description: To provide an event argument extraction method for improving accuracy of argument extraction in extracting an event from a text, an event argument extraction apparatus, an electronic device, a storage medium, and a computer program product.SOLUTION: An event argument extraction method includes: acquiring an event content to be extracted; performing argument extraction on the event content to be extracted, on the basis of a trained event argument extraction model; and acquiring a target argument of the event content to be extracted. The trained event argument extraction model acquires an advance training model by training with event news label data and weights of labeled arguments in the event news label data.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Training having function of predictably responding to difference
description: To provide a computer mounting method for training a function capable of machine learning and a corresponding system, and a computer readable medium including an instruction and/or a function parameter.SOLUTION: A system 100 for training a function capable of machine learning includes a data interface 120 and a processor sub-system 140. The data interface 120 accesses a training data set 030 of a data storage 021 including a plurality of training input observations. The data interface 120 accesses a set of parameters 040 having a function capable of machine learning to be trained. At a learned point in time, the parameter 040 is used to apply the function capable of machine learning to the observations. The processor sub-system 140 learns the set of the parameters having the function capable of machine learning by optimizing an object function during operation.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Machine learning heterogeneous edge device, method, and system
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a new and innovative machine learning heterogeneous edge device, method and system.  In a heterogeneous group in which a server communicates with one or more edge devices over one or more networks and / or communication paths, the edge devices are communication modules, data acquisition devices, memories, machine learning modules. , Includes group decision module and leader selection module. Edge devices analyze the collected data with a model, output the results, update the model to create a local model, communicate with other edge devices in heterogeneous groups, determine group membership, and lead edge. Determine the device, receive the request for the local model, send the local model to the leader edge device, receive the mixed model created by the leader edge device mixing the local model with a different local model, and receive the local model. Replace the model with a mixed model.  [Selection diagram] FIG. 4

title: Judgment result presentation program, judgment result presentation method, and judgment result presentation device
description: [Problem] To present appropriate information to be used for a user's decision-making based on a prediction result of a machine learning model. [Solution] A computer executes a process of calculating a first contribution of first data including a plurality of factors to a first prediction result of a machine learning model, referring to information 22 that associates a second contribution of the second data to a second prediction result of the machine learning model, using second data including a plurality of factors as an input, with a user's judgment result on the second prediction result, calculating a similarity between the third contribution and the fourth contribution based on a third contribution obtained by adjusting the calculated first contribution in accordance with a factor of interest of the second contribution and a fourth contribution obtained by adjusting the second contribution in accordance with the factor of interest, and controlling a priority of a judgment result to be presented among a plurality of judgment results included in the information 22 based on the calculated similarity. [Selected Figure] FIG.

title: Distributed training method, apparatus, electronic device, storage medium and computer program for deep learning models
description: To provide a distributed training method and device for a deep learning model, an electronic apparatus and a storage medium which improve the efficiency of distributed training of the deep learning model, improve the utilization ratio of a cluster hardware resource and are high in the extendability, maintainability and robustness.SOLUTION: A method comprises the steps of: generating a distributed computing view based on data information of a to-be-trained deep learning model (201); generating a cluster resource view based on attribute information of cluster hardware resources corresponding to the to-be-trained deep learning model (202); determining a target segmentation strategy of the distributed training task based on the distributed computing view and the cluster resource view (203); and performing distributed training on the to-be-trained deep learning model based on the target segmentation strategy (204).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Method and device for controlling food quality and system for processing food comprising said device
description: To provide users and/or end customers with safe products with good quality and controlled from a view point of food safety.SOLUTION: Described is an apparatus (3) for controlling quality of a food product. The device (3) comprises a quality control module (14). The quality control module (14) comprises: at least one sensorized device (S) adapted to detect at least one parameter relating to a property of a food product (P); and a processing and control unit (11) connected to the sensorized device (S) for receiving detected values relating to the property of the food product (P). The processing and control unit (11) is configured to derive a quality indication of the food product (P) based on the value detected by the sensorized device (S). The device (3) comprises a transmission module (12) connected to the processing and control unit (11) and configured to transmit information related to the derived quality indication.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Information retrieval method, device and system
description: The present invention provides an information search method, device and system. The information search method receives a search word transmitted from a user via a client (SlOl), and identifies the user's search intention based on the characteristic information of the search word and/or the search context characteristic information (SlOl). SlO2), using a search policy corresponding to the identified search intention and performing a search based on the above search word, and obtaining an information search result related to the search word (SlO3), and the information search result To the client and display the information retrieval result on the client (SlO4).

title: Machine Learning Variable Selection and Root Cause Discovery with Cumulative Prediction
description: A series of models accumulate r-squared values for an increasing number of variables to quantify the importance of each variable to predicting target yield or parametric response.  [Selection drawing] Fig. 8

title: 3D Intersection Structure Prediction for Autonomous Driving Applications
description: In various examples, a three-dimensional (3D) intersection structure can be predicted based on processing two-dimensional (2D) input data using a deep neural network (DNN). To train the DNN to accurately predict the 3D intersection structure from the 2D input, the DNN first compares the 3D output of the -DNN after transformation to 2D space with the 2D ground truth data. It can be trained using a loss function and a second loss function that analyzes the DNN's 3D predictions considering one or more geometric constraints—e.g., using geometric knowledge of intersection points , can penalize predictions of DNNs that do not match the geometry of known intersections and/or road structures. As such, the live perception of autonomous or semi-autonomous vehicles can be used by DNNs to detect the 3D positions of intersection structures from 2D inputs.

title: Biometric Authentication Based on Heart Signals
description: A method and system for biometric authentication. A cardiac signal, such as a ballistocardiogram signal, acquired from a reference subject is segmented into cardiac segments over a selected duration. The cardiac signal may be acquired using a remote non-invasive millimeter wave radar detector. A linear mapping is applied to each cardiac segment to generate a respective cardiac frequency encoding, which is assigned an identification label for the reference subject. During a modeling phase, a machine learning process is applied to the set of cardiac frequency encodings to produce a model for subject classification. During an identification phase, the model is applied to an input cardiac frequency encoding to classify the input cardiac frequency encoding as belonging to the reference subject if a matching classification is obtained, or to determine that the input cardiac frequency encoding belongs to a non-reference subject if a matching classification is not obtained. Subject identification may be utilized for healthcare monitoring applications. Optionally, FIG.

title: Random Access Channel Procedures Using Neural Networks
description: The wireless communication system (100) uses DNN or other neural networks (118, 130, 138, 146) to provide RACH technology. The TX DNN (118) of the user equipment (UE) (108) generates and transmits a random access (RA) signal (124) wirelessly to the base station (BS) 110. The BS (110) receives the RA signal (124) as an input and generates from this input an RA response signal (150) for wireless transmission to the UE (108).

title: Target recognition method, target recognition model training method and device
description: The disclosure provides a target recognition method, a target recognition model training device, an electronic device, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product, relates to the field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of image processing, computer vision and deep learning, and can be applied to scenes such as 3D vision and virtual reality. The scheme is as follows: initializing a student model to be trained and determining a trained teacher model; acquiring sample data and corresponding label data, wherein the label data is used for marking the position of the area where the corresponding target to be identified is located in the sample data; respectively inputting sample data into a student model and a teacher model to obtain a first characteristic diagram and a target recognition result output by the student model and a second characteristic diagram output by the teacher model; determining a distillation loss value based on the first and second feature maps and the label data; adjusting a parameter value of the student model based on the distillation loss value and the determined target identification loss value.

title: Multi-classification change detection method and system for multi-scale fusion of bitemporal remote sensing images
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of remote sensing image processing, and discloses a multi-classification change detection method and system for multi-scale fusion of bi-temporal remote sensing images. The multi-classification change detection method for multi-scale fusion of bi-temporal remote sensing images comprises: first Two single-phase images are put into the ShelfNet network of the first stage to extract their respective high-level semantic features, and then the extracted features are fused and mapped to a new space; the second-stage semantic segmentation network is constructed in the space PSPNet extracts the deep-level features of the fusion features and performs similarity judgment, so that the correlation of unchanged pixels increases, and the correlation between changed pixels decreases, and finally the result map of multi-class change detection is determined. The invention speeds up the running speed and reduces the consumption of resources.

title: A device state detection method
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of mechanical system vibration state monitoring, and in particular relates to a device state detection method. The invention collects normal data of multiple working conditions and learns from the normal data, and constructs a training sample that only uses the normal multiple working conditions vibration data. Learn and train deep learning models to realize real-time online identification of abnormal states. Specifically, the essential features of the data are extracted through the deep learning network, and then various types of abnormal data are discriminated according to the established abnormal monitoring thresholds. In addition, the method of the present invention makes full use of time domain, frequency domain, and autocorrelation information, and can capture the essential characteristics of normal samples under multiple working conditions by performing feature extraction through a deep self-encoder, and effectively improve the abnormal detection capability of vibration states under multiple working conditions. . Thus, the present invention solves the problem of low anomaly detection accuracy in the prior art.

title: A 3D Image Method Based on Image Inpainting
description: The present invention provides an image 3D transformation method based on image restoration, which includes: obtaining an image to be processed, obtaining image depth through a pre-trained depth extraction model; obtaining a primary background edge map based on a preset depth edge value, and The background edge image is filtered and the connected domain is detected to obtain an accurate background edge map; the image range that needs to be repaired in the precise background edge map is determined according to the preset 3D effect, and the content used for the repair processing is obtained from the to-be-processed image material; input the image to be processed, the precise background edge map, the background image range to be repaired, and the content material into a pre-trained image repair model to generate a repaired background image; combine the foreground image with the repaired background image, according to Output converted video with preset 3D effect. The present invention can be more widely used in practical scenes, has strong robustness, and can also achieve good processing effects on images with complex foreground and background.

title: A customer value tiering method based on transfer federated learning
description: The invention discloses a customer value stratification method based on migration federated learning, which includes the following steps: S1. Summarize customer big data to obtain data from a basic data platform, provide a basic data source for a tag library module, and do Preprocessing; S2, establish a big data aggregation and sharing module, each isolated small base station calculates the weighted distance sum to the adjacent small base stations, and the load can be simplified to the number of users connected to the small base station; S3: Build an auxiliary model, including classification label, get the federated learning model; S4, use the federated learning model to set the data weight: S5, test the data quality, for the evaluation weight value and the growth rate index of the evaluation weight value with outliers, set the outliers to this type of customer group Corresponding to the mean and median of attributes, the final stratification can be realized, which can accurately evaluate the value of customers, so that the final value score can fully reflect the value of customers.

title: Image reconstruction model generation and image reconstruction method, device, device and medium
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses an image reconstruction model generation method, an image reconstruction device, an image reconstruction equipment and a medium, wherein the image reconstruction model generation method comprises the following steps: acquiring fully-sampled magnetic resonance K-space data, and obtaining under-sampled K-space data corresponding to the fully-sampled magnetic resonance K-space data based on a preset low-resolution sampling model; inputting the under-sampled K-space data, performing optimization solution according to an inverse problem of a preset low-resolution model to obtain a sub-problem, establishing an over-resolution reconstruction to generate a network model, then training the over-resolution reconstruction to generate the network model according to the under-sampled reconstruction image generated by the model and a full-sampling reconstruction image corresponding to the full-sampling magnetic resonance K-space data based on a judgment network output result, and generating a target image reconstruction model. According to the technical scheme, the high-resolution image can be reconstructed while the sampling acceleration multiple is increased, and the image quality is improved.

title: Rule-based management device
description: A rule base (200) for storing a plurality of rules each composed of a condition part and a conclusion part, a case information database (210) for storing case information related to rule application results, and case information satisfying the rules and rules Using the associating unit (108) to be associated and the condition part of the rule to be validated as a key, the case information set is searched from the case information database by the case searching unit (110), and in the case information set, the conclusion part of the rule And a validity check unit (106) that calculates the proportion of case information that satisfies the conditions, and the validity check unit (106) determines the validity of the rule based on the proportion.

title: Chip recognition learning system
description: The chip recognition learning system 10 includes a game recording device 11 that records the state of the chips W stacked on the game table 4 as an image by the camera 212, and an image analysis of the recorded image of the state of the chip W, and a player. A chip determination device 12 including an artificial intelligence device 12a for determining the number and type of chips W bet by C, and a determination by the chip determination device 12 when the determination result of the chip determination device 12 is determined to be erroneous. And a teacher device 13 for inputting the number and type of chips W of correct answers to errors and errors as errors to the artificial intelligence device 12a for learning.

title: Methods and systems for automated personalization
description: The present disclosure provides a system for automating custom personalization for a target website. The system comprises: an artificial intelligence (AI) engine including one or more machine learning algorithm trained models for providing one or more personalization features; a personalization module configured for integrating the one or more personalization features into the target website; and a user interface module configured to provide a graphical user interface (GUI) for a user to modify and manage the one or more personalization features.

title: Information processing system, information processing device, information processing method, and program
description: An information processing system according to the present invention comprises a first information processing device for acquiring the data to be inferred, and a second information processing device. The first information processing device has: a first inference unit that performs, using a first partial model composed of an input layer and some of intermediate layers, a first inference process on the data to be inferred; and a third inference unit that performs, using a third partial model that includes an output layer, a third inference for the output from a second partial mode. The second information processing device is provided with a second inference unit that performs, using a second partial model composed from intermediate layers of a trained inference model that are different than the intermediate layers that constitute the first partial model, a second inference process, with the result of having performed the first inference process as an input.

title: Controlled-phase quantum logic gate
description: A method and circuit QED implementation of a control-phase quantum logic gate U CP (?) = diag[1,1,1, ei?]. Two qubits Qi, two resonators Ra, Rb and a modulator. Q1 and Q2, each has a frequency ? qi and characterized by ð zi . Ra is associated with Q1 and defined by a quantum non-demolition (QND) longitudinal coupling g 1z ð 1z (â + â). Rb is integrated into Ra, the QND second longitudinal coupling is defined by Ra as g 2z ð 2z (b^+b^) or, when Rb is integrated intoRa, the QND second longitudinal coupling is defined by Ra as g 2z ð 2z (â + â) The modulator periodically modulates, at a frequency ? m during a time t, the longitudinal coupling strengths g 1z and g 2z with respective signals of respective amplitudes g~ 1 and g~ 2 . Selecting a defined value for each of t, g 1z and g 2z determines ? to specify a quantum logical operation performed by the gate. Q1 and Q2 are decoupled when either one of g 1z and g 2z is to set to 0.

title: Method, apparatus and computer program for generating robust automated learning systems and testing trained automated learning systems
description: The present invention pertains to a method for training the neural network 100, a method for testing the neuronal network 100 as well as a method for detecting adversarial examples, which can fool the neural network 100. A superposed classification is backpropagated through the second neural network 500, Maryland the output value of the second neural network 500 is utilized to determine whether the input of the neuronal network 100 is adversarial example. Set methods of the present invention are based upon this utilization of the second neural network 500. The present invention further pertains to a computer program and an apparatus which are configured to carry out a said methods.

title: An emergency communication satellite terminal management system
description: The present invention discloses an emergency communication satellite terminal management system. In order to improve the information management of emergency satellite phones, the present invention gives full play to the important role of satellite phones in emergency communication, constructs a scientific and reasonable satellite phone management system, and realizes the unified registration, monitoring, management and GIS display for basic information, allocation information, number resource information, operation status and location information of satellite phones and portable satellite stations based on basic requirements of command and dispatch of emergency communication. In case of emergencies, the above management system can provide information resources and decision-making basis for the command department to uniformly dispatch emergency communication resources, so as to improve emergency communication support capability. The main functions of the system include satellite terminal monitoring, satellite terminal management, statistical analysis, GIS display and monitoring, and emergency resource sharing.

title: Photo assisted self-diagnosis of appliances
description: Systems and methods for photograph assisted self-diagnosis of appliance. The method includes receiving, by a processor, a first set of data related to an appliance from an electronic device; identifying, by the processor, a model of the appliance based on the first set of data; receiving, by the processor, a second set of data from the electronic device; identifying, using a machine learning model, an issue of the appliance by using the second set of data; and transmitting, by the processor, a recommendation for fixing the issue to the electronic device.

title: Method, system and computer program product for self-learned and probabilistic-based prediction of inter-camera object movement
description: A method, system and computer program product for self-learned and probabilistic-based prediction of inter-camera object movement is disclosed. The method includes building and storing a transition model defined by transition probability and transition time distribution data generated during operation of a first video camera and one or more other video cameras over time. The method also includes employing at least one balance flow algorithm on the transition probability and transition time distribution data to determine a subset of the video cameras to initiate a search for an object based on a query. The method also includes running the search for the object over the subset of the video cameras.

title: Auto-adjudication process via machine learning
description: An example operation may include one or more of receiving a loan application of a user, extracting a plurality of personal attributes about the user from the loan application, querying a machine learning model via an application programming interface (API) based on the plurality of attributes about the user to identify one or more rules for auto-adjudicating the loan application, determining whether or not to approve the loan application based on the one or more rules identified via the machine learning model, and transmitting notice of the determination to a device associated with the user.

title: System and method for associating a signature of an animal movement and an animal activity
description: A system, apparatus, and/or method of identifying an activity of an animal. The activity may include the animal drinking, eating, urination, or defecating. Motion data of a first animal may be received, for example, via a sensor. Predetermined signatures of one or more second animals may be received. The predetermined signatures of the one or more second animals may be associated with one or more activities of the one or more second animals. A signature of an activity of the first animal may be determined based on the motion data of the first animal. Based on the signature of the activity of the first animal and the predetermined signatures of the second animal, the activity of the first animal may be identified. The identified activity of the first animal may be displayed via a display device.

title: Inference system having a frame structure and method of storing information therein
description: In an inference system, an inference mode and a knowledge editing mode can conduct inference with an inherent effect by using knowledge represented by frames in a hierarchical structure, the frames having a relationship of a parent frame being higher in the hierarchical structure than a child frame thereof. Such an inference system includes a mode determining section for selecting the knowledge editing mode or the inference mode, a storage area for storing only information intrinsic to a frame in the hierarchical structure into the frame when the knowledge editing mode is selected by the mode determining section, and a storage area for storing into the frame both information intrinsic to the frame and information inherited by the frame from frames higher in the hierarchical structure than the frame when the inference mode is selected by the mode determining section.

title: Expert system for designing computer networks
description: An expert system is used to design a computer network comprising hardware platforms, applications, data bases, user interfaces, etc. The expert system initially displays questions and receives responsive information from a user as to characteristics of backend data bases and whether copies of said backend data bases should be stored in respective frontend data bases. In response, the expert system "builds" one of a predetermined set of backend models which corresponds to the information. Next, to reduce complexity, the expert system identifies two or more of the frontend data bases of compatible type that can be merged together and then displays questions and receives responsive information indicating whether the mergers should be made. Next, the expert system displays questions and receives responsive information as to characteristics of frontend components including an intermediate server. In response, the expert system builds one of a set of predetermined frontend models which corresponds to the information. Next, the expert system identifies a function of the intermediate server that can be performed on a backend platform within the backend model. Next, the expert system displays questions and receives responsive information whether the function should be performed on the backend platform, and updates the frontend model accordingly. Next, the expert system displays questions and receives responsive information as to characteristics of connections between the updated frontend model and the backend model. In response, the expert system determines a final design of the computer network based on the connection information, backend model and updated frontend model.

title: Self-organizing neural network for pattern classification
description: A neural network includes a plurality of input nodes for receiving the respective elements of the input vector. A copy of all of the elements of the input vector is sent to the next level of nodes in the neural network denoted as intermediate nodes. The intermediate nodes each encode a separate template pattern. They compare the actual input pattern with the template and generate a signal indicative of the difference between the input pattern and the template pattern. Each of the templates encoded in the intermediate nodes has a class associated with it. The difference calculated by the intermediate nodes is passed to an output node for each of the intermediate nodes at a given class. The output node then selects the minimum difference amongst the values sent from the intermediate nodes. This lowest difference for the class represented by the output node is then forwarded to a selector. The selector receives such values from each of the output nodes of all of the classes and then selects that to output value which is a minimum difference. The selector in turn, generates a signal indicative of the class of the intermediate node that sent the smallest difference value.

title: Device and method for identifying causes of web breaks in a printing system on web manufacturing attributes
description: A device and method that determine conditions under which a break in a web of a printing system is more likely to occur store data pertaining to one or more attributes associated with the manufacture of each web used in a plurality of printing runs. The device and method then implement a correlation analysis, such as a decision-tree induction analysis, using the stored data to determine if there is a correlation between the one or more web manufacturing attributes and the occurrence of a web break. The device and method may store web manufacturing data indicating one or more of a mill site, a web manufacturing machine, a date, a reel number, a reel set, a log position, any auxiliary web manufacturing equipment, a web tensile strength, a web moisture content and/or a coefficient of friction associated with the manufacture of the webs used in the plurality of printing runs.

title: Hybrid physics-based and machine learning models for reservoir simulations
description: System and methods for simulating fluid flow during downhole operations are provided. Measurements of an operating variable at one or more locations within a formation are obtained from a downhole tool disposed in a wellbore within the formation during a current stage of a downhole operation being performed along the wellbore. The obtained measurements are applied as inputs to a hybrid model of the formation. The hybrid model includes physics-based and machine learning models that are coupled together within a simulation grid. Fluid flow within the formation is simulated, based on the inputs applied to the hybrid model. A response of the operating variable is estimated for a subsequent stage of the downhole operation along the wellbore, based on the simulation. Flow control parameters for the subsequent stage are determined based on the estimated response. The subsequent stage of the operation is performed according to the determined flow control parameters.

title: Self-learning integrity management system and related methods
description: An integrity management system predicts abnormalities in complex systems before they occur based upon the prior history of abnormalities within the complex system. A topology of the nodes of a complex system is generated and data is collected from the system based on predetermined metrics. In combination with dynamic thresholding, fingerprints of the relevant nodes within a complex system at various time intervals prior to the occurrence of the abnormality are captured and weighted. The fingerprints can then be applied to real-time data provide alerts of potential abnormality prior to their actual occurrence.

title: Feature interaction resolution using fuzzy rules
description: A method of detecting feature interaction conflicts between agents in response to events in a multi-agent system comprises posting said events as tuples and event requests as anti-tuples from said agents in said multi-agent system, receiving said events and said event requests in a tuple space, generating responses to each of said agents for said events which match said event requests of said agents, wherein feature interaction conflict is detected when more than one of said agents are to exert control over an event.

title: Historians embedded in industrial units
description: Systems and methods that provide a historian integrated as part of an industrial unit and/or product manufactured by the industrial process. A historian integrated as part of the industrial unit itself, can increase data resolution and supply immediate and real time data regarding the industrial unit's operation—while mitigating short comings of conventional PC historians. Moreover, a locator component can detect embedded historians that are distributed on the back plane of an industrial network, and integrated as part thereof.

title: Feedback in group based hierarchical temporal memory system
description: A Hierarchical Temporal Memory (HTM) network has at least first nodes and a second node at a higher level than the first nodes. The second node provides an inter-node feedback signal to the first nodes for grouping patterns and sequences (or co-occurrences) in input data received at the first nodes at the first nodes. The second node collects forward signals from the first nodes; and thus, the second node has information about the grouping of the patterns and sequences (or co-occurrences) at the first nodes. The second node provides inter-node feedback signals to the first nodes based on which the first nodes may perform the grouping of the patterns and sequences (or co-occurrences) at the first nodes.

title: Batch Normalization Layers
description: Neural network system (100) implemented by one or more computers, the neural network system comprising: a batch normalization layer (108) between a first neural network layer (104) and a second neural network layer (112) , where the first neural network layer generates first layer outputs presenting a plurality of components, and where the batch normalization layer is configured to, during training of the neural network system with a batch of training examples: receive a first respective layer output for each batch training example; calculate a plurality of standardization statistics for the batch from the first layer outputs; normalize each component of each first layer output using normalization statistics to generate a respective standardized layer output for each example of batch training; generate a respective output of the batch normalization layer for each of the training examples from the standardized layer outputs; and provide the output of the batch normalization layer as input to the second layer of neural network; where the plurality of first layer output components are indexed by dimension, and where to calculate a plurality of normalization statistics for the first layer outputs comprises: calculating, for each of the dimensions, an average of the components of the first output layer in the dimension; and calculate, for each of the dimensions, a standard deviation of the components of the first layer outputs in the dimension.

title: Method for construction universal DNA based molecular turing machine
description: This invention discloses a novel method for constructing a Universal DNA based molecular Turing machine. Included in the invention is a method of operating the DNA based Turing machine of this invention.

title: System and method for dynamic knowledge generation and distribution
description: A system and method that includes the use of a knowledge delivery computer program stored in computer-readable form on a tangible storage medium for delivering concepts from a configuration data base to a user. An author can create the configuration data base using the knowledge delivery computer program so that the configuration includes a plurality of concepts and, optionally, a plurality of problems associated with the concepts. As the author creates the concepts within the configuration, the knowledge delivery software allows the author to create a taxonomy that defines the relationships between the concepts. The knowledge delivery software can then automatically generate a pedagogy for the configuration based on the configuration taxonomy that defines how the concepts will be delivered to the user. The knowledge delivery software can facilitate the delivery of the content within the configuration to a user according to the pedagogy.

title: Method and apparatus for relocating elements in an evolvable configuration bitstream
description: A system and method for evolving configuration bitstreams for a programmable logic device are disclosed. A plurality of data structures having respective sets of data are established. From the sets of data, respective configuration bitstreams are generated, wherein the sets of data are mapped to positions in the bitstreams. The configuration bitstreams are then evaluated for relative suitability to meet predetermined criteria when deployed on a programmable logic device. From the relative suitability of the configuration bitstreams, next-generation data for the data structures are generated using a genetic algorithm applied to sets of data. In the various embodiments, the configuration bitstreams eliminate resource contentions, selectively eliminate asynchronous behavior, include built-in test circuits, and are relocatable. Multiple populations of configuration bitstreams can evolve in parallel over a network.

title: Control device and control method for robot
description: A controlling apparatus for a robot of the type formed by a plurality of joint actuators and operating in accordance with a behavioral schedule comprises a behavior scheduling unit for setting a robot's behavioral schedule, an operation controller for implementing an operational pattern corresponding to the behavioral schedule as determined by the behavior scheduling unit by driving each joint actuator, a detector for detecting the state of operation implementation by the operation controller and a recording unit for recording a log including the behavioral schedule by the behavior scheduling unit and the state of operation implementation by the detector. A user issuing a command for the robot is authenticated and the contents of the command supplied from the user are recorded in combination with the behavior taken by the robot responsive to the command and the time point of implementation of the behavior.

title: Automatic data extraction, error correction and forecasting system
description: A “Rapid Learner Client Service” (RLCS) system that allows a large number of end-users to obtain the benefits of a sophisticated neural-network forecasting system. Rather than purchasing or developing a forecasting system of their own, RLCS clients subscribe to a forecasting service performed by forecasting equipment located at a remote site. This allows a single highly sophisticated forecasting system to meet the forecasting needs of a large number of subscribers. This forecasting service is performed by an RLCS server that periodically and automatically accesses the subscriber's computer to obtain a fresh set of input data. Alternatively, the subscriber's computer may contact the RLCS server to initiate the process. This input data is then downloaded to the RLCS server, where it is checked and corrected for errors by imputing values for missing or deviant input values. The error-corrected input data is then used to compute a forecast of output values, which are downloaded to the client's computer. The RLCS server also computes and downloads a set accuracy statistics for the client's review.

title: Methods and apparatus for detecting temporal process variation and for managing and predicting performance of automatic classifiers
description: Techniques for detecting temporal process variation and for managing and predicting performance of automatic classifiers applied to such processes using performance estimates based on temporal ordering of the samples are presented.

title: Incremental evaluation of complex event-condition-action rules in a database system
description: In the scenario in which a rule set is defined for composite events, instances of the associated primitive events are added to a database-centric rules engine one at a time. Rules that rely on these events fire the corresponding actions when instances of all the corresponding primitive events are detected. Intermediate states of the rule evaluations are persistently stored in the database, thereby avoiding repeated evaluation of portions of rules and supporting efficient incremental evaluation of the rules. The rules defined within a rule set could vary significantly, using various rule condition language constructs such as “any” and negation constructs. The state information generated from evaluating the rules belonging to a single rule set is all stored in a single relational table and managed using direct SQL and DML commands.

title: Soil nutrient detection method and device based on gamma ray spectrum and XGboost algorithm
description: The present invention proposes a soil nutrient detection method based on gamma ray spectroscopy and an XGboost algorithm. The method comprises: constructing a training sample for soil nutrient detection, wherein the training sample comprises radioactive element data, and the label of the training sample is soil nutrient data of the same soil point as the radioactive element data; inputting the training sample into an XGboost model, wherein the XGboost model extracts features of the training sample and predicts soil nutrients of the training sample as nutrient prediction values; constructing a loss function based on the nutrient prediction values and the labels of the training samples to train the XGboost model, thereby obtaining a soil nutrient detection model; and collecting soil radioactive elements of the soil to be tested using a gamma ray spectrometer, and inputting the collected radioactive elements into the soil nutrient detection model, thereby obtaining nutrient detection results of the soil to be tested.

title: Intelligent AI detection system and method for river channel occupation detection
description: The invention relates to the field of river channel occupation detection and discloses an intelligent AI detection system and method for river channel occupation detection, wherein the system comprises an image acquisition module, a controller and a cloud platform; the image acquisition module is connected with the controller through a wired network circuit; the system and the method can solve the problems of low efficiency, more false alarms and insufficient coverage of the traditional monitoring means, effectively improve the intelligent degree of river monitoring, realize all-weather automatic monitoring and localized data processing, and remarkably enhance the real-time performance, reliability and stability of the system.

title: Rainbow trout phenotype measurement and sex judgment method based on deep learning
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural aquaculture, and relates to a method for measuring the phenotype of rainbow trout and determining the sex of the rainbow trout based on deep learning. The various parts of the rainbow trout in the photo are annotated and preprocessed as the training set and verification set of the model; the Unet model of the full convolutional neural network is used for training, and the optimal model is obtained to complete the segmentation of the various parts of the rainbow trout; the color thresholds of the various parts of the rainbow trout after segmentation are defined respectively, and the contour is searched to obtain the minimum circumscribed matrix; the actual length and width of the various parts of the rainbow trout are calculated by the ratio relationship between the physical distance and the image pixels, and the fish weight is calculated by the function relationship between the body length and the weight; according to the ratio relationship between the length and width of the head, the judgment of the sex of the rainbow trout is realized based on the support vector machine. The present invention can quickly obtain the phenotypic information such as the body length, total length, body width and weight of the rainbow trout, improve the low efficiency, and minimize the damage to the fish body; the sex of the rainbow trout is identified by image processing to meet the needs of the production and processing of the rainbow trout.

title: Code detection method, electronic device and computer readable medium
description: The present invention discloses a code detection method, an electronic device and a computer-readable medium. When performing code detection, the code to be detected is first preprocessed to obtain a code word block index sequence; then, the code word block index sequence is embedded to represent the code word block index sequence, and the relative position encoding of each word block in the code word block index sequence is obtained, and based on the relative position encoding, the embedded representation of the code word block index sequence is embedded and enhanced and then modeled to obtain a code semantic vector sequence; then, the code semantic vector sequence is tested for vulnerabilities to obtain code detection results. The present invention introduces relative position encoding during code detection, which can better capture the relative position information of each word block in the code word block index sequence; and based on the relative position encoding, the embedded representation of the code word block index sequence is embedded and enhanced, generating a vector representation of code semantics with rich semantic information and more accurate, which greatly improves the accuracy of code detection.

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for data processing
description: According to embodiments of the present disclosure, a method, apparatus, device, and storage medium for data processing are provided. The method includes: obtaining initial prompt word information generated based on user input at a client; encrypting the initial prompt word information using a target key to obtain encrypted prompt word information; retrieving at least one target encrypted knowledge fragment that matches the encrypted prompt word information from multiple encrypted knowledge fragments, the multiple encrypted knowledge fragments being encrypted using the target key; and obtaining a response to the user input using a machine learning model based on the at least one target encrypted knowledge fragment. This reduces the risk of data resource leakage during storage and transmission, thereby addressing data security issues.

title: Data protection method, device and storage medium for fingerprint browser
description: The invention provides a data protection method, equipment and media for a fingerprint browser, which comprise the steps of inputting equipment fingerprint data, constructing an equipment fingerprint data set, respectively calculating entropy values of each feature according to a high-frequency feature set and a low-frequency feature set, constructing an entropy value set of each feature, designing a low-frequency feature disturbance formula aiming at the low-frequency feature set to obtain a disturbed low-frequency feature value and a disturbed low-frequency feature set, constructing an countermeasure network according to the high-frequency feature set and the disturbed low-frequency feature set, collecting dynamic feedback information of a tracking system in real time, and finally outputting an updated generated countermeasure network and a verified confusion feature set. The invention solves the contradiction between privacy protection and functional compatibility in the prior art, and remarkably improves the dynamic adaptation capability of the system.

title: Street interface digital diagnosis and optimization method and system based on multi-agent line-of-sight simulation
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for digital diagnosis and optimization of street interfaces based on multi-agent line of sight simulation, the system includes a data acquisition module for acquiring architectural image data of target city streets in the current state; a sand table construction module for combining geographic data and architectural image data of target city streets and constructing a digital sand table of a three-dimensional model of the target city streets in the current state; a pedestrian trajectory acquisition module for acquiring the original dynamic trajectory of pedestrians in the target city streets in the current state; an agent module, an identification and measurement module, a diagnosis and optimization module, and a display and interaction module. The present invention collects the target street pedestrian movement trajectory data and creates a simulation environment in a three-dimensional real-scene digital sand table, which improves the accuracy and efficiency of the simulation, ensures that the results of the digital diagnosis meet the actual situation of the real street and the needs of real work, and improves the scientificity and standardization of the digital diagnosis and optimization of the street interface.

title: Flood prediction method based on deep learning algorithm
description: The invention discloses a flood prediction method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining and processing geospatial data and rainfall data, inputting the obtained data into a flood numerical model to obtain a flood sample, preprocessing the obtained geospatial data, the rainfall data and flood sample data obtained from the numerical model to construct a model training database, inputting one-dimensional rainfall data and two-dimensional geospatial data in the model training database as models, and outputting the flood sample as a model to train a flood prediction model. Before extreme rainfall occurs, only the geospatial data and rainfall sequence data of the research area are input into the model, so that a flood risk map of the research area can be calculated.

title: Digital twin intelligent manufacturing and testing system for key parts of aerospace equipment
description: The invention discloses a digital twin intelligent manufacturing and testing system for key parts of aerospace equipment, which belongs to the field of intelligent manufacturing and comprises an intelligent manufacturing module, a surface detection module, a nondestructive inspection module and a mechanical detection module. The intelligent manufacturing module digitizes the manufacturing process by means of a digital twin technology, is convenient for mapping the processing process state and the subsequent detection result, the surface detection module mainly uses visual detection, uses two-dimensional or three-dimensional visual information and combines an artificial intelligent algorithm to realize the detection of the surface processing quality, the nondestructive inspection module detects the internal defects of the parts by means of internal defect inspection equipment, and the mechanical detection module mainly simulates the detection of the mechanical characteristics and life cycle of the parts under dynamic working conditions such as stress, temperature and the like. The invention realizes the digital mapping of the intelligent manufacturing process, the surface characteristic, the internal characteristic and the mechanical property by constructing the neural network architecture, thereby achieving the purpose of gradually replacing the physical test by using the digital test.

title: Intelligent body training method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: This disclosure provides an agent training method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium, belonging to the field of agent training technology. The method includes: determining a first policy model for a master agent and a second policy model for a training agent, wherein the first policy model is a model in the master agent's historical version pool, and the second policy model is a model in the training agent's historical version pool; updating the first policy model based on the interaction data between the first and second policy models to obtain a third policy model; updating the second policy model based on the interaction data between the first and second policy models to obtain a fourth policy model; adding the third policy model to the master agent's historical version pool, and adding the fourth policy model to the training agent's historical version pool. The agent training method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium provided by this disclosure can meet the practical needs of asymmetric tasks with variable policies and complex environments.

title: Acceleration performance test method and system for unmanned motorcycle under extreme working conditions
description: The invention relates to a method and a system for testing acceleration performance under a limited condition of an unmanned motorcycle, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned motorcycle testing. The method comprises the steps of firstly, generating an overall scene library according to an open source scene data set generated by an automatic driving actual test, secondly, collecting a part of scenes of an unmanned motorcycle for limiting working condition test in a real environment as a part of limiting working condition scene data set, training by using a generating countermeasure learning method to obtain a limiting working condition virtual scene library which is simultaneously based on the overall scene library and contains limiting working condition characteristics, thirdly, clustering the generated limiting working condition virtual scene library by adopting unsupervised learning, randomly generating according to proportion of various scenes obtained by clustering when the limiting working condition test is carried out, and fourthly, carrying out acceleration performance test on the unmanned motorcycle according to the result of the unmanned motorcycle tested in the generated limiting working condition virtual scene library.

title: A method and system for predicting small and micro enterprise credit based on reinforcement learning
description: The invention provides a small and micro enterprise credit prediction method and system based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining credit evaluation data of loan application clients, evaluating credit scores of the loan application clients by using a credit score model, giving classification results according to the relation between the credit scores and score thresholds, optimizing the score thresholds according to environment states by using a trained reinforcement learning model, wherein the environment states comprise actual repayment conditions of the clients after the credit is expired, credit scores and loan information of repayment clients and unrendered clients, and can also comprise other state features such as industry overall bad account rates and the like which can be used for describing market conditions. Compared with the traditional method, the real-time updating mechanism based on the actual repayment data can enable the score threshold to be set more reasonably and timely, so that the score threshold is not too high or too low at any time, and the optimal input-output ratio is achieved.

title: Model construction method, prediction method and device based on multi-target object interaction
description: The present invention relates to the field of visual perception processing technology, and discloses a model construction method, a prediction method and a device based on multi-target object interaction. The present invention uses first distance information, second distance information, first posture information and second posture information of multiple target objects to characterize the interaction relationship between the multiple target objects, and then constructs a stereoscopic visual interaction model. Because the multiple target objects are automatically associated in the same stereoscopic visual interaction model, there is no need to repeatedly rebuild the stereoscopic visual interaction model corresponding to a single target object and continuously infer the interaction relationship. Therefore, the present invention not only simplifies the tedious process of model construction, but also improves the accuracy of model construction.

title: Method, device and electronic device for identifying the functional state of temporomandibular joint movement based on multimodal deep learning
description: The invention relates to a temporomandibular joint movement function state identification method and device based on multi-mode deep learning and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-modal data sample from a pre-built temporomandibular joint movement function state database, preprocessing the multi-modal data sample, respectively training and optimizing a pre-trained image segmentation model and an image classification model according to data types based on the preprocessed multi-modal data sample, fusing the trained image segmentation model and the trained image classification model by a back-end fusion method to obtain a multi-modal deep learning model, training and optimizing the multi-modal deep learning model by the preprocessed multi-modal data sample, obtaining multi-modal data to be identified, inputting the trained multi-modal deep learning model, and obtaining a corresponding temporomandibular joint movement function state identification result. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of improving the efficiency and accuracy of temporal and mandibular joint movement function state identification and the like.

title: System version management method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a system version management method, a system version management device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining to-be-processed data corresponding to a first system and a second system associated with the first system under the condition that version updating of the first system is detected, determining version consistency states of the second systems by determining fingerprint information and system version information of the second systems, processing the fingerprint information, the system operation information and the system version information of the second systems based on a pre-built version compatibility prediction model, determining the version compatibility states of the second systems, and carrying out early warning processing if the version consistency state of any second system is inconsistent and/or incompatible. The scheme improves the accuracy and the high efficiency of the version management of the system by detecting the version consistency state and the version compatibility state of the multiple systems.

title: A dynamic optimization method, device and medium for a central Mesh network
description: The invention provides a dynamic optimization method, a device and a medium of a central Mesh network, which relate to the technical field of dynamic optimization of the central Mesh network, and the invention takes the current moment as a starting point to collect operation time sequence data and service request time sequence data of the Mesh network, wherein the operation time sequence data comprises information such as node residual energy, link quality, bandwidth utilization rate and the like, classifies the service request data according to priority, counts the request quantity and data quantity of various services and generates a service request feature vector; the method comprises the steps of extracting characteristics of network operation data by adopting a time sequence modeling method, dynamically distributing characteristic weights by using an attention mechanism, generating a joint characteristic vector through dimension reduction processing, providing input characteristics for multi-objective optimization, constructing a global optimization path planning model according to the generated joint characteristic vector, solving a multi-objective optimization function by applying a genetic algorithm, and searching a Pareto optimal solution, so that a path planning scheme with highest fitness is output.

title: Equipment status assessment method and model training method thereof, electronic equipment
description: The disclosure provides a state evaluation method of equipment, a model training method thereof and electronic equipment. The network architecture of the state evaluation model comprises a bidirectional gating circulation unit network and an attention mechanism layer, the training method comprises the steps of obtaining a time sequence sample, inputting the time sequence sample into the state evaluation model to additively fuse multi-dimensional parameters contained in the equipment operation data by the attention mechanism layer, inputting an additively fused result into the bidirectional gating circulation unit network to extract equipment state characteristics by the bidirectional gating circulation unit network and output equipment prediction states, and adjusting model parameters of the state evaluation model according to the equipment labeling states and loss errors of the equipment prediction states. In the state evaluation model disclosed by the disclosure, the attention mechanism layer is combined with the bidirectional gating circulation unit network, so that the overall accuracy and reliability of the state evaluation model can be greatly improved.

title: Encrypted traffic classification method and system based on word sense aggregation and semantic separation technology
description: The present invention discloses an encrypted traffic classification method and system based on word sense aggregation and semantic separation technology, which belongs to the field of cyberspace security. Aiming at the problem that current methods cannot effectively understand encrypted traffic data, word sense aggregation and semantic separation technology are adopted to retain the complete word meaning through word sense aggregation, and decouple abstract features in different category spaces through semantic separation, thereby enhancing feature distinguishability and achieving a more accurate encrypted traffic classification effect.

title: A kiwi fruit visual counting method based on knowledge distillation of 1+2+1 distillation model
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of image recognition, and particularly relates to a knowledge distillation kiwi fruit vision counting method in a 1+2+1 distillation mode, which comprises the steps of constructing a student model by using a YOLOv11 network model; the method comprises the steps of taking a SEAM attention module as a detection head of a YOLOv11 network model to obtain a teacher model, adding an SBA self-adaptive attention module and a SOEP module to a neck network of the YOLOv11 network model, distilling the two teaching aiding models by using the teacher model to obtain two distillation loss functions, performing distillation training on a student model by using the sum of the two distillation loss functions, performing self-distillation operation on the student model, and detecting and counting input kiwi fruit images by using the student model after distillation training. The invention can solve the problem of overlarge gap between the teacher model and the student model, improve the reliability and the accuracy of the model and realize efficient kiwi fruit counting.

title: A high-resolution human key point detection method and system
description: This invention discloses a high-resolution human keypoint detection method and system. The method includes the following steps: S1, selecting a dataset; S2, preprocessing the dataset; S3, constructing a pyramid-shaped high-resolution network, including a shuffling module and a feature fusion module; wherein, the shuffling module consists of a feature preservation branch and a feature extraction branch, the feature extraction branch including a PSA module and a convolutional layer; the feature fusion module first fuses from the high-resolution branch to the low-resolution branch, then fuses from the low-resolution branch to the high-resolution branch, and finally adds the results of the two fusions as the output; S4, training the human keypoint network constructed in S3 using the dataset preprocessed in S2; S5, selecting the network with the best performance during training for human keypoint prediction, introducing a super-resolution head heatmap post-processing method to obtain the keypoint locations. This invention can extract rich multi-scale spatial information and capture important cross-dimensional features in the channel attention vector.

title: Sparse large-scale multi-objective optimization method based on generation countermeasure network
description: The invention discloses a sparse large-scale multi-objective optimization method based on a generation countermeasure network, which relates to the technical field of large-scale multi-objective optimization. According to the invention, through sparse data preprocessing, a sparsity control mechanism and multiple rounds of countermeasure learning circulation, solution set diversity and coverage rate of a generated countermeasure network in multi-objective optimization are improved, a mode collapse phenomenon is effectively avoided, and an optimization result is more comprehensive. When the high-dimensional sparse data is processed, through feature extraction, dimension reduction and dynamic learning rate adjustment, the computational complexity is reduced, the training efficiency and stability are improved, the generator is ensured to be capable of exploring the sparse region and the high-density region of the solution space in a balanced mode, and efficient and reliable technical support is provided for complex decision scenes.

title: Target detection method and system based on SIP and MFWF
description: The present invention provides a target detection method and system based on SIP and MFWF in the field of target detection technology, the method comprising: step S1, obtaining a large number of historical aerial images for preprocessing to construct a data set, dividing the data set into a training set, a verification set, and a test set; step S2, creating a target detection model based on a backbone network, a neck network, and a head network, and setting a loss function of the target detection model; step S3, training the target detection model through the training set until the loss value of the loss function is less than a preset loss threshold, then verifying the trained target detection model with the verification set, and testing the verified target detection model with the test set; step S4, deploying the tested target detection model, and performing target detection through the deployed target detection model. The advantages of the present invention are: greatly improving the accuracy of small target detection.

title: Highway carbon emission analysis method, storage medium and computer terminal equipment based on dynamic Bayesian network
description: The invention aims to solve the technical problem of providing a dynamic Bayesian network-based expressway carbon emission analysis method, a storage medium and computer terminal equipment, which can realize dynamic analysis and probabilistic evaluation of expressway carbon emission in an operation period. A highway carbon emission analysis method based on a dynamic Bayesian network comprises the steps of establishing Kaya identical formulas according to key factors affecting the total highway carbon emission of a research target area, taking the key factors as hidden variables, taking primary variables and secondary variables affecting hidden variables as observation variables, establishing a dynamic Bayesian network model, carrying out hidden variable state simulation by using the dynamic Bayesian network model to generate hidden variable posterior distribution samples at different time points, calculating contribution degrees of hidden variables in each hidden variable sample by using a LMDI decomposition method, and counting contribution degrees of all samples to generate probability distribution of contribution degrees of hidden variables. The invention is helpful for more scientifically and accurately formulating a dynamic emission reduction strategy.

title: Monitoring and alarm method and device based on AI identification of dangerous points in on-site working environment
description: The application relates to the field of intelligent safety management, and provides a monitoring alarm method and a device based on-site operation environment dangerous point AI identification, wherein on-site operation images acquired by a on-site camera are transmitted to edge computing equipment, and on the edge computing equipment, a first dangerous point identification result used for indicating whether a worker wears a safety belt and a second dangerous point identification result used for indicating whether a dangerous area exists in a scaffold are obtained by identifying the states of workers and scaffolds in the on-site operation images, and different grades of emergency alarm prompts are generated by combining the first dangerous point identification result and the second dangerous point identification result. Therefore, the abnormal wearing condition of the safety belt can be accurately identified in real time, meanwhile, the hidden danger of the scaffold can be rapidly detected, the dynamic evaluation of composite risks and grading early warning are realized, and the safety prevention and control precision and initiative are improved.

title: A digital virtual staining method and system for pathological sections based on a CycleGAN-based unsupervised model
description: The invention discloses a pathological section digital virtual staining method and system of CycleGAN-based unsupervised model, belonging to the field of digital pathology and artificial intelligence data processing. By combining the multi-modal information, the autofluorescence image and DAPI image of the unstained tissue section are used as input and converted into a traditional hematoxylin-eosin staining output image for pathology diagnosis. The method utilizes an unsupervised model, avoids dependence on a pixel-level matching training set, and breaks through the limitation of the traditional supervised model. Experimental results show that the generated virtual dyeing image is excellent in dyeing consistency and contrast, and the accuracy and efficiency of clinical diagnosis can be improved. In addition, the method adopts a conventional fluorescence microscope, avoids the use of chemical reagents and complex experimental equipment, and provides higher practical value for clinical transformation of the virtual dyeing technology.

title: Optimization method and device for improving proximal strategy based on language model, and electronic device
description: The application discloses an optimization method and device for improving a near-end strategy based on a language model and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a plurality of answers corresponding to question data, and determining a first probability value of a single vocabulary in each answer based on the answers; the method includes determining a first probability value for a single word in each answer based on a reference model in the language model, determining a KL divergence based on the first probability value and the first probability value, determining an instant prize for each answer based on a prize model in the language model and a target prize signal, and determining a target loss function based on the question data, the answers, the first probability value, the instant prize, and the KL divergence to update a policy model of the language model based on the target loss function. The method can relieve the memory occupation problem in the near-end strategy training process, reduce the memory use, improve concurrency and accelerate the generation and training process of answers.

title: APT organization attack profile generation reasoning method, device and electronic equipment
description: The present invention provides an APT organization attack portrait generation reasoning method, device and electronic device, wherein the APT organization attack portrait generation reasoning method includes: obtaining reference data, and annotating the reference data through a large model; fine-tuning the large model through the reference data to obtain a target large model; obtaining a text to be analyzed, and performing entity recognition and relationship extraction on the text to be analyzed through the target large model to obtain entity results and relationship results; constructing a knowledge graph based on the extracted entity results and the relationship results, and generating an APT organization attack portrait; performing attack reasoning on the APT organization attack portrait to obtain a reasoning result. Through the present invention, the behavior pattern, attack strategy and potential targets of the APT organization can be revealed from multiple dimensions, solving the problem of poor accuracy in the existing attack portrait generation reasoning method.

title: A road lane segmentation method and system based on semantic segmentation
description: The present disclosure provides a road lane line segmentation method and system based on semantic segmentation, which relates to the field of autonomous driving technology. The method comprises: obtaining an actual road image; inputting the actual road image into a trained semantic segmentation network to obtain a segmented lane line region; skeletonizing the segmented lane line region to obtain a lane line segmentation result; wherein the semantic segmentation network is an improved BEIT network, in which two different feature extractors are used to extract features from the input image, the extracted features are data enhanced through the Align hybrid strategy, and then the enhanced image is segmented. The present disclosure can improve the accuracy of road lane line segmentation.

title: A dynamic detection and analysis method for early performance of ultra-high performance concrete
description: The invention relates to the technical field of concrete detection, in particular to a dynamic detection and analysis method for early performance of ultra-high performance concrete. The technical scheme includes that the method comprises the steps of establishing a raw material characteristic spectrum library based on multi-physical field coupling, constructing a dynamic detection array based on a time sequence, developing a multi-mode data fusion algorithm, establishing a nonlinear coupling effect decomposition model and implementing dynamic parameter inversion. According to the invention, by constructing a four-dimensional monitoring network-multi-physical field coupling analysis-trans-scale prediction-self-adaptive regulation and control technology chain, dynamic accurate detection and intelligent regulation and control of the early performance of the ultra-high performance concrete are realized, the technical bottlenecks of the traditional method in terms of parameter coupling, trans-scale association and real-time regulation and control are solved, the early performance prediction precision and maintenance efficiency are remarkably improved, the cracking risk is reduced, and reliable technical support is provided for the application of the ultra-high performance concrete in major engineering.

title: Non-volatile memory internal computing structure of enhanced MRAM and computer
description: The invention discloses a non-volatile memory computing structure of an enhanced MRAM and a computer. The in-memory computing structure comprises a memory-operation integrated array and a mode selection module. The storage-operation integrated array comprises a plurality of magnetic tunnel junctions, a plurality of vanadium dioxide phase-change materials and a plurality of transistors, wherein the magnetic tunnel junctions and the vanadium dioxide phase-change materials are connected through the transistors and form a storage unit, the storage units are arranged in a rectangular mode, the vanadium dioxide phase-change materials are in a metal state in a read-write mode, the magnetic tunnel junctions are in a storage state, the parallel magnetic tunnel junctions are combined with the metal state vanadium dioxide phase-change materials in a calculation mode, and the anti-parallel magnetic tunnel junctions are combined with the insulating state vanadium dioxide phase-change materials. The mode selection module is used for switching the working mode of the storage-operation integrated array according to the external enabling signal. The invention effectively improves the network operation energy efficiency, has higher storage density and calculation power density, and reduces the area overhead.

title: Urban municipal rainwater regulation facility layout method based on multi-objective optimization
