description: The invention relates to a town municipal rainwater regulation facility layout method based on multi-objective optimization analysis, which comprises the following steps of A, constructing a comprehensive objective function according to constraint conditions to be considered by design and a metering objective, B, establishing a hydrologic model in a target area, calibrating the hydrologic model, generating an initial layout characteristic quantization matrix X  0 , C, inputting the initial layout corresponding to the initial layout characteristic quantization matrix X  0  into the hydrologic model established in the B, simulating, calculating an initial comprehensive objective function value, and inputting the particle swarm optimization algorithm determined in the B for iterative solution to obtain the optimal solution of the comprehensive objective optimization function. According to the invention, reasonable municipal rainwater regulation facility layout positions and main facility design parameters can be provided according to a plurality of waterlogging and cost control targets, and the comprehensive operation efficiency of a municipal drainage facility system is improved while urban waterlogging and runoff pollution are reduced.

title: A method for constructing a large spatiotemporal spectrum model of forestry resources for forestry vertical fields
description: The invention discloses a forestry resource space-time spectrum large model construction method facing the forestry vertical field, which belongs to the technical field of image data processing and comprises the steps of constructing a space-time spectrum data set of forestry resources, wherein the data set comprises spectrograms, geographic information, climate data and real fire probability maps of different time steps in a monitoring area, constructing an ST-SegNet network, comprising a SegNet encoder, a SegNet decoder, a ConvLSTM model, a feature fusion layer and a merging layer, constructing the total loss of the ST-SegNet network, and training the ST-SegNet network to obtain the forestry resource space-time spectrum large model. The invention improves the space-time consistency and classification precision of remote sensing image data, ensures higher-quality data processing, enhances the adaptability to complex scenes through space-time spectrum data fusion, improves the detail processing capability, provides a new technical path for environment monitoring and disaster response, and remarkably improves the efficiency of an emergency early warning system.

title: Multi-heat source multi-material additive manufacturing optimization method and system based on machine learning
description: The present application proposes a multi-heat source and multi-material additive manufacturing optimization method and system based on machine learning, which involves the field of additive manufacturing. The steps are as follows: real-time collection of process parameters, material properties and target response data to construct a multi-source data set. Based on this, a multi-task learning model is trained to extract common features and simultaneously predict target responses. The predicted values are used to construct a proxy objective function. If the error exceeds the threshold, the model is updated through experimental verification and feedback of new data. The weight coefficient is used in a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm to iteratively screen the Pareto candidate solution set, verify high-uncertainty solutions, and update the model until the error converges. The entropy-weighted TOPSIS method is used to select the optimal parameter combination and deploy it, and an online learning mechanism is embedded to form a closed-loop optimization. This method combines multi-task learning with an adaptive evolutionary algorithm to achieve efficient optimization of process parameters for multi-heat source and multi-material additive manufacturing.

title: Infrared image super-resolution method based on generation countermeasure network
description: The invention discloses an infrared image super-resolution method based on a generation countermeasure network, which comprises a super-resolution reconstruction method combining a dense residual error module and multi-scale feature extraction, wherein the super-resolution reconstruction quality of an infrared image is effectively improved by combining an interpolation upsampling technology, meanwhile, the feature extraction capacity of the residual error network is expanded, the receptive field of a convolution kernel is increased to more effectively capture key features, and in addition, mean square error loss is introduced into a loss function to balance a clear visual effect and a high PSNR value so as to achieve a better image reconstruction effect. The super-resolution performance is obviously improved on objective evaluation indexes, and meanwhile, the method also has better effects on the aspects of processing noise, blurring, artifacts and the like of the image. The invention can be deployed on an embedded platform and has wider practical value.

title: Method and system for constructing digital images depicting focused samples
description: The present inventive concept relates to a method (30) and apparatus (10) for training a machine learning model for constructing a digital image depicting a focused sample. The method includes acquiring (S300) a digital image training set of a training sample by positioning (S302) the training sample relative to a microscope objective at a focus position outside a range of positions between a near limit and a far limit of a depth of field of the microscope objective, illuminating (S304) the training sample with a plurality of illumination modes by an illumination system and capturing (S306) a digital image of the training sample for each of the plurality of illumination modes, receiving (S308) real data comprising a digital image depicting the training sample in focus, and training (S310) the machine learning model using the digital image training set and the real data for constructing the digital image depicting the focus sample. The inventive concept further relates to a microscope system (20) and a method (40) for constructing a digital image depicting a focused sample.

title: Spinning frame front roller rotating speed intelligent regulation and control system and method
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of spinning control, and discloses a system and method for intelligently controlling the rotation speed of a front roller of a spinning frame, comprising: collecting data on a production process of a target spinning frame, obtaining and storing corresponding spinning frame information; the spinning frame information comprises operating data and production data; processing the obtained spinning frame information, and constructing a corresponding multi-objective optimization function based on the data processing result; constructing a corresponding production parameter tuning model based on the obtained target optimization function; and controlling parameters of the target spinning frame in combination with the production parameter tuning model; the present invention is of great significance for improving the production efficiency and product quality of spinning frames and reducing energy consumption and labor costs.

title: Knowledge graph-based ERP system data analysis method
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of system data services, and specifically relates to an ERP system data analysis method based on a knowledge graph. Various types of data are preprocessed, and a knowledge graph is constructed based on the processed data. The abnormal conditions monitored in real time are substituted into the established knowledge graph to match the optimal solution from the constructed knowledge graph. Not only can the optimal solution corresponding to the abnormal condition be quickly obtained, but also the relevant attribute information of the abnormal condition can be obtained, and the workload of data query can be reduced, thereby improving the reliability, stability and user experience of the ERP system, and providing support for the enterprise's data analysis and decision-making, helping the enterprise to improve work efficiency, reduce operational risks, and at the same time ensure the stability of the enterprise's production and operation.

title: Coal mining machine fault diagnosis method and system
description: The invention provides a fault diagnosis method and system of a coal mining machine, and relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis of the coal mining machine; the method comprises the steps of calculating an effective value of a coal mining machine in a preset time period based on real-time working data, calculating a fault value of the coal mining machine based on the effective value of the coal mining machine, comparing the fault value with a preset alarm threshold value, storing real-time working data corresponding to the fault value as fault working data if the fault value is larger than the preset alarm threshold value, inputting the fault working data into a preset fault diagnosis model to judge whether the coal mining machine has a fault or not, outputting a fault type and fault positioning if the coal mining machine has the fault, and stopping running the preset fault diagnosis model if the coal mining machine does not have the fault. The coal cutter fault diagnosis method solves the technical problems that the calculated amount is large and misjudgment is easy to occur due to the influence of the environment in the fault diagnosis of the coal cutter in the related technology.

title: Photometric stereo reconstruction method based on coaxial light guide
description: The invention discloses a photometric stereo reconstruction method based on coaxial light guide, which particularly relates to the technical field of three-dimensional measurement and computers, wherein a cross-image local brightness perception module firstly extracts local brightness change characteristics of input tensors in all illumination directions, then a cross-image global brightness perception module realizes information interaction and fusion among local characteristics in different illumination angles through three-dimensional convolution, so as to generate global brightness change characteristic representation, a shallow texture characteristic aggregator firstly extracts shallow local space information from the brightness change characteristics in an image, then aggregates the local characteristics through maximum pooling operation to generate global shallow space characteristic representation, a deep structure characteristic extractor further extracts deep local structure characteristics from a shallow feature map, realizes characteristic fusion through maximum pooling operation, finally generates deep global structure characteristics, and inputs the extracted deep total structure characteristics into a normal regression to obtain a surface normal estimation result.

title: Water surface flow velocity detection method, device, equipment and medium
description: The present disclosure relates to the field of image recognition technology, and discloses a method, device, equipment and medium for detecting water surface velocity. The method includes: obtaining multiple frames of image data to be detected; using a target detection network to perform feature extraction, feature fusion and prediction on the image data of the current frame to obtain a first target detection frame corresponding to the image data of the current frame, and performing feature extraction, feature fusion and prediction on the image data of the next frame to obtain a second target detection frame corresponding to the image data of the next frame; using a target tracking algorithm to update the historical trajectories of all water surface tracers in the current frame based on the first target detection frame and the second target detection frame to obtain the target trajectory of all water surface tracers in the current frame; and obtaining the water surface velocity of the image data of the current frame based on the target trajectory. The present disclosure improves the accuracy of water surface velocity detection by integrating an attention mechanism into a target detection network and using a target tracking algorithm to track water surface tracers.

title: Two-stage underwater sound signal demodulation method based on space-time attention and U-shaped network
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of underwater acoustic communication, and particularly relates to a two-stage underwater acoustic signal demodulation method based on space-time attention and a U-shaped network. The method comprises two stages, wherein in the first stage, modulation type identification is carried out on an input signal through a multi-time-scale space-time attention network, so that effective distinction of various modulation signals is realized, in the second stage, signal demodulation is carried out by utilizing a generated lightweight U-shaped channel network, so that multi-scale characteristics are extracted more effectively, model complexity is reduced, signals are demodulated efficiently and accurately, and meanwhile, a generated type countermeasure network and countermeasure combined loss strategy is introduced, so that noise resistance and robustness of the model are enhanced.

title: Marketing short video material editing method and system based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of short video material editing, and specifically to a marketing short video material editing method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: performing preliminary analysis on uploaded marketing short video materials to generate a preliminary video editing list, analyzing interactive data parameters of promotional videos released for products of the same category, calculating the promotional value of each video, thereby screening out high-quality optional videos, and generating a video reference list. Subsequently, a multi-dimensional feature analysis is performed on the videos in the video reference list to calculate the keynote bias coefficient of the video, and determining the keynote bias level of the video based on the coefficient. Images that do not meet the level in the preliminary video editing list are eliminated to obtain a target video editing list. At the same time, the viewing time bias value and music matching parameters of the video are analyzed, and the result is substituted into a machine learning model for training to generate a marketing short video, thereby achieving efficient and accurate automatic editing of short videos and improving the effect of the marketing video and the audience participation.

title: Transformer fault diagnosis method, system, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for diagnosing faults of a transformer, which comprise the following steps of defining the fault type of the transformer and obtaining the concentration value of dissolved gas in a transformer oil sample in operation; the method comprises the steps of determining the uncertainty range of concentration values of each dissolved gas, generating data sets of all the uncertainty of the dissolved gas, forming a plurality of groups of combinations of the content of the dissolved gas by utilizing the generated data sets, performing fault diagnosis on all the combinations by using a Duval pentagon method, calculating the proportion of each fault type as the probability of occurrence of the fault, generating a feature vector containing a plurality of fault type probabilities, building a fault diagnosis model, training the fault diagnosis model, and performing fault diagnosis and type prediction on a transformer by the trained fault diagnosis model according to the concentration values of the dissolved gas in a transformer oil sample in operation. The influence of measurement uncertainty of dissolved gas is eliminated, and the accuracy and reliability of fault diagnosis are improved.

title: BP neural network of spring layered series cement resistor and ant colony detection method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of resistor detection, and in particular to a BP neural network and ant colony detection method for a spring layered series cement resistor, comprising: obtaining multiple sets of current-voltage-power factor data sets of a spring layered series cement resistor to be detected; establishing an initial evaluation function model; based on the multiple sets of current-voltage-power factor data sets, using a BP neural network and an ant colony optimization algorithm to iteratively correct the parameters in the initial evaluation function model to obtain an optimal evaluation function model; using the optimal evaluation function model to classify all current-voltage-power factor data sets, inputting the classified current-voltage-power factor data sets into the BP neural network, obtaining an evaluation result, and comprehensively reflecting the performance characteristics of the resistor by collecting multi-dimensional current-voltage-power factor data; and accurately describing the complex relationship between multiple parameters by using a nonlinear evaluation function model.

title: Child pneumonia etiology typing system based on deep convolutional neural network
description: The invention relates to the technical field of training models, in particular to a children pneumonia etiology typing system based on a deep convolutional neural network. The system comprises a data acquisition module, an adult comparison analysis module, a clinical influence analysis module and a model adjustment training module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring images and features in a training model, the adult comparison analysis module obtains comparison importance through the performance deviation of corresponding features of the images of the pneumonia of children and adults on different etiologies and the performance deviation of feature association, the clinical influence analysis module obtains clinical references through the association of the etiology and clinical indexes in combination with the feature correlation condition, and the model adjustment training module synthesizes contribution degrees of comparison importance and clinical reference representation and adjusts weights of training classifications according to the obvious conditions of the contribution degrees on different etiologies to obtain the model. According to the invention, through feature comparison and extraction of children and adults, and combining with the auxiliary classification features of clinical relevance in etiology typing, classification errors caused by different growth stages are reduced, and accuracy and robustness of the children pneumonia etiology typing model are improved.

title: A method and system for detecting target in hysteroscopic images
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of hysteroscopy, and provides a hysteroscopic image target detection method and system, the method comprising inserting a hysteroscope into the patient's uterine cavity, collecting high-definition images and environmental data of the tissue in the uterine cavity in real time; using image recognition technology to perform automated analysis, identify different types of lesion tissues, automatically evaluate the lesions, and obtain first evaluation data; based on the patient's physiological data set, evaluate the future development potential of the lesions through multi-level neural network model association analysis, divide the lesion area into risk levels, and generate second evaluation data; based on the second evaluation data, automatically generate a risk assessment report. The present invention can objectively and automatically output a targeted risk assessment report, and provide reliable data support and technical guarantee for the scientific evaluation and intelligent management of intrauterine lesions.

title: Worst-case runtime program analysis method and system for DSP architecture
description: The present invention discloses a worst-case running time program analysis method and system for DSP architecture, belonging to the technical field of binary program static analysis. The method comprises: generating a control flow graph of a target program; extracting a LASW loop structure in the target program according to the control flow graph, and calculating the minimum loop count upper bound of the LASW loop structure; performing a worst-case running time analysis of the target program based on the control flow graph and the minimum loop count upper bound, and obtaining a worst-case running time analysis result of the target program. The present invention can improve the accuracy and automation of worst-case running time analysis.

title: Multi-mode abstract generation and output method, device, equipment and medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of data analysis technology, and can be applied to business scenarios such as medical health, financial technology, and cultural research. A multimodal summary generation and output method is disclosed, including: collecting target field data and performing cleaning processing to obtain structured data; extracting entities and the relationship between entities from the structured data to construct a target field knowledge graph; generating a text summary containing entity association information based on the target field knowledge graph; matching the image data and audio data corresponding to the text summary, and integrating the text summary, image data, and voice data to generate a multimodal summary; constructing a user portrait based on user behavior data, and outputting the multimodal summary based on the user portrait. The present invention optimizes the extraction and analysis of entities and their relationship through knowledge graph construction; realizes the association display of text, image, and voice through multimodal fusion; and improves the efficiency and adaptability of knowledge summarization through user portrait optimization output.

title: Security detection method and intelligent device
description: This application is applicable to the field of privacy and security detection technology, and provides a security detection method and intelligent device, including: obtaining one or more first images, wherein the first image includes an environmental picture outside the driving device captured by at least one camera deployed on the driving device; performing feature analysis on each of the first images to obtain the behavioral features of the pedestrians included in each of the first images; determining whether the driving device has a security risk based on the behavioral features of the pedestrians corresponding to the multiple first images; and if the security risk exists, displaying the environmental picture captured by at least one of the cameras on the display screen of the driving device. The above method can improve the accuracy of security detection of driving devices.

title: Language translation data processing method and system based on large model
description: The application provides a language translation data processing method and system based on a large model, which are used for obtaining a plurality of text fragments by coding and segmenting language translation data, performing dependency syntax analysis on each text fragment, determining a dependency tree structure of each text fragment, determining a dependency relationship of explicit semantics between each two text fragments according to semantic similarity between each two text fragments and the dependency tree structure of the corresponding text fragment, performing dependency analysis on the implicit semantic relationship between each two text fragments according to the association degree of the implicit semantics between each text fragment and the segmentation loss of each text fragment to obtain the dependency relationship of the implicit semantics between each two text fragments, constructing paragraph labels of the language translation data through the explicit semantics between each two text fragments and the dependency relationship of the implicit semantics, and performing translation processing of the data to be translated based on the paragraph labels. By adopting the scheme of the application, the cross-section semantic guidance translation of long and complex texts can be realized.

title: Non-contact currency authenticity detection method, system, device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a non-contact currency authenticity detection method, a non-contact currency authenticity detection system, a non-contact currency authenticity detection device and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of currency detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an original emission signal and an original reflection signal which are used for scanning a target currency bundle through a millimeter wave radar, obtaining a radar signal snapshot of each currency in the target currency bundle through fast Fourier transform calculation based on the original emission signal and the original reflection signal, processing the radar signal snapshot through a continuous wavelet transform technology to obtain a feature map, and inputting the feature map into a pre-trained currency authenticity detection model to obtain a detection result of authenticity of each currency in the target currency bundle. The invention adopts millimeter wave radar technology to carry out non-contact detection, avoids the problems of abrasion, depreciation and the like of currency caused by the traditional physical contact detection method, and realizes nondestructive detection of the currency.

title: Industrial user energy storage scheduling method based on shared energy storage power station
description: The invention provides an industrial user energy storage scheduling method based on a shared energy storage power station, which uses electricity data through industrial users; the method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-objective function based on the capacity scheduling of the industrial users of the shared energy storage, wherein the multi-objective function comprises an energy storage capacity and an energy storage power target, the multi-objective function aims at the minimum capacity and the maximum charge and discharge power of the shared energy storage power station, establishing constraint conditions meeting the electronic operation characteristics of the shared energy storage according to the requirements of the shared energy storage power station and the characteristics of the industrial users, and solving the multi-objective function under the constraint conditions by utilizing an improved particle swarm algorithm to obtain the energy storage capacity and the energy storage power after the optimal configuration. The method provided by the invention has the advantages of carrying out shared energy storage configuration, reducing resource waste, improving the utilization efficiency of resources, being beneficial to maximizing the utilization of resources and minimizing environmental pollution, being capable of greatly avoiding the phenomenon of renewable resource waste and reducing the pressure of a power grid.

title: Online oil detection system and method for cement ball mill
description: The invention discloses an online oil detection system and method for cement ball mill, and relates to the technical field of industrial equipment status monitoring and fault diagnosis. The system comprises a data acquisition module, which uses a multi-channel vibration sensor array to synchronously acquire data of a ball mill bearing seat, a gear box and a transmission shaft position, and obtains an original vibration signal matrix containing multi-component coupling information through high-frequency sampling. If the sampling frequency is lower than ten times of the wear characteristic frequency, the sampling parameters are automatically adjusted until the Nyquist theorem requirements are met. The fault warning and model adaptive module adapts to changes in equipment operating conditions by updating model parameters in real time. The online oil detection system and method for cement ball mill effectively improve equipment operation reliability and maintenance efficiency, extend service life, reduce maintenance costs, and provide data support for preventive maintenance decisions of ball mills.

title: Security verifiable cross-modal retrieval method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of information retrieval privacy protection, and discloses a safe verifiable cross-modal retrieval method which comprises the steps that a data owner constructs a corresponding image verifiable B+ tree and a corresponding text verifiable B+ tree based on high-dimensional vectors corresponding to image modes and text modes in a multi-mode dataset, and stores encrypted multi-mode data, the high-dimensional vectors after digital signature and root node signature values into a data service provider for cross-modal retrieval when query vectors generated by a query user are received subsequently. The invention constructs the verifiable B+ tree containing the node data, the index key value, the center point, the radius and the abstract, can rapidly judge the distance between the node and the query vector during retrieval, avoids unnecessary subtree traversal, improves the query efficiency, and further ensures the authenticity of the query result through result verification and signature verification.

title: Data sampling method, device, equipment and medium of index log
description: The present invention discloses a data sampling method, device, equipment and medium for an indicator log. The method includes: obtaining at least one target data set in an indicator log library based on a data acquisition rule set by a user; sorting each target data set according to a preset data sorting rule to obtain an original tensor matrix that matches each target data set; obtaining the user's data sampling requirements, using a pre-set convolutional neural network to process each original tensor matrix based on the data sampling requirements, and obtaining each sampling data matrix that matches each original tensor matrix; performing an aggregation operation on each sampling data matrix to obtain a sampling data result that matches the data sampling requirements. Through the technical solution of the present invention, data sampling of indicator logs can be realized, the data dimension and data redundancy of indicator logs are reduced, and the efficiency of indicator data sampling is improved.

title: A multi-objective optimization method for sensor arrays for magnetic field signal denoising
description: The present invention discloses a sensor array multi-objective optimization method for magnetic field signal denoising. The implementation steps include: establishing a magnetic field interference model under a constrained mode and performing transient analysis to obtain time series data of magnetic field signals collected by all sensors; setting an optimization index, using the optimization index as a multi-objective fitness function, optimizing the multi-objective fitness function, and obtaining an optimal auxiliary sensor layout scheme when the fitness function value is maximized; based on the optimal auxiliary sensor layout scheme, establishing a main sensor and an optimal auxiliary sensor array; in an environment affected by interference sources, processing the noise signal of the optimal auxiliary sensor array based on a trained deep learning network model to obtain a denoised magnetic field signal of the main sensor, and reconstructing the main position noise through sensor layout optimization and auxiliary sensor array noise to achieve magnetic field signal denoising when the object is disturbed, thereby improving the accuracy of magnetic field testing.

title: Dynamic knowledge graph construction method oriented to power grid resource scheduling
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of power grid resource scheduling, and discloses a method for constructing a dynamic knowledge graph for power grid resource scheduling. The present invention establishes a multi-level scheduling analysis mechanism of scheduling demand identification-power transmission unit screening set construction-target power transmission unit set generation, taking into account distance efficiency, voltage quality and user risk, dynamically adapting to the real-time status of the power grid, significantly improving the accuracy, safety and efficiency of resource allocation, and providing a systematic solution for the dynamic scheduling of smart grids. When identifying the target power transmission unit, the present invention establishes a multi-level screening rule that integrates geographical location, power supply capacity, number of path nodes and transformer stability to obtain the target power transmission unit set, thereby achieving accurate filtering of the power transmission units, avoiding the one-sidedness of traditional single indicator screening, and significantly improving the reliability of the target set and the comprehensive benefits of the scheduling scheme.

title: Video retrieval generation method and device based on sparse representation and reordering
description: The invention discloses a video retrieval generation method and device based on sparse representation and reordering, and relates to the technical field of cross-mode video retrieval. The method comprises the steps of obtaining query texts, candidate video sequences and a video retrieval generation model, obtaining dense query text representations and dense candidate video sequence representations according to an encoder module, the query texts and the candidate video sequences, generating text sparse representations according to the dense query text representations through a sparse representation module, generating candidate video sparse representations according to the dense candidate video sequence representations, conducting inverted index screening on the candidate video sequences to obtain partial candidate videos, determining global scores of each video in the partial candidate videos through a cross attention module, sorting the partial candidate videos, and generating target texts corresponding to the query texts according to the sorted candidate videos and the query texts through a generation module. By adopting the invention, the retrieval efficiency is improved in a sparse representation and reordering mode.

title: Federated graph learning method and system based on feature fusion and temperature scaling distillation
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of federated graph neural networks, and provides a federated graph learning method and system based on feature fusion and temperature scaling distillation, wherein the client obtains a first soft target based on the initial feature structure encoder parameters, calculates a first target loss value according to the first soft target, and optimizes the model parameters in the initial GNN model in the direction of reducing the first target loss value. The client obtains a predicted label distribution based on the optimized GNN model, calculates a second target loss value according to the predicted label distribution, and optimizes the initial feature structure encoder parameters and the initial structure proxy set in the direction of reducing the second target loss value. The server aggregates the feature structure encoder parameters and the class-level structure proxy average values respectively to obtain the target feature structure encoder parameters and the target structure proxy, thereby alleviating the data heterogeneity problem and improving the accuracy of node classification.

title: Human face counterfeiting detection method and system based on space-time hyperbolic hypergraph
description: This invention discloses a face forgery detection method and system based on spatiotemporal hyperbolic hypergraph in the field of image processing technology, aiming to solve the problem that existing technologies struggle to capture the intrinsic feature relationships of facial structures. The method includes: inputting a face video to be detected (real or fake) into a trained face forgery detection model; extracting features from the face video using a face feature partitioning extraction module to obtain local facial features; constructing a spatiotemporal hypergraph based on the local facial features using a spatiotemporal node hypergraph construction module; extracting semantic classification features from the spatiotemporal hypergraph using a hyperbolic hypergraph learning module to obtain classification features; and inputting the classification features into a classifier to obtain a detection result of true or false. This invention enables face forgery detection with high accuracy and strong generalization, and can be widely used in security, finance, and other fields, providing reliable assurance for related face recognition applications.

title: Charging service platform performance evaluation method and system based on knowledge graph
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for evaluating the performance of a charging service platform based on a knowledge graph, and relates to the field of charging stations. The method includes constructing a knowledge model for a charging service platform based on a standardized data set and using knowledge graph technology; extracting implicit patterns in charging services from the knowledge model using machine learning and data mining algorithms; constructing a charging service quality evaluation model based on implicit patterns in charging services; using the charging service quality evaluation model to monitor and evaluate the performance of the charging service platform in real time, and generating charging quality evaluation results; identifying charging performance indicators to be optimized from the charging quality evaluation results; and adjusting control parameters of the charging performance indicators to be optimized based on an optimization algorithm. The present invention represents and queries various types of information of a charging service platform in a structured manner, can identify key factors affecting service quality, and provide dynamic performance evaluation results.

title: Fresh flower unloading platform scheduling optimization system and method based on deep reinforcement learning and evolutionary algorithm
description: The invention relates to a fresh flower unloading platform dispatching optimization system and method based on a deep reinforcement learning and evolution algorithm, and belongs to the field of operation optimization and intelligent dispatching. The invention constructs a fresh flower unloading platform scheduling optimization model aiming at minimizing maximum finishing time, minimizing platform idle time punishment cost and the like, and provides a DQN-based multi-strategy hybrid evolutionary algorithm for solving. The algorithm firstly adopts three methods of generating initial solutions, namely random generation, first-come first-serve scheduling rules and minimum cost increment scheduling rules, generates various and high-quality initial solutions, uses random reserved crossover operation and two-point crossover conversion elements to conduct global search in the initial stage of search, then uses DQN intelligent agent to adaptively select five search operators to conduct local search to obtain better solutions, and finally generates new solutions through reverse mutation. The invention can effectively improve the platform dispatching efficiency and reduce the time waste and the resource consumption in the fresh flower cold-chain logistics process.

title: Multi-contact marketing effect attribution method for AI big data fusion
description: The invention discloses a multi-contact marketing effect attribution method for AI big data fusion, which relates to the field of information technology and data science and is used for solving the problems of higher calculation redundancy, large resource consumption and low execution efficiency of an overall model, by collecting user behavior data and transaction data of a plurality of contacts, preprocessing, constructing feature vectors and calculating contact weight coefficients, if the weight exceeds a set threshold, then using dynamic time regularization algorithm to judge whether there is causal relation between contacts, after judging that there is causal relation, collecting interaction frequency and depth between contacts, analyzing association degree and calculating association strength, according to association degree, the method improves the dynamic modeling capacity of causal identification and realizes the self-adaptive redundancy identification and optimization of attribution models.

title: Lithium battery performance analysis method, device, equipment and medium
description: This application proposes a lithium battery performance analysis method, device, equipment and medium, applies Bayesian optimization to variational quantum optimization, uses Bayesian optimization to dynamically adjust the parameters in the quantum circuit, and guides the optimization process to avoid local optimal solutions and gradually approach the global optimal solution through uncertainty modeling and prior information update. The acquisition function of Bayesian optimization can select the most potential parameter points in each round of optimization, optimize the efficiency of the search process, and effectively deal with the interference of randomness and noise in quantum computing. Through the introduction of Bayesian optimization, more efficient and robust ground state energy calculations are achieved in quantum computing, avoiding the shortcomings of traditional optimization methods in noisy environments and improving the stability and accuracy of calculation results. This method not only improves the accuracy and convergence speed of quantum optimization, but also has broad application prospects and can be applied to more quantum chemical calculations and quantum physics research fields.

title: Front-end page code generation method and device, electronic equipment and medium
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a front-end page code generation method, a device, electronic equipment and a medium. The method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-source data fusion on a multi-source front-end page design manuscript and user history page browsing behavior information to obtain front-end page fusion design information, carrying out element visual semantic extraction on the multi-source front-end page design manuscript to obtain a page text element information set and a page design visual element information set, constructing a page behavior semantic knowledge graph, generating an initial front-end page code, carrying out code interaction adjustment on the initial front-end page code to obtain a front-end interaction code, carrying out multi-dimensional page evaluation on the front-end page to obtain a page multi-dimensional evaluation value set, and carrying out code dynamic adjustment optimization on the front-end interaction code. According to the embodiment, the front-end page code can be automatically and accurately generated, the efficiency and adaptability of code generation are improved, the page error of a design draft is reduced, and the user interaction experience is improved.

title: Text-to-chart dynamic generation method and system based on DeepSeek and API operators
description: The invention discloses a text-to-chart dynamic generation method and a system based on DeepSeek and API operators, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligent natural language processing and data visualization intersection, and the technical problems to be solved by the method are how to improve the intention analysis accuracy, enhance the dynamic adaptation capability of multi-source data and improve the chart generation efficiency and flexibility, and overcome the technical bottlenecks of traditional tools in semantic understanding, data adaptation and dynamic rendering; the method comprises the steps of API operator matching and scheduling, namely constructing a standardized API operator library, uniformly managing data retrieval conditions, chart rendering rules and interface calling protocols, selecting an optimal operator according to vector matching results, dynamically generating API request parameters and calling a data interface, dynamically obtaining and formatting data, and dynamically rendering by a visualization component.

title: A smart classification and retrieval system for government documents
description: The invention discloses an intelligent classification and retrieval system for government affair files, and belongs to the technical field of file management and information. Aiming at the problems of low efficiency, high error rate, insufficient safety management and control, low retrieval accuracy and the like of the traditional government affair file management mode and the existing general file management system in the government affair file management, the system adopts a deep learning architecture combining CNN and RNN to carry out intelligent classification, and realizes accurate retrieval through a word vector model and an attention mechanism. The system builds a government field knowledge graph to provide intelligent decision support, designs a multi-level authority management system to ensure file security, and also has a real-time data updating and self-learning mechanism, so that the system can adapt to the rapid updating of government knowledge. Compared with the prior art, the system has remarkable advantages in classification and retrieval efficiency, accuracy, safety, compatibility, intelligent expansibility and the like, can realize the intellectualization, high efficiency and standardization of government affair file management, and meets the complex demands of government affair office.

title: Semi-supervised GCN modulation identification method based on transducer mask
description: The application relates to a semi-supervised GCN modulation identification method based on a transducer mask, which comprises the steps of establishing a semi-supervised GCN model of the transducer mask, calculating weight distribution among sampling points in a signal sequence by utilizing a multi-head attention mechanism of the transducer to construct an I/Q signal diagram, updating node characteristics in an I/Q signal diagram structure by utilizing a diagram rolling network based on p-Laplacian, training through supervised loss and unsupervised loss of the semi-supervision, combining local characteristics into global characteristics by a full-connection layer to carry out classification decision, and converting characteristics output by the full-connection layer into final classification results by a softmax layer. The application enables the model to sample and capture the most significant feature point of the original signal preferentially through the weight distribution strategy of the transducer, thereby enhancing the capability of the model to accurately identify the signal feature, and the semi-supervised graph convolutional network based on the transducer mask introduces a semi-supervised loss function through the feature reconstruction of the transducer network, and improves the identification accuracy and stability of the model under the condition of insufficient labeling data.

title: A standard digital modeling and verification method and system based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention discloses a standard digital modeling and verification method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method obtains initial multi-source heterogeneous data through a multi-source API interface; uses the BERT model to perform semantic recognition on text data and establish a dynamic knowledge graph; processes the structural characteristics of the dynamic knowledge graph based on the GNN graph neural network, uses the Transformer to capture long-range text dependencies, inputs the dynamic knowledge graph into a hybrid neural network model for recognition, and uses the Monte Carlo Dropout method to quantify the prediction confidence; selects the best modeling paradigm based on the recognition result to establish a digital model, and uses the trained GAN generative adversarial network to generate test cases for the digital model to detect model blind spots. The method fully explores the correlation relationship and semantic information between the data, so that the constructed digital model can more realistically reflect the actual scene, greatly improving the accuracy and reliability of the model.

title: Target detection method, device, equipment and medium based on remote sensing large model
description: The application discloses a target detection method, device, equipment and medium based on a remote sensing large model, and relates to the technical field of computers, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a remote sensing large model trained based on target remote sensing image data sets in advance, and determining a multi-scale feature map corresponding to a to-be-processed remote sensing image based on a target multi-scale encoder in the remote sensing large model; the method comprises the steps of sequentially carrying out feature fusion operation and feature grouping operation on a multi-scale feature map through a grouping topology component in a remote sensing large model, carrying out multidirectional key information scanning and feature extraction on a subgroup feature map in a grouping result by utilizing a preset single scanning rule, carrying out region segmentation on each level of features in the multi-scale feature map based on a plurality of preset segmentation heads in the remote sensing large model, and carrying out parallel processing on a region segmentation result and an extraction result based on a detection head in the remote sensing large model so as to determine a target detection result. The application can improve the efficiency, precision and accuracy of remote sensing image saliency target detection.

title: Auxiliary diagnosis method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The application discloses an auxiliary triage method, an auxiliary triage device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the auxiliary triage method comprises the steps of obtaining diseased information of a patient, inputting the diseased information into a triage model, wherein the triage model at least comprises an image model, a text model and a forward network model which are trained sequentially, a training set of the image model comprises a disease description image of a patient who has been treated in at least one department, a training set of the text model comprises a disease description text of the patient who has been treated, a training set of the forward network model at least comprises output of the image model and output of the text model, and determining triage results of the patient according to the output of the triage model, wherein the triage results are used for indicating the department to be treated in the patient. By the application, the accuracy of diagnosis is improved.

title: A business automation processing method based on large language model and related devices
description: The present invention provides a business automation processing method based on a large language model and related devices. The present invention relates to the field of business processing. The method includes: establishing a business knowledge graph based on business data stored in a business system; constructing a training set based on historical request information input into the business system and semantic features corresponding to the historical request information, training the large language model, and obtaining a semantic recognition model; splicing user request information with historical conversations, and inputting the semantic recognition model and a graph neural network based on a business knowledge graph respectively to obtain semantic features and knowledge graph reasoning results; fusing the semantic features and knowledge graph reasoning results, classifying the fused data, and obtaining intent types; matching the intent types with the functional types of various business processes in the business system; if the intent type and the functional type are successfully matched, executing the business task corresponding to the user request information according to the business process corresponding to the functional type.

title: An order scheduling management method based on MES system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of digital MES systems, in particular to an order scheduling management method based on an MES system, which comprises the steps of firstly detecting a scheduling adjustment trigger signal, acquiring first production state data based on the MES system after acquiring the scheduling adjustment trigger signal, searching an optimal scheduling strategy based on a preset genetic algorithm according to the first production state data, acquiring a preliminary scheduling plan, indicating a production line to perform production based on the preliminary scheduling plan, simultaneously acquiring second production state data based on the MES system, dynamically adjusting the preliminary scheduling plan based on a preset reinforcement learning algorithm according to the second production state data, acquiring a real-time scheduling plan, and finally indicating the production line to perform production based on the real-time scheduling plan. The invention optimizes the production scheduling process cooperatively by double intelligent algorithms, not only ensures the global optimality of the production plan, but also can respond to the production environment change in real time, and solves the problem that the existing production scheduling management method cannot respond quickly.

title: A method for assessing exposure risk to indoor dust mite allergens
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of risk assessment for allergic disease induction caused by dust mites (allergens), and particularly relates to an indoor dust mite allergen exposure risk assessment method, which comprises the steps of constructing an allergen related data set A; detecting the concentration of dust mite allergen in a household, judging the dust mite exposure risk classification to which the dust mite allergen concentration belongs, adding the dust mite exposure risk classification as a new dimension into a relevant data set A of allergic factors to form a household dust mite exposure risk data set B, coding objective environment data, individual behavior data and the dust mite exposure risk classification to obtain a sample data set, inputting the sample data set into an MLP deep learning neural network for training to obtain a multi-classification prediction model, predicting the probability that different detection points belong to different dust mite exposure risk classifications, and judging the dust mite exposure risk classification to which the detection points belong. The invention realizes the evaluation and prediction of the dust mite exposure risk, replaces the traditional laboratory detection, and reduces the cost.

title: Unmanned surface vessel dynamic obstacle avoidance control method based on real-time nonlinear model predictive control
description: The present invention relates to a dynamic obstacle avoidance control method for an unmanned surface vehicle based on real-time nonlinear model predictive control. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a dynamic model of the unmanned surface vehicle, as well as a static obstacle model and a dynamic obstacle model; constructing a multi-objective optimization model based on the dynamic model, the static obstacle model, and the dynamic obstacle model, wherein the multi-objective optimization model uses trajectory tracking cost, obstacle avoidance cost, and control smoothing cost as objective functions, and uses motion range, speed limit, control input limit, and collision avoidance rules as constraints; obtaining the state of the unmanned surface vehicle and the state of obstacles in real time, inputting the multi-objective optimization problem for solution, obtaining control input, and completing dynamic obstacle avoidance control of the unmanned surface vehicle based on the control input. The present invention can improve the adaptability and safety of unmanned surface vehicles in complex navigation environments.

title: Automatic creative material generation system and method based on AI
description: The invention discloses an automatic creative material generation system and method based on AI, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and quantum computation, wherein the system comprises a quantum computation module, a data preprocessing module, an AI generation model module, a post-processing module and a user interaction module; according to the invention, parallel computation is realized by integrating the quantum computation module and utilizing the superposition state and entanglement characteristic of the quantum bits, so that the data processing and model computation speed is remarkably accelerated, when large-scale data and complex model computation tasks are processed, the quantum computation module can process a plurality of computation tasks simultaneously, so that the computation efficiency is improved by 30% -50%, meanwhile, the AI generation model module adopts a double-countermeasure generation network structure, comprising a main generation countermeasure network and an auxiliary generation countermeasure network, the originality and diversity of the generated materials are improved through joint training, and the generation efficiency and quality of the creative materials are remarkably improved.

title: Double-layer non-cooperative demand response method based on asynchronous multi-agent reinforcement learning
description: This application discloses a two-tier non-cooperative demand response method based on asynchronous multi-agent reinforcement learning, comprising: S1. Constructing a two-tier non-cooperative game framework, including: building a two-tier dynamic game model between utility companies and consumers; S2. Modeling a partially observable Markov game, transforming the two-tier non-cooperative game into a partially observable Markov game; S3. Designing an asynchronous multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm as the engine for solving the game equilibrium; and S4. Implementing centralized training and prioritized experience replay to optimize the efficiency of the asynchronous multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm. This application is applicable to dynamic game scenarios between utility companies and consumer groups in smart grid environments, enabling efficient consumption of distributed energy resources and load fluctuation suppression in the power grid.

title: Multi-base-station combined wireless positioning method and system based on self-attention mechanism
description: The present invention discloses a multi-base station joint wireless positioning method and system based on a self-attention mechanism, which relates to the field of deep learning and wireless communication technology and includes the following steps: collecting channel observation data from distributed base stations to form a multi-base station joint channel matrix; performing Gaussian normalization on the various dimensions of the multi-base station joint channel matrix to obtain a normalized multi-base station joint channel matrix and performing multi-channel convolution to obtain a feature fusion matrix; performing self-attention value calculation on the feature fusion matrix to obtain a distributed attention coding matrix; constructing a long short-term memory recurrent neural network for the distributed attention coding matrix to decode the spatial position coordinates of the target to be sensed. The present invention innovatively proposes the ideas of distributed base station perception, multi-base station channel information fusion, and self-attention encoding and decoding, improving the channel feature extraction method in existing wireless positioning algorithms and improving the base station perception accuracy in large-scale wireless communication scenarios.

title: Emotion recognition reasoning modeling method, device, storage medium and program product
description: The present invention provides an emotion recognition reasoning modeling method, device, storage medium and program product, which relate to the cross-technical field of brain-like computing and multimodal intelligent perception. Among them, the emotion recognition reasoning modeling method includes: constructing a modal perception encoder to encode the original multimodal input including text, voice, and image into a pulse time series in a unified format; constructing a modal fusion module, in the pulse self-attention mechanism embedded in the SNN logic, using LIF integral to obtain Spike features, and retaining the event-driven characteristics, modeling the long-distance dependency between modalities to obtain fusion features; constructing an emotion predictor, performing statistical processing on the fusion features, realizing category mapping, and then obtaining the emotional state output. The present invention realizes a structured multimodal fusion mechanism, so that different modalities can complete the interaction at the pulse stage, avoiding shallow fusion that is only spliced at the feature layer, and improving the collaborative expression ability between modalities.

title: Novel optic disc and macula segmentation method for ophthalmologic optical coherence tomography angiography
description: The present invention provides a new method for medical image segmentation based on an attention mechanism, belonging to the field of image processing. First, training images and a gold standard are selected from a training set. Then, the extracted features are labeled as target images using a label block. These features are input into a deep learning attention network to form a deep learning feature vector for learning. During the training process, the training set images undergo nonlinear mapping using a power oscillation activation function. Finally, the trained deep learning model is used to obtain a predicted segmentation result map and calculate the loss value using the gold standard. The present invention can extract targets from OCTA eye images, achieving good results.

title: Multi-mode dialogue emotion recognition method and device
description: The invention discloses a multi-modal dialog emotion recognition method and device, and relates to the technical field of multi-modal emotion recognition. Through the steps of extracting multi-modal characteristics, deducing implicit relation, constructing a mixed relation graph, aligning multi-modal semantics and the like, more accurate emotion prediction is realized. The method comprises the steps of extracting and fusing single feature vectors of an input multi-mode dialogue sequence needing emotion recognition to obtain an initial multi-mode feature vector, determining an implicit association relation between sentences included in each mode according to a constructed similarity function, mapping a representation subjected to weighted fusion with visual and audio mode information onto a vocabulary through a linear network to obtain a predicted word generation probability of a target sentence, and determining a difference loss value between the predicted word probability and an actual word probability based on a cross entropy loss function to obtain a loss function.

title: Super-resolution reconstruction method of remote sensing images based on cross-scale Mamba
description: The invention relates to a remote sensing image super-resolution reconstruction method based on a cross-scale Mamba, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing image super-resolution reconstruction. The method comprises the steps of introducing CSRSSG cross-scale residual state space groups and a CABR channel attention back projection reconstruction module to improve an original MambaIR model to obtain a cross-scale Mamba super-resolution reconstruction model, extracting shallow features of a remote sensing image to be reconstructed based on the cross-scale Mamba super-resolution reconstruction model, extracting deep features from the shallow features based on the cross-scale Mamba super-resolution reconstruction model, adding the shallow features and the deep features element by element to obtain residual connection features, and inputting the residual connection features and the remote sensing image to be reconstructed into the cross-scale Mamba super-resolution reconstruction model for reconstruction to obtain a super-resolution reconstructed remote sensing image. The invention can effectively enhance the extraction and expression capability of the model on the associated information among different scale features in the remote sensing image, and improve the super-resolution reconstruction quality of the remote sensing image.

title: PCB sorting quality real-time monitoring and identifying method based on machine vision
description: The application discloses a real-time monitoring and identifying method for PCB sorting quality based on machine vision, which relates to the technical field of PCB quality monitoring, and aims to conduct continuous identification on PCB sorting results for a plurality of days by training a plurality of deep learning models, obtain a plurality of identification accuracy rates of identification objects representing the deep learning models, calculate an evaluation value according to an out-of-tolerance ratio representing the discrete degree of the plurality of identification accuracy rates, a bad difference ratio representing probability of occurrence of low accuracy rates and an average value of the identification accuracy rates, and determine a used object from the identification objects according to the evaluation value.

title: System and method for predicting traditional Chinese medicine preference behaviors of middle-aged and elderly patients
description: The invention relates to the technical field of crowd medical preference prediction, and discloses a traditional Chinese medicine preference behavior prediction system and method for a middle-aged and elderly people, comprising the steps of collecting initial traditional Chinese medicine treatment behavior data of a source crowd, preprocessing the initial traditional Chinese medicine treatment behavior data, extracting features, performing dimension reduction processing to obtain dimension reduction traditional Chinese medicine feature data, training a deep learning network model and a transfer learning network model by using the dimension reduction traditional Chinese medicine feature data, integrating the models after training is completed to generate a traditional Chinese medicine preference prediction model, and inputting clinical data of a patient into the traditional Chinese medicine preference prediction model to obtain traditional Chinese medicine treatment preference probability. The invention inputs the clinical data of the patient into the traditional Chinese medicine preference prediction model, and outputs the personalized preference weight of the patient, including the preference probability of the traditional Chinese medicine category, and the like.

title: Mixed light LED optical characteristic prediction method based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a mixed light LED optical characteristic prediction method based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of photoelectron technology and artificial intelligence intersection, and comprises the steps of adjusting spectral output through white and red LED configuration equipment, collecting time-related optical and chromaticity measurement data, and constructing spectral power distribution of the white and red LED configuration equipment according to a spectral power distribution model to obtain a steady data set of spectral power distribution measured values; based on the robust data set of the spectrum power distribution measured value, training a deep learning algorithm, and predicting the spectrum power distribution, the optics and the chromaticity parameters of the white-red LED configuration equipment. Therefore, by adopting the mixed light LED optical characteristic prediction method based on deep learning, a stable data set of spectrum power distribution measured values can be constructed, the prediction of optical and chromaticity parameters by a deep learning algorithm is realized, and a reference basis is provided for optimizing the LED spectrum performance.

title: Method and system for predicting residual service life of rotary machine based on complex frequency domain information
description: The present invention provides a method and system for predicting the remaining service life of a rotating machinery based on complex frequency domain information, comprising: collecting the original vibration signal of the rotating machinery, and performing low-pass filtering on the original vibration signal using a low-pass filter; applying a linear neural network to extract features from multi-channel data of the filtered vibration signal; slicing the extracted features according to the time window size and the slicing step size to obtain a training set in the time dimension; building a prediction complex-valued neural network model according to the data features, inputting the training set into the built prediction complex-valued neural network model, obtaining a final life prediction complex-valued neural network model after the model converges, and determining the remaining service life of the rotating machinery according to the output result.

title: Scientific and technological project assessment method and system
description: The invention relates to a scientific and technological project assessment method and system, and relates to the technical field of multi-index decision and intelligent modeling. The method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional data of finance, intellectual property, team, history projects and the like of a science and technology project, constructing an evaluation index system, constructing a cognitive map by taking indexes as nodes and combining statistical relativity and expert rules, training the map by using a graph attention network (GAT), extracting structural causal weights among the indexes, fusing the structural weights with an original fuzzy relation matrix to form a structural enhanced fuzzy relation matrix, and carrying out fuzzy weighted comprehensive evaluation by combining weight vectors determined by a Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP) to output project grades and interpretable results. The invention effectively improves the accuracy, the adaptability and the interpretability of the scientific and technological project evaluation, and is suitable for complex project evaluation tasks in a multi-source heterogeneous data environment.

title: Eyelash forming system and method based on laser cutting film
description: The invention discloses an eyelash forming system and method based on a laser cutting film, which relate to the technical field of eyelash forming processing and aim at solving the technical problems of insufficient precision and hot melting deformation in the traditional eyelash process, and comprise a design input and modeling module, a process parameter intelligent optimization module, a cutting path intelligent planning module, a production process intelligent control module, a quality on-line monitoring and feedback module and a data management and analysis module; the intelligent process parameter optimizing module is connected with the design input and modeling module and is used for receiving an initial design scheme, combining a laser cutting process knowledge base and film material characteristics, optimizing cutting process parameters of laser power, cutting speed, pulse frequency and light spot diameter by using a machine learning algorithm, and the intelligent cutting path planning module is connected with the design input and modeling module and the intelligent process parameter optimizing module. The invention has the advantages of improving the processing qualification rate and the production efficiency of eyelashes.

title: Reinforcement learning model training methods, devices, electronic equipment, and storage media
description: This application relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology and provides a method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium for training a reinforcement learning model. The method first acquires N sample data, including questions, candidate answers, evaluations of candidate answers by review groups, and review group identifiers. Then, based on the N sample data, it generates a preference context vector for each review group. At least based on this preference context vector, it constructs a reward model for a pre-trained reinforcement learning model. Next, based on the reward model, it constructs a loss function that includes at least an inter-group alignment loss term, so that the loss function can characterize the evaluation differences of different review groups on the same sample data. Finally, it uses the constructed loss function to train the pre-trained reinforcement learning model, obtaining a trained reinforcement learning model. This method effectively solves the reward learning bias caused by inter-group differences in the reward model and improves the stability of reinforcement learning model training.

title: Method and system for constructing clinical application-level pathology large model based on weak supervision learning
description: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing a large clinical application-level pathology model based on weak supervised learning, wherein the method and the system respectively carry out weak supervised training on each historical clinical pathology image, adjust the upper study away from home or abroad learning parameters of the large model according to training results and construct an upstream task of the large model, respectively carry out segmentation decoding on each weak supervised training result, determine the segmentation results to adjust the lower study away from home or abroad learning parameters of the large model and construct a downstream task of the large model, acquire upstream fine features and downstream fine features, construct an upstream cooperative task of the large model, combine the upstream task of the large model and the downstream task of the large model to generate a large pathology model, input the current clinical pathology image into the large pathology model to carry out pathology information recognition to obtain a plurality of pathology recognition labels of corresponding patients, generate a pathology report of the patients, reduce the computational complexity when processing high-resolution images, optimize the cooperative mechanism among different tasks in the large model, and can be widely applied to pathology recognition technology.

title: Learning video compression method and system based on spatial correlation and layering
description: The present invention discloses a learning video compression method and system based on spatial correlation and layering, and relates to the technical field of video coding and decoding. A learning video compression method and system based on spatial correlation and layering, the method comprises the following steps: selecting a current frame and a reference frame in a given video sequence and sequentially performing preprocessing, motion vector compression processing, layered temporal attention refinement temporal context compression processing and frame reconstruction processing to obtain a reconstructed frame of the current frame; then constructing a loss function, encoding the guided entropy model, and training the evaluation index model; performing the above-mentioned operation processing on the current frame and the reference frame to be compressed, and compressing the video frame by the training model, and outputting the compressed and reconstructed current frame. The learning video compression method based on spatial correlation and layering of the present invention solves the problem of low utilization rate of spatiotemporal information in entropy coding, and improves the image quality of the reconstructed frame and the compression ratio of the video frame.

title: Human motion prediction method, system, device and storage medium
description: The invention provides a human body action prediction method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the field of artificial intelligence, and comprise the steps of establishing a mapping between a human body and a double-pendulum model to obtain a human body motion state and corresponding motion parameters under the double-pendulum model; according to the human motion state at the historical moment and the corresponding motion parameters, fitting a three-dimensional nonlinear motion track of the double-pendulum model in a state space by using a cubic Bayesian spline to obtain a nonlinear dynamics equation, and predicting the double-pendulum motion state at the next moment according to the nonlinear dynamics equation. Based on the conditional diffusion model, the motion prediction model is built by taking the human skeleton data and the double-pendulum motion state at the next moment as constraint conditions, and the prediction results of human motions of all parts of the human body at the next moment are predicted through the motion prediction model. The accuracy of human motion prediction is improved.

title: Data augmentation method and device
description: The present invention discloses a data augmentation method and device, relating to the field of data augmentation technology. The data augmentation method comprises: separating source image data into target images and scene images according to target and scene; generating multiple three-dimensional new-perspective target images based on the target images; and fusing the new-perspective target images with the scene images to obtain an expanded dataset.
