This application utilizes a target new-perspective generation algorithm to generate new three-dimensional perspectives from existing data, significantly enriching the diversity of the dataset.

title: Platform security information integration situational early warning method
description: This invention provides a platform security information integration situational early warning method, relating to the field of security situational early warning technology. This invention acquires network security element data and device operating data for each device type on the platform, performs standardization and time-series alignment, generates a network security element knowledge graph from the network security element dataset, calculates the operational stability coefficient of each device based on the operating data of each device type, and determines the security correlation of each device based on its network topology and historical fault data. By constructing graph-structured data, a security situational early warning model is established to provide early warnings for the security situation in the next time window. Device stability is determined based on the predicted operational stability coefficient in the operating type data, and network stability of each device is determined based on the predicted network security element data. Early warnings are provided based on the calculated functional loss rate of platform device types.

title: Construction method of rainfall field space feature intelligent recognition model
description: This invention discloses a method for constructing an intelligent recognition model of spatial features of precipitation fields, comprising the following steps: Step 1, collecting precipitation data of the study area; Step 2, constructing a near-realistic precipitation field; Step 3, identifying and quantifying influencing factors; Step 4, constructing an intelligent recognition model of spatial features of precipitation fields; Step 5, model training and validation. The method of this invention fully considers various factors that significantly influence the spatial distribution of precipitation, which helps improve the model's adaptability and transferability, and enhances its generalization performance; it also helps reveal the changing patterns and response mechanisms of the model in recognizing spatial features of precipitation under different conditions. Through the method of this invention, spatial information from multi-source precipitation data can be effectively integrated, combining spatial scale, precipitation magnitude, and topographic change influencing factors to construct a precipitation field spatial feature recognition model with strong robustness and interpretability, providing reliable technical support for applications such as refined meteorological monitoring and disaster early warning.

title: Method and system for automatically testing relay protection function of transformer substation
description: This invention discloses a method and system for automatic testing of substation relay protection functions, relating to the field of automatic testing of substation relay protection functions. The method includes: constructing a knowledge base for relay protection and developing standardized relay protection function testing templates; setting up a self-testing device simulating multiple types of pulses and a relay protection action logic signal acquisition device to construct an adaptive automatic testing mechanism; using specialized testing techniques to specifically test relay protection functions and constructing a static testing mechanism; optimizing the internal action logic output results of the relay protection device under the influence of test signals based on an LSTM neural network; and comprehensively evaluating the stability of the adaptive automatic testing mechanism based on the static testing mechanism, the adaptive automatic testing mechanism, and optimized historical data. The advantages of this invention are: setting up an adaptive automatic testing mechanism to achieve online automatic testing of substation relay protection functions, improving automatic testing efficiency and accuracy.

title: Welding quality diagnosis method and platform considering multi-sensing time sequence characteristics
description: This invention discloses a welding quality diagnosis method and platform considering multi-sensor temporal features, relating to the field of welding quality diagnosis technology. The method includes: acquiring visible light, infrared light, and temperature data from the welding process to obtain first welding process data; filtering the first welding process data to obtain second welding process data; normalizing the second welding process data to obtain third welding process data; inputting the third welding process data into a 3DCNN-TimesNet model; extracting the first k dominant frequencies of the third welding process data using Fast Fourier Transform and calculating the corresponding period lengths; reshaping the one-dimensional temporal data into k two-dimensional tensors based on the period lengths; extracting features from each two-dimensional tensor and fusing features from adjacent time points, adjacent periods, and different sensor signals; and weighting and aggregating the feature extraction results according to spectral amplitude to output welding quality classification results.

title: Nuclear power station risk information dual-stable differential privacy defense method and device based on Hodges-Lehmann
description: The invention discloses a Hodges-Lehmann-based nuclear power station risk information dual-robust differential privacy defense method and device, which relate to the field of information safety and comprise the steps of pairing multiple types of noise in pairs, calculating the average value of each combination, taking the median of each average value to obtain fusion noise, adding the fusion noise into deep learning model training, dynamically adjusting the intensity of the fusion noise according to the current gradient condition, preprocessing the confidence coefficient output by the deep learning model, dividing intervals, obtaining Hodges-Lehmann candidate values, screening, selecting disturbance values as new Hodges-Lehmann candidate values by probability close to the confidence coefficient, and replacing the confidence coefficient of the interval with the candidate values. The invention adopts a double defense method, can resist model inversion attack and membership reasoning attack at the same time, and realizes comprehensive nuclear power station risk information protection.

title: Method and system for generating fractal planning scene of power system by considering source-load time sequence change
description: The present invention proposes a method and system for generating fractal planning scenarios for power systems that consider time-series variations in sources and loads. The method comprises the following steps: preprocessing historical annual net load time series data with fractal characteristics, grouping the preprocessed historical annual net load time series data according to load cycles to generate groups of net load time series; calculating the box dimension of each group of net load time series, and predicting the initial data points of the planning scenario based on the box dimension of each group to obtain predicted values of the initial data points of the planning scenario; calculating the fractal interpolation parameters of each group of net load time series, and combining the predicted values of the initial data points of the planning scenario for each group to generate a typical scenario for the planning year. By carefully considering the constraints of the distribution network to generate distribution network planning scenarios, the present invention significantly improves the accuracy and practicality of scenario generation.

title: A method for evaluating hand function status in stroke patients
description: The present invention relates to a method for evaluating the hand function status of stroke patients, belonging to the field of stroke. The method combines the Fugl-Meyer motor function rating scale and doctor's advice, determines nine standard hand movements for evaluation, and uses the Mediapipe algorithm to accurately obtain the three-dimensional coordinates of 21 key points of the patient's hand, providing an accurate data basis for the evaluation. According to the characteristics of each hand movement, the present invention selects the geometric features with the highest discrimination between "healthy" and "sick" states as evaluation indicators, including angles and distances, which can stably distinguish the hand function states of different rehabilitation levels. During the evaluation process, the present invention adopts a weighted average method to assign reasonable weights to different fingers, highlighting the differences between healthy and affected hands, further improving the accuracy of the evaluation. At the same time, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is introduced to realize the automatic selection of thresholds, avoiding the subjectivity and uncertainty of manually setting thresholds, making the evaluation results more scientific and reasonable.

title: Large model field quantification and self-adaptive model deployment method for intelligent citrus planting management
description: The present application belongs to the field of computer artificial intelligence technology, and relates to a large-scale model field quantization and adaptive model deployment method for intelligent citrus planting management, comprising the following steps: first, constructing a large-scale model calibration data set and performing preprocessing, and inputting it into a Transformer model to perform forward reasoning; then, performing left multiplication and right multiplication rotation on the weight matrix of the model's to-be-quantized layer and right multiplication and rotation on the activation matrix, performing GPTQ quantization and calculating the dynamic adaptive smoothing factor of each channel of the activation matrix, and then performing normalization and symmetric quantization by grouping by hidden dimensions to generate a quantized Transformer model; then, obtaining citrus industry text data to construct a fine-tuning instruction set, and performing supervised training on the quantization model to generate a fully quantized and full-precision model; finally, by training a task complexity classifier, selecting a fully quantized or full-precision model as the target deployment model according to the task complexity level, the present invention realizes efficient model quantization and intelligent task adaptation.

title: A multi-parameter coupling control and quality prediction system for seed soaking and germination process
description: The present invention discloses a multi-parameter coupling control and quality prediction system for the seed soaking and germination process, which relates to the field of seed soaking and germination control technology. The system comprises a bionic neural sensing module for high-precision acquisition of environmental data such as temperature and humidity; a spatiotemporal topology prediction module for predicting indicators such as germination rate through a dynamic network; a plasma collaborative control module for treating seeds with low-temperature plasma to improve germination efficiency; a metamaterial environmental control module for precise control of temperature, humidity, and light; and a metabolic flow dynamic monitoring module for real-time detection of seed soaking liquid metabolites. The present invention improves seed soaking and germination performance, significantly improving temperature and humidity detection accuracy and germination rate prediction accuracy, increasing seed moisture permeability, shortening germination time, and improving germination rate. It also achieves precise environmental control, reduces energy consumption, monitors seed metabolic status in real time, reduces human intervention, and contributes to efficient production in modern agriculture.

title: System and method for correcting a quantitative diffusion model
description: A system for correcting a quantization diffusion model and a correction method thereof are provided, the method including quantizing a floating noise prediction network of a floating diffusion model to generate a quantization noise prediction network of the quantization diffusion model, measuring a quantization error of each sampling time step between the floating diffusion model and the quantization diffusion model in a sampling time step sequence using a calibration data set, calculating a corrected time step sequence and an error mean sequence based on the measured quantization error associated with each sampling time step, and processing input data using the quantization diffusion model, generating an output result based on the corrected time step sequence and the error mean sequence.

title: A real-time estimation method for vehicle road slope based on deep learning
description: The present application relates to the field of vehicle technology, and in particular to a method for real-time estimation of vehicle road slope based on deep learning. The main steps include: constructing an estimation model, the estimation model including a feedforward neural network and a convolutional neural network, the output layer of the feedforward neural network connected to the input layer of the convolutional neural network, the feedforward neural network for receiving tire pressure data and outputting vehicle mass, and the convolutional neural network for receiving vehicle mass and vehicle power data and outputting the vehicle slope; determining whether the vehicle has started, and if the vehicle has entered the starting phase, starting to collect real-time tire pressure data and vehicle power data from the vehicle's CAN bus to form a real-time data set; preprocessing the real-time data set, and then inputting the real-time data set into the pre-trained estimation model to obtain the vehicle's real-time slope. The present application can estimate the vehicle's road slope in real time at low cost.

title: A manufacturing execution system (MES) equipment online operation status data processing system and method
description: The application discloses a system and a method for processing on-line running state data of MES equipment of a manufacturing execution system, wherein the system comprises a service layer, a data layer, an acquisition layer and an equipment layer, wherein the equipment layer utilizes a goroutine and channel mechanism unique to Golang to achieve a multi-thread and high-concurrency data acquisition function, the acquisition layer is used for efficiently processing data of multi-source heterogeneous equipment to ensure that running parameters of various equipment can be acquired in real time, timely and accurate data support is provided for subsequent state research and judgment, the service layer uses JavaScript script to create an equipment running judgment rule base, dynamically analyzes the equipment parameters, research and judge the running state of the equipment, and writes the running state of the equipment back to a data center.

title: Target recommendation method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The application relates to the technical field of computer models, and provides a target recommendation method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining associated data of an object, inputting the associated data into a target recommendation model, wherein the target recommendation model is generated based on the joint training of a sample training set and an initial prediction baseline, the initial prediction baseline is determined by performing out-of-the-way prediction on the sample training set, obtaining recommendation data output by the target recommendation model based on the associated data, and performing target recommendation based on the recommendation data, wherein most information of original data features and baseline features is reserved in the initial prediction baseline determined by performing out-of-way prediction on the sample training set, so that the target recommendation model in a training stage can learn multi-level data identification at the same time, the features of the sample training set are enhanced, the learning capacity and the prediction precision of the target recommendation model are improved, and the target recommendation model can accurately predict based on the associated data, so that accurate recommendation data is obtained.

title: Multimodal data processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to the field of data processing technology, and discloses a multimodal data processing method, apparatus, equipment, and storage medium, including: obtaining an original data set of an energy management and control area, wherein the original data set contains multiple energy and power data, and the energy and power data includes structured data and unstructured data; determining the redundancy ratio of data in the unstructured data, and obtaining the structured ratio of the original data set based on the redundancy ratio and each structured data; screening and associating the structured data and the unstructured data based on the structured ratio to obtain target associated data; cross-modally associating and fusing the target associated data to generate a power grid knowledge graph. By quantifying the redundancy ratio of unstructured data and calculating the overall structured ratio, key data is dynamically screened out to eliminate redundancy and retain core information, thereby generating a power grid knowledge graph, strengthening the cross-modal data fusion capability, and improving the intelligent level of energy management and control.

title: AI Agent-driven credit risk warning strategy automated assessment method, device, control device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The application relates to an automatic evaluation method, device, control equipment and computer readable storage medium of an AI Agent-driven credit risk early warning strategy, which comprises the steps of obtaining structured financial data, unstructured text data and dynamic time sequence data of an enterprise through multi-source data, carrying out standardized processing, outputting a standardized risk data set, extracting static financial features, dynamic derivative features and associated network features based on the standardized risk data set, generating a high-discrimination feature set through feature screening and dimension reduction optimization, inputting the high-discrimination feature set into a neural network, a Stacking integrated model and a graph neural network by adopting a multi-model integrated strategy, outputting enterprise risk scores and grades, and automatically matching early warning rules based on the enterprise risk scores and grades, and carrying out real-time monitoring and early warning on enterprise credit according to the early warning rules.

title: Medical image super-resolution network framework based on hybrid window attention of Transformer architecture
description: This paper proposes a medical image super-resolution network framework based on a hybrid window attention of the Transformer architecture. By fusing directional perception features with cross-scale contextual information, efficient and robust medical image super-resolution reconstruction is achieved. First, a hybrid window attention mechanism combining dense and sparse windows is adopted. The dense window part adopts an attention mechanism combining rectangular windows and triangular windows to enhance the modeling ability of directional structures such as vascular bifurcations and organ edges; then, a selective spatial-channel attention module is used to integrate multi-scale convolution and dynamic channel calibration to improve the accuracy of local detail reconstruction; finally, an adaptive window fusion mechanism is designed, which utilizes dynamic window division and cross-window feature propagation strategies to achieve efficient fusion of multi-scale local features and global context. This scheme effectively improves the reconstruction quality of fine structures in medical images and enhances the model's ability to recover high-frequency details, thereby significantly improving the performance of super-resolution.

title: Long video processing method and device based on large model, electronic equipment and medium
description: The present invention discloses a long video processing method and device based on a large model, an electronic device, and a medium, which relates to the field of video processing technology. The device includes a segmentation module, a feature extraction module, a cache mechanism module, and a model processing module; a structured design is used to achieve efficient and accurate processing of long videos; SSIM is used to segment long videos into semantically coherent segments based on content, avoiding invalid processing of redundant frames, reducing the length of the single processing sequence of the large model, and reducing computing power; character posture features condense action trends by averaging the coordinates of key skeletal points, and scene semantic features reflect scene attributes based on the average value of the proportion of semantic regions, maximizing the retention of key semantics while reducing redundancy; a cross-segment dynamic attention cache mechanism updates previous features in real time, constructs new features that incorporate historical context through correlation calculation, and resolves information gaps between segments; fused features are input into the large model to achieve collaborative processing of segment details and cross-segment associations.

title: Multi-parameter analysis detector for water quality by full spectrum method
description: The present invention relates to the field of water quality parameter detection, and specifically to a full-spectrum water quality multi-parameter analysis and detection instrument, which includes a full-spectrum acquisition module, a preprocessing module, an information processing module and an application module; the full-spectrum acquisition module is used to emit a full-spectrum signal to a detection sample, and detect transmitted light and scattered light signals to generate original spectral data; the preprocessing module is used to preprocess the original spectral data using edge computing to obtain a standardized spectral matrix; the information processing module is used to calculate the actual concentration value of each impurity in the detection sample based on the standardized spectral matrix; the present invention introduces the influence relationship between different types of impurities, and compared with common prediction methods, the prediction accuracy of the concentration of each impurity is higher, which is conducive to judging whether an early warning is needed based on it, and avoiding misjudgment.

title: Method and device for protecting property of model, storage medium and computer equipment
description: The embodiment of the application provides a title protection method, a device, a storage medium and computer equipment of a model, wherein the title protection method of the model comprises the steps of obtaining an original parameter matrix of an original model, and carrying out parameter disturbance processing on the original parameter matrix to obtain a target parameter matrix; the method comprises the steps of obtaining an original model, obtaining an original sample data corresponding to the original model, carrying out sample disturbance processing on the original sample data to obtain trigger sample data, training the adjusted model based on the original sample data and the trigger sample data to obtain a trained model, and protecting property rights of the model.

title: Container bottom plate production line equipment fault early warning method and system
description: This invention relates to the field of data reasoning technology, and discloses a method and system for early warning of equipment failures in a container floor production line. The method includes: acquiring product quality characteristics of the container floor production line equipment; identifying defects in the product quality characteristics to obtain product defect types of the container floor production line equipment; performing reverse reasoning on the product defect types based on a pre-established mapping relationship library to obtain potential faulty components of the container floor production line equipment; plotting performance degradation curves of the potential faulty components based on their operating parameters; and performing early warning analysis on the potential faulty components based on the performance degradation curves to obtain corresponding early warning information for the container floor production line equipment. This invention achieves early and accurate early warning and location of equipment failures based on the direct result of product quality, effectively avoiding unplanned downtime and improving the accuracy of maintenance and production efficiency.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for constructing paired data of conventional and low-dose CT
description: The present invention discloses a method, apparatus, device and medium for constructing paired data of conventional and low-dose CT. The method comprises the following steps: preprocessing unpaired conventional-dose and low-dose CT images; converting the conventional-dose CT images into a sinusoidal domain to generate a pseudo conventional-dose CT sinusoidal graph; degrading the pseudo conventional-dose CT sinusoidal graph by adding physical noise to generate an original noise sinusoidal graph; constructing a generator for generating a pseudo low-dose CT image after inputting the original noise sinusoidal graph; using a discriminator based on a high-frequency information extractor to identify the authenticity of the pseudo low-dose CT image; calculating a joint loss of an adversarial loss and a physical content fidelity loss of the pseudo low-dose CT image to update the generator; inputting the conventional-dose CT image into the generator to obtain a degraded synthetic low-dose CT image; and ensuring that the noise characteristics of the output pseudo low-dose CT image are highly realistic and natural, and that its tissue structure content is consistent with that of the conventional-dose CT image.

title: Animation generation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application discloses an animation generation method, apparatus, computer equipment, and storage medium, belonging to the field of computer technology. The method comprises: obtaining a first animation description text; using an animation guidance agent, based on the first animation description text, determining a first target function library from a plurality of function libraries, wherein the functions in the function library are used to generate animations, and each function library corresponds to its own decision-making agent; using a decision-making agent corresponding to the first target function library, based on the first animation description text, determining a first target function in the first target function library; using a code generation agent, based on the first target function, generating an animation generation code corresponding to the first animation description text, wherein the animation generation code is used to call the first target function to generate an animation; and running the animation generation code corresponding to the first animation description text to obtain a first animation. The present application realizes the intelligentization and automation of animation production, and improves the efficiency of animation generation.

title: Single-frame infrared small target detection method based on self-adaptive channel interaction
description: The invention provides a single-frame infrared small target detection method based on a variant convolutional neural network, which comprises the steps of carrying out standardized pretreatment and primary feature extraction on an original image by a picture input module, carrying out high-efficiency calculation weight by a high-efficiency channel attention module through global pooling to extract channel descriptors, carrying out weighting adjustment on input channels by utilizing a lightweight network, realizing high-efficiency fusion of cross-scale features by an FPN module through space cyclic shift and channel grouping technology, effectively solving the gradient disappearance problem in deep network training by adopting a structural design combining a convolutional path and jump connection by a residual convolutional module, integrating a high-efficiency channel attention mechanism by a feedforward module, enhancing the response capability of key feature channels by global information aggregation, channel weight generation and recalibration operation, converting high-layer features into high-precision mask images by a model output module, carrying out real-time calculation of detection performance indexes, forming a complete feature extraction-fusion-prediction processing chain by cooperative work of each module, and obviously improving the infrared small target detector performance while guaranteeing the time reasoning efficiency.

title: Driving suggestion generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiments of the present application provide a driving suggestion generation method and device, an electronic device and a storage medium, which belong to the field of traffic technology. The method includes: obtaining macro traffic data and micro individual data, and using multimodal data fusion technology to fuse the macro traffic data with the micro individual data to obtain a current traffic situation model; using machine learning algorithms and traffic flow theory based on the current traffic situation model, predicting the future driving trajectory of each regional vehicle to obtain a vehicle trajectory prediction result; based on the vehicle trajectory prediction result, performing conflict detection on regional vehicles to generate a conflict pool; performing conflict negotiation on conflicting vehicles to generate driving order recommendations for conflicting vehicles. The embodiments of the present application can realize real-time monitoring, analysis and decision-making of traffic conditions, which is conducive to improving the adaptability and effectiveness of decision-making, improving traffic efficiency and safety, and reducing vehicle waiting time and energy consumption.

title: Intelligent mineral exploration and prediction methods, systems, terminals, and media based on three-dimensional geological models of mineral deposits
description: The application relates to the field of geological exploration, in particular to an intelligent ore finding prediction method, system, terminal and medium for a three-dimensional geological model of a deposit. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source geological data of a target area to construct a three-dimensional geological model of a deposit, inputting the three-dimensional geological model into a trained intelligent prospecting prediction model to perform mineral potential analysis, optimizing the model or generating an intelligent prospecting prediction scheme according to confidence level of predicted resource quantity, performing three-dimensional inversion calculation, element abnormal field construction and the like when constructing the model, realizing dynamic update by transferring the learning optimization model and accessing exploration data in real time, establishing a multi-target optimization model to output the exploration scheme, and simultaneously relating to a corresponding system, a terminal and a storage medium. The application achieves the technical effects of improving the accuracy and efficiency of prospecting prediction, dynamically optimizing the model according to actual conditions, reasonably planning the prospecting scheme and reducing the prospecting cost and risk.

title: Equipment dynamic obstacle avoidance method, system, equipment and medium based on behavior trend prediction
description: The invention relates to the technical field of machine vision identification, in particular to a dynamic obstacle avoidance method, a dynamic obstacle avoidance system, a dynamic obstacle avoidance device and a dynamic obstacle avoidance medium for equipment based on behavior trend prediction. Not only improves the fitting precision of the real boundary, but also ensures the consistency of the expansion boundary covering the landmark, and provides stronger data support for collision modeling of image-physical fusion. The human body positioning and equipment lower edge convex edge construction method based on the back projection of the image bottom edge center point is introduced to serve as a key link of collision modeling, so that the two-dimensional spatial relationship between equipment and personnel is restored. By the method, not only is the diversity of different equipment modes focused, but also the directivity and the orientation characteristics of the equipment can be accurately modeled, and the stability and the interpretation of collision pre-judgment are obviously improved.

title: Method and system for evaluating power load adjustment potential based on total incoming line
description: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating power load adjustment potential based on total incoming lines, which relate to the field of power data analysis and comprise the steps of obtaining the total incoming line load data of a target power distribution system and extracting characteristic factors; the method comprises the steps of constructing a causal directed graph taking characteristic factors as nodes, determining causal relations among the nodes through an improved PC algorithm, wherein the improvement comprises time lag expansion, correction chi-square statistics, time sequence constraint and dynamic adjacency optimization, carrying out anti-facts reasoning based on the causal graph to obtain a predicted value of total load, calculating load adjustment potential under virtual intervention according to a multidimensional adjustment potential index through the predicted value of the total load, and realizing non-invasive, interpretable and dynamic assessment of the user load flexibility adjustment potential.

title: Intelligent cleaning and surface quality control system for casting gating and risers based on feature extraction
description: The invention provides a casting head intelligent cleaning and surface quality control system based on feature extraction, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and intelligent processing. The system comprises a three-dimensional reconstruction module, a feature planning module, a process execution module and a quality control module, wherein the three-dimensional reconstruction module collects laser-visual data of a casting head area on the surface of a casting to achieve three-dimensional reconstruction of the casting head area on the surface of the casting, the feature planning module extracts three-dimensional reconstruction data features of the casting head area on the surface of the casting, multi-target path planning under the restriction of robot kinematics is conducted to generate a real-time processing track of the robot, the process execution module executes compensation according to the real-time processing track of the robot and process parameters to conduct processing cleaning operation, and the quality control module extracts texture features of the casting surface to construct a roughness evaluation model and realizes process execution compensation through reverse optimization of the process parameters. The system can more suitably perform intelligent cleaning work of the large casting head.

title: Method and system for preventing carbon buildup on the surface of silicon nitride ceramic heating elements
description: This invention discloses a method and system for anti-carbon deposition treatment of silicon nitride ceramic heating elements, relating to the field of heating element coating technology. The method includes: determining an anti-carbon deposition coating for the silicon nitride ceramic heating element; performing buffer coating matching; determining a thermal expansion gradient buffer coating; constructing a three-dimensional model of the silicon nitride ceramic heating element surface for spraying; performing local mask analysis for coating homogenization; determining spraying parameters for each layer; performing powder flow defect analysis during spraying; determining ultrasonic dispersion pretreatment parameters before spraying; and performing spraying treatment of the anti-carbon deposition coating and the thermal expansion gradient buffer coating. This invention solves the technical problems in the prior art where coatings are prone to cracking due to differences in thermal expansion coefficients, coating inhomogeneity caused by inaccurate spraying parameters, and coating quality affected by powder flow defects, achieving the technical effect of improving the quality and stability of the anti-carbon deposition coating on the surface of silicon nitride ceramic heating elements.

title: A method for training large-scale artificial intelligence models in a heterogeneous multi-machine, multi-GPU environment
description: This application discloses a method for training large-scale artificial intelligence models in a heterogeneous multi-machine, multi-card environment, belonging to the field of artificial intelligence large-scale model training technology. This application achieves load balancing of heterogeneous devices by constructing a unified interface, optimizes communication efficiency by using hierarchical pipeline aggregation and dynamic quantization compression, and realizes dynamic adjustment of nodes by combining elastic topology structure. It effectively solves the problems of poor device compatibility, high communication latency and rigid topology structure in the prior art, and has significant advantages in improving the utilization rate of heterogeneous computing resources, reducing cross-node communication overhead and enhancing system fault tolerance.

title: A Unit Test Generation Method Based on a Large Language Model
description: This invention discloses a unit test generation method based on a large language model, belonging to the field of test generation. The method includes: first, extracting contextual information related to the method under test using static analysis; then, using the extracted contextual information, slicing the method under test using a large language model, breaking down the original complex method into multiple simpler code segments; finally, using the code segment information to generate different unit test methods for each segment, and combining multiple unit test methods into a final test suite. This invention utilizes a large language model to slice code, dividing complex code into multiple simpler code segments before generating test cases. Compared to directly generating test cases for the method under test using a large language model, this effectively improves the line coverage and branch coverage of complex methods.

title: Lightweight RGB-T (red, green and blue-T) significant target detection method
description: This invention relates to the field of computer vision technology and discloses a lightweight RGB-T salient object detection method. At the feature interaction level, a local-global complementary aggregation module is designed, which enhances local details through shallow convolution and bilinear upsampling, and achieves global semantic modeling using global average pooling and fully connected layers, reducing computational overhead and memory usage while maintaining consistency and discriminativeness across different layers. At the feature mining level, a triple cue mining module is introduced, employing low-overhead operators such as multi-scale dilated convolution, pointwise convolution, and discrete cosine transform to model spatial context, channel dependence, and frequency semantics. This ensures the capture of cross-modal details and complementary information while reducing the number of parameters and computational complexity. At the training optimization level, channel consistency loss and deep saliency supervision loss are used to effectively compensate for the insufficient feature alignment and weakened shallow representation caused by the limited capacity of the lightweight network, thereby improving the model's detection capability.

title: A multimodal fusion-based intelligent early screening system for autism
description: The early-stage intelligent screening system for the autism based on the multi-modal fusion comprises a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a characteristic extraction module, a single-modal analysis module, a multi-modal fusion module, a result output module and a result output module, wherein the data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for synchronously acquiring various modal raw data and carrying out preliminary noise reduction and standardization processing, the characteristic extraction module is used for extracting specialized characteristics from the various modal raw data, the single-modal analysis module is used for analyzing the various modal characteristics and outputting independent risk probabilities, the multi-modal fusion module is used for integrating various modal results to generate final risk assessment, the result output module is used for generating a visual report and supporting clinical decisions, and the data acquisition and preprocessing module, the characteristic extraction module, the single-modal analysis module, the multi-modal fusion module and the result output module are electrically connected in sequence. The core breakthrough of the invention is to break through the limitation of single-mode data, effectively integrate four types of heterogeneous data of acoustic characteristics, gene information, eye movement track and behavior characteristics by a multi-mode fusion method, and improve screening accuracy.

title: Multi-part collaborative voice AI programming expression robot control system and method
description: The invention discloses a multi-position collaborative voice AI programming expression robot control system and a method, wherein the system comprises a main control unit, a voice processing module, an AI accelerating unit, a safe storage area, a debugging and program injection interface, an actuator driving circuit and multistage safety hardware, the system extracts a structured control intention vector through voice recognition, automatically generates or modifies a control code by an AI programming agent by combining an emotion action mapping library and physical constraint, and safely burns to the hardware and executes after digital twin simulation verification and automatic debugging optimization, thereby realizing the automatic generation and reliable execution of multi-position collaborative expression actions, remarkably reducing programming complexity and improving interaction naturalness and system safety.

title: Code change influence intelligent analysis method and system based on grammar structure tree
description: This invention provides a method and system for intelligent analysis of the impact of code changes based on a syntax structure tree (AST). The method includes: extracting control flow, data flow, and call flow from the AST generated by parsing the original and modified code; constructing a static dependency graph (SDG) containing multi-dimensional dependencies; constructing a multi-layer feature impact assessment model, including: a base layer for comparing the differences between the AST before and after the code change and generating a syntax structure change feature vector; a business layer for matching corresponding business tags to the changed AST nodes using business domain templates; a change annotation layer for constructing cross-version dependency chains for the changed AST nodes and generating historical feature vectors; and using the feature calculation results, combined with a multi-dimensional impact diffusion algorithm, calculating the risk value of the changed AST nodes and automatically generating decision recommendations. This invention delves into multiple dimensions of control flow, data flow, and call flow, utilizing natural language processing and historical change data to optimize risk prediction, thus aiding in a better understanding and management of the impact of code changes.

title: A data analysis-based job matching method, equipment, and medium
description: This invention discloses a data analysis-based job matching method, device, and medium, relating to the field of intelligent job matching technology. The method includes: extracting features from structured industrial behavior data using a behavioral pattern mining algorithm to obtain a multi-dimensional feature set; constructing a multi-dimensional industrial capability profile vector through normalization and weighted fusion with preset capability dimension weights; constructing a semantic association mapping graph using the multi-dimensional industrial capability profile vector and a job semantic knowledge graph; mapping and inferring the semantic association mapping graph using a mismatch inference algorithm to identify potentially undermatched job areas and generate user job matching scores; and ranking the user job matching scores and combining job priority with user preferences to generate a personalized job recommendation list. By constructing the semantic association mapping graph, a deep connection between user capabilities and job semantics is achieved, effectively improving the accuracy and robustness of multimodal information matching.

title: Improved yolopose-based space target pose estimation method
description: This application relates to a space target pose estimation method based on an improved YOLOPose algorithm. The method includes: constructing an experimental dataset using simulations and actual satellite images; extracting and labeling satellite feature points to form a pre-training dataset; and calculating 3D feature point coordinates using a multi-view geometric algorithm. An improved YOLOPose network is constructed, comprising a backbone network, a neck network, a detection head, and a 3D task loss function. The network is trained using the pre-training data. The backbone network undergoes cross-stage feature aggregation and attention optimization, while the neck network performs size recovery and multi-level feature fusion. Deep branching and a Swin Transformer module are used to capture long-range dependencies, and the detection head outputs 2D feature points. A projection equation is then constructed through keypoint matching, and the 3D feature points are solved using the least squares method. Finally, target satellite pose estimation is completed based on the 2D-3D feature points, achieving pose awareness in space missions. This method enables a lightweight model architecture and real-time inference.

title: DOA (angle of arrival) estimation method based on residual error network
description: This invention discloses a wave arrival angle (HAA) estimation method based on residual networks, comprising a spatial encoder and an improved residual network cascaded module. The system uses the complex signal received by the antenna array elements as input, extracts its covariance matrix, and constructs a multi-channel feature map. A coarse AHA estimation is performed by partitioning the signal using the spatial encoder, followed by a fine AHA estimation using the improved residual network. By reasonably combining deep neural networks and residual networks, this invention maintains high estimation accuracy and running speed even in complex scenarios such as low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), small source angle spacing, and multipath interference. Compared with traditional AHA estimation methods, the proposed method shows a significant advantage in AHA estimation accuracy under complex test conditions such as low SNR. Simultaneously, while maintaining high accuracy, this method has a faster running speed, demonstrating good real-time performance and promising engineering application prospects.

title: Business processing method, system and terminal based on large model middleware engine
description: This application relates to a business processing method, system, and terminal based on a large model middleware engine, belonging to the technical field of data processing. The business processing method uses the middleware engine as the execution entity and includes: receiving business requests sent by the business application side through a unified API entry point; parsing the business requests to identify business function point tags, business parameters, and output formats; filtering a set of associated models matching the business function tags from a large model cluster; selecting the optimal target model from the set of associated models; reconstructing the business parameters according to the interface specifications of the optimal target model and sending a request to the optimal target model; receiving the processing results sent by the optimal target model, encapsulating the processing results according to the output format, and pushing them to the business application side, whereby the business application side presents the processing results. This application has the beneficial effects of reducing the development and maintenance costs of business applications and improving the efficiency and quality of business processing.

title: Camouflage target existence detection method and system based on electroencephalogram feature guidance
description: The invention discloses a camouflage target existence detection method and a camouflage target existence detection system based on electroencephalogram feature guidance, wherein the camouflage target existence detection method constructs a camouflage target existence detection model, and image data and electroencephalogram data are respectively subjected to camouflage target existence judgment through an image branch and an electroencephalogram branch in the camouflage target existence detection model; the image encoder and the electroencephalogram encoder in the camouflage target existence detection model are utilized to respectively extract images and electroencephalogram feature codes, cross-modal information alignment is achieved through the decoupling fusion module, the information integrity after decoupling is guaranteed through the plurality of decoupling image feature integrators and the decoupling electroencephalogram feature integrators, finally in the reasoning stage, the camouflage target existence judgment is independently completed only through image branches in the camouflage target existence detection model, and the judgment capability and the generalization performance of the camouflage target existence detection model in a complex camouflage scene are improved.

title: Automatic test method, device, electronic equipment and computer storage medium
description: The invention relates to an automatic test technology and provides an automatic test method, an automatic test device, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a test task aiming at a target test scene, wherein the target test scene comprises a plurality of preset sub-services; constructing target intelligent agents of each preset sub-service according to basic test knowledge and custom test knowledge of each preset sub-service, wherein the target intelligent agents are used for planning test flows of the corresponding preset sub-service, and automatically testing test tasks by utilizing the target intelligent agents of a plurality of preset sub-services. The invention can improve the automatic test efficiency.

title: Virtual-actual migration equipment fault prediction method and system based on SNN (network virtual network)
description: A virtual-actual migration equipment fault prediction method and system based on an SNN (social network) belongs to the technical field of mechanical equipment fault diagnosis. The real fault data is deficient and the virtual and real data have distribution difference. A virtual-actual migration equipment fault prediction method and system based on an SNN (social network) network are provided, a source domain adopts a sufficient number of faults generated by a simulation model, a target domain adopts a small amount of real fault data, and equal-length samples are generated through sliding segmentation. The SNN network parameters are optimized through a genetic algorithm, classification loss and domain loss are minimized alternately, and the distribution difference between domains is reduced when the fault characteristics are extracted by the model. And inputting the target domain state sequence into a trained model, and outputting a fault type prediction result through a classification layer. Aiming at the health management requirements of key components such as rolling bearings, the fault diagnosis accuracy of the equipment is improved through transfer learning by fusing simulation data and real data.

title: Mobile device, method, medium and product for security verification of agent in mobile device
description: The invention relates to a computer system utilizing a computing model, and discloses a mobile device, a method for carrying out security verification on an agent in the mobile device, a medium and a product. A mobile device includes a computing resource, an agent configured to invoke the computing resource to perform an operation in response to an input instruction by a user, the operation including a plurality of actions, and a security detector configured to capture the plurality of actions of the agent using a simulator or a debug tool, capture states associated with each action, the states including a system state and an interface state of the mobile device, and perform security verification on the operation performed by the agent based on the plurality of actions and the associated states, wherein a context determination is performed based on the input instruction and a trace file to determine a result of the security verification. The mobile device provided by the invention overcomes the problem of insufficient security verification reliability of the graphical user interface agent of the mobile device, and improves the breadth, depth, efficiency and accuracy of security detection.

title: Pasture altitude adaptability assessment system and method based on big data
description: This invention relates to the field of agriculture and animal husbandry, and discloses a big data-based system and method for assessing the adaptability of pasture to plateau environments. The system includes: a data acquisition module for collecting meteorological data, soil data, remote sensing data, and historical growth data of pasture related to the pasture growth environment; a data preprocessing module connected to the data acquisition module for cleaning, standardizing, and feature selection of the collected data; a model building module connected to the data preprocessing module for establishing a dynamic pasture growth model based on partial differential equations based on the preprocessed data; and a numerical solution and optimization module connected to the model building module for numerically solving the partial differential equations. In this invention, by introducing a dynamic growth model based on partial differential equations, the growth process of pasture can be continuously and dynamically simulated and predicted.

title: Motor fault state monitoring method, system, computer program product and storage medium based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a motor fault state monitoring method, a system, a computer program product and a storage medium based on deep learning, which are used for collecting vibration signals and rotating speed signals in the motor operation process in real time, identifying a current working condition section of the motor operation by utilizing a section dividing algorithm according to the rotating speed signals, intercepting a section of vibration signals and rotating speed signals in a first time length and a second time length in the current working condition section according to a preset time rule to form a first signal section and a second signal section, respectively performing equal-angle resampling on the first signal section and the second signal section, performing Fourier transformation to generate respectively corresponding order spectrograms, splicing the two order spectrograms according to a time axis to form a spliced spectrogram as a data sample to form a data set, training a model, inputting the spliced spectrogram data sample into a pre-trained neural network model for reasoning, using the neural network model to identify whether the spliced data sample has difference, outputting a result, and judging whether the motor has faults or not.

title: Tumor dynamic segmentation method and model training method suitable for BNCT treatment
description: The application provides a tumor dynamic segmentation method and a model training method suitable for BNCT treatment, wherein the tumor dynamic segmentation method comprises the steps of obtaining PET-CT multi-mode data; inputting the PET-CT multi-modal data into a trained tumor segmentation model to obtain a tumor segmentation probability map based on spatial position dimension and boron concentration distribution dimension according to the tumor segmentation model, and carrying out dynamic threshold segmentation on the tumor segmentation probability map based on boron pharmacokinetic characteristics to obtain a tumor segmentation result. The application combines PET-CT multi-modal data, boron sensitive attention mechanism and BNCT boron pharmacokinetics characteristics to realize high-precision segmentation of tumors, and enables the segmentation result to reflect the boron drug biodistribution characteristics at the same time, thereby providing more accurate input parameters for BNCT treatment planning.

title: Code generation method and system based on waterfall model and multi-agent cooperation
description: This invention provides a code generation method and system based on the waterfall model and multi-agent collaboration. Based on the waterfall model of software development, this method constructs a multi-agent collaborative framework comprising a problem analysis agent, a solution agent, a pseudocode agent, a coding agent, and a repair agent. A dynamic collaboration algorithm coordinates the interaction process of each agent. Specifically, the problem analysis agent retrieves similar problems and solutions; the solution agent generates and evaluates candidate solutions; the pseudocode agent performs solution conversion; the coding agent generates executable code; and the repair agent performs fine-grained repairs to the code at the syntax, runtime, and semantic levels through a two-dimensional repair mechanism. This invention overcomes the limitations of single agents in complex programming tasks, achieving automated code generation covering the entire process of requirements analysis, solution design, code implementation, and testing and repair, significantly improving the quality and reliability of the generated code.

title: Training method, system and medium for satellite remote sensing image feature extraction model
description: The invention discloses a training method, a training system and a training medium for a satellite remote sensing image feature extraction model, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining satellite remote sensing image data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out data enhancement on satellite remote sensing image data to obtain data enhancement images under different view angles, comprising global and local clipping data enhancement images, constructing a satellite remote sensing image feature extraction model, inputting the data enhancement images into the satellite remote sensing image feature extraction model for model training, calculating a loss function according to the output of the contrast learning mapping module, the contrast learning prediction module, the mask learning mapping module and the mask learning prediction module, and adjusting parameters of the satellite remote sensing image feature extraction model according to the calculated loss function. The invention gives consideration to the capabilities of no need of manual labeling, model stabilization and general feature extraction.

title: Multi-unit pressure sensor self-calibration method and system based on federal learning
description: The invention provides a multi-unit pressure sensor self-calibration method and system based on federal learning, wherein a multi-unit sensing node is positioned in a pre-built multi-unit sensing node-edge-cloud layered star topology sensing network, the multi-unit sensing node performs pressure compensation under environment calibration on measured pressure sensing data according to environment variable data through a pre-built pressure self-calibration model, self-calibration pressure data is generated, the pressure self-calibration model is obtained by iterative training based on a federal learning framework, bayesian fault tolerance and gradient cutting are realized, model convergence stability is ensured, system complexity and maintenance cost are reduced, universality is improved, the problem of low cooperative efficiency of heterogeneous equipment is relieved, model convergence is accelerated, resource utilization rate is improved, calculation load is reduced for pressure sensor data isomerism, communication efficiency is ensured, and dynamic environment adaptability and calibration result accuracy are improved.

title: Camera fault diagnosis method and system
description: This invention provides a method and system for diagnosing faults in a synchronous condenser. The method includes: acquiring vibration and audio signals from the synchronous condenser using a signal acquisition device; simultaneously performing primary fusion of the acquired data using an energy spectrum-based scheme; converting the one-dimensional sequence of the primary fusion into a two-dimensional recursive image; and finally performing feature extraction, feature fusion, and classification using a multi-scale convolutional neural network or a self-supervised cross-modal alignment and bidirectional attention-gated fusion network. This invention solves the technical problem that, in fault diagnosis using deep learning models based on a single data source, the limited dataset type prevents the learning of global features of the object being diagnosed.

title: Laser scanning track planning method for obtaining uniform laser cleaning effect
description: This invention proposes a laser scanning trajectory planning method for achieving uniform laser cleaning results. By acquiring the boundary contour of the workpiece surface to be cleaned, the stopping points of the robotic arm are determined. An optimized ant colony algorithm is used to plan the global motion path of the robotic arm traversing all stopping points. Then, for each stopping point, the geometric parameters of the concentric circle scanning trajectory executed by the galvanometer are determined. The robotic arm is then controlled to move sequentially to each stopping point, and the concentric circle scanning action is performed by the galvanometer. During the concentric circle scanning process at each stopping point, after completing one concentric circle scan, the starting point of the next concentric circle is controlled to deflect around the center by a preset angle. This invention organically combines global path optimization of the robotic arm with local scanning path optimization of the galvanometer. Macroscopically, it optimizes the movement sequence of the robotic arm and reduces ineffective movement time; microscopically, by dynamically changing the starting point of the concentric circles, it breaks the periodicity of energy distribution, thereby improving cleaning efficiency and surface uniformity.

title: Model training method and apparatus for communication based on artificial intelligence and/or machine learning
description: The embodiment of the application provides a model training method and device for communication based on artificial intelligence and/or machine learning (AI/ML). The terminal receives data for AI/ML model training from the base station and performs AI/ML model training based on the received data. After performing the AI/ML model training, the terminal sends a first message to the base station indicating that data collection is complete.

title: Soil heavy metal pollution detection and restoration hardware system based on isotope tracing
description: This invention discloses a hardware system for soil heavy metal pollution detection and remediation based on isotope tracing, relating to the field of soil technology. The system includes an isotope tracing module, a heavy metal detection module, a remediation execution module, a real-time monitoring module, an intelligent control module, and a data storage and transmission module. The data storage and transmission module is connected to the isotope tracing module, heavy metal detection module, remediation execution module, real-time monitoring module, and intelligent control module, and transmits data to a remote monitoring center via wired or wireless communication for further data analysis and remote control. This invention achieves precise location, dynamic monitoring, and efficient remediation of heavy metal pollution through multi-source data fusion and intelligent algorithm optimization. Isotope tracing technology can locate pollution sources and predict diffusion paths, improving the efficiency of plant and microbial co-remediation. This system is applicable to industrial contaminated sites, farmland, and other scenarios, offering significant environmental and economic benefits.

title: A cross-subject adaptive motion imagery decoding method and its application integrating EEG-fNIRS
description: A cross-test-domain self-adaptive motor imagery decoding method for fusing EEG-fNIRS is used for analyzing the decomposition action of a collected clinical cerebral apoplexy patient when performing sitting-standing conversion rehabilitation training, designing a 2D dynamic sitting-standing motor imagery stimulation experimental paradigm based on E-Prime software, acquiring and preprocessing original EEG and fNIRS data under a subject motor imagery task, acquiring new tested EEG-fNIRS data, segmenting a task state and a resting state according to preset marking points to construct a target domain dataset, loading a pre-trained cross-test-domain self-adaptive model, finely adjusting the pre-training model by utilizing the target domain dataset, realizing classification of new tested motor imagery intention, and converting the classification result output by the optimized cross-test-domain self-adaptive model into a control instruction. And applying the method to a rehabilitation training system. The method and the device improve accuracy and robustness of motor imagery intention recognition.

title: Power energy source selection method, device and system for inland ship and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a power energy type selection method, a device, a system, a storage medium and a computer program product of a inland ship, belonging to the technical field of inland ship engineering, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining an evaluation index set and candidate power energy types, converting qualitative evaluation information of each index into a fuzzy relation matrix based on a fuzzy mathematical theory, calculating each index weight value by adopting an entropy weight method, carrying out fuzzy synthesis operation by combining the weight values and the fuzzy relation matrix, normalizing the result, and finally determining the adaptive target power energy type by solving the total evaluation score, calculating the relative proximity of each candidate type and the optimal solution. The scheme realizes quantification, comprehensiveness and precision of power energy source selection of inland ships.

title: Whole vehicle thermal management simulation method based on vein neural network
description: This invention discloses a vehicle thermal management simulation method based on a pulse neural network, relating to the field of automotive thermal management technology. The specific steps of this method are as follows: first, synchronously collect and preprocess data from multiple components; then, convert continuous signals into adaptive pulse sequences; next, extract multi-scale temporal features and quantify thermal coupling relationships; then, predict the thermal management status and risk level; next, restore the prediction results and trigger multi-level warnings; finally, dynamically correct model parameters to compensate for the effects of thermal aging, forming a complete encoding, extraction, prediction, warning, and optimization process. This invention, through an improved IF neuron model and a thermally sensitive dynamic threshold design, balances feature accuracy and computational power requirements, and accurately captures multi-scale thermal features using the thermal coupling STDC formula; simultaneously, it integrates thermal risk attention weights and a multi-level warning mechanism to achieve accurate prediction and graded response of the thermal management status, and superimposes thermal aging compensation to maintain long-term accuracy, forming a closed-loop optimization system that improves thermal management safety, real-time performance, and durability.

title: Intelligent identification and compliance monitoring system and method for operation and maintenance site operation behaviors of new energy
description: This invention relates to the field of new energy equipment operation and maintenance technology, specifically to an intelligent identification and compliance monitoring system and method for on-site operation behavior in new energy operation and maintenance. The system comprises a multi-source perception layer, an edge intelligence layer, a compliance inference layer, a command and control layer, and an evidence and audit layer. The multi-source perception layer uses multi-source acquisition devices to monitor the status of personnel, tools, and the environment at the operation and maintenance site, collecting and fusing multi-source data. The edge intelligence layer performs spatiotemporal alignment on the fused data, performs action recognition and interactive behavior modeling analysis, and outputs results. The compliance inference layer makes compliance judgments based on the above results, forming a risk quantification result. The command and control layer responds according to the risk quantification result and risk level classification, and executes measures. The evidence and audit layer forms an immutable chain of evidence and a compliance audit log, enabling evidence preservation and traceability.

title: Interaction method, device, equipment and medium based on game strategy model
description: This application discloses an interactive method, apparatus, device, and medium based on a game strategy model, relating to the field of computer technology. The method includes: monitoring the game information of a current Dou Dizhu (a popular Chinese card game) match and determining an input feature set; simulating independent matches based on the input feature set and the current game strategy model under perfect information conditions where all players' hands are known, and determining a trained first strategy model using the obtained training sample set; completing opponent modeling self-game training under imperfect information environment simulation based on global state features and the first strategy model; training the obtained second strategy model using a teacher network trained based on game match win/loss information; training the obtained third strategy model based on the input feature set and player card-playing behavior types, and using the trained fourth strategy model to generate the player's current card-playing decision for interaction. This solves the problem of bridging the gap between perfect and imperfect information in existing solutions.

title: Emergency knowledge graph construction method based on bi-directional energization of petty ranking algorithm and Lu Mo algorithm
description: This invention relates to the fields of intelligent emergency management, knowledge graph analysis, and algorithm fusion technology, specifically to a method for constructing an emergency knowledge graph based on the bidirectional empowerment of the Page ranking algorithm and the Luwan algorithm. This method constructs an emergency knowledge graph of "entity-relationship-entity" triples. The Page ranking algorithm calculates the global importance score of entities, which is then converted into weights for dividing emergency topic communities using the Luwan algorithm. After bidirectional empowerment optimization, a three-dimensional result of "community-entity-priority" is output. The innovative method achieves bidirectional empowerment of two algorithms, solving the problems of insufficient adaptability of a single algorithm and disconnect between graph applications. While improving the accuracy of entity analysis, it also supports the intelligent generation of emergency response reports, significantly improving the efficiency and scientific nature of emergency response decisions.

title: A Low-Overhead Sampling Analysis Method for Broadband Wireless Signals
description: This invention relates to a low-overhead sampling analysis method for broadband wireless signals. The method includes the following steps: acquiring the original low-rate IQ sample sequence of the target broadband signal, performing multi-dimensional feature embedding to obtain an original feature sequence; performing autocorrelation simulation sampling processing on the original low-rate IQ sample sequence to obtain an enhanced autocorrelation feature sequence, and concatenating it with the original feature sequence to form a fused enhanced feature sequence; inputting this sequence into a spectrum sensing model based on a deep neural network for processing, predicting the spectrum occupancy prior information in real time, and using this as a signal reconstruction constraint to reconstruct the original low-rate IQ sample sequence to obtain an effectively recovered signal; and performing signal analysis on the effectively recovered signal using a Transformer-based signal analysis model to obtain deep analysis results. Compared with existing technologies, this invention has advantages such as overcoming sampling rate limitations and significantly simplifying the data processing flow.

title: A method, system, and storage medium for multi-model collaborative AI-assisted matchmaking based on dynamic personality and threshold takeover.
description: The invention discloses a multimode collaborative AI chat wedding matching method, system and storage medium based on dynamic personality and threshold takeover. And acquiring the hard/soft information to generate an initial personality vector, backfilling evidence with RFI+TTL in the chat, and dynamically updating the personality. Hard filtering and soft sorting are performed first, and after threshold compatibility screening, an AI chat box is entered, AI is marked obviously, and contact information/outer link/PII is forbidden. The scorer continuously calculates the bidirectional scores S_AB and S_BA, reduces the weight of the sensitive attribute, applies fairness constraint and outputs interpretable evidence. And triggering the real person to take over and exit the chat domain only when the bidirectional score reaches the threshold value simultaneously, and grading the open chat record and the optional contact way through secondary agreement. The system realizes identity and privacy management, matching and threshold state machine, security document storage, telemetry and strategy gray scale and SDK/API gateway in a modularized manner.

title: An Autonomous Vulnerability Analysis System and Method Based on Knowledge Graph Guidance and Hierarchical Verification
description: The disclosure provides an autonomous vulnerability analysis system and method based on knowledge graph guidance and hierarchical verification, relating to the technical field of automated software vulnerability analysis, comprising the steps of constructing a structured vulnerability knowledge graph by using unstructured historical vulnerability cases; the method comprises the steps of obtaining items to be analyzed, inputting the items to be analyzed into a large language model, taking a structured vulnerability knowledge graph as priori knowledge, carrying out information retrieval by utilizing a macroscopic mode and statistical evidence in the structured vulnerability knowledge graph, guiding the large language model to identify pollution sources and risk pools based on retrieval conditions, driving a static analysis engine to generate preliminary suspected paths, screening the suspected paths through a two-stage hierarchical inspection mechanism, finally outputting to obtain a high-credibility vulnerability, and generating a final high-credibility vulnerability report. The method and the device are based on the deduction of the statistical law, so that the false alarm rate can be greatly reduced, and the discovery accuracy of the real loopholes is remarkably improved.

title: Information processing methods, devices, storage media, equipment and products in games
description: This application discloses an information processing method, apparatus, storage medium, device, and program product for games.
