The method includes: acquiring text to be processed; inputting the text to be processed into a large language model for first prediction processing to output a first prediction result corresponding to the text to be processed; if the first prediction result is a first target type among multiple first preset types, inputting the text to be processed into a target natural language processing model for second prediction processing to output a second prediction result corresponding to the text to be processed; and if the second prediction result is a first target type, determining the target prediction result of the text to be processed as the first target type. Thus, this application can identify the type of text with complex expressions such as obscure language and irony through a large language model, thereby reducing the probability of missed or incorrect text type identification.

title: Automatic special effect generation
description: And (5) automatically generating special effects. The present disclosure describes a technique for automatically generating special effects. The plurality of special effect creatives may be generated by at least one trained machine learning model in response to receiving text input by a user. In response to selecting the effect creative, the effect creative may be decomposed into a plurality of components. The effect creative may be among the plurality of effect creatives. Executable code may be generated based on the decomposition of the special effect creative. The code may be executed by a predetermined effect creation tool to generate an effect. The generated special effects may be output.

title: intelligent personal assistant
description: An intelligent social agent is an animated computer interface agent with social intelligence that has been developed for a given application or type of applications and a particular user population. The social intelligence of the agent comes from the ability of the agent to be appealing, affective, adaptive, and an appropriate when interacting with the user. An intelligent personal assistant is an implementation of an intelligent social agent that assists a user in operating a computing device and using application programs on a computing device.

title: Neural network model storage method, loading method, device, device and storage medium
description: The present application discloses a neural network model storage method, loading method, device, equipment and storage medium. The storage method includes: acquiring a source model file of a neural network model; parsing data in the source model file to obtain the content of the model data; splicing the content data of the model into an object memory block of the first programming language; packaging the object memory block into a byte stream memory block; storing the byte stream memory block to obtain a target model file. The method for storing the neural network model in this embodiment does not need to integrate a third-party library, which can reduce the demand for memory.

title: Convolutional neural network computing device and data computing method
description: A convolutional neural network computing device is applied to the technical field of computers and comprises: the device comprises a distributed local storage module, a convolution calculation module, an effective signal control module, an address management module and a buffer output module, wherein the distributed local storage module is used for storing an input activation value and a weight value, the convolution calculation module is used for carrying out convolution operation on the input activation value and the weight value to obtain an intermediate result, the effective signal control module is used for controlling the convolution calculation module to carry out convolution operation, the address management module is used for carrying out read-write management on the distributed local storage module, and the buffer output module is used for processing the intermediate result to obtain a final result and outputting the final result. The invention also discloses a data calculation method, which enhances the calculation efficiency of the convolution network.

title: An automatic posture recognition system for AD scale comprehension ability testing
description: The present invention discloses an automatic posture recognition system for AD scale comprehension ability test, which mainly includes a video stream acquisition module, a human body key point two-dimensional coordinate extraction module, a target object vertex two-dimensional coordinate extraction module, a preprocessing module, a posture recognition module and a database. The present invention establishes an evaluation mathematical model for the completion of specified actions in the AD scale, extracts the coordinate points of the human skeleton based on OpenPose, and uses a paper positioning algorithm based on image morphological processing to complete the evaluation of the subject's action completion.

title: A Method for Analyzing and Predicting Land Use Change
description: The invention discloses a method for analyzing and predicting land use change, which comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining land remote sensing image data of several historical years; S2, completing the splicing of remote sensing image data according to the POS data of the remote sensing image data, obtaining Click the overall remote sensing image map of this area; S3, realize the identification and marking of various land type areas in the overall remote sensing image map based on the YOLT model; S4, realize the recognition of the shape and size measurement of various land type areas; S5, according to each Calculate the land change range, dynamic degree, and spatial change from the shape and size data of various land types in the area at a point in time, and then analyze the dynamic changes of land in different periods, and summarize the characteristics and laws of land use temporal and spatial changes in historical years; S6, Select several driving factors to build a Markov-CA prediction model, etc. The invention can significantly improve the accuracy of prediction results.

title: Equipment fault self-adaptive upper and lower early warning boundary generation method based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention provides a device fault self-adaptive upper and lower early warning boundary generation method based on a convolutional neural network, which can be used for fault diagnosis of a chemical fiber winding machine in a spinning process, and comprises the following steps: a convolution neural network model for interval prediction and an upper and lower boundary model for interval self-adaptive generation and classification. The invention utilizes the vibration signal collected by the chemical fiber winding machine in the spinning process to carry out fault diagnosis, overcomes the defects of low accuracy and easy influence of human factors of the existing fault diagnosis technology, introduces the cost sensitive learning module to optimize the loss function in the convolution neural network updating iteration process, and obtains the machine learning fault detection method with the error-division cost as the optimization target. The invention has better practicability under the condition of unbalanced samples.

title: Infrared and visible light image fusion method based on self-attention mechanism
description: An infrared and visible light image fusion method based on a self-attention mechanism belongs to the field of image fusion. The method mainly solves the problem of neglecting the importance of human eye subjective feeling during image fusion. The method comprises the following implementation steps: 1) constructing a depth self-coding network structure based on a self-attention mechanism, extracting features in an end-to-end mode, and simultaneously learning a fusion rule and a reconstruction rule; 2) inputting feature maps of different branches of the coding layer into an attention mechanism to obtain an attention map, and obtaining an output feature map by adopting a mean value fusion strategy; 3) designing two types of loss functions of content loss and detail loss, wherein the two types of loss functions are respectively used for highlighting infrared target information, sharpening edges and better utilizing texture details in a source image; 4) the neural network is trained and the self-attention mechanism is visualized to adjust the network structure and the loss function. The invention can distribute attention in an optimal mode through learning attention diagrams, acquire the key information of the image, improve the visual effect and improve the quality of the fused image.

title: Gaze area detection method, device and electronic equipment
description: The present application provides a method, device and electronic device for gaze area detection, wherein the method comprises: obtaining a face image collected in a predetermined three-dimensional space; performing line of sight detection on the face image to obtain a line of sight detection result; based on a gaze area classifier pre-trained for the predetermined three-dimensional space, detecting the category of the target gaze area corresponding to the face image according to the line of sight detection result; wherein the target gaze area belongs to one of the multiple types of defined gaze areas obtained by pre-dividing the predetermined three-dimensional space. The use of the gaze area detection provided by the present application can effectively reduce the time cost and technical difficulty of migrating the entire gaze area detection system in different three-dimensional spaces.

title: Mobile application use prediction method based on time sequence mode
description: The invention discloses a mobile application use prediction method based on a time sequence mode, which comprises the steps of obtaining label data of mobile application, and constructing a bipartite graph of a user and the mobile application according to mobile application attribute information and a mobile application use sequence; then, modeling a relation between the user and the mobile application by using a graph neural network model to obtain a node vector representation of the mobile application; then respectively embedding the node vector of the mobile application and the position, time, usage amount and the like of the mobile application used by the user to obtain corresponding embedded vectors; then inputting the embedded vector into an RNN model based on an attention mechanism to obtain the use preference of the user; and finally, constructing a DNN model and outputting whether the user uses the label of the current mobile application at the next moment. The invention can more comprehensively utilize the use data of the smart phone, so that the user operation becomes simple and efficient, and can plan and optimize the battery energy consumption and the mobile application search time in advance.

title: A common representation learning method for few-shot cross-modal hash retrieval
description: The invention provides a few-sample cross-modal hash retrieval common characterization learning method, which designs a known-known network. Known-known networks mainly involve two major modules: a known module and a known-to-one module. The information hidden in the data can be fully utilized by the knowledge module, features of different layers are fused, and features with more global properties are extracted; on the basis of the knowledge module, the knowledge module models the correlation of all samples, and captures nonlinear dependency relations among data so as to better learn the common characterization of different modal data. Finally, a loss function for keeping the similarity between the modes is established, and the network is trained and optimized. The method can effectively solve the problem of unbalanced data under the condition of few samples, and can learn more representative common characterization, thereby greatly improving the cross-mode retrieval precision.

title: Learning-based data processing system and model updating method
description: A learning-based data processing system is provided that generates a learning model by learning a learning data set, identifies observation data according to the learning model, and provides the identification result. The learning-based data processing system may include data identification means configured to rank a first learning model generated based on the first learning data set and a second learning model generated based on the second learning data set to generate cascaded learning models.

title: A deep learning-based cleaning device and cleaning method for Chinese herbal decoction pieces
description: The invention relates to a deep learning-based traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece cleaning and selecting device and a deep learning-based traditional Chinese medicine decoction piece cleaning and selecting method. The identification adopts a pre-trained deep learning neural network model, images are divided into local image blocks as input for training, local image information is fully utilized, and the demand of deep learning on samples is greatly reduced. During operation, the deep learning neural network can optimize itself, and the defect identification capability is continuously improved. After the defective traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces are identified, the computer positions the defective traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces through a built-in positioning program, and the removing mechanism removes the corresponding defective traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces according to the positioning data. The method has the advantages of simple and flexible flow and high implementation feasibility. The method has the advantages of high efficiency and accuracy in identifying the defective traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces and capability of obviously improving the cleaning efficiency of the traditional Chinese medicine decoction pieces. The invention can also be popularized and applied to the detection of the defects of food, light and small parts and the like, and solves the problem of the screening pain points of various products.

title: Deep learning model suitable for small sample hyperspectral image classification
description: The invention provides a deep learning model suitable for classifying small sample hyperspectral images, wherein the whole framework of the model is based on a coder-decoder and comprises the following steps: inputting a hyperspectral image and a data set to be classified; carrying out random sampling twice on an original data set to generate a group of random training sample sequences; extracting spectral dependence characteristics in a long-short range and spatial relation of pixels in a local range by using a global convolution long-short term memory module; respectively extracting detailed spectrum dependent features and space details by utilizing a global spectrum and space attention mechanism; recovering the spatial details of the semantic features by using a feature migration module; the invention provides a novel global learning classification method, which not only can fully mine the dependence between spectral features in a long and short range, but also can extract the dependence between pixel spatial features in the long and short range, so that the most distinguished features can still be extracted when training samples are limited, and the classification accuracy is ensured.

title: Network crawler detection method, system and device based on graph neural network
description: The invention discloses a web crawler detection method, a system and a device based on a graph neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a network session sample, wherein the network session sample comprises each accessed resource; extracting resource features of each resource in the network session sample, wherein the resource features comprise inherent features of the resource embodied in a website and/or session features of the resource accessed by a user; and constructing a resource map of the network session sample based on the extracted resource features, and training the constructed resource map by using a preset map algorithm so as to detect the web crawlers through a classification model obtained through training. The technical scheme provided by the application can improve the detection efficiency of the web crawler.

title: Network public opinion information source influence evaluation method and system based on deep learning
description: The invention provides an online public opinion information source influence assessment method and system based on deep learning, and relates to the technical field of information source influence assessment and deep learning. The method and the system firstly acquire a plurality of target information source structures and semi-structured and unstructured data in the target information source structures, and process the acquired data into structured data in a unified format; then establishing a network information source evaluation data set and a deep learning Xgboost evaluation model and setting model parameters; training and testing the model to obtain the model accuracy on the test set; performing iterative training on the model after optimizing and modifying the model parameters, and storing the model with highest accuracy; and finally, inputting the acquired multiple target information source data into a model with highest accuracy to obtain the score and ranking of each target information source. The method and the system can evaluate the public opinion information source more efficiently and reliably, and greatly improve the accuracy of public opinion information searching.

title: Method and device for processing customer calls
description: The invention discloses a method and device for processing customer calls. The method includes: when a customer calls, obtaining customer information and to-do business types of a plurality of customers waiting to be connected before the time of the call; The customer information and to-do business type of the incoming customer are predicted, and the waiting time of the incoming customer is predicted; when the waiting time of the incoming customer is greater than the preset time threshold, a stop-waiting instruction is sent to the incoming customer, which can remind the customer to hang up and avoid The customer waits online for a long time. After the calls of multiple customers waiting to be connected are completed, an intelligent outbound call is initiated to the incoming customer, without the need for the customer to make repeated calls, which improves the processing efficiency of customer calls and improves the customer experience.

title: Medical image display method, viewing device and computer device
description: The application relates to a medical image display method, a viewing device and a computer device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an original image of a detected object; acquiring a focus area selected from the original image; taking a focus area as a reference, and selecting an image in a preset range as an image of the region of interest; acquiring a plurality of plane images in the region-of-interest image according to a preset acquisition mode; and generating dynamic images from the plurality of plane images according to a preset sequence. The physician can save the workload of the physician and the time for the physician to determine the focus by observing the dynamic image to determine the focus position.

title: A traffic light and road association method based on Bayesian classification
description: The invention relates to a traffic light and road association method based on Bayesian classification, which comprises the following steps: training to obtain a training set related to the traffic light and the road, wherein the input of the training set is the related attribute of the traffic light and the road, and the output is whether the traffic light is related to the road or not; inputting the correlation attributes of the traffic light to be detected and each road into a training set, and obtaining a preliminary correlation result of the traffic light to be detected and each road according to a Gaussian naive Bayes classification method; when the preliminary association results of the traffic lights to be detected and at least two roads are associated, the road corresponding to the final association result of the traffic lights to be detected is selected according to the preliminary association results, the reliable truth data of the existing typical intersection is used as a training set, the probability of the association of all the roads entering the intersection and all the traffic lights in the intersection is obtained by a Bayesian classification method, and the association relation is established by the traffic lights and the road with the maximum association probability, so that the difficulty of manually searching for rules is avoided, and a better effect can be obtained.

title: A Seismic Wave Impedance Inversion Method Based on Adversarial Learning
description: The invention discloses a seismic wave impedance inversion method based on countermeasure learning, which is applied to the field of seismic data processing and aims at the problem of lack of logging data in the traditional high-resolution seismic wave impedance inversion method.

title: A multi-source fusion detection and early warning method for partial discharge for high-voltage switchgear
description: The invention relates to a local discharge multi-source fusion detection early warning method for a high-voltage switch cabinet, and belongs to the technical field of electric power early warning systems. Which comprises the following steps: collecting discharge data of the high-voltage switch cabinet under different discharge types, designing a convolutional neural network structure according to the collected discharge data, generating a training data set and a test data set, and preprocessing the training data set and the test data set to obtain a partial discharge type convolutional neural network model of the high-voltage switch cabinet; inputting the real-time collected high-voltage switch cabinet discharge data into a convolutional neural network model, obtaining the characteristic parameters of the discharge data, judging the characteristic parameters, and sending out an early warning signal under the condition that discharge is judged. The invention can realize the detection and early warning of the partial discharge in the switch cabinet, find the partial discharge problem in time and process in time so as to reduce unnecessary outage and repair and test.

title: A deep learning-based lidar environment perception method and system
description: The invention discloses a deep learning-based laser radar environment perception method and system. Step 1: mapping a laser radar point cloud into a depth map; converting each point of the laser radar from a spherical coordinate system to an image coordinate system; Step 2, performing the step of semantic segmentation of the depth map; Step 3, mapping the semantic segmentation map to a semantic segmentation point cloud image. The present invention adopts laser radar spherical mapping and uses stable mapping formula, which has low algorithm difficulty and low development and maintenance cost; adopts semantic segmentation with high precision and has many segmentation types; it will form environment recognition data suitable for autonomous vehicles, which is convenient for autonomous vehicles to identify surrounding areas. object.

title: A method and device for model training with linear feature independence
description: The embodiment of the present application discloses a model training method and device with linearly independent features. When it is determined that the original features are linearly independent, feature derivation is performed for the original features of each category to obtain a derived feature matrix; the original features include The features of multiple different categories are arranged horizontally between the features of multiple different categories; the feature arrangement transformation is performed on the derived feature matrix, and the features of different categories are converted from horizontal arrangement to vertical arrangement, and the converted feature matrix is obtained. Feature matrix; model training is performed using machine learning algorithms according to the transformed feature matrix. After the feature matrix is converted, the features of each category are used as a sample, and the features are changed from the original horizontal arrangement to the vertical arrangement, so the machine learning algorithm will not learn the correlation between the features during training, reducing the introduction of The influence of unnecessary association between features, such as noise, greatly improves the prediction effect of the model, promotes the implementation of the model, and achieves business requirements.

title: Platform and system for therapeutic procedures
description: A portable treatment platform (10) for a treatment process, comprising (a) at least one compartment (14) for containing at least one therapeutically effective item required to perform the treatment process and (b) at least one electronic communication device (17, 47A) for receiving and transmitting information about the environment surrounding the platform (10) and including the platform (10) itself. The use of the platform (10) is conveniently managed by a system (100) that communicates information about the environment surrounding the platform (10) and including the platform (10) itself between the electronic communication device (17, 47A) and a computer system (200) that includes a processor (210) that processes the information, and initiates a control response to the processed information. The platform (10) and system (100) are suitable for addressing a range of public health problems and as a countermeasure against biosafety threats.

title: Vehicle-mounted video-based lane line and pavement indication mark detection and identification method
description: The invention relates to a method for detecting and identifying a road surface lane line and an indicator mark based on deep learning and other technologies, which finally realizes the detection and identification of the road surface lane line and the indicator mark by decomposing a vehicle-mounted video stream, preprocessing a video frame, extracting the characteristics of the lane line and the road surface indicator mark, segmenting the lane line, extracting a lane central line, detecting and identifying the road surface indicator mark and compressing a model. By adopting the multi-task learning and model compression technology, the lane line extraction and road surface indication mark detection and identification model can simultaneously obtain the effects of high speed and high precision, and can meet the performance requirement of real-time detection.

title: A machine learning fusion method for subjective and objective precipitation forecasting
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a machine learning fusion method for subjective and objective rainfall forecast in the technical field of rainfall forecast, which comprises the following steps: s1, compiling the numerical model certainty forecast historical data to obtain a precipitation with the length not less than one year and a standardized data set Q1 of relevant physical quantities; s2, compiling the historical data of the numerical mode ensemble forecast to obtain a full set member precipitation forecast standardized data set Q2 with the length not less than one year; and S3, acquiring the live precipitation data of the automatic observation station with the length not less than one year through the CIMISS data interface, and compiling the data into a standardized data set Q3. The invention solves the problems of loss of the precipitation characteristics in the numerical mode and lack of physical significance by establishing a mathematical model between precipitation spatial distribution and numerical mode precipitation and related products. By reconstructing the precipitation distribution characteristics in the whole precipitation space field, the problem of discontinuous precipitation at the fusion boundary is solved.

title: Adjusting the machine learning model based on the second set of training data
description: A system and method for adjusting a first machine learning model that takes clinical data as input, based on a second set of training data. The first machine learning model has already been trained on the first set of training data. The method includes: adding an adjustment module to the first machine learning model, the adjustment module including a second machine learning model; and training the second machine learning model using the second set of training data to take the output of the first machine learning model as input and provide an adjusted output.

title: Concurrency control method and system based on machine learning
description: The present invention provides a concurrency control method and system based on machine learning, including: initializing a transaction to be executed and marking the state as being executed; determining whether there are unexecuted operations in the transaction being executed, and if so, querying the operation execution strategy to continue execution, determining whether to perform advance verification and executing the corresponding operation; if not, verifying and submitting the transaction according to the submission strategy of the current transaction; verifying the correctness of the accumulated read operations of the transaction; querying the submission strategy of the transaction, performing a waiting operation according to the submission strategy and the transaction dependency established by the transaction until the transaction dependency meets the preset conditions, and verifying the correctness of the set of read operations of the transaction. The present invention allows the transaction to perform database operations of arbitrary behavior according to the training results of machine learning, fully matching the characteristics of different application scenarios, and maximizing the flexibility of the system.

title: Spectrum sensing method and device based on deep learning classification
description: The present invention relates to a spectrum sensing method and device based on deep learning classification, which belongs to the field of signal processing technology, and solves the problem that the existing spectrum sensing method needs to involve a large number of manual processes and relies on too much professional knowledge, resulting in low accuracy. The method includes the following steps: obtaining sample data of the signal; the sample data includes a signal sampling sequence, a signal power spectrum, and a wavelet vector; constructing a convolutional neural network, and performing network training on the convolutional neural network based on the sample data to obtain the optimal network structure corresponding to the convolutional neural network; inputting the signal data to be detected into the optimal network structure corresponding to the convolutional neural network, obtaining the confidence corresponding to the signal data to be detected, and obtaining the spectrum sensing result based on the confidence. The spectrum sensing of the signal to be detected is realized, and the accuracy of the spectrum sensing result is improved.

title: An image processing method and system for full-thickness brain CT images
description: The embodiment of the invention provides an image processing method and system for a full-layer brain CT image, which comprises the following steps: inputting a target brain CT image group into a trained convolutional neural network for feature extraction processing to obtain a feature map of each image in the target brain CT image group, and constructing a feature vector matrix corresponding to the target brain CT image group according to the feature maps; the trained convolutional neural network is obtained by training a sample brain CT image marked with a brain CT image classification label and a scanning interference label; and carrying out multi-feature fusion processing on the feature map in the feature vector matrix to obtain an image processing result of the target brain CT image group. According to the embodiment of the invention, the continuous brain CT images are subjected to feature extraction and fusion processing, the correlation among a group of brain CT images is correlated to obtain the brain CT image with stronger correlation, and the interference is removed to provide the brain CT image with better effect.

title: Screening method, device, electronic device and computer storage medium for feature data
description: The present application provides a screening method, device, electronic device and computer storage medium for feature data. The method includes: first, acquiring a feature set; wherein, the feature set includes at least one feature; then, all features in the feature set are Input to the calculation model, the input features are processed by the calculation model, and the benchmark performance score of the calculation model is obtained; then each feature in the feature set except the feature to be detected is input into the calculation model, and the input features are processed by the calculation model to obtain the calculation model. The reference performance score of the model; the feature to be detected refers to each feature in the feature set; finally, it is determined that the feature to be detected corresponding to the reference performance score greater than the benchmark performance score is an effective feature; wherein, the effective feature is used for training calculation Model. In order to achieve the purpose of selecting effective features to train the computational model, thereby improving the performance of the computational model obtained by training.

title: Optical character recognition method for tobacco documents and orders
description: The invention discloses an optical character recognition method for tobacco documents and orders. The method includes a training phase and a reasoning phase. The training phase collects tobacco documents for training and training pictures of the order, and sends them to a neural network for training after being processed by an algorithm. Optical text recognition pre-training model, in the inference stage, the collected images to be recognized are processed and sent to the optical text recognition pre-training model to obtain the inference results, and the inference results are structured and classified to obtain different text content and finally obtain different elements. content information. The present invention can train the neural network by using a small amount of data, and can effectively improve the accuracy of identification, greatly improve the efficiency of tobacco certificate and order entry, and thus enable tobacco retailing.

title: System and method for integrating statistical models of different data modalities
description: A technique for performing a prediction task using a multimodal statistical model, the multimodal statistical model being configured to receive input data from multiple modalities, including input data from a first modality and input data from a second modality different from the first modality. The technique includes: obtaining information specifying the multimodal statistical model, the information including values of parameters for each of a plurality of components of the multimodal statistical model, the plurality of components including first and second encoders, first and second modality embeddings, a joint modality representation, and a predictor for processing input data from the first and second modalities respectively; obtaining first input data from a first data modality; providing the first input data to a first encoder to generate a first feature vector; identifying a second feature vector using the joint modality representation, the first modality embedding, and the first feature vector; and using the predictor and the second feature vector to generate a prediction for the prediction task.

title: Chinese character font generation method based on compression and excitation GAN network
description: The invention discloses a Chinese character font generation method based on a compressed and excited GAN network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a font data set, wherein the font data set comprises two parts; constructing a font style conversion network, and realizing the conversion of Chinese character font styles to obtain font images; performing detail reconstruction on the font image by adopting end-to-end depth convolution through a detail reconstruction network model, and fusing Chinese character stroke semantics and a depth generation network; the characteristics of different intermediate layers in a decoder are utilized to supplement countermeasure training for the detail reconstruction network model; sequentially inputting the font data set into a detail reconstruction network model after the countermeasure training, and inputting a corresponding complete target font through a generator; different weights are given to different scale spaces by adopting an attention mechanism, so that global and comprehensive representations of the different scale spaces are obtained, the feeling of the neural network is improved, and the quality of the generated image can be further improved.

title: A method of constructing daily portrait of farmers market based on Bayesian network
description: The invention provides a method for constructing a daily portrait of a farmers market based on a Bayesian network. The method includes step 1. Obtaining agricultural product purchase, transaction and pesticide residue value detection data in a farmers market database, and selecting the daily purchase volume and sales volume in the data. , transaction volume, sales amount, total number of vegetable types, unit prices of different dishes and pesticide residue detection results as characteristic variables; step 2, clean and organize the data in step 1, and delete data with missing characteristic variables greater than 3 in the data , and replace the mean value of the data that is not within the reasonable value range; step 3, quantify the characteristics of the cleaned and sorted data; step 4, analyze the characteristic variables selected in step 1, and construct the Bayeux of the farmers market according to the analysis results Bayesian network topology structure; step 5, according to the feature quantized data in step 3, the Bayesian network node parameter learning is performed to form the daily portrait of the farmers market. This method can easily and quickly establish the daily portrait of the farmers market.

title: Occlusion image detection method, device and medium
description: The disclosure relates to a method, a device and a medium for detecting an occlusion image. The method comprises the steps of capturing an image through a camera, obtaining the image and taking the image as an image to be detected, inputting the image to be detected into a trained shielding image detection model, wherein the shielding image detection model adopts an original shielding image, does not have the shielding image, and is trained by utilizing a trained data characteristic enhancement network, judging whether the image to be detected is the shielding image or not based on shielding characteristics of the shielding image detection model, and outputting an image detection result. By adopting the method, the generation model can be stably trained to generate the shielding image features by using a small number of finger shielding images with mask marks, so that the problem of insufficient positive samples in the training of the finger shielding detection model can be effectively solved, and a large number of positive sample acquisition costs are saved.

title: Active Learning for Defect Classifier Training
description: The invention provides a method and system for performing active learning for a defect classifier. A system includes one or more computer subsystems configured for performing active learning for training a defect classifier. The active learning includes applying an acquisition function to data points of the sample. The acquisition function selects one or more of the data points based on an uncertainty estimate associated with the data points. The active learning also includes acquiring a signature of the selected one or more data points and generating a signature dataset that includes the selected one or more data points and the acquired signature. The computer subsystem is also configured for training the defect classifier using the label data set. The defect classifier is configured for classifying defects detected on the specimen using images generated by an imaging subsystem.

title: Optimization method of HarDNet-Lite on embedded platform
description: The present invention discloses an optimization method of HarDNet-Lite on an embedded platform, which is used to solve the problems that the existing target detection network is too complex, has a large amount of calculation, and has a slow reasoning speed and low positioning accuracy on an embedded platform. The method comprises the following steps: 1) building a lightweight HarDNet-Lite feature extraction network; 2) using a weighted FPN structure to fuse feature maps of different scales, so that the rich underlying detail information and high-level semantic information are fully integrated; 3) generating a YOLO detection head, placing anchor frames generated by k-means clustering on feature maps of different sizes, to detect targets of different scales; 4) using classification and regression loss functions to perform an end-to-end training model; 5) deploying the trained model on an embedded platform for target detection. The beneficial effect of the present invention is that the reasoning speed and target detection accuracy of the HarDNet-Lite target detection network on an embedded platform are improved.

title: Semi-supervised encryption traffic identification method for generating countermeasure network based on auxiliary classification
description: The invention discloses a semi-supervised encryption traffic identification method for generating a countermeasure network based on auxiliary classification. The method comprises the steps of transforming an original auxiliary classification generation countermeasure network, fusing a generator into vectors after receiving random noise, hidden variables and data labels, generating generated data containing real flow characteristics, receiving unmarked samples and marked samples in the real data by a discriminator, stacking three MLP networks to finish judgment of true and false flows, classifying the flows and extracting the hidden variables respectively. The method of the invention modifies the loss function of the original auxiliary classification generation countermeasure network, so that the method can utilize unmarked data to carry out semi-supervised learning, improve the identification precision, reduce the cost of network flow acquisition and marking, and simultaneously improve the network management and safety monitoring level.

title: On-orbit calibration method of Mars material analyzer based on elastic particle swarm optimization
description: The invention discloses an elastic particle swarm optimization-based on-orbit calibration method for a Mars substance analyzer, which is based on a particle swarm optimization algorithm and comprises nine steps of simulation environment cabin establishment and standard lamp testing, standard calibration equation establishment, target standard testing, target standard wavelength set establishment, on-orbit target testing, on-orbit spectral line peak searching, particle swarm generation, particle fitness calculation, particle evolution and on-orbit calibration equation establishment. The method has the advantages that the elastic matching fitness particle swarm optimization method is adopted to solve the wavelength fitting coefficient of the in-orbit LIBS spectrometer, and accurate in-orbit correction of the drift can be realized by means of evolution optimization of a large number of particles under the condition of large-scale drift of the spectrometer caused by an extraterrestrial field environment, so that the feasibility and the accuracy of planet LIBS material analysis are ensured, the method has strong environmental adaptability, and the method is particularly suitable for spectrum loads without sufficient energy for constant-temperature work, such as MarsCode and the like. The particle swarm software algorithm can achieve the same precision effect of constant temperature test under the condition of saving energy supply cost.

title: Segmentation method of myopic maculopathy in OCT images based on improved U-shaped network
description: The embodiment of the present application discloses a method for segmenting myopic maculopathy in retinal OCT images based on an improved U-shaped network. The method includes: building a network structure, which includes an encoder module, a feature aggregation pooling module FAPM, and a decoder module. , deep supervision module, and the feature aggregation pooling module FAPM is set in the encoder channel of the encoder module for downsampling and aggregation of global context information and local information, and the deep supervision module is set in each layer of the decoder except the bottom layer , used to guide the network to generate more representative feature maps; in the experiment, the output of the network structure was verified by the joint segmentation task of RBCC damage and myopic traction striation lesion areas in optical coherence tomography OCT images. The method for segmenting myopic maculopathy in retinal OCT images based on the improved U-shaped network of the present application realizes the automatic segmentation of RBCC damage and myopic traction lines in retinal OCT images, and improves the performance of small target segmentation.

title: A method for machine learning to set electricity prices to improve the operation level of power grids
description: A method for improving the operation level of a power grid by machine learning and fixed electricity price belongs to the technical field of power systems, and comprises the following steps: step 1: selecting a larger safe and stable operation area of the power grid, determining the area as one area according to the provincial power grid, and analyzing a day-ahead load prediction curve of the regional power grid; step 2: according to deviation from standard load P 0 Setting the actual electricity price; and step 3: stepping the electricity price; and 4, step 4: the invention divides the user power load into adjustable load and non-adjustable load, and the like, and utilizes the adjustment of the day-ahead load data on the power price to change the input power mode of the variable load, reduce the peak-valley difference, enhance the stability of the power grid, obtain an optimal power utilization strategy,the electricity cost of the user is the minimum.

title: Image recognition automatic labeling method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image labeling, and discloses an automatic labeling method, device, equipment and storage medium for image recognition. The method includes: acquiring an initial image, dividing the initial image according to a preset dividing rule, and obtaining several Image to be labeled, input the several images to be labeled into an image labeling algorithm model obtained by training for image labeling, obtain corresponding regional labeling images, and combine the corresponding regional labeling images according to preset combination rules, Get auto-annotated images. By dividing the initial image into several images to be annotated, and inputting the image to be annotated into the image annotation algorithm model to annotate the image, the region annotated image is obtained, and then the region annotated image is combined into a complete automatic annotated image without any manual operation, thereby reducing the need for The error rate affected by human factors is reduced, and the work efficiency of image annotation is improved.

title: Region identification method and device, storage medium and electronic device
description: The present invention provides a method and device for identifying a region, a storage medium, and an electronic device. The method includes: obtaining image information to be identified, wherein the image information to be identified includes an outdoor driving scene of a target movable device; obtaining a region identification result through the image information to be identified based on a target neural network model; when the region identification result indicates that the outdoor driving scene includes a first region of a first region type and a second region of a second region type, and there is an abnormal edge at the junction of the first region and the second region, setting the target movable device to not allow switching between the first region and the second region, wherein the first region of the first region type and the second region of the second region type are both passage areas where the target movable device is allowed to travel. Through the present invention, the problem that vehicles in the related art cannot adapt to different driving scenes is solved, and the effect that vehicles can adapt to different scenes is achieved.

title: Vehicle control method using vqa model
description: [Problem] To provide vehicle control using a VQA model. [Solution] The system/method performs an operation that includes receiving an image of a candidate object of interest or user (COI/U) captured by a camera mounted on the vehicle. The operation includes inputting a first dataset, which includes the image and a first question associated with the COI/U, into a VQA model. The operation includes obtaining an answer to the first question as output from the VQA model. The operation includes performing a vehicle operation based on the answer. [Selected Figure] Figure 1

title: Image quality improvement based on removing image degradation through learning from multiple machine learning models
description: The method includes receiving an input image. The method includes predicting a transformed version of the input image with an image transformation model, the image transformation model being trained to remove image degradations associated with the input image, the training including: (1) training a plurality of intermediate machine learning models to remove image degradations, each intermediate machine learning model of the plurality of intermediate machine learning models being trained with a respective training dataset of a plurality of training datasets corresponding to each of a plurality of degradation factors, each training dataset including a plurality of pairs of a sharp image and a corresponding synthetically degraded version of the sharp image; and (2) the image transformation model being trained with an additional training dataset of real images and learning from the plurality of intermediate machine learning models. The method includes providing the predicted transformed version.

title: Face image-changing model training method, device, equipment and medium
description: A face image model training method, device, equipment and medium. The method comprises the following steps: superposing the human face basic image of the first person and the human face characteristic image of the second person to obtain a training image; inputting the training image into a preset neural network consisting of a cyclic generation type confrontation network cycleGAN and a VGG network to obtain an output image; determining a loss function value according to the output image and the target image; and adjusting the network parameters of the preset neural network according to the loss function values so as to enable the loss function values to meet the preset conditions, and obtaining the face image changing model. According to the method, the device, the equipment and the medium provided by the embodiment of the invention, the face-changing image of the person to be replaced can be obtained when the human face basic image of any person is taken as the input image.

title: Method, device and system for processing data
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose methods, apparatus, and systems for processing data. A specific implementation of the method includes: receiving a deep learning request including a learning target and raw data; determining a target deep learning module required to complete the learning target; sending the raw data to the target deep learning module; obtaining the data returned by the target deep learning module data processing results. In this embodiment, specific deep learning modules can be customized according to requirements. This deep learning modular design is flexible and easy to migrate to similar projects.

title: Method for optimizing traffic organization of limited bidirectional channel ship
description: The invention relates to a method for optimizing the ship traffic organization of a restricted two-way channel, which includes: establishing a multi-objective optimization model for the ship traffic organization of a restricted two-way channel according to the special navigation rules of the restricted two-way channel, including establishing a multi-objective optimization model for ensuring the smooth navigation process of ships in the port. The ship's pre-navigation preparation model, the restricted/one-way navigation mode conversion model used to meet the variability of the restricted two-way channel navigation mode, and the restricted one-way/two-way navigation model used to ensure the one-way navigation of the ship in the restricted one-way segment Navigation mode conversion model, traffic conflict resolution model to ensure safe navigation of ships at risk points on restricted routes; establish a multi-objective evolution model; instantiate the multi-objective evolution model to obtain an optimization plan for restricted two-way ship traffic organization. The invention can be used to assist relevant port departments in formulating optimization plans for restrictive two-way channel ship traffic organization, and improve the safety and efficiency of port ship entry and exit operations.

title: Horizontal federated modeling optimization method, apparatus, device and readable storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium for optimizing horizontal federal modeling, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing parameter updating operation on a local basic model by adopting a preset local data set to obtain parameter updating information respectively corresponding to a private part model and a public part model in the local basic model, wherein the public part models of all participating devices have the same structure; sending the parameter updating information corresponding to the common part model to the coordination equipment participating in the horizontal federal modeling, so that the coordination equipment performs federal fusion on the parameter updating information sent by each piece of participation equipment to obtain global updating information; and updating model parameters in the public part model by adopting the global updating information received from the coordinating equipment, and updating model parameters in the private part model by adopting the parameter updating information of the private part model so as to update the local basic model. After the invention realizes the horizontal federal modeling, each participating device can flexibly adjust the respective local model.

title: A pedestrian tracking method, device and medium based on LSTM model escalator scene
description: The invention discloses a pedestrian tracking method based on an LSTM model escalator scene, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a video stream of pedestrians under an escalator scene in a monitoring video; creating a target detection model, and detecting the video stream to obtain a tracking target; classifying the tracking targets according to the positions of the pedestrians, screening the tracking targets, tracking the tracking targets, and generating target tracking tracks; training the pedestrian trajectory data under the normal operation condition of the escalator by using a neural network to obtain the conventional pedestrian motion trajectory; matching the target tracking track with the conventional pedestrian motion track by using an LSTM-based track matching model, and distinguishing a target with an abnormal track; and performing key tracking on the abnormal tracking target. The embodiment of the invention discloses a pedestrian tracking method based on an LSTM model escalator scene, which is used for classifying and tracking optimizing multiple targets by adopting a track matching method of an LSTM model and fusing the escalator scene, so that the detection speed, the tracking efficiency and the tracking precision are improved.

title: A knowledge graph completion method, device, device and storage medium
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of knowledge graph processing, and particularly relates to a knowledge graph complementing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein semantic association information between entities and relations in a knowledge graph is extracted from entity description text information of the knowledge graph through a preset association information extraction model, the semantic association information and the knowledge graph are associated and reconstructed, an entity description text input sequence is encoded through a deep Bi-GRU network and a preset association strengthening model to obtain encoded entity association sequence information, the entity association sequence information is decoded through a unidirectional GRU network, each candidate entity in the decoded knowledge graph is comprehensively graded, each entity in an entity description text data set is sequentially linked to the candidate entity with the highest comprehensive grade in the knowledge graph to complement the knowledge graph, thereby enhancing the semantic association information of the existing knowledge graph.

title: Artificial intelligence-based implant position prediction method, device, terminal and medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of oral implant technology. The present invention discloses an implant position prediction method, device, terminal and medium based on artificial intelligence, which can improve the accuracy of the prediction result of the implant position. The implant position prediction method based on artificial intelligence includes obtaining first implant position information of a crown area and multiple crown slice images; using an artificial intelligence algorithm to process the first implant position information and all the crown slice images to obtain the target implant position information of the implant in the root area corresponding to the crown area.

title: Large model-fractal combined auxiliary mineral image intelligent segmentation and identification method
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of computer vision and image processing. A method for intelligent segmentation and recognition of mineral images assisted by a large model-fractal joint is provided, comprising the steps of: acquiring mineral image data, performing preprocessing to obtain a mineral image data set; constructing an initial joint model based on a SAM and a fractal model, training the initial joint model, and obtaining a joint model; optimizing the joint model through the mineral image data set to obtain an optimized joint model; segmenting the mineral image to be processed, and marking the boundaries of the mineral particles in the mineral image to be processed; performing fractal analysis on the marked mineral particles through the optimized joint model, and outputting the segmentation mask and fractal quantitative information of the mineral particles. This method solves the problem that the traditional mineral image analysis method relies on manual observation and manual annotation, which is not only time-consuming and labor-intensive, but also easily affected by subjective factors, resulting in inconsistency and uncertainty in the analysis results.

title: Vertical federal learning-oriented hidden back door attack method, equipment and product
description: The present invention discloses a hidden backdoor attack method, device and product for vertical federated learning, analyzes two attack modes, input space and potential space, and studies the risk of attackers embedding backdoors into vertical federated learning models without directly intervening in global data or labels; the input space attack is to replace part of the input samples and inject triggers during the training process of the vertical federated learning model, so that the top model learns the association between the backdoor trigger and the target label, thereby guiding the top model to misclassify the samples with triggers in the inference stage; the potential space attack is to directly act on the feature embedding space of its local model during the training process of the vertical federated learning model, and use the optimization strategy to adjust the embedding vector to generate a specific backdoor response in the top model. The present invention lays a solid foundation for the design and optimization of defense mechanisms and promotes the security improvement of VFL technology.

title: Wheat disease detection method based on deep learning
description: The present application relates to the field of wheat disease detection, and specifically to a wheat disease detection method based on deep learning. It uses image processing technology based on deep learning to perform foreground target extraction and multi-level feature extraction on the wheat image to be detected, so as to capture the shallow and deep features of the wheat foreground, and use the Transformer architecture to perform global interaction modeling on the shallow and deep features of the wheat foreground, respectively, to enhance the contextual information expression ability of the features, and then perform two-way attention joint perception on the two, so as to intelligently identify whether the wheat has disease. In this way, the accuracy of wheat disease detection can be effectively improved, and the robustness of the model in complex scenarios can be enhanced.

title: Intelligent track defect detection and fault identification system and method
description: The present invention discloses a system and method for intelligent track defect detection and fault identification. The system includes: a real-time image acquisition module and a real-time Tiny computing chip module; the real-time Tiny computing chip module includes an image processing unit, an image anomaly detection and judgment unit and a fault type identification unit; the real-time image acquisition module collects track circuit images in the train path in real time; the image processing unit extracts the track circuit physical feature diagram in real time according to the track circuit image; the image anomaly detection and judgment unit performs track defect detection according to the extracted track circuit physical feature diagram, and outputs the detection result; the fault type identification unit completes track fault identification according to the track defect detection result, and outputs the identification result. Through the system of the present invention, it is possible to support staff to quickly and effectively reach the fault site for error correction and maintenance, so as to improve the efficiency of track circuit maintenance and reduce the workload of track circuit maintenance.

title: Intelligent analysis system and method for orthopedic nursing
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent analysis system and method for orthopedic care, which relates to the field of medical information technology, including collecting and preprocessing medical imaging data, combining with the patient's daily motion state data, constructing a multidimensional data set containing bone morphological features and motion features, extracting data features, using attention mechanism for adaptive fusion, and establishing a digital feature model containing static morphological features and dynamic motion features; based on the digital feature model, obtaining joint force characteristics and coupling characteristics, constructing a comprehensive evaluation index system to achieve quantitative evaluation of bone health status; according to the evaluation index system, constructing a multi-level risk warning system to monitor and warn abnormal conditions in real time, and adaptively generating personalized rehabilitation plans and exercise suggestions based on rehabilitation progress evaluation indicators. The present invention not only ensures the safety of the rehabilitation process, but also improves the pertinence of the rehabilitation effect by combining the rehabilitation parameter adjustment method with dual-objective optimization.

title: Intelligent driving path planning method and system based on reinforcement learning
description: The invention discloses an intelligent driving path planning method and system based on reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a detection area into a plurality of grids; the method comprises the steps of obtaining detection data, inputting the detection data into a preset target recognition model for analysis, outputting recognition data of a recognition target, analyzing the recognition data of the recognition target through a preset path planning model, determining a moving path of the recognition target, determining a second predicted running probability and a second occupied time interval of each grid, calculating an intersection risk score of each grid, intercepting a preset running path of a current vehicle, determining a first running path, and adjusting the first running path according to the intersection risk score of each grid on the first running path. The traffic environment is analyzed in real time, so that a safe and efficient driving path is generated, and the safety of intelligent driving is ensured.

title: Big data-based electric bed quality evaluation system
description: The present invention discloses an electric bed quality assessment system based on big data, comprising a data acquisition layer, an edge cloud layer, an AI analysis model and a visualization module; the data acquisition layer is used to collect raw data of the electric bed; the edge cloud layer is used to receive, store and preprocess the raw data; the AI analysis model is used to analyze the processed data after preprocessing by the edge cloud layer; the visualization module integrates a line graph, a box plot, a quality assessment block diagram and life prediction data on a digital twin model; the present invention can not only monitor the status of the electric bed in real time, but also effectively predict faults, extend the life of the equipment, and improve the operational convenience of users and managers through data visualization; it has high application value, especially in improving the reliability of electric beds, reducing maintenance costs and improving user experience.

title: GAN-based blade battery pole piece defect detection model construction method
description: The invention discloses a GAN-based blade battery pole piece defect detection model construction method which comprises the steps of collecting a plurality of target pole piece images with defects, preprocessing the images to obtain preprocessed images, extracting effective areas with the defects in the images, obtaining contour information for the effective areas and accurately classifying the effective areas according to characteristic parameters, carrying out data enhancement on the classified data to obtain an enhanced data set, training a neural network in the data set by taking defect types and position information as labels, and taking the neural network model as a defect detection model of a blade battery pole piece. According to the invention, the data set with enhanced data is used as a training set to be input into a network, so that the problem that the training samples are seriously insufficient due to the fact that the number of types of defects of the battery pole pieces is large and the occurrence probability of individual samples is low is solved, the detection accuracy of the battery pole piece defect detection model is greatly improved, and various defects and position information of the battery pole pieces with blades can be rapidly and accurately detected.

title: Video frame inserting method, electronic device, chip system and readable storage medium
description: The application provides a video frame inserting method, electronic equipment, a chip system and a readable storage medium, wherein the method is applied to the electronic equipment and comprises the steps of acquiring a first image and a second image, inputting the first image and the second image into a first module, extracting pixel characteristics through the first module to obtain a first characteristic image, inputting the first characteristic image into a second module, dividing the first characteristic image into a first sub-characteristic image and a second sub-characteristic image through the second module, determining difference data between the first sub-characteristic image and the second sub-characteristic image, and predicting to obtain a third image according to the difference data, wherein the difference data is used for representing the motion condition of pixels in a time sequence from the first image to the second image. Thus, the application realizes the acquisition of the intermediate image between the two images by the frame inserting model which does not comprise non-convolution operation such as pooling operation, interpolation up-sampling operation and the like, and can shorten the time for outputting the intermediate image by the frame inserting model.

title: Semi-supervised multi-view clustering integration method and system based on width learning
description: The present invention relates to the field of machine learning, and discloses a semi-supervised multi-view clustering integration method and system based on width learning, the method comprising the following steps: constructing an autoencoder based on width learning that can perform feature processing based on multi-view face image data, for extracting features from input face images, and calculating the weights of different node features based on width learning; constructing a clustering integration model by combining the autoencoder based on width learning and bidirectional constraint propagation; and realizing clustering integration of multi-view face images using the clustering integration model. The present invention utilizes the performance advantages of the width learning system to perform clustering processing on multi-view data, obtains a model network with both efficiency and performance, introduces a flow structure and pairwise constraints, and adopts constraint propagation in the consensus process to enrich sample information, effectively improving the robustness and accuracy of the clustering integration network model based on width learning, and thus is more applicable in actual scenarios.

title: Urban rail engineering building energy-saving design method and system based on deep learning
description: The urban rail engineering building energy-saving design method and system based on deep learning proposed in this application takes the multiple entrances and exits corresponding to each urban rail station as analysis targets, generates multiple first building portraits according to the multiple first buildings corresponding to each first entrance and exit, thereby obtaining multiple first entrance and exit portraits according to the multiple first building portraits, and obtaining the first lighting control strategy in combination with the historical travel patterns of the first entrance and exit. In addition, the first air-conditioning control strategy is obtained based on the multiple first entrance and exit portraits and the comparison of the clothing of passengers when getting on and off the train, thereby integrating the first lighting control strategy and the first air-conditioning control strategy in the dimension of time interval to obtain the first urban rail energy-saving adjustment strategy. Through the technical solution of this application, the lighting strategy and air-conditioning operation strategy in the urban rail station can be made more in line with the actual needs of users, thereby effectively reducing the energy consumption of the urban rail station.

title: Method for managing biological information of user by aid of diagnosis guiding system based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention discloses a biological information management method for a user based on an artificial intelligence diagnosis guiding system, which comprises the steps that the user interacts with intelligent diagnosis guiding equipment, the intelligent diagnosis guiding equipment binds collected audio information and facial image information with a user account of the user and stores the collected audio information and facial image information in a corresponding user database, when the user uses the intelligent diagnosis guiding equipment again and interacts, the intelligent diagnosis guiding equipment invokes data in a user database of a registered user from a server after comparing facial image information of the user with facial image information of the user database, the intelligent diagnosis guiding equipment performs normal interaction with the registered user and simultaneously collects current audio information of the registered user in real time, and when the deviation value of the current audio information of the registered user and the audio information in the user database is large, the intelligent diagnosis guiding equipment actively sends reminding information, so that the reminding function can be automatically made, and the medical experience and the safety of the patient are further improved.

title: Infrared small target detection method based on fusion architecture of Transformer and U-shaped network
description: The invention discloses an infrared small target detection method based on a fusion architecture of a Transformer and a U-shaped network, which can obtain wider context information under the condition of maintaining resolution in the feature extraction process by a light and efficient robust feature extraction module, and can effectively alleviate the problems of information loss and feature blurring caused by deep sampling. Meanwhile, IRconvformer blocks are adopted, semantic information of the image blocks is enriched in a novel embedding mode, a novel attention mechanism is used for focusing target characteristics, background interference is reduced, a feedforward network is optimized through a gating mechanism, and local information sensing and denoising capabilities are enhanced. The method solves the problems that the prior art is difficult to consider better global and local precision and cannot accurately judge the real target and the strong interference.

title: Rolling bearing anomaly detection model construction method and system
description: This invention belongs to the technical field of bearing anomaly related fields and discloses a method and system for constructing a rolling bearing anomaly detection model. The method includes the following steps: collecting vibration signals from the bearing to form an original vibration signal set A and assigning fault labels; using a data generation model to process the original vibration signal set to generate new vibration signals, forming a new vibration signal set B; splicing the vibration signal set B with the vibration signals in the original vibration signal set A to form a spliced vibration signal, the fault labels of the spliced vibration signal being the same as those in the vibration signal set B; adding the spliced vibration signal to the original vibration signal set A to form a vibration signal set C; training an anomaly detection model using the vibration signal set C to obtain the required rolling bearing anomaly detection model, the input of which is the vibration signal and the output is the fault label. This invention solves the technical problem of difficulty in bearing anomaly detection.

title: Harmonic detection method, system equipment and terminal based on dung beetle optimization algorithm
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of harmonic detection, but is not limited to, and particularly relates to a harmonic detection method, system equipment and terminal based on a dung beetle optimization algorithm, in order to obtain high-precision harmonic parameters, sampling data are firstly analyzed through Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) and then processed through the dung beetle optimization algorithm, and the method specifically comprises the following steps: DFT transform A Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) Fourier analysis is the most basic method for signal analysis, and Fourier transform is the core of Fourier analysis, and the frequency spectrum structure and the change rule of the signal are further researched by transforming the signal from the time domain to the frequency domain. B. Judging whether inter-harmonic exists, and C, updating the amplitude, frequency and phase of the harmonic by adopting a dung beetle algorithm. The waveform reconstructed by the algorithm is basically consistent with the original waveform, and the algorithm has the characteristics of high precision and rapid convergence.

title: Flexible scheduling method for finished cigarette and tobacco raw material mixing warehouse of tobacco enterprise
