description: The invention discloses a flexible scheduling method of a tobacco enterprise cigarette finished product and tobacco raw material mixing warehouse, which comprises the steps of obtaining and obtaining a mixed warehouse road surface congestion condition and a truck loading and unloading condition according to the number of mixed warehouse road surface trucks, loading and unloading operation trucks and waiting trucks and the average speed of mixed warehouse road surface traveling trucks, guiding each truck to a target dock to load and unload a cigarette finished product/tobacco raw material or a warehouse outlet area by combining a preset truck operation scheduling principle, obtaining and obtaining the mixed warehouse inter-warehouse congestion condition and the forklift loading and unloading condition according to the number of mixed warehouse dock operation trucks, elevator operation trucks and inter-warehouse operation trucks and the average speed of mixed warehouse inter-warehouse operation trucks, and guiding each forklift to the target dock or the warehouse to load and unload the cigarette finished product/tobacco raw material by combining a preset forklift operation scheduling principle. The invention solves the problems of low utilization efficiency of tobacco finished products and raw materials in a warehouse entry platform, low warehouse entry and exit operation efficiency and congestion of elevators for goods.

title: Track inspection equipment and track inspection vehicle
description: In an embodiment of the present application, a track inspection device is provided, including a device body, which has: an image acquisition module for collecting surface image information and three-dimensional structural information of the rail; a main control module connected to the image acquisition module, for real-time processing of the rail image data collected by the image acquisition module, and alarming according to the processing results; a network communication module connected to the main control module, and uploading the processing results of the main control module to a host computer. The present application collects the surface image information and three-dimensional structural information of the rail through the image acquisition module, and the main control module processes the above-mentioned rail image data of the image acquisition module, and alarms according to the processing results; at the same time, the processing results are uploaded to the host computer; the image acquisition module covers the rails on both sides of the railway line, detects the defects of the rails in real time, improves the inspection efficiency and accuracy, and reduces the risk of human misdetection and missed detection.

title: Multi-scale cross-mode-based satellite remote sensing image graph and text retrieval method, system, terminal and medium
description: The invention belongs to the field of image retrieval, and particularly relates to a multi-scale cross-modal satellite remote sensing image graph and text retrieval method, a system, a terminal and a medium, which are used for constructing a multi-source multi-scale cross-modal remote sensing image semantic understanding model; the method comprises the steps of processing a plurality of source satellite remote sensing images by using a multi-source multi-scale cross-mode remote sensing image semantic understanding model to obtain source feature vectors of the source satellite remote sensing images, storing the source feature vectors in a vector library, processing input image retrieval information or text retrieval information by using the multi-source multi-scale cross-mode remote sensing image semantic understanding model to obtain image retrieval feature vectors or text retrieval feature vectors, comparing the image retrieval feature vectors or text retrieval feature vectors with the source feature vectors in the vector library in similarity, and screening out target source satellite remote sensing images. The invention improves the robustness of text and image features, constructs a unified storage and management carrier aiming at multi-source data features, and improves the management efficiency, the retrieval precision and the efficiency.

title: Entity semantic guidance and relationship fusion-based pairing-free cross-modal retrieval method
description: The present invention discloses an unpaired cross-modal retrieval method based on entity semantic guidance and relationship fusion, including: extracting entity image features and entity text features from entity data sets; obtaining entity public semantic space through negative sample selection and intra-modal neighbor relationship constraints based on entity image features and entity text features; obtaining a high-confidence image-text pseudo-pairing set through pseudo-pairing generation and screening methods based on entity public semantic space; capturing relationship information and aligning through a relationship fusion module based on the high-confidence image-text pseudo-pairing set to obtain a fused public semantic space; calculating the similarity between images and texts based on the fused public semantic space, sorting according to the similarity and outputting cross-modal retrieval results. Compared with other unpaired cross-modal retrieval methods, the present invention has significantly improved performance, the learned space can accurately express data from a deeper level, and the overall method has better interpretability.

title: Brain-computer interface cap-based brain-computer signal processing method, system and medium
description: The invention discloses an electroencephalogram signal processing method and a rehabilitation system of an electroencephalogram signal interface cap, which are characterized in that processing operations such as band-pass filtering, feature extraction and the like are carried out on an electroencephalogram signal collected by the electroencephalogram signal interface cap, and model learning is carried out on the extracted features through a convolutional neural network model, so that the action intention of an output subject is more close to the actual action intention, the classification accuracy of the electroencephalogram signal is improved, meanwhile, the electroencephalogram signal is collected in a single-stage communication mode, and electrodes at the bottoms of two ears are connected into electrode holes in the electroencephalogram signal interface cap through communication wires arranged in the brain-computer interface cap.

title: Big data-based automobile industry financial data processing method, platform and system
description: The application discloses a car industry financial data processing method based on big data, which relates to the field of data processing and comprises the steps of obtaining car industry financial data; the method comprises the steps of analyzing data circulation characteristics of automobile property data, constructing a property data graph network according to the data circulation characteristics of the automobile property data, sampling the property data graph network based on the characteristic similarity to obtain a circulation characteristic sample set, dividing the circulation characteristic sample set into an abnormal training set and an abnormal test set, sampling the abnormal training set to obtain a mixed training set, marking abnormal points of the mixed training set, inputting the mixed training set into a preset property abnormality detection model for iterative training to obtain a target property abnormality detection model, and inputting an abnormality test set into the target property abnormality detection model to obtain data abnormality of the automobile property data. The application can effectively realize high-precision anomaly detection for data with large data quantity and high dimensionality.

title: Method and device for determining tunnel arrangement by using tunnel boring machine and drilling and blasting combined construction method
description: The present invention provides a method and device for determining tunnel layout using a tunnel boring machine and a drilling and blasting combined method, and relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering. The method comprises: obtaining the diameter information of the tunnel; based on the diameter information of the tunnel, obtaining the position information of the concrete transport vehicle, the air duct and the belt conveyor; obtaining the initial parameters of the particle swarm algorithm; based on the initial parameters, using the particle swarm algorithm to obtain particles with the best fitness, and the corresponding tunnel section diameter and internal equipment layout scheme are the optimal solutions sought. By implementing this method, the equipment layout scheme in the tunnel can be determined quickly and accurately, ensuring that the spatial relationship between the equipment is reasonable and the operation efficiency is high, while meeting the requirements of the safe operation distance. At the same time, since the diameter of the TBM tunnel is reduced after optimization, a large amount of construction costs can be saved. This has important guiding significance for equipment layout and operation arrangement in tunnel construction.

title: Target detection method and system based on sparse region extraction
description: The invention discloses a target detection method and system based on sparse region extraction. The method comprises the steps of firstly extracting image features to be detected, carrying out fusion enhancement to obtain enhancement features with different resolutions, then screening out feature windows through a sparse region extraction module according to the high-resolution features, then generating a first priori frame based on the feature windows, predicting categories and offset by a first target detection head module, simultaneously generating a second priori frame according to other enhancement features, predicting by a second target detection head module, finally adding all the priori frames into a candidate anchor frame set after offset, and obtaining a final target detection frame through non-maximum suppression. According to the invention, the sparse region extraction is carried out on the high-resolution features, the important partial regions are screened to detect the small-size targets, and the other low-resolution features are subjected to normal global target detection, so that the detection accuracy of the small-size targets is improved, and the detection efficiency is improved.

title: Plant growth state deep learning identification method and system based on plant lamp
description: The present invention relates to the field of deep learning recognition technology, and discloses a deep learning recognition method and system for plant growth status based on plant lamps. The method comprises: using a track-type multi-spectral camera array matched with a fixed LED plant fill light to collect multimodal data of the plant growth area, and obtain a plant image data set and an environmental parameter data set; performing feature extraction to obtain a plant growth feature vector; performing plant growth status recognition and fill light demand prediction based on a multi-task deep learning model of an improved Transformer architecture, and obtaining plant growth stage discrimination results and fill light demand spatiotemporal distribution data; constructing an initial fill light parameter optimization model based on the plant growth stage discrimination results and fill light demand spatiotemporal distribution data, and obtaining an LED plant fill light illumination parameter sequence through deep Q network iterative optimization. The present invention realizes efficient optimization and dynamic adjustment of fill light parameters, and significantly improves the accuracy of fill light control.

title: Decoding and encoding method, device and equipment
description: The present application provides a decoding and encoding method, device and equipment thereof, the decoding method comprising: obtaining a first feature corresponding to a current image block through a first neural network, and obtaining a feature adjustment factor corresponding to the current image block, the first neural network comprising at least one convolutional layer; determining a target feature based on the first feature and the feature adjustment factor; based on the target feature, obtaining a reconstructed image block corresponding to the current image block through a second neural network, the second neural network comprising at least one convolutional layer. Through the technical solution of the present application, the encoding performance and the decoding performance can be improved.

title: A data privacy protection method
description: The invention provides a data privacy protection method which comprises the steps of obtaining an original data set, extracting a high-sensitivity field, calculating the correlation between the high-sensitivity field and other fields, determining a high-correlation field combination, carrying out intelligent segmentation and decentralized storage on the high-correlation field combination, constructing a distributed hash table index, realizing encryption aggregation and asynchronous updating of global model parameters through a federal learning framework, constructing a contrast sample for the high-correlation field combination, training a privacy protection defense model, carrying out differential privacy disturbance processing on the high-sensitivity field, calculating the correlation risk index of the high-correlation field combination in real time, generating a correlation risk analysis report, dynamically adjusting a data segmentation strategy according to the correlation risk analysis report, optimizing local model training sample selection, and triggering self-adaptive updating of a differential privacy de-correlation processing flow if the correlation risk index exceeds a preset safety threshold.

title: A method for optimizing composite membrane performance parameters based on neural network
description: The invention provides a composite membrane performance parameter optimization method based on a neural network, which relates to the technical field of composite membranes, and is used for dynamically regulating and controlling the optimization priority of targets by setting an optimization target set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a two-stage optimization structure, wherein a first layer adopts a neural network input layer to add weight codes, a second layer automatically adjusts a hidden layer activation function based on target sensitivity to adapt to different optimization requirements, adopts a dynamic error compensation mechanism to respectively carry out joint analysis on target errors and adjust a neural network loss function to control the errors in different optimization modes, adjusts the target weights through continuous two-round optimization iteration, corrects the weight codes according to the error change trend, realizes the self-adaptive switching of an optimization target, and improves the comprehensive performance of a composite membrane. The invention can achieve higher optimization precision and adaptability in the aspect of optimizing the performance parameters of the composite membrane, and improves the comprehensive performance of the composite membrane.

title: A mangrove ecological management system and method based on drone
description: The invention discloses a mangrove ecological management system and method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, which relate to the technical field of ecological management, and are characterized in that a first recognition model and a second recognition model are arranged to respectively recognize vegetation growth states and suspected victim plants of a target mangrove area, so that compared with the existing method of only adopting single-model recognition, the image data processing capacity of each recognition model can be effectively reduced, the effect of improving the recognition efficiency is achieved, and the condition that the single-model recognition accuracy is poor is avoided on the premise that each recognition model can effectively perform targeted recognition; meanwhile, the identification result of each identification model is quantized, so that an analysis result which is more based on data driving and higher in scientificity can be obtained, the subsequent establishment of a corresponding management plan can be developed based on more scientific quantization basis, and the ecological management of mangrove can be more effective and scientific.

title: A method for economic load allocation of supercritical wet cooling and heating units based on multi-objective intelligent optimization
description: The invention discloses a load economic distribution method of a supercritical wet cold heat supply unit based on multi-objective intelligent optimization, which relates to the technical field of supercritical wet cold heat supply units, and the invention remarkably enhances the global searching capability of weighing among objectives in the load distribution process through intervention of an intelligent algorithm, provides strong support for formulating an operation strategy under a complex and changeable operation environment, takes environmental emission control into consideration as an optimization objective, is beneficial to reducing the influence of the heat supply system operation on the environment, according to the current social requirement for environmental protection, the unit operation is more refined through accurate simulation and optimization calculation, the energy waste is reduced, the environmental protection target is realized, meanwhile, the maximization of economic benefit is ensured, the capability of reacting market change can be greatly improved, the load distribution is more adaptive and ageing, and the high-degree intellectualization and self-adaptation enable the invention to have important application value and popularization prospect in the current and future energy supply field.

title: Refractive medium abnormality detection method, storage medium and electronic equipment
description: The application provides a method for detecting refractive medium abnormality, a storage medium and an electronic device, after acquiring an eyeball shooting image of a target to be detected, and carrying out image quality enhancement processing on the racket image to obtain an enhanced eyeball image, and cutting the enhanced eyeball image according to the boundary of the pupil region to obtain a pupil image of the target to be detected. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a refractive medium detection model in advance through a learning training mode, and inputting pupil images into the refractive medium detection model to obtain a region segmentation result of the pupil images, wherein the region segmentation result comprises a pupil normal region, a pupil abnormal region and an eyelash region. And determining the refractive medium abnormality detection result of the target to be detected according to the position and the area occupation ratio of the pupil abnormality region in the pupil image. The application can improve the segmentation precision and accuracy of the abnormal region in the pupil image, avoid false detection of eyelashes, and improve the accuracy of refractive medium abnormality detection, thereby improving the judgment accuracy of whether cataract exists according to the detection accuracy.

title: Intelligent obstetrical nursing screening auxiliary system
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent obstetric nursing screening auxiliary system, including an information entry module, a physiological data collection module, a risk assessment module, a nursing plan generation module, a prompt warning module and a data security management module. The present invention belongs to the field of nursing assistance technology, specifically an intelligent obstetric nursing screening auxiliary system, which uses a deep separable convolutional neural network to extract features in ultrasound images of pregnant women and fetal development features, analyzes the temporal changes of physiological data, uses recursive weight updates, adjusts the update amplitude according to the window size, ensures that the model effectively captures long-term trends, and combines the attention mechanism to weightedly fuse different modal features; performs search and matching on encrypted data, performs attribute verification, compares the requester's attribute vector with the access strategy vector, introduces adjustment parameters for keyword weights to calculate relevance scores and sorts, and improves data retrieval efficiency.

title: Market supervision dynamic monitoring and intelligent risk early warning system and method based on big data
description: The invention discloses a market supervision dynamic monitoring and intelligent risk early warning system and method based on big data, and relates to the technical field of monitoring and early warning. The invention carries out full-flow dynamic monitoring on market supervision tasks through a dynamic monitoring module, sets a risk analysis module to carry out intelligent analysis on abnormal behaviors or trends of a market main body, carries out feature extraction and risk classification on monitoring data through a chaotic immunity optimization algorithm and a migration immunity algorithm to generate a risk early warning report comprising risk grades, risk types and corresponding treatment suggestions, displays the stock, increment, industry trend and regional distribution situation of the market main body in a visual mode based on the analysis result of the risk analysis module, integrates an early warning notification function, sends the risk early warning result to related supervision departments, supports priority processing of risks of different grades and a multi-department collaborative early warning mechanism, and realizes full life cycle dynamic supervision and intelligent risk early warning of the market main body.

title: Optimal focusing embryo image screening method based on ConvNeXt network of fusion position information
description: This invention discloses a method for selecting optimally focused embryonic images based on a ConvNeXt network with fused location information. The method includes: 1) combining two grayscale embryonic images to create dual-channel combined data that conforms to the model input pattern; 2) subtracting the data from the two channels of the dual-channel combined data to obtain a difference image and downsampling it; 3) using a convolutional neural network to extract the overall features of the difference image, obtaining the corresponding feature matrix; 4) incorporating the prior information of the location index of the original embryonic image corresponding to the dual-channel combined data into the feature matrix; 5) constructing a loss function and training a binary classification model for optimally focused images; and 7) using the trained binary classification model to process a set of embryonic images to achieve the selection of optimally focused images. This invention can effectively analyze the focus of embryonic images, demonstrates excellent performance in the task of selecting optimally focused embryonic images, and has a certain degree of interpretability.

title: Method for improving video semantic understanding based on space-time convolution
description: The invention relates to a method for improving video semantic understanding based on space-time convolution, which comprises the following steps of S1 collecting training data from various channels, S2 carrying out preliminary processing on the training data, S3 carrying out audio description labeling on the training data by utilizing a Clap model and/or a manual labeling mode to obtain training data matched with video-audio description, S4 sending the training data into the model for training in a video-audio description pairing mode, S41 adding a visual connector after a visual encoder, S42 aligning a video mode with the audio description through a visual adapter after the visual connector, S43 obtaining a Mel frequency spectrum through a diffusion model and a decoder and then obtaining output audio through a vocoder, S5 carrying out audio synthesis by utilizing the trained model, and outputting synthetic audio by taking a video frame as input. The invention obviously improves the overall quality of the synthesized sound effect through the refinement treatment of the input video frame.

title: An intelligent detection method for equipment anomalies based on periodic data
description: The present invention relates to an intelligent device anomaly detection method based on periodic data, comprising the following steps: obtaining a three-phase power signal during device operation; processing the three-phase power signal to obtain a single integrated time series signal; constructing a state machine and obtaining a periodic data set in combination with a sliding window technique; time-aligning the time axis of each periodic data and obtaining its corresponding discretized time series; inputting the discretized time series of each periodic data into a statistical model for preliminary screening, determining whether the periodic data is a normal cycle or an abnormal cycle, and inputting the obtained normal cycle into an unsupervised TadGAN model for training; collecting the three-phase power signal to be detected in real time, and inputting the signal into the trained unsupervised TadGAN model for anomaly detection; the method can accurately extract periodic data, avoid misjudgment due to transient noise or load fluctuation, and improve the accuracy of anomaly judgment by the unsupervised TadGAN model.

title: A device failure early warning method based on time series data trend prediction
description: The invention provides an equipment fault early warning method based on time sequence data trend prediction, which comprises the steps of constructing pearson correlation coefficients among different measuring points to obtain equipment measuring point correlation data, amplifying early abnormal data features based on history and current data, detecting the abnormal data to obtain a detection result according to the equipment measuring point correlation data through a measuring point trend prediction model of a time sequence, judging equipment fault conditions according to the detection result, and realizing subsequent early warning. The failure condition is predicted by the correlation data among the measuring points through a time sequence measuring point trend prediction model, and the alarm is given according to the detection result, so that the technical problem that the accuracy of predicting the failure is poor due to the fact that the correlation among the measuring point data is not considered in the prior art is solved.

title: A space target image optimization and recognition system
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of image processing, and particularly discloses a space target image optimizing and identifying system which comprises an image processing module, a feature analysis module and a target identifying module, wherein the image processing module comprises sharpening pretreatment and edge extraction, the feature analysis module comprises feature space distribution optimization, the target identifying module comprises target increment identification, the sharpening pretreatment is used for improving the quality and the definition of an image, the edge extraction is used for accurately extracting the edge of the target in the image and providing a basis for subsequent processing, the feature space distribution optimization is used for analyzing and optimizing the features of the target and improving the accuracy and the efficiency of identification, the target increment identification is used for identifying the newly-appearing target and realizing the monitoring and the tracking of the space target, the definition, the contrast and the resolution of the space target image can be improved through processing, the target can be more clearly distinguished, and the optimized image can provide more details and features.

title: High-precision deterministic polishing method capable of dynamically regulating scanning speed and immersion depth
description: A high-precision deterministic polishing method for dynamically regulating and controlling scanning speed and immersion depth belongs to the field of optical polishing. The method comprises the steps of establishing a relation model between the immersion depth and a controllable time-varying removal function of a magneto-rheological polishing method and a balloon polishing method based on a Reynolds equation and a Hertz contact model, realizing time variability of the removal function by precisely regulating the immersion depth according to the relation model between the immersion depth and the removal function, further improving the efficiency and controllability of material removal, providing a processing mode of introducing a variable speed regulating mechanism by adopting constant speed control and line feed scanning stages in a single-line scanning process, ensuring the stability of a path, reducing the influence of dynamic load of a machine tool on precision, constructing a residence time solving method of single-line constant speed scanning and line feed speed, ensuring the accuracy and reliability of residence time solving, and establishing a technical realization path of dynamically regulating and controlling the scanning speed and the immersion depth to realize efficient convergence of surface shape errors and high-precision control of the polishing process.

title: Implicit aspect-level sentiment analysis prediction method and system based on dual-prompt template
description: The invention relates to an implicit aspect-level emotion analysis prediction method and system based on double-prompt templates, wherein the method comprises the steps of setting the double-prompt templates for sentence processing on collected texts, respectively carrying out feature encoding on the collected texts through two T5 encoders after sentence processing to obtain corresponding sentence representations, constructing tag template features for the double-prompt templates, utilizing the constructed tag template features in a decoding stage, enabling the two T5 decoders to interactively learn dependence on the sequence of the opposite template, respectively carrying out decoding output on the sentence representations of the double-prompt templates, and taking intersection of the two decoding output of the double-prompt templates to obtain a final prediction result. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of enhancing the dependency among emotion elements, enhancing the capturing capability of implicit emotion, realizing more accurate emotion analysis prediction and the like.

title: A method, device, equipment and medium for extracting document content in rail transit industry
description: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for extracting document content in the rail transit industry. By prompting the prompt through each instruction after the pre-tuning and combining the content extraction large model, various key information can be accurately extracted from the document to be processed. Key information can be comprehensively extracted from documents to be processed in the rail transit industry through different types of campt, a reliable data basis is provided for subsequent data analysis, decision making and other works, and the accuracy of judgment and decision making based on the document information is greatly improved. The whole extraction process is highly automated, and a large number of track traffic industry documents can be rapidly processed by means of the pre-trained content extraction large model. The dependence on manual document processing is reduced, and the labor cost is reduced. Meanwhile, errors caused by factors such as fatigue and negligence possibly occurring in the manual processing process are avoided, and the consistency and accuracy of document processing are improved.

title: Neural network structured pruning method, device and medium based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The application relates to the technical field of deep reinforcement learning model compression and hardware acceleration, in particular to a neural network structured pruning method, device and medium based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a neural network model to be pruned, constructing a multi-dimensional state vector for each layer of the neural network, constructing a hierarchical self-adaptive hybrid pruning model, inputting the multi-dimensional state vector into the hierarchical self-adaptive hybrid pruning model, outputting joint actions of continuous pruning proportion and discrete pruning strategies through a double-branch Actor network, quantifying long-term benefits of actions through a hardware perception type composite reward function by the Critic network, iteratively training the hierarchical self-adaptive hybrid pruning model, executing pruning actions according to the pruning proportion and the pruning strategies of each layer, selecting an optimal strategy, and pruning the neural network according to the optimal strategy to be deployed in an FPGA. The application provides an innovative solution for accurate and efficient deployment of the neural network model on the end side equipment such as the FPGA.

title: Intelligent fault diagnosis system and method for substation equipment based on deep learning and knowledge graph
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent fault diagnosis system and method for substation equipment based on deep learning and knowledge graph. At present, substation equipment fault diagnosis generally monitors equipment working data, locates the position of the abnormal fault data, and dispatches maintenance personnel. The present invention collects historical fault data of substation equipment and preprocesses it; constructs a training substation equipment fault diagnosis knowledge graph based on the preprocessed historical fault data; collects substation equipment working data in real time, and when abnormal fault data is monitored, diagnoses the cause of the equipment failure based on the substation equipment fault diagnosis knowledge graph. The present invention can quickly diagnose the cause of the failure of substation equipment, reduce the labor intensity of maintenance personnel, and integrate a large amount of fault diagnosis experience of substation equipment. The fault cause diagnosis has high accuracy and can improve the maintenance efficiency of substation equipment.

title: A fast and efficient method and system for identifying mesoscale convective systems in mid- and low-latitude regions
description: The invention belongs to the field of image processing, and discloses a method and a system for quickly and efficiently identifying a mesoscale convection system in a middle-low latitude area, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring bright temperature data of a cloud top; the method comprises the steps of establishing a mesoscale convection system identification data set according to cloud top bright temperature data, establishing a mesoscale convection system identification model, training the model by using the established training set, and testing the model by using a test set after the specified training round number is reached to obtain a final mesoscale convection system identification result. The invention designs a slicing learning strategy so that the model can learn the characteristics of the scale convection system in different areas at the same time, constructs a half-residual multi-scale characteristic extractor to prevent the problem of losing small-scale characteristics in the characteristic extraction process, and designs a semantic consistency regular to restrict the redundant characteristic extraction and the characteristic asymmetry in the characteristic recovery process. The method solves the problem of low recognition speed in the middle-low latitude area by using the traditional threshold method.

title: A cross-modal person re-identification method based on cross-scale information interaction
description: The present invention discloses a cross-modal pedestrian re-identification method based on cross-scale information interaction, which belongs to the field of computer vision technology. The method mainly includes: sending visible light pedestrian images and infrared pedestrian images into a cross-modal obfuscator, using mature image processing technology to pre-process the input images of these two different modes, and then obtaining input objects that meet the requirements of the model; then, using a parameter-separated feature extraction network to process the input objects to obtain visible light image features and infrared image features respectively; on this basis, using a parameter-shared feature extraction network and combining a cross-scale interaction module to further extract modal shared features; at the same time, for the two different scales of features output by the feature extraction network, extract global features and local area feature information respectively; finally, according to the acquired features, a multi-loss joint optimization strategy is used to optimize the model, and finally the query result is determined based on the similarity between the query image and the gallery image features. The present invention can significantly improve the accuracy and efficiency of visible light infrared pedestrian re-identification, and has broad application prospects in many fields that require pedestrian identity recognition, such as security monitoring.

title: Business recommendation method, device and medium
description: The application provides a service recommending method, a device and a medium, and relates to the technical field of data analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining user groups which are related to each other and are interested in the same service to be recommended; and according to the different attention values, making different strategies for recommending the same service to be recommended to the users in the user group. According to the application, the group is firstly divided into the users, then, different attention values of the same service to be recommended are obtained for the users in the group, and finally, different strategies for recommending the same service to be recommended for the users in the group are manufactured according to the different attention values, so that the association relation among a plurality of users is effectively processed, the personalized requirement of each user in one group is met, and the service recommending effect is improved.

title: Campus security informatization management method based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based campus security information management method, and relates to the technical field of campus security information management. The invention collects multimodal identity features of passing personnel in real time, combines with a pre-stored authorized personnel database, adopts a convolutional neural network (CNN) based on deep learning and a spatiotemporal feature extraction model, performs high-precision comparison of face and gait features, matches face features first, and triggers gait feature recognition after failure, and combines with a dynamic comparison decision mechanism to classify and generate suspicious personnel tags or verification notifications for matching failures, so that the verification process is efficient and accurate; integrates a crowd density monitoring and congestion prediction model, uses a long short-term memory (LSTM) network to perform trend prediction on real-time collected data, calculates density growth rate and congestion status tags, identifies peak congestion risks in advance, and automatically adjusts the traffic mode; enables additional channels or switches to a fast verification mode to ensure traffic efficiency during peak hours.

title: Reservoir flood prevention water level early warning system and method
description: The present application relates to the field of flood control water level warning, and specifically discloses a reservoir flood control water level warning system and method, which first obtains real-time rainfall data along the upstream river, and monitors the water level changes at the reservoir entrance and key river sections, and then uses artificial intelligence technology based on deep learning to analyze the collected rainfall data and water level data to capture the spatiotemporal correlation characteristics between rainfall data at various monitoring points along the river, as well as the spatiotemporal correlation characteristics between water level data at various monitoring points in the water level monitoring area, and uses rainfall data as the main variable and water level data as the covariate, and conducts a time series interactive analysis of the two to reveal the impact mechanism of rainfall changes on water level changes, thereby realizing the prediction of reservoir water level change trends. In this way, the response speed and accuracy of reservoir flood control water level warnings can be effectively improved, the dependence on human resources can be reduced, and the maintenance cost of traditional hydrological models can be reduced.

title: Cascade power station scheduling parameter access and influence factor prediction method
description: The invention discloses a step power station scheduling parameter access and influence factor prediction method, which relates to the technical field of power station scheduling and comprises the following steps of obtaining operation parameter data of each step power station, including but not limited to flow, output, storage capacity and water level; multidimensional impact factor data is collected relating to power plant scheduling, including meteorological data, geographic data, and hydrographic data. According to the method, the reservoir water level is accurately predicted through multi-source data fusion and deep learning, prediction errors are reduced, scheduling is optimized, and the method is especially suitable for extreme weather. The feedback adjustment mechanism is introduced to reduce water waste and improve the water and electricity utilization efficiency and the flexibility of the power grid. And by combining an intelligent optimization algorithm and deep reinforcement learning, a scheduling scheme is dynamically adjusted, so that the utilization of water and electricity resources is maximized, the safety of a power grid is ensured, overload or insufficient supply of loads is avoided, and the emergency response capability and stability of the power grid are enhanced.

title: A charging pile line fire warning method and storage medium based on big data
description: The present invention provides a charging pile line fire warning method and storage medium based on big data, by collecting the line operation data set of the target charging pile cluster, the line operation data set includes multi-source time series monitoring data, performing cross-modal feature alignment on the multi-source time series monitoring data, generating a spatiotemporal correlation feature matrix, inputting the spatiotemporal correlation feature matrix into a pre-trained fire risk prediction model, generating a line abnormal risk probability distribution map, generating a hierarchical warning signal set according to the risk level corresponding to each spatial node in the line abnormal risk probability distribution map, triggering a dynamic protection mechanism based on the hierarchical warning signal set, and the dynamic protection mechanism includes performing a current cutoff operation on a high-risk line segment and performing a power attenuation operation on an adjacent line segment. The present invention can comprehensively improve the reliability and intelligence level of the charging pile line fire warning system.

title: Beam scanning method and device for phased array auxiliary transmission super surface
description: The invention provides a beam scanning method and device for a phased array auxiliary transmission super-surface, and particularly relates to a method and device for constructing a high-transmissivity transmission type intelligent super-surface, fitting complex transmission coefficients according to electromagnetic characteristics of a high-transmissivity phase modulation unit, constructing a unit antenna model according to a target working frequency band and a beam scanning range of a phased array combined transmission type intelligent super-surface system, determining an array combination mode, deploying the position of the phased array combined transmission type intelligent super-surface system to obtain a feed source end-to-transmission type intelligent super-surface end position information set, obtaining a phased array combined transmission type intelligent super-surface system model according to an array factor synthesis principle, calculating system beam gain, introducing phased array excitation parameter codes, maximizing the system beam gain to be a target guide, and obtaining phased array excitation parameter configuration for optimizing the phased array combined transmission type intelligent super-surface system beam by utilizing a particle swarm optimization algorithm so as to realize system benefit optimization and improvement.

title: Video generation method, device, equipment, medium and program product
description: The application discloses a video generation method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program product, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of denoising noise characteristic representation based on a first text, an object motion track and camera gesture parameters to obtain video characteristic representation, and carrying out video prediction based on the video characteristic representation to obtain a first video. In addition to the first text, additionally acquiring video object motion in the first video generated by determining the object motion trail, namely, local motion in the first video generated by controlling the object motion trail; the camera motion in the first video determined by the camera attitude parameter control is additionally acquired, namely, the global motion in the first video generated by the camera attitude parameter control is additionally acquired, so that the local motion control and the global motion control of the generated first video are realized, and the action diversity in the first video is improved.

title: Operational data anomaly detection and repair
description: A technique for detecting and repairing anomalous intervals in time series data of monitored equipment is disclosed. The system trains a machine learning model on a combination of real data obtained from the monitored equipment and false data generated by adding noise to the real data. The model predicts the operating values of the equipment at various intervals of the time series data set. The system identifies anomalies in the time series data based on the difference between the predicted values and the true values. If the difference between the predicted values generated by the machine learning model and the true values exceeds a threshold, then the system identifies a particular data point, such as a meter reading, as an anomaly. The system rates the anomalies to perform repair actions based on the ratings.

title: Watershed multi-stage hydrologic forecasting method and system based on dual-mode driving
description: This invention provides a basin-wide multi-level hydrological forecasting method and system based on a dual-mode driven approach. The method includes the following steps: identifying forecast nodes in the river system of the basin based on historical hydrological and meteorological data, and classifying them into Type I and Type II forecast nodes; constructing a corresponding physical mechanism hydrological model for each Type I forecast node; constructing a corresponding machine learning model for each Type II forecast node; and predicting the hydrological forecast results for the corresponding Type I and Type II forecast nodes based on the physical mechanism hydrological model and the machine learning model, respectively, to generate a basin-wide hydrological forecast. This invention deeply mines the correlation characteristics between water level and flow rate, and introduces deep learning algorithms to enhance the accuracy of hydrological forecasts for stations that are not suitable for physical mechanism hydrological models.

title: Numerical prediction method based on deep neural network
description: The invention discloses a numerical prediction method based on a deep neural network, which comprises the following steps of S1 collecting and preprocessing training data, S2 constructing a lightweight neural network model comprising at least one attention mechanism module, S3 training the model by utilizing the training data, minimizing a loss function and adopting a mean square error as the loss function, S4 carrying out knowledge distillation on the model, S5 carrying out numerical prediction by utilizing the smaller model, and reducing the calculation resource requirement and improving the model training speed and efficiency by utilizing the lightweight neural network model. By knowledge distillation, the calculation resources required by reasoning can be reduced, and the prediction efficiency is improved. By integrating the attention mechanism, the model can highlight key features in input data, the interpretability of a model prediction result is improved, a data set is expanded by a data enhancement technology, and the generalization capability of the model is improved. Through residual connection, stable training of the model in a deep network is ensured.

title: Load prediction method and device of power system and electronic equipment
description: The present application discloses a load forecasting method, device and electronic device for an electric power system. The present application relates to the field of electric power load forecasting. The method comprises: obtaining historical load data of an electric power system within a preset period; inputting the historical load data into a target model to obtain forecasted load data at a target moment, wherein the target model comprises a plurality of target basic models and a target meta-model, and the forecast results outputted by the plurality of target basic models based on the historical load data are used as input data of the target meta-model, and the target meta-model obtains forecasted load data based on the input data processing. The present application solves the problem of low accuracy of load forecasting for electric power systems in the related art.

title: Database test case generation and optimization method, system, equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a method, system, device and storage medium for generating and optimizing database test cases, which obtain knowledge information related to a target database, vectorize the knowledge information and store it in a vector database supporting vector storage and vector retrieval; obtain test requirement information, retrieve vector data related to the test requirement information from the vector database, and extract original text data corresponding to the vector data through the mapping relationship of the vector database; obtain a pre-built prompt word template, fill the test requirement information and the original text data into the prompt word template to obtain prompt words, analyze the prompt words through a preset large language model, and generate test cases for the target database; send the test cases to a database server for running, obtain running results, optimize the prompt words according to the running results and re-enter the large language model until the test cases generated by the large language model meet the user requirements.

title: Large model fingerprint erasing method and device based on catastrophic knowledge forgetting
description: The invention relates to the field of machine learning, in particular to a large model fingerprint erasing method and device based on catastrophic knowledge forgetting, which are used for constructing a semantic offset data set, generating LoRA adapters with generalized erasing capability according to the semantic offset data set, processing a fingerprint model by utilizing LoRA adapters to obtain a model for finishing fingerprint erasing, processing the model for finishing fingerprint erasing by utilizing a cleaning data set to obtain a final model, verifying the final model, and judging whether the final model successfully erases fingerprints. The invention can solve the problems of large resource consumption, sharply reduced model performance, poor robustness and the like of the existing large language model fingerprint erasing technology, and completely remove the back door fingerprints embedded by the model fingerprint technology of different black boxes under the condition of not depending on the prior knowledge of the trigger-output mode, thereby realizing the large language model fingerprint erasing technology with low cost, high efficiency, light weight and strong robustness.

title: Weak semi-supervised heart MRI segmentation method based on pseudo-tag frequency domain dynamic hybrid supervision
description: The present invention discloses a weak semi-supervised cardiac MRI segmentation method based on pseudo-label frequency domain dynamic hybrid supervision, which belongs to the field of medical image segmentation technology, and includes the following steps: S1, providing graffiti labels for a small number of cardiac MRI images in a training set; S2, establishing a main segmentation model and an auxiliary segmentation model, and outputting corresponding prediction values; S3, using Haar wavelet transform and frequency domain dynamic hybrid method to generate supervised pseudo-labels; S4, combining a partial cross entropy loss constraint strategy to establish a total loss function to optimize the training of the three segmentation models, and realize the segmentation of cardiac MRI images. The present invention uses a pseudo-label frequency domain dynamic hybrid supervision method to generate reliable supervision signals using a small number of graffiti labels and a large amount of unlabeled data, significantly improving the utilization efficiency of unlabeled data; using a weak semi-supervised strategy, only a small number of graffiti labels are needed to achieve high-quality segmentation, reducing the dependence on pixel-by-pixel precise labeling, and solving the problem of high cost of medical image labeling.

title: Magnetostriction-based multi-physical field defect detection method and system for pressure-bearing equipment
description: The present invention provides a multi-physical field defect detection method and system for pressure-bearing equipment based on magnetostriction, which relates to the field of detection technology, including constructing a reconfigurable magnetic field excitation array and a multi-physical quantity sensing network through intelligent excitation and sensing devices, and dynamically adjusting the excitation phase to improve detection accuracy. The hierarchical coupling calculation scheme establishes the coupling relationship between the magnetic field, stress field and temperature field, and performs multi-physical field data calculations in combination with physical constraints. After multi-level wavelet packet decomposition and denoising, a deep neural network is used to extract features and generate a defect feature dictionary to achieve efficient defect positioning and size assessment, significantly improving the accuracy and reliability of detection.

title: Method, system and device for providing intelligent service in communication system
description: The present disclosure provides a method, system and device for providing intelligent services in a communication system, and relates to the field of communication technology. The method includes: receiving a trained target machine learning model and description information of the intelligent service provided by the target machine learning model sent by a model training function entity; determining the input data of the target machine learning model and the correct data corresponding to the input data based on the description information; determining the output data through the target machine learning model based on the input data; determining whether the target machine learning model passes the test based on the correct data and the output data; if the target machine learning model passes the test, sending the target machine learning model to the analysis function entity to provide intelligent services through the analysis function entity; if the target machine learning model does not pass the test, feeding back the test result to the model training function entity to instruct the model training function entity to retrain the target machine learning model.

title: Interactive large-screen visualization system and method based on real-time rendering of multidimensional data
description: The present invention discloses an interactive large-screen visualization system and method based on real-time rendering of multi-dimensional data, relates to the field of image rendering technology, and aims to solve the bottleneck problems of traditional systems in data throughput efficiency, rendering delay and interactive response. The method includes: using a non-uniform octree to divide the space blocks, dynamically adjusting the block size according to the data density, and combining the ZSTD+Huffman hybrid compression algorithm; constructing a CPU-GPU three-level asynchronous processing pipeline, and dynamically adjusting the task priority through the gaze point weight algorithm; the master node dynamically allocates LOD parameters, and the slave node realizes sub-pixel splicing of special-shaped large screens based on the spherical coordinate system model; using the Q-learning algorithm to predict the user operation sequence, and combining the ASTP protocol to realize dual-channel bandwidth adaptive allocation. The system includes dynamic blocking, pipeline scheduling, multi-node collaboration, intelligent preloading, and exception handling modules. The present invention can realize real-time interactive visualization of large amounts of data, improve rendering efficiency, and reduce hardware resource usage.

title: A multi-level large model scheduling and knowledge base adaptive optimization method and system
description: The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a multi-level large model scheduling and knowledge base adaptive optimization method and system. The method includes: obtaining tasks to be processed, and calculating the complexity of the tasks to be processed after pre-processing the tasks to be processed; using small models to process the tasks to be processed, obtaining test processing results, and calculating the maturity of the test processing results; determining the scheduling strategy of the large model based on the complexity and maturity, and using the scheduling strategy to process the tasks to be processed to obtain processing results; and optimizing the small models or knowledge bases related to the scheduling strategy based on the processing results. By calculating the complexity of the tasks to be processed and the maturity of the test processing results, models of different sizes are selected accordingly, reducing the call to the super-large model, reducing computing costs, and improving system response efficiency. The small models or knowledge bases are optimized using historical processing results, improving the processing capabilities of the small models and knowledge bases, continuously accumulating knowledge, and reducing repeated calculations.

title: Multi-mode eye movement characterization method and system based on images
description: The present disclosure provides an image-based multimodal eye movement representation method and system, belonging to the field of eye movement representation technology, the method comprising: converting the original eye movement data to obtain an eye movement line graph corresponding to the original eye movement data; obtaining a scanning path based on eye movement features, the eye movement features are features extracted from the original eye movement data; encoding the eye movement line graph to obtain a target image latent vector, encoding the text information corresponding to the scanning path to obtain a target text latent vector; fusing the target image latent vector and the target text latent vector to obtain a comprehensive latent vector; inputting the comprehensive latent vector into a self-attention network for transmission to obtain an eye movement representation. The present disclosure provides an image-based multimodal eye movement representation method and system that can improve the quality of eye movement representation.

title: Intelligent data interaction method and system for electronic stop board
description: The invention provides an intelligent data interaction method and system for an electronic stop board, which are used for realizing accurate arrival time prediction of a bus through data fusion and neural network prediction, and solving the technical problems of the prior art that a data interaction system is insufficient in the aspects of data processing accuracy, data transmission stability and safety through bidirectional data transmission optimization scheduling.

title: Index extraction method, device, equipment and storage medium of power document
description: The present application discloses a method, device, equipment and storage medium for extracting indicators from electric power documents. The method includes: obtaining electric power documents and indicators to be queried, segmenting the electric power documents to obtain multiple chapter document blocks, extracting keywords from the chapter document blocks, determining the frequency, weight and occurrence position of each keyword to construct a bag-of-words index, semantically expanding the indicators to be queried, and searching the bag-of-words index of the electric power document, determining several target chapter document blocks, inputting them into a large model so that the large model loads knowledge regulations, outputs an indicator information summary, and inputs each indicator information summary into the large model so that the large model can reason according to the knowledge regulations and the logic of the thinking chain, and outputs the indicator value. It can be seen that through semantic expansion and knowledge injection, and making the large model reason according to a standardized logical chain, it is ensured that the large model can reason according to the expert thinking mode, improve the accuracy of indicator extraction, and thus improve the efficiency of electric power indicator review.

title: Method, system and computer equipment for detecting and processing quality of clinical test document
description: The invention discloses a method, a system and computer equipment for detecting and processing the quality of clinical test documents. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a clinical test document to be processed, carrying out format conversion and optimization treatment on the clinical test document to be processed to obtain a pretreatment result, carrying out automatic classification on the pretreatment result to obtain a classification result, extracting key information of the document according to the classification result, generating a file name to obtain an extraction result, checking the integrity, compliance and archivability of the corresponding document according to the extraction result, carrying out automatic treatment according to the detection result to obtain an automatic treatment result, and storing and archiving the automatic treatment result. By implementing the method of the invention, high-efficiency and accurate document quality detection and automatic processing can be realized, so that the quality and efficiency of document processing are improved, and the problems of low efficiency, poor consistency and high error rate in the prior art are solved.

title: Short-term power load prediction method and system based on improved DSSFA-SAC-ConvLSTM
description: A short-term power load forecasting method and system based on improved DSSFA-SAC-ConvLSTM. The method first collects regional historical power load data and preprocesses it, then uses DSSFA to analyze and extract features, constructs a feature matrix, and then generates a distance adjacency matrix and a dynamic adjacency matrix based on geographical distance and DSSFA features, and merges them into an autocorrelation matrix. Subsequently, the feature matrix and the autocorrelation matrix are spliced and input into a ConvLSTM model for training, and Warmup and improved OneCycleLR are used to adjust the learning rate. Finally, the output features are mapped to power load forecast values. The present invention extracts key features through DSSFA, effectively reduces data dimensions and retains important information, and combines geographical distance and self-attention mechanism to generate a dynamic adjacency matrix, fully considers spatial information, and improves the accuracy of multi-region prediction. Warmup and improved OneCycleLR strategies are used to optimize the ConvLSTM learning rate, enhance the model training effect, and further improve the accuracy of power load prediction, so that it has a more excellent performance in complex scenarios.

title: Intelligent analysis system for power quality and meter reading data
description: The present invention relates to the field of data processing technology, and in particular to an intelligent analysis system for power quality and meter reading data, including a data fusion module, a modeling module, an analysis module, a detection module, an optimization module and a control module. The data fusion module aligns the data of the meter terminal, the power grid monitoring equipment and the environmental sensor through a sliding time window. The analysis module calculates the power grid node loss transfer coefficient based on a graph neural network, and integrates the transformer no-load loss and the line contact resistance parameters to generate a dynamic line loss assessment matrix. The detection module identifies the deviation of power consumption characteristics through a random forest classifier, and generates a priority management strategy in combination with a multi-dimensional anomaly scoring model. The control module adaptively selects a communication protocol to execute control instructions according to the network status. The heartbeat detection mechanism feeds back the operation data of the management device in real time, drives the iterative update of the model parameters, and realizes the dynamic coordination of power supply quality optimization and line loss management.

title: LLM and RAG-based oxygen-enriched side-blown copper smelting process control system
description: The present invention is an oxygen-enriched side-blowing copper smelting process control system based on LLM and RAG, comprising a parameter configuration module, an expert experience and literature management module, a vector database module, a RAG module, a prompt word module and an LLM module; the parameter configuration module is used to realize parameter configuration of key processes; the expert experience and literature management module is used to configure key parameters, map words into low-dimensional dense vector space, and convert them into semantic vectors for efficient numerical calculation; the vector database module is used to perform structured storage on the converted semantic vectors; the RAG module is used to retrieve and introduce the latest and relevant information from a knowledge base in real time; the prompt word module is used as an input of a large model to generate a recommendation result that is more in line with expectations; the LLM module is used to generate a recommendation result based on prompt word reasoning and analysis; the present invention applies LLM and RAG technologies to an oxygen-enriched side-blowing copper smelting process control system to realize real-time and precise control of the smelting process.

title: Dynamic confidence assessment-based self-adaptive extraction method and system for garbage incineration large model field knowledge
description: The embodiments of the present application relate to the field of artificial intelligence technology, and specifically, to a method and system for adaptively extracting domain knowledge of a large model of waste incineration based on dynamic confidence evaluation, the method comprising: performing dynamic word segmentation processing on preprocessed text data to obtain a dynamic word segmentation result; performing domain term confidence analysis based on the dynamic word segmentation result to obtain a dynamic term confidence score; generating a candidate domain term set based on the dynamic term confidence score; screening the candidate domain term set according to a confidence score threshold, and constructing a waste incineration domain knowledge dictionary according to the screening result; merging the waste incineration domain knowledge dictionary into a preset large model underlying dictionary to obtain a merged knowledge dictionary; parsing a target working condition document based on an AI algorithm model corresponding to the merged knowledge dictionary to generate an operation instruction question and answer pair; and fine-tuning parameters of the AI algorithm model using the operation instruction question and answer pair to obtain a target algorithm model.

title: Question-answering system based on semantic vectorization knowledge graph and approximate nearest neighbor cluster
description: The invention discloses a question-answering system based on semantic vectorization knowledge graphs and approximate nearest neighbor clusters, which comprises a data acquisition and preprocessing module, a knowledge graph construction module, a knowledge graph enhancement module and an embedding model, wherein the data acquisition and preprocessing module is used for inputting and primarily processing unstructured texts, the knowledge graph construction module is used for constructing dynamic knowledge graphs according to primarily processed data, the knowledge graph enhancement module is used for expanding the representation of entities in the knowledge graphs by adopting an information enhancer and simultaneously converting each entity node and each relation node in the knowledge graphs into high-dimensional semantic vectors by using the embedding model. The knowledge integration model is based on an approximate nearest neighbor clustering method, can realize the integration output of a plurality of large-scale language models, and effectively improves the hit rate of answers with higher credibility.

title: Information consultation analysis processing system based on Internet of things
description: The invention relates to the field of information consultation analysis processing, in particular to an information consultation analysis processing system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a module for data collection, knowledge graph construction, optimization reasoning, knowledge query and user emotion analysis, wherein the knowledge graph construction module integrates a multi-mode data source, a graph database is used for constructing a knowledge graph, the knowledge query module processes user input by using a BERT model, searches and filters results by using a BFS algorithm and feeds the results back to a user, the optimization reasoning module extracts a data training knowledge reasoning model, calculates knowledge point grasping probability by combining a Bayesian network, the user emotion analysis module performs feature extraction, inputs a long-short term memory network model to analyze emotion states, and outputs emotion intensity values and trend labels.

title: Communication radiation source individual identification method based on multi-domain feature self-adaptive fusion
description: The present invention relates to a method for individual identification of communication radiation sources based on adaptive fusion of multi-domain features, belonging to the technical field of individual identification of communication radiation sources. The method adopts a multi-domain feature extraction strategy including time domain, integral bispectrum and power spectrum, breaks through the limitation of single-domain information, and then suppresses the interference of irrelevant feature information by deeply extracting feature information of multi-domain features, and strengthens important feature information with individual distinguishing degree. Further, feature fusion and classification recognition are used to realize deep correlation mining of multi-level features, and improve the feature robustness in complex electromagnetic environments. Compared with traditional single-domain identification methods, the present invention effectively solves the problem of insufficient feature extraction of radiation sources in non-cooperative scenarios.

title: Multitasking detection and quality assessment method for intelligent harvesting of root vegetables
description: The invention discloses a multitask detection and quality assessment method for intelligent harvesting of root vegetables. The method comprises the steps of constructing a double-branch network structure YOLOv-Dual, combining a multi-scale attention aggregation module MSAA and a multi-scale feature enhancement module MAFE, and realizing collaborative optimization of root vegetable body detection, leaf segmentation and quality classification. The MSAA module promotes multi-scale adaptability through multi-scale feature fusion and an attention mechanism, and the MAFE module promotes information complementation between tasks through shape/texture feature enhancement. The method can ensure real-time performance and simultaneously remarkably improve detection precision and quality evaluation capability, provides a high-efficiency solution for agricultural mechanized harvesting, and promotes an agricultural intelligent process.

title: Visual navigation method and system integrating diffusion model and explicit constraint guidance
description: The application discloses a visual navigation method and a visual navigation system integrating a diffusion model and explicit constraint guidance, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting features of visual observation data to obtain target observation semantic features; the method comprises the steps of extracting features of navigation target data to obtain target image features, carrying out feature fusion on target observation semantic features and target image features to generate condition vectors, inputting the condition vectors into a condition diffusion model to carry out diffusion training to generate a plurality of initial candidate paths, constructing explicit constraints based on the initial image data, carrying out path optimization on each initial candidate path according to the explicit constraints to obtain a plurality of candidate optimized paths, wherein the explicit constraints comprise collision constraints and target distance constraints, and determining target navigation paths from each candidate optimized path according to a path selection strategy. The application can solve the problems of insufficient path safety and poor dynamic adaptability, and remarkably improve the path navigation efficiency, and can be widely applied to the technical field of computers.

title: Data processing method and related equipment
description: The present application discloses a data processing method and related equipment, wherein the method comprises: obtaining first data, wherein the first data is input data of a large language model; determining a first target model matching the attribute of the first data from a plurality of first optional models, wherein each first optional model is obtained by program compilation based on different pre-filling lengths, and each first optional model has the same model parameters; performing a pre-filling process of a large language model on the first data using the first target model to obtain a pre-filling result of the first data; and performing a decoding process of a large language model on the first data using a second target model based on a key-value cache result and a first-word output word in the pre-filling result to obtain second data for replying to the first data.

title: Fire disaster identification method and system based on smoke analysis algorithm
description: The invention discloses a fire disaster identification method and a fire disaster identification system based on a smoke analysis algorithm, belongs to the technical field of forest fire disaster identification, and is used for solving the technical problems that the conventional forest fire disaster identification algorithm is easily interfered in multiple aspects under a complex forest environment, so that the misjudgment rate is increased, and potential fire points and fire disaster spreading trends cannot be rapidly locked when a fire disaster occurs. The method comprises the steps of collecting multidimensional monitoring data of a monitored forest zone, dividing the monitored forest zone into cells based on the multidimensional monitoring data and generating a dynamic smoke threshold value of each cell, constructing a cell dynamic association library according to the multidimensional monitoring data of each cell, carrying out smoke recognition on the multidimensional monitoring data and determining a target cell with fire disaster based on the dynamic smoke threshold value, carrying out spreading dynamic simulation on the multidimensional monitoring data of the target cell to obtain spreading simulation data, obtaining an associated cell of the target cell in the cell dynamic association library, determining the associated cell as a potential fire disaster zone, and generating a potential fire disaster zone thermodynamic diagram.

title: Magma rock mineral analysis method and system based on geological image
