description: The invention discloses a magma rock mineral analysis method and system based on geological images, and relates to the technical field of mineral analysis. A magma rock mineral analysis system based on geological images comprises a magma rock characteristic analysis module and a magma rock comprehensive analysis module. The method is beneficial to revealing the ore formation evolution history and future ore formation potential of the magma by fusing magma rock mineral images and magma rock geological auxiliary data, realizes high-precision automatic identification and classification of minerals in the magma rock by utilizing a mineral classification model, reduces manual intervention, improves identification efficiency and accuracy, extracts mineral crystallization characteristics and integrates oxygen loss characteristics, realizes joint analysis of physical structure and chemical properties of the minerals, and provides more comprehensive data support for subsequent geological evolution research and mineral product prediction.

title: Small sample SAR target detection and recognition method and system based on meta-learning
description: The present invention discloses a small sample SAR target detection and recognition method and system based on meta-learning, which mainly solves the problems of insufficient image feature extraction and lack of comparison and fusion of local features of support samples and query samples in the prior art. Its implementation scheme is: obtain SAR data and annotate it as training data, divide it into base class support data set, base class query data set, new class support data set and new class query data set; construct a local contrast aggregation network including a candidate region feature extraction unit, a local feature aggregation unit, a meta-contrast loss unit and a detection head unit, wherein the local feature aggregation unit includes a global cross-attention module and a re-weighted local cross-attention module; use training data to train the local contrast aggregation network; input the test image into the trained local contrast aggregation network to obtain the detection and recognition results. The present invention significantly improves the accuracy and robustness of SAR target detection under small sample conditions, and can be used for battlefield reconnaissance and situation awareness.

title: Photovoltaic energy storage intelligent management system based on microservice architecture
description: The present invention relates to the field of photovoltaic energy storage technology, and discloses a photovoltaic energy storage intelligent management system based on a microservice architecture, comprising the following modules: an environmental parameter acquisition module, wherein G is irradiance, ΔT is temperature difference, RH is humidity, α, β, and γ are attenuation coefficients, quantifying the dynamic impact of the environment on power generation efficiency, and outputting a power correction factor to a collaborative control module; a power generation efficiency correction module; an edge computing optimization microservice module; a light-storage-network collaborative control microservice module; an adaptive prediction microservice module; accurately quantifying the dynamic impact of environmental factors on power generation efficiency through a nonlinear coupling model; being able to calculate the power correction factor in real time, effectively capturing the impact of complex working conditions such as sudden increase in environmental humidity and instantaneous change in irradiance in cloudy weather on photovoltaic efficiency, providing a scientific basis for system decision-making, and ensuring that abnormality detection and energy efficiency optimization are close to actual working conditions.

title: Voice interaction method and system based on 3D (three-dimensional) virtual
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent voice interaction and discloses a voice interaction method and system based on 3D (three-dimensional) virtual, which comprise the steps of receiving real-time voice of a user, preprocessing, establishing a voice recognition model, analyzing the pronunciation characteristics and definition of the user, optimizing the voice recognition model based on the pronunciation characteristics and definition of the user, generating a candidate prediction instruction set of the next step of the user by utilizing the optimized voice recognition model in combination with a historical command and a current 3D environment context of the user, wherein the candidate prediction instruction set comprises a plurality of candidate instructions, recognizing the priority of each candidate instruction, taking the candidate instruction with the highest priority as the prediction instruction of the next step of the user, preferentially loading related resources of the prediction instruction, and rapidly responding to the user requirement. The user demand is predicted more accurately in a complex scene, and the accuracy of voice interaction and the real-time response capability are improved remarkably.

title: Method and device for predicting power generation amount, electronic equipment, storage medium and program product
description: The present application provides a power generation prediction method, device, electronic device, storage medium and program product, the method comprising: obtaining initial power plant data; inputting the initial power plant data into a trained converter model to predict the power generation based on the initial power plant data to obtain a prediction result; wherein the converter model is configured to optimize the model parameters through a chameleon optimization algorithm; and outputting the prediction result.

title: Dynamic public opinion early warning method based on LSTM-XGB-RF
description: The present invention relates to the field of dynamic network public opinion early warning, and specifically to a dynamic public opinion early warning method based on LSTM-XGB-RF, with the following steps: Step 1: Collect index data, establish a Baidu index basic attribute data set, and divide the public opinion event cycle; Step 2: Construct a public opinion indicator system, integrate data, and supplement and improve the data set; Step 3: Construct a public opinion data prediction model based on LSTM; Step 4: Construct a dynamic public opinion state and level recognition model based on XGB-RF, and optimize model parameters to improve model performance; Step 5: Deploy the model to achieve real-time monitoring and prediction of the public opinion early warning system; Step 6: Analyze the interpretability of the constructed public opinion early warning model. The present invention utilizes homologous data sets, which can more directly and accurately reflect the popularity and trend of public opinion, and the data authenticity and reliability are high. It can achieve comprehensive monitoring of long-term public opinion events and cover public opinion predictions throughout the entire event cycle.

title: Plant terminal bud real-time positioning method, system, terminal and storage medium based on double-flow convolutional network
description: The invention discloses a plant terminal bud real-time positioning method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium based on a double-flow convolution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining left and right images of a target plant, inputting the left and right images into the double-flow convolution network, and carrying out optical flow calculation on the left and right images through an optical flow algorithm to obtain an optical flow field; the method comprises the steps of extracting features of left and right images to obtain static information, fusing an optical flow field and the static information to obtain global features, and calculating the space three-dimensional coordinates of a target plant according to a projection matrix and the global features. The invention can improve the accuracy of identifying and positioning the terminal buds of the plants, thereby providing accurate data support for agricultural operations such as accurate fertilization, topping and the like of the plants.

title: Mamba-UNet-based aortic true and false cavity segmentation and three-dimensional reconstruction method and device
description: The present invention discloses a method for segmenting and 3D reconstruction of the true and false lumens of the aorta based on the Mamba-UNet architecture. The existing segmentation of the true and false lumens in aortic dissection cannot meet the urgent clinical demand for high precision. The method obtains the patient's three-dimensional aortic medical imaging data and preprocesses the medical imaging data. The preprocessed data is input into the Mamba-UNet model to extract multi-scale feature information of the aortic image. The extracted feature information is subjected to spatial interaction within the modality and interaction between modalities to obtain multi-layer fusion features. The true and false lumens of the aorta are segmented according to the multi-layer fusion features. Based on the true and false lumens of the aorta segmentation results output by the Mamba-UNet model, a 3D reconstruction method is used to convert the segmentation results into an intuitive 3D model. This method assists doctors in reverse tear risk assessment, rupture location, anchoring area selection, and visceral artery area identification, thereby providing reliable support for clinical decision-making.

title: Dual-channel wind power generation power prediction method and system
description: The invention discloses a two-channel wind power generation power prediction method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power load time sequence data, processing the power load time sequence data according to a preset gradient sensing index moving average EMA algorithm to obtain target power load time sequence data, respectively inputting the target power load time sequence data into a pre-constructed Mamba module and an LSTM module, outputting by the Mamba module to obtain a first result, outputting by the LSTM module to obtain a second result, inputting the first result and the second result into a multi-head cross attention mechanism to carry out self-adaptive adjustment, and outputting a final prediction result through an FFN feedforward network. The accuracy and stability of wind power generation power prediction are remarkably improved.

title: Big model-driven smart education resource recommendation method and system
description: The invention discloses a large-model-driven intelligent education resource recommendation method and system, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an education resource set, identifying action points of resources through a first agent, and constructing an education resource pool; the method comprises the steps of analyzing by a second agent in combination with learning records and interest preferences to generate a first resource demand set, generating by a third agent in combination with learning targets and learning records to generate a second resource demand set, comparing differences between the first resource demand set and the second resource demand set to generate a resource demand list, and providing the list as a personalized recommendation list to students. The invention solves the technical problems that the existing educational resource recommending method can not meet the personalized demands of students, and the recommending result lacks dynamic adaptability and accuracy, and achieves the technical effects of realizing personalized educational resource recommendation with strong dynamic adaptability and improving recommending accuracy through multi-agent cooperative analysis and dynamic feedback mechanism.

title: A method and system for tracing the production batches of prepared dishes
description: The invention provides a method and a system for tracing and analyzing a production batch of prefabricated vegetables, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of performing field arrangement optimization on an original data set based on a genetic algorithm, determining optimal field arrangement combination through dynamic iterative calculation, and performing splicing processing on data elements according to an optimized field sequence to generate a long character string with dynamic optimization characteristics; the method comprises the steps of carrying out hash abstract operation on a generated long character string, generating a digital fingerprint with fixed length through a preset one-way encryption algorithm to form a unique hash identification code of the production batch, writing the generated hash identification code into distributed nodes of a block chain database, constructing a storage time sequence record based on a time stamp chain structure, and establishing an index mapping relation between the hash identification code and an original data set. The invention can improve the fineness of data preprocessing.

title: Method and system for extracting buildings from remote sensing images based on SAM
description: The invention provides a remote sensing image building extraction method and system based on SAM. The method comprises the steps of adding an adaptive layer in an encoder of a SAM model, removing a prompt encoder of the SAM model to form a new SAM model, training the new SAM model, namely freezing the encoder of the SAM model, updating only mask decoders of the adaptive layer and the SAM model, inputting a remote sensing image to be detected into the trained new SAM model to perform building extraction, and outputting a prediction graph, wherein the building extraction process of the new SAM model comprises the steps of generating prompt information according to embedded features and high-frequency information features of the remote sensing image by utilizing the adaptive layer, inputting the prompt information into the encoder to be combined with general knowledge learned by the encoder, so as to generate a feature graph of the remote sensing image, and inputting the feature graph into the mask encoder to obtain the prediction graph. The invention can alleviate the problems of holes of large buildings, missed detection of small buildings, blurred edges and the like.

title: Teaching system, method and electronic equipment for sharing digital slices
description: The present invention provides a teaching system, method, and electronic device for sharing digital slices, including: a lecturer end and a student end; the lecturer end is used to receive the original PPT courseware and digital slices uploaded by the lecturer, obtain the slice features of the digital slices through AI feature extraction, and associate the digital slices with the original PPT courseware to obtain the target PPT courseware; when the lecturer is giving a live lecture, the lecturer end is used to respond to the lecturer's first click operation, share the target PPT courseware with the student end for display, obtain the positioning information of the slice features of the digital slices through AI semantic recognition, and synchronize the positioning information to the student end through AI control mode and/or lecturer manual control mode; the student end is used to view the target PPT courseware synchronously with the lecturer end and operate the digital slices. The present invention can share digital slices between the lecturer end and the student end, improving the efficiency of teaching interaction.

title: A lightweight AI predictive control method for embedded devices
description: The present invention discloses a lightweight AI predictive control method for embedded devices, which specifically relates to the field of embedded control technology and includes the following steps: collecting and preprocessing real-time multidimensional data to form a unified time series structure, identifying whether entering a high heat accumulation or control response delay risk zone based on a static feature threshold and a dynamic trend function, and if entering, calculating a hysteresis impact index and a heat load accumulation index, substituting them into a pre-trained artificial intelligence prediction model to output a scheduling risk coefficient, and performing a dynamic switching operation of the control path based on the scheduling risk coefficient and the joint trend of the two indices; the present invention realizes pre-identification of high heat accumulation and control response delay risks by unifying the multidimensional data time series structure; introduces a dual quantization mechanism of the hysteresis impact index and the heat load accumulation index to enhance the expressiveness of the operating status; combines the artificial intelligence prediction output and the index trend to dynamically switch the control path to realize adaptive adjustment and structural optimization of the control strategy.

title: Industrial defect detection method based on self-supervision fine tuning
description: The invention discloses an industrial defect detection method based on self-supervision fine tuning, which solves the problems of scarcity of industrial scene defect samples and weak model generalization capability. The method comprises the steps of dividing a data set, preprocessing, improving data robustness through size scaling, random luminosity transformation, geometric enhancement and the like, extracting a foreground mask by utilizing a significance model, synthesizing a pseudo-abnormal image fused by Perlin Noise and DTD textures, performing self-supervision fine tuning on WIDERESNET-50 trained by ImageNet in advance, enhancing the characteristic extraction capability of industrial data, constructing a model comprising a visual trunk, characteristic aggregation mapping, noise characteristic adaptation and a discriminator, fusing local neighborhood characteristics through Unfold operation, superposing Gaussian Noise to generate the pseudo-abnormal characteristics, and outputting abnormal scores by the discriminator after multi-scale fusion. The training adopts binary cross entropy and focus loss optimization parameters. The invention has the innovation points that the self-supervision fine tuning is suitable for industrial data distribution, the characteristic aggregation promotes fine granularity detection, and the multi-scale fusion gives consideration to different defects.

title: Agricultural monitoring data feedback system for high-speed transmission
description: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring data feedback systems, and discloses a high-speed transmission agricultural monitoring data feedback system which comprises a farmland monitoring module, an image processing module, a data compression module, a satellite communication module and a control feedback module, wherein the farmland monitoring module is used for monitoring the growth condition of crops and the field environment parameters in real time, the image processing module is used for carrying out identification analysis on monitoring images by adopting a convolutional neural network to judge the occurrence condition of diseases and insect pests, the data compression module is used for compressing monitoring data and image identification results by utilizing a wavelet transformation algorithm to reduce transmission load, and the satellite communication module is used for uploading the compressed data to a cloud analysis platform by independently developing a high-speed satellite communication system. This high-speed transmission's agricultural control data feedback system utilizes satellite communication to realize farmland high-speed monitoring and control command feedback, and image recognition technology realizes initiatively monitoring, reduces the cost of labor by a wide margin, realizes accurate monitoring and the operation of agriculture, wide application in intelligent agriculture.

title: Compressed sensing method and device for sparse signal recovery
description: The present application discloses a compressed sensing method for sparse signal recovery, comprising: inputting a current state sequence for sparse signal recovery into a trained first neural network to obtain a predicted reward value for each predicted action; selecting a predicted action from each predicted valid action in accordance with a set first selection strategy; updating the state value of the state corresponding to the predicted action and the current prediction residual according to the selected predicted action; and updating the state value of the last state in the current state sequence according to the current prediction residual and a preset first perception matrix to obtain an updated state sequence; using the updated state sequence as the current state sequence, returning to execute until the number of selected predicted actions reaches a set prediction action number threshold, and determining a recovery signal according to each selected predicted action. The present application implements compressed sensing in a deep reinforcement learning manner, thereby improving the generalization capability of compressed sensing.

title: Myoelectric signal classification detection method and system combining impulse neural network and super-dimensional calculation
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of electromyographic signal classification detection, and discloses an electromyographic signal classification detection method combining SNN and HDC. In the framework, SNN performs event-driven feature extraction by using random untrained weights, so that the calculation cost is reduced to the greatest extent, and HDC realizes anti-noise classification through high-dimensional representation. The integration of the two not only realizes the real-time detection of energy conservation, but also is particularly suitable for being applied to the scenes with limited resources such as wearable equipment. The method realizes the average accuracy rate of 95% (the peak accuracy rate is 96.44%) in three fatigue recognition tasks, and the training speed is 5.7 times faster than that of a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) and 45 times faster than that of a five-dimensional long-short-term memory network (5D-LSTM). Even if only 20% training data is used, the method can still maintain the accuracy rate of more than 90%, and the high efficiency and the robustness in actual deployment are fully proved.

title: Image processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present application discloses an image processing method, apparatus, device, and storage medium, relating to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method includes: extracting a target area from an image to obtain a target area map, wherein the pixels of the target area each belong to one of a plurality of preset pixel categories; performing feature extraction on the target area map to obtain feature information of the target area map; performing image segmentation on the target area map based on the feature information to obtain an image segmentation result of the target area map; obtaining the confidence level of the preset pixel category to which each pixel in the target area map belongs based on the feature information; and obtaining the uncertainty of the image segmentation result based on the confidence level of the preset pixel category to which each pixel in the target area map belongs. This method improves the accuracy of the uncertainty estimation of the image segmentation result.

title: Parking charging method and system based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention relates to the field of parking metering technology, specifically to an artificial intelligence-based parking metering method and system, comprising the following steps: obtaining timestamps through a geomagnetic sensor, cutting time periods to statistically calculate dwell density, using a sliding window to calculate density change rates, marking over-threshold points to identify turning points, segmenting nonlinear metering time periods, calculating the Euclidean distance of dwell ratios to obtain dwell intensity changes, using K-means clustering analysis to obtain a main rate interval, constructing a multi-path model to calculate costs, dynamically programming to extract the optimal path, and outputting a metered amount. In the present invention, timestamp data is collected through a vehicle's geomagnetic sensor, a fixed-step-size statistical density sequence is cut, a sliding window is used to calculate density offsets, a rate-of-change threshold is used to mark anomalies, continuity judgment is used to identify turning points, a dwell ratio sequence is constructed to calculate Euclidean distances, clustering is used to extract the main rate interval, and a multi-path model combined with dynamic programming is used to screen the optimal cost, thereby improving metering matching, reducing manual intervention, and improving the rationality of resource allocation.

title: River basin runoff uncertainty forecasting method driven by multi-source data and physics in combined mode
description: The invention relates to a method for forecasting runoff uncertainty of a river basin driven by multi-source data and physical combination, which comprises the steps of obtaining runoff sequence data and external forecasting factor data of a target river basin, constructing a runoff uncertainty generation model, carrying out probability diffusion on the runoff sequence data through a diffusion generator with constraint, generating approximate runoff data, designing a combined loss function to update weights and bias items of the runoff uncertainty generation model, converging loss under training combined guidance, and outputting a runoff forecasting result. The method has the beneficial effects that the method combines a loss function based on Fourier transform and a physical theory guide term, and the introduction of physical constraint not only can effectively quantify the randomness in a runoff physical system, but also can provide more selectable predicted values while guaranteeing the physical consistency of a predicted result, thereby effectively quantifying the inherent random uncertainty in the physical drought and waterlogging process and further enhancing the physical consistency and the prediction precision of a model.

title: Energy-saving optimization method and system for industrial circulating water system
description: The present invention discloses an energy-saving optimization method and system for an industrial circulating water system, relating to the field of energy-saving control technology. The method and system divide the heat exchanger into a high zone and a low zone according to the installation height. The high zone uses non-circulating water cooling equipment, while the low zone continues to use circulating water for water supply. Environmental and operational data are collected, and key features are identified based on grey correlation analysis. An integrated learning model is constructed to predict the return water temperature of the cooling tower, and sub-model weights are dynamically adjusted based on feature differences and energy consumption anomaly indexes. The method and system automatically adjust the water pump, fan, and water supply flow rate based on the deviation between the predicted results and the energy-saving target, forming a closed-loop optimization control. This method and system effectively reduces energy and water consumption, improves system operational stability and intelligence, and is applicable to a variety of industrial cooling scenarios.

title: Image superdivision method, device and lightweight image superdivision model
description: The application relates to the field of image processing, and provides an image superdivision method, an image superdivision device and a lightweight image superdivision model. The method comprises the steps of inputting an image to be processed into a trained lightweight image super-division model, and outputting a super-division reconstructed image, wherein the resolution of the image to be processed is lower than that of the super-division reconstructed image, the lightweight image super-division model comprises a first convolution module, a combined basic network module, a large-scale separation convolution attention module, a second convolution module, a first pixel recombination module, a third convolution module and a feature map fusion module which are sequentially connected, a second pixel recombination module connected with the first convolution module, a fourth convolution module connected with the second pixel recombination module, and the fourth convolution module is connected with the feature map fusion module. The method has good superdivision effect on the images, small calculated amount, short time consumption and high superdivision efficiency, and is suitable for crop quantity detection scenes (such as corn seedling detection scenes).

title: Intelligent sensing industrial robot semiconductor manufacturing system
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of information, and particularly focuses on an industrial robot semiconductor manufacturing key technical algorithm comparison synergy embodiment based on multidimensional synergy and intelligent perception. Conventional semiconductor fabrication is frequently problematic in terms of wafer handling positioning, chip packaging, equipment failure handling, multi-robot coordination, and process optimization. The algorithm reduces wafer carrying deviation from +/-0.5 mm to +/-0.05 mm in actual enterprise production through technologies such as multi-sensor fusion, real-time state sensing and deep learning, improves chip packaging qualification rate from 87% to 97%, greatly reduces equipment failure times, shortens multi-robot collaborative production time, shortens new product development period by half, comprehensively optimizes manufacturing flow, and remarkably improves production efficiency and product quality.

title: Preparation of a tobacco bud inhibitor based on eugenol and its compounding method for reducing dosage and increasing efficiency
description: The invention provides a eugenol-based tobacco bud inhibitor preparation and a compound decrement synergy method thereof, belonging to the technical field of tobacco bud inhibitor preparation. The preparation method comprises the steps of forming an inclusion compound from eugenol compound and beta cyclodextrin to realize molecular level protection, mixing the inclusion compound with gelatin and acacia to prepare an aqueous solution, adding chitosan to form a stable emulsion, precisely controlling particle size of particles by adopting a microemulsifying technology, adding an ultraviolet absorber and an antioxidant to enhance environmental stability, preparing a microcapsule with a core-shell structure by a spray drying method with optimized parameters, and finally mixing the microcapsule with corn starch and a dispersing agent to form a final slow-release product, so that the technical problems of poor stability, large volatilization loss and limited application of the eugenol compound in the tobacco bud inhibitor are successfully solved, and meanwhile, the use of the chemical bud inhibitor, namely, butralin is also reduced.

title: Car rental management method and system based on visual monitoring
description: The application relates to the technical field of vehicle leasing operation management and discloses a vehicle leasing management method and system based on visual monitoring, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1-multi-mode data acquisition, namely acquiring order information of a vehicle, vehicle position data and visual monitoring data inside and outside the vehicle in real time; S2-dynamic risk assessment, namely constructing a risk scoring model based on acquired multi-mode data to generate a real-time risk index, wherein reference indexes of the risk scoring model comprise order risk, vehicle body state and driving behavior, and S3-lease strategy dynamic adjustment, namely adjusting lease terms according to the real-time risk index, wherein adjustment contents comprise deposit amount and order distribution logic. The system corresponds to the method. According to the intelligent management system and the intelligent management method, intelligent management is achieved through the three modules including multi-mode data acquisition, dynamic risk assessment and lease strategy dynamic adjustment, and potential risks are accurately identified when a user leases a vehicle and the use safety of the vehicle after leasing is guaranteed.

title: A mathematical data management system optimization method based on cloud control
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of mathematical data management, and aims to propose a mathematical data management system optimization method based on cloud control. The method is characterized by comprising a data acquisition end, a quantitative analysis end, an optimization and upgrading end, a permission encryption end, and a user service end. The method collects user retrieval failure data, data abandonment data, error operation data, and system operation data, and uploads them to a metadata database. The method collects system pain points through quantitative data, classifies and analyzes the system pain points through classification and attribution, and then outputs an optimization target list to upgrade the core functions of the system. The method also optimizes the user operation layer in detail, refines the permission classification after optimization, and encrypts the collected data and uploads it to the cloud. Based on the user's data browsing, downloading, and collection data, personalized recommendations are made on the user end. At the same time, high-frequency and error-prone topics are automatically added to the classification directory according to the data usage heat map to actively serve users.

title: Dam deformation monitoring method and system
description: The invention discloses a dam deformation monitoring method and system, which belong to the technical field of image processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly calculating Harris angular point response values for each pixel point in a dam remote sensing real-time image and a standard image respectively, and marking the pixel points with obvious response values in each image area as obvious angular points; the method comprises the steps of screening out an image area with deformation, extracting significant angular points for the deformation area and a corresponding standard image area to obtain an angular point distribution real-time image and a standard image, obtaining an increased angular point distribution real-time image and a vanishing angular point distribution real-time image according to the angular point distribution real-time image and the angular point distribution real-time image, further calculating the increased angular point density and the vanishing angular point density, processing the two angular point distribution real-time images by adopting a double-channel dam deformation monitoring neural network, carrying out feature enhancement by combining the angular point densities, and finally obtaining a deformation degree value. According to the dam deformation monitoring method, accurate angular point analysis and neural network processing are adopted, so that the dam deformation monitoring precision is effectively improved.

title: Automatic detection method and system based on hidden crack characteristics of photovoltaic module
description: This invention discloses an automated detection method and system based on the microcrack characteristics of photovoltaic modules, belonging to the field of automated detection technology. It includes a drone equipped with an infrared thermal imager, a polarization camera, and a vibration sensor to simultaneously collect the thermal distribution, surface texture, and micro-vibration signals of the photovoltaic module, constructing a multi-dimensional microcrack feature dataset. This invention achieves local data processing and microcrack probability value output by deploying a lightweight convolutional network on the drone, reducing cloud dependence and latency. The microcrack probability value is calculated by weighting infrared thermal anomaly factors, polarization texture anomaly factors, and edge sharpness factors, effectively suppressing environmental noise and improving detection accuracy. Multi-angle re-inspection tasks are inserted into high-probability microcrack areas, low-risk areas are scanned quickly, and medium-probability areas are determined based on power and priority. When there are many re-inspection areas, the globally optimal path is recalculated. When a high-probability microcrack is detected, the current path is immediately interrupted, and a re-inspection task is inserted to avoid delays.

title: Feature extraction and time sequence modeling method of radar echo data based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a feature extraction and time sequence modeling method of radar echo data based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of radar data processing, and comprises the steps of preprocessing data, removing outliers by using a self-adaptive threshold, removing noise by combining EMD (empirical mode decomposition) and wavelet, normalizing by an improved formula, extracting DS-CNN (digital standard-computer n) by using multi-scale features, convoluting with holes, encapsulating a network, combining GRU (generalized unit) with a transducer encoder by time sequence modeling, and finally obtaining feature representation by using attention self-adaptive fusion features through ResNet full-connection layers. The method fully extracts the multi-scale and multi-mode characteristics of the radar echo by virtue of a plurality of advanced technologies, accurately models the time sequence relationship, optimizes model training, improves generalization and efficiency, balances characteristic characteristics, comprehensively improves radar data processing quality and has wide application prospect.

title: A training method for mine roadway design models, mine roadway design and equipment
description: This application discloses a training method for a mine roadway design model, a mine roadway design, and an apparatus, relating to the fields of deep learning technology and intelligent mining technology. The method includes: acquiring graph structure data of the mine for model training, the graph structure data including non-roadway data and roadway data; inputting the non-roadway data into a graph neural network to be trained, obtaining roadway design data output by the graph neural network, the roadway design data including roadway design node data and roadway design edge data, the roadway design edge data representing the spatial relationship between each non-roadway node and each roadway design node; and adjusting the network parameters of the graph neural network based on the error between the roadway design data and the roadway data. This approach improves the design efficiency of mine roadway design.

title: Multi-agent simulation-based medium-short term power spot price prediction method
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of electricity spot market price forecasting, and specifically to a medium- and short-term electricity spot price forecasting method based on multi-agent simulation, comprising the following steps: S1, data collection: acquiring historical market, unit parameters, and forecast day data; S2, agent optimization: using a Gaussian mixture model for dimensionality reduction and determining the number of agents based on AIC/BIC; S3, simulation environment: determining electricity prices based on supply and demand relationships according to a marginal price mechanism; S4, reward function: integrating price, contract deviation, and revenue, and optimizing dynamic weights; S5, strategy model: constructing a generator bidding model based on MADDPG; S6, model training: training and optimizing the generator bidding strategy model; S7, prediction evaluation: evaluating the model effect and realizing electricity price forecasting. The present invention achieves high-precision medium- and short-term predictions of electricity spot prices, significantly improving the model's adaptability and prediction reliability in complex market environments.

title: Multi-scale grouping feature fusion AD screening method based on voice features
description: The application relates to a multi-scale grouping feature fusion AD screening method based on voice features, which comprises the steps of obtaining an original voice signal from a subject, preprocessing the original voice signal to generate standardized voice data, extracting frequency domain features according to the standardized voice data, constructing a multi-dimensional feature mapping matrix, grouping the multi-dimensional feature mapping matrix, generating deep voice feature representation through a residual connection mechanism, calculating feature difference weights through an attention mechanism, carrying out feature fusion to generate local optimization feature vectors and global optimization features, splicing the local optimization feature vectors and the global optimization features, carrying out activation function processing to obtain joint feature vectors, processing the joint feature vectors through a pre-trained classification model, and outputting classification results of cognitive states.

title: An intelligent dynamic annotation system based on edge cloud collaboration
description: The invention relates to the field of intelligent labeling, in particular to an intelligent dynamic labeling system based on edge cloud cooperation, which comprises a region screening unit, a data analysis unit, a first labeling unit, a second labeling unit and a task processing unit, wherein the region screening unit is used for determining a final screening effective region according to the number of multi-frame personnel corresponding to a preliminary screening effective region and the differential value of the multi-frame personnel, the data analysis unit is used for determining a data labeling mode to be region labeling or independent labeling according to an extractable state, the first labeling unit is used for responding to the independently labeled data labeling mode, the second labeling unit is used for responding to the region labeling data labeling mode, the task processing unit is used for determining a value state according to the threshold crossing rate and the bias coefficient threshold crossing rate of adjacent effective regions and determining whether task control is carried out on edge equipment according to the value state and determining a task control mode according to the region continuous coefficient of the final screening effective region.

title: Intelligent construction simulation system based on BIM and virtual reality fusion
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent construction simulation system based on the fusion of BIM and virtual reality. The processing flow of the intelligent construction simulation system includes: constructing a three-dimensional digital model based on design drawings, geological survey data, and planned construction schedule; building a digital twin model of the bridge with the three-dimensional digital model as the core, combining the Internet of Things, sensors, and big data analysis technology, integrating the three-dimensional digital model and the digital twin model into a VR development platform, and performing a virtual simulation of the bridge construction site; inputting real-time sensor data collected by various sensors into the digital twin model to construct a dynamic risk field; and performing risk propagation path analysis and dynamic warning threshold adjustment based on the dynamic risk field to obtain a risk heat map, warning level, and recommended response strategy. The present invention breaks through the limitations of traditional construction management models and can be adjusted in advance based on predicted risks, providing a more comprehensive, accurate, and real-time simulation and management method for the bridge construction process.

title: Methods, equipment, and media for causal inference of commuting carbon efficiency using multiple transit priority strategies
description: The invention discloses a commute carbon efficiency causal deducing method, equipment and medium of a multi-bus priority strategy, which comprises the following steps: and constructing a variable set containing control variables (bus lane, signal priority strategy), covariates (carbon efficiency influencing factors) and carbon efficiency true values. And splicing the control variable and the covariate into a joint feature vector, and inputting the joint feature vector into the trained multi-strategy causal neural network. The network outputs the carbon efficiency estimated values under four situations, namely no strategy, only a special channel, only signal priority and joint strategy through the completely decoupled branches. And further, on the basis of no strategy, the carbon efficiency improvement rates under the implementation of three strategies are respectively calculated, namely, the ratio of the estimated difference value to the basic value is estimated, so that the emission reduction effect of each strategy is quantized.

title: Assembly process parameter optimization method and system based on improved moss growth algorithm
description: The invention discloses an assembly process parameter optimization method based on an improved moss growth algorithm, which comprises the following steps of (1) selecting a plurality of assembly precision indexes, (2) analyzing and evaluating the influence degree of each influence factor on the assembly precision indexes, selecting influence factors with larger influence to input an improved support vector machine precision prediction model, outputting an assembly precision prediction value, utilizing the assembly precision prediction value to formulate a process optimization objective function, (3) selecting assembly process parameters to be optimized, formulating an assembly process parameter optimization constraint condition, combining the process optimization objective function to construct a process parameter optimization model, (4) utilizing the improved moss growth algorithm to solve the optimal assembly process parameters by the process parameter optimization model, (5) outputting the optimal assembly process parameters to form an assembly process adjustment scheme. The invention improves the convergence speed and optimizing capability of the existing algorithm, not only improves the assembly precision and quality, but also reduces the repair cost caused by trial and error and correction.

title: Photosynthetic productivity prediction method and system based on three-dimensional structure
description: The invention relates to the field of photosynthetic productivity analysis, and provides a photosynthetic productivity prediction method and system based on a three-dimensional structure. The method comprises the steps of carrying out three-dimensional reconstruction on a multi-angle canopy image to obtain a canopy three-dimensional structure, carrying out light distribution simulation on the canopy according to the canopy three-dimensional structure to obtain canopy light distribution data, training a deep learning prediction model based on the canopy light distribution data to obtain a photosynthetic productivity prediction model, and carrying out photosynthetic productivity prediction on the canopy to be predicted through the photosynthetic productivity prediction model to obtain photosynthetic productivity data. The invention improves the efficiency of obtaining photosynthetic productivity based on the canopy structure and improves the prediction accuracy.

title: Retina blood vessel segmentation and analysis method and system based on multitask learning
description: The invention discloses a retina blood vessel segmentation and analysis method and system based on multi-task learning, which relate to the technical field of medical image processing, wherein a EMCAD module is introduced into an R-Unet model to segment retina blood vessels, an area percentage quantization function is designed, a multi-task learning framework RetiVas-MTNet is constructed, and the multi-task learning framework is used for auxiliary diagnosis of eye diseases. The EMCAD module fuses the channel attention CAB and the space attention SAB mechanism, namely 1) generating channel weights through self-adaptive maximum pooling and average pooling to strengthen key channel characteristics, and 2) establishing context connection of local characteristics by large-kernel convolution to calculate the space attention weights. The invention improves the segmentation precision of the micro-blood vessels by introducing EMCAD modules, realizes the crossing from qualitative segmentation to quantitative diagnosis by quantitatively designing the area percentage of the blood vessels, and provides a comprehensive solution for the automated diagnosis of eye diseases by the multi-task learning framework RetiVas-MTNet.

title: A real-time risk identification method and system for on-site operation behaviors based on deep learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of real-time risk identification of field operation behaviors, in particular to a method and a system for real-time risk identification of field operation behaviors based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of field operation data set generation, operation risk multidimensional quantitative evaluation, early warning sensitivity threshold adjustment, camera parameter setting judgment and camera parameter closed-loop adjustment; according to the method, a field operation data set is generated by collecting historical early warning data, operator verification data and equipment identification data, an early warning risk index and a risk identification precision coefficient are evaluated according to the historical early warning data and the historical early warning sensitivity threshold are dynamically adjusted based on the historical early warning risk index and the equipment identification data, finally whether camera parameters (lens distance and placement height) are reasonable or not is judged by combining the equipment identification data, closed-loop adjustment is carried out on unreasonable parameters, multi-dimensional quantitative evaluation of operation risk is achieved through multi-source data fusion, early warning sensitivity and the camera parameters are dynamically optimized, and risk identification precision and coverage are improved.

title: Commission calculation system and method
description: The invention belongs to the field of financial systems, and provides a commission calculation system and a commission calculation method, wherein the commission calculation system comprises the steps of collecting voice data, text data and behavior data in the interaction process of sales personnel and clients, and processing the data into a behavior factor matrix containing multiple dimensions; the method comprises the steps of constructing an intention weight function according to the behavior factor matrix, calculating a commission value according to a basic commission value, the behavior factor matrix, customer portrait information and sales personnel historical data, updating a dynamic gain item in a commission evaluation module according to a behavior label and a conversion result in a customer interaction path, and periodically adjusting the intention weight function according to the historical transaction data and the commission calculation result.

title: Dizziness light control method and system based on human body depth estimation and target detection
description: The present invention discloses a stun light control method and system based on human body depth estimation and target detection, comprising: acquiring a first data set and a second data set; training a pre-built depth estimation model according to the first data set, and then training a pre-built pedestrian detection model according to the second data set to obtain a human body depth estimation network; collecting a current monocular image, inputting the current monocular image into the human body depth estimation network to obtain human body depth information; and adjusting the brightness of the stun light according to the human body depth information. The present invention combines target detection with depth estimation to obtain human body depth information, and can automatically and dynamically adjust the brightness of the stun light for different target pedestrian distances, so as to increase the single use time of the stun light while ensuring its effect, and can be widely used in the field of lighting control technology.

title: An integrated intelligent production scheduling system for railway box girder manufacturing and erection
description: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, in particular to an integrated intelligent production scheduling system for railway box girder manufacturing and frame, which comprises a data acquisition and management subsystem, an intelligent production scheduling subsystem, a monitoring management subsystem and an interactive subsystem, wherein the data acquisition and management subsystem is used for acquiring construction data in real time and storing and processing the data, the intelligent production scheduling subsystem is used for generating a production scheduling plan based on a standardized basic data set, the production scheduling plan comprises a girder manufacturing plan and a girder frame plan, predicting risks of a plan implementation process and dynamically adjusting the plan, the monitoring management subsystem is used for tracking and managing the construction process in real time, monitoring production conditions, the execution management subsystem is used for planning the execution plan based on the production scheduling plan and completing task allocation of the execution plan, and the interactive subsystem comprises a user interface module which is used for users to know production conditions and manage production tasks and realizes intelligent management and optimal configuration of the whole girder frame process from girder manufacturing to girder frame through integrating advanced data acquisition, optimization algorithm and real-time adjustment and user interface design.

title: Intelligent inventory early warning method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses an intelligent inventory early warning method, an intelligent inventory early warning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are used for solving the technical problems that the existing inventory early warning method is insufficient in instantaneity and easily causes inventory overstock or stock outage risks. The inventory early warning method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data related to inventory, wherein the multi-source data comprise time sequence characteristics, static characteristics and provider data, inputting the time sequence characteristics and the static characteristics into a preset sales volume prediction network, outputting predicted sales volume, inputting the provider data into a preset order delivery time prediction model, outputting order delivery time and delay predicted values, calculating safety inventory according to the predicted sales volume, the order delivery time and the delay predicted values, and carrying out inventory early warning according to the safety inventory.

title: Method and device for fusing end-to-end temporal perception results for vehicle-road collaboration
description: The invention provides a method and a device for fusing end-to-end time sequence sensing results for vehicle-road cooperation, and relates to the technical field of automatic driving, wherein the method comprises the steps of aligning a plurality of first frame data acquired by vehicle-end equipment with a plurality of second frame data acquired by road-end equipment in a time dimension to obtain a plurality of time-aligned frame data pairs; the method comprises the steps of aligning target detection frames in frame data of a middle vehicle-end device with target detection frames in frame data of a road-end device in space dimension to obtain candidate frame data pairs with space alignment, determining cross-view matching pairs based on constructed space-time semantic joint graphs, fusing information of the target detection frames in the frame data included in all the cross-view matching pairs to obtain target tracks, and determining the target tracks as time sequence sensing results. According to the invention, the time synchronization, the space alignment, the cross-view matching, the time sequence sensing fusion and other modes are introduced, so that the accuracy of the time sequence sensing result fusion is improved.

title: Parkinson's disease assessment method and system based on multimodal physiological feature fusion of face video
description: The invention discloses a parkinsonism assessment method and system based on multi-mode physiological feature fusion of face video, and relates to the technical fields of computer vision, physiological signal processing and the like, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, extracting rPPG signals based on continuous face video streams; the method comprises the steps of calculating heart rate variability key parameters to obtain heart rate variability characteristics, S2, analyzing eye fixation point dynamic changes in face videos based on IPAST, extracting key eye movement behavior parameters, obtaining eye movement behavior characteristics through a convolution gating circulation unit, S3, inputting the heart rate variability characteristics and the eye movement behavior characteristics into a multi-mode fusion network structure, and outputting continuity risk scores or illness state labels for assisting doctors in early Parkinson risk assessment. According to the invention, a multi-mode feature collaborative analysis framework is constructed by deeply integrating multiple physiological signals acquired by video, so that the subjective limitation of traditional scale evaluation is broken through, and the unilateral defect of single biomarker detection is overcome.

title: Chain thinking enhancement multi-mode space reasoning method for expressway video data
description: This application belongs to the field of electronic digital data processing technology, specifically relating to a chain-thinking enhanced multimodal spatial reasoning method for highway video data. The method includes: acquiring highway video data; extracting semantic features from the highway video data using a two-dimensional visual encoder and geometric features from the highway video data using a three-dimensional geometric encoder; fusing the semantic and geometric features to form an enhanced visual feature sequence; generating a chain-thinking trajectory based on the enhanced visual feature sequence and language task instructions; constructing a dataset consisting of visual information, language task instructions, a complete reasoning trajectory, and the final answer; fine-tuning a pre-trained visual language model based on the dataset; performing reinforcement learning on the pre-trained visual language model through group relative policy optimization to optimize the reasoning process; and generating a structured reasoning path, visualized intermediate judgment information, and final traffic behavior decision suggestions based on the reasoning trajectory.

title: Traffic maintenance information processing method, device and storage medium based on AI language big model
description: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of traffic and discloses a traffic maintenance information processing method, a traffic maintenance information processing device and a storage medium based on an AI language large model, wherein traffic maintenance voice data uploaded by a user terminal is firstly acquired and converted into text information by utilizing a voice recognition model, then the text information is analyzed to acquire a target geographic position and the state characteristics of a maintenance object, and constructing a traffic congestion rate matrix according to historical traffic state information of the target geographic position in different weather types and time periods, extracting extremum elements to obtain a first traffic congestion rate and a second traffic congestion rate, correcting the first traffic congestion rate and the second traffic congestion rate according to traffic congestion contribution degrees corresponding to state features to obtain the first target traffic congestion rate and the second target traffic congestion rate, and triggering a traffic maintenance work order to be dispatched when the difference value of the first traffic congestion rate and the second traffic congestion rate is larger than or equal to a congestion rate threshold value. The application can accurately evaluate the influence condition of the state characteristics of the maintenance object on the traffic jam, thereby realizing intelligent and timely dispatch of the traffic maintenance work order.

title: Multi-mode physiological signal processing method, device, equipment and medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of data processing technology and can be applied to business scenarios such as financial technology and medical health. A multimodal physiological signal processing method, device, equipment and medium are disclosed, including: acquiring and preprocessing multimodal physiological signal data, generating data segments, performing data enhancement, generating damaged data segments, inputting each physiological signal into a modal encoder, generating modality-specific representations, aggregating non-target modality representations, generating positive sample aggregate representations, inputting damaged data segments into a decoder, generating reconstructed data segments, adjusting representation similarity, optimizing the modal encoder and decoder, and generating target task results based on the updated modal encoder. The present invention enhances the similarity between the target modality and the positive sample aggregate representation and reduces the similarity between the target modality and other data segments, thereby optimizing the update process of the modal encoder and decoder, thereby improving the processing effect of the target task and the migration capability between different tasks.

title: Semi-supervised classification method for gastroscope images through multi-mode collaborative learning
description: The invention relates to a gastroscope image semi-supervised classification method for multi-mode collaborative learning, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. According to the method, the training process of the label-free sample is separated from the training process of the label sample, and a self-supervision pre-training strategy based on consistency learning, restorative learning and Ji Xingxue learning collaborative learning is provided. In order to realize multi-mode feature fusion on a label sample, a fine tuning strategy based on feature distribution drift is provided. To verify the effectiveness of the method of the present invention, extensive experiments were performed on two published gastroscopic image datasets Kvasir and Kvasir v. The method provided by the invention has good classifying performance on the classification of the gastroscopic image under the condition that only a small amount of label data is used.

title: Method, system and computing equipment for determining content of coal element
description: The invention discloses a method, a system and computing equipment for determining the content of coal elements, relates to the technical field of radioactive safety detection, and solves the technical problems of complex standardized correction of the existing coal element analysis and low accuracy of the coal element analysis and prediction results; according to the method, the actual measurement energy spectrum data of an initial coal sample are obtained through a gamma detector, the actual measurement energy spectrum data are subjected to data enhancement to obtain a plurality of experimental coal samples, an element identification model is built through a self-attention mechanism and a multi-mode attention mechanism, the plurality of experimental coal samples are input into the element identification model to obtain the types of elements in the experimental coal samples and the predicted content distribution of the corresponding types, if the element identification model is in a preset convergence state through rating indexes, the identification of the elements in the experimental coal samples is marked as completed, and the accuracy of the prediction of the element content in coal is improved.

title: Digital management method for full life cycle of ocean sample
description: The invention relates to the technical field of marine sample management, and discloses a full life cycle digital management method for marine samples, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting characteristic data such as sample types, source positions, chemical component information and the like of the marine samples, calculating classification schemes and storage parameters according to the characteristic data, and combining sample library real-time management data to evaluate management requirements and generate a target management strategy; and finally, the proposal is implemented, the temperature threshold value and the storage position of the classified storage equipment are dynamically adjusted through monitoring the sample storage rate index by a sensor, and a real-time feedback mechanism is introduced to iterate and correct adjustment parameters, so as to generate the full life cycle management proposal. The method realizes the whole-flow digital management of the ocean samples, and improves the management efficiency and the sample preservation quality.

title: Operator intention recognition method based on visual-language big model
description: The present invention proposes a method for operator intention recognition based on a large visual-language model. By constructing a standardized prompt word template according to the target assembly object, operation requirements and steps, environmental information, collaboration requirements, natural expression habits and part features, the method combines the operator's collected task instruction information to perform task link inference to generate task execution steps and assembly area visual information. Based on object availability detection technology combined with real-time sensor fusion and environmental perception, dynamic collaboration data is generated, and then component manipulation information and robot collaboration instructions are generated as dynamic manipulation information. Combined with the operator's skeletal information and appearance texture features, multi-source perception data is fused through a gating mechanism to achieve feature weighted fusion, obtain the operator's intention, strengthen the intrinsic correlation between human behavior and assembly tasks, suppress irrelevant information interference, achieve accurate operator intention recognition, and improve the efficiency of human-machine collaboration. It has important theoretical significance and practical value.

title: Grassland ecological assessment early warning monitoring system based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention relates to the field of ecological monitoring technology, and discloses a grassland ecological assessment and early warning monitoring system based on artificial intelligence. Vegetation indices, soil parameters, livestock trajectories, and terrain data are collected in real time through satellite remote sensing, drones, and Internet of Things devices. Intelligent algorithms are used to process missing values and standardized data to extract vegetation phenological characteristics. Weights are dynamically calculated by integrating indicator volatility, correlation, and ecological synergy rules, and the net impact of grazing activities on the ecology is accurately quantified based on a strictly geographically constrained control area to generate a degradation risk score. High, medium, and low risk areas are divided according to the score, and a stocking capacity optimization plan and targeted measures matching the policy library are dynamically output. The system accurately separates the impact of natural interference and human grazing, solving the problem of traditional methods misjudging risk levels. The dynamic weight model improves the adaptability of the assessment.

title: Stereoscopic warehouse cargo space distribution and picking scheduling method and system based on digital twin
description: The present invention provides a digital twin-based storage location allocation and picking scheduling method and system for a three-dimensional warehouse. This method relates to the field of digital twin technology and includes constructing a three-dimensional digital model of the three-dimensional warehouse; performing storage location allocation based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, using product access frequency, associated purchase probability, and seasonal demand forecasts as input parameters, and generating storage location allocation instructions with the shortest picking path and centralized storage of associated products as optimization goals; executing warehousing operations and receiving picking orders; constructing a virtual potential field within the model, and determining task priority based on order urgency and triggering obstacle avoidance and yielding when the repulsive force between stackers exceeds a threshold; and calculating obstacle avoidance trajectories and generating collaborative scheduling instructions to execute picking operations. This invention achieves efficient storage location allocation and intelligent multi-stacker collaborative scheduling.

title: Image processing method, apparatus, electronic device, computer readable storage medium, and computer program product
description: This application provides an image processing method, apparatus, electronic device, computer-readable storage medium, and computer program product. The method includes: obtaining a control signal and an observation perspective vector for a target object model; decoding based on the control signal to obtain a dynamic neural texture map of a first region in the target object model in the appearance dimension; decoding based on the observation perspective vector to obtain a perspective neural texture map of the first region in the perspective dimension; and fusing the dynamic neural texture map, the perspective neural texture map, and a pre-trained diffuse neural texture map to obtain a texture map of the first region. This application improves the ability to express detail in textures used to render images.

title: Multi-mode image group HDRBT combined thermal ablation treatment liver cancer curative effect evaluation system
description: The application discloses a multi-mode image histology HDRBT combined thermal ablation liver cancer curative effect evaluation system, which relates to the field of liver cancer treatment and comprises a multi-mode image data acquisition module, a three-dimensional visual model construction module, a combined treatment plan generation module, a curative effect evaluation module and a treatment evaluation module, wherein the multi-mode image data acquisition module is used for acquiring multi-mode image data, the three-dimensional visual model construction module is used for reconstructing a three-dimensional structure of a liver tumor, peripheral blood vessels and a bile duct through an image segmentation algorithm and generating a visual model by fusing image histology characteristics, the combined treatment plan generation module is used for integrating HDRBT dosimetry parameters and thermal ablation process parameters, optimizing a catheter implantation path, a thermal ablation electrode position and a treatment sequence and generating a combined treatment scheme, and the curative effect evaluation module is used for quantitatively analyzing tumor volume change, ablation boundary integrity and residual tumor activity through accurate registration of multi-mode images before and after treatment. The proposal of the application can solve the problems of incomplete thermal ablation and high recurrence rate of the hepatocellular carcinoma and provide full-chain technical support for clinical accurate application.

title: Method for predicting fatigue of controller in sentry based on work type and circadian rhythm
description: The present invention relates to the field of air traffic management technology and discloses a fatigue prediction method for controllers on duty based on work type and circadian rhythm. The method comprises: obtaining facial video frames of the controller on duty and calculating a PERCLOS time series representing the percentage of eyelid closure; obtaining exogenous factors related to the control task; encoding the PERCLOS time series and exogenous factors and inputting them into a trained time series neural network model, wherein the time series neural network model is configured to apply different weights to work type, circadian rhythm, and work demand for differentiated modeling; and generating a fatigue level curve covering a preset prediction time window based on the output of the time series neural network model. The present invention aims to solve the technical problems of the prior art fatigue monitoring methods, which have a delayed response and insufficient adaptability to dynamic work scenarios, thereby providing a method that can proactively and accurately predict the future fatigue development trend of controllers.

title: An Indoor 3D Visual Positioning System and Method Based on Dual Cameras
description: The invention provides an indoor three-dimensional visual positioning system and method based on double cameras, which belong to the technical field of indoor positioning and comprise an image acquisition module, a model detection module and a target position determination module, wherein the image acquisition module comprises two cameras and is used for respectively acquiring a first image and a second image, the model detection module is preset with a target detection model and is used for carrying out human body detection and face detection, a first detection result aiming at the first image and a second detection result aiming at the second image are acquired, and the target position determination module is used for fusing the first image and the second image and sequentially carrying out binocular correction, parallax calculation and reprojection when the detection result contains a detection target, so that the three-dimensional coordinate of the detection target is determined. The method has the advantages that monocular limitation is broken through based on the double cameras, the method can adapt to complex scenes, the recognition performance of a model for small targets and long-distance targets is improved, meanwhile, the double cameras can be flexibly installed, parameters suitable for subsequent parallax calculation can be calculated through binocular correction, and accurate three-dimensional positioning is achieved.

title: A Job Matching Method and System Based on Distributed Architecture
description: The invention relates to a job hunting matching method and system based on a distributed architecture, which belong to the field of data processing, and are characterized in that job seekers and recruiters data are acquired and preprocessed in parallel through multiple nodes, high-precision data extraction is realized by adopting a distributed crawler cluster and a double-engine verification mechanism, privacy desensitization and feature vectorization are completed by combining dynamic cleaning pipelines, cross-modal matching is performed by constructing a dual-channel depth residual error network, skills and job features are dynamically fused by using a gating attention mechanism, robustness of an optimization model is combined with countermeasure training and contrast learning, a dynamic job hunting relation map is generated based on a matching result, weight attenuation and increment updating are realized by adopting a time sequence graph convolution network, an ant colony optimization task migration is triggered by a design load perception mechanism, calculation tasks are dynamically distributed through an improved consistency hash algorithm, and an integrated online learning module is used for generating an increment sample by using implicit feedback data and updating model parameters in real time.

title: A method, system, electronic device, and storage medium for generating new energy samples.
description: This application pertains to a sample generation method. Addressing the technical problem of discrepancies between generated and real-world data in current artificial data generation methods, this application provides a method, system, electronic device, and storage medium for generating new energy samples. It utilizes a diffusion model to generate new energy samples based on historical new energy data. During diffusion model training, forward noise addition and backward noise reduction are performed sequentially. By leveraging the forward diffusion and backward noise addition processes of the diffusion model, it learns how to recover new energy data from Gaussian noise, thereby generating high-quality and diverse new energy sample data. Furthermore, when obtaining the loss function during diffusion model training, the correlation value between Gaussian noise samples and training samples is calculated to construct a corresponding correlation matrix, and then a contrastive loss function is constructed as the loss function during diffusion model training.

title: A Material Removal Depth Prediction Method Based on Improved XGBoost
description: The invention relates to the technical field of machine learning, in particular to a material removal depth prediction method based on improvement XGBoost.
