The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting a grinding and polishing processing data set, dividing the grinding and polishing processing data set into a training set and a testing set, preprocessing the data set, optimizing super-parameters of a polar gradient lifting algorithm (XGBoost) by adopting an improved aigrette optimization algorithm (IESOA) so as to establish a prediction model of material removal depth, and finally quantifying contribution degree of each grinding and polishing process parameter to the material removal depth based on a Shapley additive interpretation (SHAP) method so as to realize visual analysis of a model decision process. The method can remarkably improve the prediction precision of the removal depth of the polishing processing material, and clear the influence mechanism of each technological parameter through the interpretability analysis, and has the dual advantages of high prediction precision and decision interpretability.

title: Human-computer dialogue-based simulated medical consultation interaction analysis method, device, and equipment
description: The application discloses a man-machine dialogue-based simulated inquiry interaction analysis method, device and equipment, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence and medical treatment and comprise the steps of obtaining inquiry dialogue data generated by interaction between a user object and a virtual user; based on the preset medical knowledge graph and the preset diagnosis information, multidimensional interactive analysis is carried out on the inquiry dialogue data to generate corresponding evaluation indexes and corresponding index scores, and an evaluation report containing the index scores and inquiry dialogue improvement suggestions facing to the user objects is generated and output. The objectivity and the accuracy of the evaluation result are ensured, and the prejudice and the inconsistency caused by subjective experience difference in manual evaluation are overcome, so that the evaluation result is accurate, a user can clearly know the performance level of the user in each dimension, and a targeted inquiry optimization direction can be obtained.

title: Ice lake burst small river basin identification method and system based on valley landform characteristic index
description: The invention provides a method and a system for judging and identifying ice lake burst small watershed based on a valley landform characteristic index, which belong to the technical field of ice lake burst small watershed judgment, and comprise the following steps of S1, acquiring elevation data and multi-period remote sensing image data; S2, identifying a channel and a ice lake, determining the channel position and the ice lake position, calculating average gradient of the upstream and the downstream of the ice lake along the channel direction, S3, acquiring an upstream b value of the ice lake along the vertical channel direction and a downstream b value of the ice lake along the vertical channel direction, S4, calculating GLBN values of small watershed according to the average gradient of the ice lake along the channel direction, the upstream b value of the ice lake along the vertical channel direction and the downstream b value of the ice lake along the vertical channel direction, and judging that the small watershed is a small watershed of the ice lake when GLBN values are larger than a judging threshold. The invention develops the identification of the iced lake burst small river basin in the mountain unmanned area and the historic data recording area through the valley landform characteristic indexes of the slope mutation and valley type conversion.

title: A few-sample target detection method based on data association enhancement and feature interaction
description: A small sample target detection method based on data association enhancement and feature interaction comprises the steps of obtaining a basic class data set and a new class data set for micro-adjustment, constructing a small sample target detection network comprising double branches and backbone network weight sharing by taking a target detection network based on two stages of training and micro-adjustment as a main body frame, constructing a data association enhancement module, distinguishing a secondary positive sample from a false positive sample, constructing a bidirectional mutual support-query feature enhancement module, introducing dense convolution to support a feature guide mechanism, injecting discrimination semantics learned in a support set into a query branch, and training and micro-adjusting network parameters based on the obtained basic class data set and the new class data set to obtain a final small sample target detection model. The invention improves the overall detection performance of the small sample target.

title: Instruction multiplexing methods, apparatus, computer equipment and program products
description: The present application relates to the field of deep learning technologies, and in particular, to a method, an apparatus, a computer device, and a program product for multiplexing instructions. The method comprises the steps of determining an associated problem corresponding to a current input problem, wherein the length of the associated problem is consistent with the length of the current input problem, or the associated problem is consistent with a specific sequence of the current input problem, the specific sequence is the sum of the length of the input problem and the generated answer length, modifying a task address in a historical memory carrying instruction to be a target address corresponding to the current input problem, obtaining a carrying instruction to be executed, the historical memory carrying instruction is a task instruction corresponding to the associated problem, and executing the carrying instruction to be executed so as to process a task corresponding to the current input problem. The proposal of the application can reduce the occupation of the large language model to the memory space.

title: Method for generating prediction model of remaining life of software, prediction method and storage medium
description: The invention provides a generation method, a prediction method and a storage medium of a software residual life prediction model, belonging to the technical field of software aging and regeneration, wherein the generation method comprises the steps of obtaining failure field data during the running of software, and preprocessing the failure field data to obtain a training sample; the method comprises the steps of training a preset network model based on training samples to obtain a software residual life prediction model, wherein the network model comprises a step of embedding a coding layer to code the training samples to obtain a high-order representation with unified dimension, a step of converting the high-order representation into a multi-scale space feature representation by a multi-scale graph convolution model, a step of obtaining a high-dimensional feature representation with frequency domain and time domain fusion by a frequency domain window fusion model based on the multi-scale space feature representation, and a step of predicting the software residual life by a multi-scale convolution predictor based on the high-dimensional feature. The method can solve the problem that the restarting decision of the software is inaccurate due to the defects of the existing method in the aspects of extracting complex aging factor relation, modeling multi-scale aging modes and the like.

title: A search ranking method based on knowledge community discovery
description: The invention provides a search ordering method based on knowledge community discovery, which comprises the steps of forming knowledge communities based on domain knowledge graphs in the domain to be searched, generating a theme and a description text for each knowledge community by using a large model, generating semantic space vectors according to the theme and the description text of each knowledge community, generating semantic vectors of query words according to query words input by users, recalling candidate data sets, retrieving n knowledge communities which are most similar to the query words as related knowledge communities according to the semantic vectors of the query words in the candidate data sets, selecting m nodes in the n related knowledge communities to obtain node sets, acquiring intersection sets of retrieved contents and the node sets to obtain knowledge enhancement candidate document sets, calculating scores of documents in the knowledge enhancement candidate document sets by adopting a knowledge enhancement ordering method, and ordering to finish search ordering based on knowledge community discovery.

title: Marine wind power cable line fault positioning method and system
description: This invention discloses a method and system for locating faults in offshore wind power cable lines, relating to the field of line fault location technology. The method includes: collecting cable distribution parameters and instantaneous data collected by sensors at the cable fault point and adjacent points; defining the equivalent impedance of the faulty cable and forming a unified feature vector; dividing the cable into equal intervals based on its total length and performing logarithmic mapping; and calculating the power loss at discrete lengths of interval points by combining the magnitude of the equivalent impedance. The method of this invention achieves the effect of uniformly expressing the spatiotemporal characteristics of all fault points by combining the fault feature vector, the mapped power value, and the logarithmically varying discrete length to form a discrete feature matrix. By co-mapping the logarithmically varying discrete length and power value of candidate solutions, a physical solution set matrix weighted by the comprehensive target value is constructed, achieving the effect of unifying the cable fault point attributes with physical parameters.

title: Intelligent defect detection method for CT images of multi-type lattice structural members in additive manufacturing
description: The intelligent defect detection method for the CT image of the multi-type lattice structural member for additive manufacturing belongs to the technical field of intelligent detection and image processing, and solves the technical problems of post-processing delay, large calculated amount, low defect feature extraction efficiency and the like in the prior art, and comprises the following steps that S1, a backbone network is adopted to process an original CT image to generate a plurality of feature images with different scales; S2, integrating the feature images with different scales generated in the step S1 by adopting a neck network, reserving space details of a shallow layer, integrating the space details into deep semantic information, obtaining a feature image with both positioning accuracy and semantic expression, S3, comparing the feature image with multi-scale information generated in the step S2 with marked image data in a head network, calculating a loss function of the training set, outputting position information, category and confidence of defects in the images, and finishing intelligent defect detection. The defects of the lattice structural member can be automatically detected and identified with high precision and high speed.

title: Face recognition method and system suitable for outdoor electronic instrument
description: The invention relates to the technical field of face recognition, and discloses a face recognition method and a face recognition system suitable for an outdoor electronic instrument, which aim at the problem that recognition accuracy is low under complex illumination, gesture change and shielding conditions in the prior art, wherein S1 is used for collecting image data and preprocessing, S2 is used for carrying out face region detection and face key point positioning on an illumination enhanced image, S3 is used for carrying out affine transformation on face alignment based on a face detection result set, S4 is used for extracting face feature vectors based on a ResNet structure, S5 is used for carrying out gesture-guided feature reconstruction processing on the face feature vectors to obtain gesture-enhanced face feature vectors, S6 is used for carrying out feature normalization and identity classification on the gesture-enhanced face feature vectors to output face recognition results, and S7 is used for outputting final identity recognition results and confidence. The invention can provide an efficient and scientific optimization scheme in outdoor face recognition, and brings remarkable technical value and economic benefit for practical application.

title: Electronic medical record standardized conversion method and system based on Minnan dialect feature recognition
description: The invention provides an electronic medical record standardization conversion method and system based on Minnan dialect feature recognition, comprising the following steps of constructing an Minnan dialect acoustic-semantic joint modeling framework, establishing a Minnan dialect vocabulary intelligent mapping system based on medical context, designing a symptom description standardization conversion engine, realizing a syntax structure intelligent recombination mechanism, and establishing an incremental learning and quality control mechanism.

title: Verification code identification method and device based on large model and related equipment
description: This invention discloses a method, apparatus, and related equipment for CAPTCHA recognition based on a large-scale model. The method acquires sample CAPTCHAs of different types; preprocesses the sample CAPTCHAs of different types to extract multimodal features; acquires the verification strategy and interference features of each sample CAPTCHA, and inputs each multimodal feature and its corresponding verification strategy and interference features into an initial multimodal large-scale model for recognition training; based on the output of the initial multimodal large-scale model and the corresponding real CAPTCHA type identifier, calculates the model loss using a triplet loss function, and performs backpropagation based on the model loss to optimize the model parameters of the multimodal large-scale model, resulting in an optimized multimodal large-scale model; acquires the target CAPTCHA to be recognized, outputs the target CAPTCHA to the multimodal large-scale model for recognition, and obtains the recognition result. This method improves the accuracy and success rate of recognizing cross-type CAPTCHAs.

title: A genetic optimization spatial layout method and system for farmland monitoring stations
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural information and resource monitoring, and discloses a genetic optimization space layout method and system of a cultivated land monitoring site, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining geographic information and soil index data of the cultivated land monitoring site, and carrying out normalization processing on the data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a spatial heterogeneity comprehensive index, fusing multi-index weights based on an entropy weight method, calculating the spatial heterogeneity comprehensive index of each cultivated land monitoring site, carrying out heterogeneous grade division on the cultivated land monitoring sites according to the quantile of the spatial heterogeneity comprehensive index, generating a Thiessen polygon quantitative monitoring range, optimizing the cultivated land monitoring site layout through a genetic algorithm, and iteratively selecting an optimal cultivated land monitoring site spatial layout scheme. By adopting the genetic optimization space layout method and system of the cultivated land monitoring station, various key indexes of soil and space distribution characteristics of the monitoring station are comprehensively considered, and a space heterogeneity comprehensive index is constructed, so that the layout optimization of the monitoring station is realized.

title: High-precision land carbon flux reconstruction method based on four-dimensional space-time deep learning
description: This application relates to a high-precision land carbon flux reconstruction method based on four-dimensional spatiotemporal deep learning, comprising: acquiring and preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous datasets; constructing a four-dimensional spatiotemporal deep learning model architecture that sequentially connects a multi-scale spatiotemporal feature extraction module, a spatiotemporal feature fusion module, a prediction layer, and an uncertainty quantification layer from input to output, using the preprocessed multi-source heterogeneous dataset as input and the carbon flux reconstruction result as output; constructing a loss function, adopting a hierarchical learning rate strategy and introducing a cosine annealing scheduler, and training the four-dimensional spatiotemporal deep learning model architecture based on the preprocessed multi-source heterogeneous dataset to obtain a four-dimensional spatiotemporal deep learning model; acquiring a carbon flux data reconstruction set, inputting it into the four-dimensional spatiotemporal deep learning model to generate carbon flux reconstruction results. This method can effectively integrate multi-source heterogeneous data, capture the complex spatiotemporal dynamic characteristics of carbon flux, and achieve high spatiotemporal resolution accurate reconstruction of land carbon flux.

title: Virtual power plant optimal scheduling method and device for improving power system adjustment capability
description: This invention discloses a virtual power plant optimized scheduling method and apparatus for improving the regulation capacity of power systems, belonging to the field of virtual power plant technology. The method includes: acquiring basic data of aggregated resources in the virtual power plant; constructing resource operation constraint models under multiple scenarios based on the basic data; embedding a Conditional Value at Risk (CVaR) risk control mechanism into the operation constraint model to establish a multi-scenario stochastic optimized scheduling model; and solving the model using a hybrid algorithm of CVX-SeDuMi and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme that balances maximizing regulation capacity and controlling risk. This invention can fully explore the regulation potential of virtual power plants while effectively avoiding scheduling risks in extreme scenarios, providing a scientific optimized scheduling method for virtual power plants to participate in power system regulation, under the premise of ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power system.

title: Graph analysis method, device, medium, equipment and product based on large model
description: Responding to trigger operation on a dashboard page, determining a chart analysis template corresponding to the trigger operation, wherein the first content is associated with executable codes for acquiring second content, the executable codes are determined through a large model based on input content of a user, and the input content is used for indicating analysis logic of the first data chart in at least one data chart; and replacing the first content in the chart analysis template with the second content, and outputting the chart analysis content according to the chart analysis template obtained after the replacement. By leading the large model processing process to the template configuration stage, the large model is prevented from repeatedly processing the same logic, and the code multiplexing rate, the chart analysis efficiency and the accuracy are improved.

title: Large model interaction information security filtering method and device
description: This invention provides a method and apparatus for security filtering of interactive information in a large-scale model. The method includes: receiving query information input by a user; inputting the query information into a configurable multi-layer filtering module for filtering; if the multi-layer filtering module does not trigger interception, submitting the filtered query information to a large language model for inference; the large language model continuously outputting streaming text during the inference process and accumulating the continuously outputting streaming text into a buffer; when the accumulated text in the buffer meets a preset trigger condition, performing a sensitive content check on the accumulated text in the buffer; if sensitive content is detected in the accumulated text, terminating the inference process of the large language model; if no sensitive content is detected in the accumulated text, outputting a complete answer text after the inference process is completed. The method and apparatus of this invention can filter sensitive information in real time and accurately, avoiding the exposure of risky information.

title: Model distillation method and device based on knowledge base
description: This application provides a knowledge-based model distillation method and apparatus, belonging to the field of model distillation technology. The method includes: extracting features from multiple pre-trained large models to form a distillation knowledge base; determining the task content corresponding to the student model; matching target knowledge from the distillation knowledge base based on the task content, wherein the task content includes multiple ordered task steps, each task step corresponding to at least one target knowledge; matching the task description of the task step with multiple task types to determine target features under the target task type; and identifying the knowledge corresponding to the target features as target knowledge; and guiding the training of the student model based on the target knowledge, wherein the size of the trained student model is smaller than the large model corresponding to the target knowledge. The knowledge-based model distillation method and apparatus provided in this application are used to provide targeted distillation strategies, enabling lightweight models to better adapt to real-world application scenarios.

title: Electric power skill training and scoring evaluation method based on large model algorithm
description: The invention discloses an electric skill training and scoring evaluation method based on a large model algorithm, which belongs to the technical field of electric skill training and scoring evaluation and comprises the steps of integrating all kinds of processed data into a unified data warehouse for storage through collecting and processing student information data and historical operation behavior data, analyzing the requirements of each student information data and electric skill post through a natural language processing technology to generate a requirement analysis result, generating a training content scheme based on a preselected large model according to the requirement analysis result, constructing a student learning style model through analyzing learning behavior data, further optimizing the training content scheme to obtain a training optimal scheme, constructing a three-dimensional electric work scene model through computer graphics and VR/AR technology, and performing real-time scoring evaluation on electric skill operation of students through establishing an operation evaluation model to obtain an evaluation result of each student.

title: Main steam flow soft measurement method, system and medium based on TCN-TA model
description: This invention discloses a soft measurement method, system, and medium for main steam flow based on TCN-TA. The method includes the following steps: Step 1, collecting raw data of operating parameters related to main steam flow from the power plant monitoring system; Step 2, imputing missing and outlier values in the raw data, and then normalizing the data; Step 3, performing dimensionality reduction on the data using kernel principal component analysis; Step 4, constructing a TCN-TA model, including an input layer, a TCN layer, a TA layer, and an output layer connected in sequence; Step 5, inputting the data to be measured into the TCN-TA model, and outputting the measured value of the main steam flow of the thermal power unit. This invention avoids the gradient vanishing and gradient exploding problems that occur in time series forecasting, and the introduced TA module can optimize and integrate the TCN output results, making the prediction results more accurate.

title: Multi-sensing information fusion method and device for multi-target recognition scene
description: This invention provides a multi-sensor information fusion method and apparatus for multi-target recognition scenarios, relating to the field of intelligent sensing technology. The method includes: acquiring multi-sensor point cloud data for each target to be identified through a sensor system; performing polarization slicing on the multi-sensor point cloud data to obtain corresponding multi-path information slices; performing spatiotemporal synthetic polarization coding on the multi-path information slices to obtain a synthetic coding stream formed by multiple polarization codes; and calling a spatiotemporal neural network model to extract multi-scale semantic information of the target to be identified from the synthetic coding stream for alignment evaluation of each target. This invention addresses the shortcomings of existing multi-sensor systems in multi-target recognition scenarios, such as low information coding efficiency, prolonged data processing time, and severe information synthesis distortion.

title: Intelligent decision method and device based on multiple modes, equipment and medium
description: The application provides a multi-mode-based intelligent decision method, device, equipment and medium, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and is suitable for the fields of financial science and technology and medical health. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target object voice of a target object, carrying out voice conversion on the target object voice to obtain a target conversion text sequence, carrying out text coding on the target conversion text sequence to obtain target conversion text characteristics, carrying out characteristic extraction on the target object voice to obtain auxiliary language characteristics, obtaining target environment information of an environment where the target object is located, carrying out characteristic extraction on the target environment information to obtain environment characteristics, carrying out characteristic enhancement according to the target conversion text characteristics, the auxiliary language characteristics and the environment characteristics to obtain joint enhancement characteristics, obtaining semantic graphs, generating decision feature vectors according to the semantic graphs and the joint enhancement characteristics, and carrying out intention decision according to the decision feature vectors to obtain intention decision results. The application can improve the accuracy of the perception decision.

title: Knowledge Graph-Based Threat Intelligence Big Data Governance System and Method
description: This application provides a threat intelligence big data governance system and method based on knowledge graphs, relating to the field of cybersecurity. The system includes a data acquisition module, an entity extraction module, a knowledge graph construction module, a graph governance module, a graph evolution module, and an output module. Through multi-module collaboration, this application first standardizes multi-source heterogeneous threat intelligence, then extracts entities and resolves ambiguities to construct a structured knowledge graph. After governance and optimization to eliminate redundancy and contradictions and calibrate credibility, combined with time decay and feedback mechanisms, the timeliness and accuracy of the intelligence are ensured. Finally, multiple forms of output support downstream applications. This effectively solves the problems of single-item processing, lack of context, and difficulty in identifying redundant contradictions in existing technologies, significantly improving the credibility, completeness, and usability of threat intelligence, reducing false positive rates, and increasing data processing efficiency and the effectiveness of downstream security defenses.

title: A Multimodal Endoscopic Image Fusion Analysis Method
description: The invention discloses a multi-mode endoscope image fusion analysis method, which relates to the technical field of medical image navigation and comprises the steps of collecting an original white light image and an original narrow-band image, preprocessing, collecting real-time pose parameters, extracting vascular texture characteristics in the preprocessed original white light image and the preprocessed original narrow-band image, generating a binary semantic mask, calculating a space transformation matrix according to the binary semantic mask, generating preliminary visual deformation field data, calculating microscopic deformation field data according to a pre-stored biomechanical characteristic database, the preliminary visual deformation field data and the real-time pose parameters, reversely calculating to obtain physical deformation compensation field data, and performing space superposition operation with the preliminary visual deformation field data to obtain comprehensive compensation deformation field data. According to the method, the reliability of the fusion result is quantitatively evaluated and abnormally early-warned in real time through multi-mode fusion quality early-warning judgment, and the reliability of clinical decisions and the operation safety are enhanced.

title: A Power Operation and Maintenance Report Generation System and Method Based on a Large Language Model
description: This invention discloses a power operation and maintenance report generation system based on a large language model. It includes: a data acquisition and processing module for collecting multi-dimensional power operation and maintenance datasets, performing data preprocessing and data augmentation, and dividing the dataset into training and test sets; a model training and update module for selecting a general-purpose large language model as a baseline model, performing pre-training and fine-tuning based on the training set, optimizing parameters using LoRA technology, and obtaining an optimized model through evaluation iterations; and a report generation module, based on the optimized model, employing a two-stage strategy to retrieve and generate a report outline and a complete report from a vector database according to user input. This invention solves the problems of low credibility and accuracy of content generated by existing general-purpose large language models in power operation and maintenance scenarios, significantly improving the accuracy and professionalism of report generation.

title: AI-driven harmonic wave cooperative governance method, equipment and medium
description: This application discloses an AI-driven harmonic collaborative governance method, device, and medium. The method includes: collecting multi-source heterogeneous data through pre-deployed monitoring terminals, performing data fusion processing on the multi-source heterogeneous data, and constructing a system state feature vector; using a long short-term memory network model, based on the system state feature vector, predicting the dynamic change trend of the harmonic spectrum within a future time window, and outputting the current amplitude sequence of each major characteristic harmonic; using a reinforcement learning algorithm, based on the predicted dynamic change trend of the harmonic spectrum and the system state feature vector, calculating the compensation priority weight vector of each harmonic, and generating a compensation current command for an active power filter based on the compensation priority weight vector; controlling the active power filter cluster to execute harmonic compensation operations according to the compensation current command, converting the compensation current command into an actual compensation current through pulse width modulation and a driving unit, and injecting it into the power grid to achieve dynamic collaborative governance.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle image transmission method based on cooperative path self-adaptive transducer
description: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle image transmission method based on a cooperative path self-adaptive transducer. The problems that the image transmission channel of the unmanned aerial vehicle is shallow in coupling, the backbone network cannot consider the overall situation and the local situation, the redundancy is ignored in rate allocation and the like are considered. Therefore, the invention provides an end-to-end image transmission method based on a cooperative path self-adaptive module. The method designs a cooperative path self-adaptive module, and the Swin path and the CNN path are parallel to efficiently extract global and local characteristics. Secondly, a channel state encoder and a cooperative self-adaptive fusion module are designed, and SNR perceptibility is deeply coupled to each layer of a backbone network, so that dynamic characteristic modulation is realized. And finally, designing a channel relation sensing module at the output end of the encoder, evaluating channel redundancy by using a self-attention mechanism and executing intelligent pruning. Compared with the existing semantic communication method, the method has the advantages of better performance and stronger robustness under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, and is suitable for unmanned aerial vehicle real-time image transmission.

title: Task intelligent planning method and system based on large language model and Monte Carlo tree search
description: This invention discloses a task intelligent planning method and system based on a large language model and Monte Carlo tree search. Step 1: Define objects in the environment and obtain the initial belief distribution of all movable items based on the definition. Step 2: Use a large language model L to transform the natural language task objective into a formal objective. Step 3: Based on the initial belief distribution of all movable items, formalize the objective and use the large language model L and Monte Carlo tree search method to obtain the action with the maximum value estimate at the root node. Step 4: The agent performs the action with the maximum value estimate in the environment, updates the observation representation, and repeats Step 3 based on the new observation representation until all action sequences of the formal objective are obtained. This invention significantly improves the flexibility, robustness, and efficiency of task planning.

title: An optimized method and system for the recycling and reuse of power batteries
description: The application relates to a power battery recycling cascade utilization optimization method and system, which comprise the steps of obtaining a multi-dimensional state data set of a target battery, inputting the multi-dimensional state data set into a multi-channel prediction model, enabling the multi-channel prediction model to generate and output a prediction information set, dividing the target battery to corresponding cascade utilization performance levels based on the prediction information set and a preset grading strategy, obtaining real-time market data, respectively executing simulation calculation, generating an optimization scheme corresponding to each cascade utilization performance level based on the result of the simulation calculation by taking the maximum of a batch residual value as a decision target, and finally, realizing accurate evaluation by fusing the multi-dimensional state data to construct a prediction model, executing simulation calculation by combining dynamic market data, and finally generating the optimization scheme taking the maximum of the residual value as the target.

title: Equipment fault diagnosis method, device and equipment based on Internet of things
description: The application discloses a device fault diagnosis method, device and equipment based on the Internet of things, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and ensure the global performance of optimization and the rapidity and the accuracy of convergence by adopting a self-adaptive position exploration strategy, an optimal solution exploration strategy, a self-adaptive tangent exploration strategy and a sinusoidal exploration strategy to automatically optimize, so that the trained fault diagnosis model can be improved in accuracy, robustness and generalization capability, the optimization of the fault diagnosis model is realized, the fault diagnosis is carried out by combining the Internet of things and the optimized fault diagnosis model, the requirements on the professional skills of operation and maintenance personnel are reduced, and meanwhile, the time cost and the computational resource waste caused by manual fault trial are reduced by an automatic process, so that the intelligent diagnosis technology can be widely and economically applied to various industrial scenes.

title: A Multi-Target Defect Detection Method for Precast Components Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
description: The invention discloses a prefabricated part multi-target disease detection method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of performing image acquisition on a prefabricated laminated slab through an image acquisition system; performing multi-target parameter detection on the prefabricated laminated slab image based on YOLOv detection models to obtain detection parameters; acquiring a reference parameter, and performing error analysis on the detection parameter to obtain an analysis result; outputting a multi-target disease detection result of the prefabricated laminated slab according to the analysis result; the invention is used for realizing the multi-target intelligent detection of the non-contact prefabricated component, realizing the simultaneous detection of multiple targets by shooting images, and detecting the number and the size of the concrete bottom plates, detecting the number and the coordinates of the embedded wire boxes and detecting the overhanging reinforcing steel bars with unqualified bending directions by a single image; and the detection time of a single image is less than 40ms, so that the real-time detection requirement of a production line can be met, the labor cost of a prefabricated component factory is reduced, the detection precision is improved, and the detection speed is accelerated.

title: Multi-target detection method and device based on dual-module cascading
description: This invention provides a multi-target detection method and apparatus based on a dual-module cascade. The method includes: an onboard camera capturing an image of a foggy scene to be identified; a defogging module defogging the image and inputting the defogging image into a detection module; the detection module outputting detection results, including the bounding box of the target to be identified, the category of the target, and the confidence level of the category; and an onboard control unit outputting an obstacle avoidance path based on the detection results. This invention offers high detection efficiency and high detection accuracy.

title: Intelligent medical CDSS cross-platform diagnosis support system based on knowledge graph and dynamic reasoning and implementation method
description: The invention discloses a knowledge graph and dynamic reasoning-based intelligent medical CDSS cross-platform diagnosis support system and an implementation method, and relates to the technical fields of intelligent medical treatment, artificial intelligence and knowledge graph. The system comprises a cross-platform data access layer, a medical knowledge graph layer, a dynamic reasoning engine layer, a decision support service layer and a terminal adaptation layer, wherein multi-source medical data are acquired through a multi-protocol interface, a medical knowledge graph containing entities such as diagnosis items and treatment items is constructed, main medical items are determined through entity extraction and association analysis, and then the matching and combination rationality of diagnosis and treatment are checked through dynamic reasoning, so that decision support information is finally output to the multi-terminal. The method comprises the steps of data acquisition standardization, knowledge graph construction and update, medical project extraction association, main project determination, dynamic reasoning verification and cross-platform output. The invention realizes multi-source data integration and cross-terminal adaptation, improves diagnosis accuracy and clinical work standardization, and meets the requirements of multi-scene clinical decisions.

title: A Method and System for RFID Electrical Cabinet Status Monitoring Based on Transfer Learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of electrical equipment state monitoring, and particularly discloses a method and a system for monitoring the state of an RFID (radio frequency identification) electrical cabinet based on transfer learning, wherein an RFID multi-dimensional data acquisition system is constructed to acquire temperature, humidity, vibration, electric field intensity and other data; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing an edge computing gateway and performing feature engineering to form a high-dimensional feature vector, utilizing a pre-trained CNN-LSTM hybrid neural network, adopting a hierarchical migration learning strategy to combine a small sample data fine tuning model in the target field, and realizing state monitoring and fault early warning through the fine tuning model, wherein the early warning is divided into three stages, two stages and more to trigger warning and processing advice. According to the invention, the monitoring precision of a small sample scene is improved by utilizing transfer learning, and the efficient state monitoring and fault early warning of the electric cabinet are realized.

title: Cross-chain protocol generation method and system based on large language model
description: This application relates to a method and system for generating cross-chain protocols based on a large language model. The method includes: acquiring technical data of two heterogeneous blockchains targeted by the cross-chain operation, and constructing chain feature information for each blockchain based on the technical data; inputting the chain feature information and user intent into a trained protocol package generation model, enabling the protocol package generation model to interact with a preset formal verification backend for verification and code repair, resulting in an initial protocol package; the initial protocol package includes smart contract code corresponding to the business logic and a formal proof script; inputting the initial protocol package into a trained security monitoring model to obtain a target protocol package; the target protocol package is a protocol package with added monitoring logic, a built-in circuit breaker, and a security governance contract on top of the initial protocol package. This improves development efficiency, reduces error rates, and enhances security at the formal verification level.

title: Training method and energy optimization method for human-shaped robot energy consumption prediction model
description: This invention discloses a training method and energy optimization method for a humanoid robot energy consumption prediction model. The training method acquires static parameter sample data of the humanoid robot's motors, scene load sample data for several different scene types, and measured energy consumption sample data corresponding to each scene load sample data. Based on the static parameter sample data, feature fusion is performed on all scene load sample data to obtain a fused feature matrix. Matrix feature extraction is performed on the fused feature matrix to obtain feature difference data. Based on the feature difference data and all measured energy consumption sample data, the parameters of the humanoid robot energy consumption prediction model are updated to obtain a trained humanoid robot energy consumption prediction model. The model provided by this training method helps reduce the prediction error of humanoid robot motor energy consumption when predicting energy consumption across scenes, thereby effectively meeting the precise control requirements of subsequent motor energy consumption assessments. This invention relates to the field of intelligent robot technology.

title: Multi-source heterogeneous data fusion method, system, equipment and medium applied to hotel room resources
description: This application discloses a method, system, device, and medium for multi-source heterogeneous data fusion applied to hotel room type resources. Primarily relating to the field of resource processing technology, it addresses the problems of existing solutions relying heavily on hard-coded static mapping rule tables or frequent manual configuration. These solutions are not only costly to implement and maintain but also difficult to adapt to the rapid integration of new suppliers and dynamic changes in data models, lacking scalability and intelligent capabilities. The method includes: when hotel room type resource display information from any hotel supplier is obtained, extracting display triples from the display information; determining the corresponding room type knowledge graph network based on the similarity between the display triples and the corresponding triples in the room type knowledge graph network; obtaining modified data from the room type knowledge graph network; and mapping the modified room type knowledge graph network to a resource display template to obtain standardized resource display information.

title: Privacy protection type distributed optimization method and system based on optimal control
description: This invention discloses a privacy-preserving distributed optimization method and system based on optimal control, relating to the field of privacy protection technology. The method includes: dividing the model parameters of each client into local private components and globally shared components; constructing an optimal control model; at the beginning of each round of communication, the client receives the globally shared components and combines them with the local private components to obtain the current state variables; performing local updates, calculating the gradient and Hessian matrix, correcting the Hessian matrix according to a regularization matrix, and solving for the updated model parameters using the optimal control model; uploading the updated globally shared components to the server so that the server performs aggregation operations to generate a global model, until the termination condition is met. This reconstructs the original least squares problem into a discrete-time optimal control problem, updating model parameters by solving for the optimal control input, and avoiding direct inversion of the Hessian matrix by introducing a control regularization matrix, thus ensuring robustness under singular or ill-conditioned matrix conditions.

title: A Defect Detection Method for Playing Cards Based on YOLO and RESNET
description: This invention discloses a playing card defect detection method based on YOLO and RESNET. It acquires playing card images from multiple angles and with multiple defect types under controlled lighting conditions to construct an original dataset. The data is preprocessed using dynamic enhancement strategies such as noise injection, controlled GAN defect simulation, and lighting condition simulation to generate an anti-interference training dataset, which is then divided into training and testing sets. A hybrid backbone network is designed, replacing the default YOLOv8 backbone with ResNet50, integrating ECA attention mechanism, employing dilated convolution, and globally replacing the activation function, thus combining deep feature extraction capabilities with real-time detection advantages. Based on the Neck multi-scale feature fusion results, target detection is performed using the MMFF module and an optimized loss function. Finally, through model optimization and validation, accurate detection of multiple types of defects in playing cards, such as blurred printing, edge wear, and creases, is achieved. Simultaneously, a lightweight model is obtained through structural optimization, meeting the millisecond-level response requirements of production lines, effectively improving the efficiency and reliability of playing card quality detection.

title: Rib fracture CT image intelligent detection system based on deep learning
description: This invention discloses a deep learning-based intelligent detection system for rib fracture CT images, comprising a rib CT image acquisition module, a tissue adaptive progressive enhancement module, a density threshold dynamic adjustment module, a CT perception loss constraint module, a rib CT image detection model design module, and a rib fracture CT image detection module. This invention belongs to the field of image processing, specifically referring to a deep learning-based intelligent detection system for rib fracture CT images. This solution designs a tissue adaptive progressive enhancement mechanism to gradually strengthen fracture line features and avoid overexposure caused by single strong enhancement; it designs a density threshold dynamic adjustment mechanism to further widen the density difference between minor fractures and cancellous bone; it designs a bone tissue feature enhancement activation function to avoid insufficient response to rib CT features; and it uses a skewed feature balance loss design to address the skewed distribution of rib fracture data; thereby improving the final rib fracture CT image detection effect.

title: Dynamic committee consensus method for decentralization federal learning
description: The invention discloses a dynamic committee consensus method for decentralizing federal learning, which belongs to the technical field of machine learning, and comprises the steps of firstly establishing a node utility function according to node training benefits, consensus benefits and corresponding cost, selecting whether to join a committee according to a utility maximization principle by each node, iterating through scale and rewarding adjustment, strategy updating and member selection stages in a game process until the committee composition meets utility maximization and Nash equilibrium conditions, and after dynamically electing the committee, updating competition of the committee inner nodes through aggregation local model to become a committee leader to obtain block weights and block rewards, evaluating the improvement of global model performance according to the nodes, maximizing the committee utility when guaranteeing the node self benefits, and exciting the node to participate in the federal learning process for a long time, thereby improving the global model training quality and accelerating the federal learning process.

title: Dynamic purchasing plan generating system and method based on performance prediction
description: This invention relates to a dynamic procurement plan generation system and method based on performance forecasting, comprising: a data collection module for collecting and integrating historical sales data, inventory data, market demand data, and supplier delivery data; a performance forecasting module including a forecasting model for demand forecasting based on historical data and selected features; a procurement plan generation module for formulating procurement plans based on the forecast values generated by the performance forecasting module, current inventory status, and preset procurement strategies, including minimum order quantity, maximum inventory level, and supplier delivery dates; a dynamic adjustment module for real-time monitoring of actual sales and inventory; a user interface module for displaying forecast data and procurement plans; and a report generation module for generating reports containing forecast results. This system can effectively integrate and manage complex data, improve the accuracy of demand forecasting, optimize procurement plans, and thus achieve efficient supply chain operations.

title: Lightweight Leak Identification Method, System, Medium, and Equipment for Water Supply Networks Based on Time-Frequency Cross-Domain Feature Alignment
description: This invention relates to the field of water supply network leakage monitoring, and in particular to a lightweight water supply network leakage identification method, system, medium, and device based on time-frequency cross-domain feature alignment. The method includes: acquiring unlabeled raw acoustic monitoring data of the water supply network; constructing a time-domain waveform view and a frequency-domain spectrum view for each segment of raw acoustic monitoring data; constructing a heterogeneous dual-path pre-trained network containing a time-domain encoder and a frequency-domain encoder; inputting the time-domain waveform view and the frequency-domain spectrum view into the corresponding encoders; performing self-supervised pre-training using a cross-domain alignment loss function to force the time-domain encoder to learn the frequency-domain distribution characteristics of the signal; after pre-training, decoupling the heterogeneous dual-path pre-trained network, retaining only the time-domain encoder as the backbone network, constructing the final leakage identification model; using a small number of labeled samples to perform supervised fine-tuning of the leakage identification model; and deploying the fine-tuned model on a monitoring terminal for water supply network leakage identification.

title: A deployment and inference system and method for a multimodal large model
description: This invention relates to a deployment and inference system and method for a multimodal large model. The deployment and inference system includes: a first namespace used to obtain corresponding microservice orchestration code and model runtime data based on received external requests; to call multiple functional modules based on the microservice orchestration code to form a multimodal large model; and to perform inference based on the model runtime data to obtain model output results; a second namespace used to store the microservice orchestration code, which includes the execution order and dependencies of each functional module; a third namespace used to store the functional modules; and a fourth namespace used to store the model runtime data and parameters of each functional module. This invention can improve the efficiency, reusability, and scalability of model deployment, and accelerate model inference speed.

title: Digital text creation product design system integrating Yimeng red elements
description: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and discloses a digital text-created product design system fusing Yimeng red elements, which comprises a red element acquisition module, a digital design module, a user interaction module, a product generation module and a central control module, wherein a culture evaluation unit is integrated in the system, a culture resource is structured by a multi-source data acquisition technology of the red element acquisition module, a standardized red element database is constructed, the comprehensiveness and the accuracy of design materials are ensured, and meanwhile, an artificial intelligence generation algorithm of the digital design module and a virtual realization technology are utilized to automatically generate a fusion scheme, so that creative fusion of the red culture elements and modern designs is realized, the cultural connotation and innovation of the text-created product design are ensured, and the design efficiency and quality are improved.

title: Hemorrhagic stroke microwave image classification method based on multi-input neural network
description: This invention belongs to the field of medical imaging technology and relates to a microwave image classification method for hemorrhagic stroke based on a multi-input neural network. The method includes: acquiring microwave brain images and corresponding time-domain waveform data; inputting the microwave brain images and time-domain waveform data into an image classification model to obtain hemorrhagic stroke classification results; the image classification model is obtained by training a multi-input neural network using a training set, and a weighted cross-entropy loss function is introduced during the training process; the image classification model employs a dual-channel feature extraction network architecture to extract image features and time-domain waveform features from the microwave brain images and time-domain waveform data respectively, and uses channel-dimensional concatenation to obtain the hemorrhagic stroke classification results. This invention achieves multimodal data feature extraction through a multi-input neural network architecture, utilizes residual connections to ensure network training stability, and combines long short-term memory networks to model waveform temporal features, effectively improving the classification ability for hemorrhagic stroke.

title: Methods, devices, computer equipment, and storage media for processing cross-border emails
description: This application relates to the field of information processing technology, and discloses a method, apparatus, computer equipment, and storage medium for processing cross-border emails. The method includes: acquiring the email text from a cross-border supplier; querying a supply chain domain dictionary associated with the supplier; segmenting the email text based on the dictionary to obtain a segmentation sequence; performing multi-level semantic recognition on the segmentation sequence to obtain semantic recognition results; correcting the results to generate structured email semantic information; acquiring the first language type of the email text and the second language type used by the recipient; and inputting the email semantic information into a pre-trained large language model to generate a draft email reply in the first language type and a supply chain early warning report in the second language type. This application can accurately understand the semantics of cross-border business emails, significantly reduce ambiguity, and automatically generate replies and reports, greatly improving processing efficiency and the accuracy of cross-language communication.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and computer program product
description: This invention provides an information processing apparatus, an information processing method, and a computer program product. An information processing apparatus (10) is provided capable of generating a high-speed inference neural network including a Transformer. The information processing apparatus (10) includes: an NN input unit (11) that acquires a neural network including a Transformer; a judgment unit (12) that determines whether one or more parameters used in the neural network satisfy predetermined conditions; and a correction unit (13) that, when it is determined that one or more parameters do not satisfy predetermined conditions, corrects the one or more parameters so that the one or more parameters satisfy the predetermined conditions.

title: Adaptive interaction using an adaptive agent-oriented software architecture
description: The method for handling topic messages and the agent network structure, where each agent has its own concept of responsibility. An initiator agent that receives a user input request but does not itself have a corresponding interpretation strategy queries its downlink agents: whether the queried agent considers such a message to be within its responsibility. Each queried agent recursively determines whether it has its own interpretation strategy applicable to the request; if not, it further queries its next-next-downlink neighbor agents. The next-next agent eventually responds to this further query, thus allowing the first queried agent to respond to the initiator agent. This recursive process ultimately determines one or more paths through the network from the initiator agent to one or more branch agents. The request is then passed down the path, with each agent along the path taking any local action and passing the message to the next agent on that path. If a contradiction arises, the network is often able to resolve such contradictions according to a predetermined algorithm; if it cannot resolve a contradiction automatically, it learns the new interpretation strategy necessary to correctly interpret the topic message. This learning preferably includes interaction with the user (but only to the required extent) and preferably restricts this learning to approaching the correct branch agent location in the network.

title: Motion classification model learning device, motion classification device, motion classification model learning method, program
description: Provided is a model learning device for motion classification that learns a model for early recognition of motion. A teacher data acquisition unit that acquires teacher data consisting of a pair of motion video information that can be classified into any of a plurality of categories according to the characteristics of the motion and category information that is a correct answer label corresponding to the video information. Includes a motion history image generation unit that generates a motion history image of video information, and a model learning unit that learns a model that inputs a motion history image and outputs a label that is category information.

title: Patent text generator, patent text generator, and patent text generator
description: Provided are a patent text generator, a patent text generation method, and a patent text generation program capable of keeping the quality of the generated patent application specification constant.  The patent text generator accepts new claims and a learning unit that learns the correspondence between claims of a patent document, descriptions other than the claims of the document, and descriptions of the prior art documents associated with the patent document. It includes a reception unit and a generation unit that generates sentences other than the new claim corresponding to the new claim based on the learning result by the learning unit and the new claim received by the reception unit.

title: Risk address identification method and apparatus, and electronic device
description: The embodiments of the specification disclose a risk address identification method and apparatus, and an electronic device. The risk address identification method comprises: after obtaining a corresponding address word sequence according to an input address, performing risk identification on the input address using a hidden Markov model and a support vector machine model according to a hit address word in the address word sequence and the semantics before and after it.   FIG.2

title: Protection system including machine learning snapshot evaluation
description: The present disclosure relates to a protection system including machine learning snapshot evaluation. The device may include a machine learning engine (MLE) for generating snapshots of device operation. MLE can use active or scheduled actions in snapshots to learn user behavior. Once normal user behavior is established for a device, the MLE may be able to determine when a snapshot includes unusual behavior that may indicate a threat to the device. Snapshots determined to include unusual behavior can be transmitted to a remote resource for evaluation. The remote resource may include at least a User Behavior Classification Engine (UBCE) for classifying user behavior by characterizing user behavior into at least one usage type. The snapshot can be analyzed by UBCE to determine whether a potential threat is present in the device, and the threat analysis can be provided to the device for evaluation and/or corrective action.

title: Systems and methods for intelligent and interpretive analysis of sensor data and generating spatial intelligence using machine learning
description: Systems and methods for augmenting real-time semantic information to a spatial rendering of a predefined space and providing a real-time situational awareness feed.

title: Predictive alerts for individual risk of injury with ameliorative actions
description: Methods and systems for predicting injury risk include generating state sequences that precede a hazard event based on information regarding a user's state. A cognitive suite of workplace hygiene and injury predictors (WHIP) is generated based on the state sequences using a processor, wherein the cognitive WHIP predicts a degree of risk correlated with each particular user state sequence. A risk heat map of a workplace is generated based on the cognitive WHIP that encodes regions of greater and lesser risk. An ameliorative action is triggered when a user moves into an area of high risk based on the heat map.

title: Adaptive, performance-oriented, and compression-assisted encryption scheme
description: An approach for an adaptive, performance-oriented, and compression-assisted encryption scheme implemented on a host computer to adaptively improve utilization of CPU resources is provided. The method comprises queueing a new data packet and determining a size of the new data packet. Based on historical data, a plurality of already encrypted data packets is determined. Based on information stored for the plurality of already encrypted data packets, an average ratio of compression for the plurality of already encrypted data packets is determined. Based on the average ratio of compression, a throughput of compression value and a throughput of encryption value, a prediction whether compressing the new data packet will reduce a CPU load is derived. If it is determined that compressing the new data packet will improve utilization of the CPU resources, then a compressed new data packet is generated by compressing the new data packet.

title: System and method providing automatic completion of task structures in a project plan
description: Systems, methods, and other embodiments are disclosed that are configured to automatically complete the generation of task structures in a project plan. In one embodiment, user data is generated by monitoring interactions of a user with a computer user interface when forming a task structure in a project plan. The user data is compared to learned behavior data. The learned behavior data represents reusable patterns derived from information associated with user creation of previous task structures. If, based on the comparison, the user data matches a reusable pattern of the learned behavior data, a prompt is displayed to the user indicating an option to accept or reject automated completion of the task structure. In response to receiving an acceptance from the user, the forming of the task structure is automatically completed in the project plan based on the matching reusable pattern.

title: Coupled multi-task fully convolutional networks using multi-scale contextual information and hierarchical hyper-features for semantic image segmentation
description: Techniques related to implementing fully convolutional networks for semantic image segmentation are discussed. Such techniques may include combining feature maps from multiple stages of a multi-stage fully convolutional network to generate a hyper-feature corresponding to an input image, up-sampling the hyper-feature and summing it with a feature map of a previous stage to provide a final set of features, and classifying the final set of features to provide semantic image segmentation of the input image.

title: Concept indexing among database of documents using machine learning techniques
description: Systems and techniques for indexing and/or querying a database are described herein. Discrete sections and/or segments from documents may be determined by a concept indexing system. The segments may be indexed by concept and/or higher-level category of interest to a user. A user may query the segments by one or more concepts. The segments may be analyzed to rank the segments by statistical accuracy and/or relatedness to one or more particular concepts. The rankings may be used for presentation of search results in a user interface. Furthermore, segments and/or documents may be ranked based on recency decay functions that distinguish between segments that maintain their relevance over time in contrast with temporal segments whose relevance decays quicker over time, for example.

title: Estimating object properties using visual image data
description: A system is comprised of one or more processors coupled to memory. The one or more processors are configured to receive image data based on an image captured using a camera of a vehicle and to utilize the image data as a basis of an input to a trained machine learning model to at least in part identify a distance of an object from the vehicle. The trained machine learning model has been trained using a training image and a correlated output of an emitting distance sensor.

title: Contaminated soil purification method
description: A contaminated soil purification system for decomposing a contaminant in contaminated soil E. The contaminated soil purification system includes: injecting, into contaminated soil through a water injection well, an injection liquid containing a purification agent to decompose a contaminant or an activator to stimulate biological decomposition by the purification agent; a process of measuring a concentration of the purification agent or the activator in groundwater in an observation well or in a pumping well, the observation well or the pumping well being provided at a location spaced apart from the water injection well; and a process of, based on the concentration that has been measured, automatically controlling an addition amount of the purification agent or the activator to the injection liquid or automatically controlling a pumping amount of water from the pumping well.

title: Methods and systems for 3D ball trajectory reconstruction
description: Methods and systems for 3D ball trajectory reconstruction are disclosed. The methods and systems perform steps of receiving a 2D ball trajectory, a shooter's on-ground foot location, and a camera projection matrix; generating on-ground trajectory line assumptions based on the shooter's on-ground foot location and the 2D trajectory; reconstructing a candidate 3D trajectory for each on-ground trajectory line assumption, by determining a ball height for each on-ground projection point in the on-ground trajectory line and by curve fitting; evaluating each candidate 3D trajectory and selecting one with a best score as the reconstructed 3D ball trajectory. Embodiments of the present invention enable a resource-limited mobile device such as a smartphone to conduct the aforementioned steps. Also disclosed are benefits of the new methods, and alternative embodiments of implementation.

title: Using machine learning to detect which part of the screen includes embedded frames of an uploaded video
description: A system and methods are disclosed for using a trained machine learning model to identify constituent images within composite images. A method may include providing pixel data of a first image as input to the trained machine learning model, obtaining one or more outputs from the trained machine learning model, and extracting, from the one or more outputs, a level of confidence that (i) the first image is a composite image that includes a constituent image, and (ii) at least a portion of the constituent image is in a particular spatial area of the first image.

title: Dynamic text generation for social media posts
description: Utilizing a computing device to share a social media post with automatically generated dynamic text in a social media service in real time. A computing device receives a social media post from a social media user computer. The computing device monitors social media activities of a social media user computer. The computing device accesses one or more social media activities of social media follower computers. The computing device compares social media activities of the social media user computer with the one or more social media activities of social media follower computers. The computing device aligns the received social media post to a preference model. The computing device generates dynamic text in real time to accompany the received social media post. The computing device outputs the generated dynamic text to the social media user computer to accompany the received social media post.

title: Battery-based neural network weights
description: A controllable resistive element and methods for controlling the resistance of the same include a resistor layer formed in contact with a shared read/write electrode and a read electrode, the resistor layer having a resistivity that depends on a concentration of charge carrier ions. An electrolyte layer is formed on the resistor layer. A reservoir layer is formed on the electrolyte layer and in contact with a write electrode.

title: Determining exploit prevention using machine learning
description: Examples of the present disclosure describe systems and methods for determining exploit prevention software settings using machine learning. In aspects, exploit prevention software may be used to identify processes executing on a computing device. Metadata for the identified processes may be determined and transmitted to a machine learning system. The machine learning system may use an exploit prevention model to determine exploit prevention configuration settings for each of the processes, and may transmit the configuration setting to the computing device. The computing device may implement the configuration settings to protect the processes and monitor the stability of the protected processes as they execute. The computing device may transmit the stability data to the machine-learning system. The machine-learning system may then modify the exploit prevention model based on the stability data.

title: Systems and methods for implementing an intelligent application program interface for an intelligent optimization platform
description: Systems and methods for implementing an application programming interface (API) that controls operations of a machine learning tuning service for tuning a machine learning model for improved accuracy and computational performance includes an API that is in control communication the tuning service that: executes a first API call function that includes an optimization work request that sets tuning parameters for tuning hyperparameters of a machine learning model; and initializes an operation of distinct tuning worker instances of the service that each execute distinct tuning tasks for tuning the hyperparameters; executes a second API call function that identifies raw values for the hyperparameters; and generates suggestions comprising proposed hyperparameter values selected from the plurality of raw values for each of the hyperparameters; and executes a third API call function that returns performance metrics relating to a real-world performance of the subscriber machine learning model executed with the proposed hyperparameter values.

title: Methods and systems for converting weights of a deep neural network from a first number format to a second number format
description: Methods and system for converting a plurality of weights of a filter of a Deep Neural Network (DNN) in a first number format to a second number format, the second number format having less precision than the first number format, to enable the DNN to be implemented in hardware logic. The method comprising: determining, for each of the plurality of weights, a quantisation error associated with quantising that weight to the second number format in accordance with a first quantisation method; determining a total quantisation error for the plurality of weights based on the quantisation errors for the plurality of weights; identifying a subset of the plurality of weights to be quantised to the second number format in accordance with a second quantisation method based on the total quantisation error for the plurality of weights; and generating a set of quantised weights representing the plurality of weights in the second number format, the quantised weight for each weight in the subset of the plurality of weights based on quantising that weight to the second number format in accordance with the second quantisation method and the quantised weight for each of the remaining weights of the plurality of weights based on quantising that weight to the second number format in accordance with the first quantisation method.

title: Component based review system
description: A component-based review system for generating a digital recommendation is provided. A computing device monitors for one or more consumer-based reviews. A computing device identifies one or more commercial products or services associated with the one or more consumer-based reviews. A computing device generates a digital recommendation associated with the one or more consumer-based reviews.

title: System and method for automated analysis of ground truth using confidence model to prioritize correction options
description: A method, system and computer-usable medium are disclosed for automated analysis of ground truth using confidence model to prioritize correction options. In certain embodiments, the ground truth data is analyzed to identify review-candidates. A confidence level may be assigned to each of the identified review-candidates and the review-candidates are prioritized, at least in part, using the assigned confidence levels. The review-candidates are electronically presented in prioritized order to solicit verification or correction feedback for updating the ground truth data.

title: Vehicular driving actions in the presence of non-recurrent events
description: Embodiments for planning vehicular driving actions in the presence of non-recurrent events by a processor. One or more dynamics of non-recurrent events in a transport network may be learned according to one or more contextual factors. One or more vehicle-specific factors may be learned in relation to a historical journey and current journey of a vehicle.
