description: A video chaotic encryption method based on a quantum cell neural network relates to the technical field of video encryption, solves the problems of low encryption speed, damage to a video coding format, poor video transmission real-time performance, poor safety and the like of the existing encryption method, and generates a matrix A by performing iterative solution on a two-cell quantum cell neural network hyperchaotic system; performing matrix transformation on the A to generate a chaotic sequence K and an Index sequence Index; splitting the chaotic sequence K to generate an initial key pool; respectively taking elements in the Index sequence Index as initial values of Logistic chaotic mapping, performing iteration, generating two chaotic Index sequences, and transforming to obtain two integer sequences; respectively serving as indexes and substituting the indexes into an initial key pool, and calculating to generate a Boolean key KeyB; its keyb1 and keyb 2; the key keyb1 encrypts the exponential golomb encoding information bits of h.264; and (3) encrypting the encoded data of the H.264 by using keyb2 as a key to realize the video chaotic encryption of the quantum cell neural network.

title: Technology for Enhanced User Authentication Using Advanced Sensor Monitoring
description: Technologies for information security include computing devices having one or more sensors. The computing device can authenticate a user and, after successful authentication, analyze sensor data to determine whether the user might be forced to authenticate. If so, the computing device performs security operations, such as generating an alert or presenting the user with false but seemingly believable data. Alternatively or additionally, within a trusted execution environment, the computing device can monitor sensor data and apply a machine learning classifier to the sensor data to identify an increased risk of malicious attacks. For example, the classifier can identify potential user identification fraud. If an increased attack risk is detected, the computing device can trigger a security response. For example, the trusted execution environment can trigger increased authentication requirements or increased anti-theft monitoring for the computing device. Other embodiments are described and claimed.

title: Image recognition method and device
description: The invention discloses a kind of image identification method and device, belong to image identification technical field.Methods described includes：Obtain picture to be identified；The SHNN models trained are obtained, SHNN is obtained by multiple HNN model aggregations trained；According to the SHNN models trained, picture to be identified is identified, obtain the class probability vector of picture to be identified, class probability vector belongs to the class probability of every kind of classification including picture to be identified, the class probability of every kind of classification is the average value of the element on every dimension of multiple reference category probability vectors, and multiple reference category probability vectors are obtained by multiple HNN models to picture recognition to be identified；According to class probability vector, the classification of picture to be identified is determined.Because picture to be identified is identified using the SHNN models trained by the present invention, and the SHNN models that this has been trained are obtained by multiple HNN model aggregations trained, therefore, accuracy of identification can not only be ensured, and significantly shorten the time that identification process is consumed.

title: Automatic targeting method, device and electronic equipment in radiotherapy planning
description: The embodiment of the present invention discloses an automatic targeting method, device and electronic equipment in radiotherapy planning, wherein the method includes: receiving an input image, identifying the input image through a pre-stored list of ROI regions of interest, and obtaining the Input the suspected region in the image, outline the suspected region in the input image; include at least one organ image in the input image; save a plurality of images of known regions of interest in the region of interest list; The input image of the delineated suspected area is input into the pre-trained fully convolutional neural network, and the delineated image of at least one interested area is output. In the radiotherapy planning system of the embodiment of the present invention, before making a plan for the patient, the organs at risk and the irradiation target area are automatically outlined in the positioning image of the patient, which reduces a lot of manual operations by doctors and physicists, and has a very high value in the radiotherapy department. application value.

title: Method and system for automatically answering plane geometry proof questions
description: The invention discloses a kind of Proving Plane Geometry to inscribe automatic answer method and system, and wherein method comprises the following steps：Topic inputs；Topic understands, the Proving Plane Geometry topic text identified is segmented and part-of-speech tagging, and topic is divided into n simple subordinate sentences, and subordinate sentence is standardized；Mark out all geometry entity words in subordinate sentence；Each geometric element vocabulary is shown as two tuples, while each geometrical relationship word is also illustrated that into two tuples；Geometrical relationship is extracted using syntactic-semantic model, all geometrical relationships form a first geometric proposition set；Machine is solved, and first geometric proposition set is made inferences, obtains the geometry chain of evidence of topic；Class people answers generation, according to chain of evidence, is constantly searched by forward chaining by the known condition provided, conclusion is arrived until deriving, so as to generate the expression of class people.The present invention can greatly improve the automaticity of answer system compared to current existing Proving Plane Geometry system.

title: A multi-view gait classification method based on multiple regression
description: The invention discloses a multi-view gait classification method based on multiple regression, which includes the following steps: step 1, extracting human body contours from the gait data set to be classified, constructing two kinds of human body region images represented by interior points and boundaries, and Further generate the hub energy map; Step 2, based on the hub energy map in the previous step, calculate the multi-period mixed gait energy matrix corresponding to each gait image sequence as the gait feature; Step 3, convert the multi-view gait classification into a Multivariate regression problem, and construct a convolutional neural network to solve it. The multi-view gait classification method based on multiple regression of the present invention uses a multi-period mixed gait energy matrix as a gait feature, does not need accurate gait cycle segmentation, and reduces the dependence on gait cycle segmentation. At the same time, the present invention transforms the multi-view gait classification problem into a multiple regression problem, and solves it through a convolutional neural network, thereby improving the correct rate of gait classification.

title: System and method for fault-tolerant prediction of short-term passenger flow in urban rail transit
description: The present invention proposes a kind of urban track traffic fault-tolerant forecasting system of passenger flow and method in short-term, wherein, system includes 3 neural network modules, prediction fault detection module, screening module and fault-tolerant processing module；The method have the benefit that：Proposing a kind of urban track traffic, the fault-tolerant forecasting system of passenger flow and method, this technology can effectively improve the stability of a system and fault-tolerant ability in short-term, make prediction result more accurate.

title: Risk identification model construction and risk identification method, device and equipment
description: Disclose a kind of risk identification model construction and Risk Identification Method, device and equipment.The Risk Identification Method includes：User Status record of the targeted customer in given duration is obtained, the User Status record includes：The operation behavior and/or system event of user；User Status record is ranked up according to time of origin, User Status sequence is generated according to ranking results；The User Status sequence generated is converted into sequence signature；Input using the sequence signature as the risk identification model built in advance, export risk identification result.

title: Analysis device and analysis system
description: The operational part (50) of resolver (23) is in production equipment (1) operating, fallout predictor (A-C) is used using 1 or more selected from multiple fallout predictors (A-H), it is carried out in real time in relation to good and bad main prediction operation, when not carrying out main prediction operation, use the preparation fallout predictor (D-H) of 1 or more do not selected from multiple fallout predictors (A-H), it carries out in relation to good and bad secondary prediction operation, and the precision of prediction (QD-QH) based on the precision of prediction (QA-QC) using fallout predictor (A-C) and preparation fallout predictor (D-H), replacement to carry out using fallout predictor (A-C) and preparation fallout predictor (D-H) is handled.

title: A Chinese word segmentation method based on seq2seq model
description: The invention discloses a kind of Chinese word cutting methods based on seq2seq models, including：Step 1 pre-processes corpus of text, and the word in each sentence of input is just switched to Chinese-character digital sequence, and the position according to word in word according to word frequency, is converted into corresponding sequence label；The Chinese-character digital sequence obtained in step 1 is input to by sentence in word vector conversion coating, output word vector matrix by step 2；Step 3, the word vector matrix for obtaining step 2 carry out piecemeal using mini batch, are input in the seq2seq models using attention mechanism, obtain prediction label sequence；Step 4, sequence post-processing, the prediction label sequence in step 3 is compared with the sequence label of urtext language material, by the sentence after the final participle of meaning synthesis of each label, is opened by space-separated.The method uses seq2seq deep learning frames, in conjunction with attention mechanism in Chinese word segmentation task, effectively increasing the accuracy rate of participle.

title: Diabetic retinal image classification method and system based on deep learning
description: A kind of diabetic retina image classification method and system of the field of artificial intelligence based on deep learning, including：Obtain eye fundus image；Same eye fundus image is imported in microaneurysm lesion identification model, bleeding lesion identification model and exudation lesion identification model and is identified；Lesion characteristics information is extracted according to recognition result, then is classified to the lesion characteristics information of extraction using housebroken SVM classifier, classification results are obtained；Microaneurysm lesion identification model inputs CNN models by microaneurysm lesion candidate region in extraction eye fundus image and is trained to obtain again；Bleeding lesion identification model, exudation lesion identification model are respectively by being labeled to bleeding lesion region, exudation lesion region in eye fundus image, then inputting FCN models and be trained to obtain.Present invention reduces the requirements to network model descriptive power so that model is easy training, and can carry out positioning to lesion stove region for different lesions and delineate, and doctor is facilitated to carry out Clinical screening.

title: An intelligent electric vehicle longitudinal motion control system and method
description: A kind of intelligent electric automobile longitudinal movement control system and method, are related to automatic driving.Control system is equipped with velocity sensor, the 1st filter, it is expected acceleration planning module, fuzzy neural network model reference adaptive acceleration tracing control module, intelligent electric automobile, acceleration transducer and the 2nd filter.Control method：The reference model of design characterization intelligent electric automobile longitudinal direction behavioural characteristic, makes reference model have phase same order with object；The fuzzy optimal feedback controller of intelligent electric automobile longitudinal movement based on particle group optimizing is designed, task is to determine the desired control torque of motor according to fuzzy optimal feedback control strategy according to desired acceleration；The BP neural network identifier for designing intelligent electric automobile longitudinal movement, so as to the acceleration of dynamical output prediction.It has fully considered the characteristics such as the non-linear of intelligent electric automobile longitudinal dynamics system, time-varying and uncertainty, has effectively enhanced the robustness of longitudinal movement control system.

title: Question-answering system implementation method based on deep learning and topic model
description: The invention discloses a method for realizing a question-answering system based on deep learning and a topic model, which comprises the following steps: s1, inputting the question into a Twitter LDA topic model to obtain the topic type of the question, extracting corresponding subject words, and expressing the input question and the subject words as word vectors; s2, inputting the word vector of the input question into RNN recurrent neural network coding to obtain a coding hidden layer state vector of the question; s3, decoding the RNN recurrent neural network by using a joint attention mechanism and combining local and global mixed semantic vectors of the question to generate words; s4, training a deep learning topic question-answer model based on a coding and decoding framework by using large-scale dialogue corpus; and S5, predicting answers of the input question by using the trained question-answer model, and generating answers related to the subject of the question. The invention makes up the deficiency of the exogenous knowledge of the question-answering model and increases the richness and diversity of answers.

title: Building safety detection method based on correlation analysis
description: The invention discloses a building safety detection method based on correlation analysis, comprising: step 1, collecting vibration data frames, pressure data frames, temperature data frames, and humidity data frames of the building through sensors, and analyzing the transmitted data frames Carry out signal feature extraction; step 2, according to the characteristic data extracted in step 1, obtain fitting formula to calculate the safety factor of building; Step 3, combine the safety factor obtained in step 2 with building structure parameters and building materials The performance parameters are input into the fuzzy controller to obtain the comprehensive evaluation coefficient of the building; the comprehensive evaluation coefficient in step 4 and step 3 determines the corresponding safety level of the building through the correlation analysis method, that is, the data relationship between the building detection data and the building safety level is obtained Model; step 5, using the data relationship model obtained in step 3 to predict and analyze the safety level of the building, which can be used to evaluate the safety level of the building and provide decision support for building safety.

title: A Fast Optimization Method for Decoding Parameters of Polar Codes
description: The present invention provides a method for quickly optimizing decoding parameters of polar codes. The method first starts with collecting and sorting out sample data; then uses the characteristics and size of the sample data as a basis for modeling, and uses supervised learning and stochastic gradients Optimize the method to train the network; then input the likelihood ratio calculated by the received signal into the trained radial basis function neural network model, and output M; finally initialize L to M, and execute the serial offset list decoding algorithm . The method combines radial basis function neural network technology with polar code decoding technology to avoid unnecessary calculation operations, thereby greatly reducing the decoding complexity of polar codes.

title: Word vector processing method and device
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a word vector processing method and device. The method comprises the following steps: segmenting the corpus into words to obtain each word; determining each n-gram phonetic notation character corresponding to each word, wherein the n-gram phonetic notation characters represent continuous n phonetic notation characters of the corresponding word; establishing and initializing word vectors of the words and phonetic notation character vectors of the n-element phonetic notation characters corresponding to the words; and training the word vectors and the phonetic notation character vectors according to the word vectors, the phonetic notation character vectors and the linguistic data after word segmentation. By utilizing the embodiment of the application, the characteristics of the word can be more finely expressed through the n-element phonetic notation character corresponding to the word, so that the accuracy of the word vector of the Chinese word is favorably improved, and the practical effect is better.

title: A multi-attention mechanism video description method based on spatio-temporal and channel
description: The invention discloses a multi-attention mechanism video description method based on space-time and channels, which extracts video features from the video through a CNN network, and then calculates the video features and the output of the encoding at the previous moment based on the multi-attention network, thereby obtaining The attention weights of video features in the time domain, space domain, and channel, and then calculate the three sets of weights with the video features again to obtain the fused features, so that we can get more effective video features, and finally encode the fused feature lines output, resulting in a description that is more consistent with the video content.

title: A population prediction method based on multi-source big data and long short-term memory neural network model
description: The invention discloses a population number prediction method, which includes the following steps: (1) Obtaining data related to the number of population activities in a predetermined time period in a predetermined space unit, the data includes mobile phone signaling data, meteorological data and other possible data. (2) Clean the cell phone signaling data obtained in step (1) to obtain fine data; (3) Perform spatial matching and fusion of multi-source heterogeneous big data, which will affect the spatial distribution of population activities The data of other influencing factors are matched with the cleaned mobile phone signaling big data in step (2) to unify the data caliber; (4) use the data import model to predict the population; (5) output the results of population number and spatial distribution.

title: Image feature extraction method, apparatus, device and readable storage medium
description: The invention discloses an image feature extraction method, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing an input image to be recognized to obtain an input characteristic diagram; setting parameters of nodes in the convolutional node network on chip according to node coefficients acquired in advance; splitting and packaging the input characteristic diagram data to obtain a communication data frame; sequentially sending the communication data frames to each node in a network on a convolutional node chip according to the corresponding node flow sequence for data processing to obtain output data; recombining the output data of each data frame to obtain the output data of the characteristic diagram; and performing feature classification according to the feature map output data. According to the method, the extracted feature map data is divided into a plurality of data blocks, and data transmission processing is performed in a routing mode, so that the data transmission efficiency can be improved, the operation time of convolution data is reduced, and the image identification efficiency is improved; the invention also discloses an image feature extraction device, equipment and a readable storage medium, which have the beneficial effects.

title: Detection and correction method of radio frequency interference in low frequency channel of spaceborne microwave sensor
description: The invention discloses a method for detecting and correcting radio frequency interference of a low-frequency channel of a satellite-borne microwave sensor, which solves the problem that the existing method has high requirement on the consistency of the ground surface of a processing area. A method for detecting and correcting radio frequency interference of a low-frequency channel of a satellite-borne microwave sensor comprises the following steps: establishing a training sample set according to high-frequency channel and low-frequency channel brightness and temperature historical values in historical observation data of the satellite-borne microwave sensor, and determining the relation between the low-frequency channel and the high-frequency channel brightness and temperature historical values by adopting a machine learning algorithm to obtain a training model; inputting the high-frequency channel brightness temperature observation value into the training model to obtain a low-frequency channel brightness temperature simulation value; and performing difference operation on the low-frequency channel brightness temperature observation value and the low-frequency channel brightness temperature analog value to obtain a radio frequency interference index. The invention realizes accurate detection of the radio frequency interference in a large area.

title: An image denoising method based on deep learning and multi-scale image enhancement
description: The invention relates to an image denoising method based on deep learning and multi-scale image enhancement, comprising: performing multi-scale image information enhancement on an original image to be processed to obtain an enhanced image; The enhanced image is processed to obtain a denoised image. The image denoising method increases the preprocessing process of multi-scale enhancement information, improves the contrast between image pixels, the gray level of the image becomes balanced, and the gray level range of the image becomes wider, so that important details of the image can be obtained. and texture, and input the enhanced image into the subsequent convolutional neural network model, which can enhance the visual effect of the denoised image.

title: A Neural Network Based Malicious Network Behavior Recognition Method
description: The present invention relates to a neural network-based network malicious behavior identification method. The method includes the following steps: Step 1: training normal domain names and dynamic domain names to form training data; Step 2: obtaining network data packets; Step 3: according to the data filter Set filtering data and set merging; Step 4: Perform feature pre-extraction on protocol data; Step 5: Mark the obtained vectors; Step 6: Generate LSTM neural network weight and bias description files. This technical solution provides analysis basis, methods and tools for better discovering network security problems and detecting various means of evasion, especially providing a powerful solution for dynamic domain name requests and subsequent behavior screening.

title: A kind of transmission line of electricity on-line monitoring equipment method for diagnosing faults
description: The invention discloses a kind of transmission line of electricity on-line monitoring equipment method for diagnosing faults, include following steps: (1) obtaining the fault code that on-line monitoring equipment uploads；(2) data processing is carried out using fault code of the 3 δ criterion to acquisition, retains the fault code for belonging to random error, rejecting includes the fault code of gross error;(3) it is encoded using the fault code that V system previous step obtains, to obtain the characteristic value about this group of fault code, and fault information database is established according to the characteristic value extracted;(4) the self study training of neural network, prediction trend are carried out to the fault message that previous step obtains；(5) the V system features value for comparing prediction data, provides diagnostic result;The present invention, which is realized, carries out multiple data processing and Precise Diagnosis to the fault data that on-line monitoring equipment uploads, upper flexible and changeable in control, finds fault point in time convenient for monitoring personnel and safeguards, improves the efficiency of maintenance work.

title: A tree species identification method based on transfer learning
description: The wood recognition method based on transfer learning that the invention discloses a kind of, comprising the following steps: S1 collects Tree image, makes tree species image data set；S2 carries out data enhancing to raw data set image, to expand the quantity of picture；S3 obtains more than one pre-training models based on convolutional neural networks trained on large-scale image data set, S4 is trained pre-training model with tree species image data set, optimize one or several full articulamentums in pre-training model in the training process, to train multiple classifiers based on convolutional neural networks；The accuracy rate for testing each classifier selects accuracy rate highest classifier；S5 carries out wood recognition with the classifier that step S4 is selected, to obtain the result of identification.The present invention is based on the modes of transfer learning to identify to tree species, so that can also train the good model of generalization ability in the limited situation of tree species sample size, and substantially increases the wood recognition rate under complex background.

title: Method and system for intelligent ladder patch distribution
description: A method for delivering intelligent ladder subsidy includes constructing user feature vector according to consumption data of user, processing user feature based on multi-dimensional feature dynamic encoder to obtain optimized feature data, adopting dynamic game-reinforcement learning frame to optimize subsidy strategy through interaction of enterprise agent and user group agent, carrying out data collaboration through federal learning technology, training abnormal detection model across mechanism, detecting malicious benefit of user based on countermeasure training, regulating subsidy delivery, dynamically regulating subsidy amount based on self-adaptive ladder subsidy calculation mechanism, calculating final subsidy amount based on user behavior feature and history record, and executing subsidy delivery automatically through intelligent contract. The application not only realizes the fine management of subsidy resources, but also ensures the strategy flexibility and the long-term excitation effect.

title: MiniGPT-4 large visual language model-oriented unsupervised detection method for surface defects of inner cavity of cylinder cover of automobile
description: The invention discloses a MiniGPT-4-oriented unsupervised detection method for surface defects of an inner cavity of an automobile cylinder cover, which comprises the steps of constructing a parameterized imaging model of the inner cavity surface of the automobile cylinder cover, collecting normal images, constructing an image dataset, generating an abnormal image from the normal images to form the dataset, collecting image features of the dataset, extracting features through a multiscale local neighborhood aggregation method and a mutual scoring mechanism, establishing an unsupervised detection model of the inner cavity surface of the automobile cylinder cover, comprising an image encoder, an image decoder, an image-text matching module, a prompt learner, a geometric information learner and a large language model, inputting images into the image encoder, the image decoder, the image-text matching module, the prompt learner, the geometric information learner and the large language model, and determining mask images of detected images, defect attributes and geometric information. The invention has great practical engineering application value for controlling the quality of products in complex manufacturing scenes and improving the defect detection efficiency and accuracy.

title: A robot control method, device, and medium based on human demonstration and guidance
description: This invention belongs to the fields of robotics and computer vision, and discloses a robot control method, device, and medium based on human demonstration guidance. First, a human demonstration video corresponding to the task to be performed by the robot is acquired. Then, latent feature representations are extracted from the robot's initial state image, along with visual information from the first frame and the entire demonstration video. The extracted robot initial state latent feature representations are input into a spatial information processing module, and features of different sizes extracted from each layer of a U-shaped network are input into the corresponding layers of the U-shaped network in a spatiotemporal information processing module. Finally, the visual information from the human demonstration video is input into the spatiotemporal information processing module, which performs progressive denoising to generate a robot operation video and predict the sequence of actions to be performed. Compared with existing technologies, this invention can efficiently utilize information from human demonstrations and, through the capabilities of a diffusion model, achieve accurate control of the robot, enabling it to effectively perform the target task.

title: Energy consumption and calculation force two-dimensional deterministic optimization scheduling method and device and data center
description: The invention relates to the technical field of power computing scheduling and discloses an energy consumption and power computing two-dimensional deterministic optimization scheduling method, a device and a data center, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring power computing resource information of each server in the data center and resource requirements of target tasks; and optimizing the computing power provided by each server for the target task at different moments according to the computing power information and the computing power requirement, so as to minimize the total energy consumed by the data center for executing the target task and obtain a scheduling strategy. According to the invention, different types of computing power provided by each server at different moments are optimized, so that the scheduling of heterogeneous resources in the servers is realized, and the energy consumption when a target task is executed according to the scheduling strategy obtained by optimization is minimized.

title: Machine learning-oriented aircraft running track fine segmentation extraction method and device
description: The invention discloses a machine learning-oriented method, a machine learning-oriented device, a machine learning-oriented equipment and a machine learning-oriented storage medium for extracting the moving track of an aircraft in a refined and segmented mode, wherein the machine learning-oriented method comprises the steps of obtaining parameters such as the speed, the acceleration, the course angle and the like of the aircraft from a flight log; calculating the maximum value of a single track, calculating the track variation of each track point, calculating the track variation threshold value, judging the abrupt change point and carrying out fine segmentation. The method provided by the invention comprehensively considers the changes of the speed, the acceleration and the course angle, can accurately identify the state mutation points in the flight track, and automatically completes the segmentation extraction. The method effectively improves the accuracy of flight trajectory analysis, provides high-quality data support for machine learning model training, and simultaneously meets the requirements of different flight tasks.

title: Integrated circuit core process modeling method and system based on personalized federal learning
description: The invention provides an integrated circuit core process modeling method and system based on personalized federal learning, wherein the method comprises the steps that a server side initializes a global model and sends the global model to a plurality of clients, the clients execute cross-layer local training after receiving the global model to generate a local model, the method comprises the steps that the local model is personalized and the universal local model are generated, the clients upload the local model to the server side, the server side generates an updated global model through model aggregation, and the steps are repeated until preset convergence conditions are met, so that the global model corresponding to each core process flow of an integrated circuit is obtained. The method is used for realizing efficient and accurate core process modeling on the premise of protecting data privacy, generating the personalized model and the local model through cross-level local training so as to improve the generalization capability of the model, accelerating model convergence and reducing oscillation behaviors through an integrated optimization method, and can still keep high precision under the condition of greatly reducing data quantity.

title: Multi-angle CPR training video detection method based on machine vision
description: The present invention discloses multi-angle CPR training video detection based on machine vision, which is characterized by: including the establishment of LCGS-YOLO model, preparation, KCHT matching algorithm design and formulation of scoring criteria. The advantages of the present invention compared with the existing technology are: the present invention uses pure machine vision technology to accurately detect the key goals in cardiopulmonary resuscitation - appropriate frequency of cardiopulmonary compression and artificial respiration, especially in complex dynamic environments, to ensure efficient and accurate evaluation, and to build a customized data set for CPR evaluation. The LCSG-YOLO model is trained based on this data set. By uploading the video, the system automatically evaluates the CPR operation according to the preset standard to determine whether it meets the standard without relying on sensors, which provides scientific support for CPR quality improvement and training, and promotes the popularization of intelligent evaluation applications.

title: 3D human body posture estimation method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The application belongs to the field of computer vision and discloses a 3D human body posture estimation method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a 2D key point sequence, generating high-dimensional characteristics of each frame through posture space embedding, and applying a random mask and position codes to form a sparse time sequence Token sequence; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a gesture time sequence interaction module based on a transducer to extract global time sequence characteristics, adopting a joint-level space embedding, space interaction module and hierarchical convolution to capture local time sequence details for a current frame and a neighborhood frame thereof to obtain local characteristics, inputting a gesture optimization network (a 2D gesture, a global 3D gesture and a central frame 3D gesture contrast learning module) to generate a 3D human gesture after integrating the global and local characteristics through a self-adaptive fusion strategy, calculating total loss, optimizing by utilizing a sparse-dense training strategy, and finally outputting the 3D human gesture. The method can remarkably improve the accuracy of 3D attitude estimation.

title: Small-drainage-basin flood early warning method based on X-band dual-polarization phased array radar
description: The application discloses a small-river basin flood early warning method based on an X-band dual-polarization phased array radar, which relates to the technical field of flood early warning and comprises the following steps of acquiring an X-band dual-polarization phased array radar data set and a rainfall station actual measurement rainfall data set, and establishing a radar rainfall calculation model through linear fitting; the method comprises the steps of obtaining an X-band dual-polarization phased array radar image set, predicting by adopting a short-term rainfall prediction model to obtain a predicted radar image and corresponding predicted radar data, inputting the predicted radar data into a radar rainfall calculation model to obtain predicted rainfall, and carrying out flood early warning of a small river basin by adopting a flood prediction model. According to the method, the X-band dual-polarization phased array radar data and the image are combined with the radar rainfall calculation model, the short-term rainfall prediction model and the flood prediction model, so that the accuracy of rainfall prediction is improved, and the reliability of flood early warning is further improved.

title: Medical image segmentation model training method and system and medical image segmentation method
description: The present invention provides a medical image segmentation model training method, system and medical image segmentation method, wherein the training method includes pre-training a large model with high segmentation accuracy as a first teacher network, then building a semantic segmentation student network with RGCN, then building a confidence discrimination network, inputting the probability map representing each pixel output by the first teacher network into the built confidence discrimination network, and obtaining a confidence map, and finally integrating the confidence map into the training of the student network. The present invention adopts knowledge distillation with confidence to transfer the correct knowledge of a large model with good segmentation effect but slow segmentation speed to a small model with RGCN feature fusion with faster segmentation speed, so that the small model has segmentation efficiency and accuracy. The present invention can avoid the negative impact of the teacher network on the student network in the traditional knowledge distillation process, thereby obtaining a better knowledge distillation effect.

title: Mobile terminal light-weight drug-absorption auxiliary detection method and system based on facial image
description: The invention discloses a mobile terminal light-weight drug-taking auxiliary detection method and system based on facial images, comprising the following steps of S1, collecting face images of detected persons by using a camera, carrying out preprocessing operations of face detection, background removal and face alignment, S2, designing a light-weight neural network module, constructing a light-weight drug-taking detection network based on the module, S3, acquiring a drug-taking person face data set and training the drug-taking detection network, S4, extracting face features by using the drug-taking detection network and obtaining classification results and certainty, and S5, converting and transplanting a drug-taking detection network model to a mobile terminal, and constructing mobile terminal application. The invention detects the drug addict based on the facial image, avoids the defects of high matching requirement, long detection period, difficult large-scale screening and the like of the traditional biochemical sample detection method, adopts deep learning and lightweight ideas, effectively improves the algorithm performance, and is suitable for application scenes such as mobile terminals, portable terminals and the like.

title: Intelligent control system and method for quality of semiconductor production process
description: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductor device testing, in particular to an intelligent control system and method for quality of a semiconductor production process, which are used for acquiring target application scene information of a semiconductor device to be tested, generating baseline test severity configuration matched with the target application scene according to the target application scene information by utilizing a first intelligent test model, wherein the baseline test severity configuration comprises test limit values of a plurality of test parameters, test item selection and test conditions, acquiring and analyzing quality feedback data and upstream process data related to the semiconductor device to be tested in real time in the test process to obtain semiconductor real-time data, comprehensively analyzing the semiconductor real-time data and the baseline test severity configuration by utilizing a semiconductor quality adjustment model, dynamically adjusting the baseline test severity configuration, generating a final test severity configuration, and generating a control instruction based on the final test severity configuration to test the semiconductor device.

title: Real-time wheel centrifugal force prediction method, device and server
description: The present invention provides a real-time wheel center force prediction method, device and server, which relates to the technical field of vehicle dynamics modeling and intelligent control, including: real-time acquisition of high-dimensional original feature data, wherein the original feature data includes: wheel center acceleration data and dynamic auxiliary data, and the dynamic auxiliary data includes: vehicle speed, steering angle, tire pressure, tire force, vehicle body force and vehicle dynamics relationship; combining principal component analysis with physical constraints, dynamically reducing the order of the original feature data, and determining the target feature data after the reduction; calculating and processing the weight values corresponding to different input features in the target feature data through a preset deep neural network to dynamically adjust the importance of each input feature, and performing weighted calculation on the weight value and the target feature data to generate the target wheel center force prediction result in the output layer of the preset deep neural network. The present invention can significantly improve the accuracy of wheel center force prediction.

title: A method and related device for detecting undervoltage defects of tension clamps based on X-ray image recognition
description: The invention provides a strain clamp under-voltage defect detection method and a related device based on X-ray image recognition, wherein the method comprises the steps of optimizing an original X-ray image of a strain clamp to obtain an optimized ray image, inputting the optimized ray image into a deep learning model, extracting microstructure feature vectors related to the strain clamp under-voltage defect in the image by using the deep learning model, inputting the extracted microstructure feature vectors into a target detection deep learning model, recognizing the under-voltage defect of the original X-ray image, and grading the recognized defect by combining with a preset standard, wherein the target detection deep learning model adopts a one-stage or two-stage architecture. According to the invention, the accuracy and reliability of the undervoltage defect detection of the strain clamp can be remarkably improved by optimizing the X-ray image and adopting the target detection deep learning model to detect the defects.

title: Improved face detection method, system and data storage device based on convolutional neural network
description: A face detection method based on convolutional neural network improvement comprises the steps of fusing a P2 layer in the convolutional neural network into a path aggregation network, replacing a cross-stage local network module in a P5 layer of the convolutional neural network with a receptive field enhancement module, setting widths of anchor frames of different layers based on step sizes of the P2 layer, the P3 layer and the P4 layer in the convolutional neural network, wherein the widths of the anchor frames are in a proportional relation with the step sizes, counting average proportion of heights and widths in a real frame, obtaining the heights of the anchor frames of different layers according to the average proportion and the adjusted widths, adding NWD loss into a prediction frame regression loss function, adjusting the proportion of the cross-ratio loss and the NWD loss, and finishing adjustment of the loss function.

title: Layered mixed structured compression method and device for large language model
description: The present invention provides a hierarchical hybrid structured compression method and device for a large language model, which relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology, including: determining the compression ratio of each layer of the target model based on the importance of each layer of the target model; compressing the target model based on the compression ratio of each layer to obtain a compressed model; wherein compressing the target model includes: for the current processing layer, calculating the second norm of the input activation value corresponding to each weight of the current processing layer on a calibration data set to obtain a feature norm; when the current processing layer is a multi-head attention sublayer, based on the feature norm of the current processing layer and the compression ratio of each layer, performing weighted low-rank decomposition and differentiated singular value allocation processing on the current processing layer; when the current processing layer is a feedforward network sublayer, based on the feature norm of the current processing layer and the compression ratio of each layer, performing channel pruning and compensation processing on the current processing layer. Thus, the compression rate and performance balance of LLM are achieved.

title: A line-of-sight-based pursuit-escape game decision-making method with capture radius
description: The invention discloses a vision-based chase game decision method with a capturing radius, which aims at the game scene of a chaser and an escaper in a complex obstacle environment in an area, and provides a framework for combined solution of dynamic partitioning and optimal strategies based on the dynamic relative position relationship between the chaser and the escaper and the obstacle. The geometric method of the Cartesian oval line is introduced to construct the boundary of the dominant areas of the chaser and the escaped in the chaser-and-escaped game, and the optimal tracking path of the chaser and the optimal escape direction of the escaped are analyzed, so that the accurate description of game dynamics is realized. The strategy decision efficiency of both game parties in a complex environment is remarkably improved, the method is particularly suitable for the field of high-dynamic military countermeasure, and the method has wide application potential and has important significance in promoting the rapid development of related technologies.

title: Reservoir stage-by-stage drought-limiting water level determining method and system based on hedera helix algorithm
description: The invention provides a reservoir stage-grading drought-limiting water level determining method and system based on a hedera helix algorithm, comprising the steps of 1, collecting and sorting reservoir water supply data, water demand data and a reservoir scheduling procedure, 2, carrying out preliminary stage on a reservoir scheduling period based on the reservoir scheduling procedure, adding stage nodes based on the reservoir water supply data and the water demand data, further carrying out stage-grading to obtain a plurality of stage-grading drought-limiting water levels based on the water demand data, 3, taking the plurality of stage-grading drought-limiting water levels as parameters, constructing a drought-limiting water level multi-objective optimization model, 4, solving a non-inferior solution set obtained by optimizing the drought-limiting water level multi-objective optimization model, sequencing the non-inferior solution set obtained by optimizing, and determining the final stage-grading drought-limiting water level. The invention has the characteristics of high convergence rate and less algorithm parameters, and provides the explicit scheduling rule which is obtained by adopting the parameter simulation optimization method to better meet the actual needs and better guide drought-resistant water-supplementing scheduling.

title: Multi-heat source multi-material additive manufacturing optimization method and system based on machine learning
description: This application proposes a machine learning-based optimization method and system for multi-heat-source, multi-material additive manufacturing, relating to the field of additive manufacturing. The steps are as follows: Real-time acquisition of process parameters, material properties, and target response data to construct a multi-source dataset. Based on this dataset, a multi-task learning model is trained, common features are extracted, and the target response is predicted synchronously. The predicted values are used to construct a surrogate objective function. If the error exceeds a threshold, experimental verification is conducted, and new data is fed back to update the model. Weight coefficients are used in a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm to iteratively screen Pareto candidate solutions, verify solutions with high uncertainty, and update the model until the error converges. The optimal parameter combination is selected and deployed using the entropy-weighted TOPSIS method, embedding an online learning mechanism to form a closed-loop optimization. This method, combining multi-task learning and adaptive evolutionary algorithms, can achieve efficient optimization of process parameters in multi-heat-source, multi-material additive manufacturing.

title: Method and device for segmenting ultraviolet discharge facula image of electrical equipment based on DTDU-Net model and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to a method, device and storage medium for segmenting ultraviolet discharge spot images of electrical equipment based on a DTDU-Net model. After acquiring the ultraviolet discharge spot image of the electrical equipment, the method uses the trained DTDU-Net model to segment the aforementioned ultraviolet discharge spot image of the electrical equipment to obtain an image segmentation result; wherein the DTDU-Net model is based on a U-Net model, including a deformable convolution residual encoder and a channel cross-fusion Transformer module, and an ultra-light dynamic upsampler is used in the decoder part. Compared with the prior art, the present invention has the advantages of effectively improving the segmentation accuracy of discharge spots in ultraviolet images of electrical equipment, etc.

title: Space orientation-based bat type ultrasonic identification method, medium and system
description: The invention provides a space-orientation-based bat type ultrasonic identification method, medium and system, which belong to the technical field of bat type identification and comprise the steps of acquiring a first acquisition signal, a second acquisition signal and a third acquisition signal acquired by three ultrasonic signal collectors, preprocessing the three ultrasonic signals to obtain the first ultrasonic signal, the second ultrasonic signal and the third ultrasonic signal, inputting relative coordinates of the three ultrasonic signals and the three ultrasonic signals by utilizing a Doppler compensation equation set which is fitted in advance to obtain three ultrasonic signals with Doppler effect removed, respectively recording the three ultrasonic signals as a first signal, a second signal and a third signal, respectively inputting the first signal, the second signal and the third signal into a bat type identification model which is trained in advance to obtain corresponding bat types and confidence degrees thereof, and selecting the bat type with the highest confidence degree as an identified bat type result.

title: Low-bit-depth image enhancement method based on noise shaping and latent space modeling
description: The present invention relates to the field of image processing, and more specifically, to a low-bit-depth image enhancement method based on noise shaping and latent space modeling. The method comprises: constructing low-bit-depth images through noise shaping and quantization using a Sigma-Delta modulator; generating low-bit-depth-low-resolution image pairs through a hierarchical feature discovery module; modeling the relationship between low-resolution images and high-bit-depth images in the latent space; and fusing multiple low-bit-depth-low-resolution image pairs containing different feature information through an adaptive weight fusion module. The adaptive weight fusion module dynamically fuses the images based on the amount of feature information, with weights dynamically adjusted based on the specific features of the input image pairs. The present invention is suitable for low-bit-depth image enhancement.

title: Efficient reinforcement learning method for solving batch travel business problems in express package distribution
description: An efficient reinforcement learning method for solving batch traveling salesman problems (TSP) in express parcel delivery. By constructing a planning information design and fusion module, a planning strategy is designed based on the graph structure environment model of the delivery task, and non-parametric planning information is integrated into the decision process of the neural solver to guide path exploration and improve the efficiency of batch task exploration. A diverse group exploration module is designed, and a shared encoder-multiple decoder architecture is adopted to give each decoder a diverse decoding strategy. A group collaborative baseline is introduced, and the path plan is stored in a shared buffer and the average delivery distance is calculated as a baseline to promote strategy diversity and improve the overall exploration capability. A coarse-grained three-part search method is implemented, and Gaussian noise perturbation is combined with a three-part search mechanism to quickly lock the optimal planning information intensity interval, optimize the generalization ability of the neural solver, and achieve the shortest total delivery distance. This method provides an efficient solution for express delivery path optimization.

title: Defect code detection method and related device based on text mode and graph mode
description: The invention provides a defect code detection method and a related device based on a text mode and a graph mode, and belongs to the technical field of defect code detection. The method of the invention carries out interactive fusion on the vector representations of the statement level source code attribute graph and the statement level abstract code attribute graph and the vector representations of a plurality of word marks to obtain multi-mode embedding. Training the defect code classifier by utilizing multi-mode embedding, grading the training result, and selecting the defect code classifier with the highest grading as a final defect code detection model. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device solve the problem that the defect code detection accuracy is not high.

title: Quantization parameter prediction method for improving precision of quantization network
description: The invention provides a quantization parameter prediction method for improving the precision of a quantization network, which comprises the steps of S1, selecting a subset of a batch of data sets, counting quantization parameters of each input data, recording the input and the corresponding quantization parameters, S2, constructing a parameter prediction network, wherein the network input is the input recorded in the step S1, the output is the predicted quantization parameters, namely scale and zero_point of each layer, and the predicted parameters are mse loss with the real quantization parameters, S3, using the data training parameter prediction network in the step S1, iterating until convergence, S4, after an original network is quantized, carrying out parameter prediction through the parameter prediction network, and loading the predicted parameters into the quantization network for testing. The network is used for predicting the quantization parameters which are more in line with data distribution, and for different inputs, different quantization parameters can be predicted to adapt to a quantization algorithm, so that the quantized model precision is improved.

title: Automatic drive visual odometer system in foggy day
description: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic driving visual navigation, in particular to a visual odometer system for an automatic driving foggy day, which comprises a graphic processing module, a defogging network model and a LEAP-VO module, wherein the graphic processing module comprises an image preprocessing unit, a feature extraction unit, a threshold value judging unit and a comprehensive judging unit, and is used for identifying whether an image is a foggy image, the defogging network model comprises a generator G, a generator F and a judging unit D, the generator G and the generator F are adopted for defogging in multiple stages to generate clear and semantically consistent foggy images, the defogging effect is optimized through the judging unit D, and the LEAP-VO module comprises feature point extraction, key point track generation, track filtration and local beam adjustment, and performs beam adjustment in a sliding window mode, so that the pose estimation of a camera is continuously optimized in a local range. The invention can provide more accurate and reliable pose estimation in dynamic and foggy weather environments, thereby better meeting the high requirements of an automatic driving and robot navigation system on visual perception.

title: Big data management system for field emergency rescue medical treatment
description: The invention discloses a field emergency rescue medical big data management system, which relates to the technical field of medical data management and comprises a data acquisition, transmission, storage, analysis processing and rescue decision support module, wherein the acquisition module acquires physiological and environmental data by using a multi-mode sensor array and performs edge preprocessing, the transmission module constructs a multi-link communication architecture and performs encryption transmission, the storage module adopts distributed encryption and blockchain storage, the analysis processing module combines deep migration and federal learning mining data, and the decision support module also fuses VR/AR auxiliary decisions based on a knowledge graph and reinforcement learning providing scheme. The invention comprehensively and accurately collects data, stably transmits stored data in various field environments, deeply excavates data value to assist accurate decision, supports remote collaboration, realizes functions of intelligent early warning, equipment management, authority control and the like, and comprehensively improves the medical efficiency and accuracy of field emergency rescue.

title: Power transmission line icing thickness prediction method, device, computer equipment, readable storage medium and program product
description: The application relates to a method, a device, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product for predicting ice coating thickness of a power transmission line. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target prediction time and target geographical position information of a target prediction point, determining current meteorological data and current icing thickness corresponding to the target prediction point, and performing space-time attention processing on the target geographical position information, the current meteorological data and the current icing thickness through a pre-trained power transmission line icing thickness prediction model to obtain predicted icing thickness corresponding to the target prediction point at the target prediction time. By adopting the method, the accuracy of ice coating thickness prediction can be provided.

title: Remote sensing cross-mode image-text retrieval method and device
description: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing, in particular to a remote sensing cross-mode image-text retrieval method and device, comprising the following steps: the remote sensing image and the corresponding real segmentation mask construct a non-foreground restoration loss function and a predictive segmentation mask loss function, the remote sensing image and the corresponding text description are used for constructing a triplet loss function, and the remote sensing image and text retrieval model is trained by constructing a total loss function, so that the trained remote sensing image and text retrieval model is used for retrieving remote sensing image and text data and retrieving remote sensing image and text data. The invention improves the accuracy and efficiency of cross-mode remote sensing image-text retrieval and additionally outputs the predictive segmentation image of the remote sensing image.

title: Live fish damage detection method based on AI and multi-vision underwater imaging technology
description: The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and visual detection technology, and specifically to a live fish damage detection method based on AI and multi-eye visual underwater imaging technology, which is as follows: a multi-eye visual imaging device is set to collect clear and complete fish body images, and the collected images are subjected to image denoising, graying, contrast enhancement and normalization operations to obtain pre-processed fish body images; a convolutional neural network based on ResNet-50 as the main framework is constructed as a live fish damage grading detection model, and the convolutional neural network based on ResNet-50 as the main framework is improved, and then the pre-processed fish body image is input into the live fish damage grading detection model for training. The present invention can effectively reduce the overfitting problem, optimize the feature extraction effect, improve the classification accuracy, solve the problem of category imbalance in underwater images, and thus improve the accuracy of detection.

title: A method for predicting state of charge of lithium-ion batteries
description: The present invention proposes a method for predicting the state of charge of a lithium-ion battery. First, battery experimental data is obtained and characteristic data reflecting the state of charge (SOC) is extracted, and the characteristic data is standardized. The characteristic data is reduced in dimension by using the principal component analysis method and divided into a training set, a validation set and a test set. A TCN-LSTM weight allocation model is constructed. The hyperparameters of the TCN-LSTM weight allocation model are optimized by using the ivy optimization algorithm (IVY), and the training set data is used for training to construct the IVY-TCN-LSTM weight allocation model. The test set data is input into the model to obtain the test set prediction value. In order to further improve the prediction accuracy, an error compensation module is added. The error correction value obtained by the module is added to the test set prediction value to obtain the SOC prediction value. Finally, it is determined whether the SOC prediction value meets the prediction requirements. If not, the model is rebuilt. If it is, the battery SOC prediction value is output.

title: Crop yield prediction method and system based on spatiotemporal geographic weighted regression
description: This invention discloses a crop yield prediction method and system based on spatiotemporal geographic weighted regression. The crop yield prediction method comprises: obtaining county-level environmental data for a target region during the target crop's growth cycle, as well as county-level yield data for the target crop, wherein the county-level environmental data includes data on factors influencing the target crop's yield; performing differentiation and factor detection on each of the influencing factors in the county-level environmental data, and screening key explanatory variables from the influencing factors; constructing a crop yield prediction model and training it using the county-level data on the key explanatory variables and the county-level yield data for the target crop; and using the trained crop yield prediction model to predict the county-level yield of the target crop. This method demonstrates high prediction accuracy and strong generalization across different regions and years, effectively overcoming the limitations of current crop prediction methods.

title: Image anomaly detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiments of the present application provide an image anomaly detection method, device, equipment and storage medium, and relate to the field of computer vision technology. The method inputs an anomaly detection image and a deep visual cue feature into an image encoder to generate a classification vector and multiple block vectors, inputs multiple prompt texts into a text encoder to obtain a text vector, calculates the similarity between the classification vector and multiple text vectors to obtain a global similarity score, calculates the similarity between the block vector and multiple text vectors to obtain a block similarity score, and then obtains a similarity mapping result, and obtains an anomaly detection result based on the global similarity score and the similarity mapping result. With the help of deep visual cue features, the depth information of the image, the spatial position and structure of the object, etc. are provided to improve the ability to recognize anomalies of unknown categories. The block vector is used to describe the image in detail from the perspective of local pixels, thereby significantly improving the accuracy of anomaly recognition.

title: A driving intelligent monitoring method and system based on driving recorder
description: The invention discloses a traveling intelligent monitoring method and system based on a vehicle data recorder, and relates to the technical field of vehicle data recorders, wherein the system continuously collects video data inside and outside a vehicle through a double-lens Tandem; the method comprises the steps of constructing a deep learning model through a convolutional neural network CNN, a cyclic neural network RNN and a long and short time memory network LSTM, extracting key features from a face image of a driver and the surrounding environment of the vehicle, processing feature vectors by a data analysis module through a machine learning and statistics method, calculating a vehicle running coefficient Clx, a traffic density coefficient Jtm and a driver fatigue coefficient Jsp, comprehensively generating a running early warning index ZHY, primarily evaluating the fatigue state of the driver based on a preset threshold value by an evaluation early warning module, secondarily evaluating according to the comprehensive running early warning index, providing real-time safety prompt and suggestion, and effectively improving the driving safety and the running efficiency.

title: Intelligent fire control system and intelligent fire control data optimization method
description: The application provides an intelligent fire protection system and an intelligent fire protection data optimization method, and particularly relates to the technical field of fire protection data processing. The system collects fire control environment data in real time through the distributed sensor units, and stores the fire control environment data in the distributed database and the blockchain storage unit after edge calculation and cloud computing processing. And carrying out multidimensional data analysis by using a machine learning and deep learning model, and generating early warning and executing decision by the early warning decision module according to the multidimensional data analysis. The user interaction module displays early warning information and decision results through the visual interface and the mobile terminal, and the system solves the technical problem that the traditional fire control system is easy to be paralyzed due to data bloated, transmission delay, low storage efficiency and poor instantaneity, enhances the instantaneity, reliability and safety of the system, and optimizes user experience.

title: Distributed power source locating and sizing planning method and device based on improved river horse optimization algorithm
description: The present invention discloses a method and device for distributed power site selection and sizing planning based on an improved Hippopotamus optimization algorithm, which relates to the technical field of distribution network planning, and is used to solve the technical problem that the existing distributed power site selection and sizing planning methods lead to low efficiency of distributed power site selection and sizing planning. The method includes setting site selection and sizing constraints and constructing a distributed power site selection and sizing multi-objective model based on the goal of minimizing network active power loss and voltage deviation when distributed power site selection and sizing planning is required; based on the K-means clustering algorithm and the multi-objective optimization mechanism, the improved Hippopotamus optimization algorithm is used to iteratively solve the distributed power site selection and sizing multi-objective model to generate a distributed power site selection and sizing planning scheme. The present invention uses the K-means clustering algorithm to improve the sorting efficiency, and combines the improved Hippopotamus optimization algorithm to guide the solution to different target values, thereby improving the efficiency of obtaining the distributed power site selection and sizing planning scheme.

title: A method and system for detecting surface defects of motor magnetic shoe
description: The invention provides a motor magnetic shoe surface defect detection method and system, which belong to the defect detection field and comprise the steps of obtaining motor magnetic shoe surface image data, constructing a motor magnetic shoe surface image enhancement model according to different sample problems, enhancing the magnetic shoe surface image data to obtain an enhanced sample dataset, introducing a mixed convolution module ADconv into a back bone part of an original YOLOv n model, replacing a common convolution conv in an original model CSP, introducing a mixed attention module HAM into a Neck part, introducing cost sensitivity factors and optimizing a loss function Focal-EIOU to obtain an improved YOLOv n model, training the improved YOLOv n model by utilizing the enhanced sample dataset to obtain a motor magnetic shoe surface defect detection model, and processing a motor magnetic shoe image according to the motor magnetic shoe surface defect detection model to obtain a motor magnetic shoe surface defect detection result. The defect detection accuracy and efficiency of the motor magnetic shoe are improved, and the production requirement of industrial quality detection is met.

title: Multi-agent reinforcement learning method
description: The present application discloses a multi-agent reinforcement learning method, which relates to the technical field of multi-agent reinforcement learning, including: generating multiple final hyperedges based on the observation information of each agent in the multi-agent system and a complex variable strategy mechanism; obtaining a multidimensional feature vector of each agent, and generating a correlation matrix corresponding to the multi-agent system based on the communication structure and the multidimensional feature vector; fusing the communication information of each agent based on the correlation matrix to obtain fused communication information; the fused communication information is used to guide the actions of the corresponding agent; by setting a complex variable strategy mechanism, adjusting the hyperedge according to the task state value and the environment state value of the agent, dynamically adjusting the adaptation mode, optimizing the communication cooperation between agents, and achieving the effect of accurately capturing and efficiently fusing the complex relationships between different agents; introducing a multidimensional feature vector to generate a correlation matrix, and achieving the effect of improving the accuracy of correlation calculation.

title: User fraud risk identification method and device and electronic equipment
description: The application provides a method, a device and electronic equipment for identifying user fraud risk, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining first basic information of a target user; the method comprises the steps of obtaining first multi-dimensional unstructured data of a target user based on first basic information, processing the first multi-dimensional unstructured data according to a plurality of preset time windows to generate first feature data under the plurality of time windows, inputting the first feature data under the plurality of time windows into a preset user fraud risk identification model, wherein the first feature data comprise a natural language processing model, a parameter server and a machine learning model, processing the first feature data into semantic feature vectors through the natural language processing model, and outputting fraud risk levels of the target user based on the semantic feature vectors corresponding to the first feature data through the parameter server and the machine learning model. The application can identify potential fraud risk of the user under the framework of low cost, low time consumption and relative simplicity.

title: Dynamic style behavior planning method, device and storage medium based on multi-mode large language model
description: The invention discloses a dynamic style behavior planning method and a storage medium based on a multi-mode large language model, comprising the steps of driving data acquisition, and acquisition of various styles of driving data; the multi-modal language model training maps the data of multiple modes into a unified feature space, and interacts and infers the information of different modes in the common space. The invention utilizes the simulator and the image style migration technology to obtain a large amount of driving data close to the real world scene efficiently and at low cost, can generate diversified responses according to different prompts by means of the multi-modal language model to achieve the purpose of flexibly converting the automatic driving style of the vehicle, and simultaneously greatly enhances the interpretability of the system due to the capability of outputting relevant information such as scene understanding, decision logic and the like in a text form.

title: An efficient adaptive signal processing system
description: The efficient adaptive signal processing system of the present invention integrates a number of innovative technologies. It uses deep learning and adaptive algorithms to fit signals and reduce distortion; it uses multimodal feature fusion and integrated learning to intelligently remove noise and improve signal purity. The temperature control uses intelligent partitioned heat dissipation, combined with solar energy and thermoelectric refrigeration, which is energy-saving and efficient. The outer shell uses waterproof, dustproof and self-repairing nano-composite materials, and has an internal integrated environmental monitoring module to adapt to harsh environments. When the signal deviation exceeds the threshold, the system will alarm and record data through multiple channels. The key components are made of new alloy materials, with modular and layered structures. It also provides customized services based on big data and artificial intelligence to meet the needs of different users, comprehensively improve the accuracy, stability and equipment reliability of signal processing, and has significant technical advantages and application value.

title: An embedded runway detection method based on YOMO-RunwayNet
description: The present invention discloses an embedded runway detection method based on YOMO-RunwayNet, which adopts a lightweight backbone network and combines the ability to efficiently aggregate multi-scale feature information. By optimizing the feature extraction capability and network structure, the detection accuracy and computational complexity are balanced, and the pixel-level error of the runway key points is reduced to below 0.003, and the inference speed is increased to more than 90.9FPS.

title: Safety detection method, device, equipment and medium for power wireless sensor network
description: The present invention provides a security detection method, device, equipment and medium for a power wireless sensor network, which relates to the technical field of wireless sensor networks. The method includes: obtaining network intrusion data in the power wireless sensor network; inputting the network intrusion data into a security detection model to obtain a security monitoring result of the power wireless sensor network output by the security detection model; the security detection model is trained based on historical intrusion data and historical labels corresponding to the historical intrusion data.
