The technical solution of the present invention performs security detection on intrusion data through a pre-trained security detection model, thereby improving the precision and accuracy of security detection, thereby being able to better protect the data security of the power wireless sensor network.

title: Multi-algorithm fusion robot motion path planning method and robot
description: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, in particular to a planning method of a multi-algorithm-fused robot motion path and a robot. The method comprises the steps of firstly modeling a motion scene of a robot, then improving a JPS algorithm and a GWO gray wolf optimization algorithm, wherein the JPS algorithm updates a measurement mode of jump point search, and the GWO gray wolf optimization algorithm introduces a route random disturbance mechanism and reconstructs a multi-target fitness function. Finally, performing multi-algorithm fusion robot motion path optimization by utilizing an RRT algorithm, an improved JPS algorithm and a GWO gray-wolf optimization algorithm, wherein the method specifically comprises the steps of generating a random path by utilizing the existing RRT algorithm, performing first-stage optimization by utilizing the improved GWO gray-wolf optimization algorithm, performing path simplification, performing second-stage optimization by utilizing the improved JPS algorithm, and performing third-stage optimization by utilizing the improved GWO gray-wolf optimization algorithm. The invention can solve the problems of low path planning efficiency and poor planning result quality existing in the complex scene in the existing scheme.

title: A sparse trajectory recovery method based on graph neural network
description: The application belongs to the technical field of computer information calculation. The application provides a sparse track recovery method based on a graph neural network. The embodiment of the disclosure builds a STREAM model based on a graph neural network, and for a given sparse track, the graph neural network builds a subgraph for each point to represent the surrounding road network area. The convolution operation is applied to the speed matrix of the time period to obtain global traffic representation, and local traffic dynamics are learned through traffic information of adjacent road segments. And (3) the global traffic representation is transmitted into an encoder and is fused with the local traffic condition, so that the complex space-time dependency relationship is captured. The network combines layered motion dynamics, and can extract global and local traffic dynamics in the encoder, thereby enabling the decoder to accurately reconstruct missing track points.

title: Carbon fiber preform dual-arm humanoid acupuncture robot system and acupuncture method
description: The invention discloses a carbon fiber preform double-arm human-shaped needling robot system and a needling method, which are divided into a mechanical structure module, a decision module and an algorithm module, and the whole process from laying of a preform to needling is automatically completed through automation equipment and a self-imputation method, so that the dependence on manual operation is greatly reduced, and the high-efficiency automatic carbon fiber preform operation is realized. The design and implementation of the invention comprises double-arm cooperative control and collision avoidance algorithm, sensing and feedback mechanism and process parameter self-adaptive optimization to control the robot system, integrates multi-axis linkage control, intelligent sensing and deep learning algorithm, can perform real-time optimization when complex tasks are executed, realizes the full-automatic operation of the needling module, and has high flexibility and self-adaptability.

title: Power cable path search method and device based on Internet platform
description: The invention relates to the field of power cable path searching, in particular to a power cable path searching method and a power cable path searching device based on an Internet platform, wherein in the method, a transmitter injects signals, a receiver processes noise and errors by using Kalman filtering, a built-in thermal imaging camera collects a thermal imaging image, an initial path is generated by means of Internet platform data by an A-type algorithm, a genetic algorithm optimizes the path to balance burial depth and construction cost, and a convolutional neural network is utilized to analyze the thermal imaging image to locate hot spots; the device comprises a signal acquisition module, an initial path generation module, an optimization module and a fault judgment module, can accurately process signals, efficiently plan paths and timely detect faults, realizes data integration and real-time updating by means of an Internet platform, and improves the level of intellectualization and reliability of operation and maintenance of the power cable.

title: Improved truss floor deck defect detection by integrating ShuffleNet-YOLO model
description: The invention provides an improved truss floor support plate defect detection method by fusing ShuffleNet-YOLO models, which constructs a truss floor support plate defect data set with damage, honeycomb pitting, cracks and steel bar corrosion. Firstly, the attention mechanism CBAM is integrated into the ShuffleNetv model, then the lightweight network ShuffleNetv-CBAM is integrated with the object detection algorithm yolov5s.60, and finally, a WIOU, soft-NMS improved strategy is adopted at the output end to form a final network model. The method well utilizes the characteristic of high detection speed of the YOLO model and the advantage of light weight of ShuffleNet algorithm, so that the model has the advantages of high identification precision, high detection speed, strong generalization capability and the like, is convenient to be deployed on embedded equipment, can be widely applied to on-site real-time monitoring of scenes, improves construction quality and efficiency, provides a more reliable and efficient solution for detecting defects of truss building carrier plates, and further provides technical support for intelligent transformation of the building industry.

title: Gradient catalytic biomass tar cracking reactor and control method thereof
description: The invention relates to the technical field of biomass energy conversion, in particular to a gradient catalytic biomass tar cracking reactor and a control method thereof, which cover modules of multi-level component representation, functional group reactivity evaluation, multi-scale reaction network coupling, oxygen content gradient regulation and self-adaptive product directional regulation and control and the like, the tar component is finely represented by a 3D-CRCM matrix, complex composition recognition and processing capacity is improved, functional group reactivity index calculation and three-layer reaction network construction are improved, optimizing the reaction path selectivity, generating oxygen content gradient index and catalyst distribution scheme, realizing gradient reduction of oxygen content and directional conversion of products in the reactor, designing a multistage fixed bed reactor, filling different catalysts in each reaction zone, adapting to reaction requirements, intelligently regulating and controlling reaction operation parameters by a system, remarkably improving biomass tar cracking efficiency and product directionality, and bringing innovation breakthrough for the technical field of biomass energy conversion.

title: Combustion optimization control system and method based on flame intensity detection
description: The application discloses a combustion optimization control system and method based on flame intensity detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining flame intensity signals of a plurality of wave bands of combustion flame, determining combustion efficiency of a combustion object based on the flame intensity signals, sending the combustion efficiency to a coupling index calculation model to enable the coupling index calculation model to output a coupling index of the combustion efficiency and NO  x  emission, sending the coupling index to a preset combustion parameter solving model to enable the combustion parameter solving model to take the maximization of the combustion efficiency and the minimization of pollutant emission as an objective function, solving the combustion parameter, and controlling material combustion according to the solved combustion parameter. The application improves the combustion efficiency of the combustion products.

title: Large-scale model security protection methods, devices, equipment and storage media
description: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and discloses a large model safety protection method, device, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating an attack data set through a preset attack model, wherein the preset attack model is a model trained in advance based on true harmful query sentences, the true harmful query sentences are query sentences obtained by screening query sentences to be distinguished through an evaluation model, and the evaluation model is a large language model for distinguishing whether the query sentences are true harmful or not; because the attack data set is generated by the preset attack model, the preset attack model is obtained through training of real harmful query sentences, and the real harmful query sentences are screened from query sentences to be distinguished through the large language model, the quality and coverage of the attack data set can be improved, and the safety protection effect of the large model can be improved.

title: Maintenance management system and method for intelligent office equipment
description: The invention discloses a maintenance management system and method of intelligent office equipment, which relate to the technical field of intelligent office equipment maintenance management and comprise an equipment fault diagnosis grading module: installing a multidimensional sensor on the intelligent office equipment, collecting multidimensional sensor information in real time, analyzing and judging the fault type by combining historical fault data, dynamically calculating a fault severity index, automatically dividing maintenance priority, and outputting maintenance results to a maintenance order generation module; according to the invention, the maintenance priority is automatically divided by dynamically calculating the fault severity index, the accuracy of fault diagnosis is improved, a GIS positioning technology and a dynamic route optimization algorithm are adopted, a proper maintenance person is determined, an optimal maintenance work order is generated, meanwhile, intelligent order assignment is realized, the maintenance person can quickly respond and carry out maintenance operation through dynamic authority management, the maintenance time is shortened, the maintenance efficiency is improved, the equipment downtime is reduced, and the service loss caused by equipment faults is reduced.

title: Crop row identification method based on global row-column segmentation
description: The invention relates to the field of crop seedling identification, in particular to a crop line identification method based on global line-column segmentation, which comprises the following steps of firstly, carrying out multi-scale feature extraction on an input image; and a third, a row/column feature probability classifier. The crop line identification method based on global line-column segmentation provides an end-to-end convolutional neural network model, crop lines in different weed germination periods can be directly identified, and the influence of different weed densities and illumination changes on crop line identification is solved.

title: Personalized federated learning method and system based on domain-invariant text representation and domain global prior
description: The present invention discloses a personalized federated learning method and system based on domain-invariant text representation and intra-domain global prior. By introducing text embedding as a global representation, the category labels described in natural language are used to generate a stable, unbiased, and domain-invariant global feature representation. Through the mutual guidance of local features and text embedding vectors, the intra-class distance can be effectively narrowed and the inter-class distance can be widened, thereby alleviating the problem of data heterogeneity. At the same time, the introduced intra-domain prior module generates a global sample prior by aggregating observable data embeddings, which can help local models better understand the global data distribution. Compared with traditional global models or prototypes that rely on image feature generation, the method of the present invention is based on text embedding and intra-domain global prior, does not rely on local data quality, and naturally has denoising and generalization capabilities, effectively alleviating the problem of global targets changing with training.

title: Intelligent supply chain management system and method based on big data
description: The present application discloses a smart supply chain management system and method based on big data, which relates to the field of supply chain management technology. It solves the technical problem that the existing technology does not fully consider the fluctuations caused by the weather and market dynamics of products, which makes suppliers unable to make adequate preparations, resulting in an imbalance between supply and demand, and causing the accuracy and efficiency of the supply chain management system to be low; by constructing a supply chain knowledge graph; generating product demand forecast data based on weather data and product dynamic data and adjusting the supply chain knowledge graph accordingly; generating supplier ratings based on supplier data; generating alarm signals based on supplier ratings and adjusting the supply chain knowledge graph, so that users can accurately and quickly query information on various parts of the supply chain, and at the same time generate product demand forecast data based on weather data and product dynamic data, and adjust suppliers based on product demand forecast data, thereby improving the efficiency and accuracy of the supply chain management system.

title: Cross-modal dynamic collaboration-based visible light and infrared image fusion method
description: The invention discloses a cross-modal dynamic collaboration-based visible light and infrared image fusion method, which comprises the steps of respectively extracting texture detail characteristics of a visible light image and heat radiation characteristics of an infrared image through a visible light encoder and an infrared encoder; and generating a high-resolution fusion image by dynamically gating multi-scale decoder to fuse deep semantic and shallow detail features in a layered manner. The method solves the problems of feature dislocation, detail loss and unreasonable fusion weight distribution caused by modal differences in the prior art, can remarkably improve the detail fidelity, the thermal target significance and the complex scene adaptability of the fusion image, and provides high-robustness fusion results for low-illumination environment perception and multi-modal identification.

title: Data acquisition system for environment monitoring and processing method thereof
description: The invention discloses a data acquisition system for environmental monitoring and a processing method thereof, and relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring, comprising an energy supply module, a data acquisition device and a data processing module, wherein the energy supply module is used for providing electric energy of the data acquisition device based on a solar panel and dynamically adjusting electric power distribution through an intelligent energy management system; the system comprises a structure support module, an information processing module, a communication and data transmission module, a low-power consumption Bluetooth technology and an edge calculation module, wherein the angle of a solar panel can be adjusted based on a bracket, the information processing module is used for collecting atmospheric environment data of each point in an area in real time, an environment real-time analysis model is established based on a deep learning algorithm, a pollution source is identified, a pollution expansion trend is predicted, and the communication and data transmission module is used for carrying out data communication based on the low-power consumption Bluetooth technology and the edge calculation. The invention provides a solar power supply and intelligent energy management system, which ensures long-term independent operation of the system and optimizes energy collection efficiency, adopts a deep learning algorithm to identify pollution sources, predict concentration and forecast pollution expansion trend, and provides intelligent support for environmental monitoring.

title: Method and system for identifying dirt of net cage ship
description: The application relates to the technical field of net cage ship dirt recognition, in particular to a net cage ship dirt recognition method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of synchronously acquiring an optical image sequence and an acoustic data sequence of the net cage ship; the method comprises the steps of carrying out region identification on an optical image sequence to obtain a dirt region, extracting an optical dynamic characteristic sequence of the dirt region according to the optical image sequence, extracting an acoustic dynamic characteristic sequence of a region corresponding to the dirt region in an acoustic data sequence, combining optical image characteristics and acoustic data characteristics in the same time period, determining dirt type information according to the change rate of each characteristic in a combined dynamic characteristic set, and determining dirt parameter information according to the specific value of each characteristic in the combined dynamic characteristic set.

title: Multi-source heterogeneous data access method and system for photovoltaic power generation digital twin platform
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for accessing multi-source heterogeneous data of a photovoltaic power generation digital twin platform. The method includes collecting raw data from multi-source sensors such as meteorological, environmental, electrical, and image sensors, performing data cleaning, format standardization, and anomaly elimination, and then sampling, synchronizing, feature extraction, and structured preprocessing of the data, and storing them in a time series database, a relational database, or an object storage according to the data type. The system also pushes the processed data to the digital twin platform in real time through a standardized interface to achieve data visualization and model-driven simulation. The present invention solves the problems of heterogeneous multi-source data, large precision differences, and high real-time requirements in photovoltaic stations. It has good system scalability and engineering adaptability, and is widely applicable to distributed and centralized photovoltaic power generation systems.

title: A method for predicting intranet lateral movement attacks based on deep Q-network
description: The invention discloses a method for predicting the internal network transverse movement attack based on a deep Q network, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining information of an enterprise internal network, carrying out data cleaning and structuring, then analyzing the data to obtain an activity diagram, and optimizing to obtain an optimized activity diagram; the method comprises the steps of forming MulVAL input files according to the corresponding relation between preset entity types and variable types in MulVAL readable network state representation, constructing an attack graph by using an automatic script, constructing a depth Q network, training by using a historical attack graph, and finally inputting suspicious behaviors corresponding to newly identified security alarms into an optimal depth Q network for lateral movement attack behavior prediction. The invention uses the deep Q network to conduct real-time modeling analysis on the enterprise intranet activity so as to predict the next possible attack, and provides effective defense strategy and decision support rapidly, thereby timely coping with the attack and effectively reducing risks and uncertainty caused by insufficient prediction on the behavior of the attacker.

title: Construction scheme document architecture self-adaptive adjustment method and system and electronic equipment
description: The present invention proposes a method, system and electronic device for adaptively adjusting the construction plan document architecture, which relates to the field of document processing technology. It includes obtaining a first-edited document and all review suggestions for the first-edited document; constructing a graph structure, and constructing a knowledge graph based on the graph structure; updating the optimized graph structure based on the current review suggestions, and updating the knowledge graph based on the updated graph structure; matching the current review suggestions with the nodes of the updated knowledge graph to obtain matching results; adjusting the first-edited document based on the matching results; using the adjusted first-edited document to perform a second update on the updated graph structure, and performing a second update on the knowledge graph based on the second updated graph structure; looping until all review suggestions are executed, and obtaining a second-edited document after adaptive adjustment. The present invention realizes a new understanding of the adjusted document after each review suggestion processing, and realizes dynamic content migration.

title: Multi-agent conflict coordination methods, devices, equipment and media
description: This invention relates to the field of intelligent agents, providing a method, apparatus, device, and medium for conflict coordination among multiple intelligent agents. The method includes: distributing pre-acquired planned paths for each intelligent agent to the corresponding intelligent agent; performing deadlock detection on the next path node of each intelligent agent according to their planned paths to obtain key intelligent agent information, including agents that are stuck in a waiting state due to occupying the same path node; selecting and executing a conflict coordination strategy based on the number of key intelligent agents in the key intelligent agent information; wherein the conflict coordination strategy is configured in advance based on the corresponding number of key intelligent agents. This invention prevents deadlocks caused by path conflicts during intelligent agents' execution by performing deadlock detection before the agents execute tasks, and accelerates conflict resolution by adopting corresponding conflict coordination strategies based on the deadlock detection results, thereby effectively solving the path conflict problem in multi-agent systems.

title: Training method of video fake identification model, video fake identification method, device, electronic equipment, storage medium and computer program product
description: This disclosure relates to a training method, device, electronic device, storage medium, and computer program product for a video authentication model. The training method includes: acquiring video samples, wherein the video samples are genuine, unforged video samples; extracting spatial structural features of preceding video frames contained in the video sample segments; learning the temporal sequence patterns between preceding video frames based on the spatial structural features; predicting the content corresponding to subsequent video frames based on the embedded frame vectors corresponding to the preceding parts; calculating a loss based on the predicted content and the actual content; and adjusting the parameters of the video authentication model based on the loss. Thus, by training the video authentication model using genuine video samples, over-reliance on specific forgery traces can be avoided, thereby effectively handling various types of video authentication scenarios. Specifically, it can achieve efficient detection of novel, unknown types of forged videos, improving the generalization ability of the video authentication model.

title: An AI-based campus intrusion detection and response system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image recognition, in particular to an AI-based park intrusion detection and response system, which comprises a target track acquisition module, an event density analysis module, a disturbance behavior recognition module and a response joint control execution module. According to the invention, through fusion of space-time characteristics of the target track and motion vector pattern recognition, intrusion behavior dynamic risk assessment and early warning collaborative optimization are realized, multidimensional data association calculation and event density increment monitoring are combined, abnormal situation perception sensitivity and discrimination accuracy under a complex scene are improved, camouflage behavior and irregular motion capturing capacity are enhanced by utilizing motion vector time sequence modeling and disturbance characteristic extraction, environment perception and response execution closed-loop control links are constructed by means of intelligent matching and parameter self-adaptive adjustment of multi-source sensing equipment, manual rechecking dependency is remarkably reduced, recognition-to-treatment response delay is shortened, and an early warning research and judgment and linkage treatment full-flow automatic system is formed.

title: Competition management system and method based on cloud computing
description: The invention relates to a competition management system and method based on cloud computing, and belongs to the technical field of resource allocation. The method comprises the steps of dynamically obtaining competition information to determine the number of virtual machines, physical resources and competition grades, automatically associating resource priorities, guaranteeing stable allocation of high-grade competition item resources, constructing a scheduling model through a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to generate a virtual machine allocation probability matrix, evaluating long-term benefits by combining a reward function, realizing autonomous learning optimization of a scheduling strategy, constructing a multi-dimensional server state matrix, quantitatively matching tasks and hardware characteristics, reducing task interruption risks, generating a dynamic tag system by combining static code analysis and runtime data to ensure key competition item resource allocation, and grading competition items and defining resource demand vectors to realize grading dynamic resource adjustment. The invention improves the fairness, the system stability and the intelligent level of competition management by obviously improving the resource utilization rate and the load balancing capability.

title: Motion control method for realizing stop of modularized bus station
description: The invention discloses a motion control method for realizing modularized bus stop, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of constructing a motion control model and defining an objective function, acquiring module bus data and environment sense data, inputting the module bus data and the environment sense data into a trained first neural network model to obtain a weight coefficient, weighting the objective function through the weight coefficient, and solving the objective function under the motion control model to obtain an optimal control quantity.

title: Method and system for extracting high generalization water based on remote sensing image
description: The application relates to a method and a system for extracting a water body with high generalization based on a remote sensing image, wherein the extraction method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source remote sensing image data, marking the water body, cutting into image blocks with preset sizes, generating original and label image block data sets, carrying out data enhancement processing, and generating an enhanced data set; the method comprises the steps of screening a band combination with the maximum inter-class variance, generating an expansion data set with the optimal band, preprocessing data, generating a vector format data set, dividing the vector format data set into a training set, a verification set and a test set, constructing a SAM model in advance, performing first-stage fine adjustment on an image encoder based on the training set and the verification set, performing second-stage fine adjustment on a mask decoder based on the training set and the verification set to obtain a fine-adjusted water body extraction professional model, and inputting remote sensing image data to be extracted into the water body extraction professional model to obtain a full-size water body extraction result image. The application can improve the precision and generalization capability of water body extraction.

title: Enterprise Digital Systems and Methods Based on SaaS Microservice Architecture
description: This invention discloses an enterprise digital system and method based on a SaaS microservice architecture, belonging to the field of enterprise digital technology. The method includes the following steps: S1, collecting multi-tenant microservice call data and configuration information to generate basic service path data; S2, constructing a jump path tensor structure to represent multi-hop dependencies and contextual relationships between services; S3, constructing a path modeling network including path attention and gating mechanisms to extract key path features; S4, setting a structure optimization function with targets for response latency, path accuracy, and model complexity; S5, applying the Spotted Hyena optimization algorithm to globally optimize the network structure parameters; S6, outputting the optimal structure and modeling parameters to achieve system structure deployment and service scheduling optimization. This invention achieves accurate modeling and efficient optimized deployment of cross-tenant service paths, significantly improving system response performance and structural stability.

title: Transformer multi-target tracking method based on relative position sensing
description: This invention relates to the field of computer vision technology, and particularly to a Transformer multi-object tracking method based on relative position awareness. The method includes: modeling the relative positional relationships of image features extracted from targets using a rotational attention module to obtain tracking results; performing spatial clustering of the tracking results using a spatial grouping attention module to obtain tracking query results; using collective average loss (CAL) to aggregate prediction results from multiple frames in a video sequence to optimize the temporal dependencies of the rotational and spatial grouping attention modules; and performing Transformer multi-object tracking based on the optimized modules. This invention aims to enhance the model's ability to perceive spatial relationships between targets. RP2Track improves the model's ability to capture relative position information by introducing rotational position encoding and a spatial grouping attention module.

title: A composite characterization method for multi-source heterogeneous nondestructive testing signals of metal structure defects based on deep neural network and attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses a metal structure defect multi-source heterogeneous nondestructive testing signal composite characterization method based on a deep neural network and an attention mechanism. According to the method, a deep neural network model is built, and the data fusion and defect composite characterization are carried out on multi-source heterogeneous signals obtained by three nondestructive detection technologies, namely magnetic flux leakage detection, electromagnetic ultrasonic detection and electromagnetic guided wave detection by combining an attention mechanism. The method comprises the steps of firstly simplifying data processing and analysis flow by advanced signal processing and data fusion technology, realizing effective processing and interpretation of complex data, improving detection efficiency and reliability, and then realizing more accurate and comprehensive characterization of the size, type, shape and position of the metal structure defect by comprehensively utilizing information of different signal sources, thereby providing innovative technical support for nondestructive detection in the industrial field.

title: SEI thickness obtaining method, device, storage medium and program product
description: The present disclosure provides a method, device, storage medium, and program product for determining SEI thickness. The method includes: inputting an image containing an SEI region into a pre-trained instance segmentation model to identify the SEI region from the image using the instance segmentation model; obtaining scale values and scale lines in the image to establish a correspondence between pixels and physical dimensions in the image; performing curve fitting on the contour of the SEI region identified from the image to obtain a contour curve of the SEI region; and determining the thickness of the SEI region based on the contour curve and the correspondence between pixels and physical dimensions. The present disclosure can improve the efficiency and accuracy of SEI region thickness analysis.

title: Particle swarm optimization-based energy storage scheduling method and system for photovoltaic energy storage system
description: The invention provides an energy storage scheduling method and system of a photovoltaic energy storage system based on particle swarm optimization, wherein the point with the maximum rising rate of an energy storage capacity-maximum annual average peak clipping proportion curve is selected, the initial capacity of the energy storage system is determined, the state of charge, load power, photovoltaic power generation power and time of the energy storage system are used as state spaces, the energy storage power is used as an optimization action, the product of the maximum grid power peak square root and the daily grid power peak square sum in a time period is minimized as an optimization target, a particle swarm optimization algorithm is trained, energy storage capacity alternative values are selected at equal intervals within the range of +/-A% of the initial capacity, the energy storage capacity alternative values are traversed through the trained particle swarm optimization algorithm, and the weighted sum of the internal yield IRR and the cost recovery is maximally used as an objective function to obtain an energy storage capacity configuration value and a corresponding action strategy. The accurate control of the energy storage capacity and the charge and discharge power is realized.

title: Fatigue loss calculation method, device and medium for photovoltaic bracket of offshore photovoltaic
description: The present disclosure relates to a fatigue loss calculation method, device, and medium for an offshore photovoltaic support, and relates to the technical field of fatigue loss analysis. The method comprises: determining the current service condition of the photovoltaic support to be tested based on current environmental data; determining the current load type of the photovoltaic support to be tested under the current service condition, and calculating the current load value of the photovoltaic support to be tested under the current service condition based on the current load type; inputting the current service condition and current environmental data into a preset weight coefficient prediction model to determine the load weight coefficient of the current load type based on the current service condition; determining the total load value of the photovoltaic support to be tested based on the current load value and the load weight coefficient corresponding to the current load value, and calculating the current fatigue loss of the photovoltaic support to be tested based on the total load value. The present disclosure improves the calculation efficiency of fatigue loss.

title: Electric power material thinking chain soft label generation method and device
description: The present invention discloses a method and device for generating soft labels for a thought chain of electric power materials. The method comprises: obtaining historical review data of electric power materials; extracting and analyzing features of the historical review data of electric power materials based on a pre-built multimodal neural network model to generate a first thought chain; verifying and correcting the first thought chain in combination with a reasoning rule base for electric power material review to obtain a second thought chain; integrating a Bayesian network and a conditional random field to quantify the dependency between each step in the second thought chain of the electric power material to-be-reviewed data, obtaining a basic similarity, dependency coefficient, and uncertainty coefficient for each step, determining weights in combination with preset labels, determining soft labels for each step, and generating soft labels for the thought chain of electric power materials. The present invention improves thought chains and soft label generation, quantifies review opinions, and generates corresponding soft labels, making the review process traceable and ensuring the review effect to a certain extent.

title: Gate opening flow dynamic coupling prediction method based on AI driving
description: The invention discloses a gate opening flow dynamic coupling prediction method based on AI driving, which relates to the field of hydraulic engineering and comprises the steps of obtaining a conversion function, establishing a sedimentation simulation model, establishing a water flow extrusion model, establishing a water flow blocking model, taking a conventional opening partition exposed by opening a gate controlled by opening as a target opening partition, dividing the target opening partition into a first target opening partition and a second target opening partition based on the water surface at the downstream of the gate, predicting the water flow speed of a characteristic opening partition, taking the water flow speed of the characteristic opening partition as the characteristic speed, calculating the water flow speed of the target opening partition as the target speed, and obtaining a prediction function of the opening area and the gate opening flow. The method comprises the steps of forming a conversion function, establishing a sedimentation simulation model, establishing a water flow extrusion model, establishing a water flow blocking model, classifying target opening partitions, obtaining a prediction function, and opening a gate to a required size according to a prediction result to generate required flow.

title: Method and system for quickly constructing BIM (building information modeling) model of clustered medical building
description: The invention relates to a method and a system for quickly constructing a BIM model of a clustered medical building, which are used for constructing a multi-attribute thinking tree based on design requirements, pruning by combining a medical prototype library with a compliance bundle, generating a DAG according to leaf node tasks of the pruned thinking tree, endowing inter-dependent key levels to DAG edges based on cluster linkage among tasks to form a weighted DAG, planning an agent to determine task priority and resource allocation according to the weighted DAG to generate an execution sequence, generating an agent by BIM codes, processing tasks according to the sequence, generating component codes by adopting a thinking chain process of grading confidence score, calculating the confidence degree according to node attributes and medical geometric rules at the end of each stage, and adjusting and restarting the thinking chain if the confidence degree is lower than a threshold dynamically adjusted based on the complexity of a cluster unit. And when the confidence level is continuously too low or the critical task cluster is completed, checking and correcting the intervention of the intelligent agent, checking and correcting the generated code, and collecting the corrected code to construct the BIM model.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle power inspection image intelligent analysis method, system and medium based on deep learning and multi-mode fusion
description: The present invention discloses a method, system and medium for intelligent analysis of UAV power inspection images based on deep learning and multimodal fusion, and relates to the technical field of power equipment detection. The method comprises: using the A* algorithm to plan the optimal inspection path and realize multi-sensor synchronous data acquisition; performing adaptive histogram equalization and dehazing processing on visible light images, performing non-uniformity correction and temperature calibration on infrared images, filtering and aligning point cloud data; constructing a multi-scale feature fusion network based on the improved VGGNet‑16, introducing deformable convolution and cross-modal attention mechanism to realize multi-source data fusion; performing defect detection based on a three-level template library and feature map cross-correlation algorithm, combining non-maximum suppression and sub-pixel positioning to improve accuracy; and finally generating a test report containing defect type, location and maintenance suggestions. The present invention significantly improves the automation level and detection accuracy of power inspections.

title: Chart analysis method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present invention provides a chart parsing method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium, belonging to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method comprises: extracting visual features of a chart image to be parsed; and inputting the visual features into a multimodal large language model to obtain a structured parsing result of the chart image output by the multimodal large language model. The present invention provides a first task adaptation module composed of multiple first expert modules and a first gating network within the multimodal large language model. The first gating network is used to dynamically assign chart parsing tasks to different first expert modules for collaborative processing, thereby improving the comprehensiveness and accuracy of chart parsing. Furthermore, because the present invention constructs the first expert module based on low-rank adaptation technology, only a small number of parameters need to be updated during training. This improves chart parsing capabilities while effectively retaining the general world knowledge learned by the multimodal large language model during pre-training, thus avoiding the problem of world knowledge forgetting.

title: Sign language recognition method and device based on improved YOLOv12
description: This invention discloses a sign language recognition method and device based on an improved YOLOv12. The method comprises: obtaining a target sign language video and converting it into a target image; improving the YOLOv12 model through an efficient multi-scale large-kernel attention mechanism and deformable dilated convolution to obtain a sign language recognition model; inputting the target image into the sign language recognition model to obtain sign language categories; and integrating the sign language categories to obtain a target sign language recognition result. This invention can improve the accuracy and speed of sign language recognition and can be widely applied in the field of computer vision technology.

title: Missing data filling model building method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for establishing a missing data filling model, wherein the method for establishing the missing data filling model comprises the steps of obtaining historical energy data in an energy station; based on the historical energy data, a data missing mask matrix is generated by adopting a random simulation algorithm, a missing sample data set is generated and constructed based on the historical energy data and the data missing mask matrix, a machine learning model which is built in advance is subjected to model training by adopting the missing sample data set until a preset model training ending condition is met, and the trained machine learning model is used as a missing data filling model. By the scheme, the authenticity of filling the missing data is improved.

title: Strong thunderstorm potential risk and intensity prediction method based on artificial neural network
description: The present invention is applicable to the field of thunderstorm prediction technology and provides a method for predicting the potential risk and intensity of severe thunderstorms based on an artificial neural network. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining ground-to-ground lightning data in a target area, determining the temporal distribution characteristics of thunderstorm events, and identifying the temporal trough of thunderstorm events; collecting multi-source meteorological data in the target area and screening meteorological prediction factor data; performing spatiotemporal alignment processing on the ground-to-ground lightning data and the meteorological prediction factor data, and constructing a daily sample set of grid units based on the aligned data; constructing a probability classification model for the occurrence of severe thunderstorm events based on the daily sample set of grid units; constructing a regression neural network model for grid units determined as having a high risk of severe thunderstorms based on the probability classification model; outputting collaborative prediction results, and synchronously outputting predicted values of the ground-to-ground lightning frequency and the geometric mean of the lightning current amplitude. Through double-order modeling, a risk assessment basis for classification discrimination and numerical prediction capabilities is provided for extreme weather warning and power grid disaster prevention and mitigation.

title: A Cross-Domain Collaborative Detection Method for PCB Defects Based on Multimodal Model
description: The invention provides a multi-mode model-based PCB defect cross-domain collaborative detection method, which comprises the steps of collecting an X-ray image and an optical image, and processing the X-ray image and the optical image by adopting a Vision Transformer model to obtain visual characteristics. And processing the production log text by adopting the BERT model to obtain text characteristics. And performing feature alignment on the visual features and the text features by adopting a cross attention mechanism to obtain fusion features. And carrying out defect classification on the fusion characteristics to obtain the PCB defect type. Processing the X-ray image and the optical image by Vision Transformer model enables capturing the internal features of the PCB defect and the surface features of the PCB defect simultaneously. And understanding and analyzing the production log text through the BERT model, and extracting the technological parameter information related to the defects. And the visual features and the text features are aligned through a cross attention mechanism, so that feature fusion among the multi-mode data is realized.

title: Deep learning-based osteoporosis classification detection method
description: The invention relates to an osteoporosis classification detection method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining medical image data, preprocessing the medical image data to highlight key features, carrying out data enhancement operation on the preprocessed medical image data, constructing a data set for training, loading a pre-trained visual transformation deep learning model, inputting the data set for classification training, optimizing the data set through a multi-scale feature fusion structure to obtain a trained classification model, enhancing the recognition capability of bone density difference, carrying out classification prediction on verification data according to the trained classification model, and outputting a classification result. The invention adds a multi-scale feature fusion module on the basis of a model, enhances the capturing capability of fine density change of bones, optimizes training efficiency and deployment feasibility through combination of standardized preprocessing and migration learning and data enhancement, balances efficiency and precision, and has good clinical application potential.

title: Railway foreign matter intrusion monitoring method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a railway foreign object intrusion monitoring method, device, equipment and readable storage medium, which are applied to the field of railway safety monitoring technology, including: using laser scanning point cloud data to construct a spatiotemporal environment base state model in a safe environment; using the spatiotemporal environment base state model to perform environmental risk assessment on the first real-time point cloud data obtained by dynamic laser scanning, and adjusting the scanning mode according to the assessment results; when the scanning mode is focused scanning, hierarchical feature extraction is performed based on the second real-time point cloud data in a dangerous environment obtained by focused scanning to determine the foreign object contour, foreign object movement trajectory and foreign object category. The present invention constructs a spatiotemporal environment base state model based on the time dimension, and uses this model to judge the railway environment; by adjusting the scanning mode to perform dynamic energy distribution, save energy and avoid the interference of special weather on the laser scanning data collection; and uses hierarchical feature extraction to provide size, type and threat feedback on the intrusion of foreign objects on the running track.

title: Power load prediction method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present disclosure relates to a method, device, electronic device, and storage medium for power load forecasting. The method comprises: obtaining load energy consumption time series data corresponding to a load device within a preset time period; performing low-frequency time series forecasting based on a preset SARIMA model to obtain low-frequency forecast data corresponding to the load device at the next moment; performing high-frequency time series forecasting based on a preset ELM model to obtain high-frequency forecast data corresponding to the load device at the next moment; fusing the low-frequency forecast data and the high-frequency forecast data to obtain the overall load energy consumption corresponding to the load device at the next moment. Thus, the SARIMA and ELM two-segment load time series forecasting models can accurately capture the changing characteristics of load time series at different time scales, and then obtain the overall load energy consumption of the load device through fusion processing, thereby improving the accuracy of load forecasting.

title: A method and device for detecting particle size of green silicon carbide micropowder
description: The invention relates to the technical field of granularity detection, and discloses a method and a device for detecting granularity of green silicon carbide micropowder, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting granularity distribution data to obtain a two-dimensional detection data set; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing to obtain a particle size distribution data set, reducing the dimension, analyzing the particle size distribution data set to form a particle size distribution feature vector, obtaining a proportioning parameter time sequence of silicon and carbon content, calculating a correlation coefficient of the particle size distribution feature vector and proportioning parameters, establishing a dynamic particle size prediction model, inputting real-time silicon and carbon content data into the dynamic particle size prediction model to obtain particle size distribution features, adjusting the silicon and carbon content when a main particle size interval deviates from a preset target particle size range to obtain an optimized proportioning parameter time sequence, updating the model based on the optimized proportioning parameter time sequence to obtain an adjusted particle size prediction model, and repeatedly predicting to obtain optimized particle size distribution features. The method can realize accurate prediction and dynamic adjustment of the particle size distribution and improve the particle size stability of the product.

title: A tunable large language model active recommendation agent system
description: This invention discloses a tunable large language model active recommendation agent system. The system comprises an actor-advisor framework, consisting of an actor module and an advisor module. The advisor module is configured to generate a structured guidance signal based on the user's historical data, current state, and environmental rewards; the actor module is configured to generate a recommended action based on the current state and the guidance signal; the commentator module is configured to calculate state values and action advantage values; and the optimization module is configured to fine-tune the underlying large language model of the actor and advisor modules using a direct preference optimization algorithm based on the action advantage values. Given a target item, this system can gradually explore a user's potential interests, expand the user's interest boundaries, and increase their interest in the target item. It is applicable to recommendation scenarios such as major online social networking platforms and e-commerce platforms.

title: A Method and Device for Abnormal Parking Detection in Highway Scenarios Based on Large Models
description: This disclosure provides a method and apparatus for detecting abnormal parking in highway scenarios based on a large model, relating to artificial intelligence technologies such as autonomous driving, large language models, and image feature detection. The method includes: acquiring temporal video of a highway scene; extracting multi-scale features from each video frame constituting the temporal video; determining the image quality information and environmental information of each video frame based on its multi-scale features; determining the location and category information of traffic elements in each video frame based on its image quality information, environmental information, and multi-scale features; determining the movement trajectory of the same traffic element based on its location, category, and temporal information between video frames; and identifying the abnormal parking event based on the movement trajectory. This method can accurately detect abnormal parking events in highway scenarios.

title: Multi-agent collaborative medical stroke follow-up voice dialogue system and its construction method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of model voice interaction, and particularly discloses a multi-agent cooperative medical stroke follow-up voice dialogue system and a construction method thereof; according to the invention, the voice interaction model, the playing_agent module, the knowledge retrieval agent module, the question _ rewrite _agent module and the messages_agent module are arranged as system components, the knowledge retrieval agent module builds a database by crawling real and reliable professional knowledge of stroke, so that the illusion of building a large model can be avoided, the question _ rewrite _agent module and the playing_agent module cooperate, long problems generated in the interaction process can be resolved into a plurality of sub problems, errors in the problems are corrected, the system is prevented from generating deviation in resolving interaction information, and the resolving capability and stability of the system are effectively improved.

title: A multi-parameter status monitoring and fault warning system for box-type transformers based on the Industrial Internet
description: The invention discloses a box transformer substation multi-parameter state monitoring and fault early warning system based on an industrial internet, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of industrial equipment and comprises a data acquisition and quality quantization unit, a dynamic weight optimizing unit and a causal relationship reasoning unit, wherein the data acquisition and quality quantization unit is used for gathering monitoring data from a sensor and quantizing the quality of the monitoring data in real time to generate a data quality vector, the dynamic weight optimizing unit is used for receiving fault posterior probability distribution output by the data quality vector and the causal relationship reasoning unit, forming the current state of a decision environment based on the data quality vector and the fault posterior probability distribution and further outputting evidence weight vector through a built-in reinforcement learning agent, and the causal relationship reasoning unit is used for receiving the evidence weight vector and weighting a conditional probability table of a built-in dynamic Bayesian network model by utilizing the evidence weight vector and further updating and outputting the fault posterior probability distribution.

title: A data-driven method for predicting operating conditions of industrial processes
description: The invention discloses a data-driven industrial process operation condition prediction method, which belongs to the technical field of condition prediction, and comprises the steps of regarding each production batch as a node, obtaining embedded characteristics of the node, and embedding the node characteristics, wherein the production batch comprises a historical batch with known conditions and a future batch with unknown conditions, the nodes corresponding to the historical batch are known label nodes, the nodes corresponding to the future batch are unknown label nodes, constructing a dynamic diagram containing a plurality of known label nodes and one unknown label node, carrying out node characteristic propagation and updating in the dynamic diagram to obtain the missing characteristics of the unknown label node, and combining the missing characteristics and the embedded characteristics of the unknown label node to realize industrial process operation condition prediction. The data-driven industrial process operation condition prediction method provided by the invention solves the problems of characteristic extraction and condition prediction under the heterogeneous condition of multiple sources of data.

title: Paint corrosion resistance prediction method and system based on reinforcement learning model
description: This invention discloses a method and system for predicting the corrosion resistance of coatings based on a reinforcement learning model, belonging to the field of coating corrosion resistance prediction technology. The method includes collecting data on coatings in corrosive environments, using the YOLO v5 algorithm to form a structured corrosion performance data table, generating time-series corrosion states through interpolation methods combined with kinetic equations, and training a reinforcement learning model using an improved Double DQN algorithm to generate corrosion resistance adjustment strategies. This method not only accurately reflects the corrosion behavior of coatings in corrosive environments but also rapidly generates corrosion resistance optimization adjustment strategies, achieving intelligent and efficient corrosion performance adjustment.

title: Knowledge graph presentation method, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: This invention relates to the field of data processing technology, and in particular to a knowledge graph presentation method, electronic device, and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining several key nodes from a given knowledge graph; dividing a preset presentation page into an initial node grid containing several grid units and obtaining the grid unit corresponding to each key node in the initial node grid; calculating the area allocation score corresponding to each key node; adjusting the area of the grid unit corresponding to each key node in the initial node grid based on the area allocation score corresponding to each key node to obtain a target node grid; and adjusting the presentation positions of each key node and non-key node based on the target node grid to obtain the final presented target knowledge graph. This invention can optimize the node positions in the knowledge graph, achieve a reasonable layout of the presentation page, and make the presented knowledge graph clearer.

title: Ocean thermocline space-time prediction method and system based on thermodynamic constraint
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of ocean thermocline prediction, and discloses an ocean thermocline space-time prediction method and system based on thermodynamic constraint. The method comprises the steps of constructing and preprocessing a data set, constructing a thermodynamic constraint-based ocean thermocline space-time prediction model, completing extraction of thermocline space-time characteristics, training and applying the model, completing space-time prediction from a sea surface layer to different underwater depth temperatures in the future, and completing thermocline multi-characteristic space-time extraction according to the different underwater depth temperatures obtained through prediction by combining a quasi-step function approximation QFA and a vertical gradient criterion GC zoning identification strategy. By introducing physical mechanism constraint, the invention not only improves the accuracy of thermocline prediction, but also enhances the interpretability of the model, and realizes the multi-key characteristic time-space prediction from sea surface data to underwater thermocline.

title: Semantic enhancement self-adaptive blocking method and system for natural resource large model question and answer
description: The invention provides a semantic enhancement self-adaptive blocking method and a semantic enhancement self-adaptive blocking system for a natural resource large model question and answer, which aim to solve the problems of difficult recognition of a term boundary, damage of semantic integrity and the like. The method integrates three core technologies, namely, topic-aware coarse-granularity paragraph division, self-adaptive sliding window topic level division and context self-adaptive text segmentation of embedded perception. The system analyzes the long text structure of natural resources, identifies the title and the theme level, aligns the related content, extracts paragraphs according to the theme perception strategy, subdivides the paragraphs into sentence sets according to the rules of language, and adopts an improved sliding window mechanism to divide the sentences into window sentence block groups. The method is characterized in that a dynamic aggregation threshold mechanism is introduced, semantic relevance between adjacent sentence blocks is calculated through a context semantic segmentation technology of embedded perception, and whether sentence blocks are merged or not is judged by dynamically adjusting a threshold according to a similarity distribution change trend, so that self-adaptive demarcation of semantic boundaries is realized, and text blocks with clear structures and coherent semantics are generated.

title: Multi-type energy storage phased capacity optimization configuration method for new energy uncertainty
description: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a multi-type energy storage staged capacity optimization configuration method of new energy uncertainty, which comprises the steps of collecting energy storage parameters, new energy output and user load data through edge equipment, and generating a high-confidence data set by checking photovoltaic conversion efficiency and electrochemical behavior of a lithium battery through a physical model; the federal collaborative system fuses the distributed node data to output a health degree distribution map, a memory network analyzes the temperature and the charge-discharge coupling effect to generate a dynamic compensation coefficient alpha, an optimization engine receives an alpha value and wind-light prediction, a parallel algorithm generates a staged scheme and inputs the staged scheme into a simulation system for verification, an edge node executes the scheme and acquires response data, and a twin body compares the simulated value with the actual deviation to update an acquisition strategy. According to the method, data distortion is eliminated through physical rule verification, the state deviation of an aging unit is corrected through a dynamic compensation mechanism, the real-time health degree of decision binding is optimized, and the charge-discharge analysis errors of a virtual power plant dispatching desk are effectively prevented.

title: Method for reconstructing three-dimensional model based on artificial intelligence by utilizing two-dimensional image and application thereof
description: The invention provides a method for reconstructing a three-dimensional model based on artificial intelligence by utilizing a two-dimensional image and application thereof, when an implant is needed to replace a pathological tissue in operation, the pathological tissue is not required to be scanned by adopting three-dimensional CT scanning, and the three-dimensional model of the pathological tissue can be obtained by the artificial intelligence model only by shooting a two-dimensional medical image. The doctor can know the specific condition of the operation part through the three-dimensional model, then makes a specific operation scheme, can also directly design corresponding implants and customized operation auxiliary tools on the three-dimensional model aiming at the operation part, can also automatically generate related auxiliary designs of the implants and the operation auxiliary tools in the manufacturing process of the three-dimensional printing technology, and finally sends the generated design data of the implants and the operation auxiliary tools to the three-dimensional printing equipment to directly finish the printing operation of the implants and the operation auxiliary tools. The workflow can be greatly simplified, the accuracy can be improved, and the requirements for customizing the design of the medical device can be greatly improved.

title: Video cross-mode pedestrian detection method based on time-space high-frequency information
description: The invention discloses a video cross-mode pedestrian detection method based on time-space high-frequency information, and belongs to the field of computer audio visual software. The method comprises the steps of acquiring a visible light pedestrian video sequence and an infrared pedestrian video sequence, mapping the visible light pedestrian video sequence and the infrared pedestrian video sequence to a frequency domain space through three-dimensional fast Fourier transform, obtaining a time-space high-frequency pedestrian sequence through filtering and inverse three-dimensional fast Fourier transform by a constructed time-space high-pass filter, performing data enhancement operation, extracting characteristics of the pedestrian video sequence and the time-space high-frequency characteristics through a double-flow network, obtaining high-frequency detail enhancement characteristics through a fusion network, and finally obtaining a final detection result by adopting a joint optimization double-flow network. The invention operates the video sequence instead of a single frame image, thereby constructing a sequence-level intermediate mode containing time sequence information, meeting the complex requirement of pedestrian re-identification task of video visible light-infrared light, and having wide application prospect in the fields of intelligent security, video monitoring and the like.

title: AI safety monitoring method and system based on database access analysis
description: The invention discloses an AI safety monitoring method and system based on database access analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an access request of a target user to a target database, predicting key attention fields in the access request based on a neural network model, analyzing field risks corresponding to the key attention fields according to a plurality of historical access records related to the target database, and determining an access strategy when the target user accesses the target database according to the field risks. Therefore, the method and the system can realize accurate database access control based on important attention fields and risk assessment, improve the security and access efficiency of the target database, and reduce the risk of access holes caused by risk fields.

title: Acquired image recognition method and system for surveying and mapping unmanned aerial vehicle
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for image acquisition recognition for a surveying and mapping drone. The method uses a multimodal sensor carried by the drone to acquire surveying image data and surveying point cloud data of a target surveying and mapping area. A time camera is used to capture motion signals of dynamic targets and generate event stream data. The surveying and mapping image data is subjected to histogram equalization and multi-scale enhancement, and the surveying and mapping point cloud data is subjected to voxel filtering and surface reconstruction. Wavelet packet decomposition is used to extract frequency domain features of the image in the pre-processed acquisition data and fuse them with motion trajectory features in the event stream data. The mixed feature vector is input into a lightweight adaptive model, and the weights of different modalities are dynamically adjusted through an attention mechanism to output the surveying and mapping results of the target surveying and mapping area. This method can more comprehensively and meticulously describe image information at different frequencies and directions, effectively improving surveying and mapping efficiency.

title: Detection device and method for lumbar degenerative diseases
description: The present application discloses a device and method for detecting lumbar degenerative disease, relating to the field of image processing technology. The device comprises: an acquisition module for acquiring lumbar magnetic resonance images to be processed; a preprocessing module connected to the acquisition module for preprocessing the lumbar magnetic resonance images to obtain different image sequences; a detection module connected to the preprocessing module for inputting the different image sequences into a trained computer-aided diagnosis network for lumbar degenerative disease for detection, thereby determining the type, severity, and location of the lumbar degenerative disease; wherein the types of lumbar degenerative disease include spinal stenosis, neural foraminal stenosis, and subarticular stenosis; the computer-aided diagnosis network for lumbar degenerative disease includes a spinal stenosis detection subnetwork, a neural foraminal stenosis detection subnetwork, and a subarticular stenosis detection subnetwork; each subnetwork includes multiple feature extractors. The present application improves the detection efficiency of lumbar degenerative disease.

title: A Method for Predicting the Effect of Epidermal Growth Factor Addition Based on Growth Performance Data
description: This invention discloses a method for predicting the effect of epidermal growth factor (EGF) addition based on growth performance data, belonging to the field of time series data analysis technology. The method includes: collecting target object data and structuring the data to establish an original dataset containing growth performance time series, environmental variables, and EGF addition dose records; calculating residuals after preprocessing, performing wavelet decomposition, and combining them into input features; inputting the data into a dual-track learning model to obtain individualized causal effect estimation and dose-time-growth performance prediction mapping; then performing new observations of the target object to establish correction factors, and outputting the prediction results after compensation. This invention solves the technical problem that traditional EGF addition effect prediction methods lack consideration for dynamic changes in the time dimension and individual differences among different target objects, making it difficult to meet the technical requirements of accurate assessment and individualized regulation, thus achieving accurate and comprehensive prediction of the EGF addition effect.

title: Machine Learning-Based Parametric Modeling Algorithm for Port Wave Spectrum
description: This invention discloses a machine learning-based parameterized modeling algorithm for port wave spectra, relating to the field of marine engineering technology. The invention achieves high-precision modeling through three steps: First, a federated learning framework is constructed, where each data provider trains a sub-model that shares only parameters. Homomorphic encrypted feature fusion and dynamic weight adjustment are combined to achieve privacy-preserving data fusion. Second, a generative adversarial network is deployed on each local node. Multi-scale wave features are extracted through a frequency-domain hierarchical attention branch network, wave energy conservation constraints are implanted, and the generator is optimized to generate extreme samples that conform to physical laws, forming a hybrid training dataset. Third, a CNN-LSTM base model is trained, and dynamic model optimization is achieved through sliding window, forgetting factor, Bayesian optimization, and performance monitoring and reconstruction. This invention effectively improves the accuracy and long-term stability of wave spectrum prediction, reduces maintenance costs, and can be applied to scenarios such as port vessel berthing and disaster early warning.

title: A Method and System for Event Heat Prediction Based on Multi-Perspective Neural Hawkes Processes
description: This invention discloses a method and system for predicting event popularity based on multi-view neural Hawkes processes, relating to the field of data mining technology. The method includes: receiving a streaming event popularity prediction dataset, which is constructed based on event-related data, including post information, comment information, and popularity information; extracting a training set from the streaming event popularity prediction dataset; inputting the training set into a pre-established streaming event popularity prediction model based on multi-view neural Hawkes processes; training the model using a negative log-maximum likelihood loss function; and inputting the streaming event popularity prediction dataset into the trained streaming event popularity prediction model based on multi-view neural Hawkes processes to output the event popularity prediction result, thereby enhancing prediction accuracy.

title: Boiler efficiency soft measurement method, system and medium based on CNN-ELM
description: The invention discloses a boiler efficiency soft measurement method, system and medium based on CNN-ELM, which comprises the following steps of 1, collecting historical operation data, 2, preprocessing the data, 3, constructing a CNN-ELM model, 4, training the CNN-ELM model by using a training set, determining the optimal network structure and parameter setting, 5, inputting test set data into the optimized CNN-ELM model, obtaining a prediction result, performing inverse normalization processing, then analyzing and evaluating the prediction result by using an evaluation function, and 6, inputting the boiler operation data collected in real time into the trained CNN-ELM model, and outputting a dynamic thermal efficiency prediction value. The invention can effectively overcome the defect of a single model, realize high-precision dynamic measurement of the thermal efficiency of the boiler, and remarkably improve the precision and instantaneity of the measurement of the thermal efficiency of the boiler.

title: Method, system and equipment for dynamically selecting and optimizing search path for intention perception
description: This disclosure provides an intent-aware dynamic selection and optimization method, system, and device for retrieval paths. Applied to the field of artificial intelligence technology, the method includes: classifying user questions using a classification model to identify the relational entities of the user questions and the relationships between them; fine-grainedly dividing the intents and their corresponding intent tags into types; determining a path list and invocation strategy based on the fine-grained types; determining whether the relationships between the relational entities of the user questions are causal; if so, obtaining the optimal causal path; otherwise, obtaining the optimal non-causal path; generating an optimized answer by retrieving the answer paragraph of the user question through the optimal causal path; or directly obtaining the optimized answer of the user question through the optimal non-causal path; calculating a path score based on real-time user behavior data, and feeding back the path score for optimization. This disclosure significantly improves the accuracy, efficiency, and user experience of retrieval paths.

title: A node separation learning method and system based on discrimination difficulty awareness
