description: The invention discloses a node separation learning method and a system based on discrimination difficulty perception, and relates to the technical field of graph neural networks; the method comprises the steps of constructing a hybrid expert network architecture, splicing entropy values and node characteristics, predicting a threshold value for a Top-p expert selection mechanism, activating a private sub-network set according to the threshold value, combining the output of the private sub-network set in a weighting mode to generate node representation, finally obtaining a prediction result through a classifier, and dynamically updating the entropy values in a training process. The method can adaptively allocate the computing resources and improve the accuracy and the robustness of the classification of the nodes of the heteroleptic graph.

title: A method, equipment, and medium for digital management and control of enterprise projects based on AI big data models.
description: The invention discloses an AI large model-based enterprise project digital management and control method, equipment and medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, comprising the steps of receiving a research report and a project data table, extracting text feature vectors and numerical feature matrixes through a lightweight large model, injecting Laplace noise, and generating an encryption feature vector set; the method comprises the steps of inputting a research report into a knowledge privacy protection review agent for content analysis, carrying out risk verification and historical case matching through real-time query of a dynamic knowledge graph to generate a structured review result, carrying out logic verification on the structured review result to generate interpretable evidence, adding the interpretable evidence to the structured review result to obtain a review report with an evidence chain, and obviously reducing reverse inference risk caused by gradient leakage by introducing a lightweight large model in a feature extraction stage and combining with a Laplace noise injection and encryption mechanism.

title: GIS disconnect switch fault diagnosis method
description: This invention discloses a fault diagnosis method for GIS disconnect switches. The method acquires the voltage and current signals of the GIS disconnect switch and performs noise reduction using a wavelet filtering algorithm. It extracts the modal function components of the current signal under different states as frequency domain features using EMD, and fuses the frequency domain and time domain features using PCA to obtain a fused feature set. The fused feature set is divided into a training sample set and a test sample set. The kernel parameters and penalty factor of the support vector machine model are optimized using an improved whale optimization algorithm. The support vector machine model is trained and tested based on the training and test sample sets to obtain a GIS disconnect switch fault diagnosis model. The fused feature set of the GIS disconnect switch is input into the GIS disconnect switch fault diagnosis model to identify GIS disconnect switch faults. This method achieves efficient fault diagnosis of high-voltage disconnect switches using a limited number of features when there are few fault samples.

title: Task monitoring method, system, terminal and storage medium based on multiple agents
description: The invention relates to the technical field of task monitoring, and discloses a task monitoring method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium based on multiple intelligent agents, wherein the method comprises the following steps: decomposing the target task, storing the subtask information of each subtask into different arrays, transmitting the subtask information to a plurality of subtask execution models, and executing the subtasks by the subtask execution models according to the subtask information to obtain corresponding execution results; and monitoring the process of executing the subtasks according to the risk information to obtain a corresponding monitoring result. According to the invention, through a modularized design and a cooperation mechanism, efficient allocation and cooperation processing of tasks are realized, and meanwhile, through a risk monitoring and summary feedback mechanism, the reliability and continuous optimization of task execution are ensured.

title: Warehouse monitoring method based on edge calculation
description: This invention discloses a warehouse monitoring method based on edge computing. An edge-layer industrial camera dynamically adapts to complex warehouse lighting conditions using an adaptive exposure control algorithm, and optimizes image quality using an image enhancement algorithm. An edge computing box decodes and preprocesses the video stream, extracting multi-scale features using an improved MobileNetV3 architecture. After feature pyramid network fusion, an improved Softmax classifier, combined with temporal features, accurately classifies the status of goods. The system supports dynamic division and adjustment of ROI at three levels: shelf, layer, and storage location. It also supports multi-camera collaborative feature completion to address occlusion issues. The system features sub-storage management functions such as stack counting, orientation recognition, and spatial alerts, and can generate operation heatmaps to optimize operations. Abnormal events are stored on a blockchain consortium blockchain, ensuring data reliability and traceability. This achieves intelligent control of warehouse operations, accurate status identification, efficient resource allocation, and risk compliance traceability, improving operational efficiency and space utilization.

title: Automatic identification method and system for cross-section image of carbon fiber scanning electron microscope
description: This application relates to the field of image recognition technology, and in particular to an automatic recognition method and system for carbon fiber scanning electron microscope cross-sectional images. The automatic recognition method for carbon fiber scanning electron microscope cross-sectional images includes: acquiring a carbon fiber cross-sectional image obtained by a scanning electron microscope; uniformly dividing the carbon fiber cross-sectional image into multiple sub-images; inputting each sub-image into a carbon fiber cross-sectional recognition model for feature extraction and classification, wherein the carbon fiber cross-sectional recognition model is a neural network model based on a combination of an improved residual neural network and a transfer learning mechanism; obtaining the classification results of each sub-image; and determining the final classification result of the carbon fiber cross-sectional image based on a majority voting mechanism to obtain the carbon fiber quality inspection result. This application can significantly improve the efficiency and standardization level of carbon fiber quality inspection.

title: AI intelligent coal blending method based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses an AI intelligent coal blending method based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of intelligent coal blending, solves the technical problems of low characteristic association recognition and screening efficiency and poor adaptability of model architecture scenes, and realizes accurate coverage of light-weight dynamic-complex scenes by innovatively distinguishing linear and nonlinear association characteristics through a scatter diagram and residual diagram system, and eliminating redundancy of linear characteristics by a pearson coefficient and nonlinear characteristics by a mutual information method in a layering manner, thereby avoiding the limitation of traditional single statistic screening characteristics, generating mining implicit association through composite characteristics, enabling characteristic dimension to be more simplified, enabling the association with a coal blending target to be more direct, effectively improving model training efficiency and prediction precision, and realizing accurate coverage of light-weight dynamic-complex scenes by comparing with the conventional method of adapting a single model to full scenes, and greatly improving the adaptability and optimization effect of a coal blending scheme under different scenes.

title: Custom map node visualization method based on business attribute dynamic rendering
description: This invention provides a method for visualizing custom graph nodes based on dynamic rendering of business attributes. It receives and verifies node style configurations in JSON format, parsing them into an internal model containing graphic definitions, styles, rules, and positions. Combining this with node business data, it dynamically evaluates whether graphic elements should be displayed according to rules, generating a set to be rendered. Finally, it performs layered rendering: first, basic shapes and styles are drawn, then dynamic elements that meet the conditions are rendered sequentially to complete the node drawing. Users only need to set rules and styles through the configuration interface; no drawing code is required. The system can automatically and dynamically render nodes with rich visual elements based on business data, greatly improving the expressiveness and development efficiency of graph visualization.

title: Magnetic particle image reconstruction method and system based on multi-mode diffusion model
description: This invention belongs to the field of image reconstruction and multimodal generative artificial intelligence models in magnetic particle imaging. Specifically, it relates to a method and system for magnetic particle image reconstruction based on a multimodal diffusion model, aiming to solve the problem that there is currently no method that can combine generative models and multimodal imaging technology to achieve accurate quantitative reconstruction of MPI (Magnetic Particle Imaging). The invention includes: integrating and modeling a first excitation signal, discretizing it to obtain a discrete signal; fitting each discrete signal separately and superimposing them to obtain a first response signal; calculating a loss function; training a model based on the loss function; processing a second time-series signal using the trained particle response model to obtain a second response signal; calculating, progressively adding noise, and constraining the second response signal and system matrix to obtain a noisy constrained image; and progressively denoising and restoring the noisy constrained image in the final step to obtain the final reconstructed image. This invention makes fast and high-quality MPI image reconstruction possible.

title: NDIR-based total hydrocarbon concentration online detection method and system
description: This invention discloses an online detection method and system for total hydrocarbon concentration based on NDIR. The method includes: acquiring the temperature and pressure of a gas sample through an NDIR detection module, and calculating the absolute humidity and light absorbance ratio (AHL); measuring the total hydrocarbon concentration of the gas sample using a gas chromatograph; and constructing a GRU-Attention neural network model to establish a mapping relationship between AHL, temperature (Temp), pressure (P), and absolute humidity (AH) to total hydrocarbon concentration (  CHC  ), significantly improving the accuracy and adaptability of NDIR in the field of total hydrocarbon gas concentration detection technology and achieving adaptive compensation of environmental parameters. The system includes an NDIR detection module, a gas chromatography module, a processing unit, and a communication unit. It can output the compensated total hydrocarbon concentration in real time and transmit it remotely, thereby achieving accurate measurement of total hydrocarbon concentration by NDIR. Each sensor provides multi-parameter data, and the design is a miniaturized product with low cost, fast measurement, real-time monitoring, and an accurate and efficient model.

title: Recommended course system based on attention network of user preference
description: This invention relates to the field of course recommendation and discloses a course recommendation system based on user preference attention networks. The system includes a user preference propagation module, which explores courses with potential user preferences through different relationships in a knowledge graph, enriching the user's preference representation; an item neighbor enhancement module, which captures high-order neighboring items of the target course, aggregates the correlations between neighboring items, and generates final candidate courses; and a prediction module, which outputs a prediction of the user's choice of candidate courses based on the fused user and item representations. This invention not only effectively expands user preferences to solve the sparsity problem but also mines high-order structural and semantic information between entities in the knowledge graph to improve the utilization rate of side information.

title: Food ingredient identification method and system based on progressive multi-scale feature aggregation
description: The invention provides a food component identification method and a system based on progressive multi-scale feature aggregation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a neural network model of component analysis, wherein the neural network model comprises a global feature extraction module, a progressive local feature learning module and a component identification classifier; the input food image sequentially passes through a global feature extraction module and a progressive local feature learning module to respectively obtain multi-scale global semantic features and fine-grained local features, network layers with different depths are activated in stages by adopting an end-to-end progressive training strategy, the difference of the multi-scale features is enhanced by combining KL divergence constraint, and finally a component identification result is output through a classifier. The invention solves the technical problem of insufficient characterization of the local characteristics of food identification.

title: Shield tail gap measurement method based on example segmentation and laser projection error compensation
description: The invention discloses a shield tail clearance measurement method based on example segmentation and laser projection error compensation, and belongs to the technical field of shield construction automation measurement. The method solves the problem that in the prior art, projection coordinates deviate due to shield type TBM mechanical vibration and laser thermal drift, and further the measurement accuracy of a shield tail gap is affected. The technical scheme is characterized in that a plurality of groups of lasers are arranged in the circumferential direction of a shield tail to project stripes to a segment, images are synchronously acquired through an industrial camera, a segment joint sub-pixel boundary and a laser stripe center line are respectively extracted through a double-branch example segmentation network, real-time vibration and temperature drift compensation are carried out on laser projection points based on a thermal-mechanical coupling error model, and finally gap values and three-dimensional gradient distribution are calculated through point cloud registration. The method is mainly used for high-precision and real-time dynamic measurement of the gap between the shield tail and the segment in the shield type TBM tunneling process.

title: System and method for realizing risk early warning self-adaptive dynamic enhancement based on large model
description: This invention relates to a system and method for adaptive dynamic enhancement of risk warning based on a large model. The system includes: an adaptive data acquisition module that dynamically acquires risk warning data from multiple heterogeneous data sources; an element extraction module that achieves structured, high-precision extraction of risk warning elements; a performance threshold control module that dynamically adjusts the model for fine-tuning or provides optimization suggestions; a retrieval enhancement module that supplements external knowledge in real time; a dual decoupling module for entity extraction and analysis that separates the information extraction layer from the deep analysis layer; a contextual reasoning module that enables semantic understanding and reasoning; and a full-process feedback loop and RLHF optimization module that optimizes suggestion templates and model parameters. The system and method for adaptive dynamic enhancement of risk warning based on a large model, when used in a computer software environment, will produce significant and inevitable technical effects in multiple dimensions, including data acquisition, semantic recognition, logical reasoning, dynamic optimization, and human-computer collaboration.

title: Remote sensing image change detection method based on task-driven Mamba joint model
description: This invention discloses a remote sensing image change detection method based on a task-driven Mamba joint model, comprising: acquiring a set of dual-temporal remote sensing images of the same location at different times using a public dataset; implementing end-to-end change detection by designing a task-decoupled U-shaped three-layer network architecture remote sensing image change detection network model, through which the dual-temporal remote sensing image set can obtain binary change maps with change features in the images using the network model; the network model includes three core modules: a temporal interactive Mamba module extracting dual-temporal feature maps at three scales through multi-level downsampling; an edge-focusing Mamba difference module independently capturing temporal feature differences at each scale to generate multi-scale difference feature maps; and a dual-attention Mamba reconstruction module fusing temporal features and feedback information from the AFF module to reconstruct a set of three-scale dual-detail change feature maps. This invention utilizes Mamba's long sequence modeling capabilities to significantly improve the accuracy of remote sensing image change detection and the edge detail preservation effect.

title: Lithology recognition method based on improved Tabnet model
description: The application relates to a lithology recognition method based on an improved Tabnet model, which comprises the following steps of constructing an improved Tabnet model, adding Transformer encoder modules before attention converter modules of each step of a Tabnet network to form a composite attention converter module, training the improved Tabnet model, and carrying out lithology recognition by using the trained improved Tabnet model. According to the application, not only can the distribution decision be made and the complex characteristic representation among the parameters be gradually output, but also the front-back and long-distance dependency relationship among the characteristics can be synchronously learned, so that the extraction of global characteristics is realized, thereby effectively processing complex logging data and improving the accuracy of lithology identification, aiming at the situation that the lithology sample data of a research area is unbalanced, a Bsmote algorithm is adopted to obtain balanced lithology samples so as to predict lithology, and finally, the complex nonlinear problem of lithology identification of a sandstone reservoir is solved through the deep learning algorithm, and the accurate identification of lithology of the research area is realized.

title: Edge computing devices and their deep learning model optimization methods
description: A method for optimizing a deep learning model performed by an edge computing device is provided. The method includes the following steps: measuring the similarity between data collected in the installation environment of the edge computing device and training data used to train a deep learning model deployed in the edge computing device; determining whether to perform optimization of the deep learning model based on the similarity measurement result; generating training data for performing the optimization of the deep learning model based on reliability information; training and generating a deep learning model based on the training data; and updating an existing deep learning model applied to the edge computing device using the generated deep learning model.

title: Text content extraction method, text content extraction device, computer equipment and computer readable storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a text content extraction method, a text content extraction device, computer equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of executing extraction operation on acquired scanning content to acquire test content, determining template content corresponding to the test content, carrying out matching analysis on the test content according to the template content to determine prefix and suffix information and extract text, and executing secondary extraction operation on the prefix and suffix information and the extract text to obtain an extraction result and outputting the extraction result. Therefore, the method and the device can improve the recognition accuracy of the key information by extracting the prefix and the suffix, extracting the text by the prefix and the suffix, and then extracting the text for the second time. By combining the prefix and the secondary extraction, the difficult problems that the extraction effect of the python library is poor due to the fact that semantic information cannot be understood or the deep semantic information understanding capability of a large model is poor due to the fact that the length of a document is too long in the prior art are solved, and the extraction and identification precision is greatly improved.

title: Photonic computing chip
description: The embodiment of the application provides a photon calculation chip which comprises a multilayer diffraction neural network and a photoelectric detector, wherein the multilayer diffraction neural network is used for carrying out phase regulation and control on an input optical signal to obtain a mixed optical field of an OAM mode, and the photoelectric detector is used for converting the mixed optical field of the OAM mode into photocurrents which are suitable for different ports. The mixed light field of the OAM mode is output after the optical signal is processed and then transmitted to the photoelectric detector for processing, so that the information can be transmitted and processed by utilizing the degree of freedom of Orbital Angular Momentum (OAM) of the light, the information is not limited to the traditional intensity, phase or polarization regulation and control, and the parallel transmission and high-dimensional coding with higher capacity are realized by means of the inherent infinite-dimensional orthogonal space of the OAM mode.

title: Materials Analysis Methods
description: The present invention relates to a material analysis method, which may include the following steps: (a) preparing a specimen for structural analysis; (b) training an artificial intelligence model using training images of any specimen labeled with structural features; (c) using the trained artificial intelligence model to analyze multiple analysis images of the specimen without labeled structural features, and removing analysis images classified as preset noise structural features; and (d) using the trained artificial intelligence model to analyze the analysis images after removing analysis images classified as noise structural features, and classifying the analysis images as at least one target structural feature.

title: Intelligent furniture control system based on intelligent identification and Internet of things
description: This invention discloses a smart furniture control method and system based on intelligent recognition and the Internet of Things (IoT). The system includes: collecting voice commands and converting them into semantic command vectors; combining this with an improved MiniRocket-generated delay-aware feature matrix; and then constructing a furniture control path map and generating a path response difference vector. The system further integrates the operating status of the furniture equipment with environmental parameters to construct a fused state vector set, and uses this set to build a Whittle exponential scheduling model to generate a furniture equipment scheduling priority sequence. Finally, control commands are sent to the furniture equipment control terminal via an IoT communication interface, and the equipment adjusts its operation according to the commands. This method optimizes the scheduling efficiency and response accuracy of furniture equipment, ensuring that the furniture system can achieve intelligent and precise control in complex environments.

title: Computer-readable recording medium storing program, data processing device, and data processing method
description: A recording medium storing a program for causing a computer to execute: receiving user definition information including: function definition information defining an objective function of a combinatorial optimization problem and neighborhood definition information defining neighborhood states at a time of searching for a solution to the problem by a local search; generating an optimization system using the user definition information and base information indicating processing independent of: a definition of the function and a definition of the neighborhood states; receiving a coefficient in the function; and executing the optimization system to: calculate a change amount of a value of the function when a state represented by state variables in the function transitions to the neighborhood states, using the function definition information, the neighborhood definition information, and the coefficient, select a first state among the neighborhood states based on the change amount, and update the state variables to the first state.

title: Optical identification of telecommunications equipment
description: Examples of the present disclosure relate to the optical identification of telecommunications equipment. In examples, a user interacts with an application to capture image data relating to a device according to instructions presented to the user. The application may further generate metadata, such as user responses to one or more questions. The image data and/or metadata are evaluated using a machine learning model to generate an equipment classification for devices pictured therein. The data may also be used to generate an equipment configuration for the device, as well as an operational state (e.g., based on one or more indicators present on the device, log data, etc.). Accordingly, such information may be used to update a pre-existing inventory record for the device, or generate a new inventory record. In other examples, such information is used to generate one or more predicted issues and associated actions to troubleshoot the device.

title: System and method for performing preemptive scaling of micro service instances in cloud network
description: A method for performing preemptive scaling is disclosed. The method includes monitoring of incoming data volume outside of a cloud network at a node upstream from the cloud network, and identifying micro services required for processing of the incoming data volume. The method further includes determining a number of instances for each of the identified micro services, and contemporaneously creating the determined number of instances for each of the identified micro services in the cloud for processing of the incoming data volume.

title: Cleaning system capable of selfdiagnosis, and self-diagnosis method of cleaning system
description: The present disclosure relates to a self-diagnosis on a state of a cleaning system, whereby a wireless vacuum cleaner solely, or the wireless vacuum cleaner docked on a station device, may self-diagnose the state of the wireless vacuum cleaner based on at least one of a flow path pressure value of the wireless vacuum cleaner and an operation current value of a brush device, and a state of a station device is self-diagnosed based on a pressure value of the station device.

title: Continuous Integration and Automated Testing of Machine Learning Models
description: A system and method are disclosed to generate, modify, and deploy machine learning models. Embodiments include a database comprising historical sales data and a server comprising a processor and memory. Embodiments receive historical sales data comprising aggregated sales data for one or more items sold in one or more stores over one or more past time periods. Embodiments train a first machine learning model to learn model parameters and generate sales predictions by identifying one or more causal factors that influence the sale of one or more items. Embodiments train a second machine learning model, based on the first machine learning model, to generate second predictions. Embodiments evaluate the predictions of the first and second machine learning models as compared to the historical sales data, and deploy the machine learning model that generated the predictions that are closer to the historical sales data to generate one or more subsequent predictions.

title: Method for providing training data for a machine learning (ml) model for predicting the behavior of a technical system
description: A method for providing training data for a machine learning (ML) model for predicting the behavior of a technical system. The method includes: generating a first data set containing simulation data for the technical system; generating a second data set containing prototype data of the technical system; generating a third data set by combining the first and second data sets; training the ML model based on the third data set; generating a fourth data set as first input data based on the third data set by maximizing an information function, to obtain a first feature combination as input data for the technical system; measuring the first feature combination for the prototype data of the technical system to obtain a fifth data set; and adding the fifth data set as output data and the generated fourth data set as first input data to the third data set as training data.

title: Machine learning -based generation of beamforming coefficients by utilizing prior radio channel related information, and related devices, methods and computer programs
description: Devices, methods and computer programs for machine learning-based generation of beamforming coefficients by utilizing prior radio channel related information are disclosed. At least some example embodiments may allow reducing the amount of historical information to be fed to a neural beamformer or machine learning-based beamformer to reduce computational complexity and memory requirements.

title: Method and system for structuring and deploying an electronic skill-based activity
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure enable system(s) and method(s) for creating and deploying an electronic skill-based activity, including implementing a matchup tool to determine a projected performance score for participants in real-world events based at least in part on historical performance data of each participant. The matchup tool creates suggested matchups for inclusion in a skill-based game by selecting, for each suggested matchup, at least two components, formed from one or more participants, expected to produce substantially similar scores in the skill-based game based on the projected performance score of each participant. The matchup tool renders for display to a game operator the suggested matchups to enable the game operator to interactively select suggested matchups for inclusion within the skill-based game. The matchup tool transmits the selected matchup to presentation devices of users to enable the users to interactively select components as predicted winning components of the skill-based game.

title: Adaptive Minimum Voltage Aging Margin Prediction Method and Adaptive Minimum Voltage Aging Margin Prediction System Capable of Providing Satisfactory Prediction Accuracy
description: An adaptive minimum voltage aging margin prediction method includes acquiring characteristic data of a plurality of dies in a testing line, predicting a wear-out failure rate of each module of the plurality of dies according to the characteristic data by using a neural network, and predicting a minimum voltage aging margin of the each module according to the wear-out failure rate of the each module by using the neural network.

title: Vehicular trailer assist system
description: A vehicular trailer assist system includes a camera disposed at a rear portion of a vehicle and viewing at least rearward of the vehicle, and an electronic control unit (ECU), which includes an image processor for processing image data captured by the camera. The ECU executes a deep convolutional neural network (CNN) to determine, via processing of image data captured by the camera, presence of a trailer rearward of the vehicle. The CNN, responsive to processing of image data captured by the camera, determines a position of a trailer relative to the vehicle. The CNN, responsive to determining the position of the trailer, classifies the trailer into a trailer category. The ECU, responsive to the CNN determining the position of the trailer, generates an output based on the trailer classification to autonomously control the vehicle to align the vehicle with the trailer and navigate the vehicle toward the trailer.

title: System and methods for data model detection and surveillance
description: A computer system is provided for monitoring and detecting changes in a data generating processes, which may be under a multi-dimensional and unsupervised setting. A target dataset is split into paired subgroups by a separator and one or more detectors are applied to detect changes, anomalies, inconsistencies, and the like between the paired subgroups. Metrics may be generated by the detector(s), which are then passed to an evaluating system.

title: Regenerating views based on prompts and user history
description: The technology disclosed herein relates to the generation and regeneration of three-dimensional environments for users to visualize particular items within the three-dimensional environment. For example, an indication for generating a three-dimensional environment associated with a search query can be received. Previous user interaction data associated with a user providing the indication can be identified and provided to a generative artificial intelligence model. The generative artificial intelligence model can be trained using prior user interaction data from a plurality of other users. In some embodiments, the generative artificial intelligence model can also be trained using a plurality of item features for an item within an item corpus to identify particular images of items associated with a particular style that corresponds to the search query and the previous user interaction data of the user. In embodiments, three-dimensional environments can be generated with items that are associated with the particular style.

title: Monitoring livestock in an agricultural pen
description: A method comprising: receiving an image of a scene comprising one or more animals; defining region boundaries for each of said one or more animals; evaluating a suitability of each of said region boundaries for further processing, based, at least in part, on a predetermined set of parameters; and determining at least one of: (i) a physical state of at least some of said one or more animals, based, at least in part, on said further processing, and (ii) an identity of at least some of said one or more animals.

title: Privacy-Preserving Quantum Computation Using Masked Quantum Circuit
description: Systems and methods for quantum computation are provided. In one example, performing quantum computation using a masked circuit can include obtaining, by a classical computing system, data indicative of a quantum computation circuit. One or more quantum gates within the circuit can be masked to generate a masked quantum computation circuit. Data indicative of the masked quantum computation circuit can be sent to a quantum computing system. The classical computing system can receive masked results associated with one or more quantum computations based on the masked quantum computation circuit. The classical computing system can determine, based on the masked results, an output of the quantum computation circuit.

title: System and method for generating images of rf signals and/or rf impairments
description: The disclosure relates to a system for generating images of RF signals and/or RF impairments. The system includes a receiving unit to receive information on a number of RF signals and/or RF impairments, and image parameters; RF signal generator(s) to generate the number of RF signals and/or RF impairments according to the received information; an image generation unit to generate an image of a frequency spectrum and/or a spectrogram of the generated RF signals and/or RF impairments according to the received image parameters; a calculation unit to calculate a respective bounding box for at least one of the RF signals and/or for at least one of the RF impairments in the generated image, wherein the bounding box indicates a location of the at least one RF signal and/or the at least one RF impairment in the generated image; and a memory to store the image together with the bounding box(es).

title: Systems and methods for evaluating and displaying subject-specific compliance standard information
description: Systems and methods for evaluating and displaying subject-specific compliance standard information are provided.

title: Microscopy System and Related Methods
description: In a computer-implemented method for controlling a microscope, a textual input describing a desired microscope image and an employed sample is received. The textual input and an overview image of the employed sample are input into a large language model, which is trained to process the textual input and the overview image together to calculate microscope settings for capturing a microscope image that corresponds to the desired microscope image. A microscope image is then captured with these calculated microscope settings.

title: Computer-based systems configured for entity resolution and indexing of entity activity
description: In order to facilitate the entity resolution and entity activity tracking and indexing, systems and methods include receiving first source records from a first database and second source records from a record database. A candidate set of second source records is determined by a heuristic search in the set of second source records. A candidate pair feature vector associated with each candidate pair of first and second source records is generated. An entity matching machine learning model predicts matching first source records for each candidate second source record based on the respective candidate pair feature vector. An aggregate quantity associated with the matching first source records is aggregated from a quantity associated with each first source record, and a quantity index for each candidate second source record is determined based the aggregate quantities. Each quantity index is displayed to a user.

title: Method and System for edge intelligence using federated learning with blockchain, covariance matrix transfer, and artificial intelligence (FLwBC-AI)
description: This disclosure describes methods for adaptive machine learning in distributed edge computing. An edge node collects local data, selects a suitable large language model (LLM) or small learning model (SLM), trains it, and shares updates with a federated server or peer nodes. Another method matches AI functions with appropriate models, uses datasets with confidence values, and applies a Kalman Filter to assign weights and update covariance matrix confidence. In collaborative training, edge nodes store trained models with per-layer covariance values, transmit them to a control node, and update models based on aggregated inputs. Blockchain may be used for secure model storage and distribution, with smart contracts managing access and updates. These approaches support efficient, privacy-preserving learning by adapting models using statistical confidence and decentralized coordination.

title: Method and apparatus for searching multi-vector using span-level sequence compression technique
description: An apparatus according to an embodiment of the present disclosure comprises: at least one memory for storing instructions; and at least one processor. The at least one processor is configured to execute the instructions to perform the steps of: generating a span including a span index for an arbitrary document token; encoding an input query token to generate a query token encoding vector; encoding a document token; generating a document token encoding vector; compressing the document token encoding vector into a span vector according to the span index and outputting the compressed document token encoding vector; and searching for a document token encoding vector having the highest similarity to the query token encoding vector by calculating a score between the query token encoding vector and the compressed document token encoding vector.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR ANALYSIS OF FLIGHT DATA RECORDED DURING THE FLIGHT OF AN AIRCRAFT.
description: The present invention relates to a method of analyzing a set of flight data, said first, whose values have been recorded during a flight of an aircraft and in which at least a subset of flight data , comprising at least one of the flight data of the first set and / or at least one flight data of a second set provided that at least one of its data exceeds its nominal value, is defined by correlation of the value of d at least one flight data of the first set with the value of at least one of the flight data of the second set. A flight event is then likely to be detected from the values of the flight data of a subset and the values of the flight data of one of the second set of flight data, and if a flight event is not detected from a subset, a probability of matching between at least a second set and this subset is associated with this subset, the first set is then updated by adding a subset at least one new flight data from at least one second set and / or by deleting at least one of its flight data, according to the match probability values, the first set of flight data thus set update is then recorded again during a new flight, and the process is iterated as long as an expert can not make a decision on that subset.

title: Electronic device with cryogenic component and method of producing it
description: Title: Electronic device with cryogenic component and method for producing it The invention relates to an electronic device comprising: - a functional zone (C1) comprising a cryogenic component configured to operate at a temperature below 10 K, - a control zone (C2) comprising an electronic control component configured to control the cryogenic component, - a routing zone (C3) comprising a passive structure (22) electrically connected to the cryogenic component and to the electronic control component, the passive structure (22) being based on a superconducting material and integrated in a dielectric matrix (13), Advantageously, the dielectric matrix (13) comprises a cavity (52) around the passive structure (22), so that the passive structure (22) is partly suspended in said cavity (52). Figure for abstract: Fig.11

title: State representation method and inverse dynamic model of deformable objects
description: The invention discloses a state representation method of a deformable object, which comprises the following steps of S1, S2, obtaining the outline of the deformable object from the RGB image, S3, utilizing the obtained outline to obtain the centroid of the outline, establishing a polar coordinate system by taking the centroid as a center point, dividing a plurality of sector areas, and S4, calculating the average distance from the outline point in each sector area to the centroid as one-dimensional characteristics in the state multidimensional characteristics of the deformable object. The state representation method of the deformable object provided by the invention enables the reverse dynamics model to pay more attention to the outline of the deformable object, so that a robot can better finish the task of operating the deformable object.

title: Retinal artery and vein blood vessel direct identification method and system based on fundus image
description: The retinal artery and vein blood vessel direct identification method based on the fundus image comprises the steps of processing an input fundus image through a basic segmentation network, outputting a 64-channel feature map, processing the 64-channel feature map through a blood vessel constraint module, outputting a first result map, generating a 4-channel artery and vein feature map containing background, arteries, veins and unknown blood vessels through convolution of 1X 1 of the first result map, and generating a final retinal artery and vein blood vessel identification map through a first Sigmoid function through the 4-channel artery and vein feature map. The arteriovenous blood vessel classification result obtained by the method is higher in accuracy, efficiency and robustness.

title: Point cloud quality detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the field of automatic driving control and discloses a point cloud quality detection method, a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining point cloud data and images corresponding to driving scenes, extracting dimension attribute information in the point cloud data, projecting the point cloud data onto the images by means of preset calibration parameters, respectively carrying out point cloud dyeing on the projected images according to the dimension attribute information to correspondingly obtain a plurality of point cloud dyed images, and carrying out multi-label classification on various quality indexes corresponding to the point cloud by means of a preset deep learning model according to the point cloud dyed images to obtain a quality detection result of the point cloud. The method and the device realize real-time monitoring of the quality of the point cloud.

title: Generating type abstract error correction method aiming at fact consistency
description: The embodiment of the application provides a generating type abstract error correction method aiming at fact consistency, which is technically characterized by comprising the steps of establishing a retrieval module and an error correction module, preprocessing data of an abstract to be corrected and a corresponding source text, inputting the abstract and the corresponding source text into the retrieval module in pairs, retrieving evidence information from the corresponding source text to obtain a matching set aiming at each sentence content of the abstract to be corrected in a three-classification task mode, decoding mask features by the error correction module through an encoder, a mask and a decoder to generate an error correction text, evaluating the error correction text from two aspects of content and facts, generating a record, adding the record into a sample pool, selecting N records with the largest profit of the sample pool to calculate strategy gradient loss, guiding parameter learning of the error correction module, and correcting the abstract to be corrected in target data by using the learned retrieval module and the error correction module.

title: User bidding method and device based on multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm under federal learning
description: The invention discloses a user bidding method and a device under federal learning based on a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a learning task issued by a federal learning platform is acquired, a sample client uploads bidding information to the federal platform by means of a reinforcement learning algorithm, the platform selects the sample client through the algorithm and then issues a global sharing model to the selected sample client, the selected sample client performs local training and uploads updating parameters, and the platform gathers the uploaded updating model parameters according to an aggregation algorithm and updates model parameters in the global model. The method can be used for realizing dynamic bidding of federal learning participators and simultaneously relieving model overfitting, and solves the problems of federal learning fairness deficiency and model overfitting caused by no change of a user bidding strategy in a subsequent training process after the user submits the bidding strategy by the existing auction-based incentive mechanism.

title: Endpoint detection in manufacturing process by near infrared spectroscopy and machine learning techniques
description: A method may comprises identifying, by a device, a support vector machine (SVM) classification model for determining whether a manufacturing process has reached a steady state; receiving, by the device and from one or more spectrometers, multivariate spectral data measured during a performance of the manufacturing process; determining, by the device, based on the multivariate spectral data, and using the SVM classification model, whether the manufacturing process is at the steady state at a particular time; and providing, by the device and after determining whether the manufacturing process is at the steady state at the particular time, an indication that the manufacturing process has reached the steady state.

title: Analyzing measurement results of a communications network or other target system
description: Analyzing measurement results of a target system. Measurement results are obtained (401). The measurement results include multiple data entries, and each data entry includes multiple data values on a lowest Hierarchy level and Hierarchy information Defining with which entities the entry is related to on different Hierarchy levels. An aggregated anomaly score is determined (402) for each data entry. Data entries, where the aggregated anomaly score fulfills predefined criteria, are chosen for further analysis. Hierarchical clustering is performed (404) on the chosen entries based on dissimilarity of the chosen entries to combine at least some of the chosen entries together; and the hierarchically clustered entries are used (405) to identify one or more anomalous entities on Hierarchy levels above the lowest Hierarchy level.

title: Control of nucleic acid amplification procedures including the polymerase chain reaction (pcr)
description: A method is provided in which a neural network is used to predict the level of amplification of DNA during a polymerase chain reaction for a given set of reaction criteria. <IMAGE>

title: Method and apparatus for data analysis
description:
With known systems, when performing analysis of data, users typically have a
solution-oriented view: there is a problem, and data has been collected with a view
to providing some information about the problem. Usually a method is selected,
based on vague knowledge about some feature of the problem. This is often sub-optimal,
because the user can be assumed to be an expert in the application area,
but not in data analysis. 
     Embodiments of the invention provide a means of characterising data analysis
methods in terms of tangible and non-tangible parameters such as user-friendliness,
accuracy, simplicity, interpretability, speed, cost, comprehensibility, and
transparency, and then matching these to some pre-specified requirements. 
     This means is provided by a method of selecting a data analysis method in
accordance with a user preference, wherein the user preference relates to a feature
of the data analysis method and is represented by a fuzzy set comprising a range of
values. The method comprises the following steps:
   (i) using the user preference to identify one or more rules corresponding to the
user preference, each rule comprising at least one fuzzy set that relates
features of data analysis methods to data analysis characteristics;   (ii) evaluating the or each identified rule, thereby identifying an instance of a
data analysis characteristic associated with the identified rule, the
instance comprising a fuzzy set having a range of values;   (iii) accessing a plurality of data analysis methods, each of which has a plurality
of data analysis characteristics, wherein each of which data analysis
characteristics is characterised by a fuzzy set having a range of values;
and   (iv) comparing the data analysis characteristics associated with the accessed
data analysis methods with the data analysis characteristic instance in
order to identify a data analysis method that matches the user preference.

title: Electronic circuit design
description: A system for optimising electronic circuits to be designed has two parts or phases, a training phase 10 in which optimisation scenarios for selected electronic circuits are derived using an evolutionary algorithm, and an operation phase 11, in which the derived optimisation scenarios are used to optimise new electronic circuits to be designed. The training phase 10 uses an evolutionary algorithm to produce a specialised and relatively fast optimisation scenario for each of a plurality of input circuits or groups of circuits (step 13). One or more of the evolved specialist optimisation scenarios are then selected to form a suite of optimisation scenarios (step 15) for use to optimise new circuits to be designed. In the operation phase 11, a new circuit to be optimised is input at step 18, and a plurality of optimisation scenarios from the suite of optimisation scenarios 15 is then used to try to optimise the new circuit (step 19). The best optimisation result is taken as the optimisation for the circuit (step 20).

title: Companion robot for personal interaction
description: A mobile robot guest for interacting with a human resident performs a room-traversing search procedure prior to interacting with the resident, and may verbally query whether the resident being sought is present. Upon finding the resident, the mobile robot may facilitate a teleconferencing session with a remote third party, or interact with the resident in a number of ways. For example, the robot may carry on a dialogue with the resident, reinforce compliance with medication or other schedules, etc. In addition, the robot incorporates safety features for preventing collisions with the resident; and the robot may audibly announce and/or visibly indicate its presence in order to avoid becoming a dangerous obstacle. Furthermore, the mobile robot behaves in accordance with an integral privacy policy, such that any sensor recording or transmission must be approved by the resident.

title: Personalized text proofing using distributed services
description: Systems and methods provide personalized text proofing. A user model that is used to personalize generic critiques for text proofing a document is generated based on user signals indicating past user actions. During runtime of an application used to create the document, the user model is accessed and locally cached. User inputs comprising typed components used to create the document are received and a set of one or more generic critiques for the user inputs is accessed from an editor system. The user model is applied to the set which may modify a generic critique of the set. Modifying the generic critique can cause the generic critique to be automatically applied or suppressed at the client device. The set including the modified generic critique is transmitted to a user device, whereby the user device applies the set to the document including automatically applying or suppressing the modified generic critique.

title: Language-model pretraining with gradient-disentangled embedding sharing
description: A method for training a language model comprises receiving vectorized training data as input to a multitask pretraining problem; generating modified vectorized training data based on the vectorized training data, according to an upstream data embedding; emitting pretraining output based on the modified vectorized training data, according to a downstream data embedding equivalent to the upstream data embedding; and adjusting the upstream data embedding and the downstream data embedding by computing, based on the pretraining output, a gradient of the upstream data embedding disentangled from a gradient of the downstream data embedding, thereby advancing the multitask pretraining problem toward a pretrained state.

title: Josephson parametric converter having impedance-matching networks
description: One or more systems, devices and/or methods of use provided herein relate to a device that can provide bandwidth and/or saturation power to amplify a plurality of readout frequencies or to convert one or more frequencies. In quantum technology, the one or more systems, devices and/or methods of use provided herein can be employed to simultaneously readout a plurality of qubit resonators. A device can comprise a Josephson parametric converter device comprising a Josephson ring modulator having a pair of nodes, and an impedance matching circuit network operatively connected across the pair of nodes. The device can be separately operable in an amplification mode or in a conversion mode.

title: Vacuum cleaner and control method for same
description: A vacuum cleaner includes a main body, a suction motor in the main body, an extension pipe, a suction head, connected to the suction motor through an extension pipe and including a suction port through which the foreign substances are sucked, a brush inside the suction head, a brush motor configured to rotate the brush, a pressure sensor configured to detect a pressure of air flowing through the suction port, a memory configured to store reference data used to identify the type of surface to be cleaned and a learning model to update the reference data, and a controller configured to determine a suction pressure based on the detected pressure and an atmospheric pressure, and identify the type of surface using the determined suction pressure, a load of the brush motor, and the stored reference data, and to update the stored reference data based on a predetermined update condition.

title: Vista de-noising
description: An optical coherence tomography angiography (OCT-A) method that includes generating at least two OCT-A images based on different interscan times, de-noising the at least two OCT-A images, and generating a short interscan time (SIT) representative image and a long interscan time (LIT) representative image based on the at least two de-noised OCT-A images. Estimating a relative blood flow velocity based on the SIT representative image and the LIT representative image. Further, generating a blood flow image based on the relative blood flow velocity.

title: Space efficient technique for estimating cardinality using probabilistic data structure
description: Methods and technologies are disclosed for the sketch efficient estimation of large-scale multi-sets in distributed, stream-oriented environments. Sketch updates are idempotent and commutative, to support duplicate set elements and varying element sequences. They are also mergeable to support distributed sketch recording. The recording process uses stepwise approximated geometric distributions, efficiently generated from NLZ values of received sketch updates, by using only multiplications with powers of two and integer additions. Sketch registers are subdivided into a portion storing an observed max update value for the register, and a portion storing set of flag bits indicating observed next smaller update values for the register. A Max Likelihood base sketch data evaluation, based on the assumption of statistically independent sketch registers is proposed. The limited number of different probabilities created by the stepwise approximated geometric distributions leads to a Max Likelihood function with coefficients that can be calculated solely with integer arithmetic.

title: Systems and methods for distributing layers of special mixture-of-experts machine learning models
description: Some disclosed embodiments are directed to computing systems having different accelerators such that a first set of accelerators has a greater memory capability than a second set accelerators, while the second set of accelerators has a greater processing capability than the first set of accelerators. A machine learning model having different dense layers and sparse layers is distributed on the different accelerators such that the dense layers are distributed on one or more accelerators selected from the first set of accelerators and the sparse layers are distributed on one or more accelerators in the second set of accelerators.

title: Adapting a machine learning model for determining intent of a person to pass through a door
description: It is provided a method for adapting an intent model (20), being a machine learning, ML, model for determining intent of a person to pass through a door (15). The method is performed by an intent determiner (1). The method comprises: determining (40) that a physical environment outside a door has changed; increasing (42) a rate of training of the intent model (20), wherein the training is based on input features based on image data from an image capturing device (11) covering an area near the door (15); and applying (44) the intent model (20) for inferring when a person exhibits intent to pass through the door, based on image data from the image capturing device (11).

title: Circuit for use in connection with signals representative of fuzzy information
description: A circuit is disclosed for deriving an output which is indicative of the centre of gravity of electric signals representative of fuzzy information distributed over a plurality of lines. In one embodiment the circuit comprises a weighted summing circuit which forms a sum from the signals after multiplying each signal by a respective value corresponding to the grade of its said line, and a simple summing integration circuit which executes summing integration of the electric signals without any weighting. In an alternative embodiment the circuit comprises a weight summing integration circuit which executes summing integration of the signals after multiplying each such signal by a respective value corresponding to the grade of its line, and a simple summing circuit that simply sums the signals without weighting. In both embodiments a comparator then makes a comparison between the outputs of the two circuits. <IMAGE>

title: Improvements in or relating to processing data for interpretation
description: A system for improving sensor-based decision making provides for the automatic submission of data obtained locally from instrumentation (such as image data) together with the interpretation of that data, which can be the output of some software which has been checked and possibly corrected by a user according to his/her expertise, to a remote database via an internetwork. The submission to the remote database is preferably automatic so that the remote database grows over time. The local site can access the remote database to retrieve information to assist in interpretation of the locally produced data (for example similar images and their corresponding interpretations), or can retrieve updated or improved software or parameters improving the software used for processing the data. The information on the remote database can also be reprocessed by software agents to provide statistical information based on information from a variety of such local sites.

title: Accessing prologue and epilogue data
description: The processor(s) identifies a prologue or epilogue loop having a corresponding data array for storing values of the prologue or epilogue loop in a N-dimensional tensor calculation and populates, for a first address offset value element that corresponds to the prologue or epilogue loop, the address computation elements for the first address offset value element with respective values based at least on a number of iterations of the prologue or epilogue loop. For each address offset value element, the apparatus can include address computation elements that each store a value used to determine the address offset value. The data arrays may include a prologue data array each element of which stores a bias value for an artificial intelligence machine learning calculation, with nested loops. The address of a particular tensor element may be determined by summing the address offset values for each dimension using hardware adders.

title: Track segment cleaning of tracked objects
description: The invention provides methods and systems for combining tracks of objects identified by a vehicle 102. The method comprises: detecting first 515 and second 525 track segments; determining a stitching score between the first and second track segments; and, in response to the stitching score satisfying a threshold, combining the first and second track segments to form a single track segment representative of an object exterior to a vehicle. The stitching score may be based on track features derived from track trajectory (710,Fig.7), point cloud data (720,Fig.7) and image features (730,Fig.7). The methods may employ track cleaning of tracks using a machine learning model based on neural networks. Claims are also included for generating a training data set by dividing a known single track, and for subsequently training a machine learning model. The invention could find application in autonomous vehicles (AV) where segmented tracks from the same road users and false tracks 545 can cause AVs to make incorrect navigation decisions.

title: Method for converting continuous system to Markov decision process
description: A continuous dynamical system is converted to a Markov decision process (MDP) with discrete states. A predetermined number of continuous states of the continuous system is selected, wherein each continuous state corresponds to one discrete state of the MDP. Delaunay triangulation is applied to the continuous states to produce a set of triangles, wherein vertices of each triangle represent the continuous states. For each discrete state, a next discrete state  y = f ( x, a ) is determined, wherein  x  represents the continuous state corresponding to the discrete state, a is a control action, and  f  is a non-linear transition function for the continuous state. A particular triangle containing the next discrete state  y  is identified, and the next discrete state  y  is expressed as probabilities of transitioning to the discrete states corresponding to the continuous states  x  represented by the vertices of the particular triangle.

title: Tunable coupler with coupling extension
description: A tunable coupler is provided for making a controllable coupling to at least a first qubit (801, 1501). It comprises a first constant coupling element (803, 1506) and a tunable coupling element (804, 1509). Said first constant coupling element (803, 1506) forms a non-galvanic coupling interface to at least said first qubit (801, 1501) at a first extremity that is distant from said tunable coupling element (804, 1509). Said tunable coupling element (804, 1509) is located adjacent to a non-galvanic coupling interface formed to a further circuit element (802, 805, 1507) at a second extremity thereof.

title: Neural network for bulk sorting
description: A mass classification system is provided for classifying objects (1) in mass. The system comprises: at least one radiation source (10) configured to irradiate the objects; at least one optical sensor (12) configured to capture reflected radiation (22) from the objects and acquire it as multispectral or hyperspectral data (24); a processing circuit (16) configured to analyze the reflected radiation from the objects by inputting the multispectral or hyperspectral data into a convolutional neural network (CNN) (18) with at least two convolutional layers to detect and classify the objects in the multispectral or hyperspectral data, or to semantically segment them; and a mechanical classifier (20) configured to classify the objects according to their classification or segmentation by analyzing the processing circuit, such that different overlapping or stacked objects are separated or treated as a single group. (Automatic translation with Google Translate, no legal value)

title: Constructing and Operating Artificial Recurrent Neural Networks
description: Methods, systems and apparatus for selecting a set of elements in a recurrent neural network that form a cognitive process - including a computer program encoded on a computer storage medium. The method comprises: identifying activity in the recurrent neural network commensurate with a relatively simple topological pattern; using the identified relatively simple topological pattern as a constraint to identify a relatively more complex topological pattern of activity in the recurrent neural network ; use the identified relatively more complex topological patterns as constraints to identify the relatively more complex topological patterns of activity in the recurrent neural network; and output the identification of the topological patterns of activity that have occurred in the recurrent neural network .

title: Distributed photovoltaic output prediction method and device based on DTW meteorological offset correction
description: The invention provides a distributed photovoltaic output prediction method and a distributed photovoltaic output prediction device based on DTW (data transformation and data reconstruction) meteorological station offset correction, wherein meteorological data of a photovoltaic meteorological station and distributed photovoltaic users and power generation data within 20 kilometers of a meteorological station are collected, the meteorological data and the power generation data are cleaned, offset correction is carried out on the meteorological data based on DTW, then data matching is carried out according to corresponding hour-scale time, and meteorological statistical characteristics and power generation user images are generated; establishing an hour-level prediction sample; establishing a multi-head attention mechanism neural network model suitable for power prediction; and training the model, and LOSS weighting is carried out on the sample with rare characteristic distribution in the training process, so that the generalization capability of the model is ensured. The meteorological data offset correction algorithm based on the DTW solves the meteorological data offset problem caused by time sequence offset, and the meteorological data offset problem caused by time sequence offset is solved, so that the model complexity is simplified, and the prediction accuracy is improved.

title: Intent recognition model training method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the field of intelligent decision-making, and discloses an intent recognition model training method, device, electronic device and storage medium. The method includes: recognizing the task category of an intent recognition task, constructing a student intent identifying model and a teacher intent identifying model; constructing a joint The adversarial training method uses training samples to calculate the cross-entropy and relative entropy of the teacher's intention recognition model; calculates the model loss according to the cross-entropy and the relative entropy, and obtains the trained teacher's intention recognition when the model loss meets a preset threshold model; use the trained teacher intent recognition model to recognize the text intent of the intent text; identify the initial intent recognition function of the student intent recognition model, and construct the adversarial intent recognition function of the student intent recognition model; use the adversarial intent recognition function to calculate the intent text Distillation loss, when the preset threshold is met, the trained student intent recognition model is obtained. The present invention can improve the accuracy of intent recognition training.

title: Complex causal relationship extraction method based on comparison expression learning
description: The invention discloses a complex causal relationship extraction method based on comparative expression learning, which comprises the following steps of firstly, in order to convert an implicit causal relationship into an explicit causal relationship, searching a sample set initialization memory momentum with explicit causal relationship connection words from a large-scale data set, wherein the samples are organized in a form of < cause, result, causal connection words > triple; secondly, acquiring a causal argument set contained in a text in a training data set, matching the causal arguments with causal argument triples in memory momentum, and selecting a causal relation connecting word with the highest similarity as a causal relation connecting word structure normal sample for data enhancement; the locations of the causes and results in the positive example were interchanged, and the negative example was constructed. And finally, learning the causal relationship contained in the text by adopting a contrast learning framework and taking the bidirectional long-short term memory network and the Transformer as a backbone network. The method can solve the problem of difficult extraction of complex causal relationship, and greatly improves the extraction performance of the model.

title: Nuclear power plant operator operation guidance method, guidance system and equipment
description: The invention discloses an operation guidance method, guidance system and equipment for an operator of a nuclear power plant. The method includes: obtaining a first structured feature vector according to the current operation of the operator; The log obtains the second structured feature vector; after combining each event in the preset event set with the first structured feature vector and the second structured feature vector, input a preset prediction model to obtain The current operation triggers the probability of occurrence of each event in the event set; the probability of occurrence of each event is used to guide the operator to continue or abandon the current operation. The invention combines the current operation of the operator with the operation state of the nuclear power plant before the current moment, and online predicts the events that may be caused by each operation of the operator in real time, so as to assist the operator to issue correct control commands and improve the operation safety of the nuclear power plant.

title: Semantic Enhanced Knowledge Graph Periodic Reasoning Method and Device
description: The invention discloses a semantically enhanced knowledge graph periodic reasoning method and device, belonging to the technical field of knowledge graphs. The method includes: discretizing the knowledge graph at suitable time intervals to obtain time series subgraphs of different periods; calculating the vector representation of the same entity in different time series subgraphs through relational graph convolution network; The vector representation of the sub-graph is integrated to obtain the entity vector representation of a time series period; the entity vector representation containing the time series semantic information is obtained by using the TransE model idea and combining the loss function model to optimize the parameters of the entity vector representation. This patent aggregates local neighbor information of entity nodes through relational graph convolutional network, which makes our model more semantically expressive, and uses gated recurrent units to train vectors of a time series period. Compared with the prior art, Better performance on periodic temporal information inference tasks.

title: System and method for controlling industrial assets in the presence of a cyber attack
description: Systems and methods for controlling industrial assets, such as power generation assets, are provided. Thus, the cyber attack model predicts a plurality of operational impacts on the industrial asset resulting from a plurality of potential cyber attacks. The cyber attack model also predicts a corresponding plurality of potential mitigation responses. In operation, a cyber attack affecting at least one component of the industrial asset is detected via the cyber attack neutralization module, and a protected operational impact of the cyber attack is identified based on the cyber attack model. The cyber attack neutralization module selects at least one mitigation response of the plurality of mitigation responses based on the predicted operational impact and alters an operational state of the industrial asset based on the selected mitigation response.

title: Processing method and device for screening lake satellite radar height measurement data and electronic equipment
description: The invention discloses a processing method and device for screening lake satellite radar height measurement data and electronic equipment. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring random sample data from satellite radar height measurement data of the global lake surface; basic data required by the random sample data comprise global satellite height measurement data and lake boundary data; processing the random sample data based on a preset graphical interface tool, and displaying an echo waveform and multi-source auxiliary information corresponding to the random sample data; the multi-source auxiliary information comprises a multi-source footprint characteristic value and geographical position information; according to the echo waveform and the multi-source auxiliary information, carrying out category marking on random sample data; and performing machine learning model training by using the marked random sample data to obtain an automatic classification model of the lake satellite radar height measurement data. The invention solves the technical problem of low sampling and classifying efficiency of lake satellite radar height measurement data.

title: Multimodal data classification method and system based on deep learning
description: The invention provides a multi-modal data classification method and system based on deep learning.
