The method comprises the following steps: acquiring N groups of data, and dividing the data into a training set, a verification set and a test set; training the training set; recording the verification result after the last training as a matrix S; testing by adopting a deep learning network model with a test set after training is completed, and obtaining a softmax matrix R from each group of test data; multiplying the elements in the matrix S as weights according to the corresponding classification corresponding modal characteristics by the elements in the softmax matrix R corresponding to each group of test data to obtain a matrix F of each group of test data; adding probabilities corresponding to different modes of the same classification in the matrix F to obtain a matrix Fr; and performing softmax processing on the matrix Fr to obtain a final classification result. The multi-modal data classification method based on deep learning reduces the overfitting degree of the neural network and improves the classification capability of the multi-modal neural network.

title: System and method for disinfecting adjacent areas between individuals using ultraviolet light
description: Systems and methods for disinfecting adjacent areas between individuals using ultraviolet light. A decontamination system for a space includes an Ultraviolet (UV) light source configured to emit UV light. The system includes a sensor device configured to sense a position of a plurality of individuals within a space. The system includes a controller in communication with the sensor device. The controller is configured to monitor locations of a plurality of individuals, determine that two or more individuals are less than a threshold distance from each other based on the locations of the plurality of individuals, and control the UV light source to emit UV light toward a vicinity between the two or more individuals in response to determining that the two or more individuals are less than the threshold distance from each other.

title: A Differentiable Genetic Programming Symbolic Regression Method
description: The invention relates to a differentiable genetic programming symbolic regression method, belonging to the technical field of data processing. The proposed method initializes a basic expression set and then starts iterative optimization. The initial expression set contains some basic mathematical expressions, such as x and x+y. In each iteration, each mathematical expression is first transformed into a differentiable symbol tree, and then gradient descent is used to gradually optimize the structure of the symbol tree. After the execution result of the symbol tree converges with the loss of the true value, the discrete structure is sampled from it. In addition, in order to avoid the search process falling into local optimum, the genetic operator is executed on the sampled symbol tree to generate more new mathematical expressions, etc.

title: A multi-scale cultural relic point cloud super-resolution method and system
description: The invention relates to a multi-scale cultural relic point cloud super-resolution method and a multi-scale cultural relic point cloud super-resolution system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring cultural relic point cloud data; acquiring a point cloud super-resolution model; and inputting the cultural relic point cloud data into the point cloud super-resolution model to obtain a cultural relic point cloud super-resolution result. The point cloud super-resolution model comprises at least one processing subsystem; the processing subsystem includes: the dynamic residual error image processing system comprises a feature embedding module, a first dynamic residual error image attention module, a dynamic residual error image attention module with introduced scale vectors, a second dynamic residual error image attention module and an up-sampling module. The invention provides a point cloud super-resolution model which comprises a feature embedding module and a dynamic residual image attention module and can effectively extract high-level semantic features of point clouds, on the basis, multi-scale information is introduced to replace a conventional single-scale network structure, and compared with the conventional image convolution structure, the invention can reduce video memory occupation and improve the quality of the finally generated point clouds.

title: A training method, device, equipment and medium for a text matching model
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of text retrieval, and provides a text matching model training method, the method comprising: obtaining data of a text set to be input; establishing a constraint layer in a neural network model to generate a constraint weight matrix; Input to the encoding layer in the neural network model to generate an encoding vector; input the character vector to the decoding layer in the neural network model to generate a decoding vector; normalize the decoding vector to generate a sample data set; The constraint weight matrix trains the text matching model to obtain a trained text matching model. The invention can reduce the storage memory of the feature vector and reduce the training cost of the text matching model.

title: A method and system for intelligent analysis and prediction of substation transformer status
description: The application discloses a method and a system for intelligently analyzing and predicting the state of a transformer substation, mainly relates to the technical field of transformers of the transformer substation, and is used for solving the problems that an existing mechanism model is not timely and asynchronous, an algorithm model is not accurate enough and the like. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source data of a transformer pair; determining a calculation running state and a calculation change trend corresponding to multi-source data based on a preset multi-physical field mechanism model and a preset first artificial intelligence model; and determining the final operation state and the final change trend corresponding to the transformer according to the preset second artificial intelligence module, the calculation operation state and the calculation change trend. According to the method, the defects of a single mode are overcome, and high-precision state evaluation, risk identification and situation prediction of component level and equipment level performance of the main transformer under complex working conditions are achieved.

title: Method, device, electronic equipment, and storage medium for predicting the state of health of a lithium battery
description: The embodiments of this specification relate to the technical field of lithium batteries, and in particular to a method, device, electronic equipment, and storage medium for predicting the state of health of a lithium battery. Among them, the prediction method of the health state of the lithium battery includes: collecting the cycle aging data of the target lithium battery during multiple charge and discharge cycles; wherein, the cycle aging data includes the original voltage data and the original temperature data; for each charge and discharge cycle, the Execution: Clean the original voltage data and original temperature data in the current charge and discharge cycle to obtain the target voltage data and target temperature data; based on the target voltage data and target temperature data, obtain the DTV data of the current charge and discharge cycle; Perform feature extraction on the DTV data of the charge and discharge cycle to obtain time series data; input the time series data into the preset LSTM model for training to obtain a prediction model; use the prediction model to predict the health status of the lithium battery to be tested and quantify the uncertainty sex results.

title: Apparatus for providing notification information and method thereof
description: According to the present invention, a method for providing information, performed in an electronic device, is disclosed, comprising the following steps: identifying one or more indicators related to the provision of services; obtaining historical information related to a first indicator included in the one or more indicators; obtaining critical information corresponding to the first indicator based on the historical information; applying the critical information; and determining, based on the critical information, whether to provide a notification related to the first indicator.

title: Switched artificial synapse
description: Electronic neural circuit including at least one pre-neuron having an output voltage VAout, and at least one post-neuron that are linked by at least one excitatory synapse having at least one switching input, wherein the excitatory synapse is supplied with power by the output VAout and receives, on its switching input, a switching signal VAout_bar whose state is complementary to that of the output VAout.

title: Method for developing agitation system of a scale-up polymerization vessel
description: The application relates to a method for developing the agitation system of a scale-up polymerization vessel. A simulated prediction model is obtained by use of a small polymerization vessel and by integrating Taguchi experimental design with artificial intelligence (AI) neural network. Accordingly, vessel parameters for the agitation system of a scale-up polymerization vessel can be rapidly and accurately predicted based on simulation qualities thereof, further facilitating a construction of the agitation system of a scale-up polymerization vessel.

title: Parallel processing of image regions with neural networks – decoding, post filtering, and rdoq
description: The present disclosure relates to picture encoding and decoding of image regions on tile-basis. In particular, multiple components of an input tensor including a first and second component in spatial dimensions is processed within multiple pipelines. The processing of the first component includes dividing the first component in the spatial dimensions into a first plurality of tiles. Likewise, the processing of the second component includes dividing the second component in the spatial dimensions into a second plurality of tiles. The respective first and second plurality of tiles are then processed each separately. Among the first and second plurality of tiles there are at least two respective collocated tiles differing in size. In case of compression, the processing of the first and/or second component includes picture encoding, rate distortion optimization quantization, and picture filtering. In case of decompression, the processing includes picture decoding and picture filtering.

title: Recognition using re-recognition and statistical classification
description: Architecture that employs an overall grammar as a set of context-specific grammars for recognition of an input, each responsible for a specific context, such as subtask category, geographic region, etc. The grammars together cover the entire domain. Moreover, multiple recognitions can be run in parallel against the same input, where each recognition uses one or more of the context-specific grammars. The multiple intermediate recognition results from the different recognizer-grammars are reconciled by running re-recognition using a dynamically composed grammar based on the multiple recognition results and potentially other domain knowledge, or selecting the winner using a statistical classifier operating on classification features extracted from the multiple recognition results and other domain knowledge.

title: Machine learning based discovery of software as a service
description:
An example embodiment involves receiving an activity record including activity data, 
provider data, and description data; applying a first layer of a multi-layer machine learning (ML) 
model to predict that the activity record relates to software, applying a second layer of the multi
layer ML model to predict a provider name of a software application referenced in the activity 
record, applying a third layer of the multi-layer ML model to predict an application title of the 
software application referenced in the activity record, and storing, in a database, a configuration 
item indicating that the activity record relates to software, where the configuration item contains 
attributes including the provider name and the application title.

title: Platform, systems, and devices for 3D printing
description: Described are 3D printing platforms comprising stereolithographic 3D printing devices utilizing a static optical assembly and procedural modeling applications representing 3D scenes as signed distance function. Described are also structures such as bioreactors that can be printed using such platforms, as well as characteristics and used thereof.

title: Apparatus and method for analysis, sample container and cap for a sample container
description: A cartridge for use in gathering a swab sample, comprising: a main body having a sidewall defining an interior space, the main body having an open end; a swab holder configured to hold a swab, and which is removably attachable to the main body, wherein at least part of a swab held by the swab holder is within the interior space; an aperture formed in the sidewall; and a slide carrier having a slide portion and a rim portion, wherein: the slide carrier can be engaged with the aperture in a first position, so that the slide carrier is releasably attached to the sidewall, at least a part of the slide portion is received within the interior space, and at least a part of the rim portion protrudes outwardly beyond the main body; the slide carrier can be repeatedly placed in the first position, and separated from the main body; when the slide carrier is engaged with the aperture, the slide carrier may be removed from the main body by being moved in a first direction; the slide carrier is wider than the main body in a direction perpendicular with the first direction; and the slide carrier comprises engagement features which, when the slide carrier is engaged with the aperture, protrude beyond the main body in a direction perpendicular with the first direction, such that the slide carrier can be removed from the main body by pushing on the engagement features in the first direction.

title: Method and system for evaluating performance of developers using artificial intelligence (ai)
description:
A method and system for evaluating performance of developers using Artificial 
Intelligence (AI) is disclosed. In some embodiments, the method includes receiving, 
each of a plurality of performance parameters associated with a set of developers.  
The method further includes creating one or more feature vectors corresponding to 
each of the plurality of performance parameters, based on one or more features 
determined for each of the plurality of performance parameters. The method further 
includes assessing the one or more feature vectors, based on the first pre-trained 
machine learning model. The method further includes classifying the set of 
developers into one of a set of performance categories based on the assessing of 
the one or more feature vectors. The method further includes evaluating the 
performance of at least one of the set of developers, based on an associated category 
in the set of performance categories, in response to the classifying.

title: Template-based generation of synthetic data sets
description: A method includes obtaining first data records associated with a first schema. Each respective data record of the first data records may include corresponding values of a plurality of fields. The method also includes obtaining a mapping representing a transformation of a field of the plurality of fields from the first schema to a training schema, and selecting, based on the mapping and for each respective data record of the first data records, a corresponding value of the field from the first data records. The method further includes generating second data records by transforming, based on the mapping and for each respective data record of the first data records, the corresponding value of the field from the first schema to the training schema. The method additionally includes training a machine learning model based on the second data records.

title: Mission planning for weapons systems
description: A mission planning method for use with a weapon is disclosed. The method comprises:obtaining a first training data set describing the performance of the weapon; using the first training data set and a Gaussian Process (GP) or Neural Network to obtain a first surrogate model giving a functional approximation of the performance of the weapon; and providing the first surrogate model to a weapons system for use in calculating a performance characteristic of the weapon during combat operations.

title: Semantic segmentation to identify and treat plants in a field and verify the plant treatments
description: A farming machine including a number of treatment mechanisms treats plants according to a treatment plan as the farming machine moves through the field. The control system of the farming machine executes a plant identification model configured to identify plants in the field for treatment. The control system generates a treatment map identifying which treatment mechanisms to actuate to treat the plants in the field. To generate a treatment map, the farming machine captures an image of plants, processes the image to identify plants, and generates a treatment map. The plant identification model can be a convolutional neural network having an input layer, an identification layer, and an output layer. The input layer has the dimensionality of the image, the identification layer has a greatly reduced dimensionality, and the output layer has the dimensionality of the treatment mechanisms.

title: Real-time video ultra resolution
description: A computer-implemented method for increasing the image resolution of a digital image. The method includes performing bicubic upsampling of the digital image to generate a base high-resolution (HR) image. The digital image is converted from a red-green-blue (RGB) color space to a Luma (Y), Chroma Blue Difference (Cb), and Chroma Red Difference (Cr) (YCbCr) color space to generate a low-resolution (LR) residual image. A plurality of convolutional layers of a neural network model is applied to the LR residual image to convert it to a plurality of HR residual sub-images corresponding to the digital image. An HR image corresponding to the digital image is generated using the base HR image and the plurality of HR residual sub-images.

title: Method and device for determining trajectories of mobile elements
description: Method for determining the trajectory of at least one mobile element from position data, characterized in that it comprises an initial step consisting in classifying a set of positions relating to at least one detected mobile element by applying a first data classification algorithm to said set of positions, which provides an initial trajectory relating to each detected mobile element. The method comprises the following steps, implemented on each current observation window: - classifying each new position detected in at least one trajectory by applying a second data classification algorithm; - identifying, for each detected mobile element, the positions relating to said detected mobile element; - determining an intermediate complete trajectory for each detected mobile element; - determining a final complete trajectory for each detected mobile element. title: A controller and method for transporting devices
description:
A Controller and Method for Transporting Devices

the controller limits the loads imparted on a grid of pathways structure by the plurality of

particular, there is provided a controller arranged to control movement of a plurality of 
transporting devices, the plurality of transporting devices arranged to transport containers, the 
10 containers being stored in a facility, the facility arranged to store the containers in a plurality of 
stacks, the facility comprising a plurality of pathways arranged in cells so as to form a grid-like 
structure above the stacks, wherein the grid-like structure extends in a first direction and in a 
second direction, the plurality of transporting devices arranged to operate on the grid-like

20 area. Moreover, at least one of the clearance unit is further arranged to grant or withhold 
clearance to a transporting device to traverse a portion of the determined route based on the 
calculated constraint limit in the particular constraint area, and the route determination unit is 
further arranged to determine a route for a transporting device from one location to another 
location traversing or not traversing a particular constraint area based on the calculated 
25 constraint limit in the particular constraint area.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHOD FOR PREDICTING VEHICLE DIMENSIONS
description: Systems and methods are provided for controlling a vehicle. In one embodiment, a vehicle dimension prediction method includes generating a set of simulated observed dimensions based on a set of known vehicle dimensions and training a machine learning module based on the set of simulated observed dimensions and the set of known vehicle dimensions. The method further includes acquiring sensor data associated with a first vehicle as observed by a sensor system of an autonomous vehicle, determining observed dimensions of the first vehicle based on the sensed sensor data, and determining predicted actual dimensions of the first vehicle with a first vehicle Processor by applying the plurality of observed dimensions to the machine learning model.

title: Process for a measurement system in the vehicle for the detection and classification of objects in the vehicle environment using a deep learning process with a self-learning decision maker
description: The invention relates to a method for recognizing objects and / or object components and / or arrangements of objects and / or object components on the basis of the second object recognition results of a second neural network model (136) of a second measuring system (161) and on the basis of third object recognition results of a fourth neural network model (156) of a third measuring system (162) by a fifth neural network model (158). The claimed method relates to the training of the neural networks, the fifth neural network model (158) acting as a voter.

title: Determination of a future switching behavior of a system unit
description: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method for configuring a system model and a computer-implemented method for configuring a sensor model. The invention also relates to a computer-implemented method for determining a future switching behavior of a system unit, comprising the steps: a. Receiving the configured plant model; b. Receiving the configured sensor model; wobeic. the configured sensor model is a probability distribution of how the sensor unit will behave in the specific period of time; d. Determining at least one sample of a behavior of a sensor unit by sampling from the probability distribution; unde. Determination of the future switching behavior of the system unit and / or at least one associated statistical value using the trained system model on the basis of the determined sample. Furthermore, the invention is directed to a corresponding computer program product.

title: System for performing a XiL-based simulation
description: The invention relates to a method for carrying out an XiL-based simulation, with the steps: (S100) reading in operating data sets (BDS), (S200) training an artificial intelligence (4) with the operating data sets (BDS), (S300 ) generating test data sets (TDS) with the trained artificial intelligence (4), and (S400) providing the test data sets (TDS) for the XiL simulation.

title: Method and device for training a neural network with quantized parameters
description: A device for training a neural network for a target function is described. The apparatus is configured to quantize one or more activations of the one or more layers of the neural network using an activation quantization function to determine one or more corresponding quantized activations, and the one or more sets of parameters of the one or more layers using a quantize a parameter quantization function to determine one or more corresponding sets of quantized parameters. The device is also set up to determine a predicted output of the neural network based on the one or more quantized activations and based on the one or more sets of quantized parameters. Furthermore, the device is set up to adapt the activation quantization function, the parameter quantization function and the one or more sets of parameters on the basis of the predicted output and on the basis of an optimization function.

title: Method and device for jointly determining an optimal architecture of a neural network and optimal hyperparameters for training the neural network
description: Method for determining an optimal architecture of a neural network for a given data set comprising training data and validation data and optimal hyperparameters for training the neural network, comprising the following steps: defining a common search space which characterizes possible architectures of the neural network and possible hyperparameter configuration. Drawing candidates from the search space and training neural networks according to the drawn candidates on the training data and validating the trained neural networks on the validation data. Initializing a Gaussian process, where the Gaussian process has a Weisfeiler-Lehman graph kernel. Run a Bayesian optimization to find the candidate architecture that performed best.

title: Method and device for optical inspections
description: Method for training a machine learning system for the optical quality inspection of manufactured products (31a, 31b), comprising the following steps: providing (S21) a data set comprising first variables, which are sensor data with an imaging sensor (30) of recorded manufactured products (31a, 31b), and assigned second variables that characterize a quality of the respective recorded manufactured product; Training (S23) a machine learning system with a first subset of first and assigned second variables, wherein during training a loss function is optimized with regard to a prediction accuracy of the machine learning system, the loss function having a combination of a plurality of loss terms that characterize a prediction accuracy and at least characterize a performance parameter of the machine learning system.

title: Verification system, verification method, and non-transitory computer readable recording medium
description: This disclosure provides a verification system. The authentication system includes a biological information acquisition device and an identification device. The first processor of the biological information acquisition device is used for generating first authentication information, and encrypting the biometric data according to the first authentication information to generate encrypted biological data. The second processor of the identification device is configured to generate the second authentication information, and generate the likelihood vector identification result information according to the encrypted biological data, and use the second authentication information to encrypt the likelihood vector identification result information. The first processor uses the first authentication information to decrypt the encrypted likelihood vector recognition result information, and determines whether to generate an instruction according to the packet decryption and inference results.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR PROVIDING A SITE-SPECIFIC FERTILIZER RECOMMENDATION
description: System and method for adjusting a fertilizer recommendation for an agronomic field based on remote sensing and determining a position-dependent yield to adjust it. In different embodiments, different approaches are provided for a nutrient-specific fertilizer recommendation setting, comprising the selection of a fertilizer product.

title: Method and apparatus for optimal representation of variables in the nervous system
description: Some aspects of the case support techniques for optimal representation of variables in the nervous system. The bit allocation of the neural signals and parameters in the neural network described in this case may include: at least one measurement based on the sensitivity of the predetermined performance metric to the quantization error in the neural signal, assigning the quantization level to the neural signal; and based on the predetermined The at least one measure of the sensitivity of the performance metric to the quantization error in the parameter assigns the bit to the parameter.

title: Face recognition method
description: This case is a face recognition method that first receives an input image. After receiving the input image, the first convolutional neural network model is used to perform face recognition on the input image to generate at least a first block of interest. Each first block of interest contains a suspicious image, and the pixel values of the suspicious image are in each The proportion of the pixel values of the first block of interest is greater than the proportion of the pixel values of the suspicious image in the pixel values of the input image. Then use the second convolutional neural network model to perform face recognition on each first block of interest to generate at least one second block of interest. The number of convolutional operation layers of the second convolutional neural network model is small. The number of convolutional operation layers in the first convolutional neural network model. Finally, a mark corresponding to the position of the second block of interest is displayed on the input image.

title: Method for determining and/or monitoring the condition of a lubricant dispenser
description: The invention relates to a method for determining and/or monitoring the state of an electromechanically operated lubricant dispenser, wherein the lubricant dispenser has a container filled with lubricant and an electromechanical drive unit which is exchangeably connected to the container and with which lubricant can be conveyed from the container to an outlet, wherein the drive unit or one or more sensors integrated into the drive unit and/or into the container provide measurement data for one or more measured variables and wherein at least one state of the lubricant dispenser is determined on the basis of the measurement data. The method is characterized in that the measurement data or data generated therefrom are processed as input data by a classification algorithm trained using machine learning methods, which classifies a state of the lubricant dispenser on the basis of the input data. For this purpose, the measurement data can be made available, for example with a predetermined sampling rate, as time series with a plurality of measured values for one or more measured variables, and these time series or data generated therefrom are processed as input data (E) by the algorithm.

title: Method and system for unsupervised discovery of unigrams in speech recognition systems
description: SUMMARY A system and method for automatically discovering unigrams in a speech data element may include receiving a linguistic model that includes a plurality of n-grams, where each n-gram includes one or more unigrams; applying a machine learning (ML) acoustic model on one or more speech data elements to obtain a character distribution function; apply a greedy decoder on the character distribution function, to predict an initial corpus of unigrams; filter one or more unigrams from the initial corpus to obtain a corpus of candidate unigrams, where the candidate unigrams are not included in the linguistic model; analyzing the one or more first speech data elements to extract at least one n-gram comprising a candidate unigram; and update the linguistic model to include the at least one extracted n-gram.

title: Test procedure for virtual testing of a fuel cell
description: The present invention relates to a test method for virtual testing of a fuel cell (100), having the following steps: specifying a default parameter (VP) in the form of at least one test parameter (VPT) for the course of the virtual test, specifying a default parameter (VP) in the form of at least one fuel cell parameter (VPZ) for the fuel cell (100) to be virtually tested,  specification of a specification parameter (VP) in the form of at least one connection parameter (VPA) for the fuel cell (100) to be tested virtually,  specification of a specification parameter (VP) in the form of at least one gas parameter (VPG) for the gases to be used in the virtual test,  specification of a default parameter (VP) in the form of at least one operating parameter (VPB) for virtual operation of the fuel cell (100),  input of the specified default parameters (VP ) into a virtual test device (10),  execution of the virtual test based on the default parameters (VP ) for generating a virtual test result (TE),  Output of the generated virtual test result (TE) from the test device (10).

title: Homomorphic reasoning apparatus, homomorphic reasoning method, homomorphic reasoning program, and secret information processing system
description: A range determination unit (412) receives an input ciphertext Ci obtained by encrypting input data, determines whether or not a value obtained from the input data falls within a reference range, and performs range encryption according to the determined result. A sentence aj is generated. The result generation unit (413) performs a result of inference including non-polynomial operation on the input data by performing a homomorphic operation on the range ciphertext aj generated by the range determination unit (412). A ciphertext D is generated. The output unit (414) outputs the result ciphertext D.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, and program
description: [Problem] Suppressing calculation costs in a calculation method using automatic differentiation [Solution] An information processing device (1) includes an acquisition unit (21) that acquires initial values for calculation of a value of an object function that directly or indirectly includes one or more parameters as arguments, and a calculation unit (26) that calculates a differential coefficient of the object function, wherein the calculation process of the differential coefficient by the calculation unit includes a first process and a second process, the calculation process of the differential coefficient by the calculation unit includes an iterative process, the first process includes a part of the iterative process, the second process includes a part other than the part of the iterative process, and the calculation process of the differential coefficient by the calculation unit includes a third process including a calculation process of automatic differentiation for a process that does not include the first process but includes the second process. [Selected Figure] Figure 1

title: Work support system and work support program
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a work support system suitable for dealing with various kinds of work. An AI manual system extracts a term from a manual describing a procedure, contents, points to be noted, or other matters based on a term table in which one or more terms are registered, and extracts the extracted terms. A rule that describes a judgment condition for a work target or work situation is generated as an element. Then, the sensor information is acquired from the device 300, the work target and the work situation corresponding to the term as an element in the determination condition are recognized based on the acquired sensor information, and the work support information is based on the rule and the recognition result. Is transmitted to the device 300. [Selection] Figure 1

title: Method and system for determining a color recipe
description: The present invention relates to a method for determining a prescription for a sample color that matches a target color based on a given range of color base and based on a color prescription that is no longer used. According to the proposed method, a color prediction model is used to calculate the gap between the color parameter of each candidate color formula and the color parameter of the target color, and the genetic algorithm uses a population of candidate color formulas. Used to obtain a prescription for the sample color from Here, the difference between the color parameters of each of the candidate color prescriptions of the group of candidate color prescriptions with respect to the color parameters of the target color is automatically set to the candidate color prescriptions in which the predetermined stop criteria are held as sample color prescriptions. Until it is guided and met, it is minimized by a genetic algorithm with an iterative process of mutation / crossover and selection of candidate color formulas that best fit the fitness criteria.   [Selection] Figure 2

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and information processing program
description: The analysis unit (120) divides the hierarchized program code into a plurality of program elements according to a predetermined division condition, analyzes each program element of the plurality of program elements, attributes of each program element, and a plurality of program elements To extract the hierarchy. The functional module extraction unit (130) performs machine learning based on the attribute of each program element extracted by the analysis unit (120) and the hierarchy of the plurality of program elements, and groups the plurality of program elements into a plurality of groups. To do.

title: Identification system, parameter value update method and program
description: The intermediate data deriving means 703 derives intermediate data in a process of identifying an object represented by the data based on the parameter values of a predetermined layer and the data. The first identification means 704 identifies the object represented by the data based on the intermediate data and the parameter values of the lamina propria of the model of the identification system itself. The second identification means 705 identifies the object represented by the data based on the intermediate data and the parameter value of the lamina propria in the model of the other identification system for each other identification system in a predetermined case. The eigenparameter value updating means 706 relearns the parameter value of the eigenlayer in the model of the discriminating system itself based on the label for the data determined based on the discriminating result obtained as a result and the teacher data including the data. ..

title: User screening method, device, equipment and medium
description: The present application relates to the field of computer technology, and in particular to a user screening method, device, equipment and medium, the method comprising: obtaining a plurality of target user feature sets according to received pre-push text, calculating the user priority of each target user and screening out a plurality of first user feature sets, expanding the number of first user feature sets, and determining positive sample sets and negative sample sets to train a target neural network model, using the target neural network model to label a given full amount of users, screening out a plurality of second user feature sets, and returning to perform the screening of the first user feature set and the acquisition steps of the target neural network model, until the user change rate corresponding to the plurality of target user feature sets is less than a preset change rate threshold, screening the target user at this time as a final user; the present invention can screen out comprehensive users that meet the requirements, thereby realizing the accurate push of the pre-push text.

title: Topology road network controllable generation method and system oriented to automatic driving simulation
description: The present invention discloses a controllable generation method and system of a topological road network for autonomous driving simulation. First, the present invention encodes spatial position constraints and inputs them into a generator to generate a road network image under the constraints. Then, a discriminator makes a judgment on the authenticity of the generated road network image and whether it complies with the constraints of the spatial position feature map. At the same time, a differentiable topological structure extractor is used to extract the topological structure of the generated road network image for the topological attribute reward network to calculate the topological attribute score of the generated road network, and the topological attribute score is used to guide the generator to generate a topological road network that meets specific topological attributes. Based on a generative artificial intelligence model, the present invention simultaneously models and learns the road network spatial position information and topological features in the training data, and generates a large number of topological road network models with strong connectivity and meeting the expected attributes under given spatial position constraints.

title: Automatic topology identification system and method for power distribution area
description: The invention discloses an automatic identification system and method for distribution area topology, relates to the technical field of distribution boards, and aims to solve the problem of inaccurate communication interaction during power equipment topology. The automatic topology identification system and method for the power distribution station can be used for adjusting the time interval of communication interaction transmission, effectively maintaining the stability of communication interaction and transmission and ensuring the reliability of interaction data. The method is beneficial to preventing potential problems in equipment communication interaction, improving the stability and reliability of topology, optimizing control on equipment communication interaction frequency, improving the communication interaction quality of equipment, improving the transmission efficiency, stability and reliability, reducing resource waste, realizing intelligent power equipment topology management, unifying power equipment with the same line type in the power equipment, realizing mutual communication of carrier equipment in the same power line, and further completing the identification of the automatic topology relation of low-voltage equipment.

title: Machine learning algorithm improvement method and system based on large language model
description: The invention discloses a machine learning algorithm improvement method and system based on a large language model, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting analysis prompts and technical documents into the large language model to generate analysis results of an existing machine learning algorithm, utilizing the large language model to mine potential innovation points based on the analysis results, utilizing the large language model to generate a new machine learning algorithm by using a meta learning strategy, combining the large language model with a model interpretation tool to generate a model fusion strategy by utilizing the large language model, combining prediction results of a plurality of newly generated machine learning algorithms, utilizing the large language model to automatically generate a feature engineering strategy, inputting the generated feature engineering strategy into an automatic feature tool to conduct feature extraction, and utilizing a training and verification data set to train and evaluate the final machine learning algorithm. The invention improves the performance and accuracy of the machine learning algorithm by analyzing the existing machine learning algorithm by using a large language model.

title: Data storage device and bridge device
description: The invention provides a data storage device and a bridging device. The data storage device includes a data storage medium, a processor including a plurality of processor cores, a plurality of application acceleration black box slots, a host interface receiving a host command from a remote application running on a remote host computer, the host command including an image file including a register transfer level bitstream and a firmware driver image, and a configuration controller downloading the register transfer level bitstream to the application acceleration black box slots and reconfiguring the application acceleration black box slots and loading the firmware driver image to the processor cores of the processor. The processor core runs a data acceleration process of the remote application to access data stored in the data storage medium and processes the data stored in the data storage medium using a register transfer level bit stream. The present invention may provide an efficient data processing solution while reducing the overall cost of computing and storage infrastructure.

title: An Agent-based Intelligent Patent Retrieval Method and System
description: The present invention discloses an agent-based intelligent patent search method and system, which rewrites the information related to the search target input by the user to generate specific query questions, and uses the trained question generation model to generate rewritten questions from the original input questions; evaluates and optimizes the rewriting effect, and continuously performs generation, evaluation and optimization cycles until the expected standards are reached; respectively uses the user's original input and the rewritten query questions to perform patent search, and performs feature analysis and statistics on the retrieved patents, and judges whether the patent search results meet the requirements based on the IPC classification number concentration degree and patent vector space distance of the retrieved patents. It helps to more accurately screen and recommend patent documents that meet user needs, thereby improving the quality of search results. Dynamic adjustment meets user needs, comprehensively considers user feedback to optimize the system, and improves user satisfaction and user experience.

title: Point material image characteristic enhancement method, device, medium, program product and terminal
description: The application provides a spot material image characteristic enhancement method, a spot material image characteristic enhancement device, a medium, a program product and a terminal, wherein the enhancement processing of an original spot material image is realized through a central reduction model formed by combining a transducer model and a U-net model, so that the problem of image center deviation caused by X laser of a spot material machine is solved. Meanwhile, the image quality input to the center restoring model is improved through a plurality of preprocessing methods, so that the accurate analysis of the detail characteristics of the image and the integral characteristics of the materials after model training can be ensured, and the spot material identification accuracy is effectively improved. The method can be better suitable for various novel materials, improves the image enhancement accuracy, realizes more efficient and accurate material counting operation, and solves the problems that the surface mount component material counting machine is low in material counting efficiency, partial material counting is difficult to count and X laser image distortion is solved.

title: Cross-domain battlefield target recognition method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The invention provides a battlefield target cross-domain identification method and system based on deep reinforcement learning, which relate to the technical field of target identification and comprise the steps of respectively obtaining a marked source field target image and a unmarked target field target image based on a source field battlefield environment and a target field battlefield environment, extracting source field image characteristics and target field image characteristics through a deep convolution neural network model, mapping to the same characteristic space through countermeasure training based on a countermeasure domain adaptation network, learning common characteristic representation, obtaining target field image domain adaptation characteristics through reducing distribution difference, inputting the target field image domain adaptation characteristics into a deep reinforcement learning module, learning an optimal classification strategy aiming at a target field battlefield target identification task through interactive exploration of an intelligent body and a reinforcement learning environment containing a state space, an action space and a reward function, classifying the target field image domain adaptation characteristics based on the optimal classification strategy, and outputting a battlefield target cross-domain identification result.

title: A method for predicting pH value of concrete in submarine immersed tunnel
description: The invention discloses a method for predicting the concrete pH value of a submarine immersed tube tunnel. First, monitoring data of the submarine immersed tube tunnel is obtained, including temperature, humidity, polarization resistance, dielectric resistance, Cl ion concentration, corrosion current density and pH value of a concrete structure; the obtained monitoring data is preprocessed and normalized to form a data set of a time series; then the periodic characteristics of the frequency components of the data are identified; then an LSTM model and a Transformer model are constructed, the temperature, humidity, polarization resistance, dielectric resistance, Cl ion concentration, corrosion current density and pH value of a previous time period are used as input variables, and the pH value of a subsequent time period is used as a predicted output variable; the LSTM model and the Transformer model are trained using the data set and the obtained periodic characteristics; after the model training is completed, the prediction results of the LSTM model and the Transformer model are fused by a weighted average method to generate a final prediction result.

title: Corn ear DUS character judging method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of crop trait discrimination, and discloses a corn ear DUS trait discrimination method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: inputting a corn ear image training set into a neural network model based on DeepViT and ASPP for training, using a corn ear image test set for testing, adding ear images of other trait categories based on the training test results to update a corn ear image sample set, and repeating the training and testing process until the training test results meet the requirements, and using the corn ear DUS trait discrimination model that has been finally trained to generate a DUS trait discrimination result of a corn ear to be discriminated. Thus, by considering the influence of the introduction of corn ear image samples of each trait category on the improvement of the discrimination accuracy of all trait categories, the training samples are gradually increased, and the efficiency and accuracy of corn ear DUS trait discrimination are improved while the sample processing workload is reduced.

title: Network slice allocation optimization method and device based on service drive
description: The present invention relates to the field of communication network technology, and in particular to a service-driven network slice allocation optimization method and device, wherein the method comprises: constructing a slice architecture based on at least one actual requirement of each business scenario in the current network environment, constructing an intelligent agent for each slice for training a target neural network, outputting a slice allocation set from the trained target neural network for population optimization, obtaining a target slice allocation set for each business scenario, and optimizing the target slice allocation set based on a preference list of business scenarios and slices to perform slice allocation in the current network environment. The present invention can construct a network slicing framework based on the different requirements of multiple business scenarios, and perform multi-agent reinforcement learning, multi-objective optimization, and business slice preference matching based on the framework, thereby realizing a dynamically adjusted network slice optimization process according to actual business needs, thereby improving user experience and network operation and maintenance efficiency.

title: Intelligent question-answering method for electric power problems
description: The present invention proposes an intelligent question-answering method for power problems, which includes: receiving user queries; parsing the user queries through the DRL algorithm, and formulating the best path to retrieve relevant information from the power knowledge base based on the parsing results, and generating a query strategy; retrieving relevant information from the power knowledge base according to the query strategy, and in the information retrieval process, introducing an attention mechanism to dynamically assign weights to the retrieved information; constructing a power knowledge graph based on a graph neural network, combining the power knowledge graph, and performing logical reasoning and rule matching on the retrieved information through a hybrid reasoning engine to generate a target answer; outputting the target answer to the user. The intelligent question-answering method for power problems proposed in the present invention realizes efficient, accurate, and intelligent answers to power problems through the organic combination of the DRL algorithm, the attention mechanism, the graph neural network, and the hybrid reasoning engine.

title: Method, apparatus and medium for generating NIMBY event response strategies based on reinforcement learning
description: This invention discloses a method, apparatus, and medium for generating NIMBY (Not In My Backyard) event response strategies based on reinforcement learning. The method includes: setting parameters and constructing a reinforcement learning model according to the NIMBY event scenario; obtaining an initial state; performing reinforcement learning on the reinforcement learning model using the Q-Learning algorithm; and iteratively determining the optimal strategy with the goal of maximizing reward. The apparatus includes a setting module and a simulation module. The medium includes a computer program storing the aforementioned reinforcement learning-based NIMBY event response strategy generation method. By using this invention, the problems of lack of universality and dynamic uncertainty in traditional risk and crisis analysis methods are solved, and the output of the optimal behavioral strategy can effectively mitigate the instability risks caused by NIMBY events. This invention can be widely applied in the field of strategy self-generation.

title: Short-term forecasting method of comprehensive energy multi-load based on secondary decoupling
description: The present invention provides a comprehensive energy multi-load short-term forecasting method based on secondary decoupling, including collecting multi-load data sets, reconstructing winter data sets and summer data sets in the multi-load data sets to perform primary decoupling; decomposing the reconstructed winter data sets and summer data sets; dividing the decomposed data into periodic items and trend items to perform secondary decoupling; screening the trend items, and predicting the screened trend items to obtain trend item prediction results; performing multi-load forecasting on the periodic items to obtain periodic item prediction results, and adding the trend item prediction results and the periodic item prediction results to obtain the final prediction results. The present invention can effectively capture the coupling of multi-load components, and can achieve accurate decomposition of nonlinear and non-stationary signals, improve noise resistance and time-frequency resolution, and effectively improve the prediction accuracy while taking into account balance.

title: Method for predicting composition and yield of supercritical multi-component hot fluid for thickened oil thermal recovery
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of heavy oil development, and in particular to a method for predicting the composition and yield of a supercritical multi-component thermal fluid for thermal recovery of heavy oil. The method comprises the following steps: using a molecular simulation platform to simulate the reaction of a reaction molecule system with different organic matter concentrations, obtaining a simulation result close to the result of a physical experiment at an economic cost and time cost lower than that of a physical experiment, obtaining the composition and yield data of the supercritical multi-component thermal fluid under different reaction conditions, and establishing a relationship model between the composition and yield and a plurality of reaction condition factors through a machine learning modeling method, so as to facilitate the study of the influence of each reaction condition factor on the composition and yield of the supercritical multi-component thermal fluid, and at the same time achieving the purpose of predicting the composition and yield of the supercritical multi-component thermal fluid according to the level of the reaction condition factor. In addition, the method of combining molecular simulation with machine learning has strong plasticity, and more factors can be added according to the research progress and needs, thereby further improving the accuracy and applicability of the prediction model.

title: Fault detection method based on large model
description: The invention relates to a fault detection method based on a big model, and belongs to the field of big data. The method of the invention adopts an improved model for fault detection, the improved model comprises an encoder-dyLLM, a sound embedding module and a word embedding module, wherein the improved model comprises the following processes of dividing text and sound data into n sections according to a time stamp, in the kth reasoning, a text vector is generated by the kth text data section through the word embedding module, a sound vector is generated by the kth sound data through the sound embedding module, the jth encoder-dyLLM reasoning outputs a cache vector memj, the text vector, the sound vector and the cache vector are subjected to concat, the text vector, the sound vector and the cache vector are sent to the encoder-dyLLM reasoning to complete the kth improved model reasoning, and the classification result output by the encoder-dyllama comprises normal IO faults and system faults. According to the invention, through modifying the decoder module, introducing global buffer memory, introducing sound and ECC data, various data fusion is realized, and the robustness of the model to fault detection is improved.

title: A self-supervised trajectory classification method and system based on multi-level feature extraction
description: The invention relates to the technical field of track classification, in particular to a self-supervision track classification method and system based on multi-level feature extraction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a road network and a track based on GPS, carrying out track matching on the road network and the track based on GPS, generating a track constrained by the road network, carrying out track enhancement on the track constrained by the road network, constructing a track classification model, embedding a graph annotation network and a graph convolution network into the track classification model, obtaining a position sequence by a view of track enhancement, embedding a long-time memory network into the track classification model, obtaining a time sequence by a time sequence of the view, carrying out pre-training on the track classification model by utilizing the position sequence embedding and the time sequence embedding, optimizing the pre-trained model and carrying out track classification. Solves the problems of the traditional track classification method in terms of accuracy and efficiency.

title: Multi-mode remote sensing image feature fusion method based on frequency strategy
description: The present invention discloses a multi-modal remote sensing image feature fusion method based on frequency strategy, which includes the following steps: data preprocessing: using bilinear interpolation upsampling for low-resolution SAR images; network construction: building corresponding encoders according to different modalities; low-frequency feature sharing   And high frequency features   Perform image reconstruction to obtain a reconstructed image, and perform unsupervised training based on the reconstructed image, step S4, generate a fusion image of high-resolution RGB image, SAR remote sensing image, and near-infrared remote sensing image. The method of the present invention uses high-resolution image data from different satellites, and extracts features of SAR, RGB and near-infrared images through a private encoder. Utilize the characteristics of each image to extract feature information of different frequencies. Perform element-by-element addition operation on multi-modal high-frequency features to fully retain the local detail information of each image, which is conducive to improving the quality of the fused image.

title: LSTM network simulation football robot evaluation method based on genetic algorithm optimization
description: The invention provides a simulated football robot evaluation method based on an LSTM (least squares) network optimized by a genetic algorithm, which comprises the following steps of establishing a football robot team program based on a simulated football platform, constructing a basic device evaluation module, acquiring original training data of the football robot team, constructing a training set and a testing set after preprocessing, constructing an evaluation network model of the football robot team program based on a long-short memory network algorithm frame, constructing a genetic algorithm optimization model, defining a fitness function for guiding genetic operation, performing continuous iterative optimization on the evaluation network model by utilizing the genetic algorithm, and acquiring an optimized evaluator module to help the football robot to select optimal action parameters in real time. The invention combines the genetic algorithm with the long-time and short-time memory network, so that the evaluator can more accurately reflect the decision requirement of the football robot in the complex dynamic environment, the accuracy of the overall decision is improved, and the common adaptability deficiency problem in the traditional evaluation method is avoided.

title: Platform limit detection method
description: The invention discloses a station boundary detection method which comprises the steps of S1, data acquisition, S2, time synchronization and space synchronization of station data, S3, point cloud fusion, S4, point cloud denoising, S5, station rough matching based on matrix transformation, S6, station fine matching based on an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, S7, station boundary detection, S8, real-time display and result uploading. The method can realize the matching of the platform and the design contour, acquire the change of the platform and finish the extraction of the height and the side limit value of the platform limit detection platform. According to the method, the platform point cloud data are collected through the integration and synchronization of multiple sensors, the data processing analysis is fully automatically carried out through a high-precision intelligent platform detection algorithm based on a low-cost scanner, the platform limit detection is rapidly completed, and the requirement of measurement precision can be met.

title: Meteorological-wind power combined prediction method based on Swin-converter framework
description: This invention provides a joint meteorological-wind power prediction method based on the Swin-Transformer framework, relating to the field of short-term wind power prediction. The method includes the following steps: acquiring historical wind power time-series data and future meteorological grid forecast data; performing spatiotemporal location encoding convolution on the acquired historical wind power time-series data and future meteorological grid forecast data to output initial features of the meteorological forecast array and historical power, respectively; merging and filling these two sets of initial features in the last dimension to form a new feature data; inputting the new feature data into a meteorological-new energy prediction model to output fused features; and convolving the fused features again with an MLP layer to obtain the final prediction result. This invention solves the problem of inconsistent modalities between meteorological grid data and wind power time-series data, making effective fusion and understanding by machine learning models difficult; it also solves the problem of high redundancy in meteorological grid data, making it difficult for traditional machine learning models to effectively utilize and improve prediction accuracy.

title: Cross-border e-commerce logistics big data optimization system
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of cargo loading optimization, and in particular to a cross-border e-commerce logistics big data optimization system, which comprises a data acquisition unit, a data storage unit, a loading algorithm unit and a real-time guidance unit. The present invention obtains cargo size, weight and shape data through the data acquisition unit, the storage unit stores cargo and transport tool data, the loading algorithm unit divides three-dimensional grid units according to transport tool space data, classifies cargo by weight using a clustering analysis algorithm, determines the best position of a single cargo through shape matching and a heuristic search algorithm, groups and arranges cargo using a path planning algorithm in combination with information such as a delivery sequence, and the real-time guidance unit receives new data during loading, re-runs the algorithm and generates guidance information. The system effectively solves the problem of loading space utilization and improves space utilization.

title: Character expression driving method and device, storage medium and computer equipment
description: The character expression driving method, device, storage medium and computer equipment provided by the present application, when performing expression driving, first determine the continuous video frame images and expression driving targets in the character video to realize expression driving on the video frame images to ensure the naturalness of the expression driving effect; then perform face alignment based on the face key points in the video frame images to obtain a standard face image, and then perform expression driving on the standard face image based on the expression driving target through the target expression driving model to generate an expression driving video, thereby improving the quality of the expression driving effect. Since the target expression driving model is composed of a three-dimensional convolutional neural network, which is used to map a two-dimensional image into a three-dimensional latent space for feature encoding and expression driving, the model can accurately track the faces at various angles in the video frame images and perform expression editing and driving, so as to achieve the natural connection of the expression between frames of the video frame images without affecting the quality of the character video.

title: Apparatus and method for providing context aware service
description:
A device and method for providing context aware service (Apparutus and method for providing context-aware service).
     
     
      The context aware service providing apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a CAS management module for registering, managing, and removing a context defined by a context-aware service object (CAS) module; A sensor management module for registering, managing, and removing information on a sensor that observes context information for checking a context, and requesting a sensor to observe context information; And a context management module that manages the observed context information and informs the CAS management module of the CAS that defines the context when the context information satisfies the context provided by the CAS management module. At this time, when the CAS management module receives the CAS notification from the context management module, the CAS management module requests the corresponding CAS object to provide the service.
     
       
     
      Context-Aware Service, Context, Knowledge,

title: System for Predicting Nano-catalyst Reaction Result using a Artificial Neural Network and Method using the same
description:
The present invention relates to a nanocatalyst reaction result prediction system and prediction method using an artificial neural network. The nanocatalyst reaction result prediction system using the artificial neural network of the present invention includes an input unit for inputting an input condition, an artificial neural network for predicting a reaction result with respect to the input condition input by the input unit, and a result predicted by the artificial neural network. It includes an output unit indicating. The method for predicting nanocatalyst reaction result using the artificial neural network of the present invention comprises the steps of constructing an artificial neural network which correlates the information collection step for obtaining empirical information on the input condition, and the contribution of the response result to the input condition and the input condition; Training the neural network by the back-propagation method; and predicting the response result by the trained neural network. According to the present invention configured as described above, it is possible to accurately predict the reaction result of the nanocatalyst by the artificial neural network trained by the back-propagation method, and there is an advantage of optimizing the reaction conditions through the reaction result predicted by the artificial neural network. .
     
       
     
      Artificial Neural Networks, Nanocatalysts, Backpropagation

title: Component selection device and component selection method
description: (57) [Summary] To cultivate an electronic pseudo-creature so that a user can intuitively understand the influence of a character on an input. SOLUTION: When growing an electronic pseudo-creature in an electronic device, a digitizing device 3 converts an image input from a user into a numerical value to obtain numerical data. The neural network 4 classifies the numerical data and outputs a classification number. The component reference table 6 stores the component types of the electronic simulated creature, and the component storage device 7 stores component image data according to the component types. The judging device 5 judges whether to change the part of the electronic simulated creature according to the classification number, and if it judges that the part of the electronic simulated creature is to be changed, refers to the part reference table according to the classification number. The component image data is provided from the component storage device to the image display device.

title: A YOLOv7 target recognition method and system based on global coordinated attention
description: The application discloses a YOLOv target identification method and a system based on global coordination attention, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a water-float garbage image and carrying out data marking treatment to obtain a marked water-float garbage image; based on YOLOv model, introducing a global coordination attention module and a multi-detection head module to construct a water-float garbage image identification detection model; inputting the marked water float garbage image into a water float garbage image recognition and detection model to perform image recognition and detection treatment, and obtaining a water float garbage recognition result. The embodiment of the application can improve the feature extraction precision of the water float garbage image recognition detection model and the detection precision of the water float garbage with different sizes. The application can be widely applied to the technical field of image recognition.

title: Image acquisition method and device and 3D Gaussian splatter modeling method
description: The invention provides an image acquisition method, an image acquisition device and a 3D Gaussian splatter modeling method, which comprise the following steps: acquiring point cloud data corresponding to the region of interest; generating grid data corresponding to the region of interest, and determining attribute tags corresponding to each cell in the grid data based on the point cloud data; the attribute tag is used for representing the point cloud occupation condition and the cell space distance of the cell; planning a route according to the attribute tags, and generating a target route corresponding to the region of interest; and acquiring image data corresponding to the region of interest based on the target route, wherein the image data is used for training a scene modeling model. The invention can make the collected image data better meet the training requirement of the scene modeling model, thereby improving the modeling effect of the scene modeling model.

title: Surgical robot tail end force tracking method based on self-adaptive neural network
description: The present application relates to a method for tracking the end force of a surgical robot based on an adaptive neural network, the method comprising: the surgical robot is composed of a mechanical arm and an end effector fixed at its end; the information conversion between the end effector and the mechanical arm is established through the forward and inverse dynamics of the mechanical arm and the Jacobian matrix; a dynamic model of the interaction between the end effector and human tissue is established, and a terminal force controller is designed based on the dynamic model; the final terminal force controller is determined through a radial basis function neural network; the force of the end effector is tracked and controlled based on the joint speed, posture and final terminal force controller on the mechanical arm. This method can improve the robot's control accuracy of surgical force, thereby making the surgery more precise, and the surgical environment is complex and changeable; the terminal force controller can adjust the control parameters in real time to adapt to different surgical scenarios and tissue characteristics, and ensure the force tracking performance of the end effector.

title: An innovative knowledge graph enhanced multi-module question answering system and method
description: The invention provides an innovative knowledge graph enhanced multi-module question-answering system and method, belonging to the technical field of artificial intelligence, comprising the following steps: the system comprises an assumption output module, an entity naming identification module, a knowledge graph retrieval module, a noise filtering module, a tendency probability scoring module and an output module; the hypothesis output module is used for receiving the fuzzy query, adjusting the BERT model by utilizing the question analyzer and the customized language model so as to adapt to a problem scene, converting the fuzzy query into an accurate query and generating a hypothesis answer; the output module selects the accurate query and the assumption answer group with the highest tendency scores and provides corresponding replies, deep understanding of the internal knowledge structure and accurate response to the user query are realized by fusing the knowledge graph retrieval technology, the large language model and other key modules, knowledge related to the user query can be comprehensively covered, and deeper replies are provided.

title: Prediction method and system for etching parameter conditions
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting etching parameter conditions, wherein the method for predicting the etching parameter conditions comprises the following steps of firstly collecting a plurality of existing etching parameter conditions of a plurality of etched products and a plurality of groups of position-optical measurement values corresponding to the plurality of existing etching parameter conditions. Next, supervised learning training is performed based on the plurality of optical measurements in each set of position-optical measurements to construct a predictive model. Inputting the specification data of the position-optical parameters of the product to be etched into the prediction model to obtain a prediction result. Then, one of a plurality of existing etching parameter conditions is selected as a recommended etching condition for the product to be etched according to the prediction result.

title: Image super-resolution reconstruction method and system for generating countermeasure network based on depth residual error
description: The invention discloses an image super-resolution reconstruction method and system based on a depth residual error generation countermeasure network, wherein the method adopts the depth residual error generation countermeasure network with a residual error group network structure based on a multi-layer jump connection strategy and used for strengthening high-frequency details, the depth residual error generation countermeasure network comprises a generator network model used for generating a super-resolution image according to a low-resolution image and a discriminator network model used for judging the similarity between the super-resolution image generated by the generator network model and a real high-resolution image in the training process, and the super-resolution image which is completed in resolution reconstruction is output by inputting the low-resolution image into the depth residual error generation countermeasure network model which is completed in advance.
