According to the method, a residual group network structure is constructed, a deeper residual group design is adopted in the residual group network structure, the gradient propagation problem of a deep network in the training process is effectively solved, and the learning capacity of the network on image high-frequency details is enhanced.

title: A method for restoring three-dimensional structure of microscopic objects based on time-frequency coupled deep network
description: The present invention belongs to the field of three-dimensional reconstruction technology, and specifically relates to a method for restoring the three-dimensional structure of a microscopic object based on a time-frequency coupled deep network. The method first collects a sequence of microscopic object images of different focal lengths, then extracts features of different scales of the image sequence, combines the spatial domain and frequency domain features at the smallest scale, realizes the fusion of local features and global features, and finally, performs a dot multiplication of the obtained deep attention map with the focal position to obtain high-precision three-dimensional structural information of the microscopic object. The method of the present invention can effectively maintain the edge structure information of microscopic objects, and can realize high-precision three-dimensional structural restoration of microscopic objects in complex scenes.

title: Sample data generation method, training method, target object detection method, device, electronic device, storage medium and program product
description: The present disclosure provides a sample data generating method, a training method, a target object detecting method, a device, an electronic apparatus, a storage medium, and a program product, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the fields of automatic driving, intelligent traffic, computer vision, deep learning, and large language models. The sample data generation method comprises the following steps: acquiring road fusion detection data, wherein the road fusion detection data is determined according to road detection data of different sources, and the road fusion detection data comprises object information related to a road object; determining an associated object associated with the road object from the candidate road image to be marked based on the object information; and generating sample data for training the target detection model according to the object information and the associated object.

title: Short-term scheduling risk management method and device considering hydroelectric generating set hydraulic characteristics
description: The present invention provides a short-term scheduling risk management method and device considering the hydraulic characteristics of a hydropower unit, including obtaining source-grid operation risk index data of a water-wind-solar multi-energy complementary system, the source-grid operation risk index including a power supply low-load area operation risk index and a power grid power shortage risk index, obtaining a short-term optimization scheduling target of the multi-energy complementary system based on the constraints of the water-wind-solar multi-energy complementary system and the source-grid operation risk index, obtaining the wind-solar uncertainty output, obtaining a power generation plan, solving the short-term optimization scheduling target result of the multi-energy complementary system based on the power generation plan and the wind-solar uncertainty output, obtaining a hydropower unit combination and load distribution according to the target result, and performing risk management based on the hydropower unit combination and load distribution. The present invention can greatly reduce the operation risk of a hydropower unit in a low-load area, can balance the power generation, safe operation risk and peak-shaving performance of the multi-energy complementary system, and obtain an ideal flexible operation range of the hydropower unit.

title: Cancer detection and classification using methylation set analysis
description: The present application describes a method of detecting the presence of DNA from cancer cells in a subject comprising: providing a sample of cell-free DNA from a subject; library preparation of samples to allow subsequent sequencing of cell-free methylated DNA; adding a first amount of filler DNA to the sample, wherein at least a portion of the filler DNA is methylated, and then optionally denaturing the sample; capturing cell-free methylated DNA using a binding agent selective for methylated polynucleotides; sequencing the captured cell-free methylated DNA; comparing the sequence of the captured cell-free methylated DNA to a control cell-free methylated DNA sequence from a healthy and cancer individual and from an individual having a different cancer type and subtype; the presence of DNA from cancer cells is identified if there is statistically significant similarity between the captured cell-free methylated DNA and one or more sequences of cell-free methylated DNA sequences from an individual with cancer.

title: Industrial park energy consumption scheduling optimization method based on depth deterministic strategy
description: The invention discloses an industrial park energy dispatching optimization method based on a depth deterministic strategy, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a comprehensive optimization model based on key characteristics of an industrial park; s2, adding constraint conditions of the comprehensive optimization model according to the objective function, and constraining the comprehensive optimization model; s3, converting the comprehensive optimization model into a multiple function system based on a deep reinforcement learning framework, and constructing a deep reinforcement learning model; s4, taking the production operation parameters of the industrial park as the input of a deep reinforcement learning model, iterating the learning and updating strategies, and solving to obtain an optimal objective function result; s5, optimizing production planning and energy consumption scheduling of the industrial park through an optimal objective function result; the method solves the problems of high energy consumption, low scheduling method applicability, high calculation complexity, failure to comprehensively consider various factors and the like in the traditional method, obviously reduces the energy consumption and scheduling cost of industrial park production planning, and improves the energy utilization scheduling efficiency and energy utilization rate.

title: Method and system for detecting woodcut engraving elements
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for detecting woodcut engraving elements, the method comprising: obtaining an image including a plurality of woodcut engraving elements as a sample image; performing 3D modeling according to the sample image to form a plurality of three-dimensional models; performing illumination preprocessing on the three-dimensional model, and performing image sampling to generate an enhanced sample image; annotating the enhanced sample image to generate a sample set, and training a deep neural network model according to the sample set to form a recognition model; and performing woodcut engraving element detection on the image to be detected by the recognition model. The present invention discloses a method and system for detecting woodcut engraving elements, which can effectively solve the sample deviation problem caused by defects and uneven illumination in existing Tibetan woodcut engravings through the above technical scheme, effectively improve the detection accuracy of the trained model in subsequent use, and at the same time enrich the sample amount that can be used for training, providing sufficient data for the research of Tibetan woodcut engravings.

title: Traffic flow prediction method
description: The invention discloses a traffic flow prediction method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical S continuous traffic attribute data of a preset road network; the preset road network comprises N sensors for data acquisition; inputting the traffic attribute data of the historical S continuous preset time steps into a trained space-time multi-factor fusion graph neural network; the neural network of the map carries out data complement processing on the traffic attribute data of the historical S continuous preset time steps through a data complement layer to obtain complement data; then, extracting the space dependence relationship and the short-term and long-term time dependence relationship between traffic attribute data acquired by different sensors in the complement data through a plurality of space-time multi-factor fusion blocks to correspondingly obtain a plurality of different sub-data; then, fusing a plurality of different sub-data through a fusion layer to obtain fused data; and finally, predicting the traffic attribute data of S time steps through the prediction block. The invention can improve the accuracy of the prediction result.

title: KMeans-LSTM model and comment text feature extraction and false comment identification method
description: The invention discloses a KMeans-LSTM model and a comment text feature extraction and false comment identification method, which belong to the field of evaluation systems, wherein the KMeans-LSTM model comprises the following components: TF-IDF comment text vectorization, data set balancing based on K-means clustering algorithm, gloVe pre-training word embedding and LSTM classifier. The comment text feature extraction and false comment identification method comprises the following steps: s1, data preprocessing, S2, clustering and data balancing, S3, word embedding and model training, S4, model evaluation and application. The invention effectively solves the problem of unbalanced data and improves the learning capacity and the prediction accuracy of the model by utilizing the deep learning technology. The model improves the recognition rate of false comments, has stronger generalization capability, and can be suitable for comment data of different sources and types. By analyzing and applying comment data from different sources, the generalization ability of the model is enhanced. The method not only is suitable for the data set during training, but also can effectively process the data from other sources.

title: Hyperspectral image classification method and device based on state space model
description: The invention provides a hyperspectral image classification method and device based on a state space model, and relates to the technical field of image processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a hyperspectral image to be classified, inputting the hyperspectral image to be classified into a gating module in a trained classification model, and encoding semantic relations between pixels in the hyperspectral image to be classified and a neighborhood through the gating module to obtain an intermediate hyperspectral image, wherein the pixel value of each pixel in the hyperspectral image to be classified comprises spectral information of an object corresponding to the pixel under a plurality of wave bands; inputting the intermediate hyperspectral image into a segmentation sequence scanning module in the classification model, and segmenting spectral information corresponding to each wave band in the intermediate hyperspectral image through the segmentation sequence scanning module to obtain a plurality of segmentation tensors; and inputting the segmented tensor into a state space module in the classification model, and obtaining a classification result output by the state space module. The method can improve the classification accuracy of the hyperspectral image.

title: Polarization and intensity image fusion method based on salient mechanism and multi-layer attention perception
description: The invention discloses a polarization and intensity image fusion method based on a salient mechanism and multi-layer attention perception, which comprises the steps of inputting polarization and intensity images into a dense connection feature extraction encoder to obtain corresponding source image features, inputting a multi-layer progressive attention perception fusion module to perform image fusion operation, and outputting fusion features; feeding the polarized image into a polarized salient object highlighting mechanism, and mining a high-brightness polarized salient object in the polarized image based on intensity saliency and space compactness to obtain a polarized object saliency map; and performing splicing operation on the fusion characteristics and the polarized target salient graphs, inputting the characteristics obtained after splicing into an image reconstruction decoder, reconstructing the characteristics into a fusion image through multi-layer convolution processing, training a fusion network based on a loss function of the depth characteristic graph, and performing real-time polarization and intensity image fusion based on the trained fusion network. The ideal fusion effect of the polarization information and the texture details can be realized, and a high-quality fusion image can be obtained.

title: Urban land planning method, device and electronic equipment based on large language model
description: The invention relates to the technical field of urban planning, and provides a method, a device and electronic equipment for planning urban land based on a large language model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on a given area to be planned, acquiring an initial urban land planning scheme proposed by a planner intelligent agent; acquiring comprehensive feedback comments of a plurality of resident intelligent agents on an initial urban land planning scheme; and updating and optimizing the initial urban land planning scheme based on the planner agent according to the comprehensive feedback opinion to obtain the target urban land planning scheme. According to the method, the large language model plays a planner intelligent body with professional knowledge and a plurality of resident intelligent bodies with different user figures, and urban land planning is realized by utilizing cooperative interaction between the planner intelligent body and the resident intelligent bodies, so that residents can effectively participate in the urban land planning process, the finally obtained urban land planning scheme can better meet the requirements of residents, and the generation efficiency of the urban land planning scheme is effectively improved.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and non-transitory computer readable medium
description: The present disclosure provides an information processing apparatus, an information processing method, and a non-transitory computer readable medium. The privacy of a real person is protected and the quality of life in a geographic area is improved. The information processing device (1) includes a control unit, wherein the control unit performs actions including: collecting action-related information about actions of 1 or more persons in a certain geographical area; extracting character parameters from the action-related information; training a model using the human parameters; generating more than 1 virtual character using the model; measuring actions of more than 1 virtual character in the geographic area; and determining service content in the geographic area based on the determined actions.

title: Short-term power prediction method and device for regional distributed photovoltaic
description: The invention provides a short-term power prediction method and device of regional distributed photovoltaic, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring output characteristics of historical power data of a plurality of power station distributed photovoltaics in a target area, and dividing the target area based on the output characteristics to obtain a plurality of subareas; determining a representative power station of each sub-area based on a weather type and an output characteristic corresponding to the predetermined historical power data of each power station; carrying out power prediction on the representative power station of each sub-region based on a pre-trained distributed photovoltaic short-term power prediction model to obtain a representative power station prediction result; and carrying out upscaling prediction on the representative power station prediction result based on a statistical upscaling prediction method to obtain a region prediction result. The short-term power prediction method of the regional distributed photovoltaic can effectively reduce the influence of the single-station prediction error on the overall prediction precision of the region, and can improve the prediction precision of the regional distributed photovoltaic short-term power.

title: Intelligent optimization method for sleep patch production and processing technology
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent optimization of processes, in particular to an intelligent optimization method of a sleep patch production and processing process, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a sleep patch raw material database, a target product parameter set and quality constraint conditions; establishing a digital twin model of the sleep patch product; determining an optimal ratio through a self-adaptive formula optimization algorithm according to the raw material database, the target product parameter set and the quality constraint condition to obtain a sleep patch raw material formula; adopting a continuous microfluidic mixing system to mix raw materials to form a uniform sleep patch medicine mixture; obtaining a sleeping patch base film with uniform thickness; obtaining a sleeping patch semi-finished product with the water content meeting the requirement; forming a sleep patch with uniform specification; the quality stability of the sleeping patch is ensured; the production efficiency of the sleeping patch is improved; the sleep patch production process is continuously improved, and the variation coefficient of the content of the active ingredients of the product is reduced to 2.1 percent by the intelligent control of the whole process, which is far superior to the prior art.

title: Target detection method, device, equipment and medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle
description: The present application discloses a target detection method, device, equipment and medium based on a drone, and relates to the technical field of target detection. The existing YOLO model is improved, and specifically a brain neuron redundancy detection module is used to replace the C3 module in the YOLO model to obtain an improved YOLO model. The improved YOLO model is used to identify detection targets in images obtained by using a drone to shoot a city scene to be detected, and a target detection result is obtained. The target detection result includes the category and position of each detection target in the captured image. By improving the model structure, the problems of high computational complexity and excessive model parameters in the existing target detection algorithm model can be solved, and the detection efficiency can be significantly improved.

title: Light-weight sports automatic identification and test method, device and equipment
description: The invention discloses a method, a device and equipment for automatically identifying and testing light sports, and relates to the technical field of intelligent sports. The method comprises the following steps: the data acquisition labeling process comprises the following steps: acquiring a target motion video and a false motion video, and obtaining a human body relation point time sequence; the model construction process comprises the following steps: constructing an automatic identification test model, wherein the automatic identification test model comprises a key point detection model and an action identification model Lighting-GCN; model training process: inputting a human body relation point time sequence as a training sample to train the automatic identification test model, and re-parameterizing the Lighting-GCN model after training is finished; automatic identification test process: and acquiring a video of the appointed acquisition area by using a camera carrying the automatic identification test model, and enabling a user to directly perform target movement so as to realize autonomous automatic movement measurement. According to the invention, by constructing the automatic identification test model and re-parameterizing in the reasoning process, the accuracy is improved, the speed is ensured, and the method is suitable for an edge deployment scene and realizes automatic sports training.

title: Liquid cooling plate design method and system based on reduced order model
description: The present invention discloses a liquid cooling plate design method and system based on a reduced-order model, which relates to the technical field of battery liquid cooling and heat dissipation, and includes the steps of: obtaining a liquid cooling plate model after retaining the flow channel and simplifying the shell, and performing parameterized design of the liquid cooling plate model based on the battery pack size and heat dissipation requirements; simulating the parameterized liquid cooling plate model through the LHS algorithm to obtain an initial database of design variables and corresponding design targets; extracting singular values and corresponding left and right singular vectors through the ROM model based on the initial database, and training the relationship between the singular values and the corresponding input data through the PINN neural network; establishing a proxy model through the trained ROM‑PINN, and obtaining the best structural parameter combination under optimization through the NSGA II algorithm. The liquid cooling plate design based on the reduced-order model of the present invention greatly reduces the time required for simulation, shortens the design cycle, improves the design efficiency, and reduces the dependence on large amounts of data and long-term simulation.

title: Machine learning-based farmland soil moisture condition assessment and quality classification method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of farmland quality detection, in particular to a machine learning-based farmland soil moisture condition assessment and quality classification method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring multisource historical data of cultivated land, and executing geometric correction, radiometric calibration and atmospheric correction to form a training data set and a testing data set; training the soil moisture content evaluation index model based on the training data set, calculating a loss value between the test data set and the predicted soil moisture content evaluation index, and optimizing the soil moisture content evaluation index model by setting an objective function; calculating a soil moisture content index predicted value of the cultivated land through the trained soil moisture content evaluation index model, carrying out quantitative calculation on the soil moisture content index predicted value of the cultivated land, and carrying out comprehensive evaluation and classification on the comprehensive evaluation value of the soil moisture condition based on a set judgment logic to generate a quality distribution diagram of the cultivated land.

title: Deep learning compiling optimization method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention provides a deep learning compilation optimization method, device, electronic device and storage medium, the method comprising: expressing a deep neural network as a calculation graph through a deep learning framework, converting the calculation graph into an intermediate layer between the deep learning framework and the deep learning compiler; marking the operators that need to be compiled in the intermediate layer, and clustering the marked operators into multiple subgraphs; the subgraphs include at least one fusion operator, which is obtained by fusion of multiple marked operators; compiling the fusion operator online through a deep learning compiler to generate the kernel code of the fusion operator; online compilation includes converting the innermost loop code into a microkernel call code based on a microkernel library. The present invention can take into account the flexibility of programming and the efficiency of calculation, improve development efficiency, and improve the problem of large code generation search space, reducing compilation time overhead.

title: Remote sensing image and video sequence image fusion method based on InSAR technology and geographic information data
description: The invention discloses a remote sensing image and video sequence image fusion method based on InSAR technology and geographic information data, the invention integrates the collection, pretreatment, sparsification treatment, inSAR deformation monitoring and data fusion technologies of various remote sensing images and video sequences. First, various data sources including panchromatic bands, polarized SAR, visible light images and video sequences are collected, and SAR image sequences are acquired for InSAR analysis. And secondly, performing preprocessing such as radiation, geometric correction, noise removal and the like on all images. And then optimizing the full-color band image through sparse basis dictionary training, and performing IHS (direct-View) transformation on the polarized SAR and the visible light image to extract components. And then, carrying out block thinning processing on the preprocessed image, and monitoring the surface deformation by utilizing an InSAR technology. In the data fusion stage, the compressed measured values are fused to reconstruct an image, and the inverse IHS conversion is performed by combining the hue and saturation components of the multispectral image to form a fused image.

title: Training method and processing method of voice processing model based on large model
description: The present invention belongs to the field of computer technology, and specifically provides a training method and a processing method for a speech processing model based on a large model. The training method of the present invention includes: obtaining speech audio samples and text instruction samples; obtaining text labels; extracting features from the speech audio samples based on a speech feature extraction model; based on a mapping layer, mapping the features in the vocabulary of a large model to obtain speech token samples; outputting processing results based on the large model according to the speech token samples and the text instruction samples; using the text label as the true value, calculating the loss of the output speech processing result through a preset loss function; performing back propagation based on the loss to update the parameters of the speech processing model to complete the current round of iterative training. Using a trained speech processing model, speech data can be efficiently processed without changing the vocabulary of the large model.

title: Simulation decision method combining dynamic knowledge graph
description: The present invention discloses a simulation decision-making method combined with a dynamic knowledge graph, comprising the following steps: Knowledge graph construction and dynamic update: construct a knowledge graph covering adversarial entities and rules, and update it in real time through an integrated information collection module to reflect the latest adversarial scenario conditions and adversarial rules. Adversarial decision support based on knowledge graph: automatically generate adversarial plans through knowledge graphs, conduct simulations and plan evaluations, and dynamically adjust adversarial plans and rules according to real-time intelligence and changes in adversarial situations during the adversarial execution phase. Learning and optimization mechanism: introduce machine learning mechanisms to adapt to complex and changeable adversarial environments and improve decision-making quality. This application uses knowledge graph technology to improve the flexibility, efficiency and adaptability of adversarial simulation and adversarial planning to complex adversarial environments.

title: Electrocardiosignal image enhancement characterization learning method for emotion recognition of wearable Internet of things equipment
description: The invention discloses an electrocardiosignal image enhancement characterization learning method for emotion recognition of wearable Internet of things equipment, which is used for carrying out signal transformation on an original single-lead electrocardiosignal to obtain a corresponding transformation signal; the original signal is regarded as a central node, the transformation signal is regarded as other nodes, a self-signal transformation weighted graph is constructed, and the self-signal transformation weighted graph is divided into a plurality of subgraphs; capturing the relation between the transformed signal and the original signal by adopting a local subgraph learning method, and extracting the characteristics of each subgraph; combining other nodes and a central node to obtain a signal enhancement graph; and (3) performing feature aggregation by adopting a stacked graph convolution network to obtain enhanced representation of an electrocardiogram signal, and inputting the enhanced representation into an emotion classification model to obtain emotion recognition of the electrocardiogram. The invention uses signal transformation to enhance the difference between different label signals innovatively, introduces a graph learning method to perform characterization enhancement, does not need to use complicated data preprocessing technology such as filtering and the like, and can more effectively extract characterization from the original signal for emotion recognition.

title: Afforestation construction information acquisition monitored control system
description: The application discloses an landscaping construction information acquisition monitoring system, and belongs to the technical field of landscaping construction information acquisition. Including gathering gardens construction state data, gather data that air humidity and dust degree are correlated with, carry out data cleaning, normalization processing etc. to gardens construction state data, utilize gardens construction state data to establish gardens construction state model and train through gardens construction state data, evaluate the gardens construction state model that has trained, verify its performance in the aspect of predicting dust fall head size and direction adjustment, including the accuracy, the index such as generalization ability, through setting up of gardens construction state model, in the in-process of gathering through the terminal, can predict dust that produces in the gardens construction process and dust under different humidity, thereby slightly handle through the dust fall head is different, the energy consumption of minimizing the shower nozzle adjustment, and the improvement treatment effect is the most.

title: Automatic recognition method for surface standard components of airborne finished products based on graphic neural network
description: The invention belongs to the field of machine vision, in particular to an automatic recognition method for an on-board finished product surface standard component based on a graphic neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a surface image of an airborne finished product to be detected, and constructing an airborne finished product surface image data set; labeling the image to be detected; obtaining a scaled standard component image; the standard component image input features extract a neural network to obtain corresponding feature vectors; carrying out normalization treatment; dissimilarity between standard components in the image to be measured; constructing a standard component relation diagram in an image to be detected; outputting a relation diagram containing local information; selecting the category with the highest probability as the prediction category of the standard component; constructing a loss function, and training the neural network by using a training set; the neural network with the best performance on the validation set is selected as the final model and tested on the test set. The invention can obviously improve the identification accuracy of the standard component and reduce the risk of false omission.

title: Boundary-aware angiography image segmentation method and system
description: The invention provides a boundary-aware angiography image segmentation method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: capturing blood vessel and boundary information from a global perspective; capturing vessel and boundary information from both global and local perspectives; vessel and boundary information is captured from a local perspective. The invention solves the technical problems of obviously reduced performance of the supervision model, fuzzy boundary and lower boundary segmentation accuracy caused by dependence on pixel-level manual labeling operation, single applicable vessel type and appearance difference.

title: Phase unwrapping method, device, equipment and medium based on deep learning
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a phase unwrapping method, a phase unwrapping device, equipment and a medium based on deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a parcel phase diagram; the wrapping phase map is input into a pre-trained deep learning network model for phase unwrapping, so that the deep learning network model outputs an absolute phase map corresponding to the wrapping phase map according to a nonlinear mapping relation between wrapping phases and absolute phases, the deep learning network model adopts a U-Net framework, the deep learning network model comprises an encoder, a decoder, a deep supervision feature fusion module and a cavity space convolution pooling pyramid module, and the encoder and the decoder comprise I ncept ion modules. Based on the above, the embodiment of the invention can predict the absolute phase map with high quality by only one step by using the trained deep learning network model under the conditions of high noise environment and discontinuous phase, thereby completing accurate phase unwrapping.

title: Orthopedic rehabilitation management system based on deep learning
description: The present invention discloses an orthopedic rehabilitation management system based on deep learning, which relates to the field of medical systems; it includes: a data acquisition module, which is used to collect patient data; a data processing module, which uses a deep learning model to analyze the collected data and extract the characteristics of the data; a data evaluation module, which evaluates the extracted data characteristics; a rehabilitation suggestion module, which judges the patient's recovery status according to the results of the data evaluation, and provides subsequent rehabilitation suggestions according to the recovery status. The present invention collects various information of the patient, then analyzes its motion model, thereby judging the recovery status, and then generates rehabilitation suggestions based on the comparison of the actual situation with the database, so that the patient's rehabilitation management can be more targeted.

title: Knowledge graph-based construction method of geographic knowledge question-answering system
description: The present invention relates to the field of geographic knowledge question-answering technology, and specifically discloses a method for constructing a geographic knowledge question-answering system based on a knowledge graph. First, a system development environment based on a browser-server architecture is created; then a system architecture including a data layer, an application service layer, and a user layer is built; then a geographic logic query system is constructed; and finally, the operation results of the geographic logic query system are analyzed. The present invention adopts the above-mentioned method for constructing a geographic knowledge question-answering system based on a knowledge graph, and by analyzing the system requirements, the system is divided into three parts: a data layer, an application service layer, and a user layer; HTML, CSS, and JavaScript are used to implement rich front-end interactive functions; Python language and Neo4j graph database are used to implement back-end algorithm modules and database storage modules; functions such as algorithm selection, query parsing, knowledge graph matching, logical query, and result display are supported, and a complete process from user query input to reasoning result display is implemented.

title: Electric power transaction contract auditing method, system, equipment and medium based on rule base enhancement and deep learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of contract auditing, in particular to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for auditing a power transaction contract based on rule base enhancement and deep learning; firstly, invoking BiLSTM a network to extract a preprocessed electric power transaction contract text to obtain an electric power transaction contract naming entity; secondly, establishing a power transaction contract tree structure according to the power transaction contract naming entity; then, calling a graph convolutional neural network, and classifying tree nodes of the power transaction contract tree structure to obtain abnormal points of the power transaction contract; and finally, generating an electric power transaction contract auditing result according to the established electric power transaction contract static rule base and contract abnormal points, and conducting electric power transaction contract auditing in a rule pre-auditing and abnormal point predicting mode, so that deep analysis and accurate auditing of the contract clauses are realized, the interpretability of the rule base is fused with the learning capability of an automation technology, and the efficiency, accuracy, interpretability and expandability of contract auditing are improved.

title: Power equipment image abstract generation method and device
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image analysis, and particularly provides a method and a device for generating an image abstract of power equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sequentially passing the power equipment image through a Darknet model and a capsule network, and extracting key structural features corresponding to the power equipment image; and taking the key structural features as input of a pre-trained transducer model to obtain abstract information corresponding to the power equipment image output by the pre-trained transducer model. According to the technical scheme provided by the invention, through fine joint optimization, the internal rule of the power failure is deeply revealed, and the generation quality and the diagnosis efficiency of the abstract are greatly enhanced.

title: Agricultural machinery operation area planning method and system
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for planning an agricultural machine operation area, which relate to the technical field of agricultural machine operation planning and comprise the steps of measuring the boundary of the agricultural machine operation area and the boundary of an obstacle, and generating a head area and an actual operation area; defining an agricultural machine operation direction, generating a parallel operation track according to the operation direction, and decomposing an actual operation area into subareas according to the parallel operation track; calculating an optimal sub-region operation connection sequence of each operation direction, constructing an evaluation matrix to analyze the suitability of each operation direction, and taking the operation direction with the highest suitability as the final agricultural machinery operation direction; and generating an agricultural operation scheme according to the final agricultural operation direction and implementing the agricultural operation scheme. The invention effectively improves the adaptability and the flexibility of the agricultural machinery to the operation area and greatly improves the operation efficiency of the agricultural machinery.

title: A programming language compilation method and device based on end-edge collaboration
description: The invention discloses a programming language compiling method and device based on end-edge cooperation, which relates to the technical field of program compiling, and the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring equipment information of terminal equipment and state information of an edge server; s2, extracting a code segment to be compiled contained in the equipment information in real time, and creating a compiling task attribute set based on the code attribute of the code segment to be compiled; s3, setting an optimization target of a code segment to be compiled, and matching an unloading strategy set by constructing a game model; s4, based on the compiling position, invoking a compiler to compile the code segment to be compiled; s5, responding to dynamic update of the compiled information. According to the method, the computing capacity, the load condition and the attribute of the code segments to be compiled of the terminal equipment and the edge server are comprehensively considered, the unloading strategy of the code segments to be compiled is optimized by utilizing the game theory decision algorithm, intelligent distribution of the code segments to be compiled is realized, the compiling efficiency is improved, and the load and the power consumption of the system are balanced.

title: Method and device for identifying fraudulent behavior
description: The invention discloses a fraudulent identification method and device, relates to the technical field of data security, and mainly aims to solve the problems that the existing fraudulent identification is poor in accuracy and a large amount of rights and resources are wasted. Comprising the following steps: acquiring rights acquisition information and user information of a target resource, wherein the rights acquisition information is used for representing contents for acquiring the rights information of the target resource from different service channels; performing behavior feature division on the rights acquisition information to obtain at least one behavior feature, and performing behavior classification on the behavior feature and the user information based on a decision tree classification model to obtain a behavior classification result; and when the behavior classification result is matched with at least one fraud in a preset fraud strategy, determining a target fraudulent user and a target fraud.

title: A risk assessment method for planning and scheduling systems in digital workshops
description: The present invention discloses a risk assessment method for a planning and scheduling system of a digital workshop, and belongs to the field of flexible manufacturing technology. The present invention obtains workshop scheduling information of an enterprise production department according to the digital workshop, including the name of the processed product, the number of products put into production, the number of production equipment, the number of products that can be produced by each equipment at the same time, and the production plan output; the obtained workshop production scheduling data is optimized by the genetic algorithm model constructed by the present invention to output the optimized workshop scheduling plan. Finally, the utilization rate, idle rate, processing completion time and completion degree of the operation plan of the machine are used as evaluation factors, and the evaluation index is calculated according to the evaluation factors to obtain the evaluation result. The evaluation value obtained from the risk assessment result is notified to the enterprise production department or ERP system, and an optimized workshop scheduling plan and suggestions are given. The risk assessment of the planning and scheduling system of the digital workshop is completed.

title: A container storage location selection method based on storage behavior characteristics
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of container stacking, and particularly relates to a container storage and position selection method based on stacking behavior characteristics, which comprises the following steps: step S100: establishing PSCW ++ stocking rules; step S200: building a stacking time predictor model; step S300: calculating to obtain the predicted stacking time of the containers to be stacked; step S400: determining a storage box area of a container to be stacked; step S500: determining a stacking shellfish position of a container to be stacked in a stacking box area; step S600: determining the container position of the container to be stacked in the stacking shellfish position; the container storage and position selection method based on the stacking behavior characteristics provided by the invention aims at solving the problem that the conventional container storage and position selection technology does not utilize port operation historical data, predicts the stacking time of the container through a neural network, combines with a rule-based storage and position selection method, uses the predicted stacking time for box area selection and box position selection, and can effectively improve the operation efficiency and reduce the container turnover rate.

title: A distribution transformer fault detection method and system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a distribution transformer fault detection method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining data sequences of all position areas on the distribution transformer in real time, determining noise expression degrees of all data points in all the data sequences, correcting the noise expression degrees of the data points according to correlation between the data sequences and sequences of preset local ranges of corresponding data points in other data sequences in the neighborhood of the data sequences, determining noise influence degrees of all the data sequences, determining the number of adaptive segmentation trees when the corresponding position areas are detected by using an RRCF model according to the noise influence degrees of all the data sequences, and detecting through the RRCF model so as to detect faults of the distribution transformer. By analyzing the noise influence degree of each data sequence and self-adapting to the number of the segmentation trees in the RRCF model, the distribution transformer fault detection calculation resources are saved, and the calculation efficiency and the detection accuracy are improved.

title: A landmark point detection and small parts segmentation method for large-scale medical point cloud models
description: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a mark point detection and small part segmentation method of a large-scale medical point cloud model, which belongs to the technical field of data processing, and specifically comprises the steps of downsampling sample points of a target point cloud model to a preset number, selecting a plurality of adjacent points around the mark point, adding semantic labels consistent with the mark points to serve as segmentation masks, pre-training a regression model corresponding to an initial point cloud saliency map, pre-predicting the point cloud saliency map on point clouds of unmarked mark points through the trained regression model, initializing the mark points through the pre-predicting point cloud saliency map, determining the final position of each mark point, separating a region to be segmented from the target point cloud model, and completing part segmentation of point clouds in a bounding box through a point cloud part segmentation network. Through the scheme of the disclosure, the mark points with semantic tags can be directly detected on the large-scale point cloud, and the segmentation accuracy and adaptability of small components in the large-scale point cloud are greatly improved.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle electromagnetic domain countermeasure training method and device based on game theory
description: A method and device for electromagnetic domain confrontation training of unmanned aerial vehicles based on game theory, the method connects the physical or digital model of unmanned aerial vehicles and the physical or digital model of anti-unmanned aerial vehicle equipment to a virtual electromagnetic environment platform and selects the physical or digital model type and training scene; sets the physical or digital model of unmanned aerial vehicles as the first player and defines its pure strategy space; sets the physical or digital model of anti-unmanned aerial vehicle equipment as the second player and defines its pure strategy space; in the selected training scene, based on the order of first unmanned aerial vehicle and then anti-unmanned aerial vehicle equipment, the pure strategy is selected in sequence, and the referee or computer selects the pure strategy space and assigns the utility function; the training is carried out in sequence; after stopping the training, the referee or computer outputs the optimal strategy and provides confrontation training suggestions. The present invention can realize the interactive linkage between the virtual body and the physical entity in the electromagnetic domain, greatly reducing the training and confrontation costs of personnel.

title: Intelligent ceramic tile conveying and warehousing system
description: The present invention provides an intelligent conveying and warehousing system for tiles, which relates to the technical field of material conveying application. The present invention uses a marking module to number the conveying stages to achieve accurate tracking and improve the system operation efficiency; a data acquisition module monitors the tile status and energy consumption in real time, optimizes resource allocation and reduces costs; a weight prediction module uses machine learning to predict the weight of tiles, improves automation and prediction accuracy; a threshold comparison module verifies weight prediction and ensures product quality; a first association module analyzes the relationship between physical indicators and energy consumption to provide a basis for energy consumption management; an energy consumption construction module sets an expected energy consumption value to optimize energy use; and an optimal energy consumption selection module adjusts the set value so as not to exceed the expected energy consumption to achieve energy saving and cost optimization.

title: Cloud elevator maintenance management method, device and system
description: The invention relates to the field of elevator maintenance, and particularly discloses a cloud elevator maintenance management method, device and system, wherein real-time elevator operation data are obtained and stored in a database; the method comprises the steps of detecting the real-time running state of an elevator according to real-time elevator running data, sending out real-time elevator running abnormality alarming if the elevator runs abnormally, generating a real-time maintenance task, transmitting the real-time maintenance task to maintenance personnel, inputting elevator running period data into a pre-trained fault early-warning model to obtain a fault early-warning result, sending out elevator running early-warning alarming if the fault early-warning exists, generating an early-warning maintenance task, and transmitting the early-warning maintenance task to the maintenance personnel, and displaying the running state of each elevator on a man-machine interaction interface according to the elevator running real-time data, the maintenance task and the maintenance task. The invention realizes the intellectualization and automation of the elevator maintenance management, realizes the cloud centralized management, improves the elevator maintenance efficiency and ensures the safe operation of the elevator.

title: JavaScript module packaging method, system, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology, and in particular to a JavaScript module packaging method, system, device and medium based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method specifically comprises: according to a configuration file, a module dependency graph is established by analyzing the dependency relationship between multiple JavaScript modules of a development project, and the packaging order of multiple JavaScript modules is determined according to the module dependency graph; based on the module dependency graph, each JavaScript module is divided into module granularity by a dynamic programming optimization algorithm to determine the code splitting scheme of each JavaScript module; according to the historical access data and current load situation of each JavaScript module, a resource demand prediction algorithm is used to determine the resource demand of each JavaScript module; according to the packaging order, the code splitting scheme and the resource demand, multiple JavaScript modules are packaged to generate a JavaScript code package. The present invention realizes the intelligent management and optimization of JavaScript modules, provides strong support for the development of large and complex projects, and significantly improves the development efficiency and product performance.

title: Method and device for determining conversion rate of commercial tenant advertiser
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining conversion rate of commercial tenant advertisers, and relates to the technical field of big data intelligent processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining dimension data of a target merchant, wherein the dimension data comprise business registration information, camping category information, same-cycle ratio information and advertiser mining rates of target mining personnel corresponding to the target merchant, the advertiser mining rates of the target mining personnel are calculated by adopting Bayesian smoothing, the dimension data of the target merchant are processed into dimension features, the dimension features of the target merchant are input into an advertiser conversion rate model, and therefore the advertiser conversion rate of the target merchant is output, and the advertiser conversion rate model is obtained by training a neural network model. The technical problem that the advertiser has low diving accuracy can be solved by the implementation mode.

title: Bionic multi-brain module expert thinking link intelligent system
description: The invention discloses a bionic multi-brain module expert thinking link intelligent agent system which comprises N dialogue AI modules, N supervision AI modules, N path decision AI modules, a history dialogue record module, a long memory AI module and a working memory AI module, wherein the dialogue AI modules are used for directly carrying out dialogue with a user, generating corresponding answers according to user input information, the history dialogue record modules are used for respectively and independently storing the history dialogue records of all the dialogue AI modules, the long memory AI modules are used for storing the accumulated dialogue records of all the dialogue AI modules, the working memory AI modules are used for storing key dialogue information and context information of the current dialogue AI module and outputting reasoning conclusion, the supervision AI modules are used for providing supervision comments for the dialogue AI modules according to real-time dialogue contents of the dialogue AI modules, and the path decision AI modules are used for deciding which dialogue AI module is used for continuously communicating with the user according to the history dialogue records of the dialogue AI modules. The invention can improve the processing capacity of the system, the consistency of the dialogue, the deep reasoning capacity and the user experience.

title: A power grid operation and maintenance method based on telemetry real-time perception technology
description: The invention discloses a power grid operation and maintenance method based on telemetry real-time perception technology, which relates to the technical field of power grid operation and maintenance and comprises the steps of acquiring network nodes for data transmission in a power grid; evaluating the requirement of the network node on the real-time property of the data, and configuring telemetry subscription relations according to the evaluation result; the network node transmits real-time data through telemetry; the invention combines telemetry real-time sensing technology into power grid operation and maintenance to realize rapid and accurate data transmission, and evaluates the real-time requirement of the network node for data transmission in the power grid when applied to the power grid operation and maintenance, and carries out telemetry dynamic subscription or static subscription configuration according to the evaluation, thereby being applicable to different network nodes, being capable of monitoring network state more comprehensively and efficiently, and helping an administrator to discover and solve network problems in time.

title: Shale micro-pore structure characterization method considering complex pore morphology and application
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of unconventional oil and gas exploration, and specifically relates to a shale microscopic pore structure characterization method and application considering complex pore morphology, the characterization method comprising the following steps: S1. Acquire the pore structure characteristics of the real reservoir core, the pore structure characteristics including the maximum pore width λ  max  , m, the minimum pore width λ  min  , m, the total porosity φ, dimensionless, the total pore frequency m, and the pore shape distribution parameter; S2. Based on the characteristic parameters of the real reservoir core acquired in step S1, construct a porous medium model under complex pore morphology to characterize the shale microscopic pore structure. The porous medium model constructed by the present invention can not only be used for quantitative prediction of the occurrence and flow characteristics of fluids in the pore structure, but also can guide the study of fluid migration laws in the exploration and development of shale gas reservoirs, and provide strong support for optimizing mining plans and improving recovery rates.

title: Model operation method, device, equipment, medium and product
description: The application provides a model running method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product, wherein the method is implemented by determining the residual storage resources of hardware equipment; the method comprises the steps of comparing residual storage resources of hardware equipment with storage resources required by a quantization model, determining the type of a target model which can be operated by the hardware equipment, wherein the type of the target model is a first quantization model or a second quantization model, the first quantization model and a first quantization coefficient corresponding to the first quantization model are stored in a memory, a first quantization parameter is used for dequantizing the first quantization model to obtain the second quantization model, the bit width of a model parameter corresponding to the second quantization model is larger than that of a model parameter corresponding to the first quantization model, acquiring the corresponding target model according to the type of the target model, and operating the target model by the hardware equipment to execute a target task. The application can realize the effects of small occupied memory and high reasoning accuracy.

title: Model training method suitable for federal learning environment of Internet of vehicles
description: The present invention discloses a model training method suitable for a federated learning environment of an Internet of Vehicles, which belongs to the field of edge computing technology of the Internet of Vehicles, including S1, a central node obtains a corresponding global model of federated learning, and loads a deep reinforcement learning decision module; S2, initializes the global model of federated learning, and distributes the model to edge nodes in the region; S3, after each edge node participating in the federated learning calculation has trained the model, it sends the model to the central node; S4, determines the aggregated model; S5, repeats steps S3 and S4 until the central node uploads the trained model to the cloud; S6, the cloud trains and optimizes the deep reinforcement learning decision module. The present invention adopts the above-mentioned model training method suitable for a federated learning environment of the Internet of Vehicles, realizes the effective screening of client models participating in aggregation, and improves the availability and robustness of the federated learning of the Internet of Vehicles while reducing the total aggregation time.

title: CT image virtual thin layer reconstruction method and medium
description: The present application discloses a method and medium for virtual thin-layer reconstruction of CT images, belonging to the field of information technology, including: obtaining the resolution of an input CT image as a first resolution, and dividing the input CT image into multiple image blocks; using a generator in a generative adversarial network GAN to reconstruct the image block of the first resolution to generate an image block of a second resolution, the generator including: multiple cascaded convolutional layers and at least one pixel de-shuffle layer; using a discriminator to discriminate the authenticity of the second resolution image block reconstructed by the generator to obtain an authenticity probability value, the discriminator adopts a U-Net structure; according to the authenticity probability value output by the discriminator, the loss function includes a weighted sum of adversarial loss, perceptual loss and pixel loss; using a gradient descent algorithm to optimize the parameters of the generator, and adjusting the weights of each layer in the generator through a back-propagation algorithm. In view of the low image resolution in CT image reconstruction in the prior art, the present application improves the resolution.

title: AI scheduling distribution method and device based on fresh food orders
description: The invention discloses an AI scheduling distribution method and device based on fresh food orders, which belong to the technical field of semantic processing, and the method and device provided by the invention are used for screening recommended refrigeration equipment by calculating the characteristic coincidence degree of a current food characteristic set and a food characteristic set corresponding to historical fresh food orders to obtain a first recommended refrigeration equipment set and a first coincidence degree vector; the method comprises the steps of extracting user demand information on fresh food orders, calculating the demand coincidence ratio of user demands and residual refrigeration equipment in a bin to obtain a second recommended refrigeration equipment set and a second coincidence vector, extracting semantics from the current food characteristic set, the first recommended refrigeration equipment set and the second recommended refrigeration equipment set by adopting an AI scheduling distribution model, and obtaining distributed refrigeration equipment based on weights applied by the first coincidence vector and the second coincidence vector.

title: Power supply conversion control method and system for chip
description: The invention provides a power conversion control method and a system for a chip, which relate to the technical field of power management and comprise the steps of constructing a power conversion optimization model, randomly generating a model training sample for pre-training, generating network parameters, and migrating to an actual control environment to obtain a trained power conversion optimization model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining working state parameters of a chip to be tested and external power supply voltage, performing forward reasoning to generate an optimal conversion control strategy, adjusting the working voltage of the chip to be tested, judging whether significant change occurs, if so, regenerating the optimal conversion control strategy, otherwise, packaging to generate an operation log, performing characteristic engineering, determining association rules, generating an optimal control rule set, training a base learner, combining to obtain an integrated optimization model, fusing with the power supply conversion optimization model, obtaining a candidate conversion model, performing optimization effect evaluation, feeding back parameters of the candidate conversion model with the highest optimization effect as optimal parameters, and performing power supply conversion.

title: Image generation method and device, literature graph network architecture and electronic equipment
description: The application discloses an image generation method and device, a literature graph network architecture and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The text-to-image network architecture comprises a text image feature extraction module, a text encoding module, an image encoding module, a noise prediction module and an image decoding module, wherein the text image feature extraction module is used for generating text image feature vectors based on text-to-image requirement information, the text encoding module is used for converting the text-to-image requirement information into text description feature vectors, the image encoding module is used for generating image feature matrixes based on the text-to-image requirement information, the noise prediction module is used for obtaining predicted image feature matrixes based on the text image feature vectors, the text description feature vectors and the image feature matrixes, and the image decoding module is used for generating images matched with the text-to-image requirement information based on the predicted image feature matrixes.

title: Back door defense method of image classification model, image classification method and related equipment
description: The embodiment of the present application provides a backdoor defense method for an image classification model, an image classification method and related equipment. The backdoor defense method includes: obtaining a first test data set, an image classification model, a generator, a first label and a plurality of first random noises corresponding to the first label; wherein the image classification model is a discriminator of the generator; inputting the first label and the corresponding plurality of first random noises into the generator, outputting a plurality of first disturbance quantities; determining whether the first label is an attack target label according to the similarity of the plurality of first disturbance quantities; generating a second test data set; inputting the first test data set into the image classification model to determine the first activation state of a plurality of neurons of the image classification model; inputting the second test data set into the image classification model to determine the second activation state of a plurality of neurons of the image classification model; determining the backdoor neurons of the image classification model according to the first activation state and the second activation state, and clearing the backdoor neurons.

title: Automatic analysis method and system for transient electromagnetic disturbance macro-pulse waveform of transformer substation
description: The invention discloses a transformer substation transient electromagnetic disturbance macro-pulse waveform automatic analysis method and system, which comprise the steps of collecting transformer substation transient electromagnetic waveform data, extracting waveform characteristics, identifying the type of an output port and the amplitude of background noise according to the waveform characteristics as a first amplitude threshold value, traversing the transformer substation transient electromagnetic waveform data, taking the difference value between the maximum value and the minimum value in the waveform as a macro-pulse peak value, taking the maximum value of the absolute value of the maximum value and the minimum value as a macro-pulse maximum peak value, carrying out global search on the waveform according to the first amplitude threshold value to obtain the maximum peak value position and the absolute time, removing micro-pulses of which the waveform amplitude does not meet the first amplitude threshold value by taking the maximum peak value position as the center, storing the absolute time of the maximum peak value in the waveform into a first array, sequencing, calculating the time difference between the adjacent two points to form a second array as micro-pulse interval time, and taking the macro-pulse duration as the difference between the maximum value and the minimum value in a one-dimensional array. The invention can automatically analyze the waveform data to obtain the waveform parameters of the macro pulse sequence.

title: Multi-sensor fusion three-dimensional reconstruction method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a multi-sensor fusion three-dimensional reconstruction method, device, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring image data and point cloud data through sensors; inputting the acquired image data and point cloud data into a trained three-dimensional reconstruction model to generate point-by-point RGB prediction results to achieve reconstruction of a three-dimensional scene. The present invention inputs image features into a cross-attention module as keys and values, uses point cloud features as queries to de-aggregate image features and update point cloud features; processes point cloud features through a reconstruction prediction head to generate point-by-point RGB prediction results to achieve reconstruction of a three-dimensional scene; decouples calibration information from model input to achieve implicit spatial alignment of multi-sensor information and improves robustness to calibration noise. The present invention can be widely used in the field of intelligent recognition technology.

title: Laser thermal effect evaluation method and device
description: The invention discloses a laser thermal effect evaluation method and device, and belongs to the technical field of biology. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an original laser speckle blood flow image sequence, analyzing the original laser speckle image by adopting a time contrast analysis algorithm to obtain a laser speckle contrast image, and converting the laser speckle contrast image to obtain the laser speckle blood flow image. The method comprises the steps of calculating half-width of blood vessels in a laser speckle blood flow image to serve as the width of the blood vessels, obtaining a difference image by taking difference between the blood flow image after laser irradiation and the blood flow image before laser irradiation, obtaining the blood vessels changed by laser irradiation according to the difference image, then selecting a region of interest, obtaining blood flow average values of the blood vessels before and after laser irradiation, and evaluating the final laser treatment effect. The invention irradiates the mouse ridge window 108 from the whole skin side of the mouse ridge window 108, and adopts the technologies of laser speckle blood flow imaging and the like to monitor the blood flow change in real time on the side of the opposite side exposed blood vessel. The influence of upper skin tissues is considered, and the blood flow change is monitored in real time, so that the accurate evaluation of the laser thermal effect of the blood vessel is realized.

title: Method and system for model training
description: The present disclosure provides a method and system for model training. A method for training a deep learning model may include: a graphics processor (GPU) groups parameters of each layer of the deep learning model; the GPU unloads the grouped parameters to multiple storage devices, wherein each storage device stores a set of parameters of each layer; and the GPU and the multiple storage devices perform training of the deep learning model in parallel.

title: Water conservancy gate control monitoring system based on machine vision
description: The present invention relates to the field of machine vision technology, and specifically to a water conservancy gate control and monitoring system based on machine vision, the system comprising a visual data acquisition module, a visual feature extraction module, a time series analysis module, a prediction and decision module, a fault diagnosis module and an execution control module. In the present invention, by directly extracting the visual features of water level and flow rate from an image using a convolutional neural network, the system not only improves the speed of data analysis, but also enhances the accuracy of the data and the predictability of the operation. The digitalized hydrological characteristic data reveals the dynamic characteristics of hydrological changes through time series analysis, enhances the automation of the system and optimizes the decision-making process. The application of the Bayesian network model makes the prediction of the hydrological condition more accurate, provides data support for gate operation, thereby ensuring the efficiency and safety of water resources management, and the automatic identification and risk assessment of structural defects reduce potential safety risks.

title: Intelligent agriculture management method and system applied to ecological agriculture
description: The invention discloses an intelligent agriculture management method and system applied to ecological agriculture, and relates to the technical field of ecological agriculture management. This closed loop mechanism ensures continued improvement of the system, further improving the accuracy of predictions and decisions. By means of fine feature extraction and selection, sensitivity of the model to key influence factors is improved, and reliability of a prediction result is enhanced. The integrated learning capability of the random forest is utilized, so that the model still keeps high efficiency in a complex environment, and the dependence on single characteristics or the model is reduced. The comprehensive scoring system enables the drug application and management decision to be driven by more data, and reduces resource waste caused by experience judgment. The dynamic adjustment mechanism of the system reduces unnecessary chemical investment, is beneficial to protecting ecological environment and promotes the development of ecological agriculture.

title: Problem processing method, model generating method and related devices
description: The application discloses a problem processing method, a model generating method and a related device, belonging to the technical field of artificial intelligence; the method comprises the steps of carrying out time domain positioning on a target video based on a to-be-processed problem, generating a target answer for the to-be-processed problem according to a first target video segment obtained by positioning, and outputting a processing result of the to-be-processed problem, wherein the processing result comprises time domain information corresponding to the target answer and the first target video segment, and the video question-answering model is a model obtained by respectively carrying out video question-answering processing based on time domain positioning on the problem information in different question-answering pairs meeting a dual relationship through a video question-answering network and adjusting parameters of the video question-answering network based on consistency loss between the video question-answering processing corresponding to the different question-answering pairs.

title: Damper scale estimation method and system
description: The present invention relates to a damper scale estimation method and system, the method comprising the following steps: acquiring an image of a damper to be identified; processing the image of the damper to be identified to obtain a damper barrel area, a damper coarse scale line area, and a damper fine scale line area; performing scale identification on the damper coarse scale line area to obtain scale result data of the damper. The present invention significantly improves the efficiency and accuracy of damper scale identification by identifying the damper barrel area, the coarse scale line area, and the fine scale line area in the damper image, and performing scale identification on the coarse scale line area to obtain scale result data, thereby solving the problems of cumbersomeness, large workload, and easy introduction of human errors in traditional manual visual detection or photo recognition methods.

title: Radar active interference identification and classification method based on multi-channel TCN-BiGRU network fusion
description: The present invention belongs to the field of radar technology, and discloses a radar active interference signal identification method based on a TCN-BiGRU fusion network, including: establishing different radar active interference signal models; performing wavelet packet decomposition on the radar active interference signal to obtain wavelet packet decomposition coefficients; establishing data sets for the real part, imaginary part and modulus of the wavelet packet decomposition coefficients respectively and dividing them into a training set and a verification set: building a three-channel TCN-BiGRU network model, training to obtain a radar active interference signal identification model; inputting a test set and a verification set into the radar active interference signal identification model for signal identification and verification.
