The present invention uses wavelet packet decomposition and separates the real part, imaginary part and modulus of the interference signal to form three independent data sets. The time convolution network TCN and the bidirectional gated recurrent unit BiGRU are connected in series to build a three-channel network model, and the three groups of data are processed respectively. The outputs of the three channels are fused by weighted voting, thereby improving the overall recognition accuracy of the model.

title: Method, device and computer readable storage medium for recognizing formula
description: The present application discloses a method, device and computer-readable storage medium for identifying formulas, wherein the method comprises: extracting hidden variables from a picture containing a formula; packing the hidden variables to obtain an initial formula sequence; and unpacking the initial formula sequence to obtain a complete formula sequence. By packing and unpacking the formula sequence according to the solution of the present application, the model's ability to parse the formula structure in formula identification can be improved.

title: Methods, systems, and computer program products for pre-classifying a drug based on drug characteristics to reduce the size of an artificial intelligence model for validating the drug
description: A method includes receiving information associated with a drug, the information including a plurality of characteristics, filtering the information based on at least one of the plurality of characteristics to identify an artificial intelligence engine of a plurality of artificial intelligence engines, and predicting a National Drug Code (NDC) of the drug using the identified one of the plurality of artificial intelligence engines or verifying whether the drug matches a target drug using the identified one of the plurality of intelligent engines.

title: Convolution calculation method, convolution calculation device, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
description: The application discloses a convolution calculation method, a convolution calculation device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of segmenting feature map data to obtain a plurality of sub-image blocks; the method comprises the steps of dividing weight data in a plurality of weight data sets to obtain sub weight blocks, obtaining corresponding first target elements based on clock periods, obtaining corresponding second target elements, broadcasting the first target elements to all computing units of corresponding rows in a corresponding computing array, broadcasting the second target elements to all computing units of corresponding columns in the computing array, and outputting a target feature map based on the current convolution computing result. According to the method, the device and the system, the feature map data are segmented according to the parameters of the computing array, so that convolution computing results of all image blocks in the same feature map direction are accumulated in the computing unit, additional intermediate result storage resources and chip resources for processing the stored intermediate results are not required to be consumed, and the area of a chip can be effectively reduced.

title: Expressway vehicle abnormal event detection system based on monitoring video
description: The present invention relates to the field of video anomaly detection technology, including: a detection method based on multi-target tracking, using target detection and target tracking algorithms to accurately detect and track vehicles in video data; a detection method based on weakly supervised video, using a video anomaly detection algorithm to detect abnormal vehicle behavior; a detection method based on trajectory classification, using a motion trajectory detection algorithm to detect vehicles with abnormal trajectories in surveillance videos, and this method uses a trajectory anomaly detection algorithm to achieve binary classification of all vehicle motion trajectories in surveillance videos. By combining multiple detection methods, combining target detection and tracking with lane line detection to achieve detection of vehicle position and motion state, a two-stage network is proposed to achieve accurate detection of abnormal events of highway vehicles.

title: Ground wave radar data quality control method based on CNN-LSTM model
description: The present invention discloses a method for controlling the quality of ground wave radar data based on a CNN-LSTM model, the method comprising: determining the range of radar detection data affected by terrain according to the accuracy difference of radar echo data; training a CNN-LSTM neural network according to the range of radar detection data to obtain a target model; and correcting the radar data of the area affected by terrain according to the target model to obtain corrected radar data. The embodiment of the present invention can correct the radar detection data affected by terrain such as coastlines and islands in combination with actual marine environmental information, improve the accuracy of the ocean current direction synthesized by the radar detection data, and can be widely used in the field of computer technology.

title: Hydropower unit fault diagnosis method based on HOA-ELM
description: The invention discloses a hydroelectric generating set fault diagnosis method based on HOA-ELM, which is implemented according to the following steps of firstly, collecting vibration signals of a hydroelectric generating set under different working conditions, secondly, extracting time domain features, frequency domain features, energy entropy features, root mean square features and singular value features of the vibration signals collected in the first step, putting the vibration signals into a multi-dimensional feature set, thirdly, converting the features in the multi-dimensional feature set obtained in the second step into low-dimensional features, thirdly, training an ELM model according to an HOA algorithm to obtain optimal hidden layer weights w and deviation b and applying the optimal hidden layer weights and deviation b to the ELM model to obtain an HOA-ELM diagnosis model, thirdly, inputting the test set obtained in the third step into the HOA-ELM diagnosis model to test the HOA-ELM diagnosis model, and thirdly, performing fault diagnosis by using the tested HOA-ELM diagnosis model. The invention solves the problem of lower diagnosis accuracy in the prior art.

title: Video anomaly detection method, device, equipment, medium and program product
description: The embodiment of the application provides a video anomaly detection method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of anomaly detection. The method comprises the steps of extracting cross-scale local features and global features from an input image, fusing the cross-scale local features and the global features to obtain corresponding fused feature images, carrying out feature enhancement on each fused feature image to obtain a corresponding feature enhancement image, carrying out feature storage on the feature enhancement images, matching memory features most relevant to a current original image based on the stored features to reconstruct a reconstructed feature image corresponding to the current original image based on the memory features, and comparing differences between the reconstructed feature images and the current original image based on a preset difference threshold to carry out anomaly detection on the current original image. The embodiment of the application can simultaneously improve the calculation efficiency and accuracy of abnormal video detection by combining the local feature extraction capability of the convolution layer and the long-distance dependency capture capability of the state space model architecture.

title: Surgical patient rehabilitation auxiliary system based on neural network model
description: The invention relates to the technical field of rehabilitation guidance of patients in thoracic surgery, in particular to a surgical patient rehabilitation auxiliary system based on a neural network model, which comprises a biosensor module, a motion sensor module, an emotion information analysis module and a rehabilitation effect evaluation module, wherein in the surgical patient rehabilitation auxiliary system based on the neural network model, the patients are monitored in real time through the biosensor module, the treatment effect evaluation unit detects the value of the rehabilitation training of the patient through the motion sensor module and compares with the value of the rest time of the patient detected by the biological sensor module, the recovery condition of the patient is judged, then a doctor adjusts the medication condition of the patient according to the analysis result, the metabolism state evaluation unit detects the absorption effect of the drug after the medication of the patient, and meanwhile, when the patient performs the rehabilitation training, the motion posture of the patient is predicted through the motion track prediction unit, and when the motion posture is wrong, the alarm unit timely alarms to staff.

title: Extreme air temperature forecasting method, device and storage medium
description: The present application relates to the technical field of temperature forecasting, and specifically to a method, device and storage medium for extreme temperature forecasting. The method includes: obtaining historical meteorological observation data within a preset historical time period within a preset geographical range; determining the time series of typical spatial modes within the preset geographical range according to the historical meteorological observation data; determining key circulation factors according to the circulation factors and the time series corresponding to the circulation factors; determining predicted circulation factor data according to weather forecast data; determining the extreme temperature prediction value within the preset prediction time period according to the predicted circulation factor data; constructing a temperature anomaly field within the preset geographical range according to the extreme temperature prediction value; determining the extreme temperature forecast within the preset prediction time period according to the weather forecast data within the preset prediction time period; updating the extreme temperature forecast through the temperature anomaly field, and determining the updated extreme temperature forecast as the target extreme temperature forecast for the preset geographical range within the preset prediction time period.

title: Signal processing device and signal processing method
description: A kind of signal processing apparatus and signal processing method.The signal processing apparatus includes receiver, memristor array and classifier.Receiver is configured as receiving the first signal.Memristor array includes multiple memristor units, each of multiple memristor units include memristor, memristor array is configured as: first signal received being applied at least one memristor unit in the multiple memristor unit, and exports the second signal of the memristor resistance value distribution based on the memristor array.Classifier is configured as classifying to the second signal that the memristor array exports, to obtain the type of first signal.The signal processing apparatus is small in size, low in energy consumption and be easily integrated.

title: Method, device, system and storage medium for detecting dog face feature points
description: The present invention provides a method, device, system, and computer storage medium for labeling dog facial feature points. The method includes performing feature point detection based on an image containing a dog face and a trained detection model to obtain precisely located feature points. The detection model includes a first-level network and a second-level network. Obtaining precisely located feature points includes performing feature point detection based on a full-face image of the dog face and the first-level network of the detection model to obtain coarsely located feature points; and locating the coarsely located feature points based on a partial image of the dog face and the second-level network of the detection model to obtain the precisely located feature points. The method, device, system, and computer storage medium of the present invention can effectively improve the accuracy and real-time performance of dog facial feature point detection.

title: Natural language processing method, training method and data processing equipment
description: The present application discloses a natural language processing method, training method and data processing device in the field of artificial intelligence. The method includes: obtaining natural language text to be processed; processing the natural language text by using a deep neural network obtained by training , and output the target result obtained by processing the natural language text; wherein, the deep neural network includes: a granular labeling network, a first feature network, a second feature network, a first processing network, a second processing network, and a fusion network. In this application, the data processing device uses mutually decoupled networks to process words of different granularities in natural language text, which can effectively improve the performance of processing natural processing tasks.

title: Five-axis numerical control machine tool part management method and system
description: The invention discloses a management method and system for five-axis CNC machine tool parts, which relates to the technical field of CNC machine tool management, including: acquiring key parts and corresponding associated data, extracting features of the associated data and establishing a feature data set; fuzzy processing the feature data, formulating an evaluation set based on three wear probabilities, acquiring historical monitoring values of the associated data from historical operation records and extracting features; fuzzy marking the feature data, establishing a quadratic parabolic membership function, determining the wear interval in combination with the feature data value interval under normal and abnormal conditions, and determining the membership value of the feature data in each wear interval for each wear probability according to fuzzy rules; at the end of each monitoring cycle, combining all feature data of the same part to obtain a comprehensive evaluation value of the wear probability, judging whether wear quality inspection is needed, and further judging in combination with the use time after the last maintenance when it is impossible to judge directly; accurate management of five-axis CNC machine tool parts is achieved through multi-dimensional data monitoring.

title: Port ecological construction assessment method and system
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of port ecological construction, and specifically discloses a port ecological construction evaluation method and system, comprising the following steps: collecting dynamic ecological environment data in port construction and operation through a multi-source sensor array; performing spatiotemporal coupling analysis on the data, and using an adaptive sliding time window algorithm to calculate the dynamic attenuation rate of environmental indicators in each dimension.   , adjust the ecological response time constant θ based on the hydrodynamic conditions of the sea area around the port, and synchronously calculate the historical cumulative effect by integration   , generating an environmental health evolution surface; constructing a comprehensive assessment model; and predicting environmental risk values based on a hybrid prediction model. This invention provides an intelligent, automated, safe, reliable, green, and low-carbon assessment solution for port ecological construction, significantly improving port ecological protection and sustainable development.

title: A method and device for constructing a conceptual bottleneck model based on variational information bottleneck guidance.
description: This invention discloses a concept bottleneck model construction method guided by variational information bottleneck. This method utilizes a visual language model to generate a basic concept pool directly related to the input image content, and a large language model to generate a descriptive supplementary concept pool, covering diverse attribute features of the target category. Based on the principle of variational information bottleneck, it calculates concept importance scores through cross-modal aligned image-text embedding spaces to filter highly relevant concepts. A dual-branch concept bottleneck network is constructed from the basic concept classifier and the supplementary concept classifier, and the prediction results of both are fused through a classification fusion unit. An interpretability efficiency index is used to optimize the model, balancing classification accuracy and concept interpretation efficiency. This invention utilizes variational information bottleneck to perform deep alignment of CLIP-encoded image-text embeddings, and further improves classification accuracy using supplementary concept bottlenecks.

title: Common convolution computing hardware architecture based on row data stream and implementation method thereof
description: This invention discloses a hardware architecture for conventional convolutional computing based on row data streams and its implementation method, which is applied to chips to implement conventional convolution operations for neural network mapping. The method utilizes a serial-parallel conventional convolutional computing architecture to achieve delay-free, real-time serial-parallel computing of input data streams. This invention provides a method for optimizing time, area, and power consumption for conventional convolutional computing solutions for data streams of arbitrary granularity.

title: Non-contact monitoring method for three-dimensional integral deformation millimeter-level precision of landslide
description: This invention discloses a non-contact monitoring method for three-dimensional overall deformation of landslides with millimeter-level accuracy. First, calculation center points are selected at certain intervals in the original three-dimensional point cloud to form preliminary point cloud blocks. Next, the average domain vector algorithm is used to register the point cloud blocks with point cloud data from another period, interpreting the current deformation data. Subsequently, the spacing between the calculation center points is reduced to obtain finer-grained calculation points. Distance weights are used to take the initial deformation of neighboring calculation points as a reference for the current calculation point, and the registration step is repeated, with the calculation results superimposed. Calculation of the current region is stopped when the spacing is reduced to a specified threshold or the deformation is less than a set threshold. During the calculation process, key parameters such as block radius, registration search distance, and outlier removal are automatically determined through a trained neural network model combined with Bayesian optimization. This method automates the calculation process, achieving the acquisition of the overall displacement and deformation field with millimeter-level accuracy.

title: A method for inbound/outbound scheduling of linear reciprocating multi-RGV collaborative operations
description: A method for coordinating inbound and outbound operations of multiple reciprocating RGVs in a linear track is disclosed, relating to the field of RGV scheduling and control technology. The method involves collecting and organizing historical inbound and outbound task data of RGVs within the system, rasterizing the linear track, and extracting track numbers, inbound/outbound platforms, and RGV-related data. It also involves organizing the selectable buffer positions on the linear track, determining the current buffer position number, and allocating tasks to RGVs. A mathematical model for RGV inbound and outbound scheduling is established with the objective function of minimizing the maximum time consumed by RGVs to complete tasks. A genetic algorithm is used to solve for the buffer positions and optimal times for RGV task execution. By setting buffers on the linear track to avoid RGV collisions and optimizing buffer positions to minimize the total time for RGVs to complete tasks, an intelligent algorithm is employed to solve the RGV inbound and outbound operation scheduling scheme, improving operational efficiency and the system's adaptability and flexibility.

title: A carbon emission monitoring system and method for green transportation in railway engineering
description: The application relates to the technical field of carbon emission monitoring, in particular to a carbon emission monitoring system and a method for railway engineering green traffic, which firstly acquire actual power consumption in the running process of a train from a train traction power supply system based on a preset time period, synchronously acquire a power grid carbon emission factor corresponding to a train running area, calculate the carbon emission of the train in each time period based on the power grid carbon emission factor, and then, further screening out high-carbon emission data items, and calling train operation state information in each high-carbon emission time period, and further, based on a deep learning technology, identifying main influencing factors causing high-carbon emission of the train by carrying out deep feature extraction and cluster analysis on the train operation state information in each high-carbon emission time period. The method can realize the fine attribution analysis of the carbon emission of the train, and timely find and early warn the potential high-carbon emission event, thereby providing scientific basis for formulating a targeted energy-saving and emission-reduction strategy.

title: Optical remote sensing cloud and cloud shadow removal method, system, device and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of image enhancement technology, specifically to a method, system, device and storage medium for removing clouds and cloud shadows from optical remote sensing. To solve the technical problem of poor image declouding effect in the prior art, the present invention first preprocesses optical images and SAR images separately to solve the speckle noise problem in the SAR image and enhances the high-frequency information in the optical image. Then, the penetration ability of the SAR enhanced image is fused with the spectral information of the optical enhanced image, and the fusion result is processed by a channel and space coupled attention mechanism to obtain a semantic complementary feature image. Finally, the semantic complementary feature image is subjected to several structural reconstruction processes to retain high-frequency details and low-frequency semantics, thereby improving the image reconstruction quality. The obtained structural reconstruction feature image is subjected to convolution processing to obtain a cloud noise removed reconstructed image. The present invention is applied to the field of image cloud and cloud shadow removal, and has good removal effect and high image restoration quality.

title: Multi-mode traffic flow prediction method and system based on deep learning
description: The invention provides a multi-mode traffic flow prediction method and a system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the steps that electronic equipment acquires multi-mode vehicle running acquisition data of a specific intersection; and inputting the traffic flow prediction data into a reinforcement learning model of the double Q network structure to obtain a traffic signal lamp regulation strategy of the specific intersection. According to the embodiment of the invention, the traffic flow prediction data is obtained by using the traffic flow prediction model, the Markov decision model aiming at maximizing the traffic efficiency of the intersection is constructed by using the reinforcement learning model of the double-Q network structure, and the Markov decision model is solved to obtain the traffic signal lamp regulation strategy of the specific intersection.

title: Collaborative Optimization Method for Dynamic Charging and Discharging Strategies to Extend the Lifespan of Energy Storage Systems
description: This invention relates to the field of energy storage system technology, specifically to a dynamic charging and discharging strategy collaborative optimization method for extending the lifespan of energy storage systems. The method includes: inputting historical electricity price time series data based on a pre-defined long short-term memory network model to generate an electricity price prediction sequence; constructing a state vector, which includes the internal state of the energy storage system at the current time t and the electricity price prediction sequence; inputting the state vector into a pre-trained deep reinforcement learning agent, which outputs a specific action selected from a predefined set of discrete charging and discharging actions based on the input state vector; and converting the output specific action into charging and discharging power control commands and sending them to the energy storage converter for execution. This invention, through deep reinforcement learning combined with accurate electricity price prediction and dynamic battery health modeling, achieves collaborative optimization of charging and discharging strategies for energy storage systems in complex market environments.

title: Methods, devices, and media for joint optimization of 3D point cloud sampling and semantics for holographic communication
description: The invention provides a holographic communication-oriented three-dimensional point cloud sampling-semantic joint optimization method, device and medium, and relates to the technical field of holographic communication. The method comprises the steps of extracting semantic features of an original point cloud by a sending end in a semantic communication system, determining local semantic features of each point based on correlation between the semantic features of a plurality of adjacent points of the point and the semantic features of the point, determining semantic information criticality of the point based on the local semantic features of each point, sorting all points in the original point cloud according to the sequence of the semantic information criticality from large to small, conducting semantic sampling on the first M points to obtain downsampled semantic features, sending the downsampled semantic features to a receiving end in the semantic communication system, recovering the downsampled point cloud by the receiving end based on the received downsampled semantic features, and executing target tasks based on the downsampled point cloud, so that collaborative sampling and semantic joint encoding and decoding are achieved, and the end-to-end communication efficiency is improved.

title: A novel digital marketing collaboration method and system suitable for small and medium-sized banks
description: The application discloses a novel digital marketing cooperation method and system suitable for small and medium banks, and relates to the field of marketing cooperation; constructing a user portrait of a target user according to user attributes, analyzing demand information through a preset CNN-BiLSTM model to determine demand intention of the target user, performing matching degree verification on the demand intention according to the user portrait, converting the demand intention into marketing task indexes, acquiring resource information of all departments, determining evaluation indexes of all departments according to the department resource information and the marketing task indexes and combining game theory empowerment and multi-criterion compromised solution sequencing, comparing the evaluation indexes with a preset evaluation threshold, and determining marketing task allocation departments by using a preset screening model if the evaluation indexes are smaller than the preset evaluation threshold. The application can effectively improve the marketing efficiency of small and medium banks.

title: Dynamic intelligent multi-module real-time content recommendation system based on multi-channel behavior data
description: The invention discloses a dynamic intelligent multi-module real-time content recommendation system based on multi-channel behavior data, which comprises a basic tool module, an authoring tool module, a content stream module, an authoring agent module, a multi-channel data acquisition and analysis system and a cross-module dynamic linkage recommendation module. The method and the system can accurately predict the user demands and actively position related contents, greatly reduce the browsing and searching time of the user, improve the matching degree of first-screen contents, improve the content acquisition efficiency, dynamically adjust the content display strategy and the function arrangement sequence of each functional module according to the triggering of the user behaviors, break the barriers among the modules, realize the intelligent linkage among the modules, provide more personalized creation experience for the user, effectively solve the core problems of content homogenization, module isolation and poor user experience faced by the current AI content creation platform, and provide a dynamic intelligent multi-module real-time content recommendation system based on multi-channel behavior data for the user.

title: A method and system for predicting tidal flat evolution based on a hybrid model
description: The invention provides a tidal flat evolution prediction method and system based on a hybrid model, which relate to the technical field of intersection of dynamic geomorphology and artificial intelligence and comprise the steps of constructing a tidal flat erosion and deposition evolution database under different situations of a target coastal zone; the method comprises the steps of establishing a topography prediction model through an artificial intelligent algorithm based on a database, taking hydrodynamic feature data as input and seabed scouring and silting change amount as output, performing hybrid simulation based on a physical mechanism model and the topography prediction model, updating topography boundary conditions through cyclic iteration to realize long-duration evolution prediction, configuring a service application module, receiving user input parameters through an interactive interface and outputting a visual result. According to the invention, the traditional hydrodynamic force-sediment-landform coupling calculation is decoupled into a chain-type flow with a physical mechanism and AI cooperated, so that the calculation complexity is obviously reduced, the off-line rapid calculation business of tidal flat evolution is realized, and a real-time technical support is provided for coastal zone planning and disaster prevention decision.

title: SAR image water body segmentation system and method combining optical characteristics
description: This invention relates to the field of image processing technology, and more particularly to a SAR image water segmentation system and method combining optical features. An optical coding branch and a SAR coding branch extract features from the input optical and SAR water images respectively. A dual-modal fusion module fuses the shallow and deep features of the two extracted features. A multi-scale fusion module performs multi-scale fusion of the fused shallow and deep features. A decoding branch decodes the fused features to obtain the water segmentation map. This invention achieves high-precision segmentation of water regions in remote sensing scenes by designing modules such as shallow guidance, cross-modal attention, and multi-scale context fusion, improving the accuracy of water category identification and boundary preservation capabilities.

title: A document authentication method based on spectral analysis
description: The invention discloses a document identification method based on spectrum analysis, which comprises the steps of obtaining spectrum data of a local document, carrying out data processing and feature extraction on the spectrum data to obtain local spectrum features, training a local teacher model through the local spectrum features to obtain spectrum feature knowledge representation of the local teacher model, uploading the spectrum feature knowledge representation of the local teacher model to a central server, training a global student model through the spectrum feature knowledge representation of a plurality of local teacher models in the central server, generating an antagonistic spectrum sample through the global student model and the spectrum feature knowledge representation, issuing the global student model and the antagonistic spectrum feature sample to the local area to carry out incremental iterative training to obtain a local document identification model, and outputting an identification result on the spectrum data of the local document based on the model.

title: Incremental knowledge operation and management methods for big data in ship design knowledge
description: This invention relates to the field of ship design knowledge management technology, and discloses an incremental knowledge operation and management method for ship design knowledge big data. The method first acquires initial knowledge data from a ship design knowledge base and assigns incremental tags; then, it acquires metadata records, classifies and processes them, and stores them hierarchically; it sets update tags for operation terminals and associates them with incremental tags, synchronizes knowledge data, and matches update cycles according to time information; it compares the knowledge status of operation terminals with the update cycle and generates update prompts; it obtains usage frequency to calculate a knowledge activity index, combines it with operator identification, and transmits it to the management backend terminal; after verifying updated knowledge, it adjusts knowledge priorities. This method achieves orderly storage, timely updates, and rational utilization of knowledge data, improves retrieval efficiency, ensures knowledge timeliness, optimizes knowledge management, and enhances the overall level of ship design.

title: Intelligent textile printing and dyeing process optimization method and system
description: This invention provides an intelligent method and system for optimizing textile printing and dyeing processes. The method determines the parameters of the membership function based on the characteristics of the current batch of materials, and uses the membership function to fuzzify the real-time process parameters to obtain fuzzy process features. It calculates the activation contribution of each fuzzy rule based on the historical prediction accuracy and the correlation with process benefits, thereby obtaining the process coordination state. The sensor time-series data and the process coordination state are input into a multimodal time-series master capsule layer to obtain the master capsule output vector. The confidence level of the vector is calculated, and the influence of the vector on subsequent routing to higher-level capsule layers is adjusted based on the confidence level. The higher-level capsule layer generates a set of control parameters for subsequent processes. Quality inspection data from subsequent processes is acquired, and a multi-objective deviation vector is obtained based on the quality inspection data and the control parameter set. The multi-objective deviation vector is used to optimize the higher-level capsule layer, resulting in an optimized set of control parameters.

title: A method and system for predicting the temporal propagation of rock cracks based on the fusion of GAN and LSTM
description: This invention proposes a method and system for temporal prediction of rock crack propagation based on the fusion of GAN and LSTM, relating to the field of image processing technology. The method includes: acquiring multiple sets of preprocessed crack propagation image sequence samples; each set of crack propagation image sequence samples includes multiple standard temporal samples; extracting temporal dependent features and global spatial features from the crack propagation image sequence samples using a generator within an initial prediction model to obtain fused spatiotemporal features, and inputting these fused spatiotemporal features into a residual attention module for feature fusion and feature weight adjustment to generate an initial prediction image; the generator includes a bidirectional LSTM module and a Transformer encoder; alternately optimizing the discriminator and generator within the initial prediction model using the initial prediction image until the loss functions corresponding to the discriminator and the generator converge or reach a set number of training rounds to obtain a target prediction model; and inputting the image to be processed into the target prediction model to obtain a target crack propagation prediction image.

title: Drilling camera shooting intelligent interpretation method based on geological vision large model
description: This invention discloses an intelligent interpretation method for borehole camera images based on a large-scale geological visual model, comprising: 1) acquiring and preprocessing borehole images to construct a sample library containing geological tags; 2) embedding a geological feature attention module and a lithology classification adapter into an existing general-purpose large-scale visual model, and performing specific optimizations based on the geological characteristics of deep coal mines to construct a large-scale geological visual model; 3) constructing a geological algorithm dictionary to transform geological knowledge and experience into computationally achievable algorithm modules, and embedding them into the large-scale geological visual model; 4) implementing sample adaptive diagnosis and iterative learning through an AI module. This invention, by constructing a large-scale geological visual model, embedding a geological feature attention module and a geological algorithm dictionary into the model, and integrating sample adaptive diagnosis and iterative learning mechanisms, can significantly improve the accuracy of geological feature recognition in borehole camera images, achieving efficient and accurate interpretation of borehole images and providing precise geological data support for underground mining operations.

title: Predictive data processing methods and related products for construction progress and resource coordination
description: This invention relates to the field of data processing technology, specifically to a predictive data processing method and related products for construction progress and resource coordination. The method includes: constructing a BIM knowledge graph; real-time monitoring of dynamic data; generating a multi-dimensional risk prediction vector if a risk event deviating from the construction plan is identified; constructing a multi-objective optimization model to generate a collaborative optimization strategy; executing the collaborative optimization strategy to update the construction progress plan and resource allocation plan, and simultaneously updating the BIM knowledge graph. By constructing a BIM knowledge graph that integrates multi-source heterogeneous data, this invention breaks down the information barriers between traditional BIM design data and on-site execution data. Furthermore, by simulating the chain reaction propagation of risk events, it quantitatively predicts future time and cost deviations, transforming project management from a traditional "post-event remediation" model to a "pre-event control" model.

title: A method and system for optimizing water-drive sandstone reservoir development schemes
description: This invention discloses a method and system for optimizing water-drive sandstone reservoir development schemes, belonging to the field of reservoir development technology. It utilizes a large language model to convert user-input natural language into input parameters for a reservoir dynamic prediction network model, obtaining multiple production schemes. Production dynamic data and well trajectory information corresponding to different production schemes are input into the updated reservoir dynamic prediction network model to obtain production prediction results for each scheme. Based on a reservoir knowledge graph, the production prediction results of different production schemes are used as attribute information and associated with well entities, stratigraphic entities, and scheme entities in the reservoir knowledge graph for reasoning and searching, generating multiple candidate development schemes. Multi-objective optimization is performed on these candidate schemes to determine the optimal reservoir development scheme. This method can uncover the potential relationships and influences between schemes, selecting candidate schemes that better suit the actual reservoir conditions and development objectives.

title: A Reinforcement Learning-Based Optimization Method and System for Cost Control Strategies in Engineering Cost Projects
description: This invention provides a method and system for optimizing cost control strategies in engineering cost projects based on reinforcement learning, relating to the field of engineering cost technology. The method includes: Step 2, executing resource allocation and cost control in the current construction phase according to the initial cost control strategy, and obtaining actual cost, schedule, and quality data; Step 3, integrating the actual cost, schedule, and quality data to construct a multi-dimensional data distribution model, forming an abstract decision space; fitting discrete data into a continuous decision surface, calculating the curvature of local regions, and analyzing the structural change characteristics of the decision surface; dividing the abstract decision space into regions based on the structural change characteristics, mapping the original data to the corresponding partitions, extracting the inherent features of each partition, and generating strategy correction parameters. This invention achieves dynamic adaptive optimization of cost control strategies in engineering cost projects, improving the accuracy of cost control in engineering projects.

title: Neural network with modification of neuron weights and reaction coefficient
description: A neural network computation apparatus having a plurality of layers, each of the plurality of layers has at least an input layer and an output layer, each layer having a plurality of units, a plurality of links, each of the plurality of links connecting units on the plurality of layers, and changing means for changing input and output characteristics of a particular unit of the plurality of units and/or the weight of a particular link of the plurality of links in accordance with an output of the output layer after learning an example and with a particular rule. After the neural network computation apparatus learns an example, the changing means changes input and output characteristics of units and weights of links in accordance with outputs of the output layer and a particular rule. Thus, a mutual operation between a logical knowledge and a pattern recognizing performance can be accomplished and thereby a determination close to that of a specialist can be accomplished. In other words, a proper determination in accordance with an experience can be made so as to deal with unknown patterns with high flexibility.

title: Neural network weight reduction device, neural network weight reduction method and program
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce the weight of a weight filter on a channel-by-channel basis while suppressing deterioration of the performance of a neural network after weight reduction.  SOLUTION: A first neural network having a plurality of processing layers including at least one convolution layer is acquired, and at least one second second with respect to a subsequent stage of the convolution layer included in the first neural network. A third neural network to which the neural network is connected as an additional layer is generated, the third neural network is trained, and a feature amount and a predetermined threshold value calculated based on the weight parameter of the second neural network are performed. Select a channel that satisfies the predetermined relationship with and as a redundant channel.  [Selection diagram] Fig. 3

title: Anomaly detection device, mechanical system and anomaly detection method
description: In order to perform error-free anomaly detection when detecting the state of a mechanical device, a state signal generator (11) that detects the state of the mechanical device (2) as a state signal, and an operating condition for the operating state of the mechanical device. a condition signal generation unit (15) for generating a condition signal detected as a condition signal, a state feature generation unit (12) for generating a state feature from the state signal, and a condition feature generation unit for generating a condition feature from the condition signal (16), an initial state learning unit (13) that learns based on the state feature amount for initial learning and outputs the initial state learning result, and an initial condition that learns based on the condition feature amount for initial learning and outputs the initial condition learning result. A learning unit (17), an abnormality degree calculation unit (14) that calculates the degree of abnormality based on the state learning result that is the initial state learning result or the additional state learning result and the state feature amount for detection, and the initial condition learning result or An unknown degree calculation unit (18) is provided for calculating an unknown degree based on the conditional learning result, which is the additional conditional learning result, and the detection condition feature amount.

title: Neural network circuit and learning method thereof
description: Provided are a neural network circuit and a learning method thereof capable of appropriately performing a learning operation based on pulse timing even when the number of neurons is large. The neuron circuit (30) generates an analog pulse voltage (V  POST1  ) and a switching pulse voltage (V  POST2  ) for input to the other neural network circuit element (40) as a first input signal (V  PRE  ). The synapse circuit (20) includes a waveform generation circuit (33), and the neuron circuit that is the same as the synapse circuit (20) in the input allowable period in the first input signal (V  PRE  ) from the other neural network circuit element (40). The analog pulse voltage (V  POST1  ) generated in (30) is input to the third terminal (15) of the resistance change element (10) in the synapse circuit (20), and the analog pulse voltage in the input allowable period The resistance value of the variable resistance element (10) is changed by the potential difference between the first terminal (13) and the third terminal (15) generated depending on the magnitude of (V  POST1  ).

title: Method, system, apparatus, storage medium, and device for identifying high-resolution plant leaves
description: [Problem] To provide a method, system, apparatus, storage medium, and device for identifying plant leaves with high resolution. [Solution] In the method, an image of a plant leaf is first randomly masked to obtain an enhanced image, which is then input to a feature extraction network model in pair with the original image to obtain a feature vector. The feature vector of the original image and the feature vector of the masked image are input to a classification network layer to perform variety identification, the feature vector of the original image and the feature vector of the masked image are input to an adversarial network layer to perform binary classification identification, and the feature vector of the masked image is input to an autoencoding network module for self-supervised learning of image restoration, using loss functions for three tasks. In the self-supervised task, the masked image makes the feature extraction network focus on local features of the leaf (texture, veins) through pixel restoration learning, while the original image makes the feature extraction network focus on the original shape information and global features of the leaf in the variety identification task. [Selected Figure] Figure 2

title: Face recognition method utilizing artificial neural network and its device
description: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a face recognition method for recognizing a face by utilizing an artificial nerve network.  <P>SOLUTION: The face recognition device includes an eigenpaxel selection part which generates an eigenpaxel indicating feature patterns of the face and selects the prescribed number of eigenpaxels among the generated eigenpaxels, an eigenfiltering part which filters an inputted video image respectively by the selected eigenpaxel, the prescribed number of neural networks in which a signal of the video image filtered by corresponding eigenpaxel is inputted and which outputs a face recognition result and a decision part in which recognition results are inputted from each neural network and which outputs the final face recognition result of the inputted video image. Thus, learning time of the neural network is remarkably shortened and learning convergence speed of the neural network is vastly improved by constituting many neural networks in parallel and performing face recognition by learning each neural network by the eigen-filtered video image having similar pattern characteristics.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO

title: Cloud storage resource intelligent scheduling and backup recovery system
description: The present invention relates to the technical field related to cloud storage resource scheduling and backup, and discloses a cloud storage resource intelligent scheduling and backup recovery system. The present invention includes a distributed metadata management cluster, a storage resource dynamic scheduling engine, an intelligent backup controller, a disaster recovery execution unit, and a control plane bus. The present invention realizes dynamic optimization configuration of storage resources through the synergy of an LSTM neural network prediction model and an improved consistent hashing algorithm, thereby achieving the purpose of significantly improving the utilization rate of storage resources. It also realizes multi-dimensional protection through the joint innovation of Merkle tree verification and pipeline recovery technology and a composite security architecture to achieve comprehensive enhancement of disaster recovery efficiency, security, and reliability. While reducing costs, the overall algorithm is optimized, and manual intervention is reduced as much as possible, thereby achieving more accurate scheduling and backup recovery.

title: Multi-agent thinking link construction method and system based on reinforcement learning
description: The invention discloses a multi-agent thinking link construction method and system based on reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of 1, initializing an agent and constructing a thinking link, using a multi-agent reinforcement learning frame, 2, monitoring the agent to collect countermeasure information in a countermeasure scene, feeding back the countermeasure information to a decision-making agent, making the decision-making agent generate a countermeasure target position, analyzing the countermeasure environment and the states of the agents by using the thinking link to generate an action plan, 3, generating an optimal countermeasure path and opportunity by the countermeasure agent, executing countermeasure tasks, and guaranteeing that the agent provides logistic support. According to the method, chain thinking is introduced into a multi-agent system, and an effective link is formed by utilizing dynamic information interaction among agents, so that the dynamic adaptability and instantaneity of the link can be effectively improved, and the resource consumption of link construction can be reduced, so that the decision efficiency and the countermeasure effect are improved in a complex and dynamic countermeasure environment.

title: AI-based image generation method, AI-based image generation device, terminal and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses an image generation method, device, terminal and storage medium based on AI. The scheme can receive character basic information input by a user, extract corresponding character feature vectors according to the character basic information, input the character feature vectors into a preset network model to generate a character image, receive scene basic information input by the user, extract corresponding scene feature vectors according to the scene basic information, generate a background image according to the character feature vectors and the scene feature vectors, and synthesize the background image with the character image. According to the scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the character image matched with the user requirement is automatically generated through the AI technology, and the background image and the character image are synthesized, so that the synthesized image is more suitable for the personalized requirement of the user, and the generation efficiency and consistency are higher.

title: Remote sensing image ship semantic segmentation method and system based on feature super-fusion module
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for semantic segmentation of remote sensing image ships based on a feature hyper-fusion module, which belongs to the technical field of remote sensing image processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a remote sensing ship image data set, and performing preliminary feature extraction on the remote sensing ship images of the remote sensing ship image data set to obtain the initial features of the remote sensing ship images; using the feature hyper-fusion module to perform feature fusion and enhancement on the initial features of the remote sensing ship images to obtain a fusion-enhanced feature map of the remote sensing ship images; performing feature extraction on the fusion-enhanced feature map of the remote sensing ship images to obtain feature representation for semantic segmentation, and obtaining a semantic segmentation result based on the feature representation of semantic segmentation. The present invention effectively improves the model's detection and semantic segmentation capabilities for ship targets by means of feature fusion, enhancement, and adaptive calibration.

title: Hexahedral grid intelligent simplification method for guaranteeing analysis precision
description: The invention discloses an intelligent simplifying method of a hexahedral mesh for guaranteeing analysis precision, which belongs to the technical field of hexahedral mesh simplification and comprises the following steps of extracting characteristics of layers and columns of the hexahedral mesh, including geometric characteristics, topological characteristics, quality characteristics and physical characteristics, checking effectiveness of the layers and the columns, predicting deleting probability of the layers/columns which can be deleted based on a constructed simplified neural network HSimNet, and executing layer/column deleting operation. In the invention, the physical characteristics of layers and columns are introduced into the hexahedral mesh simplification for the first time, the model simplification is connected with the physical problem, the geometric characteristics are introduced into the hexahedral mesh simplification, the layer and column structures with invalid mesh geometry are predicted, thereby ensuring the geometric effectiveness of the simplified mesh, and the topological characteristics and the quality characteristics are introduced into the hexahedral mesh simplification, thereby ensuring the integral quality of the simplified mesh.

title: Edge calculation and data optimization technology suitable for electronic Internet of things operation system
description: The present invention relates to the fields of power systems, the Internet of Things, and computing technology, and in particular to an edge computing and data optimization technology suitable for the Dianhong IoT operating system. The present invention improves the data processing capability of the Dianhong IoT operating system in edge computing scenarios by integrating edge computing and data optimization technologies. Specifically, through the steps of edge node deployment and data collection, data preprocessing and compression, edge computing and preliminary analysis, data optimization and aggregation, intelligent model training and updating, and data visualization and decision support, real-time, efficient, and accurate processing and analysis of IoT data are achieved, and the response speed and data processing efficiency of the system are improved. Beneficial effects include: improving the processing speed and accuracy of IoT data and reducing data transmission delays. Reducing data transmission bandwidth and storage requirements and reducing system costs. Providing data-based decision support and optimizing system performance and management efficiency. The scalability and flexibility of the system are enhanced, and it is suitable for a variety of IoT application scenarios. In summary, the present invention proposes an edge computing and data optimization technology suitable for the Dianhong IoT operating system, which has significant technical advantages and application prospects.

title: Short-term wind power prediction method based on quadratic decomposition and mixed deep neural network
description: The invention discloses a short-term wind power prediction method based on a secondary decomposition and mixed depth neural network, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining original wind power data and performing primary modal decomposition, clustering the original wind power data into 3 IMF components of high frequency, medium frequency and low frequency through K-means, performing secondary modal decomposition on the high frequency IMF components through a VMD algorithm, respectively inputting medium frequency components and low frequency components of each stable subsequence after VMD decomposition and a K-means clustering result into the neural network to perform combined model prediction, optimizing super parameters of the neural network through SBOA algorithm to prevent the network from sinking into local optimal solution, and superposing predicted values of all subsequences to obtain a final short-term wind power prediction result. The method adopts the combined prediction model based on the quadratic modal decomposition, and can fully exert the advantages of various single models, thereby improving the overall prediction performance.

title: A visual inspection system and its application method
description: The present invention provides a visual inspection system and its application method. The system includes an image acquisition module for acquiring multi-angle optical images and laser three-dimensional point cloud data; a data preprocessing module is responsible for denoising, geometric correction and multimodal data alignment; a feature extraction module extracts texture, edge and defect features through a convolutional neural network; a defect detection module identifies cracks, scratches and foreign matter based on feature fusion; an adaptive optimization module dynamically adjusts the detection threshold and classifier parameters; a result output module generates a test report and marks the defect location; a feedback calibration module corrects the detection model weight according to the manual review result; an equipment control module triggers a sorting device to remove defective products; and a performance monitoring module counts the detection accuracy and system response delay. The present invention can improve the detection accuracy and system stability.

title: Federal distributed aggregation method, federal distributed aggregation device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The application provides a federal distributed aggregation method, a federal distributed aggregation device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method is applied to the technical field of machine learning and comprises the following steps: dividing global secret s in the target global model training process into n secret fragments, and transmitting the n secret fragments to n model training devices; for any model training device, determining a key of the model training device and sending the key to the model training device, enabling the model training device to encrypt original model parameters to obtain encrypted model parameters, dividing the encrypted model parameters to obtain m encrypted shares, aggregating the m encrypted shares to obtain an aggregate share of the model training device, and updating a target global model based on the aggregate shares of the n model training devices. The method can encrypt data in the training process in the model training process of the federal distributed method, so that the privacy and safety in the model training process are improved, and the success rate of model training is ensured.

title: Video detection method and device
description: The embodiments of the present application provide a video detection method, apparatus, computer equipment, computer-readable storage medium, and computer program product, and relate to the field of computer technology. The video detection method comprises: obtaining a video frame to be detected; inputting the video frame to be detected into a pre-trained target classification network model to output the category probability of the video frame to be detected; based on the category probability, determining the resolution of the video frame to be detected; wherein the target classification network model is obtained by binary classification training based on two types of sample video frames with different resolutions. The technical solution of the embodiments of the present application realizes accurate identification of the resolution of the video frame to be detected.

title: A PRI jitter radar signal sorting method, program, device and storage medium based on vine moss algorithm
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of radar signal sorting, and particularly relates to a PRI (pulse-rate oscillation) jitter radar signal sorting method, program, equipment and storage medium based on a moss algorithm. According to the invention, TOA difference distribution is reconstructed through overlapping PRI box structures, and the adaptability of an algorithm is improved by combining a dynamic time starting point calibration idea. The invention designs a vine moss algorithm, adopts chebyshev mapping to construct population initialization position distribution, introduces a Lev flight strategy to change spore propagation searching mode, integrates an environmental factor adaptation searching mechanism, avoids sinking into a local optimal solution, improves global searching capability, and improves parameter space coverage rate, so that the PRI shake radar signal sorting can be realized in an unknown environment. According to the PRI jitter radar signal sorting method, the overlapping rate and the observation time adjustable coefficient of the PRI box in the sorting process are obtained in a self-adaptive mode, the subharmonic adjustable coefficient is eliminated, and the noise adjustable coefficient is eliminated, so that the generalization and the accuracy of sorting are improved, and the PRI jitter radar signal sorting is realized.

title: New line passenger flow prediction method based on semi-supervised Conv-converter deep learning model
description: The invention discloses a new line passenger flow prediction method based on a semi-supervised Conv-Transformer deep learning model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining POI data aiming at a target line, inputting the POI data into a trained convolution transducer model to obtain trend flow and scale flow, wherein the scale quantity reflects scale characteristics of station passenger flow, the trend flow reflects trend characteristics of station passenger flow, training the convolution transducer model in a semi-supervised learning mode, and combining the trend flow and the scale flow to obtain a passenger flow prediction result. The invention improves the accuracy of predicting the new line passenger flow and reduces the demand for training data.

title: Industrial anomaly detection method based on semi-supervised contrast learning
description: The present invention proposes an industrial anomaly detection method based on semi-supervised contrastive learning, which solves the problem of scarce labeled data in industrial anomaly detection by combining semi-supervised and contrastive learning techniques. CLAD adopts a dual-branch contrastive learning architecture, which is optimized for limited labeled data and a large amount of unlabeled data respectively. For labeled data, an enhanced negative sample learning strategy based on CutPaste is adopted to generate discriminative feature representations through explicit category-aware contrastive learning; for unlabeled data, an adaptive contrastive learning mechanism is designed to automatically discover potential data relationships through similarity-aware instance discrimination. The method performs well in the MVTec AD benchmark test, achieving an AUROC of 98.7% using only 10% of labeled data, which is significantly better than existing traditional semi-supervised methods.

title: Unsupervised industrial abnormal sound detection method based on TinyCRNN-GMM network
description: An unsupervised industrial abnormal sound detection method combining self-supervised learning and Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) is provided, and the monitoring challenge of intelligent industrial equipment is met. Traditional diagnosis relies on manual work or rules, and is difficult to deal with various faults and data non-uniformity. The method uses TinyCRNN and GMM, the audio frequency is processed into a Mel spectrogram through Librosa, the normal sound characteristics are extracted from the supervision, the abnormality is identified through GMM cluster analysis, and the performance is evaluated through AUC and the like. The method reduces dependence on labeling data, solves the problem of data scarcity, improves detection accuracy and robustness, has great application potential in industrial fault detection, and has obvious advantages on unknown faults.

title: On-line proxy model auxiliary multi-objective optimization method for green hydrogen coupling hydrogenation process
description: The invention provides an online proxy model auxiliary multi-objective optimization method for a green hydrogen coupling hydrogenation process, which comprises the steps of aiming at green hydrogen-ash hydrogen mixed fluctuation of the green hydrogen coupling hydrogenation process, constructing an economic and carbon emission reduction multi-objective operation parameter optimization problem, carrying out sensitivity analysis on the operation parameter to obtain the operation parameter to be optimized and a value range thereof, establishing a first principle model for the hydrogenation process, carrying out Latin hypercube sampling, establishing an offline proxy model by adopting Gaussian process regression, generating an initial online proxy model based on the Gaussian process under the condition of mixed hydrogen fluctuation, solving the economic and carbon emission reduction multi-objective optimization problem by adopting a rapid non-dominant sorting optimization method, and periodically updating the online proxy model. The invention gives consideration to investment cost and carbon emission reduction benefit, and realizes balance optimization of economic benefit and carbon emission reduction multi-objective under frequent fluctuation of green hydrogen-ash hydrogen mixing.

title: Night electric worker protective equipment detection method based on deep cascade network architecture
description: The present invention discloses a method for detecting protective equipment for electric power workers at night based on a deep cascade network architecture, comprising: constructing an improved YOLO v8 model; preprocessing low-light and high-noise images through the input part of the improved YOLO v8 model to generate an optimized image tensor; extracting features from the optimized image tensor through the backbone network of the improved YOLO v8 model to obtain feature maps of different scales; capturing the content relationship between image features of large-scale feature maps through the Transformer module in the backbone network; transferring the feature map to the detection head of the improved YOLO v8 model for detection; when training the improved YOLO v8 model, introducing a sliding loss function, and outputting a detection result with the annotation information of the improved YOLO v8 model. The present invention significantly improves the performance and accuracy of target detection under low-light conditions.

title: Human body falling recognition method and device
description: The invention relates to a human body falling recognition method and a device, belonging to the technical field of falling recognition, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining motion characteristics of key points of a human body, and processing the motion characteristics based on a sliding window to obtain time sequence characteristics; and inputting the multi-level features into a fully-connected classifier to identify a human body falling result, and improving the identification precision by using the deep learning model.

title: Semi-supervised training scheme for speech recognition
description: A method (400) includes receiving a sequence of acoustic frames (104) extracted from unlabeled audio samples (303) corresponding to spoken utterances that are not paired with any corresponding transcriptions. The method also includes using a supervised audio encoder (212) to generate target high-order feature representations (214) of the corresponding acoustic frames. The method also includes enhancing the sequence of acoustic frames, and generating predicted high-order feature representations (218) of corresponding enhanced acoustic frames in the sequence of enhanced acoustic frames as output from an unsupervised audio encoder (216). The method also includes determining an unsupervised loss term (330) based on the target high-order feature representation and the predicted high-order feature representation, and updating parameters of a speech recognition model (200) based on the unsupervised loss term.

title: Method for monitoring sand and dust weather in whole day
description: The invention discloses a method for monitoring sand and dust weather throughout the day, which comprises the following steps of S1, calculating a sand and dust spectrum index, S2, extracting time sequence characteristics, S3, constructing a visibility inversion model, and S4, drawing sand and dust intensity. By coupling the two-way long-short-term memory network model, a model is built based on the time sequence characteristics, and the inversion of the sand and dust strength is realized, so that the effect of dynamically and accurately monitoring the sand and dust strength all the day is achieved. In the process, the limitation that the traditional spectrum index method and the machine learning method are difficult to fully utilize time sequence image information when inverting the sand and dust intensity is overcome, and the inversion accuracy of the sand and dust intensity in the whole day is obviously improved.

title: Target object distribution method, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of data processing technology, and in particular to a method for allocating target objects, an electronic device and a storage medium. The method comprises: screening out a number of target impact features according to historical data corresponding to each preset impact feature, constructing a time series data set and training a model based on the historical data corresponding to the number of target impact features and the corresponding number of target objects by a sliding window method, adjusting the prediction result interval according to the prediction result of each decision tree, inputting the data of each target impact feature of a target geographical area collected within a preset historical time period into a target random forest model, outputting the predicted number of target objects, obtaining the number of target objects allocated in the sub-geographical area according to the calculated area score of the sub-geographical area, and calculating the minimum allocation spacing of the target objects in the sub-geographical area; the present invention can effectively predict and allocate the reasonable capacity of the target object.

title: Multi-frame wide-area InSAR deformation result fusion method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing mapping, in particular to a multi-frame wide area InSAR deformation result fusion method, which aims at the problem of splicing multi-frame InSAR deformation under a large spatial scale, optimizes on the basis of a double-layer triangular network and a local extraction method, respectively splices the deformation storage characteristics of point and plane, converts LOS deformation of each frame of image into LOS deformation along the vertical direction, and then optimizes a genetic algorithm and PSO (particle swarm optimization) as an improved algorithm for matching point-like deformation data on the basis of a double-layer triangular network model so as to solve the many-to-one situation during matching. Under the condition of ensuring that the space position offset of the overlapping area is small, calculating the offset of the adjacent planar data by using an optimized local extraction method, and solving the deviation of adjacent deformation results in a large range. And finally, generating a wide area InSAR deformation product with consistent space reference and strong availability based on two optimization algorithms.

title: Multi-modal language model assisted class guide image segmentation method and system
description: The invention discloses a multi-modal language model assisted class guide image segmentation method and system, which relate to the technical field of image processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of respectively extracting original image characteristics and user interaction click characteristics of an image to be segmented through an image encoder and a prompt encoder; the method comprises the steps of encoding a true value mask by using a convolution network, performing cross attention fusion after splicing with original image features to generate mask image features, extracting original text features by using a text encoder, aligning the original text features with the mask image features based on contrast learning, inputting the aligned text features, original image features and interactive click features into a mask decoder, performing cross attention operation and normalized focus loss calculation, obtaining segmentation loss, and optimizing an overall training target. According to the method, through the normalized focus loss and the cross entropy loss function, the precise alignment of the regional visual mode and the text mode is ensured, and the accuracy and the comprehensiveness in the image segmentation task are remarkably improved.

title: A visualization method based on multi-source economic data mining
description: The present invention relates to the field of digital economic technology, and in particular to a visualization display method based on multi-source economic data mining. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining multi-source e-commerce economic data; performing data cleaning and standardization processing on the multi-source e-commerce economic data, and performing data quality assessment and screening to obtain standardized e-commerce economic data; performing multi-dimensional data dimensionality reduction analysis based on the standardized e-commerce economic data, and performing feature importance sorting to obtain key economic indicator data; performing time series analysis on the standardized e-commerce economic data based on the key economic indicator data, and predicting sales trends and user behaviors based on key economic indicators through a preset plurality of deep learning models to obtain trend prediction data. The present invention realizes the generation of explanatory data for the economic indicator relationship network in combination with the economic knowledge graph, and enhances the interpretability of data analysis.

title: An enterprise big data mining method and system based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention discloses an enterprise big data mining method and system based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out dynamic modal alignment by adopting a multi-modal hypergraph neural network according to enterprise multi-source heterogeneous data to generate multi-modal joint embedded tensors with consistent time and space, inputting the multi-modal joint embedded tensors into an orthogonal countermeasure manifold learning module to generate semantic embedded vectors with low-dimensional compactness and enhanced category separability, carrying out time-space causality mining on the semantic embedded vectors to output a time-space causality path map containing implicit business logic, inputting the time-space causality path map into a dynamic game countermeasure interpretation framework, and finally outputting an enterprise-level intelligent decision map with the robustness against facts. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, the multi-mode data can be efficiently integrated and intelligently analyzed, and the accuracy and the effectiveness of the mining result are improved.

title: Small sample-based prospecting prediction method, device, medium and equipment
