description: The invention discloses a small sample-based ore finding prediction method, a device, a medium and equipment, and relates to the technical field of mineral resource prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a data set of a region to be mined, wherein the data set comprises geological data, geophysical prospecting data, chemical prospecting data, remote sensing data and drilling data, obtaining any one of space positioning accuracy, mineral seed identification accuracy, resource quantity estimation accuracy and abnormal identification accuracy of a user, selecting a method associated with the time efficiency requirement or the accuracy requirement according to the time efficiency requirement or the accuracy requirement to construct a mineral exploration prediction model, and inputting the data in the data set into the mineral exploration prediction model to obtain a region with mineral products in the region to be mined. Through the scheme, the balance between accuracy and efficiency of the prospecting prediction can be realized according to actual demands.

title: Low-illumination target detection method and system based on impulse neural network
description: The application discloses a low-illumination target detection method and system based on a pulse neural network, which takes a pre-trained YOLO model as a main network, utilizes a feature coding self-adaptive method to extract features of an input image, converts a continuous feature diagram into a space-time pulse sequence, carries out coding optimization on the space-time pulse sequence to generate a space-time pulse sequence meeting the processing requirements of the pulse neural network, carries out target positioning and classification on the space-time pulse sequence meeting the processing requirements of the pulse neural network by using the pulse neural network through feature value normalization and Poisson process pulse generation and time dynamic coding optimization of the space-time characteristics of the pulse sequence, generates a target bounding box and a target class label of the target, improves the detection performance in a low-illumination environment by using an end-to-end training frame, jointly optimizes the YOLO main network and an SNN detection head by using a substitution gradient technology, minimizes a total loss function, solves the problem that an SNN pulse mechanism cannot be tiny, and realizes high-precision detection under a low-power consumption condition.

title: Indoor robot navigation method based on multi-mode feature fusion
description: The present application relates to an indoor robot navigation method based on multimodal feature fusion. The method includes: constructing a semantic map based on visual observation environment information; obtaining RGB images of indoor scene objects and converting them into point cloud data, and preprocessing the RGB images and point cloud data; extracting the image multi-layer semantic features and point cloud features in the RGB images and point cloud data respectively, and performing initial fusion; using space-channel-cross-modal multi-attention dynamic collaboration to weightedly fuse the image multi-layer semantic features and point cloud features; predicting the long-term goal in the top-down map space based on the fused feature map and the semantic map, and performing navigation path planning based on the current position and long-term goal. Under low-cost hardware configuration, the robustness of environmental perception in dynamic and complex environments, the real-time nature of decision response, and the ease of system integration are comprehensively improved, and it is particularly suitable for application scenarios such as indoor service robots.

title: DeepSeek-based engineering machinery lease management method and system
description: The invention discloses a DeepSeek-based engineering machinery lease management method and system, and relates to the technical field of intelligent lease management. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical lease time sequence data of a to-be-leased party, analyzing lease risk indexes of the to-be-leased party based on DeepSeek, obtaining lease requirement information of the to-be-leased party, comprehensively analyzing by combining a pre-trained requirement identification model to obtain lease requirement indexes of the to-be-leased party, obtaining functional state data of a plurality of devices in an inventory, analyzing the functional adaptability indexes of each device in the inventory, comprehensively analyzing the lease risk indexes and the lease requirement indexes of the to-be-leased party to obtain adaptation indexes of each device in the to-be-leased party and the inventory, and performing device lease management after the adaptation indexes are obtained, so that accurate matching judgment between the devices and the to-be-leased party is achieved, and accuracy and task adaptation of a device lease management process are remarkably improved.

title: Road defect detection method based on improved RT-DETR-R18 model
description: The invention discloses a road defect detection method based on an improved RT-DETR-R18 model, wherein a backbone network adopts CSPNet architecture. The original C2f module is innovatively improved, and Bottleneck of the original C2f module is replaced by DynamicIncMixerBlock to form a C2f_ DCMB module. DynamicIncMixerBlock merge DynamicInceptionMixer and ConvolutionalGLU modules. DynamicInceptionMixer adopts a dynamic Inception depth convolution structure, and adaptively captures the characteristics of different scales and directions through dynamic kernel weight distribution; the method is characterized in that intra-scale feature interaction (AIFI) in the efficient hybrid encoder is improved, the module is combined with EfficientAdditiveAttnetion and a feed-forward network structure to form TransformerEncoderLayer _ EfficientAdditiveAttnetion, a RepC3 module is replaced by a RetBlockC3 module in a cross-scale feature fusion module (CCFM) through a multi-head attention mechanism and a nonlinear activation function, retBlockC3 is improved based on RepC3, retBlock and RelPos d are introduced, and the method is remarkably superior to a traditional detection model in the aspects of accuracy, recall rate and detection speed of road defect detection, and provides a more accurate and efficient technical solution for maintenance and traffic safety guarantee of road infrastructure.

title: Acceleration method and device based on irregular sparse model, electronic equipment and medium
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses an acceleration method, an acceleration device, electronic equipment and a medium based on a random sparse model. The method comprises the steps of inputting a sparse model into a target compiler, splitting a sparse weight matrix of the sparse model into sparse sub-blocks in a layer intermediate representation to obtain a split sparse weight matrix, generating attribute information of each sparse sub-block in the split sparse weight matrix based on a sparse operator performance model, carrying out fusion processing on each sparse sub-block according to the attribute information of each sparse sub-block in the block layer intermediate representation, mapping each sparse block and a calculation unit according to the attribute information corresponding to each sparse block in the operator layer intermediate representation to obtain a mapping result, generating a processing task corresponding to the sparse model according to the mapping result, and executing the processing task. According to the embodiment, the end-to-end optimization is realized through multilayer optimization, and the profit boundary of the traditional irregular sparse acceleration design is broken through.

title: Rock breaking efficiency prediction method based on image recognition and machine learning
description: A rock breaking efficiency prediction method based on image recognition and machine learning, which obtains rock surface images, applies image processing technology to grayscale processing, and then performs pixel classification and image segmentation to clearly divide different minerals into several independent structural diagrams; models rock materials according to mineral components, and imports the boundary information of several structural diagrams into the model to generate several large-particle filling rock blocks of equal size to several structural diagrams, and calibrates the mesoscopic parameter values according to the mechanical properties of the rock; establishes a discrete element calculation model for rock breaking with a roller cutter, and conducts multiple intrusion rock breaking simulation tests on rock samples with different mineral contents; collects simulation results to construct a rock breaking efficiency data set; establishes a prediction model based on the PSO-BPNN algorithm, and obtains a rock breaking efficiency prediction model after training; and uses the established model to predict rock breaking efficiency in real time. This method can achieve efficient and accurate prediction of the rock breaking efficiency of the roller cutter by considering the influence of rock mineral composition on the rock breaking effect and combining the rock microscopic composition with the macroscopic rock breaking behavior.

title: Method for automatically searching and positioning target minerals by utilizing microscope
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of mineral resource exploration, and specifically relates to a method for automatically finding and locating target minerals using a microscope. A set of automatic target mineral search systems is established based on the Python language. Before the mineral search work is carried out, the target minerals are first found manually, and the target mineral range is accurately limited. The target mineral automatic search system is used to carry out machine learning and limitation of the transmitted light, orthogonal light, and reflected light petrographic image features of the target minerals in a targeted manner, and then the target minerals in the entire thin section are automatically identified, found, and located. If the microscope observation magnification is increased, more subtle minerals can be quickly and systematically identified, eliminating the time-consuming manual identification, and can also reduce the probability of error and neglect in the identification process. At the same time, the coordinate information of the target mineral can be systematically collected, and then translated into positioning coordinates that meet the actual situation of the experimental software through an algorithm, which greatly reduces the experimental time.

title: Image tag labeling method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiments of the present application provide a method and device for labeling an image, an electronic device, and a storage medium, which belong to the field of image processing technology. The method includes: obtaining a target image; performing entity recognition on the target image to obtain entity description text; based on the entity description text, performing image style extraction on the target image to obtain image style features of the target image; based on the image style features, performing image clustering on the target image to obtain clustering areas; obtaining entity description texts in the same clustering area to obtain target description texts, obtaining target images belonging to the same clustering area to obtain the current image; labeling the current image based on the target description text. The embodiments of the present application can improve the labeling accuracy of image labels.

title: Marketing method, system, equipment and medium based on user portrait
description: The invention discloses a marketing method, a system, equipment and a medium based on user portraits, which belong to the technical field of marketing and comprise the steps of obtaining behavior data of a plurality of users, carrying out preprocessing operation to obtain the preprocessed behavior data, carrying out attribute feature extraction and probability prediction based on a user attribute model, constructing user portraits of the plurality of users, carrying out grouping to obtain a plurality of user groups, constructing a knowledge graph, extracting to obtain high-order neighbor node features based on a graph algorithm, using a marketing scheme generation model to obtain a plurality of marketing schemes, inputting the knowledge graph and the plurality of marketing schemes into a recommendation model, and then selecting a marketing scheme corresponding to the highest recommendation degree to push the corresponding user. According to the invention, the multidimensional characteristics of the user are fully processed through the user attribute model, wherein the user portrait comprises a plurality of attribute characteristics, the problem of singleness of user portrait data is solved, and the marketing scheme with the highest recommendation degree is selected to be pushed to the client, so that the recommendation accuracy of the marketing scheme is greatly improved.

title: Photoelectric memristor based on covalent organic framework film and preparation and application thereof
description: The present invention belongs to the field of organic/polymer information storage technology, and specifically provides a photoelectric memristor based on a covalent organic framework film, and its preparation and application. By utilizing a photoelectric memristor based on a donor-redox covalent organic framework (COF, Covalent organic framework). The device structure is a classic sandwich structure, the bottom electrode is a glass substrate coated with ITO, and the active layer is a BTT-Cu  3  COF film. The prepared ITO/BTT-Cu  3  COF/ITO device has fast response and high energy efficiency, and can significantly achieve a higher refresh rate and recognition accuracy than traditional electronic devices. The high-frequency refresh capability ensures that rapidly changing information, such as motion trajectory or environmental changes, can be captured and processed in real time.

title: Binary digit encryption operation method based on DNA nano switch
description: The present invention discloses a binary digital encryption operation method based on a DNA nanoswitch; the present invention belongs to the field of information storage and encryption technology of biomolecular self-assembly materials. Based on the "protect first, deprotect later" strategy, the present invention prepares four basic numbers 1, 2, 4, and 8 through different circular DNA nanoswitches; secondly, the basic numbers are mixed according to the operation to be performed, and the operation encryption is triggered using RNase A endoribonuclease; finally, a connecting chain T is added to trigger the operation and the operation result is read by agarose gel electrophoresis technology; a simple, low-cost information storage and digital operation solution is provided. By combining the response characteristics of biomolecules with information encryption requirements, the DNA nanoswitch provides a solution for high-security, high-density, and biocompatible data protection, and provides a possible new path for low-energy, high-confidential biocomputers and precision medical operations; at the same time, the DNA nanoswitch is rewritable, and the present invention has strong scalability and may be applied to more complex information storage and logical operation scenarios in the future.

title: Three-dimensional parameterized model generation method and device based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention discloses a method and device for generating a three-dimensional parametric model based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises: receiving natural language description information input by a user to describe the design requirements of a mechanical component, and performing semantic parsing on the natural language description information to obtain structured requirement data; based on the structured requirement data, generating an initial form of the mechanical component using a deep generative model, and geometrically constructing the initial form to obtain a basic geometric body of the mechanical component; and performing structural optimization and manufacturing feasibility verification on the basic geometric body to generate a three-dimensional parametric model that meets the design requirements. The present invention solves the technical problem of low engineering accuracy of existing three-dimensional modeling technology when applied to mechanical components.

title: Linear slide rail defect identification prediction system with machine vision and big data fusion
description: The present invention relates to the field of industrial automation detection and intelligent operation and maintenance technology, and in particular to a linear slide rail defect recognition and prediction system that integrates machine vision and big data. The system comprises a machine vision acquisition module, a time series feature extraction module, a big data analysis platform, a defect prediction and decision-making module, etc. The machine vision acquisition module acquires slide rail images through a circular camera array and multi-angle light sources, and ensures acquisition quality through motion compensation. The time series feature extraction module utilizes a spatiotemporal attention model to mine defect features. The big data analysis platform associates multi-source data to construct a defect evolution map. The defect prediction and decision-making module outputs remaining life predictions and maintenance instructions based on dual-objective reinforcement learning, and the dynamic model update unit optimizes the model according to the error. The present invention achieves high-precision identification, forward-looking prediction, and intelligent decision-making of linear slide rail defects, effectively improving equipment reliability, reducing operation and maintenance costs, adapting to complex industrial environments, and having broad application value.

title: Dynamic protection method and system for Internet of vehicles data in federal learning process
description: The invention provides a dynamic protection method and a system for internet of vehicles data in the federal learning process, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a dynamic position set of vehicles; the method comprises the steps of building a digital model of the Internet of vehicles, training node models under the same vehicle according to a vehicle dynamic position set to obtain trained node models, carrying out differential privacy protection on first model parameters of the trained node models, uploading the first model parameters to corresponding road side units, carrying out differential privacy protection on second model parameters under all road side units, uploading the second model parameters to a server, enabling the server to carry out secondary aggregation on the second model parameters under all road side units to obtain second aggregation parameters, building a super-ellipsoidal equation, obtaining a target information set according to the super-ellipsoidal equation, and uploading the target information set of the target vehicle to carry out federal learning on an aggregation global model. The method and the system can improve the safety and reliability of the internet of vehicles data sharing.

title: A grain storage environment prediction method, prediction system and computer equipment based on optimized extreme learning machine
description: A grain storage environment prediction method based on an optimized extreme learning machine comprises the steps of obtaining grain bin environment information, generating input layer parameters according to the grain bin environment information, predicting the input layer parameters by using a pre-trained extreme learning machine to generate a prediction result, generating original parameters based on an input layer weight matrix and an implicit layer threshold vector of the extreme learning machine, performing iterative optimization on the original parameters serving as position information by using a dung beetle algorithm to obtain optimized parameters, wherein the optimized parameters comprise an optimized weight W and an optimized threshold b, and training the extreme learning machine according to the optimized parameters.

title: Image super-resolution reconstruction method based on multi-scale large kernel distillation attention network
description: This image super-resolution reconstruction method, based on a multi-scale large-kernel distilled attention network, belongs to the field of image processing technology and addresses the difficulty of existing methods in balancing computational cost, model complexity, and high-resolution image reconstruction quality. A low-resolution image is input into the multi-scale large-kernel distilled attention network for processing, outputting a high-resolution image. The multi-scale large-kernel distilled attention network comprises shallow feature extraction, deep feature extraction, and image reconstruction. After the low-resolution image is input into the shallow feature extraction process for feature extraction, it is divided into two low-resolution image paths. The first low-resolution image path is input into the deep feature extraction process for feature refinement and then subjected to a residual connection with the low-resolution image path after feature extraction from the second low-resolution image path. Finally, the input image is reconstructed to output a high-resolution image.

title: EDNA data dimension reducing method
description: The invention discloses an eDNA data dimension reduction method, which not only performs standardized processing on abundance data, but also translates and codes sequence data in a data preprocessing and feature extraction stage, and performs preliminary dimension reduction on sequence information through a self-encoder. The graph attention self-encoder is constructed, an abundance matrix, a sequence matrix after dimension reduction and an adjacency matrix constructed based on a K neighbor strategy are simultaneously input into the graph attention self-encoder, hidden relations among multi-source data are better captured in a potential space through a graph attention mechanism, and the potential relations among samples are explored and characterized, so that a more stable and clear low-dimensional representation is obtained.

title: Airplane group guarantee scheduling method based on discrete time Markov decision
description: The application discloses an airplane group guarantee scheduling method based on discrete time Markov decision, which relates to the field of airplane guarantee scheduling and comprises the steps of obtaining airplane group guarantee scheduling task data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a directed acyclic graph scheduling model based on airplane group guarantee scheduling task data, converting dependency relations among the airplane group guarantee scheduling task data into nodes and edges by the directed acyclic graph scheduling model, determining an airplane group guarantee scheduling scheme under the constraint of the edges based on the node sets and discrete time Markov decision models, and training a reinforcement learning network by the discrete time Markov decision models. The application can improve the efficiency and applicability of the airplane group guarantee scheduling.

title: Rail state evaluation method and device, electronic equipment and medium
description: The present invention provides a track condition assessment method, apparatus, electronic device, and medium. The method includes separately collecting monitoring data collected by sensors when a train passes through multiple spatially continuous measurement zones; the monitoring data includes signal sampling data collected by sensors in the multiple continuous measurement zones; extracting a first train passing signal from the monitoring data; the first train passing signal includes a second train passing signal corresponding to each sensor; converting the second train passing signals using a preset autocorrelation function so that the second train passing signals corresponding to each sensor are aligned; constructing a data set using the autocorrelation functions of the aligned second train passing signals; training a multi-channel track damage detection model based on the data set to obtain a trained track damage detection model; the input of the track damage detection model is the autocorrelation functions corresponding to the second train passing signals collected in a preset number of continuous measurement zones. The present invention can achieve robust health diagnosis of railway tracks.

title: Financial model selection method based on accuracy query
description: The invention discloses a financial model selection method based on accuracy query, which comprises an accuracy query interface construction step and a model training step based on the accuracy query interface. Firstly, constructing an accuracy query interface, namely enabling a financial data owner to perform basic processing on data, designing basic specifications of the interface, realizing accuracy calculation of a model conforming to the specifications on the data, and externally disclosing the input requirement of the model, then, enabling a model provider to train the model according to the public information of the interface and interaction with the interface, comprising initializing the model, obtaining feedback of the model on the data through the interface, calculating approximate gradients of an accuracy function of the model on a data set, continuously adjusting and optimizing the model through the approximate gradients, and the like. The process realizes that the model training party trains only by relying on the accuracy of the model on the data without touching the financial data, and enables the owner of the financial data to obtain the desired model on the premise of ensuring the safety of the data.

title: Self-adaptive image depth estimation method based on encoder-decoder architecture
description: An adaptive image depth estimation method based on encoder-decoder architecture converts depth estimation task into classification problem, divides depth range into fixed number and equal width intervals for processing, encodes image by pre-trained DenseNet encoder, and inputs encoding result into standard feature up-sampling decoder for decoding, thereby outputting decoded feature tensor And then decoding the characteristic tensor Inputting Mini-ViT model for processing to obtain depth predicted value of each pixel position By depth prediction And calculating the total loss of the image by the real depth value d  i , and further adjusting model parameters to perform model training. The invention not only can obtain the decoding characteristic tensor by encoding and decoding the image and effectively improve the accuracy of image depth estimation, but also can realize the depth estimation of the image with the highest resolution through the Mini-ViT model.

title: Ransomware automated collection and analysis method and system based on large language model
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for automated collection and analysis of ransomware based on a large language model in the field of network security technology. The method comprises constructing a target data source to collect a first sample of the ransomware, capturing the first sample actually triggered in an enterprise-level network environment and its contextual behavior data from the first sample; using an open source web crawler framework to build an automated crawler system to establish a real-time connection with a malicious code platform, analyzing the popularity of the first sample on the malicious code platform, and setting optimization tasks. By combining the natural language processing capabilities of the large language model with automation technology, the present invention achieves efficient capture, accurate analysis, and rapid response to samples. By implementing a countermeasure strategy for anti-virtualization detection, the method effectively responds to the anti-virtualization detection mechanism of the ransomware, thereby building an intelligent protection chain for network security.

title: Expert-guidance-based video streaming media bit rate self-adaption method and system
description: The application relates to the technical field of video streaming, in particular to a video streaming media bit rate self-adaption method and system based on expert guidance. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a mixed throughput track data set, training according to the data set to obtain an initial model, clustering the data set into subsets, training expert models on each subset, recording state-action decision pairs of each expert model, storing the pairs into an expert experience pool, generating a virtual video session, collecting state-action-rewards triples of each video segment in the transmission process, calculating accumulated rewards and dominant values, combining the state-action-rewards triples, the accumulated rewards, the dominant values and the state-action decision pairs of the expert models to form a training tuple, sampling the training tuple to synchronously optimize an Actor network and a Critic network, and obtaining a general ABR model. The application solves the problem of catastrophic forgetting of the ABR algorithm by a multi-expert guidance method, and improves the generalization capability and the self-adaptation performance of the model.

title: Mildew detection method and related device for peanut screening
description: The invention relates to the technical field of peanut mildew detection, in particular to a mildew detection method and a related device for peanut screening, which are implemented by acquiring image data and volatile gas data of peanuts to be detected; the method comprises the steps of inputting image data into a pre-trained peanut mildew feature extraction model to obtain peanut mildew features, determining peanut mildew initial tags, obtaining mildew comprehensive indexes according to the peanut mildew initial tags and volatile gas data, judging mildew grades of peanuts to be detected, and realizing mildew detection of peanut screening. According to the method, the mildew condition of the peanut to be detected is primarily judged through visual information, then the comprehensive mildew index is calculated through volatile gas data, the defect that aflatoxin pollution cannot be accurately identified through visual information is overcome, accurate detection of peanut kernels which do not show obvious mildew characteristics but are polluted by aflatoxin is achieved, and the problem that the reliability of peanut mildew detection results in the prior art is poor is solved.

title: Power data anomaly detection method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a power data anomaly detection method, apparatus, computer device, computer-readable storage medium, and computer program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining electric power data to be detected, inputting the electric power data to be detected into an isolated forest model to calculate average isolation depth of each data point in the electric power data to be detected in an isolated tree structure to obtain first abnormal data, inputting the electric power data to be detected into an automatic encoder to obtain second abnormal data, obtaining a first weight value corresponding to the first abnormal data and a second weight value corresponding to the second abnormal data, and determining an abnormal detection result according to the first weight value, the first abnormal data, the second weight value and the second abnormal data. By adopting the method, the power data anomaly detection accuracy can be improved.

title: 5GNR indoor positioning method, program, system and storage medium based on dynamic multi-image aggregation network
description: The invention discloses a 5G NR indoor positioning method, a program, a system and a storage medium based on a dynamic multi-graph aggregation network, and belongs to the field of deep learning. Through preprocessing the CSI data, a CSI graph structure is constructed, a spatial relationship is established in the CSI, feature aggregation is carried out by using a graph rolling network GCN, fusion of local and global features is carried out, feature extraction of the CSI graph is extracted, a CSI subgraph is dynamically aggregated, and position mapping is carried out, so that three-dimensional space coordinates are obtained. According to the invention, the data are represented as the graphic information by utilizing the multi-channel characteristic information and introducing the topological connection in the non-Euclidean space, so that the spatial relationship among different channels is more comprehensively analyzed, and a dynamic sub-graph aggregation mode is used, so that the positioning application with higher precision is finally realized.

title: Integrated disinfection monitoring management system based on quantitative risk assessment
description: The present invention provides an integrated disinfection monitoring and management system based on quantitative risk assessment, which belongs to the field of disinfection monitoring technology. It includes an environmental and behavioral parameter acquisition module, a bacterial growth risk analysis module, and a disinfection quality analysis module. The environmental and behavioral parameter acquisition module is used to construct a first data set, a second data set, and a third data set, and use a convolutional neural network to build a predictive risk model. Based on the first data set, the second data set, and the third data set, the environmental bacterial growth coefficient, bacterial transmission coefficient, and behavioral bacterial growth coefficient of the i-th region are respectively constructed. Combined with the environmental bacterial growth coefficient and behavioral bacterial growth coefficient of the i-th region, a comprehensive disinfection behavior coefficient is constructed, and an evaluation is performed to generate a corresponding strategy. Through multi-dimensional linkage, bacterial monitoring within the station is achieved, and an appropriate disinfection plan is adopted according to the degree of bacterial growth.

title: Household appliance shopping guide method, device and system and electronic equipment
description: The invention provides a home appliance shopping guide method, device and system and electronic equipment, and belongs to the field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining attribute information and an interest map of a target user according to transaction related behavior data of the target user on the target product, integrating attribute items, attribute information and the interest map of the purchased product to obtain integrated attributes of the purchased product, obtaining recommended products of each product category from products to be searched according to the integrated attributes of the purchased product, obtaining at least one product package recommendation scheme according to each recommended product, and feeding back the recommended products to a client of the target user. Therefore, the grouped product package recommendation scheme can be provided finally, and the transaction related behaviors, the attribute information and the interest patterns of the target user and the attribute items of the purchased products are considered, so that the final product package recommendation scheme can meet the market demand and meet the personalized demand of the user, the product is recommended to the client more accurately, and the user experience is improved.

title: Transmission line defect detection system and method based on sparse attention and double-cross attention
description: The invention relates to a transmission line defect detection system and method based on sparse attention and double cross attention, wherein the system comprises a transmission line defect semantic generation model, a visual extraction module, a text extraction module, a visual text fusion module and a semantic generation module are arranged in the transmission line defect semantic generation model; the method comprises the steps of carrying out fine tuning training for a pre-trained visual language model for multiple times by utilizing transmission line defect image-text pair data, constructing and obtaining a transmission line defect semantic generation model, inputting a current transmission line image into the transmission line defect semantic generation model, and outputting and obtaining a defect description text of the current transmission line, wherein the defect description text comprises the type, the position and the early warning information of the transmission line defect. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can realize accurate detection and semantic description of the defects of the power transmission line.

title: Wireless device and wireless communication method
description: The wireless device of the present invention is provided with a control unit which generates a frame including AIML data acquisition subfields, wherein the AIML data acquisition subfields instruct transmission of data to a station corresponding to artificial intelligence/machine learning, i.e., station corresponding to AI/ML, and a communication unit which transmits the generated frame.

title: Operation decision method, device, system and medium of operation detection robot
description: The application provides an operation decision method, device, system and medium of an operation inspection robot. The method comprises the steps of constructing a plurality of positive sample pairs and a plurality of negative sample pairs, training a cross-modal semantic alignment model based on the positive sample pairs and the negative sample pairs, carrying out semantic alignment on each positive sample pair by adopting the trained cross-modal semantic alignment model to obtain a knowledge vector with aligned semantics, storing the knowledge vector into a multi-modal operation detection knowledge base, carrying out semantic alignment on a job request text based on the cross-modal semantic alignment model in response to a job request text aiming at the operation detection robot to obtain a job request text vector with aligned semantics, searching a target knowledge vector similar to the job request text vector in the multi-modal operation detection knowledge base, and generating a job action instruction of the operation detection robot based on the target knowledge vector and the job request text. The embodiment of the application can improve the accuracy of the operation decision of the operation detection robot.

title: Boundary information-assisted semantic segmentation method for mobile intelligent agent
description: The invention discloses a boundary information-assisted semantic segmentation method for a mobile intelligent agent, which comprises the following steps of preprocessing a dataset, constructing a lightweight semantic segmentation model based on boundary information assistance, training a constructed network model, calculating a model parameter gradient according to a loss function, updating parameters through a AdamW optimizer, using the network model after updating the parameters for a next group of training samples, repeating the steps until the loss value of a network on a verification set tends to be stable, wherein the model is a model which is trained, inputting a test set into the network model which is trained in the step 3, and outputting a semantic segmentation graph and a boundary detection graph. The invention greatly reduces FLOPs, ensures the real-time performance of the model, optimizes the semantic segmentation head and the edge detection head, and keeps higher segmentation precision under the condition of reducing the parameter quantity.

title: Traffic information prediction method based on temporal graph convolutional network and attention mechanism
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent traffic, and particularly relates to a traffic information prediction method based on a time graph convolution network and an attention mechanism. Firstly, when data preprocessing is carried out, an adjacency-similarity algorithm is designed for the topological structure of an urban road network to process missing values and abnormal values in a data set, secondly, when a traffic information prediction model is constructed, a gating circulation unit and a graph convolution network are respectively used for capturing time correlation and space correlation of data, and in addition, a attention mechanism is added into the model to extract key information in input data, so that the model can better analyze a complex graph structure. By the method, the traffic information data in a period of time in the future can be predicted based on the historical data, and the method is helpful for research in the fields of intelligent traffic and the like.

title: Three-dimensional human body grid estimation method and system based on clothes scissors and human body vision model
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for estimating a three-dimensional human mesh based on clothing shears and a human visual model. The method comprises the following steps: extracting a first human image containing clothing from the image to be reconstructed; identifying the boundary between the clothing region and the body region in the first human image, removing the clothing region from the first human image, and obtaining a second human image; inputting the second human image into a three-dimensional human mesh estimation module, which is used to extract three key intermediate representations from the second human image: joint information, depth information, and contour information. Using an iterative optimization algorithm, the intermediate representation of the initially generated three-dimensional human mesh is aligned with the intermediate representation extracted from the second human image, minimizing the difference between the two, and ultimately outputting a high-precision three-dimensional human mesh. This invention can improve the algorithm's stability under complex clothing conditions and ensure the high fidelity of the reconstructed mesh.

title: Fusion encryption traffic classification method and system based on graph neural network
description: The present invention relates to the field of network traffic analysis technology, and more particularly to a method and system for fused encrypted traffic classification based on a graph neural network. The method comprises: standardizing the encrypted traffic data to be classified to construct a dataset; constructing a traffic interaction graph based on data packets and the communication relationships between data packets, and extracting statistical feature vectors; converting the encrypted traffic data into grayscale images, and extracting data feature vectors of the encrypted traffic from the grayscale images; concatenating the statistical feature vectors and data feature vectors to obtain a joint feature map, and classifying the joint feature map using a classifier. The present invention can improve accuracy while ensuring the integrity of the original traffic data.

title: Methods for training models, generating report outline information, and obtaining data report information
description: The present application provides a method for training a model, generating report outline information, and obtaining data report information, wherein the training method for a large language model includes: obtaining first question information and a first object data set targeted by the first question information; inputting the first question information and the first object data set into a first large language model to obtain first analysis result data generated by the first large language model based on preset report logic information; the first analysis result data includes first report outline information and first thinking process information for determining the first report outline information; using the first question information and the first analysis result data as training data, performing supervised fine-tuning training on a second large language model to obtain a data report planning model; the data report planning model is used to generate second report outline information based on second question information and a second object data set targeted by the second question information.

title: Homogeneity, heterogeneity and attribute signal decoupling representation learning scientific question answering method and system
description: The invention discloses a homogeneous heterogeneous and attribute signal decoupling representation learning science question-answering method and system, which belong to the field of visual question-answering and comprise the steps of obtaining initial embedding of texts and visual modes through an encoder, decoupling the embedding of each mode into homogeneous embedding and heterogeneous embedding by utilizing a first decoupling module, fusing to obtain initial representation of each mode, further decoupling the fused multi-mode embedding according to attribute signals of a problem by utilizing a second decoupling module, enhancing the embedding distinguishability under different attribute signals, fusing the decoupled representation with original information, and predicting answers by a decoder. The invention solves the problems of high entanglement of multi-modal information homogeneity and heterogeneity and high entanglement among various attribute signals in the existing scientific question-answering model.

title: Three-dimensional reconstruction method and electronic device
description: The embodiment of the application provides a three-dimensional reconstruction method and electronic equipment. In the process of three-dimensional reconstruction based on the 3D Gaussian sputtering technology, after determining the pixel characteristics of each target pixel in L images, when the three-dimensional point characteristics corresponding to each three-dimensional point are obtained based on the pixel characteristics of each target pixel, when the three-dimensional point characteristics corresponding to the three-dimensional point are obtained by fusing the pixel characteristics of the plurality of target pixels, the correlation between the shooting view angle direction and the target view angle direction of each target pixel is referred, and for the target pixel with the shooting view angle direction closer to the target view angle direction, the ratio of the pixel characteristics of the target pixel in the three-dimensional point characteristics of the three-dimensional point is larger. The three-dimensional point characteristics of the three-dimensional points obtained through fusion are more suitable for generating the 3D Gaussian ball attribute of each three-dimensional point in the target view angle direction, and the rendering quality when rendering is performed based on the 3D Gaussian ball attribute is further improved.

title: Steel tape surface defect detection method, system and readable storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a method, system and readable storage medium for detecting surface defects of a steel tape measure, wherein the method comprises: receiving a template image and an image to be inspected of the steel tape measure; obtaining an initial defect mask based on the template image and the image to be inspected; horizontally flipping the image to be inspected and combining it with the template image to obtain a flip mask; obtaining a defect mask based on the initial defect mask and the flip mask; and performing a connected domain analysis and grayscale contrast secondary verification based on the defect mask to output the defect detection position. The present invention extracts the difference features between the template image and the image to be inspected through a twin network structure, combines multi-scale segmentation with post-processing optimization, and can achieve high-precision defect positioning, significantly improve the detection rate of minor defects, and has low computational cost. Accuracy and efficiency can be balanced by sharing weights and subgraph cutting. In addition, complex interference is suppressed through flip fusion and secondary verification to improve robustness.

title: Method and device for determining concentration of particulate matters, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present application provides a method, device, electronic device, and storage medium for determining particulate matter concentration. The method includes: obtaining a voltage value, ambient temperature information, and ambient humidity information collected by a particle sensor; inputting the voltage value, ambient temperature information, and ambient humidity information into a pre-trained particulate matter concentration fitting model; performing nonlinear curve fitting on the voltage value, ambient temperature information, and ambient humidity information to predict the particulate matter concentration under the voltage value, ambient temperature information, and ambient humidity information; wherein the particulate matter concentration fitting model is obtained by iteratively training a BP neural network model. Using the particulate matter concentration fitting model, particulate matter concentration can be accurately and automatically predicted, and the stability of the prediction results can be guaranteed even when the ambient temperature information and ambient humidity information change drastically.

title: Service processing method, service processing system, vehicle and storage medium
description: This application provides a business processing method, business processing system, vehicle, and storage medium. The method relates to the vehicle field and includes: obtaining a user's business consultation request; determining at least two target task units corresponding to the business consultation request; invoking a target model in a preconfigured model via the at least two target task units to obtain a target response to the business consultation request; and outputting the target response. This method can improve business processing efficiency in vehicle business scenarios.

title: A monitoring method and system for inhalation therapy based on the Internet of Things
description: The present invention belongs to the field of medical monitoring technology. The present invention provides an inhalation therapy monitoring method and system based on the Internet of Things, including: collecting the inhalation flow value and breath-holding time of the patient's single treatment behavior through an intelligent flow rate monitoring device in a jet nebulizer, generating an inhalation and breath-holding time series, calculating a pseudo-compliance evaluation value to determine whether pseudo-compliance exists, and if so, analyzing the correlation between the two through a distance correlation coefficient. When correlated, an attention mechanism-residual network model is used to construct an influence capture model, output the influence coefficient and perform positive and negative coordination analysis. When positively coordinated, the atomization flow rate is adjusted based on the standard range and the influence coefficient. The present invention realizes the accurate evaluation of pseudo-compliance, improves the effectiveness and controllability of inhalation therapy through correlation analysis and parameter linkage optimization, is suitable for inhalation therapy equipment such as jet nebulizers, and helps to improve patient treatment compliance and clinical efficacy.

title: Service optimization method, device, equipment and storage medium based on multimodal data
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a business optimization method, a device, equipment and a storage medium based on multi-modal data, wherein the business optimization method comprises the steps of inputting user audio information into an audio emotion classification model to obtain a first emotion classification of a user, scoring emotion of each keyword corresponding to user text information based on a preset business emotion dictionary to obtain emotion scores of each keyword, weighting scores of alternative emotion classifications and emotion scores of keywords corresponding to alternative emotion classifications to obtain a second emotion classification with highest emotion scores in the weighted alternative emotion classifications, obtaining a final emotion classification of the user according to the first emotion classification and the second emotion classification of the user, and generating a business recommendation strategy for the user according to the final emotion classification of the user. The invention solves the technical problem that the service recommendation strategy cannot be customized for the user according to the actual emotion of the user in the prior art.

title: System and method for beam failure recovery using artificial intelligence and machine learning
description: Systems and methods for beam failure recovery using artificial intelligence and machine learning are disclosed. A system and method for performing BFR by a UE are disclosed. The method includes detecting beam failure of a beam used by a UE in a serving cell including one or more TRPs, measuring one or more beams included in a first candidate beam set, predicting a candidate beam from a second candidate beam set based on the measurement of the one or more beams included in the first candidate beam set, and performing BFR using the candidate beam.

title: Hard disk failure prediction method, lightweight prediction model construction method and electronic device
description: The application discloses a hard disk fault prediction method, a lightweight prediction model construction method and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of servers, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting sensing data sets of sensors corresponding to a plurality of hard disks, and preprocessing the sensing data sets; the method comprises the steps of constructing a time space structure, converting a preprocessed sensing data set into a multi-dimensional array, inputting the multi-dimensional array into a lightweight prediction model, obtaining prediction states corresponding to a plurality of hard disks through a convolution long-short-term memory network layer in the lightweight prediction model, processing the prediction states corresponding to the plurality of hard disks through the prediction layer in the lightweight prediction model, outputting fault prediction results of the plurality of hard disks, solving the technical problems of lack of edge autonomy and multi-parameter trend analysis capability, slow response to complex faults, untimely early warning and easy false alarm and omission, and achieving the technical effects of remarkably improving the advanced perceptibility and local autonomy level of a server system to the hard disk faults.

title: A wind power data privacy protection completion method based on federated learning
description: The invention provides a sequence-to-sequence wind power deficiency data complement method combining federal learning and an attention mechanism, which is called Fed-Attn-Seq2Seq. Firstly, taking the complete wind energy characteristic containing wind power as the input of a Atttn-Seq2Seq model of a local decoder-containing encoder architecture, integrating information in the encoding stage, extracting necessary information through a dynamic context vector of an attention mechanism during decoding, and gradually generating a complete wind power sequence. The federal learning framework collects and aggregates model parameters of network edge equipment at a central server instead of transmitting complete data, so that data privacy in the training process is effectively protected, communication cost is reduced, and the method has the advantages of being scientific and reasonable, high in applicability, good in effect and the like.

title: Generating time series using a diffusion TRANSFORMER neural network
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus for generating a time series of data elements conditioned on an input, including a computer program encoded on a computer storage medium. One of the methods includes obtaining the input, wherein the input comprises a noisy input comprising a plurality of latent representations of an output time series; updating each latent representation using a latent denoising neural network; and generating the output time series of data elements by processing the updated latent representations using a decoder neural network.

title: Fault diagnosis method for variable frequency drive motor of drilling machine based on IMSOA-MCNN-BIGRU
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of motor fault diagnosis, and in particular to a fault diagnosis method for a drill rig variable frequency drive motor based on IMSOA-MCNN-BIGRU, comprising collecting current data of an experimental platform motor and adding interference to simulate data of a real drill rig drive motor; improving the population initialization strategy of the SOA algorithm, introducing adversarial-reverse learning in the iterative process, and adding an adaptive worst-case resampling mechanism after stagnation monitoring; optimizing the convolution kernel size, hidden layer size, initial learning rate, and L2 regularization strength of the MCNN-BIGRU model based on IMSOA, reassigning the optimized parameters to the MCNN-BIGRU model to construct an IMSOA-MCNN-BIGRU classification model; and inputting the current data after adding interference into the IMSOA-MCNN-BIGRU classification model to obtain a diagnosis result. The present invention uses MCNN and BIGRU to combine and complement each other, improves the characterization capability of complex non-stationary signals and the fault discrimination accuracy, and optimizes the MCNN-BIGRU model using the improved Seagull optimization algorithm to improve the performance of the model.

title: Book resource matching method based on knowledge graph and book culture analysis
description: The invention discloses a book resource matching method based on knowledge graph and book culture analysis, which relates to the technical field of knowledge graph, and aims to establish a recommendation system based on knowledge graph and culture semantic analysis by constructing a two-dimensional adjustment mechanism fusing a book context coverage factor Ccf and a cluster offset index value Ksd, quantitatively evaluate a recommendation result through a book culture adaptation index Lmf, remarkably improve new user matching precision and culture coverage breadth, dynamically balance a matching structure of user preference and book theme vectors through semantic coverage adjustment and structure depolarization path reconstruction strategies, ensure multi-culture dimension coverage by using a book context coverage factor Ccf, optimize recommendation path diversity by means of the cluster offset index value Ksd, effectively solve the problems of single interest focus and resource concentration of a traditional system, realize content diversity and distribution balance, and construct sustainable-expansion recommendation ecology.

title: Natural language-assisted teacher gesture recognition method
description: The invention relates to a natural language-assisted teacher gesture recognition method, belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and aims to solve the problem of misjudgment caused by teaching context deficiency, intra-class difference interference and inter-class similarity confusion in teacher gesture recognition. According to the invention, video space features are extracted through a CLIP model, GPT-4o generates frame-level gesture text description, sentence-BERT codes text features, video and text features are spliced and fused, one-dimensional time convolution and GRU modeling short-term and long-term time dependence are adopted, a self-attention mechanism is adopted to integrate position information, and classification is realized based on semantic similarity calculation. The method has the technical effects of eliminating semantic ambiguity, enhancing the understanding capability of teaching contexts, fusing double-scale dynamic characteristics to promote action analysis comprehensiveness, reconstructing a classification decision mechanism to strengthen inter-class relationship modeling, and remarkably improving recognition robustness and accuracy.

title: Deep learning model multi-NPU end side one-key deployment system and method
description: The invention discloses a deep learning model multi-NPU end side one-key deployment system and a method, wherein the system comprises a front end interaction module, a service side control module, an end side execution module and a result integration module; pushing a file at the end side to a service side, starting an inference script to acquire an inference result and NPU performance data, and distributing a report at the receiving end of the user side to feed back to the user through a front end interface. The invention realizes the automatic model deployment on various NPU devices by integrating the front-end interaction module, the service side control module, the container environment management unit, the end side execution module and the result integration module. The one-stop automatic deployment is realized, the whole flow from front end configuration to end side execution and result analysis is performed without manual intervention, and the efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Quotation index data query method, system and terminal based on large language model
description: The present invention relates to a market index data query method, system, and terminal based on a large language model, and relates to the field of data processing technology. The method comprises: collecting query data input by a user; determining the query industry based on the query data; establishing a query model based on the query industry; identifying user intent based on the query data and inputting it into the query model to generate an answer to the user's needs; and outputting the answer to the user's needs. The present invention has the effect of improving the user's query experience for market index data.

title: Data association sensitivity analysis method and system based on graph attention network
description: The present invention relates to the field of data security, and specifically to a data association sensitivity analysis method and system based on a graph attention network. The method includes constructing a knowledge graph based on the features and relationships of multiple different types of data; stacking multiple layers of graph attention networks to obtain dependency weights of nodes in different ranges in the knowledge graph; obtaining the sensitivity of data combinations based on preset rules and association models between data, and feature encoding and classifying the data combinations based on the sensitivity to obtain categories of sensitivity risks under different data combinations; performing similarity aggregation on continuously increasing data and evaluating the uncertainty and sensitivity of data associations; comparing the sensitivity with the sensitivity threshold under the corresponding sensitivity risk category to achieve sensitivity analysis; the present application can accurately capture the complex association relationships of data, and compared with traditional methods, the sensitive association discovery rate is increased by 30% to 50%.

title: Intelligent diagnosis management system for full life cycle of fan equipment
description: The invention discloses a full life cycle intelligent diagnosis management system of fan equipment, which comprises a data acquisition and management module, an intelligent diagnosis and analysis module, a business process and operation and maintenance management module, an intelligent report management module, a user interaction module, an issue library and expert library module. The intelligent data collection system aims at not only efficiently collecting and managing data through optimizing the existing working flow, but also remarkably improving operation and maintenance efficiency through intelligent diagnosis and automatic business flow, reducing equipment downtime and lowering maintenance cost. Meanwhile, the system realizes the whole-flow optimization from data acquisition to fault processing, report generation and user interaction by constructing a targeted management system, and provides a more efficient, reliable and friendly solution for the whole-life cycle management of fan equipment.

title: Personalized clothing recommendation method, system and medium based on artificial intelligence
description: The present application provides a personalized clothing recommendation method, system, and medium based on artificial intelligence, belonging to the field of e-commerce technology. The method is based on a preset query data parsing module to determine query semantic information and attribute weight vectors corresponding to query data input by the user; wherein the preset query data parsing module at least includes a preset image encoder and a preset NLU module; the query semantic information at least includes query intent and query attribute parameters; based on the query semantic information, the attribute weight vector, and a pre-built attribute module set, corresponding attribute fusion feature information is determined; based on the attribute fusion feature information, a retrieval strategy from a user terminal, and a preset ANN algorithm, a number of corresponding candidate clothing images in a clothing image database are matched, and an image ranking sequence is generated using a preset re-ranking model; and based on the image ranking sequence, the corresponding recommended clothing image is sent to the user terminal.

title: Methods, apparatus, devices and storage media for acquiring embedded data
description: This application relates to a method, apparatus, device, and storage medium for acquiring embedded data. In this application, a promotional search command sent by a client is received. Based on the user identification information and item identification information in the promotional search command, corresponding target embedded data is obtained from an embedded data caching service container. This data is then used to generate inference results through a promotional search model deployed within an inference container and the target embedded data. Furthermore, the embedded data caching service container in this application is deployed on the physical machine where the inference container resides. The inference container can acquire the target embedded data through a shared memory mechanism. This method of acquiring embedded data through a shared memory mechanism reduces network overhead and latency caused by remote acquisition by the inference container, thereby improving the inference efficiency of the promotional search model.

title: A method and system for intelligent fault diagnosis of reactors based on magnetic field distribution characteristics
description: A reactor intelligent fault diagnosis method and system based on magnetic field distribution characteristics. Collecting magnetic field distribution data of multiple positions of a reactor, constructing a data sample containing magnetic field distribution characteristics of the reactor, extracting statistical characteristics and morphological characteristics from the data sample to form a characteristic sample, adjusting characteristic weights in the characteristic sample based on historical fault evolution tracks, constructing a graph structure, updating node characteristics by the characteristic weights, calculating attention coefficient correction side weights of adjacent nodes, training a fault diagnosis model of the reactor by the updated node characteristics and the side weights, collecting the magnetic field distribution data in real time, extracting real-time characteristic samples, adjusting the characteristic weights, and detecting and diagnosing real-time working conditions of the reactor by adopting the trained fault diagnosis model of the reactor. According to the application, by combining the multi-position magnetic field distribution data, the historical fault evolution track and the graph convolution neural network, the characteristic weight is dynamically adjusted in real time, so that the accuracy and the adaptability of the fault diagnosis of the reactor can be improved.

title: A method for calibrating the heat transfer coefficient in large tube sheet quenching simulation based on particle swarm optimization algorithm
description: A large-scale tube plate quenching simulation heat exchange coefficient calibration method based on a particle swarm optimization comprises the steps of collecting tube plate quenching data, building a particle swarm optimization model, building a tube plate quenching finite element simulation model, and updating the quenching heat exchange coefficient through the particle swarm optimization to obtain the heat exchange coefficient of a forging and air and the heat exchange coefficient of a forging and a medium. Based on a finite element simulation technology and based on deviation of time-temperature data simulation values and production values in the quenching process of all parts of the tube plate, the simulation heat exchange coefficient of the quenching of the large tube plate is calibrated, so that simulation prediction precision is improved, and the tube plate quenching numerical simulation can be ensured to effectively guide process optimization and actual production.

title: BIM-based digital building operation and maintenance collaborative management system
description: This invention discloses a BIM-based digital building operation and maintenance collaborative management system, belonging to the field of big data analysis technology. This invention reads structured data from the building equipment management section, analyzes and constructs associated datasets, merges and selects target sensors, integrates historical operational data in a time-series manner to construct a fault feature analysis set, further associates pre-fault operational data with historical maintenance data, performs feature analysis on the data, and predicts fault time through a neural network model. The sensor acquisition frequency setting module connected to its output calculates two types of acquisition frequency coefficients and weights and fuses them to dynamically adjust the acquisition frequency. Finally, the multi-sensor operation and maintenance monitoring module connected to the output of the sensor acquisition frequency setting module ensures stable operation of multiple sensors through sliding windows, threshold calculation, and anomaly early warning, realizing collaborative management of digital building operation and maintenance, improving data association accuracy, fault prediction reliability, and operation and maintenance stability.

title: Knowledge tracking method based on hybrid convolution
description: The invention relates to the technical field of knowledge tracking, in particular to a knowledge tracking method based on mixed convolution, which comprises the steps of obtaining interaction information of learners and educational content, inputting the interaction information into a preset knowledge tracking model, and predicting correct answer probability of a target object, wherein the knowledge tracking model is used for constructing an input sequence based on the interaction information, extracting behavior characteristics of different time ranges in the sequence by utilizing multi-scale causal convolution, modeling by combining an attention mechanism with a distance penalty item, and finally completing knowledge tracking by combining correct answer probability prediction of the target object. According to the invention, knowledge tracking is performed by combining multi-scale causal convolution and a distance attenuation attention mechanism, so that the modeling capability of the cognitive state of a learner is improved.

title: A Pixel-Level Semantic Segmentation-Based Intelligent Marking Method and System for Road Occupation Construction Violations
description: This invention discloses an intelligent annotation method for illegal road construction based on pixel-level semantic segmentation, comprising the following steps: S1: acquiring the original image of the road construction scene; S2: processing the acquired image based on a semantic segmentation network, wherein the semantic segmentation network includes a backbone network for feature extraction, a pyramid pooling module with multiple pooling sizes for capturing multi-scale contextual information, and a feature fusion layer; the feature fusion layer is used to fuse multi-level semantic information and output segmentation heatmaps of different construction elements; S3: performing boundary optimization on the segmentation heatmaps based on a conditional random field algorithm; S4: identifying and outputting composite violation scenes based on the segmentation results of multiple construction elements. This invention can solve the problems of high manual annotation costs, difficulty in multi-element collaborative identification, and insufficient identification accuracy in complex scenes in existing technologies.

title: A method for generating UAV control signals based on convolutional neural networks
description: This invention discloses a method for generating UAV control signals based on convolutional neural networks, belonging to the field of UAV communication technology. The method includes the following steps: S1: Collecting UAV communication signals and constructing a UAV communication signal dataset; S2: Constructing a UAV control signal generation network model, including a complex convolutional network, a feature extraction network with residual modules, and a spectrum signal adjustment network; S3: Using the UAV communication signal dataset, training the constructed UAV control signal generation network model with the optimization objective of minimizing the difference between the generated control UAV communication signal and the real UAV communication signal, until convergence; S4: Generating UAV control signals using the converged UAV control signal generation network model. This invention can learn the time-frequency domain patterns of UAVs based on historical UAV communication signals, resisting complex and unknown modulation methods of UAVs.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for preprocessing configured machine learning data set
description: This application discloses a configurable machine learning dataset preprocessing method, apparatus, device, and medium, relating to the field of machine learning technology. The method includes: verifying and parsing a dataset preprocessing configuration file, and replacing variable parameters in the configuration file to generate a directed graph representing the dependencies of the dataset preprocessing steps; calling a target main function based on the configuration file to load target plugin functions from a preset plugin algorithm pool; reading the target machine learning dataset corresponding to the configuration file from a preset hierarchical storage directory, and performing parallel preprocessing of the dataset according to the directed graph using a thread pool, and saving the preprocessing results to a directory; recording the execution status of each preprocessing step during the preprocessing process for breakpoint resumption, continuously tracking the processing progress of each file data to display the tracking results to the front end, and handling exceptions according to a preset exception handling strategy when they are detected.

title: Artificial intelligence chip pre-silicon verification system and method
description: The invention provides an artificial intelligent chip pre-silicon verification system and method, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligent chips and comprise a model importing layer, a model analyzing layer and an operator realizing layer, wherein the model importing layer is used for importing a current model, the model analyzing layer is used for analyzing the current model to obtain a calculation map, the distributed strategy configuring layer is used for configuring a distributed topology strategy of a hardware simulator of an artificial intelligent chip based on a distributed strategy of the current model and adjusting the calculation map of the current model to enable the calculation map to be matched with the distributed topology strategy, the performance predicting layer is used for determining the operation performance data of the current model on the artificial intelligent chip based on the operation performance data of each operator, or determining the performance predicting result of the current model on the artificial intelligent chip based on the performance predicting result of each operator, and the operator realizing layer is used for controlling each operator in the operation calculation map of the hardware simulator. The system and the method provided by the invention realize the end-to-end full-flow verification of the artificial intelligent chip from the input of the model to the output of the result.

title: Power load scene generation method and system integrating cross-season data
description: This application proposes a method and system for generating power load scenarios by fusing cross-seasonal data, belonging to the field of power load scenario generation technology.
