The method includes: determining the collection time window for the target area and collecting cross-seasonal time-series data for that area; parsing the cross-seasonal time-series data to perform non-standard seasonal division, obtaining multiple candidate seasonal intervals; performing rapid modeling based on mathematical models for the multiple candidate seasonal intervals to generate multiple candidate load scenarios; calculating the representativeness and coverage metrics of the candidate load scenarios and performing adaptive interval adjustments to output multiple specialized seasonal intervals; forming specialized power load scenarios and merging these specialized power load scenarios to output the target power load scenario. By fusing cross-seasonal data and performing adaptive seasonal interval adjustments, the representativeness and coverage of the power load scenarios are improved, thereby generating more accurate and comprehensive power load scenarios.

title: A system and process for preparing oxygen-free copper from recycled copper.
description: The application provides a system and a process for preparing oxygen-free copper from reclaimed copper, wherein the system comprises a smelting device, an oxidation device, a reduction device and a deslagging device, wherein the smelting device is used for melting pretreated reclaimed copper to obtain copper liquid, the oxidation device is provided with a first output end, the first output end is communicated with the interior of the smelting device and used for conveying oxygen to the interior of the smelting device through the first output end, the reduction device is provided with a plurality of second output ends, the plurality of second output ends are communicated with the interior of the smelting device through the bottom wall of the smelting device and used for conveying carbon monoxide to the interior of the smelting device through the second output ends, and the deslagging device is used for removing primary impurities and secondary impurities on the surface of the copper liquid. The application realizes the efficient removal of impurities.

title: Energy Document Generation Method and Equipment Based on RAG and Large Model Fusion
description: This invention relates to the fields of natural language processing and generative artificial intelligence, specifically to a method and device for generating energy documents based on the fusion of RAG (Research Aggregator) and a large model. The method includes: preprocessing the user's original materials to generate several first text blocks; verifying and correcting the parameters and contextual logic of each first text block based on a pre-built energy domain knowledge base to obtain second text blocks; inputting the energy topic, first prompt words, and all second text blocks into a fine-tuned large model to generate a preliminary document; extracting keywords from the preliminary document and, based on the extracted keywords, obtaining supplementary technical descriptions and constraints from the energy domain knowledge base; displaying the preliminary document, supplementary technical descriptions, and constraints through a human-computer interaction interface; and inputting the preliminary document, second prompt words, supplementary technical descriptions, and constraints into the fine-tuned large model to generate a final document. This invention improves the quality of the generated documents.

title: A Chinese text intelligent error correction method integrating spelling and semantics
description: The invention discloses a Chinese text intelligent error correction method integrating spelling and semantics, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining original candidate correction sets of all intelligent agents through parallel operation of all the intelligent agents according to original Chinese texts to be corrected and correction intention instructions, S2, processing the original candidate correction sets according to the correction intention instructions to obtain the score of each original candidate correction item, and S3, comparing the original candidate correction items with the comprehensive evaluation scores through a diversity optimization screening algorithm to determine a final candidate correction item set. According to the invention, the candidate correction set is generated in parallel by multiple agents and combined with the conflict resolution and multidimensional evaluation mechanism, so that not only can the accuracy of error correction be ensured, but also diversified expression selection can be provided, and the problems of single output and rigidness of the traditional error correction system are avoided.

title: Image segmentation method based on box cueing enhancement SK-VM++ network
description: This invention relates to the field of medical image processing technology, and particularly to a medical image segmentation method based on an SK-VM++ network with bounding box cue enhancement. The method includes: acquiring images to be segmented from a dataset; performing three-channel copying on the images; extracting lesion bounding box information from a text annotation file to generate a binary mask; generating a bounding box cue visualization using the binary bounding box cue mask; fusing the binary bounding box cue mask with the copied three-channel image to obtain a four-channel tensor; constructing an SK-VM++ model using the four-channel tensor as input; and performing segmentation processing using the SK-VM++ model. This invention addresses the problem that existing medical image segmentation methods struggle to accurately infer spatial context based solely on pixel intensity in low-contrast, high-noise environments, easily leading to false positives and false negatives.

title: License Plate Detection and Recognition Methods and Devices
description: The invention relates to the field of urban management, in particular to a license plate detection and recognition method and device, comprising the following steps of S1, MSCA_ YOLOv12 license plate target detection based on multi-scale convolution attention; S2, MSEE _ LPRNet license plate character recognition based on multi-scale edge enhancement, and S3, end-to-end license plate detection and recognition automatic processing. Compared with the prior art, the method can effectively solve the core problems of poor multi-scale adaptability, insufficient edge feature extraction and the like in the license plate recognition field for a long time, provides a high-efficiency and reliable technical support for applications such as intelligent traffic management, security monitoring and the like, and has wide commercial application prospect.

title: CNN-BiLSTM-based dynamic filling method for electric power measurement data
description: The invention provides a CNN-BiLSTM-based dynamic filling method for electric power measurement data, which is based on history synchronous similar data and adopts a convolutional neural network and a two-way long-short-term memory network to realize dynamic missing filling of data sent on a platform intelligent fusion terminal. The invention takes time sequence characteristics, history characteristics, relativity among data and other influencing factors of electric power measurement data into consideration, and constructs a data dynamic prediction model based on a CNN-BiLSTM network, wherein a convolutional neural network CNN is adopted to extract local characteristics of data, a two-way long-short-term memory network is adopted to learn time sequence characteristics, relativity and history characteristics of the measurement data, finally, based on a dynamic fusion strategy, the missing data is dynamically filled by combining the history characteristics and prediction results, and filling effect evaluation is carried out under different scenes. The method is simple, easy to implement, high in generalization capability and accuracy, and can adapt to scenes with high deletion rate and complex data.

title: Abnormal sound diagnosis software method and system based on actual use condition triggering
description: The invention relates to the technical field of abnormal sound diagnosis of working conditions, in particular to an abnormal sound diagnosis software method and system triggered on the basis of actual working conditions, comprising the following steps of obtaining an audio signal; the method comprises the steps of dividing an audio signal into a braking segment and a steering segment through a working condition mark and a time stamp corresponding to the audio signal, preprocessing the braking segment and the steering segment respectively, marking the braking segment with an abnormal braking type and marking the steering segment with an abnormal steering type respectively to obtain a trained CNN network model and a trained LSTM model, automatically transmitting a section of recorded test audio signal, a time stamp list and a working condition mark list by abnormal sound diagnosis software to evaluate the trained CNN network model and the trained LSTM model, and integrating the trained CNN network model and the trained LSTM model into abnormal sound diagnosis software to perform abnormal sound diagnosis triggered by actual use working conditions. The invention improves the accuracy of abnormal sound diagnosis of the working condition.

title: An adaptive adjustment intelligent vehicle window system based on environmental perception
description: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic digital data processing, in particular to a self-adaptive adjustment intelligent car window system based on environment awareness, which comprises a data acquisition module, a central processing module, a car window energy management module, a final control scheme decision module, a car window intelligent control module and a man-machine interaction module. According to the intelligent control system, the safety intelligent control of the system on the vehicle window is realized through the cooperative work of the data acquisition, the central processing, the vehicle window energy management, the final control scheme decision and the vehicle window intelligent control module, the battery electric quantity redundancy condition is switched, the intelligentization of battery power supply under different modes is improved, the stable operation of the battery is ensured, the use efficiency of the standby battery is improved through the selection of the standby battery mode, the energy source supply capacity of the system is improved, the influence of the battery electric quantity on the final control scheme is considered, the safety of the vehicle window control is improved, and the comfort of the personalized setting of man-machine interaction is improved through manual adjustment.

title: Fault prediction method and device for numerical control machine tool
description: This application discloses a fault prediction method and device for CNC machine tools. This application has the following advantages: it collects various types of data, including multi-source process parameter data and machining image data, comprehensively covering all aspects of CNC machine tool operation; innovative data preprocessing and feature extraction methods fully explore the value of the data, enabling more accurate description of the machine tool's operating status and improving fault prediction accuracy; a unique dynamic spatiotemporal attention network architecture adaptively focuses on key spatiotemporal features, capturing dynamic correlations between data and early, subtle signs of faults, resulting in more sensitive perception of fault characteristics and improved prediction performance; it fuses fault probabilities: by fusing two output probabilities, the result maintains stable prediction accuracy under different machine tools and operating conditions; and it provides multi-level early warning and decision support: multi-level fault early warning and detailed fault cause analysis reports and maintenance suggestions provide enterprises with comprehensive decision support, reducing production losses and maintenance costs.

title: Temperature model liquid production prediction interpretation model based on artificial intelligence algorithm
description: The invention is suitable for the technical field of oil production prediction, provides a temperature model liquid production prediction interpretation model based on an artificial intelligence algorithm, and aims to solve the problems that parameters of a traditional oil production prediction method are difficult to obtain, the efficiency is low and the artificial intelligence training time is long. The model optimizes the input weight and bias of ELM and reduces the influence of randomness by improving the initial temperature setting and the sectional cooling strategy of the simulated annealing algorithm, screens characteristic parameters (water yield, working fluid level, pump efficiency, temperature difference and water content) by combining with the Pearson correlation analysis, and adopts CTGAN to enhance data. The model obviously improves the prediction precision and efficiency of the liquid yield, and is suitable for the dynamic analysis of the oil field yield.

title: Pipeline abnormality detection method, storage medium and application
description: This invention belongs to the field of pipeline monitoring technology, specifically relating to pipeline anomaly detection methods, storage media, and applications. This invention proposes a pipeline anomaly detection method, including data preprocessing, model construction and training, and anomaly detection result output. First, pipeline operating status data is preprocessed to generate a spatiotemporal waterfall plot. Then, a multi-scale parallel cascaded early retreat network model is constructed. This model consists of multiple parallel branches and a decision module. Each branch contains multiple cascaded meta-detection modules, and each meta-detection module consists of a feature extractor, a feature flattener, a preliminary classifier, and a decision unit. The spatiotemporal waterfall plot data is input into the model for training, obtaining the final parameters of each module. Finally, the pipeline status data to be detected is input into the trained model, and the anomaly detection result is output.

title: Urban Cinnamomum camphora health monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle hyperspectrum
description: The invention discloses an urban Cinnamomum camphora health monitoring method based on unmanned aerial vehicle hyperspectrum, which relates to the technical field of ecological environment monitoring and comprises the following steps of firstly, acquiring Cinnamomum camphora canopy images of a monitored area by carrying a hyperspectral camera on an unmanned aerial vehicle; the method comprises the steps of collecting leaf samples of the camphor tree in a monitoring area, extracting spectral bands, vegetation indexes and texture features from hyperspectral images, matching the leaf samples with the field collected data space, generating synthetic samples by using a generated countermeasure network, amplifying the number of the samples, screening key feature combinations, constructing a gradient lifting regression health parameter estimation model, outputting a camphor tree health grading map of the monitoring area by using the gradient lifting regression health parameter estimation model, monitoring the health condition of the camphor tree in the whole area, and positioning abnormal plants. The urban camphor health monitoring method based on the unmanned aerial vehicle hyperspectrum is used for accurately, rapidly and nondestructively monitoring the health condition of the camphor tree.

title: Multi-scale hierarchical prototype learning-based few-sample relation classification method and system
description: This invention relates to the field of natural language processing technology, specifically disclosing a few-shot relation classification method and system based on multi-scale hierarchical prototype learning. The method includes constructing a few-shot relation classification task and generating a support set and a query set; encoding the support set samples, query set samples, and relation description information using a pre-trained language model to generate semantic vector representations; constructing a multi-scale hierarchical prototype representation through three levels: cross-set collaboration, intra-class collaboration, and inter-class collaboration; calculating the distance between the query sample and each type of prototype and outputting the classification probability using softmax; jointly optimizing the cross-entropy loss and distribution alignment loss; dynamically adjusting the contribution of each support sample to prototype construction by introducing an intra-class collaborative modeling mechanism; improving the model's ability to recognize fine-grained relations by introducing inter-class interaction modeling and relation description information; and significantly reducing the spatial offset between the prototype and the sample to be classified by introducing a distribution alignment module between the support set and the query set.

title: Intelligent interactive oral health monitoring method and system
description: The invention discloses an intelligent interactive oral health monitoring method and system, which relate to the technical field of oral health monitoring, and are characterized in that multi-dimensional oral health data of a user are collected, the oral health data are analyzed through a deep learning algorithm, tooth and gum conditions of the user are identified, oral health features are generated, the amount of deviation of health and risk urgency are calculated, an initial feature value is comprehensively generated, when the initial feature value meets preset conditions, a corresponding oral care task is automatically generated, a task form is generated by combining user interaction preference setting, the task form comprises a child animation plot task and an adult challenge task, after the task is completed, a second feature value is generated according to task quality parameters, and when the second feature value meets the preset conditions, layered rewards are generated according to different task forms. According to the invention, oral health monitoring is converted into immersive experience through multi-mode interaction design, and a dynamic task generation and personalized incentive mechanism is combined to guide a user to actively participate and form long-term habits.

title: A security management method and system for smart parks, and storage media
description: The invention provides a security management method, a security management system and a storage medium for an intelligent park, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring abnormal behaviors of personnel based on multi-source data, and carrying out abnormal behavior type identification and risk grade assessment; the method comprises the steps of positioning abnormal behavior personnel with high risk level and tracking a real-time track across a video camera, predicting all potential escape paths of the abnormal behavior personnel with high risk level by adopting a graph neural network, selecting an optimal escape path from the potential escape paths, identifying a high risk area in a park based on the optimal escape path and a risk thermodynamic diagram, deploying security measures on the high risk area, judging whether the optimal escape path passes through a sensitive area, and triggering an early warning signal if the optimal escape path passes through the sensitive area. The intelligent control system and the intelligent control method realize the full-chain intelligent prevention and control of the park abnormal behavior event, and remarkably improve the intelligent level and response efficiency of the park security system.

title: Downstream data measuring and calculating method, device, medium and product
description: The invention discloses a downstream data measuring and calculating method, equipment, media and products, and relates to the fields of artificial intelligence and financial science and technology. The method comprises the steps of obtaining measurement voucher information of a target service of an upstream and downstream combined service, carrying out structural pretreatment on the measurement voucher information, inputting the structural pretreatment to a pre-trained downstream data measurement model, and predicting downstream data of the target service when the upstream data are unknown. The method realizes the unified management of the structuring of various measuring and calculating elements, optimizes and upgrades the model through a genetic algorithm, so that the model can adapt to the difference and the demand change of business regulations under different scenes, improves the prediction precision, reduces the error, provides accurate downstream data evaluation support for upstream units, reduces the information interaction times between the upstream units and the downstream units, simplifies the handling flow of upstream and downstream combined business, and improves the handling efficiency.

title: Target tracking method and system based on track perception
description: The invention discloses a target tracking method and a system based on track perception, and relates to the technical field of computer vision, wherein the method comprises the steps of dynamically fusing historical frame characteristics by constructing PatchBlender a hybrid matrix generator, combining a two-dimensional video characteristic extraction network consisting of a PatchBlender smooth layer and ViT Transformer to obtain a preliminary historical representation of target motion, further introducing a three-dimensional space-time diagram attention mechanism to model the time-space relationship of the historical characteristics, updating to obtain more discriminative track perception characteristics, fusing the characteristics with search frame characteristics, and realizing high-precision target positioning and bounding box regression through a prediction head network. According to the invention, through PatchBlender mixed matrix generator, patchBlender Transformer feature extraction network and three-dimensional space-time diagram attention mechanism, efficient modeling and accurate tracking of the target motion track are realized.

title: Method and system for determining wireless network transmission parameters
description: This specification provides a method and system for adjusting wireless network parameters. The method includes: acquiring the current wireless network parameters and environmental characteristics of the target location, wherein the wireless network parameters refer to the transmission parameters of a wireless router transmitting the wireless network; determining the wireless network demand in the target location based on the environmental characteristics; generating at least one candidate adjustment value based on the wireless network demand; determining the estimated experience quality of connected users at a future time using an experience quality prediction model; determining an evaluation value of the at least one candidate adjustment value through weighted calculation based on the estimated number of connected users at a future time and the estimated experience quality of connected users at a future time; and determining a target adjustment value from the at least one candidate adjustment value based on the evaluation value.

title: Industrial system
description: The present application relates to determining measures to improve the operation of industrial systems. Reference data indicative of one or more states of the industrial system is obtained and a determination is made as to whether the reference data is biased. If a deviation exists, an effect of the deviation on the industrial system is evaluated, and one or more mitigation control measures are selected from a plurality of predetermined control measures based on the evaluated effect of the deviation. The method includes outputting, to a user interface, a characterization of an effect of performing one or more mitigation control measures, such that a user of the user interface is able to select to initiate an operation to perform the one or more mitigation control measures to change one or more processes of the industrial system.

title: A Hand Movement Recognition Method Based on Feature Collaborative Optimization of Surface Electromyography Signals
description: This invention discloses a hand movement recognition method based on feature co-optimization of surface electromyography (SEMG) signals, comprising: acquiring SEMG signals; preprocessing the SEMG signals to obtain a clean SEMG signal sample set; extracting multi-domain statistical features from the clean SEMG signal samples and normalizing the multi-domain statistical features to obtain a multi-dimensional feature set; co-optimizing the multi-dimensional feature set through a two-stage feature feedback method to obtain an optimal feature subset; wherein the two-stage feature feedback method includes a feature weight selection method and a feature structure feedback correction method; and inputting the optimal feature subset into a machine learning classification algorithm for hand movement recognition to obtain the recognition result.

title: Non-supervision anomaly detection and feature reconstruction network training method based on prototype guidance
description: A prototype-guided unsupervised anomaly detection and feature reconstruction network training method involves inputting the test sample into a feature extraction module to obtain an n-layer feature map b  <sub>i</sub>  ; obtaining a prototype instance; inputting the n-layer feature map b  <sub>i</sub>  and the prototype instance into a feature reconstruction module, where the prototype instance guides the n-layer feature map b  <sub>i</sub>  for feature reconstruction, resulting in a comprehensive feature map B and a reconstructed feature map C for the test sample, thus obtaining an anomaly segmentation map of the test sample; and obtaining the anomaly detection result of the test sample based on the obtained anomaly segmentation map. By guiding the multi-layer feature map of the test sample for feature reconstruction using a prototype instance representing a normal sample, and based on the reconstruction error between the reconstructed feature map and the comprehensive feature map, pixel-level accurate segmentation of the abnormal region is achieved, significantly improving detection accuracy. Anomaly detection is performed using a feature reconstruction network with the prototype encoding module removed, resulting in faster inference speed and stronger real-time performance, thereby improving detection efficiency.

title: Design network training method, design method and system for sheet acoustic metamaterial
description: The application discloses a design network training method, a design method, a system, equipment, a medium and a product of a thin-plate type acoustic metamaterial, and relates to the technical field of acoustic metamaterial design, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of thin-plate type acoustic metamaterial structures, wherein mass blocks of the thin-plate type acoustic metamaterial structures are randomly distributed; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing each thin-plate type acoustic metamaterial structure to obtain a sample data set, wherein the sample data set comprises mass distribution pixel images and sound transmission loss curves corresponding to each thin-plate type acoustic metamaterial structure, and training a bidirectional neural network model based on the sample data set to obtain a forward prediction network and a reverse design network. The application can rapidly predict the acoustic transmission loss curve and efficiently generate the matched mass block distribution structure, thereby remarkably improving the design efficiency.

title: A medical voice recognition system
description: This invention provides a medical speech recognition system, belonging to the field of medical speech recognition technology, comprising: an acoustic feature extraction module, an improved Transformer model, and a fusion inference module; the improved Transformer model employs rotational positional encoding multi-head attention to model the relative temporal relationships between frames in high-level acoustic features to capture long-range global acoustic context information; a convolutional module is introduced to integrate local acoustic features and structured details on top of the global acoustic context information to obtain enhanced acoustic features; this invention uses rotational positional encoding multi-head attention instead of traditional absolute positional encoding, enabling the model to better perceive and utilize the relative temporal relationships between speech frames, and is more adaptable to the essential characteristics of speech signals. At the same time, the introduction of a convolutional module in the encoder enhances the model's ability to extract and model local acoustic features of speech signals, making up for the shortcomings of the standard self-attention mechanism.

title: A non-destructive method for detecting veterinary drug residues in eggs
description: The invention provides a nondestructive testing method for veterinary drug residues of eggs, and belongs to the technical field of nondestructive testing. Measuring a veterinary drug molecular characteristic wave band spectrum, determining a molecular structure and a functional group of a veterinary drug specimen corresponding to each spectrum data peak value interval, establishing an initial veterinary drug molecular characteristic wave band spectrum library, constructing an egg veterinary drug residue nondestructive testing model, selecting a training egg sample, training the egg veterinary drug residue nondestructive testing model based on the initial veterinary drug molecular characteristic wave band spectrum library, and adopting the trained egg veterinary drug residue nondestructive testing model to detect veterinary drug residues of eggs to be detected.

title: A method, apparatus, device, medium, and product for finite-state intelligent agent behavior decision-making.
description: The invention discloses a finite state agent behavior decision method, a finite state agent behavior decision device, finite state agent behavior decision equipment, finite state agent behavior decision medium and finite state agent behavior decision products. The method comprises the steps of obtaining system related information, constructing a system Action Graph according to the system related information, wherein the Action Graph comprises nodes and edges, constructing a logic mapping set according to the Action Graph, wherein the logic mapping set comprises an initial function set, an operation set and a dependency relationship between functions and operations, and determining an initial decision according to the logic mapping set, the Action Graph and task description information, wherein the initial decision comprises at least one of task identification, an operation sequence, data dependency constraint and cost evaluation indexes, and through the technical scheme of the invention, an end-to-end automatic flow suitable for an intelligent body can be constructed, so that full-flow automatic processing of task description from natural language to task execution is realized.

title: Cross-border business intelligent interaction method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The application discloses a cross-border business intelligent interaction method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of cross-border business; the method comprises the steps of analyzing cross-border service request information through a multi-level intention recognition mechanism to obtain a service intention type corresponding to the cross-border service request information, determining a corresponding cross-border service processing module according to the service intention type, wherein the cross-border service processing module comprises at least one of a service question-answering module, a deposit price inquiring module, a foreign exchange inquiring module and a shortcut tool calling module, and executing corresponding service processing operation on the cross-border service request information through the cross-border service processing module to generate a service processing result fed back to a user. The application reduces the user operation path and the learning cost of novice users by integrating the cross-border business function, improves the intention recognition precision by means of a multi-level intention recognition mechanism, improves the accuracy of business processing results and improves the cross-border business processing efficiency.

title: Community self-service electricity consumption verification method and system
description: This application discloses a community self-service electricity consumption verification method and system. The method includes: residents, after scanning a QR code and binding their household number via a mobile terminal and verifying their identity, retrieve a pluggable smart analysis unit from a community self-service locker. This unit is used to connect to a household socket and electrical appliances. The unit collects voltage, current, and other data through a high-precision chip to generate sub-item time-series data, which is then networked via PLC-IoT and synchronized with a dual-mechanism clock of a smart energy meter. The cloud uses an adaptive multi-scale alignment algorithm to compare the sub-item and overall electricity consumption data, generating an error vector and consistency rate, and generating a location marker when an anomaly occurs. An improved graph convolutional neural network decomposes the load and diagnoses the cause of errors. An embedded large model guides the operation and explains deviations. When the error exceeds the limit, a work order is automatically generated and pushed to the power supply company, tracking the process to a closed loop. The system includes modules for self-service retrieval and electricity consumption collection, with encrypted data transmission. The equipment has self-diagnosis capabilities, achieving self-service, accurate, and closed-loop electricity consumption verification.

title: Data processing method, server and client device
description: This application discloses a data processing method, a server, and a client device. The server obtains a reference text sequence and a candidate text sequence to be verified. The candidate text sequence is a text sequence inferred by the client based on the reference text sequence using a first model. The candidate text sequence includes at least one candidate word. The reference text sequence includes prompts for the inference task and words verified by the server. A second model is invoked to process the reference text sequence and the candidate text sequence, obtaining a comprehensive probability distribution output by the second model. The comprehensive probability distribution includes the probability distribution of the position of each candidate word in the candidate text sequence within the vocabulary. The parameter magnitude of the second model is greater than that of the first model. Based on the probability distribution corresponding to each candidate word in the candidate text sequence, a corrected candidate text sequence is determined. The corrected candidate text sequence is returned to the client as a verified reference text sequence.

title: Computer architecture and method for modifying data input parameters based on predictive models
description: The present invention provides computer architecture and software configured to modify data entry operations in an asset monitoring system based on a predictive model. In accordance with the present invention, an asset monitoring system outputs an indication of whether at least one event in a group of events (eg, a failure event) may occur on a given asset within a given period in the future The prediction model to be executed can be executed. Based on the output of this predictive model, the asset monitoring system can determine either the storage location for the captured data, the set of data variables from the captured asset, the rate at which the data is captured from the asset, or any combination thereof. Such that one or more operational parameters for capturing data from a given asset can be modified.

title: image processing system
description: The invention provides an image processing system capable of improving the determination accuracy even if a low-function device is configured on site. An image processing system determines at least one object using a low-function device and a high-function device having higher calculation capability than the low-function device. The low-function device includes: a unit that outputs a first determination result for identifying an object by applying a first convolutional neural network to a captured image of the object; and a unit that outputs the captured image to the high-function device if the first determination result meets a prescribed condition. The high-performance device includes a unit that outputs a second determination result for identifying the object by applying a second convolutional neural network to the captured image, the second convolutional neural network being learned in advance using a sample at least a part of which is common to the first convolutional neural network.

title: Emotion classification method based on deep forest and transfer learning
description: The invention provides an emotion classification method based on deep forest and transfer learning, which comprises the steps of firstly, selecting a source domain data set and a training target domain data set; training the source domain data set by using a deep convolutional neural network to obtain and store a trained feature extraction model; preprocessing training target domain data, wherein the preprocessing comprises channel conversion and size cutting; performing feature extraction on the preprocessed training target domain data set by using the feature extraction model to obtain sample features; taking the sample characteristics as the input of a deep forest classification model, and training the deep forest classification model; after the training of the deep forest model classification model is completed, classifying the face emotion images which need to be processed actually by using the trained deep forest classification model to obtain the classification results of the face emotion images. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the classification efficiency is improved, and the classification cost and the demand on training samples are reduced.

title: Image description generation method based on architecture phrase constraint vector and double vision attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses an image description generation method based on an architecture phrase constraint vector and a double vision attention mechanism, which obtains a semantic model for automatically describing image visual content information by training images described by massive labeled texts, and comprises the following three parts: an architecture phrase generation model, a dual visual attention mechanism and a constraint language model. And the text description can be automatically generated for any input test image. The invention can effectively establish the connection between words and images in text description and has good expression on the description between the obvious objects or scenes of the images based on semantics.

title: Large-model-fused human-in-loop Text2SQL iterative data labeling method
description: The invention provides a large-model-fused human loop Text2SQL iterative data labeling method, which comprises the steps of firstly training and fine tuning a generated model by utilizing a pre-constructed manual labeling training sample, then conducting homosemantic diversified expansion on the training sample by utilizing an expansion model, inputting a plurality of expansion training samples into the generated model to obtain first SQL query sentences, conducting reward and punishment assignment on model parameters of the expansion model according to expert analysis results and reinforcement learning mechanisms aiming at each first SQL query sentence to determine target training samples, then conducting manual labeling on the target training samples, conducting incremental training on the generated model by utilizing manual labeling results to obtain a second SQL query sentence, and circularly conducting manual labeling on the target training samples when verification results of the second SQL query sentence indicate that query expectations are not met, until verification results meet the query expectations. The efficiency of data annotation is improved through man-machine cooperation and reinforcement learning.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent scheduling method and system based on knowledge-driven meta learning device
description: This invention discloses a method and system for intelligent scheduling of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) based on a knowledge-driven meta-learning device. Specifically, the method comprises: deploying and initializing a knowledge-driven meta-learning device, including meta-training and target retraining modules; the meta-training module determines the meta-learning objectives of the UAV intelligent scheduling model and optimizes meta-parameters, performing weight estimation through linear regression and measuring the similarity between different feature representations through a similarity metric; constructing a meta-task environment covering multiple tasks to learn cross-task update rules, using feature domain basis matrices to form orthogonal multi-domain feature representations; introducing a physical guidance term into the meta-learning loss function to align the output with physical laws and optimize the meta-learning objective function; and the target retraining module performs self-training using unlabeled data, updating the parameter set to obtain the final model, and directing and optimizing the collaborative operation of multiple UAVs. This invention can rapidly optimize the performance of the UAV intelligent scheduling model even when data is scarce.

title: Intelligent planning method and system for wire cutting machine cutting path based on image processing
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and discloses an intelligent planning method and system for a cutting path of a wire cutting machine based on image processing. The method comprises the steps of collecting and preprocessing multi-angle images of a workpiece to be machined to obtain a workpiece feature map, inputting the workpiece feature map into a sensing area identification network to process the workpiece feature map to obtain a target machining area identification map, carrying out feature enhancement on the target machining area identification map to obtain an enhanced feature map and an importance weight map, carrying out cutting path planning according to the enhanced feature map and the importance weight map to obtain an initial cutting path, and carrying out multi-objective optimization on the initial cutting path to obtain a target cutting path and a corresponding electric spark parameter configuration table. The invention realizes the cooperative optimization of the cutting path and the electric spark parameters, balances the contradiction among the machining precision, the machining time and the energy consumption, and ensures that the system can achieve the optimal process matching on workpieces with different materials and geometric complexity.

title: Method, device and energy storage system for predicting maximum available capacity of battery cell
description: The application provides a method, a device and an energy storage system for predicting the maximum available capacity of a battery cell, and relates to the technical field of batteries; the method comprises the steps of inputting first preset fragment data and a plurality of first fragment data into a preset model for first voltage prediction to obtain a plurality of first predicted voltage sequence data, stopping the prediction when the predicted voltage corresponding to the first predicted voltage sequence data reaches a first cut-off voltage to obtain first moment and target fragment data, inputting second preset fragment data and a plurality of first fragment data starting from the target fragment data into the preset model for second voltage prediction to obtain a plurality of second predicted voltage sequence data, stopping the prediction when the voltage corresponding to the second predicted voltage sequence data reaches a second cut-off voltage to obtain second moment, and generating the predicted maximum available capacity of the battery core according to standard working condition information of battery core discharge, the first moment and the second moment.

title: Judicial document analysis method and system based on big data
description: The present invention relates to the field of text processing technology, and in particular to a judicial document analysis method and system based on big data. Starting from word vector data, a preset classification model is used to output word thermal data, and the correlation between word segments and word categories is quantitatively displayed in the form of thermal values, so as to accurately locate the word segments related to each word category in the target judicial document, and then determine the central word, central sentence and keyword in a progressive manner, thereby providing a rich and comprehensive data basis for subsequent quality analysis, improving the accuracy of the quality analysis report, and being able to effectively filter out irrelevant text information in the target judicial document during the keyword extraction process, so that the subsequent data extraction and analysis focus on the core content of the target judicial document, reducing the resources occupied by the large language model in the calculation and reasoning process, and improving the efficiency of the quality analysis process.

title: Performance evaluation method, system and medium for open type high-flexibility energy interconnection system
description: The present invention provides an open high-flexibility energy interconnection system performance evaluation method, system and medium, which belongs to the field of energy interconnection system technology, including: based on the original parameters of the energy interconnection system and the performance indicators of the open high-flexibility energy interconnection system, determining the performance evaluation results and building a training set; building an LSTM model, determining the number of hidden layer nodes k and the learning rate of the LSTM model;   , Dropout rate   The LSTM model's evaluation accuracy on the 5-fold cross-validation training set is used as the objective function to calculate the fitness value. The optimized parameters are then optimized using an improved snake optimization algorithm to obtain the optimal LSTM model parameters. An LSTM model based on these optimal LSTM model parameters is then constructed to evaluate the performance of energy interconnection systems. This method can effectively improve the accuracy of performance evaluation of open, highly flexible energy interconnection systems, achieving ideal evaluation results.

title: End-to-end turbulence suppression data set augmentation method based on diffusion model
description: The invention provides an end-to-end turbulence suppression data set augmentation method based on a diffusion model, which is used for solving the technical problems of large calculated amount, long calculated time or poor visual effect on a clear truth image of the existing method for accurately characterizing the space-time correlation of a turbulence degradation process or the generated high-frequency and low-frequency information of a phase screen. According to the end-to-end turbulence suppression data set augmentation method based on the diffusion model, the diffusion model is used for directly generating the turbulence degradation image under the new turbulence degradation condition diagram from the clear image, so that the end-to-end turbulence suppression data set augmentation is realized, a large-scale, high-quality and infinite near-actual observed image sample can be provided for a data-driven turbulence degradation image restoration algorithm, the simulation of the complicated atmospheric turbulence condition is realized, and the observation capability of the foundation large-caliber optical telescope is further improved.

title: Reservoir emergency plan large language model examination method integrating knowledge graphs
description: The present invention relates to the field of natural language processing technology, and specifically to a large language model review method for reservoir emergency plans that integrates knowledge graphs. The method obtains the reservoir emergency plan to be reviewed and performs data structured processing; utilizes a first neural network model combined with a multi-scale context perception mechanism to comprehensively capture local and global semantic information and construct a knowledge graph representation of the reservoir emergency plan text; utilizes a second neural network model to process graphical information and construct a multimodal knowledge graph for the reservoir emergency plan; simultaneously, uses contrastive learning to fine-tune the open source large language model of the Transformer architecture to construct a dedicated large language model for reservoir emergency plans, and realizes the complementary enhancement of the semantic embedding of the language model and the structural representation of the knowledge graph through a two-way reinforcement mechanism. Finally, the multimodal knowledge graph is embedded into the fine-tuned large language model in combination with the graph attention mechanism for comprehensive review, and a review report is generated.

title: Remote fault early warning system and method for transformer substation based on deep learning
description: The present invention discloses a substation remote fault warning system and method based on deep learning, comprising the following steps: obtaining a standardized substation operation data set; constructing an improved variational autoencoder model; obtaining an optimized improved variational autoencoder model; using the optimized improved variational autoencoder model to perform multiple rounds of training on the standardized substation operation data set to form a highly sensitive and highly accurate anomaly detection model; collecting substation operation data in real time and inputting it into the anomaly detection model, analyzing the substation operation data in real time, and detecting anomaly patterns that deviate significantly from the normal substation operation state; when the anomaly detection model detects an anomaly pattern, the system automatically triggers a remote fault warning. The present invention further identifies typical patterns of temperature rise anomaly, voltage fluctuation anomaly, equipment degradation trend anomaly, and sudden composite anomaly based on the degree of deviation of the reconstruction error, thereby enhancing the interpretability and guidance of the warning.

title: Automatic synthesis method and device for RAG system evaluation data set based on reinforcement learning
description: This application relates to an automatic synthesis method and apparatus for RAG system evaluation datasets based on reinforcement learning. The method includes: acquiring knowledge base data of the RAG system and extracting keywords and related documents from the knowledge base data in a target vertical domain; synthesizing initial question-answer pairs using preset prompt word templates based on the keywords and documents; constructing rewards for the initial question-answer pairs; determining training data for the initial policy model based on the keywords, initial question-answer pairs, rewards, and parameters of the initial policy model; training the initial policy model based on the training data to obtain a target policy model; and using the target policy model to batch generate target question-answer pairs that satisfy the rewards based on the keywords and documents. This application solves the problems of high cost and low efficiency in synthesizing evaluation datasets in related technologies, which affect the effectiveness of evaluating RAG systems, thereby reducing synthesis costs and improving synthesis efficiency.

title: A Degree-Based Graph Partitioning Method and System for Heterogeneous Environment Graph Neural Networks
description: The invention discloses a graph dividing method and a system based on degree classification for a heterogeneous environment graph neural network, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining classification thresholds of high degree vertexes and low degree vertexes according to power law characteristics of vertex degree distribution in the input graph neural network, and classifying vertexes into low degree vertexes and high degree vertexes; and carrying out initial sub-division on the high vertex, calculating locality scores and load balancing scores for the high vertex divided into different partitions, weighting and summing the locality scores and the load balancing scores to comprehensive scores divided into corresponding partitions, and selecting the partition with the highest comprehensive score as a division result, wherein each partition corresponds to one calculation node in the heterogeneous environment. The invention aims to realize the load balancing perceived by heterogeneous equipment while optimizing the edge cutting rate, and improve the overall performance and the resource utilization rate of the distributed graph neural network training system.

title: Power equipment fault prediction and diagnosis system based on artificial intelligence algorithm
description: This application relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology. It provides a power equipment fault prediction and diagnosis system based on artificial intelligence algorithms, including: acquiring and preprocessing multimodal data such as vibration signals, temperature signals, electromagnetic field signals, and partial discharge signals from power equipment to generate preprocessed multimodal feature vectors; constructing a dynamic time reference axis on the preprocessed multimodal feature vectors to generate time-calibrated multimodal data; performing semantic enhancement feature fusion processing on the multimodal data to generate globally semantically consistent features; training a fault prediction and diagnosis model to generate fault type classification results and root cause tracing results; and generating a visual interactive interface based on the fault type classification results and root cause tracing results, outputting a decision view including a fault probability heat map and economical disposal strategies, thereby solving the problems of temporal misalignment and lack of physical correlation in multimodal data in related technologies.

title: Driving style identification method and system based on entropy weight method
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and provides a driving style identification method and a driving style identification system based on an entropy weight method, wherein the driving style identification method based on the entropy weight method comprises the steps of processing based on original driving data of a target vehicle and an artificial neural network model to obtain a predicted driving period label of each time segment and a predicted driving style label of each time segment; storing the predicted driving period label of each time segment and the predicted driving style label of each time segment, calculating based on the time number and the predicted driving style label to obtain an average style score, calculating based on the predicted driving period label and the predicted driving style label to obtain an entropy weight, weighting and calculating based on the average style score and the entropy weight to obtain a target driving style score, and determining the target driving style based on the target driving style score and a preset score, thereby remarkably improving the objectivity and reproducibility of the score.

title: Mangrove forest distribution information extraction method based on deep learning and remote sensing images
description: The invention discloses a mangrove forest distribution information extraction method based on deep learning and remote sensing images, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a space diagram fused with ecological priori knowledge such as hydrologic connectivity and the like, adopting a PG-STGT network to extract high-dimensional features containing complex space-time dependency relationships from an irregular satellite image time sequence, and then adopting a physical information guided antagonistic decoupling mechanism to explicitly decompose the high-dimensional features into three subspaces. Finally, the method applies the decoupled identity feature vector to generate a high-robustness distribution map, and utilizes residual error abnormal features to generate a multidimensional mangrove health index. The invention deeply fuses the physical mechanism and the deep learning, improves the time consistency of the classification result, and provides the capability of diagnosing the health condition of the ecological system.

title: Method for quantitatively detecting chlorophenol isomer based on residual error correction
description: This invention discloses a quantitative detection method for chlorophenol isomers based on residual correction, relating to the field of material testing or analysis by measuring the chemical or physical properties of materials. The method includes: preparing two isomers of chlorophenol in various mass ratios; establishing a fitting relationship between the ratio of Raman characteristic peak areas in the two isomers and the mass ratio of the two isomers based on the various mass ratios, obtaining fitting parameters; calculating the corrected residual between the experimental Raman characteristic peak and the fitted Raman characteristic peak of the chlorophenol to be detected; and constructing a predictive model for detecting and distinguishing chlorophenol isomers. This invention, through the above method, can improve the predictive stability and accuracy under conditions such as peak shape anomalies and signal-to-noise ratio fluctuations, achieving rapid and highly sensitive quantitative detection of various isomers. This method has advantages such as requiring no sample pretreatment, being non-destructive, rapid, and having high repeatability.

title: A subway traffic operation decision-making and adjustment system and method based on a large visualization screen
description: This invention relates to the field of intelligent transportation technology, specifically to a subway traffic operation decision-making and adjustment system and method based on a large-screen visualization platform. The system includes: a sensing data module, a data processing hub, a large-screen visualization interactive platform, an intelligent command decision engine, and a dynamic adjustment unit. The sensing data module collects real-time train positioning data, platform monitoring video streams, turnstile passage data, and environmental sensor data. The data processing hub integrates and analyzes the data, uncovering potential patterns, correlations, and anomalies. The large-screen visualization interactive platform presents real-time network congestion heatmaps, equipment fault locations, and passenger flow prediction trends. The intelligent command decision engine dynamically generates train schedule adjustment strategies and emergency evacuation plans. The dynamic adjustment unit dynamically adjusts electronic guide screens and platform broadcasts to dynamically schedule trains. This solves the problems of delayed anomaly response, unreasonable resource allocation, and low efficiency in existing technologies.

title: Intelligent network control methods and related equipment for low-latency video backhaul
description: The invention relates to the field of multimedia communication and network control, in particular to an intelligent network control method for low-delay video backhaul and related equipment. The intelligent network control method comprises the following steps of collecting network key indexes including bandwidth, delay, jitter and packet loss rate of a network link in real time and providing real-time network environment data support for transmission strategy adjustment. The invention effectively solves the technical problem of low-delay video feedback in a complex network environment by constructing an intelligent control mechanism combining network state sensing and video content characteristic recognition. Specifically, key indexes of a network link are collected in real time, a lightweight CNN model is introduced to analyze video content liveness, double perceptibility of network environment and content characteristics is formed, data support is provided for dynamically adjusting coding parameters, and accurate balance of video quality and network adaptability is achieved.

title: A method for optimizing mold airtightness testing parameters
description: The invention provides a method for optimizing a mold air tightness detection parameter, which belongs to the technical field of parameter optimization and comprises the steps of carrying out simulation detection on a physical model of a target mold, carrying out simulation optimization and actual use on the physical model, carrying out division statistics on the operation time ratio of each working condition according to a high-temperature forming working condition, a normal-temperature storage working condition and a high-pressure test working condition on an actual use log of the target mold, synchronously collecting multi-mode data of each working condition and carrying out redundancy processing, constructing a multi-working condition collaborative optimization objective function based on the operation time ratio of each working condition and the redundant multi-mode data, carrying out target optimization on the multi-working condition collaborative optimization function, reversely updating a detection threshold value of the multi-working condition collaborative optimization objective function according to an optimizing result, guaranteeing the rationality of detection parameter setting and the accuracy of the detection result, improving the reliability of mold air tightness detection, and realizing cross-working condition self-adaption optimization of mold air tightness detection parameters.

title: A method and system for rapid human motion capture based on multi-view calibration
description: The invention discloses a multi-view calibration-free human body motion rapid capturing method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of using a human body three-dimensional reconstruction model obtained by training based on a neural network to reconstruct human body three-dimensional at corresponding view angles according to videos at different view angles, and obtaining digital three-dimensional human body motions under a coordinate system of each camera; the method comprises the steps of estimating an initial external parameter for cameras with different visual angles, carrying out iterative computation on the external parameters of each camera by utilizing the initial external parameter of each camera and the digital three-dimensional human body motion under a corresponding camera coordinate system, carrying out world coordinate system conversion on the digital three-dimensional human body motion under the corresponding camera coordinate system by utilizing the external parameters of the camera obtained by iterative computation, and carrying out multi-visual angle fitting to obtain the final digital three-dimensional human body motion. The invention does not need heavy calibration work, realizes automatic calibration by utilizing the multi-view video frame, and further rapidly captures human body actions and completes three-dimensional reconstruction.

title: Student model training methods, image forgery detection methods, and computer equipment
description: The invention discloses a student model training method, an image forgery detection method and computer equipment, and belongs to the field of image detection. The image counterfeiting detection method comprises the steps of determining a target image to be detected, calling a trained student model based on the target image to generate a detection result, wherein the student model is obtained through training of fusion counterfeiting features, training images and intermediate features, the training images are provided by more than two domains, the intermediate features are generated by calling corresponding teacher models based on the training images, the fusion counterfeiting features are generated by calling teaching aid models based on all the intermediate features, and the fusion counterfeiting features are features corresponding to common information in all the intermediate features. The method can improve the accuracy in recognizing whether the image is a forged image.

title: Data analysis and early warning method for human health monitoring
description: This invention discloses a data analysis and early warning method for human health monitoring, belonging to the field of electroencephalogram (EEG) monitoring technology. First, this invention uses a sliding window to process the time-domain signals of EEG in both sleep and wake states, obtaining frequency-domain signals through Fourier transform and dividing them into three frequency bands. Next, the deviations in the centroid and energy of the three frequency band signals in the two states are calculated, yielding corresponding frequency difference sequences and energy difference sequences. Subsequently, features are extracted from these sequences and a feature matrix is constructed. This feature matrix is then processed through a multi-channel, multi-scale neural network to obtain an EEG abnormality assessment value. When this assessment value exceeds a threshold, the system triggers a risk warning, thereby achieving accurate assessment and timely early warning of EEG abnormalities.

title: Wave beam scheduling method and system based on peak information age optimization in millimeter wave communication network
description: The invention relates to a wave beam dispatching method and a wave beam dispatching system based on peak information age optimization in a millimeter wave communication network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining environment parameters and network parameters of the millimeter wave network; the method comprises the steps of establishing an information age updating model according to the environment parameters and the network parameters, establishing a beam scheduling problem according to the information age updating model, converting the beam scheduling problem into a Markov decision process, and solving the Markov decision process by adopting a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to obtain a beam scheduling scheme with the minimum peak information age. The invention can automatically select the optimal beam scheduling scheme according to the dynamic channel state and the network load, effectively reduce the peak information age and improve the timeliness of the network information.

title: A method and system for automatic fitting of reservoir geomechanical parameters
description: The present invention relates to a kind of reservoir geology mechanics parameter automatic Matching Method and systems, it is the following steps are included: generate the random field about mechanics parameter by the Karhunen-Loeve method of development；Random field is imported and carries out the calculating of reservoir crustal stress in Abaqus finite element modelling device；The random number in Karhunen-Loeve algorithm is adjusted by optimization algorithm, realizes reservoir stress analog result and the fitting of actual observed value in error range；Using the random number by genetic algorithm after preferred, more accurate geomechanics parameter field is obtained.The generation of random field is realized using the Karhunen-Loeve method of development, utilize the stress distribution under Abaqus software simulation stratum condition, the geomechanics parameter being fitted using optimization algorithm, a kind of method for setting up geomechanics parameter automatic Fitting, this method energy automatic Fitting reservoir geology mechanics parameter, and the parameter field for meeting Statistical Distribution Characteristics is obtained, this spatial distribution that reservoir geology mechanics parameter is quick and precisely obtained for engineer has important directive significance.

title: A method for constructing a risk assessment model for green building materials product certification
description: The present invention provides a kind of method of green building productions certification risk evaluation model building, the index parameter including obtaining green building productions certification, and the index parameter is determined according to certification node and risk point；The corresponding sample value of the index parameter is obtained, training sample and test sample are established；The index parameter is inputted into neural network model, configures the parameter of neural network；The neural network model is trained using training sample, after training, the neural network model is optimized using test sample, the neural network model after optimization is that green building productions authenticate risk evaluation model.The program can extract tacit knowledge and rule using neural network model from training data, reduce the influence of the subjective factor and accidentalia in evaluation procedure, more scientific, intelligence and expansion.

title: Multi-band photoacoustic non-invasive blood glucose concentration prediction system based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses the multiband optoacoustic Woundless blood sugar concentration prediction systems based on deep learning.System mainly includes ultrasonic transducer, amplifier, data collecting card and the signal processing module of laser source, n different frequency range.Laser source generates pulse laser, irradiates human skin tissue.The ultrasonic transducer of n different frequency range obtains the photoacoustic signal of different frequency range respectively.Amplifier amplifies photoacoustic signal.The time-domain information of data collecting card acquisition photoacoustic signal.Time-domain information is converted to frequency domain information by signal processing module, and is input in the multiband optoacoustic Woundless blood sugar concentration prediction model based on deep learning, to obtain blood glucose concentration value.Blood sugar concentration prediction result accuracy of the present invention is high, and the limitation of blood glucose level can not be reacted comprehensively by overcoming one-segment photoacoustic signal.

title: Campus violence behavior detection method and system
description: The invention provides a campus violence detection method and device, the method comprises the steps of constructing a campus scene violence data set, utilizing a BoT-SORT algorithm to conduct motion trail analysis on a YOLOv model, detecting campus monitoring video violence, setting and utilizing a video understanding model TSM to conduct video understanding operation, capturing video sequence time sequence information in the campus scene violence data set, conducting time migration operation on channel characteristics on a preset time dimension, conducting local time information exchange in an input characteristic map of each time step to extract strong time sequence dependency characteristics and sense dynamic behaviors of a pedestrian target, conducting characteristic fusion operation on output data of the video understanding model TSM and a YOLOv model, obtaining a fusion characteristic map, and conducting campus monitoring line video violence detection according to the fusion characteristic map. The method solves the technical problems that the omission and false detection, the real-time performance and the precision are difficult to consider and the adaptability in the campus monitoring scene is poor due to insufficient feature utilization.

title: Magnet quench detection method based on attention mechanism feature fusion
description: The invention relates to the technical field of magnet quench detection, and discloses a magnet quench detection method based on attention mechanism feature fusion, which comprises the steps of preprocessing the existing time sequence data and the time sequence data to be detected of a superconducting magnet to obtain an existing data signal frame and a data signal frame to be detected; extracting time domain features and frequency domain features from the existing data signal frames and the data signal frames to be detected, extracting the convolution features from the existing data signal frames and the data signal frames to be detected by using a convolution neural network, splicing the extracted time domain features and frequency domain features with the convolution features for the existing data signal frames, extracting attention weights of the spliced features by using an attention network, acquiring fusion features by using the extracted attention weights, performing quench detection on the fused features by using a deep neural network as a classifier to obtain detection results, training a detection model to determine an optimal model, and obtaining the detection results of the data signal frames to be detected according to the optimal model. Thereby, the magnet quench detection is achieved.

title: Intelligent furniture collaborative design method
description: The invention discloses an intelligent furniture collaborative design method, which relates to the technical field of furniture collaborative processing and comprises the following steps of S1, collecting collaborative operation data packets of furniture equipment to be processed, S2, calculating a plurality of importance scores according to the collaborative operation data packets of the furniture equipment to be processed, generating a performance evaluation sequence based on the importance scores, S3, determining a collaborative encryption key according to the performance evaluation sequence of the furniture equipment to be processed, encrypting, and storing the encrypted collaborative operation data packets to a cloud. The intelligent furniture collaborative design method can carry out fine evaluation on the collaborative operation condition of furniture equipment by calculating a plurality of importance scores in the collaborative operation data packet, and stores the encrypted collaborative operation data packet to a cloud, thereby realizing remote access and sharing of data and facilitating collaborative work across equipment.

title: Defect detection method and system based on image processing and deep learning
description: A defect detection method and system based on image processing and deep learning relates to the field of laser welding image processing and comprises the following steps of obtaining a first image, obtaining a second image based on convolution operation and hierarchical aggregation recognition and removal of shadows in the first image, obtaining a third image by converting source colors of the second image into target colors, eliminating brightness extracted by influencing features based on separation and processing of illumination components and reflection components of the third image, obtaining a fourth image, converting the fourth image into RGB channels based on histogram equalization, obtaining a fifth image, positioning defect positions of the fifth image based on ResNet and Unet mixed networks, processing environmental factors influencing image defect detection through shadow removal, color neutralization, brightness neutralization and contrast enhancement, and utilizing a deep learning network to carry out defect detection, so that the influence of complex environments on detection effects is solved.

title: A multi-objective optimization method for the check valve structure of a high-pressure diaphragm pump based on digital twin
description: The invention discloses a multi-objective optimization method of a high-pressure diaphragm pump check valve structure based on digital twinning, belonging to the technical field of pump valve optimization design; the method comprises the steps of collecting geometric dimension parameters and material properties of a check valve of a high-pressure diaphragm pump, establishing a simulation model, adopting Isight and ANSYS joint simulation methods to carry out experimental design to generate sample points and calculate response values, establishing a proxy model according to each group of sample point response values, improving calculation efficiency, completing digital twin model construction, establishing a multi-objective optimization model of a check valve structure by taking maximum equivalent stress of a valve core and minimum maximum flow rate of a valve gap flow field as objective functions, adopting a genetic algorithm to solve, obtaining a structural parameter combination with the best impact resistance of the check valve, and finally carrying out result verification. The invention can realize high-precision simulation of the running state of the one-way valve and solving of the optimal structural parameters of the shock resistance, thereby guiding the structural design of the one-way valve, reducing the cost of the research and development time of the product and prolonging the service life.

title: An energy consumption prediction method based on B-spline improved TCN and self-attention bidirectional cross BiLSTM
description: The invention discloses an energy consumption prediction method based on B-spline improved TCN and self-attention bidirectional intersection BiLSTM, and relates to the technical field of building energy consumption prediction.
