The method comprises the steps of obtaining building energy consumption data, obtaining a pre-trained energy consumption prediction model, obtaining the energy consumption prediction model through parallel connection of a TCN network based on B-spline improvement and a BiLSTM network based on self-attention bidirectional intersection and adding a full connection layer and an output layer, inputting the building energy consumption data into the energy consumption prediction model, adjusting parameters of the energy consumption prediction model according to the building energy consumption data, processing the building energy consumption data by utilizing the adjusted energy consumption prediction model, and outputting an energy consumption prediction result in a future period.

title: Multi-agent traffic signal control method based on spatiotemporal convolutional attention mechanism
description: The present invention relates to the field of intelligent traffic control technology, specifically a multi-agent traffic signal control method based on a spatiotemporal convolutional attention mechanism, in which a multi-intersection traffic network in a region is modeled as a multi-agent system, and each multi-agent simultaneously considers the influence of the actions of adjacent multi-agents at adjacent moments in the process of learning strategies, so that multiple multi-agents can collaboratively control the traffic lights of multiple intersections, and establish a tensor that can reflect the current state of the regional traffic network. The convolutional attention mechanism is integrated into the deep reinforcement learning neural network so that the agent can better pay attention to the state of vehicles at adjacent intersections. Finally, a multi-agent intersection signal control model based on the deep reinforcement learning algorithm D3QN_CBAM is established. The multi-agent traffic signal control method based on the spatiotemporal convolutional attention mechanism of the present invention combines the attention mechanism with regional signal control, thereby improving the performance and effect of regional traffic signal collaborative control.

title: A cluster intelligence decision-making model training method based on digital twins
description: The present invention discloses a cluster intelligent decision model training method based on digital twins, and the method constructs a cluster intelligent decision model training system based on digital twins. Before the cluster intelligent decision model training begins, observation state information is collected by various high-precision sensors, and the model parameters of the twin simulation model are corrected to improve the modeling accuracy of the collaborative control task scenario. During the decision model training process, the central server runs multiple corrected twin model copies simultaneously in a parallel manner to conduct extensive behavioral exploration, taking into account improving the efficiency of acquiring learning samples and the effectiveness of training for the cluster intelligent decision model. During the task execution process, each intelligent agent can make distributed intelligent collaborative control decisions based on their respective partial observation results, and at the same time send the observation data obtained in the real task environment to the central server, continuously driving the autonomous evolution of the decision model.

title: A three-dimensional Gaussian splash optimization method based on depth information
description: The disclosure belongs to the technical field of computers, and relates to a three-dimensional Gaussian splatter optimization method based on depth information. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-view image, extracting a plurality of Gaussian points of the multi-view image, replacing spherical harmonics of each Gaussian point with RGB values, limiting the RGB values of each Gaussian point within a preset range according to a Sigmoid function, and executing depth guidance operation on each limited Gaussian point to obtain a three-dimensional object. The method and the device can improve the interpretability of each Gaussian point by carrying out RGB restriction and depth guidance on the multi-view image, and further can enable the finally reconstructed three-dimensional object to be more accurate.

title: Manuscript collection and AI auditing method and device
description: The application relates to the technical field of advertisement data processing, and discloses a manuscript collecting and AI auditing method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining manuscripts to be audited of a social media platform according to a preset unified submission interface; the method comprises the steps of pre-checking manuscripts to be checked to obtain preliminary screening manuscripts, comprehensively analyzing texts, images and videos of the preliminary screening manuscripts to obtain text information, image information and video information, respectively extracting text feature vectors, image feature vectors and video feature vectors from the text information, the image information and the video information, normalizing the text feature vectors, the image feature vectors and the video feature vectors and integrating the text feature vectors, the image feature vectors and the video feature vectors to obtain fusion features, inputting the fusion features based on a preset neural network model, and outputting a checking decision result by combining a weight matrix and a bias item of a preset decision layer. The method and the device can achieve the effects of improving the collection efficiency of the social media platform manuscripts and the identification precision of the auditing model.

title: Blood vessel segmentation model training method, blood vessel segmentation method and electronic equipment
description: The present disclosure discloses a blood vessel segmentation model training method, a blood vessel segmentation method and an electronic device. The model training method includes: inputting the acquired DSA training data pair into a neural network model for training to obtain a blood vessel segmentation model; the neural network model includes: an encoder including at least one layer of coding units, an attention module including attention units corresponding to the coding units one by one, and a decoder; during training, for each coding unit except the last layer of coding units, the image features output by the coding unit are input into the attention unit corresponding to the coding unit, and the product of the attention weight map output by the coding unit and the image features is input into the next layer of coding units; the image features output by the last layer of coding units are input into the attention unit corresponding to the coding unit, and the product of the attention weight map output by the coding unit and the image features is input into the decoder for identification and segmentation, thereby realizing automatic blood vessel segmentation.

title: Peanut bacterial wilt-resistant breeding strategy analysis method and system based on growth cycle
description: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a peanut bacterial wilt resistance breeding strategy analysis method and system based on a growth cycle. The method comprises the steps of acquiring and analyzing peanut growth period characteristic data to obtain a growth period characteristic library, performing phenotype comparison on healthy plants and pathogenic plants to establish a bacterial wilt resistance early warning model, performing real-time monitoring according to the early warning model to obtain risk early warning results, performing growth period tracking based on the early warning results to establish a resistance scoring system, obtaining strain stability parameters through environmental response analysis, and finally determining excellent strains to form a bacterial wilt resistance breeding scheme. According to the application, by establishing a data monitoring and analyzing system in the whole growth period, the dynamic evaluation and early warning of the bacterial wilt resistance of plants are realized, and the accuracy and efficiency of bacterial wilt resistance variety breeding are improved.

title: Aircraft landing distance prediction method, equipment and product based on fuzzy reasoning
description: The disclosure relates to the technical field of avionics, and in particular provides a method, equipment and a product for predicting an aircraft landing distance based on fuzzy reasoning. The method comprises the steps of starting a sliding section distance prediction module to predict the landing distance under the condition that the aircraft reaches a first preset height, predicting the distance change of the aircraft in a sliding stage in a numerical calculation mode by the sliding section distance prediction module, switching a leveling section distance prediction module to predict the landing distance under the condition that the aircraft reaches a second preset height, predicting the distance deviation of the aircraft in the leveling stage through fuzzy reasoning by the leveling section distance prediction module, switching the sliding section distance prediction module to predict the landing distance under the condition that the aircraft slides on a runway, and predicting the landing point position of the aircraft in a numerical calculation mode by the sliding section distance prediction module. The method combines the accuracy of numerical calculation and the adaptability of fuzzy reasoning to improve the accuracy and the robustness of the airplane landing distance prediction.

title: Semantic network frame construction method, system and equipment based on traditional Chinese medicine full chain
description: The invention discloses a semantic network framework construction method, a semantic network framework construction system and semantic network framework construction equipment based on a traditional Chinese medicine full chain, which relate to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine information management, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining traditional Chinese medicine data; identifying and extracting multiple entities in the Chinese medicinal data, determining multiple semantic types of each entity, constructing a relation network of each semantic type of each entity, integrating the multiple semantic types of each entity and the relation network of each semantic type, and forming a semantic network based on the Chinese medicinal data. According to the invention, the link information of the traditional Chinese medicine can be associated, and dynamic display and management are carried out through the semantic network, so that the knowledge management efficiency and the retrieval efficiency of the traditional Chinese medicine are improved.

title: Image processing method, device, storage medium and electronic equipment
description: The embodiment of the present application discloses an image processing method, device, storage medium and electronic device; through a first application, a first view image is captured in a model window of a target model, and the first view image is stored in a target storage location of the first application; a second application is opened through the first application, and the first view image is displayed through the second application; the first view image is processed by the second application based on a decal texture to obtain a second view image; the first view image in the target storage location is replaced with the second view image; the second view image in the target storage location is projected onto the target model to obtain a model map with a decal texture added corresponding to the target model based on the projection result. In this way, the decal drawing process of the three-dimensional model can be effectively simplified, and fast decal drawing on the three-dimensional model can be achieved, thereby improving the decal drawing efficiency.

title: Training method of underwater image enhancement network model, underwater image enhancement method, device and storage medium
description: The invention provides a training method of an underwater image enhancement network model, an underwater image enhancement method, equipment and a storage medium. The invention uses unpaired underwater image data and water image data for training, solves the problem that the traditional method is difficult to model a complex underwater degradation mode through enhancement-degradation and degradation-enhancement bidirectional mapping, and meanwhile, the introduction of a physical optical model ensures that the enhancement result accords with an optical rule, avoids artifacts or distortion possibly generated by a pure depth learning method, thereby effectively improving the quality and stability of an enhanced image and solving the technical problems of insufficient underwater image enhancement effect and insufficient image quality in the prior art.

title: Deep learning-based brain tumor region automatic segmentation method and system
description: The invention discloses a brain tumor region automatic segmentation method and system based on deep learning, which belong to the technical field of image segmentation, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining a disclosed brain tumor segmentation data set and constructing a multi-mode brain tumor medical image database; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing data of a multi-modal brain tumor medical image database, dividing the preprocessed multi-modal brain tumor medical image database into a training set, a verification set and a test set according to a proportion, designing a deep learning model LG-FPN-TransBTS based on improvement TransBTS, and training, evaluating and applying the model. The system comprises a data preprocessing module, a data set dividing and secondary processing module, a deep learning model building module, a model training and optimizing module and a model evaluating and applying module. The invention obviously improves the accuracy and the robustness of brain tumor image segmentation.

title: Image segmentation system and method for monitoring seaweed bed of unmanned aerial vehicle
description: The invention provides an image segmentation system and method for monitoring an unmanned aerial vehicle seaweed bed, which belong to the technical field of image segmentation of computer vision, are improved based on an iterative small sample adaptive device IFA and comprise a feature grouping mapping part, a feature fusion part and a segmentation prediction part, wherein the feature grouping mapping part comprises a decoder and a Gaussian energy prototype-driven grouping mapping module which are used for feature extraction and strengthening the focus on key features, the feature fusion part adopts a channel space feature fusion module to fuse the features extracted by the feature grouping mapping part into the features of channels and space dimensions, the grouping mapping module comprises a channel attention unit and a space attention unit, the segmentation prediction part comprises a decoder which is used for converting an optimized feature image into a final segmentation mask, and the segmentation precision and the generalization capability of a model in a small sample segmentation task are remarkably improved through an innovative encoder, the grouping mapping module, the channel space feature fusion module and the decoder.

title: Wind speed and direction prediction method based on improved TCN-LSTM
description: The invention relates to the field of wind speed and wind direction prediction, and discloses a wind speed and wind direction prediction method based on an improved TCN-LSTM, which comprises the following steps of collecting real-time monitoring multidimensional meteorological data of an offshore wind station and preprocessing; performing feature fusion and feature enhancement processing on the preprocessed data, wherein the feature enhancement processing comprises spatial feature extraction, tensor reconstruction and time sequence modeling; inputting the data subjected to the feature fusion and the feature enhancement into a wind speed and wind direction prediction model based on an improved TCN-LSTM hybrid neural network, and predicting the wind speed and wind direction at the future moment; the wind speed and direction prediction model comprises a space-time separation TCN network, a multi-head self-attention mechanism, a self-adaptation Dropblock mechanism, an LSTM network and a Bayesian optimization module, and the accuracy, the robustness and the calculation efficiency of wind power prediction in a complex marine environment can be improved.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle target selection method and device based on Markov game and Bayesian optimization
description: The application relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle target selection method and device based on Markov games and Bayesian optimization. The unmanned aerial vehicle target selection method comprises the steps of extracting target feature data of an unmanned aerial vehicle, carrying out sparsification processing on the target feature data according to the distance between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the target unmanned aerial vehicle, generating global characterization, constructing a Markov game model, defining a reward function as a Bayesian optimized target function, carrying out probability modeling on the target function by using a Gaussian process as a proxy model, obtaining an optimal reward function output value through iterative solution, and outputting an unmanned aerial vehicle target selection result of the Markov game model according to the optimal reward function output value. By adopting the method, the selection effect of the unmanned aerial vehicle under the complex condition can be optimized.

title: LSTM-based DuPont financial data trend analysis method and device
description: The invention discloses a financial data trend analysis method and device based on LSTM and DuPont analysis, and belongs to the technical field of financial analysis. The method comprises the main steps of obtaining enterprise financial data through a multi-source interface, generating a dynamic core index set after cleaning and standardization treatment, constructing a composite analysis model based on historical data fitting and future trend prediction, and realizing multi-dimensional index association analysis through an interactive visual map. The corresponding device comprises data acquisition, data preprocessing, index calculation, data fitting and prediction, visual drawing and comprehensive analysis. The technical scheme improves the static data processing mode of the traditional DuPont analysis, supports the continuous monitoring of enterprise profit capability, operation efficiency and financial risk, and provides dynamic data support for strategic decisions. The system is compatible with the deployment of computer equipment and a cloud platform, and is suitable for application scenes such as an enterprise financial management system, a risk early warning platform and the like.

title: Hollow village identification method and system based on multi-source data fusion
description: The invention relates to the technical field of hollow village identification, in particular to a hollow village identification method and a system based on multi-source data fusion, wherein the method is realized based on a hollow village identification model, and the model comprises a first feature extraction unit, a second feature extraction unit and a third feature extraction unit, wherein the first feature extraction unit converts a received remote sensing image into a high-dimensional feature map, weights the attention of channel and space dimensions of the high-dimensional feature map, and converts the weighted feature map into a static feature vector; the method comprises the steps of receiving a village scene picture, flattening the village scene picture into a feature vector with preset dimension, aggregating the feature vector into a micro feature vector based on an attention mechanism, capturing long-term dependency relationship in a time sequence from the received time sequence night light data, capturing local features from the time sequence night light data, generating a dynamic feature vector based on the long-term dependency relationship and the local features, splicing the static feature vector, the micro feature vector and the dynamic feature vector into a comprehensive feature vector by a multi-source data fusion recognition unit, outputting a remote sensing image, the village scene picture and the prediction probability of the village corresponding to the time sequence night light data as a hollow village based on the comprehensive feature vector, and obtaining a hollow village recognition result by the model and the method.

title: Method, device and equipment for determining the amount of replenishing fluid before repeated fracturing of horizontal wells
description: The application provides a method, a device and equipment for determining the pre-pressure energy supplementing liquid quantity of a horizontal well, which comprise the steps of quickly constructing a numerical simulation model, constructing a large number of data sample sets, screening key characteristic parameters influencing the pressure recovery level, training a machine learning model to obtain a pre-pressure energy supplementing post-pressure level prediction model of the horizontal well, constructing an agent model for optimizing the pre-pressure energy supplementing parameter of the horizontal well, taking the maximum pressure recovery level as a target, constructing an optimized mathematical model, calling an optimization algorithm, and obtaining the corresponding relation between the pre-pressure energy supplementing liquid quantity and the pressure recovery level under different geological, engineering and production conditions. The method can rapidly and accurately determine the optimal energy supplementing liquid quantity parameters before repeated fracturing of the horizontal well, solves the problems that the capacity numerical simulation means are single, key characteristic parameters cannot be cleared and the like, can reduce a large number of high-cost simulation tests, remarkably improves economic benefits, and can greatly reduce the time cost of the tests due to extremely high calculation efficiency.

title: A dynamic identification system and method based on light-controlled neural synapse array
description: The invention provides a dynamic identification system and a method based on an optical control nerve synapse array, which relate to the technical field of photoelectric pulse and comprise a lens imaging module, a displacement buffer module and a dynamic imaging module, wherein the lens imaging module is configured to collect optical signals and transmit the optical signals to the optical control nerve synapse array so as to adjust the resistance value of the optical control nerve synapse array, the displacement buffer module is configured to receive serial input signals of a micro control unit, convert the serial input signals into parallel output signals and transmit the parallel output signals to the optical control nerve synapse array after a register is filled, the optical control nerve synapse array comprises a plurality of optical control nerve synapses, and the optical control nerve synapses correspond to a target optical control nerve synapse and are connected with an analog-to-digital converter under the condition that the parallel output signals are at a low level, the analog-to-digital converter is configured to collect the voltage value of the target optical control nerve synapse and determine the resistance value of the target optical control nerve synapse based on the voltage value, and the dynamic imaging module is configured to convert the resistance value into a gray value image.

title: Large language model distributed training method and system based on dynamic resource scheduling
description: The present invention provides a large language model distributed training method and system based on dynamic resource scheduling. By collecting resource status data of each computing node at periodic time intervals, the training task of the large language model is divided into multiple subtasks in the current training batch, and based on the resource status data of each computing node and the task description data of each subtask, a reinforcement learning strategy is used to distribute each subtask to the optimal computing node in an optimal proportion. In addition, a gradient compression algorithm is used to compress the gradient data generated on the computing node, and the compression rate of the gradient data is dynamically adjusted in combination with the current network bandwidth utilization rate of the computing node. The parameter server then performs weighted fusion on the compressed gradient data of different computing nodes based on the parameter synchronization interval, updates the global model parameters based on the fusion result, and broadcasts the global model parameters to each computing node, which can significantly improve the training efficiency of the large language model.

title: Lithium ion battery health state estimation method and system based on unsupervised transfer learning and electronic equipment
description: The invention discloses a lithium ion battery health state estimation method, a system and electronic equipment based on unsupervised transfer learning, comprising the following steps of selecting two batteries with different models and determining a source domain battery and a target domain battery; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a cyclic test data set, further obtaining a sample set and a label set, carrying out data processing on the sample set and the label set to obtain a training verification data set, training a domain countermeasure neural network model by using the training verification data set, inputting cyclic test data of a battery to be tested into the domain countermeasure neural network to obtain an estimation result, and utilizing the cyclic test data and calibration test data of an existing active domain battery and a small amount of cyclic test data of a target domain battery without calibration test, so that a redundant cyclic test flow of the target domain battery is avoided, and the accurate estimation of the health state of the target domain battery is realized.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle flight track optimization method based on UFO frame
description: The application relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle flight track optimization method based on a UFO frame, which aims to solve the track planning problem in an unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary wireless power supply Internet of things system so as to minimize system energy consumption and improve data collection and energy collection efficiency. The method is achieved by the steps of Iencoder encoding information of all the IoT devices by using a self-attention mechanism and a recursion structure, extracting features of each device and combining the features into a system feature, tdecoder generating an optimized unmanned aerial vehicle track according to the system feature, the self-attention feature of the IoT device and resource constraints of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and each unmanned aerial vehicle performing data collection and energy collection according to the optimized track. The method and the system can effectively process large-scale internet traffic (IoT) equipment, adapt to complex environmental constraints, provide quick response in application scenes with high real-time requirements, remarkably improve the energy efficiency and the data collection efficiency of the system, and have wide application prospects.

title: Improved YOLOv network-based field weed detection method
description: The invention provides a field weed detection method based on an improved YOLOv network, which comprises the following steps of obtaining a training sample set and a test sample set, improving a YOLOv network model and performing iterative training on the model, and obtaining a field weed detection result. According to the invention, the reversible feature extraction columnar subnetwork gradually carries out deep feature extraction on each training sample through a plurality of feature extraction branches, so that effective detection of shielded small-size weeds is realized while detection of large-size weeds is ensured, the separable kernel attention module weights the importance of different areas of the feature map to enable the model to better focus on information of a target area, and meanwhile, the shielding perception attention module can more effectively process shielded information by enhancing feature response of shielded areas in the fusion feature map, so that detection precision is further improved.

title: Method for recommending online doctors
description: The invention discloses a method for recommending online doctors, which relates to the technical field of intelligent medical treatment and solves the technical problems that the availability of data and the validity of a model limit the effective excavation of the medical demands of patients and the professional capacities of doctors; the invention provides a novel knowledge enhancement graph neural network for on-line doctor recommendation, namely a collaborative attention network (KGTCAN) based on a knowledge graph converter, wherein a medical knowledge graph is firstly constructed to reflect the relationship between a doctor and a key medical entity, then patients are clustered, the patients with similar treatment histories are clustered to form a denser cluster-doctor interaction graph, finally, a knowledge graph converter layer and the collaborative attention layer are designed to respectively process the medical knowledge graph and the cluster-doctor interaction graph, and through utilizing a Transformer framework and a collaborative attention mechanism, KGTCAN can effectively filter irrelevant connection and aggregate relevant information, so that the characterization learning capacity of the patients and doctors is improved.

title: Slight traumatic brain injury image evaluation system based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a deep learning-based mild traumatic brain injury image evaluation system, which relates to the technical field of medical images and comprises a data source module, a preprocessing module and a feature extraction module, wherein the data source module is used for acquiring skull magnetic resonance imaging data as an input data source, the preprocessing module is used for carrying out denoising processing and image registration on the skull magnetic resonance imaging data so as to realize standardized preprocessing, and the feature extraction module is used for extracting a local feature map from multidimensional image data by constructing a multi-layer convolutional neural network and identifying subcortical structural change and injury suspicious regions. The invention provides a deep learning-based mild traumatic brain injury image evaluation system, and a standardized evaluation report generated automatically by the system integrates clinical information of a patient, provides detailed injury types, severity and follow-up suggestions, greatly improves the efficiency and reliability of clinical decisions, and provides powerful support for the establishment of an individual diagnosis and treatment scheme.

title: System, method, medium and product for upgrading software of battery pack
description: The present application relates to a system for upgrading software of a battery pack. The system comprises a plurality of remote refreshing modules, wherein each remote refreshing module is in wireless connection with a plurality of battery packs. The system further includes a controller communicatively coupled to the plurality of remote refresh modules, the controller including a memory storing instructions and a processor executing the instructions, the instructions including instructions to obtain a battery pack to be upgraded and a location of the plurality of remote refresh modules, generate an allocation scheme for the plurality of remote refresh modules and the battery pack to be upgraded based on the location, optimally adjust the allocation scheme, perform a software upgrade of the battery pack according to the adjusted allocation scheme, wherein during execution of the software upgrade, data among the plurality of remote refresh modules is kept consistent and synchronized, and load balancing control is performed according to a current state and capacity of the plurality of remote refresh modules.

title: RAG knowledge retrieval method based on B+ tree structure
description: The present invention discloses a RAG knowledge retrieval method based on a B+ tree structure, comprising: converting a user query into a low-dimensional vector obtained by dimensionality reduction through principal component analysis; performing a range query through a pre-built B+ tree index to retrieve similar knowledge fragments, wherein the B+ tree index uses the low-dimensional vector of the knowledge document as a key value; and generating a final answer in combination with the retrieval results. By constructing a hierarchical semantic index and a dynamic update mechanism, efficient knowledge retrieval, dynamic update, and comprehensive optimization of storage costs are achieved.

title: A method for identifying intestinal stricture types in Crohn's disease based on radiomics and deep learning
description: The application relates to the field of medical image processing, and discloses a Crohn disease intestinal stenosis type identification method based on image histology and deep learning, which is characterized in that a region of interest of an intestinal canal stenosis section is marked through standardized ultrasonic gray-scale image acquisition, and image histology characteristics and deep learning characteristics are extracted; A classification model based on image histology is built by adopting a random forest algorithm, meanwhile, deep features are extracted by utilizing a ResNet deep learning network, and the classification model is built, so that the classification performance is further improved, the results of the image histology model and the deep learning model are combined, multi-modal classification is realized through weighted fusion, and the classification result is used for distinguishing inflammatory stenosis and fibrous stenosis of Crohn disease intestinal tracts. The application overcomes the dependence of the traditional ultrasonic diagnosis on the experience of operators, remarkably improves the consistency and accuracy of diagnosis, and provides reliable support for noninvasive accurate diagnosis of the Crohn's disease intestinal stenosis type.

title: Legal service method, system and related equipment based on large language model
description: The invention provides a legal service method, a legal service system and related equipment based on a large language model, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining user request information and identifying category information and field information of the user request information; selecting preset intelligent agents meeting the category information and the field information from a preset intelligent agent library according to the category information and the field information, taking the preset intelligent agents meeting the category information and the field information as target intelligent agents, wherein the target intelligent agents comprise a preset large language model meeting the field information and a preset function matrix meeting the category information, inputting user request information into the target intelligent agents to obtain initial results, inquiring enhanced information in a preset vector knowledge base through a RAG retrieval technology based on the user request information, generating target results aiming at the user request information based on the enhanced information and the initial results, and displaying the target results through a visualization technology. The method can flexibly cope with different legal problems in face of diversity and individuation requirements of legal services.

title: Course learning framework, product, medium and equipment oriented to cross-modal molecular retrieval
description: The invention discloses a course learning framework, a product, a medium and equipment for cross-modal molecular retrieval, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The framework comprises a multi-mode encoder, a sample difficulty quantizer, a sample scheduler and an adaptive strength learning module, wherein the multi-mode encoder is configured to be capable of converting an input sample into text representation and molecular representation, the sample difficulty quantizer is configured to be capable of classifying difficulty levels according to the average value of the text similarity and the molecular similarity of the sample and an example in a training set, the sample difficulty is quantized, the sample scheduler is configured to introduce a course learning strategy, the samples can be ordered according to the difficulty level to obtain sample sets with different difficulties capable of being applied to different training stages, and the adaptive strength learning module is configured to be capable of dynamically adjusting training strength according to the sample complexity of the model in different stages based on the sample set of the sample scheduler. The invention can solve the problem that the performance and the efficiency of the cross-modal text-molecule retrieval method cannot be optimized simultaneously, and obviously improves the performance of the cross-modal text-molecule retrieval method in compatibility with any backbone network.

title: Sports performance evaluation system based on AI discernment
description: The present invention relates to the field of sports evaluation technology, and specifically to a sports performance evaluation system based on AI recognition, comprising an image acquisition module, a drone control module, a model building module, and a performance evaluation module. The present invention dynamically tracks athletes through the drone control module to obtain all the movements of athletes at various angles during the game; then uses the model building module to construct the athlete's personal motion model and overall motion model; and comprehensively evaluates the athlete's performance through the features in the personal motion model and the overall motion model. In the above manner, the present invention can solve the problem that in football matches, sports videos of athletes are often shot at fixed positions next to the field, and there are often blind spots during the intersection of athletes, resulting in the inability to obtain some of the athletes' key movements, which in turn leads to an incomplete analysis of the athletes' performance.

title: Optimization method and device for identifying true and false hidden space of sound in audio information
description: The embodiment of the specification provides an optimization method and device for identifying true and false hidden spaces of sound in audio information, which optimize prototype vectors on the basis of classifying classification categories into a plurality of hidden categories of hidden spaces and describing the hidden categories by using the prototype vectors. In the optimization process, the sample audio information is encoded to obtain corresponding encoding vectors, and then the encoding vectors and the prototype vectors can be compared with each other to obtain corresponding similarity. Thus, intra-class losses are determined by similarity comparisons between prototype vectors of the same class, inter-class losses are determined by similarity comparisons between prototype vectors of different classes, and classification losses are determined by similarity comparisons between the encoded vectors of the audio information and prototype vectors of the belonging classification class and other classification classes. The prototype vector thus optimized can improve classification effectiveness and generalization capability.

title: Knowledge graph creation method, device and computer readable medium
description: The present invention discloses a method, device and computer-readable medium for creating a knowledge graph. The method includes: using a large language model to perform annotation processing on unstructured data to be extracted to generate structured data with annotations; using a knowledge extraction model to perform knowledge extraction processing on the structured data to generate knowledge triples; wherein the knowledge triples are used to indicate a combination formed by a first entity, a relationship between entities and a second entity; based on a number of the knowledge triples, a knowledge graph of a target domain is constructed. Thus, using a large language model to annotate data effectively reduces the need for manual intervention, solves the problem of financial pressure in project implementation, and improves the utilization rate of funds; by adjusting the data processing method and establishing a reliable trust mechanism, the problems of low consistency and poor interpretability of directly using a large model for knowledge extraction are solved, and the efficiency and automation of the knowledge graph construction process are improved.

title: Very short-term prediction method of ship rolling motion based on BP neural network optimized by whale algorithm
description: This invention discloses a method for extremely short-term prediction of ship roll motion based on a BP neural network optimized with a whale algorithm, and relates to the field of ship safety. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining ship roll motion data as sample data and normalizing it; constructing a multi-layer feedforward BP neural network model, and optimizing the parameters of the BP neural network model using a whale optimization algorithm to obtain a WOA-BP model; training the WOA-BP model using the sample data until the prediction accuracy meets the requirements; and using the trained model to perform extremely short-term prediction of ship roll motion. This invention not only improves the accuracy of ship roll motion prediction but also provides a new theoretical basis and technical support for ship motion prediction and control.

title: Diffusion recommendation method and system based on dynamic mask modeling
description: The invention discloses a diffusion recommendation method and a system based on dynamic mask modeling, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out dynamic mask processing on a user history interaction sequence, wherein the dynamic mask processing comprises a dual probabilistic mask strategy based on local relevance scores and global stationarity scores, and generating a dynamic self-adaptive editing sequence; the editing sequence is used for generating a dynamic guide signal through an encoder, denoising the denoising target object gradually based on a denoising diffusion implicit model and combining the dynamic guide signal to generate a recommendation result, and acquiring a Top-K recommendation result from the candidate object through K neighbor search. According to the invention, through a dual random masking strategy, combining local correlation and global stationarity, modeling a dynamic and random interaction sequence, optimizing the generation of a guide signal, improving the robustness and flexibility of a diffusion model recommendation system on a dynamic interaction sequence, creatively combining a dynamic guide signal with a denoising diffusion model, and enhancing the adaptability of the generation model on the dynamic sequence.

title: Processing quality control method of three-dimensional laser cutting system
description: The invention discloses a processing quality control method of a three-dimensional laser cutting system, which is characterized in that a follow-up detection visual camera is arranged in the cutting processing process of a workpiece, cutting images of all positions of the workpiece can be recorded in real time in the cutting process, so that dynamic monitoring of the cutting process is realized, if problems are found, the processing can be carried out at the current position through a beam module, the processing time of the workpiece is not additionally occupied, efficient collaborative work is realized, after the workpiece is cut and processed, higher-precision comprehensive detection can be carried out by arranging a finishing detection visual camera, the accuracy of quality control is ensured, meanwhile, an unqualified product is transported to a stacking area of the unqualified product, and the automatic marking machine carries out classification marking according to the defect type, so that the subsequent classification processing according to the defect type is facilitated.

title: Iterative generation type multi-mode thinking chain reasoning method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention provides an iteration generation type multi-mode thinking chain reasoning method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence; and iteratively updating the text reasoning result and the intermediate reasoning prompt by utilizing the multi-mode large language model to generate an updated text reasoning result and an updated intermediate reasoning prompt, wherein in the iterative updating process, the input of the multi-mode large language model comprises a previous text reasoning result and an auxiliary image matched with the previous text reasoning result, a graphic thinking chain is generated based on the text reasoning result generated by each iteration and the matched auxiliary image, and a target reasoning result is obtained based on the graphic thinking chain. By the method provided by the invention, the synchronous generation of the text and the image is realized, and the reasoning precision and the interpretation of the multi-mode complex task are improved.

title: Optimized scheduling method for electric comprehensive energy system
description: The present invention discloses an optimization scheduling method for an electrical integrated energy system, which relates to the technical field of power systems; the method comprises the following steps: data collection and system modeling: comprehensively collecting relevant data such as energy production, load, equipment parameters, and market, and constructing a mathematical model of energy production, conversion, storage, and load to accurately describe system characteristics; target setting: determining the optimization scheduling target of lowest economic cost and maximum benefit, environmental emission reduction and improvement of renewable energy consumption, and reliability guarantee of stable energy supply according to demand; constraint condition determination: clarifying energy balance, equipment operation restrictions, network transmission capacity, and policy and regulatory conditions to ensure that the scheduling scheme is within a feasible range. The present invention selects a suitable optimization algorithm to better deal with complex problems and improve solution efficiency and quality. Different optimization algorithms have different characteristics and applicable scopes. Selecting a suitable algorithm according to the specific situation of the system can improve the accuracy of the solution.

title: Credit risk prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a credit risk prediction method, apparatus, device and storage medium, which are applied to the fields of artificial intelligence and financial technology, including: using sample credit data of financial institutions to evaluate different types of Bayesian network models to obtain evaluation results; dynamically screening from different types of Bayesian network models according to the evaluation results and selected business needs to determine a target Bayesian network model; using the target Bayesian network model to predict customer credit data to obtain the customer's risk status. By evaluating different types of Bayesian network models to obtain evaluation results, the characteristics of each type of Bayesian network model are known according to the evaluation results, and referring to the evaluation results according to actual business needs, a target Bayesian network model that matches the actual business needs is screened out, and the customer's credit risk is accurately predicted based on the Bayesian network model adapted to the business needs, so that the obtained prediction results have reference value.

title: Power distribution network load composition identification method and system based on multi-scale feature fusion
description: The invention provides a power distribution network load composition identification method and system based on multi-scale feature fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-channel color V-I track graph, inputting historical load composition, voltage, current and power of a power distribution network target load node into the three-channel color V-I track graph, extracting track feature data, carrying out missing value filling and normalization processing on the extracted track feature data, dividing the track feature data into tag data and multi-scale feature data, storing the tag data and the multi-scale feature data into a sample set, inputting the sample set into a convolutional neural network for training to fit a mapping relation between a load composition feature matrix and the multi-scale feature track to obtain a load composition identification model, inputting the track feature data into a trained load composition identification model, and outputting the track feature data to obtain a load composition under the target load node. The invention combines the load characteristics under different scales, and improves the accuracy and the instantaneity of the load composition identification.

title: Pipe ring convergence monitoring method and device based on wireless inclination sensor, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The application discloses a pipe ring convergence monitoring method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on a wireless inclination sensor, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting data related to pipe ring convergence, and preprocessing the data, including data cleaning and feature extraction; S2, inputting the preprocessed data into a trained neural network model to predict the convergence condition of the pipe ring and output a convergence prediction result of the pipe ring, S3, automatically adjusting and optimizing related parameters according to the deviation degree of the convergence prediction result, S4, feeding back the automatically adjusted and optimized parameters and results to the neural network model for iterative training so as to perform further model optimization and iteration, obtaining feedback and evaluation of a user, and continuously iterating and improving and optimizing the performance and functions of the system according to the feedback and evaluation of the user. The application greatly improves the pipe ring convergence monitoring efficiency, the prediction precision and adaptability of pipe ring convergence, and the stability and safety of pipe ring.

title: Recommendation model generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention provides a generation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium of a recommendation model, wherein the generation method comprises the following steps of obtaining training data and creating the recommendation model, wherein the recommendation model comprises an embedding layer, a prompting layer, a basic model layer and an output layer; training the recommendation model based on the training data. The generation method can generate a recommendation model.

title: IMSSA-NARX-based aquaculture water quality prediction method
description: The invention discloses a IMSSA-NARX-based aquaculture water quality prediction method. The method comprises the steps of collecting culture water quality parameters, establishing a data set, completing pretreatment, realizing improved Tent chaotic mapping by introducing multi-bit control parameters on a chaotic equation of an original Tent, realizing improved Tent chaotic mapping by combining a goblet sea squirt swarm algorithm with the improved Tent chaotic mapping, realizing improved goblet sea squirt algorithm IMSSA for improving global exploration and local development capacity of the goblet sea squirt algorithm, training a non-linear autoregressive neural network NARX model by utilizing a IMSSA algorithm to optimize weight and bias of the NARX neural network, thus establishing a culture water quality prediction model based on IMSSA-NARX, completing a culture water quality prediction experiment based on IMSSA-NARX, and comparing the method with a conventional method. Compared with the prior art, the model provided by the invention has the highest prediction accuracy, and the IMSSA-NARX network model has good performance in the aspect of the prediction of the water quality condition of the cultivation.

title: Financial pre-opening risk assessment system based on intelligent recognition
description: The invention relates to the technical field of financial risk control and discloses a financial pre-opening risk assessment system based on intelligent identification, which comprises a multi-dimensional situation feature acquisition module, a situation analysis processing module, a risk assessment module, a knowledge graph updating module and a crowd-sourced knowledge collection module, wherein the multi-dimensional situation feature acquisition module is used for acquiring multi-dimensional situation features in a pre-opening process, the situation analysis processing module is used for converting the multi-dimensional situation features into situation feature vectors and extracting layering risk features of identified similar situation cases, the risk assessment module is used for generating risk scores and risk classification results, the knowledge graph updating module is used for carrying out quality assessment on newly extracted risk knowledge and dynamically updating a risk knowledge graph based on the assessment results, and the crowd-sourced knowledge collection module is used for forming a continuous optimization closed loop of the risk assessment.

title: Data generation method, device, equipment and medium based on dynamic multi-level prompt words
description: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and can be applied to the field of financial science and technology and the field of medical health, and discloses a data generation method, device, equipment and medium based on dynamic multi-level prompt words, which are applied to a financial market dynamic simulation and risk prediction scene and a multi-mode medical image auxiliary diagnosis generation scene; and generating target scene data by generating a model and performing data generation processing based on the preprocessed data and the multi-level prompt words. The method solves the problems of sparse data, poor consistency of multi-mode generation and insufficient extreme scene data in the intelligent field, and improves the accuracy of data generation.

title: Lightweight point cloud feature extraction method based on deep learning network
description: The invention discloses a lightweight point cloud feature extraction method based on a deep learning network, which utilizes a data enhancement technology to increase the diversity of samples and enhance the generalization capability of the network, adopts a lightweight classification feature extraction module to extract point cloud features in a classification task, adopts a lightweight segmentation feature extraction module to extract local features and further improves segmentation accuracy through global feature extraction in a segmentation task, adopts a Polarization Pooling method to extract global features of the point cloud, and utilizes the global features to complete downstream classification and segmentation tasks. The invention effectively reduces the computation complexity and the storage requirement by introducing the shared one-dimensional convolution, the ultra-light multi-scale feature extraction module and the innovative global feature fusion strategy, and is particularly suitable for environments with limited resources, such as embedded systems and mobile equipment.

title: Method and device for detecting human alertness
description: The present invention provides a method for detecting human alertness. The method includes receiving a bioelectric signal for detecting human alertness; obtaining feature data of the bioelectric signal for detecting human alertness using a vigilance feature extraction model trained through self-supervised learning; and performing human alertness detection using the vigilance detection model based on the feature data of the bioelectric signal.

title: Federal learning model optimization method and system based on meta learning and regularization
description: The invention discloses a federal learning model optimization method and a federal learning model optimization system based on meta learning and regularization, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and data privacy. Aiming at the problems of slow model convergence and insufficient individuation caused by non-independent co-distributed data, the method adopts a meta-learning double-circulation mechanism and regularization collaborative optimization, wherein a central server distributes a global model to a client, the client performs inner circulation gradient update and outer circulation meta-gradient calculation through dividing a support set and a query set to generate update information adapting to local data, simultaneously, L2 regularization items are introduced to restrict parameter difference of the local model and the global model, and the individuation model is optimized in combination with prediction loss. The system realizes collaborative training through a global distribution module, a local adaptation module, a personalized module and an aggregation module, and a server adopts data volume weighting to aggregate client updating. The method and the system effectively improve the generalization capability of the model under heterogeneous data and equalize the prediction difference between clients.

title: Power load prediction method based on climate-user behavior
description: The application provides a power load prediction method based on climate-user behaviors, which comprises the steps of collecting climate data, intelligent ammeter data and historical power load data, generating a comprehensive feature set based on the intelligent ammeter data and the climate data, analyzing the historical power load data by adopting a structural causality model, determining a first proportion of a direct effect of an output climate and an indirect effect of the user behaviors, and determining power load prediction based on the comprehensive feature set and the first proportion. According to the method provided by the application, the direct effect of climate on the power load and the indirect effect through the user behavior are quantified by combining the causal model of the structure and the inverse fact reasoning, so that the prediction accuracy and the result interpretability are obviously improved.

title: Abnormal member early warning marketing management system and method based on customer behaviors
description: The present invention discloses an abnormal member early warning marketing management system and method based on customer behavior, which relates to the technical field of customer behavior early warning. The system includes: a behavior collection and storage module, an analysis and dynamic screening module, an abnormal group marking module, a notification and whitelist management module, and an abnormal member handling module. Its technical points are: accurate monitoring in special scenarios such as flash sales is achieved, further reducing the false alarm rate; combined with the graph attention mechanism, it can distinguish between true group collaboration and accidental behavior overlap; by calculating the attention coefficient between nodes, it focuses on those nodes with strong correlation, reducing false alarms caused by accidental similarity; and adopts a multi-stage verification process to ensure that only users who have passed strict verification will be finally marked as abnormal group members, effectively balancing the reliability and accuracy of the system's abnormal judgment.

title: Pareto optimization-based intelligent photovoltaic array reconstruction system and method
description: The invention discloses an intelligent photovoltaic array reconstruction system and method based on Pareto optimization, wherein the method comprises the steps of 1) modeling an intelligent photovoltaic array reconstruction problem as a Markov decision process; and 2) optimizing a Markov decision process by using a Bi-PPO network to obtain an optimal intelligent photovoltaic array reconstruction scheme, and alternately updating parameters alpha phi, alpha theta and omega i of the Bi-PPO network by using a Pareto optimization algorithm in the optimization process. The invention provides a photovoltaic array optimization method which combines the maximum power output and the minimum switching times, and overcomes the limitation of the traditional method. The technology can effectively improve the overall efficiency of the photovoltaic system, reduce the maintenance cost, prolong the service life of equipment and provide an innovative solution for the intelligent and efficient operation of the photovoltaic power generation system.

title: A method and device for optimizing the design of a multi-winding control transformer for flexible loop closing
description: The invention relates to the field of transformer optimal design, in particular to an optimal design method and equipment of a multi-winding regulation transformer for flexible loop closing, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an optimal design model of the multi-winding regulation transformer for flexible loop closing based on a mathematical model of the transformer; and solving by using a genetic optimization algorithm optimization design model to obtain a global optimal solution of the transformer design, wherein the fitness function in the genetic optimization algorithm is inversely related to the optimization objective function in the optimization design model. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of reducing design cost, improving design precision and efficiency and the like.

title: A method for constructing a learning ability assessment model for personalized learning on an online learning platform
description: The present invention belongs to the field of data processing technology. The present invention provides a method for constructing a learning ability assessment model for personalized learning on an online learning platform. First, the behavioral data and learning resource metadata of the user during the learning process are collected; based on this, an individual behavioral heterogeneous graph, a knowledge system hypergraph, and a knowledge point sequential graph are constructed; then, a learning scenario attention matrix is preset, and a context perception mechanism is determined in combination with the knowledge point sequential graph; finally, a learning ability assessment model is constructed based on the context perception mechanism, the individual behavioral heterogeneous graph, and the knowledge system hypergraph. By constructing an individual behavioral heterogeneous graph, a knowledge system hypergraph, and a knowledge point sequential graph, the present invention deeply integrates the behavioral data generated by the user during the learning process with metadata such as the type, difficulty, and associated knowledge points of the learning resource, thereby achieving accurate modeling of the complex interactive relationship between "user-resource-knowledge point", comprehensively displaying the systematicity and dynamics of the knowledge system, and effectively improving the accuracy of learning ability assessment.

title: Safety detection method and system for contract signing process and electronic equipment
description: The application relates to the field of multi-agent systems, and provides a safety detection method, a system and electronic equipment for a contract signing process, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring information of participants in the contract signing process, and establishing the multi-agent system based on the information of the participants; the method comprises the steps of establishing a first automaton model of the multi-agent system, establishing a second automaton model based on a preset safety detection standard, establishing a product automaton model based on the first automaton model and the second automaton model, and determining that the safety detection in the contract signing process passes if the product automaton model is empty. The method and the system are used for solving the defect that the safety of the contract signing process in the related technology cannot be guaranteed, and the safety detection of the contract signing process can be realized by converting the contract signing process into a multi-agent system and then carrying out the safety detection on the multi-agent system, so that the safety of the contract signing process is guaranteed.

title: Safety evaluation method, system and equipment for intelligent bridge construction
description: The invention provides a safety evaluation method, a system and equipment for an intelligent built bridge, which comprise the steps of collecting associated data in the bridge building process, extracting vibration mode parameters of a bridge structure based on the associated data, carrying out similar theoretical modeling on geometric dimensions and material properties in a bridge design drawing, constructing a physical test model with a reduced scale proportion, simulating mechanical response of the bridge under static loading and dynamic loading, obtaining model test data, obtaining field actual measurement data of the bridge, carrying out dimensionless treatment on the field actual measurement data and the model test data, calculating to obtain similarity criterion deviation degree, carrying out cluster analysis on historical bridge disease case data, establishing a disease feature classification system based on Euclidean distance, matching current detection data of the bridge with the disease feature classification system, identifying the disease type, carrying out comprehensive evaluation on the identified disease type, the similarity criterion deviation degree and the vibration mode parameters, and determining the bridge safety risk level. In the invention, the evaluation result is more accurate.

title: Method and related apparatus for thermal simulation of semiconductor devices
description: The present invention provides a method and related equipment for thermal simulation of semiconductor devices. The method comprises: dividing a plurality of subdomain units from a simulation model; one of each two adjacent subdomain units is a target subdomain unit and the other is a neighboring unit; encoding the thermal characteristics of each subdomain unit by a subdomain encoder to obtain a sampling latent vector group corresponding to each subdomain unit; combining the sampling latent vector group of each target subdomain unit and the corresponding neighboring unit to obtain an input latent vector set corresponding to each target subdomain unit; processing the input latent vector set by a flux conservation autoencoder to obtain an output latent vector set; decoding the output latent vector set by a subdomain decoder corresponding to the subdomain encoder to obtain a target thermal characteristic corresponding to the target subdomain unit. The present invention can solve the problem of excessive computing power consumption in the thermal simulation of the core particle system in the prior art, significantly reduce computing power consumption, and achieve the effect of saving computing power.

title: Multi-template intelligent generation device for donor trails by utilizing image recognition
description: The present invention relates to the field of digital content generation and discloses an intelligent multi-template generation device for donor deeds using image recognition, comprising: an acquisition module for collecting relevant images of donors and performing preprocessing to obtain processed data; a processing module for performing manifold learning on the processed data using a local linear embedding algorithm, estimating the Riemann metric tensor through a graph convolutional network to obtain semantic features, using a superconducting quantum bit array and a variational quantum circuit to perform quantum state preparation to obtain emotional features, and co-optimizing the semantic features and emotional features based on a joint optimization objective function to obtain fused features; and a dynamic module for constructing a directed weighted graph based on the fused features. The device extracts the nonlinear manifold features of the image using a local linear embedding algorithm and a graph convolutional network, and uses a superconducting quantum bit array to perform quantum state encoding of the emotional information, and achieves deep fusion of the semantic and emotional features through a joint optimization objective function.

title: Transformer winding leakage magnetic field distribution calculation method and system
description: The invention discloses a transformer winding leakage magnetic field distribution calculation method which comprises the steps of establishing a transformer finite element model, calculating a transformer winding space distribution leakage magnetic field, constructing a transformer winding leakage magnetic field calculation model through a cyclic neural network, training the transformer winding leakage magnetic field calculation model through a calculation result of the space distribution leakage magnetic field to obtain a trained transformer winding leakage magnetic field calculation model, obtaining a space distribution leakage magnetic field actually measured at a selected position of a transformer winding, inputting the space distribution leakage magnetic field into the transformer winding leakage magnetic field calculation model, outputting the space distribution leakage magnetic field of a transformer winding target position, and fitting the obtained space distribution leakage magnetic field distribution by a least square method to obtain final transformer winding leakage magnetic field distribution. According to the invention, through fusion of the echo state network dynamic modeling and the least square optimization algorithm, the rapid and accurate calculation of the leakage magnetic field of the whole region of the transformer winding is realized.

title: Intensity format SAR image speckle noise suppression method based on intensity complex domain conversion network
description: The present invention relates to the field of image noise suppression and discloses a method for suppressing speckle noise in an intensity-format SAR image based on an intensity-complex domain conversion network. The method comprises: constructing an intensity-complex domain conversion network; training the intensity-complex domain conversion network by adopting a self-built supervised learning method; inputting an intensity-format SAR image damaged by speckle noise into the trained intensity-complex domain conversion network to obtain an image in a complex domain format; constructing and pre-training a multi-receptive field spatial attention speckle suppression network; inputting the image in a complex domain format into the trained multi-receptive field spatial attention speckle suppression network to obtain an output high-dimensional feature vector; constructing and pre-training an intensity domain detail restoration network; inputting the high-dimensional feature vector into the trained intensity domain detail restoration network to obtain a finally restored intensity-format SAR image after speckle noise suppression. The present invention can restore the intensity-format SAR image damaged by speckle noise with high fidelity.

title: Concha area vagus nerve stimulation device and pattern recognition method of output waveform thereof
description: The present invention relates to the field of pattern recognition technology, and more specifically to a method for pattern recognition of a vagus nerve stimulation device in the concha area and its output waveform, which comprises the following steps: real-time acquisition of current waveform data output by the vagus nerve stimulation device in the concha area; manual annotation of the raw current waveform data; generation of a reference current by the vagus nerve stimulation device in the concha area according to hardware parameter configuration; generation of an inertial component base matrix for the raw current waveform data using a simulator guided by physical properties; construction of a pattern recognition model, inputting the raw current waveform data in a data set into the pattern recognition model for pattern recognition prediction; alternating training of a neural network in the model; and correction of the model's classification results based on the reference current, ultimately generating a corrected classification probability. By effectively distinguishing between the inherent pattern of the waveform and distortion caused by inertia, the present invention can avoid the loss of important and effective features during the recognition process, thereby improving the accuracy of the recognition results.

title: Knowledge graph updating method, electronic device and storage medium
description: The application belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to a knowledge graph updating method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a target newly added document and extracting a candidate triplet; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-dimensional conflict detection on candidate triples, determining correction triples based on a large model, an external knowledge base and the candidate triples when the candidate triples do not pass the multi-dimensional conflict detection, determining target triples based on the correction triples and the existing triples in the knowledge graph to be updated, and updating the knowledge graph to be updated based on the target triples. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the flow processing, the multi-mode verification and the dynamic weight technology are fused, the triples are extracted in real time through the RAG model, the conflict is accurately identified by combining a semantic embedding, aging range and an external knowledge base triple verification mechanism, a correction strategy is generated by utilizing a large model, the confidence of new and old knowledge is balanced by adopting a weighted fusion algorithm, second-level updating is realized, and the efficiency and the accuracy of knowledge map updating are improved.

title: Recommendation model training method, object recommendation method, device and storage medium
description: The application discloses a training method of a recommendation model, a method, equipment and a storage medium for recommending objects, and belongs to the technical field of computers. In the method, sample data are acquired, conversion labels of the sample data are acquired every day in the delayed 0 th day to the delayed nth day, the sample data are respectively processed through the n+1 towers, the predicted conversion rate of the sample data every day in the delayed 0 th day to the delayed nth day is determined, training loss values are determined based on the predicted conversion rate of the sample data every day in the delayed 0 th day to the delayed nth day and the conversion labels of the sample data every day in the delayed 0 th day to the delayed nth day, and parameter optimization is performed on the recommendation model based on the training loss values until convergence conditions are achieved, so that a trained target recommendation model is obtained. According to the application, the sample data within N days is supplemented, so that deviation caused by delayed transformation is reduced, and the recommendation accuracy of the recommendation model is improved.

title: A collaborative reasoning method, device and medium based on multi-expert model
description: The embodiments of this specification disclose a collaborative reasoning method, device and medium based on multiple expert models, which relate to the field of collaborative reasoning technology. The method includes: receiving multiple reasoning task requests to obtain task feature information of each reasoning task; performing task allocation based on the task feature information of each reasoning task and pre-acquired model registration information to determine at least one assigned expert model corresponding to each reasoning task; predicting the model load of each assigned expert model to adjust the at least one assigned expert model corresponding to each reasoning task according to the predicted load rate to determine the corresponding at least one target expert model; sending each reasoning task to the corresponding target expert model, collecting the single model reasoning data of each target expert model through an asynchronous message queue, and determining the collaborative reasoning result corresponding to each reasoning task through the single model reasoning data of each target expert model.

title: A personalized career development method and device based on Markov decision making
description: The present application discloses a method and device for personalized training of the entire career cycle based on Markov decision-making, which relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology.
