The method plans an optimal training path that meets organizational goals and employee personalized requirements based on employee portrait data, project portrait data, training portrait data, enterprise complete job portrait data and multi-dimensional evaluation results based on the Markov decision process. The optimal training path not only takes into account the current capabilities and job requirements of employees, but also takes into account the potential and direction of future development of employees. Based on the optimal training path, it ensures that employees can smoothly adapt to job requirements and achieve the simultaneous improvement of personal career development and organizational goals, providing enterprises and employees with more intelligent and personalized training and development programs, and improving the efficiency of employee career management.

title: Intelligent diagnosis method for furnace tube leakage based on big data AI
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of intelligent diagnosis of furnace tubes, and in particular to an intelligent diagnosis method for furnace tube leakage based on big data AI. The method collects boiler operation data in real time through multi-source sensors, including temperature, pressure, vibration, sound waves and flue gas composition data; performs time series alignment, outlier removal and standardization preprocessing on the collected raw data; inputs the preprocessed data into a pre-trained deep neural network model, which is obtained by comparing and training historical normal data with leakage accident data; generates real-time diagnosis results and warning levels based on the leakage probability value and feature contribution analysis output by the model; the present invention realizes early, accurate and automated diagnosis of boiler tube leakage through multi-source perception, AI deep analysis, dynamic warning and predictive maintenance closed loop, significantly improving the safety and operation and maintenance efficiency of industrial equipment.

title: Power transaction violation identification method and system
description: The present invention discloses a method for identifying power trading violations. The method comprises generating a data set of declarations from power market entities participating in power market transactions based on a Monte Carlo simulation scheme, and processing the data to obtain a training data set; selecting several candidate transaction violation identification indicators and constructing a joint transaction violation identification indicator based on correlation; constructing an initial model for power trading violation identification, and performing training and optimization to obtain a power trading violation identification model; and using the obtained power trading violation identification model to perform actual power trading violation identification. The present invention also discloses a system for implementing the power trading violation identification method. The present invention not only enables power trading violation identification, but also achieves higher reliability, better accuracy, and higher efficiency.

title: Image defogging quality evaluation method, device and storage medium
description: The invention provides an image defogging quality evaluation method, an image defogging quality evaluation device and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of image evaluation, wherein the method comprises the steps of importing a plurality of defogging images to be evaluated and an original foggy day image; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing each defogging image to be evaluated to obtain preprocessed defogging images, carrying out feature analysis on each preprocessed defogging image and an original foggy day image through a training model to obtain target defogging feature images, and carrying out evaluation analysis on each target defogging feature image to obtain an evaluation result of defogging quality of the images. The invention realizes the cooperative sensing of the image content, distortion and fog density information, improves the accuracy and subjective consistency of image quality assessment, and has strong practical value and popularization potential.

title: Remote sensing image segmentation method and system based on multi-scale context enhancement
description: The invention discloses a remote sensing image segmentation method and a remote sensing image segmentation system based on multi-scale context enhancement, which relate to the technical field of remote sensing image processing and comprise the steps of acquiring a remote sensing image to be processed and inputting the remote sensing image to a global-local fusion network to obtain multi-scale characteristics; the method comprises the steps of inputting multi-scale features into a cascading fusion network to obtain a first processing feature, a second processing feature, a third processing feature and an integration feature, inputting the multi-scale features into the multi-scale context fusion network to obtain multi-scale semantic features based on the integration feature, respectively fusing the multi-scale semantic features with the first processing feature, the second processing feature and the third processing feature to correspondingly obtain a first fusion feature, a second fusion feature and a third fusion feature, fusing the first fusion feature, the second fusion feature and the third fusion feature to obtain cascading features, and inputting the cascading features into a result output network to obtain a segmentation prediction result of a remote sensing image. The segmentation precision of complex ground object boundaries and small targets in the remote sensing image is effectively improved.

title: Method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium for monitoring and evaluating recurrence of spartina alterniflora
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of recurrence monitoring after secondary invasion in a spartina alterniflora removal treatment area, and provides a spartina alterniflora recurrence monitoring and evaluation method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of remote sensing image collection, normal area rejection processing, area risk data generation, unmanned aerial vehicle acquisition path formulation, color image and multiband image acquisition and high-accuracy monitoring and evaluation; the method and the device have the advantages that the normal area removing processing is carried out on the satellite remote sensing image, the information irrelevant to the spartina alterniflora is directly removed, the complexity of model input data is reduced, the sensitivity of the model to abnormal information is improved, the satellite remote sensing monitoring speed and the unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring accuracy are simultaneously achieved through the low-accuracy monitoring model and the high-accuracy monitoring and evaluating model, the monitoring reliability is further improved through the two-stage monitoring, the appearance characteristics of the spartina alterniflora are highlighted through the processing of the color image and the multiband image, the image characteristics are optimized, and the model monitoring accuracy is improved.

title: Power load prediction method based on periodic pattern decomposition and double-flow architecture
description: The present invention discloses a power load forecasting method based on periodic pattern decomposition and a dual-stream architecture. The method comprises the following steps: first, constructing a power load data sequence input and decomposing the original sequence into a periodic component and a residual component using a learnable cyclic period module; second, using the dual-stream architecture to process the two decomposed components separately, wherein the linear stream uses a multi-layer perceptron to process the linear features of the residual component, and the nonlinear stream uses a convolutional neural network based on block technology to process the nonlinear spatiotemporal pattern of the periodic component; third, using a feature connection module to fuse the dual-stream outputs; and finally, combining the inverse tangent loss function and the sigmoid learning rate adjustment strategy to optimize the model training process and generate the final forecast results. Experimental results show that the proposed method performs well on power load datasets, with the advantages of explicitly modeling periodic patterns, effectively separating sequence components, high forecasting accuracy, excellent parameter efficiency, and strong training stability. Compared with existing methods, it significantly improves both the MSE and MAE indicators.

title: Spatial omics data completion method and system based on variational graph autoencoder
description: The invention provides a space histology data complement method and a space histology data complement system based on a variogram self-encoder, and relates to the technical field of bioinformatics. Extracting genes shared by parts in the data pair to obtain a feature matrix, obtaining a first sub-adjacent matrix of cells in the space transcriptome sequencing data based on space position information, respectively obtaining a second sub-adjacent matrix of cells in the single-cell RNA sequencing data and a third sub-adjacent matrix of cells in the data pair based on gene expression similarity, combining the first sub-adjacent matrix, the second sub-adjacent matrix and the third sub-adjacent matrix to obtain a final adjacent matrix, and inputting the feature matrix and the final adjacent matrix into a pre-trained variogram self-encoder network to complete the complementation of the space transcriptome deletion genes. The invention can effectively utilize the position information and gene expression characteristics among idle data cells, not only can reduce errors, but also can improve the similarity of the complement genes and the true values.

title: An intelligent recovery system for water-flooded layers in oil reservoirs based on pulse neural networks
description: The invention provides an intelligent recovery system for an oil reservoir flooding layer based on a pulse neural network, which belongs to the technical field of petroleum exploration and development and comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a model training module, a resistivity recovery module and a flooding layer interpretation module. The method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-mode data such as a conventional well logging curve and an electrical well logging curve by a data acquisition module, performing extremely poor normalization and Z-Score normalization on the data by a data preprocessing module, constructing a resistivity recovery model by a model training module through a pulse neural network, optimizing and verifying the resistivity recovery model in various modes, recovering the original resistivity by the resistivity recovery module, and determining and classifying a flooding layer by a flooding layer interpretation module based on calculation related parameters of the flooding layer interpretation module. The intelligent recovery system for the oil deposit flooding layer based on the impulse neural network is used for recovering the resistivity of the flooding layer with high precision, accurately quantifying the flooding effect and providing a scientific and reliable basis for oil deposit development and adjustment.

title: Smart wearable device interactive control method, device, storage medium and electronic device
description: The embodiment of the application discloses an intelligent wearable device interaction control method, an intelligent wearable device interaction control device, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and acquiring user interaction data, determining a user emotion state and a target story theme based on the user interaction data, calling a story writing big model to perform story writing processing based on the user emotion state and the target story theme to obtain complete story content, and storing the complete story content. Therefore, the intelligent wearing equipment determines the emotion state of the user and the subject of the target story through the user interaction data, and invokes the story writing big model to write the story, so that complete story content is obtained, the story creation function of the intelligent wearing equipment is realized, and the interaction function of the intelligent sensing equipment in the aspect of story creation is enriched.

title: A method for predictive maintenance of equipment based on deep learning
description: This application relates to the field of equipment diagnosis and specifically discloses a method for predictive maintenance of equipment based on deep learning, which includes: performing time-domain amplitude normalization and frequency-domain weighted normalization on the training data, and then performing dual-channel feature fusion to obtain a fused feature vector; using multiple sets of adaptive wavelet kernels to extract features from the fused feature vector to obtain an adaptive time-frequency feature vector; constructing a weight population through statistical characteristics to screen the optimal initial weights of the initial diagnosis model; iteratively updating the initial diagnosis model by performing multi-scale deep feature calculation, time-frequency domain attention feature fusion, fault prototype comparative learning, and a pre-constructed total loss function on the adaptive time-frequency feature vector to obtain a diagnostic model; and diagnosing the equipment using the diagnostic model. Multi-scale feature fusion and the dual-path attention mechanism can collaboratively capture short-term shocks and long-term patterns, overcoming the limitations of traditional methods in diverse fault scenarios.

title: A torch combustion monitoring and optimization control system based on multispectral infrared and visible light imaging
description: The application discloses a flare combustion monitoring and optimizing control system based on multispectral infrared and visible light imaging, which comprises a multispectral imaging module, a physical model calculation module, an artificial intelligent calculation module, a data fusion and correction module and a closed-loop control module, wherein the multispectral imaging module is used for synchronously acquiring an infrared image and a visible light image of flare flame and performing spatial registration to acquire multispectral radiation data of the flame, the physical model calculation module is used for calculating a first combustion state parameter according to the multispectral radiation data based on a Planckian radiation formula and a gray body radiation model, the artificial intelligent calculation module adopts a pre-trained multiscale vision transducer network and calculates a second combustion state parameter according to the multispectral radiation data, the data fusion and correction module is used for fusing and correcting the first combustion state parameter and the second combustion state parameter by adopting a Kalman filtering algorithm to output a final combustion state parameter, and the closed-loop control module is used for dynamically adjusting the operation parameter of the flare according to the final combustion state parameter to optimize combustion efficiency.

title: Hospital resource scheduling system and method based on spatiotemporal graph neural network
description: The present application relates to the field of artificial intelligence and provides a hospital resource scheduling system and method based on a spatiotemporal graph neural network. The method: collects multidimensional operational data of medical equipment and medical service terminals through a multimodal sensor network in medical equipment and medical service terminals; based on the multidimensional operational data, the geographical locations of medical equipment and medical service terminals, determines the real-time medical scenario through a first-level scheduling model based on a spatiotemporal graph neural network, and predicts the resource scheduling chain matching each real-time medical scenario through a second-level scheduling model matching different medical scenarios; constructs a virtual resource mapping of the hospital model based on the resource scheduling chain, simulates the execution effect of the scheduling scheme of different candidate diagnosis and treatment paths in the resource scheduling chain in real time through digital twin technology, and allows users with corresponding permissions to select the target diagnosis and treatment path and the corresponding scheduling scheme to be finally adopted, thereby realizing intelligent scheduling of medical resources and improving the efficiency of medical resource scheduling.

title: Method, electronic device and program product for determining computational fluid dynamics data
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method, electronic device, and computer program product for determining Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) data. The method includes obtaining a set of spatial coordinates associated with a target object. The method further includes determining a set of position encodings associated with the set of spatial coordinates. The method further includes determining CFD data associated with the target object using a machine learning model based on the position-coded set, wherein the set of sample space coordinates associated with training of the machine learning model includes a plurality of subsets of sample space coordinates acquired by uniform spatial sampling. In this way, it is possible to reduce the cost of acquiring CFD data and to increase the speed of acquiring CFD data.

title: Instant messaging AI auxiliary method, system and medium based on multi-mode fusion
description: The present invention relates to the field of instant messaging technology, and more particularly to an AI-assisted instant messaging method, system, and medium based on multimodal fusion. The method comprises: activating the system through a dual-trigger mechanism, comprising a message long-press trigger and a floating button trigger; employing an improved message relevance algorithm to dynamically identify relevant conversation content and construct an intelligent analysis engine comprising a data access layer, a feature processing layer, and a model calculation layer; implementing a dynamic two-factor authorization mechanism to generate a time-sensitive encrypted token; and automatically generating a structured communication summary report. This solution significantly enhances the communication assistance effect in instant messaging scenarios through innovative multimodal fusion technology and dynamic interaction mechanisms. The system employs an improved message relevance algorithm to achieve precise context analysis, and combined with the BERT-GRU hybrid model and adaptive spectrum analysis technology, it increases the accuracy of cross-modal feature recognition by over 15%, achieving a speech recognition accuracy of 92.4% on the VOiCES test set.

title: Self-adaptive spectrum monitoring and interference suppression method for railway power transformer
description: The invention discloses a self-adaptive spectrum monitoring and interference suppression method for a railway power transformer, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting original multi-source signal data, S2, carrying out high-order filtering and Z-score normalization processing on the original multi-source signal, S3, inputting the original multi-source signal into a multi-scale residual fusion time-frequency conversion network, extracting a time-frequency characteristic tensor, S4, inputting the time-frequency characteristic tensor into an interference recognition network of a fusion attention mechanism, S5, dynamically activating an interference suppression module according to a recognition result, S6, constructing a multi-dimensional tensor data structure, extracting sparse dictionary morphological characteristics and spectral domain statistics, generating a composite characteristic vector set, S7, inputting the composite characteristic vector into a health state evaluation module, and S8, uploading a diagnosis result to a remote monitoring platform through an embedded communication module. The invention integrates multidimensional sensing and self-adaptive modeling, and realizes intelligent fault identification and remote monitoring of the railway transformer.

title: Saliency target detection method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a salient target detection method, system, electronic device and storage medium, and relates to the technical field of salient target detection. In the method, a constructed salient target detection model is trained based on multiple sample images. In the constructed salient target detection model, multiple local detail features and multiple global semantic features of the target sample image are extracted by a dual-branch encoder. After interactively fusing some local detail features with all local detail features, multiple enhanced local detail features and multiple enhanced global detail features are obtained. Each enhanced local detail feature and the corresponding enhanced global detail feature are feature spliced. After combining all spliced features and the remaining local detail features and processing them through an edge-aware enhancement module and a decoder, a salient target detection result is obtained. The trained salient target detection model is used to accurately detect salient targets on the target image.

title: Image processing method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present invention disclose an image processing method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium. The method includes obtaining a first sample set and a second sample set, training a prediction model based on video images of adjacent frames in a first video image sequence in the first sample set, and training a target segmentation model based on video images of adjacent frames in a second video image sequence in the second sample set having parameter information, wherein the parameter information includes motion parameters and camera parameters. Thus, in this embodiment, by training and determining the target segmentation model and predicting and using the motion parameters and camera parameters during model training, the efficiency of model training can be improved while ensuring the reliability of the model output results.

title: Rotary machine fault diagnosis method and system based on multichannel data
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and equipment fault diagnosis, and provides a rotating machinery fault diagnosis method and system based on multi-channel data. The basic probability distribution of each channel is obtained according to the frequency domain energy significance adjustment. In the frequency domain energy significance adjustment, the signal weights of the X-axis and Y-axis are dynamically adjusted according to the importance, the contribution of the low-frequency periodic signal is strengthened, and the weight corresponding to the high-frequency impact signal of the Z-axis is increased; the similarity between the signals of different channels is measured through the consistency index of each channel signal, and the consistency of the signal is enhanced through consistency adjustment; the degree of conflict between different channels is quantified; for the conflict between the X-axis and Y-axis signals and the Z-axis signal, the weight of the signal with greater conflict is reduced according to the frequency domain energy, significance and consistency of the signal, and the weight of each channel can be dynamically adjusted to ensure that the key signals are fully utilized and effectively suppress the influence of redundant and conflicting information.

title: Wind farm power prediction method, system and medium under extreme weather
description: The invention discloses a wind power plant power prediction method, a system and a medium under extreme weather, which belong to the technical field of renewable energy power generation prediction, and comprise the steps of obtaining historical weather characteristic data and corresponding wind power plant power data, screening out weather characteristics highly correlated with the wind power plant power data through maximum mutual information coefficients, processing the wind power plant power data by adopting a CEEMDAN method and a VDM method and combining a sample entropy analysis and wavelet packet threshold denoising method to obtain a wind power plant power sequence with noise suppression and characteristic enhancement, constructing a wind power plant power prediction model for predicting wind power plant power under extreme weather according to a BiLSTM network after super parameter combination optimization based on the weather characteristics and the wind power plant power sequence with noise suppression and characteristic enhancement, and carrying out interval shrinkage reconstruction on wind power plant power under future extreme weather through time sequence similarity to obtain a final prediction result of wind power plant power under extreme weather.

title: Abnormality detection method, device and equipment for automobile die casting image and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of image anomaly detection, and in particular to a method, device, equipment and storage medium for anomaly detection of automobile die-casting images. Feature extraction is performed on normal images of automobile die-castings and constructed abnormal images of automobile die-castings. Feature fusion is performed on feature extraction maps corresponding to the obtained normal images of automobile die-castings and the corresponding abnormal images of automobile die-castings to perform anomaly detection. Abnormal probability maps corresponding to several normal images of automobile die-castings are obtained. Model training is performed in combination with abnormal mask images constructed based on the normal images of automobile die-castings, so that the trained model can effectively extract abnormal information in the image and improve the accuracy of anomaly detection.

title: A data processing method for assisting the elderly based on smartwatches
description: The invention relates to the field of wearable equipment and discloses a data processing method based on an intelligent watch for assisting an elderly person, which comprises the steps of establishing an individual physiological baseline library of the elderly person at the intelligent watch end, collecting dislocation difference between signals and the baseline library in real time through dynamic comparison, performing behavior interference separation on individual compensation sequences, generating an interference stripped health time sequence characteristic block based on a multi-scene embedding model, introducing an event entropy triggering mechanism into the health time sequence characteristic block, automatically marking the health time sequence characteristic block as a candidate health abnormal event when drift rate exceeds an individual self-adaptive threshold, marking a signal source corresponding to the candidate health abnormal event as a local feedback loop node, carrying out coupling correction on signals in the local feedback loop, combining global circadian rhythm change trend and abnormal event accumulation weight based on a health monitoring priority feedback map, and generating a multi-level interaction prompt instruction. The invention has the advantage of improving the accuracy of the health monitoring data of the old.

title: A dynamic risk assessment system for dialysis complications
description: This invention relates to the field of dialysis and discloses a dynamic risk assessment system for dialysis complications. The system includes a data acquisition module for real-time acquisition of multi-source patient data; a data preprocessing module for outlier detection and processing using an isolated forest algorithm and imputation of missing values in the multi-source data using an Attention-GAN network; a feature fusion module for feature fusion of the cleaned multi-source data using a cross-modal attention fusion algorithm to generate a comprehensive feature vector; a model building module for constructing a ResNet-GRU hybrid model based on the comprehensive feature vector and introducing a dynamic feature attention mechanism; and a risk assessment module for inputting patient data to be assessed into the ResNet-GRU hybrid model to obtain risk assessment results. This invention significantly improves the timeliness and accuracy of the assessment.

title: Interpretable human behavior recognition method based on time-feature decoupling decision path
description: This invention discloses an interpretable human behavior recognition method based on a time-feature decoupled decision path. It ensures standardized input of multi-source time-series data, effectively captures time dependencies using an xLSTM variant, uses a hierarchical decision tree to correct classification results with soft probability and visualize the decision path, integrates gradient technology to locate key spatiotemporal features, and achieves high accuracy and interpretability of human behavior recognition by fusing xLSTM feature extraction, hierarchical decision tree inference, and integrated gradient attribution. Experimental results verify the effectiveness of the framework and provide certain technical support for transparent decision-making in scenarios such as the industrial metaverse.

title: Multi-energy complementary system site selection-volume fixing-operation closed loop collaborative optimization method based on geographic information system
description: The invention discloses a dynamic collaborative optimization method of a multi-energy complementary system based on a geographic information system, and belongs to the technical field of energy system optimization. Aiming at the bottleneck problems of operation feedback deficiency, planning and scheduling disjointing and the like in the prior art, a real-time optimization framework of space evaluation-capacity allocation-operation verification-closed loop adjustment is provided. The method has the innovation points that an hour-level operation model is built through mixed integer programming, actual performance of capacity configuration is accurately quantized, a bidirectional feedback channel is built, operation indexes such as load electricity shortage rate, electricity rejection rate and the like are fed back to an upper-layer capacity decision in real time, and dynamic balance of economy and reliability is achieved through an improved NSGA-II algorithm. The invention obviously enhances the adaptability of the system to uncertainty, ensures the continuous optimization of the planning scheme in the whole life cycle, and provides a self-adaptive decision tool for the renewable energy system.

title: Marketing System Based on Intelligent Analysis of Multimodal Document Data
description: The invention provides a marketing system based on multi-mode literature data intelligent analysis, which automatically identifies and analyzes scientific research literatures in various formats through an literature analysis and preprocessing module to extract structured information, wherein an AI (advanced information technology) enhancement analysis module utilizes a large model to deeply mine literature semantics, a data processing and integration module cleans and integrates information and constructs researcher portraits containing identity, interests, technology, equipment and requirement prediction five dimensions so as to generate a personalized marketing strategy, a cache management module optimizes result storage and retrieval efficiency, and a batch processing module coordinates a multi-file parallel processing flow. The method realizes deep mining and accurate marketing of the multisource scientific research literature, and remarkably improves information extraction accuracy and marketing conversion efficiency.

title: Multimodal health risk prediction methods, devices, electronic equipment, and media
description: The embodiment of the application provides a health risk prediction method and device based on multiple modes, electronic equipment and a storage medium, belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and is suitable for financial scenes. The method comprises the steps of obtaining at least two mode data of a query text, a query image and physiological index data of a target user, extracting text features of the query text, extracting image features of the query image, extracting physiological index features of the physiological index data, fusing the text features, the image features and the physiological index features to obtain target health state features, and predicting health risks of the target user according to the target health state features. According to the embodiment of the application, the health risk prediction is performed on the target user based on the fused text, image and physiological index multi-modal characteristics, so that the problem that the health risk prediction is inaccurate possibly caused by a single data source can be fundamentally solved, and the accuracy of the health risk prediction is improved.

title: A multi-center clinical data management system and method based on multimodal acquisition
description: This invention discloses a multi-center clinical data management system and method based on multimodal acquisition, relating to the field of clinical data management. The system includes constructing a disease modality map, which comprises multiple disease nodes and multiple modality type nodes. Edges between disease nodes and modality type nodes represent the dependency relationship between a disease and its corresponding modality type in historical cases. The system receives the preliminary diagnostic label of the current case. Based on the disease modality map, it retrieves connected modality type nodes from disease nodes related to the current case and generates a modality fusion path for the case according to modality fusion order information and modality statistical weights. Finally, it performs feature-level fusion operations based on the modality fusion path. This invention can automatically generate personalized modality fusion paths according to different diseases, achieving more accurate, efficient, and medically consistent multimodal data processing and fusion.

title: Boss-PSO-BP neural network-based cyromazine detection method fused with ultraviolet-fluorescence spectrum
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of pesticide residue detection, and particularly discloses a method for detecting cyromazine based on a BOSS-PSO-BP neural network by fusing ultraviolet-fluorescence spectrum, which comprises the following steps of preparing 2.25X10  ‑6 ~1.47×10 ‑4  mg/mL gradient concentration cyromazine samples for training the neural network, detecting samples with different concentrations by using an LS55 fluorescence spectrophotometer and an UV-6300 ultraviolet spectrophotometer respectively to complete data acquisition, carrying out maximum and minimum normalization treatment on the ultraviolet spectrum and the fluorescence spectrum respectively to unify data scales and carrying out data preprocessing, adopting a BOSS algorithm to screen key wavelengths, optimizing the BP neural network by adopting the PSO algorithm, evaluating indexes such as decision coefficients, RMSE and relative errors after training is completed, storing network parameters after meeting requirements, and applying the network parameters to prediction of samples to be detected. Compared with a single spectrum model, the detection method disclosed by the invention has the advantages that the accuracy is improved by about 30%, and the detection accuracy of trace pesticides in complex water bodies is obviously enhanced.

title: Method and system for predicting weather forecast time sequence based on Transformer
description: The invention discloses a weather forecast time sequence prediction method and a weather forecast time sequence prediction system based on a transducer, wherein the weather forecast time sequence prediction method and the weather forecast time sequence prediction system based on the transducer comprise the following steps of S1, normalizing a time sequence to obtain a standardized sequence, S2, dividing the standardized sequence into small blocks, adding time and channel position codes, projecting the small blocks into a high-dimensional space through mapping, S3, dividing the sequence into blocks, sequentially stacking the blocks into composite units, sequentially processing the units through an integrated perception fusion module, layer normalization, a convolution feedforward network, layer normalization and downsampling, S4, carrying out projection mapping on top layer features, carrying out inverse normalization to obtain a prediction model, S5, inputting a training set into the prediction model to train to obtain a prediction value, comparing the prediction value with a true value, calculating loss, calculating the loss on a verification set after each training round is finished, conforming to conditions, stopping iterating, storing an optimal model, and predicting a test set through the trained optimal model, and comparing the prediction result with a true result through error evaluation index.

title: Carbon footprint accounting method and system based on machine learning
description: The invention relates to a carbon footprint accounting method and system based on machine learning, and relates to the technical field of carbon footprint management, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining activity sequences, factor sequences and characteristic sequences of all process parameters of a plurality of historical life cycles of the same product; the method comprises the steps of calculating the isolation significance degree, interaction significance degree and feature significance degree of all process parameters relative to each emission factor based on a factor sequence and a feature sequence, dividing the feature sequence of the process parameters into a plurality of samples, calculating the relative importance degree of each sample, constructing a loss function based on the relative importance degree of the samples, constructing an emission factor prediction model, training based on the loss function, acquiring data of the current life cycle of a product, obtaining a predicted emission factor based on the trained emission factor prediction model, and calculating the total carbon footprint of the product. The invention can improve the prediction accuracy of the emission factors and effectively improve the accuracy of the calculation of the carbon footprint.

title: Prostate cancer diagnosis method based on multi-mode large model prompt learning mechanism
description: The invention belongs to the field of characterization learning, and particularly relates to a prostate cancer diagnosis method based on a multi-mode large model prompt learning mechanism. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing data in the step 1, calculating key frames and similarity, compressing irrelevant clips in the step 2, aligning and training texts and images in the step 3, and in the step 4, testing the step, providing a screening mechanism based on the similarity, primarily screening ultrasonic videos under coarse-granularity labels under the division of a large model, focusing on focus areas in time sequence, and simultaneously providing a preprocessing mechanism based on the large model, wherein the influence of a large amount of irrelevant information on the model in the ultrasonic image scanning of the prostate is compressed at a data end, so that the diagnosis effect of the model is improved.

title: Adjustable coding and deep learning reconstruction inversion method and system for infrared spectrum detection chip
description: The invention discloses an adjustable coding and deep learning reconstruction inversion method for an infrared spectrum detection chip, which comprises the steps of constructing a spectral response matrix of a target infrared spectrum detector, forming a training set by a real spectrum curve and photocurrent data under corresponding different voltage channels, constructing an initial model based on the spectral response matrix and a deep learning network frame, wherein the initial model comprises a data preprocessing module, a characteristic extraction module, a characteristic fusion module and a prediction module, training the initial model by using the training set to obtain a reconstruction model for reconstructing the spectrum curve, and inputting the photocurrent data acquired by the target infrared spectrum detector into the reconstruction model to output the spectrum curve corresponding to the photocurrent data. The invention also provides an adjustable coding and depth learning reconstruction inversion system. The method provided by the invention can obviously improve the resolution and noise resistance of the spectrum reconstruction of the infrared spectrum detector.

title: Battery capacity fading mode quantification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The application provides a battery capacity fading mode quantification method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein a two-dimensional matrix is built based on pseudo-open-circuit voltage curves of an aged lithium battery and a fresh lithium battery, the two-dimensional matrix is input into a deep learning model to output a capacity fading mode of the lithium battery, the capacity fading mode is a capacity fading path of the lithium battery at an electrode layer, and the deep learning model of the second type lithium battery is determined according to the difference of the shapes of charging curves of the first type lithium battery and the second type lithium battery. According to the application, a two-dimensional data matrix is constructed through pseudo-open circuit voltage curves of the aged lithium battery and the fresh lithium battery, a deep learning model is input to output a degradation path of the lithium battery at an electrode layer, and a deep learning model component of a cross-type lithium battery is optimized by combining a migration learning strategy, so that accurate quantitative analysis of capacity degradation modes of the electrode layers of batteries of different chemical systems is realized.

title: Content recommendation method and system based on industry knowledge graph and reinforcement learning
description: The invention discloses a content recommendation method and a system based on industry knowledge graph and reinforcement learning, which relate to the technical field of advertisement recommendation and comprise the steps of collecting original advertisement data and user behavior data, carrying out entity identification, relation extraction and attribute extraction to construct an industry knowledge graph, analyzing the association strength between different mode entity nodes in the industry knowledge graph by adopting a graph attention network, dynamically recombining advertisement elements according to the association strength to generate a personalized advertisement material package, mapping the personalized advertisement material package into an action space of reinforcement learning, extracting a user history behavior path construction state space from the industry knowledge graph to obtain a reinforcement learning environment, mapping user behavior nodes into a relation chain of the industry knowledge graph in the reinforcement learning environment, distributing rewarding values to intermediate nodes to construct an RL strategy model, realizing deep modeling and strategy optimization of user behavior intention, and enhancing the correlation of recommended content and the intelligence of decision.

title: Large-scale code library analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: This invention discloses a method, apparatus, device, and storage medium for analyzing large-scale codebases. The method includes: performing a first parsing process on a code file to obtain a code knowledge graph corresponding to the code file, and storing the code knowledge graph in a graph database; performing a second parsing process on the code file based on the code knowledge graph to obtain the semantic logic corresponding to the code file, and storing the semantic logic in a vector database; and performing a retrieval based on the graph database and the vector database to return the retrieval results corresponding to the user's query request. Because this invention performs a first parsing process on the code file to obtain a code knowledge graph, then performs a second parsing process on the code file based on the code knowledge graph to obtain semantic logic, and stores the code knowledge graph in a graph database and the semantic logic in a vector database, it improves the interpretability and maintainability of large-scale codebases, thereby improving the accuracy and efficiency of large-scale codebase retrieval.

title: Fault diagnosis method of onboard relay for railway full-electronic interlocking system
description: This invention relates to the field of railway fully electronic interlocking systems, specifically to a fault diagnosis method for onboard relays used in such systems. The method includes the following steps: S1, constructing an onboard relay test case library and statistically analyzing fault conditions and probabilities; S2, generating an onboard relay fault tree; S3, fusing the fault tree with a Bayesian network to obtain an analysis model; S4, collecting actual operating parameters of the onboard relays used in railway fully electronic interlocking systems, conducting tests according to the test cases in the library, obtaining and marking abnormal parameters, and matching these abnormal parameters with the model; S5, generating a fault report after testing, recording the fault occurrence time, fault phenomenon, fault cause, and fault location. This invention can quickly diagnose and locate faults using abnormal operating parameters of onboard relays, significantly improving fault diagnosis efficiency and ensuring the operational safety of railway fully electronic interlocking systems.

title: Thermal stress balance design method and module layout of power supply modularized system
description: The invention discloses a thermal stress balance design method and a module layout of a power supply modularized system, comprising the following steps: constructing a thermoelectric cooperative coupling network: designing a large-current bus between power supply modules into a heat pipe-conductor composite structure, wherein the inner layer is a conductive core, the outer layer is wrapped with a heat pipe structure, and utilizing joule heat generated by current to drive a heat pipe working medium to circulate so as to synchronously realize electric energy transmission and heat evacuation; dynamic load balancing regulation: through thermal stress feedback regulation module power distribution, when certain module temperature exceeds the threshold value, based on the prediction control algorithm, partial load is transferred to the low-temperature module, and the thermal coupling effect of the bus heat pipe is combined to form an electric load-thermal load double-balanced closed loop.

title: Forest carbon sequestration amount assessment method based on climate index influence
description: This invention provides a method for assessing forest carbon sequestration based on the influence of climate indices, comprising: determining the complete growth cycle of trees; calculating the biologically corrected forest carbon sequestration; calculating the winter temperature anomaly index  WTAIi  , summer temperature anomaly index  STAIi  , growing season monthly precipitation anomaly index GSPAI-  Si  , growing season bi-monthly precipitation anomaly index GSPAI-  Bi  , and annual sunshine anomaly index  YSAIi  for the study area in year  Ti  ; and constructing a forest carbon sequestration-climate index model. This invention, from the perspective of addressing climate change and ensuring forest carbon sequestration, designs climate indices that characterize the degree of climate anomalies, constructs a "forest carbon sequestration-climate index" model that quantifies the impact of climate anomalies on forest carbon sequestration, and develops an objective and efficient method for assessing the impact of climate anomalies on forest carbon sequestration.

title: SAR satellite image simulation generation and system of improved CycleGAN
description: This invention relates to the field of satellite image processing technology, and discloses an improved CycleGAN-based SAR satellite image simulation generation system, comprising: acquiring real optical satellite images and real SAR image datasets, and placing them respectively in the source domain.   and target domain   The two-domain images are preprocessed and divided into training, validation, and test sets. An improved CycleGAN model is constructed to establish the forward and reverse mapping relationship between optical images and synthetic aperture radar images. The improved adversarial loss and cycle consistency loss are integrated to generate the total loss function of the model. The model is then subjected to unsupervised adversarial training based on the improved loss function, with the generator and discriminator parameters being updated alternately until the model converges. The optical image to be converted is input into the trained improved CycleGAN model, which outputs a simulated SAR image and performs post-processing enhancement. This addresses the contradiction between the limited acquisition of SAR satellite images and the abundance of optical image resources, providing support for applications that rely on SAR imagery.

title: An AI-based procurement behavior anomaly detection system based on big data analysis
description: The invention provides a purchasing behavior anomaly AI detection system based on big data analysis, and relates to the technical field of purchasing behavior anomaly detection. The purchasing behavior anomaly detection system based on big data analysis realizes purchasing behavior anomaly detection through an AI fusion decision engine and a multidimensional data fusion architecture, and is concretely divided into a core module and a flow, S1, a data acquisition and preprocessing module, S2.AI fusion decision engine, S3, a dynamic cognitive map module, and S4, a multidimensional early warning and closed loop treatment module. Through LSTM time sequence prediction and external event coefficient dynamic adjustment threshold value, simultaneously, early warning information is automatically pushed to an OA/ERP system, the average treatment period is shortened to 8 hours from 7 days, the manual review workload is reduced by 70%, the exclusive dependence is reduced by 20%, the price fluctuation rate is reduced by 15%, and the supply chain elasticity and stability score is directly optimized.

title: Synthetic data generation for machine learning models
description: Techniques for generating synthetic data for a Machine Learning (ML) model are described. A system includes a language model that processes a task and a corresponding set of example inputs to generate another input, referred to herein as machine-generated data. The machine-generated data is processed using the ML model for which the data is being generated to determine a model output, and the model output is analyzed to determine whether it corresponds to a target output. If the model output corresponds to the target output, machine-generated data is added to the set of examples and one of the original example inputs is deleted to generate an updated set of example inputs. The updated set may be used for various training techniques.

title: Data expansion method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic driving, and discloses a data expansion method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first scene description; the method comprises the steps of determining a matched target map area from a preset map data set based on the first scene description, generating a model based on the first scene description, the target map area and a preset traffic flow, generating three-dimensional track information of a dynamic target, performing coordinate conversion based on the three-dimensional track information and a target vehicle, generating three-dimensional boundary frame structural information and lane line structural information corresponding to the target vehicle, and processing the three-dimensional boundary frame structural information and the lane line structural information to generate expansion data. According to the method, the first scene description in the natural language form is used for matching the target map area and generating the dynamic target three-dimensional track, the structured information is obtained through coordinate conversion, then the scene data of multi-view continuous frames are generated, the acquisition cost of automatic driving data is reduced, and the generalization capability of the model is further improved.

title: HRV-based body energy state analysis method
description: This invention proposes a body energy state analysis method based on HRV (Human Energy Status), relating to the field of computer technology. The method includes: acquiring a user's cardiovascular physiological signals and simultaneously obtaining real-time activity type data; performing adaptive filtering on the cardiovascular physiological signals to extract R-R interval sequences; extracting multi-dimensional feature vectors from the R-R interval sequences, the multi-dimensional feature vectors including temporal features, nonlinear dynamic features, and energy distribution features based on parameter dynamic optimization (VMD); inputting the multi-dimensional feature vectors and the user's real-time activity type data into a multimodal time-series discriminant model; outputting the user's body energy state classification results; matching and outputting the optimal intervention plan from a personalized intervention strategy library based on the classification results; and performing multimodal data analysis in conjunction with the user's real-time activity context to provide accurate and dynamic body energy state assessment and personalized intervention guidance.

title: Intelligent Analysis and Early Warning Methods for Visual Monitoring Data of Power Transmission Lines
description: The invention discloses an intelligent analysis and early warning method for transmission line visual monitoring data, in particular to the technical field of power system state monitoring, which comprises S1, constructing a dynamically updated transmission line space-time heterogram, S2, carrying out risk dynamic simulation based on a space-time diagram attention network, S3, fusing data prediction and knowledge rules through an objection game mechanism to generate a comprehensive risk assessment conclusion, S4, triggering hierarchical early warning according to risk grades, and driving model and strategy optimization by using feedback data of early warning treatment. The method solves the problems of early warning lag and decision stiffness in the prior art, realizes dynamic prediction deduction of line risks, intelligent fusion decision and continuous self-optimization of a system, and remarkably improves the prospective, accuracy and operation and maintenance efficiency of early warning.

title: Quadruped robot recharging and positioning method, device, robot and medium
description: This disclosure provides a method, device, robot, and medium for quadruped robot recharging and localization. During the quadruped robot's movement, raw radar point cloud data and image data are acquired and their features are extracted. Node features from the radar features are aligned with shallow feature maps in the image features, and edge features from the radar features are aligned with deep feature maps in the image features, resulting in aligned multimodal features. Based on these aligned multimodal features, feature fusion processing is performed to obtain fused features. A spatiotemporal memory system is constructed based on the fused features, and charging station identification and localization are performed using this system to generate charging station location results, guiding the quadruped robot to the charging station for charging. This eliminates reliance on prior maps and manual annotation, achieving true real-time multimodal fusion perception, meeting the differentiated positioning accuracy requirements during multi-stage recharging, and maintaining temporal consistency of perception results during robot movement.

title: A Genealogical Iterative Method for MBSE Model Versions Based on Graph Theory and Knowledge Graph
description: This invention discloses a version hierarchical iteration method and system for MBSE models based on graph theory and knowledge graphs. The method includes: constructing an MBSE model of a spacecraft and mapping it to an attribute graph; recording the version iteration process using a directed acyclic graph, managing it through a version number system including major version number, merge version number, and revision version number, and employing a differentiated storage strategy; performing change detection and merging based on baselines, accurately identifying changes through a model comparison algorithm that includes internal attributes, internal relationships, overall relationships, and difference analysis, and handling conflicts in collaborative design. This invention achieves atomic-level version control, solves the problems of missing change traceability, inefficient verification, and multiple baseline conflicts, and improves the efficiency and quality of spacecraft full lifecycle model management.

title: Digital twin simulation platform for acoustic wave rain-increasing meteorological condition response of river basin
description: This invention discloses a digital twin simulation platform for meteorological condition response of acoustic rain enhancement in watersheds, comprising: constructing physically realistic three-dimensional spatial lower boundary conditions; continuously receiving multi-source meteorological observation data streams, generating initial meteorological fields and boundary conditions through data preprocessing and multi-source data fusion; coupling a non-hydrostatic mesoscale meteorological model with a two-parameter cloud microphysical parameterization scheme to output four-dimensional spatiotemporal distribution data; dynamically correcting the two-parameter cloud microphysical parameterization scheme based on the output of solving the acoustic propagation equation using the microphysical model; and employing a global optimization algorithm and a deep neural network surrogate model to iteratively adjust the acoustic parameter combination according to a preset rain enhancement objective function, outputting the optimal acoustic parameter combination and its corresponding predicted rain enhancement effect. This invention can achieve high-fidelity full-process simulation, reveal the acoustic-cloud interaction mechanism, and improve the applicability and economic benefits of acoustic rain enhancement technology in actual watershed water resource management.

title: Burn model skin healing rate evaluation method
description: This invention discloses a method for assessing skin healing rate in a burn model, relating to the field of skin healing rate assessment technology. The method includes the following steps: multimodal data acquisition, image preprocessing and registration, multidimensional feature extraction, fusion assessment model calculation, visualization of the healing process, and report generation. This invention captures the surface healing process using visible light images, while OCT and ultrasound provide deeper information such as dermal collagen remodeling, granulation tissue filling, and subcutaneous edema. Thermal infrared monitoring monitors local blood flow and temperature dynamics. Multi-source data, after precise registration, forms a unified analytical benchmark, achieving a comprehensive characterization of the macroscopic morphology, microstructure, and physiological activity of the burn wound. Furthermore, the assessment model incorporates a time-series attention mechanism, weighting the contribution of features at different stages to the final healing index, overcoming the limitations of static assessment and comprehensively improving the scientific rigor and practicality of burn healing assessment. It also achieves dynamic quantification and forward-looking prediction of the healing process.

title: A method, apparatus, medium, and device for evaluating content generated by a large model.
description: This disclosure provides a method, apparatus, and device for evaluating content generated by a large model. One specific implementation of the method includes: acquiring target prompt words; inputting the target prompt words into a target large model to obtain first generated content; constructing auxiliary prompts, including a first prompt and a second prompt, the first prompt indicating a scoring standard for the generated content and the second prompt indicating a reference answer for the target prompt words; constructing a request-for-score prompt word based on the first generated content, the target prompt words, and the auxiliary prompts; and inputting the request-for-score prompt word into the evaluation large model to obtain a first score for the first generated content. This method enables accurate evaluation of content generated by a large model in an automated manner, improving evaluation efficiency and reducing evaluation costs.

title: A Method for Constructing a Reasonable Tillage Layer Evaluation Index System Based on Dual-Objective Optimization
description: The invention relates to the technical field of plough layer structure identification and evaluation, in particular to a reasonable plough layer evaluation index system construction method based on double-objective optimization. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource soil data of a cultivated land of a target area, preprocessing to obtain an original soil attribute variable set, constructing a double-target comprehensive scoring function to obtain comprehensive scoring values to divide cultivated layer grades, adopting a principal component analysis method to process the original soil attribute variable set to obtain a first variable set, constructing a LASSO regression model to screen the first variable set and the original soil attribute variable set to obtain a second variable set and a third variable set, adopting a random forest algorithm to obtain a fourth variable set, determining three-level key variable sets through intersection comparison, and constructing a reasonable cultivated layer grade and index system by combining the cultivated layer grades of the cultivated land of the target area. The invention realizes the cooperative quantification of the plough layer output function and the corrosion resistance function, and provides scientific basis for plough quality improvement, soil improvement and partition management.

title: Molecular property prediction method and device based on hidden space causal feature decoupling learning, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
description: This application relates to a method, device, electronic device, and readable storage medium for predicting molecular properties based on latent space causal feature decoupling learning, belonging to the interdisciplinary field of materials informatics and artificial intelligence. The system provided in this application integrates graph neural networks and causal inference theory to model the structure-property relationships of complex molecules. The system includes modules for data preprocessing, causal subgraph partitioning, structural representation encoding, feature decoupling learning, multi-task training, and performance prediction. Through an edge mask partitioning mechanism, the original molecular graph is split into causal subgraphs and bias subgraphs, and embedded features are extracted using graph neural networks. Furthermore, a mutual information loss term and feature enhancement strategy are constructed to achieve effective and efficient decoupling of causality and bias in the feature space. The system supports accurate regression or classification prediction of multiple target performance indicators such as electron affinity and ionization energy, and possesses good generalizability, interpretability, and engineering application value.

title: Normalized cross-correlation calculation method and system based on Fourier transform and integral graph
description: The application relates to a normalized cross-correlation calculation method and a normalized cross-correlation calculation system based on Fourier transformation and an integral graph, which are implemented by constructing a normalized cross-correlation formula for calculating the similarity between a target image and a source image; performing Fourier integral diagram form transformation on the normalized cross-correlation formula to obtain a Fourier integral diagram related formula comprising a Fourier calculation item and an integral diagram calculation item, performing fast Fourier transformation calculation on the Fourier calculation item to obtain a Fourier calculation result, performing image integral diagram calculation on the integral diagram calculation item to obtain an integral diagram calculation result, substituting the Fourier calculation result and the integral diagram calculation result into the Fourier integral diagram related formula to obtain a region similarity value of a region on the source image, and solving the problems that the conventional normalized cross-correlation calculation process is long in time consumption and difficult to meet the requirement of fast template matching.

title: Motion feature prediction method, robot, electronic device, and medium
description: This application provides a motion feature prediction method, a robot, an electronic device, and a medium. The motion feature prediction method includes: acquiring intermediate features output by an image processing model, wherein the intermediate features are obtained by the image processing model processing input data, the input data including image features, which are used to characterize images acquired during the robot's execution of a target task, and the intermediate features are used to characterize information in the image features; inputting the intermediate features, current motion features of multiple parts of the robot at the current moment, and a sequence of noisy motion features into the motion model to obtain a predicted motion feature sequence output by the motion model, wherein the predicted motion feature sequence is used to characterize the robot's motion trajectory in a future time period. The technical solution of this application can improve the generalization of the motion feature prediction method.

title: Mechanism- and Data-Driven Data Extension Methods and Applications in Wastewater Treatment
description: This invention discloses a mechanism- and data-driven method and application for expanding wastewater treatment data, belonging to the field of wastewater treatment data generation technology. The method includes: acquiring experimental-level data from the wastewater treatment process; calibrating a mechanistic model; constructing a high-dimensional spatial input parameter set covering all operating conditions in the wastewater treatment process; inputting the input parameter set into the calibrated mechanistic model for simulation calculation to obtain an output dataset. The wastewater treatment database consists of the input parameter set and the output dataset. This invention provides a wastewater treatment database with a wide numerical range, comprehensive parameters, and accurate values, solving the problem of incomplete and inaccurate predictions caused by the inability to obtain some data in existing technologies.

title: Knowledge map and sequence deep learning fused intelligent diagnosis and treatment decision system for traditional Chinese medicine
description: This invention discloses a TCM intelligent diagnosis and treatment decision-making system integrating knowledge graphs and sequence deep learning. The system includes: a knowledge graph construction module for constructing a multimodal TCM knowledge graph and generating semantic aggregation vectors for medicinal materials; a data processing module for fusing multi-source heterogeneous information such as patient diagnostic information, genotype, and physiological indicators into personalized context vectors; an intelligent evaluation module for performing risk quantification assessment of TCM prescription sequences based on an attention mechanism sequence model, combining semantic aggregation vectors and personalized context vectors; and a prescription optimization module for generating adjustment suggestions based on the knowledge graph and patient information when risk is detected. This invention solves the problems of traditional TCM prescription analysis relying on experience and lacking quantitative assessment and personalized adaptation, achieving automated and interpretable analysis of prescription risk, and improving the accuracy and practicality of intelligent auxiliary decision-making in TCM.

title: A method and apparatus for predicting regional load sources based on distributed multi-source data
description: The invention provides a regional charge source prediction method based on distributed multi-source data, which comprises the steps of 1, obtaining historical parameter data of each distributed power device in a region and historical total charge source data in the region, 2, preprocessing the historical parameter data of each distributed power device, 3, constructing a regional charge source prediction model, training the regional charge source prediction model based on the preprocessed historical parameter data and the historical total charge source data in the region, and 4, inputting the historical parameter data of each distributed power device in a prediction target region into the regional charge source prediction model, outputting a regional total charge source prediction value in a future preset time, and realizing the prediction of the regional total charge source in the future preset time. The invention realizes the integrated prediction of the load demand and the power supply output in the region, fully learns the internal coupling relation of the load source, and enables the power management department to perform the power resource scheduling more intuitively and conveniently.

title: Exception handling method for chip platform
description: The embodiment of the application provides an exception handling method of a chip platform, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of starting an abnormality detection intelligent agent arranged on a chip platform, wherein at least one abnormality processing model is arranged in the abnormality detection intelligent agent, acquiring abnormality data generated in the operation process of the chip platform through the abnormality detection intelligent agent, wherein the abnormality data are used for representing the abnormal state of a functional module in the chip platform, and calling the abnormality processing model through the abnormality detection intelligent agent to process the abnormality data so as to obtain an abnormality solution. The application can improve the exception handling efficiency of the chip platform.

title: A Data Transformation Method Based on Output Distribution to Improve Prediction Accuracy
description: This invention relates to the fields of data intelligence and machine learning technology, specifically disclosing a data transformation method based on output distribution guidance to improve prediction accuracy. The method includes: data acquisition and preprocessing: acquiring multi-source input features and corresponding output results, performing data cleaning, standardization, and outlier handling; output distribution feature extraction: calculating the statistical characteristics of the output variables; distribution deviation feature calculation: calculating the standardized deviation of the sample's output variables relative to the benchmark distribution; first-stage modeling: predicting the output distribution features based on the input features; second-stage modeling: fusing the predicted distribution features with the original input to establish an enhanced prediction model; model evaluation and optimization: verifying the model's effectiveness through error metrics and generalization performance, and optimizing parameters. This invention achieves a shift from an "input-driven" to an "input-output collaboratively driven" modeling mode, improving the model's prediction accuracy, stability, and generalization performance in different types of data processing.

title: Soil body constitutive parameter determining system and method based on in-situ expansion test and numerical inversion
description: This invention discloses a system and method for determining soil constitutive parameters based on in-situ expansion testing and numerical inversion, belonging to the field of geotechnical engineering investigation technology. The system includes a data interface and preprocessing module, a configurable numerical calculation engine, an intelligent inversion module, and a result output module. It acquires the pressure-expansion displacement curve of the soil in situ using an integrated probe; selects a target constitutive model and sets the parameter inversion space; and uses an intelligent optimization algorithm to drive the numerical calculation engine to perform iterative forward simulation, automatically searching for the optimal constitutive parameter set with the goal of minimizing the difference between the simulated curve and the measured curve. This invention deeply integrates in-situ expansion testing and intelligent numerical inversion, achieving in-situ, accurate, and automated calibration of the entire set of parameters for the HSS model, eliminating reliance on empirical formulas and disturbed soil samples. It provides reliable technical support for the refined design of major projects such as offshore wind power, and has significant scientific value and engineering application prospects.

title: Cutter head positioning method of die cutting machine based on embedded FOMO model
description: This invention discloses a die-cutting machine cutter head positioning method based on an embedded FOMO model, comprising: pruning and performing 8-bit integer quantization on a standard FOMO model to obtain a lightweight model; acquiring an image of the paper surface to be cut and dynamically adjusting the camera exposure time based on the average brightness value of the 8-bit quantization of the image; performing grayscale conversion, median filtering for noise reduction, and contrast enhancement on the image to generate standardized grayscale image data; calling the lightweight FOMO model to identify positioning marker points, and filtering valid positioning marker point coordinate data based on a confidence threshold; using a moving average filtering method to remove outliers, outputting optimized positioning marker point coordinates, and generating control commands to drive the cutter head for precise positioning. This invention significantly reduces system resource consumption, improves positioning efficiency and adaptability while ensuring positioning accuracy, effectively overcoming the shortcomings of traditional mechanical limiting and manual visual inspection, and is suitable for high-precision die-cutting scenarios such as packaging and printing.

title: Non-contact fault detection method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product
description: The present application relates to a non-contact fault detection method, apparatus, device, storage medium and program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining motor audio signals aiming at a motor to be detected, carrying out noise suppression processing on the motor audio signals and extracting motor audio feature information, wherein the noise suppression processing comprises the steps of dynamically adjusting a noise threshold by utilizing self-adaptive frequency spectrum subtraction and highlighting motor feature frequency by utilizing harmonic enhancement processing, and obtaining a fault classification result aiming at the motor to be detected by utilizing a pre-trained motor fault detection model based on the motor audio feature information. The application can effectively improve the reliability of motor fault detection.

title: Protein-ligand binding affinity prediction method based on graph rolling network
description: This invention proposes a protein-ligand binding affinity prediction method based on graph convolutional networks. First, a protein map is constructed based on the three-dimensional structure of the protein pocket, and ESM3 is used to encode the sequence residues. Simultaneously, a molecular map containing geometric information is constructed for the ligands, and chemical features are extracted using molecular fingerprinting. Then, a multilayer message-passing graph neural network is used to achieve cross-graph interaction between the protein and ligand maps, and an attention mechanism is introduced to capture key interaction sites and spatial dependencies. A unified representation vector at the complex level is generated through pooling, and the binding affinity is output by the prediction network. This invention can automatically learn multimodal associations between structure and sequence, effectively improving the accuracy and efficiency of virtual screening and lead compound optimization.

title: An AI-based method for assessing postoperative wound rehabilitation in urology, an electronic device, and a storage medium.
