description: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical rehabilitation evaluation and provides an artificial intelligence-based postoperative wound rehabilitation evaluation method, electronic equipment and a storage medium for urology surgery, wherein the method comprises multi-source data acquisition, data preprocessing, space alignment, normalization processing, three-branch network feature extraction, feature integration, feature compression, feature mapping and wound rehabilitation grade matching; according to the invention, through three-mode objective data of microwave imaging, electrical impedance imaging and bioelectrical impedance, the whole data acquisition process is free from invasion and interference, the error caused by individual difference is reduced, and through the three-branch characteristic extraction network and the depth fusion process, different types of data characteristics are adapted, the cross-mode information complementation is realized, and the wound rehabilitation multidimensional key signals are captured.

title: Low-power operation method and system based on wireless HART temperature transmitter
description: The invention provides a low-power-consumption working method and system based on WIRELESSHART wireless temperature transmitters, wherein the system comprises S1, a main communication unit is responsible for protocol stack and data processing, a coprocessor manages RTC wake-up and power gating, and partition power supply realizes zero static power consumption in a non-communication period. S2, the coprocessor acquires a TDMA schedule from the main unit, S3, local temperature data delta T threshold comparison is performed, only overrun triggering reporting is performed, RSSI/SNR is dynamically evaluated, non-key broadcasting time slots are intelligently skipped, deep dormancy of a stabilization period is achieved, S4, equipment reports an energy state through Join Request and a health report, a network manager distributes relay tasks through an energy weighting algorithm, and battery node electric quantity is lower than a threshold value and can be applied to enter a terminal mode. S5, LSTM predicts the node electric quantity and network load, strengthens learning to dynamically adjust the TDMA scheduling and routing strategy, and realizes active prediction maintenance and full-network energy balance.

title: Resampling in image compression
description: This disclosure relates to tensor resampling in image compression. The disclosure provides a method for reconstructing at least a portion of the image, the method comprising: parsing a first bitstream to obtain a first prior tensor; processing the first prior tensor to obtain a first tensor representing a principal component of the image. The method further comprises: parsing a second bitstream different from the first bitstream to obtain a second prior tensor different from the first prior tensor; resampling the first prior tensor according to an integer factor to obtain a resampled first prior tensor; and obtaining a second tensor representing at least one minor component of the image based on the second prior tensor and the resampled first prior tensor.

title: Intelligent prediction method for elevator faults based on BeiDou positioning and multi-source data fusion
description: This invention relates to the field of multimodal data processing and predictive analytics, specifically disclosing an intelligent elevator fault prediction method based on BeiDou positioning and multi-source data fusion. The method includes: acquiring multi-source heterogeneous data containing dynamic temporal information, physical sensor information, and dynamic visual feature vectors; generating a digital twin early warning state matrix using a shaft trajectory algorithm; and inputting this matrix into a model containing parallel processing paths and an attention fusion layer to calculate the fault probability. This invention solves the technical problem of traditional data processing methods' difficulty in effectively coordinating the analysis of multi-source information by constructing a specific attention fusion model to dynamically weight and deeply fuse heterogeneous data.

title: Driving decision model training method and automatic driving control method
description: The invention discloses a driving decision model training method and an automatic driving control method, which relate to the technical field of automatic driving, and comprise the steps of firstly utilizing a driving data sample to conduct offline training on a driving path point sequence of a diffusion model for predicting future time according to driving perception data, then deploying the diffusion model in a simulation environment for online optimization, improving diversity of a generated track of the diffusion model and generalization capability of the diffusion model through one-stage offline training and two-stage online training of the diffusion model, utilizing a trained diffusion model to train an evaluator model, utilizing the diffusion model and the evaluator model obtained through training to construct a driving decision model, improving decision capability of the driving decision model for generating candidate driving tracks and selecting optimal driving tracks, and improving automatic driving performance of a vehicle in a complex traffic environment.

title: Semi-Supervised Learning Framework based on Cox and AFT Models with L1/2 Regularization for Patient’s Survival Prediction
description: The present invention provides a novel semi-supervised learning method based on the combination of the Cox model and the accelerated failure time (AFT) model, each of which is regularized with L 1/2 regularization for high-dimensional and low sample size biological data. In this semi-supervised learning framework, the Cox model can classify the "low-risk" or a "high-risk" subgroup though samples as many as possible to improve its predictive accuracy. Meanwhile, the AFT model can estimate the censored data in the subgroup, in which the samples have the same molecular genotype. Combined with L 1/2 regularization, some genes can be selected by the Cox model and the AFT model and they are significantly relevant with the cancer. Page 22 '1 g0 Jo p 0 a ro LA Lei L mL

title: METHOD OF IDENTIFYING A CLINICALLY SIGNIFICANT PROSTATE CANCER SIGNATURE USING MICROFLOW CYTOMETRY
description: DISEASE DIAGNOSTIC METHODS USING MICROFLOW CYTOMETRY. Methods of diagnosing disease, such as clinically significant prostate cancer, in a patient are disclosed. Also disclosed are methods for identifying a disease signature. The methods involve microflow cytometry (μFCM) to identify particle phenotypes and then using machine learning to determine whether the patient has the disease of interest or the particle phenotypes of a disease particle. The µFCM analysis workflow disclosed in the present invention helps to identify the most clinically useful information within the µFCM data that may be overlooked by conventional gating analysis.

title: An illumination-adaptive single-stage 2D multi-person pose estimation method
description: The invention discloses a single-stage 2D multi-person gesture estimation method with self-adaptive illumination. The method comprises the steps of constructing a decomposition network to obtain a reflectivity image and an illumination image, constructing a channel attention mechanism to generate an illumination self-adaptive weight factor, constructing a denoising recovery network to obtain an optimized reflectivity image, constructing a backbone network to extract joint backbone characteristics of the optimized reflectivity image and an input image, constructing a characteristic enhancement and fusion module to enhance the illumination self-adaptive characteristics based on the joint backbone characteristics and the illumination self-adaptive weight factor and output enhanced global characteristics, constructing a key point detection head to position human key points based on the enhanced global characteristics, constructing a single-stage 2D multi-person gesture estimation model and training, and estimating the single-stage 2D multi-person gesture of the image. The invention can obviously improve the detection precision of multi-person gesture estimation under a low light field scene, does not obviously increase the calculation cost and improves the reasoning speed.

title: Power tag knowledge classification method and system based on large model
description: The invention discloses a power tag knowledge classification method and system based on a large model, and relates to the field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of collecting power source end data, determining effective source end data, determining a hierarchical label map, supervising and training an open source large model, introducing a label-free standard semantic library to determine an initialized classification model, reading downstream task characteristics, performing supervised adjustment to determine the classified large model, receiving a pre-classification task, performing classification decision to determine a classification result, and if the classification result of the pre-classification task is empty, receiving a new defect type and executing class increment learning. The method solves the technical problems of rare label class data and poor interpretability of the power knowledge labels in the prior art due to high professional, realizes the introduction of field knowledge to enhance the interpretability of the model, achieves the label classification of standard knowledge, and is used for predicting and deducing new sample data.

title: Marine electromagnetic anti-interference method and system based on software radio broadband ad hoc network
description: According to the software radio broadband ad hoc network-based marine electromagnetic anti-interference method and system provided by the embodiment of the invention, in view of the fact that the event environment element variables of the marine broadband ad hoc network state detection report and the electromagnetic interference element variables corresponding to the abnormal communication state identification record can be subjected to characteristic aggregation to obtain global marine communication element variables corresponding to each aggregation channel of the communication state reporting event in the marine broadband ad hoc network state detection report, the global marine communication element variables of different aggregation channels can be subjected to characteristic linkage operation to obtain the marine communication linkage element variables with more interactive characteristics of the marine broadband ad hoc network state detection report, so that electromagnetic anti-interference decisions can be carried out on the marine broadband ad hoc network state detection report by utilizing the marine communication linkage element variables, and the generation precision and pertinence of electromagnetic anti-interference decision plans corresponding to the marine broadband ad hoc network state detection report are improved.

title: Lightning-bulb-based sea defense secret evidence obtaining system
description: The invention discloses a sea defense marking and privacy evidence obtaining system based on a thunderball, which comprises a radar, a ball machine, an edge machine, a client platform and a network switch, wherein the radar and the ball machine are coaxially installed up and down to form a Lei Qiu linked thunderball front end, one edge machine is connected with a plurality of the thunderball front ends in a butting mode, the plurality of edge machines are in communication connection with the client platform through the network switch, the edge machine is used for controlling the thunderball front end to track a target by adopting a master-slave search type target tracking strategy or a multi-target tracking strategy, a tracking image is input into an improved YOLOv network structure, a target type and a target position are output, the master-slave search type target tracking takes the tracking of the radar guiding ball machine as a main tracking, a video tracking algorithm of a target image position driving PTZ is adopted as an auxiliary tracking after the target is found, and the multi-target tracking strategy takes the fastest high-speed target as a first priority.

title: A method, device and storage medium for reviewing violations
description: This invention discloses a method, apparatus, and storage medium for traffic violation review. The method includes: acquiring a traffic violation scene image of a vehicle, and locating the position of the vehicle from the scene image as a first position; if the violation category of the vehicle is a preset category, using a preset special vehicle detection model to detect special vehicles in the scene image; if a special vehicle is detected in the scene image, locating the position of the special vehicle from the scene image as a second position; if the relative relationship between the first and second positions satisfies preset conditions, using a preset vehicle state detection model to detect the working state of the special vehicle from the scene image; if the working state is performing a task, determining that the reason for the violation is avoiding a special vehicle. This technical solution improves the efficiency and intelligence of traffic violation review.

title: ASM-CNAG algorithm-based complex-valued neural network solar radiation prediction method and system
description: The present invention provides a complex-valued neural network solar radiation prediction method and system based on the ASM-CNAG algorithm, the method comprising preprocessing the collected raw solar radiation data to obtain a data set, dividing the data set into a training set and a test set; constructing a complex-valued neural network model according to the size of the data set; training the complex-valued neural network model using the data of the training set; inputting the data of the test set into the trained complex-valued neural network model to test the prediction ability of the model, and obtaining a solar radiation prediction model; and predicting solar radiation using the obtained solar radiation prediction model. The present invention overcomes the problem that the traditional CNAG algorithm needs to manually adjust parameters when training the complex-valued neural network, improves the prediction accuracy of the model, and achieves a good prediction effect when predicting solar radiation.

title: Regularized Continuous Learning Method Based on Bayesian Parameter Update and Weight Memory
description: The invention provides a regularized continuous learning method based on Bayesian parameter updating and weight memorizing, which comprises the following steps of S1, generating replay data by adopting a brain heuristic replay model when each new task is learned, S2, inputting the new task and the replay data into the brain heuristic replay model, training through regularized constraint, judging the importance of model parameters, and S3, analyzing a loss function of the model according to the importance of the model parameters. The invention can overcome the defects and shortcomings of the existing regularization technology, can better learn the new task, and can reduce the disastrous forgetting caused by the old task knowledge while learning the new task knowledge more efficiently.

title: Training method, device and electronic device for detection model across data sets
description: The application discloses a training method of a detection model crossing a data set, a training device of the detection model crossing the data set, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the training method comprises the following steps: a plurality of detection modules are arranged in one detection model to be trained, and feature extraction and feature fusion can be carried out on training samples from different data sets at the same time, so that a fusion feature map of each training sample is obtained; for each fusion feature map, each detection module can predict the fusion feature map according to the corresponding detection task, output the corresponding prediction feature map and match positive and negative samples for the fusion feature map; optimizing the detection model to be trained by combining training loss values of the plurality of detection modules, and continuously updating model parameters of the detection model to be trained under the condition that the detection model to be trained does not complete training until the detection model to be trained is trained. The method can reduce the data labeling cost of the detection model training set.

title: Collaborative motor imagery decoding method based on hypergraph representation and brain-computer system
description: The invention discloses a collaborative motor imagery decoding method based on hypergraph representation, which comprises the following steps of S1, preprocessing a multi-brain motor imagery data set acquired in advance, S2, extracting interaction information among individuals from the data by using the hypergraph representation method, S3, extracting core features and compressing the features of the extracted interaction information to reduce model training calculation cost, and obtaining a classification model by training STM (structure model) models through the extracted core features and the compressed features, S4, loading the trained classification model into an online brain-computer interface system, S5, acquiring real data of a user through brain-computer data acquisition equipment, and inputting the real data into the classification model in the online system as a test sample to carry out classification decision so as to obtain a recognition result. The method is a multi-person online brain-computer system, has high accuracy and high stability of online identification, and a feature classification module adopts a Support Tensor Machine (STM) model to deal with the problem of small samples.

title: A method to improve the quality of digital holographic reconstruction images
description: This invention discloses a method for improving the quality of digital holographic reconstruction images, comprising the following steps: acquiring digital holograms to be processed, including digital holograms containing speckle noise and digital holograms without speckle noise, and obtaining the dataset required for neural network training; denoising the digital holograms using a deep learning algorithm and a neural network method with image denoising capabilities; performing preset reconstruction processing on the denoised digital holograms to obtain a reconstructed image of the digital hologram; and denoising the reconstructed image using a preset image processing algorithm to obtain the final result. This invention, based on a combination of deep learning and multi-sub-hologram reconstruction, reduces the impact of speckle noise on the quality of holographic reconstruction images, overcoming the shortcomings of existing technologies and improving the quality of reconstructed images. Experiments demonstrate that this invention has a better effect in removing speckle noise from digital holograms, and its advantages are significant compared to traditional algorithms.

title: Method and determination system for defining recording tracks
description: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method for defining a recording trajectory for detecting a first object and a second object in a three-dimensional medical image. The method includes providing at least two heuristic views. The method comprises the following steps: partitioning the first object in the heuristic view, wherein a first two-dimensional object mask is determined; and segmenting the second object in the heuristic view, wherein a second two-dimensional object mask is determined. The method includes determining a first three-dimensional object mask from the first two-dimensional object mask and determining a second three-dimensional object mask from the second two-dimensional object mask. The method includes determining an overlap of the first object and the second object from the first three-dimensional object mask and the second three-dimensional object mask for at least one recording trajectory.

title: Method for detecting surface defects of copper-clad plate based on multi-scale gridding
description: The present invention provides a method for detecting surface defects of copper-clad boards based on multi-scale gridding, including S1, collecting the captured copper-clad board images through a line scan camera; S2, dividing the copper-clad areas and non-copper-clad areas, and dividing the copper-clad boards into Rotate the area to the positive position; S3, divide the copper clad area of the image according to the set grid parameters, and perform pyramid operations on the divided original grid map; S4, calculate the original grid map and the pyramid grid map of each layer The mean value; S5, through the mean degradation coefficient, fuse the original grid map and the mean value of the pyramid grid map of each layer to obtain the final background mean value, and detect defects through the background and foreground differences; S6, classify the defects. The invention reduces the amount of calculation while retaining local information of the background, which not only improves the detection speed but also ensures the stability of accuracy. This has good detection results when high-speed detection of materials is required.

title: A collaborative vehicle localization method based on federated transfer learning
description: This application is applicable to the field of intelligent transportation technology and provides a vehicle collaborative positioning method based on federated transfer learning. The vehicle collaborative positioning method includes: clustering multiple regional states based on a multi-attribute spatiotemporal clustering algorithm on the cloud side to determine the regional state cluster corresponding to the target domain; aggregating the model weights corresponding to all regional states in the regional state cluster on the edge side, and obtaining the spatiotemporal characteristics of all regional states in the regional state cluster using a self-attention mechanism module; filtering the aggregated model weights using the spatiotemporal characteristics to obtain the final model weights on the edge side, and constructing a global model using the final model weights; the vehicle side receives the global model sent from the edge side and obtains a local model based on the global model based on federated learning; the local model outputs the GPS regional error; and the vehicle side uses the GPS regional error to correct its own position information. The vehicle collaborative positioning method of this application can solve the problem of low vehicle positioning accuracy.

title: Elevator dispatching decision-making method and system based on recurrent neural network
description: The invention discloses an elevator dispatching decision-making method and system based on a cyclic neural network, comprising the following steps: constructing a pre-trained cyclic neural network model; obtaining the number of people waiting for the elevator at each current floor, and predicting the destination floor of the passenger through the constructed pre-trained cyclic neural network model, so as to obtain the change and distribution of the number of people waiting for the elevator at each future floor; and scheduling elevator operation. From two angles of time and space, taking the selection of passengers to the destination floors of taking the elevator as a study object, adopting a circulating neural network to analyze and train elevator traffic flow data to obtain a prediction model of the selection of the passengers to the destination floors, thereby achieving the purposes of predicting the number distribution of people waiting for the elevator in a certain time point and a certain space in the future, forming an analysis prediction model of the elevator traffic flow, further generating an elevator dispatching strategy, and optimizing the elevator operation efficiency and energy conservation and environmental protection efficiency by introducing an elevator no-load operation time factor in the model optimization process.

title: Parallel deep forest network intrusion detection method based on mutual information and fusion weighting
description: The invention provides a parallel depth forest network intrusion detection method based on mutual information and fusion weighting, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting real-time network access data to obtain an original feature set, then carrying out feature dimension reduction on the original feature set, S2, carrying out multi-granularity scanning on the feature subjected to dimension reduction to obtain an input feature set, and S3, inputting the input feature set into a cascade forest to carry out intrusion classification on the network access data to obtain a predicted intrusion category result. The invention can rapidly analyze the network behavior, thereby effectively sensing the attack behavior existing in the network.

title: GraphQL-based Chinese question-answering model training method and related equipment thereof
description: The embodiment of the application belongs to the technical field of finance and technology, and relates to a GraphQL-based Chinese question-answer model training method and related equipment thereof, wherein the method and the related equipment are used for generating GraphQL query sentences corresponding to target Chinese question data according to GraphQL specifications, acquiring answer data corresponding to the target Chinese question data through a language analysis model, constructing a first text pair set and a second text pair set, inputting the first text pair set and the second text pair set into a T5 question-answer model which is pre-trained in an end-to-end mode, training the T5 question-answer model to obtain a trained T5 question-answer model, inputting new Chinese question data into the trained T5 question-answer model, and obtaining a model output result as answer data. By introducing a double-tower model structure into the end-to-end T5 question-answering model, graphQL specifications construct query sentences, the end-to-end Chinese atlas question-answering model with effective intermediate representation is trained, and good quality control is performed on the output of answer data.

title: Power scene anomaly detection method and device based on difficult sample mining
description: This application relates to a method, apparatus, computer device, storage medium, and computer program product for power scene anomaly detection based on hard sample mining. The method includes: generating several candidate boxes based on a power scene image dataset and determining the positive and negative sample types of each candidate box; performing iterative operations on the candidate boxes: forward propagating the candidate boxes output from the previous iteration and obtaining the corresponding target loss; sorting the target losses and selecting candidate boxes based on the sorting results and a preset ratio of positive and negative samples; backward propagating the selected candidate boxes, updating the target parameters and sharing them with the forward and backward propagation processes, and performing the next iteration based on the target parameters; ending the iteration operation and using the corresponding candidate boxes output from the last iteration as hard samples to train a classification model, and using the classification model for power scene anomaly detection. This method can optimize the performance of power scene anomaly target detection by utilizing mined hard samples.

title: Page filling method and device, electronic device and computer-readable storage medium
description: The invention provides a page filling method and device, electronic equipment and a computer-readable storage medium, which can be applied in the fields of computer front-end technology and artificial intelligence technology. The page filling method includes: extracting M groups of information units from the target requirement statement; obtaining the page structure data of the page to be filled; processing the page structure data to determine the controls of M input control boxes that match the M groups of information units one by one. Identification; based on the control identification of the M input control boxes, a predetermined filling operation program is called to match the M groups of information units one by one to the M input control boxes; the method of the present invention can realize information structuring and the dynamics of the form input control and intelligent matching to improve the accuracy and efficiency of filling out forms.

title: Convolutional neural network-based power tower acceptance state sensing method
description: The invention discloses a power tower acceptance state sensing method based on a convolutional neural network, which belongs to the field of power tower component state identification and comprises the following steps of: s1: obtaining a data set for model training; s2: constructing a power tower multi-acceptance component convolutional neural network identification model; s3: training the constructed power tower multi-acceptance component convolutional neural network identification model through the data set for model training, which is prepared in the step S1, until convergence; s4: the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for carrying out multi-source image acquisition, preprocessing and multi-source image matching in sequence, inputting the multi-source image acquisition and the multi-source image matching into a converged power tower multi-acceptance component convolutional neural network identification model, carrying out component type and running state identification, and outputting a result. The power tower acceptance state sensing method based on the convolutional neural network solves the problem of unbalanced class of the data set, realizes synchronous identification of various components, and improves acceptance efficiency and identification accuracy of the power tower.

title: Intelligent monitoring system and method for static pressure turntable
description: This invention discloses an intelligent monitoring system and method for a hydrostatic rotary table, comprising a data acquisition system, a big data computing system, a control system, and an artificial intelligence system. The data acquisition system collects rotary table parameters and transmits them to the big data computing system, control system, and artificial intelligence system to monitor and evaluate the working status of the hydrostatic rotary table in real time. A model of the hydrostatic rotary table and a circular oil pad is established, and the control system controls each sensing unit to record the real-time parameters of the rotary table. The data acquisition system collects relevant parameters affecting the hydrostatic rotary table, and the collected data is transmitted to the big data computing system for data classification and processing. An artificial intelligence system is built using MATLAB, and the processed data is input into an artificial neural network model for training. The output value is used to evaluate and monitor the working status of the hydrostatic rotary table. This invention can monitor the working status of the hydrostatic rotary table in real time and dynamically, providing a more comprehensive and accurate understanding of its performance and condition.

title: A refined inversion method for atmospheric XCO2 concentration integrating land surface environmental variables
description: The invention discloses an atmospheric XCO  2  concentration refined inversion method integrating land surface environment variables, which is suitable for the field of atmospheric and spatial data monitoring. Performing outlier processing, space-time matching, re-projection and nested re-sampling data preprocessing on the acquired terrestrial environment data and the multi-source satellite XCO  2  observation data; quantifying the scale correlation between the land surface environmental factors of the research area and the XCO  2  concentration to obtain an optimal analysis scale, quantifying the time correlation and the space correlation between the land surface environmental factors of the research area and the XCO  2  concentration by using a pearson correlation coefficient and a geographic detector q statistical quantity analysis method, screening to obtain land surface environmental factors with strong correlation, and constructing a land surface environmental index system applicable to the research area; and constructing a space-time fusion model based on the convolutional neural network and the long-term and short-term memory network to finish the refined inversion. The method has strong generalization capability and high data inversion precision, and can be suitable for the refined inversion of the concentration of the atmospheric XCO  2  in different space scales and different areas.

title: Brain disease classification system, method and equipment based on multi-modal feature similarity
description: The application discloses a brain disease classification system, method and equipment based on multi-mode feature similarity, and relates to the technical field of magnetic resonance images, comprising a feature stitching module, a data stitching module and a magnetic resonance brain image feature, wherein the feature stitching module is used for screening functional state data to obtain target functional state data, inputting data features of structural state data and target functional state data into a data stitching model, and outputting the magnetic resonance brain image features; the system comprises a similarity calculation module, a graph classification module and a disease classification module, wherein the similarity calculation module is used for calculating first similarity of brain image features and training sample image features, calculating second similarity of sample image features among each training sample in a training sample set, acquiring a target similarity graph based on the second similarity and the first similarity, and the graph classification module is used for classifying diseases of the target similarity graph. Classifying the similarity graph, and classifying the brain diseases of the test set group.

title: Multi-fan wind speed space-time prediction method and system
description: The present invention belongs to the field of wind turbine wind speed prediction, and discloses a multi-wind turbine wind speed spatiotemporal prediction method and system, obtains regional multi-wind turbine wind speed data, wind turbine location coordinates (latitude and longitude) and other weather variable data (wind direction, temperature, air pressure) related feature data; for data after data preprocessing, performs modeling steps based on the Pytorch framework; constructs a multi-wind turbine spatial feature extraction model; constructs a temporal feature extraction model for regional multi-wind turbine wind speed prediction; model training and hyperparameter adjustment; selects multiple evaluation indicators to evaluate the prediction effect of the model. The present invention can effectively aggregate the spatial features of neighboring wind turbines, and is suitable for wind speed prediction of multiple wind turbines. At the same time, it combines the bidirectional GRU model and the attention mechanism to extract long-term and short-term time features, and uses a multi-task learning strategy in the multi-wind turbine wind speed prediction task, taking into account the inherent connection between multiple tasks. The above method can effectively improve the prediction accuracy of multi-wind turbine wind speed.

title: Transmission line detection method and related equipment
description: This invention provides a method and related equipment for detecting power transmission lines, comprising: acquiring laser data and image data of a target power transmission line; extracting local and global features of the laser data using a point cloud encoder module; fusing the local and global features of the laser data with the features of the image data to obtain fused features; inputting the fused features into a YOLOv5 framework for target detection to obtain detection results; the point cloud encoder module includes a point cloud preprocessing unit, an encoder, and a decoder; the output of the point cloud preprocessing unit is connected to the input of the encoder, the output of the encoder is connected to the input of the decoder, and the output of the decoder is connected to the input of the YOLOv5 framework; this method effectively fuses laser data and image data, reduces the sensitivity of environmental factors around the line to enhance the robustness of line detection, and improves the accuracy and reliability of line detection.

title: Acoustic emission signal identification method and network model training method
description: The invention discloses an acoustic emission signal identification method which comprises the following steps of collecting acoustic emission signal data generated in an axle running process, preprocessing the collected signal data, importing the preprocessed signal data into a network identification module, carrying out identification analysis on the imported signal data by utilizing a trained improved one-dimensional CNN network model in the network module, and outputting an identification result. The invention also discloses a model training method for training the improved one-dimensional CNN network model. The invention is used in the field of train fault diagnosis, can be used for identifying the train axle acoustic emission signals after acquisition and monitoring the axle running process in real time, can extract higher-level signal characteristics from the original acoustic emission signals through a deep network architecture, and has better fault identification capability.

title: DR pipeline defect detection method based on decoupling detection head YOLOv5
description: This invention discloses a DR pipeline defect detection method based on a decoupled detection head YOLOv5, comprising: inputting a pipeline surface defect image dataset into the backbone network of a single-stage detection model YOLOv5n, outputting five feature maps at different scales; inputting the three middle feature maps into the neck network of the single-stage detection model YOLOv5n for feature fusion, outputting three feature maps; and inputting the three feature maps output by the neck network and the remaining two feature maps output by the backbone network into a task-independent decoupled detection head for classification and regression prediction, obtaining the classification and regression prediction results. This invention introduces a task-independent decoupled detection head into the YOLOv5n detection head, constructing independent feature maps for classification and regression tasks respectively to achieve decoupling, thereby improving the accuracy of DR pipeline defect detection.

title: Data-driven base station power consumption modeling method
description: The invention discloses a data-driven base station power consumption modeling method, which includes the following steps: S1. Use any type of base station as an initial type base station, collect data from the initial type base station, and preprocess the collected data. Construct the original sample set; S2. Construct the base station power consumption model through machine learning algorithm, and train the base station power consumption model through the original sample set to obtain the power consumption model of the initial type base station; S3. Based on the power consumption model of the initial type base station Transfer learning is performed on the model to obtain different categories of base station power consumption models. The present invention models base station power consumption by collecting base station data, and then uses the migration learning method to complete power consumption modeling of different types of base stations, which has good accuracy and generalization.

title: An energy Internet platform architecture method based on distributed smart grid
description: This application belongs to the field of electrical digital data processing technology and provides an energy Internet platform architecture method based on distributed smart grids, including: discrete processing of microgrid historical and current data to obtain historical transfer states and current transfer states, based on The historical transition state is used to obtain the transition probability matrix; based on the transition probability matrix, the expected electric power value is obtained according to the current transition state; the basic attributes of the network nodes and edges in the distributed grid are calculated to construct a distributed grid energy network; based on the distributed grid energy network, Construct a power dispatching strategy for residual power distribution and electric energy replenishment; add the power dispatching strategy to the existing distributed energy management system to complete the energy Internet platform architecture of the distributed smart grid. The method provided by the invention not only completes the low-consumption energy complementation between nodes, but also reduces power fluctuations on the main grid, stabilizes power supply, and improves energy utilization efficiency.

title: Ground pressure disaster prediction method and device based on multitasking learning
description: The invention provides a method and device for predicting ground pressure disasters based on multi-task learning, which are applied in the field of data analysis and prediction technology, including: extracting microseismic time series data from parameter data of microseismic source; preprocessing the microseismic time series data to obtain Input vector, the preprocessing includes data resampling, missing data processing and data normalization; input the input vector into the pre-trained ground pressure disaster prediction model to obtain the predicted number of events, cumulative energy, cumulative apparent volume and energy Index to predict ground pressure disasters. The invention can significantly improve the efficiency and accuracy of ground pressure disaster prediction, and can also retain real microseismic data characteristics.

title: A selective disassembly planning method and system based on RQL algorithm
description: The present invention provides a method and system for selective disassembly planning based on an RQL algorithm, which obtains a data set of products to be disassembled, combines a Q-learning algorithm and a Rollout strategy to iteratively sample the data set of products to be disassembled, and obtains a preferred disassembly sequence of the products to be disassembled. The RQL (Rollout-Q-learning) algorithm of the present application optimizes the action selection of the Q-learning algorithm in the iteration process based on the Rollout strategy. After each feasible action is simulated and sampled for a limited number of steps using the Rollout strategy in each decision stage, the feasible action with the largest estimated value within the limited number of steps is selected, so that the Q-learning algorithm has a stronger global search capability, and finally obtains the preferred disassembly sequence. Compared with the traditional Q-learning algorithm, the RQL (Rollout-Q-learning) algorithm has a great performance improvement in disassembly sequence planning, and can also improve the recycling efficiency of the disassembly process and minimize the harm caused by EoL products to the environment.

title: Classification method and system for ultra-short time signals with low signal-to-noise ratio
description: This invention discloses a classification method and system for low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) ultra-short-time signals. The classification method includes the following steps: extracting features from acquired input sub-samples to obtain feature vectors of multiple pairs of points, wherein each feature vector consists of the feature amplitudes of multiple pairs of points; and classifying the low SNR ultra-short-time signal using the feature vectors of multiple pairs of points. The acquisition process of the input sub-samples includes: sampling pairs of points of the narrowband signal of the low SNR ultra-short-time signal to obtain input sub-samples; wherein each pair of points is any two sampling points of the low SNR ultra-short-time signal. This invention enables real-time classification of low SNR ultra-short-time signals.

title: A Super-Resolution Image Quality Assessment Method Based on Triple Attention Dual-Scale Residual Network
description: This invention discloses a super-resolution image quality assessment method based on a triple attention dual-scale residual network. First, given a super-resolution image, it is cropped into non-overlapping super-resolution image patches. Then, features of the super-resolution image patches are extracted sequentially through convolutional layers, a triple attention module, and a dual-scale convolutional module. Finally, the output features from the feature extraction stage are compressed using max pooling, and the compressed features are fed into a fully connected layer for nonlinear quality mapping, outputting the predicted quality score of the super-resolution image patch. This invention employs a triple attention module to explore salient features in the image and designs a dual-scale convolutional module (DSCM) to capture more comprehensive image information, thereby achieving a more effective evaluation of super-resolution images.

title: Code generation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a code generation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium. The method comprises: extracting at least two fusible network layers from a neural network; obtaining multiple operations contained in each of the at least two fusible network layers; combining the multiple operations contained in each of the at least two fusible network layers to obtain a fusion node; obtaining the quantized implementation code of the fusion node according to the operation combination corresponding to the fusion node, the abstract syntax tree of each fusible network layer and the type of backend hardware. The method uses automatic generation instead of manual addition, which can reduce labor costs and has a low error rate.

title: Information processing method, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present application provides an information processing method, an electronic device and a storage medium, which are applied to the field of artificial intelligence technology, wherein the method includes: determining the information to be processed corresponding to the agent; inputting the information to be processed and the node sequence information into a large model, wherein the node sequence information is used to indicate the multiple nodes contained in the task flow and the edges between the nodes, the nodes represent the action instructions for the agent, and the edges represent the jumps between the nodes, so that the large model determines the target node to be executed according to the information to be processed, and controls the agent to execute the action instructions corresponding to the target node. The present application can realize the planning of complex processes and the controllability of the execution process, so that the agent can complete the task more efficiently and accurately, and can support the customization of different task processes for different scenarios, meet the usage requirements in different scenarios, and improve the user experience.

title: Management method, system and storage medium of intelligent course arrangement system
description: The present invention relates to a management method, system and storage medium of an intelligent class scheduling system, and belongs to the technical field of class scheduling system management. The present invention constructs a state membership matrix according to the membership information corresponding to a new leaf node, integrates a Markov chain, evaluates the state membership matrix through the Markov chain, obtains a state transition probability value matrix, and finally predicts the paralysis probability value of the intelligent class scheduling system according to the state transition probability matrix, and generates relevant control measures based on the paralysis probability value of the intelligent class scheduling system. The present invention analyzes the usage load of the intelligent class scheduling system by integrating a decision tree model and a Markov chain, and can accurately predict the paralysis probability of the intelligent class scheduling system, thereby adjusting the usage load information of each communication link through a genetic algorithm, so that the real-time usage load information of the communication link is optimized in real time, reducing the paralysis probability of the intelligent class scheduling system, and maintaining the normal operation of the intelligent class scheduling system.

title: Distributed photovoltaic power generation power prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a distributed photovoltaic power generation power prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method includes dynamically clustering historical power generation parameter information according to an improved clustering algorithm to obtain clustered target time series data; performing variational modal decomposition on each target time series data based on the optimal decomposition parameter corresponding to the target time series data to obtain at least two sub-modal components; using an improved kernel principal component analysis method to perform high-dimensional feature space mapping on each sub-modal component to obtain the contribution of historical power generation weather data to distributed photovoltaic power generation; inputting historical power generation parameter information into a long short-term memory neural network to obtain a distributed photovoltaic power generation power prediction result; the embodiment of the present invention, through the above technical solution, can improve the stability and accuracy of photovoltaic power generation prediction, realize the accurate prediction of ultra-short-term distributed photovoltaic aggregate power generation, and provide a prerequisite guarantee for supporting the power grid to quickly adjust its power.

title: A management method and system for energy storage system based on environmental prediction
description: The invention discloses a management method and a system of an energy storage system based on environment prediction, which belong to the technical field of energy storage management and comprise the steps of obtaining sequence environment data and carrying out environment prediction results; the method comprises the steps of obtaining energy demand data, obtaining an energy demand prediction result based on the energy demand data and an environment prediction result, predicting energy storage according to the environment prediction result to obtain an energy storage prediction result, and finally scheduling and managing the energy storage system and the power supply system according to the energy demand prediction result and the energy storage prediction result. According to the invention, the environment in a future period is predicted, and then the energy demand and the energy storage amount are predicted by combining the environment prediction result, so that the energy demand and the energy storage amount in the future period can be known in time, the energy scheduling is planned in advance, the energy utilization efficiency is improved, the stability and the reliability of a power grid are enhanced, and the large-scale application of renewable energy sources is promoted.

title: A satellite cloud-edge collaborative computing offloading method and device
description: The present invention discloses an unloading method and device for satellite-cloud-edge collaborative computing, and the method comprises: constructing a cost model of a task under each layer of computing based on a three-layer cloud-edge collaborative computing framework of terminal-satellite-cloud; constructing an optimization problem model based on each cost model, taking the minimum total cost as the optimization target, taking the unloading decision, CPU operating frequency and transmission power as the optimization variables; adopting a model-assisted method and an interior point method to optimize and solve the CPU operating frequency and transmission power, and adopting a Q-learning algorithm to optimize and solve the unloading decision; performing unloading computing according to the optimal solution results of the CPU operating frequency, transmission power and unloading decision; the present invention optimizes the CPU operating frequency and transmission power by using a model-assisted method and an interior point method, determines the unloading decision of concurrent multi-tasks by using a Q-learning algorithm, and realizes collaborative computing and resource allocation in computing according to the optimal solution.

title: New energy-containing power distribution network power supply reliability influence factor analysis method and system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, and discloses a method and a system for analyzing influence factors of power supply reliability of a power distribution network containing new energy, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a data set of each target area; for each target zone, calculating a number of data reliability indicators and a number of power supply reliability indicators based on the data set; for each target area, based on a plurality of power supply reliability indexes, obtaining a comprehensive power supply reliability index through a weighted approximation ideal solution algorithm; based on a plurality of data reliability indexes, obtaining a comprehensive data reliability index through a weighted approximation ideal solution algorithm; fitting a curve of the comprehensive data reliability index and the comprehensive power supply reliability index by using a convolutional neural network; and calculating correlation coefficients of each data reliability index and each power supply reliability index to select the data reliability index affecting each power supply reliability index. The limitation that the coupling influence is analyzed only from a logic angle at present is overcome.

title: A park-level distributed energy system optimization method, device, equipment and medium
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of energy system optimization, and specifically relates to a park-level distributed energy system optimization method, device, equipment and medium. The park-level distributed energy system optimization method provided by the present invention first optimizes the capacity of each device in the distributed energy system, and then optimizes the operation of the distributed energy system after preliminary optimization using the day-ahead stage, intraday stage and real-time stage as time scales, and divides the system's optimization operation process from "coarse adjustment" to "fine adjustment" into three stages of "day-ahead-intraday-real-time". By coordinating the operation mode of the equipment in each stage step by step, the impact of multiple uncertain factors on the system is gradually reduced, and the source-load energy matching degree is improved.

title: A method and system for predicting mineral composition content
description: The present invention provides a method and system for predicting mineral composition content, belonging to the field of oil and gas field exploration and development. The method comprises collecting measured rock mineral composition content data and well logging data and mud logging data within a preset depth range, and performing preprocessing; selecting and reducing the dimension of features by using a correlation coefficient method and a principal component analysis method; then constructing a multi-source fusion data set, and training a hybrid neural network model, establishing a loss function for predicting mineral content by using user-defined constraints, and finally predicting the mineral composition content by using the hybrid neural network model. The present invention fully considers the correlation between the well logging data and mud logging data and the rock mineral composition, constructs a user-defined loss function according to the mineral composition content characteristics, improves the accuracy of prediction, and solves the defects of difficult formation core sampling, inconvenient indoor experiment, and discontinuous rock mineral content data.

title: Automatic adjustment method and device for medical central oxygen supply system
description: The present invention discloses an automatic adjustment method and device for a medical central oxygen supply system, which belongs to the field of oxygen supply system control, wherein the method includes: obtaining regional layout feature data of a target area and dividing the oxygen supply area; performing deep learning of the features of oxygen supply adjustment records and generating an oxygen supply adjustment decision channel; performing oxygen supply balance verification of multiple target oxygen supply areas in combination with a global oxygen supply balance verifier and multiple regional oxygen supply target scene data sources; performing oxygen supply adjustment analysis on each oxygen supply target in multiple target oxygen supply areas, obtaining multiple regional oxygen supply adjustment decision sets, and performing oxygen supply adjustment. This application solves the technical problem that the existing medical central oxygen supply system is difficult to dynamically adjust according to actual needs and lacks autonomous intelligent adjustment capabilities, resulting in low oxygen supply adaptability and stability, and achieves the technical effect of realizing dynamic adaptive adjustment of the medical central oxygen supply system according to actual needs and improving the oxygen supply adaptability and stability.

title: Model training method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present application discloses a model training method, device, electronic device and storage medium. The method includes: broadcasting a training data set corresponding to a target model in a peer-to-peer computing network, so that multiple nodes in the peer-to-peer computing network negotiate and allocate the training data set, and determine their respective corresponding training data subsets to be trained; training the target model based on the target training data subset allocated to the target node, and obtaining a first training result corresponding to the target model; broadcasting the first training result in the peer-to-peer computing network, receiving the second training result broadcasted by other nodes in the peer-to-peer computing network, and the second training result is obtained by training the target model by other nodes in the peer-to-peer computing network based on the corresponding allocated training data subset; updating the target model based on the first training result and/or the second training result to obtain the first update information corresponding to the target model, reducing the equipment cost required for model training, and improving training efficiency and scalability.

title: Unsupervised image super-pixel generation method and device and readable storage medium
description: The invention provides an unsupervised image super-pixel generation method, an unsupervised image super-pixel generation device and a readable storage medium. Then, the preprocessed image features enter a CRE feature extraction module designed by the invention to extract the image features, and finally, the super-pixel confidence estimation is output through a classification layer, and the super-pixel segmentation result is obtained by using argmax. The invention can generate super pixels with higher quality based on RIM algorithm, and better fit the image edge.

title: Energy management method and system for fuel cell aircraft
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy management, and discloses an energy management method and system of a fuel cell aircraft. First, a suitable system topology is selected and a fuzzy logic controller is established that targets fuel consumption and battery state of charge. The input of the controller comprises the system required power and the charge state of the storage battery, and the output is the proportionality coefficient of the fuel cell to the system required power. And the parameters of the controller are optimized by using a mucosae optimization algorithm, so that the optimization of energy management is ensured. The improved fuzzy control solving result is compared with the direct optimization result of the myxobacteria algorithm, and the optimal controller parameters are selected to realize the optimization of the energy management strategy. The method not only innovatively fuses the mucosae algorithm and the fuzzy logic control, but also effectively improves the energy efficiency of the fuel cell system, and has obvious economic and environmental benefits.

title: Negative ion concentration detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to the field of concentration detection technology, and discloses a method, device, equipment and storage medium for detecting negative ion concentration. The method comprises: monitoring the environmental parameters of the hydroxide ion warehouse, obtaining the environmental parameter data set and performing baseline comparison to obtain the environmental change data set; generating an environmental adjustment signal according to the environmental change data set and performing environmental adjustment; performing negative ion capture on the hydroxide ion warehouse after environmental adjustment to obtain negative ion charge data; performing digital signal conversion on the negative ion charge data to generate an initial negative ion concentration digital signal; performing deep signal processing on the initial negative ion concentration digital signal to obtain the target negative ion concentration digital signal and calculate the corresponding negative ion actual concentration data; inputting the negative ion actual concentration data into the concentration change prediction model to predict the negative ion concentration change trend, and obtaining the negative ion concentration prediction result. The present application improves the negative ion concentration detection and prediction accuracy of the hydroxide ion warehouse.

title: Cloud ERP system security evaluation method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention belongs to the field of cloud ERP system, and discloses a cloud ERP system security evaluation method, system, computer equipment and storage medium. Based on the preset cloud ERP system security evaluation index system, the security monitoring risk value of each secondary indicator of the cloud ERP system for N cycles is obtained, and the security evaluation value of each secondary indicator for N cycles is obtained in combination with the preset evaluation weight of each secondary indicator; according to the security evaluation value of each secondary indicator for N cycles, the cloud ERP system security evaluation result is obtained. When setting the preset evaluation weight of each secondary indicator, the initial weight of each secondary indicator of each security standard document and the risk coefficient of each security standard document are combined to achieve a complete evaluation of cloud security documents. The evaluation result can more accurately characterize the security of the cloud ERP system, and then the cloud ERP system can be better used or repaired to avoid the security risks of the cloud ERP system.

title: Data information extraction and analysis method for medical examination list
description: The invention discloses a data information extraction and analysis method of a medical examination sheet, which relates to the technical field of examination sheet data extraction and comprises the following steps: converting the paper medical examination sheet into image data to obtain examination sheet image data; correcting the image data of the inspection sheet to obtain a corrected image; dividing the corrected image according to typesetting and content of each part of the image to obtain a plurality of partial images; according to the data information extraction and analysis method of the medical examination sheet, the image segmentation model is obtained through image correction and training based on the deep convolutional neural network model, and the image can be automatically segmented according to the content and typesetting characteristics of the image of the examination sheet based on vectorized similarity analysis by arranging the segmentation template, so that the complete image of the examination sheet is prevented from being identified when character identification is carried out, the segmented images can be respectively identified, and the identification precision of the examination sheet is improved.

title: A product launch prediction method based on decision sandbox
description: The application relates to the field of data processing, and provides a product release amount prediction method based on a decision sand table, which is used for determining burst co-occurrence probability by checking co-occurrence probability of a release area and a customer burst product purchasing behavior characteristic in a sand table simulation process and completing community division; determining a region selection coefficient based on the analysis result of the ordering of the sudden purchasing behavior of the client in the trial delivery region in the community and the satisfaction degree of the dynamic demand of the client to obtain the delivery region; determining a business turn influence weight sequence based on the influence of the selected existing products in the putting area on the business turn purchasing power; and analyzing the potential attraction capacity of the released product to the clients to obtain potential attraction indexes, obtaining a released quantity sample sequence, and completing the released quantity prediction in each released area. According to the method, the single data sequence is weighted through the influence analysis of complementarity among the products and the analysis of the product purchasing abilities of business circles and clients, so that the accurate prediction of the multi-region delivery quantity is realized.

title: A sea wave forecasting method, electronic device and medium for flat sea areas
description: The invention discloses a wave forecasting method for a plane sea area, an electronic device, and a medium, comprising: training a wave forecasting model, including: setting a step size, obtaining the effective wave height, effective wave period, and wave direction corresponding to the target time through a sliding window; processing the historical effective wave height, historical effective wave period, historical wave direction, and sea-land distribution information of the plane sea area to be predicted through a ConvLSTM layer to obtain a first intermediate tensor; performing spatiotemporal fusion on the first intermediate tensor to obtain a second intermediate tensor; processing the second intermediate tensor through a Conv3D layer to obtain the corresponding effective wave height, effective wave period, and wave direction of the plane sea area at the target time; taking the effective wave height, effective wave period, and wave direction corresponding to the target time as training labels, iteratively training the wave forecasting model. Wave forecasting is performed using a pre-trained wave forecasting model.

title: A sleep staging method and system based on self-supervised learning and Mamba network
description: The present invention relates to a sleep staging method and system based on self-supervised learning and Mamba network, belonging to the technical field of health information processing and pattern recognition. A self-supervised training network is used for data processing to extract high-quality sleep EEG signal features, and the self-supervised training network includes a three-branch parallel network of feature enhancement, feature screening, and mask prediction; a separable convolution module is used to extract time-frequency features of high-quality sleep EEG signal features; the extracted features are input into a feature enhancement module based on the Mamba network to extract context features again; and a classifier is used to classify the extracted feature information into sleep stages. The overall method of the present invention improves the efficiency, accuracy, and adaptability of sleep staging classification.

title: Model training method, device, electronic device and computer-readable storage medium
description: The application provides a model training method, a model training device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium; the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a student model to be trained and N teacher models, wherein the model performances of the teacher models are different, and N is a positive integer greater than 1; training a student model to be trained through a first teacher model to obtain a student model after first training; training the student model after the n-1 th training through the nth teacher model to obtain the student model after the n-th training; and determining the student model after the Nth training as a trained student model.

title: Training method and device for mine occupation feature extraction model
description: The invention provides a training method and a training device for a mine occupation feature extraction model, and relates to the field of remote sensing data processing; the method comprises the steps of performing first enhancement processing on remote sensing data in an original training sample set to obtain a first training sample set, performing second enhancement processing on the remote sensing data in the original training sample set to obtain a second training sample set, wherein the first enhancement processing and the second enhancement processing are different data enhancement processing methods, respectively inputting the first training sample set and the second training sample set into a model to be trained, performing iterative training, and stopping the iterative training until the similarity loss of the first feature and the second feature meets a preset condition to obtain a feature extraction model. The invention solves the problem of poor applicability of the extracted mine floor space characteristics on multitasking in the related technology.

title: Intelligent and efficient error detection and repair method and system
description: The invention discloses an intelligent and efficient error detection and repair method and system, which belong to the technical field of software engineering and artificial intelligence, and comprise the following steps: static code analysis: identifying potential errors and code odors by analyzing the source code; comprehensively scanning a source code, identifying potential grammar errors, logic loopholes and code peculiar smell, generating a preliminary error report, and displaying all detected problems; anomaly detection algorithm: detecting abnormal behaviors and potential defects in codes through machine learning and pattern recognition, and generating a comprehensive error report by combining static analysis results; intelligent repair: generating a repair suggestion according to the comprehensive error report and displaying the repair suggestion on a user interface; for common errors, the repair operation is automatically performed and the repair process is recorded. According to the invention, through static code analysis and advanced anomaly detection algorithm, efficient error detection and repair are realized, and the software quality and development efficiency are improved.

title: Method for programmatically generating role clusters in CG scene
description: The invention discloses a method for programmatically generating character clusters in CG scenes, and relates to the technical field of character cluster generation in CG scenes. The invention models a single character, creates a skeleton system of the character, and binds the skeleton system to the single character model. Use animation software to produce multiple character animations of a single character model, and the character animation includes action animation and expression animation; for multiple pairs of character animations with a correlation degree greater than a set animation correlation degree threshold, a correlation character animation library is generated, and these correlation character animations are randomly assigned to multiple pairs of single character models with a subsequent model action correlation degree higher than the threshold, so as to increase the correlation of nearby character actions, making them look more reasonable and real; and for character models with a lower correlation degree, a chaotic random algorithm is used to assign action animations; the character generation and animation assignment of character clusters in CG scenes can be quickly realized, making the visual experience more reasonable and real.

title: An intervention method for insomnia based on artificial intelligence and cognitive behavior
description: The invention relates to the technical field of insomnia analysis intervention, and discloses an insomnia disorder intervention method based on artificial intelligence and cognitive behaviors, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining the respiratory rate of a target person, forming sleep analysis data, forming the sleep analysis data, constructing an insomnia knowledge graph, forming comparison data, forming distribution data, pushing a diagnostician to the target person, judging and determining whether the sleep of the patient has insomnia problems according to the respiratory rate of the patient, performing intervention in time, judging and determining whether the sleep of the patient has external factors in a non-sleep period according to the heart rate of the patient, enabling the sleep of the patient to be disturbed, judging and determining the number of days of the influence of the external factors on the sleep of the patient according to the historical heart rate data of the patient, enabling the patient to obtain corresponding intervention treatment in time in the early stage of insomnia, and preventing the generation of more serious health problems.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle maneuver strategy generation method based on sparse rewards
description: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle maneuver strategy generation method based on sparse rewards, and belongs to the technical field of maneuver strategy generation methods. In order to solve the problem that sparse rewarding tasks are slow to converge, the method comprises the steps of collecting tracks, enabling distributed executors to interact with the environment independently, collecting tracks of the distributed executors, calculating discount rewards, storing the collected tracks in a global playback experience pool for offline strategy training, updating a strategy network and a value network model of a learner, wherein the strategy network model of the learner is updated, the learner distributes strategy network parameters to each executor, so that the strategy network model of all the executors is updated, each executor utilizes a parameter mask to randomly remodel inactive weights of an embedded network, strategy randomness is increased, and accordingly environment exploration capacity is improved.

title: Methods, devices, equipment, media and products for determining flood inundation range
description: The application discloses a flood inundation range determining method, device and equipment. The medium and the product relate to the technical field of flood disaster identification, and the flood submerging range determining method comprises the following steps: acquiring section information, elevation information, stripe height and compression block size; the section information includes: the point position longitude and latitude of the section, the water level of the section and the corresponding time; the stripe height is the pixel value of the segmentation stripe; the size of the compression block is the grid size of the segmentation elevation data; carrying out data compression on the section information, the elevation information, the stripe height and the compression block size to obtain stripe-section-grid associated information; determining a connected block by adopting a seed spreading algorithm based on the association information of the strip-section-grid; and determining a flood inundation range based on the connected blocks. The method can improve the calculation efficiency and reduce the memory consumption.

title: Furnace zone dew point control method and system for annealing furnace
