description: The application relates to the technical field of annealing furnace dew point control, in particular to a method and a system for controlling the dew point of a furnace zone of an annealing furnace, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting dew point data, temperature data and furnace pressure data; the method comprises the steps of obtaining fluctuation difference coefficients and variable speed difference coefficients of all dew point subsequences, calculating a data invariant index of the dew point sequence, obtaining a data change rate of the dew point sequence, obtaining a front duty ratio of the temperature sequence based on difference conditions between abrupt points in the temperature sequence and the dew point sequence, further obtaining a temperature response coefficient between the temperature sequence and the dew point sequence, obtaining ascending subsequences and descending subsequences of all corresponding dew point peaks, calculating a temperature response coefficient of the dew point sequence, and further controlling the furnace area dew point of the annealing furnace by combining a neural network. The application solves the problems that the prior control technology is difficult to cope with complex furnace section change and sudden process parameter fluctuation, and realizes accurate control of dew point.

title: Multi-feature indoor vision positioning method and system based on ground segmentation network
description: The present application relates to the field of indoor positioning technology and discloses a multi-feature indoor visual positioning method and system based on a ground segmentation network. The method comprises obtaining an initial image containing environmental information; extracting point features, line features, and surface features based on the initial image; matching the point features, line features, and surface features of the current frame with the point features, line features, and surface features in the previous key frame, calculating the matching error, and optimizing to obtain an estimated pose; judging whether the current frame is a new key frame based on the estimated pose; if the current frame is a new key frame, semantically segmenting the initial image based on a preset fully convolutional network model to obtain a ground semantic mask, and using the ground semantic mask to eliminate dynamic point features and dynamic line features located on the ground in the current frame; and performing local mapping operations. The present application has the effect of improving the accuracy and robustness of the positioning method and assisting intelligent robots in more accurate and faster positioning.

title: Water distribution optimization method and system for well-canal combined irrigation area based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The invention discloses a well and canal combined irrigation area water distribution optimization method and system based on deep reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining geographic satellite data, motor-pumped well information, channel information, soil moisture content prediction data and weather prediction data of a target area; dividing a target area into a well irrigation subarea, a canal irrigation subarea and a well canal combined irrigation subarea according to motor-pumped well information and channel information, combining soil moisture content prediction data and weather prediction data, predicting irrigation water demand of each subarea in each period of a future water distribution period, constructing and training a well canal combined irrigation subarea real-time water distribution model based on deep reinforcement learning, calculating water distribution capacity according to irrigation water demand for each well irrigation subarea and canal irrigation subarea, acquiring an optimal strategy according to the trained model for each well canal combined irrigation subarea, calculating water distribution capacity, and finally integrating water distribution capacity of all subareas to output as an optimal water distribution scheme. The invention can acquire a real-time water distribution scheme according to meteorological data, and the water distribution scheme is more accurate.

title: A method and system for monitoring specific personnel based on knowledge graph
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for monitoring specific personnel based on a knowledge graph, wherein the method includes, during the real-time monitoring process of the specific personnel, collecting the location data of all the collection moments in each cycle, constructing a knowledge graph for the specific personnel, obtaining each retention period and the corresponding retention position in each cycle, calculating the recent unconventional access coefficient of each retention position in the target cycle, determining the unconventional retention period of the target cycle, obtaining the unconventional retention distribution difference index and the unconventional retention trend progressive index, obtaining the monitoring behavior violation index, and obtaining the monitoring result of the specific personnel based on the knowledge graph and the monitoring behavior violation index. The embodiment of the present invention provides a method and system for monitoring specific personnel based on a knowledge graph, analyzes the behavior pattern of the monitored specific personnel, and improves the real-time monitoring of the specific personnel while ensuring the accuracy of the monitoring of the specific personnel.

title: Digital warehouse and logistics management system based on AI intelligent scheduling technology
description: The present invention discloses a digital warehousing and logistics management system based on AI intelligent scheduling technology, and specifically relates to the technical field of digital warehousing management, including: collecting material information, actual logistics efficiency and actual material energy consumption in digital warehousing; building a theoretical energy consumption prediction model and a theoretical efficiency prediction model based on machine learning, inputting logistics execution instructions into the trained theoretical energy consumption prediction model and theoretical efficiency prediction model, and outputting theoretical efficiency and theoretical energy consumption; constructing a material position fitness function of the material according to the theoretical efficiency and theoretical energy consumption of the material, taking the highest material position fitness as the goal, outputting the updated position coordinates of each material type through an optimization algorithm, and obtaining the maximum material position fitness when all materials are in the updated position coordinates; optimizing the material position based on the updated position coordinates, and solving the problem of resource waste caused by unreasonable material stacking position in the prior art.

title: Targeted polypeptide design method based on multitasking pre-training and migration learning
description: The present invention discloses a method for designing targeted peptides based on multi-task pre-training and transfer learning, and belongs to the field of peptide design. The method comprises: obtaining large-scale peptide sequence data and protein-peptide pairing data, encoding protein sequences and peptide sequences; constructing the peptide generative pre-training model based on multi-task autoregressive pre-training, and performing self-supervised multi-task training on the encoded large-scale peptide sequence data; guiding the transfer generation of peptide sequences through interactive perceptual attention, and obtaining a trained targeted peptide design model; and using the trained targeted peptide design model to generate peptide sequences for protein sequences. The present invention effectively utilizes the protein sequence-peptide sequence interaction relationship, and solves the problem of low precision in targeted peptide design; utilizes a multi-task prediction module to fully learn the synergistic interaction relationship between multiple tasks, and further improves the robustness and generalization ability of the targeted peptide design model.

title: A federated knowledge graph representation learning method and system based on reconstruction network
description: The present invention discloses a method for learning a federated knowledge graph representation based on a reconstruction network, including: initially defining a federated knowledge graph; constructing a global model M located on a server S; reconstructing a neural network of a defined client entity; obtaining the global model from the server, and restoring the low-dimensional entity vector therein to a local entity vector through an entity reconstruction network; and performing federated training by combining the server global model, the client's local reconstruction neural network, and a knowledge graph representation learning loss function. The present invention enables the knowledge graph representation learning model to adaptively learn the features of local data based on the characteristics of the knowledge graph, and at the same time, its low-dimensional entity vector can also effectively reduce the communication complexity between the server and the client, thereby achieving more effective federated knowledge graph learning.

title: Load forecasting method and device based on area profile, and electronic equipment
description: The invention discloses a load prediction method and device based on a district portrait and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of power load prediction, wherein the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the acquired platform region data, dividing the platform region data into a plurality of platform region images by adopting a clustering algorithm, extracting load data of a time sequence, inputting the load data into an input layer, inputting an output sequence of the input layer into a position coding layer for position coding to obtain a position coding output sequence, inputting the position coding output sequence into a convolution layer and a long-short-period memory layer to obtain characteristic data, inputting the characteristic data into a multi-head attention layer, performing linear transformation on the characteristic data to obtain data vectors, calculating periodic position codes of each head to obtain an output vector of the multi-head attention layer, inputting the output vector into a full-connection layer, and performing dimension transformation on the output vector to obtain a prediction result. The method solves the technical problem that the prediction accuracy is reduced due to the fact that the periodic characteristics of the load data cannot be effectively identified in the related technology.

title: Multi-neural network model calling method and device, industrial camera and storage medium
description: The multi-neural network model calling method and device, industrial camera and storage medium provided in the present application relate to the field of neural network model calling technology. In the present application, firstly, in response to the multi-neural network model configuration operation performed, the multiple neural network models that need to be called are called and configured to form a target calling configuration file; secondly, in response to the neural network model calling operation performed, the target calling configuration file is loaded to complete the loading of multiple neural network models, and the target industrial camera is triggered to start to perform image acquisition operations to obtain image data to be processed; then, the image data to be processed is loaded into multiple neural network models, so that the multiple neural network models process the image data to be processed in turn, and return the image data processing results. Based on the above content, the problem of high complexity of the implementation logic of multi-neural network model calling in the prior art can be improved.

title: Video mole pattern removing method based on selective time domain fusion
description: The invention discloses a video mole pattern removing method based on selective time domain fusion, which comprises the steps of inputting the characteristics output by a frame alignment module into a selective time domain fusion module after the characteristics are spliced, segmenting the spliced characteristics through a time domain channel fusion module, processing the characteristics by using a convolution layer and an activation function, then fusing the characteristics, inputting a spatial characteristic self-adaption module to refine the fused characteristics, effectively fusing time domain information of adjacent frames, and adaptively exploring useful characteristics of the fused frames, and meanwhile, effectively guiding the learning of parameters of shallow adjacent frame alignment through the spatial exploration of deep fused characteristics by the selective time domain fusion module, so as to avoid unstable system caused by overlarge characteristic deviation. In addition, the mole pattern removing sub-network used by the method effectively removes the mole patterns of each scale in the fusion frame by embedding the multi-scale attention module into each level of encoder of the codec network.

title: A wireless expansion board for automatically switching networks and a network switching method thereof
description: The present invention provides a wireless expansion board for automatically switching networks and a network switching method thereof, wherein the expansion board includes: a SIM card module for installing a SIM card; an expansion interface module for externally connecting a general routing board or a CPE device; a wireless interface module electrically connected to the SIM card module through a SIM card interface, and electrically connected to the expansion interface module through a USB protocol; an out-of-band interface module for providing remote control services; a control module electrically connected to the wireless interface module and the out-of-band interface module, for implementing SIM card switching through the wireless interface module, and implementing remote control services through the out-of-band interface module. The present invention uses a plug-in 4G/5G module wireless expansion board and a standard USB interface as an expansion interface, so that enterprises are no longer restricted by the support capabilities of the general routing operating system for 4G/5G module products, thereby flexibly realizing independent access and operation and maintenance management of wireless networks.

title: Multi-tamper positioning method based on front background union and edge guidance
description: The invention discloses a multi-tamper positioning method based on foreground-background linkage and edge guidance, which comprises the following steps of obtaining a multi-operation image dataset, wherein each image comprises at least two tamper types, the tamper types comprise splicing, copying-moving and deleting, constructing a multi-tamper positioning model, and the multi-tamper positioning model comprises a backbone network formed by a Res2net network and a residual network connected to each scale output of the Res2net network and an edge-assisted thinning fusion module, and training the multi-tamper positioning model by utilizing the multi-operation image dataset so that the trained multi-tamper positioning model is used for positioning different types of tampered areas in the image. The problem of how to accurately position a plurality of tampered areas in the image is solved, and the accurate positioning of a plurality of tampered types of one picture is realized.

title: A two-stage pedestrian and vehicle detection method
description: The invention provides a two-stage pedestrian vehicle detection method which specifically comprises the steps of S1, collecting and marking a pedestrian vehicle data set, S2, training a pedestrian vehicle detection model, S3, applying a pedestrian vehicle detection device end and the like. The invention can effectively combine the advantages of the two models of the single-stage and the double-stage, optimize some inherent problems of the single-stage detection model, remarkably improve the detection precision on the premise of keeping the real-time performance by the serial combination of the two single-stage detection models, reduce false alarm and missing report, and have stronger robustness and flexibility. Compared with the existing single high-performance model, two-stage detection model and single lightweight model, the method provides better balance in performance and resource occupation under a complex background, particularly a scene containing a small target, and is particularly suitable for a scene needing to consider speed and precision.

title: Training method of machine-generated text detection model based on machine style optimization, machine-generated text detection method and device
description: The training method of the machine-generated text detection model comprises the steps of loading a first pre-training model by using a model loading module, loading a word segmentation device of the first pre-training model by using a word segmentation device loading module, obtaining the difference between the output of the first reference model and the output of the first scoring model by using a sampling deviation analysis module so as to obtain a prediction result, and training the machine-generated text detection model based on an original text, a real label initialized to be None, and the degree of difference between the current prediction result of the model and the real label. The invention solves the problem of misalignment between the source model and the detection model in the existing zero sample method, improves the alignment rate between probability distribution of the source model and the detection model, and further remarkably improves the accuracy of the machine-generated text detection technology.

title: A method for generating large language models from blockchain smart contract code
description: The invention relates to the technical field of machine learning and blockchain, in particular to a method for generating a large language model by using a blockchain intelligent contract code. A CodeBC model is generated through intelligent contract codes, and the method comprises the following steps of task definition, code filling, vulnerability detection and instruction fine adjustment guided by labels. The invention provides a safer blockchain intelligent contract code generation model CodeBC, which adopts a two-stage fine tuning method to enhance the capability of the model to program intelligent contract codes and understand human instructions. The method comprises a first stage of adopting a multi-task learning fine tuning strategy comprising code filling and vulnerability detection tasks to strengthen understanding of a model on intelligent contract codes and perception capability on security vulnerabilities, and a second stage of adopting label-guided instruction fine tuning to improve the capability of the model to generate security contract codes while the model is aligned to understand language instructions.

title: Method and apparatus for creating software objects
description: Method and apparatus for the dynamic generation (2) and regeneration (3) of software objects that can have logic that specifies structure, functionality and behavior in a computing system. In one embodiment, the regeneration function (3) produces related, but different instances of software objects, including System Logic Objects. The regeneration function (3) comprises ordered sequences of tasks, whose definition, and parameterization are obtained from a Generative Model (2), and which are performed by software objects called Builders (4). Each Builder (4) accepts a set of input parameters and a reference to a container that contains zero or more generated software objects, including System Logic Objects. The regeneration function (3) directs each Builder (4) to work on the contents of the container, add, modify, and delete objects, and return the container with updated contents. The behavior of the regeneration function can be altered by disabling selected Builders, and by changing the inputs to the Builders (4).

title: Systems, methods, and apparatus for automatic image recognition
description: A method of improving the accuracy and computation time of automatic image recognition by the implementation of association graphs and a quantum processor.

title: Network methods for neurodegenerative diseases
description: A method of determining patient response to a neuropharmacological intervention, a method of determining a patient's likelihood of developing one or more neurological disorders, and systems for the same. The method of determining a patient's likelihood of developing one or more neurological disorders, comprising the steps of: obtaining data indicative of electrical activity within the brain of the patient; generating a network, based at least in part on the obtained data, said network comprising a plurality of nodes and directed connections between nodes,wherein the network is indicative of a flow of the electrical activity within the brain of the patient; calculating, for each node, a difference in a number and/or strength of connections into the node and a number and/or strength of connections out of the node; and determining, using the calculated differences, the patient's likelihood of developing one or more neurological disorders.

title: Computer-implemented platform for tracking and analyzing customer-mattress interactions
description: A customer's affinity towards a plurality of mattresses displayed in a brick and mortar store is determined. The probability of the customer purchasing at least one of the displayed mattresses is extrapolated based on the customer's affinity towards each of the mattresses. Customer engagement with each of the mattresses is determined based on the pressure data obtained from embedded pressure sensors responsive to the body pressure. The pressure data and the information indicative of a total number of positions taken up by the customer on each of the mattresses, time spent by the customer on each of the mattresses in each of the positions, and the total time spent by the customer on each of the mattresses are fed to a neural network as inputs, with the neural network determining an affinity score indicative of the customer's affinity towards each of the mattresses.

title: Systems and methods for writing by sequencing of nucleic acids
description: The systems, devices, and methods described herein provide nucleic acid digital data storage encoding and retrieving methods that are less costly and easier to commercially implement than existing methods. The systems, devices, and methods described herein provide scalable methods for writing data to and reading data from nucleic acid molecules. The present disclosure covers five primary areas of interest: (1) writing digital information into nucleic acid molecules, (2) accurately and quickly reading information stored in nucleic acid molecules, (3) partitioning data to efficiently encode data in nucleic acid molecules, (4) error protection and correction when encoding data in nucleic acid molecules, and (5) data structures to provide efficient access to information stored in nucleic acid molecules.

title: Back propagation system
description: INVENTION: Back Propagation System INVENTOR: Max Stanford Tomlinson Jr.             ABSTRACT OF OF THE DISCLOSURE   A continuous-time information processing system having an input layer, which receives an input stimulus vector, a hidden layer which processes the input stimuli vector and passes the information to an output layer which provides an output vector and receives an error stimulus vector. Each layer consists of one or more processing elements. Two processing elements may be coupled together by a synaptic element. Each synaptic element has a unique transfer function. Each synaptic element provides a forwards transfer of information and a backwards transfer of error between processing elements. The output value of each process-ing element is dependent upon a function of the information transferred to the processing element by the synaptic elements transferring information to it. The error value of each hidden processing element is similarly dependent upon a different function of the error transferred to the hidden processing element by the synaptic elements transferring error thereto. The system further includes a means for adjusting the transfer characteristics of each synaptic elements.

title: Product obsolescence forecast system and method
description: A product obsolescence forecast system includes machine instructions stored in a non-transitory computer readable storage medium, the machine instructions. A processor executes the instructions to receive an identity of a first product and identities of one or more second products similar to the first product, each of the second products having gone obsolete; receive a determinant of obsolescence of one or more of the obsolete second products; generate one or more observations related to the first product by inputting each received determinant to a trained network; and generate a statistical analysis of the one or more observations to provide an expected value of an actual obsolescence date for the first product.

title: Methods and systems for touchless control with a mobile device
description: Methods and systems for touchless control of a device include receiving an image from a camera and applying a machine learning technique the image to determine a first map, the first map including a function that generates a correspondence between data associated with the image to a feature space. A second map including a representation of a user in the image can be determined based on the first map. Further, a pose of the user can be determined based on the second map. The pose of the user and a portion of a body of the user can be tracked to determine a mapping between the portion of the user's body and an input feature of a device. The input feature can be modified based on the mapping to enable a touchless interaction between the user and the device.

title: Machine learning system
description: A machine learning system configured to map an input data instance to an output according to a system mapping. The system mapping may be composed from multiple functions. A latent input vector may be determined in a second latent space for the input data instance, from latent reference vectors related to a number of reference data instances identified as parents.

title: Electronic apparatus and method of controlling the same
description: Disclosed is an electronic apparatus comprising, a memory configured to store instructions; and at least one processor connected to the memory, and configured to detect at least one object of a first-class object or a second-class object included in a target image by the electronic apparatus using an artificial intelligent algorithm to apply the target image to a learned neural network model, and identify and apply an image-quality processing method to be individually applied to at least one detected object, the neural network model is set to detect an object included in an image, as trained based on learning data such as an image, a class to which the image belongs, information about the first-class object included in the image, and information about the second-class object included in the image.

title: Semantic Mapping of Environments for Autonomous Devices
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus for receiving a reference to an object located in an environment of a robot, accessing mapping data that indicates, for each of a plurality of object instances, respective probabilities of the object instance being located at one or more locations in the environment, wherein the respective probabilities are based at least on an amount of time that has passed since a prior observation of the object instance was made, identifying one or more particular object instances that correspond to the referenced object, determining, based at least on the mapping data, the respective probabilities of the one or more particular object instances being located at the one or more locations in the environment, selecting, based at least on the respective probabilities, a particular location in the environment where the referenced object is most likely located, and directing the robot to navigate to the particular location.

title: Data generalization for predictive models
description: A method, apparatus and a product for data generalization for predictive models. The method comprising: obtaining a training dataset that comprises a plurality of training instances and predicted labels thereof, wherein each training instance is a valuation of a set of features, wherein the set of features comprises a feature having a domain, wherein the predicted label of each training instance is a label predicted thereto by a predictive model; training an auxiliary model using the training dataset; based on the auxiliary model, determining an alternative set of features that is a generalization of the set of features, wherein the alternative set of features comprises a generalized feature having a generalized domain, wherein each value in the generalized domain corresponds to one or more values in the domain; obtaining a generalized instance having a valuation of the alternative set of features; and determining a label for the generalized instance.

title: Example based entity extraction, slot filling and value recommendation
description: Methods, systems, apparatuses, and computer program products are provided for extracting an entity value from a sentence. An embedding set that may include one or more sentence embeddings is generated for at least part of a first sentence that is tagged to associate a first named entity in the sentence with an entity type. A plurality of candidate embeddings is also generated for at least part of a second sentence. The one or more sentence embeddings in the embedding set may be compared with each of the plurality of candidate embeddings, and a match score may be assigned to each comparison to generate a match score set. A particular match score of the match score set may be identified that exceeds a similarity threshold, and an entity value of the entity type may be extracted from the second sentence associated with the identified match score.

title: Data management system for use with agreements and data detailing concepts, designs, and ideas
description: Systems and methods for managing an organization's agreements and possible IP assets. The system provides users from the organization a user interface in which to enter ideas, concepts, and/or designs related to one or more projects, which can include products, services, transactions and ideas. These entries can then be stored, managed, and mined as necessary by the organization. In addition, the system allows for the storage of the organization's agreements and for the analysis of such agreements to flag/identify potential issues with such agreements. Machine learning and artificial intelligence-based methods and subsystems can be used to analyze these agreements. Experts in the various relevant fields provide the logic and samples against which the agreements are to be assessed. Multi-tenant embodiments of the system permit organization users, expert users, and third parties to access, modify and/or review data related to the projects.

title: Automatically adjusting screen brightness based on screen content
description: Disclosed are examples for adjusting screen brightness based on screen content being presented on a display screen of a mobile device. The described examples may determine a time at which the screen content is to be evaluated. The screen content is categorized based on the evaluation. A category of the screen content may be input into a machine learning algorithm that may be used to determine whether a screen brightness adjustment is appropriate. If a screen brightness adjustment is appropriate, a degree of the screen brightness adjustment may be determined.

title: Enhanced survey information synthesis
description: Enhanced survey information synthesis can include performing a respondent assessment of a survey respondent based on respondent data obtained electronically from one or more electronic data sources. Survey responses provided by the survey respondent can be adjusted, the adjusting based on the respondent assessment. A revised survey can be generated, the revised survey comprising the survey responses adjusted based on the respondent assessment.

title: Methods and systems for determining emergency data for a vehicle
description: A system, a method, and a computer program product are provided for determining emergency data in a region. The system may include a processor configured to execute computer program code instructions stored in a memory to obtain live video data associated with the vehicle in the region and determine the emergency data of the vehicle from the live video data using a three-dimensional convolution neural network (3D-CNN) model. The live video data may include one or more video clips. The 3D-CNN model may include a plurality of convolution layers, a plurality of pooling layers, and a plurality of fully connected layers. The processor is further configured to generate an emergency notification based on the emergency data and providing the emergency notification to one or more subjects.

title: Server device
description: A server device includes a processor and a memory. The server device provides a user portal including multiple user levels to one or more users. The multiple user levels include: a first user level, which includes a homepage, and a second user level, which includes a key account portal.

title: Object detection based on pixel differences
description: Aspects of the subject technology relate to machine learning based object recognition using pixel difference information. A difference image generated by subtraction of a current image from one or more previous images can be provided, as input, to a machine-learning engine. The machine-learning may output a detected object or a detected action based, at least in part, on the difference image. In this way, temporal information about the object can be provided to, and used by, a machine-learning model that is structured to accept image input.

title: Enhanced processor functions for calculation
description: Enhanced processor functions for calculation are described. An example of an apparatus includes one or more processors including one or more processing resources and a memory to store data, the data including data for compute operations. A processing resource of the one or more processing resources includes a configurable pipeline for calculation operations, and wherein the configurable pipeline may be utilized to perform both a normal instruction for a calculation in a certain precision and a systolic instruction for a calculation in a certain precision.

title: Construction machine
description: This construction machine comprises: an attitude sensor that detects the current attitude of an upper turning body; a reference angular acceleration calculation unit that calculates a reference angular acceleration to be generated when an electric turning motor is driven by a torque command value generated according to the operation amount of an operation part; a reference gravity torque calculation unit that, on the basis of the current attitude and the deviation between an actual angular acceleration which is obtained from a rotation speed and the reference angular acceleration, calculates a reference gravity torque which is a torque component to be generated about the turning axis by the gravity in the reference attitude; a gravity compensation torque calculation unit that, on the basis of the reference gravity torque and the current attitude, calculates a gravity compensation torque for compensating a torque component generated about the turning axis by the gravity in the current attitude; and a correction unit that corrects the torque command value by using the gravity compensation torque so as to cancel the torque component generated about the turning axis by the gravity in the current attitude.

title: Scenic Route-Based Navigation Directions
description: To provide navigation directions for a scenic route, a machine learning model is trained using (i) characteristics of road segments that have been assigned a scenic metric and (ii) the scenic metrics for the road segments. In response to a request for navigation directions, a set of candidate routes for navigating from the starting location to the destination location is identified. Then for each road segment within each candidate route, characteristics of the road segment are applied to the machine learning model to generate the scenic metric for the road segment. A route is then selected from the set of candidate routes based at least in part on the scenic metrics of the road segments within the route. A set of navigation directions is provided for presentation on a client device for navigating from the starting location to the destination location via the selected route.

title: Systems and methods for scalable segmentation model training
description: Systems and methods for cloud-based scalable segmentation model training solutions including a computing interface by which a client/user/customer can upload and store training data in a storage device of a cloud-based network, provide access to the training data stored in the storage device, initiate a request for training a segmentation model, monitor the training of the segmentation model, and download the trained segmentation model, and a computing system operatively coupled with a client device through the computing interface and configured to pre-process the training data using a first set of computing resources of the cloud-based network, store the processed training data in a storage device of the cloud-based network, deploy, upon a training request from the client device, a training application on a second set of computing resources of the cloud-based network to train the segmentation model based on the processed training data, provide access to the client device to monitor the training, and provide access to the trained segmentation model.

title: Systems and Methods for Spinal Correction Surgical Planning
description: A system for surgical planning and assessment of spinal deformity correction is provided that has a spinal imaging system and a control unit. The spinal imaging system is configured to collect at least one digitized position of one or more vertebral bodies of a subject. The control unit is configured to receive the at least one digitized position, and calculate, based on the at least one digitized position, an optimized posture for the subject. The control unit is configured to receive one or more simulated spinal correction inputs, and based on the inputs and optimized posture, predict an optimal simulated postoperative surgical correction.

title: Control device, control method, and program
description: A control device includes a recognizing unit that recognizes the external environment based on sensing information; an action decision managing unit that, based on the recognized external environment, decides on the actions to be taken; a behavior managing unit that, based on at least either the difficulty level of recognition for the recognizing unit or the difficulty level of action decision for the action decision managing unit, determines about whether or not to exhibit emotional expressions; and a drive control unit that, based on the determination performed by the behavior control unit, controls the execution of the actions corresponding to emotional expressions.

title: Bus Network for Artificial Intelligence-Based Base Caller
description: The technology disclosed relates to a system that comprises a spatial convolution network and a temporal convolution network. The spatial convolution network is configured to process a window of per-cycle sequencing image sets and generate respective per-cycle spatial feature map sets. Trained coefficients of spatial convolution filters in spatial convolution filter banks of respective sequences of spatial convolution filter banks vary between sequences of spatial convolution layers in respective sequences of spatial convolution layers. The temporal convolution network is configured to process the per-cycle spatial feature map sets on a groupwise basis and generate respective per-group temporal feature map sets. Trained coefficients of temporal convolution filters in respective temporal convolution filter banks vary between temporal convolution filter banks in respective temporal convolution filter banks.

title: Systems and Methods for Controlling Data Exposure Using Artificial-Intelligence-Based Periodic Modeling
description: Systems and methods for periodically modifying data privacy elements are provided. The systems and methods may identify a set of data privacy elements. A data privacy element can characterizes a feature of a computing device and can be detectable by a network host. A first artificial profile can be generated by modifying a first data privacy element based on an artificial profile model that defines a relationship associated with one or more constraints between the set of data privacy elements. Subsequent to generating the first artificial profile, a second artificial profile can be generated by periodically modifying a second data privacy element in accordance with the relationship defined by the artificial profile model. The computer device can be masked from being identified by the network host by sending the second artificial profile including the second data privacy element to a requested network location.

title: Generating performance predictions with uncertainty intervals
description: A technique for generating a performance prediction of a machine learning model with uncertainty intervals includes obtaining a first model configured to perform a task and a production dataset. At least one metric predicting a performance of the first model at performing the task on the production dataset is generated using a second model. The second model is a meta-model associated with the first model. At least one value predicting an uncertainty of the at least one metric predicting the performance of the first model at performing the task on the production dataset is generated using a third model. The third model is a meta-meta-model associated with the second model. An indication of the at least one metric and the at least one value is provided.

title: Continuous utility pole health monitoring based on finite element analysis and operational modal analysis using das
description: Aspects of the present disclosure describe distributed fiber optic sensing (DFOS) systems, methods, and structures that advantageously enable and/or facilitate the continuous monitoring and identification of damaged utility poles by employing a DFOS distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) methodology in conjunction with a finite element analysis and operational modal analysis. Of particular advantage and in further contrast to the prior art, systems, methods, and structures according to aspects of the present disclosure utilize existing optical fiber supported/suspended by the utility poles as a sensing medium for the DFOS/DAS operation.

title: System and method of quantum enhanced accelerated neural network training
description: A novel and useful system and method of quantum enhanced accelerated training of a classic neural network (NN). The quantum system implements an optimizer that accelerates training of the classic NN by exploiting the properties of quantum mechanics and manipulating the quantum system into a state that represents the complete state of the classic NN, including the loss function. The quantum system is then allowed to transition to its “optimum state” and the minimum energy state is read out from detectors and weight updates are calculated and fed back to the classic NN. Mapping and detection helper neural networks learn the characteristics of the quantum system structures. By averaging this over a number of images the learning weight or gradient of descent can be controlled to yield optimum neural network parameters. The time and energy required for training the classic NN as well as for inference is drastically reduced.

title: Robotic camera software and controller
description: A robotic camera system comprising: a robot head ( 45 ), for carrying and orienting a camera ( 48 ), a video capture unit ( 30 ), operatively arranged to capture video and/audio recording from the camera and storing in a frame buffer area ( 260 ), a processor unit ( 40 ), having access to the frame buffer area ( 260 ) and operatively arranged for generating a reference camera trajectory ( 130 ) based on directives from a director, optimizing ( 140 ) said camera trajectory based on a real-time projection of objects of interest in the video recording in the frame buffer area ( 260 ), driving the robot head ( 45 ) to follow the optimized trajectory.

title: Handling an Outbound Call Reaching a Voicemail Service
description: Various embodiments of the invention provide methods, systems, and computer-program products for handling a call reaching a party's voicemail. A predictive model is used to generate a first probability of an outcome occurring as a result of leaving a voicemail message and a second probability of the outcome occurring as a result of sending a text message. If the first probability is greater, an IVR uses DTMF tone(s) to bypass a greeting on the voicemail so that a message can be recorded with minimal time. If the second probability is greater, the call is ended and an email is sent to the party's service provider using an email address comprising a mobile number for the party and a domain portion specific to the provider. As a result, the provider delivers a text message to the party with the body of the message including the content of the email.

title: Systems and methods for connecting to people with requested skillsets
description: A computer system is provided. The computer system includes a memory and at least one processor coupled to the memory and configured to query a user profiling system with a skillset provided by a requestor and identify a target user that is associated with the skillset based on the query results. The at least one processor is further configured to identify a network path linking the requestor with the target user. The network path includes one or more links between nodes of a user network, the nodes associated with users including the requestor, the target user, and other users. The at least one processor is further configured to identify a preferred communication channel associated with the target user and/or the other users, based on the query results, and to provide a recommendation to the requester, the recommendation comprising the target user, the preferred communication channel, and the network path.

title: Systems and methods for fraud dispute of pending transactions
description: A system for fraud dispute of pending transactions. The system comprising receiving data corresponding to a pending transaction between the user and a merchant; and analyzing the transaction data to determine whether the transaction data comprises at least one indicator of a fraudulent transaction. Wherein, pausing an initiation to provide funds for the pending transaction, providing the user at least one questionnaire relating to the received transaction data or a set of stored user data, receiving a response from the user for the questionnaire, comparing the received response to the received transaction data or the stored user data, determining whether to validate the user based on the comparison, rejecting the pending transaction when the user is not validated, and removing the indicator when the user is validated. Wherein, approving the pending transaction, and initiating a request to provide funds to the merchant. And storing the received transaction data and analysis.

title: Parallel proxy model based machine learning method for oil reservoir production
description: The present disclosure relates to a parallel proxy model based machine learning method for oil reservoir production. With the proposed method, multiple optimized candidate solutions can be obtained within an iteration, and then a matrix laboratory (e.g., MATLAB) is used to call numerical simulation software Eclipse in parallel to conduct actual evaluation on the candidate solutions simultaneously, so that optimization time of complex problems can be greatly reduced. With the method of the present disclosure, the efficiency of solving an oilfield production optimization problem can be speeded up to a greater extent than in the art, and the final optimization effect can be improved. Moreover, the method of the present disclosure may further be used for well pattern optimization, history matching, and so on, apart from adjusting schedules of the producers and injectors in the oilfield.

title: Intelligent data munging
description: According to examples, intelligent data munging may include ascertaining data that is to be transformed, and determining, based on an analysis of the ascertained data, a sample of the ascertained data. Intelligent data munging may further include enriching the sample of the ascertained data, determining features of the enriched sample of the ascertained data, and determining, based on the features, a transformation to be applied to the enriched sample of the ascertained data to transform the enriched sample of the ascertained data from a first format to a second format. Further, intelligent data munging may include validating the determined transformation, and generating, based on the validation of the determined transformation, a script that is to be applied to the ascertained data to transform the ascertained data from the first format to the second format.

title: Environmental monitoring systems, methods and media
description: A system for monitoring a physical environmental property having non-stationary heteroscedastic noise is disclosed. A processor receives physical environmental measurement data, and constructs a combined input and output noise levels matrix containing output noise terms associated with the physical environmental property and input noise terms associated with the at least one independent variable. Using the combined input and output noise levels matrix, the processor constructs a main Gaussian Processes (GP) model for the physical environmental property and its non-stationary heteroscedastic noise. The processor generates and co-operates with the output device to perceptibly output a predictive probabilistic representation of the environmental property, using the main GP model. The predictive probabilistic representation includes a respective range of possible values of the physical environmental property for each respective value of the independent variable(s), the range reflecting both the input noise terms and the output noise terms.

title: Superconducting interposer for the transmission of quantum information for quantum error correction
description: A system for transmission of quantum information for quantum error correction includes an ancilla qubit chip including a plurality of ancilla qubits, and a data qubit chip spaced apart from the ancilla qubit chip, the data qubit chip including a plurality of data qubits. The system includes an interposer coupled to the ancilla qubit chip and the data qubit chip, the interposer including a dielectric material and a plurality of superconducting structures formed in the dielectric material. The superconducting structures enable transmission of quantum information between the plurality of data qubits on the data qubit chip and the plurality of ancilla qubits on the ancilla qubit chip via virtual photons for quantum error correction.

title: Adversarial semi-supervised one-shot learning
description: A method, a computer program product, and a system of adversarial semi-supervised one-shot training using a data stream. The method includes receiving a data stream based on an observation, wherein the data stream includes unlabeled data and labeled data. The method also includes training a prediction model with the labeled data using stochastic gradient descent based on a classification loss and an adversarial term and training a representation model with the labeled data and the unlabeled data based on a reconstruction loss and the adversarial term. The adversarial term is a cross-entropy between the middle layer output data from the models. The classification loss is a cross-entropy between the labeled data and an output from the prediction model. The method further includes updating a discriminator with middle layer output data from the prediction model and the representation model and based on a discrimination loss, and discarding the data stream.

title: Ensuring reproducibility in artificial intelligence infrastructure
description: Ensuring reproducibility in an artificial intelligence infrastructure comprising one or more storage systems and one or more graphics processing unit ('GPU') servers, comprising: identifying, by a unified management plane, one or more transformations applied by the artificial intelligence infrastructure to a data set, wherein applying the one or more transformations to the data set causes the artificial intelligence infrastructure to generate a transformed data set; storing, within the one or more storage systems, information describing the data set, the one or more transformations applied to the data set, and the transformed data set; identifying, by the unified management plane, one or more machine learning models executed by the artificial intelligence infrastructure using the transformed data set as input; and storing, within the one or more storage systems, information describing the one or more machine learning models executed using the transformed data set as input.

title: Intelligent radiation source supervision method and system based on Internet of things
description: The invention discloses an intelligent radiation source supervision method and system based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the following steps: synchronously recording the geographic, time and radiation intensity characteristic data set of each data point, transmitting the data to a time sequence database, and carrying out indexing processing, aggregation and normalization on the data to generate a radiation data set; performing characteristic index calculation, applying an encoder to learn, optimizing encoder parameters, calculating an abnormal index of each data point, and calculating to obtain an abnormal recognition threshold; converting the radiation intensity into a fuzzy value, performing aggregation operation to obtain fuzzy matching degree, and further calculating fuzzy weight scores of each data point; combining the anomaly identification threshold value with the fuzzy weight score, calculating a risk score of each data point, and calculating a risk assessment result of each data point by combining the risk classification threshold value.

title: Speculative decoding method, device, equipment and medium in large language model
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a speculative decoding method, a device, equipment and a medium in a large language model. The method comprises the following steps: reading historical text information in a memory and transmitting the historical text information to a computing unit; executing in a computing unit: inputting the historical text information into a preset length predictor to obtain an inference length; inputting the reasoning length and the historical text information into a preset speculative decoding model to obtain predictive text information with the same number as the reasoning length; inputting the historical text information into the large language model to obtain target text information output by the large language model; inputting the historical text information, the target text information and each predicted text information into a large language model for verification to obtain the target predicted text information with correct reasoning; and performing iterative training according to the historical text information and the target predictive text information to obtain a target length predictor and a target predictive decoding model. The method considers the reasoning length in the speculative decoding, and can improve the model reasoning performance.

title: License plate recognition method and device based on RAW image
description: The invention discloses a license plate recognition method and device based on RAW images, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining license plate data and historical data of an object to be detected; preprocessing historical data, and determining preprocessed target data; constructing a license plate recognition model, training the license plate recognition model by utilizing target data, and determining a target license plate recognition model; and identifying license plate data by utilizing the target license plate identification model, and determining an identification result. The invention uses RAW image data with four channels as input to construct a convolutional neural network, converts RGGB four-channel RAW data into RGB three-channel image data in a self-adaptive way, then connects with a license plate character recognition model pre-trained based on the RGB three-channel data, and fixes model parameters of the license plate recognition model, thereby fully extracting and utilizing RAW image data information of the four channels, and converting unsupervised data into RGB images which can be easier to carry out license plate character recognition.

title: Power transmission line segmentation method and system for aerial images of unmanned aerial vehicle
description: The invention discloses a transmission line segmentation method for unmanned aerial vehicle aerial images, which comprises the steps of obtaining the unmanned aerial vehicle aerial images of a transmission line and preprocessing to obtain a training data set; constructing a power transmission line segmentation primary model based on a U-Net network, an ASPP network and a residual attention network, and training to obtain a power transmission line segmentation model; and acquiring an aerial image of the target power transmission line by using the unmanned aerial vehicle, and completing the segmentation of the power transmission line for the aerial image of the unmanned aerial vehicle by using a power transmission line segmentation model. The invention also discloses a system for realizing the transmission line segmentation method for the unmanned aerial vehicle aerial image. According to the invention, an accurate training data set is obtained in a preprocessing mode, and a transmission line segmentation model is constructed and trained based on the U-Net network, the ASPP network and the residual attention network, so that the segmentation of the transmission line for the unmanned aerial vehicle aerial image under a complex background can be realized, and the reliability and the accuracy are higher.

title: Safflower quality production allocation method and system based on near infrared hyperspectral image recognition and LIBS data fusion
description: The invention provides a safflower quality production and allocation method and system based on near infrared hyperspectral image recognition and LIBS data fusion, which are used for training to obtain a safflower image-hydroxysafflor yellow A concentration recognition model; respectively collecting near infrared hyperspectral image data of safflower of the same batch of different packages, and obtaining respective hydroxysafflor yellow A concentration by using a carthamus tinctorius image-hydroxysafflor yellow A concentration identification model; detecting the same batch of safflower with different packages in the step S2 by using a laser-induced breakdown spectrometer LIBS to obtain inorganic ion concentration; and carrying out blending decision on the concentration of the hydroxysafflor yellow A and the concentration of the inorganic ions of the safflower which are packaged in different batches through a deep reinforcement learning model DQN to obtain a blending scheme. The invention effectively reduces the quality fluctuation in the Chinese medicinal material batch and improves the quality consistency of the product.

title: Large language model distributed flow parallel fine tuning method for heterogeneous GPU graphics card
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural language processing, and discloses a large language model distributed flow parallel fine tuning method for a heterogeneous GPU display card, which is based on a multi-task fine tuning system to realize fine tuning on a plurality of LoRA models at the same time; each LoRA model is divided into a plurality of parts, distributed on the corresponding number of GPUs, and the GPUs are ordered; generating a plurality of tasks through a task configuration module according to a user request, and dividing each task into a plurality of training batches; generating a scheduling scheme by combining a task dynamic scheduler with a dynamic scheduling strategy according to the training batch sequence of each task; and sending the scheduling scheme to a multi-task training module on the corresponding GPU according to the GPU positive sequence, and training all LoRA models. The invention adopts a fine model segmentation and distribution strategy, a pipeline optimization path and a task load balancing strategy, can more effectively utilize the computing resources of a multi-machine multi-card environment, improves the overall efficiency of the fine tuning process, and reduces the waste of resources.

title: Real-time detection task scheduling system and method for defects of high-speed railway overhead line system through sensing and calculation coordination
description: The invention discloses a system and a method for real-time detection task scheduling of a high-speed railway catenary defect with sense calculation coordination, which combine a sense calculation coordination frame to decouple the high-speed railway catenary defect detection task, split subtasks, establish a sense calculation coordination high-speed railway catenary defect real-time detection scheduling model, design an improved cuckoo genetic algorithm scheduling method to obtain a task scheduling decision, and reasonably schedule the tasks to edge equipment. The system and the method provided by the invention effectively improve the task execution efficiency and the edge equipment resource utilization rate in the contact network defect detection scene, better meet the real-time detection requirement, and realize reasonable allocation of the edge computing resources and the tasks to be detected in the contact network defect detection scene under the sensing and computing cooperative architecture.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for processing periodic texture image
description: The disclosure relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for processing a periodic texture image, comprising the following steps: collecting a first image of a tested product, taking the first image as a current image and executing the following parameter detection operation: searching a texture period of the current image by GAMPD; detecting whether abnormal pixel points exist in the current image or not according to the adjacent comparison algorithm and the current detection threshold value one by one according to each texture period; determining the texture period without abnormal pixel points as a candidate texture period; collecting a second image of the detected product after the position is moved, taking a spliced image of the second image and the current image as a new current image, and executing parameter detection operation again; stopping until no abnormal pixel point exists in the current image is detected, and determining a target texture period, a target detection threshold value and a target golden template image through the steps; image defect detection is performed using the target texture period, the target detection threshold, and the target golden template image. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of image defect detection.

title: Urban road management method and system based on AI
description: The application provides an AI-based urban road management method and system, which construct an urban traffic network knowledge structure by acquiring holographic traffic perception data in real time, and determine traffic participation subject clusters and traffic path clusters according to the knowledge structure. The method further utilizes the cluster information to extract the fusion expression characteristics of the communication members related to the target traffic participation main body and the target traffic path, combines the traffic perception characteristics to conduct accurate traffic jam rate prediction, achieves fine management and prediction of urban traffic states, is beneficial to improving the efficiency and accuracy of urban traffic management, reduces traffic jam phenomena, optimizes urban traffic flow, and further improves the traveling experience and life quality of urban residents.

title: Noise-containing tag learning method based on meta learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, and discloses a noise-containing label learning method based on meta learning, which comprises a built student model network and a teacher model network, the picture data are respectively input into a student model network and a teacher model network, noise labels established according to the picture data in the student model network are updated and learned through an inner loop, the updated data are sent to the teacher model network, an attention mechanism is added to the teacher model network through an outer loop, and finally a result is output. The noise-containing tag learning method based on meta learning constructs internal and external loops of meta learning. In the internal circulation, consistency is used for enhancing consistency of error labeling and correct labeling prediction results, and in the external circulation, MAE is used for reconstructing a covered mask area, so that alternate updating of the internal and external circulation is realized, attention of features to a foreground area is improved, and classification precision on different noise proportions is improved.

title: Advertisement media intelligent pushing system and method based on user behavior information
description: The application provides an intelligent advertisement media pushing system and method based on user behavior information, relating to the field of intelligent advertisement pushing, which is characterized in that through carrying out text semantic extraction and image content extraction on user history browsing webpage information to know the attention characteristics of user browsing content, meanwhile, the image data of the advertisement to be recommended is subjected to feature extraction to know the content features of the advertisement to be recommended, then the fitness features between the advertisement to be recommended and the browsing attention of the user are established in a high-dimensional feature space, and finally whether the advertisement to be recommended needs to be pushed to the user is judged by passing the fitness features through a classifier. Therefore, accurate pushing of advertisements can be realized, the click rate and conversion rate of the advertisements are improved, and meanwhile, interference of users by irrelevant advertisements is reduced.

title: Neural network device, method and system comprising said device
description: A neural network device (1) is disclosed, comprising a physical memory (2), a data processor core (3), a configurable memory mapping unit (4), a configuration module (5) and a memory interface module (6). The physical memory (2) has a plurality (M) of independently accessible memory groups (2a, 2b, 2c, 2d), and the data processor core (3) is configured to execute instructions involving a plurality of memory access operations, the plurality of memory access operations specifying corresponding logical memory addresses in corresponding logical memories within the physical memory (2). The configurable memory mapping unit (4) is configured to map a logical memory address (A) to a physical address, the physical address comprising an indication of a memory group (B) in the plurality of memory groups and a row address (R) within the indicated memory group, and the configuration module (5) is configured to configure the configurable memory mapping unit (4) for a specific application, the configuration being maintained during runtime. The memory interface module (6) facilitates memory access operations for mutually different logical memories configured in the physical memory. As a result, no matter what application is executed by the neural network device (1), the physical memory (2) can be used flexibly and efficiently.

title: Image compression and reconstruction using machine learning models
description: A method includes: acquiring image data; identifying a machine learning compressible (ML compressible) portion of the image data; and determining a location of the ML compressible portion within the image data. The method also includes: selecting an ML compression model for the ML compressible portion from a plurality of ML compression models based on image content of the ML compressible portion; and generating an ML compressed representation of the ML compressible portion based on the ML compressible portion and by the ML compression model. The method also includes: generating a compressed image data file, the compressed image data file including the ML compressed representation and the location of the ML compressible portion; and outputting the compressed image data file. The compressed image data file is configured to cause an ML decompression model corresponding to the ML compression model to generate a reconstruction of the ML compressible portion of the image data based on the ML compressed representation.

title: Low-cost liquid pH value detecting system
description: The present invention discloses a low-cost liquid pH detection system. The system includes a sensor tag, a reference tag and a detection system; the detection system includes a signal transceiver subsystem for sending a continuous wave signal to activate the tag, and sending a query signal to establish communication with the tag, and collecting the reflected signal of the tag; a differential sensing subsystem for separating the reflected signal, removing the signal interference in the reflected signal, and performing signal differentiation on the reflected signal after eliminating the interference to obtain the differential amplitude and phase of the sensor tag and the reference tag; a liquid pH detection subsystem for extracting the features of the amplitude and phase from the differential amplitude and phase using a machine learning method, and determining the pH value of the liquid to be detected according to the mapping relationship between the liquid pH and the features of the amplitude and phase. The solution provided by the present invention is simple in composition, low in equipment cost, and easy to deploy on a large scale. In addition, the system has low difficulty in operation and high detection accuracy, and can achieve low-cost, fast and efficient liquid pH detection.

title: Power distribution network two-stage reactive voltage optimization method based on double time scales
description: The present invention provides a two-stage reactive voltage optimization method for a distribution network based on a dual time scale. The present invention adopts historical power generation data of photovoltaic power stations, fully considers the uncertainty of the day-ahead prediction of distributed photovoltaic power in the distribution network, and establishes a charging station electric vehicle cluster participating in the reactive power optimization dispatching model of the power grid based on the Monte Carlo algorithm. In addition, based on various flow constraints of the distribution network operation and constraints of capacitor groups and electric vehicle power, a two-stage optimization model for electric vehicles participating in the reactive power optimization of the distribution network is established. The switching plan of the reactive compensation capacitor group in the distribution network is formulated on a long time scale, and the output of electric vehicles connected to the power grid is formulated on a short time scale. A deep network is added to DQN and DDPG intelligent agents, samples in a dangerous state are trained, and the intelligent agents are restricted from exploring in the direction of the dangerous state, so as to solve the voltage over-limit problem caused by the grid connection of a large number of distributed power sources and electric vehicles.

title: Guide wire end detection method based on YOLOV4Tiny network
description: The invention provides a method for detecting the end of a guide wire based on a YOLOV4Tiny network, comprising: acquiring guide wire image data, and performing feature extraction on the guide wire image data, wherein the residual structure in the feature extraction network is divided into multiple groups , feature extraction is performed on the guide wire image data input with the residual structure through a plurality of filters, wherein one filter performs feature extraction on a set of guide wire image data with the residual structure, and the extracted features The guide wire image data of the next group of residual structure and the next group are input to the next filter together for feature extraction, until all the guide wire image data of each group of residual structure complete the feature extraction, and each group of residual structure The feature map extracted from the poorly structured guidewire image data is tensor connected and input to a 1×1 convolution filter to obtain the fused feature map. The invention improves the feature extraction ability, detection accuracy and robustness of the algorithm for the end of the guide wire.

title: Free document question-answer corpus labeling method
description: The invention discloses a free document question and answer corpus labeling method, comprising the following steps: S1. Create a free document question and answer corpus labeling task according to different labeling requirements; Type, answer and answer type are marked to obtain the result of the labeling task; S3. Export the result of the current labeling task as a required labeling corpus file. The present invention uses the labeling method of machine pre-labeling and manual modification and confirmation, and the labeling personnel only need to label or verify and modify the corpus that is not automatically marked in the model or the wrongly marked results. The revised results will continuously expand the domain corpus. As the amount of labeled data increases, the accuracy of machine pre-labeling continues to improve. Through machine pre-labeling, the labeling workload can be reduced by 80% to 90%, and the efficiency of data labeling can be significantly improved.

title: A model training method and device for multi-task knowledge fusion
description: This specification discloses a model training method and device for multi-task knowledge fusion. First, get the image data. Secondly, according to the number of feature blocks in the target recognition model to be trained, identity transformation is performed on each pre-trained recognition model to obtain each equivalent feature block recognition model. Then, for each feature block contained in the target recognition model, the feature block corresponding to the feature block is determined from each equivalent feature block recognition model as the target feature block, and the image features output by each target feature block are processed. splicing to obtain the spliced image feature corresponding to the feature block, and use the deviation between the image feature output by the feature block and the spliced image feature corresponding to the feature block as the deviation corresponding to the feature block. Finally, with the optimization goal of minimizing the deviation corresponding to each feature block, the object recognition model is trained. The method can enable the target recognition model to simultaneously solve the tasks of pre-trained recognition models.

title: Calibrating malanar qubits by detecting topology degeneracy
description: A method for using a topological quantum computing device is provided. The method may include setting a plurality of device parameters for a qubit architecture that includes a plurality of Majorana Zero Modes (MZMs). The method may also include calibrating the plurality of device parameters at least in part by determining whether the plurality of MZMs exhibit ground state degeneracy. Calibrating the plurality of device parameters may further include modifying one or more of the plurality of device parameters when the plurality of MZMs are determined to not exhibit ground state degeneracy. When the plurality of MZMs are determined to exhibit ground state degeneracy, the method may further include modifying one or more parameters of a measurement device coupled to the qubit architecture.

title: A method of migration learning based on filter fine-tuning and related devices
description: The present application discloses a filter fine-tuning based transfer learning method and related devices, which are used to improve the accuracy of a model transferred to a target task.
