The application method includes: obtaining a C-layer pre-training model and a target data set; decomposing the task of solving the target filter fine-tuning strategy into C subtasks according to the number of network layers of the pre-training model; The corresponding subtasks are solved until the corresponding subtasks of the last layer are solved, and the sub-fine-tuning strategies corresponding to different layers are obtained, and when solving the subtasks corresponding to the latter layer, the corresponding Solve the sub-fine-tuning strategy; determine the set of sub-fine-tuning strategies corresponding to all different layers as the target filter fine-tuning strategy; perform the first preset number of epoch training on the target data set for the pre-trained model according to the target filter fine-tuning strategy; determine The pre-trained model after training is the target task model.

title: Power battery residual life prediction method based on Monte Carlo and deep learning
description: The invention discloses a method for predicting the remaining life of a power battery based on Monte Carlo and deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of power batteries. This method uses EEMD technology and correlation analysis method to decompose the SOH time series into main trend time series and fluctuation time series, uses deep belief network to predict the main trend time series, and uses Monte Carlo technology to obtain the optimal interval threshold set Data preprocessing is performed on the fluctuation time series, and then resampling is performed by segmented cubic Hermitian interpolation, and then the long-short-term memory neural network is used to predict the sequence after resampling, and then the anti-resampling and Reverse data processing to obtain the final forecast value, and then integrate the main trend time series and fluctuation time series forecast results to obtain the final SOH forecast result, combined with the SOH value at the end of the battery life to obtain the forecast value of the remaining life, and realize the remaining life of the power battery high-precision predictions.

title: Structured information extraction method and electronic equipment
description: The application discloses a structured information extraction method and electronic equipment, and relates to the fields of natural language processing technology and machine learning. The electronic equipment acquires a section of unstructured text input by a user, inputs the unstructured text and the guiding information into a machine learning model, and outputs structured information with a preset coding structure. Since the output of the machine learning model is based on a unified coding structure, and the guide information is input at the prefix, the type of the output information is indicated; the dependence on real data in training the machine learning model is reduced, and the accuracy of the machine learning model in extracting the structural information can be remarkably improved under the condition that the real data are few.

title: Overload protection for edge clusters using a two-layer reinforcement learning model
description: An overload protection mechanism for network nodes in an edge node cluster uses a two-layer reinforcement learning model; one at the edge node level and one at the cluster level. The node-level reinforcement learning model optimizes the routing policy of the service/application to determine whether the edge node receiving the client request should handle the traffic of the service/application. The cluster-level reinforcement learning model optimizes the application's policy that determines which neighboring edge node should be considered to handle a client request for a given application, given the redirection or proxying by the edge node receiving the client request.

title: Wave impedance prediction method and device
description: The present application provides a method and equipment for predicting wave impedance, including acquiring seismic data of the geographical area to be predicted, inputting the seismic data of the geographical area to be predicted into a deep neural network model, and outputting multiple wave impedances. The deep neural network model includes The LSTM network, the LSTM network includes multiple LSTM layers, at least one LSTM layer is applied with a random dropout layer, and the confidence interval of the wave impedance is output by performing statistical analysis on multiple wave impedances. Compared with using the Bayesian deep neural network model, the solution provided by this application takes less time and has better robustness.

title: Power grid dispatching control method and system based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention relates to the technical field of power dispatching, in particular to an artificial intelligence-based power grid dispatching control method and system. First construct the power grid structure diagram, and obtain the initial graph structure according to the imbalance degree of different node areas. Firstly, calculate the degree of membership of each power consumption node and power supply node and different power consumption regions through the method of graph clustering, and then according to the clustering process According to the balance of the number of category centers and power supply nodes in different power consumption areas, the edge weights are adjusted, and then the power scheduling priority of each node area is obtained, and the power grid is dispatched according to the priority and edge weights. The invention can realize effective dispatching of grid power.

title: Power grid power flow adjustment method based on graph neural network
description: A power grid power flow adjustment method based on a graph neural network belongs to the technical field of power grid control. In order to solve the problems of manpower resource consumption and very low speed in the current mode of manually adjusting the power flow of the power grid. The invention utilizes a graph neural network model to conduct graph embedding processing on the power grid data of the power grid heterograph nodes; then, aiming at the non-converged power grid data after the graph embedding processing, carrying out power grid parameter adjustment based on a reinforcement learning mode; when the graph neural network model is subjected to graph embedding processing, the node sampling of the power grid is performed by restarting a random walk mode, different parameters of the same node are converted into characteristics with the same dimension, then the characteristics corresponding to the converted different parameters are aggregated in a non-sequential order, then the neighbor nodes of the same type are selected for aggregation aiming at the target node, and finally the neighbor nodes of different types and the target node parameters are aggregated with weight. The method is mainly used for adjusting the power flow of the power grid.

title: Machine learning-oriented aluminum alloy tensile strength characteristic expansion method
description: The invention provides a machine learning-oriented aluminum alloy tensile strength characteristic expansion method, which comprises the following steps of: collecting tensile strength data, and selecting a plurality of tensile strength data as characteristic values of machine learning prediction tensile strength; performing single-heat encoding treatment on the selected multiple tensile strength data; preprocessing a plurality of tensile strength data subjected to independent heat coding; establishing a machine learning model, training the established machine learning model by utilizing a data set, and predicting the tensile strength by adopting the trained machine learning model; analyzing the feature importance, and finding out the feature variable with the greatest influence on the establishment of the machine learning model; and performing feature expansion to obtain expansion features with greater importance. The invention can expand the characteristic value with the greatest influence degree from a plurality of tensile strength characteristic variables.

title: Computing device and method for image pixel processing network
description: The present invention provides a computing device and method for image pixel processing network, said device includes external storage, bus controller, address controller, input buffer, weight buffer, bias buffer, output buffer, q block calculation units, the present invention designs and proposes a novel hardware architecture, which can convert various convolutions into specific deformable convolutions for calculation to flexibly support multiple types of The convolutional layer also designs corresponding computing units and a new decoupling computing process, thus unifying various memory access modes and ensuring the consistency of input/output layout formats.

title: A non-invasive method, system, device and medium for detecting R-peak of fetal electrocardiogram
description: The invention discloses a noninvasive fetal electrocardio R peak detection method, system, equipment and medium, and relates to the technical field of physiological signal detection. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target electrocardiosignal; determining fetal electrocardio R peak information according to the target electrocardio signal and the fetal electrocardio R peak detection model; the fetal electrocardio R peak detection model is constructed according to a time sequence convolutional neural network and a residual multi-head attention module; the time sequence convolution neural network comprises a plurality of task processing units; the task processing unit comprises a main task processing unit and an auxiliary task processing unit; each task processing unit comprises a coding module, a channel characteristic enhancement module, a time sequence convolution module, a mask information interaction module, a mask extraction module and a decoding module which are connected in sequence; the time sequence convolution module comprises an expansion convolution layer and a residual error link layer which are sequentially connected. The invention can improve the accuracy of fetal R peak detection.

title: Operation equipment coding similarity association method based on factory object position
description: The invention discloses an operation equipment coding similarity association method based on a factory object position, which comprises the following steps: acquiring position number information of a factory object to be associated, wherein the position number information comprises a factory object position and a factory object name, and the factory object position is used for representing a specific process function position of the factory object in a factory; based on the operation equipment codes corresponding to the stock factory objects, matching the factory object positions corresponding to the factory objects to be associated to obtain a matching result, wherein the matching result is used for representing the operation equipment codes corresponding to the stock factory objects matched by the factory object positions; and correlating the operation equipment codes in the matching result with the bit number information of the factory object to be correlated to obtain a similarity correlation result. The operation equipment codes and the equipment positions of the stock equipment are used as training data to train the neural network model, so that the neural network model has the capacity of matching the corresponding operation equipment codes by adopting the equipment positions, and the working efficiency is effectively improved.

title: Design method of removable partial denture clasp three-dimensional model
description: The invention discloses a design method of a removable partial denture clasp three-dimensional model, which comprises the following steps of S1: discretizing an abutment triangular mesh curved surface model into voxel representation, and calculating a truncated symbol distance field in a voxel space by using a fast marching algorithm; s2: inputting the truncated symbol distance field of the abutment into a neural network to obtain a truncated symbol distance field of a removable partial denture clasp matched with the input abutment; s3: and converting the truncated symbol distance field of the removable partial denture clasp into a triangular mesh curved surface model by using a marching cube algorithm. The scheme effectively improves the design efficiency of the removable partial denture clasp, avoids the product quality gap caused by the experience and level difference of doctors, and can be used as the auxiliary design of the removable partial denture; meanwhile, the truncated symbol distance field is used as an intermediate representation, a convolution module and an attention mechanism module are used in a mixed mode, the capturing capacity of the network on the shape mapping relation is improved, and the requirement of an attention mechanism on the training set scale is reduced.

title: Sign language identification method and system based on lightweight GLnet network
description: The invention discloses a sign language identification method and a sign language identification system based on a lightweight GLnet network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: taking N multiplied by M sign language videos marked with sign language vocabulary as a training sample set; preprocessing sign language videos in a training sample set to obtain L-frame sign language continuous frame images corresponding to each sign language video; constructing a sign language recognition model based on a lightweight GLnet network, wherein the GLnet network is a CNN-LSTM network introducing an improved Ghost module; training a sign language recognition model by using a training sample set; preprocessing the sign language video to be recognized, inputting the preprocessed sign language video into a sign language recognition model after training, and outputting a recognition result. According to the invention, an improved Ghost module is introduced on the basis of a CNN-LSTM network, a lightweight GLnet network is constructed, the volume and the calculated amount of a network model are greatly reduced, and sign language identification with high identification rate is realized.

title: Distributed comprehensive sensing method and device
description: The present application discloses a distributed comprehensive sensing method and device. The method includes: determining the task boundary of the sensing target and the resource conditions required by the system according to the acquired environmental data and task requirements, optimizing the system deployment scheme by using the particle swarm optimization algorithm according to the task boundary and resource conditions, and determining the work of the sensing nodes Sequence: Use the sensing nodes to obtain the target information of all dimensions of the sensing target according to the working sequence and the optimized system deployment plan, and correlate and fuse the target information of all dimensions to obtain the target status information. By optimizing the deployment scheme and working sequence of the sensing node system, the sensing nodes can obtain the target information of the sensing target in all dimensions, and realize accurate global monitoring of the sensing target.

title: A method and device for predicting the operation and maintenance time of a photovoltaic power station
description: The invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic operation and maintenance, and solves the technical problem that the maintenance time point cannot be accurately predicted, and in particular relates to a method and device for predicting the operation and maintenance time of a photovoltaic power station, including: obtaining basic information of equipment to be repaired in a photovoltaic power station and The operating status data at the current moment; calculate the current health index of the equipment to be overhauled based on the operating status data; use a multi-level retrieval method to filter out historical sample data sets that are the same model as the equipment to be overhauled and have the most similar operating environment from the historical database; The historical sample data set, the basic information of the equipment to be overhauled and the current health index are predicted by a multi-hidden layer neural network, and the predicted probability of failure of the equipment to be overhauled within a preset time period in the future is obtained. In the present invention, the failure rate of the equipment to be repaired is cyclically estimated by using a prediction model based on a multi-hidden layer neural network as the basic structure according to various influencing factors, thereby improving the accuracy of the predicted value of the repair time point.

title: Medical image multi-target domain field self-adaption method based on prompt learning
description: The invention discloses a medical image multi-target domain self-adaption method based on prompt learning, which comprises the following steps: step 1, a segmentation backbone module utilizes a U-net segmentation model for generating a segmentation result from an input medical image; step 2, a prompt generation module generates a prompt of a corresponding domain by using the intermediate features of the domain classifier; and 3, the feature fusion module fuses the segmentation result and the prompt feature, and the countermeasure learning module further improves the model performance by using the countermeasure learning principle and using the fused feature as the feature. The invention utilizes the known input domain category to generate prompts to guide the model to carry out specific segmentation processing on different domains, thereby realizing a deep learning model with better segmentation performance.

title: Event prediction method and device and electronic equipment
description: The present invention provides an event prediction method, device, and electronic equipment. The method includes: in the evolution process of the current main population, evaluating the fitness of all individuals in the current main population, and using individuals whose fitness is less than a first threshold as individuals to be updated; receiving candidate individuals sent from a thread, and if the fitness of the candidate individuals is greater than the fitness of the individual to be updated, replacing the individual to be updated with the candidate individual to obtain an updated main population; copying the individual with the highest fitness in the updated main population to the current iterative main population, and using the copied current iterative main population as the current The main population returns to execute the evolution process of the current main population until the condition for the end of evolution is satisfied, and the individual with the highest fitness in the current main population is used as the prediction result of the prediction event. The invention can not only prevent the population from falling into a local optimum, improve the accuracy of the prediction result, but also accelerate the algorithm process, thereby being more suitable for multi-core computing and high-performance computing.

title: Lung cancer spine metastasis image processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a method, device, computer equipment, and storage medium for image processing of spine metastasis of lung cancer. The method comprises: obtaining an image of lung cancer spine metastasis; inputting the lung cancer spine metastasis image into a lung cancer spine metastasis image segmentation model based on unet as a network skeleton; wherein, the double pooling module of the lung cancer spine metastasis image segmentation model performs down-sampling processing, and the cross-attention module fuses encoding features and decoding features; the bottleneck layer of the lung cancer spine metastasis image segmentation model is a pyramid pooling module; obtaining the segmentation result of the target object in the lung cancer spine metastasis image output by the lung cancer spine metastasis image segmentation model. Using this method, the target object can be more accurately segmented in the image of lung cancer spine metastasis with complex lesion shape, more noise and other tissues around the lesion area.

title: Smart power grid anomaly detection and classification method, smart power grid anomaly detection and classification equipment and readable storage medium
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid anomaly detection, and specifically relates to a smart grid anomaly detection and classification method device and a readable storage medium; step 1, obtaining a suitable training data set, step 2, constructing an anomaly detection and classification system (ADCS), the anomaly detection and classification system includes a self-encoding and generation confrontation network architecture, which is divided into architectures in two cases of anomaly detection and anomaly classification; step 3, training the anomaly detection and classification system network, preprocessing training data, and using sliding windows to format data; The abnormality detection and classification system network after the training of the data is encoded and decoded to obtain the results of abnormality detection and abnormality classification; the invention solves the technical problems that the intrusion detection speed of the smart grid system is not fast enough and the precision is not high enough in the prior art.

title: Design method of non-circular gear set for single-row two-stage transmission with given input angle and output angle
description: The invention discloses a design method for a single-row two-stage transmission non-circular gear set with a given input angle and output angle. Firstly, a single-row two-stage transmission non-circular gear set model composed of a frame, an input wheel, an intermediate wheel and an output wheel is constructed. , and then according to the characteristics that the phase difference between the rotation angle relationship between the intermediate wheel and the input wheel and the rotation angle relationship between the intermediate wheel and the output wheel is an angle λ, using λ and the corresponding angle that the output wheel turns when the input wheel turns through the specified angle as the calculation variables, a unit is established The solution model of the non-circular gear set with two-stage transmission uses the optimization algorithm to complete the solution of each variable, and then completes the pitch curve solution of the input wheel and the intermediate wheel, and obtains the tooth profiles of the three non-circular gears, and finally obtains the single-row two-stage Drive non-circular gear sets to minimize the structural weight, reduce the axial size of the gear set, reduce unbalanced centrifugal force, and reduce vibration.

title: Digital Tobacco Field Smart Agriculture System
description: The invention discloses a digital tobacco field intelligent agriculture system, which includes a flue-cured tobacco planting information module, a meteorological big data module and a production suggestion module, wherein the flue-cured tobacco planting information module is used to collect flue-cured tobacco plots, the number of flue-cured tobacco plants, household head information, and barn information At the same time, soil fertility data of each flue-cured tobacco plot is collected according to the grid, and superimposed on the gridded digital base map of the flue-cured tobacco planting layout; the meteorological big data module includes the tobacco weather sub-module, real-time Tobacco meteorological early warning submodule and tobacco weather forecast submodule, the tobacco weather live submodule is used to display the tobacco weather live data of each grid point on the gridded digital base map; the production suggestion module includes disaster response submodule, Production technology program sub-module, agricultural reminder sub-module and tobacco production forecast sub-module. The invention can realize accurate matching of meteorological and soil data to plots in the tobacco planting process, and facilitates the realization and management of various functions in production.

title: Distributed small-sample image classification system based on mutual information of multi-attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses a distributed small sample image classification system based on multi-attention mechanism mutual information. Simply extract image features through convolutional neural network or residual network, and then use multi-type attention mechanism to further train the features to extract more representative features, use the features to get the loss of the network, and then use the mutual learning module to combine these different The excellent features are combined. In the training phase, the present invention considers the training efficiency of small-sample learning, combines small-sample learning with distributed learning for the first time, and uses distributed learning based on the All-Reduce algorithm for parallel training, which can significantly improve the training of small-sample learning. efficiency. The invention is a plug-and-play method suitable for distributed small-sample image classification systems.

title: A Recipe Recommendation System That Improves Convenience
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent terminal equipment, in particular to a recipe recommendation system capable of improving convenience, including an information collection module, a material statistics module, a database module, a model building module, a model training module and a recipe recommendation module. The present invention better realizes the recipe recommendation through the big data Wide&Deep algorithm, and can process a large amount of data in a short time, so as to design according to the physical conditions of different users and their different preferences and tastes, and realize that different users can use the system according to the current situation. Combining some ingredients quickly and recommending different recipes can effectively improve the convenience of the recipe recommendation system, and at the same time make the recommended recipes suitable for the user to maintain a balanced diet. At the same time, the recipe recommendation system can promote multiple modal information of food The associated interaction of the system can learn better food features and further improve the user's recipe recommendation effect.

title: Positioning method, device, equipment and medium for strip tail of steel coil
description: The embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method, device, ground equipment, computer equipment and readable storage medium for locating a tail of a steel coil, and relate to the technical field of computers. The method includes: acquiring a detection image of the steel coil; identifying the tape tail in the detection image of the steel coil; when recognizing the tape tail in the detection image of the steel coil, combining the The angular velocity of the coil is stored as the first data; continue to acquire and identify the tape tail in the subsequent detection image of the steel coil, and store the coordinates of the tape tail corresponding to the subsequent detection image of the steel coil and the angular velocity of the steel coil as the second data; according to The second data verifies the accuracy of the first data; when the first data is verified to be correct according to the second data, the position of the tape tail when the steel coil is at rest is acquired through the first data or the second data. The method provided by the embodiments of the present disclosure improves the accuracy of strip tail identification of steel coils.

title: Mask wearing detection method and device based on improved YOLOv7 model
description: The present invention provides a mask wearing detection method and device based on the improved YOLOv7 model. In order to increase the receptive field of the model and improve the detection accuracy of the algorithm, the present invention introduces RFB (Receptive Field Block, receptive field module) into the backbone network; secondly, In order to make the feature information on the result feature matrix easier to highlight, a CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) is introduced into the Head part of the model; finally, in order to improve the generalization ability and transmission performance of the model, the The original LeakyReLU activation function of YOLOv7 is replaced by the MetaAconC activation function. The experimental results show that the improved YOLOv7 model improves the detection accuracy by 3.6% compared with the original algorithm in mask wearing detection, reaching 93.9%, the average precision increases by 5.3%, and the recall rate increases by 3%.

title: Code testing method, device and equipment based on reinforcement learning
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a code testing method, device and equipment based on reinforcement learning, which are applied in the technical field of network security. The method includes obtaining each keyword in the code to be tested and its corresponding code line number, number, function name, nesting depth and path; each keyword and its corresponding code line number, number, function name, nesting Depth and path, input to the pre-trained code test model, output the test result of the code under test, the test result includes the code segment that may be wrong in the code under test, and the error type corresponding to the code segment , function name, and code line number. In this way, the code testing model can adapt to dynamically changing data and complex logical relationships based on the pre-trained code testing model during the code testing process, thereby improving the efficiency and accuracy of the code testing.

title: Method and device for determining optimal placement position of respiratory heart rate detection device
description: The invention discloses a method and device for determining the optimal placement position of a breathing heart rate detection device. The breathing heart rate signal and interference signal of the human body are received by a millimeter wave device, combined with a deep reinforcement learning network, and the detection device is ensured by the DQN algorithm. With a high accuracy rate, the influence of interference is reduced, and the best detection position suitable for the detection device can be found quickly, so as to achieve more accurate detection of breathing and heart rate. Combining the present invention with a non-contact physiological signal sensing system, the accuracy of the system can be guaranteed more stably, and health information such as the user's heart rate and respiration can be detected in real time.

title: Hidden information processing system and hidden information processing method
description: The homomorphic reasoning device (500) divides the model ciphertext into reasoning ciphertext and calculation ciphertext, does not decrypt the calculation ciphertext and data ciphertext, and generates prior result ciphertext through the homomorphic operation algorithm, without decrypting Using the prior result ciphertext and the inference ciphertext, generate an inference result ciphertext through a homomorphic operation algorithm. A partial decryption device (600) performs partial decryption of the inference result ciphertext using a model secret key to generate a partial decryption result. The final decryption device (700) decrypts the inference result from the partial decryption result using the secret key for data.

title: Wood classification system based on image recognition
description: The invention discloses a wood classification system based on image recognition, which comprises: the system comprises a first image acquisition module, an image processing module, a first classification module and a second classification module; the first image acquisition module is used for acquiring images of wood through the industrial camera to obtain a first image; transmitting the first image to an image processing module, processing the first image through the image processing module to obtain a processed first image, and performing abnormality judgment and classification on the processed first image by a first classification module to classify a defective first image and a non-defective first image; the second classification module classifies the defective first images according to the defect types to obtain the defect type of each defective first image. Not only can the defect of the wood be determined, but also the defect type can be classified according to the defect type, the defect type classification is not needed to be manually performed, the defect type can be automatically identified, and the defect classification accuracy is improved.

title: Vehicle-mounted network intrusion detection method based on stacking integration algorithm
description: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted network intrusion detection method based on a stacking integration algorithm. The steps include collecting network data sets of the vehicle external network; performing data preprocessing on the collected network data of the vehicle external network; and performing data preprocessing on the vehicle external network network after data preprocessing Perform feature engineering on the data; conduct model training through three tree-based integrated algorithms; detect the network data of the external vehicle network for normal and abnormal classification, and process the output of the results. The invention can process large-scale data sets, and has fast training and prediction speed, and can meet the requirement of real-time intrusion detection.

title: Multi-target mucus optimizing method based on reference point non-dominant sorting
description: The invention discloses a multi-objective slime optimization method based on non-dominated sorting of reference points, which introduces a chaos mechanism to improve the traversal search ability of SMA (slime mold algorithm) in decision space, thereby covering more search spaces in a short time; As the number of targets increases, the number of non-dominated solutions increases rapidly, and the non-dominated sorting method based on reference points is used to maintain the diversity of solutions; using the above technical scheme, the simulation results show that the multi-objective slime algorithm achieves the best Convergence, accuracy and diversity of good grade solutions.

title: Autonomous decision-making method for data-driven forging process
description: The invention discloses a data-driven forging process autonomous decision method, which comprises the following steps: (1) Acquiring process data and forging quality inspection data in the forging production process, and establishing a forging process database; (2) Excavating a frequent item set from a forging process database, and abstracting nodes, node attributes and ternary relations; (3) Constructing a forging process knowledge graph based on the node relation, and complementing the forging process knowledge graph through knowledge reasoning; (4) And constructing and training a reinforcement learning decision network in the forging process based on the knowledge graph in the forging process. The method provided by the invention can directly excavate the association relation between the forging process and the forging performance from the forging process data and establish the forging process knowledge graph, and can obtain the reinforcement learning decision network of action strategies at different stages of the forging process, thereby realizing the accurate autonomous decision of the forging process and remarkably improving the intelligent level of the forging process.

title: Image instance segmentation method, system, device and storage medium
description: This application discloses a method and system for image instance segmentation. In the segmentation network training phase, the network loss is obtained according to category labeling, Fourier series labeling, category confidence, Fourier series and loss functions, and the network loss is obtained through network loss Iteratively train the network until the network converges to obtain the trained instance segmentation network. In the inference stage, input the image to be segmented into the trained instance segmentation network. Through the trained instance segmentation network, first obtain the target category confidence and the Fu of the target contour. The Fourier series representation, and then inverse Fourier transform is performed on the Fourier series representation, the target contour is reconstructed in the image space domain, and the target category and target contour are output, and the target contour is processed by this Fourier series Modeling, which greatly reduces the memory consumption in the segmentation network training, enables the segmentation network to efficiently process images containing a large number of objects, and effectively improves the segmentation accuracy.

title: Analysis device, analysis system, analysis program, and analysis method
description: To provide an analysis device capable of improving detection accuracy and versatility while suppressing the amount of training data in identifying the cause of a defect in a product using machine learning and the like. An analysis device comprising: an acquisition unit for acquiring input data; a determination unit for inputting the input data into a machine learning model previously learned using training data to determine any one of predetermined recognition categories; a database for storing the recognition categories and the predetermined a correspondence relation of the information; an analyzing unit analyzing the correspondence relation between the recognition category and predetermined information using the database; and an output unit outputting the analysis result.

title: Entity discovery method based on text mining
description: The invention relates to a method for discovering entities based on text mining, which includes: selecting a text subset; extracting entities, and comparing the extracted results with real labels; randomly sampling out the required Manually label candidate data; manually mark candidate data; use the labeled data to train the entity extraction model, and return to the entity extraction step for selection training and labeling. The beneficial effects of the present invention are: in the process of entity discovery, the present invention can effectively select unlabeled corpus samples that need to be labeled to increase the labeled data, and at the same time use the existing labeled data to continuously iteratively train and label entities Extract the model to achieve the purpose of improving the accuracy of the model; furthermore, the present invention can improve the accuracy of the entity extraction model, reduce the quantity and time cost of manual labeling data, and improve the automation degree of entity extraction.

title: A method for adaptive reconstruction and property detection of abnormal near-infrared spectra
description: The present invention proposes a method for adaptive reconstruction and property detection of abnormal near-infrared spectra. Aiming at the problem of spectral anomalies and missing abnormal spectral property detection data in the online detection process of refining and chemical enterprises, the present invention adopts a method based on fast Fourier Anomaly spectral reconstruction and property detection scheme for leaf transform and particle swarm optimization algorithms. This method adaptively reconstructs the spectrum based on the degree of abnormality, eliminates main noise interference while retaining the characteristic information of the spectrum to the greatest extent, and uses the reconstructed spectrum for online property detection, providing real-time data for subsequent production process monitoring and optimization, ensuring refining and chemical processing Enterprise production runs safely and smoothly.

title: Virtual object configuration method, electronic device and computer-readable storage medium
description: This application provides a virtual object configuration method, an electronic device, and a computer-readable storage medium for configuring virtual objects using chat robot interaction functions. The method includes: using a first terminal device to display a virtual object configuration interface, and the virtual object configuration The interface is used to provide a chat robot interactive function; during the interaction process between the configuration personnel and the chat robot, the first terminal device is used to receive one or more input information from the configuration personnel; according to the received input information, obtain Initial configuration information of the virtual object; configure the virtual object according to the initial configuration information. The virtual object configuration interface provides a chat robot interaction function. During the interaction with the configurer, the initial configuration information of the virtual object is obtained and configured accordingly based on the input information of the configurer.

title: A method, medium, electronic equipment and products for estimating speaker voice coil temperature
description: This application relates to the field of terminal technology and discloses a speaker voice coil temperature estimation method, medium, electronic equipment and products, which can improve the accuracy of the speaker temperature rise model. The method includes: establishing a temperature rise model of the speaker. The temperature rise model is a mapping relationship between the input power of the speaker and the voice coil temperature of the speaker. The temperature rise model includes thermal parameters of the speaker, and the thermal parameters are determined using a stochastic optimization algorithm. Obtained, the objective function applied in the process of determining the thermal parameters of the stochastic optimization algorithm is used to indicate the difference between the estimated voice coil temperature obtained by the temperature rise model and the actual voice coil temperature; input the first input power of the speaker into the temperature rise model, and obtain The voice coil temperature corresponding to the first input power.

title: Mitochondrial segmentation and classification method based on deep learning
description: The present invention provides a mitochondrial segmentation and classification method based on deep learning, which solves the problems of low robustness and accuracy of existing technical methods and models for mitochondrial morphology analysis and processing, and the inability to conduct qualitative and quantitative analysis. The "segmentation-classification" idea that combines image segmentation and image classification achieves qualitative and quantitative analysis of mitochondrial super-resolution images. Among them, the image segmentation part reflects the quantification. Deep learning can quantify the morphological outline of mitochondria in each image, and Quantify fluorescence intensity of pseudocolor images of mitochondria. The image classification part embodies qualitative and quantitative aspects. Deep learning can classify different shapes of mitochondria to determine their characteristics (round or filamentous), and count the proportion of round mitochondria to quantify the overall degree of mitochondrial disease in the current cell.

title: File backup methods, devices, storage media and electronic equipment
description: This application discloses a file backup method, device, storage medium and electronic equipment, involving the field of financial technology and other related technical fields. The method includes: generating a backup task, wherein the backup task is used to back up N target files in different directories in the database, the backup task includes at least S target file characteristics corresponding to the N target files, and the S target file characteristics are passed through the target The regular expression indicates that both S and N are positive integers. The backup task is executed at the target time. N target files are determined from the Q files in the database according to the target regular expression, and the N target files are backed up. Among them, Q It is a positive integer greater than or equal to N. Q files are stored in different directories in the database. The technical solution of this application solves the technical problem of low storage resource utilization in the Veritas_NBU backup environment.

title: Network path optimizing method and system
description: The invention discloses a network path optimization method and system. The method includes: adjusting the adaptive weight of the heuristic function in the underlying model LPA* algorithm to make the effect of the heuristic function intelligently change with iterations; at the same time, introducing a bias p in the K value calculation to improve the search efficiency of the algorithm. Combined with the initial path calculated by the underlying model, the initial pheromone of the ant colony algorithm is distributed unbalancedly. The upper-layer model applies the ACO algorithm to plan the optical fiber network path on the grid map to obtain the globally optimal network path. Through the design of the hierarchical algorithm, the present invention provides the ant colony algorithm with prior information including pre-selected paths, enhances the traditional ant colony algorithm's ability to guide the pre-selected areas in path planning, and can search for feasible paths more quickly. It effectively solves the problems such as the slow search speed of the traditional ACO algorithm and the tendency to fall into the local optimal solution, and greatly improves the overall performance of the optical fiber network planning system.

title: Block chain carbon emission transaction anomaly detection method and device based on graph representation learning
description: This application provides a blockchain carbon emissions trading anomaly detection method and device based on graph representation learning. The method includes: summarizing the current adjacency matrix of the blockchain network used for carbon emissions trading and representing each block in the blockchain network. The attribute matrix of node attributes is input to the graph representation learning model based on autoencoder and attention mechanism to output the reconstructed adjacency matrix and reconstructed attribute matrix; the area is determined by applying the adjacency matrix, reconstructed adjacency matrix, attribute matrix and reconstructed attribute matrix. The anomaly detection score of each node in the blockchain network; determine the abnormal nodes in the blockchain network that have abnormal risks of carbon emissions trading based on the anomaly detection score. This application can effectively improve the accuracy and effectiveness of abnormal detection of carbon emissions transactions in the blockchain, effectively filter the influence of abnormal nodes and improve the ability to obtain the normal characteristics of nodes, and thus effectively ensure the security of carbon emissions transactions in the blockchain. and reliability.

title: Processing communication signals using a machine learning network
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for processing communication signals using a machine learning network are disclosed. In some embodiments, pilot and data information is generated for a data signal. The data signal is generated using a modulator of an Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) system. The data signal is transmitted over a communication channel to obtain modified pilot and data information. The modified pilot and data information are processed using a machine learning network. A prediction corresponding to the data signal transmitted over the communication channel is obtained from the machine learning network. The predictions are compared to a set of real data and updates are applied to the machine learning network based on corresponding error terms.

title: Atlas embedding system and apparatus
description: An embedded method and apparatus for generating a map is provided. The graph includes a plurality of nodes, and each node includes a connection to another one or more of the plurality of nodes. The method comprises and/or the apparatus is configured to: receiving data representing at least a portion of the map; converting the nodes of the graph to a non-euclidean geometry; iteratively updating an embedding model based on the transformed nodes in the non-euclidean geometry based on a causal loss function and a link prediction function associated with the non-euclidean geometry.

title: An operation and maintenance data distribution method, device, equipment and medium based on the Internet of Things
description: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for distributing operation and maintenance data based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of operation and maintenance management, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining first information, second information and third information; clustering is carried out according to the first information to obtain classified data; constructing a deep reinforcement learning mathematical model according to the second information, and analyzing a permission distribution strategy to obtain a distribution result; carrying out mining processing of association rules and data features according to the third information to obtain a data interaction strategy; constructing and obtaining a device prediction model according to the third information, and taking the classified data as an input value of the device prediction model to obtain a prediction result; and carrying out fusion processing on the classification data, the distribution result, the data interaction strategy and the prediction result based on a preset deep learning mathematical model to obtain an intelligent distribution rule. According to the invention, by adopting an intelligent data distribution rule, data can be rapidly and accurately distributed to corresponding management level nodes, so that efficient transmission and distribution of the data are realized.

title: Human-machine out-of-synchrony detection method, device and medium based on improved attention mechanism
description: The invention provides a human-machine asynchrony detection method, device and medium based on an improved attention mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of ventilator human-machine asynchrony detection. Data collection, slice the collected data, and then draw the data slices into images to generate model samples; preprocess the model samples through data set cleaning and image annotation; establish and improve the attention mechanism of yolov5s human-machine through training set training The asynchrony identification network model collects real-time detected patient ventilator data and inputs it into the trained yolov5s human-machine asynchrony identification network model with improved attention mechanism to obtain whether the patient has human-machine asynchrony; determine this based on the confidence level Check whether the label box is out of sync between human and machine and handle it. The present invention is more efficient and accurate in expressing human-machine asynchronous expressions, and the extracted abstract features are more robust and have better generalization capabilities.

title: Picture identification method, device, equipment and medium
description: The application discloses a picture identification method, a picture identification device, picture identification equipment and a picture identification medium, relates to the technical field of big data, and particularly relates to the technical field of image content auditing. The method comprises the following steps: performing face recognition on a target picture, and performing sensitive character detection on the target picture according to a face recognition result; performing multi-mode detection on the target picture, wherein the multi-mode detection comprises at least one of sensitive text detection, image-text fusion detection and sensitive image detection; and determining whether the target picture is a sensitive picture according to the detection result of the sensitive person and the multi-mode detection result, and judging whether the picture is sensitive according to the multi-mode identification result, so that the identification accuracy of the sensitive picture is greatly improved.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for constructing fatigue detection model of driver
description: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for constructing a fatigue detection model of a driver, wherein facial image data of the driver in different fatigue states are collected as a data set; extracting the characteristic information of the driver from the data set by adopting a pre-built characteristic extraction model; inputting the acquired characteristic information into a generated countermeasure network comprising a generator and a discriminator for training, and adjusting the strength of the countermeasure sample generated by the generator according to the change trend of the accuracy of the sample generated by the generator and identified by the discriminator; the training generation countermeasure network is used as a fatigue detection model. A fatigue detection model with high training efficiency and excellent performance is constructed.

title: Male scrotum temperature and humidity monitoring and early warning device and method
description: The invention provides a male scrotum temperature and humidity monitoring and early warning device and method, comprising the following steps: the underpants comprise an underpants body, a main control module, a waterproof flexible inner patch and a movable end; the main control module is positioned at the outer side of the underpants body, and the waterproof flexible inner patch is arranged at the front part of the scrotum at the inner side of the underpants body; the main control module is electrically connected with the waterproof flexible inner paste, and the mobile terminal is in communication connection with the main control module; the main control module comprises: the system comprises a main control chip, a temperature sensor, a humidity sensor, a vibration sensor, a first power management module and a Bluetooth module; the main control chip is electrically connected with the temperature sensor, the humidity sensor, the vibration sensor, the power management module and the Bluetooth module, and the Bluetooth module is in communication connection with the mobile terminal. According to the waterproof flexible inner patch with the sensors, the waterproof flexible inner patches with the sensors are arranged on the inner side and the outer side of the underpants, so that the waterproof flexible inner patch is convenient to wear, and the temperature and humidity of scrotum positions can be detected and analyzed in real time.

title: Modeling method and system for positioning epilepsy induction focus based on intracranial electrical stimulation
description: This application discloses a modeling method and system for locating epileptogenic lesions based on intracranial electrical stimulation. The method steps include: obtaining the CCEP data of the patient's interictal stereotactic electroencephalogram. The CCEP data is cortical-intercortical induced Potential data; preprocess CCEP data to obtain processed data; extract brain network features based on the processed data; perform statistical difference analysis on brain network features to obtain differential features; use machine learning models to train differential features and construct Prediction model; use the prediction model to visualize the patient's epileptogenic zone. This application discloses an active interventional method to delineate the epileptogenic area through intracranial electrical stimulation, which reduces the patient's morbidity and risk in preoperative evaluation by reducing the diagnostic dependence on ictal records, and shortens the invasive surgical procedure. Pre-evaluation period can reduce the pain of long-term intracranial EEG implantation for patients.

title: Gas turbine condition monitoring method, system, device and medium based on identification network
description: This application relates to a gas turbine status monitoring method, system, device and medium based on identification network, wherein the method includes: the method is implemented through a pre-built monitoring model, the monitoring model includes: a first residual network module, a second residual Network module and output module; both the first residual network module and the second residual network module include an LSTM layer, and the first characteristic data is obtained through the first residual network module according to the gas turbine data; according to the first characteristic data, the second residual network module is used to obtain the first characteristic data. The difference network module obtains the second characteristic data; obtains the output data through the output module based on the second characteristic data, and uses the output data as the status detection result of the gas turbine. The efficiency and accuracy of condition monitoring of gas turbines are improved, and it is suitable for condition monitoring of gas turbines of different models and specifications.

title: A penetration testing system
description: The invention provides a penetration testing system, which relates to the technical field of system security. The penetration testing system includes a code structure module, a code semantic module, a penetration model group and an output module; the code structure module is used to obtain the source code of the network system to be tested. , and generate the grammatical structure of the source code; the code semantic module is used to generate the semantic features of the grammatical structure; the penetration model group is used to analyze the timing features, spatial features and topological structure features of the semantic features, And generate vulnerability penetration data according to the timing characteristics, the spatial characteristics and the topological structure characteristics; the output module is used to determine the location of the vulnerability code based on the syntax structure and the vulnerability penetration data, and generate a penetration test result. The semantic features of the grammatical structure are obtained through the code structure module and the code semantic module, and then the vulnerability penetration data is obtained from the penetration model group. Finally, the output module outputs more comprehensive penetration test results.

title: Password management method and system for Internet of things
description: A password management method and system for the Internet of things are disclosed. Firstly acquiring to-be-detected password data input by a user, and a history password database used by the user, respectively carrying out semantic coding on each history password data in the history password database to obtain a plurality of history password semantic coding feature vectors, carrying out semantic association analysis on the plurality of history password semantic coding feature vectors to obtain history password semantic association topological features, carrying out semantic coding on to-be-detected password data input by the user to obtain input password semantic understanding features, mapping the input password semantic understanding features into a high-dimensional space of the history password semantic association topological features to obtain password semantic association features, and finally determining whether the semantic repeatability of the to-be-detected password data exceeds a preset threshold value and generating an early warning prompt based on the password semantic association features. In this way, password security may be improved.

title: Hydrological model parameter calibration method based on space discrete shuffling complex evolutionary algorithm
description: The invention provides a hydrological model parameter calibration method based on a space discrete shuffling complex evolution algorithm, which comprises the following steps of data collection: randomly generating values in a reasonable range of each dimension of the parameter group to form a parameter group sample point, and repeating the steps to generate a total sample D The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the Leading the sample points into a hydrological model to calculate an objective function evaluation value of each sample point; calculating a parameter range normalization Euclidean distance value of hyperspace of each sample point and sequencing the total samples; performing complex division according to the total sample points after the distance sorting; the sample points in each complex are sorted by the ascending order of the objective function evaluation value again, the simplex is extracted in the complex, and the downhill simplex is adoptedRepeating the cyclic competition evolution; filling each complex shape back to the total sample to form a new total sample, and completing the generation evolution of the shuffling complex shape evolution algorithm; repeating the steps until meeting the convergence standard; and outputting the optimal parameter set of the hydrologic model.

title: Method and device for determining three-dimensional space information of target object
description: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for determining three-dimensional space information of a target object, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image obtained by shooting a target area through camera equipment, wherein the target image comprises a target object; determining a depth image of the target image by using the determined depth information of each pixel in the target image; determining a point cloud image of the depth image using the point cloud data of each pixel, wherein the point cloud data of each pixel is determined based on the depth information of each pixel, the color information of each pixel, and the parameter information of the image capturing apparatus; three-dimensional space information of the target object is determined in the point cloud image. The method and the device solve the problem of low determination efficiency of the three-dimensional space information of the target object in the related technology, and achieve the effect of improving the determination efficiency of the three-dimensional space information of the target object.

title: Construction current situation rule judging system based on AI image recognition
description: The invention discloses a construction current situation rule judging system based on AI image recognition, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. Comprising the following steps: picture acquisition unit: the unmanned aerial vehicle flies according to the set route and shoots target information, and the acquired pictures are stored through a storage module in a picture acquisition unit; picture identification unit: reading, analyzing and judging the acquired picture through an AI module in a picture identification unit; a pollutant monitoring unit: when the unmanned aerial vehicle flies according to the set route, PM2.5 in the air is detected through an air quality detector carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle is used for carrying the camera to identify the personnel on the construction site, the AI module is used for identifying the personnel images, judging whether the personnel in the images are not wearing the safety helmet or not and alarming other human body images which are not identified in the image storage module, preventing non-staff from entering the construction site without permission, and achieving the purpose of remotely surveying the construction site.

title: A network security dynamic early warning system based on deep learning
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of network security protection. The technical problem to be solved by the present invention is that existing network defense means cannot adapt to changing attack methods and cannot achieve better network protection. The technical solution disclosed by the present invention is a network security dynamic early warning system based on deep learning, which uses a feature extraction module to preprocess the collected data, extract features related to security threats, and associate the extracted features to obtain an association mathematical model, and then use deep learning algorithms to train the correlation mathematical model, learn and pattern recognize the correlated features, and then obtain a mathematical model based on network security status and correlation status. The beneficial effects of the present invention are that it can monitor and analyze the network environment in real time, automatically identify potential security threats and issue early warnings. Through the application of deep learning technology, it improves the ability to detect and identify emerging network attack means and reduces network security risks.

title: High-quality green road path planning method, device and equipment based on double-image fusion
description: The invention discloses a high-quality green road path planning method, device and equipment based on double-image fusion, which belong to the technical field of geographic information, and comprise the following steps: acquiring OSM road network data, performing road screening and simplifying processing, extracting a road center line and generating street view sampling points; collecting street view image data based on street view sampling points, performing image segmentation processing, and calculating the green vision rate and sky width; DEM data are collected, and road network data are combined to calculate the average gradient of a road; the green vision rate, the road average gradient and the sky opening are weighted and calculated to obtain the path cost; acquiring POI data, giving a starting point and an end point of a planning path, and determining a high-quality green path with the lowest total path cost based on the path cost; and visually displaying the high-quality green road diameter. The invention effectively fuses the street view image and the remote sensing image to plan the high-quality green road path, and provides decision support for the fields of city planning, city greening, traffic planning and the like.

title: Method and device for evaluating large code model
description: The embodiment of the specification provides a method and a device for evaluating a code large model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining prompt information according to the test problem for code generation, inputting the prompt information into a code large model to obtain output information of the code large model, and extracting a code text from the output information; separating the execution code and the code annotation from the code text; compiling an execution code, and determining the compiling passing rate according to whether compiling is passed or not; if the compiling is passed, executing a corresponding test case aiming at the execution code, and determining the overall passing rate according to whether the test case is passed or not; determining semantic similarity according to the code annotation and the reference annotation corresponding to the code annotation; and determining the comprehensive score according to the compiling passing rate, the overall passing rate and the semantic similarity.

title: Vehicle-mounted directed acyclic graph task scheduling method and system
description: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted directed acyclic graph task scheduling method and a vehicle-mounted directed acyclic graph task scheduling system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a vehicle-mounted task directed acyclic graph model, and acquiring topology structure information corresponding to each subtask; bidirectional aggregation is carried out on topology structure information corresponding to the current subtask by utilizing the graph neural network so as to obtain high-dimensional characteristic representation corresponding to the current subtask; constructing a vehicle communication network, and acquiring a scheduling strategy of a historical subtask, computing power and real-time position information of all vehicles of the tasks to be executed so as to obtain a manual characteristic representation of the vehicle communication network; the high-dimensional feature representation corresponding to the current subtask and the manual feature are input into a deep reinforcement learning network after being spliced to obtain a scheduling strategy of the current subtask, so that the current subtask is scheduled and distributed according to the scheduling strategy; therefore, the generalization capability of the traditional deep reinforcement learning algorithm to the vehicle-mounted task of the new directed acyclic graph can be improved by utilizing the graph neural network, and the vehicle-mounted task can be scheduled in real time.

title: Combined simulation optimization method and system for microwave negative group delay circuit resonance structure
description: The invention provides a joint simulation optimization method and a system for a microwave negative group delay circuit resonance structure, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, meshing the area where the resonator is located into units with the same size; s2, initializing a state set and an action set of the resonance structure; s3, initializing defined network model parameters; s4, acquiring a next adjustment action from the old strategy network, and storing the current state and the like obtained after the interaction with the environment into an experience playback pool; s5, repeating the step S4 until the maximum iteration times are reached; s6, carrying out collaborative simulation on the abstract representation of the final resonant structure to obtain simulation data; s7, acquiring required negative group delay and transmission coefficients, and calculating a reward value; s8, calculating an advantage function through a current state set stored in the experience playback pool and the like; s9, calculating a loss function of the new strategy network and the new value network; s10, copying the updated parameters of the new strategy network to the old strategy network; s11, repeating the steps S4-S10 until the network converges, and obtaining the optimized resonance structure.

title: SAR image wetland classification method based on feature optimization
description: The invention discloses a feature optimization-based SAR image wetland classification method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a polarization scattering matrix of the SAR image, a Pauli transformation vector and a coherence matrix or a covariance matrix; extracting homopolar phase difference characteristics of the wetland object under a single time phase by using a polarization scattering matrix; extracting full polarization coherence optimization improvement characteristics of wetland objects under different time phases by using Pauli transformation vectors; performing polarization decomposition on the coherence matrix or the covariance matrix to obtain polarization decomposition characteristics of the wetland object; constructing an initial feature set of the wetland object by utilizing the features; optimizing the initial feature set by using a CNN model to obtain a preferred feature set; and classifying the preferred feature set by using a deep random forest method to obtain a ground object classification result. The method solves the problem of insufficient expression capacity of the characteristics of the wetland by combining the full-polarization SAR image with the deep learning technology, and improves the classification precision of the wetland objects.

title: Data processing methods, devices, storage media and electronic equipment
description: The invention discloses a data processing method, device, storage medium and electronic equipment. Involving the fields of artificial intelligence technology, financial technology or other related technical fields. Among them, the method includes: obtaining the first indicator data of the object to be evaluated; based on the indicator set, performing data screening on the first indicator data to obtain N second indicator data, wherein the indicator set includes the first indicator data determined through the principal component analysis strategy. Indicators that are related to the repayment status of the target object; standardize each second indicator data to obtain N target indicator data; input the N target indicator data into the target prediction model and output the default probability of the object to be evaluated, Among them, the target prediction model includes a model obtained by adjusting model parameters through the target dragonfly algorithm. The present invention solves the technical problem in related technologies that the artificial neural network model has a local optimum, resulting in low prediction accuracy of the risk assessment model.

title: Radio frequency fingerprint identification method and system based on adaptive wavelet threshold denoising algorithm
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of radio frequency fingerprint identification and discloses a radio frequency fingerprint identification method and system based on an adaptive wavelet threshold denoising algorithm. The method of the present invention includes: receiving radio frequency signals; training the received radio frequency signals, including: standardizing the received radio frequency signals; extracting wavelet basis functions and wavelet thresholds that match the radio frequency signals; standardizing based on the wavelet basis functions and wavelet thresholds The processed radio frequency signal is denoised; the radio frequency signal before and after denoising is added as the input of the classification network to obtain the predicted probability of each category to which the radio frequency signal belongs; according to the prediction of each category to which the radio frequency signal belongs Probabilistically update network parameters; repeatedly train on received RF signals until the network converges. This will improve the performance of subsequent recognition networks in low signal-to-noise ratio environments on the basis of solving the time-consuming problem of manual selection of wavelet bases in general wavelet threshold denoising algorithms.

title: Method and system for evaluating unsupervised vocabulary level translation quality based on pre-training model attention mechanism
description: An unsupervised vocabulary-level translation quality assessment method and system based on the attention mechanism of a pre-trained model, involving the field of vocabulary-level translation quality assessment. This solves the problem of the existing technology's strong dependence on the annotation data at the sink level. The method includes: S1: Deploy two multi-language pre-trained models XLM-RoBERTa and XLM-Align without additional training; S2: Obtain the self-attention matrix of the Transformer layer of the two pre-trained models; S3: According to the above The self-attention matrix of the Transformer layer of the pre-trained model analyzes the attention weights of the words to be evaluated and other words one by one, and uses the attention weights as the score for the quality assessment of word-level translation. The invention is applied in the field of artificial intelligence.

title: Transformer monitoring method and system
description: The invention discloses a transformer monitoring method and system, which relates to the technical field of transformer monitoring. The images to be analyzed and the characteristic parameters of each monitoring component on the transformer to be monitored are obtained through ultrasonic partial discharge detection imaging equipment. According to the characteristic parameters and preset states, Key-value pair table, generate the corresponding state feature value, use the pre-trained target transformer defect detection model to detect defects in the image to be analyzed, generate the corresponding image confidence, and determine the corresponding image to be analyzed based on the state feature value and image confidence component monitoring results. It solves the problem that in the existing operation and maintenance method, the daily monitoring of the transformer requires the operators to conduct regular inspections. Important information such as terminals and clamps on the transformer cannot be grasped in real time. Moreover, due to the large number of components on the transformer, the existing regular inspections This method is prone to inspection omissions, resulting in technical problems with low reliability of transformer safety monitoring.

title: A feature screening method that affects cyanobacterial growth based on RF-MI algorithm
description: The invention discloses a feature screening method that affects the growth of cyanobacteria based on the RF-MI algorithm, which includes: using a random forest algorithm to calculate the feature importance sequence of each water quality indicator; using a mutual information algorithm to calculate the characteristics of each water quality indicator importance sequence; perform a normalization operation on the obtained feature importance sequence; use an aggregation algorithm to aggregate the two normalized feature importance sequences to obtain a feature importance sequence based on RF-MI; perform an RF-MI based feature importance sequence on -MI's feature importance sequence is screened to obtain the best feature set.

title: Dependency task unloading method and equipment in edge computing environment
description: This application is applicable to the field of edge computing technology and provides a method and device for offloading dependent tasks in an edge computing environment.
