The dependent task offloading method includes: constructing a directed acyclic graph of dependent tasks; building a policy network model; obtaining dependent task status representation based on the directed acyclic graph of dependent tasks; obtaining computing device status representation; dependent task status based on dependent tasks Represent and calculate the device state representation, offload task-dependent subtasks to the computing device; obtain the action space representation; calculate the reward function value represented by the action space; use the reward function value to update the policy in the policy network model, and update the policy network model ;Use the policy network model to select a strategy for the dependent tasks to be offloaded, and unload and execute the dependent tasks to be offloaded according to the strategy. The dependent task offloading method in the edge computing environment of this application can solve the problem of being unable to offload multiple dependent tasks.

title: A building energy consumption monitoring method and system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of energy consumption monitoring, and specifically relates to a building energy consumption monitoring method and system, which includes: acquiring multi-dimensional building energy consumption data at different sampling periods; acquiring the changing trends of the dimensions at different sampling periods; acquiring two Correlation degree of dimension combinations of several dimensions; construct a multi-dimensional sample space; perform hierarchical clustering of all data points in the multi-dimensional sample space by setting the number of clusters of different sizes; obtain multi-dimensional samples based on different levels of clustering results and correlation degree sets Necessity of merging clusters of data points in space; obtain the adjusted merging conditions between any clusters to obtain the adjusted hierarchical clustering results; obtain multi-dimensional building energy consumption data based on the adjusted hierarchical clustering results abnormal data; based on the abnormal data in the acquired multi-dimensional building energy consumption data, the abnormal energy consumption patterns of users in the building are predicted, making the prediction of building energy consumption more accurate.

title: Component associated word mining method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of network security technology, and in particular to a component associated word mining method, device, computer equipment and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining a data set related to components and vulnerabilities; constructing a knowledge graph based on entities, attributes and relationships in the data set; obtaining associated text information of the components to be mined based on the knowledge graph; using a graph-based sorting algorithm to sort the associated text information Perform processing to determine the associated words of the component to be mined. The component associated word mining method provided by the embodiment of the present invention builds associations between components through knowledge graphs, thereby improving the accuracy and completeness of mining associated words involved in components. Natural language processing technology and knowledge graph technology are used to extract keywords, which avoids the tedious process of manual annotation and greatly improves efficiency. As a result, this method can mine component related words more efficiently, thereby better ensuring the security of the system. The analysis and prevention of component vulnerabilities are of great significance.

title: Automatic model compression method, device and medium
description: The invention discloses an automatic model compression method, device and medium, which belongs to model compression technology. The method includes: obtaining a target model to be compressed; jointly performing quantization and pruning on the target model to complete model compression; wherein the jointly performing quantification and pruning on the target model includes: unifying the perspectives of pruning and quantification, Redefine network pruning as a special case of quantization; introduce a single-path model for encoding compression configurations, in which high-bit representation values are decomposed into the sum of the lowest bit representation value and a series of offsets; rely on the single-path model , introduce learnable binary gates to encode the selection of compression configurations, and learn binary gates and network parameters simultaneously; transform the compression configuration search problem into a subset selection problem; derive mixed-precision quantization configurations to support subsequent layer-by-layer training Quantify. The present invention aims to find the best trade-off between network pruning and quantization, and further improves the technical effect.

title: A BCNN image recognition method based on feature storage strategy
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of neural networks. The method comprises the steps of performing convolution operation on input picture data and a neural network weight parameter convolution kernel sigma and a convolution kernel mu respectively to obtain a feature map Falpha and a feature map Fbeta, and sending the feature map Falpha and the feature map Fbeta into a memory for storage; then when calculating in each Bayesian instantiation network, respectively calling the data alpha of the feature map Falpha and the data beta of the feature map Fbeta from a memory to calculate to obtain a pooling feature map, and performing activation operation to obtain the output y of a single instantiation network; aiming at T instantiation networks, the invention can save 2 (T-1) convolution operations, obviously reduce the repetitive calculation amount and save the use of calculation resources in actual system deployment.

title: Intelligent transportation vehicle type recognition and detection method and device, terminal equipment and medium
description: The invention discloses an intelligent traffic vehicle model recognition and detection method, device, terminal equipment and medium, which includes: obtaining a traffic scene image to be recognized; inputting the traffic scene image to be recognized into a pre-trained Vision-Transformer model and Swin- In the Transformer model, the first vehicle feature map and the second vehicle feature map of the vehicle to be detected in the traffic scene image to be identified are obtained respectively; the first vehicle feature map and the second vehicle feature map are input to the preset attention fusion The network performs feature alignment and fusion to generate fusion features; inputs the fusion features into the preset target detection model to obtain vehicle model recognition results; wherein, the Vision‑Transformer model and the Swin‑Transformer model are trained using unsupervised training. , reducing the data annotation cost of the model in the transportation field.

title: Quantum revolving door deflection angle determining method, error relieving method and device
description: The application discloses a method for determining a deflection angle of a quantum revolving door, an error relieving method and a device, wherein the method for determining the deflection angle of the quantum revolving door comprises the following steps: determining a plurality of rotation angles for one quantum rotating gate; determining a theoretical Hamiltonian expected value and a real Hamiltonian expected value corresponding to the quantum rotating gate of each rotating angle, wherein the real Hamiltonian expected value is obtained by measuring a quantum circuit of the quantum rotating gate including the rotating angle running on a quantum chip; and determining the deflection angle of the quantum rotating gate on the quantum chip by using a distribution rule formed by the theoretical Hamiltonian expected value and the real Hamiltonian expected value. By using the embodiment of the application, the deflection angle can be determined, and then the rotation angle in actual operation on the quantum chip can be determined by using the deflection angle, so that quantum error alleviation is realized.

title: Two-dimensional irregular part layout method based on biased key genetic hybrid algorithm
description: The invention discloses a two-dimensional irregular parts layout method based on a biased key genetic hybrid algorithm, which includes the following steps: 1. Constructing a mixed integer parts layout model; 2. Initializing the biased random key genetic algorithm; 3. , initialize the genetic sequence of the population individuals; 4. Calculate the individual fitness of the population; 5. Divide the elite population and non-elite population, and construct a mutation population; 6. Retain the individuals of the elite population and mutation population to the next generation; 7. For individuals Decode the gene sequence and place the parts in sequence order; 8. If the individual solution satisfies the model constraints in 1, add 1 to the number of population iterations and return to step 4, otherwise, return to step 3. The invention can improve the layout efficiency and save the use length of plate materials, thereby improving the utilization rate of plate materials and reducing the material cost of products.

title: A cross-granularity small sample segmentation method for pipeline inner surface defect images
description: The present invention provides a cross-granularity small sample segmentation method for pipeline inner surface defect images, and relates to the technical field of non-destructive testing based on machine vision. The core idea of this method is to construct a cross-granularity small sample segmentation network model in the face of sparse defect categories and quantities on the inner surface of seamless steel pipes, including: feature extraction network, support set prior module, and support set attention module , triplet prototype module, multi-scale refinement decoder, and several convolution modules; adopt a multi-dimensional support set feature map aggregation strategy to fully activate the defect information in the defect support set image; use feature fusion method to combine the multi-dimensional support set feature map Fusion with the query set feature map; using a multi-scale refinement decoder to perform feature decoding on the fused feature map and then segmenting it using a convolutional segmentation head. The method of the present invention can still achieve good segmentation results in unfavorable scenarios such as few sample categories, insufficient sample number, and high similarity between defect classes.

title: L-band global ionosphere scintillation index modeling method based on satellite observation
description: The invention discloses a L-frequency band global ionospheric scintillation index modeling method based on satellite observation, which includes the following steps: Step 1, acquisition of solar and geomagnetic indices: Step 2, acquisition and preprocessing of occultation scintillation observation data: Step 3. Use the random forest algorithm to construct the global ionospheric scintillation index S4 model. The modeling method disclosed in the present invention is based on the data of the COSMIC satellite for nearly one solar activity cycle, and uses the random forest machine learning method to model the changes in ionospheric scintillation with local time, season, longitude and latitude, and solar geomagnetic activity. According to The trained learning network establishes a global L-band ionospheric scintillation index empirical model based on satellite observations, which can provide model support for the link design of earth-space radio information systems that traverse the ionospheric environment.

title: Micro milling force modeling method based on random tool wear identification
description: The invention discloses a micro-milling force modeling method based on random tool wear identification, which includes: 1. Collecting milling force, vibration and tool wear signals during the processing and establishing a historical training data set with dimensions T×I×N; 2. Establish a tool wear identification model based on convolutional neural network, including: several alternating convolution pooling layers and a fully connected layer; 3. Use transfer learning method to update the tool wear identification model; 4. Establish a tool wear identification model that considers random tool wear Micro-milling instantaneous cutting thickness model; 5. Establish a micro-milling force model based on random tool wear identification. The present invention uses deep learning methods to establish a dynamic identification model for tool wear prediction, considers the nonlinear impact of random tool wear on micro-milling force, and establishes a micro-milling force model based on random tool wear identification, thereby improving the processing of micro-milling tools. Precision and sustainability.

title: Construction area prediction wave high-precision improvement method based on image prediction model
description: The present invention proposes a method for improving the accuracy of wave prediction in construction areas based on an image prediction model, which includes the following steps: S1. Use a drone equipped with portable wave acoustic measurement equipment and cameras to measure wave elements in the engineering ship operating area; S2 . Collection of ocean wave pattern prediction data in engineering construction waters; S3. Normalize the data and divide it into a training set and a test set; S4. Construct a deep learning ocean wave height factor prediction model based on the ConvLSTM network; S5. Test the application. The performance of the method of the present invention in capturing the spatiotemporal changes of the sequence is better than the deep feedforward neural network and other advanced machine learning algorithms. This invention is applied to the fusion problem of numerical model prediction data and local area wave survey data. Through model training, the correlation model between numerical model prediction waves and local waves is obtained, which provides high-precision regional wave prediction for engineering operation ship requirements. provide technical support.

title: Pancreatic cancer-derived new diabetes prediction method based on CT image histology
description: The invention discloses a method for predicting new-onset diabetes caused by pancreatic cancer based on CT imaging, and relates to the field of medical technology. This CT imaging-based prediction method for pancreatic cancer-derived new-onset diabetes can more accurately and objectively differentiate between pancreatic cancer-derived new-onset diabetes and type 2 diabetes, providing additional diagnostic information for clinicians without any complications. The risk of pancreatic cancer can be identified in CT pancreatic images with visible lesions, enabling early identification of pancreatic cancer-derived new-onset diabetes patients among all new-onset diabetes people, and achieving early personalized diagnosis and risk prediction of pancreatic cancer. The process includes: obtaining the patient's CT pancreatic region image to be identified; inputting the CT pancreatic region image to be identified into the pancreatic cancer cancer-derived new-onset diabetes identification model, and the pancreatic cancer cancer-derived new-onset diabetes identification model to characterize the CT pancreatic region image to be identified Analyze the operation to obtain the qualitative analysis results of the CT pancreatic region image to be identified.

title: Multi-strategy-based two-stage competitive group optimization method
description: The invention relates to the field of information technology, and discloses a two-stage competitive group optimization method based on multi-strategy, which satisfies the execution conditions of the first stage of the algorithm, executes a fuzzy search strategy on loser particles, and executes adaptive bi-direction on winner particles. Sampling strategy, the loser particles and their sampling particles learn from the winner particles to meet the execution conditions of the second stage of the algorithm, and the loser particles perform enhanced convergence learning from the winner particles. This two-stage competitive group optimization method based on multi-strategy aims to efficiently search the entire space through the first evolutionary stage. In this stage, the algorithm is assisted by two strategies: fuzzy search strategy and adaptive bidirectional sampling strategy. The entire space can be searched more efficiently. The second evolution stage is designed to appropriately improve the population convergence in the later stage of evolution. In this stage, new updated learning strategies are proposed to accelerate convergence, even when computing resources are small. The algorithm can also achieve better convergence results.

title: A model training method and device
description: The invention discloses a training method and a training device for a model, wherein the method comprises the steps of responding to the triggering of a project creation component in a visual configuration interface to create a new project; after the uploading data aiming at the new project is detected, indexing the data based on an index operator; providing a marking operator calling interface so that a calling object marks the indexed data based on the data marking operator and obtains the obtained labeled data; receiving parameters configured for a pre-established training operator through the visual configuration interface; and providing a calling interface of a training operator so that the calling object automatically performs model training based on the tagged data and the parameters. The automatic and efficient training of the model is realized in a visual configuration mode, and the technical problems existing in the related technology are overcome.

title: Raw material purchase quantity and purchase time point optimization method based on discrete Jin Chai optimization algorithm
description: The invention discloses an optimization method of raw material purchase quantity and purchase time point based on a discrete Jin Chai optimization algorithm, which comprises the following steps: 1, constructing a single-period raw material purchasing decision optimization model, and 2, solving the purchasing decision optimization model by a discrete Jin Chai optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal purchasing scheme. The invention can obtain the purchased optimal raw material purchase quantity and the optimal purchase time point from a plurality of suppliers, thereby reducing the stock level and the total unqualified product purchase quantity on the basis of ensuring continuous production so as to improve the purchase supply chain efficiency and realize the intelligent purchase decision.

title: A method and device for predicting human resource allocation based on data mining
description: This application belongs to the field of data processing technology and relates to a method and device for predicting human resource allocation based on data mining. The method includes: step S1, extracting historical human resource information and historical aircraft development project information from different business systems in the aircraft development project; step S2, performing data alignment on historical human resource information and historical aircraft development project information from different business systems. ; Step S3, based on different historical aircraft development project information combinations as input and historical human resource information as expected output, build multiple human resource allocation prediction models and conduct training; Step S4, based on multiple human resource allocation predictions after training Model, respectively calculate the input information of the aircraft development project to be predicted, and obtain the human resource allocation information; Step S5, obtain the final human resource allocation information through weighted calculation. The application improves the accuracy of human resource allocation forecasts for aircraft development projects.

title: Energy management method for fuel cell vehicles combining working condition prediction and reinforcement learning
description: The invention relates to a fuel cell automobile energy management method combining working condition prediction and reinforcement learning, which is characterized by comprising the following steps: step 1: collecting and processing the travel working conditions of a driver, and constructing and optimizing a neural network; step 2: building a fuel cell automobile model; step 3: and constructing a TD3 deep reinforcement learning strategy, and performing training cycle of a fuel cell automobile energy management algorithm strategy combining prediction and reinforcement learning. The state quantity selects the working condition speed, the acceleration, the state of charge of the power battery and the equivalent factor adjustment coefficient, and the TD3 algorithm is trained by using the standard working condition circulation until convergence, so that the optimal energy distribution of the power battery and the fuel battery is calculated, and the fuel economy and the service life of the fuel battery can be effectively improved while the working condition adaptability of the algorithm is improved.

title: Multi-mode deep learning classification method suitable for immunosuppressant related pneumonia
description: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, and discloses a multi-mode immunosuppressant related pneumonia classification method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of acquiring CT images and electronic medical records, wherein the electronic medical records comprise large medical records and detection reports, and then inputting the CT images and the electronic medical records into a multi-mode CIP (computer-aided design) pneumonia classification network for classification prediction to obtain classification results and probabilities; the multi-mode CIP pneumonia classification network comprises an image feature extraction network, a text feature extraction network and a tensor fusion module. The multi-modal CIP pneumonia classification network disclosed by the invention performs feature extraction processing on multi-modal data of the combination of CT image modes, medical records and text modes of detection reports, integrates multi-modal feature information through a tensor fusion module, and realizes automatic extraction of multi-modes by means of a deep neural network model for performing immunosuppressant related pneumonia classification.

title: Intelligent detection method for surface defects of precision etching net
description: The invention discloses an intelligent detection method for surface defects of a precision etching net, which comprises the steps of dividing windows through an improved transducer architecture, combining the windows in a cyclic shift mode, respectively replacing a self-attention calculation algorithm and a relative position shift algorithm by using a long-short distance attention and tracking position shift algorithm, fusing the two algorithms by using a proposed MLDCFFP under different scales, and evaluating the performance of a model through an evaluation index. The method provided by the invention not only solves the problem that small target information is easy to be annihilated by noise; and the problem that the conventional defect detection algorithm is sensitive to changes of environmental factors such as illumination intensity, placement angle and the like is solved. The defect characteristics can be described more precisely and accurately, and the defect positions can be positioned accurately, so that the actual application of the relevant defect detection technology on site is guided.

title: Video abnormal event detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of videos, and discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting video abnormal events, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current video frame of an industrial field, reconstructing a current reconstruction frame corresponding to the current video frame through an anomaly detection model, wherein the anomaly detection model is a model constructed based on a double-flow self-encoder network, the double-flow self-encoder network is used for extracting spatial features and time features, calculating a current dynamic threshold of the current video frame, and detecting an anomaly event of the industrial field according to the current dynamic threshold and the current reconstruction frame; according to the invention, whether the abnormal event occurs or not is detected through the abnormal detection model and the dynamic threshold value, so that the reconstruction capability of the model to the abnormal event can be inhibited, the self-encoder is encouraged to generate higher reconstruction errors to the abnormal event, the problem of false detection or missing detection is reduced, and the accuracy of video abnormal event detection is improved.

title: Human body detection and posture estimation method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The application relates to a human body detection and posture estimation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the human body detection and posture estimation method comprises the following steps: performing self-adaptive enhancement on image contrast of an image to be detected to obtain a preprocessed image; human body detection is carried out on the preprocessed image through a trained human body detection model to obtain candidate frames of a human body target, wherein the human body detection model is a convolutional neural network with light parameters; and obtaining a human body posture estimation result through a trained joint detection model and a classifier according to the images in the candidate frames, wherein the joint detection model is an improved stacked hourglass model. The method and the device can improve the speed and efficiency of gesture estimation and enlarge the application range and application scene of gesture estimation.

title: Data-driven dynamic landslide susceptibility evaluation and disaster factor change inference method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of landslide analysis, in particular to a data-driven dynamic landslide susceptibility assessment and disaster factor change inference method, which comprises the following steps: collecting landslide susceptibility related data, preprocessing data and sampling LSA element tasks aiming at small sample problems, and constructing LSA element tasks for intermediate characterization learning; performing small sample learning by using meta learning intermediate characterization, learning an intermediate model by meta learning, and learning LSA prediction models of all years; performing an interpretability analysis on each LSA prediction model by using an SHAP algorithm; after LSA prediction models of all years are learned, landslide susceptibility graphs of each year are predicted, and dynamic landslide susceptibility analysis is completed; the landslide susceptibility assessment result is enhanced and verified by utilizing the InSAR technology, and the annual landslide susceptibility mapping performance is good by adopting the meta-learning strategy even if only a small number of samples and gradient descent updating are used based on the rapid adaptation strategy.

title: Active learning method for power grid operation action recognition model based on difficult sample selection
description: The invention discloses an active learning method and system for power grid operation action recognition model based on difficult sample selection, including: collecting image data in typical power grid operation scenes; inputting initial data sets and unlabeled image data into student models and teacher models for iteration Training; using the scoring mechanism to select difficult samples for labeling, and iteratively training and optimizing; using the trained best teacher model to identify illegal actions and obtain test results. Improve safety in typical power grid operation scenarios. Through active learning guidance, implement a multi-strategy fusion mechanism, select difficult instance data of medium and high value, improve the diversity and balance of samples, remove redundant data, and reduce sample annotations required for model updates. time cost, thereby improving the accuracy and efficiency of identifying potential illegal actions in typical power grid operation scenarios.

title: Data reconstruction method and device based on phased array antenna
description: This application discloses a data reconstruction method and device based on a phased array antenna. The data reconstruction method includes: using test excitation to control each radiation unit in the phased antenna array; using a waveguide sampling unit to follow a preset sequence Sampling the radiating units in the phased array antenna in sequence to obtain multiple sampling data, the waveguide sampling unit covers at least two adjacent radiating units, and the sampling data includes the phased array The amplitude distribution and phase distribution of the antenna under test excitation control; input multiple sampling data to the trained deep learning model to obtain reconstructed data corresponding to the multiple sampling data. The resolution of the reconstructed data is higher than that of the sampling data. The resolution can restore high-resolution amplitude and phase distribution based on the low-resolution sampling data of the phased array antenna.

title: Emergency project planning method, device and equipment
description: The present invention provides an emergency project planning method, device and equipment, the method comprising: determining emergency sub-projects related to responding to sudden disasters; constructing a dependency-exclusion network based on the association relationship between emergency sub-projects; determining key projects based on emergency sub-projects, and key projects are basic projects for responding to sudden disasters; processing key projects and other emergency sub-projects based on project portfolio optimization strategy and dependency-exclusion network to obtain a project security plan, the project security plan includes multiple project combinations, wherein one or more project combinations that respond to the same security demand in sudden disasters and are time-coherent constitute a security chain; generating an emergency plan for responding to sudden disasters based at least on the project security plan and the timeliness and energy efficiency indicators of the security chain. The emergency project planning method of the present invention can quickly and accurately generate an emergency plan that is feasible, can effectively respond to sudden disasters, and provide security for the masses.

title: Method and device for determining license plate number, storage medium and electronic device
description: The present invention discloses a method and device for determining a license plate number, a storage medium and an electronic device, wherein the method comprises: obtaining a first resolution image and a second resolution image corresponding to a target license plate; extracting a first image feature of the first resolution image and a second image feature of the second resolution image through a convolutional neural network; determining an attention feature of the target license plate based on the first image feature, the second image feature and the stroke sequence of the target license plate; and determining the license plate number of the target license plate through the attention feature. The method solves the problem in the related art that the traditional license plate recognition method ignores the important role of the visual quality of the strokes in text recognition, resulting in poor license plate recognition effect in low resolution, blurry and other scenes.

title: Magnetic resonance spectrum reconstruction method based on hypercomplex neural network
description: A magnetic resonance spectrum reconstruction method based on a hypercomplex neural network. A full-sampled time domain signal of a hypercomplex magnetic resonance spectrum is generated according to a magnetic resonance spectrum index signal model; an undersampling template is generated according to the size of the time domain signal and an undersampling operation is performed on the full-sampled time domain signal. The data points that are not collected are filled with zeros to obtain the undersampled time domain data of the hypercomplex magnetic resonance spectrum. The corresponding hypercomplex undersampled and fully sampled time domain data are subjected to a hypercomplex Fourier transform to generate a corresponding hypercomplex magnetic resonance spectrum training set; a hypercomplex neural network composed of multiple iterative blocks is constructed using residual connections, and the hypercomplex magnetic resonance spectrum training set is used to train the hypercomplex neural network; the trained hypercomplex neural network is used to reconstruct the undersampled time domain signal of the hypercomplex magnetic resonance spectrum to obtain a complete hypercomplex magnetic resonance spectrum. There is no need to convert the hypercomplex magnetic resonance spectrum into a complex magnetic resonance spectrum, and the effect is excellent and the reconstruction speed is fast.

title: A D2D-assisted two-stage air computing model aggregation method
description: A D2D-assisted double-stage aerial calculation model aggregation method belongs to the technical field of wireless communication. Firstly, after global model distribution, local model updating is carried out; secondly, performing D2D-assisted double-stage aerial calculation model aggregation on the local model; thirdly, updating the global model, wherein the base station takes the current aggregation model as a new global model; finally, stopping training when a preset federal learning training termination condition is met; otherwise, repeating the first step to the fourth step, and entering the next training round. The D2D-assisted double-stage aerial calculation model aggregation method provided by the invention can effectively reduce model aggregation errors and obviously improve the wireless communication efficiency of federal learning on the premise of ensuring the prediction precision of federal learning models in a wireless network; the cooperative diversity of the wireless federal learning system is fully utilized, and the communication efficiency and the federal learning model training speed are improved; based on the existing equipment in the network, no new equipment needs to be deployed; the aggregation method can quickly converge, and the federal learning training efficiency is effectively improved.

title: Assessment method and device for conversation robot, storage medium and computer equipment
description: The present invention discloses a method and device for evaluating a conversational robot, a storage medium, and a computer device, which belong to the field of human-computer conversation technology. The method mainly aims to solve the problem that evaluating robot replies in a manual evaluation manner lacks objective consistency, is inefficient, and affects the online effect. The method comprises obtaining the conversation context and the robot reply of the conversational robot to be evaluated to form a plurality of samples to be evaluated; evaluating the samples to be evaluated based on preset prompt words and an external evaluation model to obtain a first evaluation value; and evaluating the samples to be evaluated based on a pre-trained conversation evaluation reward model to obtain a second evaluation value; score-fusing the first evaluation value and the second evaluation value to obtain a comprehensive evaluation value corresponding to each sample to be evaluated; determining the evaluation result of each sample to be evaluated based on the comprehensive evaluation value, and marking the robot reply based on the evaluation result.

title: Method, device, electronic device and storage medium for generating software requirement document
description: The present disclosure provides a method, device, electronic device and storage medium for generating a software requirement document, which relates to the field of computer technology, and in particular to the field of artificial intelligence technology such as large language models, natural language processing, and deep learning. The specific implementation scheme is: obtaining the software requirement information to be processed and the business type corresponding to the software requirement to be processed; determining the business requirement information associated with the business type; based on the business requirement information, modifying the requirement expansion prompt word template and the requirement optimization prompt word template to obtain the target expansion prompt word and target optimization prompt word corresponding to the business type; based on the target expansion prompt word and target optimization prompt word, processing the software requirement information to be processed to obtain the target software requirement document.

title: Electric automobile moment distribution energy-saving control method based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The invention discloses an electric vehicle torque distribution energy-saving control method based on deep reinforcement learning, and specifically relates to the technical field of electric vehicle power system optimization and energy-saving control. A hierarchical double-layer learning architecture is designed, wherein an upper layer uses an LSTM long short-term memory network to construct a vehicle demand torque and a front and rear axle torque distribution ratio coefficient prediction model, and predicts the vehicle demand torque and the demand front and rear axle torque distribution ratio coefficient; through the predicted torque, the vehicle driving mode to be adopted is judged; the lower layer deep reinforcement learning network controls the rotation speed and torque of the electric vehicle according to the expected driving mode, controls the torque of a front-wheel drive vehicle, and controls the front and rear axle torque distribution ratio coefficient of a four-wheel drive vehicle, so as to obtain optimized energy-saving driving control, and at the same time ensure that the distance between the current vehicle and the front and rear vehicles is kept near the expected following distance, thereby ensuring the safety of vehicle driving and traffic efficiency.

title: A hybrid multi-objective hierarchical energy management method for urban EMUs
description: The present invention discloses a hybrid multi-objective hierarchical energy management method for urban EMUs. In the implementation of the energy management method, a hierarchical strategy is adopted. The top layer adopts a multi-objective optimization management method, which fully considers multiple factors such as the service life of the fuel cell, the system hydrogen consumption, the durability of the power battery, the state of charge SOC and the equivalent hydrogen consumption, so as to comprehensively optimize the overall performance of the power system; the fuel cell cluster system in the middle layer adopts a performance consistency coordination control strategy, and the power battery adopts an SOC consistency coordination control strategy to improve the overall durability of the fuel cell and the power battery; the bottom layer adopts an adaptive power resistance characteristic control strategy to realize the plug-and-play of the multi-source hybrid power system, which is convenient for system expansion or replacement of faulty power sources.

title: A multimodal question answering method and system based on multimodal knowledge graph
description: The present invention provides a multimodal question-answering method and system based on a multimodal knowledge graph in the field of artificial intelligence technology, the method comprising: step S1, obtaining historical data, constructing a data set after preprocessing each historical data, extracting entities and attributes from the data set based on BERT+Bi LSTM+CRF; step S2, standardizing the entities, constructing a multimodal knowledge graph based on the entities and attributes and storing them in a multimodal database; step S3, obtaining input question data and encapsulating them into a JSON data packet and sending them to an algorithm web end; step S4, the algorithm web end parses the JSON data packet to obtain question data, performs semantic analysis after standardizing the question data, and converts it into a knowledge graph query statement; step S5, querying answer data from the multimodal knowledge graph based on the knowledge graph query statement, screening the answer data, and performing multimodal output on the screened answer data. The advantages of the present invention are: greatly improving the accuracy and flexibility of question-answering.

title: Bridge construction safety monitoring method, system and terminal under complex urban traffic
description: The present application relates to a method, system and terminal for monitoring the safety of bridge construction under complex urban traffic, and belongs to the technical field of bridge construction. The method for monitoring safety includes: establishing a risk factor table, wherein the risk factors in the risk factor table are prioritized from large to small according to their influence; the risk factors include construction personnel factors, construction site factors, and construction equipment factors; obtaining the risk value of each risk factor; judging in order according to the priority whether the risk value corresponding to the risk factor is below the normal risk threshold; if there is a risk value exceeding the normal risk threshold, the corresponding risk factor is determined as an abnormal risk factor; based on the abnormal risk factor, abnormal risk warning information is sent. By establishing a risk factor table, obtaining the risk value of each risk factor, and then judging the risk value, it is possible to timely discover abnormal risk factors whose risk values exceed the normal risk threshold, and thus to timely issue safety warnings.

title: Method and system for improving positioning accuracy of Beidou navigation system in power grid asset management
description: The present invention belongs to the field of positioning technology, and discloses a method and system for improving the common positioning accuracy of a low-cost Beidou navigation system in power grid asset management, improving signal processing algorithms and multipath error correction technology; introducing an environment perception algorithm based on machine learning; combining real-time monitoring data and power grid GIS (geographic information system) data to perform real-time calibration and fusion of positioning results; integrating the optimized software algorithm into a low-cost Beidou navigation receiver, conducting field tests and verification, and conducting a large number of tests in various power grid environments; taking full account of cost factors, reducing the cost of the Beidou navigation system by optimizing hardware design and production processes, and selectively adopting some open source or existing mature algorithm libraries; designing an intuitive user interface and providing an API interface. The present invention provides strong technical support for the efficient management and maintenance of power grid assets, and improves the efficiency and response speed of power grid operation and maintenance.

title: Defending method for federal learning back door attack
description: The invention discloses a defending method for federal learning backdoor attacks, which comprises the following steps of filtering, judging, detecting and removing potential federal backdoors: firstly, a potential back door model is preliminarily filtered by using a self-adaptive aggregation algorithm; then, detecting whether a federal learning model has a back door or not by reversing the potential trigger and detecting abnormal values, and performing simple processing on the basis of the detection, so that the type of the label can be judged to be implanted into the back door; and finally, removing the backdoor of the corresponding category through the backdoor forgetting technology so as to achieve the effect of model repair. Through the steps, various potential federal learning back door attacks can be effectively defended, the safety of the federal learning model is improved, and the federal learning model is ensured to fall to the ground rapidly.

title: Stock data prediction method based on Transformer
description: The invention provides a transform-based stock data prediction method, which has the characteristics that the method comprises the following steps: s1, constructing an initial stock data prediction model; s2, constructing a training set according to the existing stock market data, and training an initial stock data prediction model to obtain a stock data prediction model; s3, acquiring stock market data of a plurality of stocks, and respectively constructing corresponding time sequence data; and S4, inputting all time sequence data into a stock data prediction model to obtain a data prediction result. In a word, the method can improve the robustness and the prediction accuracy of the data prediction result of the stock.

title: A mutual trust supply chain finance process control method based on warehouse receipt and invoice model
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of supply chain financial process control, specifically a mutual trust supply chain financial process control method for warehouse receipt and invoice mode, comprising the following steps: based on blockchain, using smart contract automated transaction processing and Merkle tree algorithm to maintain data consistency, digitally signing and time-stamping warehouse receipts and invoices, verifying their authenticity and validity, and generating verified blockchain records. In the present invention, the application of blockchain technology and smart contracts ensures the immutability and transparency of transaction records, the Merkle tree algorithm maintains data consistency, the combination of logistic regression and decision tree improves the accuracy of credit scoring, the application of convolutional neural networks and recurrent neural networks optimizes the processing of invoice data and the prediction of payment behavior, the fuzzy logic algorithm processes fuzzy or incomplete data, principal component analysis and linear regression models are used for fund flow prediction, and linear programming and network flow analysis methods optimize fund allocation and improve fund utilization efficiency.

title: Molecular property prediction method, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The present application relates to the field of computer technology, and in particular to a molecular property prediction method, an electronic device, and a computer-readable storage medium. According to the molecular prediction method of the embodiment of the present application, it is necessary to first obtain the target molecule data, and generate the target molecule conformation according to the target molecule data, and then decompose the target molecule conformation to obtain the target molecule hierarchical graph group information, and after obtaining the target molecule hierarchical graph group information, the target molecule hierarchical graph group information is input into the pre-trained molecular coding model for molecular characterization extraction and processing to obtain the target molecule characterization, and finally determine the target molecule property based on the target molecule characterization. Among them, the target molecule hierarchical graph group information obtained by decomposing the target molecule conformation can effectively extract and process the three-dimensional spatial information of the target molecule, thereby improving the accuracy of the molecular coding model in extracting the molecular characterization, and then improving the accuracy of the molecular property prediction.

title: Method for solving posterior collapse problem of variational automatic encoder
description: The invention discloses a method for solving the posterior slump problem of a variation automatic encoder. The method multiplies the mean value of the posterior probability distribution of the potential variable by a scale-up factor, thereby ensuring that the variance of each dimension of the mean value is not excessively approaching zero; sampling from the scaled posterior probability distribution and inputting the sampled posterior probability distribution into a decoder, and still calculating KL (moment of interest) items in the loss function by using the original posterior probability distribution; all data examples used the same scale-up factor. The method increases the distinction degree of potential variables of different data examples, so that the model can more easily excavate information in the potential variables, the contradiction between a reconstruction item and a KL item in a loss function is also relieved, the information of more input data can be contained in the potential variables, and the confusion of potential vector space is not brought, thereby better solving the posterior collapse problem of the automatic variable encoder.

title: Cascaded multi-resolution machine learning for image processing with improved computational efficiency
description: Systems and methods for image processing, such as image modification, are provided. More particularly, example aspects of the present disclosure relate to systems and methods for performing cascaded multi-resolution machine learning of image processing on resource-constrained devices.

title: Industry data analysis method and system based on NLP
description: The application discloses an industry data analysis method and system based on NLP, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the following steps: pre-training a language model, and performing fine tuning to obtain a domain language model; obtaining a central word for the query intention input by a user; vectorizing the center word to obtain a query vector; adopting an attention mechanism to obtain an industry data retrieval result of a user query vector; constructing a domain knowledge graph; mapping the entity and the relation to a low latitude vector space by adopting a graph embedding model; obtaining entities and relations corresponding to the query vectors by adopting an attention mechanism; carrying out relationship path reasoning in the domain knowledge graph according to the query vector to obtain a relationship path of the query vector; and calculating the correlation between the query vector and the obtained entity, relation and relation path through semantic matching to obtain a retrieval result with enhanced knowledge. Aiming at the problem of low industrial data analysis efficiency in the prior art, the application improves the industrial data analysis efficiency.

title: Named entity recognition method and device under fusion of word vector and category vector
description: The invention discloses a named entity recognition method and device under fusion of word vectors and category vectors, belonging to the field of named entity recognition, and comprising the following steps: the fusion vector generation module and the named entity recognition module are two parts; the fusion vector generation module adopts BERT word vectors to represent text language information, introduces entity types to which category vectors represent texts, learns the corresponding relation between the word vectors and the category vectors through a BERT-BiLSTM-Softmax structure, and splices the word vectors and the category vectors to generate fusion vectors of the texts. And the named entity recognition module adopts BiLSTM-CRF structure to realize extraction of context characteristics of the fusion vector and optimization of a label sequence prediction result, and obtains mapping knowledge from the fusion vector to the classification label so as to perform named entity recognition. The invention can improve the recognition performance of the named entity.

title: Medical model pre-training method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology, and specifically provides a method, device, electronic device and storage medium for pre-training a medical model. A method for pre-training a medical model, comprising sampling each pre-training text for medical entity information of each pre-training text, obtaining a set of sampling segments corresponding to each pre-training text; the sampling segments in the sampling segment set contain at least medical entity information; masking the sampling segments in each pre-training text to obtain a corresponding damaged text; using a general text prediction model, performing text prediction based on each damaged text and its corresponding sampling segment set to obtain a corresponding text prediction result; adjusting parameters based on each pre-training text and the text prediction result until a trained medical pre-training model is obtained. In this way, the semantic understanding ability and logical processing ability of the medical pre-training model in the medical field are improved.

title: Tool residual service life prediction method based on space-time feature extraction
description: The present invention relates to a method for predicting the remaining service life of a tool based on spatiotemporal feature extraction, which comprises an end-to-end architecture including a signal segmentation module, an information extraction module and an information aggregation module. The method uses a multi-channel monitoring signal collected from a tool cutting process to model the tool life degradation process; constructs an augmented feature matrix containing spatiotemporal related information, uses a bidirectional deep convolution architecture to self-extract deep features in the time domain and space domain, and uses a multi-layer perceptron to achieve the relationship mapping from spatiotemporal features to the remaining service life; uses a back propagation algorithm to dynamically update network parameter values around the smoothed mean absolute error between the true service life value and the predicted service life value to obtain the optimal solution that makes the error tend to zero; optimizes the gradient descent process based on adaptive moment estimation, and determines the initialization weight according to the input dimension to improve the adaptability of the model. Experiments using tool data have verified that the method has good comprehensive performance and can well predict the degradation process of the tool throughout its life cycle.

title: UAV wheat lodging image segmentation method based on DeeplabV3+ and Unet network architecture
description: The present invention relates to a method for segmenting wheat lodging images using a drone based on DeeplabV3+ and Unet network architecture, comprising: using a drone to obtain visible light remote sensing RGB images of a field wheat planting area for preprocessing; constructing a wheat lodging segmentation model based on DeeplabV3+ and UNet structure network; inputting the preprocessed drone remote sensing RGB images as training samples into the wheat lodging segmentation model for training; obtaining images of wheat lodging areas to be segmented, and preprocessing them; inputting the preprocessed images of wheat lodging areas to be segmented into a wheat lodging segmentation network model to obtain segmentation results of wheat crop lodging area images. The present invention improves the semantic segmentation effect, which is beneficial to the wheat lodging segmentation extraction task; the output results of each stage of the backbone feature extraction network are reconstructed by fusion of feature information with the coded output features, and the detailed fusion of the segmentation model in the reconstruction process at different scales is gradually improved, thereby improving the segmentation accuracy of the wheat lodging area.

title: Automatic testing method and system for aging test of solid state disk
description: The present application discloses an automated test method and system for solid-state hard disk aging test, which collects the read and write speed values and device temperature values of the solid-state hard disk in real time during the aging test, and introduces data processing and analysis algorithms at the back end to perform time-series correlation analysis of the read and write speed values and device temperature values of the solid-state hard disk, so as to detect the aging degree of the solid-state hard disk device. In this way, the automation of the solid-state hard disk aging test process can be realized, thereby reducing the need for manual intervention, reducing the cost and risk of testing, and in this way, it can automatically help determine the aging degree and performance status of the solid-state hard disk, thereby improving the reliability and life of the solid-state hard disk, and reducing the risk of solid-state hard disk failure and data loss.

title: Intelligent decision optimization method for asset retirement
description: The invention relates to the technical field of asset retirement, and discloses an intelligent decision optimization method for asset retirement, which comprises the following steps: step S101, constructing a trigger module, and screening current assets to obtain n assets to be retired; step S102, constructing an inspection module, and grading the retirement degree of n to-be-retired assets in a multi-dimension manner; step S103, a unified optimization module is constructed, which is used for retired t retired assets. In the invention, through screening of the triggering module, the assets automatically enter a to-be-retired asset list, then the screening module scores the assets in technical grade, maintenance cost, functional index, maintenance index and other required multidimensional degree, and finally the optimal retirement scheme is obtained by using a genetic algorithm. Compared to traditional retirement methods, the retirement of assets has unified and efficient execution criteria, and for enterprises, ensures that assets remain maximally profitable after retirement.

title: A typhoon prediction method based on multi-modal double-prompt diffusion model
description: The invention discloses a typhoon prediction method based on a multi-mode double-prompt diffusion model. And then carrying out task-specific uncertainty mining, inputting typhoon age into an age prompter to obtain age prompt, inputting task-specific environmental factors into an environment prompter to obtain task-specific environmental prompt, and merging the age prompt and the task-specific environmental prompt to obtain task-specific prompt. And finally, performing uncertainty modeling and reduction, and inputting standard noise consistent with the shape of the predicted attribute into a double-prompt diffusion model to obtain predicted values of typhoon track, pressure intensity and wind speed. The invention reduces uncertainty and realizes accurate prediction of typhoons.

title: Image classification method, product and storage medium
description: The present application relates to the field of image processing technology, and discloses an image classification method, product and storage medium. The method comprises: inputting a target image into a position embedding module, extracting the position information of the target image through the position embedding module; inputting the output data of the position embedding module into a spatial self-attention module, extracting the spatial information of the target image through the spatial self-attention module using a multi-head self-attention mechanism; inputting the output data of the spatial self-attention module into a channel self-attention module, extracting the channel information of the target image through the channel self-attention module using a multi-head self-attention mechanism, and obtaining the target image features; inputting the target image features into a classification module, and obtaining the image classification results. The use of this method can reduce the scale of model parameters and calculations, reduce the consumption of computing resources, and improve the accuracy of feature extraction.

title: Method for extracting building change region in double-phase remote sensing image based on twin mixed attention mechanism and multi-scale feature fusion
description: A method for extracting building change region in double-phase remote sensing images based on a twin mixed attention mechanism and multi-scale feature fusion comprises the steps of preprocessing an obtained remote sensing image building change detection dataset and dividing the obtained remote sensing image building change detection dataset into a training set, a verification set and a test set; constructing a remote sensing image building change detection network; sequentially inputting the training set and the verification set into a remote sensing image building change detection network for training and verification, and storing a weight parameter file; inputting the test set into a trained remote sensing image building change detection network for testing, loading a weight parameter file, and outputting a remote sensing image building change detection result; the invention introduces the mixed attention feature extraction module, the multi-scale feature fusion module and the cavity coordinate attention up-sampling module, can effectively perform feature fusion, jointly extract multi-scale features, and has the advantages of fully extracting feature information, avoiding information redundancy and noise interference and enhancing the capturing capability of the model on image global information.

title: Method and system for extracting combined travel chains of urban agglomerations based on mobile phone signaling big data
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for extracting a combined travel chain of an urban agglomeration based on mobile phone signaling big data, which relates to the field of comprehensive transportation planning and includes the following steps: S1, data acquisition: first, it is necessary to obtain the mobile phone positioning data of urban residents, which usually includes the user's location information, call records and text message records; S2, travel chain identification: using data mining and machine learning technology to identify the travel chain of urban residents, and determine the user's travel trajectory by analyzing the user's location change pattern, residence time and moving speed; the method and system for extracting a combined travel chain of an urban agglomeration based on mobile phone signaling big data can obtain data and information about travel behavior through analysis of the travel chain, so as to help understand and study the travel characteristics, traffic demand and travel mode of the crowd.

title: Pre-application patent quality assessment method and system based on clustering center characterization
description: The invention discloses a pre-application patent quality assessment method and system based on clustering center characterization, comprising the following steps: extracting keywords based on patent text input by a user for searching, generating a sub-data set with similar characteristics in the patent big data, and generating a central representation of the sub-data set through a clustering model; intercepting patent information to be predicted from a patent text input by a user to generate a text representation; calculating the similarity between the text representation and the central representation of the patent information to be predicted, and generating constraint information based on the similarity and the patent quality index; and training a patent quality evaluation model by using constraint information, and obtaining a multidimensional quality evaluation result for the patent input by the user. The multi-dimensional mass analysis method and the multi-dimensional mass analysis system can rapidly analyze the patent applied by the user plan while solving the problem of mass data comparison, are beneficial to improving the success rate of the user application and cultivating high-value patents, and reduce the cost of patent application of enterprises.

title: Seat outbound matching method and device, computer equipment and computer storage medium
description: The present application discloses a method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for matching outbound calls of agents, including: in response to a user accessing a call system, obtaining a list of agents preconfigured by the user; wherein the preconfigured list of agents includes a number of candidates obtained by an AI model based on analysis of user characteristics and agent characteristics; obtaining the real-time status of each candidate in the list of agents; matching agents based on the real-time status, and determining a target agent from the candidate seats that meets the requirements for matching with the user; connecting the target agent to the call system, establishing a call connection between the user and the target agent, and providing the target agent with conversation information with the user based on the AI model and the user's call information. By matching agents in advance and then determining a target agent for the user based on the real-time situation, the efficiency and matching degree of agent access are improved, and information feedback is provided to the target agent.

title: Neural network training method and device and computer equipment
description: The application belongs to the technical field of computers, and discloses a neural network training method, a device and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of samples and inputting the samples into a first neural network to obtain a first output result of each sample; repeating the steps until reaching the preset times; calculating the error of each sample during the last training; sorting the samples based on the respective errors; dividing the sorting result according to a preset proportion to obtain a low-error sample set and a high-error sample set; training a second neural network based on the high error sample set; calculating a high error average sample value of the high error sample set and a low error average sample value of the low error sample set; obtaining a target sample, and calculating a first distance from the target sample to a high-error average sample value and a second distance from the target sample to a low-error average sample value; and obtaining a final result based on the magnitude relation of the first distance and the second distance. The application can ensure the stability of the precision of the final result output by the neural network.

title: Directory level migration method and system based on load perception in DFS
description: The invention discloses a method for migrating directory levels based on load perception in DFS, which comprises the steps of firstly analyzing load information through a machine learning model to discover a hot directory in advance, then comprehensively predicting directory heat and system node state conditions, providing a migration cost analysis model to measure the necessity and urgency of migration data, further determining when to trigger migration or tolerating uneven conditions, then designing a peer directory cooperative migration mechanism for better utilizing locality, and finally adopting a multi-objective optimization method to properly select storage nodes to be migrated. The method can solve the technical problems that excessive pointers are introduced in the migration process, so that additional expenditure is increased, the heat of the file disappears quickly in the migration process, a lot of ineffective migration occurs in the frequent file-level migration operation process, and the hot spot data cannot be found sufficiently, so that the migration efficiency is low.

title: A multimodal method for rapid identification of the growth status of Morchella edulis
description: The invention discloses a multimodal morel growth state fast discrimination method, comprising: extracting features from an image I based on a backbone network of Mask R-CNN and obtaining a feature map, extracting boundary features from the image I based on an NSCT algorithm and a Canny operator and obtaining a subband set, unifying the spatial dimensions of the feature map and the boundary feature map, calculating the entropy information of each morel environmental data based on a discrete entropy and clustering binning method, generating a high-resolution entropy information map of the environmental data based on an inverse distance interpolation method and the entropy information of the environmental data, performing feature fusion on the feature map, the boundary feature map and the high-resolution entropy information map and expressing them as fusion features, obtaining a candidate region of the fusion feature based on an RPN of Mask R-CNN, performing target detection and instance segmentation on the candidate region and obtaining an instance segmentation result. The method can more accurately identify and segment morels, thereby improving the accuracy of discriminating the growth state of morels.

title: Online platform user preference recommendation method and system based on big data processing
description: The application discloses an online platform user preference recommendation method and system based on big data processing, comprising the following steps: constructing an initial sequence recommendation model based on time data enhancement and Fourier convolution; acquiring big data of on-line platform user interaction with a project to obtain first interaction data; according to the first interaction data, performing joint training of a comparison learning task and a recommendation task on the sequence recommendation model to obtain a target sequence recommendation model; predicting a preference result of the online platform user according to the historical interaction data of the online platform user through the target sequence recommendation model; and carrying out preference recommendation on the online platform user according to the preference result. The embodiment of the application is beneficial to realizing uniform distribution of items in a sequence, improving the existing data sparsity problem, better processing the enhanced data, extracting more accurate sequence characteristics, being beneficial to more accurately predicting user preference and being widely applied to the technical field of computers.

title: Trademark detection and classification method based on multi-scale feature fusion and convolution attention
description: The present invention discloses a trademark detection and classification algorithm based on multi-scale feature fusion and convolutional attention. The algorithm model includes: obtaining a trademark image to be detected; inputting the trademark image to be detected into a trademark detection and classification model of a supervised learning mechanism, performing feature extraction and Anchor Boxes design of the image, and predicting the position and size of subsequent targets of different scales according to the output generation results; then, dividing the feature map into different prediction heads according to target frames of different scales, calculating and generating the target category probability, coordinate information and confidence of the boundary box in the prediction head; after obtaining the prediction frame, applying the non-maximum suppression (NMS) algorithm to remove the prediction frames with more overlap, and only retaining the target frame with the highest confidence; finally, drawing the target frame in the image and marking the category information. Compared with traditional target detection technology, this method reduces the cases of missed detection and false detection, while improving the accuracy and efficiency of detection.

title: A quantum classification training method, system, storage medium and electronic device
description: The present invention discloses a quantum classification training method, system, storage medium and electronic device, including: initializing parameters of a quantum processor, obtaining first parameter information and sending it to a local device; the local device presets a training round, and determines whether the training round is reached according to the first parameter information of an output model; the quantum processor receives gradient information and uploads it to a central server, the central processor performs aggregation processing according to a plurality of received gradient information, and the quantum processor receives second parameter information through alternating training and sends it to the local device; the classification data of the local device is retained locally and does not need to be transmitted to the central server, thereby ensuring the privacy security of the participants or users, and at the same time adopts an alternating training method to effectively suppress the accelerated attenuation phenomenon caused by excessive differences in noise levels of the quantum processor, reduce the impact of noise on the training process, and improve the robustness and stability of the quantum neural network model.

title: Information transmission method and device and communication equipment
description: The application discloses an information transmission method, an information transmission device and communication equipment, which belong to the technical field of communication, and the information transmission method of the embodiment of the application comprises the following steps: the first communication device sends first information to the second communication device; wherein the first information comprises information indicative of data used to obtain accuracy of the first model.

title: Beidou deception jamming identification method integrating convolution bidirectional LSTM and attention mechanism
description: The present invention provides a Beidou deception interference identification method integrating convolutional bidirectional LSTM and attention mechanism, the method comprising the following steps: S1: analyzing and screening out key features for deception interference identification according to different characteristics of deception interference signals and real signals received by Beidou terminals; S2: constructing a deep learning model, and conducting in-depth learning and training on the deep learning model through the key features of deception interference identification; S3: introducing the deep learning model in Beidou positioning solution to identify and exclude satellite signals affected by deception interference, retaining real satellite signals for solution, thereby ensuring Beidou precise positioning in a deception interference environment. The present invention is expected to improve the identification speed and accuracy of the system for complex deception interference while ensuring the positioning accuracy of the Beidou system, and provide technical support for the stable and reliable operation of the Beidou system.

title: Marine environment prediction method and system based on remote sensing and hydrological sampling data fusion
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for predicting marine environment based on remote sensing and hydrological sampling data fusion, and relates to the field of marine environment prediction. The technical solution of the present invention uses a remote sensing image of a target sea area shot at a fixed sampling frequency, obtains sampling data of suspended particle content on the ocean surface at the time of shooting the remote sensing image, extracts basic features at the sampling point in the remote sensing image, performs correlation analysis on the suspended particle content on the ocean surface and the basic feature data, determines a method for predicting suspended particle content on the ocean surface according to the subordinate relationship between the correlation coefficient and the correlation threshold D between the basic features of the remote sensing image at the sampling point and the suspended particle content data on the ocean surface, obtains a data sequence of suspended particle content on the ocean surface at any point p in the target sea area as input data, constructs a neural network model, and obtains the predicted value of the suspended particle content data on the ocean surface at any point p in the target sea area through the model.

title: Method and device for predicting runout of water turbine, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of turbine swing prediction, and in particular to a turbine swing prediction method, device, electronic device and storage medium, wherein the method comprises: online dynamic clustering, real-time generation, updating and elimination of data sample clusters, capturing new features of complex process data; mining complex process data features based on a stacked autoencoder diversity latent feature extraction method, building a diversified base model, and laying a foundation for a high-performance integrated learning model; online adaptive weighted integration strategy, calculating the correlation between clustered local areas and query points, assigning corresponding weights, and realizing adaptive fusion of local area outputs; online fine-tuning deep learning, building a query point verification set, and fine-tuning parameters of the most relevant autoencoder network, realizing online operations of process state recognition, model construction, prediction and update, realizing the prediction of turbine equipment failure rate using turbine swing signals, and avoiding the occurrence of safety accidents in hydropower stations due to turbine failures.

title: Park energy scheduling amount prediction method and device
