description: The application is applicable to the technical field of energy scheduling prediction, and provides a method and a device for predicting energy scheduling amount of a park, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a historical energy scheduling amount of power scheduling of a power grid to a park in a preset historical period; performing self-adaptive decomposition on the historical energy scheduling amount based on a variable-decomposition mode decomposition method VMD to obtain multi-order mode components IMF, wherein each order mode component IMF forms a target power data sequence; predicting each target power data sequence based on the target power data sequence to obtain a target energy scheduling component of a target period corresponding to the target power data sequence; the target period is after a preset history period; and calculating the sum of target energy scheduling components of the target time periods corresponding to the target power data sequences, and taking the sum as the energy scheduling quantity of power scheduling of the power grid to the park in the target time periods. The method can more accurately predict the energy scheduling amount of the park and can better save energy.

title: Financial counterfeiting identification method based on multi-mode attention network
description: The present invention discloses a method for identifying financial fraud based on multimodal attention, and the steps include: 1. constructing a multimodal financial fraud identification data set; 2. building a multimodal attention network, the network structure includes a self-attention module, a guided attention module and a multimodal prediction module; 3. training a multimodal attention model and optimizing model parameters; 4. using the trained multimodal attention model to identify financial fraud. The present invention can exchange information within and between different modalities, and adaptively fuse multimodal data, thereby improving the effect of financial fraud identification.

title: FinFET electromagnetic reliability prediction method based on neural network
description: The invention discloses a FinFET electromagnetic reliability prediction method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps of; step1, modeling and constructing a circuit for a FinFET device by using TCAD; step2, acquiring a plurality of groups of HPM electromagnetic pulse parameters, external resistor resistance values of devices and corresponding electromagnetic reliability indexes of the external resistor resistance values as a sample set; step 3, randomly dividing the sample set into a training set, a verification set and a test set according to a proportion; respectively carrying out standardization processing on input parameters of the training set and the verification set, and carrying out standardization processing on output parameters of the training set and the verification set; step 4, constructing a neural network model; step 5, inputting a sample data set to train a neural network model, and obtaining a trained neural network calibration model; and 6, obtaining an index for predicting the electromagnetic reliability of the FinFET device. The burning time of the device can be quickly and accurately obtained by inputting different conditions of the HPM electromagnetic pulse and different external resistors of the device, and the neural network model used in the experiment has higher prediction precision.

title: Commodity identification method, device and electronic equipment
description: The embodiments of the present invention disclose a commodity identification method, device and electronic device, the method comprising: obtaining a first image of a commodity captured by the camera component of the smart vending machine; based on the first image, calling a commodity classification model to obtain category information of the commodity; based on the category information and the first image, calling a commodity recognition model to identify several features of the commodity to obtain a recognition result of the commodity. In the above manner, the embodiments of the present invention roughly obtain the category information of the commodity by using a commodity classification model, and then input the category information of the commodity into the commodity recognition model, and the commodity recognition model recognizes the corresponding features for the category, and further uses a matching algorithm to obtain a recognition result. It can solve the problem of low recognition rate and inaccurate recognition due to occlusion in the commodity recognition process, and adopts targeted recognition to improve recognition efficiency and recognition accuracy.

title: Method, device and computer readable medium for communication
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to methods, apparatuses, and computer-readable media for communication. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a terminal device receives a measurement configuration or a transmission configuration from a network device. The terminal device performs measurement based on the measurement configuration, and reports the result of the measurement to the network device. Alternatively, if the terminal device performs transmission based on the transmission configuration, the network device performs measurement based on the transmission. The network device trains intelligence (AI) or Machine Learning (ML) based on the results of the measurements. In this way, the actual measurement results are used to construct a suitable dataset for the AI or ML model at the network device.

title: A price prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium for building materials
description: The present application proposes a price forecasting method, device, equipment and storage medium for building materials. By acquiring historical prices, historical demand data, historical market dynamic information related to building materials and historical macroeconomic data of building materials, a short-term forecasting network and a long-term forecasting network are trained respectively to obtain corresponding short-term forecasting models and long-term forecasting models, and real-time data of building materials are acquired. According to the real-time data and decision-making criteria, a target price forecast result is obtained through at least one of the short-term forecasting model and the long-term forecasting model; model training and forecasting take into account factors such as price, demand data, market dynamic information related to building materials and macroeconomic data, which is conducive to adapting to market changes, responding to market changes in a timely manner, and improving the accuracy of target price forecast results, thereby providing effective support for decision makers and improving the effectiveness of subsequent procurement strategy formulation.

title: Block chain-based network security data processing method
description: The present invention discloses a network security data processing method based on blockchain, which relates to the field of data processing technology, and solves the technical problem that the use of a single data encryption method affects the security of the entire data and secondly reduces the security of data transmission. The present invention obtains common data and privacy data by identifying and classifying network security data, and divides the common data according to its own repeated data, and performs encryption processing in different ways on the segmented packages obtained after the segmentation, thereby increasing the overall encryption complexity and further improving the security of the entire data. For privacy data, an encryption method different from that of common data is adopted, and different encryption processing is performed according to the characteristics of repeated data to improve the security of the entire data. At the same time, different encryption methods are adopted to ensure the security of the entire data.

title: A method for OD flow prediction considering spatial heterogeneity
description: The invention relates to the technical field of population and substance OD flow analysis, in particular to an OD flow prediction method considering spatial heterogeneity. The method comprises the following steps: constructing an initial relation graph by taking each subarea in the research area as a node based on historical data; calculating the connection strength between the nodes according to the actual flow and the expected flow between any two nodes; pruning the initial relation diagram according to the connection strength to obtain an optimized relation diagram; acquiring community indexes of all nodes in the optimization relation graph; the community index, the social economic index and the geographic index form an initial feature vector of the node; establishing a smooth weighting loss function, and training a graph meaning network; inputting the initial feature vector into a drawing meaning network after training is completed, and obtaining a final feature vector of the node; and predicting according to the final feature vectors, the actual distances and the community relations of the two nodes, and obtaining the predicted OD flow between the nodes. The method and the device can effectively improve the accuracy and the efficiency of OD stream prediction.

title: A method, system and device for fitting geometric primitives of three-dimensional point cloud data
description: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for fitting geometric primitives of three-dimensional point cloud data, wherein, firstly, preprocessing is carried out on the three-dimensional point cloud data, including noise reduction, smoothing and downsampling; then, extracting three-dimensional point cloud features by adopting a three-dimensional point cloud feature extraction network; then dividing and classifying the three-dimensional point cloud data; firstly, dividing three-dimensional point cloud data into a plurality of subsets, and then classifying each subset to determine the type of the geometrical primitive which is matched with the three-dimensional point cloud data; finally, predicting specific mathematical parameters for the matched geometric primitives. The invention realizes high-precision point cloud segmentation and classification, effectively improves the feature recognition and extraction capability when large-scale point cloud data are processed, and further enhances the accuracy and high efficiency of point cloud data processing and analysis. The invention introduces a weight mechanism based on the traditional least square method, and effectively improves the accuracy of geometric parameters prediction of geometric primitives such as planes, spheres and the like.

title: Model generation method, system, device and medium
description: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a model generation method, a system, a device and a medium, belonging to the technical field of machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: training an initial model by utilizing a pre-acquired image sample set based on preset training parameters to obtain a first model; wherein the initial model is used to perform a first task; and responding to the triggering of the target condition, performing expansion training on the first model, wherein the expansion training comprises the following steps: updating the first model based on the collected images; and/or training at least one second model based on the collected images and the first model; wherein the second model is for performing a second task that is different from the first task.

title: Dynamic relay communication method for unmanned aerial vehicles
description: The invention provides a dynamic relay communication method of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the following steps: step 1: offline planning is carried out on the track of the relay unmanned aerial vehicle in the scene of the known grid data map and the channel information; step 2: acquiring image data of unmanned aerial vehicle flying in a path, and generating an additional sequence; step 3: and exploring the causal relationship among the visual data, the additional sequences and the relay unmanned aerial vehicle control information by using behavior clone training, thereby obtaining an available planning framework. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the invention can realize the performance equivalent to the offline searching strategy based on the known map under the condition of unknown map and channel information by a lightweight frame, provides a research thought for similar task-oriented problem scenes difficult to mathematically model, lays a foundation for hardware realization in reality, and has good application value.

title: Building a scalable and secure role prompting method and its prompting system for role-based dialogue
description: The present invention belongs to a technical solution for a human-like conversational agent for natural language processing, and specifically relates to a method for constructing a scalable and secure role prompt for role-based conversations and a prompt system thereof. Step 1: constructing a combined role prompt; Step 2: performing security optimization based on the combined role prompt of step 1; Step 3: simulating a role-based conversation based on the securely optimized role prompt of step 2. The present invention is used to solve the problems of high cost of manually constructing role-based conversation data, scarcity of role information for automatically collecting role-based data, and social prejudice and stereotypes that may result from directly applying simple automatically generated prompts to allow LLMs to simulate roles.

title: A method for constructing a rope skipping recognition network model based on spatiotemporal graph convolution segmentation and its application
description: The invention discloses a building method and application of a rope skipping identification network model based on space-time diagram convolution segmentation, wherein the building method comprises the following steps: collecting video data samples; detecting the key points of the 3D human body to obtain a time sequence of the key points of the human body; frame segmentation and labeling are carried out on the sample human body key point time sequence, and the result is used as a label of training data; establishing a space-time diagram convolutional neural network, and training the space-time diagram convolutional neural network by using a sample human body key point time sequence as training data; defining a loss function, and obtaining a rope skipping identification network model through back propagation updating parameters; according to the technical scheme, the space-time diagram convolutional neural network is adopted for training, the loss function is defined, the space-time diagram convolutional neural network parameters are updated through back propagation, so that the labels of training data can be accurately predicted, a network model is gradually learned to correct rope skipping action classification and identification, and the accuracy of the model is improved.

title: A method, device, equipment, storage medium and product for recommending communication time
description: The embodiments of this specification provide a method, device, equipment, storage medium and product for recommending communication time, wherein the method includes: constructing a wide data table of existing users; inputting the wide data table of existing users into a trained communication probability prediction model to predict the communication probability of existing users every day within a week; sorting the seven days of the week in descending order according to the communication probability of each day within a week; deduplicating the predicted rankings of the seven days of the week to obtain the final rankings of the seven days of the week; taking the day corresponding to the highest final ranking as the recommended communication time; obtaining the value of the target feature of the new user based on the basic information of the new user and the daily behavior information within a week; inputting the value of the target feature of the new user into the trained new user prediction model to predict the communication time of the new user as the recommended communication time for the new user. The method of the embodiments of this specification can obtain effective user response by communicating with the user at the communication time, thereby improving the user experience.

title: Crowd counting method, device, equipment and storage medium based on point query quadtree
description: The application discloses a crowd counting method, a device, equipment and a storage medium based on a point query quadtree, which relate to the technical field of computer vision and discloses a crowd counting method based on the point query quadtree, comprising the following steps: uploading crowd pictures to a VGG feature extraction network to obtain picture features extracted through the VGG feature extraction network; obtaining space elements in the picture characteristics according to the picture characteristics; inputting the marker to a quadtree encoder to cause the quadtree encoder to encode the marker; outputting the crowd information points and the candidate points to a quadtree decoder so as to enable the quadtree decoder to decode; the sparse crowd and the dense crowd are respectively processed by using a point query quadtree and a prediction head to respectively obtain a sparse scene graph and a dense scene graph; and obtaining a crowd counting result according to the summed result and the network optimization result. The four-way tree is queried by the points to process the image information, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of crowd counting are improved.

title: Compression method of pre-training model based on task matching similarity
description: The present invention discloses a compression method for a pre-trained model based on task matching similarity, comprising the following steps: S1, pre-training the model to obtain a pre-trained neural network model trained with a large amount of data; S2, aggregating the knowledge of upstream tasks and downstream tasks, and extracting the features of the general task knowledge of the upstream tasks and the specific task knowledge of the downstream tasks; S3, introducing a learnable pruning strategy, calculating statistics through the correlation information between the extracted features, retaining the weight values corresponding to the features with correlation greater than a specified threshold, and removing the remaining weights; S4, after obtaining a sparse weight matrix, re-training the pre-trained neural network model to restore the model accuracy. The present invention effectively retains the weight information that contributes highly to the current task of the model, so that the model can retain good performance on the basis of greatly reducing parameters, and can adaptively find the optimal compression strategy of the pre-trained model according to the specificity of personalized tasks.

title: Helmet detection method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
description: The disclosure relates to the field of image recognition, and in particular relates to a safety helmet detection method, a safety helmet detection device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring image data of a detection object; inputting the image data into a safety helmet detection model to obtain a safety helmet detection result output by the safety helmet detection model, wherein the safety helmet detection result is used for representing the wearing condition of the safety helmet of the detection object; the safety helmet detection model comprises an attention mechanism module, wherein the attention mechanism module comprises a channel attention module and a space attention module, and the channel attention module and the space attention module are connected in parallel. By the method, the safety helmet detection model can simultaneously consider the information of two dimensions of the channel and the space, so that the characteristics of the input image are extracted more comprehensively, the accuracy and the high efficiency of safety helmet detection are ensured, and the flexibility and the expandability of the safety helmet detection model are improved.

title: Image processing system and method based on flexible gastroscope robot and electronic equipment
description: The application provides an image processing system, an image processing method and electronic equipment based on a flexible gastroscope robot, which relate to the technical field of image processing systems, and are used for carrying out real-time data acquisition processing, preprocessing, enhancement processing and transmission to a display module for output based on a data acquisition module, carrying out data classification, modeling, error data processing, error comprehensive model processing, training, optimizing, precision compensation, data collection and arrangement, data identification, analysis and extraction on related data information, carrying out description comparison, rechecking and marking on similarity, characteristics, rules and data content, judging the data marking content through a judging module based on set content, carrying out timing on an A task module or a B task module and outputting to a notification module, adopting modeling, error analysis, error identification and fusion error to establish a comprehensive model by an error modeling module, optimizing and compensating the model, obtaining a model with higher precision, and extracting model characteristics to achieve a plurality of comparison analysis and diagnosis effects.

title: Gravity energy storage efficiency optimization method and system based on neural network
description: The invention provides a gravity energy storage efficiency optimization method and system based on a neural network, which belong to the technical field of gravity energy storage, and the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining weight, weight lifting height, weight density, weight lifting speed, weight falling speed, ambient temperature and energy storage efficiency of a gravity energy storage system, respectively constructing and carrying out model training to obtain a first convolutional neural network model, a first cyclic neural network model and a first transducer model, selecting the accuracy, precision and recall rate of the model with optimal energy storage efficiency, optimizing the model according to the accuracy, precision and recall rate, obtaining an optimal first convolutional neural network model, a first cyclic neural network model and a first transducer model, applying the model to the gravity energy storage system, and taking the average value of output data of the three models as final model output data. The energy storage efficiency is optimized through the neural network model.

title: Cheating detection method, device, equipment, storage medium and product
description: The present application provides a cheating detection method, apparatus, device, storage medium and product, the method comprising: obtaining a target answer audio and first indication information, the first indication information comprising task information of a cheating detection task and cheating judgment rules, the cheating detection task being used to perform cheating detection on the target answer audio and determine the cheating detection result; determining a first feature representation of the target answer audio in a semantic space; inputting the first feature representation and the first indication information into a pre-trained large language model, and the large language model determines the cheating detection result corresponding to the target answer audio based on the first feature representation and the first indication information. The present application can not only accurately identify cheating behavior in the target answer audio and achieve accurate detection of cheating behavior, but can also adapt to different answering scenarios and cheating methods, and improve the adaptability and robustness of cheating detection.

title: Method, apparatus and computer readable storage medium for determining antenna array
description: The present application provides a method, device and computer-readable storage medium for determining an antenna array, which relates to the field of antenna arrays to ensure that the antenna array has good signal gain at at least one beam emission angle. The method includes: obtaining a first number, a second number and at least one beam emission angle; determining antenna channel configuration parameters according to the first number and at least one beam emission angle; determining the layout information of the antenna array according to the first number, the second number and the antenna channel configuration parameters. Among them, the layout information of the antenna array is used to indicate the number of antenna channels included in the antenna array, and the position of the antenna units included in the antenna channel on the antenna array. The first number is the number of antenna units that an antenna channel needs to include. The second number is the number of radio frequency channels connected to the antenna array. The antenna channel configuration parameters include the distance between two adjacent antenna units in the antenna channel.

title: Cut tobacco dryer outlet moisture prediction method and control system based on LSTM
description: The embodiment of the present invention provides a method and control system for predicting the moisture content at the outlet of a tobacco drying machine based on an LSTM neural network, and relates to the field of cigarette tobacco production. The prediction method includes: using time series historical parameter information as the input of a prediction model, and processing the time series information through an LSTM recurrent neural network, and building a prediction model based on this; predicting the moisture content at the outlet of the drying machine through the time series historical parameter information and the prediction model; shortening the prediction time distance during the model training process, and cyclically predicting the moisture content at the outlet of the drying machine after a longer time distance when the model is applied, so that the model can consider the influence of equipment parameter fluctuations on the prediction results when predicting the moisture content at the outlet of the drying machine after a longer time. The present invention obtains production data in real time during production, and uses a trained prediction model for moisture content at the outlet of the drying machine to predict the moisture content at the outlet in real time, so that the moisture content at the outlet of the drying machine reaches a higher process level.

title: Semi-supervised remote sensing image semantic segmentation method and system based on region contrast learning
description: The invention discloses a semi-supervised remote sensing image semantic segmentation method and a system based on region contrast learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of adopting three student networks consisting of a layering enhancement module HA, a region awareness contrast module RC, an encoder and a segmentation network and a teacher network to perform semi-supervised semantic segmentation training on the encoder and the segmentation network, and the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of layering and enhancing the label-free/label-equipped images by utilizing HA, inputting the images into a student network, updating parameters of a teacher network according to parameters of the student network, and generating pseudo labels; and calculating a total loss function consisting of region perception contrast loss and pixel level cross entropy loss according to the region center and the pseudo tag predicted by the student network through a region awareness contrast module RC, and updating parameters of the student network. The invention aims to accurately and effectively identify and segment different types of objects in a remote sensing image, and improve the performance and training efficiency of a semantic segmentation network formed by an encoder and a segmentation network.

title: Image segmentation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on multi-mode information
description: The application discloses an image segmentation method based on multi-mode information, which comprises the following steps: extracting image edge characteristics to obtain an edge detection result; acquiring a chromatographic image of the image based on the edge detection result, and acquiring a depth image of the image; convolving the chromatographic image and the depth image to obtain multi-modal features of the chromatographic image and the depth image respectively; and fusing the multi-mode features of the chromatographic image and the depth image, and deconvoluting the fused features to obtain the segmentation result of the image. The application also discloses an image segmentation device based on the multi-mode information, corresponding equipment and a storage medium. The image segmentation method based on the multi-mode information provided by the application can enable the obtained image segmentation result to be more accurate.

title: Self-learning decoding decision method and system based on AI large model
description: The invention relates to a self-learning decoding decision method and a self-learning decoding decision system based on an AI large model, which belong to the technical field of software decoding and comprise the following steps: the decoding device sends a decoding configuration request to a decoding decision device; the decoding decision-making device searches whether a decision-making library has a target decision or not through a decision-making manager; if yes, the target decision is issued to the decoding equipment; otherwise, sending an experiment decoding configuration request to an experiment manager; the experiment manager searches whether the experiment pool has a target experiment or not; if yes, entering the next step; otherwise, the scheduling experiment generator creates a target experiment; invoking a decoding configuration generator to generate experimental decoding configuration, and issuing the experimental decoding configuration to decoding equipment; the decoding equipment performs decoding operation, generates decoding feedback and returns the decoding feedback to the decoding decision device; the decoding decision-making device returns decoding feedback to the target experiment; calling a decoding configuration scoring device to intelligently score decoding feedback; and updating the target decision according to the decoding configuration score.

title: Automatic driving test method, equipment and medium based on multi-agent cluster reactance
description: The present invention relates to an automatic driving test method, device and medium based on multi-agent cluster confrontation, the method comprising: S1, deduce the conflict topological relationship diagram between the tested automatic driving vehicle and the intelligent agent; S2, deduce the feasible planning space of the tested automatic driving vehicle according to the conflict topological relationship diagram; S3, according to the correlation between the individual interests of the intelligent agent and the cluster confrontation test effect of the multi-agent system, establish a multi-agent cluster confrontation model based on potential game in the feasible planning space, and solve the optimal confrontation strategy of the multi-agent system against the tested automatic driving vehicle; wherein, the confrontation intensity is introduced into the multi-agent cluster confrontation model, and the confrontation intensity is adaptively adjusted according to the actual response of the tested automatic driving vehicle; S4, repeat S1 to S3 until the confrontation task is completed. Compared with the prior art, the present invention realizes cluster confrontation with dynamically adjustable confrontation intensity, which can fully test the decision-making ability of the automatic driving vehicle in complex interactive scenarios.

title: Generating workload of storage components using machine learning
description: Embodiments described herein relate to generating workloads for storage components using machine learning. In some embodiments, a device may obtain first data related to a command issued by an operating system of a computing component of a computer system for a storage component of the computer system. The device may obtain second data related to a transaction at the storage component that is responsive to the command. The device may provide the first data and the second data to train a machine learning model to store transactions generated based on input and output of operating system commands.

title: Novel electric carbon index evaluation method and system based on optimal configuration of optical storage charging station
description: The invention discloses a novel electric carbon index evaluation method and system based on optimal configuration of an optical storage charging station, which relate to the technical field of carbon emission and comprise the following steps: establishing an electric vehicle queuing model of the optical storage charging station, and providing demand response data; taking the demand response data into consideration, establishing an objective function based on a novel electric carbon index evaluation model; establishing constraint conditions based on actual conditions, and constructing an electric vehicle optical storage charging station capacity optimization configuration model; and solving a capacity optimization configuration model of the electric automobile optical storage charging station based on a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and evaluating the carbon emission condition of the optical storage charging station. The invention fully considers the operation characteristics of the energy storage power station in the electric power system, provides a comprehensive and accurate assessment method for the carbon emission condition of the optical storage station in the electric power system by introducing two core indexes of increment size and participation degree, not only can improve the operation efficiency of the electric power system, but also can provide powerful support for the sustainable development of the electric power industry.

title: Three-dimensional wavefront tomography reconstruction method based on multi-line-of-sight point diffusion function
description: The invention discloses a three-dimensional wavefront tomography reconstruction method based on a multi-line-of-sight point diffusion function, which comprises the following steps: simulating the atmosphere turbulence multilayer turbulence layer to generate a fuzzy image, performing deconvolution on the fuzzy image to obtain a multi-line-of-sight Point Spread Function (PSF) and splicing the PSF into a multi-line-of-sight PSF spliced graph according to a spatial relationship to construct a simulation data set; and constructing an atmospheric analysis residual error network for training the mapping relation from the multi-line-of-sight PSF splice graph to the multi-turbulence layer wavefront aberration. The invention eliminates uncertainty through a multi-line-of-sight point spread function containing overlapping information by utilizing a deep learning algorithm, chromatographically reconstructs three-dimensional wave fronts, has good reconstruction precision in a full view field, can be used for multi-band image high-resolution reconstruction under a subsequent large zenith angle, and has very important significance in the field of image post-reconstruction.

title: Intelligent nursing system and method
description: The invention provides an intelligent nursing system and method. The system comprises a cloud control center, a Zigbee gateway and a device network, wherein the device network comprises an audible and visual alarm and various sensors; the sensor is used for monitoring a cared object and the environment where the cared object is located, periodically reporting monitoring data to the Zigbee gateway, and reporting first alarm information to the Zigbee gateway when the cared object or the environment where the cared object is located is abnormal; the Zigbee gateway is used for uploading the monitoring data to the cloud control center, triggering the audible and visual alarm to carry out audible and visual alarm when receiving the first alarm information, and reporting the first alarm information to the cloud control center; the cloud control center is used for displaying the monitoring data on the display page and pushing the first alarm information to the guardian when the first alarm information is received. The invention adopts Zigbee network technology, has the characteristics of low power consumption, low cost, self-networking and the like, and has a remote monitoring function.

title: Sewage treatment monitoring method, device, equipment and medium based on electric power big data
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of electric power big data, and specifically relates to a sewage treatment monitoring method, device, equipment and medium based on electric power big data. This method obtains predicted electricity consumption data based on a sewage treatment electricity consumption prediction model, and uses a linear regression model to obtain predicted sewage treatment efficiency based on the predicted electricity consumption data. The sewage treatment monitoring method provided by this scheme uses data used to train the sewage treatment electricity consumption prediction model obtained through an electric power big data platform. Based on electric power big data, AI and big data analysis are introduced to improve the accuracy, real-time and stability of sewage treatment efficiency monitoring, and effectively solve the problems existing in existing sewage treatment analysis.

title: Generating audio using autoregressive generating neural networks
description: The present application relates to generating audio using autoregressive generative neural networks. Methods, systems and apparatus for generating predictions of audio signals, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media. One of the methods includes: receiving a request to generate an audio signal; obtaining a semantic representation of the audio signal; using one or more generative neural networks to generate an acoustic representation of the audio signal conditioned on at least the semantic representation; and using a decoder neural network to process at least the acoustic representation to generate a prediction of the audio signal.

title: Facial expression recognition method for multi-granularity perception and label distribution learning
description: The present invention claims a method for facial expression recognition based on multi-granularity perception and label distribution learning (GPLDL), which aims to design a facial expression recognition model for the uncertainty problem of expressions in actual scenarios, and belongs to the field of pattern recognition. The method comprises the following steps: first, a multi-granularity hierarchical perception fusion module is designed to effectively combine low-level detail features and high-level semantic information, thereby enhancing the model's ability to distinguish subtle differences in expression. Secondly, through progressive training, multi-granularity features are learned from different granularity levels of expression images, and the structural integrity of facial features is maintained as much as possible. In addition, a global perception attention module is designed to capture the global contextual information of the face. Finally, a label distribution learning module is designed to construct a more comprehensive emotional distribution, which effectively alleviates the negative impact of fuzzy expressions on model learning. And a label distribution loss is introduced to further improve the accuracy of expression recognition.

title: A method, device and storage medium for constructing a slope creep deformation proxy model
description: The method for constructing the slope creep deformation proxy model, the device and the storage medium comprise the following steps: constructing a numerical sample set, wherein each sample comprises a first constitutive parameter, an external boundary condition, a first intermediate implicit characteristic and a first creep deformation time sequence; the first constitutive parameters include: static and dynamic first constitutive parameters and steady parameters; the first intermediate implicit feature is a time dimension correlation feature generated in the nonlinear calculation process of the constitutive model; performing an operation on each sample: inputting the static first constitutive parameters into a first learning network to obtain predicted intermediate implicit features; inputting the dynamic first constitutive parameters and the predicted intermediate implicit characteristics into a second learning network by using the steady parameters to obtain a predicted creep deformation time sequence; optimizing a combined learning network constructed by the first learning network and the second learning network based on the sample, the predicted intermediate implicit characteristic and the predicted creep deformation time sequence; and training the combined learning network based on the numerical sample set and the optimization parameters to obtain a proxy model.

title: Flexible energy-consumption excitation method for temperature prediction based on feedforward model
description: The embodiment of the present invention provides an air-conditioning flexible energy incentive method and server and a "feedforward" system, which relates to the field of air-conditioning technology, can guide users to adjust the air-conditioning to save electricity or reduce electricity pressure, and realize energy-saving operation of air-conditioning control. The air-conditioning control method includes: obtaining input parameters and output parameters of training samples; using a long short-term memory neural network algorithm to obtain a mathematical model representing the mapping relationship between the input parameters and output parameters of the training samples, and obtaining a neural network control system; configuring the neural network control system to the air conditioner; substituting the input parameters into the system for predictive calculation to obtain the prediction results; representing the prediction results on a carrier such as a web page or a mobile phone APP, and giving flexible energy incentive suggestions for users to choose, which can adjust the air-conditioning temperature or turn on the air-conditioning in advance before getting off work to save electricity, reduce grid pressure, and avoid peak electricity consumption; the system obtains new parameters through continuous monitoring for reinforcement learning.

title: Call strategy method, device, equipment and medium based on predicted user behavior
description: The present application discloses a call strategy method, device, computer equipment and storage medium based on predicting user behavior, including obtaining the user's historical call behavior data; sending the user's historical behavior data to a trained time series model; extracting the feature vector of the historical behavior data based on the time series model, and matching it according to the behavioral feature rules learned by the time series model, and determining the user behavior data matching the feature vector as the predicted behavior data of the user; generating a personalized call strategy for the user based on the predicted behavior data, the call strategy including the selection of call timing, personalized recommendation of call content and optimization method of call quality; feeding back the call strategy to the agent so that the agent can initiate a call to the user according to the call strategy. By predicting the user's behavioral response to marketing calls, the call strategies of different users are fed back to the agent to improve the effectiveness of the call.

title: Method for ship energy management strategy based on self-adaptive neural fuzzy reasoning fuel cell
description: The invention discloses a ship energy management strategy method based on self-adaptive neuro fuzzy reasoning, which comprises the following steps: obtaining the topological structure of the fuel cell ship hybrid power system and the information of the typical operating conditions of the fuel cell ship hybrid power system, and obtaining the overall optimal load distribution of the hybrid power system through an off-line algorithm; a step of taking a working condition calculation result as a training sample by discretely solving an optimal equivalent factor of each moment of the working condition; the method comprises the steps of building and training a self-Adaptive Neural Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS), calculating to obtain an optimal equivalent factor, and carrying out on-line calculation on the ship sailing working condition to obtain an optimal allocation result.

title: Sample garment diagram normalization detection method, system, equipment and storage medium
description: The application relates to a sample garment diagram normalization detection method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, and the technical scheme is as follows: acquiring a training sample set, a sample garment front view, a sample garment side view and a sample garment back view; training the neural network by adopting the training sample set to obtain a sample garment standard detection model; inputting the front view, the side view and the back view of the sample garment into a sample garment detection standard model to obtain a detection result; judging whether to upload a front view of the sample garment, a side view of the sample garment and a back view of the sample garment according to the detection result; the application has the advantages of higher efficiency, more reasonable and effective standardization of the picture shooting quality of the sample clothes, and provides a more standard picture effect for the downstream auditing process.

title: A model processing method, device and equipment
description: The embodiments of this specification disclose a model processing method, device and equipment, which includes: obtaining a first batch of image samples from multiple batches of image samples used to train a student model, the first batch of image samples including multiple different image samples and mask images after the image samples are masked; inputting the multiple image samples into a teacher model corresponding to the student model to obtain a first prediction result corresponding to each image sample, and inputting the multiple mask images into the student model to obtain a second prediction result corresponding to each mask image; based on the first prediction result, determining the association relationship information between the multiple image samples, and modulating the second prediction result based on the association relationship information between the multiple image samples to obtain prediction coding information of the reconstructed image corresponding to each mask image; training the student model based on the first prediction result and the prediction coding information.

title: A material identification method, interactive tablet and storage medium
description: The material identification method is used for the interactive flat plate, the interactive flat plate comprises an operation panel (11), an infrared touch sensor (12) and an elastic wave sensor (15), the infrared touch sensor (12) is arranged at least one edge of the operation panel (11) to form a touch detection area of the interactive flat plate, the elastic wave sensor (15) is used for detecting vibration of the operation panel (11) to generate an electric signal, and touch object material identification is performed by combining the infrared shielding electric signal and an original touch electric signal. Secondly, through setting up first duration, can be in time according to infrared shielding electric signal and original touch electric signal under the condition of the first material information that generates of electric signal, directly use the second material information that generates according to infrared shielding electric signal to confirm the material type of touching thing, can avoid calculating delay overlength, improved user's use experience.

title: STRes3dRNN model, evaluation system and evaluation method
description: The invention provides STRes model dRNN, evaluation system and evaluation method, which belong to the field of medical imaging and have the technical key points that: s100, acquiring continuous voltage data to generate an EIT image sequence; s200, extracting characteristic information by using a three-dimensional residual error network and outputting a space-time coupled characteristic sequence diagram; s300, optimizing weight distribution through a mixed attention mechanism formed by space-time, channels and motion attention modules, and improving performance; s400, capturing the dependency relationship in the EIT image sequence by using a two-way long-short-term memory network, and enhancing the capturing capacity of the space-time characteristic correlation; s500, predicting space-time classification by combining the full-connection layer and Sofamax functions, and identifying and classifying diseases.

title: Big data-based network freight management system
description: The invention discloses a network freight management system based on big data, in particular to the technical field of freight management, the intelligent logistics ecological system comprises a virtual logistics ecological module for creating a virtual environment by utilizing digital twinning and blockchain technology, an intelligent emotion interaction module for identifying through voice emotion and virtual assistant technology, and an environment and health management module for monitoring and managing health and ecological driving behaviors of a driver in real time. The intelligent logistics park module monitors and predicts the states of vehicles and cargoes in real time through a digital twin technology and a blockchain intelligent contract, ensures transparency and fairness of a transport protocol, improves safety, monitors the emotion states of a driver through a voice emotion recognition technology, prevents safety problems caused by emotion fluctuation, provides emotion accompaniment and social support, reduces the feeling of long-time driving solitary, improves efficiency, uses unmanned vehicles and robots to carry cargoes, and optimizes operation in the logistics park.

title: Bluetooth and Beidou integrated multi-mode intelligent Internet of things device control method
description: The present application is applicable to the field of Internet of Things control technology, and in particular, to a multi-mode intelligent Internet of Things device control method integrating Bluetooth and Beidou. The multi-mode intelligent Internet of Things device control method integrating Bluetooth and Beidou includes: obtaining logistics information; analyzing the logistics information to obtain delivery location information and delivery time information; analyzing the delivery location information and delivery time information to obtain delivery route information; obtaining recipient status information; and sending delivery information based on the recipient status information. By analyzing the logistics information, the method can quickly and accurately plan the optimal delivery route, reduce unnecessary waiting time and distance during the delivery process, and significantly improve the delivery efficiency; by optimizing the delivery route and delivery time, it can reduce the additional logistics costs caused by unreasonable routes.

title: RAG-based object management equipment alarm handling method and device
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for processing an alarm of a material management device based on RAG (remote access gateway), which relate to the technical field of property management and have the technical scheme that an alarm processing knowledge base of the material management device is built, a question-answering system is built, when the material management system detects that the material management device triggers a certain alarm signal, a property manager inputs a problem to the question-answering system according to the triggered alarm signal, the question-answering system matches the problem with the content in the alarm processing knowledge base through RAG technology, the fault type and processing experience related to the problem in the alarm processing knowledge base are determined to serve as initial answers, and the question-answering system generates an alarm processing description through AIGC technology. The invention can enable property management personnel to quickly obtain relevant alarm disposal description when the object management equipment triggers a certain alarm signal, avoid untimely alarm disposal caused by factors such as insufficient experience and the like, and simultaneously can help to improve the troubleshooting efficiency and disposal efficiency aiming at the alarm signal.

title: Corn identification method used in soybean and corn interplanting mode
description: A corn recognition method for soybean-corn interplanting mode includes the following steps: obtaining an original image; passing the original image through a convolution module to obtain a feature map F1; processing the original image through a boundary texture coordination module to obtain a feature map Fb; passing the original image through a convolution module, 5 downsampling and 5 relative position encoding modules to obtain a feature map   , and the feature map   The outputs after the convolution module and the convolution transpose module are sequentially connected in series with the feature map Fb and the result of the original image after two convolutions to obtain the prediction result; the texture boundary of the target feature is enhanced by introducing three modules, namely the relative position encoding module, the boundary texture coordination module and the multi-scale feature fusion module, and the utilization of the shallow features in the network structure is fully considered to improve the accuracy of the details of the recognition result, so that the present invention performs better in image recognition tasks.

title: A quantum bit mapping method
description: The present invention provides a quantum bit mapping method. The technical solution of the present invention, on the one hand, converts the hardware error rate into an estimated correct rate similar to another in physical topology by constructing a noisy distance matrix, and adds the estimated correct rate of the corresponding circuit execution on the basis of the topological distance between each two physical bits, thereby taking into account the hardware error rate information and improving the execution success rate of the final circuit; on the other hand, after selecting a switching gate to be inserted according to a nearest neighbor heuristic function, it is first determined whether the switching gate is repeated within a preset number of insertions. If so, the construction method of the switching gate is temporarily changed, a two-bit gate is selected from the front layer, and the shortest path is found for it in a topological constraint graph according to the current mapping, and a switching gate is constructed along the shortest path so that the selected two-bit gate meets the topological constraint, and the constructed switching gate is inserted into the optimized structural information; in this way, a large number of repeated switching gates can be avoided in a short period of time, and the depth of the final circuit can be reduced.

title: A SHAP paper drying process non-optimal cause tracing system and method
description: The present invention provides a SHAP paper drying process non-optimal cause tracing system and method, including data collection and preprocessing, energy efficiency grade labeling and energy efficiency identification, non-optimal energy efficiency cause tracing; data collection and preprocessing: energy efficiency grade labeling and energy efficiency identification, non-optimal energy efficiency cause tracing; energy efficiency grade labeling and energy efficiency identification: ensure the quality and consistency of model input data, by removing outliers, smoothing data and normalization processing, and ensure the reliability and interpretability of analysis results; the energy efficiency grade labeling and energy efficiency identification: clearly identify and distinguish the energy efficiency of equipment or processes, so as to formulate targeted optimization measures; the non-optimal energy efficiency cause tracing method: identify and analyze the key factors that lead to low energy efficiency, and find out the specific problems that affect energy efficiency. The present invention not only improves the accuracy and interpretability of energy efficiency monitoring, but also provides a scientific process optimization basis for papermaking enterprises, and promotes the improvement of production efficiency and energy-saving effects.

title: A method and system for adaptively repairing line losses in a distribution network
description: The present application relates to the technical field of line loss repair, and provides a method and system for adaptively repairing line losses in a distribution network. The method includes: reading the line topology network, determining the ternary division characteristics; building an abnormal positioning module; making loss determination decisions and probability calculations, and determining a line loss positioning column; building a network reconstruction model, traversing the line loss positioning column, performing regional segmentation reconstruction and self-healing correction analysis, and determining reconstruction data; traversing the line loss positioning column, reading non-self-healing line loss positioning data, and generating abnormal repair instructions; combining the reconstruction data with the abnormal repair instructions to perform line loss repair management. The present application solves the technical problems that traditional repair methods cannot accurately determine the line loss location, cannot adaptively adjust according to the real-time status of the distribution network, resulting in a large number of invalid repair operations and low repair efficiency. It realizes the improvement of the accuracy and repair efficiency of the distribution network line loss positioning through network reconstruction and abnormal tracing repair, and reduces the effect of invalid repair operations.

title: Multi-user collaborative design interaction main body switching method and equipment
description: The application discloses a multi-user collaborative design interaction main body switching method and equipment, and relates to the technical field of multi-user collaborative design interaction, wherein the method comprises the steps of being applied to a man-machine interaction system supporting a multi-user collaborative design scene, determining all users participating in the multi-user collaborative design scene at the current moment based on a current image, and determining the posture level, displacement and speed of each user at the current moment; determining the interaction strength of the corresponding user at the current moment based on the posture grade, displacement and speed of the same user at the current moment; based on the interaction strengths of all users participating in the multi-person collaborative design scene at the current moment, determining the interaction main body at the current moment and controlling the switching of the interaction main body.

title: Container expansion strategy generation method, device, equipment and medium
description: The present application discloses a method, device, equipment and medium for generating a container scaling strategy, which belongs to the field of cloud platform technology. The method includes: obtaining monitoring indicator data; performing data cleaning, conversion and merging of the monitoring indicator data; performing trend analysis on the monitoring indicator data after cleaning, conversion and merging through time series analysis and periodic pattern detection; creating a prediction model based on the trend analysis results of the monitoring indicator data; training and evaluating the prediction model based on the monitoring indicator data type; sending the latest collected monitoring indicator data to the prediction model to generate a load prediction; setting resource limit thresholds and scaling strategy trigger conditions based on the load prediction results; generating a container scaling strategy based on the resource limit thresholds and scaling strategy trigger conditions. The present application can significantly improve the flexibility and stability of the cloud platform, while reducing operation and maintenance costs, thereby greatly improving the market competitiveness of container cloud products.

title: Power settlement data analysis method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for analyzing electric power settlement data, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an electric power statement, carrying out character recognition processing on the electric power statement to obtain statement text data, carrying out attribute analysis on the basis of the statement text to obtain form attribute information, determining a matched target information template from a plurality of preset candidate information templates on the basis of the form attribute information, and inputting the target information template and the statement text data into a pre-trained large language model to carry out data analysis processing to obtain target analysis information. The embodiment of the application can improve the accuracy of data analysis on the electric power statement.

title: Intelligent body issuing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The disclosure provides a publishing method of an agent, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to the technical fields of agents, large models, computer vision and deep learning. The specific implementation scheme includes that target prompt words are determined from at least one version of prompt words, the prompt words are used for inputting of an agent to guide the agent to generate and output, first identification information of the target prompt words is added into codes, the codes are used for realizing the agent, first mark information is obtained from the codes in response to the agent starting, and the target prompt words are loaded to a designated position based on the first mark information to finish testing and publishing of the target prompt words and the codes. The disclosure also provides a publishing device of the agent, an electronic device and a storage medium.

title: Radar moving target detection method based on small sample transfer learning and attention mechanism
description: According to the radar moving target detection method based on the small sample transfer learning and attention mechanism, a small amount of actual radar echo and high-fidelity scene simulation data are used as a data training set, and the direct detection of a moving target under a strong clutter background can be realized. By utilizing the point/line distribution characteristics of moving targets and scene clutter on a space-time two-dimensional plane, a attention mechanism is introduced, so that the network can ensure the clutter sorting and identifying capability while the network training speed is improved, meanwhile, the small sample migration twin network is further combined, and a small amount of measured data can be utilized to correct the target detection network, so that the adaptability of the network to actual working conditions is improved, and the generalization capability is improved. According to the analysis of airborne flight correction test data, under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio, compared with the traditional STAP+CFAR technology, the invention has higher detection performance and lower false alarm rate. Meanwhile, based on the network pre-training and the small sample transfer learning mechanism, the method has practicability in the aspect of early warning radar real-time processing, and has higher engineering application value.

title: Feature selection method suitable for non-measurable medical data
description: The invention discloses a feature selection method suitable for non-measurable medical data. The invention is suitable for auxiliary medical diagnosis and pattern recognition related fields of non-measurable data processing and classification. The method can quickly and accurately remove redundant information in the non-measurable data on the premise of not introducing noise, thereby retaining relevant important characteristics. The method comprises the main steps of (1) preprocessing data, (2) generating prior probability of an existing sample, (3) establishing an identification model of a target sample, (4) giving an objective function corresponding to the identification model, (5) representing the objective function by using an equivalent optimization problem, (6) solving the optimization problem, (7) analyzing model interpretability, and (8) analyzing model effect and evaluation. The method utilizes probability information of the data to select the features, avoids adding extra error information to the data artificially, and can select important features from large-scale non-measurable data.

title: Green edge computing task unloading and resource optimizing method
description: The present invention discloses a green edge computing task offloading and resource optimization method, including obtaining the task type being processed by the smart port, classifying the task type by considering the delay requirement and the energy requirement; establishing a network optimization resource model, processing the classified task type, and taking minimizing energy consumption and delay satisfaction as the task offloading goal; performing global optimization on the task offloading goal based on the grey wolf algorithm to obtain the optimal network resource allocation solution; the present invention can dynamically adjust task allocation, reduce system energy consumption, optimize the response speed of delay-sensitive tasks, improve the resource utilization efficiency of the system, reduce network load and improve the stability of task processing, and is particularly suitable for scenarios with high energy efficiency requirements such as smart ports, and has strong practicality.

title: Medical knowledge graph construction and reasoning method, system, medium and equipment
description: The present invention provides a method, system, medium and device for constructing and reasoning a medical knowledge graph, including: obtaining content to be queried and a constructed medical knowledge graph; according to the content to be queried, identifying and reasoning the constructed medical knowledge graph through a graph neural network to determine the query result, and the query result includes: the entity relationship of the content to be queried in the medical knowledge graph. The present invention uses a graph convolutional network to reason about the knowledge graph, which can not only effectively process the graph data structure, but also capture the complex relationship between entities, and can handle the problem of incomplete information, significantly improving the representation and reasoning efficiency of the medical knowledge graph.

title: Customer service intelligent agent and implementation method thereof
description: The invention provides a customer service intelligent agent and a realization method thereof, wherein the method is characterized in that a large language model is pre-trained, so that the large language model has good intention recognition capability and understanding capability on knowledge in the field of target service, the large language model can accurately recognize user intention and map the user intention into corresponding target service, and then the information related to the target service can be automatically searched to enhance request information input by a user by combining an automatic flow based on service scenes and constructed by an RPA technology. And finally, inputting the enhanced request information into the large language model to help the large language model to better understand the demands of the user, so that the large language model has higher semantic understanding and expression capability, can quickly respond to the demands of the user, and better provides accurate technical support and consultation services for the user.

title: Image generation method and system based on gradual super resolution and region differentiation
description: The invention discloses an image generation method and system based on gradual super-resolution and region differentiation, and belongs to the technical field of image generation. The method comprises the steps of carrying out region division on images with different resolution levels, carrying out noise adding based on region division results to obtain regional noise adding images, inputting the images step by step into feature extraction branches according to the resolution levels, generating condition fusion features by taking final target images generated by the previous resolution levels as guidance, inputting the regional noise adding images into a U-NET network in combination with diffusion time step length, splicing the regional noise adding images with the condition fusion features with the same resolution in the processing process to obtain noise prediction values, and carrying out inverse diffusion based on the noise prediction values and the regional noise adding images to obtain target images under the corresponding resolution levels and diffusion time step length. The method can effectively capture the global structure and the local characteristics of the image, improve the quality of a generated result, and solve the defects of the prior art in capturing the whole structure and the fine details of the complex scene of the image.

title: Adjusting method and device based on human body characteristic parameters computer device, readable storage medium, and program product
description: The present application relates to a method, an apparatus, a computer device, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product for adjusting parameters based on human body characteristics. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an image to be processed, extracting features from the image to be processed to obtain a target human body feature parameter map, inputting the target human body feature parameter map to a trained position recognition model, obtaining a position recognition result output by the position recognition model, generating the position recognition model after training a sample set based on a historical human body feature parameter map, and adjusting the position of a corresponding target object in a target area according to the position recognition result. The readiness for adjustment can be improved by adopting the method.

title: Gearbox variable operating condition fault detection method based on normal sample aggregation contrast learning network
description: A gearbox variable operating condition fault detection method of a normal sample aggregation contrast learning network, in which a vibration sensor is used to collect vibration signals of a gearbox under different health states under the condition of a speed change, and the samples in the training set are continuously subjected to offset transformation and identity preservation transformation to generate virtual normal samples and virtual abnormal sample sets; a deep contrast learning network is established, and the contrast loss based on normal sample aggregation and abnormal sample separation is calculated according to the generated virtual samples, and the network is trained by minimizing the contrast loss; the memory sample set is input into the trained network, and the minimum cosine distance between each sample and the remaining memory sample set is used as the abnormal score to determine the detection threshold; finally, the abnormal score of the test sample is calculated, and the health state of the gearbox is judged according to the threshold. The present invention realizes fault detection of a gearbox under variable operating conditions.

title: Synthetic aperture radar large strabismus imaging waveform optimization algorithm
description: The present invention relates to the field of radar technology, and discloses a waveform optimization algorithm for synthetic aperture radar high squint imaging, including designing waveform parameters; using adaptive nonlinear frequency modulation waveform design to dynamically compensate for Doppler effect; combining wavelet transform and time-frequency adaptive window function to analyze echo signals; dynamically adjusting waveform parameters based on fuzzy logic particle swarm optimization method; real-time correction of waveform parameters to adapt to environmental changes; automatically adjusting waveform parameters to optimize imaging effects based on feedback of echo signal quality; and verifying the performance of optimized waveforms in target imaging quality, resolution and signal-to-noise ratio through simulation and actual measurement. The waveform optimization algorithm of the present invention can provide higher quality and more stable images in high squint angle SAR imaging, while enhancing the system's adaptability to dynamic environments and targets.

title: Landslide vulnerability evaluation method, device, equipment and medium based on InSAR
description: The invention provides an InSAR-based landslide susceptibility evaluation method, device, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining basic landslide data, extracting evaluation index data, analyzing multiple collinearity among the evaluation index data, constructing a landslide susceptibility evaluation index system, selecting all vector points in a disaster body range of a landslide inventory as landslide positive samples, selecting non-landslide negative samples, constructing a training set and a testing set sample according to the landslide positive samples and the non-landslide negative samples, constructing a landslide susceptibility evaluation model based on an RF-InSAR model of a random forest model and an SBAS-InSAR optimized sample, training the landslide susceptibility evaluation model by using the training set and the testing set sample, and inputting data to be analyzed into the landslide susceptibility evaluation model for landslide susceptibility evaluation so as to solve the problem of accurately and reliably evaluating the landslide susceptibility under the condition of comprehensively considering various influencing factors.

title: Whole blood donor low hemoglobin deferred blood donation risk prediction method
description: The present invention provides a method for predicting the risk of delayed blood donation due to low hemoglobin in whole blood donors, comprising a data regularization and outlier processing module, a classification feature encoding module, a category balance and model fitting module, a hyperparameter adjustment module and a model interpretation and deployment module. The prediction method proposed in the present invention performs data regularization and targeted feature encoding on blood donation records and hemoglobin detection data, fits a LightGBM model after category balance using the SMOTE oversampling algorithm, and uses the Hyperband hyperparameter adjustment method to tune the SMOTE and LightGBM parameters, and stores the tuned model for feature importance interpretation, model encapsulation and network deployment, thereby optimizing the whole blood donor invitation strategy and enhancing the continuity and stability of blood supply.

title: Query expansion method, computer device, storage medium, and program product
description: The invention relates to the technical field of natural language processing, and discloses a query expansion method, computer equipment, a storage medium and a program product, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial query problem; and generating abstracts based on the question-answer expansion result, the title expansion result and the keyword expansion result to determine the target query expansion problem. The method abstracts query expansion into three subtasks with different granularities, which are respectively used for acquiring key information of a document level, a sentence level and a word level, finally synthesizes the three results, outputs a final target query expansion problem, can be used for expanding and supplementing the initial query problem, and can more accurately reflect the original intention of a user.

title: Low-light image enhancement method and system
description: A low-light image enhancement method and a system relate to the field of computer vision and solve the problems of uneven illumination distribution, detail loss, color distortion and the like in the image recovery process in the illumination mapping technology in the prior art.
