Aiming at the importance and complexity of prevention and control of the influenza in the extra-large city, the method for deciding the influenza in the extra-large city based on the space-time flow of the crowd with different economic attributes, provided by the invention, takes the economic attributes of different crowds in the extra-large city into consideration, builds an influenza evolution model based on the space-time flow of the crowd with different economic attributes, and develops an integrated decision based on regional sealing control under the double targets of influenza propagation control and economic influence and the current limitation of the crowd with different economic attributes.

title: Route planning evaluation method, device, equipment, medium and product based on deep learning
description: The present invention discloses a route planning evaluation method, device, equipment, medium and product based on deep learning, the method comprising: obtaining flight plan data and actual flight data of the route planning result to be tested, forming an input feature set and an error label set; wherein the input feature set and the error label set have a corresponding temporal relationship; training the input feature set and the error label set according to a long short-term memory network, establishing an error prediction model and a residual distribution model; generating a dynamic tolerance interval according to the error prediction model, the residual distribution model and reference standard data; and evaluating the accuracy of the route planning result to be tested according to the dynamic tolerance interval. The present invention uses a long short-term memory network to deeply mine the temporal relationship between the flight plan data and the actual flight data, and constructs a dynamic tolerance interval for the planning target, which can more accurately evaluate the accuracy of route planning, thereby improving the safety and efficiency of aviation operations.

title: Real-time detection system and method for IP address state of Internet of things based on AI
description: The invention discloses an internet of things IP address state real-time detection system and method based on AI, in particular relates to the technical field of IP address detection, and aims to solve the problem that the existing method cannot accurately distinguish the real online state of a single device under a multi-device homologous IP scene; the method comprises the steps of acquiring communication data and historical connection records of the Internet of things equipment, carrying out field extraction and vectorization processing by utilizing a feature selection algorithm to generate an input feature vector of a deep neural network, carrying out online reasoning by utilizing a trained deep neural network model, outputting an initial judgment result of the equipment by combining a preset condition screening rule, verifying suspected offline equipment, analyzing and evaluating the dynamic change of the proportion of a data flow and a control flow by principal component analysis and analyzing the uncertainty characteristic of flow distribution by combining a Gao Jieshang model, rechecking the equipment state in a verification list, and continuously carrying out IP address recovery operation when offline, thereby improving the accuracy of equipment state judgment and the IP address management efficiency.

title: Deep geothermal reservoir parameter prediction system based on machine learning
description: The present invention relates to the field of geological data processing technology, and specifically to a deep geothermal reservoir parameter prediction system based on machine learning. The system includes: a data acquisition module for collecting gravity data, magnetic field intensity, and seismic wave data of an observation point; a predicted temperature acquisition module for acquiring a first predicted temperature, a second predicted temperature, and the stability of the external environment of the observation point; a geological interference analysis module for determining whether the observation point is an abnormal observation point, and then acquiring the geological interference of the observation point; a formation uniformity analysis module for calculating the formation uniformity based on the travel time curve of the observation point; a fusion predicted temperature acquisition module for training a CNN model to acquire the formation uniformity and geological interference of the target observation point; and obtaining the fusion predicted temperature of the target observation point based on the formation uniformity, geological interference, external environment stability, a first preset value, and a second predicted temperature. The present application can improve the accuracy of deep geothermal reservoir temperature prediction.

title: A prompt word optimization method, intelligent agent and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology, and more particularly to a prompt word optimization method, an intelligent agent, and a storage medium. The prompt word optimization method provided by the present invention generates multiple prompt word templates, combines different prompt word templates with different task samples and inputs them into different models. After continuous evaluation and feedback optimization, a first prompt word template adapted to each task and model type is ultimately selected. A first label representing the corresponding task type and a second label representing the corresponding model type are set for each first prompt word template to obtain and store labeled prompt word templates, making it easy to search based on task and model dimensions. This allows for fast and accurate matching of prompt word templates, improves the adaptability of prompt word templates, supports the efficient operation of intelligent agents in dynamic scenarios with different tasks and models, enables the intelligent agent to adapt to the prompt word template that is most suitable for the task and model type, and improves the generalization ability and execution effect of the intelligent agent in multi-task scenarios and multi-models.

title: A personalized physician recommendation method, system, device, and storage medium integrating knowledge graph and Transformer
description: The invention discloses a personalized physician recommending method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for fusing a knowledge graph and a transducer, wherein the method comprises the steps of calculating physician similarity and constructing an integrated physician similarity matrix; calculating the similarity of patients, constructing an integrated patient similarity matrix, constructing a transducer model and training, predicting the matching degree of doctors and patients by using the trained transducer model, generating a prediction score matrix, recommending a best matched doctor list for the patients according to the prediction score matrix, and supporting sequencing and screening. According to the invention, explicit and implicit characteristic information of doctors and patients can be fully mined, knowledge map embedding technology and a transducer model are fused, the accuracy of characteristic representation and model prediction is improved, and the accurate prediction of the matching degree of the doctors and the patients is realized. The method can meet the personalized recommendation requirement of the online medical platform, improves the patient experience and the utilization efficiency of medical resources, and has important practical significance and application value.

title: PM2.5 pollution prediction method and equipment based on adaptive sample expansion
description: The present invention provides a PM2.5 pollution prediction method and device based on adaptive sample expansion. The method comprises: S1: obtaining PM2.5 concentration data and an environmental data set at different times in a target prediction area to form an initial sample data set; S2: preprocessing the environmental data set, extracting features related to PM2.5 concentration, and filtering them to obtain a relevant feature set; S3: using the relevant feature set as a constraint, calculating sample similarity to construct a matrix, and clustering to obtain sample categories and quantities; S4: segmenting the initial sample data set and inputting it into adversarial network training to generate an adversarial network model; S5: using the model to generate new samples based on the sample categories and quantities; S6: training a machine learning model after expanding the sample set to obtain a PM2.5 concentration prediction model. The present invention can generate high-quality PM2.5 data expansion samples, improve the distribution balance of training sample data, and enhance the accuracy and reliability of PM2.5 pollution prediction.

title: Full-period monitoring and compliance verification platform and method for disinfection process of digestive endoscopes
description: This invention discloses a platform and method for full-cycle monitoring and compliance verification of the disinfection process in digestive endoscopy. It includes a data acquisition and preprocessing module for collecting and preprocessing real-time status and environmental data to generate a standardized dataset; a path optimization and decision-making module for simulating multiple operational paths of the disinfection process using a Monte Carlo tree search algorithm to select the optimal disinfection path; a compliance reasoning and verification module for reasoning about symbolic rules in the disinfection process; a blockchain evidence storage module for writing data blocks into a blockchain ledger to form a disinfection data chain; a smart contract processing module for real-time judgment, automatically triggering alarms and recording non-compliant operations; and a feedback and query module for querying, retrieving, and auditing information, alarm records, and compliance events throughout the entire disinfection process. This invention achieves intelligent optimization of the disinfection process, real-time compliance verification, and on-chain evidence storage, comprehensively improving the efficiency of safety supervision.

title: A nondestructive testing system and method for structural uniformity of composite bulletproof helmets
description: The invention discloses a nondestructive testing system and method for structural uniformity of a bulletproof helmet made of a composite material, and relates to the technical field of mechanical manufacturing of composite materials, wherein the nondestructive testing system comprises the steps of extracting path curvature in a topological graph of the helmet material structure, performing polynomial fitting by using a least square method to generate an optimized scanning track, converting the optimized scanning track into a mechanical arm control instruction, and driving an ultrasonic probe to scan the helmet structure in a multi-frequency focusing and incident angle deflection manner to obtain an original echo signal matrix; the invention realizes the quantitative analysis of the microscopic defect distribution and the communication characteristics in the composite material by constructing the topological graph of the helmet material structure and the acoustic physical nerve model, and improves the overall accuracy and reliability of nondestructive testing.

title: Industrial monitoring method, system, device and storage medium based on soft measurement model
description: The present invention relates to an industrial monitoring method, system, device and storage medium based on a soft measurement model, and belongs to the field of soft measurement technology. The present invention monitors quality variables in industrial processes by constructing a soft measurement model based on a multi-scale gated Transformer, and realizes the effective fusion of global and local features by designing a hierarchical feature fusion structure. First, the convolution operation is embedded in the attention mechanism to extract the multi-scale features of the data; secondly, the multi-scale feature weights are adaptively adjusted using the gated unit, and low-correlation or redundant features are eliminated through the sparse attention mechanism, thereby enhancing the feature extraction capability of the model in the case of data loss. The method is applied to the debutanizer industrial process to predict butane concentration. The results show that the present invention has higher prediction accuracy than the existing soft measurement industrial monitoring method. The present invention also provides an industrial monitoring system, device and storage medium based on the soft measurement model, which improves the convenience of industrial monitoring.

title: Real-time strip steel surface defect detection method
description: The invention relates to a real-time strip steel surface defect detection method which comprises the steps of S1, selecting NEU-DET as a surface defect detection data set, randomly dividing the data set into a training set and a testing set according to the proportion of 8:2, S2, preprocessing the surface defect detection data set, S3, constructing a defect detection model SteelGuard-YOLO based on YOLOv n, S4, training the defect detection model SteelGuard-YOLO through the training set, detecting the testing set by utilizing the trained defect detection model SteelGuard-YOLO, and outputting a detection result. The invention remarkably reduces the quantity of model parameters and the calculation complexity while maintaining excellent detection performance and high-speed reasoning capability, and can meet the severe requirements of the metal forging industry on an online detection system.

title: Automatic detection method, system, equipment and media for epileptic seizures based on electroencephalography (EEG).
description: This invention discloses an automatic method, system, device, and medium for detecting epileptic seizures based on electroencephalography (EEG). The method includes: preprocessing a user's one-dimensional EEG signal to obtain multiple EEG signal sequences; inputting these sequences into a pre-trained synchronous learning network to obtain classification results; and mapping the classification results back to the user's one-dimensional EEG signal to obtain the temporal localization result of the epileptic seizure. The synchronous learning network includes a multi-scale convolutional module, a feature extractor, a batch processing self-attention module, and a classification module. This invention fully utilizes intra- and inter-sample information through the multi-scale convolutional module and batch processing self-attention module in the synchronous learning network, improving the discriminative power of extracted features without requiring any additional data, exhibiting strong generalization and accurate localization results.

title: Method, apparatus, equipment and storage medium for identifying rock mass structural surfaces based on point cloud.
description: The invention provides a rock mass structural plane identification method, a device, equipment and a storage medium based on point cloud, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of processing intensive three-dimensional point cloud data of a rock mass to obtain processed three-dimensional point cloud data; the method comprises the steps of uniformly downsampling the processed three-dimensional point cloud data to obtain sampling processing point cloud data and non-sampling processing point cloud data, training a neural network model according to the sampling processing point cloud data to obtain a rock structural surface identification model, inputting the non-sampling processing point cloud data and the non-sampling processing point cloud data into the rock structural surface identification model to obtain a corresponding non-sampling processing point cloud tag set, and obtaining rock structural surface appearance according to the non-sampling processing point cloud tag set. The invention realizes the improvement of the recognition rate while ensuring the recognition precision of the rock mass structural plane.

title: A method and system for predicting the power generation of offshore wind farms based on big data.
description: This invention relates to the field of big data processing technology, and in particular to a method and system for predicting the power generation of offshore wind farms based on big data. The invention employs a data-physical hybrid-driven ultra-short-term power generation prediction model for offshore wind farm power generation prediction. This model includes a deep learning model, a physical model module, a reinforcement learning module, and a dynamic switching mechanism. The dynamic switching mechanism dynamically selects either the deep learning model module or the physical model module based on wind speed fluctuation thresholds and feedback from the reinforcement learning module. The model selection logic provided by this invention significantly improves prediction accuracy. Furthermore, by combining wind speed fluctuation thresholds and reinforcement learning feedback, the dynamic switching mechanism enhances the robustness and generalization ability of the prediction model.

title: A Parametric 3D Modeling Method for Shield Tunnels Based on Reinforcement Learning-Based Two-Layer Optimization
description: This invention discloses a parametric 3D modeling method for shield tunnels based on reinforcement learning-based two-layer optimization. The method includes: inputting planned route parameters through a global policy network and outputting segment design parameters; constructing a layout design space based on the segment design parameters and the planned route; outputting the position of the next ring of segments based on the layout space state through a sequential decision network; determining reward/penalty values by calculating the deviation between the segment axis and the designed route, and training the sequential decision layer network; iteratively completing the route layout and calculating the cumulative reward/penalty values; training the global parameter layer network based on the cumulative reward/penalty values and updating the global parameters; repeating the above process until convergence is achieved if convergence is not reached, ultimately obtaining optimized segment parameters and layout, and constructing a 3D model. This invention achieves two-layer optimization of segment design and layout, improving design efficiency and reducing route deviation.

title: Methods, devices, equipment, storage media, and software products for water pump fault monitoring
description: This application relates to a method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product for monitoring water pump faults. The method includes: acquiring sound signals generated during water pump operation; preprocessing the acquired sound signals to obtain preprocessed sound signals; extracting voiceprint features from the preprocessed sound signals to obtain first feature data; inputting the first feature data into a trained autoencoder neural network to output reconstructed second feature data; the trained autoencoder neural network reconstructs the input first feature data by pre-learning features from the feature data corresponding to the sound signals during normal water pump operation; thus, training can be performed using only data from normal water pump operation, reducing reliance on fault data. Based on the difference between the first and second feature data, it is determined whether a water pump fault has occurred. This enables early warning of water pump faults, improving water pump reliability and safety.

title: Perovskite film production data analysis method
description: This invention relates to the field of data processing technology, specifically to a method for analyzing perovskite thin film production data. The method includes: acquiring preprocessed historical data; acquiring the prior correlation of production batches and the differences in production data between stages within the production batch; based on the prior correlation of production batches and the differences in production data between stages within the production batch, acquiring the probability of joint influence of stages within the production batch; further acquiring the relative values and classification weights of stages; based on the classification weights of stages, acquiring combinations of stages with mutual influence; determining the strong influence combinations corresponding to stages based on the relative values of stages in the combinations of stages with mutual influence; and using the strong influence combinations corresponding to stages to analyze the production data to be analyzed, obtaining the analysis results. This invention analyzes production data in the perovskite thin film production process based on the mutual influence relationships of different production stages on production quality, improving the accuracy of the analysis results.

title: A Method and System for Predicting the Progression of Abdominal Aortic Aneurysms Based on Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation
description: This invention discloses a method and system for predicting the progression of abdominal aortic aneurysms based on cross-modal knowledge distillation. The method involves collecting blood samples from a target individual; detecting the concentration of blood protein fingerprint markers, including matrix metalloproteinase-12, calcitonin-related peptide-1, uroregulatory hormone, neuroinjury-inducing protein-1, glycated hemoglobin A1c, and fibroblast growth factor-9; and calculating the risk of abdominal aortic aneurysms using the cross-modal knowledge distillation framework Student-Net based on the blood protein fingerprint marker concentrations. The inputs to Teacher-Net include CTA image features and pathological slide features, and the output of Student-Net is a category probability vector.   Compared with the class probability vector output by Teacher-Net   Alignment; outputs the risk level of abdominal aortic aneurysm and the probability of occurrence, progression, and rupture of abdominal aortic aneurysm in a preset year. Provides accurate prediction of aortic aneurysm disease progression.

title: A Vision-Based Automatic Collection Method and System for Swimming Pool Leaves and Sediments
description: The embodiment of the invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and provides a swimming pool fallen leaves and sediment automatic collection method and system based on visual identification. The method comprises the steps of obtaining tree distribution conditions around a target swimming pool, dividing the target swimming pool into a plurality of swimming pool grid areas according to a swimming pool structure, combining current weather conditions and tree distribution conditions, predicting fallen leaf distribution conditions in a future preset period through a fallen leaf distribution prediction model of a space-time diagram neural network, obtaining multi-mode environment data and people flow state data around the target swimming pool, predicting sediment distribution conditions in the future preset period through a sediment prediction mixing model, generating an initial collection task of a target robot according to the fallen leaf distribution conditions and the sediment distribution conditions and aiming at a space structure of the target swimming pool, dynamically adjusting the initial collection task according to monitoring image data in a surrounding water area, so as to remove floating matters and sediment which temporarily appear in the surrounding water area, and improving the cleaning coverage rate and the cleaning efficiency of the swimming pool.

title: Rapid evaluation system for screening soil biocontrol bacteria that hinder fruit tree continuous cropping
description: This invention discloses a rapid evaluation system for screening biocontrol bacteria in soils with continuous cropping obstacles in fruit trees. The system includes gene screening, activity screening, and a field potency prediction model. The field potency prediction model comprises a feature engineering module, a multimodal fusion module, a bi-branch prediction module, a loss function, data augmentation, and interpretability analysis. This invention replaces traditional trial-and-error screening with a three-tiered system of "gene targeting → functional verification → intelligent prediction," achieving a 67% reduction in the screening cycle and a 30-fold increase in the yield of high-quality strains. It provides a highly efficient technological engine for controlling continuous cropping obstacles, and the field potency prediction is accurate and reliable, solving the problem of discrepancies between laboratory and field results. The screening cycle is shortened from the traditional 6 months to 8 weeks, and the field verification cost is reduced by 70%, significantly reducing both cost and time. This evaluation system is applicable to soils with continuous cropping obstacles in fruit trees such as apples and cherries.

title: A lung parenchyma segmentation method combining Weber-Fechner's law and semantic diffusion
description: The invention belongs to the field of image processing, and discloses a lung parenchyma segmentation method combining the Weber-Fisher law and semantic diffusion, which comprises the steps of processing an original three-dimensional CT image of a lung, cutting the image into a fixed size and randomly enhancing the image; training a lung parenchyma segmentation model combining the Webber's law and a semantic diffusion network by using the preprocessed image to obtain a lung parenchyma segmentation model, predicting a lung three-dimensional CT image by using the lung parenchyma segmentation model, and outputting a predicted segmentation result. The method is suitable for lung parenchyma segmentation based on the three-dimensional lung CT image, and can effectively and accurately segment lung parenchyma parts from the CT image. The model has excellent generalization and robustness, and can show excellent segmentation performance on a fibrillated lung image.

title: Power distribution network loop closing path optimization method and system comprehensively considering risk and benefit
description: The invention discloses a power distribution network loop closing path optimization method and system comprehensively considering risks and benefits, which comprises the steps of obtaining line data information of all loop closing paths, carrying out preliminary safety check through experience of an expert knowledge base to obtain a loop closing path candidate set, adopting a BP neural network to predict photovoltaic output and load probability distribution curves on lines, calculating static load fluctuation rate of loop closing time periods, taking photovoltaic absorption and load transfer into consideration to calculate benefits of the loop closing scheme in all time periods, constructing a priority index based on a Charpy ratio, balancing the loop closing risks and benefits, carrying out priority sorting on the loop closing paths candidate based on the index, and selecting the loop closing path with the highest priority as a final decision scheme. The method solves the problems that the traditional loop closing decision is often dependent on experience, quantitative evaluation of loop closing risk is lacked, and loop closing benefit is not considered, so that the selection of a loop closing path is more reasonable and economical.

title: A method and system for modeling environmental noise of low-altitude aircraft
description: This invention relates to the field of noise modeling technology, and more particularly to a method and system for modeling environmental noise of low-altitude aircraft. The method involves reprojecting the sound source directivity data of the low-altitude aircraft at different locations in a spherical coordinate system onto a hemispherical surface, converting it into a sound source directivity tensor. Environmental terrain information and building geometry information are converted into a terrain layout tensor. The high-level features of the sound source directivity tensor, the high-level features of the terrain layout tensor, the frequency characteristics of the low-altitude aircraft at the current moment, and the flight altitude characteristics of the low-altitude aircraft at the current moment are fused to obtain the multimodal latent features at the current moment. These multimodal latent features are then input into a diffusion model, outputting a noise intensity map of the low-altitude aircraft at the current moment. This invention can accurately capture and fuse complex multimodal conditions such as the noise source characteristics, terrain layout, and flight altitude of low-altitude aircraft, effectively improving the efficiency, accuracy, and generalization ability of noise modeling.

title: A method and apparatus for constructing a multimodal database based on visual language model-based collaborative routing.
description: This specification provides a method and apparatus for constructing a multimodal database based on visual language model-based collaborative routing. The method includes: parsing raw document data to obtain multimodal element data and determining the element structure information corresponding to the multimodal element data; arranging the multimodal element data based on the element structure information to obtain target document data; segmenting the target document data to obtain a structured dataset and determining target key data based on the structured data in the structured dataset; and constructing a multimodal database based on the target key data, wherein the multimodal database is used for data retrieval. This achieves efficient processing of multimodal unstructured data, improves database construction efficiency, and simultaneously reduces retrieval time and improves retrieval efficiency when performing data retrieval based on the multimodal database.

title: Controllable generation system based on component syntactic logic level constraint
description: This invention provides a controllable generation system based on constituent syntactic logic hierarchy constraints, applied in the field of controllable text generation technology. The controllable generation system includes a large model fine-tuning module, which comprises a training phrase extraction submodule, a training logic chain generation submodule, and a fine-tuning submodule. The training phrase extraction submodule extracts phrases from the training input text to obtain a training phrase sequence and a training label sequence. The training phrase sequence includes multiple training phrases, and the training label sequence includes training labels corresponding to each of the multiple training phrases. The training logic chain generation submodule generates a training logic chain based on the training phrase sequence and the training label sequence. The fine-tuning submodule fine-tunes the large language model using training reference text constructed based on prompt information and the training logic chain, resulting in a controllable text generation large model.

title: A method for early warning detection of hazardous waste packaging integrity
description: This invention relates to the field of image data processing technology, and more particularly to a method for detecting and warning of the integrity of hazardous waste packaging. The method includes: acquiring multispectral image data of the surface of hazardous waste packaging containers and preprocessing it to obtain reflectance spectral data; filtering the reflectance spectral data to locate suspicious areas; using non-negative matrix factorization to perform spectral unmixing on the reflectance multispectral data of the suspicious areas to obtain an abundance map containing endmembers of the leaked material and container background; extracting the abundance map of the leaked material endmembers and calculating its risk quantification index to form time-series data reflecting the development of leakage; inputting the time-series data into a long short-term memory network model for prediction to obtain the future trend of the risk quantification index; and generating a warning signal based on the future trend. This invention incorporates prior knowledge of the physics of leakage into the algorithm model, solving the problems of inaccurate identification of early, weak leakage and high false alarm rate in traditional methods.

title: Super-resolution binocular image generation method and system based on geometric structure consistency
description: The invention provides a super-resolution binocular image generation method and system based on geometric structure consistency, comprising the steps of adopting a convolutional neural network or a transducer model to extract deep features of low-resolution binocular images, combining a cross attention module to realize left-right image information interaction, and constructing a pixel incidence matrix of left-right images; the method comprises the steps of obtaining pixel correspondence of left and right images by using a pixel incidence matrix, constructing a continuous parallax field, carrying out space warping on deep features based on the continuous parallax field to obtain warped features, aligning the deep features of the left and right images, merging the deep features and the warped features after space alignment, inputting the merged deep features and the warped features into a feature up-sampling module based on implicit two-dimensional expression, and outputting high-resolution binocular images of the same scene. The invention provides a binocular image super-resolution technology comprising binocular image feature extraction, continuous parallax field construction based on implicit two-dimensional expression, left and right image feature space alignment and feature up-sampling based on implicit two-dimensional expression.

title: A Vectorized Chinese Character Image Generation Method Based on a Large Model
description: The invention belongs to the field of computer vision and vectorization image generation, and particularly relates to a vectorization Chinese character graph generation method based on a large model. The method comprises the following steps of preprocessing data, extracting stroke characteristics, discretizing and coding characteristic vectors, combining stroke sequences, predicting characteristic codes, restoring characteristics, and restoring strokes. The method combines the Chinese character stroke order information, can generate continuous Chinese character vectorization text content rich in semantics by continuously predicting the next character stroke on the basis of being capable of complementing Chinese character strokes to generate a complete vectorization image, can complement missing fonts under the condition of incomplete font library, realizes creative vectorization Chinese character text generation, contributes to the fields of artistic fonts generation, chinese character font auxiliary design, advertisement text design and the like, reduces labor cost and realizes efficient generation.

title: Image recognition system based on FPGA driving dynamic focal plane and memristor
description: The invention discloses an image recognition system based on an FPGA driving dynamic focal plane and a memristor, which comprises a photoelectric sensing and front-end convolution detection array, an analog calculation type memristor array, a signal driving and access control unit and an analog calculation reading and sampling processing unit; the system architecture enables a convolution layer and a full connection layer with the largest calculated amount in a neural network to be accelerated and executed by the most suitable external hardware through the mode of unified scheduling of the FPGA and sharing of calculation tasks by heterogeneous hardware, fully exerts the high-parallelism computation advantage of convolution of a photoelectric sensing array on a first layer and the high-energy efficiency advantage of large-scale matrix operation of a memristor matrix in an analog domain, and simultaneously remarkably reduces the occupation and energy consumption of hardware resources of the system through multiplexing of a driving circuit and a signal processing link, and realizes high-performance and low-power consumption intelligent image recognition under an edge calculation scene.

title: Deep learning-based text semantic segmentation method for Chinese electronic medical records
description: The invention discloses a Chinese electronic medical record text semantic segmentation method based on deep learning, which mainly comprises semantic dictionary construction, text semantic feature vector representation, integral feature fusion, deep neural network training and prediction optimization. And representing text context semantic features by using a pre-training language model, adding character semantic position features, and inputting the integrated features into a deep neural network for model training. Compared with the existing semantic segmentation technology, the method has the advantages that global context semantic features are fused among characters, semantic category characteristics of each character of a sequence are captured and learned, and finally, the best semantic category label of each character is found, so that fine text semantic segmentation is realized, higher accuracy of text semantic segmentation is realized under the condition that a data set is smaller, and a new method for EMR text semantic segmentation is developed.

title: Fireworks false detection removal method, device, equipment and medium
description: The application discloses a smoke and fire false detection method, device, equipment and medium, which comprise the steps of extracting a preset number of frame images from video stream data, detecting the last frame image by using a preset target detection algorithm to obtain a target rectangular frame, acquiring vertex coordinates and center point coordinates based on the target rectangular frame, calculating coordinate positions of corresponding points in the rest number of frame images by using an optical flow method based on the vertex coordinates and the center point coordinates to obtain first track images corresponding to the vertex and the center point respectively, mapping the first track images to a target drawing board according to a preset proportional relation to obtain second track images, judging whether motion tracks of the corresponding coordinate points are regular or not based on the first track images and the second track images, determining the number of coordinate points of the motion track rule in the vertex and the center point, and judging whether false detection exists in the current detection by using a preset judgment rule based on the number of the coordinate points. False detection caused by similar light sources is avoided.

title: Training method and system for convolutional neural network
description: A computer-implemented method of training a convolutional neural network is provided, including receiving first data and second data, the second data being data resulting from a stylization of the first data, and training the convolutional neural network based on the first data and the second data, the convolutional neural network having a first normalization layer for the first data and a second normalization layer for the second data. The convolutional neural network trained by the method not only enhances the robustness but also enhances the accuracy on the basis of overcoming the bias of textures.

title: Substance characteristic prediction method, terminal and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a method, terminal and storage medium for predicting the properties of a substance, the method comprising: obtaining a target graph corresponding to the molecular structure of a target substance, obtaining target information according to the target graph; inputting the target information into a trained neural network, processing the target information, and outputting a property prediction result of the target substance. The present invention can provide auxiliary decision-making for the study of the properties of a substance and shorten the time for the study of drug properties by converting the molecular structure of the substance into a corresponding graph and then predicting the properties of the target substance through a trained neural network.

title: Method and system for executing discriminating processing of printing medium by machine learning model
description: The present disclosure provides a method and system for performing a discrimination process of print media using a machine learning model, and provides a technique capable of discriminating print media having similar optical characteristics from each other. The method for executing the discrimination processing of the printing medium comprises the following steps: a step (a) of preparing N machine learning models when N is an integer of 1 or more; a step (b) of acquiring target spectroscopic data of a spectroscopic reflectance of a target printing medium; and (c) performing a classification process of the target spectroscopic data by using the N machine learning models, thereby discriminating the type of the target printing medium.

title: Railway train wheel set surface defect detection method based on deep learning
description: The present invention discloses a method for detecting surface defects of railway wheelsets based on deep learning, comprising the following steps: (1) collecting images of the surface of a train wheel set by a train wheel set surface defect detection system; (2) annotating the collected surface images, expanding the train wheel set images by data enhancement, and dividing the enhanced image data set into a training set, a validation set, and a test set; (3) establishing a train wheel set surface defect detection model based on deep learning, inputting the training set and the validation set into the train wheel set surface defect detection model in batches for training, and obtaining a trained train wheel set surface defect detection model; (4) inputting the test data set into the trained train wheel set surface defect detection model, and obtaining the shape and position of the defect in the test set image. The present invention extracts defect feature information in the sample by learning the sample image, avoids missing the detection of subtle defects in the defect image, and improves the detection accuracy and detection speed.

title: Method and device for extracting sensing and response relation of fish to water flow form
description: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental protection of water conservancy and hydropower engineering, in particular to a method and a device for extracting a fish sensing and responding relationship to water flow form. The method comprises the following steps: step S1, according to different lengths of target fish, setting cylinders, blocks or partition plates with different sizes as barriers, and manufacturing various water flow forms possibly encountered by swimming of the fish body in a water tank; s2, recording pressure data measured by the target fish in the swimming process through the flexible film pressure sensors distributed on the surface of the fish; s3, establishing an artificial neural network model of the motion parameters of the target fish and the measured pressure data by a machine learning method; and S4, predicting fish motion parameters in a new flow field environment by using the artificial neural network model established in the step S3, and continuously updating and iterating by using new measured data to perfect the artificial neural network model.

title: Task allocation method considering task delay and server cost in mobile edge computing network
description: The present invention relates to a task allocation method considering task delay and server cost in a mobile edge computing network, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining network configuration information of a system model; S2, generating a task set, obtaining the calculation, transmission delay and server execution cost of the task set; S3, randomly initializing and generating an initial particle swarm of the task set; S4, constructing a fitness evaluation function according to the total cost of the calculation delay, the transmission delay and the server execution cost; S5, using a multi-objective gravitational search algorithm, introducing a convergence factor to update particle speed and position; S6, using a crossover mutation method to replace the position information of particles; S7, looping and iterating steps S5-S6 to obtain the task allocation strategy with the minimum total cost. The method of the present invention proposes a multi-objective gravitational search algorithm method to minimize the user task execution delay and server calculation cost.

title: In-situ identification method and device for corrosion of metal substrate and aging of coating
description: The invention provides an in-situ identification method and device for corrosion of a metal substrate and aging of a coating. The method comprises the following steps: segmenting the damage image according to a preset target image segmentation model to obtain a plurality of segmentation sub-images; determining prior frame sizes and category information of prior frames of a plurality of segmented sub-images; constructing an initial substrate corrosion identification model and an initial coating aging identification model, and training the models based on segmentation subimages, prior frame sizes and category information to obtain a target substrate corrosion identification model and a target coating aging identification model; acquiring an image to be recognized on the surface of a metal, and inputting the image to be recognized into a target image segmentation model to obtain a plurality of sub-images to be recognized; and identifying a plurality of subimages to be identified respectively based on the target matrix corrosion identification model and the target coating aging identification model to obtain a matrix corrosion identification result and a coating aging identification result. The invention can improve the identification precision for identifying the corrosion of the metal matrix and the aging of the coating.

title: Instance division method, related device and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application provides an instance segmentation method, a related device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring N frames of video images in a target video, wherein each frame of video image comprises one or more examples, and N is an integer greater than 1; acquiring image characteristics of each frame of video image and corresponding time domain memory characteristics of each frame of video image, wherein the time domain memory characteristics are used for indicating the memory image characteristics of the video image in the time domain; performing time domain shift processing on the time domain memory characteristics corresponding to each frame of video image to obtain memory shift characteristics corresponding to each frame of video image; based on the image characteristics and the corresponding memory shift characteristics of each frame of video image, the N frames of video images are subjected to instance segmentation to obtain instances included in each frame of video image, and accuracy of video instance segmentation can be improved.

title: Super-joint and multi-mode network and behavior recognition method thereof
description: The present invention relates to the field of neural network technology, and in particular to a super-joint and multimodal network and a behavior recognition method thereof, comprising: collecting a human body depth map, extracting features from the depth map using a DMMS stream, and calculating a depth data prediction score; collecting a human body skeleton sequence, extracting original joint and super-joint data respectively, combining super-joints and common joints to construct skeleton information, and sending it into a structured spatiotemporal feature learning model to obtain static and dynamic joint data streams, static and dynamic super-joint data streams, and adaptively weighting the original joint and super-joint data streams to obtain joint data prediction scores and super-joint prediction scores respectively; adding the classification prediction scores of the DMMS stream and the skeleton stream to generate a final prediction score. The present invention learns the rich texture information of human body parts in space from the depth map, and learns the rich spatiotemporal features in the changes of motion postures from the skeleton sequence.

title: Method, apparatus, device and medium for managing machine learning system
description: According to implementations of the present disclosure, methods, apparatuses, devices, and media for managing a machine learning system are provided. In one method, a query request is received from a user of a machine learning system via an instant messaging application, the query request being expressed in natural language and the query request being received from a user account in the instant messaging application corresponding to the user. A determination is made as to whether a query target specified by the query request is associated with a service provided by the machine learning system. In response to determining that the query target is associated with a service provided by the machine learning system, a state of the service is obtained based on a log of the machine learning system. The status of the service is provided to the user account via the instant messaging application. In this way, the instant messaging application may act as an interface between the user and the machine learning system, automatically supporting the user to query for information of services in the machine learning system without human intervention.

title: Method for establishing lightweight multi-exit point model based on neural architecture search
description: The present invention discloses a method for establishing a lightweight multi-exit point model based on neural architecture search, comprising the following steps: collecting power grid image data to construct a sample data set, dividing the sample data set into a training set and a test set; designing a multi-exit point model architecture including a backbone network and a branch classifier based on a tree structure; constructing a search space by trimming and recombining several convolutional neural networks, establishing an objective function based on an image classification task with a trade-off between model classification accuracy and model size as the goal; inputting the training set into the search space, optimizing the objective function using a policy gradient reinforcement learning algorithm, and training based on the multi-exit point model architecture to obtain a multi-exit point model. The present invention can well balance the accuracy and parameter size of the searched neural network, and realize the compression of the image classification model on the edge side of the power.

title: A video behavior recognition method based on high-order modeling
description: The invention discloses a video behavior recognition method based on high-order modeling, comprising: inserting a correlation module at different stages of a 2D convolutional neural network, performing an iterative matrix square root normalized covariance pooling operation on the end of the network to obtain a high-order correlation network; obtaining a video data set and a label, and dividing the video data set into a training set and a test set; inputting all frames into the high-order correlation network; using the training set to train the high-order correlation network, updating network parameters in each iteration, training and verifying frames in each iteration, and saving the optimal weight of the high-order correlation network according to the optimal verification set accuracy; initializing the high-order correlation network using the optimal weight, evaluating the accuracy of the network on a test set, inputting the test set data into the network to obtain a test result, comparing the test result with the label data, and counting the number of correct and incorrect answers to calculate the accuracy of the network on the test set.

title: Architecture, method and device of dynamic resource allocation type neural network chip
description: The embodiments of the present application disclose a framework, method and device of a dynamic resource allocation type neural network chip, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The framework of the resource dynamic allocation type neural network chip includes: a data input buffer module, a data output buffer module, an on-chip resource optimization module and an on-chip resource allocation module. The framework of the resource dynamic allocation type neural network chip is provided with an on-chip resource optimization module. Therefore, the time array under different resource configuration modes can be obtained according to the neural network configuration parameters. Since the time array can reflect the operating efficiency under different resource configuration modes, the target resource configuration mode can be determined according to the time array to be the optimal resource. Configuration mode, data processing according to the target resource configuration mode can naturally improve the data processing efficiency of the chip.

title: Image noise reduction method and device, electronic equipment and medium
description: This application provides an image denoising method, apparatus, electronic device, and medium. The method acquires myelin water image data of human brain tissue based on a preset multi-echo gradient echo sequence and calculates amplitude image data acquired at each echo time point. Based on the noise value in the amplitude image data acquired at the last echo time point and the amplitude of the amplitude image data corresponding to the first echo time point, a first noise level metric of the multi-echo gradient echo sequence is determined. Based on the error value between the first and second noise level metric values, a corresponding second noise level metric is obtained. The amplitude image data at each echo time point is processed through a preset denoising convolutional neural network to obtain the noise value of the amplitude image data at each echo time point, thereby denoising the amplitude image data acquired at the corresponding echo time points and obtaining noise-free amplitude image data at each echo time point, improving the denoising effect.

title: Key point detection method and equipment
description: An image-based keypoint detection method using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). When keypoints are obscured in an image, images obtained from additional imaging modes such as depth and/or thermal images may be used in conjunction with RGB images to reduce or minimize the effects of the obscuring. Images of other modalities may be used to determine adjustment parameters, which are then applied to the weights of the CNN so that convolution operations may be performed in a mode-aware manner to improve the robustness, accuracy, and efficiency of keypoint detection.

title: Air conditioner and control method thereof
description: The invention discloses an air conditioner and a control method thereof, wherein the air conditioner comprises a human body temperature detection device, an indoor temperature detection device and a controller, wherein the human body temperature detection device is used for detecting the face temperature and the hand temperature of a target user; the indoor temperature detection device is used for detecting indoor environment temperature; the controller is configured to: the method comprises the steps of obtaining the face average temperature of the face temperature, inputting the face average temperature, the hand temperature and the indoor environment temperature into a user individual temperature cold sense decision tree model, determining the temperature cold sense state of a target user according to the output value of the user individual temperature cold sense decision tree model, adjusting the current set target temperature according to the temperature cold sense state, and controlling the air conditioner to operate according to the adjusted target temperature, wherein at least eight temperature decision condition sets configured in the user individual temperature cold sense decision tree model form a plurality of temperature decision branches. The air conditioner and the control method thereof can meet the comfort requirement of individual users and improve the comfort of the air conditioner.

title: Radar target recognition method based on neural network and SVM
description: The present invention relates to a radar target recognition method based on neural network and SVM, and belongs to the technical field of radar target recognition. The method comprises: acquiring radar echo data; performing clutter suppression processing on the radar echo data; performing wavelet packet decomposition on the clutter suppressed data to obtain energy density features; classifying the energy density features according to the speed of the target and the signal-to-noise ratio interval of signal accumulation; inputting the classified energy density features into the neural network of the corresponding interval, and converting the output results into label distance features; extracting frequency domain entropy and relative RCS features using the spectrum of the radar echo; extracting time domain waveform variance features using the time domain signal of the radar echo; combining the label distance with the frequency domain entropy, relative RCS features, and time domain waveform variance into a feature vector and inputting it into the SVM classifier; and determining the recognition result according to the output value of the SVM.

title: Image processing method and device
description: The present application discloses an image processing method and device. The method is used in an image processing model. First, a first convolutional neural network in the image processing model is used to extract a reflection component and an illumination component from the initial image information. Then, a second convolutional neural network in the image processing model is used to synthesize the reflection component and the illumination component into intermediate image information, thereby completing the illumination enhancement processing of the initial image. Then, a third convolutional neural network in the image processing model is used to extract intermediate image features from the intermediate image information. Then, an upsampling layer in the image processing model is used to amplify the intermediate image features. Finally, a fourth convolutional neural network in the image processing model is used to perform resolution enhancement processing on the amplified intermediate image features to obtain an illumination and resolution enhanced image. The image processing method provided in the embodiment of the present application can improve the image illumination while improving the image resolution and avoiding image color distortion and information loss.

title: CCMVS region carbon source sink equalization inversion method
description: The invention discloses a CCMVS region carbon source sink equalization inversion evaluation system, which comprises a multi-source CO  2  Acquisition and pretreatment of concentration observation data, natural carbon flux online optimization, efficient mixed assimilation new algorithm and atmospheric multi-source CO  2  Artificial carbon flux and CO for concentration observation  2  Concentration initial field assimilation inversion; multisource CO  2  Comprising high-precision foundation, carbon satellite and CO obtained by machine learning  2  Concentration observation data; the CCMVS region carbon source sink equalization inversion evaluation system disclosed by the invention improves the calculation efficiency of the region carbon assimilation system under huge dimension characteristics; the inversion precision of regional carbon source sink is improved by synchronous inversion of artificial carbon emission and natural carbon exchange; building high-efficiency and high-resolution area CO in national range of China  2  And the assimilation inversion system is beneficial to promoting practical application.

title: Input vocabulary completion method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the field of text prediction, and discloses an input vocabulary completion method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method includes: receiving vocabulary input by a user, analyzing the position of the vocabulary in the input text, and obtaining a position vector; performing retrieval processing on the vocabulary according to a preset vocabulary mapping matrix, and obtaining a vocabulary vector; according to a preset weight mixing algorithm, converting the position vector Perform weight superposition processing with the vocabulary vector to obtain the weight feature vector; perform row-by-row convolution processing on the weight feature vector and the vocabulary mapping matrix to obtain the vocabulary prediction probability distribution; filter out the preset sorting quantity from the vocabulary prediction probability distribution according to the probability value The corresponding vocabulary is obtained to complete the vocabulary set.

title: A collaborative attention fusion-based aspect-level multimodal sentiment analysis method
description: The invention provides an aspect-level multi-modal emotion analysis method based on a global-local feature fusion network of collaborative attention, which comprises the following steps of 1) obtaining a left text context representation, a right text context representation, an aspect aggregation representation and an image local representation, 2) generating an aspect-guided global text feature representation and an aspect-guided global image feature representation, 3) constructing a cross-modal feature interaction mechanism to simultaneously generate a local text feature representation fused with vision and a local visual feature representation fused with text, 4) constructing a gating multi-modal fusion mechanism, and 5) obtaining emotion polarity prediction results. The method has the advantages that the performance is improved in the aspect-level multi-modal emotion analysis task, and the global semantic association in the modes and the local semantic alignment among the modes can be effectively captured.

title: A method for detecting Agaricus bisporus under occlusion conditions
description: This invention discloses a method for detecting button mushrooms under occlusion conditions. It mainly includes the calibration of a freely rotating trinocular camera, image preprocessing, and target detection. The trinocular camera calibration involves obtaining the camera's internal parameters, external parameters, inter-camera parameters, and the pose parameters of the rotating camera. Image preprocessing primarily involves enhancing and matching the acquired images, extracting the unoccluded contours, and using a combination of least squares and Newton's interpolation to linearly fit the used contours, maximizing the reconstruction of the button mushroom's contour. Target detection mainly involves numerically integrating the area of the irregular elliptical contour of the button mushroom and comparing it with the harvestable area value. Compared with existing technologies, the linear fitting used in this invention overcomes the unreasonable phenomenon of fitting extrema not being in the integer range, improving the degree of contour reconstruction and the accuracy of target detection, making it suitable for button mushroom harvesting systems.

title: Magnetic flux regulating structure, testing device and testing method
description: The present application discloses a magnetic flux control structure, a test device and a test method, and belongs to the field of quantum computing technology. The magnetic flux control structure provided by the present application can form a magnetic field applied to a quantum chip using a coil formed on a substrate, thereby regulating the magnetic flux of a SQUID, solving the problem that the quantum chip cannot be tested when the frequency control line of the quantum chip is abnormal. The test method provided by the present application places the magnetic flux control structure face to face with the quantum chip, and passes a current through the coil, then collects the scattering parameters corresponding to the current, and then determines the test result of the quantum chip based on the scattering parameters, that is, the magnetic field formed on the substrate can be used to apply to the quantum chip to regulate the magnetic flux of the SQUID, and then the quantum chip is tested, thereby solving the problem that the quantum chip cannot be tested when the frequency control line of the quantum chip is abnormal.

title: Blood vessel registration method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a blood vessel registration method, device, electronic device, and storage medium. The method includes: respectively obtaining a first blood vessel centerline image corresponding to a first blood vessel image to be registered and a second blood vessel centerline image corresponding to a second blood vessel image to be registered; determining a reconstructed projection image corresponding to the first blood vessel image to be registered, inputting the reconstructed projection image and the second blood vessel image to be registered into a pre-trained key point tracking model to obtain segmented key points; segmenting the first blood vessel centerline image and the second blood vessel centerline image based on the segmented key points to obtain a first segmented centerline image and a second segmented centerline image; and determining a blood vessel registration image based on the first segmented centerline image and the second segmented centerline image. The above technical solution predicts segmented key points through a key point tracking model, and then performs blood vessel segmentation based on the segmented key points with improved accuracy, and then performs registration, thereby improving registration accuracy.

title: Impedance matching circuit, testing device and quantum computer
description: The application belongs to the field of quanta, and discloses an impedance matching circuit which is used for a test circuit of a semiconductor quanta processor and is characterized by comprising a first resistor, a first inductor and a first capacitance adjusting unit which are connected through a first end; the second end of the first inductor is used for receiving a measurement signal and outputting a measurement feedback signal, and the measurement feedback signal is a feedback signal output by the semiconductor quantum processor based on the measurement signal; the second end of the first capacitance adjusting unit is used for receiving a first direct current signal, and the first direct current signal is used for adjusting the capacitance value of the first capacitance adjusting unit; the second end of the first resistor is grounded, and the first resistor is an equivalent resistor of the semiconductor quantum processor. The application improves the impedance matching degree among the semiconductor quantum processor, the test circuit and the signal source, thereby improving the measurement sensitivity of the spin quantum bit integrated on the semiconductor quantum processor.

title: Air pollution early warning method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention is applicable to the technical field of pollutant monitoring, and provides an air pollution early warning method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining the air pollution detection results of each micro-station in the target area; When an air pollution event occurs, the current wind direction of the target area is obtained, and the probability of air pollution events occurring at each standard monitoring station associated with the micro-station is queried from the preset association rule probability library; according to the queried current The probability of air pollution events occurring at each standard monitoring site associated with the micro-station in the downwind direction, and air pollution early warning is given to each standard monitoring site. The invention can predict and warn the impending pollution of the standard monitoring site.

title: Deep reinforcement learning robot navigation method based on attention mechanism
description: The present invention discloses a deep reinforcement learning robot navigation method based on an attention mechanism, including: collecting robot vehicle-mounted camera information, vehicle-mounted single-line laser radar information, and the robot's linear velocity and angular velocity; fusing camera information and single-line laser radar information data; constructing an experience pool of a SAC deep reinforcement learning algorithm for storing action-state-reward combinations; constructing an Actor network, a V critic network, and a Q critic network of the SAC deep reinforcement learning algorithm; constructing a spatial attention module and a temporal attention module in the Actor network; and constructing a reward function model. The input of the Actor network is a state, and the output is an action probability distribution parameter; the output of the V critic network is a predicted value of a state value; and the output of the Q critic network is a predicted value of an action-state value. The navigation method of the present invention does not require prior map information and the limitations of the navigation environment, and has wide applicability and strong scalability.

title: Statistical data learning under privacy constraints
description: A computer-implemented method is provided for statistical data learning under privacy constraints. The method includes: receiving, by a processor, a plurality of pieces of statistical information relating to a statistical object and aggregating, by the processor, the plurality of pieces of statistical information so as to provide an estimation of the statistical object. Each piece of statistical information includes an uncertainty variable, the uncertainty variable being a value determined from a function having a predetermined mean. The number of pieces of statistical information aggregated is proportional to the reliability of the estimation of the statistical object.

title: Collaborative learning for efficient behavioral analysis in networked mobile device
description: Methods, systems and devices for classifying mobile device behaviors of a first mobile device may include the first mobile device monitoring mobile device behaviors to generate a behavior vector, and applying the behavior vector to a first classifier model to obtain a first determination of whether a mobile device behavior is benign or not benign. The first mobile device may also send the behavior vector to a second mobile device, which may receive and apply the behavior vector to a second classifier model to obtain a second determination of whether the mobile device behavior is benign or not benign. The second mobile device may send the second determination to the first mobile device, which may receive the second determination, collate the first determination and the second determination to generate collated results, and determine whether the mobile device behavior is benign or not benign based on the collated results.

title: System, method and apparatus for assisting a determination of medical images
description: A quantization system (700) includes: at least one input (710) configured to provide two input medical images and two locations of interest in said input medical images that correspond to the same anatomical region ; and a mapping circuit (725) adapted to calculate a direct quantization of change of said input medical images from said input (710).

title: Systems and methods for generating hash trees and using neural networks to process the same
description: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for detecting and detecting anomalies within a tree structure. In one implementation, the system may include one or more memories storing instructions and one or more processors configured to execute the instructions. The instructions may include instructions to receive a new data structure related to an individual, convert the data structure into a Bayesian wavelet, using a tree structure of existing Bayesian wavelets, calculate one or more harmonics, determine a measure of whether the Bayesian wavelet alters the one or more harmonics, and add the Bayesian wavelet to the tree structure when the measure is below a threshold.

title: Artificial intelligence channel for industrial automation
description: An industrial data broker system receives contextualized industrial data from one or more industrial devices that support data modeling at the device level. The received industrial data is augmented with contextualization metadata that defines correlations between the data relevant to an analytical objective, and labels specifying analytic topics to which each data item is relevant. The broker system allows external systems, such as analytic systems, to subscribe to topics of interest, and streams a subset of contextualized device data relevant to the topic of interest to the external system for analysis.

title: Method of and apparatus for processing data of a deep neural network
description: A computer-implemented method of processing data of a deep neural network, DNN, system, said DNN system comprising DNN topology information characterizing a structure of a deep neural network, DNN, and computing device information characterizing properties and/or a topology of at least one computing device for executing instructions associated with said DNN, said method comprising: providing said DNN topology information, providing said computing device information, determining a virtual hardware model based on said DNN topology information and said computing device information, wherein said virtual hardware model characterizes computational resources for executing at least some of said instructions associated with said DNN using said at least one computing device, said computational resources comprising at least one of: a) processing time, b) memory bandwidth, c) memory.

title: Swarm control apparatus and method using dynamic rule-based blockchain
description: Provided are a swarm control apparatus and an operating method thereof. In particular, a swarm control method, performed by the swarm control apparatus, includes: generating a first rule related to the swarm, based on an attribute of at least one node from among a plurality of nodes; sharing the generated first rule with the at least one node; forming the swarm including the at least one node, based on the shared first rule; detecting a change in the at least one node in the swarm; and changing the first rule to a second rule, based on the detected change.

title: Analytics dashboards for critical event management software systems, and related software
description: Analytics dashboards for critical event management systems that include artificial-intelligence (AI) functionalities, and related software. AI functionalities disclosed include pattern recognition and predictive modelling. One or more pattern-recognition algorithms can be used, for example, to identified patterns or other groupings within stored critical events, which can then be used to improve response performance and/or to inform the generation of predictive models. One or more predictive-modeling algorithms can be used to generate one or more predictive models that can then be used, for example, to make predictions about newly arriving critical events that can then be used, among other things, to provide optimal response performance and allow users to efficiently and effectively manage responses critical events. These and other features are described in detail.

title: System and method for collecting, analyzing and sharing biorhythm data among users
description: Disclosed is a system and method to collect, analyze and share biorhythm data among a plurality of users. The method includes the step of collecting biorhythm data of the user through a wearable user device. The method includes the step of receiving the biorhythm data of the users through a computing device communicatively connected with the wearable user device over the communication network and the step of facilitating the users to access the biorhythm data through a synchronization module. The method includes the step of establishing an interaction with the users over the communication network through an artificial intelligence (AI) based agent module. The method includes the step of analyzing and displaying emotional data of the users in real-time through an emotional data displaying module. The method includes the step of modulating biorhythms of the users based on the feedback emitted from the computing device through a feedback module.

title: Personalization of content suggestions for document creation
description: The present disclosure relates to processing operations that generate and present personalized content suggestions to assist a user with document creation. Machine learning modeling may be trained and implemented to evolve pre-canned suggestions for document creation into highly personalized content suggestions, thereby improving the document creation process and user interface experience for users of applications/services that are utilized to create digital documents. As an example, signal data may be detected and analyzed, identifying a specific user's intent to create a digital document. Machine learning modeling may be implemented to evaluate different aspects of collected signal data and identify content from previously created documents, associated with a user account, that may be most relevant to the real-time document creation experience of the user. Personalized contextual suggestions may be presented to a user through a user interface. Examples described herein may be extensible across any type of application/service configured for document creation.
