title: Avatar facial expression generating system and method of avatar facial expression generation
description: An avatar facial expression generating system (100) and a method of avatar facial expression generation are provided. In the method, multiple user data are obtained and related to the sensing result of a user from multiple data sources. Multiple first emotion decisions are determined, respectively, based on each user data. Whether an emotion collision occurs among the first emotion decisions is determined. The emotion collision is related that the corresponding emotion groups (401, 402) of the first emotion decisions are not matched with each other. A second emotion decision is determined from one or more emotion groups (401, 402) according to the determining result of the emotion collision. The first or second emotion decision is related to one emotion group (401, 402). A facial expression of an avatar is generated based on the second emotion decision. Accordingly, a proper facial expression of the avatar could be presented.

title: Estimator generation device, monitoring device, estimator generation method, estimator generation program
description: A technique allows generation of an estimator that can estimate a target person's state more accurately. An estimator generation apparatus includes a first estimator and a second estimator sharing a common encoder. The first estimator is trained to determine a target person's state from face image data. The second estimator is trained to reconstruct physiological data from face image data. The machine learning allows the common encoder to have its parameters converging toward higher-accuracy local solutions for estimating the target person's state, thus generating the estimator that can estimate the target person's state more accurately.

title: Data processing method and apparatus, electronic device, storage medium and program product
description: The present disclosure provides a data processing method and apparatus, an electronic device, a computer storage medium and a program product, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence such as deep learning and big data. The method includes: extracting, in submission information of a current test task, a first sub-directory in which a dependent package required for constructing a model is located; and obtaining the dependent package from a local storage module, in a case where the first sub-directory is as same as a second sub-directory in submission information for a historical test task. Embodiments of the present disclosure can increase efficiency of acquiring the dependent package and further increase execution efficiency of a process for constructing models according to the dependent package.

title: Method and system for detecting connection fault of parallel connection cells
description: The present invention relates to a method and system for detecting connection failure of a parallel connection cell, and for a battery that is being discharged by the operation of an external device (e.g. vehicle), by detecting whether there is a section matching the amount of change in the discharge voltage value when a cell connection failure condition occurs due to a pre-prepared CID operation or an open parallel connection line from the change in the discharge voltage value of the battery being discharged, a cell connection failure due to a CID operation of a corresponding battery or an open parallel connection line may be detected.

title: Ambiguating and disambiguating data collected for machine learning
description: A method and privacy protection system for ambiguating and disambiguating data collected for machine learning. The method comprising receiving data from an endpoint, the data including identifying information for the endpoint and non-identifying information; obfuscating the identifying information in the received data to generate obfuscated data including the non-identifying information and obfuscated identifying information; transmitting the obfuscated data to one or more machine learning providers; receiving an actionable inference message based upon the non-identifying information in the obfuscated data from the one or more machine learning providers; resolving the obfuscated identifying information in the received actionable inference message to recover the identifying information; and transmitting the resolved actionable inference message to the endpoint associated with the identifying information. The privacy protection system comprising an endpoint, and obfuscator module, one or more machine learning modules, and a resolver module.

title: Apparatus and methods for gaussian boson sampling
description: An apparatus includes a light source to provide a plurality of input optical modes in a squeezed state. The apparatus also includes a network of interconnected reconfigurable beam splitters (RBSs) configured to perform a unitary transformation of the plurality of input optical modes to generate a plurality of output optical modes. An array of photon counting detectors is in optical communication with the network of interconnected RBSsand configured to measure the number of photons in each mode of the plurality of the output optical modes after the unitary transformation. The apparatus also includes a controller operatively coupled to the light source and the network of interconnected RBSs. The controller is configured to control at least one of the squeezing factor of the squeezed state of light, the angle of the unitary transformation, or the phase of the unitary transformation.

title: Self-learning distributed system with automated ground-truth generation
description: In order to generate annotated ground truth data for training a machine learning model for inferring a desired scan configuration of an medical imaging system from an observed workflow scene during exam preparation, a system is provided that comprises a sensor data interface configured to access a measurement image of a patient positioned for an imaging examination. The measurement image is generated on the basis of sensor data obtained from a sensor arrangement, which has a field of view including at least part of an area, where the patient is positioned for imaging. The system further comprises a medical image data interface configured to access a medical image of the patient obtained from a medical imaging apparatus during the imaging examination. The patient is positioned in a given geometry with respect to a reference coordinate system of the medical imaging apparatus. The system further comprises an exam metadata interface configured to access exam metadata of the imaging examination. The system further comprises a processing unit, configured to determine an association between one or more features in the measurement image and one or more features extracted from the medical image and/or from the exam metadata by mapping a point in a coordinate system of the medical image to a point in a coordinate system of the measurement image. The system further comprises an output interface, configured to be coupled to a training set database for adding the measurement image comprising data that labels the one or more associated features in the measurement image to the training set database for training the machine learning model.

title: Active learning annotation system that does not require historical data
description: In various embodiments, a process for providing an active learning annotation system that does not require historical data includes receiving a stream of unlabeled data, identifying a portion of the unlabeled data to label without access to label information, and receiving a labeled version of the identified portion of the unlabeled data and storing the labeled version as labeled data. The process includes analyzing the labeled version and at least a portion of the received unlabeled data that has not been labeled to identify an additional portion of the unlabeled data to label and store in the labeled data including by applying at least one warm up policy.

title: Technique for efficient retrieval of personality data
description: A technique for enabling efficient retrieval of a digital representation of personality data of a user (402) by a client device (406) from a server (404) is disclosed, wherein the digital representation of the personality data is processed at the client device (406) to provide a user-adapted service to the user (402). A method implementation of the technique is performed by the server (404) and comprises storing a neural network being trained to compute personality data of a user based on input obtained from the user (402), receiving, from the client device (406), a request for a digital representation of personality data for a user (402), and sending, to the client device (406), the requested digital representation of the personality data of the user (402), wherein the personality data of the user is computed using the neural network based on input obtained from the user (402).

title: Techniques for dialog processing using contextual data
description: Techniques are described for using data stored for a user in association with context levels to improve the efficiency and accuracy of dialog processing tasks. A dialog system stores historical dialog data in association with a plurality of configured context levels. The dialog system receives an utterance and identifies a term for disambiguation from the utterance. Based on a determined context level, the dialog system identifies relevant historical data stored to a database. The historical data may be used to perform tasks such as resolving an ambiguity based on user preferences, disambiguating named entities based on a prior dialog, and identifying previously generated answers to queries. Based on the context level, the dialog system can efficiently identify the relevant information and use the identified information to provide a response.

title: Neural network-based inference method and apparatus
description: Disclosed is a neural network-based inference method and apparatus. The neural network-based inference method includes compressing a matrix comprising processing elements corresponding to an operation of a neural network, balancing workloads related to the operation by reordering the compressed matrix based on the workloads, and performing inference based on the reordered matrix.

title: A method for training a neural network to deliver the viewpoints of objects using pairs of images under different viewpoints
description: A method for training a first neural network (f<sup>v</sup>) to detect the viewpoint of an object visible on an image and belonging to a given category of object when this image is inputted to the first neural network, comprising:providing a dataset (T) of pairs of images (I<sub>i</sub>,I'<sub>i</sub>) under different viewpoints,providing a second neural network (f<sup>a</sup>) configured to be able to deliver appearance information (a) of an object,providing a third neural network (f<sup>d</sup>) configured to be able to deliver a synthetic image of an object of said category using appearance information and a viewpoint,jointly training the first neural network, the second neural network, and the third neural network.

title: Method for generating backbone network, apparatus for generating backbone network, device, and storage medium
description: The present disclosure provides a method for generating a backbone network, an apparatus for generating a backbone network, a device, and a storage medium. The present disclosure relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and specifically relates to the technologies of deep learning and computer vision. The method includes: acquiring a set of a training image, a set of an inference image, and a set of an initial backbone network; training and inferring, for each initial backbone network in the set of the initial backbone network, the initial backbone network by using the set of the training image and the set of the inference image, to obtain an inference time and an inference accuracy of a trained backbone network in an inference process; determining a basic backbone network based on the inference time and the inference accuracy of the trained backbone network in the inference process; and obtaining a target backbone network based on the basic backbone network and a preset target network. The method for generating a backbone network of the present disclosure improves the inference speed and inference accuracy of the backbone network on an Intel CPU.

title: Compensation for reference transistors and memory cells in analog neuro memory in deep learning artificial neural network
description: Numerous embodiments are disclosed for compensating for differences in the slope of the current-voltage characteristic curve among reference transistors, reference memory cells, and flash memory cells during a read operation in an analog neural memory in a deep learning artificial neural network. The embodiments are able to compensate for slope differences during both sub-threshold and linear operation of reference transistors.

title: Microwave-to-optical photon transducer
description: A microwave-to-optical photon transducer (1) is provided for generating coupling between a microwave signal (S in2 ) and an optical signal (S pi_in1 , S pi_out1 ). The transducer (1) comprises: a first input port (3); a second input port (5); a first output port (9) for outputting the optical signal (S pi_out1 ) and one or more optical sideband signals (S out1 , S out11 , S out12 ); a first waveguide (13) disposed between the first input port (3) and the first output port (9) to allow the optical signal (S pi_in1 ) and the one or more optical sideband signals (S out1 , S out11 , S out12 ) to propagate in the first waveguide (13); a second waveguide (15) connected to the second input port (5), and extending in the transducer (1) adjacent to the first waveguide (13) to allow the microwave signal (S in2 ) to propagate in the second waveguide (15); a phase-matching arrangement to cause at least the optical signal (S pi_in1 ) and the microwave signal (S in2 ) to be phase-matched or quasi-phase-matched. The first waveguide (13) is made of or comprising non-linear material such that a first electromagnetic field generated by the optical signal (S pi_in1 ) in the first waveguide (13) and a second electromagnetic field generated by the microwave signal (S in2 ) in the second waveguide (15) are arranged to interact in the non-linear material, and wherein the transducer is configured to use travelling waves for mixing the microwave signal and the optical signal to allow the one or more optical sideband signals (S out1 , S out11 , S out12 ) to be sensed at the first output port (9) to allow the power of the microwave signal at the second input port to be determined based on the sensed one or more sideband signals.

title: Computing device for performing digital pulse-based crossbar operation and method of operating the computing device
description: A computing device for performing a digital pulse-based crossbar operation and a method of operating the computing device. The computing device includes a plurality of input lines to which a pulse is selectively input in a sequential manner based on a corresponding input signal; a plurality of output lines crossing the input lines; a plurality of elements, each element being disposed at a cross point between a corresponding input line and a corresponding output line to transfer, to the corresponding output line, a pulse input to the corresponding input line in response to a corresponding weight being a first value; and a plurality of pulse counters, each pulse counter counting a number of pulses output from a corresponding output line.

title: Overlap joint flex circuit board interconnection
description: An interconnection (100) for flex circuit boards used, for instance, in a quantum computing system are provided. In one example, the interconnection (100) can include a first flex circuit board (110) having a first side and a second side opposite the first side. The interconnection (100) can include a second flex circuit board (120) having a third side and a fourth side opposite the third side. The first flex circuit board (110) and the second flex circuit board (120) are physically coupled together in an overlap joint (130) in which a portion of the second side for the first flex circuit board (110) overlaps a portion of the third side of the flex circuit board. The interconnection (100) can include a signal pad structure (132) positioned in the overlap joint (130) that electrically couples a first via (118) in the first flex circuit board (110) and a second via (128) in the second flex circuit board (120).

title: Video compression using optical flow
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for compressing video data. In one aspect, a method comprises: receiving a video sequence of frames; generating, using a flow prediction network, an optical flow between two sequential frames, wherein the two sequential frames comprise a first frame and a second frame that is subsequent the first frame; generating from the optical flow, using a first autoencoder neural network: a predicted optical flow between the first frame and the second frame; and warping a reconstruction of the first frame according to the predicted optical flow and subsequently applying a blurring operation to obtain an initial predicted reconstruction of the second frame.

title: Satellite-based remote quantum computation
description: A distributed quantum computing system 10 and a method for implementing the distributed quantum computing system 10 is disclosed. The distributed quantum computing system 10 comprises at least two ground nodes 20a, 20b located apart at a distance. The ground nodes 20a, 20b comprise a quantum processor 30, a quantum channel unit 40a, 40b for establishing quantum channels 50 with other ones of the at least two ground nodes 20, a coupling unit 60a, 60b for transferring quantum information between the quantum processor 30 and the quantum channel unit 40. A satellite unit 110 creates entanglement between a first channel unit 40a in a first ground node 20a and a second channel unit 40b in a second ground node 20b to enable establishment of said quantum channels 50.

title: Training data generator and method for generating training data sets
description: The invention relates to a training data generator comprising an interface designed to read symbols extracted from provided digital system plans for technical systems, wherein each of the system plans represents the design and/or the functionality of a technical system by means of symbols, and the system plans are identical. The training data generator also comprises a storage module which is designed to store the extracted symbols, a selection module which is designed to randomly select a symbol sub-quantity of the stored symbols using a random generator, a generator which is designed to generate at least one synthetic system plan on the basis of the selected symbol sub-quantity, and an output module which is designed to output the at least one synthetic system plan as training data in order to train a trainable image detection module, wherein the trainable image detection module is designed to generate a digital system plan using an analog system plan of a technical system.

title: Vehicle re-identification method, apparatus, device and storage medium
description: The present application discloses a vehicle re-identification method and apparatus, a device and a storage medium, which relates to the field of computer vision, intelligent search, deep learning and intelligent transportation. The specific implementation scheme is: receiving a re-identification request from a terminal device, the re-identification request including a first image of a first vehicle shot by a first camera and information of the first camera; acquiring a first feature of the first vehicle and a first head orientation of the first vehicle according to the first image; determining a second image of the first vehicle from images of multiple vehicles according to the first feature, multiple second features extracted based on the images of the multiple vehicles in an image database, the first head orientation of the first vehicle, and the information of the first camera; and transmitting the second image to the terminal device. The method of the present application may improve the accuracy of re-identification.

title: Method and controller unit for controlling motion of a hydrofoil watercraft
description: A method and a controller unit (110) for controlling motion of a watercraft (120) with a hydrofoil (130) are disclosed. The controller unit (110) obtains (A010) information indicating shape of water surface in front of the hydrofoil (130). The controller unit (110) further predicts (A040) wave acceleration of the watercraft (120) using a neural network. Furthermore, the controller unit (110) determines a target route and corresponding total acceleration of the watercraft (120) under a set of constraints. The total acceleration is minimized when the watercraft (120) travels according to the target route. The set of constraints includes: a first constraint that the hydrofoil (130) stays within an interval relative to the water surface, and a second constraint relating to magnitude of acceleration derived from maximum AoA and the predicted wave acceleration. The controller unit (110) calculates an AoA for the target route. Next, the controller unit (110) sends a signal for adjusting the hydrofoil (130) according to the AoA. A corresponding computer program (403) and a computer program carrier (405) are also disclosed.

title: 4-bit conformer with accurate quantization training for speech recognition
description: A method (500) for training a model includes obtaining a plurality of training samples (152), each of the plurality of training samples comprising a respective speech utterance (152) and a respective text utterance (154) representing a transcription of the respective speech utterance. An automatic speech recognition (ASR) model (200) on the plurality of training samples is trained using quantization-aware training with native integer arithmetic. The trained automatic speech recognition ASR model is quantized to a target fixed bit-width (162) of integers. The quantized trained automatic speech recognition ASR model comprises a plurality of weights (202). Each weight of the plurality of weights comprises an integer having a target fixed bit-width. The quantized trained automatic speech recognition ASR model is provided to a user device (10).

title: Prediction device, prediction method, and program
description: The prediction device includes an extraction unit (11) that extracts first and second multidimensional features including features of each of a plurality of frequency components included in the time-series signals of the first and second sensors, respectively; a training unit (12) that inputs the first multidimensional feature to an encoder and the second multidimensional feature to a decoder, where a transformer model including the encoder and decoder learns a relationship between the first and second multidimensional features; a prediction unit (13) that inputs the first multidimensional feature to the encoder, where the trained transformer model predicts and outputs the second multidimensional feature; and a reconstruction unit (14) that generates the time-series signals of the second sensor based on the second multidimensional feature obtained from the output of the transformer model.

title: Method of automated generation of symbolically-encoded graphics with user guidance
description: The invention is related to a computer-implemented method and a computing module for automated generation of symbolically-encoded graphics with user guidance comprising the steps of generating training data, training of a model, and use of the trained model, wherein after the training of the model using symbolically-encoded graphics, an autoencoder, a renderer, and an encoder, the model is used for generating symbolically-encoded graphics and its corresponding bitmap-represented graphics according to the user intent based on bitmap-represented graphics edited by the user by means of a graphical editor.

title: Information searching method, apparatus, storage medium, and program product
description: An information searching method, an apparatus, a storage medium and a computer program product are provided, which are related to the field of deep learning and the like. The method includes: acquiring K related second-type-entity corresponding to a target first-type-entity from a relational map based on a search word related to the target first-type-entity; wherein K is an integer greater than or equal to 1; selecting M candidate second-type-entity from the K related second-type-entity based on data representing a relation between the K related second-type-entity and the target first-type-entity; wherein M is an integer greater than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to K; selecting N target second-type-entity from the M candidate second-type-entity as a search result; wherein N is an integer greater than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to M.

title: Online world data fusion method based on physical information neural network
description: The invention discloses an online space-earth data fusion method based on a physical information neural network, which comprises the steps of constructing a fully-connected neural network model, carrying out physical constraint on an output value of the fully-connected neural network model to obtain the physical information neural network model, carrying out back propagation on errors obtained by the physical constraint through a loss function, selecting wind tunnel test data and test flight data as characteristics to input the physical information neural network model, selecting the test flight data as a label, fusing the space-earth data, and continuously updating and inputting the data in a time domain according to a given step length to realize online fusion. According to the method, the fusion data with higher precision can be obtained through a small amount of high-precision test flight data and a large amount of low-precision test data.

title: Intelligent classification method for anti-static detection data of fabric
description: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to an intelligent classification method of fabric antistatic detection data, which comprises the steps of obtaining the segmentable degree of each item of data in each subset according to the non-uniformity degree and the times that each item of data is selected as a division characteristic; acquiring the adjusted Indonesia of each item of data in each subset according to the partitionable degree; and classifying the antistatic data of the fabric based on the adjusted non-purity of the kene. The invention ensures that the classification of the fabric antistatic detection data is more accurate.

title: Health state intelligent analysis system and method based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention relates to the technical field of health state analysis, in particular to an artificial intelligence-based health state intelligent analysis system and method, comprising the following steps of S1, multi-mode health data acquisition; the method comprises the steps of S2, preprocessing data, S3, fusing the acquired multi-modal data, selecting characteristics, carrying out characteristic fusion on the data of different modes through a deep learning model, carrying out characteristic extraction on time sequence data by adopting a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), S4, carrying out prediction analysis on the health state of a user based on a long and short memory network (LSTM), combining historical health data with real-time data, and generating a health state trend chart of the user, and S5, generating personalized health intervention advice, wherein the personalized health management advice is automatically generated.

title: Object surface leveling judging method, device, equipment and medium
description: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for judging the flatness of an object surface, wherein the method comprises the steps of controlling a touch sensor to slide on the object surface to be tested according to a preset track, detecting pressure signals of a contact surface of the object surface to be tested and the touch sensor according to a preset frequency in the sliding process, receiving all the pressure signals sent by the touch sensor, carrying out signal processing on all the pressure signals to obtain target feature vectors of all the pressure signals, carrying out feature vector extraction processing based on convolution operation, and inputting the target feature vectors into a preset two-class machine learning model to obtain information about whether the surface of the object to be tested is flat. According to the invention, the target feature vector is input into the preset two-class machine learning model, and the information of whether the surface of the object to be detected is flat or not is determined based on the target feature vector, so that the efficiency of judging the flatness is improved.

title: Ecological breeding optimization method and system for white feather broilers
description: The invention relates to the technical field of breeding management and discloses an ecological breeding optimization method and system for white feather broilers, comprising the following steps of dividing white feather broiler groups into a healthy group, a slight claudication group and a serious claudication group, and collecting recording information of each group and multidimensional recording information of the broiler groups every 1 hour; generating first plane data based on the record information acquired at three time points in the recent succession, generating second plane data based on the acquired multi-dimensional record information of the chicken flock, inputting the first plane data and the second plane data into a feeding strategy model, outputting feeding strategies representing each group, performing spot check on the crop full rate of the chicken flock every 1 hour, regenerating the feeding strategy of each group when the crop full rate of the spot checked chicken is lower than 95%, and adjusting the group of the chicken flock every other day. The white feather broiler feed has the beneficial effects that the white feather broiler feed is used for grouping white feather broilers, so that the leg problems are relieved while the crop satiation rate is kept high, and the death rate is reduced.

title: Improved YOLOv coal gangue detection method
description: The invention provides an improved YOLOv-8 gangue detection method, which comprises the steps of obtaining gangue images, preprocessing the gangue images, dividing the gangue images into training sets and test sets, constructing an OSM-YOLOv n model, constructing a C2f_ OREPA module by a block linearization and block extrusion method, constructing a SegNext _attention module at the tail of the backbone network and designing a MPDIoU loss function at the head of the backbone network, training the constructed OSM-YOLOv n model by using the training sets, evaluating the performance of the trained model by using the test sets, adjusting a parameter selection model, finally obtaining a trained model, obtaining the gangue images to be processed, and inputting the gangue images to the trained OSM-YOLOv n model to obtain a classification detection result. The invention reduces the complexity of the model, reduces the training cost, enhances the understanding of the model to the image and improves the detection performance.

title: Self-adaptive compressed neural network computing circuit based on energy attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses an energy attention mechanism-based self-adaptive compression neural network computing circuit, and relates to the technical field of hardware implementation of neural networks. The invention simplifies the operation amount of the attention mechanism by a multi-stage compression processing mode through realizing a compression mechanism based on signal energy and an attention compression mechanism based on a neural network, and realizes low-delay processing of compression operation. Meanwhile, the compression of the weight data aiming at the neural network realizes an adaptive compression neural network computing circuit, which realizes the dynamic size adaptation aiming at the characteristic diagram and the compression operation aiming at the weight of the neural network. The invention realizes the low-power consumption and low-delay operation of the neural network.

title: Oral cavity image analysis method based on Micro-CT and migration learning
description: The present application discloses an oral image analysis method based on Micro-CT and transfer learning, which relates to the field of artificial intelligence-assisted medical image diagnosis. The method includes: using Micro-CT and CBCT scanning technology to obtain three-dimensional data of ex vivo teeth; using Micro-CT three-dimensional data as input, using the morphological classification results obtained through Micro-CT data as labels, training the classification model to obtain the weight parameters of the first classification model; using CBCT three-dimensional data as input, using the Micro-CT classification results as labels, training the classification model in a 3D network to obtain a trained second classification model; the initial weight of the second classification model is the weight parameter of the first classification model; and predicting the morphological characteristics of the target tooth according to the trained second classification model. The method of the present application improves the accuracy of oral image analysis.

title: Compression imaging method and system based on Swin transform network
description: The present invention relates to the field of image processing technology, and in particular to a compression imaging method and system based on a Swin Transformer network. First, the training data is sampled and processed using a CC Hadamard matrix to obtain a coded image, and then the coded image is used to train a neural network based on the Swin Transformer to obtain an optimal compression reconstruction model; in the system, the optimal compression reconstruction model is loaded into a processing center, and multiple low-resolution images collected by a detector are preprocessed to obtain a coded image, and then the optimal compression reconstruction model is used to obtain a reconstructed image. Compared with the commonly used sampling matrix, the system and method provided by the present invention have a better reconstruction effect after CC Hadamard matrix sampling, and effectively improve the reconstruction quality of the image.

title: Optimization method considering multi-element cluster energy storage dynamic reconfigurable model
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power system model aggregation method research, and particularly provides an optimization method considering a multi-element cluster energy storage dynamic reconfigurable model, which comprises the steps of generating an countermeasure network based on improved conditions and obtaining a net load fluctuation curve of each node in a system through tide simulation calculation; the method comprises the steps of carrying out variation modal decomposition on a net load fluctuation curve, stabilizing high-frequency and low-frequency components of each load curve, obtaining an aggregation model of clustered energy storage by using Minkowski summation, carrying out output analysis on each energy storage output in an obtained clustered energy storage group by taking the minimum stabilizing effect of the net load fluctuation of each region as an optimization target under the minimum economic cost, carrying out readjustment and aggregation on cluster division results, carrying out optimization calculation on the obtained model again, and determining the matching degree of each energy storage to be utilized in a provincial layer and the corresponding region. The method is used for optimizing the resources and the model base of the system through cross-space-time characteristic analysis and various types of resource matching evaluation of the energy storage resources.

title: Edge calculation-based energy supply station safety protection method and system
description: The invention relates to the field of data processing, and particularly provides an energy supply station safety protection method and system based on edge calculation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining monitoring flow data of a target edge computing node, inputting the monitoring flow data into a flow monitoring intelligent agent to obtain an abnormal flow monitoring result, wherein the abnormal flow monitoring result comprises an abnormal data range obtained by monitoring in the monitoring flow data, a core abnormal data item, an abnormal type corresponding to the abnormal data item and an abnormal support degree corresponding to the abnormal type, and when the flow monitoring intelligent agent is trained, training each sub-model independently, then jointly carrying out collaborative training, and generating monitoring flow labeling data based on the abnormal flow monitoring result and the monitoring flow data. The invention can realize data detection, type detection and core abnormal data item detection by only one flow monitoring intelligent agent, thus reducing the complexity of edge calculation and reducing the cost consumption.

title: Converter station fault diagnosis method based on fault region identification and evidence information fusion
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis of power systems, and in particular to a converter station fault diagnosis method based on fault area identification and evidence information fusion. The sequential event record (SER) data of the converter station is preprocessed to build a characteristic event database, and the confidence of each protection action is calculated to preliminarily define the fault range; the switch signal data during the commissioning and operation of the converter station is processed by a fuzzy Petri net model, and the switch evidence is obtained in combination with the MYCIN confidence reasoning method; a BP neural network model is constructed based on the electrical data during the commissioning and operation of the converter station, and the electrical data is analyzed through deep learning to extract electrical quantity evidence. The D-S evidence theory is used to fuse two types of evidence to obtain accurate fault diagnosis results. By comprehensively considering the two types of characteristic information to accurately find the fault point, not only the accuracy of fault diagnosis is improved, but also the rapid positioning of the fault is achieved, providing a strong guarantee for the safe operation of the converter station.

title: Design method and device for multi-flow compact heat exchanger
description: The present application relates to a multi-stream compact heat exchanger design method and device, which includes the steps of taking the heat exchanger fin parameters as the first type of initial decision variables; iterating the first type of initial decision variables using a multi-objective genetic algorithm; obtaining the Pareto front solution set and selecting the optimal heat exchanger fin parameters, and obtaining the corresponding number of fluid layers and the heat load of each layer; taking the layer arrangement as the second type of initial decision variables, and iterating the second type of initial decision variables using a genetic algorithm; and selecting the optimal layer arrangement based on the minimum cumulative heat load mean square error as the goal. The method optimizes the design of the heat exchanger's external dimensions and fin structure parameters with the volume specific surface area and flow power consumption as the goals, and optimizes the heat exchanger's optimal layer arrangement with the minimum cumulative heat load mean square error as the goal, thereby achieving synchronous optimization of the external dimensions, fin parameters and layer arrangement.

title: Method, device and equipment for configuring semiconductor wafer defect detection light source
description: The invention relates to the technical field of light source configuration and discloses a method, a device and equipment for configuring a semiconductor wafer defect detection light source, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring a semiconductor wafer image, carrying out dynamic image convolution processing and defect characteristic enhancement to obtain an enhanced defect characteristic image; the method comprises the steps of inputting an enhanced defect feature map into a two-way depth neural network to perform reflected light intensity calculation and image quality scoring to obtain reflected light intensity data and image quality scoring data of a defect area, obtaining light source input current and light intensity sensor data of a plurality of light sources, performing recognition calculation on light source angle parameters by combining the image quality scoring data to obtain light source initial parameters, performing nonlinear control on the basis of the reflected light intensity data and the light source initial parameters to obtain light source control parameters, calculating channel weights of the plurality of light sources, and performing differentiation treatment to obtain collaborative light source configuration parameters.

title: Automatic door anti-pinch control method and device based on artificial intelligence and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to an automatic door anti-pinch control method, device and storage medium based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises acquiring original image data through an image acquisition device arranged at a specific position of the automatic door, and performing region extraction on the original image data to obtain corresponding real-time image data; inputting the real-time image data into a preset artificial intelligence deep neural network model for target detection to obtain a target recognition result; dividing the operation area based on the target recognition result to obtain a corresponding multi-level protection area; setting the automatic door trigger parameter based on the multi-level protection area to obtain the corresponding regional trigger parameter; performing gate control judgment on the target recognition result according to the regional trigger parameter and the multi-level protection area, and executing a preset door control action to obtain a corresponding execution result; adjusting the regional trigger parameter in real time based on the execution result to obtain the corresponding system parameter. The present invention can realize the intelligent control of the automatic door.

title: Emotion index construction method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application provides a method, apparatus, computer equipment and storage medium for constructing a sentiment index. The method obtains multiple first comment information within a preset time range and label information corresponding to each first comment information; the label information includes positive labels, neutral labels and negative labels; the first comment information is input into the word embedding layer of a text classification model to be trained, and a word vector matrix is output; the word vector matrix is input into the convolution layer, and a first feature vector is output; each first feature vector is input into the fully connected layer, and a sentiment prediction result corresponding to the first comment information is output; the text classification model is constructed according to the sentiment prediction result and the label information; the second comment information to be constructed is obtained, the multiple second comment information is input into the constructed text classification model, the sentiment classification result is output, and the sentiment index corresponding to the multiple second comment information is constructed according to the sentiment classification result.

title: High-flux near-field dynamics numerical simulation method for in-service equipment damage fracture analysis
description: The invention discloses a high-flux near-field dynamics numerical simulation method for in-service equipment damage fracture analysis, which uses a neural network to carry out auxiliary solution to improve model solving efficiency, combines a near-field dynamics basic theory, a high-flux calculation method and a data driving model to carry out research, establishes a near-field dynamics damage fracture analysis calculation model of the in-service equipment of a nuclear reactor system, develops a near-field dynamics damage fracture solving high-flux method, acquires mass data, and establishes the data driving model based on the neural network. The invention can greatly improve the solving efficiency of the elastic-plastic near-field dynamics model of the pressure vessel.

title: Three-dimensional channel structure design method of micro-channel heat exchange module and related device thereof
description: The present invention relates to a three-dimensional channel structure design method for a microchannel heat exchange module and a related device thereof. The method: the heat conduction coefficient and the convection heat transfer coefficient of the microchannel heat exchange module are input into the Rayleigh-Ritz coupling model for dynamic analysis to obtain channel structure parameter data; the temperature field and pressure field of the channel structure parameter data are collected, and the time series feature is extracted through a dual-time-space automatic encoder to obtain a fluid dynamic feature data matrix; the fluid dynamic feature data matrix is input into a recursive window Bayesian network, and the channel optimization objective function is obtained by calculating the heat exchange efficiency weight coefficient, the fluid resistance weight coefficient, and the heat transfer uniformity weight coefficient; according to the channel optimization objective function, the genetic algorithm is used to perform global iterative calculations on the channel main structure, and numerical simulation is used to perform local optimization on the flow separation and confluence structure to obtain a three-dimensional channel structure optimization scheme. The implementation of the present invention effectively improves the optimization accuracy of the channel structure parameters.

title: Color enhancement method and system for color-impaired patient perceived image
description: The invention provides a color enhancement method and a color enhancement system for a color-impaired patient (CVD) perceived image, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a color-impaired friendly image database through subjective experiments based on visual characteristics of color-impaired persons, S2, constructing a color-impaired perceived guiding enhancement model (CVD acceptance-guided Enhancement Model, CPEM), wherein the color-impaired perceived guiding enhancement model comprises a feature extraction module and a diffusion conversion module which are guided by a color-impaired person in a CVD way, S3, completing training of the color-impaired perceived guiding enhancement model by utilizing the color-impaired friendly image database, S4, inputting an original image and a pure noise image as models, and performing color reconstruction on the original image through the trained color-impaired perceived guiding enhancement model to generate an enhanced image which accords with the visual Perception of a CVD user. The model provided by the invention has remarkable advantages in improving the color perception of individuals with dyschromatopsia.

title: Method for detecting and positioning spraying defects on wall surface of indoor spraying robot
description: The invention discloses a method for detecting and positioning indoor spraying robot wall surface spraying defects, which comprises the steps of S1, fusing a reversible array network and OSNet to construct a defect feature extraction network, S2, using a full-scale feature extraction module and reversible branches to obtain feature information of different layers, S3, taking the twin network as a spraying defect detection end, extracting feature differences of positive and negative samples to obtain a feature vector L2 distance, S4, adding an Edge-Seg module into the twin network as a spraying defect positioning end, extracting defect shapes and Edge information of different scales to obtain spraying defect position information, S5, using a multi-task learning method to construct a spraying defect detection and positioning integrated model RSNet, S6, using RSNet to extract feature differences of the positive and negative samples to obtain sample similarity, and carrying out semantic segmentation and Edge extraction on abnormal images to obtain defect positions. The method can effectively realize the online detection and positioning of the spraying defects, and improves the detection precision and the positioning precision.

title: Method and apparatus for image characterization learning
description: The present invention relates to a method and apparatus for image representation learning. A device for image representation learning comprises: an encoder for encoding multiple image data sets based on a network model to retrieve image data matching another image data set for image data in one of the multiple image data sets; and a trainer for training the network model of the encoder to maximize the distance between image data in one image data set and matching image data in another image data set and minimize the distance between image data in one image data set and unmatched image data in another image data set, wherein the images represented by the matching image data in the multiple image data sets are obtained at the same time from multiple perspectives. The present application also describes other embodiments.

title: New energy source soft straight-out system oscillation suppression method based on double-delay depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm
description: The invention provides a new energy source soft direct-sending system oscillation suppression method based on a dual-delay depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm. The method comprises the steps of obtaining dynamic parameters and electric quantity data of a new energy source through a flexible and straight delivery system, constructing a deep reinforcement learning model, training the deep reinforcement learning model by using a TD3 algorithm to obtain a trained deep reinforcement learning model, inputting current state space data of the new energy source through the flexible and straight delivery system into the trained deep reinforcement learning model, outputting additional damping control parameters by the trained deep reinforcement learning model, applying the additional damping control parameters to an additional damping controller, adjusting parameters of the additional damping controller on line, and generating an optimal control strategy of the new energy source through the flexible and straight delivery system. The invention provides an oscillation suppression control method for a new energy source soft and straight delivery system, which realizes the self-adaptive adjustment of additional damping control parameters through a TD3 algorithm and realizes the self-adaptive suppression of system oscillation.

title: Assessment method and system combining language model and virtual technology
description: The present invention discloses an assessment method and system combining language model and virtual technology, the method comprising the following steps: rehearsing the police-civilian dialogue process, and using a first language model to analyze the rehearsal language output of the subject to obtain the rehearsal analysis result; based on the rehearsal analysis result, obtaining the subject's rehearsal score; when the subject's rehearsal score meets the preset score requirement, obtaining assessment permission; based on the assessment permission, combining virtual technology, constructing police-civilian dialogue scene questions; based on the police-civilian dialogue scene questions, assessing the subject to obtain assessment language output; using a second language model to analyze the assessment language output, obtaining the subject's assessment evaluation report. The present invention combines language model with virtual technology to construct a more advanced and efficient assessment method and system, and improve the quality and effect of the assessment.

title: Fault diagnosis and early warning method for loader multi-sensor data fusion
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of loaders, and specifically to a fault diagnosis and early warning method of multi-sensor data fusion for loaders, comprising the following steps: S1, multi-source data acquisition and preprocessing: real-time acquisition of the operating status data of the loader; S2, multi-modal data fusion: multi-modal data fusion of the pre-processed operating status data to form comprehensive data; S3, energy flow fault propagation prediction: real-time analysis of the energy flow distribution of each component, identification of potential fault components and their propagation paths; S4, fault assessment and graded early warning: comprehensive assessment of the fault risk of the loader, and generation of graded early warning signals according to the set multi-level early warning rules. The present invention not only improves the operating efficiency and safety of the loader, but also optimizes the allocation of maintenance resources, reduces operating costs, and further improves the overall reliability and service life of the loader.

title: Time sequence analysis method based on double-flow transducer architecture
description: The invention discloses a time sequence analysis method based on a double-flow transducer architecture, which belongs to the technical field of time sequence analysis and comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-variable time sequence data set, preprocessing and dividing the data set, constructing a TSTNet model, carrying out preliminary training on a TSTNet model to obtain a final feature sequence, optimizing a loss function by applying a gradient descent method based on the obtained final feature sequence to complete one-time training of a TSTNet model, verifying a TSTNet model, carrying out overall training on a TSTNet model, and evaluating the final feature sequence output by the TSTNet model by using a test data set after training is completed to obtain a final loss score of the TSTNet on the data set. By adopting the method, the relationship between individuality and commonality among the channels is explicitly processed by constructing TSTNet models, and the complicated dependency relationship among different channels is solved.

title: Method for predicting total phosphorus concentration in sewage treatment process, electronic equipment and medium
description: The invention discloses a method for predicting total phosphorus concentration in a sewage treatment process, electronic equipment and a medium, and belongs to the field of sewage treatment. The method comprises the steps of collecting various index data in various sewage treatment processes to obtain a data set, preprocessing the obtained data set, screening characteristic variables related to total phosphorus, establishing a corresponding phosphate concentration prediction model based on a physical information technology for predicting phosphate concentration in an iron salt delivery process, combining the phosphate concentration obtained by prediction with the screened variables to jointly construct a total phosphorus prediction model, training the total phosphorus prediction model, and using the trained total phosphorus prediction model for predicting the total phosphorus concentration in the sewage treatment process. According to the invention, part of known scientific rules and empirical formulas in the sewage treatment field are innovatively integrated into the data-driven prediction model, the theoretical basis of the traditional model and the self-learning capability of the machine learning model are combined, and the prediction accuracy and reliability of the model are improved.

title: Small sample frame structure damage detection method based on meta-learning and DCCMN model
description: The present invention discloses a small sample frame structure damage detection method based on meta-learning and DCCMN model, which belongs to the technical field of structural damage detection, and includes the following steps: S1, collecting vibration signals, and dividing the data into training tasks and test tasks after data processing; S2, randomly selecting a task from the training tasks, and inputting the support set of the selected task into the DCCMN model for training to complete the inner loop; S3, using the query set to evaluate the model, calculate the loss function, and update the model parameters; S4, finally obtaining the detection result through model testing. The present invention adopts the above-mentioned small sample frame structure damage detection method based on meta-learning and DCCMN model to solve the problem of data scarcity in structural damage detection, improve the accuracy and generalization ability of small sample damage detection, and bring more reliable and efficient structural health monitoring solutions to the engineering field.

title: EOSIO intelligent contract vulnerability detection method of self-adaptive multichannel graph convolutional network
description: The invention relates to a EOSIO intelligent contract vulnerability detection method of a self-adaptive multi-channel graph rolling network, which comprises the following steps of S1, generating a control flow graph CFG and a data flow graph DFG of an intelligent contract function to be detected, S2, learning contents in the control flow graph CFG and the DFG by adopting the self-adaptive multi-channel graph rolling network EAM-GCN, S3, after a feature vector splicing process in the learning control flow graph CFG and the data flow graph DFG of the self-adaptive multi-channel graph rolling network EAM-GCN, fusing semantic features extracted from the control flow graph CFG and the data flow graph DFG of a source code by using a global fusion attention mechanism, and classifying the acquired global code features by using a classifier to identify the existence of the intelligent contract vulnerability to be detected EOSIO. The method solves the problem that deep learning cannot be applied to EOSIO intelligent contracts for vulnerability detection at present.

title: Reservoir optimal scheduling method oriented to scheduling plan
description: The present invention provides a reservoir optimization scheduling method oriented to scheduling plan, which relates to the technical field of multi-task coordination of reservoirs. The method includes randomly generating multiple groups of monthly power generation plans; obtaining the amount of water available for power generation in the reservoir by calculating the initial storage capacity of the reservoir; dynamically calculating the amount of water for power generation by using the Newton interpolation method and the improved Powell method; respectively calculating the ecological water supply, urban water supply and agricultural water supply; calculating the objective function of the power generation plan that meets the constraint conditions; comparing the power generation targets when the water shortage targets are equal, and obtaining the global optimal and individual optimal power generation plans of each generation by comparing the objective function values; and obtaining the optimal power generation plan that meets the constraint conditions based on the global optimal and individual optimal power generation plans of each generation for reaching the maximum number of iterations. The present invention solves the problem of mismatch between power generation plans and water supply plans in actual scheduling management.

title: Method, device and equipment for realizing knowledge question and answer
description: The present application discloses a method for implementing knowledge question and answer, in which a query statement input by a user is input into a trained language model, and the language model is used to predict a word-gram set corresponding to the next word-gram output for the query statement. If the word-gram set includes a first word-gram, since the text corresponding to the first word-gram is a text that actually exists in the knowledge base corresponding to the language model, indicating that there is real and relevant content in the result of this recall, an answer is output based on the text corresponding to the first word-gram included in the word-gram set. Among them, the language model is used to answer query statements for the knowledge field corresponding to the above-mentioned knowledge base. It can be seen that through the language model provided by the present application, it can be ensured that the output answer is content that actually exists in the knowledge base and is related to the query statement, thereby improving the accuracy of knowledge question and answer. For example, in the IT field, the accuracy of the response of IT intelligent assistants can be improved, thereby improving efficiency.

title: Information cascade prediction method and device based on space-time characteristics and content preference
description: The present invention provides a method and device for predicting information cascades based on spatiotemporal features and content preferences. The method includes: obtaining the user's social relationship data, and calling the GCN model to generate the social relationship data to obtain the user's social relationship embedding features; then calling the GRU model to construct the user's spatiotemporal features, and performing feature construction based on the information cascade on the user's spatiotemporal features to obtain the user's spatiotemporal cascade features; obtaining the information dissemination content that the user will participate in, constructing multimodal joint features based on the information dissemination content, and determining the interest influencing factors. Finally, the dot product similarity between the user's spatiotemporal cascade features and the interest influencing factors is determined, and the user's participation probability for the information dissemination content is predicted based on the dot product similarity. Through this application, the technical problem of poor prediction effect of the information cascade prediction task in the prior art is solved.

title: Offline reinforcement learning sequence modeling method based on internal and external selection state space
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of reinforcement learning, and particularly relates to an offline reinforcement learning sequence modeling method based on an internal and external selection state space. In order to solve the problem of inaccuracy in model learning and the problems of Transforemer of complex calculation and high cost in the sequence modeling process, the invention constructs element dependent representation according to Markov attributes among track sequence elements, models the element dependent representation by using an internal Mamba module, captures short-term causal relationships in tracks, combines a state space model and offline reinforcement learning, models the offline reinforcement learning track sequence by using Mamba of linear complexity in an external Mamba module, and captures long-term time relationships among elements.

title: Machine learning-based coal mine high-energy mine earthquake prediction and main control factor judgment method
description: A method for predicting high-energy mine earthquake and judging main control factors based on machine learning includes such steps as obtaining microseismic data, geological data and mining data during mining of working surface, determining the indexes corresponding to each data, building multiple machine learning models, training, comprehensively evaluating each model by set prediction indexes to obtain optimal model, interpreting the prediction results of machine learning model by SHAP method, and sequencing each prediction index by SHAP value as main control factor judging standard to obtain main control factors. The method can comprehensively analyze the factors causing the mine earthquake, improve the accuracy of the mine earthquake prediction, and ensure the safe mining of the coal mine and the accurate prevention and control of the mine earthquake.

title: Digital twin system for predictive maintenance of green aviation kerosene Fischer-Tropsch reactor
description: The invention discloses a digital twin system for predictive maintenance of a green aviation kerosene Fischer-Tropsch reactor, which comprises a data processing module, a digital twin module, a trend prediction module and a maintenance decision module, wherein the data processing module is used for collecting and integrating temperature data and reaction state data of a plurality of sections of reactors, the digital twin module is used for constructing a mechanism digital twin model of the Fischer-Tropsch reactor so as to simulate real equipment behaviors, the trend prediction module is used for analyzing the collected temperature data and reaction state data of the plurality of sections of reactors and driving the digital twin model to predict reactor parameters and trend of the reaction state data, and the maintenance decision module is used for generating a predictive maintenance strategy for the Fischer-Tropsch reactor according to the prediction result of the trend of the reaction state data. According to the invention, the mechanism model is combined with the data driving model, so that the selection of the optimal reaction point, the prediction of the reaction trend and the identification of potential faults are performed, and the efficiency and the safety are improved.

title: Degraded image recovery method based on perception guidance
description: The invention discloses a degraded image recovery method based on perception guidance, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a double-branch neural network architecture comprising a perception branch and a recovery branch, constructing a classification task data set and a recovery task data set which are respectively used for training the perception network and the recovery network, and finally inputting the obtained trained double-branch neural network architecture into a real degraded image to obtain a finally output recovered image. The method analyzes the complexity and diversity of image degradation in a real scene, overcomes the limitation of only aiming at a single degradation mode, effectively enhances the evaluation precision and generalization capability of a perception network to the image degradation state by introducing constraint conditions of a plurality of subtasks, can adaptively allocate and optimize computing resources aiming at different image characteristics, realizes dual promotion of computing efficiency and recovery quality, ensures high performance, does not cause consumption of a large amount of computing resources, and is more convenient and flexible in deployment process.

title: A lithium battery health status prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a lithium battery health state prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining monitoring data of a lithium battery in a cyclic charge-discharge process and SOH data corresponding to the monitoring data, reducing the dimension of the monitoring data of the lithium battery in the cyclic charge-discharge process by using a PCA algorithm to obtain dimension-reduced monitoring data, taking the dimension-reduced monitoring data as sample data, taking SOH data corresponding to the dimension-reduced monitoring data as tag data, constructing a data set, training a GRU model by using the data set, performing super-parameter optimization by using an SSA algorithm during training to obtain a lithium battery health state prediction model, and predicting SOH data of a specified lithium battery by using the lithium battery health state prediction model. In this way, it is possible to improve the accuracy of lithium battery state of health prediction and reduce the computational burden.

title: Maximum efficiency optimization method for wireless charging system based on improved parrot algorithm
description: The application belongs to the technical field of LCC-S wireless charging, and particularly relates to an optimization method and system for realizing maximum efficiency of a wireless charging system. One side of the circuit structure consists of a full-bridge inversion and LCC topological structure and comprises 4 switching tubes, and the secondary side consists of a rectifying structure and a DC-DC converter. According to the application, the improved parrot algorithm is combined with the wireless charging technology by establishing the wireless charging system with LCC-S topology, so that the charging system with maximum efficiency optimization is designed and developed, on one hand, the actual requirements of some special application occasions can be met, the application field of the wireless charging technology is expanded, and on the other hand, the energy-saving and environment-friendly advantages are realized.

title: A method for generating Riemannian manifold data sets based on geodesic interpolation technology
description: The present invention discloses a method for generating a Riemannian manifold data set based on a geodesic interpolation technique, comprising: S1, determining a task manifold and initializing a neural network; S2, establishing a geodesic interpolation model based on the task manifold and obtaining an interpolation point set; S3, calculating and optimizing two neural networks for approximating a tangent vector field on the task manifold based on the interpolation point set, obtaining an optimal neural velocity field network and an optimal neural fractional field network; S4, establishing a data generation framework on the manifold according to the optimal neural velocity field network and the optimal neural fractional field network; S5, generating new a priori initial value samples, and using the new a priori samples as initial values to input the data generation framework on the task manifold, simulating unknown distribution data to be generated, and obtaining sufficient new data points as the Riemannian manifold data set. The present invention can realize accurate modeling and rapid generation of high-quality manifold data, and provides a way to further unify flow models and diffusion models on manifolds in the future.

title: A trimodal salient object detection method based on feature fusion enhancement
description: The invention discloses a three-mode saliency target detection method based on feature fusion enhancement, firstly, respectively preprocessing a training set and a testing set in a three-mode significant target detection data set. And secondly, constructing a three-mode saliency target detection network based on feature fusion enhancement. And finally, inputting the preprocessed training set image into a three-mode saliency target detection network to generate a prediction graph with the same size as the input image, carrying out loss calculation by using a loss function, optimizing by back propagation, and testing by using the preprocessed testing set image. The method improves the accuracy of multi-modal salient target detection and enhances the complementarity and global perception capability between multi-modal information.

title: Network management system cluster with joint query processing
description: Embodiments of the application relate to a network management system cluster with federated query processing. A process includes retaining first data in a first network management system cluster for a retention period in response to a migration of a network device deployment from the first network management system cluster to a second network management system cluster. The data represents information about the deployment of the network device. The process includes receiving, by a federation layer engine of a second network management system cluster, a given query directed to information associated with a network device deployment. The process includes determining, by the federation layer engine, whether a query time associated with the given query is within a retention period, and processing, by the federation layer engine, the given query in response to the determination of whether the query time is within the retention period.

title: Deep learning-based transmission line defect detection method and system
description: The present application provides a transmission line defect detection method and system based on deep learning, which determines multiple first defect circuit information sets from a first line setting directory, and then determines the influence vectors between the first defect circuit information sets through the hidden vectors of each first defect circuit information set. Since the first influence vectors of each first defect circuit information set are obtained based on the hidden vectors of each first defect circuit information set, the influence vectors between the first defect circuit information sets cover the hidden information in the first part of the transmission line data. The process of optimizing the first defect description attribute using the first influence vector is equivalent to optimizing the first defect description attribute of each first defect circuit information set based on the hidden information in the first transmission line data, thereby weakening the hidden-related influence data covered in the first part of the transmission line data caused by hiding, thereby improving the accuracy of data detection.

title: Self-adaptive force feedback method, device and medium based on individuation virtual laparoscopic surgery
description: The adaptive force feedback method, device and medium based on individualized virtual laparoscopic surgery belong to the field of adaptive force feedback computing technology. The adaptive force feedback method includes: detecting whether the tactile pen tip of the virtual surgical instrument is in contact with the abdominal tissue/organ model; wherein, the outermost layer of the abdominal tissue/organ model is covered with a surface film, and when the tactile pen tip of the virtual surgical instrument is in contact with the surface film, it is determined that it is in contact with the corresponding abdominal tissue/organ model; if the tactile pen tip of the virtual surgical instrument is in contact with the abdominal tissue/organ model, the type of the abdominal tissue/organ model in contact is identified, and the force feedback parameter setting of the corresponding abdominal tissue/organ model is switched to perform force feedback calculation; detecting whether the tactile pen tip of the virtual surgical instrument penetrates the surface film and enters the abdominal tissue/organ model. If so, force feedback calculation is performed based on the switched force feedback parameter setting, and scene rendering is performed. The present application designs a method that can adaptively switch force feedback parameters according to different types of tissues and organs to improve the quality and authenticity of virtual surgery.

title: Dynamic point cloud rapid coding method based on LSTM network prediction
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of coding, and relates to a dynamic point cloud rapid coding method based on LSTM network prediction, which comprises the steps of obtaining point cloud, preprocessing, inputting the preprocessed point cloud into a trained multi-level prediction partitioning network to obtain sub-coding units after the point cloud partitioning, and coding the sub-coding units into bit streams; the training process of the multi-level prediction partitioning network comprises the steps of obtaining a dynamic point cloud sequence and preprocessing, inputting the preprocessed dynamic point cloud sequence into the multi-level prediction partitioning network to obtain partitioned sub-coding units and predicted occupation results, calculating loss function values according to the predicted occupation results to update network parameters until a trained network is obtained, predicting occupation results of all levels of CUs by using LSTM networks of all levels, determining whether to partition according to the occupation results, and simultaneously carrying out different-level partition prediction on different CUs by using the LSTM networks of all levels in parallel, so that coding time is saved.

title: Garment attribute identification method, system, computer device and readable storage medium
description: The invention discloses a clothing attribute identification method, a clothing attribute identification system, computer equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of image identification. The clothing attribute identification method comprises the steps of obtaining a picture to be identified. And acquiring a picture text database of the clothing, and acquiring a clothing attribute identification model according to the picture text database of the clothing and the deep learning model. And identifying the attribute of the clothing in the picture to be identified according to the clothing attribute identification model to obtain the attribute data of the clothing in the picture to be identified. In the aspect of data, the invention crawls massive clothing data through a crawler technology, merges partial open source data sets, and performs pre-labeling by means of strong content understanding capability of a visual language large model, thereby constructing a professional clothing attribute data set.
