In the aspect of algorithm, the advantages of a transducer architecture and CNN are combined, a light-weight network structure taking a self-attention mechanism and key point regression based on a local sliding frame as auxiliary tasks is designed, and the light-weight network structure is used for solving the problem of clothing multi-attribute identification and considering model precision and reasoning time delay.

title: Communication interference identification method based on three-dimensional time-frequency and deep transfer learning
description: The invention relates to a communication interference identification method based on three-dimensional time-frequency and deep transfer learning, which comprises the steps of S1, data preprocessing, S2, transfer learning feature extraction, S3, LSTM time sequence feature extraction, and S4, time-frequency diagram feature and time sequence feature weight distribution to realize interference signal identification. The method comprises the steps of processing original frequency spectrum data into a three-dimensional time-frequency diagram, reserving multi-dimensional data information, extracting the characteristics of the three-dimensional time-frequency diagram through a transfer learning mode, solving the problem of small number of interference data samples, combining an LSTM (line-space) network, extracting time sequence relevance characteristics of the characteristic diagram, and finally combining a Self-attention mechanism network (Self-Attention Mechanism) to allocate weights for the characteristics and the time sequence characteristics of the three-dimensional time-frequency diagram, so that the method is beneficial to model identification of key characteristics and improvement of identification accuracy.

title: A visual recognition system for unmanned salvage vessels for invasive plants on river and lake surfaces
description: The invention provides a visual identification system of an unmanned salvage ship for invasive plants on water surfaces of rivers and lakes, which comprises a visual identification system module, an invasive plant data set training module and a modeling method module, wherein the visual identification system module is connected with an invasive plant video image acquisition module, the invasive plant data set training module is connected with the invasive plant video image acquisition module, the modeling method module is connected with the invasive plant data set training module, and the modeling method module is connected with an image preprocessing algorithm module. The invention has simple structure, the main core is composed of the water surface invasive plant visual recognition system and the salvaging equipment, the implementation cost is low, the feasibility is strong, the whole device adopts an automatic design, the factors of artificial interference are small, the stability, the accuracy and the continuity of the device are ensured, the expansibility is strong, the application range of the device can be continuously expanded along with the continuous training refinement of the model, the reusability is strong, and the device is energy-saving and environment-friendly.

title: A CPU-GPU heterogeneous system workload dynamic allocation method and system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of memory management, in particular to a method and a system for dynamically distributing workload of a CPU-GPU heterogeneous system. The CPU-GPU heterogeneous system workload dynamic distribution method comprises the steps of carrying out preliminary analysis and preprocessing on task data by a CPU, extracting key characteristic information of the task, judging the task type, enabling an FPGA chip to realize a PSO algorithm, carrying out calculation by combining a task completion rate and a delay model to find out an optimal CPU/GPU mapping proportion, carrying out accurate distribution of the task between the CPU and the GPU by a scheduling and distribution unit according to a returned optimization result, feeding back the task completion condition and the delay data in the execution process to the FPGA chip, and carrying out real-time adjustment on the calculation of the current PSO algorithm. The CPU-GPU heterogeneous system workload dynamic distribution method and system can adjust the workload in real time according to the dynamic characteristics of the task and the real-time state of the system resources, so that the utilization rate of the system resources is improved, and the task processing efficiency is greatly improved.

title: A multi-criteria decision-making method for solving the charging strategy selection problem
description: The application discloses a multi-standard decision method for solving the problem of charging strategy selection, which comprises the following steps of carrying out grade evaluation on an electric automobile charging strategy according to the influence of an electric automobile charging station on the aspects of economic operation cost, environmental influence, social influence, operation cost and service quality evaluation, adopting a fuzzy optimal-worst method based on the comparison and evaluation result of the electric automobile charging strategy, capturing subjective fuzziness when comparing different criteria or options according to the weight grades of different criteria, and redefining the weight of the criteria through pairwise comparison, and providing an alternative scheme fuzzy sorting method for evaluating and sorting the available charging strategies of an electric automobile system.

title: Method for reconstructing standard problem oriented to natural language query
description: The present invention discloses a method for reconstructing standard questions for natural language query, comprising the following steps: Step 1, constructing a standard question corpus and storing the semantics and structural vectors of standard questions; Step 2, retrieving similar questions from the standard question corpus based on a twin neural network; Step 3: constructing a new dependency syntax tree to complete the standard reconstruction of the query question. The method for reconstructing standard questions for natural language query of the present invention solves the problems of inaccurate semantic understanding, data mode mismatch, etc. in the prior art when processing fuzzy and complex queries, as well as the lack of means for standard verification of generated atomic questions. By proposing a standard verification method for atomic questions based on an improved twin neural network, it is ensured that each sub-question can accurately point to the required information, thereby significantly improving the overall quality of the query.

title: Superconducting cable safety assessment method and system based on stacked self-coding network
description: The invention relates to a superconducting cable safety evaluation method and system based on a stacked self-coding network, wherein the method comprises the following steps of obtaining a multi-dimensional measured parameter value sequence of an index associated with a superconducting cable; based on the actual measurement parameter value sequence, a pre-trained stacked self-coding network based on a limiting Boltzmann machine is utilized to obtain a reconstruction parameter value sequence, based on the actual measurement parameter value sequence and the reconstruction parameter value sequence, a reconstruction error sequence is calculated and sliding time window processing is carried out, based on a sliding time window processing result, a risk threshold value of the superconducting cable is dynamically updated, based on the current reconstruction error and the risk threshold value, whether an alarm signal is sent or not is judged, and safety assessment of the superconducting cable is achieved. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of fully considering the influence of various factors on the safety of the superconducting cable, relieving the negative influence of the fixed threshold on the safety evaluation and the like.

title: Training method of image analysis network architecture and image analysis method
description: The application provides a training method and an image analysis method of an image analysis network architecture, wherein the training method of the image analysis network comprises the steps of adopting a SAFD-based convolution kernel learning module, carrying out convolution kernel learning on an unsupervised feature extraction module based on an input training image to obtain target convolution kernel parameters, adopting a SAFD-based unsupervised feature extraction module, carrying out feature extraction on the training image based on the target convolution kernel parameters to obtain a depth feature map, adopting a SAFD-based mode extraction module, generating and extracting potential mode information based on the depth feature map, adopting a SAFD-based initial semi-supervised analysis module, generating a prediction label corresponding to the training image based on the extracted potential mode information, a real label of the training image and pre-extraction mode information corresponding to the real label, and carrying out parameter adjustment on the initial semi-supervised analysis module according to the real label and the prediction label of the training image to obtain the target image analysis network architecture.

title: Method for predicting secondary transition temperature of polymer material based on machine learning
description: The invention discloses a machine learning-based polymer material secondary transition temperature prediction method which comprises the steps of obtaining a polymer material to be detected, constructing a secondary transition temperature prediction model, inputting the polymer material to be detected into the secondary transition temperature prediction model for prediction to obtain a prediction result, wherein the secondary transition temperature prediction model is obtained after training through a training set and testing through a testing set. The invention can effectively capture the internal relation between the molecular structure of the polymer and the secondary transition temperature (T  β ) under the condition of few data, and reveal the rotation nature of the secondary transition temperature (T  β ) of the polymer in the temperature change process.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine intelligent sharing traditional Chinese medicine pharmacy management system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine pharmacy management, and discloses a traditional Chinese medicine intelligent shared traditional Chinese medicine pharmacy management system which comprises a front-end system, a medicine grabbing system, a guiding system, an access control system, a reminding system and a control center, wherein the front-end system is used for prescription generation, landmark guiding and patient information management, the medicine grabbing system is used for automatizing a medicine grabbing device, an intelligent medicine grabbing algorithm and path planning, and the guiding system is used for helping a patient to quickly find a medicine taking place through intelligent guiding. In the invention, the automatic medicine grabbing device and the intelligent algorithm are utilized, and the shortest path algorithm and the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm are combined, so that the medicine taking flow of a patient is optimized. The shortest path algorithm helps optimize the patient's path from the portal to the drug delivery device, reducing seek time, while the PSO algorithm minimizes the patient's overall waiting time by optimizing the drug delivery sequence.

title: Visual servo-based fire hose automatic docking identification and positioning method and system
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying and positioning automatic butt joint of a fire hydrant based on visual servo, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring an image of a fire hydrant interface, identifying and positioning the image of the fire hydrant interface through an improved YOLOv algorithm to obtain a three-dimensional coordinate of the fire hydrant interface; the method comprises the steps of converting three-dimensional coordinates of a fire hydrant interface into position information under a tail end coordinate system of a mechanical arm according to camera calibration and hand-eye calibration, controlling the mechanical arm to move towards a target area, obtaining position information and posture information of the target area through recognition aruco codes by adopting a recognition positioning method based on aruco codes, calculating a rotation angle required by the mechanical arm to reach the expected position according to a difference value between the expected position and the target position as input by utilizing a visual servo control method based on the position, and driving the mechanical arm to reach the expected position to finish docking. The invention can rapidly and accurately identify and position, and can complete the butt joint task of the fire hose.

title: Multi-mode data-based source load prediction method, device, equipment and medium
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a source load prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on multi-mode data. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode initial data, preprocessing the multi-mode data to obtain multi-mode target data, wherein the multi-mode target data comprise text data and cloud image video data, fusing the text data and the cloud image video data to obtain fused characteristic data, carrying out position coding on the fused characteristic data through Informer models to obtain position coding data, taking the position coding data and the fused characteristic data together as training data sets, grouping the training data sets to obtain a plurality of groups of training sub-data sets, training the Informer models by utilizing the plurality of groups of training sub-data sets to obtain source load prediction models, and carrying out prediction on the obtained multi-mode data to be predicted to obtain prediction results. The embodiment of the application occupies less memory and has high calculation efficiency when carrying out source load prediction.

title: Artificial intelligent driven video motion capturing and attitude estimation system and method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of computer vision and artificial intelligence, and discloses an artificial intelligence driven video motion capturing and gesture estimating system and method, comprising a video input module, a preprocessing module, a target detection module, a key point detection module, a gesture estimating module, a motion capturing module and an output module, wherein the video input module comprises a high-definition camera interface and a network video stream receiving module, through integrating video input module, preprocessing module, target detection module, key point detection module, gesture estimation module, motion capture module and output module, through deep learning and optimization algorithm combination, promoted gesture estimation's accuracy, adopted lightweight model and hardware acceleration technology, satisfied real-time processing demand, can adapt to complicated scene, like shelter from, illumination change, but the motion capture of simultaneous processing many people or object.

title: Rolling bearing residual life prediction method and system based on convolution white box
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of detection of residual service life of bearings, and discloses a rolling bearing residual service life prediction method and system based on a convolution white box. The method comprises the steps of extracting time domain and frequency domain characteristics of an original vibration signal, carrying out noise reduction treatment, dividing a health state and a degradation state, carrying out deep neural network training by combining Weibull-MSE loss functions, enabling RUL prediction to accord with an actual degradation process of a bearing, and synchronously extracting long-term dependence information and local degradation characteristics of the bearing signal through a convolution CRATE network architecture of a fusion expansion causal convolution attention mechanism DCA and a multi-scale convolution MSC. The method and the system improve the accuracy of RUL prediction by combining health state evaluation, enhance the local feature extraction capability, improve the local modeling capability of the model by multi-scale information fusion, and improve the interpretability and the prediction reliability by CRATE structures.

title: Intelligent operation and maintenance method integrating multi-mode data and active learning
description: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance and discloses an intelligent operation and maintenance method integrating multi-mode data and active learning, which comprises the steps of deploying a hierarchical Internet of things equipment network in a target operation and maintenance area, collecting heterogeneous operation and maintenance data sets and generating operation and maintenance feature data sets by adopting a unified building operation and maintenance service framework coordinated by a plurality of MCPs; the method comprises the steps of inputting an operation and maintenance characteristic data set and user feedback information into a deep learning intention recognition model for intention recognition and demand analysis to obtain structured user demand data and operation and maintenance task priority order, carrying out real-time evaluation on the running state of equipment according to the operation and maintenance characteristic data set and the structured user demand data to obtain fault risk early warning data, and carrying out autonomous decision analysis through a proxy artificial intelligent engine to generate an equipment maintenance scheme and a resource scheduling scheme, thereby solving the problems that a single model for fault prediction in traditional operation and maintenance has poor adaptability and a prediction result is difficult to convert into an effective decision.

title: Dangerous chemical tank car transportation safety risk monitoring and early warning system and method
description: The present invention discloses a hazardous chemicals tanker transportation safety risk monitoring and early warning system and method based on knowledge graph, which mainly solves the problems in the prior art that the monitoring parameters are single, the safety data lacks effective mining means, and the accident case library cannot be directly used for accident early warning. The method includes the following modules: hazardous chemicals tanker transportation data acquisition module, hazardous chemicals tanker transportation laws and regulations, standards and specifications, historical accident data acquisition module, data preprocessing module, knowledge graph module, hazardous chemicals tanker transportation safety risk situation analysis module, dynamic update and feedback module, hazardous chemicals tanker transportation risk situation visualization module; the present invention can realize the safety risk analysis and accident cause mining of hazardous chemicals tanker transportation, and can significantly enhance the intelligence and accuracy of hazardous chemicals tanker transportation safety risk management and control, reduce the possibility of accidents, and improve the overall safety and stability of production.

title: Method and system for constructing cardiac resuscitation visualization flow
description: The present invention discloses a method for constructing a visualized cardiac resuscitation process, including: collecting multi-source data; constructing an automatic arrhythmia recognition model based on deep learning; judging the patient's vital sign status; using a machine learning algorithm for analysis to assess the severity of the disease; using the Internet of Things technology to locate and monitor the emergency resources in the hospital in real time; automatically calculating the best emergency resource allocation plan; analyzing the relationship between various factors and the patient after recovery to obtain the key factors and potential problem points of the success rate of treatment; generating a personalized cardiac resuscitation advanced life support process based on an artificial intelligence algorithm and visualizing it, providing emergency personnel with emergency operation steps and time node guidance. The present invention makes full use of artificial intelligence technology throughout the entire process of cardiac resuscitation to achieve intelligence and visualization of each link, thereby significantly improving the timeliness and success rate of treatment of patients with sudden cardiac death.

title: Information processing device, program and reasoning method
description: An information processing apparatus that performs artificial intelligence-based reasoning in a container that is a virtual environment constructed by a container-type virtualization technique, and includes a construction section configured to construct a container image of an operating environment of software that causes the information processing apparatus to perform screen display, database operation, and artificial intelligence-based reasoning, and an operation section configured to perform screen display, database operation, and artificial intelligence-based reasoning operation using the container reproduced by starting the container image.

title: Power prediction optimization method for photovoltaic
description: The present invention relates to the technical field related to photovoltaic power prediction optimization, specifically a power prediction optimization method for photovoltaics. The power prediction optimization method for photovoltaics first performs modal decomposition of time series preprocessing, then utilizes triangular topology aggregation optimization, and then establishes a prediction model and optimization method, and it mainly establishes a time domain convolutional network for time series prediction, frequency-time sparse learning in time series prediction, and a Transformer encoder for time series prediction, and learnable parameters of TCN, FreTS, and Transformer encoders. This method enhances the ability of the prediction model to extract meaningful features and improves the prediction accuracy. By integrating TCN, FreTS, and Transformer encoders, our model constructs a unified prediction framework that takes into account local feature extraction, frequency-based optimization, and global dependency learning. This synergy enables the model to achieve high accuracy, strong noise resistance, and adaptability to various prediction tasks.

title: Computer tomography image reconstruction method and system based on extremely sparse scanning
description: The present invention relates to a computer tomography image reconstruction method and system based on extremely sparse scanning, including: obtaining the original scanning data of a CT machine and the reconstructed image of a standard algorithm; building a generative adversarial network; designing a loss function and training the generative adversarial network; combining the VdCS algorithm and the CT-RDNet network through a feedback path to construct an extremely sparse scanning CT image reconstruction framework, namely, a CSUF image reconstruction framework; obtaining scanning data of an extremely sparse scanning mode of a CT machine, namely, extremely sparse scanning data; using the extremely sparse scanning data as input, the CSUF image reconstruction framework performs extremely sparse scanning CT image reconstruction, and outputs a reconstructed image that meets the needs of clinical diagnosis of imaging. The method of the present invention can obtain CT images that meet the needs of clinical diagnosis of imaging under extremely sparse scanning conditions, and has good robustness and engineering practicality.

title: An interactive physical education teaching method based on large models
description: The present invention relates to the field of physical education technology, and in particular to an interactive physical education teaching method based on a large model, which aims to achieve real-time monitoring of students' sports status and personalized training guidance through advanced sensor technology and machine learning models. The method includes the following steps: First, the student's sports data is collected in real time through a camera and a depth sensor, including information such as movement posture, speed, reaction time and heart rate. Then, the collected data is input into a pre-trained large model, which includes a convolutional neural network, a support vector machine and a random forest model, which are respectively used to evaluate the student's movement standardization, exercise intensity and fatigue level. The large model automatically generates personalized training items, captures the student's movement posture in real time, and provides real-time feedback to correct movement deviations. The present invention improves the scientificity and personalization level of physical education by comprehensively using a variety of technical means, and has broad application prospects.

title: Federated learning city information model based on blockchain and MPC and its construction method
description: The invention discloses a federal learning city information model based on a blockchain and an MPC and a construction method thereof, which are used for serving the fields of intelligent city management and information security. Through multiparty secure computing technology, secure sharing and model optimization of data are realized under the condition that local data of each city management department are not revealed. The MPC protocol allows parties to perform cooperative computation in a data encryption state, and ensures safe aggregation and updating of global model parameters. Meanwhile, by combining the decentralization and traceability characteristics of the blockchain technology, a non-tamperable verification mechanism is provided for the data sharing process, and data tampering and counterfeiting are prevented. The federal learning city information model provided by the invention is suitable for smart city scenes such as city traffic, energy optimization, environment monitoring and the like, effectively solves the problems of data privacy leakage, calculation pressure, model safety and the like in a centralized system, and enhances the safety and performance of a city information model system.

title: Method, device and medium for semantic segmentation detection of marine mammal click signals
description: The application discloses a semantic segmentation detection method, equipment and medium for marine mammal click sound signals, and relates to the field of voice recognition, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining original sound signals of marine mammals; the method comprises the steps of processing an original acoustic signal to obtain a time-frequency diagram, introducing Bayesian convolution and wavelet transformation convolution into an encoder-decoder framework to construct an acoustic image semantic segmentation network model, and inputting the time-frequency diagram into the acoustic image semantic segmentation network model to obtain a semantic segmentation detection result of a marine mammal click acoustic signal. The application can detect local tiny voiceprints contained in the marine mammal acoustic signals, avoid the problems of omission and the like, and further improve the accuracy of the marine mammal click signal segmentation detection.

title: Vector building element capping conflict processing method based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and provides a vector building element capping conflict processing method based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of determining and constructing a constraint Delaunay triangle network and skeleton line segments among vector building elements in a target space region to generate a space conflict detection field model; the method comprises the steps of connecting each vector building element with the central points of other surrounding vector building elements, combining a space conflict detection field model to determine abnormal vector building elements with gland conflicts, determining the current state information of the abnormal vector building elements, carrying out data grouping according to the area scale of the abnormal vector building elements to set constraint condition parameters and action rewarding information of each group, combining a DQN model to obtain action prediction information, and controlling the abnormal vector building elements to execute position movement action until the optimal position according to the action prediction information. The proposal provided by the invention improves the processing efficiency, precision and feasibility of gland conflict.

title: Furniture manufacturing system based on multidimensional sensing and intelligent regulation
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of information, and particularly relates to a furniture manufacturing system based on multidimensional sensing and intelligent regulation. The method is characterized in that a plurality of sensors are deployed on a cutting tool and a spray gun of the industrial robot, and the high-precision cutting of the plate and the optimization of the surface coating quality of furniture are realized by utilizing the multi-sensor fusion and multi-mode data fusion technology and combining algorithms such as real-time compensation and self-adaptive spraying. Through degree of depth study discernment mortise and tenon structure, the cooperation flexible control accomplishes the fast assembly. The multi-robot collaborative scheduling is realized by using reinforcement learning, and the manufacturing process is optimized by means of digital twin and virtual simulation. The technology effectively solves the problems of cutting precision, mortise and tenon assembling, coating quality and the like in furniture manufacturing, greatly improves production efficiency and product quality, and meets the requirements of industry on high-precision, high-efficiency and high-quality production.

title: Layout method, system and storage medium of partial discharge detection sensor of high-voltage equipment
description: The embodiment of the present invention provides a method, system and storage medium for the layout of partial discharge detection sensors of high-voltage equipment. The method for the layout of partial discharge detection sensors of high-voltage equipment includes obtaining type and model information of multiple high-voltage equipment in a target area; determining the radiation area data and the first installation area of the high-voltage equipment corresponding to the type and model information according to each type and model information and position information, and the first installation area is an area where the sensor can be installed determined according to the historical false detection data of the high-voltage equipment: based on the first installation area corresponding to the target installed high-voltage equipment, according to the historical defect information and radiation area data corresponding to the target installed high-voltage equipment, the layout information of the partial discharge detection sensor is obtained; according to the layout information, the partial discharge detection sensor is laid out and set on the digital twin model of the target installed high-voltage equipment. The layout position accuracy of the partial discharge detection sensor can be effectively improved, thereby improving the correctness of partial discharge detection.

title: A dynamic multi-target tracking and trajectory prediction method
description: The present invention relates to the field of multi-target tracking technology, specifically to a dynamic multi-target tracking and trajectory prediction method. The method includes: collecting color images and depth images for preprocessing; constructing a dynamic threshold two-stream neural network, extracting features from the preprocessed color images and depth images, obtaining a visual feature set and a depth feature set, fusing them through an adaptive attention mechanism to obtain a fused feature set, and combining the dynamic threshold to obtain an observation information list of the target; updating the observation information list through a self-motion decoupling mechanism to obtain a real information list; establishing spatial and temporal associations between targets and trajectories based on the real information list to obtain the latest trajectory set; analyzing target characteristics, environmental constraints, social behaviors, and historical trajectories, generating predicted trajectories for each target and corresponding multi-factor scores, generating a time-varying influence diagram, and adopting a two-layer decision mechanism for planning and decision-making.

title: A tea disease detection method based on improved YOLOv8
description: The present invention discloses a tea disease detection method based on improved YOLOv8. By constructing a data set containing 6560 high-quality RGB images, covering 8 common tea diseases and healthy control classes, a rich data foundation is provided for model training. At the model design level, the SPPFCSPC structure is introduced to replace part of the SPPF layer, integrating the advantages of spatial pyramid pooling and full convolutional network to achieve efficient fusion of multi-scale features; the SS-Conv module is used to replace the traditional convolution, integrating spatial pyramid decomposition convolution and adaptive attention mechanism to improve the feature extraction capabilities of low-resolution images and small targets. At the same time, an improved MPDIoU loss function is proposed, which optimizes the target positioning accuracy by calculating the multi-point distance information between the predicted frame and the real frame, so that the model pays more attention to the position deviation and improves the detection accuracy of disease targets of different scales.

title: A lightweight detection method for blood cell image adhesion and overlap
description: The invention provides a lightweight detection method for adhesion and overlap of blood cell images, which is characterized in that firstly, a C2f module is improved, a C2f-HCN module is designed, and the characteristic extraction capacity of a model for adhesion and overlap blood cells is improved by a mode of characteristic segmentation and multi-scale characteristic fusion. Secondly, in Neck networks, a novel hierarchical feature mixing module HFMM is designed, local features and global features are adaptively fused through a hierarchical attention mechanism, suitability of model feature expression is enhanced, and detection performance of the model on adhesion overlapping blood cells and edge blood cell images is greatly improved. In addition, LFDH detection heads are designed, and the weight reduction of the model is realized by combining BN technology and a shared convolution mechanism. The visual chart shows the excellent detection performance of the detection method. The invention can accurately identify various targets in the blood cell image, and the condition of missed detection and false detection of adhesion overlapping blood cells and marginal blood cells is greatly improved.

title: Metal loss detection method of pipeline magnetic leakage signal based on weak annotation
description: The application relates to the technical field of image processing and provides a pipeline magnetic flux leakage signal metal loss detection method based on weak labeling, which comprises the steps of converting an acquired magnetic flux leakage signal image into an RGB image, training a detection model by using a preset number of RGB images with rectangular frame labels so as to enable the detection model to generate a predicted rectangular frame, and training a classification model by using the RGB images with class labels so as to enable the classification model to acquire class confidence scores; generating a thermodynamic diagram based on the classification model, generating a fitting rectangular frame based on the thermodynamic diagram, calculating a fitting score by combining an overlapping degree evaluation result of the predicted rectangular frame and the fitting rectangular frame and a category confidence score, and performing metal loss detection on the magnetic leakage signal image to be detected by a target detection model through the fitting score to obtain a detection result. According to the method, the detection model and the classification model are cooperated, thermodynamic diagram and fitting evaluation are combined, the manual labeling requirement is reduced, and meanwhile, the metal loss detection precision is improved.

title: Complaint text classification method and device
description: The present invention provides a method and device for classifying complaint texts. The method comprises: determining multimodal features of user complaint texts; performing classification prediction on the multimodal features layer by layer based on a multi-layer neural network layer of a classification model; and using the layer-by-layer prediction results of any neural network layer as the classification result if the uncertainty probability of the layer-by-layer prediction results is less than a preset probability threshold; otherwise, continuing to perform classification prediction on the multimodal features based on the next neural network layer until a classification result is output. The method provided by the present invention utilizes multimodal features in a classification model, compares the uncertainty probability of the layer-by-layer prediction results of the neural network layer with a preset probability threshold, and implements classification prediction that is adaptive to the user complaint text, greatly improving the efficiency and accuracy of the classification prediction and ensuring the reliability of the classification results.

title: Image processing, image processing model training and image segmentation method
description: Embodiments of this specification provide methods for image processing, image processing model training, and image segmentation, wherein the image processing method includes: obtaining an image to be processed, a reference image, and prompt information, wherein the reference image is used to provide object reference features of a first category of objects, and the prompt information is used to provide object prompt features of a second category of objects; generating a task processing instruction based on the image to be processed, the reference image, and the prompt information, wherein the task processing instruction is used to describe an object processing method for the first category of objects in the image to be processed, the object processing method being obtained based on the object reference features and the object prompt features; and utilizing the image processing model to determine the object processing result for the first category of objects in the image to be processed based on the task processing instruction. By adding other categories of prompt information, richer and more comprehensive guidance information is provided, avoiding the limitation of the reference image and improving the processing accuracy of the image processing model.

title: Feature matching method based on geometric perception
description: The invention discloses a feature matching method based on geometric perception, which comprises a constructor, an information transmitter and a matcher, wherein key points, key line segments and plane point curvatures are extracted from images to serve as real geometric features, a semantic feature descriptor is generated by utilizing SuperPoint, after a filter is applied, the features are combined to construct a graph for each image, the information transmitter is used for integrating information between all local and global features, meanwhile, unnecessary representations in irrelevant foreground or background areas are ignored, the output of the information transmitter is composed of updated feature vectors, and the matcher adopts optimal transmission in SuperGlue to screen matching pairs to generate a final matching matrix, and utilizes LoFTR two independent softmax outputs to generate the final matching score matrix. The invention provides a feature matching method based on geometric perception, which strengthens geometric consistency of features, improves matching precision, enhances the effect of matching local features and improves the performance of estimating the pose of a camera by combining geometric information and a learning scheme.

title: Speed reducer sensor layout optimization method, system, equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention belongs to the field of fault testing technology and provides a method, system, device and storage medium for optimizing the layout of reducer sensors, wherein the method includes: performing local linear processing on fault characteristics to obtain a simplified fault characteristic matrix; performing measurement point sensitivity measurement based on the fault characteristic matrix; judging whether the fault sensitivity of the measurement point meets the target based on the measurement point sensitivity measurement, and ending the process if the target is met, otherwise resetting the measurement point until the fault sensitivity of the measurement point meets the target. The present invention sets multiple measurement points on a reducer fault simulation experimental platform, then extracts the fault characteristics of each measurement point, obtains a simplified three-dimensional vector by performing local linear embedding processing on the fault characteristics, and uses a convolutional neural network to carry out an index evaluation of the fault sensitivity of the measurement point, thereby optimizing the sensor layout based on the evaluation results and improving the accuracy and efficiency of fault monitoring.

title: Testing method and device for integrated electric drive system for forklift
description: This application proposes a method and device for testing an integrated electric drive system for a forklift, comprising the following steps: obtaining the factory parameters of the electric drive system of the forklift to be tested, and inputting the factory parameters of the electric drive system into a pre-trained adaptive physical model in combination with the test operating conditions to obtain simulated electric drive parameters; obtaining multiple sets of simulated electric drive parameters of the forklift to be tested under different test conditions as evaluation data sets, and inputting these evaluation data sets into a pre-trained performance evaluation model to obtain the operating temperature range, load limit, and maximum travel speed of the forklift to be tested. By integrating an adaptive multi-body dynamics physical model with a multimodal forklift performance evaluation model, a parametric virtual test system for the electric drive system is constructed, enabling efficient testing of all operating conditions without the need for actual vehicle movement and real-world environment simulation.

title: Request processing method and device of intelligent cabin and vehicle
description: The invention discloses a request processing method and device of an intelligent cabin and a vehicle. The method comprises the steps of obtaining request data, wherein the request data are used for representing user interaction requests received by an intelligent cabin of a vehicle, utilizing a comprehensive prompt word to drive a target request processing model to conduct disassembling and reasoning on the request data to obtain a reasoning result, wherein the comprehensive prompt word is used for determining a reasoning standard, the target request processing model is used for constructing and processing a plurality of reasoning tasks according to a task disassembling mode of a reasoning thinking chain, the reasoning result is used for determining response data corresponding to the user interaction requests, and generating interaction responses according to the reasoning result. The invention solves the technical problems of poor accuracy and low efficiency of the request processing method aiming at the complex task in the related technology.

title: Mine water damage risk dynamic prediction and risk evaluation method based on phase space support vector machine
description: The invention discloses a mine water damage risk dynamic prediction and risk evaluation method based on a phase space support vector machine, which comprises the steps of obtaining a one-dimensional time sequence of original data, and obtaining a delay time tau and a Cao embedding dimension m through an average mutual information method to obtain a multidimensional time sequence; dividing the multidimensional time sequence into training data and test data, and substituting the training data and the test data into a least square support vector machine regression algorithm to obtain a prediction effect. The method converts the one-dimensional time sequence data into a multi-dimensional time sequence and substitutes the multi-dimensional time sequence data into a support vector machine, and the data is divided into training data and test data to obtain a prediction effect with higher precision.

title: Reservoir area backwater risk analysis method and system considering condition risk value
description: The invention relates to the technical field of reservoir flood control scheduling, and discloses a reservoir region backwater risk analysis method considering condition risk value, which comprises the following steps of collecting basic data of reservoir flood control scheduling; the method comprises the steps of carrying out real-time warehouse-in flow Monte Carlo random simulation considering flood forecast errors to generate real-time warehouse-in flow, carrying out real-time warehouse-out flow Monte Carlo random simulation considering complex scheduling decisions to generate real-time warehouse-out flow, carrying out reservoir flood control calculation and reservoir backwater calculation based on the real-time warehouse-in flow and the real-time warehouse-out flow of random simulation, and carrying out reservoir backwater flooding risk evaluation of reservoir flood control scheduling according to conditional risk values. According to the reservoir region backwater risk analysis method and system considering the condition risk value, the reservoir region backwater flooding risk caused by subjective and objective uncertainty is quantitatively described, a knowledge graph of the reservoir region backwater flooding risk is formed, and the reservoir region backwater risk of the complex reservoir flood control schedule is effectively identified.

title: Supply chain collaborative management method and system
description: The present invention belongs to the field of supply chain management technology and discloses a supply chain collaborative management method and system. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a user portrait generation model, anomaly detection model, demand forecasting model and supply chain optimization model based on a cloud data center; collecting and processing real-time supply chain data of users; generating user portraits using a user portrait generation model based on the processed real-time supply chain data; performing anomaly detection using anomaly detection model based on the processed real-time supply chain data; performing demand forecasting using a demand forecasting model based on the real-time user portrait and the processed real-time supply chain data; and optimizing the supply chain using a supply chain optimization model based on the real-time user portrait, the real-time anomaly detection results and the real-time demand forecast results. The present invention solves the problems of poor data processing capability, poor real-time performance and low optimization strategy support capability in the prior art.

title: Mobile edge service migration system based on block type deep circulation Actor-Critic algorithm
description: A mobile edge service migration system based on a block type deep circulation Actor-Critic algorithm takes a user as a center, models a service migration problem as a part of observable Markov decision process, and realizes real-time migration decision by utilizing local system state information based on Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL). The invention models the service migration problem as a discrete time partially observable Markov decision process, and provides a service migration method based on a block type deep circulation actor-criticizer, aiming at ensuring the quality of service and reducing delay. The invention performs strategy optimization by combining the self-attention mechanism and the cyclic neural network, designs an encoder network combining long-term memory and embedded matrix, extracts hidden information from sampling history, and realizes end-to-end reinforcement learning and rapid learning of the optimal migration strategy. The invention effectively ensures the service quality and reduces the total delay.

title: Hospital management method and system based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention belongs to the field of hospital management technology and discloses a hospital management method based on artificial intelligence. The specific steps of using this management method are as follows: S1: Data collection and integration: S2: Artificial intelligence model training: S3: Intelligent diagnosis assistance: S4: Patient management and appointment optimization: S5: Drug management and personalized treatment: S6: Hospital resource management and optimization: S7: Continuous monitoring and feedback improvement. The present invention achieves a significant improvement in the quality and efficiency of medical services by integrating intelligent diagnosis assistance with patient management and appointment optimization. In terms of intelligent diagnosis assistance, advanced AI models are seamlessly embedded in existing diagnostic systems through precise model integration technology to ensure data interface compatibility and real-time interaction. After the doctor enters the patient information, the system quickly organizes and analyzes the data, and relies on powerful algorithm logic to quickly generate accurate diagnosis suggestions, providing strong support for the doctor's decision-making and significantly shortening the diagnosis cycle.

title: Federated learning method, system and electronic device for cross-subject EEG classification
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a federal learning method, a federal learning system and electronic equipment for cross-tested electroencephalogram classification. The method comprises the steps of constructing a federal learning framework based on a plurality of scattered clients, a global server, a global model and shared data ends, extracting an electroencephalogram data tag pair from the plurality of scattered clients through the global server to carry out mixed data enhancement according to differential entropy characteristics to obtain a mixed data tag pair, carrying out field generalized federal learning on the global model through the mixed data tag pair, obtaining unlabeled shared electroencephalogram data from target field data through the shared data ends based on sharing rate and aggregation parameters, generating mixed tags for the unlabeled shared electroencephalogram data, providing the unlabeled shared electroencephalogram data to the plurality of scattered clients to carry out field self-adaptive federal learning, and enabling the plurality of scattered clients to cooperatively train the global model for classifying the tested electroencephalogram. The embodiment of the invention provides a novel federal learning framework, which enhances the generalization capability of a global model.

title: Space-sky cooperative three-dimensional monitoring method and system for complex ecological environment
description: The invention discloses an aerospace collaborative three-dimensional monitoring method and system for a complex ecological environment, which are realized by a satellite layer, an unmanned plane layer and a ground control management layer, wherein the unmanned plane can dynamically select and store delay tolerant data according to the delay requirement of a data type or upload the delay sensitive data to a satellite. Meanwhile, a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning MADRL framework is introduced, a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperation mechanism and a dynamic task allocation strategy are combined, the organic combination of task scheduling and path planning is realized, and the task response speed and the resource utilization efficiency of the system under a complex dynamic environment are improved. The method not only enhances the cooperation capability of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, but also fully plays the global visual field advantage of the satellite, improves the robustness and the overall monitoring efficiency of the system, and provides an intelligent, efficient and flexible solution for the ecological monitoring task.

title: Electronic device and computer storage device
description: Electronic devices and computing storage devices are disclosed. The electronic device includes a host including a host memory, a first processor, and a second processor. The first processor updates the gradient based on parameters stored in the host memory. The electronic device further includes a Computation Storage Device (CSD) including a storage device storing the parameters of the gradient, the Optimizer State (OS), and the artificial intelligence learning model, and an accelerator configured to send the parameters, the gradient, and the OS to the storage device and receive the parameters, the gradient, and the OS from the storage device through an internal path. The electronic device further includes an interconnect configured to connect the host to the CSD and to transfer the gradient and the parameter between the host and the CSD. The second processor controls the accelerator to update the OS and the parameters based on the gradient and the OS.

title: Target identification method, device, equipment and medium based on discrete space multi-mode fusion
description: The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and provides a target recognition method, device, equipment and medium based on discrete space multimodal fusion, which obtains modal data to be recognized; inputs the modal data to be recognized into a target recognition model to obtain a target recognition result output by the target recognition model; wherein the target recognition model is to train a sub-model of the corresponding modality in the target recognition model to be trained according to each modal training data, update the codebook of the sub-model after the corresponding modality training based on the corresponding training result, and train the corresponding sub-models of each modality after the updated codebook according to the aligned modal training samples constructed based on the training data of each modality, combined with cross-modal contrast learning and codeword matching constraints, and the codebook is used to characterize the encoding rules of the corresponding sub-model encoder. The present invention can achieve efficient fusion of multimodal data in a unified discrete space and enhance the fine-grained expression ability and generalization ability of cross-modal representation.

title: RGSC-YOLO-based aluminum alloy ingot surface defect detection method and system
description: The invention provides an aluminum alloy ingot surface defect detection method and system based on RGSC-YOLO, the method comprises the steps of collecting an aluminum alloy ingot surface image, constructing an image dataset, preprocessing and marking the image dataset, dividing the image dataset into a training set, a testing set and a verification set, constructing an RGSC-YOLO detection model based on a YOLOv model, training, testing and verifying the RGSC-YOLO detection model based on the training set, the testing set and the verification set, and detecting defects of the aluminum alloy ingot surface image to be detected based on the RGSC-YOLO detection model after training, testing and verification. The RGSC-YOLO detection model can effectively improve the quality detection level of aluminum alloy ingots, reduce the number of floating point operands and parameters of the model, and increase the weight reduction of the model.

title: Method, system, equipment and medium for detecting abnormal traffic of encrypted network
description: The disclosure relates to the technical field of network security, and in particular relates to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for detecting abnormal traffic of an encrypted network. The method and the device improve the efficiency and the accuracy of detecting the traffic abnormality of the encrypted network by combining the edge calculation and the federal learning. The edge equipment independently trains the local model and uploads the local model to the central server, and the central server generates a global detection model by federally learning and aggregating model parameters. The method can be closer to a data source for real-time analysis, and delay and bandwidth consumption caused by data transmission are reduced. Meanwhile, centralized storage and transmission of sensitive data are avoided through local training and model aggregation, and data privacy is effectively guaranteed. The global model can accurately identify abnormal behaviors in encrypted traffic through multi-round optimization, improves network security protection capability, and provides an efficient, accurate and privacy-protected network security solution.

title: Prototype domain alignment feature coding-based cross-working condition bearing fault diagnosis method
description: The invention relates to a cross-working condition bearing fault diagnosis method based on prototype domain alignment feature coding, which comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition and preprocessing, S2, building a bearing fault diagnosis model, S3, building a composite loss function, wherein the bearing fault diagnosis model comprises an embedded layer, a self-care encoder, a hash encoder and a feature classifier Training the built bearing fault diagnosis model to lead the composite loss function Minimizing. According to the invention, mapping and alignment of the data feature space are realized accurately, the problem of data modal difference caused by working condition change can be solved properly, dependence on large-scale labeling data is reduced, model training and testing are performed by fully utilizing a small amount of labeled source domain data and unlabeled target domain data through an efficient domain adaptation strategy, the data labeling cost is reduced, and the adaptability and generalization capability of the model are improved. The method and the device remarkably improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis of the cross-working-condition bearing, ensure that the fault type can be accurately identified under different working conditions, and reduce the misjudgment rate.

title: Multi-station cooperative scheduling optimization method for pomegranate grain stripping production line
description: The invention relates to the field of manufacturing industry, in particular to a multi-station collaborative scheduling optimization method for a pomegranate peeling production line, which comprises the steps of collecting and processing a first business data stream from an internet of things interface, inputting historical sensor data into a business prediction model to generate a second business data stream; generating a third service data stream from the data of the multi-mode sensor array, constructing a multi-target service cost function through a business decision optimization engine, starting an iterative optimization business simulation process to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme, and generating a corresponding digital production work order from the optimal scheduling scheme. According to the method, by means of three business data stream fusion and multi-objective cost function construction methods, equipment states, equipment health cost and quality indexes are analyzed, comprehensive commercial value evaluation is generated, iterative optimization simulation and closed-loop optimization are started when conditions are met, scheduling optimization of timeliness and value fluctuation in perishable material scheduling is achieved, and commercial value creation and self-adaptive scheduling capability of production are improved.

title: Multi-agent cooperative sensing system and method
description: The invention discloses a multi-agent cooperative sensing system and a method, and belongs to the field of cooperative sensing. The system comprises at least two intelligent agents, a positioning module, an environment sensing module, a feature compression module and a fusion sensing module, wherein the intelligent agents are randomly selected to serve as a main intelligent agent, the positioning module is used for transmitting acquired positioning information to the communication module and the environment sensing module, the environment sensing module is used for acquiring a bird's eye view feature map according to acquired sensing data, the main intelligent agent transmits current positioning information to the cooperative intelligent agent through the communication module so that the cooperative intelligent agent can acquire the bird's eye view feature map under a corresponding view angle, the feature compression module is used for compressing space dimensions and channel dimensions according to the bird's eye view feature map and a preset space block to acquire a compressed feature map, the compressed feature map of the cooperative intelligent agent is transmitted to the main intelligent agent through the corresponding communication module, and the fusion sensing module is used for fusing all the received compressed feature maps to acquire a global sensing result. By implementing the invention, the intelligent agent perception result can be kept with higher accuracy at low bandwidth.

title: Grain counting detection method based on machine vision
description: The present invention relates to a grain number detection method based on machine vision, comprising the following steps: inputting a grain image to be detected into a trained improved YOLOv8x model to obtain the detected grain number; wherein, the improved YOLOv8x model replaces the PAN-FPN structure in the neck network of YOLOv8 with a BiFPN structure, and replaces all C2f modules in the backbone network and the neck network with C2fELB modules; wherein the C2fELB module includes a Conv convolution module and a Split module connected in sequence, N NewBlock modules connected in parallel, and a Conv convolution module; the NewBlock module includes a first DWConv convolution module, a Conv convolution module, and a second DWConv convolution module connected in sequence, and introduces a residual connection and an SE attention module; the beneficial effects of the present invention are: the optimized model is significantly lightweight and has high detection accuracy; and the hole diameter and hole distance detection can be well completed under both laboratory conditions and field environments.

title: Dual-carbon intelligent data management method and system
description: The present application relates to the field of data analysis technology and discloses a dual-carbon intelligent data management method and system, including: collecting dual-carbon data of multiple target groups; storing the dual-carbon data of each target group in corresponding data nodes according to a preset time window, and screening out key data nodes by voting between data nodes; uploading the corresponding dual-carbon data to the corresponding chain nodes of the first blockchain for storage according to the key data nodes of each target group, and establishing associations between the chain nodes of the first blockchain by analyzing the collaborative relationship between the target groups; dividing the first blockchain into different areas, and verifying the data upload process of each area of the first blockchain by the second blockchain to store and manage the dual-carbon data of multiple target groups; the present application can improve the security and correctness of the dual-carbon data storage process.

title: Manufacturing resource matching method considering customer demand preference and provider synergistic effect
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of complex heavy equipment manufacturing resource matching, and particularly relates to a manufacturing resource matching method considering customer demand preference and provider synergistic effect, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a corresponding multi-objective optimization objective function based on the purpose of MRMP problems, S2, representing MRMP as an abnormal composition, S3, converting MRMP problems into Markov decision processes based on the abnormal composition, constructing an agent for solving MRMP problems, designing corresponding state space, action space and rewarding functions for the agent, S4, training the agent by using an agent training model based on a graph attention mechanism and deep reinforcement learning, training the agent to independently explore an optimal strategy of MRMP problems, and obtaining the trained agent, and S5, solving actual MRMP problems through the trained agent. The method can obtain the manufacturing resource matching method for simultaneously optimizing the satisfaction of the client demand preference and the cooperative effect of the suppliers on the premise of ensuring the solving efficiency of the algorithm.

title: Multi-protocol fusion method and system for converting intelligent gateway data of Internet of things equipment
description: The present application relates to the field of data processing technology, and discloses a data conversion method and system for a multi-protocol fusion IoT device intelligent gateway. The method comprises: collecting multi-protocol device data packets, extracting protocol features and constructing a vector library; identifying protocol types and parsing data based on the vector library, and constructing a set of data objects with semantic labels; analyzing semantic relevance through an adaptive learning algorithm, and establishing a dynamic protocol semantic mapping matrix; converting data into a standard format according to the mapping matrix and recording the matching degree to form a target data pool; extracting fused data from the data pool, and re-encoding the output data frame according to the target protocol format. The present application solves the problem of the lack of protocol semantic understanding and adaptive learning capabilities in existing multi-protocol fusion data conversion methods, and improves the semantic consistency and conversion quality of data conversion between multi-protocol devices.

title: Electric field application control method and system for multi-range dynamic noninvasive non-contact treatment device
description: The invention discloses an electric field application control method and system of a multi-lesion dynamic noninvasive non-contact treatment device, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting tumor images of a patient, dividing tumor lesions, determining the number and the volume of the lesions, executing S2 if the number and the volume of the lesions are multi-lesion, S2, determining electrode plates acting on different lesions according to the volume of the tumor lesions, determining the intensity and the frequency of an electric field, S3, determining the output voltage phase of the electrode plates based on an asymmetric phase modulation model, and S4, adopting a time division energy distribution strategy to regulate and control the field intensity of an electrode array. By adopting the technical scheme, multi-range phase compensation is established, field intensity equalization is realized by adjusting the phase difference of the electrode array, and the field intensity is distributed according to the volume weight to adapt to the shape change of the tumor.

title: Frequency modulation instruction prediction method and system for thermal power generating unit coupling super capacitor energy storage
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for predicting frequency modulation instructions for a thermal power unit coupled with supercapacitor energy storage, which relates to the technical field of energy storage frequency modulation in power systems. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining an original frequency modulation sequence through the frequency modulation instructions of the thermal power unit and dividing it into a training group, a proofreading group, and a prediction group; training the training group through a BP neural network to generate a prediction value for the proofreading group; calculating a difference error and a ratio error based on the actual value and the predicted value of the proofreading group, respectively, to form a difference error sequence and a ratio error sequence; adjusting the frequency modulation instruction value of the prediction group to generate a difference error interval; adjusting the frequency modulation instruction value of the prediction group according to the ratio error sequence to generate a ratio error interval; and combining the difference error interval with the ratio error interval to obtain an interval prediction value of the final frequency modulation instruction. The method significantly improves the prediction accuracy of the frequency modulation instruction and avoids the uncertainty caused by single numerical prediction.

title: Multi-source data fusion and AI-driven head and neck cancer patient symptom management method and intelligent system
description: The invention provides a head and neck cancer patient symptom management method and system based on multi-source data fusion and AI driving, which dynamically fuses characteristics and constructs unified knowledge representation by integrating multi-mode data such as electronic medical records, wearable equipment, questionnaires, science popularization videos and the like through a concentration mechanism. And establishing a dynamically-expanded symptom-risk-intervention knowledge graph based on a Bayesian network and a Graph Neural Network (GNN), and realizing cross-layer symptom recommendation by combining a collaborative filtering algorithm. And evaluating symptom severity in real time through XGBoost algorithm, outputting tri-color early warning, and finally continuously optimizing the knowledge graph through reinforcement learning based on patient feedback data. The method realizes accurate and personalized symptom management of patients with head and neck cancer.

title: Rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on multi-scale residual attention network and adaptive Transformer encoder
description: A rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on a multi-scale residual error attention network and an adaptive transducer encoder comprises the steps of obtaining original vibration data in the running process of the rolling bearing, dividing the collected original vibration data into samples with specified lengths, dividing the samples into a training data set and a test data set, inputting the training data set into the multi-scale residual error attention network for preliminary multi-scale feature extraction, inputting feature information extracted by the multi-scale residual error attention network into the adaptive transducer encoder for obtaining time sequence features, inputting the obtained feature information into a Softmax layer for fault diagnosis after GAP processing, repeatedly executing forward propagation and backward propagation calculation to optimize model parameters until the diagnosis accuracy and loss of the training data set reach a stable level, inputting the test data set into a trained model for fault diagnosis, and determining the health condition of the rolling bearing. The method of the invention enhances the adaptability and the diagnosis accuracy of the rolling bearing in time sequence dependent scenes such as fault diagnosis and the like.

title: A photovoltaic power short-term prediction method and device based on cloud evolution
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of photovoltaic power prediction, and discloses a photovoltaic power short-term prediction method and device based on cloud evolution, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring real-time cloud image data, relevant meteorological data, historical photovoltaic power and solar radiation variable data of a region to be predicted; extracting texture features of cloud image data, carrying out noise reduction treatment on other collected variable data, carrying out processing training on the preprocessed cloud image data by adopting an application model RepViTS-YOLOX to obtain cloud image prediction data, carrying out training on related meteorological data by adopting a shallow lightweight model SAMformer to obtain a temperature and humidity prediction value, calculating solar radiation by using an empirical formula Hargreaves equation, inputting the data into an adaptive network TSLANet for training, and finally obtaining short-term prediction of photovoltaic power. According to the method, high robustness prediction in a complex environment is realized, photovoltaic power generation planning and energy storage scheduling can be optimized, the light rejection rate is reduced, the energy utilization rate is improved, a reliable basis is provided for power grid scheduling, and the power grid stability is enhanced.

title: Model training method, device, electronic device, computer-readable storage medium, and computer program product based on knowledge distillation
description: The application provides a model training method, a device, electronic equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product based on knowledge distillation; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a first sample data set, wherein the first sample data set comprises a plurality of first annotation texts, a first sample image corresponding to each first annotation text has different visual effect types and comprises a plurality of objects, invoking a pre-trained teacher model, generating a first generation image based on the first annotation texts, generating a second generation image based on the first generation image and the first annotation texts through a student model to be trained, determining knowledge distillation loss of the student model based on the first generation image and the second generation image, and updating model parameters of the student model based on the knowledge distillation loss to obtain the trained student model. According to the application, the images with different visual effects and containing a plurality of objects can be generated through the trained student model, and the generation quality of the images can be improved.

title: Intelligent VR rehabilitation program formulation method and system based on scene adaptive control
description: The present invention proposes an intelligent VR rehabilitation program formulation method and system based on scene adaptive regulation, which belongs to the field of VR rehabilitation training technology; it includes collecting multi-dimensional physiological data of the human body and performing time alignment; using a temporal attention fusion network to dynamically model the temporal correlation of multi-dimensional physiological data, generating a multi-dimensional state vector and encapsulating it as a JSON protocol package; parsing the JSON protocol package based on a hierarchical decision architecture and performing scene adaptive regulation; driving the scene library to switch between different scenes to generate a dynamic rehabilitation program adapted to the user's neural network; and realizing real-time coupling of physiology and scene through a cross-modal mapping engine, thereby achieving quantitative tracking of the user's rehabilitation process and dynamic optimization of the rehabilitation program. Based on the structure of an integrated VR device, the present invention realizes real-time correspondence between the user's physiology and scene through the implementation decision-making of multi-source heterogeneous data, greatly improving the personalized adaptation level of VR rehabilitation training.

title: Improved foundation SAR high coherence point selection method
description: The present invention relates to the field of image processing technology, specifically to an improved ground-based SAR high-coherence point selection method, comprising the following steps: extracting amplitude and phase frames to calculate statistical features and fusing them to generate an index graph, dividing regions to construct grayscale histograms to generate Boolean masks, establishing a co-occurrence matrix to eliminate abnormal regions, establishing pixel connection relationships to generate a graph structure, and mapping paths to output a high-coherence point selection scheme. In the present invention, a multi-source fusion layer is constructed in combination with amplitude and phase features to enhance the image discrimination dimension, the region recognition accuracy is improved by grayscale frequency interval extraction and Boolean mask generation, the grayscale co-occurrence matrix is used to extract local structural features and combined with boundary coherence and density features to eliminate abnormal pixels, a graph structure relationship based on adjacency paths is established to form a pixel connection network, from which a pixel set with aggregation and connectivity is screened to achieve high-coherence point clustering output, thereby enhancing the integrity of structural expression in complex regions and the aggregation rationality of target point selection.

title: Small sample semantic segmentation method based on object query
