description: The present invention discloses a small-sample semantic segmentation method based on object query, comprising the following steps: generating N object prototypes through a mask pooling operation, where the object prototypes include the first N/2 foreground prototypes and the last N/2 background prototypes; based on the object prototypes, performing class correlation enhancement on support set features and query image features through a feature fusion module to generate enhanced features; inputting the enhanced features and the object prototypes into a bidirectional Transformer module, performing bidirectional interaction at the pixel level and the object level through a mask attention mechanism for foreground-background separation, and outputting segmentation features; generating a final semantic segmentation mask based on the segmentation features. The present invention effectively reduces the background interference problem.

title: Pollen viability detection model construction and pollen viability detection method, device and equipment
description: The invention relates to the technical field of electronics, and discloses a pollen vitality detection model construction method, a pollen vitality detection device and pollen vitality detection equipment, wherein the pollen vitality detection model construction method is used for carrying out pollen particle detection on each pollen image data in pollen data sets to obtain a plurality of target pollen particle data in corresponding pollen image data, carrying out visual feature extraction on each target pollen particle data to obtain target visual index data of corresponding target pollen particles, constructing a related data set according to the target visual index data and the vitality label data of each target pollen particle data, training a preset machine learning model by utilizing the related data set, and finally obtaining a pollen vitality detection model which can output corresponding vitality label data according to the target visual index data of single pollen, thereby realizing rapid and accurate detection of pollen vitality.

title: Magnetic resonance physiological signal analysis method and system
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of magnetic resonance physiological signal analysis, and specifically to a magnetic resonance physiological signal analysis method and system. The method comprises the following steps: S1: acquiring at least two different types of physiological signal time series from a target region within the brain of each subject; S2: extracting physiological state characteristic indicators from the at least two physiological signal time series within a preset continuous time window; S3: combining the physiological state characteristic indicators extracted from the different physiological signals to form a multi-information state representation corresponding to the time window; S4: constructing a physiological state evolution path for the subject, where the physiological state evolution path is a continuous sequence of state representations within multiple time windows; S5: extracting path characteristic parameters for each physiological state evolution path; and S6: identifying differences in physiological activity processes between different population groups. This method can improve the accuracy of identifying dynamic differences in physiological activity processes within the brain between different population groups.

title: Intelligent anesthesia atomizing equipment state monitoring method and system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of medical equipment monitoring, in particular to an intelligent anesthesia atomizing equipment state monitoring method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting atomization flow, particle size distribution, motor vibration frequency, liquid medicine temperature and pipeline pressure, constructing a device state feature set, synchronously collecting brain electrical signals of a patient, constructing an electroencephalogram state vector, inputting the feature set into a support vector machine model, identifying the running state of the device, judging whether abnormality exists, constructing an atomization efficiency attenuation equation based on continuous data when the device state is normal, predicting future efficiency trend, inputting a prediction result and the electroencephalogram state into an anesthesia depth index dynamic balance model, evaluating suitability of atomization output to sedation reaction of the patient, and generating a prompt signal and uploading the prompt signal to a remote platform when the efficiency attenuation rate is too high or dynamic error exceeds a threshold value. The invention realizes the equipment state monitoring, efficiency prediction and nerve feedback linkage control, and improves the safety in operation and the evaluation precision after operation.

title: Project economy management system and method based on international engineering cost square and round model
description: This invention discloses a project economic management system and method based on the international engineering cost circle model. The system comprises: a data center comprising a data acquisition layer, an edge processing layer, a data storage layer, and a data fusion layer; an AI analysis layer, which uses a multivariate analysis system to establish an early warning model and output risk warning results; a model application layer, which matches corresponding decision instructions based on the risk prediction results output by the early warning model; and an application service layer, which displays the risk prediction results and their corresponding decision instructions. This invention relates to the field of international engineering project management and information technology, addressing existing issues such as a lack of coordinated analysis of core variables such as politics, exchange rates, and supply chains, an inability to respond to international market fluctuations in real time, and a reliance on empirical judgment in decision-making.

title: TSV packaging defect detection method and system
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for detecting TSV packaging defects. The method includes: using an eddy current pulse thermal imaging device to perform multi-dimensional excitation scanning on the TSV packaging structure to generate a three-dimensional eddy current field distribution feature matrix; inputting the three-dimensional eddy current field distribution feature matrix into a topological manifold decomposition module to separate defect features, and constructing three feature components based on a continuous homology analysis method: a structural deformation topological ring, an interface fracture chain, and a thermal stress anomaly surface; performing cross-domain fusion processing on the three feature components using a dynamic heterogeneous neural network, and generating a defect topology fingerprint map through a dual-path attention gating mechanism; inputting the defect topology fingerprint map into a multi-scale entropy value evaluation module to simulate defect evolution, and outputting a quantitative detection report containing defect geometric parameters, failure probability, and reliability threshold. Utilizing the embodiments of the present invention, a comprehensive defect detection system can be constructed to improve the accuracy and efficiency of defect identification.

title: A smart advertising management method and system based on big data
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent advertisement management. The intelligent advertisement management method and system based on big data comprises a dynamic map generation module, a false data screening module, an advertisement group generation module, a play sequence analysis module and a dynamic adjustment module, wherein the dynamic map generation module traverses Internet advertisements to generate advertisement relevance dynamic maps, the false data screening module analyzes, screens and eliminates false advertisements in the Internet advertisements by constructing a false data evaluation model, the advertisement group generation module generates advertisement groups for advertisements which are related to strong related advertisements in the maps and have integration values exceeding a preset integration threshold, the play sequence analysis module determines the insertion sequence of the advertisements in the advertisement groups, and the dynamic adjustment module dynamically adjusts the advertisement groups and the play sequence. The invention realizes intelligent advertisement delivery management, analyzes and eliminates false advertisements, maintains market order, and improves the trust degree of users on the platform and the return rate of users.

title: Graphite surface wrinkle defect detection method based on multimodal polarization feature fusion
description: The application discloses a graphite surface fold defect detection method based on multi-mode polarization feature fusion, and particularly relates to the field of defect detection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining polarized images of a plurality of polarized angles of an object to be detected, determining an intensity image, a linear polarization degree image and a polarization characteristic image according to the polarized images, carrying out defect detection on the intensity image, the linear polarization degree image and the polarization characteristic image through a pre-trained defect detection model to obtain detection results, carrying out characteristic extraction on the intensity image, the linear polarization degree image and the polarization characteristic image through a teacher network and two student networks respectively, carrying out characteristic fusion on the three extracted characteristics through a first selective attention module to obtain fusion characteristics, carrying out characteristic comparison on the fusion characteristics of the teacher network and the two student networks respectively to obtain two reconstruction characteristic differences, and carrying out weighted summation on the two reconstruction characteristic differences to obtain a defect thermodynamic diagram. Based on the method, the accuracy of defect detection can be improved.

title: Continuous monitoring method and system based on multimodal physiological parameter fusion
description: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligent monitoring, in particular to a method and a system for continuously monitoring multi-mode physiological parameter fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of continuously collecting physiological electric signals of a target individual in a plurality of behavior states; the method comprises the steps of periodically segmenting a multi-lead electric signal according to a heart beat rhythm and standardizing the multi-lead electric signal into characteristic fragments with the same time length and channel number, carrying out two-stage weighting processing on each characteristic fragment to obtain high-weight characteristic representation, carrying out characteristic alignment on the high-weight characteristic representation according to corresponding behavior states and carrying out fusion operation, inputting the fusion characteristic representation into a convolutional neural network to identify individual physiological states, and periodically judging whether a target individual is at present at risk of physiological abnormality. The method and the device effectively solve the signal distortion problem caused by neglecting multi-behavior state switching in the prior art, remarkably improve the characteristic adaptability and cross-state recognition robustness in a dynamic scene, and realize continuous and accurate physiological abnormality risk tracking.

title: Node electricity price scene generation method and device based on space-time combination and residual error diffusion
description: The invention provides a node electricity price scene generation method and a device based on space-time combination and residual diffusion, which relate to the technical field of electricity price scene generation, the method comprises the steps of preprocessing acquired multi-source time sequence data taking space-time association into consideration, such as node electricity price, wind-light output, load, date and the like, to form a historical node electricity price sequence data set, inputting a space-time combination neural network model, extracting space-time characteristics of the node electricity price data, after a node electricity price sample and a condition information matrix which are integrated with the prediction of time sequence dynamic and space topology information are generated, a residual error denoising diffusion model is input, and the electricity price probability distribution is subjected to refined modeling through a forward denoising process and a reverse denoising process, so that a node electricity price scene covering multi-dimensional uncertainty is generated, the time-space relevance and uncertainty of the node electricity price can be captured, the generated node electricity price scene is more real and close to reality, and a reliable decision basis is provided for optimizing a scheduling strategy of an electric power market participant.

title: System and method for predicting glass softening point
description: The present invention discloses a system and method for predicting the glass softening point, relating to the technical field of glass softening point prediction. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a preprocessing module, a BP neural network module, a minnow optimization algorithm module, and a prediction output module. The present invention utilizes the minnow optimization algorithm to optimize the weights and thresholds of the BP neural network, resulting in a simple structure and improved convergence speed and accuracy. Furthermore, the optimal solution obtained by optimization can be used to optimize the weights and threshold parameters of the BP neural network, significantly improving the performance of the BP neural network algorithm. This method has practical significance for improving the accuracy of glass softening point prediction.

title: Language model-based question-answering method, device, equipment, and storage medium
description: One or more embodiments of the present application provide a language model-based question-answering method, apparatus, device, and storage medium, the method comprising: obtaining a question to be solved; determining a task type corresponding to the question, and selecting a target first language model corresponding to the task type from at least one first language model; inputting the question into the target first language model, and having the target first language model generate a thought chain reasoning step corresponding to the question, and inputting the thought chain reasoning step and the question into a second language model, and having the second language model generate an answer corresponding to the question based on the thought chain reasoning step; wherein the number of model parameters of the first language model is less than the number of model parameters of the second language model. The present application can effectively reduce the computational cost and response delay of the model while ensuring the generation accuracy of the model.

title: A miRNA-disease association prediction method based on heterogeneous graph redundancy-aware network
description: The present invention discloses a miRNA-disease association prediction method based on a heterogeneous graph de-redundancy perception network, comprising the following steps: first, integrating similarity and association data to construct a heterogeneous graph, and projecting node features into the same space; then, inputting features and topological information into a model, decoupling features through an encoder, decorrelating them using a redundancy suppression mechanism, and fusing information by introducing bidirectional cross-attention and high-order interaction mechanisms; finally, outputting feature representations and making predictions. Experiments show that the prediction method outperforms existing models in indicators such as AUC and AUPR on the HMDDv2.0 dataset.

title: 5G FR1 shaping filter system and design method
description: The application provides a 5G FR1 forming filter system and a design method, and relates to the technical field of forming filters, wherein the system comprises a BBU intelligent prediction module, an RRU configuration management and dynamic coefficient switching module and an RRU unified structure channel filter module, wherein the BBU intelligent prediction module predicts an optimal FIR filter coefficient set in real time through a lightweight DNN model and transmits the optimal FIR filter coefficient set to the RRU, the RRU configuration management and dynamic coefficient switching module realizes flexible switching of coefficients by combining dynamic configuration instructions based on a pre-stored FR1 full-frequency-band initial filter coefficient set, and the RRU unified structure channel filter module is used for carrying out spectrum shaping filtering processing on downlink CP-OFDM signals after the target coefficient set is adjusted into an FIR structure. The application solves the problems of the prior art that the filter structure is scattered and the static configuration has insufficient flexibility through an AI-driven dynamic optimization mechanism and a unified hardware architecture.

title: A method and system for evaluating the operation of relay protection equipment
description: The present invention provides an operation evaluation method and system for relay protection equipment, which relates to the field of power systems. The method includes: using the current moment's sensory data of the relay protection equipment as input, generating a state prediction value for the relay protection equipment based on a preset digital twin model; performing a consistency check between the state prediction value and the sensory data of the relay protection equipment at the next moment and outputting a check report; determining the health state probability and network security risk value of the relay protection equipment based on the check report; and determining the reliability of the relay protection equipment based on the health state probability and network security risk value. The method senses the dynamic changes of the relay protection equipment in real time and performs state prediction, realistically reproducing the various conditions of the relay protection equipment in actual operation, thereby improving the authenticity and accuracy of the state prediction of the relay protection equipment. At the same time, the state prediction value is corrected in combination with the sensory data of the relay protection equipment at the next moment, ensuring the reliable operation of the power system.

title: A method for predicting battery voltage, specific energy and specific capacity based on Bayesian optimization-GRU
description: This paper proposes a method for predicting battery voltage, specific energy, and specific capacity based on Bayesian optimization-GRU. The method includes the following steps: defining and training a GRU network model whose input is battery attribute information and whose output is battery voltage, specific energy, and specific capacity; using Bayesian optimization to find the optimal parameter combination for the GRU network model; retraining the GRU network model based on the optimal parameter combination; and using the trained GRU network model to predict battery voltage, specific energy, and specific capacity. This method provides a systematic and efficient method for battery performance prediction.

title: A method, system, terminal and medium for temperature monitoring and route optimization of cold chain logistics
description: The application relates to the field of logistics transportation, in particular to a cold-chain logistics temperature monitoring and path optimizing method, a system, a terminal and a medium, which comprise the steps of performing real-time filtering and lightweight machine learning anomaly detection on a temperature sensor data stream through an edge computing node to generate a first-stage data stream; the method comprises the steps of uniformly converting multi-source heterogeneous data into a standardized format by utilizing a dynamic Schema registration mechanism to generate a second-level data stream, calculating a temperature stability score and a grade based on a sliding window model, fusing traffic data through space-time correlation to generate a third-level enhanced data stream, dynamically calculating an optimal transportation path by adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm, adaptively adjusting path cost function weights according to a real-time temperature control state, generating an emergency instruction by combining a grading response rule base, and finally issuing a decision instruction to vehicle-mounted equipment for execution. The application improves the timeliness, reliability and economy of transportation.

title: Method, device, storage medium and computer equipment for sorting evidence based on medical evidence
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a evidence ordering method, a device, a storage medium and computer equipment for medical evidence-based evidence. The method is applied to a man-machine conversation application program based on a large language model, and comprises the steps of receiving a prompt which is input by a user in a man-machine conversation interface of the application program and used for triggering a medical evidence, generating at least 2 sub-queries based on the prompt, searching each sub-query, recalling a evidence subset corresponding to each sub-query, forming an evidence set aiming at the prompt based on the evidence subset, carrying out relevance operation on the evidence in the evidence set based on the prompt, and sequencing the evidence in the evidence set based on a relevance operation result. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the evidence in the evidence set is subjected to correlation operation based on the prompt, and the evidence in the evidence set is ordered based on the correlation operation result, so that the searched evidence is matched with the requirement of a user, and the authority and accuracy of the medical evidence following are improved.

title: Brillouin distributed optical fiber sensing demodulation method based on spectrum inverse Fourier transform
description: The present invention relates to a Brillouin distributed optical fiber sensing demodulation method based on spectrum inverse Fourier transform, comprising the following steps, parameter control and data set construction: by modulating the external physical parameters applied to the optical fiber to be measured, synchronously adjusting the characteristic parameters of optical and other sensor devices, establishing a dynamic correlation between the Brillouin frequency shift and the Brillouin scattering spectrum; generating a random phase sequence, and converting the time-frequency domain scattering spectrum into a Brillouin time-domain response signal with wide-spectrum characteristics through inverse Fourier transform. The present invention directly obtains a single wide-band Brillouin gain spectrum time-domain curve by fixing the frequency of the radio frequency source, constructs a frequency shift solution model based on an artificial neural network, and directly realizes the extraction of the Brillouin frequency shift from the wide-spectrum time-domain signal. The demodulation speed and frequency shift resolution are superior to traditional methods. By optimizing the configuration of computing resources, the data processing efficiency is significantly improved, and the system meets the application requirements of distributed optical fiber sensing.

title: Providing gesture adjustment information
description: A computer-implemented method of providing pose adjustment information (110) for adjusting a pose of an anatomical structure (120) relative to a projection X-ray imaging system (130 a, 130 b) for acquiring a target X-ray projection image representative of the anatomical structure is provided. An initial X-ray projection image representing the anatomy and/or a camera image representing the anatomy is input into the neural network. An initial X-ray projection image is acquired with the anatomical structure in an initial pose (a  1 ) relative to the projection X-ray imaging system (130 a, 130 b), the camera image is acquired by a camera configured to view the anatomical structure, and is acquired with the anatomical structure in the initial pose, the neural network generates pose adjustment information (110) for adjusting an initial pose (a  1 ) of the anatomical structure relative to the projection X-ray imaging system (130 a, 130 b) in order to acquire a target X-ray projection image.

title: Methods, systems, devices, and storage media for determining the welding quality of weld joints.
description: The application discloses a method, a system, a device and a storage medium for determining welding quality of welding spots. The method comprises the steps of obtaining collected image data, controlling a service layer in a detection system to retrieve an identification model, and identifying the image data to obtain an identification result, wherein the identification model is obtained by training in a system layer of the detection system based on historical image data, the identification result is at least used for representing the welding condition state of the welding point, the historical image data comprises data of at least one abnormal welding point with an abnormal welding state, and the control service layer determines the welding quality of the welding point based on the identification result. The application solves the technical problem that the welding quality of the welding spot cannot be accurately determined.

title: A watermelon maturity detector and its detection method
description: This invention discloses a watermelon maturity detector, comprising a control circuit board, a display screen, a MEMS accelerometer, a camera, an electret microphone, an infrared rangefinder, and a housing with a striking hammer. The striking hammer uses a fixed stroke and spring design to ensure consistent striking force. The watermelon maturity detector's detection method includes the following steps: acquiring appearance images and distance information, and processing them through deep learning to obtain a visual maturity score; striking the watermelon to collect sound and vibration signals, processing them to obtain an acoustic maturity score; fusing the two through a machine learning model and dynamically adjusting the weights to output the maturity result. This invention achieves accurate assessment of watermelon maturity through visual and acoustic features, improving the accuracy and stability of maturity detection.

title: A method for real-time evaluation of flux uniformity in flux production
description: This invention discloses a real-time evaluation method for flux uniformity in the production of smelting flux, relating to the field of data processing technology. The method includes: constructing the distribution of the melt solidification impedance layer inside the particles from thermal radiation images; identifying component segregation boundaries inside the flux particles based on the melt solidification impedance layer distribution; generating segregation location markers based on the component segregation boundaries and thermal radiation images; verifying the temporal correspondence between the segregation location markers and the microstructure evolution process of the flux particles to establish a causal chain; adjusting the melt solidification impedance layer distribution based on the recapture of heat conduction shunting in the thermal radiation images when the causal chain breaks; and determining the component uniformity of the flux particles based on the adjusted melt solidification impedance layer distribution. This invention achieves high-precision evaluation of flux particle component uniformity by monitoring the thermal radiation characteristics of flux particles and accurately analyzing the dynamic evolution of the melt solidification impedance layer and component segregation.

title: Methods, devices and media for monitoring and evaluating pipeline overturning lining repair processes
description: The invention provides a pipeline overturning lining repair operation process monitoring and evaluating method, a device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein a PELT variable point detection algorithm is introduced, time sequence data are divided into different time periods based on the number of detected variable points, then different time period feature vectors are extracted, a transducer model is adopted to predict future features of process parameters based on the multi-dimensional feature vectors, the prediction precision of the transducer model is improved, so that accurate process parameter monitoring is realized, a multi-index decision CoCoSo method is introduced, and through multi-aggregation strategy fusion, the optimal solution is pursued, the consistency of strategies is considered, the reliability of decision results is improved, the reliable process state evaluation result is obtained, the dynamic monitoring and adjustment of overturning lining repair operation process parameters are realized, the repair quality is improved, and the safe and stable operation of a gas pipeline system is facilitated.

title: Instruction control system based on AI quality inspection results
description: This invention relates to the field of robotics technology and discloses an AI-based quality inspection result command control system, comprising: a multimodal data acquisition module for acquiring visible light images, thermal imaging images, environmental sensor data, and current camera parameters, and outputting the visible light image data, thermal imaging image data, environmental data, and current camera parameters; and a multimodal graph neural network analysis module for receiving the visible light image data, thermal imaging image data, environmental data, and current camera parameters to construct a heterogeneous graph model and perform feature extraction and defect identification, and outputting defect category information, confidence level, current camera parameters, and environmental data. This invention employs a multimodal data fusion acquisition method, combining visible light images, thermal imaging images, environmental sensor data, and camera parameters, achieving comprehensive perception of target information in complex scenes and solving the problem of misjudgment caused by insufficient information dimensions.

title: A fault diagnosis method, system, device, and medium based on multi-data fusion
description: The application discloses a fault diagnosis method, a system, equipment and a medium based on multi-data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting initial data, and preprocessing the initial data to obtain an initial feature matrix; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a sensor weight vector according to an artificial fish swarm algorithm, carrying out weighting treatment on an initial feature matrix according to the sensor weight vector to obtain an intermediate feature matrix, carrying out dimension reduction treatment on the intermediate feature matrix through a preset algorithm to obtain a target feature matrix, and constructing a bearing fault diagnosis model according to the target feature matrix to carry out fault diagnosis. The engine bearing fault diagnosis method based on multi-source data fusion is provided for the limitation of bearing diagnosis of a single data source, a feature vector group is formed by carrying out data fusion, feature extraction and dimension reduction analysis on multi-source data, and the on-line bearing diagnosis is realized by building a fault diagnosis model, and the system has the same beneficial effects.

title: A method and system for dynamically generating map dot data based on generative adversarial networks
description: The invention provides a map scattering point data dynamic generation method and system based on a generated countermeasure network, and relates to the technical field of intelligent security, and the method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting environment characteristic data and historical security case data in different application scenes from a security related map, carrying out standardized coding processing on the environment characteristic data and the historical security case data to obtain input characteristic vectors, S2, inputting the input characteristic vectors into a condition generator model to generate scattering point data, S3, carrying out authenticity judgment on the scattering point data by a discriminator to obtain authenticity probability, judging whether the authenticity probability is smaller than a preset threshold, carrying out parameter adjustment on the generator model, then returning to S2 to carry out iterative training on the condition generator model, and if not, deploying the generator model into a security map system, and further dynamically generating real-time scattering point data according to the current environment characteristic data associated with the security map system.

title: Recommendation Method and System for Textile Workshop Optimization Algorithm Based on Large Language Model
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for recommending a textile workshop optimization algorithm based on a large language model, and relates to the technical field of textile workshop scheduling, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a textile knowledge vector database comprising a one-stage textile modeling knowledge base and a two-stage algorithm code knowledge base; S2, carrying out textile domain adaptation fine adjustment on the large language model by taking the textile knowledge vector database as a fine adjustment data set to obtain a textile domain model, S3, based on the textile knowledge vector database, taking the acquired textile workshop scheduling requirement as input, and generating a recommended algorithm code for the textile workshop scheduling by using a retrieval enhancement generation method. According to the invention, the textile domain model is obtained by establishing the textile knowledge vector database and carrying out high-efficiency fine tuning on the large language model, and the executable codes are automatically generated by the retrieval enhancement generation method, so that the scheduling requirements and constraint conditions of different textile workshops can be adapted, the manual intervention cost is reduced, and the reusability and the scheduling scheme solving efficiency are improved.

title: Multi-label image classification method based on D-GCN and target detection network yolov5
description: The invention relates to the field of deep learning computer vision technology and the like, and discloses a multi-label image classification method based on D-GCN and a target detection network yolov, which is characterized in that a visual characteristic of each type of an image is accurately extracted by using a target detection method, a semantic decoupling method is provided, word vectors and image characteristics are subjected to multi-mode fusion to generate nodes of a graph, the method comprises the steps of carrying out characteristic extraction on an input image by using a ResNet101 model, classifying the input image through a maximum pooling layer and a full connecting layer to obtain a first group of confidence scores, carrying out target detection on the input image by using a pre-trained yolov5, summarizing frames detected by the network, calculating frames of each type to obtain a second group of confidence scores, cutting out the image according to the detected frames for each type, carrying out characteristic extraction on each cut image by using a ResNet model to generate tensor vectors, and finally obtaining a weighted average characteristic vector.

title: Multi-group chemical cancer subtype classification method based on graph-level structure fusion and site-level feature fusion
description: This invention relates to a multi-omics cancer subtype classification method based on graph-level structure fusion and site-level feature fusion, belonging to the fields of bioinformatics and artificial intelligence. Addressing the heterogeneity and complementarity issues among multi-omics biological data, this invention designs a multi-omics cancer subtype classification method based on graph-level structure fusion and site-level feature fusion. First, this invention integrates gene-gene graph structures from different omics using a similarity network fusion method. Low-confidence edges are automatically filtered out using structural entropy, and biological prior knowledge from protein-protein interaction networks is introduced to complete the graph structure, thereby constructing a biologically interpretable fusion graph. Then, a graph convolutional network is constructed on this graph structure to extract gene site-level multi-omics fusion features to improve classification discriminative ability. The proposed method significantly outperforms 12 mainstream multi-omics fusion models in terms of accuracy, weighted F1 score, and macro-average F1 score on multi-omics datasets.

title: State assessment methods, apparatus, and equipment based on frequency domain dielectric spectrum and surface potential
description: The application relates to the technical field of state detection and the technical field of machine learning, and discloses a state evaluation method, a device and equipment based on frequency domain dielectric spectrums and surface potentials, wherein the method comprises the steps of selecting a parameter combination represented by particles with highest fitness value as an optimal parameter combination when a particle swarm optimization algorithm converges or the current iteration number reaches the maximum iteration number, selecting a support vector machine using the optimal parameter combination as a trained support vector machine, and verifying the trained support vector machine by adopting a verification set to obtain the classification accuracy and F1 score of the trained support vector machine; when the classification accuracy is higher than the preset accuracy and the F1 score is higher than the preset score, the trained support vector machine predicts the aging state of the current multi-layer insulating paper according to the second splicing characteristic, and the aging state evaluation result of the current multi-layer insulating paper is obtained. The application provides an effective technical scheme for diagnosing and maintaining the insulation state of the oil-immersed transformer.

title: A method for data interaction in the energy internet
description: This invention discloses an energy internet data interaction method, including multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition and cleaning, security encryption and privacy protection, multi-energy spatiotemporal data fusion, intelligent analysis and decision optimization, three-dimensional visualization and interactive response, and real-time evaluation and strategy iteration. Homomorphic encryption and federated learning are employed to ensure the security of data interaction across the "source-grid-load-storage" system, achieving "data usable but invisible." The federated learning includes designing a regionally hierarchical federated architecture. This energy internet data interaction method automatically collects factual data on energy sources such as electricity, gas, heat, and water through IoT terminals (smart meters, weather sensors, equipment controllers, etc.), covering power sources, loads, energy storage, and pipeline networks. Data cleaning (duplicate removal, missing value filling, and format standardization) ensures data quality. Automated acquisition reduces manual intervention and labor costs, while high-frequency acquisition enables refined energy management. Data cleaning reduces the rate of outliers.

title: A Big Data-Based Efficiency Maximization Management Method for Hardware Processing Workshops
description: The invention discloses a hardware processing workshop efficiency maximization management method based on big data, which relates to the technical field of big data management and comprises the steps of obtaining historical hardware workpiece processing task video data and quantifying the class of proficiency of processing personnel in the hardware processing workshop; the method comprises the steps of carrying out clustering division according to the proficiency classes of processing personnel in a hardware processing workshop, initializing time consumption distribution of hardware workpiece processing actions under each proficiency, constructing a hardware workpiece processing action-effective/ineffective time consumption identification model, marking the type of the ineffective time consumption task of the hardware workpiece processing actions under each proficiency, carrying out causal tracing aiming at the type of the ineffective time consumption task of the hardware workpiece processing actions, constructing an ineffective time consumption causal list of the hardware workpiece processing actions, and generating an ineffective time consumption causal improvement task sequence of the hardware workpiece processing actions. The invention has the beneficial effects of improving the invalid man-hour analysis and improving the accuracy and realizing the maximization of the efficiency of a metal processing workshop.

title: A neural speech compression method and system
description: The invention provides a neural voice compression method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining original voice data, encoding the original voice data through an encoder to obtain a hidden vector, inputting the hidden vector into a layered residual vector quantization module, quantizing the hidden vector into discretized codes based on a multi-scale parallel token stream, inputting the discretized codes into a decoder for decoding to reconstruct a language signal to obtain a target language signal, wherein the encoder is configured to introduce high-level semantic representation extracted from a teacher network model through a cross-modal distillation technology when encoding the original voice data, and the decoder is configured to conduct contrast training enhancement with a multi-scale discriminator. The invention utilizes the deep learning signal potential structure to make breakthrough progress in low bit rate scenes, improves modeling capability and compression quality, and can be widely applied to scenes such as voice communication, audio storage, edge intelligent equipment and the like.

title: A Deep Learning-Based Multi-Source Data Retrieval Method and System
description: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning and data retrieval, and discloses a multi-source data retrieval method and system based on deep learning, wherein the retrieval method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional cognition harmonic space model, and representing data and query by taking symbolism, continuity and modularity as three orthogonal dimensions; the system comprises a three-layer cognitive architecture comprising a perception layer, an understanding layer and a generation layer, a bidirectional knowledge flow mechanism for realizing bottom-up feature abstraction and top-down concept visualization, a cognitive feedback loop for realizing dynamic adjustment of perception attention based on reasoning results, and a meta-cognitive monitoring module for introducing real-time evaluation of system certainty and reliability. The invention realizes the unified representation of symbol knowledge, continuous characteristics and multi-mode data, has high retrieval accuracy and has self-error correction and concept migration capability.

title: A vulnerability detection method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product.
description: The application provides a vulnerability detection method which can be applied to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The vulnerability detection method comprises the steps of obtaining an original sample, inputting the original sample into a preset generator, completing countermeasure verification after obtaining a countermeasure sample, analyzing the countermeasure sample, inputting an extracted entity into a preset knowledge graph to complete updating of the knowledge graph, and performing multimode searching based on updating of the knowledge graph to detect vulnerability information in the countermeasure sample, wherein feature alignment and cross-modal fusion processing are completed for the multimode sample in the preset generator. The application also provides a vulnerability detection device, equipment, a storage medium and a program product.

title: A reliability assessment method for aerospace electronic systems based on multi-source data fusion under design and manufacturing process constraints
description: This invention relates to a reliability assessment method for aerospace electronic systems based on multi-source data fusion under design and manufacturing process constraints, belonging to the field of electronic system reliability assessment technology. To address the problem of poor accuracy in reliability assessment of aerospace electronic systems under conditions of incomplete information, this invention first establishes a digital prototype model of the aerospace electronic system. Combined with a failure physics model, it establishes parameter degradation models for key components of the electronic system, thereby obtaining performance degradation reliability functions for each key electrical performance parameter of the electronic system. Based on the functional structure of the electronic system and the logical relationships between basic functional network nodes, a functional failure propagation network model of the electronic system is established. A Bayesian inference method is used to update the state of each functional network node of the electronic system, obtaining the functional failure reliability function of each functional network node. Then, based on the two reliability functions, a system-level reliability model is constructed to obtain the overall reliability curve of the electronic system.

title: A landslide susceptibility assessment method considering InSAR and multi-stage optimized random forest model
description: The invention relates to a landslide vulnerability evaluation method considering an InSAR and a multi-stage optimized random forest model. Selecting non-landslide points through multi-factor control and space layered sampling, selecting characteristic factors by utilizing a random forest classifier in combination with a pearson correlation coefficient matrix and a VIF method, optimizing a random forest model based on a Bayesian algorithm, and finally evaluating the performance of the model through various indexes to divide the susceptibility index into five grades. Compared with the prior art, the method takes the earth surface deformation rate identified by InSAR as a characteristic factor, and quantitatively analyzes the earth surface deformation rate and the susceptibility zoning result, so that the consistency of the earth surface deformation rate and the susceptibility zoning result is verified, the accuracy of a landslide susceptibility evaluation model can be effectively improved, an important reference is provided for landslide disaster prevention and reduction research, and the method is particularly suitable for geological disaster frequent areas such as southwest areas in China.

title: Large-model intelligent question-answering method supporting data correction
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent question and answer, in particular to a large-model intelligent question and answer method supporting data correction. The method comprises the following steps of S1, transmitting a question of a user to a question and answer system through an interface, S2, generating a preliminary answer by using the large model, extracting information related to the question from related external data sources, S3, carrying out data correction and fusion according to the preliminary answer and the external data, S4, generating a final answer by combining the preliminary answer and the corrected external data, and S5, designing a user interface, and allowing the user to evaluate the accuracy of a question and answer result or directly provide correction advice. According to the large-model intelligent question-answering method supporting data correction, the question-answering system can more accurately understand the deep meaning of the questions and the specific requirements of users, the individuation level and user experience of the questions and the answers are improved, the transmission of error information is effectively reduced, and the accuracy and reliability of the answers are improved.

title: Fusion method, device, equipment and storage medium of multi-source heterogeneous data
description: The application relates to a fusion method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of multi-source heterogeneous data, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data to be processed, wherein the multi-source data comprises an AI S track and a plurality of data to be aligned; sequentially aligning the plurality of data to be aligned with the AI S track in a space-time manner to obtain associated target data; and carrying out multi-mode fusion processing on the associated target data to obtain target fusion data. The method for fusing the multi-source heterogeneous data can realize the effective fusion of the multi-source data.

title: File data safety processing method based on artificial intelligence
description: The application relates to an archive data security processing method based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of obtaining original file data and identifying sensitive information according to a preset sensitive information identification rule, conducting desensitization processing on the sensitive information by means of a desensitization algorithm to generate desensitized file data, conducting batch vectorization processing on the desensitized file data to construct a vector database, obtaining a user query text and executing safety verification, obtaining relevant vector data from the vector database based on the query text after the safety verification to construct an enhanced prompt word, generating an initial text based on the enhanced prompt word by means of a preset language reasoning model, conducting sensitive information identification on the initial text to obtain content to be desensitized, conducting desensitization processing on the content to be desensitized by means of the desensitization algorithm to generate a reply text, and therefore safety desensitization and intelligent service integration of the file data are achieved, safety verification of the sensitive information is achieved, and query response efficiency and reply safety are improved.

title: Method of developing cancer diagnostic model and use thereof in developing cancer detection method
description: A method of cancer diagnostic model development is provided that includes constructing a training set and building a diagnostic model on the training set. The training set includes miRNA expression profiles from non-cancer subjects and cancer patients with two or more cancer types, and establishing the diagnostic model includes calculating a diagnostic index based on a selected set of miRNA biomarkers obtained from miRNA sequencing in a differential expression analysis of the miRNA expression profiles in the training set. Methods of detecting a target cancer with the diagnostic model so developed are also provided. The diagnosis model based on the 4-miRNA shows high performance in verification concentration, and can realize the sensitivity of more than or equal to 0.98 while maintaining the specificity of 0.99 when detecting various cancers including lung cancer, gastric cancer, biliary tract cancer, bladder cancer, prostatic cancer and glioma.

title: Individual psychological situation perception early warning system based on federal learning
description: This invention discloses an individual psychological situation awareness and early warning system based on federated learning, comprising a local terminal and a cloud terminal, with the local terminal and cloud terminal communicating with each other. The local terminal includes multiple smart terminals, all of which are also communicating with the cloud terminal. These smart terminals are used to acquire user-authorized user feature data from multiple preset dimensions to form a user feature dataset, which is then sent to the cloud terminal. The cloud terminal is used to input the user feature dataset into a risk warning model obtained based on federated learning to obtain current risk warning information. The cloud terminal is also used to acquire current intervention prompt information corresponding to the current risk warning information and send this prompt information to one of the smart terminals. This invention enables highly secure aggregation of user features uploaded from multiple smart terminals in the cloud, which is then input into a risk warning model obtained based on federated learning, promptly obtaining current intervention prompt information and pushing it to the user's smart terminal.

title: Structure optimization method based on mechanical embedded heterograph neural network
description: This invention discloses a structural optimization method based on a mechanically embedded heterogeneous graph neural network. The method includes pre-training the heterogeneous graph neural network, performing transfer learning on the pre-trained network to obtain a pre-trained model, embedding a preset mechanical loss function into the pre-trained model to obtain a mechanically embedded heterogeneous graph neural network, and inputting the real-time load conditions of the engineering structure into the network to output a second predicted value. This application achieves a balance between computational efficiency and accuracy by combining a pre-trained model with neural network reparameterization. The training time of the pre-trained model is significantly shortened, and the prediction accuracy is improved. Furthermore, the mechanical constraints and adaptive weight coefficients in the improved loss function make the iterative process more robust, thereby achieving the optimization of the engineering structure.

title: Block chain intelligent contract detection method
description: This invention belongs to the field of blockchain technology, specifically relating to a blockchain smart contract detection method, comprising the following steps: Step 1: Addressing the multi-stage path concealment and cross-contract semantic association complexity of attack contracts in price manipulation vulnerabilities, a dynamic semantic segmentation optimization framework based on reinforcement learning is designed; Step 2: The semantic segments output by the dynamic semantic segmentation optimization based on reinforcement learning are fused with heterogeneous features of "feature-behavior-intent" to provide highly discriminative fused feature inputs for adversarial contract identification based on attack intent reasoning and adaptive evolution; Step 3: To address the challenges of dynamic evolution and intent concealment in adversarial contract price manipulation attacks, the attack intent is fed back in real-time, and the feature library and segmentation strategy are dynamically optimized to quickly adapt to new price manipulation attacks and continuously evolve. This invention enables real-time perception of new adversarial attacks and completes blockchain smart contract detection.

title: Multi-agent code production method and system and electronic equipment
description: The application relates to a multi-agent code production method, a system and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of firstly partitioning codes according to logic units based on manually screened source codes and LLM, storing the partitioned codes through deep analysis and classification to form a code knowledge base and an available tool list, generating user intention and tool calling requirements through LLM deep analysis based on user requirements, generating preliminary codes according to the calling knowledge base and tools, debugging and compiling the preliminary codes for multiple times according to the code knowledge base until errors are avoided, and outputting final codes. The method improves the code generation accuracy, guarantees compliance through multi-mode analysis, grammar verification and the like, reduces deviation, reduces iteration of multi-round debugging, adapts multiple scenes through cross-language migration, and improves efficiency and quality.

title: Method and device for determining child rehabilitation regimen for post-traumatic stress symptoms
description: This invention provides a method and apparatus for determining rehabilitation programs for children with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). The method includes: acquiring children's questionnaire data and a target child's rehabilitation training curriculum; preprocessing the questionnaire data to obtain preprocessed data; performing a risk assessment based on the preprocessed data to obtain a risk assessment result; determining a first child rehabilitation program based on the risk assessment result; adjusting the first child rehabilitation program based on rehabilitation training data obtained from the first child rehabilitation program to obtain a second child rehabilitation program; and sending the second child rehabilitation program to a user terminal. This invention determines the corresponding rehabilitation program based on the actual situation of the child user and adjusts the rehabilitation program in real time based on rehabilitation training data during the rehabilitation training process to adapt to the actual situation of the child user, intelligently providing optimized rehabilitation programs.

title: Equipment running state identification method based on intelligent circuit breaker and intelligent circuit breaker
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent circuit breakers, in particular to an equipment running state identification method based on an intelligent circuit breaker and the intelligent circuit breaker; when data synchronization is carried out on data acquired by an intelligent circuit breaker, a time stamp is firstly generated on the data acquired by each sensor, the acquired data and the time stamp are packaged into a data packet, the data packet is sent to a data processing unit integrated by the intelligent circuit breaker, then the data processing unit carries out data alignment operation on the data packet, wherein an improved spline interpolation method is adopted for carrying out the data alignment operation, a physical model constraint condition is established, a linear equation set is established according to the physical model constraint condition, an interpolation coefficient is solved, so that a cubic polynomial function is determined, then data points after time alignment are generated according to the cubic polynomial function, the interpolation result is ensured to accord with an actual physical process by introducing the physical model constraint condition, and the reliability of subsequent analysis and state identification is improved.

title: Method and device for detecting multi-mode model cause harmfulness based on embedded large language model
description: The invention relates to the technical field of network security and artificial intelligence, and discloses a method and a device for detecting the harmfulness of a multi-mode model factor based on an embedded large language model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a visual description text from a multi-mode model image, then carrying out data enhancement on the visual description text and an original text, extracting visual features of the multi-mode model image and text features of the enhanced text, mapping the text features to a feature space matched with the visual features, realizing cross-mode alignment, fusing the visual features and the text features to obtain fusion features, processing the fusion features through a MoE hybrid expert classification model, and outputting the damage probability of the multi-mode model. The invention can realize the detection of the multi-mode cause harmfulness with high precision, high robustness and low cost.

title: Optimization method and related device of PVT-driven Brayton Carnot battery system
description: This invention belongs to the field of new energy power generation systems and discloses an optimization method and related apparatus for a PVT-driven Brayton Carnot battery system. The method first performs parameter sensitivity analysis on a pre-constructed numerical model of the PVT-driven Brayton cycle Carnot battery system to identify key variables: turbine inlet temperature and evaporation pressure. Then, with system electrical conversion efficiency and levelized cost of electricity (LCOE) as optimization objectives, a multi-objective optimization model including objective functions and constraints is established. Finally, the Pareto dominance method is used to solve the model, outputting the Pareto optimal solution set to determine the optimal operating conditions of the system. This optimization method effectively resolves the contradictory relationship between thermal efficiency and LCOE, significantly improving the overall system performance and economic benefits, and providing an efficient operation and control strategy for engineering practice.

title: Fruit and vegetable detection method for space station cargo hold
description: The invention discloses a fruit and vegetable detection method for a space station cargo hold, which is realized based on an improved LEBR-YOLO model, and the whole process comprises four core links of image preprocessing, feature extraction and enhancement, target detection optimization and transfer learning training. The method comprises the steps of firstly carrying out size adjustment and format standardization on collected fruit and vegetable images of a cargo hold, extracting edge contours and space distribution features through a double-branch structure of a EIEstem module, fusing the edge contours and the space distribution features into a multi-Scale initial feature map, then carrying out weighted fusion on global and local information through a Backbone deepening feature extraction and combining a double-layer routing attention mechanism (BRA_ nchw), focusing key areas such as shielding, small targets and the like, after completing multi-Scale feature fusion through a Neck structure, transmitting the multi-Scale information into a lightweight shared deformable detection module (LSDDETECT), carrying out channel standardization, carrying out deformable convolution dynamic feature extraction and Group Normalization optimization, optimizing boundary frame precision and size through Distributed Focus Loss (DFL) and Scale layers, and finally optimizing model parameters through a migration learning strategy of 'universal dataset pre-training+cargo hold dataset fine tuning'.

title: Precision dosing control system and device based on dynamic water quality sensing and intelligent feedback
description: This invention discloses a precision dosing control system and device based on dynamic water quality sensing and intelligent feedback, relating to the field of wastewater treatment technology. It includes a water quality monitoring unit, a water quality analysis unit, a dosage prediction unit, and a dosing execution mechanism. The invention collects real-time water quality analysis data from the water body and obtains basic data from the water treatment tank. Based on the water quality analysis data, it calculates the corresponding water purification demand coefficient for each area and assigns grayscale values to the water purification demand coefficient to obtain a water treatment demand distribution map. A nonlinear mapping model between the water purification demand coefficient and the dosing dosage is constructed based on a deep learning algorithm. The water purification demand coefficient on the water treatment demand distribution map is homogenized, and several dosing balance points are delineated on the map. The water purification demand coefficient corresponding to the dosing balance point is obtained, and the predicted dosing dosage is obtained. The dosing adjustment parameters are used to control the dosing pump group to achieve precise dosage adjustment.

title: A collaborative optimization method and system for container terminal loading and unloading operations
description: This invention discloses a collaborative optimization method and system for container terminal loading and unloading operations, aiming to improve terminal operation efficiency and resource utilization. The method includes: real-time collection of terminal operation data; establishing a mixed-integer programming (MIP) model with the objectives of minimizing the total time ships spend in port, the total travel distance of AGVs, and maximizing the utilization rate of quay cranes, while considering relevant constraints; solving the MIP model using an adaptive large neighborhood search algorithm; generating a scheduling scheme and sending it to the terminal management system for execution, monitoring the operation progress in real time and making dynamic adjustments. This invention achieves rational allocation and efficient utilization of terminal resources through collaborative optimization of berth allocation, quay crane scheduling, and AGV path planning, significantly improving the overall operational efficiency of the terminal.

title: A method and system for optimizing construction and operation parameters and managing data in water conservancy projects.
description: This invention discloses a method and system for optimizing construction and operation parameters and governing data in water conservancy projects. The method includes: Step 1, multi-source data access and vectorization; Step 2, temporal feature extraction and multimodal fusion; Step 3, interpretability influencing factor identification; Step 4, multi-task dynamic anomaly prediction; Step 5, risk-weighted fusion and uncertainty quantification; Step 6, digital twin simulation verification; Step 7, governance strategy optimization and security audit; Step 8, feedback collection and model adaptive update. The advantages of this invention are: by fusing structured data such as water level and flow rate with unstructured information such as meteorological images and operation logs, a unified multimodal representation is constructed. Combined with a spatiotemporal graph neural network for temporal feature extraction, this significantly improves the dynamic perception and prediction capabilities of complex hydrological processes, realizing a shift from static threshold alarms to multi-task, forward-looking anomaly early warning, and enhancing the system's adaptability to multiple scenarios.

title: Operation scene monitoring method and system based on panoramic stitching and cradle head linkage
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a system for monitoring an operation scene based on panoramic stitching and cradle head linkage, and belongs to the technical field of video monitoring. The method comprises the steps of respectively obtaining real-time panoramic video data and historical video data of an operation scene and partial discharge signals of high-voltage electric equipment, simulating electric disorder characteristics of the high-voltage electric equipment based on the partial discharge signals and environmental parameters of the real-time panoramic video data, obtaining operation prediction information of the real-time panoramic video based on the historical video data and the electric disorder characteristics, calculating deviation information of the real-time panoramic video based on the operation prediction information and the real-time panoramic video data, positioning a risk target area of the operation scene based on the deviation information, judging a risk early warning signal of the operation scene based on a preset risk rule base, and transmitting the risk early warning signal to a holder camera of the operation scene to monitor a close-up monitoring picture of the risk target area in real time. The invention can improve the risk disposal efficiency of the job scene monitoring.

title: A Knowledge Graph Relationship Prediction Method Based on Feature Extraction
description: The invention belongs to the field of knowledge map completion, and in particular relates to a method for predicting a knowledge map relationship based on feature extraction; the method includes: acquiring original data; constructing an initial knowledge map and a triplet to be predicted according to the original data; using trained neighbors The encoder processes the triples to be predicted, and obtains the triples with the correct relationship; the initial knowledge map is completed according to the triples with the correct relationship to obtain a complete knowledge map; the invention combines the feature extraction and the similarity computing mechanism to solve the problem. The traditional knowledge graph relationship prediction method requires a large amount of data to support the problem. The use of few-sample data can more accurately predict the knowledge graph relationship, obtain a more accurate knowledge graph, and improve the performance and computational efficiency of the few-sample relationship prediction method. with broadly application foreground.

title: A Text Detection Method for Arbitrary Shape Scenes Based on Enhanced Feature Pyramid Network
description: The invention discloses a method for detecting any-shape scene text based on an enhanced feature pyramid network, which comprises the following modules: the characteristic extraction module is used for extracting the characteristics of the input image; the ratio invariant feature enhancement module is used for enhancing semantic information; a reconstruction spatial resolution module for enhancing spatial information; the feature fusion module is used for fusing the features enhanced by the semantic information and the features enhanced by the spatial information to generate a plurality of segmentation results with different proportions; and the asymptotic expansion module is used as a post-processing module and adopts an asymptotic expansion algorithm to gradually expand and fuse the segmentation results of different scales generated by the feature fusion module to obtain a final text detection result. According to the method, the input image is understood by the text detection model through the fusion of the features of enhancing the semantic information and the features of enhancing the spatial information, and the text detection precision is improved; the post-processing module adopts an asymptotic scale expansion algorithm to sequentially expand the segmentation images with different scales from small to large, effectively predicts the real shape of the scene text and can well distinguish text examples with short distances, thereby realizing the detection of the scene text with any shape.

title: A method for identifying tail-biting behavior of group pigs in video based on computer vision
description: The invention relates to the technical field of target detection and behavior identification, in particular to a method for identifying the tail biting behavior of a group-bred pig in a video based on computer vision, which comprises the following steps: acquiring pig images, wherein the pig images comprise initial images of pigs, and labeling the pigs in the initial images; the images and videos used are shot from the top to the bottom, the size and the appearance difference of the pigs at the angle are small, the accuracy of recognition of a neural network is improved, the motion trail of the group-fed pigs is converted into pairwise interactive behaviors, the behavior recognition is specific compared with the behavior recognition on the group level, the efficiency is higher, the initial videos are converted into a plurality of sub-videos representing the interactive behaviors of the pigs, the data quantity used for training the network is increased, the convolutional neural network and the long-short term memory network are used for learning the characteristic information of the pigs on the time and the space, and the space-time characteristic of the tail biting behavior of the pigs is detected more effectively.

title: Construction method and system of automatic point selection for cutter suction dredger based on global optimal idea
description: The invention discloses an automatic point selection construction method and system for a cutter suction dredger based on a global optimal idea. The invention utilizes a dictionary search algorithm to search the construction command corresponding to the target productivity in the construction database and simultaneously outputs the construction command as a dredger construction operation command. In the aspect of processing the problem of searching a plurality of pieces of data with the same production rate, each data chain instruction is previewed in advance by using a trained machine learning model, and the data chain with the lowest energy consumption is selected as an output dredger control instruction. In order to effectively deal with the impact of sudden change influence factors on the system, the algorithm is embedded with insensitive delay control logic, so that the robustness of the system can be greatly improved.

title: A method and device for determining evaluation results
description: The invention discloses a method and device for determining an evaluation result, comprising: acquiring multi-dimensional evaluation data of an object to be evaluated, inputting the multi-dimensional evaluation data into a neural network model, and obtaining the object to be evaluated through each hidden layer in the neural network model The evaluation result of , wherein the neural network model is obtained after training according to the preset network model. When the preset network model performs forward propagation during the training process, according to the output value of the neurons in the current hidden layer, the current The output value of the neurons of the hidden layer is jumped and connected to the neurons of any hidden layer after the current hidden layer. Evaluate the object to be evaluated according to different multi-dimensional evaluation data of the object to be evaluated, so as to analyze the value of different types of objects to be evaluated from multiple dimensions, no longer use a single evaluation model to reflect the value of the object to be evaluated, and improve the investment of enterprises Comprehensiveness and accuracy of value assessment.

title: A Data Anomaly Detection Method Based on Distillation Mechanism
description: The invention discloses a data anomaly detection method based on a distillation mechanism, which comprises the following steps of 1: acquiring and preprocessing original data; 2: compressing and encoding the preprocessed data, and projecting the input data to a hidden space by an encoder to obtain an initial hidden vector; 3: inputting the initial hidden vectors into an aggregation module in a hidden space to obtain landmark vectors and weight vectors of all the initial hidden vectors, and obtaining constraint hidden vectors corresponding to the initial hidden vectors one by one through the landmark vectors and the weight vectors; 4: carrying out distillation filtration on the constraint hidden vectors to obtain clean constraint hidden vectors only containing normal mode features; 5: decoding and reconstructing the clean constraint hidden vector to obtain reconstructed data corresponding to the input data; 6: calculating an abnormal score by using the input data and the corresponding reconstructed data, and setting an abnormal threshold, wherein a sample with the abnormal score exceeding the abnormal threshold is an abnormal sample; the method can adaptively update the normal characteristics in the training process, and has high abnormality detection accuracy.

title: A Robust Chinese License Plate Detection and Correction Method in Uncontrolled Environment
description: A robust Chinese license plate detection and correction method under an uncontrollable environment belongs to the field of image processing. The current most license plate detection methods adopt matrix frame positioning, and in a non-controllable environment, if a license plate is seriously inclined or deformed, the license plate positioning is inaccurate, that is, the positioned license plate area has more backgrounds or incomplete positioning, so that interference can be caused to subsequent license plate identification, and the identification accuracy is influenced. According to the Chinese license plate detection method provided by the invention, ACON, RBN and deformable convolution are introduced, so that the feature extraction capability of a model can be improved, a detection head is improved, a corresponding coordinate regression formula is designed, a license plate with any inclination can be accurately positioned, and an ideal detection result can be obtained in various complex non-controllable environments.

title: A method for constructing a model of unmanned vehicle mobility
