description: The invention discloses a method for constructing a power model of an unmanned aerial vehicle, which describes the corresponding relation between a control instruction of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the driving capability of the unmanned aerial vehicle through a long and short memory neural network model, so as to design a model input and output variable, and according to the requirements of modeling of the power model of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the current moment speed, the current moment yaw angle, a voltage value, a timestamp, the next moment speed and the next moment yaw angle data of the unmanned aerial vehicle are used as model inputs, the speed control variable and the angle control variable are used as model outputs, and the corresponding relation is established; a long-time difference formed by the input and the feedback of the LSTM and the explosion avoidance is used for maintaining an uninterrupted error value, and finally the problem of gradient disappearance or gradient explosion is avoided.

title: A method of optimizing the flange structure of tire unloader by using multi-objective genetic algorithm
description: The invention discloses a method for optimizing a flange plate structure of a tire unloader by using a multi-objective genetic algorithm. The invention aims to fill the blank of the research on the flange plate of the giant tire unloader at present. And secondly, providing a method for optimizing the flange structure by using a dynamics, finite element and other numerical analysis platforms and combining an intelligent algorithm, and simultaneously carrying out comparison and verification by using different methods to ensure that the optimized result has higher reliability. And thirdly, the flange is structurally optimized by using an intelligent algorithm, so that the quality is reduced, the service life is prolonged, and the optimal flange plate structure is obtained.

title: A fault identification method for industrial signals based on graph regularization semi-supervised dictionary learning
description: The embodiment of the disclosure provides an industrial signal fault identification method based on graph regularization semi-supervised dictionary learning, which belongs to the technical field of data identification and specifically comprises the following steps: acquiring industrial signal data of target equipment; taking the labeled data and the unlabeled data as training data sets and inputting the training data sets into a semi-supervised dictionary learning model based on graph regularization to obtain training set sparse codes, a confidence matrix and a structural dictionary; bringing the test set signal and the structure dictionary into a classification model to obtain a test set sparse code of the test set signal; and calculating the reconstruction error of the test set signal, and identifying the fault type of the test set signal according to the reconstruction error. By the scheme, dictionary learning, semi-supervised learning and popular learning are combined, the manifold structure of data can be stored, the characteristics of label-free data can be learned, the discriminability and reliability of model learning are enhanced, and the recognition efficiency, accuracy and adaptability are improved.

title: A Knowledge Reasoning Method for Hydrogen-Oxygen Engine
description: The invention provides a knowledge reasoning method for a hydrogen-oxygen engine, including: a knowledge extraction system and a verification and optimization system; the knowledge extraction system includes a standardized knowledge graph system and a non-standardized knowledge graph system; the standardized knowledge graph system is structured data Sum; the non-standardized knowledge graph system includes semi-structured data and unstructured data that have undergone information processing. The invention overcomes the deficiencies of the prior art, has a reasonable design and a compact structure, and builds a knowledge map in the professional field by surrounding the liquid oxygen and liquid hydrogen engine engineering field. Perform knowledge extraction and other operations on the unstructured data collected from the business system platform, including entity extraction and relationship extraction, convert it into structured data, and then combine the structured data and corpus collected in the system to construct a solution The knowledge map in the field of oxygen-liquid-hydrogen engine engineering forms a knowledge map storage database.

title: Neural network execution method and system
description: The present disclosure provides methods and systems for performing neural networks. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a plurality of input vectors of input data; generating, in the plurality of input vectors, estimates associated with a subset of the input vectors based on a weight vector of the activation function; determining whether the estimate values associated with a subset of input vectors satisfy a threshold condition; and determining an output of the activation function based on the estimate.

title: Method, device and storage medium for accumulating image data
description: The present invention relates to a method, a device and a storage medium for accumulating image data, wherein the processing device of the present invention is included in an integrated circuit device, and the integrated circuit device includes a universal interconnection interface and a computing device. The computing device interacts with the processing device to jointly complete the computing operation specified by the user. The integrated circuit device may further include a storage device, which is connected to the computing device and the processing device, respectively, and is used for data storage of the computing device and the processing device.

title: A method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for generating a neural network
description: The present disclosure provides a method, an apparatus, a computer device and a storage medium for generating a neural network, wherein the method comprises: classifying the image data by using a teacher neural network to obtain a first image classification result, and classifying the image data by using a student neural network to obtain a second image classification result; determining a first loss based on the first image classification result and the second image classification result; the first loss is used for characterizing the difference between a first distribution characteristic of the first image classification result and a second distribution characteristic of the second image classification result; and adjusting network parameters of the student neural network based on the first loss to obtain a target neural network for image classification.

title: Electronic device and method of controlling the same
description: An electronic device and a method of controlling the same are disclosed. A method of controlling an electronic device using an artificial intelligent neural network model according to the present disclosure includes identifying a number of users located within a predetermined distance from the electronic device, obtaining information about a plurality of users based on the identification of the number of users as a plurality, determining at least one service by inputting the information about the plurality of users to a user-user neural network model that determines a relationship between the plurality of users, and providing the at least one service to the plurality of users.

title: Fault Detection in Synchronized Machines
description: A method of fault detection in a synchronous machine, the method comprising determining a parameter associated with a magnetic field generated within the synchronous machine using at least one sensor, the parameter comprising a parameter based on one or more of magnetic field strength, rotor current or voltage, stator current or voltage, and vibration. The sensor measurements are processed to identify data artifacts associated with the magnetic field, wherein the processing includes one or more signal processing techniques based on time, frequency, and both time and frequency. The output of the signal processing is then analyzed to identify and classify irregularities in the magnetic field indicative of a fault in the synchronous machine. The analyzing step includes identifying patterns in the processed sensor measurements by using computer-aided pattern recognition techniques, such as by machine learning algorithms.

title: A method, device, equipment and storage medium for fault rescheduling of metal mine operation
description: The invention relates to a fault rescheduling method, device, equipment and storage medium for metal mine operation. The method includes: obtaining an initial plan and a historical plan for simultaneous operation of multiple equipment; determining the occurrence probability of equipment failure according to the historical plan; Determine the equipment failure period in the initial plan; determine all rescheduling periods according to the intersection of all equipment failure periods; build a rescheduling plan preparation model according to all rescheduling periods; build a rescheduling plan preparation model according to the preset optimization algorithm Optimize according to the preset order to obtain the target rescheduling plan; according to the target rescheduling plan, schedule multiple equipment for operation. The method for re-scheduling metal mine operation failure provided by the invention guides the scheduling operation of the equipment on the premise of not increasing the number of equipment when the equipment fails, improves the equipment use efficiency of the mining equipment and the completion rate of the original plan, and further Improve the production income of the mine.

title: Method for providing preview and electronic device for displaying preview
description: A method for providing a preview and an electronic device for displaying the preview are provided. The electronic device includes a camera module, a display, a processor operably connected to the camera module and the display, and a memory operably connected to the processor, wherein the memory stores instructions that, when executed, cause the processor to: acquiring an original image frame through the camera module; displaying a first preview image frame corresponding to the acquired original image frame on the display; receiving an input for a request for recording based on dynamic tone mapping; performing the dynamic tone mapping based recording in response to receiving the input; and generating a second preview image frame by performing a dynamic tone mapping process on the first preview image frame acquired after the time point at which the input is received while the dynamic tone mapping-based recording is performed, and displaying the generated second preview image frame on the display. Various other embodiments are also possible.

title: A method and system for fault detection of EMUs based on domain adaptive binocular disparity calculation
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of urban rail transit equipment detection, and particularly discloses a method and a system for detecting faults of a motor train unit by using domain-adaptive binocular parallax calculation. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring left and right stereo images of the motor train unit by using a binocular camera, constructing a domain self-adaptive binocular disparity network, carrying out normalization processing on the stereo images, then calculating and outputting a dense disparity map, carrying out confidence degree filtering on the dense disparity map by using a Conf-CNN network model, and selecting a positive sample for training in a training data set; and training the domain self-adaptive binocular disparity network by adopting the positive sample to obtain the pre-training weight of the network, inputting the left and right stereo images of the motor train unit acquired by the binocular camera into the domain self-adaptive binocular disparity network obtained in the step S3 to output a prediction map of the motor train unit, and carrying out fault detection on the motor train unit according to the prediction map. The method has good prediction effect and high accuracy of obtaining the prediction graph, and can realize accurate detection of the faults of the motor train unit.

title: Method and system for quality detection of medical tube coating
description: The invention provides a method and system for detecting the coating quality of a medical tube, which are applied to the technical field of data processing. The method includes: determining the implantation environment information by acquiring the model of the medical tube. Feature extraction is performed on the implanted environment to generate first environment feature information. According to the first environmental feature information, the first structural threshold feature is matched. The medical tube is used for image acquisition. Extracting and collecting image features to generate first structural features of the medical tube. It is judged whether the first structural feature satisfies the first structural threshold feature. If satisfied, obtain the first structural quality inspection qualified instruction, and add it into the first quality inspection result. The technical problem in the prior art that the coating quality of the medical pipe cannot be accurately measured due to the lack of a method for detecting the coating quality of the medical pipe is solved. All-round and accurate quality inspection results of medical pipes are generated, and the technical effect of more accurate and comprehensive evaluation of the coating quality of medical pipes is realized.

title: An equipment fault monitoring method, device, equipment and medium
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance management of transformer substations, and particularly discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for monitoring equipment faults. Acquiring equipment data and generating a basic sequence; comparing the basic sequence with a preset value, if the data in the basic sequence is smaller than the preset value, no fault occurs, and if the data in the basic sequence is larger than the preset value, a standard sequence is generated according to the basic sequence; inputting the standard sequence into a recurrent neural network to obtain a tag sequence corresponding to the standard sequence; calculating a feature data set according to the standard sequence; calculating a final target loss function according to the characteristic data set and the label sequence; obtaining a weight value according to the final target loss function; carrying out lightweight processing on the weight value and outputting the weight value; and carrying out fault diagnosis according to the final output parameters. According to the invention, the fault judgment is carried out at the edge server or the sensor by carrying out lightweight processing on the equipment data, a cloud server is not needed, and the fault judgment speed is increased.

title: Device anomaly detection, training method, system and device based on feature transfer
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a system and a device for detecting and training equipment abnormity based on characteristic migration, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first sample flow set and a second sample flow set, and training a statistical characteristic detection model, a character characteristic detection model and an image characteristic detection model respectively by using the sample flow in the first sample flow set and an equipment abnormal label; marking equipment abnormal labels on the sample data streams in the second sample flow set by respectively using a current statistical characteristic detection model, a character characteristic detection model and an image characteristic detection model; and performing fusion training on the current statistical characteristic detection model, the character characteristic detection model and the image characteristic detection model by using the sample data flow of the equipment abnormal label marked in the second sample flow set to obtain the trained statistical characteristic detection model, the character characteristic detection model and the image characteristic detection model, so that the model training cost can be reduced, and the equipment abnormal detection cost can be reduced.

title: Allergy species broadcasting method, system and readable storage medium
description: The invention provides an allergic species broadcasting method, an allergic species broadcasting system and a readable storage medium, wherein the allergic species broadcasting method comprises the following steps: identifying species information and growth stage information of the plants in the picture through a plant identification model; if the current plant belongs to the allergic species, acquiring sensitization information and position information of the current plant; and pushing protection information to related users according to the sensitization information and the position information of the allergic species. According to the scheme provided by the invention, the specific species information, the position information, the sensitization information and the protection information of the allergic species in the current area can be displayed to the user through the allergic species broadcasting map, and meanwhile, the warning information or the early warning information of the related allergic species can be pushed to prompt the corresponding user to avoid the corresponding area so as to avoid the allergic symptoms.

title: License plate recognition system for high-speed intersection
description: A license plate recognition system for a highway junction comprises a power supply, an image acquisition device, a vehicle sensing device, a recognition device and a network transmission device; the power supply supplies power to the image acquisition device, the vehicle induction device, the identification device and the network transmission device on site; the power supply is a commercial power and/or solar power supply system; the image acquisition device is a digital camera, and the signal output end of the vehicle sensing device is electrically connected with the electronic shutter input end of the digital camera; the identification device is a device with a microcomputer as a core; the recognition device receives pictures from the digital camera, recognizes the license plate photos, and then stores character information corresponding to the license plate photos; the identification device is connected with the network transmission equipment; the remote management background calls the text information and/or the pictures stored in the identification device through the network transmission equipment; the recognition device recognizes the license plate by using a convolutional neural network model, and features of an input license plate picture are extracted in the convolutional neural network model to finally obtain output text information.

title: Reconstructing phase images using deep learning
description: Aspects relate to reconstructing a phase image from bright field images at multiple focal planes using machine learning techniques. The machine learning model may be trained using a training data set comprising a set of matching images, each set of matching images comprising a plurality of bright field images at different focal planes and optionally corresponding true value phase images. The initial training data set may include images selected based on image views of the sample that are substantially free of undesirable visual artifacts such as dust. The bright field image of the training data set may then be modified based on simulating at least one visual artifact, thereby generating an enhanced training data set for training the model. The output of the machine learning model may be compared to the true phase image to train the model. A trained model may be used to generate phase images from the input data set.

title: A knowledge graph cloud platform in the field of cyberspace security
description: The invention discloses a knowledge graph cloud platform in the network space security field, which relates to the technical field of knowledge graphs in the network space security field, and the key points of the technical scheme are as follows: the system comprises an OpenStack cloud management system, an original data crawler module, a knowledge extraction module, a knowledge storage database and a knowledge graph application management service system; the OpenStack cloud management system is deployed by adopting three nodes, the hardware distribution and the logic distribution of the OpenStack cloud management system are the same, and the OpenStack cloud management system is divided into a control node, a computing node and a network node. The knowledge map cloud platform in the network space security field is convenient to provide unified management and dynamic allocation service of different computing resources, low in cost, high in efficiency, capable of processing the capacity of mass resources, capable of reflecting the characteristics of more three-dimensional, wider domain, more levels and more knowledge in the network space security field and beneficial to carrying out deeper analysis and prediction on network space security research and development.

title: Determination method, device, equipment and storage medium for water output of sweeping robot
description: The present application discloses a method, device, equipment and storage medium for determining the water output of a sweeping robot. The method includes the steps of: acquiring position information of the sweeping robot; and the position information is used to determine whether the sweeping robot has completed the previous cleaning. is moved; when the position information meets the preset position requirements, obtain the ground material information of the ground to be cleaned by the sweeping robot; based on the first preset mapping relationship, determine the water output corresponding to the ground material information, and obtain target water output. The present application simplifies the user's operation process when using the cleaning robot.

title: Trajectory dataset difference measurement method, system, device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for measuring the difference of a track data set, wherein the time-space dependency relationship of multiple tracks is formally expressed as conditional distribution, the parameters of a conditional distribution density model are estimated by utilizing the existing vehicle track data, the conditional distribution contained in the track data set is approximated by utilizing the probability density distribution with an analytic form, and the distance between the conditional distributions is calculated by utilizing a sampling-based method, so that the difference of the track data set is measured. The invention measures the difference of the space-time dependency relationship in the multi-vehicle track data set for the first time, represents the difference of the vehicle interaction characteristic and the space-time dependency relationship in different traffic scenes, is beneficial to understanding and quantifying the difference of the different traffic scenes, understands the change characteristic and the change rule of the space-time dependency relationship among multiple vehicles in the same traffic scene, and is beneficial to carrying out independent processing and targeted research on the different traffic scenes and the same time-varying traffic scene.

title: System and method for robust optimization of trajectory-centric model-based reinforcement learning
description: A controller for optimizing a local control strategy for a trajectory-centric reinforcement learning system is provided. The controller includes executing the steps of: learning a stochastic predictive model of the system using a set of data collected during a trial-and-error experiment performed using an initial stochastic control strategy; estimating an associated average prediction and uncertainty; determining a local set of deviations of the system from a nominal system state using the learned stochastic system model when the control input is used at the current time step; determining a system state having a worst case deviation; determining a gradient of the robustness constraint; providing and solving a robust strategy optimization problem using nonlinear programming to obtain a system trajectory and simultaneously stabilize a local strategy; updating the control data according to the solved optimization problem; and outputting the updated control data via the interface.

title: System and method for collecting fitting data associated with selected face masks
description: A system and method of collecting feedback data from a patient wearing an interface, such as a mask, while using a respiratory pressure therapy device, such as a CPAP device. The system includes a storage device that includes an image of a face of a patient. An interface in communication with a respiratory pressure therapy device, the interface collecting operational data from use of the interface by the patient. The patient interface collects subjective patient input data from the patient about the patient interface. The analysis module associates features of the interface with facial image data, operational data, and subjective patient input data.

title: SOA-LSTM-based battery residual life prediction method and device
description: A method and device for predicting remaining battery life based on SOA‑LSTM, which relate to the field of battery remaining life prediction. The present invention solves the problem that the existing technology cannot accurately and quickly predict the remaining life of the lithium-ion power battery. The present invention obtains the real-time battery data of the lithium-ion power battery, and preprocesses the real-time information; inputs the pre-processed real-time information into the SOA-LSTM neural network model to obtain the available capacity of the lithium-ion power battery; The available capacity gives the remaining life of the battery. The present invention realizes accurate prediction of the remaining life of the battery.

title: Detection method, device, equipment and storage medium for inspection fault of transmission line
description: The present application discloses a detection method, device, equipment and storage medium for inspection faults of transmission lines, which are used to solve the technical problem that the existing fault detection methods are difficult to realize real-time fault detection. The method includes: acquiring an inspection image taken during inspection of a transmission line; performing feature extraction on the inspection image to obtain an output feature map; performing target detection on the output feature map to obtain a target detection result, where the target The detection result includes: category information and position information; decode the position information to obtain a target bounding box; output the fault detection result corresponding to the inspection image according to the target bounding box and the category information.

title: Passenger flow statistics method, device, intelligent terminal, system, equipment and medium
description: The present application discloses a passenger flow statistics method, device, intelligent terminal, system, equipment and medium. The method includes: acquiring a target image set, where the target image set includes multiple frames of images of a target area; performing pedestrian detection processing on the target image set , obtain several detection targets; perform target tracking processing on each detection target to obtain target tracking results; according to the target tracking results, perform stop analysis processing on each detection target to obtain the stop analysis results; The passenger flow information is counted, and the passenger flow statistical results are obtained. By adding a stop analysis link, this application obtains statistical results with more pertinence and greater reference value, which significantly improves the accuracy of passenger flow statistical results, and can provide more meaningful and detailed reference content for business operations, such as evaluating commodities Or show the attention of the content, better formulate the operating model and provide personalized services.

title: Deep learning-based skeleton point action recognition method for pattern skating players
description: The invention relates to a deep learning-based method for recognizing skeletal points of figure skating players, which includes randomly dividing an action video set to be classified into a training video set and a test video set, and using the training video set and the test video set respectively for calculating The training track and test track of the action, input the training track into the action recognition model for action recognition, and then optimize the action recognition model through the test track to obtain a deep action recognition model for rapid action extraction; obtain the pending action recognition model through the deep action recognition model The test action video set is used, and the body movements and trajectories of the objects in the action video set to be tested are recognized, and the recognition result of the test set is obtained. The rapid recognition of actions can be realized, the defects of non-uniform standards and low evaluation efficiency caused by purely manual evaluation in the prior art are improved, and the evaluation efficiency and the uniformity of evaluation results can be improved.

title: Train the model using candidate actions provided by the model
description: A method for training a conversational computing system. The method comprises the following steps: an initial query is provided to a machine learning model that was previously trained to generate actions for responding to the query. Based on the initial query, a plurality of candidate actions are received from a machine learning model and presented via a training interface. Based on input provided by a human annotator, selected candidate actions are identified and associated with the initial query in the tagged data example.

title: An image processing method, device and device
description: The embodiment of the specification discloses a method, a device and equipment for processing an image, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image to be processed, wherein the target image comprises privacy information of a target user; selecting a corresponding three-dimensional image for a target image, and dividing the three-dimensional image into a plurality of different areas; and respectively executing the following processing for each divided area to obtain three types of preselected steganographic images corresponding to each area: writing RGB information in a target image into the area in an information steganography mode by using a first steganography encoder; writing NIR information in the target image into the area in an information steganography mode by using a second steganography encoder; writing the RGB information and the NIR information in the target image into the area in an information steganography mode by using a third steganography encoder; and determining a steganographic image for steganographically writing the target image into the three-dimensional image based on the preselected steganographic images corresponding to the different areas, and performing service processing on the target service based on the steganographic image.

title: Method and system for compensating camber deformation of main beam of gantry crane and computer medium
description: The invention discloses a method, a system and a computer medium for compensating the camber deformation of the main girder of a bridge gantry crane. Calculate the actual lifting height; Step S2: train the first preset distance and the second preset distance according to the neural network, generate the first measurement error, and generate the error of each segmentation point according to the position of the segmentation point and the ground position, Then generate a second measurement error according to the split point error; Step S3: generate an error-compensated upper arch angle according to the first measurement error and the upper arch angle of the crane main beam, and update the actual lifting height according to the error-compensated upper arch angle , while updating the position of the crane according to the second measurement error. The invention can detect, calculate and compensate the camber change of the bridge gantry crane, and improve the positioning accuracy of the crane and the lifting.

title: A maritime target detection and recognition method and processing device based on improved YOLO v2 model
description: The invention discloses a detection and identification method and a processing device of an offshore target based on an improved YOLOv2 model, and the detection method of the offshore target based on the improved YOLOv2 model comprises the following steps: step A, training a hazy image based on a generated countermeasure network (GAN), obtaining a generator of the GAN as a defogging network through a plurality of iterations, and performing high-definition training processing on an original image by using the defogging network to obtain a high-definition training image; and B, carrying out target detection on the high-definition training image in the step A by using a target detection model based on a YOLOv2 network, and identifying whether a corresponding target exists in the image. The method can well overcome the influence of foggy images generated by ocean changeable climates on target detection, and has good real-time performance and high accuracy through the operation of defogging and re-detection.

title: A PCB board defect identification method applied in the process of automatic PCB board sorting
description: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing and identification, in particular to a PCB defect identification method applied to the automatic sorting process of PCBs, which utilizes simple electronic equipment to identify the defects of the PCBs and improves the identification capability of a neural network, and comprises the following steps: manually marking all defective surrounding frames and defect types of all PCB images containing defects; obtaining an attention heat map of each defect on the PCB; obtaining a comprehensive attention heat map according to all defect attention heat maps; constructing a first loss function by utilizing the comprehensive attention heat map, and training a self-coding network by combining a PCB image to obtain a corresponding defect characteristic map; inputting the PCB image into a defect positioning and identifying neural network to be trained, obtaining a target characteristic diagram output by a specified convolutional layer, constructing a second loss function by combining the defect characteristic diagram, and training the neural network; and operating a defect positioning and identifying neural network by using a defect electronic identification device, automatically controlling a sorting process according to an identification result, and sorting the PCB with defects.

title: A steam simulation calculation method based on kernel extreme learning machine error correction
description: The invention provides a steam simulation calculation method based on error correction of a nuclear limit learning machine, aiming at the problem of poor model construction accuracy in the conventional steam heating network simulation method. Firstly, acquiring pipeline parameters and steam parameters are confirmed, the parameters are divided into training samples for establishing a steam-water thermal coupling simulation model for calculation, errors obtained by verifying simulation results by using real pipe network data are used as output samples of a genetic algorithm-kernel limit learning machine error prediction model for training. And when the steam heat supply network model operates, calling the trained error prediction model to perform error prediction, so that the steam pipe network water-heat power coupling simulation calculation result is corrected, and the precision of the steam heat supply network simulation model is improved. The method is suitable for dynamic simulation of the steam heating network, and can be used for optimizing an original steam heating network simulation model in a targeted manner by utilizing a large amount of accumulated pipe network operation data of a heating enterprise all year round and improving the precision of a simulation result.

title: Parameter identification method for the process of homogenization and viscosity-increasing reaction kettle of recycled polyester
description: The invention relates to the field of data processing and identification, in particular to a parameter identification method for a technological process of a regenerated polyester homogenizing and tackifying reaction kettle. Acquiring a historical process parameter set of the reaction kettle after each reaction is finished and a corresponding product effect; the parameters are arranged and combined to obtain a plurality of subspaces, and the optimal subspace corresponding to each standard model is obtained; calculating a noise coincidence coefficient corresponding to the optimal subspace; calculating the attention weight of each optimal subspace to obtain the comprehensive attention weight of each parameter; and constructing a training historical process parameter set, taking the training historical process parameter set as data of a neural network, taking a product effect as output of the neural network to train the neural network, and identifying the process parameters of the reaction kettle by using the trained neural network. According to the invention, the original historical process parameter set is divided through the subspace and the attention weight of each parameter is obtained, so that the neural network is trained, and accurate and strong-adaptability parameter identification is realized.

title: A classification method, device and electronic device for target application
description: The present invention provides a classification method, device and electronic device for a target application. The method includes: acquiring a grayscale image of a target application, and the grayscale image is used to represent program features of the target application; performing wavelet transform processing on the grayscale image of the target application, removing noise in the grayscale image, and obtaining the denoising of the target application Image; input the denoised image into the pre-trained SE-Resnet network model to obtain the classification result of the target application, the classification result is used to indicate the malware type of the target application, and the SE-Resnet network model is used to perform the program features of the target application. Weighted analysis, in which different program features correspond to different weights. The invention can improve the classification accuracy of the target application and make the detection of malicious software more accurate.

title: Emotion recognition method, device, terminal device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The application discloses a method and a device for emotion recognition, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting a face area of each frame of image as a training sample based on an input continuous frame video sequence; inputting the training samples into a three-dimensional convolution neural network model to obtain a global characteristic diagram of each video frame sequence; partitioning the global feature map, taking the generated local feature map and the global feature map as feature partitions, extracting one-dimensional features of each feature partition, inputting the one-dimensional features into a three-dimensional convolution neural network model, outputting an initial predicted emotion score, determining an initial weight of each feature partition, and determining a corresponding target weight according to the initial weight of each feature partition; and weighting the initial predicted emotion scores by using the target weights to generate target predicted emotion scores. According to the method and the device, the three-dimensional convolutional neural network and the feature map blocks are combined, the confidence coefficient of the part which is not shielded is enhanced, the emotion recognition precision and efficiency are improved, and the application range is wider.

title: Preparation method of three-terminal memristive neural components, three-terminal memristive neural components
description: The invention discloses a three-terminal memristor neural component and a preparation method thereof, wherein the preparation method comprises the following steps of: preparing an input terminal electrode on the upper surface of the substrate to obtain a first intermediate piece, wherein the input terminal electrode is a silver electrode; preparing an insulating layer on the upper surface of the first intermediate piece, and forming a contact through hole on the insulating layer; preparing an active layer on the upper surface of the insulating layer, and forming an output end electrode on the upper surface of the active layer to obtain a second intermediate piece, wherein the area of the active layer in the contact through hole is used as an active area, and the active area is respectively connected with the upper surface of the input end electrode and the lower surface of the output end electrode; and preparing a current limiting layer on the upper surface of the second intermediate piece, and forming a grounding end electrode on the upper surface of the current limiting layer to obtain the three-terminal memristor neural component. The three-terminal memristor neural component provided by the invention can output a corresponding pulse signal based on the received input signal in real time without an external circuit.

title: Network intrusion detection method based on data enhancement and self-supervision feature enhancement
description: The invention discloses a network intrusion detection method based on data enhancement and self-supervision feature enhancement, which comprises the following steps: preprocessing data, wherein a preprocessed data set comprises a normal sample and an attack sample, and performing data enhancement on the attack sample by using a self-encoder to expand the number of the attack samples; constructing a CNN-BilSTM neural network and a self-encoder to form a semi-self-supervision model and respectively extracting high-dimensional flow characteristics and self-supervision characteristics; and inputting the combined features after the feature enhancement into a classification model as final features for prediction, classifying the network traffic to judge whether the network traffic is attack traffic, and realizing the function of network intrusion detection. The method enhances the data of the attack samples, and simultaneously utilizes the self-supervision model to extract the self-supervision characteristics to enhance the flow characteristics, assists the CNN-BilSTM network to complete the subsequent classification task, further improves the detection precision of network intrusion, improves the detection function of unknown attacks, and reduces the false alarm rate.

title: An AI chip reasoning quantification method for intelligent servo drives
description: The invention specifically discloses an AI chip reasoning quantification method for intelligent servo drives, which specifically includes: 1) constructing an inference model based on an application program interface of the AI chip; 2) collecting servo drive inference sequence data and intermediate process data based on the original model 3) Carry out signed 8-bit integer quantization optimization on the above collected data based on the inference model; 4) Use the evaluation method of propagation error to evaluate the accuracy of the quantized model, and optimize the accuracy; the inference quantization method can be It effectively reduces the precision loss of the inference process, and effectively promotes the application of AI algorithms to servo drives.

title: A self-check optimization method for one-key switch station in urban rail transit
description: The invention provides a self-checking optimization method for an urban rail transit one-key switching station, which comprises the following steps of: s1, constructing a time sequence data set; s2, preprocessing the time sequence data set; performing characteristic engineering on the data in the time sequence data set to convert the data into a supervised learning data set; s3, building a causal convolutional neural network model, loading training set data into the causal convolutional neural network model, and performing model training on the causal convolutional neural network model to enable the causal convolutional neural network model to capture the time sequence characteristics of a long time sequence; and S4, inputting the verification set into a causal convolution neural network model for verification, inputting the statistical value of the current day and the previous week, which is made by the characteristic engineering, into the trained neural network model, and predicting the self-checking operation record of the current day. The invention can provide the total station equipment one-time alarm information and the suggestion of the operation mode thereof for the current day patrol plan, save the operation time and improve the scientificity and the high efficiency of the one-key station switching function.

title: Optimization, prediction method, equipment and storage medium of machine learning model
description: The embodiment of the application provides an optimization and prediction method, equipment and a storage medium of a machine learning model. In the optimization method, when a batch training set is adopted to train the machine learning model, the optimization targets corresponding to the batch training set are obtained by calculating the respective optimization targets of a plurality of training data and the respective overfitting regular parameters of the plurality of training data. In the optimization mode, the training process of each training data can be constrained based on the overfitting regular parameter of each training data, and further the constraint on the overall optimization target of the batch training set is realized. Based on the mode, the regularization of training data levels can be realized, the generalization capability of the machine learning model is improved, and the prediction precision of the machine learning model under various different application scenes is favorably and effectively improved.

title: Reactive power compensation method and system for photovoltaic power generation system based on improved particle swarm algorithm
description: The utility model belongs to the technical field of reactive power compensation, in particular to a photovoltaic power generation system reactive power compensation method and system based on improved particle swarm optimization, comprising the following steps: acquiring future weather data of the photovoltaic power generation system; calculating the line loss of the photovoltaic power generation system according to the acquired future weather data of the photovoltaic power generation system and the photovoltaic power generation principle; according to the line loss and the predicted reactive compensation model, realizing reactive compensation of the photovoltaic system; the reactive compensation model is used for constructing an objective function by taking the minimum total line loss of the line as a target, solving the objective function by adopting an improved particle swarm algorithm and optimizing the reactive compensation of the photovoltaic system.

title: Vector simplification using shared scratchpad memory
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus are described for performing vector simplification using a shared scratch pad memory of a hardware circuit having a processor core in communication with the shared memory. For each processor core, a respective vector of values is generated based on computations performed at the processor core. The shared memory receives respective vectors of values from respective resources of the processor core using a Direct Memory Access (DMA) data path of the shared memory. The shared memory performs an accumulation operation on respective vectors of values using an operator unit coupled to the shared memory. The operator unit is configured to accumulate values based on arithmetic operations encoded at the operator unit. A result vector is generated based on performing an accumulation operation using the respective value vector.

title: Prediction method of monthly electricity sales based on ACO-BP
description: The invention discloses a monthly electricity sales prediction method based on ACO-BP, which comprises the following steps: collecting monthly electricity sales data and performing EMD decomposition to obtain an EMD component; establishing an improved ACO-BP network model; predicting the EMD component by using the improved ACO-BP network model to obtain a predicted value component; superposing the predicted value components to obtain a predicted value of monthly electricity sales; aiming at the problems that the BP neural network is easy to have local optimization and has low convergence speed, the invention provides the method for optimizing the initial weight and the threshold of the BP neural network by using the improved ant colony algorithm, and the improved ACO-BP model can improve the accuracy and the stability of the BP neural network and effectively reduce the iteration times when the maximum error of the BP neural network is reached.

title: A method for model training and information recommendation
description: This specification discloses a model training method and an information recommendation method. The server obtains user comment data for a specified object and a pre-built knowledge graph corresponding to each evaluation dimension. Secondly, for each evaluation dimension, the comment data and the corresponding knowledge graph under the evaluation dimension are input into the prediction model to be trained, so as to determine the evaluation feature data corresponding to the comment data and the dimension feature data corresponding to the evaluation dimension. Then, according to the dimension feature data and the evaluation feature data corresponding to the evaluation dimension, an evaluation result of evaluating the specified object by the user according to the evaluation dimension is determined. Finally, the optimization goal is to minimize the deviation between the evaluation result of each evaluation dimension on the specified object and the label corresponding to the comment data, and the prediction model is trained. This method can determine the evaluation result corresponding to each evaluation dimension. This recommends information to the user, which improves the user's purchasing experience.

title: Collaborative filtering recommendation method based on attribute knowledge introduction
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of recommendation, and discloses a collaborative filtering recommendation method based on attribute knowledge introduction, including: constructing an attribute system based on user direct information and indirect information; feature selection based on a logistic regression model with an L1 penalty; The fusion of the user behavior vector and the user attribute knowledge vector; the collaborative filtering, the calculation of neighbors based on the user attribute knowledge and the user attribute knowledge and the behavior vector are integrated to form a triple hybrid recommendation. The triple hybrid recommendation uses attribute information and weights The voting method fuses user attributes, behavioral data, and collaborative filtering recommendations. By constructing and introducing attribute information, integrating behavior data information, and on the basis of embedded feature selection and vector splicing similarity calculation, the invention establishes a triple hybrid recommendation model to combine user attributes and collaborative filtering, thereby improving the effect of recommendation.

title: A single-button auxiliary input system for web page access based on RPA
description: The invention discloses an RPA-based single-button auxiliary input system for web page access, comprising an input module, a training module, a control module and a server; the input module is used for users to input data, establish a data format template, obtain topic data, and according to the data format template Establish an input model, identify and process the subject data through the input model, and obtain the target data; the training module is used to train RPA, obtain the corresponding data format template, match the corresponding training set according to the obtained data format template, and match the training set according to the matching training set. The RPA is trained, and the RPA after successful training is sent to the control module; the control module is used to control the auxiliary input of data, receive the topic data uploaded by the user, send the received topic data to the input template, receive the RPA sent by the training module, and obtain The target data generated by the input module is processed in real time through RPA to obtain the final data.

title: Extruder emission and smoke capture system
description: The invention discloses an extruder discharge and smoke capturing system, comprising a servo motor, an extruder main body, a detection module and a central control module. The top of the extruder main body is provided with a detection module, and one side of the extruder main body is provided with a detection module. There is an emission collection box, a fan is arranged on one side of the emission collection box, a discharge pipe is connected to the bottom of the emission collection box, a neutralization treatment box is connected to the top of the emission collection box, and the interior of the neutralization treatment box is provided with A connection pipe is arranged between the treatment liquid, the neutralization treatment tank and the discharge collection tank, a control valve is installed on the connection pipe, and the detection module detects the image data and chromatographic data of the extruder main body. The invention adopts the recognition module, uses the artificial intelligence recognition mode to recognize the components inside the extruder, can realize the automatic adjustment of the type and quantity of the treatment liquid, greatly improves the emission capture efficiency, and also reduces the waste of resources. , is an intelligent high-efficiency capture system that does not require manual control.

title: Pixel cost redistribution algorithm based on artificial immune system
description: The invention discloses a pixel cost redistribution algorithm based on an artificial immune system, which is used for digital image information hiding processing, under a minimized additive distortion model, pixel modification probability distribution obtained by a given cost function is adjusted, and an adjustment mode of the pixel modification probability distribution is dynamically optimized by constructing an immune information hiding model so as to redistribute modification cost reasonably, so that modified pixels are more concentrated in regions which are difficult to detect in a carrier image. The method is suitable for various advanced cost functions, solves the problem that the existing heuristic self-adaptive steganography algorithm is difficult to have optimal safety because the heuristic self-adaptive steganography algorithm depends on empirical design to a great extent, can improve the safety of the most advanced spatial domain image steganography algorithm, and has practical value.

title: Method, system, device and medium for lane departure warning based on monocular camera
description: The invention discloses a monocular camera-based lane departure early warning method, a monocular camera-based lane departure early warning system, monocular camera-based lane departure early warning equipment and a monocular camera-based lane departure early warning medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a road scene image in front of a vehicle by using a monocular camera; performing pixel segmentation on a road scene image by using a trained lightweight convolutional neural network to obtain a vehicle travelable area image, wherein the lightweight convolutional neural network comprises a plurality of deep convolutional modules and a two-dimensional convolutional module, and the deep convolutional modules are composed of point-by-point convolutional layers and pyramid expansion convolutional layers; extracting an edge image from the image of the vehicle driving area by using a Canny edge detection algorithm, and then carrying out inverse perspective transformation on the edge image to obtain an aerial view; and acquiring the minimum distance between the vehicle and the road where the vehicle is located according to the aerial view, and controlling a vehicle alarm to give an alarm for vehicle deviation to the driver when the minimum distance is lower than a preset distance threshold. The invention can improve the real-time performance of image processing and ensure the early warning precision by building the lightweight convolutional neural network.

title: Ambient collaborative intelligence system and method
description: A method, computer program product, and computing system for obtaining calibration information for a three-dimensional space containing an ACI system and processing the calibration information to calibrate the ACI system.

title: A high-voltage transmission line network monitoring method, system, equipment and medium
description: The invention discloses a monitoring method, system, equipment and medium for a high-voltage transmission line network. The initial operation state data corresponding to a target transmission line network is acquired and preprocessed, the target operation state data is generated, and a feature selection function is called to read and transform. , generate the target time-frequency matrix and multiple initial eigenvectors, use multiple initial eigenvectors for cluster analysis, generate target eigenvectors, select multiple initial line network clustering centers according to the mean clustering results, and calculate the total target variance, Use the target eigenvector, the conjugate matrix of the target time-frequency matrix and the target total variance to determine the target output deviation value, and determine the power grid fault type according to the preset fault threshold interval where the target output deviation value is located; solve the existing manual inspection method The monitoring efficiency is low and it is not easy to monitor what kind of faults occur in the high-voltage transmission network, and it is impossible to accurately monitor the technical problems of the types of faults in the high-voltage transmission network.

title: A personalized gesture recognition system and gesture recognition method for multi-application scenarios
description: A personalized gesture recognition system and a gesture recognition method thereof for multiple application scenes belong to the technical field of human-computer interaction. The gesture segmentation method aims at solving the problems that gesture segmentation is inaccurate, and gesture information cannot be recognized more accurately and comprehensively. The data glove module is connected with the mobile equipment module, and the mobile equipment module is respectively connected with the edge equipment module and the application equipment module; the data glove module is an intelligent glove with a stretching sensor and a motion sensor, the intelligent glove collects motion information of gestures and bending information of fingers through the stretching sensor and the motion sensor, and the motion information and the bending information of the fingers are sent to the mobile equipment module through Bluetooth; the mobile equipment module is used for performing gesture recognition and data transmission; the edge device module is used for data storage, model training, model migration and data analysis; the application equipment module is intelligent equipment with a control interface. The invention has high accuracy.

title: A pulsed track pursuit-escape game method based on PRD-MADDPG algorithm
description: The invention relates to the technical field of aerospace, in particular to application of a space orbit game, and discloses a pulse type orbit pursuit game method based on a PRD-MADDPG algorithm.

title: Multi-scale image change detection method and storage medium based on DCGAN
description: The invention discloses a DCGAN-based multi-scale image change detection method and a storage medium, wherein a multi-scale change detection network is built, and a DCGAN-based semi-supervision method is adopted to expand sample data so as to meet the network training requirement; on the other hand, by adopting the multi-scale network structure, the multi-scale target can be better detected, and particularly, the multi-scale target detection method has excellent performance under some irregular and uncertain change scenes or under multi-target and multi-scale change detection scenes. The invention firstly generates a large amount of change detection samples similar to the source domain for DCGAN training, and the change detection samples are used for training a discriminator, so that the discriminator has good feature extraction function and capability of discriminating the authenticity of images, the accuracy and the stability of the network are enhanced, and the discriminator is used as a dual-channel feature extractor for detecting the network. And a multi-scale feature module is added to extract convolution features of different stages, so that the detection capability of targets of different scales is enhanced.

title: A drug molecule generation method combined with domain knowledge
description: The invention relates to the field of drug representation learning, in particular to a drug molecule generation method combining domain knowledge, which comprises the steps of obtaining a 3D conformation of a molecule by utilizing a conformation search algorithm so as to obtain molecular space information, and enhancing initial representation of the molecule by utilizing the molecular space information; obtaining molecular division results of molecules by using the optimized spectral clustering algorithm and the optimized CH clustering evaluation index; according to the enhanced representation and the molecule division result of the molecule, encoding the molecule by using a graph convolution neural network to obtain a hidden space embedded representation, namely a global graph representation and a local sub-graph representation respectively; optimizing the global graph representation and the local sub-graph representation by utilizing a mutual information maximization mechanism to obtain a molecular representation rich in spatial information and sub-structure information, and applying the molecular representation to a downstream molecular generation task; the invention is beneficial to capturing the space and structure information of molecules and can better serve the related tasks in the field of drug discovery based on deep learning.

title: Multi-objective Active Reconfiguration Method of Distribution Network Based on Analytic Hierarchy Process and Genetic Algorithm
description: The invention discloses a multi-target active reconstruction method for a power distribution network based on an analytic hierarchy process and a genetic algorithm, which relates to the technical field of optimized operation of the power distribution network of a power system and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: constructing a reconstruction model of an objective function, specifically, establishing the reconstruction model of the power distribution network by taking the reduction of network loss, the improvement of voltage quality and the reduction of switching operation times as objective functions, wherein the objective functions comprise a network loss reduction objective function, a voltage quality improvement objective function, a switching operation time reduction objective function and a comprehensive objective function; step two: determining a weight coefficient of an objective function; step three: and (5) utilizing a genetic algorithm to reconstruct the distribution network. According to the multi-target active reconstruction method for the power distribution network based on the analytic hierarchy process and the genetic algorithm, the objective function has practical value, the weight coefficient of the objective function is selected more scientifically, and economic benefits, social benefits, safety benefits and user experience benefits of the power distribution network during operation are taken into consideration.

title: Vocabulary extraction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention provides a vocabulary extraction method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining the first semantic vector of each minimum semantic unit in the target sentence through the encoding end in the vocabulary extraction model; determining the entity vocabulary in the target sentence based on the first semantic vector; and the first semantic vector, through the decoding end in the vocabulary extraction model, obtain the second semantic vector of each minimum semantic unit in the target sentence; based on the first semantic vector and the second semantic vector, determine the entity vocabulary correspondence in the target sentence attribute vocabulary. The vocabulary extraction method, device, electronic equipment, and storage medium provided by the present invention, after determining the entity vocabulary in the target sentence, jointly extract entities and attributes, directly introduce entity constraints for attribute extraction, and directly introduce different entity information for different attributes Characterizing relations can more accurately capture entity and attribute pairs in complex sentences.

title: A method and device for evaluating the impact of knowledge distillation on model backdoor attacks
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for evaluating influence of knowledge distillation on text backdoor attack, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting a backdoor attack method to attack the pre-training language model, implanting a backdoor into the model, and evaluating the classification accuracy of the backdoor model and the success rate of the backdoor attack; and (3) selecting a knowledge distillation method to distill the model containing the backdoor, obtaining a small model after distillation, and evaluating the classification accuracy of the small model and the attack success rate of the backdoor attack method which is the same as the first step. The invention compares the influence of different training sets, different distillation times, distillation temperature and distillation loss functions on the back door attack, finds that knowledge distillation can greatly reduce but can not completely eliminate the back door in the model, and simultaneously the clean classification precision of the model is reduced to some extent.

title: Named entity recognition method and device, electronic equipment and computer storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present application provide a named entity recognition method, device, electronic equipment, and computer storage medium, wherein the named entity recognition method includes: acquiring text data; using at least two recognition methods in parallel to identify entities in the text data, Obtain at least two types of entity recognition results; determine the entity recognition results of the text data according to the at least two types of entity recognition results. Because at least two types of entity recognition are performed in parallel, the time spent on entity recognition is the longest time-consuming type of entity recognition, not all types of entity recognition take the total time, which reduces entity recognition time-consuming and improve efficiency.

title: Information push method and related equipment
description: The present disclosure provides an information pushing method and related equipment. The above information push method includes: determining the content entity corresponding to the information to be pushed; determining one or more target information push schemes according to the association relationship between the pre-recorded content entity and the used information push scheme; Extracting sample data in the push plan; using the sample data to pre-train the information push model; using the pre-trained information push model to determine multiple target objects; and pushing the information to be pushed to the multiple target objects . The above method can help the information push model to quickly find the characteristics of samples that may be interested in the information to be pushed, improve the learning ability of the information push model, and improve the accuracy of information push.

title: Compressed sensing magnetic resonance image fast reconstruction method based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a compressed sensing magnetic resonance image rapid reconstruction method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring original data of magnetic resonance K space to obtain original data K of K space  fid  (ii) a S2: constructing an undersampled template mask based on a compressed sensing theory, and simulating undersampled K space data through the undersampled template mask to obtain the undersampled K space data K  cs‑fid  (ii) a S3: for K space original data K  fid  And undersampled K space data K  cs‑fid  Preprocessing the image to obtain a fully sampled image I  img  And undersampled image I  cs‑img  And for the full sampling image I  img  And undersampled image I  cs‑img  Carrying out normalization processing, and reserving normalization parameters; s4: a reconstruction network is constructed based on Unet, and the normalized full sampling graph is processed by the reconstruction networkImage I  img  And undersampled image I  cs‑img  Processing to obtain a reconstructed image I  recon  (ii) a S5: for reconstructed image I  recon  Performing fidelity operation to obtain fidelity image I  data‑consistency  . According to the invention, the rapid reconstruction of the magnetic resonance image of data of any position, any mode and any matrix size can be realized by constructing the reconstruction network through the Unet.

title: Defect evaluation method for first flexo printing piece
description: The present invention provides a method for evaluating defects of a flexographic first piece, including character detection and dirt detection, wherein the character detection includes the following steps: S1: Corresponding construction of electronic sample characters based on the character positions of the electronic sample and the first flexographic printing library and flexographic first character library; S2: Input the electronic sample characters and flexo first character into the pre-built deep evaluation network respectively, obtain the character detection result, and complete the character detection; the dirty detection includes the following steps: The image of the first print is subjected to time-frequency conversion, Gaussian filtering and Blob analysis to obtain the dirt detection result, and the dirt detection is completed; the defect evaluation result of the first flexo print is obtained according to the character detection result and the dirt detection result. The invention provides a method for evaluating the defects of the first flexo printing, which solves the problem that manual quality inspection is easy to produce wrong detection in the current first flexo printing inspection.

title: Interlayer Communication Technology for Memory Processing Unit Architecture
description: A memory processing unit (MPU) may include a first memory, a second memory, a plurality of processing areas, and control logic. The first memory may include multiple areas. Multiple processing areas may be interleaved between the multiple areas of the first memory. A processing area may include multiple computing cores. The second memory can be coupled to multiple processing areas. The control logic may configure data flow between computing cores of one or more of the processing areas and corresponding adjacent areas of the first memory. The control logic may also configure data flow between the second memory and computing cores of one or more of the processing areas. The control logic may also configure data flow between computing cores within one or more corresponding ones of the processing regions.

title: Device for completing an incomplete rulebase within a fuzzy-regulator
description: In a process for designing a fuzzy regulator with at least one input parameter and at least one output parameter (x1, x2, y), where an incomplete rule base with rules that are defined explicitly is supplemented by an implicit rule whose conditional part yields a truth value that has its greatest value when the explicit rules yield a truth value of 0 and is the smallest when the explicit rules have a truth value of 1, the truth value of the implicit rule may be determined by forming the maximum from the truth values of the explicit rules and calculating the complement to 1. This leads to a great simplification of the design of the regulator and prevents instabilities that can occur with an incomplete rule base.

title: Safety failure risk prediction method for electric vehicle and electric vehicle
description: The invention relates to a safety failure risk prediction method of an electric vehicle, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a safety tree, wherein the safety tree comprises a plurality of safety failure bottom layer events, safety failure middle events, safety failure top layer events, logic causal relations among the safety failure bottom layer events, the safety failure middle events and the safety failure top layer events and safety importance degrees; and S2, predicting the safety failure risk of the electric vehicle according to the safety tree. By implementing the method for predicting the safety failure risk of the electric vehicle, the computer readable storage medium and the electric vehicle, the rule of the vehicle failure risk changing along with time can be analyzed, the future failure risk degree can be predicted, and a necessary quantitative information basis is provided for the safety operation and maintenance of the vehicle.

title: Adaptive analytical behavioral and health assistant system and related method of use
description: This present disclosure relates to systems and methods for providing an Adaptive Analytical Behavioral and Health Assistant. These systems and methods may include collecting one or more of patient behavior information, clinical information, or personal information; learning one or more patterns that cause an event based on the collected information and one or more pattern recognition algorithms; identifying one or more interventions to prevent the event from occurri or to facilitate the event based on the learned patterns; preparing a plan based on the collected information and the identified interventions; and/or presenting the pla to a user or executing the plan.

title: Neuronal networks for controlling downhole processes
description: An apparatus for processing signals downhole includes a carrier configured to be conveyed through a borehole penetrating an earth formation and a container disposed at the carrier and configured to carry biological material. A cultured biological neural network is disposed at the container, the neural network being capable of processing a network input signal and providing a processed network output signal. One or more electrodes are in electrical communication with the neural network, the one or more electrodes being configured to communicate the network input signal into the neural network and to communicate the network output signal out of the neural network.

title: Methods and apparatus for early sensory integration and robust acquisition of real world knowledge
description: The systems and methods disclosed herein include a path integration system that calculates optic flow, infers angular velocity from the flow field, and incorporates this velocity estimate into heading calculations. The resulting system fuses heading estimates from accelerometers, 5 gyroscopes, engine torques, and optic flow to determine self-localization. The system also includes a motivational system that implements a reward drive, both positive and negative, into the system. In some implementations, the drives can include: a) a curiosity drive that encourages exploration of new areas, b) a resource drive that attracts the agent towards the recharging base when the battery is low, and c) a mineral reward drive that attracts the agent 10 towards previously explored scientific targets.

title: Dispatcher training simulating device and operation method thereof
description: A dispatcher training simulating device includes an energy management system (EMS) actual measurement data loader configured to load EMS actual measurement data to the dispatcher training simulating device, an EMS actual measurement data initializing unit configured to calculate a power flow by adjusting a generator output in the loaded EMS actual measurement data, and generate initialized EMS actual measurement data based on whether the calculated power flow converges on a predetermined value, and a dispatcher training simulation providing unit configured to provide a dispatcher training simulation based on the initialized EMS actual measurement data.

title: Transferable intelligent control device
