description: An integrated intelligent system includes a first intelligent electronic device, a second intelligent electronic device, a transferable intelligent control device (TICD) and a cross product bus. The first intelligent electronic device performs a first function and the second intelligent electronic device performs a second function. The cross product bus couples the first intelligent electronic device to the transferable intelligent control device. The TICD partially controls behaviors of the intelligent electronic device by sending commands over the cross product bus to the first intelligent electronic device and the TICD partially controls behaviors of the second intelligent electronic device to perform the second function. The TICD is first attached to the first intelligent electronic device to partially control the behaviors of the first electronic device, then detached from the first electronic device, and then attached to the second intelligent electronic device to perform the second function.

title: Premise generation based on both analytical processes and statistical processes
description: Among other things, data is received representing a case for which an output premise is to be generated. The received data is processed to generate the output premise for the case. The processing includes both analytical processing and statistical processing. The analytical processing in the statistical processing are managed so that the output premise depends on results of the analytical processing that have been affected by the statistical processing, or on results of the statistical processing that have been affected by the analytical processing, or on both.

title: Method for predicting the properties of crude oils by the application of neural networks
description:
A method for predicting the properties of crude oils by the application of neural networks articulated in phases and characterized by determining the T 2  NMR relaxation curve of an unknown crude oil and converting it to a logarithmic relaxation curve; selecting the values of the logarithmic relaxation curve lying on a characterization grid; entering the selected values as input data for a multilayer neural network of the back propagation type, trained and optimized by means of genetic algorithms; predicting, by means of the trained and optimized neural network, the physico-chemical factors of the unknown crude oil. 
     The method comprises a training and optimization process of the multilayer neural network of the back propagation type. 
     The method thus defined allows the most representative physico-chemical factors of crude oils to be predicted rapidly and without onerous laboratory structures, or alternatively the distillation curve of crude oils with an acceptable approximation degree.

title: Specification Document Check Method, Program, and System
description: A system for storing a specification document to be checked on a storage device in a computer readable format. A computer implemented method which stores a graph structure of rules for performance of checking, and creates a rule application table of whether a rule is an application subject. For each node rule of the graph structure, average entropy of whether a specification satisfies the rules is derived by searching the graph structure of rules. While performing a depth-first searching of the graph structure of rules, a priority order index is derived from the rule application table for each node rule. Amendment candidates are then displayed according to value of the priority order index.

title: Systems and methods for artificial intelligence script modification
description: Systems and methods for modifying content for interactive synthetic characters are provided. In some embodiments, a traversable script for an interactive synthetic character may be modified based on a set of analytics relating to the use of the interactive synthetic character. These uses may include words spoken by the user, language spoken, user demographics, length of interactions, visually detected objects, current environmental conditions, or location. The traversable script may include a set of conversation rules that include actions to be performed by the interactive synthetic character. The actions can include, for example, producing audible or textual speech, performing one or more animations, playing one or more sound effects, retrieving data from one or more data sources, and the like. The traversable script can be modified, customized, or improved based on the feedback from the use of the character by a plurality of users. The modifications may happen automatically or be reviewed by a content creator using a graphical user interface.

title: Systems, methods, and computer program products for expediting expertise
description: A method including generating a global topic model based on a set of data that is updated according to an activity of each user of a plurality of users, the global topic model including a topic representation for a topic, generating a plurality of user models, each user model being generated based on the activity of a respective user, generating an expertise model for the topic based on the activity of at least one user of the plurality of users, the expertise model for the topic setting a target level of knowledge for a first user of the plurality of users, comparing a user model of the first user with the expertise model for the topic, the comparing being performed by a processor of a computer system, and recommending an activity associated with the set of data to the first user based on the comparison.

title: Path searching method and path search device
description: A computer performs a path search from a departure point to a destination point and a path search from the destination point to the departure point while changing a target from a road type at a level other than the highest level to a road type at a higher level, according to a first grouping of a plurality of road types, and performs a path search for the road type at the highest level in a first process. Next, the computer performs similar path searches in an area to be searched based on a result of the first process, according to a second grouping in which a greater number of road types is classified as the highest level in a second process. Then, the computer generates path information according to a result of the second process.

title: System, method and computer program product for predicting item preference using revenue-weighted collaborative filter
description: Embodiments disclosed provide a system, method, and computer program product for identifying consumer items more likely to be bought by an individual user. In some embodiments, a collaborative filter may be used to rank items based on the degree to which they match user preferences. The collaborative filter may be hierarchical and may take various factors into consideration. Example factors may include the similarity among items based on observable features, a summary of aggregate online search behavior across multiple users, the item features determined to be most important to the individual user, and a baseline item against which a conditional probability of another item being selected is measured.

title: Processing unit using truth-valued flow
description:
A truth-valued-flow processing unit according to 
the invention comprises truth value generator circuits 
(TG1 - TG3), truth-valued-flow inference units (TVFI1 - 
TVFI7), a truth value converter (13), a first bus (15) 
and a second bus (16). Each truth value generator circuit 
is connected at an output side thereof to a corresponding 
one of the first buses, generates truth values, which 
correspond to an applied input variable, with regard to 
a plurality of functions used by the antecedents of 
implications, and outputs the truth values on the 
corresponding first bus. Each truth-valued-flow 
inference unit is connected at an input side thereof to 
all of the first buses and at an output side thereof to 
one line of the second bus, selects, from all truth 
values outputted by the plurality of truth value 
generator circuits and inputted thereto via the first 
buses, prescribed ones of the truth values in accordance 
with predetermined rules and subjects these truth values 
to a prescribed operation, thereby generating a truth 
value that is to act upon the corresponding consequent 
and outputting the truth value on the second bus. The 
truth value converter causes the truth values outputted 
by the plurality of truth-valued-flow inference units 
and inputted thereto via the second bus to act upon each 
of the plurality of functions used by the consequent, 
thereby providing an output representing inferential 
results.

title: Hybridization of polynucleotides conjugated with chromophores and fluorophores to form a donor-to-donor energy transfer system
description: The present invention contemplates chromophore-containing polynucleotides having at least two donor chromophores operatively linked to the polynucleotide by linker arms, such that the chromophores are positioned by linkage along the length of the polynucleotide at a donor-donor transfer distance, and at least one fluorescing acceptor chromophore operatively linked to the polynucleotide by a linker arm, such that the fluorescing acceptor chromophore is positioned by linkage at a donor-acceptor transfer distance from at least one of the donor chromophores, to form a photonic structure for collecting photonic energy and transferring the energy to an acceptor chromophore, and methods using the photonic structures.  <IMAGE>   <IMAGE>

title: Night monitoring recognition method and system based on neural network enhancement
description: The application discloses a night monitoring and identifying method based on neural network enhancement, which comprises the steps of firstly obtaining neighborhood information of pixels in a night monitoring image, carrying out self-adaptive enhancement on the image based on a secondary Taylor series to obtain a self-adaptive enhanced image, then extracting region features and edge features from the self-adaptive enhanced image and respectively inputting the region features and the edge features into corresponding neural networks, carrying out significance calculation on feature identification results output by the neural networks, fusing the calculated significant region images to obtain a comprehensive significant image, finally segmenting the comprehensive significant image by using a maximum entropy method to obtain a binary image, and extracting a target image from the self-adaptive enhanced image based on the binary image. The method can improve the contrast of the image, and can perform self-adaptive image enhancement aiming at the problem of uneven illumination of each part of the image, and the generated saliency map can effectively cover the boundary of the target area and well inhibit the saliency of the background area.

title: Bearing monitoring method and system applied to bearing test
description: This invention discloses a bearing monitoring method and system applied to bearing testing, belonging to the field of intelligent monitoring technology. The method includes: inputting a collected spatiotemporal sensor dataset into an improved convolutional neural network; using an attention convolutional layer for modal weight allocation; and using a pyramid pooling layer for global information aggregation, outputting a bearing joint vector; inputting the bearing joint vector into a digital twin engine to drive the bearing to perform multi-condition response simulations, and monitoring the lubricating film thickness distribution and crack propagation rate in real time, generating a virtual simulation dataset; applying a dynamic residual analysis algorithm to compare the virtual simulation dataset and the spatiotemporal sensor dataset to obtain a deviation matrix; and incrementally updating the improved convolutional neural network based on the deviation matrix. This invention utilizes an improved convolutional neural network and a digital twin engine to effectively fuse multimodal data, while simultaneously optimizing and dynamically adjusting the control strategy, ensuring efficient and stable operation under various working conditions.

title: Coherent Ising Machine and its Model Parameter Optimization Methods, Devices, Media and Products
description: The application discloses a coherent element Xin Ji and a model parameter optimization method, a device, a medium and a product thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an initial training population; the initial training population comprises a plurality of quantum neural network QNN examples configured with different parameter combinations, the initial training population is iteratively updated based on an evolutionary optimization algorithm to obtain a target training population corresponding to the initial training population when the convergence condition is reached, the optimal QNN examples in the target training population are determined, and the parameter combinations of the optimal QNN examples are obtained. Aiming at the problems of discontinuity and irreducibility of the coherent i Xin Ji quantum state, the embodiment of the application provides a solution combining the population evolution optimization algorithm with the characteristics of the coherent i Xin Ji, wherein the parameters of discrete QNN examples in a training population are iteratively updated based on the evolution optimization algorithm, and meanwhile, the optimal parameter combination is efficiently solved by utilizing the parallel computing advantage of the coherent i Xin Ji, so that the model training efficiency is improved.

title: Fourier stacked microscopic imaging reconstruction method based on residual mixed self-attention
description: The invention is suitable for the technical field of microscopic imaging, and provides a Fourier laminated microscopic imaging reconstruction method based on residual mixed self-attention, which comprises the steps of firstly preparing a data set; then constructing a Fourier stacked microscopic imaging reconstruction network model based on residual mixed self-attention, which comprises three parts of shallow feature extraction, deep feature extraction and image reconstruction, training by using a loss function and an optimizer combining structural similarity and mean square error, and finally verifying the performance and the actual data processing capacity of the model by using a test set and a real acquisition image. The method does not need lengthy iteration and has short reconstruction time, is beneficial to the practical application in the field of rapid cell detection, improves the visual quality of reconstructed images through the innovative double-branch fusion design and the mixed loss function training, and realizes the reconstruction of low-rotation high-resolution amplitude and phase accurately by the aid of the double-branch fusion design in cooperation with global residual connection and multiple input features, efficient recovery of lost information of amplitude and phase images and redundancy removal.

title: Real-time monitoring method for coaxial rotor spacing in complex environments based on MB network
description: This application relates to a method for real-time monitoring of coaxial rotor blade spacing in complex environments based on Mobile-Blade networks. It includes the following steps: installing an industrial camera and performing machine vision calibration; acquiring blade tip images; constructing a Mobile-Blade network model and training and deploying the model; locating the blade tip reference point and calculating the blade spacing. This invention effectively solves the problems of significant influence from blade aerodynamic characteristics, low accuracy of blade tip marker point detection, and slow detection speed in existing methods. It enables real-time, high-precision monitoring of coaxial rotor blade spacing in complex environments, providing data support for the design and improvement of new coaxial helicopters.

title: Efficiency Improvement Methods for Digital Management in Government and Enterprise
description: The invention discloses an efficiency improving method for digital management of government enterprises, which relates to the technical field of big data analysis and comprises the following steps: S1, establishing a business architecture interaction data synchronous network of each project type of an government enterprise, marking business log execution processes of each project type of the government enterprise, generating a business architecture interaction dynamic authority network of each project type of the government enterprise, verifying the dependency relationship between each business execution process under the business architecture dynamic authority, giving priority to the business execution process, determining initial resource allocation of the business execution process of each project type of the government enterprise, establishing a resource allocation income evaluation model of each project type of the government enterprise, and generating an optimal resource allocation scheme of each project type of the government enterprise. The invention has the beneficial effects of remarkably improving the systematicness and adaptability of digital management of government enterprises and providing an integral solution for complex business scenes with both compliance and efficiency.

title: Sewage treatment overall process supervision method and system based on Internet of things
description: This invention discloses a method and system for monitoring the entire wastewater treatment process based on the Internet of Things (IoT), relating to the field of wastewater treatment monitoring technology. Based on a dynamically weighted isolated forest algorithm, this invention significantly enhances the ability to identify deliberate evasion behaviors by adjusting feature sensitivity in real time. A nighttime low-flow compensation strategy combined with concentration shift detection effectively solves the industry problem of enterprises illegally discharging wastewater in regulatory blind spots, penetrating disguised methods such as dilution discharge and intermittent discharge to directly pinpoint abnormal discharge periods. Furthermore, by introducing a Granger causality model and a collaborative interference removal mechanism, the invention aligns enterprise equipment start-up and shutdown events with the time sequence of abnormal water quality fluctuations. Through statistical significance analysis and time decay weight allocation, it accurately isolates the interference effects of enterprises discharging simultaneously. This fundamentally solves the problem of shirking responsibility for multi-source drainage, providing an undeniable chain of evidence for environmental law enforcement.

title: Video pedestrian re-identification method based on multi-scale fusion
description: The invention provides a video pedestrian re-identification method based on multi-scale fusion, which comprises the steps of constructing a 3DCABlock framework for pedestrian shallow feature extraction, outputting a global shallow feature map of a pedestrian, constructing a 3DISBlock framework for pedestrian depth feature extraction to obtain a pedestrian depth representation map with strong discrimination, constructing a Arattention module of a pedestrian feature correction module to obtain a more effective pedestrian depth feature map, and constructing an ATC module for pedestrian feature expansion to obtain final pedestrian feature information. The method can extract more abundant pedestrian semantic features and multi-frame pedestrian space-time features under multi-scale, and effectively search the pedestrian identity under smaller parameter quantity, thereby solving the problems of excessively complex network model and poor real-time performance existing in multi-frame feature extraction of video pedestrian re-identification.

title: Engineering safety monitoring system region division method based on measuring point space-time characteristics
description: The invention discloses an area division method of an engineering safety monitoring system based on the spatio-temporal characteristics of measuring points, which includes two stages of spatio-temporal characteristic representation of measuring points and area division; , compress the high-dimensional monitoring data table to increase the time series characteristics of the measurement points, and express the spatial characteristics of the measurement points (coordinate position information, measurement point attributes, etc.) through the normalization method. In the region division stage: a region division method based on the spatiotemporal characteristics of measuring points is adopted, and auxiliary objective variables are introduced to optimize the region division objective function, so that the region division results reflect the physical laws of the structure’s operation, and the global security judgment problem is divided into local single domains. superior. The present invention realizes the comprehensive evaluation of the dam operating conditions by analyzing the change law of the monitoring data of the measuring points, and provides a decision basis for the engineering safety analysis.

title: Image retrieval method, image retrieval device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses an image retrieval method, an image retrieval device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image, and extracting image features of the target image to obtain a first feature vector; acquiring a weight fusion characteristic vector of each candidate image, wherein the weight fusion characteristic vector is obtained by adjusting the characteristic vector of the candidate image through the weight corresponding to the characteristic vector of the candidate image, and the characteristic vector of one candidate image corresponds to one weight; and fusing the feature vectors according to the first feature vector and the weight of each candidate image to determine a candidate image matched with the target image. In the embodiment of the invention, on the basis of the feature vector of each candidate image, a corresponding weight is configured for the feature vector of each candidate image, the feature vector of each candidate image is adjusted through the weight, and image retrieval is performed on the basis of the adjusted feature vector, so that the interference of images with similar details but different object types can be reduced, and the accuracy of image retrieval is improved.

title: Method, device and device for realizing isomeric map, molecular spatial structure property identification
description: The invention discloses a method, a device and machine equipment for realizing heterogeneous graph identification and realizing identification of properties corresponding to molecular space structures. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out feature description on the contained topological structure on the heterogeneous graph to generate feature information; generating a feature vector corresponding to a key node on a topological structure contained in the abnormal graph through sampling of the abnormal graph and the feature information; aggregating the feature vectors to generate a graph representation vector corresponding to the heterogeneous graph; and carrying out classification processing on the abnormal picture according to the map representation vector to obtain a classification prediction result. The method enables the identification of the heterogeneous pattern, such as the graphical representation corresponding to the molecular spatial structure, to be realized through the neural network, effectively improves the analysis processing performance related to the heterogeneous pattern, enables the neural network not to be limited to the classification identification of network data any more, and greatly expands the application scene.

title: Image recognition method, device and equipment based on lightweight network model
description: The invention discloses an image recognition method, device and equipment based on a lightweight network model. The image recognition method includes the following steps: S1, acquiring a target image to be recognized; S2, inputting the target image into a trained lightweight network model; S3, using the trained lightweight network model to classify the target image . Wherein, the process of obtaining the lightweight network model includes the following steps: S21, constructing a variant convolutional neural network without a fully connected layer; S22, classifying the image through a softmax classifier, and updating the weight of the convolutional layer; S23 , using the weight-updated variant convolutional neural network to extract the features of the image again, and standardize the features; S24, generate feature nodes and enhanced nodes from the standardized features according to the construction method of the width network, and determine the final feature nodes , Increase the number of nodes, and construct a lightweight network model.

title: An improved Faster R-CNN network detection method for floating objects based on video features
description: The present invention relates to an improved Faster R-CNN network detection method for floating objects based on video features, which replaces the two-dimensional feature extraction network in the Faster R-CNN network with the improved Faster R-CNN network obtained by the three-dimensional feature extraction network; input Continuous 16-frame video sequence images are extracted into the three-dimensional feature extraction network to extract feature maps, and the feature maps are sent to the RPN network to generate region candidate frames and classified as foreground or background; the initial candidate frames classified as foreground are corrected by bounding box regression. The position of the rectangular frame; sort all the candidate rectangular frames, and select the first N candidate frames with a higher foreground probability; map the feature maps of the N candidate frames to a fixed size through the ROI pooling layer; The obtained feature map is classified into floating objects and non-floating objects through the fully connected layer and softmax layer, and the bounding box regression is performed on the feature map again to further correct the coordinate position of the detected floating objects. The invention can improve the efficiency of the process of searching for floating objects and save manpower and material resources.

title: Method and device for optimizing damage identification results
description: An embodiment of the present specification provides a method for optimizing an impairment recognition result, where on one hand, the method includes a method for optimizing an impairment recognition result of a single picture according to data interacted with a user, and specifically includes: firstly, identifying a primary damage identification result of a single picture based on a CNN algorithm, displaying the primary damage identification result to a user, receiving the modification of the primary damage identification result by the user, then combining the modification, re-outputting the damage identification result under the influence of an LSTM and an Attention mechanism, and displaying the damage identification result to the user again until the user is satisfied; on the other hand, the method further comprises a method for optimizing the damage identification result of the current picture based on the damage identification result of other pictures, and the method specifically comprises the following steps: and identifying the initial damage identification result of the current picture based on a CNN algorithm, and then optimizing the initial damage identification result of the current picture by combining the damage identification results of other pictures through an LSTM and an Attention mechanism.

title: Artificial sensory neural circuit and preparation method thereof
description: The invention discloses an artificial sensory neural circuit and a preparation method thereof. The artificial sensory neural circuit comprises a sensor, a first memristor and a neuron circuit, wherein the first memristor has unidirectional resistance characteristics; The sensor is used for sensing an external signal, and generating an excitation signal according to the external signal; the first memristor is used for generating a response signal according to the excitation signal; the neuron circuit is used for charging according to the response signal; Discharge to output pulse signal. The invention discloses an artificial sensory neural circuit and a preparation method thereof, which can realize the sensitivity and habitual characteristics of biological perception by adopting a simple circuit structure.

title: Image processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the present application discloses an image processing method, apparatus, computer equipment and storage medium, the method comprising: obtaining a target image containing a target object, obtaining an original mask and an image segmentation model; the image segmentation model comprises a first unit model and a second unit model, based on the pooling layer in the first unit model, downsampling the original mask to obtain a downsampled mask, based on the convolution pooling layer in the second unit model and the downsampled mask, extracting regional convolution feature information of the target image, updating the original mask according to the regional convolution feature information, and when the updated original mask meets the error convergence condition, determining the target image region of the target object in the target image according to the updated original mask. The present application can improve the efficiency of image segmentation.

title: Integrated circuit repair algorithm determination method and device, storage medium, electronic device
description: The present disclosure relates to the field of computer technologies, and in particular, to a method and an apparatus for determining an integrated circuit repair algorithm, a storage medium, and an electronic device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring failure test unit data of an integrated circuit to be repaired; acquiring the distribution type of the failure units of the integrated circuit to be repaired according to the failure test unit data and by combining with a type analysis model constructed by a deep learning network; and obtaining the repair performance index of each candidate repair algorithm on the distribution type of the failure unit in a repair algorithm library according to the distribution type of the failure unit, and determining the candidate repair algorithm with the optimal repair performance index as a target repair algorithm. The method and the device have the advantages that the repairing rate of each integrated circuit to be repaired can be the highest, the using quantity of the repairing circuits is the least, the repairing analysis time is the shortest, the repairing efficiency and the repairing accuracy are improved, and the repairing cost is reduced.

title: Group behavior analysis method and device
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a group behavior analysis method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a target loss function based on a network loss function and a variance minimization method, and constructing a target supervision model based on the target loss function through a deep supervision mode; constructing a target deep neural network based on a multi-channel encoder, a multi-channel decoder and the target supervision model; and performing group behavior analysis through the target deep neural network to determine a group behavior state according to an analysis result. The group behavior analysis method provided by the invention can effectively improve the accuracy and reliability of the analysis result, improve the analysis efficiency of the group behavior and reduce the consumption of human resources.

title: An End-to-End Person Re-Identification Method Based on Self-Attention Deep Learning
description: The invention discloses an end-to-end pedestrian re-identification method based on self-attention deep learning, relates to the technical field of machine learning and pattern recognition, and is used to improve the performance of pedestrian re-identification, including the following steps: 1) using triplet images as For the input data of the deep learning network, the pre-trained Resnet50 deep network is used to remove the depth features of the last classification layer to extract the image; 2) On the basis of the depth features, the self-attention network is used to further obtain the self-attention features; 3) Integrate self-attention features and depth features to generate more discriminative image features; 4) jointly supervise the training of the network with the loss function of multi-classification tasks and verification tasks, and continuously optimize the parameters of the network model through multiple iterations, so as to obtain Optimal model for pedestrian re-identification.

title: Real-time video semantic segmentation method
description: The invention belongs to the field of computer vision, and relates to a real-time video semantic segmentation method. The method comprises the following steps: step 1: selecting a training and testing data set; step 2: constructing a backbone network based on images; and step 3: pre-training a backbone network by using a training data set; and 4, step 4: constructing an integral video semantic segmentation model; and 5: training the whole video semantic segmentation model on a training data set; step 6: and inputting the video frame of the test set, carrying out forward propagation in the trained video semantic segmentation model, and outputting a predicted semantic segmentation result end to end. The method has high reasoning speed and can meet the requirement of real-time performance; the accuracy is high, the video semantic segmentation can be accurately realized, and the practicability is very strong.

title: An optimal synchronization control method for coupled fractional-order chaotic electromechanical devices
description: The invention relates to an optimal synchronous control method of a coupled fractional order chaotic electromechanical device, and belongs to the field of automation. A synchronous model of the fractional order electromechanical device with the mutually coupled capacitors and resistors is established, and a phase diagram shows that the dynamic behavior of the fractional order electromechanical device is closely related to physical parameters, coupling coefficients and the fractional order. In order to transfer the driven system from the original track to the track of the active system, an optimal synchronous control method consisting of an adaptive feedforward controller and an optimal feedback controller is provided. Under the framework of combining a fractional order back-stepping method and a hierarchical 2-type fuzzy neural network, a feedforward controller for estimating an unknown function of a dynamic system is provided. Meanwhile, a self-adaptive dynamic programming method is provided for solving the zero and differential game problems in the optimal feedback controller. The invention not only ensures the asymptotic stability of the closed-loop system and realizes the optimal synchronization, but also minimizes the cost function.

title: An automatic identification method of point-touch verification code based on LeNet and SSD
description: The invention discloses a point-touch verification code automatic identification method based on LeNet and SSD, which includes the following steps: Step 1, use Charls and other packet capture tools to capture the requests and responses of the verification code identification process, analyze the response structure, and use HttpURLConnection Realize the automation of recognizing text acquisition, image acquisition, and simulating the fragmentation image synthesis process with reference to JavaScript, and complete the automation of web interaction; Step 2, use Matlab's advantages in processing matrix images, and use .m to process the image DBSCAN clustering, binarization, and dialation expansion , output functions such as images to be recognized, and encapsulate them into jar files for automated program calls. This touch verification code recognition method based on SSD and LeNet can automatically identify the characters of the touch verification code and their positions in the background image, and complete the verification process through a series of web automatic interactions. This method is based on the use of In-depth self-learning and reinforcement to continuously improve recognition accuracy.

title: Knowledge tracking data processing method, system and storage medium based on graph convolution
description: The invention discloses a knowledge tracking data processing method, a knowledge tracking data processing system and a storage medium based on graph convolution, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring answer information of a current time node on a problem of a current knowledge point, interference information in the answer process and adjacent knowledge points of the current knowledge point; processing answer information, interference information and adjacent knowledge points by adopting a knowledge tracking model; the processing procedure of the knowledge tracking model specifically includes: performing graph volume processing on answer information and interference information of the current knowledge point and adjacent knowledge points; and updating the mastery degree of the current knowledge point and the adjacent knowledge points according to the graph convolution processing result. The invention adopts the knowledge tracking model to process the answer information, the interference information and the adjacent knowledge points so as to update the mastery degree of the current knowledge point and the adjacent knowledge points, thereby enabling the mastery degree of the updated knowledge points to be more in line with the actual mastery degree. The invention can be widely applied to the technical field of deep learning.

title: Audio reconstruction method and apparatus using machine learning
description: An audio reconstruction method and apparatus are provided for reconstructing decoding parameters or audio signals obtained from a bitstream through machine learning to provide improved sound quality. The audio reconstruction method includes obtaining a plurality of decoding parameters of a current frame by decoding a bitstream, determining characteristics of a second parameter included in the plurality of decoding parameters and associated with the first parameter based on a first parameter included in the plurality of decoding parameters, obtaining a reconstructed second parameter by applying a machine learning model to at least one of the plurality of decoding parameters, the second parameter, and the characteristics of the second parameter, and decoding an audio signal based on the reconstructed second parameter.

title: Face emotion recognition method based on graph convolution neural network
description: The invention relates to a face emotion recognition method based on a convolutional neural network. In the image database, a background image is extracted by using a convolution neural network of a non-face area, the European structure of the image is converted into an image structure, the emotion states of people in the background are analyzed by extracting the spatial characteristic information of nodes and edges in the image structure to classify the face emotion, and finally, the face emotion recognition rate is greatly improved; for data of a video sequence, the image convolution neural network not only improves the extraction of characteristic information on a spatial domain, but also infers background change information in the video sequence, thereby greatly improving the face emotion recognition rate.

title: Commodity classification and identification method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present application provides a commodity classification and identification method, device, electronic device and storage medium. The commodity classification and identification method includes: using a first convolutional neural network to extract the first feature information of each area image of the commodity distribution image, wherein the commodity distribution image includes a plurality of mutually disjoint area images, and each of the area images The image corresponds to a commodity; the corresponding attention area map is generated according to the area image and the corresponding first feature information; the second feature information of the attention area map is extracted by using a second convolutional neural network; the first feature information and The second feature information is pooled to obtain a bilinear vector; according to the bilinear vector, the probability distribution of the classification of the product corresponding to the regional image is obtained, and the classification result is obtained based on the probability distribution . In the present application, by using bilinear vectors to identify subtle feature differences, the accuracy of product classification and identification can be improved.

title: Data processing device, method, chip and electronic equipment
description: The present application provides a data processing device, method, chip and electronic equipment, the data processing device is used to perform machine learning calculation; the data processing device includes a block compression circuit and a main processing circuit; the block compression circuit's first An output terminal is connected to the first input terminal of the main processing circuit, and the data processing device can reduce the data bandwidth between the main processing circuit and the slave processing circuit in the data processing device.

title: A neural network inference acceleration method based on two-stage cache
description: The invention discloses a neural network reasoning acceleration method based on two-section cache, which is characterized by counting the occurrence times of each input tensor in a data set, sorting each input tensor by adopting descending order according to the occurrence times, finally outputting the sorted input tensor sorted data set, constructing a data structure of static cache, and determining a storing and reading method of the static cache; determining a basic unit stored in the dynamic cache and determining a cache replacement method of the dynamic cache; the static cache is constructed and completed before the neural network is deployed, the dynamic cache is empty when the neural network is deployed, input and output pairs are stored and exchanged out according to a cache replacement method in the operation of the neural network, and the neural network reasoning acceleration based on the two-stage cache is completed. The invention fully considers the characteristics of input data in the neural network reasoning process, and designs the two-section cache algorithm and the data structure in a targeted manner, thereby avoiding unnecessary calculation, reducing the time consumption of reasoning and reducing the service cost.

title: Discrimination method, discrimination device, and recording medium
description: The invention provides a discrimination method, a learning method, a discrimination device and a storage medium, which can discriminate the type of a cell more accurately than before based on a Raman spectrum obtained from the cell. In a method for discriminating a type of a cell included in a sample, a raman spectrum is acquired from an unrecognized cell, a plurality of coincidence degrees indicating the degree to which the raman spectrum of the unrecognized cell coincides with the spectrum of a plurality of principal components obtained by principal component analysis of a plurality of raman spectra constituted by raman spectra obtained individually from each of a plurality of cells of a specified type are calculated, and the plurality of coincidence degrees are classified based on the result of classifying the plurality of principal component scores corresponding to each of a plurality of cells of a specified type obtained by the principal component analysis by using a learning model of supervised learning, thereby discriminating the type of the unrecognized cell.

title: Appeal information extraction method and system based on machine reading understanding
description: The invention discloses a appeal information extraction method and system based on machine reading understanding, which comprises the following steps: marking the appeal sample set to obtain a ternary sample set; inputting the training set into a pre-training model to obtain a appeal shape vector sequence X; embedding each sample in a referee document sample set into a vector to obtain a document vector sequence Y; aggregating the selected document vector and the appeal state vector in the appeal state vector sequence X to obtain a final vector Z; and converting the final hidden state of the pre-training model into the probability of answer span to generate a final model. The appeal-shape information extraction method and system based on machine reading understanding automatically extract the related information content of the preset template in the appeal shape by utilizing a machine reading understanding technology, and ensure the information extraction precision.

title: Seat belt status determination system and method
description: A seat belt status determination system and method for a vehicle that evaluates a seat belt and determines whether the seat belt is buckled and whether the seat belt is properly routed to a passenger. To assess the seat belt state, the systems and methods use seat belt sensors and cameras inside the vehicle cabin to generate data that is then analyzed in conjunction with machine learning techniques (e.g., by supervised machine learning techniques implemented using neural networks) to classify the seat belt state into one or more classifications, such as: the passenger is not present, the passenger presence/seat belt is not worn correctly, the passenger presence/seat belt is worn correctly, and the field of view is blocked.

title: Generate and apply prediction models based on blockchain data
description: Generating and applying a predictive model based on blockchain data is disclosed. Based on blockchain data associated with historical invoices, a predictive model is generated using machine learning. The predictive model is used to generate recommendations for obtaining a target financing amount by a target financing date for a specific entity. The predictive model is applied to outstanding invoices of the specific entity. Based on the blockchain data associated with the outstanding invoices, the predictive model determines a predicted cost that the specific entity will incur when using each outstanding invoice to obtain financing by a target financing date. A type of financing to be used for each invoice is also identified. Invoices are selected based on the predicted cost. An interface presents recommendations for obtaining a target financing amount by a target financing date using the selected invoices.

title: A license plate detection method, device, equipment and medium
description: The present application discloses a license plate detection method, device, equipment and medium, including: inputting a training sample image into a feature extraction network to obtain a corresponding first feature map; generating a heatmap corresponding to the first feature map; determining from the heatmap the pixel points whose foreground target probability value is greater than a preset probability threshold; generating anchors of different sizes and aspect ratios on the determined pixel points; performing border regression on the anchors to obtain a target candidate frame; classifying and regressing the target candidate frame to obtain a corresponding prediction result; the prediction result includes a target frame category and a target frame position; mapping the prediction result to the initial training sample image, and obtaining a corresponding training detection result using a non-maximum suppression method; repeating the above steps to train a pre-constructed detection model to obtain a trained model; when a license plate image to be detected is obtained, the trained model is used to output the corresponding detection result. The speed and accuracy of license plate detection can be improved.

title: Neural network structure search method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present application provides a neural network structure search method, device, electronic device and storage medium, the method comprising: obtaining structural parameters corresponding to multiple tasks from a network structure to be searched, the network structure to be searched is composed of multiple basic units, the basic units include multiple nodes, and the structural parameters represent the connection probability of the corresponding tasks between the nodes; retaining the structural parameter with the largest connection probability for each of the multiple tasks, obtaining a pre-trained model corresponding to each task; training the pre-trained model corresponding to each task, and obtaining a neural network model after the search. In the above implementation process, the speed of searching for an effective neural network structure model is effectively improved by combining neural network architecture search and multi-task learning.

title: A GNSS-R sea surface wind speed inversion method and system based on BP neural network
description: The invention discloses a GNSS-R sea surface wind speed inversion method and system based on BP neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting a DDM diagram to be tested into a pre-trained sea surface wind speed inversion model, and outputting a corresponding inversion wind speed; the sea surface wind speed inversion model is a BP neural network. According to the invention, the BP neural network is utilized to invert the GNSS-R sea surface wind speed, the model is simple, the modeling time and inversion time are shortened, and the inversion precision is further improved; the BP neural network fully utilizes the physical quantity related to the wind speed in the DDM to perform characteristic learning, reduces the calculated quantity and shortens the time consumption under the condition of guaranteeing the inversion precision, and has the characteristics of simple and quick model, high result precision and the like.

title: A DNA movable type printing machine, DNA-based data storage device and method
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a DNA type printer, a data storage device and a method based on DNA, wherein the DNA type printer comprises the following components: a PCR reaction region for sequentially connecting the acquired multiple DNA type sequences into DNA sequences representing binary information by PCR reaction, wherein each DNA type sequence is a single-stranded DNA fragment synthesized in advance according to a predetermined mapping rule, the predetermined mapping rule is used for defining a mapping relation between a specific multi-bit binary code and a specific base sequence, and each single-stranded DNA fragment comprises a base sequence corresponding to a specific multi-bit binary code; the PCR product purification zone is used for purifying the products subjected to the PCR reaction; a mechanical arm; and the mechanical arm control module is used for controlling the mechanical arm to acquire the DNA type sequence and controlling the mechanical arm to serve as a transfer tool of a product of the PCR reaction area and a product of the PCR product purification area.

title: Model training method, image processing method, device, computer system and medium
description: The disclosure provides a model training method, which is applied to a computer system. The method includes: building an initial network model. A plurality of sample images containing the serial number characters and respective label sets of the plurality of sample images are acquired, and the label set of each sample image in the plurality of sample images includes: a category label for each pixel in the sample image. Then, based on the plurality of sample images and their respective label sets, the initial network model is trained to obtain a target network model, and the target network model is used to segment the serial number characters. The present disclosure also provides a model training device, an image processing method, an image processing device, a computer system and a medium.

title: A mobile object intention recognition device, method, system, terminal and medium
description: The present invention provides a method, system, terminal, and storage medium for recognizing the intention of a moving object to detect a moving object in a traffic jam scene, identify the driving intention of the moving object entering the scene at the next moment, and judge whether the near-field moving object cuts into the planned path of the main body and causes a collision Probability, and then give the driver the corresponding entrapment intention prompt at the appropriate time point, or choose an appropriate avoidance response according to the result of the entrapment intention judgment, or re-iterate its own driving path. The present invention can not only judge the jamming intention, but also pre-judgment including the jamming intention in front of the vehicle, the lane changing intention in front of the vehicle, the overtaking intention on the left and right sides of the vehicle, and the lane changing intention in the rear of the vehicle, which are L4 level and L5 level Provides prerequisites for unmanned near-field vehicle behavior prediction.

title: Method and device for generating unpaired heterogeneous face image based on generation countermeasure network
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for generating a non-pairwise heterogeneous face image based on a generation countermeasure network, wherein the scheme comprises the following steps: training the heterogeneous face image generation model through a plurality of iterations, wherein each iteration comprises: inputting the unpaired heterogeneous face images sampled in the domain a and the domain b into a generator of the domain a and a generator of the domain b respectively, obtaining cross-domain generated images by using a decoder of the domain a and a decoder of the domain b respectively, evaluating the authenticity of the cross-domain generated images by using a discriminator of the domain a and a discriminator of the domain b respectively, and updating model parameters based on the loss of the heterogeneous face image generation model; and generating the face image by adopting the trained heterogeneous face image generation model. By adopting the technical scheme, the heterogeneous face image can be generated under the conditions of no supervision and unpaired condition, the quality and the diversity of the generated image are enhanced, and the identity information holding capacity is greatly enhanced.

title: A kind of drug screening method, device and electronic equipment
description: The present invention provides a drug screening method, device and electronic equipment. The method includes: determining the structural features of protein molecules and the structural features of target molecules in a molecular sample pair; determining a node information transmitter of a graph neural network in a drug screening model Network; based on the structural characteristics of protein molecules, determine the edge information transfer sub-network of the graph neural network in the drug screening model; combine protein molecules and target molecules through the drug screening model; realize the drug detection based on the activity of the binding products of protein molecules and target molecules Therefore, the structural features of protein maps and small molecule maps can be effectively represented by the drug screening model, and the protein molecules and target molecules can be accurately combined. Protein molecules and target molecules are processed to improve the efficiency of drug screening and save time for drug screening.

title: Data storage device and its data prediction method
description: The invention discloses a data storage device and a data prediction method thereof. The data storage device includes a memory unit and a prediction unit. The prediction unit obtains a plurality of access location data of a plurality of data access actions in the previous access history of the memory unit. A prediction unit analyzes the memory unit's previous access history. The predicting unit quantizes the plurality of access location data to obtain a plurality of quantized data corresponding to previous access history. The predicting unit predicts the data pre-access target of the memory unit according to the plurality of quantized data. Therefore, the data storage device and the data prediction method thereof of the present invention can effectively predict the data pre-access target of the memory unit.

title: Fault diagnosis method and system for digital twin driven marine oil underwater production system
description: The invention belongs to the field of petroleum engineering, and particularly relates to a fault diagnosis method and system for a digital twin-driven marine petroleum underwater production system. The fault diagnosis method for the marine oil underwater production system driven by the digital twin comprises the following three steps: establishing a digital twin body, tracking and updating the digital twin body and establishing a fault diagnosis reasoning model. The digital twin driven marine oil underwater production system fault diagnosis system comprises seven parts: the system comprises a data collection and analysis subsystem, an overwater control module data collection and processing subsystem, a hydraulic power unit data collection and processing subsystem, an electric power unit data collection and processing subsystem, an underwater control module electronic module data collection and processing subsystem and an underwater Christmas tree data collection and processing subsystem.

title: Method and device for processing character image data
description: The present application discloses a method and device for processing character image data, and relates to the fields of computer vision and deep learning technology. The specific implementation method includes: obtaining a character image video of a first character as the first data, and obtaining a character image video of a second character as the second data, wherein the character image video of the first character has a variety of dynamic images; replacing the character image extracted from the first data with the character image extracted from the second data; replacing the face extracted from the first data with the face extracted from the second data; replacing the face in the replaced character image with the replaced face to obtain the target character image. The present application uses a head-changing operation to allow the replaced character image to have different characteristics of different character images. Moreover, the combination with the first character with rich dynamic images can make up for the problem of insufficient richness of the second character's dynamic image. In addition, the face-changing operation performed on the face can effectively improve the clarity of the face in the replaced character image.

title: News picture shooting angle identification method based on gated convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses a method for recognizing shooting angles of news pictures based on a gated convolutional neural network. based on the target detection algorithm model and the image classification algorithm model after training; build a two-branch gated convolutional neural network algorithm model based on the two-branch gated convolutional neural network The network algorithm model obtains the news picture shooting angle corresponding to the identification image, etc. The present invention can identify the corresponding news picture as looking down, looking up or looking up to capture, consumes less resources, and takes less time to calculate, and can complete practical engineering applications.

title: Medical image classification method, device, terminal equipment and storage medium
description: The application is applicable to the technical field of image processing, and provides a medical image classification method, a device, a terminal device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining medical images to be classified; the method comprises the steps of obtaining tensors of medical images to be classified, carrying out tensor rank-one decomposition on the tensors of the medical images to be classified to obtain N-order components of the tensors of the medical images to be classified, wherein N refers to the order of the tensors of the medical images to be classified, inputting the N-order components of the tensors of the medical images to be classified into a pre-constructed decision function, classifying the medical images to be classified through the decision function, and outputting classification results of the medical images to be classified. The application can improve the classification accuracy of medical images.

title: Method, device and equipment for generating retinopathy identification model
description: The invention provides a generation method, a recognition device and equipment of a retina pathological change recognition model, which are used for training a preset network model by utilizing fundus pictures contained in a training set to obtain the retina pathological change recognition model after training, wherein the fundus pictures in the training set carry classification mark information corresponding to the fundus pictures, the classification mark information is retina characteristic classification information corresponding to the fundus pictures, and the preset network model learns the classification mark information contained in the fundus pictures in the training process, so that the retina pathological change recognition model after training can be used for recognizing retina images contained in a detection picture to give accurate classification results of retina characteristics. According to the method, the device and the equipment provided by the embodiment, the network model for identifying the retinopathy is trained in a deep learning mode, so that the accuracy and the detection efficiency of fundus image identification are improved.

title: ENDOSCOPIC IMAGE IDENTIFICATION METHOD, ELECTRONIC DEVICE AND STORAGE MEDIUM
description: The present invention provides an endoscopic image identification method, an electronic device, and a storage medium. The endoscopic image identification method includes the steps of: using a first neural network model to perform disease type prediction for each of a plurality of disease categories for a plurality of original images; constructing a test sample set for the plurality of disease categories based on the disease type prediction results for the plurality of original images; using a second neural network model to perform disease type classification for each of the test sample sets for the plurality of disease categories; and superimposing the plurality of disease type classification results to obtain a case diagnosis result, in which the second neural network model weights and combines a plurality of image features in the test sample set to obtain the disease type classification result. The endoscopic image identification method weights and combines a plurality of image features of the test sample set to improve the accuracy of disease type classification.

title: System and method for integrating calendar applications with task facilitation services - Patents.com
description: Integration of an external calendar application with a task facilitation service includes mechanisms for generating tasks within the task facilitation service based on calendar application calendar data received by the task facilitation service and processed using various dynamic models and algorithms. Further examples of integration include a task facilitation service generating recommendations for new calendar items, and modifications to existing calendar items, by leveraging data and models available to the task facilitation service.

title: A communication link diagnosis system based on dynamic trigger model
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of communication link diagnosis, and in particular to a communication link diagnosis system based on a dynamic trigger model, which includes a dynamic configuration module, a data generation module and a comparison and verification module. The dynamic configuration module constructs a dynamic task model to generate a detection task; the data generation module generates a detection object according to the task, and generates a multi-source verification package through a multi-source encapsulation strategy and transmits it to the target node; the comparison and verification module uses a multi-source analysis strategy to calculate the reliability value and restore the detection data to generate a link status evaluation result. The present application can realize efficient and accurate communication link diagnosis, realize rapid positioning of communication link fault points, and improve the intelligent level of link anomaly detection and evaluation.

title: A method and device for enhancing computing performance based on a configurable GPU tile architecture based on deep learning
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a GPU architecture, a configuration method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the architecture comprises the following components: at least one processing module comprising computing resources and storage resources; a configuration controller, connected with the at least one processing module, for configuring the at least one processing module with target computing resources and target storage resources required for executing the task; according to the invention, the configuration controller can accurately allocate the target computing resources and the target storage resources for the processing module according to task requirements, and can dynamically adjust the resource configuration according to task characteristics, so that the GPU architecture can adapt to diversified tasks, resource idling or overload can be avoided, and the overall utilization rate is improved; the GPU architecture can quickly respond to multiple types of tasks without redesigning the hardware architecture, and the flexibility and the expandability of the architecture are improved.

title: An intelligent recommendation method for urban gas emergency rescue plans
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent recommendation method for urban gas emergency rescue plans, which relates to the field of emergency decision-making technology. The method comprises obtaining historical urban gas accident emergency response plans and gas accident-related standards and specifications, establishing a case library and a rule library; constructing an urban gas pipeline emergency rescue knowledge map based on the case library and the rule library; and generating urban gas pipeline emergency rescue plans based on the urban gas pipeline emergency rescue knowledge map and the gas accidents to be handled, based on a random walk strategy and word vector learning, through similarity comparison. The present invention generates a case library and a rule library, and then constructs a knowledge map, which can provide comprehensive and structured data support. Then, a random walk strategy and word vector learning are used to match gas accidents, thereby realizing intelligent gas emergency rescue plan recommendation, improving the efficiency and scientificity of emergency rescue, reducing the impact of human factors, and meeting the rapid response requirements of sudden gas accidents.

title: Model training method, data processing method and related device
description: The application provides a model training method, a data processing method and a related device, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out type recognition on an entity in a knowledge graph sample serving as a sample to obtain an entity type of the entity, carrying out vector conversion on the entity through the model to obtain an entity vector, determining a first matrix based on the entity type, determining a first loss function based on the first matrix and the entity vector, characterizing similarity among different entity vectors, constructing a first type entity group and a second type entity group based on the knowledge graph, determining a second loss function between the first type entity group and the second type entity group, and training the model based on the first loss function and the second loss function. According to the application, the performance of the model can be improved.

title: Improved CNN (carbon nanotubes) combined with channel attention mechanism for denoising flame emission spectrum
description: The invention discloses an improved CNN (carbon fiber network) combined with a channel attention mechanism for a flame emission spectrum denoising method, and provides a CBC (cubic boron nitride) framework based on a convolutional neural network. By introducing a channel attention module after each layer of convolution operation, the model can perform self-adaptive denoising processing on spectrum signals with low signal-to-noise ratio. The mechanism performs weighted adjustment on the input feature map by calculating the weights of the various channels, so that the network can focus on more important signal parts, and simultaneously restrain the influence of noise and irrelevant information. The adaptive adjustment capability greatly enhances the performance of the network in processing complex noise environments, and particularly, the denoising effect is remarkably improved when processing short-exposure spectrum data with low SNR.

title: Building carbon emission monitoring system based on BIM
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent carbon management, in particular to a building carbon emission monitoring system based on BIM, which comprises a model building module, a thermal inertia analysis module, a carbon list generation module, a carbon emission monitoring module and an energy consumption parameter optimization module. According to the invention, the carbon emission parameter set is generated by means of standardized analysis of the type, the size and the engineering quantity of the component materials and by combining the IFC data structure, so that the carbon emission factor has the targeted adjustment capability. And introducing an actually measured environmental temperature change sequence into thermal inertia calculation, and correcting a response difference value of the heat capacity and the heat conduction behavior of the component to accurately reflect the dynamic thermal performance of the material in different environments. In the stage carbon emission measurement and calculation, component thermal inertia response and functional time period are fused for refining and stage separation, and functional frequency and time occupation ratio are overlapped in carbon emission calculation, so that double-sensitivity adjustment of carbon emission to time and component functional dimension is realized.

title: PCB surface defect detection method and system based on improvement YOLOv8
description: The invention discloses a PCB surface defect detection method and system based on an improvement YOLOv, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a special data set of the PCB surface defect and dividing the special data set according to a proportion, improving a YOLOv model, including fusing C2f and DCNv2 in a backstone frame to form a C2 f-DCNv module, introducing a BAM attention mechanism module at the tail end of the backstone, introducing a LSKA attention mechanism module in an SPPF module to fuse the module into an SPPF-LSKA module, fusing C2f and SCConv in a neg frame to form a C2 f-SCConv module, verifying the improved YOLOv model, generating an optimal weight file and evaluating the performance of the model. The improved model detection effect of the invention is greatly improved, and the invention can be better applied to the task of PCB defect detection.

title: Text2SQL medical data processing method based on large language model and electronic equipment
description: The embodiment of the application provides a Text2SQL medical data processing method and electronic equipment based on a large language model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a vector database and query sentences, wherein the vector database comprises partitioned data corresponding to data tables and at least one query sentence pair, the query sentence pair comprises preset query sentences and preset SQL sentences corresponding to the preset query sentences, splitting the query sentences into at least one sub-query task through a large language model, wherein each sub-query task corresponds to one data table, and when a plurality of sub-query tasks exist, the plurality of sub-query tasks are used for representing the logical dependency relationship of cross-data-table query, determining the SQL sentences corresponding to the at least one sub-query task according to the vector database, and determining a target query result according to the SQL sentences. The application can improve the accuracy of the query result.

title: Multi-scale dynamic fusion target detection method and system based on impulse neural network
description: The application belongs to the technical field of computer vision and nerve morphology calculation. The application provides a multi-scale dynamic fusion target detection method and system based on a pulse neural network. According to the embodiment of the disclosure, trainable integer LIF neurons are adopted in a network, a SABC module adopts a dynamic channel expansion mechanism, the deep feature degradation problem caused by pulse signal time sequence sparsity is effectively solved, SMGFDH realizes multi-scale feature fusion with self-adaptive pulse release rate through a difference attention mechanism, and the redundant convolution operation before traditional splicing is innovatively canceled, so that an efficient detection framework for completely adapting to pulse sparsity is constructed. The problems of insufficient deep feature expression and low multi-scale fusion efficiency of the traditional SNN in a complex visual task are solved.

title: Geographic information model construction method and computer program product based on intelligent segmentation and identification of aerial data
description: The present invention discloses a method for constructing a geographic information model based on intelligent segmentation and recognition of aerial data and a computer program product. The method comprises: first, using a SAM model to segment the aerial image to obtain a segmented image with key elements marked. Then, manually classifying the key elements in the segmented image, and constructing a data set based on the manual classification results. Afterwards, the KAN network integrated with the knowledge graph is trained using the data set. Then, the aerial image of the area to be built is accurately segmented using the SAM model, and the trained KAN network is used to accurately identify the key element categories in the segmented image by integrating relevant knowledge graphs. Finally, the identification results of the key elements are used to construct a geographic information model of the area to be built. The SAM model can accurately segment the key elements through sparse and dense prompts, and the KAN network uses the graph relationship in the knowledge graph to correct the mis-segmentation of the SAM model, thereby improving the accuracy of key element classification.

title: Self-adaptive electronic anti-interference source dynamic scheduling method based on spectrum sensing
description: The present invention discloses a spectrum sensing-based adaptive electronic countermeasures interference source dynamic scheduling method, comprising the following steps: S1, real-time acquisition of broadband spectrum data in an electromagnetic environment by a broadband receiver, and transmission to multiple parallel shallow convolutional neural networks for feature extraction; S2, real-time extraction of the frequency characteristics, power intensity, signal-to-noise ratio, and current interference source state of the target signal to construct a multidimensional state space; S3, constructing a multi-head deep Q network model based on the multidimensional state space, and outputting decision instructions through parallel training; S4, combining the decision instructions into an interference decision instruction and sending it to the interference source in real time; S5, the interference source executes the interference task and provides feedback on the interference effect; S6, dynamically adjusting network parameters based on the interference effect feedback. The present invention improves the interference decision accuracy and response efficiency, and is suitable for electronic countermeasure tasks in complex electromagnetic environments.

title: Oil Pipeline Corrosion Rate Prediction Method Based on Transfer Learning
