description: The invention relates to the technical field of oil pipe corrosion rate prediction and discloses an oil pipe corrosion rate prediction method based on transfer learning, comprising the following steps of S1, collecting a plurality of groups of corrosion data of oil pipes in different environments as a source domain data set, and collecting a plurality of groups of corrosion data of the oil pipes in the same environments as a target domain data set; the method comprises the steps of S2, adopting a K-fold cross validation pre-training transfer learning model through a source domain data set, learning the relation between the oil pipe corrosion related characteristics and the oil pipe corrosion rate under different environments by the transfer learning model, S3, adopting a step-by-step fine tuning strategy to train the transfer learning model again through a target domain data set, learning the relation between the oil pipe corrosion related characteristics and the oil pipe corrosion rate under the same environment by the transfer learning model, and S4, taking the oil pipe corrosion related characteristics into the trained transfer learning model, and predicting the corresponding oil pipe corrosion rate by the transfer learning model. The invention can predict the corrosion rate of the oil pipe with high precision under the small sample data.

title: A method for detecting defects in photovoltaic solar panels based on improved YOLOv5
description: The present invention discloses a method for detecting defects in photovoltaic solar panels based on an improved YOLOv5. The method comprises: constructing a YOLOv5 network structure; collecting a large number of images of solar panels with damage to form a solar panel damage image dataset, and inputting the dataset into the YOLOv5 network structure; performing feature extraction through a distributed shift convolution block, and adding the extracted features to the original input image set; introducing an attention mechanism to focus on the key information of the input image set, extracting deeper features, and performing feature fusion on the extracted features to obtain fused solar panel damage features, which are input into a photovoltaic solar panel defect detection model, and outputting photovoltaic solar panel defect detection results. When faced with a large number of solar panels with multiple types of damage, the present application utilizes an improved YOLOv5 construction environment, adopts a convolution method to reduce the amount of calculation and eliminate the influence of redundant features, and improves the detection method for the case where two defects overlap.

title: Visual analysis method, device and equipment for abnormal client detection in federated learning
description: The invention provides a visual analysis method, a visual analysis device and visual analysis equipment for abnormal client detection in federal learning. The abnormal client detection visual analysis method in the federation learning comprises the steps of obtaining local model parameters and global model parameters of each client and each server in a plurality of iteration rounds in the federation learning process, determining characteristic data of each client under at least one model analysis system according to the local model parameters and the global model parameters, responding to configuration parameters set by a user on a visual interface, and generating a corresponding visual chart on the visual interface according to the configuration parameters and the characteristic data so that the user can analyze the abnormal client in the federation learning process according to the visual chart.

title: Enterprise innovation cloud assessment and resource adaptation system and method
description: The present invention discloses a cloud-based enterprise innovation assessment and resource adaptation system and method, which relates to the field of enterprise innovation management technology and includes the following steps: periodically acquiring industry lifecycle data, innovation vital signs data, and external data source data; performing weighted average calculation on the industry lifecycle data, innovation vital signs data, and external data source data to obtain fused innovation vital signs data; performing sliding window processing on the fused innovation vital signs data within the same period, and outputting a trend curve of the fused innovation vital signs data. This solution effectively eliminates the interference caused by industry cycle fluctuations through dynamic alignment of the benchmark curve and joint judgment of continuous windows, while locating the start time of the anomaly in combination with the trend curve, providing a precise time anchor point for subsequent causal analysis, and can accurately identify persistent abnormal states in the fused innovation vital signs data to avoid misjudgment due to single fluctuations.

title: Image processing method based on non-uniform sampling and scale self-adaptive supervision
description: The present invention discloses an image processing method based on non-uniform sampling and scale-adaptive supervision, belonging to the field of image processing technology. The method comprises sequentially inputting a super-resolution image into an adaptive instance-level grid generator, a warping sampling network, and a first sampler, wherein the first sampler obtains a non-uniform image; an anti-warping sampling network performs multi-scale feature anti-warping on each block set through the inverse transformation of a bilinear mapping; the output of the anti-warping sampling network is sent to a second sampler; the non-uniform image is input into a backbone layer to obtain a non-uniform feature map, which is then sent to the second sampler; the second sampler obtains a restored feature map and inputs it into a model to obtain an image processing result. The method effectively preserves detailed features and significantly improves the processing accuracy of small targets on oilfield datasets while maintaining the processing performance of large and medium-sized targets. A dynamic token filtering strategy reduces computational redundancy, balancing efficiency and accuracy.

title: Lithium battery binder production monitoring method and system based on Internet of Things
description: This application relates to the field of lithium battery production technology and discloses a lithium battery binder production monitoring method and system based on the Internet of Things. The system collects data in real time through multiple types of sensors, classifies the data by sensor type, generates time series data based on dynamic segmentation of multiple time windows, and converts the data into grayscale images for feature extraction. The system uses an autoencoder to train an anomaly detection model, combines dynamic thresholds to determine real-time anomalies, generates correction proposals by matching historical normal data, and optimizes control points to generate a smooth correction curve. The system then displays the abnormal data and correction proposals through a human-computer interface, dynamically marks high-difference areas, and incrementally optimizes model parameters and thresholds based on user feedback. This application can improve the accuracy of anomaly detection and increase the success rate of first-time anomaly repair.

title: A dynamic sensitive information filtering system and method based on contextual semantic understanding
description: The invention discloses a dynamic sensitive information filtering system and a method based on context semantic understanding, which relate to the technical field of information security and natural language processing, and comprise the following steps of 1, creating a dynamic sensitive information filtering system, 2, cleaning, structuring and standardizing an input text through a text preprocessing module, 3, capturing deep semantic features of the preprocessed text data through a semantic feature extraction module by utilizing a deep learning model, constructing a context-associated semantic representation space, 4, detecting multi-level sensitive information based on the semantic features through a sensitive information recognition module, recognizing types, positions and risk grades of sensitive contents, 5, carrying out online iteration of knowledge base and model capacity through a dynamic updating module, coping with dynamic changes of the types of the sensitive information, 6, carrying out security treatment on the detected sensitive information through a result output module, outputting a filtering result and providing audit traceability, and 7, optimizing a closed loop through a feedback mechanism module according to a user feedback and manual audit forming system, and continuously improving detection accuracy and adaptability.

title: A railway fastener pixel-level detection method and device
description: The present invention provides a method and device for pixel-level detection of railway fasteners. The method comprises the following steps: S1, dual-stream pixel-level detection network construction: constructing a dual-stream detection network, comprising an encoder and a decoder; wherein the encoder adopts a dual-stream structure, and the decoder adopts a conventional single-stream structure; S2, dual-stream pixel-level detection network training: constructing a hybrid loss function comprising a weighted binary cross-entropy loss function and a Dice loss function. The method and device for pixel-level detection of railway fasteners provided by the present invention can achieve accurate pixel-level detection of fasteners, and at the same time, have good detection performance for fasteners in a variety of different complex scenarios, providing a technical reference for fastener disease severity detection and assessment, effectively utilizing the shape information contained in the mask image, and constructing a dual-stream detection network comprising an original image stream and a mask image stream, for achieving accurate pixel-level detection of fasteners.

title: A method for point cloud segmentation based on spherical coordinate guided multi-scale dilated convolution
description: A method for point cloud segmentation based on spherical coordinate-guided multi-scale dilated convolution, comprising the following steps: Step 1: converting the Cartesian coordinates of point cloud data into spherical coordinates; Step 2: dynamically generating multi-scale dilated convolution parameters according to the spherical coordinates, wherein the parameters include radial distance to control the expansion rate of dilated convolution, and polar angle and azimuth angle to control the directional weight of point cloud information; Step 3: sampling the farthest point of point cloud information and selecting key points with the farthest distance from each other; Step 4: constructing point cloud neighborhood features based on the sampled center points; Step 5: constructing a multi-scale dilated convolution branch fusion module to obtain multi-scale context features; Step 6: modulating the multi-scale context features according to the directional weights, and finally outputting the weighted features.

title: A thermal-mechanical coupling analysis method for elevator safety gear
description: The invention provides a thermal coupling analysis method of elevator safety tongs, which relates to the technical field of elevator safety tongs analysis, and effectively reduces the gap between simulation and actual working conditions by combining sensor data and microscopic damage information in the actual braking process of an elevator through multi-source data fusion; the method comprises the steps of adopting a time-varying friction coefficient to replace a traditional constant value, accurately reflecting the influence of friction pair surface temperature change on friction performance, embedding a thermal-force-abrasion coupling UMAT subprogram, improving the physical reality of abrasion and performance degradation simulation, generating an evolution curve of key performance indexes based on finite element simulation data, assisting in constructing a physical information neural network, fusing multiple physical information and microscopic damage equivalent values, realizing intelligent prediction and advanced safety precaution of braking efficiency degradation rate, improving accuracy and instantaneity of safety tongs performance evaluation, supporting operation optimization, enhancing elevator safety guarantee level, and being suitable for intelligent safety management under complex working conditions.

title: A technical supervision dynamic control system applied to thermal power-new energy scenarios
description: The invention relates to the technical field of process management, in particular to a technical supervision dynamic management and control system applied to a thermal power-new energy scene, which comprises a data receiving module for collecting equipment operation data of thermal power, wind power and photovoltaic business units in real time; the method comprises the steps of managing high-frequency process data and low-frequency historical data in a layered mode through a multi-level data lake architecture, constructing a thermal power, wind power and photovoltaic business process model through a data processing module, carrying out time sequence analysis on operation data of each business unit, enabling a dispatching management and control module to fuse trend error dynamic amplification factors, carrying out prediction deviation on operation states of the thermal power, wind power and photovoltaic business units, and enabling a feedback optimization module to carry out dynamic management and control on business processes based on fuzzy logic control and multi-condition comprehensive evaluation. The invention realizes the intelligent management of the technical supervision whole process of the thermal power and new energy equipment through the flow behavior portrayal based on prediction deviation and the scheduling optimization.

title: An electric energy metering box and meter reading method convenient for intelligent meter reading
description: The invention discloses an electric energy metering box and a meter reading method convenient for intelligent meter reading, wherein the electric energy metering box comprises an electric energy metering box shell body, a multi-source acquisition module, a preprocessing module, a communication regulation module, an encryption transmission module and a central processing module, wherein the electric energy metering box shell body is internally integrated with a multi-source acquisition module, the multi-source acquisition module comprises a sensor array and a data convergence subunit, the preprocessing module comprises a filtering subunit, a compression subunit and a format conversion subunit, the communication regulation module comprises a communication monitoring unit, a prediction calculation unit and a communication control unit, the encryption transmission module comprises an encryption unit and a transmission unit, the data verification module is deployed on a data center server and comprises a decryption engine, a multi-layer verification engine and a log management engine, and the central processing module adopts a heterogeneous multi-core processor and comprises an ARM Cortex-A53 quad-core processor and an FPGA logic unit. The invention solves the problems of unstable data transmission, low meter reading efficiency, poor data security and the like in the prior meter reading technology, and has higher creativity and practicability.

title: Commercial vehicle load estimation method based on BP neural network
description: This invention discloses a commercial vehicle load estimation method based on a BP neural network. The main design concept of the invention is to collect a certain amount of vehicle operating data from the commercial vehicle and feed this data as input into a load estimation model pre-established based on an end-to-end BP neural network architecture. The hidden layer of the BP neural network includes a SIMULINK module. After processing by the load estimation model, the vehicle load signal is output. This invention targets the specific usage attributes of commercial vehicles, fully integrating mainstream neural networks and an end-to-end architecture to significantly improve the accuracy of commercial vehicle load estimation.

title: Information pushing method, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention provides an information pushing method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of information pushing, wherein the method can acquire a related knowledge graph set corresponding to a main task node in a target knowledge graph according to a historical knowledge graph, wherein the related knowledge graph set comprises a plurality of related knowledge graphs, and when a task completion mark corresponding to any one of the related knowledge graph sets is not smaller than a preset ratio of the number of the related knowledge graphs of a first mark to the number of all the related knowledge graphs in the related knowledge graph set, task prompt information is sent to a target user; whether the tasks corresponding to the nodes in the current target knowledge graph can be normally executed or not can be automatically determined based on the related data of the historical knowledge graph and the related data of the current target knowledge graph, whether the tasks corresponding to part of the nodes in the current target knowledge graph cannot be normally executed or not is judged, and prompt is given to a user, so that the user experience is improved.

title: Multimodal energy-saving optimization operation technology of high-efficiency energy-saving water pumps
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of fluid mechanical control, and provides a multi-mode energy-saving optimizing operation method of a high-efficiency energy-saving water pump. The invention ensures that the water pump always operates in a high-efficiency area within a load range by a multi-mode dynamic matching mechanism of constant speed-frequency conversion-multi-pump cooperation, overcomes the problem of efficiency attenuation of a single mode under extreme working conditions, and reduces comprehensive energy consumption.

title: A Data-Driven Real-Time Shotcrete Flow Prediction and Control Method
description: The invention relates to a data-driven real-time guniting flow prediction and control method, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting data, S2, preprocessing the data, screening the data of cement mixing piles with the strength meeting the specification requirements, deleting incomplete data, S3, selecting a model which comprises linear regression, a decision tree, a random forest and a support vector regression algorithm, S4, determining the model, selecting the model with the best prediction effect as a final prediction model based on the processed data in S2, S5, predicting the guniting flow, inputting the identified key parameters into the prediction model determined in S4, generating a guniting flow prediction value, S6, monitoring and controlling in real time, adjusting the real-time guniting flow according to the guniting flow prediction value in S5, and S7, recording data and updating the model. The method can accurately predict and adjust the guniting flow in real time, thereby greatly improving the quality and stability of the cement mixing pile.

title: Node anomaly detection method and device based on graph algorithm and storage device
description: The present application discloses a node anomaly detection method, device and storage device based on a graph algorithm, the method comprising: obtaining the attribute features of each node in a network cluster within a predetermined time period, establishing edge connections based on similarity metrics of the attribute features, and connecting each node to form an undirected graph; calculating the attribute features using a feature relationship operator to obtain a feature vector of the attribute edge; calculating the different metrics of each node to obtain a set of feature vectors of each node; training the feature vectors of each node using a predetermined training algorithm to obtain a set of feature representations of each node; calculating the reconstruction error using a predetermined autoencoding model to obtain an abnormal offset value of a set of feature vectors of each node, and judging whether the node is abnormal based on the abnormal offset value. In the above manner, the present application can quickly and efficiently detect nodes with abnormal behavior.

title: A target detection method based on attention layer region convolutional neural network
description: A kind of object detection method based on attention layer region convolutional neural networks, comprising the following steps: step 1: the acquisition and production of data set；Step 2: data enhancing enhances the generalization ability of network；Step 3: data set being input to deep neural network and is trained, depth residual error network or its variant are chosen；Step 4: the characteristic pattern of output first three residual block of depth residual error network；Step 5: to one weight module of the 4th residual block postposition of residual error network, the result of prediction comes the little characteristic pattern of inhibiting effect, the big characteristic pattern of invigoration effect；Step 6: the 4th residual block of fused characteristic pattern and depth residual error network being superimposed, region of interest ROI is mapped on the characteristic pattern of superposition；Step 7: the corresponding feature of region of interest ROI is subjected to the classification of classification and the recurrence of position coordinates.The present invention solves the Issues On Multi-scales of target, and the performance of target detection has preferable raising.

title: A Defect Code Path Locating Method Based on Defect Report
description: The invention discloses a method for locating defect code paths based on defect reports. The method based on deep learning learns the association relationship between text and codes from repaired defect reports and corresponding repair code paths, so as to perform new defect reports Prediction of associated defect code file paths. Specifically, it includes two parts: (1) Defect code path tree generation model BRSP based on defect report; (2) Defect code path tree prediction algorithm based on rule constraints. The invention has the advantage that the associated defect code file path information can be provided according to the defect report, assisting the developer to locate the defect code, saving the time and energy of the developer, thereby improving the maintenance efficiency of the software project.

title: Convolution arithmetic device and method for adjusting convolution input of convolutional neural network
description: The present invention relates to the tune of the convolution at convolution algorithm device and convolutional Neural network input to advise method.A kind of convolution algorithm device, including convolution algorithm module, memory, scale domination module and tune rule device.Convolution algorithm module exports the convolution algorithm result in multiple mixed decimal portions；Memory couples convolution algorithm module, receive and store mixed decimal portion convolution algorithm as a result, and the multiple mixed decimal portions of output convolution algorithm input value；Scale domination module couples convolution algorithm module generates according to the overall size of the convolution algorithm result in mixed decimal portion and adjusts rule signal；Rule device coupling memory, scale domination module and convolution algorithm module are adjusted, according to the scale for the convolution algorithm input value for adjusting rule signal adjustment mixed decimal portion, is then exported the convolution algorithm input value in the mixed decimal portion after adjustment scale to convolution algorithm module.

title: Vehicle logistics order forecasting method and device, logistics system, and computer-readable medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of logistics, and more specifically, to a method and device for forecasting an entire vehicle logistics order, a logistics system, and a computer-readable medium. The method includes: obtaining historical monthly vehicle logistics order data; extracting features to construct a learning sample set; constructing a gradient boosting decision tree model for training and evaluation according to the learning sample set, and obtaining a monthly vehicle logistics order forecast model; inputting the required forecast For the line, according to the vehicle logistics monthly order forecast model, predict the future monthly vehicle logistics orders of the line and output. The vehicle logistics monthly order forecasting method, device, system, and storage medium provided by the present invention can realize the forecast of the monthly vehicle logistics order, greatly improve the forecasting efficiency and forecasting accuracy, and provide transportation companies with overall capacity planning and arrangement, Warehouse management provides more accurate intelligence information, thereby reducing production management costs.

title: Simulator
description: The present invention provides a simulation device including a machine learning device that learns a change in a machining route of workpiece machining. This machine learning device observes data indicating the changed machining route and data indicating the machining conditions of the workpiece as state variables, and also acquires judgment data for judging the cycle time obtained by simulation using the changed machining route. Whether it is appropriate or not, and use these state variables and judgment data to learn in association with the machining conditions of the workpiece and the change of the machining path.

title: Electromagnetic sensor and mobile device including same
description: An Electromagnetic (EM) sensor comprising: the apparatus includes a front-end module generating an EM signal using an electromagnetic wave transmitted from an external source, a sensor memory storing a portion of a plurality of machine learning models for identifying the EM signal, and a microcontroller unit identifying an external electronic device emitting the electromagnetic wave by inputting a feature value extracted from the EM signal to the machine learning models. If the machine learning model stored in the sensor memory is unable to identify an external device, the feature values may be sent to a host processor, and the host processor may compare the feature values to another set of machine learning models.

title: A Mobile Edge Computing Unmanned Aid Swarm Assisted Communication Method for Explosive Traffic
description: The invention discloses a mobile edge computing unmanned aerial vehicle cluster auxiliary communication method facing explosive flow, which is used for providing computing service for users with computing requirements on the ground when a network is congested; firstly, a prediction part predicts the distribution situation of the calculation demand of a target area by using an improved PSO-BP neural network, and deploys an unmanned aerial vehicle supporting mobile edge calculation according to the demand; secondly, calculating a demand partition part, partitioning a target area based on a fairness principle, and serving users in the sub-area by each unmanned aerial vehicle; and finally, the unmanned aerial vehicle energy optimization part in the sub-areas performs combined optimization on the unmanned aerial vehicle calculation frequency and the unmanned aerial vehicle flight track on the premise of meeting the user calculation requirements, so that the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle in each sub-area is minimum, the energy consumption of the whole unmanned aerial vehicle cluster is minimum, and the service duration of the cluster is prolonged.

title: Hobbing method based on sample adaptation
description: The invention discloses a gear hobbing processing method based on sample adaptation. The steps are: (1) realizing knowledge expression of gear hobbing process samples; (2) realizing the adaptation of gear hobbing process samples and gear hobbing process problems; (3) ) to realize the Harris Eagle optimization of gear hobbing process parameters based on fitting samples. The present invention has the following advantages: 1. Supports the noise elimination of gear hobbing process samples: There are a certain number of cases in the gear hobbing process samples that are irrelevant to or even negatively affected by the gear hobbing process problems, and the noise phenomenon of the gear hobbing process samples can be eliminated by this method; 2. Integrate biological heuristic methods: use the Harris Eagle optimization algorithm to continuously optimize the hobbing process parameters, so that the hobbing process parameters can reach a near-optimal state, and the comprehensive goal of cutting time and energy consumption is smaller. Thereby, the problem that the existing process parameter optimization method is difficult to find a suitable sample under the sample-driven condition and the optimization effect is poor is solved.

title: An Image Annotation Method Based on Region Context Deep Learning
description: The invention relates to an image annotation method for deep learning of regional context relationship, which comprises the following steps: most of the current general image labeling methods are based on visual features of images, particularly depth features, but when semantic keywords needing to be labeled are more and scattered, the complicated image labeling problem cannot be effectively solved only by means of the visual features. The invention provides an image annotation method based on a regional context relationship deep learning network, which automatically learns the context relationship between regions in an image, integrates the context relationship into the feature expression of the regions, then accumulates the features of each region as the features of the image, and finally learns a multi-class support vector machine to perform semantic recognition on each image and sort the contribution values of each semantic to obtain an annotation keyword. The method is flexible and convenient, can automatically learn the regional context relationship of the image while realizing the image annotation, and has stronger practicability.

title: An irrigation scheduling method suitable for irrigation areas
description: The invention discloses an irrigation scheduling method suitable for an irrigated area, which includes: generating a relational database among a rotation irrigation group, a main canal, and an area; The threshold value and the irrigation amount of each planned area are limited within the allowable irrigation amount range, and at least one irrigation scheme is generated, and each irrigation scheme corresponds to a start mode of the rotation irrigation group; The first flow is the evaluation factor, and each generated irrigation scheme is evaluated to obtain the corresponding comprehensive evaluation coefficient of the irrigation area. The invention can realize effective artesian irrigation in large-area irrigation areas, reduce the loss of kinetic energy in water conveyance, and evaluate the generated irrigation scheme by taking the area of artesian irrigation, water conveyance loss, and canal head flow as evaluation factors to reduce water conveyance loss and stabilize canal head flow. , to ensure that the irrigation amount of each planned area is as consistent as possible with its corresponding theoretical water demand, so as to improve irrigation efficiency.

title: Method and system for generating video summary
description: The disclosure provides a method and a system for generating a video abstract, and relates to the technical field of videos. The method can comprise the following steps: segmenting a video into a plurality of shots according to the change of a video scene, wherein each shot is a video scene with continuous content; calculating an importance score of each shot; and selecting a group of shots from the plurality of shots to splice into a video summary, wherein the total importance score of the selected group of shots is the largest under the condition that the constraint condition of the total duration of the video summary is met. The present disclosure may include some important shots or segments in the video summary.

title: Method, device and electronic device for identifying content type of PDF document
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for identifying the content type of a PDF document and electronic equipment, wherein the scheme comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a document to be recognized in a PDF format, extracting feature data of the document to be recognized, inputting the feature data serving as input data into a pre-trained neural network model, and obtaining the content type of the document to be recognized. By adopting the scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the content type of the PDF document can be identified, and better use experience is brought to a user according to the content type of the PDF document.

title: Electronic red envelope message detection method, detection device and terminal equipment
description: The application is suitable for the technical field of electronic red packet message identification, and provides an electronic red packet message detection method, a detection device and terminal equipment, and the method comprises the following steps: after receiving the message, identifying the confidence that the message is the electronic red packet message through a trained convolutional neural network; and if the confidence coefficient of the message is the electronic red packet message is greater than or equal to a preset confidence coefficient threshold value, judging that the message is the electronic red packet message, and if the confidence coefficient of the message is the electronic red packet message is less than the preset confidence coefficient threshold value, judging that the message is not the electronic red packet message. By the method, the accuracy of message identification can be improved.

title: Financial risk control system based on big data and Inception V3 deep network model
description: The invention discloses a financial risk control system based on big data and an Inception V3 deep network model, comprising a target data collection module, which calls a corresponding data mining module based on risk control indicators to collect target data; a data feature extraction module is based on CCIPCA The algorithm realizes the extraction of data features; the risk assessment module adopts the Inception V3 deep neural network model to realize the risk assessment of target data based on the data features. The invention realizes the integration of external data and internal data, which greatly improves the data processing efficiency of the financial risk control system. Efficient evaluation, so that different coping strategies can be flexibly adopted in actual operation to ensure the safety of financial transactions.

title: Reinforcement learning method and system based on RBF-A2C
description: A reinforcement learning method and system based on RBF‑A2C are disclosed. The method includes: step 1: optimize the RBF parameter α according to the current state data ψ(s) and step size, and obtain action a; step 2: execute action a to obtain environmental feedback r and state data ψ(s)' at the next moment ; Step 3: determine whether ψ(s)' reaches the predetermined target, if so, the algorithm ends, if not, go to step 4; Step 4: Calculate the Q function according to ψ(s), r and ψ(s)'value; Step 5: Calculate the advantage function A according to the ψ(s) and Q function values; Step 6: Calculate the activation function and the loss function, calculate the partial derivative of the loss function, and then calculate the optimization step size to optimize the RBF parameter; Step 7: Use The optimization step optimizes the RBF parameter, replaces the step size optimizes the RBF parameter α, and repeats steps 1-7. The invention solves the problems of slow convergence speed and poor convergence precision of traditional algorithms through the RBF neural network algorithm, and avoids the problems of difficulty in convergence in large sample learning and easy to fall into local extreme values.

title: Method and system for automatic identification of state of isolation switch in substation
description: The utility model provides a transformer substation isolation switch state automatic identification method and system, including patrolling and examining robot, processing system and control system, it is provided with binocular camera on the robot to patrol and examine, binocular camera is used for gathering the image of transformer substation isolation switch, control system control patrols and examines the removal of robot to transmit the image for processing system, processing system is configured into and constructs the degree of depth learning algorithm model, and according to the image of the isolation switch state identification of off-line collection, the artifical isolation switch mark that carries out, trains mark data, utilizes the degree of depth learning algorithm model after the training to the isolation switch image that the on-line obtained, handles, obtains the kind, the position and the state that opens and shuts of switch.

title: Lightweight convolutional neural network image identification method based on low rank and sparse decomposition
description: The invention belongs to the field of image recognition, and relates to a light convolutional neural network image recognition method based on low rank and sparse decomposition. The construction process of the lightweight convolutional neural network with low rank and sparse decomposition comprises the following steps: in the structural design stage, the weight matrix is decomposed into the sum of a low-rank matrix and a sparse matrix, and the low-rank matrix is decomposed into the product of two small matrices according to the rank; in the training stage, adding a regularization item in a loss function to constrain a sparse matrix; and in the post-processing stage, deleting the unimportant parameters according to the energy distribution of the sparse matrix. Preferably, the method further comprises the following steps: and finely adjusting the lightweight convolutional neural network with low rank and sparse decomposition. The method combines a low-rank decomposition method and a sparse compression method, trains a lightweight convolutional neural network from the beginning, and realizes compression and acceleration of the convolutional neural network while keeping the image recognition precision.

title: Image segmentation method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present application discloses an image segmentation method, device, equipment and storage medium, which belong to the technical field of image processing. In this application, the target image and the first mask are respectively processed by the neural networks of different scales in the image segmentation model to obtain multiple feature maps and intermediate masks of different scales, and the high-resolution image information is fully preserved; Force unit, apply attention weight to each feature map and perform weighted operation to obtain multiple intermediate feature maps; perform feature fusion on each intermediate feature map to obtain a second mask; if the second mask satisfies the conditions, based on the second mask The mask is used for image segmentation, otherwise, the first mask is adjusted based on the second mask, and a new second mask is output based on the adjusted first mask and the target image to determine whether the new second mask satisfies the conditions. In the above scheme, the attention mechanism, multi-scale feature fusion, and iterative adjustment of the segmentation area are applied to improve the accuracy of image segmentation results.

title: Training method of face anti-counterfeiting recognition model, face anti-counterfeiting recognition method and device
description: The present invention provides a training method for a face anti-counterfeiting recognition model, a face anti-counterfeiting recognition method and a device. This embodiment can identify the existing face anti-counterfeiting when the sample type in the sequence set is the same as the sample type in the support set Attack method, when the sample type in the sequence set is different from the sample type in the support set, a new face anti-counterfeiting attack method is identified. That is to say, if a new attack method appears, thanks to the meta-learning method, the meta-learning face anti-counterfeiting recognition model can find the general features in the new attack method for defense, and quickly learn through a small number of samples. The new fake face features can be used for more effective defense, so it can greatly improve the accuracy of face anti-counterfeiting recognition results.

title: Long-and-short-term memory network-based ponding water level prediction method for Internet of things
description: The present invention claims to protect a long-short-term memory network-based ponding water level prediction method oriented to the Internet of Things, which is used for predicting the future water level of urban ponding points. Clean and normalize, divide the data into training set and test set proportionally; send the training set data into the LSTM neural network to iteratively optimize the network; use the trained LSTM network prediction model to predict the test set , and evaluate the model error. The method of the invention can extract the temporal relationship between the characteristic data of the stagnant water, and effectively predict the stagnant water level of the waterlogging point. Compared with BP and RNN neural network, the method of the present invention has the smallest RMSE and MAE for ponding water level prediction, and has the effect of better fitting the actual ponding water level.

title: Memory-mapped interface for message-passing computing systems
description: A memory-mapped interface for a message-passing computing system is provided. According to various embodiments, a write request is received. The write request includes write data and a write address. The write address is a memory address within the memory map. The write address is translated into a neural network address. The neural network address identifies at least one input location of the destination neural network. The write data is sent to at least one input location of the destination neural network via the network based on the neural network address. A message is received from the source neural network via the network. This message includes data and at least one address. A location in a buffer is determined based on the at least one address. The data is stored at that location in the buffer. The buffer can be accessed via the memory map.

title: Target object behavior monitoring method, device, equipment, system and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a target object behavior monitoring method, device, equipment, system and storage medium, wherein the target object behavior monitoring method includes: acquiring an image containing the target object, extracting characteristic parameters in the image; determining the image according to the characteristic parameters The position of each key point and the connection relationship between the key points, and the key points are connected according to the connection relationship between the key points to form the posture skeleton of the target object; the posture skeleton of the target object is recognized to determine the target object. the behavior of. The present invention can extract feature parameters from the image containing the target object, obtain the position of each key point in the image and the connection relationship between the key points according to the feature parameters, further form the posture skeleton of the target object, and through the target object posture skeleton to obtain the behavior of the target object, which solves the problem of manual analysis and interpretation when abnormal behavior needs to be monitored in the prior art.

title: Multispectral-based vehicle weight identification method and device
description: The invention discloses a multispectral-based vehicle weight identification method and a multispectral-based vehicle weight identification device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a visible light characteristic diagram, a near infrared characteristic diagram and a thermal infrared characteristic diagram; acquiring class activation diagrams under each spectrum, and obtaining class score vectors under each spectrum by performing global average pooling on the class activation diagrams under each spectrum; respectively normalizing the class score vectors under each spectrum to obtain class prediction possibility vectors under each spectrum, acquiring loss functions under each spectrum by using the class prediction possibility vectors under each spectrum, and fusing the loss functions under each spectrum to acquire multi-stream class constraint loss functions; acquiring a heterogeneous cooperation identity loss function; obtaining a final loss function; training a multi-stream convolution neural network of heterogeneous cooperative sensing, and re-identifying the vehicle by using the trained multi-stream convolution neural network of heterogeneous cooperative sensing; the invention has the advantages that: the problem of heavy vehicle identification in severe environment can be solved.

title: Super store operation analysis method and device based on image deep learning algorithm
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for analyzing the operation of a superstore based on an image deep learning algorithm. The video data captured by a camera with at least one preset position is acquired, wherein the preset position includes a single image monitored by a camera above the storefront. The position of the angle; extract the image in the video data, detect the image through the image deep learning algorithm, identify the operation behavior of the store that exceeds the regulations and issue an alarm; Store superstore operation information. The video data obtained from different preset positions is automatically detected by the image deep learning algorithm, and the operation behavior of urban superstores is analyzed. Since the operation of superstores is a continuous behavior, the continuous operation and analysis of the image deep learning algorithm can Continuously issue early warnings for the same type of illegal behavior on the same equipment, allowing law enforcement officers to deal with them in a timely manner and improving the efficiency of urbanization management.

title: A method, device and storage medium for object recommendation based on intelligence
description: The embodiment of the present invention discloses an intelligence-based object recommendation method, device and storage medium; the embodiment of the present invention can generate an object relation network according to the operation information of a user on an object; According to the initial feature information of the object, the global distribution feature extraction is performed on the objects in the object relation network to obtain the global distribution feature information of the object; according to the global distribution feature information, the update The parameter information of the relationship mining model is preset to obtain the target relationship mining model; the feature extraction is performed on the object relationship network according to the target relationship mining model to obtain the target feature information of the object; the object recommendation is performed according to the target feature information. The scheme can mine the association relationship between objects more comprehensively and accurately, so that objects can be recommended to users more accurately.

title: The method of computer account login based on face recognition
description: The invention discloses a computer account login method based on face recognition. The present invention is a face recognition device, comprising: a face collection module, a model architecture search module and a model optimization module: the face collection module has several face avatars, and is cut into the same size that only includes the face part, so as to The network model is to be trained and tested; the model architecture search module: mainly includes three aspects: search space, search strategy and network performance evaluation; the search space includes 3x3 depthwise separable convolution, 3x3 ordinary convolution, 3x3 maximum pooling, 3x3 mean pooling, skip connection, batch normalization, ReLU activation function. The beneficial effects of the present invention: the traditional neural network structure is designed by experts in the image field with a lot of energy, and the network structure can be determined only after numerous experiments and tests.

title: Image-based two-passenger one-dangerous vehicle detection method and device
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting two-passenger one-dangerous vehicles based on images, which are characterized in that through establishing a vehicle information database of passenger cars and trucks belonging to the two-passenger one-dangerous vehicles, passing vehicles are detected in real time, the passing vehicles are identified, the brands of the passing vehicles are identified, the identified passing vehicle information is compared with the two-passenger one-dangerous vehicle information in the database, whether the passing vehicles belong to the types of the passenger cars and the trucks in the two-passenger one-dangerous vehicles is judged, and the vehicles belonging to the types of the customers are tracked; and judging whether the vehicles belong to the truck type, judging whether dangerous goods marks exist, judging the trucks with the dangerous goods marks as dangerous vehicles, and tracking. The intelligent detection and control of two-passenger and one-passenger dangerous vehicles are realized, and the safety supervision of the vehicle operation is ensured.

title: Fluorescence microscopic image super-resolution reconstruction method based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a fluorescence microscopic image super-resolution reconstruction method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: collecting a common fluorescence microscopic image and a weak fluorescence microscopic image; obtaining a super-resolution image by using an SRRF algorithm and a common fluorescence image; forming a data set by using the common fluorescence microscopic image, the weak fluorescence microscopic image and the super-resolution image; and training the U-Net network by using the training set to obtain a rapid SRRF super-resolution reconstruction model and an image enhancement model under good illumination conditions and weak illumination conditions, acquiring common fluorescence and weak fluorescence microscopic sequence images during application, obtaining a super-resolution image by using the corresponding SRRF super-resolution reconstruction model, and enhancing the quality of the weak fluorescence microscopic image by using the image enhancement model. The technical method improves the imaging speed on the premise of not sacrificing the resolution, reduces the bleaching and phototoxicity of a fluorescence sample, applies the advantages of the super-resolution imaging technology to the dynamic observation of the subcellular structure in the living cell, and has great application prospect and commercial value.

title: Glass insulator self-explosion identification method based on multi-scale deep disturbance neural network
description: A glass insulator spontaneous explosion identification method based on a multi-scale deep disturbance neural network belongs to the technical equipment field. The method is characterized in that: the method comprises the following steps: step 1001, preprocessing a glass insulator image set; step 1002, classifying the preprocessed aerial insulated sub-images; step 1003, carrying out primary positioning on the aerial insulator image and carrying out normalization processing; step 1004, constructing a multi-scale deep layer perturbation neural network; step 1005, fusing the feature vectors of the multi-branch network architecture; step 1006, the error is propagated reversely and the parameters of the perturbation neural network are updated; and step 1007, obtaining an output result of the test set sample based on a fuzzy integral fusion method. By the glass insulator self-explosion identification method based on the multi-scale deep disturbance neural network, the distinguishing capability and the state detection precision of multiple types of insulators in a complex environment are improved, the detection speed of the insulators is improved by reducing the complexity of convolution operation, and the actual requirement of accuracy and rapidity is met.

title: Method for extracting student face information to realize educational psychology analysis based on image big data
description: The invention discloses a method for extracting facial information of students to realize educational psychology analysis based on image big data, which obtains image characteristics through a deep learning algorithm to further realize analysis and identification of data, improves the accuracy of reading facial expressions of the students, is beneficial for teachers to read the facial expressions of the students and obtain psychological changes of the students so as to give psychological guidance. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing an image to obtain pure data information; the image characteristics are extracted, the analysis of the image characteristic information is realized by extracting the local information and the global texture image characteristics from the local information extraction and the global information extraction, the image information is fused, the student expression and emotion are deeply learned, and the emotion change condition reflected by the image is obtained. The invention can enable the psychological teachers to actively learn and understand the expression and emotional state changes of students, help the teachers accurately and comprehensively master the overall situation of class students and promote the improvement of classroom teaching quality.

title: Adsorption force adjustment method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The application provides an adsorption force adjusting method, an adsorption force adjusting device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of intelligent equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring data collected by a first sensor in the intelligent display terminal; determining the behavior state of an adsorption contact on the intelligent display terminal by adopting a pre-trained behavior prediction model according to the acquired data of the first sensor; according to the action state of the adsorption contact, it is right in the wisdom display terminal the magnetic force that the adsorption contact corresponds the electromagnet is adjusted, in order to right the adsorption affinity of adsorption contact adjusts. Compared with the prior art, the behavior state of the contact can not be predicted in the prior art, so that the problem that a user is too hard to take down the adsorption contact or the adsorption force of the adsorption contact is insufficient when the adsorption contact is statically adsorbed is solved.

title: A way to imitate human memory for general machine intelligence
description: The learning method provided by the invention simulates the associative activation process of human memory, recombines a plurality of response schemes by summarizing experience, generalizing experience, utilizing experience and input information, evaluates the schemes according to a mode of tending to avoid harm, and carries out response by means of dividing one response scheme into a plurality of intermediate links to search for simulative experience and the like. Through the method provided by the invention, the machine can gradually obtain simple to complex responses to the input information and has similar emotional expressions to human beings, which all show that the machine learning method provided by the invention has great difference with the existing machine learning method in the industry, and no similar method exists in the industry at present.

title: Analysis method of post-disaster functional recovery of urban building communities under scenario earthquakes
description: The invention discloses an analysis method for post-disaster function recovery of urban building clusters under a scenario earthquake, including: S1, collecting basic information of urban building clusters; S2, determining the functions of individual buildings according to the damage status of buildings and the supply status of lifeline networks State classification; S3, determine the initial functional state of each individual building after the earthquake; S4, predict the repair time of each individual building based on a preset algorithm, and the repair time at least includes preparation time and repair recovery time; S5, predict earthquake The time-varying functional state of the post-single building; S6, predict the functional recovery trajectory of the urban building community based on the time-varying functional state of the individual building. The invention rapidly predicts the whole process of functional recovery of urban building clusters after disasters occurs through a quantitative analysis method, aims to break through the deficiencies of traditional risk assessment, and provides a basis for urban management agencies to make decisions and plans for disaster prevention and mitigation.

title: Method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for processing medical text data
description: The present application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for processing medical text data, including: obtaining medical text data; inputting into the first recognition model, the second recognition model and the third recognition model respectively; Predict the first labeling result, the second labeling result and the third labeling result corresponding to each character in the medical text data through the first recognition model, the second recognition model and the third recognition model respectively; judge the first labeling result and the second labeling result Whether the result and the third labeling result are the same; when the labeling result is the same, the first labeling result is determined as the labeling result corresponding to the character; the named entity in the medical text data is extracted, and the payment calculation processing is performed. In this application, the prediction consistency of multiple models is used to improve the accuracy of model prediction, thereby improving the accuracy of named entity recognition. The solutions in this application can be applied in the field of smart medical care, thereby promoting the construction of smart cities.

title: Computer vision and image feature search
description: Computer vision and image feature search are described. The described system utilizes visual search techniques by determining the visual features of objects depicted in an image and comparing the determined features with the visual features of other images, for example, to identify similar visual features in other images. In some aspects, the described system performs a search using digital images as part of a search query to find digital content of interest. In some aspects, the described system displays multiple user interface tools, including images of patterns, textures, or materials, and can be selected to initiate a visual search for digital content with similar patterns, textures, or materials. The described aspect also includes pattern-based authentication, wherein the system determines the authenticity of an item in an image based on the similarity of the visual features of the image to the visual features of a known genuine item.

title: Escalator mechanical fault diagnosis method and system
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for diagnosing mechanical faults of an escalator, wherein the method comprises the following steps of initializing; acquiring a detection signal from an acceleration sensor, and extracting time domain characteristics; performing LCD decomposition on the time domain signal to obtain a plurality of ISC components with the maximum kurtosis, and sequencing the plurality of ISC components to obtain a data set; dividing a data set into a training set and a testing set according to a proportion, inputting the training set into a deep convolution neural network for parameter adjustment training, and performing validity verification through the testing set; and (4) calculating a signal from the acceleration sensor to be detected, and outputting a corresponding mechanical fault type. The defects of multiple calculation times, large residual error, frequency mixing, end point effect and the like in the EMD decomposition and LMD decomposition processes are avoided, the efficiency of escalator mechanical fault diagnosis is improved, the deep convolutional neural network is used, effective features which cannot be extracted manually can be extracted in a self-adaptive mode, and the accuracy of fault judgment is improved.

title: Item delivery methods, devices, robots and media
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method and a device for article distribution, a robot and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: and the control image acquisition module is used for respectively acquiring the article images corresponding to the article placing units, inputting the article images into a preset article image recognition model, determining the article names of the articles in the article images, then determining the target positions of the articles according to the article names, and delivering the articles to the target positions according to the target positions. The embodiment of the invention realizes the accurate delivery of the articles to the customers, effectively reduces the cost and improves the flexibility of the article delivery.

title: An Arc Detection Method Based on Image Recognition
description: The invention relates to an arc detection method based on image recognition, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a field picture by using a camera; converting the collected field picture into a gray picture, and eliminating the influence of the color of the electric arc; segmenting suspected arcs in the gray level picture from a normal environment by thresholding; after the gray level picture is segmented, the smallest circumscribed rectangle of the suspected arc is used as a suspected area picture by using a frame difference method; and sending the suspected area picture into a trained video classification model structure for classification, and judging whether a real electric arc exists or not. The invention realizes the monitoring of the abnormal arc condition of the whole station by a small number of monitoring cameras in the unattended transformer station, uses the trained video classification model structure for classification, identifies the existence of the arc through image processing, has strong compatibility and wide detection range, does not need to replace the existing equipment of the transformer station, can be realized by using the commonly used cameras, and saves the cost.

title: A data processing method, device and electronic device based on data form
description: The embodiments of the present disclosure relate to a data processing method, device and electronic device based on data form. The data form is a second SDK including a first SDK and data form configuration information, wherein the first SDK is used for data collection, and the data form configuration information is a collection of definition information related to data processing. The data processing method includes: pre-saving at least one data form in a data form library, and different data forms have different first SDKs and/or data form configuration information; receiving a user's selection operation of selecting a specified data form from the data form library, and receiving information of a specified business system input by the user; docking the specified data form with the data interface of the specified business system, so that the first SDK of the specified data form collects data in the specified business system. In the embodiments of the present disclosure, by docking the data form with the business system, data in the business system can be collected, and data form configuration information can be provided to provide a basis for data processing, thereby reducing development costs.

title: Calculation method and device for realizing end-to-end offloading of face recognition based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for realizing unloading calculation of a face recognition end side based on deep reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a real face picture, and training according to an edge face recognition model to obtain classification data, wherein the classification data comprises picture names, id, 128-dimensional feature vectors extracted from the pictures, terminal prediction confidence, terminal prediction values and edge prediction values; deep learning and reinforcement learning are combined, and a state space, an action set, a reward function and an agent in a Markov decision process are defined; constructing an Actor neural network and a criticic neural network according to a defined Markov decision process, and training the constructed Actor neural network and criticic neural network by using classification data to obtain an intelligent unloading decision model; comparing and evaluating the performance of the intelligent unloading decision model and a reference query strategy; and deploying the intelligent unloading decision model into intelligent terminal equipment according to the comparison and evaluation result, and carrying out task unloading decision of face recognition.

title: Image feature recognition method, device and storage medium based on deep learning model
description: This invention discloses an image feature recognition method, apparatus, and storage medium based on a deep learning model. The method involves inputting image information to be recognized into a pre-constructed deep learning model. This pre-constructed deep learning model includes a pooling module. The image information to be recognized is convolved, and the resulting feature vector is input into the pooling module. The pooling module includes at least two parallel pooling layers. Each pooling layer performs a pooling operation on the feature vector to be pooled, obtaining at least two sub-pooling feature vectors. Based on these at least two sub-pooling feature vectors, a pooled feature vector is obtained and output for subsequent learning to extract the corresponding feature vector. Because the feature vector to be pooled undergoes pooling operations through different pooling layers, it can obtain richer information, and the different pooling layers do not introduce additional parameters, resulting in better performance of the deep learning model and improved accuracy in identifying target features in images.

title: Methods of determining the authenticity of consumer products
description: The present invention provides an economical and accurate method for classifying consumer products as authentic consumer products. The method utilizes machine learning and the use of steganographic features on the authentic consumer products.

title: A Dynamic Multi-objective Teaching Optimization Method Based on Fuzzy Reasoning Population Prediction Strategy
description: The invention discloses a kind of dynamic multi-objective based on fuzzy reasoning Population forecast strategy teaching optimization method, by random initializtion learner population；Use school grade based on all learners of policy update decomposed；Assess and update reference point, calculate the adaptive value of learner, the person that chooses Optimal Learning, and renewal learning person's neighborhood；Whole learner population is carried out environmental change detection；If environment changes, then the Population forecast strategy combined with one-step prediction according to fuzzy reasoning produces new learner population；Judge whether to meet stopping criterion for iteration.The present invention strengthens algorithm to the location of optimum Pareto disaggregation and tracking ability by the Population forecast strategy that fuzzy reasoning combines with one-step prediction, rapidly environmental change can be made a response, multiple target teaching optimizes Population Regeneration, solve and solve the optimum slow-footed problem of Pareto disaggregation, DMOPs has stronger adaptability and robustness.

title: A multi-level semantic feature extraction method for smart wearable device behavior data
description: The invention discloses a multi-level semantic feature extraction method for behavior data of smart wearable devices, which includes the following steps: S101, constructing a single-level behavior space, and finding a set of bases under the behavior space; S102, constructing a multi-level behavior space, from different Analyzing the behavior data at the granularity; S103, extracting the multi-level semantic features of the behavior data in the multi-level behavior space. The present invention does not require manual labeling of data, and can be applied to any behavior while greatly reducing labor costs; at the same time, the extracted semantic features can analyze behaviors from different granularities, which can ensure high recognition accuracy. Compared with the traditional method based on the predefined feature space, the accuracy of the present invention is greatly improved, and compared with the existing method based on a supervised deep neural network, the present invention can even provide higher recognition accuracy.

title: Classification model generation method and device, data recognition method and device
description: The present application provides a classification model generation method and device, and a data identification method and device, wherein the data identification method includes obtaining a data set to be identified; constructing a second relationship network of the at least two data to be identified through The nodes of the second relational network represent the at least two data to be identified; the vectorized representation of each node in the second relational network is obtained based on a preset network embedding learning model; according to the pre-trained classification The model determines the vectorized representation of the corresponding data label of each node in the second relational network.

title: Method of processing convolution neural network
description:
A method of processing a convolution neural network includes inputting input data to a floating pre-trained convolution neural network (CNN) model to generate floating feature maps; inputting the floating feature maps to a statistical analysis simulator to generate a dynamic quantization range for each layer of the floating pre-trained CNN model; quantizing feature values of each layer of the floating pre-trained CNN model according to the dynamic quantization range for each layer of the floating pre-trained CNN model to generate feature values of each layer of a quantized CNN model, a scalar 
factor of the each layer of the quantized CNN model, and a fractional bit-width of the quantized CNN model; and inputting the feature values of the each layer of the quantized CNN model to an inference engine to generate feature values of each layer of a fixed-point inferred CNN model using fixed-point arithmetic operations with low-precision.

title: Measuring device and distance measuring device
description: The measuring device (1) of the present disclosure is provided. The measuring device (1) is provided with a plurality of light receiving elements and a recognition unit (111). A plurality of light-receiving elements are arranged on the first substrate (P1), and output signals when they receive light irradiated from the light source and reflected by the object to be measured. The recognition part (111) is arranged on a second substrate (P3) different from the first substrate (P1), and uses a mechanical learning model to recognize information related to the distance to the object based on the output signals of a plurality of light receiving elements.

title: Financial event discovery method and system based on big data
description: The invention discloses a financial event discovery method and system based on big data, comprises: acquiring financial data based on a database and integrating to obtain a financial data set; storing the financial data set in an xml database, and cleaning the data to obtain a data set to be calculated; after constructing the long-term and short-term memory network, the financial event screening model is obtained; inputting the data set to be calculated into the financial event screening model for calculation, and generating a financial event detection result. The LSTM network in the present invention is specially designed for processing time series data, which makes it very suitable for the financial field, where time series data are common. LSTM can capture the temporal correlation and patterns in data.

title: Strategy searching in strategic interaction between parties
description: Described herein are methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for performing counterfactual regret (CRF) minimization for strategy search in strategic iteration between two or more parties. One method includes: storing multiple regret samples in a first data store, wherein the multiple regret samples are obtained in two or more integrations of a CRF algorithm in strategy search in strategic iteration between two or more parties; storing multiple strategy samples in a second data store; updating parameters of a first neural network to predict a regret value of a possible action in a state of a party based on the multiple regret samples in the first data store; and updating parameters of a second neural network to predict a strategy value of a possible action in a state of the party based on the multiple strategy samples in the second data store.

title: Vector map construction method and system based on view interactive aggregation
description: The present invention relates to a vector map construction method and system based on view interactive aggregation. The method obtains a visible light image, extracts features of the visible light image in a pixel-level coordinate system and a camera coordinate system respectively, and obtains fused features through an asynchronous mutual learning fusion module. The fused features are used through a key point pre-selection module to obtain depth instance features and geometric position features, which are used as initial reference points. The fused features and the key point query and instance query obtained based on the key point pre-selection module are used as inputs of a target detection algorithm, and the obtained initial reference points are used as additional prompt features of the target detection algorithm to obtain predicted vector map element labels and their locations. The predicted vector map element labels and their locations form a single-frame vector map, and the rich feature information in the historical frames is aggregated with the sparse features in the current frame to enhance the sparse features of the current frame, and the vector map is further obtained through a detection head.

title: A method for preparing three-dimensional cobalt-platinum microstructures based on graph neural network
description: The invention discloses a preparation method of a three-dimensional cobalt-platinum microstructure based on a graph neural network, which belongs to the technical field of cobalt-platinum microstructure preparation, and comprises the steps of collecting cobalt-platinum deposition parameters in the preparation of the three-dimensional cobalt-platinum microstructure, constructing a data set and preprocessing data; and inputting the pretreated cobalt-platinum deposition parameters into the graph causal network for processing, deducing the atomic proportion of the three-dimensional cobalt-platinum microstructure, identifying the optimal cobalt-platinum deposition parameters, and completing the preparation of the three-dimensional cobalt-platinum microstructure based on the optimal cobalt-platinum deposition parameters. According to the method, the atomic proportion of the three-dimensional cobalt-platinum microstructure is deduced through a graph neural network and graph attention and causal inference combined method, and the optimal cobalt-platinum deposition parameters are identified, so that the control of deposition conditions is conveniently enhanced, the efficiency and the precision of the cobalt-platinum microstructure preparation process are improved, the trial-and-error times in a traditional experiment are reduced, and the material performance is improved.

title: Power grid system, method of consolidating power injection and consumption in a power grid system and method of supplying power
description: A power grid system and a method of consolidating power injection and consumption in a power grid system. The power grid system comprises a power grid; at least one load connected to the power grid; a first meter configured for metering power imported from the power grid to the load; at least one intermittent power source connected to the power grid, a second meter configured for metering power generated by the intermittent power source; and a consolidation unit configured for associating readings from the first and second meters such that at least a portion of the power generated by the intermittent power source is offsettable with the power imported from the power grid to the load.
