title: Feature vector generation, search method, device and electronic device
description: Methods, apparatuses and electronic devices for generating a feature vector, as well as searching methods, apparatuses and electronic devices are disclosed. The method for generating a feature vector includes: acquiring data information; extracting a semantic feature from the data information, to acquire semantic feature information; and acquiring a feature vector of the data information by using a preset function, with the semantic feature information as a parameter. The technical solution identifies picture information by recognizing semantics of image information and matching the semantics of the image information with natural language descriptions. Different from conventional image search schemes of existing search engines, this technical solution does not need to retrieve a text description of image information, but retrieves and identifies images based on the content of the image information. Therefore, results with higher accuracy may be returned compared with the existing text-based image search.

title: Lithography simulation using machine learning
description: In certain aspects, a quasi-rigorous electromagnetic simulation, such as a domain decomposition-based simulation, is applied to an area of interest of a lithographic mask to produce an approximate prediction of the electromagnetic field from the area of interest. This is then applied as input to a machine learning model, which improves the electromagnetic field prediction from the quasi-rigorous simulation, thus yielding results which are closer to a fully-rigorous Maxwell simulation but without requiring the same computational load.

title: Apparatus and method for processing data based on ai
description: An AI-based data processing device and method are disclosed. The AI-based data processing device may include a first similarity search unit that measures a first similarity between a vectorized user's question and vectorized fragments of document contents registered by the user and extracts N (N is 1 or more) vectorized fragments, a second similarity search unit that measures a second similarity between the vectorized question and the N vectorized fragments and obtains a second similarity value, a similarity correction unit that calculates correction information based on fragment size information of the document contents and corrects the second similarity value based on the calculated correction information, a prompt reconstruction unit that reconstructs a prompt for the user's question if it is determined that the user's question is related to the document contents based on the corrected second similarity value, and a display unit that requests an answer from an AI server based on the reconstructed prompt and receives and displays an answer generated by the AI server by referring to at least the document contents or at least one previously learned document contents.

title: Method and apparatus for data augmentation of uwb signal based on artificial intelligence model
description: The present disclosure relates to a data augmentation method of a UWB signal based on an artificial intelligence model. The data augmentation method of a UWB signal based on an artificial intelligence model includes the steps of receiving a first UWB signal and a second UWB signal, performing interpolation based on the first UWB signal and the second UWB signal to generate a third UWB signal, and providing at least one of the first UWB signal, the second UWB signal, and the third UWB signal to a learned artificial intelligence model to generate a fourth UWB signal having a distribution associated with the at least one signal.

title: Artificial intelligence model learning method for predicting defects in process equipment, inference method based thereon, computing device, and recording medium thereof
description: One embodiment relates to a method for learning an artificial intelligence model for predicting defects in process equipment, comprising: a first step of acquiring vibration data in real time from process equipment; a second step of converting the vibration data collected in the first step into a spectrogram to create a real-time image dataset; and a third step of training an artificial intelligence model using the image dataset acquired in the second step as learning data.

title: System and method for generating a fused environmental representation for a vehicle
description: The vehicle computing system can receive raw sensor data from both a traditional sensor data processing module and a learned sensor data processing module. Each module can reproject the sensor data into BEV space and optionally perform sensor fusion when multiple sensor data types are processed. The system can then combine the learned BEV grid map or volume with the traditional BEV grid map or volume to generate a hybrid BEV representation of the vehicle's surroundings, and process the hybrid BEV representation of the surroundings to derive a fused representation of the vehicle's surroundings.

title: Apparatus for speculative decoding in an electronic device and operating method thereof
description: The present disclosure relates to a device for performing guess decoding based on an AI model in an electronic device and an operating method thereof. The electronic device outputs first tokens for each draft model in response to a prompt input from a plurality of draft models included in the AI model. The electronic device outputs second tokens for each draft model from a target model included in the AI model, taking the first tokens for each draft model as input. The electronic device determines a target draft model to be used for guess decoding from among the plurality of draft models based on a similarity between a first probability distribution of the first tokens for each draft model and a second probability distribution of the second tokens for each draft model.

title: METHOD FOR PERFORMING FEDERATED LEARNING BASED ON MoE and LoRA, ELECTRONIC DEVICE SUPPORTING THE SAME, AND RECORDING MEDIUM
description: According to one embodiment, an electronic device may include a communication circuit, at least one processor including a processing circuit, and a memory storing instructions. The instructions, when individually or collectively executed by the at least one processor, may cause the electronic device to respectfully identify a plurality of expert models of a large language model corresponding to a plurality of external electronic devices performing federated learning. The large language model may include a gating network and a plurality of expert models. The instructions, when individually or collectively executed by the at least one processor, may cause the electronic device to transmit, via the communication circuit, the gating network and the expert model corresponding to the external electronic device to each of the plurality of external electronic devices. The external electronic device may be included in the plurality of external electronic devices. The expert model may be included in the plurality of expert models.

title: Method and system for predicting hydroplaning according to tire abrasion
description: The present disclosure relates to a method for predicting tire drainage according to tire wear. According to the present disclosure, the method includes the steps of: generating a plurality of first tread pattern images including tire pattern information; generating a plurality of second tread pattern images including the worn pattern information of the tire after road driving from each of the plurality of first tread pattern images; synthesizing a plurality of wear scanning data obtained by scanning the plurality of second tread pattern images and pre-measured environmental noise data to convert the data into learning sound data; performing learning on a noise pattern of the tire when driving on a road using a short-time Fourier transform (STFT) based on the learning sound data; acquiring measured sound data from a sound detection sensor mounted on the tire after the tire has driven for a predetermined distance; predicting a driving road condition of the tire using a correlation between the measured sound data and the learning sound data; and predicting braking performance of the tire on a wet road among the driving road conditions and wear condition information of the tire based on the measured sound data in the driving road condition.

title: EVALUATION OF THE PERFORMANCE AND OPTIMIZATION OF THE DESIGN OF INTEGRATED COMPUTATIONAL ELEMENTS.
description: A system for the analysis and optimization of the design of integrated computational elements ("ICE") that uses a genetic algorithm to develop the layer thickness of each fixed ICE structure using a restricted multi-objective merit function. The system outputs a representative classified group of ICE design candidates that can be used for additional fabricability study, ICE combination selection, efficient statistical analysis and / or feature characterization.

title: Computer-implemented method for determining the states in vivo and in vitro by analyzing the blood parameters measured in a hematological analysis device
description: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method for determining states in vivo and in vitro by analyzing blood parameters, comprising: a) obtaining blood parameters of a blood sample by means of a hematology analyzer, wherein the blood parameters encompass quantitative and qualitative measurement variables, wherein the measurement variables encompass properties of individual cells, and the individual cells encompass blood cells; b) creating at least one scatterplot having at least two axes, wherein each axis of the scatterplot encompasses a different measurement variable; c) determining at least one in-vivo and/or in-vitro and/or post-mortem state by means of at least one deep learning model and/or at least one machine learning model, wherein the input variable for the at least one deep learning model comprises at least one scatterplot, wherein the input variable for the at least one machine learning model comprises at least one 1D vector, and wherein the 1D vector is created by vectorizing the at least one scatterplot; and d) automatically generating a report which comprises at least one result regarding the determination of the at least one state.

title: Enhanced surface detection for a robotic lawnmower
description: The present disclosure relates to a computer-implemented method for providing at least two surface type detection models and is adapted to provide classifications regarding surface properties for a robotic lawnmower (100) comprising at least two drive wheels (131, 132) that are driven at corresponding drive wheel velocities (V1A, V2A; V1B, V2B), constituting a set of drive wheel rotational velocities (V1A, V2A; V1B, V2B). The method comprising, for at least two different sets of drive wheel rotational velocities (V1A, V2A; V1B, V2B), obtaining (S100) radar detections (182) related to a surface (G) on which the robotic lawnmower (100) is intended to travel, and obtaining (S200) a set of drive wheel rotational velocities (V1A, V2A; V1B, V2B). The method further comprises associating (S300) the radar detections (182) for the obtained set of drive wheel rotational velocities (V1A, V2A; V1B, V2B) with a certain type of surface; and training (S400) a surface type detection model in a neural network using the associated radar detections (182) for the obtained set of drive wheel rotational velocities (V1A, V2A; V1B, V2B). At least two surface type detection models are trained in the neural network, each surface type detection model being associated with a corresponding set of drive wheel rotational velocities (V1A, V2A; V1B, V2B).

title: Processor with memory array operable as either last level cache slice or neural network unit memory
description: The processor includes a neural network unit (NNU) comprising a plurality of process cores, a last level cache memory (LLC) shared by the plurality of process cores, an array of neural process units (NPU), and a memory array. The LLU consists of a plurality of components. In order for the memory array to transition from a first mode in which the memory array operates to store neural network weights read by a plurality of N PUs to a second mode in which the memory array operates as a component of the LLC as well as the plurality of components, the processor The hashing algorithm is updated to rewrite-validate the LLC and to include the memory array as a component of the LLC as well as a plurality of components. To transition from the second mode to the first mode, the processor updates the hashing algorithm to rewrite-validate the LLC and to exclude the memory array from the LLC.

title: Automatic driving vehicle control method and control device
description: Of interest detection unit (1) for detecting the interest of the occupant with respect to the driving situation of the automatic driving vehicle, and a manual driving characteristic learning unit (7) for learning the manual driving characteristics based on the driving situation of the automatic driving vehicle, and of the automatic driving vehicle It has an automatic driving characteristic setting unit 8 for setting automatic driving characteristics based on ambient conditions. In addition, the interest determination unit 12 for determining the degree of interest in the vehicle driving of the occupant, and when the interest determination unit 12 determines that the interest is high, based on the manual driving characteristics learned by the manual driving characteristic learning unit 7 By setting the driving characteristics, and if it is determined that the interest is low, it is provided with a driving characteristic setting unit 13 for setting the automatic driving characteristics set in the automatic driving setting unit (8).

title: Method for predicting internal heating temperature of combined electrical appliance
description: The invention relates to the technical field of power equipment state detection, in particular to a method for predicting internal heating temperature of a combined electrical appliance, which comprises the steps of recording SF6 gas pressure P, ambient temperature T, ambient humidity H, wind speed V1, wind direction V2, combined electrical appliance shell temperature T2 and heat source temperature T1 by building a combined electrical appliance model, forming a prediction data set, and obtaining a prediction function through algorithm training, so that the internal heating temperature of the combined electrical appliance can be accurately predicted when the combined electrical appliance emits heat in the actual working process, providing a basis for the accuracy of defects, reasonably making a power outage overhaul and defect elimination plan according to the heating temperature, and ensuring safe and stable operation of the power equipment.

title: Book recommendation method based on deep model
description: The invention discloses a book recommendation method based on a deep model, which comprises the following steps of constructing a data set, inputting the data set into two pre-training language modules to obtain hidden state representations of the last layer of the two pre-training language modules, carrying out average pooling on the hidden state representations of the last layer of the two pre-training language modules to obtain a comprehensive representation vector of the whole input, inputting the data set into an interest extraction module to process the comprehensive representation vector to obtain an embedded representation vector of an embedded layer, carrying out grouping and splicing on the embedded representation vector of the embedded layer to obtain the output of the interest extraction module, and fusing the comprehensive representation vector of the whole input with the output of the interest extraction module to obtain the probability of readers on candidate borrowed books. According to the method and the system, the attention mechanism is added in the deep model, and the attention mechanism dynamically distributes weight according to the influence of each behavior on the preference of the user, so that the key interests of the user are accurately identified, and the recommendation capability is obviously enhanced.

title: Data language model training method, device, equipment, medium and program product
description: The present application relates to a data language model training method, device, equipment, medium and program product, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method includes: obtaining a standard vocabulary set, first financial training data and an initial financial data language model in the financial field; inputting the first financial training data into the initial financial data language model to obtain a predicted vocabulary; fine-tuning the initial financial data language model according to the standard vocabulary set and the predicted vocabulary to obtain a target financial data language model. In the present application, by fine-tuning the initial financial data language model, the accuracy of the model parameters of the target financial data language model can be improved through model fine-tuning, thereby improving the accuracy of data processing of the target financial data language model.

title: Transformer fault diagnosis method and system based on multi-information feature fusion
description: The invention discloses a transformer fault diagnosis method and a system based on multi-information feature fusion, wherein the method collects transformer operation information and transformer voiceprint signals, and carries out filtering treatment on the transformer voiceprint signals through a self-adaptive unscented Kalman filtering algorithm; optimizing a punishment factor C of the SVM by improving a snake Lu optimization algorithm, constructing a ISBOA-SVM model, inputting data into the constructed ISBOA-SVM model to obtain probabilities of various fault types, and fusing the probabilities of the fault types output by the ISBOA-SVM models by adopting a D-S evidence theory to determine the fault types. The method provided by the invention can obviously improve the fault diagnosis precision of the transformer and has stronger generalization capability.

title: Industrial Internet defect data estimation method based on graph signal convolutional neural network
description: The present invention provides an industrial Internet missing data estimation method based on graph signal convolutional neural network, which belongs to the field of industrial Internet technology, including constructing a sample structure diagram reflecting the industrial Internet, and preprocessing the data to obtain a training set and a test set; using the training set to train the optimized graph neural network model to obtain a trained graph neural network model; using the trained graph neural network model to evaluate the test set, obtain the relative error between the data completion value and the original value, and complete the prediction and completion of the node features. The present invention solves the problem in the prior art that it is not possible to effectively complete and predict multidimensional features while ensuring the accuracy of the prediction.

title: Cell image recognition method and system based on model fine tuning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing and discloses a cell image recognition method and a cell image recognition system based on model fine tuning, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an image to be recognized comprising a cell image; the method comprises the steps of inputting an image to be identified into a trained cell definition identification model to obtain corresponding cell definition, inputting the image to be identified into a trained cell existence area identification model to obtain a corresponding cell existence area image, inputting the cell existence area image and the cell definition into a trained cell classification model to obtain a plurality of corresponding cell areas and corresponding cell types, wherein the cell definition identification model, the cell existence area identification model and the cell classification model are obtained based on joint training and fine adjustment. Therefore, the invention can fully utilize definition factors and priori region identification to accurately identify the cell region and type in the image, and improve the precision and efficiency of cell identification.

title: End-to-end communication system with variable rate mechanism
description: The present invention belongs to the field of communication technology, and specifically relates to an end-to-end communication system with a variable rate mechanism. The present invention expands the transmission rate modes that can be supported by the existing E2E system, and can realize the effective use of channel resources by the E2E system: first, through reasonable network structure division and expansion, the E2E system can work in multiple rate modes; second, by adopting a variable rate network training mechanism, the E2E system can achieve near-optimal performance in various rate modes through fewer parameter training; finally, the trained network is combined with the signal-to-noise ratio estimation technology, which can enable the E2E system to evaluate the surrounding environmental conditions and adjust the rate, so as to realize the rate adaptation of the network to the environmental conditions, so as to communicate with the highest possible efficiency while maintaining a certain BER performance.

title: Intelligent model data processing method applied to metal smelting
description: The present invention discloses a method for processing intelligent model data applied to metal smelting, which relates to the field of metal smelting technology. The specific steps of the method are: S100 collects real-time metal smelting data, S200 establishes models based on different sub models, S300 outputs prediction results and performs uncertainty evaluation, S400 intelligently fuses the output results to obtain the comprehensive optimal decision output, S500 continuously monitors the actual data in the production process, adjusts equipment operating parameters. The present invention designs a multi-objective model output fusion mechanism that can simultaneously consider product quality, energy consumption, and production efficiency in the metal smelting process. Through the weighted average method, the model prediction results corresponding to different objectives are intelligently fused to obtain the comprehensive optimal decision output, so that the metal smelting process can achieve balance and optimization among multiple key indicators, meeting the needs of enterprises for maximizing comprehensive benefits.

title: Method, apparatus and system for encoding and decoding tensors
description: Apparatus and method for decoding from a bitstream at least a plurality of tensors forming a hierarchical representation of feature maps for a single frame. The method comprises: decoding a first information unit from the bitstream; decoding a second information unit from the bitstream; and determining a first plurality of tensors based on the first information unit, the feature map of at least one of the first plurality of tensors having a different spatial resolution than the feature maps of (one or more than one) other tensors in the first plurality of tensors. The method further comprises: determining a second plurality of tensors based on the second information unit, the feature map of at least one of the second plurality of tensors having a different spatial resolution than the feature maps of (one or more than one) other tensors in the second plurality of tensors. The feature maps of each of the first plurality of tensors have a different spatial resolution than the feature maps of each of the second plurality of tensors, and the tensors in the first plurality of tensors and the second plurality of tensors correspond to the hierarchical representation of the feature maps for a single frame.

title: SiC MOSFET life prediction method based on WOA-BP
description: The invention discloses a WOA-BP-based SiC MOSFET life prediction method, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of reliability prediction of power electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of selecting drain-source voltage as an aging characteristic parameter of the SiC MOSFET, acquiring voltage data in real time in an aging test process by using a sensor, preprocessing the acquired voltage data, eliminating abnormal values, supplementing missing values and smoothing data, optimizing parameters of a back propagation neural network BP by using a whale optimization algorithm WOA, constructing a WOA-BP prediction model, initializing the WOA-BP model, inputting the voltage data for training, establishing a mapping relation between the service life of the SiC MOSFET and the voltage, and predicting the residual service life of the SiC MOSFET. The SiC MOSFET life prediction model has the advantages of strong adaptability, low computational complexity, high prediction precision and the like, can be widely applied to the fields of semiconductor industry, new energy automobiles, industrial automation and the like, and provides powerful support for the health management and maintenance of equipment.

title: Equipment fault prediction system based on multi-mode deep learning
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field related to equipment fault prediction, and discloses an equipment fault prediction system based on multimodal deep learning, which is characterized by comprising: an image processing model, including an encoder, a generator, a first decoder and a second decoder, the encoder extracts the image feature vector of the external input image and inputs it into the generator to reconstruct the image, the first decoder extracts the features of the external input image to obtain the first decoding vector, and the second decoder extracts the features of the reconstructed image to obtain the second decoding vector; a fusion module, which performs feature fusion on the external time series vector and the image feature vector and constructs a feature matrix to input into the TranAD model; the TranAD model predicts the feature data in the next time window based on the feature matrix in the current time window; a report output module, which calculates the error and outputs the error report for fault prediction, and the larger the error, the higher the probability that the equipment has a fault risk. Through the above method, the accuracy of fault prediction can be improved.

title: Method, system, equipment and medium for optimizing global track of battery temperature of electric automobile
description: The invention discloses a global track optimization method, system, equipment and medium for battery temperature of an electric automobile, which comprises the steps of collecting historical working condition data and temperature tracks, constructing an initial working condition prediction model by utilizing RBF and LSTM networks, obtaining a trained model through Bayesian optimization training optimization, then carrying out real-time iterative prediction and optimization by utilizing transfer learning to obtain an optimized working condition prediction model, carrying out real-time working condition prediction based on the model to obtain prediction data, constructing an NARX energy consumption prediction model, training with the prediction data and a temperature control target to realize real-time energy consumption prediction, finally, constructing an adaptability function by taking weighted values of energy consumption and temperature offset as targets, and optimizing in a population through a genetic algorithm to obtain an optimal global temperature track. The technical scheme of the invention can utilize the short-distance driving data and the historical working condition data to predict the global working condition and optimize the global thermal management temperature track in real time.

title: Resource scheduling method of quantum computing measurement and control system and quantum computer
description: The present invention discloses a resource scheduling method for a quantum computing measurement and control system and a quantum computer. The resource scheduling method for a quantum computing measurement and control system proposed in the present application determines whether there is a resource conflict between the quantum computing task to be executed and other quantum computing tasks being executed in a task thread through a resource manager. When there is a conflict, the conflicting task is placed in a cache queue. When there is no conflict, the quantum computing task to be executed is allocated to the task thread. This solution effectively solves the resource conflict problem that may occur when multiple tasks are to be solved at the same time, realizes the parallel execution of multiple quantum computing tasks, and effectively improves the execution efficiency of quantum computing tasks in the quantum computing measurement and control system.

title: Substation power parameter real-time monitoring and analyzing platform
description: The present invention discloses a real-time monitoring and analysis platform for power parameters of a substation, which relates to the field of power monitoring technology and includes a monitoring and analysis platform, wherein the monitoring and analysis platform is communicatively connected with a real-time monitoring module, a data acquisition and processing module, a data storage and management module, a fault feature extraction module, an event warning module, a fault diagnosis module, and a data visualization module. The real-time monitoring and analysis platform for power parameters of a substation can timely detect abnormal conditions of power equipment by real-time collection and analysis of key parameters such as voltage, current, power, temperature, and humidity, thereby preventing potential faults and accidents. By learning and pattern recognition of historical fault data, the platform can predict and identify abnormal trends that may lead to faults, and issue early warnings, thereby significantly improving the reliability and safety of the power system, reducing the risk of unexpected power outages and equipment damage, and ensuring the continuity and stability of power supply.

title: Method, apparatus and storage medium for parameter correction
description: According to embodiments of the present disclosure, a method, apparatus, and storage medium for parameter correction are provided. The method includes generating a first set of processing parameter sets based on respective initial values of one or more image processing parameters of the captured image, the processing parameter sets in the first set of processing parameter sets including respective parameter values of the one or more image processing parameters, the one or more image processing parameters for determining a first measurement regarding a target dimension of the wafer pattern. A second set of processing parameter sets is generated at least by a combination operation of parameter values in the first set of processing parameter sets, the processing parameter sets in the second set of processing parameters comprising corresponding parameter values of one or more image processing parameters. One or more image processing parameters are updated based on the respective parameter values in each of the second set of processing parameters. In this way, the accuracy of the image processing parameters is improved to further enable the user to obtain more accurate dimensional information of the wafer pattern.

title: Accurate acupoint determination method based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention provides an artificial intelligence-based accurate acupoint determination method, which comprises the steps of firstly, carrying out semantic segmentation on a human back image to construct a high-quality human back image semantic segmentation dataset, secondly, constructing an RPN (remote procedure network) by ResNet50 0+FPN, then accurately extracting characteristics of candidate areas by using RoIAlign, ensuring the accuracy of subsequent classification and masking, improving the accuracy of acupoint recognition, thirdly, outputting the accurate acupoint determination, calibrating a received prediction result, and fourthly, carrying out comprehensive analysis of multi-mode data and specific area temperature information extraction by spatially aligning and combining two different-mode image data. The method can provide a high-precision boundary box and a segmentation mask, is beneficial to accurately identifying the acupoints in a complex environment by a robot, reduces the possibility of identification errors, has strong adaptability, and can be adjusted according to the physiological characteristics of different individuals.

title: Neural codec utilizing hybrid entropy model and flexible quantization
description: Innovations in systems, methods, and software for features of a neural image or video codec are described herein. For example, a neural video encoder may receive a current video frame, encode the current video frame to produce encoded data, and output the encoded data as part of a bitstream. As part of encoding, the encoder may determine a current latent representation for the current video frame, and encode the current latent representation using an entropy model network comprising one or more convolutional layers. As part of encoding the current latent representation, the encoder may estimate statistical properties of a quantized version of the current latent representation based at least in part on a previous latent representation for a previous video frame, and entropy encode and decode the quantized version of the current latent representation based at least in part on the estimated statistical properties.

title: Programmable Analog Neural Network
description: No content.

title: Decoding and encoding method, apparatus, and device thereof
description: The present application provides a decoding and encoding method, an apparatus, and a device thereof. The decoding method comprises: decoding a code stream corresponding to a current image block to obtain coefficient hyperparametric features; on the basis of the coefficient hyperparametric features, determining probability distribution parameters, and on the basis of the probability distribution parameters, decoding another stream of the current image block to obtain reconstructed features; inputting the reconstructed features into a synthetic transformation network to obtain reconstructed image blocks; wherein the synthetic transformation network comprises an attention module, and the attention module is a cascaded mixed attention module; the cascaded mixed attention module comprises a first attention submodule and a second attention submodule, and the first attention submodule and the second attention submodule are connected in series.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, and non-temporary computer-readable medium
description: An information processing device (10) according to the present disclosure comprises: an object recognition unit (11) that uses a first modal signal and a first modal recognition model corresponding to the first modal signal to output inference results relating to the first modal signal; a teacher data processing unit (12) that uses the inference results to generate first modal teacher data relating to the first modal signal, and that uses the first modal teacher data to update second modal teacher data relating to a second modal signal which is different from the first modal signal; and a recognition model updating unit (13) that uses the second modal teacher data to update a second modal recognition model corresponding to the second modal signal.

title: Efficacy measures for unsupervised learning in a cyber security environment
description: A method for performing searches of user information comprises: receiving an initial dataset including the user information; calculating distance metrics between pairs of data in the initial dataset; performing unsupervised learning on the initial dataset to obtain a plurality of total number of clusters, each total number of clusters covering the initial dataset; determining efficacy measures for each total number of clusters using a plurality of distance metric thresholds; determining a desired efficacy measure in the efficacy measures, the desired efficacy measure corresponding to a desired distance metric threshold in the plurality of distance metric thresholds; determining a desired total number of clusters in the plurality of total number of clusters, the desired total number of clusters corresponding to the desired distance metric threshold; and performing unsupervised learning on the initial dataset using the desired total number of clusters to obtain a number of data representations of the user information.

title: System and method for a security post
description: The present teaching relates to method, system, medium, and implementations for detecting a target object via a security post. A plurality of sections are arranged in a vertical direction. Each section is designated to detect the target object in a vertical range by receiving information related to magnetic field from one or more sensors, analyzing the sensed information to extract features characterizing the magnetic field variations in the corresponding vertical range, and determining whether the target object is present in the vertical range based on the extracted features. When the target object is detected by a section, an alarm associated with the section is triggered to indicate the detection. An overall detection result is determined based on the detection result from each of the sections and is displayed on a display screen.

title: Response style component removal device, response style component removal method, and program
description: Provided is a response style component removal device with which it is possible to remove an independent response style in the content of a questionnaire. The present invention includes: a parameter learning unit that, using as learning data the evaluation values for question items for a plurality of evaluators who evaluated all of K types (where k is an integer of 2 or more) of questionnaires each including a plurality of question items, learns parameters that explain the evaluation values, the parameters comprising an evaluator parameter θ k  that is dependent on at least an index k (k=1, …, K) of the questionnaire and represents the tendency of an evaluator, an item parameter β k  that is dependent on at least an index k (k=1, …, K) of the questionnaire and represents the tendency of a question item, and a response style parameter γ that is not dependent at least on the type of questionnaire and represents the tendency of the response style; and a response style component-removed probability distribution generation unit that removes the response style parameter γ, among the learned evaluator parameter θ k , the item parameter β k , and the response style parameter γ, and generates the probability distribution of the evaluation values.

title: Artificial intelligence system and method for instantly identifying and blocking unauthorized cyber intervention into computer application object code
description: An artificial intelligence system and method securely stores all executable binary object code of a client/user's computer-based software applications in a separate and impenetrable Sealed-off Central Processing Unit (SCPU). The SCPU is shielded from any external communication interface by having no input ports or devices able to receive external transmissions. The SCPU executes four primary functions: 1. constantly reads all the primary object code in the client/user's application system; 2. simultaneously compares and matches the application system executable object code to the shielded executable object code copy stored in the SCPU; 3. permanently blocks the unmatched object code section(s) pending internal IT security team review of the unmatched object code; and, 4. notifies the client/user's authorized IT security authority of the blocked object code section(s) and submits to them a copy of the potentially invalid object code.

title: Base station positioning based on convolutional neural networks
description: Systems and methods for base station positioning based on a convolutional neural network are disclosed. The method may include acquiring, by a positioning server, feature information that is received from one or more base stations at different locations in the area of interest; generating a feature input that includes of a plurality of feature maps based on the feature information; training a convolutional neural network (CNN) based on the feature input; and determining a position of a terminal device using the trained CNN.

title: Equalizer for equalization of music signals and methods for the same
description: An equalizer and a method of controlling same are provided. The equalizer includes a memory storing an EQ value set for a plurality of music attributes and storing a general-purpose EQ value; and a processor configured to: obtain an input music signal; calculate a plurality of probability values for the plurality of music attributes by analyzing attributes of the input music signal based on a convolutional neural network; calculate a moderate index between the plurality of probability values; generate an EQ value based on the plurality of probability values and the moderate index; and perform equalizing by applying the generated EQ value to the input music signal.

title: Resource scheduling method and apparatus, and readable storage medium
description: A resource scheduling method and apparatus, and a readable storage medium. In a process in which a terminal device participates in federated learning, a network device first generates first information, the first information comprising configuration information, and specifically, the configuration information being used for indicating the characteristics of sample data with which the terminal device performs model training and/or the characteristics of a model to be trained; and then, the network device sends the first information to the terminal device, and the terminal device acquires the configuration information from the first information. The network device determines, according to a data processing capability and/or a data transmission capability of the terminal device itself, that the terminal device participates in the current round of federated learning, and generates and sends configuration information of training parameters matching the terminal device, thereby implementing scheduling of the training parameters in a wireless network.

title: Configurable quantum-computing control system
description: A system for controlling a quantum processor (10) comprises a system controller (18) having a plurality of input channels (20) and output channels (22) connected to qubit readout instruments (24) and qubit control instruments (26). The system controller (18) is implemented at least in part as an FPGA (19). It forms a register bank (44) for receiving the data from the input channels (20), a feedback block (54) for processing the data from the register bank (44), and an output interface (61) for sending the results of the feedback block (54) to the control instruments (26). The feedback block (54) can be programmed by an FPGA configuration device (28). The FPGA configuration device (28) is able to process various types of feedback block definitions (68), which e.g. describe lookup tables, minimizers, Boolean operations, etc. A configuration device (30) comprises a system compiler (31) agnostic of the specific implementation of the feedback block (54) for controlling the experiments and the operation of the instruments (24, 26).

title: Inference device, program, and inference method
description: The present invention comprises: a knowledge base unit (112) in which a knowledge base is stored for performing inferences for responses to a request; an information acquisition unit (113) that acquires condition information, which is information including user requests, which are requests from users, and response information including responses of users to inference results, which are the result of inferences; an inference unit (114) that uses the knowledge base to produce inferences in response to user requests contained in the condition information; an information output unit (115) that outputs inference results; a feedback information extraction unit (116) that specifies a desired result, which is the result desired by a user to a user request, from the response information; and an update unit (117) that updates the knowledge base so that the desired result can easily become an inference result.

title: Borehole image interpretation and analysis
description: Computer vision system and method for detecting and characterizing heterogeneities from a representation of a borehole. A memory stores processor-executable modules executed by a computer vision processor. The modules include a preprocessing module to extract a plurality of borehole images from the representation of the borehole, a computer vision module to perform semantic segmentation for automated classification of pixels in the borehole images to identify the heterogeneities, and a characterization module to execute a fitting algorithm for extracting dimensional information of the identified heterogeneities.

title: Tracking velocity information
description: Systems and methods for tracking velocity information. One system includes an application execution server providing an application layer. The application execution server is configured to receive a request including metadata. The application execution server is also configured to generate and transmit a response to the request. The application execution server is also configured to enrich the metadata by structuring the metadata for further processing by a data processing layer, where the further processing includes determining velocity information associated with the metadata, and by supplementing the metadata with available historical velocity information. The application execution server is also configured to transmit the enriched metadata for further processing by the data processing layer.

title: Systems and methods for motor function facilitation
description: Systems and methods for motor function facilitation are described herein. In one aspect, a computer-implemented method for assisted actuation of a patient movement can include: receiving a set of neural signals from a set of neural sensors; extracting a set of features from the set of neural signals; inputting the set of features into a classification model; determining from the classification model an attempted activity of a user; and transmitting a set of stimulation signals to one or more output effectors according to the attempted activity and the set of neural signals.

title: Electricity metering circuit for a matrix operation circuit, summation circuit and method for operation thereof
description: The invention relates to an electricity metering circuit for a matrix operation circuit, having a circuit input for an electrical input current that is an output current of the matrix operation circuit. The electricity metering circuit is designed to provide an earth potential at the circuit input, to integrate the input current at the circuit input over time, to store a stored charge, which is increased in proportion to the integrated input current up to a predetermined maximum stored charge in accordance with a proportionality constant, to quantify the integrated input current in a charge unit of measure, the charge unit of measure corresponding to the maximum stored charge in light of the proportionality constant, and to determine the integrated input current, rounded down to the nearest integral charge unit of measure, as a metering sum. The invention additionally relates to a summation circuit that comprises a matrix operation circuit and multiple electricity metering circuits connected to current outputs of the matrix operation circuit, a method for operating a summation circuit, a computing unit for performing the method and a computation module that comprises a summation circuit and a computing unit.

title: Data-processing method
description: A data-processing method involves: causing at least one computing device to receive at least one input signal representing at least a plurality of responses from at least one job applicant, each response of the plurality of responses being responsive to a respective prompt of a plurality of prompts, at least some responses of the plurality of responses selected from a plurality of selectable responses associated with the respective prompt; causing the at least one computing device to, responsive to at least some of the plurality of responses from the at least one job applicant, associate the at least one job applicant with a respective at least one job posting; and causing the at least one computing device to, responsive to at least some of the plurality of responses from the at least one job applicant, associate the at least one job applicant with a respective at least one learning opportunity.

title: Eclipse attack detection method and apparatus for blockchain
description: Disclosed in the present invention are an eclipse attack detection method and apparatus for a blockchain. The method comprises: for any one of N continuous first moments, determining, on the basis of a trained long short term memory network (LSTM) and according to M actual data packet feature vectors of a blockchain node at M continuous second moments before the first moment, a data packet feature vector predicted by the blockchain node at the first moment; determining an error vector at the first moment according to the data packet feature vector predicted at the first moment and the actual data packet feature vector at the first moment; and determining, according to the N error vectors at the N first moments, whether the blockchain node is subjected to an eclipse attack. When the method is applied to financial technology (Fintech), global judgment is not affected by the accuracy of prediction of a certain data packet, thereby reducing the false alarm probability of eclipse attacks.

title: Appearance inspection method and appearance inspection system
description: The following occur during an appearance inspection according to the present invention: training data, which is a set of training samples in which training images capturing an item to be inspected for training purposes are paired with correct evaluation values for the training images is stored in a storage resource; correct evaluation values for training samples included in the training data are altered in accordance with a modifiable prescribed variation distribution; expanded training samples, which are training samples in which the altered values are set as correct evaluation values, are generated; expanded training data, which is a set of expanded training samples, is generated; the relationship between the training images and the evaluation values is learned, on the basis of the expanded training data, to determine internal parameters of an evaluation engine; an inspection image capturing the item to be inspected is acquired; the inspection image is inputted into the evaluation engine; and an estimated evaluation value, which is an estimate of the inspection image evaluation value, is acquired from output from the evaluation engine. (Selected Drawing: FIG. 2)

title: Generating point cloud completion network and processing point cloud data
description: The embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method, an apparatus and a system for generating a point cloud completion network. The method includes: acquiring first point cloud data by inputting a latent space vector into a pre-trained first point cloud completion network; acquiring real point cloud data collected for a real object in a physical space; for a real point in the real point cloud data, selecting a preset number of points adjacent to the real point from the first point cloud data as neighbor points of the real point; generating second point cloud data based on the neighbor points in the first point cloud data of a plurality of real points; acquiring a second point cloud completion network by adjusting the first point cloud completion network based on a difference between the second point cloud data and the real point cloud data.

title: Image processing method and apparatus, electronic device, and readable storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present invention provide an image processing method and apparatus, an electronic device, and a readable storage medium. The method comprises: obtaining an image to be processed, the image to be processed comprising a target object; obtaining normal feature information and target feature information of the target object by using a feature model, the target feature information comprising: depth feature information and/or tangent feature information; performing, on the basis of the normal feature information and the target feature information, lighting rendering on the target object in the image to be processed to obtain an image after lighting rendering; and outputting the image after lighting rendering. Compared with the prior art, in the present invention, a terminal device can perform lighting rendering on the target object on the basis of richer feature information of the target object, so that a lighting rendering effect can be enriched.

title: Un-decimated image processing method and apparatus
description: Provided in the present disclosure are an un-decimated image processing method and apparatus. The un-decimated image processing method comprises: acquiring an image to be processed; and inputting said image into an image processing network to obtain an output image for outputting, with the resolution of the output image being the same as the resolution of said image. The image processing network comprises an analysis module, a synthesis module and at least one processing module. The step of inputting said image into the image processing network to obtain the output image for outputting comprises: after said image is input into the analysis module for feature analysis, outputting feature tensor images; after the feature tensor images are input into the processing modules for processing, outputting processed feature tensor images, wherein the resolution of the feature tensor images outputted by the processing modules is the same as the resolution of said image; and after the feature tensor images outputted by the at least one processing module are synthesized by means of the synthesis module, obtaining an output image.

title: Data processing method and apparatus
description: Disclosed in the present application are a data processing method and apparatus. The method comprises: after obtaining first data, a first communication apparatus processing the first data according to a first parameter, so as to obtain a first transmission symbol; and then, sending the first transmission symbol to a second communication apparatus, and the second communication apparatus correspondingly receiving the first transmission symbol; the second communication apparatus processing the first transmission symbol according to the first parameter, so as to obtain an input to a neural network, and processing the input according to the neural network, so as to obtain a processing result. The first parameter is determined according to a first accuracy and first channel information, wherein the first channel information is information of a channel between the first communication apparatus and the second communication apparatus, and the first accuracy is used for representing the accuracy of data processing performed by the neural network. By means of the method provided in the present application, the utilization efficiency of radio resources is effectively improved.

title: Three-dimensional point cloud up-sampling method and system, device, and medium
description: The present invention provides a three-dimensional point cloud up-sampling method, system, and apparatus, comprising: dividing three-dimensional point cloud into overlapping point cloud blocks having a fixed number of points and capable of covering all points; extracting hierarchical features according to the coordinates of the middle points of the point cloud blocks; performing point set feature expansion on the extracted hierarchical features by using multi-scale thermal kernel graph convolution; and reconstructing the coordinates of the middle point of up-sampled three-dimensional point cloud from the expanded features. The present invention can perform detail information enhancement of different fine granularities on three-dimensional point cloud that is spatially sparse and non-uniformly distributed, and has good stability for potential noise disturbance and local deformation. Compared with an existing method, the present invention can promote the uniformity of the spatial distribution of up-sampled dense point cloud, ensure the accurate representation of the geometric structure of a target object, and achieve performance improvement.

title: Optimization method and apparatus for power management system
description: Provided in the present disclosure are an optimization method and apparatus for a power management system. The method comprises: inputting training data, which is collected from a power grid, into a machine learning model, and identifying a power flow (PF) model of the power grid and gradient information that is required for optimal power flow (OPF) calculation, wherein the machine learning model is a feedforward artificial neural network; and obtaining an initial solution of a decision-making variable in an optimal power flow model, taking the initial solution as the current solving method of the optimal power flow model, and entering an iterative calculation process, and obtaining a required control instruction and display information after iterative OPF calculation is performed multiple times. By means of the present disclosure, gradient information (a Jacobi matrix) for OPF calculation can be calculated without the need for multiple iterations, and the performance and speed of OPF operation are improved by using the gradient information, so as to reduce the operation amount of OPF calculation, thereby improving the calculation efficiency. In addition, in the present disclosure, a PF model is built by using a machine learning model, and more types of input data can be used as training data for machine learning, thereby improving the robustness and precision of the PF model.

title: Method of implanting atoms in a substrate and method of forming a quantum register
description: A methods of implanting atoms into a substrate, wherein the atoms are at least some of the constituent atoms of a molecule and wherein the molecule comprises one or more colour centre atom(s) and one or more satellite atom(s). In come embodiments, the molecule comprises not more than three colour centre atoms of the same element of the group. In some embodiments, the molecule comprises one or more colour centre atom(s) other than N, on other embodiments, the molecule comprises at least 6 satellite atoms of N. In some embodiments, the molecule comprises one or more satellite atoms other than  13 C. A method of manufacturing a quantum register comprising a colour centre and at least one nuclear spin isotope atom in a substrate, wherein the colour centre of the quantum register is a colour centre formed by a colour centre atom implanted into the substrate according to one of the above methods. A quantum register comprising such colour centre and at least one nuclear spin isotope atom in a substrate. Finally, a use of a molecule that comprises one or more colour centre atom(s) and one or more satellite atom(s) for the manufacture of a quantum register.

title: Machine learning models for data development and providing user interactions policies
description: Systems, devices, and methods for data collection and development as well as providing user interaction policies are provided. In one embodiment, a method includes collecting contextual data for a first subset of a plurality of users. The method further includes generating a first set of contextual profiles for the first subset of the plurality of users based on the collected contextual data. Additionally, the method includes training one or more imputation models to develop the contextual data for the second subset of the plurality of users. The method also includes generating the contextual data for the second subset of the plurality of users using the one or more imputation models. Further, the method includes generating a second set of contextual profiles for the second subset of the plurality of users based on the generated contextual data for the second subset of the plurality of users.

title: Magnetic resonance imaging processing method and apparatus using scan parameter
description: A magnetic resonance imaging processing method according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: acquiring a first parameter group including a low-quality training image and at least one scan parameter that has been applied when the training image is acquired, and a second parameter group including a high-quality label image and at least one scan parameter that has been applied when the label image is acquired; and training an artificial neural network model by using the training image, the first parameter group, the label image, and the second parameter group.

title: Automatic tone detection and suggestion
description: A method and system for providing tone detection for a content may include receiving a request to detect a tone for a content, retrieving user data and data about the content, detecting a content environment for the content based on at least one of the user data and the data about the content, detecting the tone for the content based on the content and the content environment, inputting the content and the detected tone into a machine-learning (ML) model for modifying the tone from the detected tone to a modified tone, obtaining at least one rephrased content segment as an output from the ML model, the rephrased content segment modifying the tone of the content from the detected tone to the modified tone, and providing at least one of the detected tone or the at least one rephrased content segment for display.

title: Scam call prevention
description: A method comprises receiving a rerouted phone call identified as a scam call, and processing received caller speech from the rerouted phone call to determine a response. The method includes interacting with a caller using the determined response, wherein the response is determined in order to extend a duration of the phone call. The processing may comprise identifying features in the received call speech associated with ending and/or extending a call. The identifying may comprise identifying one or more of: negative emotions in the caller speech, and threats in the caller speech.

title: Method for operating a working apparatus in a pipeline, and working apparatus
description: The invention relates to a method for operating a working apparatus in a pipeline having, or provided for having, a medium flowing in an axial direction, wherein the untethered working apparatus is moved in the pipeline passively by the medium in a flow direction of the pipeline or is moved in the pipeline actively by a drive means, and wherein the working apparatus, which has a computing unit, records items of surroundings information in the pipeline by means of at least one, preferably by means of at least two surroundings sensors, and wherein, in the computing unit of the working apparatus, the items of surroundings information are automatedly evaluated and, in the evaluation of the items of surroundings information, which are recorded in particular by means of two different surroundings sensors, at least one feature of the pipeline is identified, preferably for the purposes of determining a position, and is in particular compared with and/or stored in a digital map of the pipeline that is stored in the computing unit. The invention furthermore relates to a working apparatus comprising at least one propulsion means for passive propulsion of the working apparatus in a pipeline and/or at least one drive means for active locomotion of the working apparatus in the pipeline, and comprising at least one, preferably two, surroundings sensors for recording items of surroundings information, wherein the working apparatus has a computing unit having at least one computer program.

title: Neural video coding
description: According to implementations of the subject matter described herein, a solution for neural video coding is provided. According to the solution, estimated motion information of a target frame in a video, reference feature information and a reference reconstructed frame of a reference frame for the target frame are obtained. Context information for the target frame is determined using a context extraction model and based on the estimated motion information, the reference reconstructed frame, and the reference feature information. In a conversion between the target frame and a bitstream of the video, a reconstructed target frame of the target frame is generated using a frame coding model and based on at least the context information. In this way, richer context information can be extracted for coding and thus the coding efficiency can be improved.

title: 3d segmentation method and system based on diffusion model and 3d transformer, device, and medium
description: Disclosed are a 3D segmentation method and system based on a diffusion model and a 3D transformer, a device, and a medium. The method comprises: obtaining an image to be segmented; and inputting said image into a 3D segmentation network model based on a diffusion model and a 3D transformer to obtain a 3D segmentation result for said image. By means of the method and system, the device, and the medium, a medical image can undergo 3D segmentation.

title: Training dataset updates for a training dataset partitioned into multiple dataset groups
description: Various aspects of the present disclosure relate to training dataset updates. A training dataset is partitioned into multiple dataset groups and each dataset group includes one or more training datapoints. Each dataset group is associated with a first label and a second label. The first label corresponds to a temporal or time-domain related parameter, such as a time stamp or a time duration. The second label is at least one of a weight or a value associated with a characteristic of the dataset. The training dataset is updated based on at least one of the first label or the second label, such as by updating a subset of values of the second label, removing a dataset group, or adding a new dataset group to the training dataset. Updated information corresponding to the updated training dataset can then be sent from one device to another.

title: Template-based generation of synthetic data sets
description: A method includes obtaining first data records associated with a first schema. Each respective data record of the first data records may include corresponding values of a plurality of fields. The method also includes obtaining a mapping representing a transformation of a field of the plurality of fields from the first schema to a training schema, and selecting, based on the mapping and for each respective data record of the first data records, a corresponding value of the field from the first data records. The method further includes generating second data records by transforming, based on the mapping and for each respective data record of the first data records, the corresponding value of the field from the first schema to the training schema. The method additionally includes training a machine learning model based on the second data records.

title: Helical fiber geometry for continuous higher-order mode stripping in beam delivery fibers
description: Example embodiments provide quantum computers, laser light delivery systems for quantum computers, and methods for delivering laser light from lasers of quantum computers to atomic object confinement apparatuses of quantum computers. In an example embodiment, a quantum computer comprises an atomic object confinement apparatus, a laser, a cylindrical guide positioned such that a first end of the cylindrical guide is adjacent the laser and a second end of the cylindrical guide is adjacent the atomic object confinement apparatus, and an optical fiber cable helically wrapped around the cylindrical guide and spanning from the first end to the second end. The optical fiber cable is configured to deliver laser light generated by the laser to the atomic object confinement apparatus. A pitch of the helically wrapped optical fiber cable is selected to provide a desired effective bend radius of the optical fiber cable to strip higher-order modes of the laser light.

title: Method for increasing the accuracy of lidar sensing in the measurement of the efficiency of flare gas combustion in face of environmental variations and degradation of the flare combustion control system
description: It combines remote sensing technology, such as LIDAR (Light Detection and Ranging), with data interpretation algorithms, to determine and control the combustion efficiency of the flare; of destruction and removal of gases, and the emission rates of gas components, offering accurate and real-time data, crucial for the optimization of burning processes and the reduction of emissions, especially CO2 and CH4.

title: Artificial intelligence image analysis-based automatic camera configuration
description: The present specification relates to an artificial intelligence image analysis-based automatic camera configuration system, an automatic camera configuration device, and a method for automatic camera configuration using same. The artificial intelligence image analysis-based automatic camera configuration system includes: a first surveillance camera which uses a wide-angle lens to capture a wide-area first surveillance area, thereby acquiring a first surveillance image; and a second surveillance camera having a PTZ function for obtaining a second surveillance image by capturing a second surveillance area within the first surveillance area. The first surveillance camera analyzes the first surveillance image on the basis of a first object analysis artificial intelligence model to derive an object feature analysis result for a detected object, and generates a profile for configuring the second surveillance camera on the basis of the object feature analysis result. The second surveillance camera controls PTZ according to the profile and can configure the camera.

title: Quantum assisted data-driven simulation methods and systems
description: Implementations involve generating quantum hybrid neural networks on a computing platform, by leveraging the computational advantages of both quantum and classical neural networks to enhance data processing capabilities. A hybrid neural network may include a quantum neural network and a classical neural network. The quantum neural network may process input data using a quantum processor to produce intermediate data. Subsequently, the classical neural network may process this intermediate data as its own inputs to generate output data. The hybrid neural network may then be stored back onto the electronic storage device for immediate or later use or training.

title: Neural network execution method and related apparatus
description: The present application provides a neural network execution method and a related apparatus, applied to an artificial intelligence chip. The artificial intelligence chip is configured with logical semaphores, each of which is associated with a plurality of physical semaphores, and a plurality of corresponding conditional wait tasks are supported to correspond to one conditional signal task. First, during a process in which resources of a neural network are applied for, the logical semaphores are allocated, the logical semaphores comprising a preset conditional signal task and a preset conditional wait task; and then, during a process in which the neural network is constructed, instantiated and executed, the neural network is executed with a first execution stream and a second execution stream. When it is ensured that the neural network is correctly executed, there is no need to manually manage a large number of physical semaphores, greatly reducing the user programming difficulty and improving the user programming experience.

title: Method and system for enabling call connectivity in extended-discontinuous reception (edrx) cycle for wearable device
description: A method performed by a wearable device comprising: configuring a Configured Grant- Small Data Transmission (CG-SDT) timer and an eDRX timer; detecting an expiry of the CG-SDT timer; based on detection of the expiry of the CG-SDT timer, changing a connection mode of the wearable device to an idle mode; sending, to a master device, a notification query request; receiving a notification query response from the master device; and performing one or more changes in the connection mode based on the notification query response.

title: Methods and systems for automatically tuning weights associated with breeding models
description: Systems and methods for use in identifying weights to be employed in a selection algorithm associated with plant advancement are disclosed. One example method includes identifying a start set of weights for a selection algorithm associated with a breeding program, and for each scale parameter value in a schedule, and for each of N iterations, modifying the start set of weights based on the scale parameter value, identifying a set of germplasm based on at least the modified set of weights, advancing the modified set of weights to a next iteration as the start set of weights when certain criteria are satisfied, and identifying the modified set of weights as an output when the iteration is equal to  N .

title: Geometrically enhanced clifford quantum computer
description: Aspects of the disclosure for reducing a qubit count employed by a quantum circuit include performing a geometric transformation to boundaries of a three-dimensional (3D) toric code, wherein a Hermite normal form is utilized to parameterize the geometric transformation. Aspects include transforming the 3D toric code to a two-dimensional (2D) toric code for the quantum circuit and causing the quantum circuit to execute the 2D toric code.

title: System and method for identifying customers for migrating from existing network to new network
description: The present invention relates to a system (108) and a method (600) for identifying customers eligible for migration from an existing network (106) to a new network (110) The disclosed system (108) and method (600) aim at enhancing the experience of the customer as well as service providers. More particularly, the present invention provides a unique approach of predicting and identifying eligible customers for migration from the existing cellular network technology to new cellular network technology based on the prediction performed by the AI/ML model (216) utilizing the historical data and trend analysis, focusing on pre-defined or dynamically set parameters. This ensures the customers can experience better performance after migrating from the existing cellular network technology to the new network cellular technology.

title: Graphics processing chip with machine-learning based shader
description: Embodiments disclosed herein relate to a graphics processing chip for rendering computer graphics. The graphics processing chip may include a controller configured to manage operations of the graphics processing chip in accordance with a graphics-rendering pipeline. The operations may include geometry-processing operations, rasterization operations, and shading operations. The chip may further include programmable memory components configured to store a machine-learning model configured to perform at least a portion of the shading operations. The chip may also include a plurality of processing units configured to be selectively used to perform the shading operations in accordance with the machine-learning model. The chip may also include at least one output memory configured to store image data generated using the shading operations.

title: Contactless continuous blood pressure estimation
description: The present disclosure relates to a contactless system for monitoring a blood pressure of a subject (e.g., human patient, non-human patient, etc.) based on vibration signals of a structure supporting the subject. The system can include a sensor coupled to the structure. A computing device in data communication with the sensor can obtain realtime sensor data from the sensor, the real-time sensor data may include seismic signal segments recorded at a predetermined sampling rate. The computing device can further filter the sensor data to remove seismic signal segments not related to vital activities and analyze the filtered sensor data to determine continuous and real-time blood pressure measurements of the subject, which include the estimated systolic blood pressure values and estimated diastolic blood pressure values. A user interface can display of at least the blood pressure measurements.

title: Learning program, learning method and learning device
description: To provide a learning program, a learning method and a learning device which reduce a calculation amount required for learning processing.SOLUTION: A learning program causes a computer to execute processing for acquiring learning data as a learning object of a model in which data and certainty of the data are correlated. The learning program determines whether learning of the learning data is necessary, by comparing a determination result about update of the model accumulated for the learning data acquired by acquisition processing with a predetermined condition. The learning program causes the computer to execute processing for excluding the learning data which is determined that the learning is not necessary from the learning object in determination processing.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: System, method, and computer program product for anomaly detection
