description: To provide a system and method for a malfunction event or error event in a processing environment, by mounting a centralized sorter model and a sorter model based on an edge node.SOLUTION: A system for malfunction detection comprises: receiving a first pair of information from a first pair of field devices placed in a process control environment; transmitting a first input vector, generated on the basis of the first pair of information, to a first malfunction detector mounted in an edge node configured to provide a gate way access to the process control environment, a first sorter model being mounted in the first malfunction detector; transmitting a second input vector to a second malfunction detector mounted in a server based on cloud, in response to detection of a malfunction event based on the first input vector transmitted by the first malfunction detector; and generating a malfunction event alert in response to detection of the malfunction event by at least one of the first malfunction detector and the second malfunction detector.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Driver assistance control system
description: To accurately determine the possibility of conflicting with a system limit at which path following control becomes poor in a driving support control system for performing the path following control to control the traveling of a vehicle so that the vehicle follows a target path.SOLUTION: A driving support control system for a vehicle determines a target path based on necessary information and comprises: a vehicle traveling control unit which performs path following control to control a traveling apparatus of the vehicle so that the vehicle follows the target path; and a system limit identification unit which identifies the possibility of conflicting with a system limit at which the path following control becomes poor. The system limit identification unit includes a determination model which has learned, by machine learning in advance, a relationship between a plurality of vehicle feature quantities related to the path following control and the possibility of conflicting with the system limit. The system limit identification unit uses the determination model to output the identification result of the possibility of conflicting with the system limit corresponding to the plurality of input vehicle feature quantities.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 7

title: System and method for predicting site, onset and / or change of coronary lesions
description: Disclosed are systems and methods for predicting the location, onset and / or change of coronary lesions from vessel shape, physiology and hemodynamic factors. One method obtains, for each of a plurality of individuals, a shape model, blood flow characteristics, and plaque information of at least a portion of the individual's vasculature; each shape model and blood flow characteristics of each of the plurality of individuals Training machine learning algorithms and features that predict the presence of plaque in the shape model and blood flow characteristics of multiple individuals based on the predicted features; for each patient, for each patient's vasculature Obtaining at least a portion of the shape model and blood flow characteristics; and executing the machine learning algorithm on the patient shape model and blood flow characteristics based on the predicted characteristics, wherein at least one of the patient shape models Including determining patient plaque information for the points.

title: Learning with converted data
description: The present disclosure relates to learning using transformed data, such as determining a plurality of training samples from a plurality of data samples. Each of the plurality of data samples includes one or more feature values and a label that classifies the data sample. The processor determines each of the plurality of training samples by randomly selecting a subset of the plurality of data samples and combining feature values of the subset data samples based on a label for each of the subset data samples. Since the training sample is a combination of randomly selected data samples, the training sample can be provided to a third party without disclosing the actual training data. This is advantageous over existing methods, for example, when the data is confidential and therefore should not be shared with the classifier learner.

title: Proper solution search method and proper solution search device
description: To provide an appropriate solution search method and an appropriate solution search apparatus that can avoid a local minimum and can cope with problems that change in time series.   As one of the genetic information about a plurality of individuals, information about a life state and a death state is included. That is, the information is stored in the life storage area E24 of the individual data storage area E2. As a result, each individual, regardless of whether it has a relatively good fitness value (fitness) or a poor fitness value (fitness), will be deceived by death. Therefore, for example, an individual having an adaptive value that is relatively good but not an appropriate solution does not become an oligopoly, and avoids falling into a local minimum in searching for an appropriate solution for a set problem, In addition, it is possible to cope with problems that change in time series while maintaining diversity of individuals.

title: Signal processing device using neural network, signal processing method and signal processing program using neural network
description: The signal processing device (10) is a signal processing device that estimates a signal with reduced reverberation from an observation signal including reverberation observed by one or more microphones, and receives the feature amount of the signal including reverberation as a signal. The reverberation corresponding to the observed signal is reduced by inputting the observed feature corresponding to the observed signal to the neural network that is trained to output the estimated value of the feature corresponding to the power of the signal with reduced reverberation. A power estimator (12) for estimating an estimated value of a feature amount corresponding to the power of the signal, and an estimated value of the feature amount corresponding to power as an estimation result of the power estimator (12) And a regression coefficient estimation unit (13) for estimating a regression coefficient of the autoregressive process to be generated.

title: Mail inspection device, mail inspection method and mail inspection program
description: In the mail inspection device (10), a learning unit (20) learns a relationship between characteristics of each mail included in a plurality of mails and characteristics of a resource attached to each mail. The resources attached to each mail include at least one of a file attached to each mail and a resource specified by a URL in the body of each mail. The determination unit (30) extracts the characteristics of the mail to be inspected and the characteristics of the resources attached to the mail to be inspected, and determines whether the extracted characteristics have a relationship learned by the learning unit (20). It is determined whether or not the mail to be inspected is a suspicious mail.

title: Image processing equipment, image processing methods, and programs
description: Provided are an image processing device, an image processing method, and a program capable of collecting high-quality correct answer data used for machine learning by a simple method. The first extractor (52) that extracts the measurement target area from the medical image using the learning result learned using the correct answer data of the measurement target area, and the measurement object determination unit that determines the measurement object used for the measurement of the measurement target area. (54), the measurement object correction unit (56) that modifies the measurement object according to the user's instruction, and the measurement target that modifies the measurement target area extracted by the first extractor using the modification result of the measurement object. The area correction unit (58) is provided, and the first extractor learns the measurement target area corrected by using the measurement target area correction unit as correct answer data.

title: Node processors for use in parity check decoders
description: Techniques for implementing message passing decoders, e.g., LDPC decoders, are described. To facilitate hardware implementation messages are quantized to integer multiples of 1/2 ln2. Messages are transformed between more compact variable and less compact constraint node message representation formats. The variable node message format allows variable node message operations to be performed through simple additions and subtractions while the constraint node representation allows constraint node message processing to be performed through simple additions and subtractions. Variable and constraint nodes are implemented using an accumulator module, subtractor module and delay pipeline. The accumulator module generates an accumulated message sum. The accumulated message sum for a node is stored and then delayed input messages from the delay pipeline are subtracted there from to generate output messages. The delay pipeline includes a variable delay element making it possible to sequentially perform processing operations corresponding to nodes of different degrees.

title: Multi-tool-based natural language processing method, equipment and medium
description: The application discloses a natural language processing method, equipment and medium based on multiple tools, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of open source NLP tools; dividing a specific language into a plurality of dimensions adapted to the specific language; determining a pre-acquired training sample, wherein at least part of structures in the training sample are embodied in a specific language form; aiming at each open source NLP tool, performing natural language processing analysis on the training sample by using the open source NLP tool to analyze the training sample under each dimension to obtain analysis results corresponding to a plurality of dimensions respectively; aiming at each dimension, acquiring analysis results of a plurality of open source NLP tools in the dimension so as to train and obtain an NLP dimension model corresponding to the dimension; and according to the multiple NLP dimension models, natural language processing of the specific language is realized. The natural language processing is carried out through a plurality of open source NLP tools, so that the analysis result of the specific language under a plurality of dimensions is obtained, the problem of low analysis accuracy by using a single basic NLP tool is solved, and the usability is improved.

title: Abuse comment detection method and system
description: The application provides a method and a system for detecting abuse comments, which relate to the technical fields of artificial intelligence and language processing, select multi-level vector representation, select a secondary pre-training model BERT with optimized parameters in a large number of word banks, and encode the comments. The encoder can be guaranteed to fully represent final semantic representation, and the accuracy and recall rate of the detection model can be further improved. The application fully combines the advantages of strategy detection and algorithm detection, reduces labor cost by skillfully combining the strategy detection and the algorithm detection, and ensures the accuracy and the effectiveness of model detection to the greatest extent on the premise of least calculation force.

title: An unsupervised learning classification algorithm for wind power
description: The present invention relates to an unsupervised learning classification algorithm for wind power, which acquires data, preliminarily identifies the data to be classified, and classifies as follows: the part of the data to be classified whose wind speed is greater than 0m/s, less than the cut-out wind speed, and whose power is lower than the actual shutdown power is marked as shutdown data. The power is divided into several power segments, and a temporally continuous power segment is found in each power segment. When the univariate linear regression slope coefficient of the wind speed power data corresponding to the power segment is 0, the power segment is marked as limited power data. The interval data between the cut-in wind speed and the cut-out wind speed is selected, and the interval data is fitted with a wind speed power spline curve, and a confidence interval is set. Points outside the interval curve are marked as abnormal data, and points within the interval curve are marked as normal data. The present invention can effectively classify the actual power into abnormal, shutdown, normal, under-generation, over-generation and power limit according to the basic data such as power and wind speed of the wind turbine.

title: Spark-based hyperspectral lidar multi-channel weighting system and method
description: The invention discloses a Spark-based hyperspectral lidar multi-channel weighting system, which includes a data distribution layer and a data storage layer. The data storage layer includes a batch processing layer, a service layer, and a speed layer. The invention also discloses a Spark-based Hyperspectral lidar multi-channel weighting method smoothes the channel data allocated by the manager and outputs the smoothed channel data; performs time domain correction on the smoothed channel data and outputs the time domain corrected channel data; corrects the time domain Perform weighted accumulation on the channel data after weighted accumulation, and output the channel data after weighted accumulation; perform parameter extraction and optimization on the channel data after weighted accumulation, and output a distance data set and an intensity data set. The invention effectively improves the extraction accuracy of spectral information and distance information of each channel and each pulse of hyperspectral lidar waveform data, as well as the running speed of the hyperspectral lidar multi-channel weighted processing algorithm.

title: Model training method, device, equipment and storage medium for task processing model
description: The application provides a model training method, device and equipment for a task processing model and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting shared feature information of various categories in the training corpus through a shared feature extraction model; according to a preset input mode, the shared characteristic information and training text information based on training corpus labels are input into a plurality of subtask models, the subtask models are trained in parallel, and the weight coefficient of each subtask model is adjusted according to the gradient change condition of the task training loss of the subtask model, so that the training rate of the subtask models is located in the same numerical range interval until the integral loss function of the subtask models meets the training cut-off condition. Therefore, the application can provide various shared characteristic information related to the subtasks executed by the subtask models for different subtask models while guaranteeing that each subtask model can be independently trained, and further, the overall model training effect of the task processing model is improved.

title: Method and device for automatically learning network preprocessing parameters, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The application discloses a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for automatically learning network preprocessing parameters, wherein the method comprises the steps of training to obtain a semantic segmentation model through randomly constructed image processing parameter items, wherein the image processing parameter items are used for adjusting the display effect of each picture, the image processing parameter items comprise image processing parameter values, inputting a plurality of pictures into a preset parameter preprocessing network to obtain image processing target parameter values corresponding to each picture, adjusting pictures to be subjected to semantic segmentation processing according to the image processing target parameter values corresponding to each picture to obtain a plurality of target pictures, and inputting the plurality of target pictures into the semantic segmentation model obtained through pre-training to carry out image semantic segmentation. The semantic segmentation method and the semantic segmentation device improve the semantic segmentation effect of the semantic segmentation model during prediction.

title: Aortic dissection detection method, system, electronic device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses an aortic dissection detection method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium. The method includes the following steps: Step 1. First, use the first deep learning model to detect the target boundary box and its target boundary box from a series of CT slices of the human body. Corresponding categories, different categories represent different aortic parts; then use the sequence information extraction algorithm to process the target bounding box in the human body series CT slices, and use the final target bounding box as the area of interest; Step 2, use the second The deep learning model detects whether there is dissection in each region of interest obtained in step 1, and thereby determines whether there is dissection in the aorta corresponding to each region of interest. The invention can automatically and efficiently complete the accurate detection of the aortic part and identify the type of aortic dissection from a series of CT images of the human body.

title: Method and system for identifying intention track of customer service hotline user
description: The invention relates to a method for identifying intent tracks of customer service hotline users, which comprises the following steps: firstly, obtaining behavior trace data and dialogue texts; the second step, converting the complete dialogue text into dialogue fragments, and associating the dialogue text fragments with user behavior track data according to time nodes; thirdly, respectively obtaining text characteristic representation, user behavior characteristic representation and the user intention characteristic representation, and outputting the text characteristic representation, the user behavior characteristic representation and the user intention characteristic representation as sample characteristic representations after characteristic splicing; fourthly, using a multi-layer perception neural network as an intention classification algorithm model, using sample characteristic representation as input, and taking a vector of the last layer as an output result; fifthly, generating an optimal user intention track by using a Beam Search strategy; and a system for identifying the user intention track of the customer service hotline based on the user behavior track and the context. The method and the system ensure higher accuracy and can effectively reduce the error transfer of the intention errors to the intention recognition of the current sentence.

title: Method and system for learning neural networks to determine vehicle pose in an environment
description: A method and system are provided for learning a neural network and determining vehicle attitude in an environment. A first processor performs a first feature extraction on sensor-based image data to provide a first feature map. The first processor also performs a second feature extraction on aerial image data to provide a second feature map. The two feature maps are correlated to provide a correlation result. The first processor uses the correlation result and ground-based data to learn a neural network, wherein each of the first and second feature extractions is learned to extract a subset of features from the corresponding image data. The geotagged second feature map can then be retrieved by an onboard processor of the vehicle, which, together with sensor-based data processed by the onboard processor through a network trained by the first processor, determines the vehicle's attitude.

title: A system and method for equipment fault monitoring based on data analysis
description: The invention discloses an equipment fault monitoring system and method based on data analysis, and relates to the technical field of data processing; the equipment fault monitoring system comprises a fault analysis and processing module, an equipment delay analysis module and an equipment delay processing module; the fault analysis and processing module The module is used to obtain the signal when the module receives data, analyze the status of the module according to the signal when the module receives data, and obtain the result of whether the module is faulty, and process the module according to the result to ensure that the processed module transmits the data completely, so as to be able to Ensure the timely validity of data transmission to the device; the device delay analysis module is used to obtain the time information of the device completing the process according to the instruction, if the time information is abnormal time information, then cluster the reasons for generating the abnormal time information, and obtain the aggregated time information. To ensure that the equipment can complete the process in time, reduce errors, and at the same time ensure the production efficiency of the equipment and achieve the determined production goals.

title: Automatic organ segmentation method based on laryngoscope medical image
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer application, and particularly relates to an automatic organ segmentation method based on laryngoscope medical images. The method comprises the steps of effectively encoding remote dependence and multi-scale contexts through a hybrid transform encoding module, enabling a model to effectively capture semantic features of different degrees, improving detail segmentation effects, gradually reducing inaccurate segmentation areas into complete areas in the process of erasing high-level semantic information and bottom semantic information through an RRM decoding module, optimizing segmentation results through a convolution conditional random field module, eliminating small error segmentation areas and refining segmentation. According to the method, the organ context information is established sequentially, the organ and the soft tissue structure are distinguished, the long-distance dependent coding is established on the laryngoscope image, and the local characteristic and the global characteristic are fused, so that the problem that the laryngeal organ is not accurately segmented in the prior art is solved. By comparison, the organ segmentation structure is superior to the current other SOTA models, and mIOU is respectively improved by 3.9% and 2.53% compared with a reference model.

title: A recommendation strategy optimization method and system based on user behavior model
description: The invention discloses a recommendation strategy optimization method and a recommendation strategy optimization system based on a user behavior model, A user behavior model capable of reflecting user behavior preferences is constructed from offline interaction data of a user and a video recommendation system based on generating an anti-impersonation learning algorithm. The reinforcement learning agent and the user behavior model are interacted to collect data, and the related indexes of the video recommendation strategy are optimized based on the reinforcement learning algorithm PPO to obtain the optimal recommendation strategy, so that the cost caused by direct trial-and-error of reinforcement learning on a recommendation system is reduced, and the instant interaction indexes and the long-term interaction indexes of the recommendation strategy are remarkably improved. The optimal recommendation strategy is deployed to a real recommendation system for online evaluation, if the related indexes do not meet the requirements of the system, new interaction data are continuously collected, and the user simulator construction process and the recommendation strategy optimization process are repeated until the related indexes of the recommendation strategy meet the requirements of the system.

title: Online ferrograph reflected light image enhancement method and system
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for enhancing an online ferrograph reflected light image, which are based on outline marks of abrasive particles in the online ferrograph reflected light image, and are used for constructing an online ferrograph reflected light image enhancement model based on SqueezeNet-Unet abrasive particle position prediction network and ResNeXt-CycleGAN image conversion network by series fusion; determining a loss function of an abrasive particle position prediction network based on SqueezeNet-Unet, optimizing a cycle consistency loss function of a ResNeXt-CycleGAN image conversion network by combining SSIM loss and L1 loss, and designing an overall loss function of an online ferrospectrum reflected light image enhancement model in a weighted fusion mode; and taking the integral loss function of the image enhancement model as an optimization target, sequentially adopting an online ferrographic reflected light original image, a traditional algorithm enhanced image, an original image and an offline ferrographic image as an image enhancement model training sample set, optimizing the online ferrographic reflected light image enhancement model, and enhancing abrasive particle characteristics in the online ferrographic reflected light image.

title: Vehicle event recognition method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a vehicle event identification method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing an original image data set into a construction image data set and a training image data set; extracting semantic words constructing a frame image in an image data set, constructing a word list by using the semantic words, determining a semantic word sequence corresponding to the frame image in a training image data set based on the word list, converting the semantic word sequence into a semantic word matrix, inputting the semantic word matrix into a convolution network for training to obtain a vehicle event recognition model, and recognizing the test image data set by using the vehicle event recognition model when the test image data set is received to obtain a vehicle event classification result. According to the invention, the semantic word matrix is constructed by acquiring the semantic words of the vehicle driving image, the vehicle event recognition model is further trained and obtained, the vehicle driving image is utilized for semantic recognition when the vehicle is driven, and the efficiency and accuracy of vehicle event recognition are improved, so that traffic accidents are avoided.

title: Label processing method, apparatus, electronic device and computer readable storage medium
description: The present application proposes a tag processing method, device, electronic device and computer-readable storage medium. The method includes: determining a first user behavior sequence; wherein the first user behavior sequence includes multiple contents processed continuously by the user; determining multiple tag jump relationships based on multiple tags corresponding to the multiple contents; and determining first graph information based on the multiple tag jump relationships. The embodiment of the present application integrates user behavior information into the construction process of the tag graph, which can fully explore the correlation between tags, thereby improving the accuracy of the graph information.

title: Traffic flow prediction method based on space-time diagram convolutional network
description: In the field of time series prediction, the present invention discloses a traffic flow prediction method based on a spatiotemporal graph convolution network. The specific steps include: obtaining traffic flow data.   , use linear interpolation method to complete its missing data; in the graph convolution network, input the traffic flow data of each node in time order, and input the adjacency matrix at the same time, let the graph convolution network extract its Spatial features; dynamically design the gated loop unit based on the spatial features extracted from the graph convolution network, so that it can better combine spatiotemporal information while extracting temporal features, improve the accuracy of traffic flow prediction, and better Meet people's living needs.

title: Glove-based human-machine interface
description: A wearable human-machine interface (HMI) includes a plurality of triboelectric finger bend sensors configured to sense finger bend, deflection or curling; a triboelectric palm sensor configured to detect applied force and its direction; and at least one mechanical stimulator configured to provide tactile feedback. The human-machine interface is configured to be worn on a human hand and may take the form of a glove.

title: Method and device for detecting abnormality of human face, processor and electronic device
description: The present application discloses a method and device for detecting facial anomalies, a processor, and an electronic device, relating to the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises: obtaining a target image of a target face, wherein the target face is a face to be detected for facial anomalies in a monitoring system; inputting the target image into a deep learning target detection algorithm for anomaly detection processing to obtain an anomaly detection result for the target face, wherein the deep learning target detection algorithm is an algorithm constructed based on an initial target detection algorithm of deep learning, a target attention mechanism module, and a feature extraction module, and the feature extraction module is generated based on the spatial pyramid pooling structure in the initial target detection algorithm. This application solves the problem in the related art that the monitoring system using the face detection method has difficulty detecting abnormal faces, thereby affecting the use effect of the monitoring system.

title: Scene classification method and system based on multi-layer local perception deep dictionary learning
description: The invention discloses a scene classification method and a scene classification system based on multi-layer local perception depth dictionary learning, belongs to scene classification in the technical field of image recognition, and aims to solve the problems that in the prior art, shallow dictionary learning cannot extract more essential characteristics of a sample and scene classification capability is weak. The invention improves the deep dictionary learning method, in the first layer dictionary learning, the sample characteristics extracted by the PCA method are used as input; in the process of learning the second dictionary layer to the last dictionary layer, the features of the last layer after the ReLU activation function are used as the input of the dictionary learning layer, the activation function is added in the deep dictionary learning, the sparsity and the effectiveness of the obtained feature codes are further ensured, and therefore a deep dictionary with higher discrimination capability is obtained, and the expressive capability of the model on scene classification tasks is improved; by the method, more essential characteristics of the sample can be effectively extracted, and more excellent scene classification capability is obtained.

title: An intermediate representation method and device for parallel execution of graph computing
description: The invention discloses an intermediate representation method and device for parallel execution of graph computation, which comprises the following steps: step S1: compiling a neural network into a computational graph; step S2: defining branch states of tensor variables in the computation graph; and step S3: defining data dependency of tensor variables in a computation graph; and step S4: defining control dependence of tensor variables in a computation graph; step S5: constructing a data dependency relationship graph of tensor variables in the computation graph; step S6: constructing a control dependency relationship graph of tensor variables in the computation graph; step S7: the control dependencies are converted into data dependencies. The invention analyzes the dependency relationship among tensor variables of different branch threads in the calculation graph in the execution process of the calculation graph from the global angle and deduces the parallel calculation method capable of executing the branch threads in parallel in the global calculation graph based on the dependency relationship, and optimizes the compiling efficiency of the calculation graph by analyzing the dependency relationship among the tensor variables of different branch threads in the execution process of the calculation graph.

title: Hierarchical semantic communication method and system based on dependency syntax analysis
description: The application relates to a hierarchical semantic communication method and a hierarchical semantic communication system based on dependency syntax analysis, belonging to the technical field of intelligent semantic communication. According to the method, dependency syntax analysis is introduced into semantic communication, semantic layering is conducted on words in a transmission sentence by means of the dependency syntax analysis at a sending end, selective transmission is conducted on words with different semantic levels in the sentence to be transmitted according to channel quality, a receiving end receives information sent by the sending end, channel decoding and information source decoding are conducted on the received information in sequence, a receiving sentence is obtained, and semantic recovery is conducted on the receiving sentence by means of a ERNIE model. According to the application, dependency syntactic analysis is introduced into semantic communication at a sending end, so that the problems of ambiguous semantic description, excessively abstract semantic representation and the like in the existing semantic communication scheme are overcome, and the receiving end uses a ERNIE language model to carry out semantic recovery after receiving information.

title: Tumor immunotherapy curative effect prediction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention provides a method and a device for predicting the curative effect of tumor immunotherapy, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of medical detection and comprise the following steps: determining image characteristic information of each tumor microenvironment in each tumor tissue slice based on the tumor microenvironment images of each tumor tissue slice of the patient to be detected; inputting the image characteristic information of each tumor microenvironment in each tumor tissue section into a tumor immunotherapy curative effect prediction model to obtain a tumor immunotherapy curative effect prediction result of a patient to be detected, wherein the tumor immunotherapy curative effect prediction result is output by the tumor immunotherapy curative effect prediction model; the tumor immunotherapy curative effect prediction model is obtained by training based on image characteristic information samples of tumor microenvironment in tumor tissue sections and corresponding sample immunotherapy curative effect labels. The invention can realize accurate prediction of the curative effect of tumor anti-PD-1/PD-L1 immunotherapy, thereby screening beneficial patients on the premise of immunotherapy.

title: An automated system operation and maintenance management method and system based on machine learning
description: This application relates to an automated system operation and maintenance management method and system based on machine learning. The method includes obtaining operation and maintenance data information in the system operating state in real time, and inputting the operation and maintenance data information into a pre-built fault model to detect faults. Match, obtain fault matching information that matches the operation and maintenance data information, perform system fault prediction processing on the fault matching information, and obtain operation and maintenance decision information, wherein the operation and maintenance decision information is used to match the fault to the fault matching information. Information provision solution, based on the operation and maintenance decision-making information, construct a system operation and maintenance plan regarding the operation and maintenance data information, and obtain system operation and maintenance management rules, so as to facilitate the operation and maintenance data through the system operation and maintenance management rules. information for quick troubleshooting. This application has the effect of improving the troubleshooting efficiency of system operation and maintenance.

title: A query-based general adversarial perturbation attack algorithm for person re-identification
description: The invention relates to the technical field of pedestrian re-recognition, and discloses a general anti-disturbance attack algorithm based on inquiry for pedestrian re-recognition, which comprises the steps that a copy channel is used for expanding the algorithm to be as same as the original sample picture channel number, gamma is a parameter (gamma epsilon [0,1 ]) for controlling the importance of pixels at pedestrian positions and non-pedestrian positions, gamma is set to be a larger value, the pixels at the pedestrian positions are identified as pixels with larger influence on the attack effect, and a calculated result W represents an importance sampling weight. According to the invention, by combining the query-based attack with the universal challenge disturbance attack, the information obtained by all queries is used for updating the universal challenge disturbance shared by all samples, rather than generating a single sample-specific disturbance by carrying out a large number of queries on each sample, the total query times of attacking the whole data set are remarkably reduced, and the advantages of the method are further improved under the large-scale challenge sample attack scene.

title: A method and device for monitoring the state of a mechanized automatic learning auxiliary device
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of equipment status monitoring, and discloses a mechanized automatic learning auxiliary equipment status monitoring method and device, comprising the following steps: S1, selecting monitoring equipment, first selecting a server, workstation, controller, wireless transmission terminal, wireless receiving terminal and multiple sensor modules for mechanized automatic learning auxiliary equipment status monitoring of hydropower plant equipment. The mechanized automatic learning auxiliary equipment status monitoring method and device not only has the function of convenient installation, but also has the function of convenient online data viewing of hydropower plants, which can reduce the work difficulty of staff, and at the same time can improve the efficiency of staff viewing hydropower plant equipment monitoring data, and the device server has a heat dissipation function, and can effectively improve the convenience of pressure sensor maintenance in the mechanized automatic learning auxiliary equipment status monitoring method and device through a connecting mechanism.

title: Method and system for modeling stall delay of wing profile of wind turbine blade
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of wind turbine aerodynamic performance calculation, and provides a method and system for wind turbine blade airfoil stall delay modeling. The method comprises: based on the geometric parameters of blades composed of the same airfoil, using the flow control region to solve the continuity equation, Navier-Stokes equation and turbulence equation of the three-dimensional discrete flow region to calculate the flow field of the wind turbine under different incoming wind speeds, inputting the relevant parameters into the lift/drag coefficient neural network model respectively, performing training, and obtaining the lift/drag coefficient neural network correction model respectively. The present invention improves the accuracy of wind turbine aerodynamic performance prediction by correcting two-dimensional aerodynamic data to obtain three-dimensional aerodynamic data of different airfoils under different speeds and other working conditions.

title: Methods, model training methods and systems for improving network representation learning and representation capabilities
description: The method, model training method and system provided by the present invention to improve the representation ability of network representation learning, obtain a set of each subgraph according to the graph network; input the adjacency matrix and feature matrix representing the subgraph into the graph convolutional neural network to obtain the subgraph. The network of the graph represents the initial vector of learning; according to the relationship between the central node and each non-central node in the subgraph, the attention weight between the central node and each non-central node is calculated; according to the initial vector and each non-central node The attention weight between nodes is used to obtain the weighted node knowledge representation vector after combining the subgraph nodes and relationships; the attention mechanism is used to calculate the attention weight of the relationship between each non-central node; according to the node knowledge representation vector and each The attention weight of the relationship is used to obtain the weighted aggregation vector of the subgraph. Using weighted aggregation vectors to represent nodes enables node knowledge embedding to have richer semantic information and improves the knowledge computing and reasoning capabilities of heterogeneous networks.

title: Quantum amplitude estimation method, device, apparatus and storage medium
description: The disclosure provides a quantum amplitude estimation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to the field of quantum computing. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring T phase estimation values of an initial unitary operator of a target quantum system, wherein the T phase estimation values meet the phase estimation precision requirement, and the T value is at least related to the phase estimation precision requirement; the initial unitary operator is a Grover operator which is determined based on a target quantum state of the target quantum system and a preset quantum circuit together; the number of the quantum bits contained in the preset quantum circuit is related to the number of the quantum bits contained in the target quantum system; obtaining a target characteristic phase of the Grover operator based on the T phase estimation values; and obtaining the amplitude of the target quantum state based on the target characteristic phase of the Grover operator. Thus, a novel quantum amplitude estimation scheme is provided.

title: A channel information compression feedback method using dual-polarization data correlation
description: The present invention discloses a channel information compression feedback method using the correlation of dual-polarization data. For the dual-polarization channel information data with correlation, the present invention first uses two-dimensional Fourier transform to transform the space-frequency domain channel matrix in two polarization directions into the angle-delay domain, and then splits the imaginary and real parts of the complex matrix into two real matrices and splices them; the encoder network uses three sub-feature extraction neural networks to extract features containing conditional entropies of the two polarization directions and features containing mutual information of the two polarization directions respectively; the decoding network inputs the conditional entropies of the two polarization directions received and the mutual information into two channel information recovery neural networks to restore the original channel information; the present invention uses the correlation between the dual-polarization data to extract the mutual information of the two polarization directions, effectively improves the compression efficiency of the channel information and improves the recovery performance of the channel information, and performs channel compression feedback more efficiently, with obvious performance advantages.

title: A light-weight visible light living body detection method and device
description: The invention discloses a light-weight visible light living body detection method and device. The light-weight visible light living body detection method utilizes a visible light living body detection model to perform living body discrimination on a human face in an original visible light image, wherein the visible light living body detection model includes a deep neural network , the first fully-connected network and the second fully-connected network, and an auxiliary supervisory network for auxiliary learning of green light intensity features is introduced during the training of the visible light living body detection model. The present invention is based on the principle that the blood in the living body has a certain intensity distribution in the direction of green light when the blood flows through the skin. When training the deep neural network, an auxiliary supervision network is set, and the auxiliary supervision network assists the deep neural network to accurately extract the human face. It solves the problem that the silent living detection method based on visible light images in the prior art cannot resist 3D non-living attacks, improves the accuracy of living detection, and is lightweight.

title: Flying camera control method and system
description: The invention provides a fly-swatter control method and a fly-swatter control system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a virtual fly-swatter simulation environment corresponding to a target environment, and constructing an intelligent body corresponding to the mechanical arm; the method comprises the steps of controlling an intelligent agent to interact with a virtual flyswatter simulation environment by adopting a first reinforcement learning model, and obtaining an observation image shot by the intelligent agent in the virtual flyswatter simulation environment; calculating interaction rewards of the intelligent agent and the virtual fly shooting simulation environment according to the observation images; optimizing the first reinforcement learning model according to the interaction rewards to obtain a second reinforcement learning model; and constructing a fly-swatter control model by taking the parameter value of the convolutional neural network of the second reinforcement learning model as an initial value, and controlling the mechanical arm to move to a corresponding shooting point in a target environment through the fly-swatter control model to shoot. Therefore, the reinforced learning model is trained in the virtual fly-swatter simulation environment, and the reinforced learning model is transferred to the real environment to perform fly-swatter control, so that the accuracy and efficiency of fly-swatter are greatly improved.

title: Gas identification methods, devices, equipment, media and products supporting online learning
description: The application relates to a gas identification method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product supporting online learning. The method comprises the steps of identifying the gas types of the collected target gas based on network parameters of a plurality of pre-stored sample gases to obtain a gas type identification result of the target gas, wherein each network parameter is generated when the gas types of the plurality of sample gases are learned in advance based on a bionic olfactory neural network. According to the method, network parameters are acquired by learning various sample gases in advance, so that the identification accuracy of target gases is improved.

title: Rapidly trainable neural tree network
description: An apparatus and methods characterized by an electric neural network including a node having multipliers respectively receiving signals representing feature vector elements and signals representing weight vector elements to produce product signals, a summer to add the product signals with a bias signal and output a sum signal to a hard limiter, the hard limiter for outputting a preliminary output signal of polarity. In response to the output signal of polarity, one of at least two logic branches is enabled. In response to such enabling, weight elements are assigned to a next weight vector to be used in subsequent processing by the one of the at least two logic branches until a label is to be produced.

title: Object oriented case-based reasoning framework mechanism
description: A framework for use with object-oriented programming systems provides a case-based reasoning (CBR) system shell that permits a framework user to develop a case base having case histories and generates a case-based reasoning system that receives user requests for query solutions and produces a query solution that can be incorporated into the case base. The framework includes a Session component that controls processing of the CBR system, a Control Flow component that manages the extension of the categories and classes of the OO framework, a Data Store component that stores persistent case structure definitions, case instances, and a change log, a Presentation component that manages the user interface to the CBR system user, and a Query Engine that evaluates a received query against the case base. The case definitions and case base descriptions comprise a set of object oriented classes that are organized into an inheritance hierarchy. Also disclosed is a case-based reasoning system that permits dynamic adjustment of property weights in either object oriented programming implementations or procedural programming implementations. This permits users to control which properties and weights are used and whether missing items should penalize case matching.

title: Superconducting dot/anti-dot flux qubit based on time-reversal symmetry breaking effects
description: A method is described for forming a solid state qubit. The method includes forming a dot or an anti-dot. The dot or anti-dot can be formed on a substrate and is delimited by an interface that defines a closed area. The dot or anti-dot includes a superconductive material with Cooper pairs that are in a state of non-zero orbital angular momentum on at least one side of the interface. The method includes removing superconducting material on the inner side of the interface or removing the outer side of the interface by etching. The method can further include forming a dot or an anti-dot by damaging the superconducting material such that the superconductive material becomes non-superconductive in predefined areas. The damaging of superconducting material can be performed by irradiation with particles, such as alpha particles or neutrons. The superconductive material can also be formed by doping a non-superconductive material.

title: Adaptive constraint problem solving method and system
description: A method for problem solving in a computer system includes an applications module for sending a problem statement to a complexity module. The complexity module configures a solving module with configuration parameters and also determines expected solver behavior. A solving module determines actual solver behavior, determines whether a problem solution has been found, and determines whether to perform a solver iteration step or to request a complexity module to perform an adaptation step.

title: Scalable methods for learning Bayesian networks
description: The present invention leverages scalable learning methods to efficiently obtain a Bayesian network for a set of variables of which the total ordering in a domain is known. Certain criteria are employed to generate a Bayesian network which is then evaluated and utilized as a guide to generate another Bayesian network for the set of variables. Successive iterations are performed utilizing a prior Bayesian network as a guide until a stopping criterion is reached, yielding a best-effort Bayesian network for the set of variables.

title: Parallel pulse signal processing apparatus with pulse signal pulse counting gate, pattern recognition apparatus, and image input apparatus
description: In a parallel pulse signal processing apparatus including a plurality of pulse output arithmetic elements ( 2 ), a plurality of connection elements ( 3 ) which parallelly connect predetermined arithmetic elements, and a gate circuit ( 5 ) which selectively passes pulse signals from the plurality of connection elements, the arithmetic element inputs a plurality of time series pulse signals, executes predetermined modulation processing on the basis of the plurality of time series pulse signals which are input, and outputs a pulse signal on the basis of a result of modulation processing, wherein the gate circuit selectively passes, of the signals from the plurality of connection elements, a finite number of pulse signals corresponding to predetermined upper output levels.

title: Classification tool
description: A classification system that includes a first input module, a marker module, unclassified Lagrange multiplier calculation module, and a classification module. The unclassified vector describes a physical condition. The marker module assigns a marker to the unclassified vector. The marker should place the unclassified vector into one of two classes. The unclassified Lagrange multiplier calculation module calculates a classifying Lagrange multiplier for the unclassified vector using the marker and a classification rule. The classification rule may be generated using a training system for classifying the physical condition. The classification module is configured to determine that the marker places the unclassified vector in the proper class if the classifying Lagrange multiplier is small.

title: Methods and systems for drug screening and computational modeling based on biologically realistic neurons
description: A method for screening a test composition for potential efficacy in treatment of a disorder includes a first computer model representative of a volume of disease-afflicted neural tissue comprising biologically realistic neurons exposed to the test composition; and providing an initial excitation to the first computer model. Following a selected computation interval, a first outcome is determined. The first outcome indicates a response of the first computer model to the initial excitation and indicates whether the test composition has the potential to be effective in treating the disorder.

title: Data partitioning and critical section reduction for bayesian network structure learning
description: In a parallel system, multiple threads operate in parallel to perform network structure learning. A global score cache is partitioned into multiple split score caches, which may in one embodiment include associating a score cache with a node of the structure to be learned. With a split score cache, the learning may be performed in split neighbor scoring loops, with the first loop operating on separate score cache partitions, and warming the score cache partitions for the second loop.

title: System and method for creating thematic listening experiences in a networked peer media recommendation environment
description: Systems and methods for providing a thematic playback experience in a peer-to-peer media recommendation system are disclosed.

title: Systematic framework for application protocol field extraction
description: A computer-implemented system is provided for implementing application protocol field extraction. The system includes: an automata generator configured to receive the extraction specification that specifies data elements to be extracted from data packets and generate a counting automaton; and a field extractor configured to receive a data flow and operates to extract data elements from the data packets in accordance with the counting automaton. The extraction specification is expressed in terms of a context-free grammar, where the grammar defines grammatical structures of data packets transmitted in accordance with an application protocol and includes counters used to chronicle parsing history of production rules comprising the grammar.

title: IC chip planning method based on dynamic parallel genetic algorithm and speckle model
description: A chip planning method, tool and system for generating a population of gene strings representing floor plans for an integrated circuit, executing crossover on the strings to generate crossover child strings, executing mutation on the strings to generate mutated child strings, applying peristalsis operators to the strings to generate peristalsis child strings, and evaluating the child strings for inclusion in the population. The operators are peristalsis operators based on a speckle model. Dynamic control of migration rates and ranking is also executed, together with controlled race migration and immigration. Dynamic ratio control and optimisation of interconnecting area and pin assignment are also executed.

title: Expert system
description:
An expert system and a method of providing automated advice are described. The system is regularly updated by advice (or diagnosis, recommendation etc.) given by practitioners in the relevant field. The combination of the underlying facts and the consequent (human) advice is used to update a ruleset that is then used to provide automated advice. 
     An example of financial advice is given. A database contains the details for the customers of a financial institution together with advice and recommendations given previously by the institution's human advisors. This database is used to derive a ruleset which is then applied to a subsequent customer's details in an automated manner, possibly at the user's own PC via the World Wide Web. Frequent updating using data from the human advisors' work means that the database (and hence the ruleset) are kept up to date. Consistent advice can thus be provided with minimum human interaction.

title: Distribution of parameter calculation for iterative optimization methods
description: Systems and methods are disclosed for distributed first- or higher-order model fitting algorithms. Determination of the parameter set for the objective function is divided into a plurality of sub-processes, each performed by one of a plurality of worker computers. A master computer coordinates the operation of the plurality of worker computers, each operating on a portion of the parameter set such that no two worker computers contain exactly the same parameter subset nor the complete parameter set. Each worker computer performs its sub-processes on its parameter subset, together with training data. For maximum efficiency, the sub-processes are performed using a compact set of instruction primitives. The results are evaluated by the master computer, which may coordinate additional sub-process operations to perform higher-order optimization or terminate the optimization method and proceed to formulation of a model function.

title: Systems and methods for outbound forecasting based on a fulfillment center priority value
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a computer-implemented method and system for outbound prediction, wherein the computer-implemented method uses a simulation algorithm to determine an initial distribution of priority values for a plurality of fulfillment centers in each region. do; determine a number of fulfillment centers having an outbound capacity utilization value exceeding a first preset threshold; generating additional distributions of one or more priority values using at least one of the determined number of fulfillment centers and a simulation algorithm; create a fulfillment center priority filter based on the further distribution of the one or more priority values; and modifying the allocation of the plurality of SKUs among the plurality of fulfillment centers based on the generated fulfillment center priority filter.

title: An artificial intelligence drone equipped with a system that detects defects based on real-time sensor data, and method for detecting defects in artificial intelligence drones using a system that detects defects based on real-time sensor data
description: The present invention recognizes object information based on artificial intelligence from images acquired from one or more cameras, recognizes the surrounding situation using the recognized object information, determines whether the aircraft is defective using sensor data mounted on the aircraft, and comprehensive flight. It is equipped with a defect detection system based on real-time sensor data that can judge the situation, participate in flight control, prevent accidents caused by aircraft defects and collisions, and also perform facility safety inspections in real time based on artificial intelligence. This relates to a method for detecting defects in artificial intelligence drones using intelligent drones and a defect detection system based on real-time sensor data.

title: METHOD, APPARATUS, AND PROGRAM FOR PROVIDING BUSiNESS ANALYSIS INFORMATION TO DIGNOSE BUSINESS PROBLEM AND PROVIDE BUISNESS STRATEGY BASED ON ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
description: The present invention is a method of providing business analysis information performed in a business analysis information providing device, comprising: obtaining business indicators from online commerce data of a specific company; analyzing the business indicators to diagnose business problems of the specific company; and It includes providing a business strategy according to the business problem.

title: System for providing subscribe service using non-fungible token art
description: A subscription service provision system using NFT artwork is provided, an artist terminal that uploads artwork, owns NFTs issued based on the artwork, and receives profits for the NFT artwork that has been converted into an NFT artwork, and NFT artwork. A reception unit that receives artwork from user terminals and artist terminals that apply for the subscription service and print NFT artwork or request to output NFT artwork on a connected display, a verification unit that verifies the originality and copyright of the artwork, and an art Once the originality and copyright of the work are verified, the publishing department issues NFTs based on the work of art. When the user terminal receives a subscription service for NFT works of art that have been converted into NFTs, the NFT work of art is delivered to the user terminal or display and output. It includes a subscription service providing server including a subscription management unit to do so.

title: Method and system for generating classification numbers using artificial intelligence to build book MARC DATA
description: A method and system for generating classification numbers using artificial intelligence for building book list information are disclosed. A method of generating a classification number using artificial intelligence for building book list information according to one aspect of the present invention includes the steps of receiving book information about a target book; Determining a first key value through artificial intelligence analysis of the book name among the book information; Determining a second key value through artificial intelligence analysis of detailed book information; and generating a classification number for the target book using the first key value and the second key value.

title: Electronic device and method for obtain attribute information related to pedestrian using the same
description: According to various embodiments of the present invention, an electronic device determines a loss function to be applied to each task based on characteristics of each of a plurality of tasks representing a plurality of attribute information related to a pedestrian, and applies the loss function to each task. By applying the determined loss function, first learning of each task is performed, and during the first learning, learning is performed a certain number of times, at least one task in which no change in accuracy value occurs among the plurality of tasks Check whether the learning number exists, prevent the learning number of the at least one task in which no change in the accuracy value occurred while performing the learning a certain number of times from being updated, and store the learning number of the at least one task in the memory. and perform learning of the plurality of tasks, and if no change in the accuracy value of at least one other task among the plurality of tasks occurs while performing the learning a certain number of times, learning of the at least one other task Prevent the count from being updated, store the learning count of the at least one other task in the memory, and based on the fact that there is no change in the accuracy value of the at least one task and the accuracy value of the at least one other task , After completing the first learning of each task, performing a second learning of each task, and with the second learning, the number of learning times for each of the stored at least one task and the at least one other task is increased. By normalizing, the normalization value of each task is calculated, and the calculated normalization value of each task is determined as the loss weight of each task, and based on the loss weight of each generated task, the loss function value is determined. It can be adjusted.  Various other embodiments other than those disclosed in this document may be possible.

title: Fault location device, fault location system, and fault location method
description: [Problem] To improve the efficiency of the maintenance and preservation of a power system by locating the point of an accident with high accuracy when an accident occurs. [Solution] A data acquisition unit 130 acquires current information and voltage information at a predetermined point when an accident occurs. A location result inference unit 140 receives the current information and voltage information obtained by the data acquisition unit 130 and an estimated cause of the accident CAest based on the current information and voltage information, and outputs a location result PFrst that quantifies the probability of the existence of an accident point on the power system. [Selected Figure] Figure 3

title: Computer-implemented method for generating control command for automatic driving vehicle
description: The present invention relates to a computer-implemented method for generating control instructions for an autonomous vehicle.  [Solution] The method includes the steps of detecting sensor data by at least one sensor of the vehicle (S10), generating input text from the sensor data (S12), interpreting the input text using a machine learning algorithm (S14), and generating control commands for the vehicle from the interpreted input text (S16).  [Selected Figure] Figure 1

title: Step-down mining capacity prediction method of natural gas hydrate by deep neural network
description: [Problem] Provided is a method for predicting the production capacity of natural gas hydrate decompression mining based on a deep neural network. [Solution] A method for building a neural network model and using existing multi-scale natural gas hydrate decompression mining test data to train, optimize, test, and evaluate the model involves collecting and preprocessing multi-scale natural gas hydrate decompression mining test data, building a deep neural network model including one input layer, three hidden layers, and one output layer, optimizing the network parameters through a backpropagation algorithm, and evaluating the model's calculation accuracy using two parameters, the coefficient of determination and the average relative error, to obtain a production capacity prediction model with high accuracy and small error. A production capacity prediction module is then designed and used to predict the production capacity of natural gas hydrate decompression mining tests at different scales and mining parameters. title: Similar contribution detection method and similar contribution detection system
description: An example method has a function f, d=(elements d[1], d[2], ..., d[n]), a=(elements a[1], a[2], ..., a[n]), b=(elements b[1], b[2], ..., b[n]), f(a)=(f(a)[1], f(a)[2], ..., f(a)[m]), f(b)=(f(b)[1], f(b)[2], ..., f(b)[m]), where n and m are positive integers, and A step of calculating a first difference d between the first input data a and the second input data b, which are given to a machine learning model that outputs a first result f(a) and a second result f(b) in accordance with the second input data b, respectively; partially differentiating the function f with respect to the first input data a and the second input data b to obtain Jacobian matrices J a and J b , and transposing the Jacobian matrices J a and J b to obtain a transposed Jacobian matrix J a calculating a first product of the transposed Jacobian matrix Ja  T  and the result  f  (a) and a second product of the transposed Jacobian matrix Jb  T  and the result f(b); calculating a second difference  w  between the first product and the second product, where w = (elements w[1], w[2], . . . , w[n]); and determining that the larger the product of an element d[j] of the first difference d and an element w[j] of the second difference w, where j is a positive integer less than or equal to n, the greater the contribution to the similarity between the first result f(a) and the second result f(b).

title: Training Data Augmentation via Program Simplification
description: Techniques are provided that relate to expanding one or more training datasets to train one or more AI models. For example, one or more embodiments described herein may have a system that may include a memory that may store computer-executable components. The system may also include a processor operatively coupled to the memory and capable of executing the computer-executable components stored in the memory. The computer-executable components may include a training expansion component that may generate an expanded training dataset for training an artificial intelligence model by extracting abbreviated source code samples from source code samples included in the training dataset.

title: Sample labeling method, device and computer storage medium
description: The present application provides a sample labeling method, device and computer storage medium, including: extracting a sub-model using a feature of a sample screening model, obtaining sample features of an unlabeled sample, using a loss prediction sub-model of the sample screening model, The sample feature performs loss prediction, obtains the predicted loss value of the unlabeled sample, and performs sample labeling for the unlabeled sample that meets the preset condition according to the preset condition and the predicted loss value of the unlabeled sample. In this way, samples with a larger gain effect on model training can be screened out for labeling, so as to improve sample labeling efficiency and reduce sample labeling costs.

title: A product launch method based on privacy protection and related equipment
description: The embodiments of the present application belong to the fields of privacy computing and artificial intelligence, and relate to a privacy protection-based product delivery method and related equipment. A product launch method based on privacy protection, the method includes: intersecting privacy sets, determining overlapping users, users with missing tags and a target prediction model according to a first data cube and a second data cube; using the target prediction model to predict the user tags of users with missing tags ; Extract a preset number of users from the users with missing tags, and deliver the target product to the users; get the delivery results, and calculate the user conversion rate of the users based on the delivery results; when the user conversion rate is greater than the preset threshold, get the overlap The initial user among the users; obtain the user portrait corresponding to the initial user in the first data party, and determine the same user as the user portrait as the target user; deliver the target product to the target user. The method can improve the user conversion rate of target users.

title: Processing method of fluxgate aeromagnetic data based on machine learning
description: The invention relates to a method for processing fluxgate aeromagnetic data based on machine learning, which comprises the following process steps: the method has the advantages that the method utilizes the technical advantages of machine learning and the accuracy of optical pump data, can establish and train the model and predict the fluxgate data, thereby reducing steering errors, improving data quality, achieving the effect of aeromagnetic surveying and the like, and is particularly suitable for the application of the fluxgate unmanned aerial vehicle aeromagnetic surveying and the three-component aeromagnetic surveying.

title: A dual-channel FaceNet occlusion face recognition method
description: The present invention provides a method for masking a face based on deep learning. In the first step, the key points of the face are determined through a face key point algorithm, and in the second step, the positions of the eyes, the mouth and the nose are determined through the face keys and intercepted. , the third step is to construct a dual-channel FaceNet backbone feature extraction network, and the fourth step is to train the dual-channel backbone network FaceNet network with triplet loss. Aiming at the problem that the feature information that can be used by FaceNet is greatly reduced by the large area of occlusion, the present invention builds a dual-channel FaceNet network model, which includes a global channel and a local feature channel, and strengthens the learning of local features by the network. , which improves the utilization of available features and thus improves the recognition accuracy of FaceNet in the presence of occlusions.

title: NPU for generating kernel of artificial neural network model and method thereof
description: Provided are a neural processing unit (NPU), a method for driving an artificial neural network (ANN) model, and an ANN driving device. The NPU includes a semiconductor circuit including at least one processing element (PE) configured to process operation of an artificial neural network (ANN) model; and at least one memory configurable to store a first kernel and a first kernel filter. The NPU is configured to generate a first modulation kernel based on the first kernel and the first kernel filter, and to generate a second modulation kernel based on the first kernel and a second kernel filter generated by applying a mathematical function to the first kernel filter . Power consumption and memory read times are reduced by reducing the size of data read from individual memory to the cores of the artificial neural network processor and/or by reducing the number of memory read requests.

title: Text recognition, model training method, apparatus, equipment, storage medium and program
description: The disclosure provides text recognition and model training methods, devices, equipment, storage media and programs, relates to the field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of deep learning, image processing and computer vision, and can be used in OCR scenes. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring a text image to be identified, and performing feature extraction on the text image to obtain image features corresponding to the text image; the feature dimension number of the image features in the height direction and the width direction is larger than 1, sampling features corresponding to a plurality of sampling points in the text image are determined according to the image features, and character recognition results corresponding to the text image are determined according to the sampling features corresponding to the sampling points. According to the technical scheme, the accuracy of the character recognition result can be improved for the text image containing any form character.

title: Method and device for generating digital twin of environment, electronic device and storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present invention provide a method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium for generating a digital twin of an environment. The method includes: acquiring a three-dimensional data set, a scene image and environmental monitoring data; wherein, the three-dimensional data set includes three-dimensional data of the scene and three-dimensional data of an object; performing depth inference on the scene image to obtain a depth image; performing three-dimensional modeling on the depth image to obtain a scene point cloud map; analyzing the environment point cloud map according to the scene three-dimensional data, the physical three-dimensional data and the scene point cloud map; combining the environment point cloud map and the environment monitoring data Get digital twin results. According to the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present invention, it is beneficial to perform visual monitoring processing on the state data of the environment.

title: Risk identification method, device and terminal equipment
