description: The present disclosure proposes a method and an apparatus for risk identification, wherein the method comprises: acquiring a service data set corresponding to each user in a preset time period; preprocessing the service data corresponding to each user to determine a medium vector and a behavior vector corresponding to each user; determining the edge relation among the users according to the similarity among the medium vectors and the similarity among the behavior vectors; according to the edge relation among the users, carrying out community division on the relation map to determine each community contained in the relation map; and determining whether each community is a community with risk according to the attribute information of the edge contained in each community. Therefore, based on the media vector and the behavior vector, the relationship of the edges is established among the users, and whether each community is a dangerous community is determined according to the attribute information of the edges contained in each community, so that the complexity of risk identification is simplified, and the accuracy of the risk identification is improved.

title: An update method and device
description: The present application discloses an update method and device. The method includes: using a detection model to detect first data including at least an object to be detected to obtain first feature data; The feature set stored in the storage module is matched to obtain the first matching information; wherein, the feature set includes a set of feature data of at least one detection object; the to-be-detected object and the detection object have at least one dimension. Distinguishing features; based on the first matching information, updating the feature set stored in the storage module to obtain an updated feature set.

title: A kind of sample composition analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a sample component analysis method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method includes: acquiring a focused image sequence collected based on a sample to be detected; wherein, the focused image sequence includes at least two focused images; Focusing on at least one image block corresponding to each of the image blocks, and determining the resolution corresponding to each image block based on the image block parameters corresponding to each of the image blocks respectively; Perform a fusion operation to obtain a target analysis image; perform a sample component analysis operation on the target analysis image to obtain a sample component analysis result corresponding to the sample to be detected. The embodiment of the present invention solves the problem of incomplete image information in the target image of a single focusing layer, and ensures the accuracy of the sample component analysis result.

title: A method and system of vulnerability event extraction based on BERT question answering model
description: The invention discloses a method for extracting vulnerability events based on a BERT question-answering model, which is characterized in that a vulnerability is taken as an event containing a process, dynamic event information is extracted from a vulnerability description text, a BIOFR labeling method is applied, a labeling method basis is provided for determining extraction content by using a statement structure, meanwhile, a problem template based on vulnerability event trigger word categories is established by using the characteristic that vulnerability event trigger words and vulnerability event elements have relevance, the target vulnerability event trigger words are used for guiding extraction of target vulnerability event elements, the accuracy of extraction of the target vulnerability event elements is improved, and finally, an auxiliary effect is provided for vulnerability analysis.

title: Training method, apparatus, device and computer storage medium for text classification model
description: The invention relates to a training method, device, equipment and computer storage medium for a text classification model. The training method for a text classification model includes: obtaining a text classification model; obtaining text training data; setting the probability value of the Dropout layer to 0 to obtain a first prediction Train the model, and input the text training data into the first pre-training model to obtain the first probability distribution; set the probability value of the Dropout layer to p(0<p<1) to obtain the second pre-training model, and put the text training data Input the second pre-training model to obtain the second probability distribution; use the first probability distribution and the second probability distribution to calculate the loss function of the text classification model, and use the loss function to optimize the parameters of the text classification model to obtain the trained text classification Model. The training method of the present invention can not only avoid the problem of overfitting of the text classification model, but also can reduce the inconsistency problem of the text classification model in the training stage and the verification stage.

title: Transformation method, device, electronic device and storage medium of deep learning model
description: The application discloses a conversion method and device of a deep learning model, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence such as deep learning. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: converting an original deep learning frame of a deep learning model to obtain a target deep learning frame of the deep learning model, determining a model graph structure of the deep learning model based on the target deep learning frame, determining a corresponding frequent item set from operation nodes in the model graph structure, combining part of nodes in N operation nodes to be combined into a module, generating an optimized model graph structure according to the module and the operation nodes which are not combined, and performing code conversion on the optimized model graph structure to obtain a code result. Therefore, the operation nodes in the model graph structure are subjected to modular processing, the number of the nodes in the optimized model graph structure is reduced, codes are optimized, and the readability of the converted codes is improved.

title: A method, device, device and medium for determining sensor arrangement
description: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for determining a sensor arrangement mode. The method comprises the following steps: inputting candidate arrangement mode information of a target sensor corresponding to a target transformer into a preset efficiency prediction model, and determining an efficiency prediction value corresponding to the candidate arrangement mode information according to an output result of the preset efficiency prediction model, wherein the preset efficiency prediction model is a deep neural network model; determining the value of an objective function according to the effectiveness predicted value, wherein the objective function is used for representing the comprehensive benefit index of the candidate arrangement mode information; and determining target arrangement mode information from the candidate arrangement mode information according to the comparison result of the value of the target function and a preset value range. According to the technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention, the comprehensive benefits of different arrangement modes of the sensors are predicted by means of the deep neural network model, so that the purpose of optimizing the arrangement modes of the sensors is achieved.

title: Data fluctuation early warning method and related equipment based on artificial intelligence
description: The present application proposes an artificial intelligence-based data fluctuation early warning method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium. The artificial intelligence-based data fluctuation early warning method includes: collecting data according to a preset data sampling time point as test data; The index analysis method divides the test data to obtain training data; performs interpolation on the training data to obtain a data volatility curve; decomposes the data volatility curve to obtain a comprehensive set of curves; calculates the data volatility according to a custom distance algorithm The distance between the curve and each comprehensive curve in the comprehensive curve set, and the comprehensive curve corresponding to the minimum distance is used as the early warning curve; based on the early warning curve and the preset fluctuation threshold, the data fluctuation is warned. This application can predict the volatility of the data transmitted by the data application through the test data after the statistical data application goes online, thereby improving the timeliness of the data application early warning.

title: Image defogging method based on layered multi-block convolutional neural network
description: The invention belongs to the field of computer vision image defogging, and discloses an image defogging method based on a layered multi-block convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: (1) constructing a training data set; (2) constructing a layered multi-block convolutional neural network model; (3) selecting a filling mode; (4) designing a loss function and selecting an optimizer; (5) training a model; (6) and (5) testing the model. The invention carries out defogging treatment on a fog image by using a layered multi-block convolutional neural network model with a specific structure and corresponding data processing, wherein the whole network model comprises a plurality of layers, each layer comprises a pair of encoders and decoders, adjacent layers are connected through multi-path connection (channel direction connection), and jump connection is arranged between the encoders and the decoders.

title: A target object counting method, device and electronic device based on image processing
description: The application discloses a target object counting method and device based on image processing and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of image processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the central point positions of a plurality of target objects in a current image frame and obtaining the central point positions of the plurality of target objects in a previous image frame; and if the distance difference between the center position of the target object positioned on the set layer in the current image frame and the center position of the target object positioned on the previous image frame is larger than or equal to a preset threshold value, updating the number of the target objects. The accuracy of target object identification is guaranteed through target detection, the situation that the target object is mistakenly identified in real-time counting is prevented, and the distance difference between the central position in the current image frame and the central position in the previous image frame is utilized to carry out preset threshold judgment, so that the target object needing to be counted is quickly determined, and the target object can be accurately and quickly counted.

title: An Encryption Method Based on Exponential Amplifier and Improved Zigzag Transform
description: An encryption method based on exponential amplifier and improved Zigzag transform, which relates to the field of image encryption technology, in order to solve the problems of insufficient key space and insufficient randomness in existing image encryption methods, and can not effectively resist known plaintext attacks and chosen plaintext attacks The security defect of Zigzag and Zigzag can only be applied to square matrix, which leads to the problem of low generality. In the present invention, the hash function of the plaintext is used as the initial value of the logistic chaotic system, and then the value obtained by Logistic iteration is used as the value of the exponential chaotic system. The initial value and control parameters are used to obtain the key related to the plaintext, and then the improved Zigziag transform is used to scramble and diffuse the plaintext at the bit level, and then use the key to iterate the exponential chaotic system to obtain a pseudo-random number sequence. Then use pseudo-random to XOR the scrambled and diffused images, and finally use the index order of the iterative values of the chaotic system to sort the images to get the final password map. This method has better robustness.

title: 5G base station address distribution system and method based on big data
description: The invention provides a 5G base station addressing system and method based on big data, wherein the system comprises: the system comprises an acquisition module, a processing module and a processing module, wherein the acquisition module is used for acquiring first area information of a first area needing 5G base station address arrangement; a formulating module, configured to formulate a base station arrangement strategy suitable for the first area according to the first area information based on a big data technology; and the execution module is used for scheduling a plurality of first workers to carry out corresponding base station arrangement in the first area according to the base station arrangement strategy, and completing the address arrangement of the 5G base station after the base station arrangement is completed. The 5G base station address distribution system and method based on the big data determine an appropriate arrangement strategy based on the first area information needing 5G base station address distribution and the big data technology, and carry out corresponding arrangement, so that the rationality of the arrangement strategy is improved.

title: Flow prediction method, device, storage medium and electronic device
description: The present disclosure relates to a traffic prediction method, device, storage medium, and electronic device. The method includes: acquiring a traffic distribution map under a target time period, wherein the first node and the second node in the traffic distribution map are nodes with known traffic and unknown traffic, respectively. based on the flow conservation constraint and the flow of each first node, determine the initial measurement flow of each second node; based on the flow of each first node in the above flow distribution diagram and the initial measurement flow of each second node , determine the weight of each node in the traffic distribution graph, the weight represents the traffic contribution of each node to the downstream node; based on the weight of each node, determine the target predicted traffic of each second node. The present disclosure can significantly improve the accuracy of traffic prediction.

title: Image restoration method based on multi-stage progressive codec network and transfer learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to a multi-stage progressive codec network and migration method for solving the blurring problem of moving images caused by relative motion of objects, camera shake, electronic interference, etc. during image shooting. The learned image restoration method builds and trains a multi-stage progressive encoder-decoder network model. The model is divided into three stages with the same structure, each stage includes a decoder part, an encoder part and a cross-layer attention feature Transfer mechanism, the decoder part and the encoder part contain three convolutional attention blocks, each convolutional attention block contains one convolutional layer and three attention blocks, and the decoder part contains three up-sampling convolutional layers; The image restoration process is completed using the trained multi-stage progressive encoder and decoder network model.

title: A face aging system and its establishment method based on pixel-level alignment generative adversarial network
description: The invention relates to a face aging system based on a pixel-level alignment generation confrontation network and its establishment method, which sequentially include a task module, a face image preprocessing module, a face feature extraction module, an age estimation module and a face synthesis module; The age estimation method of ordered regression ensures that the synthetic face is within the target age range, and the residual network structure is introduced into the convolutional neural network for face feature extraction to ensure the identity consistency of the face. In addition, pixel-level loss is added. To reduce errors caused by background noise and improve the quality of synthesized images, the pixel-level alignment generative adversarial network model proposed by the present invention has obvious advantages in practical applications compared with existing face aging methods.

title: Fund allocation method, device, equipment and medium for increasing the subscription quota for new shares
description: The invention discloses a fund configuration method, a device, equipment and a medium for improving the new stock purchase line.

title: A composite microwave sensor and detection method
description: The invention discloses a composite microwave sensor and a detection method, and belongs to the technical field of microwave detection. According to the method, by analyzing the deviation change conditions of the microwave resonance peak data of humidity, rainfall and cluster fog relative to the drying cavity, the interaction between every two detection variable data of the humidity, the rainfall and the cluster fog is subjected to cross joint analysis, and a back propagation neural network corresponding to the interaction is established, so that more accurate humidity and rainfall values can be obtained, and the cluster fog size can be judged more accurately. Compared with a common back propagation neural network, the model defines the interaction among humidity, rainfall and fog as a demand function in the last layer, and expresses the action relation among parameters on the parameter weight of the demand function, so that the model has multi-parameter interconnectivity, and can realize more accurate prediction on the humidity, rainfall and fog.

title: An electric vehicle charging scheduling method based on adaptive improved PSO algorithm
description: The invention discloses an electric vehicle charging scheduling method based on a self-adaptive improved PSO algorithm, which is used for improving the global optimization capability and the convergence rate of the algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: generating electric vehicle charging information based on the Monte Carlo idea; initializing particle positions and recording the average fitness value of the population; initializing inertial weight and learning factors and establishing a feedback regulation mechanism between fitness and the inertial weight; performing population search evolution, wherein optimal solutions are respectively solved at all time periods and then are summarized; and a probability acceptance formula of a simulated annealing algorithm is introduced to enlarge a search interval so as to ensure that global optimum is searched. Compared with the traditional PSO algorithm, the improved PSO is used for planning the electric vehicle charging scheduling problem under high load, the method improves the convergence rate of the algorithm, and reduces the power grid fluctuation variance and the charging delay time of users.

title: Genetic task scheduling method based on gene frequency improvement
description: The invention discloses an improved genetic task scheduling method based on gene frequency, which relates to the technical field of cloud computing and includes the following steps: numbering H computing nodes and M tasks to be scheduled in a cloud computing platform; randomly initializing a population, calculating The fitness of each chromosome in the population; initialize the local optimal chromosome and local optimal fitness of each chromosome; initialize the global optimal chromosome and global optimal fitness; initialize each gene value of each gene in the local optimal chromosome and the global optimal fitness. The frequency of occurrence of optimal chromosomes; perform crossover operation on the population, and update the above initialization content; according to the frequency of occurrence of each gene value of each gene in the local optimal chromosome and the global optimal chromosome, perform non-equivalent uniform mutation operation on each chromosome ; According to the gene value of each gene of the global optimal chromosome, the corresponding task is scheduled to the corresponding computing node. The invention improves the application effect of the genetic algorithm on the task scheduling problem.

title: Data processing method, data processing device, storage medium and computer terminal
description: The invention discloses a data processing method, device, storage medium and computer terminal. Wherein, the method includes: acquiring target behavior data of a target object within a preset time period, wherein the target behavior data is data generated by the target object performing the target behavior; determining a target field corresponding to the target behavior data, wherein the target field uses representing at least one data type corresponding to the target behavior data; determining multiple feature dimensions corresponding to the target field, wherein the multiple feature dimensions are used to indicate that the target field is classified in different dimensions; according to the preset time period and multiple features The dimension convolves the target behavior data to obtain target feature data, wherein the target feature data is used to monitor the target behavior. The invention solves the technical problem of low feature extraction accuracy in the related art.

title: Prediction method, program, prediction system, server, and display device
description: The prediction method includes an acquisition step (ST 1), a prediction step (ST 2), a determination step (ST 4), and a processing step (ST 5). In the acquisition step (ST 1), parameters of the drying operation are acquired. In the prediction step (ST 2), the drying time required for the drying operation is predicted by the first prediction method 1 based on the acquired parameters. In the determination step (ST 4), when the resumption of the drying operation is detected during the stop of the drying operation, it is determined whether or not the 1 ST prediction method performed in the prediction step (ST 2) can be applied. In the processing step (ST 5), when it is determined that the 1 ST prediction method can be applied, the 1 ST prediction method is continued, and when it is determined that the 1 ST prediction method cannot be applied, predetermined processing is executed.

title: A kind of transformer life prediction method and device
description: The invention discloses a life prediction method and a life prediction device for a transformer, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an evaluation index to be tested and the running time of the transformer to be tested according to a pre-constructed technical life evaluation index system; determining the membership degree of all evaluation indexes in a technical life evaluation index system; determining index weights of all evaluation indexes in a technical life evaluation index system by using a fuzzy analytic hierarchy process; and determining the technical life of the transformer to be tested based on the membership grade, the index weight and the running time. The fuzzy analytic hierarchy process is applied to the technical life prediction of the power transformer, and the overall health degree of the transformer to be tested is analyzed on the basis of a pre-established technical life evaluation index system, so that the technical life of the transformer to be tested is accurately predicted, and support is provided for the whole life cycle maintenance and management of transformer equipment.

title: A defect detection method, device, detection device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a defect detection method, a defect detection device and a storage medium. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a video to be detected on the inner wall inside the oil-immersed transformer; determining an inner wall image to be detected based on the inner wall video to be detected; and identifying the target defects in the inner wall image to be detected according to a defect detection model trained in advance, wherein the defect detection model is generated on the basis of defect sample set training with defect marks. The embodiment of the invention realizes the detection of the defect in the oil of the oil-immersed transformer, can reduce the detection time, can reduce the economic cost of the detection of the oil-immersed transformer, avoids the detection personnel from entering the oil-immersed transformer and ensures the personal safety of the defect detection personnel.

title: A Deep Learning-Based Interference Recognition Method
description: The invention discloses an interference identification method based on deep learning. The main principles of this method are: 1) A local attention fusion layer is used to divide several input segmentation information blocks with the same number into different regions, and the global features in each region are independently calculated in each region. The number of information blocks in the middle is much smaller than the number of all the information blocks. At this time, the calculation amount of independently calculating the global features in all regions is much smaller than that of multi-head self-attention to calculate all the input information blocks at the same time. 2) The block aggregation module is introduced, It alternates with the local attention fusion layer, this module can convert several input information blocks into one information block and aggregate the information of these information blocks, so that with the increase of the number of layers, the output information fragments gradually decrease, the present invention The mid-block aggregation module adopts lightweight depthwise convolution, which enriches the global features and introduces the network's attention to local features, thereby improving the recognition performance.

title: Automatic photographing control method and system suitable for Polaroid and Polaroid
description: The invention discloses an automatic photographing control method suitable for a camera, comprising: S1. A gesture detection model based on YOLO performs gesture detection on the first N frame images of a video stream obtained by a camera, to obtain a hand area; N≥3; S2, use Kalman filter to model the target motion state of the hand region, track and predict its position in the next frame in real time, and obtain the gesture of the object to be recognized; S3, compare the gesture of the object to be recognized with the preset gesture The reference gestures in the template library are compared to calculate the similarity; when the calculated similarity is greater than the set threshold, the gesture of the object to be recognized is determined as a photo-triggering gesture, and the photo-taking countdown is started; otherwise, return to step S1; S4 . When the photo-taking countdown ends, control the camera to take a photo to obtain an original image; S5, use the constructed generative adversarial network to perform face beautification processing on the original image to obtain a processed target image and output.

title: Programming assistant program, programming assistant device and programming assistant method
description: The programming auxiliary program makes the electronic computer (100) perform the following steps: the first conversion step, the first program described by the ladder diagram language is converted into the second program described by the intermediate language; the second conversion step, the second program is converted into A third program described in a procedural language; a step of generating a circuit display part, if the analysis result of one block of the second program satisfies a predetermined condition, then generating a circuit display part indicating the content of the block satisfying the condition; and a display step , the third program and the circuit display part are displayed in such a manner that it can be identified which block of the third program the circuit display part corresponds to.

title: A method for identifying soft flutter aerodynamic equations
description: The invention provides a method for identifying a soft flutter aerodynamic equation. Firstly, preparing a data set used by an identification equation, obtaining soft flutter displacement response data in a wind tunnel based on a segment model experiment, processing a data low-pass filter, and obtaining speed and acceleration data after numerical difference; sending the data into a sparse dictionary in a certain overlapping rate form for equation recognition, wherein a target function is regression with zero norm, and the zero norm regression is easy to cause N-P difficulty, so that optimization is carried out by using an equivalent ridge regression method, namely sequential threshold ridge regression; carrying out response prediction of only specified initial values on the finally obtained equation and comparing the predicted response prediction with a real signal to verify the accuracy of the algorithm; it is noted that the dictionary identification method with time overlap is very effective for identifying the soft flutter aerodynamic equation with weak non-linear characteristics, compared to the method without time data overlap.

title: A multi-sensor fusion obstacle tracking method, device, equipment and medium
description: The embodiment of this specification discloses a multi-sensor fusion obstacle tracking method, device, equipment, and medium. The method includes: acquiring radar sensing data and image sensing data of an outdoor robot, and determining the three-dimensional image of the current scene based on the radar sensing data. Obstacle data, and determine the two-dimensional obstacle data of the current scene based on the image sensing data; perform fusion judgment on the two-dimensional obstacle data and the three-dimensional obstacle data, and obtain the lidar obstacle list and the unfused camera obstacle list ;Input the lidar obstacle list into the tracking node of the outdoor robot to obtain the first obstacle tracking list; deduplicate the obstacle list detected by multiple cameras and the camera obstacle list to obtain the camera target obstacle list, and The camera target obstacle list is tracked and detected to obtain the second obstacle tracking list; the first obstacle tracking list is merged with the second obstacle tracking list to obtain the outdoor robot tracking list.

title: Remaining capacity estimating device, model generating device, remaining capacity estimating method, model generating method, and program
description: A remaining capacity estimation device (20) is provided with a storage processing unit (210) and a calculation unit (240). A storage processing unit (210) acquires a model from a model generation device (10) and stores the model in a model storage unit (220). When data for updating a model is acquired from a model generation device (10), a storage processing unit (210) updates the model stored in a model storage unit (220). A calculation unit (240) calculates the remaining capacity of a battery (30) managed by a remaining capacity estimation device (20) using the model stored by the model storage unit (220). At this time, the data (measurement data for calculation) input to the model includes the current, voltage, and temperature of the battery 30. When the input data for generating the model is only the current, the voltage, and the temperature, the measurement data for calculation is only the current, the voltage, and the temperature.

title: A segmentation method, device and storage medium based on hybrid structure
description: The invention discloses a segmentation method, a device and a storage medium based on a mixed structure, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting an image to be segmented into a backbone network model based on CNN or Transformer to obtain the multi-scale characteristics of the image to be segmented; further aligning the multi-scale features using a variability encoder; dividing the aligned multi-scale features into two parts, inputting one part into a pixel decoder to obtain a feature map, and inputting the other part into a hybrid decoder to generate spatial hybrid features; and performing convolution operation on the feature representation and the feature map generated by the pixel decoder to obtain a corresponding segmentation mask. The method has the characteristics of good segmentation effect and quick convergence.

title: Wind turbine peak and valley automatic control system and its control method
description: The application relates to the field of intelligent regulation and control of a fan, and particularly discloses an automatic regulation and control system and a regulation and control method for peak-valley power generation amount of the fan. In the process, by grouping the features along the row direction and applying a penalty to the overlapping of elements in the group, the parsimonious decomposition of the high-dimensional manifold of the feature matrix can be promoted by calculating the distance-type union of the symbolization function, so that the dimensional monotonicity of the high-dimensional manifold is improved. Therefore, the rotating speed value of the fan at the current time point can be adjusted based on the global state of the power grid load, the utilization efficiency of wind power is improved, and grid connection fluctuation can be reduced.

title: Scheme generating method, equipment upgrading method and related devices, equipment and media
description: The application discloses a scheme generation method, an equipment upgrading method, a related device, equipment and a medium, wherein the scheme generation method comprises the following steps: analyzing with a multiplexing compiling library respectively based on the analysis results of the target scheme elements to obtain an analysis result representing whether the target scheme elements can be multiplexed and compiled respectively; the multiplexing compilation library at least comprises compilation products of a plurality of candidate scheme elements; for a plurality of target scheme elements, respectively executing compiling operation or executing multiplexing compiling by combining a multiplexing compiling library based on the analysis result to obtain a compiling product of the target scheme elements; and performing integrated packaging on at least a compilation product based on a plurality of target scheme elements to obtain an algorithm solution package. According to the scheme, the compiling operation can be reduced as much as possible, particularly under the condition that the number of algorithm modules is large, the compiling operation can be further reduced, the compiling speed is increased, and the delivery speed and the delivery efficiency of the algorithm scheme can be further increased.

title: A Method and Device for Recognition of Robust Teaching Knowledge Points Based on Adversarial Learning
description: The invention relates to a robust teaching knowledge point recognition method and device based on adversarial learning. The present invention improves three aspects: 1) data production: by processing and summarizing the electronic teaching material data of the computer network, a set of knowledge point recognition data sets of computer network subjects are constructed as the input of the model; 2) the model Improvement: On the basis of the combined model of ALBERT and TextCNN, the model structure was changed, and the information of the entity in the input sentence was combined in the output of the hidden layer of ALBERT, which improved the ability of the model to capture entity information; 3) method improvement: the model The training process has been improved, adding confrontation training, which effectively improves the generalization ability and robustness of the model. The invention applies the combined model of ALBERT and TextCNN to the knowledge point recognition task, and improves the model structure and training method, so that the automatic recognition of teaching knowledge points can be effectively carried out.

title: Temperature distribution learning device
description: There is a problem that if there is no air conditioner in the target space, the information on the air outlet of the air conditioner cannot be obtained, and the temperature distribution of the target space cannot be learned. A temperature distribution learning device (100) learns a temperature distribution (TD, TM) including the temperature of at least a first point in the air in an object space (80). A temperature distribution learning device (100) includes a learning model (LM). A learning model (LM) learns by associating a temperature distribution (TD, TM) as a target variable with a thermal image (HI) associated with the object space (80) as an explanatory variable. The learning model (LM) learns based on taught data containing temperature distributions (TD, TM) and thermal images (HI).

title: Potential space method for generating food formula
description: Techniques for simulating a target food item using artificial intelligence are disclosed. The recipe generator learns from public sources and proprietary databases of ingredients and recipes. The recipe generator is trained using the characteristics of the ingredients and using recipes. In the case of a given target food item, the recipe generator determines a recipe that matches the given target food item and a score for the recipe. The recipe generator may generate a plurality of recipes that match a given target food item, and an optimal recipe may be selected from the generated recipes based on the scores.

title: audiovisual content distribution system
description: Elementary module of a processing chain of an audiovisual content distribution system, each content being received by a terminal in the form of a succession of segments, each segment being distributed to said terminal following transmission of a request by said terminal and being obtained by applying a processing chain to a portion of content. The elementary module performs processing of a predefined type and comprises: a variable plurality of processing units available to perform said processing; a scaling module, capable of determining, using a first model, a number of processing units to be allocated for an implementation of a set of processing requested from said elementary module; and, a load management module capable of choosing, using a second model, for each processing requested, at least one processing unit from among the processing units allocated by the scaling module to perform said processing, each model being a deep learning neural network. Fig. 3

title: Method for learning synaptic weight values of a neural network, data processing method, computer program, computer and associated processing system
description: Method for learning synaptic weight values of a neural network, data processing method, computer program, calculator and associated processing system The invention relates to a method for learning synaptic weight values of at least one layer of an artificial neural network. The method is implemented by computer and comprises learning weight values from learning data, each weight value from said learning being a quantized weight value belonging to a set (EQA; EQS) of quantized values. The set of quantized values consists of values encoded with a predefined number B of bits, and with a quantization step P between two successive quantized values verifying: where represents the integer part function; the quantified values further being included in a predefined interval chosen from the interval [-1-P; 1] and the interval [-1; 1]. Figure for the abstract: Figure 3.

title: Adjustment program, adjustment method, and information processing device
description: An information processing device according to the present invention compares first pattern information in which a condition section, that is one attribute value or a combination of a plurality of attribute values, has been associated with a label corresponding to the condition section, and second pattern information that differs from the first pattern information. In addition, if there is a discrepancy in either the condition section or the label, the information processing device adjusts the level of importance of the first pattern information on the basis of the degree of conformity or degree of discrepancy between the first pattern information and the second pattern information.

title: User feedback system and method
description: A user feedback system for a user of a delivery device within a delivery ecosystem comprises a first device other than the delivery device and comprising a sensor platform with at least a first sensor operable to detect at least a first physical property associated with the user; the first device comprising a processor adapted to submit data of the detected at least first physical property to an obtaining processor adapted to output data based upon the or each detected physical property as all or part of a user factor indicative of a user state; and an estimation processor adapted to identify a corresponding feedback action expected to alter a state of the user as indicated at least in part by the or each detected physical property.

title: Training data creating method, machine learning method, expendable item management device, and computer-readable medium
description: An aspect of the present disclosure relates to a training data creating method for creating training data for use in machine learning of a learning model for predicting the lifetime of an expendable item of a laser device, the method comprising: acquiring first lifetime-related information including data of at least one lifetime-related parameter of an expendable item, the at least one lifetime-related parameter being recorded corresponding to different numbers of oscillation pulses in a period between the start of use of the expendable item and replacement thereof; defining a first deterioration degree of the expendable item on the basis of a number of oscillation pulses; defining a second deterioration degree of the expendable item on the basis of the at least one lifetime-related parameter; defining a third deterioration degree of the expendable item on the basis of the first deterioration degree and the second deterioration degree; and creating training data in which the first lifetime-related information and the third deterioration degree are associated with each other.

title: Methods, systems and computer programs for processing image data and for generating a filter
description: Various aspects of the present disclosure relate to a method, system and computer program for processing image data, to a vehicle comprising such a system, and to a method, system and computer program for generating a filter. The method for processing image data comprises obtaining (110) the image data. The method comprises applying (120) a filter on the image data to generate filtered image data, the filter being configured to suppress adversarial perturbations within the image data. The method comprises processing (130) the filtered image data using a machine-learning model.

title: Deep learning bitstream encoder and decoder, and method therefor
description: The present invention relates to a deep learning accelerator. The deep learning accelerator according to the present invention has an effect of, when encoding/decoding deep learning network model data, performing encoding/decoding only as much as necessary in a specific unit such as a layer rather than the entire data, thereby saving power consumed while storing or loading the entire data in or from an external memory. Also, because a deep learning network model can be included in an additional information area of a multimedia bitstream and transmitted together with the multimedia bitstream, management of the deep learning model data is easy. In addition, as the deep learning network model can be applied in units of frames, scenes, and pictures, deep learning performance can also be improved, and accurate application of the deep learning network model is possible.

title: Artificial intelligence engine for generating candidate drugs using experimental validation and peptide drug optimization
description: In one aspect, a method for pre-clinical validation of an effectiveness of a candidate drug compound is disclosed. The method may include receiving, at a processing device, a signal that comprises at least two wavelengths that are each associated with a respective biomarker, wherein the signal is received subsequent to administering the candidate drug compound to a proxy organism, such organism including at least two assays configured to reveal the respective biomarkers. The method also may include analyzing the signal to obtain the at least two wavelengths, and detecting, based on an analysis of the at least two wavelengths, whether each of the respective biomarkers are present.

title: Pooled memory controller for thin-provisioning disaggregated memory
description: A thin-provisioned multi-node computer system comprising a disaggregated memory pool and a pooled memory controller. The disaggregated memory pool is configured to make a shared memory capacity available to each of a plurality of compute nodes. The pooled memory controller is configured to assign, to each compute node of the plurality of compute nodes, a portion of the disaggregated memory pool such that a currently assigned total of assigned portions of the disaggregated memory pool is less than the shared memory capacity. The pooled memory controller is further configured to receive a request to assign an additional portion of the disaggregated memory pool such that the currently assigned total and the additional portion would exceed a predefined threshold amount of the shared memory capacity, to un-assign an assigned portion of the disaggregated memory pool, and assign the additional portion of the disaggregated memory pool.

title: Electricity distribution network fault detection system and method
description: An electricity distribution network fault detector 122 is provided. The fault detector may comprise a signal processor 124 configured to perform signal processing on magnetic field data, the magnetic field data representing at least one magnetic field generated by at least one electricity distribution line 112; a data selector 126 configured to receive transformed magnetic field data from the signal processor 124 and to select a time window of the received data; and a classifier 128 configured to receive at least one time window from the data selector 126 and to apply a classification to the at least one time window, the classification selected from a group of classifications.

title: Vision testing via prediction-based setting of initial stimuli characteristics for user interface locations
description: Methods and systems for dynamically determining stimuli characteristics for vision defect determination during a vision test. The methods and systems convert the feedback received from the binary suprathreshold test into a feature input that is provided to a prediction model. The prediction model may be trained to predict non-binary characteristics for sets of locations and confidence scores associated with the sets of locations based on feedback indicating binary characteristics under which users see one or more stimuli presented on user interfaces.

title: Dynamic model scope selection for connected vehicles
description: A computing device (1602, 1600) in a network receives (810), into a machine learning model, a value for a prediction horizon, Tw, that defines a future time interval for generating predicted data corresponding to an element in a model region. Machine learning training data is received (820) that includes data corresponding to previous element activity in the model region, which comprises at least one model cluster, and wherein each of the at least one model cluster comprises a plurality of adjacent model cells. Using the machine learning model, model cell parameters are generated (830) defining a cell size and a cell geometry. Using the machine learning model, model cluster parameters are generated (840) that comprise a cluster geometry, a cluster centroid value identifying a center of the model cluster and a cluster radius value defining a quantity of model cells from the cluster centroid value to an edge of the model cluster.

title: End-to-end neural word alignment process of suggesting formatting in machine translations
description: In an embodiment, the disclosure provides a programmed computer system implemented via client-server Software as a Service (SaaS) techniques that allows for machine translation of digital content. When translating digital content, linguists must translate more than just the text on the page. Formatting, for example, is a commonly used and important aspect of online content that is typically managed with tags, such as ≺ b ≻ for bold and ≺i≻ for italics. When linguists work, they must ensure these tags are placed accurately as part of the translation. Projecting tags accurately depends on successfully accomplishing the challenging task of word alignment. Unfortunately, if word alignment is inaccurate, it makes placing formatting tags very difficult. In an embodiment, the present disclosure provides a method of not only translating text, but also efficiently and accurately projecting tags from input text in one language to output text in another language.

title: Methods and apparatuses for generating peptides by synthesizing a portion of a design space to identify peptides
description: In one aspect, a computer-implemented automated flow synthesis platform configured to use an artificial intelligence (AI) engine is disclosed and includes a reaction chamber configured to synthesize a sequence, detectors configured to monitor the synthesis of the sequence in the reaction chamber, wherein the synthesis uses an automated flow process, and a computing device communicatively coupled to the detectors. The computing device receives measurements from the one or more detectors, wherein the measurements comprise a spectral profile at each coupling of each amino acid in the sequence, trains, using training data comprising the measurements, machine learning models to determine a synthesizing recipe that enables the sequence to be synthesized, wherein the synthesizing recipe comprises parameters used during the automated flow process to synthesize the sequence, and controls, using the synthesizing recipe, the synthesis of the sequence in the reaction chamber.

title: Gesture classification and recognition method and application thereof
description: A gesture classification and recognition method, relating to the technical field of data classification. The method comprises: obtaining a surface electromyography (sEMG) signal; performing feature extraction on the sEMG signal to obtain a gesture feature sequence and a gesture type; and inputting the gesture feature sequence and the gesture type into a recurrent gate circuit neural network for training to obtain a classification model, and using the classification model to implement gesture classification and recognition. By means of the method, the problems that existing sEMG signal-based gesture classification and recognition algorithms are low in recognition accuracy and have overfitting and underfitting, vanishing gradient, poor robustness, and long training time during model training processes are solved, and the accuracy of predictive classification is improved.

title: Content-adaptive online training for dnn-based cross component prediction with scaling factors
description: A method and apparatus for neural network based cross component prediction with scaling factors during encoding or decoding of an image frame or a video sequence, which may include training a deep neural network (DNN) cross component prediction (CCP) model with at least one or more scaling factors, wherein the at least one or more scaling factors are learned by optimizing a rate-distortion loss based on an input video sequence comprising a luma component, and reconstructing a chroma component based on the luma component using the trained DNN CCP model with the at least one or more scaling factors for chroma prediction. The trained DNN CCP may be updated for chroma prediction of the input video sequence using the one or more scaling factors, and performing chroma prediction of the input video sequence using the updated DNN CCP model with the one or more scaling factors.

title: Method, device, and recording medium for encoding/decoding image
description: Disclosed are a method, a device, and a recording medium for encoding/decoding an image. Prediction information for a target block is determined, and prediction of the target block is performed using the prediction information. Multiple bi-prediction methods can be used for the prediction, and the bi-prediction methods include neural network-based bi-prediction. A plurality of intermediate prediction blocks are used as inputs for neural network-based bi-prediction, and a final prediction block is outputted by neural network-based bi-prediction. Such neural network-based bi-prediction is performed on the basis of attributes and coding parameters, etc. of the target block.

title: Device for detecting driver behavior using deep learning-based object classification
description: The present invention relates to an apparatus for detecting driver behavior using deep learning-based object classification. The apparatus for detecting driver behavior using deep learning-based object classification according to the present invention comprises: a frame input unit for receiving image frames as input; a downsampling unit for downsampling the resolution of each of the previous frame and the current frame among the image frames; an active image generation unit for generating an active image using the contrast value for each color of the downsampled previous frame and current frame; an active region extraction unit for extracting an active region where the window value is the largest, by using a sliding window algorithm on the generated active image; and a behavior detection unit for classifying and detecting driver behavior for the extracted active region by using an object classification algorithm. According to the present invention, dangerous behavior such as smoking, using a mobile phone, eating food, etc. while driving are detected to warn the driver, thus having the effect of promoting safe driving and preventing the risk of an accident.

title: Artificial intelligence-driven classification workflow for diagnosis of sucker rod pump operating conditions
description: Methods and systems are provided for monitoring the operation of a sucker rod pump (SRP), which involves a workflow that processes surface operational data and downhole operational data related to the operation of the SRP. The surface operational data is derived from real-time measurements performed by surface-located sensors, while the downhole operational data is derived from real-time measurements performed by downhole sensors. The surface operational data is processed to generate input data for supply to a first machine learning model (e.g., Surface Data Classifier) and the downhole operational data is processed to generate input data for supply to a second machine learning model (e.g., Downhole Data Classifier). The output of at least one of the first and second machine learning models is used to characterize an operational condition or status of the SRP.

title: System and method for optimizing fault detection in internet of things network
description: Disclosed is a method for optimizing fault detection in an Internet of Things (IoT) network (204). The method comprises determining a fault activity associated with an IoT device in IoT network (204); identifying a location information of IoT device (202); determining whether fault activity is associated with a mobile network corresponding to the location information; performing one of an automation activity of generating a service ticket for fault correction of mobile network, when fault activity is associated with mobile network, or generating a field service ticket for fault correction of the IoT device (202), when fault activity is not associated with mobile network. Disclosed also is a system for optimizing fault detection in an IoT network, system comprising a processor configured to perform the steps of the aforementioned method.

title: Text difficulty classification method and device based on classification model, and storage medium
description: A text difficulty classification method and device based on a classification model, and a storage medium. The method comprises: classifying a first text set to be trained and a second text set to be trained according to text difficulty, so as to obtain a fine first training set and a coarse second training set; inputting the first training set and the second training set into an initial classification model to obtain a predicted text difficulty value; setting an adaptive loss value for different training sets according to the predicted text difficulty value; adjusting the parameters of the initial classification model according to the loss value to obtain a target classification model; and inputting the text to be classified into the target classification model for classification, so as to obtain a text difficulty classification result. The data characteristics of the first data set and the second data set can be fully utilized, and the implicit information of the data is fully mined, so that the target classification model can complete a text difficulty classification task more accurately, and improve the accuracy of the text difficulty classification result.

title: Computationally efficient machine learning
description: The computer-implemented method for computationally efficient machine learning comprises a) generating, by the server computing device, a set of initial model parameters; b) generating, by the server computing device, a set of partitioning parameters including at least the parameters Number of partitions and Minimum number of data points in the partitions; c) communicating, by the server computing device, the set of initial model parameters and the partitioning parameters to each client computing device; d) obtaining, by each client computing device, global values corresponding to the set of initial parameters from the server computing device; e) selecting, by the server computing device, a client computing device based on a global sequence of all client computing devices; f) communicating, by the server computing device, machine learning-based model parameters to the selected client computing device; g) obtaining, by the selected client computing device, global values corresponding to the machine learning-based model parameters; h) incrementally training, by the selected client computing device, the machine- learned model based, at least in part, on a partition of the local dataset to obtain updated machine learning-based model parameters, said partition being selected from the local dataset according to a predefined scheme; i) communicating, by the selected client computing device, the updated machine learning-based model parameters to the server computing device; j) repeating steps d)-i) until all predefined conditions are satisfied.

title: Quantum extremal learning
description: Methods and systems are disclosed for determining a solution for an optimisation problem using a hybrid computer system, the hybrid computer system comprising a quantum computer system and a classical computer system, the method comprising: receiving or determining, by the classical computer system, a description of the optimisation problem, the description comprising a set of training data or enabling the classical computer system to determine the set of training data, the set of training data comprising input variables in an input space and associated observables; receiving or determining, by the classical computer system, one or more quantum circuits, the one or more quantum circuits defining gate operations to be executed by the quantum computer system, the one or more quantum circuits comprising a quantum feature map for encoding a value in the input space to a Hilbert space associated with the quantum computer system and a first parametric quantum circuit parametrised by a set of first parameters; determining, by the classical computer system, an optimised first parametric quantum circuit, the determination comprising execution, by the quantum computer system, of the gate operations defined by the one or more quantum circuits, acquisition of measurement data associated with an output state of the quantum computer system, and variation of at least one of the set of first parameters based on the measurement data and the set of training data; determining, using the quantum computer system, an optimised input value in the input space, the determination comprising execution, by the quantum computer system, of gate operations defined by the optimised first parametric quantum circuit or a derivative thereof and acquisition of measurement data associated with an output state of the quantum computer system; and determining, by the classical computer system, the solution to the optimisation problem based on the optimised input value and/or an output value corresponding to that optimised input value.

title: Systems and methods of phenotype classification using shotgun analysis of nanopore signals
description: A computer-implemented method of phenotype classification is provided. A computing system receives a plurality of segmented events generated by a plurality of nanopores in response to a sample being applied to the plurality of nanopores, wherein each segmented event of the plurality of segmented events represents ionic current changes during a protein interaction with a nanopore of the plurality of nanopores. The computing system processes the plurality of segmented events to create at least one set of model input data. The computing system provides the at least one set of model input data as input to at least one classifier model to generate a classification of the sample. The computing system transmits the classification for presentation on a display device.

title: Methods, systems and computer programs for processing and adapting image data from different domains
description: The present application discloses a method, a system and computer program for processing image data and adapting them to different domains. In particular, the method of the present application allows an online domain adaptation between source domain and target domain. After the adaptation the image data can be used as training set for a machine learning algorithm or as input images for an already trained machine learning system.

title: Data processing method and related apparatus
description: A data processing method, which can be applied to the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises: predicting, according to a first training sample, first operation information of a user for an item by means of a first recommendation model, wherein the first operation information and second operation information are used for determining a first loss, the second operation information comprises information obtained according to an operation log of the user, and the first loss is used for updating the first recommendation model; and predicting, according to a second training sample, third operation information and fourth operation information of the user for the item by means of a second recommendation model and the updated first recommendation model, respectively, wherein the third operation information and the fourth operation information are used for determining a second loss, and the first recommendation model and the second recommendation model are sorting models in different stages of a multi-stage cascade recommendation system. In the present application, a joint training mode is used, such that a model in each stage focuses on the fitting of data of the respective stage thereof, and upstream and downstream stages are also used to assist with training, thereby improving the prediction effect.

title: Low-latency captioning system
description: An artificial intelligence (Al) low-latency processing system is provided. The low-latency processing system includes a processor; and a memory having instructions stored thereon. The low-latency processing system is configured to collect a sequence of frames jointly including information dispersed among at least some frames in the sequence of frames, execute a timing neural network trained to identify an early subsequence of frames in the sequence of frames including at least a portion of the information indicative of the information, and execute a decoding neural network trained to decode the information from the portion of the information in the subsequence of frames, wherein the timing neural network is jointly trained with the decoding neural network to iteratively identify the smallest number of subframes from the beginning of a training sequence of frames containing a portion of training information sufficient to decode the training information.

title: Convolution and transformer-based image segmentation
description: Techniques are provided for image processing. For instance, a process can include obtaining an image; extracting a first set of features at a first scale resolution; extracting a second set of features at a second scale resolution (lower than the first scale resolution); performing a self-attention transform to generate similarity scores for the second set of features; adding the similarity scores to the second set of features to generate a first feature extractor output; up-sampling the first feature extractor output to generate a second feature extractor output; adding the second feature extractor output to the first set of features to generate a third feature extractor output; receiving an instance query; performing a cross-attention transform on the instance query and the first feature extractor output to generate a set of weights; and matrix multiplying the set of weights and the third feature extractor output to generate instance masks.

title: Skeleton sequence recognition method based on masked image autoencoders and system
description: Disclosed in the present invention are a skeleton sequence recognition method based on masked image autoencoders and a system. The method comprises the following steps: building a skeleton action recognition model, and using the skeleton action recognition model to recognize a skeleton sequence so as to predict the class of an action, the skeleton action recognition model comprising an M-layer spatial-temporal representation learning model and a one-layer classifier, the spatial-temporal representation learning model comprising two masked image autoencoders connected in parallel, and, by means of 1×1 convolution, output ends of the masked image autoencoders being subjected to residual connection with input ends thereof. The present invention uses the M-layer spatial-temporal representation learning model and the one-layer classifier to build the skeleton action recognition model, which uses a fine-grained dependency relationship between different skeleton joints for training and learning, is a highly-efficient skeleton sequence learning model, and is well generalized on different data sets.

title: Linear fluidic cell trap device for single cell detection
description: A sensing structure (101) is provided and includes a tubular element (110) through which a fluid is flowable along a single path, an array of sensors (120 1-5) disposed along a length of the tubular element whereby the fluid is flowable through each of the sensors and sensing circuitry electrically connected with each of the sensors and configured to measure a reactance of each of the sensors and to determine whether any reactance is indicative of a presence of a biological cell in the fluid flowing through the corresponding sensors.

title: Text clustering performance evaluation
description: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques generating one or more cluster performance evaluation metrics that allow for evaluation of the performance of an unsupervised natural language processing clustering algorithms to be used with unlabeled data. At least one embodiment pertains to methods of generating one or more cluster performance evaluation metrics based, at least in part, on one or more vectors generated by one or more neural networks to indicate a relationship among members of one or more clusters of data generated using the one or more data clustering algorithms, according to various novel techniques described herein.

title: System and method for analysing success of clinical trials, interpreting risk factors and for managing pharmaceutical portfolio using artificial intelligence
description: Methods, systems, and platform are provided for analyzing the success of clinical trials, interpreting risk factors and for strategic pharmaceutical portfolio management. The methods, systems, and platform enable exploitation of an aggregated, multimodal, structured and relational database, methodically built from a variety of heterogeneous, structured and 5 unstructured external data sources. This unique database comprehensively captures meticulously risk factors affecting the clinical drug development process while it reconstructs the historical drug clinical trials pipeline of a drug, facilitating the tracking of its clinical development. This unique database is the cornerstone for the development of an explainable machine learning systems to support complex decision-making processes for end users such as 0 large pharmaceutical companies, biotech companies, clinical research organizations, life science investment funds, investment banks, hedge funds and consulting firms.

title: Systems and methods for using artificial intelligence for liquidity optimization of electronic transactions
description: A method for liquidity optimization may include capturing a plurality of historical transaction data of a client account. The method may further include extracting a plurality of item level features from the plurality of historical transaction data. The method may further include providing the plurality of item level features to a generative machine-learning model. The generative machine-learning model may be trained to identify patterns within the plurality of item level features and generate a set of liquidity rules for the client account based on the identified patterns. The method may further include transmitting, to a user interface, the set of liquidity rules.

title: Fish intelligent recognition method and sorting system
description: A fish intelligent recognition method and a sorting system. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting a fish image data set; step 2, preprocessing the collected data set, comprising data normalization and data augmentation; step 3, building a ConvNeXt neural network; step 4, training a model; step 5, obtaining a fish image to be predicted; and step 6, inputting the image into the neural network to obtain a classification result, and outputting and displaying the classification result. The method achieves efficient fish feature recognition and recognition result display, thereby greatly reducing the recognition work of fishery workers, reducing the work intensity, and improving the work efficiency.

title: In context learning for molecular inverse design
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for molecular inverse design. In one aspect, a method comprises: generating a model input to a generative machine learning model, wherein the model input includes data defining: a set of molecule exemplars, wherein each molecule exemplar corresponds to a respective example molecule and includes: (i) a chemical structure of the example molecule, and (ii) a respective molecule property value of the example molecule for each molecule property in a set of molecule properties; and a set of molecule design parameters that specify desired characteristics of output molecules to be generated by the generative machine learning model; and processing the model input using the generative machine learning model to generate a model output that includes data defining a respective chemical structure of each output molecule in a set of output molecules.

title: Machine learning device and machine learning method
description: A statistical processing unit according to the present invention generates statistical data concerning a first feature amount and a second feature amount on the basis of first data including data concerning the first feature amount of each of a plurality of users constituting a first user group in a manner in which the plurality of users constituting the first user group are not identified, and second data including data concerning the second feature amount of each of a plurality of users constituting a second user group in a manner in which the plurality of users constituting the second user group are not identified. A training processing unit causes a machine learning model, which outputs second feature amount data for processing by using first feature amount data for processing as an input, to be trained using the statistical data as training data.

title: Functionality conversion method and apparatus, model conversion method and apparatus, and device, storage medium and program product
description: Disclosed in the present invention are a functionality conversion method and apparatus, a model conversion method and apparatus, and a device, a storage medium and a program product. The functionality conversion method comprises at least one of the following: performing functionality conversion on a first functionality; performing model conversion on a first model; acquiring functionality conversion information; and acquiring model conversion information, wherein the first functionality comprises at least one first model. Therefore, a terminal can autonomously decide whether to perform AI/ML functionality and/or model conversion, or determine, on the basis of conversion information decided by a network and indicated to the terminal, whether to perform the AI/ML functionality and/or model conversion, thereby improving the timeliness of the AI/ML functionality and/or model conversion.

title: Methods, systems, and storage mediums for providing medical consultation services
description: Provided are methods, systems and storage mediums for providing medical consultation services. The methods may include: presenting, via a first terminal device in a consultation room, a first interface element relating to an electronic health record of the patient to the patient and a doctor; obtaining, based on sensed information, a control instruction issued by the patient and/or the doctor for retrieving at least a portion of the electronic health record, the sensed information being collected by one or more sensing devices in the consultation room during a consultation process; and in response to the control instruction, retrieving the portion of the electronic health record and presenting the portion of the electronic health record via the first terminal device.

title: Information recommendation method and apparatus, device, computer-readable storage medium, and computer program product
description: The present application provides an information recommendation method and apparatus, a device, a computer-readable storage medium, and a computer program product. The method comprises: acquiring first object data of a plurality of objects to be recommended and a plurality of pieces of information to be recommended; using a trained feature extraction model to separately perform feature extraction on the first object data and the information to be recommended, so as to correspondingly obtain object features and information features, wherein the trained feature extraction model is obtained by training, on the basis of a plurality of training sample images and at least one training sub-image corresponding to each training sample image, a feature extraction model to be trained, and the training sub-image is obtained by performing image sampling on the training sample images; on the basis of the plurality of object features and the plurality of information features, determining target information to be recommended that matches each object to be recommended; and sending, to a terminal of each object to be recommended, the corresponding target information to be recommended.

title: Training method for object detection model for low-quality image, object detection method for low-quality image, and related device
description: Provided in the present disclosure are a training method for an object detection model for a low-quality image, an object detection method for a low-quality image, and a related device. The training method comprises: acquiring a low-quality sample image for a target region; inputting the low-quality sample image into a first encoder to obtain an initial feature of the low-quality sample image; inputting the initial feature into a transfer convolutional network, and on the basis of a first target feature, training the transfer convolutional network to obtain a target convolutional network, wherein the first target feature is obtained on the basis of the initial feature; on the basis of the target convolutional network, obtaining a second target feature for the low-quality sample image; inputting the second target feature into a first detection head, and training the first detection head to obtain an object detection head, wherein the first detection head is obtained on the basis of the first target feature; and on the basis of the first encoder, the target convolutional network and the object detection head, obtaining an object detection model, wherein the object detection model is used for performing object detection on a low-quality image to be subjected to detection. The present disclosure provides technical support for realizing efficient object detection.

title: Comprehensive disease risk prediction device and method considering associated disease risk
