description: The present invention relates to a comprehensive disease risk prediction device and method that comprehensively use healthcare bigdata including information about genes of a user, information about lifestyle habits of the user, and information about medical examination records of the user, and can predict disease risk for a specific disease by additionally considering the risk of associated diseases associated with the specific disease. The comprehensive disease risk prediction device comprises: a data collection module for receiving genetic information about genes of a user, lifestyle information about lifestyle habits of the user, and examination information about medical examination records of the user; and a prediction module for predicting a comprehensive disease risk, which is the risk of the user with regard to a predefined disease, on the basis of the genetic information, the lifestyle information, and the examination information.

title: Artificial intelligence-based braille conversion method, and computer program, recorded on recording medium, for executing same
description: The present invention presents a method for converting documents of various formats into braille on the basis of artificial intelligence (AI). The method may comprise the steps of: parsing an electronic document to undergo braille translation, so as to identify one or more elements included in the electronic document; using pre-trained AI to assign a braille attribute to each element identified from the electronic document; and generating, on the basis of the assigned braille attribute, a braille document corresponding to the electronic document. According to the present invention, electronic documents having various file formats can be converted into braille documents.

title: Automatic production of a training dataset for a neural network
description: A neural network training method comprising the phases of virtually creating a scenography (2) that represents a physical work area (3) in which different objects (7) to be handled are arranged. The scenography (2) models a 3D representation of the objects (7) and implements the laws of physics to which the objects (7) would be subjected in a real physical environment; processing 3D images (10) extracted from the scenography (2) by extracting from each image labeling data (11) associated with the objects (7) represented on the image, thus forming a training dataset (12); and providing the training dataset (12) to a neural network (13) to carry out a network setup phase that implements the artificial intelligence for the recognition of different types of objects (7) and for determining the positions of the individual objects (7) in the physical work area.

title: Electronic device and control method therefor
description: This electronic device comprises: a memory for storing sample data, a first feature extraction model, a noise application module, a data generator, and a second feature extraction model; and at least one processor connected to the memory and controlling the electronic device. The at least one processor: inputs the sample data into the first feature extraction model so as to obtain first data including a feature map of the sample data; inputs the first data into the noise application module so as to obtain second data derived by applying a noise filter to the first data; inputs the second data into the data generator so as to obtain third data which is different from the second data; inputs the third data into the second feature extraction model so as to obtain fourth data including a feature map of the third data; obtains a loss value on the basis of the fourth data; and trains the data generator on the basis of the loss value.

title: Learning device for mobile cyber-physical system
description: Learning device intended to be embedded in a mobile cyber-physical system (101) equipped with actuators (105), the device comprising at least one sensor (103) for perceiving the environment (102) external to the system, at least one internal sensor (112) capable of providing information on the state of the system, a first learning unit (104) configured to restore a perception of the environment from the data acquired by the at least one perception sensor (103) , a second learning unit (106) configured to control the actuators (105), a generator (109) of simulation scenarios of the system in its environment controlled by the first learning unit (104) and the second learning unit (106), a scenario simulator (107) and a virtualization platform (111) for simulating the behavior of a digital twin of the system in the scenarios simulated by the generator and adapting the parameters of the second learning unit (106) in order to control the system so that it adapts to its environment. Figure 1

title: Method and system for digital printing of images on physical supports
description: A method for digitally printing images (P) on physical media (S), comprising: i) generating a digital image (D1) in a predetermined format; ii) converting the digital image (D1) into an image (D2) in a format suitable for printing on a physical media (S); and iii) printing the converted image (D2) onto the physical media (S) to obtain said media with the printed image (P). At least step i) is performed by processing, using at least one artificial intelligence software algorithm (4), a series of inputs (T1, T2, Tn, ...) comprising images, texts, or keywords, the digital image (D1) being the result of the processing in step i). The invention also relates to a system (1) for digitally printing images (P) on physical media (S).

title: Monitoring system for an electric aircraft and a method for its use
description: An aircraft monitoring system for an electric aircraft is disclosed. The monitoring system may include at least a sensor configured to generate a failure datum. The failure datum includes a datum regarding a condition of an electric motors. An electronic checklist may include a crew alerting system (CAS). A CAS may be in electronic communication a sensor, wherein the CAS is comprised of at least a computing device. A CAS may generate a plurality of remedy data as a function of the failure datum. A CAS then may display the plurality of remedy data using a pilot display. A pilot may be prompted to apply the remedy datum using a pilot display as a function of the plurality of remedy data. The CAS provides an indication of the condition of the electric motor using a pilot display as a function of the application of the plurality of remedy data.

title: Enable transformations sketch-to-painting
description: Methods and systems are provided for transforming sketches into electronic-style held-in-style. A neural network system is trained, wherein the training involves training a first neural network, which converts input sketches into output images, and training a second neural network, which converts images into output paintings. For the first neural network, a similarity between the output image and a reference image is evaluated, and for the second neural network, a similarity between the output painting, the output image, and a reference painting is evaluated. The neural network system is modified based on the evaluated similarity. The trained neural network is used to generate an output painting from an inputted sketch, the output painting retaining features from the entered sketch using an extrapolated intermediate image and reflecting a designated style from the reference painting.

title: Method for determining a confidence value for a detection quality of a road marking boundary, driver assistance system and motor vehicle
description: The invention relates to a method for determining a confidence value (C) for a detection quality of a road marking boundary (K) of a road (9) for a motor vehicle (1):   - Determining a lane marking limit (K) of a detected lane (9) as a function of the detected lane marking (10, 11) by means of an electronic computing device (12) of the driver assistance system (2);   - generating at least one parameter value (V1 to V7) of a parameter (P1 to P7) characterizing the road marking boundary (K) as a function of the detection quality by means of a predefined confidence model (M) by means of the electronic computing device (12);   - Classifying the characterizing parameter (p1 to P7) depending on the generated parameter value (V1 to V7) by means of a predetermined membership function (Z) for the characterizing parameter (P1 to P7) according to the predetermined confidence model (M); and   - Determining the confidence value (C) as a function of the classified characterizing parameter (P1 to P7) by means of the electronic computing device (12).   The invention further relates to a computer program product, a driver assistance system (2) and a motor vehicle (1).

title: Method for training a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN), Generative Adversarial Network, computer program, machine-readable storage medium and device
description: A method (200) for training a Generative Adversarial Network (100), in particular a Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network, the Generative Adversarial Network (100) having a generator (110) and a discriminator (120), the generator (110) and the Discriminator (120) are artificial neural networks, with the step:  Training (201) the discriminator (120), wherein in the step of training (201) the discriminator (120) a parameter of the discriminator (120) is adapted as a function of a loss function, the loss function (125) including a term that the violation of the Lipschitz condition (126) as a function of a first input date and a second input date and as a function of a first output of the discriminator (120) when processing the first input data and a second output of the discriminator (120) when processing the second input data represented, the second input date (116) being created on the basis of the first input date using the method of virtual adversarial training (116).

title: Method for warning a driver of a vehicle of a potentially critical traffic situation
description: The invention relates to a method for warning a driver of a vehicle regarding a potentially critical traffic situation, comprising the steps:   - detection of a potentially critical traffic situation for the vehicle (1),   - Determining a hazard measure of the potentially critical traffic situation for the vehicle (2) and   - Issuing a warning to the driver of the vehicle (4) when the hazard level of the potentially critical traffic situation reaches or exceeds a warning threshold value (3), the warning threshold value being adjusted as a function of information from a self-learning card. Furthermore, the invention relates to a corresponding device and its use in a vehicle.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR DETECTING ANOMALIES
description: Systems and methods for detecting an anomaly of a sensor of a vehicle are provided. In one embodiment, a method includes: storing a plurality of sensor correlation groups based on vehicle dynamics; processing a subset of signals based on the sensor correlation groups to determine when an anomaly exists; processing the subset of signals based on the sensor correlation group to determine which sensor of the sensor correlation group is abnormal; and generating notification data based on the sensor of the correlation set that is abnormal.

title: DEVICE FOR DETERMINING ANOMALIES
description: An abnormality determination device for a vehicle including a transmission includes an execution device and a storage device. The storage device is configured to store map data defining a pre-trained map trained by machine learning. When a variable representing time-series data of a rotational speed of a gear is read into the map as an input variable, the map outputs a state variable representing a state of the gear as an output variable. The execution device is configured to execute: an acquisition process that acquires the variable representing the time-series data as a value of the input variable; and a determination process that determines whether there is an abnormality in the transmission based on a value of the output variable that is output from the map when the value of the input variable is read into the map.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR GENERATING AN ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE-BASED PREDICTOR AND USE THEREOF, AND COMPUTER PROGRAM
description: A method is provided for generating an artificial intelligence-based predictor, the method comprising: providing a digital map with landmarks obtained from sensor data; Determining a benefit of the respective landmark and/or the sensor data used to determine it for determining the position of a motor vehicle in the digital map based on predetermined criteria; Creating a training data set comprising the landmarks and/or the sensor data used to determine them and their respective specific benefits; and training the artificial intelligence-based predictor with the training data set, so that the predictor is designed after training to predict the benefit for determining the position of another motor vehicle in a digital map based on a landmark obtained from the recorded sensor data.

title: Method, device and computer program product for generating a user-specific functionality of a vehicle
description: In a method for generating a user-specific functionality of a vehicle (102), a user input is detected that characterizes the user-specific functionality. Input data is generated depending on the user input. Depending on the input data, at least part of a program code of a computer program is generated that provides the user-specific functionality when the computer program is executed on a control unit (114) of the vehicle (102). The computer program is provided for execution on a control unit (114) of the vehicle (102) in order to provide the user-specific functionality.

title: Method, system, and computer program product for training a neural network designed to operate a vehicle and for operating a vehicle with a neural network
description: The invention relates to a method (100), system and a computer program for training (103) a neural network (DNN1, GPT1, DNNZ, GPTZ, DNN2, GPT2) designed to operate a vehicle (10, 11, 12, ... 20, 21, 22), as well as to a method, a system and a computer program for operating a vehicle (10, 11, 12, ... 20, 21, 22) with a neural network (DNN1, GPT1, DNNZ, GPTZ, DNN2, GPT2). The method (100) comprises training (103), in particular retraining (103') of a neural network (DNN1, GPT1, DNNZ, GPTZ, DNN2, GPT2) designed to operate (104) a vehicle (10, 11, 12, ... 20, 21, 22), wherein the training (103), in particular retraining (103'), is carried out depending on: - first data in connection with one or more first errors (FF10, FF11, FF12) of a vehicle functionality of one or more first vehicles (10, 11, 12); and- second data relating (FF20, FF21, FF22) to a vehicle functionality of one or more first vehicles (20, 21, 22);wherein the training (103) is carried out with respect to an interaction of a first vehicle (10, 11, 12, ...) with a second vehicle (20, 21, 22) in a driving situation.

title: Method and arrangement and computer program with program code means and computer program product for determining a future system state of a dynamic system
description: The invention relates to a neural arrangement, ie a network structure of a recurrent neural network, which is suitable for a prognosis of a state of a dynamic system, as well as an image which describes a system behavior of a dynamic system and is suitable for predicting a state of the dynamic system.   In this case, state variables of the system are subjected to a spatial transformation at a first time, which transforms the state variables from a state space into a transformation space. The state variables transformed into the transformation space are subjected to a time transformation which transforms the state variables transformed into the transformation space from the first time point to a future, second time point. The state variables transformed to the future, second time point are subjected to a space transformation, which transforms back the state variables, which have been transformed to the future, second time point, from the information space into the state space.   Both the state variables transformed by the state space into the transformation space and the state variables transformed by the transformation space into the state space each have both influencing variables of the dynamic system and at least one target variable of the dynamic system influenced by the influencing variables. Transformation parameters for performing the space transformations are fixed; ...

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR PREDICTING A DESTINATION OF AN AUTOMOTIVE BASED ON THE CLOTHING WEARED BY A PERSON
description: The disclosure provides systems and methods for predicting a destination of an automobile based on the clothing worn by a person. Exemplary embodiments described in this disclosure generally relate to systems and methods for predicting a destination of an automobile based at least in part on identifying a category of clothing worn by a person who is an occupant of the automobile or intends to get into the vehicle to move in the direction of the automobile. The clothing can be one of several categories, such as a business clothing category, a casual business clothing category, a casual clothing category or a social clothing category. The destination may also be predicted based on other factors, such as clothing worn by a passenger of the automobile and historical data related to the passenger and / or passengers. The historical data may include a record of times the occupant traveled to a particular destination and the clothing the occupant wore while traveling to the destination.

title: Arithmetic device, operating method therefor and neural network processor
description: An arithmetic apparatus includes a first operand hold circuit configured to output a first operand according to a clock signal, generate an indicator signal based on bit values of high order bit data including a most significant bit of the first operand, and a Perform gating on the clock signal based on the indicator signal, the clock signal being applied to a flip-flop that locks the high-order bit data of the first operand; a second operand holding circuit configured to output a second operand in accordance with the clock signal; and an arithmetic circuit configured to perform data gating on the high-order bit data of the first operand based on the indicator signal and output an operation result by performing an operation using a modified first operand derived from the data -Gating results and performs the second operand.

title: PROCEDURES, SYSTEMS AND DEVICES FOR EDGE-BASED NOTIFICATION BY CROWDSOURCED LIVE STREAMED FLEET COMMUNICATION
description: Devices, methods and systems of an edge server that communicates with vehicles by continuously receiving messages containing data from state transitions from electronic control units (ECUs) included in each vehicle; Monitoring the streamed message data from each vehicle in real time to detect updates to data on state transitions from ECUs used in vehicle operations; Real-time crowdsourcing of the state transition data of the ECUs during vehicle operation to group state transition data with common features as crowdsource transition data; Processing the crowdsource transition data using a machine learning model to classify the crowdsource transition data of an abnormal event and transmitting a warning of the abnormal event in advance to an identified vehicle for a driver or ADAS to respond.

title: VEHICLE ASSIGNMENT DEVICE, VEHICLE AND TERMINAL
description: A vehicle allocation device allocates a vehicle in response to a vehicle allocation request from a terminal of a user. The vehicle assignment device includes a vehicle selection unit configured to select a vehicle that has relatively little learning progress of an input / output relationship of parameters depending on a planned driving area in which the user drives from a plurality of vehicles that input / output -Learn relationship of parameters depending on a predetermined area, owns and issue a vehicle assignment instruction to the selected vehicle when the vehicle assignment request is received.

title: BINARY EXTENSION FOR AI AND MACHINE LEARNING ACCELERATION
description: Methods, systems and apparatus can provide technology that transforms input data into a wave format, the wave format including a plurality of sinusoids for one or more data points in the input data, converting each sinusoid into a binary sequence to have a plurality of binary sequences for each of the one or obtaining the plurality of data points in the input data, and communicating the plurality of binary sequences to a machine learning model.

title: MOVEMENT PLANNING SYSTEM WITH INTERPRETATION OF COMMANDS IN NATURAL LANGUAGE
description: A system for motion planning for a vehicle includes a processor programmed to analyze text data representing a natural language command related to the environment of the vehicle. The system generates a rule having an associated condition criterion portion and a result portion. For each potential driving action from a set of potential driving actions of the vehicle, the system determines whether the potential driving action contradicts the result portion of the rule. A driving action mask is created that includes a corresponding mask parameter for each potential driving action from the set of potential driving actions of the vehicle. If the potential driving action contradicts the result portion of the rule, the corresponding mask parameter reduces the likelihood of selecting that potential driving action in a motion planning decision. The condition criterion portion is evaluated to determine whether the mask is applicable, and if the mask is applicable, the driving action mask is used to determine a motion planning decision for the vehicle. A rule expiration criterion may additionally be evaluated to determine whether a rule has expired.

title: Method for implementing a data-based position sensor for an electromagnetically actuated component, fluid valve, and fluid system
description: A method is provided for implementing a data-based position sensor 16 for an electromagnetically actuated component 11. The data-based position sensor comprises a prediction model for the position of an electromagnetically actuated element 14 of the electromagnetically actuated component 11. In the method, a training data set is generated based on the electromagnetically actuated component 11, and the prediction model is trained based on the training data set. In particular, this makes it possible to determine the position of a valve element 14 of an electromagnetically actuated fluid valve 11, which comprises only an electromagnet 13 for actuating the valve element 14, without the use of hardware sensors for position measurement.

title: Fuzzy device
description: A membership function unit includes a membership function setting section for adjusting positions or shapes of membership functions depending on inputs of elements influencing human senses so as to set the membership functions and a membership value computing section for computing membership function values associated with input variables in the membership functions attained by the membership function setting section.

title: A Prediction Method of PM2.5 Concentration Based on Hybrid Neural Network
description: A kind of PM2.5 concentration value Forecasting Methodologies based on hybrid neural networks, include the following steps：Step 1, the acquisition of four class sample datas.The four classes sample data includes PM2.5 concentration values historical data, PM2.5 concentration value indexs of correlation historical data, meteorological historical data and PM2.5 component resolving data；Step 2, using first nerves network initial forecast PM2.5 concentration values；Step 3, using nervus opticus network re prediction PM2.5 concentration values；Step 4 finally predicts PM2.5 concentration values using third nerve network, exports the final predicted value of PM2.5 concentration values.The present invention is outside the data using PM2.5 concentration values historical data, PM2.5 concentration value index of correlation historical datas and meteorological these three classifications of historical data, PM2.5 component resolving data are also introduced, the Change and Development rule of energy accurate description PM2.5 concentration values improves precision of prediction.

title: A Convolutional Neural Network-Based Saliency Detection Method Based on Region- and Pixel-Level Fusion
description: The invention discloses the conspicuousness detection methods that a kind of region based on convolutional neural networks and Pixel-level are merged, the object of this method research is still image, wherein the content of image can be arbitrary, the target of research is the target for attracting human eye attention to be found out from image, and different significance value is assigned for it.The present invention mainly proposes a kind of adaptive Area growth, and devises two CNN network structures, is respectively used to the prediction of Pixel-level conspicuousness and conspicuousness fusion.The two CNN network models are used for the training of network model, and final output and input picture Saliency maps of the same size using the legitimate reading of image as supervisory signals using image as input.The estimation of region class conspicuousness and the prediction of Pixel-level conspicuousness can be effectively performed in the present invention, obtain two Saliency maps, finally merged to obtain final Saliency maps by two Saliency maps and original image using the CNN for carrying out conspicuousness fusion.

title: Parking space detection method and system based on deep learning and big data
description: The invention relates to a parking space detection method and system based on deep learning. The method includes: obtaining relevant detection data of whether there is parking on the parking space in the parking lot; obtaining the relevant status of whether there is parking on the parking space in the parking lot; using the relevant detection data as the input of the deep neural network, and using the relevant status As the output of the deep neural network, the deep neural network is trained; the relevant detection data of whether there is parking in the parking space to be tested in the parking lot at the current moment is obtained; the relevant detection data is input into the trained deep neural network for deep learning; The corresponding output of the deep neural network is used as the relevant state of the machine to determine whether the parking space is parked or not. The invention adopts deep learning and deep neural network to identify the relevant detection data of the parking space, can remove the false and save the true from the ever-changing and interfering parking space detection data, and the obtained parking space state can reach the detection accuracy that satisfies the user.

title: System and method for learning models of radiation therapy treatment plans for predicting radiation therapy dose distributions
description: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for developing radiation therapy treatment plans by using machine learning methods and neural network components. The neural network is trained using the one or more three-dimensional medical images, the one or more three-dimensional anatomical maps, and the one or more dose distributions to predict a fluence map or a dose map. During training, the neural network receives a predicted dose distribution determined by the neural network, which is compared to an expected dose distribution. The comparison is performed iteratively until a predetermined threshold is reached. The trained neural network is then used to provide a three-dimensional dose distribution.

title: Dynamic collaborative attention network for question and answer
description: The disclosed technology involves an end-to-end neural network for question answering, referred to herein as a "Dynamic Collaborative Attention Network (DCN)." In short, DCN includes an encoder neural network and a co-attention encoder, which captures the interaction between questions and documents in so-called "co-attention encoding". DCN also includes a decoder neural network and a highway maximum output network, which handle collaborative attention encoding to estimate the start and end positions of phrases in the document that answer the question.

title: An image classification scheduling method based on edge computing in embedded scenarios
description: An image classification scheduling method based on edge computing in an embedded scenario. First, an appropriate image classification model is selected, and then the selected image classification model is deployed on the embedded end and the edge end respectively. Second, for the best classifier label generated for the image, the image and the corresponding generated best classifier label are integrated as training data. Then, build a random forest and classification model, and choose to classify the new incoming image at the embedded end or the edge end according to the classification result of the model. Finally, according to the power consumption and running time, the selection strategy of the image classification scheduling method is formulated. The random forest-based image classification scheduling method used in this process can effectively reduce the energy consumption and running time of the embedded terminal on the one hand, and improve the overall accuracy on the other hand. In addition, the scheme selection strategy of the present invention can select an appropriate scheduling method according to preferences for average inference time, average energy consumption, and accuracy.

title: Statement generation method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: This application discloses a sentence generation method, device, equipment and storage medium, which belongs to the field of artificial intelligence. The method includes: obtaining an input sequence; encoding the input sequence to obtain a sentence feature vector; decoding the sentence feature vector to obtain a first predetermined number of candidate sentence sequences; clustering the first predetermined number of candidate sentence sequences to obtain at least Two types of statement sequence sets; screening out a second predetermined number of candidate statement sequences from at least two types of statement sequence sets, the second predetermined number of candidate statement sequences including at least two statement feature types; according to the second predetermined number of candidate statement sequences , determine the output sequence corresponding to the input sequence. This application clusters and filters multiple candidate sentence sequences obtained by decoding, so that the multiple candidate sentence sequences generated include at least two sentence feature types, thereby making the output output sequence have greater diversity and improving sentence quality. Generate effects.

title: A deep learning-based intelligent design method for color sleeve paper-cut
description: The invention discloses an intelligent design method for color sleeve paper-cutting based on deep learning, comprising the following steps: A: inputting a pair of high-definition natural pictures; B: performing face recognition on the high-definition natural pictures; C: identifying The part of the image showing the face is subjected to face contour segmentation processing, and the part of the image that does not recognize the face is subjected to landscape contour separation processing; D: Select a style model for the high-definition natural picture in step A, and then divide the selected style model The image is used as a style image, and the part of the image that has been separated by the landscape contour is used as a content image for neural style transfer, and the generated image of the same layer is modified by a norm function to obtain the final neural style transfer image. The invention adopts intelligent technology to replace the traditional paper-cut technology, thereby reducing the design threshold and design cost of paper-cut, and greatly shortening the design and production cycle of paper-cut works.

title: A method for estimating the actual area of skin images based on deep learning
description: The invention provides a skin image actual area estimation method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing a shot skin image to obtain a pore density map of the shot skin image, and using the pore density map as a label of the skin image; s2, constructing a PDiNet convolution neural network model, taking the shot skin image and the corresponding label pore density map as the input of the model, and training the model by using a random gradient descent method; and S3, generating a pore density map of the shot skin image by using the trained model, further integrating the density map to obtain the number of pores on the image, and obtaining the actual size of the shot skin according to a formula. The method uses the convolutional neural network to learn the pore characteristics, has simple structure and low complexity, and improves the accuracy of pore counting estimation.

title: Floor distinguishing method, device, equipment and computer storage medium
description: The embodiments of the present invention disclose a floor discrimination method, device, equipment and computer storage medium. The method includes: acquiring first data of at least one test point set in the building to be tested, and using the first data of the at least one test point to determine a first characteristic parameter matrix, wherein each floor of the building to be tested is set At least one test point; input the first characteristic parameter matrix into the trained DAE-LSTM network to determine the floor corresponding to the at least one test point. The technical solutions of the embodiments of the present invention use the DAE network to extract the eigenvalue matrix from the characteristic parameter matrix containing noise, improve the accuracy of floor discrimination, and greatly reduce the complexity of the network and the overhead of network training; introduce the LSTM network to discriminate the floors. , which effectively improves the accuracy of floor discrimination.

title: Non-metallic mine identification method based on deep convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses a nonmetal mine identification method based on a deep convolutional neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of two-dimensional radar simulation images; preprocessing a two-dimensional radar simulation image to obtain a preprocessed image, identifying a non-metal landmine target center echo in the preprocessed image, storing the non-metal landmine target center echo in an xml file, and then arranging the preprocessed image and the corresponding xml file into a PASCAL VOC data set; dividing information in the PASCAL VOC data set into a verification set and a training set, and training an SSD target detection algorithm based on a deep convolution neural network by adopting the training set to obtain a deep convolution model; and inputting the verification concentrated data into a depth convolution model to obtain an average precision value, and inputting the preprocessed ground penetrating radar actual scanning image into the depth convolution model for recognition when the average precision value is larger than a set threshold value.

title: Disease classification and coding method, system, device and medium based on deep learning
description: The present disclosure discloses a disease classification and coding method, system, equipment and medium based on deep learning, and constructs an ICD coding knowledge base; obtains a patient discharge record for disease classification and coding, obtains a disease diagnosis name from the patient discharge record, and judges the current disease diagnosis Whether the name is the ICD standard disease diagnosis name in the ICD coding knowledge base; if not, for the current disease diagnosis name, extract the most similar t ICD standard disease diagnosis names from all the ICD standard disease diagnosis names; enter the classification step; Classification step: find the ICD standard disease diagnosis name output corresponding to the maximum probability from the t ICD standard disease diagnosis names; according to the ICD standard disease diagnosis name output by the model M, find the corresponding ICD standard disease code from the ICD code knowledge base Output as the final encoding result.

title: METHOD FOR DETERMINING ROAD SURFACES BASED ON VEHICLE DATA
description: Method for determining a road surface based on vehicle data by a controller, the method comprising the following steps:  - Classifying driving states of a vehicle into a variety of cases;  - Applying learning logic to each of the classified cases according to the characteristics of the cases, and constructing an influence model for each case; and  - Determine whether a road surface on which the vehicle travels is a high friction road surface or a low friction road surface based on the influence model for each case where the vehicle is driven by an operator.

title: System and method for automatic detection of topics in texts
description: SUMMARY A method and system for automatically detecting topical topics in texts may include receiving a text document from a corpus of documents and extracting one or more phrases from the document, based on one or more syntactic patterns. For each phrase, embodiments of the invention may: apply a word embedding neural network on one or more words in the phrase to obtain one or more respective word embedding vectors; compute a weighted phrase embedding vector, and compute a phrase prominence score, based on the weighted phrase embedding vector. Embodiments of the invention may subsequently produce one or more topic tags, which represent one or more respective topics in the document, based on the computed phrase prominence scores, and may select one or more topic tags according to their relevance. for the commercial domain of the corpus.

title: CLASS DEPENDENT CONCLUSIONS BASED ON MACHINE LEARNING
description: A computer-aided method for generating class-dependent machine learning-based conclusions comprises: accessing a test input and N class identifiers, each class identifier of the N class identifiers identifying a corresponding class of M possible classes; forming N test input data structures, each test input data structure of the N test input data structures being formed by concatenating the test input with a different one of the N class identifiers; Generating a conclusion for each of the N test input data structures using a machine learning model that is trained using examples that associate example input data structures with corresponding example outputs, where each corresponding example input data structure is formed by associating an example input with a different one of the N class identifiers is formed; and returning a class-dependent reasoning result based on the reasoning obtained for each corresponding test input data structure.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR DETERMINING CRIMPING APPLICATIONS AND REPORTING POWER TOOL USE
description: Systems and methods for reporting usage of a power tool. The power tool includes a pair of jaws configured to crimp a workpiece, a piston cylinder configured to actuate at least one of the pair of jaws, and a sensor configured to sense operating characteristics associated with a crimping application. An electronic processor connected to the sensor. The electronic processor is configured to receive one or more characteristic signals from the sensor, determine a first operating characteristic of the power tool based on the one or more characteristic signals, and determine a second operating characteristic of the power tool based on the one or more characteristic signals. The electronic processor is configured to determine the crimping application of the power tool based on the first operating characteristic and the second operating characteristic and generate a report indicating the crimping application performed by the power tool.

title: HETEROGENIC TRAIT INTERACTIONS WITH TRANSFORMERS
description: A computing system receives information indicating interactions between a user and previously recommended articles. The computing system transforms this information into a feature embedding list. The computing system applies a heterogeneous self-awareness model to the feature embedding list. The heterogeneous self-awareness model learns individual query, key, and value projection matrices for each feature embedding. The computing system generates a unique transformation matrix for each pair of feature embeddings. The computing system joins the individual query, key, and value projection matrices into a single concatenated matrix and creates a complete projection matrix by applying at least one linear transformation to the single concatenated matrix. The computing system applies a heterogeneous interaction transformer model to the feature embedding list to generate a weighted feature embedding list, including weighted task embeddings. The computing system generates a set of recommended articles based on applying a projection function to the weighted task embeddings.

title: Trainable and scalable automatic data-knowledge converter
description: A trainable, extensible, automated data-to-knowledge translator is described. One aspects of the present invention includes a computerized system having at least one repository to store user-specified rules that govern the processing of data by the computerized system and at least one processing module to process data according to the rules and to generate knowledge from the data. Another aspect of the present invention is a computerized method of translating data to knowledge. The computerized method includes providing user-specified rules to govern the behavior of a computerized system for translating data to knowledge, and processing data according to the rules to generate knowledge. A further aspect of the present invention is a computer readable medium having computer-executable instructions stored thereon for executing a method of translating data to knowledge. The computerized method comprises receiving data in an unstructured form, converting the data to a neutral form, processing data according to user-specified rules to translate the data from the neutral form to knowledge, and exporting the knowledge to a knowledge repository.

title: A Chinese event joint reasoning method and system
description: The invention provides a method and system for united inference of Chinese events on a chapter level. The method and the system can apply valuable information in argument extraction to assist in trigger word extraction in turn, so that cascading mistakes in a traditional pipeline mode can be reduced. With regard to an implementation method, the method and the system provided by the invention combine machine learning with the inference; and various types of language knowledge is used to recognize a time sequence relation of the Chinese events. The method and the system provided by the invention have the advantage that recognition performance is enhanced to a certain extent in comparison with existing methods and systems.

title: Method for establishing pedestrian detection training database, pedestrian detection method and device
description: This application provides method for building up, pedestrian detection method and the devices of a kind of pedestrian detection tranining database, method includes: that pedestrian's sample image data comprising specified prone position of specified quantity are expanded in initial pedestrian detection tranining database, obtains the first amplification data library；Non- prone position pedestrian sample image data in first amplification data library are carried out to the pedestrian's sample image amplification replaced based on color, obtain the second amplification data library；Non- prone position pedestrian sample image data in second amplification data library are subjected to the amplification of pedestrian's sample image based on human body proportion, obtain pedestrian detection tranining database.By increasing specified prone position pedestrian sample image data and carrying out the amplification based on color replacement and human body proportion respectively to non-prone position pedestrian sample data, the appearance diversity of pedestrian sample in database is improved；What is proposed carries out the amplification of prone position pedestrian sample image to pedestrian's data set, has the significance for overcoming technology prejudice to the pedestrian detection under driving environment.

title: Adaptive multi-objective hybrid differential evolution algorithm based on simulated annealing and information entropy
description: The present invention discloses a kind of adaptive multiple target hybrid differential evolution algorithm based on simulated annealing and comentropy.The method improve the random initializtion processes of multiple target differential evolution algorithm, and variation, intersection and the selected section of the adaptive multiple target differential evolution algorithm of tradition.This method will use the orthogonal initial method based on orthogonal matrix and factorial analysis, to obtain one group of representative experiment initial pool.Then new zoom factor is devised, to improve mutation operation function and parameter.The Metropolis acceptance criterion for being then based on simulated annealing devises improved crossover operation.Improved selection operation is finally devised using the crowding appraisal procedure based on entropy.The present invention can accelerate the convergence rate of differential evolution algorithm and increase obtains the probability of globally optimal solution, to obtain ideal evolution result for multi-objective optimization question.

title: A two-way analysis method for real-time flood control risk of mixed reservoirs
description: The invention discloses a kind of two-way analysis methods of mixed connection multi-reservoir Real time Flood risk, comprising the following steps: (1) establishes the dynamic bayesian network node for considering uncertain factor；(2) it is based on dynamic bayesian network, establishes the two-way analysis model of mixed connection multi-reservoir Technique for Real-time Joint Operation of Flood risk；(3) it is based on the two-way analysis model of mixed connection reservoir Technique for Real-time Joint Operation of Flood risk, carries out the positive dynamic evaluation of mixed connection multi-reservoir Real time Flood risk and the reverse diagnosis of principal risk event occurrence cause.The present invention has carried out the two-way analysis of risk using posterior probability information, more comprehensive risk information is provided than existing multi-reservoir Technique for Real-time Joint Operation of Flood methods of risk assessment, and to policymaker provide it is accurate and by when the risk information that updates, improve the dependable with function of decision in the face of risk.

title: Model building method and device
description: The embodiment of the present application discloses method for establishing model and device.One specific embodiment of this method includes: to establish the first model, wherein first model includes at least two task layers of input layer and shared input layer；First model is trained, the second model is generated, wherein second model includes task layer after input layer after training and at least two training；Task layer after each training in task layer after at least two training is generated into independent model in conjunction with input layer after training；To each independent model be trained and joint training after independent model, generate model system, wherein the information flow between independent model in the model system meets default flowing mode.This embodiment offers new model foundation modes.

title: A data processing method, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The embodiment of the present application discloses a kind of data processing method, electronic device and computer readable storage medium, wherein method include: the electronic device by the processor in each poll N number of storage request Q times to the memory transmitted in parallel；Wherein, N number of storage request is for requesting the memory to store a line output data of N number of continuous each self-generating of processing element of mark in the M processing element；The Q is determined according to the quantity M of processing element and the quantity N of storage request；The electronic device restores the P row output data of each self-generating of M processing element by the memory in the P poll according to the Q received × N number of storage request.By the application, it can solve data in existing neural network model and restore inefficient problem, by the triggering of parallel requests, storage while multiple data may be implemented, so as to improve restoring efficiency.

title: PD network training method and device for power equipment phase discrimination
description: The invention discloses a kind of partial discharge network training methods and device for the explanation of power equipment phase, it include: the shelf depreciation map for acquiring the phase explanation of partial discharge measuring signal, the original detection sample set of power equipment shelf depreciation is formed, and original detection sample is pre-processed；Pretreated detection sample is reprocessed using albefaction mechanism, and is input to neural network input layer using part detection sample as training data；Neural network is trained, and the output of the loss function optimization neural network according to the neural network；Using the detection sample of rest part as test data prediction power equipment partial discharges fault classification.The processing for carrying out albefaction mechanism to sample first of the invention, reduces the dimension of sample and removes the redundant data of sample, it is therefore prevented that the overfitting problem that neural network occurs in training；The loss function of neural network is improved, the accuracy rate of power equipment shelf depreciation defect diagonsis neural metwork training is improved.

title: System and method for predicting latency
description: Embodiments of the present application provide a method and system for predicting the waiting time of a transportation service request. The method includes receiving a transportation service request from a terminal device. The method also includes determining, by a processor, a first queue position of the transportation service request at a first point in time. The method also includes determining, by the processor, a second queue position of the transportation service request at a second point in time. The method also includes determining, by the processor, a request processing speed based on the first and second queue positions and the first and second points in time. The method also includes determining a predicted waiting time based on the request processing speed and the second queue position of the transportation service request. The method also includes providing the predicted waiting time of the transportation service request to the terminal device.

title: A kind of frequency measuring system in adaptive period
description: The invention discloses a kind of frequency measuring systems in adaptive period, comprising: frequency input interface, for inputting measured signal；Filter shape module is to complete filtered signal to distribute independent Data Identification for filtering out the interference signal outside measurement range, and using message sink coding；Frequency measuring block, for carrying out measured signal step-by-step counting and the calculating of measured signal frequency, each independent logical number of measured signal set of frequency according to Data Identification based on neural network model；Sampled signal periodic time self-adapting adjusts module, for realizing that the dynamically adapting in sampled signal period is adjusted according to the logical number of measured signal frequency；High steady temperature compensating crystal oscillator carries out step-by-step counting for frequency measuring block, the time source as frequency measurement for providing accurate pulse signal.The method that the present invention is combined using data category mark, logical number and neural network model, realizes the frequency measurement of quick high accuracy, the response time is short, and measurement accuracy is higher.

title: A kind of character detecting method based on deformable convolutional neural networks
description: The invention discloses a kind of character detecting methods based on deformable convolutional neural networks, by the image comprising text information for receiving input, then building includes the convolutional neural networks of deformable convolutional coding structure and carries out feature extraction to image, obtains multiple Feature Mappings；The feature vector in the Feature Mapping is extracted using sliding window, multiple candidate frames are predicted according to described eigenvector；Described eigenvector is input in BiGRU network, the output result of BiGRU network is input to a full articulamentum；The feature vector result obtained from the full articulamentum is classified and returned, the text detection result in image is obtained by text construction algorithm based on classification and the result returned.Due to the region overlay arbitrary shape of convolution of the present invention near vicinity and detected using multilayer, thus effectively to font excessive or too small in image carry out detection solve the problems, such as that the prior art is low for text detection accuracy rate not of uniform size in image.

title: The electromagnet signal recognition method and device of figure convolutional network and transfer learning
description: The present invention proposes the electromagnet signal recognition method and device of a kind of figure convolutional network and transfer learning, wherein method includes: graph structure of the building based on electromagnetic signal Tacit Knowledge；Figure convolutional neural networks are built, and obtain electromagnet signal generic weight vector, construct the electromagnetic signal classification weight matrix of update；Extract the further feature vector of electromagnet signal to be identified；According to the electromagnetic signal of update classification weight matrix and further feature vector, the transfer learning to electromagnet signal is completed, generates the perception recognition result to electromagnet signal.The present invention can identify electromagnet signal based on figure convolutional network and transfer learning, be effectively ensured its to the identification precision of target, occur to robustness, the response speed of identification and the fresh target that scene and awareness apparatus convert when adaptive ability.

title: Prediction model training method, device, storage medium and computer equipment
description: The invention discloses a prediction model training method, device, storage medium and computer equipment based on a neural network, mainly because it can reduce the number of manually marked samples and avoid a lot of repetitive work, thereby improving the training efficiency and prediction of the prediction model. precision. The method includes: obtaining labeled sample data and unlabeled sample data; inputting the labeled sample data into a preset neural network model for training to obtain a preliminary model corresponding to the prediction model; inputting the unlabeled sample data into The preliminary model performs prediction, and obtains the confidence degree corresponding to each prediction category of the unlabeled sample data; determines the prediction category whose confidence level does not meet the preset conditions, selects the unlabeled sample data under the determined prediction category for labeling, and uses the new Annotated sample data, updating the labeled sample data; inputting the updated labeled sample data into the preliminary model for iterative training to obtain the predictive model. The invention is applicable to the training of prediction models.

title: Quantum error correction hardware decoder and chip
description: A quantum error correction hardware decoder and chip relate to the fields of artificial intelligence and quantum technology. The quantum error correction hardware decoder includes an instruction storage device configured to store computer instructions; a control unit configured to read the computer instructions from the instruction storage device and control at least one neural network processing unit based on the computer instructions; at least one neural network processing unit configured to decode error syndrome information of a quantum circuit based on a neural network model in response to control by the control unit to obtain an output result of the neural network model, where the error syndrome information refers to an error syndrome obtained by performing error measurements on the quantum circuit; and a batch error search unit configured to determine error information based on the output result, where the error information indicates a quantum bit in the quantum circuit where an error has occurred and an error type corresponding to the error. The programmable hardware architecture provided in this application can ensure decoding performance while sufficiently reducing decoding delay and improving scalability and flexibility. (Selected Figure: Figure 5)

title: Visual feature extraction neural network model training method and system
description: The present disclosure relates to a visual feature extraction neural network model training method performed by at least one processor, the visual feature extraction neural network model training method including: receiving a first street view image captured on the ground, transforming the first street view image into a first distorted top-view image, transforming the first street view image into a second distorted top-view image, obtaining a first positional correspondence between pixels in the first distorted top-view image and pixels in the second distorted top-view image, and training a visual feature extraction neural network model using the first distorted top-view image, the second distorted top-view image, and the first positional correspondence, wherein the first distorted top-view image and the second distorted top-view image are different from each other.

title: A method for predicting the production stability of clonal cell lines
description: The present invention relates to a method for selecting a clonal cell line for use in the production of a therapeutic protein, the method comprising the steps of: measuring the product concentration of each clonal cell line for a plurality of clonal cell lines; determining product concentration profile data for each clonal cell line based on the product concentrations; inputting the product concentration profile data into a learning model including a modeling framework, wherein the modeling framework includes multivariate latent variable modeling, a multiway analysis structure, and an evolving model structure; generating an output indicative of the production stability of each clonal cell line using the learning model; and determining a clonal cell line for use in the production of a therapeutic protein based on the output. The present invention also relates to a system for determining the production stability of a clonal cell line or selecting a clonal cell line.

title: A method for resolving contention among components in a distributed system
description: Communication among entities such as customer premises equipment (20, 22, 28) in a telecommunications network (10) is set up through the use of agents representing each entity (20, 22, 28). Agents representing corresponding entities in the telecommunications network (10) negotiate over the type of communication sessions in which the corresponding entities want to be involved. The negotiation process involves the exchange of proposals by agents. A proposal comprises one or more planned actions which can be taken in the network (10). One agent generates a proposal acceptable to it and transmits the proposal to another agent. The receiving agent determines if the received proposal is acceptable to it and if not generates a counterproposal. The process continues until a proposal acceptable to both agents is found or it is determined that there is no proposal for realizing the particular type of communication session which is acceptable to both agents. An agent determines whether a proposal is acceptable to it through use of a goal hierarchy. The goal hierarchy indicates whether or not specific actions for accomplishing a goal are acceptable. The use of the goal hierarchy permits an agent to infer another agent's goals, and to find alternate actions that achieve this goal. The negotiation process enables agents to reach agreement without modification of their goals and without requiring the disclosure of restricted information to other agents. The inventive negotiation method is also applicable to other distributed systems.

title: SIGNAL PROCESSING DEVICE
description: A signal processing device that learns the operation of a user while the user being unconscious of it and allows the user to carry out an operation the most suitable for the user. A learning unit (2) monitors an operation signal fed in response to the operation of the user and judges whether or not it can be used for the learning. If the operation signal is a learning one which can be used for the learning, the learning unit (2), referring to the learning operation signal, learns a correction criterion which is a criterion for correcting an input signal. A correction unit (1) corrects the input signal on the basis of the correction criterion obtained by the learning, and the corrected signal is outputted as an output signal. The signal processing device can be applied to an NR (Noise Reduction) circuit for reducing noise.

title: Apparatus and method for problem solving using intelligent agents
description: Device and method for iterative problem solving using intelligent agents such as a brain agent, a profile agent, a personality agent, a knowledge agent and an error handling agent to interpret questions asked by a user and provide answers to the user. The device and method may further use a mood agent, a visual agent, a sound agent, a tactile agent and a smell / taste agent as well as various connectors connected to external data sources to interpret questions and provide answers to the user. The device and method can further analyze questions conceptually; and optimize their system performance by developing and responding to user interactions.

title: Method, device and computer program for determining an anomaly
description: The invention relates to a method for determining whether a series (20) of sensor values (21) contains an anomaly, comprising the following steps: providing a stack (22) and at least one training data series. Measuring a distance (32a, 32b) between the stack (22) and the training data series at a plurality of different predeterminable positions of the training data series. Determining at least one minimum distance from the measured distances and determining at least one change quantity for at least one predeterminable data point (23) of the stack (22), wherein the change variable is determined as a function of at least one of the measured distances (32a, 32b). The invention further relates to a computer program and a device for carrying out the method (40) according to the invention and to a machine-readable memory element (15) on which the computer program is stored.

title: Method, computer program, data storage unit and system for the automatic detection of damage events based on image material
description: Method for the automatic detection of damage events (1, 11) based on image material, comprising the steps of:a) creating image material of at least part of an area (2, 12) having damage (1, 11),b) analyzing the image material using an artificial neural network, whereinc) a plurality of bounding boxes (3, 4, 7) is generated,d) a two-dimensional density function is created from the bounding boxes (3, 4, 7), ande) the damage is localized and classified based on the two-dimensional density function, wherein the classification of the damage (1, 11) is carried out based on reference damage data which is stored in a database and comprises a technical categorization of the damage (1, 11).

title: DEEP LEARNING FOR DE-ALIASING AND CONFIGURING A RADAR SYSTEM
description: Deep learning in a radar system involves obtaining un-aliased time samples from a first radar system. One method includes subsampling the un-aliased time samples to obtain aliased time samples of a first configuration, matched filtering the un-aliased time samples to obtain an un-aliased data cube, and the aliased time samples to obtain an aliased data cube. and using a first neural network to obtain a de-aliased data cube. A first neural network is trained to obtain a trained first neural network. The subsampling of the un-aliased time samples is repeated to obtain second aliased time samples of a second configuration. The method includes training a second neural network to obtain a trained second neural network, comparing results to select a selected neural network that corresponds to a selected configuration, and using the selected neural network with a second radar system that has the selected configuration to recognize one or more objects.

title: DEEP LEARNING-BASED SELECTION OF SAMPLE VALUES FOR ADAPTIVE SUPERSAMPLING
description: Apparatus for facilitating deep learning-based sample selection for adaptive supersampling is disclosed. The apparatus has one or more processing elements to: receive training data comprising input tiles and corresponding supersampling values for the input tiles, each input tile comprising a plurality of pixels; and, based on the training data, train a machine learning model to identify a supersampling plane for a rendered tile of pixels.

title: Method for classifying and/or regressing input signals using a Gram matrix variant
description: Method (1000) for analyzing, in particular for classifying and/or regression, input signals, in particular sensor signals, with regard to the presence of anomalies, in particular anomalies in a technical system (12), and a spatial localization of these anomalies in the input signals, the method comprising the steps:  - Providing (101) an input signal (1),  - Providing (102) a folding neural network (3), convolutional neural network, which creates a number C of property maps (4) from an input signal (1) by using folding, convolutions, and/or merging, pooling, whereby the Property cards (4) each have a total number of HxW property values (41, 42, 43), which are arranged in a matrix (40) with H rows and W columns,  - Reading (103a) of the input signal (1) by the convolutional neural network (3) and creating (103b) C property maps (4) for the input signal (1),  - Creating (104) a collection matrix (5) from all C property cards (4), in which the row vectors of a property card (4) are arranged one after the other line by line in each column of the collection matrix (5),  - Multiplying (105) the collection matrix (5) by its transpose (6), so that a (HxW)x(HxW) Gram matrix variant (7) with (H W) (H W) entries results,  - Comparing (106) the Gram matrix variant (7) with at least one predetermined (HxW)x(HxW) comparison matrix (8), and displaying a deviation signal based on the result of the comparison, and / or evaluating (107) the searched one Classification result and/or regression result from the result of the comparison.

title: Method and system for providing a voice assistance function in a vehicle
description: The present disclosure relates to a method (100) for providing a voice assistance function in a vehicle, comprising:- providing (110) training data for a large language model (LLM), wherein the training data is based on user interactions with a voice-controlled assistance function in vehicles (10A, 10B) of a vehicle fleet;- training (120), by a central unit (20), the large language model (LLM) with the training data, wherein the large language model (LLM) trained using the training data is an at least pre-trained large language model, and the training data is used to fine-tune the at least pre-trained large language model; and- providing (130) the fine-tuned large language model for at least part of the vehicle fleet and/or at least one other vehicle (30A, 30B) for implementing a large language model-based voice assistance function.

title: Proximity-based generation of surface textures for simulated environmental systems and applications
description: In various examples, a simulation platform generates a simulated driving environment by processing road map data to derive the location of wear-related visual artifacts for sections of a lane surface. Using map data, the simulation platform generates texture maps for aesthetic road rendering, which are used to apply textures to a 3D polygon topology mesh. The simulation platform generates visual artifacts representing the wear and tear of the road surface based on a calculation of one or more lane feature distances derived from the map data. The simulation platform calculates distances associated with reference line data derived from an image to render a texture of one or more lane features. These distances are used to determine how the appearance of the texel is adjusted to include the wear-related visual artifacts when displayed on a lane of the simulated driving environment.

title: Short-term load forecast using support vector regression and feature learning
description: In a support vector regression approach to forecasting power load in an electrical grid, a feature learning scheme weights each feature in the input data with its correlation with the predicted load, increasing the prediction accuracy. The kernel matrix for the input training data is computed such that features that align better with the target variable are given greater weight. The resulting load forecast may be used to compute commands sent to demand response modules

title: A data stream classification method and device based on time series feature learning
description: The present invention provides a data flow classification method and device based on time series feature learning. When the number of data streams to be classified in the cache is small, the first setting mode of opening some feature extraction threads is used to extract the time series features of the data streams to be classified in the cache. In this way, more time slice resources can be allocated to the identification thread corresponding to the LSTM neural network, thereby reducing the time-consuming of determining the identification label, and then classifying the data stream to be detected in a timely manner. When the number of data streams to be classified in the cache is large, the second setting mode of opening all feature extraction threads is used to extract the time series features of the data streams to be classified in the cache. By enabling all feature extraction threads, it is possible to ensure that time series feature extraction is performed on each to-be-classified data stream in the cache, avoiding omission of time-series feature extraction for some of the to-be-classified data streams in the cache. In this way, it can be ensured that all the acquired data streams to be classified are classified through the LSTM neural network.

title: Robust remote sensing image change detection method and system
description: The invention provides a robust remote sensing image change detection method and system. The method includes: adding a channel structure in a Flownet network to a Deeplab network to construct a Flow-Deeplab network; generating a training data set, and using the training data set to The Flow-Deeplab network is trained and optimized to obtain the trained Flow-Deeplab network; the trained Flow-Deeplab network is used to detect changes in the remote sensing images to be detected, and the change areas of the remote sensing images are obtained according to the output of the Flow-Deeplab network. The Flow-Deeplab network of the present invention can realize automatic detection of changes in remote sensing images in two phases, and can extract semantic features from the spatial dimension and the channel dimension respectively by adding a double attention mechanism.

title: Edge-preserving image smoothing method based on deep learning knowledge distillation technology
description: An edge-preserving image smoothing method based on deep learning knowledge distillation technology belongs to the technical field of image processing. Based on the new deep learning knowledge distillation technology, the method distills the edge detection ability of the edge detection teacher network into the image smoothing student network, so that the student network has the ability to preserve the image smoothing ability. The task of the student network is to perform image smoothing, and the task of the teacher network is to extract the information of structural edges. Using the teacher network to transfer the structural edge knowledge to the student network, the student network has the ability to retain the structural edge of the teacher network while performing the task of image smoothing. The invention can retain the smooth structural edge of the image without additionally introducing a deep network for retaining edge information, and overcomes the visual influence of image quality loss such as image edge information and blurring that cannot be well preserved in the traditional image smoothing enhancement method. Greatly improves the effect of image smoothing.

title: Application method of college student portrait technology based on hybrid neural network
description: The invention discloses an application method of a college student portrait technology based on a hybrid neural network, comprising the following steps: step S1: performing label design based on high-dimensional clustering of student portraits; step S2: establishing a student portrait classification model based on the hybrid neural network ; Step S3: use the merged results to obtain the optimal solution, and then obtain the student portrait; use the collected data and use the mixed neural network model of the convolutional neural network and the feedforward neural network to obtain the merged result, and then use the merged result to participate in The optimal solution calculation of the hybrid neural network framework is carried out by using Bayesian personality sorting and genetic algorithm to obtain student portraits; the invention has the beneficial effects of helping students' academic development.

title: A method for detecting human posture
description: The invention discloses a method for detecting human body posture, comprising: inputting pre-processed human body images to be detected into a pre-trained neural network model to obtain a predetermined number of heat maps, each heat map including a human body joint point; The network model includes the first 14 layers of the MobileNetV2 network connected in sequence, the dimension transformation layer, the first upsampling layer, the first convolutional neural network layer, the BN regularization layer, the ReLU activation function layer, the second upsampling layer, the second volume The convolution operation in the neural network model adopts separable convolution operation; a predetermined number of human body joint point coordinates are obtained from a predetermined number of heat maps; the coordinates of each human body joint point are scaled to the point to be detected In the image coordinate system where the human body image is located, the human body posture joint points of the human body image to be detected are obtained. The technical solution provided by the present invention can perform real-time detection of human body posture on a terminal with small memory and limited computing power of CPU and GPU.

title: Method and device for training neural network
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for training a neural network. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a training sample; training the initial neural network by using a training sample, and determining whether the initial neural network achieves convergence; in response to determining that the initial neural network reaches convergence, updating the network weight of the initial neural network by adopting a preset periodic cosine learning rate, and determining whether the initial neural network meets a preset training ending condition; and generating a trained neural network in response to determining that the initial neural network meets the training ending condition. The embodiment can improve the training speed of the neural network while improving the accuracy of the network weight of the neural network.

title: Video motion recognition method based on residual difference type 3D CNN and multi-mode feature fusion strategy
description: The invention relates to a video motion classification method based on residual difference type 3D CNN and multi-mode feature fusion, and belongs to the field of computer vision and deep learning. Firstly, changing the traditional C3D network connection mode into residual connection mode; and (3) decomposing the 3D convolution kernel by adopting a kernel decomposition technology to obtain a space convolution kernel and a plurality of parallel time kernels with different time scales, and inserting an attention model after the space convolution kernel to obtain an A3D residual error module and stacking the residual error module into a residual error network. Building a double-flow action recognition model, inputting RGB image features and optical flow features into a space flow network and a time flow network, extracting multi-level convolution feature layer features, and fusing the two networks by using a multi-level feature fusion strategy to realize space-time feature complementation; and finally, reducing the dimensions of the global video motion descriptor subjected to the fractional fusion through PCA, and finishing motion classification by using an SVM classifier.

title: A Keypoint Extractor Generation Method for Visual SLAM System
