description: The invention discloses a method for generating a key point extractor of a visual SLAM system, which comprises the following steps: 1) training a basic convolutional neural network by using a self-supervision frame, and acquiring a false key point set by using the basic convolutional neural network; 2) calculating a good matching point set and a bad matching point set between two adjacent frames of images by utilizing a false key point set and an optical flow algorithm; 3) calculating a loss function of the convolutional neural network according to the false key points, the good matching point set and the bad matching point set; 4) the loss function is converged through training, and the trained convolutional neural network can be used as a key point extractor of the visual SLAM system. The method combines the optical flow, the self-supervision learning and the visual SLAM, reduces the difficulty of acquiring training data, and constructs the key point extractor for the visual SLAM by using the convolutional neural network, thereby improving the estimation precision and the robustness of the visual SLAM system.

title: Display device, control system of the display device, and method of controlling the display device
description: This document discloses a display device, a control system for the display device, and a method for controlling the display device. The display device includes: a receiver configured to receive content; a display configured to display the received content; and a communicator configured to communicate with a user device and an external server. The display device includes a processor configured to acquire information from the user device via the communicator, request additional information related to the received content from the external server based on the received content and information, and, upon receiving the additional information related to the received content from the external server, display the received additional information along with the received content.

title: Medical data processing method and medical data processing system based on cloud platform
description: The invention discloses a medical data processing method and a medical data processing system based on a cloud platform. The method includes: the business center server receives medical data information sent by several user terminals; the user terminal type required to interact in the medical data instruction; write the medical data information into the corresponding storage space in the business center server according to the user terminal type; carry out the medical data information stored in the storage space. Protocol conversion is converted into a medical data packet that can be parsed by the corresponding user terminal; the medical data packet is sent to the user terminal corresponding to the address information based on the address information in the user terminal information. By implementing the method and system provided by the present invention, the corresponding storage space is matched for different user terminals, the protocol conversion process is realized, and the data interaction between different user terminals based on the service center server can be ensured.

title: Method, device, electronic device and storage medium for key point detection
description: The present disclosure provides a method, device, electronic device and storage medium for key point detection. The method includes: determining a target image including a target object; performing a first key point detection on the target image to obtain a key position information; the key position information includes the first key point information on the target object, and the position point information of the detection frame corresponding to at least one target part of the target object; based on each The position point information of the detection frame corresponding to the target part, and the second key point detection is performed on the image area of each of the target parts in the target image to obtain the second key point information corresponding to each of the target parts ; Determine object key point information of the target object based on the first key point information and the second key point information.

title: Text processing method, apparatus, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a text processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium, which can involve the processing of big data, and can also perform accurate recommendations based on user portraits and processed semantically related texts, and can perform accurate recommendations based on artificial intelligence models. The method includes: acquiring an initial relevant text corresponding to a target object; acquiring a target corrosion structure element; acquiring a target text element in the initial relevant text according to the position of a corrosion reference point corresponding to the target corrosion structure element; The target corrosion structural element is compared with the target text element to obtain a target comparison result; when the target comparison result is consistent, the initial related text is eroded to obtain semantically related text corresponding to the target object. Using the method can improve the text processing efficiency.

title: Method, system and device for pattern recognition
description: A method for pattern recognition may be provided, comprising: receiving data; processing the data using a convolutional neural network to identify a pattern in the data, wherein the convolutional neural network comprises at least: a first branch comprising a sequence of first convolutional blocks, a pooling layer is set between any two adjacent first convolutional blocks, each first convolutional block comprises at least one convolutional layer; and a second branch comprising a sequence of second convolutional blocks, each second convolutional block comprises at least one convolutional layer, and wherein processing the data using a convolutional neural network to identify a pattern in the data comprises: a first second convolutional block receives a first feature map formed by combining a feature map output by a first first convolutional block and a feature map output by a subsequent first convolutional block, processes the first feature map, and outputs a second feature map; and a subsequent second convolutional block receives a third feature map formed by combining the second feature map and a feature map output by another subsequent first convolutional block, processes the third feature map, and outputs a fourth feature map. A corresponding apparatus and system for pattern recognition and a computer-readable medium are also provided.

title: Method for diagnosing machine and diagnostic device for machine
description: The invention provides a method and a device for diagnosing a machine, which can accurately diagnose abnormality due to various reasons even though the physical quantity is small. A method for diagnosing a machine includes: a sampling step of sampling n (n is an integer greater than or equal to 2) measurement data sets representing characteristics of the mechanical device in time series; a normalization step of normalizing the sampled measurement data set; and a diagnosis step of drawing the standardized measurement data sets on an n-dimensional coordinate system, and diagnosing the normal or abnormal state of the machine based on which side of a boundary threshold value preset in the n-dimensional coordinate system the drawn measurement data sets exist.

title: Deep hashing method based on metric learning
description: A depth hash method based on metric learning relates to the field of computer vision and image processing, and solves the problems that the contrast loss function of the existing depth hash method only can enable feature vectors of images of the same category before quantization to be as close as possible, but cannot encourage the same symbols; the values before quantization of different image classes are far away as possible, but the opposite signs cannot be encouraged; the invention constructs a Hash contrast loss function and carries out sign bit constraint on the real-value feature vector before quantization, so that the Hash coding of the representative image obtained after the real-value feature vector before quantization is quantized by the sign function is more accurate, and f is used for solving the problems of poor discrimination of the quantized Hash code, erroneous judgment and the like sim (f i ·f j ) And f diff (f i ·f j ) Two control functions for constraining the symbols; the other parts in the expression are used for enabling the characteristic values of the images in the same category to be close, and enabling the characteristic values of the images in different categories to be far away. The method effectively improves the classification precision and reduces the misjudgment rate.

title: Power grid operation section dynamic generation method based on Q reinforcement learning
description: The invention relates to a power grid operation section dynamic generation method based on Q reinforcement learning, which is based on the mining and analysis of power grid operation historical data and is trained to obtain a Q reinforcement learning intelligent agent, and comprises the following steps: s1), constructing an intelligent agent, determining a power grid operation characteristic index, selecting a basic generation method library, and further constructing the intelligent agent according to the Q reinforcement learning requirement; s2), training an agent, namely training a process of generating the agent meeting the requirements by using a Q reinforcement learning training algorithm according to a training set sample formed by the historical data of the power grid operation; s3), applying the intelligent agent, and putting the intelligent agent which meets the convergence condition and is qualified through the test set into practical application. The Q reinforcement learning agent is obtained through training, and the power grid operation section generation method can be dynamically selected according to the power grid operation characteristics, so that the algorithm advantages of different generation methods in different scenes are fully utilized. In addition, the dynamic generation method can improve the accuracy of the generated result by optimizing and selecting the generation algorithm under different scenes.

title: Content pushing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a content pushing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium. The method includes: determining the first conversion negative sample; using the conversion operation recognition model to be trained to identify the first conversion negative sample to obtain the first operation possibility; using the trained conversion delay recognition model to conduct the first conversion negative sample Identify and obtain the possibility of the first user performing a conversion operation on the first push content before the target time, as the possibility of conversion delay; calculate the first model loss value according to the first operation possibility and conversion delay possibility, Adjust the model parameters of the conversion operation recognition model to be trained according to the first model loss value. The above-mentioned conversion operation recognition model can be an artificial intelligence-based model obtained by supervised training, and the above method can be executed by a cloud server. Using this method can improve the recognition accuracy of the conversion operation recognition model and the accuracy of content push.

title: Face image age identification method, device and equipment
description: The present application discloses a face image age recognition method, device and device. The present application iteratively updates the first weight combination of n base classifiers to obtain the second weight combination, and after each iterative update to obtain the second weight combination, Weighted voting is performed on n probability results to obtain standard probability results, and the first weight combination is continuously updated iteratively until the standard probability results obtained by the preset number of consecutive iterative updates are less than the preset threshold, and the iterative update is stopped, which improves the accuracy of weighted voting results. , and then compare multiple standard probability results to obtain the standard probability result with the highest probability. The second weight combination corresponding to the standard probability result with the highest probability is the best integrated weight ratio. Input the face image to be recognized into the preset base classifier to get The face age recognition result can improve the accuracy of face age recognition, and solve the technical problem of low accuracy of age estimation results obtained by age classification estimation through three-layer BP neural network.

title: Space physical moving body modeling method based on long-short-time memory network
description: The present invention relates to a modeling method of space physical moving body based on a long-short time memory network, and relates to the technical field of space physical moving body modeling; it includes the following steps: step 1, establishing a first fully connected neural network; step 2, establishing a second Fully connected neural network; Step 3, establishing a third fully connected neural network; Step 4, establishing a first long-short-term memory network and a second long-short-term memory network; Step 5, establishing a dynamic model network according to steps 1 to 4; Step 6 1. Carry out network training to the dynamics model network in the step five according to the state quantity S  t  and the control quantity C  t  ; Step seven, step seven, repeat step six, until the dynamics model network converges, complete the correction to the dynamics model network; The invention adopts a training strategy combining offline training and online fine-tuning to realize online prediction of trajectory and flight status, thereby providing a basis for subsequent high-precision guidance and high-stability control.

title: A face recognition method, device, storage medium and server
description: The present application belongs to the field of artificial intelligence technology, and proposes a face recognition method, device, storage medium and server. The method includes: obtaining a face image to be recognized; inputting the face image into a preset face recognition model to obtain a face recognition result. The face recognition model is pre-trained by the following steps: obtaining a face sample data set, the face sample data set includes a plurality of frontal face sample images and a plurality of non-frontal face sample images; performing face key point detection processing on each of the non-frontal face sample images to obtain the key point features of each of the non-frontal face sample images; correcting each of the non-frontal face sample images based on the key point features to obtain an image of each of the non-frontal face sample images corrected to a frontal face; using the plurality of frontal face sample images and the images of each of the non-frontal face sample images corrected to a frontal face as training sets, the face recognition model is trained.

title: Video processing method and device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present disclosure relates to a video processing method and device, an electronic device and a storage medium. The method comprises: obtaining a reference video, wherein the reference video comprises at least one type of processing parameter; obtaining a video to be processed; segmenting the video to be processed to obtain multiple frame sequences of the video to be processed; and performing clipping processing on at least part of the multiple frame sequences according to the at least one type of processing parameter to obtain a target video.

title: DNA binding protein identification and function annotation deep learning method based on self-attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses a deep learning method for DNA binding protein identification and functional annotation based on a self-attention mechanism. A data set is selected from a protein database, and the constructed deep learning model is trained and tested by using the selected data set. The deep learning model can predict whether protein can bind to DNA; wherein, the deep learning model includes coding layer, embedding layer, long short-term memory neural network layer (LSTM), convolutional neural network layer (CNN) and self-attention Layer (Self‑Attention). Through the deep learning model based on the self-attention mechanism, the present invention can predict whether it has the function of binding with DNA according to the primary sequence information of the protein, and find out the region with the binding function.

title: Cloth defect detection method based on One-Class deep support vector description
description: The invention discloses a cloth defect detection method based on One-Class depth support vector description. Under semi-supervised conditions, the advantages of deep convolutional neural network are used to extract effective depth features of images. A hypersphere model that can accurately describe normal sample points is mapped in space. End-to-end cloth defect detection is achieved. The network parameters and the radius of the hypersphere obtained by training can completely describe the relationship between the test sample and the hypersphere, and realize the discrimination of defects. It solves the problems of large memory usage, slow detection speed, and limited defect types in previous models.

title: Method of multi-source data fire detection system based on GA and VGG network
description: The invention relates to a method of a multi-source data fire detection system based on GA and VGG networks. The present invention uses multi-source data as a source of fire determination data. Firstly, converting images into proper space according to real-time images acquired by a satellite and an unmanned aerial vehicle, respectively carrying out image recognition on different data sources by using a VGG network, and then optimizing the weights of the different data sources by using a Genetic Algorithm (GA) to obtain the optimal weight. And finally, evaluating the identification results of different data sources. The fire disaster identification rate can be improved through multi-source data fusion and a VGG network, the environment information can be monitored accurately and efficiently, natural disasters can be found in time, damage can be stopped in time, and the life and property safety of the nation and people can be guaranteed.

title: LIDAR positioning for solution inference using 3D CNN network in autonomous vehicles
description: A method of solution inference using neural networks in LIDAR positioning includes constructing a cost amount for a predicted pose of an autonomous vehicle (ADV) in solution space. The cost amount includes a plurality of sub-amounts. Each sub-quantity represents a matching cost between a keypoint from the online point cloud and a corresponding keypoint on the pre-built point cloud map (1001). The method further includes regularizing the cost amount to match a cost refinement matching cost (1003) using a Conventional Neural Network (CNN); and infer an optimal offset of the predicted pose from the regularized cost amount. The optimal offset may be used to determine the location of the ADV (1005).

title: Depth video object repairing and tampering detection method
description: The invention provides a method for detecting tampering of deep video objects, comprising the following steps: establishing a network model, the network model including a space-time cumulative residual preprocessing module, a layered feature extraction module, and an upsampling positioning module; the space-time cumulative residual preprocessing module extracts the space-time cumulative residual through a (1+2) dimensional continuous convolution layer; the layered feature extraction module receives the space-time cumulative residual, and obtains advanced representation features through convolution, maximum pooling and linear rectification functions; area. The depth video object restoration and tampering detection method provided by the present invention has high precision.

title: Few-shot training of neural networks
description: This invention discloses a technique for training a neural network with a small sample size. The neural network is trained to recognize one or more features of an image. The neural network is trained using a small number of original images, from which multiple additional images are derived. The additional images are generated by rotating and decoding the image embeddings in a latent space generated by an autoencoder. The images generated by rotating and decoding exhibit changes in features proportional to the amount of rotation.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine syndrome diagnosis method and device based on deep learning and attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses a traditional Chinese medicine syndrome diagnosis method and device based on deep learning and attention mechanism, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring medical record data with symptoms of a patient to be diagnosed; converting the medical record data into vector data; inputting the vector data into a trained traditional Chinese medicine syndrome diagnosis model, and outputting a diagnosis result; the traditional Chinese medicine syndrome diagnosis model comprises: an attention mechanism module constructed using a matrix mapping layer, activation functions tanh and softmax, and a predictive deep neural network constructed using a multi-layered perceptron and an activation function sigmoid. Firstly, performing single hot code mapping on medical record data with symptoms of a patient, and converting the medical record data into vector data; the traditional Chinese medicine syndrome diagnosis model of the multilayer perceptron combining deep learning and supervised learning is adopted to diagnose the syndrome of the patient, so that the diagnosis and prediction accuracy of the traditional Chinese medicine syndrome of the patient can be improved.

title: A method for TCT and DNA ploidy analysis based on TCT preparation
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of biomedicine and intelligent identification, and specifically discloses a method for TCT and DNA ploidy analysis based on TCT production. TCT analysis and DNA ploidy analysis can be completed at the same time by using TCT preparation, which can reduce the amount of preparation, reduce the labor intensity of doctors, overcome the differences in conclusions caused by the differences in staining between samples, and provide the possibility for detecting cervical cancer in patients. Improve accuracy. By reducing the amount of tableting and the screening of samples, it is less harmful to the patient, less painful, and the detection method is faster. Increased efficiency for detection possibilities for early diagnosis of cancer.

title: A Freeform Surface Localization Method Based on KNN-ICP Algorithm
description: The invention discloses a free-form surface positioning method based on the KNN-ICP algorithm, comprising the following steps: (1) using a robot to collect points on the surface to obtain actual measurement point cloud data; The CAD model is discretized to generate theoretical point cloud data; (3) KNN algorithm is used to calculate the closest point and the minimum distance of each data point in the actual measurement point cloud in the theoretical point cloud; judge whether the iteration termination condition is met, if yes, turn to Go to step (5), otherwise go to step (4); (4) Use the quaternion method to calculate the rotation matrix and the translation matrix, so that the current measurement point set is close to the nearest point set, and the position of the new measurement point cloud data is obtained, And return to step (3); (5) terminate the iteration, and output the workpiece coordinate system relative to the robot. The free-form surface positioning method provided by the invention searches for the nearest point through the KNN algorithm, which is simple to implement and has high calculation efficiency.

title: A rapid writing method and device based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention is applicable to the technical field of computer application, and provides a method and device for fast writing based on artificial intelligence. The method includes the following steps: collecting a user's voice, and recognizing corresponding characters; Generate original articles; modify the original articles based on artificial intelligence algorithms to generate official articles. The method of the invention can generate an article related to the content expressed by the user only by expressing one sentence or several words by the user, without the need for the user to write and contemplate, and achieve the purpose of quickly obtaining an article in a short time. Moreover, the generated articles are modified based on artificial intelligence algorithms, and the quality of the articles is high.

title: Crop identification method and system based on cloud coverage remote sensing image and deep learning
description: The invention discloses a crop identification method and a system based on cloud coverage remote sensing images and deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, collecting Sentinel-2 data and crop ground sample data; s2, preprocessing the remote sensing image, and marking the pixel covered by the cloud as '0'; s3, extracting reflectivity time sequence data of the training sample; s4, classifying crops by using the Mask LSTM-CNN model and the single-waveband time sequence data provided by the invention, and evaluating the classification precision of each waveband; and S5, sequentially establishing wave band combinations with the wave band number of 2-10 according to the sorting of single wave band classification accuracy (OA or Kappa value) from large to small, evaluating the classification accuracy, and selecting the wave band or the wave band combination with the highest classification accuracy to identify the crops in the research area. The method solves the problem of crop identification of the time series image containing the missing value, avoids the risks of cloud processing operation and error transmission of remote sensing data, and improves the efficiency of crop identification.

title: Parallel decision-making system and method for distributed data processing
description: The invention discloses a parallel decision-making system and method for distributed data processing. The system includes: an initial logical node generation component, a logical node traversal component, a predetermined configuration cost calculation component, and a parallel decision-making component. The initial logical node generation component receives task configuration data input by a user to generate an initial logical node topology map for the distributed data processing system. The logical node traversing component traverses the initial logical node topology map to obtain a predetermined configuration in the initial logical node topology map. The predetermined configuration cost calculation component calculates the sum of the transmission cost and the calculated cost for each predetermined configuration. The predetermined configuration transformation component reduces the initial logical nodes and connecting edges and merges the initial logical nodes and connecting edges according to the result of the predetermined configuration, so as to obtain the transformed result logical node topology graph after reducing the initial logical nodes, so as to reduce the solution of parallel decision-making. space. The parallel decision component obtains a parallel scheme with a total minimum cost through a local greedy strategy for the transformation result logical node topology graph.

title: A complex network security risk monitoring method and system
description: The invention discloses a complex network security risk monitoring method and system, which comprehensively considers the limitations of traditional network security monitoring methods, network security monitoring experimental problems, and artificial intelligence-based network security monitoring applications. It is proposed to use artificial intelligence technology to build a network security risk monitoring experimental platform in a complex network environment based on a virtualized network system.

title: Accelerated quantized multiplication and addition operations
description: This document discloses techniques for accelerating convolution operations or other matrix multiplications in applications such as neural networks. A computer-implemented method includes receiving a low-precision input for a convolution operation from a storage device and subtracting a low-precision value representing a high-precision zero value from the low-precision input to generate a difference, wherein the low-precision input is asymmetrically quantized from the high-precision input. The method further includes performing multiplication and summation operations on the difference to generate a sum of products and generating a high-precision output by scaling the sum of products using a scaling factor.

title: Road target detection method, device, equipment and vehicle
description: Embodiments of the present invention disclose a method, device, device and vehicle for detecting a road target. The method includes: analyzing the collected road image data to obtain the target road scene category where the vehicle is currently located; determining a target detector according to the target road scene category; processing the laser point cloud data based on the target detector to obtain the target obstacle. In the road target detection method provided by the embodiment of the present invention, a corresponding detector is selected according to the type of road scene where the vehicle is currently located to process the laser point cloud data, which can not only meet the requirements for the detection speed, but also ensure the detection accuracy. precision.

title: Time Domain Equalizer and Equalization Method Combined with Neural Network Equalization and Linear Equalization
description: The invention discloses a time domain equalizer combining neural network equalization and linear equalization and an equalization method. The method comprises the following steps: 1) inputting a segment of length L to an input register module of a time domain equalizer 1 A sequence of symbols; 2) will be L in the sequence 2 Each symbol constituting a vector X NN And transmitting the data to a neural network equalization module for processing to obtain an output result 3) Mixing L with 1 ‑L 2 Each symbol constituting a vector X LN And the data are transmitted into a linear equalization module for processing; 4) inputting vector X LN Performing a weighted summationAs an output value 5) The outputs of the linear equalization module and the neural network equalization module are added to obtain a final equalization output symbol

title: Time-series correlation network intrusion detection method based on attention mechanism
description: The invention provides a time sequence related network intrusion detection method based on an attention mechanism. The method comprises the following steps: training an SSAE network by using an intrusion detection data set to obtain trained network flow data to be classified, and performing unique thermal coding and standardized processing on the network flow data to be classified to obtain preprocessed network flow data; and inputting the preprocessed network traffic data into a classifier of the trained stacked sparse self-encoder SSAE network based on an attention mechanism, and classifying the network traffic data to be classified by the classifier to obtain a network intrusion detection result of the network traffic data to be classified. The invention designs a double-layer Bi-GRU network structure added with an attention mechanism as a classifier, has higher classification accuracy and lower false alarm rate, and greatly shortens the training and testing time of the model.

title: Weighing equipment and weighing methods
description: The present invention provides a weighing device and a weighing method, wherein the weighing device includes: an identification module configured to identify item information of an object to be weighed; a storage module configured to store the item information of the object to be weighed The function mapping relationship between the weighing error and the weighing error; the processing module is configured to establish a functional mapping relationship WE=F(A, WT) according to the data measured in the training sample; wherein, WE is the weighing error, and A is the item information , WT is the actual weighing value of the object to be weighed; and, according to the function mapping relationship, calculate the weighing error, and perform data compensation for the current weighing data according to the weighing error. Through the weighing device and the weighing method of the present invention, the weighing error can be compensated more accurately.

title: Information processing device and information processing method
description: An information processing apparatus and an information processing method are disclosed. The information processing device includes: a classification loss calculation unit that inputs each sample image in the training set to at least two feature extraction sections to obtain at least two features of the sample image, and causes the classification section to calculate a classification loss of the sample image based on the at least two features; a sample pair extracting unit that extracts, from each of at least one pair of at least two features, a plurality of sample pairs for calculating mutual information between each pair of features; an information loss calculation unit that inputs a plurality of pairs of samples into a machine learning architecture corresponding to each pair of features, and calculates information loss between each pair of features; and a joint training unit for jointly adjusting parameters of the at least two feature extraction components, the classification component and the machine learning architecture in a manner that minimizes a sum of classification losses and information losses of all sample images in the training set, thereby obtaining the trained at least two feature extraction components and classification components.

title: Pinecone detection method based on BEGAN and YOLOV3 model
description: The invention discloses a pine cone detection method based on BEGAN and YOLOV3 models. First, a plurality of pine cone images under different time nodes are collected, and traditional image enhancement technology and BEGAN deep learning method are used for data enhancement; The pine cone image after data enhancement is divided into a plurality of cells, and the densely connected network structure modified by the dense layer of the bottleneck structure is introduced into the YOLOV3 model; the detection ratio of the YOLOV3 model is expanded. , and use the DIoU algorithm to optimize the loss function of the YOLOV3 model, which can effectively improve the overall performance of pinecone detection.

title: A scheduling method for Internet dockless bicycles based on real-time data
description: The invention relates to the technical field of information data, in particular to an internet pile-free single-vehicle scheduling method based on real-time data, wherein in a plurality of scheduling areas, standard single-vehicle quantity values of each scheduling area are obtained based on the real-time data, real-time position data of a single vehicle are obtained through the internet, and when the single vehicle scheduling needs to be carried out on a target scheduling area, the number of the single vehicles needing to be scheduled in or out of each scheduling area is firstly counted based on a genetic algorithm; and (3) taking the current single vehicle information data of each scheduling area as an initial population, iterating to preset iteration times through a genetic algorithm, obtaining an optimal scheduling strategy of the target scheduling area after comprehensive evaluation, and then taking the target scheduling area as a scheduling center to execute single vehicle scheduling according to the optimal scheduling strategy. The invention can generate the scheduling path by calling algorithms in different time windows, quickly obtain the optimal scheduling strategy in a short time, effectively reduce the scheduling cost of the shared bicycle and improve the scheduling efficiency of the shared bicycle.

title: Model training method and device based on federal learning
description: The embodiments of the present invention provide a model training method and device based on federated learning. The method includes: receiving the second original independent variable calculated value sent by the second data provider; the second original independent variable calculated value is calculated by the second data provider according to the second original independent variable and the second model parameter; Calculate the estimated value of the dependent variable according to the initial value of the first model parameter, the first original independent variable and the calculated value of the second original independent variable of the first data provider; calculate the dependent variable of the first data provider and the The difference between the estimated values of the dependent variable; according to the difference, calculate the gradient value of the loss function to the first model parameter; update the first model parameter according to the gradient value of the loss function to the first model parameter.

title: Quantum subtraction operation method and device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The invention belongs to the field of quantum computation, in particular to a quantum subtraction operation method, a device, an electronic device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of converting the subtracted data into a first target quantum state and converting the subtracted data into a second target quantum state; controlling the first target quantum state to execute quantum state evolution corresponding to the complementary code operation to obtain a first complementary code quantum state; controlling the current second target quantum state to execute quantum state evolution corresponding to the complementary code operation to obtain a second complementary code quantum state; performing quantum state evolution corresponding to addition operation on the first complement quantum state and the second complement quantum state to obtain a third target quantum state; and controlling the third target quantum state to execute quantum state evolution corresponding to the complementary code operation to obtain an evolved fourth target quantum state. The invention can be used for basic arithmetic operation in quantum circuit, and fills the blank of related technology.

title: Method and device for assessing cerebral stroke morbidity risk based on carotid atherosclerosis condition
description: The present application provides a method and device for evaluating the risk of stroke based on carotid atherosclerosis, including: using the self-learning ability of artificial intelligence to establish a relationship between the condition parameters of carotid atherosclerosis and the risk level of stroke The corresponding relationship between the current subjects; obtain the current carotid atherosclerotic plaque condition parameters of the current subject; through the correspondence, determine the current stroke risk level corresponding to the current carotid atherosclerotic plaque condition parameters; Determining the current stroke risk level corresponding to the current condition parameters of carotid atherosclerotic plaques includes: assigning the same carotid atherosclerotic plaques in the corresponding relationship to the condition parameters of the current carotid atherosclerotic plaques The stroke incidence risk level corresponding to the situation parameters of the block is determined as the current stroke incidence risk level. It can well realize the quantitative estimation of stroke risk through the condition parameters of carotid atherosclerotic plaque.

title: Pedestrian risk assessment method considering pedestrian acceleration rate
description: The invention discloses a pedestrian risk assessment method considering pedestrian thrill, which comprises the following steps: step S1, detecting whether a pedestrian is passing on the driving route of the vehicle; if yes, go to step S2; step S2, calling the data of the self-vehicle sensor and the positioning data to acquire the waiting time of the pedestrian, whether the pedestrian moves backwards, the number of the group people the pedestrian passes through, the speed and the acceleration of the pedestrian and the distance between the pedestrian and the vehicle; step S3, determining the value and the aggressiveness index of the characteristic variable according to the data obtained in the step S2; step S4, taking the excitement degree index of the characteristic variable obtained in the step S3 as input, and obtaining the overall excitement degree value of the pedestrian through a deep learning network based on a multi-layer perceptron MLP; and step S5, calculating a pedestrian risk value based on the pedestrian overall acceleration value. By adopting the method provided by the invention, the recognition of the pedestrian acceleration rate can be completed and the pedestrian acceleration rate can be converted into the pedestrian risk value, so that the decision can be made on the self-vehicle in a differentiation manner, and the traffic efficiency is improved.

title: Model Compression-Based Model Generation
description: The present disclosure provides a method and apparatus for model generation. The pre-training data set may be scored by a plurality of pre-training models, which perform a first task. The initial model may be pre-trained using the scored pre-training data set. The initial model may be updated based on a plurality of reference models to obtain a target model, the plurality of reference models performing a second task. The reference data set may be scored through the plurality of reference models. The target model may be trained using the scored reference data set.

title: Method and system for video analysis
description: State of the art techniques in the domain of video analysis have limitations in terms of capability to extract the spatial and temporal information. This limitation in turn affects interpretation of the video data. The disclosure herein generally relates to video analysis, and, more particularly, to a method and system for video analysis to extract spatio-temporal information from a video being analyzed. The system uses a neural network architecture which has multiple layers to extract spatial and temporal information from the video being analyzed. The method of training the neural network that extracts a micro-scale information from a latent representation of the video is presented. This is generated using an attention network, which is then used to extract spatio-temporal information corresponding to the collected video, which is then used in multiple video analysis applications such as searching actions in videos, action detection and localization.

title: Reinforcement learning for autonomous telecommunications networks
description: Systems and methods include steps of determining a state of a network based on telemetry data; determining a value of a reward associated with the state; determining an action to take on the network to bring the network to a next state that is expected to have a better than or equal to value of the reward; and causing the action to be implemented in the network. The steps can also include continuing the determining steps and the causing step.

title: Memory for performing deep neural network operation and operating method thereof
description: A memory is suitable for performing a deep neural network operation. The memory includes: a processing unit and a weight unit. The processing unit includes a data input terminal and a data output terminal. The weight unit is configured to be coupled to the data input terminal of the processing unit. The weight unit includes an index memory and a mapping table. The index memory is configured to store multiple weight indexes. The mapping table is configured to respectively map the multiple weight indexes to multiple representative weight data.

title: Categorical input machine learning models
description: There is a need for more effective and efficient predictive data analysis based at least in part on categorical input data. This need can be addressed by, for example, solutions for performing predictive data analysis that utilize at least one of categorical level merging, mutual-information-based feature filtering, feature-correlation-based feature filtering to generate training data feature value arrangements, as well as training and using categorical input machine learning models trained using the training data feature value arrangements.

title: Layout method of a chip and electronic equipment
description: A layout method of a chip includes: determining a logic diagram corresponding to a chip to be laid out and a device list corresponding to the logic diagram; and determining a layout diagram of the chip to be laid out, according to the logic diagram, the device list, and a pre-trained layout mode. The layout diagram includes at least an arrangement position, in the chip to be laid out, of each device in the device list.

title: Neural Network Robustness through Obfuscation
description: A computer system, computer program product, and computer implemented method to enhance robustness an artificial neural network through obfuscation. One or more high frequency and low amplitude elements are added to the artificial neural network. The added elements provide a defense mechanism to the artificial network, thereby functioning as a security mechanism against an adversarial attack.

title: Target data party selection methods and systems for distributed model training
description: A computer-implemented method, medium, and system are disclosed. One example computer-implemented method performed by a server includes obtaining training task information from a task party. The training task information includes information about a to-be-pretrained model and information about a to-be-trained target model. A respective task acceptance indication from each of at least one of a plurality of data parties is received to obtain a candidate data party set. The information about the to-be-pretrained model is sent to each data party in the candidate data party set. A respective pre-trained model of each data party is received. A respective performance parameter of the respective pre-trained model of each data party is obtained. One or more target data parties from the candidate data party set is determined. The information about the to-be-trained target model is sent to the one or more target data parties to obtain a target model.

title: Segmenting an image using a neural network
description: A method for image segmentation includes receiving, by a processing device, an image. The method further includes applying a machine learning model to the image, wherein the machine-learning model is trained by a training process comprising evaluating training outputs generated during the training process using a loss function. The method further includes obtaining, for each pixel of multiple pixels of the image, an output of the machine learning model within a multi-dimensional domain, wherein the output is obtained by providing the machine-learning model with pixels of different classes of segments of the image that are mapped to spaced apart clusters associated with different axes of the multi-dimensional domain. The method further includes determining, using the machine-learning model and for each pixel of multiple pixels of the image, a class of a segment that comprises the pixel by finding a closest axis to the output.

title: Recipe providing system and method
description: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a recipe providing system may include a user cooking apparatus that generates identification information on a product to be cooked and cook the product to be cooked according to a recipe, and a recipe providing device that generates the recipe based on performance of the user cooking apparatus and the identification information on the product to be cooked.

title: Machine learning for additive manufacturing
description: An approach to intelligent additive manufacturing makes use of one or more of machine learning, feedback using machine vision, and determination of machine state. In some examples, a machine learning transformation receives data representing a partially fabricated object and a model of an additional part (e.g., layer) of the part, and produces a modified model that is provided to a printer. The machine learning predistorter can compensate for imperfections in the partially fabricated object as well as non-ideal characteristics of the printer, thereby achieving high accuracy.

title: Cross-domain structural mapping in machine learning processing
description: A method of using a computing device executing to interrelate two or more corpuses of dissimilar data that includes receiving input data from each of two or more corpuses of dissimilar data. The computing device computes a pass for each of the input data into two or more encoder-decoder models. The computing device further obtains a prediction of an identity mapping for each of different domains of knowledge from each of the two or more encoder-decoder models. The computing device additionally computes a distribution distance metric as an output from each of a low-dimensional embedding vector representation from each of the two or more encoder-decoder models. The computing device still further computes a function based on each of the predictions from each of the two or more encoder-decoder models and the distribution distance metrics. The computing device additionally updates the two or more encoder-decoder models.

title: Targeted object detection in image processing applications
description: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to train and apply a first machine learning model to identify a plurality of regions of interest within an input image, and to train and apply a plurality of second machine learning models to identify one or more objects within each region of interest identified by the first machine learning model.

title: Method for loading multiple neural network models and electronic device
description: A method for loading multiple neural network model includes compiling at least two neural network models and generating at least two binary model files corresponding to the at least two neural network models. One of the at least two binary model files is an original model file which is taken as the basic model, and differences between the two files are calculated and recorded using preset difference calculation method. A differences file is generated, and the basic model and the differences file are compressed using a preset compression method, to generate an input file. Such input file is input into a neural network accelerator, the input file being decompressed to obtain the basic model and the differences file. The basic model and the differences file are loaded into the neural network accelerator. An electronic device and a non-volatile storage medium performing the above-described method are also disclosed.

title: Computer Implemented Predisposition Prediction in a Genetics Platform
description: A method, software, database and system for attribute partner identification and social network based attribute analysis are presented in which attribute profiles associated with individuals can be compared and potential partners identified. Connections can be formed within social networks based on analysis of genetic and non-genetic data. Degrees of attribute separation (genetic and non-genetic) can be utilized to analyze relationships and to identify individuals who might benefit from being connected.

title: Abnormality degree calculation system and abnormality degree calculation method
description: An abnormality degree calculation system includes a concept classification assignment unit that assigns a predetermined concept classification based on an identification number of a target device, a feature value vector extraction unit that extracts a feature value vector based on sensor data of a sensor corresponding to the target device, a likelihood calculation unit that calculates a likelihood of the feature value vector by using a machine learning model obtained from a learning database, a loss calculation unit that calculates a loss using a loss function as a function of the likelihood, a model update unit that updates the model by using the loss and a model, a re-learning necessity determination unit that determines whether re-learning is necessary from the calculated likelihood when an abnormality of the target device is detected, and an abnormality degree calculation unit that calculates an abnormality degree when the re-learning is unnecessary.

title: Data-driven weight initialization for machine learning models
description: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for provide a method, comprising: receiving input data for a layer of a neural network model; selecting a target code for the input data; and determining weights for the layer based on an autoencoder loss and the target code.

title: Control apparatus, control method and recording medium having recorded thereon control program
description: Provided is a control apparatus comprising a control unit configured to control a control target by a control model machine-learned so as to output an operation amount of the control target according to a state of equipment provided with the control target; a simulation unit configured to simulate, by using a simulation model, the state of the equipment in a case where the operation amount, which is output by the control model, is given to the control target; and a stop unit configured to stop control of the control target by the control model, based on a simulation result.

title: Method and system for controlling a production plant to manufacture a product
description: A machine learning module is provided which is trained to generate from a design data record specifying a design variant of a product, a first performance signal quantifying a predictive performance of the design variant and a predictive uncertainty of the predictive performance. A variety of design data records each specifying a design variant of the product is generated. For a respective design data record, the following steps are performed: a first performance signal and a corresponding predictive uncertainty are generated, depending on the predictive uncertainty, a simulation yielding a second performance signal quantifying a simulated performance of the corresponding design variant is either run or skipped, and a performance value is derived from the second performance signal if the simulation is run or, otherwise, from the first performance signal. Depending on the derived performance values, a performance-optimizing design data record is determined and output to control the production plant.

title: Electronic apparatus and controlling method thereof
description: An electronic apparatus is provided. The electronic apparatus includes a memory and a processor configured to control the electronic apparatus to: classify a plurality of input data into a plurality of types to store in the memory, determine at least one among the input data of the classified plurality of types based on a voice command being recognized among the input data, and provide response information corresponding to the voice command based on the input data of the determined type.

title: System and method for machine-learning-based position estimation for use in micro-assembly control with the aid of a digital computer
description: Control loop latency can be accounted for in predicting positions of micro-objects being moved by using a hybrid model that includes both at least one physics-based model and machine-learning models. The models are combined using gradient boosting, with a model created during at least one of the stages being fitted based on residuals calculated during a previous stage based on comparison to training data. The loss function for each stage is selected based on the model being created. The hybrid model is evaluated with data extrapolated and interpolated from the training data to prevent overfitting and ensure the hybrid model has sufficient predictive ability. By including both physics-based and machine-learning models, the hybrid model can account for both deterministic and stochastic components involved in the movement of the micro-objects, thus increasing the accuracy and throughput of the micro-assembly.

title: Automated chemical formulation apparatus and method thereof
description: An automated chemical formulation apparatus includes: a data reception unit that receives an input chemical material dataset including chemical material information, chemical composition information, chemical formulation information and property information thereof; a predicting model generation unit that trains a first machine learning model using the input chemical material dataset to generate a predicting model for predicting a chemical formulation based on target property information of a target material; and a formulation prediction unit that sets a boundary condition based on the input chemical material dataset, generates a new input dataset including at least one of chemical material information, chemical composition information, and chemical formulation information within the boundary condition, inputs the new input dataset to the predicting model, and sets predetermined one or more pieces of target property information to perform prediction, thereby outputting a first group of chemical formulation data.

title: Waypoint identification in association with route navigation
description: In some implementations, a system may identify, using a machine learning model, a pattern of events based on account information associated with a user. The system may generate a prediction of a time period during which a predicted event, associated with the pattern of events, is predicted to occur. The system may receive an indication that a vehicle, associated with the user, is to travel a route from a starting location to an ending location during the time period. The system may identify a physical location associated with the predicted event based on a location associated with the vehicle or based on the route. The system may generate a new route that includes the starting location, the physical location as a waypoint along the new route, and the ending location. The system may transmit information that identifies the new route to a device associated with the vehicle.

title: Few-shot action recognition
description: Methods and systems of training a neural network include training a feature extractor and a classifier using a first set of training data that includes one or more base cases. The classifier is trained with few-shot adaptation using a second set of training data, smaller than the first set of training data, while keeping parameters of the feature extractor constant.

title: Generating verifiable agricultural data
description: System and methods for generating a verifiable package of agricultural data to determine whether one or more stewardship criteria have been met. Sensor data from one or more sensors, including at least one vision sensor, can be retrieved with corresponding location data. Agricultural data can be generated that includes the sensor data or inferences determined from the sensor data and the agricultural data can be packaged with authentication data to generate a verifiable package. The authentication data can be utilized to determine the authenticity of the agricultural data and compliance with one or more stewardship criteria can be determined based on the agricultural data.

title: Image attack detection method and apparatus, and image attack detection model training method and apparatus
description: An image attack detection method includes: acquiring an image-to-be-detected, and performing global classification recognition based on the image-to-be-detected to obtain a global classification recognition result; performing local image extraction randomly based on the image-to-be-detected to obtain a target number of local images, the target number being obtained by calculation according to a defensive rate of a reference image corresponding to the image-to-be-detected; performing local classification recognition based on the target number of local images respectively to obtain respective local classification recognition results, and fusing the respective local classification recognition results to obtain a target classification recognition result; and detecting a similarity between the target classification recognition result and the global recognition result, and determining the image-to-be-detected as an attack image when the target classification recognition result and the global classification recognition result are dissimilar.

title: Estimating uncertainty in predictions generated by machine learning models
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for generating a clinical recommendation for medical treatment of a patient. In one aspect a method comprises: receiving multi-modal data characterizing a patient, wherein the multi-modal data comprises a respective feature representation for each of a plurality of modalities; processing the multi-modal data characterizing the patient using a machine learning model, in accordance with values of a set of machine learning model parameters, to generate a patient classification that classifies the patient as being included in a patient category from a set of patient categories; determining an uncertainty measure that characterizes an uncertainty of the patient classification generated by the machine learning model; and generating a clinical recommendation for medical treatment of the patient based on: (i) the patient classification, and (ii) the uncertainty measure that characterizes the uncertainty of the patient classification.

title: System and method for optimizing data transmission in a communication network
description: Disclosed are system ( 100 ) and method ( 300 ) for optimizing data transmission in communication network. System comprises Internet of Thing (IoT) device node ( 102 ) having sensors for capturing sensor data and controller ( 106 ) configured at the IoT device node for constructing set of attributes from the sensor data, such that each set of attribute comprises sensor data based on correlation. Support Vector Regression (SVR) models for pruning the sensor data at IoT device node ( 102 ) is defined. Values for each attribute in set of attributes predicted based on predicting run-time errors in values according to the SVR models defined for each of base attribute and the non-base attribute. The run-time errors for each of base attributes and non-base attributes gets compared with threshold error values. The IoT device node ( 102 ) transmits either model parameters for attributes or training data along with the set of attributes by transceiver ( 108 ) to the data collector node ( 104 ).

title: Analyzing data influencing crop yield and recommending operational changes
description: Implementations relate to diagnosis of crop yield predictions and/or crop yields at the field- and pixel-level. In various implementations, a first temporal sequence of high-elevation digital images may be obtained that captures a geographic area over a given time interval through a crop cycle of a first type of crop. Ground truth operational data generated through the given time interval and that influences a final crop yield of the first geographic area after the crop cycle may also be obtained. Based on these data, a ground truth-based crop yield prediction may be generated for the first geographic area at the crop cycle's end. Recommended operational change(s) may be identified based on distinct hypothetical crop yield prediction(s) for the first geographic area. Each distinct hypothetical crop yield prediction may be generated based on hypothetical operational data that includes altered data point(s) of the ground truth operational data.

title: System and method for scheduling machine learning jobs
description: A system for scheduling machine learning jobs includes a user interface provision unit to transmit, to a user terminal, data for forming an input interface to receive job information including information indicative of a checkpoint file of a model to be executed and require resource information, a resource management unit to manage a job queue, wherein each item of the job queue includes the job information and annotation including an expected execution time, complement for an item in which the expected execution time is not recorded in the annotation by receiving the expected execution time from an execution time expectation unit, and execute job scheduling using the job information of each item of the job queue, and an execution time expectation unit to calculate memory usage necessary for executing the model using information of the checkpoint file and determine the expected execution time of the model, using the memory usage.

title: Platform and method for determining critical transcription factors (tf) for tf-based human induced pluripotent stem cell (hipsc) differentiation
description: A platform and method for determining critical transcription factors for TF-based hiPSC differentiation. The platform including: a transcriptomic dataset database; at least a processor; a memory communicatively connected to the processor, the memory containing instructions configuring the at least a processor to generate gene regulatory networks from transcriptomic datasets; determine a candidate transcription factor; analyze an impact of the candidate transcription factor in germline cell development; and output a set of critical transcription factors.

title: Training data generation method, training data generation device
description: A computer calculates a ratio of a number of sets of data labeled as favorable and a number of sets of data labeled as unfavorable with respect to each of a plurality of types determined by values of a combination of a first attribute and a second attribute that are associated with the sets of data, with respect to each combination of a first type contained in the plurality of types and each of types other than the first type, based on the ratio, specifies candidate data to be changed from among a plurality of sets of data having values corresponding to the first type, based on the candidate data specified with respect to each of the combinations, selects first data from among the plurality of sets of data, and generates training data by changing a label of the first data.

title: System and Method for Capturing, Preserving, and Representing Human Experiences and Personality Through a Digital Interface.
description: A system and method to capture and interact with a comprehensive digital record of an individual's biographical history and produce a synthetic model of their personality. The captured biographical history is a detailed record of this individual's actions, interactions, and experiences over a period which may span decades of their lifetime. The biographical history is indexed by areas of data variability and neural network confidence variability to identify points of likely human interest. A synthetic personality model is generated as a representation of the individual's personality structure, biases, sentiments, and traits. The synthetic personality can be interacted with through a digital interface and demonstrates the interaction patterns, triggers, and habits of the original individual. The functioning and the performance of the system over an individual's lifespan are optimized through data synthesis and disposition.

title: Using Deep Learning Models to Obfuscate and Optimize Communications
description: Concepts and technologies are disclosed herein for using deep learning models to obfuscate and optimize communications. A request can be received in a first language, from a user device, and at a first computing device storing a first neural network. The request can be translated using the first neural network into a modified request in a custom language. The modified request can be sent to a second computing device hosting an application. The first computing device can receive a modified response that is in the custom language, where the modified response can be created at the second computing device using the second neural network and based on a response from the application. The modified response can be translated into a response in the first language and sent to the user device.

title: Solar board system
description: A method includes, responsive to first input, actuating a first plurality of valves of a solar board to be in an open position to provide cold water via a first manifold mounted to the solar board to first equipment and to receive hot water from the first equipment. The method further includes, responsive to second input, actuating a second plurality of valves of the solar board to be in the open position to provide the cold water via the first manifold and a second manifold mounted to the solar board to second equipment and to receive the hot water from the second equipment.

title: Neural networks and systems for decoding encoded data
description: Examples described herein utilize multi-layer neural networks to decode encoded data (e.g., data encoded using one or more encoding techniques). The neural networks may have nonlinear mapping and distributed processing capabilities which may be advantageous in many systems employing the neural network decoders. In this manner, neural networks described herein may be used to implement error code correction (ECC) decoders.

title: Context-aided machine vision
description: Various embodiments herein each include at least one of systems, methods, software, and data structures for context-aided machine vision. For example, one method embodiment includes identifying a customer in a shopping area and maintaining an item bin in a computing system of data identifying items the customer has picked up for purchase. This method further includes receiving an image of the customer holding an item and performing item identification processing on the image to identify the item the customer is holding. The item identification processing may be performed based in part on a stored shopping history of the customer indicating items the customer is more likely to purchase. The identified item is then added to the item bin of the customer.

title: Dianet: a deep learning based architecture to diagnose diabetes using retinal images only
description: A method of training a convolutional neural network model to predict diabetes from an image of a retina is provided. The method of training a convolutional neural network includes processing a first dataset, wherein processing the first dataset comprises: extracting a circular region from a retinal image, resizing the circular region, cropping the circular region, and placing the circular region onto a black background; training an initial model using a second dataset to yield a first model; training the first model using a third dataset to yield a second model; and training the second model using the first dataset to yield a third model.

title: Edge accelerator card
description: An edge accelerator card has a first interface, a second interface, a memory and a processor. The first interface is to couple to a server. The second interface is to couple to a storage system. The processor is to handle communication between the server and the storage system through the first interface and the second interface. The processor is to perform at least one task as directed by the storage system, using the memory and communication through at least the second interface.

title: Training more secure neural networks by using local linearity regularization
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for training a neural network. One of the methods includes processing each training input using the neural network and in accordance with the current values of the network parameters to generate a network output for the training input; computing a respective loss for each of the training inputs by evaluating a loss function; identifying, from a plurality of possible perturbations, a maximally non-linear perturbation; and determining an update to the current values of the parameters of the neural network by performing an iteration of a neural network training procedure to decrease the respective losses for the training inputs and to decrease the non-linearity of the loss function for the identified maximally non-linear perturbation.

title: Retrieval-based text-to-image generation with visual-semantic contrastive representation
description: Systems and methods for image generation are described. Embodiments of the present disclosure receive a text phrase that describes a target image to be generated; generate text features based on the text phrase; retrieve a search image based on the text phrase; and generate the target image using an image generation network based on the text features and the search image.

title: Constrained decoding and ranking of language models for code generation
description: In various embodiments, a process for constrained decoding and ranking of language models for code generation includes receiving a natural language input specifying a desired computer task. The process includes using a machine learning trained converter to convert the natural language input to an output in a computer language, including by, based on a specified grammar for the computer language, limiting eligible options for a token to include in the output in the computer language. The process includes providing the output in the computer language for computer execution.

title: Calibration of quantum processor operator parameters
description: Methods, systems and apparatus for determining operating parameters for a quantum processor including multiple interacting qubits. In one aspect, a method includes generating a graph of nodes and edges, wherein each node represents a respective qubit and is associated with an operating parameter of the respective qubit, and wherein each edge represents a respective interaction between two qubits and is associated with an operating parameter of the respective interaction; selecting an algorithm that traverses the graph based on a traversal rule; identifying one or multiple disjoint subsets of nodes or one or multiple disjoint subsets of edges, wherein nodes in a subset of nodes and edges in a subset of edges are related via the traversal rule; and determining calibrated values for the nodes or edges in each subset using a stepwise constrained optimization process where constraints are determined using previously calibrated operating parameters.

title: Device and method for detecting object
description: A device and a method for detecting an object includes a camera configured for obtaining an image frame for an external environment of a vehicle, storage configured for storing a class classification model of the image frame, and a processor. The processor extracts a class for distinguishing the object in the image frame, determines class confidences for each of pixels of the image frame, generates a distribution of confidences for grayscales of pixels belonging to a class of interest based on the class confidences, generates a critical range for determining a grayscale of the class of interest based on the distribution of the confidences for the grayscales, and generates a mask based on the critical range.

title: Systems, methods, and devices for automatic signal detection based on power distribution by frequency over time within a spectrum
description: Systems, methods and apparatus for automatic alarm management in a radio-frequency (RF) environment are disclosed. An apparatus calculates a power distribution by frequency of the RF environment in real time or near real time, including a first derivative and a second derivative of FFT data of the RF environment. The apparatus then creates a baseline based on the power distribution by frequency of the RF environment in a period of time, identifies at least one alarm situation based on a multiplicity of alarm triggering conditions by comparing the power distribution in real time or near real time to the baseline of the RF environment, identifies at least one signal based on the first derivative and the second derivative of FFT data in the at least one alarm situation, and sends at least one alarm comprising details of the at least one signal identified in the at least one alarm situation.

title: Methods and systems for distributed data analysis
description: The present disclosure relates to computer implemented methods and systems for data management, data analysis, and processing. The disclosed methods and systems can incorporate external data analysis into an otherwise closed data analysis environment.

title: Method of automatically creating ai diagnostic model for diagnosing abnormal state based on noise and vibration data to which enas is applied
description: A method of automatically creating an artificial intelligence (AI) diagnostic model for diagnosing an abnormal state of a vehicle includes: acquiring noise and vibration data measured by a sensor of the vehicle as input data, processing the input data, searching and selecting an architecture of the AI diagnostic model based on the processed input data, and providing the AI diagnostic model to diagnose the abnormal state of the vehicle, where an efficient neural architecture search (ENAS) is applied to update the AI diagnostic model and a parameter configuring the AI diagnostic model, the ENAS sharing the parameter with the updated AI diagnostic model.

title: Geospatial Clustering of Regions Using Neural Networks for Autonomous Systems and Applications
