description: In various examples, a cell model that partitions a geographic region into one or more cells is used to determine clusters of cell which share similarities. Sensor data is provided to one or more machine learning models trained to classify the sensor data to one or more cells of the cell model. Based on classifying sensor data to cells of a cell model, similarities between pairings of cells of the cell model may be determined and used to form clusters of the cell which are sufficiently similar in order to aid in the curation of training data used to train machine learning models in order to aid an autonomous or semi-autonomous machine in a surrounding environment.

title: Watermarking quantum models by leveraging metadata
description: A computer-implemented method, system and computer program product for watermarking quantum models. A precision for a parameter of a quantum model on a quantum computer is determined. The parameter is then truncated based on the determined precision. Furthermore, the watermark is appended in one or more positions of truncated portion of the truncated parameter. In this manner, watermarking quantum models, such as quantum machine learning models, is achieved.

title: Systems and methods for learning and managing robot user interfaces
description: Systems and methods for learning and managing robot user interfaces are disclosed herein. One embodiment generates, based on input data including information about past interactions of a particular user with a robot and with existing HMIs of the robot, a latent space using one or more encoder neural networks, wherein the latent space is a reduced-dimensionality representation of learned behavior and characteristics of the particular user, and uses the latent space as input to train a decoder neural network associated with (1) a new HMI distinct from the existing HMIs or (2) a particular HMI among the existing HMIs to alter operation of the particular HMI. The trained first decoder neural network is deployed in the robot to control, at least in part, operation of the new HMI or the particular HMI in accordance with the learned behavior and characteristics of the particular user.

title: System and method for causal analysis of biosystems on chips
description: Methods and systems for operating biosystem on a chip are disclosed. To operate biosystem on a chip based systems, causal mechanisms may be identified based on previous operations performed by the biosystem chip based systems. The causal mechanisms may be used to develop new operation plans, refine existing operation plans, and/or develop new biosystem on a chip architecture. The causal mechanism may be derived from a causal graph that includes nodes representing unknown causal mechanisms. Data regarding previous operations in combination with the causal graph may be used to learn the unknown causal mechanisms.

title: Real time qubit allocation for dynamic network topographies
description: Qubit allocation for dynamic network topographies is disclosed. In one example, a processor device of a computing system implements a configuration to quantum definition (C2Q) service that performs real time qubit allocation for dynamic network topographies. The C2Q service can ensure synchronization between a configuration file for a network topography and a quantum definition file for qubits allocated to the network topography.

title: Channel state feedback with dictionary learning
description: In a wireless communication system, a user equipment (UE) may report channel state information (CSI) using a learned dictionary defining a set of sparse vectors. The UE determines a learned dictionary for CSI reporting. For example, the UE receives a shared dictionary from a similar and nearby UE or the UE trains the learned dictionary based on logged CSI measurements. The UE indicates the learned dictionary to a serving base station. The UE measures CSI for a plurality of channels. The UE reports a sparse vector representing the CSI based on the learned dictionary to the serving base station.

title: Methods and systems for processing read-modify-write requests
description: A memory system comprises a plurality of memory sub-systems, each with a memory bank and other circuit components. For each of the memory sub-systems, a first buffer receives and stores a read-modify-write request (with a read address, a write address and a first operand), a second operand is read from the memory bank at the location specified by the read address, a combiner circuit combines the first operand with the second operand, an activation circuit transforms the output of the combiner circuit, and the output of the activation circuit is stored in the memory bank at the location specified by the write address. The first operand and the write address may be stored in a second buffer while the second operand is read from the memory bank. Further, the output of the activation circuit may be first stored in the first buffer before being stored in the memory bank.

title: Mismatch detection model
description: A system comprising one or more processors and one or more non-transitory computer-readable media storing computing instructions that, when executed on the one or more processors, cause the one or more processors to perform operations comprising: obtaining a set of items that have been grouped together as matching items in a group; generating, using an ensemble learning model, a predictive indication of a mismatched item grouped together in error as part of the set of items, wherein the ensemble learning model comprises at least two detection models that are performed simultaneously with each other to output predictive indications comprising the predictive indication; and determining a final mismatch decision for an item of the set of items, wherein the final mismatch decision is based on the predictive indication, and wherein the item comprises the mismatched item. Other embodiments are disclosed.

title: Automatic file system capacity management using file system utilization prediction
description: Automatic file system capacity management techniques are provided using file system utilization prediction. One method comprises obtaining input data representing a utilization of a storage capacity of a file system of a given storage system; predicting a future utilization of the storage capacity of the file system based on a portion of the obtained input data; and automatically adjusting the storage capacity of the file system based at least in part on a result of a comparison of the predicted utilization of the storage capacity to a current utilization of the storage capacity. The comparison of the predicted utilization to a current utilization of the storage capacity may comprise comparing the current utilization of the storage capacity to the predicted utilization of the storage capacity for at least first and second time periods following a current time period to determine a trend of the utilization of the storage capacity.

title: Computer implemented method for the automated analysis or use of data
description: A computer implemented method for the automated analysis or use of data is implemented by a voice assistant. The method comprises the steps of (a) storing in a memory a structured, machine-readable representation of data that conforms to a machine-readable language (‘machine representation’); the machine representation including representations of user speech or text input to a human/machine interface; and (b) automatically processing the machine representations to analyse the user speech or text input.

title: Generation of Authentication Questions Based on User-Created Transaction Limitations
description: Methods, systems, and apparatuses are described herein for improving the accuracy of authentication questions using transaction limitations provided by users. A request for access to an account associated with a user may be received from a user device. An account restrictions database may be queried to determine one or more transaction rules associated with the account. The one or more transaction rules may have been created by the user and indicate limitations on financial transactions that may be performed via the account. An authentication question may be generated that is associated with a violation of the one or more transaction rules. The authentication question may be provided to the user device, and a response to the authentication question may be received. Access to the account may be provided to the user device based on the response.

title: Stabilizer instrument equality determination
description: A computing system including a processor configured to receive a first stabilizer instrument specification of a first stabilizer instrument. The first stabilizer instrument specification includes a first input Clifford unitary, a first output Clifford unitary, and first stabilizer instrument bit matrices. The processor is further configured to receive a second stabilizer instrument specification of a second stabilizer instrument. The second stabilizer instrument specification includes a second input Clifford unitary, a second output Clifford unitary, and second stabilizer instrument bit matrices. Based at least in part on the first stabilizer instrument specification and the second stabilizer instrument specification, the processor is further configured to determine whether the first stabilizer instrument is equal to the second stabilizer instrument up to measurement outcome relabeling. The processor is further configured to output an indication of whether the first stabilizer instrument is equal to the second stabilizer instrument up to measurement outcome relabeling.

title: Patient-specific auto-segmentation in online adaptive radiotherapy
description: Disclosed herein are systems and methods for adaptively training machine learning models for auto-segmentation of medical images. A system executes a segmentation model that receives a medical image as input and generates an initial segmentation of the medical image for a radiotherapy treatment. The system identifies a corrected segmentation corresponding to the initial segmentation generated in response to an input at a user interface presenting the initial segmentation. The system fine-tunes the segmentation model based on the medical image and the corrected segmentation to generate a fine-tuned segmentation model.

title: Unified query engine for graph and relational data
description: A computer-implemented method for querying by a query engine on a database including relational data and graph data, the method including receiving a query by the query engine, the query being in a language compatible with a first order logic paradigm. The method further includes generating an intermediate representation, the IR being compatible with a first order logic paradigm. The method further includes using the intermediate representation of the query for executing the query on the relational data and the graph data of the database.

title: Indoor environment control system and operation method thereof
description: Provided is an indoor environment control system including: an indoor environment device which includes a ventilator, an air purifier, and a kitchen hood; a thermal comfort device which includes a heater, an air cooler, a humidifier, and a controller; and a control device which, when the indoor temperature and humidity are within a preset comfort range, controls an operation of at least one of the indoor environment device and the thermal comfort device on the basis of indoor and outdoor fine dust concentrations.

title: Landscape sensing using radio signals
description: Systems and methods for landscape sensing using radio signals are provided. In some embodiments, a base station configured to communicate with a User Equipment (UE) includes a radio interface and processing circuitry configured to: obtain a plurality of channel measurements relating to the UE; and determine a landscape type in which the UE is operating based on the plurality of channel measurements. In this way, the base station can infer the UE's landscape without the need for any new sensor or radar infrastructure requirements. In this way, the signaling need between base stations can be reduced. In some embodiments, smaller dimension input features will reduce the computational complexity so that it can be implemented on an embedded base station hardware.

title: Behavior planning for autonomous vehicles
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to behavior planning for autonomous vehicles. The technology described herein selects a preferred trajectory for an autonomous vehicle based on an evaluation of multiple hypothetical trajectories by different components within a planning system. The various components provide an optimization score for each trajectory according to the priorities of the component and scores from multiple components may form a final optimization score. This scoring system allows the competing priorities (e.g., comfort, minimal travel time, fuel economy) of different components to be considered together. In examples, the trajectory with the best combined score may be selected for implementation. As such, an iterative approach that evaluates various factors may be used to identify an optimal or preferred trajectory for an autonomous vehicle when navigating an environment.

title: Systems and methods for personalized guidance
description: The present invention describes a computer-based system and method for training machine-learning models for delivering personalized query results. The method starts by collecting user behaviors, then categorizing each behavior and refining these categories based on additional data. The refined categories are used to create sequential, dynamic inputs that serve as both ground truth and training data for the machine-learning model. This process helps to strengthen the connections between the training data and the desired output, resulting in more accurate personalized query results. The system and method may be directed towards providing recommendations to the user, such as in the form of vehicle recommendations.

title: Proactive and Real-Time Anomaly Identification and Resolution for Automated Teller Machines (ATMs)
description: Aspects of the disclosure related to identifying and resolving anomalies associated with an ATM processing a check that has been deposited by a customer. The computing platform may receive a digital representation of the check that has been deposited. The computing platform may compare parameters associated with the check to expected parameters. The computing platform may generate a validation report comprising an anomaly, an event code associated with the anomaly, and an action to resolve the anomaly based on the event code. The computing platform may input results and feedback into a machine learning model to further refine the accuracy and reliability of the computing platform over time.

title: Monitoring apparatus and operation method thereof
description: A monitoring apparatus according to an example embodiment disclosed in this document may include an image acquisition unit configured to acquire an image of at least one process processing device related to manufacturing of a battery cell, an analyzer configured to input the acquired image into an artificial intelligence model for determining a welding state of the battery cell to generate a first determination result of determining whether the battery cell is defective, and a determination unit configured to determine whether the battery cell is defective based on the first determination result.

title: Api consolidation recommendations to improve web application qoe
description: In one embodiment, a device obtains trace data indicative of application programming interface calls made during sessions between clients and an application accessible via a network. The device identifies, based on the trace data, a set of calls among the application programming interface calls that are frequently co-occurring. The device quantifies a latency savings expected to occur were the set of calls to be consolidated into a singular call instead of being made separately. The device provides, to a user interface, a recommendation to consolidate the set of calls into a consolidated call that indicates the latency savings.

title: Methods and systems for complex natural language task understanding for embodied agents
description: The disclosure generally relates to methods and systems for complex natural language task understanding for embodied robots or agents. Conventional works on relation extraction generally find relevant triplets in a natural language phrase, but neither ground the task nor ground the arguments. The present disclosure implements a Grounded Argument and Task Extraction (GATE) technique that extracts a set of tasks and relevant arguments from the complex natural language instruction. The GATE uses an encoder-decoder neural network with nested decoding technique. The extracted tasks are mapped (grounded) to the known skill set of the robot and arguments are mapped (grounded) to objects within the environment, classifies the tokens as many times as possible which existing sequence labeling cannot do. The encoder-decoder neural network of the present disclosure extracts grounded task-argument pairs from a natural language instruction in a generative mechanism, and grounds the arguments based on object detector vocabulary.

title: Efficient transmission of decoding information
description: There is provided a method for decoding a video frame. The method comprises receiving an encoded video frame sequence data associated with a video frame sequence, wherein the video frame sequence includes the video frame. The method comprises deriving from the received encoded video frame sequence data (i) sample value information of one or more blocks and/or (ii) block information about said one or more blocks. The method further comprises, based on (i) the derived sample value information and/or (ii) the derived block information, selecting from a set of machine learning, ML, models at least one ML model to use for decoding the video frame. The method comprises decoding the video frame using the selected at least one ML model.

title: Systems and methods for predicting response to oral minoxidil for the treatment of androgenetic alopecia
description: Methods, processes, systems, and apparatuses are disclosed for predicting minoxidil response in the treatment of androgenetic alopecia, and prescribing a minoxidil dosage amount, minoxidil dosage frequency, and/or minoxidil dosage routine based on the same.

title: Disease diagnosis method using trained model, and system carrying out same
description: Proposed is an eye-related sign prediction method that includes obtaining an image representing at least one eye, obtaining two or more individual predicted values and one consensus predicted value based on the image and a single diagnostic model, and determining a presence of the eye-related sign in the eye based on the consensus predicted value. The single diagnostic model is trained using training data to output predictions of two or more individual determination values and a prediction of one consensus value in response to an input image. The training data includes a clinical image multi-labeled with two or more individual determination values and one consensus value.

title: Artificial intelligence system for generating action tendency considering emotion and mood according to external information recognition and method thereof
description: An artificial intelligence system and a method for generating action tendency by considering emotion and mood according to recognition of external information include generating primary emotion and mood based on external information of the artificial intelligence system and a preset nature data, generating secondary emotion based on the generated mood, and generating action tendency for suggesting a direction of action decision of the artificial intelligence system based on the generated secondary emotion, and accordingly, an artificial intelligence system capable of smooth and natural interaction with people may be provided.

title: Synthesis of speech from text in a voice of a target speaker using neural networks
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for speech synthesis. The methods, systems, and apparatus include actions of obtaining an audio representation of speech of a target speaker, obtaining input text for which speech is to be synthesized in a voice of the target speaker, generating a speaker vector by providing the audio representation to a speaker encoder engine that is trained to distinguish speakers from one another, generating an audio representation of the input text spoken in the voice of the target speaker by providing the input text and the speaker vector to a spectrogram generation engine that is trained using voices of reference speakers to generate audio representations, and providing the audio representation of the input text spoken in the voice of the target speaker for output.

title: Survey abandonment prediction model
description: An embodiment senses a survey sequence, responsive to the sensed survey sequence, inputs the sensed survey sequence into a prediction model. The embodiment comprises a prediction model wherein the prediction model comprises training a hidden Markov model on a previously administered survey with a corresponding response status as a hidden status and a corresponding linguistic metric as an observation. The embodiment computes a probability of a response status of the sensed survey sequence as an output of the prediction model based at least in part on the previously administered survey.

title: Process control knob estimation
description: A non-transitory machine-readable storage medium includes instructions that, when executed by a processing device, cause the processing device to perform operations. The operations include receiving (i) sensor data indicating a first state of a coating of a processing chamber subsequent to a chamber recovery procedure and (ii) substrate process data indicating a set of process parameter values associated with performing a substrate processing procedure by the processing chamber having the coating in a second state prior to the chamber recovery procedure. The operations further include processing the sensor data and the substrate process data to determine an update to at least one of the set of process parameter values. The operations further include performing a) preparing a notification indicating the update for presentation on a graphical user interface or b) causing the processing chamber to perform a selection of the substrate processing procedure based on the update.

title: Multimodal text-to-text neural machine translation using adapters
description: Methods and systems for adapting a pretrained neural machine translation (NMT) model for translating text from a noisy input in a domain. A domain adapter injected into the pretrained NMT model is trained on clean in-domain data for adapting the pretrained NMT to the domain. Each of a plurality of individual noise adapters injected into the pretrained NMT model are trained on noisy input data from an individual noise source for adapting to the individual noise source.

title: Content based image retrieval for lesion analysis
description: Computed Tomography (CT) and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) are commonly used to assess patients with known or suspected pathologies of the lungs and liver. In particular, identification and quantification of possibly malignant regions identified in these high-resolution images is essential for accurate and timely diagnosis. However, careful quantitative assessment of lung and liver lesions is tedious and time consuming. This disclosure describes an automated end-to-end pipeline for accurate lesion detection and segmentation.

title: Content matching attribution based on a content recommendation from a generative ai model
description: Techniques that provide source metadata associated with code recommendations generated by an automation controller are described. A training data set comprising queries, code recommendations and source metadata associated with each of the code recommendations may be stripped of the source metadata and encoded by an NLP model to generate vector representations of each code recommendation. Each vector representation is stored in an index in association with the source metadata corresponding to the underlying code recommendation. In response to receiving a query, the query is processed using an inference model to generate a second code recommendation, which is encoded using the NLP model to generate a second vector representing the second code recommendation. The second vector is compared to the index to identify the source metadata corresponding to the second code recommendation. The second code recommendation and corresponding source metadata are provided via an interface of the automation controller.

title: Model optimization method and apparatus, and computing device
description: A model optimization method is provided. The method includes: receiving optimization request information entered by a user or sent by an artificial intelligence AI application, where the optimization request information includes a first model file, the first model file includes M operators, each operator is used to perform one matrix multiplication calculation, each operator corresponds to one kernel function, and M is a positive integer; generating a second model file based on the first model file, where the second model file includes N fused operators, each fused operator is used to perform at least two matrix multiplication calculations, each fused operator corresponds to one kernel function, N is a positive integer, and N<M; and providing the second model file for the user or sending the second model file to the AI application.

title: Server device configurations based on machine learning
description: A system, a medium, and a method are provided to exchange data packets over a communications network and perform machine learning operations. A network server device receives account data from client devices that correspond to account profiles. An account engine of the network server device segments the account profiles into profile groups based on a respective balance associated with each account profile. The account engine determines target accounts from profile groups based on behavioral data. Further, data processing components of the network server device determine a method of contact for each target account. The data processing components determine a respective time to communicate with a respective device for each target account. Further, communication components of the network server device initiate communications to the respective devices at the respective times for each target account.

title: Cybersecurity incident investigation automation using natural language training
description: A method, computer program product, and computer system are provided for cybersecurity incident investigation automation. A potential cybersecurity threat is identified and categorized by a machine learning model. Evidence associated with the potential cybersecurity threat is gathered by the machine learning model. The potential cybersecurity threat is evaluated by the machine learning model based on the gathered evidence. A recommendation corresponding to one or more actions to take in response to the potential cybersecurity threat is provided by the machine learning model to a cybersecurity analyst. The machine learning model performs a follow-up action in response to the potential cybersecurity threat based on input from the cybersecurity analyst.

title: Ai terminal of providing ai features and method thereof
description: An artificial intelligence (AI) terminal that is capable of being provided AI features to a connected electronic device by AI processing of the AI terminal and a method of providing AI features thereof are provided. The AI terminal includes a communication module connected to an electronic device, and a processor configured to perform AI processing for providing AI features to the electronic device. When connected to the electronic device, the processor is configured to obtain identification information from the electronic device, select at least one AI feature capable of being provided to the electronic device based on the identification information, collect basic information for generating the selected at least one AI feature, generate AI feature information by performing AI processing based on the collected basic information, and provide the AI feature information to the electronic device so that the electronic device executes the at least one AI feature.

title: Automated generation of auxiliary qubits for error correction
description: One example method includes receiving, from a user, a quantum circuit, identifying, in hardware, a QPU (quantum processing unit) for execution of the quantum circuit, transpiling the quantum circuit, determining, based on the transpiling, an excess qubit count X, and based on the excess qubit count X, performing either an error correction process with respect to the quantum circuit, or an error detection process with respect to the quantum circuit. In one example, the method may be performed by middleware that communicates with the user and the hardware.

title: Method and apparatus for radio resource management in mobile wireless communication system
description: A method and apparatus to support efficient radio resource management is provided. The method includes receiving from a base station an RRReconfiguration message that comprises various parameters for AIML based prediction, performing measurement and AIML based prediction according to measurement window and prediction window and initiating measurement reporting procedure based on AIML based prediction.

title: Automated feature selection for split neural networks
description: A computer-implemented method and apparatus for feature selection using a distributed machine learning (ML) model in a network comprising a plurality of local computing devices and a central computing device is provided. The method includes training, at each local computing device, the ML model during one or more initial training rounds using a group of input features representing a input features layer of the ML model. The method further includes generating, at each local computing device, based on the one or more initial training rounds, feature group values. The method further includes transmitting, from each local computing device, to the central computing device, the generated feature group values. The method further includes receiving, at each local computing device, from the central computing device, central computing device gradients. The method further includes computing, at each local computing device, local computing device gradients, using the received central computing device gradients. The method further includes generating, at each local computing device, a gradient trajectory for each input feature in the group of input features based on the computed local computing device gradients. The method further includes identifying, at each local computing device, based on the generated gradient trajectory, whether each input feature in the group of input features is non-contributing. The method further includes removing, at each local computing device, from the group of input features representing the input features layer of the ML model, each input feature identified as non-contributing. The method further includes training, at each local computing device, the ML model during one or more continuing training rounds using the group of input features representing the input features layer of the ML model with each non-contributing input feature removed. The apparatus includes processing circuitry and a memory containing instructions executable by the processing circuitry, whereby the apparatus is operative to perform the method for feature selection using an ML model.

title: Intelligent teaching auxiliary system and method based on skill map
description: The invention relates to the technical field of educational systems, in particular to an intelligent teaching auxiliary system and method based on a skill map, comprising the following steps of uploading the skill map; the method comprises the steps of collecting ideological education events and ideological education vocabulary to obtain a fusion module, carrying out semantic recognition on a skill pattern to form a professional text, extracting all keywords in the professional text by using a language model to obtain a plurality of value vectors, obtaining the ideological education event and/or vocabulary with the highest similarity to the value of the keywords to form a mapping relation, selecting the ideological education event and/or vocabulary mapped by the keywords to be packed as an insertion example to be inserted into the technical pattern, detecting the learning effect of students on the technical pattern by the model, realizing cross-disciplinary knowledge integration by associating the ideological education event and the vocabulary corresponding to the keywords, and finally detecting the inserted effect by the detection module to be adjusted to avoid excessive insertion.

title: Evaluation weight optimization method based on gradient descent
description: The invention relates to an evaluation weight optimization method based on gradient descent, and belongs to the technical field of training evaluation. According to the invention, a model training mode and a gradient descent mode are combined to continuously iterate and update the weight, and the obtained weight value is trained by a plurality of training samples and optimized by combining a gradient descent algorithm, so that the weight value of the training sample data can be represented, the subjectivity of an expert experience method can be reduced, and the weight value is more close to the index importance in actual data.

title: Method, apparatus and computer program product for generating super resolution image
description: The present disclosure relates to a method, device and computer program product for generating super-resolution images. The method includes generating a second image of a first super-resolution based on a first image of a first resolution by a first network; determining a first residual image based on the first image and the second image by the first network; and generating a third image of a second super-resolution based on the first residual image and the second image by a second network, wherein the first super-resolution is greater than the first resolution, and the second super-resolution is greater than the first super-resolution. In this way, data fidelity can be maintained, signal-to-noise ratio can be reduced, and image quality can be improved when generating high-resolution images.

title: A method for constructing a neural network for dynamic compensation of skin microenvironment based on hybrid Transformer
description: The present invention provides a method for constructing a skin microenvironment dynamic compensation neural network based on a hybrid Transformer, which relates to the technical field of electrical digital data processing. The present invention utilizes a skin microenvironment dynamic compensation neural network model constructed by a hybrid Transformer, integrating the advantages of multispectral imaging and deep learning in design, and realizes accurate perception and evaluation of the skin microenvironment by dynamically adjusting the initial weights of the model; overcomes the static system limitations inherent in conventional algorithms, and provides a more personalized and dynamic health monitoring system; through the use of multi-dimensional evaluation indicators, this technology provides a more targeted strategy for skin care, and also improves the accuracy and effectiveness of individualized skin health management.

title: Double-salient permanent magnet memory motor multi-mode optimization method of improved chaotic firefly algorithm
description: The invention discloses a multi-mode optimization method of a doubly salient permanent magnet memory motor of an improved chaotic firefly algorithm, which aims at the problems that the structural parameters of the body of the doubly salient permanent magnet memory motor are often multi-mode and nonlinear, and meanwhile, the structural optimization has the problems of overlong calculation time, low calculation efficiency, more influence factors, slow convergence and the like, the improved chaotic firefly algorithm can effectively reduce the cogging torque pulsation problem of the motor, and the improved chaotic firefly algorithm is beneficial to enabling a complex doubly salient permanent magnet memory motor system to have better global optimal solution and high-quality quick solution capability, so that the multi-mode optimization of the doubly salient permanent magnet memory motor taking cogging torque pulsation as an optimization target is realized.

title: Dark-light-oriented color-monochromatic double-shooting unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photographing imaging method
description: The invention relates to a dark-light-oriented color-monochromatic double-shooting unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography imaging method, and belongs to the field of low-light aerial photography imaging. The method comprises the steps of obtaining paired low-illumination data sets by using a color camera and a monochromatic camera carried by aerial photographing equipment at night and under low altitude, constructing the integral structure of an aerial photographing low-light imaging method ALICE based on the color-monochromatic camera, constructing a disturbance corrector based on wavelet transformation, roughly correcting a degradation region of a low-light color image in the paired low-illumination data sets to obtain a corrected image, simultaneously avoiding losing of special texture information in an aerial photographing scene, constructing a refinement restorer based on monochromatic image guidance in the ALICE, carrying out refinement restoration on the obtained corrected image, guiding fine restoration exposure and detail by using the low-light monochromatic image in the paired low-illumination data sets, and generating a high-quality aerial photographing image with good exposure and rich texture detail. The invention can accurately generate high-quality aerial images with good exposure and rich texture details.

title: Individual activity position prediction method based on spatial clustering and graph embedding
description: The invention discloses an individual activity position prediction method based on spatial clustering and graph embedding, which relates to the technical field of space-time data analysis, and mainly comprises the steps of constructing a multidimensional behavior track data set; the spatial clustering method based on density optimization identifies individual activity hot spot areas to generate position semantic nodes with space-time consistency, fuses geographic space topological relation, mobile transition probability and user behavior preference into a multi-dimensional graph structure, extracts potential associated features of the position nodes through a hierarchical graph annotation force network, models a dynamic evolution process of an activity sequence by utilizing a time sequence dependent decoder, and introduces an anti-regularization mechanism to output individual activity position prediction results. By implementing the individual activity position prediction method based on spatial clustering and graph embedding, the accuracy of individual activity position prediction can be improved, and the expandability and generalization capability of the model can be enhanced.

title: Method for realizing in-memory computing standard extension instruction set based on RISC-V instruction set
description: The present invention relates to a method for implementing an in-memory computing standard extended instruction set based on the RISC-V instruction set, comprising the steps of: a programming model implementation step, in-memory computing hardware is abstracted into software-visible architecture registers in a hierarchical decoupling manner, the architecture registers include storage registers that map internal storage to a two-dimensional data layout and computing registers that map in-memory computing clusters to a three-dimensional data layout; and an instruction set implementation step: through specific instructions and opcodes, the hardware abstraction and interface specifications in the programming model are converted into commands that can be executed by hardware. This hierarchical decoupling programming model enables the upper-level compilation and the lower-level micro-architecture implementation to develop independently, reduces the cost and difficulty of software stack development, and speeds up the hardware development and iteration process. The unified programming model enables different in-memory computing hardware designs to use the same abstract operator library and compilation tool chain, improving the portability and reusability of the code.

title: A method and system for managing fish catches at fishing grounds based on big data analytics
description: This invention proposes a method and system for managing fish catches at fishing grounds based on big data analysis. The method includes the following steps: the user selects a fishing ground and target fish species, obtains a fishing tag, and enters initial user fishing information; historical fishing information of users at the fishing ground is obtained and preprocessed to obtain a fishing feature dataset for the corresponding fishing ground; a recommendation model is built based on a machine learning network, and the fishing feature datasets of each corresponding fishing ground are input into the recommendation model for iterative training. The recommendation model outputs recommended fish species and recommended fishing spots for the current time at the corresponding fishing ground; the user selects a fishing spot from the recommended fishing spot information to fish, weighs the catch according to the fish species, obtains the unit price of the fish species to calculate the total price of the catch, and calls the payment interface to remotely settle the user's account; this method significantly improves the efficiency of fishing ground management and the user's fishing experience by collecting user fishing information, analyzing historical data, building a recommendation model, and realizing an automated settlement process.

title: Dual-modal industrial defect detection method, device and medium based on SqueezeNet network
description: The application relates to a method, a device and a medium for detecting bimodal industrial defects based on SqueezeNet network, wherein the method for detecting bimodal industrial defects based on SqueezeNet network comprises the steps of acquiring a first image set and a second image set, inputting the first image set and the second image set into a SqueezeNet network for training to obtain a defect detection model, and the SqueezeNet network comprises a first convolution layer, a bimodal Fire unit, a second convolution layer and a classifier which are sequentially connected, wherein the bimodal Fire unit is used for dynamically fusing bimodal image characteristics, and inputting a third image and a fourth image which are respectively acquired under the two lighting conditions of a workpiece to be detected into the defect detection model to obtain the defect type of the workpiece to be detected, so that the detection precision is improved.

title: Drug target affinity prediction method based on convolution and cross-attention mechanism
description: The present invention discloses a drug target affinity prediction method based on convolution and cross attention mechanism, including S1: obtaining sample data of protein amino acid sequence and drug SMILES string for drug target affinity prediction; S2: randomly dividing the sample data and obtaining training set and test set; S3: constructing a drug target affinity prediction model based on convolution and cross attention mechanism; S4: training and evaluating the drug target affinity prediction model according to the training set and test set, obtaining the optimal drug target affinity prediction model, and realizing affinity prediction of drug target based on the optimal drug target affinity prediction model. The method solves the problem that the traditional model has the limitation of capturing the global semantic features of drug SMILES string and protein sequence, which limits the problem of obtaining higher prediction accuracy and efficiency in prediction tasks, and at the same time, the problem that too high complexity in the model prediction process will reduce the interpretability of the model.

title: Computer performance dynamic adjustment system and method based on user operation behavior
description: The present invention provides a computer performance dynamic adjustment system and method based on user operation behavior, and relates to the field of computer technology. It includes an event capture module, an operation semantic association module, a system resource optimization module and an adaptive correction module. The event capture module obtains user operation data and generates an operation event sequence with a timestamp. The operation semantic association module matches the operation event with the operation mode through a nonlinear time axis, and generates a resource demand vector by combining the window focus and the process stack call relationship. The system resource optimization module is based on an ant colony algorithm, selects the resource configuration scheme with the lowest power consumption under the response time constraint, and reallocates resources. The adaptive correction module adjusts the operation mode matching weight by comparing the deviation between the actual and expected response time, and feeds back the corrected matching threshold. The system can dynamically adjust computer performance, improve response speed and reduce power consumption.

title: A method and system for evaluating the new energy consumption capacity of a power grid with multi-energy coordination
description: The invention provides a multi-energy cooperative power grid new energy consumption capability assessment method and system, which are used for completely and effectively assessing the capability of a power system for eliminating new energy power by considering various new energy power generation modes. According to the invention, the particle swarm algorithm is used for solving the new energy consumption capability evaluation model, so that faster and better calculation results are realized, and the scheduling cost is reduced. According to the invention, the running risk of the power grid is considered, and the cost reduction and synergy prospects of the system operators are realized by adjusting the uncertain parameters of the new energy and the running risk cost coefficient.

title: Isoprene rubber polymerization reaction control method and system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing and discloses a control method and a system for isoprene rubber polymerization reaction, which comprise the steps of collecting real-time reaction data and real-time image data of isoprene rubber polymerization reaction, respectively carrying out feature extraction on the real-time reaction data and the real-time image data based on a pre-trained deep learning model to obtain time sequence features and image features, fusing the time sequence features and the image features based on a cross-modal attention mechanism to obtain multi-modal joint characterization, processing the multi-modal joint characterization through a lightweight pre-training model embedded in Arrhenius equation constraint, outputting a reaction prediction result, generating a reaction control strategy according to the reaction prediction result through a fuzzy control method and an anti-saturation integral PID control algorithm, and executing the reaction control strategy to realize control on isoprene rubber polymerization reaction, and realizing effective control on isoprene rubber polymerization reaction through deep fusion of multi-source data and a plurality of advanced algorithms.

title: Intelligent nacelle control method and system for unmanned aerial vehicle
description: The present application provides a method and system for controlling an intelligent pod of a UAV. The method obtains multiple frames of thermal radiation images through the infrared imaging module of the UAV pod, generates a dynamic temperature field map through heat source decoupling, and uses a graph neural network to analyze the spatial correlation between heat sources. Based on the temperature gradient vector, a damping torque matching the wind disturbance is generated, the filtering parameters of the magnetorheological pan-tilt platform are optimized, and the interference intensity between energy transfer paths is calibrated. The threat propagation path is generated in combination with the thermal diffusion characteristics, and the pod deflection angle is dynamically adjusted to synchronize the center of the optical field of view with the threat center of mass, thereby achieving precise tracking and anti-interference control. Used for intelligent pod control of UAVs. The present application realizes precise and stable tracking of threat targets by the UAV pod through intelligent heat source analysis and adaptive adjustment.

title: Named entity recognition system and method based on multi-modal fusion and deep learning
description: The invention provides a named entity recognition system and method based on multi-modal fusion and deep learning, and relates to the technical fields of natural language processing and financial named entity recognition. The system comprises a named entity corpus construction module, a multi-modal feature extraction module, a multi-modal feature fusion module, a feature encoding module and an entity sequence labeling module, wherein the named entity corpus construction module is used for generating text paragraphs and constructing a financial corpus by carrying out data cleaning and segmentation on acquired original financial text data, the multi-modal feature extraction module is used for respectively carrying out multi-modal feature extraction on each text paragraph in the financial corpus, the multi-modal feature fusion module is used for fusing multi-modal features, the feature encoding module is used for encoding the multi-modal fusion features, and the entity sequence labeling module is used for carrying out entity sequence labeling on multi-modal fusion feature sequences of each text paragraph, and finally the entity sequence of each text paragraph is generated. The invention can effectively improve the accuracy and precision of identifying the named entity of the financial text by fusing characters, phonetic symbols and font multi-modal characteristics.

title: Method for optimizing individual bad assets handling calling strategy based on customer image
description: The application relates to the technical field of financial customer service, in particular to a method for optimizing a call strategy for disposing individual bad assets based on customer portraits, which comprises the steps of collecting customer public credit data and communication record data, and constructing customer portraits; the method comprises the steps of carrying out risk classification on clients by adopting a XGBoost algorithm, predicting the communication volume of the clients by utilizing a LightGBM model based on client portraits and risk classification, automatically generating personalized trench conversation techniques adapting to different aggressiveness grades through a large language model, dynamically generating calling time and frequency according to the communication aggressiveness of the clients by adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm to realize an intelligent calling strategy, updating the communication volume extremely in real time according to the response result of the clients to new calls, and optimizing the calling strategy. The application can realize the intelligent, dynamic and personalized telephone call strategy for the bad asset, and improves the recovery efficiency of the bad asset.

title: Feature refinement ship instance segmentation method and device based on foggy weather perception
description: The invention discloses a characteristic refinement ship instance segmentation method and device based on foggy weather perception, and belongs to the field of instance segmentation of ship images in foggy weather scenes. The method takes YOLOv s as a basic model, designs a joint learning framework, and combines defogging and characteristic refinement enhancement perception strategies. Through a state space model and a multi-scale channel aggregation gating strategy, image features are modeled in a refined mode, and the enhancement model captures foggy weather long-distance dependent feature information. And reducing the background interference characteristics of foggy days through the self-adaptive defogging module. The extraction capability of the model to local detail information and global information is further enhanced through multi-window branch feature extraction and multi-angle similarity measurement strategies, the focusing capability of a ship target area and the adaptability to complex haze scenes are improved, and the segmentation performance and generalization capability of ship instances in foggy weather scenes are effectively improved.

title: Back door attack target class detection method, device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting a target class of a backdoor attack and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of computer vision. The method comprises the steps of classifying a backdoor model according to an image subjected to backdoor attack, adding adaptive noise to parameters of the image classified backdoor model to disturb, inputting a test image sample into the disturbed backdoor model to predict, counting prediction results on each category, and selecting the category with the largest number of predicted categories as a backdoor attack target category. The method can identify the attacked category in the image classification back door model, does not need additional training, does not need toxic samples, and has high detection efficiency and low detection requirement.

title: Cardiovascular disease risk assessment management method and system for patient
description: The invention relates to the technical field of computer information processing, in particular to a cardiovascular disease risk assessment management method and system for patients, wherein the method comprises the steps of distributing different authorities according to personal information; the method comprises the steps of obtaining cardiovascular risk indexes of a patient, evaluating the risk factors of cardiovascular diseases according to personal information and the cardiovascular risk indexes of the patient, classifying the cardiovascular risk factors into high-risk groups, medium-risk groups and low-risk groups, obtaining cardiovascular patient data of the high-risk groups and the medium-risk groups, removing samples with abnormal values to form a data set, constructing a cardiovascular prediction model, inputting the cardiovascular patient data into the cardiovascular prediction model for prediction, and calling a cardiovascular disease treatment database according to a prediction result to formulate a cardiovascular disease treatment scheme. The system comprises a user registration information module, a cardiovascular disease prediction module and a treatment scheme supervision module. The invention realizes the establishment of personalized treatment scheme.

title: A query term recommendation method based on dual-class multi-relation heterogeneous graph neural network
description: This invention discloses a query term recommendation method based on a dual-class multi-relationship heterogeneous graph neural network, which relates to the field of e-commerce technology. The method includes: obtaining a target shopping heterogeneous graph for any user, processing the target shopping heterogeneous graph through a dual-class multi-relationship heterogeneous graph neural network, and obtaining query term recommendation results for the user; the target shopping heterogeneous graph has the user as the central node, the different types of goods purchased by the user as type nodes, and the weight between any two type nodes as the edge connecting the two type nodes; the dual-class multi-relationship heterogeneous graph neural network includes: a feature fusion module, an inter-type semantic feature aggregation module, and an intra-type relation feature aggregation module. Compared with existing baseline methods, the SF-BMHG of the present invention achieves higher performance advantages on different tasks and can further more accurately recommend query terms that conform to user habits.

title: Industrial image enhancement method, system and medium based on deep learning
description: The embodiments of the present application provide an industrial image enhancement method, system, and medium based on deep learning, which include: setting environmental parameters and constructing a simulated industrial environment based on the environmental parameters; collecting image data of the simulated industrial environment, preprocessing the collected images, and obtaining preprocessed images; training a model based on the preprocessed images to obtain training results, and dynamically adjusting model parameters based on the training results to obtain an image enhancement model; obtaining an image to be processed, inputting the image to be processed into an image enhancement model, and outputting an enhanced image; analyzing and processing the enhanced image to obtain object detection and positioning information; by simulating the industrial environment and continuously training and enhancing the collected images, the robustness and adaptability of the machine vision system can be improved under complex environmental conditions, and significant improvement effects can be shown in object detection tasks, thereby having broad application prospects.

title: A facial data synthesis method based on wavelet diffusion model
description: The invention relates to a face data synthesis method based on a wavelet diffusion model, and belongs to the field of digital image processing. The method comprises the steps of S1, data preparation, S2, sampling identity images and extracting identity characteristics of the images before each round of training, extracting the identity characteristics of face images by using a face recognition model, normalizing and linearly processing the characteristics, S3, randomly sampling a plurality of style images from a style library, encoding the style images by using a style encoding block, S4, selecting one image from the identity data as model input and the identity images in each round of training, then gradually adding noise to the images, starting gradually denoising the models after the noise addition is completed to restore the images, and S5, randomly sampling one noise image as input before the model training is started, and then gradually predicting the noise images to generate the face images. The invention can effectively improve the capability of the model to fit the texture and detail of the real image and improve the diversity of the synthesized data.

title: A method, device, equipment and medium for short-term prediction of multiple loads in an integrated energy system
description: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for predicting multiple loads of a comprehensive energy system in a short period, and relates to the technical field of comprehensive energy system load prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-element load historical data sequence, carrying out MODWT decomposition on the multi-element load historical data sequence to obtain multi-element load time sequence data sets with different frequencies, carrying out MTL weight sharing to obtain a training data sample set, training a multi-element load short-term prediction model based on TCNT (TCNT) according to the training data sample set by adopting an energy valley optimization algorithm to obtain a trained multi-element load short-term prediction model, initializing a population by adopting a pinhole imaging theory by the energy valley optimization algorithm, and inputting influence factor data of a moment to be predicted and multi-element load historical data before the moment to be predicted into the trained multi-element load short-term prediction model to obtain multi-element load prediction data of the moment to be predicted. The method can accurately and reliably predict the multi-element load of the comprehensive energy system in a short period.

title: Image data processing method, system, electronic device and storage medium
description: The application discloses a processing method, a processing system, electronic equipment and a storage medium of image data. The method comprises the steps of monitoring image data to be processed, obtaining text data corresponding to the image data, wherein the text data is used for recording at least one type of target task, obtaining task description information of the target task, wherein the task description information is used for describing semantic information of the target task and semantic information of related tasks, a correlation exists between the semantic information of the target task and the semantic information of the related tasks, inputting the task description information and the image data into a visual model, and guiding the visual model to execute the target task on the image data by utilizing the task description information to obtain a task execution result. The application solves the technical problem of large limitation of the model to process the image data.

title: Method for identifying welding operation risk in steel structure welding operation and related equipment
description: The present application discloses a method and related equipment for identifying welding operation risks in steel structure welding operations, and relates to the technical field of steel structure welding construction. Based on a pre-trained welding risk identification model, the present application performs risk identification on the welding data features of the welding data in the welding operation process at the current moment, and obtains the risk identification result at the current moment, wherein the welding data at least includes: the operation data of the welding operation and the image data of the welding area, and the operation data is the data of the welding equipment collected by the sensor installed in the welding area during welding. The present application identifies whether there is a risk in the welding process from two aspects: the welding operation process and the welding operation result. In addition, the operation data of the welding operation in the present application is the data collected by the sensor, which is more accurate and comprehensive. Therefore, the welding risk identification model can identify and obtain more accurate risk identification results based on more accurate and comprehensive welding data.

title: Knowledge base implementation method and system based on scene pushing
description: The present invention provides a method and system for implementing a knowledge base based on scenario push, comprising step S1: performing knowledge scenario modeling to obtain a scenario model; step S2: collecting relevant data of the current knowledge scenario; step S3: screening the knowledge scenarios related to the user scenario in the relevant data of the current knowledge scenario to form a candidate knowledge scenario set; step S4: performing similarity matching between the candidate knowledge scenario set and the scenario model to obtain a similarity value; step S5: pushing knowledge scenarios with a similarity value higher than a preset value. The present invention adopts a knowledge push method, which can improve the timeliness of knowledge acquisition, thereby improving design efficiency; solves the problems of low efficiency, low accuracy, and poor timeliness in the knowledge retrieval process; the knowledge push software based on collaborative design automatically obtains the relevant knowledge required by the designer by acquiring the design scenario in the collaborative design process and pushes it to the designer in real time, which has high flexibility.

title: Drug recommendation method and system based on double-view representation and iterative denoising
description: The invention discloses a medicine recommendation method and system based on double-view representation and iterative denoising, and belongs to the technical field of natural language processing. The invention designs a double-view drug presentation module, which aims at capturing interaction between diseases and drugs from different angles. Meanwhile, the invention provides an iterative denoising module to filter out noise history information irrelevant to the current visit and integrate valuable history information for enriching patient representation. The invention solves the problem of insufficient interaction between diseases and medicines in an automatic medicine recommendation system and the problem that valuable medical information and irrelevant noise in historical data are difficult to distinguish effectively due to the complexity of clinical environment. The invention not only captures the complex association between diseases and medicines by the automatic medicine recommendation system, but also can effectively integrate valuable parts in the history information.

title: Intelligent health-care patient wrist strap based on multi-mode sensing and AI
description: The invention discloses an intelligent health care patient wrist strap based on multi-mode sensing and AI, which comprises an identity information module, a cloud end, a medical monitoring module, a multi-mode sensor fusion module, an AI health intervention engine module, an electricity storage module, a hardware module, a physiological monitoring module, a health care intervention module, a communication and energy module, a health care module, a software and AI function, a real-time health analysis module, a personalized health care module and a data privacy module, wherein the identity information module is connected with the cloud end, the output end of the cloud end is connected with the input ends of the medical monitoring module and the health care module in a one-way manner, and the output end of the medical monitoring module is connected with the input end of the multi-mode sensor fusion module in a one-way manner.

title: Fusion data intelligent analysis method and system based on LLM large language model
description: The invention discloses a fusion data intelligent analysis method and a fusion data intelligent analysis system based on an LLM large language model, which relate to the technical field of intelligent analysis, and the method comprises the steps of constructing a training set by collecting historical multi-source fusion data in a network, processing the historical multi-source fusion data in the training set in a data processing mode, and simultaneously reducing noise of the processed historical multi-source fusion data in a data noise reduction mode; and classifying the noise-reduced historical multi-source fusion data in a data classification mode, training the classified historical multi-source fusion data in an iterative training mode to obtain trained historical multi-source fusion data, finally acquiring user input data in real time, analyzing and matching the user input data acquired in real time through a LLM large language model to obtain multi-source fusion data matched with the user input data, and improving the accuracy of intelligent analysis of the fusion data.

title: Real-time simulation method of aeroengine based on convolutional neural network
description: The application provides a convolution neural network-based real-time simulation method of an aeroengine, which belongs to the technical field of simulation of aeroengines and specifically comprises the steps of obtaining original grid data and physical quantity distribution, constructing a training input data set and a training label data set after imaging simulation data, constructing a neural network model, training the neural network model by using the training input data set and the training label data set through a design loss function, imaging the boundary condition of engine operation real-time simulation data, inputting the imaged real-time data into a trained neural network model, and outputting an imaging prediction result through the trained neural network model. The effective area data is reserved by accurately identifying the boundary of the calculated area and constructing the shielding mask, so that the simulation prediction precision and the instantaneity based on the convolutional neural network are greatly improved.

title: Edge computing unloading method for visual application
description: The present invention discloses an edge computing offloading method for visual applications. The method extracts regions of interest and divides video frames into slices accordingly. Low-resolution video images are periodically offloaded to edge servers deployed with target counting tasks for inference to obtain a density map. Based on the obtained density map, the region of interest extraction range of the video frame is dynamically adjusted, and dense areas in the video image are identified. The possible dense areas in the video image are further divided, and the dense areas are spliced into slices. Balanced offloading is achieved for ordinary slices and dense slices. The target detection task is executed and all detection results are returned after the inference is completed. The detection results from different edge computing servers are integrated. The present invention uses a video analysis framework based on edge computing offloading to solve visual application problems, ensuring low latency while taking into account calculation accuracy.

title: Chemical element universal coding method, material performance prediction and composition optimization method
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of material science, and discloses a general coding method for chemical elements, a material performance prediction and a composition optimization method, wherein all chemical element symbols are singly subjected to token; and processing the result of token conversion on each chemical element symbol independently through the trained BERT model to obtain the semantic embedded vector of each element, thereby realizing the universal coding of the chemical elements. The invention can comprehensively express the material composition and the internal rules among elements in an element layer system, deeply excavate the abundant semantic information in unstructured documents, and further improve the intelligent and automatic level of material research and development.

title: Method, apparatus, device, medium and program product for data processing
description: The present invention provides a method, apparatus, device, medium and program product for data processing, relating to the field of cloud computing, big data and edge computing technology. The method comprises: obtaining multimodal data that has undergone data preprocessing, and storing the multimodal data in a data lake warehouse integrated system, wherein the data lake warehouse integrated system is obtained by integrating a data warehouse and a data lake cluster; extracting modal features from the multimodal data based on deep learning technology to generate feature vectors of the modal features; then mapping the feature vectors to an equal-dimensional space, calculating the similarity of each modal feature, and constructing a contrastive learning model based on minimizing the similarity of each modal feature. The contrastive learning model is used to perform distributed management of the multimodal data stored in the data lake warehouse integrated system. In the present invention, a contrastive learning model based on modal features is constructed using deep learning technology, and distributed management of data is performed based on the results of the contrastive learning model to achieve efficient heterogeneous data query.

title: Multi-channel parallel data driven power distribution network topological structure identification method, system, equipment and medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of power distribution systems, and in particular to a multi-channel parallel data-driven distribution network topology structure identification method, system, device and medium. The method comprises: obtaining multiple operating parameters of a distribution network to be identified; inputting the multiple operating parameters into a pre-trained deep learning topology structure identification model to obtain codes corresponding to the distribution network topology structure of the distribution network to be identified; and obtaining the corresponding distribution network topology structure based on the codes; wherein the deep learning topology structure identification model comprises multiple parallel computing processing channels, a fully connected layer and a Sigmoid layer; the processing channels are used to extract features and fuse the operating parameters to obtain fused data, and the fully connected layer and the Sigmoid layer perform nonlinear combination on the fused data of multiple processing channels; the present application can fully utilize diverse data, adapt to distribution networks of different sizes and types, and improve generalization performance, and the deep learning topology structure identification model adopts multi-channel parallel computing to improve recognition efficiency.

title: Flywheel energy storage energy dispatching optimization method, system, electronic equipment and program
description: The present invention discloses a flywheel energy storage energy scheduling optimization method, system, electronic device, and program, relating to the field of flywheel energy storage technology. The method comprises: establishing a coupling model between a flywheel energy storage system and a power grid system; optimizing the coupling model based on a multi-objective optimization function; solving the multi-objective optimization function using a particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain a flywheel energy storage charge and discharge power scheduling scheme; and adjusting the charge and discharge power of the flywheel energy storage system based on the flywheel energy storage charge and discharge power scheduling scheme. The disclosed processing scheme can effectively improve the quality of grid-connected power and provide technical support for the integration of large-scale renewable energy into the power grid.

title: Internet of things data anomaly detection method based on directed graph space-time feature fusion
description: The present invention discloses an Internet of Things data anomaly detection method based on directed graph spatiotemporal feature fusion, comprising the following steps: S1, collecting data from multiple sensor nodes in the Internet of Things to construct a sensor network data set; S2, cleaning and preprocessing the sensor network data in a region; S3, learning the directed graph adjacency matrix of the sensor network through Bayesian variational inference on the processed data to model the directed causal relationship between the sensor nodes; S4, processing the sensors of the predicted target location using a spatial feature extraction module, and extracting multi-hop neighborhood spatial features using a directed graph-guided graph attention mechanism; S5, processing the spatial features of the sensor network data and the directed graph of the predicted target location using a spatiotemporal feature fusion module, dynamically adjusting the directed graph structure and performing data prediction; S6, generating anomaly scores and dynamic thresholds and performing anomaly detection. The method can improve the anomaly detection performance of Internet of Things data.

title: Method and system for collaborative optimization of IP timing convergence and power consumption of memory compiler
description: The invention provides a method and a system for collaborative optimization of IP timing sequence convergence and power consumption of a memory compiler, which relate to the technical field of compilers and comprise the steps of obtaining information of a circuit netlist, extracting a timing sequence path, carrying out wiring topology analysis, adopting a fine-grained power consumption control strategy to divide a power consumption control domain, and constructing a deep neural network model to predict delay, training a decision tree model to obtain an optimization strategy, calculating path priorities to perform functional partitioning, and finally generating a layout wiring scheme meeting the timing sequence convergence requirement and optimizing power consumption. The invention realizes the collaborative optimization of the timing sequence convergence and the power consumption of the memory compiler IP and improves the performance of the integrated circuit.

title: Ship safety monitoring intelligent abnormal alarm system based on multidimensional analysis
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent anomaly alarm system for ship safety monitoring based on multi-dimensional analysis, which relates to the field of shipping safety monitoring technology and includes a safety monitoring center. The safety monitoring center is communicatively connected to the following modules, including: a data acquisition and analysis module for collecting ship operation data from various sensors and equipment on the ship, performing feature analysis, extracting alarm features reflecting ship anomalies, and integrating them to obtain an alarm feature sequence table.
