By collecting and pre-processing ship operation data from various sensors and equipment on the ship, and combining it with an anomaly recognition model and an alarm feature sequence table constructed based on a neural network model, the present invention can accurately identify anomalies in ship operation, avoiding the limitations that may be brought about by a single data source, improving the accuracy of anomaly detection, and helping to promptly discover potential safety hazards and prevent accidents.

title: U-Net-based coding and decoding bidirectional prompting cloud removal method
description: The present invention provides a U-Net-based codec-bidirectional hinting cloud removal method, comprising the following steps: Step S1: constructing a codec-bidirectional hinting guidance mechanism (BPCM) within the U-Net network framework to enhance the network's visual attention ability to capture the required cloud removal information; Step S2: constructing a residual query state space model (RQSSM) within the codec-bidirectional hinting guidance mechanism to dynamically encode information in features that is strongly relevant to the cloud removal task; Step S3: inputting clouded images from a cloud removal dataset into the network, optimizing the model through a loss-constrained training process, and ultimately achieving cloud removal results. The above steps construct a U-Net-based codec-bidirectional hinting cloud removal algorithm.

title: Intelligent prediction model and method for postoperative complications of anesthetized patient
description: The invention relates to the technical field of medical information, in particular to an intelligent prediction model and method for postoperative complications of an anesthetized patient, comprising the steps of collecting preoperative to postoperative full-period clinical data of the patient through a medical data interface; analyzing surgical codes to generate risk features, extracting dynamic features of vital signs, establishing a complication probability mapping relation through a multi-mode fusion network, establishing an optimization model by combining the complication probability and pharmacokinetic parameters, solving an individual anesthesia dosage interval by using a gradient descent algorithm, dynamically monitoring vital signs during surgery, triggering a dosage re-optimization mechanism and adjusting the infusion rate to form a closed-loop control link, and generating a visual decision report. According to the invention, through the deep integration of full-period clinical data and multi-mode feature modeling, preoperative physiological parameters, surgical coding semantic information and intra-operative vital sign dynamic mode fusion analysis are carried out, a nonlinear mapping relation between dosage and complication probability is constructed, and the accuracy and individuation suitability of risk prediction are obviously improved.

title: Region ordered electric power utilization state optimization monitoring method based on self-adaptive threshold
description: The invention discloses an area orderly power utilization dynamic optimization monitoring method based on a self-adaptive threshold, which particularly relates to the technical field of power utilization optimization, wherein an initial threshold is built by continuously monitoring real-time load and voltage data of a power utilization area and combining a historical behavior model and an extremum theory, key characteristic parameters are extracted after a continuous deviation event is triggered, a threshold adjustment trend and abnormal frequency change are quantized, the drift degree is divided into high, medium and low levels, and under the medium level, future recognition performance of a system is estimated further based on a dynamic recognition accuracy prediction model, and the threshold adjustment amplitude is dynamically limited according to the future recognition performance, so that the system is effectively prevented from mistaking the abnormal trend as a new normal state, the generation of a monitoring blind area is avoided, and the stability, the intelligence and the risk perception capability of an area power utilization regulation system are improved.

title: A method for quickly generating videos from text
description: The invention discloses a method for quickly generating a video by a text, which comprises the steps of inputting text data of the video to be generated through a text writing port, adopting a text recognition algorithm to recognize entities and backgrounds in the text data, extracting relations and events in the text data, classifying the entities, the backgrounds, the relations and the events in a preset classifier according to the entities, the backgrounds, the relations and the events in the text data to obtain a text classification result, inquiring video materials corresponding to the classification in a pre-stored video library according to an index relation, carrying out image-text consistency evaluation on obtained abstract keywords corresponding to the video materials and the entities, the backgrounds, the relations and the events in the text data, and splicing the video materials according to the sequence of the text data to obtain the corresponding video. The invention can rapidly generate the authored video by extracting and classifying the entity, the background, the relation and the event of the text data, and can improve the consistency of the generated spliced video and the original text data by evaluating the consistency of the graphics and texts.

title: A nurse shift handover management system and method
description: The invention relates to a nurse shift-switching management system and method, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein the system comprises a real-time monitoring module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the real-time monitoring module is used for constructing an individualized baseline database of a patient; the system comprises a data integration module, an intelligent analysis engine, a decision support module, an interactive shift platform, a closed loop optimization module and a system optimization module, wherein the data integration module is used for outputting a multi-dimensional structured data set, the intelligent analysis engine is used for identifying clinical state change information of a patient and generating corresponding risk early warning scores, the decision support module is used for generating targeted nursing intervention suggestions, the interactive shift platform is used for generating a structured shift abstract based on the risk early warning scores, the clinical state change information and the nursing intervention suggestions and dynamically displaying the structured shift abstract through a mixed reality technology, and the closed loop optimization module is used for receiving shift feedback information and follow-up execution data of a shift receiving party, evaluating the completeness of shift information, updating a nursing plan and optimizing and adjusting analysis and recommended parameters of the system. The system can improve the accuracy and efficiency of nurse shift-switching management.

title: An automatic test case generation device based on a large language model
description: The invention discloses an automatic test case generation device based on a large language model, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The device includes: a data source module, a test requirement module, a generation algorithm module, a test orchestration module, a test execution module and a feedback optimization module; the data source module is used to provide test data for generating test cases; the test requirement module is used to extract Test requirements input by the user; the generation algorithm module is used to generate test cases that comply with specifications; the test orchestration module is used to form test cases to be executed and test execution plans; the test execution module is used to generate data from data according to the test execution plan The test data is called in the source module to automatically execute the test cases to be executed and collect test results; the feedback optimization module is used to optimize based on the test results. The automatic test case generation device based on a large language model disclosed in the present invention can effectively improve the testing efficiency and quality of electronic systems.

title: Distributed energy storage planning method and system for power distribution network based on simulated annealing-particle swarm algorithm
description: The present invention discloses a distributed energy storage planning method and system for a distribution network. Based on the constraints of the distribution network, multiple groups of energy storage parameter values are constructed. The optimal technical and economic indicators of distributed energy storage in the distribution network are used as the objective function. The energy storage power and energy storage capacity of each node in the distribution network are used as optimization variables. Based on the constraints of the distribution network, a distributed energy storage planning model for the distribution network is constructed. The distributed energy storage planning model for the distribution network is solved by using a simulated annealing-particle swarm algorithm to obtain the energy storage power and energy storage capacity of each node in the distribution network. The present invention introduces a simulated annealing mechanism in the iteration of the particle swarm algorithm to determine whether to update particles whose optimal fitness has not been updated, so as to prevent falling into a local optimal solution, improve the reliability of finding a global optimal solution, and dynamically adjust the inertia weight to weigh the global and local search proportions. The present invention can solve the optimal solution with fewer iterations, effectively improving the planning efficiency of distributed energy storage in the distribution network.

title: Neural network model generation method and device and electronic equipment
description: The embodiment of the application provides a neural network model generation method, a device and electronic equipment, wherein the neural network model generation method comprises the following steps: based on various structural parameters and weights of the original neural network model, different first target sub-network models are determined, and according to deployment requirements of target hardware equipment, second target sub-network models meeting deployment conditions of the target hardware equipment are adaptively generated by combining performance parameters of the first target sub-network models. Therefore, a second target sub-network model with small scale and high precision can be used for replacing an original neural network model to be deployed into target hardware equipment, the second target sub-network model has fewer hardware resources, the application range of the original neural network model can be expanded, and meanwhile, the second target sub-network model is one of all sub-network model sets which are matched with the target hardware equipment and has the highest precision, so that the optimal model deployment aiming at the target hardware equipment is realized.

title: Compressed sensing image reconstruction method based on gating recursion unit
description: The invention belongs to the technical fields of signal processing and deep learning, and specifically relates to a natural image reconstruction method applied to compressed sensing. Aiming at the problem of how to achieve sparse sampling and high-quality reconstruction of natural images, the present invention proposes a new deep expansion network with persistent long and short-term memory for compressed sensing image reconstruction. This network simultaneously realizes constrained optimization of image adaptive sampling and restoration, and uses attention mechanism and long-term memory flow to solve the problem of insufficient representation in existing deep expansion networks and the inherent information loss problem that occurs when feature information is transmitted over long distances. An intra-level attention mechanism and an inter-level memory mechanism are designed and integrated into the proximal mapping module of the unfolded network to achieve persistent storage and transmission of long- and short-term feature memory. Compared with existing methods, the method proposed by the present invention can effectively improve the reconstruction quality of the image while maintaining the reconstruction speed.

title: Regulation and control method for participation of flexible load cluster in demand response
description: The invention discloses a control method for flexible load clusters to participate in demand response. Taking into account factors such as temperature, humidity, wind speed, date type (working days, non-working days), a short-term flexible load forecasting process based on the GRU model is designed, and the predicted residential flexible load curve is input into the demand response In the system, the optimal dispatch of residential flexible load clusters is realized according to the corresponding control requirements. The method proposed by the present invention can assist residential users and relevant management departments to formulate flexible load adjustment strategies and improve flexibility resource utilization efficiency.

title: Dimensionless parameter dimension reduction method and system for manufacturing process and control function acquisition method and system thereof
description: The invention provides a dimensionless number parameter dimension reduction method and a control function acquisition method and system thereof for a manufacturing process, comprising the steps of 1, acquiring an experimental data set, constructing a parameter space of the manufacturing process by using a technological parameter in the manufacturing process and a corresponding target physical characteristic value under each technological parameter, 2, carrying out dimension analysis on the manufacturing technological parameter based on the parameter space of the manufacturing process to obtain a series of dimensionless numbers, establishing a functional relation between the dimensionless numbers and the target physical characteristic value, and 3, training and optimizing the functional relation between the dimensionless numbers and the target physical characteristic value by using the experimental data set through a polynomial fitting or machine learning method, and finally obtaining key dimensionless numbers and related functional relations for describing the target physical characteristic value. The invention can simplify the high-dimensional technological parameter space into a form which only relates to a few dimensionless parameters, and effectively reduces the difficulty of technological design and parameter optimization.

title: Operator fusion method and system for image recognition depth neural network
description: The invention discloses an operator fusion method and system for an image recognition depth neural network, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a calculation graph of an input depth neural network model into calculation subgraphs; randomly constructing a plurality of candidate fusion schemes for each calculation subgraph, and testing and selecting an optimal fusion scheme on hardware; the fusion of two continuous complex operators in the candidate fusion scheme is realized by directly merging the external loops of two complex operators after circularly reorganizing the latter complex operator to unify the external loops of the two complex operators into the dimension and the shape based on the intermediate result tensor; and combining the optimal fusion schemes of the calculation subgraphs to obtain an optimal fusion execution scheme of the deep neural network model. The method and the device can solve the problem that complex operators in the image recognition depth neural network cannot be fused, improve the execution efficiency of the image recognition task through the fusion of the complex operators and the fusion of the whole neural network, and relieve the problem of cache resource shortage of the image recognition task in hardware deployment.

title: An emergency logistics system model optimization method based on adaptive parent guidance strategy
description: The invention discloses an emergency logistics system model optimization method based on an adaptive parent guidance strategy, which includes: obtaining an emergency logistics system model that minimizes each objective and its related parameters; using multi-objective evolution based on an adaptive parent guidance strategy The algorithm solves the emergency logistics system model and obtains a corresponding set of Pareto optimal emergency plans. When facing the emergency logistics system model, the present invention can eliminate individuals with poor convergence and dispersion in the newly generated offspring population, effectively preventing these poor quality individuals from misleading the population update process, thereby ensuring the convergence and dispersion of the evolved population. Improve the efficiency of obtaining effective emergency response plans. In the parent guidance strategy, an adaptive threshold mediation mechanism is given, so that the derived adaptive parent guidance strategy can effectively adjust the search direction according to the search process when dealing with the emergency logistics system model, thereby improving the search robustness of the evolutionary population. sex.

title: A stock market index prediction method based on CEEMDAN-Informer
description: The invention provides a stock market index prediction method based on CEEMDAN-Informier, and aims to solve the core problem in the field of financial investment, namely stock market index prediction modeling. Firstly, CEEMDAN decomposition and recombination are used for generating high-frequency, low-frequency and trend subsequences with simpler fluctuation characteristics, thereby creating favorable conditions for further constructing a subsequence prediction model to fully extract complex fluctuation modes of subsequences, and remarkably reducing the difficulty of high-precision predictive modeling of an index sequence. Based on the decomposition and recombination of the CEEMDAN, the advantage of high-efficiency extraction of the long-term dependency relationship of the Informamer on the complex sequence is fully utilized, and a CEEMDAN-Informamer combined stock market index integrated prediction modeling method is provided and elaborated.

title: Text classification method, device, equipment and medium based on BERT model
description: The application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and the field of digital medical treatment, and discloses a text classification method, a device, equipment and a medium based on a BERT model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring sample data, wherein the sample data is text; dividing the text, extracting entity words and extracting keywords; the entity words, the keywords and the text are constructed into a fusion format input text; training the BERT model based on the fusion format input text; and executing a text classification task based on the trained BERT model. According to the application, the entity word and the keyword information are integrated into the input of the Bert model, so that the weight of the entity word and the keyword in the text classification process is indirectly increased, and the accuracy of model classification is further improved.

title: Space-time dynamic system soft measurement method for automatically determining partial differential equation structure
description: A soft measurement method of a space-time dynamic system for automatically determining a partial differential equation structure belongs to the technical field of soft measurement of neural networks. Firstly, constructing a loss function for training a coupled physical information neural network with a cyclic prediction mechanism, and obtaining solutions and source terms meeting partial differential equations for describing space-time industrial processes; secondly, a differential operator candidate library is obtained by utilizing an automatic differential method, and a proper partial differential equation structure is selected from the differential operator candidate library to accurately describe the space-time industrial process; finally, the soft measurement result is verified by using the thermal diffusion phenomenon and the actual vibration process. The CPINRP-AIC provided by the application is suitable for a soft measurement method of a multi-type dynamic system with space-time dependency characteristics, and comprises a thermal diffusion phenomenon in an actual industrial process, a fluctuation phenomenon in an actual vibration process and the like; the method can realize effective acquisition of key variable values of high-end complex equipment, such as an aeroengine operation process, provides guarantee for good control performance and safe operation stability of high-end industrial equipment, and has practical engineering application significance.

title: Optical nano antenna structure prediction network training method, prediction method and device
description: The invention relates to a network training method, a network training method and a network training device for predicting an optical nano antenna structure. The optical nano antenna structure prediction method comprises the following steps: respectively inputting expected optical responses into m trained reverse neural networks to predict structural parameters to obtain m groups of different target structural parameter groups; clustering all the target structure parameter sets to obtain a plurality of target structure parameter sets with different classifications; and aiming at each target structure parameter set, carrying out average processing on the target structure parameter sets in the target structure parameter sets to obtain a final target structure parameter set. The optical nano antenna structure prediction method can obtain various structure parameter groups according to an expected optical response so as to meet the requirement of structural parameter design diversity.

title: Production scheduling optimization method for silo wharf
description: The invention provides a silo terminal production scheduling optimization method, which relates to the technical field of port production scheduling and includes the following steps: considering ship loading operation flow machine constraints and ship navigation mixed channel traffic flow constraints, the ship loading completion time is minimized and the waiting time is minimized. Taking the minimum time as the objective function, a collaborative optimization model of the shipping operation plan and the mixed traffic organization of the ship is constructed. According to the characteristics of the collaborative optimization model of the loading operation plan and the mixed traffic organization of the ship, the design is based on the improved large-scale neighborhood search algorithm and non-dominated The algorithm combined with the sorting genetic algorithm solves the collaborative optimization model of the shipping operation plan and the ship's hybrid traffic organization, and obtains the optimized traffic organization plan. The present invention designs a hybrid solution algorithm based on an improved large-scale domain search-non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm, and solves the scheduling problem with the optimization goal of minimizing the total waiting time of the ship and minimizing the completion time of the loading operation.

title: An unsupervised target re-identification method, device and medium based on similarity screening
description: The invention discloses an unsupervised target re-identification method, device and medium based on similarity screening, and relates to the technical field of re-identification. The method includes: using public data set pre-training to initialize the neural network and memory library of the unsupervised target re-identification model, performing feature extraction and clustering on the acquired target domain image set to update the memory library; based on the target domain image set according to the camera sample ratio Carry out sampling to determine the sampling data; calculate the total loss based on the sampling data and iteratively train the neural network, and use the newly extracted features and clustering results of the neural network to update the memory library until the total loss no longer decreases to determine the unsupervised target re-identification model; obtain the re-identification model to be carried out The identified predetermined target image and multi-target image set; according to the unsupervised target re-identification model, a target image data set with the same target as the predetermined target image is identified from the multi-target image set. Effectively reduce the impact of camera identity gaps on re-identification accuracy.

title: Integrated embedded smoke and fire detection method and system
description: The invention relates to an integrated embedded firework detection method and system. The method includes: S1: constructing an integrated embedded hardware platform; S2: hybrid quantification of a firework detection model based on deep learning; S3: detecting firework targets in forest scenes. The invention adopts an integrated design to integrate image acquisition, image processing and fireworks detection into the same embedded hardware platform. Image data transmission does not need to be carried out through the network, avoiding high dependence on the transmission network, reducing the difficulty of system engineering implementation and ensuring It provides all-weather stable real-time monitoring of forest fires; the hybrid quantitative smoke and fire detection model running on the integrated embedded hardware platform can achieve the optimal balance between running speed and detection accuracy; at the same time, the hardware acceleration function provided by the integrated embedded hardware platform further This improves the real-time performance of the system and ensures that the smoke and fire detection system of the present invention has the dual advantages of high alarm accuracy and high operating efficiency.

title: Semantic communication coding transmission and receiving method based on response network and related equipment
description: This application provides a semantic communication encoding transmission and reception method and related equipment based on a response network; the method includes: using the set first scaling parameter to construct a first response function, using the first response function to construct an analytical transformation network, and using a preset The second scaling parameter constructs the second response function, and the second response function is used to construct the encoder; the image vector is input into the first baseline network of the analytical transformation network, and the potential representation vector is output, and the first scaling parameter is used to scale it to obtain the target Representation vector; input it into the second baseline network in the encoder to obtain the second baseline network output vector, use the second scaling parameter to scale it to obtain the codeword; set the conditional entropy model, and use the conditional entropy model to estimate the target representation vector each time The entropy value of each dimension is used; the entropy value of each dimension is used to determine the symbol number vector corresponding to the target representation vector, and the codeword is mapped into a channel transmission symbol according to the symbol number vector and sent to the receiving end.

title: Internet of Things terminal data classification method and its application based on semantic cognition
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a semantic cognition-based terminal data classification method of the Internet of things and application thereof, wherein the semantic cognition-based terminal data classification method of the Internet of things comprises the following steps: constructing a data fusion calculation model according to the application scene of the terminal equipment of the Internet of things and the reinforced semantic feature vector information of the service to perform data fusion; and performing cognitive calculation through a classification model based on the fusion feature training after multi-level feature fusion, and classifying the data fused by using the data fusion calculation model to obtain a final application scene, associated service classification and a result. The method and the device solve the problems that the sensing equipment of the Internet of things in the prior art generates a large amount of isolated and heterogeneous sensing data at any time and a large amount of data islands are formed.

title: Self-adaptive detection and tracking method based on crowd concentration
description: The present invention discloses an adaptive detection and tracking method based on crowd density, comprising the following steps: preprocessing surveillance video data and generating a data set; training a target detection algorithm using a pedestrian data set and a head data set; establishing a target detection and tracking algorithm based on deep learning; using target position information to estimate distance; assessing crowd density based on the distance estimation results; and adaptively switching detection and tracking methods based on the density assessment results. The present invention combines target detection and target tracking algorithms, employing a distance estimation method to assess density in order to select appropriate detection and tracking targets, thereby implementing an adaptive detection and tracking method that can adapt to any density scenario, addressing issues such as occlusion caused by dense crowds to a certain extent, enhancing target detection capabilities, and improving pedestrian detection and tracking effectiveness.

title: Feature generation method, apparatus, equipment and storage medium for network field strength prediction
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a characteristic generation method, device, equipment and storage medium for network field intensity prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a network field intensity prediction sample, carrying out label interpolation processing on the network field intensity prediction sample to generate a rasterized label characteristic value, determining a basic characteristic sample according to the network field intensity prediction sample, generating a basic characteristic value according to the basic characteristic sample, and generating a network field intensity prediction characteristic according to the rasterized label characteristic value and the basic characteristic value, wherein the network field intensity prediction characteristic is used for training a network field intensity prediction model. By the method, multiple feature values are applied to the extraction of the feature vectors, the features for predicting the field intensity of the mobile network are generated, and the features are input into the neural network for model training.

title: Lantern cognition-oriented road-end vision remote target detection method
description: This application provides a roadside visual long-distance target detection method oriented to lighthouse cognition, including: obtaining the RGB image of the target scene collected by the roadside sensing subject; using a pre-trained image encoder to process the RGB image to obtain multiple Scale image feature map; use the pre-trained height feature extraction network to process the multi-scale image feature map to obtain the height distribution feature map; use the depth feature extraction network to process the multi-scale image feature map to obtain the depth distribution feature map; The multi-scale image feature map, height distribution feature map and depth distribution feature map are processed to obtain the height BEV feature map and the depth BEV feature map; the height BEV feature map and the depth BEV feature map are fused to obtain the fused BEV feature map; using The detection head processes the fused BEV feature map to obtain 3D target detection results. This application improves the detection accuracy and robustness of long-distance visual targets at the road end.

title: UMAP data dimension reduction-based similarity measurement transfer learning method
description: The invention discloses a similarity measure migration learning method based on UMAP data dimensionality reduction, which includes: collecting machining process signals under four different working conditions; collecting tool wear under source working conditions; extracting time domain features and frequency domain Features and time-frequency domain signal features of wavelet decomposition are used to reduce the dimensionality of the extracted data features; the feature vector after dimensionality reduction of the source working conditions and its corresponding tool wear amount constitute a labeled source domain; after dimensionality reduction of the three variable working conditions The feature vector of constitutes an unlabeled target domain; the unlabeled target domain is divided into two parts, one part forms a training data set with the labeled source domain, and is imported into the similarity transfer learning model for training; the other part is imported into the tool wear after training. The quantity prediction model is used to predict the tool wear quantity. The present invention adopts the transfer learning method to construct a new loss function to evaluate the distribution difference between the target domain and the source domain, thereby realizing the reuse of the prediction model under new process conditions.

title: Wind speed prediction method and device fusing foundation cloud pictures
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of wind power generation, and is specifically a wind speed prediction method and device that integrates ground cloud images. It includes the following steps: S1 collects the measured wind speed of the wind farm and the ground cloud image time series data at the corresponding time, and divides the training set and the test set; S2 extracts cloud motion information from the continuous ground cloud image; S3 identifies the sky and cloud pixels in the ground cloud image, Calculate cloud coverage; S4 builds a cloud motion vector prediction model, taking historical cloud motion information extracted from ground-based cloud maps as input, and cloud motion vectors in the future as the target variable to train the regression model; S5 builds a wind speed prediction model, using historical wind speed data The estimated future cloud speed is used as input, and the wind speed data in the future period is used as output. The wind speed prediction model is trained and the evaluation index of the predicted wind speed is calculated. The invention overcomes the shortcomings of single input data and low information content of the wind speed prediction model, and avoids the problem of limited model prediction performance caused by NWP uncertainty and non-locality.

title: Carrier rocket enhanced topological variation evolutionary neural network landing guidance method
description: This invention discloses an enhanced topological mutation evolutionary neural network landing guidance method for launch vehicles. The method comprises: setting a reward function, establishing a Markov decision process model for vertical landing guidance of the launch vehicle, and constructing a reinforcement learning environment for vertical landing guidance; setting an initial neural network population and evolutionary parameters using an enhanced topological neuroevolutionary algorithm, performing gene encoding operations on the neural network structure to generate a randomly initialized neural network; repeatedly interacting the neural network with the reinforcement learning environment for vertical landing guidance, obtaining the total reward, and averaging it as the fitness of the neural network; retaining the top-ranked elite individuals in terms of fitness, and performing cross-mutation among the remaining individuals in the population, recording the population with fitness below a threshold, and increasing the mutation probability; returning to the previous step to process the new population; and obtaining the final guidance network when the termination condition is met. This invention can achieve global optimization and has good generalization ability.

title: Data processing method, device, computer equipment, storage medium and program product
description: The embodiment of the application provides a data processing method, a data processing device, computer equipment, a storage medium and a program product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: object feature data of a target service object is obtained, wherein the object feature data comprises object feature information of the target service object in a target service domain and a reference service domain; carrying out semantic fusion understanding on each object feature information in the object feature data to obtain feature semantic information of the target business object; acquiring content semantic information of media content in a target service domain, and determining the matching degree between a target service object and the media content according to semantic correlation between the feature semantic information and the content semantic information; and carrying out recall processing on the media content in the target service domain according to the matching degree between the target service object and the media content. By adopting the embodiment of the application, the matching accuracy between the business object and the media content can be improved, and the accuracy of the recall result can be further improved.

title: An automatic extraction method of deformation zone boundaries based on convolutional neural network
description: The present invention relates to the field of image processing technology, and in particular to a method for automatically extracting deformation zone boundaries based on convolutional neural networks. First, data preprocessing is performed on original SAR remote sensing images to obtain annual average surface deformation phase images. After preprocessing, Based on the annual average surface deformation phase image, a sample data set of the surface deformation agglomeration area is constructed; then the sample data set of the surface deformation aggregation area is used to train the Deeplabv3+ convolutional neural network model and the ResNet residual network model, and the trained surface The preliminary extraction results of the deformation accumulation area; finally, the preliminary extraction results of the surface deformation accumulation area after training are further optimized to obtain a surface deformation accumulation area with smooth boundaries. This invention uses a deep learning network model to extract and learn strong semantic features of significant deformation areas under complex backgrounds, and determine the boundaries of significant surface deformation areas.

title: A motorcycle engine performance testing platform and system
description: The invention discloses a motorcycle engine performance testing platform and system, which belongs to the technical field of engine testing. The system includes an engine test platform, a data acquisition module, a preprocessing module and a data analysis module; the data acquisition module is used to collect operating process parameters; the preprocessing module performs training data preprocessing on the operating process parameters to obtain the first preprocessing result and update the target features. Mapping relationship, analyze the data preprocessing of the operating process parameters according to the target feature mapping relationship to obtain the second preprocessing result; the data analysis module trains the neural network model through the first preprocessing result, and inputs the second preprocessing result into the neural network model to obtain Test Results. This application performs analytical data preprocessing based on the target feature mapping relationship to quickly select the optimal feature variable type, thereby reducing the dimensionality of the input data and improving the accuracy and efficiency of neural network model analysis.

title: Cross-media data set construction method and system based on scene analysis
description: This invention discloses a method and system for constructing a cross-media dataset based on scene parsing, belonging to the field of transformer oil leakage detection technology. The method includes: acquiring cross-media prior knowledge for transformer oil leakage detection; constructing a transformer oil leakage scene and semantically fusing the cross-media prior knowledge with the transformer oil leakage scene; parsing the semantically fused transformer oil leakage scene to generate transformer inspection images and corresponding text descriptions; and combining these with manually annotated transformer inspection data to generate a cross-media dataset. This invention achieves efficient construction of a transformer inspection cross-media dataset, significantly enhances the completeness of the dataset in complex scenarios, avoids data bias caused by single-media data, and improves the accuracy and robustness of transformer oil leakage detection.

title: Quantum transducer with embedded optical resonator
description: Techniques are provided with respect to quantum transducers. For example, one or more embodiments described herein may include an apparatus that may include a superconducting microwave resonator having a microstrip architecture that includes a dielectric layer positioned between a superconducting waveguide and a ground plane. The apparatus may further include an optical resonator located within the dielectric layer.

title: Action generation method, training method and device
description: The application provides a motion generation method, a training method and a device, which are used for generating motion more conforming to a motion rule in the field of computer vision, so that the expression look and feel of a user to a digital person is improved. Comprising the following steps: firstly, acquiring input motion data, wherein the input motion data comprises data representing a plurality of actions of a digital person for performing motion; subsequently, extracting features from multiple dimensions in the input motion data to obtain motion features, wherein the multiple dimensions can comprise a time dimension and a space dimension, so that the features which can describe space-time relevance of multiple actions are extracted; the generating motion then derives output motion data based on the motion characteristics, the output motion data comprising a plurality of motions representing the motion of the digital person and at least one of the generating motions.

title: Urban rail transit dispatcher emergency treatment scheme recommendation method and system
description: The application provides a recommendation method of an emergency treatment scheme of an urban rail transit dispatcher, which comprises the following steps: step S1: constructing an emergency treatment case knowledge graph and a scheduling procedure knowledge graph through unstructured records in a scheduling log; step S2: identifying interactive voice through voice recognition technology, and when emergency treatment is triggered, identifying entity information in the interactive voice, generating a search statement, and searching in an emergency treatment case knowledge graph and a scheduling procedure knowledge graph; step S3: sorting according to the search content; step S4: and fusing the content of the extracted emergency treatment case knowledge graph and the content of the scheduling procedure knowledge graph. By the emergency treatment scheme recommendation method, an efficient information retrieval tool can be provided for a dispatcher, and the provided scheme recommendation can provide a reference auxiliary decision for the dispatcher, so that the working pressure of the dispatcher is effectively reduced.

title: Multi-dose LPET image quality optimization method
description: The invention discloses a multi-dose LPET image quality optimization method, which comprises the steps of establishing a pre-training network based on dose classification and reconstruction tasks in a pre-training stage, fully excavating high-dimensional semantic representation from LPET images of a plurality of different DRFs through the dose classification and reconstruction tasks, and extracting discriminant features so as to enhance the feature extraction capability of a model; and a SPET image prediction stage for predicting a corresponding high quality SPET image from the LPET images of the plurality of doses. Decomposing the LPET image quality optimization task with multiple doses into two subtasks based on a progressive optimization strategy of residual error learning; and (3) utilizing self-supervision contrast regularization to pull up the distance between the predicted image and the target SPET image in the feature space, and simultaneously pulling away the distance between the predicted image and the LPET image under different DRFs, so that the similarity between the predicted SPET image and the real SPET image is further enhanced, and the quality of the final predicted image is improved. The invention is suitable for LPET image quality optimization tasks of different tracer doses.

title: Auxiliary child autism spectrum disorder rehabilitation system based on VR interaction technology
description: The invention discloses a system for assisting the rehabilitation of children with autism spectrum disorders based on VR interactive technology. It specifically relates to the field of VR interactive technology and includes a virtual reality module, a personalized setting module, an interactive module, an environment control module, a real-time feedback module, and a data collection and analysis module. As well as the auxiliary cooperation module, it provides the basic platform and framework of virtual reality experience through the virtual reality platform, analyzes the status and characteristics of children through sensor data and image processing technology, and uses deep learning neural network models to classify and identify characteristics for interaction and dynamic adjustment. Control the difficulty and challenge of the environment, use progress tracking and real-time feedback to evaluate the development of children's rehabilitation and set goals, use the exponential smoothing method to capture rapid fluctuations and trend changes in data, and use professional doctors to supervise and guide children's behavior and behavior when using virtual reality technology. Response, use professional doctors’ treatment plans to assist with the use of virtual reality systems.

title: Deep neural network training
description: In a method of training a deep neural network, a processor initializes elements of an a matrix. The element may comprise a resistance processing unit. The processor determines an incremental weight update by updating the element by multiplying the chopper value with the activation value and the error value from the weight matrix. The processor reads the update voltage from the element. The processor determines the chopper product by multiplying the updated voltage by the chopper value. The processor stores elements of the hidden matrix. The elements of the concealment matrix may comprise a sum of successive iterations of the chopper product. The processor updates corresponding elements of the weight matrix based on the elements of the hidden matrix reaching a threshold state.

title: Application automatic exit methods, devices, computer equipment and storage media
description: This application relates to an application automatic exit method, device, computer equipment and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining the usage of the first application during the period between the login time and the switching time; wherein the login time is the time when the user logs in to the first application, and the switching time is the time when the user logs in to the first application. The time when the first application is switched to the second application; and whether to automatically exit the first application is determined according to the usage situation. This method can more flexibly and reasonably determine whether to automatically exit the application, thereby improving user experience.

title: Multi-index sewage water quality prediction method based on parallel CNN-GRU network
description: The invention relates to a multi-index sewage water quality prediction method based on a parallel CNN-GRU network, which comprises the following steps: after carrying out data preprocessing on historical water inlet and water outlet data, constructing a water inlet and water outlet two-dimensional matrix, forming a data set and dividing the data set, wherein the water inlet and water outlet two-dimensional matrix is respectively composed of a plurality of water inlet and water outlet input index values; constructing a multi-network combination model, which comprises two paths of parallel CNN-GRU networks and DNN networks; training the model to obtain a trained model; and predicting the historical water quality data to be predicted by using the trained model to obtain a multi-index sewage water quality prediction result, wherein the multi-index sewage water quality prediction result comprises the values of the effluent chemical oxygen demand, the effluent PH value, the effluent ammonia nitrogen amount, the effluent total phosphorus amount and the effluent total nitrogen amount at future time points. The invention adopts the prediction method of multi-index input and multi-index output, and can fully utilize the biochemical relationship between other water quality indexes and the prediction indexes, thereby improving the prediction accuracy.

title: On-load tap-changer fault diagnosis method and device based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention provides a method and device for fault diagnosis of an on-load tap changer based on a convolutional neural network. The method collects vibration signals generated during the switching process of the on-load tap changer in real time, and performs denoising processing on the collected vibration signals. , can effectively remove the noise signal generated during the acquisition process of vibration signals and reduce the impact of noise components on fault diagnosis. By utilizing the characteristics of the spectral kurtosis curve corresponding to the vibration signal, the shortcomings of the non-stationary signal can be well described, and the time variance can be measured. Using the fault diagnosis model trained by the convolutional neural network and SE attention mechanism for fault classification can reduce redundant features in the image and ensure recognition efficiency. In order to achieve the purpose of accurate fault diagnosis of the on-load tap-changer.

title: Bile duct segmentation method in CT image
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of clinical image processing, and discloses a bile duct segmentation method in CT images, which includes using a pre-trained neural network to segment the liver on the original CT image to obtain a liver extraction frame, and using the liver extraction frame to crop the original image. A local image data set containing only the liver region is obtained; the local image data set is normalized and data enhanced, and sent to the Transformer-based axial guidance neural network for segmentation. The method of the present invention can better utilize the correlation information of adjacent slices in CT images, effectively mine local features and global context information between and within slices, thereby improving the accuracy of bile duct segmentation, and at the same time, it can also enhance the continuity of the 3D structure of the bile duct. sex.

title: Marine booster station structure health monitoring method and system based on Internet of things
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring the structural health of an offshore booster station based on the Internet of things, wherein the monitoring method comprises the following steps: arranging an acceleration sensor at an offshore booster station; acquiring an initial acceleration signal, obtaining an initial self-oscillation frequency and adopting a genetic algorithm to optimize; acquiring acceleration signals under the action of earthquake load, obtaining self-vibration frequency under the action of earthquake load and adopting genetic algorithm to optimize; and calculating damage indexes, comparing the damage indexes with a set threshold value, and alarming when the damage indexes are higher than the set threshold value. The monitoring method and the system disclosed by the invention can realize real-time early warning of the dangerous state of the structure under extreme loads such as earthquake, realize accurate prediction of the long-term service life of the structure, and greatly reduce the possibility of fatal damage such as collapse and the like of the structure of the offshore booster station under the action of the earthquake and the like.

title: Service processing method and device and computer equipment
description: The present application relates to a business processing method, apparatus, computer device, computer readable storage medium and computer program product, which can be used for business processing procedures in the financial field. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring service data and user information in a preset period, processing the service data through a fuzzy clustering algorithm, determining the user category according to the obtained clustering center and membership function, pushing the service information to a user terminal according to the user category, and providing a service corresponding to the voice information to the terminal through collecting and identifying the voice information of the user terminal. The scheme can divide the user categories according to the historical service data and push the similar service information to the similar users, thereby greatly reducing the time for selecting the service by the users and improving the success rate of service handling. In addition, corresponding service can be provided by collecting voice information, so that the service processing flow is simplified, and the service handling efficiency is improved.

title: A Data Classification Method and System for Building Materials Based on Data Augmentation and Feature Extraction
description: This disclosure relates to the field of data processing technology, proposing a method and system for classifying building material data based on data augmentation and feature extraction. The method includes: acquiring the text of the building materials to be classified; preprocessing and expanding the text content of the building material names; extracting keywords from the expanded text content; using a multi-level data augmentation method to progressively enhance the semantic information of the extracted text; converting the augmented text into word vectors; extracting full-text features through a convolutional neural network; and extracting contextual features through a parallel convolutional neural network to capture the contextual semantic information and meaning in the building material text description, thus obtaining the extracted building material text features; and matching the extracted building material text features with the corresponding building material types. This method can accurately match building material names with building material types, thereby matching building materials to the correct carbon emission factors and providing a foundation for carbon emission management in the construction industry.

title: A method for diagnosing faults in a self-updating, continuously learning artificial immune system turbopump
description: The invention relates to a fault diagnosis method of a self-updating continuous learning artificial immune system turbopump, which comprises the steps of respectively corresponding a data sample, a detector and classification indexes to antigens, immune cells and affinities, establishing an artificial immune system model taking an ultra-rectangular body as a memory cell, randomly dividing vibration data of the turbopump into two groups, marking one group as an antibody for cell training, marking the other group as an antigen for testing, inputting the antibody into the model and initializing, initially generating memory cells, defining algebraic cells with the maximum memory cell density as super memory cells of the class, defining parent cells of the super memory cells as totipotent stem cells, amplifying the totipotent stem cells and the super memory cells to obtain a trained model, inputting the antigen into the trained model, and activating the memory cells or the empty cells in the artificial immune system model by using the antigens to realize fault type identification and continuous learning of the model.

title: Arbitrary-angle inverted pendulum model training method based on reinforcement learning
description: The invention discloses a training method of an arbitrary-angle inverted pendulum model based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a first-order inverted pendulum state vector of the trolley; obtaining a value function array returned by the environment; calculating a state vector of the next state, and returning to rewards obtained by executing the action and an ending mark for judging whether the environment is ended; storing the current state, the next state, the rewards, the end identifier and the selected action as a tuple in an experience playback pool; randomly extracting a batch of tuples from the experience playback pool; according to a time sequence difference algorithm, a loss function is calculated, a neural network is updated, so that the loss is reduced until the environment is judged to be ended through the end mark, network model training is completed, and models at different angles are trained through the trained models. According to the invention, the difference of training at different angles is considered, the angle is used as a part of the input element of the neural network, so that different action selections can be given by the model according to the different angles, and the training is more flexible and more general.

title: Hypersensitivity satellite task planning method and system considering image MTF degradation
description: The invention discloses a task planning method and a task planning system for a hypersensitive satellite considering image MTF degradation, wherein an area to be imaged takes the shortest sum of strip lengths as an optimization target, and strip decomposition is carried out to generate an imaging strip set; constructing a mapping relation between the attitude maneuver angular speed and the image MTF; constructing a Pareto multi-target imaging task planning model based on a partial order; aiming at the built Pareto multi-target imaging task planning model based on the partial order, solving the model by using an NSGA-II method based on the partial order; and obtaining and outputting a hypersensitive satellite multi-star area imaging mission planning scheme considering MTF degradation of the imaging image in motion. The invention redesigns the non-dominant ordering strategy of NSGA-II aiming at the specificity of the constructed model to obtain the imaging task scheduling which realizes the balanced optimization of the MTF and the observation efficiency of the image on the premise of preferentially ensuring the maximization of the imaging coverage benefit. The invention can be effectively applied to the imaging task scheduling of the hypersensitive satellite multi-star area considering MTF degradation of the imaging images in motion.

title: System and method for caring relatives and friends of evanescent person based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology, specifically an artificial intelligence-based caring system and method for relatives and friends of the deceased. The system includes an emotion analysis module, a personalized interaction module, a grief processing recommendation module, an early warning and intervention module, and a memory review generation module. module, comprehensive health management module. In the present invention, by combining the two-way long short-term memory network and speech emotion recognition technology, the user's emotions are analyzed to provide a personalized interactive experience. Collaborative filtering and K-nearest neighbor algorithm are used to customize sadness processing suggestions for the user, combining decision tree classification and emotion. Analysis technology can promptly identify psychological crises and initiate early warning to enhance mental health protection. It integrates convolutional neural network and natural language processing technology to generate rich memory reviews and help users remember their loved ones. It is a comprehensive health management module with principal component analysis and multiple linear regression. , providing users with comprehensive health management support and improving mental and physical health.

title: Pipeline sight glass phase separation detection method and device based on spectral detection technology
description: Pipeline sight glass phase separation detection method and device based on spectral detection technology. This method performs fault-tolerant screening on the collected full spectrum data, removes abnormal data with volatility beyond the set range, and obtains a stable spectrum with volatility within the set range. data; use the spectral data curve combined with the preset liquid phase state parameters to perform label calibration on the fluctuating stable spectral data after fault-tolerant screening; analyze the spectral absorption intensity based on the spectral absorption intensity of the label-calibrated fluctuating stable spectral data at the set wavelength. According to the discrete and continuous distribution rules, the fluctuating stable spectral data of the preset liquid phase state is screened; for the filtered fluctuating stable spectral data with label calibration, the preset qualitative algorithm is used to perform characteristic spectral modeling to obtain phase separation detection. Model, the phase separation of the pipe sight mirror is detected through the phase separation detection model. The invention has stable fool-proof monitoring, good real-time reading timeliness, easy integration, reliable recording, strong traceability and high security.

title: Artificial intelligence-based accurate quantitative assessment method for arterial plaque of lower limb
description: The present invention provides an accurate quantitative assessment method for lower extremity arterial plaques based on artificial intelligence, including: S1, obtaining the output files of the plain scan phase and the enhanced phase in the original lower extremity CTA image and performing voxel bicubic interpolation calculation processing; S2, comparing the plain scan and enhanced phase The scanning phase and the enhanced phase are registered in pairs; S3, obtain the background image file for training; S4, make the CTA plain scanning phase label file and the CTA enhanced phase label file; S5, combine the background image file in S3 with The label files in S4 correspond one to one and divide the training set, verification set and test set; S6, use the training set to train to obtain the extraction network model; S7, obtain the best optimization parameters; S8, construct the lower limb artery multiplexing system Automatic segmentation model of hierarchical branch blood vessels and lower limb plaques; S9, obtain predicted labels; S10, obtain semantic segmentation images with spatial measurement units and real-world physical meanings; S11, analyze lower limb plaque conditions based on semantic segmentation images and background image data Evaluate.

title: Mask-generated distillation-based heart sound signal anomaly detection algorithm
description: The invention discloses a heart sound signal anomaly detection algorithm based on mask generation distillation, which includes the following steps: Step 1: Preprocessing the heart sound recording data; Step 2: Pre-training using a teacher model based on the visual Transformer self-supervision framework; Step 3: Student model based on the structured mask module and the recast module; apply the structured mask module to randomly mask the projection features of the student model with partial pixel spectrograms; then use the recast module to generate a new model under the guidance of the teacher Feature map, thereby enhancing the performance of the student model; Step 4: Based on the weighted optimization function of minimum mean square error loss and cross entropy loss, input the obtained feature map of the student model into the fully connected layer to obtain anomaly detection results corresponding to the heart sound signal segment . By generating a distillation network, this invention can maintain the classification performance of the student model while reducing the computational complexity. The classification accuracy on the two heart sound data sets reaches 96.2% and 98.7% respectively, and only requires 1/4 of the parameters of the teacher model. quantity.

title: Reinforced learning-based distributed intelligent storage unmanned vehicle path planning method
description: The invention discloses a distributed intelligent warehousing unmanned vehicle path planning method based on reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of unmanned vehicle path planning. The method includes: Step 1: Design and train a path planning model for intelligent warehousing unmanned vehicles; Step 2: Detect environmental information through the unmanned vehicle and input it into the trained path planning model; Step 3: Run the path planning model Obtain the real-time path planning solution; step one includes: S1, use the python program to generate a raster map for training; S2, model the path planning problem of the intelligent warehousing unmanned vehicle into a Markov decision process based on the raster map and establish Path planning model. In the category of distributed planning algorithms, the present invention also adds a communication mechanism between unmanned vehicles, thereby improving the generalization ability of the multi-unmanned vehicle system in a warehousing environment to various map sizes and obstacle densities, and improving the planning of reasonable paths. The efficiency is better suited to the application in actual scenarios.

title: A random configuration network prediction method for building energy consumption based on search interval reconstruction
description: The invention provides a random configuration network prediction building energy consumption method based on search interval reconstruction, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of sorting historical data of a building to generate a historical data set; establishing an initial building energy consumption prediction model based on a random configuration network, distributing a search range based on mutual information, randomly generating an input weight of an hidden layer in a corresponding search range, and calculating an output weight of the hidden layer; calculating the output error of the building energy consumption prediction model by using the historical data set, if the accuracy requirement is not met, adding a hidden layer neuron, and calculating the output error of the building energy consumption prediction model after adding the neuron; if the precision requirement is met, a final building energy consumption prediction model is obtained; and inputting the related parameters of the current building as input vectors to obtain a final building energy consumption prediction model, and obtaining a current energy consumption prediction value. The invention can achieve the same accuracy with fewer hidden layer neurons and without increasing computational complexity.

title: A PCBA intelligent detection system and method based on data analysis
description: The invention discloses a PCBA intelligent detection system and method based on data analysis, which relates to the technical field of PCBA detection, obtains the corresponding relationship between defect features and characteristic elements, demarcates a to-be-detected area according to the characteristic elements, evaluates whether the characteristic elements are clear through a clear image evaluation function, re-acquires a picture corresponding to an unclear area, analyzes the change of the number of defects in defect types and PCBA types, sets a first detection mode and a second detection mode, adjusts the detection mode of a picture acquisition device, constructs a model of PCBA defect detection time and picture resolution, calculates a first detection resolution adopted by the first detection mode, sets a second detection resolution of the second detection mode according to the number of defects of different defect types, adopts a corresponding resolution according to the detection mode, and adjusts the picture resolution when obtaining a complete picture of the PCBA.

title: Data preprocessing bias eliminating method and device based on data re-weighting
description: The present invention discloses a data preprocessing bias elimination method and device based on data reweighting, by accurately modeling the impact of each training sample on fairness and predictive utility, and calculating individuals based on the impact of fairness and utility constraints. Weights to achieve fairness by reducing utility costs.

title: Air quality grade prediction method based on LSTM-WaveNet
description: The invention discloses an air quality prediction method based on LSTM‑WaveNet, which relates to deep learning related fields. The method includes: performing data preprocessing on the pollutant data set; inserting WaveNet residual blocks between the long short-term memory network LSTM unit blocks as the backbone network; inputting the pollutant concentration data into the backbone network for feature extraction, and the data flow passes through The LSTM unit block and WaveNet residual block extract the time-varying characteristics of pollutant concentration and the correlation characteristics with influencing factors such as wind direction, temperature and humidity; input the feature data output from the backbone network into the attention mechanism network to calculate the weight of different features ratio to predict air quality levels using attention-weighted features.

title: Environmental monitoring methods and systems based on machine learning
description: The invention discloses an environment monitoring method and system based on machine learning. The invention belongs to the technical field of environmental monitoring, in particular to an environmental monitoring method and system based on machine learning, wherein the scheme realizes the optimization processing of data through self-adaptive filtering, local binary processing and wavelet transformation; and searching the optimal parameters of the model by designing an adaptive search position function based on inertial weight value optimization, and designing a boundary backtracking function to backtrack and adjust the search direction.

title: Method for monitoring active feedback based on face and limb recognition state of virtual person
description: The invention discloses a method for active feedback based on face and body recognition status monitoring of virtual humans, which includes a control system, a cloud database, an image processing module and a display device. The display device is also provided with a camera module, a display module and a display module. The voice interaction module can identify the user. After passing the identification, it can say hello to the user, and regularly detect the user's body movements to determine whether the user has fallen, thereby sending a message to the preset recipient, thereby enabling the user to Get timely help and reduce the occurrence of some accidents. At the same time, it also has an emotion recognition function, which can correspondingly control the voice interaction module to communicate with users, thereby providing more humane and considerate services.

title: Day-ahead multi-stage optimal dispatching method for power systems based on random scenario generation
description: The invention relates to a day-ahead multi-stage optimal dispatching method for a power system based on random scenario generation. The method includes: generating a day-ahead new energy prediction random scenario based on the previous day's wind-solar output data of the power system through a conditional generation adversarial network; reducing the day-ahead New energy forecast random scenarios, and use scenario trees to describe day-ahead new energy forecast random scenarios after reduction; build a day-ahead multi-stage stochastic optimization dispatch model for power systems containing new energy; day-ahead new energy forecast random scenarios based on scenario trees describe the impact on electric power The system day-ahead multi-stage dispatch model is solved through the stochastic dual dynamic integer programming algorithm to achieve day-ahead multi-stage optimal dispatch of the power system. Therefore, the multi-stage stochastic optimization dispatch model of the present invention can change the decisions of each stage according to the realization of new energy sources, while taking into account the realization of uncertainty factors in subsequent stages.

title: An intelligent wireless network speed evaluation system based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless network speed supervision. Specifically, it is an intelligent wireless network speed evaluation system based on artificial intelligence, including a server, a data collection and packaging module, an AI processing evaluation module, a wireless network speed detection and analysis module, and a network equipment diagnosis module. and network supervision end; the present invention collects the data flow information of the wireless network in real time through the data collection and packaging module and generates a network speed packet to be analyzed, and the AI processing and evaluation module evaluates and analyzes the wireless network speed based on the network speed packet to be analyzed to identify the wireless network. If there are any anomalies, the wireless network speed detection module analyzes the abnormal information received per unit time, and can automatically, quickly and accurately evaluate the wireless network speed, improve the efficiency and accuracy of wireless network management, and generate and analyze errors. When the signal is qualified, the network equipment diagnostic module is used to diagnose and analyze the wireless network equipment, effectively ensuring subsequent wireless network speed performance and significantly reducing the management difficulty for network supervisors.

title: Efficient bottom-up map position missing identification method
description: The invention discloses an efficient bottom-up map position missing identification method, which includes the following steps: S1, data preparation; S2, training of map key point detection model: preprocessing and combining data; performing high-resolution features Extraction; convert high-resolution features into heat maps, and predict the embedding vector of each key point; obtain the prediction results, calculate the mean square error loss with the real annotations to perform back propagation for model optimization; until the model is optimized to reach the output standard, Complete training; S3, model quantification; S4, map key point detection model inference, and output map location missing identification results. This invention improves the efficiency of detecting problematic maps from massive data while ensuring accuracy. It can directly locate key points of the map on the input picture, which has high efficiency. At the same time, the required computing and storage resources are relatively limited, which can meet the needs of The processing of massive data and the actual deployment requirements of services.

title: Polar motion forecasting method and system based on GA algorithm optimization BP neural network
description: The present invention provides a polar motion prediction method and system based on GA algorithm optimizing BP neural network, which belongs to the technical field of geodesy and satellite navigation. It includes: using LS model to fit linear trend terms and periodic terms, and obtaining fitting residuals. sequence; determine different neural network structures and parameters for different forecast spans; determine the population initialization range and fitness function of the GA algorithm; use the GA algorithm to optimize the initial weights and thresholds of the determined network; and then use the optimized initial values Assign it to the neural network, and use the residual sequence for training and extrapolation forecasting; finally, the network forecast value and the LS fitting forecast value are added to obtain the final forecast value. By taking into account that different forecast spans have different optimal network structures, and at the same time utilizing the role of the multi-parameter GA optimization algorithm in the initial value optimization of the BP neural network algorithm, the present invention effectively improves the stability and performance of polar motion forecasting using the BP neural network. Overall accuracy.

title: Energy micro-grid system operation optimization control method and device
description: The invention provides an energy micro-grid system operation optimization control method and device, and belongs to the technical field of energy micro-grid control.
