The method comprises the following steps: s1: acquiring heavy correlation between multiple influencing factors and multiple loads, and acquiring heavy correlation factors according to the heavy correlation; s2: constructing a deep learning network model, and predicting and acquiring operation data through the deep learning network model based on heavy correlation factors and multi-element load data; s3: and constructing a mixed integer nonlinear model, and solving the operation data through the mixed integer nonlinear model based on a plurality of equipment models and a comprehensive demand response mechanism to obtain an operation control strategy. According to the invention, the influence of coupling characteristic factors on the operation of the whole system is considered, the comprehensive demand response excitation strategy is designed to guide the operation optimization control of the energy micro-grid system, the optimal state of the system operation is obtained, and the reference and support are provided for the operation optimization control of the actual energy micro-grid system.

title: Method for realizing migration fault diagnosis among different domains by data enhancement of small sample problem data
description: The present invention provides a data enhancement method for small sample problem data to realize migration fault diagnosis between different domains, which can perform data enhancement on small sample problems, overcome the difficulty of sample scarcity, improve the stability of sample data distribution, and improve the generalization of diagnostic models. Ability, is an effective rolling bearing small sample data migration fault diagnosis method. In view of the fact that when the small sample data is insufficient, the formation and update of the weight parameters of the migration diagnosis model are easily affected by special samples, making the model unstable, a data enhancement method based on the small sample problem is proposed to realize migration diagnosis between different domains. , realizing rolling bearing fault diagnosis. And it has enriched and improved the feature extraction and fault diagnosis methods to a certain extent, and the accuracy has been greatly improved. It is suitable for rolling bearing status detection and fault diagnosis when industrial data is scarce.

title: Image classification pre-training model continuous learning method based on low-rank adaptive combination
description: The invention discloses a continuous learning method of image classification pre-training model based on low-rank adaptive combination, and belongs to the field of image classification. The present invention proposes that (1) the weight changes of the pre-training model have low rank in the continuous process, so LoRA is a fine-tuning method more suitable for the continuous learning of the pre-training model, (2) a weighted combination of LoRA modules In this way, by updating the LoRA module and weighting coefficient corresponding to the current task, it helps the model combine the knowledge of new and old tasks and find a balance between plasticity and stability; (3) An orthogonal loss is used to constrain the LoRA module corresponding to the current task. Parameter updating prevents the knowledge learned by the model on new and old tasks from interfering with each other, further improving the model's plasticity. In addition, the method proposed in the present invention can be combined with a playback-based method or a playback-free method to show excellent performance on multiple data sets.

title: Power transmission line tower bird nest lightweight detection method integrating SheffleNet and CBAM
description: The present invention discloses a lightweight detection method for transmission line tower bird's nest that integrates ShuffleNet and CBAM. It expands the data set through random transformation of original image channels and sizes. In order to better extract features, it improves the existing target detection algorithm. The backbone network CSPDarknet53 extracts features in images for the lightweight network ShuffleNet, which not only improves the calculation speed, but also increases the applicability of the target detection model. In addition, in the Neck layer, the CBAM hybrid attention mechanism is introduced to extract purer features of the tower bird's nest, and the 9*9 pooling and 13*13 pooling in the SPP network structure are changed to average pooling. 1*1 pooling and 5*5 pooling keep the maximum pooling unchanged, integrating and retaining more feature information without reducing the amount of calculation and network training speed. Finally, transfer learning is introduced to avoid unsatisfactory model training results caused by missing training set samples.

title: Active area electric energy meter reliability prediction method based on optimized LSTM
description: A reliability method and system for active power meter based on optimized LSTM. Collect and preprocess historical fault data of smart energy meters, establish a smart energy meter failure fault tree, and classify fault types into energy meter failure modes; determine the stage failure rate and cumulative failure rate of a single fault mode of the electric energy meter, and conduct threats to a single fault mode. Boolean fitting is used to optimize the fault mode prediction results, and the instantaneous failure rates of all fault modes are accumulated to obtain the overall failure rate of the electric energy meter; the LSTM model is optimized based on the improved dung beetle algorithm to obtain the SLG‑DBO‑LSTM model; the SLG‑DBO‑LSTM model is used to The failure rate of smart energy meters in the active station area is predicted and the remaining life of the smart energy meters is obtained. The invention realizes the failure rate analysis of the smart electric energy meter in the active station area without setting up additional equipment and reduces operating costs.

title: Multi-main-body data combination method, system, server and terminal equipment
description: This disclosure proposes a multi-subject data union method, system, server and terminal device. The original data is distributed among K data owners. The original data includes instrumental variables, exposure factors and outcome variables. The method includes: K data owners Use the first encryption key to encrypt its own instrumental variables and exposure factors; receive the encrypted instrumental variables and exposure factors and obtain the first regression coefficient; K data owners use the first regression coefficient and their own instrumental variables to obtain their own Predicted values of exposure factors, and use the second encryption key to encrypt the predicted values and outcome variables; receive the encrypted predicted values and outcome variables and obtain the second regression coefficient; K data owners decrypt the second regression coefficient , to obtain the regression coefficient between the predicted value of the exposure factors and the outcome variables in the original data. Thus, on the premise of ensuring data privacy, cross-institutional sharing and fusion of data can be achieved, and Mendelian randomization analysis can be completed.

title: A data identification method, device, equipment and medium
description: The invention discloses a data identification method, device, equipment and medium. The method includes: obtaining the consumption record of the target user to be identified; determining the actual risk probability of the target user based on the consumption record to be identified, a randomly generated one-dimensional convolution kernel and a pre-generated target weight value; wherein the target weight value is based on the target The target shapelets and key time points determined by the user's matching target transaction time series data are obtained; the target user's transaction risk level is determined based on the actual risk probability and the pre-configured risk probability threshold. The invention avoids the phenomenon that the relative time point information is ignored due to the translation invariance characteristics of Shapelets, thereby causing the classification effect to deteriorate; it improves the identification efficiency and accuracy of risk probability.

title: An impeller weld positioning method integrating genetic algorithm and deep learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of impeller welding, in particular to an impeller welding seam positioning method integrating genetic algorithm and deep learning, which comprises the steps of (1) obtaining impeller welding seam data scanned by laser; (2) Manufacturing the impeller weld data based on a deep learning data set; (3) Judging whether the input impeller image is of a spot welding point type or not by adopting an image classification model based on deep learning and a histogram and processing algorithm; (4) Respectively carrying out weld joint region segmentation on the welding joint images of the spot welding type or the non-spot welding type by adopting a semantic segmentation model fused with a genetic algorithm to obtain segmented regions; and (5) adopting a weld positioning algorithm to position the weld joint of the divided areas. The method adopts an image classification model based on deep learning, so that the influence of special conditions of spot welding points on the model precision is reduced; the pixel-level positioning of the weld joint image is realized by adopting the semantic segmentation model, a genetic algorithm is fused, and the method has the characteristics of high robustness and high precision.

title: Dam time sequence reconstruction network and construction method thereof
description: The invention relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering, in particular to a dam time sequence reconstruction network and a construction method thereof; the method comprises an input matrix, a dam time sequence generator, a dam time sequence reconstruction matrix, a dam time sequence discriminator and a dam time sequence evaluation matrix; the input matrix is used for matrix input; the dam time sequence generator is used for time sequence extraction and generating a dam time sequence reconstruction matrix; the dam time sequence discriminator is used for discriminating each numerical value of the dam time sequence reconstruction matrix; the construction process is as follows: extracting time sequence characteristics by adopting a dam time sequence generator, and generating a dam time sequence reconstruction matrix; identifying each value of the dam time sequence reconstruction matrix by adopting a dam time sequence identifier; training the countermeasure iteration through a dam time sequence discriminator; learning a distribution model in the dam monitoring data by adopting a dam time sequence generator; by the method, accurate reconstruction of dam monitoring data under the condition of incomplete data sets is achieved.

title: Intelligent management and control system suitable for industrial enterprise production site environment risk
description: The invention provides an intelligent management and control system suitable for environmental risks in industrial enterprise production sites, which relates to the field of data processing and comprises the following components: the environment monitoring module comprises a plurality of types of environment data used for collecting production sites; the environment monitoring module is also used for establishing a plurality of monitoring point association maps; the edge calculation module is used for determining the environmental risk information of the production field area; the pipe network monitoring module is used for determining the damage risk and the mixed drainage risk of the pipe network; the treatment monitoring module is used for determining parallel risks of production and treatment; the hazardous waste monitoring module is used for determining the mixing risk and the hazardous waste leakage risk of a hazardous waste placement area of the production site; the operation monitoring module is used for acquiring operation image information of the production site and determining operation risk of the production site; the risk management and control module is used for managing and controlling the production field environment and has the advantages of improving the accuracy and comprehensiveness of monitoring the production field environment of industrial enterprises and the quality of intelligent management and control of the production field environment risk.

title: A method, device, equipment and storage medium for automatically generating dental arch curves
description: The invention relates to the field of medical image processing, and in particular to a method, device, equipment and storage medium for automatically generating dental arch curves. The method includes: obtaining an oral CBCT image; performing tooth centroid detection on the oral CBCT image to obtain the centroid coordinates of each tooth in the LPS coordinate system; and using the K-Means clustering algorithm to cluster the tooth centroid coordinates , to separate the upper and lower jaws; use the least squares method to fit the sorted set of centroid points to obtain the dental arch curve. Since the CT value of the tooth itself is very high and the structure is relatively fixed, the present invention can obtain stable output results. In addition, after obtaining the tooth detection model, the method provided by the present invention can automatically calculate the entire process, accurately obtain the dental arch curve position, and avoid Manual participation improves processing efficiency.

title: Hierarchical management method and system for transmission line protection lines based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention discloses a hierarchical management method and system for transmission line protection lines based on artificial intelligence. Parameter information of the transmission line is obtained in real time through multiple monitoring devices; the obtained transmission line information is preprocessed, and the processed The transmission line information is divided into training set, verification set and test set; quantifiable and measurable indicators of each factor are selected, each factor is given corresponding weight, a machine learning algorithm model and a deep learning algorithm model are constructed, and the machine learning algorithm model is adopted and deep learning algorithm models to classify the transmission lines in the test set respectively; prioritize the transmission lines according to the classification results to determine different levels of power protection lines; formulate different inspections and maintenance according to different levels of power protection lines Strategy; through the application of artificial intelligence technology, the accuracy and timeliness of classification of power protection lines can be greatly improved, and the power supply needs of different users and equipment can be better met.

title: Systems and methods for NMR analysis of physiological conditions in analytes
description: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for analyzing physiological conditions in analytes. In particular, the present disclosure relates to systems, components and methods of such systems for analyzing physiological conditions in analytes using hyperpolarization (HP) and magnetic resonance (MR) techniques.

title: On-orbit external parameter calibration method for monocular camera and laser radar
description: The invention discloses an on-orbit external parameter calibration method for a monocular camera and a laser radar, which comprises the following steps: firstly, extracting image edges from an original image through a Canny edge extraction algorithm to obtain an edge map, then performing image distance transformation operation on the edge map to obtain a distance map, and then combining the edge map and the distance map to obtain a search scene map. And extracting point cloud edge features such as depth discontinuous points, broken line points, edge points and the like from the original point cloud. And constructing an optimized objective function by combining the search scene graph and the point cloud edge characteristics, and searching the optimal external parameters by utilizing a genetic algorithm to finally realize the external parameter calibration of the monocular camera and the laser radar.

title: Positioning method and device in autonomous docking process of underwater vehicle
description: The invention provides a positioning method and a positioning device in an autonomous docking process of an underwater vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting the sound image acquired by the multi-beam sonar into a target detection depth network, and acquiring a first output result, wherein the first output result comprises a boundary frame coordinate set and a feature confidence coefficient set which are respectively corresponding to global features and local features; based on a feature matching reference threshold, matching the global feature and the local feature to obtain a first matching result, wherein the first matching result comprises a boundary frame coordinate set of the global feature and the matched local feature; tracking the first matching result by using a Kalman filter to obtain a position prediction result; inputting the first matching result into a convolutional neural network, and determining a feature vector; and constructing a correlation measurement weight matrix, matching the feature confidence of the tracking feature by combining with the Hungary algorithm, selecting global features and local features, performing coordinate conversion based on the image resolution of the multi-beam sonar, and determining the positioning result of the underwater vehicle in the autonomous docking process.

title: Data circulation system for automatic data acquisition
description: The invention discloses a data circulation system for automatically collecting data, and belongs to the technical field of data circulation. In order to solve the problem that a data source is difficult to select in a data circulation system, the invention ensures that the data provided by the data source is accurate, complete and consistent and meets the service requirement through the data quality evaluation module, the data reliability and stability evaluation module, the data security evaluation module, the data format and interface selection module, the data expandability evaluation module and the data holder compliance evaluation module, can evaluate the data precision, the data updating frequency and the data deletion rate of the data source, and can evaluate the availability, the system stability, the fault tolerance and the recovery capability of the data source and evaluate the data security measures of the data source.

title: Multi-dimensional vital signs monitoring method, device, system and smart ring
description: The present application proposes a multi-dimensional vital sign monitoring method, device, system and smart ring. The multi-dimensional vital sign monitoring method includes: collecting multiple channels of first vital sign data of the user, screening and fusing the multiple channels of the vital sign data to obtain pre-processed second vital sign data; extracting and processing the features of the second vital sign data to obtain the frequency domain features corresponding to the second vital sign data, converting the second vital sign data from the air domain to the frequency domain to obtain third vital sign data; inputting the third vital sign data into a preset model for analysis based on the identity information of the user to obtain the current vital sign monitoring and analysis results of the user, so that the terminal device can display the analysis results. The present application can ensure the accuracy of vital sign monitoring.

title: Method for analyzing fishing area resources based on big data
description: The present invention provides a method for analyzing fishing area resources based on big data, and relates to the field of smart ocean data mining and processing technology. It is divided into two parts: historical data model training and real-time data model application. Based on multi-source fusion positioning data of fishing vessels, basic information of fishing vessels, fishery categories and distribution data, meteorological data, and fishing port video data, multi-dimensional associations such as fishing vessels, catch levels, fishing vessel operation areas, fishing vessel operation behaviors, and regional distribution of fishery resources are established, and the relationship between the learning models is trained based on the deep learning BiGRU model to estimate the level of fishery resources; the real-time data model application part, based on the historical data training data model, monitors the fishery resources of each ship in real time, and predicts the resource level and fishery resource level of the operation area. Through big data modeling, the present invention breaks the multi-source heterogeneous data islands, performs federated learning calculations, mines various data relationships, and solves the real-time monitoring and prediction problems of fishery resource distribution and output.

title: Yield multi-dimensional interactive system, method, computer device and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a yield multi-dimensional interactive system, method, computer device and storage medium. The system includes: a processing engine for receiving input about describing chip yield problems, and feeding back output after analyzing and processing the input; the processing engine feeds back output after analyzing and processing the input, including: using the input information about several data dimensions describing chip yield problems, based on the knowledge database module and/or chip yield analysis module coupled to the processing engine, generating the results of the chip yield problem for output; the knowledge database module is used to generate the results of the chip yield problem based on the data pre-stored in the knowledge database; the chip yield analysis module is used to analyze the information of several data dimensions input in real time to generate the results of the chip yield problem. The use of this system for chip yield analysis can provide targeted yield analysis results accurately and timely according to the personalized needs of users.

title: Knowledge graph link prediction method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of knowledge graph completion tasks, in particular to a knowledge graph link prediction method, which comprises the following steps: obtaining an embedded layer vector by using a pre-coding model, and constructing a corresponding mask triplet; adding corresponding position codes to each element in the mask triples to obtain corresponding input sequences, inputting the corresponding input sequences into a trained main mask model, and outputting corresponding entity classification probability; predicting potential entities according to the entity classification probability; further comprises: splicing semantic information corresponding to the embedded layer vector and structural information corresponding to the embedded model to obtain a fused head entity and relational expression, and constructing a corresponding fusion mask triplet; adding corresponding position codes to each element in the fusion mask triplets to obtain corresponding fusion input sequences; the invention uses the pre-coding method, effectively lightens the training pressure of the model and improves the reasoning speed of the model; and a fusion module is used before the main mask model is input, so that the integrity of text description information is ensured, and the prediction accuracy is improved.

title: Long-time sequence prediction method based on time domain decoupling enhancement
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of time series analysis, and discloses a long time series prediction method based on time domain decoupling enhancement. The method is implemented through a prediction model, and the model mainly includes a time network module, an augmented network module, a sampling module, and a fusion enhancement module. The sampling module converts a long sequence into a time subsequence to obtain more refined feature information. The time network module is mainly used to perform rough prediction processing on the overall time series and provide feature information for the fusion enhancement module. The augmented network module performs fine processing on the time subsequence and transmits its own feature information to the fusion enhancement module. The fusion enhancement module receives the refined features from the subsequence and the feature information of the original sequence for fusion enhancement, and serves as an auxiliary decoding input of the time network and augmented network modules. Finally, the output of the time network and the augmented network are combined as the prediction output, thereby realizing the alignment of time and space information and achieving more efficient and accurate prediction capabilities.

title: Early stability evaluation method for polyphenol-containing extract
description: The present invention provides a method for evaluating the early stability of polyphenol extracts, which uses multiple light scattering technology MLS combined with artificial neural network ANN to establish a deep learning model integrating long short-term memory network LSTM and back propagation neural network BP neural network to evaluate the early stability of polyphenol extracts. The present invention also provides a method for evaluating the early stability of Sanlejiang oral liquid. The present invention uses an innovative combination of MLS and ANN to successfully establish a TFJ long-term stability early warning model with an accuracy of more than 90%. This model can accurately predict the changing trends of TFJ's optical parameters and Sm through short-term measured optical parameters (TSI, l, T, d), and quickly provide indicators through graded evaluation, providing an important shelf life prediction basis for market sales.

title: Image processing-based single wheel lane route searching and planning method and system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image data processing, in particular to a method and a system for searching and planning a single-wheel lane route based on image processing. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of collecting track image data by using monitoring equipment arranged in a wheelbarrow, and generating track image data; performing dynamic binarization threshold analysis processing on the racetrack image data to generate dynamic binarization threshold data; performing track center line data analysis processing on the track image data according to the dynamic binarization threshold data to generate track center line data; carrying out single wheel lane route planning processing according to the track central line data to generate planned single wheel lane route data; designing wheelbarrow control parameters according to the planned wheelbarrow road data to obtain wheelbarrow control parameters; and executing the wheelbarrow driving optimization operation based on the wheelbarrow control parameters. The invention realizes a more accurate and efficient single wheel lane route searching and planning method.

title: A calibration method and device for the effect of shell vegetable growth on flow measurement accuracy
description: The present invention provides a calibration method and device for the influence of the growth of seaweed on the flow measurement accuracy, which reads the inner diameter of the pipe built into the ultrasonic flowmeter set in the water pipeline to be measured and the instantaneous flow measured in real time, as well as the thickness data of the seaweed growth, so as to calculate the actual flow. The present invention automatically calibrates the measurement error of the ultrasonic flowmeter in the pipeline to be measured through calculation, provides managers with accurate and reliable real-time and precise flow data, determines the propagation velocity constant in the seaweed sludge through measurement, and through design, formula reasoning and calculation, makes the pipeline flow correction formula only related to the ratio of the inner diameter of the pipe wall to the thickness of the seaweed, so that the error correction calculation of the flow is convenient and simple.

title: Intelligent recognition method for steel surface cracks of lightweight effect-YOLOV 8
description: The invention belongs to the field of machine vision and image processing, and provides a light-weight effect-YOLOV steel surface crack intelligent identification method, which comprises the following steps: collecting a fatigue crack image of the surface of the strip steel by using metal scanning electron microscope equipment; preprocessing the crack original image by adopting a two-dimensional empirical mode decomposition method; integrating an S2-MLPv attention mechanism into a residual module of a C2f module of an original YOLOV model, and simultaneously replacing SPPF (split functional design) connecting a neck and a backbone in a YOLOV model by using S-CSPC (space-time programmable logic controller) to obtain an effect-YOLOV; and training the preprocessed image by using an E-YOLOV model to obtain a strip steel surface crack image recognition confusion matrix diagram. The method can effectively reduce the influence of background noise on crack identification, improves the space perception capability of the E-YOLOV model, can effectively identify different types of cracks, improves the influence of the microminiaturization and the complexity of the cracks on the identification, and has the advantages of low calculation complexity and high identification effect.

title: Method and system for deploying DNN model on single-machine multi-GPU equipment
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for deploying a DNN model on single-machine multi-GPU equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing a plurality of DNN models to be deployed through a preprocessing operator, and merging to generate an edited model; respectively running the edited model on n computing devices to obtain a model total running time t  DNN  of the edited model, operator configuration of each task operator on the computing devices and operator running time t  op ; according to the total running time t  DNN  of the model and the number n of the computing devices, obtaining the average running time t  avg  required by running each sub-graph to be distributed in the directed acyclic graph corresponding to the edited model on each computing device; and dividing the directed acyclic graph into n sub-graphs according to the average running time t  avg , the operator configuration and the operator running time t  op , and distributing the n sub-graphs to corresponding computing equipment for running. According to the technical scheme, the computing resources of the computing equipment are fully utilized, the situation that the computing equipment idles is avoided, the efficiency is improved, and the time of model reasoning is reduced.

title: Fault processing method, device, medium and equipment based on knowledge graph
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a fault processing method, device, medium and equipment based on a knowledge graph, relates to the technical field of aircraft maintenance, and aims to solve the problem that the level of fault processing in the adjustment process of an aircraft test flight complete machine based on the knowledge graph in the prior art is low. According to the application, the entity type and the relation type are defined in the ontology construction of the map layer, a basis is provided for the subsequent entity extraction and relation extraction, the relation between the entity result and the entity is obtained after the corresponding extraction is respectively carried out, the entity alignment is carried out, a plurality of pieces of information of the same entity or concept are fused, the problem of inconsistent entity conflict, unknown direction and the like in fault history data is eliminated, and the method is equivalent to the establishment of a large-scale unified knowledge base from the top layer, thereby helping a machine to understand multi-source heterogeneous data, forming high-quality knowledge, further establishing a high-quality knowledge map for guiding, and improving the level of fault processing based on the knowledge map.

title: Image generation method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product
description: The present disclosure provides an image generation method, apparatus, device, storage medium and program product, the method comprising: obtaining facial features according to a reference image specified by a user through a facial extraction model; obtaining a text description; generating an artificial intelligence image according to the facial features and the text description through a Vincent graph model, or generating an artificial intelligence video according to the facial features and the text description through a Vincent video model; the artificial intelligence image or the artificial intelligence video contains a character with the facial features. The method provided by the present disclosure can generate an AI image or an AI video according to the facial features extracted from an image.

title: Vulnerability mining method, device, storage medium and electronic device
description: The present invention discloses a vulnerability mining method, device, storage medium and electronic device. The method comprises: when a target communication protocol is detected in an industrial control system, obtaining a vulnerability data set corresponding to the target communication protocol; performing transfer learning training on a first vulnerability mining model according to a target learning rate and a vulnerability data set to obtain a target vulnerability mining model, wherein the target learning rate is used to control the step length of parameter update of the first vulnerability mining model, and the first vulnerability mining model is obtained by training a sample vulnerability data set corresponding to the first communication protocol; performing vulnerability mining on the target communication protocol according to the target vulnerability mining model to obtain a vulnerability mining result, wherein the vulnerability mining result is used to characterize whether the target communication protocol has a security vulnerability. The present invention solves the technical problem that the vulnerability mining efficiency is low in the prior art of performing vulnerability mining on industrial communication protocols.

title: A millimeter-wave radar fall detection method based on Transformer and multi-scale convolutional neural network
description: The present invention provides a millimeter wave radar fall detection method based on Transformer and multi-scale convolutional neural network, which includes the steps of reading original radar signal, data processing, feature extraction, multi-scale convolution module construction, ConvNetV2 layer construction, Transformer attention module construction, training phase and testing phase. The present invention performs short-time Fourier feature extraction (fall and non-fall behavior) on each type of different radar signal; establishes a training set and a data set for the extracted spectrum graph features and loads them; constructs a Transformer-based multi-scale convolutional neural network model, trains a Transformer-based multi-scale convolutional neural network classification model, and completes classification and recognition. The spectrum graph features are extracted from the radar signal and used to train the Transformer-based multi-scale convolutional neural network classification network for classification. Compared with the fall behavior classification method using the traditional training classification framework, the method proposed by the present invention has higher accuracy and stronger robustness.

title: Wireless federal model clipping method combining equipment selection and sample sampling
description: The invention provides a wireless federal model clipping method combining equipment selection and sample sampling, which comprises the following steps: in each round of communication, a client firstly downloads a global model, calculates a local update gradient according to a local data set of the client, schedules the client to participate in model round aggregation, and uploads a gradient update corresponding to a mask non-zero element to a server according to mask information provided by an edge server; in each round of communication, the server extracts noise aggregation gradients from the received signal and prunes model parameters based on predefined importance metrics; the edge server updates the global model and feeds it back to all users along with the pruned location information in the parameter vector. The process is repeated until the model converges. On the premise of ensuring the accuracy of the model, the convergence rate of the model is effectively improved, the training cost of the model is reduced, and the safety of private data of a user is ensured.

title: A simulation analysis method and device for a seawater cooling system of a ship transmission device
description: The present invention discloses a method and device for simulating and analyzing a seawater cooling system for a ship transmission device. The method comprises: obtaining text information to be evaluated and image information to be evaluated; using a first simulation analysis model to evaluate and process the text information to be evaluated to obtain first state evaluation information; and determining target simulation evaluation information based on a second simulation analysis model, the first state evaluation information and the image information to be evaluated. It can be seen that the present application is conducive to improving the simulation evaluation capability of the operating state of the seawater cooling system for a ship transmission device, thereby improving the operating guarantee efficiency of the seawater cooling system for a ship transmission device.

title: Code review method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention provides a code review method, device, equipment and storage medium, which belongs to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method includes: obtaining pull request information of the code to be reviewed based on the code review script; inputting the pull request information into a large language model to generate review suggestions for the code to be reviewed; adding the review suggestions to the pull request information. The present invention obtains the pull request information of the code to be reviewed through a code review script, and inputs the pull request information into a large language model. It can automatically generate review suggestions for the code to be reviewed based on the large language model, and realize full-process automatic review of the code without relying on manual labor. Therefore, it eliminates the technical problems of low review efficiency and review accuracy caused by manual code review, and improves the review efficiency and review accuracy of code review.

title: A decimeter-level precision urban design intelligent control method based on three-dimensional point cloud
description: The invention discloses a decimeter-level precision city design intelligent management and control method based on three-dimensional point cloud, which comprises the steps of constructing a current decimeter-level precision three-dimensional digital point cloud sand table, integrating a city design three-dimensional model, digitally translating city design management and control contents, checking an intelligent city design scheme, manually sampling, checking and controlling results and displaying virtual simulation man-machine interaction. The method can cope with the improvement of the control precision in the field of urban design, and the control precision of the urban design scheme is higher in a precise modeling mode, and the control efficiency of the urban design scheme is better in an intelligent control mode.

title: Model construction method, device and equipment based on spatial grid attention mechanism
description: The present application discloses a model construction method, device and equipment based on a spatial grid attention mechanism, which relates to the field of deep learning, including: constructing a first spatial grid for storing short-term memory and a second spatial grid for storing long-term memory based on a number of state spaces, using the first spatial grid and the second spatial grid to replace the self-attention mechanism of the converter module in the pre-trained language model to obtain a large model; using the large model to generate write coordinates and read coordinates based on the input vector; writing the state space where the write coordinates are located in the first spatial grid based on bilateral linear interpolation, and reading the two state spaces where the read coordinates are located in the second spatial grid and the first spatial grid to determine the output vector based on the read parameters. The present application constructs a spatial grid based on a number of state spaces, expands the state memory space to store more knowledge, accurately locates the state space that needs to be written and read through coordinates, and improves the efficiency of the model.

title: Method and device for optimizing display of parking space, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
description: The application relates to the technical field of image processing, and provides a method and a device for optimizing display of a parking space, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: the following operations are executed for each current parking space in the acquired image: determining target relative position relations between current real-time parking space image features corresponding to the current parking space and other real-time parking space image features corresponding to other parking spaces based on the relative position relations, and determining a cost function corresponding to each target relative position relation; the current real-time parking space image features and other real-time parking space image features corresponding to the relative position relations of the targets are used as input of a cost function, and error average values corresponding to the relative position relations of the targets are obtained; and adjusting the current real-time parking space image characteristics and other real-time parking space image characteristics by taking the minimum sum of all error averages as a target. The method for optimally displaying the parking spaces improves the accuracy and reliability of parking space detection.

title: Lightweight defect detection method based on mixed multiscale knowledge distillation
description: The present invention discloses a lightweight defect detection method based on hybrid multi-scale knowledge distillation, constructing a data set; constructing a teacher network model and a lightweight student network model; using the data set to train the teacher network model, and saving the trained teacher network model weight file; loading the saved teacher network model weight file into the teacher network model, inputting the defect image in the data set into the teacher network model and the student network model to obtain the first multi-scale feature and the second multi-scale feature respectively, and then inputting them into the cascade knowledge mixing module to obtain the final deeply fused first multi-scale feature and the second multi-scale feature respectively, and then calculating the hybrid multi-scale knowledge loss, combining the prediction loss of the student network model with the back propagation algorithm to update the network parameters, and obtaining the trained lightweight student network model to complete the defect detection of intelligent manufacturing products. Improve the cognitive ability and recognition performance of defects of different scales.

title: Federal deep learning method and system considering privacy protection of irregular users
description: The present invention provides a federated deep learning method and system that considers the privacy protection of irregular users, and relates to the field of information security technology. The method includes: using the key generation algorithm and random numbers of the Paillier cryptographic system to protect the uploaded local gradient, blinding the uploaded local gradient through the public key and each random number to determine the blinded gradient ciphertext, the participants use secret sharing to split the random number into multiple random number shares, and distribute them to each edge node, so that according to the aggregated gradient ciphertext, the sum of the aggregated random numbers, the global gradient of the current round and the learning rate, the updated global gradient and the updated global weight determined are secret protected, the privacy protection security is high, and collusion attacks can be prevented; the uploaded local gradient is calculated according to the global gradient of the current round and the local gradient of the current round, and the uploaded local gradient is calculated taking into account the influence of irregular users to reduce the influence of irregular users on the accuracy of the model.

title: Cross-domain small sample fine granularity classification method based on cross-view semantic consistency
description: The invention discloses a cross-domain small sample fine granularity classification method based on cross-view semantic consistency, which comprises the following steps: constructing a small sample data set, and dividing the small sample data set into a support set and a query set in proportion; a feature extractor in the pre-training image classification model is combined with an EMD small sample classifier, a global-local semantic consistency module and a global-local feature contrast learning module to construct a small sample fine granularity classification model, and the small sample fine granularity classification model is optimized; carrying out small sample fine-granularity classification or cross-domain small sample classification by using the optimized small sample fine-granularity classification model; the invention combines the advantages of the two methods of metric learning and data enhancement, and makes the constructed model learn a strong characteristic metric by comparing the difference between the local and global characteristics of the image, thereby being better suitable for the small sample classification task in the new field.

title: Fault diagnosis method based on linear transformation characteristic enhancement
description: The invention relates to a fault diagnosis method based on linear transformation feature enhancement, which belongs to the technical field of fault diagnosis and comprises the following steps: S1: collecting signal samples from a rotating equipment test bench, and constructing a training set and a test set by adopting a sliding window method; S2: constructing a double-branch feature enhancement module with reference to a coding and decoding framework with a linear layer as a unit, wherein one branch focuses on an effective component and the other branch focuses on an invalid component; constructing an orthogonal constraint term to modify the weights of the two branches, and constructing a cosine similarity constraint to further modify the weights of the invalid component branch; S3: inserting the constructed feature enhancement model into a classification network classifier front end to form a fault diagnosis model; S4: using a training set to train the fault diagnosis model, and using the trained fault diagnosis model to predict a test set to realize rotating equipment fault diagnosis.

title: Virtual network function forwarding graph deployment method based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The present invention relates to the field of communication technology, and specifically to a method for deploying a virtual network function forwarding graph based on deep reinforcement learning. The method uses the fast execution speed of the neural network inference process to quickly solve the deployment plan and improve timeliness and accuracy. At the same time, the deep reinforcement learning method is used to adaptively learn and adjust the deployment strategy in the face of different actual situations. Specifically, by constructing an intelligent agent learning model and a network simulation environment that is consistent with reality, the intelligent agent learning model is trained after continuously accumulating an experience pool in the simulation environment, and finally the trained model is used to give a virtual network function forwarding graph deployment decision in the actual environment. The present invention solves the complex graph structure processing and sequence decision problems in the virtual network function forwarding graph deployment problem by adding a deep reinforcement learning model and a graph neural network, and can adaptively adjust the deployment strategy in the face of different network environments, providing an efficient, fast, and low-latency deployment solution.

title: System and method for managing smooth traffic of double-circuit fusion based on block chain
description: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic general management, in particular to a block chain-based double-line fusion traffic smoothness management system and method, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical average communication duration of each user and each operator node; acquiring the communication priority level of the operator node according to the historical average communication duration of each user in the communication queue of the operator node; forming a communication priority sequence by the communication priority of each operator node according to the arrangement sequence of the operator sequence; constructing a local priority distance of each iteration according to the distance between each operator node in the communication priority sequence and the adjacent operator nodes and the difference of the communication priority; and improving a cuckoo algorithm according to the local priority distance to realize the distribution of the optimal operator nodes of the current user to be communicated. The invention aims to improve the telephone traffic conversation efficiency and the service quality and the customer satisfaction.

title: Intelligent generation method, device and equipment for live broadcast viewpoint
description: The embodiment of the specification discloses a method, a device and equipment for intelligently generating a live broadcast viewpoint. The scheme comprises the following steps: acquiring text data and image data which are generated in the live broadcast process of the electronic commerce and are used for describing live broadcast commodities, and acquiring corresponding commodity description information based on the text data and the image data; the commodity description information and the image data are used as input, commodity position information in the image data is output through a multi-mode language image model, and commodity position information is tracked based on low-calculation image characteristics of live commodities respectively corresponding to different image data; and comparing the similarity of the live goods with the prestored goods in the goods library according to the goods description information and the low-calculation image characteristics to obtain corresponding first scores, and determining the prestored goods hit by the live goods based on the first scores.

title: Complex traffic scene analysis method and system based on high-position video technology
description: The present invention discloses a complex traffic scene analysis method and system based on high-position video technology, which relates to the field of computer vision. The method includes: pre-deploying high-position video cameras in target traffic scenes, capturing image data, and obtaining traffic scene data sets; performing video frame splitting to obtain traffic scene image data; pre-setting image annotation strategies, performing annotation processing, and obtaining annotated image data; pre-building a scene analysis joint model, including a basic feature transformation module, a dual-branch feature encoding module, and a dynamic fusion module; synchronizing the annotated image data to the scene analysis joint model to perform traffic scene analysis, and obtaining real-time traffic analysis results. The method solves the technical problems of poor accuracy and reliability in the existing technology in complex traffic scene analysis, and achieves the technical effect of improving the accuracy and reliability of complex traffic scene analysis.

title: Educational resource sharing method, device, equipment and medium applicable to cloud platform
description: The present invention relates to an educational resource sharing method, device, equipment and medium applicable to a cloud platform. The method comprises monitoring a call instruction obtained at a current timestamp, and retrieving corresponding course resource data from a preset database according to the call instruction; displaying the course resource data, and collecting teaching information through a pre-trained four-state network model to form a course data packet and store it in a database; identifying the course data packet through a recognition model obtained by training a vector machine, a natural language model and an image model to identify a completion state vector corresponding to the course resource data; and forming a teaching completion degree corresponding to the course based on the timestamp and the completion state vector.

title: A traffic flow prediction method and system based on directed graph spatiotemporal information embedding
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of traffic management systems, and discloses a traffic flow prediction method and system based on the embedding of spatiotemporal information in a directed graph. Based on the road network structure of unidirectional traffic flow, a directed graph is constructed to enhance the model's ability to extract spatial features of traffic spatiotemporal data; static spatial information and dynamic spatial information based on the directed graph are embedded into traffic flow data to enhance the model's learning ability of road network spatial information; a spatiotemporal attention memory block with time period information embedding is designed to capture the spatiotemporal correlation of data. In the encoder stage, the spatiotemporal information embedding method and the spatiotemporal attention memory block connection design are used to extract traffic spatiotemporal data features; in the decoder stage, the fully convolutional UniRepLKNet‑S architecture is used to generate the final prediction results. The beneficial effects of the present invention are: it can better help traffic management departments and individual drivers cope with complex and changing traffic environments and improve road network traffic efficiency.

title: Ship loading method and device based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The invention discloses a ship loading method based on deep reinforcement learning, which is characterized in that a large number of more accurate container-container mapping relations are obtained by operating historical loading data through an annealing genetic algorithm, so that a large number of labels are provided, meanwhile, space information and characteristic information of containers and containers are subjected to pooling and convolution operation to obtain embedded vectors containing the space information, the characteristic information and information related to other containers, the labels and the embedded vectors are used as training samples, an actor network capable of accurately predicting the container-container mapping relations can be trained well through supervision learning, a directed acyclic graph is constructed based on the predicted container-container mapping relations, the loading sequence of the containers can be accurately obtained based on the constructed directed acyclic graph, and the ship loading method provided by the invention can obtain optimal solution of ship loading problems in reasonable time and has higher reusability.

title: Multi-mode fusion semantic perception method based on RGB and thermal infrared information
description: The present invention relates to a multimodal fusion semantic perception method based on RGB and thermal infrared information, comprising the following steps: obtaining RGB information and corresponding thermal infrared information of a road scene, inputting them into a trained multimodal fusion semantic perception model, and obtaining a pixel-level scene semantic category prediction mask, wherein the multimodal fusion semantic perception model comprises a hybrid asymmetric encoder and a mask classification decoder, the hybrid asymmetric encoder comprises a ViT-based visual base model encoder module, two weight-sharing lightweight convolutional neural network encoder modules, and the mask classification decoder comprises a pixel decoder module and a stacked Transformer decoder module. Compared with the prior art, the present invention effectively improves the accuracy and robustness of scene parsing through innovative hybrid, asymmetric and progressive fusion strategies, and outputs a pixel-level scene semantic segmentation mask.

title: Intelligent product quality risk monitoring method and system based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses an intelligent product quality risk monitoring method and system based on a convolutional neural network. The intelligent product quality risk monitoring method based on the convolutional neural network comprises the following steps: and acquiring and preprocessing data, checking the appearance damage of the machine dog, checking the working state of the machine dog and checking the interaction of the machine dog. According to the invention, quality risk data of the intelligent machine dog are obtained and preprocessed; judging the appearance damage condition of the intelligent machine dog based on a convolutional neural network model of the appearance image of the intelligent machine dog and carrying out early warning treatment; analyzing according to the athletic performance data to obtain a robot dog athletic index and performing early warning treatment; according to the machine dog instruction data analysis, the machine dog interaction index is obtained and early warning processing is carried out, so that whether the quality of the intelligent machine dog is normal or not is automatically checked, the improvement of the quality risk monitoring efficiency of the intelligent machine dog is achieved, the labor cost is reduced, and the problem that the quality risk monitoring of the intelligent machine dog is not efficient in the prior art is solved.

title: Acupoint positioning method and acupoint therapy robot
description: The invention discloses an acupoint positioning method and an acupoint therapy robot, which relate to the technical field of acupoint therapy; the method comprises the following steps: S1. pre-learning a human acupoint proportional distribution model; S2. identifying whether a human body exists; S3. identifying a human body contour and a human body skeletal point; S4. preliminarily positioning the human body's Dazhui acupoint based on the identified human body contour; S5. compensating and calibrating the preliminarily located human body Dazhui acupoint position to accurately locate the human body Dazhui acupoint; S6. calculating the human body central axis; S7. preliminarily positioning other human body acupoints based on the human body acupoint proportional distribution model and the human body central axis; S8. compensating and calibrating the preliminarily located human body acupoints based on the human body skeletal point to accurately locate other human body acupoints; the invention can automatically identify and locate human body acupoints, thereby facilitating finding the treatment acupoints corresponding to the treatment plan, performing path planning, and thus facilitating controlling the movement of a robotic arm to perform precise acupoint therapy.

title: Efficient local learning system and method supporting arbitrary network topology
description: The invention discloses an efficient local learning system supporting any network topology, which is applied to various local learning tasks and realized by electronic devices with computing capability, and comprises: modules encapsulated in a module layer, including: an rlayer module, a datasets module, a grads module, a metrics module and an optimizer module; operator classes, gradient solving classes, optimizer classes, data set classes and measurement index functions encapsulated in an operator layer, corresponding to the modules encapsulated in the module layer, and used for providing interfaces of the modules encapsulated in the module layer; operators, data set downloading and preprocessing classes, optimizer classes, gradient derivation classes and index calculation functions encapsulated in the module layer all have input and output interfaces, and users can create and instantiate networks on demand through the rlayer module, download and preprocess data sets through the datasets module, select corresponding optimizers through the optimizer module, select local learning gradient derivation classes through the grads module, select loss and precision calculation functions through the metrics module, complete the initialization of networks and corresponding hyperparameters, and realize network training and testing.

title: Method and device for optimizing operation interaction of virtual machines in multi-cloud VNC environment
description: The application discloses an operation interaction optimization method and device for a virtual machine in a cloud VNC environment, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: fine tuning a preset pre-training language model by adopting a first data set, and updating parameters of the pre-training language model to obtain a first virtual machine operation model; inputting the request information of the user into a first virtual machine operation model to obtain a plurality of operation suggestions output by the first virtual machine operation model; constructing a second data set according to selection results of the user from the plurality of operation suggestions and execution results of the operation suggestions based on the selection; iterative optimization of the first virtual machine operational model is performed based on the second data set. According to the method, the pre-training language model is applied to operation interaction of the virtual machine in the cloud VNC environment, user interaction data is innovatively adopted as a guide for model iteration optimization, so that the model has flexible natural language interaction capability and the capability of iteration continuously according to feedback expressed by a user, and the operation efficiency of the virtual machine is improved.

title: A data center smart energy management and control system based on big data model analysis
description: The present invention relates to a data center intelligent energy management and control system based on big data model analysis, which collects the operating power and equipment temperature of the current data center equipment and monitors the environmental parameters of the data center computer room; inputs the environmental parameters into a preset big data analysis model, and outputs the predicted cooling efficiency; calculates the required cooling time of the refrigeration system according to the equipment temperature and cooling efficiency data; controls the operating power of the data center equipment according to the required cooling time; wherein the preset big data analysis model is constructed by the environmental parameters of the historical period and the corresponding cooling efficiency big data, and is specifically configured as a random forest model constructed with the environmental parameter principal component obtained by principal component analysis as the explanatory variable and the cooling efficiency as the response variable. The present invention solves the problem that the accuracy of equipment workload control is reduced because the relationship between the environmental parameters and the cooling efficiency of the data center under different environmental conditions is difficult to quantify.

title: Distributed database generation method, device, terminal and storage medium
description: The present application provides a distributed database generation method, device, terminal and storage medium, which relates to the field of electrical digital data processing. The method includes: obtaining database data of a target centralized database; inputting the database data of the target centralized database into a random forest model, and outputting a distributed database table structure; the random forest model is constructed based on a random forest algorithm; optimizing SQL statements based on the database data of the target centralized database and a deep learning algorithm; creating a distributed database corresponding to the target centralized database according to the distributed database table structure and the optimized SQL statements. The present application can reduce the manual analysis and optimization costs in the traditional conversion process, and improve system performance and resource utilization.

title: Marine steel-lead composite ballast device adjusting method and system
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for adjusting a steel-lead composite ballast device for a ship, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of monitoring and acquiring attitude information of a ship body and state information of a ballast device in real time; raw data from the sensor is received for cleaning, format conversion, normalization and normalization operations. According to the invention, the volume of the ballast device is reduced by utilizing the high-density characteristic of lead, the space utilization rate of the ship cabin is improved, the attitude information of the ship body and the state information of the ballast device are monitored and acquired in real time, the real-time state of the ship, the marine environment and the cargo distribution factors are considered based on the analysis result of an optimization algorithm or a machine learning model, the adjustment scheme of the ballast device is formulated, the adjustment scheme is sent to the ship body control module in the form of instructions, the number and the positions of the ballast device are automatically adjusted, the automatic adjustment of the ballast device is realized, and the adjustment efficiency and the accuracy are improved.

title: Rice disease identification method and system based on random forest
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and discloses a method and system for identifying rice diseases based on random forests, which are used to improve the accuracy of identifying rice diseases based on random forests. The method comprises: collecting rice leaf images in a target area, and annotating the rice leaf images to obtain annotated rice leaf images; performing image enhancement on the annotated rice leaf images to obtain enhanced rice leaf images; performing high-level feature extraction on the enhanced rice leaf images to obtain a high-level feature set; inputting the high-level feature set into an extreme gradient boosting model for feature classification to obtain a classification feature set; inputting the classification feature set into a Bayesian optimization algorithm for feature optimization to obtain an optimized feature set; inputting the optimized feature set into a pest and disease recognition model to identify rice pests and diseases to obtain pest and disease recognition data, and matching the rice in the target area with the pest and disease recognition data to obtain rice disease data.

title: Image coding and decoding method based on end-to-end decoder correction diffusion model
description: The invention discloses an image coding and decoding method based on an end-to-end decoder correction diffusion model, which comprises the following steps: 1) Constructing an image coding and decoding model comprising an encoder E, an entropy model, an end-to-end decoder D and a diffusion model decoder mu  θ ; 2) Training an image coding and decoding model by using a training set; 3) For an image x  0  to be coded, the trained encoder E is used at the coding end to extract the image x  0  as a characteristic and discretize the characteristic into a code stream Computing a set of linear combination factors for trained diffusion model decoder and end-to-end decoder results using image x  0   Code stream And (3) with Transmitting to a decoding end; the decoding end will code stream Input trained diffusion model decoder mu  θ  and end-to-end decoder D, application And combining the two decoding results to obtain a decoded image at the decoding end. The invention can achieve more excellent balance result between faithfulness and perceived quality.

title: Flower pistil detection and identification method based on improved YOLOv network structure
description: The present invention discloses a flower stamen detection and recognition method based on an improved YOLOv8 network structure, which is specifically implemented in the following steps: step 1, collecting flower images and constructing a data set; step 2, performing data enhancement on the flower images in the data set to obtain a data enhanced data set; step 3, improving the YOLOv8 network structure to obtain an improved YOLOv8 network structure; step 4, using the data enhanced data set obtained in step 2 to train the improved YOLOv8 network structure to obtain a trained flower stamen detection model; step 5, inputting the flower image to be detected into the trained flower stamen detection model, and outputting the stamen detection result through detection and recognition. The present invention solves the problem of poor detection and recognition effect of multi-stamen and small-stamen targets in the prior art.

title: Spatial weather key parameter oversubscription method and system based on LIPF
description: The present application provides a LIPF-based super-resolution method and system for key space weather parameters, which relates to the field of data analysis technology. Key space weather parameters are obtained based on a target area, and dual-version data are outputted respectively using an ionosphere-thermosphere numerical simulation model. A super-resolution model is built based on the LIIF algorithm, and supervised training and cross-validation are performed on the model using the dual-version data to obtain a converged super-resolution model. Finally, the hyper-parameters of the model are retrieved and optimized based on a genetic algorithm, which solves the technical problems in the prior art of image super-resolution algorithms when applied to the reconstruction of thermospheric atmospheric parameters, such as insufficient model generalization ability, high computational complexity, low practicality and efficiency, and poor adaptability. This achieves the technical effect of providing an efficient, accurate, and adaptable method for reconstructing thermospheric atmospheric parameters, which can effectively improve the resolution and accuracy of thermospheric atmospheric parameters, reduce computational complexity, and improve the practicality and efficiency of the algorithm.

title: Optimization problem solving framework based on large language model
description: The invention provides an optimization problem solving framework based on a large language model, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The frame comprises: the modeling module is used for receiving description information of the optimization problem and constructing a mathematical model based on the description information; the coding module is connected with the modeling module, and is used for coding and testing based on the mathematical model and outputting codes passing the test; wherein the description information includes a data structure and a planning type of the optimization problem. The optimization problem solving framework based on the large language model has high accuracy and efficiency for solving the optimization problem.

title: Crop planting area extraction method, device, equipment and medium
description: The invention provides a crop planting area extraction method, a device, equipment and a medium, which comprise the following steps: acquiring multi-period optical satellite images and cultivated land block vector data corresponding to a working area; extracting target crop prediction pattern spots corresponding to the optical satellite images in the crop growing period through a pre-trained target crop semantic segmentation model; object segmentation is carried out on the multi-period optical satellite image under the constraint of cultivated land block vector data, and feature information corresponding to each object in object segmentation results is extracted; and screening the target crop prediction image spots by using the cultivated land block vector data and the characteristic information, and determining the crop planting area and/or the crop spatial distribution result corresponding to the working area by using the screened target crop prediction image spots. The invention can obviously improve the precision of extracting the crop planting area and effectively reduce the workload required by extracting the crop planting area.

title: Water level early warning and ponding diffusion analysis method based on multi-source heterogeneous data
description: The invention belongs to the field of time sequence prediction in deep learning, and discloses a water level early warning and accumulated water diffusion analysis method based on multi-source heterogeneous data, which combines the time sequence prediction technology in deep learning with hydrologic analysis, and the water accumulation diffusion analysis at the prediction moment is completed by combining heterogeneous sensor data, waterlogging point image data and topographic data, so that the submerged water depth of each grid result and the predicted water accumulation unit area can be obtained, and the prediction effect is more accurate.

title: A method and device for generating adversarial samples
description: The application discloses a method and a device for generating an countermeasure sample, which are applied to the technical field of countermeasure attack, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring and processing a user image to obtain a first image set and a countermeasure sample set; determining frequency domain disturbance according to the first image set and finely adjusting a diffusion model to obtain a first diffusion model and a thermodynamic diagram set; updating the countermeasure sample set N times on the frequency domain to obtain a first sample set, and updating the first sample set M times on the spatial domain to obtain a second sample set; updating the first diffusion model, updating the second sample set M times on a spatial domain to obtain a third sample set, updating the third sample set N times on a frequency domain to obtain a fourth sample set as an countermeasure sample set, and iterating the steps multiple times to obtain the countermeasure sample set, wherein the frequency domain updating is realized through the first diffusion model, the frequency domain disturbance and the thermal atlas, and the spatial domain updating is realized through the first diffusion model and the thermal atlas. The application improves the effect and efficiency of resisting the attack and ensures the image quality of the resisting sample.

title: Steel structure bridge panel detection method and system based on image recognition
description: The present application provides a steel structure bridge panel detection method and system based on image recognition, which uses sample steel structure bridge panel images and their corresponding prior labeled defects to train a defect diagnosis neural network, so that the defect diagnosis neural network can learn the characteristics and laws of steel structure bridge panel defects. By continuously optimizing the network structure, the recognition accuracy and diagnostic accuracy of defects in candidate steel structure bridge panel images are improved. By automatically acquiring candidate steel structure bridge panel images and using the trained defect diagnosis neural network to perform defect diagnosis and generate defect diagnosis results, automated detection of steel structure bridge panels is achieved, greatly improving detection efficiency. In addition, the defect diagnosis neural network includes multiple defect diagnosis neural sub-networks, each prior labeled defect corresponds to a defect diagnosis neural sub-network, which can flexibly respond to different types of defects and has good scalability.

title: Coarse-grained soil broken particle tracking method based on YOLOv network model
