description: The invention relates to a coarse-grained soil broken particle tracking method based on YOLOv network models, which comprises the steps of S1, manufacturing an initial dataset, S2, expanding the dataset, S3, carrying out image processing on images of the dataset after data enhancement, S4, training to complete a segmentation model, S5, carrying out experimental picture example segmentation, S6, extracting characteristic points of an experimental picture by using SURF, S7, corresponding an example segmentation area in S5 to the characteristic points extracted by SURF in S6, matching the characteristic points to obtain a tracking result of characteristic point matching, S8, carrying out multi-target tracking to obtain a tracking result based on YOLOv, S9, comparing the tracking result of S7 with the tracking result of S8, and outputting the tracking result. The method realizes high-precision tracking of broken particles in a coarse-grained soil breaking test.

title: Content-aware graphic layout generation method, system and device based on sequence coding and image feature learning
description: The present invention discloses a method, system and device for generating content-aware graphic layout based on sequence coding and image feature learning. The method designs a sequence coding module for coding and learning sequence constraint statements, and a multi-scale feature network for feature learning of graphics. The sequence features and image features are connected and sent to a transformer encoder and decoder for global feature processing, thereby generating a content-aware graphic layout that meets the sequence constraints. The present invention fuses the sequence features with the image features and sends them to the transformer encoder and decoder. Finally, a self-attention transformation module that introduces a self-attention mechanism is used to globally model the vector, so as to achieve interaction and integration of global features, thereby generating a content-aware graphic layout that meets the sequence statement constraints. The present invention can be used in the fields of poster, web page, magazine automatic generation, etc.

title: A UAV infrared image detection method, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method for detecting infrared images of unmanned aerial vehicles, a computer device and a storage medium, comprising: S1: establishing an infrared image data set of unmanned aerial vehicles; S2: constructing a standard HRNet network model; S3: on the basis of the standard HRNet network model, embedding an ECA module into the BasicBlock basic block and the Bottleneck bottleneck block of the standard HRNet network model to construct the HRNet-ECA network model; S4: processing the infrared image output by the HRNet-ECA network model by a fusion method, integrating image information, and obtaining a multi-scale fusion feature map; S5: optimizing the multi-scale fusion feature map by improving the Dice loss function. By embedding the ECA module into BasicBlock and Bottleneck, the model parameter amount and the amount of calculation are reduced, the network representation ability is enhanced, the model is made more lightweight, and the model performance is improved; the infrared image output by the HRNet-ECA network model is processed in combination with the fusion method, and the fusion method adopts an n×n pooling operator to reduce the computational complexity, improve the fusion performance, integrate the image information to the maximum extent, and reduce the redundancy of spatial and channel information.

title: Data missing interpolation method and system based on depth simplex convolutional neural network
description: The present invention discloses a data missing interpolation method and system based on a deep simplex convolutional neural network, which relates to the field of deep learning technology and includes the following steps: obtaining a citation data set, introducing a simplex edge sampling technique for preprocessing, and obtaining a training data set; introducing an initial residual connection technique to construct a deep simplex convolutional neural network; using the training data set to train the deep simplex convolutional neural network until the network converges to obtain a data missing interpolation model; using the data missing interpolation model to interpolate missing data in the citation data set to obtain an interpolation result. The present invention can prevent the problems of overfitting, oversmoothing, and gradient vanishing caused by the training of a deep neural network model, and the data integrity and accuracy can be improved by performing data missing interpolation through the method.

title: Laser atmosphere transmission beam expansion calibration method based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a laser atmosphere transmission beam expansion calibration method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of determining a training model and a target according to laser system parameters and atmospheric statistics characteristics; generating a data set according to a predetermined training model and a target; preprocessing and normalizing the generated data set; model training, optimization and performance characterization are carried out; and integrating the trained model into an application program interface for testing, evaluating and predicting the laser atmosphere transmission performance in a quasi-real-time mode. The method has the advantages of high calculation precision, high speed, strong applicability to a large parameter range, universality and no limitation to specific laser atmosphere transmission modes and scenes, and in practical application, the characteristics of a laser system and the atmosphere transmission scenes can be customized and optimized according to specific deployment of the laser system, so that higher calibration precision is realized.

title: Semantic segmentation-based method, device, equipment and medium for training oil model of indicator diagram and oil model of indicator diagram
description: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a dynamometer diagram oil measurement model training based on semantic segmentation and a dynamometer diagram oil measurement method, device, equipment and medium. The method comprises: performing a dynamometer diagram semantic segmentation task based on the target historical production data required for the dynamometer diagram oil measurement model training based on semantic segmentation; controlling the dynamometer diagram oil measurement model based on semantic segmentation to perform a dynamometer diagram oil measurement training task based on semantic segmentation based on the segmented dynamometer diagram obtained by the dynamometer diagram semantic segmentation task; adjusting parameters of the dynamometer diagram oil measurement model based on semantic segmentation based on the dynamometer diagram semantic segmentation task and the dynamometer diagram oil measurement training task based on semantic segmentation to obtain a converged dynamometer diagram oil measurement model based on semantic segmentation. By adopting the technical solution of the present invention, the dynamometer diagram oil measurement model based on semantic segmentation is trained using the segmented dynamometer diagram, which can effectively improve the accuracy and reliability of the measurement of the liquid production of the pumping well and improve the production efficiency.

title: Intelligent automobile lane changing method based on multi-view feature fusion and collision risk analysis
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of automatic driving, and discloses an intelligent automobile lane changing method based on multi-view feature fusion and collision risk analysis. The invention combines priori knowledge and deep learning technology, and particularly utilizes advanced algorithms such as a neural network, a graph rolling network GCN, a visual transducer ViT and the like to analyze complex traffic conditions, thereby providing a more efficient and safer decision frame for automatic driving automobile lane changing compared with the traditional method. The method has the advantages that by integrating different feature extraction methods, the dynamic state of the vehicle, the road features and the relationship among the vehicles can be accurately grasped, a new data set is formed by a feature fusion technology, accurate prediction of lane changing behavior is realized based on a ViT lane changing decision model, and the accuracy and reliability of decision are improved; meanwhile, a collision safety-based method is added to carry out channel switching decision evaluation, so that the channel switching method further ensures safety while improving performance.

title: Automatic evaluation method for security of artificial intelligent model for universal service scene
description: The invention discloses an artificial intelligent model security automatic evaluation method facing a general service scene, which comprises the steps of S1, submitting an evaluated artificial intelligent model by a user, and appointing an original data set for training the evaluated artificial intelligent model; s2, when white box evaluation is carried out on the evaluated artificial intelligent model, generating a corresponding countermeasure sample for each input sample in the original data set by improving an FGSM algorithm, and forming a countermeasure data set; s3, calling an interface of the evaluated artificial intelligent model to predict an original data set; s4, during black box evaluation, except for the countermeasure data set generated in the white box evaluation process by other evaluated artificial intelligent models, the user needs to select, and other processes are consistent with the white box evaluation process; s5, finally obtaining an evaluation score set of the evaluated artificial intelligent model; and S6, obtaining the final score of the evaluated artificial intelligent model. The invention can comprehensively reflect the performance of the model under different attack scenes and provide objective and accurate evaluation results.

title: Firework detection method adopting dynamic fusion of light space-time characteristics
description: The invention discloses a smoke and fire detection method with light weight space-time characteristic dynamic fusion, which belongs to the technical field of image data processing and comprises the steps of constructing a smoke and fire video data set; constructing a space-time characteristic dynamic fusion detection network; training a space-time characteristic dynamic fusion detection network by using a smoke and fire video data set to obtain a smoke and fire detection model; and acquiring a video segment to be identified, processing the video segment into an image sequence, sending the image sequence into a smoke and fire detection model, and outputting a predicted target position and a predicted target category in each image. Aiming at the spatial characteristics and the special time sequence characteristics of the smoke and flame targets, the invention fuses the two characteristics according to the complexity of the detection background, not only improves the efficiency and the expression depth of characteristic extraction, but also remarkably enhances the capturing capability of the model to target details, so that the model can maintain excellent adaptability and generalization performance in complex and changeable environments, effectively suppresses false alarm and false alarm phenomena, and remarkably enhances the accuracy and reliability of smoke and fire detection.

title: Semantic change detection method of similarity pyramid network with change guidance
description: The invention discloses a semantic change detection method of a change-oriented similarity pyramid network, which relates to the field of image change detection, and comprises the following steps: constructing a similarity pyramid network CG-SPNet, wherein the similarity pyramid network CG-SPNet comprises an encoder and a multi-scale similarity pyramid module MSSP; based on the remote sensing image to be detected, the multiple stages of the encoder sequentially perform feature extraction to obtain double-time-phase semantic features of different stages, and obtain the double-time-phase semantic features extracted by the last stage of the encoder to obtain input features Based on the multi-scale similarity pyramid module MSSP, the input features are compared with each other Performing similarity analysis to obtain output characteristics Based on the output characteristics Obtaining a prediction graph comprising a first prediction graph Second predictive picture And a third detection chart The third detection diagram Respectively to the first prediction graph And the second predictive picture Performing matrix multiplication to obtain a detection image; the detection result is obtained based on the detection image, so that the problem that the existing SCD method based on deep learning is limited due to limited receiving areas, and is difficult to extract multi-scale features similar to large objects and make complete and consistent response to the large-scale features can be solved.

title: Ocean data prediction method and system based on VIT module
description: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean forecasting, and specifically discloses an ocean data forecasting method and system based on a VIT module, comprising: a data acquisition step: acquiring existing sea surface height data within a first set time; a future sea surface height data acquisition step: obtaining future sea surface height data within a second set time in the future through a sea surface height prediction model based on the VIT module based on the existing sea surface height data; a vortex data acquisition step: obtaining vortex data corresponding to the future sea surface height data through a vortex prediction model based on the future sea surface height data; wherein the future sea surface height data includes a sea surface height value, and the vortex data includes a vortex position, a vortex radius and a vortex rotation direction. The invention improves the speed and accuracy of sea surface height forecasting, and reduces the forecasting cost at the same time.

title: Automatic airway segmentation result post-processing method based on oral CBCT image
description: The invention provides an automatic airway segmentation result post-processing method based on an oral CBCT image, which relates to the technical field of medical image segmentation, and comprises the following steps: acquiring CBCT images to be segmented; preprocessing CBCT images to be segmented to obtain input image data; inputting the input image data into a first segmentation model, a second segmentation model and a third segmentation model respectively to obtain a first segmentation result, a second segmentation result and a third segmentation result; and respectively extracting airway boundary characteristic points of the first segmentation result, the second segmentation result and the third segmentation result to obtain a first interface result, a second interface result and a third interface result, and endowing the first interface result, the second interface result and the third interface result with different confidence weights to obtain a final interface result. The invention solves the problem that the classification error of the whole slice often occurs at the interface between different pharyngeal regions in the prior art.

title: Colored drawing cultural relics true color image fusion method based on multi-branch fusion strategy convolution self-encoder
description: The application discloses a true color image fusion method of a colored drawing cultural relic based on a multi-branch fusion strategy convolution self-encoder, which comprises the following steps: acquiring implicit information image-true color image data, preprocessing the image data, and constructing a data set for training an image fusion network, wherein the data set comprises paired implicit information images and true color images; constructing an image fusion network model based on a multi-branch fusion strategy convolution self-encoder, wherein the image fusion network model comprises a multi-branch attention fusion module and a multi-scale feature enhancement module; and outputting a final fusion result through a decoder. The application is based on a deep learning image fusion method, introduces a multi-branch fusion strategy, solves the problems that hidden information of a true color image of a colored drawing cultural relic lacks color information and texture details in the true color image are lacking, and carries out branch feature fusion through each fusion branch to finally fuse high-quality images.

title: Handwriting image harmony method based on local light and shadow perception
description: The present application relates to a calligraphy image harmonization method based on local light and shadow perception. The method utilizes light and shadow masks to distinguish between reference areas and noise areas in an image, and shields those areas that may interfere with the harmonization. In this way, the visual style difference between the foreground and the background can be captured more accurately, and only the parts that need to be adjusted can be harmonized; not only can unnecessary interference be avoided, but the overall effect of image harmonization can also be effectively improved.

title: Nuclear magnetic resonance technology-based nondestructive measurement method for micro annular gap of shaft
description: The invention discloses a method for nondestructive measurement of a micro annular gap of a shaft based on nuclear magnetic resonance technology, which comprises the steps of preparing cement stones and sampling shale on an engineering site, and carrying out nuclear magnetic resonance detection to obtain sample porosities P  1  and P  2  respectively. A cement-shale cement sample was prepared and the porosity P  0  was measured. The theoretical porosity (P  1+ P 2 )/2 is subtracted from the measured porosity P  0  to give the annulus porosity P  A . And (3) equivalent annular space is a cuboid, the equivalent cuboid volume V  A  is obtained through porosity calculation, and the equivalent thickness t is obtained through calculation. And analyzing the oil and gas well engineering field data, preliminarily determining the variation range of the micro annular gap, selecting the step length, and determining the numerical value to calculate the parameter combination. A dataset is obtained that affects wellbore micro-annulus production factors. And deploying the trained BP neural network model on the cloud. And the equivalent thickness of the micro annular gap of the shaft is predicted through different engineering parameters, so that the sealing integrity of the whole life cycle of the cement sheath is improved.

title: Intelligent code generation and compiling system based on AI large model
description: The invention provides an intelligent code generation and compiling system based on an AI large model, which belongs to the field of information processing systems and is used for improving the collaboration efficiency and the code quality in software development; the generating and compiling system includes: the code acquisition module is used for collecting personal code texts of development team members; the code analysis module is responsible for carrying out deep semantic analysis on the codes and extracting the structure, the function and the style characteristics of the codes; the normalization module is used for constraining the feature vectors according to a preset team style to generate code feature vectors with uniform styles; and the code reconstruction module is used for generating team code texts according to the normalized feature vectors by utilizing the artificial intelligence model. The generating and compiling system reduces the time consumption of team members in code examination and integration through an automation tool, ensures the consistency of the style of the codes, and therefore, the efficiency of project development and the overall quality of the codes are remarkably improved.

title: Material detection method, system, equipment and medium based on improved yolov network
description: The material detection classification method, system, equipment and medium based on the improved yolov8 network include: S1, adding GhostNetV2 network to replace the original model Backbone in the yolov8 model, adding bottleneck attention module BAM before the object detection head module of the yolov8 model, and obtaining the improved yolov8 model; S2, obtaining training images, training data sets of material defects; inputting the training data sets into the improved yolov8 model to obtain a trained model; S3, collecting images of materials to be detected, inputting them into the trained model, and outputting detection results and classification signals; S4, according to the category of the signal, selecting the corresponding positioning group to complete the material picking. The present invention selects the target detection of YOLOv8 as the recognition model, and improves the original YOLOv8 model structure to obtain the improved YOLOv8 model structure, and obtains a detection model with higher accuracy and lower false detection rate.

title: A customer demand sentiment analysis method based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention relates to the technical field of natural language processing, in particular to a customer appeal emotion analysis method based on a convolutional neural network. According to the invention, by analyzing the context change and emotion weight of the customer appeal, a proper receptive field is established, the situation that the neural network model pays attention to local characteristics too much for the learning process of the customer appeal is avoided, the receptive field of the customer in the learning process of the neural network model cannot be purified and learned, the problem of model overfitting possibly caused by noise problems is blindly changed, the real emotion of the customer in the more complex customer communication text can be purified and learned, the accuracy of the neural network for the emotion analysis of the customer appeal is improved, the communication efficiency of customer service is improved, the customer satisfaction is improved, and the service flow is optimized.

title: Knowledge-graph-based conductive adhesive film curing parameter auxiliary decision-making method
description: The invention discloses a conductive adhesive film curing parameter auxiliary decision-making method based on a knowledge graph, and belongs to the technical field of passive component assembly. According to the invention, through the conductive adhesive film curing process knowledge graph, multistage curing parameters can be provided for the novel conductive adhesive film, technical support is provided for development and application of the novel conductive adhesive film, and the problem that a large passive component processing unit cannot provide effective basis of processability and processing parameters is solved; verification times are saved through the solidification dynamics simulation model, training errors can be less than 10% after multiple independent learning and iteration, verification efficiency of the new material is improved, and verification cost and verification time are saved; the later stage of the curing parameter knowledge graph of the conductive adhesive film can be used as a sub-library of the genome of the conductive material, so that a foundation is provided for the formula design of the conductive adhesive film, and the development progress of high-end electronic materials in China is accelerated.

title: Collaborative reasoning task scheduling method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
description: The application belongs to the field of multi-agent reinforcement learning, in particular to a collaborative reasoning task scheduling method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, which initializes the multi-agent environment, sets a plurality of user devices, each user device is an agent, deploys independent Actor neural networks on each user device, setting a plurality of cloud servers, deploying a central Critic neural network on a central control server, providing a plurality of communication channel selections for user equipment, the method has the advantage that the method solves the problem of optimizing the combination of task division points, communication channels and server selection.

title: Multichannel radio frequency signal processing method based on quantum array
description: The invention discloses a multichannel radio frequency signal processing method based on a quantum array, and relates to the technical field of quantum communication. By designing the appropriate quantum gate sequence, different radio frequency signals can be mapped into the state space of the qubit and processed in parallel on the quantum array, and by designing the quantum gate sequence, different radio frequency signals can be mapped into the state space of the qubit and operated in parallel on the quantum array. The parallel processing capability enables the quantum array to process signals of a plurality of channels in the same time period, thereby remarkably improving the efficiency and speed of signal processing, realizing the encoding, transmission and decoding of multi-channel signals, shortening the time of the whole signal processing process and improving the response speed and processing capability of the system.

title: Self-adaptive intrusion detection method based on CDIVAE and bidirectional time sequence model
description: The invention discloses a self-adaptive intrusion detection method based on CDIVAE and a bidirectional time sequence model, which belongs to the technical field of network attack detection, and is characterized in that source domain data is filtered and clustered through a GWR algorithm, and a large amount of repeated data in the source domain data is filtered out to extract a source domain data subset which is clear in distribution and smaller in scale; based on the difference of posterior distribution between the source domain and the target domain of the Gaussian mixture condition domain invariant variation self-encoder, finally, intrusion detection is carried out through a fusion neural network BRN-BiLSTM of a two-way retention network encoder and a two-way long-short-term memory network, two-way time sequence weighting is carried out on data through the BRN, then the data after time sequence weighting is identified and classified through BiLSTM, and the dependency relationship of the data can be effectively captured through a memory unit and a gate control unit. The invention can better extract the domain invariant feature and align the data distribution, and has better cross-domain intrusion detection performance.

title: Medical universal telescopic drill bit, control method and application thereof
description: The invention discloses a medical universal telescopic drill bit, a control method and application thereof; the invention relates to the technical field of dental surgical instruments; the telescopic assembly 3 comprises a telescopic assembly 3 which is telescopic and is universally adjusted in the body assembly 2, the telescopic assembly 3 comprises a plurality of small free bodies 302 with dipole moments, and the telescopic and the universal adjustment can be respectively and independently carried out and can be simultaneously carried out; the discretized PID controller receives as input a target value tv (desired magnetic field strength and direction) and an actual feedback value fv (current magnetic field strength and direction); calculating an error E between the target value tv and the feedback value fv; according to the invention, the expansion and contraction of the drill bit assembly and the universal angle adjustment are realized through electromagnetic control, so that a doctor can more accurately position and operate in the operation process, and the integral action and the saturation value of the PID controller can be adjusted in real time by combining the discretized PID controller and the Bi-directional Bi-GRU circulating neural network so as to adapt to the change of the system state.

title: Task processing method, document dialogue method and document processing method
description: The embodiment of the application provides a task processing method, a document dialogue method and a document processing method, wherein the task processing method comprises the steps of obtaining task data aiming at a target document and a document structure diagram of the target document, inputting the task data and the document structure diagram of the target document into a task processing model to obtain a task processing result, wherein the target document comprises a plurality of document blocks, the document structure diagram is constructed based on association relations among the document blocks and a hierarchical structure diagram of the target document, and the hierarchical structure diagram is constructed by taking the document blocks as nodes and the hierarchical relations among the document blocks as edges. The target document is represented by utilizing the coarse-granularity hierarchical relationship between the document blocks, and the fine-granularity association relationship between the document blocks is merged, so that the target document is represented as a multi-granularity document structure diagram, more accurate and detailed document knowledge can be provided in the task processing process, and the comprehensiveness and accuracy of the task processing result are improved.

title: Test case priority ordering method integrating clustering algorithm and diversity
description: The invention discloses a test case priority ordering method integrating a clustering algorithm and diversity, which comprises the following steps: performing feature extraction on the training set and the constructed new test set by adopting a pre-trained deep neural network model to obtain two data feature sets; performing cluster analysis on the data characteristics of the training set by using a clustering algorithm, and predicting clusters to which each test sample belongs in the new test set according to a clustering result; calculating cosine similarity between the data characteristics of each test sample and the center of the cluster to which the test sample belongs; extracting the feature vector of each test sample in the test set, and calculating the standard deviation of each test case cluster; and carrying out normalization processing on the cosine similarity and the standard deviation, and weighting the cosine similarity and the standard deviation according to weights to generate a final test case priority ranking list. The method screens out as many test cases as possible under the condition of limited resources, which can detect the fault of the deep neural network model, and improves the test efficiency while reducing the test marking cost.

title: Micro-class video teaching platform based on knowledge graph
description: The invention discloses a micro-class video teaching platform based on a knowledge graph, and relates to the technical field of knowledge graph teaching. The platform comprises: the micro-class video unit, the module learning unit and the learning effect evaluation unit; the units organically integrate the target courses through micro-course video-PPT-exercises-teaching materials, redesign a course score evaluation method by utilizing the function of a digital technology in teaching, focus on the organic integration of on-line and off-line learning, and effectively improve the learning efficiency of on-duty students.

title: Artificial intelligence health management system and method
description: The present invention discloses an artificial intelligence health management system and method, including modules such as front-end education, intelligent voice service, data collection, data analysis, personalized suggestions, health monitoring and user interface. The front-end education module can ask and answer common health questions and provide reminders for work and rest and taking medicine. The intelligent voice service can achieve instant response and solve most problems in a short time. The data collection module covers various personal health data. The data analysis module uses technical in-depth analysis to identify risks and needs and generate evaluation reports. The personalized suggestion module provides suggestions based on the analysis results. The health monitoring module monitors and adjusts the suggestions in real time. The user interface provides friendly interaction, which is convenient for users to view data and suggestions and interact. The system is comprehensive and intelligent, improves the health management effect, and continuously strengthens the optimization and improvement of service effects.

title: Underwater propulsion motor fault diagnosis method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for diagnosing faults of an underwater propulsion motor, which relate to the technical field of fault diagnosis of the underwater propulsion motor and comprise the following steps: preprocessing a plurality of vibration signals and current signals to obtain a tagged frequency band feature set and an untagged frequency band feature set; training a Markov decision frame to obtain an optimal fault frequency band selection strategy, and obtaining a labeled optimal feature subset and an unlabeled optimal feature subset according to the optimal fault frequency band selection strategy; and applying an optimal fault frequency band selection strategy to the preprocessed vibration signals and current signals of the underwater propulsion motor to be diagnosed to obtain a corresponding tagged optimal feature subset and a corresponding untagged optimal feature subset, and inputting the tagged optimal feature subset and the untagged optimal feature subset into a fault diagnosis model to obtain a corresponding fault type. According to the invention, the fault frequency band selection is performed through the Markov decision process, so that the noise reduction of fault characteristics is realized.

title: Method and system for training neural networks to improve adversarial robustness
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose a method and system for training a neural network to improve adversarial robustness. The method includes the following steps: collecting multiple data samples including clean data samples and adversarial data samples. The training of the neural network includes training a probability encoder to encode the multiple data samples into a probability distribution on a latent space representation. In addition, the training of the neural network includes training a classifier to classify instances of the latent space representation to generate classification results. In addition, the method includes the following steps: training the shared parameters of a first instance of the neural network using the clean data samples and training the shared parameters of a second instance of the neural network using the adversarial data samples. In addition, the method includes the following steps: outputting the shared parameters of the first instance of the neural network and the second instance of the neural network.

title: Annealing furnace speed control method and system based on reinforcement learning
description: The invention provides an annealing furnace speed control method and system based on reinforcement learning, comprising the following steps: step S1: forming a process of speed regulation change in the annealing furnace into a Markov decision process, and defining states, actions, strategies and rewards; step S2: constructing a strategy network and a comment network, and coordinating training of the two models; step S3: and using the trained strategy network model for predicting the speed setting of the actual production line. The invention provides an annealing speed control method, which aims at enabling a speed issuing value of an annealing furnace to be matched with temperature setting, so that strip steel entering a furnace section reaches a required target temperature range, adjusting the speed in the furnace in a planned way, ensuring smooth transition of the set speed of strip steel entering the furnace section successively, and further improving productivity and efficiency while meeting the requirements of stable plate passing and process.

title: Data processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The application discloses a data processing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of constructing a weighted directed non-self-loop graph of multi-user data access comprising M first nodes and a first directed connecting edge connected with each two first nodes based on data access logs of N users accessing data objects, wherein the first nodes are ith accessed data objects of at least one user; extracting P sampling subgraphs from the weighted directed acyclic graph; based on each sampling sub-graph and the corresponding label vector, training a first graph neural network and a pre-fetching decoder model to obtain a second graph neural network and a pre-fetching decoder for generating probability values of users accessing P data objects with association relations in a second time period based on the data access log of the users in the first time period. In this way, the association relation between the graph neural network and the access data is learned by the decoder to determine the data object to be accessed, so as to improve the hit rate of cache prefetching.

title: Method for identifying key node set of shield machine cutterhead production supply chain network
description: The invention discloses a method for identifying a key node set of a supply chain network for shield machine cutterhead production, and belongs to the technical field of supply chain risk propagation. According to the method, a complex network model of a shield machine cutterhead production supply chain is established, a proper propagation model is selected to simulate and analyze a risk propagation process in the shield machine cutterhead production supply chain network, a key node set in the shield machine cutterhead production supply chain network, namely a node set with the largest risk propagation, is identified by using a deep reinforcement learning method, and a function of protecting risks in the shield machine production process in advance is achieved. According to the method, the complex modeling is carried out on the shield tunneling machine cutterhead supply chain network, the CML propagation model is applied to simulate the risk propagation condition, the property of the supply chain network can be analyzed, the importance of the node set is rapidly measured through the propagation result, the key node set on the network is identified through the maximum propagation influence range, and the method provides favorable support for risk protection on the shield tunneling machine cutterhead supply chain network.

title: Big data mining method and system applied to VR market
description: The present application provides a big data mining method and system for VR shopping malls, which improves the accuracy of product promotion and market response speed. By accurately determining the interaction mode labels of VR shopping mall interaction events and screening out potential target customer groups based on preset audience label features, the user's interest trend in specific VR products can be effectively identified. Furthermore, by utilizing the big data of product interaction migration in the preparation stage that has feature connections with activated products, generating sample data sequences and training an interest prediction network, it is possible to accurately predict the user interest that may be aroused by new products (in presentation preparation mode) after being converted to activation mode, and then deduce the predicted VR interaction parameters, which not only provides a scientific basis for the formulation of product launch strategies, but also promotes the efficient allocation of resources, allowing shopping malls to more accurately grasp market opportunities and quickly respond to changes in consumer demand.

title: Point cloud target detection method based on multi-mode fusion network
description: A point cloud target detection method based on a multi-mode fusion network belongs to the technical field of three-dimensional target detection. The invention improves the point cloud grouping mode. The voxel structural features and the features of the point clouds are spliced, the features of the original data are expanded, more effective information is provided before the original data are input into a network architecture, and the information of each point cloud is expressed more reasonably. The network architecture provided by the invention splices and merges the characteristics of the point cloud and the picture. The advantages of depth information can be provided by the point cloud data, and rich texture information can be provided by the picture data, so that the advantages are effectively fused, and the detection precision of the three-dimensional object is improved. Can be applied to the related fields of automatic driving, underwater robots and the like.

title: Multi-view remote sensing scene classification method, device and apparatus based on feature fusion
description: The present invention discloses a multi-view remote sensing scene classification method, equipment and device based on feature fusion. The present invention performs multi-view scene feature recognition on an image set after image processing based on a preset GLS-HBP model to obtain a scene feature recognition result. The preset GLS-HBP model is a bilinear feature fusion model of an improved global attention mechanism obtained by training based on an HBP network model combined with a GAM attention mechanism and a loss function based on label smoothing. The loss function of label smoothing refers to a cross entropy loss function for multi-category classification. According to the scene feature recognition result, the scene corresponding to the remote sensing image set is classified to obtain a target scene type. The present invention reduces the influence of inter-class similarity on feature representation by introducing a label smoothing cross entropy loss function, avoids the hidden danger of overfitting when classifying similar object categories, and further improves the classification performance of the algorithm.

title: Early warning method, system, equipment and medium for potential safety hazards of equipment electricity utilization
description: The invention provides an early warning method, system, equipment and medium for potential safety hazards of equipment, which comprise the steps of carrying out ultrahigh frequency dynamic sampling on real-time current of the equipment through a current detector based on a carbon nanotube array to obtain a plurality of current data sample points, carrying out chaotic characteristic index calculation on the current data sample points, obtaining nonlinear characteristic points in the current data sample points based on the chaotic characteristic index to form a risk current characteristic set, carrying out synchronous monitoring processing on real-time voltage of the equipment through a voltage monitoring module, carrying out data normalization and characteristic extraction processing on monitored voltage data to obtain voltage key characteristic parameters, and inputting the risk current characteristic set and the voltage key characteristic parameters into a fusion evaluation model based on deep learning for fusion analysis to obtain an evaluation result of potential safety hazards of the equipment. The invention realizes the detection and early warning of potential safety hazards.

title: Industrial control anomaly detection method based on distributed linear deep learning
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of industrial control systems, and specifically to an industrial control anomaly detection method based on distributed linear deep learning. The method performs time series bilateral filtering on time series data, effectively removes the noise in the time series data, and can also retain the information of attacking a single or a few sensors. The method solves the problem that when traditional bilateral filtering is used for time series, the data after filtering is different due to the different positions of sensor data. The method uses a distributed method to split a large problem into multiple small problems, and can distribute data, tasks, etc. to multiple machines for parallel execution. The mask method is used to remove redundancy. The designed model is simple and effective, and the threshold of anomaly detection is adjusted according to the prediction error of the verification set. The method can not only detect abnormal attacks, but also locate the sensor causing the anomaly, thereby solving the problems that the existing industrial control anomaly detection method is susceptible to various noise interferences, the model is complex, and the memory cost is high.

title: Aging prediction method, equipment and medium for proton exchange membrane fuel cell
description: The present application discloses a method, device and medium for predicting the aging of a proton exchange membrane fuel cell, which relates to the field of fuel cells, including: obtaining the stack voltage of a proton exchange membrane fuel cell at different historical sampling time points, and obtaining a stack voltage sequence arranged in the order of the time historical sampling time period; intercepting training samples in the stack voltage sequence to construct a training set; using the training set to train a gated recurrent unit neural network model using the honey badger algorithm to obtain a trained gated recurrent unit neural network model; and based on the n-1 stack voltages at and before the current moment, predicting the N-n stack voltages after the current moment, and then predicting the aging trend of the battery. The present application improves the aging prediction accuracy of a proton exchange membrane fuel cell by using a training set to train a gated recurrent unit neural network model using the honey badger algorithm, and predicting the stack voltage based on the trained model.

title: Fetal heart image recognition method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention provides a fetal heart image recognition method, device, electronic device and storage medium, belonging to the field of deep learning technology, the method includes: obtaining an ultrasonic cardiac image of a fetus, obtaining a segmentation network, inputting the ultrasonic cardiac image into the segmentation network, obtaining contour images of the atrium and ventricle, obtaining a first eigenvector based on the contour images of the atrium and ventricle, obtaining a self-supervised learning network, inputting the ultrasonic cardiac image into the self-supervised learning network, obtaining a second eigenvector, performing score calculation on the second eigenvector, obtaining a score corresponding to the second eigenvector, performing regression analysis on the scores corresponding to the first eigenvector and the second eigenvector, obtaining a multimodal nomogram, and obtaining a recognition result of a fetal heart image based on the multimodal nomogram. The present invention solves the technical problem that the recognition efficiency and the recognition accuracy cannot be taken into account in the prior art.

title: Saline-alkali soil treatment and early warning method
description: The present invention provides a saline-alkali land governance early warning method, which relates to the field of saline-alkali land governance early warning. The saline-alkali land data of the successfully improved saline-alkali land are collected during the improvement period of the successfully improved saline-alkali land; the historical saline-alkali land data of the successfully improved saline-alkali land are used to fill the missing data; a standard curve is established according to the completed saline-alkali land data of the successfully improved saline-alkali land; the standard curve is corrected according to the difference in the improvement influencing factors to obtain the governance target curve; the remote sensing data of the saline-alkali land to be evaluated is collected in real time to obtain the saline-alkali land data of the saline-alkali land to be evaluated; the saline-alkali land data of the saline-alkali land to be evaluated is subtracted from the governance target curve; if the difference is within a preset range, the governance of the saline-alkali land to be evaluated does not require an early warning; if the difference exceeds the preset range, a BP neural network is established to predict the saline-alkali land data at the next collection moment of the saline-alkali land to be evaluated and to conduct governance early warning. The present invention realizes accurate and timely early warning of the saline-alkali land governance process.

title: Deep learning-based pneumoconiosis prognosis multi-outcome competition risk prediction method
description: The invention discloses a method for predicting the risk of multiple outcomes of pneumoconiosis prognosis competition based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: (1) Acquiring basic data and constructing a database, wherein the basic data comprise social status, life hygiene habit, dust collecting factors, gene susceptibility, disease conditions, inspection indexes and fatalities; (2) processing basic data: processing abnormal values in the basic data by utilizing an interpolation method, and creating a data set for the basic data by utilizing a synthetic minority class oversampling technology; (3) And (3) constructing a pneumoconiosis ending prognosis prediction model by using the DNN neural network according to the data set constructed in the step (2), and training the pneumoconiosis ending prognosis prediction model to obtain a final prediction model. The invention effectively prevents pneumoconiosis, and reduces the loss of work ability and economic benefit of pneumoconiosis patients by managing the bad prognosis factors.

title: Electric power material demand prediction method and system based on deep learning
description: The embodiment of the application provides a power material demand prediction method and a system based on deep learning, which utilize a sample power equipment association track and a sample material association track as input data, and respectively generating a sample electric power material knowledge vector and a sample power station knowledge vector by extracting the trajectory graph vector and introducing a first prediction unit and a second prediction unit. Further, the characteristic distance between the two characteristics is calculated as a target training cost parameter, and the basic prediction neural network is subjected to fine parameter adjustment and optimization, so that a more accurate target prediction neural network is generated, complex demand association between a power station and electric power supplies can be effectively captured, the change of a demand mode in an electric power system can be automatically adapted, timely and accurate electric power supply demand prediction is provided for the electric power system, powerful support is provided for material allocation, inventory management and purchasing decision, inventory cost is effectively reduced, and the overall efficiency and response speed of a supply chain are improved.

title: Detection model for brake pads, sorting system and sorting method
description: The invention discloses a detection model, a sorting system and a sorting method for a brake pad, wherein the detection model designed by the invention is an improved YoloV-OBB neural network model, so that the detection speed and the detection accuracy can be improved. The sorting system and the sorting method for the brake pads, which are designed by the invention, can realize rapid sorting of the brake pads based on the detection model, and have the advantages of high sorting efficiency, low detection cost, high detection speed and high detection quality compared with the existing industrial manual flow water line detection.

title: A self-supervised downscaling method and system for remote sensing temperature products
description: The application relates to the technical field of design optimization, and provides a self-supervision remote sensing temperature product downscaling method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a scale reduction multiple based on the spatial resolution and the target resolution of remote sensing temperature product data RS  1 , obtaining upscaled remote sensing raster data RS  0  through upscaling, calculating respective range flat value raster data of RS  1  and RS  0 , expressing different data rules by using original temperature data and range flat value raster data, carrying out extraction of self-supervision knowledge, reducing the spatial resolution of remote sensing temperature product data RS  1  to the target resolution according to the extracted self-supervision knowledge, and finally obtaining a temperature simulation value of the downscaled raster data RS  1α  by using a high-precision curved surface modeling method. According to the method, data from other sources are not needed, the law of the remote sensing data is fully mined based on the characteristics of the remote sensing temperature product data, and the extracted self-supervision knowledge is applied to the downscaling process, so that the conversion of the spatial resolution from low to high is realized.

title: A general method for change detection in multi-temporal and high-resolution remote sensing images
description: The present invention discloses a universal multi-temporal high-resolution remote sensing image change detection method, constructs a universal multi-temporal high-resolution remote sensing image change detection process, establishes an end-to-end universal segmentation model, adopts query images and template images, introduces multiple annotation methods to form prompt information, completes the training of the end-to-end universal segmentation model, and realizes that in actual use, only two template images of different phases and related prompts need to be input to complete the detection of similar changed targets of the entire data set. The changed target detection process has a certain degree of universality and does not require retraining, thereby effectively reducing the workload of sample annotation and model training in existing change detection tasks.

title: Biological neuron simulation method based on dendritic bilinear artificial neural network
description: A biological neuron simulation method based on a dendritic bilinear artificial neural network constructs an equivalent artificial neural network model of a biological neuron based on a biological neuron dendritic bilinear integration rule in an off-line stage, trains by using numerical simulation data of a neuron fine model as a training set, and realizes biological neuron dynamics simulation by adopting the equivalent artificial neural network model of the biological neuron in the on-line stage. The invention combines the dendritic bilinear integration rule with the artificial neural network to establish the equivalent model of the biological neuron, has low training cost and high prediction accuracy for the dynamics of the biological neuron, can predict the characteristics of the biological neuron such as subthreshold membrane potential, discharge moment and the like, and can realize the same calculation characteristics as the biological neuron such as direction selectivity, consistency detection, logic operation and the like. Compared with the traditional biological neuron dynamics simulation method, the simulation operation time is greatly shortened, and convenience is provided for large-scale biological neuron dynamics simulation.

title: Integrated intelligent decision-making method for regional attack and defense under threat of explosion impact
description: The invention discloses an area attack and defense integrated intelligent decision-making method under explosion impact threat, which comprises the following steps of constructing an explosion damage effect database and an explosion impact structure mechanical response database to obtain an attack and defense integrated intelligent decision-making database, constructing an explosion impact structure mechanical response object driving intelligent model, constructing a dispatching, protecting and striking area network flow model, acquiring area network flow from the area network flow model, constructing an area key facility rush repair dispatching decision-making model, constructing an area weak point and vulnerability assessment model, constructing an area protection scheme decision-making model, constructing an area striking scheme decision-making model, and calling a corresponding decision-making model to make a decision according to decision requirements and on-site decision parameters acquired by real-time communication to obtain an attack and defense integrated intelligent decision-making result. The intelligent decision method provided by the invention has comprehensive and accurate decision.

title: Object searching method, system, medium and robot based on dynamic scene graph
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of object search, and discloses an object search method, system, medium and robot based on a dynamic scene graph, including: obtaining a target search object; obtaining the posture information and visual angle information of the robot at the current moment; judging whether the visual angle information contains the target search object, if so, controlling the robot to move to the target search object; otherwise, combining the posture information and the visual angle information with the dynamic scene graph and the staged target object at the previous moment, integrating to obtain a prompt, based on the prompt, using a large language model to obtain the staged target object at the current moment; adding the posture information and the visual angle information at the current moment to the dynamic scene graph, controlling the robot to move to the staged target object, and returning to continue to obtain the posture information and the visual angle information. The robot can complete the object search task in an unknown environment.

title: Spacer installation gap identification positioning method and system based on semantic segmentation
description: The present invention discloses a method for identifying and locating the installation gap of spacer bars based on semantic segmentation, comprising the following steps: acquiring an image of the installation process of spacer bars to obtain an image data set; performing data enhancement on the image data set, annotating the image, and finally performing data processing to obtain a training data set; constructing an initial model for identifying and locating the installation gap of spacer bars based on the DeepLab3+ algorithm; using the training data set, training the initial model for identifying and locating the installation gap of spacer bars to obtain a model for identifying and locating the installation gap of spacer bars; using the model for identifying and locating the installation gap of spacer bars, identifying and locating the installation gap of spacer bars. The present invention also discloses a system for realizing the method for identifying and locating the installation gap of spacer bars based on semantic segmentation. The method of the present invention improves the recognition efficiency while ensuring the recognition accuracy, adopts the Otsu threshold method for binarization, and effectively divides the image without being affected by the brightness and contrast of the image.

title: Training method, detection method and device of trace element content prediction model and electronic equipment
description: The invention provides a training method, a detection method and a detection device of a trace element content prediction model and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical fields of computer technology and artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of obtaining sample trace element content and sample laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy, resampling the sample laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy to obtain normalized sample laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy, determining correlation coefficients according to the sample trace element content and a set of pixel point intensity values in the normalized sample laser-induced breakdown spectroscopy, determining the set of correlation coefficient pixel point intensity values meeting different preset correlation coefficient thresholds as target sample spectrum data, inputting the target sample spectrum data into K sub-network structures respectively to obtain predicted sample trace element content, adjusting parameters of the K sub-network structures according to the predicted sample trace element content and the sample trace element content respectively, and determining a target trace element content prediction model from the K sub-network structures.

title: Abnormal data identification method and device in power calculation network based on federal Bayesian learning
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying abnormal data in a computational power network based on federal Bayesian learning, wherein under the computational power network architecture, a decentralised federal learning framework is constructed based on a Bayesian neural network, and each computational power node under the framework has various computational power attributes; and selecting an algorithm node with abundant data quantity and strong calculation capability as an initial training node for the first training, and analyzing the characteristics with the greatest influence of an input layer by utilizing the inherent interpretability after the training is finished. According to the calculation force attribute evaluation, selecting the next calculation force node participating in training, transmitting the key characteristic to the calculation force changing node to correspondingly adjust the prior distribution of the calculation force node, and then training. And repeating the operation until the model converges, and stabilizing the performance. The invention not only utilizes the dispatching of the power calculation nodes in the power calculation network to improve the resource utilization rate, but also ensures the privacy of the data. In addition, the invention fully plays the fitting resistance and the interpretability of the Bayesian neural network, and ensures the accuracy of deep learning.

title: Semantic communication method and system based on self-adaptive semantic reconstruction
description: The present invention discloses a semantic communication method and system based on adaptive semantic reconstruction, which belongs to the field of wireless communication technology. It proposes a task-oriented semantic communication framework based on adaptive semantic reconstruction. Through mask operation and design of a semantic reconstruction network with integrated attention mechanism, it realizes flexible compression of semantic information, simulation of data loss during transmission and reconstruction effect adapting to different environments. It also proposes a joint training method of encoding, decoding network and semantic reconstruction network to minimize the loss function of the target task and obtain the approximate optimal solution of neural network parameters. Compared with the existing semantic communication scheme, the proposed scheme has better adaptability to different signal-to-noise ratio, semantic compression rate and semantic loss rate conditions, and can obtain higher task execution performance and semantic transmission benefits in communication.

title: Semantic reverse analysis method for binary communication protocol of intelligent Internet of things
description: The present invention belongs to the field of communication protocol security and discloses a semantic reverse analysis method for a binary communication protocol of an intelligent Internet of Things. The method collects a large number of publicly available protocol specifications of the intelligent Internet of Things binary protocol and the corresponding open source client and server code, obtains a set of semantic tokens for the intelligent Internet of Things binary protocol, automatically generates client and server code in different communication scenarios, captures binary communication traffic between the client and server, relabels the binary traffic, obtains a training data set, trains a deep neural network, and obtains a semantic reverse model for the intelligent Internet of Things binary protocol. The present invention realizes the semantic reverse engineering capability of unknown intelligent Internet of Things binary protocols, improves the understanding of unknown intelligent Internet of Things binary protocols in different communication scenarios, helps to discover hidden protocol vulnerabilities and backdoor control commands, and can effectively improve the security of the intelligent Internet of Things system.

title: User identification method and device
description: The present invention discloses a user identification method and device, and relates to the field of blockchain technology. A specific implementation of the method includes: obtaining blockchain transaction information; inputting the blockchain transaction information into a trained graph neural network to obtain a first graph embedding feature corresponding to the blockchain transaction information; the graph neural network is trained based on a transaction network corresponding to historical transaction information, and the transaction network has blockchain users as nodes and transaction relationships between blockchain users as edges; based on the first graph embedding feature, a random forest model is used to identify risky users in the blockchain transaction information; the random forest model is trained based on a second graph embedding feature corresponding to the transaction network and the positive and negative labels of each node in the transaction network, and the positive and negative labels of the nodes are determined based on the positive and negative labels of the transaction input address and/or transaction output address corresponding to the node. This implementation improves the accuracy of identifying risky users.

title: Question and answer information processing method and device based on permission label and electronic equipment
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a question and answer information processing method and device based on a permission label and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a question and answer information set, extracting question and answer information characteristics of question and answer content information included in the question and answer information, combining the question and answer information in the question and answer information set in a heterogeneous mode, generating an updated question and answer information label for the question and answer information set according to a question and answer information source and a question and answer information label included in the question and answer information set in response to the fact that the number of the question and answer information included in the question and answer information set is larger than the target number, carrying out index updating on a question and answer information index tree corresponding to a virtual question and answer information base according to the updated question and answer information label and the question and answer information set, and carrying out index updating on the question and answer information index tree according to the question and answer information set in response to the fact that the number of the question and answer information included in the question and answer information set is equal to the target number. This embodiment increases storage resource utilization.

title: Method and system for obtaining crop species suitable for soil planting based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for acquiring the types of crops suitable for planting in soil based on artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps of acquiring the PH value, soil fertility index and climate data of selected soil; the PH value, soil fertility index and climate data of the selected soil are standardized and then input into a trained classification model, and crop types suitable for planting of the selected soil are obtained, wherein the climate data comprise annual average temperature, annual average water quantity and sunshine duration. The invention can improve the efficiency and accuracy of obtaining the soil suitable for planting the crop species.

title: Citrus weathering identification method, device, equipment and medium
description: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for identifying a citrus weathering period. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an image to be identified of the citrus in a target area and current environmental parameters of the target area, determining candidate period of the citrus based on the image to be identified and the current environmental parameters based on a citrus candidate period identification model, correcting the candidate period according to the acquisition time of the image to be identified, and determining the target candidate period of the citrus. According to the technical scheme, the influence of the citrus image, the environmental parameters and the acquisition time on the recognition of the citrus weathering period is considered, so that the recognition accuracy of the citrus weathering period is improved.

title: Automatic fault detection and repair integrated circuit design method based on neural network
description: The present invention discloses a method for designing an integrated circuit for automatic fault detection and repair based on a neural network, comprising the following steps: S1, obtaining and preprocessing the operation data of the integrated circuit; S2, using a trained neural network model to analyze the preprocessed data, and the model is dynamically optimized by an adaptive weight pruning algorithm; S3, inputting circuit operation data in real time, automatically identifying the fault type and location, and storing the fault information; S4, based on the stored fault information, starting the automatic repair mechanism, and generating a repair strategy through a multi-objective collaborative optimization algorithm; S5, performing logical reconstruction, enabling redundant circuits and parameter adjustment according to the repair strategy, and optimizing the repair path through deep reinforcement learning; S6, after the repair is completed, using the neural network model to detect and verify the repair effect again; S7, after the repair verification is passed, updating the fault history database. The present invention improves the automation level of integrated circuit fault detection and repair, and enhances the reliability and efficiency of the system.

title: Patent text retrieval method, device, equipment and medium based on knowledge graph
description: The present invention provides a patent text retrieval method, device, equipment and medium based on knowledge graph, wherein the method includes: obtaining key technical solutions in the patent text, using a keyword extraction tool to extract keyword groups and corresponding weights in the key technical solutions; constructing a knowledge graph according to the keyword groups and corresponding weights; obtaining words to be searched, comparing the words to be searched with keyword groups in the knowledge graph, obtaining corresponding search keywords, arranging the search keywords according to matching parameters, searching in the knowledge graph with the search keywords as indexes, and obtaining a searched patent set, so as to solve the technical problem that the search scope is too large and the search results are inaccurate due to fewer keywords.

title: Social robot detection method and system based on modality-specific expert multi-gating hybrid
description: The present invention relates to a social robot detection method and system based on modality-specific expert multi-gated hybrid, and belongs to the field of natural language processing technology. The present invention integrates three account features and adopts a multi-gated hybrid expert mechanism for social robot detection. First, the metadata, relationship graph data, and tweet data of the social account are encoded respectively, and then, in order to better deal with the problem of community differences, we send the encoded information to the multi-gated hybrid expert layer for learning. Next, after obtaining the three major user features (respectively, relationship features, tweet features, and account features) processed by the multi-gated hybrid expert layer, we will send them to the multi-head attention layer to combine these features for account detection. The present invention has achieved good accuracy in the field of social robots, and also shows good performance in generalization and robustness.

title: Troposphere error correction method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a tropospheric error correction method, device, electronic device and storage medium, the method comprising the following steps: obtaining multiple meteorological parameter data of the two grid points closest to the measuring station; obtaining the numerical value of each meteorological parameter of the measuring station; obtaining the zenith dry delay and zenith wet delay at the measuring station; constructing a deep learning model; obtaining the tropospheric dry delay residual and the tropospheric wet delay residual corresponding to the measuring station; obtaining the tropospheric corrected dry delay and wet delay corresponding to the measuring station. The present invention utilizes multiple meteorological parameters of the grid points to obtain the numerical value of each meteorological parameter of the measuring station, thereby obtaining a more accurate meteorological parameter value of the measuring station, obtains the tropospheric dry delay residual and the tropospheric wet delay residual through the deep learning model, and finally obtains the dry delay and wet delay after compensating the corrected residual; thereby correcting the tropospheric delay, reducing errors, and improving signal accuracy.

title: Compliance public chain system widely applied to common business
description: The present invention belongs to the field of blockchain security, and in particular to a compliant public chain system widely used in ordinary business. The system integrates multiple modules such as registration and authentication, smart contracts, compliance verification, behavior monitoring and cross-chain evaluation to ensure the security, compliance and efficient execution of on-chain transactions. The system first implements strict identity registration and address chaining, combined with smart contracts to achieve effective verification and de-anonymization of data, ensure the authenticity and legality of transactions, monitor transaction behaviors in real time, respond quickly to anomalies, and use a traceability and positioning mechanism to accurately lock in violators, implement reputation management and risk warning. In cross-chain transactions, the reputation score is used to select the main node to ensure the quality of cross-chain connections, synchronously monitor cross-chain data transactions, disconnect and trace in case of anomalies, and effectively prevent cross-chain risks.

title: Real-time vehicle detection method adopting feature processing and IoU strategies
description: The invention discloses a vehicle real-time detection method adopting feature processing and I oU strategies, which comprises the steps of obtaining an image to be detected comprising vehicle information, inputting the image to be detected into a vehicle detection model generated by adopting feature processing and IoU strategies, and outputting a vehicle detection result. The method has higher precision in detecting the vehicles in the traffic scene, obviously improves the detection effect of the model on the vehicles which are difficult to identify and are easy to confuse and classify, and improves the problems of small targets and vehicle shielding to a certain extent.

title: Unit combination generation countermeasure imitation learning method considering participation of green motor unit
description: The invention discloses a unit combination generation countermeasure imitation learning method considering participation of a green motor unit, which belongs to the technical field of operation and planning of electric power systems and comprises the steps of S1, establishing a safety constraint unit combination expert system, S2, establishing a safety constraint unit combination generator network model, S3, establishing a safety constraint unit combination discriminator network model, and S4, performing safety constraint unit combination generation countermeasure imitation learning network model training. The invention can be used for the rapid calculation of the electric power spot market under the participation of the green motor group, and provides technical support for promoting the electric power spot market and the comprehensive opening of the green electric trade market.

title: Deep learning dense matching method and system based on probability error rejection
