description: The present invention relates to the field of dense matching technology, and in particular to a deep learning dense matching method and system based on probability error elimination, the method comprising constructing a deep learning dense matching network; in the above network structure, the disparity soft regression adopts a disparity soft regression module based on probability error elimination, firstly sorts the disparity probability of each pixel from large to small, retains the first k values of the disparity probability, and sets the remaining probability values to zero to eliminate small probability errors; adopts a smooth L1 loss function as the target constraint function of network training learning, and uses the trained network to perform dense matching on target scene data. The present invention designs a disparity soft regression module based on probability error elimination, and through the elimination of small probability errors, effectively reduces the interference of small probability errors on the final disparity regression value, thereby improving the matching accuracy.

title: Partial discharge detection method based on ViT and transducer models
description: The present invention discloses a partial discharge detection method based on ViT and Transformer model, comprising the following steps: obtaining a partial discharge PRPD spectrum and converting it into a feature PRPD image; using a pre-trained ViT model to extract feature data of the feature PRPD image and output it to a Transformer model; customizing the Transformer model to process the feature data; using global average pooling and a fully connected layer to classify the processed feature data and identify multiple partial discharge sources. The present invention uses a pre-trained ViT model as a feature extractor to convert the partial discharge PRPD spectrum into image data and extract feature data. A multi-layer TransformerBlock is set to better interpret and analyze the feature PRPD image. Global average pooling and a fully connected layer further process the feature data to achieve multi-label classification, solve the problem of pulse signal overlap and noise signal overlap of multiple partial discharge sources, and can adapt to PRPD image data from different sources and in different formats, thereby improving detection speed and efficiency and reducing detection errors.

title: Self-supervision multi-camera depth prediction method with structural consistency
description: The present invention proposes a self-supervised multi-camera depth prediction method with structural consistency, comprising the following steps: S1: inputting RGB images of adjacent viewpoints into a depth estimation network to obtain a depth basis of the corresponding RGB images; S2: optimizing the depth basis weights of the RGB images and linearly summing them with the depth basis to obtain an initial depth map; S3: projecting the features of the feature images of the adjacent viewpoint RGB images onto the same viewpoint based on the initial depth map to obtain merged projected features; S4: inputting the merged projected features into a weight update network for optimization; S5: performing a linear summation calculation on the updated projected feature weights and the depth basis to obtain an optimized depth map; S6: repeating S1-S5, iteratively optimizing the depth map until the depth basis weights converge, and obtaining a self-supervised multi-camera collaborative depth prediction result. The present invention can utilize small overlapping information between cameras to achieve structural consistency in depth prediction.

title: A method, system, medium and device for calculating the proportion of river ice cover area
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of image processing, and discloses a method, system, medium and device for calculating the proportion of ice-covered area of a river, comprising: dividing an ice surface video into a plurality of video segments, and extracting the first frame of each video segment; for each video segment, using a segmentation model to segment the first frame to obtain a floating ice mask and a river mask, using the floating ice mask and the river mask of the first frame as annotations, and using a video object segmentation model to segment all frames in the video segment to obtain a floating ice mask and a river mask of each frame; based on the pixel area of the floating ice mask and the pixel area of the river mask corresponding to each frame, calculating an estimated interval of the proportion of ice-covered area; and adding an attention mechanism to the segmentation model to make it more suitable for small target object detection and segmentation under the perspective of a drone, and finally achieving an accurate video segmentation task, thereby accurately estimating the ice-covered area of the river.

title: Method and system for predicting retinopathy symptoms of premature infants
description: The present invention relates to the field of image processing, and more particularly to a method and system for predicting retinopathy of prematurity symptoms. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multiple angle retina images and risk factor information, conducting noise reduction and redundancy elimination processing, constructing a feature extraction network, conducting feature fusion on the multiple angle features to obtain fusion features, extracting features from a coder through stacking the risk factor information to obtain risk factor features, conducting feature splicing on the fusion features and the risk factor features to obtain final features, and obtaining a prediction result according to the final features. According to the method, a plurality of retina images shot from different angles are adopted, and the characteristics obtained in the images are spliced with the dangerous factor characteristics, so that the influence of correction gestational age during treatment on retinopathy of premature infants is considered, and the intelligent prediction effect of retinopathy symptoms of premature infants is improved.

title: A mold injection control method and device for electric toothbrush plastic molding
description: The invention provides a method and a device for controlling injection molding of a mold for plastic molding of an electric toothbrush, which relate to the technical field of plastic injection molding and comprise the steps of obtaining geometric data of the electric toothbrush and physical property data of plastic parts, and initializing a mold model of the electric toothbrush; initializing particle swarm parameters, optimizing a material flow path, iteratively obtaining an optimized mold model, performing injection molding simulation to obtain a mold injection performance influence parameter, constructing an injection molding control strategy library, performing matching search to obtain a matching injection molding control strategy, dividing a selected interval to obtain a mold injection molding control strategy parameter interval, constructing an fitness function, performing global optimization, determining a target mold injection molding control strategy parameter, and performing mold injection control of electric toothbrush plastic molding. The invention solves the technical problems of high cost and low efficiency caused by the fact that the injection molding parameter optimization in the prior art is usually started after the die is manufactured and the control parameter is adjusted by trial and error.

title: Software and hardware decoupling brain-like calculation compiling method and device and compiling framework
description: The present disclosure relates to the field of brain-like computing compilation technology, and in particular to a brain-like computing compilation method, device and compilation framework with software and hardware decoupling. The method comprises: converting a brain-like computing application to be compiled into a first intermediate expression, the first intermediate expression being used to be recognized by the compilation framework; converting the first intermediate expression into a second intermediate expression, the abstract level of the second intermediate expression being lower than the abstract level of the first intermediate expression; converting the second intermediate expression into an underlying hardware expression, the underlying hardware expression being used to generate a parameter file running on the target hardware. The method provided in the embodiment of the present disclosure is based on the design concept of software and hardware decoupling, and uses multiple layers of intermediate expressions to hierarchically lower brain-like computing applications to underlying hardware expressions, thereby achieving efficient support for different types of applications.

title: Contract and law consistency examination method based on fine granularity semantic multitasking learning
description: The invention discloses a contract and law consistency examination method based on fine granularity semantic multitask learning, which can be used for law contract examination. According to the invention, a legal provision matching task is taken as a main task, coarse granularity representation of legal texts is learned by using a BERT model, deeper fine granularity semantics contained in the legal texts are extracted by constructing a fine granularity legal semantics enhancement module, and legal provision with higher correlation degree with input contract clauses is matched by using cosine similarity. According to the method, legal text classification tasks are used as auxiliary tasks, and learning ability of legal text features is improved by sharing rich characterizations learned by legal texts in different tasks. Experiments on CLSAD datasets demonstrated the effectiveness of the present invention.

title: Target detection method, target detection device, apparatus, and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the present application provides a target detection method and a target detection device, equipment, and storage medium, which belongs to the field of financial technology technology. The method includes: obtaining a training sample set, adjusting the sample image based on the target size label and the preset target size to obtain an adjusted target and a sample adjusted image; dividing the adjusted target based on the preset target size to obtain an adjusted small target and an adjusted large target; detecting the sample adjusted image based on the initial detection model to obtain a first predicted target category; calculating the first small target loss contribution value based on the first predicted target category; determining the first small target area ratio based on the total area of the small targets of the adjusted small targets and the total area of the large targets of the adjusted large targets; adjusting the initial detection model based on the first small target loss contribution value and the first small target area ratio to obtain a target detection model to perform target detection on the target image. The embodiment of the present application can improve the target detection efficiency while ensuring the detection accuracy.

title: Enterprise risk evaluation method, system and storage medium based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
description: The present invention discloses an enterprise risk assessment method, system and storage medium based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation, and relates to the technical field of enterprise risk assessment. At present, it is difficult to accurately assess risks in combination with the actual influencing factors of enterprise risks. The present invention obtains enterprise operation data to dynamically monitor and evaluate material procurement, project progress, project quality and contract performance risks, including monitoring the damage, specification differences and timeliness of materials to assess material procurement risks; assessing project progress risks in combination with task dependencies and external factors; analyzing the impact of design defects, construction errors and raw material price fluctuations on project quality based on a dynamic weight mechanism; and dynamically adjusting risk prediction contract performance capabilities using fuzzy membership functions and time series models. The dynamic adjustment mechanism of this technical solution improves the real-time nature of the assessment; comprehensively considers a variety of complex factors to adapt to the diversified needs of enterprises; and achieves accurate risk prediction to provide strong support for decision-making.

title: A foundation pit support monitoring method, device and equipment based on machine learning
description: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a foundation pit support monitoring method, a device and equipment based on machine learning, which are used for acquiring foundation pit image data, extracting multi-scale features of the image data through a visual pyramid PVT network, and generating multi-scale feature vectors by utilizing different scale information fused by a feature pyramid network FPN. And (3) calculating global average pooling after flattening the features to obtain global semantic vectors of each scale, and generating cross-scale semantic feature vectors through channel stitching and 1*1 convolution. Based on the relation, the dynamic adjacency matrix is constructed, and the relation semantic features of the foundation pit and the supporting structure are inferred through the graph rolling network GCN. And finally, generating an enhancement characteristic by combining an attention mechanism to judge whether the number and the positions of the supporting structures meet the construction requirements or not, so as to realize real-time and accurate foundation pit supporting monitoring.

title: Next point of interest recommendation method based on multi-relation variational contrastive learning
description: A next interest point recommending method based on multi-relation variation contrast learning relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and enhances the understanding capability of a model on user access place information by constructing a transposed attention-enhanced weight matrix. Through the combined use of the transducer encoder and the GRU network, the multilevel semantic relation in the user access sequence is effectively captured and utilized, and the accuracy of the recommendation system is improved.

title: Automatic sketching method and related equipment for rectal cancer radiotherapy target area
description: The present invention provides an automatic delineation method and related equipment for a target area for radiotherapy of rectal cancer, which are applied to the field of data processing technology. The present application obtains target user information, target area label information, target area label information to be trained, a training data set matching the target area label information to be trained, and a preset target area automatic delineation model based on nnUNET; processes the training data set based on the target area label information to be trained to generate a preset delineation rule; processes the preset target area automatic delineation model based on nnUNET to generate a target target area automatic delineation model; processes the target user information to generate the target user's multimodal CT image information and clinical prior knowledge information matching the target user; processes the target user's multimodal CT image information, the target area label information, and the clinical prior knowledge information matching the target user based on the target area automatic delineation model to generate the target target area delineation information.

title: Multi-component intelligent fault diagnosis method and system for low-rotation-speed mechanical transmission system
description: The invention discloses a multi-component intelligent fault diagnosis method and system for a low-rotation-speed mechanical transmission system, which belong to the field of mechanical fault diagnosis, and adopt improved robust local binarization operation to convert vibration signals into characteristic enhanced gray texture images, and highlight component characteristic information in original vibration data. A vibration gray texture image noise reduction model based on a self-encoder is constructed, and the noise reduction model has good noise reduction effects on noise of different degrees. By optimizing the width of the convolutional neural network model, the weight of the fault diagnosis model is reduced, the fault diagnosis accuracy is ensured, and the fault diagnosis efficiency is improved. The invention solves the problem of low accuracy of the fault diagnosis model caused by weak vibration signal energy and noise interference of the traditional mechanical system in the low-rotation-speed and noise environment, and provides an effective solution for intelligent fault diagnosis of all parts of the mechanical transmission system in the low-rotation-speed and noise environment.

title: Air conditioner control method and system for optimizing thermal comfort of subway carriage
description: The invention discloses an air conditioner control method and system for optimizing the thermal comfort of a subway carriage, which relate to the technical field of fluid simulation and comprise a subway carriage model established by AnsysFluent, and carrying out numerical simulation on the non-optimized subway carriage, and then carrying out error analysis on the non-optimized subway carriage and the actual data, so as to establish a more accurate carriage model. Numerical simulation is carried out on the thermal environment of the subway carriage under different standing room densities, the air supply parameters are optimized based on the related standard specification, the PMV and other evaluation indexes, and the three-dimensional density is classified according to the optimization result. The method comprises the steps of calculating a zone where the density of the railway carriage standing room is located at each train starting moment in real time by adopting a detection algorithm of the density of the subway carriage standing room based on a self-adaptive susceptor, controlling a carriage air conditioning system by adopting fuzzy PID control instead of a traditional switch, and adjusting the temperature in the carriage by adopting a standing room density zone linkage fuzzy PID controller obtained by calculation.

title: Hidden crack identification method and device and hidden crack identification equipment
description: The embodiment of the application provides a hidden crack identification method and device and hidden crack identification equipment. The method comprises the steps of determining a first crack to be identified in a first view of an object to be identified and a second crack to be identified in a second view, determining hidden cracks to be identified in the first crack to be identified according to the pixel change condition of the first crack to be identified in the first view when the position of the first crack to be identified does not correspond to the position of the second crack to be identified, and identifying hidden cracks to be identified according to the position relation between the first hidden cracks to be identified and the second crack to be identified and the position relation between the first hidden cracks to be identified and other cracks to be identified in other views of the object to be identified to obtain hidden crack identification results. The method is used for achieving the effect of improving the detection accuracy.

title: Signal lamp timing method and device for intelligent traffic system and electronic device
description: The application discloses a signal lamp timing method, a signal lamp timing device and an electronic device of an intelligent traffic system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining traffic data collected in real time by sensing equipment deployed at a human as you like crossroad and a crossing adjacent to the crossroad and processing the traffic data; the method comprises the steps of training and deploying a gate control transducer model, carrying out state and action state and rewarding sequence modeling on traffic data collected at each time point by utilizing the gate control transducer model, analyzing and predicting traffic and pedestrian flow states, processing and analyzing real-time data flow by the gate control transducer model, outputting signal timing adjustment data, and dynamically adjusting signal timing time, thereby solving the problems of low response speed, incapability of effectively predicting future traffic trend, low data processing speed, low data utilization rate, difficulty in adapting to traffic environment change and the like of a signal lamp adjustment method in an intelligent traffic system.

title: Apparatus for manufacturing display device and method of manufacturing display device
description: Provided is an apparatus for manufacturing a display device and a method for manufacturing a display device, the apparatus comprising: a droplet ejection unit for ejecting droplets; a detection unit arranged on a falling path of the droplets and configured to detect low-resolution data of the droplets to obtain detection low-resolution data; and a control unit configured to determine the volume of each of the droplets based on the detection low-resolution data. The control unit comprises: a machine learning unit configured to perform machine learning to determine the correlation between the sampled low-resolution data and the sampled high-resolution data of the droplets; and a volume extraction unit configured to determine the volume of the falling droplets by amplifying the detection low-resolution data into amplified high-resolution data based on the result of learning by the machine learning unit. The sampled high-resolution data has a magnification greater than that of the sampled low-resolution data.

title: Neural network accelerator and acceleration method
description: The invention provides a neural network accelerator and an acceleration method, comprising an on-chip cache module and a calculation module, wherein the on-chip cache module is used for storing an input characteristic diagram, an output characteristic diagram and sparse weight parameters in a compression format, the calculation module comprises N processing unit groups, each processing unit group is used for decompressing the sparse weight parameter group, screening out the non-zero sparse weight parameters, the processing unit groups acquire input data corresponding to the sparse weight parameters in the sparse weight parameter group, and multiply-accumulate calculation is carried out on all the sparse weight parameters and the input data in the sparse weight parameter group.

title: Improved depth residual error network gold ore prospecting prediction method
description: The invention discloses an improved depth residual error network gold ore prospecting prediction method, and relates to the field of gold ore prospecting prediction. The method comprises the steps of obtaining relevant data of gold ores in a research area, selecting a plurality of element data as first sample data, obtaining four load factors by adopting a self-adaptive nuclear density estimation method and a factor analysis method, taking the content data of the plurality of geological elements containing the four load factors in the research area as second sample data, constructing a regular grid for the second sample data by adopting an inverse distance weight interpolation method, fusing the data in the regular grid to form a multidimensional data sample, processing the multidimensional data sample by adopting a step size translation method and a random discarding method to obtain a sample data subset, constructing an improved depth residual error network model integrated by three depth residual error network submodels, and respectively predicting the sample data subset by adopting the improved depth residual error network gold ore finding prediction model to obtain potential distribution areas of the gold ores.

title: Organic matter identification method and system based on pseudo-color enhancement and channel fusion
description: The present invention provides an organic matter identification method and system based on pseudo-color enhancement and channel fusion, the method comprising the steps of: obtaining a training sample consisting of a first pseudo-color X-ray image that has been marked; inputting the training sample into an improved target recognition model for training to obtain a trained organic matter detection model; wherein the improved target recognition model comprises a preprocessing module and a target detection module, the preprocessing module comprises a channel fusion unit for separating and fusing the RGB channels of the pseudo-color X-ray image and a pseudo-color enhancement unit for dynamically weighting the RGB channels of the pseudo-color X-ray image, and the target detection module is used to identify the preprocessed pseudo-color X-ray image; inputting a second pseudo-color X-ray image to be identified into the organic matter detection model to obtain a target detection result of the second pseudo-color X-ray image. The present invention can significantly improve the recognition rate of pseudo-color organic matter targets while ensuring real-time performance.

title: Intelligent monitoring-based coal mine fireproof early warning method
description: The invention discloses a coal mine fireproof early warning method based on intelligent monitoring, which relates to the technical field of coal mine fireproof early warning. According to the invention, the generated environment safety change index is used for carrying out intelligent evaluation on the environment, when the high-risk environment is judged, the system dynamically adjusts the sampling frequency based on the preset sampling frequency, timely captures the fine change of the early stage of the fire disaster such as methane diffusion or air static pressure fluctuation, ensures rapid early warning, improves the accuracy and timeliness of signal capturing, and strives for early intervention time for management staff. In a low-risk environment, the system collects data at a fixed sampling frequency, reduces unnecessary calculation tasks and energy consumption, and supports long-term monitoring and trend analysis. Through the dual regulation mechanism, the system not only ensures the data integrity, but also optimizes the resource utilization and the operation efficiency.

title: Traffic accident risk assessment method, equipment and medium based on 2D-CNN deep learning model
description: The invention discloses a traffic accident risk assessment method, equipment and medium based on a 2D-CNN deep learning model, wherein the traffic accident risk assessment model based on the 2D-CNN deep learning is trained to determine optimal model parameters, so that traffic accident risks can be more scientifically and accurately assessed, deep features of the traffic accident can be automatically excavated through a convolution layer, the calculation depth of the convolution neural network can be increased, data distribution is regularized by adding batch normalization (Batch Normalization, BN) layers into the model, the influence caused by data distribution deviation can be reduced, secondary dimension reduction is carried out by a pooling layer, meanwhile, a discarding layer (Dropout) is introduced, the generalization capability of the model can be improved, finally, the accident risk assessment grade is determined through a Softmax function, and finally, the probability distribution result of the visual traffic accident risk grade is output.

title: Image processing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application provides an image processing method, an image processing device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are applied to the field of financial science and technology. And inputting the image characteristics into a characteristic enhancement network to obtain image characteristics, screening high-resolution target image characteristics, and carrying out characteristic aggregation to obtain aggregation characteristics. The aggregate features and other image features are input into a first convolution network to obtain a multi-level feature map, and the image to be processed is input into a residual error network to obtain a residual error feature map. And finally, fusing the multi-level feature map and the residual feature map to obtain the image with enhanced features. Therefore, different downsampling and characteristic enhancement networks are adopted to adapt to different scale information, so that the image contains multi-scale information such as high-resolution details, low-resolution global structures and the like, the problem of missed detection caused by dark light is effectively avoided, the detection accuracy is improved, and a more reliable basis is provided for detecting a maintenance scheme of a vehicle part.

title: Medicine adverse event detection method and system based on knowledge enhancement neural network model
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for detecting adverse drug events based on a knowledge-enhanced neural network model, and relates to the technical field of natural language processing. The method combines a pre-trained language model BioBERT, a convolutional neural network, and a Transformer network, and enhances the model's ability to understand biomedical entities and their relationships by acquiring keywords related to biomedical text entities from an external knowledge base. The joint learning strategy is adopted to achieve simultaneous optimization of entity recognition and relationship extraction, thereby significantly improving the accuracy of adverse drug reaction detection and the robustness of the model, and being able to effectively handle complex semantic relationships.

title: Efficient and accurate pollution source monitoring quality control system and method
description: This application relates to the field of environmental monitoring and discloses an efficient and accurate pollution source monitoring quality control system and method. The system includes a multimodal data acquisition module, a high-dimensional data modeling module, a spatiotemporal correlation analysis module, a time series prediction module, a multi-task learning module, and an anomaly detection feedback module. By collecting pollutant data such as air, water quality, and noise, the data is high-dimensionally modeled and optimized, and the spatiotemporal propagation paths of pollutants between different sensor nodes are captured. The system predicts short-term changes and long-term trends in pollutant concentrations in real time. The multi-task learning model is used to simultaneously predict the concentration changes of multiple pollutants, and the time series is decomposed at multiple scales through wavelet transform to detect abnormal changes in the data and generate feedback control strategies. The present invention improves the accuracy and real-time performance of pollution source monitoring, can effectively respond to the dynamic changes of multiple pollutants, and ensure the efficiency and reliability of environmental quality monitoring.

title: Method for generating Flink stream processing task, electronic device, storage medium, and computer program product
description: The application provides a generating method of a Flink stream processing task, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product, which comprise the steps of taking task description information aiming at target power distribution equipment as input of a trained large power distribution field model to obtain a configuration file of the stream processing task output by the large power distribution field model, wherein the task description information indicates data of a plurality of measuring points on the target power distribution equipment to be processed, checking the configuration file to determine whether the configuration file is correct, and if so, generating the Flink stream processing task based on a preset operator and a preset data source indicated by the configuration file. The method and the device solve the problem that a user cannot quickly and accurately generate a correct Flink stream processing task due to insufficient writing capacity of the Flink stream processing task.

title: Nonlinear modal data driving identification method based on physical fusion deep learning
description: The invention provides a nonlinear modal data driving identification method based on physical fusion deep learning, the method utilizes a deep learning technology, and can identify the nonlinear mode only by relying on response data of a nonlinear system. This process strictly follows the definition of nonlinear regular modalities, ensures the physical interpretability of the recognition process, and is applicable to various nonlinear systems. Compared with the traditional nonlinear modal identification method, the nonlinear modal identification method effectively solves the problems that the nonlinear modal identification is high in computational complexity, priori knowledge of nonlinear behaviors depends on, the identification method lacks of physical explanation and the like.

title: Cloud edge collaboration mechanism-based prediction method, system and equipment for aggregation adjustable capacity of virtual power plant
description: The invention discloses a prediction method, a prediction system and prediction equipment for aggregation adjustable capacity of a virtual power plant based on a cloud edge cooperative mechanism, which are used for carrying out correlation analysis and feature reconstruction on input data according to a maximum information coefficient based on a cloud edge cooperative system network system and preprocessing the data; and carrying out point prediction on the future aggregation adjustable capacity value through a CNN-BiLSTM-QR model, reliably representing probability intervals of the adjustable capacity under different quantiles through a quantile regression probability prediction model, and simultaneously outputting a point prediction result and an interval prediction result of the aggregation adjustable capacity. The method and the system can accurately predict the adjustable capacity of the demand side resources in the virtual power plant, so that the virtual power plant effectively participates in power system dispatching and the running efficiency and stability of the system are improved.

title: Digital person rapid development method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: A method, system, electronic device and storage medium for rapid development of digital human beings, relating to the field of digital human development. In the method, when a first character requirement and a first scene requirement are received, a first appearance feature and a personality feature are determined according to the first character requirement, and a second appearance feature and a preset function are determined according to the first scene requirement; a first digital human is constructed according to the first appearance feature, the second appearance feature, the personality feature and the preset function; an activity scene and a test scenario are constructed according to the first scene requirement, and the test scenario includes a trigger condition, an interactive object, and an expected result; and the first digital human is trained according to the test scenario to obtain a second digital human. The technical solution provided by the present application is implemented to achieve the effect of rapidly developing a digital human capable of coping with complex scenes and emotional interactions.

title: Feature fusion module based on wavelet transformation
description: A feature fusion module based on wavelet transform, comprising the following specific steps: first, down-sampling low-level features by wavelet transform; second, up-sampling high-level features by wavelet transform; and finally, splicing the current level features with the low-level features and the high-level features to obtain fused features. The beneficial effects of the present invention are as follows: the feature fusion module based on wavelet transform has the function of capturing multi-scale feature information, which not only effectively suppresses noise and reduces information redundancy, but also can enhance the feature expression capability.

title: A method for constructing a cell nucleus segmentation model, a cell nucleus segmentation method, and a construction device.
description: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a cell nucleus segmentation model construction method, a cell nucleus segmentation method and a construction device, wherein the construction method comprises the steps of obtaining a cell image data set; the method comprises the steps of constructing a cell nucleus segmentation network structure, wherein the cell nucleus segmentation network structure comprises a patch embedding layer, an encoder module, a tokenization KAN network module, a decoder module and a projection layer which are sequentially connected, the encoder module and the decoder module are further connected through a frequency domain learning module, the frequency domain learning module is used for transmitting low-level features in the encoder module to the decoder module, the tokenization KAN network module is used for extracting deep features, and the cell nucleus segmentation network is trained based on a cell image data set to obtain a cell nucleus segmentation model. The cell nucleus segmentation model provided by the invention focuses on the cell nucleus boundary effect, and greatly improves the cell nucleus segmentation precision.

title: Accidental health risk assessment method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The application discloses a damage assessment method, device, equipment and storage medium for unexpected health risks, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. Firstly, an image of an invoice to be processed is acquired, and the type of the invoice is identified by using a convolutional neural network. And selecting a corresponding text field extraction rule according to the invoice type, and performing text extraction on the invoice image to obtain specific text information in the invoice. And then, correlating the extracted invoice text field with a medical knowledge graph, and identifying medical service item codes and medicine codes. Then, the item expense amount in the invoice is calculated by combining the codes of the medical service item and the medicine through the preset expense standard. Finally, the risk of damage is assessed and determined according to the project cost amount and the limit of the claim amount of the unexpected health risk. The application also relates to the technical field of blockchain, and the invoice image is stored in a blockchain network. The application greatly improves the damage assessment efficiency, reduces the dependence on professional manpower and obviously improves the processing speed of the insurance cases.

title: Clinical data acquisition system and data correction method for respiratory patient
description: The application provides a respiratory patient clinical data acquisition system and a data correction method, which are characterized in that firstly, a historical clinical data set of all respiratory patients is acquired through acquisition instructions, then, test indexes of different respiratory signs are extracted from the historical clinical data set, then, multi-level pathological feature association analysis is carried out on all the test indexes to obtain the dependence of pathological structures among all the test indexes, further, association clustering is carried out on the pathological features of all the respiratory signs to obtain a plurality of pathological feature clusters, a feature dependence tree of each pathological feature cluster is constructed through the dependence of the pathological structures among all the test indexes in each pathological feature cluster, and further, correction processing is carried out on clinical data of target respiratory patients according to all the feature dependence trees to obtain correction data of clinical data of target respiratory patients. The multi-variable relevance correction of clinical data of respiratory patients can be realized, so that the reliability of the clinical data is improved.

title: Slurry pump operation monitoring and optimizing system and method based on machine learning
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of operation monitoring, and discloses a slurry pump operation monitoring and optimization system and method based on machine learning. The present invention first obtains the slurry pump operation index, obtains the original slurry pump operation data, and performs abnormal data detection and deletion and missing data filling to complete data preprocessing; secondly, uses the historical slurry pump operation data to calculate the adaptive threshold, verifies the security of the slurry pump operation data based on the adaptive threshold, and completes the slurry pump operation monitoring; then trains the support vector regression model to obtain the support vector regression prediction model, and outputs the slurry pump operation data prediction value; finally, according to the slurry pump operation data prediction value and the slurry pump operation index, uses the escape optimization algorithm to optimize the slurry pump operation index to achieve slurry pump operation optimization. The present invention achieves the purpose of slurry pump operation monitoring and optimization by processing and analyzing the slurry pump operation data, and the method is accurate and objective.

title: HRRP sample generation method and system based on category-guided DDPM
description: The present invention discloses a HRRP sample generation method and system based on category-guided DDPM, the method comprising: normalizing and centroid-aligning preprocessing the HRRP raw data to generate a small sample data set; constructing a one-dimensional conditional convolutional network, the input of which is a sample to be denoised, and the output is a predicted noise with the same dimension as the input, the one-dimensional conditional convolutional network comprising a downsampling module and an upsampling module integrated into the time step and the angular domain; training the one-dimensional conditional convolutional network using the small sample data set to obtain a trained category-guided denoising diffusion probability model; and generating an extended sample data set using the trained category-guided denoising diffusion probability model. The present invention solves the problems in the field of HRRP sample generation, such as unstable model training, poor quality of samples generated under small sample conditions, uncontrollable angular domain of samples generated by conventional diffusion models, and easy generation of out-of-distribution samples.

title: Small sample target detection data enhancement method
description: The present invention relates to the field of target detection, and in particular to a small sample target detection data enhancement method, comprising the following steps: dividing small sample data to form a training set, a verification set and a test set, and annotating the data set for target detection; using the center point position of a target detection frame in the training set as input, and using the width and height of the target detection frame as labels to train a neural network; performing a two-dimensional Gaussian distribution conversion on the target detection frame in the training set; using a graph target in the training set and adopting a stable diffusion model to train the image to generate a new target image; randomly selecting coordinates within a visible range, and generating corresponding coordinates through a previously trained size prior neural network to obtain a new target detection frame; through the present invention, the problem of small sample target detection is effectively solved, the accuracy of target detection is significantly improved, and manufacturing enterprises are brought many benefits, including reducing the false detection rate, improving production efficiency, and reducing production costs.

title: A method, device and equipment for software detection and computer storage medium
description: The present application provides a method, device, equipment and computer storage medium for software detection, which relates to the field of computer technology and is used to improve the efficiency and objectivity of assessment results in practical assessments. The method includes: dividing the program file of the software to be detected into at least two data blocks; respectively obtaining at least one continuous byte sequence set in each data block, and the distribution in a data block; the byte lengths corresponding to each continuous byte sequence set are different; based on the distribution corresponding to each continuous byte sequence set obtained, a data block is classified and identified to obtain a classification and identification result corresponding to a data block; based on the classification and identification results corresponding to each of the at least two data blocks obtained, combined with the position information of each data block in the program file, the at least two classification and identification results obtained are weighted and fused to obtain the target detection result corresponding to the software to be detected.

title: Cleaning factor evaluation method, system, device and medium based on monitoring data
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of boiler operation and maintenance, and in particular to a cleaning factor evaluation method, system, device and medium based on monitoring data; deploying monitoring equipment to obtain monitoring data of a coal-fired boiler, and performing data cleaning on the acquired data; establishing a parameter adjustment model based on historical boiler operation data and monitoring data, and optimizing boiler operation parameters; calculating the heat transfer coefficient of a heating surface, evaluating the operating state of the boiler, and using a neural network model to construct an ideal heat transfer coefficient prediction model; establishing a boiler heating surface cleaning factor calculation model, and dynamically adjusting boiler maintenance and cleaning strategies; the present invention solves the problem of untimely or excessive maintenance in traditional maintenance strategies, reduces maintenance costs and energy consumption, improves the heat transfer efficiency and operation stability of the boiler, and extends the service life of boiler equipment; the present invention significantly improves the overall operation efficiency and safety of the boiler system, and realizes intelligent boiler maintenance and management.

title: A data analysis method, system and storage medium
description: The application discloses a data analysis method, a data analysis system and a storage medium, which are used in the field of natural language processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining natural language input by a user, constructing a semantic data model for converting the natural language into semantic query sentences, constructing a semantic analyzer by combining the semantic data model with a user-defined rule, inputting the natural language into the semantic analyzer for analysis to obtain the semantic query sentences, inputting the semantic query sentences into a semantic corrector for correction to obtain target semantic query sentences, converting the target semantic query sentences into structured query sentences through a semantic translator, and inputting the structured query sentences into a database for query to obtain query results.

title: Scene management and intelligent recommendation method and system based on data space
description: The invention provides a scene management and intelligent recommendation method and system based on a data space, wherein the scene management and intelligent recommendation method based on the data space comprises the steps of selecting a system function in a preset database, matching corresponding data types according to the selected system function, and making a corresponding data acquisition plan according to the system function and the data types; the method comprises the steps of preparing a data acquisition plan, acquiring data based on the prepared data acquisition plan, selecting a data processing model matched with the acquired data according to the acquired data, processing the acquired data to form a feature fusion layer, introducing an attention mechanism and an information transmission mechanism between channels into the selected data processing model to optimize the selected data processing model, training the optimized data processing model to obtain an attention mechanism weight matrix, and adjusting the obtained attention weight matrix to realize personalized recommendation. The technical problems of insufficient processing and recommending capabilities of heterogeneous data in the related art are solved.

title: Method and system for generating active safety coping strategy enhancement of power grid event
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of network security of power systems, and particularly discloses a method and a system for generating an active security coping strategy enhancement of a power grid event, wherein the method comprises the following steps of constructing a security constraint rule based on a power grid fault coping strategy; the method comprises the steps of constructing a power grid event safety coping knowledge graph, generating a plurality of coping strategies for fault problems by using the constructed power grid event safety coping knowledge graph, and screening the most suitable coping strategies from the plurality of coping strategies according to the constructed safety constraint rules. According to the method and the system for generating the power grid event active safety coping strategy enhancement, the power grid event fault coping strategy is actively generated by constructing the power grid event safety coping knowledge graph, and the generated coping strategy can be optimized to obtain the optimal coping strategy, so that inefficiency and deficiency caused by dependence on manual experience adjustment are avoided.

title: Dam concrete defect air-space inspection system and method thereof
description: The invention discloses a dam concrete defect space inspection system and a method thereof, and relates to the technical field of nondestructive inspection, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a defect sample database of a high dam database based on public dam data, performing defect sample reinforcement learning by using a digital image processing model, generating a plurality of comprehensive defect reinforcement samples of the high dam database, and constructing the defect sample reinforcement database of the high dam database; the method comprises the steps of carrying out multi-source analysis and fusion on defect sample enhancement data based on a defect sample enhancement database of a high dam database to obtain a multi-source fusion defect data set of the high dam database, training a high dam database engineering defect target detection model based on the multi-source fusion defect data set of the high dam database, carrying out rapid identification and quantification on a defect target of the high dam database, carrying out light weight treatment on the high dam database engineering defect target detection model, and deploying to edge equipment to carry out a dam concrete defect inspection task. The invention has the advantages of improving the defect inspection efficiency of the dam and reducing the potential safety hazard of the dam.

title: Intelligent industrial park energy management system and method thereof
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent industrial park energy management system, the system includes a park energy management module, a park energy supply and demand interaction module and a park energy control module. The park energy management module is based on a blockchain to share supply and demand information, record data and manage transactions for distributed energy in the park; the park energy supply and demand interaction module integrates distributed energy in the park and controllable loads of an external network through a virtual power plant architecture; the park energy control module coordinates distributed energy in the park with external network power resources based on a deep reinforcement learning network. The present invention can aggregate distributed energy, energy storage systems and load resources in the park to participate in power grid scheduling in an integrated manner, while blockchain provides a transparent and reliable trading platform through decentralization.

title: Question-answering method for customizing furniture plate processing technology based on multi-mode knowledge graph
description: The present invention discloses a question-and-answer method for custom furniture panel processing technology based on a multimodal knowledge graph, comprising: dividing the production process into different production stations according to processing requirements, dividing the different production stations into multidimensional data, and constructing a station task rhythm model for a custom furniture panel processing workshop based on the multidimensional data; performing preprocessing based on the multidimensional data to obtain a custom furniture panel processing knowledge graph dataset; defining a custom furniture panel processing knowledge graph and entity sets, relationship sets, and attribute sets based on the custom furniture panel processing knowledge graph dataset; performing knowledge extraction, knowledge fusion, and knowledge storage processing on the custom furniture panel processing knowledge graph dataset to obtain a knowledge graph data layer, and constructing a custom furniture panel processing knowledge graph; and constructing a question-and-answer system based on the custom furniture panel processing knowledge graph. The present invention improves the availability and value of data.

title: A graph reachability analysis method and device for third-party library combination calls
description: The present invention relates to a graph reachability analysis method and device for combined calls of third-party libraries, the method comprising: extracting the call edges of software projects and TPLs through an internal call graph summary generation step, distinguishing internal call edges from external call edges, adopting a refinement strategy to eliminate unreachable methods in the TPL through matrix operations, and generating a reachability summary; receiving the position of the TPL to be retrieved through an internal call graph summary retrieval step, reversely searching to determine its dependency path, and forming a dependency node link from the software project to the queried TPL; in the reachability analysis step, combining the call graph summary retrieved by the dependency path with a set of source methods to be judged, and constructing a set of reachable paths from the source method to the target method. The present invention optimizes the generation and retrieval process of the call graph summary, is suitable for processing complex software projects containing a large number of TPLs, and effectively improves the efficiency of graph reachability analysis for combined calls of third-party libraries.

title: A method and system for rapid image recognition based on yolov8 architecture
description: The present disclosure belongs to the field of computer vision technology, and specifically provides a method and system for rapid image recognition based on the yolov8 architecture, wherein the method includes: modifying the serial network architecture of yolov8 into a parallel network architecture, so that the image data passes through the network of the teacher model and the student model during forward propagation; based on the positive sample allocation method of yolov8, the positive sample intervals of the student model and the teacher model are combined into a unified positive sample interval; designing a loss function to obtain an optimized knowledge distillation model; based on the optimized knowledge distillation model, quickly outputting image recognition results. For yolov8, the current leading target detection model, an innovative knowledge distillation system is proposed, aiming to further optimize the performance of yolov8 through this system and expand its application potential in resource-constrained environments. This yolov8 not only maintains its fast and accurate target detection capabilities, but also achieves a better balance between computing resource consumption and model performance.

title: Face depth counterfeiting detection method based on voice and expression matching and related equipment
description: This invention provides a method and related equipment for detecting deepfake faces based on voice and facial expression matching. The method involves inputting video files used for training into a constructed CNN-15-GRU-B model and an improved CNN model, respectively, to obtain a voice emotion analysis model and a facial expression emotion analysis model. These models are then used to extract features from the video files to be detected, resulting in voice emotion features and facial expression emotion features. An emotion similarity matrix is constructed based on this matrix, and the deepfake detection results are analyzed accordingly. Compared with existing technologies, this method extracts voice emotion features and facial expression emotion features through the voice emotion analysis model and the facial expression emotion analysis model. The similarity between these two emotions is used to deeply analyze the naturalness of facial expressions, thereby determining whether deepfake faces exist. This approach overcomes the limitation of directly training with deepfake face samples while improving detection accuracy.

title: Detection method for pipeline transportation of coal bed gas particles
description: The invention discloses a detection method for pipeline transportation of coal bed gas particles, which relates to the technical field of coal bed gas detection, and comprises the steps of utilizing a laser-induced sedimentation technology to promote the sedimentation of the particles in air flow, and obtaining sample data of the particles based on a sedimentation result; the method comprises the steps of processing sample data in a sample data set by using a wavelet transformation technology, extracting sample characteristic data of particles, carrying out primary classification on the sample characteristic data by combining a spectral clustering algorithm, carrying out anomaly detection on a primary classification result by using an isolated forest algorithm, screening the particles based on the anomaly detection result, carrying out secondary classification on the screened particles by using a machine learning algorithm, and carrying out visual display on the particles by using a visual tool. According to the invention, the abnormal detection is carried out on the preliminary classification result by utilizing the isolated forest algorithm, so that abnormal particles are effectively screened out, the overall detection efficiency is improved, and the data processing flow is optimized.

title: Emotion analysis method, emotion analysis device, emotion analysis medium, and emotion analysis program product
description: The invention relates to the technical field of computers and discloses an emotion analysis method, equipment, medium and program product, comprising the steps of dividing a data set containing multiple emotion categories into different subtasks according to set regression categories; the method comprises the steps of traversing each subtask, randomly selecting a set number of samples in the current subtask when training a pulse neural network by adopting the current subtask, calculating weight importance corresponding to each sample, forming a fuzzy set containing membership according to the weight importance, selectively carrying out gradient shielding on partial neurons in a full-connection layer and partial convolution kernels in a convolution structure by using the fuzzy set, obtaining an observation model for emotion analysis after traversing all the subtasks, and carrying out emotion analysis on data to be tested by using the observation model. The gradient shielding mode based on the fuzzy set theory can improve the continuous learning capacity in emotion analysis tasks, reduce data transmission quantity, improve hardware processing speed and further improve emotion prediction accuracy.

title: Feature fusion and multi-task learning-based genome variation named entity recognition method and system
description: The invention relates to a genome mutation named entity recognition method and system based on feature fusion and multitask learning, which comprise the steps of obtaining biomedical text data with genome mutation entity labels, carrying out data enhancement on the biomedical text data to generate diversified enhanced biomedical text data, training a named entity recognition model based on the enhanced biomedical text data, carrying out named entity recognition on biomedical text to be recognized through the trained named entity recognition model to obtain a recognition result, wherein the named entity recognition model comprises a multi-scale feature fusion module with enhanced attention, a first BILSTM layer, a NER module, a token classification module and an entity boundary division module.

title: Photovoltaic power prediction method and system based on seasonal weather typing and RLHF large model
description: The present invention discloses a photovoltaic power prediction method based on seasonal weather typing and RLHF large model, comprising the following steps: Step 1: Data acquisition: Acquire the power generation data and historical meteorological data of the photovoltaic power station to construct a data set; Step 2: Construct a prediction model: Construct a weather typing and photovoltaic output prediction model, divide a year into multiple seasons, subdivide the weather into several weather types, and construct a photovoltaic output prediction model for each weather type in each season; Construct an RLHF large model, use a method combining deep learning and reinforcement learning, and improve the prediction accuracy and interpretability of photovoltaic power generation through pre-training and human feedback; Step 3: Construct a fusion model: Fusion the weather typing and photovoltaic output prediction model and the prediction output of the RLHF large model to obtain the final prediction result of photovoltaic power generation. The present invention also discloses a photovoltaic power prediction system based on seasonal weather typing and RLHF large model.

title: Determining principal components using multi-agent interactions
description: A method, system, and apparatus comprising a computer program encoded on a computer storage medium for determining principal components of a data set using multi-agent interaction. One of the methods includes obtaining initial estimates for a plurality of principal components of a dataset and generating final estimates for each principal component by iteratively performing operations, is an operation that uses the current estimates of the principal components to generate reward estimates, and if the current estimates of the principal components capture more variance in the dataset, then the reward estimates are more Large, for an action and for each parent principal component of the principal component, an action that produces a penalty estimate, if the current estimate of the principal component and the current estimate of the parent principal component are not orthogonal, then the penalty estimate is larger, and an operation of updating the current estimate of the principal component according to the difference between the reward estimate and the penalty estimate.

title: Method and system for determining emotions or sensory perceptions regarding exposure to flavor or aroma components - Patents.com
description: A method (400) for determining emotions or sensory perceptions related to exposure to a flavor or aroma ingredient includes the steps of: inputting (405) at least two flavor or aroma physical component digital representation identifiers on a computer interface, the input corresponding to physical composition digital identifiers representing physical compositions of physical flavor or aroma ingredients; and operating (410) by a computing device instructions configured to associate at least one value with the input physical composition digital identifiers, the value being associated with at least one of the input flavor or aroma physical component digital representation identifiers. The method includes a step (410) of presenting, for the at least one input flavor or aroma physical component digital representation identifier, a relative ranking for the determined perceived emotion or sensation, a value representative of said perception for the at least one determined perceived emotion or sensation, and/or a value representative of a class of flavor or aroma component in a classification of flavor or aroma components by a perceived emotion or sensation for the at least one determined emotion or sensation perception, and a step (415) of providing, on a computer interface, at least one value obtained during said operating step for said input physical composition digital identifier.

title: Calculation and storage of feature values of object shapes
description: [Problem] By selecting feature values of the shape of an arbitrary object that can be calculated as quickly as possible from point cloud data representing the shape of that object, it is possible to more quickly calculate the feature values. [Solution] A device for calculating and storing feature values of an object's shape acquires point cloud data consisting of coordinate values of points assigned to each part of the object, in which points are assigned so that the greater the curvature of the object's shape, the smaller the point spacing, selects, for each point in the point cloud data, other points in the point cloud data that are within a specified range from that point, and calculates, as feature values for each point in the point cloud data, one of the following: the distance between that point and other points included within the specified range, its reciprocal, the difference in coordinate values, its reciprocal, the sum, summation, or dispersion of any of the following: the difference in coordinate values, its reciprocal, the power of the difference, and its reciprocal; and stores the feature values for each point in the point cloud data. [Selected Figure] Figure 3

title: Context set and context fusion
description: In an aspect of the disclosure, a method, a computer readable medium, and apparatus for operating a computational network are provided. The apparatus includes a memory and at least one processor coupled to the memory. In an aspect, the at least one processor may obtain a plurality of features associated with the apparatus. The at least one processor may generate a context based on the plurality of features, the context comprising a multidimensional output. The at least one processor may provide at least a portion of the context to a component of the apparatus.

title: Knowledge management system
description: A computer implemented knowledge management system for performing enterprise scale architectural reviews of IT architecture or IT project proposals uses topic analysis and machine learning methods applied to unstructured data regarding IT strategy, standards and other guidelines to allow generation of technical and business domain specific collections. This enables efficient review by domain experts. This is further enabled through the use of a cloud based digital portal and social networking services that implement a social collaboration model to capture and allow review and exchange of intermediary knowledge during review and evaluation process. This allows wider members of the organisation to comment on a published expert review prior to formal endorsement, thereby speeding up the architecture review process.

title: Quantization for dnn accelerators
description: Methods and apparatus are disclosed for providing emulation of quantized precision operations. In some examples, the quantized precision operations are performed for neural network models. Parameters of the quantized precision operations can be selected to emulate operation of hardware accelerators adapted to perform quantized format operations. In some examples, the quantized precision operations are performed in a block floating-point format where one or more values of a tensor, matrix, or vectors share a common exponent. Techniques for selecting the exponent, reshaping the input tensors, and training neural networks for use with quantized precision models are also disclosed. In some examples, a neural network model is further retrained based on the quantized model. For example, a normal precision model or a quantized precision model can be retrained by evaluating loss induced by performing operations in the quantized format.

title: Machine learning query session enhancement
description: A computer method, system, and device of training an empathy model for detecting a type of query, the method including defining an intent for detecting closed ended queries, providing a plurality of queries that are closed ended queries to a machine learning model generator, said plurality of queries comprising training data, providing a plurality of corresponding labels identifying the plurality of queries as closed ended queries, and generating a model that classifies closed ended queries as a function of the training data.

title: Anchor determining method and apparatus, and electronic device and storage medium
description: An anchor determining method and apparatus, and an electronic device and a storage medium. The method comprises: performing feature extraction on an image to be processed to obtain a first feature map of said image (S11); and performing anchor prediction on the first feature map via an anchor prediction network to obtain position information of anchors generated in the first feature map and shape information of the anchors (S12).

title: Recommendation model training method and related apparatus
description: A recommendation model training method and a related apparatus. The method comprises: selecting positive samples from sample sets and adding same into a training set, wherein the sample sets comprise the positive samples and negative samples, each sample consists of n sample features, n is greater than or equal to 1, and the sample features of each sample comprise a feature for representing whether the sample is a positive sample or negative sample; calculating sampling probabilities of the plurality of negative samples in the sample sets by using a preset algorithm; selecting the negative samples from the sample sets according to the sampling probabilities and adding same to the training set; and training the samples in the training set to obtain a recommendation model. Application of the recommendation model training method to the field of artificial intelligence (AI) for model training increases model performance.

title: Resource constrained neural network architecture search
description: A method (200) includes defining a neural network computational cell (122), the computational cell including a directed graph of nodes (402) representing respective neural network latent representations and edges (404) representing respective operations that transform a respective neural network latent representation; replacing each operation that transforms a respective neural network latent representation with a respective linear combination of candidate operations, where each candidate operation in a respective linear combination has a respective mixing weight that is parameterized by one or more computational cell hyper parameters; iteratively adjusting values of the computational cell hyper parameters (132a) and weights (132b) to optimize a validation loss function subject to computational resource constraints (106); and generating a neural network (152) for performing a machine learning task using the defined computational cell and the adjusted values of the computational cell hyper parameters and weights.

title: Image processing system and method for landmark location estimation with uncertainty
description: A controller for executing a task based on probabilistic image-based landmark localization, uses a neural network, which is trained to process images of objects of a type having a structured set of landmarks to produce a parametric probability distribution defined by values of parameters for a location of each landmark in each processed image. The controller submits the set of input images to the neural network to produce the values of the parameters that define the parametric probability distribution over the location of each landmark in the structured set of landmarks of each input image. Further, the controller determines, for each input image, a global landmark uncertainty for the image based on the parametric probability distributions of landmarks in the input image and executes the task based on the parametric probability distributions of landmarks in each input image and the global landmark uncertainty of each input image.

title: Neural network-based optical character recognition
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for neural network-based optical character recognition. An embodiment of the system may generate a set of bounding boxes based on reshaped image portions that correspond to image data of a source image. The system may merge any intersecting bounding boxes into a merged bounding box to generate a set of merged bounding boxes indicative of image data portions that likely portray one or more words. Each merged bounding box may be fed by the system into a neural network to identify one or more words of the source image represented in the respective merged bounding box. The one or more identified words may be displayed by the system according to a standardized font and a confidence score.

title: Abnormal cervical cell detection apparatus and method
description: Disclosed are an abnormal cervical cell detection apparatus and method. The apparatus comprises: an acquisition module (501) for acquiring a cervical cell pathological slide image; a segmentation module (502) for segmenting the cervical cell pathological slide image into a plurality of cervical cell pathological slide image blocks; a pre-processing module (503) for pre-processing each cervical cell pathological slide image block to obtain a plurality of target cervical cell pathological slide image blocks; a processing module (504) for processing each target cervical cell pathological slide image block in order to obtain cervical cell features, wherein the cervical cell features are obtained by means of the weighted fusion of two-way features from high-order features to low-order features and from low-order features to high-order features of cervical cells; and a determining module (505) for determining the probability of abnormal cervical cells occurring in the cervical cell pathological slide image according to the cervical cell features. The apparatus and method are beneficial for improving the detection precision of abnormal cervical cells.

title: Apparatus and method for generating video summary through recursive graph modeling
description: The present invention may provide an apparatus and method for generating a video summary, in which, by considering a plurality of frames of video images as nodes of a relationship graph and inferring semantic similarity between the plurality of frames by using a graph convolution neural network having a recursive inference structure, an accurate key frame in consideration of a global long-term correlation between the plurality of frames can be extracted, thereby generating a video summary in various video platforms with a relatively small number of parameters and high accuracy.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, and program
description: Provided is an information processing device comprising a generator constructing unit for constructing a generator that uses a cycle GAN to generate one of image data of a first domain and image data of a second domain from the other. The first domain is defined by image data of multiple channels comprising at least two time-series images including a first subject and a second subject that have mutually different tendencies of motion. The second domain is defined by image data of multiple channels comprising at least two time-series images including the first subject and not including the second subject.

title: Systems and methods to predict structures and properties of biomolecule-ligand complexes and uses thereof
description: Embodiments herein describe systems and methods to predict biomolecule-ligand complexes and uses thereof. Many embodiments generate candidate poses and docking scores for ligands known to interact with a target protein as well as a candidate ligand. Based on similarities present in the candidate poses and docking scores, a pose for the candidate ligand is identified. Many embodiments determine whether a candidate ligand can bind to a target and, if so, determine an affinity. Many embodiments can be used for virtual screening or lead optimization.

title: Failure predictor detection device, failure predictor detection method, failure predictor detection program, learning device, method for generating trained learning model, and trained learning model generation program
