description: The invention discloses a multi-LED sunlight spectrum synthesis LED type selection method based on a residual error evolutionary algorithm, which comprises the following steps of: s1, calculating residual distribution of the spectrum matching degree, and searching the position of a wave band where the maximum residual exists; s2 selecting the corresponding LED type; s3, optimizing the spectrum synthesis working parameters under the current LED type combination by using a differential evolution algorithm, calculating to obtain a spectrum synthesis optimization result under the current LED type combination, and judging whether the optimization result meets the requirements; and (5) iterating until the spectrum matching degree meets the design requirement, and outputting the result of LED type selection. The method selects proper LEDs for sunlight spectrum synthesis, and the whole method has simple steps, relatively small workload and short time; the method has high calculation accuracy, and can effectively ensure the effectiveness of LED type selection on spectrum matching.

title: A method for evaluating the output power of double-sided double-glass photovoltaic modules based on neural network
description: The invention discloses a method for evaluating the output power of a double-sided double-glass photovoltaic module based on a neural network. Each parameter is used as the independent variable, the output power of the component measured at the same time is used as the dependent variable, and the obtained data is input into the structurally optimized neural network for nonlinear fitting analysis. Finally, any four parameters are input into the neural network. With only one parameter, the fitting calculation result of the output power of the double-sided double-glass photovoltaic module can be obtained. The invention makes up for the deficiency of the output power evaluation method of the double-sided double-glass photovoltaic module, and the fitting accuracy of the output power is relatively improved.

title: Core user mining method and system based on deep neural network and graph network
description: The present disclosure proposes a core user mining method based on a deep neural network and a graph network, including: constructing a user-game history information database; performing data preprocessing; is a directed graph with nodes and edges in time sequence, and is input into the graph network embedding method to predict the game of interest at the next time; the above directed graph is established for each game user, and each game obtained is obtained. The expression is spliced with the personal information of the corresponding user, and input into the deep neural network to predict whether the user is the core player of the game. The present disclosure solves the problem of sequence prediction based on the fusion method of graph network embedding and deep neural network, fully learns time series information in the form of graph network, and integrates deep learning method to learn higher-level interactive expressions, so as to improve model prediction accuracy. Accuracy.

title: Software testing device and method
description: The invention provides a software testing device and a method, which are used for judging whether software with unpredictability performs expected actions. The software testing device comprises: a data conversion unit for receiving test input data via a computer and converting the test input data into software input data and model input data for software; a software execution unit that receives software input data, executes software to be tested based on the software input data, and outputs an execution result; a model execution unit that receives a reference model relating to the software, and generates a model allowable output value range including an allowable output value range of an execution result obtained by executing the software, based on the model input data and the reference model; a difference analysis unit that generates difference information based on the execution result output by the software execution unit and the model allowable output value range generated by the model execution unit; and a determination unit that receives the evaluation criterion and determines the operation of the software based on the difference information and the evaluation criterion.

title: Synapse and neuromorphic device including the same
description: Synaptic and neuromotor devices are provided. A synapse according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a first electrode; A second electrode spaced apart from the first electrode; An oxygen-containing layer interposed between the first electrode and the second electrode; And a reactive metal layer interposed between the oxygen retaining layer and the second electrode and capable of reacting with oxygen ions in the oxygen retention layer, wherein the width of the reactive metal layer is reduced as the oxygen retention layer is closer to the oxygen retention layer can do.

title: Interface neural network
description: An operation method and a signal processing apparatus of a neural network are disclosed. A method of operating a neural network in accordance with an embodiment includes receiving a signal from a neural network of any of a plurality of neural networks and converting the characteristic contained in the received signal to match the desired characteristics of the input of another neural network Lt; / RTI &gt;

title: Contents service system providing contents corresponding to voice input by user using beacon
description: A method of providing a content service using a beacon, a mobile terminal and a server is provided. The method of providing a content service comprises the steps of: detecting, by a beacon, whether a button disposed in the beacon is pushed and broadcasting a beacon frame when the button is pushed; receiving the beacon frame by a mobile terminal; receiving, by a mobile application executed in the mobile terminal, a voice from a user of the mobile terminal in response to the beacon frame; generating, by the mobile application, a first voice signal using the voice; transmitting, by the mobile application, the first voice signal to a server; selecting, by the server, content corresponding to the first voice signal; and transmitting, by the server, the selected content to the mobile terminal.

title: Artificial neural network training using flexible floating point tensors
description: The present invention relates to a system for training artificial neural networks using tensors, capable of increasing speed and correctness of deep learning for the neural network, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the tensor includes a plurality of floating point (FP) 16 values and a plurality of bits defining an index shared with a part or all of FP16 values included in the tensor. The FP16 values include IEEE754 format 16-bit floating point values and the tensor includes a plurality of bits defining the shared index. The tensor includes the shared index and the FP16 values and the FP16 values include a variable bit-length mantissa dynamically set by a processor circuit and variable bit-length index. Moreover, the tensor includes the shared index and FP16 values, wherein the FP16 values include: a variable bit-length mantissa dynamically set by a processor circuit; a variable bit-length index; and a shared index switch set by the processor circuit to selectively combine an FP16 value index with the shared index.

title: FOOD FEED DEVICE ASSOCITED WITH Intelligently Recommending and Evaluating Feed
description: The present invention relates to a machine learning and web crawling-based intelligent feed recommendation and evaluation method to recommend optimal pet feed for a pet. According to the present invention, the method comprises the steps of: (S1) allowing a member terminal to access a server; (S2) allowing the member terminal to provide purchase information related to feed purchase and receiving rewards for the purchase information from the server; (S3) allowing the server to analyze and store the information received from the member terminal in a database; (S4) allowing the server to suggest recommendation data for breed/age/disease history of a pet dog based on the data analyzed in the step (S3); (S5) allowing the member terminal to purchase feed from the server by referring to the recommendation data of the server; (S6) allowing the member terminal to provide a review about purchase particulars to the server and receive rewards from the server; and (S7) allowing the server to store the review in a database.

title: Method for estimating position of vehicle and the vehicle
description: The present invention relates to a method for enabling a moving vehicle to estimate the position thereof by using relative distance and azimuth information between moving vehicles, and the moving vehicle capable of estimating the position thereof. A method for enabling a moving vehicle to estimate the position thereof, according to an embodiment of the present invention, is a method for enabling a moving vehicle to estimate the position thereof in a wireless network environment capable of communication between the moving vehicles. The method comprises the steps of: receiving position information of a relative moving vehicle from the relative moving vehicle; measuring a relative distance and a relative azimuth angle with respect to the relative moving vehicle; allowing a moving vehicle to determine the current position information thereof by using the relative distance information and the relative azimuth information and a mobility estimation value of a reference moving vehicle as input values of first and second machine learning algorithms, respectively; and broadcasting the determined current location information in a message form.

title: Server, method and computer program for predicting intention of user
description: The server for predicting user intention analyzes at least one of a receiving unit receiving a query from the user terminal, a recognition unit recognizing at least one of keywords and semantic tags corresponding to the query, and at least one of the recognized keywords and the recognized semantic tags And a user intention predicting unit predicting a user intention related to the query and a query sentence completing unit completing a query sentence for the query based on the predicted user intention.

title: Risk assessment device, risk assessment method and risk assessment program
description: The risk evaluation device for displaying a risk matrix in which the probability of failure occurrence and the degree of impact when a failure occurs are set on two axes, shows the change over time in the probability of failure occurrence from the current point of time for the target equipment group. The acquired influence on the probability of occurrence of failures constituting the data group acquired on the risk matrix, the failure occurrence probability acquisition unit acquiring the data group, the impact level acquisition unit acquiring an impact level corresponding to the target device group And an image data generating unit that generates image data displaying a plot diagram in which a pair of tiles is plotted.

title: Method and apparatus for recommending items based on multi-type pair-wise preference
description: Disclosed is a method for recommending items based on multi-type pair-wise preference, capable or recommending items to users with high precision. A method of recommending an item using an evaluation result, which is a result of evaluating at least one item among a plurality of items by a plurality of users, according to an embodiment of the present invention includes the steps of: generating a comprehensive result by synthesizing a prediction result, which is a result of predicting an evaluation result of a plurality of unevaluated items included in the evaluation result, and the evaluation result using a collaborative filtering technique; classifying the plurality of unevaluated items into a plurality of non-information items and a plurality of indifferent items from the synthesis result; learning a model parameter based on the synthesis result and a plurality of item pairs selected from among item pairs consisting of two of an evaluation item, an unevaluated item, a no-information item, and an indifferent item included in the synthesis result; and recommending a predetermined number of items to at least one recommendation target among the plurality of users by using a final prediction result, which is a result of predicting evaluation results for the plurality of unevaluated items based on the learned model parameters.

title: A system for registering and authenticating human face using support vector machines and method thereof
description: The present invention relates to a system and method for performing identity authentication using face information. That is, in the face registration and authentication using the SVM, in the face registration process, a feature set having excellent discrimination ability is selected for each individual, and in the face authentication process, only the feature set selected in the learning process at the time of face registration is used for unnecessary information. As a result, memory usage and data computation for face authentication can be reduced, thereby enabling identity authentication through face authentication even under limited resource environments such as USB tokens or smart cards. In addition, authentication performance can be improved by using highly distinguishable feature information, and in the authentication process, the face authentication time can be shortened as face authentication is performed by SVM based on the optimal feature set created through learning. There is this.

title: Method and device for classifying pictures
description: The present invention relates to a method and a device for classifying images belonging to the field of image processing technology. The method includes: obtaining images to be classified; Determining a class of each image in accordance with the feature information of the image, wherein the class includes the character image class and the non-character image class; And classifying the images according to the class of each picture. The present invention solves the problem of low view efficiency caused by separating a character image into non-character images when the terminal displays the images according to the storage time of the images, and thus improves the view efficiency of the character images .

title: Method for operating of artificial intelligence transparent display and artificial intelligence transparent display
description: Disclosed are a method for operating an artificial intelligence transparent display and the artificial intelligence transparent display. The method for operating an artificial intelligence transparent display includes the steps of: enabling a plurality of sensors implemented in the artificial intelligence transparent display to sense user information; enabling an artificial intelligence processor to generate reaction operation information based on the user information; and enabling an artificial intelligence object outputted on the transparent display implemented on the artificial intelligence transparent display to perform an operation according to the reaction operation information. Accordingly, the present invention can improve the convenience of a user by being variously used in a service field for the user.

title: Method for stabilizing deep neural network using residual network
description: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for stabilizing a deep artificial neural network using a residual network comprises the steps of: having a group of neural networks realizing a function to be learned by dividing the neural networks into first and second configurations as one block and constructing a whole neural network by accumulating the plurality of blocks; constructing the block by introducing a projection matrix into the first configuration if the first configuration and the second configuration are vectors of different dimensions; and learning the entire neural network to increase accuracy of a test and collect a test result.

title: Customized learning service providing method based on big data associated with learning
description: Provided is a customized learning service providing method executed in a customized learning service providing system connected to a terminal of a learner account by a network. The customized learning service providing method includes the steps of: receiving structured data for classifying a learner type, a learning service type to be provided, and a learning subject from the terminal of the learner account; classifying the learner account into a first learner group among a plurality of learner groups based on the inputted structured data; and providing a learning service according to the first learner group to the terminal of the learner account. The learning service type is learning contents recommendation or learning management. The learner account is classified into the first learner group through a first cluster analysis algorithm or first machine learning with the structured data as an input value. Accordingly, the present invention can provide customized learning management to a learner.

title: Method and apparatus for image processing using image transform network and inverse transform neaural network
description: Disclosed are a decoding method, a decoding apparatus, an encoding method, and an encoding apparatus of a video. A transformed block is generated by performing a first transform using a prediction block for a target block, and a reconstructed block is generated for the target block by performing a second transform using the transformed block. The prediction block is a block in a reference image or is a reconstructed block in a target image. The first and second transforms can be performed by neural networks. Since the transform is automatically performed by the neural network, information required for the transform can be excluded from a bit stream.

title: Method and apparatus for managing operational data of appliance device for failure prediction
description: Disclosed are a method for managing operational data of an appliance for failure prediction and an apparatus thereof. The method performed by an appliance comprises the steps of: receiving information of an abnormal data pattern detection routine to be used for detecting abnormal data from operational data of an appliance; judging whether the operational data of the appliance corresponds to a normal data pattern defined by the abnormal data pattern detection routine; determining the operational data to abnormal data when the operational data corresponds to the normal data pattern; and transmitting the determined abnormal data to a management server.

title: Method and system for recognizing images based on machine learning
description: Disclosed are a machine learning-based image recognition method and a machine learning-based image recognition system. The machine learning-based image recognition method according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: recording data about a background fragment selected by processing image for training in a machine learning DB; determining whether the background fragment is included in an input actual image; and retrieving the data from the machine learning DB when the background fragment is included in the actual image and outputting information recognized in relation to the actual image on a screen by using the retrieved data.

title: An apparatus for network monitoring and method thereof, and system
description: Disclosed is a network security monitoring apparatus included in a network including a first entity and a second entity, a switching device provided between the first entity and the second entity, and a network security monitoring device connected to the switching device. The apparatus comprises: a port for acquiring at least one packet transmitted and received between the first entity and the second entity based on mirroring from the switching device; and a processor which determines whether a security problem occurs with respect to a network associated with the first entity and the second entity based on at least some of the information included in the at least one mirrored packet.

title: Apparatus and method for selecting robot service block
description: Disclosed are a robot service block selection device and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the robot service block selection device comprises: a lower composite knowledge generation component generating knowledge by collecting raw data corresponding to at least one of a user and an environment, storing data in the form of symbolizing the raw data in a knowledge base, and performing an inference process by using the data and a set of rules stored in the knowledge base; and an upper composite knowledge generation component receiving the knowledge from a plurality of composite knowledge generating components including at least one lower composite knowledge generating component, performing an inference process by using the received knowledge, and selecting a robot service block corresponding to at least one of the user and the environment.

title: Method and system for providing road driving situation through preprocessing of road driving image
description: Disclosed are a method and a system for providing a road driving situation through preprocessing of a road driving image. According to one embodiment, the method for providing a road driving situation comprises the steps of: obtaining a road driving image on the road; detecting a plurality of road lines and one or more objects in the road driving image; and generating driving situation data for driving situation recognition between the user vehicle and the one or more objects based on a location of the one or more objects on the road determined based on two road lines in which a road lane in which the user vehicle drives among the plurality of road lines is defined.

title: A system for the provision of artificial intelligence services
description: A network separation device connected to an institution operating system providing institutional services according to an embodiment of the present invention is connected to an institutional network that is independently secured by the institutional operation system, and provides institutional services by accessing the institutional system. An institutional network interworking module that relays AI service data to a receiving user terminal; An artificial intelligence network interworking module connected to an artificial intelligence service system that provides artificial intelligence services through a public network; And only data for artificial intelligence service processed by signal conversion through a synchronized channel connection in a state in which the institutional network interworking module and the artificial intelligence network interworking module are physically separated from each other, the institutional network interworking module and the artificial intelligence network interworking module. It includes a network separation processing module that transmits/receives between.

title: Electronic apparatus and operating method thereof
description: An electronic device and a method of operating the same are provided. The operation method of the electronic device includes an operation of acquiring target speech data based on a speech input of a specific speaker, an operation of determining the number of times of learning the target speech data based on a data characteristic including a data amount of the target speech data, and a determined learning. Based on the number of times, an operation of generating a target learning model by training a pre-trained model to convert text into an audio signal using target speech data as training data, and using the generated target learning model, An operation of generating output data obtained by converting the input text into an audio signal and an operation of outputting the generated output data may be included.

title: Apparatus and method for controlling drive of autonomous vehicle
description: A method of controlling an autonomous driving operation of a vehicle control device according to an embodiment of the present invention is a method performed by a vehicle control device including at least one processor. Determining the expected driving situation, determining the expected driving behavior of the vehicle based on the expected driving situation of the vehicle, determining the need to wear a seat belt of the occupant based on the image of the occupant and the expected driving movement of the vehicle, and the occupant It may include controlling a driving operation of the vehicle based on a result of determining whether to wear a seat belt. The autonomous vehicle of the present invention can be linked or integrated with artificial intelligence module, drone (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle, UAV), robot, augmented reality (AR) device, virtual reality (VR), etc. And traffic information and map information may be transmitted through a 5G network.

title: Method for nonintrusive load monitoring of energy usage data
description: An unsupervised learning-based load monitoring method of energy usage data is provided. An unsupervised learning-based load monitoring method of energy usage data according to an embodiment of the present invention includes the steps of: storing a multi-learning model; and inferring the current state by inputting real-time energy usage data based on the stored multi-learning model. Accordingly, unsupervised learning-based load monitoring (NILM) can be performed using only the main power consumption data of the energy consumption space, and through this, when recognizing what is happening in the energy consumption space and intelligently controlling the recognition result, It can be used as an important parameter.

title: Building Energy Failure Diagnosis and Analysis System with integrated Virtual sensor and Deep learning, and Building Energy Failure Diagnosis and Analysis Method
description: The present invention relates to a building energy failure diagnosis and analysis system integrating a virtual sensor and deep learning, and a building energy failure diagnosis and analysis method using the same. a database for collecting and storing measured building temperature data; a virtual sensor unit for estimating virtual data of the air conditioner by using the building temperature data and generating a first failure diagnosis result through the virtual data for the air conditioner; A deep learning unit that learns the building temperature data and the first failure diagnosis result of the virtual sensor unit in a deep learning model, and generates a second failure diagnosis result through simulation verification using the learned deep learning model, and the first and first 2 It is possible to provide a building energy failure diagnosis and analysis system that integrates deep learning and a virtual sensor including a management server including a failure diagnosis integration unit that generates a final diagnosis result by integrating the failure diagnosis results.  In addition, (a) a virtual sensor diagnosis step of estimating the air conditioner virtual data using the building temperature data measured from the temperature sensor unit, and then generating a first failure diagnosis result through the air conditioner virtual data; (b) a deep learning diagnosis step of learning the building temperature data and the first failure diagnosis result in the deep learning model, and generating a second failure diagnosis result through simulation verification using the learned deep learning model, and (c) the first It is possible to provide a building energy failure diagnosis and analysis method including a failure diagnosis integration step of generating a final diagnosis result by integrating the first and second failure diagnosis results.

title: method for forecasting power demanding and apparatus adopting the method
description: The present invention relates to a deep learning-based power demand predicting method and a device thereof. The predicting method assigns different weights to data according to a frequency of collected power demand data to form weighted power demand data and forms a power demand predicting model by RNN-based deep learning using the weighted power demand data. From the power demand predicting model, a corresponding power demand predicting value is extracted by using a prediction target label or index information.

title: Device and method for training a classifier
description: A computer-implemented method for training a classifier (60) for classifying input signals (x) provided to the classifier (60), in which the classifier (60) is configured to obtain an output signal (y) characterizing a classification of the input signal (x), includes: a) providing a set of perturbations (601); b) providing a subset of each of first training samples including an input signal and a corresponding desired output signal from a first dataset of training samples (602); c) selecting a first perturbation from the set of perturbations for the input signal and the corresponding desired output signal from the subset (603); d) obtaining a second perturbation that is stronger than the first perturbation by adapting the first perturbation based on the input signal, the corresponding desired output signal, and the classifier (604); e) obtaining a first adversarial example by applying the second perturbation to the input signal (605); f) adapting the classifier (60) by training the classifier (60) based on the first adversarial example and the corresponding desired output signal to strengthen the classifier (60) against the second perturbation (606); g) replacing the first perturbation within the set of perturbations with a linear combination of the first perturbation and the second perturbation (607); and repeating the steps b) to g) (608).

title: Apparatus for generating entangled operation
description: Disclosed herein is a device capable of generating an entangled quantum operator without additional qubits. An apparatus for generating an entanglement operation according to the present specification includes: a first interferometer having at least two or more optical paths having different lengths; a second interferometer having at least two optical paths having different lengths; a photon pair source for inputting a pair of photons to the first and second interferometers; an operator positioned on the optical path of the first interferometer and the second interferometer; a photon detection and sensing unit configured to detect photons output from the first interferometer and the second interferometer, respectively; and a control unit configured to selectively detect signals simultaneously output from the first interferometer and the second interferometer among the signals output from the photon detection and sensing unit.

title: Method and apparatus for predicting population using a learning model and method and apparatus for training the learning model
description: Disclosed are a method and apparatus for predicting a population using a learning model and a method and apparatus for training the learning model. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for predicting the population using the learning model can comprise: a step of, determining whether there is a learning model to predict a population for each advertisement; a step of, if there is a learning model for an advertisement, predicting the population by using the learning model for the advertisement; a step of, if there is no learning model for the advertisement, determining the presence or absence of a pre-learned learning model for a category to which the advertisement belongs; a step of, if there is a learning model for the category, predicting the population by using the learning model for the category; and a step of, if there is no learning model for the category, predicting the population based on the records on the conversion of a target user. The present invention aims to provide a method and apparatus for predicting a population using a learning model and a method and apparatus for training the learning model, which are capable of increasing the efficiency of advertisements compared with the cost.

title: Smart Shelter for providing User Customized Service
description: Disclosed is a capsule-type smart shelter that provides customized services.  This embodiment is a capsule-type smart shelter applicable to places such as bus stops, corporations, public institutions, resting spaces of educational institutions, cafes, multi-use facilities, houses, and apartment common spaces. People who enter the smart shelter based on AI After recognizing the emotions of each user, we provide a capsule-type smart shelter that provides a customized service that allows users to receive psychological stability therapy and air care so that each user can have a more comfortable rest.

title: Liveness detection model training method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology, and specifically to the field of computer vision and deep learning that can be applied to scenes such as facial recognition, and provides a biosensing model training method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium. Specific implementation means include: constructing a training set and a test set for training the biosensing model; training a preset biometric model based on the training set to obtain a first biometric model; train a first biosensing model based on the test set to generate a test result; analyzing the test set according to the test result to obtain first sample data; The biosensing model is additionally trained by updating a training set and a test set based on the first sample data. The present invention introduces the idea of sample mining in terms of data to effectively reduce a large number of redundant and non-useful samples, thereby improving model training efficiency.

title: Method and apparatus for tracking object
description: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, an object tracking method performed by a computing device including at least one processor is disclosed. The object tracking method may include the steps of: obtaining a query set including one or more query samples from a first frame included in an image sequence including two or more image frames; obtaining a detection set including one or more detection samples from a second frame included in the image sequence; and determining a label corresponding to each query sample included in the query set based on a label of each detection sample included in the detection set.

title: Computerized systems and methods for providing product recommendations
description: Receive, from the user device, a search query, use the query handler cluster to define a context associated with the search query, use the search cluster to identify one or more products associated with the defined context, use the search cluster, Filter the one or more products associated with the defined context based on characteristics associated with the one or more products stored in the database, and use the search cluster to rank the one or more products associated with the defined context based on the score generated for each product. A system and method are provided for providing product recommendations, including ranking a product recommendation, and displaying the product recommendation on a user device, the product recommendation comprising a number of one or more ranked products.

title: Server and Methof for managing a safety of infant thereof
description: A server and a safety management method for infants and young children are provided. The infant safety management method of this server includes the steps of receiving an image obtained by photographing an infant through a camera placed in an infant-related facility, analyzing the infant's face and joints included in the acquired image, and analyzing the infant's face. And analyzing the emotions and activities of infants based on information on joints, detecting abnormal signs based on the analyzed information on emotions and activities of infants, analyzing information on emotions and activities of infants, abnormalities Generating a safety report based on information related to symptoms and providing the generated safety report to a user terminal.

title: Method for controlling differential-speed controlling motor in centrifugal dehydrator applying machine learning
description: Disclosed is a method for controlling a differential-speed control motor in a centrifugal dehydrator applying machine learning, which comprises: a past inflow sludge concentration data obtaining step of obtaining past data about the concentration of sludge flowing into a scroll; a future inflow sludge concentration predicting step of predicting inflow sludge concentration at a preset point in the future by applying a time-series prediction model based on machine learning to past inflow sludge concentration data; and a future differential-speed control motor load current calculating step of calculating a load current of a differential-speed control motor at a point in the future by using the inflow sludge concentration at a point in the future.

title: PERSONAL PROTECTION SYSTEMS WITH ANALYZED ANALYSIS TO INTEGRATE MONITORING, ALARM AND Predictive Safety Event Evasion
description: In some examples, the system is a Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) article comprising one or more sensors, wherein the one or more sensors are configured to generate usage data representing the operation of the PPE article; And at least one computing device including a memory and one or more computer processors, wherein the one or more computer processors receive usage data indicating operation of the PPE article; Applying usage data to a safety learning model that predicts the probability of occurrence of a safety event associated with a PPE item based at least in part on previously generated usage data corresponding to a safety event; Performs at least one operation based at least in part on predicting the likelihood of occurrence of a safety event.

title: Deep learning-based variant classifier
description: The disclosed technique works directly with sequencing data and derives its own feature filters. This technique processes a plurality of aligned reads joining target base positions. This technique uses lightweight hardware to combine the elegant encoding of leads with lightweight analysis to produce good recall and precision. For example, one million training examples of target base variant regions each having 50-100 reads can be trained for good recall and precision within 10 hours on a single GPU card. Single GPU cards are desirable because computers with a single GPU are inexpensive and are almost universally available to users viewing genetic data. This is readily available on cloud-based platforms.

title: Lossy Sparse Load SIMD Instruction Family
description: Systems, apparatuses, and methods for implementing a family of lossy sparse load single instruction, multiple data (SIMD) instructions are disclosed. A lossy sparse load unit (LSLU) loads a plurality of values from one or more input vector operands and determines how many number of non-zero values are included in one or more input vector operands of a given instruction. If one or more input vector operands have less than a threshold number of non-zero values, the LSLU causes the instruction to be skipped to process one or more input vector operands. In this case, the processing of the instruction of one or more input vector operands is considered redundant. If one or more input vector operands have more than a threshold number of non-zero values, the LSLU causes the instruction to process the input vector operand(s) to be executed.

title: Method and apparatus for suppressing non-maximum values using IOU-predicted value of PP-YOLO technique and size and ratio of detection box
description: A method and apparatus for suppressing the non-maximum value using the IOU-prediction value of the PP-YOLO technique and the size and ratio of the detection box are presented. The non-maximum value suppression method using the IOU-prediction value and the size and ratio of the detection box of the PP-YOLO technique proposed in the present invention receives an image for object detection through the PP-YOLO detection execution unit and performs PP-YOLO detection. to obtain a detection box by using the detection box classification unit for a plurality of classes by class, classifying and grouping the acquired detection boxes according to the box width, width and height ratio; For each class, the detection boxes are arranged in the order of predicted values for each group of detection boxes classified in the class, and the DIOU (Distance-IoU) value of each detection box is calculated and compared, and the corresponding value is determined according to the comparison result. and removing the detection box and finally selecting a class having the highest predicted value among a plurality of classes of the detection box and a predicted value as the class and predicted value of the detection box through the detection box selection unit.

title: Systems, methods and media for manufacturing processes
description: A manufacturing system is disclosed herein. A manufacturing system includes one or more stations, a monitoring platform, and a control module. Each station of the one or more stations is configured to perform at least one step in a multi-step manufacturing process for a component. The monitoring platform is configured to monitor the progress of components throughout the multi-step manufacturing process. The control module is configured to dynamically adjust process parameters of each step of the multi-step manufacturing process to achieve a desired final quality metric for the component.

title: Entity based search retrieval and ranking
description: In an example embodiment, one or more query terms are obtained. Then, for each of the one or more query terms, a standardized entity taxonomy is searched to locate a standardized entity that most closely matches the query term, with the standardized entity taxonomy comprising an entity identification for each of a plurality of different standardized entities. A confidence score is then calculated for the query term-standardized entity pair for the standardized entity that most closely matches the query term, and the query term is tagged with the entity identification corresponding to the standardized entity that most closely matches the query term and the calculated confidence score.

title: Utilizing artificial intelligence for data extraction
description: Solved diagnosis case data is stored by utilizing a redundant discrimination net as a dynamic memory. The stored diagnosis case data is incorporated to form scientific descriptions within a medical knowledge base and heuristics within an empirical knowledge base. Diagnosis hypotheses are generated using an initial symptom description, the dynamic memory, and the medical knowledge base. The initial symptom description is received from an end user. A subset of the diagnosis hypotheses is created to form one or more solution cases. The one or more solution cases are presented to a subject matter expert. A diagnosis success or a diagnosis failure identifying, based on a response received from the subject matter expert, to form an assessed solution case. An assessed solution case is converted into experiences. The experiences are inputted into the dynamic memory. Data containing the assessed solution case is transmitted to a medical artificial intelligence analytics application.

title: Systems and methods for causing execution of an action based on physical presence of a detected person
description: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for causing an action to be executed based on whether a detected person is physically present. In one implementation, such a system may include a wearable image sensor configured to capture a plurality of images from the environment of the user of the wearable apparatus and at least one processing device. The at least one processing device may be programmed to analyze at least one of the plurality of images to detect the person; analyze at least one of the plurality of images to determine whether the detected person is physically present in the environment of the user; select at least one action based on whether the detected person is physically present in the environment of the user; and cause the selected at least one action to be executed.

title: System and method for automatic generation of features from datasets for use in an automated machine learning process
description: There is provided a method for generating features for use in an automated machine learning process, comprising: receiving a first training dataset comprising unclassified raw data instances each including a set of objects of arbitrary types; applying a function to each data instance to calculate a set of first results; generating a set of classification features each including the function for application to a newly received data instance to calculate a second result, and a condition defined by a respective member of the set of first results applied to the second result; applying each classification feature to each instance of an unclassified second training dataset to generate a set of extracted features; selecting a subset of pivotal classification features from the set of classification features according to a correlation requirement between classification variable(s) and each respective member of the set of extracted features; and documenting the subset of pivotal features.

title: Vehicle-trailer backing system having targetless hitch angle detection and trailer geometry learning
description: A backing system for a trailer and vehicle and associated method includes recording an image of a hitch for the vehicle and trailer assembly with a camera. A plurality of distances related to geometry of the vehicle and the trailer and a plurality of reference points are learned based on the camera inputs. A plurality of reference distances related to the plurality of reference points are then determined. A current hitch angle may then be determined using the plurality of reference distances and the geometry distances.

title: Generation of video recommendations using connection networks
description: A method receives ratings for videos from a first user that is using a video delivery service. A first model includes connection networks where each connection network corresponds to a rating. The method inputs each rating into a connection network in an order. Also, parameters for the ratings and ratings other than the rating received from the first user are modeled in a respective connection network. Values for the set of parameters are trained such that the plurality of connection networks predict conditional probabilities that the first user would provide the rating corresponding to the each connection network in the order. The conditional probabilities are based on the first user providing ratings that are previously located in the order. The parameters are then used to generate a list of videos to recommend to the first user using the first model.

title: Efficient context monitoring
description: Disclosed are systems, methods, and non-transitory computer-readable storage media for efficiently monitoring the operating context of a computing device. In some implementations, the context daemon and/or the context client can be terminated to conserve system resources. For example, if the context daemon and/or the context client are idle, they can be shutdown to conserve battery power or free other system resources (e.g., memory). When an event occurs (e.g., a change in current context) that requires the context daemon and/or the context client to be running, the context daemon and/or the context client can be restarted to handle the event. Thus, system resources can be conserved while still providing relevant context information collection and callback notification features.

title: Matrix multiplication acceleration of sparse matrices using column folding and squeezing
description: Disclosed embodiments relate to sparse matrix multiplication (SMM) acceleration using column folding and squeezing. In one example, a processor, in response to a SMM instruction having fields to specify locations of first, second, and output matrices, the second matrix being a sparse matrix, uses execution circuitry to pack the second matrix by replacing one or more zero-valued elements with non-zero elements yet to be processed, each of the replaced elements further including a field to identify its logical position within the second matrix, and, the execution circuitry further to, for each non-zero element at row M and column K of the specified first matrix, generate a product of the element and each corresponding non-zero element at row K, column N of the packed second matrix, and accumulate each generated product with a previous value of a corresponding element at row M and column N of the specified output matrix.

title: Network equipment operation adjustment system
description: A network equipment operation adjustment system is provided herein that is configured to improve the performance of a telecommunications network by generating a network score representing the performance of a telecommunications network within a geographic region, determining one or more network equipment parameter adjustments using the network score, and causing the adjustments to occur. The network equipment operation adjustment system can further display the network score and other network scores for other geographic regions in an interactive user interface to efficiently allow a network operator to view the network performance of a telecommunications network by geographic region and/or to view how the network performance in each of the geographic regions is changing over time.

title: Sentiment analysis in a video conference
description: In an approach, a computer determines based, at least in part, on a video of an attendee of a video conference, a first sentiment of the attendee wherein the first sentiment includes at least a sentiment from a sentiment analysis of one or more facial expressions of the attendee and a sentiment from a sentiment analysis of a plurality of the attendee's spoken words. The approach includes a computer receiving an indication of an attendee activity in at least a first application in computing devices accessed by the attendee and determining whether the first sentiment of the attendee is related to the video conference based, in part, on the attendee activity in at least the first application. Responsive to determining that the first sentiment of the attendee is not related to the video conference, the computer discards the first sentiment that is unrelated to the video conference.

title: Method and device for virtual resource allocation, modeling, and data prediction
description: Evaluation results of a plurality of users are received from a plurality of data providers. The evaluation results are obtained by the plurality of data providers evaluating the plurality of users based on evaluation models of the plurality of data providers. A plurality of training samples is constructed by using the evaluation results. Each training sample includes a respective subset of the evaluation results corresponding to a same user of the plurality of users. A label for each training sample is generated based on an actual service execution status of the same user. A model is trained based on the plurality of training samples and the plurality of labels, including setting a plurality of variable coefficients, each variable coefficient specifying a contribution level of a corresponding data provider. Virtual resources to each data provider are allocated based on the plurality of variable coefficients.

title: Real-time, location-aware mobile device data breach prevention
description: A cognitive security service learns regular locations and usage of one or more mobile devices for a user at multiple times based on aggregated location and usage information reported by the one or more mobile devices via a network. The cognitive security service forecasts one or more selected locations and selected usage by the user with a highest probability of predictability at one or more future sequential times from among the regular locations and usage. The cognitive security service, responsive to detecting a current location of the one or more mobile devices for the user deviates from the one or more selected locations and selected usage beyond a threshold, triggers, via the network, one or more secondary levels of authentication at the one or more mobile devices, wherein the one or more secondary levels of authentication prevent data breaches on the one or more mobile devices through real-time, location aware data security.

title: Systems and methods for providing transaction affinity information
description: In certain aspects, the disclosed implementations include methods and systems for dynamically generating and providing transaction affinity recommendation data. In certain implementations, the transaction affinity recommendation data may include information that identifies a target merchant and associated merchant promotion data that may be generated based on a dynamic analysis of transaction data corresponding to an account record. The disclosed implementations may determine temporal relationships between pairs of sequential transactions corresponding to the account record, and based on such relationships, may identify pairs of transactions involving separate merchants. The disclosed implementations may determine affinity relationships associated with one or more pairs of the temporally related transactions and a target merchant, and based on such relationships, generate and provide the transaction affinity recommendation data.

title: Method and/or system for sorting digital signal information
description: Embodiments of methods and/or systems for sorting digital information are disclosed. In one particular embodiment, samples of a portion of digital information are associated with prime numerals. Such digital information may then be sorted based upon combinations of such digital information. In another example embodiment, a portion or sub-portion of a collection of digital information is converted to at least one sorting value. It should be understood, however, that these are merely example implementations and that claimed subject matter is not limited in this respect.

title: Cryogenic radio-frequency resonator for surface ion traps
description: The present subject matter provides technical solutions for the technical problems facing cryogenic ion traps by providing a cryogenic radio-frequency (RF) resonator that is compact, monolithic, modular, and impedance-matched to a cryogenic ion trap. The cryogenic RF resonator described herein is power-efficient, properly impedance-matched to the RF source, has a stable gain profile, and is compatible with a low temperature and ultra-high vacuum environment. In some examples, the gain profile is selected so that the cryogenic RF resonator acts as a cryogenic RF amplifier. This cryogenic RF resonator improves the performance of ion traps by reducing or minimizing the heat load and reducing or minimizing the unwanted noise that may erroneously drive trapped ions. These features of the present subject matter improve the performance of atomic clocks and mass spectrometers, and especially improve the performance of trapped ion quantum computers.

title: Graph summarizing device, graph summarizing method and program
description: To realize graph summarization capable of suppressing accuracy deterioration in factor estimation based on a causal graph.SOLUTION: A graph summarization device has a factor degree indicating the degree of a factor with respect to a state of a graph by each node, and has: a calculation part which, when a graph having a weight indicating the strength of causal relationship between nodes by each side changes, calculates the degree of significance based on the factor degree of the node of the graph before the change for each node of the graph after the change; a selection part which selects, as a candidate to be deleted, the first node whose degree of significance is equal to or less than a threshold value; and a deletion part which deletes the first node.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Cruise control methods, equipment, devices, vehicles, media, and programs
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a cruise control method, an apparatus, a device, a vehicle and a medium capable of improving fitness between a cruise control process and a driving user.  SOLUTION: The driving habit weight of at least one candidate driving policy related to the target driving environment, which is determined based on the driving history data of the driving user's past driving device, is acquired, and the driving A target driving policy is selected from at least one candidate driving policy based on the habit weight, and cruise control is performed on the target driving device of the driving user based on the target driving policy.  [Selection diagram] Fig. 1

title: Temperature distribution learning device
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain information on an air outlet of an air conditioner without an air conditioner in the target space, and to learn the temperature distribution of the target space.  A temperature distribution learning device 100 learns temperature distributions TD, TM, including the temperature of at least a first point in the air of a target space 80. The temperature distribution learning device 100 includes a learning model LM. The learning model LM learns by associating the temperature distributions TD and TM, which are objective variables, with the thermal image HI regarding the target space 80, which is an explanatory variable. The learning model LM learns based on the teacher data including the temperature distributions TD, TM and the thermal image HI.  [Selection diagram] Fig. 2

title: Resistance change type crossbar array device
description: To provide a resistance-variable crossbar array device that is able to more accurately control, by a pulse width control, a change of a resistance value at set writing.SOLUTION: A synapse array device 100 according to the present invention has: a crossbar array 110 in which a resistance-variable memory element is connected to each of intersections of a plurality of row lines and a plurality of column lines; a row selector/drive circuit 120 that selects a row line of the crossbar array and applies a pulse signal to the selected row; a column selector/drive circuit 130 that selects a column line of the crossbar array and applies a pulse signal to the selected column line; and writing means that performs writing on the resistance-variable memory element connected to the selected row line and the selected column line. A first writing voltage a pulse width of which is controlled is applied to the selected row, a second writing voltage a pulse width of which is controlled is applied to the selected column, thereby, set writing on the resistance-variable memory element is performed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: Search model training methods, equipment, devices, computer storage media, and computer programs
description: To provide a method and apparatus for training a retrieval model, a device, and a computer storage medium.SOLUTION: The method includes the steps of: acquiring initial training data; performing a training operation using the initial training data to obtain an initial retrieval model; selecting texts with the correlation degrees with a query in the training data meeting a preset first requirement from candidate texts using the initial retrieval model, so as to update relevant negative text examples corresponding to the query; performing a training operation using the updated training data to obtain a first retrieval model; selecting texts with the correlation degrees with the query in the training data meeting a preset second requirement from the candidate texts using the first retrieval model, so as to expand relevant positive text examples corresponding to the query, and/or selecting texts with the correlation degrees with the query meeting a preset third requirement, so as to expand the relevant negative text examples; and performing a training operation using the expanded training data to obtain a second retrieval model.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: A system and computer-based method for simulating human-like control behavior in an environmental context.
description: A computer-based method for simulating human-like decisions in an environmental context, the method comprising:   -Capturing environmental data with at least one sensor (10);   -Implementing a computer-based method for compressing said data into a low-dimensional map to realize bi-directional compression of high-dimensional data (16);   -When environmental data is captured during the learning phase of a computer-based model, the captured data corresponds to known pre-recorded data that has been pre-evaluated and to what extent data with different characteristics Evaluating the map of compressed data by determining the quality of the map according to whether it is well separated (24);   -If environmental data is captured after the learning phase, add a new point to the compressed data (26) to generate a signal indicating the decision-making state close to human being used to correspond to the operator's state Including.

title: A Configurable Parallel Fast Convolution Kernel Structure Based on FPGA
description: The structure of the invention discloses a kind of configurable parallel fast convolution core based on FPGA.The fast convolution core is mainly made of serial number register, data width register, address width register, latch width register, this five registers of burst-length register and two row buffers, a multiplier, an adder, a latch on hardware configuration.The fast convolution core can realize quick example, multinuclear collaboration carries out parallel convolution operations, hardware-accelerated to achieve the purpose that carry out a large amount of convolution algorithm according to the hardware resource of selected FPGA by above-mentioned five registers of Verilog program flexible configurations.

title: Information processing method and equipment
description: The disclosure provides information processing method and equipment, information processing method include：Obtain original image；The original image is inputted into depth convolutional network model, the depth convolutional network model according to noise image for predicting to obtain denoising image；Prognostic chart picture is obtained by the depth convolutional network model, the image after the removal noise that the prognostic chart picture, which is the depth convolutional network model, to be predicted according to the original image.The technical solution utilizes depth convolutional network model, is predicted to obtain the image after removing noise according to original image.Have benefited from the powerful modeling ability of depth convolutional network, depth convolutional network model can more accurately predict position, the intensity of noise signal, to improve the accuracy of denoising.

title: Image defogging method based on deep learning
description: In foggy or hazy weather, the image quality is seriously degraded, with low contrast and poor definition. Using traditional methods to defog often produces color cast and distortion. Here is a new image defogging method: firstly, the deep convolutional neural network designed in this paper is used to extract the color, texture, structure and other features of the image and map them to obtain various Pixel scene depth, and then substitute the depth value into the atmospheric scattering model to calculate the fog-free image. This method makes full use of the powerful feature extraction and learning capabilities of convolutional neural networks, and improves the problems of texture detail loss and color distortion in traditional haze removal methods.

title: A Knowledge Graph Representation Learning Method Based on Dynamic Paths
description: The present invention discloses a kind of knowledge mapping expression learning method based on dynamic route, based on translation model, consider structure triple (entity, relationship, entity) and (entity, path, entity) semantic information, in the presence of (h, t), during the expression in path, a dynamic factor α vector is added to it.I.e. in the training process, path vector made of each multistep composition of relations towards with the extremely similar objective optimization of direct relation, as long as then it will all be considered as illustrating in a certain range its semantic information without must be strictly equal with given vector.The present invention solves the problems, such as that the prior art can not effectively distinguish multiple direct relations true of complex relationship type and multiple paths, has good practicability.

title: A kind of Forecasting Flood method based on deep learning model and KNN real time correction
description: The invention discloses a flood prediction method based on a deep learning model and KNN real-time correction. The steps are: 1. normalizing historical flood process data; 2. analyzing the normalized historical flood process data sequence 3. Use the sliding window to establish the input and output values of the prediction model from the historical flood data, and establish the prediction model data set TRSet1; 4. Establish the prediction model CNNFM based on deep learning; 5. Establish the real-time error correction model training data set TRSet2 6. Establish a real-time error correction model KNNCM based on weighted K-nearest neighbors; 7. Make predictions, use the model CNNFM to predict the real-time data, and use the real-time error correction model KNNCM to correct the training data TRSet2 to obtain the final predicted value. The present invention models the training data by automatically extracting the characteristics of the data features through the convolutional neural network, and corrects by the weighted k-nearest neighbor error correction model to improve the accuracy of the model prediction.

title: A method of the detection meaning of a word based on term vector changes over time
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of natural language processing, and more particularly, to a method for detecting changes in word meaning over time based on word vectors. The present invention considers the time dimension on the basis of ordinary word vectors, and enriches the semantic representation of word vectors at different times compared with ordinary word vectors. Contribute to higher-level applications of natural language processing. Unlike existing methods, all data are considered to be in the same time period, ignoring the effect of time on word meaning. On the other hand, by comparing the changes of word vectors of words in different eras, we can observe the changes of word meanings with the changes of the times, which is helpful for linguists and historians to investigate.

title: A method of rice ear recognition based on digital camera images
description: The invention relates to the field of crop canopy image recognition, in particular to a method for recognizing rice ears based on digital camera images, comprising the following steps: obtaining a color image of a rice canopy with a digital camera; and performing texture filtering on the rice canopy image to obtain texture feature parameters; The scatter plot of the ground objects in the combined coordinate system of different texture feature parameters is established; the green mean B  1  and the blue mean B  2  combined coordinate system of the ground objects obtained by the second-order probability filter has a clear dividing line, and the dividing line Fen= B  1  ‑1.3182*B  2  ‑3.6594, as a feature parameter, perform band calculation on the image to obtain the result; set a threshold for the calculation result map to extract rice ears, the pixel value of the calculation result map is less than 0 for rice ears, and greater than 0 for non-ears . The invention utilizes computer image processing technology to extract rice ears. Compared with the commonly used classification method, the invention has low dependence on samples and high recognition accuracy. The method will be widely used in rice field investigation and management, and provides support for the realization of precision agriculture.

title: Deep and wide machine learning models for job recommendation
description: In an example, the features in a boosted decision tree model that is positioned in a GLMM and connected to a deep neural network collaborative filtering model through a prediction layer are initialized to zero. The deep neural network collaborative filtering model is trained while the features in the boosted decision tree model remain zero. One or more trees in the boosted decision tree model are boosted using logi values resulting from training of the deep neural network collaborative filtering model as a margin. The prediction layer is trained using features from the deep neural network collaborative filtering model and features from the boosted decision tree model. It is then determined whether a set of aggregation criteria are satisfied. If not, the features are used to retrain the deep neural network collaborative filtering model, and the process repeats until the group pooling criteria are met.

title: Infrared and visible light image fusion method
description: The invention discloses a kind of infrared and visible light image fusion methods to construct convolutional neural networks basic unit firstly, building visible light and infrared picture data library, determine convolutional neural networks structure；Secondly, being trained by transfer training to GoogLeNet using visible light and infrared picture data library；Then, blending image is added respectively as objective function with the loss function of original image and regular terms, carries out the training of converged network；Finally, inputting visible light and infrared image to be fused obtains final blending image.Image co-registration is divided into converged network and evaluation network by the present invention, objective function is determined according to perception loss function, and parameter in converged network is updated using stochastic gradient descent method, obtains optimal blending image, compared to existing deep learning blending algorithm, syncretizing effect is more preferable.

title: A method and system for code completion based on double AST sequences
description: The present invention provides a kind of code completion method and system based on double AST sequences, comprising: source code processing step uses abstract syntax tree analysis source code；AST turns binary tree step, and above-mentioned abstract syntax tree is converted to two different sequences simultaneously；Model training step, by described two different sequence inputting LSTM models, train language model；Completion step is predicted, according to the language model completion code trained.The abstract syntax tree (AST) of program code to be learned is converted to two sequences (such as " preamble sequence " and " middle sequence sequence ") by the present invention simultaneously, and utilizes information one LSTM model of training of the two sequences simultaneously.The LSTM that method of the invention trains has higher accuracy rate.Technical solution of the present invention have the characteristics that it is simple, quick, can preferably improve code recommendation accuracy rate and recommend efficiency.

title: A video description method and system based on information loss function
description: The present invention relates to a kind of video presentation method and systems based on information loss function, comprising: obtains training video, obtains the semantic information of the set each frame of training video；By in stratification attention Mechanism Model of the semantic information input of training video in conjunction with LSTM, the verbal description of training video is obtained；According to word each in verbal description to the importance of expression video content, loss weighting is carried out to word, obtains information loss function, using information loss function as objective function anti-pass gradient optimizing stratification attention Mechanism Model, obtains video presentation model；Obtain video to be described, video to be described, is separately input into target detection network, convolutional neural networks and action recognition network, to obtain target signature, the general characteristic, motion feature of gathering each frame of video to be described, semantic information as video to be described, it is input to video presentation model, obtains the verbal description of video to be described,.

title: Social security violation detection method, device, device and computer-readable storage medium
description: The invention provides a social security violation detection method based on an intelligent decision detection model. Whether there is an abnormal price parameter in the data; if there is an abnormal price parameter in the medical visit data, determine that the medical visit data is abnormal, and extract the abnormal data in the medical visit data to provide a punishment certificate for punishing the medical institution. The present invention also provides a social security violation detection device, equipment and computer-readable storage medium. The invention realizes the supervision of the medical institution's medical treatment data settled by the social security card through the deviation detection model, thereby avoiding the waste of manpower and outpatient pooling funds caused by manual supervision, and improving the supervision efficiency of the outpatient pooling funds.

title: Method for reducing failure rate
description: Systems and methods are provided for reducing failure rates of a manufactured products. Manufactured products may be clustered together according to similarities in their production data. Manufactured product clusters may be analyzed to determine mechanisms for failure rate reduction, including adjustments to test quality parameters, product formulas, and product processes. Recommended product adjustments may be provided.

title: Retention and accessibility of data characterizing events on an endpoint computer
description: An endpoint computer system can harvest data relating to a plurality of events occurring within an operating environment of the endpoint computer system and can add the harvested data to a local data store maintained on the endpoint computer system. A query response can be generated, for example by identifying and retrieving responsive data from the local data store. The responsive data are related to an artifact on the endpoint computer system and/or to an event of the plurality of events. In some examples, the local data store can be an audit log and/or can include one or more tamper resistant features. Systems, methods, and computer program products are described.

title: Hardware implementation of convolution layer of deep neural network
description: Hardware implementations of, and methods for processing, a convolution layer of a DNN that comprise a plurality of convolution engines wherein the input data and weights are provided to the convolution engines in an order that allows input data and weights read from memory to be used in at least two filter-window calculations performed either by the same convolution engine in successive cycles or by different convolution engines in the same cycle. For example, in some hardware implementations of a convolution layer the convolution engines are configured to process the same weights but different input data each cycle, but the input data for each convolution engine remains the same for at least two cycles so that the convolution engines use the same input data in at least two consecutive cycles.

title: System and method for combined automatic and manual inspection
description: A method for inspecting a part in a manufacturing environment, the method including: acquiring at least one image of the part; optionally enhancing the at least one image; automatically analyzing the enhanced image to determine if the part has a potential defect; if it is determined that there is a potential defect: displaying the at least one image to an operator; and receiving operator input of a part status, wherein the part status may be defect or no defect; and storing the part status in association with the at least one image. The automatic analysis may include a confidence level and only images having a confidence level that does not meet a threshold will be displayed to an operator.

title: Automated 3d root shape prediction using deep learning methods
description: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method for automated 3D root shape prediction comprising: a pre-processor receiving 3D data defining at least one 3D representation of a tooth and processing the 3D data, the processing including: transforming at least part of the 3D data into a voxel representation of a crown, the voxel representation defining a voxel space that fits the input space of a first 3D deep neural network executed on a computer; the pre-processor providing the voxel representation of the crown to the input of the 3D deep neural network, the 3D deep neural network being trained on the basis of clinical 3D data defining 3D representations of real teeth; the first 3D deep neural network generating a voxel representation of a predicted root or a complete tooth comprising the predicted root on the basis of the voxel representation of the crown, wherein the generation of the voxel representation of the predicted root or the complete tooth includes: determining voxel activations for voxels in a voxel space of the output of the 3D deep learning network, each voxel activation representing a probability measure defining the probability that a voxel is part of the root or the complete tooth; and, determining whether a voxel activation is part of the root or the complete tooth by comparing the voxel activation with a voxel activation threshold value.

title: Neural networks for information extraction from transaction data
description: Methods, systems and computer program products implementing character level deep neural networks for information extraction are disclosed.
