A system uses character level information retrieved from a transaction record to classify the transaction as a whole and to tag individual sections of the transaction record by entity type. The system processes the transaction record using multiple and separate character-level models. The system can use a one dimensional neural network for featurization fed into a fully connected network for classification for identifying the most common classes of a transaction record. The system can identify one or more entities, e.g., service provider names, from the transaction using an RNN. The RNN can include one or more LSTM models. The LSTM models can be BI-LSTM models.

title: Network-based learning models for natural language processing
description: Systems and methods for network-based learning models for natural language processing are disclosed. Information may be information stored in a memory relating to a user interaction with a network content. In addition, a digital recording of a voice utterance made by a user can be captured. The voice utterance can be interpreted based on the stored user interaction information. A user's intention can be identified on the basis of the interpretation, and a prediction can be made based on the identified intention. The prediction may furthermore correspond to a selected workflow.

title: Method, system and apparatus for pattern recognition
description: A method for pattern recognition may be provided, comprising: receiving data； processing the data with a trained convolutional neural network so as to recognize a pattern in the data, wherein the convolutional neural network comprises at least: an input layer, at least one convolutional layer, at least one batch normalization layer, at least one activation function layer, and an output layer； and wherein processing the data with a trained convolutional neural network so as to recognize a pattern in the data comprises: processing values outputted by a batch normalization layer so that the histogram of the processed values is flatter than the histogram of the values, and outputting the processed values to an activation function layer. A corresponding apparatus and system for pattern recognition, as well as a computer readable medium, a method for implementing a convolutional neural network and a convolutional neural network are also provided.

title: Storage system and storage control method
description: A storage system that performs irreversible compression on time-series data using a compressor/decompressor based on machine learning calculates a statistical amount value of each of one or more kinds of statistical amounts based on one or more parameters in relation to original data (time-series data input to a compressor/decompressor) and calculates a statistical amount value of each of the one or more kinds of statistical amounts based on the one or more kinds of parameters in relation to decompressed data (time-series data output from the compressor/decompressor) corresponding to the original data. The machine learning of the compressor/decompressor is performed based on the statistical amount value calculated for each of the one or more kinds of statistical amounts in relation to the original data and the statistical amount value calculated for each of the one or more kinds of statistical amounts in relation to the decompressed data.

title: Method for adapting sensitivity of a pointing device, computer program and image evaluation device
description: The invention provides a method for adapting sensitivity of a pointing device and a related image evaluation device (1). The pointing device is connected to a processor configured to execute a plurality of application workflows (A1,A2,…,An), and to a display configured to display a cursor. The method comprises the steps of: receiving a default sensitivity (S) of the pointing device; determining one of the plurality of application workflows (A1,A2,…,An) which is to be executed, said application workflow being the currently-active application workflow (Ai); receiving or determining a target sensitivity (Si) for the currently-active application workflow (Ai); receiving or determining a correction factor (Fi) for the currently-active application workflow based on the target sensitivity (Si) for the currently-active application workflow (Ai) and the default sensitivity (S); receiving a current position (x1,y1) of the cursor; detecting delta coordinates (∆x,∆y) inputted by an operation made by the user on the pointing device in order to move the cursor on the display during execution of the currently-active application workflow (Ai); and computing, in response to the operation of the user on the pointing device, a new position of the cursor on the display based on the current position (x1,y1) of the cursor, the delta coordinates (∆x,∆y) and the correction factor (Fi) for the currently-active application workflow (Ai).

title: Wind turbine yaw offset control based on reinforcement learning
description: Methods, systems, and devices for controlling a yaw offset of an upstream wind turbine based on reinforcement learning are disclosed. The method comprises receiving data indicative of a current state of the first wind turbine and of a current state of a second wind turbine adjacent to the first wind turbine downstream along a wind direction, determining one or more controlling actions associated with the yaw offset of the first wind turbine based on the current state of the first wind turbine, the current state of the second wind turbine, and a reinforcement learning algorithm, and applying the determined one or more controlling actions to the first wind turbine.

title: Operation assistance system and method for the generation of control signals for voice control of a motor-controlled mobile robot kinematics of such an operation assistance system
description: The invention relates to an operation assistance system (1) for guiding an endoscope camera (20), which can be inserted and moved in a controlled manner at least in sections via a first operation opening (11) in an operating room (12) of a patient's body (10), comprising an endoscope camera (20) for capturing images (B) of the operating room (12) in the form of image data (BD) and a robot kinematic system (3, 4, 5) which records the endoscope camera (20) by means of an auxiliary instrument holder (6) at the free end and which is used to guide the The endoscope camera (20) can be moved in the operating room (12) under motor control, specifically via control signals (SS) generated by a control unit (CU), that at least one voice control routine (SSR) is executed in the control unit (CU), via which voice commands and/or or voice command combinations (SB, SBK, OSB, SSB) in the form of voice data (SD) recorded, evaluated and dependent on the control signals (SS) are generated, and that in the control unit (CU) zumi At least one image acquisition routine (BER) for the continuous acquisition of the image data (BD) provided by the endoscope camera (20) relating to the operating room (12) is executed. At least one image evaluation routine (BAR) is particularly advantageously provided in the control unit (CU), by means of which the recorded image data (BD) are continuously evaluated and classified based on statistical and/or self-learning methods of artificial intelligence. Object- and/or scene-related information (OI, SI) relating to the surgical scene currently captured by the endoscope camera (20) in the image (B) is then determined by means of the continuous evaluation and classification of the image data (BD), and the captured speech data (SD) evaluated depending on the detected object and/or scene-related information (OI, SI).

title: Ai-based new learning model generation system for vision inspection on product production line
description: An AI-based new learning model generation system (100) for vision inspection on a product production line (300) is proposed. In the AI-based new learning model generation system, the candidate set extraction module (110) extracts two or more candidate data sets on the basis of determination type information from among a plurality of training data sets that have been applied to learning of existing learning models previously generated for vision inspection on the product production line. In addition, an additional set determination module (120) calculates similarity between training images of new training data and a candidate data set, and determines any one greater than or equal to a reference value as an additional training data. In addition, the new model generation module (140) may generate a new learning model by training the additional training data set and the new training data as a pre-training model.

title: Method and apparatus for supporting the production of a functional material
description: Method and apparatus for monitoring and evaluating production of a functional material, wherein, by assessing steps carried out by users on the basis of a database, the user is provided with feedback regarding the extent to which predetermined properties of a produced functional material are achieved in the event of discrepancies in the steps carried out.

title: Control system for controlling a technical system and method for configuring the control device
description: According to the invention, an operating signal (BS) of the technical system (TS) is fed into a first machine learning module (NN1), which is trained to reproduce a behavioral signal of the technical system that arises specifically without the current application of a control action, and the reproduced behavioral signal (VSR1) first output signal. The first output signal (VSR1) is fed into a second machine learning module (NN2), which is trained to use a control action signal (AS) to reproduce a resulting behavior signal of the technical system and to output the reproduced behavior signal (VSR2) as a second output signal. Furthermore, an operating signal (BS) of the technical system is fed into a third machine learning module (NN3) and a third output signal (AS) of the third machine learning module (NN3) is fed into the trained, second machine learning module (NN2). A control action performance (Q) is determined on the basis of the second output signal (VSR2). This trains the third machine learning module (NN3) to optimize the control action performance (Q). The training of the third machine learning module (NN3) configures the control device (CTL) for controlling the technical system.

title: Systems and methods for determining execution state
description: There is described a method of enabling identification of the execution state of an item of software at runtime. The method comprises receiving from one or more clients one or more respective labelled sets of invocation data generated at the one or more clients by the execution of an executable of the item of software configured to cause the collection of invocation data at runtime for one or more callable units of the item of software, wherein each labelled set of invocation data comprises a label indicating an execution state of the item of software during a respective portion of runtime and invocation data corresponding to said respective portion of runtime; training, based on said collection of invocation data, an identification algorithm to identify the execution state of the item of software from collected invocation data of the item of software. There is also described a related method of identifying the execution state of an executable during a portion of runtime, as well as related apparatus and computer programs.

title: Measurements on a first band applicable to procedures on a second band
description: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for measurements on a first frequency band applicable to procedures on a second frequency band. A technique that may be performed by a user equipment (UE) may include sending a base station (BS) an indication of the first frequency band, which may be a preferred measurement frequency band. The UE may then measure one or more reference signals (RSs) on the preferred measurement frequency band. The UE may then apply the measurements of the one or more RSs on the preferred measurement frequency band for one or more procedures on the second frequency band.

title: A method, system and computer program product for generating labelled 3d data representations of real world objects
description: There is provided a method for generating labelled 3D data representations of real- world objects, comprising: - obtaining, using processing circuitry (110), a set of one or more pre-labelled 3D coordinate, each 3D coordinate in the set of one or more pre-labelled 3D coordinate representing a point on a real world object in a real world area, - for each of the one or more pre-labelled 3D coordinates in the obtained set: - obtaining a template volume to be applied to the 3D coordinate using the processing circuitry (110); - generating an object volume comprising the 3D coordinate, using the processing circuitry (110), by applying the obtained template volume to the 3D coordinate; and - labelling the generated object volume, by assigning the object label of the pre-labelled 3D coordinate to all 3D coordinates located within the generated object volume. Also provided are a system and computer program product.

title: Neural networks
description: A neural plane, which can form the basis of a neural network or a component thereof, is comprised by an optical modulator, an electrical non-linearity circuit and an optical detector interconnected whereby in use the non-linearity circuit controls the modulator in dependence on the detector output. There are parallel arrays (10, 11, 12) of such modulators, non-linearity circuits and detectors (M, T, D, 30, 33, 34). The modulator, non-linearity circuits and detectors have components formed in a common semiconductor substrate (20), for example by VLSI techniques with a silicon substrate, the modulators (30) may be comprised by liquid crystal on silicon in that case.

title: A Chinese Name Recognition Method Based on Recurrent Neural Network
description: The invention provides a Chinese name recognition method based on a recurrent neural network. The method includes the steps of S1, corpus pretreatment; S2, word vector training, wherein a word2vec tool is used for word vector training; S3, Chinese name recognition model training, wherein data obtained after processing in S1 and word vectors obtained after training in S2 are used for training a neural network model; S4, name recognition and aftertreatment, wherein the model obtained after modeling in S3 carries out name recognition on test corpuses, names recognized by the model are subjected to aftertreatment through a context rule and a diffusion algorithm, and finally names are obtained. By means of the method, the complexity of feature selection during Chinese name recognition can be effectively lowered, rich syntax and grammar information included in Chinese texts is fully utilized through the word vectors, the generalization ability of the model is improve accordingly, Japanese names and foreign transliteration names are recognized at the same time, and the extent of Chinese name recognition is widened.

title: Instance segmentation method based on visible light infrared image feature fusion
description: This invention relates to the field of image analysis technology and discloses an instance segmentation method and system based on visible light and infrared image feature fusion. The method includes: acquiring infrared and visible light images in a low-light environment; analyzing the visible light image using a first model to obtain an instance segmentation result in a first state; analyzing the infrared image using a second model to obtain an instance segmentation result in a second state; aligning the instance segmentation results in the first and second states to adjust for heterogeneity between the visible light and infrared images; and generating a final instance segmentation result based on the analysis results. This method significantly improves the accuracy and robustness of instance segmentation in low-light or weak-light environments. It overcomes the shortcomings of traditional methods in low-light environments, effectively reduces alignment errors caused by heterogeneity, improves image quality and detail preservation, and provides reliable technical support for image analysis tasks in practical applications.

title: Non-line-of-sight propagation channel identification method and device, wireless communication system and medium
description: The present disclosure provides a non-line-of-sight propagation channel identification method and device, a wireless communication system and a medium. The method comprises: obtaining measured channel data corresponding to a wireless communication channel; preprocessing the measured channel data to determine first measured data, wherein the preprocessing comprises at least one of channel calibration, outlier removal and denoising; performing feature space transformation on the first measured data to determine second measured data; and inputting the second actual measurement data into a deep neural network (DNN), and determining a channel identification result output by the deep neural network (DNN). The method can address defects that an identification result corresponding to the channel data cannot be accurately obtained due to limitations of classic methods, and realizes a non-line-of-sight propagation channel identification method based on a deep neural network (DNN). The identification process of the measured channel data is simplified, and the channel identification result corresponding to the measured channel data can be accurately determined while the identification efficiency is improved.

title: Fractional-bit quantization and deployment of convolutional neural network models
description: The disclosure relates to fractional-bit network quantization and deployment of CNN models. An AI accelerator, including: an input buffer configured to buffer an input image; a weight buffer configured to buffer convolutional kernel indexes for a convolutional layer of a CNN model; a kernel pattern buffer configured to buffer a 1-bit convolutional kernel subset for the convolutional layer of the CNN model, wherein the 1-bit convolutional kernel subset includes 2  τ  1-bit convolutional kernels with a size of K×K; a PE array including one or more PE nodes, each of which is configured to generate convolutional results of an image region of the input image and 1-bit convolutional kernels corresponding to the convolutional kernel indexes in the 1-bit convolutional kernel subset; and an output buffer configured to buffer convolutional results of respective image regions of the input image and the 1-bit convolutional kernels corresponding to the convolutional kernel indexes.

title: Oversubscription reinforcement learner
description: A computing system including one or more processing devices that train an oversubscription reinforcement learner at least in part by receiving computing resource usage trajectories. At the oversubscription reinforcement learner, the training further includes generating prototypes based at least in part on the computing resource usage trajectories. The training further includes, based at least in part on the prototypes, generating an oversubscription rate. The training further includes outputting a prototype feedback query and/or an oversubscription rate feedback query. The training further includes receiving a prototype feedback input and/or an oversubscription rate feedback input. Based at least in part on the computing resource usage trajectories, the prototypes, and the prototype feedback input and/or the oversubscription rate feedback input, the training further includes computing an objective function value and training the oversubscription reinforcement learner based at least in part on the objective function value.

title: Systems and methods for configuring surgical systems to perform patient-specific procedure with surgeon preferences
description: Systems and methods for configuring a surgical system for performing a surgical procedure on a patient. The systems can include, for one or more patient categories, display a plurality of biomechanical simulations indicating postoperative performance of an implant based on alignment algorithms and receive a selection of one of the plurality of biomechanical simulations. In connection with the performance of a surgical procedure, the systems can retrieve a selected alignment algorithm corresponding to a patient category of the plurality of patient categories with which the patient is associated and configure the surgical system according to the selected alignment algorithm.

title: Laser apparatus for excitation of strontium atoms in a quantum processor
description: The present disclosure relates to a laser apparatus for excitation of Strontium atoms in a quantum processor. It comprises a fiber laser source (111) for emitting light at a wavelength of about 1064 nm; an Er-doped fiber laser (112) for emitting light at a wavelength of about 1534 nm; a fiber-coupled SHG device (114) configured to receive said light at about 1064 nm to produce light at a wavelength of about 532 nm; a fiber-coupled DFG device (113) configured to receive said light at about 1534 nm and said light at about 532 nm and produce light at a wavelength of about 813 nm; a fiber-coupled SFG device (115) configured to receive said light at about 813 nm and light at about 1064 nm partially transmitted by said fiber-coupled SHG device and produce light (15) at a wavelength of about 461 nm and partially transmit the light at about 813 nm. The transmitted light at about 813 nm (10) is configured to produce a dipolar trapping beam and the light at about 461 nm is configured to produce first MOT laser beams.

title: Method for evaluating pleat shape and method for manufacturing pleat body
description: Provided are: a method for evaluating a pleat shape, the method making it possible to objectively evaluate the pleat shape of a pleat body; and a method for manufacturing a pleat body. This method for evaluating the pleat shape of a pleat body (20) obtained by processing a sheet-like material (30) into a pleat shape comprises: an extraction step for extracting a feature pertaining to the pleat shape from image data (56) of the pleat body (20); and an evaluation step for evaluating the pleat shape on the basis of the feature extracted in the extraction step.

title: Action control system
description: The present invention causes a robot to execute an action appropriate to an action of a user.　This action control system comprises: an emotion determination unit that determines the emotion of a user or the emotion of a robot; and an action determination unit that generates, on the basis of a text generation model having a dialog function that causes the user and the robot to have a dialog, the content of an action of the robot appropriate to the action of the user and the emotion of the user or the emotion of the robot, and determines the action of the robot corresponding to the action content. The action determination unit sets an action schedule of the user on the basis of the dialog between the user and the robot.

title: Frequency-splayed multi-channel system and methods for use thereof
description: A system (100) comprises a plurality of voltage signal sources (120A..120D) and a controller (30) configured to control operation of the voltage signal sources to cause them to generate respective voltage signals (122A..122D) characterized by respective frequencies. The plurality of voltage signal sources includes a first voltage signal source (120A) adjacent a second voltage signal source (120B) and a third voltage signal source (120C) adjacent to the second voltage signal source such that the second voltage signal source is physically disposed between the first voltage signal source and the third voltage signal source. The controller causes the first voltage signal source to generate a first voltage signal (122A) characterized by a first frequency (fA), the second voltage signal source to generate a second voltage signal (122B) characterized by a second frequency (fB), and the third voltage signal source to generate a third voltage signal (122C) characterized by a third frequency (fC). The first and third frequencies are different from the second frequency.

title: Model training method and apparatus, and storage medium
description: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of communications. Provided are a model training method and apparatus, and a storage medium. The method comprises: a second entity sending a model training request message to a first entity; the first entity determining model-training-related information according to the model training request message, and sending a first indication message to a third entity; the third entity sending an execution operation request message to at least one sixth entity according to a target QoS index parameter list and an execution operation list; each sixth entity performing model training according to the execution operation request message, so as to obtain a model training result, and sending an execution operation response message to the third entity, wherein the execution operation response message comprises the model training result; the third entity sending a first response message to the first entity; and the first entity sending a second response message to the second entity, wherein the first response message and the second response message each comprise the model training result. By means of interaction among a plurality of entities, a communication system can provide a model training service for a user, a network or a third party as required.

title: Single-core processing core and control method therefor, many-core communication architecture, and chip
description: Disclosed in the present invention are a single-core processing core and a control method therefor, a many-core communication architecture, and a chip. Each single-core processing core comprises a network-on-chip interface for external data transmission and a memory access interface; the inter-core data transmission is carried out on the network-on-chip interface; the single-core processing core comprises a compute engine, a control unit, a data exchange unit, a parameter RAM, an NI unit, a DMA unit, a queue transmission unit, a weight gradient transmission unit, a data exchange bus, and a control bus; the queue transmission unit is used for realizing capacity expansion and acceleration of a hardware queue between forward and backward directions; the weight gradient transmission unit is used for providing transmission acceleration for the frequent reading and writing of weight gradients of a deep neural network (DNN) in a DRAM; and the weight gradients are stored in the DRAM so as to accelerate gradient read/write access of weight gradient calculation. Therefore, the embodiments of the present invention can improve the transmission performance and the energy efficiency of inter-core communication, and reduce the DNN training data transmission time delay.

title: Methods and systems for conditional mutual information constrained deep learning
description: A system, method and computer program product for training a deep neural network. The deep neural network can be trained using a learning process that is defined to optimize both an error function of the deep neural network as well as a network mapping function of the deep neural network. The network mapping function can represent a predicted label distribution geometry property of the deep neural network. This learning process can improve the accuracy of the trained deep neural network model as well as its robustness again adversarial attacks. Optimizing the network mapping function can also provide increased insight into the operation of the trained deep neural network model, which may promote increased interpretability of the trained model and thus encourage uptake of the trained model.

title: Information processing method, electronic device and computer readable storage medium
description: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of large model technologies and data processing. Disclosed are an information processing method, an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises: in a forward inference process of a target machine learning model, acquiring parameter information corresponding to a query request, wherein the parameter information is obtained by encoding the query request; performing quantization compression on the parameter information according to a preset quantization mode, to obtain quantization compression information; using the quantization compression information to perform quantization compression processing on the parameter information, to obtain cache information; and performing inference on the basis of the cache information to obtain a query result corresponding to the query request. The present disclosure solves the technical problem in the related art of low model precision caused by offline compression key value cache, complex quantitative calibration steps and the influence of calibration data on the model precision.

title: A method of training a neurol network for controlling an elevator group and a system using the same
description: Embodiments of the present invention relates to a system (100) for controlling an elevator group comprising a receiver module for receiving state variables of elevators (110) and registered calls of a passenger from an elevator group; a calculation module for calculating sorting parameters from the state variables of elevators (110) and registered calls of a passengers; a determination module (120) for determining an order of the sorting parameters according to at least one demand parameter; an ordering module (130) for ordering the state variables of elevators (110) in the order of determined order; a neural network module (140) for inputting the ordered state variables of elevators (150) to a trained neural network and for outputting ordered control values for each elevator; a de-ordering module (160) for de-ordering the ordered control values for each elevator (170) for generating control values; a controller for controlling the elevator group.

title: Building energy management method using multi-agents
description: The present invention relates to a method for automatically managing energy of a building according to each scenario by using deep reinforcement learning (DRL) multi-agents. The building energy management method using multi-agents, according to one embodiment of the present invention, controls a power device of a building according to a plurality of scenarios, the method comprising the steps of: using training environment data classified by each scenario, so as to train, through reinforcement learning, multi-agents for each scenario; specifying a plurality of scenarios on the basis of environmental data collected from a plurality of environmental sensors; inputting the environmental data into head agents, from among the trained multi-agents, each corresponding to the plurality of scenarios; and controlling the power device on the basis of outputs of the head agents.

title: Electronic device for performing calculation using artificial intelligence model, and method for operating electronic device
description: This electronic device comprises a memory for storing a first artificial intelligence model, and a processor. The first artificial intelligence model includes: a prompt execution unit for executing a user prompt; and a token generation unit for generating a single token. The processor: measures at least one of the accuracy, a memory usage, or an operation speed of the first artificial intelligence model on the basis of the execution of instructions stored in the memory and stores the measured result in the memory; determines the type of first data to be provided to the prompt execution unit among the plurality of data types; determines the type of second data to be provided to the token generation unit; generates a second artificial intelligence model on the basis of the type of the first data and the type of the second data; and determines whether to use the second artificial intelligence model by comparing at least one of the accuracy, a memory usage, or an operation speed of the second artificial intelligence model with that of the first artificial intelligence model.

title: Machine learning program, machine learning device, and machine learning method
description: Concept drift occurs during the operation of an AI system, resulting in a decrease in accuracy of the machine learning model. Therefore, there is a method to maintain accuracy by training each layer of the machine learning model separately and decreasing the learning rate slowly and gently to keep up with the concept drift. However, conventional methods train only some specific layers, which may result in an inability to sufficiently maintain the accuracy of the machine learning model. This machine learning program causes a computer to perform a process for: acquiring, when inference is performed using a trained neural network model, the degree of contribution of each of a plurality of neurons included in the neural network model to the prediction; and on the basis of the degrees of contribution, re-training the neural network without updating the weights of neurons, among the plurality of neurons, the degrees of contribution of which meet a prescribed criterion. Thus, it is possible to suppress degradation in accuracy of the neural network model.

title: Information processing method and apparatus, and terminal side device and network device
description: Provided in the present disclosure are an information processing method and apparatus, and a terminal side device and a network device. The method comprises: a terminal side device transmitting to a first network device first information corresponding to a first artificial intelligence (AI) model and/or a first AI function, the first information comprising at least one of the following: beam codebook dimension information; the mapping relationship between reference signals and beams; and the spatial relationship between reference signals corresponding to a first reference signal set and reference signals corresponding to a second reference signal set, wherein the first reference signal set is related to an input, and the second reference signal set is related to an output.

title: Dilator proximal end blocker in a surgical visualization
description: Computing systems and methods are disclosed for detecting and tracking a proximal end of a dilator from a surgical video stream, and mitigating the tool's visually distracting effects. In one example system, a memory may store instructions that, when executed by one or more processors, may cause the system to receive, in real-time, image data from an incoming surgical video stream of a field of view of the digital surgical microscope camera. The field of view may show a proximal end of a dilator. The system may generate, using the image data and a trained neural network, a bounding box around a region corresponding to the proximal end of the dilator. A pixel modification algorithm may be applied to the region of the image data corresponding to the proximal end of the dilator. An updated image data may be generated in real-time for an outgoing surgical video stream.

title: System for post-training quantization of large language models
description: Post-training quantization of weight values and activation values substantially reduces the memory and processing requirements of floating-point (FP) large language models (LLMs). A quantization parameter training process is performed on the FP LLM to determine quantization parameters. Weight-activation scaling may be applied to linear modules of the LLM, including down projection layers, enabling subsequent per-tensor quantization for activation values. The weight and activations values of the FP LLM are quantized from FP to integer values. Different layers may have different integer sizes. For example, weight values may be reduced to 4 bit integers and activation values to 8 bit integers. Layers within the model are modified to operate on the integer values. For example, an integer SiLU module may provide an integer approximation of a sigmoid-weighted linear unit activation function.

title: System and methods for estimating level of services
description: Systems and methods are provided for estimating a level of service for a medical service. An example method entails (a) retrieving a medical record of a patient seeking emergency medical service; (b) analyzing the medical record, preferably using a machine learning model, to identify problems, data and risk useful to support estimation of a level of service (LoS); (c) displaying, on a user interface, (i) the identified problems, data and risk, (ii) forms for a user to input additional information on the problems, data or risk or edit the identified problems, data or risk, and (iii) an estimated LoS based on the problems, data and risk; and (d) generating an output summarizing the problems, data and risk and the estimated LoS.

title: Systems and methods for ai agent control layer through performance evaluation of artificial intelligence agents
description: Systems and methods are provided for improving the performance of artificial intelligence agents. A computer-implemented method for improving artificial intelligence agent performance is provided that includes processing a plurality of inputs through an agent management logic and, in response, generating a plurality of outputs. The inputs in the plurality of inputs are sourced from past runtime execution of a plurality of agents. The outputs in the plurality of outputs are configured to improve future runtime execution of the plurality of agents.

title: Communication method and apparatus
description: The present application discloses a communication method and apparatus. The method comprises: a second node sending first information to a first node, wherein the first information is used for requesting to train a first model, and the first information comprises a first duration; receiving second information sent by the first node, wherein the second information is used for indicating a training task that has not been completed within the first duration; and sending third information to the first node on the basis of the second information, wherein the third information is used for instructing the first node to exit training or for instructing the first node to suspend training, or the third information comprises a second duration. In the method, when the first node fails to complete a training task within a preset duration, the second node can instruct the first node to exit training or suspend training, thereby avoiding training efficiency degradation caused by the prolonged training duration due to the failure of the first node to complete training.

title: Method for managing dynamic database for providing personalized service, and electronic device for performing same
description: This method for managing a dynamic database for providing a personalized service may comprise the steps of: acquiring user input information about an electronic device; acquiring context information related to the personalized service from the user input information, the context information including implicit information determined from the user input information; and updating the dynamic database on the basis of the context information.

title: Sub-cell level service coverage estimation
description: According to some embodiments, a method is performed by an analytics system network node. The method comprises obtaining a static service coverage map for a cell of a wireless network. The static service coverage map comprises an association of service quality and coordinates in the cell. The method further comprises: calibrating the service coverage map using one or more of drive test measurements and crowdsource data; blending the calibrated service coverage map with one or more per-flow key performance indicator (KPIs) associated with one or more wireless devices in the cell; training a machine learning (ML) model using the blended service coverage map and one or more per-flow KPIs resulting in a labeled service coverage map; and operating the ML model using actual network load, network configuration and external conditions to generate a dynamic sub-cell service coverage map.

title: Hardware acceleration for generative models
description: A computing system with hardware acceleration for execution of generative models is provided. The computing system comprises a processor and memory storing instructions that, when executed by the processor, cause the processor to execute a generative model. An accelerator module performs compute operations during execution of the generative model. Prior to execution of the generative model, the accelerator module determines a maximum and minimum value for a functional computation to be performed during execution of the generative model. The accelerator module modifies possible inputs into functional computation to reduce the size of an input value by N bits. The accelerator module performs the functional computation based upon the modified input value, the minimum value, and the maximum value. During execution of the generative model, the accelerator module obtains a value for the functional computation to be used during generation of output of the generative model.

title: Collaborative artificial intelligence (al) learning groups in new radio (nr) environments
description: In an aspect, a user equipment (UE) may receive collaborative learning group information corresponding to different collaborative learning groups. The UE may receive artificial intelligence (AI) model information corresponding to different AI models associated with performing wireless operations at the UE, wherein each AI model of the different AI models is associated with at least one collaborative learning group of the different collaborative learning groups. The UE may perform, based on the UE being associated with a given collaborative learning group, wireless operations based on a given AI model associated with the given collaborative learning group.

title: Method of producing an atom trap apparatus and atom trap apparatus
description: The present disclosure relates to a method (200) of producing an atom trap apparatus and to an atom trap apparatus. The atom trap apparatus comprises a first substrate (2) and a second substrate (3). The method (200) comprises providing (210) a first substrate (2) comprising a main surface and providing (220) a second substrate (3) comprising a main surface. The method (200) comprises arranging (230) the first substrate (2) and the second substrate (3) with respect to each other. The method (200) comprises bonding (240) the first substrate (2) and the second substrate (3). Bonding (240) the first substrate (2) and the second substrate (3) comprises forming at least one joint (20) by means of laser beam welding. The atom trap apparatus comprises at least one atom trap (50) located above the main surface of the first substrate (2) and/or located above the main surface of the second substrate (3).

title: Apparatus and method for generating a fuzzy number for use in fuzzy logic systems
description: An arrangement (apparatus and method) using fuzzy logic for fuzzifying a crisp input using a membership function defined by center, width, and type. The input signals are selected and supplied to a fuzzy input processor. The crisp input signal is fuzzified by selected center and width data corresponding to a selected membership function. Each crisp input is fuzzified by determining the distance of the crisp input from the center of the membership function and linearly complementing the result with respect to the width of the membership function, thereby eliminating the necessity for determining the shape of the membership function. The center and width may be fixed or dynamic values. The fuzzified input signals are successively compared in a min-max comparator which determine a minimum rule term for each rule processed. The minimum rule term is compared with a previously stored minimum rule term to determine a maximum among the minimum rule terms. The fuzzy input processor outputs a clock signal whenever a new maximum among the minimal rule terms is determined, and stores the new maximum value. The arrangement also incudes a fuzzy output processor which executes the rule identified by the fuzzy input processor as the optimum rule. A fuzzy memory interface controls the transfer of data for the fuzzy input processor and the fuzzy output processor, thereby optimizing parameter storage. The disclosed arrangement may be integrated as an integrated circuit or a software-controlled computer system.

title: Data mining model building using attribute importance
description: A system, method, and computer program product that uses attribute importance (AI) to reduce the time and computation resources required to build data mining models, and which provides a corresponding reduction in the cost of data mining. Attribute importance (AI) involves a process of choosing a subset of the original predictive attributes by eliminating redundant, irrelevant or uninformative ones and identifying those predictor attributes that may be most helpful in making predictions. A new algorithm Predictor Variance is proposed and a method of selecting predictive attributes for a data mining model comprises the steps of receiving a dataset having a plurality of predictor attributes, for each predictor attribute, determining a predictive quality of the predictor attribute, selecting at least one predictor attribute based on the determined predictive quality of the predictor attribute, and building a data mining model including only the selected at least one predictor attribute.

title: System for managing objects of virtual space
description: A simulator system containing a plurality of individual simulators to simulate behavior of a predetermined simulation target, where: individual simulators select the simulation target satisfying a predetermined notification condition among simulation targets to send the information related thereto to an intercommunication control apparatus; and an intercommunication control apparatus executes the processing of the content determined according to a condition related to this notified simulation target to notify the result of the execution to individual simulators.

title: Case-based reasoning system and method for scoring cases in a case database
description: A case-based reasoning system is disclosed that includes a case database and a search engine. The case database is capable of storing a plurality of cases that each include one or more attributes that each have an associated match weight. Match weights of attributes in different cases are separately specified. In response to receipt of an incident including one or more input terms, the search engine scores the relative closeness of a selected case to the incident utilizing the match weights of attributes in the selected case that match input terms in the incident.

title: Hybrid neural network and support vector machine method for optimization
description: System and method for optimization of a design associated with a response function, using a hybrid neural net and support vector machine (NN/SVM) analysis to minimize or maximize an objective function, optionally subject to one or more constraints. As a first example, the NN/SVM analysis is applied iteratively to design of an aerodynamic component, such as an airfoil shape, where the objective function measures deviation from a target pressure distribution on the perimeter of the aerodynamic component. As a second example, the NN/SVM analysis is applied to data classification of a sequence of data points in a multidimensional space. The NN/SVM analysis is also applied to data regression.

title: Techniques for suggesting correct identifiers
description: In an illustrative embodiment, an apparatus, computer-readable medium, system, or method may be configured to suggest correct identifiers. Frequencies of occurrence of expected identifiers may be determined. One or more unrecognized identifiers may be detected. One or more first numerical scores indicating that one or more unrecognized identifiers were provided to the computing environment in place of one or more of the expected identifiers may be calculated. Second numerical scores indicating that the unrecognized identifiers were intended to include expected identifiers may also be calculated. The second numerical scores may be calculated using the first numerical scores and the frequencies of occurrence of the expected identifiers. One or more expected identifiers may be selected based on the second set of numerical scores.

title: Photonic Quantum Computer Architecture
description: A circuit and method for generating entanglement between quantum bits using a "rasterization" and interleaving technique is provided. The circuit includes a resource state generator 2702 that generates one resource state per clock cycle, with each resource state 2704 having multiple entangled quantum bits. The circuit also includes delay circuits 2708 and delay lines that perform entanglement measurement operations on quantum bits in resource states generated by the same resource state generator at different clock cycles. By appropriately selecting the delay lines, a single resource state generator generates all the resource states required to generate a large entangled structure. A hybrid technique can also be used, in which the number of resource state circuits is greater than one, but less than the number of resource states required to generate the entangled structure. In this manner, the U-Net can generate contextually different retinal layers at different axial positions based, at least in part, on depth index information and/or proximity to selected retinal layers (eg, proximity to). apply the calculation of The U-net outputs OCT volume data with reduced flow artifacts compared to the input OCTA data.

description: A sound effect recommendation for a visual input is generated by training a machine learning model that learns coarse-grain and fine-grain audio-visual correlations from a reference visual, a positive audio signal, and a negative audio signal. be. The trained acoustic recommendation network outputs audio and visual embeddings and uses the audio and visual embeddings to measure correlation distances between image frames or video segments obtained from the database and one or more audio segments. configured to compute The correlation distances of one or more audio segments in the database are sorted, and one or more audio segments having the closest correlation distances from the sorted audio correlation distances are determined. The audio segment with the closest audio correlation distance is applied to the incoming image frame or video segment.  [Selection drawing] Fig. 5

title: Semantic recognition method
description: This application acquires the multi-intent text input by the current user in real time, preprocesses it, and builds a multi-intention recognition model for recognizing the user's multiple intentions based on the cluster pre-analysis. , constructing a BiLSTM-CRF semantic slot filling model based on the Slot-Gated association gate mechanism, fully utilizing the intention recognition results to guide the filling of semantic slots; This paper proposes a multi-intention recognition-semantic slot-filling composite modeling method based on cluster pre-analysis, including optimizing the slot-filling composite model. [Selection drawing] Fig. 1

title: Smart high temperature aging system
description: The present invention relates to a high-temperature aging system, and includes a battery cell tray stack having a structure in which battery cell trays each containing a large number of battery cells are stacked in multiple stages, and a battery cell tray stacked in a high-temperature aging chamber. at least one tray rack including a lattice-shaped storage space in which the laminate is accommodated; a stacker crane that transports battery cell trays to the lattice-shaped storage space; It includes a thermal imaging camera that acquires thermal image temperature data of the battery cell tray stack stacked in the space, and a control unit that adjusts the temperature in the high temperature aging chamber based on the thermal image temperature data.

title: Method and system for performing convolution using an optical network - Patents.com
description: The apparatus includes a frequency comb (505a) configured to generate a first carrier signal (505) having at least one first frequency interval. The apparatus also includes a plurality of modulators (345) configured to modulate one of the amplitudes of the first carrier signal to generate a modulated carrier signal. The apparatus further includes a two-dimensional array of optical couplers (330) configured to perform a one-dimensional discrete Fourier transform in a first direction using the modulated carrier signal. The apparatus also includes an array of coherent detectors (625a-625n) and a first demultiplexer (605) optically coupled to an output of the array of optical couplers and to the coherent detector. The apparatus further includes a local oscillator (LO) bank or array (515a) configured to generate a second carrier signal (515) having at least one second frequency interval different from the at least one first frequency interval. In addition, the apparatus includes a second demultiplexer (615) optically coupled to the output of the LO bank or array and to a coherent detector.

title: Multi-task collaborative perception network model and detection method for traffic road surface information
description: The present invention provides a multi-task joint perception network model and detection method for traffic road surface information, which can simultaneously detect lane markings and drivable areas, and integrate a coordinate attention mechanism into a traditional feature extraction network to ensure that the amount of calculation is not increased while enhancing the effect of feature extraction. In the neck network, a dilated convolution residual module is creatively proposed in the present invention to enhance the network's prediction performance of details, and the decoder part shares the features of the drivable area with lane marking detection to enhance the lane detection effect in complex road conditions. In the training session, a new alternating optimization training method is proposed to improve the segmentation performance of the entire model. The present invention achieves very high accuracy and excellent speed performance in the challenging BDD100K dataset, with the mIoU of drivable area segmentation reaching 92.51%, the lane marking detection accuracy rate and IoU being 87.29% and 32.12% respectively, and the overall inference speed reaching 39 FPS, and the detection effect is better than that of the traditional single-task network model. [Selected Figure] FIG.

title: Method, apparatus and computer program
description: An apparatus is provided that includes means for receiving, from a user equipment, measurement data relating to one or more cells of the network, means for determining, based on the measurement data, a prediction including at least one sequence of one or more beams that are predicted to have the highest signal quality to the user equipment at a respective one or more time instances, and means for transmitting the prediction to the user equipment.(FIG. 7)

title: Systems and methods for image processing
description: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for image processing. A trained deep learning model may be determined. The input image may be acquired. The processing result may be generated by processing the input image based on the trained deep learning model. The trained deep learning model may be obtained according to a process, which process obtains a preliminary deep learning model, obtains a sample image, and generates a plurality of sub-images based on the sample image. This includes training a preliminary deep learning model based on multiple sub-images in order to obtain a trained deep learning model.  [Selection diagram] FIG. 9

title: Methods and systems for monitoring the administration of carbon monoxide (CO) to Exvivo fluids
description: The present invention is a method of administering carbon monoxide (CO) to a fluid of Exvivo and monitoring the administration of the carbon monoxide, wherein (i) a CO release molecule (CORM) is reacted with a release trigger molecule. Steps of generating CO, (ii) a step of administering CO to the fluid of Exvivo by bringing the CO generated in step (i) into contact with the fluid of Exvivo through a gas permeable membrane, (iii) Step (ii). ), Then the CO is administered to the Exvivo fluid, followed by the step of analyzing carbon monoxide and / or carbon monoxide markers by complementary monitoring techniques, and (iv), if necessary, step (iii). The present invention relates to a method comprising the step of adjusting the administration of CO based on the analysis of carbon monoxide or carbon monoxide markers. The present invention further relates to an extracorporeal circulation circuit system for use in the methods of the present invention.

title: Single transistor multiplier and how
description: The multiplier has MOSFETs with a common source configuration. The MOSFET current source is coupled to the drain terminal of the MOSFET. The inverter has an input coupled to the drain terminal of the MOSFET. The output of the inverter gate gates two currents that are proportional to the current magnitude. The first capacitor has a first of two currents, a first terminal coupled to the gate of the MOSFET, and a grounded second terminal. The second capacitor has a first terminal coupled to the second current of the two currents and a second terminal coupled to the first current of the two currents. The multiplier is reset by first discharging the gate capacitance of the MOSFET. In the next reset phase, the second capacitor holds the charge multiplication value.  [Selection diagram] Fig. 2

title: Detecting plant disease infections with improved machine learning
description: Disclosed are systems and processing methods for brushing up convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to obtain features that characterize different classes. In some embodiments, the system uses a filter that often corresponds to more class-specific features within one of the last few convolutional layers of the initial CNN. Initial CNNs to get started, and to rank those filters to refine the more relevant filters, and by turning off the less relevant filters within that one convolutional layer. Is programmed to update. The result is a more generalized CNN, with certain filters removed that often do not help characterize the class.

title: Methods and devices for recognizing stacked objects, electronic devices, storage media and computer programs
description: The present disclosure is to acquire a recognized image including a sequence in which at least one object is stacked along a stacking direction, and to perform feature extraction on the recognized image to obtain a feature map of the recognized image. With respect to methods and devices, electronic devices and storage media for recognizing stacked objects, including recognizing at least one object category in the sequence based on the feature map. The embodiments of the present disclosure can realize accurate recognition of the category of stacked objects.  [Selection diagram] Fig. 1

title: Systems and methods for augmenting visual output from robotic devices
description: A method is presented for visualizing data generated by a robotic device. The method includes displaying the intended path of the robotic device in the environment. The method also includes displaying a first region identified as drivable by the robotic device in the environment. The method further includes receiving input for identifying a second region in the environment as drivable and transmitting the second region to the robotic device. [Selection drawing] Fig. 3A

title: System and method for processing electronic images for computer detection methods
description: receiving one or more electronic slide images associated with the tissue sample, wherein the tissue sample is associated with the patient and/or medical case; partitioning a slide image into a plurality of tiles; detecting a plurality of tissue regions of the first slide image and/or the plurality of tiles to generate a tissue mask; determining whether it corresponds to non-tissue; removing any of a plurality of tiles determined to be non-tissue; determining a prediction for at least one landmark for the image, the machine learning prediction model being generated by processing a plurality of training images; and prediction of the trained machine learning prediction model. Systems and methods are disclosed for and outputting the .

title: Defect detection system
description: A computing system generates a training data set for training a predictive model to detect defects present in a target surface of the target sample, and detects defects present in the target surface of the target sample based on the training data set. Train a predictive model to A computing system generates a training data set by identifying a set of images for training a predictive model, the set of images including a first subset of images. A deep learning network generates a second subset of images for subsequent labeling based on a set of images that includes the first subset of images. The deep learning network generates a third subset of images for labeling based on the set of images including the first subset of images and the labeled second subset of images. The computing system continues the process until a threshold number of labeled images are generated.

title: Systems and methods for determining and providing personalized PAP therapy recommendations for patients
description: A method of providing personalized PAP therapy recommendations to a patient includes, at a controller, receiving patient information obtained from one or more electronic devices associated with the patient; Analyzing, at a controller, determining from the analysis of the patient information an individualized PAP therapy recommendation for the patient, and providing the individualized PAP therapy recommendation to the patient.

title: Shift-left topology construction and information expansion using machine learning
description: Methods, computer systems, and computer program products are provided for constructing shift-left topologies. Embodiments of the invention may include collecting data sets. Embodiments of the invention may include extracting topological entities from a dataset. Embodiments of the invention may include correlating multiple data from topological entities. Embodiments of the invention may include mapping topological entities. Embodiments of the invention may include marking entry points of multiple subgraphs of a topological entity. Embodiments of the invention may include constructing a topology graph.

title: Prediction model training method, data prediction method, device and computer program
description: The present invention provides a predictive model training method, apparatus, computer equipment, and storage medium. The method includes the steps of: obtaining a training sample set, the training sample set including each training sample, a training sample weight corresponding to each training sample, and a target energy feature corresponding to each training sample; Determining the current training sample from the training sample set based on the training sample weight and inputting the current target energy feature corresponding to the current training sample into the pre-trained prediction model to perform basic training, and the basic training is completed. The steps of obtaining a base prediction model and updating the training sample weights corresponding to each training sample based on the base prediction model until the model training is completed and performing iteratively to obtain the target prediction model. The target prediction model is used to predict interaction state information corresponding to input protein information and input compound information. By using this method, the prediction accuracy of the target prediction model obtained through training can be improved. [Selection diagram] Figure 2

title: Demultiplexer and method for using same
description: Generally, an optical demultiplexer is described that includes an electro-optic modulator configured to change a polarization of an optical pulse having a first polarization and passing through the electro-optic modulator from the first polarization to a second polarization when the electro-optic modulator is in a first state, and a first mirror and a second mirror, the electro-optic modulator disposed in an optical trajectory between the first mirror and the second mirror with respect to an optical pulse traveling in the optical trajectory between the first mirror and the second mirror to pass through the electro-optic modulator, the first mirror and the second mirror shifting the optical pulse from the first mirror to the second mirror each time the optical pulse traveling in the optical trajectory between the first mirror and the second mirror moves back and forth between the first mirror and the second mirror. a first mirror and a second mirror arranged within the optical demultiplexer so as to be displaced perpendicular to a propagation direction of the light pulses between the second mirror; and a first polarizing beam splitter arranged in the optical trajectory between the first mirror and the electro-optic modulator, the first polarizing beam splitter configured to transmit light pulses having the first polarization and reflect light pulses having the second polarization to remove the light pulses having the second polarization from the optical trajectory between the first mirror and the second mirror, the first polarizing beam splitter configured to reflect the light pulses that are mutually displaced perpendicular to the propagation direction into different output trajectories.

title: Product output method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and can be applied to business system platforms such as medical health, financial science and technology, and discloses a product output method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein a product output model is constructed by utilizing a large language model based on pre-training through migration learning and fine tuning training; the method comprises the steps of receiving user information, preference data and a display strategy input by a user terminal, constructing a user portrait according to the user information and the preference data, generating a strategy according to the user portrait and a preset prompting word, constructing a target prompting word of a product output model, taking the target prompting word as input, generating a product output result through the product output model, and sending the product output result to the user terminal for display according to the display strategy.

title: A rotor airfoil design method, device, equipment, medium and product based on machine learning
description: This application discloses a rotor airfoil design method, apparatus, equipment, medium, and product based on machine learning, relating to the field of airfoil design. The method comprises: obtaining target airfoil aerodynamic performance data for a target rotorcraft under different flight modes; inputting the target rotorcraft's airfoil geometric parameters into a trained deep neural network model to obtain predicted airfoil aerodynamic performance data under different flight modes; constructing multiple objective functions based on the target airfoil aerodynamic performance data and the predicted airfoil aerodynamic performance data; performing a weighted summation of the multiple objective functions to obtain an overall objective function; utilizing a genetic algorithm to search for airfoil geometric parameters that minimize the overall objective function to obtain the optimal airfoil geometric parameters; and designing the rotor airfoil based on the optimal airfoil geometric parameters. This application improves the efficiency and flexibility of rotor airfoil design while reducing design costs.

title: An image denoising method and system for intelligent agent visual perception
description: The invention relates to the technical field of federal image denoising, in particular to an image denoising method and system for intelligent visual perception. The method comprises the steps of performing semantic segmentation on an original noise image y  n  through a visual large model, converting the image into a mask gray image y  mask , superposing an original noise image y  n  with the mask gray image y  mask , performing downsampling on the superposed image y obtained in the step S1 to generate a downsampled image y  1 、y 2 , training a self-supervision learning network model f  θ  by taking the downsampled image y  1 、y 2  as a training data set, inputting the noise image into the self-supervision learning network model f  θ  obtained in the step S3, and outputting a noise removal image y  denoised . According to the invention, through the self-supervision learning network, different types of noise are self-adapted under the condition of no tag data, and the self-supervision learning network is used for training in a dynamic complex environment with high efficiency, so that the computing resource cost is reduced, and the denoising performance is improved. In addition, the prior knowledge of the large visual model is combined, the target recognition and scene understanding capability of the intelligent body is enhanced, and the adaptability and stability of the intelligent body in a complex environment are improved.

title: Systems and methods for robust and personalized data set solutions for improving customer interactions with interactive areas
description: A system for facilitating user interaction with an interactive area includes a memory encoding a processor-executable routine. The system also includes a processor configured to access the memory and execute the processor-executable routine. The processor can identify a user of the interactive area based on identification data obtained at the interactive area. The processor can also utilize a trained machine learning model personalized for the user, wherein the trained machine learning model personalized for the user is configured to recognize traits of the user. The processor can also use the trained machine learning model personalized for the user to detect a trait task performed by the user interacting with the interactive area to activate a special effect associated with the interactive area based on interaction data obtained at the interactive area. The processor can further indicate the activation of the special effect in response to detecting the trait task.

title: Predictive models for early identification of pregnancy disorders
description: Embodiments include a computing device executing software routines and/or one or more machine learning architectures that provide clinical predictive models to predict health complications resulting from pregnancy. The predictive model may identify and enhance variables available in the electronic health record system during the first three months of gestation and utilize machine learning methods to predict problematic outcomes during the later or post-partum of gestation. The predictive model follows several steps to identify possible pregnancy disorders, such as identifying the data sources and experts of the classifier, checking the data with clinical experts, applying statistical and machine learning methods, and evaluating model performance and interpretability. Predictive models and related methods provide unprecedented early detection of pregnancy complications for early intervention and treatment to improve maternal and child health outcomes.

title: Diagnosis and treatment path prediction method based on time sequence knowledge graph completion
description: The invention relates to the technical field of natural language processing, and discloses a diagnosis and treatment path prediction method based on time sequence knowledge graph completion, which comprises the steps of obtaining a snapshot sequence of a diagnosis and treatment knowledge graph; dividing the diagnosis and treatment knowledge map snapshot sequence into three diagnosis and treatment information subgraphs of long term, medium term and short term according to time sequence and clinical path characteristics, carrying out structural coding on the three diagnosis and treatment information subgraphs to obtain diagnosis and treatment information map structural representations of different time scales, carrying out weighted fusion on the diagnosis and treatment information map structural representations of different time scales to obtain diagnosis and treatment information query representation, and grading and sorting all candidate tail diagnosis and treatment information entities by inputting a scoring function to obtain a diagnosis and treatment path prediction result. The invention can improve the accuracy and the robustness of completing complex application tasks on diagnosis and treatment paths.

title: Electric power consultation document generation system
description: The present invention provides a system for generating electric power consultation documents, relating to the field of electric power consultation technology. The system comprises: a question receiving module for receiving electric power consultation questions raised by users and transmitting the questions to a document generation module; the document generation module comprising: a text embedding submodule for receiving the electric power consultation questions and embedding the questions to obtain multiple question text embeddings; and an answer generation submodule for analyzing each question text embedding to obtain an electric power consultation document. The present invention trains the document generation module using a training data set of electric power consultation questions labeled with electric power consultation documents, thereby outputting adaptive electric power consultation documents based on the electric power consultation questions. This allows users to quickly obtain accurate electric power consultation documents by simply inputting the electric power consultation questions into the system.

title: Method and system for controlling welding quality of urban gas pipeline based on Paddleocr model
description: The application belongs to the technical field of gas pipeline welding, and discloses a method and a system for quality control of an urban gas pipeline based on Paddleocr model. The management and control method comprises the steps of constructing a standard welding model and a standard quality trend diagram based on a pipe image to be welded, welder information and a welding process, establishing a real-time welding quality characteristic database, classifying the real-time welding quality characteristic database, constructing a data information chain of the data at the same time, constructing a simulation welding model and a simulation quality trend diagram, constructing relations among the simulation quality trend diagram, the simulation welding model and the data information chain, judging the qualification of welding quality based on the standard and the simulation welding model, searching defect factors according to the simulation and standard quality trend diagram and the data information chain, and optimizing the related model and database based on data feedback after each welding. The application provides a method for managing and controlling the welding quality of an urban gas pipeline, which systematically monitors the whole welding process in real time, evaluates the quality accurately and feeds back and optimizes the welding process.

title: Rolling bearing compound fault diagnosis method based on ACTSR-SVMD and CIMAT combination
description: The present invention discloses a rolling bearing composite fault diagnosis method based on the combination of ACTSR-SVMD and CIMAT. The method comprises the following steps: Step 1: Preliminary preprocessing of the vibration signal using Hilbert transform and high-pass filter; Adaptive optimization of the parameters in ACTSR using QPSO; Dynamic adjustment of SVMD parameters using the SHO algorithm; Signal enhancement of the filtered signal using the ACTSR system, SVMD decomposition of the enhanced signal to accurately locate the characteristic frequencies within the IMF component; and Reconstruction of the enhanced signal. Step 2: Using a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1DCNN) to process the frequency domain signal of the signal after FFT transformation, using an informer encoder architecture to capture the global features of the signal after VMD processing, and using a multi-head attention mechanism to integrate the features of different branches; The time-frequency domain feature vector enhanced by the attention mechanism passes through a fully connected layer and is input into a softmax layer, and fault classification is achieved by outputting the probability distribution of each category.

title: Use of deep learning techniques to determine a contextual reading order in a document
description: Described are techniques for determining a reading order in a document. A current selected text pass (R1), a RIGHT text pass (R1) and a BOTTOM pass (R3) are generated. The text passage marked R1 is processed by a first LSTM, the text pass labeled R2 is processed by a second LSTM, and the R3 marked pass is processed by a third LSTM, each of the LSTMs having a respective internal representation (R1 ', R2 'and R3') generated. In addition to the LSTMs, other deep learning tools can be used. The respective internal representations R1 ', R2' and R3 'are concatenated or otherwise combined into a vector or tensor representation and provided to a classifier network which has a predicted marker for a next pass as RIGHT, UNDERHARD or EOS in the reading order of the document generated.

title: QUANTIFYING PHOTOREALISM IN SIMULATED DATA WITH GAN
description: This disclosure provides quantifying photorealism in simulated data with GAN. The present disclosure discloses a system and method.
