In an exemplary implementation, the system and method may receive a synthetic image on a first deep neural network; and determine, via the first deep neural network, a prediction which indicates whether the synthetic image is generated by machine or originates from the real data distribution. The prediction can include a quantitative measure of the photorealism of the synthetic image.

title: Process and device for the visualization of three-dimensional objects
description: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method for visualizing a three-dimensional object represented by volume data (VD) for a user in the form of a two-dimensional visualization image (VB) made up of a number of visualization pixels (VP). The method has the following steps: providing (S10) an image synthesis algorithm, which image synthesis algorithm is designed to visualize the three-dimensional object by mapping the volume data (VD) onto the visualization pixels (VP); detecting (S20) a current viewing direction of the user; determining (S30) a focus area (FB), the focus area (FB) being defined as an area of the visualization image (VB) that the user focuses on based on the current viewing direction; Adapting (S40) the image synthesis algorithm such that the computing effort required for imaging for visualization pixels (VP) outside the focus area (FB) is less than for visualization pixels (VP) within the focus area (FB); and mapping (S50) the volume data (VD) onto the visualization pixels (VP) with the adapted image synthesis algorithm.

title: Controller for generating training data for training a machine learning algorithm
description: Control device for generating training data for training a machine learning algorithm, the control device (12) having a first provision unit (13) which is designed to provide first training data, a generation unit (14) which is designed to provide additional training data from at least one part of the first training data, the additional training data being generated by the generation unit (14) in that an augmentation function selected randomly from a set of possible augmentation functions is applied to all of the training data contained in the at least part of the first training data, and a second provision unit (15) configured to provide the first training data and the additional training data for training the machine learning algorithm.

title: Method for determining an optimal architecture of an artificial neural network
description: The invention relates to a method for determining an optimal architecture of an artificial neural network, wherein the method (1) has the following steps: for each of at least two specifications for determining the architecture, in each case determining an architecture that is optimal with respect to the corresponding specification by assigning a flow to each edge of a directed graph, and respectively updating the flows assigned to the edges along the trajectory based on the cost function, wherein the steps are repeated until a determined trajectory satisfies a termination criterion for the architecture search, and wherein the trajectory that satisfies the termination criterion represents the optimal architecture (4); and determining the optimal architecture of the artificial neural network based on the respective optimal architectures with respect to each of the at least two specifications (5).

title: INT-based SFC network fault prediction method, INT-based SFC network fault prediction device and SFC network fault prediction processor
description: The embodiment of the present application provides a method, device, processor and storage medium for predicting SFC network failure based on INT. The method includes: determining the telemetry frequency and telemetry parameter group of SFC; sending the telemetry frequency and telemetry parameter group to the SDN controller to determine the network transmission path of SFC and generate INT telemetry data packet through the SDN controller; obtaining the parameter value of each telemetry parameter contained in each switch in the INT telemetry data packet; determining the SFC network data at a preset time point according to the parameter value contained in the telemetry parameter group; inputting the SFC network data into the neural network model to output the SFC network data at the next time point through the neural network model; inputting the SFC network data at the next time point into the classification model to obtain the predicted fault type of SFC for the next time point output by the classification model, so as to quickly locate the fault location and ensure the network service quality of SFC.

title: Writing identification equipment
description: The present invention relates to a writing recognition device, belonging to the technical field of writing devices. The present invention includes a stylus pen and a recognition display terminal; the stylus pen includes a battery, a control circuit, a posture acquisition module, a battery management module, a writing device that realizes the basic functions of the pen, and a pen drop detection module; the pen drop detection module and the posture acquisition module are connected to the control circuit, and the battery management module is connected to the battery; the control circuit includes a radio frequency circuit and a main control chip; the control circuit is connected to an information receiving module in a host computer through the radio frequency circuit thereon; the recognition display terminal adopts a host computer, and the host computer includes an information receiving module, a preprocessing module, a neural network module, and a display output module; the information receiving module, the preprocessing module, the neural network module, and the display output module are connected in sequence. The present invention can recognize the strokes or characters written by the user, and finally achieve the effect of being able to recognize the Chinese characters and letters written by the user.

title: Image noise reduction method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application provides an image denoising method, device, equipment and storage medium, which are used for inputting an image to be processed into an image denoising model to perform denoising treatment to obtain an initial denoising image corresponding to the image to be processed output by the image denoising model, inputting the image to be processed into a labeling model to perform pixel labeling to obtain pixel information corresponding to the image to be processed output by the labeling model, and obtaining a target denoising image corresponding to the image to be processed based on the pixel information and the initial denoising image. The image noise reduction is realized by combining the image noise reduction model and the pixel-level labeling model, so that the problem of local blurring of the image can be effectively solved while the overall noise reduction effect of the image is ensured, and the possibility is provided for noise reduction of image edge information and image detail recovery.

title: Method and system for defect analysis of sintered surface by laser selective powder laying based on machine vision
description: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, in particular to a method and system for analyzing defects on a sintered surface of laser-selected powder laying based on machine vision, comprising: collecting a powder bed image; ; Carry out abnormal area detection on the powder surface of the laser selection part; According to the confidence model of the defect type, carry out the initial classification of the defect type on the defect area on the powder surface of the laser selection part, which is divided into linear defects and block defects. Defects; the linear defect types and block defect types are reclassified according to defect characteristics, the linear defect types are subdivided into streak defects and powder pile defects, and the block defect types are subdivided into cladding layers High defects and insufficient powder supply defects. The above method is used to analyze the defects of the powder-sprayed sintered surface of the laser-selected part, and the automatic identification of the defects of the laser-selected powder-spread and sintered surface can be realized by the above method, and the efficiency and accuracy of the defect analysis can be improved.

title: Chord generation model training method, chord generation method, device and equipment
description: The disclosure relates to a training method, a chord generating method and a device of a chord generating model, and the training method of the chord generating model comprises the following steps: acquiring a sample sequence set; comprising the following steps: sample melody sequence and sample tonality sequence, sample chord sequence and sample chord function sequence; inputting the sample sequence set into a neural network model to be trained; the neural network model is used for predicting complete chord sequences and chord function sequences according to the sample melody sequences, the sample tonality sequences, the sample chord sequences and the partial sequence bits in the sample chord function sequences in the sample sequence set, and outputting predicted chord sequences and predicted chord function sequences; based on the predicted chord sequence and the sample chord sequence, predicting the chord function sequence and the sample chord function sequence, and determining a loss value of the current neural network model; and if the current neural network model is smaller than the preset loss threshold value, taking the current neural network model as a chord generation model. The present disclosure may improve the harmony of the resulting chord.

title: Water environment model parameter calibration method based on reinforcement learning
description: The invention relates to a water environment model parameter calibration method based on reinforcement learning. Comprising the following steps: collecting data as input, and model parameters to be calibrated as output, so as to construct a neural network for calibrating the model parameters; the weight is optimized by the return calculation; after the neural network outputs parameters, combining output data Y ' = { Y '  (1) ,y' (2) ,...,y' (n)  } predicted by the mechanism model, and taking the difference between Y ' and measured data Y= { Y  (1) ,y (2) ,...,y (n)  } obtained in the data acquisition step to obtain data z  i  as a random variable; calculating a risk value VaR  α  (X) of the random variable, and calculating a conditional risk value CVaR  α  (X); setting a threshold value to be T=0.1, and constructing a conditional risk value constraint CVaR  α  (X) to be less than or equal to 0.1; and (3) outputting parameters by the neural network, obtaining predicted output data Y ' = { Y '  (1) ,y' (2) ,...,y' (n)  } by combining a mechanism model, comparing Y ' with the measured data Y= { Y  (1) ,y (2) ,...,y (n)  } obtained in the data acquisition step, calculating the least square cost and the variance cost between the two, inversely summing the least square cost and the variance cost, and adding the inverse number of Nash efficiency coefficient and the variance to obtain the total return.

title: Anti-condensation methods, devices and air-conditioning systems for air conditioners
description: This application provides an anti-condensation method, device and air-conditioning system for an air conditioner. The anti-condensation method includes: an acquisition step. When the air conditioner is turned on, actual operating data is acquired. The actual operating data includes: the outdoor environment corresponding to the air conditioner. Temperature data, indoor ambient temperature data where the air conditioner is located, inner tube temperature data of the air conditioner and compressor operating frequency data of the air conditioner; input step, input the actual operating data into the neural network model to determine whether the air conditioner has entered the anti-condensation working mode, and obtain a determined result ; Control step: control the operation of the air conditioner based on the determination result. This application makes the judgment conditions more comprehensive, ensuring that the determination results obtained are more accurate, and then controls the operation of the air conditioner based on the determination results, ensuring that the time point at which the air conditioner is controlled to enter the anti-condensation working mode is more reasonable, and avoiding the problem of entering the anti-condensation working mode too early or too late. The anti-condensation working mode causes problems such as insufficient cooling capacity and water blowing from the air conditioner.

title: Substrate layer thickness determination using polishing pad wear compensation
description: A method of training a neural network includes obtaining two ground truth thickness profiles of a test substrate, obtaining two thickness profiles of the test substrate measured by an in situ monitoring system while the test substrate is on polishing pads of different thicknesses, generating an estimated thickness profile for another thickness value between the two thickness values by interpolating between the two profiles, and training the neural network using the estimated thickness profile.

title: Method and apparatus for determining and/or predicting sleep and respiratory behavior that governs airway pressure
description: Devices, systems, and methods for controlling operation of a breathing assistance device of a user are provided. The controller may include: an input for receiving sensor data to measure at least one airflow parameter of the airflow of the user; a memory unit storing at least one machine learning model and at least one classifier or predictor; and a processor configured to perform the measurements and generate control signals to adjust operation of the breathing assistance device during the current monitoring period by: obtaining measured air pressure and/or air flow data during a current monitoring period of time and measured FOT data; performing feature extraction on the measured data to obtain feature values that are used by a machine learning model employed by at least one classifier or predictor to determine attributes of the user; and adjusting the control signal based on the determined attribute.

title: A monitoring method and system for preventing external breakage of cables
description: The invention relates to a cable external damage prevention monitoring method and a system, belonging to the technical field of auxiliary equipment of a power transmission line; the method comprises the following steps: monitoring information of a road surface above a cable line is obtained by using monitoring equipment, a vibration signal of the road surface above the cable is obtained by using an intelligent external damage prevention device, and whether a cable external damage risk exists is judged according to the vibration signal and the monitoring information; the invention also provides a cable external-damage-prevention monitoring system, which comprises: the monitoring module acquires monitoring information through a visual camera; the induction module comprises a plurality of intelligent anti-external damage ground nails for acquiring vibration signals; the GPS Beidou positioning module is adopted to acquire the position information and the date information of the intelligent anti-external damage ground nail, so that workers can directly arrive at a designated place according to the position information; the transmission module adopts a wireless communication mode to transmit signals with a cable monitoring center. The cable external damage prevention monitoring method and the system provided by the invention have wide application scenes, reduce the operation and maintenance burden of teams and groups, and reduce the occurrence rate of cable and channel accidents.

title: A drum music score recognition method and device
description: The invention discloses a music score identification method and device for a drum set, and relates to the technical field of music score identification. According to the invention, the drum music score pictures are creatively converted and the corresponding text sequences are generated, and the semantic items are converted into the digital sequences through the semantic dictionary, so that the drum music score pictures can be recognized and trained through the convolutional cyclic neural network, the steps of recognizing spectral lines in the middle, recognizing single musical symbols and the like are omitted, the laborious assembly design is reduced, and various properties or advanced features are more easily captured and extracted; the single model is more robust than the error accumulation of each component, can effectively reduce the error accumulation, and has an advantage in recognition effect.

title: A public transportation travel group classification method based on hypergraph attention network
description: A public transport travel group classification method based on hypergraph attention network belongs to the field of intelligent transportation systems and aims to solve the problem of travel group classification. Firstly, utilizing a KNN (K-NearestNeighbor) network to construct a hypergraph representation of travel characteristic data of individual public transportation, wherein nodes represent travel individuals, and supersides are attribute topological relations among the travel individuals modeled by the KNN; next, the representation of the nodes in the hypergraph is learned using a hypergraph attention network (HGAT), which is split into two steps. First, a node's attention is used to learn a characteristic representation of the node. A second step of aggregating the final representation of the node with another aggregator; and finally, inputting the representation of the nodes into a linear layer, classifying the travel groups, and optimizing the prediction capacity of the model by adopting cross entropy loss. Experiments prove that the method can realize the accurate classification of public transportation travel groups, and the accuracy is greatly improved.

title: Depth learning-based water quality transparency detection method for water-free ruler Seiki plate
description: The invention discloses a depth learning-based water quality transparency detection method for a water-free ruler Session disk, which comprises the following steps of 1, obtaining a Session disk water quality transparency measurement video, 2, determining an initial position of the Session disk, tracking the Session disk position in other frames of the video according to the initial position of the Session disk by adopting a SiamFC ++ network, dividing the tracking result of each frame to serve as a division result, 3, cleaning data of the division result obtained in the step 2 by adopting a discriminator to obtain a critical position of the Session disk, removing a part after the critical position of the Session disk from the division result, 4, extracting features of the rest part in the division result obtained in the step 3, and calculating the water quality transparency calculation result based on the extracted features by adopting a circulation network Bi-Lstm. The invention does not need to observe the water gauge, avoids a plurality of inconveniences caused by water gauge reading, and greatly improves the measuring speed and accuracy.

title: A tire defect X-ray image detection and grading system and method
description: The invention relates to a tire defect detection grade-judging system and a method thereof, wherein the detection grade-judging system comprises X-ray machines, an AI automatic grade-judging system based on deep learning, an automatic grade-judging system based on pattern recognition, a central grade-judging system, a manual rechecking end, a local display, an MES system and a PLC system, wherein an industrial control host of a plurality of X-ray machines is connected together through a local area network, each X-ray machine is electrically connected with the AI automatic grade-judging system based on deep learning, the automatic grade-judging system based on pattern recognition and the central grade-judging system, the AI automatic grade-judging system based on deep learning and the automatic grade-judging system based on pattern recognition are respectively connected with the central grade-judging system, and the central grade-judging system is respectively electrically connected with the manual rechecking end, the local display, the MES system and the PLC system. The method solves the problems of non-uniform detection standard, large difference of judgment results, low recognition rate and the like of the existing method.

title: Particle swarm optimization method for PID parameters
description: The invention discloses an optimization method of particle swarm optimization for PID parameters, which comprises the following steps of initializing a particle swarm, assigning the PID parameters to positions of particles, adopting an fitness function to calculate fitness values of the particles, searching individual optimal positions of the particles and population optimal positions of the particles according to the fitness values of the particles, updating the positions and the speeds of the particles, sequentially judging whether iteration times are smaller than one third of the maximum iteration times, not smaller than one third of the maximum iteration times and smaller than two thirds of the maximum iteration times, and not smaller than two thirds of the maximum iteration times, and outputting the positions of the particles to be optimized PID parameters if not.

title: A campus access control management method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: This application relates to the field of access data management, and in particular to a campus access control management method, device, equipment and medium. Methods include: obtaining traffic standard information, personnel identification information, and current time information. The personnel class category information and the passage time information corresponding to the personnel class category information are determined based on the passage standard information. Class category information is determined based on the person identification information. Match class category information with personnel class category information to obtain matching class information. According to the corresponding relationship between the class information and the transit time information, the transit time information corresponding to the matching class information is determined. Determine whether the current time information matches the transit time information. If it is consistent, an access control opening instruction is generated to control the opening of the access control. This application has the effect of improving traffic efficiency.

title: A camera device preset automatic setting method and camera group
description: The invention discloses a method for automatically setting a preset position of an imaging device and an imaging group, and relates to the technical field of image processing. The method for automatically setting the preset position of the camera device includes: Step 1: the edge computing gateway obtains a plurality of trained neural network models; Step 2: the edge computing gateway controls each camera device to automatically obtain the preset position according to each trained neural network model Position. The method for automatically setting the preset positions of the camera devices of the present application can automatically set the preset positions of each camera device without manual setting, thereby reducing the workload of people.

title: Collaborative content recommendation platform
description: A system and method for summarizing suggested content and sharing the summarized suggested content is described. In one aspect, a computer-implemented method includes performing an analysis of text of a document, searching a document library for content elements and documents based on the analysis of the text, identifying candidate documents and candidate content based on the searching, presenting a list of candidate documents or candidate content with the document authoring application, receiving a selection of a candidate document or candidate content from the list in the document authoring application, and providing the selected candidate document to a collaborative content sharing platform, the collaborative content sharing platform configured to generate a graphical user interface that displays a list of shared documents, the shared documents includes candidate documents selected by one or more users of a group of users that share access to the collaborative content sharing platform.

title: Distributed learning method and device
description: The present application provides a distributed learning method and device. By combining wireless communication and distributed learning, resources can be saved, and the performance of distributed learning in a wireless environment can be improved. The method comprises: a first node using a first data model to process first data so as to obtain first intermediate data, and sending the first intermediate data to a second node by means of a first channel, wherein the first channel is updated according to error information of second intermediate data, information of the first channel and the first intermediate data, the second intermediate data is a result of the first intermediate data being transmitted to the second node by means of the first channel, and the first channel is a channel between the first node and the second node.

title: Entity relationship joint extraction-based legal knowledge graph construction method and device
description: An entity relationship joint extraction-based legal knowledge graph construction method and device, the construction method comprising: construction of a triple data set; design of model architecture and training of a model, the model architecture comprising a model encoding layer, a head entity extraction layer and a relationship-tail entity extraction layer; determination of relationships between text sentences; and triple compounding and graph visualization. The design of the model architecture of the present invention uses a Chinese bert pre-training model as an encoder, which has a good effect on Chinese text encoding. An entity extraction part uses two BiLSTM binary classifiers to distinguish between start and end positions of entities, which may effectively extract the entities in the form of phrases in the text. In the present invention, a head entity is extracted first, and a tail entity corresponding to an entity relationship is then extracted from the extracted head entity. When extracting the entity relationship and the tail entity, not only is encoding information of a sentence used, but encoding information of the head entity is also incorporated. In the present invention, a highly accurate legal knowledge graph may be obtained.

title: Device and method for controlling a robot device
description: A method for training a robot device controller is described comprising training a neural network comprising an encoder network, a decoder network and a policy network, such that, for each of a plurality of digital training input images, the encoder network encodes the digital training input image to a feature in a latent space, the decoder network determines, from the feature, for each of a plurality of areas shown in the digital training input image, whether the area is traversable and information about the distance between the viewpoint of the digital training input image and the area and the policy model determines, from the feature, control information for controlling movement of a robot device wherein at least the policy model is trained in a supervised manner using control information ground truth data of the digital training input images.

title: Behavior model cost estimation device, method, and program
description: An aspect of the present invention pertains to a behavior model using a graph. When the cost pertaining to a behavior is estimated for each of a plurality of sides, which indicate behaviors, between a plurality of vertexes which indicate states, the behavior model acquires graph data including at least information about rewards set for the structure of the graph and the plurality of vertexes of the graph, and acquires behavior data including a plurality of behavior trajectories from the graph. In addition, the cost is shown using parameters, the parameters are estimated using a gradient method pertaining to the likelihood function on the basis of the graph data and the behavior data, and the estimated parameters are output as the estimation value of the cost.

title: Systems and methods for automatic environmental planning and decision support using artificial intelligence and data fusion techniques on distributed sensor network data
description: Disclosed are systems and methods for community-based multi-sensor fused data processing to determine natural hazard risk. In one embodiment, a system comprises one or more memory units storing instructions and one or more processors configured to execute the instructions to receive localized data from a distributed multi-sensor network, the distributed multi-sensor network including a plurality of sensor devices associated with a community, receive property data, community infrastructure data and environmental data from at least one external repository, generate combined data using data fusion, the combined data being based on the localized data from the distributed multi-sensor network and at least one of the property data, community infrastructure data or the environmental data, determine a community risk score for a natural hazard by implementing a machine learning method on the combined data, and perform a mitigating action based on the community risk score.

title: Imaging system for automated intubation
description: A system, method and apparatus to automatically perform endotracheal intubation in a patient comprising, inserting a blade inside the upper airway of the patient to retract an anatomical structure; inserting a bending portion and a tube arranged on the bending portion inside the airway of the patient; collecting airway data using at least one imaging sensor arranged on the bending portion; communicating collected airway data to a processing circuitry; predicting an intended path for insertion of the tube and generating control signals using the processing circuitry, wherein the intended path is predicted based on at least one anatomical structure recognized by the processing circuitry using the collected airway data; displaying an intended path via a user interface to display at least one intended path to an operator and also allow the operator to select an intended path; and communicating the control signals generated by the processing circuitry to at least one actuation unit to actuate the three-dimensional movement of the tube.

title: Image synthesis
description: A first apparatus comprises a first receiver (301) receiving images of a scene captured and a second receiver (303) receives 3D spatial data for the scene A view synthesis neural network (307) generates view shifted images for the scene for different view poses from the images and the spatial data. A neural network trainer (309) trains the view synthesis neural network (307) based on images of the scene for different view poses. A generator (305) generates an audiovisual data stream comprising: image data for the images, scene data representing the three dimensional spatial data, and coefficient data describing coefficients of the view synthesis neural network (307) after training. A second apparatus receives the audio visual data stream and sets a local neural network (403) based on the coefficient data. The local neural network (403) is then used to generate images of the scene for different view poses.

title: Intelligent toxic and harmful gas alarm system for preparation of electronic grade hydrogen peroxide
description: The present application relates to the field of intelligent detection of electronic grade gases, and specifically discloses an intelligent toxic and harmful gas alarm system for the preparation of electronic grade hydrogen peroxide, and an alarm method thereof. In the present application, a convolutional neural network model is used to extract high-dimensional implicit correlation features among hydrogen peroxide concentrations at different positions of a place to be monitored and topological features of multiple gas chromatographs so as to generate feature vectors and a feature matrix; in order to fuse feature information of the feature vectors and the feature matrix to enhance the spatial correlation of hydrogen peroxide distribution on the basis of the topological features so as to improve the accuracy of classification, a classification feature vector is further generated by means of a class representation of spatial mapping of the feature vectors to the feature matrix, so that a simultaneous projection of the feature vectors to a high-dimensional feature space of the feature matrix under a specific label class probability is achieved, and the dimensional alignment of feature distributions of the feature vectors in the high-dimensional feature space is improved, thereby improving the sensitivity and accuracy of early warning classification.

title: Machine learning data collection, validation, and reporting configurations
description: A device in a wireless network may process information with machine learning associated with a model ID, a machine learning function, or a machine learning use case and report data via the wireless communication based on a configuration associated with the model ID, the machine learning function, or the machine learning use case. A device may provide a configuration for machine learning associated with a model ID, a machine learning function or, a machine learning use case; and may receive a report of data based on the configuration associated with the model ID, the machine learning function, or the machine learning use case.

title: Rockfill particle size identification and monitoring apparatus and method based on three-dimensional reconstruction of camera group
description: A rockfill particle size identification and monitoring apparatus and method based on three-dimensional reconstruction of a camera group. The apparatus comprises: a camera group (1), the camera group (1) at least comprising two cameras which are configured to collect, from different angles, rockfill multi-angle images of rockfill to be identified at different heights in the rockfill process; a calibration module, configured to place a marker within a collection field of view of the camera group and calibrate parameters of the camera group; and an identification and monitoring module (5), connected to the camera group (1), and configured to process the rockfill multi-angle images, determine, according to the rockfill multi-angle images, a particle size classification result oof each rockfill in the rockfill to be identified, establish, according to the classification result, a grading curve of the rockfill to be identified, and identify and monitor, according to the grading curve, the rockfill to be identified.

title: Weakly paired image style transfer method based on pose self-supervised generative adversarial network
description: A weakly paired image style transfer method based on a pose self-supervised generative adversarial network, relating to the field of image processing. The method is suitable for style transfer of weakly paired images, different styles of pictures having certain overlap are used to perform model training of an adversarial neural network, so that the model is insensitive to poses and focuses on style learning, and therefore, in an actual application process, a source style can be converted into a target style, but a pose is kept unchanged. In addition, in the model training process of the adversarial neural network, a differentiable pose solver capable of estimating a relative pose of any two images is introduced, a phase correlation algorithm is optimized to be differentiable, and the phase correlation algorithm is embedded into an end-to-end learning network framework to achieve pose estimation. Style transfer of weakly paired data can be achieved, and thus support is provided for robot self-positioning technology.

title: Deep learning systems and methods for predicting impact of cardholder behavior based on payment events
description: A system is configured to retrieve a set of customer raw transaction data, wherein the transactions are devoid of any target transactions of interest. An impact neural network model is applied to the transaction data using a "notTargef ' variable. The "notTargef ' variable indicates that the target transaction of interest is not included in the transaction data. The model predicts a first result based on the "notTargef' variable. The model is applied to the transaction data using an "isTargef ' variable. The "isTargef ' variable indicates that the target transaction of interest is included in the set of customer raw transaction data. The model predicts a second result based on the "isTargef ' variable. The system determines a difference between the second and first results. The difference is a predicted incremental impact on cardholder behavior. The system presents the predicted incremental impact on cardholder behavior to an issuer associated with the transaction data.

title: Electronic device for training speech recognition model and control method thereof
description: Provided are an electronic device for training a speech recognition model and a control method thereof. The control method of the electronic device for training a speech recognition model comprises the steps of: inputting a training speech sequence into a speech recognition model including a plurality of layers; obtaining a plurality of loss values respectively from output terminals of the plurality of layers; and training the speech recognition model on the basis of the plurality of loss values.

title: Method for managing machine-learning dataset using policy resource in internet of things platform
description: Provided is a method for managing an ML dataset using a policy resource in an IoT platform. The method for managing an ML dataset according to an embodiment of the present invention generates a policy resource containing a policy for managing an ML dataset, refers to the generated policy resource and generates an ML dataset from data stored in data resources, and provides the generated ML dataset. Accordingly, by making it possible to define a policy resource for managing an ML dataset in an M2M platform and manage/utilize the ML dataset using same, the method frees a user of an ML application, which requires an ML training dataset or an ML inference dataset, from the inconvenience of data combination/refinement work, as well as the time and effort required thereby.

title: Method, program, and device for constructing medical artificial intelligence model
description: Disclosed are a method, a program, and a device for constructing a medical artificial intelligence model, the method being performed by a computing device, according to an embodiment of the present disclosure. The method may comprise the steps of: establishing an evaluation criterion for an artificial intelligence model on the basis of a task intended by a user; determining a first indicator used in a loss calculation for training of an artificial intelligence model and a second indicator used in an evaluation calculation for selecting the trained model according to the established evaluation criterion; and constructing an artificial intelligence model that performs the task intended by the user, on the basis of the determined first indicator and second indicator.

title: Magnetic resonance weighted image synthesis method and apparatus based on variational autoencoder
description: A magnetic resonance weighted image synthesis method and apparatus based on a variational autoencoder. The method comprises the following steps: step S1: acquiring real magnetic resonance weighted images having multiple contrasts and a magnetic resonance quantitative parameter diagram by using a magnetic resonance scanner; step S2: forming a magnetic resonance weighted image; step S3: constructing a pre-trained variational autoencoder model having encoder and decoder structures; step S4: obtaining a variational autoencoder model; and step S5: synthesizing the magnetic resonance weighted image and the magnetic resonance quantitative parameter diagram into a second magnetic resonance weighted image by means of the variational autoencoder model. According to the method, a variational autoencoder model is used and trained by using magnetic resonance weighted images having multiple contrasts, thereby obtaining continuous distribution of approximate contrast information, so that the variational autoencoder model can reconstruct a magnetic resonance weighted image that is not present in training data.

title: Time series perdition optimization method, device, and storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present application provide a time series prediction optimization method, a device, and a storage medium. A feature conversion module and a prediction module are constructed in a time series prediction model, and a time-invariant feature can be introduced into a time series prediction process by means of the feature conversion module to serve as an important influencing factor. In addition, it is also proposed that a volatility evaluation index for the time-invariant feature is used as a first loss function corresponding to the feature conversion module, an evaluation index of a prediction sequence based on dynamic time warping (DTW) is used as a second loss function corresponding to the prediction module, and tuning is performed on the time series prediction model at least based on the two loss functions. In this way, the extraction of the time-invariant feature is more accurate, and the DTW can be introduced into the time series prediction process by means of the second loss function to serve as another important influencing factor, thereby improving the accuracy of sudden change prediction. Therefore, the performance of the time sequence prediction model can be effectively optimized, and the prediction accuracy is improved.

title: Data augmentation method, device, and program for mhc class ii binding and immunogenicity prediction model
description: Disclosed are a data augmentation method, device, and program for an MHC class II binding and immunogenicity prediction model. The data augmentation device according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises a processor for: selecting a plurality of pieces of to-be-augmented data, including first type data and second type data to be augmented, from original data according to predetermined selection conditions; generating a plurality of pieces of augmented data by augmenting the selected plurality of pieces of to-be-augmented data according to predetermined augmentation conditions, the first type data and the second type data being augmented according to a first type data augmentation condition and a second type data augmentation condition, respectively; and changing the labeling of the plurality of pieces of augmented data, the labels of the first type data and the second type data being changed according to different labeling conditions.

title: Downhole tool string movement sensor system
description: A method can include acquiring motion sensor data using a motion sensor at a motion sensor location of a tool string disposed in a borehole during a field operation; transmitting the motion sensor data to transfer function circuitry of the tool string; operating the transfer function circuitry to apply a transfer function to the motion sensor data to determine one or more of lateral displacement and velocity at a location of the tool string that is a distance from the motion sensor location; and characterizing sensor data acquired by a sensor at the location using at least one of the one or more of the lateral displacement and the velocity.

title: Dioxin emission concentration soft measurement method based on improved generative adversarial network
description: Provided in the present invention is a dioxin emission concentration soft measurement method based on an improved generative adversarial network, comprising: inputting MSWI process data into a missing data partitioning module for partitioning, so as to obtain an input feature and a target feature; inputting the input feature and the target feature into an adversarial generative data filling module for data filling, so as to obtain filling data; inputting the filling data and dioxin emission concentration experiment data into an input-output data matching module for data matching, so as to obtain modeling data; and inputting the modeling data into an improved deep forest regression module for modeling and prediction, so as to obtain a concentration predicted value. The present invention can improve the diversity and accuracy of dioxin emission concentration soft measurement.

title: Diffusion modeling based subsurface formation evaluation
description: Some implementations include a method for controlling a computer to geologically characterize a space relative to a borehole. The method may include configuring a diffusion process applied to information and data about samples of reservoir parameters. The method also may include determining, via the diffusion process, a probability distribution of the reservoir parameters in the space relative to the borehole.

title: Model parameter optimization method and related system, and storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present application provide a model parameter optimization method and a related system, and a storage medium. The method comprises: acquiring multiple reference values of a parameter of a first model (301); according to preset model evaluation information, the first model, and a prior data pair of the first model, traversing the multiple reference values to obtain at least one target value of the parameter (302), wherein a loss value, on the prior data pair, of the model corresponding to the target value is not greater than an upper bound of the loss value, on the prior data pair, of the model in the preset model evaluation information, and/or a test accuracy value, on the prior data pair, of the model corresponding to the target value is not less than a lower bound of the test accuracy value of the model on the prior data pair; determining an optimal value of the parameter according to the at least one target value, the prior data pair of the first model, and a posterior data pair of the first model (303); and updating the parameter of the first model according to the optimal value (304). Thus, the model precision can be improved.

title: Method and system for generating contents using language model
description: According to an aspect of the present invention, a method for generating content by using a language model is provided, the method comprising the steps of: extracting information associated with first content by referring to the first content, and causing a language model to be trained by referring to the information associated with the first content; and in response to acquisition of information on a request for generating second content, generating the second content by using the language model.

title: Predicting worker instance count for cloud-based computing platforms
description: Described are examples for recommending increase in worker instance count for an availability zone in a cloud-based computing platform. A machine learning (ML) model can be used to predict a time series forecast of a workload for the availability zone in a future time period. A predicted number of worker instances to handle the predicted workload can be computed, and if the number of worker instances in the availability zone is less than the predicted number of worker instances, a recommendation to increase the number of worker instances in the availability zone can be generated.

title: Artificial intelligence based unstructured document geotagging solution
description: Systems and methods presented herein utilize text mining, Optical Character Recognition (OCR), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Named Entity Recognition (NER) to extract entity relations for spatial exploration and production (E&P) objects and document categories from unstructured document content autonomously. Language models may be utilized and the results between them may be compared. The extracted information may then be linked to a structured database that contains geolocations.

title: Formula-driven supervised learning method and system for ai model, and method and system for creating transfer-learned ai model
description: The present invention provides formula-driven supervised learning method and system for an AI model for pre-training, with more practical accuracy than before, an AI model that can be transferred to a target task. A formula-driven supervised learning system 1 for an AI model is constituted by a first image data set creation unit 11, a second image data set creation unit 12, a mixed database creation unit 13 incorporating a mixed database 13A, and an AI model learning unit 14. The mixed database creation unit 13 creates the mixed database 13A which is obtained by mixing a first type of image data set DS1 and a second type of image data set DS2. The AI model learning unit 14 uses the mixed database 13A to pre-train an AI model.

title: End-to-end workflow for automated narrative creation
description: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for narrative creation. A method generally includes receiving a selection of a first narrative type for generation, obtaining: a plurality of user responses to a plurality of prompts associated with the first narrative type; and at least one of: one or more stories from one or more users stored in a repository; or one or more insights associated with one or more documents stored in the repository, and processing, by one or more machine learning (ML) models, the plurality of user responses and at least one of the one or more stories or the one or more insights to generate an output associated with the first narrative type.

title: Multi-modal reasoning segmentation to enhance language models for healthcare reasoning analysis
description: A computer-implemented method for improving language models includes tokenization processing to concatenate an obtained image and texts with designated tags. An image encoder is trained to encode image information of the image. A two token representation is generated by a multi-modal generative agent using the encoded image information and the obtained texts. A text encoder and the image encoder are trained to encode the obtained image and texts. A text decoder and an image decoder are combined for the multi-modal reasoning segmentation by training the text decoder and the image decoder to generate a segmented image and segmented textual information using the two token representation in combination with an output of the text encoder and an output of the image encoder. The method has applications including, but not limited to, use cases in medical Al / healthcare, for example, for optimizing medical diagnosis or treatment or supporting decision making.

title: County power distribution network grid planning method based on digital resource fusion technology, and system
description: Disclosed in the present invention are a county power distribution network grid planning method based on a digital resource fusion technology, and a system. The method comprises: acquiring geographic information of a county region, and performing preliminary division of power supply grids; performing secondary division of the power supply grids by means of a K-means clustering algorithm; and by means of an adaptive multi-objective whale optimization algorithm, selecting an optimal planning strategy to perform tertiary division of the power supply grids. By studying the development and evolution mechanism of a county power distribution network across temporal, spatial, and resource dimensions, planning and operation methods for the county power distribution network are integrated for digital resource fusion, enabling grid division of the county power distribution network. Moreover, a multi-objective collaborative planning model of the power distribution network is constructed from the perspectives of economy and security, and an optimal planning solution is selected.

title: Apparatus and method for efficiently operating ai/ml model in wireless communication system
description: According to various embodiments of the present disclosure, an operation method for a first node in a wireless communication system is provided, the method comprising the steps of: receiving at least one synchronization signal from a second node; receiving control information from the second node; transmitting first communication environment data to the second node; receiving, from the second node, model information related to a first secondary artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) model based on a first sub-feature set related to the first communication environment data; transmitting, to the second node, second communication environment data changed from the first communication environment data; and receiving, from the second node, model update information for a second secondary AI/ML model, which is based on a second sub-feature set related to the second communication environment data and is changed from the first secondary AI/ML model.

title: Systems and methods for agentic operations using multimodal generative models for tennis
description: Disclosed techniques relate to using one or more of tennis match statistics, textual insights, predictions (e.g., team and player at the match level, and team at the season level), graphics, video overlays, and player and ball tracking data. Tracking data may be generated using an in-venue feed or a broadcast feed. The tracking data may be supplemented with event data which may be provided by an operator or an automated system based on the events related to a given sport within a venue or via a broadcast feed. The tracking data and/or event data may be used to generate insights such as match statistics, textual insights, predictions, graphics, video overlays, and or the like. Accordingly, the tracking data and insights generated in accordance with the subject matter disclosed herein may be specific to a given sporting event and/or the sport associated with the sporting event.

title: Enhanced machine learning for iron-based oligomerization of ethylene k-value prediction
description: A machine learning model predicts a K value for a new iron ethylene oligomerization catalyst structure, where the K value has not yet been experimentally determined. A system comprising: a device comprising memory coupled to at least one processor, the memory having instructions that cause the at least one processor to: convert a tested iron ethylene oligomerization catalyst structure having an experimental K value to a first computer-readable string; generate, based on the first computer-readable string, chemical features of the tested iron ethylene oligomerization catalyst structure.

title: Electrical connector, control method, microwave line, and quantum computer system
description: An electrical connector (100), a control method, a microwave line, and a quantum computer system. The electrical connector (100) comprises a plug (1) and a receptacle (2); a closed air chamber (3) is provided in the plug (1) or the receptacle (2); two electrodes (31, 32) that are not in contact with each other are provided on an inner wall of the closed air chamber (3), and are configured to be connected to wires; the closed air chamber (3) is filled with an easily ionizable gas; when the wire connected to either electrode (31, 32) among the two electrodes (31, 32) is energized, the easily ionizable gas is ionized, so that a current path is formed between the two electrodes (31, 32); and when neither of the wires connected to the two electrodes (31, 32) is energized, the easily ionizable gas is not ionized, and the closed air chamber (3) does not conduct a current.

title: Method for providing llm-based ai agent to which artificial intelligence model including plurality of models is applied, and system therefor
description: A method for providing an LLM-based AI agent to which an artificial intelligence model including a plurality of models is applied, according to an embodiment of the present invention, is a method by which a computing system comprising a memory and a processor provides an LLM-based AI agent to which an artificial intelligence model including a plurality of models is applied, and comprises the steps of: executing an on-device AI agent service; acquiring predetermined input data based on the executed on-device AI agent service; determining a domain in accordance with the acquired input data; determining an application model, which is an artificial intelligence model for processing a task in accordance with the determined domain; generating output data for the input data on the basis of the determined application model; and providing the generated output data on the basis of the on-device AI agent service.

title: Methods and apparatuses for vertical federated learning capability registration and discovery
description: A method implemented by a network device may comprise sending a registration request to register a capability of an NWDAF to act as a vertical federated learning (VFL) active participant; receiving a registration response indicating that the capability of the NWDAF to act as the VFL active participant has been registered successfully; receiving an analytics service request from a consumer network function (NF); sending a first discovery request based on the analytics service request; receiving a first discovery response; sending initial ML model information to a first VFL passive participant; determining that the first VFL passive participant is not available to perform an inferencing service of an analytics service indicated by the analytics service request; sending a second discovery request to discover a second VFL passive participant that is available to perform the inferencing service; and receiving a second discovery response that indicates the second VFL passive participant.

title: Boolean logic-gated protein presentation via autonomously compiled molecular topology
description: Biomaterials and polypeptide-based biological circuits configured for conditional release of a cargo therefrom. Logical biological circuit elements, including YES, AND, and OR elements, can be used to construct biosensors and implantable devices that are configured to conditionally release a biologically relevant cargo therefrom, such as a drug, biotherapeutic, or biomarker, in an appropriate scenario.

title: Method and apparatus for artificial intelligence based channel estimation in a wireless communication system
description: The disclosure relates to a 5G or 6G communication system for supporting a higher data transmission rate. A method performed by a first electronic device may include receiving, from a second electronic device, a signal indicative of a state of a channel, the signal being associated with a channel matrix and corrupted by a noise, obtaining a noisy image of the channel in a first domain, the noisy image being a least squares estimate of the channel matrix, transforming the noisy image into a second domain, and performing a channel estimation (CE) of the channel based on at least one of the transformed noisy image, a CE model configured to denoise an input signal, or a sparsity of channel state information (CSI) in the transformed noisy image in the second domain.

title: Adaptive document integration using generative artificial intelligence
description: Systems, methods, and computer-readable media are provided for using generative Al enriched with metadata about historical document characteristics to transform documents of various formats, including images, to the fields and values they represent. A prompt template may be selected in association with a type of document. The prompt template indicates field definition(s) of field(s) to be detected in the document and location(s) in which the field(s) have been detected in prior documents. A large language model is prompted with a prompt generated using the prompt template to generate a result that assigns value(s) to the field(s). Output from the language model is used for identifying the field to value mapping for the document, such that data detected from the document may be stored in appropriate database structures of a database. Metadata stored in association with the prompt template is updated based on location(s) in the document in which the field(s) were detected, and the value(s) of the field(s) are stored in a database. Outbound documents may be similarly translated to detect values of corresponding fields requested by third parties, even if those values are not stored in the database. In this scenario, values for fields may be detected in outbound documents using the prompt templates enriched with metadata as processed by the large language model before such information is prepared to be sent to a third party.

title: On-demand co-processing resources for quantum computing
description: An algorithm execution management system of a provider network may receive a request from a user for executing an algorithm using different types of computing resources, including classical computing resources and quantum computing resources. The request may indicate a container that includes the algorithm code and dependencies such as libraries for executing the algorithm. The algorithm execution management system may first determine that the quantum computing resources are available to execute the algorithm, and then cause the classical computing resources to be provisioned. The algorithm execution management system may cause at least one portion of the algorithm to be executed at the classical computing resources using the container indicated by the user, and at least another portion of the algorithm to be executed at the quantum computing resources. The quantum task of the algorithm may be provided a priority during execution of the algorithm for using the quantum computing resources.

title: Inverse system design for constrained multi-objective optimization
description: A design methodology and tool called INFORM are provided that use a two-phase approach for sample-efficient constrained multi-objective optimization of real -world nonlinear systems. In the first optional phase, one may modify a genetic algorithm (GA) to make the design process sample-efficient, and may inject candidate solutions into the GA population using inverse design methods. The inverse design techniques may be based on (i) a neural network verifier, (ii) a neural network, and (iii) a Gaussian mixture model. The candidate solutions for the next generation are thus a mix of those generated using crossover/mutation and solutions generated using inverse design. At the end of the first phase, one obtains a set of nondominated solutions. In the second phase, one chooses one or more solution(s) from the non-dominated solutions or another reference solution to further improve the objective function values using inverse design methods.

title: Automated generation of rules and control from partial rulesets
description: A system is controlled. A ruleset is specified based at least in part on a ruleset expression that comprises one or more ruleset operations whose operands include partial rulesets. The ruleset expression is evaluated to produce a compiled ruleset. The compiled ruleset is outputted. The outputted compiled ruleset is applied to control a physical actuator.

title: ADAPTIVE EVALUATION OF META RELATIONSHIPS IN SEMANTIC GRAPHS
description: A method and system are provided for an adaptive assessment of meta relationships in semantic graphs. The method includes providing a semantic graph based on a knowledge database in which concepts in the form of graph nodes are linked by semantic relationships in the form of graph edges. Metadata of weights for measuring a meta relationship is encoded in the edges and nodes of the semantic graph, the meta relationship applying to the concepts of the semantic graph and being independent of the semantic relationship defined by the edges of the semantic graph. Graph activation is performed for an input context that relates to one or more concepts of the semantic graph, with the weights applied to an activation propagation signal through the semantic graph to generate a meta relationship measurement for a subset of concepts of the semantic graph.

title: DETECTION OF ORIENTATION POINTS USING CURVE FITTING FOR APPLICATIONS FOR AUTONOMOUS DRIVING
description: In various examples, one or more deep neural networks (DNN) are performed for regression on control points of a curve, and the control points can be used to perform a curve fitting operation - e.g. B. a Bezier curve fit - to identify locations and geometries of landmarks in an environment. The outputs of the DNN can thus indicate the two-dimensional (2D) image-space and / or three-dimensional (3D) world-space control point positions, and post-processing techniques - such as clustering and temporal smoothing - can be performed to locate and position landmarks precisely and in real time. As a result, reconstructed curves corresponding to the landmarks - e.g. Such as lane line, road gauge, zebra crossing, mast, text, etc. - can be used by a vehicle to perform one or more operations to navigate a surrounding area.

title: METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR GRAPH DATA PROCESSING WITH HYBRID CONCLUSION
description: Graph data processing embodiments are provided. A graph is created containing a plurality of explicit nodes and at least one implicit node. Traversing between a first explicit node of the plurality of explicit nodes and a second explicit node of the plurality of explicit nodes is performed using deductive reasoning. Traversing between a third explicit node of the plurality of explicit nodes and a fourth explicit node of the plurality of explicit nodes is performed through the at least one implicit node using inductive reasoning.

title: A real-time super-resolution method using additional rendering information based on convolutional neural networks
description: The invention relates to a real-time super-resolution method using extra rendering information based on a convolutional neural network, including acquiring feature map information of low-resolution data of a current frame and feature map information of high-resolution extra information; Cache feature map information; obtain historical feature weights and assign input data; redistribute input data according to the feature map information of low-resolution data of the current frame, feature map information of high-resolution extra information, and historical feature weights, and obtain high-resolution images information. The beneficial effects of the present invention are: on the basis of the feature map information of the low-resolution data, the present invention can help the convolutional neural network by adding cheap and high-resolution extra information G-Buffer rich in various detailed information as an input. Better prediction of high-resolution results.

title: Target detection method, device, medium and equipment based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses a target detection method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a picture to be detected; inputting a picture to be detected into a pre-trained target detection model, and performing feature extraction on the picture to be detected by using a backbone network of the target detection model, wherein the feature extraction comprises a first-stage feature extraction and a second-stage feature extraction; performing first-stage feature extraction by adopting a CNN network; performing second-stage feature extraction by adopting a Transformer network; fusing the feature graph obtained by the first stage of feature extraction with the feature graph obtained by the second stage of feature extraction to obtain a fused feature graph; and finishing target detection of the picture to be detected based on the fusion feature map and the target detection model. In the invention, the first-stage feature extraction is carried out through the CNN network, and then the second-stage feature extraction is carried out by adopting the Transformer network based on the feature map obtained by the first-stage feature extraction, so that the receptive field is increased, and the detection effect of the large target and the snapshot map is improved.

title: A laser point cloud target detection and recognition device and method based on deep learning
description: The invention relates to a laser point cloud target detection and identification device and method based on deep learning. The method includes the following steps: 1) a data acquisition module collects laser point cloud data; 2) a data labeling module automatically labels the laser point cloud data; 3 ) The deep learning module performs feature extraction on the marked laser point cloud data; 4) The prediction module performs real-time prediction of the target based on the deep neural network model according to the extracted features. In the laser point cloud target detection and recognition method based on the deep learning of the present invention, the single frame of point cloud data is firstly feature extracted, and then the extracted features are sparsely processed, and converted into RPN convolutional neural network for computing. The convolutional neural network used in the image field is transplanted to the three-dimensional laser point cloud field, thereby improving the accuracy of target detection and recognition in the laser point cloud data.

title: Image orientation recognition method, device, device, storage medium and program product
description: The present disclosure provides an image direction recognition method, an image direction recognition device, an electronic apparatus, a computer-readable storage medium, and a computer program product, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence such as deep learning, image processing, computer vision, and can be applied to scenes such as optical character recognition. The method comprises the following steps: determining the whole image direction and the whole image direction confidence of a complete image containing a target object; in response to the fact that the confidence coefficient of the direction of the whole image is smaller than or equal to a preset confidence coefficient threshold value, image areas only containing target objects are deducted from the whole image, and sub-images consistent with the number of the target objects are obtained; determining a subgraph direction and a subgraph direction confidence coefficient of each subimage respectively; determining a target subgraph direction according to each subgraph direction and each subgraph direction confidence coefficient; and determining the target sub-image direction as the real direction of the complete image. The method integrates the direction discrimination of the whole image level and the sub-image level, and improves the accuracy of the real direction of the judged complete image.

title: A multi-stage real-time optimal scheduling method for reservoirs based on forecast uncertainty
description: The invention discloses a multi-stage real-time optimization scheduling method for a reservoir based on forecast uncertainty, which comprises the steps of S1, collecting and sorting data required by reservoir real-time scheduling; s2, constructing a reservoir runoff forecasting model to realize reservoir runoff forecasting; s3, analyzing uncertainty of the multi-stage runoff forecast of the reservoir; s4, constructing a reservoir real-time optimization scheduling model to realize reservoir real-time optimization scheduling; s5, carrying out convergence analysis on the reservoir real-time optimization scheduling scheme; and S6, implementing a reservoir real-time optimization scheduling scheme, and entering the next scheduling stage. The advantages are that: the method can synthesize the multi-stage forecast information, simultaneously distinguish and consider the uncertainty of the multi-stage forecast, can fully utilize the forecast information, and can reduce the influence of the forecast uncertainty on a real-time dispatching scheme as much as possible, thereby obviously improving the dispatching benefit of the reservoir and having practical value for the forecast dispatching of the reservoir.

title: Behavior recognition method of caged poultry based on neural network and Euclidean distance
description: The invention relates to a method for identifying cage-rearing bird behaviors based on neural network and Euclidean distance, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting original videos of cage-rearing bird behaviors in a farm, extracting a video data set and an image data set from the original videos, wherein each video clip in the video data set corresponds to one bird behavior; secondly, training a target detection network by using an image data set; finally, all frame images contained in each video clip are input into a pre-trained target detection model, and the positions of the head, the trough and the drinking nipple of an individual in the images are detected; calculating the Euclidean distance between the head of the individual and the drinking nipple and the trough, and constructing a Euclidean distance matrix; and inputting the Euclidean distance matrix into a pre-trained classification network to identify the behavior of the poultry. The European distances between the head of the individual and the drinking nipple and between the head of the individual and the trough of the individual are different from each other, so that the image detection and the European distances are combined, and the identification precision is improved.

title: Target Tracking Method Based on Transformer and CNN
description: The invention discloses a target tracking method based on Transformer and CNN, which includes the following steps: according to the initial target position, the target and the search area are cropped; according to the known target, an image augmentation method is used to generate an online template library; Target feature extraction; analyze the target features to obtain the corresponding frame score map; calculate the similarity of the two targets, if the similarity is higher than a certain threshold, output after simple processing; if the similarity is lower than the threshold, judge the cause of missed detection , if only a single network is missed, use the current correct target to update the template library and correct the corresponding network; if two networks are missed at the same time, try to retrieve the target. The invention guarantees the robustness to deformation and fuzzy target tracking; ensures the adaptive force to target scale changes during tracking; ensures the stability of long-term tracking of the target;

title: Vehicle recognition method and system based on multi-sensor decision-level information fusion
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of vehicle type recognition, and provides a vehicle type recognition method and a vehicle type recognition system based on multi-sensor decision-level information fusion. In addition, a vehicle type recognition method of vehicle type appearance size is provided, and vehicle type output results based on size are obtained through information data obtained by a laser radar sensor and a data calculation model. And finally, carrying out comprehensive decision on the vehicle type predicted by each sensor to obtain the final predicted vehicle type. The fusion method solves the recognition problems of similar visual characteristics of vehicles but different sizes, and effectively improves the effectiveness and reliability of vehicle type recognition in a spraying workshop.

title: A kind of expectoration detection method, device and related equipment and storage medium
description: The application discloses a expectoration detection method, a device and related equipment and a storage medium thereof, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image containing a face of a target object; and performing expectoration detection on the target image to obtain an expectoration detection result of the target image, wherein the expectoration detection result of the target image is used for indicating whether the target object in the target image has expectoration. Through the mode, the expectoration detection can be carried out under the condition that the target object is not contacted.

title: A monitoring method, device and system for distribution network
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a monitoring method, a device and a system for a power distribution network, which relate to the field of power distribution and Internet of things, and the monitoring method comprises the following steps: acquiring state information in the power distribution network in real time, wherein the state information is at least one of a state video vector, a state image vector and a state text vector; taking the state information as particles to be brought into a PSO particle swarm algorithm to determine optimal parameters of the particles; bringing the optimal parameters of the particles into a BilSTM model to obtain a key feature set; determining attention degrees of different features in the key feature set by combining an AM algorithm and the BilSTM model; monitoring for faults in the power distribution network based on the attentiveness of the characteristic. The monitoring method improves the accuracy and convergence time of power distribution network monitoring fault positioning, realizes the flow control of the power distribution terminal equipment fault, and reduces the operation risk of the terminal equipment.

title: A method and device for analyzing the test requirement range of a product
description: The application discloses a method and a device for analyzing a test requirement range of a product, which can be applied to the financial field or other fields.
