The method comprises the following steps: constructing a product map according to the product information; acquiring characteristic information and structural information of the product map; training a graph neural network model by using the characteristic information and the structural information to obtain a test requirement range analysis model; and inputting the test requirement to the test requirement range analysis model so as to analyze the product test requirement range. Therefore, clear division of the technical architecture and the whole transaction path of the product is achieved, the effect of accurate coverage of the test requirement range of the product is achieved, and the problems of time and labor waste caused by complex structure or irregular structure of the product of a tester are also reduced.

title: A Surface Anomaly Detection Method Using Adversarial Generative Autoencoder Neural Networks
description: A surface anomaly detection method using an adversarial generative self-encoding neural network, comprising the following steps: using multiple industrial camera groups to collect defect-free images and combining them; importing the defect-free images into an anomaly detection neural network, pre-training, and saving The location information of the false detection defect; finally save the result after eliminating the false detection as the final result of abnormal detection; load the preview of the final result of abnormal detection into the shared memory, and return the inference end signal to the client through Socket. The invention overcomes the deficiencies of the prior art, and realizes efficient and accurate abnormality detection by applying the abnormality detection method combined with the confrontation generation network and the self-encoder in the field of abnormality detection, and through the convolutional neural network and traditional image processing.

title: A Ro-ro Passenger Ship Stowage Optimization Method Based on Improved LHL Algorithm
description: The invention discloses a passenger ship rolling and loading optimization method based on an improved LHL algorithm, which aims at the problem of single-deck loading optimization decision of a passenger ship rolling and loading, and establishes a passenger ship rolling and loading optimization method considering multiple factors on the basis of fully considering the stability safety of a ship, the rated loading capacity of the ship, the safe distance between vehicles and other factors in the loading process in order to ensure the navigation safety of the ship and the safety of loaded vehicles. The method comprehensively considers the influence of various factors on the passenger-rolling ship stowage, obtains the optimal solution with the largest cabin area utilization rate by taking a genetic algorithm as a basic algorithm for sequencing the sea-ferrying vehicles, performs auxiliary decision by using an LHL algorithm, determines the exact position of the vehicle on a cabin deck, and generates a passenger-rolling ship stowage decision scheme. The method can carry out optimization decision on the stowage of the passenger rolling vessel, provides more accurate reference for working personnel of deck scheduling command, and fully utilizes the effective area of the cabin, thereby improving the voyage income and improving the efficiency of the whole working process.

title: A Speckle Image Super-Resolution Reconstruction Method for Laminated Veneer
description: The invention discloses a speckle image super-resolution reconstruction method for veneer laminates, comprising: spraying white primer and black speckle on the surface of veneer laminates in sequence, so that the veneer laminates test specimens Black and white speckles are formed on the surface; continuous collection of multiple original high-definition speckle images of veneer laminate specimens with extended tip cracks caused by external forces; multiple original high-definition speckle images are processed to obtain multiple original high-resolution speckle images Image blocks and low-resolution image blocks; build a residual network model, use the training set to train the residual network model, and obtain a trained residual network model; the invention overcomes the super-resolution image reconstruction of veneer laminates The detail information is lost and the edge is blurred in the image; the dynamic weighting module of the feature map is added to improve the authenticity of the super-resolution image reconstruction of veneer laminates; a new residual network model is adopted to improve the network performance; The super-resolution image of laminated veneer has high precision and high authenticity.

title: Intelligent identification and optimization method for energy absorption structure
description: The invention relates to an intelligent identification and optimization method for an energy-absorbing structure, comprising the following steps: (1) designing an anti-shock energy-absorbing component; (2) constructing a finite element model; (3) researching the equivalent plastic strain of the component; (4) based on fish The optimization process of the group optimization algorithm; (5) Numerical simulation model: through the continuous iteration of the optimization process in step (4), the final calculated rib width x and rib height y are output; the component and the rib edge are bound by the command tie, so as to Simulate actual welding. This method is based on the numerical simulation calculation and analysis of the widely used square pre-folded energy-absorbing components, and uses ABAQUS, MATLAB, PYTHON multi-software and fish swarm optimization algorithm to coordinate the calculation to optimize the structure of the support, and obtain the ribbed area of the energy-absorbing component. , and combined with the energy-absorbing device to improve the anti-shock performance of the energy-absorbing anti-shock hydraulic support in the face of vertical and horizontal shocks.

title: A Modeled Emotion-Aware Dialogue Policy Learning Approach
description: The invention discloses a method for learning an emotion perception dialogue strategy with a model. The method comprises the following steps: performing multi-round interaction between the conversation agent and a human user to obtain real conversation experience, performing data cleaning on the real conversation experience according to a task scene, and training a conversation strategy model; the emotion-aware world model adjusts parameters based on real conversation experience to learn the actions and emotion changes of the user; and (3) performing strategy learning based on simulation experience, and interacting with the emotion-aware world model through a conversation agent to obtain simulation conversation experience and optimize parameters of a conversation strategy model. The method converts the emotion-aware conversation strategy learning from a model-free learning process into a model-based learning process, relieves the dependence of the original method on a user simulator, simultaneously solves the problem of poor simulation performance in the existing deep Dyna-Q learning framework, and improves the training efficiency of the conversation strategy model.

title: Method and electronic device for data federation
description: The present disclosure provides a method and an electronic device for data federation, so as to improve the privacy and security of data for data federation on the basis of realizing data federation. Including: in response to the determination instruction sent by the user for other nodes that need to participate in the data federation, according to the metadata information uploaded by each node in the blockchain to the blockchain, determine other nodes that need to participate in the data federation; The metadata information includes the data attributes and data volume of the local data of the node; upload the federated learning task and the initial training model to the blockchain, so that other nodes participating in the data federation download the initial training model. , using the initial training model to perform federated learning according to the federated learning task; and while the other nodes are trained using the initial model according to the federated learning task, use the initial training model according to the federated learning task Do federated learning.

title: A fine-grained classification method and system for social media topic reviews based on self-attention
description: The invention discloses a self-attention-based fine-grained classification method for social media subject comments, which comprises the following steps of: step a, preprocessing and classifying and labeling the social media theme comment data in a fine-grained manner to obtain a text corpus data set, and vectorizing to obtain a vectorized text corpus data set; b, constructing a classification model based on a multi-head input structural layer, an LSTM layer, a self-attention layer, a regularization layer and a classification output layer, and obtaining a trained classification model through multiple training; and c, preprocessing and vectorizing the social media theme comment data to be classified, inputting the preprocessed and vectorized social media theme comment data into the trained classification model, and outputting to obtain fine-grained classification of the social media theme comment data. The method has the advantage of performing sentiment tendency fine-grained classification on the social media theme comments. The fine-grained classification system based on self-noticed social media topic comments has the advantages of being less in occupied resources and easier to deploy locally.

title: Filter design method and device for neural network assisted implicit spatial mapping
description: A filter design method and device for neural network assisted implicit spatial mapping are disclosed, the method comprises: establishing a rough model; sending the design parameters and the auxiliary parameters into the rough model to obtain response; taking each group of design parameters and the corresponding response thereof as neural network input vectors, and taking the auxiliary variables as neural network output vectors to form training samples; training a neural network by using the training samples; selecting design parameters when optimizing the coarse model to the optimum X     c     1  (ii) a Establishing a fine model and making it design variables X     f     1  = X     c     1  Get a response R     f    ( X     f     1  ) (ii) a Will respond to R     f    ( X     f     1  ) And design ofVariables of X     f     1  Inputting the trained neural network to obtain an auxiliary variable; the auxiliary variables are sent into a rough model, and the design parameters are optimized to be X     c     2  (ii) a Order to X     f     2  = X     c     2  Get a response R     f    ( X     f     2  ) (ii) a And returning to the auxiliary variable acquisition step by using the response of the new accurate model and the design variable until the requirement is met, and if the requirement is not met, continuing to execute. The parameter extraction process in the implicit spatial mapping is simplified through the neural network, and the design efficiency and the design precision are improved.

title: A method and system for sketch image translation without network training
description: The invention discloses a sketch image translation method and a sketch image translation system without network training. The method comprises the following steps: inputting a sketch drawn by a user and automatically normalizing the sketch into an image in a standard form; calculating loss of a sketch structure, image fidelity loss and total loss by using a weighted scoring mechanism; selecting an initial basis vector and a weight of a network sample space; obtaining images of a fitted sketch satisfactory to a user through iteration hidden variables according to a defined training target and a defined training strategy, and temporarily storing n images of recent iteration for the user to select; and the end user selects the image which best meets the self requirement for storage. The invention can use the existing trained GAN to generate the network to obtain better images, thereby reducing the training cost of the network and accelerating the speed of obtaining feedback by users.

title: A kind of feed formula optimization method and system based on pet differentiation analysis
description: The invention provides a pet differential analysis-based feed formula optimization method and system, and relates to the technical field of pet feed optimization processes, a standard pet feed formula is matched based on pet basic information, adjustment is performed according to feeding environment characteristics and pet physiological characteristics to generate a pet feed formula adjustment result, a formula optimization value constraint condition is constructed based on feed component types and feed component proportion intervals, a formula optimization vector space and a feed optimization fitness function are constructed, an initial pet feed formula is optimized based on the formula optimization result, pet feed formula optimization results are generated, and pet feed preparation is performed based on the formula optimization value constraint condition.

title: Method and device for updating trusted model
description: The embodiment of the specification provides a method and a device for updating a credible model. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a newly added sample and a label corresponding to the newly added sample; inputting the newly added sample into the original credible model, and acquiring and storing an output result of the original credible model aiming at the newly added sample as a simulated original label of the newly added sample; a new output layer which has the same structure as the original output layer and is parallel to the original output layer is additionally arranged in the original credible model, and a new credible model is obtained; training a new credible model by using the newly added sample to minimize the difference between the output result of the original output layer aiming at the newly added sample and the simulated original label of the newly added sample, the difference between the output result of the new output layer aiming at the newly added sample and the label corresponding to the newly added sample, and the difference between the output result of the new output layer aiming at the newly added sample and the simulated original label of the newly added sample; and removing the original output layer from the new credible model obtained after the training is finished to obtain an updated credible model.

title: A logarithmic asymmetric modification design method for the main drive bearing roller of a large roadheader
description: The invention belongs to the field of multi-parameter optimization and reliability design of a main drive bearing of a large-scale tunneling machine, and discloses a logarithmic asymmetry modification design method of a main drive bearing roller of the large-scale tunneling machine. According to the method, a contact mechanics model based on roller logarithmic asymmetry modification under the eccentric load action of a main drive bearing of the large-scale tunneling machine is established, the load distribution condition of each row of rollers of the bearing is determined, a fatigue life calculation model of the bearing is further established, and the logarithmic asymmetry modification curve is optimized and designed through establishing an optimization model, so that the optimal parameters under the action of the eccentric load are obtained, the contact stress in the length direction of the rollers is uniformly distributed, and the excessive stress in the middle of the rollers caused by the excessive modification quantity is avoided. The method can flexibly calculate the optimal logarithmic asymmetry modification curve of the roller under different working condition loads, thereby meeting the requirements of high reliability and long service life of the bearing.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle assisted edge unloading decision method based on deep reinforcement learning
description: A UAV-assisted edge offloading decision-making method based on deep reinforcement learning, including the following steps: setting S static edge servers and N  UAVs  carrying storage devices; It arrives in a loose distribution, and is unloaded to the server with a certain probability p  i,t  for processing, and the rest is processed by the UAV; an optimization problem model with the optimization goal of minimizing task completion time and computing task cost is established, and adopts The deep reinforcement learning method is used to solve this problem, and the optimal number of drones is allocated and the unloading scheme between the server and the drone is obtained. The present invention is suitable for mobile edge computing system scenarios where server computing tasks are unbalanced, and can reasonably deploy drones and formulate appropriate unloading decisions according to the computing task load of the edge server.

title: A Model Heterogeneous Federated Learning Method and System
description: The invention provides a model isomerism federal learning method, which comprises the following steps: s1: uploading the independently designed and trained local models to a central server by each client; s2: inputting each local model into an allosteric feature generator to generate an allosteric feature at a central server; s3: cooperatively updating each local model by using the generated allosteric characteristics; s4: and returning the updated local model to each client. The invention also provides a model isomerism federated learning system which is used for realizing the model isomerism federated learning method. The invention provides a method and a system for federal learning of model isomerism, which solve the problem that the existing federal learning method has poor aggregation effect under the actual condition of model isomerism.

title: Safety monitoring system and method for thermal power plant
description: The application provides a safety monitoring system and a method of a thermal power plant, wherein the system comprises a monitoring sensing layer, an intelligent analysis layer and a study and judgment decision layer, wherein the monitoring sensing layer is communicated with the intelligent analysis layer through a network and used for acquiring all safety related data of the thermal power plant and sending the safety related data to the intelligent analysis layer, the intelligent analysis layer is used for receiving and storing the safety related data, and carrying out safety screening on the safety related data based on a safety threshold corresponding to the safety related data, the study and judgment decision layer is communicated with the intelligent analysis layer through the network and used for carrying out a safety screening result of the safety screening according to the received safety related data and generating a monitoring instruction corresponding to the safety screening result so as to regulate and control the thermal power plant, therefore, the thermal power plant is regulated and controlled based on the safety related data of the thermal power plant, all-round monitoring of the thermal power plant is realized, and the accuracy of the safety monitoring of the thermal power plant is improved.

title: An Energy Consumption Monitoring Platform Using Distributed Data Processing
description: The invention provides an energy consumption supervision platform adopting distributed data processing, and relates to the field of energy consumption monitoring. The method comprises a software architecture, a hardware architecture, deployment and data security, and is characterized in that: the software architecture comprises a hardware layer, a data transmission layer, a data processing layer, a system application layer and a system management layer, wherein the hardware architecture and the deployment comprise traditional machine room deployment, cloud deployment, interfaces with other platforms and interfaces between terminal devices. The energy consumption monitoring system is not limited to primary functions of data acquisition, summarization, display and the like, technically, on the basis of large amount of data acquisition, prediction analysis and machine learning are executed by means of artificial intelligence, different variable parameters are input by professionals, and an energy consumption diagnosis report is formed, so that the professionals can quickly know energy consumption conditions of all parts, the application range of the energy consumption supervision platform is further enlarged, and the energy consumption supervision platform can supervise various fields.

title: Data collection procedures and model training
description: In wireless communication systems, user equipment (UE) vendors and network entity vendors may configure one or more UEs and network entities to perform data collection and train channel state information (CSI) feedback (CSF) models.

title: Multimode couplers for quantum gates
description: Techniques and couplers for managing coupling between qubits are presented. The coupler can be connected between a first qubit and a second qubit. The coupler can include three Josephson junctions (JJs). The first and second JJs can be symmetric, which facilitates the creation of a first mode of oscillation and a second mode of oscillation opposite to the first mode. The third JJ facilitates splitting between the first and second modes. The activation status of a ZZ gate between the first and second qubits can be controlled based on the excitation status of the first mode and the relationship between the first and second modes, where the excitation status is based on whether a pulse is applied to the coupler. When no pulse is applied, the ZZ gate is inactive and no coupling exists. When a pulse is applied, the first mode is excited, the ZZ gate is activated, and coupling exists between the qubits.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, and information processing program
description: [Problem] To estimate a suitable modification strategy for generating desired output information. [Solution] The information processing device according to the present invention comprises an estimation unit and a determination unit. The estimation unit estimates a modification strategy for a learning model to generate desired output information, based on sparse features obtained by transforming features output by a predetermined layer of the learning model when predetermined input information is input, for a learning model that has been trained to generate an answer to a question input as output information. The sparse features indicate a generation strategy for the learning model to generate output information corresponding to the predetermined input information. The determination unit determines a correction value for modifying the sparse features based on the sparse features and the modification strategy. [Selected Figure] Figure 5

title: Communication method and communication device
description: The present application provides a communication method and a communication device for use in a scenario in which AI is integrated into a wireless network, particularly in a scenario in which an AI model for beam management is integrated into a wireless network. According to the method provided in the present application, a network device transmits reference signal resource configuration information to a terminal device, the reference signal resource configuration information including instruction information indicating the purpose of the reference signal resource, so that the terminal device can identify the purpose of the reference signal resource based on the instruction information to prevent the terminal device from using the reference signal resource for other purposes. For example, if the instruction information indicates that the reference signal resource is for performing a first operation based on an AI model, the terminal device can prevent the terminal device from using the reference signal resource for a non-AI model-based operation. This ensures the performance of the AI model and avoids resource waste.

title: A face recognition method and system based on lightweight network structure design
description: The invention discloses a face recognition method and system based on lightweight network structure design. Firstly, processing an acquired image to acquire a face image; then, preprocessing the obtained face image to obtain a processed face image and a mirror image thereof; then, inputting the face image and the mirror image thereof into the trained face recognition model to obtain the face characteristics; and finally, carrying out similarity measurement on the human face features and the features in the human face feature library one by one to obtain a human face recognition result. The invention uses the light-weighted structural design of the depth separable convolution, the bottleneck layer and the down-sampling layer on the design of the face recognition model structure, and reduces the parameter and the calculated amount of the network. Compared with most of the existing face recognition methods using large convolutional neural networks, the face recognition method provided by the invention has fundamental advantages in the deployment of mobile equipment and embedded equipment.

title: A target detection method fused with a lightweight attention model
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of target detection in computer vision, and relates to a target detection method integrating a lightweight attention model. The present invention proposes corresponding solutions for the two problems in target detection. One is to solve the problem of a large amount of parameters in the attention model and propose to aggregate channel and spatial context features respectively through one-dimensional convolution and hole convolution, which significantly reduces the the parameters of the model. The second is to select a suitable location in YOLOv4 to inject the lightweight attention model, which significantly improves the performance of YOLOv4.

title: Method and device for recognizing image orientation and recognizing nameplate characters
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for recognizing image direction and nameplate characters. The method includes: receiving an image sent by an image acquisition device; cropping the image into multiple window images; predicting the orientation of each window image in the multiple window images; and determining the orientation of the image according to the orientation of each window image through a voting algorithm. Through this method, the angle recognition accuracy of the image can be made higher.

title: System for real-time probablistic resource management
description: A system providing a real-time probabilistic prediction mechanism is described herein that is adapted to the address probabilistic implementations. The described mechanism provides a better balance between the tradeoffs of accuracy versus computational resources than the prior art, which makes it suitable for real-time applications, and in some cases offers a simpler path to implementation as well. In one exemplary approach, the real-time probabilistic prediction mechanism is implemented as a system for real-time resource management.

title: Generating Predilection Cohorts
description: A computer implemented method, apparatus, and computer program product for generating risk scores for specific risk cohorts. Digital sensor data associated with a specific risk cohort is received from a set of multimodal sensors. The specific risk cohort includes a set of identified cohort members. The digital sensor data includes metadata describing attributes associated with at least one cohort member in the set of identified cohort members. Description data for each cohort member in the set of identified cohort members is retrieved to form a set of cohort description data. The description data for each cohort member comprises data describing a previous history of the cohort member or a current status of the cohort member. The cohort member is a person, animal, plant, thing, or location. A specific risk score is generated for the specific risk cohort based on selected risk factors, the attributes associated with the at least one identified member, and the set of cohort description data. A response action is initiated in response to a determination that the specific risk score exceeds a risk threshold.

title: Matching apparatus and non-transitory computer readable storage medium
description: The matching apparatus  100  stores, with respect to a branching pattern included in event patterns  140   a , a reception time of an event that serves as the branching point in a source node that indicates the transition destination of the event, connects the source node to the branch node by a transition with an interval condition, connects the branch nodes to the link node that indicates the linking point at which these branch nodes are linked together, and thereby generates NFAs  140   b . Then, the matching apparatus  100  compares event streams  140   c  with the NFAs  140   b  to determine whether the event streams  140   c  includes the event patterns  140   a.

title: Data processing method, device and electronic equipment
description: The embodiments of this specification provide a data processing method, device and electronic equipment. The method includes: determining the value of the split condition in the split condition set according to the business data to obtain the value set; using random numbers to encrypt the values in the value set to obtain the value ciphertext set; The value ciphertext set is the input and the model party cooperates to execute the security data selection algorithm; the random number is used as the input to cooperate with the model party to execute the multi-party security calculation algorithm, so that the model party and/or the data party can obtain the prediction results of the decision forest.

title: Image quality improvement method and image processing apparatus using the same
description: An image quality improvement method and an image processing apparatus using the same are provided. Denoise filtering is performed on an original image by using a filter to obtain a preliminary processing image. The preliminary processing image is inputted in to a multi-stage convolution network model to generate a optimization image through the multi-stage convolution network model. The multi-stage convolution network model includes a plurality of convolution network sub-models, and the convolution network sub-models are respectively corresponding to the different network architectures.

title: Method of operating a neural network device, a method of operating an application processor and a computing device
description: A method of operating a neural network device configured to perform a neural network operation on successively input image frames includes generating, by a processing circuit, a second delta feature map by performing a linear operation on a first delta feature map generated based on a difference between a current image frame and a previous image frame; loading feature values as a second previous feature map onto the processing circuit from at least one memory, the loaded feature values being feature values corresponding to a first partial region to be updated in a first feature map stored in the at least one memory; generating, at the processing circuit, a second current feature map based on the second delta feature map and the second previous feature map; and updating the first feature map by storing the second current feature map in the at least one memory.

title: Methods and apparatuses of contrastive learning for color constancy
description:
A contrastive learning method for color constancy employs a fully-supervised construction of contrastive pairs, driven by a novel data augmentation. The contrastive learning method includes receiving two training images, constructing positive and negative contrastive pairs by the novel data augmentation, extracting representations by a feature extraction function, and training a color constancy model by contrastive learning representations in the positive contrastive pair are closer than representations in the negative contrastive pair. The positive contrastive pair contains images having an identical illuminant while negative contrastive pair contains images having different illuminants. The contrastive learning method improves the 
performance without additional computational costs. The desired contrastive pairs allow the color constancy model to learn better illuminant feature that are particular robust to worse-cases in data sparse regions.

title: System and method of overlay measurement
description:
A metrology system includes one or more through-focus imaging metrology sub-systems communicatively coupled to a controller having one or more processors configured receive a plurality of training images captured at one or more focal positions. The one or more processors may generate a machine learning classifier based on the plurality of training images. The one or more processors may receive one or more 
target feature selections for one or more target overlay measurements corresponding to one or more target features. The one or more processors may determine one or more target focal positions based on the one or more target feature selections using the machine learning classifier. The one or more processors may receive one or more target images captured at the one or more target focal positions, the target images including the one or more target features of the target specimen, and determine overlay based thereon.

title: Data maintenance and driving support system, elevation reliability judgment system and method
description: An elevation reliability judgment system that appropriately determines the reliability of an estimated elevation as the estimated elevation reliability irrespective of the attribute of an area where a road is paved, comprising: a map information acquisition unit that acquires map information including road information and background information The elevation information acquisition part divides the map displayed by the map information into a plurality of unit areas with a predetermined area, and obtains the elevation information showing the elevation of each unit area; The estimated elevation of each reference point among the plurality of reference points set by the road; the reliability determination unit determines the reliability of the estimated elevation as the estimated elevation reliability; the reliability determination unit determines the location based on the background information of each reference point At least one of the background category data and the road width data in the road information determines the reliability of the estimated elevation of each reference point.

title: Method and device for controlling a visual aid
description: For each pixel in the pixel matrix, the input signal (f) representing the scene to be viewed comprises an event-based asynchronous signal sequence derived from light variations associated with pixels within the scene. This input signal is spatially transformed within the pixel matrix and temporally along the signal sequence to generate individual control signals (S) for the pixel regions of the assistive device (20).

title: Method and apparatus for automatically summarizing contents of electronic documents
description: One embodiment of a method for summarizing an electronic document includes segmenting the electronic document into a plurality of terms, wherein each of the plurality of terms is associated with a respective length, a respective informativeness score, and a respective consistency score; automatically selecting a subset of the plurality of terms such that an aggregate informativeness score of the subset is maximized and an aggregate length of the subset is less than or equal to a maximum length; and arranging the subset as a summary of the electronic document.

title: Beach tourist safety accident prediction method based on large language model GPT-4
description: The present invention relates to a beach visitor safety accident prediction method based on a large language model GPT-4. The beach visitor safety accident database is used to select characteristic factors related to beach visitor safety, and the support vector machine (SVM) and BP (Back-propagation) neural network are trained and the model performance is evaluated by using Bayesian optimization; after creating a personal GPT in GPT-4, the trained model is output as a pkl file and uploaded to the GPT database to generate a GPT for users to directly input relevant factors to predict the beach risk level. The present invention relies on a large language model. Users only need to input characteristic factor information such as effective wave height, temperature, wave direction, wave period, etc. to the personal GPT created by the method, and the beach risk level fed back by the GPT can be obtained and appropriate suggestions can be given. It has the characteristics of flexible input information and good interactivity with users.

title: Environmental monitoring method and environmental monitoring system
description: The purpose of the present invention is to provide an environmental monitoring method and an environmental monitoring system, aiming to solve the problems existing in the existing environmental monitoring technology in terms of monitoring efficiency and accuracy. The method and system utilize advanced sensing technology, data processing algorithms and cloud computing technology to monitor and analyze environmental parameters in real time and provide effective environmental monitoring means.

title: Prediction method and prediction device for high-speed shaft temperature of wind turbine generator
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of wind power generation, and discloses a prediction method and prediction device for the high-speed shaft temperature of a wind turbine set, wherein the prediction method comprises the following steps: a wind power SCADA system collects unit data and cleans the unit data to obtain monitoring data; an improved hybrid deep learning model is established based on a CNN-LSTM network model; the prediction data of the high-speed shaft temperature of the wind turbine set is output using the improved hybrid deep learning model; the improved hybrid deep learning model established based on the CNN-LSTM network model comprises: using a black-winged kite optimization algorithm to optimize the parameters of the CNN-LSTM network model to obtain an improved hybrid deep learning model. The present invention adopts a deep learning hybrid model CNN-LSTM to extract spatial and temporal features, and then predicts the high-speed shaft temperature of a gearbox, and adopts BKA to improve the selection of network model hyperparameters, thereby reducing the noise points of the original data in the prediction of the high-speed shaft temperature of the gearbox and improving the prediction accuracy.

title: Robotic device and expression method of robotic device
description: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a robotic device and an expression method of the robotic device which makes expression according to complicated and various emotions or states of instinct and motion, such as important information realizing smooth communication with a human by highly efficiently using limited resources.  <P>SOLUTION: This robotic device expresses a plurality of states such as emotional states and sense perception states by a light emitting device mounted on a position equivalent to the eyes in the head part of a bipedal human type robotic device. The light emitting device is provided with hues, saturations, and light emission patterns as expression units showing mutually independent orthogonal expressions. The plurality of orthogonal states, namely for example, the emotional states and the sense perception states are simultaneously expressed using a plurality of orthogonal expressions of the light emitting device, which are linked by a link means linking the plurality of mutually orthogonal states based on own internal states and external stimuli with, at least, a single expression unit.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2004,JPO&NCIPI

title: Systems and techniques for predictive data analysis
description: Systems and techniques for data analysis are provided.   A method for selecting a prediction model for a prediction problem determines the suitability of a prediction modeling procedure for a prediction problem based on characteristics of the prediction problem and / or attributes of each modeling procedure. judge. A subset of the predictive modeling procedure is selected based on the determined suitability of the selected modeling procedure for the prediction problem. A resource allocation schedule that allocates computational resources for execution of the selected modeling procedure is generated based on the determined suitability of the selected modeling procedure for the prediction problem. Get the result of executing the selected modeling procedure according to the resource allocation schedule. A prediction model for the prediction problem is selected based on these results.   [Selection] Figure 3

title: System and method for collecting clinical trial data based on block-chain
description: Provided is a method and system for collecting clinical trial data based on blockchain, and the method of collecting clinical trial data based on blockchain includes the steps of: receiving the clinical trial data from a researcher terminal; requesting verification of the received clinical trial data from a verification node; performing consensus verification on a verification result when the verification result according to the verification request is received from the verification node; and propagating the clinical trial data to the verification node according to a result of the consensus verification, performed by a platform.

title: Neural hardware accelerator for parallel and distributed tensor computations
description: Networks and encodings therefor are provided that are adapted to provide increased energy efficiency and speed for convolutional operations. In various embodiments, a neural network comprises a plurality of neural cores. Each of the plurality of neural cores comprises a memory. A network interconnects the plurality of neural cores. The memory of each of the plurality of neural cores comprises at least a portion of a weight tensor. The weight tensor comprising a plurality of weights. Each neural core is adapted to retrieve locally or receive a portion of an input image, apply the portion of the weight tensor thereto, and store locally or send a result therefrom via the network to other of the plurality of neural cores.

title: In-call experience enhancement for assistant systems
description: In one embodiment, a method includes establishing a video call between a plurality of client systems, wherein access to an assistant system is persistently maintained during the video call, receiving, from a first client system of the plurality of client systems, a request by a first user to be performed by the assistant system during the video call, wherein the request references one or more activities associated with one or more users associated with the plurality of client systems, analyzing, by a context engine of the assistant system, images of a scene of the video call to identify the one or more activities within the scene, instructing the assistant system to execute the request based on the identified one or more activities, and sending, to one or more of the plurality of client systems, a response to the request while maintaining the video call between the plurality of client systems.

title: Energy demand forecasting and sustainable energy management using machine learning
description: Aspects of the present disclosure provide systems, methods, and computer-readable storage media that leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning (ML) to forecast energy demand and to generate an energy plan for one or more facilities of an organization. For example, a system may forecast an occupancy of the facilities for use with historical demand data in forecasting the energy demand. The forecasting may be performed by one or more trained ML models. Additional ML models may be trained to select energy resources that satisfy the forecasted energy demand and that prioritize constraint(s). The system may generate an energy plan that indicates information related to the selected energy resources, such as cost, energy type, environmental impact, etc., for use in increasing an amount of renewable energy resources used at the facilities. In some implementations, the system may recommend actions to reduce a negative environmental impact associated with the selected energy resources.

title: Artificial intelligence determination of building smoke and indoor air quality management
description: Methods and apparatus operative to quantify building metrics using artificial intelligence analysis of a design plan and apply the quantified building metrics to smoke control practices. A design plan is represented using multiple dynamic components. Each dynamic component may include a parameter changeable via the user interactive interface. The dynamic components may be arranged in a user interactive interface to form a first set of boundaries, including a respective length and area, and defining at least a portion of a first unit. AI may determine a longest path of egress and a supportable occupancy load that may be used to determine compliance with parameters of a given code. The AI may assess whether a building described in the design plans complies with a relevant code set forth by an authority having jurisdiction. Codes may include, for example, codes relating to smoke control and fire safety.

title: Display device and operating method of the same
description: A display device for performing image processing by using a neural network including a plurality of layers, may obtain a plurality of pieces of model information respectively corresponding to pixels included in a first image based on object features respectively corresponding to the pixels; identify the plurality of pieces of model information respectively corresponding to the plurality of layers and the pixels input to the neural network based on information about a time point at which each of the pixels is processed in the neural network; update parameters of the plurality of layers, based on the plurality of pieces of model information; and obtain a second image by processing the first image via the plurality of layers to which the updated parameters are applied; and display the second image.

title: Adaptive optimization with improved convergence
description: Generally, the present disclosure is directed to systems and methods that perform adaptive optimization with improved convergence properties. The adaptive optimization techniques described herein are useful in various optimization scenarios, including, for example, training a machine-learned model such as, for example, a neural network. In particular, according to one aspect of the present disclosure, a system implementing the adaptive optimization technique can, over a plurality of iterations, employ an adaptive learning rate while also ensuring that the learning rate is non-increasing.

title: Systems and methods for updating email addresses based on email generation patterns
description: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for updating email addresses based on email generation patterns. The method includes accessing a plurality of electronic activities used to update a plurality of member node profiles. The method includes determining that the plurality of member node profiles is linked to a group node profile of a group entity. The methods includes identifying, for each of the plurality of member node profiles, a first field-value pair of the member node profile corresponding to an email address. The method includes determining, for each member node profile, a correlation between the email address, a second field-value pair corresponding to a first name and a third field-value pair corresponding to a last name. The method includes determining, based on the determined correlation, an electronic account identifier pattern. The method includes storing an association between the group node and the electronic account identifier pattern.

title: Damage detection apparatus and method
description: The present disclosure provides an apparatus and method to automatically detect vehicle damage which minimises the time taken to detect damage per vehicle. For example, the action of damage detection is also performed with an action of causing the fixing of any detected damage, where appropriate. A damage detection unit is configured and arranged to detect damage on a vehicle. The damage detection unit includes a receiving unit arranged to receive an image from a camera and a determining unit arranged to determine damage on the vehicle based on the received image. Moreover, the damage detection unit includes a storing unit arranged to store information about damage previously determined to be present on the vehicle and a comparing unit arranged to compare the damage determined by the determining unit with the information about previous damage as stored by the storing unit.

title: Spatially aware computing hub and environment
description: Aspects of the disclosure provide for a sensory augmentation system. In some examples, the sensory augmentation system includes a first electro-tactile stimulator comprising at least one user interaction element driven by a driver and contactable to a human body to provide stimulation having a first stimulation waveform and a signal generation and sensing processor configured to receive data corresponding to information to be communicated to the user. The signal generation and sensing processor may generate a first instruction to the driver, the first instruction corresponding to the first stimulation waveform. The driver may generate the stimulation having the first stimulation waveform in response to the first instruction.

title: Customization of gui layout based on history of use
description: A hand-held electronic device, method of operation and computer readable medium are disclosed. The device may include a processor is operably coupled to a visual display and touch screen. Instructions executable by the processor may be configured to a) present an image on the visual display containing one or more active elements; b) correlate one or more active portions of the touch interface to one or more corresponding active elements in the image on the visual display; and c) adjust a layout of content shown on the display according to a probability of one or more actions that may be taken with the one or more active elements.

title: Training function generating device, training function generating method, and feature vector classifying method using the same
description: Provided is a training function generating method. The method includes: receiving training vectors; calculating a training function from the training vectors; comparing a classification performance of the calculated training function with a predetermined classification performance and recalculating a training function on the basis of a comparison result, wherein the recalculating of the training function includes: changing a priority between a false alarm probability and a miss detection probability of the calculated training function; and recalculating a training function according to the changed priority.

title: Learning method of neural network circuit
description: A neuron circuit in a neural network circuit element includes a waveform generating circuit for generating a predetermined pulse voltage, and a first input signal has a waveform of the predetermined pulse voltage. For a period having a predetermined duration of the predetermined pulse voltage generated within the neural network circuit element including the variable resistance element which is applied with the first input signal from another neural network circuit element, the first input signal is permitted to be input to the control electrode of the variable resistance element, to change the resistance value of the variable resistance element due to an electric potential difference generated between the first electrode and the control electrode which occurs depending on an input timing of the first input signal with respect to the period during which the first input signal is permitted to be input to the control electrode.

title: Model calculation method and device
description: The embodiment of the present invention provides a model calculation method and device. The method includes: dividing the target model into N parts according to modules and deploying them on a computing unit, where N is less than or equal to the number of computing units included in the electronic device; wherein at least one part is deployed on a computing unit, and each part includes at least one module; inputting the input sequence of the first target task into the target model, so that each part of the target model uses the computing unit where it is located to calculate the input it receives; wherein the input received by the latter part includes the output of the previous part, and the input received by the first part includes the input sequence of the first target task. The embodiment of the present invention can run a large language model on multiple computing units, and at the same time can greatly improve the computing resource utilization of the computing unit, and improve the efficiency of the large language model in executing the target task.

title: MADDPG algorithm-based electricity generation alliance electricity-carbon-green market bidding decision method
description: The application discloses a power generation alliance electricity-carbon-green certificate market bidding decision method based on MADDPG algorithm. The power generation alliance comprises a renewable energy unit and a conventional thermal power unit, and the market also comprises a conventional thermal power generation main body and a wind-solar new energy generation main body. The method comprises the steps of constructing a quotation decision model of each market subject participating in an electricity-carbon-green evidence market based on sales income of each market subject in the electricity-carbon-green evidence market, taking the quotation decision model as a decision model, respectively taking the electricity purchasing cost of the electricity market as a minimum, the welfare of the carbon market as a maximum and taking the welfare of the green evidence market as a target, constructing a daily clearing model, a carbon market clearing model and a green evidence market clearing model of the electricity market as a coupling clearing model, taking the decision model as an upper model and taking the coupling clearing model as a lower model, constructing a double-layer coupling transaction model, solving the double-layer coupling transaction model by adopting MADDPG algorithm, and determining the medium price, the medium scalar and the total income of each market subject in the electricity market, the carbon market and the green evidence market.

title: Large-model-based power communication construction drawing information extraction method and system
description: The application discloses a large-model-based power communication construction drawing information extraction method and system, comprising the steps of obtaining an image of a power communication construction drawing to be identified and preprocessing the image; the method comprises the steps of carrying out text recognition on a pre-processed construction drawing image by using a constructed and trained CRNN model, carrying out post-processing on the recognized text, converting the post-processed text into supervision instruction data, carrying out fine adjustment on a large model based on the supervision instruction data to obtain a fine-adjusted large model, and carrying out key information extraction on the text recognized based on the CRNN model by using the fine-adjusted large model. According to the application, the large model is finely adjusted, and the computer vision technology is combined, so that the automatic and high-precision identification of key information in the power communication construction drawing is realized, and the identification accuracy and efficiency are improved.

title: Artificial intelligent medicine interactive personalized consultation robot and identification system
description: The present invention discloses an artificial intelligence interactive personalized drug consultation robot and recognition system, which realizes the real-time integration of patient medication data by connecting to the hospital HIS database and the pharmacy system. The system adopts multi-mode interaction technology, combined with a new dynamic knowledge base, to provide comprehensive and personalized, as well as visual and audible medication consultation solutions, which helps to improve the overall medical service efficiency, reduce queuing for consultation, facilitate and quickly obtain information, enhance the correct understanding and use of drugs, and ensure targeted and rational use of drugs.

title: Intelligent fire-fighting system and method for energy storage cabinet suitable for distributed architecture, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting system and method for an energy storage cabinet suitable for a distributed architecture, wherein the intelligent fire-fighting system for the energy storage cabinet suitable for the distributed architecture comprises an environment-aware flame smoke detection module, an environment temperature and key position monitoring module, a control module and a fire-extinguishing execution module; when the detection or/and monitoring data of the environment-aware flame smoke detection module or/and the environment temperature and the key position monitoring module reach a preset threshold or abnormal condition, the control module sends a control instruction to the fire extinguishing execution module, and the fire extinguishing execution module executes fire extinguishing actions. The intelligent fire-fighting system for the energy storage cabinet, which is suitable for the distributed architecture, can improve the safety and reliability of the energy storage cabinet and reduce the resource waste and potential economic loss caused by false alarm.

title: Multi-intelligent system based on large language model
description: The invention discloses a multi-agent system based on a large language model, which is used for solving a travel planning task and comprises a plurality of agents, wherein each agent is responsible for different travel planning subtasks, and the agents work cooperatively through a structured communication protocol and share information with each other to generate a final travel scheme. The intelligent agents comprise a demand analyzer intelligent agent, a travel designer intelligent agent, a budget planner intelligent agent, a risk assessment intelligent agent and an optimization coordinator intelligent agent, and the intelligent agents complete corresponding tasks according to role division and exchange information through a structured report.

title: Non-contact intelligent transmission system and method for electric power data
description: The present invention relates to the field of power data transmission, and discloses a contactless intelligent transmission system and method for power data. The system includes: an optical acquisition module, which is used to obtain display data of a smart meter and convert it into an optical signal; a multi-wavelength optical transmission module, which adopts a multi-wavelength encoding method to modulate and transmit data; an optical path dynamic adjustment module, which monitors the optical signal path through a laser adjustable lens and an AI visual recognition system, and dynamically adjusts the direction of the light beam; an intelligent light beam tracking system, which detects the light beam state in combination with a laser feedback control algorithm and adjusts the transmission path of the optical signal; a hybrid transmission module, which switches to a wireless communication method for data compensation transmission when the optical signal is interfered with; a data processing and error correction module, which adopts a deep learning signal enhancement algorithm to optimize signal quality, and performs data correction based on an adaptive error detection and correction algorithm to improve data accuracy.

title: High-precision real-time tracking method for small unmanned aerial vehicle
description: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and particularly discloses a high-precision real-time tracking method of a small unmanned aerial vehicle, which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-mode sensor array through a millimeter wave radar, a binocular vision module and an infrared thermal imager, wherein the multi-mode sensor array is used for acquiring three-dimensional motion data of a target object in real time; the invention can effectively challenge illumination change, target shielding and the like through the cooperative work of the millimeter wave radar, the binocular vision module and the infrared thermal imager, collect three-dimensional motion data of a target object in real time, and improve the accuracy of target positioning and tracking. Meanwhile, the Kalman filtering algorithm is improved to be combined with a convolution attention mechanism, so that the weight of the sensor can be dynamically adjusted, and the motion track prediction error is compensated.

title: A food safety data traceability method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a food safety data tracing method. The method comprises the steps of taking a production chain of food as one item, constructing a hierarchical clustering tree, classifying leaf nodes in the hierarchical clustering tree to construct a category number sequence corresponding to each item, comparing adjacent elements in the category number sequence to obtain category expansion degree, determining the center of the item according to the same condition of the item and other items in the corresponding category sequence, determining the similarity of the production chain of the item by combining the category expansion degree and the center, determining the self-adaptive support degree corresponding to each item by combining the similarity of the production chain of the item and the occurrence frequency of the item, and constructing an FP tree corresponding to the production chain of the food according to the self-adaptive support degree corresponding to each item. According to the invention, the support degree of the FP tree is adaptively adjusted, so that the tracing accuracy of food is improved.

title: Domain adaptive semantic segmentation method based on domain unbiased self-training under image language supervision
description: A domain-adaptive semantic segmentation method based on domain-unbiased self-training under image-language supervision, comprising: constructing and training debiasing training frameworks for image and language domains; constructing and training debiasing training frameworks for frequency domains; constructing multiple supervised domain-adaptive semantic segmentation models according to the debiasing training frameworks for image and language domains and the debiasing training frameworks for frequency domains; inputting the image to be segmented into the trained multiple supervised domain-adaptive semantic segmentation models to obtain semantic segmentation results. The present invention distills the domain-unbiased information in the image encoder and text encoder of a large language vision model into the segmentation model, improves the migration effect, alleviates the systematic errors that cannot be handled in the scene to a certain extent, and alleviates the domain bias of unsupervised domain adaptation by using the image encoder and text encoder of the visual language model, thereby improving the distillation quality of the image encoder.

title: Product design generation method, system, device and medium
description: The invention provides a product design generation method, system, equipment and medium based on a knowledge graph and a meristem graph model, which are used for receiving an object input by a user and converting the input object into a root node of the knowledge graph to be constructed, constructing the knowledge graph based on the root node, extracting attribute values of leaf nodes in the knowledge graph, expanding the attribute values through a large language model to generate an image generation prompt word, and generating a design corresponding to the object through the meristem graph model based on the image generation prompt word. By combining the knowledge graph with the depth of the draft graph model, the problem that the traditional AI generation method only depends on a single prompt word and lacks systematic creative expansion capability is solved, so that the design generation process is hierarchical, logical and controllable. And the automatic creative divergence is supported, the knowledge graph is combined, the high-quality and controllable prompt words are dynamically generated, and the user is supported to automatically generate new design schemes at different levels, so that inspiration exploration is more efficient.

title: Nutritional management strategy recommendation method and system for ICU (information and communication unit) surviving stroke postoperative rehabilitation patient
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for recommending nutritional management strategies for postoperative rehabilitation patients who survived stroke in ICU, which relates to the fields of medical health and artificial intelligence technology, including: obtaining basic physiological indicators, existing examination data and drug use records of postoperative rehabilitation patients who survived stroke in ICU according to medical records, obtaining corresponding text feature representations through pre-training models after data preprocessing, calling domain knowledge graphs to enhance knowledge of feature representations, and constructing multidimensional nutritional health features; using graph convolutional neural networks to learn and represent the corresponding graph structures of multidimensional nutritional health features, extracting nutritional health portraits of patients, and evaluating the nutritional health status of patients; extracting personalized nutritional management strategies based on the evaluation results of the nutritional health status of patients for recommendation. The present invention realizes accurate evaluation of the nutritional health status of rehabilitation patients based on existing examination data combined with massive rehabilitation nutritional management knowledge, and provides accurate and personalized nutritional management solutions.

title: Battery energy coupling optimization method, system, storage medium and computer
description: The application provides a battery energy coupling optimization method, a system, a storage medium and a computer, wherein the optimization method comprises the steps of obtaining current driving data of a vehicle, preprocessing the driving data at least comprising driving data of the vehicle, battery state data and driving environment data, inputting the preprocessed driving data into a feature extraction model for analysis feature extraction, sorting the importance of each extracted analysis feature based on a self-attention mechanism, and carrying out weight adjustment on each analysis feature according to an importance sorting result, wherein the importance of the analysis feature represents the influence degree of the analysis feature on energy management decision, and inputting the analysis feature after weight adjustment into a decision tree model for energy coupling analysis so as to adjust the energy output and recovery of the battery according to the current driving state. The battery energy coupling optimization method provided by the application has the advantages of high energy recovery and flexible adjustment mode.

title: Multi-scale intelligent load prediction and dynamic visual display method and platform
description: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, and discloses a multi-scale intelligent load prediction and dynamic visual display method and a platform, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a prediction period and dynamically adjusting the prediction period; the method comprises the steps of analyzing space-time dependence of a power grid area by utilizing a space-time diagram neural network model, determining a combined prediction model according to an adjusted prediction period, dynamically adjusting weights of the prediction models based on reinforcement learning and quantum heuristic optimization technology, carrying out intelligent load prediction by utilizing the combined prediction model, fusing prediction results to obtain final prediction results, and carrying out decision analysis and visual display. According to the invention, the prediction and weighted fusion results are combined through integrating a plurality of algorithms, so that accurate and comprehensive load prediction service is provided for users, and the prediction results are displayed in real time through a dynamic visualization platform combining a real-time prediction panel, historical trend analysis, algorithm comparison optimization and decision support report.

title: A multi-source data fusion and intelligent analysis method for smart transportation enterprises
description: The invention discloses a multisource data fusion and intelligent analysis method for intelligent transportation enterprises, which relates to the technical field of intelligent transportation, and comprises the following specific steps: S100 collects video frame data, radar track data and voiceprint data of traffic enterprises in real time, S200 calculates quantized video definition scores, S300 calculates radar signal to noise ratios, S400 calculates voiceprint environment interference indexes, S500, weight distribution and data fusion, the invention can accurately judge video, radar and voiceprint data quality through multi-mode data quality real-time evaluation and reliability quantization, under a complex environment, a cross-modal attention weight matrix is dynamically adjusted according to a quality evaluation result, namely when the video quality is reduced, the system automatically increases the radar data weight, so that the key information of a high-quality data source is always focused, more accurate and comprehensive abnormal characteristics are learned, the occurrence rate of traffic accidents is effectively reduced, and the road traffic safety is ensured.

title: Power grid frequency prediction method and system based on time sequence prediction algorithm
description: A power grid frequency prediction method and system based on a time sequence prediction algorithm mainly comprises the steps of constructing an adjacency matrix for predicting a power grid based on topological relations among power grid sites, selecting historical data of the power grid, preprocessing the historical data, including data cleaning, standardization processing and time alignment, constructing a power grid frequency prediction model, including an improved dynamic diagram learning module, a linear space convolution layer and a time convolution layer, and inputting the adjacency matrix and the preprocessed data into the trained power grid frequency prediction model to predict power grid frequency change within 10 seconds in the future with high precision. According to the method, the accuracy of power grid frequency prediction is improved by enhancing the learning ability of the model on dynamic characteristics.

title: An optimization control method for agricultural comprehensive energy park considering environmental capacity constraints
description: The invention discloses an agricultural comprehensive energy park optimization control method considering environmental capacity constraint, which optimizes a multi-energy scheduling strategy and improves energy utilization efficiency. Firstly, constructing a multi-energy system operation control and pollution emission model, quantifying the influence of pollution emission on the environment, introducing environmental capacity constraint, and evaluating and dynamically adjusting an energy scheduling strategy in real time. Then, an optimal control model based on fuzzy membership is provided, and a nonlinear relation between agricultural production requirements and energy supply is processed by adopting a fuzzy theory. Secondly, a comprehensive planning method based on environmental capacity assessment is provided, and a long-term energy configuration scheme is solved by adopting dynamic planning. And finally, providing an optimized control model based on data driving, predicting energy demand and pollution emission trend by adopting a deep learning algorithm, and dynamically adjusting an operation strategy to ensure that the system operates efficiently under the constraint of environmental capacity. The invention can realize the collaborative management of energy and environment, improve the operation efficiency and promote the sustainable development.

title: Automatic driving vehicle track planning method based on interactive vehicle track prediction
description: The present invention discloses a method for trajectory planning of an autonomous driving vehicle based on interactive vehicle trajectory prediction, and the invention relates to the field of vehicle decision planning. The present invention proposes a method based on an interactive vehicle trajectory prediction model, firstly using a quintic polynomial curve and a collision residual time to plan a driving path for the vehicle; then using an SSA-AN trajectory prediction model that takes into account vehicle driving parameters, shape, size, and spatial influences to accurately predict the future driving trajectory of vehicles around the main vehicle, and calculating the potential collision between the main vehicle and the interactive vehicle according to a collision judgment model to plan a reasonable longitudinal driving speed for the main vehicle, and then obtaining the vehicle planning trajectory; then using an MPC-based lateral controller to control the lateral direction of the vehicle, and using a PID-based longitudinal controller to control the longitudinal speed of the vehicle.

title: Multi-pollutant cooperative treatment monitoring system of desulfurization equipment
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of testing, and particularly relates to a multi-pollutant cooperative treatment monitoring system of desulfurization equipment. The device comprises a processor, a desulfurization effect monitoring module, an equipment operation feedback module, a matching judgment module, a preprocessing analysis module and a regulation and control optimization module. The desulfurization effect monitoring module synchronously collects sulfur, nitrogen oxide content and dust concentration data in tail gas, the comprehensive deviation value is used for evaluating treatment effect, the equipment operation feedback module is used for calculating equipment comprehensive treatment capacity value by combining air compressor and slurry pump operation data, the matching judgment module is used for evaluating the matching degree of treatment capacity and multi-pollutant load and generating a regulation and control signal, the pretreatment analysis module is used for evaluating pretreatment effect and generating an optimization instruction, the regulation and control optimization module is used for generating an optimal regulation and control parameter set based on a multi-objective optimization algorithm, and the processor is used for dynamically adjusting a weight threshold value and executing fault diagnosis, so that comprehensive evaluation and cooperative regulation and control of the sulfur, nitrogen oxide and dust treatment effect are realized.

title: Complex equipment data monitoring method and system based on knowledge graph and edge calculation
description: The present invention relates to the field of data monitoring technology, and more particularly to a complex equipment data monitoring method and system based on knowledge graphs and edge computing. The method includes multimodal data acquisition and intelligent edge preprocessing; feature extraction of preprocessed data; multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and dynamic knowledge graph construction; deep knowledge reasoning and hierarchical fault warning decision-making; and self-optimization and knowledge closed-loop management based on warning decisions. The differential coding and adaptive compression algorithm at the edge layer of the present invention reduces data transmission volume by 75%, significantly reducing network bandwidth requirements and improving system operational efficiency.

title: Data quality detection method, equipment and medium for DataX
description: The application discloses a data quality detection method, equipment and medium for DataX, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of reading a data source through a reader plug-in of a DataX in parallel in a slicing way to obtain data to be processed, triggering a quality detection engine when the data to be processed is transmitted to a memory buffer, loading a predefined detection rule base through the quality detection engine, generating an abnormal log containing a problem type, a field identification and original data if the field is detected to be empty and the format deviates from a preset template or a field deletion is required to be filled, storing the abnormal log into a distributed file system according to time stamp classification, generating a visual abstract report, analyzing the problem type, the field identification and the original data, and calling the predefined restoration script base for restoration.
