According to the method, the data quality detection is carried out in the data input and output process of the DataX, and the detection result is output to the text file, so that the quality detection of the data can be carried out efficiently and accurately.

title: RSU-assisted single-hop task offloading optimization method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
description: The present invention discloses an RSU-assisted single-hop task offloading optimization method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, which belongs to the field of vehicle networking and edge computing technology. The present invention includes: actively sensing the road environment through RSU to generate perception tasks; predicting the distribution status of neighboring vehicles through the gated recurrent unit GRU model, and updating the neighboring node set of each RSU in real time; according to the task characteristics, the tasks generated by the RSU are offloaded to the adjacent edge computing nodes, and based on the delay and energy consumption calculation model, the delay and energy consumption of offloading to other nodes are calculated; optimizing the objective function to minimize the total calculation delay and total energy consumption, and modeling the task decision problem as a Markov decision process; using the MAPPO algorithm for distributed training and optimization to obtain the optimal task offloading decision. The present invention can effectively reduce the long-term average task processing delay and energy consumption, and improve the efficiency and robustness of task offloading in a dynamic vehicle networking environment.

title: Party space conversion-based split learning large language model privacy protection method
description: The present application relates to a privacy protection method for a split learning large language model based on parameter space conversion, including: splitting a pre-trained large language model to obtain a head segment model, a middle segment model and a tail segment model of the large language model, and deploying the head segment model and the tail segment model on a first device end, and deploying the middle segment model on a second device end; connecting the head segment model and the tail segment model based on a projection layer, and preheating the connected head segment model and the tail segment model so that the parameters of the head segment model and the tail segment model are converted to a specified parameter space; freezing the parameters in the head segment model, and collaboratively training the middle segment model and the tail segment model based on the first device end and the second device end to obtain a fine-tuned large language model. This method can improve the security of the split learning process of the large language model.

title: Bit-width-quantization-oriented accelerator for LSTM neural network
description: The invention discloses an accelerator of a bit-width-oriented LSTM neural network, which comprises an external dynamic random access memory, a first I P core, a second I P core and a first-in first-out queue for temporarily storing data, wherein the first I P core consists of a first data loading module, a vector matrix multiplication module, a dequantization module and a first data storage module, the second I P core consists of a second data loading module, a bias addition module, an activation function application module, a memory cell update module and a second data storage module, the first I P core and the second I P core both adopt an LSTM gating computing architecture, and the gating computing architecture consists of four gating computing units consisting of an input gate, a forgetting gate and an output gate.

title: Digital twinning-oriented industrial large language model corpus manufacturing method
description: The present invention relates to a method for producing industrial large language model corpus for digital twins, comprising the following steps: first, for the digital twin system, extract multidimensional data such as production, equipment status, fault records, etc. from the steel industry database. Then use a large language model agent to process and associate the data. Then divide the document into multiple smaller text blocks, and use the BGE embedding model to vectorize the data after the blocks. Finally, design a prompt word prompt to guide the large language model agent to generate Alpaca format question and answer pairs for the block data. This method solves the problem that it is difficult to extract useful information from a large amount of data in the industrial field to assist decision-making and optimize the production process. By constructing a dedicated industrial large language model fine-tuning data set, the application effect of the large language model in the steel industry is improved. It not only provides effective support for the subsequent SFT (supervised fine-tuning) process, but also further promotes the development of automation in the steel field.

title: Park light hydrogen storage charging collaborative optimization method and system based on dynamic carbon emission factors
description: The invention discloses a garden light hydrogen storage charging collaborative optimization method and system based on a dynamic carbon emission factor, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining various historical data of a garden micro-grid; the method comprises the steps of establishing a prediction model and an equipment model based on historical data, establishing an optimization model based on the prediction model and the equipment model by taking a daily electric power dynamic carbon emission factor into consideration, taking the minimum carbon dioxide emission of a micro-grid of a park as an objective function and combining supply and demand balance constraint, and solving the model by using an optimization algorithm to obtain a low-carbon operation plan. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a prediction model construction module, an equipment model construction module, an optimization model definition module and an optimization solving module. By using the method and the system, the daily optimal operation plan of each energy facility in the park can be obtained optimally. The invention can be widely applied to the field of carbon emission reduction.

title: Electromagnetic touch feedback system for virtual operation robot training
description: The present invention discloses an electromagnetic tactile feedback system for virtual surgical robot training, comprising: a virtual surgical simulation part and an electromagnetic tactile feedback part, wherein the virtual surgical simulation part simulates the control and feedback of an electromagnetically driven surgical robot operating in human tissues and organs; the electromagnetic tactile feedback part comprises an electromagnetic coil module, a hardware driver module, a visual unit module, a wireless communication module, an artificial intelligence computing module, and a handheld interactive device. The present invention achieves a high degree of consistency in size, motion trajectory, material modeling, and geometric shape between the electromagnetically driven surgical robot in virtual interaction and the handheld device in real interaction by adopting a digital twin control interaction form, thereby providing a deeply immersive interactive experience.

title: Regional scale groundwater recharge mechanism prediction method combined with machine learning
description: The application provides a regional scale groundwater recharge mechanism prediction method combining machine learning, which comprises the steps of carrying out qualitative analysis on a target region to generate a groundwater recharge mechanism, processing environmental factor data through a soil water isotope prediction model and a groundwater isotope prediction model to obtain a soil water isotope landscape map and a groundwater isotope landscape map respectively, retrieving a historical quantitative analysis sample set meeting the soil water isotope landscape map, the groundwater isotope landscape map and the environmental factor data, counting a linear surplus lc-process high-frequency value set of groundwater and substrate flow prediction in a one-to-one correspondence manner, calculating to obtain a substrate flow recharge proportion set, and adding the groundwater recharge mechanism and the substrate flow recharge proportion set into a groundwater recharge mechanism analysis result when the substrate flow recharge proportion set meets a quantity ratio threshold value. The technical problem of low prediction accuracy of the regional scale groundwater recharge mechanism in the prior art is solved.

title: Remote sensing winter wheat identification method based on multitask learning model
description: The present invention relates to a remote sensing winter wheat recognition method based on a multi-task learning model. Aiming at the problems of inaccurate edge extraction of winter wheat in high-resolution remote sensing images and omission and misclassification caused by overly dense distribution and intra-class diversity in existing classic semantic segmentation models, the present invention designs a Vision Transformer (MCFormer) based on multi-task learning, which associates the semantic segmentation task with the semantic boundary task, significantly improving the accuracy of boundary detection. NDVI and LST are also introduced as sample bands to enhance the spectral characteristics of winter wheat.

title: Ablation assistance method, system, electronic device and storage medium based on image processing
description: The invention provides an image processing-based ablation auxiliary method, an image processing-based ablation auxiliary system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the fields of image processing and ablation. The ablation auxiliary method based on image processing mainly comprises the steps of acquiring a plurality of groups of ultrasonic images of an operation area in real time through an ultrasonic radiography technology, extracting first characteristics and first fusion characteristics through a multi-attention network model, acquiring second characteristics of the plurality of groups of ultrasonic images based on the first characteristics, generating an accurate three-dimensional operation area model by combining a three-dimensional reconstruction technology, helping doctors to accurately locate focuses, acquiring third characteristics around an ablation needle in real time through a miniature ultrasonic sensor integrated on the ablation needle in the ablation process, matching the third characteristics with the second characteristics, and ensuring that the ablation area is highly coincident with the focuses. The invention can obviously reduce the damage to healthy tissues, improve the accuracy and success rate of ablation operation, and can effectively avoid the problem of focus residue or excessive ablation especially when complex lesions are treated.

title: Photovoltaic module fault diagnosis and early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention discloses a photovoltaic module fault diagnosis and early warning method, device, equipment and medium based on artificial intelligence, which comprise the steps of obtaining historical monitoring data to be processed of a plurality of photovoltaic modules under different preset weather characteristics, and preprocessing the historical monitoring data to be processed to obtain processed historical monitoring data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a photovoltaic module fault diagnosis model according to a plurality of preset weather features and a plurality of processed historical monitoring data, obtaining weather data of a period to be predicted, clustering the weather data with the preset weather features to obtain a clustering result of the period to be predicted, diagnosing the running state of the photovoltaic module of the period to be predicted with the photovoltaic module fault diagnosis model based on the clustering result to obtain a diagnosis result, and judging whether an early warning signal is generated or not based on the diagnosis result. The invention belongs to the field of photovoltaics. According to the invention, by combining weather characteristics, the fault modes under different weather conditions can be more accurately identified, so that false alarms and false alarms are reduced.

title: A method and device for modeling equivalent loads of wind, solar and water load clusters
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for modeling equivalent loads of a wind-light water load cluster, which are used for determining an equivalent comprehensive load model structure of the wind-light water load cluster, carrying out mathematical equivalent modeling on various loads, then constructing a simulation model based on the equivalent comprehensive load model structure, fitting relevant parameters of the simulation model by using a particle swarm algorithm, and solving corresponding parameters in the equivalent comprehensive load model.

title: A BOTDA system Brillouin frequency shift extraction method and device
description: The application relates to the field of oil and gas pipeline transportation, in particular to a Brillouin frequency shift extraction method and device of a BOTDA system, which can be better adapted to the system to a certain extent, simplify the steps of data processing, improve the extraction precision and reduce the algorithm processing threshold. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a BGS image, carrying out normalization processing on the BGS image, carrying out identification judgment on the BGS image based on the normalization processing to determine that the BGS image is processed through an ANN algorithm or an LSSVM algorithm, outputting a BGS fitting result according to the result of the processing of the BGS image by the algorithm, extracting a Brillouin frequency shift result, realizing accurate extraction of temperature and strain information, guaranteeing pipeline safety, realizing improvement of extraction precision of an optimized Brillouin frequency shift extraction method, reducing the requirement of an extracted BGS signal to noise ratio, and achieving the aim of automatically identifying BGS peak numbers.

title: Training method, device, electronic device and storage medium for neural network model
description: The present disclosure proposes a training method, device, electronic device and storage medium for a neural network model, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology. It includes: obtaining the initial weights corresponding to each output channel of each layer of the network in the initial neural network model, and the predicted value of the initial neural network model for sample data; determining the similarity between the initial weights corresponding to every two output channels of each layer of the network; determining the first loss corresponding to the initial neural network model according to the similarity; and correcting the initial weights in the initial neural network model based on the first loss and the second loss corresponding to the predicted value. Thus, the similarity between the initial weights corresponding to every two output channels of each layer of the network is added to the loss of the model, so that the similarity between the initial weights corresponding to every two output channels of each layer of the network can be smaller, thereby enabling different channels of each layer of the neural network to learn more different features, thereby avoiding feature redundancy and improving model performance.

title: Multi-scale spatiotemporal modeling video summary generation method and device
description: The multi-scale spatiotemporal modeling video summary generation method and device provided by the present invention include a feature extraction module, a multi-scale spatiotemporal modeling module, an importance classifier, and a summary generation module; the multi-scale spatiotemporal modeling module includes a multi-scale aggregator, a cascaded time modeling module, and a parallel space modeling module that are freely arranged in sequence. The present invention comprehensively captures the local details and global structure of the video by constructing a multi-scale spatiotemporal modeling module including a multi-scale aggregator, a cascaded time modeling module, and a parallel space modeling module; and the order of the multi-scale aggregator, the cascaded time modeling module, and the parallel space modeling module can be freely arranged, so that the adaptability of the model to different video features is improved, so that the model has low computational complexity while maintaining high performance. The present invention has the advantages of low cost, simple structure, good performance, and strong adaptability.

title: Digital twinning-based wind power plant equipment modeling and operation and maintenance control method and device
description: The application provides a method and a device for modeling and operation and maintenance control of wind power plant equipment based on digital twin, which are constructed by a high-precision digital twin model, wherein a fan entity is restored based on a 1:1 three-dimensional modeling technology, multi-source data including equipment sensors, video monitoring and GIS topographic data are integrated, and real-time mapping of a physical field and a virtual field is realized. And the intelligent decision support module predicts wind resource distribution by utilizing a dynamic boundary layer model, optimizes a grid-connected control strategy by combining a virtual inertia simulation technology, and realizes the guarantee of transient stability of the power grid under the new energy fluctuation scene. And the full life cycle management platform supports full-flow management from site selection planning, operation monitoring and fault diagnosis, and realizes multi-service data fusion display and interactive operation and maintenance strategy verification through a three-dimensional visual large screen.

title: Mobile robot path planning method based on improved Q-learning
description: The invention provides a mobile robot path planning method based on improved Q-learning, which comprises the following steps of modeling an environment by adopting a grid method, modeling a mobile robot path planning problem by adopting a Markov decision process, and solving an optimal path based on an improved Q-learning algorithm. The invention improves the navigation performance and decision intelligence of the mobile robot in a complex environment, and provides a more adaptive path planning solution for intelligent storage, outdoor inspection and other scenes.

title: Agricultural condition remote sensing image change detection method based on time sequence analysis
description: The invention relates to the technical field of remote sensing image processing, and discloses a pesticide remote sensing image change detection method based on time sequence analysis, the agricultural condition remote sensing image sequence is acquired by a multi-temporal remote sensing sensor, and after registration and radiation correction by a space-time alignment algorithm, the multi-scale fusion characteristics are extracted by utilizing a multi-mode data fusion network. The time series decomposition model decomposes the characteristic, extracts the time dynamic change characteristic, detects the unusual change area from the unusual detection model of the encoder of the variant. The multi-objective optimization algorithm optimizes the change area, and builds a visual model to generate a high-resolution agriculture-intelligence change distribution map. The method integrates multiple sensor data, integrates multiple algorithms and models, effectively solves the problems of data processing, feature analysis, abnormal detection, result presentation and the like in agricultural condition remote sensing image change detection, improves detection accuracy and efficiency, and provides accurate basis for agricultural production management.

title: YOLOv8n road multi-target detection method and system based on HGNet backbone network
description: The invention discloses a YOLOv n road multi-target detection method and system based on HGNet backbone network, which are used for realizing rapid and accurate extraction of road markers such as lane marks, traffic marks and the like by comprehensively analyzing geometric characteristics, coordinate information, reflection intensity and other multi-dimensional information of point cloud data and combining an intelligent extraction algorithm, and can finish intelligent tracking extraction of the lane marks, arrows, zebra crossings and the like on a long-length road of hundreds of meters by an operator through simple point selection and basket pulling operation, and generate high-quality vector output. The technology obviously reduces manual intervention, improves the working efficiency, and provides important data support for the fields of road asset management, intelligent traffic system construction and the like.

title: Model interpretation method and evaluation method based on theory selection in aspect emotion classification
description: The invention provides a model interpretation method based on theory selection in aspect emotion classification, which adopts an interpretation module to process input text and select theory in the input content, an ASC model predicts emotion polarity of the original input and theory content to obtain Y  I  and Y  R , an optimization objective function is constructed by maximizing simplicity and consistency of theory X  R  and consistency of Y  I  and Y  R , the interpretation module is trained, and the theory extracted by the trained interpretation module is an ASC model decision basis. The method can extract the decision basis of the aspect-level emotion classification model under the condition that the model structure is not required to be disassembled. Based on the extracted theory of the interpretation method, the emotion polarity classification quality of the ASC model can be evaluated by comparing the description content of the theory truly corresponding to the aspect of the input text. The evaluation method breaks through the category that only the accuracy of the model output is concerned, and evaluates the model from the angle of decision basis.

title: Power grid data anomaly detection method and system based on hybrid deep learning model
description: The present invention provides a method and system for detecting anomalies in power grid data based on a hybrid deep learning model, which belongs to the technical field of power grid data processing. The method performs hybrid modeling by combining a convolutional neural network with a recursive neural network, a gated recurrent unit, a long short-term memory network, and an attention model to obtain an initial detection model. At the same time, a model collaborative optimization mechanism is used to perform distributed parallel training on the initial detection model, and an adaptive optimizer is constructed through an adaptive optimization algorithm. The optimizer and a dynamic training mechanism are used to dynamically update the model parameters and model structure to obtain a hybrid detection model. The real-time data stream of the power system is input into the hybrid detection model for anomaly detection. At the same time, according to a preset defense strategy, active security protection operations are performed on the power system for the detected abnormal data and potential attack behaviors. The present invention can accurately detect and provide real-time warnings for complex abnormal behaviors of the power system.

title: Hierarchical optimization scheduling method for deep peak shaving of thermal power generating unit
description: The present invention discloses a hierarchical optimization scheduling method for deep peak regulation of thermal power units, comprising the following steps: system hierarchicalization: dividing the power system into several subsystems, each subsystem including a cluster of thermal power units and differentiated load demands; subsystem-level prediction: generating a basic scheduling plan; dynamic preference-driven multi-objective collaborative optimization: receiving multi-objective data from each subsystem, performing multi-objective collaborative optimization, modeling the objectives of the power grid company, the environmental protection department, and the end user as game participants, using a fuzzy membership function to quantify the priorities of each party, generating a dynamic game solution through a Nash equilibrium solver, and screening out a Pareto optimal solution that takes into account the interests of multiple parties; dynamic safety domain online verification; virtual synchronous machine collaborative support: simulating the operating characteristics of synchronous generators; global collaboration and iterative optimization: the optimal scheduling plan of each subsystem is uploaded to the dispatching center through a message queue telemetry transmission protocol for global constraint verification.

title: Multi-hop knowledge graph question-answer state dynamic updating method based on reinforcement learning
description: This application provides a method for dynamically updating the state of multi-hop knowledge graph question-answering based on reinforcement learning. The method includes: using a multi-hop question dynamic perception module to dynamically capture the current multi-hop question representation at different time steps based on a relationship-query alignment mechanism; using a relationship enhancement module to enhance the reasoning relationship representation of the current single-hop question by combining an attention mechanism and a query-relation alignment mechanism; and integrating the dynamically updated multi-hop question representation and the enhanced reasoning relationship representation into the state information to achieve dynamic updating and path reasoning of the multi-hop question. The technical solution provided by this application can improve the reasoning efficiency and accuracy of multi-hop knowledge graph questions based on reinforcement learning.

title: Method and equipment for detecting splashing of blast furnace tap hole
description: The application provides a method and equipment for detecting splashing of a blast furnace tap hole, belonging to the technical field of metallurgy and image data processing. The method for detecting the splashing of the blast furnace tapping hole comprises the steps of collecting historical image data of the blast furnace tapping hole at the tapping moment, marking the historical image data according to the splashing detection category, generating a splashing cluster anchor frame corresponding to the marking data by combining a clustering algorithm, constructing a target detection model with an attention mechanism, setting a loss function according to the splashing detection category and the splashing cluster anchor frame, training the target detection model by using the historical image data and the marking data to learn the splashing characteristics corresponding to the splashing cluster anchor frame by combining the attention mechanism until the loss function converges, collecting current image data of the blast furnace tapping hole in real time, inputting the current image data into the target detection model, and outputting a splashing detection result corresponding to the splashing of the blast furnace tapping hole. The application can solve the problems of low accuracy in detecting the splashing of the blast furnace tap hole, missed detection and high false alarm rate in the prior art.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle infrared remote sensing image weak and small target detection method and device
description: The present invention relates to a method and device for detecting small targets in unmanned aerial vehicle infrared remote sensing images. The method comprises: obtaining an infrared remote sensing image to be tested; inputting the infrared remote sensing image to be tested into a preset target detection model, and outputting a small target detection result. The target detection model is obtained by inputting a training set and training using a Width Over Union (WIoU) loss function based on a range attention mechanism. The training set includes infrared remote sensing images and corresponding target annotations. The target detection model is constructed by introducing an efficient intra-scale feature interaction mechanism and a non-maximum suppression mechanism into a YOLO-based target detector. The present invention can effectively utilize feature information in infrared remote sensing images and improve the accuracy and robustness of small target detection.

title: SAR image glacier missing speed recovery method and system based on combined network
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for recovering the missing velocity of glaciers from SAR images based on a combined network, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing image signal processing. The method comprises: acquiring time series SAR images of the study area and performing preprocessing to obtain a glacier velocity field; calculating the mean of each glacier velocity point in the neighborhood, and inputting the mean and the position coordinates of the glacier velocity into an artificial neural network to train the artificial neural network; obtaining the initial recovered glacier velocity using the trained artificial neural network; obtaining the reconstructed glacier velocity using the initial recovered glacier velocity; performing a weighted combination of the initial recovered glacier velocity and the reconstructed glacier velocity as the input of a denoising autoencoder, and finally recovering the missing glacier velocity. The present invention makes full use of the spatiotemporal characteristics of glacier velocity, and can be completed only by relying on time series SAR images, without introducing additional external data, thereby improving the robustness of glacier velocity recovery.

title: ICL lens implant suitability judgment method, system, electronic device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for judging ICL crystal implantation suitability, wherein the judging method comprises the following steps of collecting eye parameter data of a patient; the eye parameter data of the patient to be diagnosed is input into the classification model, and a suitability judgment result is output, wherein the judgment result is a first result or a second result. By integrating the eye anatomy structure parameters and the physiological function parameters and combining an improved Weighted Fuzzy Support Vector Machine (WFSVM) algorithm, the limitation of traditional single parameter evaluation is solved, the suitability judgment accuracy of critical cases is obviously improved, and the surgical risk caused by misdiagnosis is avoided.

title: Intelligent medical health assessment analysis management system based on deep learning
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent medical health assessment and analysis management system based on deep learning, comprising: a data processing module for collecting and preprocessing medical health data; a coding and decoding module for inputting medical health data into an improved TransUNet network and outputting a health risk feature map; a feature fusion module for constructing a nested representation structure of spatial and channel dimensions of candidate feature blocks and performing cascade fusion; a label classification module for generating a health level distribution map, extracting regional discriminant features, and labeling corresponding regional classification labels; a parameter updating module for calculating the loss response corresponding to each category and iteratively updating the network weight parameters; and a closed-loop training module for training the network, forming a closed-loop iterative process, and outputting health assessment and analysis results. The present invention achieves multimodal fusion, precise identification, and dynamic optimization, improving assessment accuracy and intelligence.

title: PCB welding spot defect positioning detection method and system based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for positioning and detecting PCB welding spot defects based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, collecting visible light data and thermal imaging data of a PCB, preprocessing the visible light data and the thermal infrared data of the PCB to obtain preprocessed visible light data and thermal infrared data of the PCB, S2, respectively carrying out feature extraction and feature alignment according to the preprocessed visible light data and the preprocessed thermal infrared data of the PCB to obtain aligned texture feature images and temperature feature images, S3, carrying out feature calibration to generate fusion feature images, S4, calculating positioning feature images and optimized enhancement feature images, finally outputting a welding spot defect detection frame set, S5, calculating sub-pixel feature images, outputting a defect distribution probability image, S6, converting the defect distribution probability image into a binary defect mask, combining morphological closing operation and outputting a final defect detection result. The invention can solve the problem of insufficient accuracy of the traditional PCB welding spot defect positioning method for identifying the micro defects.

title: Digital printing machine nozzle temperature and humidity control method and system
description: The invention discloses a digital printing machine nozzle temperature and humidity control method and system, which relate to the technical field of digital printing, and the control method comprises the steps of dividing a nozzle area in a target digital printing machine into an inner peripheral area and an outer peripheral area, respectively collecting temperature and humidity data of the inner peripheral area and the outer peripheral area according to basic frequency, constructing a prediction model by utilizing temperature and humidity data in a history period, and predicting temperature and humidity change trends of different areas by adopting a machine learning algorithm.

title: Scheduling method and device of computing tasks and electronic equipment
description: The present application discloses a scheduling method, device, and electronic device for computing tasks. The method includes: obtaining network performance indicators, computing task characteristic indicators, and computing resource indicators of a distributed computing system; respectively determining a first correlation relationship and a second correlation relationship between the computing resource indicator and the network performance indicator and the computing task characteristic indicator; determining a first computing resource indicator and a second computing resource indicator that are commonly corresponding to the network performance indicator and the computing task characteristic indicator at the target moment; fusing the computing resource indicators to obtain a target computing resource indicator, and scheduling the computing task in the namespace when the target computing resource indicator meets a preset condition. The present application solves the technical problem of being unable to accurately allocate computing resources because the relevant task scheduling method only considers the quota of computing resources and the amount of resources required for the task, but does not fully consider the influence of other factors such as network performance and task characteristics.

title: Training method and distribution method of Internet of vehicles resource distribution model
description: The invention discloses a training method and a training method of a vehicle networking resource allocation model, the training method comprises the steps of obtaining state vectors of agents, inputting the state vectors of the agents into an actor network to obtain first strategy action vectors, capturing key information of the state vectors of each agent by adopting a self-attention mechanism to generate self-attention output, realizing information sharing among the agents by adopting a cross-attention mechanism to generate cross-attention output, fusing the self-attention output and the cross-attention output to output fused feature representations, inputting the obtained fused feature representations into the first MLP network to perform dimension reduction processing, adding noise to the feature representations after dimension reduction, inputting the feature representations into a diffusion model to output prediction noise, and obtaining second strategy action vectors based on the prediction noise.

title: Processing trust using multiple trust roots and graphical data of runtime attestation
description: The present disclosure relates to processing trust using multiple trust roots and graphical data of runtime attestations. An apparatus includes a graphics processor to collect first measurement data from a Physical Partition Manager (PPM) using a hardware trust root, generate a PPM Composite Device Identifier (CDI) for securely binding to the PPM using the first measurement data, collect second measurement data from a Logical Partition Manager (LPM) using the PPM, generate an LPM CDI for securely binding to the LPM using the second measurement data and the PPM CDI, collect third measurement data from a graphics tenant partition of the graphics processor using the LPM, the graphics tenant partition including a confidential computing environment for running a workload of a host tenant partition, and generate GPUN-TDn CDI for the graphics tenant partition to be securely bound to the graphics tenant partition using the third measurement data and the LPM CDI.

title: Intelligent design system and method for architectural decoration
description: The invention relates to the technical field of architectural decoration design, in particular to an architectural decoration intelligent design system and method, comprising an intelligent perception analysis module, a control module and a control module, wherein the intelligent perception analysis module is used for acquiring space characteristic information and environmental parameters; the system comprises an intelligent perception analysis module, an AI design engine module, a multi-dimensional optimization evaluation module, an immersive visual interaction module, an intelligent perception analysis module and an interactive design adjustment interface, wherein the intelligent perception analysis module is used for receiving the information of the spatial characteristics and the environmental parameters, the AI design engine module is in communication connection with the intelligent perception analysis module and is used for receiving the fusion characteristic matrix, generating a preliminary design scheme based on the fusion characteristic matrix, the multi-dimensional optimization evaluation module is in communication connection with the AI design engine module and is used for carrying out functional, aesthetic and economical evaluation on the preliminary design scheme, generating an optimized design scheme based on an evaluation result, the immersive visual interaction module is in communication connection with the multi-dimensional optimization evaluation module and is used for receiving the optimized design scheme, generating a three-dimensional visual model of the optimized design scheme, and providing the interactive design adjustment interface, so that the design period can be obviously shortened, and the labor cost can be reduced.

title: Pedestrian track prediction method, system, equipment and medium based on continuous learning
description: The invention relates to a pedestrian track prediction method, system, equipment and medium based on continuous learning, which are used for collecting motion data and task scene information of a target pedestrian in an environment, wherein the motion data comprises position coordinates and instantaneous speed values under a global coordinate system, a history track sequence is input into a main model in a pedestrian track prediction model for calculation to obtain a real predicted future track sequence of a current task, a social generation model in the pedestrian track prediction model is used for generating a pseudo history track of an old task after training based on task scene information, the pseudo history track is input into a main model copy corresponding to the old task to generate a pseudo future track, the pseudo history track and the pseudo future track are combined to form a pseudo sample, the real predicted future track sequence and the history track sequence are combined to form a real sample, and the real sample and the pseudo sample are combined to form a mixed data set to participate in training together. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of low forgetfulness, strong adaptability, less resource utilization and the like.

title: Medical endoscope 2D video real-time 3D conversion method based on deep learning
description: The invention provides a medical endoscope 2D video real-time 3D conversion method based on deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of medical image processing. The medical endoscope 2D video real-time 3D conversion method based on deep learning comprises the following steps of preprocessing an original 2D endoscope video, including self-adaptive histogram equalization processing and specular reflection suppression. The preprocessed video frames are depth estimated by a lightweight depth estimation network EndoDepthNet. And processing the continuous multi-frame video by using a motion restoration structure algorithm. And generating a binocular parallax image according to the optimized depth map, performing sub-pixel level time sequence smoothing processing, and outputting a real-time 3D stereoscopic video. The method aims at the deep learning model, the multi-mode geometric constraint and the hardware parallel optimization of the endoscope scene optimization, and solves the defects of the traditional method in precision, instantaneity and anti-interference capability.

title: Multi-mode-based pre-operative evaluation method and system for abdominal compartment syndrome
description: The invention provides a multi-mode-based pre-operation evaluation method and system for abdominal compartment syndrome, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring multiple physiological data of a patient; the method comprises the steps of inputting the multiple physiological indexes and physical examination parameters into a pre-established preoperative index judging system, judging whether the physiological indexes and physical examination parameters of a patient accord with surgical indexes or not by utilizing the preoperative index judging system, constructing an interpretable artificial intelligence model based on XAI (extensible markup language) by the preoperative index judging system, and fusing a self-attention mechanism of a transducer. The multi-mode-based pre-operation evaluation method for the abdominal compartment syndrome skillfully fuses a self-attention mechanism of a transducer, so that a model can automatically learn and pay attention to information which is most critical to diagnosis, and the accuracy of diagnosis is further improved.

title: Visual language reasoning method and system integrating contextual learning and chain reasoning
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to a visual language reasoning method and a visual language reasoning system integrating context learning and chain reasoning, wherein the method carries out multi-mode reasoning in two stages, and in the first stage, a ROI (region of interest) of a target image is identified by combining a context example and a target problem; in the second stage, the global features and the ROI areas of the target image, the global features and the ROI features of the context examples and the target questions are combined, and a final text answer is predicted. The invention realizes local feature extraction and fusion of local features and global features, and combines a context example to perform staged visual language reasoning, thereby improving the logical reasoning capability and robustness of visual language tasks.

title: An intelligent evaluation and feedback system for simulated patient teaching based on conversation analysis
description: The invention discloses an intelligent evaluation and feedback system for simulating patient teaching based on dialogue analysis, which relates to the technical field of medical teaching and artificial intelligence, the system comprises a dialogue data acquisition module, an NLP analysis module, a machine learning and deep learning model module, an evaluation and scoring module, a feedback and improvement suggestion module and a data storage and teaching management module. The invention analyzes the dialogue between students and simulated patients in real time based on the techniques of natural language processing, voice recognition, machine learning and the like, comprehensively evaluates the clinical communication, illness state judgment and treatment decision making capability, realizes real-time feedback on the basis, provides personalized evaluation report and suggestion, and provides decision basis for teaching improvement.

title: Task-oriented semantic communication method and related device
description: The invention belongs to the field of information and communication engineering, and discloses a task-oriented semantic communication method and a related device, wherein a transmitting end device processes acquired image data to be transmitted by using a trained first deep neural network to obtain a plurality of signals; the transmitting end device selects semantic feature dimensions according to the dynamic wireless channel, and transmits complex signals to the receiving end device by utilizing the selected semantic feature dimensions, and the receiving end device processes the signals transmitted through the dynamic wireless channel by utilizing the trained second deep neural network to obtain image features. The invention can solve the problems that the reasoning accuracy and the transmission delay are balanced and the wireless channel is dynamically changed in the prior art.

title: A Neural Network-Based Tracking Robot Trajectory Recognition Method
description: The invention discloses a tracking robot track identification method based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: 1) the robot collects road images in an illumination change environment; 2) compressing the acquired image data into pictures, and storing the pictures into jpg files; 3) cutting the collected picture; 4) transferring the collected picture data to a computer, and marking the centers of the guide lines in the three areas in each picture at the computer; 5) importing the obtained training data into matlab, and training the neural network to obtain each parameter of the neural network; 6) compiling a neural network algorithm for marking the middle point of a guide line in the middle of a road in a picture according to the neural network parameters obtained by matlab training; … …, respectively; the tracking robot track identification method based on the neural network has strong self-adaptive capacity, has high accuracy rate for identifying the track of the road under the condition of changing visual illumination conditions, and has high robustness.

title: Evaluation technology of operator's functional status based on functional near-infrared spectroscopy
description: The present invention relates to it is a kind of based on functional near-infrared spectrum technique, brain electricity, cardiac electrical fusion operator's functional status（Operator functional state, abbreviation OFS）Assessment technology.The present invention can not only solve operator's functional status assessment technology under the influence of the factors such as task load, emotional state and fatigue.But also the assessment models of operator functional status variation of the prediction based on multi-physiological-parameter can be provided, with the state of high task performance and suitable Mental Workload for best OFS standards, as the adjusting foundation for automating man-machine distribution system.

title: Method and controller for controlling output bit rate of video encoder, camera
description: The disclosure provides a method for controlling the output bit rate of a video encoder, a controller, and a camera. A controller and method are provided for controlling the output bit rate of a video encoder when encoding a video stream. The method includes: receiving weather forecast data for a location where a video stream is captured; based on the weather forecast data, predicting a future increase in the output bit rate of a video encoder due to weather affecting the content of the video stream; level to reduce the output bitrate of the video encoder, thereby compensating for future increases in the output bitrate of the video encoder.

title: An image classification method based on semi-supervised self-paced learning cross-task deep network
description: The invention discloses a kind of based on the semi-supervised image classification method for learning across task depth network from step, includes the following steps：S1, a small amount of mark sample is randomly selected from image overall data concentration, retain its label, remaining all samples, which are used as, does not mark sample, its true tag is not known in whole flow process, it is 1 that the weight of mark sample is permanent in the training process, sample weights are not marked and are initialized as 0, and mark sample is only used when initial as training set；S2, across task depth network is trained using training set；S3, according to trained across task depth network, predict all pseudo labels for not marking sample, and assign and each do not mark sample respective weights；From step study formula, that chooses high confidence level does not mark sample, is added in training set for S4, basis；S5, step S2-S4 is repeated, until across task depth network performance is saturated or reaches preset loop number.The method need not input the feature artificially designed, directly input original image and classification can be realized.

title: A Passenger Flow Prediction Method Based on Dual Population Adaptive Chaotic Fireflies
description: A Passenger Flow Prediction Method Based on Dual Population Adaptive Chaotic Firefly Algorithm. In view of the above problems, the present invention proposes a firefly algorithm to optimize passenger flow forecasting model. The improved algorithm introduces a dual-population mechanism to increase the diversity of the population. The two populations use different search steps. One population has a larger search step for global search, and the other has a smaller search step for local fine search. Global search The population transmits the optimal solution information to the fine search population to improve the search accuracy. In order to solve the problem of being stuck in a local solution, the confusion mechanism is introduced into the firefly attraction function to improve the ability to jump out of the local solution. In order to solve the oscillation problem in the later stage of iteration, the search step size is modified based on the fitness value of fireflies to improve the convergence speed. The improved firefly algorithm significantly improves the accuracy in the process of solving the optimal solution, the number of iteration steps is small, the convergence speed is fast, and the solution accuracy and stability of the passenger flow prediction model are greatly improved.

title: An optimization method for segmentation of coronary angiograms based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses an optimization method for coronary angiography image segmentation based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: using a Tensor object to store a coronary artery angiogram, and performing accelerated calculation in a neural network through a GPU to obtain a segmentation result; the segmentation result of the coronary artery angiogram is optimized through a network structure formed by combining a cascade module and a pixel recovery module added in a neural network. The invention can improve 0.083s by iterating one graph once during training, and can save more than 1 minute in the face of a data set with the number up to thousands of levels in real life. And the neural networks generally used for the image style are trained for at least more than 10 ten thousand times, and the training of the whole network can be saved by more than 100 minutes. Meanwhile, part of the structure of the network is modified, so that the method has the advantages of greatly shortening the time length while ensuring the picture segmentation accuracy, and improving the segmentation accuracy.

title: Image text retrieval method and system
description: Pictograph search method and system provided by the invention, obtain it is multiple text filed in image to be retrieved, respectively to it is multiple it is text filed in each text filed carry out connected component analysis, obtain it is each it is text filed in each text character image；By it is each it is text filed in the character image of each text be separately input into the corresponding default single verbal model of goal-selling text, if for the character image of any text, when default single verbal model output result is the first default value, it is determined that any text is goal-selling text.Pass through the corresponding default single verbal model of one goal-selling text of building, so that can judge whether the text is goal-selling text after being input to the corresponding default single verbal model of goal-selling text for the character image of any text in image to be retrieved.It does not need to identify the text in image to be retrieved, greatly accelerates the speed of character search, while having saved resource.

title: A deep learning parameter exchange method, device, server and storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present invention relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and disclose a deep learning parameter exchange method, device, server and storage medium. In the present invention, the method includes: obtaining matching training data; performing training according to the matching training data and known first weights to obtain a first training parameter; compressing the first training parameter and exchanging it with other processors to obtain a second training parameter training parameters. When using the processor to train the deep learning network, the first training parameter is obtained by obtaining the matching training data and the known first weight for training, and the first training parameter is compressed and exchanged with other processors to obtain the first training parameter. Second, the training parameters are compressed and then transmitted to improve the speed of parameter exchange between processors, thereby saving the time spent in parameter exchange.

title: Method and device for recommending songs
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a song recommending method and a song recommending device, wherein the song recommending method comprises the following steps: establishing a convolutional neural network model based on the tag information of the song to obtain tag characteristics; establishing a time sequence neural network model based on the user behavior information of the songs to obtain the time sequence characteristics of the user behaviors; establishing a deep neural network model based on the label characteristics and the user behavior time sequence characteristics to obtain target characteristics; wherein the target characteristics are used for determining the tracks to be recommended. Therefore, the scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention can recommend the song which is more in line with the preference requirement of the user for the user.

title: An optimal configuration method for distributed power generation considering energy storage and photovoltaic randomness
description: The invention discloses a distributed power supply optimal configuration method considering energy storage and considering photovoltaic randomness, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, constructing a typical daily scene generation method of distributed power output according to a large amount of photovoltaic output historical data based on a kernel density estimation and K-means clustering method; further, based on a double-layer planning theory, on the basis that the annual total cost is the lowest in the upper layer, the lower layer sets up a double-layer planning model for planning and operating the cameras and the distributed power supply from the two angles of comprehensive social benefit and income of the power company; and finally, combining random scene generation with a distributed power supply double-layer planning model, and calculating by an intelligent optimization algorithm to obtain a distributed power supply optimization configuration scheme meeting the load requirement. The double-layer planning model provided by the invention can provide a distributed power supply optimal configuration scheme comprising configuration nodes and capacity from different interest parties, and the annual total cost of the system is effectively reduced.

title: A dance movement evaluation system with motion capture function
description: The present invention provides a dance action evaluation system with motion capture function, comprising: a spatial positioning component, a motion joint sensor component, a sensor signal summarization component, a sensor signal processing component, a joint parameter processing component, a dance action processing component, and a dance standard diaphragm , Human-computer interaction components. The invention has simple structure and convenient operation, collects the dancer's dance movements at the first time, and matches and scores the movements stored in the dance standard diaphragm, which can intuitively reflect the difference between the dancer's movements and the standard movements. The display terminal that provides dancers with digital suggestions not only allows dancers to intuitively understand the defects of their own movements, but also can be used as a standard dance grading equipment to grade dance standard movements, which has good educational significance and commercial prospects.

title: Training method, storage medium and computing device for graphic image reproduction model
description: The embodiment of the present invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, and discloses a training method for a graphic image replication model, comprising: acquiring a sample set containing multiple real samples; randomly selecting two real samples from the sample set each time as a sample pair, The sample pairs are input into the neural network model to be trained for paired learning. The embodiments of the present invention provide a training method, a storage medium and a computing device for a graphic image replication model, realize training a neural network with few samples, and reduce the sample collection cost for training a neural network.

title: Method for generating face animation from single image
description: The invention discloses a kind of methods for generating human face animation from single image.This method is broadly divided into four steps: human face characteristic point generation, image overall two-dimensional deformation, the optimization of human face region details, the generation of mouth area texture in image.The present invention can change according to human face characteristic point generates human face animation in real time, and quality of animation reaches the level of current state-of-the-art facial image cartoon technique.The present invention can be used in a series of applications, such as facial image editor, the editor of human face expression in portrait animation producing and video based on single image.

title: A program representation method based on stack-enhanced LSTM
description: The present invention provides a kind of program representation method based on stack enhancing LSTM, the stack enhancing LSTM includes a stack, and the stack enhancing LSTM starts to access described program, and the hidden state of stack enhancing LSTM is pressed into the stack；Read character all in the code block of described program；Return to the hidden state in the stack top portion；In conjunction with the hidden state in the stack top portion and the hidden state of previous time step to obtain the language ambience information of described program；Described program is indicated based on the language ambience information.The performance of model of the invention in code completion, class of procedures, code summary three program analysis tasks of generation will be better than traditional standard LSTM, this shows the hierarchical organization information that program is captured by stack, can help the more accurate representation program language of model.

title: Particle swarm optimization Steiner minimum tree construction method based on multi-stage conversion and genetic operation under X structure
description: The invention relates to a particle swarm optimization Steiner minimum tree construction method based on multi-stage transformation and genetic operation under the X structure. In order to be able to deal with two SMT problems at the same time, the invention proposes an effective edge-point coding strategy. The invention provides a multi-stage conversion strategy which can not only expand the search space of the algorithm but also ensure effective convergence. By testing three schemes from two-stage to four-stage and different combinations of each scheme, the present invention gives an optimal combination. At the same time, the present invention constructs discrete particle update operations for discrete VLSI routing by using genetic operations combined with union-search partitioning. Furthermore, in order to introduce uncertainty and diversity, the present invention presents a mutation operation that improves the edge transition strategy. The method of the present invention can obtain a wiring scheme with the best quality from a global perspective.

title: A pipeline layout method and device based on bidirectional ant colony and dynamic programming
description: This invention discloses a pipeline layout method and apparatus based on bidirectional ant colony optimization and dynamic programming. By improving the bidirectional ant colony algorithm, the improved algorithm can increase the computation speed by 80% compared with the traditional ant colony algorithm, and reduce the probability of only local optima, thus improving the accuracy of the results. Addressing the shortcomings of single-mode algorithms and slow operation speed, dynamic programming models are increasingly used in water resource planning. Dynamic programming has advantages such as transforming high-dimensional problems into relatively simple low-dimensional problems, having wider restrictions on the functional form of objective functions and constraints, and being easier to process. It reduces the probability of only local optima and improves the accuracy of the results. The bidirectional ant colony algorithm is an improvement on the traditional ant colony algorithm, with bidirectional starting efficiency increasing by approximately 60%. Parallel computation of main roads and branch roads is expected to improve accuracy and computation speed by 80%.

title: Classification model training method, classification method and device, equipment and medium
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a classification model training method, a classification model training device and related equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of training an initial classification model by utilizing a first sample set comprising a large number of first samples to obtain a pre-training model, wherein the first samples comprise social texts and corresponding emoticon labels; and then, training the pre-training model by using a second sample set comprising a small number of second samples to obtain a social text emotion classification model taking the social text as input and taking the probability distribution of emotion categories corresponding to the social text as output. According to the method, a large number of weak supervision samples and a small number of supervised samples are combined to train the model, and the trained model can be guaranteed to have better model performance under the condition that manual labeling samples are not added.

title: Reconstruction method of spectral imaging system based on optimization-inspired neural network
description: The reconstructing method of the spectrum imaging system of the neural network disclosed by the invention inspired based on optimization belongs to calculating camera shooting field.Implementation method of the present invention is as follows: establishing the propagated forward model of spectrum imaging system；Construct high spectrum image reconstructed network that is inspiring based on optimization and considering high spectrum image spatial coherence and spectral correlations simultaneously；Make training set；Parameter needed for configuring the training of high spectrum image reconstructed network；Training high spectrum image reconstructed network；Target high spectrum image is reconstructed using the high spectrum image reconstructed network block-by-block that training obtains.The present invention being capable of the structure insight of utilization system observation model and the modeling ability of neural network, while guaranteeing that reconstructed results have high spatial resolution and EO-1 hyperion fidelity, the efficiency that high spectrum image is rebuild is improved, the application range of high spectrum image is extended.The present invention is suitable for the multiple fields such as remote sensing, medical imaging, visual inspection, sewage detection, vegetation study, atmospheric monitoring.

title: Method and apparatus for speech end-point detection using acoustic and language modeling knowledge for robust speech recognition
description: A method and apparatus for detecting a voice endpoint using sound and language modeling information for robust voice recognition are presented. The method for detecting a speech endpoint according to an embodiment includes inputting an acoustic feature vector sequence extracted from a microphone input signal to a recurrent neural network (RNN)-based acoustic embedding extraction unit, a phoneme embedding extraction unit, and a decoder embedding extraction unit. step; Combining sound embedding, phoneme embedding, and decoder embedding in the sound embedding extraction unit, the phoneme embedding extraction unit, and the decoder embedding extraction unit to construct a feature vector; And inputting the combined feature vector to a deep neural network (DNN)-based classifier to detect a voice endpoint.

title: Apparatus and method for estimating bio-information
description: A biometric information estimation apparatus is disclosed. According to an embodiment, the biometric information estimation apparatus extracts a first feature based on a sensor unit that measures a pulse wave signal and a contact force according to a contact of the subject, the pulse wave signal and the contact force, and extracts a first feature based on the second feature of the user. It may include a processor for selecting one of a plurality of estimation models and estimating biometric information based on the first feature by using the selected estimation model.

title: Video data quality improving method and apparatus
description: A method for improving image illuminance according to an embodiment of the present invention includes receiving an original video data image, classifying and aligning images according to illuminance for image improvement processing in the original video data image, and then for image improvement. The image is processed according to the image enhancement neural network according to the properties of the image classified from the neural network group to generate a high illuminance image for the image area, so that an image with improved illuminance can be reproduced. The neural network for image improvement of the present invention may be a deep neural network generated through machine learning, and image input and output may be performed in an IoT environment using a 5G network.

title: Low Power Deep Learning Accelerator
description: As a measure to enable effective and efficient low-power operation of a deep learning acceleration device, the deep learning acceleration device for controlling power application is provided for each storage block and each operation block individually. The deep learning acceleration device according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a memory divided into a plurality of storage blocks; a processor divided into a plurality of operation blocks; and a power controller that individually controls application of power to each storage block and individually controls application of power to each operation block. Therefore, in the deep learning acceleration device, the application of power is controlled individually for each storage block and for each operation block, thereby being capable of enabling effective and efficient low-power operation of the deep learning acceleration device.

title: Apparatus for disturbance compensation when driving on a curved road and method thereof
description: Disturbance compensation device when driving on a curved road according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a camera for acquiring a front image of a vehicle, a sensor for acquiring a driving speed of the vehicle, a driving steering angle that is steering angle information collected while the vehicle is driving, and the front A convolutional neural network that calculates a compensated steering angle by comparing the calculated steering angle, which is steering angle information learned by receiving the image and the driving speed, and if the compensated steering angle is less than or equal to a predetermined threshold value, the speed of the vehicle increases up to a preset speed and, when the compensation steering angle exceeds a predetermined threshold, a reinforcement learning neural network configured to decrease the speed of the vehicle up to a preset speed.

title: Electronic device and operating method for the same
description: According to an embodiment disclosed, an electronic device performing inference by using a neural network includes a memory to store information on the neural network and at least one instruction, and a processor to execute the at least one instruction stored in the memory. The processor includes a plurality of accelerators, and the neural network includes a common block and a selectable block set. The processor acquires inference time information of the neural network with respect to each of the plurality of accelerators, based on information on the neural network, determines an accelerator for performing inference of the neural network of the plurality of accelerators, based on the inference time information, selects a candidate block, which is optimized for the determined accelerator, of the plurality of candidate blocks included in the selectable block set, and infers the neural network by using the common block and the selected candidate block.

title: Method for providing mode of hearing ear earphones with hear mode and music mode and the system thereof
description: The present invention relates to a method of providing a mode of hearing aid earphones providing an external sound and a music sound set with a customized decibel suitable for a hearing condition of a user in a hear mode of a hearing aid function and a music mode of an earphone function, and a system thereof. The system for providing a mode of hearing aid earphones includes: a sound input part inputting an external sound from the hearing aid earphones; a mode selection part selecting at least one mode among a hear mode of a hearing aid function and a music mode of an earphone function; a mode processing part amplifying or reducing the external sound in accordance with a customized decibel supplementing the hearing of each of the right and left ears of a user in the hear mode, and amplifying or reducing a music sound in accordance with the customized decibel in the music mode; and a sound output part outputting the amplified or reduced external and music sounds to the hearing aid earphones. Therefore, the present invention enables a user to listen to music with high quality.

title: How to determine the uncertainty of a deep learning netwrok
description: The present invention relates to a method for determining an uncertainty of a deep learning network. The method comprises the steps of: performing Gaussian modeling on a boundary box (Bbox) area and a mask area included in a prediction head of an object segmentation model which performs real-time processing, respectively; designing a loss function associated with the prediction head based on results of the Gaussian modeling; and extracting uncertainties related to the boundary box (Bbox) area and the mask area using the designed loss function. According to the method for determining an uncertainty, suggested by the present invention, the method has an advantage of obtaining a low-speed penalty and excellent mask accuracy by extending Gaussian modeling, which was applied only to an object boundary region in a conventional case, to the mask area. In addition, a Gaussian mask achieves an effect of preventing accidents in real applications by significantly incorrectly-segmented object by balancing the reliability scores of the mask and an object to be detected.

title: Global Non-Face-To-Face Clothing Self-Design System Based On AI Preparing For Post-Corona
description: The present invention relates to an AI-based global non-face-to-face fashion apparel user optimization design system in preparation for post-COVID, and more specifically, to a system for allowing an oversea user to directly request a local manufacturer to design an optimized design suitable for a local area by using desired materials and subsidiary materials in a non-face-to-face manner in line with a post-COVID era, to produce a self-made garment. At this time, it has been designed to add a function that utilizes big data-based AI so that consumers can design comfortably.

title: Method for early diagnosis of cancer using cell-free DNA by modeling tissue-specific chromatin structure based on Artificial intelligence
description: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence (AI)-based method for early diagnosis of cancer and, more specifically, to an artificial intelligence (AI)-based method for early diagnosis of cancer using a method of performing analysis by inputting information on cell-free DNA distribution in a tissue-specific adjustment area into an AI model trained for diagnosing cancer early. According to the present invention, a method for early diagnosis of cancer has high accuracy and sensitivity and thus has high commercial utilization since it diagnoses cancer early based on AI by using cell-free nucleic acid distribution in a tissue-specific adjustment area acquired by next generation sequencing (NGS). Therefore, the method of the present invention is useful for early diagnosis of cancer.

title: Geometric calibration method and apparatus of computer tomography
description: The geometry correction device detects a plurality of points from a plurality of projection areas in which a plurality of markers disposed on a phantom are projected in two dimensions by a computed tomography device, inputs data corresponding to each point into a learning model, and inputs data corresponding to each point to a learning model. An output vector including a probability distribution representing a probability of being a projection of each of a plurality of markers is calculated. The geometric correction device extracts a predetermined number of samples based on a probability distribution, converts a correspondence between a marker determined based on a sample from among a plurality of markers and a point determined based on a sample among a plurality of points, and converts a candidate projection matrix. is obtained, calculates the points where the plurality of markers are transformed by the candidate projection matrix, calculates the difference between the set of transformed points and the set of detected points, and designates the candidate projection matrix as the projection matrix if the difference is less than or equal to a threshold value. .

title: Quality control for sealed lens packages
description: A method for quality control of a sealed contact lens package includes placing a package of sealed contact lenses in a light box, causing the package to be illuminated in the light box by a light source, image data of the illuminated package in the light box. Capturing, analyzing image data of the illuminated packages in the light box based on one or more quality control models, and based on the analysis, causing the output of quality control metrics indicative of at least acceptance or rejection conditions of the packages. steps may be included.

title: A method for predicting NOx concentration at the inlet of denitration system
description: The invention discloses a method for predicting NOx concentration at the inlet of a denitration system. The method is based on historical data, and the mapping relationship between indicators is learned from the historical data. Models and predictions. The GBDT algorithm model is used to learn the historical data, predict the delay time of the indicators, and comprehensively analyze the information of multiple related indicators according to the predicted delay time, and use the RNN algorithm to learn the impact relationship of the related indicators on the target indicators, so as to predict the target. The corresponding value of the indicator.
