The method has a fast prediction speed and can automatically predict the index value, which better solves the need to master the delay time of the index measurement value and the prediction of the relevant index in the actual work of denitrification optimization.

title: Image quality adjustment method and device
description: The present application provides an image quality adjustment method and device. The method includes: in the image quality adjustment strategy training process, based on the currently used image quality adjustment strategy, performing a preset number of image quality adjustment actions, and based on the preset number of times Based on the reward value corresponding to the image quality adjustment action, the currently used image quality adjustment strategy is updated until the preset strategy update completion condition is reached; based on the trained image quality adjustment strategy, the image quality of the newly input target of interest is adjusted Image quality adjustment. The method can reduce the dependence of image quality adjustment on manual experience, realize automatic learning of image quality adjustment, and improve the performance of image quality adjustment.

title: Method, apparatus, computing device and medium for recognizing face image
description: The present disclosure provides a method for recognizing a face image, which can be used in information security or other fields. The method includes: acquiring a face image to be recognized; using a preset neural network model to determine the face feature data of the face image to be recognized; determining multiple pieces of data according to the face feature data; Encrypt to obtain a plurality of ciphertext fragment data; send the plurality of ciphertext fragmentation data to the server device, so that the server device generates a recognition result for the face image to be recognized according to the plurality of ciphertext fragmentation data; And receive the identification result from the server device. The present disclosure also provides an apparatus for recognizing a face image, another method for recognizing a face image, another apparatus for recognizing a face image, a computing device, a computer storage medium, and a computer program product .

title: Determining Corrections to the Process
description: A method for configuring a semiconductor manufacturing process, the method comprising: obtaining a first value of a first parameter based on a measurement associated with a first operation of a process step in a semiconductor manufacturing process and a first sampling plan; determining, using a recurrent neural network, a predicted value of the first parameter based on the first value; and using the predicted value of the first parameter to configure a subsequent operation of the process step in the semiconductor manufacturing process.

title: A bearing fault database construction method, analysis method and system
description: The present disclosure provides a bearing fault database construction method, analysis method and system for obtaining historical fault identification results; according to the historical fault identification results, a bearing product structure tree is constructed with the component unit grade of the bearing as the minimum unit; Define failure mode, build bearing failure dictionary, and form database. The present disclosure establishes a localized bearing failure database for EMU bearings, and records the analysis of the bearing failure causes, which is of great significance for ensuring operational safety, improving maintenance efficiency, and avoiding unnecessary losses.

title: Neural network training method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present application relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and in particular to a neural network training method, device, electronic device and storage medium. The method includes: performing text enhancement processing on an original text sample to obtain a first text sample and a second text sample; inputting the first text sample into a neural network for enhanced prediction to obtain a first prediction result; inputting the second text sample into The neural network performs enhanced prediction to obtain at least one second prediction result; performs a first semantic enhancement process on the original text sample according to the at least one second prediction result to obtain a first semantic feature vector; performs a second semantic enhancement process on the original text sample, Obtain the second semantic feature vector, and perform label enhancement processing on the original sample label to obtain the first sample label; according to the original text sample, the first semantic feature vector, the second semantic feature vector, the first prediction result, the original sample label and The first sample label, adjust the network parameters of the neural network.

title: A method for monitoring urban dust
description: A method for monitoring urban dust, the monitoring method determines the spatial distribution of the bare surface of the area to be monitored through satellite image data of the area. Further obtain dust monitoring equipment adjacent to the bare surface area, obtain meteorological data, normalized vegetation index data, and dust data at the location of the dust monitoring equipment, and establish a high-value judgment model for dust. Combine the meteorological data of the monitoring area and the normalized vegetation index data to determine the high dust value of each bare surface in the area to be monitored, so that when a bare surface area in the area has a high dust value, the area is identified as a high dust value area, the dust value in the area to be monitored can be dynamically monitored.

title: A prediction method of meteorological temperature and illumination based on deep transfer learning
description: The present invention provides a meteorological temperature and illumination prediction method based on deep migration learning. The specific steps are as follows: obtaining historical data recorded by each meteorological station in a target area, and performing data preprocessing on the historical data to obtain the preprocessing data; The clustering algorithm of density peaks preprocesses the data to classify the meteorological detection points, and calculates the cluster center point of each type; uses each type of data to train the respective spatial prediction neural network module, and according to the optimized spatial prediction neural network module , train its own prediction model for the type data obtained by each cluster; use different input and model structures to predict the temperature and illumination in the target area according to whether there are data samples in the target prediction area, and the present invention is suitable for the target prediction area. Prediction of temperature and sunshine when there is a small amount of sample data or zero sample data.

title: Label joint probability analysis method and system
description: The present invention relates to a label joint probability analysis method and system, including obtaining label data through multiple channels, calculating the probability distribution of label data according to the channel weight corresponding to each channel, generating a label probability statistical table; grouping and combining all label data According to the label combination, the label probability statistics table is split to obtain multiple label probability sub-tables, and the joint probability of all label probability sub-tables is calculated; the joint probability calculation of all label probability sub-tables is integrated to obtain the label probability matrix. The present invention can solve the problem of insufficient discrimination of existing 0-1 tags by expressing the probability of tags, estimate the complete joint probability, make full use of all known conditions, and improve the accuracy of algorithm tags.

title: Method, system and storage medium for automatic extraction of billboards in video
description: The invention provides a method, a system and a storage medium for automatically extracting a billboard in a video, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting video key frames in the video samples based on preset billboard classification information; detecting the billboard corresponding to the billboard classification information in the key frame by adopting a RetinaNet convolutional neural network; when the type of the billboard corresponding to the detection result of each frame and the continuity of the frame meet preset conditions, obtaining fragments of various billboards; and performing classification management on the detected advertising board according to the classification information, and presenting the detected advertising board to the user. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device improve the accuracy and speed of extracting the billboard in the video.

title: System and method for semiconductor chip surface topography metrology
description: Systems and methods for semiconductor chip surface topography metrology are disclosed. One method comprises the following steps: a plurality of interference signals are received by the at least one processor, each interference signal corresponding to a respective one of a plurality of locations on the surface of the semiconductor chip. The plurality of interference signals are transformed by the at least one processor into a plurality of spectral signals, each spectral signal corresponding to a respective one of a plurality of locations on the surface of the semiconductor chip. Classifying, by the at least one processor, the spectral signals into a plurality of classes using a machine learning model, wherein each class corresponds to a region on the surface of the semiconductor chip having the same material. Determining, by the at least one processor, a surface height offset between the surface baseline and the at least one category based at least in part on a calibration signal associated with the region corresponding to the at least one category. Characterizing, by the at least one processor, a surface topography of the semiconductor chip based at least in part on the surface height offset and the interference signal.

title: Image segmentation method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The present disclosure provides an image segmentation method, device, electronic device and computer-readable storage medium; the method includes: extracting underlying image features from an image to be processed, and performing semantic segmentation on the underlying image features to obtain high-level semantic features; The underlying image features are processed by at least one of texture enhancement and texture feature statistics to obtain the underlying texture features; the underlying texture features are used to represent the enhanced texture details of the image to be processed and/or the statistical distribution of texture features; combine high-level semantic features and underlying texture features texture features to obtain semantically segmented images. Through the present disclosure, the accuracy of image segmentation can be improved.

title: A processing method of embedded representation and related equipment
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a processing method and related equipment for embedding a representation, which can be applied to a scene of training a neural network in the field of artificial intelligence, the method is applied to a processing system for embedding the representation, the processing system for embedding the representation comprises a management device, storage equipment of a first processor and storage equipment of a second processor, and the method comprises the following steps: the management device acquires a target request carrying a first characteristic and sent by a first processor, acquires a first embedded characteristic according to a storage address of the first embedded characteristic, and sends the first embedded characteristic to the first processor, wherein the first embedded characteristic is used for the first processor to execute training operation on a neural network, a storage device of the first processor and a storage device of a second processor are used for storing different embedded characteristics, and the first processor and the second processor can be simultaneously utilized to complete reading operation of the embedded characteristic so as to shorten the time for reading the embedded characteristic in the whole training process.

title: Scene recognition method, apparatus, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a scene recognition method, apparatus, computer equipment and storage medium. The method includes: inputting a training image into a feature extraction network of a scene recognition model to be trained to perform feature extraction, obtaining a training feature map, performing scene correlation detection based on the training feature map and a correlation detection network of the scene recognition model, and obtaining the first The first scene correlation of each first sub-feature map in the sub-feature map set; based on the first scene correlation of the first sub-feature map, the training sub-feature maps related to the scene are obtained from the first sub-feature map set by screening ; Perform scene recognition based on the training sub-feature map and the scene recognition network of the scene recognition model, and obtain the predicted scene recognition result corresponding to the training image; adjust the parameters of the scene recognition model based on the predicted scene recognition result. Using this method can improve the accuracy of scene recognition. The scene recognition model in this application may be an artificial intelligence-based neural network model.

title: Video bit enhancement method based on efficient space-time information fusion
description: The invention discloses a video bit enhancement method based on efficient space-time information fusion, which comprises the following steps: constructing a video bit depth enhancement network based on efficient spatio-temporal information fusion; in the training stage, a low bit video sequence of a training set is enhanced to a high bit video sequence through zero filling, a coarse high bit depth video sequence is input into a depth enhancement network and output into a reconstructed high bit depth intermediate frame, a mean square error loss function is adopted in the training period, and an Adam optimizer is adopted to train the network; in the testing stage, the rough high bit depth video sequence is sent into a network loaded with trained model parameters, and the quality of the reconstructed high bit depth intermediate frame is evaluated by adopting objective image quality evaluation. The invention can obtain the high bit depth intermediate frame of the input video sequence with higher quality.

title: Method, device, device and storage medium for virtual number assignment based on logistics information
description: The invention provides a virtual number allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on logistics information. The virtual number allocation method based on logistics information includes: grouping users based on user address information; at least according to the grouping information of users, A virtual number is assigned to a user, wherein the virtual number is bound to the user's real number to communicate with the user. The invention optimizes the allocation of virtual numbers and improves the utilization rate of virtual numbers, so as to reduce the cost of virtual numbers and at the same time ensure that user telephone information is not leaked.

title: Multi-view face synthesis method and system based on generative adversarial network
description: The invention relates to computer vision and pattern recognition technology, and discloses a multi-view face synthesis method and system based on a generative confrontation network. The method and system include: data preparation, obtaining data sets of different identities and postures; frontal face generation, inputting face images x, through the face normalization generator, generate the frontal face image x  frontal  ; frontal face editing, the face editor receives the frontal face image x  frontal  , the face editor controls the frontal face image x  frontal  through the remote control module Generate a face image with a set angle x  -turn  ; face comparison and recognition, the face recognizer compares and recognizes the input face image x and the feature of x  -turn  with the same deflection angle as x generated by face editing; parameter update, according to the distribution The training strategy updates the parameters; iterative training is performed through the training module, and the model parameters are saved. Through the present invention, a realistic multi-view face image is generated, rich identity information is preserved, and the face is rotated at any pose at the same time.

title: A Few-Sample Object Detection Method and System Based on Dynamic Prototype Feature Fusion
description: The invention relates to a few-sample target detection method and a system based on dynamic prototype feature fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1: respectively inputting the support sample and the query sample into a few-sample target detection network, and extracting corresponding support characteristics and query characteristics; step S2: simultaneously inputting the support features and the query features into a dynamic prototype feature generation module to obtain dynamic query features, and simultaneously inputting the support features into an auxiliary detection module for supervision and training; step S3: inputting the dynamic query features into a regional suggestion network to generate a recommendation regional result, and extracting regional query features and regional support features according to the support features and the query features; step S4: inputting the region query feature and the region support feature into the RCNN neural network, performing regression on the bounding box, and classifying the query target. The method provided by the invention improves the expression capability of extracting the characteristics of the few-sample detection network, can adapt to the change of the input scene more flexibly, and has higher robustness.

title: A financial early warning system and early warning method constructed using public data
description: The present invention discloses a financial early warning system constructed by applying public data, comprising: an alarm source search module for monitoring Internet information to obtain input data; an alarm identification and warning sign analysis module for extracting document data features of the process of converting input data into alarms to clarify event information related to the alarmed enterprise; a pre-alarm degree module for predicting the alarm degree information of the enterprise, capable of issuing early warnings for financial risks and dividing risk levels; the present invention also discloses a financial early warning method constructed by applying public data, which can obtain early warning information efficiently, quickly and accurately.

title: Method, electronic device and computer storage medium for task scheduling
description: According to an example embodiment of the present disclosure, a method, electronic device and computer-readable storage medium for task scheduling are provided. The method includes scheduling tasks in the current task set that can be supported by the current available resources for execution if it is determined that the current available resources of the task processing system cannot meet the resource requirements of the current task set to be executed in multiple task sets, the tasks in each task set are independent of each other, based on the unscheduled tasks in the current task set, creating a set of tasks to be scheduled for the next round of scheduling, determining a subset of tasks independent of the tasks in the task set to be scheduled in the next task set after the current task set in multiple task sets, the next task set at least partially depends on the current task set, and moving the subset from the next task set into the task set to be scheduled. Thus, the present scheme can schedule parallel tasks while maximizing the use of currently available resources.

title: Session-based recommendation method and device
description: One or more embodiments of this specification provide a session-based recommendation method and device, using a pre-trained recommendation model for item recommendation, the method includes: constructing a directed session graph according to the session to be predicted; The graph is input to the gated graph neural network, and the item embedding vector is output by the gated graph neural network; the user's dynamic preference is determined according to the user's current preference and the first long-term preference; wherein, the current preference is the The item embedding vector of the last item, the first long-term preference is determined according to the item embedding vector and the importance score of the item; the prediction score of each item is determined according to the dynamic preference and the item embedding vector; according to each item The prediction score of , and output the recommended item. This embodiment can improve the accuracy of item recommendation.

title: A method of using machine learning to remove water mist from the monitoring screen of the drilling platform
description: The invention belongs to the field of combining image processing and machine learning in a specific industry, in particular to a method for removing water mist from a monitoring picture of a drilling platform by using machine learning. In the method, a camera collects video samples of drilling platform monitoring images according to a predetermined frame rate, frames the video samples, takes 8 consecutive images from the video sequence containing fog, and combines them into a video frame sequence. The training set is divided into two parts, A and B, of which part A accounts for 30% of the training set, and the remaining part is B. The training and updating model is used to dewater the monitoring screen of the drilling platform through the model.

title: A method for unmanned lane keeping based on maximum entropy reinforcement learning framework
description: The invention discloses an unmanned lane keeping method based on a maximum entropy reinforcement learning framework, which comprises the following steps: (1) creating an unmanned vehicle simulation road environment; setting an environmental vehicle driving strategy and a pedestrian motion model, and designing a reward function and a collision detection condition; (2) utilizing a deep neural network approximate state value function, an action value function and a strategy, and initializing network parameters; (3) acquiring an initial state of the unmanned vehicle, enabling the unmanned vehicle to interact with the environment, collecting data, and storing the data in a buffer pool; (4) updating the state value function network, the action value function network and the strategy network; (5) updating the target value function network until the strategy network is approximately converged; (6) setting the entropy item coefficient in the state value network optimization target to zero, and continuing training until the strategy network is completely converged; (7) and for the trained strategy model, selecting the action with the maximum probability value to be executed by the unmanned vehicle according to the action probability distribution output by the network.

title: An optimization method for energy storage configuration of power grid in central urban area
description: The present invention provides an optimization method for energy storage configuration of a power grid in a central urban area, including: step S1, establishing a target grid data model, a node electricity price and energy storage capacity correlation model; step S2, determining the DC power flow result of the target grid; step S3, Calculate the node marginal electricity price result and power output; step S4, determine whether the node marginal electricity price rises, if it rises, calculate the rising coefficient and determine the optimal energy storage configuration scheme through the preset node energy storage configuration optimization model; if it does not rise, then According to the preset safety check rules, the safety check is performed on the double-circuit line in the target grid. If the safety check is satisfied, the parameter is modified to a single-circuit line, and the process returns to step S2; when the safety check is not satisfied, the The energy storage configuration at this time is output as the optimal energy storage configuration scheme. The invention eliminates the rising phenomenon of node marginal electricity price caused by line congestion, avoids redundancy and waste of battery capacity in the process of energy storage planning and layout, and realizes the optimization of energy storage configuration capacity.

title: Seismic positioning method and equipment based on fusion of machine learning and dynamic computing
description: The application relates to the technical field of seismic positioning, in particular to a seismic positioning method and equipment based on machine learning and dynamics calculation fusion. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source data, and performing regularization processing on the multi-source data; performing short-time Fourier transform on the regularized data to obtain a time-frequency image as a sample, generating label data for each sample according to the position of a seismic source and three-dimensional Gaussian distribution, and generating a training set and a test set by adopting a cross validation method; carrying out full convolution neural network model training based on the training set, and carrying out precision evaluation on the trained model based on the test set to obtain a trained model; inputting the real-time monitoring data into a trained model to preliminarily estimate the position of a seismic source; and correcting the preliminarily estimated seismic source position by adopting a dynamic calculation model. The method and apparatus enable fast preliminary positioning of the seismic source, and then the accurate seismic source location can be further determined using a dynamic computational model.

title: A Large-scale Radio Signal Recognition Method Based on Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
description: The invention provides a large-scale radio signal identification method based on a deep convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: s1: collecting radio frequency baseband signals of communication radiation source individuals through a receiver to obtain I/Q baseband signals; s2: intercepting a steady-state signal segment of the I/Q baseband signal as a radio frequency fingerprint of a communication radiation source individual; s3: dividing the radio frequency fingerprint into a training sample and a test sample according to the proportion of 4: 1; s4: establishing a deep convolutional neural network and training the deep convolutional neural network by utilizing a training sample and a test sample; s5: and identifying the radio frequency fingerprint by using the trained deep convolution neural network. The large-scale radio signal identification method based on the deep convolutional neural network can prevent the problems of equipment cloning, replay attack, user identity impersonation and the like, accurately identify and authenticate an internet of things object, and improve the identification accuracy and reliability.

title: A method and system for standardizing nursing records in cardiology department
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for standardizing nursing records of a cardiology department, wherein a historical nursing feature set is obtained by extracting features of all images in a first image set; determining a first recovery curve trend according to the historical care feature set; acquiring first image information, and judging whether the first image information is wrong or not based on the trend of a first recovery curve; if the first image information is wrong, first early warning information is obtained; if the first image information is correct, adding the first image information into the first image set to obtain a second image set; the recovery state graph of the first user is optimized by the second set of images. The technical effects that the historical nursing records are utilized to perform trend analysis on the recovery state of the user, the nursing records are judged based on the recovery curve, meanwhile, the neural network model is added to improve the accuracy of the construction of the recovery curve, and the nursing record deviation caused by the experience of medical staff is avoided to influence the post-nursing effect are achieved.

title: An artificial intelligence reinforcement learning service system
description: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence reinforcement learning service system, in particular to the field of reinforcement learning development platforms, which comprises an interface access layer, a service layer, a functional layer, a storage layer, a sorting layer, a model layer and a buffer layer; the interface access layer is an access layer of a cloud service consumer and can enable a reinforcement learning researcher to manage the cloud computing environment of the reinforcement learning researcher in a self-service mode; the service layer comprises a Project-based packaging and management module, a cloud development and debugging environment module and a virtual development environment interface module; the three parts provide various universal or self-defined cloud research environments for field researchers from top to bottom; the platform encapsulates data, algorithms and research environments involved in reinforcement learning research in a form of Project into a virtualized container, opening up an independent testing environment for each user using the platform. The invention provides a visual image of data, which can write codes, debug and preview the data and check the effect in real time for a researcher to analyze and verify the algorithm.

title: An optimization method for the layout of energy storage tram charging station based on genetic algorithm
description: The invention discloses an energy storage type tramcar charging station layout optimization method based on a genetic algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a dynamic model of the energy storage type tramcar according to the running characteristics of the energy storage type tramcar, and establishing a calculation model of a charging station; then establishing a train operation energy consumption model and a vehicle-mounted energy storage device energy state model according to the dynamic model of the energy storage type tramcar and the calculation model of the charging station; then, optimizing the layout of the charging station according to the constraint conditions of the layout optimization of the charging station to obtain an optimal layout optimization objective function of the charging station, wherein the optimal layout optimization objective function of the charging station can enable the vehicle to run through all the intervals, the number of the charging stations is the minimum, and the energy lowest point of the super capacitor is the maximum; and finally, carrying out genetic coding on the layout of the charging station, and optimizing the layout of the energy storage type tramcar charging station by adopting a genetic algorithm. The invention reduces the installation quantity of the charging devices, and reduces the project cost while ensuring the normal running of the train.

title: Hadamard product realization method, device and storage medium
description: The present application discloses a method, device and storage medium for realizing a Hadamard product. The method includes: acquiring a plurality of optical signals to be processed with different wavelengths; inputting the optical signals to be processed into a wavelength division multiplexer; The device feeds the optical signal to be processed to the microring resonator structure; the microring resonator structure includes a plurality of microring resonator groups consisting of two microring resonators with the same radius; the microring resonator structure is applied with corresponding Current, according to the output light intensity to get the result of Hadamard product. In this way, the micro-ring resonator is used as the basis for the realization of the artificial neural network scheme. The wavelength division multiplexer is used to feed the optical signal to be processed into the micro-ring resonator structure, and the effective refractive index and phase of the micro-ring resonator can be changed by current heating. According to the light intensity of the output optical signal, the Hadamard product result can be obtained, and then the simulation solution suitable for the Hadamard product in the optical neural network is realized.

title: A small target face recognition method based on deep learning
description: The invention relates to a small target face recognition method based on deep learning, which includes: constructing a high-to-low generative adversarial network, and inputting the first pixel face image into the trained generative adversarial network to obtain a third pixel close to the real scene. Two-pixel face image; construct a teacher-student network, use the first-pixel face image and the second-pixel face image to train the teacher-student network, and input the second-pixel face image to be recognized into the trained The teacher-student network gets the identification results. The invention can improve the recognition ability of small target face images.

title: Method for processing human weight identification data, method and device for human weight identification
description: The present application provides a method for processing human body weight identification data, a method and device for human weight identification, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the field of computer vision. The method for processing human weight recognition data includes: obtaining first feature information and second feature information from unlabeled data, and then labeling the unlabeled data according to the first feature information and the second feature information, and obtaining corresponding unlabeled data self-labeled data. The method for processing human weight recognition data comprehensively considers various feature information to obtain self-labeled data, which can improve the accuracy of labeling, so that when the human weight recognition model is trained according to the self-labeled data, the accuracy of the human weight recognition model can be improved. accuracy.

title: A high-resolution remote sensing image surface element identification method and storage medium
description: The invention relates to a high-resolution remote sensing image surface element identification method and a storage medium, wherein the surface element identification method includes: step 1: acquiring low-level spatial spectral features; Fusion; step 3: fuse the features fused in step 2 through a mid-level multi-scale feature fusion model; step 4: fuse the features fused in step 3 through a deep multi-level feature fusion model; step 5: output according to step 4 The fusion features of , obtain high-level semantic features; Step 6: Classify the surface elements through the classifier, and obtain the identification results of the surface elements. Compared with the prior art, the present invention has the advantages of high precision, high speed, accuracy and speed, and the like.

title: Robust self-adaptive countermeasure sample generation method based on human visual model
description: The invention discloses a robust self-adaptive countermeasure sample generation method based on a human visual model, which comprises the following steps: searching the most suitable disturbance countermeasure by utilizing a human visual model, and selecting the optimal disturbance embedding area for each image; the pixel with a larger gradient value in the image is disturbed by utilizing a gradient attack mode, so that the loss increasing speed is improved; calculating a dynamic self-adaptive coefficient matrix for the color and the content of each image by designing a noise visible function based on a texture masking theory; the speed of calculating the local variance of the image is improved through filtering type calculation; the intensity and invisibility of the disturbance are effectively controlled to balance by customizing the upper limit and the lower limit of the disturbance. The invention maximizes the disturbance strength on the premise of ensuring that the embedded antagonistic disturbance cannot be observed by human eyes, and the generated antagonistic sample has excellent invisibility and robustness.

title: A method and device for generating image description text
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for generating an image description text, which relate to the technical field of image processing, and the method comprises the following steps: detecting a target area where a target is located; calculating an average pixel value to obtain regional characteristics; extracting features of the first input information to obtain first hidden features; generating a weight coefficient of each target area; weighting and calculating pixel values of pixel points at the same position in each target area to obtain first output information; extracting features of the second input information to obtain second hidden features; obtaining an output word with highest output probability in a preset vocabulary; updating the first input information into information containing the first hidden feature, the obtained output word and the region feature, and returning to the step of obtaining the first hidden feature until the output text meets the output end condition, and determining the output text as the image description text. By applying the scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the accuracy of generating the image description text can be improved.

title: A kind of eye shape recognition method and intelligent device
description: The invention discloses an eye type identification method and intelligent equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a reference image containing face information of a user, performing key point detection on the reference image, and determining eye contour key point information of the user; and according to the eye contour key point information, calculating eye-type geometric characteristic parameters and determining whether the eye-type geometric characteristics meet the corresponding eye-type geometric characteristics, and according to eye-type geometric characteristics corresponding to at least one preset eye type, determining the preset eye type corresponding to the user. The eye shape recognition method and the intelligent device provided by the invention are used for carrying out accurate eye shape recognition, helping a user to make up according with the eye shape characteristics of the user when making up, and solving the problem of low recognition accuracy of the existing eye shape recognition method.

title: A data processing method and related equipment
description: The application relates to the field of artificial intelligence and discloses a data processing method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a transformer model comprising a target network layer and a target module, and processing data to be processed through the transformer model to obtain a data processing result; the target module is used for performing target operation on the feature diagram output of the target network layer to obtain an operation result, and fusing the operation result and the feature diagram output to obtain updated feature diagram output. According to the method and the device, the target module is inserted into the transform model, the operation result generated by the target module is fused with the input, the information carried in the characteristic diagram output by the target network layer in the transform model is increased, and the parameter quantity of the target module and the calculation power cost required during operation are small, so that the data processing precision of the model is improved on the premise of reducing the parameter quantity and calculation power cost of the model.

title: Audio automatic labeling method based on transfer learning
description: The invention discloses an automatic audio labeling method based on transfer learning. The method mainly includes the following steps: data preprocessing, establishing first-level labels according to the distribution of audio labels (for example: music genre, playing instrument, music mood, singer information, etc.), the original data set is divided into data sets containing first-level labels as input to the model; transfer learning uses the knowledge structure learned in the field of image recognition to complete audio classification on small audio data sets, and can also classify unlabeled The audio data of the first-level label is annotated; audio is automatically annotated. The reconstructed data set uses different audio representations as input to build a classifier to learn the time-frequency domain characteristics of the audio signal and perform automatic annotation. The automatic audio annotation method proposed by the present invention can effectively alleviate the problem of extremely sparse original audio annotation data set, increase the diversity and balance of audio annotation, and improve the accuracy of automatic audio annotation.

title: In-vivo relative positioning method and device of wireless capsule endoscope
description: The in-vivo relative positioning method and device for the wireless capsule endoscope realize the relative positioning of the wireless capsule endoscope in an in-vivo deformable tubular environment by training a visual odometer network based on unsupervised learning without changing the hardware of the wireless capsule endoscope, and accurately estimate the position and depth of each image according to a given image sequence by using the trained visual odometer network, thereby improving the positioning accuracy. The visual odometer can be developed by directly using the visual information of the camera of the capsule, a sensor is not additionally added or the capsule is not refitted, the used visual odometer based on unsupervised learning does not need a complicated manual labeling process, and the problem of inelastic deformation of the environment can be solved by trust mask matrix. The invention uses visual information to relatively position the wireless capsule endoscope in the body, and is more practical in practical clinical application compared with the existing method.

title: Sketch work rating method and device based on model fusion
description: The invention relates to a sketch work rating method and device based on model fusion. The sketch work rating method based on model fusion comprises the following steps: obtaining a sketch work to be rated; constructing a sketch rating model, wherein the sketch rating model is obtained by fusing a first sub-model and a second sub-model, the first sub-model is a ResNeSt model, and the second sub-model is an LSTM model; and inputting the sketch work to be rated into the sketch work rating model to obtain a rating result of the sketch work. The sketch work rating method based on model fusion is based on ResNeSt and LSTM migration models, the model fusion results are weighted and averaged to obtain the final result, and the method has the advantage of being more stable and reliable in result. Corresponding to the method, the invention also provides a sketch grading device based on model fusion.

title: Character image processing method, device, and ancient Chinese book image recognition method
description: The application discloses a character image processing method, which comprises the following steps: performing clustering operation on the single character image to obtain a clustering result; according to the character occurrence frequency, screening out high-frequency single character images from the clustering results, and taking characters corresponding to the high-frequency single character images as labels of the high-frequency single character images; obtaining a few-sample classification model according to the high-frequency single character image and the label of the high-frequency single character image; identifying the single character image by using the few-sample classification model to obtain a label of the single character image; and obtaining a single character image classification model according to the single character image and the label of the single character image. By adopting the method, the marking difficulty of character images of ancient Chinese books and the like is reduced.

title: Data processing device and data processing method
description: A data processing device and a data processing method. The data processing device is used for data processing of a neural network, the neural network includes at least one first processing layer and at least one second processing layer, the data processing device includes: a first memristor array, including a plurality of first memristor units arranged in an array, and configured to store a weight value matrix corresponding to at least one first processing layer; a second memristor array, including a plurality of second memristor units arranged in an array, and configured to store a weight value matrix corresponding to at least one second processing layer; wherein the data retention of the plurality of first memristor units is better than the data retention of the plurality of second memristor units, and/or the durability of the plurality of second memristor units is better than the durability of the plurality of first memristor units. The data processing device uses two memristor units with different durability and data retention, which facilitates the flexible implementation of neural network weight layers with different requirements for memristor units.

title: A method for realizing momentum recoil, and a method and device for constructing quantum logic gates
description: A method for realizing momentum recoil, a method and a device for constructing a quantum logic gate comprise the following steps: selecting an ion qubit comprising a first long life energy level and a second long life energy level; irradiating the selected ion qubit by preset pulsed laser to enable the ion qubit to generate resonance transition between a first long-life energy level and an excited state energy level; wherein the frequency of the pulsed laser is equal to the absolute value of the frequency difference between the first long-life level and the excited state level, and the duration length of a single laser pulse of the pulsed laser is in the femtosecond order; the coding basis vector of the ion qubit is the two zeeman sublevels of the first long-lived level; the first long life energy level and the second long life energy level may be coherently transferred. The embodiment of the invention realizes spin-dependent momentum kick (SDK) through resonance transition, and suppresses the decoherence error caused by spontaneous radiation of ion qubits; only the ion quantum bit in a specific spin state is excited to generate resonance transition, so that the fidelity of realizing the SDK is improved.

title: Image reflection elimination method based on panoramic camera
description: The invention discloses an image reflection elimination method based on panoramic photography, relates to the technical field of image processing, and solves the corresponding problems of the reflection elimination method adopted in the prior art. A reflection alignment method is provided to convert a reflection scene in the panoramic image into a corresponding glass reflection image, and the designed background recovery network recovers a high-quality background image according to the guidance of the glass reflection image. And a single panoramic image with a glass reflection interference area is used, so that the difficulty of data acquisition is greatly reduced.

title: Handwriting recognition method, touch display device, computer device and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a handwriting recognition method, touch display equipment, computer equipment and a storage medium. In a specific embodiment, the handwriting recognition method comprises the steps of obtaining sampling points in a writing track of a character set which is input by a user through handwriting of a touch screen, determining track points of the character set, wherein parameters of the track points comprise coordinate parameters and time parameters, preprocessing the track points of the character set, including resampling each continuous track formed by the track points of the character set to enable track point density of each continuous track to be equal to a set density value, and inputting the track points of the preprocessed character set into a trained handwriting recognition model to recognize the character set which is input by the user through handwriting. The handwriting recognition method of the embodiment has the advantages of being high in operation convenience, high in recognition accuracy, wide in application range and the like.

title: Target detection method and device, storage medium and electronic device
description: The application discloses a target detection method, a target detection device, a storage medium and an electronic device, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting an image to be detected into a first detection network to obtain a first detection result output by the first detection network, wherein the first detection result is used for indicating a first target frame containing a detection target in the image to be detected, carrying out feature fusion on first multi-scale features corresponding to the first detection network based on the first target frame to obtain a first fusion feature map, wherein the first multi-scale features are feature maps extracted from the image to be detected by a plurality of feature extraction networks of the first detection network, inputting the first fusion feature map into a second detection network to obtain a second detection result, and the second detection result is used for indicating a second target frame containing the detection target in the image to be detected. The application solves the problem that the target detection method in the related technology has low accuracy in predicting the position of the detection target in the image.

title: A method and system for train braking fault detection based on graph convolutional neural network
description: The invention relates to a train braking fault detection method and system based on a graph convolution neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring train brake fault data and a connection relation between monitors, and constructing a train brake fault sample set according to the train brake fault data and the connection relation; constructing a standard adjacency matrix according to the connection relation among the monitors; constructing a self-adaptive adjacency matrix according to the train braking fault data; constructing a train braking fault detection model according to the standard adjacency matrix and the self-adaptive adjacency matrix; training the train braking fault detection model by using the train braking fault sample set to obtain a trained train braking fault detection model; and detecting the train braking fault by using the trained train braking fault detection model. The invention can effectively detect the braking fault and the fault type thereof in the running process of the train, thereby ensuring the safety and the reliability of the running of the train.

title: A method and device for panoramic monitoring of power supply status based on cloud deployment
description: The present invention discloses a method and device for panoramic monitoring of power supply status based on cloud deployment, wherein the method includes: collecting multi-source heterogeneous signal data of a power supply terminal based on a data acquisition sensor, and performing multi-source heterogeneous signal data on the multi-source heterogeneous signal data. Perform unified processing to obtain unified signal data; upload the unified signal data to the virtual data server based on the virtual interface server for partitioned storage processing; the virtual computing server extracts unified signal data from the partitioned storage of the virtual data server based on business instructions, Perform service analysis and processing on the extracted unified signal data to obtain analysis results; push the analysis results to the terminal, and generate a user playback interface with browser software on the terminal based on the extensible markup language to perform analysis on the analysis results. Play the show. In the embodiment of the present invention, the relevant management users can intuitively monitor the power supply in a panoramic view, so as to know the health status of the power supply in time.

title: An Economical Optimal Distribution Method of Thermal Power Load Based on Grey Wolf Algorithm
description: The invention discloses an economical optimal distribution method of thermal power load based on the gray wolf algorithm, which comprises the following steps: 1) under the condition that the thermal and electrical load dispatching requirements of the power grid and the thermal network and the limited conditions of the operation of each unit are met, the The operating parameters of each unit are variables, and the economical distribution mathematical model of thermoelectric load is established with the goal of minimizing the operating cost of the power plant; 2) Based on the gray wolf algorithm, the economical distribution mathematical model of thermoelectric load is solved, and then the thermoelectric load is calculated according to the solution results. Economical optimal distribution, the method can realize the economical optimal distribution of thermal and electrical loads, and the calculation complexity is low.

title: Power transmission line clamp inclination quantitative analysis method based on key point detection
description: The invention discloses a quantitative analysis method for the inclination of a power transmission line clamp based on key point detection, which particularly relates to the technical field of power transmission lines, and comprises the following steps of firstly, acquiring images on the power transmission line through an unmanned aerial vehicle and transmitting the images to a remote server through a network; inputting a plurality of target images, and performing feature segmentation and feature extraction and classification of four preset key points, namely an upper key point, a lower key point, a left key point and a right key point, on the images acquired by the unmanned aerial vehicle by adopting a CNN (computer network; and step three, creating a Redis non-relational database, and storing the feature attributes and corresponding image data after CNN feature extraction and classification in the database in a key value form. The invention has practical popularization value, supports a large number of data structures to be effectively stored and buffered, carries out quantitative analysis on the inclination of the power transmission line clamp so as to obtain fault information, is suitable for processing high access load of a large amount of data, has faster data reading and writing speed, and improves the efficiency of detection work.

title: Image retrieval category determining method, system and image retrieval method
description: The invention discloses a method for determining an image retrieval category, which includes: inputting an image to be queried into a preset image classification network model to output a first image feature code corresponding to the image to be queried and a plurality of first images belonging to the image to be queried the first probability of the category; calculating the first similarity value between the first image feature code and the second image feature code of each sample image in the image library to select a first preset number of target images, wherein each target The image carries a second similarity value and a second image category related to the image to be queried; based on the first probability that the image to be queried belongs to multiple first image categories, the second similarity value of each target image, and the second image category. The image category determines the final retrieval category of the image to be queried. The present invention improves the accuracy of final search category determination.

title: Cross-domain adaptive SAR image classification method, device and equipment based on simulation data
description: The application relates to a cross-domain self-adaptive SAR image classification method, device and equipment based on simulation data. The SAR imaging conditions are introduced into the training process of the model, the domain confusion measurement between the two domains is calculated by using the source domain simulation image and the target domain simulation image according to the imaging conditions, the model is trained to reduce the domain difference between the source domain and the target domain, meanwhile, the model is further trained by using the source domain actual measurement image, so that the model has the function of classifying and identifying, and finally, the target classification model obtained by training can better identify targets in the target domain SAR image which is different from the source domain imaging conditions, and has higher accuracy in classifying the targets.

title: Text processing method and device
description: The present application provides a text processing method and device. In the present application, since the user inputs voice into the electronic device based on the guide text output by the electronic device, the content of the guide text output by the electronic device and the content of the voice input by the user on the electronic device have an internal logical association and an internal content association, therefore, the recognized text can be corrected based on the first pinyin, the second pinyin and the guide text, so that the recognized text after the correction can be the text corresponding to the content that the user wants to express, and then the intention of the recognized user can be determined based on the recognized text after the correction, and the user can be given a corresponding reply according to the consultation intention, so that the content of the reply output by the electronic device to the user later is consistent with the actual conversation content that the user wants, and then the user's problem can be solved to improve the user experience.

title: Training method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium of target detection model
description: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a training method, device, electronic equipment, and storage medium of a target detection model. The method includes: classifying and regressing candidate sample areas in an image through forward propagation of a target detection network to obtain candidate sample areas in an image. The classification confidence and regression position of the sample; according to the classification confidence and regression position of the candidate sample and the position of the reference sample area, determine the loss weight information adopted by the candidate sample area in the model training process; wherein the reference sample area Including the ignored sample area corresponding to the fuzzy target in the image and the difficult sample area in the image; according to the loss weight information used in the candidate sample area, backpropagation is performed, and the parameters of the target detection network are controlled to suppress ignored samples and enhance difficult samples. Adjust to get the trained object detection model. Realize the learning of the enhanced model on difficult samples and the suppression model's attention on neglected samples.

title: A Circuit Breaker Performance Status Detection Method Based on R-NCC Image Recognition Algorithm
description: The invention relates to a circuit breaker performance state detection method based on an R-NCC image recognition algorithm, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an image sequence of a circuit breaker opening and closing process, acquiring a circuit breaker opening and closing characteristic X, acquiring a circuit breaker performance state neural network evaluation function F (X) in the third step, and evaluating any circuit breaker performance state in the fourth step; the invention has the advantages that: the characteristic X of the opening and closing of the circuit breaker is obtained through the image sequence, and the evaluation on the performance state of any circuit breaker of the same model is realized through the circuit breaker performance state neural network evaluation function F (X).

title: Detection method, equipment and system for abnormality of substation
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image detection, and provides a method, equipment and a system for detecting transformer substation abnormity in an implementation mode. The detection method for the transformer substation abnormity comprises the following steps: training a detection model based on deep learning by adopting a data sample of a transformer substation monitoring picture to obtain a well-trained detection model based on deep learning; inputting the monitoring picture of the transformer substation to be detected into the trained detection model based on deep learning to obtain a detection result; wherein the deep learning based detection model comprises: the method comprises the steps of extracting a MobileNetv2 network of picture features from the substation monitoring picture to be detected, and identifying a Yolov3 network of foreign matter types corresponding to the picture features. The implementation method provided by the invention reduces the calculated amount and complexity of the model, and improves the detection speed and the detection accuracy of the transformer substation abnormity.

title: Traffic element identification method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
description: The application provides a traffic element identification method, a device, equipment and a computer readable storage medium; the method comprises the steps of detecting traffic elements of an obtained road image to obtain traffic elements to be classified, predicting characteristics to be classified and a plurality of spatial potential field characteristics corresponding to the traffic element templates from the traffic elements to be classified and the obtained traffic element templates, wherein the spatial potential field characteristics represent attraction or rejection degrees between the traffic elements to be classified and the traffic element templates, searching matching element templates corresponding to the traffic elements to be classified from the traffic element templates according to the spatial potential field characteristics and the traffic element templates, and determining the categories corresponding to the matching element templates as target categories of the traffic elements to be classified. The application can improve the accuracy of the identification of the traffic elements.

title: A voiceprint recognition method based on multi-feature fusion
description: The invention discloses a multi-feature fusion voiceprint recognition method, which is different from the traditional feature fusion method and can be used for carrying out fusion based on two feature parameters in the traditional method. The method proposes to fuse three characteristics of MFCC, LPC and PLP and select the dimension with main information, and the problem of overhigh dimension is not caused even though the three characteristic parameters are adopted. The fusion characteristic parameters of the invention have respective advantages of various types of voice characteristic parameters and respective potential implicit information, and the individual characteristics of the speaker can be better shown by fusing different characteristics, thereby improving the accuracy of voiceprint recognition.

title: Neural network computing method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
description: The application discloses a neural network computing method, a device, equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the neural network computing method comprises the following steps: acquiring the cache occupation amount required by each operator in the neural network model when data operation is performed; determining the priority of each branch when the neural network calculation is executed according to the cache occupation amount required by the operator of each branch in the neural network model; and sequentially executing the data operation of each branch in the neural network model according to the priority. The present application is directed to increasing cache utilization, and thus increasing the speed at which neural network computations are performed.

title: Recommended methods and related devices
description: The application discloses a recommendation method and a related device, relates to the technical field of data processing, and aims to realize more accurate recommendation. The main technical scheme of the application is as follows: acquiring user behavior diagram data which comprises N user identifications, M first entity identifications and a first incidence relation between each user identification and at least one first entity identification; acquiring knowledge graph data which comprises K second entity identifications and a second incidence relation between each second entity identification and at least one other second entity identification; inputting the user behavior diagram data and the knowledge graph data into a recommendation model, and outputting a recommendation result; the recommendation model comprises a bidirectional cyclic processing network, a recommendation network and a feature learning network, wherein the bidirectional cyclic processing network is used for realizing the mutual evolution of a first entity vector and a second entity vector, the first entity vector is transmitted to the bidirectional cyclic processing network by the recommendation network, and the second entity vector is transmitted to the bidirectional cyclic processing network by the feature learning network.

title: Hybrid neural network model prediction method and system for three degrees of freedom of ship
description: The invention provides a method and a system for predicting a three-degree-of-freedom hybrid neural network model of a ship, which comprises the steps of acquiring original ship shaking attitude data by an attitude sensor arranged on the ship, and decoding the original ship shaking attitude data by resampling to obtain a ship shaking attitude time sequence; carrying out self-adaptive decomposition on the ship shaking posture time sequence by a self-adaptive empirical wavelet transform method to obtain a plurality of decomposed subsequences, forming a subsequence matrix to reduce the nonlinear non-stationarity of three-degree-of-freedom ship motion, and dividing the subsequence into a training set, a verification set and a test set; the bidirectional long and short term memory network is introduced to learn the time characteristics of three degrees of freedom of the ship from the past and the future, the hybrid optimization algorithm combining the gravity search algorithm and the particle swarm algorithm is used for optimizing the number of nodes of the hidden layer and the learning rate, and the results are predicted and output based on the optimized bidirectional long and short term memory network. The method improves the stability and accuracy of the three-degree-of-freedom prediction of the ship.

title: Intelligent drug efficacy evaluation method based on machine learning and application thereof
description: The invention discloses an intelligent drug efficacy evaluation method based on machine learning and application thereof, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a mapping relation between a drug and a corresponding target treatment disease or symptom; extracting the corresponding potential side effects of the medicines, and calculating similarity indexes among the medicines; labeling the data on the medicine line to mark whether the medicine is effective or not, structuring the text data of the medicine, and extracting multi-dimensional crowd information and medicine and treatment related feature vectors; dividing the structured data into a training set and a verification set, establishing an integrated prediction model and selecting a scheme with optimal prediction effect by utilizing various algorithms and different characteristic variable selection mechanisms; and finally, obtaining the effective rate ranking of the similar medicines according to the medicine similarity index and realizing various functions of medicine curative effect evaluation through the application.

title: A kind of code retrieval method, system and computer readable storage medium based on graph neural network
description: The invention discloses a code retrieval method, system and computer-readable storage medium based on a graph neural network. The method includes: S1: acquiring code data and performing code integrity preprocessing; S2: extracting sequence information of the preprocessed code respectively , control flow graph information, program dependency graph information; S3: use code sequence information, control flow graph information, and program dependency graph information to construct code sequence code graphs; S4: build a code retrieval model based on graph neural network, using code-based The code graph and natural language description of the sequence train the code retrieval model based on the graph neural network; S5: use the trained code retrieval model based on the graph neural network to retrieve the code. The code semantics and structural feature extraction of the present invention is more complete, and a single graph neural network structure is adopted at the same time, which shortens the training time of the model, reduces the adjustment of parameters, and improves the retrieval accuracy.

title: A method for handling classification relationships in dynamic uncertain causal graphs
description: The invention provides a computer readable storage medium, which is characterized in that a computer program is stored on the storage medium, when the computer program is executed, the construction and reasoning method of an intelligent system for processing information of uncertain causal relation and classification relation can be executed, the method is based on the existing DUCG technical scheme, an expression method of a classification variable C  i  and a reasoning method thereof are added, in the reasoning process, C  i  and an input directed arc thereof are deleted, and an output directed arc thereof is directly connected with V  k , namely V  k  is used as a father variable of X  n , F  n;i  becomes F  n;k  at the moment, parameter values embedded therein are unchanged, and then reasoning calculation is carried out according to the existing DUCG reasoning method to obtain a reasoning result of the DUCG. Therefore, the problem that the existing DUCG is easy to cause expression errors (possibly causing reasoning calculation errors) or inconvenient because the classification relation cannot be expressed is solved.

title: An Interpretable Android Malware Detection Method Based on Concept Drift
description: The invention discloses an interpretable Android malware detection method oriented to concept drift, which belongs to the field of information security technology, including introducing detection features through artificial Android malware analysis reports, improving traditional feature packaging based on automatic machine learning algorithms and interpretable algorithms , and integrate the same distribution test and transfer learning algorithm. The invention improves the interpretability of the Android malware detection model, is beneficial to reverse analysts to manually verify the detection model, reduces the impact of the concept drift problem on the accuracy of the detection model, and is beneficial to the low-cost long-term maintenance of high accuracy of the detection model. It is used in the detection and analysis of Android malicious application software.

title: A method and system for processing and confirming an enterprise statement mail
description: The invention provides a method and a system for processing and confirming an enterprise statement mail, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining first mail information sent by a first mailbox, wherein the first mailbox meets a preset requirement and comprises statement information; acquiring a first reply email according to the first email information, wherein the email body of the first reply email comprises reply content corresponding to the statement of account information; analyzing the content of the first reply e-mail to obtain statement of account reply information, inputting the statement of account reply information into a matching analysis model, wherein the matching analysis model is obtained by training and converging a plurality of groups of training data, and each group of training data comprises statement of account reply information and identification information for identifying a reply result; and obtaining an output result of the matching analysis model, wherein the output result comprises matching reply information, and the state of the bill information is changed and stored. The technical problems that in the prior art, due to the fact that mail confirmation is carried out manually, real-time performance is poor and efficiency is low are solved.

title: An encryption system and method for preventing leakage of image cloud storage
description: The invention discloses an image cloud storage anti-leakage encryption system and method. The encryption system comprises the following modules: an image encryption method selection module; a data acquisition and preprocessing module; a depth feature extraction module; an image encryption module; an image decryption module; a distributed module; and a service stability maintaining module. The encryption method based on the multi-level image realizes the personalized formulation of the privacy protection strategy of the personal image data by the user, effectively ensures the safety of the cloud image data and has strong universality.

title: Using semi-supervised deep learning to understand query intent to medical artificial intelligence systems
description: A method and apparatus are provided for receiving a query comprising a sequence of a plurality of terms. The sequence of words is converted into a sequence of feature vectors. A bidirectional long-short time memory (LSTM) is used to generate semantic meanings for a sequence of multiple words. The LSTM is regularized based on the generated semantic meaning of a sequence of a plurality of feature vectors using a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM).

title: Method, apparatus, device and computer storage medium for training resource allocation model
description: Embodiments of the present invention provide a method, device, equipment, and computer storage medium for training a resource configuration model; the method for training a resource configuration model includes: acquiring emergency vehicle outbound record information of all hospitals in a preset area, and the emergency vehicle outbound record. The information includes: patient characteristics and first-aid resources; a training sample set is generated based on the first-aid ride record information, and the training sample set indicates the corresponding relationship between patient characteristics and first-aid resources; based on the training sample set, a neural network model is trained as a resource allocation model; according to this The method for training a resource configuration model according to the embodiment of the invention can train a resource configuration model reflecting the mapping between patient characteristics and first aid resources according to the emergency car-out record information, and the resource configuration model can be used to quickly and accurately obtain the characteristics that should be configured for the patient to be rescued. First aid resource allocation information, solves the problem of inaccurate and slow decision of first aid resource allocation based on manual experience.

title: Game theory-based optimization method for integrated aluminum alloy precision casting anti-collision beam structure
description: The invention discloses an integrated aluminum alloy precision casting anti-collision beam structure optimization method based on game theory, belonging to the technical field of anti-collision beam structure design and optimization. The thickness sample data of each part is obtained, and then the quadratic response surface approximate model of the maximum longitudinal displacement, peak collision force, mass and specific energy absorption is constructed; Design a multi-objective game. The invention only optimizes the thickness parameters of each part of the aluminum alloy anti-collision beam assembly, and through the multi-objective game design, the collision resistance of the anti-collision beam is improved, the mass of the anti-collision beam is greatly reduced, and the anti-collision beam is realized. Structural optimization design of beams.

title: A Scalable Collaborative Approach to Energy Management for Communities with Large-Scale Prosumers
