description: The invention discloses an extensible energy management collaborative method for communities containing large-scale producers and consumers, which firstly provides a method for combining parameter sharing with a priority depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, and improves learning efficiency and reduces training difficulty through strategy and experience sharing among intelligent agents. Secondly, constructing an end-to-end transaction platform to cooperate with the electric energy transaction and sharing of producers and consumers in the community; performing bonus corrections to avoid bounce peaks to protect safe operation of the local distribution network; the trusted third party provides global information about community markets for the producers and the consumers, so that the privacy of each producer and the consumer is protected, the environmental non-statics are effectively reduced, and the expandability of the algorithm is improved. Finally, through the embodiment verification, the interaction and collaborative optimization of multiple producers and consumers in a large-scale energy community can be assisted, privacy information of the producers and consumers is protected, the operation cost of the producers and consumers is reduced, and compared with the prior art, the operation efficiency is improved, and the operation complexity is reduced.

title: System and method for labeling ultrasound data
description: A method for marking ultrasound data is provided. The method may include training a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based on the ultrasound data. The ultrasound data may include ultrasound waveform data (e.g., radio Frequency (RF) waveform data). The radio frequency input at each of a plurality of downsampling layers in the CNN may be downsampled. The radio frequency input may include radio frequency waveform data for ultrasound. Tissue in the ultrasound may be segmented based on the output of the CNN. A system is also disclosed.

title: Communication method, device and computer program product
description: An apparatus, method, and computer program are described that include components for converting one or more inputs into one or more data symbols at a transmitter of a transmission system using a transmitter algorithm, wherein: the transmission system includes a transmitter that implements the transmitter algorithm, a channel, and a receiver that includes a receiver algorithm; the transmitter algorithm includes trainable parameters for converting one or more received data symbols into one or more outputs; and the transmitter algorithm is stochastic.

title: Image segmentation method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The disclosure provides an image segmentation method, an image segmentation device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of computer vision and deep learning, and can be applied to image processing and image recognition scenes. The specific scheme is as follows: inputting a video image frame to be segmented into an image segmentation model to obtain a target segmentation image, wherein each element in the target segmentation image indicates a target segmentation confidence coefficient that a corresponding pixel point in the video image frame belongs to a foreground object, a target image area with motion blur in the video image frame is determined according to a pixel gradient of each candidate area in the video image frame and a pixel gradient of the video image frame, the target segmentation confidence coefficient corresponding to each pixel point in the target image area is corrected according to a set threshold, the video image frame is segmented according to the corrected target segmentation image, the motion blur area is monitored according to gradient change, and the segmentation result is corrected, so that the accuracy of image segmentation is improved.

title: An intelligent control method for energy storage system to stabilize power transmission section flow of power grid
description: The invention discloses an intelligent control method of an energy storage system for stabilizing the power transmission section tide of a power grid, which models the charge and discharge operation process of a large-scale battery energy storage system connected to the power grid as a Markov decision process, constructs two groups of deep learning Q networks, uses a strategy function to generate actions and interact with the environment by an Actor network group, and uses a cost function to evaluate the performance of the Actor by the Critic network group and guide the action of the Actor in the next stage. Based on the interactive perception of the power grid environment state characteristics and the power flow section stability limit control effect, the four networks obtain the optimal Actor current network parameters and the optimal Critic current network parameters w through updating and iteration, and finally an energy storage intelligent control method based on the combination of strategies and values is determined. The method realizes the effective control of the power flow of the safety and stability limit of the power transmission section of the power grid, and solves the problems of complex uncertainty modeling and poor convergence in the traditional method.

title: A marine diesel engine health control system and control method
description: The invention discloses a ship diesel engine health management and control system, including: a diesel engine, a digital twin module, a data management module, an operation simulation platform module, a twin data processing module, and a health management module; the diesel engine is respectively connected to the digital twin module, the operation simulation platform module, the twin data processing module, and the health management module; the digital twin module is respectively data-interactive with the data management module and the operation simulation platform module; the data management module is data-interactive with the health management module; the data management module is data-interactive with the operation simulation platform module. The invention can timely predict, identify, and solve diesel engine anomalies and faults, effectively evaluate diesel engine performance, improve diesel engine work efficiency, and save maintenance costs.

title: Intelligent machine room cable cross-dimension quality inspection method and device based on example segmentation
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for checking the cable cross-dimension quality of an intelligent machine room based on example segmentation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic information of the cross-dimension inspection request through an information input unit, and generating a task list according to the basic information; acquiring a picture of an area to be inspected in an intersection site through a picture acquisition unit; receiving a picture to be detected through a target extraction unit, and extracting target information from the picture by using a trained deep convolutional neural network classification model and a trained deep convolutional neural network instance segmentation model; receiving target information through a detection judgment unit, and formulating a corresponding judgment rule according to the cross-dimension acceptance requirement to obtain a corresponding detection judgment result; and receiving the judgment result of the target specification through a result feedback unit, summarizing the judgment result to obtain a final cable cross-dimension quality detection result, and feeding the final cable cross-dimension quality detection result back to cross-dimension personnel. The method and the device mainly adopt an example segmentation algorithm, and realize the automatic inspection of the cable cross-dimension quality of the intelligent machine room.

title: Detecting vocabulary skill levels and correcting misalignments in remote interactions
description: The present disclosure relates to detecting lexical skill levels and correcting misalignment in remote interactions. To provide effective communication, individuals participating in the communication should have appropriately matched linguistic proficiency. By ensuring that a customer of a contact center matches an agent that has or presents communication content that utilizes language proficiency appropriate for that customer, efficient communication can be provided. If the agent deviates from and provides communication content with language proficiency that is not aligned with the customer, automatic corrective action can be taken to realign the language proficiency presented to the customer.

title: Method, device, device and storage medium for constructing multimodal power knowledge graph
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for constructing a multi-mode power knowledge graph, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining entity feature vectors of entities related to the electric power field in the same dimensional space based on multi-modal data of the electric power field; determining neighbor entities of each entity through a preset entity triple, and layering each neighbor entity according to a set rule; determining a comprehensive characteristic vector representing the incidence relation between the entities by combining the characteristic vectors of the entities based on an entity relation model formed after layering; and acquiring a power knowledge graph representing the incidence relation among the entities based on the comprehensive characteristic vector. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, multimodal data in the electric power field are represented by unified comprehensive characteristic vectors, and data support is provided for related intelligent application and big data analysis in the electric power field.

title: A method and system for autoencoder recommendation based on mean pooling operation
description: The invention provides a self-encoder recommendation method and system based on mean pooling operation, and belongs to the technical field of recommendation. The system comprises a server part comprising a data acquisition and preparation module, a model training module and a model prediction and recommendation module, wherein the server is connected with a plurality of databases and a plurality of intelligent terminals; the intelligent terminal is used for collecting the relevant information of the user data and sending the relevant information to the database through a network protocol; the database is responsible for storing and extracting data information related to the user; the server cleans and transforms data through a data acquisition and preparation module, then models and solves the data through a model training module, and finally recommends articles for the user through a recommendation module; multiple experiments prove that the method can more fully and effectively utilize data information, has better performance in both the scoring prediction task and the top-N task, and can recommend more interesting items for the user.

title: Method for judging drill holes based on self-coding and gradient lifting tree combined algorithm
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of internet, and particularly discloses a method for judging a drilled hole based on a self-coding and gradient lifting tree combined algorithm, which comprises the following steps: step 1: carrying out normalization processing on drilling sample data; step 2: drilling data set D ═ X 1 ，X 2 ，...，X n‑1 ，X n Divide into training set D 1 And test set D 2 (ii) a And step 3: label-free training set D 1 To trainCollection D 1 Performing stack type self-coding layer training, performing dimension reduction processing on drilling data processing, and outputting data of a hidden layer; and 4, step 4: training set D for data and tape labels of hidden layers 1 Processing, training in a gradient lifting decision tree, and setting a residual function; and 5: and the output layer is an optimal model after the training of the output decision tree. The method can realize the function of batch judgment of the drilling qualification, reduce the drilling design workload of the in-situ leaching well site for in-situ leaching mining personnel, improve the drilling design quality of the in-situ leaching well site, and improve the efficiency and the accuracy of drilling judgment in logging data by the algorithm model.

title: Knowledge fusion method applied to machine translation
description: The invention discloses a knowledge fusion method applied to machine translation, which comprises the following steps: training one or more neural machine translation models as providers of knowledge, namely teacher models, by using a bilingual corpus; translating the source language S in the language database and extracting teacher model knowledge; carrying out knowledge fusion; copying a source language S, splicing, and finally obtaining a corpus after knowledge fusion; training a neural machine translation model for final use; decoding source sentences in a bilingual corpus, firstly, using the same sentence splicing method for corresponding source sentences and using separation symbols for separation, then sending the source sentences into a finally trained neural machine translation model for decoding, then separating decoded results, and realizing knowledge fusion by using separation symbols used in sentence splicing. The invention solves the problem that the knowledge often has more errors, and the knowledge of the teacher model and the knowledge in the real corpus can be fused to form the corpus with rich knowledge.

title: A method for fusion of power equipment status data based on big data
description: The utility model provides a power equipment state data fusion method based on big data, it is firstly builds power equipment information model, and then carries out information extraction integration to the power equipment state data of gathering based on power equipment information model, and calculate based on RPN convolutional neural network and obtain each logic node type analog data, then compare analog data with corresponding standard data, screen out the logic node type that analog data is the same with standard data, then carry out feature extraction to the logic node type example data of screening out, finally carry out space, time axis, redundant data relevance to it, and merge the data after the association into the index of prejudgement analysis data. The design effectively improves the data fusion efficiency of the power equipment.

title: Method and device for obtaining customer requirements
description: The invention discloses a customer demand acquisition method and a device, which relate to the technical field of big data, are used for determining customer demands by analyzing historical work orders so as to improve the accuracy and efficiency of acquiring the customer demands, and comprise the following steps: acquiring a pre-constructed target model, classifying historical work orders through the target model, and determining a customer demand type work order from the historical work orders; clustering the customer demand type work orders according to the customer demand corresponding to each work order in the customer demand type work orders to obtain multiple types of work orders; determining target customer requirements according to the quantity of the work orders of each customer requirement type in the multiple types of work orders; the target customer requirements comprise customer requirements corresponding to the work orders of N customer requirement types with the largest work order quantity, wherein N is a positive integer. The embodiment of the invention is applied to the scene of acquiring the customer requirements.

title: A method for image detection and localization of tunnel diseases based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a method for detecting and locating a tunnel disease image based on deep learning. First, an industrial camera is used to collect a video image in a tunnel; secondly, the obtained video is cropped and preprocessed to obtain a corrected image with uniform brightness; Thirdly, according to the corrected image, extract the pixel column of the image, match the best pixel column, and obtain the panorama of the tunnel image; then, use the panorama of the tunnel image to perform equidistant cropping and calculate the pixel of the tunnel image and the actual distance Then, the cropped tunnel image sequence is sent into the deep learning model for disease detection, and finally, the disease detection result information is stored in the database management system; the invention effectively solves the situation that GPS positioning cannot be provided in the tunnel It can accurately locate the tunnel disease, which is convenient for users to quickly find the location of the disease that needs to be corrected in a long tunnel, and realizes the automation of the disease detection in the tunnel.

title: Training method, device, electronic device and storage medium for sample prediction model
description: The invention provides a training method, device, electronic device and storage medium for a sample prediction model, which belong to the field of data processing. The second sample of the label is predicted to determine the first predicted probability corresponding to the second sample, and the second sample is classified according to the preset classification threshold and the first predicted probability to obtain a pseudo-label, and then based on the first sample and the first predicted probability of the pseudo-label The two-sample training sample prediction model, wherein the preset classification threshold can be obtained by classifying the first sample by using the second prediction probability as the classification threshold, and determining the classification threshold that meets the first classification condition, and the second prediction probability is the first The prediction probability of the model for the first sample, since the first sample is a known label, the classification performance of the first model can be tested by the first sample, which ensures that the first model can classify the second sample to obtain false quality of labels.

title: A fatigue detection method and system based on 3D convolutional network multi-feature fusion
description: The invention relates to a fatigue detection method and system based on multi-feature fusion of a 3D convolutional network. Pre-training an X3D convolutional neural network by utilizing a motion recognition data set to determine a motion classification model; initializing the X3D convolutional neural network by using network weight values in an action classification model, and training the initialized X3D convolutional neural network by using driver video data to determine an initial fatigue detection model; preprocessing the video data of the driver; adding an attention layer in the initial fatigue detection model, and constructing a fatigue detection classification network; training and verifying the fatigue detection classification network by utilizing the preprocessed image to determine a fatigue detection model; and carrying out fatigue detection classification on the video to be detected by using a fatigue detection model. The invention can improve the precision of fatigue detection.

title: Secure Multi-Party Reach and Frequency Estimation
description: Systems and methods for generating a minimum delta count bloom filter to determine counts and frequencies of device identifiers and attributes in a networking environment are disclosed. The system may maintain a set of data records that include device identifiers and attributes associated with devices in the network. The system may generate a vector including coordinates corresponding to the counter register. The system may identify a hash function to update the count bloom filter. The system may hash the data record to extract an index value that points to a set of counter registers. The system may increment a position in the minimum delta count bloom filter corresponding to the minimum value of the counter register. The system may obtain an aggregated public key that includes the public key. The system may encrypt the counter register using the aggregate shared key to generate an encryption vector. The system may transmit the encryption vector to the networked worker computing device.

title: Psoriatic nail image processing method and system based on deep learning
description: The present invention provides a deep learning-based psoriatic nail image processing method and system, including: trimming a nail ROI area from a nail image through a detection network, and segmenting a nail from the nail ROI area through a rough segmentation model Area and nail damage area, the nail cap ROI area and nail damage area are merged by image channel through the fine segmentation model, and the subdivided nail damage area of each symptom is finely segmented. Calculate the proportion of the total area of the nail damage area to the nail cover area, or combine the subdivided nail damage areas of multiple symptoms, increase the weight of the overlapping parts of the subdivided nail damage areas of multiple symptoms, and calculate the combined nail damage area The proportion of the total area to the nail cover area, or, calculate the proportion of the total area of the subdivided nail damage area to the nail cover area. The invention can detect and extract the nail region from the patient's hand photo by the detection network, and perform image segmentation to identify the nail region and the nail damaged image region.

title: Methods for increasing the certainty of parametric model predictions
description: A method for increasing the certainty of a parameterized model prediction is described. The method comprises the following steps: clustering dimension data in a potential space associated with the parameterized model into clusters. Different clusters correspond to different portions of a given input. The method comprises the following steps: the output is predicted based on dimensional data in the underlying space using a parameterized model. The method comprises the following steps: using the parameterized model, the dimensional data in the potential space is transformed into a restored version of the given input corresponding to one or more of the clusters. In some embodiments, the method comprises: determining which clusters correspond to prediction outputs having higher variances and making the parameterized model more descriptive by increasing the dimensionality of the underlying space and/or training the parameterized model with more diverse training data associated with one or more of the determined clusters or portions of clusters associated with higher variances.

title: Method of providing one or more sets of graphics parameters, computer executing a program implementing the method of providing one or more sets of graphics parameters
description: A method of providing optimized settings for graphics parameters of a computer game application, comprising: arranging data related to the setting of the graphic parameters and the corresponding performance values of different computer hardware devices; training a machine learning model based on the collated data; determining, by the trained machine learning model, a weight for each setting of the graphical parameter; for each set of graphical parameters, predicting, by the trained machine learning model, a performance value achievable when the computer game application is executed on a particular type of computer; assigning a priority value to each graphical parameter based on the contribution of each graphical parameter to the performance value; at least one set of graphics parameters that provides optimized performance values is selected or generated based on the predicted performance values associated with each set of graphics parameters and the determined weights for each graphics parameter and/or based on the assigned priority values.

title: Hydropower station runoff and associated source-load power annual scene simulation and prediction method thereof
description: A method for simulating and predicting annual scenarios of runoff from a hydropower station and its associated source-load power comprises the following steps: Step 1: collecting historical daily runoff data of multiple schedulable hydropower stations in a certain area and historical daily power data of their externally associated energy sources and loads; Step 2: clustering the above data by ten days to form typical ten-day scenarios of runoff and source-load power by using a self-organizing map neural network; Step 3: establishing a ten-day state transition probability model for the runoff from a target hydropower station, and simultaneously establishing multi-scenario conditional probability models between the runoff from the target hydropower station and the associated source-load power, and between the runoff from the target hydropower station and the runoffs of other schedulable hydropower stations; Step 4: randomly simulating the source-load power and the schedulable hydropower station runoff time series scenarios in future years, and aggregating them into typical annual time series simulation scenarios of the source-load power and the schedulable hydropower station runoff by using a scenario reduction method; Step 5: predicting the probability of occurrence of each typical scenario.

title: A spatial potential measurement method and system for small sample learning of neural networks
description: The present invention proposes a spatial potential measurement method for neural network small sample learning, including: firstly, feature extraction is performed on the support set and the query set in a certain scenario by a feature embedding extraction network  fθ  , and the feature embedding vector set of the labeled instance and the unlabeled instance is obtained; secondly, the feature embedding vector of the labeled instance is extracted by a charge parameter extraction network  gθ  , and the charge range parameter of the labeled instance is obtained, and the same type of mean fusion is performed; then, the feature embedding vector set of the labeled instance and the charge range parameter of the labeled instance are used to construct a quasi-space electrostatic field, and the superposition potential of the unlabeled instance in the electrostatic field is used as the measurement value between the unlabeled instance and the labeled instance; finally, the category probability and the learning loss are obtained according to the measurement value, and all network parameters are updated by back propagation. The method provided by the present invention can be compatible with most small sample networks with a lower model cost, and further improve the expressiveness of small sample tasks.

title: A crowd gathering alarm method based on transformer technology
description: The present invention provides a crowd gathering alarm method based on transformer technology in the field of image processing technology, comprising the following steps: step S10, obtaining a large number of crowd images and annotating each of the crowd images; step S20, converting the annotated crowd images into a crowd density map; step S30, preprocessing each of the crowd density maps to obtain a training atlas; step S40, creating a crowd counting model based on transformer, and training the crowd counting model using the training atlas; step S50, using the trained crowd counting model to count the video captured by the camera, and then issuing an alarm for crowd gathering. The advantages of the present invention are: greatly improving the accuracy and efficiency of crowd gathering recognition.

title: Text detection method, text recognition method and device
description: The present disclosure provides a text detection method, a text recognition method and a device, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of deep learning and computer vision, and can be applied to scenarios such as optical character recognition. The text detection method is: acquiring an image to be recognized The image features of Chinese text strips, perform visual enhancement processing on the image to be recognized, and obtain the enhanced feature map of the to-be-recognized image, and compare the image features of the text strip with the enhanced feature map to obtain the target of the text strip on the enhanced feature map. bounding box. The enhanced feature map characterizes the features of the image to be recognized from more dimensions, so that the determined bounding box has high accuracy and reliability, and is determined by the similarity comparison between the bounding box of the text bar and the enhanced feature map The bounding box of the text bar can avoid the mismatch between the bounding box and the text bar, so that the bounding box has strong reliability.

title: A Sketch Recognition Method Based on Double Hierarchy Structure
description: The invention discloses a sketch recognition method based on a double-hierarchy structure, which aims at the current situation that most sketch recognition methods do not consider shape characteristics, and provides a method for simultaneously coding shape characteristics and visual characteristics for sketch recognition by using the double-hierarchy structure. Comprising the following steps: and (3) obtaining sketch samples in two formats, constructing a multi-level shape network based on a layering idea of extracting depth features of a convolutional neural network, and constructing a multi-level visual network by constructing a multi-scale residual block, an inner layer residual block and an outer layer residual block. Based on the sketch samples, a shape network is trained using cross entropy loss, and a visual network is trained using cross entropy loss and weight compression triplet center loss. And combining the shape network, the visual network and the multiplication fusion layer to obtain a double-hierarchy structure. And finally, inputting the sketch test sample into the double-hierarchy structure for identification test. The invention does not require that the sketch sample contains stroke information, does not need a fine adjustment process, has simple training process and has obvious advantage of sketch recognition effect.

title: Image processing method and system
description: The invention discloses an image processing method and system, wherein the method includes: a front terminal receives an input picture and reads the picture information, performs de-drying and binarization preprocessing on the picture and outputs it; the rear terminal receives the preprocessed picture , read the processing request of the user, perform a unique identification and encoding operation on the picture, and standardize the name of the encoded picture; carry out deep learning, fix and save the entire processing link above, execute the batch file in the above method, In the processing file, input the name of the picture as parameter information to complete the picture processing process; add an identification code to the processed picture and save it in the local disk; the rear terminal sends the picture with the identification code to the front terminal and then sends it to user. In this method, by performing unique identification coding and standardized naming operations on the picture, the user can ensure the uniqueness of the picture and the processed picture without logging in.

title: Non-feature construction type MOF carbon capture performance prediction method based on deep learning
description: The present invention discloses a non-feature-constructed MOF carbon capture performance prediction method based on deep learning, firstly, using machine learning to predict the importance of each atom for carbon dioxide adsorption performance; then the importance of atoms for carbon dioxide adsorption is ranked as the projection weight of this type of atoms; then, for each atom in the crystallographic information file CIF, the coordinate conversion formula is used to project it to the a-b, b-c, a-c plane to obtain a feature map; finally, the three feature maps of each MOF are trained and predicted using ResNet. The present invention combines machine learning with deep learning methods, and efficiently and accurately predicts the carbon dioxide adsorption performance and  CO2  /  N2  selectivity of a given MOF without the need to construct additional descriptors, using only CIF files as input. The method can significantly reduce the prediction cost, reduce the use threshold and prediction time, and provide the possibility for large-scale screening of databases.

title: A method, device, equipment and storage medium for determining target area in an image
description: The invention is suitable for the technical field of image processing, and provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for determining a target area in an image, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of determining targets and position coordinates of the targets in an image, generating a series of candidate target areas with the position coordinates of the targets as the center according to a preset candidate target area proportion, calculating a target likelihood score of each candidate target area, and determining the candidate target area with the highest score in the target likelihood scores of each target as the target area of each target in the image, so that a user can complete the selection of the target area through one-time simple man-machine interaction operation, the operation process is simplified, and the intelligence degree of the selection of the target area in the image is improved.

title: Scene gas memory and recognition method and application thereof
description: The invention relates to a method and application of scene gas memory and recognition. The steps of scene gas memory are: (1) for a variety of pre-memory different scene gases, respectively collecting the response signal data of the sensing array; (2) to The collected data is processed to extract the characteristics of different scene gases; (3) the characteristics of scene gases are analyzed and calculated to obtain the distribution attributes of the characteristic values, and stored as memory data; the steps of scene gas recognition are: (I) For the pre-identified scene gas, collect the response signal data of the sensor array; (II) perform arithmetic processing on the collected data to extract the characteristics of the scene gas; (III) compare the acquired scene gas characteristics with the memory scene gas characteristics The characteristics are compared to determine whether the scene gas is the memory scene gas category; it can be applied to air purifiers, fresh air systems, range hoods or exhaust fans. The invention can accurately identify the scene gas and has a high degree of intelligence.

title: Artificial intelligence-based automatic acetabular radius measurement method and system
description: An artificial intelligence-based automatic acetabular radius measurement method and system relates to the technical field of acetabular radius measurement, and is used to solve the problem that the prior art cannot accurately and automatically measure the human acetabular radius. The technical points of the present invention include: obtaining the medical image data of the patient through CT and labeling it, preprocessing the multiple labeled CT images, and segmenting the hip joint structure based on the trained segmentation model based on the 2D Unet neural network. , and identify the feature points on the acetabulum through the pre-trained recognition model based on 3D Unet neural network, so as to calculate the radius of the acetabular fossa and complete the measurement of the radius of the acetabulum. The present invention can be used for surgical planning before orthopaedic surgery, and can make the subsequent surgical process more precise, more personalized, and lower in complications. The invention has strong clinical application prospect and value.

title: Load identification method, system, device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The invention discloses a load identification method. The load identification method includes the following steps: acquiring active power information, instantaneous active current information and instantaneous reactive current information; judging whether a load event occurs according to the active power information; When a load event occurs, the coarse classification information of the load event is obtained according to the instantaneous active current information, the instantaneous reactive current information and the preset coarse classification model; according to the corresponding active power information and the coarse classification information A sub-classification model is preset, and the identification result of the load event is obtained. The invention also discloses a system, a device and a computer-readable storage medium. The invention improves the accuracy of load identification.

title: Model training method, emotional message generation method and device, equipment, medium
description: This embodiment provides a model training method, an emotional message generating method, device, device, and medium, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence. Including: acquiring a dialogue data set, preprocessing the dialogue data to obtain a preliminary data set; performing sentiment labeling on the preliminary data set through a preset sentiment classifier to obtain a preliminary sentiment label; Perform preliminary encoding to obtain a preliminary encoding vector; decode the preliminary encoding vector through a second neural network to obtain a target emotional message; train the neural network model according to the target emotional message to obtain an emotional message generation model. Preliminary sentiment labels are trained through the dataset for sentiment labeling processing, and the neural network model is initially encoded and decoded according to the diverse needs of sentiment responses, so as to train the sentiment generation model, so that the sentiment generation model can generate different sentiments for question messages. target emotional message.

title: Resource recall model updating method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present disclosure relates to a resource recall model update method, device, electronic device and storage medium, the method comprising: obtaining a resource click log corresponding to the current model update cycle; determining a click resource pool according to the resource click log, the click resource representing the resources clicked by the user in the time period between the current model update cycle and the previous model update cycle; selecting the first click resource in the click resource pool, taking the first click resource as the positive sample resource, and determining the corresponding negative sample resource from the click resources other than the first click resource; generating training samples in a training sample set according to the positive sample resource, the corresponding negative sample resource and the user; optimizing the parameters in the resource recall model according to the training sample set using a preset loss function to obtain an updated resource recall model. The present disclosure solves the problem of poor resource recall accuracy caused by the resource recall model not being able to fully learn the useful information in the training data that matches the resource recall process.

title: Expression recognition method and system
description: The invention discloses an expression recognition method and system, and belongs to the technical field of biological feature recognition. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a facial expression picture sample and a corresponding class label, carrying out facial detection and facial alignment according to the facial expression picture sample, establishing a deep neural network model, sending the facial expression picture into the deep neural network model to extract characteristics to obtain expression characteristics, selecting a plurality of triplets according to the expression class label, calculating a first loss value according to the expression characteristics and the triplets, calculating cross entropy loss according to a real class label and the obtained expression characteristics to serve as a second loss value, sending the expression characteristics into a classifier to be classified, and outputting a classification result. The invention mainly aims to readjust the inter-class distance between the negative expressions and solve the problem of poor recognition effect of the negative expressions.

title: Fault diagnosis method of transformer on-load tap-changer based on background sound texture
description: The invention relates to a transformer on-load tap-changer fault diagnosis method based on background sound textures, which comprises the following steps of: preprocessing original audio data; obtaining a time-frequency mask of the equipment sound by using the deep neural network, and separating the pure equipment sound by using the time-frequency mask; carrying out fault state pre-judgment on the separated sound activities by using an initial analysis model; carrying out start-end endpoint detection on the audio event in the audio data area which is judged to be in the fault state, and intercepting an audio event segment; and accurately identifying the detected audio event segment by using a reanalysis model to obtain the type of the fault. The method is beneficial to improving the accuracy of fault diagnosis.

title: Target object detection method, device, device and storage medium
description: The disclosure provides a target object detection method, a target object detection device and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, particularly relates to computer vision, image recognition and deep learning technologies, and can be applied to smart cities and smart traffic scenes. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: carrying out feature extraction processing on the received original image to obtain a feature image with specified resolution; in the characteristic image, determining at least one effective area related to the target object; determining the outline of the target object according to the central point of each effective area; and obtaining a detection result of the target object according to the effective area and the outline of the target object. According to the scheme disclosed by the invention, the effective area can be utilized to identify the category of the target object, and the identification accuracy can be greatly improved.

title: A vehicle recognition method based on 3D point cloud data and traffic scenes
description: The invention provides an automobile identification method based on three-dimensional point cloud data and a traffic scene. The invention can realize the identification of the traffic scene based on the point cloud data set through the three characteristic modules, and effectively improve the detection efficiency and the detection precision of the vehicle.

title: Image processing method and device, device, video processing method and storage medium
description: An image processing method and apparatus, a device, a video processing method and a storage medium, the image processing method comprising: receiving an input image; and processing the input image by using a convolutional neural network to obtain an output image. The output image has a higher definition than the input image. The processing of the input image by the convolutional neural network to obtain the output image comprises: performing feature extraction on an input image to obtain a plurality of first images; splicing the input image and the plurality of first images to obtain a first image group; performing feature extraction on the first image group to obtain a plurality of second images; fusing the plurality of second images and the plurality of first images to obtain a plurality of third images; splicing the input image and the plurality of third images to obtain a second image group; and performing feature extraction on the second image group to obtain an output image. The convolutional neural network required by the image processing method is simple in structure, can improve the definition of a picture, and is convenient to deploy on a terminal.

title: Sample processing method and related device
description: The application discloses a sample processing method and a related device in the field of artificial intelligence, parameter learning is not required to be carried out again, overfitting is avoided, and additional correction is not required to be carried out on the second sample expression in a query set; the value of K does not need to be specified in advance; and classification of the query sample is realized, and the second query sample representation is continuously utilized to correct the class representation of the support set. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a support set and a query set; processing the support set and the query set through a preset neural network to obtain a first support sample representation and a first query sample representation of the support set; calculating a first information gain, wherein the first information gain is used for reflecting the contribution degree of each word in the support set to the category of the support set; a second support sample representation in the support set is determined from the first support sample representation and the first information gain, and a second query sample representation in the query set is determined from the first query sample representation and the first information gain.

title: Method and system for business flow-oriented threat level division in SDN network
description: The invention discloses a business flow-oriented threat level classification method and system in an SDN network, belonging to the field of SDN network control. The present invention classifies the service flow according to the characteristics of the service, calculates the ways in which the service flow of this type is subjected to different attack intensities by weighting the proportion of the network equipment deploying this type of service flow in the total equipment, and calculates the threat index of each type of service flow respectively, and then The threat index of the entire SDN network can be obtained by weighting the importance of each type of business flow in the SDN network service. The security situation of different business flows in the SDN network can be observed, and it can be used for troubleshooting, attack defense and strategy after a network attack occurs. Provide guidance for the development of SDN networks and lay the foundation for threat early warning and precise defense of SDN networks. The present invention converts the difficult-to-quantify SDN network threat level into a quantitative evaluation through the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method and the membership degree theory of fuzzy mathematics, and realizes the threat level division of the SDN network, making the final division result more credible.

title: Federal learning system construction method and device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application provides a federal learning system construction method, a federal learning system construction device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method includes the steps of obtaining federal learning task construction information, determining associated candidate participation devices based on the federal learning task construction information, and then sending federal learning requests containing the federal learning task construction information to each candidate participation device. And receiving reply information returned by each candidate participating device, determining a target participating device based on the reply information, constructing a federal learning task based on federal learning task construction information, and executing the federal learning task with at least one target participating device. According to the application, the participation equipment can be flexibly and pointedly determined according to the service requirement through the federal learning task construction information, the determined number of the participation equipment is more, the data provided by each participation equipment is more fit with the training requirement of the federal learning task, and finally the training result of the federal learning task is optimized.

title: An Enhanced Distribution Estimation Optimization Method for Coordinated Scheduling of Balance Loader Final Assembly Process
description: The invention discloses an enhanced distribution estimation and optimization method for coordinated scheduling of the final assembly process of a balancing loader, and belongs to the technical field of assembly line balancing. The method of the invention includes: taking the assembly line beat and smoothing index as the primary and secondary optimization objectives, establishing an integer programming model for coordinated scheduling of the final assembly process of the balance loader; and designing an enhanced distribution estimation algorithm to optimize the optimization objective. The invention takes the assembly cycle as the main optimization objective and the smoothing index as the secondary optimization objective, so that the workload of the optimization scheme workstation is more balanced, and at the same time, high production efficiency can be ensured; the enhanced distribution estimation algorithm designed for the process arrangement can quickly generate satisfying The high-quality solution of the constraints ensures that the algorithm can quickly respond to the changes in the loader assembly process in actual production.

title: Edge cloud collaborative task unloading method based on self-adaptive covariance matrix evolution strategy
description: A method for edge-cloud collaborative task offloading based on an adaptive covariance matrix evolution strategy belongs to the field of the Internet of Things. Aiming at the MEC computing offloading scenario of community smart terminals, the present invention models the computing offloading model as a three-layer computing offloading model of an end-MEC-cloud architecture. It solves the problem in the prior art that the computing power of the edge server alone is difficult to meet the needs of all terminal devices for efficient computing and low latency. In order to meet the computing needs of all users as much as possible, the present invention uses a short-job-first task calculation method in the edge server and the cloud server, and simultaneously jointly optimizes the latency and energy consumption of the offloaded tasks. Experimental results show that compared with other heuristic algorithms, the algorithm proposed in the present invention has better performance in computing offloading of the three-layer mobile edge computing architecture.

title: Method and device for style conversion of face picture, electronic device and storage medium
description: The application relates to the technical field of face recognition, and discloses a style conversion method of a face picture, which comprises the following steps: constructing a first generator and a second generator based on a Cycle GAN algorithm, so that the first generator realizes the conversion of the picture style from a first style to a second style, and the second generator realizes the conversion of the picture style from the second style to the first style; training the first generator and the second generator according to the acquired first face data set and the acquired second face data set so as to enable a loss value between the first generator and the second generator to be converged; and acquiring an attack face picture of any first style or second style, and realizing the picture style conversion of the attack face picture through the first generator or the second generator. The application also discloses a style conversion device of the face picture, electronic equipment and a storage medium.

title: An early warning model for transformers and generators based on multi-feature quantities
description: The invention discloses an early warning model of a transformer and a generator based on multiple characteristic quantities, which belongs to the field of electric power and is used for solving the problems of single fault diagnosis mode, high maintenance cost and incapability of real-time monitoring of the existing electrical equipment, and comprises an environment monitoring module, a fault judgment module, an intelligent early warning module and a region division module, wherein the region division module is used for dividing the region where the transformer or the generator is located, the environment monitoring module is used for monitoring the environment condition of the region where the transformer or the generator is located, the intelligent early warning module is combined with the early warning model and is used for carrying out intelligent early warning on the real-time operation data of the transformer or the generator, the fault judgment module is combined with an environment deviation value and an operation deviation value and is used for carrying out fault judgment on the operation condition of the transformer or the generator in a monitoring period in the monitoring region, the invention discovers potential safety hazards of the electrical equipment in advance and carries out early warning, the cost is reduced, and powerful support is provided for realizing the management of the whole life cycle of the electrical equipment.

title: Method and system for recovering missing value in network flow measurement data
description: The invention discloses a method for recovering missing values in network traffic measurement data, which comprises modeling network traffic data as a three-dimensional tensor of source node-destination node-measurement time slot, and mapping each source node, destination node, measurement time Slots are mapped to a shared latent feature space (D-dimensional vector space) and embedded as factor vectors, and an attention-enhanced long short-term memory network is used to enhance the temporal factor vectors considering the temporal patterns of network traffic, and design a new multi-modal fusion Method - Lightweight trilinear pooling as a tensor-filled interaction function to effectively model the three-way and multi-order nonlinear correlations between different feature dimensions of latent factor vectors Accurately estimate the missing values of network traffic, all missing values The estimated value of is combined with all measured values to obtain complete network traffic data. The invention also discloses a recovery system for missing values in the network traffic measurement data.

title: Method for predicting creep performance of metal structure material based on hard constraint neural network model
description: The invention discloses a method for predicting creep performance of a metal structure material based on a hard constraint neural network model. The method comprises the steps of S1, establishing constraint conditions of a first derivative and a second derivative of a creep strength creep life curve, S2, combining the constraint conditions, establishing a hard constraint neural network model comprising establishment of a network structure, derivation of the network structure, constraint loss function and the like, S3, setting the structure of the hard constraint neural network model, inputting and outputting parameters, a training method and the like, fitting experimental data, obtaining a fitting result and a prediction result, comparing the fitting result and the prediction result with the experimental data, and S4, and finally analyzing the accuracy of the obtained result. The method can be used for predicting the long-term creep properties of new materials such as most commercial austenitic stainless steel, nickel-based alloy, high-chromium steel, high-temperature alloy in the research and development stage at present, and the result is stable and reliable.

title: User behavior recognition method based on multi-task multi-view incremental learning
description: The invention discloses a user behavior recognition method based on multi-task multi-view incremental learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting activity gesture data, dividing the data into a plurality of parts, determining the number of tasks and the number of views of each task according to personnel involved in training, initializing parameters of each stage, S2, extracting features for sensor data by utilizing a multi-task multi-view deep neural network, S3, updating parameters, carrying out parameter updating by calculating a plurality of loss functions and carrying out parameter updating by back propagation, and S4, finishing training in all stages, and obtaining a final prediction result. The advantage is that MTMVIS extracts features separately using each layer of the multi-tasking multi-view depth neural network and uses the attention layer to weight the outputs of all layers of the multi-tasking multi-view depth neural network for each task as the final output layer. MTMVIS use adaptive weight consolidation to mitigate catastrophic forgetfulness problems and enhance model extensibility.

title: A communication quality enhancement system and communication system
description: The invention discloses a communication quality enhancement system and a communication system; the communication quality enhancement system includes a first communication quality enhancement device and a second communication quality enhancement device, the first communication quality enhancement device is connected with the first communication equipment, and the second communication quality enhancement device is connected with the second communication quality enhancement device. The communication quality enhancement device is connected to the second communication device. The first communication quality enhancement device is provided with a first neural network for encoding and a second neural network for decoding, and the second communication quality enhancement device is provided with a third neural network for encoding and a fourth neural network for decoding. By implementing the present invention, the communication quality between communication devices can be improved.

title: A deep learning-based URL detection method for phishing websites
description: The invention discloses a phishing website URL detection method based on deep learning, which can detect phishing websites on the Internet in real time only according to website URLs. The method comprises the steps of firstly encoding a URL character string sequence into a one-hot two-dimensional sparse matrix, then converting the one-hot two-dimensional sparse matrix into a dense character embedded matrix, inputting the dense character embedded matrix into a convolutional neural network, extracting local depth characteristics, then inputting the output of the convolutional neural network into a long-term and short-term memory network, capturing the front-back correlation of the URL sequence, and finally accessing a softmax model to classify the URL. The method can avoid redundant feature engineering, extract local deep correlation features through the convolutional neural network, learn long-range dependence in the URL through the long-short term memory network, and quickly and accurately detect the URL of the phishing website.

title: Image recognition method and device based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses an image recognition method and device based on a convolutional neural network. The method includes: using a preset convolutional neural network to determine the first probability value of the training image; obtaining the interval value of the normalized exponential function of the preset soft interval, and normalizing according to the interval value, the first probability value, and the preset soft interval Exponential function, determine the second probability value of the training image; determine the loss value according to the second probability value and the preset cross-entropy loss function; judge whether the loss value is convergent, if so, use the preset convolutional neural network as the convergent convolutional neural network network; or, if not, update the network parameters of the preset convolutional neural network, and re-execute the preceding steps with the updated preset convolutional neural network until the loss value converges, and the current updated preset convolutional neural network As a convergent convolutional neural network; using the convergent convolutional neural network to perform image recognition on the image to be detected. Using this method to identify unknown images, the accuracy of the identification results is higher.

title: A scene classification method for remote sensing images that fuses deep features and saliency features
description: The invention discloses a kind of remote sensing images scene classification methods for merging depth characteristic and significant characteristics, first, convolutional neural networks trained on ImageNet data set are finely adjusted using original graph data set, and extract the depth characteristic of raw data set image using the convolutional neural networks after fine tuning；Then, original graph data set is handled by conspicuousness detection method and obtains notable figure, and extract the significant characteristics of notable figure using the convolutional neural networks after finely tuning on notable figure data set；Next, merging two kinds of features by Concurrent Feature convergence strategy, fused feature Training Support Vector Machines are utilized；Finally, being classified by trained support vector machines to target data set image.The present invention can obtain the global information and high-lighting information of original image simultaneously, and the effective distinction for improving feature vector has better feature representation ability and nicety of grading to remote sensing images scene.

title: Quantum bit control device and quantum computer
description: [Problem] To provide a qubit control device that can contribute to the integration of qubits. [Solution] The qubit control device 16 generates pulse signals having waveforms that suppress excitation at the second and third frequencies other than the first frequency that drives excitation, toward a plurality of qubits 14a, 14b, and 14c that are excited at individually assigned first, second, and third frequencies. [Selected Figure] Figure 2

title: Unmanned store product calculation method and device
description: A commodity calculation method and device for an unmanned store are disclosed. The commodity calculation device for an unmanned store according to an embodiment of the present invention can include a transport unit for transporting commodities, a commodity recognition unit for recognizing that a commodity is placed on the transport unit, a scanning unit for scanning the barcode and image of the commodity transported by the transport unit, a weight sensor for measuring the weight of the scanned commodity, a processor for identifying what the commodity is, a commodity classification unit for classifying the commodity into a first zone or a second zone based on the commodity identification result, and a calculation unit for calculating a total price by summing up a first price obtained by summing up the prices of the commodities classified into the first zone and a second price obtained by summing up the prices of the commodities classified into the second zone and confirmed by the manager. [Selected Figure] FIG.

title: Device for constructing sequence transformation neural network for transforming input sequence and learning method using the same
description: A neural network construction device according to one embodiment of the present invention includes at least one memory and at least one processor communicating with the at least one memory, wherein the at least one processor is configured to receive first input data and second input data corresponding to the first input data, to train a sequence-transformation neural network by performing an attention operation based on predetermined label information and the labeled first input data and the labeled second input data, and to determine output data to be output by the sequence-transformation neural network trained based on the first input data, the second input data, and the label information. [Selected Figure]

title: Estimation of elemental content in molten material at the opening of a metallurgical vessel
description: A system (1000) including a computer (200) estimates the content of a specific chemical element in a molten material available at an opening (110) of a metallurgical vessel (100). In the system (1000), a pyrometer (140-P) monitors the opening (110) and provides radiation data (150-P) representing thermal radiation from the molten material (300) at the opening (110) for at least two wavelengths (λ1, λ2). The computer (200) processes the radiation data (250) to estimate the content by a pre-trained estimation module (250). Because deposits, fumes, or reflections, among other phenomena (160) at the opening (110), can interfere with the estimation, the system (1000) further includes a camera (140-C) monitoring the opening (110) and an image classification module (260) for identifying the phenomena (160). The computer (200) obtains a phenomenon-based reliability classification (RC) and filters reliable emission data from being processed or ignores content based on unreliable emission data, thereby improving the overall estimation accuracy. (Selected Figure: Figure 6)

title: Method and system for pre-processing machine learning data
description: A method and system for preprocessing training data used to train a machine is disclosed. According to an aspect of the present invention, the learning data pre-processing system acquires N basic learning data (N is an integer of 2 or more) used to train a machine, wherein each of the basic learning data is a first It consists of M feature values and labels corresponding to each of the features to M features (M is an integer of 2 or more)-and for each integer m in which the learning data pre-processing system is 1 <= m <= M, the agent and selecting a normalization technique corresponding to the m feature.

title: Method and apparatus for controlling injection mold manufacturing process
description: Disclosed are a control method for an injection mold manufacturing process, and an apparatus. According to one embodiment, the control method for an injection mold manufacturing process is based on artificial intelligence and may: store a design of a target injection mold produced by a designer using a design program; on the basis of the stored design, control a milling machine to produce a model of the target injection mold from a modelling metal; on the basis of the design, generate a first input signal; input the generated first input signal to a blockchain network via a high-speed internet network; on the basis of the input, obtain a first output signal; on the basis of the first output signal, obtain a first material of the target injection mold; on the basis of the first output signal, control a first process facility; on the basis of the control result, control a lapping sander to polish a produced product; assemble the product by controlling a robot arm; inspect the quality of the product by controlling a quality inspection device; generate a first training signal; and input the first training signal to a convolutional neural net as training data.

title: Learning Support System And Method Using Augmented Reality And Virtual reality based on Artificial Intelligence
description: The present invention relates to a learning support system and method using artificial intelligence-based augmented reality and virtual reality, and the system according to the present invention is a teacher's voice information, teacher's motion information according to the teacher's movement, and a teacher's viewpoint photographed from the teacher's viewpoint The teacher terminal unit that generates and transmits images, the student's voice information, the student's motion information according to the student's movement, and the student's terminal unit that generates and transmits a student's viewpoint image captured at the student's viewpoint, the teacher's voice information, and the teacher's It includes an education server that synthesizes a virtual reality-based learning image generated based on motion information according to motion into a student viewpoint image and provides it to a student terminal. The education server may include an artificial intelligence learning assistant that selects and provides supplementary learning content based on artificial intelligence according to the learning state of the student. According to the present invention, there is an effect that can support more efficient teaching by selecting and providing auxiliary learning content based on artificial intelligence according to the learning status of students participating in learning.

title: Artificial intelligence apparatus for recognizing speech of user in consideration of user's application usage log and method for the same
description: An embodiment of the present invention provides an artificial intelligence device for recognizing a user's voice, comprising: a microphone; and receiving a sound signal corresponding to the user's spoken voice through the microphone, recognizing the spoken voice from the sound signal using a language model, determining the user's intention based on the recognition result, and the user's intention Comprising a processor to determine whether the determination is successful, to collect the application usage record of the user when the determination of the intention is not successful, and to update the language model using the collected application usage record provides

title: Matching system and method for seller reseller of advertising sales system based on reseller recommendation
description: The present invention relates to an advertisement selling service system based on reseller recommendation and, more specifically, a seller/reseller matching system of a reseller recommendation-based advertisement selling system for matching a reseller with a campaign about an item to be sold or advertised, of an advertiser who is a seller. In the case of an existing selling system, vendors and shopping mall companies, which are sellers, have difficulty in searching for and selecting resellers, and resellers also have difficulty in coming in contact with sellers for a contract and trading. In accordance with the present invention, provided is the seller/reseller matching system of a reseller recommendation-based advertisement selling system, capable of matching a reseller optimized for an item of a seller considering characteristics of the advertiser (seller) and the reseller; helping the reseller to freely perform selling activities for the item of the seller to be advertised by providing an individual selling channel of the seller to the matched reseller; and helping the seller to easily check the activities. Moreover, in accordance with the present invention, provided is the seller/reseller matching system of a reseller recommendation-based advertisement selling system, capable of matching a reseller optimized for an item of a seller considering characteristics of the advertiser (seller) and the reseller; helping the reseller to freely perform selling activities for the item of the seller to be advertised by providing an individual selling channel of the seller to the matched reseller; and helping the seller to easily check the activities.

title: Apparatus and method for removing noise in speech
description: The present technology discloses an apparatus and method for removing noise in speech. A specific implementation example of such a technique is to collect a noise-inserted voice and a pure voice without noise, then set a plurality of groups based on the collected voice-to-noise ratio, and set multiple groups for the extracted voice data for each set group. Each of the speech section detection algorithms is performed, and the performance of each speech section detection for each speech section detected by the performed speech section detection algorithm is analyzed, and the optimal threshold value of the optimal speech section detection algorithm is selected based on the analysis results. Accordingly, it is possible to detect the optimal voice section for each noise, and as the voice length is shortened and then the noise is removed, the processing time and memory used for noise removal can be reduced to a minimum. It has the effect of performing high-performance noise cancellation in lightweight devices such as embedded equipment.

title: Method and apparatus to provide comprssion and transmission of learning parameter in distributed processing environment
description: A method and apparatus for compressing training parameters for training a deep learning model in a distributed processing environment and transmitting the compressed parameters are disclosed. A plurality of electronic devices in the distributed processing system perform learning of the neural network. The parameters are updated by performing learning. The electronic device may share its updated parameters with other electronic devices. In order to efficiently perform such sharing, a residual of a parameter is provided to another electronic device. When the residual of the parameter is provided, another electronic device updates the parameter using the residual of the parameter.

title: Method and apparatus for detecting dark circles and quantifying the degree of dark circles
description: According to various embodiments, a device for diagnosing dark circles includes a memory and at least one processor operatively connected to the memory, and the at least one processor interworks with the device to generate a user's face image. acquiring the face image of the user photographed by a photographing camera; detecting a user's dark circle area from the obtained user's face image; calculating a dark circle score for the detected dark circle area; and an operation of outputting the calculated dark circle score through a display interlocked with the device.

title: Construction Site Management System and Management Method Based on Technologies for Automatic Intent Recognition and Photo Messaging with Construction Photographs
description: In the present invention, a control server 10 having a construction site photo information analysis processing unit and a photo message generating unit, a database 20, and a terminal 30 generating construction site photo information are connected to a network, and construction is executed by a computer. As a site management system, the control server 10 includes a construction site photo information generated by the terminal 30 and an information collection unit 100 that collects corpus and annotation information including job information of a photographer; an information pre-processing unit 200 for pre-processing the construction site photo information and corpus and annotation information collected by the information collection unit 100; an information analysis processing unit (300) for extracting an analysis object and key words belonging to the shooting intention from the construction site photos through the corpus and annotation information that have passed through the information pre-processing unit (200); A report type classification unit 400 that classifies construction site photos into preset report types using the extracted analysis object and key words; and a photomessage generation unit 500 for generating a sentence explaining the purpose of photography by combining a group of sentences pre-stored in the database 24 for each report type and the extracted key words. It is also a construction site management system based on automatic recognition and photo-messaging technology.

title: Method and apparatus for determining an order quantity of hmr food according to a predicted sales volume by a sever using a neural network
description: Embodiments suggest a method and apparatus for transmitting a message including an order amount of home meal replacement (HMR) food according to predicted sales volume by using a neural network. In the method according to an embodiment, sales-related information is received from a plurality of second servers, and the sales-related information includes sales volume data for each menu, customer satisfaction data for each menu, and cooking difficulty for each menu. data, wherein the data on sales volume by menu includes data on store sales volume by menu, data on delivery sales volume by menu, and data on packaging sales volume by menu, and the data on sales volume by menu and the menu A menu related to HMR food is determined through a recommendation model using a first neural network based on customer satisfaction data for each customer, and data on cooking difficulty of the menu related to the HMR food and ingredients of the menu related to the HMR food Determines the type of the HMR food based on information about the HMR food, and predicts the HMR food through a prediction model using a second neural network based on sales volume data and a plurality of economic index data for menus related to the HMR food Determining the sales volume, determining the order amount of the HMR food based on the predicted sales volume and information on ingredients of the menu related to the HMR food, and transmitting an approval request message including the order amount of the HMR food to a user terminal. can include

title: Carotid artery stenosis diagnosis method using machine learning
description: The present invention relates to a method for providing information for determining carotid artery stenosis using machine learning, wherein auscultation sound data of an electronic stethoscope is divided into a plurality of segment data, and the divided data is input to a machine learning neural network to generate noise of each data.
