(bruit) signals are determined, and the determined data are calculated as quantitative index values to be used for diagnosing carotid artery stenosis, thereby solving the existing limitation of relying only on the auditory judgment of experts and at low cost. It also has the effect of enabling precise and rapid diagnosis of carotid artery stenosis.

title: Apparatus for interactive event recognition
description: An interactive event recognition device is disclosed. The interactive event recognition device includes an object detection and tracking module that extracts object information appearing in the input video, a general-purpose event recognition module that recognizes a general-purpose event through spatial operation between objects, and a general-purpose event materialized based on object type. and an event descriptor management and output module that records event recognition results and outputs all finally detected interaction events. Therefore, it is possible to stably provide event recognition results.

title: Method and apparatus for creating virtual world
description: The present invention discloses a method and apparatus for generating a virtual world. According to the present invention, it includes a processor and a memory connected to the processor, wherein the memory receives an image of a real space through a device having a stereo camera, and exists in the real space and the real space through the image. mesh data for a target object is collected, coordinates of first corners of the real space are determined from the mesh data of the real space, and coordinates of first corners of the real space are determined than corners of polygons preset in the real space. 1 When there are many corners, one of the plurality of second corners is selected based on the area of the virtual space defined by each of the plurality of second corners facing a predetermined direction, and some of the first corners and the An apparatus for creating a virtual world storing program instructions executed by the processor to output a virtual space defined by one selected second corner and a virtual object corresponding to a real object recognized in the real space is provided.

title: Apparatus and method for diagnosis of psychiatric disorders using mean amplitude-based features of event-related potential signal to improve diagnostic performances of computer-aided diagnosis system
description: An apparatus and method for classifying mental disorders based on the average amplitude of an event evoked potential signal for improving the performance of a computer-aided diagnostic system capable of diagnosing patients with mental disorders are disclosed. A mental disorder classification method based on the average amplitude of an event evoked potential signal according to an embodiment of the present invention includes collecting brain wave data by measuring brain waves evoked in a user while performing an auditory bipolar stimulation method; extracting an event evoked potential signal within a set interval based on the generation time of the target stimulus; Calculating average amplitudes of EEG signals divided in units of time windows from the event evoked potential signal; and classifying a mental disorder based on the average amplitude feature calculated and obtained in units of the time window.

title: Apparatus for exchanging control right of autonomous vehicle and method thereof
description: The present invention discloses a control right switching device and method for an autonomous vehicle. An apparatus for switching the control right of an autonomous vehicle of the present invention includes a photographing unit that photographs the inside of the vehicle and provides an image; a storage unit for storing learning information and weights for inferring the presence and age of passengers and whether or not the steering wheel is gripped based on deep learning; And according to the request for manual conversion, the possibility of driving is determined by inferring the presence and age of passengers through the learning information and weights stored in the storage unit from the image input from the recording unit, and then inferring whether or not to grip the steering wheel to manually switch the control right of the vehicle. It is characterized in that it comprises a control unit to.

title: Electronic apparatus and controlling method thereof
description: This disclosure relates to artificial intelligence (AI) systems utilizing machine learning algorithms and their applications. An electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device rotates a memory storing a first filter for identifying an input image and a plurality of elements included in the memory storing the first filter and the first filter, or rotates a filter area containing at least some of the plurality of elements. It includes a processor 120 that obtains at least one second filter by scaling and identifies the input image based on a result of convolving pixel values included in the input image with each of the first and second filters.

title: Device for capturing imprints
description: The present invention relates to a device for capturing imprints of body parts on the fly. The device includes a stand containing an area of empty space through which a user can pass a body part. When it is in this zone, the body part is simultaneously illuminated by a light source that produces uniform illumination of the body part and a site, i.e. a site-projection module that projects the illumination pattern onto the body part, and the body so illuminated The image of the part is acquired by an image-acquisition module. The capturing device can model the variation in light intensity of the projection of the site onto the body part by determining the parameters of a mathematical model of predetermined parameters (43), using the predetermined parameters and based on the model. Thus, a composite image of the projection can be generated (44). In that case the composite image is subtracted from the acquired image to obtain an image of the site-free body part, which can be used in identification or authentication methods.

title: Quantum computer phase tracking and correction
description: The quantum system's controller identifies phase update triggers and interaction times for quantum objects in the quantum system.  In response to identifying a phase update trigger, the controller determines, during between the first time and the interaction time, (a) a position/position relative to the phase of the quantum object based on the positions of the quantum object and movement operations performed on the quantum object; (b) determine the effect of the quantum operation on the topology of the quantum object based on (b) any quantum operations applied to the quantum object;  The immediately previous phase update for the quantum object occurred at the first time.  Based on position/movement effects, quantum computing effects, and interaction time, the controller determines the interaction time phase of the quantum object.  The controller coordinates the operation of the manipulation source so that the phase of the signal generated by the manipulation source corresponds to the interaction time phase at the interaction time.

title: System for warning unauthorized excavation work
description: The present invention includes a camera that takes images of a section where an underground cable is installed, a vibration detection sensor that detects a vibration signal occurring in the section, a speaker that is provided in the section and generates a warning, and an image captured through the camera or Receives a vibration signal detected through a vibration detection sensor, determines whether or not excavation work is to be performed within the section based on the received image or vibration signal, and if it is determined that excavation work is being performed within the section, the excavation work is performed. It is characterized by including a server that determines whether this is an unauthorized excavation operation and outputs a warning through a speaker if the excavation operation is determined to be an unauthorized excavation operation.

title: Business Intelligent Platform System
description: The present invention relates to a business intelligence platform system, comprising: a data storage (30) including public data (31) and private data (32) as data sources; a control unit (10) for collecting, refining, extracting meaning, predicting and analyzing data of the data storage (30); and a dashboard (20) on which data extracted, predicted and analyzed by the control unit (10) are displayed, wherein the control unit (10) includes a data collection module (11), a data refinement and meaning extraction module (12) and a prediction and analysis module (13), and wherein the data collection module (11) includes a real-time complex data extraction unit (111).

title: System and memory for artificial neural network
description: According to one disclosure of the present specification, a system is provided. The system may include a main memory including dynamic memory cells electrically connected to bit lines and word lines; and a memory control unit configured to selectively omit a restore operation during a read operation of the dynamic memory cells.

title: Apparatus and Method for Dynamic Object Detection using Background Modeling based on Inpainting Technique
description: The present invention provides a dynamic object detection device and method, including: an initial mask acquisition unit which detects a motion area in which a change has occurred between temporally consecutive first and second frames and acquires an initial mask; a background inpainting unit which receives the initial mask and the first frame and performs a neural network operation according to a pre-learned method to fill the motion area specified by the initial mask with a background based on the first frame to acquire a background-enhanced image; a background mask acquisition unit which calculates the difference between the background-enhanced image and the second frame to detect a residual motion area of the background together with a dynamic object area and generates a residual motion mask, and acquires a background mask in which the residual motion area is separated from the background from the residual motion mask based on the second frame according to a pre-learned method; and a dynamic object detection unit which detects a dynamic object area that is not masked by the background mask in the second frame, thereby generating a background model that is robust to instantaneous changes in the background or the dynamic background with low computational complexity, thereby enabling accurate detection of a dynamic object at high speed close to real time.

title: System for providing customized brokerage services based on ai
description: The present invention provides an artificial intelligence-based customized product brokerage service providing system, comprising: a keyword management unit for collecting, storing, and managing user keywords of buyers and sellers; a keyword-based recommendation unit for recommending products based on keywords by providing at least one or more product information matching user keywords to a buyer terminal or a seller terminal; and a final product recommendation unit for finally selecting and recommending products from among products corresponding to the product information provided by the keyword-based recommendation unit.

title: Text message sending system to block spam using AI
description: The present invention relates to a system for detecting spam text messages and managing efficient text message transmission, and more particularly, to a technology capable of analyzing text data in real time to determine whether it is spam, dynamically adjusting the transmission radius to maximize the efficiency of text message transmission, and simultaneously managing spam blocking and normal text message transmission through organic data linkage between modules.

title: Skill templates for learning robot demos
description: Methods, systems, and devices for utilizing skill templates for robot demo learning, comprising computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium. One of the methods comprises receiving a skill template for a task to be performed by a robot, wherein the skill template defines a state machine having a plurality of subtasks, and one or more respective transition conditions between one or more of the subtasks. Local demonstration data for a demo subtask of the skill template is received, and local demonstration data is generated from a user that demonstrates how to perform the demo subtask by the robot. A machine learning model is refined for the demo subtask, and the skill template is executed on the robot, thereby causing the robot to transition through the state machine defined by the skill template to perform the task.

title: Method and system for localization accuracy response
description: Various implementations disclosed herein include devices, systems, and methods for providing XR in which virtual objects are positioned based on the accuracy with which an electronic device is positioned in a physical environment. In some implementations, the techniques assess the accuracy of the positioning (e.g., centimeter-level accuracy, room-level accuracy, and building-level accuracy) and dynamically adjust the display strategy. In some implementations, the techniques determine conditions that cause inaccuracies (e.g., semantic conditions such as "too fast," "too far," or "too dark"), and provide a notification on the electronic device based on the conditions that cause inaccuracies in the positioning (e.g., "too fast—slow down," "too far—move closer," "too dark—turn on the lights").

title: Machine Learning Inference Time-spatial SW Scheduler Based on Multiple GPU
description: A method and system for spatiotemporal partitioning scheduling based on a multi-GPU environment for machine learning inference tasks are presented. The spatiotemporal partitioning scheduling system for a multi-GPU environment for machine learning inference tasks proposed in the present invention comprises: a scheduler that determines scheduling including inference delay for pairs of batch sizes and glit sizes using a performance profiler that monitors incoming request rates and collects offline performance statistics; the scheduler is triggered at predetermined intervals to determine whether rescheduling is necessary and determines the size of a glit, which is a virtual GPU with an optimal amount of resources, and model allocation to the glit; and a dynamic partition reconfiguration unit that prepares glits on the GPU to process the next inference request based on the scheduling determined by the scheduler.

title: Deep learning distribution system based on query and distribute training method
description: The present invention relates to a query-based deep learning distributed system and a distributed training method, and more particularly, to a query-based deep learning inference system in which a deep learning framework is connected to an information database in the form of a plug-in so that even a user without specialized knowledge of deep learning can provide necessary information to the user without difficulty, and data corresponding to the query is inferred by learning data stored in the information database in a deep learning manner according to a user's request query, and to a method and system for training deep learning in a distributed manner.

title: Sanitation Pest Repellent Device for a Food Waste Reduction Machine and Control Method Thereof
description: The present invention relates to a food waste reduction device for exterminating disgusting insects that are introduced into a food waste reduction device, which is installed in a food waste reduction device that receives food waste, decomposes the waste through contact with a microbial carrier to reduce its volume, and then discharges the waste in the form of a solid, and is configured to exterminate disgusting insects that are introduced into the food waste reduction device, the device comprising: an ultrasonic irradiation unit that is installed in an internal space of a body of the food waste reduction device forming the exterior of the food waste reduction device and irradiates ultrasonic waves in a frequency range that disgusting insects avoid to block the approach of disgusting insects; an ultraviolet irradiation unit that irradiates ultraviolet rays of a specific wavelength that disgusting insects avoid into the internal space of the body of the food waste reduction device to perform a sterilization and insect access prevention function; a first light irradiation unit that irradiates light of a specific wavelength that disgusting insects avoid into the internal space of the body of the food waste reduction device to prevent access; a second light irradiation unit that irradiates light of a specific wavelength in a frequency range different from the first light irradiation unit that disgusting insects avoid into the internal space of the body of the food waste reduction device to prevent access; It includes a hot air drying unit that blows hot dry air into the internal space of the body of the weight loss device to dry the internal space of the body of the weight loss device; and a control unit that controls the operation of the ultrasonic irradiation unit, the ultraviolet irradiation unit, the first light irradiation unit, the second light irradiation unit, and the hot air drying unit.

title: AI and IoT based steel material surface defect inspection system
description: The present invention relates to an AI and IoT-based steel material surface defect inspection system that detects surface defects in steel materials, predicts defect occurrence using process data, and efficiently determines scrap disposal priorities. More specifically, a high-resolution vision inspection module and a data collection and analysis module collaborate to identify defect information in steel materials in real time, and by executing multiple artificial intelligence models on a server, the system enables automated, intelligent processing of a series of processes, from defect detection to quality assessment, defect prediction, and scrap management.

title: String predictions from buffer
description: In a mobile device, the strings that comprise the current thread in the application are stored in a buffer. A thread is a series of communications sent between a user of a mobile device and one or more other users, such as a series of text messages or a series of emails. When the user inputs a text to continue the current thread, the characters of the input text are compared with the strings stored in the buffer, and strings having the input text as a prefix are selected, Are displayed to the user as string predictions. Alternatively, strings in the buffer may be used to increase the probabilities of the matched strings in the dictionary or model used to select the string predictions.

title: Blockchain Data analyzing Method based on Neural Network for Electric Power Trading
description: The present invention relates to a method for analyzing electric power trading data stored in a blockchain based on a neural network, which records trading between a power prosumer and a power consumer and analyzes and predicts a power trading time frequency by power prosumer household, a power demand amount by time slot of a household, and a power price through a neural network technology. According to the present invention, the method comprises the step of: allowing a power prosumer power sensor to collect power trading data; allowing a power prosumer to request the power prosumer power sensor to verify the collected power trading data to record power trading in a blockchain and allowing the power prosumer to perform agreement to record the power trading data in a power trading information blockchain; acquiring and storing power trading information corresponding to a power consumer in a power information analysis database; and analyzing and predicting power trade and a power price of the power consumer through the neural network technology based on the data stored in the power information analysis database. Accordingly, the present invention can cope with a behavior for forging/altering power trading, can record power trading verified through agreement among power consumers, and can realize systematic consumption through prediction of a power trading demand amount and power price.

title: System and method for coreference resolution using hierarchical pointer networks
description: The cross-reference resolution system of the present invention includes an input data extraction unit for extracting data to be subjected to cross-reference solving in an input document, and a mutual reference solution system for mutual reference resolution based on an attenuation mechanism based Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) And a hierarchical pointer network that performs reference resolutions. According to the present invention, there is an effect of improving cross-reference resolution performance by performing cross-reference resolution using a hierarchical pointer network.

title: Method and electric apparatus for predicting electronic structure of a material
description: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for an electronic device to predict an electronic structure of a material comprises the steps of: receiving input data of a user related to elements constituting a first material; applying the received input data to a learning model for estimating a state density of the first material; and outputting a first graph representing the state density for each energy level of the first material output from the learning model. The learning model may be trained to generate the first graph based on pre-input data for a plurality of second materials composed of at least some of the plurality of elements constituting the first material, and a plurality of second graphs showing a state density for each energy level of each of the plurality of second materials.

title: Reinforcement learning model creation method for automatic control of PTZ camera, and the reinforcement learning model
description: Disclosed in the present invention is a method for generating a reinforcement learning model which can improve image control efficiency of an intelligence security control system by generating an efficient reinforcement learning model for the automatic control of a PTZ camera used in the intelligence security control system. To this end, the present method comprises: (1) a learning image data acquisition and analysis step in which learning image data including object information are acquired to perform reinforcement learning, and information of the position and the size of an object in an image is analyzed; (2) a step in which the action value of a PTZ camera is selected for controlling the PTZ camera; (3) a step in which a reward is calculated by estimating the control direction of the PTZ camera; (4) a step in which a data set including the state before and after the action of the camera and a reward is stored; (5) a step in which it is determined whether the number of the stored data sets is equal to or greater than the predetermined number; and (6) a step in which a reinforcement learning model is generated based on the stored data sets.

title: Central surveillance server for recommending taxi stand
description: Provided are a taxi stand server that manages whether taxis enter or leave and a central control server for recommending taxi stands that perform wired and wireless communication with taxi terminals installed in taxis. The central control server includes: a taxi stand recommendation processing unit that receives a request for information on a recommended platform of a taxi from a taxi terminal and uses artificial intelligence to assign an entry sequence number for one or more recommended taxi stands; a history information database that stores the taxi stand information and history information about taxi information including taxi driver characteristic information; and a real-time traffic information collection unit that collects real-time traffic information. The taxi stand recommendation processing unit selects one or more recommendation taxi stands using the history information and real-time traffic information and assigns an entry sequence for each of the one or more selected recommendation taxi stands.

title: A method for slicing a neural network and a neuromorphic apparatus
description: A method of implementing a neural network according to an aspect includes dividing the neural network into a plurality of sub-networks based on a size of a core of a memory included in an apparatus for implementing the neural network; Initializing a hyper-parameter used in the sub-networks; And learning the sub-networks using the initialized hyper-parameters.

title: Method and apparatus for processing convolution operation of neural network
description: The present invention relates to a method for performing a convolution operation between a kernel and an input feature map based on reuse of an input feature map and a neural network device for the same. According to the present invention, the neural network device comprises: a memory in which at least one program is stored; and a processor processing a convolution operation of a neural network by executing the at least one program.

title: Power usage management system and method
description: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a power usage management system is provided. The power usage management system includes: a data management part storing power usage data; an area model creation part creating an area model dividing daily power usage into a plurality of areas by time slot and power usage; a feature data extraction part extracting feature data including past maximum load section information, a power usage data amount by area, a power usage data ratio by area, a power usage maximum value by area and a maximum gradient value by area by using the power usage data and the area model; and a machine learning part calculating a maximum load section by inputting the feature data into a neural network machine learning model. Therefore, the power usage management system is capable of reducing electric rates by operating an energy storage apparatus.

title: Prediction of etching properties in thermal and atomic layer etching
description: The etching of the thermal etch reaction is predicted using a machine learning model. Chemical properties of the etch process and associated energies of one or more reaction paths of a predetermined thermal etch reaction are identified using quantum mechanics simulation. Labels indicative of etch properties may be associated with the chemical properties and associated energies of a predetermined thermal etch reaction. A machine learning model can be trained using chemical properties as independent variables and associated energies and labels as dependent variables across many different etch reactions of different types. When the chemical properties and associated energies for the new thermal etch reaction are provided as inputs of the machine learning model, the machine learning model can accurately predict the etch properties of the new thermal etch reaction as outputs.

title: Data Processing System and Operating Method Thereof
description: The data processing system according to an embodiment of the present technology includes a plurality of pages, and includes a memory device that is accessible in a page unit and a controller that controls the memory device, and the controller includes a type of processing operation requested by a host and an access request. And a mode control unit that generates an activation mode control signal for activating at least a portion of a page to be accessed of the memory device based on the address information, and the memory device may be driven at least partially in response to the activation mode control signal.

title: Apparatus, method, system and program for analysing state information
description: Disclosed is a method for analyzing state information. The method performed by a computer comprises the steps of: obtaining an image of photographing an object; and obtaining state information of the object by analyzing the obtained image. Therefore, the method can contribute to improving oral health.

title: Capacitance-based sequential matrix multiplication neural network by controlling weights with transistor-capacitor pair
description: A capacitance-based sequential matrix multiplication neural network capable of controlling weights with a transistor-capacitor pair according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a transistor coupled to a word line, a bit line, and a capacitor; and a capacitor coupled to the transistor. The input of the bit line is connected to a pulse generator and the output is connected to a sense amplifier.

title: Biometric authentication system, biometric authentication method and program
description: An image input unit that acquires an image of a living body, a storage unit that stores registration information on a plurality of biometric characteristics obtained from the biometric region of each person's image, and a biometric region of the image acquired by the image input unit is registered by processing A biometric authentication system having an authentication processing unit that performs biometric authentication based on information, wherein a plurality of biometric characteristics obtained from a biometric region of each person are a plurality of biometric characteristics having a low correlation of a pattern with each other, and the authentication processing unit processes an image. Biometric authentication is performed by combining a plurality of biometric features having a low correlation between the obtained patterns.

title: Image analysis apparatus using machine-learning based artificial intelligence including preprocessing modules
description: Disclosed is an image analysis apparatus using machine learning-based artificial intelligence (AI) to provides an image analysis method capable of performing segmentation, detection, and diagnosis with respect to a lesion. According to the present invention, the image analysis apparatus comprises a computing system and the computing system includes a processor, a communication module receiving an input image, and an artificial neural network generating a first pre-processing condition and a second pre-processing condition through inference on the input image. The processor includes a first pre-processing module generating a first pre-processed image by applying the first pre-processing condition to the input image and a second pre-processing module generating a second pre-processed image by applying the second pre-processing condition to the input image. The processor controls the first pre-processing module, the second pre-processing module, the artificial neural network, and the communication module to transmit the first pre-processed image and the second pre-processed image to an image analysis module which performs image analysis on the input image on the basis of the first pre-processed image and the second pre-processed image.

title: Operation method of reinforcement learning based agent using state memory based artificial neural network for collision avoidance and autonomous driving of autonomous vehicle and driving method of autonomous vehicle equipped with the agent
description: The present invention provides a method of operating a reinforcement learning-based agent using a state memory-based artificial neural network that enables autonomous moving objects to perform obstacle collision avoidance and autonomous driving even in indoor or outdoor environments where GPS shadow area or location recognition is not possible, and the agent Disclosed is a driving method of an autonomous mobile device equipped with

title: Apparatus and method for network optimization and non-transitory computer readable media
description: An apparatus for network optimization comprising: at least one memory device storing computer-executable instructions; and at least one processor configured to access the memory device, the processor comprising: a core data center and an edge data center; determining a network parameter associated with a network architecture, using the network parameter, a first programmatically expected delay time associated with the core data center and a second programmatically expected delay time associated with the edge data center; determining a time to be routed between the core data center and the edge data center based at least in part on a difference between the first programmatically expected delay time and the second programmatically expected delay time; An apparatus configured to execute the computer-executable instructions for determining a distribution of a workload is provided.

title: Generation of text tags from game communication transcripts
description: Some implementations relate to a method, a system, and a computer readable medium to generate a text tag for a game. In some implementations, a computer-implemented method to generate one or more text tags includes a step of obtaining a plurality of chat transcripts, wherein each chat transcript is associated with each gameplay session of each game of a plurality of games. Each chat transcript includes content provided by a participant in the gameplay session. The method further includes the steps of: programmatically analyzing the plurality of chat transcripts to determine one or more characteristics for each game of the plurality of games; and generating a text tag for at least one game of the plurality of games based on the one or more characteristics of the at least one game.

title: System for Providing User-Personalizied Plastic Surgery Information by Using Deep-Learning Technology
description: The present invention relates to a user-customized plastic medical information providing system and method using deep learning technology, comprising: an information receiving unit for receiving user information and desired procedure and surgery information from a user terminal; a distributed storage server for distributed storage of the received information; a diagnosis unit that matches text extracted from the desired procedure and surgery information received by the information receiving unit with information stored in big data to identify suitable procedures and surgeries that match a preset reference matching rate or higher; and an information providing unit that provides information necessary for the treatment including the procedure and surgery identified in the diagnosis unit and at least one recommended plastic hospital or plastic surgeon to the user terminal. By resolving the problem of the increase in over-treatment by plastic surgeons and indiscriminate medical shopping by users of plastic medical services, the effect is derived that allows plastic surgery consumers to choose and receive plastic surgery procedures and surgeries proactively.

title: Multifunctional didital signage systeom based on arrificial intelligence technology
description: The present invention relates to a multifunctional digital signage system based on artificial intelligence technology. By collecting features and analyzing and contrasting facial features through deep learning learning, it effectively manages the entry of unauthorized personnel, and precisely measures body temperature using the thermal sensor mounted on the artificial intelligence digital signage. It is to contribute to public health by detecting in advance those infected with influenza, such as influenza, accompanied by symptoms of high fever, and blocking the occurrence and spread of influenza.  For example, based on artificial intelligence facial recognition technology and pre-registered user face registration data, the captured image is analyzed to recognize the user's face to classify the user's registration status, and the user's body temperature is measured using a thermal imaging camera. It operates in a self-diagnosis video mode that detects the heat condition of each user and displays it through the output screen, and a general video mode that outputs advertisement or promotional video and living information, and switches the output screen according to each video mode a digital signage device unit; and management to provide the advertisement or promotional image information, life information, and user face registration data to the digital signage device unit, and receive and manage face recognition data matched with the user's fever state data from the digital signage device unit Disclosed is a multifunctional digital signage system based on artificial intelligence technology including a server unit.

title: Apparatus for Analyzing Sleeping Using Estimation of Electrocardiogram
description: According to one aspect of the present invention, a sleep analysis apparatus using electrocardiogram (ECG) estimation capable of accurately estimating an electrocardiogram signal from a photo-plethysmography (PPG) signal comprises: a sensing device acquiring a photo-plethysmography signal from a user; and a sleep state analysis server estimating an effective electrocardiogram signal from the photo-plethysmography signal, and using the effective electrocardiogram signal to analyze the sleep state of the user. The sleep state analysis unit includes: an electrocardiogram signal estimation unit trained by using a plurality of datasets consisting of photo-plethysmography signals for training and electrocardiogram signals for traning corresponding to the photo-plethysmography signals for training, and estimating the effective electrocardiogram signal based on a photo-plethysmography signal acquired by the sensing device when the photo-plethysmography signal is inputted to output the effective electrocardiogram signal; a heart rate variability (HRV) calculation unit using the intervals between peak values included in the effective electrocardiogram signal to calculate heart rate variability; and a sleep state analysis unit analyzing the sleep state of the user based on the heart rate variability to generate sleep state analysis results.

title: Vehicle driving learning system using reinforcement learning
description: The present invention relates to a vehicle driving learning system using reinforcement learning. According to the present invention, an internal data acquisition unit that acquires internal data on the driving state of a driving vehicle from a driving record self-diagnosis device (OBD), and an external data acquisition unit that acquires external data on driving states and road conditions of surrounding vehicles from external sensors A data acquisition unit, a data processing unit that analyzes the acquired internal data to label the driving state of the driving vehicle, and integrates the labeled internal data and external data acquired at the same time period, and the integrated internal data; and a reinforcement learning unit configured to input external data into a pre-learned reinforcement learning algorithm, compare the output value of the reinforcement learning algorithm with the driving state of the current driving vehicle, and compensate.  As described above, according to the present invention, by inputting internal data capable of grasping the driving state of the driving vehicle from the driving record self-diagnosis device and combining data on the external environment acquired through an external sensor, for determining the driving of the driving vehicle It can collect training data and improve reinforcement learning algorithms.  In addition, the current driving state may be compared by using the pre-reinforced learning algorithm, and the driving state of the driving vehicle may be improved according to the driver's tendency.

title: Apparatus and method for classifying class using deep learning
description: A class classification apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a principal component analysis unit generating important parameters by performing principal component analysis on data, and a classification unit generating classification data by classifying the data into one or more classes through a convolutional neural network , a clustering unit for generating a cluster by performing clustering for each class based on the important parameter, and generating learning data to set a class for each cluster to learn when the clusters are classified, and the learning and a learning unit for learning the convolutional neural network according to data.

title: Method and apparatus for configuring learning data set in object recognition
description: In a method for constructing a training dataset for object recognition according to an embodiment of the present invention, the method comprising: (a) calling an object image stored in a first dataset; (b) randomly calling an image from the second dataset; (c) automatically arranging the object image of the called first dataset in the random image of the called second dataset in an arbitrary position according to a preset method; and (d) storing an image in which the object image of the first dataset is automatically placed in the random image of the second dataset.

title: Method for Encoding and Decoding an Audio Signal Using a Neural Network Model, and an Encoder and Decoder Performing the Method
description: Disclosed are a method for encoding and decoding an audio signal using a learning model and an encoder and decoder performing the same. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the method for encoding and decoding an audio signal using the learning model may include: a step of extracting pitch information on the audio signal; a step of determining an expansion factor of a first expandable neural network block extracting a feature map from the audio signal based on the pitch information; a step of determining a receptive field of the first expandable neural network block according to the expansion factor; a step of generating a first feature map of the audio signal by using the first expandable neural network block; a step of determining a second feature map by inputting the first feature map to a second expandable neural network block processing a feature map; and a step of converting the second feature map and the pitch information into a bitstream. The present invention can effectively remove long-term redundancy in the audio signal.

title: 3D reconstruction method, apparatus, apparatus and storage medium
description: An embodiment of the present invention discloses a three-dimensional reconstruction method, apparatus, apparatus and storage medium, wherein the three-dimensional reconstruction method obtains a first key image of a plurality of frames for this reconstruction, and a first key image of a plurality of frames determining a first space surrounding the view cone of the key image, wherein the first key image is obtained by imaging a target to be reconstructed; obtaining, based on image information in the first key image of the plurality of frames, a first feature map of a first space, the first feature map including first feature information of voxels in the first space; obtaining a first reconstruction result of this reconstruction based on the first feature map; and updating a second reconstruction result obtained by a previous reconstruction based on the first reconstruction result of the current reconstruction. The above-described solution can improve the real-time of the 3D reconstruction process and the smoothness of the 3D reconstruction result.

title: Neural network operation method and apparatus
description: A neural network computation method and apparatus are disclosed. A neural network computing device according to an embodiment includes an input register for storing an input feature map, and a processing element array including a processing element that performs an operation based on the input feature map and a weight matrix; and a controller that maps a portion of the input feature map on which the operation is to be performed and a portion of the weight matrix to the processing element.

title: Odor classification system in hospital
description: The present invention relates to a bad smell classification system in a hospital, wherein the bad smell classification system in the hospital may comprise: a sensor part that recognizes a smell in the hospital by using a total volatile organic compound (TVOC) sensor that recognizes an organic compound gas; a modeling part that learns a pattern of a recognition value per smell of the sensor part in a deep learning model; and a classification part that classifies the smell based on the model learned through the modeling part. Therefore, the present invention is capable of classifying the bad smell in the hospital.

title: Method and apparatus for calculating comprehensive disease index
description: A method for calculating a global disease index is disclosed. The method includes analyzing medical data to calculate a disease risk value; calculating a disease severity value by analyzing biometric data and biometric data mapped to standard practice guideline data among the biometric data; and calculating the CDI by analyzing the disease risk value, the disease severity value, and medical knowledge information acquired from a medical knowledge base.

title: Auto Adjust Bidet
description: Provided is an electronic, self-adjusting bidet which provides equal to or more than five user-specific functions through a machine learning software. According to the present invention, a body portion is scanned through a camera, entered into the software, and a customized bidet is set using processed information. A user can set the functions he/she wants and the software can operate accordingly. The self-adjusting bidet of the present invention is equipped with an interior camera, a fluid nozzle, and an air circulation device. By installing the air circulation device in the bidet, a space can be utilized efficiently. Additionally, an odor generated after the user uses a toilet is immediately removed, reducing possibility of continued odor generation.

title: Vehicle steering monitoring device and method of the same
description: The present invention relates to a vehicle steering angle monitoring device and method capable of accurately predicting the steering angle (or turning angle) of a vehicle without the help of expensive equipment. a steering angle prediction unit 100 that predicts; a steering angle sensor 200 for sensing a steering angle of the steering device of the vehicle; and a steering monitoring unit that compares the steering angle of the vehicle from the steering angle predictor 100 and the steering angle of the steering device from the steering angle sensor 200, and determines whether or not there is an abnormality in the steering system of the vehicle based on the comparison result. (300).

title: Disaster Prevention System According to Building Resilience Destruction and Method Using the Same
description: One embodiment of the present invention relates to a method for preventing a severe disaster caused by the collapse of a building, wherein information including vibration data collected by a vibration sensor (120) attached to a building is used to predict the rigidity of the building. The method of the present invention comprises: a step (a) of allowing a learning information generation module (10) to collect vibration data and building rigidity; a step (b) of allowing a vibration property learning module (20) to learn a prediction model (22); a step (c1) of outputting the rigidity of the building when the vibration data are entered into the vibration property learning module (20); a step (d) of comparing the rigidity outputted in the step (c1) with a size of a preset risk level; a step (e2) of comparing the cumulative impact applied to the building during a predetermined unit period with a threshold value of the building resilience when the rigidity outputted in the step (d1) is less than the preset risk level; and a step (f2) of allowing an alarm provision module (40) to provide building users, an adjacent building management department, and an infrastructure management department with an alarm when the cumulative impact in the step (e2) exceeds the threshold value of the building resilience.

title: Driving assistance control apparatus and driver assistance control method of vehicle
description: The present invention relates to a driver assistance control device and a driver assistance control method for a vehicle, and its purpose is to more accurately detect the distraction of a driver driving a vehicle using dynamic Bayesian network technology. To this end, the vehicle control device according to the present invention includes a plurality of sensors provided to detect the driver's status and the vehicle's status; Perform at least one of visual distraction detection and cognitive distraction detection based on driver state information and vehicle state information acquired through the plurality of sensors, and determine the results of the visual distraction detection and the cognitive distraction detection. A control unit provided to calculate the driver's distraction value from at least one of the results, wherein the control unit detects the visual distraction, detects the cognitive distraction, and uses a dynamic Bayesian method to calculate the driver's distraction value. Use the network.

title: Neural network output generation through cross-attention of query embeddings over a set of latent embeddings
description: Methods, systems and devices include a computer program encoded on a computer storage medium for generating network output using a neural network. In one aspect, a method includes obtaining (i) a network input to a neural network, and (ii) a set of query embeddings; Processing the network input using a neural network to generate a network output comprising each dimension corresponding to each query embedding in the query embedding set, wherein processing the network input converts a representation of the network input into a latent embedding. Processing the network input using the encoder block of the neural network to produce a set; and processing (i) the latent embedding set and (ii) the query embedding set using a cross-attention block that generates each dimension of the network output by cross-attention of the corresponding query embedding with respect to the latent embedding set.

title: Electronic apparatus for processing image using AI encoding/decoding and cotrol method thereof
description: An electronic device that processes images using AI encoding is disclosed. The electronic device acquires a second image including luminance information based on a memory in which the learned first neural network model is stored, a communication interface, and a first image including pixel information, and inputs the second image to the first neural network model. Obtain a first residual image including luminance residual information, obtain a second residual image including pixel residual information based on the first residual image, and obtain an AI encoded image based on the first image and the second residual image. It includes one or more processors that acquire and encode the AI-encoded image and transmit the obtained compressed image to an external device through a communication interface.

title: Auto Control Tripod for broadcast filming equipment
description: The present invention relates to an automatic control stand for photographic equipment. It builds a motion recognition artificial intelligence model using a subject recognition AI model to recognize the user's movements, mounts the photographic equipment using the holder, and uses a servo motor or step motor to control the user's movements. By controlling the angle, the shooting angle can be automatically adjusted, and the shooting equipment holder is detachable and can be held appropriately to the type of equipment to be filmed, reducing the high price of the product and the filming equipment (camcorder, mobile phone, etc.) that you already have. ) cannot be utilized and the angle is only 2 axes, thereby solving the problem of the high price of existing products, the inability to utilize existing filming equipment (camcorders, mobile phones, etc.), and the problem of only 2 axes of angle. It was meant to be resolved.  In other words, the present invention builds a motion recognition artificial intelligence model in a subject tracking camera, collects datasets by filming human movements to recognize user movements, and uses artificial intelligence built based on open source Media Pipe and LSTM. After learning, the subject recognition AI model transplanted to Raspberry Pi 4, equipped with shooting equipment, and controlling the angle with a servo motor or step motor to produce motor joints with servo and step motors so that the shooting angle can be automatically adjusted. It is a detachable stand made up of the body of the stand by connecting the motor through metal processing or 3D printing. A holder suitable for the body of various shooting equipment such as camcorders and smartphones is prepared so that the user can hold it according to the shape of the equipment to be filmed. It is composed of a filming equipment holder that holders follow.  Therefore, the present invention builds a motion recognition artificial intelligence model using a subject recognition AI model to recognize the user's movements, mounts the shooting equipment on a holder, and controls the angle with a servo motor or step motor to adjust the shooting angle. It can be adjusted automatically, is attachable and detachable by the filming equipment holder, and can be held appropriately to the type of equipment to be filmed. This eliminates the high price of the product, the inability to use existing filming equipment (camcorders, mobile phones, etc.), and the angle By solving the problem of having only 2 axes, the high price of existing products, the inability to use existing filming equipment (camcorders, mobile phones, etc.), and the problem of having only 2 axes of angle are effective. .

title: Multi-weather laser radar point cloud generation method based on physical model
description: The invention discloses a multi-weather laser radar point cloud generating method based on a physical model, which comprises a weather simulator based on the physical model, simulating laser radar point cloud data after different days for training, and performing multi-step denoising through a denoising-diffusion network comprising a designed spider-black man bar denoising network. The method can generate the laser radar point cloud data in different weather states in a unified frame, the control of weather conditions is accurate and efficient, and the generated laser radar point cloud data in different weather states has excellent fidelity and diversity.

title: Super-resolution-based linear rigid body motion tracking system and method
description: The invention discloses a linear rigid body motion tracking system and method based on super-resolution, comprising the following steps of performing super-resolution on video frames acquired through video stream data; and carrying out real-time detection and three-dimensional space motion tracking on each rigid body. The invention can carry out linear motion tracking on the rigid body to be tracked in the monitoring video, and ensures high accuracy of tracking in the industrial environment.

title: Intelligent leg training rehabilitation method
description: The invention discloses an intelligent leg training rehabilitation method which comprises the steps of constructing a leg training rehabilitation system based on a deep learning model and a data mining analysis algorithm, analyzing the healing degree of a patient rehabilitation training according to the output of the leg training rehabilitation system, customizing the leg rehabilitation training content of the patient, monitoring the performance and progress of the patient in the rehabilitation training process through the leg training rehabilitation system, adjusting the leg rehabilitation training content, introducing an expression analysis module based on the result monitored by the leg training rehabilitation system, monitoring the expression state of the patient, performing human intervention, evaluating and optimizing the leg training content, introducing the expression analysis module to provide real-time expression state analysis for avoiding overdependence on the deep learning and data mining algorithm, providing leg rehabilitation support which is more in line with the expression state for the patient according to the analysis result, and improving the rehabilitation speed of the leg of the patient.

title: Word segmentation representation and learning method for robot perception data based on graph neural network
description: The invention relates to a robot perception data word segmentation representation and learning method based on a graph neural network, which comprises the following steps of obtaining various perception data of a robot, carrying out word segmentation representation according to the category of the perception data, carrying out word segmentation representation learning, constructing an initial feature graph based on the perception data after word segmentation representation, reconstructing a graph structure based on compact representation of a self-encoder learning feature graph, wherein the graph structure represents the relationship of edges between different nodes, fixing the graph structure after the self-encoder finishes the learning of the graph structure, converting the perception data into node feature vectors, constructing the feature graph based on the learned graph structure, and carrying out numerical coding on the node feature vectors by utilizing the graph neural network to obtain the high-dimensional feature vector representation of the perception data. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of better expressing the complexity of the perception data, multidimensional information and the like.

title: A learning method and device
description: The embodiment of the present invention provides a learning method and device, including: obtaining the sub-models of the hydropower station submitted by each user through the secondary blockchain; initiating a secure aggregation smart contract request through the secondary blockchain to execute the secure aggregation smart contract to aggregate the sub-models into a local model, and storing the local model in the secondary blockchain account book of the secondary blockchain and broadcasting; obtaining the local model from the secondary blockchain account book through the primary blockchain; initiating a secure aggregation smart contract request through the primary blockchain to execute the secure aggregation smart contract to aggregate the local model into a global model, and storing the global model in the primary blockchain account book and broadcasting, and the user is used to obtain the global model from the primary blockchain account book. The final global model obtained by the federated learning method based on the hierarchical alliance chain of the embodiment of the present invention can be more safely and effectively applied to the operation and maintenance and monitoring scenarios of hydropower stations.

title: Factory vehicle detection method based on improved YOLO v8
description: The present invention discloses a factory vehicle detection method based on improved YOLO v8, comprising: S1, collecting monitoring pictures of factory vehicles, marking the selected monitoring pictures, and dividing the data set into a training set and a test set; S2, based on the network structure of the YOLO v8 algorithm, improving the factory vehicle detection target to obtain an improved YOLO v8 detection model; S3, using the data set obtained in step S1 to train and test the improved YOLO v8 detection model. Compared with the original YOLO v8 algorithm and the existing vehicle detection model, the present invention effectively improves the detection accuracy of factory vehicle targets and has strong reliability. The present invention provides a new idea for subsequent research on factory vehicle tracking and positioning, and has certain significance for improving the safety and safety management level inside the factory.

title: A method for measuring the body size of cattle based on multi-view keypoint localization using colorized point clouds.
description: The invention provides a method for measuring a bovine body ruler based on colorization point cloud multi-view key point positioning, which comprises the steps of collecting a bovine 3D point cloud, constructing an initial point cloud data set, acquiring a three-view image set by using a space point colorization model, dividing the three-view image set into a training set, a verification set and a test set, constructing a key point recognition model, training by using the training set, verifying by using the verification set, carrying out key point recognition on the test set after acquiring a key point recognition model with optimal performance, acquiring two-dimensional plane coordinates of a plurality of key points, converting the two-dimensional plane coordinates into three-dimensional space coordinates by using a different-dimensional key point coordinate conversion algorithm, and calculating the body ruler parameters of the bovine by using the three-dimensional space coordinates of all the key points.

title: Power grid dispatching training method and system based on panoramic digital twin simulation
description: The present invention discloses a power grid dispatching training method and system based on panoramic digital twin simulation, which relates to the field of power grid dispatching technology, including: obtaining the operation data of the power grid, constructing a power grid digital twin model; simulating the power grid operation scenario and fault according to the operation data of the power grid; making power grid operation and dispatching decisions on the power grid digital twin model according to the selected power grid operation scenario and fault type; and providing feedback and evaluation on the power grid operation and dispatching decisions. The present invention constructs a power grid digital twin model, a power grid operation and dispatching decision twin model, reconstructs the power grid operation and dispatching decision twin model, and simulates power grid dispatching training through multiple twin models, providing a real training environment, improving the training efficiency and quality of dispatchers, and enhancing the safety and reliability of power grid dispatching. Provide a comprehensive, real, and interactive training platform for power grid dispatchers to effectively improve their professional skills and emergency handling capabilities.

title: Power outage area warning method, device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
description: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a power outage area warning method, a device, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium. The method comprises the steps of executing a generating step of determining a target power data sequence corresponding to each power device, determining a first data interception time period, a second data interception time period, a third data interception time period and a fourth data interception time period sequence, generating a first power data subsequence, a second power data subsequence, a third power data subsequence and a fourth power data subsequence set, generating device abnormality detection information, determining device abnormality cause information and device influence range information, generating device operation summary information, executing power operation abnormality display and carrying out alarm processing on a corresponding power failure area. According to the embodiment, the abnormal condition of the electric power operation corresponding to the target electric power region can be accurately and efficiently displayed, and equipment maintenance and power failure warning can be timely carried out on the abnormal operation electric power equipment.

title: Graph classification method based on quantum graph attention network
description: The invention provides a graph classification method based on a quantum graph attention network, which comprises the steps of 1, converting graph data into quantum states for quantum computation through angle coding and amplitude coding, 2, establishing a quantum linear mapper, and forming a group of unitary gates by using a group of alternative trainable parameter-containing sub-gates and CNOT gates for the quantum states obtained through angle coding The method comprises the steps of carrying out quantum state evolution, establishing a quantum graph attention layer, splicing nodes in pairs when attention coefficients between nodes are calculated, iteratively inputting the spliced nodes into the quantum graph attention layer, eliminating nodes with small influence on a target node as noise items, and carrying out graph classification in step 5. The invention avoids strict dependence on graph structure, can better cope with the processing requirement of large-scale graph data, is a universal circuit design method, and remarkably improves the processing efficiency and flexibility of quantum graph neural network.

title: Face image super-resolution method, system and storage medium capable of defending against attack
description: The invention discloses a face image super-resolution method, a face image super-resolution system and a storage medium capable of defending against attacks, which comprise the steps of constructing a frequency perception decomposition network model based on empirical mode decomposition, obtaining a clean sample set, obtaining an countermeasure sample set based on the clean sample set, performing countermeasure training on the frequency perception decomposition network model based on the clean sample set and the countermeasure sample set, inputting a given face image into the trained frequency perception decomposition network model to obtain depth features, obtaining an intrinsic mode function feature map based on the depth features, and reconstructing the face image based on the intrinsic mode function feature map. The invention provides a robust and efficient FSR model by combining the multi-branch structure of EMD, the high-frequency noise suppressor and the learnable prompt, which can effectively recover the high-frequency details of the face image under the condition of the existence of anti-noise and improve the identification accuracy and the visual quality.

title: Sha Gehuang wind-solar energy and solar energy scene generation method and system based on conditional diffusion model
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for generating a Shagohuang wind and solar term scene based on a conditional diffusion model, which belongs to the technical field of power systems. First, the twenty-four solar terms are used as the division intervals of the historical time series, and each solar term sample is assigned a label. Secondly, based on the feature extraction network of the solar term factor, the solar term factor is mapped into a feature vector concentration in the latent space, effectively retaining the solar term regularity characteristics of the wind and solar output. Finally, a generative network based on small sample learning technology is introduced to construct a solar term wind and solar scene generation network based on the conditional diffusion probability model C‑DDPM, and the prior distribution of the mapping of a single solar term feature vector is converted into a joint probability distribution of the twenty-four solar terms. A denoising network architecture is used to capture the uncertainty and temporality of the output. After the training is completed, the input noise and the corresponding solar term label can generate the solar term scene. It is particularly suitable for areas where data samples are scarce. The model can generate diversified wind and solar scenes through solar term conditions and noise input.

title: Electric vehicle charging station layout optimization configuration method and system
description: The invention discloses a method and system for optimizing the layout of electric vehicle charging stations, comprising the following steps: obtaining traffic network information and distribution network information of a planning target area, determining the number of electric vehicle charging demands and the distribution of charging load demands; determining the service scope of each charging station according to the distribution of electric vehicle charging load demands, and constructing a capacity determination model for a proposed charging station; constructing an upper-level charging station site selection model to determine the optimal site of each charging station; establishing a lower-level mixed integer programming model to determine the number of various types of charging piles configured at each charging station; solving a double-layer site selection and capacity planning configuration model by using a hybrid genetic simulated annealing algorithm and a hierarchical analysis method to obtain the optimal site selection and capacity determination plan for the charging station; the invention comprehensively considers the attractiveness of the charging station to users and the configuration plans of different types of charging piles, establishes a double-layer planning configuration model, solves an optimal solution set by using a hybrid genetic simulated annealing algorithm, and finally determines the optimal plan by using a hierarchical analysis method.

title: Intelligent generation method of dental implant microstructure based on generation countermeasure network
description: The invention discloses an intelligent generating method of a dental implant microstructure based on a generating countermeasure network, which comprises the steps of S1, extracting anatomic features and mechanical demand data, S2, constructing a double-layer generating countermeasure network model, S3, designing a plurality of macroscopic generators and macroscopic discriminators in a macroscopic generation layer, enabling the macroscopic generators to generate the whole geometric structure of the dental implant according to the anatomic feature data of a patient, enabling the macroscopic generators to evaluate and adjust the generated whole geometric structure, S4, designing a plurality of microscopic generators and microscopic discriminators in the microscopic generation layer, enabling the microscopic generators to generate the microstructure of the dental implant according to the whole geometric structure output by the macroscopic generation layer, S5, introducing non-cooperative games between the macroscopic generators and the microscopic generators, S6, introducing cooperative games between the macroscopic discriminators and the microscopic discriminators, and S7, and repeating the steps of S3-S6. The invention realizes the multi-objective optimization of the microstructure of the implant and obviously improves the long-term stability and the clinical success rate of the implant.

title: A method and system for identifying mountain fires at night
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for identifying wildfires at night, and relates to the technical field of wildfire monitoring, comprising the steps of: obtaining a training set of camera nighttime flame interception pictures and a training set of camera nighttime light interception pictures corresponding to each camera; obtaining a flame candidate area in an image to be identified and recording a target shooting camera corresponding to the flame candidate area; determining a distance matching score, a similarity matching score, and a light frequency score; obtaining a flame confidence of the flame candidate area; and determining whether it is a real wildfire area according to the flame confidence. In the scheme of the present invention, the flame confidence is obtained based on full consideration of image color characteristics, appearance time node characteristics, and appearance position characteristics, and the flame candidate area is identified based on the flame confidence, so that wildfire scenes at night can be effectively identified, and the method has a wide range of application scenarios.

title: Power distribution network fault line positioning method and device
description: The present application discloses a method and device for locating a distribution network fault line, which relates to the field of distribution network fault identification, including: constructing a distribution network topology based on historical power supply data of a faulty distribution network to be located; optimizing model parameters of a preset graph neural network model based on node characteristics of each node in the distribution network topology, and performing iterative propagation calculations on the distribution network topology based on the graph neural network model, optimizing the model parameters of the graph neural network model based on a gradient descent method during iteration, completing training until the model parameters meet a preset threshold, and obtaining a power grid fault location model; inputting real-time power supply data of the faulty distribution network to be located into the power grid fault location model to obtain fault location data; inputting the fault location data into a preset text annotation model to obtain a fault label for the fault location data, and annotating the real-time power supply data based on the fault label to obtain a fault location result.

title: Bonding encapsulation impedance matching device of superconducting quantum chip and quantum processor
description: The invention discloses a bonding package impedance matching device of a superconducting quantum chip and a quantum processor, which relate to the field of superconducting quantum technology and include a PCB board, a bonding wire and a chip, wherein pad-to-ground capacitors are arranged in both the PCB board and the chip; a transmission line of the PCB board is connected with a transmission line of the chip through a bonding wire, and the bonding wire is used as an inductor to form a low-pass filter with two pad-to-ground capacitors to reduce the reflectivity at the bonding wire; the two pad-to-ground capacitors are independently arranged, and the capacitance size is adjusted by changing the shape of the pads respectively; the bonding package impedance matching device and the quantum processor solve the reflection problem at the chip packaging; and at the same time, there is no need to introduce external patch capacitors and add additional matching lines, thereby greatly saving the chip and PCB board space.

title: Fault plan determining method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for determining a fault plan. The terminal obtains the fault phenomenon data of the power system; the fault phenomenon data is input into the fault phenomenon of the historical period and the plan matching model obtained by the fault plan training for matching processing to obtain the target fault plan. Based on the complex semantic processing and natural language generation capabilities of the plan matching model, the present application improves the accuracy and interpretation ability of the fault plan matching of the power automation system, thereby realizing the automatic matching of the fault phenomenon and the fault plan of the power dispatching automation system, and improving the speed of dispatching personnel in handling faults.

title: Method and system for recommending positions of unemployed personnel
description: The invention discloses a station recommendation method and a system for a person out of service, which belong to the technical field of big data analysis, and the station recommendation is realized by using simbert algorithm in a deep neural network; the method comprises the steps of collecting data, carrying out cleaning and standardization processing on the collected data, carrying out semantic analysis and feature extraction on the preprocessed background information and post requirements by utilizing an SIMBERT algorithm, encoding texts by utilizing a bi-directional encoder to generate high-dimensional semantic vector representation by SIMBERT algorithm, constructing a matching model according to the semantic vector of the background information of the unemployed personnel and the semantic vector of the post requirements, calculating the semantic similarity of the unemployed personnel and the post, carrying out quantization, and generating a recommendation result and carrying out feedback optimization. The invention can help the lost operators to find out the proper work more quickly, and the quality and efficiency of employment service are improved obviously.

title: Rock mass instability grading early warning method and system based on microseismic feature perception and classification enhancement algorithm
description: The present invention discloses a rock instability graded warning method based on microseismic feature perception and classification enhancement algorithm, including obtaining rock instability case data information of different geotechnical engineering projects; selecting several microseismic parameters as candidate assessment indicators of rock instability risk and performing correlation analysis to obtain rock instability graded warning assessment indicators; constructing a training data set; constructing a rock instability graded warning primary model based on a classification enhancement algorithm and a genetic algorithm and training to obtain a rock instability graded warning model; using the obtained rock instability graded warning model to complete the rock instability graded warning based on microseismic feature perception and classification enhancement algorithm. The present invention also discloses a system for realizing the rock instability graded warning method based on microseismic feature perception and classification enhancement algorithm. The present invention can not only realize the rock instability graded warning based on microseismic feature perception and classification enhancement algorithm, but also has higher reliability and better accuracy.

title: Sedum-free and seed-containing watermelon classification method based on combination of transmission spectrum and feature fusion deep learning model
description: The invention discloses a seedless and seedless watermelon classification method based on a transmission spectrum combined characteristic fusion deep learning model.
