The method comprises the steps of acquiring a transmission spectrum data set of the watermelon by using a transmission spectrum acquisition device, constructing a characteristic fusion model, inputting the transmission spectrum data set of the watermelon into the characteristic fusion model for training to obtain a trained characteristic fusion model, acquiring a transmission spectrum of the watermelon to be detected, inputting the transmission spectrum of the watermelon to be detected into the trained characteristic fusion model for classification and identification treatment to obtain the seedless or seedy type of the watermelon to be detected. The invention realizes the effective combination of the transmission spectrum method, the image conversion method and the convolution neural network method, and the advantages of collecting the transmission spectrum of the watermelon and directly obtaining the rapid and accurate classification result of the seedless and seedy watermelon by performing model processing.

title: Machine room energy consumption prediction method based on cyclic neural network codec
description: The present invention discloses a method for predicting energy consumption of a computer room based on a recurrent neural network codec. The recurrent neural network (LSTM) is good at modeling time series data and can effectively capture the time dependency in the computer room energy consumption data, thereby improving the accuracy of the prediction. The LSTM model is constructed as a codec architecture, which can better extract the spatiotemporal characteristics of the input data and generate accurate prediction results. By effectively utilizing the training set and the test set, combined with the loss function optimization and the prediction standard evaluation, it can be ensured that the developed LSTM model has good generalization performance. Using the LSTM codec architecture, combined with the preprocessing of the historical computer room energy consumption data and the model training evaluation, a method for accurately predicting the energy consumption of the future computer room can be achieved to meet the needs in practical applications. This method is expected to overcome the limitations of traditional prediction techniques and improve the efficiency of computer room energy management.

title: Gesture recognition method and system based on multi-head attention and space-time feature fusion
description: The invention belongs to the field of gesture recognition, and provides a gesture recognition method and a gesture recognition system based on fusion of multiple attentions and space-time features, which utilize a deep learning framework to build a neural network model structure, introduce a gesture sequence of hand joint points containing time sequence features, and carrying out feature extraction, position coding and attention calculation, feature fusion and feature mapping on the gesture sequence data by using the proposed gesture recognition algorithm, and outputting a gesture classification result with higher accuracy. The novel network topology structure is adopted, and the complex relation between space and time in two dimensions of space and time is captured by the local global multi-head attention module, so that the problem that short-term and long-term dependency relations are insufficient when complex time sequence data are captured by the current model is solved, and the fusion algorithm is more flexible and efficient when different types of gesture sequence data are processed.

title: A distribution network self-healing method and system based on distribution network SCADA
description: This invention discloses a distribution network self-healing method and system based on SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) for distribution networks, comprising: data acquisition and preprocessing based on the SCADA system; feature extraction of the preprocessed data; detection of anomalies using an optimized LOF (List of Elements) algorithm; fault isolation; and reconstructing the power grid topology to achieve self-healing of the distribution network. The distribution network self-healing method and system based on SCADA provided by this invention significantly improves the accuracy and efficiency of fault detection by extracting features from the data and introducing an optimized LOF algorithm combined with a genetic algorithm for anomaly detection, enabling rapid identification of fault points. Through the SCADA system and automated switches, automatic fault isolation is achieved, and by combining linear programming and ant colony optimization algorithms, the power grid reconfiguration scheme is optimized to ensure load balancing and improve the reliability and stability of the power grid.

title: Resource allocation method and system in general sense calculation integrated Internet of vehicles system
description: The present invention discloses a resource allocation method and system in a telematics-computing integrated vehicle networking system, relates to the field of wireless communication technology, and solves the contradiction in the allocation of limited bandwidth and power resources between delay-sensitive perception services and high-traffic communication services in the existing telematics-computing-enabled vehicle networking. The key points of the scheme are: a telematics-computing integrated vehicle networking system is proposed, and a resource allocation method in the telematics-computing integrated vehicle networking system is developed. The method pays special attention to the contradiction between delay-sensitive perception services and high-traffic communication services, and optimizes perception delay, computing processing, network stability and communication rate by jointly associating node association, power and subcarrier block allocation. The present application can reasonably optimize node association, power and subcarrier block allocation to maximize model training completion while ensuring collaborative perception delay constraints and collaborative perception accuracy.

title: Data transmission method, data processing device and electronic equipment
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a data transmission method, a data processing device and electronic equipment, relates to the technical field of chips, and solves the problem of how to develop operators for chips of different chip architectures at lower cost to realize synchronization between data by adopting a parallel data processing mode when a dependency relationship exists between the data. The method comprises the steps of firstly applying for a target storage space in a storage space corresponding to a first logic position. And then, transmitting the data stored in the storage space corresponding to the second logic position to the target storage space. And finally, changing the first corresponding relation between the data and the second logic position into the second corresponding relation between the data and the first logic position.

title: Software risk assessment method, device, storage medium, program product and equipment
description: The present application discloses a software risk assessment method, apparatus, storage medium, program product and equipment, the method comprising: parsing a code file of the software to be assessed to obtain code information, wherein the code information is used to indicate components and library functions corresponding to the code file; extracting features based on the code information to obtain word vector features, and determining a word vector risk score based on the word vector features; based on the code file, performing a risk assessment on the component to obtain a first static feature risk score, and performing a risk assessment on the library function to obtain a second static feature risk score; determining a static feature risk score based on the first static feature risk score and the second static feature risk score; determining an overall risk score based on the word vector risk score and the static feature risk score, thereby being able to efficiently and accurately identify risks existing in the software to improve software quality and software security.

title: A text style transfer method based on generative adversarial network
description: The invention discloses a text style migration method based on a generated countermeasure network, which comprises the steps of obtaining predicted attribute style probabilities through a text convolution network by an original sentence, deleting attribute words in the original sentence, inputting the deleted sentence into the text convolution network again until the predicted attribute style probabilities after deleting each attribute word are obtained, carrying out probability difference operation on the predicted attribute style probabilities, arranging each attribute word according to a result to obtain a sorting result, deleting a first attribute word in the original sentence according to a descending order to obtain a first sentence, continuing deleting a second attribute word in the first sentence when the attribute style probabilities and the lengths of the first sentence are not in accordance with preset conditions, obtaining semantic content until the attribute style probabilities and the lengths of the deleted sentence are in accordance with preset conditions, and obtaining a target sentence by a semantic content coder and a decoder. The invention improves the statement style judging accuracy, the text generating quality and the authenticity.

title: Residual electric life prediction method of low-voltage direct-current circuit breaker based on image analysis of inner wall of arc extinguishing chamber
description: The present invention provides a method for predicting the remaining electrical life of a low-voltage DC circuit breaker based on the analysis of the inner wall image of the arc extinguishing chamber. The method comprises: conducting an electrical life test on the circuit breaker under constant current stress conditions and establishing a corresponding database; preprocessing the image, removing the part irrelevant to the arc extinguishing chamber, and dividing the training set and the test set; building a CNN network; using the attention mechanism to optimize the network output; and using the optimized model to predict the life of the circuit breaker. When processing the inner wall image of the arc extinguishing chamber, the present invention does not require complex preprocessing or manual feature extraction, and directly uses the original image as input to allow the network to learn the optimal representation features, thereby reducing the influence of artificial subjective factors on feature selection, and has the characteristics of higher efficiency and strong robustness.

title: Log counting method based on Yolov9-UNet in complex environment
description: The invention relates to a Yolov-UNet-based log counting method in a complex environment, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the steps of embedding a transducer into a UNet to form a Trans-UNet module, combining the Trans-UNet module with Yolov to form a Yolov-UNet model, collecting training data to train the Yolov-UNet model, respectively training the Trans-UNet module and Yolov by referring to the training process of a GAN network, collecting images containing the end faces of logs, carrying out normalization processing, inputting the normalized images into the trained Yolov-UNet model to obtain detection frames, and carrying out statistics on the detection frames to obtain the number of the logs. The invention can realize effective recovery of images in different scenes and log counting in complex environments.

title: Mixed intrusion detection system and method suitable for incomplete data of Internet of things
description: The present invention discloses a hybrid intrusion detection method suitable for incomplete data of the Internet of Things, comprising the following steps: obtaining an open source data set and preprocessing it; configuring a training environment; constructing and training a multi-classification stage algorithm model, wherein the multi-classification stage algorithm model is weighted aggregation of four integrated learning algorithms, namely, an RF algorithm, a category feature boosting algorithm CatBoost, an XGBoost algorithm, and a lightweight gradient boosting machine algorithm LightGBM; constructing and training a binary classification stage algorithm model, wherein the binary classification stage algorithm model is weighted summation of anomaly scores output by an autoencoder, a single-class support vector machine, and an isolation forest algorithm to obtain an aggregated anomaly score, and the final detection result is obtained by comparing it with a threshold. The method can reduce data imbalance, better adapt to incomplete data sets, thereby providing system adaptability, and can effectively aggregate the training results of multiple algorithms.

title: Secure encryption method for mobile storage equipment, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a secure encryption method for a mobile storage device, an electronic device and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data encryption for mobile devices, comprising the following steps: establishing a chaotic mapping system, the chaotic mapping system comprising: a first chaotic mapping and a second chaotic mapping; establishing a chaotic sequence generation method based on the first chaotic mapping and the second chaotic mapping; splitting a file header of a file to be encrypted, and encrypting the file header based on the chaotic sequence generation method; segmenting the file content of the file to be encrypted, and encrypting the file content based on the chaotic sequence generation method; the invention is used to solve the problem that the existing mobile device data encryption technology cannot quickly encrypt large files by operating character segments while ensuring encryption security in a mobile computing environment.

title: MRI-TRUS image registration method and device based on weak supervision learning
description: The application provides an MRI-TRUS image registration method and device based on weak supervision learning, comprising the following steps: firstly, an MRI image and a TRUS image to be registered are acquired, and are input into a pre-trained segmentation sub-network to obtain a corresponding mask. These masks and the original image are then re-input into a pre-trained registration sub-network to obtain registration results. The registration sub-network comprises a transformation field unit and a registration unit, wherein the transformation field unit generates a dense transformation field, the registration unit takes an MRI mask and an image as a moving object, the TRUS mask and the image as a fixed object, and the moving object is registered into the fixed object according to the transformation field. And acquiring an MRI mask to be registered and a TRUS mask to be registered by dividing the sub-network, and carrying out accurate registration in the registration sub-network by taking the MRI mask to be registered and the TRUS mask to be registered as guidance.

title: Optimization of executable graphs for artificial intelligence model reasoning
description: The present application relates to the optimization of executable graphs for AI model reasoning. The optimization method may include: copying an executable graph to generate M identical executable graphs; determining one or more nodes eligible for optimization from the executable graph based on an inference throughput-related parameter associated with an inference device for performing AI model reasoning; and generating an optimized executable graph for AI model reasoning by optimizing one or more nodes from each of the M identical executable graphs. Here, M is an integer in the range of 2 to the maximum number of executable graphs allowed, N, and N is an integer estimated or manually configured based on the memory size of the inference device and the size of the executable graph.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR CONSTRUCTING NEURON NETWORK FOR IMAGE RECOGNITION, DATA MEDIUM, RECOGNITION METHOD AND DEVICE, AND CORRESPONDING COMPUTER PROGRAM PRODUCTS
description: The invention relates to a method for constructing a neural network for recognizing a class of membership of an image to be recognized, among a set of membership classes, comprising an initialization phase comprising the following steps : - obtaining a set of at least one initialization image for each membership class to be processed; - association of at least one signature with at least one region of interest of at least one of said images of initialization; training of a neuron map with the aid of said signatures, delivering an initialized neuron network.This method comprises a labeling phase of said initialized neuron network, associating at least one of said neurons with a weight for at least one of said membership classes, from an injection into said initialized neural network of at least one signature of at least one of said initialization images.The invention also relates to a method of recognition.

title: Model training method, network congestion control method, device and related products
description: The disclosure discloses a model training method, a network congestion control method, a device and related products. The cloud storage technology relates to the technical field of cloud computing, in particular to the cloud storage technology. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring at least one off-line network connection between the local terminal equipment and the opposite terminal equipment; adjusting the network congestion control data aiming at each offline network connection, and collecting first transmission behavior data and first transmission result data corresponding to the offline network connection after the network congestion control data is adjusted; constructing a corresponding training sample according to the adjusted network congestion control data, the corresponding first transmission behavior data and the first transmission result data; training a preset neural network model by using a training sample to obtain a training-to-convergence neural network model, wherein the training-to-convergence neural network model is used for determining optimal network congestion control data corresponding to on-line network connection between the local terminal equipment and the opposite terminal equipment.

title: Business-to-individual e-commerce service methods and systems
description: The present application provides a business-to-individual e-commerce service method and system. The method includes: the terminal device determines the first video selected by the target object, and plays the first video to the target object; the terminal device determines that the first video does not have the function of shopping. When linking, extract a multi-frame picture of the first video. The time difference between two adjacent frames in the multi-frame picture is the same. Each frame of the multi-frame picture is used as an input picture for photography and shopping, and the at least one corresponding to the multi-frame picture is obtained. A shopping video, at least one link of the at least one shopping video is displayed in a preset position of the first video in a preset form; when the terminal device receives that the target object clicks the first link in the at least one link, it plays the first link. Link to the corresponding shopping video and enter the shopping page corresponding to the first link. The technical solution provided by this application has the advantage of high user experience.

title: Feature memory forgetting unit, network and system for removing image stripe noise
description: The invention relates to a feature memory and forgetting unit, network and system for image strip noise removal. The feature memory and forgetting unit includes: Block Cache module, used to store the previous output feature tensor, the current output feature tensor, and the previous cycle state. tensor, the current loop state tensor and the sequence of image tensors to be processed; the Buffer module is used to store the input feature tensor obtained based on the previous output feature tensor and the current input image tensor to be processed; the cache module is used It is used to store weights; the convolution operation module is used to obtain the current cycle state tensor based on the convolution result and the previous cycle state tensor, and to obtain the current output feature tensor based on the convolution result and the current cycle state tensor. The present invention constructs an image strip noise removal unit using a recurrent neural network, uses the recurrent neural network to find the spatial distribution and time correlation of the strip noise in the image, and can effectively extract the characteristics of the strip noise.

title: Heart nuclear magnetic resonance image lesion structure extraction method based on deep learning
description: The invention provides an image feature extraction method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: receiving, by a deep learning network from a cardiac nuclear magnetic resonance imaging system, first input data representing an unannotated image of cardiac nuclear magnetic resonance; pre-processing the unannotated image by a deep learning network to generate second input data representing a saliency image of cardiac nuclear magnetic resonance and corresponding annotation data representing a saliency region of the saliency image; processing the first and second input data to perform training of the deep learning network by target feature detection in unannotated images in salient regions identified in the salient images; the third input data is processed using the trained deep learning network to identify lesion structures in the new unannotated image. The invention provides an image feature extraction method based on deep learning, which does not need a complex structure and can complete the training of a required model at one time so as to more quickly position a heart lesion structure.

title: Processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for living body detection model
description: The present application relates to artificial intelligence, and in particular, to a method, apparatus, computer equipment and storage medium for processing a living body detection model. The method includes: sequentially extracting image features from image samples of different application scenarios; determining, based on the image features, a discrimination difficulty value of a data domain to which the different image samples belong; Recognition difficulty value; assign weights of different sizes to different image samples according to the recognition difficulty value; there is a negative correlation between the weight and the recognition difficulty value; based on the image samples of different application scenarios, according to the Perform model training on the living body detection model in order of the weights from large to small. Using this method can speed up the model convergence speed.

title: Equipment fault early warning method and system based on multi-mode sensitive feature selection fusion
description: The invention provides a device fault early warning method and system based on multi-modal sensitive feature selection fusion, which are used for solving the technical problems of low accuracy and narrow application range of an early warning system based on single-modal features. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, extracting a characteristic vector of collected parameter operation data of a normal state of the historical equipment, and standardizing the characteristic vector; secondly, acquiring sensitive characteristics of standardized characteristic data by using core PCA based on a Mercer kernel, and training a GMM (Gaussian mixture model) according to the sensitive characteristics; then, real-time state data of the equipment in operation are acquired on line, and multi-modal sensitive features are selected according to the steps; and finally, inputting the multi-modal sensitive features into the trained GMM, and determining whether to alarm or not according to whether the obtained probability value is smaller than a preset threshold value or not. According to the invention, through multi-mode feature selection and fusion of the equipment, the accuracy of the equipment fault early warning system is improved, and off-line early warning model construction and on-line real-time fault early warning are realized.

title: License plate recognition method and device
description: A license plate recognition method and a device thereof are provided, the method comprises the following steps: receiving an acquired image sequence; carrying out vehicle detection on the image sequence to obtain a vehicle detection result and RE-ID characteristics; tracking the vehicle according to the vehicle detection result and the RE-ID characteristic to obtain a tracking track of the vehicle; detecting the license plate of the vehicle based on the tracking track to obtain license plate characters; recognizing the license plate characters to obtain a current license plate recognition result of the vehicle; fusing the current license plate recognition result of the vehicle with the historical license plate recognition result of the vehicle to obtain a fusion result; judging whether the fusion result meets the set requirement or not; if so, outputting the fusion result as a final license plate recognition result; otherwise, continuing to carry out license plate detection and license plate recognition on the vehicle. By using the method and the device, the accuracy of the license plate identification result can be improved.

title: A neural network architecture search method, device, equipment and medium
description: The present application provides a neural network architecture search method, which is applied to a search system, wherein the search system includes a generator and a searcher, and the method includes: the generator generates multiple neural network architectures according to the search space, the searcher obtains the evaluation index values of multiple sub-models obtained according to the multiple neural network architectures on the first hardware, and the searcher determines the first target neural network architecture that meets the preset conditions according to the neural network architectures corresponding to the multiple sub-models and the evaluation index values of the multiple sub-models on the first hardware. In this way, the decoupling of the training processes of different initial sub-models and the decoupling of the neural network architecture search process and the initial sub-model training process are achieved, which shortens the search time and improves the search efficiency.

title: Method and device for generating speaking face video based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses a method and device for generating a talking face video based on a convolutional neural network. The method includes: constructing a data set; designing a lip synchronization discriminator; using the data set to train the lip synchronization discriminator to obtain trained lip sounds Synchronize the discriminator; construct the speaking face generation network; use the dataset to train the speaking face generation network to obtain the trained speaking face generation network; input the target voice and the face picture of the target person into the trained speaking face generation network Generate a video of the target person speaking the target voice; the advantage of the present invention is that it can generate a speaking face video with high clarity and high authenticity in which the lip movement is synchronized with the voice.

title: Method for determining configuration parameters and related equipment
description: This application discloses a method for determining configuration parameters and related equipment, including: determining forwarding service simulation information, which includes input traffic information and data path behavior; and separately determining the forwarding service simulation information based on multiple sets of first configuration parameters. A simulation test is performed to obtain multiple sets of first simulation test results; and based on the multiple sets of first simulation test results, a target first configuration parameter corresponding to the target first simulation test result is determined from the multiple sets of first configuration parameters. Through simulation testing, the efficiency of determining configuration parameters can be effectively improved. Determining configuration parameters does not require technicians to have high technical analysis capabilities and rich debugging experience. Moreover, the determined configuration parameters can meet the needs of multiple business overlays. the required data path performance.

title: A method for classifying metagenomic contigs based on self-supervised learning
description: The invention discloses a metagenomic contig classification method based on self-supervised learning. The method includes: dividing the sequence into overlapping short sequences of fixed length; treating each short sequence as a word, obtaining all the words in the sequence, and converting the character sequence into a numerical sequence by digitally encoding different words, where different A collection of words is used as a dictionary; the numerical sequence is input into the trained self-supervised learning neural network model to extract sequence features; the extracted sequence features are dimensionally reduced to map to a low-dimensional classifiable feature space, and use Clustering algorithm performs classification and obtains classification results. The present invention can improve the efficiency and accuracy of metagenomic contig classification.

title: A kind of audio and video multimodal emotion classification method and system
description: The invention relates to the field of voice and image processing and mode recognition, in particular to an audio and video multi-mode emotion classification method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: processing and calculating original video data to obtain a video data sample, an audio data sample and a text characteristic sample; constructing an emotional feature extraction network, and respectively extracting features of the video data sample, the audio data sample and the text feature sample to obtain visual modal features, audio features and text features in multiple modes; and unifying the dimensionality of the extracted visual modal characteristics, audio characteristics and text characteristics, inputting the unified dimensionality to a tensor fusion network for fusion learning, and finally classifying and outputting a multi-modal emotion classification probability result. The invention can effectively integrate the emotion information between the cross-modal, extract the features of the video, the audio and the text in high space-time dimension, splice the multi-modal feature vectors, and perform fusion learning and emotion classification.

title: Debiasing method of deep learning model based on bidirectional feature embedding
description: The invention discloses a deep learning model depolarization method based on bidirectional feature embedding, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a first sample set of privileged groups and a first sample set of non-privileged groups; constructing a dual-feature embedded sample set; building a revenue prediction model, wherein the deep learning model comprises a 6-layer fully-connected network; embedding a sample set by using double characteristics, and judging the total loss formed by the loss _ m1 of the task and the loss _ m2 of the social bias as the final loss during training; and in each training stage, measuring and calculating the income judgment result output by the income prediction model and the corresponding sensitivity sample set through the mean difference, and obtaining the final income prediction model when the calculation result of the mean difference meets a threshold value. The revenue prediction model is capable of accurately predicting revenue without bias.

title: A 3D reconstruction method of multi-focus images based on deep learning
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of three-dimensional reconstruction, and in particular relates to a multi-focus three-dimensional reconstruction method based on deep learning. It includes the following steps: first, use the image data of the real scene to construct a defocus sequence set and a simulated real depth set; secondly, input the constructed defocus sequence set and the simulated real depth set into a deep learning network structure designed for training; then, Collect the set of defocus sequences of the scene to be tested, and obtain the depth prediction map of the scene to be tested through the trained neural network; finally, use the variance map of the set of defocus sequences as a guide map to guide the filtering of the depth prediction map to obtain the final object to be tested. 3D reconstruction results. The method of the present invention has better expansibility, and can realize rapid deployment and application of different application scenarios.

title: Communication method and device
description: The application discloses a communication method and a communication device, which are used for solving the problem that the computing power of a special accelerator arranged inside a terminal side device can not meet the requirements of software and application. The method comprises the steps that the end-side equipment applies for computing resources from the cloud-side equipment as required, on one hand, the end-side equipment can send an artificial intelligence model and data to be analyzed to the cloud-side equipment, the cloud-side equipment combines the computing resources to load and operate the artificial intelligence model, and reasoning is conducted on the data to be analyzed to obtain a reasoning result and feed the reasoning result back to the end-side equipment. On the other hand, the end-side device can load the artificial intelligence model, then operates the artificial model and the data to be analyzed to generate a calculation instruction and calculation data, sends the calculation instruction and the calculation data to the cloud-side device, and then the cloud-side device executes the calculation instruction to calculate the calculation data to obtain a calculation result and feeds the calculation result back to the end-side device.

title: Line parameter identification method based on BP neural network and improved SCADA data
description: The invention discloses a line parameter identification method based on BP neural network and improved SCADA data. It is characterized by including the following steps: Step S1: Establishing a training set containing SCADA data of different lines under different operating conditions; Step S2: Improving SCADA data. , establish a BP neural network, and input the improved SCADA data into the BP neural network for signal forward propagation training and error back propagation training; Step S3: Use the modified SCADA data measured at both ends of the line to be identified as input Data is input into the trained BP neural network to obtain the predicted value; Step S4: Use the median robustness to remove abnormal data and noise in the predicted value as the final identification result. The BP neural network is combined with improved SCADA data and applied in the online measurement method of parameter identification to improve the tolerance of the identification method; improved SCADA data can improve the model learning effect and identification accuracy of the BP neural network. The adoption of median tolerance effectively reduces the impact of gross errors in most quantitative measurements on the identification results.

title: Axon input extension method, device, device and storage medium
description: The present application provides an axon input expansion method, device, device, and storage medium. When the number K of axon inputs required to participate in the calculation is greater than the maximum supportable number of axon inputs N, the K axon inputs are grouped and respectively Axon input connected to multiple neuron nuclei; each neuron nuclei performs weighted addition of each single-bit axon input to obtain a weighted sum with an M-bit width, and deletes X low bits to convert to a weighted sum with an S-bit width ; Connect to different axon inputs of a summary neuron nucleus, and add up the weighted sum of all S-bit bit widths to obtain a weighted sum; add the weighted sum to the last membrane voltage value and compare it with the threshold; if greater than or equal to the threshold , the aggregated neuron core outputs 1-bit pulse data. This application does not require a multiplication circuit, nor does it need to support ANN mode, and does not introduce additional computing units, and the cost is low; compared with existing methods, the algorithm accuracy is higher; the number of neuron cores used is higher than that of Tsinghua's axon extension method few.

title: Method for monitoring a switch of a railway track system
description: The invention relates, among other things, to a device for determining a classification model (KM, KM') for a switch (W) of a railway track system, which classification model is capable of determining a fault of the switch (W) from measured values measured during a switch revolution. According to the invention, reference revolution data sets are respectively determined for a plurality of switch revolutions, the reference revolution data sets respectively relate to at least two physical measurement parameters measured during the corresponding switch revolution, and a classification model (KM, KM') is determined based on the plurality of reference revolution data sets.

title: Automatic construction and topic discovery method for international organization science and technology text vocabulary chain
description: The invention discloses a scientific and technological text vocabulary chain construction and theme discovery method based on an international organization term library, and relates to the technical fields of information science and knowledge engineering. Aiming at the problem that low-frequency words such as terms are difficult to process by a conventional method, the method constructs a term vocabulary chain of a technological text based on an international organization term library, further carries out similarity discrimination, clustering and theme discovery on the text, and translates the language into Chinese based on multilingual characteristics of the international organization term library by taking the vocabulary chain as a clue, so that the method is finally used for dynamic monitoring of international leading-edge technological information. Compared with the traditional text analysis method based on statistics, the method is based on the international organization term library, has the characteristics of authority, high accuracy, tight semantic association, cross-language and the like, provides a good knowledge base for automatically discovering, fusing, reasoning and calculating scientific and technological text topics, and can effectively support related engineering application.

title: An intelligent comparison method for appearance state changes of track slabs
description: The invention relates to the technical field of automatic inspection of railway work track lines, in particular to an intelligent comparison method for the appearance state change of a track plate. The invention has the advantages that: 1) The labor cost is saved; 2) The detection range is wide; 3) The calculation speed is high; 4) The detection precision is high; 5) The detection method is flexible.

title: A method and device for intelligent medical consultation guidance in hospitals based on the new crown epidemic
description: The invention discloses a method and device for guiding intelligent medical consultation in a hospital based on the novel coronavirus epidemic. The method includes: judging whether the patient belongs to the key prevention and control object according to the electronic medical record information, judging whether the patient comes from the risk area according to the epidemic prevention and control registration information, and comprehensively judging whether the patient needs to be triaged with manual intervention; obtaining the patient's first body temperature data , according to the first body temperature data and whether it is a key prevention and control object and whether it is from the risk area, comprehensively judge whether the patient can enter the outpatient hall and diagnosis and treatment department; import the patient's first body temperature data into the electronic medical record information to form new medical treatment information, and Transmit the consultation information to the diagnosis and treatment department corresponding to the patient; obtain the second body temperature data of the patient at the diagnosis and treatment department, compare the second body temperature data with the first body temperature data, and determine whether manual intervention on the patient is required according to the comparison result triage. The invention can realize intelligently guiding patients to go to see a doctor.

title: Sensor device, data acquisition method, and current monitoring system
description: The present invention provides a sensor device, a data acquisition method and a current monitoring system, which have: a sensor data acquisition unit that acquires sensor data of a measurement object from a sensor; a sensor data analysis unit that analyzes the data acquired by the sensor data acquisition unit; an extraction data setting unit that sets extraction conditions representing a portion to be extracted from all sensor data acquired by the sensor data acquisition unit; a specific condition extraction unit that extracts a portion of all sensor data acquired by the sensor data acquisition unit based on an analysis result analyzed by the sensor data analysis unit and the extraction conditions from the extraction data setting unit; and a user interface unit for inputting and outputting information to a user, the user interface unit having: a simple condition setting unit that can set at least one or more extraction conditions, i.e., simple conditions, among the extraction conditions for the sensor data analysis unit and a detection result display unit that displays data in the sensor data analysis unit that meets the simple conditions.

title: Method to establish multi-label multi-attribute classification model based on elevator picture data
description: The invention relates to a method for establishing a multi-label multi-attribute classification model based on elevator picture data, which includes the following steps: a. Collecting pictures in the elevator car and uploading them to the cloud; b. Preprocessing the pictures and segmenting objects ; c. Use the segmented objects to train the backbone network of the classification model; d. Complete the training of the branch network of the classification model based on the backbone network. The invention can reduce the workload of labeling and reduce the amount of parameters while ensuring the accuracy of the model.

title: Video recommendation method and system based on deep learning behavior sequence
description: The present invention provides a video recommendation method based on deep learning behavior sequences, which includes: extracting user evaluation behavior sequence information according to the user's behavior footprint on the video platform, constructing a video sequence and preprocessing, and treating each video name as a word, The word vector model is trained in a negative sampling manner to obtain the video feature vector and its composed video feature vector library; in the video feature vector library, word embedding is performed on the user evaluation behavior sequence, and the depth features of each video feature vector are extracted to capture potential connections, and further predict a series of videos to form a candidate recommendation video collection; preliminary screening of the candidate recommendation video collection, and secondary screening based on the user's interest score for each type of video, to obtain the final video list recommended to the user. Implementing the present invention solves the problems of low recommendation accuracy and limited recommendation effect in existing recommendation methods, making the recommendation accuracy more accurate and the recommendation effect more obvious.

title: Method for burying heating pipeline near root zone of fruit tree
description: The invention discloses a method for burying a heating pipeline near a root zone of a fruit tree. The method comprises the steps of obtaining distribution conditions of heating temperature fields of root areas of fruit trees under different heating pipeline burying schemes based on computational fluid dynamics simulation, recording temperature values of monitoring points of the root areas of the fruit trees, and then carrying out parameter optimization by iteration of a firefly algorithm, wherein position updating is realized for firefly individuals in each iteration process, and positions of the firefly individuals represent buried distance and depth parameters of the heating pipelines. And for a group of new embedded space and embedded depth parameters, a KNN machine learning model is called to output corresponding monitoring point temperature values, a firefly algorithm is returned, whether the monitoring point temperature meets constraint conditions is judged, and heating pipeline embedded space and embedded depth parameters are optimized by taking the distribution uniformity of heating temperature fields in root areas of fruits as targets, so that a numerical basis is provided for heating pipeline embedding.

title: A GRU-based method for detecting and identifying abnormal network traffic
description: The invention discloses a GRU-based network abnormal flow detection and identification method, which comprises the steps of initializing a software defined network, initializing a network model and an original flow matrix on a node controller, establishing a topological adjacency matrix, extracting spatial characteristics, extracting time sequence correlation characteristics to obtain a classification result, evaluating and defining safety conditions, uploading space-time data to a global controller, and reversely propagating and updating the original flow matrix by the global controller. The invention can present more complete network change, avoid the uncertainty of the change trend and ensure the robustness of the whole network and the availability of time sequence data.

title: A solid waste dataset generation method based on offline data enhancement
description: A method for generating a solid waste data set based on offline data enhancement specifically includes: manually labeling a first solid waste data set A1; performing offline data enhancement on the first solid waste data set A1 to generate a second solid waste data set A2, merging the first solid waste data set A1 and the second solid waste data set A2 to form a merged solid waste data set; using a deep learning model to train the merged solid waste data set; using the trained deep learning model to predict an unlabeled solid waste data set D; finding an image set that is inaccurately predicted by the deep learning model through a query function, and manually labeling it to obtain a third solid waste data set B1; performing offline data enhancement on the third solid waste data set B1 to generate a fourth solid waste data set B2. The method proposed in the present invention can generate a large number of solid waste data sets, quickly and effectively construct and expand solid waste data sets, thereby facilitating the training of deep learning models and further improving the accuracy of solid waste identification.

title: Method and system for prediction of HLA antigen presentation based on multimodal depth coding
description: The present invention discloses a method for predicting HLA antigen presentation based on multi-modal depth coding, comprising: 1) using a variety of different deep neural networks to encode known sequence information; 2) introducing existing literature and computing tools to calculate affinity index 3) Multi-modal feature fusion to get prediction scores and make predictions. Different from the previous methods based only on biological experiments or affinity index prediction, this system scheme can efficiently integrate multimodal information and make more accurate and efficient predictions. In addition, it has flexible expansion in processing negative samples of different methods and data imbalance, which can better adapt to the real drug development and production environment.

title: Hardware Trojan detection method, medium and computer based on Bagging
description: The invention belongs to the field of circuit design, and discloses a Bagging-based hardware Trojan detection method, medium and computer, wherein an effective feature matrix of a hardware Trojan circuit is extracted from a gate-level netlist file based on Verilog; preprocessing the characteristic data set by using SMOTH technology so as to balance the number of Trojan horse circuit characteristics and common circuit characteristics; establishing a detection model based on a Bagging integration method by utilizing an LSTM neural network model; and detecting the gate-level netlist by using the constructed Bagging integrated Trojan detection model. The invention extracts and predicts the characteristics of each logic gate and each register of the gate netlist, can accurately determine the position of the Trojan horse circuit in the gate netlist, and is convenient for a designer to check and modify the gate netlist. In addition, the feature extraction mode does not need the whole netlist information, so that Trojan horse detection is conveniently carried out on the local netlist circuit.

title: Long-tail distribution image recognition method based on grouping balance and diversity enhancement
description: The invention provides a long-tail distribution image recognition method based on grouping balance and diversity enhancement, which comprises the steps of grouping by utilizing the frequency of each category in an image recognition data set, uniformly sampling to obtain an input image, effectively utilizing the information of a head category to enhance the feature diversity of a tail category through a diversity enhancement module to reduce the phenomenon of overfitting the tail category, balancing the gradient and updating a multi-label image recognition model by inputting a classification confidence and a true mark into a grouping balance loss module, wherein the grouping balance loss can ignore all forward category gradients of other groups, only update the category of the current sampled group, and balance the gradient among the categories, thereby improving the performance of multi-label image recognition.

title: Stomach cancer patient survival risk prediction method based on histopathological image and gene expression data
description: The present invention relates to a method for predicting the survival risk of gastric cancer patients based on histopathological images and gene expression data. The method performs cell nucleus segmentation on the histopathological images, selects the image blocks with the largest number of cell nuclei as the input of the neural network, and integrates the histopathological images with structured demographic and gene expression data to construct a multimodal fusion model. Compared with the prior art, the present invention has the advantages of improving prediction accuracy.

title: Method, device and equipment for planning electricity coupling time period based on artificial neural network
description: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a planning method of an electricity coupling period based on an artificial neural network, which comprises the following steps: generating a probability prediction model based on a preset model generation algorithm, wherein the probability prediction model is used for predicting the probability of success of each to-be-joined user in each period of time; obtaining a model factor corresponding to each user in each period; inputting a model factor corresponding to each user in each time period into the probability prediction model for analysis to obtain a success probability value of each user in each time period; and analyzing the success probability value of each user corresponding to each time interval based on a preset planning algorithm to obtain a planning result of the time interval of the electricity. Therefore, the invention can realize planning of the electric coupling time period by utilizing the computer technology, so that the communication probability of the electric coupling whole body can be improved, and the working efficiency and the working experience of telephone agent marketing personnel are improved.

title: Edge detection method and readable storage medium
description: The invention provides an edge detection method and a readable storage medium. The edge detection method comprises the steps of carrying out convolution calculation based on 2 x 2 pixel groups as the center to obtain convolution of convolution pixels, wherein color channels of original pixels in each 2 x 2 pixel group are the same, each convolution pixel corresponds to one 2 x 2 pixel group, calculating gradient of the convolution pixel based on the convolution pixel, and judging whether the current convolution pixel is an edge pixel or not based on the gradient of the convolution pixel. The configuration solves the problem that the prior art lacks a method for directly carrying out edge detection on the original information contained in the Quad Bayer Raw image. Meanwhile, the method has the advantages of simple calculation process and high accuracy.

title: Target detection method for large-size aerial remote sensing image
description: A method for target detection of large-scale aerial remote sensing images belongs to the technical field of target detection. The present invention aims at the problem that large-scale aerial remote sensing images may lose context information due to image segmentation. The method comprises the following steps: determining the name of the original image; configuring a sub-image name for a sub-image; retrieving the corresponding current original remote sensing image from the original remote sensing image set according to the sub-image name; extracting features from the current sub-image to be detected using a local feature extractor to obtain a set of multi-scale sub-image feature maps; downsampling the current original remote sensing image and then extracting features using a global feature extractor to obtain a set of multi-scale original image feature maps; obtaining a fused feature map using a feature pyramid network with a global-local coupling mechanism; respectively obtaining target prediction results and filtered global prediction results; and fusing the fused target prediction results and filtered global prediction results to obtain a detected target. The present invention is used for target detection.

title: An intelligent traffic load balancing method for high-rate satellite-to-ground link communication services
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent traffic load balancing method for high-rate satellite-to-ground link communication services, which belongs to the field of onboard processing of satellite communication systems. First, a virtual satellite-to-ground communication environment is constructed, and the data sender is regarded as an intelligent agent in reinforcement learning. The execution action is to select a certain sending link. An environmental reward function based on traffic statistics is designed, and the environmental state is information such as the satellite-to-ground link state. A fully connected neural network is built to estimate the cumulative rewards of each execution action of the intelligent agent, and a deep reinforcement learning algorithm is used for training; then, the neural network model is transplanted to the FPGA, and the collected satellite-to-ground link state and other information are input, and the optimal sending link is selected according to the cumulative rewards to achieve load balancing between links. The small fully connected network model used in the present invention has a small parameter scale, which is suitable for FPGA platforms with limited onboard resources, and the trained neural network model can better extract features from the input information and has a better load balancing effect.

title: A Gas Pressure Prediction Method for SF6 Equipment Based on Prophet-LSTM Model
description: The invention relates to a method for predicting the gas pressure of SF6 equipment based on a Prophet-LSTM model, comprising the following steps: collecting and preprocessing data when SF6 electrical equipment is running, and dividing the data into a training set and a test set after normalization; The data of the training set is trained by the Prophet model and the Bayesian optimized LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory Network) model respectively; the training set prediction results of the Prophet model and the LSTM model and the real data of the training set are input into the optimal weight coefficient acquisition module, The combined weights of the two models are obtained; the test set data is input to the combined model, and the prediction performance of the combined model is tested according to the test set prediction results and the test set real data; finally, the perfect combined prediction model is used for SF6 stress prediction. The present invention applies the Prophet-LSTM model to the prediction of the pressure value in the SF6 electrical equipment, which is helpful for judging possible overheating faults and leakage faults in the equipment through the gas pressure value, and plays an early warning role.

title: Semantic knowledge base construction method and system in environmental impact evaluation field
description: The invention provides a semantic knowledge base construction method and a semantic knowledge base construction system in the environmental impact evaluation field, comprising the steps of constructing a professional term knowledge base and a non-professional term knowledge base corresponding to each industry category according to business requirements and industry expert knowledge, establishing a fuzzy extraction rule for each non-professional term keyword in the non-professional term knowledge base through a regular expression, constructing a quaternary relation among the industry category, the professional term, the rule and the keyword, generating a keyword-rule word base according to the quaternary relation, selecting a corresponding professional term from the keyword-rule word base according to the industry category of a target criticizing file, positioning a target chapter of the target criticizing file, a table corresponding to the target chapter and text content, extracting the keywords in the table corresponding to the target chapter and the text content according to the rule in the keyword-rule word base, scoring the extraction result, and evaluating the normative of the target criticizing file according to the scoring result.

title: Gesture recognition method and device
description: The present application discloses a gesture recognition method and device. The method includes: obtaining a first image vector and a weight of the first image vector; the first image vector is an image vector of a key frame in an image sequence generated based on a video image of a gesture to be recognized, and its weight is the weight of the key frame in the image sequence; generating a first gesture feature vector based on the first image vector and the weight of the first image vector; determining a gesture recognition result of the gesture to be recognized based on the first gesture feature vector and a first gesture feature vector set; the first gesture feature vector set is a set of gesture feature vectors whose gesture recognition results are known. Using this method, the image vector of the key frame of the image sequence of the gesture to be recognized can be converted into a gesture feature vector of a fixed length, and the gesture recognition process can be converted into a gesture feature vector retrieval process, thereby avoiding the introduction of noise or loss of feature information, as well as the increase of equipment overhead.

title: Methods, systems, and apparatus for enabling and managing quantum networks
description: Centralized quantum capability management may be provided. The quantum network architecture may include a centralized quantum network manager. Quantum policy management may be controlled by a quantum network manager. Quantum capability registration, request, subscription, and discovery may be provided. Centralized quantum connection creation and management may be provided. An efficient quantum link layer service can be provided.

title: Image brightness enhancement method, terminal and storage medium based on adversarial network
description: The present invention discloses a method, terminal, and storage medium for enhancing image brightness based on an adversarial network. The method comprises: converting an image to be processed from RGB space to Lab space to obtain preprocessed data; inputting the preprocessed data into an adversarial network model; inputting the output image data into a discriminant network model to obtain a discrimination result; training the adversarial network model according to the discrimination result to obtain a trained adversarial network model; and adjusting the brightness of the image to be processed based on the trained adversarial network model. The present invention can avoid color distortion by converting the image into Lab space; and by inputting the converted data into the adversarial network model and using the discriminant network model to discriminate the output result, thereby automatically finding a brightness enhancement factor, improving the accuracy of image brightness enhancement, and avoiding the phenomenon of prominent light and dark edges and color distortion of the image caused by excessively high or low brightness values.

title: A ferroelectrically controlled two-terminal lead-free perovskite artificial optical synapse device and its preparation method
description: The present invention discloses a ferroelectrically controlled, two-terminal, lead-free perovskite artificial optical synaptic device and its preparation method. The device is characterized by sequentially spin-coating a lead-free perovskite film and an organic ferroelectric polymer film on a lower electrode to form a semiconductor active functional layer, followed by thermal evaporation of an upper electrode on the functional layer to form a vertically layered, ferroelectrically controlled, two-terminal artificial synaptic device. The preparation process specifically includes preparing a spin-coating solution, spin-coating the lead-free perovskite film and the organic ferroelectric polymer film, and evaporating the upper electrode. Compared with existing technologies, the present invention has advantages such as picoampere-level operating current, zero power consumption, and long memory time. It can simulate typical biological synaptic functions under light stimulation of a specific wavelength and can be applied to construct artificial neural network systems. The preparation method is simple, low-cost, safe, and environmentally friendly.

title: Video pedestrian re-identification method
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of video pedestrian re-identification, and provides a video pedestrian re-identification method. The invention uses a transducer structure to extract multi-view features to solve the task of video pedestrian re-recognition. The purpose of video pedestrian re-identification is to realize the cross-camera matching of pedestrian sequence pictures. The invention provides a method for respectively acquiring the spatial view angle, the time sequence view angle and the space-time view angle of pedestrian videos by using a three-fork network, so as to obtain multi-view angle observations in different characteristic fields. The transform is used to mine single view feature relationships within a single view feature domain and optimize view features. And exploring multi-view feature relations among cross-view feature domains by using a transducer, and fusing multi-view information to obtain more sufficient feature representation. The invention can extract the characteristic representation of the pedestrian video with more robustness and more discriminant, and can realize the matching of the pedestrian video instance with higher precision.

title: Landslide deformation prediction method based on GA-GM (1,1) power model
description: The invention discloses a landslide deformation prediction method based on a GA-GM (1, 1) power model, which solves the related parameters of the GM (1, 1) power model, such as an initial condition s  (1) t 0 , a development coefficient a, an ash action amount b and the like, by solving the power exponent alpha and the sequence length m of the GM (1, 1) power model through a GA algorithm, so as to obtain the landslide occurrence time t. The invention can ensure the optimal related parameters, further ensure that the landslide occurrence time of final prediction and forecast has smaller phase difference with the actual landslide occurrence time, and improve the accuracy of geological disaster prediction and forecast.

title: Regional pedestrian track reconstruction device and method based on deep learning
description: The present invention provides a regional pedestrian trajectory reconstruction device and method based on deep learning. The trajectory reconstruction device comprises a pedestrian detection module, a pedestrian re-identification module and a pedestrian trajectory reconstruction module. The pedestrian detection module can perform pedestrian detection on the collected surveillance video RTSP data stream. The pedestrian re-identification module compares the detected pedestrians with the pedestrian images stored in the data storage and updating module for similarity, and generates trajectory record information according to the successfully compared pedestrians. The pedestrian trajectory reconstruction module then sorts the trajectory record information and the stored trajectory data and reconstructs the trajectory map of the pedestrian in time sequence. Finally, the result display module displays the trajectory map for analysts to view. Since a deep learning method is used to acquire, detect and analyze pedestrian information in massive surveillance video data, and to reconstruct pedestrian trajectories using feature information of the video data, efficient processing and intelligent monitoring of massive surveillance video data are achieved.

title: Named entity recognition method and device using dictionary knowledge, electronic equipment and medium
description: The application relates to the technical field of named body recognition, in particular to a named body recognition method, a named body recognition device, electronic equipment and a named body recognition medium by utilizing dictionary knowledge, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a context representation of text data in a text; matching the matching entity of the text by using the entity dictionary, and obtaining the hidden vector representation of the matching entity; and obtaining a representation of the text union entity and a representation of the entity union context based on the context representation and the hidden vector representation, and generating a named-body recognition result. Therefore, the problems that a large amount of domain knowledge and manual labeling are needed when a named object is identified, a named object identification model is trained by severely depending on labeled sentences are solved, context representation of words of texts is obtained by adopting various models, word-level modeling is carried out on matching entities by using a bidirectional gating circulation unit, the representation of the entity is obtained, and the named object identification performance is improved through text and entity representation joint learning.

title: A UAV target tracking method based on DAMDNet-EKF algorithm
description: The present invention discloses a method for tracking unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) target of DAMDNet-EKF algorithm, comprising the following steps: step 1, collecting video frames, training a bounding box regression model according to the initial video frames through a preset tracking model; wherein the tracking model is constructed based on a neural network model of DAMDNet, and has been pre-trained and initialized; step 2, removing the initial video frame, using the remaining video frames as tracking model input, obtaining a target bounding box of the video frame and a target score corresponding to the target bounding box; step 3, if the target score obtained in step 2 is less than a preset value, updating the tracking model; if the target score obtained in step 2 is not less than a preset value, using a bounding box regression model to adjust the optimal target bounding box and updating the tracking model. The present invention effectively solves the problem that the UAV tracking algorithm is prone to tracking failure and has poor real-time performance.

title: A training method, apparatus, device, and storage medium for a model.
description: The embodiment of the application provides a training method, device and equipment of a model and a storage medium thereof. The method comprises the steps of mapping a first model feature vector and a second model feature vector to a vector space with the same dimension by determining a first model feature vector generated by a first model with a smaller scale at an hidden layer and determining a second model feature vector generated by a second model with a larger scale at the hidden layer, dividing the second model feature vector into a first sub-feature vector and a second sub-feature vector, using a first loss value to represent the first sub-feature vector for inheriting knowledge learned by the first model, using a second loss value to represent the second sub-feature vector to explore knowledge which is not learned by the first model, and training the second model based on the first loss value and the second loss value.

title: Machine learning-based light monitoring method and system
description: The invention provides a machine learning-based lamplight monitoring method which comprises the steps of obtaining RGB data, IR gray data and Depth data of images in a sample image set, obtaining luminous flux and color temperature of lamps in corresponding images, constructing a characteristic sequence according to the RGB data, the IR gray data and the Depth data of the images, taking the luminous flux and the color temperature of the lamps in the corresponding images as a first label and a second label, inputting the characteristic sequence, the first label and the second label into a pretrained multi-to-multi regression network model for training to obtain a trained multi-to-multi network model, fusing the RGB data, the IR gray data and the Depth data of the extracted images into the trained multi-to-multi network model to obtain a lamplight monitoring model, inputting the images to be monitored into the lamplight monitoring model to obtain the luminous flux and the color temperature of the lamps in the images, and realizing automatic lamplight monitoring of the lamps.

title: Blasting control method for differential directional fracture of local area of deep-buried tunnel
description: The invention relates to a differential directional fracture control blasting method in a local area of a deep-buried tunnel. The steps are as follows: installing various functional sensors on a rock drilling rig to collect and organize data; establish a neural network model based on the collected data, and analyze the surrounding rock The grade information is output; according to the surrounding rock grade output by the neural network model, the surrounding rock grade of the face is divided, and the same lithology area is connected to realize the regional division of the surrounding rock grade, and the division information of the face is obtained; digital image processing technology is used Cracks and analysis of the rock mass on the face face are carried out to obtain the fissure information; the face partition information and the fissure information are imported into the data analysis software at the same time, the joint fissures are added to the original surrounding rock grade zoning map, and the integral method is used to automatically calculate the area of each area , to update the blasting design area and carry out blasting work. The invention solves the problem of over and under excavation in the process of tunnel excavation, and improves the energy utilization rate.

title: Method, device, storage medium and compiling system for compiling quantum circuit
description: The invention discloses a method, a device, a storage medium and a compiling system for compiling a quantum circuit. The method for compiling the quantum circuit comprises the following steps: acquiring chip information of a quantum chip, and calculating cost information of application double gates between any two physical bits of the quantum chip according to the chip information; the chip information comprises topology structure information and cost information of measurement operation; constructing an objective function and constraint conditions by combining the chip information and the cost information of the application double gates, and solving to obtain an optimal initial mapping scheme according to the objective function and the constraint conditions; determining an optimal target scheme according to the optimal initial mapping scheme; and compiling a quantum circuit by combining the optimal initial mapping scheme and the optimal target scheme to obtain a target quantum circuit. The invention can consider the error condition of the quantum chip, optimize the compiling quantum circuit and improve the execution success rate of the quantum circuit on the quantum chip.

title: Method for generating a dental image
description: A method for generating an image of a dental arch of a beneficiary called "modified image" is disclosed, the method comprising the steps of a) at an acquisition time, acquiring a photograph depicting the dental arch called "original image", b) processing the original image such that the original image depicts the dental arch contour, c) submitting the original image to a neural network called "simulated neural network" trained to simulate the effect of a dental event on the original image, thereby obtaining the modified image, d) preferably processing the modified image so as to be ultra realistic, e) preferably, -presenting the modified image, and/or-selecting an orthodontic appliance based on the modified image.

title: Multi-mode image missing complement classification method based on tensor network model
description: The invention provides a multi-mode image deletion complement method based on a tensor network model. Firstly extracting features from a multi-mode image to obtain incomplete feature tensors, then decomposing the incomplete high-order tensors into a series of low-order kernel tensors through tensor ring decomposition, simultaneously adding low-rank constraint to the rank mode and the dimension mode expansion of the kernel tensors, performing kernel norm regularization on each mode expansion, then recovering the complete tensors by using the inverse process of tensor ring decomposition, and finally putting the complete tensors into a classifier for classification. The algorithm verification is carried out on BraTS2018 and BraTS2019 data, and the result shows that the method provided by the invention is better than the traditional method, and has better complementation and classification effects.

title: Electrochemical device with variable conductance
description: An electrochemical device includes an electrochemical cell and an electrical circuit. The electrochemical cell includes a first solid component and a second solid component. The two solid components comprise the same chemical element but different concentrations of at least one type of chemical element. A solid electrolyte is disposed between the two solid components. The solid electrolyte is a dielectric material. The circuit is connected to the electrochemical cell. The electrochemical cell may operate according to a redox process to exchange at least one type of chemical element between the first solid component and the second solid component and thereby change the conductance of each of the two solid components.

title: Image network system based on unsupervised degradation feature learning and super-resolution algorithm thereof
description: The invention discloses an image network system based on unsupervised degradation feature learning and a super-division algorithm thereof. The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning and image super-resolution, in particular to an image network system based on unsupervised degradation characteristic learning and a super-division algorithm thereof, which is used for estimating degradation without displaying compared with the super-division algorithm of other real world images, the feature expression is directly learned in the representation space of the image to distinguish the degradation of the image, and the method has good adaptability to the extraction of complex degradation feature images. Compared with a fuzzy core estimation super-division algorithm based on an antagonism network, the method is less influenced by estimation errors and has high feature extraction accuracy. The last superdivision network has smaller parameter quantity, strong coupling and large optimization potential.

title: Method and device for detecting smoking behavior based on video and electronic equipment
description: The present application relates to the field of deep learning technology, and discloses a method for detecting smoking behavior based on video.
