The method for detecting smoking behavior based on video includes: obtaining a video segment to be identified; encoding each video frame in the video segment to be identified to obtain a single-frame feature vector of each video frame; encoding all single-frame feature vectors and their corresponding position codes to obtain a frame sequence feature vector; wherein the position code corresponding to the single-frame feature vector is used to indicate the order of the video frames corresponding to each single-frame feature vector in the video segment to be identified; classifying the frame sequence feature vectors to obtain the detection result of smoking behavior. The method for detecting smoking behavior based on video can more accurately identify smoking behavior. The present application also discloses a device, an electronic device, and a storage medium for detecting smoking behavior based on video.

title: Trajectory prediction method and device
description: The invention relates to a trajectory prediction method and device. The method includes: acquiring an image including a target object, and performing semantic segmentation processing on the image to obtain first feature information of the target object; acquiring point cloud information including the target object, and based on The second feature information of the target object is extracted from the point cloud information; the three-dimensional local map is constructed based on the first feature information and the second feature information; the historical frame images of the target object are obtained, and the spatiotemporal feature sequence of the target object is extracted based on the historical frame images; The spatiotemporal feature sequence is input into the pre-trained trajectory prediction model to predict the trajectory of the target object. By combining the spatiotemporal feature sequence, the present invention enriches the perceptual information, thereby improving the prediction accuracy of the model.

title: Virtual resource pushing method, device and equipment
description: The embodiment of the specification discloses a pushing method, device and equipment of virtual resources. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an interactive image of a user; inputting a first frame image in an interactive image of a user into an interactive mode classification model to obtain an interactive mode of the user; based on the interaction mode of the user and a single-frame attention sensing result of the user, obtaining an attention change function of the user; predicting a peak time at which the user's attention reaches a peak based on the user's attention variation function; determining the pushing time of the virtual resource based on the peak time; and pushing the virtual resource at the pushing time.

title: Multi-instance learner for organizing image classification
description: The invention relates to a method for classifying tissue images. The method comprises-receiving (102) a plurality of digital tissue images, -splitting (104) each received image into a set of image blocks, -extracting (106) feature vectors from the blocks for each of the blocks, -providing (108) a multi-instance learning (MILs) program configured to use a model to classify the input image as a member of one of at least two different classes based on feature vectors extracted from all blocks of any image, -calculating (110) for each of the blocks a certainty value indicating a certainty of the model's contribution of feature vectors to the classification of the image for each of the blocks, -aggregating, by the MILs program, feature vectors of the image or predictors calculated from the feature vectors of the image as a function of the certainty values of the blocks of the image, -calculating a predictor value of each of the classes based on the aggregated predictors of the image, -classifying the image as a member of the class by the MILs program.

title: Method for image processing by neural network and method for training neural network
description: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method for processing an image, comprising the steps of dividing the image into at least two image areas, grouping at least one of the image areas into at least one group, assigning each of the image areas to only one group or not, and applying at least one kernel in a layer of a neural network to at least one group of the image areas, each group of the image areas being applied to at most one kernel. The invention also relates to a computer-implemented method for training a neural network, a device for processing images in a neural network and/or for training a neural network, and a computer-readable medium.

title: An Image Adaptive Quantum Median Filtering Method
description: The invention belongs to the field of image filtering processing, and specifically relates to an image self-adaptive quantum median filtering method, which defines a probability function of a single qubit state according to the real information of image pixel gray scale distribution, improves the filtering performance of the filtering method, and has good performance Practicality, the present invention is suitable for image salt and pepper noise filter processing.

title: Acoustic emission detection method for train wheel and axle faults based on TCN network
description: This invention discloses a method for detecting acoustic emission of train wheel axle faults based on a TCN network. The method includes: constructing a TCN network; inputting a large number of samples into the TCN network for network training, wherein the samples include acoustic emission signals, wheel axle speeds, and corresponding classification labels; the TCN network extracts features from the acoustic emission signals, considering the correlation between the acoustic emission signals and wheel axle speeds, combining the learned features with the wheel axle speeds for further feature learning, outputting classification results, and continuously training the network until a predetermined number of training iterations or the minimum value of the network's loss function is reached, thus obtaining a trained TCN network model; inputting the real-time detected acoustic emission signals and corresponding wheel axle speeds into the trained TCN network model to obtain the train wheel axle fault detection results. The advantage of this invention is that it fully utilizes data information and avoids information loss caused by manual feature selection.

title: Input sampling method of focusing control neural network for space synthesis laser detonation system
description: The invention provides a focusing control neural network input sampling method of a space synthesis laser explosion elimination system, which comprises the following specific scheme: obtaining a target distance D; generating class I input data and class II input data according to a sampling method, and performing dimension expansion respectively; respectively randomly sampling the data after the dimensionality expansion; carrying out 1 × 1 convolution calculation on the data after random sampling respectively; performing tiling processing on convolution calculation type I input data and convolution calculation type II input data to generate one-dimensional vectors of the type I input data and the type II input data; the combined one-dimensional vector is used as an input layer of the neural network, enters the trained neural network for calculation, and outputs a vector of the adjustment quantity of the focusing platform; and controlling the displacement platform of the system to complete respective focusing control. The invention is beneficial to improving the beam combination effect of the space combination laser at the target position and improving the striking performance of the space combination laser under the same condition.

title: Face recognition method, device, terminal and storage medium
description: The present application discloses a face recognition method, device, terminal and storage medium, the method comprising: receiving a first face image and a second face image; obtaining multiple facial region image pairs corresponding to the first face image and multiple facial region image pairs corresponding to the second face image based on the first face image, the second face image and a face analysis network model; determining the facial features descriptor corresponding to the first face image and the facial features descriptor corresponding to the second face image based on the multiple facial region image pairs corresponding to the first face image, the multiple facial region image pairs corresponding to the second face image, a feature extraction network model and a mapping network model; determining that the portraits in the first face image and the second face image are the same person based on the facial features descriptor corresponding to the first face image, the facial features descriptor corresponding to the second face image and a preset threshold. The present invention improves the accuracy of face recognition and the robustness of the model.

title: Real-time fan blade image segmentation method and system
description: The application provides a real-time fan blade image segmentation method and a real-time fan blade image segmentation system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of constructing a deep semantic segmentation network based on a double-path information fusion structure, wherein the deep semantic segmentation network comprises a high-resolution branch, a low-resolution branch, a feature fusion module, a spatial attention module and a segmentation module; inputting images in a fan blade image data sample set into a network, and extracting features through lightweight dense connection modules in all branches; the method comprises the steps of acquiring context information of a feature map output by a low-resolution branch through a spatial attention module, carrying out feature fusion on information output by two branches through a feature fusion module, and acquiring an initial segmentation result through a segmentation module; and performing iterative training on the segmentation network until the precision of the segmentation result reaches a preset threshold, inputting the image to be segmented into the segmentation network after training is completed, and obtaining the image segmentation result output by the network. The method ensures the segmentation accuracy and improves the real-time performance of image segmentation.

title: A dynamic forecasting method for industrial intermittent energy data combining information characteristics and production planning
description: The present invention belongs to the field of information technology. It is a method for dynamically predicting industrial intermittent energy data that combines information features with production plans. It is a method for predicting quasi-periodic data in industry by combining a deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm with effective time-frequency features in information fragments. First, the information elements are divided into data fragments with effective equal time intervals, and then a method for describing information particles based on module-base matching is used to extract time domain features and frequency domain features that can describe the periodic properties in industry from different data fragments, and describe them by constructing a two-dimensional feature vector. After that, the two-dimensional feature vector is combined with the production plan, and the DDPG method is used for modeling and prediction, and the obtained prediction information is used to realize dynamic prediction of data through feature vector anti-reconstruction. This method has high prediction accuracy, and the calculation efficiency meets the application requirements of industrial sites, providing scientific and effective decision support for subsequent energy optimization scheduling.

title: Power transmission and transformation inspection model network structure searching method, system and storage medium
description: A network structure searching method, system and storage medium for power transmission and transformation inspection model belong to the technical field of deep neural network structure design, and the searching method comprises the steps of designing a plurality of basic network modules according to the requirements of power transmission and transformation inspection tasks; and training the super network by adopting a pruning strategy, selecting an optimal basic network module from each hidden layer of the super network, and connecting all selected basic network modules in series in sequence to obtain a power transmission and transformation inspection model target network structure. According to the invention, the neural network structure search is realized based on the super network pruning strategy, and the automatic search of the neural network structure is realized through three steps of basic network module design, super network construction and super network pruning training, so that the neural network structure with excellent performance can be conveniently and efficiently automatically designed, excessive calculation power consumption is avoided, the research and development efficiency of a deep learning model is improved, the research and development cost is reduced, and the manpower consumption is reduced.

title: Neural network-based rapid target detection method for forging defects
description: The present invention discloses a method for rapid target detection of forging defects based on a neural network. By introducing a convolutional neural network (CNN) and a deep learning method, feature extraction is performed on thermal imaging data of defects such as surface cracks, scratches and inclusions that appear in the forging of metal alloys, so that the defects that appear in the forging process are changed from image form to mathematical matrix form, and the CNN diagnostic model is expanded to better analyze the local defect area in the image to support the real-time visual decision-making process. The present invention uses a CNN neural network to analyze and determine various defects that appear in the forging process to achieve rapid target detection. Compared with traditional detection methods such as flaw detection to judge defects, the method of the present invention achieves the purpose of scientifically controlling product quality in actual production, and can also achieve the goal of optimizing material composition and forging process, improving work efficiency, and reducing production losses.

title: Method for determining at least one property of a time signal, in particular a telecommunications signal, and associated devices
description: Method for determining at least one property of a time signal, in particular a telecommunications signal, and associated devices The present invention relates to a method for determining at least one property of a time signal, the method being implemented by computer, the method comprising an optimization of a neural network from a learning base, to obtain a learned neural network, the neural network successively comprising convolutional layers, a marginalization layer and a classifier, the optimization being carried out according to a performance criterion, the learning base comprising time signals exhibiting known properties, the neural network being able to classify according to at least two categories, the time signals sampled into a respective number of samples , preferably at least two numbers of samples being distinct, each category corresponding to a property to be determined . Figure for abstract: 2

title: Assessment platform and method
description: In examples, an assessment platform comprises a memory configured to store a trained machine learning model, wherein the model has been trained using (i) data indicative of user response to data content to which a plurality of users have been exposed and (ii) context data indicative of a context in which the data content was exposed to each user, and wherein the model is trained to determine a response score indicative of a predicted level of user response to data content. The platform further comprises a data receiving module to receive a plurality of requests for content, each request associated with context data; a prediction module to use the model to determine a predicted response score for requests; an assignment module to assign the request to a control group or a behaviour prediction group, wherein when the request is assigned to the behaviour prediction group, the prediction module is to determine a predicted response score for the request; a monitoring module to receive data indicative of user reactions to items of content, and to compare a level of user reaction associated with requests assigned to the control group to those associated with requests assigned to the behaviour prediction group; an assessment module configured to assess the performance of the platform to provide a platform score; and a transmission module configured to, based on the predicted response score for the request and the platform score, determine and execute a processing plan for each request.

title: System and method for generating images of rf signals and/or rf impairments
description: The disclosure relates to a system (10) for generating images of RF signals and/or RF impairments. The system (10) comprises: a receiving unit (11) configured to receive information on a number of RF signals and/or RF impairments, and image parameters; one or more RF signal generators (12) configured to generate the number of RF signals and/or RF impairments according to the received information; an image generation unit (13) configured to generate an image of a frequency spectrum and/or a spectrogram of the generated RF signals and/or RF impairments according to the received image parameters; a calculation unit (14) configured to calculate a respective bounding box for at least one of the RF signals and/or for at least one of the RF impairments in the generated image, wherein the bounding box indicates a location of the at least one RF signal and/or the at least one RF impairment in the generated image; and a memory (15) configured to store the generated image together with the bounding box(es).

title: Merging adversarially-robust neural networks
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for merging adversarially-robust neural networks.

title: Detecting liver cancer using cell-free dna fragmentation
description: Methods for liver cancer detection use a combination of genome-wide mutation and fragmentation features of cfDNA that facilitate cancer screening.

title: Cybersecurity command line assessment
description: A cloud-based, machine-learned cybersecurity command line interpretation service simplifies complex command lines using plain language. Command lines are input to the cybersecurity command line interpretation service for an interpretation by a machine learning model. If, however, a command line is known and been previously interpreted, then the cybersecurity command line interpretation service may conserve hardware and software resources by retrieving a historical command line interpretation. If the command line is unknown or not historically logged, then the cybersecurity command line interpretation service may generate a current command line interpretation using the machine learning model. The cybersecurity command line interpretation service may then generate a cybersecurity prediction associated with the command line based on the historical or current command line interpretation. The cybersecurity command line interpretation service thus provides a much faster interpretation and cybersecurity prediction for assessing command lines as malicious or benign.

title: Method and arrangement for building a piping and instrumentation diagram
description: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method for building a Piping and Instrumentation Diagram, "P&ID", (P&ID_SYS), characterized in thata) first data (P&IDn_SYS) representing data structured according to a standardized description format (XML) at least describing a part of subsystems (P&IDn_SUB) of said P&ID (P&ID_SYS) representing a process, in particular industrial process, to be established, is automatically built based on a formalized textual input (RQS), said formalized textual input (RQS) being automatically generated based on a natural language input (NLI) representing said process, in particular industrial process, to be established, wherebyc) said natural language input (NLI) being automatically transformed to a second data representing formalized textual input (RQS),c) said first data (P&IDn_SYS) is retrieved and/or combined based on said second data (RQS) in such a manner that third data (P&ID_SYS) representing said P&ID can be generated for further processing, for example at least temporally stored, displayed and/or edited,d) said building of first data, transformation to second data, retrieval, combination and/or generation of third data (P&ID_SYS) is achieved through prompting at least one large language model (LLM1...LLM3). It also relates to an arrangement for carrying out the method, a computer-program product and a provisioning device.

title: Communication device and communication method
description: A communication apparatus is an apparatus capable of executing processing of a plurality of functionalities related to communication with another communication apparatus. The communication apparatus includes a management unit configured to perform management of an AI/ML model used in the processing, based on the functionalities.

title: Methods and apparatuses for training a graph neural network
description: Embodiments described herein relate to training a graph neural network, GNN, model. In particular the GNN model is trained to predict performance metrics for a network. A method for training the GNN model comprises: obtaining a graph representation of a network, wherein the graph representation comprises: a set of nodes, V, wherein each node represents a radio coverage area; and a set of edges, E, wherein each edge connects two nodes in the set of nodes and represents a relationship between the two nodes; obtaining sets of geometric features, G, associated with overlaps between respective radio coverage areas associated with at least some edges in the set of edges; conducting a first phase of training using one or more first output layers for the GNN model, wherein the first phase of training comprises training the GNN model to predict the sets of geometric features; after the first phase of training, selecting at least one first parameter of the GNN model to fix; and conducting a second phase of training using one or more second output layers in the GNN model to predict performance metrics associated with the set of nodes, wherein the second phase of training comprises training the GNN model with the at least one first parameter fixed.

title: Automatic localized evaluation of contours with visual feedback
description: A localized evaluation network incorporates a discriminator (111a) acting as classifier, which may be included within a generative adversarial network, GAN (111). GAN (111) may include a generative network such as U-NET for creating segmentations. The localized evaluation network is trained on image pairs (220) including medical images of organs of interest and segmentation (mask) images. The network is trained to distinguish whether an image pair (220) does or does not represent the ground truth. GAN (111) examines interior layers of the discriminator (111a) and evaluates how much each localized image region contributes to the final classification. The discriminator (111a) may analyze regions of the image pair (220) that contribute to a classification by analyzing layer weights of the machine learning model.

title: Model transmission method and apparatus
description: Provided in the embodiments of the present application are a model transmission method and apparatus. The method comprises: a terminal device receiving model transmission control information from a network device, and then, receiving a model from the network device according to the model transmission control information. By means of acquiring model transmission control information, resource configurations for model transmission are acquired, and a model is acquired on the basis of the resource configurations for model transmission, such that the effectiveness and reliability of model transmission are both taken into consideration.

title: Device and method for controlling a robot device
description: A method for training a robot device controller is described comprising training a neural network comprising an encoder network, a decoder network and a policy network, such that, for each of a plurality of digital training input images, the encoder network encodes the digital training input image to a feature in a latent space, the decoder network determines, from the feature, for each of a plurality of areas shown in the digital training input image, whether the area is traversable and information about the distance between the viewpoint of the digital training input image and the area and the policy model determines, from the feature, control information for controlling movement of a robot device wherein at least the policy model is trained in a supervised manner using control information ground truth data of the digital training input images.

title: Systems and methods for recognising hand-drawn shapes
description: Described herein is a computer implemented method. The method includes receiving, via an input device, first user input drawing an input shape and generating, based on the first user input, original drawing data that includes an ordered set of points that define the input shape. The original drawing is processed to generate an input vector which also includes an ordered set of points. The input shape is then classified as a first template shape by processing the input vector using a machine learning model. A new shape is then generated based on the first template shape and the original drawing data.

title: Data conversion method and apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium
description: A data conversion method and apparatus (200/300), an electronic device (400) and a storage medium (600) for converting dimensions of a first data combination, the first data combination includes at least one batch, dimensions of data to which each of the at least one batch corresponds includes a first dimension, a second dimension, and a third dimension. The data conversion method includes: reading n elements in the first data combination according to a first-dimension direction to obtain a first processing group, a first element to an n-th element in the first processing group are arranged according to the first-dimension direction, and n is a positive integer; performing a transpose on the first dimension and the third dimension of the first processing group to obtain a second processing group, a first element to an n-th element in the second processing group are arranged in a third-dimension direction; and writing the first element to the n-th element in the second processing group to a first storage.

title: Thermal anomaly management
description: A method of managing thermal anomalies in an environment is described. A deep learning system is trained to identify thermal anomalies from recorded environment parameter data. A Bayesian network is also trained to identify relationships between environment parameters, and the identified relationships are used to develop a causal explanation hierarchy. Using these trained systems, environment parameters are measured first to identify a thermal anomaly, and on identification of a thermal anomaly, and then to provide a causal explanation hierarchy for the thermal anomaly. This enables a real-world intervention to address the thermal anomaly. A suitable system to perform this method is also described.

title: Trace representation learning
description: The present invention avoids overfitting in deep neural network (DNN) training by using multitask learning (MTL) and self-supervised learning (SSL) techniques when training a multi-branch DNN to encode a sequence. In an embodiment, a computer first trains the DNN to perform a first task. The DNN contains: a first encoder in a first branch, a second encoder in a second branch, and an interpreter layer that combines data from the first branch and the second branch. The DNN second trains to perform a second task. After the first and second trainings, production encoding and inferencing occur. The first encoder encodes a sparse feature vector into a dense feature vector from which an inference is inferred. In an embodiment, a sequence of log messages is encoded into an encoded trace. An anomaly detector infers whether the sequence is anomalous. In an embodiment, the log messages are database commands.

title: Method for determining a robust prediction and a certification interval associated with a regression task
description: Method for training an automatic prediction model of a physical quantity, comprising the steps of:- Receiving (401) an initial automatic prediction model of said quantity,- Receiving (402) a set of training data,- Generating (403) a set of noisy training data by adding to each data item of the training data set a randomly drawn noise value,- For each data item of the noisy training data set, executing (404) the initial automatic prediction model to determine a main prediction of the physical quantity,- Modifying the initial model by replacing the main prediction of the physical quantity with a robustified prediction,- Training (405) the modified model from the set of noisy training data so that the robustified prediction is equal to a median value of the distribution of the main prediction values provided by the initial model from the set of noisy training data.

title: Mixture-of-experts model based collective communication method, system and device
description: The present disclosure provides a Mixture-of-Experts model based collective communication method, system and device, and relates to the field of communication technology, and specifically to the fields of technologies such as chip processors, computing power clusters, collective communication operations and large models. The collective communication method is applied to a communication receiving end, and includes: receiving a data write-in instruction, where the data write-in instruction includes to-be-processed data and first address information; accessing a virtual expert address in a pre-created virtual address space according to the first address information; applying for a corresponding actual physical space for the virtual expert address based on a size of the to-be-processed data; and writing the to-be-processed data into the actual physical space. According to the collective communication method provided in the present disclosure, the collective communication can be realized without synchronizing memory information.

title: Quality defect diagnostic device and quality defect diagnostic method
description: A quality defect diagnosis device diagnoses a quality defect occurring in a product, the quality defect diagnosis device including: a data dividing unit that two-dimensionally divides product data as a diagnosis subject into predetermined blocks, the product data including operational data and quality data; a data aggregation unit that extracts the operational data for each of predetermined classifications of quality defects on a basis of a trend of quality defects in the divided blocks and aggregates the extracted operational data for each of the blocks and for each region including two or more of the blocks; a quality defect determination unit that evaluates presence or absence of occurrence of a quality defect by using a plurality of prediction models which is generated for each of the classifications of quality defects and in which a relationship between the aggregated operational data and the quality data is learned; and a factor estimation unit that estimates a factor of the quality defect on a basis of a quality defect quality defect determination step result.

title: Method of model switching signaling for radio access network
description: The present disclosure describes methods of using a list of AI/ML candidate models for model switching in wireless mobile communication system including base station e.g., gNB and mobile station e.g., UE. Alternative model(s) is applied to model switching operation autonomously based on the pre-configured mapping relationship information between model IDs and other associated parameter values. Therefore, model switching supports multiple alternative models to be switched to replace any outdated model depending on different model execution environment with varying models.

title: Coordination and increased utilization of graphics processors during inference
description: An apparatus of embodiments, as described herein, includes a processing system including a graphics processor, the graphics processor including a plurality of processing resources for inference employment in neural networks, the plurality of processing resources configured to be partitioned into a plurality of physical resource slices; and a scheduler to receive specification of a limitation on usage of the plurality of processing resources by a plurality of application processes and schedule shared resources in the processing system for a plurality of application processes associated with a plurality of clients of the processing system according to the limitation on usage. The processing system has a capability to limit usage of the plurality of processing resources of the graphics processor by the plurality of application processes based on the specification of the limitation on usage. The limitation on usage of the plurality of processing resources of the graphics processor includes to limit execution of threads of each application process of the plurality of application processes to a specified portion of available threads provided by the plurality of processing resources of the graphics processor, the specified portion being less than all available threads provided by the plurality of processing resources of the graphics processor.

title: Magnetic resonance image reconstruction device and magnetic resonance image reconstruction method
description: A magnetic resonance image reconstruction device (1) according to an embodiment is a magnetic resonance image reconstruction device (1) that reconstructs magnetic resonance image data in which an artifact due to undersampling is removed or reduced based on undersampled k-space data, and includes a reconstruction unit (60) reconstructing the magnetic resonance image data using a reconstruction network (RN) having a correction module. The correction module includes a regularization block (IRN) generating second image data by performing a regularization process on first image data using a first neural network, and a data consistency block (DCB) generating third image data by performing a data consistency process so that k-space data corresponding to the second image data approaches the undersampled k-space data. The correction module further includes at least one of a data consistency adjustment block (DCMB) adjusting the data consistency process and a regularization adjustment block (IRMB) adjusting the regularization process.

title: System for controlling operation of an airline
description: An airline operations control system (30) for an airline having multiple aircraft and multiple routes formed by one or more flights where the airline operations control system (30) includes a computer searchable database (32) a query module (34) configured to query the database (32) to determine stable operating solutions for the airline in response to actual or predicted failure of at least one aircraft and preferably either a prognostic module (150) for running hypothetical scenarios or a learning module (260) for learning the learning the selection preferences of the airline operations personnel.

title: Chunking and overlap decoding strategy for streaming RNN transducers for speech recognition
description: A computer-implemented method is provided for improving accuracy recognition of digital speech. The method includes receiving the digital speech. The method further includes splitting the digital speech into overlapping chunks. The method also includes computing a bidirectional encoder embedding of each of the overlapping chunks to obtain bidirectional encoder embeddings. The method additionally includes combining the bidirectional encoder embeddings. The method further includes interpreting, by a speech recognition system, the digital speech using the combined bidirectional encoder embeddings.

title: Multimodal machine learning for generating three-dimensional audio
description: Methods and systems use one or more machine learning models to automatically generate three-dimensional sound. A multimodal content item is accessed by a computing device. Three-dimensional sound is automatically generated by the computing device using the one or more machine learning models based on the multimodal content item.

title: System for recognizing conversation
description: PURPOSE:To improve performance in a conversation recognition system using only voice or visual oral position information under an environment where a particularly disadvantage noise is rich. CONSTITUTION:This system is a conversation recognition system for recognizing speaking belonging to a prescribed set consisting of an allowable speaking candidate, and is constituted of a voice feature extracting device 24 for converting a signal showing voice conversation to a set of the signal having a corresponding voice feature vector, a motional visual feature extracting device 14 for converting an attending signal showing a motional face feature accompanying voice conversation generation to the set of the signal having a corresponding visual feature vector and a neural network classification device 200 for generating a conditional probability distribution in the speaking candidate of allowable conversation by receiving and operating the set in the motional voice feature and the visual feature vectors provided respectively by the voice and the motional visual feature extracting devices 24, 14.

title: Machine learning methods and systems for determining file risk using content disarm and reconstruction analysis
description: File risk and malware detection and classification can be enhanced using machine learning analysis of content disarm and reconstruction (CDR) output. Correlations can be discovered or analyzed between individual elements of such outputs, which can include an XML report. Such correlations can provide useful information on threat intelligence and help validate content disarm and reconstruction A method can include training machine learning algorithms with a dataset derived from CDR results from test files labelled as malicious or not malicious; instructing algorithms to predict probabilities; and determining correlation between the report items and malware (for example, using the function feature importances and the SHAP value method).

title: Deep learning-based variant classifier
description: The technology disclosed directly operates on sequencing data and derives its own feature filters. It processes a plurality of aligned reads that span a target base position. It combines elegant encoding of the reads with a lightweight analysis to produce good recall and precision using lightweight hardware. For instance, one million training examples of target base variant sites with 50 to 100 reads each can be trained on a single GPU card in less than 10 hours with good recall and precision. A single GPU card is desirable because it a computer with a single GPU is inexpensive, almost universally within reach for users looking at genetic data. It is readily available on could-based platforms.

title: Root cause determination in computer networks
description: A method is provided to determine the root cause of a failure in a computer network. An error propagation model is mapped to a neural network model or to a computational operator network comprising summation operators and sigmoid operators, based on the interdependencies of the system components of the computer network. The error messages indicating the failure are analyzed based on the error propagation model using the neural network. The analysis considers the probability that an error message will be issued in the event of a failure of a monitored network component and the probability that an error will actually propagate to a dependent network component from other network components of the network. that the dependent network component depends on. The probability is determined by at least one of (i) experiments and (ii) expert knowledge. Through analysis, potential root cause failure candidates are determined. The determined candidates for the root cause are presented. (Automatic translation with Google Translate, without legal value)

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for processing vocabulary in Buddhist field
description: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides a method, device, equipment and storage medium for processing vocabulary in the field of Buddhism, which are used for the accuracy of vocabulary mining processing for vocabulary in the field of Buddhism. The processing method of vocabulary in the field of Buddhism includes: performing word segmentation and removing stop words on the text corpus in the field of Buddhism to obtain a candidate vocabulary set; using an unsupervised learning model, sequentially performing word vector transformation and matrix conversion on the candidate vocabulary set to obtain a vocabulary matrix; Through the preset clustering model, the vocabulary matrix is sequentially clustered and the domain words are extracted to obtain the target domain vocabulary set; each target domain vocabulary in the target domain vocabulary set and the paraphrase information corresponding to each target domain vocabulary are spliced to obtain the initial Domain vocabulary information; the target domain vocabulary information is obtained by classifying the initial domain vocabulary information through the target integrated vocabulary filtering model. In addition, the present invention also relates to the blockchain technology, and the text corpus in the field of Buddhism can be stored in the blockchain.

title: A method of lip shape transformation based on adversarial generative network
description: The invention relates to a lip shape correcting method based on an antagonistic generation network, which is characterized in that a generator network model based on the generation antagonistic network is constructed firstly, wherein the generator network model comprises a generator and a discriminator; then data preprocessing is carried out, the data are subjected to graying processing and are cut according to the frame rate of a video during data processing, and finally, the data are normalized, and the data type and the data shape and size are unified; thirdly, training the cross entropy error by using random gradient descent to optimize ADAM parameters of a generator and a discriminator; and finally, inputting the data to be detected into the trained generator network model so as to output the lip shape corrected result. According to the method, a network is generated to generate a target image through a deep convolution countermeasure from a small number of existing features, so that a front view is effectively acquired to be used as visual voice research and application.

title: A deep inspection method for automatic identification of ship corroded areas
description: The invention relates to a depth inspection method for automatically identifying a ship corrosion area, which comprises the steps of establishing a pre-training image identification model and a corrosion image automatic identification model, labeling a large number of ship images, and training the corrosion image automatic identification model by using part of labeled images; inputting a plurality of naval vessel images to be detected into the trained model, reserving the images with the rust labels, labeling a boundary frame of a rust area, and forming a rust area positioning data set by the labeled images; establishing a corrosion area target detection model, and training the model by adopting an image with a part of corrosion area positioning data concentrated; and finally, inputting the image of the rust naval vessel to be positioned into the trained rust area target detection model, outputting the parameters of the boundary frame of the rust area, and marking the position of the rust area by the boundary frame. The method realizes an integrated process of acquiring the rust area automatic positioning from the naval vessel image, integrates a deep learning image recognition algorithm and a target detection algorithm, and is extremely intelligent.

title: An unsupervised cross-database micro-expression recognition method
description: The invention relates to an unsupervised cross-database micro-expression recognition method, comprising: firstly, aligning and reorganizing the macro and micro-expression data of the source domain, and selecting a joint data matrix after the recombination through the source domain selection model to select one that matches the target domain. The more closely related optimal subset is used as the auxiliary set. Then, the conditional and marginal distributions of the source and target domains are dynamically matched through an adaptive distribution alignment model. Finally, the L  2,1  norm is used to re-weight the auxiliary set samples to reduce the influence of outliers and realize micro-expression recognition. The invention adopts the transfer learning method, with the aid of macro-expression samples that have great similarity with micro-expressions, through the macro-expression database with tags and one kind of micro-expression database, another kind of micro-expression database without any tags is used. The supervised cross-database micro-expression recognition reduces the time-consuming and laborious manual labeling work of the target-domain micro-expression database, and improves the micro-expression recognition effect.

title: Method, apparatus, and computer-readable storage medium for generating a model for a user
description: Disclosed is a method for generating a model for a user, comprising: obtaining, at a server, a plurality of first data sets for a plurality of users; generating, at the server, a sharing model for the plurality of users using a meta-learning algorithm based on the plurality of first data sets; transmitting, by the server, the sharing model to a client of a user; obtaining a corresponding second data set of the user at the client of the user; and adaptively training a shared model at the user's client to generate a private model for the user based on the user's corresponding second dataset. The present application also relates to other methods, apparatus, and computer-readable storage devices. The method can more accurately establish the private model of the user under the condition of protecting privacy.

title: Passenger Flow Estimation Method of Rail Transit Carriage
description: The invention relates to a method for estimating passenger flow in rail transit carriages, comprising the following steps: using a variety of detection algorithms to train human body features contained in a variety of data sources to obtain a detection model; a camera in the carriage captures an image in the carriage, and using the trained image Each detection model detects the images captured by each camera and integrates the detection results; divides multiple seat positions and blank positions in the carriage into seating areas and blank areas; Count the number of people standing in the blank area and the number of people standing in the seating area and the number of seats in the visual overlapping part; derive the number of people in the blank area and seating area in the visual remote part according to the number of people in the blank area and seating area in the visual overlapping part; Estimate the number of passengers in the whole car . The present invention makes full use of the existing equipment and realizes real-time acquisition of passenger flow characteristic information in the carriage.

title: Traceable Self-feedback Learning Urban Plant Factory
description: The invention relates to a traceable self-feedback learning urban plant factory, which includes an application layer, a contract layer and a service layer; the application layer includes several independent soilless culture systems and a traceability platform; Execute the contract; the service layer includes an artificial intelligence platform, a big data platform and a blockchain platform. The artificial intelligence platform includes a model training unit and a model storage unit. The model storage unit is used to store plant growth models and production parameter tuning models. The advantage is that it can conduct real-time statistics and analysis of plants from the initial seedling stage to flowering and results, and now automatically conduct plant growth research in a self-feedback manner. At the same time, with the help of blockchain technology, the quality supervision and service level of agricultural products can be improved by means of information technology, so as to achieve the goal of “recording the production process, tracking the flow of products, querying storage and transportation information, and traceability of quality problems” in the quality management of agricultural products.

title: A detection method of mine conveyor belt deviation based on semantic segmentation network
description: A mining conveying belt deviation detection method based on a semantic segmentation network belongs to the technical field of coal mine monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: recording a running video of the mining conveyor belt in real time, and capturing a video frame by frame to obtain a sample image of the mining conveyor belt; preprocessing the image to obtain a mining conveying belt deviation detection data set; constructing a semantic segmentation network for deviation detection of a mining conveyor belt; training a sample image training set and a verification set to generate a training model; inputting an original mining conveyor belt image to be segmented based on a trained semantic segmentation network model, and segmenting a planned safe region and a real region sub-image of the conveyor belt; evaluating the position relation, judging a safe region of the conveying belt, and judging that the deviation fault occurs to the mining conveying belt when the area of the conveying belt exceeds the safe region and the fusion area is larger than the area of the safe region; and after the deviation fault is detected, the system automatically sends out an alarm signal on site. The advantages are that: the real area of the conveying belt in the running process is judged quickly and accurately, and the real-time performance and the accuracy are improved.

title: A method, device, equipment and storage medium for biological weight assessment
description: The present application discloses a method for estimating the weight of an organism. The method includes the following steps: collecting an image of a target organism through an image acquisition device to obtain image data of the target organism; inputting the image data of the target organism into a pre-trained image In the weight estimation model, the image data of the target organism is processed through the weight estimation model to obtain a processing result; according to the processing result, the weight of the target organism is determined. By applying the technical solution provided in the present application and processing the image data of the target organism by using the weight estimation model obtained by pre-training, the weight estimation error of the organism by human judgment can be reduced, and a relatively accurate weight of the organism can be obtained. The present application also discloses a biological body weight evaluation device, equipment and storage medium, which have corresponding technical effects.

title: Page layout method and device
description: The invention discloses a page layout method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: loading a preset model library to the machine learning platform, and determining a function in the machine learning platform according to the preset model library; acquiring and transmitting an external environment information stream to a designated label of a page, and processing the external environment information stream in the designated label in a machine learning platform by using a functional function to obtain reference data and write the reference data into a cascading style sheet; a plurality of display attributes in a page layout are responsively determined or adjusted based on a cascading style sheet. The method and the device can determine the user preference based on the user and the environment, provide the response type webpage layout in a personalized mode, and improve the browsing experience.

title: Search autonomous vehicle sensor data repositories
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for searching an autonomous vehicle sensor data repository. One of the methods comprises: maintaining a set of sensor samples and for each sensor sample, an embedding of the sensor sample; receiving a request specifying a query sensor sample, wherein the query sensor sample characterizes a query environmental region; and identifying a plurality of relevant sensor samples from the set of sensor samples that characterize an environmental region similar to the query environmental region, including: processing the query sensor sample through an embedded neural network to generate a query embedding; and identifying a plurality of sensor samples having an embedding closest to the query embedding from among the sensor samples in the subset of sensor samples in the set.

title: Prediction method of line loss in Taiwan area based on clustering and convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses a method for predicting line loss of a distribution room based on clustering and convolutional neural networks, which comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a power grid model by adopting PSASP software, and collecting line loss data of a transformer area; secondly, judging and eliminating line loss abnormal constant data by adopting a combined model of a K-means clustering algorithm-LOF local outlier factor detection method; and finally, optimizing the convolutional neural network by adopting a particle swarm algorithm to obtain a PSO-CNN neural network, and performing predictive analysis on the line loss of the transformer area by using the PSO-CNN neural network. The method introduces the convolutional neural network into the prediction application of the line loss of the transformer area, and combines the clustering algorithm, so that the line loss prediction is obviously improved in the aspects of speed and accuracy, and the method has higher practical application value.

title: An information management system for surveying and mapping engineering
description: The invention relates to the field of surveying and mapping data management, in particular to an information management system for surveying and mapping engineering, which comprises: the mapping project registration module is used for realizing registration of a mapping project; the mapping data acquisition module is used for realizing the acquisition of mapping data of the mapping engineering project; the mapping data sorting module is used for sorting, classifying, calculating and filing the mapping data; and the mapping data visualization module is used for realizing the visualization of the mapping data in a three-dimensional model mode, and each mapping engineering project corresponds to one three-dimensional model. The invention can realize automatic acquisition, autonomous analysis, sorting and filing of the mapping data, realize visualization of the mapping data and greatly facilitate tracing and checking of the subsequent mapping data.

title: Using Adversarial Networks to Dynamically Attenuate Visual Artifacts in Image Processing Systems
description: The present application relates to using a countering network to dynamically attenuate visual artifacts of an image processing system. An apparatus, method, and computer-readable medium for reducing visual artifacts in processed images. An annotated data set of an image to be processed by an image processing system is created. The countermeasure control network is trained to operate as an image quality expert when classifying images. After the countermeasure control network has been trained, the image processing system is dynamically supervised using the countermeasure control network.

title: A vertical federation-based isolated forest training and prediction method and system
description: The invention discloses an isolated forest training and prediction method and system based on vertical federation, which obtains first intersection data, obtains second intersection data, and anonymizes the first intersection data and the second intersection data respectively. , obtain the first anonymized intersection data and the second anonymized intersection data; set the maximum splitting depth d of the isolated tree and the number n of the isolated trees, and obtain the first parameter setting result; according to the first parameter setting result, the isolated tree The forest generation method, the first anonymized intersection data and the second anonymized intersection data, the first isolated forest is generated on the first client, and the second isolated forest is generated on the second client; based on the first isolated forest and the second isolated forest For the first client and the second client, perform data prediction according to the isolated forest prediction method. It solves the technical problem in the prior art that in the process of abnormality detection, it is difficult for multi-party data to cooperate, resulting in limited means of abnormality detection.

title: Data processing method and device
description: The embodiment of the specification provides a data processing method and a data processing device, wherein a first data processing method comprises the steps of obtaining a target object and a resource value aiming at the target object; inputting the target object into a first machine learning model to obtain a first prediction result, and inputting the target object into a second machine learning model to obtain a second prediction result; acquiring a resource amount corresponding to the resource value based on the first prediction result and the second prediction result; the data processing method realizes intelligent and automatic determination of the resource quantity corresponding to the resource value of the target object through machine learning, and greatly improves the prediction efficiency and accuracy of the resource quantity corresponding to the resource value of the target object.

title: A method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for information verification
description: The embodiments of the present application disclose a method, an apparatus, a computer device, and a storage medium for information verification. In this solution, an information verification request is sent to the server by triggering the operation of the graphical user interface, so that the server returns the virtual object expression image and verification prompt information to the terminal according to the information verification request. When the terminal receives the virtual object expression image and verification prompt information , generate a verification page and display the verification page on the graphical user interface, obtain the operation result according to the user's operation on the verification page, and further determine the verification result based on the operation result, so as to complete the function corresponding to the request of the graphical user interface according to the verification result. The security of information verification can be improved.

title: Tool wear state identification system and method based on wavelet scale map and depth migration learning
description: The invention discloses a tool wear state identification system and method based on wavelet scale maps and deep migration learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting physical quantity related to tool wear; carrying out wavelet packet decomposition transformation on the collected physical quantity; selecting the complex Morlet wavelet basis function scale image features as two-dimensional wavelet scale image features; building a CNN network model; and inputting the enhanced two-dimensional wavelet scale image characteristics serving as samples into a trained CNN network model, and identifying the wear state of the cutter. The complex Morlet wavelet scale graph with high resolution is selected as the time-frequency image feature, so that the neural network model can capture local information of the time-frequency feature more obviously, the identification accuracy of the tool wear state is improved, and the generalization capability is achieved. The tool wear state real-time identification model is established, the tool wear state is accurately controlled, the production cost is greatly reduced, and the tool utilization rate is effectively improved.

title: Precise quantification method and device for cell-based indices in corneal confocal images
description: The invention provides a method for accurately quantifying cell basic indexes in a corneal confocal image, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a corneal confocal image to be identified, inputting the corneal confocal image to a cell boundary segmentation model, and outputting a cell boundary probability map according to the cell boundary segmentation model; the cell boundary segmentation model is obtained by machine learning training by taking a corneal confocal image sample as input and taking a labeling result of whether each pixel point in the corneal confocal image sample is a cell boundary as an output label; performing preset post-processing on the cell boundary probability map to obtain a cell boundary segmentation map; and acquiring a cell area of the corneal confocal image based on the cell boundary segmentation map, and calculating a basic index of the corneal cell according to the cell area of the corneal confocal image. The method and the device for accurately quantifying the basic indexes of the cells in the confocal cornea image can realize automatic and efficient segmentation of the cell boundaries in the confocal cornea image and accurate quantification of the basic indexes of the cornea cells.

title: A method and system for automatic grouping and packaging of chips based on machine learning
description: The invention discloses a chip automatic grouping packaging method and a system based on machine learning, relating to the field of chip packaging, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining performance parameters of chips on a wafer, and establishing a multidimensional hyperplane based on the item number of the performance parameters; mapping the chips on the wafer to the established hyperplane based on the performance parameters of the chips on the wafer; grouping the chips mapped into the hyperplane based on a machine learning clustering analysis algorithm; and selecting the chips in the same group to package the chips on the same module or the lining board according to the grouping result. The performance parameters of the chip include threshold voltage, saturation voltage drop and cutoff current. The dimension of the multi-dimensional hyperplane is the same as the number of performance parameter items of the chip. The invention can ensure the consistent performance parameters of each chip on the same module or lining plate, and effectively ensure the stability of the module or lining plate.

title: An Entropy Rate Test Method Based on Deep Learning
description: The invention relates to an entropy rate testing method based on deep learning, belonging to the technical field of information security and random number generators; the problem that the complexity of an algorithm of a high-dimensional system is high in entropy rate test in the test of a random number generator can be solved; the technical scheme for solving the technical problems is as follows: the method comprises four steps of entropy source data collection processing, deep learning model training, data testing and entropy rate calculation, wherein the strong learning capacity of a deep learning model is utilized, random data obtained by entropy source collection is processed and then partially used for training the model, the trained model tests the rest data to obtain a prediction result, the minimum entropy is calculated according to parameters such as the prediction result, and the minimum entropy is multiplied by the random data rate generated by the entropy source to obtain an entropy rate test result; the invention is applied to entropy rate testing.

title: Privacy protection image classification method based on federal learning
description: The invention discloses a privacy protection image classification method based on federated learning. Neural network; 4 shuffler random subsampling client; 5 subsampling client predicts public data, perturbs and encrypts it and sends it to the shuffler; 6 shuffler forges and randomly arranges predictions and sends anonymous predictions to the server; 7 server Aggregate anonymous predictions and train the global neural network; 8. The server sends the trained global neural network to each client; 9. The client uses the trained global neural network for image classification. The present invention utilizes differential privacy and federated learning to realize privacy-protected collaborative image classification.

title: A method for dividing plant leaves
description: The invention discloses a plant leaf segmentation method, which relates to the field of image processing. The method includes: constructing a sample data set, and inputting the sample images in the sample data set into a convolutional neural network, where the convolutional neural network includes a Backbone network, an RPN network and several cascaded leaf segmentation modules, each leaf segmentation module includes ROIAlign network and Head network, each Head network includes classification branch, segmentation branch and detection branch, use the sample data set based on convolutional neural network training to obtain a plant leaf segmentation model, input the image to be segmented into the plant leaf segmentation model, and obtain the image to be segmented. The result of leaf segmentation, in which the image to be segmented can adopt a multi-scale segmentation strategy. The method proposed in the present invention can effectively segment occluded leaves, leaves with unclear edges and small-scale leaves, and promote the application of deep learning in the field of plant leaf segmentation.

title: Entity identification method, device, device and storage medium
description: The present application discloses an entity identification method, device, device and storage medium, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method includes: performing a first feature mapping on an input text to obtain an initial feature vector of the input text; obtaining a first-type feature vector and a second-type feature vector based on a knowledge map; wherein the first-class feature vector is a word in the knowledge map The feature representation of level knowledge, the same word belonging to different types in the knowledge graph corresponds to different feature representations; the second type of feature vector is the feature representation of character-level knowledge in the knowledge graph, the same character belonging to different types in the knowledge graph corresponds to different features Representation; entity recognition is performed on the input text based on the initial feature vector, the first-class feature vector, and the second-class feature vector of the input text. The present application can avoid word segmentation errors and entity type confusion, improve the accuracy of entity recognition, and achieve good entity recognition effects.

title: A fault detection method for power equipment based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses a power equipment fault detection method based on a convolutional neural network, which comprises the steps of constructing a fault type database to carry out fault identification training on the convolutional neural network; enhancing the brightness, color, contrast and sharpness of a picture to be detected, filtering the detected picture by using a selective search algorithm with a filter, and screening out a candidate region which is most likely to have a fault; and importing the candidate area into the trained convolutional neural network, and obtaining the fault type of the area to be tested and the relative position and size of each fault according to the training rules, wherein the fault type comprises dial plate fuzziness, shell damage, ground oil stain, respirator damage and abnormal box door closing. The method is applied to the detection of the power grid equipment, and then the problems of various types of faults, high detection difficulty and the like of the conventional power distribution network equipment are effectively solved; and the aim of monitoring the running state of the power distribution network equipment in real time is fulfilled, and the working efficiency is improved.

title: A method and system for lung sound feature recognition and classification based on VMD-CNN
description: The invention discloses a VMD-CNN-based lung sound feature recognition and classification method and system, belonging to the technical field of biomedical signal analysis, wherein a lung sound signal is collected, VMD deconstruction and reconstruction are carried out on the lung sound signal, and Hilbert transform is carried out on the reconstructed lung sound signal to obtain a corresponding time-frequency spectrogram; and respectively extracting and fusing the characteristics of the reconstructed lung sound signals and the corresponding Hilbert time-frequency spectrogram through the constructed convolutional neural network model, and finally realizing the identification and classification of the characteristic information of the lung sound signals. The invention provides important basis for doctors by fully considering the characteristics of the lung sound signals, and improves the lung sound identification efficiency and the lung sound identification accuracy.

title: Medical image processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present application discloses a medical image processing method, device, equipment and storage medium, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The present application obtains the overall characteristics of the abnormal object by acquiring the position and image features of the abnormal object in the medical image, obtains a sub-image containing the abnormal object based on the position of the abnormal object, and obtains the visualization feature of the abnormal object based on the sub-image. It has a clear physical meaning, so as to obtain the physical characteristics of the abnormal object, and further classify the abnormal object based on the image feature and the splicing feature of the visual feature, so that in the classification process, the overall characteristics and physical characteristics of the abnormal object are comprehensively considered. At the same time, because the visual features have clear physical meaning and strong interpretability, they can further improve the accuracy of identifying abnormal objects, thereby effectively assisting doctors in diagnosing diseases. .

title: Method for identifying video human body posture in light weight mode
description: A method for recognizing human body gestures of a video in a light weight mode includes the steps of firstly conducting preprocessing such as image enhancement and guided filtering denoising on RGB video frame images after framing processing, meanwhile utilizing a video frame sequence to calculate an optical flow sequence and extract an optical flow characteristic graph. And then, the features of the RGB video frame are extracted by constructing a lightweight LHN model, and the lightweight and effective human body posture estimation in the space field is completed. And then, an LRDN model is designed to realize light weight optical flow feature extraction, and human body posture information of the video in the time sequence field is acquired. And finally, building a parallel heterogeneous convolutional neural network by using the trained LHN model and LRDN network model to finish accurate estimation of the video human body posture. And finally, selecting the posture category corresponding to the maximum probability value as the human body posture category to which the currently input video frame sequence of the model belongs.

title: Recommended information processing method, recommended information generation method and device
description: The present disclosure provides a method for processing recommendation information, a method and device for generating recommendation information. The method for processing recommendation information includes: acquiring a recommendation information set containing multiple recommendation information; extracting feature elements of multiple categories of each recommendation information in the recommendation information set to obtain a feature element set; for each category of feature elements: The recommendation information in the recommendation information set is divided into at least two groups, wherein the attributes of the feature elements of the category of the recommendation information in each of the at least two groups are different from the attributes of the recommendation information in other groups of the at least two groups. The attributes of the feature elements of this category are mutually exclusive; at least one type of result data corresponding to the recommendation information in each group is obtained; for each type of result data, the degree of difference between the result data of any two groups is calculated, and in the degree of difference When the value is greater than the first predetermined threshold, it is determined that the feature element of this category is significant to the result data.

title: A fuzzy image generation method for license plate images
description: The invention provides a method for generating a fuzzy image of a license plate image. The clear-blurred image pair transferred to the real scene is further trained on the sample set, and the final trained fuzzy image generator model is obtained. It has the following advantages: (1) The fuzzy image generator model can generate enough fuzzy images simulating real scenes to form clear-fuzzy paired images, which solves the problem of difficulty in collecting clear-fuzzy paired images in real scenes in large quantities . (2) The fuzzy image generator model learns the various features of motion blur, Gaussian blur, image pyramid blur, and real scene graphics blur, and solves the problem that the blurred image mode is single and cannot simulate complex blurred images in the real environment.

title: Intelligent robot vision SLAM closed-loop detection method, device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a visual SLAM closed-loop detection method, device and storage medium for an intelligent robot. The method includes: extracting a CNN feature vector according to an image obtained by a robot; calculating the similarity between the CNN feature vectors to obtain a similarity matrix; The similarity matrix is decomposed into eigenvalues to obtain a main diagonal matrix and an eigenvector matrix; the main diagonal matrix is reconstructed to obtain a reconstructed matrix; according to the eigenvector matrix and the reconstructed The matrix is calculated, and the target matrix is calculated; the K-nearest neighbor median filter is performed on the target matrix to construct a closed-loop detection. The invention enhances the robustness and reliability of closed-loop detection, and can be widely used in the technical field of intelligent robots.

title: A method and system for generating job knowledge graph
description: The invention relates to a method and system for generating a job knowledge graph, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing corpora with different data states based on job description data set, personal resume data set and encyclopedia knowledge data set; The predicate corpus recalls entities to obtain map entities, wherein the entities are nouns or noun phrases; the relationship between entities is extracted from the encyclopedia knowledge data set through a relationship extraction model, wherein the relationship between the entities is inclusive or similar ; and establishing a mapping relationship between entities according to the relationship between entities. Using the graph of the present invention, taking the resumes of job-seeking users and the job descriptions of recruiting users as basic information, the keywords of the basic information are extracted through semantics, and the keywords are matched with entities in the graph provided by the present invention, so that users can be deeply understood. demand, and obtain the implicit information in the demand information.

title: AI technology channel state information feedback method and equipment
description: The application discloses a channel state information feedback method of AI technology, comprising the following steps: indicating at least one AI model to be used with the first information; indicating a first feedback period with second information; processing CSI original data by using the selected AI model to generate result data; the first feedback period is used for transmitting the result data. The application also includes a device applying the method. The method and the device solve the problems that the CSI feedback precision is not high and the number of signal codebooks is large in the prior art.

title: A dual-camera-based on-line measurement system and method for porosity of manufactured sand
