description: The invention provides an on-line measurement system and method for the void ratio of manufactured sand based on dual cameras. The system includes a basic CCD camera, a precision CCD camera, an LED backlight, a prism group, a vibrating feeder, a transmission tube and a terminal. The basic CCD camera and the precision CCD camera are respectively connected to the terminal, the vibrating feeder is located above the transmission tube, and the prism group is located between the transmission tube and the two cameras; the basic CCD camera is used to photograph the falling of the whole machine-made sand The precision CCD camera is used to photograph a part of the falling area of the whole machine-made sand, and the precision CCD camera compensates for the fine particles that cannot be measured by the basic CCD camera. The invention combines dual-camera multi-scale measurement with machine learning, overcomes the difficulty of measuring the large size span of the machine-made sand, can effectively realize the on-line detection of the porosity of the machine-made sand, and improves the detection accuracy and efficiency. The porosity detection accuracy of the dual-camera detection system of the present invention conforms to practical engineering requirements.

title: A kind of experience quality evaluation method, system and device for real-time audio and video communication
description: The invention provides a method, a system and equipment for evaluating experience quality of real-time audio and video communication, wherein the method comprises the following steps: calculating the current network communication quality parameters to obtain the characteristics of the current network communication quality; extracting audio quality characteristics and video quality characteristics; splicing the characteristics of the current network communication quality, the audio quality characteristics and the video quality characteristics, and fusing and screening the spliced characteristics through a deep neural network; and regressing the fused and screened characteristics to obtain a real-time audio and video experience quality evaluation score. The invention combines the characteristics of real-time audio and video communication, fully considers and utilizes the quality characteristic information of multiple dimensions, thereby being capable of obtaining the quality score of the real-time audio and video communication system which accords with the subjective feeling of human beings.

title: A device and method for executing a program
description: Aspects of the present invention provide methods and apparatus for performing procedures, such as Neural Network (NN) inference. For example, the apparatus may include an executor and a dynamic load agent. An executor is coupled to the second memory and configured to execute a portion of the NN inference that has been loaded on the second memory from the first memory storing the NN inference and to generate a signal based on a progress of execution of the NN inference. The dynamic load agent is coupled to the executor, the first memory and the second memory, and is configured to load a next portion of the NN inference stored in the first memory to the second memory and to manage power provided to the first memory based on a signal from the executor and the inference execution scheme stored in the second memory.

title: An entity recognition method for coal mine safety field
description: The invention discloses an entity identification method facing the coal mine safety field, which is suitable for the informatization use of the coal mine safety field and comprises three steps of coal mine safety field entity data set construction, model design and model training: the method comprises the steps that data cleaning, processing and labeling are carried out in a construction stage of a real data set in the coal mine safety field, and the data are processed into an available data set; and in the model design stage, a RoBERTA pre-training language model is used as input, the characteristic input which is more in line with the context is obtained by utilizing the advantages of a larger training set, a larger Batch size and a dynamic covering mode, the context relationship is further learned through a bidirectional long-short term memory network, an attention mechanism is added to assign different weights to sequence elements, the CRF is utilized to calculate the most probable state path to obtain the final entity category, the MSRBAC model is constructed, and finally the trained MSRBAC model is used for entity identification in the mine safety field. The method has the advantages of simple steps, convenient use and wide practicability.

title: Ancient book character recognition method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for recognizing ancient books by characters, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring and preprocessing an ancient book image to be identified; inputting the ancient book image into a target detection model to obtain one or more positioning frames contained in the ancient book image; the positioning frame is used for representing Chinese character areas which are longitudinally and continuously arranged and have the same font form; inputting the area image determined by each positioning frame into a character recognition model to acquire characters contained in the area image; and determining the character recognition result of the ancient book image according to characters contained in all the area images. The invention realizes the positioning and identification of the characters in the ancient book literature pictures without manual intervention, and converts the characters in the pictures into digital characters, thereby improving the efficiency of ancient book entry and accelerating the ancient book arrangement work.

title: An optimization method of optical fiber preform preparation process based on genetic algorithm and BP neural network
description: The application provides an optimization method of an optical fiber preform preparation process based on a Genetic algorithm and a BP (back propagation) neural network, which comprises the steps of processing test data, constructing an optical fiber preform preparation quality prediction model net based on the BP neural network, constructing a Genetic algorithm model, optimizing an initial weight and a threshold of the optical fiber preform preparation quality prediction model net based on the BP neural network, assigning the weight and the threshold optimized by the Genetic algorithm to the BP neural network, training the BP neural network, testing the optical fiber preform preparation quality prediction model net based on the BP neural network, adjusting the weight and the threshold of the optical fiber preform preparation quality prediction model net according to a test error, and obtaining the optical fiber preform preparation quality prediction model based on the BP neural network; then, optimizing the input data through a genetic algorithm model optize to find out the optimal input gas combination; the invention can use the neural network to replace a large amount of experimental labor, save the cost and improve the efficiency.

title: Photovoltaic power prediction method and system based on Elman neural network and satellite cloud image
description: The invention belongs to the technical field related to photovoltaic power generation, and provides a photovoltaic power prediction method and a system based on an Elman neural network and a satellite cloud picture, wherein the photovoltaic power prediction method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical electricity utilization data and satellite images of an electricity utilization system to be predicted and preprocessing the historical electricity utilization data and the satellite images; constructing an Elman dynamic recurrent neural network model, and inputting the preprocessed data for training; inputting the preprocessed data into a trained Elman model, and outputting a prediction result; carrying out high-precision extraction on the gray value of the satellite cloud picture to prepare modeling of an Elman neural network prediction model; an Elman photovoltaic power prediction model and an Elman photovoltaic power prediction algorithm which simultaneously consider historical operating data and satellite cloud picture gray values; and obtaining model error evaluation by an error calculation mode of the measured value and the actual value, thereby improving the accuracy of power prediction.

title: Construction method, device, electronic device and storage medium of risk prediction model
description: The invention provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for constructing a risk prediction model, wherein the method comprises the steps of analyzing user personal data and user relation network data from historical user data; constructing historical user characteristics based on the user personal data and the user relationship network data; training a machine learning model according to the historical user characteristics to obtain a sub-prediction model; and fusing the sub-prediction model with a preset risk judgment rule to obtain a risk prediction model. Therefore, the risk prediction model is established through historical user data so as to predict the risk degree of the user, different credit services are provided through different risk degrees of the user, and the loss of a company is avoided.

title: Image processing method and device, readable storage medium and electronic equipment
description: The disclosure relates to an image processing method, an image processing device, a readable storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises the following steps: extracting brain tissues in the target SWI image to obtain a SWI brain tissue image; determining a micro bleeding point candidate region in the SWI brain tissue image through a Hessian matrix; identifying a microhemorrhage point from the microhemorrhage point candidate region. Therefore, automatic detection of the micro bleeding point can be realized, and the problems that manual searching of the micro bleeding point is long in time consumption and has human errors are avoided. In addition, based on the three-dimensional SWI brain tissue image, the micro bleeding point candidate region in the image is extracted through the Hessian matrix, so that the non-micro bleeding point candidate region which can cause interference can be effectively reduced, and the efficiency and accuracy of accurate extraction of the subsequent micro bleeding points are improved.

title: Scenario-based method and device for returning bank transaction error information
description: The invention discloses a scenized bank transaction error information returning method and a scenized bank transaction error information returning device, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the following steps: when the transaction has errors, acquiring transaction error description information and transaction scene information corresponding to the transaction error code; matching transaction error description information and transaction scene information corresponding to the transaction error code with a prompt information template obtained through a prompt information prediction model in advance to obtain a prompt information template matched with the transaction error code; the prompt information prediction model is obtained by training a machine learning model according to historical transaction error description information, corresponding historical transaction scene information and a historical transaction error processing mode; and filling the transaction error description information and the transaction scene information corresponding to the transaction error code into a prompt information template matched with the transaction error code to obtain scene user prompt information for the user to process the transaction error, so that the diversity of transaction error information return can be improved.

title: Prediction method of ADMET properties of ERα antagonists based on MMS_ResNet_1d model
description: The invention discloses an ADMET property prediction method of an ER alpha antagonist based on an MMS _ ResNet _1d model, which respectively takes n ADMET properties of ER alpha antagonist compounds as dependent variables and m molecular descriptor information of corresponding compounds as independent variables to create original data, and after a Micro _ Multi _ Scale _ Resnet _1d deep learning model is built for iterative training, optimal model parameters are obtained for predicting the property of the ADMET. The invention can more quickly and effectively carry out statistical modeling and prediction on the drug properties and improve the prediction accuracy, thereby reducing the number of pharmacologically unsuitable compounds in the early stage of drug development and saving time and cost.

title: Pulse wave identity authentication method, device and medium based on Gaussian mixture model
description: The invention relates to the field of non-contact physiological signal detection, in particular to a pulse wave identity authentication method, a device and a medium based on a Gaussian mixture model, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly utilizing a user finger pulse wave signal acquired by an oximeter, inputting the pulse wave signal into a manual feature extraction module to extract time domain and frequency domain features, respectively processing the time domain and frequency domain features into dynamic features, and respectively inputting the obtained dynamic features of the time domain and the frequency domain into a feature extraction network to extract deep level features of the frequency domain and the time domain; further, performing feature screening on the two deep-level features obtained in the last step through a probability linear discriminant analysis algorithm; and finally, carrying out identity recognition on the screened features by utilizing a Gaussian mixture model algorithm. The method can be effectively applied to a biological recognition system based on the pulse wave.

title: Shield attitude position deviation prediction method
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of shield tunneling, and particularly relates to a shield attitude position deviation prediction method. The method comprises the steps of taking all parameters of a finished shield construction project as source domain data, training in a pre-training model, extracting relevant parameters of a feature extraction layer in the pre-training model, superposing two new full-connection layers behind the feature extraction layer to form a shield attitude deviation prediction model, taking all parameters in the current shield construction project as target data, and training on the shield attitude deviation prediction model by using the target data to obtain prediction of shield tunneling deviation; in addition, the invention takes various parameters of the finished shield construction project as source domain data, ensures that enough training data are trained in the initial stage of shield construction, and further ensures the prediction effect of the shield attitude deviation prediction model. The situation that the prediction effect is inaccurate due to the fact that only a small amount of data are trained in the initial stage of the shield is avoided.

title: A method for generating personalized fonts based on CycleGAN
description: The invention provides a method for generating personalized fonts based on CycleGAN. Starting from the idea of image style transfer, this method builds a model for font style transfer based on Cycle Generative Adversarial Network (CycleGAN). The generator of the recurrent generative adversarial network is optimized, the original Resnet structure in the generator is replaced with a U-net structure, the appropriate model parameters are selected, and their own data set is constructed to enhance the data set. Operation, and finally obtain a better effect of the generated style font picture.

title: A method and system for identifying topology of users in distribution station area
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying a user topology in a power distribution area, which comprises the steps of receiving a starting user topology identification data acquisition message sent by a power distribution area service application system; acquiring voltage data of the ammeter according to the acquisition message; performing message packaging on the collected voltage data of the electric meter; and sending the encapsulation message to a power distribution station business application system, and forming a user topological relation of each station by the power distribution station business application system. The distribution area service application system can identify the topological structure of the user in the distribution area through calculation, can quickly confirm the topological structure change from the user electric meter to the collector and to the concentrator, is convenient for the refined management of the distribution area, saves a large amount of manpower and material resources, and does not generate errors due to manual mode.

title: Rolling Time Domain State Estimator
description: A rolling time domain state estimator estimates the state of a vehicle to reduce the overall communication cost of acquiring external measurements in a prediction time domain, wherein the state estimation accuracy of a time step is a function of the state estimation accuracy of a previous time step. For each time step of the prediction horizon, the estimator selects a subset of the external sensors having a precision estimation state sufficient to satisfy a constraint on state estimation precision for the corresponding time step while reducing an overall communication cost of acquiring the external measurements over the prediction horizon. The estimator requests external measurement values from the subset of external sensors determined for the current time step, and estimates a state of the vehicle using the internal measurement values and the requested external measurement values.

title: Video interview multidimensional scoring method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a video interview multidimensional scoring method, system, computer equipment and storage medium, wherein the scoring method comprises the following steps: data preprocessing is performed on video interview data of candidates; Score the candidates in multiple dimensions and generate a multi-dimensional analysis report of the video interview; when the interview result data of the candidates accumulates to a preset number, start the comprehensive recommendation index algorithm module, and combine the multi-dimensional scoring module to fit the comprehensive target position. Recommendation index model; the new candidate data outputs the corresponding recommendation index through the comprehensive recommendation index model of the target position, and is pushed to the multi-dimensional analysis report of the video interview. The present invention can be based on multi-dimensional scoring such as video interview output statement quality and competency, and can automatically learn a fitting algorithm from multiple dimensions based on the evaluation results of the interviewer, generate a comprehensive recommendation index model, and help enterprises to complete high-quality screening The goal.

title: Method and system for precise fertilization decision and plot level display
description: The present application relates to a precise fertilization decision-making and plot-level display method and system, including the steps of reading map information; the steps of marking plots for planting crops on the map according to the ridges; Steps: marking each plot with a production ratio value or marking each plot with a specific color according to the production ratio value. By directly displaying the plot shape and production ratio on the map, the relevant personnel can intuitively see the balanced fertilization status of the plots in a certain area.

title: An interpretable model-based text discriminative sample detection and generation system and method
description: The invention discloses a text discrimination sample detection and generation system and method based on an interpretable model, wherein the method comprises three steps of positioning seed samples containing potential discrimination in a text classification set, and detecting and generating a large number of generated discrimination samples: firstly, constructing a corresponding word bank and a disturbance word bank of all sensitive features in a given sensitive feature set through a knowledge graph; secondly, randomly selecting a part of samples from the text data set to obtain important characteristics of Top-k of the samples through an interpretable model, and selecting seed samples through matching a sensitive word stock; and finally, detecting discrimination samples from the seed samples through a genetic algorithm, and generating a large number of discrimination samples to retrain the model to eliminate discrimination of the model.

title: Video defogging method based on depth information guidance
description: The invention relates to a video defogging method based on a deep neural network, which comprises the following steps: inserting the current frame information and the reference frame information into a defogging subnetwork frame by frame, and fully extracting the multiframe information; estimating the depth map of the current frame through a depth prediction sub-network; and fusing the features extracted in the first step with the depth map estimated in the second step by adopting a non-local structure, capturing the long-distance pixel correlation among the depth map, the input features, the depth map and the input features, and guiding the depth map to video defogging to obtain a final defogging result.

title: A non-destructive rapid detection method and system for shellfish toxins based on hyperspectral imaging technology
description: A nondestructive and rapid detection method and system for shellfish toxins based on hyperspectral image technology, which relate to the technical field of shellfish toxin detection, and are used to solve the problem that the existing shellfish toxin detection methods have long detection time, complicated operation and need for sample detection. preprocessing questions. The technical points of the present invention include: collecting hyperspectral images of multiple shellfish samples; performing spectral data extraction and preprocessing on the hyperspectral images; obtaining the optimal feature band subset based on a feature selection algorithm based on fuzzy clustering and particle swarm optimization ; Input the optimal feature band subset into the shellfish toxin nondestructive detection model based on the cost-sensitive probability neural network for training, and obtain the trained detection model; input the preprocessed spectral data of the shellfish samples to be detected into the trained In the detection model of , get the detection results. The invention applies the hyperspectral image technology to the nondestructive detection of shellfish toxins, and provides a new approach for solving the problem of shellfish consumption safety.

title: Alerting method, apparatus, device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The application discloses an alarm method, an alarm device, alarm equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image to be analyzed sent by a target shooting device arranged in an area of an oil gas filling station; determining a target area corresponding to the first image to be analyzed; the target region is contained in a plurality of sub-regions contained by the petroleum gas filling station region; determining alarm characteristic information corresponding to the first image to be analyzed based on the target area; and determining whether the first image to be analyzed meets the alarm condition or not by utilizing the alarm characteristic information, and if so, displaying corresponding alarm information to play a role in improving the alarm efficiency.

title: A three-dimensional storage pool based on a volatile three-dimensional memristor and its fabrication method
description: The invention provides a three-dimensional reserve pool based on a volatile three-dimensional memristor and a manufacturing method thereof, wherein a storage layer, a selection layer and an electrode layer in each through hole in the three-dimensional reserve pool form a memristor, namely a reserve pool unit, and the three-dimensional reserve pool based on the volatile three-dimensional memristor is formed on the basis of a laminated structure and a plurality of through holes. And reduces the area of the system.

title: A model training method, device, equipment and storage medium thereof
description: The embodiment of the application provides a model training method, a model training device, model training equipment and a storage medium of the model training device. The method comprises the steps of mapping a first model feature vector and a second model feature vector generated by a first model with a smaller size in a hidden layer to a vector space with the same dimension by determining the first model feature vector generated by a second model with a larger size in the hidden layer, dividing the second model feature vector into a first sub feature vector and a second sub feature vector, using a first loss value to characterize the first sub feature vector for inheriting the knowledge learned by the first model, using a second loss value to characterize the second sub feature vector, exploring the knowledge not learned by the first model, and training the second model based on the first loss value and the second loss value.

title: A method and device for optimizing target word vector model
description: The invention provides a target word vector model optimization method and a device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: converting the one-hot codes corresponding to all words in a dictionary into M-dimensional column vectors according to a pre-initialized parameter matrix, determining a loss function containing font information according to the one-hot codes, the parameter matrix, the M-dimensional column vectors and a prediction result of each word output by a target word vector model, and constructing an optimized loss function according to the loss function and an original loss function corresponding to the target word vector model; and performing iterative training on the target word vector model parameters and the parameters of the parameter matrix according to the original loss function and the optimized loss function, and obtaining an optimized target word vector model after the training is completed. The device is used for executing the method. The method and the device provided by the embodiment of the invention improve the training efficiency of the optimized target word vector model.

title: A template-based multimodal named entity recognition method and related equipment
description: The invention discloses a multi-modal named entity recognition method based on a template and related equipment. According to the template-based multi-mode named entity recognition method, the named entity recognition problem is converted into the text generation problem, the neural network model can learn the semantic similarity between the multi-mode data and the entity type through a semantic learning mode, and the accuracy of named entity recognition is improved.

title: A method for allocating quay cranes in container terminals based on the set partition model
description: A container terminal berth shore bridge distribution method based on a set partitioning model comprises the following steps: establishing G-BQCAP-TW model constraint, designing a column generation strategy, generating an initial GSPP matrix, generating all ship berthing schemes (GSPP matrix columns) conforming to the G-BQCAP-TW constraint by the matrix, initializing and combining the GSPP matrix and a genetic algorithm, carrying out selective cross mutation on individuals, designing a gene repair operation in the cross mutation process, and defining the individual with the best fitness in a population as an optimal solution after the genetic algorithm reaches a set algebra. The invention has the beneficial effects that: 1. the combined allocation of the continuous berth and the shore bridge under the influence of the tide is considered. 2. The G-BQCAP-TW model is an NP difficult problem, a column generation strategy is adopted to embed model constraints into genes, and meanwhile, the population is initialized to ensure that an equation in the model is always established. The invention improves the operating efficiency of the container wharf, reasonably distributes the berth shore bridges and reduces the operation cost of the wharf.

title: Group monkey action recognition method based on space-time interaction network
description: The present application discloses a group monkey action recognition method based on a spatiotemporal interaction network, including: building a group monkey action recognition model with three layers in sequence: a position and category recognition layer, a feature map processing layer, and an action reasoning layer, and a group monkey action recognition model in the position and category recognition layer. The residual network is connected to the second interface of the feature map processing layer through the first region generation network. The feature map processing layer converts the position and category information of different action subjects in the current frame into multi-dimensional tensors, and uses the position information of the action subjects as an index. , select the region of interest from the first region generation network, and superimpose it with the multi-dimensional tensor. The action inference layer forms a three-dimensional data group according to the time sequence, and performs the shift operation to generate the action inference tensor, and outputs the corresponding position of the action subject. The action category of the monkey group; use the monkey group action data to train the group monkey action recognition model until the model converges. Through the technical solution in the present application, the problem of motion recognition of group monkeys in a cage is solved.

title: Visualized malware detection and classification method, system, storage medium and terminal
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of information security, and discloses a visual malicious software detection and classification method, a system, a storage medium and a terminal, wherein software to be detected is put into a virtual execution environment to run, dynamic execution behavior information of the software to be detected is collected, and information is extracted; generating an image based on the dynamic execution behavior of the software to be detected according to the extracted dynamic execution behavior information of the software to be detected; and analyzing the generated image based on the dynamic execution behavior of the software to be detected by utilizing a malicious software detection and classification model, and judging whether the corresponding software to be detected belongs to malicious software. Compared with the existing method for directly converting the malicious software or the inverse assembly code thereof into the image, the method uses the dynamic analysis report which can represent the behavior characteristics of the malicious software, adopts a visual method to convert the malicious software into the image, and simultaneously adopts a deep learning method to construct the model, thereby avoiding manual feature extraction and improving the detection performance of the model.

title: Image super-resolution processing method, apparatus, device and storage medium
description: The application provides an image super-resolution processing method, an apparatus, a device and a storage medium, comprising: inputting an image to be processed into a super-resolution reconstruction model; performing hyper-resolution reconstruction on a first region image of the image to be processed and outputting a first region hyper-resolution image through a feature extraction unit and a first region decoding unit of the super-resolution reconstruction model; performing hyper-resolution reconstruction on a second region image of the image to be processed and outputting a second region hyper-resolution image through a feature extraction unit and a second region decoding unit; and fusing the first area hyper-resolution image and the second area hyper-resolution image to obtain a hyper-resolution image of the image to be processed. In the method, the different areas of the image are respectively subjected to the super-resolution reconstruction, and compared with the direct super-resolution reconstruction of the whole image, the pertinence of the super-resolution reconstruction processing can be ensured; and the same feature extraction unit is adopted when the super-resolution reconstruction is carried out on different regions, so that the volume of the super-resolution reconstruction model can be reduced, and the super-resolution reconstruction model is favorable for being deployed on equipment such as a mobile terminal.

title: Transmission line path optimization method based on intelligent image recognition
description: The invention relates to a power transmission line path planning technology. The invention provides a power transmission line path optimization method based on intelligent image recognition, aiming at solving the problems that the path optimization of a power transmission line is influenced by expert experience or has low efficiency, and the technical scheme can be summarized as follows: firstly, loading a high-definition remote sensing satellite image, a digital elevation model and vector thematic data by adopting a GIS geographic information system; determining a starting point and a stopping point of the line, connecting the starting point and the stopping point to form an aerial line, and determining line parameters to obtain a design plan of the power transmission line; then intelligently identifying the surface feature elements by adopting a pre-established improved U-Net model; then, carrying out grid division, calculating, identifying and mapping out a project cost adjustment coefficient of the unit grid; and finally, calculating the cost of any side line or diagonal line of the unit grid, and equivalently solving the path with the minimum cost of the two-point line engineering by utilizing an A-x algorithm. The method has the advantages of being simple to use and suitable for power transmission line path planning.

title: A kind of human hand recognition method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a hand recognition method, a hand recognition device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The human hand recognition method specifically includes: acquiring an image to be identified, and extracting low-layer image features from the image to be identified; carrying out deformation convolution processing on the low-layer image characteristics, and acquiring a palm center point matched with a deformation processing result; standard convolution processing is carried out on the low-layer image characteristics, and hand description information matched with a standard processing result is obtained, wherein the hand description information comprises: the offset between the palm center point and the hand center point and the width and height value of the hand; and identifying the hand area in the image to be identified according to the palm center point and the hand description information. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can reduce the calculation amount in the hand recognition process and simplify the hand recognition task, thereby improving the hand recognition efficiency.

title: A kind of centralized management method and system for automatic breeding and feeding of aquatic products
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for centralized management of automatic aquaculture feeding, relating to the technical field of aquaculture and comprising the steps of obtaining a motion image of a current aquatic product; performing target tracking according to the current aquatic product moving image to record the aquatic product moving track; determining the movement parameters of the aquatic products according to the movement tracks of the aquatic products; determining the hungry state of the aquatic product according to the motion parameters of the aquatic product; determining the current feeding behavior and acquiring preset feeding data; obtaining target feeding data required within preset time through a target neural network model; and feeding the feed to the aquaculture place according to the required target feeding data. According to the method, the target neural network model is obtained through continuous learning and training according to the acquired environment data, the aquatic product data and the preset feeding data, the feeding data can be accurately determined by taking the current actual behavior of the aquatic product as a parameter, and therefore a feasible accurate feeding strategy can be flexibly provided for the aquatic products in different culture environments.

title: Modification method of graphene lubricating oil based on fluoride ion doping
description: The invention provides a method for improving graphene lubricating oil based on fluorine doping, which comprises the following steps: firstly, establishing a graphene composite fluorination reaction energy efficiency optimization model and a graphene fluorination reaction product optimization model through a fluorination reaction sample generation test; secondly, aiming at a specific graphene raw material, providing an energy efficiency optimal reaction condition by using a graphene composite fluorination reaction energy efficiency optimization model; inputting the energy efficiency optimal reaction conditions and the set proportion of the products into a graphene fluorination reaction product optimization model, and giving out the optimized reaction conditions considering the product ratio; and fourthly, carrying out fluorination reaction. The problem of agglomeration caused by long-term wear of the graphene lubricating oil can be greatly reduced, and the stability and the wear resistance of the lubricating oil are greatly improved compared with the original lubricating oil.

title: A system and method for generating face images of masks with diverse styles
description: The invention relates to a system and a method for generating mask face images with various styles. The facial feature detection module is mainly used for ensuring the correctness of generating a mask face image; the mask binary segmentation module is mainly used for reserving facial features of an unobstructed area in an input image; the mask style coding module is mainly used for extracting mask style codes from input mask faces and further guiding the model to generate masks with various styles according to the style codes. The invention can solve the problems that the shielding position of the face image in the current face recognition image generation system is random, the shielding area is not consistent with the area of the mask, the face outline can not be well reserved, the face recognition by wearing the mask is not suitable, the application scene is narrow and the like.

title: Model construction method, device and storage medium based on network architecture search
description: The invention provides a model construction method, a device and a storage medium based on network architecture search, wherein the method comprises the steps of combining the number of nodes and operands to obtain a first number of construction schemes, and constructing multidimensional vectors corresponding to the construction schemes into an initial population; carrying out cross variation to obtain a new population; fusing the new population and the initial population into a fused population; determining a first range in the Yangtze-Huffian triangle based on the set-up target quantity, dividing a second range in the first range based on the fusion population, calculating the sum of parameters in the second range as the quantity of reference points, and representing the reference points as reference point vectors; grading the multidimensional vectors in the fusion population by adopting non-dominated sorting, and establishing a first vector set based on a threshold value grade; calculating the distance between the multidimensional vector of the next level of the threshold level and the reference point vector, and outputting the closer multidimensional vector as a second vector set; and merging the vectors into a target vector set, wherein the construction scheme corresponding to the multidimensional vector in the target vector set is a target scheme.

title: 3D image generation method and device based on generation countermeasure network
description: The present invention provides a 3D image generation method and device based on a generative confrontation network. The method includes: inputting a multi-vision 2D image and a random variable taken from different perspectives into a trained generative confrontation network to generate a 2D image; inputting the generated 2D image into a 3DINN network to obtain the corresponding 2D image. 3D structure; stitching the 3D structure and the 2D image into a trained 3D convolutional neural network, output R, G, B three-channel prediction value. The present invention utilizes a generative confrontation network to generate 3D images based on polycular vision 2D images shot from different perspectives of the same scene, can effectively reduce noise, and can solve the problem of the existing 3D scene generated by the existence of 3D images generated based on monocular vision 2D images in the prior art Simpler and less complete.

title: A visualization method for multi-mobile robots to work along assigned task points
description: The invention discloses a visualization method for a multi-mobile robot to operate along assigned task points, which comprises the task points, a storage unit, a mobile robot, a reset button, a pause button, an improved genetic algorithm and VisualOne engine software; when a visualization method for simulating operation of a multi-mobile robot along task point distribution is used, the number of mobile robots, task point execution points and warehousing units is determined; then, based on an improved genetic algorithm, the task allocation of the sequence of task points completed by the multiple mobile robots is solved; then building a required virtual operation scene in Visualone engine software; establishing a link between VisualOne engine software and a result obtained by improving a genetic algorithm; when the visualization operation is carried out, resetting, pausing, dragging, rotating, zooming in and zooming out can be carried out according to the time period of the task amount of the operation. The concept is simple, the operation is convenient, the method is suitable for the actual requirement of the multi-mobile robot to operate along the assigned task points, and the reasonability of the multi-mobile robot to operate and plan along the assigned task points is improved.

title: Pedestrian intent prediction method and readable storage medium for running a red light
description: The invention relates to the technical field of pedestrian traffic management, in particular to a method for predicting the intention of pedestrians to run a red light and a readable storage medium. The method includes: acquiring the image information to be tested at the intersection position; extracting the red light running behavior feature related to the condition factor of pedestrians running the red light in the test image information of the intersection position; The predicted probability of running a red light is the result of the pedestrian's intention to run a red light. The invention also discloses a readable storage medium. The present invention can effectively predict the behavior intention of pedestrians running a red light, thereby assisting vehicle drivers to avoid collision risks, thereby improving the management effect and operation safety of intersection traffic.

title: Ship classification method and system based on underwater acoustic radiation audio data
description: The application provides a ship classification method and system based on underwater sound radiation audio data. The ship classification method comprises the steps of obtaining target underwater sound radiation audio data of a ship to be classified; processing the target underwater sound radiation audio data according to a preset conversion method to obtain a target spectrogram to be classified; and classifying the target spectrogram to be classified by using the trained ship classification model to obtain the target category of the ship to be classified. The ship classification method is high in accuracy of the obtained classification result.

title: A method for quality classification of crayfish based on neural network
description: The invention discloses a method for classifying the quality of crayfish based on a neural network, comprising (1) collecting and constructing a crayfish data set, and randomly dividing it into a training set, a verification set and a test set; Under the pytorch framework, the whale algorithm is used to improve the positioning accuracy of the anchor detection frame, and the ResNet152 classification network is constructed. The improved model is trained on data and repeatedly verified and tested to locate and identify the lobster. A distance-based refinement algorithm is used to extract the lobster skeleton. Complete the classification of shrimp tail shape according to the posture, and complete the classification results of freshness and color. (3) The method of converting the lobster image to binary image is used to calculate the proportion of the shrimp body pixels, and classify the specifications according to the threshold. (4) According to the classification results of (2) and (3), different levels of sorting are carried out. The invention integrates deep learning and image processing technology, so that the positioning of the lobster is more accurate, the shape detection accuracy is higher, and the speed is faster.

title: Two-stage WECC load modeling method based on deep learning dual deep Q network
description: The invention discloses a two-stage WECC load modeling method based on a deep learning double-deep Q network, and relates to the technical field of load modeling. The detailed model structure, control logic and parameter setting of the existing WECC CLM are limited by most software suppliers , so it is not transparent to the public, which affects the popularization, application and practicability of WECC CLM, the granularity and accuracy of the survey data depends entirely on the survey agency, and there are many assumptions that cannot be confirmed and verified. Due to the inconvenience, the following solutions are proposed, including: The DDQN method of the present invention can perform load modeling with only a few sets of transient records, effectively overcomes the data availability problem, and can be easily extended when the WECC CLM is updated with new load components such as distributed energy sources (DER) this method.

title: Skin cancer image identification method, device, device and readable storage medium
description: The present application relates to a skin cancer image recognition method, device, equipment and readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of medical image recognition, including inputting the skin image to be detected into a deep convolutional neural network skin cancer image recognition model, and the skin image to be detected. After successively processing the input layer, asymmetric decomposition convolution layer, deep feature extraction layer and category output layer of the deep convolutional neural network skin cancer image recognition model, the output result is obtained, and the output result is the recognition result of the skin image to be detected. The results include whether the skin image to be detected is a skin cancer image and the skin cancer image category. This application can not only accurately identify whether the skin picture to be detected is a skin cancer picture and the category of the skin cancer picture, but also provide patients with a means of self-detection of skin cancer, so as to promote patients to seek medical treatment in time, and can also effectively realize the deep convolutional neural network skin The weight reduction of the cancer image recognition model improves the diagnosis efficiency.

title: Joint learning training method and device
description: The disclosure relates to the technical field of joint learning, and provides a joint learning training method and device. The method comprises the following steps: after a model requiring party initiates a training task, determining a plurality of participating parties through a joint learning training center according to the training task; performing joint learning training on the neural network model by using a plurality of participant data of a plurality of participants; in the joint learning training, acquiring a working log corresponding to each participant, and acquiring supervision information corresponding to each participant through a safety supervision center; and auditing the neural network model according to the working log and the supervision information corresponding to each participant to obtain a trusted joint learning model. By adopting the technical means, the problems that the use of party data in the joint learning training cannot be monitored, the potential safety hazard of data exists and the reliability of the joint learning training cannot be guaranteed in the prior art are solved.

title: Text emotion recognition method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention provides a text emotion recognition method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the text emotion recognition method comprises the following steps: acquiring sample data; marking sample data, and classifying the marked sample data according to the emotion types to obtain a sample data set; the method comprises the steps of establishing a first network model by performing syntax level sequencing and context coding on a sample data set; establishing a second network model according to the output result and the classification processing result of the first network model, and training the second network model to obtain a text emotion recognition model, wherein the text emotion recognition model comprises the first network model and the trained second network model which are sequentially connected; and inputting the text data to be recognized into the text emotion recognition model to obtain a text emotion recognition result of the text data to be recognized. The method can acquire richer text characteristic information, and greatly improves the accuracy of emotion recognition of the text data.

title: Prompt ensemble method and computing device based on contrastive learning for efficient adaptation of embodied agent, and recording medium thereof
description: The prompt ensemble method based on contrastive learning of the present invention comprises a first step of generating a prompt for each domain factor given as an input while an encoder is optimized through offline contrastive learning based on prompts, and a second step of predicting a task-specific state representation for a new domain by giving the output of the encoder reflecting each prompt generated in the first step online as an input of an attention module, wherein the online step is an environment in which an agent can learn a policy for a task through interaction with an environment, the offline step is an environment in which interaction with the environment is limited and only pre-created data exists, and the domain factor is a property that causes a domain change in the environment and is the minimum unit that constitutes the domain.

title: Label checking apparatus and checking method thereof
description: A label inspection device includes: a camera for capturing at least one tire image; a control device for controlling a tire production process; a communication unit for transmitting and receiving data regarding the tire production process; and a control unit for performing label inspection on a finished tire having a label attached thereto. The control unit may obtain the at least one tire image from the camera, detect a label attached to the finished tire from the obtained at least one tire image, determine conformity with respect to a position of the detected label based on inspection reference information determined in advance, and provide inspection result information indicating the determined conformity to the control device.

title: Method for performing random access procedure in small cell base stations in ultra-dense networks and device for the same
description: The present invention relates to a method and apparatus for performing a random access procedure of a small cell base station in an ultra-dense network. Specifically, the method includes a step of transmitting, to a Machine-Type Communication Device (MTCD), an SIB-2 message including a number of power level pools for power allocation and an access control element for access control, a step of receiving, from the MTCD, a composite signal based on the SIB-2 message, and a step of performing Successive Interference Cancellation Decoding (SIC decoding) on the SIB-2 message.

title: Localization, classification, and picking point detection of strawberries for a harvesting robot
description: Harvesting robots for strawberry harvesting in greenhouses or smart farms have been unable to accurately recognize strawberries depending on the position of sunlight, the position of lighting, and the angle at which strawberry leaves obscure the light. Furthermore, they have been able to only harvest strawberries, and have been unable to classify them by grade or condition after harvest. The present invention seeks to solve these problems. To address these problems, the present invention provides a strawberry harvesting robot comprising: four wheels; four motors that independently drive the four wheels to move the strawberry harvesting robot; a robot body having the four motors internally; an artificial intelligence controller and communication module provided in the robot body and a battery that supplies power to drive the robot; a multi-joint robot arm provided above the body and configured with multi-joints for harvesting strawberries; an RGB-D camera provided at the end of the robot arm; and a strawberry stem cutting and strawberry harvesting gripper provided above the RGB-D camera.  This invention has the effect of accurately harvesting strawberries without damage with minimal robot movement by recognizing multiple strawberries that can be harvested simultaneously at once and harvesting strawberries that are nearby first using distance measurement values through the configuration of the invention as described above.

title: Method and system for providing vehicle accident negligence rate using machine learning model
description: The present disclosure provides a method for providing a fault ratio for a vehicle accident, which is performed by at least one processor. The method comprises the steps of: receiving a first user input associated with a vehicle accident; determining a type of fault associated with the vehicle accident based on the first user input using a first machine learning model; and determining a fault ratio associated with the vehicle accident based on the type of fault.

title: Data processing apparatus for compressing multimodal data, data processing apparatus for decoding multimodal data and integrated processing system for multimodal data
description: A system for performing integrated processing of multimodal data includes a compression device that generates a plurality of embedding vectors by embedding a plurality of data having different modalities in multimodal data, a merged embedding vector obtained by merging the plurality of embedding vectors, and a decoding device that decodes the compressed merged embedding vector from a bitstream including the compressed merged embedding vector and decomposes the plurality of embedding vectors for data having different modalities from the decoded merged embedding vector.

title: Enterprise contents management system capable of treating harmful contents
description: A method for managing enterprise content capable of processing harmful content is disclosed. According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for managing enterprise content capable of processing harmful content is provided, which is performed by a server, and includes the steps of: storing a first electronic document transmitted to the server in a dictionary database; generating a second electronic document, which is a copy of the first electronic document, and backing up the first electronic document; converting the second electronic document into a file based on a deflate compression algorithm and then parsing it, if the second electronic document has an OLE (Object Linking & Embedding) or OOXML (Office Open XML) structure; extracting the visual content, if the second electronic document includes visual content; detecting harmful content in the parsed second electronic document using a learning model trained based on machine learning; neutralizing the harmful content; and transmitting the neutralized second electronic document from the dictionary database to a main database. According to the present invention, a system is provided that can safely manage corporate content by processing harmful content such as malware included in documents flowing into a corporate content management system of a company.

title: Generative neural networks for stylizing media content
description: A mobile application with an improved user interface facilitates the creation of stylized media content items, including images and videos. The end user selects a desired visual effect from a set of options. The mobile application captures or accesses the image. The image is processed on a server using a pre-trained generative neural network to apply stylizations based on the selected effect. The server then transmits the stylized image back to the mobile application for display. The end user can then save the stylized image or generate a video (e.g., an animation) depicting the transition of the original image into the stylized image. The user interface provides an efficient creative workflow for applying aesthetic enhancements to the visual style selected by the end user. Generative machine learning techniques automate stylization to enable accessible media customization and sharing.

title: Method And Apparatus for Video Editing Based on Drag And Input/Output Region
description: A method and device for performing video editing based on drag and input/output areas are disclosed.  According to one aspect of the present disclosure, a method for performing image editing based on drag and input/output areas is provided, the method comprising: receiving, from an original image, a handle point and a target point, a modification area including the handle point and the target point, and an output area which is shape information desired to be created using the image editing; and generating an initial modified image using a diffusion model based on the handle point and the target point, the modification area, and the output area.

title: System and Method for Dynamically Conducting Conversations Based on Chatbot Agents with Dialogue Generation Models
description: Embodiments relate to a system and method for dynamically conducting a conversation based on a chatbot agent including a conversation generation model, the system including the steps of: generating a conversation session in which a user-desired conversation is to be recorded by setting at least some of the conversation session properties according to a user input; generating a conversation message of the first chatbot agent (30) and registering the generated conversation message of the first chatbot agent (30) in the conversation session; and generating a conversation message of the second chatbot agent (30) by the second chatbot agent (30) when a second chatbot agent (30) different from the first chatbot agent (30) is connected to the conversation session, and registering the generated conversation message of the second chatbot agent (30) in the conversation session.

title: Nonlinear Circuits and Horned Neural Networks Using the Same
description: The present invention discloses a nonlinear circuit and a chaotic neural network using the same. The circuit has a first variable resistor having one side to which an input signal is applied, an amplifier having a negative input terminal connected to the other side of the first variable resistor and a positive input terminal connected to ground, and one side connected to the negative input terminal of the amplifier. A third variable resistor having a second variable resistor, one side connected to an output terminal of the amplifier and the other side connected to the other side of the second variable resistor, and one side to which an input signal is applied and the other side connected to the other side of the third variable resistor. And a fourth variable resistor having an excitation. The chaotic neural network using the same may include a first sample and hold for sampling an input signal in response to a first clock signal, nonlinear means for generating an output signal having a nonlinear characteristic corresponding to an output signal of the first sample and hold; An addition means for adding the output signal of the nonlinear means and an external input signal, and a second sample &amp; sample for outputting the output signal of the adding means to the input terminal of the first sample & hold in response to a second clock signal. And a clock generating means for generating the first clock signal and the second clock signal. Therefore, the configuration of the nonlinear circuit is simplified, and the configuration of the chaotic neural network using the same is simplified.

title: Predictive maintenance for industrial machines
description: A computer-implemented failure predictor has a module arrangement (373) with first and second sub-ordinated modules (313, 323) that are sub-ordinated to an output module (363). The first and a second sub-oriented modules process data from an industrial machine to determine first and second intermediate status indicators. A third sub-oriented module (333) determines an operation mode indicator, and the output module (363) processes the status indicators and the operation mode indicator to predict a failure of the industrial machine. The module arrangement has been trained by cascaded training to comprises to train the sub-ordinated modules (312, 322, 332), to subsequently operate the trained sub-ordinated modules, and to subsequently train the output module.

title: Method for evaluating cell population heterogeneity based on energy indicators
description: The present invention provides a method for evaluating cell population heterogeneity based on energy indicators. By preprocessing single cell transcriptome data, selecting features, defining cell state, constructing gene local network and calculating its energy and cell energy, then normalizing cell energy, using Gaussian mixture model to analyze energy distribution, identifying cell potential state and clustering, the heterogeneity of cell population is evaluated finally. This method can accurately reveal the internal complexity and differences of cell populations.

title: METHOD AND SYSTEM TO RECOMMEND RECOMMENDED CONTENT THROUGH THE USE OF CONTENT GROUPERS
description: Method and system for storing inserted content that includes a user device that has memory and a viewer tracking module, which allows creating a history of the content viewed on the user device. The recommendations recording module compares the history of the contents viewed and the insertion of contents and stores at least one inserted content on the user's device, as a result of the comparison performed, to create a list of inserted contents recorded. The screen displays the list of recorded inserted content corresponding to the content stored in the device

title: Intelligent Discharging Monitoring Method and System for Concrete Batching Station
description: The present invention relates to the disclosure of a method and system for intelligent discharging monitoring of a concrete batching station. The method comprises: obtaining a video frame monitoring a concrete batching station discharging area to obtain a first video frame; detecting and identifying the first video frame based on a predetermined algorithm model, and monitoring the discharging of the concrete batching station based on the identification result. According to the method, there is no need for manual participation in the discharging monitoring process, and the discharging monitoring intelligence can be achieved, the discharging monitoring effect can be ensured, and the discharging efficiency of the control system is thus improved. Figure 1.

title: Method and system for assigning tasks to mining and/or construction machines
description: The present invention relates to a method for assigning a set of tasks to a plurality of mining and/or construction machines (200A, 200B;701-703), being driven between positions for performing tasks. The method includes:- defining a first set of constraints to be fulfilled when assigning said tasks;- finding an overall solution fulfilling said first set of constraints by solving each constraint as a sub-problem, a solution to at least one sub-problem being dependent on the solution of at least one other sub-problem;- said overall solution fulfilling said first set of constraints being an overall solution where a first of said sub-problems is validated by solutions of others of said sub-problems, and- assigning tasks to said plurality of machines (200A, 200B;701-703) according to the overall solution, wherein tasks are arranged to be carried out at least partially overlapping in time by said machines (200A, 200B;701-703).

title: Method and apparatus for performing launch detection in a neuron spike representation of a signal
description: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide methods and apparatus for performing motion detection in a neuron spike representation of a signal, such as an audible signal. An example method generally includes: receiving a signal; filtering a signal into a plurality of channels using a plurality of filters having different frequency pass bands; transmitting the filtered signal in each channel to a first type of spike neuron model; The filtered signal in each channel is sent to a second type of spike neuron model; and a first output based on the first type of spike neuron model and a second output of the second type of spike neuron model for each channel To detect one or more launches of the signal.

title: Sample observation device and method
description: In learning processing performed before sample observation processing (steps S705 to S708), the sample observation device acquires a low-picture quality learning image under a first imaging condition for each defect position indicated by defect position information, determines an imaging count of a plurality of high-picture quality learning images associated with the low-picture quality learning image for each defect position and a plurality of imaging points based on a set value of the imaging count, acquires the plurality of high-picture quality learning images under a second imaging condition (step S702), learns a high-picture quality image estimation model using the low-picture quality learning image and the plurality of high-picture quality learning images (step S703), and adjusts a parameter related to the defect detection in the sample observation processing using the high-picture quality image estimation model (step S704).

title: Image encoder using machine learning and data processing method of the image encoder
description: An image encoder for outputting a bitstream by encoding an input image includes a predictive block, a machine learning based prediction enhancement (MLBE) block, and a subtractor. The predictive block is configured to generate a prediction block using data of a previous input block. The MLBE block is configured to transform the prediction block into an enhanced prediction block by applying a machine learning technique to the prediction block. The subtractor is configured to generate a residual block by subtracting pixel data of the enhanced prediction block from pixel data of a current input block.

title: Polishing apparatus
description: A polishing apparatus includes a polishing station to hold a polishing pad, a carrier head to hold a substrate in contact with a polishing pad at the polishing station, a camera positioned to capture an image of a lower surface of a consumable part when the consumable part moves away from the polishing pad, and a controller configured to perform an image processing algorithm on the image to determine whether the consumable part is damaged. The consumable part can be a retaining ring on a carrier head, or a conditioner disk on a conditioner head.

title: Body relationship estimation method and apparatus
description: A body relationship estimation method and apparatus are disclosed. The method includes obtaining a target picture, calculating a first body relationship feature of two persons according to at least one of first location information of a body part of each person of the two persons in the target picture or second location information of body parts of the two persons, where the first location information is obtained by performing single-person gesture estimation on each person, and the second location information is obtained by performing two-person joint gesture estimation on the two persons when the first location information indicates that the body parts of the two persons overlap, and determining a body relationship between the two persons according to the first body relationship feature.

title: Operational parameters
description: A customer service robot may be limited to a maximum physical ability, such as speed of travel, speed of a robotic arm, etc. However, certain customers may be uncomfortable with a robot operating at the maximum capacity. Accordingly, a customer may have an attribute associated with a performance-limiting criteria. The criteria then limits the robot to operations within operational parameters associated with the performance-limiting criteria. As a benefit, a robot may be transformed to provide a better customer service experience by working quickly to address a customer service task, but within the confines of what a particular customer, or customer type, may consider comfortable or acceptable.

title: Operation circuit and operation control method thereof
description: A product-sum operation circuit includes a pulse width/digital conversion circuit ( 9 ) which converts a pulse signal having a pulse width representing an operand value into a digital signal, a sorting circuit ( 4 ) which outputs, in descending or ascending order of magnitude, a plurality of operand values Xi converted into digital signals by the pulse width/digital conversion circuit ( 9 ), and an accumulated sum circuit ( 1 ) which multiplies each operand value output from the sorting circuit ( 4 ) by a corresponding operand value Wi and calculates the accumulated sum of multiplication results. The pulse width/digital conversion circuit ( 9 ) includes a counter ( 10 ) which counts a clock and outputs a count value as a digital signal, and n trailing edge latch circuits ( 11 - 0 - 11 -(n−1)) each of which latches a common count value output from the counter at the trailing edge of the input pulse signal.

title: System and method to customize the facilitation of development of user thinking about an arbitrary problem
description: Preferred embodiments of the invention provide systems and methods for customizing the facilitation of development of user thinking about an arbitrary problem. The system includes first logic to facilitate user specification of a problem structure, second logic to facilitate user specification of a conclusion structure, third logic to facilitate specification of a knowledge structure, related to the arbitrary problem. Some embodiments of the system further include customization logic to accomplish customized or specialized facilitation as in the provisioning of a customized or specialized process for the user. Other embodiments further include customization or specialization of the structure for the user and in some embodiments, customization of the system output.

title: Parameterized statistical interaction policies
description: A method and apparatus are disclosed for selecting interaction policies. Values may be provided for a group of parameters for user models. Interaction policies within a specific tolerance of an optimal interaction policy for the user models may be learned. Up to a predetermined number of the learned interaction policies, within a specific tolerance of an optimal policy for the user models, may be selected for a wireless communication device. The wireless communication device, including the selected interaction policies, may determine whether any of a group of parameters, representing a user preference or contextual information with respect to use of the wireless communication device, is updated. When any of the group of parameters has been updated, the wireless communication device may select one of the selected interaction policies, such that the selected one of the selected interaction policies may determine a better interaction behavior for the wireless communication device.

title: Regulating activation threshold levels in a simulated neural circuit
description: A simulated neural element includes a cell body and one or more simulated branches. Simulated branches are configured to receive input signals and to activate when a combination of the signals received during a specified window of time exceeds a branch activation threshold level. The simulated cell body is configured to activate when a combination of activity in the simulated branches during another specified window of time exceeds a cell body activation threshold level. The branch and cell body activation threshold levels may be automatically and locally regulated so that the actual branch activation rates for the simulated branches approximate desired branch activation rates and the actual cell body activation rate for the simulated cell body approximates a desired cell body activation rate. Such “homeostatic” regulation of branch and cell firing thresholds, done locally (i.e. individually for each branch and cell), may enhance the performance of artificial neural circuitry.

title: Behavioral targeting system
description: A behavioral targeting system determines user profiles from online activity. The system includes a plurality of models that define parameters for determining a user profile score. Event information, which comprises on-line activity of the user, is received at an entity. To generate a user profile score, a model is selected. The model comprises recency, intensity and frequency dimension parameters. The behavioral targeting system generates a user profile score for a target objective, such as brand advertising or direct response advertising. The parameters from the model are applied to generate the user profile score in a category. The behavioral targeting system has application for use in ad serving to on-line users.

title: Logifolg
description: LOGIFOLG is a system and method for finding implicit information that is not explicitly mentioned in the sentence, not contained in the synonyms of the particular word, not present in the concept the word belongs to, not found with statistical or concordance based analysis. Nevertheless, this implicit information is present and understood, implicitly, consciously or unconsciously, by everybody who reads the text. LOGIFOLG uses a computer software process, such as computer-executable program code, to discover this implicit information. The steps in this process are: analyzing user's written input, up to five successive and non-successive words in a sequence, understanding the meaning of the written input, finding implicit information in the written input and finally, displaying the implicit information as a variant of the original sentence. The subject matter of the invention deals with Artificial Reasoning, namely inductive and deductive reasoning, based on Natural Language written sentences. The medium is non-transitory.

title: Moderation of user-generated content
description: A system and method for updating and correcting facts that receives proposed values for facts from users and determines a correctness score which is used to automatically accept or reject the proposed values.

title: Nonstandard locality-based text entry
description: A computer-implemented method of providing text entry assistance data includes receiving at a system location information associated with a user, receiving at the system information indicative of predictive textual outcomes, generating dictionary data using the location information, and providing the dictionary data to a remote device.

title: Mapping neural dynamics of a neural model on to a coarsely grained look-up table
description: Embodiments of the invention relate to mapping neural dynamics of a neural model on to a lookup table. One embodiment comprises defining a phase plane for a neural model. The phase plane represents neural dynamics of the neural model. The phase plane is coarsely sampled to obtain state transition information for multiple neuronal states. The state transition information is mapped on to a lookup table.

title: Iterative active feature extraction
description: Techniques for iterative feature extraction using domain knowledge are provided. In one aspect, a method for feature extraction is provided. The method includes the following steps. At least one query to predict at least one future value of a given value series based on a statistical model is received.
