description: Embodiments of this disclosure include a data processing method. In the method, a training sample set that includes a plurality of graph computing task training samples is obtained. At least one performance indicator feature of each of the graph computing task training samples is extracted. The at least one performance indicator feature includes one or more of a graph data feature, a graph processing platform feature, a graph algorithm feature, and a machine hardware feature. A target performance prediction model is generated based on a mapping relationship between actual execution times of the graph computing task training samples and the performance indicator features. According to at least one performance indicator feature of an inputted graph computing task test sample, a predicted execution time of the graph computing task test sample is output based on the target performance prediction model.

title: Storage medium, learning method, and information processing apparatus
description: A non-transitory computer-readable storage medium storing a program that causes a computer to execute a process, the process includes identifying, among combinations of any two pieces of image data included in a plurality of pieces of image data that satisfies a first condition, similarity between two pieces of image data in a combination in which one image data satisfies a second condition in addition to the first condition; identifying, based on the calculated similarity between the two pieces of image data, a score that becomes greater as the similarity increases; and performing, by using training data based on another image data in the combination and the score, machine learning.

title: Creating and Interacting with Data Records having Semantic Vectors and Natural Language Expressions Produced by a Machine-Trained Model
description: A computer-implemented technique uses a machine-trained model to convert input information provided by a user into a natural language expression and a semantic vector. The semantic vector provides a distributed representation of the natural language expression. The technique then uses the generated semantic vector to find a target data record having a target semantic vector that is within a prescribed distance to the generated semantic vector. The technique then outputs at least a target natural language expression that is associated with the target data record. The target data record is produced in an offline process that converts one or more attribute values in an existing structured data record into the target semantic vector and the target natural language expression. Also described herein is a technique for training the machine-trained model and for updating existing collections of data records using the machine-trained model.

title: Secure multi-party reach and frequency estimation
description: Systems and methods for generating min-increment counting bloom filters to determine count and frequency of device identifiers and attributes in a networking environment are disclosed. The system can maintain a set of data records including device identifiers and attributes associated with device in a network. The system can generate a vector comprising coordinates corresponding to counter registers. The system can identify hash functions to update a counting bloom filter. The system can hash the data records to extract index values pointing to a set of counter registers. The system can increment the positions in the min-increment counting bloom filter corresponding to the minimum values of the counter registers. The system can obtain an aggregated public key comprising a public key. The system can encrypt the counter registers using the aggregated shared key to generate an encrypted vector. The system can transmit the encrypted vector to a networked worker computing device.

title: Vibration control method and system for computer device
description: Techniques for controlling vibrations of a computing device is provided in the present disclosure. The techniques comprise obtaining a target audio file of a multimedia file; dividing the target audio file into a plurality of audio segments; determining a target audio segment among the plurality of audio segments based on detecting at least one feature associated with each of the plurality of audio segments; determining a target time period in a total time period of playing the multimedia file, the target time period corresponding to a playback of the target audio segment in the multimedia file; monitoring a current time point of playing the multimedia file; and controlling a vibration element in the computing device to perform a vibration operation when the current time point of playing the multimedia file is within the target time period.

title: Structural information preserving for graph-to-text generation
description: A method, computer program, and computer system for training a graph-to-text generation network is provided. Encoded graph information corresponding to a target sentence is received, and the encoded graph information is decoded based on a biaffine attention score. One or more loss values are determined based on the decoded information, whereby the text-to-graph generation network is trained by minimizing the one or more loss values. A first loss value is generated by reconstructing one or more triple relations based on the biaffine attention score, and a second loss value predicts the graph as a linearized sequence.

title: System and method for predicting and handling short-term overflow
description: A system for early predicting of impending data overflow situations in data networks, comprising one or more sensors being networked computers that do not provide services, for collecting monitored data regarding network traffic volume from content providers to an Internet Service Provider (ISP) entering or exiting the ISP via peering autonomous systems connected to the ISP via physical links; one or more processors executing one or more deep learning models, being adapted to: identify over the data network being handovers alternative peering links, which are not inherent Private Network Interconnects (PNI) between the content providers and the ISP; determine static or dynamic threshold for dataflow anomaly associated with overflow; for each alternative handover, predict impending overflow situation by applying ML algorithms to the collected data that corresponds to the each alternative handover.

title: Recommendation generation using one or more neural networks
description: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques are presented to generate recommendations for players of a game. In at least one embodiment, one or more neural networks are used to generate one or more recommendations for one or more players of a game based, at least in part, upon one or more cumulative changes of state in the game.

title: Method for identifying an unknown biological sample from multiple attributes
description: A method for identifying an unknown biological sample (e.g. a glycan, an antibody, a metabolite) is disclosed. The method comprises: receiving more than two sample measurements for the unknown biological sample, calculating a sample point in a two-dimensional plot from the more than two sample measurements for the unknown biological sample and identifying the unknown biological sample by comparing the sample point against the plurality of reference points in the two-dimensional plot. The two-dimensional plot includes a plurality of stored reference points corresponding to respective known biological compounds. Each reference point is calculated from a plurality of reference measurements for more than two attributes of the corresponding known biological compound (e.g. by performing principal component analysis on the plurality of reference measurements), with each attribute being different from another attribute. Each reference measurement may be obtained experimentally (e.g. by liquid chromatography, mass spectrometry, tandem mass spectrometry, ion mobility spectrometry) or by a machine learning algorithm.

title: Method to parameterize a 3d model
description: The present invention provides a method to produce a 3D model of a person or an object from just one or several image. The method uses a neural network that is trained on pairs of 3D models of human heads and their frontal images, and then, given an image, infers a 3D model.

title: System and method for focused crowdsourced information
description: A system and method for analyzing crowdsourced information to locate one or more informational signals.

title: Prediction or usage or compliance
description: Systems and methods have been developed to increase user compliance and adherence to various devices and services including respiratory therapy devices, exercise equipment, and online or other software services. For instance, in some examples the disclosed technology may monitor usage data output from a respiratory therapy device, exercise equipment or computer software program to determine, based on the trends of usage, when a user is likely to terminate or reduce usage within a specified time window. Flagging a user may also trigger further actions to automatically intervene before the user terminates engagement with the service.

title: Method, apparatus, and system for generating asynchronous learning rules and/architectures
description: An approach is provided for generating an asynchronous learning rules and/or architectures. The approach involves, for example, configuring an asynchronous machine learning agent to learn based on machine learning tasks. The asynchronous machine learning agent includes agent inputs for inputting task inputs of the machine learning tasks, agent outputs for outputting task outputs of the machine learning tasks, task feedback signals for scoring a performance on the one or more machine learning tasks, and a stateful neural units that are arbitrarily connected. The approach also comprises initiating a training of the asynchronous machine learning agent to learn an agent architecture, an agent learning rule, or a combination thereof based on the machine learning tasks. The approach further comprises configuring the stateful neural units based on the agent architecture, the agent learning rule, or a combination thereof to perform a subsequent machine learning task.

title: Artificial intelligence for automated stock orders based on standardized data and company financial data
description: A computer-implemented method comprising receiving user preference information, based on the received user preference information, determining one or more user settings, processing data to determine a data condition, wherein, to determine the data condition, a plurality of alternate data inputs of different types are processed and normalized, and applied to a series of operations to generate a forecast having a degree of confidence, and the data condition is compared with third party information; providing an electronic notification indicative of the data condition to the user device, wherein the electronic notification includes the data condition compared with the third party information, a confidence indicator associated with the data condition, and a user prompt; in response to a single user input, the user device generating an instruction to execute the user request; and based on the instruction, executing the user request based on the determined one or more user settings.

title: Tunable coupler with coupling extension
description: A tunable coupler for making a controllable coupling to at least a first qubit is disclosed. The tunable coupler includes a first constant coupling element and a tunable coupling element. The first constant coupling element forms a non-galvanic coupling interface to at least the first qubit at a first extremity that is distant from the tunable coupling element. The tunable coupling element is located adjacent to a non-galvanic coupling interface formed as an interface to a circuit element at a second extremity thereof.

title: Modelling timing behavior using augmented sensitivity data for physical parameters
description: A method for modelling timing behavior using augmented sensitivity data for physical parameters is disclosed. The method includes acquiring timing library data and sensitivity data for a physical parameter associated with a circuit design, generating a timing behavior model for the circuit design based on the timing library data and sensitivity data for the physical parameter, and storing the timing behavior model. The timing behavior model reduces a difference between a current known best measurement associated with the circuit design and a static timing analysis timing for the circuit design.

title: System and method for tracking detected objects
description: Systems and methods for tracking objects are disclosed herein. In one embodiment, a system having a processor merges features of detected objects extracted from a point cloud and a corresponding image to generate fused features for the detected objects, generates a learned distance metric for the detected objects using the fused features, determines matched detected objects and unmatched detected objects, applies prior tracking identifiers of the detected objects at the prior time to the matched detected objects, determines a confidence score for the fused features of the unmatched detected objects, and applies new tracking identifiers to the unmatched detected objects based on the confidence score.

title: Predictive system remediation
description: Techniques for predictive system remediation are disclosed. Based on attributes associated with applications of one or more system-selected remedial actions to one or more problematic system behaviors in a system (e.g., a database system), the system determines a predicted effectiveness of one or more future applications of a remedial action to a particular problematic system behavior, as of one or more future times. The system determines that the predicted effectiveness of the one or more future applications of the remedial action is positive but does not satisfy a performance criterion. Responsive to determining that the predicted effectiveness is positive but does not satisfy the performance criterion, the system generates a notification corresponding to the predicted effectiveness not satisfying the performance criterion. The system applies the remedial action to the particular problematic system behavior, despite already determining that the predicted effectiveness does not satisfy the one or more performance criteria.

title: Enhanced word embedding
description: Methods and systems for language processing include augmenting an original training dataset to produce an augmented dataset that includes a first example that includes a first scrambled replacement for a first word and a definition of the first word, and a second example that includes a second scrambled replacement for the first word and a definition of an alternative to the first word. A neural network classifier is trained using the augmented dataset.

title: Method of Neural Data Usage
description: The inventor has become aware of the fact that his neural data has been extracted, disseminated, collected and utilized without his consent nor knowledge. The inventor eventually became conscious to the fact that he had received a brain-computer interface (BCI) device with neither his knowledge nor his consent, and that the inventor's neural data was being used to program consciousness. The scope of the invention covers all intellectual property derived from the inventor's neural data. The inventor's neural data serves as a conduit for developing neural data computations and programs.

title: Methods for protecting pattern classification node from malicious requests and related networks and nodes
description: A method of operating a protection node for protecting a pattern classification node from malicious requests may be provided. The protection node may receive, from a user node, a request containing an original pattern to be classified by a machine learning algorithm performed by the pattern classification node. The protection node may add noise to the original pattern to generate a noisy pattern. The protection node may obtain a first classification of the noisy pattern based on processing of the noisy pattern by a first clone of the machine learning algorithm at the protection node; obtain a second classification of the original pattern based forwarding the request for processing of the original pattern by the machine learning algorithm performed at the pattern classification node; and compare the first and second classifications to determine whether the first and second classifications satisfy a defined similarity rule. The protection node may use the comparison to manage the request from the user node.

title: System and Method for Using an Artificial Intelligence Engine to Anonymize Competitive Performance Rankings in a Rehabilitation Setting
description: The present disclosure provides a method comprising the steps: receiving first patient data, wherein the first patient data includes at least a first patient identifier associated with the first patient and a first treatment plan including an exercise; receiving first measurement data, where the first measurement data is associated with a first performance data; receiving second measurement data, where the second measurement data is associated with at least one of a second performance data and a second patient identifier; one of anonymiztion of and pseudonymization of the second patient identifier; determining, via an artificial intelligence engine and based on one or more differences between the first and the second measurement data, differential data; and presenting, with a patient interface, at least one of the differential data, first measurement data, second measurement data, and the first patient data.

title: Neuromorphic device and unit synapse device forming the same
description: Disclosed are a neuromorphic device and a unit synapse devices forming the same. The unit synapse device has a learning device and an inference device. The learning device and the inference device may share a via oxide layer and a common electrode, and a learning operation and an inference operation may be performed in one unit synapse device.

title: Sample data generation device, sample data generation method, and sample data generation program
description: An acquisition unit (10) acquires normal sample data and abnormal sample data. A model generation unit (120) generates a normal model representing normal sample data. A change unit (141) generates an abnormal feature vector of the abnormal sample data, and generates an abnormal change vector obtained by changing an element of the abnormal feature vector. When the abnormal change vector and the normal model are similar, the verification unit (142) executes a process using the sample data represented by the abnormal change vector. Then, the verification unit (142) verifies whether the detection device detects an abnormal event. When it is verified that the abnormal event is not detected, the verification unit (142) determines whether there is an abnormal event regardless of the detection device. When determining that there is an abnormal event, the verification unit (142) stores the sample data represented by the abnormal change vector in the storage unit (150) as detection-missing sample data (154).

title: Pattern recognition system, parameter generation method and parameter generation program
description: The first parameter generation unit 811 uses the first learning data including the combination of the data to be recognized, the correct label of the data, and the domain information indicating the collection environment of the data of the first recognizer. Generate the first parameter, which is a parameter. The second parameter generation unit 812 includes a combination of the data to be recognized collected in the predetermined collection environment, the correct answer label of the data, and the target domain information indicating the predetermined collection environment based on the first parameter. The second training data is used to generate a second parameter, which is a parameter of the second recognizer. The third parameter generation unit 813 integrates the first parameter and the second parameter, and generates the third parameter used for pattern recognition of the input data by learning using the first learning data.

title: An interactive system and method for regionalized vehicle cooperative early warning and risk avoidance
description: An interactive system and method for regional vehicle collaborative early warning danger avoidance belongs to the technical field of multi-vehicle collaboration and vehicle danger avoidance scheduling. The invention solves the problem that the prior method can not carry out early warning on the chain rear-end collision. The invention judges the speed condition before running to ensure the safety monitoring under the normal running state of the vehicle. The method combines the judgment condition of whether the front rear-end vehicle is in the system, selects different early warning avoidance schemes according to different conditions, and has self-adaptability. And a feedback link is added, after the time length is fed back in a limited way, the coordinates of the vehicles in the dangerous state and the vehicles which are not fed back are integrated, a certain early warning range is defined, the information of the dangerous vehicles is sent to the vehicles within the range again, and the occurrence of the accidental rear-end collision is further avoided. The invention can be used for early warning of the chain rear-end collision of the vehicle.

title: An Intelligent Fast Interframe Coding Method
description: The invention discloses an intelligent rapid interframe coding method, which comprises the following steps: considering the division of the coding units as a two-classification problem, designing a multi-information fusion convolutional neural network model as a classifier, and realizing the early termination of the division of the coding units; the texture information and the motion information of the coding unit are used as the input of a classifier, and the input features are obtained through an asymmetric convolution kernel feature extraction module respectively; then, a feature fusion module based on attention is used for obtaining fused features, and finally a classification module is used for obtaining a classification result according to the fused features; and realizing early Merge mode decision by taking the motion information of the coding unit and the confidence coefficient output by the multi-information fusion network as conditions. The invention shortens the interframe coding time as much as possible under the condition of unchanged quality of the compressed video, and effectively reduces the interframe coding complexity by fully utilizing the information of the space domain, the time domain and the motion field by means of the characteristic extraction and analysis capability of deep learning.

title: Method for determining stereotactic brain targets
description: The invention relates to a method for determining stereotactic brain targets, comprising at least one target point, comprising the steps of-selecting patients whose measured result at the at least one target point is greater than or equal to a threshold value after treatment, post-operatively imaging each of said patients, -processing said post-operative imaging to determine the coordinates of said at least one target point, -selecting brain marker points, -processing said post-operative imaging to determine the coordinates of said marker points, -creating a learning database comprising the coordinates of the target points and the coordinates of the marker points determined for all selected patients, -determining a prediction function giving the coordinates of the at least one target point from the coordinates of the marker points by using said learning database and a supervised statistical learning method, -processing pre-operative imaging of a new patient to be treated to determine the coordinates of the marker points of said new patient, -utilizing said prediction function to obtain the coordinates of the at least one target point of said new patient from the coordinates of the marker points determined for said new patient.

title: A service recommendation method and system based on transfer learning
description: The present invention relates to a service recommendation method and system based on migration learning, including: S1, establishing a data set: collecting relevant data, filtering valid data, and establishing a data set; S2, service semantic modeling: extracting different information in the data set The geographical location information in the data is clustered and analyzed, and the appropriate proportion is used as a feature to integrate into the original information to perform service semantic modeling; S3, transfer learning: combine cross-domain prior information and service semantic modeling information. Refine it; S4, data fusion matrix decomposition: After obtaining the correction coefficient, determine the hidden factors of the user-topic matrix and topic-service matrix, and perform different weight decay techniques on the hidden factors determined in advance, and use ADAM optimizer to combat overfitting; S5, perform service recommendation to the user. The present invention is used to provide stable service recommendation quality in a complex environment, and can also provide users with a good service experience in a hot-start environment.

title: Method and Device for Remote Supervision Relation Extraction Based on Consistent Text Enhancement
description: The invention provides a remote supervision relation extraction method and a device based on consistency text enhancement, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing the multiple sentence instances according to the entity pairs and the relationship labels to obtain multiple sentence sub-packets; adopting different text enhancement methods for each sentence instance in each sentence sub-packet to obtain a strong enhancement sample and a weak enhancement sample corresponding to each sentence instance in each sentence sub-packet; determining a noise sample, and training the relation prediction model through a non-relation sentence sample, a strong enhancement sample and a weak enhancement sample of the noise sample to obtain a trained relation prediction model; and predicting the sentence packet to be predicted by using the trained relation prediction model to obtain the corresponding relation label. By the method and the device, the scale of the data set can be increased through consistent text enhancement, the generalization learning capability of the model is enhanced, and the 'NA' type and noise sample constraint model is enabled to learn more supervision information.

title: A method, system and device for image fine-grained classification
description: The application discloses a method, a system and equipment for classifying fine granularity of images, wherein the method comprises the following steps: firstly, preprocessing and normalizing the image, and then inputting the image into a convolutional neural network for feature extraction, so that the traditional image space feature and the feature of an image channel are considered, and the effect of fine-grained image classification is improved; then, a proportional relation among different channels is obtained through a SENET module, and more subtle discriminant areas of the image can be identified; a clustering method of metric learning is adopted to find a plurality of attention areas in one image, so that the local features of the same category in the image are further shortened, and the local features of different categories are further lengthened; and finally, continuously training the image classification model until the loss function is converged to obtain the optimal image classification model, so as to classify the image through the model, thereby solving the technical problem of poor accuracy of fine-grained classification of the image in the prior art.

title: Bank card application wind control method and device, electronic equipment and medium
description: The present disclosure provides a bank card application risk control method based on voiceprint recognition, a bank card application risk control device, an electronic device, a computer-readable storage medium, and a computer program. The bank card application risk control method and device can be used in the field of artificial intelligence technology. The bank card application risk control method includes: receiving a user's bank card application request; when the user applies for a bank card, obtaining the user's first voiceprint information; when investigating the user, obtaining the user's second voiceprint information; determining a first similarity between the first voiceprint information and the second voiceprint information; when the first similarity is greater than a first threshold, determining a second similarity between the second voiceprint information and a black voiceprint in a black voiceprint library; and when the second similarity is greater than a second threshold, storing the first voiceprint information and/or the second voiceprint information in the black voiceprint library.

title: An Image Classification Method Based on DW-Tempotron Algorithm
description: The invention discloses an image classification method based on a DW-Tempotron algorithm, which comprises the following steps: obtaining a DW-Tempotron algorithm on the basis of the Tempotron algorithm; initializing parameters of a DW-Tempotron algorithm; acquiring membrane voltage of the postsynaptic neuron in a + mode and membrane voltage of the-mode respectively; training and updating delay and synapse weights; judging whether the training round reaches the iteration number, if so, adopting the current DW-Tempotron algorithm to classify the images; otherwise, continuing training. According to the DW-Tempotron algorithm, the time of input pulses is adjusted, so that the ignition time of the postsynaptic neurons is directly influenced, and the learning efficiency is improved.

title: Computing device, method, board and computer readable storage medium
description: The present disclosure discloses computing devices, integrated circuit boards, methods, and computer-readable storage media for processing multi-bit wide values, wherein the computing devices may be included in a combined processing device that may also include a universal interconnect interface and other processing devices. The computing device interacts with other processing devices to jointly complete the computing operation designated by the user. The combined processing means may further comprise storage means connected to the device and the other processing means, respectively, for storing data of the device and the other processing means. The scheme of the disclosure can split the multi-bit width value so that the processing capacity of the processor is not affected by the bit width.

title: A joint estimation method of monocular depth and pose based on epipolar geometry
description: The invention discloses a monocular depth and pose joint estimation method based on epipolar geometry, and belongs to the field of three-dimensional vision. The method comprises two parts of depth estimation and pose estimation. The depth estimation module is a convolution network model combined with an attention mechanism; in the pose estimation process, dense optical flows are used, accurate matching point pairs are screened out, and the pose is solved based on epipolar geometry; the pose is then used for training of the supervised depth estimation network. The invention designs 3 sampling masks to eliminate occlusion and mismatching of dynamic objects, and screens more accurate matching for subsequent pose solving. The use of the attention mechanism in the depth estimation network improves the depth estimation accuracy and optimizes the problem of boundary ambiguity in the depth map. According to the method, the depth network and the traditional geometric pose solving method are combined, the obtained monocular depth and pose combined estimation model has high precision and generalization capability, and more advanced depth estimation and pose estimation results are obtained in the open source data set.

title: A method and system for generating facial animation based on multimodal correlation
description: The invention discloses a face animation generation method and a face animation generation system based on multi-modal correlation, and firstly, a face animation generation neural network framework based on multi-modal correlation is provided; on the network structure, firstly, a multi-Transformer structure is provided for modeling the correlation of a voice mode, an image mode and a voice/image cross-mode in a voice-driven face animation generation task, and the face expression characteristics corresponding to the driving voice are calculated based on the correlation, so that the reality and the fluency of the generated face animation are improved. On the basis of a network structure, a source video is innovatively introduced into a training process, and a more accurate expression prediction result of a driving voice can be achieved. In addition, the method driven by the single voice mode can only generate a better animation result on the lips, and the reality of other face regions except the lip region can be improved by introducing the source video, so that a more vivid human face animation result is generated.

title: Method and system for measuring and calculating core temperature inside battery on line based on charge and discharge data
description: The application discloses a method and a system for measuring and calculating the internal core temperature of a battery on line based on charge and discharge data. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of detection items for determining the core temperature of a battery to be detected, obtaining a first measurement value corresponding to the detection item obtained by detecting the battery to be detected at the current sampling moment, and obtaining a second measurement value corresponding to the detection item obtained by detecting the battery to be detected at the last sampling moment; and acquiring a linear neural network model for measuring and calculating the core temperature of the battery to be measured, and inputting the detection item, the first measurement value and the second measurement value into the linear neural network model so that the linear neural network model can measure and calculate the target core temperature of the battery to be measured at the current sampling moment. According to the method and the device, the neural network model is constructed based on the linear relation between the detection items and the core temperature, and the weight corresponding to each detection item is directly determined through the model, so that the core temperature of the battery can be rapidly measured and calculated, and meanwhile, the accuracy of the measurement and calculation and the core temperature is guaranteed.

title: A kind of fitness action recognition monitoring method and system
description: The invention discloses a fitness action recognition monitoring method and system, comprising the steps of: S1, constructing a standard action image library, constructing a standard image library of all fitness actions based on the fitness actions of trainers; The front view image and side view image are analyzed for the influence degree of some actions; S3, the standard action image library correction, the action influence degree is obtained through the body shape parameters of the students, the standard action judgment range is corrected, and the time optimization factor is added. Based on the student body shape evaluation module described in the present application, the present invention can obtain the relationship between the body shape difference of the students and the degree of influence of the movements. Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effect is that it takes into account the early stage of the students' fitness, and the difference in the body shape causes the fitness movement. Action difference size.

title: Mobile application recommendation method based on lightweight graph convolutional network
description: The present invention discloses a mobile application recommendation method based on lightweight graph convolution network. First, a bipartite graph is used to model the interactive relationship between the APP and the user, and high-order connectivity (tree diagram) is used for initial embedding; then, In the lightweight graph convolution layer, embedding propagation is used to capture collaborative filtering signals along the graph structure to further refine the embedding of mobile applications and users; finally, user preferences for different mobile applications are predicted through inner products to complete the recommendation task. The invention belongs to the technical field of mobile applications, and specifically refers to a mobile application recommendation method based on lightweight graph convolution network.

title: Method for reducing weighted training bias by applying weight correction in machine learning
description: The present invention develops a method for reducing weighted training bias by applying weight correction in machine learning, the method comprising the following steps: S1. Marking the number of samples of each group: Calculate the number of samples of each group in the training data N  i  , where i is the label assigned to the group; S2. Calculate the average weight of the samples in each group: In a certain group i of the training data, add up the weight w  ij  of each sample j, then divide it by N  i  , and mark the average weight w  i  of the group i; S3. Use a machine learning algorithm to perform classification regression on the features of the samples in the training data and their corresponding labels; S4. Calculate the probability P  w  (i) of the group i by the machine learning classifier, and correct it by applying the weight correction formula to obtain the corrected probability P (i); S5. Use the corrected probability P (i) to make the final classification decision. This method can improve the accuracy of the classifier in assigning probabilities to new data in machine learning applications.

title: Evaluation method of rolling bearing operating status based on EEMD energy entropy
description: The invention relates to a rolling bearing running state evaluation method based on EEMD energy entropy, which comprises the following steps: collecting bearing life vibration data; calculating to obtain a full-life time domain characteristic value of the bearing; decomposing bearing vibration signals in different time periods into modal components, and calculating EEMD energy entropy; calculating to obtain comprehensive index values of the whole service life of the bearing; constructing a data set by using the time domain characteristic value, the modal component energy entropy and the comprehensive index value; training a bearing life prediction model by utilizing a data set and a chaotic particle swarm algorithm, and determining optimal parameters; and collecting vibration signals of the bearing to be detected, calculating a time domain characteristic value and a modal component energy entropy, inputting a bearing life prediction model, and evaluating the running state of the bearing to be detected according to the comprehensive index value output by the model. According to the method, the comprehensive index value is extracted by utilizing the time domain index and the time-frequency domain characteristic index, and the optimal model parameters are searched and determined by utilizing the chaotic particle swarm algorithm, so that the bearing life prediction model with high prediction precision is obtained.

title: Data processing method, electronic device and storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide methods, apparatus, and storage media for data processing, relating to the field of artificial intelligence. The data processing method includes the steps that data processing equipment obtains a Cronecker factor matrix used for indicating a high-order information matrix of a neural network model, the Cronecker factor matrix is segmented to obtain a plurality of square matrixes, the segmented square matrixes are submatrices of the Cronecker factor matrix, main diagonal lines of the square matrixes are corresponding to part of main diagonal lines of the Cronecker factor matrix one by one, and parameters of the neural network model are adjusted based on the obtained square matrixes. In this way, adjusting parameters of the neural network model based on the cut-out square matrix, rather than directly based on the kronecker factor matrix, can reduce the time cost required to train the model.

title: Privacy protection method and device for monitoring video image
description: The present invention discloses a privacy protection method and device for monitoring video images. The method comprises: generating a first generated image and a second generated image according to a monitoring original image and a style image; forming a first loop link by the monitoring original image, the style image, the original style transfer model, the first generated image, the style original transfer model and the third generated image, and forming a second loop link according to the style image, the monitoring original image, the style original transfer model, the second generated image, the original style transfer model and the fourth generated image; adjusting the loss function of the original style transfer model, the loss function of the style original transfer model, the loss function of the first loop link and the loss function of the second loop link in the initial monitoring privacy protection model to form a stable monitoring privacy protection model. According to the stable monitoring privacy protection model, the monitoring original image is converted into a privacy protection image.

title: Self-adaptive resource scheduling method based on improved ant colony algorithm
description: The present invention relates to an adaptive resource scheduling method based on an improved ant colony algorithm. In view of the current situation that the passive wideband phased array radar system has wide frequency domain and airspace coverage, large resource consumption, and great difficulty in resource scheduling, the present invention is based on combining the characteristics of the ant cycle model and the ant density model in the ant colony algorithm, using the residence time for the frequency domain and airspace in different scheduling strategies as the ant colony route, and using the scheduling time as the pheromone concentration judgment standard to perform adaptive adjustment of the route, and combining the feedback mechanism of multi-level resource scheduling to realize adaptive scheduling of the radar system. The present invention uses a multi-iteration ant colony system as an improvement on the basic ant colony algorithm, and applies it to a passive wideband phased array radar system that lacks prior knowledge, overcoming the shortcoming of low flexibility of the fixed template scheduling algorithm in conventional scheduling, and improving the resource utilization rate of the passive wideband phased array radar system. The invention has good versatility and practicality.

title: Combined hit target self-adaptive scoring and associated recommendation method and system
description: The invention provides a combined hit target self-adaptive scoring and associated recommending method, a system and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target entity relationship data; constructing a target knowledge graph super network; generating an initial inference vector of the knowledge graph; optimizing an initial inference vector of the knowledge graph; complement the target knowledge graph; and carrying out associated recommendation of the fire power hitting targets. According to the invention, a knowledge graph reasoning technology is introduced into the construction of a combined fire hit target system, so that the automatic link of the target association relationship is realized; establishing a emergence assessment index model in a complex super-network system, and realizing the measurement of the emergence value of the hit target super-network; the associated recommendation and the optimal recommendation of the preferred hit targets of the commander are realized, and the intelligent level of the auxiliary decision is improved.

title: Priori semantic knowledge guided high-resolution remote sensing image weak supervision building change detection method
description: The invention provides a priori semantic knowledge guided high-resolution remote sensing image weak supervision building change detection method, which utilizes high-resolution remote sensing images to perform building automatic change detection, firstly adopts a building extraction algorithm integrating domain self-adaption and weak supervision strategies to generate priori semantic knowledge, and fully utilizes the domain self-adaption and weak supervision strategies to furthest improve the domain expansion capability of the priori knowledge and reduce the number and difficulty of sample dataset production. And then designing a priori semantic knowledge guided high-resolution remote sensing image weak supervision building change detection network, taking intermediate results of all stages of a building extraction network as priori knowledge, reducing dependence of the network on change detection sample data to the greatest extent, and improving the effect of building change detection.

title: Image steganography method based on hierarchical adversarial learning
description: The invention provides an image steganography method based on hierarchical antagonism, which comprises the steps of constructing a hierarchical antagonism learning network, training the hierarchical antagonism learning network, steganography data, displaying network training and displaying secret data. The invention captures the representation capability of the layers through a remodelling net and an authentication layer in each unit, and updates the weight of each layer by using the representation capability and the weight of the same discriminator, thereby having good information hiding and information recovering capabilities. When the weight of the same identification layer is updated, the position information of the visual watermark is ensured to be unchanged, and the problem of changing the appearance of the container image is avoided. The invention can reduce the complexity of the network, and whether the image contains secret information can not influence the effectiveness of the identifier network in identifying the image.

title: Nuclear power plant pavement crack rate calculation method based on gridding
description: The invention discloses a nuclear power plant pavement crack rate calculation method based on gridding, which comprises the steps of carrying out gridding on an acquired nuclear power plant pavement crack image, aligning a crack detection frame generated by using a deep learning target detection model with a grid boundary, counting the number of grids containing cracks in the detection frame, and calculating the plant pavement crack rate.

title: Electronic device, method and computer program supporting naming
description: The present invention provides a naming support system, comprising a processing unit configured to receive first-language name information input by a user, determine basic name evaluation information related to the first-language name information, generate name evaluation information based on the basic name evaluation information in a target language including at least one of a plurality of languages, and transmit the information to an output unit. The first-language name information includes at least one of character notation information of the first-language name, pronunciation information of the first-language name, or information related to desired items of the first-language name, and the basic name evaluation information includes the first-language name information.

title: Troubleshooting method, device, equipment and storage medium for power communication network
description: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for troubleshooting a power communication network, comprising the following steps: preprocessing the original alarm information, selecting the most relevant data characteristics for fault diagnosis, and performing weighted coding to form an alarm transaction database; marking the alarm information with a corresponding fault site label and forming a training set, and processing the training set based on a deep belief network to complete fault positioning of the power communication network; a weighted FP-Growth communication network fault parallel mining method based on Spark frame distributes alarm information to different nodes in the Spark frame, and after WFPS algorithm is used for mining alarm frequent items in parallel, alarm association rules are obtained according to the principle of whether minimum confidence threshold is met or not, and after analysis of the alarm association rules, fault positioning overhaul is realized. The method and the device can effectively extract important information related to feature diagnosis, eliminate uncertainty and realize rapid fault maintenance of the power communication network.

title: Method and device for determining depth filter
description: A method for determining a depth filter comprising the steps of receiving a mixture, estimating the depth filter using a depth neural network, wherein the estimation is performed such that the depth filter, when applied to elements of the mixture, obtains an estimate of each element of a desired representation, wherein the depth filter having at least one dimension comprises a tensor having the elements.

title: Three-dimensional model display method, computer-readable storage medium and electronic device
description: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a three-dimensional model display method, a computer-readable storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: determining a viewing angle to be displayed of the target three-dimensional model; acquiring a first model image of a target three-dimensional model under a reference view angle; determining first view angle difference information of a view angle to be displayed and a reference view angle; generating a second model image of the target three-dimensional model under the view angle to be displayed through an image generating network according to the first model image and the first view angle difference information; a second model image is shown. The embodiment of the disclosure can reduce the amount of image data which needs to be stored in advance, thereby saving the storage space.

title: A breast ultrasound segmentation method based on feature set correlation
description: The present invention provides a breast ultrasound segmentation method based on feature set correlation, which belongs to the field of image segmentation. The present invention first uses morphological attribute profiles (AP) to reconstruct attribute refinement and attribute coarsening of ultrasound images to eliminate noise and extract spatial structural features. Then, the feature set extracted by the model is constrained by correlation with the empirical feature set to guide the training of the model. CoNet has achieved good results in the segmentation of tumor lesions in breast ultrasound images, and the IOU has reached 87.1% and the F1 value has reached 89.9% on the public data set BUSI.

title: A method and system for predicting subway passenger flow
description: The present invention provides a method and system for predicting subway passenger flow, which relates to the technical field of passenger flow prediction, including: continuously collecting real-time passenger flow and at least one environmental data of at least one subway station to be predicted within a preset time period, so as to obtain passenger flow time series data and environmental time series data bound to an identity code of the subway station to be predicted; according to the collection time of each real-time passenger flow and environmental data, the passenger flow time series data and environmental time series data corresponding to the identity code are associated to obtain a multi-dimensional time series data; according to at least one preset feature engineering model, feature engineering is performed on the multi-dimensional time series data to obtain corresponding quantized time series data; the quantized time series data corresponding to the identity code is input into a pre-trained multiple time series prediction model to predict the predicted passenger flow of the subway station to be predicted corresponding to the identity code in a future time period. The beneficial effect is that a more accurate predicted passenger flow can be obtained while greatly saving computing power overhead.

title: Techniques for extracting machine-readable information from P & ID
description: In an example embodiment, a technique is provided for using machine learning to extract machine-readable tags for text boxes and symbols in a P&ID (Portable & Found) in image-only format. The P&ID data extraction application uses an Optical Character Recognition (OCR) algorithm to predict tags for text boxes in the P&ID. The P&ID data extraction application uses a first machine learning algorithm to detect symbols in the P&ID and returns a predicted bounding box and a predicted class of equipment for each symbol. One or more of the predicted bounding boxes can be extracted using non-maximum suppression to avoid overlapping detection. The P&ID data extraction application uses a second machine learning algorithm to infer attributes for each detected symbol with remaining predicted bounding boxes. The P&ID data extraction application stores the predicted bounding boxes and tags, including the predicted class of equipment and inferred attributes, in a machine-readable format.

title: An image-text matching method based on multi-relational perceptual reasoning
description: Aiming at the image-text matching task, the present invention designs an image-text matching method based on multi-relational perceptual reasoning, involving two fields of computer vision and natural language processing. Fully mining the features of visual and text modalities, and aligning the features of different modalities is the key to overcoming the difficulty of image-text matching tasks. Reasonable use of the graph convolutional neural network is conducive to improving the performance of the model. Based on the graph convolutional neural network, the present invention designs a multi-relationship perception reasoning module for images, pays attention to the semantic relationship and spatial position relationship of the image, and extracts richer The visual feature representation achieves better alignment with the text semantic information; combined with the BERT-GRU-based text encoder, it can fully express the deep semantic information of the sentence and achieve a good alignment with the visual representation of the image. The invention has certain significance in practical applications such as automatic image-text mutual retrieval, children's intelligence education and assistance to visually impaired persons.

title: Feature selection method and device, model training method and device, equipment and medium
description: The disclosure provides a computer-implemented feature selection method and device, a model training method and device, equipment and medium, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of big data. The method includes the steps of determining a weight coefficient and a correlation coefficient of each feature of a plurality of features of an object to be processed, wherein the weight coefficient of each feature is determined according to the correlation degree of the feature and a task to be processed, the correlation coefficient of each feature is determined according to the correlation between the feature and other features, and determining a selected feature for executing the task to be processed in the plurality of features based on the weight coefficient and the correlation coefficient of each feature of the plurality of features.

title: Heat exchange station heat load short-term prediction method and prediction system based on deep learning
description: The invention provides a heat exchange station heat load short-term prediction method and a prediction system based on deep learning, wherein the prediction method comprises the following steps: constructing a real data set and a simulation data set of working condition operation; extracting features in each dataset by using a CNN convolutional neural network, and inputting the features into an improved LSTM prediction model for training; and correcting the predicted result of the real data by using the predicted result of the analog data to obtain a final result. According to the scheme, a comparison data set is established by combining a real operation history data set and building energy consumption simulation data, then features are extracted by using CNN convolutional neural networks respectively, the features are input into an improved LSTM prediction model respectively for training, then two prediction models trained by the real data and the simulation data are used for predicting a current value, and finally a correction system corrects the two output results to obtain a final predicted value. The whole method improves the accuracy of the whole prediction method.

title: Robust power control method and system for uncertain channel state information of Internet of vehicles
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication, and discloses a robust power control method and a system for uncertain channel state information of the Internet of vehicles, wherein the robust power control method for uncertain channel state information of the Internet of vehicles comprises the following steps: the base station firstly needs to sample the uncertain channel state information on the vehicle-vehicle link and learns the first moment and the second moment of the uncertain channel state information according to the sampling result; constructing a robust equivalent vehicle-to-vehicle link convex constraint condition according to the learned moment information to equivalently replace a probability constraint condition which is difficult to solve before; according to the obtained robust peer-to-peer, invoking a dichotomy to solve the transmitting power of the vehicle-base station link and the vehicle-vehicle link; and then carrying out feasibility verification on the obtained transmitting power, and outputting a verified result. The invention has the capability of deployment under different scenes, and is easy to be used together with other subcarrier allocation schemes, so that the invention has good compatibility.

title: Pedestrian detection method, device, equipment and medium
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a pedestrian detection method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a target image to be detected; inputting the target image into a preset detection network model, wherein the preset detection network model is used for determining a preset distribution parameter value corresponding to each pedestrian in the target image, the preset distribution parameter value corresponds to a two-dimensional probability distribution map, the probability distribution boundary of the two-dimensional probability distribution map is a whole body frame of the corresponding pedestrian, the probability peak value of the two-dimensional probability distribution map is positioned at the center of the visible frame of the corresponding pedestrian, and the pedestrian detection result corresponding to the target image is determined according to the output of the preset detection network model. By the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the problem of misclassification caused by shielding can be solved, and the accuracy of pedestrian detection is improved.

title: Image recognition method with integrated storage and computing and low power consumption
description: The system and the method for the integrated image recognition with the integrated memory and calculation and the low power consumption comprise a low power consumption camera, an integrated memory and calculation chip, a low power consumption output module, a low power consumption communication module, a battery and a power supply circuit, and the system fully utilizes the low power consumption and high energy efficiency characteristics of the integrated memory and calculation chip to perform the image recognition deep neural network reasoning calculation, so that the requirements of the integrated application with the low power consumption and the small size can be fully met.

title: Monitoring protection method for diesel generator access
description: The present invention provides a monitoring and protection method for diesel generator access, comprising the following steps: collecting basic data of the diesel generator in operation, establishing a first evaluation index, conducting a subjective and objective evaluation on the first evaluation index, and obtaining a comprehensive weight of the first evaluation index; collecting basic data of multiple loads in operation, establishing a second evaluation index, conducting a subjective and objective evaluation on the second evaluation index, and obtaining a comprehensive weight of the second evaluation index; constructing a first neural evaluation network, evaluating the overall power quality of a power supply branch network connected to the diesel generator based on the second evaluation index, and outputting a first adjustment parameter; establishing a second neural evaluation network, evaluating the power quality of the diesel generator based on the first evaluation index, and outputting a second adjustment parameter based on the evaluation result.

title: Data operation method, data operation device and data processor
description: The invention provides a data operation method, a data operation device and a data processor. The data operation method comprises the steps of receiving a data flushing instruction, determining a flushing target domain, wherein the data flushing instruction at least comprises a first field representing the flushing target domain and a second field representing a target data type, executing flushing operation on the flushing target domain according to the data flushing instruction, and providing target data in the flushing target domain to the flushing target domain, wherein the target data comprises object data which accords with the target data type in at least one item of object data in the flushing target domain. The data operation method can adaptively provide the object data meeting the target data type in the flushing target domain, but not provide all data, especially non-target data, out of the flushing target domain, so that the phenomenon of over-killing of the artificial intelligent processor is reduced or avoided, and the performance loss caused by excessively frequent flushing operation is slowed down.

title: False information detection method, device, equipment and medium
description: The disclosure provides a false information detection method, which comprises the steps of obtaining social media information to be detected, wherein the social media information to be detected comprises an image to be detected and a first text to be detected, extracting text feature vectors to be detected from the first text to be detected and the second text to be detected under the condition that the image to be detected contains the second text to be detected, extracting image feature vectors to be detected from the image to be detected by combining semantic features in a space domain and physical features in a frequency domain, fusing the text feature vectors to be detected and the image feature vectors to be detected to obtain fusion feature vectors to be detected, inputting the fusion feature vectors to be detected into a pre-trained classification model, and outputting detection results. The present disclosure also provides a false information detection apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product.

title: Deep learning channel estimation method based on self-attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses a deep learning channel estimation method based on a self-attention mechanism under a multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency division multiplexing system. The feature is to utilize the correlation between time-frequency domain channel impulse responses and use self-attention. The mechanism module can effectively extract channel feature information, thereby constructing a globally dependent feature map. Using deep learning methods, it can deeply learn the correlation between time-frequency domain channel impulse responses. Compared with the channel estimation results of existing multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency division multiplexing systems, the channel estimation results have an ideal improvement in accuracy.

title: Geological hidden trouble point monitoring method and system considering heavy rainfall disaster
description: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power disaster prevention and reduction, in particular to a geological hidden trouble point monitoring method and a geological hidden trouble point monitoring system considering heavy rainfall disasters. The method and the system creatively realize the function of alarming the influence level of the geological disaster, overcome the difficult problems that the geological disaster is difficult to scientifically calculate and visually display and is induced by heavy rainfall to influence the power transmission and distribution facilities, accurately reflect the monitoring data such as the displacement, the inclination angle and the like of the power transmission and distribution facilities, and support the production monitoring command center to guide the development of emergency works such as load transfer, facility reinforcement, power repair and the like.

title: Methods, apparatus, equipment and storage media for neural network training and object detection
description: The disclosure provides a neural network training method, a neural network training device, a neural network target detection device, a neural network training device and a neural network training storage medium, wherein the neural network training device comprises a first neural network, a second neural network and an image generation network, wherein the first neural network is acquired in an upstream task, the first neural network is to be trained in a downstream task, and the second neural network is obtained based on the training of the first image sample; the second neural network is used for extracting features, the image generation network is used for generating a new image, and the new image accords with the overall distribution of the first image sample; extracting features of a new image generated based on the image generation network according to the second neural network obtained through training and the first neural network to be trained respectively; training the first neural network to be trained based on the extracted first image features and the second image features to obtain a trained first neural network. The training method and the training device can better guide the training of the first neural network through the two image features, so that the performance of downstream tasks is improved.

title: A Reservoir Production Prediction Method Based on Graph Wavelet Neural Network Model
description: The invention discloses an oil reservoir production prediction method based on a graph wavelet neural network model, belonging to the technical field of oil reservoir development. The output of each production well under the system, build a sample database, and divide the training set and test set; build a graph wavelet neural network model; optimize the hyperparameters of the graph wavelet neural network model, and train the constructed graph wavelet neural network model; verification training The performance of the completed graph wavelet neural network model; output the graph wavelet neural network model that has been trained and has good evaluation performance, collect reservoir production data in real time through monitoring equipment set up in the oilfield block, input the model, and predict the change of reservoir production in real time. The invention can realize the prediction of the oil production and water production of production wells in oil reservoir production with similar precision and greatly improved speed.

title: Signal lamp time domain state detection method, model training method and related device
description: The present invention discloses a method for detecting the temporal state of a signal light, a model training method, and related devices. The method comprises: acquiring an image sequence, the image sequence comprising at least two consecutive frames containing a signal light; inputting the images in the image sequence into a signal light temporal state detection model in chronological order to obtain the signal light's temporal state. This method can identify temporal changes in signal light information and improve detection accuracy.

title: Fire evacuation path planning method based on deep learning and hybrid genetic algorithm
description: The present application relates to a fire evacuation path planning method based on deep learning and hybrid genetic algorithm, including: when a fire is determined in a target area according to a video of real-time fire monitoring, obtaining tracking information corresponding to the evacuation target in the target area, the tracking information includes crowd information and target position information; obtaining node information corresponding to multiple spatial nodes outside the target area, generating an evacuable path corresponding to the evacuation target, and the spatial node is used to characterize the area passed by the evacuation target when evacuating; determining an evacuation optimization label based on crowd information, target position information and evacuable path; using a hybrid genetic algorithm and evacuation optimization label to process the evacuable path, obtain an alternative evacuation path corresponding to each evacuation target, and determine the evacuation path planning result according to whether the alternative evacuation path is blocked. Through this application, the problem of slow evacuation speed and low evacuation efficiency of the fire evacuation path planned in the related art is solved.

title: Data security grading classification method based on deep learning
description: The present invention provides a data security grading and classification method based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of data security grading and classification, and includes the following steps: 1: collecting business data, obtaining multiple groups of security data flow direction sequence combinations, and grading and marking; 2: extracting the security data flow direction sequence combination features; 3: building a data security grading mature model based on deep learning; 4: using the data security grading model to perform real-time dynamic monitoring of the internal and external data flows occurring in the business information system, extracting complete/incomplete dynamic data information flow sequence groups for classification, and forming data security grading results of A core data, B important data, and C general data, until this group of operation behaviors ends. Through the method provided by the present invention, the automatic grading of business information system data can be realized, and real-time grading and classification scenarios can be performed on massive data with a large number of data categories in real time, thereby improving the work efficiency of data administrators.

title: Integrated memory chip and method based on neural network weight matrix scaling control
description: The invention provides a memory calculation integrated chip and a memory calculation integrated method based on a neural network weight matrix scaling control, comprising an input signal conversion circuit module, a memory calculation unit array module, a scaling control circuit module and an output signal conversion circuit module, wherein the neural network weight matrix pre-stored in the memory calculation unit array module is obtained by integrally scaling part of columns for an original neural network weight matrix, the scaling control circuit module comprises a plurality of scaling control branches, the output end of each column of memory calculation units is connected with one scaling control branch, and the scaling control branches are used for scaling control on the calculation result output by each column of memory calculation units, so that the calculation result after the scaling control is restored by adopting an analog circuit in an analog domain, the operation amount for restoring in a digital domain is reduced, the ADC circuit scale is reduced, and the scaling control chip is beneficial to miniaturization and integration.

title: Adhesive product production fault monitoring method based on image processing technology
description: The invention discloses a production fault monitoring method for adhesive products based on image processing technology, which relates to the technical field of image data processing or generation. The technical problem solved is the production fault diagnosis of adhesive products, which includes the following steps: Step 1, extracting through an image acquisition method The characteristics of the production information of the adhesive products, and the data format processing and image information processing are performed on the collected data information to improve the quality of the obtained image information, and the extracted data information is divided; step 2, through the failure analysis method to realize the glue Analysis of failures in the production process of products; combined with the types and types of failures in the production process of adhesive products; Step 3: Analyze and display the production failure data of adhesive products through a visual display module to display the analyzed data information. The invention improves the production fault monitoring capability of the adhesive product through the image recognition technology, has a high degree of automation and a strong monitoring capability.

title: Cooperative processing method for unmanned aerial vehicle multitasking execution resource limitation
description: The invention discloses a cooperative processing method for unmanned aerial vehicle multitasking execution resource limitation, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle edge calculation. In the invention, the unmanned aerial vehicle i receives the instruction and then independently completes the multi-task decision, and the task states of the rest networking unmanned aerial vehicles are obtained; carrying out multi-unmanned aerial vehicle collaborative processing task decision-making according to calculation resources required by a target detection task, residual calculation resources of other networking unmanned aerial vehicles and execution task states of other networking unmanned aerial vehicles; and finally, integrating the detection results of the cooperative targets of the multiple unmanned aerial vehicles by the unmanned aerial vehicle i, and transmitting the detection results back to the target position display center for display. According to the target detection system formed by a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles with intelligent edge computing capability, collaborative computing of target detection tasks among the plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles is realized through comprehensive decision rules of resources and tasks, and the problem of resource limitation faced by a single unmanned aerial vehicle when the single unmanned aerial vehicle executes the multi-target detection tasks is solved.

title: Modeling and capturing method, system, equipment and storage medium for image airspace information
description: The present invention discloses a method, system, device and storage medium for modeling and capturing spatial information of an image. In the present invention, in view of the problem that the current multi-layer perceptron network model is inefficient in processing spatial information of an image, an innovative grouped spatial information fusion method based on position coding is designed, which effectively improves the performance of the baseline model while significantly reducing the number of model parameters and introducing only a small amount of computational overhead. In addition, the present invention is the first to propose the application of generalized secondary position coding in perceptron networks, and improves the model performance from the perspective of simultaneously realizing global/local feature modeling. The final design adopts a hierarchical connection network framework based on feature windowing design, which further improves the performance of the perceptron network, making it have a network performance that is equivalent to or even exceeds that based on convolution and self-attention models.

title: A method, device, equipment and readable storage medium for evaluating test taker's performance
description: The invention provides a method, device, equipment and readable storage medium for evaluating a candidate's performance, and relates to the technical field of image processing. Whether it is correct or not, and analyze the examinee's experimental operation through the abnormal operation judgment model, judge whether each experimental operation of the examinee meets the requirements, and deduct points based on the operation that does not meet the requirements, and then carry out the evaluation based on the first scoring information and the second scoring information. Clustering, classifying the operation of candidates according to the results of all candidates, determining the performance level of each candidate, and then evaluating the results of different candidates.
