This can prevent candidates from not operating but memorizing test answers, resulting in inaccurate grading and reducing waste of teacher resources.

title: A method, system and storage medium for signaling trace recovery based on deep learning
description: The present invention provides a method, system, and storage medium for restoring signaling traces based on deep learning. The method includes: acquiring current signaling trace data and historical signaling trace data respectively; The time period is divided into multiple time intervals, and the trajectory retention points of each time interval are determined; the base station transition probability matrix is determined according to the historical signaling trajectory data, and the spatial attention data is obtained; the base station representation vector is generated, and the location representation of each time interval is determined Vector and time representation vector, determine the historical trajectory attention data based on the sum of the position representation vector and the time representation vector; input the sum of the base station representation vector and the corresponding time representation vector in the current signaling trajectory data to the encoder to obtain the trajectory representation vector , to obtain the encoder attention data; input the trajectory representation vector, spatial attention data, historical trajectory attention data and encoder attention data to the decoder to obtain the predicted signaling trajectory sequence.

title: A general model construction method for navigation scene perception combining SVM and HMM
description: The present invention proposes a method for constructing a general model of navigation scene perception by combining SVM and HMM, which are respectively an SVM-HMM1 construction method based on result level fusion and an SVM-HMM2 construction method based on probability level fusion. It includes: establishing a navigation scene perception feature fingerprint library by combining SFFS feature selection and LDA feature dimension reduction algorithm; using grid search to iteratively train SVM to output the classification results and classification probabilities of navigation scenes; introducing HMM to smooth the SVM recognition results and improve the accuracy of scene recognition, wherein the classification results output by SVM are combined with discrete HMM to form an SVM-HMM1 model, and the classification probability output by SVM is combined with continuous HMM to form an SVM-HMM2 model; for the constructed HMM model, a navigation scene adjacency matrix is constructed, and the unreasonable state transition parameters of HMM are corrected to further improve the reliability of the model. The present invention can realize fast and high-precision navigation scene perception, and provide scene perception information for adaptive configuration of multiple PNT sensors and seamless navigation of multiple scenes.

title: Quantum noise intensity determination method and device, electronic device and medium
description: The present disclosure provides a quantum noise intensity determination method, apparatus, electronic device, computer readable storage medium and computer program product, relating to the field of quantum computers, in particular to the field of quantum noise sustained release technology. The implementation scheme is as follows: obtaining the maximum mixed state; repeatedly operating the quantum measurement equipment to measure the maximum mixed state for a first number of times so as to obtain a measurement result; applying a phase gate to each of the qubits of the obtained maximum superposition state; sampling the phase theta for a plurality of times, so that for each theta value obtained by sampling, the quantum measurement equipment is operated repeatedly to measure the maximum superposition state for a second number of times, and a measurement result is obtained; counting the measurement result of the maximum mixed state and the measurement result of the maximum superposition state corresponding to each theta value to obtain a first probability value and a second probability value; and determining a quantum noise intensity of the quantum measurement device based on a difference between the first probability value and the second probability value.

title: Vehicle identification method, system, equipment and storage medium for multi-machine information fusion
description: The invention provides a vehicle identification method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for multi-machine information fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps that an image acquisition device is respectively arranged at two ends of a channel to acquire a forward image and a backward image; the method comprises the steps of respectively establishing a first image coordinate system and a second image coordinate system based on a forward image and a backward image, establishing a channel space three-dimensional coordinate system based on a channel, carrying out image recognition on vehicles in the forward image and the backward image, obtaining channel space three-dimensional coordinate systems respectively corresponding to image areas occupied by the head and the tail of each vehicle in the forward image and the backward image when at least two vehicles appear in the images, and carrying out pairing on the head pattern and the tail pattern of each vehicle based on the spatial position relation of the head and the tail. The invention can automatically identify the scenes of passing multiple vehicles based on multiple machine positions, reduces the overall cost, greatly improves the identification accuracy and reaction speed, and has high robustness of the vehicle separation effect.

title: Method, apparatus and computing device for searching for a target model
description: The present disclosure relates to a method, apparatus and computing device for searching for a target model. The method includes: constructing a super-network; training a maximum sub-network and a minimum sub-network of the super-network, respectively, to generate a trained maximum sub-network and a trained minimum sub-network; based on the trained maximum sub-network and the trained minimum sub-network A minimum sub-network, training a first preset number of first sub-networks of the super-network; and performing a search in the trained super-network to determine the quantized network structure of the target quantized sub-network that meets the performance parameter conditions of the target hardware device , and generate the target model according to the target quantization sub-network.

title: Commodity selection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: This specification provides a product selection method and device, electronic device, and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining a sample set to be trained, wherein the sample set to be trained includes a feature combination consisting of business district features of a sample business district and product features of sample products, and each feature combination is added with a training label, and the training label is used to characterize whether the historical data of the corresponding sample product in the corresponding sample business district meets predefined product selection conditions; based on the sample set to be trained, a constructed neural network model is trained to generate a corresponding product evaluation model, and the product evaluation model is used to predict whether the target product meets the product selection conditions in the target business district.

title: A high-speed imaging method, device and electronic equipment
description: This application relates to the field of high-speed imaging technology, specifically to a high-speed imaging method, apparatus, and electronic device, which can solve the problem that the computation time of the existing DeSCI algorithm is too long and cannot meet the requirements of real-time imaging. The high-speed imaging method includes: determining initial information based on known information, wherein the known information includes a pre-set mask matrix and acquired compressed signals, the initial information being obtained based on the relationship between the mask matrix and the acquired compressed signals; inputting the initial information into an end-to-end neural network including a feature extraction module and a feature fusion module to obtain an inverse mapping for signal reconstruction, wherein the inverse mapping is learned by the end-to-end neural network under supervised training with a large amount of known information; and outputting reconstructed information based on the inverse mapping, the reconstructed information being obtained by the inverse mapping according to the initial information.

title: Reservoir landslide displacement prediction method and device based on nonlinear combination model
description: The present invention provides a reservoir landslide displacement prediction method and device based on a nonlinear combination model, which can effectively reduce the reservoir landslide displacement prediction deviation and improve the accuracy and stability of the prediction model. The prediction method includes: Step 1. Construct a data set for reservoir landslide displacement prediction; Step 2. Divide the training set, verification set, and test set, decompose the cumulative landslide displacement into trend term displacement and periodic term displacement, and train the central tendency term displacement. Perform fitting; Step 3. Based on BPNN, SVM, RF and XGBoost, combine the periodic displacement and corresponding inducing factors in the training set data to construct multiple periodic displacement prediction models; Step 4. Determine the optimal periodic displacement Prediction model; Step 5: Construct a complementary error function, determine the optimal complementary model and perform nonlinear combination prediction to obtain the optimal periodic term predicted displacement; add the trend term predicted displacement and the periodic term predicted displacement to obtain the displacement prediction value.

title: An online optimization method for distribution network considering missing measurements
description: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution network operation, and discloses an online power distribution network optimization method considering measurement loss, which comprises the following steps: generating unsupervised training of an countermeasure network, learning complex relations of distributed photovoltaic power, load power and voltage amplitude based on historical operation data of the power distribution network, and generating node power and voltage data of the power distribution network meeting tide constraint under different topological connection relations of the power distribution network after the training is completed; the judging device outputs whether the node power and voltage data are probability values of authenticity samples or not; designing an authenticity loss function, a consistency loss function and a reconstruction loss function to optimize the input noise of the generator, and completing the online state reconstruction of the power distribution network under the condition of incomplete real-time measurement data; after the online state of the power distribution network is rebuilt and perceives that the voltage is out of limit, the input of the generator is optimized through the design of the authenticity loss, the consistency loss and the related constraint conditions, and finally, the distributed photovoltaic reactive power control instruction is determined through iterative calculation, so that the condition of voltage out of limit is avoided.

title: Pedestrian re-identification method and device
description: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of machine learning, and provides a method and device for pedestrian re-identification. The method includes: constructing a pedestrian re-identification model, wherein the pedestrian re-identification model includes: a pedestrian re-identification branch and a quality regression branch; obtaining a pre-trained model, and using the pre-trained model to initialize the pedestrian re-identification model; performing multi-stage training on the initialized pedestrian re-identification model; obtaining a pedestrian data set to be classified, wherein the pedestrian data set includes: multiple pictures of multiple people; using the pedestrian re-identification model after multi-stage training to classify the pictures in the pedestrian data set, and obtain one or more pictures of each person. The above-mentioned technical means are adopted to solve the problems in the prior art that the model training is time-consuming, costly, and has low accuracy in the current pedestrian re-identification algorithm.

title: AIS data-based ship abnormal state detection method
description: The present invention discloses a method for detecting abnormal ship status based on AIS data, comprising the following steps: obtaining raw AIS data, preprocessing the raw AIS data to obtain the original trajectory of the ship, and segmenting the original trajectory to obtain straight and curved segments of the original trajectory; after extracting the curved and straight segments, using a trajectory similarity measurement algorithm to eliminate abnormal trajectories, and using a Bi-LSTM model to predict on the basis of the absence of abnormal trajectories; and constructing a prediction-based anomaly detection model based on the straight and curved segments using a Bi-LSTM deep learning model to complete the detection of abnormal ship status. The present invention monitors the ship's navigation status in real time, automatically detects anomalies, and issues timely warnings, effectively reducing the reliance of safety supervision on manpower and having important significance in ensuring the safe navigation of ships and the prosperity and development of maritime trade.

title: Abnormal User Identification Method and Device
description: The embodiment of the application provides an abnormal user identification method and device. The abnormal user identification device comprises a first acquisition unit, a matching unit, a second acquisition unit, a generation unit and an identification unit. Therefore, whether the user logged in at the bank side is an abnormal user can be more efficiently and accurately identified based on the first data of the user at the bank side and the second data of the user at the operator side, namely multiparty data, and under the condition that privacy security of the data of each party is ensured.

title: Arbitrary style migration method and system based on contrast learning
description: The invention relates to a method and a system for migrating any style based on contrast learning. The method comprises the steps of training an arbitrary style migration network model by using a training data set, inputting a target content image into a content encoder after training is completed, processing to obtain a content code, inputting a reference artwork into the style encoder, respectively outputting style codes by a first convolution layer and a convolution layer containing the maximum pooling, inputting the content code and the deepest style code into an exchangeable style converter, inputting the content output by the exchangeable style converter into a decoder, and processing to obtain a final style migration result image or video frame by adapting each characteristic in the decoder to the mean value and variance of the style codes of other layers input by a single sample normalization layer. According to the invention, the style characterization of any appointed reference works of art can be transferred to any target content image, so that any stylization of the target content image is realized, and the subjective visual quality and artistic effect are improved.

title: Marine wind energy comparison and assessment method based on ocean cyclone removal
description: The invention discloses a marine wind energy comparison and evaluation method based on marine cyclone removal, which utilizes re-analysis data and a cyclone tracking algorithm to extract marine cyclone related parameters, establishes an influence buffer zone according to the cyclone parameters, acquires the sea level air pressure process quantity in the cyclone removal process, acquires the sea level air pressure after the cyclone removal, constructs a near coastal zone surface wind field model, acquires an near coastal zone surface wind field without cyclone influence, and compares and evaluates the marine wind energy according to the near coastal zone actual wind field and a simulated wind field without cyclone assumption.

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for business wind control
description: This specification discloses a business risk control method, device, equipment, and storage medium, which can extract the first feature of the user's business data through the first feature extraction subnet of the twin-tower model, so that the first feature of the user's business data can be extracted from the twin-tower model The reference features are matched with the second features of the historical business data extracted by the second feature extraction subnetwork, and then the risk control of the user's business can be performed according to the risk control results of the historical business data corresponding to the reference features.

title: Neural network array circuit and its design method based on RRAM device
description: The present invention relates to the field of semiconductor technology, in particular to a neural network array circuit based on an RRAM device and a design method thereof, the method comprising: determining the neural network array m*n in the array circuit M*N according to the neural network model, and according to The node weight of the neural network model configures the neural network array m*n; the preset data is processed through the configured neural network array m*n, and the data processing result is obtained; the data processing result is compared with the simulation obtained through the neural network model The error analysis of the data processing results is carried out to obtain the error index of the neural network array m*n; the weight value of the (M‑m)*n array in the array circuit is determined according to the error index, and the array circuit is configured according to the weight value. The method reversely adjusts the neural network array by adjusting the circuit array, and can compensate and adjust the result error caused by device characteristics in the neural network array, thereby effectively improving the accuracy of neural network calculation.

title: Bearing fault classification method of snake optimization support vector machine with fault feature selection
description: This invention relates to a bearing fault classification method, specifically a bearing fault classification method using a snake-optimized support vector machine for fault feature selection. This method can quickly, accurately, and efficiently classify bearing faults with a limited number of input fault features. The method includes a data processing module, a feature selection module, a model parameter optimization module, and a fault classification module. The data processing module divides the collected raw data and then converts each set of data into a time-domain signal index, which serves as the input data for the model's fault features. The feature selection module uses a decision tree to select the optimal fault features. The decision tree divides the root node based on a partitioning attribute, and the partitioning attribute is used as the optimal fault feature for the model. The model parameter optimization module combines the snake optimization algorithm and support vector machine to improve the model's classification accuracy and classification time. The fault classification module classifies bearing faults into four types and accurately locates the fault state.

title: Data processing method, device and equipment
description: The embodiment of the specification provides a data processing method, a device and equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring second data corresponding to the first data under the condition that the absence of the characteristic data in the newly added characteristic data in the first data is detected; inputting the historical characteristic data in the first data into a pre-trained coding model to obtain a first compression score corresponding to the historical characteristic data in the first data, and inputting the historical characteristic data in the second data into the pre-trained coding model to obtain a second compression score corresponding to the historical characteristic data in the second data; and determining target data corresponding to the first data in the second data based on the first compression score and the second compression score, and filling the newly added characteristic data in the first data based on the newly added characteristic data in the target data so as to improve the filling effect on the missing data and improve the accuracy of subsequent data processing.

title: A distributed storage system automatic parameter adjustment method and system based on reinforcement learning
description: The invention discloses an automatic parameter adjusting method and system of a distributed storage system based on reinforcement learning, which belong to the technical field of distributed storage, wherein a plurality of system parameters which have great influence on the performance of the distributed storage system are screened out from a first sample pool by counting the performance indexes of the distributed storage system in the first sample pool, the system parameters are used as a group of optimal parameters of the distributed storage system, the complexity of the optimization problem is reduced, the feasibility of subsequent parameter adjusting based on reinforcement learning is ensured, then, further optimal adjustment work is carried out by utilizing a DDPG model of reinforcement learning on the basis of parameter screening, in the process, the early-stage cold start time consumption problem of a DDPG model is considered, the collected samples are input into a DDPG model for pre-training, the problem of massive time consumption of early-stage cold start is avoided, and the distributed storage system parameters can be reasonably and effectively adjusted accurately.

title: Fuzzy memristor calculation method and system for hierarchical quantification of blood pressure
description: The invention discloses a fuzzy memristor calculation method and a system for blood pressure grading quantization, comprising the following steps: acquiring a blood pressure related data set based on a big data method, and carrying out preprocessing such as normalization and the like on the blood pressure related data set according to a threshold high pressure judging method to obtain definition and classification of blood pressure levels in the data set; establishing a fuzzy semantic set according to a judging result of hypertension in a blood pressure data set, generating an input variable based on the fuzzy semantic set, and leading the input variable into a memristor fuzzy logic circuit to determine a membership function; determining fuzzy rules through membership functions, obtaining fuzzy rule weights, converting the fuzzy rules stored in a rule base into mapping relations among fuzzy sets, obtaining final output results of memristor fuzzy logic circuits, and determining hierarchical quantization results of blood pressure data. According to the real-time intelligent fuzzy calculation method, the blood pressure data of the wearer are analyzed in real time, the blood pressure grading condition is analyzed, and the real-time efficient intelligent fuzzy calculation method is provided for health monitoring of the wearable equipment.

title: Multi-metal lateral layer devices with internal bias generation
description: A ferroelectric capacitor or a ferroelectric transistor may include a first metal layer having a first metal having a first work function, and a second metal layer having a second metal having a second work function. The capacitor may also include a vertical electrode and a ferroelectric material that surrounds the vertical electrode and forms a plurality of switching regions in the ferroelectric material. The transistor may include a vertical channel, a vertical buffer layer that surround the vertical channel, and a ferroelectric material that surrounds the vertical buffer layer and forms a plurality of gate regions in the ferroelectric material.

title: Lifecycle management for customized natural language processing
description: Methods, systems, and computer-readable media for lifecycle management for customized natural language processing are disclosed. A natural language processing (NLP) customization service determines a task definition associated with an NLP model based (at least in part) on user input. The task definition comprises an indication of one or more tasks to be implemented using the NLP model and one or more requirements associated with use of the NLP model. The service determines the NLP model based (at least in part) on the task definition. The service trains the NLP model. The NLP model is used to perform inference for a plurality of input documents. The inference outputs a plurality of predictions based (at least in part) on the input documents. Inference data is collected based (at least in part) on the inference. The service generates a retrained NLP model based (at least in part) on the inference data.

title: Model training processing method and apparatus, computer device, and medium
description: The present application relates to data processing technology, and provides a model training processing method and apparatus, a computer device, and a storage medium. The method comprises: obtaining auxiliary servers corresponding to a target server; calculating the optimal training quantity of the auxiliary servers, and allocating a model training request to each auxiliary server; detecting whether the auxiliary server outputs a training response message; when the detection result is no, determining an auxiliary model training request, and outputting the auxiliary model training request to a corresponding target slave node; acquiring a model training result of each auxiliary server, and detecting whether there is an abnormal item in the model training result; and when the detection result is yes, modifying a target training model on the basis of the abnormal item, and according to the model training result, dynamically adjusting the training quantity of the auxiliary servers so as to retrain the target training model. The present application can increase the model training efficiency, and promotes the construction of smart healthcare and smart cities.

title: System and method for automatically recognizing and monitoring livestock behavior by using deep learning
description: The present invention relates to a system and a method for automatically recognizing and monitoring livestock behavior by using deep learning, wherein the behavior of livestock is automatically recognized and detected in a video by using deep learning pre-trained using livestock behavior annotations, and is stored and subjected to short-term behavior analysis/long-term behavior analysis so as to provide an alarm in case of a dangerous situation, so that livestock behavior can be automatically monitored in real time.

title: Video quality assessment method and device on basis of existence and non-existence of audio
description: A video quality assessment device is disclosed. The video quality assessment device comprises: a memory storing one or more instructions; and a processor executing the one or more instructions stored in the memory, wherein, by executing the one or more instructions, the processor may: obtain a first quality score with respect to a video frame on the basis of the video frame and an audio frame output together with the video frame; obtain a second quality score with respect to the video frame on the basis of the video frame without the audio frame; and obtain a final quality score with respect to the video frame from the first quality score and the second quality score.

title: Decision tree native to graph database
description: Systems, methods, and other embodiments associated with decision tree machine learning native to a graph database are described. In one embodiment, a method includes receiving an objective property value of a training graph for a graph-native decision tree to be trained to predict; determining feasible ranges of values from the training graph; automatically generating a graph query language grammar for graph-native decision trees based on the feasible ranges; progressively evolving output decision trees in a graph query language from the graph query language grammar to generate a final decision tree that accurately predicts the objective property value; and storing the final decision tree for subsequent execution against a target graph.

title: Process for dimensional manipulation using key fractal elements
description: Described herein is application of key fractal elements (KFE) of AuT (the science) inherent in the fractal design of dimension for dimensional manipulation based on fractal underpinnings of the universe and the absorption and control of electromagnetic effects in conjunction with ions, solar, and ionic batteries. The process is applicable at all dimensional levels for defining and using fractal transitions. AuT defines the bit required for this logic to work (positive and negative result) and its operation. The iterated equations primarily discussed are fpix=-1^x+2x(-1 )^(x-1), an equation generating the denominator of pi and made up and derived from underlying iterated equations, n+1 which drives changes in fpix and 2f(n)^(2^n) the observed compression function the results of which are called ct states.

title: Techniques for generating multi-modal discourse trees
description: Methods for generating and utilizing a multi-modal discourse tree (MMDT) are provided herein. An extended discourse tree (EDT) may be generated (e.g., from a discourse tree (DT) or a communicative DT (CDT)) from a corpus of text. Data records (e.g., records contained numerical data) may be linked to the extended discourse tree to generate a multi-modal discourse tree. The multi-modal discourse tree may link any suitable text/records from disparate sources. For example, entities identified from elementary discourse units of the EDT may be matched to an entity of a data record. Causal links may be identified between EDTs and/or data records. Rhetorical relationships can be identified for each entity/causal link match to incorporate the data records with the EDT to generate a MMDT. The MMDT may be used to classify subsequent input, to generate answers to subsequent questions, to navigate the corpus of text and/or data records, or the like.

title: Control of a supply network, in particular an electricity network
description: The invention relates to a method for reinforced learning of an artificial neural network, wherein the neural network determines, from measurements associated with a supply network, in particular an electricity network, a plurality of control values for controlling the supply network. The method is characterised by the following steps: - (S1) determining a control value such that at least one limit value of a measured variable of the supply network is exceeded during a time period, wherein the time period is fixed such that protective devices of the supply network are not triggered; - (S2) acquiring at least one measurement associated with the control value; and - (S3) training the neural network by means of the calculated control value and the acquired associated measurement. The invention further relates to an artificial neural network for controlling a supply network and to a control device comprising such a neural network.

title: Image processing method and apparatus, and storage medium
description: The present application relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and in particular to an image processing method and apparatus, and a storage medium. The method comprises: processing a collected original image according to an ISP parameter, so as to obtain a target image; calling, according to the target image, a pre-trained image quality assessment model to output a target assessment result, wherein the target assessment result indicates the assessed image quality of the target image; and adjusting the ISP parameter according to the target assessment result. By means of the embodiments of the present application, an image quality assessment model is called to assess the image quality of a target image, so as to output a target assessment result, and an ISP parameter is automatically adjusted according to the target assessment result, thereby ensuring a debugging effect of the ISP parameter, and improving the subsequent image quality after ISP processing is performed. The method and apparatus provided in the embodiments of the present application can be applied to an intelligent vehicle, a new energy vehicle, etc.

title: Processing execution system, processing execution method, and program
description: A second classification information acquisition unit (202) of a processing execution system (S) acquires second classification information relating to the classification of second data on the basis of a first model that has been trained on the relationship between first data and first classification information relating to the classification of the first data. An effectiveness estimation unit (206) estimates the effectiveness of the combination of the second data and the second data classification information on the basis of a prescribed estimation method. An execution unit (207) executes prescribed processing on the basis of the effectiveness estimation results.

title: Delay encoded vector symbolic radio multiple access
description: A method by a neuromorphic device in a wireless communication network which communicates using radio frames and carrier frequencies. The method includes obtaining a high dimensional (HD) vector containing symbols. At least some symbols have a value indicating a pattern of firing events for associated one or more neurons of a neural network (NN). For each symbol in the HD vector having a nonzero value, selecting a subframe of a radio frame and/or a carrier frequency among a set of carrier frequencies, based on a defined mapping between subframes of the radio frame and/or carrier frequencies of the set and the locations of symbols in the HD vector, determining a time offset relative to the selected subframe and/or a frequency offset relative to the selected carrier frequency, based on the value of the symbol, and transmitting an impulse at the determined time offset relative to the selected subframe and/or at the determined frequency offset relative to the selected carrier frequency. (Figure 7)

title: Virtual digital human driving method and pose acquisition model training method
description: A virtual digital human driving method and a pose acquisition model training method. The driving method comprises: obtaining animation audio data of a virtual digital human, obtaining a target dance style of the virtual digital human, and then generating a pose information sequence according to the animation audio data and the target dance style, and according to the pose information sequence, driving the virtual digital human to make a corresponding dance action.

title: Simulation warmup
description: A machine learning optimizer (205B) that runs a simulator (210B) uses time-state waves as input to determine initial node values for the simulator (210B) in an official simulation run, producing time state waves as a result. A learning model (125) uses the input and output as a training example by reversing the time-state waves, using the output from the simulator (210B) as input, obtains output, reversed the output, and then uses the reversed output as ground truth to compare to desired output of the simulation.

title: Embedded rom-based multi-bit, multi-kernel, multi-channel weights in individual pixels for in-pixel computing
description: Provided is an integrated circuit comprising: an amplifier; a sensor electrically connected to a first input of the amplifier; and a set of weights electrically connected to a second input of the amplifier, wherein the amplifier is configured weight an output of the sensor according to an output of the set of weights. Provided is an array of integrated circuits comprising an amplifier; a sensor electrically connected to a first input of the amplifier; and a set of weights electrically connected to a second input of the amplifier, wherein the amplifier is configured weight an output of the sensor according to an output of the set of weights.

title: Method and device for transmitting or receiving quantization-based channel state information in wireless communication system
description: A method and a device for transmitting or receiving a wireless signal in a wireless communication system are disclosed. A method by which a terminal reports channel state information (CSI), according to one embodiment of the present disclosure, may include the steps of: receiving, from a base station, configuration information related to a CSI report; receiving, from the base station, at least one CSI-reference signal (CSI-RS) on the basis of the configuration information; and transmitting, to the base station, a CSI calculated on the basis of the at least one CSI-RS. Here, the CSI can include a plurality of parameters according to the configuration information, and at least one of the plurality of parameters can be determined on the basis of a specific learning algorithm.

title: Smart media overlay selection for a messaging system
description: A text string provided by a second client device of a second user is received by a first client device of a first user. The text string is parsed into one or more text portions. A score is assigned to each of the one or more text portions based on a specified criterion. One or more relevant tags of a plurality of tags are determined based on the one or more text portions. One or more media overlays are selected based on the one or more relevant tags and the assigned score for each of the one or more text portions. The text string with a reply interface for sending a reply message to the second client device is displayed.

title: Cosmetic spreadability prediction method, cosmetic spreadability prediction device, and computer program stored in recording medium in order to execute method
description: The present invention relates to a cosmetic spreadability prediction method, a cosmetic spreadability prediction device, and a computer program stored in a recording medium in order to execute the method. The device comprises: a communication unit for establishing a network connection to an external device; a user interface unit; a processor; and a memory that stores instructions that can be executed by the processor. By executing the instructions, the processor: acquires spreadability panel evaluation data for a plurality of cosmetic formulations; acquires parameter data of a spreadability prediction model for the plurality of cosmetic formulations, the model being acquired through a spreadability analysis of the plurality of cosmetic formulations; and receives information about the cosmetic formulations and predicts the spreadability of the cosmetic formulations on the basis of the parameter data of the spreadability prediction model.

title: Apparatus and method for maintaining a machine learning model repository
description: A non-transitory computer readable storage medium has instructions executed by a processor to maintain a repository of machine learning directed acyclic graphs. Each machine learning directed acyclic graph has machine learning artifacts as nodes and machine learning executors as edges joining machine learning artifacts. Each machine learning artifact has typed data that has associated conflict rules maintained by the repository. Each machine learning executor specifies executable code that executes a machine learning artifact as an input and produces a new machine learning artifact as an output. A request about an object in the repository is received. A response with information about the object is supplied.

title: Determining hplc method parameters using machine learning
description: Computer-implemented methods for predicting HPLC retention time for one or more compounds using machine learning models are disclosed. In particular, the use of machine learning models for identifying a set of HPLC method parameters suitable for separating two or more compounds in a composition is disclosed. Related systems and products are also described.

title: Apparatus and method for mobility with ai/ml channel prediction
description: A method performed by at least one processor of a user equipment (UE) having a connection with a serving cell in a wireless communication network includes receiving, from a target cell in the wireless communication network, a set of resources for a slot n. The method includes measuring, for the target cell, a network quality parameter based on the set of resources. The method includes reporting, to the serving cell, results corresponding to the measuring of the network quality parameter. The method includes receiving, based on (i) a prediction from an artificial intelligence machine learning (AI/ML) model using the measuring of the network quality parameter as an input into the AI/ML model and (ii) a determination that a cell switching condition is satisfied, a command to switch from the serving cell to the target cell at a time corresponding to slot n+k.

title: Federated learning method and apparatus, readable storage medium, and electronic device
description: The present application relates to a federated learning method and apparatus, a readable storage medium, and an electronic device. The method comprises: using a predeployed tangent plane base, injecting a first tangent plane program at a gradient sending function of a federated learning device; according to local training data, training a model to be trained, obtaining a plaintext gradient of the model to be trained, and using the gradient sending function to send the plaintext gradient to a federated learning server; using the first tangent plane program to intercept the plaintext gradient, encrypt the plaintext gradient to obtain a ciphertext gradient, and send the ciphertext gradient to the federated learning server, so as to cause the federated learning server to decrypt the received ciphertext gradient sent by each federated learning device, and according to each plaintext gradient obtained following decryption, update the parameters of the model to be trained. The federated learning method and apparatus of the present application involve encrypting a plaintext gradient of a federated learning device, and sending the encrypted ciphertext gradient to a federated learning server, thereby avoiding privacy leaks caused by an attacker obtaining the plaintext gradient.

title: Methods, systems, and related aspects for the automated optimization and individualization of clinical management
description: Examples may provide computer-implemented method of predicting and optimizing a medical outcome of a patient. The method includes identifying relationships among a set of characteristics of an initial patient population, a set of therapies, and a set of outcomes in a given clinical scenario to produce a set of identified relationships. The method also includes identifying modifiable levers that can be optimized in the set of identified relationships to produce a set of identified modifiable levers. In addition, the method also includes adjusting the set of identified modifiable levers applicable to a selected patient population to produce a reduction in a predicted probability of a negative outcome for the patient. Additional methods and related systems and computer readable media are also provided.

title: Methods and systems for user equipment capability reporting and machine-learning based channel state information configuration
description: A method performed by a user equipment (UE) is provided. The method comprises sending an indication of one or more UE capabilities of performing artificial intelligence/machine learning (AIZML)-based channel state information (CSI) report compression to a network node. The indication of one or more UE capabilities comprises information for identifying one or more maximum payload sizes, or one or more payload size ranges, of a compressed CSI report. The method further comprises receiving an AI/ML-based CSI report configuration, and sending the AI/ML-based CSI report to a network node. The AI/ML-based CSI report configuration comprises information for identifying one or more AI/ML models of the UE. The one or more AI/ML models of the UE are configured to generate an AI/ML-based CSI report based on the AI/ML-based CSI report configuration.

title: Efficient hamiltonian exponentiation in a quantum circuit
description: A method, apparatus, and computer product comprising: obtaining a multitree data structure that represents a plurality of ordered Pauli-terms, the plurality of ordered Pauli-terms representing an exponentiation module, wherein implementing a Pauli- term in a quantum circuit requires to implement a basis change stage and a parity summation stage, the multitree data structure comprises root nodes representing the plurality of Pauli-terms, leaf nodes representing qubits, and a non-leaf node; converting the multitree data structure to an ordered binary multitree that comprises an additional node; and synthesizing the quantum circuit based on the ordered binary multitree, whereby the quantum circuit comprises an implementation of the parity summation stage and an implementation of the basis change stage, whereby the quantum circuit implements at least one cancellation of a given CX gate of the parity summation stage.

title: Interactive packet security system for modulating and demodulating image superpixel bits
description: The present invention relates to an interactive packet security system for modulating and demodulating image superpixel bits. The present invention provides a packet security system using image fragments (PSIF) platform targeting a 5G wireless network, wherein a communication packet is divided into blocks by using a datagram method from among packet switching methods and transmitted to a plurality of paths, and when one image is divided and transmitted along with respective packet blocks, a reception node may match matching pieces to combine the packet blocks, which may complete the communication packet, thereby obtaining original data.

title: Electronic device and method for controlling electronic device
description: This electronic device comprises at least one processor causing the electronic device to perform the following operations of: obtaining first throughput information for an inference operation of a first model and second throughput information for a training operation of a second model on the basis of at least the first throughput information and the second throughput information; identifying a first resource for performing the inference operation of the first model and a second resource for performing the training operation of the second model on the basis of the first throughput information and the second throughput information; allocating the identified first resource as a resource for performing the inference operation of the first model and allocating the identified second resource as a resource for performing the training operation of the second model; and training the second model by using an inference result of the first model via the allocated first and second resources.

title: Implicit predictive coding for point cloud compression
description: Some embodiments of a method may include: obtaining a previously decoded point cloud frame as a reference point cloud frame; determining a predictor feature map based on the reference point cloud frame; obtaining a current feature map that represents the current point cloud frame given the predictor feature map as a condition; and reconstructing the current point cloud frame based on the current feature map and using the predictor feature map as a condition.

title: Assessment tool, graphical user interface, and associated functionality
description: A property assessment system includes circuitry that obtains predetermined data for one or more properties, and obtains at least one of a map or an image of the one or more properties. The circuitry then generates assessments for the one or more properties based on the predetermined data, and ranks the one or more properties based on the assessments. The circuitry generates a list of the one or more properties based on the rank, and displays the list of the one or more properties in conjunction with the map or image of the one or more properties.

title: Model determination method and apparatus, and communication device
description: The present application relates to the technical field of communications, and discloses a model determination method and apparatus, and a communication device. The model determination method in embodiments of the present application comprises: a first device determines a first model on the basis of first information; and the first device activates the first model. The first information comprises any one of the following: scenario information where a terminal device is located, and a mapping relationship between a machine learning model and the scenario information; the first device being the terminal device or a network side device; and model information of the machine learning model associated with the scenario information where the terminal device is located.

title: Agilegan-based refinement method and framework for consistent texture generation
description: Methods and systems for generating a texturized image are disclosed. Some examples may include: receiving an input image, receiving an exemplar texture image, generating, using an encoder, a first latent code vector representation based on the input image, generating, using a generative adversarial network generator, a second latent code vector representation based on the exemplar texture image, blending the first latent code vector representation and the second latent code vector representation to obtain a blended latent code vector representation, generating, by the GAN generator, a texturized image based on the blended latent code vector representation and providing the texturized image as an output image.

title: Photonic neural network accelerator
description: A photonic neural network accelerator, comprising: a Mach Zehnder Interferometer (MZI) comprising phase change material (PCM), the MZI configured to modulate input light passing through a main waveguide; an optical coupler disposed on the main waveguide and configured to split a fraction of the modulated input light into a sub-waveguide from the main waveguide; and an optical resistance switch (ORS) disposed on the sub-waveguide and configured to capture optical information in the sub-waveguide, wherein the optical information comprises optical power and incident wavelength.

title: A Method for Implementing Non-Linear Activation Functions in Artificial Neural Networks Using Low Resources and Consuming Low Power
description: The invention relates to a method that does not use block memory elements (LUT, Block RAM, etc.) or distributed RAM in the implementation of the activation functions of artificial neural networks, completely eliminating the need for shift operations and multiplication elements. Since the activation function is found in every neuron, eliminating the impact element provides significant resource and power savings in ANN implementation.

title: Digital twin-based interference reduction system and method in local autonomous networks with dense access points
description: In order to reduce the negative impact on performance due to the interference problem in wireless networks and dense access point positioning, the invention provides the solution that reduces the impact of the most interference, by using reinforcement learning and by performing a comprehensive search process, by choosing the possibility that reduces the interference created by the access points (3) on the devices. It's about the system and method.

title: Machine learning device, motor control device, processing machine, and machine learning method for optimizing cycle processing time of processing machine
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a machine learning device that can obtain a motor downtime on its's own, a motor controller of a processor, the processor, and a method for machine learning.SOLUTION: A machine learning device 16 includes a state observation part 17 and a learning part 18. The state observation part 17 observes a state variable made up of at least a preset processing downtime B, an actual processing time T for one cycle of a processor 10, and the temperature of a motor 11 in repeated processing operations. Further, the learning part 18 learns the value of selecting a minimum processing downtime B, which ensures that the temperature of the coil of the motor 11 does not exceed the overheat alarm level P when the repeat processing operations are conducted, on the basis of the state variable and the overheat alarm level P.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Data storage determination program, data storage determination method, and data storage determination device
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To store data of high reutilization efficiency in data processing which is comprised of a plurality of processes and in which an output result of a process is used in another process.SOLUTION: Provided is a data storage determination program for causing a computer to perform processing of: referring to the content of the process for obtaining the final result from the memory through the plural processes for each of plural output data pieces generated during a course of obtaining a final result from target data through plural processes; generating a first cost when the data piece is stored in an output data repository and a second cost when the data piece is not stored in the output data repository; and determining whether or not each of the plural output data pieces is stored on the basis of the first cost and the second cost.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title: Thermal displacement correction device
description: To provide a thermal displacement correction device capable of efficiently performing temperature correction of machine accuracy when a peripheral situation is an unknown environment.SOLUTION: A machine learning device 100 provided in a thermal displacement correction device 1 includes: a model data selection section 130 which selects a learned model suitable for additional learning of thermal displacement correction amount of each shaft provided in a manufacturing machine 70 for an operation state of the manufacturing machine under a change of a peripheral temperature of the manufacturing machine 70; and a learned model storage section 200 which stores a pattern of a peripheral temperature change curve indicating the transition of the change of the peripheral temperature of the manufacturing machine 70 and the learned model learned under the change of the peripheral temperature in association with each other. The model data selection section 130 selects the learned model suitable for additional learning of the thermal displacement correction amount of each shaft provided in the manufacturing machine 70 for the operation state of the manufacturing machine 70 on the basis of the peripheral temperature change curve stored in the learned model storage section 200.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: State determination device and method
description: To provide a state determination device and method for efficiently performing machine learning without large cost, using the learning result for assisting maintenance of various industrial machines.SOLUTION: A state determination device 1 of the invention comprises: a data acquisition part 30 for acquiring data related to industrial machines; a learning data extraction part 32 for, on the basis of data related to the industrial machines acquired by the data acquisition part 30, generating a plurality of pieces of partial time series data obtained by sliding in a time axis direction, a physical amount of pieces of time series data in pieces of data related to the industrial machines, and extracting a plurality of pieces of learning data including the plurality of partial time series data; and a learning part 110 for performing machine learning using the learning data extracted by the learning data extraction part 32, generating the learning model.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

title: Methods and equipment for recommending and generating network settings
description: To provide a method and a device for recommending and generating network settings.SOLUTION: A method for automatically generating a recommended network setting for a block chain network includes steps of receiving a descriptive text related to a project that a user inputs through an input device, extracting features related to predetermined characteristics from the descriptive text, calculating feature values for the features, matching the descriptive text with known network settings based on the features and the feature values, selecting the best matching known network settings as recommended network settings for the project, and showing the recommended network settings to the user by an output device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Output device, learning model generation method, and computer program
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an output device capable of controlling a human-powered vehicle to travel comfortably for a long time by using a learning model, a method of generating a learning model, and a computer program. An output device is a power consumption efficiency in an acquisition unit that acquires input information related to traveling of a human-powered vehicle and a power supply device that supplies power to a component of the human-powered vehicle when the input information is input. It is provided with a learning model which is trained based on an index value indicating the above and is configured to output output information regarding the control of the component. [Selection diagram] Fig. 3

title: A Positive Sample Augmentation Method for Surface Defect Detection
description: The invention discloses a positive sample expansion method for surface defect detection. , retain the detection frame containing the target information; screen and determine negative samples, positive samples and semi-positive samples by the sample determination unit; Sampling; input all the sampled data into the loss regression unit, and perform detection frame classification loss training and detection frame positioning regression training through the loss regression unit, and then expand the positive samples; the present invention can more accurately measure the overlap between the detection frame and the target frame At the same time, the imbalance problem of positive and negative samples is improved, and it can be directly transferred to various target detection networks without pre-training and has good versatility.

title: Reservoir group dispatching decision-making behavior mining method and reservoir dispatching automatic control device
description: The invention provides a reservoir group dispatching decision-making behavior mining method and a reservoir dispatching automatic control device. The method includes: step 1. Determine a research scenario, collect the basic data of the reservoir group system, historical dispatch data and the meteorological data of the reservoir area, and determine the reservoir group dispatch behavior. Influencing factors and decision variables; Step 2. Determine the deep learning algorithm for mining the decision-making behavior of reservoir group dispatching; Step 3. Review the accuracy of the reservoir group dispatching data; Step 4. Construct the reservoir group that couples the basic principles of the reservoir and the deep learning model Scheduling decision-making behavior mining model; Step 5. Determine the hyperparameters of the model based on the training set samples, update the network parameters of the model based on the model loss function backpropagation, determine the optimal hyperparameters of the model according to the simulation accuracy of the model in the test set, and finally establish The mapping relationship between the influencing factors of the reservoir group dispatching behavior and the decision variables can realize the mining of the reservoir group dispatching decision-making behavior.

title: A Pixel Difference Convolution Edge Detection Method Based on Local Binary Pattern
description: The invention discloses a pixel difference convolution edge detection method based on a local binary pattern, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a pixel difference convolution to replace a common convolution layer in a deep convolution neural network, and establishing a pixel difference convolution neural network; and S2, carrying out edge detection on the image by using a pixel difference convolution neural network, and outputting an edge detection result. The invention applies the pixel difference to a main network of a three-module structure inspired by HED, and provides two types of pixel difference convolution neural networks, namely RPD-CNN and APD-CNN, without introducing any additional parameter so as to improve the edge detection capability of a deep learning network. The pixel difference convolution-based backbone network can provide preliminary feature extraction for the subsequent side output module and the feature fusion module.

title: A task assignment path determination method, device and electronic device
description: The present application discloses a task assignment path determination method, device and electronic device, which relate to the technical field of maps. The specific implementation scheme is: acquiring N tasks in the target time period; clustering the N tasks to obtain M task classes; calculating the intra-class allocation path in each task class, and calculating the M tasks The inter-class allocation path of the class; the final task allocation path of the N tasks is generated according to the intra-class allocation path and the inter-class allocation path within each task class. The present application can improve task allocation efficiency.

title: An image deblurring method, system, device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses an image deblurring method, a system, a device and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a standard image sample set, wherein the standard image sample set at least comprises a clear standard image sample; converting each standard image sample in the standard image sample set into a corresponding native image sample, and performing fuzzy processing on each native image sample to generate a fuzzy native image; restoring the blurred native image into a blurred standard image, and constructing a standard training sample set according to the blurred standard image and the clear standard image sample; and the standard training sample set is used for training the standard model so as to perform deblurring processing on the standard image to be processed through the trained standard model. The technical scheme provided by the invention can improve the precision and efficiency of deblurring processing.

title: An X-ray security inspection contraband detection method for overlapping problems
description: The invention provides an X-ray security inspection contraband detection method aiming at the overlapping problem of X-ray images in the existing X-ray security inspection contraband detection, and the method can be deployed on a security inspection machine for use. The invention is realized by the following technical scheme: inputting images of a training set into a network for training; and step two, inputting the test set image into the trained network for testing. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the following advantages: firstly, the invention adopts an end-to-end deep learning network, has high detection speed and is easy to deploy. And secondly, the invention can predict only by using the image generated by the X-ray security inspection system, compared with other methods, the method does not need additional physical equipment, is simple and easy to implement, can be quickly deployed on a security inspection machine, and is put into practical application.

title: Human action recognition method based on multi-scale attention graph convolutional network
description: The invention relates to the technical field of human behavior identification, in particular to a human behavior identification method based on a multi-scale attention-seeking convolutional network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an original 3D skeleton map sequence to be identified; inputting the original 3D skeleton diagram sequence into a human behavior recognition model which is trained in advance: firstly, extracting joint information, skeleton information and motion information from the original 3D skeleton map sequence through a multi-branch input module to serve as behavior characteristic data; then, learning the correlation of the 3D skeleton joint points through a multi-scale attention map convolution module based on the behavior characteristic data, and extracting time sequence information of various behaviors in different durations; finally, recognizing human body behaviors corresponding to the original 3D skeleton diagram sequence through a global attention pooling layer; and outputting a corresponding human behavior recognition result. The human behavior recognition method can give consideration to the accuracy and efficiency of human behavior recognition, so that the recognition effect of human behavior recognition can be ensured.

title: A charging station service pricing method based on hierarchical game
description: The invention discloses a charging station service pricing method based on hierarchical game. The method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a game model of electric vehicle charging and charging station pricing based on a hierarchical Starkegberg game, wherein the game model comprises the game characteristics that the pricing of the charging station of a charging operation company influences the electric vehicle decision, the decision of the electric vehicle influences each other, and the decision of the electric vehicle influences the pricing of the charging station. Then, the charging cost optimization problem of the electric vehicle is defined according to the optimization target of the electric vehicle, and the income optimization problem of the electric vehicle is defined according to the optimization target of a charging operation company. And then analyzing the convergence of the problem based on an optimization theory, solving the optimization problem of the electric automobile and the operation company based on an optimization algorithm, and finally taking the solved pricing result as a pricing strategy of the charging operation company for the charging station operated by the charging operation company. The method considers the rational decision of charging the electric automobile, and can greatly improve the income of a charging operation company.

title: A network operation and maintenance method, device and system
description: The embodiment of the application provides a network operation and maintenance method, device and system, which are used for solving the problems of high cost and low operation and maintenance efficiency of a human-based network operation and maintenance method. The method comprises the following steps: the network intelligent unit obtains first network data, trains based on the first network data to obtain a data model, and deploys the data model. The data model is a first model, a second model or a third model, the first model is used for determining a network control instruction sent to the operation support system, the second model is used for determining a network control instruction sent to the network element/network management system, and the third model is used for determining a network control instruction sent to the network element. The network intelligent unit carries out AI training on various uploaded network data to generate a data model, the generated model is deployed into the reasoning unit, and the reasoning unit carries out real-time data model reasoning as required, so that the real-time intelligentization level of the network can be improved.

title: Muscle CT image delineation method, system, electronic device and machine storage medium
description: The invention provides a muscle CT image delineation method, a system, electronic equipment and a machine storage medium, which relate to the technical field of image processing, and the method comprises the following steps: preprocessing the acquired muscle CT image to obtain a preprocessed muscle image sequence; positioning and identifying the muscle image sequence in CT sagittal position to obtain sagittal position positioning image of target muscle (including designated muscle or muscle group); performing segmentation processing on the sagittal positioning image of the target muscle at the axial level to obtain a plurality of results of CT images of the muscle or muscle group at the designated position; the segmentation result includes a variety of muscle parameters. The invention can quickly and accurately realize the automatic measurement of the muscle segmentation parameter information of the three-dimensional medical image, thereby improving the muscle delineation and measurement efficiency of the medical image (image) and reducing the labor cost.

title: A method of forming a track detection model, a method of detecting track wear
description: The application provides a method for forming a track detection model and a method for detecting track abrasion. The method for forming the track detection model comprises the following steps: receiving an original picture acquired by a shooting device travelling along a track, wherein the original picture comprises a track image; carrying out data augmentation on the original picture to obtain a plurality of augmented pictures; distinguishing and labeling a normal area and a damaged area of a track image in the multiple augmented pictures to obtain multiple labeled pictures; and training the deep neural network by using a plurality of labeled pictures to form a track detection model.

title: System and method for synchronization of multithreaded channels
description: An apparatus for synchronizing scattered channels or drifting threads is disclosed. In one embodiment, a graphics multiprocessor includes a queue having an initial state with a set of a first group having threads of a first instruction type and a second group having threads of the first instruction type and the second instruction type. The re-grouping engine (or re-grouping circuit) re-groups the threads into a third group having threads of the first instruction type and a fourth group having threads of the second instruction type.

title: Monitoring method, equipment and storage medium for interrogation scene
description: The application relates to a monitoring method, equipment and a storage medium of an interrogation scene, belonging to the technical field of computers, wherein the method comprises the following steps: performing personnel analysis on at least one frame of target image in the same interrogation scene to obtain image position information of n personnel in the target image; determining a suspect area and an inquirer area according to the image position information, and the number of people in the suspect area and the number of people in the inquirer area; determining whether the interrogation scene has abnormal interrogation according to the number of personnel in the suspect area and the number of personnel in the interrogator area; the problem of low accuracy of detecting whether the abnormal query exists only according to the distance can be solved; the abnormity is judged not only through the distance between the personnel, but also through determining the positions of the suspect area and the inquired person area, and the abnormity is judged by combining the area position and the number of the personnel in the area, so that the accuracy of judging the abnormal interrogation is improved.

title: An energy-optimized configuration and evaluation method based on thermoelectric coupling
description: The present application belongs to the technical field of aircraft energy management, and relates to an energy optimization configuration and evaluation method based on thermoelectric coupling. The method includes first performing multi-objective optimization on a system architecture to be optimized, taking a preset top-level design objective as an optimization objective, and using component specifications and component quantities of the system architecture as variables, and performing a multi-objective optimization on the component specifications and components of the system architecture. After that, according to the reliability data of each device itself, determine the initial connection mode between devices; finally, for the initial connection mode, verify the reliability of the system architecture, if the system reliability is not satisfied, increase the System redundancy, multi-objective optimization is performed again, and the component specifications and number of components of the system architecture are determined until the system architecture meets the reliability. In this application, a multi-objective and multi-parameter multi-level optimization model of the aircraft electromechanical system is established to form an optimization method and strategy for the aircraft secondary energy system architecture, which improves the reliability of the entire optimization process.

title: A 3D point cloud semantic segmentation method based on deep feature representation
description: The invention discloses a three-dimensional point cloud semantic segmentation method based on depth feature expression. Comprises the following steps of 1: collecting and processing a data set related to the three-dimensional point cloud for training a model; step 2: preprocessing data in the model training process; and step 3: establishing a depth network model, inputting point cloud data into an edge feature module to obtain an edge feature, inputting a feature tensor obtained by inputting the edge feature into a U-increment module, and inputting the feature tensor into an attention weight module; repeating the operation for multiple times, integrating the obtained results each time, and inputting the integrated results into a semantic segmentation module to obtain a final semantic tag endowing result; and 4, step 4: sending the data obtained after the processing in the step 2 into the parameters of the network established in the step 3 for training; and 5: the model is tested. The method and the device realize the full extraction of the hidden information in the point cloud, solve the problem of local information loss in the three-dimensional point cloud characteristic processing process, reduce the required parameters, and have high precision and high speed.

title: Intelligent service method for equipment leasing based on cloud computing
description: This application relates to equipment leasing in the field of cloud computing. Cloud computing is to decompose a huge amount of data processing programs into countless small programs through the network cloud, and then process and analyze these small programs through a system composed of multiple servers to obtain results. In the rental of equipment, for example, when the current shared bicycle is riding, the specific riding data of the shared bicycle can be obtained on the cloud server. Correspondingly, the present application proposes an intelligent service method for equipment leasing based on cloud computing. The method obtains the riding route data and riding speed data of the shared bicycle during a certain riding process, and compares the data with the reference route data and the riding speed data. Compare with reference speed data to determine whether the riding process is within the normal range. In this way, maintenance companies of shared bicycles can use this to profile users and the usage of shared bicycles, thereby reducing the maintenance cost of shared bicycles for rental companies.

title: A kind of abnormal head portrait identification method and device
description: The present application relates to the field of computer technology, and in particular, to a method and device for identifying an abnormal avatar, for obtaining first image feature information of an avatar to be identified; The image feature information is matched, and the target avatar is an avatar whose security level reaches the set level; when it is determined that the target avatar is matched, it is determined whether the to-be-identified avatar is an abnormal avatar according to a preset security control strategy. In this way, through feature extraction And similar matching, and then to identify abnormal avatars, improve the accuracy and efficiency of abnormal avatar recognition.

title: Ceramic tile label recognition model training method and ceramic tile label recognition method
description: The invention relates to a ceramic tile label recognition model training method and a ceramic tile label recognition method. After a picture to be recognized of a ceramic tile to be recognized is obtained, when the spray printing mark is a line mark, the line mark is recognized from the picture to be recognized through a line recognition algorithm and used as a ceramic tile label recognition result, when the character mark is a character mark, the picture to be recognized is input into a ceramic tile label recognition model, and a prediction result of the ceramic tile label recognition model is used as a ceramic tile label recognition result. Based on this, through the label identification mode of difference, richen the label identification demand of each type ceramic tile, the ceramic tile label of being convenient for improves and bears the weight of information volume, improves ceramic tile label's practicality.

title: Sediment particle identification method and device in complex river environment based on deep learning
