description: The invention discloses a method and a device for identifying silt particles in a complex river environment based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting an original image of silt particles in a complex river environment; processing the original image to generate an image which rotates 90 degrees anticlockwise, a horizontal turnover image, a weak deformation image and a strong deformation image corresponding to the original image; inputting an original image and an image which is rotated by 90 degrees anticlockwise and corresponds to the original image, a horizontally flipped image, a weakly deformed image and a strongly deformed image into a pre-trained sediment particle recognition model, and outputting five sediment particle recognition results corresponding to the original image, wherein the sediment particle recognition model is obtained by performing machine learning training on a U-net model; and determining the final silt particle identification result of the original image according to the five silt particle identification results corresponding to the original image. The invention can improve the identification accuracy of the sediment particles in the complex river environment.

title: Text processing method and device and model training method and device
description: The disclosure provides a text processing method and device and a model training method and device, and relates to the technical field of data processing. The text processing method comprises the following steps: determining a first language text module based on the first language text and a second language text module based on the second language text; sentence and word splitting operation is respectively carried out on the first language text module and the second language text module to generate a plurality of first language text units and a plurality of second language text units; and determining a parallel sentence pair corresponding to the first language text module and the second language text module based on the plurality of first language text units and the plurality of second language text units. The method makes full use of the structural characteristics of the text, and converts the corresponding text module into the text unit comprising fragmented sentence segmentation and word segmentation by means of sentence word splitting operation, so that the method can fully take the potential semantic information between sentences into consideration, and further can effectively improve the construction effect of parallel sentence pairs.

title: A perception information integrated access system based on important urban infrastructure
description: The present invention proposes an integrated access system for perception information based on important urban infrastructure, including: a support layer: including a basic database and a knowledge base; a core business layer: including a diagnosis center, an emergency dispatch center, a security center, a data center, and a monitoring center , operation center, user center and operation and maintenance center; data application layer: including statistical analysis center and data sharing center. The system is based on the Internet of Things technology to obtain a variety of real-time monitoring information, and based on the MQTT technology, it connects to the existing monitoring system data, and establishes and maintains a holographic digital mapping model through the multi-dimensional perception data correlation analysis algorithm of big data and deep learning. Intelligent assessment, simulation, real-time early warning and rapid response of important infrastructure disasters and emergencies.

title: A method and system for obtaining deep learning model structure based on side channel information
description: A method for obtaining a deep learning model structure based on side channel information comprises the following steps: (S1): setting up an experimental platform for acquiring power information of the embedded intelligent equipment during operation; (S2): the method comprises the steps that a convolution layer, a pooling layer, an activation function layer and a full connection layer are independently operated on the embedded intelligent device respectively, and meanwhile, power consumption information is collected in real time; (S3): processing the collected power information; (S4): building a model structure classifier based on a convolutional neural network, and training the acquired data; (S5): and analyzing the model by using the generated deep learning model structure classifier, and presenting the test result in a mode of a confusion matrix. The invention also comprises a system for acquiring the deep learning model structure based on the side channel information. The invention can identify the specific structure of the model by using a proper convolutional neural network according to the power consumption track.

title: A Neural Network-Based Chip Screening Method
description: The invention discloses a chip screening method based on a neural network, which uses the S-parameter test data of the chip, calculates and compares the S-parameters through a neural network formula, intercepts abnormal chips with an early failure risk, and prevents them from becoming qualified products. Compared with the existing methods of manually screening chips, the subjectivity is less and the reliability is high. In the mass production test stage of the chip, the present invention adds a chip screening test program on the original test platform, and because no new test equipment is introduced, the test cost is low, the speed is fast, and the environment is simple. The invention can significantly restrain the interference effect of the normal fluctuation of the chip mass production test on the mass production test, and deeply intercept the chip with failure risk from the perspective of the S-parameter AC signal, thereby reducing the early failure rate of the chip.

title: NAND flash memory signal detection method and system based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting NAND flash memory signals based on a convolutional neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: setting parameters of an MLCNAND flash memory channel and generating a threshold voltage sequence; s2: constructing and training a convolutional neural network model; s3: inputting the threshold voltage sequence into the trained convolutional neural network model, and outputting the average posterior probability of each threshold voltage region; s4: the log-likelihood ratio of the threshold voltage region is calculated using the average posterior probability of the threshold voltage region. The invention outputs the average posterior probability of each threshold voltage area by constructing the convolutional neural network, thereby obtaining the log-likelihood ratio of the threshold voltage area, avoiding obtaining the log-likelihood ratio corresponding to each bit by the convolutional neural network again, reducing the delay and loss of the flash signal and improving the precision of the log-likelihood ratio.

title: Item information display method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable medium
description: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses an article information display method, an article information display device, an electronic device and a computer readable medium. One embodiment of the method comprises: generating a user behavior rule vector according to the user behavior information sequence of the target user; generating a user characteristic cross vector according to the user information of the target user; determining the acquisition probability of the target user to the target object based on the user behavior rule vector and the user characteristic cross vector; and controlling the terminal equipment of the target user to display the article information of the target article according to the acquisition probability. According to the embodiment, more accurate article information display is realized, the value transfer operation of the target user can be promoted, and the circulation rate of the target article is improved.

title: Safe multi-party computing method based on neural network model
description: The invention relates to the technical field of block chains, in particular to a safe multi-party computing method based on a neural network model, which comprises the following steps: establishing a host side, and constructing a neural network model by the host side; the host automatically generates a plurality of groups of input numbers; the function result is used as a label to form sample data; training and testing a neural network model using sample data; the host publishes a neural network model; the participants substitute the privacy numbers into the weighting and calculation formula to obtain an intermediate value, and the intermediate value is sent to the host; after receiving all the intermediate values, the host sums the intermediate values, and adds the intermediate values to the offset value to obtain the input number of the layer 1 neuron; after the input numbers of all neurons of the layer 1 are obtained, the output of the neural network model is obtained through calculation, namely the result of safe multi-party calculation. The substantial effects of the invention are as follows: the neural network model is used for fitting any objective function to obtain a safe multi-party calculation scheme, and the application range of the safe multi-party calculation is expanded.

title: A Baseline Method for Person Re-identification Based on Hierarchical Self-Attention Networks
description: The invention provides a pedestrian re-identification baseline method based on a hierarchical self-attention network, which belongs to the field of computer vision. In the present invention, the Swin Transformer is creatively introduced into the field of pedestrian re-identification as the backbone network, and the weighted sum of ID loss and Circle loss is used as the loss function. At the same time, the feature extraction ability is improved. Compared with the traditional ResNet-based baseline method, the present invention significantly improves the effect of person re-identification.

title: Intersection detection and classification in autonomous machine applications
description: In various examples, live perception from sensors of a vehicle can be utilized to detect and classify intersections in the environment of the vehicle in real-time or near real-time. For example, a Deep Neural Network (DNN) may be trained to compute various outputs, such as bounding box coordinates of an intersection, an intersection overlay corresponding to the bounding box, intersection attributes, a distance to the intersection, and/or a distance overlay associated with the intersection. The output may be decoded and/or post-processed to determine the final location of, distance to, and/or attributes of the detected intersection.

title: Data processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present disclosure provides a data processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium, wherein the method includes: acquiring a panoramic video obtained by using an image acquisition device to collect images of a target place; generating the target based on the panoramic video The three-dimensional model of the place; the three-dimensional model includes: a plurality of position points; based on the positions of the plurality of the position points in the three-dimensional model, the plurality of the position points are respectively projected to a preset plane to obtain the Sectional view of the target site.

title: A Genetic Algorithm-Based Classification Rule Threshold Optimization Method
description: A classification rule threshold optimization method based on genetic algorithm relates to the fields of remote sensing image-based classification, data mining and the like. The present invention prepares remote sensing classification features and existing classification results according to the classification rules, finds the features involved in the classification rules and calculates its value range As the upper and lower limits of the optimization threshold, the classification rule threshold is used as the recommended threshold; the genetic algorithm is initialized and the remote sensing classification features are classified according to the rules and the randomly generated threshold in the evaluation function, compared with the existing classification results and the error rate is calculated as the current threshold. Fitness; record the minimum error rate of each generation in the monitoring function, and end the iteration when the minimum error rate remains unchanged; run the genetic algorithm to obtain a series of thresholds and minimum error rates when the minimum error rate remains unchanged; the threshold corresponding to the minimum error rate is the optimization threshold. The invention can efficiently optimize the threshold of the classification rule, and overcomes the problem that the visual judgment method is difficult to effectively optimize the threshold when the classification rule involves multiple indicators.

title: Information processing apparatus, generation method, and generation program
description: An information processing device (10) calculates the amount of information for each of the segmentation methods when using each label, which is a candidate for an index when dividing the data, for a data set divided by labels. Then, the information processing device (10) divides the data into a plurality of data sets based on the division method of the highest information content among the calculated information quantities, and generates a learned model for each data set using the divided data sets.

title: Ontology-based drug quality verification laboratory management system
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of medicine quality detection, and particularly relates to a body-based medicine quality verification laboratory management system, which specifically comprises the following steps: collecting medicine knowledge, and constructing an ontology concept knowledge base; extracting key data from an ontology concept knowledge base to obtain an ontology concept; constructing an ontology knowledge framework according to the ontology concept; constructing an ontology problem set and a verification set by a domain expert, obtaining a result set by the problem set through an ontology knowledge framework, and then comparing the result set with the verification set to obtain ontology credibility data; and verifying the credibility data through a prototype system to finally obtain an effective body. The invention combines the association data and the data quality technology, carries out data association between different ontologies on the basis of establishing an ontology knowledge base, continuously corrects the ontology knowledge base through field experts, verifies the credibility of the ontology according to actual requirements, improves a large amount of defects of medicine knowledge, achieves the aim of controlling the ontology quality of different medicine knowledge, and visually quantifies and manages the ontology quality.

title: A small loan credit evaluation method integrating income expectation
description: The invention relates to the field of financial risk control, and discloses a small loan credit evaluation method fusing income expectation. The patent provides a small loan credit evaluation method fusing income expectation, which is characterized in that the evaluation of income brought by an applicant is completed while the default of the applicant is predicted by using a machine learning algorithm through self-defining the actual annual income rate and an income confusion matrix and designing the income expectation as a target function, and finally the most valuable loan application is predicted.

title: Resource library generation method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The disclosure relates to a resource library generation method, a resource library generation device, an electronic device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: randomly generating an element group to be detected; inputting the element group to be detected into a preset target network model to obtain the output probability that the element group to be detected meets a preset condition; the target network model is obtained by training a preset initial network model by taking an element group in a first resource library as a positive sample and a random element group obtained by random sampling as a negative sample, wherein the element group meeting a preset condition is stored in the first resource library and is a combination of at least one interaction unit interacting in one task; and screening the element group to be detected with the output probability in the first preset interval to form a second resource library. According to the method and the device, the output probability corresponding to the randomly generated element group to be detected is obtained through the target network model, the element groups of which the output probabilities are in the first preset interval can be rapidly and massively obtained conveniently, the corresponding second resource library is obtained, and the construction efficiency of the resource library is improved.

title: A vehicle image retrieval method based on local area aware deep learning
description: The invention discloses a vehicle image retrieval method based on a local area perception convolutional neural network, and aims to solve the problem that vehicles of the same manufacturer and the same model are difficult to distinguish according to global appearance in vehicle image retrieval. It is proposed to combine these local details of local areas such as windshields, detection tags, decorations, etc. to search to form a deep network model containing both the local areas by attributes (color, id, type), which network model consists of several shared convolutional layers and three branches. The three branches mainly comprise convolution branches, attribute branches and local area branches, and each branch corresponds to a separate classifier Softmax loss function. The model is proposed to be applied to not only the label attribute but also the local region feature, so that the accuracy of vehicle image retrieval can be improved.

title: Prediction method, device, electronic device and storage medium of subway operation state
description: The disclosure provides a method and a device for predicting the running state of a subway, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical fields of intelligent transportation, artificial intelligence and the like. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring air pressure information of a mobile terminal used by a user on a subway at each moment in a time window; and predicting the operation state of the subway in the time window based on the air pressure information at each moment in the time window. According to the technology disclosed by the invention, the recognition efficiency of the subway running state can be effectively improved.

title: A FM-based IP first access detection method, system and device
description: The present application discloses an FM-based IP first access detection method, system and device, which mainly relate to the technical field of access detection, and are used to solve the technical problem of the high false positive rate of the existing first access detection method. The method includes: determining the access frequency between the source IP and the destination IP according to the source IP and the destination IP in several historical traffic access logs; obtaining the trained preset FM algorithm; according to the trained preset FM algorithm and the preset network A grid search algorithm is used to obtain the parameter list between the source IP and the destination IP; the list includes the access probability between the source IP and the destination IP; the actual access destination IP of the source IP is obtained, when the actual access destination IP corresponds to the parameter list When the first access probability of , is less than the preset access probability, it is determined that the source IP has the first access behavior. The present application reduces the false alarm rate of the first detection by the above method.

title: Multi-objective optimization management method for standard substances
description: A multi-objective optimization management method for standard substances comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a standard substance multi-objective optimization management model; s2, encoding the information of the standard substance; s3, checking whether the storage cabinet has the same standard substance with the same type as the target standard substance in the cells according to the code of the target standard substance; s4, if the same standard substance with the same type as the target standard substance exists in at least two cells, comparing the output value of the target function, and selecting one cell to store or deliver from the warehouse according to the comparison result; and S5, responding to the fact that the same standard substance with the same type as the target standard substance does not exist in the storage cabinet, and performing optimization solution on the standard substance in the storage link by adopting a mixed BAS-SA algorithm. The standard substance information coding method provided by the application enables standard substance management to be more accurate.

title: System and method for achieving high resolution of genetic data using a training set
description: Systems, methods, and computer program products for generating enhanced sequence sets for taxonomic classification are disclosed. In various embodiments, multiple reference sequences are received. Each of the plurality of reference sequences corresponds to a taxonomic classification. A marker corresponding to at least one of the reference sequences is assigned to each of the plurality of complementary sequences. Each of the multiple complementary sequences and each of the multiple reference sequences are truncated to the region of interest, resulting in a truncated sequence set. The similarity between pairs of truncated sequences in the set of truncated sequences is measured to determine whether the similarity is above a predetermined threshold. When the similarity is above a predetermined threshold, intermediate taxonomic markers are assigned to truncated sequence pairs in the truncated sequence set, resulting in an enhanced sequence set.

title: A SVM Vp/Vs Prediction Method Based on Small Sample Machine Learning
description: The invention discloses a SVM Vp/Vs prediction method based on small sample machine learning in the cross field of machine learning and geophysical prediction. The method first uses the wave impedance Ip and Vp curve data of at least one well and the label data Vp/Vs (dipole acoustic wave data is required) to iteratively train the small-sample machine learning SVM model and achieve the required accuracy. Then the trained SVM Vp/Vs prediction model is applied to other dipole-free sonic wells Vp/Vs prediction. By using the method of the invention, the Vp/Vs curve prediction can be carried out for the acoustic wave data well without dipoles, and the method is fast and convenient, and the work efficiency is improved by more than 10 times compared with the traditional method. The method of the present invention is particularly suitable for areas with fewer wells.

title: A crowdsourced trajectory matching method and system based on HMM model
description: The invention provides a crowd-sourced trajectory matching method and system based on an HMM model, wherein the matching method comprises the following steps: constructing a continuous observation state sequence by using multi-source track points, constructing a hidden state set of each observation track point on a road network, and calculating the output probability from each hidden state to the corresponding observation state and the conversion probability between two hidden state points in two adjacent hidden state sets; calculating the probability from each hidden state in the current hidden state set to the next observation state; obtaining an implicit state chain with the maximum probability corresponding to the observation state sequence through a Viterbi algorithm; and acquiring the optimal matching sequence corresponding to the observation state sequence on the road network based on the implicit state chain. When the continuous track sequence is matched with the road network, the topological property of the road network is fully utilized, and scenes with complicated topological communication, such as intersections, can be dealt with.

title: A Generative Adversarial Network-Based Small-Sample Fault Diagnosis Method for Rotating Machinery
description: The invention discloses a rotary machine small sample fault diagnosis method based on a generation countermeasure network, which comprises the steps of firstly converting collected rotary machine time domain signals into frequency spectrum signals with characteristics easy to observe through Fast Fourier Transform (FFT); and then, on the basis of ACWGAN-GP, an ACWGAN-GP-ARGMAX diagnosis model is obtained by introducing an ARGMAX multi-classification idea. The diagnosis model endows the discriminator with classification and identification capabilities, enhances the classification and identification capabilities of the discriminator, and can effectively improve the accuracy and efficiency of fault diagnosis of small samples of rotary machines.

title: A lightweight multi-scale infrared image super-resolution reconstruction method
description: A light-weight multi-scale infrared image super-resolution reconstruction method belongs to the technical field of image super-resolution reconstruction, and aims to solve the problems in the prior art, the method constructs a network model: the entire network comprises four main modules: the device comprises a shallow layer feature extraction module, a deep layer feature extraction module, an information fusion module and an up-sampling module. Preparing a data set: performing analog degradation on the data set, and using the obtained high-resolution image pair and the obtained low-resolution image pair to train the whole convolutional neural network; training a network model: inputting the low-resolution images of the data set prepared in the step 2 into the neural network model constructed in the step 1 for training; a loss function value is minimized, namely the loss function of the image and the label is output through a minimized network until the training times reach a set threshold value or the value of the loss function reaches a set range; training and fine-tuning the model; and (4) storing the model: and (5) solidifying the finally determined model parameters, and directly inputting the image into a network when super-resolution reconstruction is required.

title: Method and device for detecting malicious domain name
description: The invention discloses a malicious domain name detection method and device, comprising: acquiring a domain name to be detected, and generating a bipartite graph of the domain name based on a pre-built bipartite graph set based on each domain name to be detected; generating a bipartite graph based on the domain name encoding vector of the domain name; inputting the encoding vector into the trained detection model; determining whether the domain name is a malicious domain name based on the output result of the detection model. The method of the present disclosure converts the connection relationship of the domain name into the bipartite graph of the domain name, generates the encoding vector of the domain name node to be detected based on the corresponding bipartite graph, and uses the trained detection model to classify the domain name, thereby effectively improving the malicious domain name. Identify the effect.

title: Exhaled breath detection-based disease risk assessment method and device and related products
description: The invention discloses a disease risk assessment method and device based on exhaled breath detection and a related product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring exhaled air samples of a patient and a healthy person which are respectively acquired, and constructing a data set of the exhaled air samples of a human body; randomly selecting exhaled breath samples in the data set according to a preset proportion to form a training set and a testing set; extracting a plurality of characteristics extracted from each exhaled breath sample in the training set, and establishing a preliminary risk assessment model; verifying and optimizing the preliminary risk assessment model through a test set, and iteratively selecting a data set for multiple times to obtain a final risk assessment model; detecting and evaluating the blind sample to obtain a disease risk score value or a probability value; the subjects who corresponded to the blind samples were assessed for risk of disease. The method can quickly detect the exhaled breath of the human body, evaluate the risk of blindness cancer and infectious diseases, and has the advantages of simple and clear operation, high analysis efficiency and accurate detection.

title: A method and system for assisting editing of documents
description: The embodiments of this specification disclose a method for assisting editing of a document, applied to a client, including: a method for assisting editing of a document, applied to a client, including: receiving and displaying a second text obtained by a server based on a first text The first text includes at least one discourse, each discourse includes at least one key point; the second text includes at least one structural node corresponding to the at least one discourse or/and at least one key point; the second text also includes at least one discourse or at least one key point. At least one text unit corresponding to a structural node; when detecting that the structural node is triggered, an acquisition request for the target text unit corresponding to the structural node is generated, and the acquisition request is sent to the server; the target text unit and the target text acquired by the server are received and displayed multiple adjacent text units of the unit; obtain the modification instruction for the target text unit; after executing the modification instruction, display the updated target text unit.

title: A method for predicting the strength and resistance to chloride ion permeability of geopolymer mortar
description: The invention belongs to the field of building materials, and particularly relates to a prediction method for strength and chloride ion permeability resistance of geopolymer mortar, which comprises the following steps; s1 design the proportion of geopolymer mortar adopts a controlled variable method, namely, the water-cement ratio, the cement-sand ratio, the water glass modulus and the cement ratio are fixed, and the nano SiO is singly changed 2 Or the doping amount of the PVA fiber; through the design and training of the model, the function of accurately predicting the compressive strength and the electric flux value of the chlorine ion permeability resistance index of the geopolymer mortar is realized, the problems of low verification efficiency and high cost of the electric flux value of the compressive performance and the chlorine ion permeability resistance index of the existing geopolymer mortar are solved, and the prediction of the electric flux value of the chlorine ion permeability resistance index of the geopolymer mortar is improvedThe compressive strength and the chloride ion permeability resistance are indicative of the convenience and accuracy of the electrical flux values.

title: A U-Net++ cell segmentation network system, method, device and terminal
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical image processing, and discloses a U-Net + + cell segmentation network system, a method, equipment and a terminal, wherein the U-Net + + cell segmentation method comprises the following steps: carrying out initialization preprocessing on an input image through data enhancement, data normalization and normalized image size operations; training a U-Net + + cell segmentation model based on a multi-scale and multi-feature fusion module, adding the multi-scale module and the multi-feature fusion module based on the U-Net + + network, and segmenting an input image to obtain a primary segmentation result; accurately segmenting adhesion areas in the cell segmentation images by using a watershed algorithm; and (4) segmenting the images in the verification set by adopting an example method and the prior art respectively, and carrying out a comparison experiment and analysis. The method is based on the U-Net + + network, improves the accuracy of the segmentation result by integrating the characteristics under different scales, and ensures stable segmentation precision.

title: Rational Adversarial Patch Generation Method
description: The invention relates to a method for generating a reasonable countermeasure patch, which comprises the following steps: a. selecting images with rationality, extracting contour features and randomly initializing countermeasure patches; b. the countermeasure patch is pasted on the original sample to generate a countermeasure sample; c. carrying out patch attack on a target detection model by using the countermeasure sample, and updating the countermeasure patch under the condition of no rationality constraint; d. c, taking the countermeasure patch obtained in the step c as an initial patch, and taking the image as a rationality constraint condition to attack the target detection model to generate a rationality countermeasure patch; e. and adjusting the weight parameters of the rationality constraint conditions, respectively evaluating the rationality and the aggressivity of the rationality counterpatch according to the rationality index and the AP value, and selecting the rationality counterpatch with the best rationality and aggressivity. The generated reasonable confrontation patch is reasonable in both antagonism and rationality, and can avoid a target detection model and human eyes at the same time.

title: Text matching method, training method and device for text matching model
description: The present disclosure provides a text matching method, a text matching model training method, device, equipment, medium and product, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical fields of natural language processing and deep learning. The text matching method includes: performing word segmentation processing on the target text to obtain initial words; processing the initial words to obtain target words, wherein the amount of text semantic information contained in the target words is lower than the amount of text semantic information contained in the initial words; Extract the word feature of the target word; obtain the text feature for the target text based on the word feature of the target word; match the text feature of the target text and the text feature of the candidate text to obtain the relationship between the target text and the candidate text. similarity.

title: Object three-dimensional shape reconstruction method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for reconstructing a three-dimensional shape of an object, which relate to artificial intelligence image processing and comprise the following steps: normalizing the two-dimensional image comprising a single object to obtain a normalized image; inputting the normalized image into an object shape reconstruction network, acquiring corresponding characteristic information through a characteristic extractor of the object shape reconstruction network, and inputting the characteristic information into a generator of the object shape reconstruction network to obtain a confidence three-dimensional tensor of a predicted voxel of an object; and performing binarization processing on each element in the three-dimensional reliability tensor based on a preset threshold value to obtain a voxel expressing the three-dimensional shape of the object. The method can accurately and efficiently recover the three-dimensional structure of the object from the two-dimensional image, improve the efficiency of three-dimensional shape reconstruction, and save manpower and material resources.

title: Recognition method of radar high-resolution range image noise reduction based on GAN and self-attention
description: The invention discloses a high-resolution range profile noise reduction identification method based on GAN and self-attention, which mainly solves the problems that the characteristics with strong separability are taken as noise to be eliminated and long-distance dependence information cannot be extracted in the existing radar high-resolution range profile noise reduction identification technology. The implementation scheme is as follows: 1) acquiring a target radar echo, and generating a training sample set and a test sample set; 2) constructing a radar high-resolution range profile noise reduction identification network which is composed of a generator, a discriminator and an identifier and is based on GAN and self attention; 3) training the noise reduction recognition network constructed in the step 2) by using a training sample set and adopting a back propagation algorithm; 4) and inputting the test sample set into a trained radar high-resolution range profile noise reduction and identification network to obtain a radar high-resolution range profile noise reduction and identification result. The method improves the target recognition rate in the low signal-to-noise ratio environment, and can be used for recognizing the airplane and satellite targets in the low signal-to-noise ratio environment.

title: A method, device, device and storage medium for monitoring network data
description: The utility model provides a monitoring method, a device, equipment and a storage medium of network data, wherein the method can be applied to a hyper-integration all-in-one machine, firstly, a distributed data acquisition system is used for acquiring the network data of a target monitoring object; inputting the network data into an identification model corresponding to the data type based on the data type to which the network data belongs; then, carrying out identification processing on the network data by using an identification model, and determining whether the network data belong to preset risk data; and if the network data are determined to belong to the preset risk data, performing early warning processing on the network data based on a pre-configured early warning mode. Therefore, the method and the device can determine whether the network data belong to the preset risk data or not based on the type of the network data and the identification model corresponding to the data type, can monitor the risk data, and perform early warning on the risk data, so that the monitoring discovery capability and the emergency disposal capability are improved.

title: Product analysis method and system, device and medium
description: The invention discloses a product analysis method, system, device and medium, and relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing and artificial intelligence. The predicted value of the production process parameter; the SHAP value of each production process parameter is calculated and obtained based on the predicted value of each production process parameter. Names of key process links and several key production process parameters.

title: A method, device, electronic device and storage medium for evaluating the degree of haze
description: The invention relates to a haze degree evaluation method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the haze degree evaluation method comprises the following steps: s1, traversing the haze image through a preset sliding window, and respectively acquiring a dark channel model corresponding to the haze image through a minimization operation and acquiring a bright channel model corresponding to the haze image through a maximization operation based on the atmospheric scattering model; s2, acquiring first difference information of bright channel information of the original image and bright channel information of the haze image based on the dark channel model and the bright channel model, wherein the first difference information is a first function containing the dark channel information of the haze image and the bright channel information of the haze image; s3, obtaining the mean value of the first difference information based on the traversal process and the first function as a first evaluation index, and obtaining a haze degree evaluation result according to the first evaluation index. The haze degree evaluation method and the haze degree evaluation device have the advantages that the haze degree evaluation process is simplified, and meanwhile, the haze degree evaluation result is guaranteed.

title: A Trajectory Prediction Method Based on Fusion Inverse Reinforcement Learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of pedestrian trajectory prediction and analysis, in particular to a trajectory prediction method based on fusion inverse reinforcement learning, which comprises S1, generating a path rewarding map and an end point rewarding map based on an input observation trajectory and a scene map; s2, obtaining a path by sampling the strategy by using an inverse reinforcement learning algorithm; s3, path position coding is carried out by using a full convolution network, a scene path is coded by fusing a bidirectional gating circulation unit, and the scene path and a pedestrian observation track are fused. According to the method, the ENet network is extracted by introducing the light-weight characteristics, so that the algorithm parameter quantity is reduced, and the generalization capability of the algorithm understanding scene is improved; by using the attention mechanism module of the scene, scene information and pedestrian observation tracks are better fused, and compared with a mainstream algorithm, the scene-oriented pedestrian track prediction network S2Tirl has a better effect on public data sets and actual data.

title: Methods and devices for evaluating the quality of public spaces
description: The invention provides a method and a device for evaluating quality of a public space. The method comprises the steps of obtaining index factor data, and determining an index factor set and an evaluation grade set of a target object; determining a fuzzy relation from the qualitative index factors to the evaluation grade set to obtain a fuzzy relation matrix of the qualitative index factors; carrying out statistical normalization on the quantitative index factor data to obtain a fuzzy relation matrix of the quantitative index factors, and synthesizing a comprehensive fuzzy relation matrix; calculating the weight of the index factors to obtain a weight vector; synthesizing the weight vector and the comprehensive fuzzy relation matrix to obtain an evaluation value of the target object; and carrying out single-valued processing on the evaluation value, and evaluating the public space quality of the target object through the obtained evaluation single value of the target object. In this way, qualitative and quantitative comprehensive quantitative evaluation of the public space quality is realized, and the evaluation accuracy of the public space quality can be effectively improved.

title: A rapid detection method for strawberry powdery mildew in greenhouse production environment
description: The invention relates to a rapid detection method for strawberry powdery mildew in a greenhouse production environment. The method comprises: collecting back images of powdery mildew diseased leaves under different lighting conditions in a greenhouse strawberry production environment, and performing detection on the back images according to the disease, diseased leaves and other leaves. Annotation; construct the DW‑YOLOv4 network, the network includes two parts: the backbone network module and the fusion feature extraction module: the backbone network module: It is obtained by using five sets of cross-stage local network modules based on depthwise separable convolution; The three output feature maps of the 3rd, 4th, and 5th cross-stage local networks based on depthwise separable convolutional structures are used as inputs to form three output feature maps with different scales; the collected images are input into the DW‑YOLOv4 network Realize the detection of strawberry leaf powdery mildew disease area and diseased leaves, solve the problem of difficulty in the initial detection of strawberry powdery mildew disease, and realize the rapid detection and disease grading of strawberry powdery mildew.

title: Multispectral image change detection method based on geospatial perception low-rank reconstruction network
description: The invention discloses a multispectral image change detection method based on a geospatial perception low-rank reconstruction network, which comprises the steps of firstly defining a twin multi-temporal remote sensing image feature extraction framework, and extracting multi-scale spatial spectrum combined features of a multispectral image with sub-meter resolution; according to the proposed geographic space perception module, the extracted feature of the offset of the double-time-phase image feature map is corrected, so that the actual spatial contents of the feature map correspond to each other, the position sequence of the one-to-one correspondence of the inherent spatial pixels is broken, and a sparse spatial correction feature map is obtained through subtraction. Meanwhile, in order to separate effective low-rank feature expression from the corrected feature map, the problem is described as the reconstruction constraint problem of the features, the feature embedding of fine-grained change detection is realized, the purpose of overcoming various pseudo-changes is achieved, and the multispectral image change detection precision is effectively improved.

title: A license plate recognition method in haze environment
description: The invention provides a license plate recognition method in a haze environment, which aims to reduce the influence of the haze on the boundaries and features of the license plate in the image, so as to correctly identify the license plate. First, a dark channel prior algorithm based on local estimation of atmospheric light value is used to initially dehaze the blurred image. Then the image is further dehazed. On the basis of the target detection convolutional neural network, the license plate region is detected by the joint dehazing and region extraction model JFRM, which greatly reduces the distortion of image restoration and accurately extracts the license plate dehazing. image. Finally, image super-resolution is achieved by convolution-enhanced SRCNN, which can successfully recognize license plate characters. The invention improves the accuracy of license plate recognition in the haze environment.

title: Concrete crack detection method based on ConcreteCrackSegNet model
description: The present invention provides a concrete crack detection method based on the ConcreteCrackSegNet model. The photos taken by the drone are input into the ConcreteCrackSegNet model for detection, and then the predicted segmented concrete crack images are output through prediction; the ConcreteCrackSegNet model of the present invention is According to the specific characteristics of concrete crack segmentation combined with experiments, it is proposed that the color demarcation of concrete cracks is not obvious, and the cracks have a certain continuity. The test fully considers the indistinguishability and continuity of cracks. The method of the invention has high segmentation accuracy for pictures, can detect the crack damage of the concrete structure, thus can monitor the derivation of the crack of the concrete structure early, provide support for the maintenance department to propose a scientific pre-curing decision, and can save a lot of manpower and material resources at the same time .

title: Method for identifying neurogenic damage of needle pole electromyogram in cross-site manner
description: The invention relates to a method for identifying neurogenic damage in acupuncture electromyography across parts. The method comprises the following steps: in the first step, a certain preprocessing is performed on the original electromyographic signal input into the system; in the second step, the Feature extraction is performed on the preprocessed needle pole EMG data, and the extracted features are cascaded to form feature vectors   ; The third step is to analyze the characteristic data of acupuncture EMG of a certain part   , input into the ensemble classifier, perform ensemble learning, and use the weighted ensemble strategy to realize the ensemble learning of the output results of multiple classifiers, and realize the prediction output of all sample data of each individual; the fourth step, in the classification stage, Combine the predicted probabilities of multiple classifiers   Do a weighted summation to get the final predicted probability   , 0.5 is used as the threshold to judge whether the disease is sick or not, so as to realize the classification of EMG signals; among them,  wi  is the probability weight of each classifier.

title: A method and device for processing oil drilling big data based on machine learning
description: The invention discloses a method and device for processing big data of oil drilling based on machine learning, comprising: acquiring real-time logging data and drilling risk record data of historical wells; Build and train multiple drilling risk identification and early warning models; input the real-time logging data of target wells into each drilling risk identification and early warning model according to the input parameters of different drilling risk identification and early warning models to perform real-time identification of drilling risks of target wells Early warning processing. By adopting the technical scheme of the present invention, real-time and effective identification and early warning of drilling risks can be realized, and the purpose of improving the accuracy of risk early warning is achieved.

title: Regional carbon emission monitoring and early warning system
description: The invention provides a monitoring and early warning system for carbon emissions in a region, including: a data acquisition module, a data processing module, a trend prediction module and a prevention alarm module; the data acquisition module is used for real-time acquisition of raw data for determining carbon emissions; the The data processing module is used to process the real-time collected raw data and calculate carbon emissions; the trend prediction module is used to predict the future trend of carbon emissions according to the processed raw data and carbon emissions calculation results; the prevention The alarm module is used to make preventive alarms based on the forecast results of carbon emission trends. The present invention not only calculates the carbon emission amount through various kinds of raw data collected in real time, but also carries out the future trend development and change of each kind of data through the various kinds of raw data collected in real time. Early warning, to realize real-time monitoring and advance warning of carbon emissions in the region.

title: A method, device, device and storage medium for generating a three-dimensional heart model
description: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for generating a heart three-dimensional model, and aims to quickly and accurately acquire a heart two-dimensional ultrasonic image and establish the heart three-dimensional model. The method comprises the following steps: clamping an ultrasonic probe by a mechanical arm to acquire a plurality of groups of heart two-dimensional ultrasonic images; performing three-dimensional reconstruction on the multiple groups of heart two-dimensional ultrasonic images to obtain multiple heart three-dimensional prior models; carrying out self-supervision training on the deep neural network through the multiple groups of cardiac two-dimensional ultrasonic images and the multiple cardiac three-dimensional prior models to obtain a cardiac three-dimensional model generation network; and executing a heart three-dimensional model generation task through the heart three-dimensional model generation network to obtain a heart three-dimensional model.

title: Target clue finding method, device, equipment and medium
description: The application provides a target clue searching method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a collection clue of the target object, wherein the collection clue comprises time information corresponding to the target object and position information corresponding to the target object; calling a video stream matched with the position information according to the position information corresponding to the target object, and determining a video segment matched with the time information corresponding to the target object in the video stream; analyzing and processing the video clip, and determining the target characteristics of the target object and a characteristic diagram associated with the target characteristics; performing characteristic comparison in the video clip by using the target characteristics or/and the characteristic diagram of the target object, searching for an object meeting the target characteristics or/and the characteristic diagram, and determining the object as a target clue; the searching range is narrowed according to the position information and the time information of the target object, the workload of searching by workers is reduced, and a target clue can be quickly and accurately determined by combining the target characteristic or/and the characteristic diagram associated with the target object to perform characteristic matching.

title: A method for identifying leakage of water supply network based on deep learning
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of leakage detection of a water supply network, and aims to solve the problems of difficult extraction of leakage characteristics, sensitive parameters and the like existing in a conventional noise meter processing method; secondly, the characteristics are automatically extracted for recognition through the self-learning capability of the CNN model by utilizing a large number of existing actual samples, the artificial experience limitation is broken through, and the method has more accurate leak detection capability and stronger generalization characteristic compared with the conventional signal processing method.

title: A method, device, computer storage medium and terminal for text angle classification
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a device, a computer storage medium and a terminal for text angle classification, wherein the probability value of the angle classification of a segmented subgraph is determined through anchor combination; and processing the probability value of the determined angle classification based on preset weighting information to determine the angle classification of the text. The angle classification is determined based on the subgraphs keeping the resolution ratio of the original image, and the accuracy of the text angle classification is improved.

title: Video detection method, device, equipment and medium
description: The present disclosure relates to a video detection method, device, device and medium. The video detection method includes: acquiring an image sequence to be detected, where the image sequence includes at least two video frames in the same video; for each image in the image sequence, performing nonlinear transformation processing on facial features of the image to obtain an image Corresponding attention features of multiple areas of the face; based on the attention features of multiple areas of the face corresponding to each image, construct the temporal relationship features between the multiple face regions corresponding to the image sequence; based on the temporal relationship features, calculate The probability that the video is a fake face video. According to the embodiment of the present disclosure, the accuracy of the calculation result of the probability can be higher and the generalization ability is stronger, thereby improving the detection accuracy of the fake face video.

title: A Lightweight 3D Convolutional Network-Based Vehicle Black Smoke Detection Method
description: The invention relates to the field of three-dimensional convolution network image processing, in particular to a light-weight vehicle black smoke detection method based on a three-dimensional convolution network. The invention effectively utilizes the motion characteristic of the black smoke of the vehicle, regards the black smoke as a motion target, distinguishes the motion target from interference factors such as vehicle shadow, road stain and the like, effectively utilizes the time sequence information of the video and realizes the real-time detection of the black smoke vehicle.

title: Data caching method, apparatus, device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The present application provides a data caching method, apparatus, device, and computer-readable storage medium, wherein the method includes: acquiring multiple cache policies from multiple types of cache policy libraries, and each type of cache policy library includes: At least one cache policy is of the same type, wherein the type of the cache policy library includes at least one of filter type, prefetch type, replacement type, and sacrifice cache type. The filter type cache policy is used to filter data, and the prefetch type cache policy It is used to prefetch data, the replacement type of cache policy is used to eliminate data from the cache, and the sacrifice cache type of cache policy is used to process the data eliminated from the cache; the first cache policy group including multiple cache policies is applied to the first cache policy group. Data generated by an entity. By using the above method, the caching strategy applied to the data generated by the first entity can be flexibly selected, thereby improving the caching effect of the first caching strategy group on the data generated by the first entity.

title: A federated learning system and method for life prediction of rotating machinery
description: The invention discloses a federated learning system and method applied to the life prediction of rotating machinery equipment, including local end equipment, the local end equipment establishes a data connection with a cloud optimization module, and a signal acquisition device is installed on the inner side of the local end equipment module, data calculation module, display module, data transmission module and alarm module, the signal acquisition module includes sensor module, acquisition board module, AD conversion module and storage module, and the data transmission module includes WIFI wireless transmission module and download module , the present invention adopts the method of local training and model aggregation in the cloud, which reduces unnecessary data transmission while satisfying the high precision of the algorithm, adopts the concept of federated learning to train the model, and under the premise of protecting user privacy, The successful training of a mechanical equipment remaining life predictor with wide applicability, strong safety and high prediction accuracy can well assist industrial production and life.

title: Single image reconstruction HDR method based on knowledge heuristic
description: The invention discloses a knowledge inspiration-based single image reconstruction HDR method, which is applied to the field of image processing and aims at solving the problem that the recovery result is unstable because the existing prior art is only considered from the content of an LDR image and is not combined with the imaging process from HDR to the LDR image; according to the method, a pipeline simulation mathematical formula is formed by reversely deducing HDR to LDR images, so that an LDR to HDR reconstruction basic module is constructed under the guidance of the formula to reconstruct the HDR image; the method of the invention can effectively enhance the authenticity of the reconstructed image.

title: Prosthetic control system and method with energy recovery and gait recognition functions
description: The invention provides a prosthetic limb control system and a method with energy recovery and gait recognition functions, which utilize angle signals to carry out gait recognition, the data acquisition is convenient, the adopted self-organizing competitive neural network can carry out clustering, the network parameters can be obtained by off-line training or adjusted by on-line learning, compared with the BP self-organizing competitive neural network, the self-adapting capability is stronger, the learning rule is not gradient reduction, and the probability of falling into local minimum values is greatly reduced. The energy recovery module has simple structure, is easy to realize, and can reduce cost and energy consumption.

title: Localization method of tea sprout picking point based on fusion thermal image and RGB image
description: The invention discloses a tea tender shoot picking point positioning method based on fusion of a thermal image and an RGB image, which comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring tea tender shoot image pairs of a plurality of tea tree tender shoots by using image acquisition equipment, and labeling each pair of tea tender shoot image pairs to obtain a tea tender shoot target detection database and a tea tender shoot key point detection database; secondly, respectively inputting the tender shoot target detection database and the tea tender shoot key point detection database into a target detection model and a key point model based on a deep convolutional neural network for training to respectively obtain a target detection model and a key point detection model; and finally, processing the tea tree tender shoot image pairs in sequence by utilizing the trained target detection model and key point detection model to obtain tender shoot key point positions, and positioning picking points of tea tree tender shoots in combination with tender shoot growth characteristics to obtain tender shoot picking point positions. The invention improves the precision and efficiency of positioning the picking point of the tea tender shoot.

title: Interactive information processing method, network model training method and device
description: The disclosure provides an interactive information processing method, a training method and device of a network model, equipment, a medium and a product, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of deep learning and computer vision, and can be applied to scenes such as 3D vision, augmented reality, virtual reality and the like. The specific implementation scheme comprises the following steps: responding to the acquired interactive input information, and determining interactive response information; determining face driving parameters and limb driving parameters aiming at a preset virtual image model according to the interactive input information and the interactive response information; and applying the face driving parameters and the limb driving parameters to the virtual image model to obtain an interactive response video based on the interactive response information.

title: Deep learning-based assessment method and system for osteoporotic vertebral compression fractures
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for evaluating osteoporotic vertebral compression fracture based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a clinical chest and waist three-dimensional CT original image; carrying out CT value normalization on the chest and waist three-dimensional CT original image; carrying out segmentation processing on the image data set obtained by the normalization processing based on the target vertebral body cancellous bone positioning model and the segmentation model; preprocessing an original image by using the segmented image to obtain an image with a uniform size as a data set of an input osteoporosis centrum compression fracture classification model; evaluating the data set obtained by the S4 based on an osteoporotic vertebral body compression fracture classification model DenseNet to obtain the probability of generating the osteoporotic vertebral body compression fracture; the method can assist doctors to quickly identify OVCF patients, and effectively solves the problems that the existing OVCF disease diagnosis is mostly judged subjectively by a doctor visual method, the overall diagnosis missing rate of OVCF is high, and the medical conditions and the doctor level are different.

title: A software defect prediction method based on gene expression programming algorithm
description: The invention discloses a software defect prediction method based on a gene expression programming algorithm, which comprises the following steps: s1, setting operation parameters and randomly generating a character string chromosome initialization population; s2, dividing the software defect historical data set into a training set and a testing set; s3, converting the character string chromosomes in the population into an expression tree through a tree structure; s4, decoding the expression tree and converting the expression tree into a corresponding program model; s5, calculating a fitness value according to the fitness function; s6, selecting the population by using a roulette selection mechanism; s7, evolving the population by using a gene expression programming algorithm based on the field variation; s8, repeating the steps S3 to S5; s9, checking whether the ending condition is met, if not, returning to S6, and obtaining the optimal chromosome which is the model for predicting the software defects after ending; s10, testing the obtained model through a test set to finally obtain a software defect prediction model; and S11, inputting the live software defect data into the model to obtain a prediction result. The method is simple and efficient, and can be used for predicting the software defects in the technical field of defect prediction.

title: Abnormal electricity consumption time interval detection method for smart power grid
description: The invention discloses an abnormal electricity utilization time interval detection method for an intelligent power grid, which comprises the following steps: screening out a candidate interval based on expert knowledge, and judging whether the candidate interval is a real abnormal electricity utilization time interval or not according to whether the overlapping rate of the candidate interval and the real abnormal electricity utilization time interval exceeds a threshold value or not; inputting abnormal power consumption time sequence data into a feature extraction network to obtain a feature map, performing regional weighting on the feature map through different candidate intervals to obtain a corresponding weighted feature map, and inputting the weighted feature map into a classification network and a regression network to obtain predicted candidate interval labels and predicted abnormal power consumption time intervals; calculating loss by using a real candidate interval label and a real abnormal electricity utilization time interval as real labels until the model converges; and detecting the abnormal electricity utilization time interval by using the converged model. The method can effectively extract key information from the long-time data with more redundant information and noise, thereby improving the detection speed and the detection accuracy.

title: Deep learning index enhancement method, apparatus, device, medium, and program product
description: The disclosure provides a deep learning index enhancement method which can be applied to the technical field of finance. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of characteristic indexes of each share of a stock index in a first preset trading day to form time series characteristics; calculating various statistical parameters between every two characteristic indexes in the time series characteristics to form a first characteristic matrix; inputting the time series characteristics into a convolutional neural network to obtain a second characteristic matrix; superposing the first characteristic matrix and the second characteristic matrix and inputting the superposed first characteristic matrix and second characteristic matrix into a preset long-short term memory model to obtain the rise-fall probability of each component stock within a second preset transaction day; and adjusting the weight index of each component stock based on the rise and fall probability. The present disclosure also provides a deep learning index enhancement apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product.

title: Method, device, electronic device and storage medium for identifying components in architectural drawings
description: The present application relates to a method, device, electronic device and storage medium for identifying components in architectural drawings. In the method, the corresponding CAD drawing data of high resolution is combined with an image of a local area of a target component and a corresponding complete image of low resolution. For the image of the CAD drawing data, multiple component recognition can be performed by data enhancement, that is, increasing the high-resolution image corresponding to the local area of the target component in the CAD drawing data. The target component in the CAD drawing data can be identified more accurately to avoid the problem of inaccurate recognition results due to the distortion of the target component in the CAD drawing data when it is converted into an image.

title: A DDoS attack detection method for SDN network based on graph neural network
description: The invention provides an SDN network DDoS attack detection method based on a graph neural network, which relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and network security. The present invention establishes a flow table graph according to six DDoS-related flow characteristic values extracted from flow table data in an SDN network environment, wherein the six flow characteristic values include: source IP address growth rate GSIP, flow survival time change ADF, port growth rate GSP , flow table entry rate RFE, flow table matching success rate RFM, and comparison flow ratio PPF. The invention processes the data packets through the graph neural network double-layer structure, establishes a DDoS attack detection model based on the graph neural network, increases the accuracy of the judgment and analysis of network data, isolates possible network security threats, and provides warning prompts and real-time protection. measures to prevent users from being affected after contacting data and information, resulting in various losses, and to provide authorized users with a safe and reliable network environment.

title: A Network Interface Traffic Prediction Method Based on Sparrow Optimal Width Learning System
description: The invention discloses a network interface traffic prediction method based on a sparrow optimization width learning system. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining network interface traffic data, determining a prediction period T, and using the network traffic information of [t-12, t-1] to predict Network traffic at time t; initialize network parameters; randomly generate p groups of shrinkage coefficients and regularization coefficients as initial hyperparameters within the range of parameter values; use p groups of initial hyperparameters to automatically train the width learning system model to generate initial fitness (5) Use the sparrow optimization algorithm to optimize the hyperparameters; (6) Use the updated hyperparameters to train the width learning system and update the fitness value; (7) Determine the maximum number of iterations to output the network parameters corresponding to the best fitness, and use the Train the width learning model, and establish a network interface traffic prediction model; otherwise, return to step (5). The invention can predict the accuracy of network traffic and reduce the influence of network hyperparameters on the prediction result.

title: A device-cloud collaborative ship target recognition method fused with semantic segmentation
description: The invention discloses a semantic segmentation fused end cloud collaborative ship target efficient identification method, which comprises the following steps: step S1: training a semantic segmentation model; step S2: carrying out land classification detection; step S3: designing an optimization classification module; step S4: training a target detection model; step S5: training a target detection model; step S6: and detecting the ship target. According to the method, the end cloud cooperative computing framework is adopted, the ships in the remote sensing images can be efficiently and accurately detected, and the classified images of the cloud end are utilized to construct the mask capable of covering the non-water area, so that the ship target detection of the water area is only carried out; and finally, detecting the ship targets in the remote sensing image by using the trained target detection weight file, and compared with the existing method, adopting a cloud collaborative calculation frame, neglecting the area (namely, non-water area) where ships can not appear, and only detecting the ship targets in the water area part, wherein the identification computation amount is low.

title: A Software Cross-modal Retrieval Method Based on Hypothesis Testing in Heterogeneous Semantic Spaces
description: The invention discloses a software cross-modal retrieval method based on hypothesis testing in a heterogeneous semantic space, which uses a distribution generation network to project a text to CFP (computational fluid dynamics) related distribution in a distribution space; representing the code as a control flow graph and extracting all paths in the control flow graph; mapping the CFP into CFP sample vectors in a sample space by using a sample generation network, wherein the code is expressed as a CFP sample vector set; and calculating the compliance degree of the CFP sample vector set to the CFP related distribution by using hypothesis testing as a matching score of the CFP sample vector set and the CFP sample vector set, and using the CFP sample vector set and the CFP sample vector set to realize a cross-modal retrieval task in the form of code retrieval text or text retrieval code. The invention firstly proposes that the codes and the texts are projected into a heterogeneous semantic space for representation learning, namely the texts are projected into a CFP related distribution space and the codes are projected into a CFP sample space, so that the respective unique semantics of the texts and the codes can be accurately represented, and the accuracy of cross-modal retrieval is improved.

title: Key response equivalence-based pavement structure layer equivalent modulus determination method and device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method, a device and a storage medium for determining equivalent modulus of a pavement structure layer based on key response equivalence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the correspondence between the road surface structure layer granular material and the roadbed soil structure layerThe key response index is used as an equivalent calculation basis; an axisymmetric road surface structure numerical calculation model is created according to an actual road surface structure, and a structural layer key Response considering the nonlinear characteristics of materials is calculated by a finite element method  i  Iteratively calculating a target value as the equivalent line elastic modulus; calculating initial iteration modulus of the granular materials and the roadbed soil structure layer based on the equivalent stress state method, and calculating key response in each iteration step by a finite element method Obtained by calculation And Response  i  And determining the next iteration modulus, wherein when the convergence condition is met, the obtained modulus value is the equivalent linear elastic modulus of the nonlinear structural layer. The method is scientific and reasonable, has high accuracy and provides a theoretical basis for directly designing the asphalt pavement.

title: Temperature regulating device and temperature control method and device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of temperature adjustment, and provides a temperature adjustment device, a temperature control method and device thereof, an electronic device and a storage medium. A temperature control method for a temperature adjustment device includes: acquiring current environment data of the temperature adjustment device and current device parameter values of the temperature adjustment device, where the current device parameter values include the device temperature; inputting the current environment data and the current device parameter values into a temperature control model to obtain The temperature control threshold, wherein the temperature control model is obtained by training based on the weighted historical data of the temperature adjustment equipment, and the weighted historical data is obtained by weighting the initial historical data of the temperature adjustment equipment; the temperature adjustment equipment is controlled based on the temperature control threshold to perform temperature adjustment. In this method, the temperature control model can automatically output the most suitable temperature value of the temperature adjustment device, that is, the temperature control threshold value based on the current environmental data and the current equipment parameter values. Since there is no need for the user to manually adjust the temperature adjustment device, the operation can be simplified and the user satisfaction can be improved. .
