title: Training method, device, equipment and storage medium for preview distance prediction model
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for training a pre-aiming distance prediction model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting driving information of an autonomous vehicle; acquiring control information corresponding to each alternative pre-aiming distance data; selecting pre-aiming distance label data according to the driving information and each piece of control information; acquiring a plurality of pre-aiming distance calculation data according to the driving information and a distance formula; selecting a group of preview parameter tag data according to the plurality of preview distance calculation data and the preview distance tag data; and generating a preview distance prediction model according to the preview parameter tag data. In the embodiment of the invention, the sighting parameters of the sighting distance prediction model do not adopt constants set according to experience. The real value of the preview parameter is more suitable for the driving conditions of the automatic driving vehicle under different working conditions, and the preview distance prediction model is more suitable for predicting the preview distance of the automatic driving vehicle under different working conditions, so that the prediction scenes of the preview distance are enriched, and the prediction accuracy of the preview distance is improved.

title: A Robust Image Watermarking Method Based on Generative Adversarial Networks
description: The invention discloses a robust image watermarking method based on a generative confrontation network, comprising: an encoder embeds binary secret information into a three-channel carrier image, and a decoder extracts the secret information from the secret image; encoding The generator network and the decoder network form an end-to-end model as the generator network, the secret image is generated through the generator network and the secret information is extracted, and the discriminator network is used to judge the authenticity of the generated encoded image; The network and the discriminator network learn against each other, so that the generated secret image and the original image, the decoded secret information and the original secret information error are within a certain range; use the data set to train the network model to obtain the optimal model parameters; Robustly encoded images and extracted secret information are obtained through the trained network model. The model of the present invention is robust, and the accuracy of extracting secret information after attacking the secret image is relatively high.

title: A method and system for establishing a UWB positioning system interference identification model library
description: The invention provides a method and a system for establishing an interference identification model library of a UWB positioning system. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of partitioning a map, classifying different interference scenes, determining a typical cell, performing key learning on the typical cell, reliably sampling data in a fixed point mode, collecting training data by a master station, storing the training data into a database, and establishing an interference identification database. And (3) establishing an algorithm model, inputting training data, training to obtain an interference identification model, then, after the label enters a positioning area, acquiring real-time data by a master station, inputting the real-time data into the model, judging the NLOS/LOS condition of each measured distance, further removing NLOS data, and resolving the positioning position of the label. With the increasing learning of typical cells, a model base for interference identification is formed. The invention is used in UWB positioning system to identify NLOS/LOS data, improve positioning accuracy, reduce repeated learning and reduce workload.

title: Gout intelligent auxiliary diagnosis and treatment system for combination of traditional Chinese medicine and western medicine
description: The invention discloses a gout intelligent auxiliary diagnosis and treatment system for integrated traditional Chinese and Western medicine, and relates to the field of intelligent medical treatment. The intelligent auxiliary diagnosis and treatment system includes a knowledge extraction module, an auxiliary diagnosis and reasoning module, an evaluation feedback module and a data storage module. The knowledge extraction module is responsible for constructing a gout knowledge map. The auxiliary diagnosis and reasoning module is responsible for learning a prediction model based on historical annotated data, which is used for reasoning and diagnosis, predicting the stage of the gout course of a patient, and recommending a treatment plan. The evaluation and feedback module is responsible for evaluating the effect of diagnosis and treatment, and is used for feedback to strengthen the auxiliary diagnosis and treatment system and improve the intelligence level of the system. The data storage module is responsible for storing the data of each link of the whole system. The present invention takes into account the complexity of gout, mines multi-level gout-related knowledge, combines traditional Chinese and Western medicine for diagnosis and prediction, and constructs a feedback enhancement module, thereby greatly improving the reliability and intelligence of the gout auxiliary diagnosis and treatment system.

title: System and method for storage management
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide methods and systems for storage management. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a request to allocate target node data to a memory space, wherein the memory space includes a buffer and an external memory, the target node data includes attribute data and structure data and represents a target node of a graph having a plurality of nodes and edges; determining a node degree associated with the target node data; allocating the target node data to the storage space based on the determined node degrees.

title: A method and device for processing tumor tissue data based on ultrasonic radio frequency signals
description: The present invention provides a tumor tissue data processing method and device based on ultrasonic radio frequency signals. The second radio frequency data is obtained by performing shear wave transformation on the radio frequency signal of tumor tissue, and the second radio frequency data is converted by a preset transformation method. The data is converted into a spatial distribution matrix of component feature information, so that the radio frequency signal of tumor tissue can be deeply mined, which is beneficial to provide accurate data for in-depth analysis of tumor tissue and improve the accuracy of tumor tissue data acquisition. Further analysis of the spatial distribution matrix of the characteristic information of tumor tissue components generated by the present invention is beneficial to improve the ability to distinguish tumor tissue.

title: Multi-label classification method and system based on label dependence measure
description: The invention discloses a multi-label classification method and a system based on label dependence measurement, belonging to the technical field of natural language processing, aiming at solving the technical problems that the classification of the relationship among multiple labels is difficult and the convergence is difficult, and adopting the technical scheme as follows: s1, processing a given text; s2, defining a correlation relation matrix C among multiple labels; s3, sequentially inputting the text tensor T into the Embedding layer and the core layer to obtain a text Embedding vector; s4, initializing label embedding by using the number of categories in the classification label set D; s5, calculating the inner product attention of text embedding and label embedding by utilizing label information contained in the multi-label correlation coefficient matrix C, so that the relation matrix information is merged into a text embedding vector X and re-represented; and S6, inputting the text embedding vector after the re-representation in the step S5 into a Maxpooling layer and a linear classification layer, calculating the forward cross entropy loss, and updating the gradient of all parameters by using a random gradient descent algorithm.

title: Method and device for segmentation of blood vessels in liver region
description: Embodiments of the present invention provide a method and device for segmenting blood vessels in a liver region, which belong to the technical field of digital medicine. The method includes: constructing a segmentation network of blood vessels in the liver region; converting the liver image into a reconstructed segmentation map of the liver blood vessels; using the segmentation network of the blood vessels in the liver region, training on the public data set of liver blood vessel segmentation, and obtaining the training completed The liver blood vessel segmentation network; and outputting the liver blood vessel reconstruction segmentation map as a liver region blood vessel segmentation image. This application will automatically extract the multi-scale local features and global features of the liver region in CT images, and use the multi-task consistent output branch to model the blood vessel feature conversion relationship, so as to achieve liver blood vessel segmentation; the used combined class balance loss function, for The characteristics of multitasking and vascular data alleviate the extreme class imbalance problem of the network.

title: AI application deployment method and related platforms, clusters, media, and program products
description: The application provides an Artificial Intelligence (AI) application deployment method, which comprises the following steps: the development system converts the trained AI model into at least one adaptation model, each adaptation model is adapted to one inference frame, the development system further generates a model configuration file, the model configuration file comprises configuration information required by the inference frame when the inference frame performs inference based on the corresponding adaptation model, then the development system generates AI applications according to the AI functional unit group and the model configuration file, the AI functional units are used for obtaining inference results based on one adaptation model, the deployment management system can uniformly deploy the AI applications to different devices based on the AI functional units and the model configuration file generated by the adaptation models, inference codes do not need to be modified manually, deployment difficulty of the AI applications is reduced, and deployment efficiency of the AI applications is improved.

title: Solar cell electroluminescence image defect detection method based on convolution neural network
description: The invention provides a solar cell electroluminescence image defect detection method based on a convolution neural network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an electroluminescence image of a solar cell to be detected as an original image data set by adopting an image acquisition device; constructing a label file of a data set, dividing the label file into a training set and a test set, and expanding the training data set by using random affine transformation; inputting the expanded training data set into a main feature extraction network with a convolution kernel as variable convolution to extract a feature map; inputting the characteristic diagram into an area to generate an area where a network detection target is located, and normalizing the size of the target area by using region-of-interest pooling; and the double-head network is used for realizing the classification task processed by the full connector and the positioning task processed by the convolution head. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device have the advantage that the detection accuracy rate of the small defects of the electroluminescence image of the solar cell is improved under the condition that the size difference of the target defects is large.

title: An online learning method for forward-looking emergency rescue planning
description: The invention discloses an online learning method for forward-looking emergency rescue planning, which models the stage-based confrontation between rescuers and attackers as a synchronous rescue route game problem;   As a result, assuming that all data and parameters are known in advance, a multi-stage offline emergency rescue plan is constructed; the multi-stage offline emergency rescue plan is extended to a real online multi-stage rescue plan, the key parameters are displayed in an online manner, and the decision is obtained using an online learning algorithm . The long-range terrain planning considering online features has performance advantages and can be effectively applied to large-scale practical problems.

title: An airspace complexity control method based on multi-objective optimization
description: The invention relates to the field of air traffic management, in particular to an airspace complexity control method based on multi-objective optimization. ; Obtain the initial population, and after setting the constraints, the initial population is optimized through the multi-objective optimization algorithm in which the objective function is the standard deviation of the airspace complexity of each sector and the coordination load value of the overall airspace, and the Pareto plane is obtained and the current maximum value is selected. The optimal individual is adjusted to obtain the second population; the multi-objective evolutionary algorithm is used again to optimize the second population, and the current optimal individual is selected as the final sector representation from the Pareto frontier obtained after optimizing the second population. The method meets the needs of air control resource allocation when flow changes, and provides an effective and stable solution to the airspace complexity control problem.

title: Detection method for acquiring apple diameter in natural scene based on Kinect camera
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision, and in particular relates to a method for detecting apple fruit diameters in natural scenes based on a Kinect camera. The mechanism enhances the feature extraction ability of the network to the image and improves the detection accuracy of the algorithm. The detected image is segmented based on pixel points, and depth information is extracted from RGB-D data to realize fruit diameter estimation. The invention first proposes a scientific collection and processing method for apple tree images, and uses image blur, noise reduction, enhanced exposure, etc. to improve the diversity of data sets for the problem of changing natural scene environments, and extracts the initial position of apple fruits on the basis of convolution network. Combined with traditional computer vision algorithms to achieve fruit diameter estimation. The invention is used for apple detection and fruit diameter measurement.

title: Data processing method and system
description: The embodiment of the specification provides a data processing method and a system, wherein the data processing method comprises the following steps: receiving sample spatio-temporal data sent by member equipment, mining graph nodes and graph node relations of the sample spatio-temporal data, and constructing a spatio-temporal data graph based on the graph nodes and the graph node relations; and sending the spatiotemporal data map to the member equipment so that the member equipment updates an anomaly detection model held by the member equipment based on the spatiotemporal data map to obtain the updated anomaly detection model. The method avoids the condition that many member devices cannot train the anomaly detection model held by the member devices based on the spatiotemporal data constructed by the spatiotemporal data, and improves the performance of the anomaly detection model.

title: Abnormal detection method and device for a lithium battery
description: The lithium battery abnormity detection method, the lithium battery abnormity detection device and the storage medium provided by the disclosure acquire the acquired original characteristic data corresponding to a plurality of sample lithium batteries, perform data cleaning on the original characteristic data to acquire the sample characteristic data corresponding to each sample lithium battery, acquire the isolation density of each sample lithium battery by using the sample characteristic data, wherein the isolation density of each sample lithium battery is the probability density of the sample data of each lithium battery appearing in all sample data, determine the abnormity threshold value of each lithium battery based on the isolation density of each sample lithium battery, acquire the lithium battery to be detected, calculate the isolation density of the lithium battery to be detected, and perform abnormity detection on the lithium battery to be detected by using the abnormity threshold value of the lithium battery. Therefore, the method is stable and reliable, improves the execution efficiency, can be suitable for large-scale data set scenes, and is wide in application range.

title: A staff fatigue detection method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present application provides a staff fatigue detection method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining image acquisition data of the staff to be tested during work; The staff's expression recognition result and eye position information; when the test staff's expression recognition result is abnormal, determine the eye movement track information of the test staff according to the eye position information; according to the test staff's eye movement Trajectory information to determine the fatigue detection results of the staff to be tested. The method provided by the above solution realizes the accurate detection of the fatigue state of the staff in the monitoring room by determining the fatigue detection result based on the eye movement track information of the staff to be tested after determining that the facial expression recognition result of the staff to be tested is abnormal.

title: Visual scene reconstruction method and storage medium based on brain wave data pre-training model
description: The invention relates to a visual scene reconstruction method based on a brain wave data pre-training model and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of coding acquired brain wave data by using a pre-training coding module; generating an image according to the encoded brain wave data by using a pre-training decoding module; the pre-training coding module is used for simulating a training method of a BERT model in natural language processing, training a pre-training model based on brain wave data, and is built in the pre-training coding module to code the brain wave data; the pre-training decoding module is internally provided with a pre-training neural network model, decodes the encoded brain wave data, and restores the image causing the section of brain wave data. The method for analyzing the brain wave data into the user observation content can reflect the activity characteristics of the brain wave to a certain extent. The invention pre-trains the model with a structure similar to BERT, can fully utilize the existing brain wave data, solves the problem of small brain wave data volume to a certain extent, and has certain help to the accuracy of the model.

title: An intelligent monitoring system and method for grid operation
description: The invention provides a power grid operation intelligent monitoring system and a method, which relate to the technical field of power grid engineering, and are characterized in that the system acquires operation plan information of a target power grid project through acquisition, acquires a current operation unit for operation and acquires information of a plurality of operators; inputting information of a current operation unit and a plurality of operators into a safety monitoring scheme space to obtain a current safety monitoring scheme comprising a current training scheme and a current monitoring scheme; carrying out safety training according to the current training scheme; according to the current monitoring scheme, acquiring a plurality of pieces of pre-operation monitoring requirement information and a plurality of pieces of in-operation monitoring requirement information; and carrying out safety monitoring on a plurality of operating personnel before and during operation according to the monitoring requirement information before the operation and the monitoring requirement information in the operation. The invention achieves the technical effects of adaptively carrying out the operation safety monitoring of the power grid and improving the efficiency and the effect of the operation safety monitoring of the power grid.

title: A monocular depth estimation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The application provides a monocular depth estimation method, a monocular depth estimation device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the RGB image generates feature maps with a plurality of scales through different paths based on a dynamic routing network; fusing the feature graphs of a plurality of scales by using a feature fusion module to generate a new feature graph; and taking the new feature map as an input of a convolution module, and generating a predicted depth map through convolution operation. According to the scheme, the generalization capability of the network is effectively improved on the premise of ensuring the accuracy rate of the network.

title: Medical image interpretation method and system
description: The invention provides a medical image interpretation method and system. The medical image is provided to a convolutional neural network model, which includes a feature acquisition portion, a first classifier, and N second classifiers. The last layer of the feature acquisition part of the convolutional neural network model is used to generate N feature maps. Obtaining N symptom interpretation results of N symptoms of a disease based on the N feature maps through the N second classifiers. And acquiring a disease interpretation result of the disease based on the N characteristic maps through a first classifier.

title: A Layout Method of Irregular Measuring Network for 3D Surface Controlled Source Electromagnetic Exploration
description: The invention discloses a three-dimensional ground controllable source electromagnetic prospecting irregular measuring network layout method, which belongs to the technical field of electromagnetic prospecting. First, based on the nonlinear relationship between observation data and model parameters, the three-dimensional ground controllable source electromagnetic The sensitivity matrix of exploration; secondly, the objective function (fitness function) of the optimal design of measuring point position is defined by using the singular value of the sensitive local matrix; finally, the genetic algorithm of global optimization is used, and the constraint condition of measuring point distribution is added to search for the optimal function of the fitness function. The minimum value realizes the optimal design of the irregular surveying network for three-dimensional ground electromagnetic survey; the invention breaks through the traditional regular surveying network layout idea of fixed point spacing and line spacing, and establishes the optimal free surveying network data acquisition system according to the actual situation in the field . In order to maximize the acquisition of geophysical information of deep geological targets, improve the imaging quality of 3D controllable source electromagnetic data, and reduce exploration costs and risks.

title: Method, system and equipment for constructing prediction model
description: The invention provides a method for constructing a prediction model, which comprises the following steps: constructing a macroscopic economy prediction index system; establishing a traditional mixing vector autoregressive economic prediction model; establishing an economic prediction model based on deep learning; fusing the prediction results of the models by using a time series model fusion method; and obtaining a final macroscopic economic prediction result. The model of the invention reserves a vector autoregressive model, can extract hidden features and linear features in time sequence data and has the characteristic of good interpretability. The invention integrates two deep learning models, wherein the deep learning model is a nonlinear model, can successfully capture nonlinearity in data, has higher precision, and can accurately predict the macroscopic economic situation with higher interpretability.

title: Point cloud denoising method based on generation countermeasure network and self-attention mechanism
description: The invention relates to a point cloud denoising method based on a generative confrontation network and a self-attention mechanism, and belongs to the technical field of 3D point cloud denoising and the field of deep learning. Construct a noisy point cloud data set to be denoised, construct a self-attention generator module, construct a discriminator module, and then confront the training generator and discriminator until the generator and discriminator reach Nash equilibrium, and finally get the training completed Generator; input the noise point cloud into the trained generator, and the result is the denoising point cloud. The invention further integrates the global and local features of the point cloud by combining the generative confrontation network and the attention mechanism, retains more details of the original point cloud, improves the denoising effect, and obtains more refined high-quality point cloud data.

title: Method and device for soft handover of networked vehicles on multiple edge cloud gateways
description: The invention discloses a method and device for performing soft handover of networked vehicles on multiple edge cloud gateways. The invention relates to the field of information technology, including: V2X message gateway agents receive networked vehicle network connections (MQTT/TCP/UDP ), according to the vehicle identification, obtain the latest location information of the connected car from the motor vehicle attribution register; then determine the target edge cloud gateway corresponding to the current connected car according to the classifier AI model of the edge cloud; finally The network connection (MQTT/TCP/UDP) is forwarded to the target edge cloud gateway. By applying the technical solution of the present application, smooth switching of the edge cloud gateway can be realized.

title: A Method of Task Offloading and Resource Allocation for Edge Computing
description: The invention discloses a task unloading and resource allocation method facing edge computing, which comprises three aspects of relay selection, unloading decision and resource allocation and is used for solving the problems of task delay and energy consumption of a mobile user in the environment of the Internet of things.

title: Quaternion map convolutional neural network-based recommendation method and device
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a recommendation method and device based on a quaternion graph convolutional neural network. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical interactive data of a plurality of users; constructing an interaction matrix according to historical interaction data of a plurality of users, wherein the interaction matrix is used for representing the interaction relation between the plurality of users and a plurality of objects; determining an initial quaternion vector representation for each user and each object; inputting the initial quaternion vector representations of the interactive matrix, the multiple users and the multiple objects into a graph convolution neural network to be processed in a quaternion space, and obtaining vector representations of each user and each object; determining the preference degree of each user to each object according to the vector representation of each user and each object; and selecting at least one target object from the plurality of objects to recommend to the target user according to the preference degree of the target user selected from the plurality of users to the plurality of objects. Based on the method and the device, the accuracy of object recommendation for the target user can be improved.

title: Method of detecting the presence state of an object in a vehicle
description: The present disclosure relates to a method of detecting a presence state of an object in a vehicle, and more particularly to a computer-implemented method of detecting a presence state of a given object in a vehicle, comprising the steps of: processing data received over time from various devices in a vehicle, the data including a parameter related to a given object indicative of whether the given object is present in the vehicle, to determine a cumulative set of scores; determining an object-related confidence value representing a likelihood that the given object is present in the vehicle based on the set of cumulative scores; the object-related confidence value is compared to a predetermined threshold value to detect the presence of the object in the vehicle if the current object-related confidence value exceeds the predetermined threshold value.

title: A method for predicting the severity of tunnel traffic accidents based on neural network
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of traffic accident prediction, and relates to a method for predicting the severity of tunnel traffic accidents based on a neural network, comprising the steps of: S1, obtaining a quantitative index table corresponding to each accident factor; The quantitative data corresponding to the multi-seed factors in the accident factors; S3, reduce the dimension of the multi-seed factors in each accident factor through the principal component analysis method, so as to determine the number of principal components and the principal component load of each accident factor; S4, determine The principal components of each accident factor in each tunnel traffic accident training sample; S5, using the firefly algorithm to optimize the BP neural network model used to predict the severity of tunnel traffic accidents; S6, inputting the principal components of each accident factor in the real tunnel traffic scene to optimize The final BP neural network model is used to output the prediction results of the severity of traffic accidents. The invention can effectively predict the severity of tunnel traffic accidents and improve the safety of road tunnel operation.

title: Feeder prediction maintenance method and system based on imaging
description: The invention provides a feeder prediction maintenance method and a feeder prediction maintenance system based on imaging, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting glass manufacturing information and carrying out imaging processing; collecting and displaying the using condition of the batch feeder; adjusting and optimizing a control scheme of the batch feeder in real time; collecting, analyzing and judging the operation condition of the batch feeder in real time; and carrying out process adjustment or prediction fault treatment on the batch feeder. The invention solves the technical problems of low polling maintenance efficiency, single control maintenance mode and poor applicability.

title: An intelligent pre-inspection alarm system for humped vehicles
description: An intelligent pre-inspection and alarm system for humped vehicles, including: image processing method, deep learning method, image intelligent analysis, big data, automatic application to the field of hump slipping protection, using image method, deep learning method, and image intelligent analysis method, real-time monitoring of the vehicle's low profile, collecting and analyzing the video content of the vehicle's low profile, judging the change of the target shape in the video, and identifying the brakes and locks of various vehicles through the set conditions and rules, and calculating the piston The extension length of the rod can be used to judge whether it exceeds the set threshold, so as to realize the early warning and judgment of potential risks. Advantages of the present invention: it is used for the method of panorama detection and early warning of the bottom of railway trucks, and collects the image information of the bottom of the truck that is about to roll over the hump, so as to realize the early warning and prediction of potential risks; through the set conditions and rules, the calculated The protruding length of the bar is determined, combined with the set threshold to judge the early warning vehicle, and identify the braking brake of the railway freight car.

title: Image style transfer and model training method, device, device and medium
description: The present disclosure relates to an image style transfer and model training method, device, device and medium. Wherein, the method includes: obtaining a first number of portrait image samples, and using each portrait image sample to train a preset neural network model, determining a portrait image generation model and portrait model parameters; obtaining a second number of style image samples, and Use each style image sample to train the portrait image generation model, and determine the style model parameters; wherein, the second number is less than the first number; based on the portrait model parameters and style model parameters, determine the migration model parameters; based on the migration model parameters and the preset neural network The network model generates the first image style transfer model. According to the embodiments of the present disclosure, only a small number of style image samples are needed to realize the training of the image style transfer model, which greatly reduces the model training cost, improves the model training efficiency, and further improves the implementation efficiency of different image style transformations.

title: Self-adaptive map dividing planning method, device, medium and equipment
description: The application discloses a self-adaptive map dividing planning method, a device, a medium and equipment, and belongs to the technical field of high-precision maps. The self-adaptive map dividing and planning method mainly comprises the following steps: determining a map fusion probability factor of a map corresponding to each of a plurality of tasks which are synchronously performed according to a pre-established planning model; planning the drawing according to the drawing fusion probability factor; and distributing the pictures to operators for operation according to the planning result, wherein the operation result is used for training a pre-established planning model. And determining the picture fusion probability factors of the pictures corresponding to the tasks through the pre-established planning model, planning the pictures according to the picture fusion probability factors, reducing the mutual waiting time caused by the operation conflict in the task process, and improving the working efficiency.

title: A malicious domain name detection method and system based on multi-channel graph convolution
description: The invention discloses a malicious domain name detection method and system based on multi-channel graph convolution, and relates to the technical field of network security. The method includes: extracting DNS parsing logs to generate triples; constructing an association relationship graph of a domain name in a multi-channel space based on the triples; obtaining a trained deep learning network model, the deep learning network model includes graph convolution Neural network, Attention layer and fully-connected neural network; According to the domain name's association relationship graph in the multi-channel space and the vector of the domain name, based on the graph convolutional neural network, the graph embedding vector of the domain name in the multi-channel space is generated; the graph of the domain name is embedded The vector is input into the Attention layer for feature selection, and the graph embedding vectors in the multi-channel space are aggregated into a single feature vector sequence with the same dimension; the feature vector sequence is input into the fully connected neural network to obtain the classification result of the domain name. Compared with the prior art, the present invention gets rid of the dependence on manually designed features, and improves detection accuracy and robustness.

title: Injection molding quality inspection method and system based on LF-XGBoost model
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing, and discloses a method and system for inspecting the quality of injection molded parts based on the LF‑XGBoost model, comprising the following steps: S1. collecting production data of injection molded parts; S2. preprocessing the production data of injection molded parts; S3 .Construct the LF-XGBoost model, the LF-XGBoost model includes the LSTM-FCN model and the XGBoost model; S4. carry out feature engineering to the preprocessed production data through the LSTM-FCN model; S5. extract the The features are input into the XGBoost model for training to obtain a test model for the quality test of the injection molded part; S6. Perform the quality test of the injection molded part through the test model. The invention solves the problem that the prior art cannot efficiently inspect the quality of injection molded parts, and has the characteristics of strong robustness and high accuracy.

title: Target object tracking method, related device, equipment and storage medium
description: The application discloses a target object tracking method based on artificial intelligence technology, in particular to the field of image recognition, and an application scene at least comprises various terminals, such as: a mobile phone, a computer, a vehicle-mounted terminal, etc. Extracting an original detection image from a current image frame if a target object is detected in a previous image frame; acquiring a target feature map through a feature extraction network; for each feature map, acquiring an anchor point frame according to an anchor point set in the feature map; acquiring optional boundary frame parameters through an object detection network based on the characteristics corresponding to the anchor frame; determining T groups of boundary frame parameters; and determining a tracking result aiming at the target object in the current image frame according to the T groups of boundary box parameters. The application also provides a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method and the device not only reduce the data processing amount and improve the target tracking efficiency, but also achieve better recognition effect in the image detection process, thereby being beneficial to improving the accuracy of target tracking.

title: Lane line and lane area detection method based on road scene
description: The invention relates to a lane line and lane area detection method based on a road scene, which processes a vehicle front-view RGB image into a high-resolution image and a low-resolution image, and inputs both the high-resolution image and the low-resolution image into a pre-built And in the trained detection network, the detection results of lane lines and lanes are obtained. The detection network includes: lane primary feature extraction module: extract primary features of lane lines; lane primary feature extraction module: extract primary features of lanes; feature interaction learning module: interact two primary features to generate interactive features; Decoder and Lane Decoder: Decode the interaction features for the first time respectively, and input the decoded features for the first time into the opponent’s decoder, and combine the interaction features for the second decoding; the interaction constraint loss module: combine the two decoders with the second The decoding features of the secondary decoding are constrained. Compared with the prior art, the present invention can accurately detect lane lines and lanes at the same time.

title: Tea Garden Information Extraction Method Based on Medium Resolution Remote Sensing Image Based on Deep Learning
description: The invention relates to a method for extracting tea garden information from medium-resolution remote sensing images based on deep learning. Consists of encoder, bottleneck, decoder and skip connections. First, the encoder part uses the backbone network of Swin Transformer (four-layer hierarchy), each layer is composed of Patch Merging and Swin Transformer blocks; second, the decoder part is based on CNN network for upsampling, while using skip connections to fuse low-level information and advanced information. Finally, the loss function is optimized to improve the accuracy of extracting tea gardens. This model can overcome the dependence of traditional deep learning on high-resolution images in tea garden extraction, realize tea garden information extraction on medium-resolution images, and provide an effective method for large-scale tea garden mapping.

title: Cloud computing task automatic scheduling method based on track optimization rewards
description: The present invention discloses a method for automatic scheduling of cloud computing tasks based on trajectory optimization rewards, which relates to the field of AI technology and aims to solve the following problems: 1. The premature phenomenon of genetic algorithms still exists when applied to cloud computing resource allocation scenarios. When the population evolves to the middle and late stages, the diversity of the population is destroyed, and the algorithm search is stagnant, resulting in the algorithm failing to obtain a local optimal solution and failing to obtain a global optimal solution. The premature phenomenon affects the global convergence and computing performance of the genetic algorithm; 2. The current heuristic search algorithm only optimizes the task scheduling time in cloud computing task scheduling, without considering other constraints, and cannot solve multi-objective problems. The key point of its technical solution is to use a reinforcement learning algorithm to schedule a batch of tasks. The purpose of improving the resource utilization rate, task completion efficiency and cost reduction of cloud servers is achieved, and the effects of improving response time and load balancing are achieved.

title: Bank customer classification method, system and electronic equipment
description: A bank customer classification method, a system and electronic equipment are characterized by comprising the following steps: formulating classification targets and purposes, and determining specific targets to be realized and requirements of banking business; collecting customer information, integrating data from a plurality of channels; determining key indexes for classification, and adopting a machine learning algorithm to automatically identify modes and adjust classification standards; according to the transaction behavior, consumption habit and saving mode of the customer, designing a classification method, and verifying the accuracy of the classification method by using historical data to ensure that the classification method can correctly identify different types of customers; personalized service policies are formulated for each customer group to meet its needs and desires. The invention can help banks identify cross-selling opportunities and recommend additional products and services meeting customer demands, thereby increasing transaction amount and customer value. By better understanding the customer and providing customized services according to his needs, the bank can enhance customer loyalty and reduce customer churn rates.

title: Indoor air unsteady flow field prediction method and system based on space-time distribution characteristics
description: The present application provides a method and system for predicting indoor air unsteady flow field based on spatiotemporal distribution characteristics, the prediction method comprising the following steps: obtaining indoor air unsteady flow field data sets at N moments before prediction time T, where N≥20; constructing N‑1 input data sets based on the indoor air unsteady flow field data sets at N moments before prediction time T; inputting the N‑1 input data sets into the indoor air unsteady flow field coupling prediction model to obtain the indoor air unsteady flow field data set at prediction time T. The technical solution of the present application can make predictions based on the coupled characteristics of the temporal and spatial distribution of the indoor air unsteady flow field, effectively improving the accuracy of the prediction.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for recovering image of depth camera under screen
description: The invention discloses an image recovery method, device, equipment and medium for an under-screen depth camera, which comprises the following steps: acquiring an original depth image through an under-screen TOF depth camera, and performing complex conversion on original Raw data of the original depth image to input the complex data into a deep learning sub-network of a Raw domain; the enhanced Raw data is output through a deep learning sub-network of the Raw domain, and is input into the deep learning sub-network of the deep domain through unwrapping processing; outputting a restored image through a deep learning sub-network of a depth domain; and performing iterative training on the deep learning sub-network of the Raw domain and the deep learning sub-network of the depth domain by using the loss function, and recovering the target depth image by using the trained network. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can restore the quality of the depth image acquired by the depth camera under the screen to the non-screen state, and improves the restoration efficiency of the depth image and the effectiveness of the restoration result.

title: Charging load control method, device and electronic equipment
description: The present invention provides a charging load control method, device and electronic equipment, belonging to the field of data processing technology, the method includes: controlling the intelligent fusion terminal in the control area to receive the charging load prediction data of the charging pile sent by the charging pile operation management platform; the intelligent fusion terminal in the control area determines the control index power based on the power supply capacity threshold, the area load and the charging load prediction data; the control platform sends a power control instruction to the charging pile operation management platform when the full load power of the charging pile is greater than the control index power; the charging pile operation management platform sends a control instruction to the charging pile based on the power control instruction, so as to reduce the charging power of the charging pile to within the control index power. The present invention determines the control index power for controlling the charging pile by combining actual data and predicted data, realizes dynamic control of the charging flexible load of the charging pile while meeting the user's electricity demand, and guides the orderly charging of electric vehicles.

title: Radar word cutting method, device and system and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a radar word cutting method, device, system and storage medium to solve the problem of difficult cutting of multifunctional radar radar words. The method comprises: obtaining a pulse train, and quantizing and encoding the pulse train to obtain a quantized pulse sequence; inputting the quantized pulse sequence into a network basic module, and outputting the classification probability corresponding to each quantization point through bidirectional long and short time feature capture; using a filtering module to filter the classification probability density of adjacent quantization points to achieve point-by-point classification and recognition of quantization points; anchoring a detection frame on the basis of achieving point-by-point classification and recognition of quantization points. Experiments have shown that the present invention can effectively achieve radar word cutting.

title: Greenhouse equipment fault diagnosis method and system based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention discloses a greenhouse equipment fault diagnosis method and system based on artificial intelligence, the method includes: S1, collecting data information within a predetermined time period; S2, cleaning and processing all data information, and dividing them into training sets and test sets; S3, constructing a prediction model of crop leaf temperature and leaf humidity based on convolutional neural network, firefly algorithm and deep learning method based on attention mechanism; S4, constructing an image classification model of equipment on working state and off working state based on training set and test set of image data. S5, real-time collection of environmental factor data inside and outside the greenhouse, equipment operation data and crop physiological and ecological data, inputting real-time data into the prediction model to obtain future values of crop leaf temperature and leaf humidity; S6, comparing the actual value and predicted value of crop leaf temperature and humidity, and checking the numerical data of the current operating state of the equipment to determine the type of equipment working fault.

title: Universal coding circuit design method for CSS quantum error correction code
description: The present invention proposes a method for designing a universal coding circuit of a CSS quantum error correction code, and the implementation steps are: initializing parameters; simplifying logic operations based on stabilizers; determining the initial coding state of the coding circuit to be designed corresponding to Z  L1  or Z  L2  ; implementing the simplest X-type logic operation of the coding circuit to be designed corresponding to Z  L1  or Z  L2  ; and obtaining the coding circuit of the CSS quantum error correction code corresponding to Z  L1  or Z  L2  . The present invention is based on stabilizers when determining the initial coding state of the coding circuit to be designed corresponding to Z  L2  , avoiding the defect of the prior art that all quantum bits cannot be initialized under the same coding basis due to the inconsistency between the X-type and Z-type logic operations of the Shor code and the corresponding type operations, and improving the versatility of the coding circuit design; and by dividing the deformed generator matrix into time slots, the operations that can be implemented simultaneously are divided into the same time slot, thereby improving the parallelism of the coding circuit, and thus improving the efficiency of the coding circuit.

title: Semantic automation builder for robotic process automation
description: A method is provided. The method is implemented by a semantic automation builder executing on a processor. The method generates semantic automation of robotic process automation. The method includes receiving user input corresponding to a target application, written automation task, or step to identify an action of the robotic process automation. The method also includes mapping each action to an activity to generate a mapped activity, converting the action to semantic automation based on the mapped activity, and providing the semantic automation in a user interface of a semantic automation builder to enable editing of the action.

title: Two-stage local generation type abstract method based on guiding mechanism
description: The invention relates to a two-stage local generation type abstract method based on a guiding mechanism, belonging to the field of natural language processing; the method solves the problems that the existing generated abstract model consumes too much computing resources when processing long text and is easy to generate inaccurate information. The technical proposal is as follows: firstly, obtaining an extraction type abstract of an input text and inputting the abstract as a guide signal of an article into an encoder for encoding; secondly, dividing the article and inputting the article into an encoder for local encoding; and finally, inputting the coding information of the guide signal and the local coding information of the partition page into a decoder for decoding, and carrying out combined prediction on the decoded local prediction information so as to generate an article abstract. The invention has the following beneficial effects: the local coding is utilized to reduce the calculation memory resource needed in the coding and decoding process; the quality of the generated abstract is improved by adding a guiding mechanism; the abstract of the article is used as the guiding signal to ensure the authenticity and the significance of the guiding signal.

title: A probability box-based combined positioning optimization method for unmanned mining vehicles
description: The invention discloses a combined positioning optimization method of an unmanned mine car based on a probability box, which comprises the steps of acquiring original data by utilizing a vehicle-mounted IMU of the unmanned mine car; constructing a probability box P-box based on a direct modeling method according to the collected original data, extracting the features of the positioning original data, and constructing a feature vector set in the longitude direction and the latitude direction by using effective feature vectors; feature fusion is carried out on the feature vector set with longitude direction and latitude according to the double-channel PCNN, an accumulated uncertainty feature matrix is formed, the feature matrix with labels is input into a normalized exponential function for classification, and the accuracy of the PCNN model is checked based on test set data to obtain a final PCNN model; and carrying out unmanned mine car combination positioning optimization according to the obtained final PCNN model to obtain a positioning optimization result. According to the invention, a probability box is obtained by using a direct modeling method, the characteristics of positioning original data are extracted, a vector set is constructed and then is input into a model for training, and information fusion is carried out to realize positioning optimization.

title: Power equipment fault diagnosis method, system, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a power equipment fault diagnosis method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of operation and maintenance of power equipment. Comprising the following steps: acquiring historical operation data of target power equipment, inputting a trained random forest model for processing, and acquiring a temperature predicted value at the next moment; performing temperature compensation on the temperature predicted value according to the running temperature of the target power equipment at the current moment, the environment temperature and the running temperature of the adjacent power equipment to obtain the running predicted temperature of the target power equipment at the next moment; judging whether a fault risk exists or not according to the operation prediction temperature and a preset fault risk early warning threshold value; if yes, acquiring a voiceprint signal of the target power equipment; acquiring a spectrogram according to the voiceprint signal; and carrying out reconstruction processing on the spectrogram, generating a reconstructed spectrogram, carrying out fault identification, and obtaining a fault identification result. The power equipment can be subjected to accurate fault diagnosis, and the efficiency is improved; the problem of current fault diagnosis real-time performance, accuracy are relatively poor is solved.

title: An adaptive teaching quality evaluation system based on AI analysis
description: An adaptive teaching quality evaluation system based on AI analysis is disclosed. It first obtains the class expression image of the evaluated student collected by the camera, then performs distortion correction on the class expression image to obtain the distortion-corrected class expression image, then extracts features from the distortion-corrected class expression image through an expression local feature extractor based on a deep neural network model to obtain a class expression local feature map, then passes the class expression local feature map through an expression space dimension enhancement expressor based on a spatial self-attention module to obtain a spatially enhanced class expression local feature map as the spatially enhanced class expression local feature, and finally, based on the spatially enhanced class expression local feature, determines the student's reaction to the teaching and the label of the degree of understanding. In this way, it can help teachers optimize teaching strategies and improve teaching quality.

title: Multi-truck multi-unmanned aerial vehicle package delivery task distribution method under time sequence constraint
description: The present invention discloses a method for allocating package delivery tasks of multiple trucks and multiple drones under timing constraints. In the first stage, according to the initial positions of the truck-drone, the positions of the customers to be delivered, and the directed acyclic graph representing the timing constraints, a truck-drone path satisfying the endurance constraint is obtained by using a range constraint checking method. In the second stage, a variable neighborhood descent algorithm is used to improve the truck-drone path satisfying the endurance constraint, and a truck-drone joint delivery path is obtained to complete the multi-truck multi-drone package delivery task allocation. The present invention can arrange the service path of each pair of truck-drone, so as to minimize the time for the last customer to be served while satisfying the drone cargo capacity, flight duration, and timing constraints.

title: Vascular guidewire tracking method, device, equipment and medium based on medical imaging
description: The present application relates to a vascular guidewire tracking method, device, equipment and medium based on medical images. The method segments the guidewire in the medical image according to three different guidewire widths to obtain a first segmented image, a second segmented image and a third segmented image corresponding to the three different guidewire widths, and then uses the advantages of the segmented images with different guidewire widths to correct and optimize the other two images. After correcting the connected domains in each segmented image for multiple times, the updated second segmented image is output as a guidewire segmented image. The method can overcome the problems of false detection, high missed detection and inaccurate segmentation of the guidewire head and tail in some specific image conditions, thereby achieving real-time and accurate tracking of the guidewire.

title: Active learning training method for object detection model based on teacher-student training framework
description: The present application provides an active learning training method for a target detection model based on a teacher-student training framework. In each training cycle, the recognition detection results of the candidate sample images are inferred through the detection model to be optimized, and the optimized detection results of the candidate sample images are obtained through optimization processing; the training sample images are screened out from the candidate sample images using the recognition detection results and the optimization detection results; the auxiliary detection model is trained using the training sample images, and the auxiliary model parameters of the auxiliary detection model are adjusted in combination with the comprehensive loss value determined by the training sample images; the model parameters of the auxiliary detection model are updated using the auxiliary model parameters of the auxiliary detection model, and finally the target detection model is obtained. In this way, the detection model to be optimized can be used to assist users in actively learning candidate sample images in a weakly supervised manner, which reduces the time cost of manual annotation, improves the training efficiency of the model, and quickly adapts to the migration and diversity of target detection scenarios.

title: Monitoring method and system for mine pollution and mine restoration
description: The invention discloses a monitoring method for mine pollution and mine restoration, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a video image of an area to be monitored near a mine, wherein heavy metal susceptible vegetation is planted in the area to be monitored; setting a time interval threshold, and performing frame extraction screenshot on the video image based on the time interval threshold to obtain a region picture to be monitored; performing edge detection on the image of the area to be monitored to obtain edge detection information; performing target segmentation and pooling on vegetation degradation areas of the to-be-monitored area picture based on the edge detection information to obtain a to-be-predicted picture; and carrying out time sequence prediction on the picture to be predicted to obtain a prediction result, and obtaining a prevention plan for mine pollution and mine restoration based on the prediction result. The invention can be used for mine pollution monitoring and completion acceptance monitoring of repair engineering, has high intelligent degree and excellent neural network performance, and can realize intelligent, fine, efficient and accurate mine pollution and repair effect monitoring.

title: A radar data acquisition method based on intelligent algorithm
description: The present invention relates to a radar data acquisition method based on an intelligent algorithm. By introducing an intelligent algorithm, the efficiency and accuracy of radar data acquisition are improved, and real-time monitoring and identification of targets are realized. The system includes a radar device, a data acquisition module, an intelligent algorithm module and a control module. The intelligent algorithm module processes and analyzes radar data, optimizes the data acquisition process, and improves the accuracy of target detection and identification. The method and system have broad application prospects.

title: Training method, training device, training data construction method, training device, training data construction equipment and training data construction medium for large language model
description: This specification provides a large language model training and training data construction method, device, equipment, and medium, which relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The large language model training method includes: determining the real privacy data in the initial training data set; performing data conversion on the real privacy data to obtain simulated privacy data, and the data structure of the simulated privacy data is the same as the data structure of the real privacy data; constructing a target training data set based on the simulated privacy data and the initial training data set; and performing model training on the pre-constructed large language model through the target training data set to obtain a trained large language model. This technical solution can protect privacy data from the source, avoid the leakage of privacy data in training data, and improve the security of personal privacy data. At the same time, it can also ensure that the large language model's ability to understand privacy data is not lost, and improve the accuracy of the output results of the large language model.

title: Soft-sensing model of oil absorption value of glassine paper based on SA-PSO-LSSVM
description: In the present invention, there is a corresponding relationship between each component and the oil absorption value in the glassine paper coating process, but due to the nonlinear relationship, its value cannot be simply inferred and predicted. In this case, a soft measurement model for predicting the oil absorption value of glassine paper based on SA-PSO-LSSVM is provided, which can realize the accurate detection of the oil absorption value in the glassine paper coating process, provide a quick method for optimizing the glassine paper coating process, select the daily production data of real papermaking enterprises, and is suitable for the actual production activities of general papermaking enterprises.

title: Hardware design using evolution algorithms
description: The design of a hardware component such as a digital filter can be optimised by taking an initial population of filter designs and encoding them as chromosomes. The fitness of each chromosome is then evaluated and parent chromosomes are then selected based on the fitness criteria. Offspring chromosomes are then generated ussing genetic operations such as mutation and crossover from the pool of offspring, and optionally parents, individuals are selected to survive using a combination of Pareto fronts based on non-dominated individuals and clustering. The process is repeated or until a termination criteria is satisfied.

title: Target detection method based on homomorphic encryption
description: The present invention discloses a target detection method based on homomorphic encryption, comprising: generating a pair of public and private encryption keys on a local client using a homomorphic encryption algorithm, encrypting original image data using the public key to obtain an encrypted image, and sending the encrypted image to a server; the server preprocessing the encrypted image, and calculating the preprocessed encrypted image data using a pre-trained convolutional neural network model, extracting image feature values and locating target areas in an encrypted domain, and generating encrypted target detection results; the server returning the encrypted target detection results to the local client; and the local client decrypting the encrypted target detection results returned by the server using a private key to obtain final target location and category information. When the present invention uses a convolutional neural network for target detection, data is encrypted during transmission and processing, thereby improving data security and protecting privacy information while not affecting model performance.

title: Data processing method and device based on map retrieval
description: The embodiment of the specification provides a data processing method and a data processing device based on spectrum retrieval, wherein the data processing method based on spectrum retrieval comprises the steps of obtaining a problem type by identifying the type of the input problem in the process of generating an answer to the problem input by a sub-service of a resource service by an access user, extracting the problem characteristic of the problem and inputting a spectrum retrieval model corresponding to the problem type, invoking a spectrum retrieval interface to search in the sub-spectrum through the spectrum retrieval model on the basis of the sub-spectrum obtained by entity selection and spectrum editing in advance according to the knowledge spectrum of the resource service, and generating the answer according to the retrieval result returned by the interface call, thereby generating the answer to the problem on the basis of the spectrum retrieval.

title: Driving safety assessment method of axle coupling system based on physical data driving
description: The invention discloses a driving safety evaluation method of an axle coupling system based on physical data driving, which comprises the steps of firstly carrying out graph structuring on the axle coupling system to generate a graph structure, endowing feature vectors to nodes in the graph structure, constructing a graph isomorphic network model and training, inputting the graph structure into the trained graph isomorphic network model to carry out driving safety evaluation, and outputting a safety evaluation index, wherein the safety evaluation index comprises a speed spectrum intensity VSI index and a derailment coefficient. According to the invention, by constructing the map isomorphic network model, the influence of the changes of parameters such as bridge structural form, train speed, track irregularity and the like on the operation safety is effectively captured, so that the accuracy of driving safety assessment is improved, and the computing resource is remarkably saved.

title: Deep learning model training method suitable for heterogeneous environments of network and equipment
description: The invention relates to the technical field of model training, in particular to a deep learning model training method suitable for heterogeneous environments of networks and equipment. The method comprises the steps of designing an improved hybrid parallel strategy, constructing a model division and task placement scheme based on dynamic programming according to the improved hybrid parallel strategy, and designing a self-adaptive weighted semi-synchronous hybrid training mechanism according to the improved hybrid parallel strategy and the model division and task placement scheme based on dynamic programming.

title: Model reasoning performance optimization method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present application discloses a model reasoning performance optimization method, apparatus, device and storage medium, including: in response to receiving an inference request, identifying the structural characteristics of a target reasoning model, determining the type of the target reasoning model based on the structural characteristics, wherein the inference request includes request parameters, the target inference model is used to execute the inference request, determining a first resource allocation based on the type of the target inference model and the request parameters, obtaining system load data, determining a system load status level based on the system load data, determining a second resource allocation based on the first resource allocation and the system load status level, calculating the inference request based on the second resource allocation, and obtaining an inference result. Through this method, resource utilization can be optimized and system throughput can be improved.

title: Method for realizing quantum circuit braiding
description: The application discloses a method for realizing quantum circuit braiding. The method comprises the steps of compiling an obtained initial quantum circuit to determine a first quantum circuit, wherein the first quantum circuit comprises a single-bit quantum gate and a double-bit quantum gate. Next, a second quantum wire and target two-bit quantum gate information are determined from the first quantum wire. And finally, determining a target single-bit quantum gate operation set according to the target double-bit quantum gate information so as to realize quantum circuit weaving. In this way, by compiling the initial quantum wire into a first quantum wire comprising only single bit quantum gates and double bit quantum gates, the interference of complex quantum gate structures on subsequent operations is eliminated. And by generating a target single-bit quantum gate operation set equivalent to the target double-bit quantum gate and combining and simplifying repeated operations, the sampling overhead of quantum hardware is obviously reduced.

title: Vehicle fault processing method and device, vehicle and storage medium
description: The application relates to a fault processing method and device for a vehicle, the vehicle and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of inputting a current fault processing feedback result as input data to a preset diagnosis model, determining a new fault solving strategy set according to the input data, the preset diagnosis model and a preset fault knowledge graph when the preset diagnosis model does not output the fault solving strategy set, acquiring a new fault processing feedback result generated by a user based on the new fault solving strategy set, and inputting the new fault processing feedback result as input data to the preset diagnosis model until the current fault of the vehicle is solved. Therefore, in the fault checking processing process, the residual fault solving strategy is dynamically adjusted according to the processing result of checked content fed back by a user, so that the problems of low checking efficiency, insufficient diagnosis accuracy and the like caused by the fixed stiffness of a processing scheme provided by the existing fault processing technology are solved, and the efficiency and accuracy of fault processing are improved.

title: Panoramic image complement method based on spherical nested diffusion model
description: The present invention discloses a panoramic image completion method based on a spherical nested diffusion model, which belongs to the technical field of panoramic image completion. The method comprises: adopting a cyclic convolutional layer structure and introducing a SiLU activation function to convert the number of channels of an input image into a 256-dimensional feature space, and adopting an overall downsampling rate of 8 times for latent feature sampling; outputting the latent features to a priori injection layer to obtain aggregated features containing ERP structural information and image completion details; constructing a spherical feature extraction network based on spherical nested blocks; wherein each spherical nested block contains an SDC layer; for each SDC layer, introducing a deformable convolution layer as a bridging module in the network structure, performing multi-scale fusion of the aggregated features containing spherical information with the original image information, and gradually integrating them into the intermediate feature layer and the final output layer of the pre-trained diffusion model in a cascade manner, and decoding the output results through an image decoder to complete the panoramic image completion.

title: Image tampering analysis method and device based on prompt engineering
description: The invention discloses an image tampering analysis method and device based on prompt engineering, which comprises the steps of generating image tampering behavior analysis data by inputting a tampered image, an original image before tampering and a corresponding text instruction through the prompt engineering based on a pre-trained multi-modal large model, cleaning data, screening out analysis contents describing the integrity, constructing a training data set, carrying out fine adjustment on the pre-trained multi-modal large model according to the training data set, retrieving similar images of an image to be detected from a pre-constructed database, taking the similar images as reference information for assisting in image tampering behavior analysis, and outputting tampering behavior analysis results of the image to be detected through the prompt engineering based on the fine-adjusted multi-modal large model. The method and the device realize accurate analysis of the image tampering behavior by the multi-mode large model, and improve the interpretability of the positioning result of the tampering positioning model.

title: Grape embryo focus segmentation and integration method and device based on image large model
description: The invention discloses a grape embryo focus segmentation and integration method and device based on an image large model, which comprises the following steps of A constructing a focus segmentation neural network model comprising a proliferation segmentation neural network model and a edema segmentation neural network model, B acquiring a grape embryo slice scan image, C acquiring a grape embryo slice scan image segmentation block, D acquiring a proliferation focus segmentation image and a edema focus segmentation image corresponding to each segmentation block by utilizing the proliferation segmentation neural network model and the edema segmentation neural network model, respectively carrying out corresponding fusion to obtain a preliminary complete slice proliferation focus segmentation image and a slice edema focus segmentation image, E integrating the preliminary complete slice proliferation focus segmentation image and the slice edema focus segmentation image to obtain an integrated slice focus segmentation image, and F obtaining a post-processed slice focus segmentation image reflecting the actual focus morphology through post-processing. The invention can accurately identify the lesion areas of hyperplasia and edema of the grape embryo slices.

title: A large-scale question-answering device based on a local knowledge base
description: This invention relates to the field of intelligent management technology, and specifically discloses a large-scale question-answering device based on a local knowledge base. The device includes a knowledge base building module: constructing a local knowledge base based on acquired domain knowledge and dynamically updating the knowledge base; a query and retrieval module: integrating intelligent user role judgment and intelligent analysis mechanisms, and outputting actual retrieval results based on scenario-causal dual-dimensional analysis; and a model interaction module: the target question-answering large model outputs answers based on the actual retrieval results and provides feedback to optimize the answers. By constructing a local knowledge base and dynamically updating it, integrating intelligent user role judgment and intelligent analysis mechanisms, outputting actual retrieval results, and using the target question-answering large model to output answers based on the actual retrieval results and provide feedback to optimize the answers, this device can effectively achieve personalized adaptation to user needs and improve the level of question-answering intelligence, enabling it to adapt to complex and dynamic work environments and providing efficient decision support for enterprises.

title: A triplet extraction method and device for sparse samples in the field of coal mine electromechanical equipment
