description: The present application provides a method and device for extracting triples from sparse samples in the field of coal mine electromechanical equipment. The method includes: using the BERT model as a training model for text vectorization; using Bi-LSTM to fuse Span contextual semantic relationships during the Span extraction process; and performing relationship classification on candidate Span entity pairs through a relationship classifier; wherein, a sliding window mechanism is used during the Span extraction process to represent each entity as a continuous subsequence. In this method, the Span method uses a sliding window mechanism, which represents each entity as a continuous subsequence rather than a separate tag, which can effectively solve the triple overlap problem. Bi-LSTM is used to fuse Span contextual semantics in the entity extraction and relationship prediction stages, thereby improving the recognition effect of overlapping triples. This method also has better effects on enhancing relationship categories within the field than ordinary synonym replacement and back translation methods.

title: An activity recognition method based on conditional adversarial data augmentation
description: The invention discloses an activity recognition method based on condition antagonism data enhancement, which comprises three parts of a conditional generation antagonism network, a kinematic feature constraint module and a prototype sample generator, wherein the system hardware structure is designed based on an embedded heterogeneous computing platform, a main processor adopts ARM Cortex-A72 core operation conditions to generate the antagonism network, a coprocessor adopts NPU to accelerate kinematic parameter calculation, and a sensor interface module is connected with a six-axis IMU sensor through an SPI bus to acquire accelerometer and gyroscope data in real time. The activity recognition method based on the condition contrast data enhancement can provide enhancement data with diversity, authenticity and semantic accuracy for the human activity recognition model under the scene of insufficient training data, so that the overall recognition accuracy of the model on a UCI HAR data set is improved by 14.7%, the F1 value on few sample types is averagely improved by 21.3%, and an effective technical solution is provided for data scarcity scenes such as medical monitoring and motion analysis.

title: A rapid design and preparation method of absorbing materials based on machine learning
description: The invention relates to a rapid design and preparation method of a wave-absorbing material based on machine learning, and belongs to the technical field of wave-absorbing material preparation. The rapid design and preparation method of the wave-absorbing material comprises the following steps of firstly obtaining a small sample database by experimental preparation, secondly establishing a machine learning model, training the model through the small sample database, and improving the accuracy of the model. And then, obtaining corresponding electromagnetic parameters by inputting different process parameters, optimizing the wave absorbing performance of the wave absorbing material by adopting impedance gradient design, and inverting the process parameters based on an optimizing result to prepare the multi-layer wave absorbing material. According to the rapid design and the preparation method of the wave-absorbing material, disclosed by the invention, a large number of electromagnetic parameters are rapidly obtained through combination of machine learning and simulation optimization, and broadband wave-absorbing performance is obtained through the simulation optimization design. And then inverting the process of the required electromagnetic parameters based on the design result to guide the actual preparation.

title: Generalized 3DGS sparse reconstruction method, system, equipment and medium based on wavelet enhancement
description: The present invention discloses a generalizable 3DGS sparse reconstruction method, system, device and medium based on wavelet enhancement. The reconstruction method includes: obtaining a two-dimensional sparse image; obtaining enhanced features that fuse the frequency domain and the spatial domain from the two-dimensional sparse image through a wavelet-enhanced image feature extraction network; performing target view depth estimation on the enhanced features that fuse the frequency domain and the spatial domain to obtain target view geometric depth distribution information; establishing a Gaussian ellipsoid based on the target view geometric depth distribution information; and rendering the Gaussian ellipsoid through rasterization to obtain a rendered image of a new perspective. The present invention utilizes a wavelet-enhanced image feature extraction network to obtain enhanced features that fuse the frequency domain and the spatial domain, constructing a global cost volume that can better highlight low-frequency shapes, thereby improving the geometric accuracy of 3DGS and enabling better scene modeling. The method can be widely used in downstream tasks such as sparse three-dimensional reconstruction, new perspective synthesis, and scene editing.

title: Autonomous mapping method for intelligent robot in GNSS refusing environment
description: The application belongs to the technical field of intelligent robot navigation and positioning, and discloses an intelligent robot autonomous mapping method under a GNSS refused environment, which comprises the following steps of monitoring GNSS signal states in real time, and switching to pure laser SLAM mapping when the number of available satellites, PDOP or pseudo range residual errors exceeding a threshold value are detected; collecting three-dimensional point cloud data, filtering and denoising to obtain filtered and denoised current frame point cloud, performing laser radar map building and positioning registration, selecting key frame point cloud, constructing lightweight neural implicit scene representation and training an MLP (multi-level rule based) network, performing loop detection and constructing a sparse factor graph, correcting the pose of the key frame, and then applying the corrected pose of the key frame to the original three-dimensional point cloud data to generate a two-dimensional grid map. According to the application, under the condition that GNSS signals are blocked or fail, the environment map with high precision and low drift is continuously generated, and the real-time performance and the robustness of the autonomous map building are remarkably improved.

title: Task scheduling method, device, equipment, medium and product for electric power system
description: The embodiment of the application provides a task scheduling method, device, equipment, medium and product for an electric power system, which are applied to the technical field of intelligent power grids. The method comprises the steps of responding to task scheduling requests, obtaining operation data of multiple dimensions in an electric power system, distributing corresponding data preprocessing strategies for the operation data based on a preset strategy rule base aiming at the operation data of each dimension, carrying out data preprocessing on the operation data based on the data preprocessing strategies to obtain preprocessed data, carrying out feature extraction on the preprocessed data to obtain data feature vectors, inputting the data feature vectors corresponding to the operation data of the multiple dimensions into a pre-trained scheduling task generating model to obtain a task execution list, and executing scheduling tasks based on the task execution list, wherein the scheduling task generating model is obtained by carrying out model training on the historical operation data of the electric power system. The method achieves the technical effect of improving the task scheduling efficiency of the power system.

title: Fluorescent image computer vision quantification method for OPCs differentiation markers
description: The invention relates to the field of image data processing, in particular to a fluorescent image computer vision quantification method of an OPCs differentiation marker. The method comprises the steps of carrying out contrast enhancement treatment on a fluorescent image of an OPCs differentiation marker to obtain an enhanced fluorescent image, carrying out self-adaptive denoising treatment to obtain a denoised fluorescent image, extracting multi-scale features from the denoised fluorescent image to obtain a multi-scale feature map, carrying out expansion treatment on a boundary region of the OPCs differentiation marker based on the multi-scale feature map to obtain an expanded boundary region of the OPCs differentiation marker, carrying out image segmentation to obtain a preliminary segmentation image, carrying out optimization treatment on the preliminary segmentation image to obtain a final segmentation image, and carrying out quantization analysis on the final segmentation image. Solves the technical problems of inaccurate and incomplete fluorescent image quantitative analysis caused by inaccurate fluorescent image processing analysis of OPCs differentiation markers.

title: Knowledge graph automatic construction and updating method based on graph neural network
description: The present invention discloses a method for automatically constructing and updating a knowledge graph based on a graph neural network, comprising the following steps: obtaining multi-source data and constructing a graph structure; initializing a node embedding matrix, using the initial features of the node as the node embedding of the 0th layer; setting the number of network layers, and cyclically executing the following neighbor feature aggregation steps from the 1st layer to the set number of layers: uniformly and randomly sampling the neighbors of each node to obtain a fixed number of sampled neighbor sets; aggregating the node embeddings in the sampled neighbor sets of each node to generate neighbor aggregation features; concatenating the embeddings of the node in the previous layer with the neighbor aggregation features to generate the node embeddings of the current layer; and updating the entity relationships of the knowledge graph based on the node embeddings of the current layer according to changes in similarity. In this way, the semantic and structural information of entities and relationships can be automatically learned and the latest status of entity relationships can be reflected in a timely and accurate manner, effectively improving the automation level and update efficiency of knowledge graph construction.

title: Breast cancer pathological section classification method and system based on improved residual error network
description: The present invention relates to the field of medical image recognition technology, and in particular to a breast cancer pathology section classification method and system based on an improved residual network. The method obtains a tissue pathology section image, inputs the tissue pathology section image into a pre-trained slice classification residual network model, and obtains a classified tissue pathology section image. The slice classification residual network model is obtained by adding an attention module mechanism BiFormer to the main residual network architecture Basicblock of the residual network, and replacing the convolution kernel in the residual block with a depthwise separable convolution. The collaboration of the attention module mechanism BiFormer and the depthwise separable convolution can not only improve the accuracy of breast cancer pathology section classification, but also significantly reduce the computational cost, thereby solving the problems of high computational complexity and large background noise interference in the pathology section classification method in the prior art.

title: Flexible exoskeleton device for relieving parkinsonism frozen gait and control method thereof
description: The invention discloses a flexible exoskeleton device for relieving parkinsonism frozen gait and a control method thereof, wherein the exoskeleton device comprises a driving device, a flexible supporting and wearing structure, a multi-source sensing module and a control circuit module, the tension is directly acted on the corresponding position of the quadriceps femoris muscle group through the flexible cable driven by the motor, so as to simulate the knee lifting action during muscle contraction and complete the hip joint buckling action. The invention provides an exoskeleton control method based on joint moment estimation under the condition of unknown tasks, which is used for predicting the joint moment of a human body based on a deep neural network, mapping the joint moment estimation value into an auxiliary moment required by the exoskeleton through continuous functions such as scaling, delay, filtering and the like, and completing tracking of the auxiliary moment by a feedback control driving motor. The control method disclosed by the invention can dynamically adapt to non-periodic and unstructured human motion tasks without predefining task types or gait phases, and can provide individualized assistance for parkinsonism patients.

title: Shaft diameter measurement method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of shaft diameter measurement, in particular to a shaft diameter measurement method which comprises the following steps of S1, measuring a measured shaft by using a shaft diameter contour point measurement device to obtain point cloud data of a measured shaft section contour, S2, denoising the obtained point cloud data to obtain measured shaft section contour points, and S3, performing optimal circle fitting on the point cloud data by adopting a bat algorithm added with boundary rules for limiting bat positions, thereby realizing the measurement of the measured shaft diameter. The invention has the advantages that the measuring device is adopted to measure the diameter contour point of the measured shaft, the noise is removed through filtering, and the point cloud data is subjected to optimal circle fitting through the bat algorithm added with the boundary rule for limiting the bat position, so that the diameter of the measured shaft is measured.

title: Hydrogen-electricity composite scheduling optimization method and system
description: The invention discloses a hydrogen-electricity composite scheduling optimization method which comprises the following steps of (1) collecting power grid and load data, hydrogen energy storage system data, lithium battery system data, maintenance cost and system service life data, (2) carrying out main component analysis and dimension reduction on a data matrix, smoothing the data through time sequence feature processing, (3) establishing a target function of hydrogen-electricity composite scheduling optimization according to the data obtained in the step (2), (4) carrying out load prediction and comprehensive strategy calculation by adopting a TS-SAC algorithm based on a Transformer framework according to the target function established in the step (3), (5) carrying out optimal battery charge and discharge power calculated in the step (4) and optimal power grid load scheduling, transmitting the optimal battery charge and discharge power and optimal power grid load scheduling into a distributed control framework, and coordinating and controlling an energy storage system and a power grid connection point, and (6) utilizing an encryption technology and an authentication technology to ensure safety of data transmission. This patent improves electric wire netting stability and system efficiency through reasonable configuration and optimal scheduling.

title: Beam management in a communication network
description: Methods, apparatus, and systems for beam management in communications are disclosed. The method includes identifying an optimal beam pair based on one or more signals received from a base station, updating one or more learning models included in the UE based on the identified optimal beam pair, the one or more learning models including at least one of one or more weights, or one or more parameters, determining one or more beam directions of at least one of the UE or the base station based on the updated one or more learning models, and transmitting at least one of the updated one or more learning models, or the updated one or more parameters, to the base station.

title: Service life assessment method of enhanced high-voltage circuit breaker
description: The present invention is applicable to the technical field of life assessment and provides an enhanced high-voltage circuit breaker life assessment method, which includes: constructing a dynamic evolution model of contact material wear rate; constructing a dynamic prediction model of nozzle degradation; constructing a probability distribution of the remaining life of insulating materials; constructing a comprehensive life assessment index based on the dynamic evolution model of contact material wear rate, the dynamic prediction model of nozzle degradation and the probability distribution of the remaining life of insulating materials; inputting the comprehensive life assessment index into a preset hierarchical prediction architecture for evaluation; wherein, the first layer generates a basic life distribution through a Bayesian network, the second layer outputs a posterior life distribution correction parameter through a convolutional neural network, and the third layer optimizes the posterior distribution through a KL divergence minimization algorithm to obtain a probability density function and a confidence interval of the remaining electrical life; dynamically correcting the model parameters of the hierarchical prediction architecture, the present invention is based on the ability to reduce the error of life assessment under complex working conditions.

title: Storage method and system of intelligent storage cabinet
description: The invention discloses a keeping method and a system of an intelligent keeping cabinet, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving authority parameters and user biological characteristics of an on-line approval request and generating an encrypted digital token; based on the encrypted digital token, a multi-mode biological feature fusion algorithm is adopted to carry out identity authentication, a space-time attention mechanism is used for associating human face features with voiceprint features, a dynamic identity verification code is output, a target storage cabinet group is activated according to the dynamic identity verification code, an article unique identification set is generated, an optimal cabinet allocation scheme is output based on difference analysis of the article unique identification set and a preset inventory list, a modularized cabinet group executing mechanism is driven according to the optimal cabinet allocation scheme to adjust a physical structure, article state data is synchronously encrypted and written into a distributed account book, and an edge computing node is triggered to update a global inventory topological diagram. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, the intelligent, self-adaptive and distributed collaborative management of the safe deposit cabinet can be realized on the premise of ensuring the safety.

title: Campus intelligent monitoring system and method based on LoRa and sensor data fusion
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring, in particular to a campus intelligent monitoring system and method based on fusion of LoRa and sensing data, comprising the following steps of establishing a sensing distribution model; the method comprises the steps of periodically obtaining link performance of each sensing module, calculating a priority value and a corresponding first transmission quantity by combining data importance and a first cache data quantity, transmitting the sensing data to a gateway unit by each sensing module based on the priority value and the first transmission quantity, adding the sensing data to a corresponding transmission queue according to the priority value, predicting predicted priority values and network link performance for a period of time in the future by a real-time updated sensing distribution model, data importance and a second cache data quantity based on a machine learning model, calculating the capacity of the transmission queue and dynamically distributing a storage space, transmitting the data of a cache area to a monitoring unit according to priority, extracting monitoring information and marking the monitoring information to the sensing distribution model. The method solves the problem of low campus data transmission efficiency, and improves the campus monitoring real-time performance and the system stability.

title: A Decision-Making Method for Adjusting Territorial Spatial Layout Based on Planning Conflict Identification
description: This application discloses a decision-making method for adjusting the spatial layout of national territory based on planning conflict identification, belonging to the field of national territory spatial planning and management technology. The method includes the following steps: constructing a spatiotemporal conflict feature vector library containing multi-dimensional attributes; generating a semantic knowledge graph containing causal relationships, temporal relationships, spatial relationships, and subordinate relationships; achieving accurate prediction of the intensity and duration of the impact of conflict states over time; achieving trend analysis and risk level assessment of cross-scale conflict propagation paths; automatically identifying explicit conflicts in the current layout and potential conflicts based on propagation prediction, and using fuzzy clustering to intelligently classify complex conflicts; automatically generating phased differentiated conflict intervention strategy recommendations; solving for spatial layout adjustment schemes; and determining whether the layout adjustment schemes meet preset conflict mitigation standards.

title: Switch cabinet partial discharge real-time monitoring method based on signal transmission
description: The present invention discloses a real-time monitoring method for partial discharge in switchgear based on signal transmission, which relates to the field of discharge monitoring technology. The method comprises placing UHF antennas and environmental monitoring sensors at key locations within the switchgear to collect partial discharge signals; setting trigger conditions to obtain high-speed sampling waveforms, and improving the signal-to-noise ratio through wavelet packet decomposition and dynamic threshold denoising; adaptively adjusting denoising parameters in conjunction with a reinforcement learning algorithm; classifying and reasoning the denoised signals using a pulse neural network to extract the confidence levels of multiple types of partial discharge patterns; and confirming the classification results or triggering rollback and degradation modes based on multi-dimensional indicators. The present invention possesses high-precision signal denoising, adaptive parameter optimization, and multi-mode classification capabilities, enabling online identification and real-time response to partial discharge types, making it suitable for switchgear status monitoring in complex electromagnetic environments.

title: Intelligent nuclide identification method and system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear radiation detection and marine environment monitoring, and discloses an intelligent nuclide identification method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a nuclide energy spectrum based on a target area actually measured by a gamma detector, determining a nuclide characteristic peak according to the nuclide energy spectrum, determining the peak area of the nuclide characteristic peak and the energy difference between a theoretical energy value and an actually measured energy value of the nuclide characteristic peak, determining a nuclide initial confidence according to the peak area and the energy difference, identifying nuclide based on the nuclide initial confidence if the nuclide initial confidence is smaller than or equal to a set threshold, determining nuclide existence based on the nuclide initial confidence, converting the initial confidence into probability based on a Bayesian network if the nuclide initial confidence is larger than the set threshold, and identifying nuclide based on the probability, and determining nuclide existence. The nuclide identification accuracy can be improved through the method and the device.

title: Fault diagnosis methods and devices, storage media and electronic equipment
description: This application discloses a fault diagnosis method and apparatus, storage medium, and electronic device, relating to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method is applied to a container platform and includes: obtaining context information of the container scheduling unit from a front-end page, and generating first request information based on the context information and natural language instructions input by the target object; querying associated information corresponding to the first request information from a database to obtain query results; executing an execution instruction determined based on the first request information and the query results to obtain execution results, wherein the execution results include container scheduling unit status information and fault log information; and inputting the first request information, the query results, and the execution results into a large language model to obtain fault diagnosis results output by the large language model. This solves the technical problem of low operational efficiency in container platforms and achieves the technical effect of improving the operational efficiency of container platforms.

title: Aeroengine gas circuit system fault diagnosis method based on cross-domain small sample learning
description: The present invention discloses a method for fault diagnosis of an aero-engine gas path system based on cross-domain small sample learning, comprising: balanced sampling of source domain data and probabilistic data enhancement of target domain data; extracting deep-level features of the data using a multi-level feature enhancement module, calculating the loss of the source domain data using an LDAM loss function with an adaptive weight mechanism, comparing and projecting the source domain features with the target domain features, inputting the comparison loss function, using the weight sum as the final loss function, updating the parameters using a back propagation algorithm, and finally training based on an aero-engine gas path system data set to obtain a final fault diagnosis result; the present invention improves the fault diagnosis accuracy under the condition of scarce samples, optimizes the label and feature offset problems caused by imbalanced source domain data, significantly improves the accuracy of the diagnosis result, and provides an effective solution for ensuring the stability and reliability of aero-engine gas path systems in industrial applications.

title: Intelligent body reasoning method based on knowledge graph
description: The invention discloses an agent reasoning method based on knowledge graph, belonging to the technical field of knowledge graph, which integrates user inquiry, knowledge graph and multi-modal data through NLP model and entity linking technology to extract target entity, relation constraint and structured feature vector, the invention can synthesize more information to generate more comprehensive conclusion through fusing multi-modal data such as text, image, audio and the like, the knowledge embedding model maps entity relations into geometric relations in a vector space, the LLM is assisted to verify reasonability of reasoning, the system can comprehensively generate confidence coefficient through LLM output probability, knowledge embedding similarity and data quality, the confidence coefficient scoring can explain reliability of a result, and the LLM generation capacity is combined with the knowledge embedding vector reasoning capacity to make up for limitation of a single model.

title: Model light-weight method and system for end-side large model
description: The application relates to the technical field of large models, in particular to a model light-weight method and system of an end-side large model, and aims to solve the problem of how to acquire quantization bits suitable for each layer of the end-side large model based on the precision requirement of the end-side large model. The method comprises the steps of obtaining reference precision and data distribution statistical results corresponding to preset quantized bits based on an inference sample set, obtaining disturbance influence factors after disturbance data are added based on the inference data set, disturbance data, the reference precision and the data distribution statistical results, and further obtaining optimal bits of each layer. The method comprises the steps of carrying out quantization on a large model by using an optimal bit suitable for each layer of precision, reducing the quantization bit for a layer with low operator precision requirement, thereby improving operation speed and storage efficiency, and improving the quantization bit for a layer with high operator precision requirement, compensating precision loss caused by fixed quantization with lower numerical value, thereby ensuring operation effect of the end side large model.

title: Blood coagulation specimen quality screening classification system and method based on image recognition
description: The present invention relates to the field of specimen image detection technology, and discloses a coagulation specimen quality screening and classification system and method based on image recognition, the method comprising: obtaining image information of each coagulation specimen in a batch to be screened, and performing image preprocessing on the image information; extracting feature information of each coagulation specimen in the preprocessed image information, and performing a primary evaluation of the coagulation specimen based on the feature information and configured preset feature information; performing a trust score evaluation on the primary evaluation result based on a fused convolutional neural network, and determining whether to perform a secondary evaluation of the coagulation specimen based on the relationship between the evaluated trust score and the configured preset trust score, wherein if the trust score is lower than the preset trust score, it is determined that the coagulation specimen is to be secondary evaluated. The present invention effectively improves the accuracy of coagulation specimen quality screening through multi-level image preprocessing, feature extraction, primary evaluation and trust score evaluation, combined with the judgment mechanism of the fused convolutional neural network.

title: Cross-domain transducer-based infrared and visible light image fusion method
description: The present invention relates to a cross-domain Transformer-based infrared and visible light image fusion method, belonging to the field of computer image processing. The method comprises: performing preprocessing operations on infrared images and visible light images to obtain training datasets; designing an end-to-end image generator network, wherein an encoder module is used to extract deep semantic features of the infrared and visible light images; a fusion module introduces an axial attention mechanism to enhance the global modeling capability of features and combines information in the spatial and frequency domains to perform feature fusion; the fused features are gradually restored to the image space through a decoder module to generate a fused image; a fusion loss function module is constructed to guide the network to focus on significant feature differences between the source image and the fused image based on contrastive learning ideas; and finally, the Y channels of the infrared and visible light images are input into the network model to generate a fused image and complete the training process, thereby achieving unified optimization of fusion performance and visual quality.

title: Intelligent monitoring and early warning method, system, equipment and medium for ice coating thickness of distribution line
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of power system safety monitoring equipment, and specifically to a method, system, equipment and medium for intelligent monitoring and early warning of ice thickness on distribution lines. The method realizes synchronous acquisition and preprocessing of multi-dimensional parameters by deploying an anti-icing packaged multi-parameter sensor array; dynamically optimizes the mode number and penalty factor of variational mode decomposition using a genetic algorithm to realize multi-scale feature decoupling of icing signals; uses a gated recurrent unit to extract time series features, inputs the Kolmogorov-Arnold network to perform nonlinear mapping, and fuses dual-path outputs through residual connections; deploys the trained hybrid model to an industrial-grade edge computing unit, and uses edge computing power to complete local real-time inference; triggers sliding window incremental updates based on a prediction error threshold, and dynamically adjusts the output layer weights to maintain model adaptability; and through hardware-algorithm collaborative innovation, ensures reliable operation in extreme low-temperature environments, significantly shortens warning response time, and improves prediction accuracy.

title: Model training method, conversion method, electronic device, medium, and program product
description: The present disclosure provides a model training method, a conversion method, an electronic device, a medium and a program product, which relate to the field of image processing technology. Among them, the model training method includes: performing pixel-level alignment processing on the eye image of the source modality and the corresponding eye structure diagnosis video of the target modality; selecting the key frames in the eye structure diagnosis video of the target modality after the alignment processing; using the eye image of the source modality after the alignment processing as the first initial domain, and the key frames of the corresponding target modality as the first target domain for training to obtain a first model; using the key frames of the target modality as the second initial domain, and the eye structure diagnosis video of the target modality after the alignment processing as the second target domain for training to obtain a second model, so as to obtain an eye dynamic sequence generation model. Through the technical solution of the present disclosure, the static ophthalmic image of the source modality is converted into the dynamic ophthalmic video of the target modality, and it has the characteristics of non-invasiveness, safety and low cost.

title: A rate-delay scalable coding method and system for vibration tactile signals
description: The invention discloses a code rate delay scalable coding method and a code rate delay scalable coding system for vibration touch signals, which relate to the technical field of vibration touch signal coding and comprise the steps of receiving triaxial vibration touch signals, preprocessing the triaxial vibration touch signals to obtain preprocessed triaxial vibration touch signals, inputting the preprocessed triaxial vibration touch signals into a pre-established non-stationary self-coder model based on limited scalar quantization and attention, outputting to obtain a difference value between a normalized reconstruction frame and a normalized frame and an FSQ code word, calculating to obtain a residual error based on the difference value between the normalized reconstruction frame and the normalized frame, quantizing the residual error according to quantization bit width by adopting a non-uniform quantization method to generate a residual error quantization index, and performing lossless compression on the FSQ code word and the residual error quantization index by using entropy coding to generate an output bit stream, so that the coding performance can be improved.

title: Cultural and tourism map search system and method based on deep learning and Beidou database
description: This invention discloses a cultural and tourism map search system and method based on deep learning and the Beidou database. The system includes the following steps: obtaining user location and trajectory data, loading geographic objects, and constructing a heterogeneous graph; receiving natural language requests, extracting semantic vectors, and writing them into the graph; constructing a graph comparison learning network, generating views, and performing embedding learning; optimizing structural parameters using the pigeon flock algorithm and outputting the optimal model; constructing a current location node, extracting local subgraphs, and generating a ranked list; performing path reasoning, generating recommendation results, and providing feedback updates. By integrating deep semantic understanding with geographic trajectory modeling, the system achieves high-precision, interpretable, and self-learning intelligent search and recommendation for cultural and tourism maps driven by the user's current location.

title: A data analysis method and system based on machine learning
description: The application provides a data analysis method and a system based on machine learning, which belong to the technical field of data processing and analysis, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring and fusing multi-source heterogeneous data sources of a processing target hospital; the method comprises the steps of processing multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain a target data set, storing the target data set into a plurality of storage partitions based on a preset data model and partition rules to obtain a plurality of data subsets, analyzing filtering conditions in a user query request, matching the target data subsets from the plurality of data subsets, selecting an analysis model from a preset model base according to analysis target parameters in the query request and partition attributes of the target data subsets, analyzing the target data subsets and outputting analysis results, generating corresponding reports based on the analysis results, and interacting with a user through a graphical user interface. The application can improve the management level of the hospital.

title: Tea lesser leafhopper disaster prediction method based on self-attention mechanism
description: The invention provides a tea lesser leafhopper disaster prediction method based on a self-attention mechanism, the method includes acquiring a data set, and generating a time sequence sample by using a sliding window method on the data set. Constructing a tea lesser leafhopper number prediction model, wherein the tea lesser leafhopper number prediction model is based on an LSTM neural network and a multi-head self-attention mechanism. And inputting the data set into a tea lesser leafhopper number prediction model to predict, so as to obtain the current number of the shutter insects of the tea lesser leafhopper. Calculating the insect mouth change rate according to the current number of the shutter insect mouths, and sending out a tea lesser leafhopper disaster risk prompt according to the insect mouth change rate. The invention adopts a sliding window method to construct time sequence data samples so as to fuse multi-source time sequence data and a biophysical mechanism. The double-layer LSTM module and the multi-head attention mechanism are adopted to construct a tea lesser leafhopper number prediction model, so that high-rank expression and task self-adaption are realized under the condition that parameters are not increased, and the disaster risk of the tea lesser leafhopper is accurately and dynamically quantified.

title: A method for real-time monitoring of fuel consumption of diesel locomotives in work teams based on multi-factor coupling
description: This invention discloses a real-time fuel consumption monitoring method for diesel locomotives in work teams based on multi-factor coupling, belonging to the field of locomotive real-time fuel consumption monitoring technology. It includes collecting raw data through a multimodal sensor network according to the locomotive's full-domain perception requirements, and performing spatiotemporal alignment and anomaly detection through edge computing units. This invention constructs an asymmetric game model, incorporating the intensity of policy interference between locomotives and locomotives into the payoff function. The asymmetric game model quantifies the policy interference of locomotive i on locomotive j, achieving dynamic game-theoretic solution of multi-locomotive collaborative strategies. Pareto optimal search further combines the game payoff function with multi-objective optimization, selecting the optimal solution through weighted sum of policy comprehensive scores, avoiding the one-sidedness of single-objective optimization. While ensuring the lowest global energy consumption, it also considers the stability of locomotive operation and individual fairness. Furthermore, the dynamic update mechanism of the game model adapts to real-time operating condition changes, improving system flexibility.

title: Power grid equipment operation state fault monitoring system with improved YOLOv8
description: The invention discloses an improved YOLOv power grid equipment running state fault monitoring system which comprises a multispectral image acquisition module, a data fusion module, an improved YOLOv target detection module, a multi-mode feature analysis module, a fault diagnosis module, a self-adaptive information updating module, an alarm module and a remote interaction module, wherein the multispectral image acquisition module is used for acquiring a multispectral image; the problems of multi-spectrum data redundancy, insufficient target detection precision, weak model generalization capability, poor fault diagnosis instantaneity and lack of dynamic updating capability of a traditional power grid equipment monitoring system are solved; according to the method, the multispectral image data is subjected to fusion processing through an improved weighted principal component analysis IWPCA algorithm, so that the data redundancy is eliminated, and the information utilization rate is improved; the type, the position and the running state of the power grid equipment are detected with high precision through the improved YOLOv network structure and the loss function, so that the small target identification capability is remarkably improved, the background interference is reduced, and the stable running and the efficient maintenance of the power grid equipment are ensured.

title: A method to improve the dynamic simulation accuracy of kinetic reactors
description: A method for improving dynamic simulation precision of a dynamic reactor comprises the steps of establishing a basic simulation model of the dynamic reactor, designing a training frame, wherein the training frame comprises an intelligent body and the basic simulation model, the intelligent body is used as a training target, the basic simulation model is used as a learning environment, the value of a key parameter is used as an action space of the intelligent body, training the intelligent body by using actual operation data of the dynamic reactor based on the training frame to obtain a value strategy of the key parameter value of the intelligent body after optimization under different working conditions, and carrying out parameter optimization on the basic simulation model to improve the precision of the basic simulation model. The dynamic model of the dynamic reactor, which covers all working conditions and has high precision, high stability and high calculation efficiency, is constructed.

title: A deep learning-based method for detecting and classifying abnormal electrocardiogram signals in internal medicine
description: The invention discloses a deep learning-based internal medicine electrocardiosignal anomaly detection and classification method, which relates to the technical field of electrocardiosignal detection and classification and comprises the following steps of collecting electrocardiosignal data and preprocessing, and removing noise by adopting a custom filtering algorithm; according to the invention, a multi-label hierarchical classification electrocardiographic abnormality detection framework based on reinforcement learning is constructed, so that more accurate abnormality detection and classification effects are realized, multiple abnormality types are marked, the problem that multiple abnormalities are difficult to identify concurrently is solved, a hierarchical classification structure is used for dividing a major class first, then accurately subdividing the major class, classification efficiency and accuracy are improved, a reinforcement learning algorithm is introduced, a classification result is compared with clinical diagnosis and fed back, attention points and judgment standards of a model are dynamically adjusted, a hierarchical classification flow and a multi-label classification strategy are optimized, self-optimization is performed according to actual conditions, the reliability of complex electrocardiographic abnormality detection is improved, and clinical diagnosis requirements are met.

title: Automatic soccer goal scoring system based on piezoelectric film pressure sensing
description: The present application relates to the field of sports science and technology, and discloses an automatic scoring system for soccer goals based on piezoelectric film pressure sensing. The system includes a piezoelectric film sensor array module, a signal acquisition and preprocessing module, a main control and data processing module, a communication module, and a display and feedback module. The method comprises the following steps: sensing pressure signals by deploying a sensor array at different points, amplifying and filtering, performing analog-to-digital conversion, and detecting events to output digitized waveform data; and then performing refined feature extraction, matrix decomposition pattern recognition, and machine learning classification and discrimination on the data. The present invention senses impact signals by deploying a piezoelectric film sensor array, amplifying, filtering, performing analog-to-digital conversion, and detecting events to output digitized waveform data. Refined feature extraction, matrix decomposition, and machine learning classification and discrimination are then used to intelligently determine goals, transmit, and display the results, effectively addressing the shortcomings of traditional penalty scoring.

title: Multi-mode data quality assessment method based on deep learning
description: This invention discloses a deep learning-based multimodal data quality assessment method, comprising: acquiring first-modal record data and second-modal record data marked as aligned in a database; extracting semantic features from the first-modal record data and the second-modal record data respectively to obtain a text structured data semantic coding feature tensor and a metadata description semantic coding feature vector; jointly encoding the text structured data semantic coding feature tensor and the metadata description semantic coding feature vector across modalities to obtain a structured-metadata cross-modal quality assessment joint coding feature tensor; generating reconstructed record data based on the structured-metadata cross-modal quality assessment joint coding feature tensor and calculating the offset features of the reconstructed record data; and performing quality assessment on the offset features using a first deep learning model. This invention improves the accuracy of data quality assessment through semantic coding feature extraction, fine-grained hash cross-modal coding, and bidirectional reconstruction offset assessment.

title: A building height extraction method and system based on oblique photogrammetry model
description: The invention relates to the technical field of three-dimensional modeling, and discloses a building height extraction method and system based on an oblique photography measurement model, which can remarkably improve the precision and efficiency of extracting building height from OSGB oblique photography models and realize automatic and accurate identification and height calculation of a building main body structure. By integrating space geometric feature analysis and a deep learning model, the problems of reflection interference of a glass curtain wall, misjudgment of a complex roof structure, miscounting of auxiliary structures such as a balcony and equipment are effectively solved, and reliability of a main body height extraction result is ensured. Meanwhile, subjective links such as manual measurement, manual contour drawing and experience parameter adjustment are completely abandoned, so that the accumulation of human errors is greatly reduced, and the processing speed is remarkably improved.

title: Method, apparatus and equipment for visual reconstruction of multi-bubble phase field in liquid metal
description: This invention relates to the field of nuclear reactor technology, specifically to a method, apparatus, and device for visual reconstruction of the phase field of multiple bubbles within liquid metal. The method includes: acquiring ultrasonic signals received by N ultrasonic transducers during each of T consecutive ultrasonic scans of the liquid metal within a test period; determining a spatiotemporal dynamic response sequence based on the ultrasonic signals received by the N ultrasonic transducers during each ultrasonic scan; characterizing the phase field evolution of the liquid metal within the test period using the spatiotemporal dynamic response sequence; and inputting the spatiotemporal dynamic response sequence into an image reconstruction model to obtain a sequence of phase field distribution maps of the liquid metal within the test period output by the image reconstruction model. This invention captures the dynamic information of the multi-bubble phase field evolution over time using an image reconstruction model based on the spatiotemporal dynamic response sequence, achieving visualized measurement of the dynamic behavior of bubbles within liquid metal.

title: Railway freight car buffer plate fault detection method, storage medium and device
description: A method, a storage medium and equipment for detecting faults of a buffer slave plate of a railway wagon belong to the technical field of railway wagon detection. In order to solve the problem that the conventional detection method cannot effectively detect the deformation of a buffer beam, the method acquires an image of a railway wagon buffer, and sends the image into a wagon buffer slave plate fault detection network model for detection, wherein the wagon buffer slave plate fault detection network model adopts a neural network model provided with a position detection regression head and a category classification head, a slave plate deformation regression branch is added at an output layer of the network, the slave plate deformation degree D is output through a full connection layer, and the D is determined according to the inclination angle of the slave plate in the width direction and the inclination angle of the slave plate in the height direction and the difference between the width and the height included angles and 90 degrees.

title: Knowledge base management method, system and medium based on data mining technology
description: This application discloses a knowledge base management method, system, and medium based on data mining technology, which mainly relates to the field of knowledge base management technology and is used to solve the problem that existing solutions are difficult to balance privacy protection and data utility, and there is a risk of privacy data being leaked during the calculation process. It includes: migrating encrypted numerical data in a privacy knowledge database to a visual database; obtaining specific data and specific formulas involved in the calculation through the corresponding display interface of the visual database; when encrypted numerical data exists in the specific data, inputting the encrypted numerical data and calculation formula into a trained preset neural learning algorithm to obtain first result data, inputting non-encrypted numerical data into a conventional formula to obtain second result data; and inputting the first result data and the second result data into a combined result formula to obtain the final calculation result.

title: Storage-efficient inference computation for neural networks on embedded systems
description: A method for processing input data into output data by means of a neural task network, wherein the behavior of the neural task network is characterized by trainable parameters, the method comprising the following steps: · The processing of input data into output data by the neural task network is divided into a plurality of computational steps based at least on the architecture of the neural task network, wherein different subsets of trainable parameters are required simultaneously in these computational steps; · For each of the computational steps, a call vector for accessing the respectively simultaneously required trainable parameters is determined; · The call vector is fed to a supernetwork, which then outputs the parameters required simultaneously for the computational steps; and · The corresponding computational steps are executed using the parameters.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle operator behavior prediction method and system based on machine learning
description: This invention relates to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) control technology, and discloses a method and system for predicting UAV operator behavior based on machine learning. The method includes: collecting multimodal behavioral data such as operation command sequences, visual gaze trajectories, and physiological signals; generating parameter evolution feature data through noise suppression and temporal feature processing; constructing an operation mode-behavior response correlation model, analyzing intent correlation, and evaluating intent probability; identifying the scope of behavior influence, coupling operation state modes to generate state-effect coupling data; and predicting operator behavior and adjusting UAV operation parameters based on the machine learning model. The system includes a scene monitoring module, a data processing module, an intent analysis module, a state evaluation module, and a behavior prediction module. This invention achieves efficient integration and dynamic prediction of multimodal data, improving the intelligence level and response accuracy of UAV operation.

title: A medium- to long-term wind power simulation method, system, and related equipment
description: This application belongs to the field of wind power prediction technology and discloses a medium- and long-term wind power simulation method, system, and related equipment. The method includes: effectively dividing typical daily power fluctuation processes from the wind power output fluctuation process based on time series similarity and an improved K-means clustering algorithm; establishing a correlation probability matrix of typical daily fluctuation processes in different seasons of the wind farm based on the typical daily power fluctuation processes to obtain the correlation rules of the typical daily power fluctuation processes; replacing the time transition probability matrix in the traditional Markov algorithm with the correlation probability matrix of the typical daily fluctuation processes to construct a medium- and long-term wind power simulation model based on the correlation characteristics of the typical daily fluctuation processes. The statistical characteristics, probability distribution, and autocorrelation of the wind power time series generated by this method are superior to traditional single-point modeling methods.

title: Cross-border logistics data collaborative optimization methods, devices, electronic equipment and storage media
description: This application relates to the field of cross-border logistics data collaborative optimization technology, and discloses a method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium for cross-border logistics data collaborative optimization. The method includes: inputting feature data into a preset prediction network to obtain a first predicted value; performing preliminary desensitization on the feature data; and inputting the desensitized feature data from the desensitized regional dataset into the preset prediction network to obtain a second predicted value; calculating the prediction error of each feature data, obtaining the desensitization level, and performing desensitization processing on the feature data in the regional dataset to obtain a desensitized target regional dataset; and inputting the target desensitized feature data into a preset global model to obtain an optimization scheme. The beneficial technical effects of this invention are: it achieves the ability to dynamically adjust the desensitization granularity, effectively solving the shortcomings of traditional static desensitization methods in adjusting data value.

title: Super-resolution-based transparent medium surface weak and small defect detection method and system
description: The application relates to the technical field of transparent medium surface defect detection, in particular to a super-resolution-based transparent medium surface weak and small defect detection method and system. According to the application, through a multistage degradation modeling and dynamic parameter filtering mechanism, the detection precision of low-contrast and small-size defects is remarkably improved, the differentiation requirements of different functional areas are met, and meanwhile, the accurate classification of defect types is realized. The method can efficiently identify the micro defects such as scratches, stains, pits and the like, and is suitable for high-precision quality detection scenes.

title: A method for measuring the flatness of anode plates used in anode shaping
description: This invention discloses a method for measuring the flatness of an anode plate used in anode shaping, relating to the field of anode plate measurement technology. The method includes acquiring ultrasonic measurement data of the anode plate to be tested; inputting the ultrasonic measurement data into a trained hybrid network model for two-stage feature extraction to obtain an initial feature set; the hybrid network model is composed of a one-dimensional convolutional network and a long short-term memory network; using a pre-built dynamic attention mechanism to map and perform weight analysis on the initial feature set to obtain key feature information; and generating the flatness measurement result of the anode plate to be tested based on the key feature information. The measurement method of this invention can effectively improve the accuracy of the measurement results.

title: Tri-tracking-based passive data field self-adaptive rotary machine fault diagnosis method
description: This invention discloses a passive data-domain adaptive fault diagnosis method for rotating machinery based on tri-training, comprising the following steps: S1, inputting source domain data and training the initial three-classifier; S2, inputting target domain data and generating pseudo-labels; S3, scoring results and fusing models; S4, co-training the three classifiers; S5, iterative optimization and self-adjustment; S6, outputting the fault diagnosis results for the target domain data. By introducing mutual supervision and self-training of the three classifiers, unlabeled data can be effectively utilized for model optimization. Compared with other passive data-domain adaptive methods, this method utilizes the feedback mechanism of multiple models to continuously generate pseudo-labels, improving the utilization efficiency and stability of unlabeled target domain data, and gradually improving the fault diagnosis accuracy of the model under target domain operating conditions, providing an efficient and reliable solution for fault diagnosis of rotating machinery in power systems.

title: Multistage condition diffusion model-based generation type face anonymization method
description: This invention discloses a generative face anonymization method based on a multi-level conditional diffusion model. The method first detects and aligns the face portion of the input image to obtain a face-aligned image, then extracts facial landmark features. Next, the face-aligned image and facial landmark features are combined using an attention mechanism to generate multi-level conditional features. Finally, based on these multi-level conditional features, an anonymized image is generated using a conditional diffusion model. This invention dynamically balances privacy strength and visual usability, adapting to different scenarios such as the diversity required by social media and the high anonymity requirements of security monitoring.

title: Capacity optimization configuration method of optical-storage multi-energy complementary micro-grid system
description: The invention relates to a capacity optimizing configuration method of an optical-storage multi-energy complementary micro-grid system, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing an optical-storage multi-energy complementary micro-grid system model, 2, constructing an objective function by taking the minimum life cycle cost of equipment as a target, 3, constructing constraint conditions by considering the operation characteristics of the optical-storage multi-energy complementary system and the management strategy of the energy storage system, 4, optimizing configuration of the capacity of the optical-storage multi-energy complementary micro-grid system by adopting multi-target optimization, 5, analyzing an example, and having the advantages of the hybrid energy storage system, the multi-target optimization and the double-layer optimizing planning.

title: Disaster recovery method, device and equipment based on large model
description: This application discloses a disaster recovery method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium based on a large model, comprising: acquiring system operation data and business knowledge; inputting the system operation data and business knowledge into a large model for defect simulation to generate a disaster model and a corresponding disaster recovery model, wherein the disaster recovery model is used to handle the corresponding disaster model; after monitoring a real-time disaster, determining a target disaster model matching the real-time disaster, and executing the target disaster recovery model corresponding to the target disaster model. This overcomes the limitations of traditional solutions that rely on manual intervention and the lack of customized IT disaster recovery knowledge in general large models, thereby more accurately generating disaster models and disaster recovery models that fit the actual IT architecture, improving the accuracy of disaster recovery solutions, reducing the delay and bias of manual decision-making, and better adapting to the dynamic changes of cloud-native environments. It provides more efficient and reliable disaster recovery support for complex and ever-changing IT systems, effectively ensuring business continuity and data security.

title: A Multi-Cloud Data Analysis Method and System Based on a Cloud Platform
description: The invention discloses a cloud platform-based multi-cloud data analysis method and system, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and the cloud platform-based multi-cloud data analysis method and system comprise the steps of configuring cross-cloud security connection and deploying an acquisition agent, scanning heterogeneous storage to generate a structured metadata list and a mode mapping table, constructing a unified metadata catalog based on a semantic similarity algorithm, marking a compliance label and generating an interactive topological graph in combination with geographic positioning, analyzing a blood-edge relationship after receiving a multi-mode request to output a standardized task descriptor, dynamically selecting an optimal node by adopting a four-dimensional evaluation matrix, enabling a sensitive task to return an encryption gradient through federal learning segmentation, enabling a non-sensitive task to execute homomorphic encryption aggregation, finally, injecting Laplace noise into a fusion intermediate result to realize differential privacy protection, generating a traceable audit report and automatically recycling resources.

title: A method and system for diagnosing bearing faults in a stamping press drive shaft
description: This invention provides a method and system for diagnosing bearing faults in a stamping press drive shaft. Addressing the current problem of insufficient fault data and limited labeling in stamping presses, which hinders the accuracy of fault diagnosis models, this invention considers the data equivalence between the test bench and the stamping press. A test bench with the same characteristic frequencies as the stamping press is constructed to acquire abundant, labeled source domain data. Combined with target domain data, which lacks sufficient fault data and labels from the stamping press, the vibration signals are preprocessed and their characteristic amplitudes are normalized. A transfer learning bearing fault diagnosis model is then constructed, reducing the distribution and feature differences between the target domain data and the source domain data, thereby achieving accurate identification and early diagnosis of faults in the stamping press drive shaft bearing.

title: Power optical cable fault positioning method and system using electronic signboard
description: The application provides a power optical cable fault positioning method and system utilizing an electronic signboard. The method comprises the steps of constructing a temperature distribution cloud chart based on temperature data and geographic distribution data, reconstructing a three-dimensional temperature field of an electric power optical cable in an electric power pipe gallery based on the temperature distribution cloud chart, identifying whether an optical cable overheat fault area exceeding a preset reference exists in the three-dimensional temperature field, identifying whether an optical cable external damage fault area exists based on image data and geographic distribution data, and generating electric power optical cable fault positioning information based on position information pre-stored in an electronic signboard in a target fault area and azimuth distance information of the target fault area and the electronic signboard, wherein the target fault area is the optical cable overheat fault area or the optical cable external damage fault area. The technical scheme provided by the application realizes unmanned intelligent inspection of the electric power pipe gallery and accurate positioning of double-type faults, and improves the fault response efficiency and the operation and maintenance safety.

title: Resource scheduling method and system based on reinforcement learning
description: This invention belongs to the field of resource scheduling technology, specifically disclosing a resource scheduling method and system based on reinforcement learning. The method includes: constructing a dynamically updatable task causal relationship graph to characterize the dependencies and conflicts between tasks; constructing a state space and action space based on the current task state and causal relationships, and training an intelligent agent using a reinforcement learning model with a multi-objective reward function to generate scheduling and resource allocation strategies; performing linear programming and heuristic joint resource allocation under the guidance of these strategies, and dynamically adjusting task priorities and causal relationships based on task states; and further adjusting the model structure and parameters by collecting execution data and analyzing strategy deviations to form a complete closed-loop optimization process. This invention achieves dynamic adjustment of task priorities, adaptive updating of resource allocation strategies, and closed-loop optimization of the scheduling process, making it suitable for complex project management scenarios with multiple tasks and resource constraints.

title: Systems and methods for machine learning based CSI codebook generation and CSI reporting
description: A system and method for a wireless device to derive a CSI codebook based on a decoder and a vector quantization codebook, receive a reference signal from a base station, derive an estimated channel from the reference signal, select an entry from the CSI codebook based on the estimated channel and a selection criterion, and report an index of the selected entry to the base station. The wireless device may receive a subset indication, derive a second CSI codebook from the subset indication, and select the CSI codebook entry from the second CSI codebook. The network controller may obtain a CSI compression machine learning (MACHINE LEARNING, ML) system and a vector quantization codebook. The decoder may be part of the CSI-compression ML system, the vector quantization codebook may be based on an encoder of the CSI-compression ML system, and the vector quantization codebook may be transmitted to the wireless device.

title: Self-calibration temperature sensor based on temperature fixed point and predicted temperature point
description: The invention discloses a self-calibration temperature sensor based on a temperature fixed point and a predicted temperature point, which relates to the technical field of temperature testing and comprises the following components: the thermal resistance temperature sensor is used for sensing the ambient temperature; the device comprises a metal block, a heating sheet, a phase change point alloy, a processor and a self-calibration temperature sensor, wherein the metal block is heated to a specified high temperature to obtain a temperature natural falling curve from a high temperature point, the phase change point alloy is a certain metal block with a fixed high temperature phase change temperature point, the fixed high temperature phase change temperature point is used as a first standard temperature point for calibration, the heating sheet is distributed on the phase change point alloy to ensure that the phase change point alloy is heated uniformly, and the processor is a controller of the self-calibration temperature sensor and used for controlling the operation of all devices in the interior and recording the temperature value and the resistance value measured by the thermal resistance temperature sensor in the whole temperature falling process. The invention improves the convenience of the calibration of the temperature sensor, improves the calibration efficiency and accuracy, and reduces the limitation of the using conditions and the calibration cost.

title: Camera potential safety hazard inspection and identification method based on video frame image segmentation
description: The invention discloses a camera potential safety hazard inspection and identification method based on video frame image segmentation, which belongs to the technical field of image processing, the method obtains data through a video cloud storage system and classifies the data into a basic data pool, and selecting a target video source set by combining a daily safety inspection mechanism and a special safety inspection mechanism, performing image segmentation and feature extraction by adopting a region growing algorithm and a U-Net network, and executing judgment and identification operation based on different selection mechanisms. Meanwhile, the potential safety hazard list items and the time period of easy occurrence are dynamically evaluated and updated, hidden trouble reporting records are generated, and the patrol strategy is optimized. The method can comprehensively and automatically identify potential safety hazards in the construction environment of the construction site, and improve the early warning accuracy and efficiency.

title: Environment-friendly high-glow-wire high-impact PBT (polybutylene terephthalate) particles and preparation method thereof
description: This invention relates to the field of PBT particle preparation, and more particularly to an environmentally friendly, high-glow-wire, high-impact PBT particle and its preparation method. The method includes: generating a feeding feature vector by using a multi-scale CNN and attention mechanism architecture to analyze the actual feeding speed of flame-retardant powder, the actual feeding speed of glass fiber, and the equipment discharge speed; capturing the feeding fluctuation patterns of the feeding feature vector using an LSTM model to generate feeding bridging and agglomeration features; and using the feeding bridging and agglomeration features through a fully connected network to generate predicted powder feeding speed and predicted fiber feeding speed, and adjusting the desired powder feeding speed and desired fiber feeding speed of the forced feeding equipment. This invention, through a multi-model collaborative architecture, maps and generates a feeding speed that can actively predict feeding fluctuations and suppress bridging and agglomeration, thereby ensuring the uniformity of component dispersion in the feed and achieving stable performance in the preparation of environmentally friendly, high-glow-wire, high-impact PBT particles.

title: Engineering construction technical problem processing management system and method based on artificial intelligence
description: This invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based engineering construction technical problem handling management system and method, including a data acquisition module for collecting technical liaison forms and historical processing information; an AI large-scale model processing module for analyzing newly submitted technical problems, identifying similar problems, and extracting historical solutions or assisting in solution generation; a liaison form generation and approval module for automatically generating numbered construction technical liaison forms based on solutions, associating them with drawing files, and initiating the approval process according to preset approval rules; a data storage module for storing technical liaison forms, historical processing information, and solutions; a query and retrieval module for querying historical processing information and solutions; and a user interaction module for providing an operating interface. This invention achieves efficient and intelligent processing of construction technical problems through intelligent and automated technical means, significantly improving the overall efficiency and quality of engineering management.

title: Ship-shore cooperative communication method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: This invention relates to the field of communication technology, specifically to a ship-shore collaborative communication method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium. This solution overcomes the limitations of traditional systems that rely on a single monitoring indicator by acquiring basic and customized indicator data, enabling comprehensive monitoring of the shipborne platform's operational status and significantly improving monitoring accuracy. Based on these two types of indicator data, it predicts potential fault information, transforming passive alarms into proactive warnings and solving the problem of untimely fault warnings. Through communication between shore-based equipment and other shipborne platforms, it acquires target repair strategies and generates collaborative control commands, constructing a cross-platform collaborative mechanism that breaks the limitations of isolated operation in traditional systems and enhances shore-based collaborative capabilities. In cases where no matching self-repair strategy exists, it can dynamically invoke external strategy resources, changing the single fault recovery method, effectively improving fault repair efficiency, and ensuring the stable operation of the shipborne platform.

title: Lithium ion battery state of charge self-adaptive estimation method based on double-parameter fractional order GRU network
description: An adaptive estimation method for the state of charge (SOC) of lithium-ion batteries based on a two-parameter fractional-order GRU network is proposed. The method comprises the following steps: Step 1: Collect lithium-ion battery data to construct a dataset; Step 2: Construct a fractional-order B-GRU network with single-parameter adjustable characteristics; Step 3: Form a fractional-order GRU network with two-parameter adjustable characteristics; Step 4: Perform convergence analysis on the two-parameter fractional-order GRU network; Step 5: Combine gradient optimization algorithm and fractional-order calculus theory to optimize network parameters using a fractional-order adaptive adjustment strategy; Step 6: Train and fine-tune the two-parameter fractional-order GRU network using the dataset, and validate the optimized network; Step 7: Use the two-parameter fractional-order GRU network to predict the SOC of lithium-ion batteries. This invention improves the network's ability to capture subtle changes in the dynamic characteristics of the battery, and has significant advantages in SOC estimation accuracy, model flexibility, and adaptability to different operating conditions.

title: Underground cavern displacement prediction method, equipment and medium based on distributed optical fibers
description: This application discloses a method, device, and medium for predicting the displacement of underground caverns based on distributed optical fibers, relating to the field of underground cavern displacement monitoring.
