The method includes: acquiring the strain change sequence of the target underground cavern; inputting the strain change sequence into a trained displacement prediction model to obtain the radial displacement change value of the test point on the inner surface of the target underground cavern; the displacement prediction model is a CNN-BiLSTM-Attention model; the training process of the displacement prediction model is as follows: based on the training sample set, the model hyperparameters are optimized using the Crowned Pig Optimization Algorithm to obtain the optimal model hyperparameters and the corresponding optimal displacement prediction model; based on the training sample set, the optimal displacement prediction model is trained to obtain the trained displacement prediction model. This application can achieve rapid and accurate assessment of the actual deformation of underground caverns.

title: Multifunctional on-site physical evidence investigation and evidence collection system based on intelligent machine dog
description: This invention relates to a multifunctional on-site evidence examination and collection system based on an intelligent robot dog, belonging to the field of forensic trace evidence technology. The system includes: driving the robot dog to the trace evidence examination site via communication devices and a locator, transmitting the collected trace evidence image data to a main control device; adjusting the posture accuracy using a joint encoder equipped with an angle-driven architecture, combined with the collected trace evidence image data; calculating the actual distance between the microscope and the target trace using a trace evidence distance model; controlling the movement of the focusing drive architecture based on the actual distance and corresponding initial focusing parameters; and performing real-time sharpness evaluation of the collected trace evidence images using a sharpness evaluation architecture, recording the optimal focusing position and related trace evidence image data after passing the evaluation, and updating the database. This system enables multi-scenario applications of trace evidence detection, solves the problem of blurred trace evidence images caused by environmental interference or sample movement, and effectively improves the focusing quality and shooting success rate of trace evidence photography.

title: Self-adaptive emotion adjustment method oriented to co-emotion interaction in virtual reality environment
description: The invention relates to a self-adaptive emotion adjustment method for co-emotion interaction in a virtual reality environment, which comprises the steps of S1, obtaining a user dialogue text, calculating emotion scores of the dialogue text through a pre-training emotion analysis model, S2, obtaining behavior data of emotion interaction tasks of a user, calculating the behavior emotion scores, S3, calculating comprehensive emotion scores capable of representing emotion states of the user based on the emotion scores and the behavior emotion scores, S4, dynamically generating an optimal emotion adjustment strategy through a heterogeneous graph modeling technology on the basis of calculating the obtained comprehensive emotion scores, and S5, generating a co-emotion dialogue which is consistent with emotion requirements of the user and is used for guiding generation of text interaction based on the generated optimal emotion adjustment strategy, and generating an interaction task which guides the user to explore and adjust emotion and comprises a color scene. The self-adaptive emotion regulating method can sense the emotion of the user in real time, dynamically follow and regulate the emotion of the user, and improve the accuracy and flexibility of emotion regulation.

title: Method, equipment and medium for classifying ship lift ship reception compartment water area floaters
description: This invention discloses a method, device, and medium for classifying floating objects in the waters surrounding a ship lift's cargo hold. The method includes: S1: acquiring original images of floating objects in the waters surrounding the ship lift's cargo hold, and performing image enhancement processing on the original images to generate a dataset of floating object images containing labels for recyclable and other categories; S2: constructing an improved ConvNeXt network model; S3: training the improved ConvNeXt network model; and S4: classifying the floating object images in the waters surrounding the ship lift's cargo hold using the trained model to distinguish between recyclable and other types of floating objects. This invention achieves high-precision, low-missibility, and easily deployable automatic classification of floating object images, significantly improving the intelligent operation and maintenance level of hydropower stations and navigation safety.

title: INVERSE REINFORCEMENT LEARNING METHOD, STORAGE MEDIUM FOR STORING INSTRUCTION TO EXECUTE PROCESSOR FOR PROCESS FOR INVERSE REINFORCEMENT LEARNING, SYSTEM FOR INVERSE REINFORCEMENT LEARNING, AND PREDICTION SYSTEM INCLUDING SYSTEM FOR INVERSE REINFORCEMENT LEAD
description: A method of inverse reinforcement learning for estimating a cost function and a value function for a subject's behavior, obtaining data representing a change in a state variable defining the subject's behavior, and a correction given by equation (1) The Bellman equation is applied to the acquired data and q (x) + γV (y) −V (x) = − ln {π (y | x) / p (y | x)} (1), where q (x) and V (x) represent the cost function and value function of state x, respectively, γ represents the discount rate, and p (y | x) and π (y | x) are before and after learning, respectively. Indicates the state transition probability. The density ratio π (y | x) / p (y | x) in the equation (1) is estimated, and the least square method is used according to the estimated density ratio π (y | x) / p (y | x). Estimating q (x) and V (x) in equation (1), and outputting the estimated q (x) and V (x).

title: Neural watchdog
description: A system and method for detecting and recovering from errors in a neural network. A method for monitoring a neural network, which monitors the activity of a neural network and detects a condition based on the activity. Execute exception events based on detected conditions. In the neural processing system, in response to detecting the exceptional condition, the neural monitor resets and / or reconfigures the primary neural network. [Selection] Figure 5

title: Non-factoid question answering system
description: A non-factoid type question answering apparatus capable of giving a high-accuracy and accurate answer to a non-factoid type question is provided. A question answering device 124 converts a question and an answer into a semantic vector according to a general context, a similarity between semantic words between a word in the question and a word in the answer Corresponding to the strength of the causal relationship between words, a general sentence level CNN 214 that calculates sentence-level expressions of questions and answers by weighting each semantic vector, and between sentence-level expressions of questions and answers General passage level that calculates passage level expressions for questions and answer passages by weighting sentence level expressions according to the strength of the relationship between vectors in the sentence level expression as seen from similarity and causality A classifier 184 is included that determines whether the answer is a correct answer based on the similarity between the outputs of CNN 218 and CNN 214, 218. [Selection] Figure 10

title: Numerical control system
description: The present invention provides a numerical control system capable of detecting an abnormality in the operating state of a machine tool even when the operation pattern of a motor, tools, workpieces, etc. during machining are different.   A numerical control system (1) according to the present invention includes a condition designation unit (110) for designating a condition in machining operation of a machine tool, a state quantity detection unit (140) for detecting a state quantity indicating an operation state of the machine tool, A feature quantity creation unit 210 that creates a feature quantity that characterizes the state of machining operation from the above, an inference calculation unit 220 that infers an evaluation value for the operation state of the machine tool from the feature quantity, and an abnormality that detects an abnormal state The detection unit 400 includes a learning model generation unit 500 that generates or updates a learning model by machine learning using feature amounts, and a learning model storage unit 300 that stores a learning model in association with a combination of processing driving conditions.   [Selected figure] Figure 1

title: Learning program, learning device and learning method
description: To provide a learning program, a learning device and a learning method with which it is possible to efficiently specify an appropriate parameter value used in model generation.SOLUTION: Determination is made as to whether or not there exists a discontinuous point where a change of learning time to a change of learning parameter becomes discontinuous, and when a discontinuous point does exist, a range of learning parameters where a change of learning time to a change of learning parameter becomes continuous is specified on the basis of the discontinuous point. For each specified range, calculation is made of the estimated value of a trial achievement per learning time of machine learning by learning parameters included in the range, in which trial parameters learned by machine learning are used. A learning parameter is specified for which one of estimated values selected out of the calculated estimated values in accordance with the size of estimated values is obtainable. Machine learning by the specified learning parameter is executed.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 12

title: Display screen peripheral circuit detection method, display screen peripheral circuit detection device, electronic devices and storage media
description: The present application provides a display screen peripheral circuit detection method, a display screen peripheral circuit detection device, an electronic device, and a storage medium. Receives a quality detection request containing an image of the display screen peripheral circuit collected by the image acquisition device on the display screen peripheral circuit production line sent from the console located on the display screen peripheral circuit production line, and receives the display screen peripheral circuit peripheral. Enlarge or reduce the image of the circuit to obtain an image to be detected that matches the input size requirement of the defect detection model obtained by training the instance segmentation Mask RCNN algorithm with the image of the defect display screen peripheral circuit whose size is historical. .. The image to be detected is input to the defect detection model, the defect detection result is obtained, and the quality of the display screen peripheral circuit corresponding to the image of the display screen peripheral circuit is determined based on the defect detection result. As described above, the defect detection by the technical solution means has high accuracy, good system performance, and high business expansion ability.  [Selection diagram] Fig. 2

title: Regression device, regression method, and program
description: The regression device 10 is a device for simultaneously optimizing the regression and clustering criteria, and includes a classifier training unit and a clustering result acquisition unit. The classifier training unit trains the classifier with weight vectors or weight matrices using labeled training data, feature similarity, loss functions that characterize regression accuracy, and penalties that promote feature similarity. The intensity of the penalty is proportional to the similarity of the features. The clustering result acquisition unit uses a trained classifier to identify feature clusters by grouping features with equal weight vectors or weight matrices.  [Selection diagram] Fig. 1

title: Estimating system, estimation device and estimation method
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To generate a trained model having higher estimation performance.  An estimation system uses an estimation model using a first data set containing a plurality of sample data to which a correct answer is given and a second data set containing a plurality of sample data to which a correct answer is not given. Includes a learning unit that generates the data and an estimation unit that determines the estimation result. From the sample data, the estimation model is a first feature quantity that is independent of the first and second datasets, and a second feature quantity that is dependent on the first data set or the second data set. Includes an encoder that calculates ,. The learning unit should be given the same correct answer as the first sample data contained in the first data set and the correct answer given to the first sample data contained in the second data set. The encoder is configured to learn the same first feature amount from any sample data for the pair with the sample data.  [Selection diagram] Fig. 1

title: Document vectorization method, document vectorization device and computer equipment
description: To provide a vectorized representation method of a document, a device, and a computer device.SOLUTION: A method comprises the steps of: dividing a document to obtain a plurality of text segments; performing vectorized representation each text segment as a segment vector representing semantic of the corresponding text segment by using a first-level semantic model; and performing semantic recognition of the document on each segment vector by using a second-level semantic model to obtain a document vector.EFFECT: Information of each level of paragraph-level and document-level can be obtained, and full text information is obtained and loss of information is reduced by the generated document vector, thereby, accuracy of the generated document vector is improved to solve the conventional technical problem.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Question answering robot generation method and equipment
description: To provide a query and response robot generating method, a generating apparatus therefor, a computer device, and a computer program which allows a developer to quickly establish a category query and response robot with high quality and which can reduce labor costs and development costs for the robot.SOLUTION: A query and response robot generating method according to the present invention has a step of acquiring category information input by a user to acquire a corresponding category robot from a robot library based on the category information, a step of acquiring a template list corresponding to the category robot to provide it to the user, a step of receiving a plurality of templates input by the user, a step of expanding an input query based on a query word definition library so as to generate combination of queries corresponding to an answer to form a pair of query and response of combination of responses and corresponding queries, and a step of generating a query and response robot based on the query and response pair.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Methods and systems to protect against universal hostile attacks on time series data
description: To provide a method and a system for protecting from a universal adversarial attack to time series data.SOLUTION: In any industry, data are vulnerable to various attacks, such as a cybersecurity attack. The most recent system in a data security domain cannot identify an adversarial attack in real time, and hence processes/systems not only bring about unintended results but also cause security problems. In general, the present disclosure relates to a data security analysis, and, in more detail, evaluates an influence of an adversarial attack to time series data, and relates to a method and a system for providing protection against such an attack. The system executes an adversarial attack to a selected data drive type model, determines an influence of the adversarial attack to the selected data model, and re-trains the selected data model when the performance of the selected data model is less than a threshold.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3

title: Speech processing method, device and method of generating speech processing model, device
description: To provide a speech processing method and a device, a method and a device for generating a speech processing model, an electronic apparatus and a storage medium for improving an echo cancellation performance.SOLUTION: A speech processing method includes: obtaining M speech signals to be processed and N reference signals; performing sub-band decomposition on each signal to obtain each frequency-band component in each speech signal and each reference signal to obtain an ideal ratio mask (IRM) corresponding to the N reference signals in each frequency band of each speech signal; and performing echo cancellation on each frequency-band component of each speech signal based on each IRM to obtain echo-cancelled M speech signals.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Multi-source timing data failure diagnosis method and medium based on graph neural network
description: To provide a multi-source timing data fault diagnosis method based on graph neural network, and to provide a multi-source timing data fault diagnosis device, a storage medium, and computing equipment.SOLUTION: A method includes the steps of: acquiring multi-source timing history data for a system for which a fault is detected; performing data preprocessing to the multi-source timing history data, obtaining training samples, performing training to a graph neural network model via the training samples, and obtaining a fault diagnosis model; and acquiring multi-source timing real-time data for a system for which a fault is detected, performing data preprocessing, and then performing input to a fault diagnosis model, and outputting a fault diagnosis result of the system by the fault diagnosis model.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Information processing program, information processing apparatus, and information processing method
description: To provide an information processing program, an information processing device and an information processing method with which it is possible to generate a model capable of analyzing with high accuracy a molecule for which the characteristic value (characteristic data) regarding a prescribed characteristic has not been identified.SOLUTION: Provided is an information processing program for performing, on the basis of the characteristic data of each of a plurality of molecules, analysis with regard to a first molecule which is different from any of the plurality of molecules, the program generating a model that performs an analysis regarding the first molecule on the basis of the degree of mutual similarity in the structure of each of the plurality of molecules and a structure descriptor which is the index identified on the basis of the structure of each of the plurality of molecules.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 22

title: Deep learning framework operator registration method, apparatus, device and storage medium
description: To provide an operator registration method and apparatus for a deep learning framework, a device and a storage medium, configured to simplify an operator registration process for the deep learning framework.SOLUTION: A method includes: receiving registration information provided by a user for registering operators with a deep learning framework, the registration information including a custom calculation function written in a manner irrelevant to the deep learning framework; building operator meta-information in the deep learning framework based on the registration information; and constructing a to-be-registered operator within the deep learning framework based on the operator meta-information, and registering the to-be-registered operator in a global operator table within the deep learning framework.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Inter-terminal connection state prediction method and device, and analysis device
description: This application discloses an end-to-end connection state prediction method and apparatus, and an analysis device, and relates to the application of artificial intelligence technology in the field of computer networks. The analysis device acquires the connection states of the test terminal pair respectively corresponding to a plurality of unit times within the first past time segment. The test terminal pair includes a first terminal and a second terminal, the first past time segment is a time segment before the current time, the first past time segment is M consecutive M is a natural number of 2 or more. The analysis device is of the test terminal pair based on the connection state of the test terminal pair respectively corresponding to a plurality of unit times in the first past time segment and at least one unit in the future time segment Determine the connection state corresponding to the time of day.

title: Operation management support system and operation management support method for water treatment plant
description: A technology is provided that enables even a general facility manager to detect an abnormality in an air diffuser during operation of a water treatment plant. A treated water tank (20) in which an air diffuser (30) for releasing air or oxygen into water is arranged, a vibration information collecting device (40) for collecting vibration information emitted by air bubbles released from the air diffuser, and vibration An operation management support system for a water treatment plant including an information processing device 50 that processes vibration information collected by an information collection device, wherein the information processing device acquires vibration information from the vibration information collection device. a vibration information acquisition unit that performs conversion processing on vibration information; a determination algorithm execution unit that executes processing based on a determination algorithm on the vibration information converted by the vibration information acquisition unit; and a determination algorithm execution unit. and a determination result notification unit for notifying the result determined by the vibration information determination unit. [Selection drawing] Fig. 2

title: Method and system for inspecting smoking articles - Patents.com
description: The present disclosure relates to a method for inspecting smoking articles, each smoking article comprising an elongated tubular wrapper (IC) extending along a longitudinal axis (AC), a filler material (MTA) wrapped in the wrapper (IC), and an elongated body (CP) embedded in the filler material (MTA) at a predetermined location, the method comprising the steps of capturing an image (IMM) of the smoking article or a portion thereof observed along a light path oriented along the longitudinal axis (AC), and feeding, by a processor, the image (IMM) to a machine learning model (MA), where the machine learning model (MA) is trained to identify the body (CP) in the image (IMM).

title: Method for diagnosing and predicting cancer using methylated cell-free DNA
description: The present invention relates to a method for cancer diagnosis and cancer type prediction using methylated cell-free nucleic acid, more specifically, to a method for cancer diagnosis and cancer type prediction using a method of extracting methylated nucleic acid from a biological sample, obtaining sequence information, generating vectorized data of nucleic acid fragments based on aligned reads, and inputting the vectorized data into a trained artificial intelligence model to analyze calculated values. The method for cancer diagnosis and cancer type prediction using methylated cell-free nucleic acid according to the present invention is useful because it generates vectorized data and analyzes it using an AI algorithm, compared to a conventional method using a step of determining chromosome amount based on read count or a detection method using a distance concept between aligned reads, which utilizes values related to reads as standardized values one by one, and therefore can achieve the same effect even if the read coverage is low.

title: Controlling access to resource systems based on user profile modifications
description: A system can be provided for automatically enrolling and unenrolling user accounts in and from resource systems. For example, the system can receive an enrollment request from a user device. In response, the system can request a mobile communication from a piece of contact data of a user profile associated with the user account. Upon receiving the mobile communication, the system can verify a user of the user account and automatically enroll the user account in the resource system to provide access for the user account to the resource system. Subsequent to enrolling the user account in the resource system, the system can monitor the user profile to detect a modification to the piece of contact data in the user profile. Upon detecting the modification, the system can prevent the access for the user account to the resource system for a period of time.

title: Energy efficient digital to time converter (DTC) for edge computing
description: A spatially unrolled time domain (TD) architecture that includes an input and weight register having i inputs and j weights, where i corresponds with a number of delay lines for i neurons, and j corresponds with a number of processing elements (PEs) for each delay line of the i delay lines. An enable control register sends a global input pulse to i neurons, and each delay line of the i delay lines includes the corresponding j PEs for that delay line. Each PE includes a digital-to-time converter (DTC) that accepts a digital input and weight and generates a relative delay, each time delay within a given delay line contributing to an overall delay for the given delay line. i time-to-digital converters (TDCs). A readout register receives digital outputs from each of the i TDCs, and serially outputs a signal from each of the i delay lines based on the overall time delay for each of the i delay lines.

title: Method and apparatus for creating a dataset using file creation dates
description: A method and apparatus for generating a content detection dataset using file creation dates. The method accesses a database comprising data files. The files are analyzed by a machine learning model to determine file creation dates. The creation dates are used to identify relevant content files. The most relevant files are included into a content detection dataset as content samples. The dataset may be used for training machine learning based content detectors.

title: Managing content items to fill a content slot on a webpage
description: Present invention describes a computer-implemented method for managing content to be rendered in a webpage. A web server receives a request to access a webpage. A user identifier or a device identifier is extracted from the request. The web server transmits a request for a Self Sovereign Identity (SSI) to a gatekeeper server using the identifier. The web server receives the SSI generated based on a propensity score indicating extent to which the user has propensity for releasing user's data to a digital platform. The web server extracts data about content preferences, user characteristics, or browsing history from the SSI based on data related to privacy of a user associated with the user identifier. using the data, a content item is selected to fill a content slot on the webpage. The web server configures the webpage such that the selected content item fills the content slot.

title: Method for constructing support vector machine of nonparallel structure
description: A method for constructing a support vector machine of a nonparallel structure is provided. On the basis of a traditional parallel support vector machine (SVM), a least square term of samples is added, an additional empirical risk minimization term and an offset constraint term are added to an original optimization problem, so as to obtain two nonparallel hyperplanes respectively, and a new nonparallel support vector machine with additional empirical risk minimization is formed. The method includes: preprocessing data, solving a Lagrange multiplier of a positive-class hyperplane, solving a Lagrange multiplier of a negative-class hyperplane, solving parameters of positive-class and negative-class hyperplanes, and determining a class of a new data point. Through the new method, a new nonparallel vector machine algorithm is proposed to further improve classification accuracy of hyperspectral images on the basis of the algorithm itself, so as to obtain better classification performance.

title: Extraction device, extraction method, and extraction program
description: An extraction device includes processing circuitry configured to access an entrance URL described in user-generated content generated by a user in a plurality of services in a predetermined period to extract a feature quantity of the user-generated content, perform training by using the extracted feature quantity of the user-generated content generated by a normal user and a feature quantity of content generated by a malicious user, and determine whether or not the user-generated content has been generated by the malicious user using a trained model.

title: Secure machine learning model processing
description: A data processing method, apparatus and system are disclosed. The method includes: splitting a preset data processing module from a machine learning model, to generate a security application module configured for performing encryption calculation on data input into the machine learning model; taking, through a preset operator, an output value of an operation layer in the split machine learning model as an input value to be input into the security application module, and inputting the input value into the security application module; performing, through the security application module, subgraph calculation in an isolated operating environment according to the input value, to obtain a calculation result; returning the calculation result to the preset operator. The present application solves the technical problem of high computational pressure of TEE model due to that different reasoning frameworks need to be adapted to different customer requirements in the TEE model in related technologies.

title: Extracting enriched target-oriented common sense from grounded graphs to support next step decision making
description: Aspects of the invention include systems and methods configured to extract enriched target-oriented common sense from grounded graphs to support efficient next step decision making of an autonomous agent. A non-limiting example computer-implemented method includes extracting common sense from a source. The extracted common sense can include a first knowledge graph. An environment state can be extracted from an observation. The extracted environment state can include a second knowledge graph. The second knowledge graph can include an interactive object and a state of the interactive object. A difference graph including the extracted common sense and the extracted environment state can be generated. A next action is selected based on the difference graph and the next action is taken by an autonomous agent.

title: Automatic and unsupervised detached subgraph detection in deep learning programs
description: Detecting an anomaly in deep learning programming can include receiving a deep learning program with neural network. A pre-trained machine learning model can be run with the deep learning program with neural network as input. The pre-trained machine learning model detects whether the neural network includes a detaching subgraph. Responsive to detecting that the neural network includes a detaching subgraph, a location of the deep learning program causing the detaching subgraph can be output. The neural network of the deep learning program can be run in training mode and weight gradients associated with training of the neural network can be monitored. Based on the monitoring, occurrence of one or more detaching subgraphs can be detected. Responsive to detecting a detaching subgraph, the detaching subgraph can be output. A suggestion to correct the deep learning program can also be output.

title: Mechanism and method for dynamic question handling through an electronic interface
description: An improved mechanism for intelligently presenting questions through an electronic interface is disclosed. A rule server receives information identifying a set of answers from a user corresponding to a first set of questions presented to that user. In response, analysis is performed upon the set of received answers. A first determination is then made of whether any questions from the first set of questions need to be answered again based upon rules governing responsive answers. Next, a second determination is made of the composition of a second set of questions. The first determination and second determination may be performed at a rule server or an application tier. The second set of questions is then presented to a user through an electronic interface. Suggested answers to the second set of questions may also be presented to the user through an electronic interface contemporaneously with the second set of questions.

title: Quantum bit with a multi-terminal junction and loop with a phase shift
description: A solid-state quantum computing qubit includes a multi-terminal junction coupled to a superconducting loop where the superconducting loop introduces a phase shift to the superconducting order parameter. The ground state of the supercurrent in the superconducting loop and multi-terminal junction is doubly degenerate, with two supercurrent ground states having distinct magnetic moments. These quantum states of the supercurrents in the superconducting loop create qubits for quantum computing. The quantum states can be initialized by applying transport currents to the external leads. Arbitrary single qubit operations may be performed by varying the transport current and/or an externally applied magnetic field. Read-out may be performed using direct measurement of the magnetic moment of the qubit state, or alternatively, radio-frequency single electron transistor electrometers can be used as read-out devices when determining a result of the quantum computing. Further, qubits as described above can form arrays of qubits for performing controlled quantum computing calculations. In one example, an array of qubits can be utilized as a random number generator.

title: Method of flexibly generating diverse reaction chemistries
description: Computational tools automatically suggest/generate diverse reaction sets for particular precursors, classes of precursors, or different reaction chemistries. This is accomplished by automatically generating a group of reaction chemistries for a particular precursor or class of precursors. Some of the reactions and/or products may be produced without reliance on reactions and products reported in available references.

title: Self-organizing feature map with improved performance by non-monotonic variation of the learning rate
description: The learning rate used for updating the weights of a self-ordering feature map is determined by a process that injects some type of perturbation into the value so that it is not simply monotonically decreased with each training epoch. For example, the learning rate may be generated according to a pseudorandom process. The result is faster convergence of the synaptic weights.

title: HTTP acceleration by prediction and pre-fetching
description: Described is a technology by which high latency problems with respect to web requests are reduced by having a web proxy server predict and pre-fetch content, in parallel, that is to be requested by a client. The web proxy analyzes a main web page requested by a client to predict subsequent client requests. The web proxy prep fetches content before the client requests it, by making concurrent requests for the page's embedded objects that exceed the client's limited number of (e.g., two) connections. In one example, the web proxy sends HTTP requests substantially in parallel to a web server, thereby reducing overall latency. In another example, the web proxy server sends parallel requests to a remote web proxy coupled to a web server. The remote web proxy requests only a limited number of objects (e.g., two) at a time, but does so over fast (low latency) connections to the web server.

title: Apparatus and method for performing service adaptation in respect of a mobile computing device
description: One embodiment of the invention provides a method and apparatus for performing service adaptation in respect of a mobile computing device. The method includes providing a service adaptation specification as a set of rules, where each rule comprises a rule body containing one or more premises and a rule head containing one or more conclusions that hold if said one or more premises are true. The rules are defined as classes in an ontology. The premises represent adaptation context and the conclusions represent service adaptation decisions. The method further comprises running the rules on a Description Logics reasoner in conjunction with adaptation context relating to the mobile computing device for a requested service to produce one or more service adaptation decisions. The method further comprises adapting the requested service provided to the mobile computing device in accordance with the service adaptation decisions from the description logics reasoner.

title: Method, apparatus and system for providing vocal academy information based on user vocal evaluation information
description: The device according to one embodiment acquires the user's song data from the user's terminal, receives evaluation information for each item of the song data, processes the evaluation information to generate input data, and inputs the input data into an artificial neural network. Obtain the user's vocal grade, provide singing data and vocal grade to the vocal academy, receive vocal training information from the vocal academy, transmit vocal training information to the user's terminal, and receive user input for vocal training information. And, based on the user input, the user's recommended vocal academy information can be generated.

title: Device and method for recommeding contact information
description: This disclosure relates to an artificial intelligence (AI) system and its applications that mimic the functions of the human brain, such as cognition and judgment, using machine learning algorithms such as deep learning. A device according to an embodiment includes a processor and a memory that stores instructions executable by the processor, and the processor executes the instructions to determine an identifier from context information of an application running on the device, and to determine at least one identifier related to the identifier. Recommended contacts may be searched, the priority of at least one searched recommended contact may be determined, and the at least one recommended contact may be displayed according to the priority.

title: System for providing map based franchise foundation simulation service using market analysis
description: Provided is a system for providing a virtual franchise foundation simulation service using map-based market analysis. The system comprises: a user terminal that selects a franchise to start a company, selects a region of the franchise, and outputs a sales range derived using a virtual franchise foundation simulation; and a simulation service provision server including a collection unit that collects raw data including franchise information disclosures of at least one franchise, sales aggregate data for card companies, and review data for social media, a processing unit that displays, on a map, results obtained by processing the raw data, a simulation unit that operates the virtual franchise foundation simulation that predicts the sales range according to the franchise and the region when the user terminal selects the franchise and the region, and a transmission unit that transmits the sales range to the user terminal. Therefore, the system can help with decision making for foundation.

title: Control method of electronic apparatus for performing prediction of leisure activity lesson based on data collected through plurality of platforms
description: A method for controlling an electronic device is disclosed. The control method includes obtaining, for each lesson provided through at least one seller, the value of a plurality of parameters related to at least one of a leisure activity included in the lesson and a transaction of the lesson, the plurality of parameters obtained for each provided lesson. Based on the values of the parameters, identifying the degree of correlation between the plurality of parameters, for at least one scheduled lesson, obtaining the value of at least one first parameter among the plurality of parameters, a second among the plurality of parameters and predicting the value of the second parameter for at least one scheduled lesson based on the correlation between the parameter and the first parameter.

title: Hbm based memory lookup engine for deep learning accelerator
description: A storage device and a method for controlling the storage device are disclosed. The storage device includes a high-bandwidth memory stack that includes a host, logic die, and memory die. The computational lookup table is stored in a memory array on the memory die. The host transmits a command to perform an operation using a kernel and a plurality of input feature maps, including finding the product of the weight of the kernel and the values of the plurality of input feature maps. The computational lookup table contains rows corresponding to the weights of the kernel, and columns correspond to values of the input feature map. The result value stored in the location corresponding to the row and column is the product of the weight corresponding to the row and the value corresponding to the column.

title: Accelerating device for deep convolutional neural networks using number theoretic transform
description: A deep convolutional neural network accelerator using numerical theory transformation is provided. The deep convolutional neural network accelerator using numerical theory transformation includes a plurality of tile engines that perform a convolution operation in an NTT domain using tiled input feature maps and weights, wherein each of the plurality of tile engines includes an array of processing elements that perform an element-by-element MAC (Multiply-Accumulate) operation on input feature map tiles of the NTT domain and weight tiles of the NTT domain.

title: Server, method and program providing mentoring service using artificial intelligence
description: According to the present disclosure, an artificial intelligence-based mentoring service providing method is provided, including: a step of receiving a mentoring service request signal from a mentee through a first service platform; a step of collecting first data of the mentee from the first service platform and second data of the mentee from a second service platform, respectively; a step of determining a mentoring service matching group of the mentee based on the collected first data and second data; a step of collecting third data of mentors from the first service platform; a step of selecting at least one mentor corresponding to the determined mentoring service matching group of the mentee based on the collected third data of mentors; a step of obtaining mentoring service data of the at least one selected mentor; and a step of transmitting first mentoring service information from among information of the at least one selected mentor and the obtained mentoring service data of the mentor to the mentee, wherein the second service platform is a service platform that can use the service by using login information of the first service platform.

title: A memorial funeral service provision system using virtual humans and holograms
description: A system for providing a virtual human and a hologram-based memorial funeral service is provided, and includes a funeral service providing server including a user terminal requesting the creation of an avatar, a memorial terminal for conversing with a virtual human created based on an avatar in order to commemorate a user of the user terminal, a receiving unit receiving a request for avatar creation from the user terminal, a virtual human creation unit for creating a virtual human based on a photograph and an image in response to the request for avatar creation, an interface unit for creating a channel to enable a conversation between the created virtual human and the memorial terminal, and a hologram providing unit for connecting a hologram device and the memorial terminal to enable a conversation between the virtual human in the hologram device and the mourner of the memorial terminal when a hologram conversation is requested from the memorial terminal.

title: Cable Diagnostic Apparatus and Method based on Infrasound Measurement Data
description: The cable diagnosis device based on ultra-low frequency measurement data of the present invention comprises: a feature factor extraction unit for extracting a mean value (TD) and a deviation (DTD) for voltage fluctuation from ultra-low frequency tan-delta measurement data for a target cable, and a skirt reflecting linearity between measurement data; an index calculation unit for merging the respective values of three deterioration factors extracted from the extraction unit to finally calculate an index capable of indicating one deterioration characteristic; and a cable condition diagnosis unit for diagnosing the condition of the target cable from the deterioration level according to the index,  The above-described feature factor extraction unit may include an A Skirt calculation unit that calculates A Skirt by applying a linear equation based on minimum and maximum values among measurement values; a B Skirt calculation unit that calculates B Skirt by applying a linear deviation calculation method based on a linear regression model; and a Skirt combination unit that combines the A Skirt calculated by the A Skirt calculation unit and the B Skirt calculated by the B Skirt calculation unit.

title: Method and system for providing online education platform for national examination of cloud-based educational medical personnel
description: The system for providing a non-face-to-face online education platform according to the present invention comprises: a problem analysis unit that derives keywords through analysis of the problem types and difficulty levels of multiple past questions from national examinations conducted during a certain period of time collected from a content provider server, classifies the difficulty levels into three levels of high, medium, and low, and constructs a problem bank DB; a user analysis unit that conducts a first mock test on a terminal of a newly subscribed service user based on the problem bank DB, analyzes the results of the first mock test based on artificial intelligence, and creates a user profile regarding the learning level of the service user in a user DB database; a problem extraction unit that extracts incorrect questions and similar problem types and difficulties of the service user from the problem bank DB based on the CBF (Content Based Filtering) algorithm based on the user profile; a content provision unit that recommends customized learning content including questions extracted according to the CBF algorithm to the terminal; and a content provision unit that calculates a first difficulty calculation value based on data collected from a plurality of the results of the first mock test at predetermined intervals, and sets the problem difficulty of the problem bank DB to the first difficulty level based on the calculated first difficulty calculation value. It may include a first difficulty balancing module that does the balancing.

title: Method for safety management by object segmentation based on Deep-learning and system for the method
description: The present invention relates to a neural network for object segmentation, and according to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for detecting a management target object for safety management using a learned neural network comprises the steps of: receiving a segmentation target image; dividing the target image into unit images having a predetermined size; outputting a unit activation map for the divided unit images as a first segmentation result using the neural network; merging the unit activation maps; and outputting a second segmentation result according to the merged unit activation map. It is preferable that the neural network is trained by mutually utilizing the entire activation map for the target image and the merged activation map. According to the present invention, by generating a more accurate object segmentation result, it is possible to more accurately and quickly determine whether regulations for safety management in various industrial sites are complied with or whether an event has occurred.

title: method of providing fashion information that recommends fashion items based on machine learning
description: According to one embodiment of the present invention, based on the registration of a plurality of user members and at least one posting information of each user member, complex and diverse learning data can be simplified and high-satisfaction fashion recommendation information can be provided through machine learning. To this end, in particular, one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a step (S10) of constructing a member information DB based on the registration of a plurality of user members and at least one posting information of each user member; a first preprocessing step (S20) of distinguishing and processing member-specific data, social data, and outfit shot image data for each of the plurality of user members based on the constructed member information DB; a second preprocessing step (S30) of generating and classifying first association data between the member-specific data and the social data, second association data between the member-specific data and the outfit shot image data, and third association data between the social data and the outfit shot image data; a machine learning step (S40) of receiving the generated 1, 2, and 3 association data by a fashion recommendation information learning unit and learning fashion item associations between user members and fashion items; and a step (S50) of deriving fashion recommendation information based on the learned fashion item associations according to a request from a fashion recommendation requesting member who requests a fashion recommendation among the plurality of user members. The present invention includes a fashion information providing method for recommending fashion items based on machine learning, including a step (S60) of transmitting the derived fashion recommendation information to a terminal of a fashion recommendation user member.

title: Apparatus for determining posture based on artificial intelligent using and method thereof
description: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence-based posture determination device using a body pressure sensor and a method thereof, comprising: a body pressure sensor module for measuring the body pressure of a user touching a bed frame or mattress using a plurality of body pressure sensors; a sample body pressure distribution data generation module for learning and generating sample body pressure distribution data of the user using a preset generative adversarial network (GAN) based on actual body pressure measurement data of the user measured from the body pressure sensor module; and a posture determination module for analyzing the actual body pressure distribution data of the user based on the actual body pressure measurement data of the user measured from the body pressure sensor module, and learning and predicting two-dimensional body pressure distribution data in a time series format using an ensemble artificial intelligence deep learning technique that combines a convolutional neural network (CNN) and a long short-term memory (LSTM) neural network model having different characteristics based on the analyzed actual body pressure distribution data of the user and the sample body pressure distribution data of the user generated from the body pressure distribution data generation module, and then determining the lying posture of the user based on the learned and predicted two-dimensional time series body pressure distribution data. By including it, the user's lying posture can be more accurately determined, thereby effectively changing the user's body position, thereby increasing the bedsore prevention function and convenience.

title: Remote medical diagnosis system based on artificial intelligence using in-vitro and in-vivo biosignals and method thereof
description: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence-based remote medical treatment system utilizing internal and external bio-signals, and is characterized by including: a mobile terminal that measures bio-information, which is basic medical information of a patient, and transmits it to a remote server via a network; a remote server that analyzes the bio-information using artificial intelligence; and a remote doctor's mobile terminal or remote PC that receives the diagnosis results analyzed by the remote server and performs medical treatment.

title: An on-device multimodal generative AI-based industrial safety system that detects safety risk factors in industrial sites and infers the situation of the site based on the risk level of the detected safety hazards
description: The present invention aims to provide an on-device multimodal generative artificial intelligence-based industrial safety system that detects safety hazards in industrial sites and infers the situation of the industrial site based on the risk level of the safety hazards, thereby preventing accidents in industrial sites and thus preventing casualties, and enabling post-accident response in the event of an accident in industrial sites.

title: Method and apparatus for designing motion capture volume based on simulation
description: According to one embodiment of the present disclosure, a method performed on a computing device for designing a motion capture space based on a simulation is disclosed. Specifically, according to the present disclosure, the computing device identifies information related to one or more input variables included in a first motion capture scenario, inputs information related to the one or more input variables and first design information of a motion capture space into a simulator, generates information related to one or more output variables based on the simulator, and modifies the first design information based on the information related to the output variables to generate second design information.

title: Electronic device for automatic fire detection, real-time reporting, and ai-based report generation in residential complexes
description: A fire response method according to one embodiment comprises the steps of: acquiring images of the interior or the surroundings; detecting a fire situation in a first image among the images using an artificial intelligence module; determining a fire location based on the first image; and generating data including the first image and the fire location, wherein the artificial intelligence module is trained using a learning dataset including input data as an image of a complex and correct data as correct fires, pseudo-fires, and incorrect fires, and including a base term based on a difference between output data corresponding to the input data and the correct data, and a distinction term for distinguishing between a fire situation and a pseudo-fire situation.

title: Method for predicting the occurrence of anomalies in injection equipment based on artificial intelligence and providing warning notifications
description: According to one embodiment, a device collects injection history data for a plurality of injection equipment, learns an artificial intelligence model through the injection history data, acquires data for a first injection equipment, applies the data for the first injection equipment to the learned artificial intelligence model to acquire an abnormality occurrence probability for the first injection equipment, determines whether the abnormality occurrence probability is higher than a critical probability, and if it is determined that the abnormality occurrence probability is higher than the critical probability, provides a solution for the first injection equipment, and if it is determined that the abnormality occurrence probability is not higher than the critical probability, determines that there is no problem with the first injection equipment.

title: Apparatus for performing class incremental learning and operation method thereof
description: A method for performing class augmentation learning in a neural network device according to one aspect may include training an autoencoder using first input embeddings for a first class group and retraining the autoencoder using second input embeddings for a second class group.  According to the present disclosure, a neural network device can train an autoencoder to minimize a first loss function and retrain the autoencoder to minimize a second loss function including a regularization-related term.

title: System and method for performing intelligent command and control based on generative artificial intelligence
description: The embodiments present an intelligent command and control system and method based on generative AI. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle terminal collecting first image data taken from an aerial viewpoint, a field execution terminal collecting second image data taken from a ground viewpoint, a command and control server generating a three-dimensional operational terrain map based on the first image data and the second image data, reflecting field situation information on the three-dimensional operational terrain map, and a command and control terminal displaying the three-dimensional operational terrain map and transmitting a user command to the command and control server, wherein the command and control server performs wireless communication through a multi-wireless communication network including a first wireless communication network using a TVWS (television white space) band and a second wireless communication network using a frequency band different from the TVWS band, and receives field information from the unmanned aerial vehicle terminal and the field execution terminal, and the field information includes the first image data, the second image data, first location information, and second location information, and generates an operational terrain and object information on the operational terrain through a three-dimensional terrain generation model using a plurality of neural networks based on the field information, and the plurality of neural networks include a first neural network-based terrain supplementation model and a second neural network-based A three-dimensional operational terrain map is generated by combining objects in the operational terrain by selecting three-dimensional objects corresponding to object information from a pre-stored object library, including an object recognition model, and placing them on the operational terrain, and transmitting the three-dimensional operational terrain map to the command and control terminal, and receiving the user command including at least one of a user's voice, drawing, or text from the command and control terminal, and updating at least one of a position, a path, or a state of an object in the three-dimensional operational terrain map based on the user command, and transmitting the updated three-dimensional operational terrain map to the command and control terminal, and generating command information corresponding to the user command and transmitting it to the field execution terminal.

title: Electronic device and method for identifying video
description: A video identification method for an electronic device may include: a step of identifying at least one feature vector indicating the degree to which at least one of the multiple videos is associated with a text query based on information about a plurality of videos and information about a text query; a step of, for each of the at least one video, identifying first information regarding the probability that a frame included in the video is the starting frame of the text query and second information regarding the probability that it is the ending frame of the text query using a feature vector corresponding to the video; and a step of identifying a target video corresponding to the text query among the plurality of videos based on a predetermined operation based on the first information, the second information and at least one feature vector.

title: Intelligent aging delay training system based on personal body information
description: The proposed invention relates to an intelligent aging delay training system based on an individual's physical information, which generates training index data for health promotion based on a virtual aging model and an aging index, thereby confirming an individual's physical function and providing a guide for customized health promotion.

title: Platform and Method for generating GMP validation sequence
description: As a preferred embodiment of the present invention, a method for generating an optimized validation sequence in a GMP validation improvement platform is characterized by including the steps of: receiving a validation sequence requested by the orderer from the orderer based on a biopharmaceutical to be produced, providing the orderer with a validation sequence obtained by machine learning big data acquired from a past project and factors required for a new project; setting a validation sequence reconstructed by the orderer based on the machine-learned validation sequence as an initial validation sequence, and then updating the validation sequence to an optimized validation sequence by machine learning field data according to the project progress rate.

title: Legged mobile robot and control method thereof, leg structure of legged mobile robot, and mobile leg unit for legged mobile robot
description:
The walking mobile robot according to the present invention makes it possible to perform the attitude stability control of the gas while using the ZMP stability discrimination norm at a relatively slow sampling period.
     
     
      The walking mobile robot has a ZMP stable region composed of a support polygon formed by the sole ground point of the movable leg and a road surface, and a ZMP behavior space in which the deformation amount or momentum of the gas is generated such that the ZMP is directed toward the center of the ZMP stable region. In the ZMP behavior space, the determinant of the deformation amount (or momentum) of the robot is a direction in which the negative causes the space distortion to move the ZMP to the edge of the stable region, and positively stabilizes the ZMP. It is a direction for generating spatial distortion to be moved to the center of the region.

title: U-city system conducting an deducing operation based on condition information and operating method thereof
description: PURPOSE: A u-city system capable of performing an inference operation based on situation information and an operating method thereof are provided to supply optimum information to users. CONSTITUTION: An information collecting unit(122) collects information from a U-City internal/external side by relating an object which can be a management object. A context reasoning unit(123) infers a present or past situation relating to an object using received situation information and at least one among general rule information of history information and an object group. The history information is related to the previous situation pattern of the object. An inter-switch call control function(124) performs an operation for connecting a inference result which is from the situation inference unit with a real service.

title: Scalable Clustering
description: A scalable clustering system is described. In one embodiment, the clustering system can operate for extremely large scale applications where millions of items with tens of millions of features are clustered. In one embodiment, the clustering system utilizes a stochastic cluster model that models the uncertainty in the data set, where the data set is, for example, an advertisement that subscribes to a keyword, a text document containing a text keyword, an image with associated characteristics or Other items may be. In one embodiment, a clustering system is used to create additional properties for associating with a given item. For example, additional keywords are proposed that an advertiser may want to subscribe to. The additional properties that are generated have an association probability value that can be used to rank these properties in some embodiments. In some examples, user feedback on the generated feature is received and used to revise the feature creation process.

title: Safety guaranteed control when planning with uncertainty
description: According to some embodiments, described herein is a method and a system for guaranteeing safety at a control level of an ADV when at least a portion of a planned path generated by a planning module of the ADV is uncertain due to traffics and/or road condition changes. The planning module, when generating a path, also generate a confidence level of each segment of the path based on one or more of perception data, map information, or traffic rules. The confidence levels are decreasing further away from the ADV. When the control module of the ADV obtains the path and the associated confidence levels, the control module issue control commands to track only one or two segments whose confidence levels exceeds a threshold hold, and issue default control commands for the rest of the path.

title: Method and apparatus for providing content search using keypad in electronic device
description: Various embodiments of the disclosure provide a method and apparatus for performing a content search using a keypad (or a keyboard) in an electronic device. The electronic device according to various embodiments include a display; a wireless communication circuit; a memory; and a processor. The processor may be configured to: display an execution screen of an application; detect a first input for calling a keypad; display the keypad on the execution screen; detect a second input for a smart search while displaying the keypad; request a content search from at least one application of the electronic device; and display a search result searched by the at least one application through the keypad. Other embodiments are possible.

title: Network element management method, network management system, independent computing node, computer device, and storage medium
description: Provided are a network element management method, a network management system, an independent computing node, a computer device, and a computer-readable medium, wherein the network element management method comprises: acquiring first network element data of each network element; determining a network element waiting to receive a model; training a model according to the first network element data; and issuing a model, which is obtained by means of training, to the network element waiting to receive a model. The network management system can intelligently manage a network element, the computing power of a base station is enhanced, and the intelligent operation and maintenance of the base station are realized.

title: A method for detecting dead insects and a system for implementing thereof
description: A method for detecting dead insects, including fragments thereof, characterised in placing the insects within the range of a UV radiation source (1) and within the field of view of an image-recording device (2) connected to a computer (3), after which an image of the insects covered by UV radiation is recorded using the image-recording device (2), the image thus obtained is then loaded into the computer's memory and processed using a photograph processing software that uses saturation image thresholding to divide the image into objects and background according to differences in saturation. The object of the invention is also a system for implementing this method.

title: Method and system for segmenting and characterizing aortic tissues
description: There is provided a method for segmenting aortic tissues (or detecting calcification) in an image of a body of a given subject, the method being executed by a processor, the processor having access to at least one deep learning model having been trained to segment aortic tissues in images, the method comprising: receiving the image of the body of the given subject, the image comprising an aorta, an intraluminal thrombus and additional body parts; extracting a region of interest from the received image, the region of interest comprising the aorta and the intraluminal thrombus; determining, within the region of interest, a presence of a calcification on at least one of an aortic wall and the intraluminal thrombus; and outputting an indication of the presence of the calcification.

title: Data processing apparatus, program, and data processing method
description: A data processing apparatus configured to: search for a combination of values of a plurality of state variables that minimizes or maximizes a value of an Ising-type evaluation function that includes the plurality of state variables, repeat determining whether to permit a change in a value of a first state variable among the plurality of state variables based on the first local field, and when the change in the value of the first state variable is permitted, updating the first local field based on the first weight value, updating the second local field that corresponds to a constraint condition in which the second weight value with the first state variable is non-zero based on the second weight value, and updating the first local field based on the second local field before the updating and the second local field after the updating.

title: Predicting protein amino acid sequences using generative models conditioned on protein structure embeddings
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for performing protein design. In one aspect, a method comprises: processing an input characterizing a target protein structure of a target protein using an embedding neural network having a plurality of embedding neural network parameters to generate an embedding of the target protein structure of the target protein; determining a predicted amino acid sequence of the target protein based on the embedding of the target protein structure, comprising: conditioning a generative neural network having a plurality of generative neural network parameters on the embedding of the target protein structure; and generating, by the generative neural network conditioned on the embedding of the target protein structure, a representation of the predicted amino acid sequence of the target protein.

title: Method and apparatus for estimating state of health of battery
description: A method of estimating a state of health of a battery is performed by at least one computing device, and includes preparing a pre-trained artificial neural network, generating input data by measuring at least one parameter of the battery, inputting the input data into the pre-trained artificial neural network to obtain a health state estimation value of the battery and an attention map, calculating an attention score based on the attention map, and determining whether to trust the health state estimation value based on the attention score.

title: Machine learning device, machine learning method, and machine learning program
description: A weight storage unit (50) stores weights of a plurality of filters used to detect a feature of a task. A continual learning unit (20) trains the weights of the filters in response to an input task in continual learning. A filter processing unit (30) locks, of a plurality of filters that have learned one task, the weights of a proportion of the filters to prevent the proportion of the filters from being used to learn a further task and initializes the weights of other filters to use the other filters to learn a further task. A comparison unit (40) compares the weights of a plurality of filters that have learned two or more tasks, extracts overlap filters having a similarity in weight over a threshold value as shared filters shared by tasks, leaves one of the overlap filters as the shared filter, and initializes the weights of filters other than the shared filter.

title: System, method, and computer program for a surgical imaging system
description: Examples relate to a system (110), a method, and a computer program for a surgical imaging system (100), and to a corresponding surgical imaging system comprising such a system for a surgical imaging system. The system (110) is configured to obtain an eye-tracking sensor signal from an eye-tracking system (130). The system is configured to determine a gaze of a user of a surgical imaging device (120) of the surgical imaging system on a portion of a field of view of the surgical imaging device based on the eye-tracking sensor signal. The system is configured to adjust the field of view of the surgical imaging device based on the gaze of the user on the portion of the field of view.

title: System and method to generate augmented training data for neural network
description: A robotic system capable of being trained with a plurality of images that are synthetically augmented from an initial image data set includes a training system toward that end. An image augmentation system includes in one form a neural network trained to generate synthetic images using a generative adversarial network which includes the ability to synthesize images having various poses with adjustments to image parameters such as light and color among potential others. In another form the image augmentation system includes a set of images projected or transformed from its original pose to a number of different poses using an affine transform, and the ability to progress across an entire dimensional space of anticipated robot movements which produce various potential poses.

title: Electrical control of a quantum processing element
description: A method of controlling a quantum processing element, the quantum processing element comprising: a semiconductor substrate; a barrier material formed above the semiconductor substrate such that an interface forms between the semiconductor substrate and the barrier material; an arrangement of gate electrodes; an external magnet; and electronic controllers, where the method comprises: generating an electrostatic confinement potential by applying voltages to the arrangement of gate electrodes for binding a controllable number of electrons or holes, forming a first quantum dot; applying a constant magnetic field to the quantum processing element using the external magnet, the magnetic field separating energy levels of spin states associated with an unpaired electron or hole of the controllable number of electrons or holes in the first quantum dot; and changing the voltages of the arrangement of gate electrodes using the electronic controllers to change a shape of a confinement potential of the unpaired electron or hole.

title: Method and apparatus with semiconductor pattern correction
description: A processor-implemented method including generating a first corrected result image of a first desired pattern image using a backward correction neural network provided an input based on the first desired pattern image, the backward correction neural network performing a backward correction of a first process, generating a first simulated result image using a forward simulation neural network based on the first corrected result image, the forward simulation neural network performing a forward simulation of a performance of the first process, and updating the first corrected result image so that an error between the first desired pattern image and the first simulated result image is reduced.

title: Customized image reprocessing system
description: The technical problem of automatically reprocessing an image captured by a camera in a manner that produces a personalized result is addressed by providing a customized image reprocessing system powered by machine learning techniques. The customized image reprocessing system is configured to automatically reprocess an image on a pixel level using a machine learning model that takes, as input, the image represented by pixel values, sensor data detected by the digital sensor of a camera at the time the image was captured, and, also, flash calibration parameters previously generated for that specific user.

title: Compute optimization mechanism for deep neural networks
description: A graphics processing unit (GPU) is disclosed. The GPU comprises a host interface to enable a connection with a host processor, a set of compute clusters, each including a set of graphics multiprocessors, a cache memory shared by the set of compute clusters, and memory coupled with the set of compute units via a set of memory controllers. The graphics multiprocessors of a compute cluster include multiple types of integer and floating point logic units to perform computational operations at a range of precisions.

title: Controlled jitter injection into a signal
description: A method of controlling a quantum computing output includes generating a baseline quantum computing signal from a quantum computing system. A controlled noise component is added to the quantum computing system. An output from the quantum computing system is read, wherein the output includes the controlled noise component. An effect on the baseline quantum computing signal due to the controlled noise component in the output is determined.

title: Safety rule generation device, navigation system, safety rule generation method, navigation method, and program
description: A safety rule capable of coping with a complex scenario is formulated.
