description: The present invention discloses a 3D mesh reconstruction method and device enhanced by multi-dimensional features and three-plane representation, belonging to the field of 3D reconstruction technology, including: 3D prior knowledge acquisition: after generating a multi-view image sequence based on a single image, a multi-dimensional feature extraction and fusion module is used to extract the multi-dimensional features of the image sequence, and a high-resolution three-plane representation construction module including a dual-stream Transformer, a convolutional layer and a pixel rearrangement operation is used to perform feature fusion on the multi-dimensional features and the initial three-plane features to organize the initial three-plane features into a high-resolution three-plane representation; a 3D mesh construction module is used to generate a 3D mesh based on the three-plane representation, and a color decoder is used to generate the color texture of the spatial point based on the three-plane representation decoding, and the 3D mesh and the color texture are combined to obtain a high-precision textured 3D mesh, which effectively reduces the blur and artifact phenomenon of the mesh surface and improves the accuracy of the geometric structure. It can be widely used in the modeling process of the game and film and television industries.

title: A blade milling profile error prediction method driven by spatiotemporal feature fusion
description: The present invention discloses a blade milling profile error prediction method driven by spatiotemporal feature fusion. The present invention combines GAT, ECA Net and CNN to form a blade profile error prediction model, and applies it to the scenario of predicting the profile error of a machine tool processed blade. By combining static process parameters with dynamic process parameters, a graph data driven model is constructed. The algorithm can extract the time features and spatial features in the blade processing data, and fuse the two features. Among them, the introduced GAT can learn the spatial relationship between the blade process parameters and the dynamic process parameters. ECA Net can capture the time feature weights in the dynamic process parameters, thereby improving the model's timing analysis capability. Finally, the features extracted by GAT and ECA Net are fused and extracted through CNN, so that the time features and spatial features can be fused, effectively improving the model's prediction accuracy for the blade milling profile error.

title: Motion analysis correction method, system and storage medium for aerobics training
description: This invention belongs to the field of aerobics movement correction technology, specifically relating to a method, system, and storage medium for movement analysis and correction in aerobics training. The method includes: S1, a preprocessing module acquires training videos, extracts all training images from the training videos, and determines the category of each image element based on the function value of the classification function corresponding to each image element; S2, the preprocessing module removes image elements of preset categories from the training images, and a comparison module determines the training image corresponding to each standard image; S3, the comparison module detects several key points of the human body in each standard image and the corresponding training image, extracts the feature values of the key points, and combines the feature values of the key points into a feature sequence; S4, the analysis module generates correction suggestions for the training image corresponding to each standard image. This invention can generate correction suggestions for aerobics movements.

title: Generative invisible watermarking method based on stable diffusion model
description: The invention discloses a generation type invisible watermarking method based on a stable diffusion model, which comprises the steps of firstly processing text prompt/image prompt to obtain a latent variable, utilizing the latent variable to guide generation of an image, firstly converting the image into a low-dimensional potential representation through a variation self-encoder, generating potential noise according to the low-dimensional potential representation, generating a noise-containing image through multiple iterations by combining the potential noise and the low-dimensional potential representation, utilizing a watermarking decoder to fine tune the decoder so as to embed a fine-tuned weight watermarking in the generated image, simultaneously, compressing the image into the potential noise through the variation self-encoder when the image is generated through the stable diffusion model, carrying out wavelet transformation on the obtained potential noise to obtain a noise watermarking, mapping noise watermarking information into a ring-shaped pattern watermarking, embedding the noise watermarking information into a noise low-frequency sub-band, and generating the image through the watermark-containing watermarking noise. The invention embeds watermark in the course of generating image, and can extract watermark information in the generated image.

title: Regional lake and reservoir nutrient salt benchmark formulation method based on Bayesian hierarchical model
description: The invention discloses a regional lake and reservoir nutrient salt standard formulation method based on a Bayesian hierarchical model, which comprises the following steps of S1 collecting regional lake and reservoir different-form nitrogen and phosphorus index monitoring data, constructing a regional lake and reservoir nutrient salt standard formulation database, S2 establishing a Bayesian hierarchical model for specific-form nutrient salt, simulating the concentration of the lake and reservoir nutrient salt, S3 establishing monitoring data in the database according to the regional lake and reservoir nutrient salt standard formulation database, carrying out parameter estimation on the Bayesian hierarchical model to obtain posterior distribution of each parameter in the model, S4 obtaining distribution of the regional lake and reservoir nutrient salt concentration according to a parameter estimation result, S5 deriving a nutrient salt standard value according to a fractional number set by a reference state method, wherein the method is directly easy to use, has obvious advantages when quantifying regional commonality and differential balance, can accurately and scientifically formulate the regional lake and reservoir nutrient salt standard, and provides effective support for lake and reservoir water environment management, and has obvious advantages and application values.

title: SiRNA screening method and device based on deep learning
description: This invention relates to the field of deep learning technology and discloses a deep learning-based siRNA screening method and apparatus. The method includes: constructing an siRNA inhibition rate prediction model; obtaining preliminary siRNA screening results corresponding to the mRNA sequences of the target sites based on the siRNA inhibition rate prediction model; performing molecular dynamics simulations on the mRNA sequences of the target sites to generate molecular dynamic trajectories corresponding to the mRNA sequences of the target sites; constructing a neural relationship inference model to generate an interaction diagram corresponding to the mRNA sequences of the target sites; and further screening the preliminary siRNA screening results based on the interaction diagram to obtain the final siRNA screening results. This invention effectively improves the accuracy of deep learning models in real-world screening tasks and avoids problems such as weak generalization ability due to training set bias when screening siRNAs.

title: Image processing method and device, readable medium and electronic equipment
description: The embodiment of the disclosure relates to an image processing method, an image processing device, a readable medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of determining a second image according to a first image to be processed, wherein the image size of the second image meets the preset size requirement, obtaining a first feature image and a second feature image based on the second image, wherein the first feature image is used for determining the opacity of an edge area in the second image, the edge area is the boundary area between a foreground image and a background image in the second image, the second feature image is used for determining the opacity of a non-edge area in the second image, and according to the first image, the first feature image and the second feature image, obtaining a target opacity feature image corresponding to the first image, and processing the first image according to the target opacity feature image.

title: Adaptive scene analysis and target generation method and system based on deep learning
description: The invention provides a self-adaptive scene analysis and target generation method and system based on deep learning, and relates to the technical field of computer vision. And simultaneously, obtaining a semantic label graph by utilizing semantic segmentation, constructing a semantic association matrix, and calculating a scene semantic vector. The two input variables are divided from the encoder to obtain a target feature vector, and the attention score is calculated based on the target feature vector to generate a weighted target description vector. Finally, generating target contour features through a probabilistic graph inference network, and generating a final target result by combining regional attention map. The method improves the accuracy and efficiency of target generation.

title: A 3D model retrieval method based on multi-view aggregation
description: This invention provides a 3D model retrieval method based on multi-view aggregation, comprising the following steps: Step 1: Designing a view-based 3D model retrieval network (MVAT). This MVAT network can extract features of the 3D model from its view representations for 3D model retrieval. The MVAT network includes a single-view feature extraction network and a multi-view feature aggregation network. The single-view feature extraction network is responsible for independently extracting local features of the 3D model from each view, while the multi-view feature aggregation network is responsible for generating a global feature representation through information fusion from multiple views. Step 2: Introducing weight freezing and contrastive learning techniques, and using a three-stage training method to train the MVAT network. Step 3: Evaluating the performance of the trained MVAT network on a test set. The beneficial effects of this invention are: the 3D model retrieval method of this invention has strong feature representation capabilities, efficient training methods, high accuracy, and good generalization.

title: Outlier removal and reflectivity and normal line generation method based on multi-angle illumination image
description: The present invention discloses a method for removing outliers and generating reflectivity and normals based on multi-angle illumination images, which belongs to the fields of optics, digital image processing, self-supervised deep learning, etc. First, images under illumination from different directions are obtained; the images are read and normalized to obtain a multi-channel image array; a spatial coordinate system is established according to the position of the light source and the camera, and multiple light sources form a light source direction matrix; a neural network model is built, and a loss function is selected according to the characteristics of the outliers; each channel of the image array and the light source direction matrix are respectively input into the neural network model in pairs, and a back-propagation algorithm is used for iterative optimization to obtain a normal matrix with reflectivity scaling; the normal with reflectivity scaling is obtained by obtaining the vector modulus and normalizing it to obtain the reflectivity and normal of each channel, and the average value of the normal of each channel is the final normal. The present invention can be applied to solving the normal of an object, and can effectively reduce errors such as those caused by highlights, shadows, noise, etc.

title: Multi-instance image classification method based on pre-detection feature fusion
description: This invention relates to the field of deep learning multi-instance image classification technology, specifically to a multi-instance image classification method based on pre-detection feature fusion. The method includes: acquiring multi-instance images of the target; performing region pre-detection on each instance image using a pre-detection module; extracting pre-detection features from the pre-detection region using a pre-detection feature encoder; weighting and fusing the features of each instance using an instance fusion module to obtain an instance fusion view; mapping each instance to the same spatial plane and compressing spatial features using a spatial fusion module to obtain a spatial fusion view; and performing joint prediction of multi-instance classification using the instance fusion view and the spatial fusion view. This technical solution can reduce image size and computational load in multi-instance scenarios, improve the effectiveness of multi-instance image information, and solve the information sparsity and high computational requirements problems in multi-instance image learning tasks, thereby improving the accuracy and speed of multi-instance image classification.

title: Sea surface weak target detection method based on improved bidirectional long short-term memory network
description: The present invention discloses a method for detecting weak targets on the sea surface based on an improved bidirectional long short-term memory network, which relates to the technical field of radar signal processing. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a signal to be detected, the signal to be detected comprising a sea clutter signal and a target echo signal, dividing the signal to be detected into training data and test data, and reconstructing a chaotic phase space of the signal to be detected; using a bidirectional long short-term memory network Bi-LSTM algorithm to initially model the signal to obtain an LSTM model; using the reconstructed phase space signal as input to the BiLSTM network, determining the length of the training data by embedding dimension and delay time, optimizing the parameters of the BiLSTM model by using an improved Newton-Raphson optimization algorithm, improving the model prediction accuracy and running speed, reducing the target detection threshold, performing single-step prediction in combination with the BiLSTM model, and using the prediction error to detect weak target signals under strong chaotic background noise.

title: Digital twin visual modeling method and system based on neural network
description: The present invention relates to the field of digital twin modeling, and discloses a digital twin visualization modeling method and system based on a neural network, including collecting multi-dimensional perception data of a target physical system, unifying and normalizing the format of the original sensor data through a heterogeneous data fusion module, and combining a structured embedding algorithm to construct a high-dimensional input feature set for neural network modeling; pre-evaluating the stability of the constructed input feature set, and using a disturbance sensitivity analysis mechanism to screen core features; introducing a dynamic residual feedback mechanism to enhance the training of the preliminary twin model, and modeling the spatiotemporal dependencies of different components through a graph neural network; tracking the stability index of the visualization performance in real time during the model training process; and interpreting the multi-dimensional visualization results output by the final twin model in combination with an industrial scene semantic rule library. The present invention has the advantage of improving the practicality of twin models in industrial scenes.

title: Communication network resource optimization method and system based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention provides a communication network resource optimizing method and system based on artificial intelligence, which relates to the technical field of communication optimization, by collecting historical network data, utilizing time sequence decomposition and LSTM algorithm to extract characteristics, combining attention mechanism to calculate the weight of performance index, the network flow is predicted by adopting a multi-scale prediction mechanism, and dynamic calibration is carried out based on the historical error, so that the network flow change trend can be accurately predicted, the prediction precision is improved, the reasonable distribution and the optimal configuration of network resources are realized, and the network operation efficiency is effectively improved.

title: Building carbon emission prediction and control method based on machine learning and multi-objective optimization
description: The invention discloses a building carbon emission prediction and control method based on machine learning and multi-objective optimization. The method comprises the steps of collecting building design parameters and operation parameters, constructing a data set for training a machine learning model, training the machine learning model based on the data set, predicting air conditioner carbon emission indexes, illumination carbon emission indexes, equipment carbon emission indexes and carbon emission reduction indexes, establishing a multi-objective optimization model, taking minimized air conditioner carbon emission indexes, illumination carbon emission indexes, equipment carbon emission indexes and maximized carbon emission reduction indexes as optimization targets, solving the multi-objective optimization model by adopting a multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain a pareto optimal scheme set meeting different carbon emission target compromises, taking the pareto optimal scheme set as a candidate solution set which is optimized by adopting a near ideal solution ordering method subsequently, selecting an optimal scheme by adopting the near ideal solution ordering method based on the candidate solution set, and controlling the carbon emission of the building. The invention can be used for efficiently optimizing in a complex building parameter space.

title: A 3D yard measurement method, system, equipment and medium based on drone
description: A drone-based 3D yard measurement method, system, equipment, and medium relate to the field of yard measurement. In this method, a drone is controlled to fly along a preset flight path to collect measurement images and point cloud data of each target cargo pile in a port. The measurement images and point cloud data are registered, and the registered measurement images and point cloud data are fused to generate a fused dataset. The dataset is input into a preset deep convolutional neural network to generate a preliminary 3D model of the target cargo pile, and the preliminary 3D model is input into a generative adversarial network to generate a target 3D model. Cargo characteristic data and environmental factor data of the target cargo pile are obtained, and a density model of the target cargo pile is constructed based on the cargo characteristic data and environmental factor data. The mass data of the target cargo pile is calculated based on the target 3D model and density model. Implementing the technical solution provided by this application can more accurately and efficiently complete port yard cargo measurement.

title: Original monitoring video-oriented unsupervised pedestrian searching method
description: This invention relates to an unsupervised pedestrian search method for raw surveillance videos, comprising: using a pre-trained neural network to detect pedestrian regions in the raw surveillance video, and using a feature encoder to generate pedestrian features; in the raw surveillance video, based on the visual similarity and contextual similarity of pedestrians, finding the first nearest neighbor relationship of pedestrian features and organizing the chain structure of pedestrian features, determining the spatial distribution of pedestrian features, and performing unsupervised clustering based on segmented regions to generate pedestrian identity categories and their pseudo-labels; during the forward propagation process, calculating the contrast loss function of each branch from three branches: category discriminative learning, single-camera contrast learning, and multi-camera contrast learning, and updating the cluster center memory and multi-camera memory respectively according to the momentum update mechanism; jointly optimizing the contrast loss functions of the three branches, and minimizing the total loss value through multiple iterations during the backpropagation process to optimize the parameters of the feature encoder.

title: Self-adaptive rendering method and system for characters and images in AI digital human virtual and real scene fusion
description: The invention discloses a self-adaptive rendering method and a self-adaptive rendering system for characters and images in AI digital human virtual and real scene fusion, comprising the following steps of S1, collecting Chinese text and image data, extracting semantic and regional characteristics, S2, constructing a neural ordinary differential equation converter model, inputting the text and the image characteristics to generate fusion representation, S3, extracting a attention weight matrix, determining the spatial arrangement position of the Chinese text in the images, S4, optimizing structural parameter vectors by adopting a luminous insect group optimization algorithm to obtain a fusion model, S5, generating an image-text rendering instruction set based on the preliminary arrangement and the optimization model, S6, combining the action state of a digital human and background image information, completing gesture mapping and illumination adjustment to generate a rendering frame, S7, inputting the rendering frame into a rendering engine, and outputting video content of the Chinese text and the image fusion. The invention realizes the precise fusion of Chinese semantics and images, and remarkably improves the naturalness and interactivity of the AI digital human image-text presentation.

title: A method for constructing a flood disaster vulnerability curve model
description: The invention discloses a flood disaster vulnerability curve model construction method which comprises the steps of selecting an optimal daily extreme precipitation threshold and an optimal continuous daily number, calculating grid points by grid points to obtain annual total extreme precipitation data corresponding to a precipitation parameter combination, carrying out statistics on land coverage change data and gradient data by adopting a density calculation method to obtain a corresponding weight matrix, carrying out rasterization on county-level annual total loss data obtained by statistics according to county-level annual total loss data and annual total extreme precipitation data by combining the weight matrix, and dynamically constructing a flood disaster loss curve by adopting a deep learning multi-objective optimization four-parameter Logistic function based on the rasterized county-level annual total loss data and the rasterized annual total extreme precipitation data. The method can solve the technical problems that the existing flood disaster loss curve construction process is insufficient in data quantity, low in precision and limited to flood events or local cities, and cannot be popularized to a large scale and a large range.

title: Large-scale self-organizing network control system and method based on software-defined network
description: The present invention discloses a large-scale ad hoc network control system and method based on software-defined networking. The system's data plane layer consists of large-scale nodes; the control plane layer consists of a link monitoring module, a data flow management module, a routing planning module, and a topology control module; and the application plane layer consists of a routing planning application and a topology control application. The link monitoring module is responsible for receiving the ad hoc network link status information reported in real time by the data plane layer and generating a traffic matrix; the data flow management module is responsible for managing all data flows in the ad hoc network; the routing planning module performs data flow routing planning based on the ad hoc network traffic matrix and information about all data flows; and the topology control module is responsible for developing the ad hoc network initial topology and reconstructing the topology when the inter-node connectivity status changes. The present invention improves on the standard SDN architecture by adding functional modules, utilizing node community information to control the topology, and optimizing the genetic algorithm to increase the convergence speed of routing solutions.

title: An end-to-end adaptive visual feature extraction method based on PLFuNet
description: This invention discloses an end-to-end adaptive visual feature extraction method based on PLFuNet, belonging to the field of image processing technology, and used for visual feature extraction for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) pose estimation. The method comprises: collecting and preprocessing raw drone images, and then inputting them into a PLFuNet-based visual feature extraction model; generating multiscale images through adaptive multi-scale feature extraction, and extracting feature maps of varying resolutions and semantic depths using a shared backbone network; fusing the images through a feature pyramid network that adaptively adjusts the fusion level coefficients, followed by residual channel attention enhancement; and finally extracting and fusing features using key point and line segment detection branches to generate a joint feature description. The method automatically selects the optimal image scale and fusion level, eliminating manual setup. It extracts features end-to-end, reducing manual intervention. Its dynamic network structure and quantization scheme enable real-time operation on embedded platforms, with low power consumption, extending the drone's flight time and improving operational efficiency.

title: Unbalanced sample galloping prediction method and system based on meteorological data
description: This invention relates to the field of power transmission engineering technology and discloses a method and system for predicting unbalanced galloping events based on meteorological data. The prediction method includes: collecting historical monitoring data from each monitoring point and simultaneously collecting meteorological information from the corresponding monitoring points; selecting one sample data from the daily data of each device, using the monitoring device and date as the basic unit; grouping the non-galloping samples in the sample data according to the line number, and retaining only samples corresponding to different spans within each group; assigning differentiated loss weights to the sample data based on the span characteristics, high-incidence periods of galloping, and typical meteorological combinations, and constructing a weighted cross-entropy loss function; constructing a daily-scale galloping prediction model, and training the model using the weighted cross-entropy loss function to achieve daily-scale prediction of galloping events. By constructing a scientific sample extraction strategy, introducing a category weight mechanism, and adopting a deep learning classification model, the model's ability to identify minority events is improved.

title: A multi-source sound field localization and separation algorithm
description: The invention relates to the technical field of voice or sound processing and discloses a multi-source sound field positioning and separating algorithm which comprises the steps of intercepting a source generated waveform segment by monitoring the energy of an audio stream in real time, performing sliding cross-correlation operation on the source generated waveform segment serving as a matching template and a subsequent audio stream to detect distortion related peaks, and realizing sound source positioning and separation based on a time domain identification result of direct sound and reverberation.

title: Resource intelligent scheduling method based on multi-target reinforcement learning
description: This invention discloses a resource intelligent scheduling method based on multi-objective reinforcement learning. The method comprises the following steps: Step S1: Obtaining a resource scheduling scenario and extracting several objectives to be optimized based on the different scenarios; Step S2: Constructing several optimization spheres based on the different objectives, evaluating the priority of each objective, and dividing the optimization spheres into fixed spheres and moving spheres according to their priority; Step S3: Evaluating the correlation between the objectives and mapping the fixed and moving spheres to the same multi-dimensional space based on the correlation; Step S4: Adjusting the parameters of the moving spheres using reinforcement learning and causing the moving and fixed spheres to intersect. The intersection of the fixed and moving spheres is output as a resource scheduling strategy. By modeling the objectives to be optimized to generate spheres and introducing reinforcement learning to drive the intersection of the spheres, the intersection region can be obtained quickly and accurately and used as the optimal resource solution set to guide the scheduling of real-world resources.

title: A method for predicting ship trajectories based on graph attention mechanism and electronic nautical charts
description: This invention proposes a ship trajectory prediction method based on graph attention mechanism and electronic nautical charts, belonging to the field of intelligent ship technology. By fusing dynamic AIS trajectory data with static waterway geographic information, it achieves high-precision modeling and prediction of future ship trajectories. This method extends traditional time-series-based trajectory modeling to multimodal joint modeling, introducing waterway structure vector representation for the first time. It extracts structural information of the waterway environment based on graph neural networks and deeply integrates it with historical ship trajectory data, constructing a trajectory expression method that simultaneously incorporates temporal, spatial, and environmental semantics. In terms of model architecture, a graph attention mechanism is used to enhance the node representation capability in the waterway subgraph, while a temporal modeling module is introduced to model the trajectory evolution law, effectively improving the prediction accuracy and generalization ability of the model in complex water environments, achieving high-quality modeling, interpretable prediction, and intelligent support for ship trajectories.

title: Spiral CT image reconstruction method based on neural radiation field
description: The application discloses a spiral CT image reconstruction method based on a nerve radiation field, and belongs to the field of computer vision. The method comprises the steps of determining an original projection image of a scanned object, acquiring the original projection image by a spiral CT device in a fan-shaped beam scanning mode, classifying and splicing the original projection images with the same sampling angle in each week of a rotating process according to the sampling angle corresponding to the original projection image to obtain a spliced projection image, calling an image reconstruction model based on the spliced projection image to generate the spiral CT image, wherein the image reconstruction model is constructed and trained based on a nerve radiation field. The method reduces the radiation risk of the related personnel.

title: Knowledge graph realization method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
description: This application provides a knowledge graph implementation method, apparatus, device, and readable storage medium. The method utilizes the appearance and order of knowledge points in the analysis steps of real questions, combined with joint modeling of bidirectional co-occurrence and unidirectional temporal relationships, to automatically mine the actual usage paths between knowledge points from the analysis of real questions, accurately capture the implicit dependencies and cognitive paths between knowledge points, generate a dynamic knowledge graph with cognitive rationality, improve the accuracy and rationality of knowledge associations, make the knowledge graph closer to real learning behavior, and further transform the knowledge graph into a predictable transition matrix for student mastery evolution to simulate the process of knowledge diffusion along reasonable paths. This achieves dynamic tracking and accurate prediction of students' knowledge point mastery status, providing a basis for personalized learning path recommendations.

title: Online evaluation method, device, equipment and medium for primary frequency modulation capability of thermal power generating unit
description: The application discloses an online evaluation method, device, equipment and medium for primary frequency modulation capability of a thermal power unit, which relate to the field of thermal power unit frequency modulation, and adopt UMAP algorithm to perform characteristic dimension reduction and reconstruction processing on a high-dimensional operation dataset of the thermal power unit to be evaluated, unlike the linear dimension reduction limitation of traditional PCA, UMAP can capture the manifold structure of data, retain local association and global distribution, greatly reduce the characteristic dimension, and input the obtained unit output characteristic set into a pre-trained primary frequency modulation output prediction model of the thermal power unit to realize online frequency modulation output prediction. The traditional framework only focusing on frequency modulation performance is broken through in the evaluation dimension, evaluation dimension quantification is carried out based on the unit output prediction result and the high-dimensional operation data set, and an evaluation factor set is constructed. And finally, carrying out weight distribution calculation on the evaluation factor set by adopting an entropy weight TOPSIS method to generate a primary frequency modulation capability comprehensive evaluation index, intuitively reflecting the merits of the frequency modulation capability of the unit and improving the accuracy of frequency modulation capability evaluation.

title: An Evolutionary Method for Precise Boundary Segmentation Model of Remote Sensing Images Guided by Mask
description: This invention belongs to the field of pattern recognition technology, specifically disclosing a mask-guided evolution method for a precise boundary segmentation model of remote sensing images. The method includes: acquiring the original remote sensing image and constructing a mask image based on the annotation information of the original remote sensing image; constructing a latent diffusion model module for a precise boundary segmentation model of the remote sensing image; based on a deterministic diffusion process, using the mask image to guide the latent diffusion model module to learn the denoising process and output mask features; constructing a Transformer prediction head module for the precise boundary segmentation model of the remote sensing image; and constructing a loss function to optimize and train the precise boundary segmentation model of the remote sensing image, thus completing the evolution of the precise boundary segmentation model of the remote sensing image. This invention solves the problem that the randomness of Gaussian noise in the traditional random diffusion process introduces unnecessary perturbations to U-Net features, making it unsuitable for deterministic segmentation tasks.

title: A Service Monitoring and Management System Based on Distributed Agents
description: The invention relates to the technical field of cross treatment of a distributed artificial intelligent system and a micro-service, in particular to a service monitoring and managing system based on distributed agents, which adopts a three-level architecture of a user layer, a host Agent layer and a service Agent layer, wherein the user layer is provided with a unified entry forwarding request; the host Agent layer integrates the modules such as a service registry and the like to realize overall management and control, and the modules such as the service Agent layer containing registration and the like complete functions and state feedback. The service function and the state are dynamically bound through four innovations of a dynamic observability model, an incremental heartbeat protocol, a fine-granularity state machine and an intelligent routing engine. The method and the device have the advantages of improving service observability, optimizing problem positioning efficiency, reducing monitoring data transmission quantity, shortening service interruption time, improving usability, improving throughput in high concurrency scenes, and being suitable for scenes such as intelligent customer service.

title: Fan bolt looseness monitoring and identifying method and system based on acoustic emission technology
description: This application provides a method and system for monitoring and identifying loose bolts in wind turbines based on acoustic emission technology. The method includes: processing sensor coordinates and acoustic emission signal transmission duration to determine the sound source coordinates of the loose bolts; determining wind turbine operating status label data based on the acquired acoustic emission signal; performing adaptive noise reduction processing to obtain a noise-reduced acoustic emission signal; performing acoustic-electric coupling analysis to obtain an effective noise-reduced acoustic emission signal; further evaluating the effective acoustic emission signal; processing it using a preset cross-correlation function to obtain the stress abrupt change state of adjacent bolts; if a bolt experiences a stress abrupt change, acquiring and processing the acoustic emission energy to determine the change in preload; and performing real-time monitoring through threshold comparison. This application quantifies the collaborative stress relationship of multiple bolts, predicts the failure risk of grouped bolts, constructs dynamic noise reduction, and improves signal quality in complex environments, thereby achieving monitoring and identification of loose bolts in wind turbines based on acoustic emission technology.

title: A Deep Learning Method for Predicting Dam Deformation by Integrating Lag HST and Interpretable Hybrid Convolutional Attention Mechanism
description: This invention proposes a deep learning prediction method for dam deformation that integrates delayed HST (Hyper-Self-Attention) and an interpretable hybrid convolutional attention mechanism, belonging to the field of hydraulic structure health monitoring. The HST model categorizes dam deformation influencing factors into three types: water level, air temperature, and time. It also introduces phase difference analysis and related compensation techniques, significantly reducing the number of model parameters from the traditional nine periodic terms to four core components, thus improving modeling efficiency and accuracy. Based on this, a hybrid deep learning model combining 1D convolution, LSTM, 2D convolution, multi-head self-attention mechanism, and the interpretability method SHAP is constructed to achieve efficient prediction of dam deformation. This model possesses both long-term and short-term response modeling capabilities and long-term sequence stability, and exhibits strong interpretability, making it suitable for dam structural health assessment and early warning in complex environments.

title: Illegal website identification and clue attribution method, device, equipment, medium and product
description: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product for identifying illegal websites and attributing clues, which relate to the field of Internet information security, wherein the method comprises the steps of aiming at any target website, collecting multi-source heterogeneous data of the target website; the method comprises the steps of extracting characteristics of multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain a structured characteristic vector, determining the violation probability of target websites by adopting a pre-trained deep learning classification model according to the structured characteristic vector, carrying out relevance analysis on target websites in a high-probability violation website list to construct a network association graph, wherein the high-probability violation website list comprises target websites with the violation probability higher than a set threshold, clustering the network association graph by adopting a community discovery algorithm, and determining the operation subject information of the violation websites. According to the application, through multi-source heterogeneous data feature extraction, deep learning classification and graph association analysis, automatic and accurate identification of illegal websites and attribution analysis of a back operation main body are realized.

title: A Personnel Location System and Method Based on Multi-Source Data for Fireworks Storage Area
description: The invention discloses a firework storage area personnel positioning system and method based on multi-source data, and relates to the technical field of multi-source data analysis. The system comprises a coverage characteristic parameter acquisition module, a blind area analysis module, a positioning signal monitoring module, a cooperative positioning verification module and a positioning result output module, wherein a coverage matrix is constructed by acquiring coverage characteristic parameters of various positioning monitoring devices, a blind area with single invalid coverage is identified, a positioning related signal of a monitoring person is monitored in real time, and the cooperative positioning is triggered to invoke scene division complementary verification of adjacent devices. The invention solves the positioning problem caused by stacking shielding of the firework storage area and equipment coverage blind areas, realizes the positioning of personnel without dead angles in the whole area, and improves the safety management and control capability of the warehouse area.

title: Characterization of graphical representations of numerical simulation results
description: Improved methods of characterizing or classifying graphical representations of digital simulation results are disclosed. A training database is created in the computer system by including multiple graphical representations of various results obtained from multiple numerical simulations. Each graphical representation is associated with a textual description of an associated feature associated with the user's digital simulation. By applying the module, using an auto-correlation technique that correlates all graphical representations in the training database with each other, a quality index is calculated for the correlated textual descriptions. Next, a new graphical representation obtained from another numerical simulation is obtained by comparing the new graphical representation to all graphical representations in the training database, taking one of the textual descriptions and the corresponding confidence score. Improve the training database by adding or removing appropriate graphical representations according to predefined criteria.

title: Analysis method and system for multi-source biomarker data
description: The present application discloses an analysis method and system for multi-source biomarker data, which relates to the field of data analysis technology. The method includes: obtaining multi-source biomarker data corresponding to the biomarker to be analyzed, the multi-source biomarker data including local measurement data and reference measurement data of the biological sample; constructing an association expression model between the biomarker to be analyzed and the target disease based on the local measurement data and the reference measurement data; solving the association expression model based on the Bayesian method to obtain the association analysis results between the biomarker to be analyzed and the target disease. Since a model describing the association relationship between local measurement data, reference measurement data and target disease is constructed in the present application, and the model is solved based on the Bayesian method, the analysis results of the association between biomarkers and diseases can be accurately estimated without relying on complex assumptions, which is more suitable for the integrated analysis of multi-source biomarkers in clinical trial scenarios than existing methods.

title: Dynamic dividing method, device, medium and product for ecological red line area
description: The application discloses a dynamic dividing method, device, medium and product of an ecological red line area, which are characterized by constructing ecological indexes of an ecological protection data system according to collected ecological environment data, calculating index weights of all the ecological indexes through a preset fuzzy logic algorithm, determining an ecological environment index score, simulating dynamic changes of all the ecological indexes by adopting an uncertainty environment dynamic decision method according to the ecological environment data and the acquired ecological environment historical data, adjusting the ecological environment index score, and determining an ecological red line dividing area according to the adjusted ecological environment index score. According to the application, dynamic adjustment of the ecological red line can be realized according to dynamic changes of an ecological system, and the ecological red line is divided more accurately.

title: Automatic design method, equipment, medium and product for complex special instruction of hardware
description: The present application discloses a method, device, medium and product for automatic design of complex special instructions for hardware, which involves special hardware design, special instruction design or instruction set expansion. The method includes: analyzing the program to collect dynamic information; converting the basic blocks in the program into a data dependency graph based on the intermediate representation of the compiler, and extracting seeds; using a genetic algorithm to obtain candidates with full input and output restrictions based on the seeds; using a specially designed cost model to score the candidates as a basis for screening; using maximum weighted independent set analysis to overcome the overlapping problem of candidates; fusing the subgraphs corresponding to special instructions to generate special functional units, and completing the automatic design of complex special instructions for hardware. The present application can explore the similarities between basic blocks, and find common and frequently executed code snippets from the program as special instructions; the search can cover the target program to the greatest extent, so that the program can be fully accelerated.

title: Airport luggage system gear motor fault diagnosis method, system and medium
description: The invention provides a fault diagnosis method, system and medium for a speed reduction motor of an airport luggage system, which comprises the following steps of obtaining operation data of a plurality of groups of speed reduction motors, wherein the operation data comprise motor main body data, shaft data, bearing data and gear box data, preprocessing the operation data, constructing an original data set according to rules, constructing a WDCNN model, training a WDCNN model to be converged through the original data set to obtain a multi-dimensional fault diagnosis algorithm model, and inputting the operation data of the speed reduction motors to be diagnosed into the multi-dimensional fault diagnosis algorithm model for fault diagnosis to obtain a fault diagnosis result.

title: Power load prediction method based on large language model and social demographic information
description: The present invention discloses a method for power load forecasting based on a large language model and social demographic information, which relates to the technical field of power load forecasting and solves the technical problem that the power load forecasting method is difficult to combine social demographic information and difficult to process unstructured text information, which affects the accuracy and generalization ability of power load forecasting. The method includes obtaining historical power load information based on a time series conversion module; obtaining structured demographic information based on a social adapter module; fusing historical power load information and structured demographic information as input data of a power load forecasting model; and training by minimizing the prediction error of the power load forecasting model to obtain a power load forecasting model that is ultimately used for forecasting. The present invention combines a large language model with social demographic information, breaks through the limitations of traditional load forecasting models in data utilization, can process unstructured text information, and improves the accuracy of predictions.

title: Graph anti-emotion recognition method and system for dialogue analysis in Internet of things environment
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of emotion recognition, and discloses a graph anti-emotion recognition method and a system for dialogue analysis in an Internet of things environment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a context analysis module and a causal perception module, analyzing structure dependency relations in dialogue, and learning context emotion characteristics among dialogues by utilizing the structure dependency relation graph; and finally, introducing a differential regularization term to measure the difference between the outputs of the context analysis module and the causal sensing module and promote the information interaction between the context analysis module and the causal sensing module to obtain more comprehensive emotion information. According to the method, the complex dialogue scene is better subjected to emotion recognition processing in the environment of the Internet of things, and the recognition accuracy of emotion recognition tasks is improved.

title: Master-slave game-based collaborative optimization method for supply and demand sides of regional cooling system
description: The invention discloses a method for collaborative optimization of a supply and demand side of an area cooling system based on master-slave gaming, which comprises the following steps of acquiring meteorological data and date attribute data of a climate zone where a selected city is located, determining a typical building type, and collecting building information; building a building energy consumption agent model of a user side, calculating a cold load demand based on the building energy consumption agent model, building an objective function of a user side purchase cold cost based on the cold load demand, building a cold supply station operation model, building a supply-demand side cooperative optimization model between the cold supply station and a user side building, enabling the building energy consumption agent model to meet thermal comfort degree constraint, taking the maximum cold supply income of the cold supply station and the minimum user side building purchase cold cost as optimization targets, carrying out master-slave gaming on the cold supply station and a cold user, and solving to obtain a result of supply-demand side cooperative optimization. The invention brings the demand side model into the optimization problem to form global optimization, so that the flexibility of the system can be effectively improved, and the running stability of the regional cooling system in an extreme scene can be improved.

title: Configuration method and device of three-dimensional structure light ranging equipment
description: The invention relates to the technical field of optical equipment, in particular to a configuration method and device of three-dimensional structure optical ranging equipment. The method comprises the steps of carrying out characteristic analysis on predicted dynamic environment characteristic data of each sub-configuration area to obtain a class of candidate sub-configuration areas, carrying out screening analysis on each class of candidate sub-configuration areas according to a terrain area three-dimensional model diagram to obtain a class of candidate sub-configuration areas, carrying out screening analysis on the class of candidate sub-configuration areas according to a scene three-dimensional model diagram to obtain three classes of candidate sub-configuration areas, obtaining error rates of each class of candidate sub-configuration areas, and carrying out screening analysis on the three classes of candidate sub-configuration areas according to the error rates to obtain a final configuration area of the three-dimensional structure light ranging equipment. The method can enhance the adaptability of the three-dimensional structure light ranging equipment to environmental changes, improve the reliability of the measurement result and effectively reduce the equipment configuration cost.

title: Deep learning-based method and system for identifying and monitoring aloft work violation behaviors
description: The invention provides a deep learning-based high-altitude operation violation identification monitoring method and a deep learning-based high-altitude operation violation identification monitoring system, which comprise the steps of respectively configuring signal tracking equipment for each operator, carrying out operation tracking on the operators to obtain operation tracks corresponding to each operator, respectively configuring video shooting equipment for each operator, collecting operation video streams corresponding to each operator, establishing a plurality of operation actions corresponding to each operator based on the operation tracks and the operation video streams, carrying out deep hazard identification on each operation action based on the operation height corresponding to each operation action, determining the violation action corresponding to each operator according to a hazard identification result, calling a hazard warning language corresponding to each violation action, transmitting the hazard warning language to an information hearing display device of the corresponding operator to carry out hazard early warning, and identifying and supervising a series of violation actions and normalized operation actions of the high-altitude operators, thereby effectively reducing the high risk and protecting the safety of the operators.

title: Parallel pump set energy efficiency optimization method based on improved wolf-sparrow algorithm
description: A parallel pump group energy efficiency optimization method based on an improved Gray Wolf-Sparrow algorithm, which obtains the basic data of the target pipe network through a centrifugal pump hydraulic performance test; establishes polynomial fitting equations for centrifugal pump flow-head and flow-power at different speeds; constructs the objective function of the parallel pump group optimization model according to demand; constructs and considers the constraints of the parallel pump group optimization model; and uses the improved Gray Wolf-Sparrow algorithm to solve and obtain the parallel pump group optimization model control scheme. The present invention proposes a parallel pump group optimization control scheme, which is optimized and solved by start-stop, frequency conversion and valve adjustment at the same time, and uses an improved algorithm to improve calculation efficiency and accuracy, reduce the total energy consumption of the system and increase the expected life of the pump system.

title: Customer service attitude detection method, system, device and medium
description: The invention discloses a customer service attitude detection method, system, device and medium, which comprise the steps of judging whether a selected single sentence text contains forbidden words, selecting a plurality of upper and lower rounds of conversations of a current single sentence text to respectively analyze emotion values of customers and customer service, judging that the current single sentence text belongs to a non-civilized text when emotion values between the customers and the customer service exceed respective thresholds, acquiring the number of the non-civilized texts in text data, and further judging the service attitude of the customer service in the conversations of the customers and the customer service. The invention detects whether the emotions of both sides are upgraded by combining the context emotion with the single sentence intention, thereby avoiding the environment noise and the error judgment caused by the ASR transcription problem, and simultaneously, the invention detects whether the emotions of both sides are upgraded by the anger value duty ratio of a plurality of rounds of conversations between the client and the customer service and the difference value of the emotion values on the time sequence, thereby improving the accuracy of judging the emotion of the customer service.

title: Lithium ion battery SOC estimation method based on GRU neural network
description: The present invention discloses a lithium-ion battery SOC estimation method based on a GRU neural network, and the specific steps include the following: S1, establishing a GRU neural network model; S2, using an immune genetic algorithm to optimize the GRU neural network hyperparameters; S3, optimizing the neural network model using a multi-head attention mechanism and a residual structure; S4, estimating the SOC based on the optimized neural network model. In the present invention, a multi-head attention mechanism is introduced to fully mine the input data features, wherein the multi-head attention mechanism overcomes the shortcomings of a single-head attention in processing complex models, can better extract feature information from multiple aspects, prevent the model from overfitting, and use an immune genetic algorithm to optimize the GRU recurrent neural network hyperparameters to seek a better network structure and improve training efficiency. GRU can well preserve the time series features of important data and mine time series information, making it a good candidate for SOC prediction.

title: Training fault tolerance method and device applied to distributed training system and chip product
description: The present application provides a training fault-tolerant method, device and chip product applied to a distributed training system, and relates to the field of distributed training technology. The method includes: for a distributed training system including multiple computing nodes and at least one spare node, when the spare node is set as a new computing node, determining a target computing node related to the new computing node from multiple computing nodes; migrating the checkpoint data stored in the memory of the target computing node to the new computing node, wherein the checkpoint data is used to indicate the state of the computing node when participating in the execution of a distributed training task; and controlling the new computing node to participate in the execution of the distributed training task based on the checkpoint data. The embodiment of the present application helps to improve the reading efficiency of the checkpoint data by migrating the checkpoint data stored in the memory of the target computing node to the new computing node without reading the checkpoint data from the persistent storage system.

title: Orchard three-dimensional reconstruction and fruit tree semantic segmentation method based on nerve radiation field
description: The present invention relates to the field of agricultural information technology, specifically to a method for three-dimensional reconstruction of an orchard and semantic segmentation of fruit trees based on a neural radiation field, comprising the following steps: using a drone to shoot an orchard from multiple perspectives to obtain an original image data set for three-dimensional reconstruction; preprocessing the original image data set, including camera pose estimation and dedistortion, image downsampling, monocular depth estimation and semantic annotation, to generate image data of RGB images, depth maps and semantic maps suitable for neural radiation field network training. When dealing with large-scale outdoor environments, especially under complex lighting conditions and changing terrain, the present invention overcomes the limitations of traditional methods and achieves faster, more precise and accurate three-dimensional reconstruction when facing large-scale orchard scenes through optimized drone multi-perspective reconstruction, improved NeRF algorithm and introduced semantic fields.

title: Power distribution network new user electricity utilization time sequence load prediction method, system, device and medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of power grid technology, and specifically discloses a method, system, device and medium for predicting the electricity time series load of new users in a distribution network, including collecting intermittent data of trial operation of new users, using Markov chain and sequential Monte Carlo simulation to extract the probability characteristics of the electricity time series load state of new users, establishing an interpolation model for missing electricity time series load with time and weather as influencing factors, correcting the interpolation model based on a generative adversarial network, obtaining continuous trial operation data of new users, and using the LS-SVM algorithm, Kalman filter algorithm or a combination of these two algorithms to predict the electricity time series load of new users. The present invention can accurately predict the electricity time series load of new users who have registered for distribution network business expansion, which is conducive to selecting suitable power access points for new users who have registered for distribution network business expansion in practical applications.

title: Drilling fluid reservoir protection performance optimization method and system based on data association analysis
description: The invention provides a drilling fluid reservoir protection performance optimization method and system based on data association analysis, wherein the method comprises the following steps of carrying out attribution analysis on association relation between initial drilling fluid parameters and target permeability recovery values; the method comprises the steps of constructing multiple regression models between controllable parameters of all target drilling fluids and target permeability recovery values, calculating based on the multiple regression models to obtain an optimal multiple regression equation, generating parameter map nodes and node edges according to the controllable parameters of all target drilling fluids to obtain a parameter map structure of the controllable parameters of the target drilling fluids, constructing a parameter optimization map network by combining the parameter map structure and the optimal multiple regression equation, inputting initial drilling fluid parameters into the trained parameter optimization map network to obtain optimal drilling fluid parameters output by the parameter optimization map network, and adjusting an initial drilling fluid formula to be an optimal drilling fluid formula according to the optimal drilling fluid parameters. The invention has the effect of efficiently and accurately optimizing the protective performance of the drilling fluid reservoir.

title: Method, device, system and storage medium for processing intelligent agent tool configuration information
description: The disclosure relates to a method, a device, a system and a storage medium for processing configuration information of an agent tool, which relate to the technical field of data processing and at least solve the technical problems that in the related art, the whole service program of an agent is closed due to tool change of one task, so that other tasks of the agent cannot be executed, and therefore, the execution efficiency of the task of the agent is low and the use experience of a user is poor. The method comprises the steps of selecting target tools and target configuration information of the target tools for providing service for target tasks of task requests from preset disk files when an agent perceives the task requests of a first user, enabling configuration information, which is contained in the preset disk files and characterizes association mapping relations between each task and each tool, to be modifiable, and loading the target tools and the target configuration information into a target service program for executing the target tasks so as to call the loaded target service program to execute the target tasks.

title: Space-time domain prediction channel modeling method based on reinforcement loss function
description: The invention discloses a space-time domain prediction channel modeling method based on a reinforcement loss function, which effectively improves the prediction accuracy of predictive channel modeling based on machine learning. The method comprises the steps of preprocessing indoor corridor channel measurement data to obtain channel statistics characteristics under corresponding scenes and frequency bands, designing a weight function based on a space-time correlation function according to space-time correlation in the channel statistics characteristics, combining the weight function with a traditional loss function to form a weight loss function, and finally sensing the space-time correlation characteristic in the channel data by improving the loss function of a gate control circulation unit network, outputting more accurate prediction channel data, and improving the prediction performance of a prediction channel model. The channel statistical characteristics obtained by model prediction clearly illustrate that the prediction accuracy of the air-time domain prediction channel model is improved, and the proposed loss function can be used for designing a more accurate prediction channel model based on machine learning.

title: Model training method, data prediction method, computing device and readable storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a model training method, a data prediction method, computing equipment and a readable storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The model training method comprises the steps of constructing a first neural network according to nodes corresponding to the number of types of operation data of engineering machinery and nodes corresponding to target data to be predicted, training the first neural network, determining all first nodes and all second nodes in the trained first neural network, taking the second nodes as initial nodes, constructing an nth neural network corresponding to all initial nodes, training the nth neural network, determining all third nodes and all fourth nodes in the trained nth neural network, updating the initial nodes by using the fourth nodes, executing the step of constructing the nth neural network corresponding to all initial nodes until the number of the fourth nodes is zero, and constructing a data prediction proxy model based on the first neural network and all the nth neural network.

title: Scientific research project quality management methods, systems, electronic equipment and storage media
description: The invention provides a quality management method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for scientific research projects, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a mapping relation between quality activities in a scientific research project plan book and chapter strips specified by a quality management system file, determining a plan time schedule of the project quality activities, correcting the plan time schedule based on the project quality activity completion time schedule, the mapping relation and the comparable completion time schedule of the project quality activities of the same kind, obtaining a correction time schedule of the project quality activities, and obtaining a quantity target value of each project quality activity stage development in response to the operation of inputting project development period proportion and stage project quality activity completion schedule target value in the correction time schedule, so that the scientific research project quality activity law can be accurately predicted, the quality plan can be timely adjusted according to actual working conditions, and the quality management efficiency of the scientific research projects is improved.

title: Flood condition dynamic monitoring algorithm based on SAR time sequence feature optimization
description: The present application relates to the field of flood monitoring technology, specifically a dynamic flood monitoring algorithm based on SAR time series feature optimization, which includes the following steps: obtaining Sentinel‑1SAR sample data of several target areas during the flood season; processing the sample data to construct an initial feature set; assigning labels to some sample data to form a training set, wherein the label types include normal water bodies, submerged water bodies, and non-water bodies; training a recognition model using the training set; determining the optimal number of features; based on the optimal feature subset, using the optimal feature subset as input, and using the trained recognition model to output the spatiotemporal change results of the target area. The present application achieves high-precision flood season water body monitoring by jointly optimizing and selecting features from the polarization dimension and the time dimension respectively, and using a small number of effective optimized features, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of dynamic flood monitoring and achieving automatic, rapid, and effective monitoring of spatiotemporal information of water bodies at a large scale.

title: Task planning method of intelligent world model with body based on visual reasoning
description: The invention provides a task planning method of an intelligent world model based on visual reasoning, which combines the language processing capability of a large language model with an advanced visual perception technology, so that an intelligent body can pre-infer an environment state and simulate possible actions through the world model under the condition of acquiring a small amount of environment visual information, thereby effectively deciding and rapidly adapting to the continuously-changing environment state in a complex environment, and further remarkably improving the task execution efficiency and the task completion success rate of the intelligent body in the complex scene.

title: Urban pipe network monitoring and optimizing method, system and medium based on intelligent agent map
description: The present application provides a method, system and medium for monitoring and optimizing urban pipe networks based on intelligent agent maps. The method includes: extracting pipe network structure layout data according to the intelligent agent map, and processing to obtain pipe network structure layout evaluation index, constructing an urban pipe network intelligent agent system model according to the intelligent agent map, simulating the operation of the urban pipe network according to the urban pipe network intelligent agent system model, obtaining pipe network resource allocation data, obtaining pipe network resource allocation evaluation index according to pipe network resource allocation data processing, obtaining supply data of the urban pipe network within a preset time period, obtaining pipe network supply capacity evaluation index according to supply data processing, determining the urban pipe network operation evaluation level according to the pipe network structure layout evaluation index, pipe network resource allocation evaluation index and pipe network supply capacity evaluation index, and obtaining the corresponding urban pipe network optimization plan; thereby achieving the purpose of monitoring and optimizing the urban pipe network.

title: Infrastructure intelligent monitoring method of skin-like structure
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent monitoring method for infrastructure of a skin-like structure, and relates to the technical field of the Internet of Things for civil engineering. The method comprises: obtaining infrastructure data of multiple sensor nodes in a sensor network; constructing a spatiotemporal correlation model according to the infrastructure data of multiple sensor nodes, and distinguishing the properties of each sensor node in the sensor network according to the spatiotemporal correlation model; inputting the time characteristics and spatial characteristics of the spatiotemporal correlation model into a conditional variational autoencoder CVAE model to determine the risk coefficient of each sensor node; visualizing the structural health status of the infrastructure according to the risk coefficient of each sensor node, and adjusting the infrastructure monitoring work of the sensor network according to the risk coefficient of each sensor node and the properties of each sensor node. The present invention can ensure the monitoring accuracy while effectively reducing the system energy consumption and extending the service life of the sensor network.

title: Building site off-grid power supply optimizing system based on big data fusion analysis
description: The present invention discloses a construction site off-grid power supply optimization system based on big data fusion analysis, which belongs to the field of construction site power supply management, and includes a collection and preprocessing module, a sorting and fusion module, a graph construction module, a demand prediction module, a resource optimization module, a simulation evaluation module, a decision support module, a real-time monitoring module, a feedback adjustment module and a report analysis module; the present invention ensures that in different environments and demand changes, it can respond quickly, maintain power supply stability, improve overall energy utilization efficiency, maintain a good operating state in the face of emergencies, enhance the robustness and reliability of the power supply system, reduce prediction errors, and improve the overall prediction accuracy of the system, which helps to better understand the relationship between past and future demands, enhance the effectiveness of prediction, reduce the need for manual intervention, and improve the intelligence level of the system.

title: Photovoltaic newspaper data processing method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a photovoltaic application data processing method, system, electronic device and storage medium. The photovoltaic application data processing method comprises: obtaining photovoltaic application data; extracting features of photovoltaic application data using a pre-trained form filling model to obtain field data; and filling the field data into a target form to obtain a photovoltaic application form. The present invention solves the technical problem of low efficiency and accuracy in filling out photovoltaic application forms.

title: Methods, architectures, apparatus and systems for data-driven prediction of augmented reality (XR) device user input
description: Programs, methods, architectures, apparatuses, systems, devices and computer program products implemented by a wireless transmit/receive unit (WTRU) include obtaining first user input data at a first time, transmitting first information including neural network data generated from a first distributed Deep Neural Network (DNN) of the WTRU, receiving second information including first predicted user input data generated from a second DNN of an edge device at a second time, obtaining second user input data at the second time, determining a first prediction error based on the first predicted user input data at the second time and the second user input data obtained at the second time, and transmitting third information including the first prediction error and/or an indication to trigger an error correction algorithm for predicting user input if the first prediction error is above a threshold.

title: Taraxacum effective ingredient extraction process optimization method based on I-WO-SVR model
description: The present invention relates to an optimization method for extracting effective components from dandelions based on an I‑WO‑SVR model, comprising: obtaining factors to be predicted, the factors to be predicted include: ethanol concentration, ultrasonic time, ultrasonic temperature and ultrasonic power; inputting the factors to be predicted into the I‑WO‑SVR model to obtain the chlorogenic acid extraction rate of dandelion flower stems; the I‑WO‑SVR model is obtained by training a support vector regression SVR prediction model using a training set, and using an improved walrus optimizer I‑WO to optimize the penalty parameters and kernel parameters of the SVR prediction model; wherein the training set includes: original factors and the chlorogenic acid extraction rates corresponding to the original factors. The present invention combines modern artificial intelligence technology with traditional Chinese medicine to design an optimization method for extracting effective components from Chinese medicinal materials, has broad application prospects, and can provide new ideas for Chinese medicine extraction and its intelligent industrial production.

title: Distribution network single-end positioning method and related device based on global traveling wave time-frequency diagram
