description: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing and discloses a single-ended positioning method of a power distribution network based on a global traveling wave time-frequency diagram and a related device, wherein the single-ended positioning method comprises the steps of analyzing transmission characteristics of fault traveling waves under a single branch line based on the global traveling wave time-frequency diagram of fault traveling wave signals of the power distribution network to obtain the transmission characteristics of the single branch line; the method comprises the steps of analyzing transmission characteristics of fault traveling waves under a cross branch line based on a global traveling wave time-frequency diagram to obtain the cross branch line transmission characteristics, constructing a power distribution network fault location model based on a residual network according to the single branch line transmission characteristics and the cross branch line transmission characteristics to obtain an initial power distribution network fault location model, optimizing and improving the initial power distribution network fault location model based on a graph mixed convolution neural network according to the global traveling wave time-frequency diagram to obtain a target power distribution network fault location model, and carrying out single-ended fault location on a multi-branch power distribution network according to the target power distribution network fault location model to obtain a more accurate target fault location result.

title: Generation of multi-layer federated learning architecture, model training method and device based on multi-layer federated learning architecture
description: The invention relates to the technical field of federation learning, and provides a model training method and device based on a multi-layer federation learning architecture, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of primary clusters generated based on division of a plurality of participants, selecting a bottom layer center node from each primary cluster, obtaining a plurality of secondary clusters generated by division of the bottom layer center node, selecting a center node from each secondary cluster, obtaining a middle layer center node, obtaining a plurality of tertiary clusters divided by the middle layer center node, selecting the center node from the tertiary clusters, iterating layer by layer, obtaining a top layer center node, aggregating model parameters of the middle layer participants by the middle layer center node, distributing global model parameters, updating the global model parameters by the top layer center node, and transmitting the global model parameters to the middle layer center node. According to the method, model aggregation operation is completed in layers in sequence, so that a single central node is prevented from bearing all aggregation tasks, and the system interruption risk caused by single-point faults is reduced.

title: Aircraft flight connection planning method, system, device and medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of route planning and provides an aircraft flight route planning method, system, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of utilizing flight information of a plurality of cities to construct a flight information diagram, wherein the flight information of each city a in the flight information diagram comprises a city a, coordinates of the city a, a city b with a direct flight between the city a and the city a, and average duration of flights from the city a to the city b; based on the information in the flight information graph, constructing heuristic functions, loss functions and expected loss functions of an A-path planning algorithm, carrying out path planning by using the A-path planning algorithm, outputting a planned path from a starting node to a target node, and based on the planned path, matching flights to obtain a matching result and outputting the matching result. The invention can make full use of the data in the flight schedule to make the planned flight procedure more scientific.

title: A spatial attention module and training method for deep models
description: The application discloses a spatial attention module of a depth model and a training method. The spatial attention module of the depth model comprises a spatial position coding unit, an initial weight generating unit, a weight normalizing unit and a spatial screening unit, wherein the spatial position coding unit is used for coding two-dimensional positions on the height and the width of an input feature map to generate position codes, the initial weight generating unit is used for fusing the position codes with the input feature map to generate initial weights of spatial attention through convolution and nonlinear transformation, the weight normalizing unit is used for normalizing the initial weights to obtain normalized weights, and the spatial screening unit is used for acting the normalized weights on the input feature map to spatially screen features at different positions in the input feature map. According to the application, the technical problem that noise and a target object are difficult to distinguish due to the fact that spatial position information is ignored in the prior art is solved, and the technical effects of reducing interference of noise on detection of the target object and improving the accuracy of detection of the target object are achieved.

title: A quantum error correction code decoding method, system and terminal based on momentum belief propagation
description: The invention discloses a quantum error correction code decoding method, a system and a terminal based on momentum belief propagation, wherein the method comprises the steps of representing prior information of occurrence probability of each bubble error of each quantum bit through a log likelihood ratio, obtaining an initialization message according to the prior probability vector, updating information transmitted to all adjacent variable nodes by check nodes according to the initialization message, obtaining updated horizontal information, carrying out dynamic information update on posterior information of each variable node according to the updated horizontal information and historical information, obtaining updated posterior information, calculating updated vertical information through a fixed suppression method based on the updated horizontal information and the posterior information, obtaining real error estimation according to the posterior information, and outputting a result. According to the invention, a momentum item is introduced in message updating, so that a decoding algorithm based on momentum message propagation is obtained, and the decoding accuracy and convergence rate of decoding on a high-degeneracy quantum code are greatly improved.

title: An X-band active atmospheric waveguide over-the-horizon detection system and method
description: The invention provides an X-band active atmosphere waveguide beyond visual range detection system and method, the system comprises a waveguide transmitting antenna, a waveguide receiving antenna, a satellite positioning receiving antenna, a transmitter, a receiver, a data processor, a computer and a power supply system. The transmitter is connected to a waveguide transmitting antenna, the waveguide transmitting antenna is used for transmitting X-band signals, the waveguide receiving antenna is used for receiving shore-based radar signals and echo signals and is connected to a receiver, the satellite positioning receiving antenna is used for receiving navigation satellite signals and is connected to the receiver, the receiver is connected to a data processor, the data processor is connected to a computer, and the power supply system is connected to the transmitter and the receiver respectively. The method has the beneficial effects of improving the sea clutter interference resistance, improving the detection precision, improving the reliability of the detection capability, improving the calculation capability and reducing the calculation complexity.

title: A hybrid expert multimodal large model feature fusion method and system
description: The invention provides a method and a system for combining characteristics of a mixed expert multi-mode large model, wherein the method comprises the steps of autoregressive pre-training of the large model, performing token on text, image and voice data and predicting the next element; and the small model expands capacity, and processes more diversified tasks by adding the multi-mode small model and adjusting a gating network. In the aspect of feature fusion, a token embedded self-adaptive gating strategy is adopted to realize effective information integration among different modalities. According to the invention, a plurality of multi-mode small models are designed, and large model experts of a plurality of modes are comprehensively utilized to complete tasks, so that the model performance, the processing efficiency and the task universality are remarkably improved.

title: Outdoor parking space intelligent detection method, system, device and medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of outdoor parking space detection technology, and provides an outdoor parking space intelligent detection method, system, device and medium. The outdoor parking space intelligent detection method comprises the following steps: S1, constructing an OP-RTDETR model; S2, realizing intelligent detection of outdoor parking through the OP-RTDETR model; wherein, in step S1, the specific method of constructing the OP-RTDETR model comprises the following steps: S10, creating GC-VanillaNet as a feature extraction network; S11, using the Efficient Hybrid Encoder of RTDETR as the encoder of the OP-RTDETR model; S12, optimizing Bayesian uncertainty through the uncertainty minimization query selection strategy of RT-DETR; S13, training the decoder through the GCDN method. The present invention can realize intelligent detection of outdoor parking by constructing the OP-RTDETR model, and improves detection accuracy while realizing high real-time performance.

title: Information processing method based on memory mechanism, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The application provides an information processing method, electronic equipment and a storage medium based on a memory mechanism, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining information to be processed corresponding to a target user, searching knowledge related to the information to be processed in a memory bank corresponding to the target user to obtain a processing result corresponding to the information to be processed by using the searched knowledge, wherein the memory bank comprises a long-term memory bank and a short-term memory bank, and if the used knowledge is knowledge in the short-term memory bank, recording using behaviors aiming at the knowledge, wherein the short-term memory bank is used for temporarily storing the knowledge related to the target user, and when the using behaviors corresponding to any knowledge in the short-term memory bank meet preset conditions, the knowledge meeting the preset conditions is stored in the long-term memory bank. The application can realize the hierarchical storage of the memory, simulate the real-world memory mechanism to process the information to be processed of the user, improve the interaction effect with the user and promote the user experience.

title: Aircraft positioning method and device
description: The application belongs to the technical field of positioning, and particularly discloses an aircraft positioning method and device. According to the method, the security graph is matched with the first image of the preset positioning area, the security sub graph with the highest similarity with the first image in the security graph is found, the geographic coordinates of the first image are determined according to the geographic coordinates of the security sub graph, and finally the position of the aircraft is determined according to the geographic coordinates of the first image. When the positioning of the aircraft is realized, the application does not depend on satellite navigation, solves the problem that the high-precision positioning of the aircraft is difficult to realize in the satellite rejection environment in satellite navigation, and realizes the autonomous high-precision positioning of the aircraft under the satellite rejection condition.

title: Embroidery stitch reverse pushing and dynamic reproduction method based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses an embroidery stitch reverse-pushing and dynamic reproduction method based on deep learning, which belongs to the technical field of embroidery stitch identification and comprises the steps of collecting stitch data; the method comprises the steps of utilizing a point cloud registration algorithm to fuse three-dimensional point cloud data acquired from multiple views to construct a multi-mode data set, constructing a dynamic map space-time interaction network, extracting feature vectors in the multi-mode data based on the dynamic map space-time interaction network, constructing a needle method inverse pushing model to obtain needle method space layout instructions, dynamic process parameters and an optimized array method sequence, and constructing a dynamic reproduction model to obtain an actual embroidery brake sequence. The invention can automatically learn deep features of embroidery methods in embroidery images, remarkably improve the accuracy of reverse pushing of the embroidery methods and the authenticity of dynamic reproduction, and realize accurate reverse pushing of various embroidery methods under complex textures, different illumination conditions and various embroidery angles.

title: Intelligent barking control method, device and computer-readable storage medium
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent barking control method, device and computer-readable storage medium, wherein the method is run in an embedded terminal worn on a pet, wherein a preset pet barking model is built in the embedded terminal; the method comprises: sound collection, obtaining the sound decibel value of the ambient noise around the pet; model comparison, if the sound decibel value is greater than the preset decibel value, the collected sound is compared with the pet barking model and the comparison result is output; and punishment is output, if the comparison result is greater than the preset punishment value, the punishment module is triggered to stop the pet from barking. The technical solution of the present invention, through machine learning models and signal processing technology, can realize high-accuracy dog barking recognition on embedded systems with limited resources; at the same time, it reduces the dependence on powerful computing resources, does not need to be connected to a PC or the cloud, realizes the stand-alone operation of the data model, and improves the feasibility and popularity in practical applications.

title: A two-stage fine-tuning training method and device based on a large language model
description: The application provides a double-stage fine tuning training method and device based on a large language model, the method comprises the steps of obtaining a correlation judgment data set and a correlation selection data set, wherein the correlation judgment data set and the correlation selection data set both comprise triples consisting of query, positive samples and negative samples, and the complexity of the correlation selection data set is higher than that of the correlation judgment data set; the method comprises the steps of performing preliminary fine adjustment on a pre-trained large language model by adopting a correlation judgment data set, wherein the preliminary fine adjustment is used for enabling the large language model to master basic correlation judgment capability, performing fine adjustment again on the preliminary fine-adjusted large language model by adopting a correlation selection data set, wherein the fine adjustment is used for enabling the large language model to master correlation judgment capability in a complex environment, and deploying the fine-adjusted large language model into an information retrieval system. The application can improve the accuracy of information retrieval.

title: Bridge construction progress monitoring method and system based on BIM
description: The present application provides a method and system for monitoring the progress of bridge construction based on BIM, including: obtaining an observation matrix based on the BIM model data and sensor monitoring data of the target bridge; inputting the observation matrix into a preset Kalman filter to obtain a corresponding fusion matrix; taking the overall progress deviation as the dependent variable, and taking the stress ratio, environmental index, resource delay rate, and process progress deviation as independent variables, performing a Granger causality test to obtain the Granger causality test result; constructing a corresponding DAG, and obtaining the cause of the overall progress deviation based on the DAG. The solution accurately integrates the BIM model data and the sensor monitoring data, constructs a DAG between the overall progress deviation and each quantitative information, and can accurately obtain the quantitative information causing the overall progress deviation, providing an effective basis for subsequent decision-making.

title: A method for reducing noise of digital model of cultural relics and related device
description: The present application discloses a denoising method and related device for a digital model of cultural relics, which relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The original feature data is input into a preset denoising model; multiple iterative encodings are performed through the preset denoising model to obtain low-dimensional feature data, and the low-dimensional feature data is geometrically transformed to obtain features to be reconstructed; the features to be reconstructed are decoded to obtain reconstructed feature data of the digital model of cultural relics. Iterative encoding includes: linearly transforming the input features of this iterative encoding; projecting the results of the linear transformation using the corresponding linear weight matrix and nonlinear weight matrix; normalizing the results of the projection transformation to obtain the activation output of this iterative encoding, and using the activation output of this iterative encoding as the input feature of the next iterative encoding; it can be seen that this scheme improves the accuracy and fidelity of the digital model of cultural relics by combining linear projection transformation and nonlinear projection transformation to project the features in the encoding stage.

title: Automatic protection charging method for electric vehicle
description: The invention discloses an automatic protection type charging method for an electric car, which relates to the technical field of electric car charging and comprises the steps of carrying out license plate recognition and car type matching on a car entering a charging area, carrying out double authentication on the identity of the car owner by utilizing a face recognition technology, and carrying out authority verification by combining background information; and distinguishing the characteristics of the moving object through an intelligent recognition algorithm, automatically adjusting a warning mode according to different types of objects, and pushing the abnormal event in real time. The charging station safety management system not only improves safety in the charging process, but also enhances intelligent management of charging facilities, and can effectively improve the safety and the operation efficiency of the charging station.

title: A Fault Diagnosis Method for Analog Circuits Based on IHO-KELM
description: The present invention relates to the field of fault diagnosis technology, and in particular to an analog circuit fault diagnosis method based on IHO-KELM, including collecting voltage values under different fault modes of analog circuits to construct a statistical feature set; using KPCA to weight the Mahalanobis distance to construct a fusion feature; using the IHO algorithm to optimize the regularization coefficient C and kernel function parameter g of the KELM network; using the fusion feature to train the improved KELM network and output the fault classification result; using the Sobol sequence in the IHO algorithm to initialize the population, using the position update strategy of the oscillation of the sine-cosine algorithm and the randomness of the Cauchy distribution, introducing a dynamic Rice step strategy to balance the ability of global search and local search, and adjusting the shape parameters. The present invention solves the problem that the classification accuracy and classification efficiency of KELM need to be further improved.

title: UAV safety evaluation method based on digital twin
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a safety evaluation method of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on digital twinning, which comprises the steps of constructing a high-precision digital twinning body, generating a dynamic airflow disturbance field, optimizing flight control parameters through reinforcement learning, evaluating risk probability, and importing the parameters into an entity unmanned aerial vehicle for verification through hardware in a ring system.

title: A snooker artificial intelligence scoring system based on machine vision recognition
description: The invention relates to the technical field of billiards, in particular to a machine vision identification-based snooker artificial intelligence scoring system. The invention aims to provide a machine vision identification-based snooker artificial intelligence scoring system, which combines deep learning and multi-sensor data fusion technology with deep fusion of player batting gestures to effectively improve timeliness and objectivity in snooker competition.

title: Structured data artificial intelligence large model analysis method and system based on semantic decoupling
description: The present application discloses a structured data artificial intelligence large model analysis method and system based on semantic decoupling, which relates to the field of data analysis technology. The method includes: semantically encoding each feature in the structured data according to the feature name and/or feature description; numerically encoding each feature in the structured data according to the feature value, and then analyzing the semantic feature vector and the numerical feature vector to obtain the data analysis result. Since the present application performs semantic encoding according to the feature name and/or feature description, and numerical encoding according to the feature value, the semantic understanding is decoupled from the numerical analysis, so that the semantic understanding of structured data can be achieved in-depth, robust and generalizable by using a large language model. Feature analysis is performed on the semantic feature vector and the numerical feature vector, and the original data is converted into a feature sequence, which can be analyzed without filling or filtering missing data, thereby improving the accuracy of data analysis.

title: Infrasonic wave signal analysis method and system for oil and gas pipeline leakage detection
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of oil and gas pipeline leakage detection, and discloses an infrasound signal analysis method and system for oil and gas pipeline leakage detection. The present invention obtains the basic data of the oil and gas pipeline and the sample data of the original infrasound signal when the oil and gas pipeline has no leakage under normal conditions, and then obtains the infrasound signal through an infrasound sensor, calculates the signal interference value based on the interference degree of the interference factor on the infrasound signal, extracts the feature of the infrasound signal to obtain the acoustic wave feature data, calculates the similarity coefficient between the infrasound signal and the original infrasound signal, and obtains the interference-free judgment coefficient based on the constructed deviation prediction model, and judges and generates a leakage warning signal according to a preset judgment threshold. The present invention can eliminate the interference of meteorological interference factors, activity interference factors and biological interference factors on the infrasound signal, and improves the accuracy of oil and gas pipeline leakage detection using infrasound signals.

title: Puppet action processing method and system in puppet animation
description: The present application discloses a puppet action processing method and system in a puppet animation, the method comprising: obtaining a first shape and a second shape of a virtual puppet, wherein the virtual puppet is a puppet image generated in software, the virtual puppet is provided with a plurality of joints, the first shape and the second shape are different forms of the virtual puppet after the plurality of joints are adjusted by the software; marking the same joints in the first shape and the second shape; obtaining a first position of each same joint in the first shape and a second position in the second shape; setting a path between the first position and the second position; moving the joints of the virtual puppet of the first shape with the path set along the path from the first position to the second position, and generating an animation of the movement process, thereby improving the efficiency of shooting to a certain extent.

title: Cloud resource life cycle prediction method and device and computer equipment
description: The application relates to a life cycle prediction method and device of cloud resources and computer equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining the resource usage amount, the resource performance parameters and the resource fault records of target cloud resources, carrying out feature cross combination on the resource usage amount and the resource performance parameters to obtain resource utilization efficiency features, modeling the resource performance parameters and the resource fault records to obtain influence degree features which indicate the influence degree of faults on the resource usage, and inputting the influence degree features into a prediction model according to the resource utilization efficiency features and the influence degree features to obtain the life cycle of the target cloud resources.

title: AI dialogue system and method based on bidirectional interactable form
description: The present invention relates to the field of computer technology, and discloses an AI dialogue system and method based on a two-way interactive form; the present invention significantly reduces the user interaction burden and the threshold of prompt word engineering by dynamically generating structured forms and intelligent pre-filling mechanisms, and solves the problems of passive interaction, low efficiency of multiple rounds, and faults in collaboration between models in the prior art. The system can automatically identify information gaps and generate optimal forms, support multi-modal input and cross-model collaboration, and ensure the integrity and accuracy of information transmission. At the same time, through a feedback-driven self-optimization mechanism, the form generation strategy and template adaptability are continuously improved, achieving an efficient, accurate, and scalable intelligent interactive experience.

title: Intelligent cabinet receiving method based on image recognition technology
description: The invention relates to the technical field of a cabinet, and discloses an intelligent cabinet-using method based on an image recognition technology. The invention helps new users to get up to hand quickly by being provided with a plurality of functions and leading and guiding for the first time, stores and fetches the commodity Cheng Guifan, ensures accurate record of operation by camera recording operation, binds certificates by a system and updates a database, monitors the commodity in real time by means of YOLOv algorithm, monitors abnormality by means of the light self-adaption, multi-view fusion and other algorithms when the user loses the certificate, searches for the lost commodity, combines multiple camera images to accurately position the commodity, effectively aims at complex environment while reducing hardware and maintenance cost, greatly improves image recognition accuracy and efficiency, improves user experience and commodity storage safety, and has wide application prospect.

title: Network state inference and HTTP fuzzy test method based on large model
description: The present invention relates to a network state inference and HTTP protocol fuzzy testing method based on a large model, and belongs to the field of network security technology. The method includes steps such as data collection and preprocessing, large model training and optimization, network state inference, etc.; the HTTP protocol is fuzz tested using the large model, including test case generation, test execution and monitoring, vulnerability detection and reporting, etc.; complex test cases are constructed through the generation capability of the large model, and the test coverage is improved in combination with the mutation strategy. The method improves the security of the HTTP protocol and the efficiency of vulnerability detection by combining the intelligent inference capability of the large model with the fuzzy testing technology.

title: Quantum computing device and quantum computer
description: A quantum computing device (1) is described, the quantum computing device (1) comprising: a permanent magnet device (2); and a space (5) within the permanent magnet device (2) for at least two trapped quantum particles (6), the at least two trapped quantum particles (6) being arranged along a first axis (7), wherein the permanent magnet device (2) comprises a plurality of segments (3), namely at least four segments (3), each segment (3) having a magnetization direction (4), the magnetization directions (4) of the at least four segments (3) being different from each other, thereby establishing a magnetic field having a strength that varies along the first axis (7). In addition, a quantum computer (8) comprising the quantum computing device (1) is described.

title: Neural network learning diagnosis method based on cognitive load enhancement answer process step-by-step modeling
description: The present invention belongs to the field of educational data mining, and provides a neural network learning diagnosis method based on step-by-step modeling of the answering process with cognitive load enhancement, including a cognitive attribute extraction stage, a cognitive attribute interaction stage, a cognitive load enhancement stage, and a diagnostic analysis stage, making full use of the reaction process data in the student answering record, introducing cognitive load into the model for the first time as a new attribute affecting the student's answering result, using LSTM to model the student's answering process step by step and using the attention mechanism to fuse the student's attributes with the exercise attributes, thereby realizing the transmission of temporal information. The method of the present invention models the student's answering steps step by step through a long short-term memory network, and makes full use of the reaction process data in the student's answering record to characterize the student's cognitive load and integrate it into the cognitive diagnosis model, thereby improving the accuracy and effectiveness of the model diagnosis.

title: Behavior recognition method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a behavior recognition method, device, equipment and storage medium, which comprise the steps of obtaining a plurality of video frames in a video to be processed, obtaining skeleton sequence data of an object to be recognized in the video frames by utilizing a preset gesture estimation network, extracting motion characteristics of the object to be recognized from the video frames by utilizing a graph neural network according to the skeleton sequence data and joint point priori topological connection structures corresponding to different preset behaviors, extracting visual characteristics of the object to be recognized and an object interacted with the object to be recognized from the video frames, fusing the motion characteristics and the visual characteristics into multi-modal behavior characteristics, and performing behavior recognition on the object to be recognized according to the multi-modal behavior characteristics to obtain a behavior recognition result. The invention can improve the accuracy and the effectiveness of behavior identification.

title: Intelligent optical fiber detection system and method
description: A method and a system for detecting optical fiber faults with wavelength selection belong to the technical field of optical communication monitoring. The method adopts a multi-wavelength OTDR (optical time domain reflectometer) technology, analyzes OTDR echo signals with different wavelengths through an AI module, intelligently selects the wavelength most suitable for detecting the faults of the specific type of optical fiber, and improves the detection precision and efficiency. The invention can analyze historical data by utilizing a machine learning algorithm, optimize a wavelength use strategy and generate a comprehensive optical fiber state report by combining multi-wavelength measurement data. The invention can obviously improve the intelligent level of the optical fiber fault detection, and is particularly suitable for the maintenance and management of a large-scale optical fiber network.

title: Reading management method and device for electronic document
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of electronic document management, and discloses an electronic document reading management method, including the following steps: S1, a document information entropy calculation step, analyzing the text content of the electronic document based on the information entropy calculation method to determine the complexity of different contents; S2, a user behavior data collection step, collecting the user's scrolling, staying, returning, highlighting and note-taking behavior data when reading the electronic document, and also provides an electronic document reading management device, including: a document information entropy calculation module, used to calculate the complexity of the electronic document text and set the reading weight; a user behavior monitoring module, used to collect user reading behavior data. The present invention optimizes recommendation sorting through reinforcement learning, temperature parameter regulation exploration and utilization balance, time decay mechanism dynamically adjusts interest preferences, and interactive recommendation enhances user control sense, so as to achieve more intelligent, efficient and personalized reading management.

title: Toothbrush partition calibration method, tooth brushing area determination method and related device
description: The application discloses a toothbrush partition calibration method, a toothbrush area determination method and a related device, wherein the toothbrush partition calibration method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of sample data, wherein each sample data comprises a label of a first tooth area and first data corresponding to the first tooth area, the first data are collected by a sensor of a toothbrush in the process that a user brushes the first tooth area by using the toothbrush, the plurality of first tooth areas respectively contained in the plurality of sample data are obtained by partitioning the toothbrush area, and a toothbrush partition model is calibrated by adopting the plurality of sample data. The embodiment of the application can calibrate the tooth brushing partition model by utilizing the collected first data so as to enable the tooth brushing partition model to be more suitable for the user, thereby being beneficial to improving the accuracy of the tooth brushing partition model in predicting the tooth brushing area of the user.

title: Production line fault identification method based on BiLSTM-Logistic regression
description: The present invention discloses a production line fault identification method based on BiLSTM-Logistic regression, and belongs to the technical field of industrial fault diagnosis. The present invention comprises the following steps: determining characteristic parameters characterizing the operation of the production line, respectively collecting data of each characteristic parameter at different times under different working conditions; constructing a sample set and a time series data set; constructing a fault identification model, the fault identification model comprises a parallel BiLSTM network unit and a Logistic regression model, the two extract features from the time series data set and the sample set respectively, and the extracted features are spliced as the input of the SVM classifier; training the fault identification model and using it to predict production line faults. The present invention utilizes the BiLSTM network structure to mine the long-term and short-term time series dependencies of the data, and utilizes the logistic regression model to perform rapid explicit modeling of non-time series features, avoiding excessive smoothing of structured data by the deep model, and the parallel outputs of the two are classified by the SVM classifier, with good recall effect and high precision, and can efficiently identify production line faults.

title: Prediction method, device and model training method for growth part of tobacco product raw material
description: The disclosure relates to a method and a device for predicting growth parts of tobacco product raw materials and a training method of a prediction model, and relates to the technical field of tobacco production. The method comprises the steps of obtaining thermal weight loss analysis data and chemical composition data of a tobacco product raw material, wherein the thermal weight loss analysis data comprise a plurality of pyrolysis temperatures of a pyrolysis process of the tobacco product raw material and mass change rates corresponding to each pyrolysis temperature, the chemical composition data comprise content of each chemical composition in the plurality of chemical compositions in the tobacco product raw material, determining characteristic data comprising characteristic temperatures and mass change rates corresponding to the characteristic temperatures in the plurality of pyrolysis temperatures from the thermal weight loss analysis data, and predicting growth positions of the tobacco product raw material by utilizing a trained prediction model based on at least one parameter of the characteristic temperatures and the mass change rates corresponding to the characteristic temperatures and the chemical composition data. According to the technical scheme, the prediction accuracy of the growth part of the tobacco product raw material can be improved.

title: Visual perception interaction system and method based on AI scene understanding
description: The present invention discloses a visual perception interaction system and method based on AI scene understanding, which belongs to the field of augmented reality technology. The system captures the user environment in real time through an image sensor, combines a convolutional neural network (CNN) to perform feature extraction and target detection, quantifies the scene complexity, and dynamically adjusts the brightness, contrast and display parameters of the AR device. The core modules include complexity analysis, adaptive brightness/contrast adjustment, user feedback optimization and global scoring. By calculating the image entropy value, standard deviation and user score, the system optimizes the display effect in real time and improves the user's visual clarity and comfort. The present invention solves the problem of poor adaptability of AR display in complex environments, significantly enhances the quality of human eye perception, and is suitable for virtual reality, autonomous driving and other fields.

title: AIGC-based animation generation method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of animation generation, in particular to an animation generation method based on AIGC. The method comprises the steps of inputting texts corresponding to story outlines and optimal prompt words into a script generation model, outputting script texts, respectively constructing a semantic relation diagram and a spatial relation diagram based on phrase features and object region features, calculating the similarity of text images according to an integration result, judging whether the similarity exceeds a preset similarity threshold, outputting a pre-generated scene image if the similarity exceeds the preset similarity threshold, inputting the pre-generated scene image into an animation generation model, outputting an initial animation video, adopting the optimal prompt words to combine to generate the sound effect and background music of the initial animation video, and automatically editing and deriving the generated animation to obtain a final animation file. The invention can obviously improve the efficiency and quality of animation creation, reduce the manufacturing cost, has high customization and expandability, and can be personalized customized and expanded according to the demands and the favorites of users.

title: Water resource demand optimization method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The present invention discloses a method for optimizing water resource demand based on deep reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of water resource management, including: obtaining raw data and real-time data; preprocessing the raw data; extracting parameters of extreme climate events according to the raw data, and generating extreme scene data of several disturbance scenes based on a pre-trained environmental simulator according to historical climate data and parameters of extreme climate events, training a preset DQN-based deep reinforcement learning model according to an optimized training set, the network architecture of the DQN-based deep reinforcement learning model is CNN, optimizing the DQN-based deep reinforcement learning model with a multi-objective reinforcement learning strategy, obtaining a trained DQN-based deep reinforcement learning model, inputting real-time climate data into the trained DQN-based deep reinforcement learning model, and outputting real-time optimized regional water resource demand data. The present invention significantly improves the decision-making efficiency and accuracy of water resource demand optimization.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for processing clue data of attack event
description: The present invention discloses a method, device, equipment and medium for processing clue data of attack events. The method includes: regularly acquiring clue data within a preset time period; each clue data is log layer clue data or alarm layer clue data; aggregating each clue data according to the generation time to obtain multiple attack event trees; each attack event tree is composed of clue data belonging to the same attack event; aggregating each attack event tree according to path information, identification information and time information to obtain one or more attack event forests; each attack event forest is composed of attack event trees belonging to the same attack path; and providing each attack event forest to a target user. The embodiment of the present invention can regularly aggregate the clue data of attack events, aggregate the clue data belonging to the same attack event, and aggregate the clue data of attack events belonging to the same attack path.

title: Knowledge-guided dynamic expression method for urban physical examination scene
description: The invention provides a knowledge-guided urban physical examination scene dynamic expression method, which comprises the steps of obtaining business demand data of a target city based on space-time data of the target city, constructing a scene knowledge graph according to the space-time data and the business demand data of the target city, analyzing the space-time data and the scene knowledge graph of the target city to obtain an analysis result, recombining the analysis result guided by combining semantic constraint and graphic primitive combination, driving scene generation and updating by means of scene narrative logic to obtain an urban physical examination scene, enhancing object semantics in the urban physical examination scene in a dynamic and static combination mode to obtain an enhanced urban physical examination scene, and carrying out data priority scheduling presentation on the enhanced urban physical examination scene to obtain a dynamic expression result of the urban physical examination scene.

title: Method for managing crops on red soil sloping field
description: The invention relates to the technical field of crop management, in particular to a red soil sloping field crop management method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining crop data, surrounding environment data and soil data corresponding to crops planted in a target red soil sloping field region, identifying the crop data and the soil data, determining the current drought grade corresponding to the crops, identifying the crop data, determining the current insect disease type and the current insect disease grade corresponding to the crops, determining drought grade reasons and insect disease grade reasons corresponding to the crops based on the surrounding environment data and the soil data, outputting an irrigation strategy based on the current drought grade and the drought grade reasons, and outputting pest control measures corresponding to the crops based on the current insect disease type, the current insect disease grade and the current insect disease grade reasons. The method realizes comprehensive, scientific and accurate management of the crops on the red soil sloping field, improves the efficiency, and saves the time cost and the labor cost.

title: A data processing method, device, storage medium and computer equipment
description: The present application provides a data processing method, device, storage medium and computer equipment, the method comprising: traversing the data to be processed according to the rules of convolution calculation, encoding the initial digital domain signal corresponding to the sub-data currently traversed into a first light domain signal for the sub-data; inputting the first light domain signal into an optical neural network for convolution processing and nonlinear processing to obtain a second light domain signal of the sub-data; the convolution kernel weights used in the convolution processing are characterized by the optical constant values of the phase change materials in each storage-computation integrated unit set in the optical neural network; converting the second light domain signals corresponding to each sub-data obtained by traversal into target digital domain signals and inputting them into a classification neural network to obtain classification results. The present application breaks through the limitations of existing optical neural networks in terms of power consumption and depth, has the advantages of high efficiency, low latency, and scalability, and is suitable for edge intelligent computing scenarios for tasks such as image classification.

title: Metabolic aging identification model construction system, storage medium and kit
description: The present invention provides a metabolic aging recognition model construction system, storage medium and kit. Through machine learning of age and plasma metabolite biomarkers, a metabolic aging recognition model is obtained. The metabolic age calculated by the model shows excellent sensitivity, specificity and accuracy in predicting the risk of all-cause mortality, which exceeds the actual age itself. Experiments have confirmed that it can intuitively reflect the acceleration of metabolic aging by comparison with the actual age. The present invention only requires a small amount of plasma as a test sample, the evaluation process is simple and convenient, the cost is low, it is easy to be accepted by the subjects, and it is suitable for large-scale promotion of the method. And the high sensitivity and specificity enable it to be used in the screening of anti-aging drugs.

title: Hydrothermal power generation system scheduling optimization method based on transfer learning and GAN
description: The invention discloses a hydro-thermal power generation system dispatching optimization method based on transfer learning and GAN, which is characterized in that when the current power demand is the second power demand, the hydro-thermal power generation system dispatching is carried out by combining a dispatching scheme population generated randomly with an optimized dispatching scheme population of the previous power demand, the optimized dispatching scheme population of the current power demand is obtained based on a non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm, when the current power demand is the third or more power demands, experience of the historical optimized dispatching scheme population is extracted based on the idea of transfer learning, a new dispatching scheme population with historical experience is generated by combining generation of an opposing network GAN and standard normal distribution, and the optimized dispatching scheme population of the current power demand is obtained through fusion and the non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm.

title: Porcelain pattern generation method, system, equipment and medium based on user requirements
description: The present invention relates to artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a method and device for generating porcelain patterns based on user needs, including: performing semantic analysis on the user's pattern generation demand text to obtain demand semantics, screening a preferred pattern set from a pattern material library according to the demand semantics, obtaining a modified feedback text of a first pattern selected by the user in the preferred pattern set, and performing semantic analysis to obtain feedback semantics, using a pattern generation model to generate a second pattern according to the first pattern and feedback semantics, judging whether the second pattern meets the user's requirements according to the user's feedback result on the second pattern, if not, adjusting the hyperparameters of the pattern generation model, reusing the pattern generation model to generate the second pattern, and confirming that the second pattern is the final pattern if it meets the requirements. The present invention also proposes a porcelain pattern generation device, electronic device, and storage medium based on user needs. The present invention can improve the generation efficiency of porcelain patterns.

title: MIMO radar mutual coupling error and DOA joint estimation method based on energy valley-compressed sensing
description: The invention discloses a method for jointly estimating MIMO radar mutual coupling errors and DOA based on energy valley-compressed sensing. According to the method, under a compressed sensing design framework, the problem of poor accuracy of target angle identification caused by mutual coupling errors of an array model of the MIMO radar is solved, different disturbance strategies are introduced into an EVO algorithm, and weighting and subspace filtering operations are introduced into a CS signal reconstruction process, so that the EVO-CS algorithm is improved, the algorithm can obtain a global optimal solution to the greatest extent, meanwhile, the robustness of the algorithm under severe conditions such as low signal-to-noise ratio is enhanced, the applicability of the compressed sensing algorithm in the MIMO radar is widened, and the solving capability of the compressed sensing algorithm in realizing target angle positioning in the MIMO radar scene is improved and improved. The example shows that the method can realize more accurate mutual coupling error coefficient and DOA estimation result, has stronger global optimizing capability and highest estimation accuracy, and effectively enhances the detection performance of the MIMO radar system for identifying the space target.

title: Flood monitoring method, flood monitoring device, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
description: The application provides a flood monitoring method, a flood monitoring device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the flood monitoring method comprises the steps of obtaining digital elevation data, multispectral image data and time sequence Sentinel-1 data of a flood occurrence area, determining terrain features according to the digital elevation data, selecting a plurality of water body sample areas and non-water body sample areas from the multispectral image data as training samples, performing image segmentation on the Sentinel-1 data by utilizing a multi-resolution segmentation algorithm for each Sentinel-1 data to obtain image segmentation results, extracting polarization band features, texture features, water body index features and time SAR features of the Sentinel-1 data, taking the features as input of an initial random forest model, and training the initial random forest model by utilizing the training samples so that the trained random forest model has the capability of distinguishing the water body areas from the non-water body areas in the Sentinel-1 data. By the method, the monitoring precision of flood is improved.

title: A full-ear capacitor control system and method for AI servers
description: The invention discloses a full-tab capacitance regulation and control system and method for an AI server, which relate to the technical field of data analysis, and are used for receiving information content uploaded by a user in a terminal system, extracting characteristic parameters of the information content, normalizing and constructing characteristic vectors, constructing training samples by utilizing the characteristic vectors and operation grades, training a random forest model to predict the operation grades, setting training periods to form training sample triplets, constructing a double-channel neural network fusion extraction characteristic based on LSTM and GRU, adopting a maximum likelihood estimation optimization model, generating a capacitance state training set and training a capacitance state prediction model, constructing a digital twin system to simulate capacitance behaviors, outputting multidimensional operation indexes, collecting a capacitance state vector of a target sampling period, predicting future capacitance states by combining a plurality of candidate motion vectors, screening characteristic actions according to thresholds, and determining a final regulation instruction, thereby improving response speed.

title: A ray tracing positioning method and system for VR large-space immersive tour
description: The present invention discloses a ray tracing positioning method and system for VR large-space immersive tours, wherein the method comprises: collecting scene parameters in a VR large space and generating training data; processing the training data to obtain processed data; inputting the processed data into a constructed ray tracing positioning model, and outputting ray tracing positioning results. The present invention effectively solves the problems of large amount of calculation and sensitivity to scene changes in traditional positioning methods in complex scenes by combining deep learning models with ray tracing technology. The method utilizes a network structure combining a convolutional neural network and a recurrent neural network, which can efficiently extract spatial features and time series features, and focuses on key light paths with the help of an attention mechanism, significantly improving positioning accuracy and the generalization ability of the model.

title: Waste removal vehicle route optimization method and related products based on the Internet of Things
description: The invention relates to the technical fields of transportation, internet of things and environmental protection, in particular to a waste clearing and transporting vehicle path optimization method based on the Internet of things and related products, wherein the method comprises the following steps of generating a reference access block according to a waste clearing and transporting period; the method comprises the steps of generating first waste access information according to a reference access block, generating second waste access information according to the access degree of freedom, destroying and repairing the first waste access information and the second waste access information to obtain third waste access information, and selecting a waste clearing vehicle path according to waste clearing vehicle path costs corresponding to the first waste access information, the second waste access information and the third waste access information. The method reduces the cost of the waste clearing vehicle path and improves the calculation efficiency of the waste clearing vehicle path.

title: A method and system for selecting text results generated by multiple models
description: The present application discloses a method and system for selecting text results generated by multiple models, which involves large model technology, including: obtaining text generated by multiple models as a candidate text set; calculating multiple shared credible text features for the text in the candidate text set; constructing a decision tree model for weight calculation of the value of each credible text feature, and dividing it according to the calculated weight according to the preset classification standard to obtain the importance index of each credible feature; using the importance index as the weight, weighting the credible text features to obtain text quality parameters; according to the result of the weighted processing, determining the text with the highest text quality parameter as the final output. The method of the present application deeply mines text features, directly performs calculation and evaluation at the feature level, and well distinguishes the quality scores of texts of different qualities.

title: Methods for identifying minors on social platforms
description: The invention relates to the technical field of social platform safety wind control, and provides a social platform minor identification method. The invention optimizes two points, namely, the first point is to introduce a large model to identify chat content of a user, compared with keyword capture, semantic-based understanding precision is higher, identification misjudgment is reduced, the second point is to introduce a deep neural network model of audio identification of minors, recall of potential minors of a platform is enlarged, audio judgment is more visual, precision is higher, and recall rate and precision are improved greatly.

title: Intelligent medical wastewater treatment and monitoring integrated system
description: The invention discloses an intelligent medical wastewater treatment and monitoring integrated system. In the invention, a Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm is integrated, a Gaussian kernel function is utilized for model training, and the complexity and training error of the model are effectively balanced and the accuracy of anomaly detection is improved by solving the optimization problem and introducing L2 regularization. The SVM algorithm is excellent in performance when processing high-dimensional data, can accurately identify abnormal modes in the data, and provides powerful support for early warning of potential problems. The early warning mechanism enables the system to timely find and treat abnormal conditions in the medical wastewater treatment process, prevents pollution accidents, and guarantees environmental and public health safety. Meanwhile, the data analysis module helps a decision maker to make a more scientific and reasonable treatment strategy and emergency measures, and the intelligent level and management efficiency of the whole intelligent medical wastewater treatment and monitoring integrated system are further improved.

title: Offshore wind farm identification method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiments of the present disclosure provide an offshore wind farm identification method, apparatus, device, and storage medium, which are applied to the field of machine learning technology. The method includes obtaining an offshore remote sensing image to be identified, and then obtaining a slice image of the offshore wind farm to be identified; the slice image of the offshore wind farm to be identified is obtained by slicing the offshore remote sensing image to be identified; the slice image of the offshore wind farm to be identified is input into a pre-trained offshore wind farm recognition model to obtain the image coordinates of the recognition frame corresponding to the slice image of the offshore wind farm to be identified; the recognition frame is used to identify the identified offshore wind farm; the offshore wind farm recognition model is constructed based on the YOLOv8 model and the C3K2 model; the image coordinates are converted into geographic coordinates to obtain the location information and quantity information of the offshore wind farm corresponding to the offshore remote sensing image to be identified. In this way, high-precision and high-efficiency fully automatic recognition of offshore wind farms can be achieved.

title: Deep learning model training method and system
description: The present application discloses a method and system for training a deep learning model. The method comprises: obtaining a training sample set and a sample label set of a deep learning model; for each training batch in the iterative training process, determining the floating-point results and integer results obtained by the deep learning model when analyzing each training sample in the training batch, determining the correction step size corresponding to each training sample based on the floating-point results and integer results, and correcting the integer result corresponding to each training sample based on the correction step size; constructing a loss function based on the sample labels and corrected integer results corresponding to each of the multiple training samples in the training batch, and adjusting the model parameters of the deep learning model based on the loss function. The present application solves the technical problem that the related art does not consider the quantization error corresponding to different output results when correcting the model output results, resulting in poor model performance.

title: A collaborative control method for building energy systems
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of building energy management, and provides a collaborative regulation and control method of a building energy system, which comprises the steps of obtaining dynamic response characteristics of a heterogeneous energy subsystem, constructing a characteristic matrix and determining a response system group with highest coupling contribution degree through cross-correlation analysis; the method comprises the steps of constructing a load mutation model based on historical data and a genetic algorithm, simulating a periodic step load scene, evaluating the degree of cooperative response mismatch among subsystems, performing correlation analysis on communication protocol isomerism, identifying dominant mismatch factors and classifying by using a random forest algorithm, and finally dynamically constructing a compensation strategy aiming at the dominant mismatch of physical characteristics, and sensing and inhibiting ripple diffusion effect of the load mutation through a state equation and recursive filtering. The invention realizes the cooperative regulation and control among the subsystems of the building energy system, and improves the robustness of the system to the load mutation and the energy utilization efficiency.

title: An intelligent decision-making method for bill discounting based on price comparison model
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent decision-making method for bill discounting based on a price comparison model, which relates to the financial field. The method comprises the following steps: step 1: deploying an intelligently optimized lightweight crawler to crawl bill text messages from multiple sources, parsing and extracting key semantic tags through a deeply fine-tuned BERT model, and mapping them into structured data; step 2: constructing a multi-dimensional risk indicator system, performing dimensionality reduction through PCA, dividing risk intervals using DPC and decision tree algorithms, and clarifying the risk status of the bill; step 3: according to different risk intervals, respectively adopting a low-risk linear regression enhancement model, a medium-risk random forest ensemble model, and a high-risk LSTM-attention model to output recommended interest rates and influencing factor weights; step 4: using a dual-loop dynamic threshold self-calibration mechanism, combining macro indicators to adjust the Pareto search optimal threshold, and perform dynamic risk-return balance.

title: Intelligent textile workshop management and control platform and method based on big data driving
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent textile workshop management and control, and discloses an intelligent textile workshop management and control platform and method based on big data driving, wherein the method comprises the steps of matching a to-be-produced task sequence with a historical task and extracting operation data of the historical task; preprocessing operation data to construct a multidimensional information feature space containing basic features and derivative features; based on the production task to be arranged and the feature space, the production sequence of the production task is dynamically optimized through a weighted heuristic genetic algorithm to generate a new production sequence.

title: Wire harness testing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The application relates to the technical field of wire harness detection, and provides a wire harness testing method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of acquiring and preprocessing multi-dimensional electrical characteristic parameters of a target wire harness sample to obtain a standardized electrical parameter matrix, carrying out thermal conduction analysis by combining a dynamic thermal field model to obtain a temperature distribution tensor, carrying out multi-physical field coupling mechanical stress analysis on the temperature distribution tensor to obtain strain energy density field data, carrying out space-time data fusion on the standardized electrical parameter matrix, the temperature distribution tensor and the strain energy density field data, carrying out deep residual error network classification on the fused multi-mode characteristic matrix by combining a depth network model, and carrying out dynamic Bayesian network reasoning to obtain life prediction data and maintenance information. According to the application, life prediction and maintenance decision are realized through multidimensional electrical parameter acquisition, multi-physical field modeling and deep learning reasoning, so that the accuracy, efficiency and reliability of wire harness detection are improved.

title: Electric power edge heterogeneous fusion discharge identification method and system based on visual primitives
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of partial discharge identification, and discloses a method and a system for identifying electric power edge heterogeneous fusion discharge based on visual primitives, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting visual primitive data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a target detection model, inputting visual primitive data into the target detection model to detect the GIS partial discharge position and category of the gas insulated metal-enclosed switchgear by using the target detection model, storing the visual primitive data when the GIS partial discharge is detected, performing visual reconstruction as visual primitive data to be reconstructed, outputting a reconstruction result, and mapping the category and the reconstruction result to obtain an image with the GIS partial discharge detection result. By combining an advanced hardware acquisition technology and a deep learning algorithm, the GIS partial discharge is efficiently and accurately identified. The GIS equipment management method has the advantages of being accurate, real-time, light in weight, intuitive and the like, and provides powerful technical support for maintenance and safety management of the GIS equipment.

title: Machine learning-based giant infant risk prediction method and system
description: The application discloses a machine learning-based giant infant risk prediction method which comprises the following steps of S1, multi-mode clinical data acquisition, S2, data preprocessing, S3, multi-algorithm model training and optimization, S4, model evaluation and selection, namely, evaluating the performance of each model based on accuracy, precision, recall rate, AUC and a calibration curve, selecting a model with optimal comprehensive performance as a target prediction model, S5, risk prediction and interpretation, namely, inputting a sample to be predicted into the target prediction model, outputting a giant infant risk prediction result, and quantifying contribution degree of each feature to the prediction result by a SHapley addition interpretation (SHAP) method. Through the deep fusion of machine learning and clinical multi-modal data, the technical problems of single dimension, insufficient interpretation and poor adaptability of a base layer in the existing method are solved, and a high-precision, interpretable and easy-to-operate solution is provided for the risk prediction of the infants.

title: Wind tunnel valve vibration signal fault early warning device and method based on edge calculation
description: The invention discloses a wind tunnel valve vibration signal fault early warning device and method based on edge calculation, comprising the following steps of obtaining structural parameters of a wind tunnel valve to construct a finite element simulation model, simulating and collecting vibration signals in the operation of the valve, and combining measured data to form a training data set; and training the obtained component energy characteristics based on the CNN-LSTM self-encoder neural network model, establishing a mapping relation between the vibration signal energy distribution and fault characteristics, and realizing fault prediction. Compared with the prior art, the method combines finite element simulation with actual signal analysis, and through the embedded lightweight neural network model, the accuracy and the instantaneity of fault diagnosis are remarkably improved, and the safety and the reliability of wind tunnel valve operation are improved.

title: Heterogeneous pneumatic fusion method embedded with dimension-reducing physical characteristics
description: The present invention discloses a heterogeneous aerodynamic fusion method embedded with dimensionality reduction physical features in the field of intelligent fluid mechanics technology, including the following steps: data preprocessing: filtering out outliers in the data and obtaining the gradient information at the distributed load points of the research object; data preparation: arranging aerodynamic state data and concentrated loads and distributed loads under the aerodynamic state, and setting sample sets and training sets of corresponding proportions; model training: constructing a heterogeneous multi-source fusion neural network and training it, and converging and verifying the accuracy; and model prediction: using the trained model to simultaneously predict concentrated loads, distributed loads, and pressure distribution information. The present invention is novel and effective. By fully utilizing the distributed load information ignored in the aerodynamic modeling process, the method extracts relevant physical information and integrates it into the model, thereby constructing a new neural network architecture that incorporates dimensionality reduction physical features, effectively reducing the model's dependence on samples, improving model accuracy, and reducing model uncertainty.

title: Knowledge graph fusion reasoning method and system for public policy case analysis
description: The application relates to the technical field of information data analysis. The method comprises the steps of generating standardized pretreatment data, extracting the standardized pretreatment data to generate a structured triplet set, processing the structured triplet set to generate a multi-dimensional knowledge graph, constructing a hybrid reasoning engine, processing the multi-dimensional knowledge graph to generate reasoning result data, performing incremental update processing on nodes and relations of the multi-dimensional knowledge graph, performing parameter optimization processing on the hybrid reasoning engine to generate an updated knowledge graph and an optimized reasoning engine, processing the reasoning result data, and outputting a visual analysis result to solve the problem that the rule engine is limited in causal reasoning, the problem that a large language model is fuzzy in semantics and logic illusion in the policy field, and the problem that the single-field knowledge graph is insufficient in cross-field interaction influence disclosure.

title: Abnormal defect detection application for generating and discriminating task based on diffusion model
description: The present invention provides an abnormal defect detection application based on a diffusion model for generation and discrimination tasks, comprising the following steps: obtaining a standard sample for detection; using a diffusion anomaly generation module to perform forward diffusion processing and introduce perturbations on the standard sample to generate an abnormal sample, and calculating the diffusion loss function of the diffusion anomaly generation module; using a diffusion discrimination module to capture the difference between the abnormal sample and the standard sample, and identifying and locating the abnormal area based on the probability distribution, while calculating the difference loss function of the diffusion discrimination module; using a probability optimization module to optimize the probability distribution of the generated abnormal sample, and calculating the optimization loss function of the probability optimization module; designing a comprehensive loss function that integrates the diffusion loss function, the difference loss function, and the optimization loss function to weigh the contributions of the diffusion anomaly generation module, the diffusion discrimination module, and the probability optimization module to obtain a detection algorithm score. In this invention, the diffusion model is used to improve the detection accuracy of abnormal defects.

title: Network attack prediction method and device based on graph neural network, terminal equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a network attack prediction method, a device, a terminal device and a storage medium based on a graph neural network, which belong to the technical field of network security, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining an attack event log of an attack event received by a current power grid system, and determining attack time, attack frequency, attack source, attack target, attack step time corresponding to each attack step and attack step frequency; and finally, inputting the attack graph and the attack graph characteristics into a preset attack prediction model, and predicting to obtain a next attack prediction target and a corresponding attack prediction path. By implementing the method and the device, the problem that damage to a power grid system is increased due to the fact that potential attack targets and attack paths in the power grid cannot be predicted, and then attack blocking is realized in advance can be solved.

title: Active distribution network disturbance source positioning method and system based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for positioning disturbance sources of an active distribution network based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the technical field of intelligent power distribution systems. The method and the system for positioning the disturbance source of the active distribution network based on the artificial intelligence comprise the steps of S1 data acquisition and preprocessing, S2 simulation-data fusion model construction, S3 interpretability module design, S4 positioning analysis and improvement of diversity and authenticity of simulation data by constructing a finer simulation model and simulating more actual scenes. The field self-adaptive technology is introduced, so that the distribution difference between simulation data and measured data is reduced. The light 1D-CNN model and the self-adaptive learning rate adjustment strategy are adopted, so that the model training speed is accelerated, and the calculation resource consumption is reduced. And the semi-automatic labeling method and the field self-adaptive technology are adopted, so that dependence on a large amount of actually measured labeling data is reduced. By introducing methods such as a spatial attention mechanism, decision tree integration and the like, the interpretability of the model is improved from multiple angles.

title: Large model parameter optimization and self-adaptive adjustment method and device based on reinforcement learning
