description: The invention relates to the technical field of large model optimization and discloses a large model parameter optimization and self-adaptive adjustment method and device based on reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the current running state of a target large model, and comprehensively evaluating the running state of the target large model by combining data characteristics to obtain a running state vector; the method comprises the steps of constructing an intelligent body, inputting an operation state vector into the intelligent body to obtain a parameter optimization strategy, optimizing parameters of a target large model based on the parameter optimization strategy to obtain an optimized large model, calculating a plurality of preset indexes of the optimized large model by using a reward function to serve as a reward result, and adaptively adjusting the parameters of the intelligent body based on the reward result. In training and practical application, the large model is dynamically adjusted by the intelligent agent, so that the rapid convergence in the early stage of training is ensured, the global optimal solution can be accurately approximated in the later stage, the training efficiency and quality are effectively improved, the intelligent agent is enabled to adaptively adjust parameters by means of a reward mechanism, and the generalization capability of the large model is improved.

title: 3D target detection method, system, device and medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of point cloud image analysis, in particular to a 3D target detection method, system, device and medium, which comprises the steps of firstly voxelizing and gridding points in target point cloud data to obtain grid voxelized point cloud, then screening foreground points in the grid voxelized point cloud, carrying out differential attention processing, downsampling processing and foreground point updating marking processing for a plurality of times after feature dimension conversion to obtain multi-scale foreground point cloud features, locking an interested region based on the multi-scale foreground point cloud features, sampling key points, converging different range neighborhood features, splicing and fusing the multi-dimensional features through channels, and then converging and splicing the features of the interested region to obtain 3D target to-be-detected features, finally carrying out target detection processing on the 3D target to-be-detected features to obtain detection results, and being applied to the 3D target detection field based on the point cloud image analysis, thereby having high efficiency and robustness, improving detection precision and enhancing adaptability to complex environments.

title: Fault diagnosis method, system, equipment and medium for power transmission and transformation equipment
description: The invention discloses a power transmission and transformation equipment fault diagnosis method, system, equipment and medium, which comprise the steps of obtaining multi-mode diagnosis data of power transmission and transformation equipment, wherein the multi-mode diagnosis data comprise vibration diagnosis data and acoustic diagnosis data, inputting the vibration diagnosis data and the acoustic diagnosis data into a preset fault diagnosis model, the preset fault diagnosis model comprises a first fault diagnosis channel and a second fault diagnosis channel, generating a first fault diagnosis result based on the vibration diagnosis data through the first fault diagnosis channel, generating a second fault diagnosis result based on the acoustic diagnosis data through the second fault diagnosis channel, and generating a fault diagnosis result corresponding to the power transmission and transformation equipment based on the first fault diagnosis result and the second fault diagnosis result. The invention not only remarkably improves the accuracy and reliability of fault detection, but also solves the problems of low diagnosis precision and insufficient efficiency caused by the traditional method depending on specific test conditions.

title: Ecological environment prediction system and method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of ecological environment prediction, in particular to an ecological environment prediction system and method, the comprehensiveness, the precision and the practicability of ecological environment prediction are obviously improved by adopting artificial intelligence technologies such as a transducer architecture neural network model and the like through multisource data fusion, dynamic space-time modeling, cross-modal collaborative optimization, space-time deep learning, multi-modal learning and self-adaptive optimization.

title: Controllable digital human real-time interaction system based on multi-mode sensor
description: The invention discloses a controllable digital human real-time interaction system based on a multi-modal sensor, which relates to the technical field of digital human, and comprises a multi-modal sensor data acquisition module, a multi-modal feature extraction module, an intention understanding module, a digital human interaction output module and a digital human interaction output module, wherein the multi-modal sensor data acquisition module is used for capturing user interaction videos, acquiring user interaction voice signals, acquiring user temperature and distance between a user and equipment, the multi-modal feature extraction module comprises a static feature extraction unit and a dynamic feature extraction unit, the multi-modal fusion module is used for analyzing the credibility of each information source in a current task, judging the importance of each information source, comprehensively considering, dynamically adjusting weight distribution, fusing multi-modal feature data, the intention understanding module is used for understanding the user interaction intention by using a large language model LLM based on the fused features and context, and the digital human interaction output module is used for generating open-domain text replies based on the user interaction intention, and finally realizing digital human multi-modal fusion interaction output.

title: Multi-source heterogeneous geographic data processing method based on depth fusion algorithm
description: This invention discloses a method for processing multi-source heterogeneous geographic data based on a deep fusion algorithm, comprising: collecting multi-source heterogeneous geographic data and writing them into a unified index library; performing coordinate base normalization, time series completion, and completeness-correctness joint verification to obtain standardized geographic data blocks; performing semantic-spatial joint matching to generate candidate cross-modal entity pairs; constructing a cross-modal attention network, extracting fusion features, and calculating posterior fusion confidence; selecting the fusion result with the highest confidence in each candidate cross-modal entity pair as the target geographic entity and generating a unique fusion identifier; and writing the target geographic entity with the unique fusion identifier into the fusion database to obtain a unified geographic entity dataset. This invention solves the problems of low data fusion quality, insufficient fusion process credibility, and difficulty in cross-modal feature matching in the prior art, thereby improving fusion accuracy, efficiency, and credibility.

title: Parameter estimation method based on data enhancement and related equipment
description: The present disclosure provides a parameter estimation method and related equipment based on data enhancement, which relate to the field of computer technology. The method includes obtaining low-frequency data, inserting auxiliary data points into the low-frequency data, and determining high-frequency data; determining a model function based on a target basis function; combining the model function with a sparse prior to determine the prior distribution of the model; combining the prior distribution with high-frequency data and noise variance to determine the joint posterior probability distribution of the model, wherein the joint posterior probability distribution includes each parameter of the model training; and determining the estimated value of each parameter based on the joint posterior probability distribution. The present application increases the sampling frequency of the data by inserting auxiliary data points and promotes the sparsity of the model by combining a sparse prior, and accurately estimates the values of the model parameters by sampling from the posterior distribution, thereby solving the problem of inaccurate parameters of the diffusion process training model caused by low-frequency data.

title: An intelligent writing support method and system based on semantic graph
description: The invention discloses an intelligent writing support method and system based on semantic graphs, which relate to the technical field of intelligent writing assistance, and are characterized in that writing is initiated, writing intention and context are determined, an initial context feature vector is generated, a basic semantic graph model containing nodes and relation weights is constructed, a real-time monitoring module is input for subsequent monitoring and adjustment, the real-time monitoring module analyzes user input, dynamically evaluates writing intention and context change, generates an intention-context state vector, transmits the intention-context state vector to a semantic graph dynamic processing module, triggers dynamic expansion and updating of the semantic graph, inputs the updated model into a writing suggestion generation module, generates personalized suggestions, optimizes the model by using a graph neural network algorithm and then outputs the model to the writing suggestion generation module, the writing suggestion generation module searches a knowledge path by using the updated model, determines writing thought and expansion direction, and combines audience information adaptation style and expression mode, and visually presents writing suggestion assistance.

title: A lightweight design method for new energy vehicle body frame based on digital twin
description: The invention discloses a new energy automobile body frame lightweight design method based on digital twinning, which relates to the technical field of new energy automobile body structure design and computer aided engineering simulation and comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a digital twinning body connected with a physical automobile body sensing system; and S2, dynamically dividing a simulation precision area of the vehicle body frame according to the dynamic precision topology network module, the dynamic precision topology network module and the real-time sensing data. According to the digital twin-based new energy automobile body frame lightweight design method, intelligent distribution of computing resources is achieved through a dynamic precision topological network, accurate prediction of a key structure is guaranteed, meanwhile, the computing burden of multi-physical field coupling simulation is effectively reduced, sharp contradictions among model precision, real-time response and optimization efficiency are effectively solved, and the lightweight design is enabled to achieve effective closed loop iteration under complex constraint conditions.

title: Information processing method and device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The present disclosure relates to an information processing method and apparatus, and a computer-readable storage medium, and relates to the field of computer technology. The information processing method includes: determining a service type based on user input; querying a knowledge base for service knowledge matching the user input based on the service type; and generating a service configuration plan based on the matching service knowledge using a machine learning model.

title: Image detection and recognition method, device and computer-readable storage medium
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of image detection and recognition, and relates to an image detection and recognition method, device and computer-readable storage medium; the method includes treating fundus image sample pairs in which the labels of the left fundus image and the right fundus image are the same as each other as a group of fundus image sample pairs, and assigning a new label to each group of fundus image sample pairs as its true label; inputting the left and right fundus images of the fundus image sample pairs into two feature extraction branches, outputting a first feature map and a second feature map; inputting the first feature map and the second feature map into two attention branches, outputting a first depth feature map and a second depth feature map; splicing the first depth feature map and the second depth feature map into a classification module, outputting a predicted label of the fundus image sample pair, calculating the value of the detection and recognition loss function and training the dual-branch feature extraction module, the dual-branch attention module and the classification module to obtain a trained fundus image detection and recognition model.

title: Broadcast transmitting signal optimizing method based on multi-antenna cooperation
description: The present invention relates to a broadcast transmission signal optimization method based on multi-antenna collaboration, comprising constructing a multi-antenna collaborative broadcast transmission system, including a central control unit, a distributed antenna array, an environment perception module, and a terminal feedback module; collecting real-time channel state information (CSI) through the environment perception module and constructing a dynamic propagation environment map; and optimizing the radiation pattern of the antenna array using a three-dimensional beamforming algorithm based on the propagation environment map. The present invention implements dynamic beamforming and power optimization through a multi-antenna collaborative broadcast transmission signal optimization method, adopts a collaborative architecture of a central control unit, a distributed antenna array, an environment perception module, and a terminal feedback module, significantly improves the coverage uniformity of the broadcast signal, reduces blind spots and overlapping interference areas, improves energy utilization efficiency, reduces energy waste caused by ineffective radiation, enhances the system's adaptability, and can respond to channel environment changes in real time.

title: Intelligent diagnosis method and system for battery faults of new energy automobile
description: The invention relates to the technical field of battery fault detection, and particularly discloses an intelligent diagnosis method and system for a new energy automobile battery fault, comprising the steps of collecting three-dimensional time sequence data streams of battery pack voltage, temperature and internal resistance through a distributed sensor array, and synchronously integrating environment temperature, charge and discharge cycle times and vehicle operation working condition parameters as auxiliary diagnosis dimensions to construct a multi-source heterogeneous data sensing system; the multi-dimensional time sequence data and auxiliary diagnosis parameters of the battery pack are comprehensively collected through the constructed multi-source heterogeneous data sensing system, a rich and accurate data basis is provided for fault diagnosis, noise interference is reduced through the dual-channel mixed filtering architecture and the self-adaptive filtering parameter adjustment mechanism, and a solid basis is laid for subsequent feature extraction and model training.

title: Topic propagation prediction method and system based on multidimensional feature fusion
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of network information dissemination prediction, and discloses a topic dissemination prediction method and system based on multidimensional feature fusion. The method comprises extracting multidimensional features, inputting the multidimensional features into the decoder layer of a Transformer for fusion, and constructing a prediction model to predict topic dissemination. The multidimensional features include user comprehensive influence, text sentiment features, temporal dynamic features, and user interaction behavior. The present invention significantly improves the accuracy of social network dissemination prediction through the coordinated optimization of three modules: dynamic user modeling, multimodal feature fusion, and intelligent time series analysis, achieving precise prediction of topic dissemination trends in social networks.

title: Machine learning-based radio frequency circuit and device-oriented de-embedding method and related equipment
description: The present invention discloses a de-embedding method for radio frequency circuits and devices based on machine learning and related equipment, wherein the method includes: designing a test structure and a structure to be predicted; establishing a parameterized model of the test structure and the structure to be predicted; performing parameter scanning or Monte Carlo analysis on the established test structure and the structure to be predicted model to generate a data set; establishing a neural network prediction model and training the model using the generated data set; inputting the measured data of the test structure into the trained neural network prediction model to output the measured data of the structure to be predicted; processing the measured data of the test structure and the structure to be predicted according to the type of the structure to be predicted to obtain the measured results of the DUT. The present invention learns the intrinsic mapping relationship between the test and structure data by training the neural network model, and can achieve high-frequency and high-precision de-embedding using a small number of calibration components. The method has a wide range of applicable scenarios and is not limited to specific circuit structures and processes.

title: Large language model time sequence prediction method and device based on integer decimal decomposition
description: The invention discloses a large language model time sequence prediction method and device based on integer decimal decomposition. The method comprises the steps of decomposing an integer part and a decimal part of each numerical value in time series data, extracting correlation features between the integer part and the decimal part to obtain feature representation, enabling the correlation features to be used for assisting residual understanding, enabling a time series mode of the time series data to be aligned with a text mode through a double cross attention mechanism to obtain mode alignment representation, fusing the time series data and the feature representation with the mode alignment representation to obtain final input features, and based on the final input features, utilizing reasoning in a large language model to output a prediction result. The invention solves the technical problem that the reasoning result of the large language model is not accurate enough.

title: PCB solder paste printing quality detection method and system based on image processing
description: The present invention relates to the field of image data processing technology, and more specifically to a method and system for detecting the quality of solder paste printing on a printed circuit board (PCB) based on image processing. The method comprises: acquiring a surface image of a PCB to be detected; filtering the surface image of the PCB to be detected using an improved anisotropic diffusion filtering algorithm to obtain a filtered surface image of the PCB; and identifying solder paste offset defects in the filtered surface image of the PCB based on a convolutional neural network. The improved anisotropic diffusion filtering algorithm includes a K value, which is the product of an initial K value and a correction coefficient, and the correction coefficient is positively correlated with the noise intensity and importance of each pixel in the PCB surface image. The present invention solves the problem of low detection accuracy of existing filtering algorithms.

title: Road and bridge construction measurement data processing method and system based on deep learning
description: This paper discloses a deep learning-based method and system for processing road and bridge construction measurement data. The system uses a GCN graph convolutional network to extract spatial topological features from point cloud data, an improved ResNet-50 to extract texture and structural features from image data, and an LSTM long short-term memory network to extract temporal features from sensor data. A multi-head self-attention mechanism is introduced to dynamically calculate the weights of different modal features. A VAE variational autoencoder is constructed based on fused feature vectors. Outliers are identified by reconstruction error and secondary verification is performed on these outliers using a bridge structural mechanics model. A GAN generative adversarial network is used to generate surrogate data for the outlier detection results, and Bayesian optimization is used to select the optimal correction scheme. This method improves data processing efficiency and outlier detection accuracy.

title: Data intelligent processing method and device applied to industrial communication intelligent platform
description: The invention discloses a data intelligent processing method and device applied to an industrial communication intelligent platform, and the method and device comprise the steps of obtaining data to be processed corresponding to communication equipment, determining a data calculation task through a preset heterogeneous calculation resource scheduling algorithm and the data to be processed, generating a data time sequence corresponding to all the data to be processed based on the data calculation task and all the data to be processed, executing data processing operation on all the data to be processed based on the data calculation task and the data time sequence to obtain a data processing result, analyzing the data processing result to obtain a data analysis result, generating a data optimization instruction corresponding to the communication equipment according to the data analysis result, and executing optimization operation matched with the data optimization instruction on the communication equipment. Therefore, the implementation of the invention can be beneficial to improving the intelligence and efficiency of data processing and improving the accuracy and reliability of data processing.

title: A vulnerability detection method based on xLSTM-ATT
description: The invention relates to the technical field of vulnerability detection, in particular to a vulnerability detection method based on xLSTM-ATT, which comprises the steps of preprocessing source codes, word segmentation, word list construction, word vector initialization and end-to-end updating in a training process by inputting a word vector index sequence into an embedded layer, extracting local and global time sequence features by inputting the word vector sequence into a feature extraction module, introducing an attention mechanism, carrying out linear mapping and activation on output of each time step, calculating attention score, normalizing to obtain attention weight, weighting and summing to generate context vectors, processing the context vectors, inputting the context vectors into a fully connected classifier, outputting prediction probability of various vulnerabilities, determining a vulnerability detection result according to the maximum probability or a threshold value, and utilizing the advantage of xLSTM in the aspect of extracting deep semantic information of a long sequence by combining the attention mechanism to automatically focus key parts in codes so as to capture and accurately position complex vulnerability features.

title: A real-time design method for laser cutting machine tools based on digital twin
description: The invention relates to the technical field of laser cutting equipment, and discloses a real-time design method of a laser cutting machine tool based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of collecting real-time operation data from distributed sensor nodes, carrying out compensation checking on a design change history record and laser cutting track information in a digital twin fusion design mode to obtain design attribute indexes, determining track interaction periods of design objects on cutting paths according to the design attribute indexes, obtaining processing path information and analyzing risk characteristics to obtain cutting node risk data, determining risk situation levels according to the cutting node risk data and the laser cutting track information, and optimizing and adjusting dynamic design blind areas in the laser cutting design process according to the track interaction periods and the risk situation levels. The method integrates real-time data and a digital twin technology, can improve the real-time performance and the accuracy of the design, and can cope with the dynamic change of a complex processing environment.

title: Multi-shift collaborative work scheduling method and system based on improved whale optimization algorithm
description: The invention discloses a multi-team collaborative operation scheduling method and a system based on an improved whale optimization algorithm, which are used for constructing a scheduling model for multi-team continuous collaborative operation by taking the minimum maximum finishing time and the minimum team task load as double objective functions aiming at the situation that the same workpiece is required to be processed by the multi-team collaborative operation, meanwhile, solving by adopting a whale optimization algorithm comprising task sequence and team cooperation double-layer discrete coding, and designing improved operators such as multi-strategy whale group initialization, multi-strategy whale searching, multi-strategy whale predation, multi-dimensional similarity calculation and the like aiming at multi-team continuous processing characteristics. The invention directly maps the constraint of the continuity and rest time of the shifts through a task and shift double-layer coding mechanism, and builds an objective function based on shift indexes to obviously improve the optimization efficiency of multi-shift collaborative scheduling, thereby being widely applicable to the multi-shift collaborative manufacturing scene with equal periods of large spacecraft cabin structural members, high-speed rail carriages, ships and heavy machinery.

title: A customer service robot response method, device and equipment
description: The present application provides a response method, device, and equipment for a customer service robot, relating to the technical field of customer service robots. The method comprises: obtaining multimodal request data input by a user into a current conversation with a customer service robot, as well as the conversation status of the current conversation; constructing a multimodal heterogeneous graph based on the modal features of the request data of different modalities and the request data of the corresponding modalities; fusing the different modal features based on the request data of different modalities and the corresponding modal features, the conversation status, and the multimodal heterogeneous graph to obtain a multimodal fusion feature; inputting the multimodal fusion feature into a pre-constructed user intention response model based on causal relationships to obtain the customer service robot's response strategy for the multimodal request data; wherein the user intention response model is used to characterize the causal relationship between the multimodal interaction data input by the user and the response strategy of the customer service robot. The present application can improve the response accuracy of the customer service robot and enhance the user interaction experience.

title: Data quality intelligent auditing system and method based on dynamic rule base
description: The invention discloses a data quality intelligent auditing system and method based on a dynamic rule base, which belong to the technical field of data auditing and comprise a rule base construction module, a multi-source monitoring engine module, an automatic verification execution module and a feedback optimization module, wherein the rule base construction module is used for analyzing service scene parameters to generate rule configuration instructions according to service scene requirements and data type characteristics through a scene analysis unit, the multi-source monitoring engine module is connected to the rule base construction module and is used for collecting multi-source data in real time and loading corresponding verification rules, the automatic verification execution module is used for executing normalized quality verification on the multi-source data based on the verification rule base, and the feedback optimization module is used for analyzing rule hit rate and false alarm rate in a verification result through a reinforcement learning algorithm and dynamically iterating and updating rule threshold values and logic combinations in the rule base. By constructing a full-automatic process of rule generation, execution, feedback and update, the problem that the traditional system depends on manual intervention to cause slow response is solved, and the industry average rule update period is 3-7 days.

title: A machine learning-based non-invasive method for early-stage endometrial cancer assessment
description: The invention discloses a machine learning-based early noninvasive endometrial cancer assessment method which comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring index data of a potential endometrial disease patient in advance, integrating data according to preset standards based on the index data to obtain a feature set, S2, carrying out standardized pretreatment on the feature set in the step S1 to obtain a standardized training set and a standardized test set of endometrial disease data, S3, constructing a disease prediction model for predicting endometrial cancer results based on a preset multi-mode machine learning model based on the training set and the test set containing endometrial disease data acquired in the step S2, and S4, inputting the endometrial disease index data of the patient to be assessed into the disease prediction model to carry out early noninvasive endometrial cancer prediction assessment to obtain endometrial cancer prediction results of the patient. The invention has the advantages of capability of meeting non-invasive screening, high prediction accuracy and small economic burden.

title: A deadlock prediction method for intelligent manufacturing systems based on Petri-Net-GCN
description: The invention discloses a deadlock prediction method of an intelligent manufacturing system based on Petri-Net-GCN, which comprises the following steps of dividing the intelligent manufacturing system into a production equipment module, a production procedure module and a production resource module, carrying out formal modeling on the modules based on the Petri network, constructing a Petri-Net-GCN deadlock prediction model comprising a library-to-library transition message transfer module and a library-to-library message transfer module, carrying out bidirectional aggregation update on characteristics among nodes in a Petri network diagram by using a graph neural network structure, acquiring an initial Token distribution, an association matrix and a deadlock label construction dataset of the intelligent manufacturing system, inputting model training, and predicting deadlock risk under an unknown system state by using the trained model.

title: Dynamic dosing method and system of composite bacterial agent combined with water quality monitoring
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of water pollution control, and discloses a method and system for dynamically adding a composite microbial agent in combination with water quality monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: collecting real-time water quality parameters, preprocessing the real-time water quality data, and obtaining preprocessed water quality data; establishing a hybrid model including a water quality prediction branch and a microbial agent addition branch; inputting the preprocessed water quality data into the hybrid model, determining the composite microbial agent dosage required at the current moment through the microbial agent addition branch, and obtaining a preliminary dosage; obtaining predicted values of water quality parameters within the next 1-2 hours through the water quality prediction branch, and dynamically adjusting the preliminary dosage using a MO-IPSO algorithm based on the predicted values of the water quality parameters to obtain an optimized dosage; and sending the optimized dosage to a dosage device so as to control the dosage device to add the composite microbial agent according to a set dosage and dosage time. The present invention dynamically calculates and adjusts the dosage of the composite microbial agent, thereby achieving precise dosage of the microbial agent.

title: Fetal abnormality auxiliary diagnosis method and system based on medical intelligent model
description: The present invention discloses a fetal anomaly auxiliary diagnosis method and system based on a medical intelligent model. The method obtains fetal ultrasound examination data, including standard cross-sectional images, cardiac dynamic images, biological measurement values, and medical questionnaire text; inputs multimodal data into the medical intelligent model to generate auxiliary diagnosis results for fetal structural anomalies; the medical intelligent model includes a Chinese medical language model, a Chinese medical multimodal model, a structured visual measurement model, and a diagnostic multimodal model; first, the medical questionnaire text is enhanced with medical knowledge; then, semantic fusion of the medical image and the questionnaire text is achieved to obtain fused image-text features; then, structural dimension information is extracted from the standard cross-sectional images to obtain measurement values; finally, a structural anomaly auxiliary diagnosis conclusion is generated based on the fused image-text features and measurement values. The present invention achieves accurate identification and diagnosis of complex fetal structural anomalies and has important application value in the field of medical artificial intelligence.

title: Quantum bit graphical interaction method and device and related man-machine interaction system
description: The invention discloses a quantum bit graphical interaction method, a quantum bit graphical interaction device and a human-computer interaction system. The method comprises the steps of responding to interaction operation of a graphic character on a user interface, executing corresponding quantum computing operation on quantum bits of a first quantum state corresponding to the graphic character according to a quantum computing mode defined by the interaction operation, generating and outputting the graphic character corresponding to the quantum bits of a second quantum state according to the quantum bits of the second quantum state obtained by the quantum computing operation. According to the invention, through a mode of graphically displaying quantum computing knowledge and quantum effects, a learner and a fan can intuitively understand quantum computing theoretical knowledge, visual and intuitive learning experience is brought to the learner and the fan, the threshold of quantum theoretical learning is reduced, and the learning efficiency is improved.

title: Energy system optimal scheduling method, device, equipment, medium and program product
description: The present disclosure relates to an energy system optimization scheduling method, apparatus, device, medium and program product, the method comprising constructing an uncertainty fuzzy set of energy system output based on generating an antagonism network; based on the uncertainty fuzzy set, the lowest comprehensive operation cost of the energy system is determined as a daily optimization target, a daily optimization model is built, the comprehensive operation cost comprises at least one of start-stop cost, operation cost, outsourcing electric cost and waste wind and waste light cost, the highest net income of the energy system is determined as a daily optimization target based on a self-attention long-short-period memory network, a daily optimization model is built, and the daily optimization model are subjected to optimization solution to obtain target output data of the energy system for each time period and the start-stop state of the unit. According to the method, the self-attention mechanism is embedded in the long-period and short-period memory network, so that the capturing capability of the model on the long-distance dependency relationship can be improved, and the accuracy of optimizing and scheduling the comprehensive energy system is further improved.

title: A Method and System for Identifying Black Plastic Based on Two-Layer Fuzzy Region Modeling
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of plastic identification, and discloses a black plastic identification method and a black plastic identification system based on double-layer fuzzy region modeling, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining spectrum data of black plastic, extracting spectrum data characteristics, and reconstructing the spectrum data characteristics to obtain reconstructed characteristics; the fuzzy rule system is constructed by determining the central position of a fuzzy rule by clustering similar characteristic points, defining the membership degree of the upper and lower bounds of a characteristic interval, synthesizing the membership degrees of the upper and lower bounds to obtain the average fuzzy response degree, constructing a fuzzy rule for each characteristic interval, modeling each characteristic interval, obtaining local output according to input characteristics, carrying out weighted fusion on the local output to obtain a black plastic recognition result, defining a loss function, optimizing model parameters and obtaining a trained recognition model. The invention provides an end-to-end method for fusing structure transformation, double-layer fuzzy division and robust subnetworks, which remarkably improves the recognition precision, stability and interpretability in a spectrum recognition task.

title: A Method and System for Feature Fusion and Extraction of Multi-Source Data from Photovoltaic Power Plants
description: This invention relates to the field of new energy technology and discloses a method and system for feature fusion and extraction from multi-source data of photovoltaic power plants, comprising the following steps: S1, collecting multi-source data and preprocessing the multi-source data; S2, using a variational autoencoder to extract low-dimensional feature representations from the multi-source data and combining it with a clustering algorithm to identify abnormal patterns; S3, conducting local model training in a distributed photovoltaic power plant, sharing only model parameters to a central server, and aggregating to generate a global model; S4, quantifying the contribution of each data source to the fusion result and generating visualization results; S5, deploying a lightweight model on edge devices and performing real-time prediction and anomaly detection through model compression technology. In this invention, by introducing a variational autoencoder combined with a clustering algorithm into the feature extraction module to perform low-dimensional embedding representation and anomaly identification on multi-source data, it can comprehensively characterize the differences in potential feature distributions, reduce false positives and false negatives, and improve the accuracy of anomaly detection.

title: A Virtual Sensing Active Noise Control Algorithm Based on Grey Wolf Algorithm Optimization and VBAP Interpolation
description: The invention discloses a virtual sensing active noise control algorithm based on the optimization of a wolf algorithm and interpolation of VBAP. The method comprises the steps of measuring and recording the distance between a virtual sensor and a physical sensor, calculating the weighting weight of the physical sensor by adopting a VBAP method, obtaining a sound pressure signal by utilizing the physical sensor, weighting the sound pressure signal of the physical sensor by using the calculated weighting weight, estimating to obtain the sound pressure signal of the virtual sensor, and optimizing the control filter coefficient by adopting a gray wolf algorithm based on the estimated sound pressure signal of the virtual sensor to realize active noise control. The method has no requirement on the number and layout of the physical sensors, can effectively estimate the sound pressure, can be applied to any active noise control algorithm, is robust to the position characteristics and the azimuth changes of the noise source, and is robust to the changes of the secondary paths, such as the position of the secondary source, the position changes of the virtual sensor and the like.

title: A function-level vulnerability detection method based on source code comments and program dependency graphs
description: This invention relates to the fields of software security technology and discloses a function-level vulnerability detection method based on source code comments and program dependency graphs. The method aims to improve the vulnerability detection rate by fusing code comments and code statement features, using a program dependency graph as a code representation, and employing a graph convolutional neural network to learn the structural and syntactic semantic information of the code. This approach also exhibits good scalability. The steps include: removing non-standard comments from the code and standardizing the code; generating a program dependency graph (PDG) of the standardized code; generating comment information for each node using a large model to obtain a program dependency graph containing code statements and their comment information; generating vector representations of code comment information and code statements, and then fusing these two vector representations into a fused feature vector, which is then used as input to the overall architecture of the graph neural network for model training.

title: Lithium battery thermal runaway monitoring method and related device
description: The application discloses a lithium battery thermal runaway monitoring method and a related device, and relates to the field of lithium battery thermal runaway monitoring; the multi-perception parameter time sequence comprises a battery temperature time sequence, a battery voltage time sequence, a battery inner gas concentration time sequence and a battery deformation time sequence, the multi-perception parameter time sequence is input into a monitoring model to obtain the space-time characteristic of each perception parameter, the monitoring model comprises a convolution neural network, an LSTM network and an attention mechanism module which are connected in series, and the thermal runaway state of the lithium battery is monitored according to the space-time characteristic of each perception parameter and a corresponding dynamic threshold. The application can accurately monitor the thermal runaway state of the lithium battery in real time and predict the occurrence of the thermal runaway in advance so as to send out an early warning signal in time.

title: A method for cloud anomaly detection and removal based on DDIM remote sensing imagery
description: The invention discloses a cloud anomaly detection and removal method based on a DDIM remote sensing image in the technical field of remote sensing image processing, which comprises the following steps of S1, loading and preprocessing a data set, obtaining a multispectral remote sensing image, carrying out radiation correction and atmosphere correction, S2, converting a cloud-free image into a noise image sequence by gradually adding noise in a forward diffusion process, S3, training a U-Net noise prediction network to predict the noise in the forward diffusion process and reconstruct an original image, S4, reversely denoising and sampling, restoring the noise image into the cloud-free image based on the trained noise prediction network and a deterministic sampling strategy, S5, generating a pixel-level cloud mask, and obtaining a cloud anomaly region by combining a self-adaptive threshold value through pixel-by-pixel difference of the original cloud image and the reconstructed cloud-free image. The method is based on a denoising diffusion model, and achieves pixel-level positioning and high-fidelity reconstruction of cloud layers through a back diffusion sampling and deterministic sampling method, so that the effect of remote sensing images is improved.

title: A Hybrid Vehicle Testing Method and System
description: The invention provides a method and a system for testing a hybrid vehicle, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting power signal samples correspondingly generated by a hybrid system under different torque ratios in a full-rotation speed interval, and extracting signal distortion characteristics correspondingly generated in the power signal samples through wavelet transformation; the method comprises the steps of establishing a dynamic correlation model between torque fluctuation quantity and signal distortion characteristics of a hybrid system, storing standard signal characteristics correspondingly generated at each rotating speed, calculating torque ratio fluctuation values of an engine and a battery pack after starting a test, generating distortion correction parameters matched with the torque ratio fluctuation values in real time through the dynamic correlation model, carrying out real-time correction processing on an original power output signal generated by the hybrid system through the distortion correction parameters to generate a corresponding correction power signal, and correspondingly completing power test of the hybrid system according to the correction power signal. The invention can effectively improve the test efficiency.

title: Agent-based database anomaly repair method, apparatus, equipment, and media
description: The application discloses a database abnormality repairing method, device, equipment and medium based on an agent, relating to the technical field of computer database management and comprising the steps of recording characteristic information corresponding to the current abnormal state of a target database and the current operation parameters of the target database; the method comprises the steps of inputting characteristic information and current operation parameters into a target intelligent agent, so that the target intelligent agent can determine an initial repairing scheme from a preset database, and determine a target repairing scheme from the initial repairing scheme, and performing abnormal repairing treatment on the target database by utilizing the target repairing scheme. By utilizing the intelligent agent to determine the target repair scheme, the database repair efficiency is improved.

title: An Internet of Things-based method for arthropod target detection
description: This invention provides an arthropod target detection method based on the Internet of Things (IoT), comprising: Step 1, improving the Yolov5s model by introducing an SE attention module optimized for arthropod feature distribution and redesigning the three-level feature processing architecture of the output reconstruction ORS module; Step 2, training the model in a deep learning framework environment by combining a cosine annealing strategy with the iterative convergence curve characteristics of arthropod training samples for targeted training, outputting a target detection model optimized for arthropod detection; Step 3, comparing and evaluating the improved Yolov5s model with the original Yolov5s model and target detection algorithm. This method, through various improvements, enhances the sensitivity to arthropod features, optimizes the detection of small and overlapping targets, and reduces computational load to adapt to IoT devices.

title: A method, apparatus, medium, and equipment for image recognition of electronic patrol officers on information boards.
description: The invention discloses an image identification method, device, medium and equipment for an information board electronic inspector. The method comprises the steps of adopting an improved SwinTextDetector algorithm model to identify LED images of an information board electronic inspector, carrying out text identification, outputting identification texts, splitting the identification texts into sentence lists, calculating hash values of each sentence text sentence by sentence, inquiring whether the hash values of each sentence text sentence exist in a text data hash table of a display data area one by one, skipping the sentence text sentence if the hash values exist, otherwise, comparing the sentence text sentence with the contents in a special sensitive word corpus to obtain comparison results, and outputting abnormal events of the LED images according to the comparison results.

title: Indoor escape route optimization method and system
description: This invention relates to the field of path planning technology, and particularly to an indoor escape route optimization method and system. The method involves constructing a hierarchical road network model; in the event of a hazard, receiving IoT monitoring data to simulate hazard spread and predict the affected area; combining camera and Wi-Fi probe data to obtain crowd distribution information, resulting in a predicted personnel distribution map within a preset time zone; using the hierarchical road network model, optimizing escape routes within the preset time zone based on the predicted hazard area and personnel distribution map, and outputting the optimal escape plan; and sending several optimal escape routes to several associated escapees via a device terminal, dynamically updating the routes according to hazard perception data until all personnel have evacuated. This method enables the rapid and accurate planning of optimal escape plans adapted to different hazard scenarios and personnel distribution conditions.

title: Decision scheme recommendation method driven by decision style
description: The invention discloses a decision-making style driven decision-making scheme recommending method, which relates to the technical field of intelligent recommending, and adopts a style driven scheme evaluating network based on an attention mechanism to acquire feature vectors of attributes in a decision-making scheme after comprehensively considering all attribute information so as to acquire the feature vectors acquired after comprehensively considering all attribute information after being fused by the attention mechanism, so as to acquire the probability that the decision-making scheme belongs to a decision-making style, further acquire a trained style driven scheme evaluating network, and finally acquire the score of a new task decision-making scheme according to the trained style driven scheme evaluating network to realize the recommendation of the decision-making scheme of a new task. According to the invention, aiming at the decision style of the individual user, the proposal which accords with the decision style of the user is adopted to evaluate the network for recommendation, and the recommended decision proposal can be consistent with the decision preference style of the individual user to the maximum extent, thereby improving the consistency between the recommendation result and the individual user.

title: Lightweight topology optimization and assembly control method for wood-aluminum composite outer vertical surface
description: This invention discloses a lightweight topology optimization and assembly control method for wood-aluminum composite facades, belonging to the field of digital twin and intelligent construction technology. It includes generating a cross-scale parametric twin entity; performing iterative optimization to generate a topology design scheme with life-cycle value as the objective; deconstructing the scheme into an intelligent construction instruction set; calculating assembly deviations by comparing the twin model with on-site measured data; and updating the twin entity based on deviation feedback. This invention employs a co-evolutionary architecture that combines cross-scale digital twin modeling, full life-cycle value optimization, and closed-loop assembly control integrating virtual and physical elements. This architecture incorporates factors such as material microstructures, manufacturing costs, and long-term durability into the initial design and adaptively corrects errors during the physical construction phase, significantly improving the global optimality of complex composite structure design and the accuracy and reliability of the physical construction process.

title: Data center network card energy efficiency optimization method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of computer networks and discloses a data center network card energy efficiency optimization method, a device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of collecting working state data and network flow data of a plurality of network cards associated with a data center in real time, constructing a multi-dimensional feature vector, executing potential activation operation on each neuron in a pulse neural network according to the multi-dimensional feature vector to obtain response characteristics of each neuron, and predicting energy efficiency parameters of each network card according to the response characteristics, wherein the potential activation operation comprises activation operation and inhibition operation, generating an energy efficiency optimization strategy of the network card based on the energy efficiency parameters, and performing global energy efficiency balancing of each network card by utilizing a preset global optimization algorithm according to the energy efficiency optimization strategy. The method and the system improve the dynamic adaptability, global optimization capacity and prediction precision of the energy efficiency of the data center network card, and obviously improve the energy efficiency optimization level of the data center network card.

title: Navigation method, device, equipment and medium based on GRPO algorithm
description: The application discloses a navigation method, a device, equipment and a medium based on GRPO algorithm, which relate to the technical field of reinforcement learning and comprise the steps of calculating average similarity between a current strategy and a previous iteration strategy based on KL divergence, updating a step factor through average rewarding change rate and average similarity determined based on rewards of a plurality of iterations, determining a gradient estimation correction term based on gradient estimation of a sampling track, determining a target gradient estimation according to the gradient estimation correction term and original gradient estimation, updating the current strategy through the target gradient estimation correction term and the updated step factor, cutting importance weight when updating the current strategy, correcting an objective function of GRPO algorithm according to the weight after cutting, training GRPO algorithm based on the corrected function and the updated strategy, so that an agent learns an optimal strategy based on the GRPO algorithm after training, and determining an outlet of a maze according to the optimal strategy. Thus, the stability of the algorithm is improved.

title: KV cache compression and eviction word recovery method and system for large language model reasoning
description: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and natural language processing, and in particular relates to a KV cache compression and eviction word recovery method and system for large-scale language model reasoning, wherein the method comprises the following steps of for a query vector of an ith word calculated by a current transducer layer Calculate its and all key vectors Performing a V-cache dynamic update operation based on the attention score, for an ith term, based on all After the dynamic update operation of the V cache is completed, the updated value vector set in the V cache storage pool and the pre-calculated attention fraction partial product P are used for carrying out attention calculation. The technical scheme solves the technical problem that the video memory occupation and the calculation efficiency are difficult to cooperatively optimize in the prior art, and has the advantages of dynamically managing the KV cache video memory occupation, maintaining the model reasoning quality and improving the calculation efficiency.

title: Underground coal mine safety prediction method and system
description: The invention is suitable for the technical field of coal mining safety monitoring, and provides a method and a system for predicting the safety of a coal mine underground, wherein the method comprises the following steps of acquiring environmental data and roadway geometric parameters of a target area of the coal mine underground in real time; the method comprises the steps of determining an oxygen concentration prediction factor according to oxygen concentration, wind speed, roadway oxygen consumption rate and roadway geometric parameters of a target area, determining a gas concentration prediction factor according to gas concentration, wind speed, humidity and roadway geometric parameters of the target area, determining a coal dust concentration prediction factor according to coal dust concentration, coal dust deposition thickness, wind speed, humidity and roadway geometric parameters of the target area, constructing an explosion risk prediction model based on a physical information neural network, and performing prediction assessment on the safety of the target area based on the explosion risk prediction model. According to the invention, the explosion risk prediction model constructed by the physical information neural network is combined with the multi-source environmental factors, so that the underground safety of the coal mine can be accurately predicted and estimated.

title: Open-air brain injury rapid diagnosis system based on brain electricity data
description: This invention discloses a rapid field brain injury diagnostic system based on electroencephalogram (EEG) data, belonging to the field of EEG data analysis and diagnostic technology. It includes an external stimulation module that utilizes sound waves and electrical impulses to stimulate limb muscles to induce specific event-related potentials and motor cortical activity rhythms for detection; an EEG data analysis module that performs multi-scale time window preprocessing and deep learning algorithm analysis; and an injury assessment module that determines the type and quantifies the degree of injury. This system can be implemented using a portable EEG acquisition helmet, a portable pulse stimulation device, and a chip-level handheld terminal to achieve a method from stimulation to detection to diagnosis. The overall device is lightweight, suitable for deployment in field scenarios, and can operate stably in complex environments.

title: Method for determining optimal placement quantity and position of single-type material boxes of automobile parts on tray
description: This invention discloses a method for determining the optimal quantity and position of single-type automotive parts boxes on a pallet. The method includes first obtaining the maximum pallet loading height limit, box dimensions, and pallet specifications; calculating the maximum number of stacked boxes and the theoretical upper limit of the quantity per layer; then designing an objective function and constraints based on a two-dimensional coordinate system to construct a mathematical model; obtaining relaxed solutions for the maximum quantity per layer using a Gurobi solver; obtaining feasible solutions through neighborhood search; and determining the final maximum quantity per layer using a genetic algorithm for iterative optimization and maximum subspace decoding. The maximum loading quantity is then calculated based on the number of stacked layers. Finally, the second objective is solved based on the mathematical model to determine the most compact placement position. This method offers advantages such as high reliability, practicality, and high computational efficiency. It can replace manual planning, maximize pallet space utilization, and reduce transportation and warehousing costs. It is suitable for pallet loading calculation scenarios for single-type automotive parts boxes in the automotive parts logistics field.

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for designing hole slag aggregate high-strength concrete
description: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for designing high-strength concrete with hole slag aggregate. Relates to the technical field of building materials. The method comprises the steps of obtaining the length-diameter ratio and the circularity of hole slag aggregates, calculating the fractal dimension of the aggregate outline by adopting a box counting method, generating a grading curve based on the fractal dimension D, establishing a multi-element stacking model, iteratively optimizing the mixture ratio of aggregates with different particle diameters by using the aggregate stacking density as an optimization target through a genetic algorithm, outputting the mixture ratio of aggregates with the optimal particle diameter and the corresponding aggregate stacking density, taking the aggregate stacking density output by the multi-element stacking model as the mass of the aggregates in unit cubic meter of concrete, calculating the mass of slurry according to the mass of the aggregates in the unit cubic meter of concrete and the slurry-to-bone ratio, and solving the cement mass, the water-to-cement ratio formula and the admixture mass by using a simultaneous slurry composition formula, a water-to-cement ratio formula and an admixture proportion formula.

title: Machine learning for property prediction and formulation recommendation of polyolefin polymer blends
description: This invention relates to a computer-implemented method for predicting the properties of a polypropylene composition. The method includes: training a fingerprint model using a polypropylene training composition by mapping the component content of a polypropylene training composition to analytical features of the polypropylene training composition; feeding the component content of a polypropylene test composition as input into the trained fingerprint model; and receiving the analytical features of the polypropylene test composition as output. Hereinafter, the analytical features include at least one characteristic property of the amorphous fraction or crystalline fraction of the polypropylene composition. Furthermore, this invention provides a computer-readable storage medium for storing computer program instructions defining the steps of the method of this invention. Furthermore, this invention also covers the use of analytical features including at least one characteristic property of the amorphous fraction or crystalline fraction of the polypropylene composition and the component content of the polypropylene composition in training the computer-implemented model.

title: Video game decision system based on auxiliary task learning
description: This invention relates to the field of video game decision-making technology, specifically disclosing a video game decision-making system based on auxiliary task learning. This invention generates a structured game state vector by comprehensively collecting and fusing visual, numerical, textual, and interactive data from the game; constructs a multi-dimensional auxiliary task library, evaluates, sorts, and schedules it, outputting a priority-ranked list of auxiliary tasks; achieves collaborative learning between the main task and auxiliary tasks through a shared-private dual-branch network and a collaborative loss function, outputting optimized decision model parameters; and generates and executes game operations based on the decision model parameters and the game state vector, continuously adjusting and optimizing based on feedback data from the game environment. This invention solves the problem that traditional intelligent game decision-making struggles to comprehensively analyze complex game states, improving the targeting, efficiency, robustness, and generalization of decisions, providing comprehensive and powerful support for video game decision-making.

title: Power distribution network power supply partition optimization method and system based on line loss prediction
description: A method and system for optimizing power supply zones in a distribution network based on line loss prediction includes: initially dividing the distribution network into power supply zones based on the area's jurisdiction, and acquiring multi-source data related to the power grid at the time of prediction for each node on each voltage branch of the power supply zone; performing feature fusion on the multi-source data to obtain fused features; substituting the fused features into a pre-trained line loss prediction model to obtain the line loss of each branch in each power supply zone; and using an improved whale algorithm to solve for the optimization scheme of the power supply area to be optimized based on the line loss combined with the pre-constructed distribution network power supply zone optimization model. The objective function of the distribution network power supply zone optimization model includes maximizing the number of power supply zones for load transfer, minimizing line loss costs in each area, and minimizing voltage disturbances within the area as optimization objectives. This method accurately assesses the power loss of different zone schemes, effectively balances load distribution, reduces resource idleness, and improves power supply quality.

title: Hospital health education intelligent question-answering method based on large language model and knowledge base
description: This invention provides an intelligent question-and-answer method for hospital health education based on a large language model and knowledge base, belonging to the field of intelligent question-and-answer technology. The method includes: collecting and preprocessing relevant hospital health education document data; converting text blocks into vector form using a vector embedding model; storing the vectors in an AI-native database along with metadata and building an index to form a hospital health education knowledge base; receiving user-inputted health consultation questions, performing semantic analysis and keyword extraction, and retrieving relevant knowledge fragments from the hospital health education knowledge base; fusing and reordering the retrieved knowledge fragments, calculating relevance scores, and selecting the top K knowledge fragments with the highest scores; inputting the selected knowledge fragments and user questions into a preset prompt word template to generate prompt words that are input into the large language model, generating an answer to the user's question and providing feedback. This enhances patients' acceptance and practicality of health knowledge, improves the efficiency of hospital health education, and increases patient satisfaction.

title: Learning data generation device, learning data generation method, and learning data generation program
description: When generating learning data for constructing a proxy model, the bias of the simulation mode is reduced. A learning data generation apparatus for constructing a proxy model includes: a decision unit that randomly determines an initial value and a final value of input data; a path generation unit that generates a path by randomly assigning the possible changes of each step in a path from the determined initial value to the final value; and a learning data generation unit that generates learning data including the determined initial value and final value, and the changes assigned to each step of the generated path.

title: ADSS optical cable potential measurement method, equipment and medium based on CNN-PINN fusion network
description: The invention discloses an ADSS optical cable potential measurement method, equipment and medium based on a CNN-PINN fusion network, which comprises the steps of S1, collecting space electric field vectors around an optical cable and environment temperature and humidity parameters to construct a three-channel tensor, S2, extracting high-dimensional characteristic vectors, S3, embedding a PINN physical constraint module into a Poisson equation, field strength gradient constraint and dielectric compensation, S4, outputting a three-dimensional space potential distribution field and an electric erosion risk level, improving CNN and PINN through fusion, thoroughly breaking through the bottleneck of the traditional technology, capturing high gradient distortion through UNet, CBAM strengthening key region perception, PINN enabling a measurement error to be reduced compared with a traditional contact sensor through three-channel decoupling environment interference, suppressing humidity drift through dielectric compensation, guaranteeing reconstruction accuracy stability under a strong interference environment through frequency domain noise reduction, generating three-dimensional potential field distribution through an output layer, calculating the electric erosion risk level integrating the spatial gradient and time-varying characteristics in real time, and supporting corrosion protection decisions.

title: Fiedler spider-web privacy protection noise mechanism construction method based on transducer
description: The invention relates to a method for constructing a Fiedler spider-web privacy protection noise mechanism based on a transducer, and belongs to the technical field of high-order networks and privacy protection noise. The method comprises the steps of starting from two dimensions of node attributes and local topology, constructing two parts of node and superside representation, and carrying out deep interaction modeling on the two parts by a transducer cross-attention mechanism to generate an enhanced supergraph correlation matrix. And constructing a normalized hypergraph Laplace matrix based on the enhanced hypergraph incidence matrix, and extracting Fiedler values and corresponding feature vectors through spectrum decomposition to characterize the global structural features of the hypergraph. And calculating the association influence of each superside by taking the Fiedler value as a global standard and combining with the enhanced hypergraph association, and designing a Fiedler noise disturbance mechanism by taking the maximum influence as a noise sensitivity scale to apply differential protection to the query result so as to realize effective defense on epsilon-level cobweb privacy protection, thereby reducing the risk of leakage of hypergraph sensitive information and simultaneously maintaining the high-efficiency usability of data query.

title: Tunnel microseism signal integrated classification method with high noise robustness
description: The invention relates to the technical field of seismic signal processing and pattern recognition, and discloses a tunnel microseism signal integrated classification method with high noise robustness, which comprises the steps of acquiring and processing an elastic wave signal to obtain a feature vector; the method comprises the steps of constructing a Stacking integrated model comprising a plurality of base classifiers and a meta classifier, using a focus loss function for optimizing a class imbalance problem, carrying out parameter optimization on the model by adopting a hierarchical optimization strategy, wherein an outer layer of optimization parameters are used for adjusting the focus loss function, an inner layer of optimization is used for adjusting super parameters of the base classifiers, and finally training and generating a final classification model for signal classification according to the obtained optimal parameters. By combining the Stacking model with the focus loss function with the layering optimization strategy, the technical problem of class imbalance and model parameter deep coupling is effectively solved, and accurate identification of key microseism signals can be realized under a strong noise background.

title: Detection method and system for detecting small target foreign matters in reinforced tobacco leaves
description: This invention discloses a detection method and system for enhancing the detection of small foreign objects in tobacco leaves, belonging to the field of tobacco foreign object detection technology. The method includes: data acquisition; hyperspectral feature processing: extracting features from the spectral data of each pixel; comparing the extracted features with a pre-established hyperspectral feature database and marking suspected foreign object regions with similarity exceeding a threshold; small target optimization detection: using an improved convolutional neural network structure as the small target optimization detection head, outputting the location and type judgment of the small target foreign object; multimodal decision-making: fusing morphological analysis and material analysis, using logical judgment or machine learning classification algorithms to fuse the results and determine the foreign object; and result output. This invention can significantly improve the accuracy and efficiency of detection, increase detection precision, reduce false alarm rates, reduce product recall losses caused by foreign objects, and improve the overall production quality and economic benefits of the tobacco industry.

title: A method for identifying trace gases in seawater based on multi-column collaboration and machine learning
description: This invention discloses a method for identifying trace gases in seawater based on multi-column collaboration and machine learning, belonging to the field of gas chromatography analysis technology. The method includes preparing the gas sample to be identified and performing gas chromatography detection; denoising, normalizing, and outlier removal of the gas chromatogram; extracting manual peak features and time-series peak features to form a multi-dimensional feature set; performing hierarchical screening of the feature set to retain core features; constructing a dual-model fusion architecture of KNN and CNN models; dividing the features into training and validation sets, training and validating the dual-model architecture, and optimizing the dual-model architecture parameters; applying SHAP analysis to analyze the model decision process and generating a visualization report of feature importance. This invention does not rely on precise standard sample calibration, improving efficiency and adaptability, and adapting to personalized detection needs in different scenarios; the introduction of SHAP technology clarifies the contribution of key identification features, enhancing interpretability and reliability.

title: Coding method and system for predicting channel state information
description: This application discloses an encoding method for predicting channel state information. The encoder obtains first summed data based on the coherent time vector of complex CFR data, the time mask of each batch of input data, and the input data of each batch. The first summed data serves as the input to a first deep learning model, which outputs the predicted CFR data. This application incorporates temporal features of channel state information into the encoding, integrating temporal and spatial information into the input data of the deep learning model. This approach considers the relative stability of the channel at future moments, addressing the problem of weak temporal and spatial information capture capabilities in the model and improving the accuracy of channel state information prediction.

title: Multimode transformer fault analysis method and system based on KAG technology
description: This invention discloses a multimodal transformer fault analysis method and system based on KAG technology, belonging to the field of power equipment fault diagnosis technology. The system integrates transformer operating data, online monitoring data, and historical test data through a multimodal data acquisition module, combines this with a dynamically updated knowledge graph in a knowledge base construction module, and uses a logical judgment module to establish a dynamic early warning matrix for multi-dimensional evaluation. A hybrid retrieval strategy in the retrieval module matches similar fault cases, and interpretable diagnostic reports and visualization results are generated based on KAG technology. This invention achieves the fusion analysis and fault reasoning of multi-source heterogeneous data, solving the problems of traditional methods relying on single parameters and lagging knowledge updates, significantly improving the accuracy of transformer fault diagnosis and operation and maintenance efficiency.

title: Disaster prevention and rescue method, system, equipment and medium based on quantum computation
description: This invention belongs to the field of structural data processing and disaster prevention and relief technology, specifically involving a disaster prevention and relief method, system, equipment, and medium based on quantum computing.
