The invention collects data by deploying multimodal quantum sensors at key locations, denoises the data using a lambda denoising filter, extracts features from the denoised data using a quantum wavelet transform algorithm, reduces the dimensionality of the extracted data using quantum principal component analysis, maps the dimensionality-reduced data to a high-dimensional space using a kernel function, performs vector classification on the mapped data, calculates the probability of disaster occurrence using quantum Monte Carlo on the classified data, predicts the disaster impact range using a quantum diffusion model, generates early warning information based on the probability and the disaster impact range, distributes the early warning information via quantum communication technology, generates emergency plans based on the disaster impact range, evaluates and optimizes the plans, distributes the emergency plans, and evaluates and proposes disaster prevention and relief measures based on data before and after the disaster.

title: Mail fusion treatment device with AI recognition technology
description: This invention discloses an email fusion governance device with AI recognition technology, specifically relating to the field of email governance technology. It includes a data receiving module, a multimodal intelligent parsing engine, an email account relationship modeling module, a customs data collision engine, and an Excel result output module. This invention constructs an email governance architecture that integrates AI multimodal recognition and relationship mining, achieving intelligent structured conversion of multi-format attachments. Utilizing a large language model and a multimodal model working collaboratively, it automatically extracts and maps unstructured business data scattered in attachments into standardized database fields, establishing a dynamic email entity relationship graph. Based on email exchange characteristics, it generates a relational network to enhance business traceability capabilities. A cross-source data intelligent collision engine is designed to compare structured email data with third-party systems such as customs declarations in real time, automatically outputting risk clues or business evidence loops, significantly reducing the time cost of manual verification.

title: Prostate image segmentation method with multi-granularity self-attention mechanism
description: This invention discloses a prostate image segmentation method with a multi-granularity self-attention mechanism, belonging to the field of medical image processing technology. The key technical points are: the prostate image segmentation method introduces a multi-granularity self-attention mechanism after the convolutional module of U-Net to establish a prostate image segmentation model, thereby enhancing feature representation capabilities. This method performs branching processing on each set of convolutional feature maps, splitting them in two to reduce computational burden. One part is used to calculate the relationship between each feature point, and the other part is used to calculate the relationship between each feature point and each region. Finally, the features reconstructed from the two different granularities are fused, effectively combining local details and global semantic information, thereby enhancing the expressiveness of the prostate image model in complex prostate images.

title: Method, system, equipment and storage medium for generating knowledge base page code
description: The invention relates to the technical field of computers and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for generating a knowledge base page code, wherein the method, the system, the equipment and the storage medium comprise the steps of analyzing received page construction requirements and generating structural requirement data; the method comprises the steps of generating structural requirement data, matching resources and forming page constituent elements, converting page dynamic elements by the page constituent elements based on the structural requirement data, matching reusable scripts, data interfaces and UI controls, organizing prompt words and generating page codes based on the structural requirement data and the page constituent elements, integrating data binding, style definition and interaction logic by the page codes, detecting the page codes, deploying the detected page codes to generate page access links, feeding back page generation results, and detecting the detection including operability, safety and sensitivity. The invention can understand the requirements of users, automatically generate the page codes with high quality and depth adaptation with knowledge content.

title: Automatic rewriting conversion method from function neural network operators/models to C code
description: This invention discloses an automatic rewriting and conversion method from function neural network operators/models to C code, belonging to the field of deep learning. A tensor shape-safe deep learning framework is constructed in the Coq theorem prover, and the corresponding C code is automatically generated. Neural network operators or models defined by this method can detect tensor shape incompatibility and parameter constraint incompatibility issues during the compilation phase. Simultaneously, the automatic generation of C code eliminates the time-consuming and tedious manual derivation, lowering the development threshold.

title: A method and apparatus for continuous prediction of reservoir outflow
description: The invention provides a continuous prediction method and device for reservoir outlet flow, and belongs to the field of watershed hydrologic simulation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining daily reservoir storage flow corresponding to a period to be predicted every day, carrying out standardization on the total reservoir storage flow of one month, six months, one year, two years and five years, taking water quantity and time stamps, respectively constructing a first input characteristic data set, inputting a reservoir water storage model to obtain a prediction result of the reservoir water storage quantity and the reservoir water level at the beginning of each day, carrying out standardization on the total reservoir storage flow of one month, six months, one year, two years and five years, taking water quantity and time stamps in the period to be predicted and the output result of the reservoir water storage model, constructing a second input characteristic data set, and inputting a reservoir outflow model to obtain a reservoir outlet flow sequence of the period to be predicted. The method and the device remarkably improve the accuracy of continuously predicting the reservoir outlet flow, and are suitable for the condition of lacking continuous water storage observation data.

title: Risk early warning monitoring and personalized AI educational intervention recommendation system for student deception and campus violence
description: This invention discloses a risk warning and monitoring system for student bullying and school violence, along with a personalized AI-based educational intervention recommendation system, belonging to the field of campus safety and prevention technology. This invention enables early warning and dynamic tracking of student bullying and school violence risks, improving the timeliness and accuracy of risk identification. It employs multi-level risk aggregation and visualization report generation functions, allowing education administrators to quickly grasp the overall campus safety situation and formulate personalized intervention measures for different risk levels, thereby effectively reducing the incidence of bullying and violence incidents and creating a safer campus environment. Through the collaborative operation of AI-generated educational intervention strategies and a web push module, it achieves real-time identification and precise intervention of school bullying risks, integrating multi-dimensional data such as individual student risk scores, behavioral history, and environmental factors to generate highly personalized intervention plans.

title: Real-time anomaly sub-trajectory detection method based on multi-level self-supervised learning
description: This invention discloses a real-time anomaly sub-trajectory detection method based on multi-level self-supervised learning, belonging to the technical field of spatiotemporal data mining and intelligent transportation systems. To address the limitations of existing technologies in fine-grained anomaly localization and reliance on prior source-target point information, this invention employs a multi-scale local encoder and a hierarchical fusion mechanism to capture the hierarchical features of the trajectory. Furthermore, by randomly masking the fused embedded sequence and training a context encoder and decoder to reconstruct the masked segments, normal behavior patterns are learned under a self-supervised paradigm. Finally, the reconstruction error of the trajectory segments is used as an anomaly score for judgment. This invention achieves accurate and real-time detection of local anomalies without requiring prior source-target point (SD) information, significantly improving detection accuracy and versatility. Simultaneously, this invention introduces a novel set of fine-grained evaluation metrics, providing a more scientific evaluation benchmark for research in this field.

title: Automatic Determination Method and Device for Single-Phase Ground Fault Triggering Causes in Distribution Networks
description: This invention discloses a method and apparatus for automatically determining the triggering cause of single-phase grounding events in a distribution network. The method includes: acquiring raw transient waveform data corresponding to historical single-phase grounding events in the distribution network; processing the raw transient waveform data to obtain a standardized waveform dataset; inputting the standardized waveform dataset into the feature encoder of a trained deep learning model to determine a feature vector dataset, wherein the trained deep learning model is trained unsupervised based on the standardized waveform dataset; clustering the feature vector dataset to determine multiple clusters; receiving the triggering causes corresponding to the labeled raw transient waveform data for each of the multiple clusters to determine a cause labeling system; and determining the triggering cause corresponding to the raw transient waveform data based on the cause labeling system. This invention solves the technical problems of low efficiency and poor quality in sample library construction caused by reliance on manual annotation, manual feature extraction, and the weak capabilities of traditional clustering.

title: Cable insulation breakdown field strength prediction method, device, system and terminal equipment
description: The application provides a cable insulation breakdown field strength prediction method, a device, a system and terminal equipment, which relate to the technical field of high-voltage insulation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining characteristic parameters of a cable to be tested; the method comprises the steps of taking characteristic parameters as input, obtaining an insulation breakdown field strength prediction correction value of a cable to be tested through a breakdown field strength correction value prediction model, obtaining the thickness of an insulation layer of the cable to be tested, determining an insulation breakdown field strength theoretical value of the cable to be tested under the thickness of the insulation layer through the insulation breakdown field strength prediction model, wherein the insulation breakdown field strength prediction model is obtained by carrying out nonlinear fitting on insulation breakdown field strength actual values of insulation layer slice samples with different thicknesses, and determining the insulation breakdown field strength prediction value of the cable to be tested according to the insulation breakdown field strength prediction correction value and the insulation breakdown field strength theoretical value. The method can predict the cable insulation breakdown field strength without a destructive test, and improves the accuracy of cable insulation breakdown field strength prediction.

title: A microbial control and quality optimization system for prickly pear juice based on ultra-high pressure technology
description: The invention discloses a microorganism control and quality optimization system for roxburgh rose juice based on an ultrahigh pressure technology, which relates to the technical field of food processing. The ultra-high pressure technology-based roxburgh rose juice microorganism control and quality optimization system solves the contradiction between microorganism inactivation and quality protection caused by the fluctuation of the roxburgh rose juice raw material through a double-model dynamic game mechanism and a boundary overlapping domain optimizing algorithm. The dual-model collaborative decision-making module generates a quantization processing boundary according to the characteristics of the real-time raw materials, precisely locates the optimal parameter combination with maximized active substance retention rate on the premise of guaranteeing the food safety threshold value, and realizes dynamic correction of process parameters by a hard real-time coordination system of pulse pressure relief and feedback, thereby effectively improving the adaptability of complex raw materials such as high acid turbidity and the like.

title: A Smart Question Answering Method for Lifting Machinery Faults Based on Knowledge Graph and Large Model Fusion and Its Application
description: This invention discloses an intelligent question-answering method for crane machinery faults based on the fusion of knowledge graphs and large-scale models, and its application. The method first constructs a crane machinery fault knowledge graph containing nodes such as equipment type, components, fault modes, symptoms, and operating conditions. Text extraction is used to write instruction manuals, standards, maintenance records, and fault cases into the graph. Based on natural language questions and operational data, a domain-fine-tuned large-scale language model generates graph query instructions containing equipment, components, symptoms, and operating condition constraints. Query and pattern matching are performed on the knowledge graph to obtain several candidate fault interpretation subgraphs. Subsequently, the candidate subgraph summaries, along with the question and operating condition summaries, are input into the large-scale language model to generate diagnostic answers. The answers are parsed into structured triples and their consistency with the knowledge graph is checked. Conflicting answers trigger rewriting under constraints. This solution can significantly improve the accuracy, structural rationality, and interpretability of crane machinery fault question-answering.

title: Methods and related products for optimizing the transmission chain of wind turbine gearboxes
description: The application discloses a method for optimizing design of a wind power gear box transmission chain and related products. The gearbox transmission chain comprises at least one planetary transmission stage, an optimization model is established for a wind power gear transmission chain design problem, wherein an objective function of the optimization model comprises maximizing transmission chain torque density, decision variables of the optimization model comprise the number of planetary gears in each planetary transmission stage, transmission ratio, modulus, helix angle, tooth width and total deflection coefficient of each planetary transmission stage, and an optimization algorithm is utilized to solve the optimization problem to obtain an optimal decision variable value. According to the application, a mathematical model is established with the aim of maximizing the torque density of the transmission chain, and an optimization algorithm is utilized to solve the mathematical model, so that the optimal decision variable value is obtained, and further, the design of the wind power gear transmission scheme with high torque density is rapidly completed.

title: A 3D printing model construction method based on multimodal condition guidance
description: The invention relates to the technical field of three-dimensional computer graphics and artificial intelligence, in particular to a 3D printing model construction method based on multi-mode condition guidance, which comprises the following steps that S1, an open source model is used as a backbone network architecture to construct a basic model; the method comprises the steps of S2, constructing a latent space diffusion model constrained by view parameters, S3, constructing a paired data set, S4, training the latent space diffusion model based on the paired data set, S5, receiving text prompts input by a user, defining a standard view parameter sequence required by a group of 3D printing models, S6, generating a corresponding 2D image for each view parameter in the sequence, and S7, outputting the 3D printing model.

title: Method and device for automatically generating an artificial neural network
description: A method of automatically generating an artificial neural network (60) comprising modules and links linking that module, wherein successive modules and / or links are added to a current source network (60), modules and / or links to be added predetermined plurality of possible add-on modules and connections are randomly selected, and wherein a plurality of possible developments (61) of the current output network (60) are respectively generated by adding modules to be added and / or connections to the output network, and then one of the further developments (61) from the plurality of possible developments (61) is selected to serve as the current output network (60) in a next pass of the method.

title: Method and device for the detection of an anatomical feature of a blood vessel section
description: The invention relates to a method and a device (21) for detecting an anatomical feature of a blood vessel section, comprising the following features: a first interface (23) designed to receive a medical image data set, comprising a region of an anatomy of a patient to be examined, which has the blood vessel section ; a first arithmetic unit (31), designed to apply a first algorithm pre-trained on an anatomical feature for detecting the anatomical feature based on the medical image data set; and a second interface (31) configured to provide information based on the detection of the anatomical feature; The anatomical feature includes a caliber skip of a blood vessel and the presence of the anatomical feature is indicative of a pulmonary vascular disease, in particular of chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension.

title: Print quality analysis with neural networks
description: Method for compensating local register and / or duplication errors in a printing process in a printing press (7) by means of a computer (6), at least one image sensor (5) acquiring, digitizing and printing these specific image patterns (8) to the computer (6) forwards, which examines the digital image data (9) for possible local register and / or duplication errors and initiates any measures necessary to compensate for these errors, which is characterized in that the computer (6) converts the digital image data (9) supplies neural network (12) which has been taught in by means of training data (10, 10a, 10b) in such a way that it determines the corresponding register and / or duplication values from the supplied digital image data (9).

title: TRAINING A MACHINE LEARNING MODEL USING A BATCH-BASED ACTIVE LEARNING APPROACH
description: A system for training a machine learning model using a batch-based active learning approach. The system includes an information source and an electronic processor. The electronic processor is designed to receive a machine learning model to be trained, an unlabelled training dataset, a labeled training dataset and an identifier of the information source. The electronic processor is also designed to select a batch of training examples from the unlabeled training data set and to send a request, for each training example contained in the batch, for a label for the training example to the information source. The electronic processor is further designed to receive a label for each training example contained in the batch, to associate the training example with the label and to add the training example to the labeled training data set. The electronic processor is also designed to train the machine learning model using the labeled training data.

title: RCCC RGB DOMAIN TRANSLATION WITH DEEP NEURAL NETWORKS
description: The present disclosure provides RCCC RGB domain translation with deep neural networks. The present disclosure discloses a system and method for translating, e.g. B. Mapping an RCCC (Red-Clear-Clear-Clear) image into an RGB (Red-Green-Blue) image. In an exemplary implementation, the system and method may receive, in a deep neural network, an image having an RCCC (red-clear-clear-clear) image pattern, the deep neural network including a generator and a discriminator; generate at the generator an RGB (Red-Green-Blue) image based on the image having the RCCC image pattern; determine at the discriminator whether the RGB image is machine-generated or comes from the real data distribution; and update at least one weight of the generator when the discriminator determines that the RGB image is machine generated.

title: Method, system and computer program product for evaluating test cases for testing and training a driver assistance system (ADAS) and/or an automated driving system (ADS)
description: The invention relates to a method for evaluating test cases (Ti) for testing and training a driver assistance system (ADAS) and/or an automated driving system (ADS) and/or a driving function for a defined driving task in at least one scenario (SZi), comprising:- Generating (S10) at least one test case (Ti) from a test agent (350) by selecting at least one parameterized scenario (SZpi) and concrete scenario parameters (Pci) and concrete scenario parameter values (PVci) from a scenario database (200) using a test strategy of one Test agents (350) for the driving task; - Generating (S20) a simulation environment with the selected test case (Ti) and carrying out a simulation of the behavior of the driver assistance system (ADAS) and/or an automated driving system (ADS) and/or a driving function in the simulation environment by a simulation module (400) for determining simulation results (450); - evaluating (S30) the simulation results (450) by an evaluation module (500) for determining a criticality index (590) for the test case (Ti).

title: Computer-implemented method for configuring a virtual testing system and training procedures
description: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method for configuring a virtual test system for testing vehicle functions of a motor vehicle, wherein for each of the plurality of input ports (10) of the artifact (12) to be tested, an assignment (S3a) of the highest confidence value (K) having output ports (14) of the at least one further artifact (16) to be tested depending on a first condition (B1), creating (S3b) a list of output ports (14) having the highest confidence values (K) depending on a second condition (B2) or not assigning (S3c) an output port (14) depending on a third condition (B3) for configuring a connection of the input ports (10) of the artifact (12) to be tested to suitable output ports ( 14) of the at least one further artifact (16) to be tested is carried out. The invention further relates to a computer-implemented method for providing a trained machine learning algorithm (A1) for configuring a virtual test system for testing vehicle functions of a motor vehicle.

title: TECHNOLOGIES FOR SIGNAL CONDITIONING OF SIGNALS FOR QUBITS
description: Signal conditioning technologies for signals for qubits are disclosed. In the illustrative embodiment, a finite impulse response filter is applied to a control signal for a target qubit to filter out a frequency corresponding to a collateral qubit. An infinite impulse response filter is then applied to the signal after the finite impulse response filter, which boosts some of the frequencies filtered out by the finite impulse response, thereby narrowing the bandwidth that is filtered out. Such an approach reduces the attenuation of the signal and can be used to reduce memory requirements of quantum/classical interface circuitry.

title: USING A NEURONAL NETWORK TO GENERATE A UP-SAMPLED IMAGE
description: Devices, systems and techniques that use one or more neural networks to generate an upsampled version of one or more images based at least in part on a denoised version of the one or more images. At least one embodiment relates to generating an upsampled, high resolution image from a noisy and denoised version of a low resolution image. At least one embodiment relates to separating components of a low resolution image prior to denoising an image.

title: DATA AUGMENTATION EVALUATION AND AUTOMATIC TRAINING SET IMPROVEMENT THROUGH TYPING
description: The presented embodiments include methods for evaluating augmented training items. The augmented training items may be generated using various augmentation techniques. Disclosed embodiments may generate training sets useful for training a variety of different machine learning models.

title: Control procedure, control system, computer program product and computer-readable medium
description: The present invention relates to a control method (200) for controlling an electric drive device (110) by a control system (10) with a motor vehicle (100), the control method (200) comprising: - calculating (202) at least one input parameter (EP) of the electric drive device (110) by means of a recurrent neural network (RNN) of a first logic device (12) of the control system (10), - calculating (204) at least one operating characteristic (BK) of the electric drive device (110) based on the at least one theoretical input parameter (EP) by means of a forward neural network (FNN) of a second logic device (102) of the motor vehicle (100) of the control system (10), - controlling (206) the electric drive device (110) by a control device (104) of the motor vehicle (100) based on the calculated at least one operating characteristic (BK). Furthermore, the invention relates to a control system (10), comprising a first logic device (12) and a motor vehicle (100) with a second logic device (102) and a control device (104) for executing the control procedure (200) as well as a computer program product (300) and a computer-readable medium (400).

title: Method and apparatus for providing a pharmacokinetic drug dosing regiment
description: Systems and methods for providing a clotting factor VIII (CFVIII) dosing regimen include collecting two blood samples from a patient after an infusion of CFVIII and determining a CFVIII clearance based on the two blood samples, and determining if a patient has a half-life greater than a predetermined threshold. A pharmacokinetic (PK) profile of the patient is determined using a Bayesian model of pharmacokinetic profiles of sampled patients having similar body weight or age of the patient. A first weight is applied to the Bayesian model of pharmacokinetic profiles of sampled patients if the half-life of the patient is greater than the predetermined threshold, and a second weight, less than the first weight, is applied to the Bayesian model of pharmacokinetic profiles of sampled patients if the half-life of the patient is less than the predetermined threshold. A dosing regimen is determined for the patient based on the PK profile.

title: A ply drop optimization design method for composite materials based on ply database
description: The application provides a composite material layer loss optimization design method based on a layer database, which adopts a double isogenic genetic algorithm to generate a composite material layer database meeting engineering requirements, and then, obtaining the layering thickness and layering proportion of each layering region by adopting a finite element method, dividing layering of different types by a connecting matrix, and determining layering data of each type of layering. And (3) matching the layering data in a composite material layering database to obtain layering sequences of layering of various types, and checking and verifying the layering sequences by adopting a finite element method to obtain an optimal layering design scheme. The application can rapidly realize the optimal design of the composite material layer loss, fully plays the advantages of an engineering layer database, avoids the problems of low efficiency and the like of an optimization algorithm in layer loss treatment, and provides an efficient means for the layer loss optimal design of a large composite material structure.

title: A controllable gain RCS active enhancement method and device
description: The present invention discloses a controllable gain RCS active enhancement method and device, the method comprises performing geometric feature extraction and electromagnetic scattering feature extraction on a target three-dimensional CAD model, adopting a tensor network projection algorithm to fuse and generate joint feature characterization data, and performing feature dynamic update according to the target posture; according to the feature characterization data, a nonlinear model is established by adopting a multi-dimensional Lie algebra dynamic mapping, and a prediction model is generated by a chaotic system prediction algorithm; based on the prediction model, a control objective function is constructed by adopting a multi-objective constraint optimization algorithm, and an adaptive control strategy is generated by a hybrid control law synthesis algorithm; according to environmental parameters, an environmental disturbance compensator is used to perform real-time compensation, and control quantity conversion is realized by hardware constraint mapping. The present invention improves the RCS feature extraction accuracy and control response speed, and enhances the system environmental adaptability.

title: Energy storage cluster dynamic optimization control system based on edge calculation
description: The invention discloses an edge calculation-based energy storage cluster dynamic optimization control system, which relates to the technical field of energy storage clusters and comprises the steps of collecting historical data of the energy storage clusters and local data of edge nodes, predicting a time sequence by using an ARIMA model, identifying and correcting nonlinear errors by using a BP neural network, and outputting a final power predicted value. According to the method, through short-term trend prediction of ARIMA and error correction of BP neural network, power fluctuation can be responded more rapidly, power distribution is optimized, stable operation of an energy storage system in a power grid is ensured, distributed computing resources can be fully utilized through training of a local BP neural network model on each edge node, a final power distribution scheme and a transmission path optimization result are output under the synergistic effect of a double-layer optimization model, efficient operation can be ensured under fluctuation of load demand and power supply, energy consumption is reduced, and utilization of renewable energy sources is maximized.

title: Magnetic core loss prediction method
description: This invention discloses a method for predicting magnetic core loss in the field of electromagnetic material prediction technology, comprising: acquiring environmental parameters and a one-dimensional magnetic flux density time series signal of the magnetic core to be tested; performing prediction based on a pre-trained magnetic core loss prediction model to obtain a predicted value of the magnetic core loss; the data processing method of the magnetic core loss prediction model includes converting the environmental parameters into tensor form to obtain parameter feature vectors; converting the one-dimensional magnetic flux density time series signal into a two-dimensional time-spectrum graph; extracting features from the two-dimensional time-spectrum graph to obtain image feature vectors; concatenating the parameter feature vectors and the image feature vectors to obtain a comprehensive feature representation; and processing the comprehensive feature representation through a fully connected layer to obtain the predicted value of the magnetic core loss; wherein, the environmental parameters include continuous variables and discrete variables. This invention solves the problem that existing technologies struggle to accurately predict magnetic core loss under high-frequency or non-sinusoidal excitation.

title: Digital human speech generation system based on large language model
description: The invention relates to the field of data processing technology, and specifically discloses a digital human speech generation system based on a large language model, which is used to solve existing problems. The system comprises a semantic analysis module, a speech generation module, a multimodal synchronization module, a data transmission module and a user feedback module. The semantic analysis module uses a large language model to perform semantic analysis and sentiment analysis on speech and text data input by a user, extracts speech information and sentiment metadata describing a context, and dynamically constructs a semantic structure and sentiment label adapted to an educational scenario according to input content based on an automatic metadata derivation technology. The invention uses a dynamic time warping algorithm and an educational knowledge graph to accurately capture semantic and sentiment changes, flexibly adjust speech speed and pitch, and improve the naturalness of digital human speech generation and the adaptability to educational scenarios.

title: Three-dimensional scene reconstruction method based on cross channel attention mechanism feature fusion
description: The present invention relates to the field of robot visual perception technology, specifically a three-dimensional scene reconstruction method based on cross-channel attention mechanism feature fusion, including: S1, collecting multiple binocular stereo vision images to be three-dimensionally reconstructed after distortion correction and stereo correction, and constructing a training set; S2, constructing a three-dimensional scene reconstruction network; S3, selecting a binocular stereo vision image to input into the three-dimensional scene reconstruction network, and obtaining the predicted disparity of each different stage; S4, constructing a loss function, calculating the loss between the predicted disparity and the real disparity of each different stage, and looping from S3 to S4 until the loss function converges; then updating the weight of the three-dimensional scene reconstruction network; S5, testing the trained three-dimensional scene reconstruction network, and obtaining the three-dimensional depth information of the binocular stereo vision three-dimensional reconstruction scene. The present invention greatly improves the efficiency of context feature fusion and improves the binocular stereo vision disparity estimation performance.

title: Novel feature selection method suitable for disease diagnosis and based on corner lizard algorithm
description: The invention provides a novel feature selection method based on an angular lizard algorithm, which is suitable for disease diagnosis, and belongs to the technical field of machine learning, wherein a basic population agent is generated; binarizing each agent to generate a new feature selection vector group, judging whether the population is the current optimal solution or the worst solution, iterating based on HLOA algorithm, namely subtracting the population before iteration from the population after iteration to obtain a difference vector group, comparing the difference vector group with a threshold value to obtain the feature selection vector group, training and predicting the model, judging the performance by using an fitness function, repeating until all the iterations are completed, and outputting the screened optimal feature selection vector group and a model evaluation result corresponding to the optimal feature selection vector group. The characteristics screened by the corner lizard algorithm can better reflect the essential characteristics and the internal rules of the diseases, and is beneficial to improving the recognition capability of the model to symptoms.

title: A method for denoising transformer voiceprint signals
description: The invention discloses a transformer voiceprint signal denoising method which comprises the following steps of collecting a transformer voiceprint signal by using a sound collecting device, optimizing a bandwidth threshold value and a B spline order of time-varying filtering empirical mode decomposition by adopting an improved cat optimization algorithm, decomposing the collected transformer voiceprint signal into an intrinsic mode function by using the optimized time-varying filtering empirical mode decomposition, sectionally intercepting the intrinsic mode function by adopting a sliding window, constructing the intercepted intrinsic mode function into a third-order signal tensor, inputting the constructed third-order signal tensor into a Bayesian tensor decomposition model for decomposition reconstruction, and restoring the reconstructed third-order signal tensor into a one-dimensional vector according to a tensor construction inverse process.

title: A decoding and encoding method, apparatus and equipment
description: This application provides a decoding and encoding method, apparatus, and device. The decoding method includes: obtaining a first feature corresponding to a current image patch through a first neural network, and obtaining a feature adjustment factor corresponding to the current image patch, wherein the first neural network includes at least one convolutional layer; determining a target feature based on the first feature and the feature adjustment factor; and obtaining a reconstructed image patch corresponding to the current image patch through a second neural network based on the target feature, wherein the second neural network includes at least one convolutional layer. The technical solution of this application can improve encoding and decoding performance.

title: Model-based approach to intelligent automation in a computing domain
description: A method is provided in an example and includes adding two or more objects to a model, receiving a request to establish a relationship between first and second objects of the two or more objects; and determining whether the relationship violates a design policy. The method also includes taking an action based on whether the relationship violates the design policy. More specific embodiments of the method include selecting a process from a set of processes for execution in a determined order, where successful execution of the set of processes in the determined order provisions the two or more objects to establish a model instance in a target. The more specific embodiments may further include determining whether the selected process violates a deployment policy, and taking an action based on whether the selected process violates the deployment policy.

title: Method and apparatus for secured information storage
description: A method, apparatus and computer program, in which an experience matrix (152, EX1) is built (210) based on content. The content is searched (220) using the built experience matrix (152, EX1). References are identified (230) to one or more files potentially comprising searched content. The referenced one or more files are decrypted (230) for verifying whether searched content was present in the referenced one or more files.

title: Alternative training distribution data in machine learning
description: Technologies are generally described for methods and systems in a machine learning environment. In some examples, a method may include retrieving training data from a memory. The training data may include training inputs and training labels. The methods may further include determining a set of datasets based on the training inputs. The methods may further include determining a set of out of sample errors based on the training inputs and based on test data. Each out of sample error may correspond to a respective dataset in the set of datasets. The methods may further include generating alternative distribution data based on the set of out of sample errors. The alternative distribution data may be used to determine weights to be applied to the training data.

title: Information processing device, information presentation method, and program
description: [Problem] To provide an information processing device, an information presentation method, and a program, whereby user actions can be predicted and items can be provided. [Solution] An information processing device comprising: an acquisition unit that obtains sensing data for detected user actions; a recognition unit that recognizes user states on the basis of the obtained sensing data; an action prediction unit that predicts user actions in accordance with the recognized user states; and a presentation unit that presents information in order to provide items to a user, in accordance with the predicted user actions.

title: Scalable complex event processing with probabilistic machine learning models to predict subsequent geolocations
description: Provided is a process, including: obtaining a set of historical geolocations; segmenting the historical geolocations into a plurality of temporal bins; determining pairwise transition probabilities between a set of geographic places based on the historical geolocations; configuring a compute cluster by assigning subsets of the transition probabilities to computing devices in the compute cluster; receiving a geolocation stream indicative of current geolocations of individuals; selecting a computing device in the compute cluster in response to determining that the computing device contain transition probabilities for the received respective geolocation; selecting transition probabilities applicable to the received respective geolocation from among the subset of transition probabilities assigned to the selected computing device; predicting a subsequent geographic place based on the selected transition probabilities.

title: Information processing system, function creation method, and function creation program
description: A table storage unit 81 stores a first table including a target variable and a second table having a granularity different from that of the first table. A function creation unit 82 creates a feature amount generation function for generating a feature amount serving as a variable that may influence the target variable from the first table and the second table. The function creation unit 82 creates a plurality of feature amount generation functions by generating combinations of a correspondence condition element representing a correspondence condition of rows in the first table and the second table and an aggregate method element representing an aggregation method for aggregating data in each column included in the second table for each target variable.

title: Improved general object detection using neural networks
description: In general, certain embodiments of the present disclosure provide methods and systems for object detection by a neural network comprising a convolution-nonlinearity step and a recurrent step. In a training mode, a dataset is passed into the neural network, and the neural network is trained to accurately output a box size and a center location of an object of interest. The box size corresponds to the smallest possible bounding box around the object of interest and the center location corresponds to the location of the center of the bounding box. In an inference mode, an image that is not part of the dataset is passed into the neural network. The neural network automatically identifies an object of interest and draws a box around the identified object of interest. The box drawn around the identified object of interest corresponds to the smallest possible bounding box around the object of interest.

title: Determining a road surface characteristic
description: Systems and methods are provided for determining a road surface characteristic. In one implementation, a system includes at least one processing device programmed to receive, from at least one camera, at least two images representative of an environment of a vehicle; align at least a portion of the at least two images using estimated motion of the vehicle; provide, to a trained system configured to determine a characteristic of the road surface, at least the aligned portions of the at least two images; receive, from the trained system, the determined characteristic of the road surface; and provide, to a vehicle control system, based on at least the determined characteristic of the road surface, control information for changing at least one setting of the vehicle control system.

title: INTELLIGENT SELF-ENERGY FARM SYSTEM BASED ON SALINITY GRADIENT ENERGY PRODUCTION
description: A smart farm system based on salinity generation is disclosed. The SmartPharm system includes a high-concentration solution containing at least one selected from the group consisting of farm facilities where crop cultivation is performed, filtration wastewater, food waste acid fermentation broth, carbon dioxide absorption solution, filtrate solution and fertilizer solution, and a low concentration solution having a concentration lower than that of the high concentration solution And a salt difference generation device for generating electricity using a difference in concentration between the high concentration solution and the low concentration solution, and supplying the growth source used for growing the crop.

title: Learning data management method, device, and program
description: Disclosed is a learning data management method comprising the steps of: acquiring, by a computer, new learning data; performing a test on the acquired new learning data by using a learned model; extracting first learning data in which labeled information is acquired with the accuracy of a predetermined first reference value or more as the test result; deleting the extracted first learning data from the new learning data; and relearning the learned model by using the new learning data from which the extracted learning data is deleted.

title: System and method for learning preferences in dialogue personalization
description: The present teaching relates to method, system, medium, and implementations for user machine dialogue. Historic dialogue data related to past dialogues are accessed and used to learn, via machine learning, expected utilities. During a dialogue involving a user and a machine agent, a representation of a shared mindset between the user and the agent is obtained to characterize the current state of the dialogue, which is then used to update the expected utilities. Continuous expected utility functions are then generated based on the updated expected utilities, wherein the continuous expected utility functions are to be used in determining how to conduct a dialogue with a user.

title: Three-dimensional environment modeling based on a multicamera convolver system
description: Systems, methods, and machine-readable media for determining a three-dimensional environment model of the environment of one or more camera devices, in which image processing for inferring the model may be performed at the camera devices, are described.

title: Machine learning systems for monitoring of semiconductor processing
description: A method of operating a polishing system includes training a plurality of models using a machine learning algorithm to generate a plurality of trained models, each trained model configured to determine a characteristic value of a layer of a substrate based on a monitoring signal from an in-situ monitoring system of a semiconductor processing system, storing the plurality of trained models, receiving data indicating a characteristic of a substrate to be processed, selecting one of the plurality of trained models based on the data, and passing the selected trained model to the processing system.

title: Electronic device, machine learning-based stock trade timing method and storage medium
description: Disclosed by the present application are an electronic device, a machine learning-based stock trade timing method and a storage medium, the method comprising: first, acquiring a preset type of index factor corresponding to a predetermined stock market index on each trading day within a preset time period; next, analyzing the acquired preset type of index factor of each trading day respectively according to a completely pre-trained timing strategy analysis model so as to output a trend factor value corresponding to each trading day; then, performing clustering analysis on the trend factor value corresponding to each trading day according to a predetermined clustering algorithm so as to obtain a trend type corresponding to the trend factor value for each trading day; and finally, according to the obtained trend type corresponding to the trend factor value of each trading day, determining a trade timing strategy. Thus, the efficiency and accuracy of stock trade timing are improved.

title: Motion-based object detection method, object detection apparatus and electronic device
description: A motion-based object detection method includes the steps of extracting, by processing acquired first and second images, one or more regions of interest (ROIs); transforming the one or more ROIs into grayscale; and acquiring, by processing the grayscale ROIs with a deep neural network (DNN) model to classify the objects contained in the one or more ROIs, a classification result of whether the objects contained in the one or more ROIs belong to a given categories. The DNN model comprises N (N is a positive integer and ranged from 4-12) depthwise separable convolution layers; each depthwise separable convolution layer comprises a depthwise convolution layer for applying a single filter to each input channel and a pointwise layer for creating a linear combination of the outputs of the depthwise convolution layer to obtain feature maps of the grayscale ROIs.

title: Method and device for detecting object in real time by means of deep learning network model
description: Disclosed are a method and device for detecting an object in real time. A device for detecting an object according to an embodiment can: receive an input image; extract a first feature map from the input image; detect an object included in the input image on the basis of the first feature map; extract a second feature map, which has a higher resolution than the resolution of the first feature map, from the input image; extract a third feature map from the second feature map on the basis of a region of the detected object; and re-detect the object on the basis of the first feature map and the third feature map.

title: Electronic apparatus for detecting risk factors around vehicle and method for controlling same
description: Disclosed is an electronic apparatus for detecting risk factors around a vehicle. The present electronic apparatus comprises a communication unit, a memory storing at least one computer-executable instruction, and a processor for executing the at least one computer-executable instruction, wherein the processor receives, through the communication unit, an image obtained from a camera located to capture the outside of the vehicle, calculates a rollover index of an external vehicle on the basis of an image of the external vehicle included in the obtained image, and performs a preset operation according to the calculated rollover index.

title: Systems and methods for organizing and finding data
description: A system and associated methods for organizing, representing, finding, discovering, and accessing data. Embodiments represent information and data in the form of a data structure termed a"Feature Graph". A Feature Graph includes nodes and edges, where the edges serve to"connect" a node to one or more other nodes. A node in a Feature Graph may represent a variable, that is, a measurable object, characteristic or factor. An edge in a Feature Graph may represent a measure of a statistical association between a node and one or more other nodes that has been retrieved from a source or sources. Datasets that demonstrate or support the statistical association, or measure the associated variable are" linked to" from the Feature Graph.

title: Cluster based classification for time series data
description: For analyzing time series data monitored on a machine, a device (200) segments the time series data into multiple time segments (230). Further, the device (200) determines a cluster of time segments estimated to have the same dynamics of the time series data. The device (200) then classifies the cluster based on label information associated with at least one of the time segments. If none of the time segments of the cluster has associated label information, the device (200) presents at least a part of the time series data of the cluster to a user (10). Based on a user input received in response to said presenting the time series data, the device (200) classifies the cluster and generates label information associated with the time segments of the cluster. The generated label information indicates a result of classifying the cluster.

title: Carrying out an application using at least one robot
description: The invention relates to a method for carrying out an application using at least one robot (1), comprising the steps, repeated multiple times: ascertaining (S100) a stochastic value of at least one robot parameter and/or at least one environmental model parameter, in particular on the basis of a specified stochastic parameter model and/or using at least one random generator (3a); and carrying out (S200) a simulation, in particular a multi-stage simulation, of the application on the basis of the ascertained stochastic value; the steps: training (S200, S500) at least one control agent and/or at least one classification agent using the simulations by means of machine learning, in particular training a first control agent and/or first classification agent by means of first stages of the simulations, and at least one additional control agent and/or additional classification agent by means of additional stages of the simulations; and carrying out (S600) the application using the robot; and at least one of the steps: configuring (S400) a controller of the robot, by means of which the application is carried out wholly or in part, on the basis of the trained control agent, in particular on the basis of the trained control agents; and/or classifying (S700) the application using the trained classification agent, in particular using the trained classification agents.

title: Graph outcome determination in domain-specific execution environment
description: A method includes obtaining identifiers of entities and symbolic artificial intelligence (AI) models configured to produce outputs responsive to inputs based on events caused by at least one of the entities. At least some of the entities are associated with outputs of respective symbolic AI models and have respective scores corresponding to the respective outputs of the symbolic AI models. The method may include obtaining scenarios, where each scenario includes simulated inputs corresponding to one or more simulated events, and at least some scenarios include a plurality of simulated inputs. The method may also include determining a population of scores of a given entity among the entities, where respective members of the population of scores correspond to respective outputs of the plurality of symbolic AI models, and where the respective outputs correspond to respective scenarios among the scenarios.

title: Algorithmic suggestions based on a universal data scaffold
description: The disclosure is related to a method to securely present a suggestion to a user without disclosing the user's information to a server. The user device can receive from the server a data structure configured to represent the user's information. The user device, after obtaining the user's information from a document, can populate the received data structure with the user's information extracted from the document. The use device can receive from the server a suggestion detection module including a criterion and an executable computer code. The executable computer code can determine whether to present the suggestion at the user device by determining whether the populated user's information satisfies the criterion. Upon determining that the populated user's information satisfies the criterion, the executable computer code can present the suggestion at the user device, without disclosing to the server the user's information.

title: Systems and methods for the early detection and classification of live microorganisms using time-lapse coherent imaging and deep learning
description: A system for the detection and classification of live microorganisms in a sample includes a light source and an incubator holding one or more sample-containing growth plates. A translation stage moves the image sensor and/or the growth plate(s) along one or more dimensions to capture time-lapse holographic images of microorganisms. Image processing software executed by a computing device captures time-lapse holographic images of the microorganisms or clusters of microorganisms on the one or more growth plates. The image processing software is configured to detect candidate microorganism colonies in reconstructed, time-lapse holographic images based on differential image analysis. The image processing software includes one or more trained deep neural networks that process the time-lapsed image(s) of candidate microorganism colonies to detect true microorganism colonies and/or output a species associated with each true microorganism colony.

title: Hardware execution and acceleration of artificial intelligence-based base caller
description: A system for analysis of base call sensor output has memory accessible by the runtime program storing tile data including sensor data for a tile from sensing cycles of a base calling operation. A neural network processor having access to the memory is configured to execute runs of a neural network using trained parameters to produce classification data for sensing cycles. A run of the neural network operates on a sequence of N arrays of tile data from respective sensing cycles of N sensing cycles, including a subject cycle, to produce the classification data for the subject cycle. Data flow logic moves tile data and the trained parameters from the memory to the neural network processor for runs of the neural network using input units including data for spatially aligned patches of the N arrays from respective sensing cycles of N sensing cycles.

title: Apparatus for diagnosing disease causing voice and swallowing disorders and method for diagnosing same
description: The present specification discloses an apparatus for diagnosing a disease and a method for diagnosing a disease, in which: a plurality of voice signals are received to generate a first image signal and a second image signal which are image signals for each voice signal; a plurality of disease probability information for a target disease causing a voice change are extracted by using an artificial intelligence model determined according to the type of each voice signal and a generation method used to generate each image signal for the first image signal and the second image signal for each voice signal; and it is determined whether the target disease is negative or positive on the basis of the plurality of disease probability information.

title: Federated modelling method based on non-uniformly distributed data, and related device
description: A federated modelling method based on non-uniformly distributed data, and a related device, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and may be used in smart hospital systems. The method comprises: splitting samples of original clients having a number of samples which exceeds a preset threshold value, and constructing several corresponding virtual clients according to the split samples; taking un-split original clients and the split virtual clients as training clients, executing local model training in parallel in the various training clients according to an original model, and during the training process, setting a corresponding loss weight for loss of each training client during training; aggregating changes reported by all the training clients after the training, and obtaining an average gradient; using the average gradient to update the original model, and obtaining a global model used for image classification. The method improves a classification effect for non-independent and non-uniformly distributed image data.

title: Fusion splicer, fusion splicing system, and method for fusion splicing optical fiber
description: This fusion splicer comprises an imaging unit, a determination unit, and a splicing unit. The imaging unit captures images of a pair of optical fibers to generate imaging data. The determination unit determines the type of each of the pair of optical fibers on the basis of a plurality of feature values obtained from imaging data from the imaging unit. The determination unit employs determination results from either of a first and a second determination algorithm. The first determination algorithm is predefined using a method other than machine learning on the basis of the correlation between a plurality of feature values obtained for optical fibers from imaging data and the types of said optical fibers. The second determination algorithm includes a determination model. The determination model is created by machine learning that uses sample data that indicates the correspondence between a plurality of feature values obtained for optical fibers from imaging data and the types of said optical fibers. On the basis of determination results from the determination unit, the splicing unit fusion splices the pair of optical fibers per splicing conditions that correspond to the combination of types of the pair of optical fibers.

title: System, method, and computer program product for dynamic user interfaces for rnn-based deep reinforcement machine-learning models
description: A method for evaluating a RNN-based deep learning model includes: receiving model data generated by the RNN-based model, the model data including a plurality of events associated with a plurality of states; generating a first GUI based on the events and states including a chart visually representing a timeline for the events in relation to a parameter value; generating a second GUI including a point chart visually representing a two-dimensional projection of the multi-dimensional intermediate data, each point of the point chart representing a time step and an event from the time step, based on multi-dimensional intermediate data between transformations in the model that connect a state to an event; and perturbing the environment at a time step based on user interaction with at least one of the first and second GUIs.

title: Measuring the effects of augmentation artifacts on a machine learning network
description: In various examples, sets of testing data may be selected and applied to an MLM such that differences in performance of the MLM in the testing between the sets indicates and may be used to determine whether and/or an extent by which the MLM is trained to rely on artifacts. Training data for the MLM may be generated using a first value of a parameter that defines a value of a characteristic of the training data. For testing, first testing data may be selected that corresponds to a second value of the parameter that shifts the value in a first direction and second testing data may be selected that corresponds to a third value of the parameter that shifts the value in a second direction (e.g., opposite the first direction). Various possible actions may be taken based on results of analyzing the differences in performance.

title: Quantum circuit determining method and apparatus, device, and storage medium
description: The present application relates to the technical field of quanta. Disclosed are a quantum circuit determining method and apparatus, a device, and a storage medium. The method comprises: sampling K groups of circuit units from an initial circuit unit pool according to an initial sampling mode, and constructing and generating K candidate quantum circuits; determining performance evaluation indexes corresponding to the K candidate quantum circuits; updating the sampling mode and circuit units in the circuit unit pool on the basis of the performance evaluation indexes; sampling K groups of circuit units from an updated circuit unit pool according to an updated sampling mode, and constructing and generating K candidate quantum circuits; and in the case that a cycle suspension condition is satisfied, determining a target quantum circuit from the K candidate quantum circuits generated at the last time. The solution of the present application has extremely high universality and generality, a quantum circuit used for completing a target task can be efficiently constructed, and the calculation consumption is low.

title: Data transmission method and apparatus
description: Provided are a data transmission method and apparatus. The method comprises: a receiving terminal receiving a first parameter, wherein the first parameter comprises a parameter of a probability distribution of an implicit variable, and the implicit variable is obtained by means of an encoder of a variational auto-encoder encoding first data; the receiving terminal determining the probability distribution according to the first parameter; the receiving terminal performing sampling M times on the probability distribution, so as to obtain M pieces of sampling data, wherein M is a positive integer; and the receiving terminal reconstructing the first data according to the M pieces of sampling data. According to the data transmission method and apparatus in the present application, a first parameter is transmitted, such that a receiving terminal can support sampling multiple times, thereby reducing the transmission amount of data in an air interface, and saving on overheads.

title: Transfer learning method for image classification, related device, and storage medium
description: A transfer learning method for image classification, relating to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises: mapping source domain image data and target domain image data to a manifold space, and obtaining, in the manifold space, a pseudo label of the target domain image data according to the source domain image data (S21); aligning the source domain image data with the target domain image data having the pseudo label, to obtain aligned source domain image data and aligned target domain image data (S22); constructing a classifier by using the aligned source domain image data, and classifying the aligned target domain image data by using the constructed classifier, to obtain a predicted label of the target domain image data (S23); and classifying the target domain image data on the basis of the predicted label, to obtain a classification result (S24). The method is beneficial to improve the effect of transfer learning, so as to improve the accuracy of image classification. In addition, the present invention further relates to the blockchain technology, and the constructed classifier can be stored in a blockchain node.

title: High-altitude parabolic object detection method and apparatus, computer device, and storage medium
description: Provided in the present application are a high-altitude parabolic object detection method and apparatus, a computer device, and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: setting a video monitoring area and collecting target video images in real time; detecting all moving objects in the target video images by means of a background modeling algorithm; tracking detected moving objects by means of a Kalman filtering method and acquiring trajectory characteristics and relevant parameters of the moving objects; on the basis of regular high-altitude parabolic object identification, determining and identifying whether the moving object is a high-altitude parabolic object; using a long short-term memory (LSTM) network classification model for classification, inputting parameters of the moving objects into the LSTM as feature data to acquire classification results, and determining whether the result is a false positive. The high-altitude parabolic object detection method used in the present application has strong anti-interference ability, can effectively filter out the moving objects that are not high-altitude parabolic objects, and can detect high-altitude parabolic object events in the field of view of a surveillance camera in real time; the method has good real-time performances and low missed detection rates.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, and information processing system
description: An information processing device according to the present disclosure includes at least two processors which extract, from first information input into a system, second information necessary for processing formulated as a combinatorial optimization problem, input the extracted second information to calculate an objective function of the combinatorial optimization problem, input the objective function and output the solution to the combinatorial optimization problem, wherein one of the at least two processors outputs the solution to the combinatorial optimization problem.

title: Method and system for performing a digital process
description: Method for performing a digital process (P). In the method, a central system initiates the process with a defined set of at least a a second activity (A2) to be performed by a second, autonomous peripheral system (220). Further, the central system requests said second pe-ripheral system to perform said second activity, the second peripheral system performs said second activity, and a resulting second piece of information (I2) is made available to said central system. Then, the central system updates a process status based on the second piece of information. The invention is characterised in that a second request (R2) comprises a second identifier (ID2), in that said second piece of information is made available to the central system via a digital work product (WP) output by the second peripheral system, in that the central sys-tem collects said work product; finds an anchor piece of information or pattern (I2') in the work product and identifies said second piece of information in said work product using said anchor. Furthermore, the second identifier comprising redundant information and the an-chor piece of information or pattern comprises only a subpart of the second identifier. The invention also relates to a system.

title: Risk probability assessment for cargo shipment operations and methods of use thereof
description: In some embodiments, the present disclosure provides an exemplary method that may include steps of receiving input data for a plurality of identified data records; receiving a plurality of predetermined policy parameters associated with at least one logistics data provider of the plurality of logistics data providers; dynamically enriching the input data by aggregating current data, forecast data, and predictive data; calculating a respective risk probability value associated with each qualifying provider of the plurality of providers; generating a respective dynamic data model associated with each of the qualifying provider of the plurality of providers; dynamically determining a predetermined policy risk threshold in real time for the identified data record; automatically modifying the predetermined policy risk threshold in real time associated with the at least one qualified provider of the plurality of providers; and dynamically selecting a respective data point for each qualified provider of the plurality of providers.

title: Systems and methods for generating 3d models from drone imaging
description: A method comprising receiving a plurality of images of a scene captured by at least one drone; identifying features within the plurality of images; identifying similar images of the plurality of images based on the features identified within the plurality of images; comparing the similar images based on the features identified within the similar images to determine a proportion of features shared by the similar images; selecting a subset of the plurality of images that have a proportion of shared features that meets a predetermined range; generating a first 3D model of the scene from the subset of images using a first 3D model building algorithm; generating a second 3D model of the scene from the subset of images using a second 3D model building algorithm; computing errors for the first and second 3D models; and selecting as the model of the scene the first or second 3D model.

title: Automatic data-driven human skeleton labelling
description: A computer system obtains a plurality of first images of a scene captured concurrently by a plurality of first cameras. Each first image is captured by a respective first camera that is disposed in a distinct location in the scene. The computer system generates a plurality of two- dimensional (2D) feature maps from the plurality of first images, and each first image corresponds a respective subset of 2D feature maps. The plurality of feature maps are projected into a plurality of aggregated volumes of the scene. The computer system generates a plurality of three-dimensional (3D) heatmaps corresponding to the plurality of aggregated volumes of the scene using a heatmap neural network. Automatically and without user intervention, the computer system identifies positions of a plurality of key points in the scene from the plurality of 3D heatmaps. Each key point corresponds to a joint of a person in the scene.

title: Autonomous spreadsheet creation
description: A method includes receiving, by a processing device, a natural language query corresponding to a request to create a document having a tabular structure, identifying, by the processing device, one or more attribute categories pertaining to the document, converting, by the processing device, the natural language query into a data access query for accessing at least one external data source, retrieving, by the processing device from the at least one external data source, a plurality of data items corresponding to the one or more attribute categories, and generating, by the processing device, the document by populating each cell of a plurality of cells of the document with a respective data item of the plurality of data items.

title: Liver ct automatic segmentation method based on deep shape learning
description: Disclosed is a liver CT automatic segmentation method based on deep shape learning. The method comprises: first, constructing a liver segmentation data set, performing preprocessing, and performing coarse segmentation of a liver CT using liver segmentation; second, constructing a liver shape set, learning the shape of the liver using a variational auto-encoder, constructing a geometric shape regularization module, and adding a geometric shape regularization module to liver segmentation, to obtain a liver segmentation model constrained by geometric shape consistency and used for automatic segmentation of a liver CT. The present invention novelly adds a represented shape feature to an existing deep segmentation network by means of a regularization module, and prior shape information is introduced into a training process of a convolution neural network, so that the regularity and generalization ability of the segmentation model can be improved, and the segmentation result is more consistent with medical anatomical features of a standard liver. The present invention has the characteristics of automation, high precision, and expandable migration, and can realize automatic accurate segmentation of large abdominal organs, such as the liver.

title: Skin-like stretchable neuromorphic devices for artificial intelligence applications
description: This disclosure generally relates to neuromorphic computing devices, systems, and platforms for artificial intelligence applications. Specifically, the disclosed platform is stretchable, and devices fabricated based on such a platform can thus be configured to adhere to human skin conformably even in areas of the skin that frequently stretch, bend, or otherwise deform. The devices may be integrated to form a wearable and stretchable artificial neural network (ANN) circuit for performing predictive health monitoring and other functions. For example, each neuron of the ANN may be based on a neuromorphic organic-electrochemical-transistor (OECT) structure and each OECT structure may be based on a redox-active electrochemical cell. The ANN can be trained and updated as the device is being worn on human body. The electronic characteristics relevant the neuromorphic computation of the ANN may be minimally impacted by repeated stretching of the device.

title: Multimodal learning framework for carbon footprint prediction for healthcare procurement and waste management activities, system, method, and computer program product
description: The present disclosure relates to a multimodal system (100) comprising of a plurality of healthcare centers (102), a data repository engine (104), an information processing engine (106), a pattern prediction engine (108), a live emission recording engine (110), an inventory engine a procurement engine (114), an evaluation engine (116) and a supplier (118), and a method (200) thereof.

title: Mouse device with detection function of non-human mouse events and detection method thereof
description: The present invention provides a mouse device with a detection function of non-human mouse events and a detection method thereof. A driver receives a plurality of movement mouse events through a computer device from a mouse device, executes a non-human movement detection on the movement mouse events to determine each movement mouse event as a suspicious event or a human-made event, executes an interference process when the suspicious events meet a non-human critical condition, and executes the plurality of movement mouse events when the suspicious events do not meet the non-human critical condition.
