The present invention can effectively detect non-human movement mouse events, and execute interference on the non-human movement mouse events to deter non-human operations.

title: Image generation using a neural network
description: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques to generate an image. In at least one embodiment, one or more neural networks are to generate a second image based, at least in part, on a first image and information indicating zero or more differences between the first and second image.

title: Hot water supply system capable of hot water preheating and malfunction determination method using same
description: A hot water supply system according to the present invention comprises a boiler which heats water supplied from a direct water pipe to provide same to a hot water pipe and a hot water circulation valve which connects or separates the hot water pipe to or from the direct water pipe on the basis of a valve operation temperature, wherein a preheating time may be learned on the basis of a flow rate of water circulated through the hot water pipe, the hot water circulation valve, the direct water pipe, and the boiler when a preheating operation is performed, and a malfunction of the hot water circulation valve can be determined through flow rate detection without a separate device.

title: System and method for managing access to event-related recommendations
description: A system for managing access to event-related recommendation(s) is provided. The system includes a processing subsystem which includes an input module (40) which receives input(s) upon registration of a user. The processing subsystem also includes an object segregation module (50) which recognizes object(s) from each of multiple frames of streaming multimedia and segregates the object(s) under a first category. The processing subsystem also includes a linking module (60) which identifies object-related information about the object(s) in a system database, links multiple network-based informative systems with the system database when the object-related information remains unidentified in the system database, identifies the object-related information in the multiple network-based informative systems, links the object-related information with the object(s). The processing subsystem also includes a recommendation module (70) which trains a recommendation-related model, generates the event-related recommendations corresponding to multiple preferred events, and provides link(s) for the event-related recommendation(s), thereby managing the access to the event-related recommendation(s).

title: Attention neural networks with parallel attention and feed-forward layers
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for performing a machine learning task on a network input to generate a network output. One of the systems comprises an attention neural network configured to perform the machine learning task, the attention neural network comprising a plurality of attention layers, each attention layer comprising an attention sub-layer that is arranged in parallel with a feed-forward sub-layer.

title: Model processing method and apparatus, device, computer-readable storage medium, and computer program product
description: The present application provides a model processing method and apparatus, a device, and a computer-readable storage medium. The method comprises: acquiring model information of a three-dimensional model to be processed and at least one preset angle of view; on the basis of the model information, determining a model visible region of the three-dimensional model which corresponds to the at least one angle of view; on the basis of the model visible region corresponding to the at least one angle of view, determining a model visible region corresponding to the three-dimensional model; and generating a processed three-dimensional model by using the model visible region corresponding to the three-dimensional model.

title: Method and system for predicting and/or detecting the presence of a lesion
description: The present invention relates to a computer-implemented method of predicting and/or detecting the presence of a lesion in a human or animal tissue, the method comprising: identifying a tissue type based on image data of the human or animal tissue using a first model, and predicting and/or detecting the presence of a lesion in the tissue based on the image data and the tissue type using a second model.

title: Method for processing recorded audio content
description: The invention concerns a method for processing recorded audio content, said audio content having at least two timely synchronized audio signals recorded by a respective microphone, said microphone associated with a respective sound source, wherein each of the at least two audio signals comprise a speech component associated with the respective sound source and a secondary component unrelated to said respective sound source. The method comprising the steps of separating from each of the at least two audio signals a clean data stem, a crosstalk stem and a noise stem. The various stems are processed individually and then combining back together.

title: Serving cell-based data collection and model monitoring mechanism for ai/ml positioning
description: This disclosure describes a serving cell-based data collection and model monitoring mechanism for AI/ML based positioning. Specifically, this disclosure provides the behavior of serving cells and PRUs to collect assistance data with the channel characteristics of current environment, and it is also introduced in detail how the serving cell provides the appropriate assistance data and AI/ML model according to the changing environment to the mobile UE for UE-side model training and model monitoring/update.

title: Method and device for determining combination of microbial strains
description: Embodiments of the present specification relate to methods for optimizing a combination of microbial strains and predicting the growth state of the strains. To achieve the above-described objective, a method for determining a combination of microbial strains, according to an embodiment of the present specification, may include the steps of: obtaining genomic analysis information about a target microorganism; obtaining first metabolic information about each of a plurality of first microbial colonies including the target microorganism; estimating first growth index information for each of the plurality of first microbial colonies by using the genome analysis information and the metabolic information as inputs to a first model; and determining a combination of strains on the basis of at least one of the metabolic information and the growth index information.

title: Hybrid multipy-accumulation operation with compressed weights
description: A compute block can perform hybrid multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations. The compute block may include a weight compressing module and a processing element (PE) array. The weight compression module may select a first group of one or more weights and a second group of one or more weights from a weight tensor of a DNN (deep neural network) layer. A weight in the first group is quantized to a power of two value. A weight in the second group is quantized to an integer. The integer and the exponent of the power of two value may be stored in a memory in lieu of the original values of the weights. A PE in the PE array includes a shifter configured to shift an activation of the layer by the exponent of the power of two value and a multiplier configured to multiplying the integer with another activation of the layer.

title: Single-channel spike potential classification method based on comparative learning, and related device
description: Disclosed in the present invention are a single-channel spike potential classification method based on comparative learning, and a related device. The method comprises: using an electrode to acquire single-channel electrical signals fired by a plurality of neurons, and amplifying and demodulating the electrical signals, so as to obtain digital signals fired by required neurons; performing bandpass filtering on the digital signals, and performing spike value lookup to obtain a spike potential; performing data enhancement processing on the spike potential to obtain three types of enhanced data, and using the spike potential and the three types of enhanced data to train a neural network model, so as to obtain a trained neural network model; and for a newly collected target digital signal that has been subjected to bandpass filtering, obtaining a target spike potential by means of spike value lookup, on the basis of the trained neural network model, performing classification according to the target spike potential, and outputting a classification probability of the target spike potential. By means of the present invention, a classification probability of a spike potential in an original signal fired by a neuron can be quickly identified, and an extremely high classification accuracy can be finally obtained.

title: Calculation program, calculation method, and information processing device
description: A calculation program that, when repeating a process for searching for a solution by evolutionary computing based on an evaluation function for evaluating a plurality of objective functions, causes a computer to execute a process for controlling a solution search direction in accordance with the distribution of a resulting palate solution and searching for a solution of the next generation.

title: Coal and rock identification method based on partial least squares, electronic device, and medium
description: A coal and rock identification method based on partial least squares, comprising: step E1, acquiring P1 coal sample sets and Q1 rock sample sets; step E2, determining the number F of principal components and F principal component extraction architectures on the basis of all samples, wherein the sum of the interpretability of overall sample data corresponding to the F principal component extraction architectures is greater than a preset first interpretability threshold, and the sum of the interpretabilities of corresponding independent variable spectral line wavelengths on a dependent variable coal and rock classification result is greater than a preset second interpretability threshold; step E3, extracting F principal components corresponding to each sample; step E4, using the F principal components corresponding to each sample as the input of a preset classification model, using a coal and rock W classification result as the output of the preset classification model, and training to obtain a W classification model; and step E5, carrying out coal and rock identification on the basis of the W classification model. The method simplifies the complexity of sample input data, and improves the accuracy of coal and rock classification.

title: Video generation method, and server
description: Provided in the present disclosure are a video generation method, and a server. The method in the present disclosure comprises: acquiring description text and a reference image, which are used for generating a target video; inputting the description text and the reference image into a double-branch video generation model, and by means of the video generation model, generating, on the basis of the reference image, sequence frames of the target video which semantically match the description text, wherein the video generation model comprises an image reference branch and a video generation branch, the image reference branch is used for extracting a reference image feature of the reference image, and the video generation branch is used for generating the sequence frames of the target video on the basis of the reference image feature and text features of the description text; and further generating the target video according to the sequence frames of the target video. In this way, image features of a given reference image can be introduced into a video generation branch, and the given reference image is diffused on the basis of text features of description text so as to generate a target video, thereby improving the quality of the generated video.

title: Device and method for optical signal processing
description: The invention relates to a device (100) for optical signal processing, comprising: at least one image capturing device (10) for generating at least one image of an environment (200), wherein the at least one image has multiple pixels and at least one analogue pixel signal (1) can be generated for each pixel; means (20) for reading the at least one analogue pixel signal (1); at least one light generation device (30) for generating at least one optical signal (2); at least one modulator (40) for modulating the at least one optical signal (2) on the basis of the at least one analogue pixel signal (1); at least one optical processor (50) for processing the at least one modulated optical signal (3), wherein at least one processed optical signal (4) can be generated via the processing, wherein the at least one processed optical signal (4) represents at least one result value of the signal processing, and a method for optical signal processing.

title: Computer session management using a language model
description: According to an aspect, a method includes receiving, by a language model, session state information, generated by a browser application, about a computer session of a user, receiving, by the language model, a user-generated query including a natural language description about a browser tab, generating, by the language model, a textual response about the browser tab using contextual data, the contextual data including the session state information, and providing the textual response on a user device.

title: Defect detection method and related device
description: The present disclosure belongs to the technical fields of computers and defect detection. Provided are a defect detection method and a related device. The method comprises: obtaining an image to be processed; processing said image by means of a feature extraction module in a deep-learning defect detection model, wherein the feature extraction module comprises an intermediate feature layer, the intermediate feature layer comprises a dropout layer, and the dropout layer is configured to randomly drop features which are extracted by means of the intermediate feature layer processing said image, such that a plurality of features subjected to random dropout are obtained after said image is processed by means of the feature extraction module; by means of a detection head in the deep-learning defect detection model, processing the plurality of features subjected to random dropout, so as to obtain a plurality of category prediction results and a plurality of position prediction results of defects in said image; and obtaining category detection results, position detection results, category uncertainties and position uncertainties of the defects in said image according to the plurality of category prediction results and the plurality of position prediction results of the defects. (FIG. 1)

title: Training data acquisition apparatus and training data acquisition method
description: An AI model generation apparatus 2 is provided with: a photographed image data storage unit 211 that stores image data of a 3D image acquired by photographing a weld part by a 3D sensor 36; and a processor 22 that identifies, on the basis of an input to a first input device 24 by a user, a correction area on the XY coordinate plane of the image data stored in the photographed image data storage unit 211, amends the Z coordinate of the correction area to a value in a state of no weld defect in the image data stored in the photographed image data storage unit 211, and acquires the amended image data as image data to be used for machine learning.

title: Cross-layer energy efficient radio access network power control
description: The technology described herein is directed towards a distributed cross-layer intelligent power control engine in a communications network architecture that determines power control per user equipment (UE) per access point, using an AI / ML model at each layer. One application (e.g., in a non-real time controller) outputs candidate minimum required signal-to-noise-plus-interference ratio (SINR) policy, and another application (e.g., in a near-real time controller) adjusts the candidate SINR data to provide an environment-aware refined SINR threshold. A third, real time application (e.g., in a real time controller) determines the real time power allocation coefficients per UE per access point based on current conditions such as channel coefficients / parameters and/or UE enrichment information. The distributed cross-layer intelligent power control engine can optimize spectral efficiency and energy efficiency within SINR constraints for a group of UEs based on policy data, and adjust as the network environment changes.

title: Method of ai/ml model re-training in a wireless network
description: Methods of using pre-configured AI/ML (artificial intelligence/machine learning) based model dataset adaptation in wireless mobile communication system including base stations (e.g., gNB) and mobile stations (e.g., UE). If an AI/ML model is applied to a radio access network, signaling of model dataset information exchange can be heavily congested based on different model execution environments with varying models when a model drift occurs. Therefore, model operation (e.g., model re-training/updating) can be set up between the network and the UE by selecting different subset(s) of features/datasets adaptively.

title: Learnable deformation for point cloud self-supervised learning
description: A processor-implemented method includes obtaining, with a backbone artificial neural network, an original feature map of point cloud data. The method also includes deforming the point cloud data, with a deformation artificial neural network, into a number of deformed point cloud objects based on the original feature map of point cloud data. The method further includes combining the deformed point cloud objects into a mixed point cloud. The method still further includes extracting, with the backbone artificial neural network, a mixed feature map from the mixed point cloud. The method includes extracting a number of deformed feature maps from the deformed point cloud objects. The method still further includes computing, with a contrastive module, a loss for the backbone artificial neural network and for the deformation artificial neural network based on the mixed feature map and the deformed feature maps.

title: Live-broadcast monitoring processing method and system, and device and medium
description: Disclosed in the present invention are a live-broadcast monitoring processing method and system, and a device and a medium. The method comprises: performing data collection and aggregation processing of a whole live-broadcast process, so as to obtain monitoring source data, wherein the monitoring source data comprises monitoring data and historical data; using the monitoring source data as a training data set for model training processing, so as to obtain a large language model; performing anomaly detection processing on the monitoring source data by means of the large language model, so as to obtain a fault result; and performing real-time search and analysis processing on the fault result by means of combining the large language model and an internal search engine, so as to obtain an alarm handling scheme, wherein the alarm handling scheme comprises alarm trend information and a solution. By means of applying a large voice model and an internal search engine to a real-time monitoring system, and quickly processing and querying data, the embodiments of the present invention realize timely discovery and processing of anomalous data, and can be widely applied to the technical field of operation and maintenance monitoring.

title: Information processing device and information processing system
description: [Problem] To perform training to facilitate switching of a sensor modality, or, to execute information processing using training results. [Solution] This information processing device comprises a calculation unit. The calculation unit: acquires first data output by a first sensor and second data output by a second sensor that acquires information of a type different from that of the first sensor; inputs the first data to a first converter to acquire a first intermediate expression; inputs the second data to a second converter to acquire a second intermediate expression; and trains the second converter on the basis of the first intermediate expression and the second intermediate expression.

title: Optimization of mapping and demapping for wireless communication channels
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer-storage media, for optimization of mapping and demapping for wireless communication channels. In some implementations, a transmitter includes a mapper that has been trained through machine learning training. The transmitter is trained based at least in part on demapper characteristics for a demapper of a receiver. The mapper has parameter values that have been trained to at least partially compensate for non-linear distortion of signals in a wireless communication channel, including through application of non-linear distortion during training. The mapper is configured to map data to be transmitted to symbols in a symbol constellation for transmission. The parameter values of the mapper define characteristics of the symbol constellation including amplitude or phase of the symbols in the symbol constellation.

title: Content service apparatus and method
description: A content service apparatus and method are disclosed. The content service apparatus, according to an aspect of the present invention, comprises a communication circuit and a processor connected to the communication circuit, wherein, when a content generation request signal including first query information is received from a user terminal via the communication circuit, the processor may use a generative AI to generate first response information corresponding to the first query information by using pre-registered content, generate new content on the basis of the first response information, and calculate a usage fee for each piece of content on the basis of a reference ratio in which each piece of content is used in generating the new content.

title: Artificial intelligence enhanced functional electrical stimulation for central nervous system disabilities
description: Provided herein are systems for treating a paralysis patient in need of controlled motion to improve quality of life, and related methods. The systems comprise an implantable system formed from a hub, various electrodes, such as spinal cord (upstream) electrode, periphery nerve (downstream) electrode and an external system formed of communication pod implanted just under the skin, a computing core, and a plurality of motion sensors. A software system, providing AI compatibility are used to supply the computing core, and thereby implanted electrodes, with signal. In this manner, the specially positioned electrodes, upstream of the spinal cord injury and downstream of the spinal cord injury, can provide safe and reliable patient motion.

title: Qubit calibration method and apparatus, electronic device, computer program product, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The present application discloses a qubit calibration method and apparatus, and a storage medium. The method comprises: for a first calibration function in a qubit calibration graph, acquiring a general function substructure corresponding to the first calibration function; on the basis of the general function substructure, constructing a general function prototype structure corresponding to the first calibration function, the general function prototype structure having a function pointer, and the function pointer pointing to the first calibration function; on the basis of the general function prototype structure, constructing a second calibration function corresponding to the first calibration function; calling the second calibration function, so as to call the first calibration function by means of the function pointer; and running the first calibration function, so as to execute qubit calibration on the basis of the qubit calibration graph.

title: Telecommunications switch infrastructure for real-time audio interpretation and recording via artificial intelligence agents
description: A telecommunications switch-type platform positioned between a private-branch exchange and a data network dynamically hosts artificial-intelligence agents that interpret, transcribe, translate and transliterate live call traffic while the session is in progress. Machine-readable instructions stored in local memory instantiate, migrate and terminate the agents on demand across dedicated processing resources such as field-programmable gate arrays, application-specific integrated circuits or system-on-chip devices, thereby maintaining end-to-end latency below 250 milliseconds. An integrated call-audio recorder captures bidirectional media streams for secure archiving without interrupting service. The platform exposes a network interface that passes both signalling and media traffic, enabling seamless deployment inside call-centre or enterprise environments and compatibility with softswitch architectures conforming to class-4 Computational Interpretation of Communication using Artificial Intelligence standards. The same functional stack is deliverable as a computer-implemented method and as a non-transitory machine-readable medium storing the instructions executed by the processing resources.

title: DISTRIBUTED MULTI-PART SECURITY MODEL LEARNING APPARATUS FOR PRIVACY PROTECTION
description: Methods, systems and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for learning a multi-party secure logistic regression model. One of the methods includes receiving, at a plurality of secure computing nodes (SCNs), a plurality of random numbers from a random number provider; encrypting, at each SCN, data stored at the SCN using random numbers received; iteratively updating a Secure Logistic Regression Model (SLRM) using the encrypted data from each SCN; and after the iterative update of the SLRM, to deliver a result of the SLRM, the result being configured to allow the realization of a service by each SCN.

title: Method and device for word embedding on basis of context information and morphological information of word
description: The present invention relates to a method and device for word embedding on the basis of context information and morphological information of a word. A method for word embedding according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: processing a sentence by replacing an out of vocabulary (OOV) word in the sentence to be learned with an unknown token; inputting characters of a target word excluding the out of vocabulary word in the processed sentence as an input of a context character model to be learned; combining surrounding context vectors for surrounding words of the target word in the sentence so as to set the context character model as an initial state; and learning the context character model such that an error can be minimized between predicted embedding of the target word and real embedding of the target word, the predicted embedding being generated by connecting a forward hidden state and a backward hidden state calculated from the context character model.

title: Adaptive adversarial system to structure competing interests
description: Data describing how multiple users interact with an online system is gathered. Macro-level data is extracted from the collected data that is associated with overall trends of products offered by the online system. A machine learning model is trained using the macro-level data to receive features of a product as input to generate a supply-demand curve of the product. The machine learning model is applied to multiple products to generate a supply-demand curve for each product. Placements of at least a subset of products are determined based on the supply-demand curves of the products. A user's interaction with at least one product is predicted, upon the placements of the subset of products being presented to the user. The adjusted placements of the subset of products are presented to the user on a graphical user interface.

title: Adapting media storage based on user interest as determined by biometric feedback
description: The present invention discloses a system, method, apparatus, and computer usable product code adapting a media stream based upon biometric feedback. The system can include one or more biometric sensor, a media handling component, an importance inference engine, and a media processing component. The biometric sensor can be able to receive biometric feedback from at least one user. The media handling component can be a media creation component (e.g., video recorder, camera, etc.) and/or a media playback component (e.g., video player, music player, etc.). The importance inference engine can be configured to analyze biometric feedback received from the biometric sensor to determine an emotional interest level that a provider of the biometric feedback has in the media of the media handling component. The media processing component can modify the media of the media handling component based upon the emotion interest level determined by the importance inference engine.

title: System and method for selecting a package structural design
description: A system and method of selecting a package model may include maintaining a data structure of a plurality of package models. Each package model may have a plurality of package model attributes including at least a size and a style. A user input may be received that is descriptive of a desired package capability. The user input may be analyzed using a semantic reasoner to determine one or more desired attributes. One or more package models may be automatically selected by accessing the data structure wherein, for each selected package model, each desired attribute satisfies the corresponding package model attribute. The one or more selected package models may be presented.

title: Real-time intelligent virtual characters with learning capabilities
description: A system, method, and computer-readable instructions for real-time characters with learning capabilities. A plurality of rules are defined in a rules-based system, each of the rules defining a condition that determines a behavior of a virtual agent when the rule is triggered by the condition being satisfied so that upon triggering of multiple rules at the same time, each of the behaviors of the multiple rules whose conditions were satisfied are combined into a resultant behavior for the virtual agent. This resultant behavior is compared with a desired behavior to providing feedback in the form of rewards or punishments to each of the multiple rules based on their corresponding contribution to the resultant behavior as compared to the desired behavior.

title: Bayesian classifier system using a non-linear probability function and method thereof
description: A classification system and method are provided, wherein the classification system includes a memory device, a processor communicatively connected to the memory device, and an input communicatively connected to the processor, wherein the input is configured to receive data comprising at least one object that is to be classified as one of an object of interest (OOI) and a nuisance of interest (NOI) based upon at least one non-Boolean attribute of the object, wherein the processor is configured as a Bayesian classifier to classify the object based upon the non-Boolean attribute using a non-linear probability function.

title: Medical system, apparatus and method
description: There is provided a method of generating a pulmonary index value of a patient, which includes receiving two or more measured patient parameters, wherein at least one of the measured parameters originates from a pulmonary sensor; and computing the pulmonary index value based on the two or more measured patient parameters.

title: Semi-supervised random decision forests for machine learning using mahalanobis distance to identify geodesic paths
description: Semi-supervised random decision forests for machine learning are described, for example, for interactive image segmentation, medical image analysis, and many other applications. In examples, a random decision forest comprising a plurality of hierarchical data structures is trained using both unlabeled and labeled observations. In examples, a training objective is used which seeks to cluster the observations based on the labels and similarity of the observations. In an example, a transducer assigns labels to the unlabeled observations on the basis of the clusters and certainty information. In an example, an inducer forms a generic clustering function by counting examples of class labels at leaves of the trees in the forest. In an example, an active learning module identifies regions in a feature space from which the observations are drawn using the clusters and certainty information; new observations from the identified regions are used to train the random decision forest.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and program for evaluating content
description: There is provided an information processing apparatus including an evaluation giving unit that gives an evaluation based on a second user to an item in a list created on a basis of a first user, and a display control unit that controls display of the list, on a basis of the evaluation based on the second user.

title: Reconfigurable processing unit
description: A processing device includes a processor core and a number of calculation modules that each is configurable to perform any one of operations for a convolutional neuron network system. A first set of the calculation modules are configured to perform convolution operations, a second set of the calculation modules are reconfigured to perform averaging operations, and a third set of the calculation modules are reconfigured to perform dot product operations.

title: Integrated drive and readout circuit for superconducting qubits
description: Embodiments of the present invention are directed to an integrated drive and readout circuit assembly. Directional couplers are configured to connect to qubit-resonator systems. Diplexers are coupled to the directional couplers. A microwave signal combiner is coupled to the diplexers.

title: Learning method for self-organizing neural networks and device for carrying out the method
description: The method involves associating the individual neurons in the network with points in the pattern space. The network pattern (U) is presented and prototypes (DeltaWi) changed according to a learning specification in which a winner neuron is determined for each pattern which best represents that pattern. A learning step is finally conducted according to the specification. According to the specification, the magnitude of the variation of the prototype depends on its distance from the winner neuron and the variation is only performed under the conditions in which the pattern spatial distance (U-Wi) of the neuron prototype to the presented pattern dos not exceed a freely defined distance parameter.

title: Method and apparatus for the extraction of a subset of objects by optimizing a measure, using a neural network
description: A neural network includes a stage of construction for a recursive neural network from objects and relations between these objects by associating to each object the binary output of a neuron pi (t) at time t: pi (t) = 1 implies that the object belongs to a searched for sub-assembly; pi (t) = 0 implies that the object does not belong to a searched for sub-assembly. A utilisation stage of an interruption method obtains two-by-two object sub-assemblies not in or in relation and to pass from one sub-assembly to another whilst trying to improve the quality of the solution. An initialisation stage is provided for the output and the potential associated with each neuron. A dynamic recursive running stage is provided for the network. A choosing stage selects the best sub-assemblies listed by comparison with the solution quality. <IMAGE>

title: Object modeling for computer simulation and animation
description: An abstract simulation entity definition for use in real time computer simulation and animation (100) encapsulates both the physical and behavioral characteristics of a display object. The simulation entity provides a unique "genetic plan" (106) containing abstract attributes that may be shared among objects. Each simulation entity has the knowledge of common operations, and the ability to communicate with other simulation entities via communication pathway (102).

title: Device and method for determining adversarial perturbations of machine learning
description: A computer-implemented method (700) for determining adversarial perturbations to an input signal (x) of a machine learning system (60), particularly a sensor signal or a feature of a sensor signal. In the method (700), a best perturbation is iteratively determined, the best perturbation is provided as an adversarial perturbation after a predetermined number of iterations, and at least one iteration includes: sampling (701); - applying the sampled perturbation to the input signal, thereby determining (702) potential adversarial examples; and - from the machine learning system for potential adversarial examples. determining (703) an output signal of the input signal; determining (704) a loss value characterizing the deviation between the output signal and a desired output signal corresponding to the input signal; the loss value being a previous loss value; , then setting the best perturbation to the sampled perturbation (705). [Selection diagram] Figure 1

title: Semiconductor device
description: A semiconductor device capable of shortening the processing time of a neural network is provided. A memory MEM1 stores compressed weight parameters WP. A plurality of multiply-accumulators MAC1 to MACn perform multiply-accumulate operations on a plurality of pixel data Di and a plurality of weight parameters W. A decompressor 22 restores the compressed weight parameters WP stored in the memory MEM1 to a plurality of weight parameters W. A weight parameter memory WRAM stores the plurality of weight parameters W restored by the decompressor 22. A DMA controller DMAC1 transfers the plurality of weight parameters W from the memory MEM1 to the weight parameter memory WRAM via the decompressor 22. A sequence controller 21 writes the plurality of weight parameters W stored in the weight parameter memory WRAM to a weight parameter buffer WBF at a write timing. [Selected Figure] FIG.

title: Systems and methods for on-board targeted advertising delivery of mobile platforms
description: Techniques for providing targeted electronic advertising on aircraft are described. A server onboard the aircraft may establish a connection with a client device onboard the aircraft. The server may identify a user profile associated with a user of the client device. The user profile may include itinerary information for the user of the client device. The server may select targeted electronic advertisements based in part on the itinerary information. A targeted electronic advertisement may be selected from a data store of electronic advertisements. Targeted electronic advertisements may be transmitted to a client device for display using a graphical user interface on the client device. [Selection diagram] Figure 1A

title: Computerized system for managing preparation and prosecution of applications in various countries for protection of industrial property rights
description:
A computerized system for managing preparation 
and prosecution of applications for protection of 
industrial property rights in various contries includes 
a data memory which stores a rule data for controlling 
input, output and internal operation of the system. The 
rule data includes information concerning required 
actions at each step of prosecution of applications in 
each country when the applications are filed. Such rule 
data is so designed as to provide proper guidance to the 
operator for guiding proper entry of input data in order 
to avoid error in operation. Preferably, the rule data 
consists of common rule data components which are 
commonly applicable for applications in any country and 
local rule data components which are specifically 
applicable for a specific country.

title: Marketing prediction method and device and computer equipment
description: The present application discloses a marketing prediction method, device and computer equipment. The method includes: obtaining the image features of the marketing account, the image features at least include: the business usage of the marketing account; using a preset model to analyze the image features of the marketing account to determine the probability of the marketing account handling the target business, wherein the preset model is trained based on conditional noise and a training data set, wherein the conditional noise is determined based on the training data set, and the training data set at least includes: historical marketing data, and the conditional noise is used for the generator in the preset model to generate false samples; outputting the prediction result of the marketing account. The present application solves the technical problem of low prediction accuracy in the related art.

title: Integrated prediction method based on empirical mode decomposition algorithm and random configuration network
description: The present application discloses an integrated prediction method based on an empirical mode decomposition algorithm and a stochastic configuration network in the technical field of power load demand prediction. First, the load demand time series is decomposed into several intrinsic mode functions (IMFs); then, each extracted IMF is modeled using a data-dependent stochastic configuration network (SCNs) so that the trend of these IMFs can be accurately predicted. Finally, the prediction results of all IMFs are combined by unbiased or weighted summation to obtain an aggregate output of load demand.

title: Method and apparatus for measurement prediction in a wireless communication system
description: A method and apparatus for measurement prediction in a wireless communication system are provided. A wireless device receives a measurement configuration including (i) a measurement object, (ii) a reporting condition, and (iii) information about a prediction time from a network. The wireless device derives at least one predicted measurement result for the measurement object based on the prediction time. Based on determining that at least one predicted measurement result satisfies the reporting condition, the wireless device sends the at least one predicted measurement result.

title: A method and system for orthopedic ultrasound image segmentation based on machine learning
description: The present invention discloses an orthopedic ultrasonic image segmentation method and system based on machine learning, and the method includes data acquisition, basic preprocessing, edge information enhancement, feature encoding and decoding, and ultrasonic image segmentation. The present invention relates to the field of ultrasonic image segmentation technology, and specifically refers to an orthopedic ultrasonic image segmentation method and system based on machine learning. The present invention adopts a method of generating mid-valley ultrasonic parameter and entropy ultrasonic parameter image to enhance edge information, highlighting edge information; adopts a feature encoding and decoding structure combined with a network structure of a feature fusion module, and adopts a machine learning method to perform feature encoding and decoding based on the ultrasonic parameter image data, thereby improving the performance of feature fusion; adopts a channel-aware fusion unit to perform feature fusion optimization, thereby improving the performance of feature fusion in the feature map, and refining high-quality ultrasonic image features.

title: Complex background material tracking method
description: The present invention relates to a method for tracking materials with complex backgrounds. The method comprises adding an ID code to the surface of the material, using a camera to collect the original image of the surface of the material, processing the original image, establishing an initial model M0 and predicting a new ID tag; in the final prediction stage, predicting the possible probability of each character for each position of the ID tag, and the prediction result is in the form of a matrix. After softmax processing, the ID tag is spliced into a complete ID tag, and finally the ID tag is transmitted to the corresponding position of the database for self-increment; the ID tag of each material is sent to the back-end database for unified management. The present invention can improve the recognition accuracy of character recognition when it is seriously interfered by the external background, and accelerate the implementation speed of the recognition algorithm. By collecting data online and continuously updating the model for online incremental learning, the cost of manual labeling can be saved, the time for the implementation of the deep learning algorithm can be greatly reduced, and the recognition accuracy can be further improved.

title: Construction method of cross-camera agent contrast loss based on self-adaptive weight
description: The present invention relates to the field of image retrieval technology, and in particular, provides a method for constructing a cross-camera proxy contrast loss based on adaptive weights. The method includes obtaining a preprocessed training data set; inputting the preprocessed training data set into a convolutional neural network to obtain global features; constructing a cross-camera proxy contrast loss function through the global features; constructing an adaptive weight of the cross-camera proxy contrast loss according to the cross-camera proxy contrast loss function; training a network using a cross-camera proxy contrast loss fused with adaptive weights, optimizing network parameters through back propagation, and optimizing the network. Through the adaptive weights, the network model can adjust the contribution of each sample to the loss according to the relationship between the similarity between samples and the center of mass of camera features, and samples with similar features will be given greater weights, thereby prompting the model to pay more attention to these important samples during the training process and improving the efficiency of feature learning.

title: Model reasoning method, terminal device, storage medium and computer program product
description: The application discloses a model reasoning method, terminal equipment, storage medium and computer program product, relating to the technical field of artificial intelligence, wherein the model reasoning method comprises the steps of obtaining an original request text of a user; the method comprises the steps of carrying out semantic segmentation processing on an original request text to generate each reasoning subtask, sending each reasoning subtask to a preset reasoning model to obtain a reasoning subtask result of each reasoning subtask, and generating a reasoning response result of the original request text based on each reasoning subtask result. The application realizes the protection of the privacy of the user in the model reasoning process while smoothly executing the reasoning task.

title: Pattern recognition method and device
description: The invention discloses a pattern recognition method and device, the method comprises the steps of preparing a first quantum state based on a sequence number of a reference sequence and a sequence number of a target sequence, measuring the first quantum state on a designated quantum bit to obtain a first measurement result, performing inverse quantum Fourier transform on the first quantum state to obtain a second quantum state in response to the first measurement result as a target value, obtaining a target wave number based on the second measurement result, and obtaining recognition results of an object to be recognized and the target object by using the target wave number and a preset threshold value. By using the embodiment of the invention, the efficiency of pattern recognition is improved.

title: Fine-granularity multi-mode prompt guided visual relationship recognition method and device
description: The present invention discloses a visual relationship recognition method and device guided by fine-grained multimodal prompts, the method comprising: using multivariate Gaussian distribution to model the acquired multiple groups of relationship weight vectors, and combining the output composite image features, deriving the relationship classification loss based on a small number of training samples and calculating the semantic diversity loss, minimizing the total training loss to optimize the text prompt; taking the average relationship weight vector, respectively calculating the similarity and weighted fusion with the composite image features of the target object, and obtaining the relationship prediction probability distribution through normalization operation; verifying the relationship predicate with the maximum prediction probability, and detecting abnormal behaviors in large public places in real time according to the output relationship category intelligent monitoring system. The device comprises: a processor and a memory. The present invention accurately adjusts the visual language model to the visual relationship detection task, realizes the accurate detection of visual relationships, thereby improving the detection capability of abnormal behaviors of the intelligent monitoring system, and timely triggering alarms to notify relevant personnel.

title: Space odor detection system, method, device and storage medium
description: The application discloses a space odor detection system, a space odor detection method, a space odor detection device and a storage medium. Relates to the field of space environment detection. The system comprises an electronic nose system, a space environment detection system and a data transmission system, and a cloud server. The cloud server is configured to receive an odor data sequence and an environment data sequence from a satellite, fuse odor data vectors in the odor data sequence with corresponding environment data vectors in the environment data sequence, generate a plurality of fused data vectors corresponding to each sampling time, generate semantic features corresponding to the plurality of fused data vectors by using a feature extraction model based on an attention mechanism, and determine component information corresponding to space odors acquired at each sampling time based on the semantic features by using a preset odor identification model based on a neural network. The problems of time and labor consumption, information lag and high cost of the space odor detection technology are solved, and real-time monitoring of the space environment is difficult to realize.

title: RIME-SVMD-based electromyographic signal denoising method
description: The present invention provides an electromyographic signal denoising method based on RIME-SVMD. The steps of the method are as follows: S1, obtain the original electromyographic signal, and adaptively iterate and search the optimal balance parameters of the SVMD algorithm through the RIME algorithm. S2, use SVMD to perform successive variational modal decomposition on the original electromyographic signal to obtain the decomposed IMF: S3, calculate the NCC corresponding to each IMF, take 0.3 as the standard, the part greater than 0.3 is identified as a useful signal, and the part less than 0.3 is identified as a useless signal. S4, denoise and reconstruct the signal with NCC greater than 0.3, and obtain the electromyographic signal after noise reduction. The electromyographic signal denoising method based on RIME-SVMD of the present invention solves the maximum balance parameter of SVMD through RIME, decomposes the original electromyographic signal using SVMD, and denoises the useful signal in combination with the wavelet threshold method, so as to better retain the characteristics of the original electromyographic signal for subsequent analysis and discrimination.

title: Water station anti-jamming early warning method based on lightweight pre-training vision large model
description: The present invention belongs to the field of target detection technology, and relates to a water station anti-human interference warning method based on a lightweight pre-trained visual large model. The method comprises: pre-training the visual large model using a target tracking data set; training the pre-trained large model using a self-made data set to obtain a trained visual large model; jointly training the classification network and the segmentation network using a knowledge distillation transfer learning method; segmenting the image area through a lightweight visual large model; warning the target close to the warning area according to the prediction results and warning according to the residence time of the target not close to the warning area; predicting the target behavior according to the items carried by the identified target and warning according to the target behavior. The present invention can reduce the probability of false detection and false alarm; improve the accuracy of management by monitoring and warning the behavior of fast-moving targets; and enable the system to have the ability to migrate to different scenarios and targeted learning capabilities.

title: Inventory violation building investigation method based on mass data
description: A method for investigating existing illegal buildings based on massive data, which relates to the field of geographic information technology, and is characterized in that the method includes the following steps: definition of illegal buildings; data comparison; data analysis and collection; data production; data determination; data correction and verification; summary analysis and evaluation; feedback reminder. Advantages: This method uses orthophotos to quickly identify building change areas, and uses point cloud data to conduct building surveys without the need for field surveys, which greatly improves the efficiency and speed of identification and investigation; point cloud data can accurately capture the shape and location information of buildings, and has higher precision and accuracy than traditional two-dimensional image analysis; combined with approval data judgment, and management authority judgment and verification, it has higher authority and recognition; all-round analysis, display and approval; visualization technology assists decision support.

title: Multi-period traffic prediction method based on federal learning
description: The invention discloses a multi-period traffic prediction method based on federal learning, which utilizes federal learning technology to allow clients in different areas to share intermediate results of model training while keeping data localization, so as to realize knowledge sharing and optimization. Each client divides a day into a plurality of time periods, and independently processes and analyzes the data of each time period, so that the model can capture the unique traffic characteristics of each time period, the adaptability of the model to the traffic characteristics of different areas and time periods is improved, and the generalization capability of the model is enhanced. The method can realize privacy protection, multi-period adaptability and collaborative optimization of the global and local models, and simultaneously has higher prediction precision.

title: Fatigue simulation method for nonlinear energy dissipation of asphalt mixture
description: The application discloses a fatigue simulation method for nonlinear energy dissipation of an asphalt mixture, which abandons the simplified assumption of a traditional linear damage model, accurately describes the residual bonding radius multiplier change rules of the asphalt mixture in an initial stage, a micro-damage stage, an accelerated damage stage and a damage stage through a piecewise function, can accurately capture nonlinear mechanical behaviors of the material in different damage stages, combines an ant colony optimization algorithm to accurately calibrate model parameters, efficiently searches model parameter space through simulating intelligent behaviors of ant colony foraging in nature, finds out optimal parameter combinations, enables simulation results to be matched with test results to be high, obviously improves the accuracy of fatigue life prediction, effectively reduces prediction errors, provides more reliable theoretical basis for structural design of asphalt pavements, and prolongs the service life of pavements.

title: Live pig price long-term aging prediction method and system based on multi-model aggregation
description: The application discloses a live pig price long-term aging prediction method and a live pig price long-term aging prediction system based on multi-model aggregation, wherein the method comprises the steps of aiming at live pig price prediction, collecting historical data of live pig prices in 5000 days; ten years history data of 16 indexes of a 4-large latitude meter are collected; performing 30 balance slide data cleaning on all acquired historical data to obtain effective historical data; the method and the system for predicting the price of the live pigs can effectively improve the accuracy of the price prediction of the live pigs in long time.

title: Efficient image super-resolution method based on multi-branch hybrid transducer-MBMT
description: An efficient image super-resolution method based on Multi-Branch Mixer Transformer (MBMT), in which a unique module of Multi-Branch Token Mixer (MBTM) is introduced, which aims to replace the depth by increasing the network width, thereby enhancing the learning ability and generalization ability of the model. It consists of three branches: a self-attention mechanism module, a depth-wise convolution (DWConv) and an adaptive token mixer (ATM), each of which is responsible for capturing long-term dependencies, extracting local features and expanding the global information space. The present invention combines adaptive space and channel attention mechanisms to ensure that there is sufficient interaction between the information extracted from the three branches, thereby enhancing the feature representation ability of MBTM. Thanks to the high efficiency and shallower network structure of MBTM, the present invention significantly improves the performance of the SR model while reducing the complexity.

title: Cluster division-based power distribution network voltage control method containing high-proportion household photovoltaic
description: The invention relates to the technical field of voltage control of a photovoltaic power distribution network, in particular to a power distribution network voltage control method based on cluster division and containing high proportion of household photovoltaic, which comprises the following steps of firstly, selecting cluster division and key control nodes, wherein the method specifically comprises the steps of cluster comprehensive division indexes, cluster division and key control node selection; the voltage control method based on cluster division comprises a voltage control model based on cluster division, a voltage control method based on cluster division and a voltage control method based on cluster division. According to the voltage control method based on cluster division, the power distribution network is divided into a plurality of independent clusters by utilizing the comprehensive division index, and the voltage control is realized by the energy storage priority action at the key control nodes of each cluster, so that the complexity of the overall voltage control of the power distribution network system is reduced, and the problems of voltage out-of-limit and the like can be rapidly solved.

title: Model training task allocation method and system in heterogeneous computing power environment
description: The present invention belongs to the field of distributed training, and provides a method and system for allocating model training tasks in a heterogeneous computing power environment, constructs a layered deep reinforcement learning model, and is used to optimize the selection of split points and resource allocation between the terminal layer, the edge layer, and the cloud computing layer, thereby achieving efficient computing task allocation and model training. Tasks with different computing power requirements are handled by designing multiple sub-strategy networks. A resource perception module is combined to measure the computing resources, network bandwidth, and latency of each layer. A heuristic algorithm is used to preliminarily estimate the range of split points, reduce the exploration of irrelevant locations, and optimize search efficiency. The resources required for the calculation of the neural network model are measured by the number of floating-point operations. In the selection of split points, the deep reinforcement learning method is mainly combined with the resource perception module to find the optimal split point through structural optimization to achieve effective splitting of the model and complete efficient joint training on both ends.

title: Pressure pipeline corrosion online monitoring method and system
description: The present invention provides a pressure pipeline corrosion online monitoring method and system, which relates to the technical field of pipeline monitoring, including acquiring three-dimensional point cloud data, obtaining downsampled point cloud data through an octree filtering algorithm, constructing a geometric feature scattering matrix, inputting a multi-scale fusion twin network, learning feature differences through a contrast loss function, and generating a corrosion probability distribution map; based on an iterative nearest point algorithm, aligning the corrosion probability distribution map, extracting an excessive corrosion area, superimposing and analyzing the excessive corrosion area and a pipeline stress concentration area, and determining a high-risk corrosion area; arranging a sensor array around the high-risk corrosion area, acquiring a sensor corrosion signal, performing variational mode decomposition, extracting an intrinsic function component related to the corrosion feature, sparsely representing the intrinsic function component, constructing a dispersion compensation matrix, determining a corrected sparse feature matrix, and inputting a multi-core extreme learning machine discriminator to determine whether a leakage occurs in the high-risk corrosion area.

title: Combined visual question-answering method based on core-to-global semantic fusion reasoning
description: The application discloses a combined visual question-answering method based on core-to-global semantic fusion reasoning, which belongs to the technical field of image and text processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining image data and text question data; the method comprises the steps of inputting image data into a semantic feature extraction model to obtain image global features and visual core features, inputting text question data into the semantic feature extraction model to obtain text question global features and text core features, transmitting the image global features, the visual core features, the text question global features and the text core features to a preset multi-mode semantic fusion model to execute multi-mode semantic learning of different levels, fusing single-layer language learning results, and calculating according to target answer prediction vectors to obtain target prediction answers. The application solves the technical problems of inaccurate reasoning and model instability caused by inaccurate semantic alignment, feature redundancy and noise interference of multi-mode information in the prior art.

title: River flow monitoring method, device, equipment, medium and product
description: The present application discloses a method, device, equipment, medium and product for monitoring river flow, and relates to the field of hydrological measurement and video flow measurement technology. The method comprises: obtaining a water gauge picture; the surface of the water gauge is painted with a signature color; using a picture recognition method to recognize the water level information on the water gauge picture; inputting the water level information into a trained river flow prediction model to obtain water flow data. The present application uses a water gauge with a signature color on the surface. At night or in heavy rain, the captured water gauge picture still contains rich water gauge features. The water level can be effectively identified through an image recognition algorithm, solving the problem that the river flow cannot be effectively monitored under harsh conditions such as night or heavy rain. The present application can perform reliable and efficient river flow monitoring at night or in heavy rain conditions.

title: Data detection method, model training method and related device
description: The present application provides a data detection method, a model training method and related devices, which are applied to the field of data processing and are used to improve the accuracy of log event anomaly detection. The method includes: extracting at least one first feature of any event among multiple events and vectorizing it to obtain at least one first feature vector; encoding the at least one first feature vector by an encoder to obtain at least one second feature vector; decoding the at least one second feature vector by a decoder to obtain at least one third feature vector; calculating the reconstruction error of the at least one first feature vector and the at least one third feature vector; inputting the at least one second feature vector into a one-dimensional convolutional neural network and obtaining the output of the abnormal probability of any event; calculating the abnormal score of any event according to a preset rule based on the reconstruction error and the abnormal probability, and performing an alarm for the event whose abnormal score is greater than a threshold.

title: Human body point cloud analysis method based on millimeter wave radar
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of radar point cloud identification processing, and discloses a human body point cloud analysis method based on millimeter wave radar, which takes radar point cloud captured from human body as input, identifies a body part corresponding to each point in the point cloud, groups and analyzes the point cloud, the point cloud data acquired by the millimeter wave radar are firstly transmitted into the multi-layer perceptron to perform feature extraction, then features are learned through the coding module, then a symmetrical decoder structure is adopted to decode local features into predicted human body analysis information, and after training, a model is stored and used for analyzing human body point cloud and performing subsequent posture estimation tasks. The method and the device improve the accuracy of the point cloud analysis task of the model under the sparse point cloud, improve the robustness of the system, reduce the complexity of a network structure, reduce the network training overhead, improve the operation efficiency and greatly improve the accuracy of human body analysis under the condition of fewer training rounds.

title: Machine learning and data classification for operating a device such as a vehicle
description: The present disclosure provides "machine learning and data classification for operating a device such as a vehicle". A computer comprising a processor and a memory, the memory comprising instructions executable by the processor to input an image to a first neural network to generate a first detected object and to input the image to a second neural network to generate a reconstructed image, the reconstructed image being input to a third neural network to generate a second detected object. The image may be divided into a plurality of portions and the plurality of portions input to a respective fourth neural network to generate a plurality of portions of a third detected object. The first detected object, the second detected object, portions of the third detected object, and the context data may be input to a partially observable markov decision process to generate a high confidence detected object.

title: Processing measurement data more robustly by means of a neural network
description: A method for processing measurement data in a neural network, the neural network having multiple layers of neurons, wherein the outputs of neurons in at least one layer are respectively guided as inputs to neurons in at least one subsequent layer, and comprising the steps of: processing the input supplied to each neuron into a job result of the neuron according to parameters associated with the neuron; selecting a group of neurons; determining a target distribution for the job results of the neurons in the group; providing an inverse cumulative density function of the target distribution; mapping the job results to unit values in the interval [0, 1] by means of a preset unit function, so that the unit value belonging to each job result occupies the same rank in the list of all unit values as the corresponding job result in the list of all job results; calculating a normalized job result from the unit value by means of the inverse cumulative density function; and further processing the normalized job result in the neural network instead of the original job result into the output of the neural network.

title: Method and system for determining taxi taking order queuing strategy
description: The embodiment of the specification provides a method and a system for determining a taxi order queuing strategy, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of order queuing strategies related to a target area and a test taxi order set, predicting values of target parameters corresponding to each order queuing strategy when the order queuing strategy is executed on the test taxi order set, and determining at least one target order queuing strategy from the plurality of order queuing strategies based on the values of the target parameters corresponding to each order queuing strategy.

title: Night infrared detection method and system based on improved lightweight YOLOv model
description: The present invention proposes a nighttime infrared detection method and system based on an improved lightweight YOLOv8 model, and relates to the technical fields of deep learning and target detection. First, an infrared image data set is obtained, the infrared image data set is preprocessed, and the preprocessed infrared image data set is divided into a training set, a verification set, and a test set; an improved lightweight YOLOv8 model is constructed; the improved lightweight YOLOv8 model is added with a DWR module for improving the multi-scale and feature extraction capabilities of infrared images, a CGAFusion module for improving the image feature fusion capability, and an LSDECD_Detect module on the basis of the YOLOv8 model; the improved lightweight YOLOv8 model is trained using the training set, and during the training process, the validity of the improved lightweight YOLOv8 model is verified using the verification set to obtain a trained improved lightweight YOLOv8 model; the test set is input into the trained improved lightweight YOLOv8 model to obtain an infrared detection result, so as to improve the vehicle detection accuracy under the condition of poor visibility at night.

title: Data source-based business customization device and method, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The invention relates to a business-customized device and method based on a data source, and a computer-readable storage medium. The business-customized device includes: a memory, a processor, and a data source-based service stored on the memory and operable on the processor. The business custom system, when the data source-based business custom system is executed by the processor, implements the following steps: obtaining predetermined user-generated content in each data source; generating user groups using a pre-trained user group label recognition model to generate user The content is identified to identify the user group tags corresponding to each data source; the group service corresponding to each data source is determined according to the mapping relationship between the predetermined user group label and the group service, and each data source and the corresponding group service are sent to Scheduled terminals for group business customization of each data source.

title: Data processing method, device, medium and product based on polynomial chaos expansion
description: The invention discloses a data processing method, a device, a medium and a product based on polynomial chaotic expansion, which are used for obtaining a plurality of sample points of a random variable as a sample data set, carrying out polynomial chaotic expansion by adopting an orthogonal polynomial basis function, solving expansion coefficients in the polynomial chaotic expansion, training a plurality of generation models, learning the distribution of absolute values of products in normalized Galerkin projection, updating a probability density function according to the generation models, obtaining a plurality of newly-increased sample points of the random variable according to the updated probability density function, merging the newly-increased sample points into the sample data set, and re-solving the expansion coefficients in the polynomial chaotic expansion until the iteration termination condition is met, and generating a polynomial chaotic expansion proxy model according to the finally-solved expansion coefficients. By adopting the method and the device, the fitting precision of the proxy model can be improved, the calculated amount can be effectively reduced, and the data processing efficiency can be improved.

title: Polarized SAR image classification method, system, medium and program product
description: The present invention discloses a polarimetric SAR image classification method, system, medium, and program product, relating to the field of polarimetric SAR image classification. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a polarimetric dataset; constructing an anchor sample training set and a positive sample pair dataset based on the polarimetric dataset; constructing a residual neural network model; performing a first-stage training of the residual neural network model using the positive sample pair dataset to obtain an intermediate residual neural network model trained in the first stage; performing a second-stage training of the intermediate residual neural network model using the polarimetric dataset and the anchor sample training set to obtain a residual neural network model trained in the second stage; and clustering polarimetric SAR images to be classified using the residual neural network model trained in the second stage to generate a classification result graph. The present invention can effectively and accurately classify and identify polarimetric SAR images without requiring any labeling costs.

title: Method and System for Predicting and Controlling the Flow Rate of the Primary Loop Pump of a Pressurized Water Reactor
description: This invention discloses a method and system for predicting and controlling the flow rate of the main pump in the primary loop of a pressurized water reactor (PWR). The method includes: acquiring the original main pump flow rate signal of the PWR primary loop; using the HOFEM module of NL-FCNN to perform multi-scale decomposition on the main pump flow rate signal to obtain multi-scale main pump flow rates; inputting the multi-scale main pump flow rate components into an ANSA dynamic optimization network structure for feature extraction to obtain multi-scale feature vectors; based on the extracted multi-scale feature vectors, using NL-FCNN to predict the main pump flow rate signal to obtain the optimal predicted main pump flow rate value; converting the optimal predicted main pump flow rate value into an electrical signal through a digital-to-analog converter circuit based on a D-ADC algorithm, and then inputting the electrical signal into the main pump frequency converter to drive the main pump to operate at variable frequency, thereby controlling the main pump flow rate of the PWR primary loop. This method and system can accurately control the main pump flow rate of the PWR primary loop.

title: Decentralized fairness federal learning method based on DAG chain
description: The invention provides a decentralized fairness federation learning method based on a DAG chain, which comprises the steps of client side slicing training, global model aggregation according to weights, DAG chain issuing model and sparsification redistribution. First, the contribution of the clients is estimated through multiple dimensions, the data diversity, the category distribution difference, the gradient contribution and the parameter updating contribution are synthesized, and the actual contribution of each client is comprehensively quantized. Then, a dynamic adjustment rewarding mechanism is designed, according to the reputation value and the response time factor of the client, the sparsification technology is combined, gradients of different sparsification degrees are distributed according to the comprehensive performance of the client, and the client is stimulated to actively participate and the system efficiency is improved. Finally, a method for fairness of tip walk based on the DAG chain is provided, an optimal father node is selected in the DAG chain by utilizing a walk algorithm, efficient aggregation and updating are carried out by combining similarity and accuracy of model parameters, expansibility and aggregation efficiency of the DAG chain are optimized, and fairness and overall performance of the system are ensured.

title: Stirring and crushing control method and system based on image processing
