description: The present invention discloses a stirring and crushing control method and system based on image processing, comprising the following steps: S1: collecting feed image data and preprocessing it to obtain preprocessed feed image data; S2: extracting grid texture features, a similarity matrix, a distance matrix, and binary features based on the preprocessed feed image data to calculate stirring features; S3: calculating the remaining stirring time based on the stirring features and recording it to form a remaining stirring time sequence, and calculating the remaining stirring time features and the stirring completion status; S4: calculating a grinder reference speed and crushing time based on the stirring features, grid texture features, a similarity matrix, a distance matrix, and binary features; then updating and calculating the grinder reference speed to obtain an updated grinder speed; S5: controlling the grinder to perform feed crushing operations based on the updated grinder speed. The present invention can solve the problems of uneven stirring and unreasonable crushing time during traditional feed stirring and crushing.

title: Semi-supervised natural language time sequence positioning method and related device based on diffusion model
description: The present invention belongs to the field of computer vision and pattern recognition technology and discloses a semi-supervised natural language temporal localization method and related apparatus based on a diffusion model. The method comprises: obtaining a text description and video data to be temporally localized, performing feature extraction to obtain text features and video features, respectively; performing temporal localization using a pre-trained temporal localization model based on the text features and video features to obtain a temporal localization result. The temporal localization result includes the start and end times of the video segment corresponding to the text description in the video data to be temporally localized. The technical solution disclosed in the present invention integrates the diffusion model into a teacher-student framework, improves the quality and reliability of pseudo-labels through denoising and de-noising processes, and can enhance the overall performance of semi-supervised natural language temporal localization.

title: Harmonic active suppression optimization method for rectifier transformer for hydrogen production by water electrolysis
description: The present invention discloses a method for actively suppressing harmonics in a rectifier transformer for hydrogen production by water electrolysis, comprising the following steps: constructing a rectifier circuit, the rectifier circuit including a switch tube, combining a voltage vector output by the switch tube with a zero vector to obtain a combined output voltage vector; processing the combined output voltage vector to obtain harmonic amplitudes; introducing a Levy tangent flight strategy and a trust region mutation strategy into a black kite optimization algorithm to construct an improved dynamic search algorithm; iteratively calculating the harmonic amplitudes using the improved dynamic search algorithm to obtain a total harmonic distortion rate (THD), i.e., an optimal switch tube combination; adjusting the switches of the rectifier circuit using the optimal switch tube combination to reduce the THD of the rectifier circuit. The present invention iteratively calculates the optimal switch tube combination of the rectifier circuit using the improved dynamic search algorithm, effectively reducing resource consumption, accelerating processing speed, and improving the efficiency and accuracy of the rectifier for hydrogen production by water electrolysis.

title: Traffic resilience dynamic assessment and prediction system based on deep learning
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of urban traffic resilience analysis, and discloses a dynamic assessment and prediction system for traffic resilience based on deep learning. The present invention breaks through the limitations of traditional single indicators by constructing a traffic resilience assessment matrix that includes the dimensions of absorption capacity, recovery capacity, and maintenance capacity, and realizes a three-dimensional characterization of traffic resilience. It combines the road network structure with the accident parameter correction to improve the assessment accuracy and scenario adaptability, provide a scientific basis for traffic emergency management and road network planning, and help improve the comprehensive performance of the traffic system under emergencies. The present invention integrates the identification of key nodes in the road network and the calculation of accident space parameters to establish a multi-factor weighted accident impact correction model, breaking through the limitations of traditional single accident parameter correction, realizing the coordinated analysis of road network topology and accident scale, and improving the adaptability of the assessment results to complex traffic scenarios.

title: A non-contact heart rate monitoring method and system based on adaptive feature fusion and key area division
description: This paper proposes a non-contact heart rate monitoring method and system based on adaptive feature fusion and key region segmentation. First, a face detection dataset is acquired, and a multi-scale feature extraction network is constructed. Input facial video frames are processed in parallel using convolutional layers with different kernel sizes to extract multi-scale features. Next, an adaptive feature fusion module (AFFM) is designed. The SE-Net channel attention mechanism is employed to obtain channel and spatial attention weights, fuse feature maps of different scales, and enhance feature expression to produce a feature map for face detection. Key facial regions are then selected, and region boundaries are delineated using a deep learning semantic segmentation model. Light intensity information is extracted from each region at different times, and integrated using a linear weighted fusion model to obtain a comprehensive heart rate signal source. Finally, filtering techniques are used for denoising, and a sliding window is used to detect light intensity peaks to derive the heartbeat period and heart rate value.

title: Pavement grade identification method and suspension system embedded with friction nano generator
description: The invention discloses a pavement grade identification method and a suspension system embedded with a friction nano generator, which comprise the steps of acquiring a friction electric signal, outputting the friction electric signal by the friction nano generator which synchronously acts with the suspension system, converting the friction electric signal into image data by adopting wavelet transformation, constructing a pavement grade identification model based on a deep learning network, inputting the image data into the pavement grade identification model to obtain a pavement grade identification result.

title: Efficient molecular docking method based on geometric perception attention model
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of molecular docking, and particularly relates to a high-efficiency molecular docking method based on a geometric perception attention model. The dynamic memory reduction strategy utilizes iterative evaluation and blocking technology to realize efficient parallel computation of an attention matrix, and utilizes a shared memory to complete communication of intermediate results among different thread bundles, the hierarchical fusion strategy designs two high-performance fusion kernels for triangle attention so that data generated by each thread block are all stored in a register and the shared memory, tensor tiled data are moved to reorganize the mapping relation between threads and data in a trans-dimensionality data carrying mode to realize a global merging memory access mode, and multi-head parallel attention merging utilizes the multi-head attention merging strategy to optimize QKV data layout and reduce additional data transposition and splicing operation of the intermediate results. The invention solves the problems of internal memory explosion, irregular memory access and redundancy memory access in the triangle update operator in the prior triangle attention operator reasoning.

title: Power distribution network running state analysis method, electronic equipment and medium
description: The invention discloses a power distribution network running state analysis method, electronic equipment and medium, relating to the technical field of deep learning, the scheme considers that the prediction of the running state of a power distribution network by the original data of the power distribution network can cause inaccurate prediction results due to irregular changes of the original data, so the scheme decomposes the history running state information of an unstable power distribution network by a wavelet packet decomposition mode to carry out multi-level frequency on the current running state signal of the power distribution network, the power distribution network running state prediction model obtained after the neural network training can more accurately predict the future state of the power distribution network, and in addition, because the power distribution network running state prediction model has the function of monitoring the real-time running state information of the power distribution network in real time, the future running state information can be adjusted based on the real-time running state information, so that the accuracy of the future running state information is improved, and the accuracy of the power distribution network running state analysis process is further improved.

title: Manufacturing quality analysis system and method based on large model Agent and MCP
description: The invention discloses a manufacturing quality analysis system and method based on large model agents and MCP, and mainly relates to the field of intelligent manufacturing and artificial intelligence application. The method comprises the following steps of S1, initializing a setting stage layer, S2, a data input stage layer, S3, a data processing stage layer, S4, an intelligent analysis stage and S5, and a result output stage. The intelligent Agent analysis and report generation system also comprises a large model intelligent Agent module, an intelligent Agent selection module, a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module and an analysis and report generation module. The invention has the beneficial effects that the process quality data processing and analyzing efficiency can be improved by more than 30% through the combined application between the large model Agent and the large model MCP, and the quality analysis and decision proposal output of the six sigma black band level can be provided through AI, so that the limitations of the existing system in the aspects of strong manual dependence, lag in analysis timeliness, lack of quality talents and the like are solved.

title: Automatic loading method of chemical carrier based on route planning
description: The invention discloses an automatic allocation method of a chemical carrier based on route planning, which belongs to the technical field of allocation of chemical carriers and comprises the steps of obtaining chemical property data and carrying condition data, constructing a chemical information database, encoding ports in a planning period to generate an initial route population, generating an optimal allocation scheme meeting the requirements on stability and safety according to the database data and the performance of a ship cargo hold, formulating a transportation scheme evaluation standard and model, reserving 40% of high-quality routes according to an evaluation result, updating the route population, judging whether a termination condition is met, outputting the optimal transportation scheme if the termination condition is met, and continuing iterative operation if the termination condition is not met. The automatic allocation method for the chemical carrier based on the route planning can solve the optimization problem of route planning and automatic allocation of the chemical carrier, improve the safety of dangerous chemical transportation, maintain the marine ecological environment, save shipping time, relieve the tension of shipping capacity and improve economic benefit.

title: Method, apparatus, device and storage medium for evaluating quality of image
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide methods, apparatuses, devices, storage media, and program products for evaluating the quality of an image. The method includes performing a degradation process for a first image to obtain a second image, the degradation process being a reverse image process associated with an image enhancement process, the first image and the second image having a same resolution and a quality of the second image being lower than a quality of the first image, determining a first quality assessment of the first image and a second quality assessment of the second image, respectively, using a machine learning model, and updating the machine learning model based on the first quality assessment and the second quality assessment. In this way, the accuracy and efficiency of quality assessment of the enhanced image may be improved.

title: Database self-optimization and decision support method and system based on large language model
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of database optimization, and is a method and system for database self-optimization and decision support based on a large language model. The method comprises the following steps: determining a database to be optimized and a current transmission task set; obtaining an original allocation strategy set for the current transmission task set; extracting data nodes to be optimized; and determining node transmission task sets corresponding to the data nodes to be optimized; constructing node constraints and single-node costs based on the node transmission task sets; obtaining a database cost function based on the single-node costs; performing task allocation optimization based on the node constraints and the database cost function to obtain an optimal task matrix solution; generating a target allocation decision set based on the optimal task matrix solution; and obtaining a decision suggestion text based on the target allocation decision set. The present invention can improve the efficiency of database optimization and enhance the intelligence level of database optimization.

title: Quantum state data transmission method, device, equipment, medium and quantum simulation system
description: The application discloses a quantum state data transmission method, a device, equipment, a medium and a quantum simulation system, wherein partial quantum state data required by a server for executing a simulation quantum calculation task is read from a shared storage pool through a storage network; based on partial quantum state data, the server executes the simulated quantum computing task and stores the quantum state data generated after executing the simulated quantum computing task into a shared storage pool. According to the method, quantum state data are stored in a shared storage pool independent of each server instead of a private storage medium of each server, so that any server does not need to directly access any storage medium through a storage network by means of other servers, east-west data traffic of a distributed quantum simulation cluster is eliminated, the maximum bottleneck problem of distributed expansion of a quantum simulation system is effectively solved, and the distributed expansion capacity of the quantum simulation system is improved so as to meet the data transmission requirement of a large-scale quantum simulation system.

title: Mapping prediction method and system based on hardware resource load and system operation relation
description: The present invention discloses a prediction method and system based on mapping the relationship between hardware resource load and system operation, comprising: real-time collection of hardware indicator data during the operation of an operating system; pre-processing the hardware indicator data, performing association analysis on each indicator data using an association rule mining algorithm, generating association rules and evaluating them, screening out association rules that meet the conditions, and constructing a multivariate association model; based on the association analysis results, constructing and training a load prediction model, deploying the trained model into the system, and performing load prediction; dynamically adjusting the system hardware resource allocation strategy based on the prediction results, performing task migration and load balancing based on the predicted load conditions, and automatically adjusting hardware resources through automated scripts or scheduling tools. The present invention improves the resource utilization and operating efficiency of the system and enhances the stability and reliability of the system through real-time monitoring and in-depth association analysis of indicators such as CPU, memory, storage I/O, and network bandwidth.

title: Time alignment and dynamic fusion method for electroencephalogram and functional near infrared signals
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of multimodal brain-computer interface signal processing, and specifically relates to a method for time alignment and dynamic fusion based on EEG and functional near-infrared signals. The method comprises: neural network setting: setting a feature decoupling module for decoupling EEG features and functional near-infrared features into shared features and specific features; setting a deformable time alignment module for adaptively time-aligning shared features and specific features based on a deformable alignment mechanism with a learnable offset Δt; setting a graph distillation module for achieving fusion output of specific features and shared features by constructing a cross-modal graph structure between samples and introducing dynamic edge weights and dual difference metrics; neural network training: constructing a loss function for fusion of EEG and functional near-infrared signals and performing neural network model training; feature fusion: inputting the EEG and functional near-infrared signals to be fused into a trained neural network, and the neural network outputs fusion features.

title: H13 steel mold intelligent temperature control and thermal fatigue prediction cooperative system and use method thereof
description: The invention discloses an intelligent temperature control and thermal fatigue prediction collaboration system for an H13 steel mold and a use method thereof, and relates to the field of steel molds. According to the invention, the intelligent temperature control subsystem utilizes dual-controller redundancy and dynamic strategy adjustment to realize high-precision dynamic temperature control, the thermal fatigue prediction subsystem fuses a multi-scale model and an LSTM neural network to realize high-precision prediction, the data processing module supports high-efficiency noise reduction and cross-domain data conversion, the fault diagnosis module constructs a multi-level threshold detection and intelligent response system, the data interaction module realizes multi-protocol compatibility and full-flow collaboration, the user management module guarantees system safety and globalization adaptation, the mold temperature control precision, the thermal fatigue prediction reliability and production collaboration efficiency are integrally improved, the maintenance cost is reduced, and the mold life is prolonged.

title: Medical image segmentation model training method, segmentation method, device and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of image processing technology, and specifically to a medical image segmentation model training method, segmentation method, device, and storage medium. In the present invention, a multi-scale global channel attention (MCA) module is used to perform convolution and bilinear interpolation operations on the output features of each encoding module and then splices them to obtain global features; the global features are processed by a channel attention mechanism to obtain global regional features; the global regional features are element-wise multiplied with the output feature rows of the last encoding module, pooled and normalized, and activated with an activation function to obtain the output features of the multi-scale global channel attention module. The medical image segmentation model of the present invention reduces the number of parameters and computational overhead while maintaining performance, and the training process is stable and efficient, alleviating the class imbalance problem in medical images.

title: Lane changing intention identifying method based on driving style
description: The invention provides a lane change intention recognition method based on driving style. The method comprises the steps of collecting driving behavior data in a following scene through a driving simulation experiment, constructing a multidimensional data set containing a self-vehicle state, a front-vehicle state and space-time following characteristics, identifying reaction characteristics, steady-state risk characteristics and operation characteristics of a driver based on an expected safety margin model, extracting behavior parameters forming a driving style, including indexes such as reaction time, an expected safety margin interval and operation sensitivity, and the like, and further classifying the driver into different style types and giving style labels by using a clustering algorithm. On the basis, the lane change intention time information of subjective labels of a driver is collected through an uncontrolled observation experiment and aligned with the track data, so that a track data set with a real intention label is constructed. And finally, constructing a dynamic Bayesian network model based on the data set, taking a history driving state sequence in a fixed time window as input, and fusing driving style, interaction characteristics of a vehicle and surrounding vehicles and traffic flow characteristics to realize real-time identification of whether lane changing intention exists at the current moment. The method has good interpretability, individual difference adaptability and engineering deployment, and is suitable for dynamic identification and response control of driver intention in an intelligent driving auxiliary system.

title: Swin transducer-based cow face recognition method
description: A cow face recognition method based on Swin Transformer obtains and annotates cow face images; constructs a recognition model, including an image segmentation module, a backbone network, a two-layer routing attention module, a convolution enhancement merging module, and a classification head; the backbone network is constructed based on the Swin Transformer structure and is divided into four cascade stages, each stage consisting of a patch merging module and multiple Swin Transformer blocks, which are used to gradually extract multi-scale feature information from cow face images; a two-layer routing attention module is introduced between the input and output of one or several stages of the backbone network to enhance global context modeling capabilities and spatial relationship modeling; a convolution enhancement merging module is introduced at the output of the stage where the two-layer routing attention module is introduced, and the output of the stage is fused with the output of the corresponding two-layer routing attention module as the input of the next stage to enhance feature representation capabilities; the features output by the backbone network are input into the classification head for classification; the recognition model is trained, and the trained recognition model is used to perform cow face recognition.

title: A Fault Diagnosis Method and System for Integrated Roll Cutting and Rolling Machines Based on Large Language Models
description: This invention discloses a fault diagnosis method and system for a roll-to-roll cutter based on a large language model, belonging to the field of equipment fault diagnosis technology. It includes a table data intelligent processing module, a knowledge base construction module, a diagnostic reasoning module, and a user interaction module. The table data intelligent processing module automatically annotates and standardizes the descriptions of user-provided roll-to-roll cutter fault diagnosis case libraries. The domain knowledge graph construction module integrates the standardized table database and automatically constructs a domain knowledge graph. The diagnostic reasoning module performs fault diagnosis reasoning based on the large language model and knowledge graph. The user interaction module provides a multimodal user interface and supports the visualization of fault diagnosis. Therefore, adopting the above-mentioned fault diagnosis method and system for a roll-to-roll cutter based on a large language model can improve the intelligence level of fault diagnosis, reduce the cost of knowledge base construction and expansion, and enhance the system's usability and maintainability.

title: Three-dimensional point cloud vehicle sensing method in expressway scene based on PPL network model
description: The invention discloses a three-dimensional point cloud vehicle detection method in an expressway scene based on a PPL network model, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a three-dimensional point cloud vehicle detection data set in the expressway scene, including routine and foggy days, S2, constructing a PPL network model for three-dimensional point cloud vehicle detection in the expressway scene according to the characteristics of the data set and the requirements of detection tasks, S3, model training and parameter optimization, constructing experimental result evaluation indexes in the expressway scene, and respectively evaluating the average detection accuracy and the detection speed of the three-dimensional point cloud vehicle detection method in the expressway scene based on the PPL network model. The model performance constructed by the invention has the average accuracy of vehicle detection in expressway scenes (82.98,80.89,72.65) and the detection frame rate of 45.5Hz.

title: Transformer model based on quantum-classical combined structure and training method thereof
description: A transducer model based on a quantum-classical combined structure and a training method are disclosed, a transducer model based on a variable component sub-line is constructed, a quantum neural network structure based on the variable component sub-line is introduced on the basis of a traditional transducer, a connection summation structure is constructed by combining a classical neural network module, a novel quantum-classical mixed transducer structure is formed, a feedforward neural network based on the construction of the quantum-classical mixed structure is used for solving the gradient of an output result to model parameters through the training of the quantum-classical mixed transducer structure, and the parameters are optimized and updated by using a gradient descent method. The invention is hopeful to fully utilize the performance of quantum computation by combining the computing performance potential of quantum computation and obtain the capability which is not weaker than that of the traditional transducer by combining the capability of the classical transducer module as supplement. The invention is suitable for application scenes such as natural language processing, genome analysis and the like.

title: Intelligent diagnosis method for defects of external facades of infrared thermal imaging building based on multi-mode fusion
description: The invention provides an intelligent diagnosis method for defects of an outer facade of an infrared thermal imaging building based on multi-modal fusion, which relates to the technical field of building detection, and comprises the steps of synchronously acquiring infrared thermal imaging, visible light images and three-dimensional point cloud data to construct a multi-modal data set; the method comprises the steps of dividing a hot spot area by adopting an improved morphological watershed algorithm, extracting contour and temperature characteristics, identifying surface cracks and peeling areas based on a double-branch attention network to generate a texture defect characteristic map, calculating curvature distribution and thermal deformation gradient through spatial registration constrained by a heat conduction equation, calculating hot spot morphology dispersion TSMD and structure risk quantization factor SRQF by fusing multisource characteristics, constructing a defect risk decision matrix to output defect types, positions and risk grades, and superposing diagnosis results to a BIM model to generate a three-dimensional visual report and predicting thermodynamic evolution trend. The method realizes the collaborative analysis of multi-mode data, accurately quantifies the defect risk, and solves the problems of poor anti-interference performance, inaccurate segmentation and large registration error of the traditional method.

title: A machine learning-assisted microwave circuit optimization method based on a high-dimensional output surrogate model
description: The invention discloses a machine learning auxiliary microwave circuit optimization method based on a high-dimensional output proxy model, which utilizes Gaussian process regression (HOGP) of high-dimensional output to learn various performance parameters in a microwave circuit working frequency band to obtain the proxy model, and optimizes an acquisition function of a maximum basis Yu Mengte Carlo sample to explore the existing optimal solution. HOGP map the high-dimensional output to a low-dimensional latent space, modeling correlation by covariance structure of latent variables. Compared with the traditional machine learning optimization method, the method has the advantages of faster convergence speed, better optimization result and robustness.

title: Method and device for tracing generated model based on inverse fact reasoning
description: The application relates to a method and a device for tracing a generated model based on anti-facts reasoning, wherein the method comprises the steps of inputting a face image into a pre-trained backbone network to extract a basic feature map, generating fact attention and anti-facts attention in parallel by utilizing an anti-facts feature decoupling module, carrying out enhancement processing on the basic feature map to generate a causal enhancement feature map, acquiring corresponding fact attention prediction and anti-facts attention prediction according to the causal enhancement feature map, obtaining causal effect of quantized attention quality based on difference between the fact attention prediction and the anti-facts attention prediction, taking the causal effect as an optimization target, designing a loss function, and adding the loss function into a loss function of an original basic network. Therefore, the problems that the generated attention is hard to stably reflect the unique fake characteristics of the model due to the fact that the related technology generally faces the interference of false correlation and source deviation content, and accurate tracing and identification of an unknown generated model cannot be achieved are solved.

title: Behavior specification supervision large model system cooperatively defined by natural language and picture
description: The present invention provides a large-scale model system for behavioral norm supervision with collaborative definition of natural language and pictures, which belongs to the technical field of behavioral norm supervision. First, a set of association mapping rules is constructed between natural language descriptions and normative schematic pictures to clarify the correspondence between text semantic elements and picture visual elements and collaborative constraints; then, the behavioral description text and scene schematic pictures of the to-be-supervised scene are received, and bidirectional conversion processing is performed according to the association mapping rule set to obtain a text-picture collaborative feature set, and then a pre-trained norm generation model is called based on this to extract behavioral norm elements and generate a behavioral norm draft containing behavioral boundary conditions and compliance judgment benchmarks; the draft behavioral norm is compared with a preset regulatory standard library for consistency, and the draft is iteratively adjusted according to the correction item identifier in the comparison result, and finally a behavioral norm supervision instruction is generated and sent to a regulatory execution terminal, which greatly improves the accuracy and reliability of behavioral norm supervision.

title: Semi-supervised abdomen multi-organ CT image segmentation method based on bidirectional anatomical mixing
description: The present invention belongs to the field of medical image digital processing technology, and specifically relates to a semi-supervised abdominal multi-organ CT image segmentation method based on bidirectional anatomical blending. The method comprises the following steps: Step 1: generating a random mask for labeled and unlabeled abdominal multi-organ CT image data, then performing bidirectional foreground blending in the foreground area corresponding to the mask, and also blending the labels accordingly, reducing the distribution difference between labeled and unlabeled data through data fusion; Step 2: introducing an image segmentation and reorganization method to segment and reorganize the mixed image; Step 3: using the Mean Teacher framework, model training and loss calculation are performed on the mixed and reorganized image, and finally outputting a segmentation mask; Step 4: using the segmentation mask trained in Steps 1 and 3 to process the abdominal multi-organ CT image to be segmented to obtain a segmentation result. The present invention performs optimization training under the Mean Teacher framework to achieve efficient and accurate segmentation results.

title: Vehicle-mounted atmosphere lamp control method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a method, device, electronic device, and storage medium for controlling vehicle ambient lighting. The method includes: extracting music rhythm features from audio signals from a vehicle audio system in real time; determining a currently loaded user profile, wherein the user profile stores at least one personalized setting parameter for the vehicle ambient lighting for the corresponding user; and controlling the vehicle ambient lighting according to the music rhythm features based on the personalized setting parameter. The present invention's solution enables precise synchronization of the ambient lighting with the music rhythm, while also controlling the ambient lighting according to user preferences, thereby improving the user experience of the in-vehicle lighting environment.

title: Airplane collaborative recovery dynamic scheduling decision-making method and system based on parallel reinforcement learning
description: The present application discloses a method and system for dynamic scheduling decision-making of collaborative aircraft recovery based on parallel reinforcement learning, which involves the intersection of air traffic control and reinforcement learning. The method includes creating multiple parallel environment instances, configuring the initialization attributes of each aircraft in each environment instance, generating a fleet state vector, performing a recovery action on the aircraft selected by the intelligent agent in the decision stage of each environment instance, calculating multi-target rewards, updating the global timestamp by the current recovery time, synchronizing the current fleet state vector, and repeating the above steps until all are recovered; selecting the action sequence corresponding to the maximum total accumulation as the target dynamic scheduling decision sequence. The present application solves the problems of insufficient consideration of fuel consumption randomness, insufficient priority task guarantee, and ineffective avoidance of safety risks caused by static scheduling based on a multi-target reward mechanism composed of fuel rewards, priority rewards, and safety rewards, and solves the problem of low efficiency of single-environment reinforcement learning training.

title: Cigarette image detection method based on deep learning
description: This invention discloses a deep learning-based cigarette image detection method, comprising: 1. preprocessing a cigarette image dataset; 2. constructing a cigarette detection network to output predicted cigarette labels; 3. constructing a loss function; and 4. using the constructed cigarette network and loss function to train the preprocessed cigarette data. This method enables high-precision positioning and recognition of cigarette packs/cartons at any rotation angle, effectively overcoming the effects of packaging reflections and uneven lighting on recognition. It also effectively distinguishes cigarettes of similar brands through texture-color bimodal fusion.

title: A locomotive wheel-rail adhesion identification and traction motor coordinated control method and system
description: The invention relates to the field of traffic locomotives, in particular to a locomotive wheel track adhesion identification and traction motor cooperative control method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting wheel track adhesion data, preprocessing the wheel track adhesion data to generate an input data sequence, constructing and training an adhesion state prediction module based on a long-short-term memory neural network, inputting the input data sequence into the trained adhesion state prediction module, outputting an adhesion coefficient predicted value, constructing a torque optimization calculation module, inputting the adhesion coefficient predicted value into the torque optimization calculation module, calculating to obtain optimized traction motor torque, transmitting the optimized traction motor torque to a locomotive motor control module, and adjusting the output motor shaft torque by the locomotive motor control module based on the optimized traction motor torque so as to achieve the optimal adhesion state of the wheel track. The invention realizes the accurate control of the locomotive, effectively reduces the phenomena of wheel slip and idle running, and reduces the energy consumption and the abrasion of wheel tracks.

title: Image hiding method and related device based on spatial-channel attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses an image hiding method and a related device based on a space-channel attention mechanism, which belong to the technical field of image hiding, wherein a secret image and a carrier image are input into a pre-trained image hiding network model to obtain a secret image and lost information, and image hiding is completed, the image hiding network model is an image hiding network model based on the space-channel attention mechanism and comprises a preprocessing network, a hiding network and an extraction network, the hiding network takes a reversible neural network as a basic framework, forward propagation and reverse propagation processes of the reversible neural network are modeled as encoding and decoding processes of the image according to the requirements of an image hiding task, and the reversible hiding and high-quality extraction of the secret image are realized by combining with a DWT (discrete wavelet transform).

title: A multi-source fusion transmission line channel safety monitoring method and device based on digital twin
description: The invention relates to the technical field of power transmission safety of power systems, and discloses a digital twinning-based multi-source fusion power transmission line channel safety monitoring method and device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining binocular vision image data and laser radar point cloud data, fusing by utilizing DeepFusion multi-mode fusion models, generating fusion models so as to conduct digital twin modeling on a transmission line channel and achieve intelligent safety monitoring on the transmission line channel, conducting semantic segmentation and target recognition on the obtained fusion model data, recognizing and positioning potential hidden danger targets such as construction vehicles, tree barriers, forest fires and artificial buildings below the transmission line channel, calculating the distance between the transmission line and the potential hidden danger targets, sending early warning to power grid operation staff if the potential danger is recognized, establishing a digital twin model on the transmission line channel, assisting the operation staff in judging dangerous situations quickly, formulating maintenance rescue schemes in time, and guaranteeing safe and stable operation of the transmission line. The intelligent safety monitoring system can realize intelligent safety monitoring of the transmission line channel, improve the operation and maintenance efficiency of the power grid and reduce the manual inspection cost.

title: Load prediction and energy dynamic scheduling method and system for multi-region micro-grid
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power, and discloses a load prediction and energy dynamic scheduling method and system for a multi-district micro-grid. The method comprises the steps of obtaining total load power, energy storage state, charging and discharging power and load power of each station area in a first period before tracing, inputting the total load power and the load power of each station area into a cloud LSTM model to obtain load prediction base lines of each station area in a second period in the future, constructing a multi-target scheduling model with minimum total cost and minimum load change rate as targets, solving the multi-target scheduling model based on a quantum chaos collaborative algorithm to obtain a prediction charging and discharging strategy, inputting the load prediction base lines, the prediction charging and discharging strategy, a real-time energy storage state, the real-time charging and discharging power and a real-time load power deviation value into an edge LSTM model to obtain charging and discharging power adjustment quantity in a third period in the future, and obtaining a target charging and discharging strategy to conduct energy storage adjustment. The invention can more accurately schedule the energy to meet the actual demands.

title: A method and system for realizing early warning of key odor components in a factory
description: The present invention discloses a method for realizing early warning of key odor components in a factory, comprising: measuring the odor concentrations of different production units in a factory area to be evaluated, and screening key odor sources; collecting odor samples of the key odor sources, and performing full odor component analysis and olfactory sensory testing on the odor samples, and screening key odor components in the factory; collecting historical concentration data at the boundaries of relevant devices corresponding to each key odor component, analyzing the diffusion of the corresponding component, and obtaining the factory boundary concentration of each component after the diffusion analysis; based on this, combined with the factory boundary concentration limit of each key odor component, determining the early warning concentration threshold value at the boundary of each relevant device; collecting the actual concentration data at the boundary of each relevant device, and using the early warning concentration threshold value to issue an early warning for the key odor components in the factory.

title: Method and medium for generating controllable content of natural person values based on PEFT
description: The present application discloses a method and medium for generating controllable content of natural person values based on PEFT, which relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method includes: guiding the original ternary argument structure data set with an instruction template to determine a structured training sample; establishing a learnable value embedding matrix, and based on the learnable value embedding matrix, embedding through dimensionality transformation to obtain a structured value matrix; based on the structured training sample, performing LLM perceptual fine-tuning learning on the structured value matrix to determine the MoE‑LoRA extended architecture; according to the MoE‑LoRA extended architecture, configuring the routing expert weight through adaptive expert weight configuration to obtain the routing expert weight; based on the routing expert weight, determining the value guidance vector through the forward process enhancement of the associated sample. The present application solves the technical problems of the lack of coherent expression of value classification tasks, the need for value-oriented tasks to additionally meet semantic constraints, and the coexistence of irrelevant knowledge and value-specific elements through the above method.

title: Generative image forgery detection method based on attention guidance and incremental learning
description: The invention discloses a generated image counterfeiting detection method based on attention guidance and increment learning, and constructing an end-to-end detection model, wherein the end-to-end detection model comprises a multi-mode feature coding module, an A-DTG module, an increment learning module and a classification module. The A-DTG module generates domain labels by using a self-attention mechanism and a multi-mode attention fusion technology, the incremental learning module is combined with an online incremental learning algorithm, knowledge distillation and migration learning technology to realize real-time updating of the model, and the model is optimized and trained through classification loss functions, distillation loss functions and total loss functions. The invention effectively solves the problems of insufficient detection capability of the novel counterfeiting technology, weak multi-mode data processing and incapability of updating the model in real time in the prior art, and can remarkably improve the accuracy, generalization and timeliness of image counterfeiting detection in scenes such as news media, judicial evidence obtaining, social media and the like.

title: Financial data query method and device, electronic device, and storage medium
description: The application discloses a financial data query method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence or other related fields, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving a data query demand, and retrieving a knowledge document according to the data query demand to obtain index information of a target data table indicated by the data query demand; generating N sequentially associated reasoning tasks based on the data query requirement, and sequentially executing the N reasoning tasks to obtain N reasoning results, wherein N is a positive integer, generating a prompt text based on the data query requirement, the search result and the N reasoning results, inputting the prompt text into a target large language model, outputting a database query sentence, and executing the database query sentence to obtain a financial data query result. The application solves the technical problem that the accuracy of the financial data query is low because the user query requirement is difficult to be accurately understood under the condition of complex financial system database environment in the related technology.

title: A BERTopic-SBERT hybrid-driven duplicate defect report detection method
description: The invention relates to a BERTopic-SBERT hybrid-driven repeated defect report detection method which comprises the steps of selecting public defect report original data, marking all the defect report original data to obtain real labels of the defect report original data, inputting a defect report original data set into a data preprocessing module for data feature extraction, preprocessing all the extracted data features to obtain a training set, constructing a defect report group by using the training set, generating a positive sample pair set and a negative sample pair set by using all the defect report groups, then calculating the topic similarity and semantic similarity of each defect report pair, combining the topic similarity value and the semantic similarity value of the defect report pair, and inputting the combined result into a defect report classification module to obtain a repeated report classification result. The method of the invention can lead the project to have stronger generalization performance and robustness when the project is different.

title: An early screening system for pulmonary fibrosis based on big data analysis
description: The invention provides a pulmonary interstitial fibrosis early screening system based on big data analysis, which comprises a data acquisition module, a model checking module, a data preprocessing module, a data storage module, a data analysis module and a result output module. The system builds an early stage pulmonary interstitial fibrosis screening model based on historical data, performs big data analysis on the characteristics extracted from the medical image data of a patient according to the model, so as to remove wrong characteristics, and performs calculation of pulmonary interstitial fibrosis characteristic coefficients according to the correct characteristics by using a data analysis module, so that the accuracy of calculation results is improved, and based on evaluation made by the calculation results, a doctor can be assisted to more accurately identify early stage pulmonary interstitial fibrosis characteristics, the accuracy of early diagnosis is improved, and missing diagnosis and misdiagnosis conditions are reduced.

title: Multi-timescale rolling optimization method for active distribution networks driven by multi-agent graph reinforcement learning
description: The invention provides a multi-agent diagram reinforcement learning driven active power distribution network multi-time scale rolling optimization method which comprises the steps of dividing slow time scale equipment and fast time scale equipment, modeling slow time scale optimization into multi-agent Markov games, defining a global state space and a joint action space corresponding to a switching action, a reactive compensation equipment gear and a voltage regulation equipment gear, generating a switching action candidate vector based on a power distribution network basic loop, compressing action space dimension through a scheme excluding the same common branch conflict action, fitting action cost functions of each agent by adopting a graph neural network, generating a discrete action strategy after dimension reduction according to the global state space, and performing collaborative optimization through a distributed decision and a global rewarding mechanism, and converting a fast time scale optimization problem into a mixed integer second-order cone planning model and solving a rolling instruction based on a slow time scale optimization result.

title: Manufacturing visual identification method and system based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention discloses a manufacturing visual identification method and a manufacturing visual identification system based on artificial intelligence, which relate to the technical field of visual identification and comprise the steps of acquiring a manufactured product finished product image as target domain data, synchronously acquiring a finished product image containing a label as source domain data, unifying target domain data and source domain data formats, processing the extracted characteristics of the target domain data and the source domain data by adopting deep separable convolution, constructing a covariance matrix, calculating correlation alignment loss, synchronously defining contrast loss and domain-specific invariant loss aiming at the target domain and the source domain respectively to form final optimized target function output aligned target domain data and source domain data characteristics, updating a weighted result by a time gating mechanism, outputting the further processed target domain data and source domain data characteristics, constructing an SVM classification model, and inputting the further processed target domain data and source domain data characteristics into the SVM classification model to identify manufactured product defects. The invention greatly improves the accuracy of visual identification.

title: Quantum calculation measurement and control system, control method thereof and quantum computer
description: The application provides a quantum computing measurement and control system, a control method thereof and a quantum computer, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining the triggering period of an intermediate frequency signal and the frequency of a plurality of microwave signals, so that the ratio of the triggering period to the period of any microwave signal is a positive integer; based on the trigger period, the trigger waveform output module outputs a plurality of intermediate frequency signals so that the signal processing module mixes the plurality of intermediate frequency signals with the plurality of microwave signals to generate a plurality of quantum bit driving signals with coherent phases, wherein each quantum bit driving signal corresponds to at least one intermediate frequency signal and at least one microwave signal. The application ensures that the triggering period of the intermediate frequency signal is positive integer times of the period of each microwave signal, and can mix frequencies to obtain a plurality of paths of quantum bit driving signals with coherent phases as long as the phase coherence among the plurality of paths of microwave signals is kept.

title: Product screening method, apparatus, computer device, storage medium and computer program product
description: The present application relates to a product screening method, apparatus, computer device, storage medium and computer program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining attribute information and promotion conversion information of each product, determining a first product state of the product in a current time period according to the promotion conversion information of the product, representing the heat condition of the product, predicting a second product state of the product in a future time period according to the attribute information and promotion conversion information of the product, and screening out a target product from the products according to the first product state and the second product state. The method can improve the product screening efficiency.

title: Intelligent adaptation method and adapter for battery pack increase Cheng Kuorong of new energy automobile
description: The invention discloses a new energy automobile battery pack Cheng Kuorong intelligent adaptation method and an adapter, which relate to the technical field of new energy automobile power battery management and comprise the following steps: and establishing a handshake state behavior model, continuously recording a sending message and a receiving message in each communication interaction process in a primary access process through an adaptation system, extracting a time stamp of each handshake response, data frame structure characteristics and a feedback state of a main control controller, and forming a standard communication behavior track data set for comparison analysis. According to the invention, the pseudo-synchronous risk coefficient driving access control logic is constructed, so that the capacity expansion battery is automatically disconnected when communication is abnormal, and intelligent judgment and re-access after communication is recovered are realized, high-risk working conditions such as SOC drift and current conflict can be effectively prevented, the compatibility and safety of the system are improved, and an intelligent capacity expansion general technical framework suitable for a multi-platform and multi-protocol environment is constructed.

title: PM prediction based on GCN-TCN combined neural network2.5Concentration method
description: This application belongs to the field of environmental resource information technology, and in particular relates to a method for predicting PM  2.5  concentration based on a GCN-TCN combined neural network, comprising: using a motor vehicle-mounted atmospheric suspended particulate matter sensor to record atmospheric suspended particulate matter concentration data at each monitoring location within a target area in real time, on a minute-by-minute basis; obtaining real-time meteorological data from a meteorological monitoring station adjacent to the target area; constructing an adjacency matrix based on each monitoring location covered by the area to be predicted, and combining the PM  10  concentration data at each monitoring location within the area to be predicted with the meteorological data via timestamps to obtain time series data; training a GCN-TCN combined neural network using the adjacency matrix and time series data as input and the PM  2.5  concentration at each monitoring location in the area to be predicted as a target value; and using the trained GCN-TCN combined neural network to predict PM  2.5  concentration within a future time range in the area to be predicted. This method improves the spatial resolution from kilometers to hundreds of meters while ensuring the accuracy of pollutant concentration prediction.

title: Glacier flow speed monitoring method and system based on multi-source remote sensing data
description: The invention discloses a glacier flow speed monitoring method and system based on multi-source remote sensing data. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an optical image, radar data, a height model, time sequence information and a glacier surface image, generating a glacier change trend through data fusion analysis, calculating a glacier surface two-dimensional displacement vector and constructing a three-dimensional flow velocity vector, extracting feature point coordinates to conduct gridding spatial analysis, perfecting three-dimensional motion description through a local interpolation method, extracting texture and crack features from the surface image, analyzing a microstructure through a convolutional neural network, generating preliminary dynamic information through space-time correlation and weighted fusion, determining the flow velocity change trend through history data correction and filtering treatment, and finally outputting complete glacier dynamic information through a dynamic prediction model. The method solves the problems of dimension missing and insufficient precision in the traditional glacier monitoring, and obtains more comprehensive and accurate glacier dynamic information.

title: Multi-agent collaborative cross-platform flood emergency decision support system and method
description: This invention discloses a multi-agent collaborative cross-platform flood emergency decision support system and method, including a data acquisition and processing module for acquiring and preprocessing multi-source sensor data; a terrain confluence construction module for constructing a directed terrain confluence map and generating a weighted adjacency matrix; a prediction processing module for establishing a neural ODE model of the terrain confluence map and outputting short-term and long-term prediction sequences; a consistency correction module for performing consistency judgment and outputting prediction results and a map of dangerous areas; a causal relationship construction module for forming an event-resource causal relationship graph; a causal game scheduling module for constructing a game problem and generating an emergency resource scheduling scheme; and a result distribution and display module for distributing the emergency resource scheduling scheme to the emergency response terminal. This invention achieves accurate flood prediction and efficient emergency resource scheduling through the terrain confluence map neural ODE and causal game equilibrium.

title: Method and system for repairing and 3D reconstructing based on polluted face picture
description: This invention discloses a method and system for restoration and 3D reconstruction of contaminated facial images, relating to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method comprises: obtaining and preprocessing a contaminated image containing a real prototype facial image; processing the preprocessed facial image using a preset generator-discriminator network; combining the initial generated prototype facial image with a preprocessed public facial dataset as input, processing the input image using a parallel encoder network to obtain an initial 3D facial model, a depth map, and a reflectivity map; establishing a depth-reflectivity loss function based on the depth map and reflectivity map; and training the generator and discriminator based on the updated generator loss function and the preset discriminator loss function, respectively, to output a target 3D facial reconstruction model. This invention addresses the problem of poor detail fidelity and realism in 3D reconstruction results from a single contaminated image.

title: Multi-scale fused intelligent detection method for machining quality defects of complex precise parts
description: The invention relates to the field of computer vision and defect detection, in particular to an intelligent detection method for machining quality defects of a multi-scale fused complex precise part, which comprises the steps of inputting a PCB image to be detected into a trained defect detection model and outputting corresponding PCB defect prediction information, wherein the processing steps comprise feature extraction of the PCB image through a backbone network, bidirectional feature fusion of initial feature images of multiple scales from top to bottom and from bottom to top through a bidirectional feature fusion module, decoding of the fused feature images of all scales and obtaining of the PCB defect prediction information through a detection head, and the bidirectional feature fusion module (BiFM) is used for carrying out bidirectional feature fusion of the initial feature images of the multiple scales from top to bottom and from bottom to top, and a multi-scale C2F module (MS-C2F) and a high-efficiency up-sampling module (EUSB) are introduced, so that the calculated amount of the model is effectively reduced while feature expression is enriched, and the accuracy and the instantaneity of small-size defect detection are improved.

title: Plant disease and pest image identification method and device based on ResNet and transducer fusion model
description: This application relates to a plant pest and disease image recognition device based on a ResNet and Transformer fusion model, and relates to the field of deep learning technology. The method comprises: inputting the plant pest and disease image to be identified into a ResNet and Transformer fusion model, wherein the fusion model includes a feature extraction module, a feature conversion module, and a classification module; performing feature extraction on the plant pest and disease image using a self-attention mechanism embedded in the feature extraction module to obtain image feature information; performing feature information conversion on the image feature information using the feature conversion module to obtain feature association information; and inputting the image feature information and feature association information into a classification module to obtain a recognition result for the plant pest and disease image. This method provides an efficient and reliable solution for the accurate identification of plant pests and diseases.

title: Artificial intelligent driven gastric sinus cancer new adjuvant therapy scheme optimization method and system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of medical decision and artificial intelligence, and discloses an optimization method and a system for an artificial intelligence driven novel auxiliary treatment scheme of antrum cancer, wherein the optimization method comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring clinical data of an antrum cancer patient and preprocessing; the method comprises the steps of S2, screening core features by adopting an iterative ReliefF algorithm and constructing composite features, S3, constructing a prediction model based on a Bayesian optimized K nearest neighbor algorithm, taking the composite features as input of the prediction model to predict treatment response, outputting individual tumor retraction level probability distribution of a patient, S4, taking the tumor retraction level probability distribution as a core component of a state space, inputting the core component into a double-layer reinforcement learning frame based on a punishment mechanism to optimize treatment decisions and outputting an individual treatment strategy parameter set, and S5, carrying out real-time scanning and verification on drug dosage parameters in the strategy parameter set and outputting a final approved individual treatment scheme. The invention improves the accuracy and intelligence level of the gastric sinus cancer treatment.

title: Multiphase fluid separation system based on fractal distributor and micro cyclone matrix
description: The invention relates to the technical field of multiphase fluid separation, in particular to a multiphase fluid separation system based on a fractal distributor and a micro cyclone matrix, which comprises a fractal distribution module, a cyclone matrix module, an intelligent regulation module and an adaptive feedback module, wherein the fractal distribution module distributes flow of multiphase fluid through a multi-stage branch network, the cyclone matrix module performs centrifugal separation through serial/parallel arrangement between a hydrocyclone and a spiral separator, the intelligent regulation module determines a control instruction of the cyclone matrix module through a CFD physical model and an LSTM prediction model, and the adaptive feedback module monitors the concentration of fluid particles of an actual separation product pipeline through an ultrasonic optical sensor array and determines a corresponding response result according to a comparison result of the concentration of the fluid particles and a preset particle concentration threshold range. The high uniform distribution of multiphase fluid can be realized, the formation of uneven flow and dead zone can be effectively avoided, and stable and consistent feeding conditions are provided for the subsequent cyclone separation.

title: Water surface micro amplitude wave detection method based on nonlinear reconstruction and Gao Weijie coupling technology
description: The invention provides a water surface micro amplitude wave detection method based on nonlinear reconstruction and Gao Weijie coupling technology. The method is used for the task of detecting the micro amplitude waves on the water surface. According to the method, a time-frequency domain constraint module and a blind source separation precision feedback module are introduced into a U-NET countermeasure network to carry out nonlinear reduction on a micro-amplitude wave signal, then feature extraction is carried out based on a subspace translation covariance matrix, a non-metric scaling technology is introduced to improve hybrid matrix estimation, and then a source signal is recovered through an optimal submatrix in a sparse space. The method realizes high-efficiency and accurate detection of the micro amplitude waves on the water surface.

title: An Unconditional Two-Light Face Image Generation Method and System Based on Attribute Decomposition
description: The invention provides an unconditional double-light face image generation method and system based on attribute decomposition, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring training data, namely acquiring data by using a thermal infrared camera and a visible light camera, and processing an infrared image into alignment with the visible light image by a quantization method; the training stage of generating a network comprises the steps of training a human face image pair with identity matching as a training sample, pre-training an identity feature extractor on a data set, recombining the identity feature acquired by the identity feature extractor and style features extracted by an encoder by a generator to reconstruct an image, and generating a double-light human face image, wherein the training sample selects any two images with different spectrums, and pre-training the features extracted by the identity feature extractor by a random identity sampler. The method has the beneficial effects that the style and the identity characteristics of the visible light image and the style characteristics of the thermal infrared image are respectively extracted, so that the identity information is kept uniformly under the cross-mode condition.

title: AI-based sepsis diagnosis and treatment system and methods
description: This invention relates to the field of medical data processing technology, and more particularly to a sepsis diagnosis and treatment system and method based on artificial intelligence analysis, comprising a data acquisition module, a dynamic detection and knowledge base module, a preprocessing module, an optimization algorithm module, a model building module, and an early warning output module. The data acquisition module generates a raw case dataset; the dynamic detection and knowledge base module performs data validity verification and triggers enhanced monitoring labels from the medical knowledge base to output a quality verification dataset; the preprocessing module generates a standardized feature matrix; the optimization algorithm module outputs an optimized training set; the model building module outputs a risk score; and the early warning output module generates a clinical decision support report. Clinical intervention results are fed back to the data acquisition module to form a closed-loop training sample stream. Through a three-pronged mechanism—dynamic detection to correct data bias, optimization algorithm to strengthen learning of scarce cases, and incremental training to update the decision boundary—the model's generalization ability and diagnostic accuracy in specific populations are improved.

title: A method for predicting urban traffic flow based on multiple spatiotemporal characteristics of road networks
description: The invention discloses an urban traffic flow prediction method based on road network multiple time-space characteristics, which comprises the following steps of obtaining historical traffic flow information and road topology connection structure information of a related area, constructing a corresponding data set according to prediction requirements, preprocessing the historical traffic flow information, constructing a time-space characteristic tensor and constructing a road adjacency matrix The invention carries out hierarchical decomposition on the time sequence data of the original traffic flow through the wavelet decomposition unit, extracts and models the characteristics of different frequency components respectively, so that the low frequency component fully learns the global trend and the periodic variation of the traffic flow, and the high frequency component mainly characterizes the dynamic variation of the burstiness and the locality in the traffic network.

title: Financial institution business process intelligent optimization method and related device
description: This application relates to the field of data processing, providing a method and related apparatus for intelligent optimization of business processes in financial institutions. The method includes: acquiring business process node data, business interaction support data, and business result feedback data of the financial institution to be processed; performing dynamic bottleneck process mining based on a dynamic conditional response mechanism, using the business process node data and business interaction support data to obtain bottleneck process analysis data; performing bottleneck process impact quantification based on the bottleneck process analysis data and business result feedback data to obtain bottleneck process priority data; performing bottleneck process association rule mining based on the bottleneck process priority data, business process node data, and business interaction support data to obtain bottleneck process association relationship data; and performing business process optimization based on the bottleneck process analysis data, bottleneck process priority data, and bottleneck process association relationship data to obtain more accurate business process optimization strategies.

title: Vegetation carbon reserve prediction method, apparatus and storage medium
description: This application provides a method, device, and storage medium for predicting vegetation carbon storage. The method includes: extracting a feature set of the area to be measured based on remote sensing images, an elevation model, and historical vegetation index information; inputting the feature set into a random forest vegetation classification model for prediction to obtain at least one vegetation type and the regional information of each vegetation type in the remote sensing image; segmenting the remote sensing image of the area to be measured based on a pre-trained vegetation segmentation model to obtain at least one vegetation proportion and the corresponding regional information of each vegetation proportion in the remote sensing image; and determining the carbon storage of the area to be measured based on the vegetation type, the regional information of each vegetation type in the remote sensing image, the vegetation proportion, and the corresponding regional information of each vegetation proportion in the remote sensing image. This application effectively improves the accuracy of forest carbon storage estimation.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle small target recognition method based on wavelet decomposition and motion vector
description: The invention relates to the technical field of target recognition, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle small target recognition method based on wavelet decomposition and motion vectors, which comprises the steps of performing three-level wavelet decomposition on a small target image to obtain a third layer of low-frequency information area and a plurality of high-frequency detail information areas, performing image enhancement processing on the high-frequency detail information areas, and carrying out image reconstruction on the plurality of high-frequency detail information areas and the third-layer low-frequency information area after image enhancement to obtain a reconstructed image, inputting YOLOv the reconstructed image into an improved model to identify small targets in the reconstructed image, and carrying out false detection judgment on the identified small targets. The invention can effectively improve the recognition accuracy of small targets under complex background by utilizing wavelet transformation to enhance the image detail information, and further improves the accuracy of the target recognition algorithm by removing false detection generated by partial environmental noise through false detection judgment.

title: Cardiovascular lesion parameter identification method and system based on data analysis
description: The invention relates to the technical field of cardiovascular disease diagnosis and discloses a cardiovascular disease parameter identification method and system based on data analysis, which are used for acquiring cardiovascular image data, physiological parameter data and clinical data of a patient to obtain multi-source data, and carrying out noise reduction, missing value and abnormal value processing on the multi-source data to obtain preprocessed data; calculating the mutual information value between each feature and the cardiovascular lesion by adopting a feature selection algorithm based on mutual information to obtain a target feature; encoding the target features, inputting the encoded target features into a parameter identification model, and processing the encoded target features by the parameter identification model to obtain a cardiovascular disease parameter identification result; the invention realizes accurate and rapid identification of cardiovascular disease parameters and improves the accuracy and efficiency of cardiovascular disease diagnosis.

title: Cross-modal alignment knowledge distillation-based kidney stone hardness prediction method and system
description: The invention discloses a kidney stone hardness prediction method and a kidney stone hardness prediction system based on cross-modal alignment knowledge distillation, comprising training a teacher network by utilizing multichannel DECT data, enabling the teacher network to predict stone hardness and extracting a physical attribute vector phi  DECT ;Φ DECT , wherein the dimension of the physical attribute vector phi  DECT ;Φ DECT  is d  p , each dimension corresponds to one physical attribute which plays a decisive role in hardness prediction, constructing a student network, and generating potential physical attribute vectors after receiving a single-channel SECT image by the student network And then based on the potential physical attribute vector Predicting hardness, building alignment loss, and letting in training student model The distribution and the geometric structure of the model approach phi  DECT , and the SECT image to be predicted is input into a trained student model to be predicted to obtain the hardness of the calculus. The method can transfer the rich information of the dual-energy CT into the flat scanning CT model so as to improve the prediction capability of the flat scanning CT on the hardness of kidney stones.

title: Domestic three-section code BERT training method based on dynamic increment learning
description: This invention discloses a BERT training method based on dynamic incremental learning for Chinese three-segment codes.
