The method specifically includes the following steps: S1, initializing the pre-trained model by selecting a BERT pre-trained model in a Chinese context as the starting point; S2, fine-tuning the base model by using the three-segment code dataset to fine-tune the BERT pre-trained model; S3, creating a base model by saving the fine-tuned BERT pre-trained model as a new base model; S4, iteratively fine-tuning the base model by using the previous version of the model as the pre-trained model and fine-tuning it using the three-segment code dataset to complete the iteration of the base model; S5, periodically resetting the model by resetting it to the state of the previous version of the base model at predetermined time intervals or when performance metrics are triggered, and then restarting fine-tuning to complete the training of the base model. This invention utilizes the previously trained model as a new pre-trained model to achieve knowledge accumulation and transfer, thereby improving the model's adaptability to new data.

title: Image processing system and method for differentiating types of dry eye syndrome
description: This application discloses an image processing system and method for differentiating types of dry eye syndrome (MGD), belonging to the field of image processing technology. It first performs standardized preprocessing on raw infrared meibomian gland images. Further, it introduces an artifact detection step to actively identify and locate interference areas in the image, such as eyelash occlusion and uneven lighting. Then, the perceived artifact information is used to guide the subsequent meibomian gland segmentation process, thereby achieving accurate extraction of meibomian gland morphology against complex backgrounds. Based on this, the precisely segmented gland morphology is quantified in multiple dimensions, transforming image features into objective numerical indicators. Finally, a decision tree model is used to comprehensively judge these numerical indicators and output a standardized MGD severity grading. This intelligently suppresses interference information caused by image artifacts, thus achieving more robust and accurate MGD severity grading even in poor-quality clinical images.

title: Container vulnerable part identification and 3D display method and system
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of container maintenance analysis and display, and provides a method and a system for identifying and displaying vulnerable parts of a container in 3D, which are characterized in that by a random forest model, and selecting a key factor field with higher importance from factor fields included in the collected historical maintenance data, so as to be beneficial to accurately identifying the vulnerable part. By analyzing the association relation between the components and the damage reason, generating association characteristics according to the association relation and association rules, and accurately predicting damage risk of the components in the target container which are not maintained for a long time in advance through a damage prediction model based on the association characteristics, key factor fields and current static characteristics of the target container so as to accurately identify vulnerable components. The 3D model of the target container and the fragile parts are displayed visually, so that the container structure and the fragile parts are displayed to a user more clearly, intuitively and vividly, the cognition comprehensiveness of the user on the container structure and the fragile parts is improved, and the accuracy of maintenance decision is improved.

title: Data center equipment fault prediction method and system based on machine learning
description: The application provides a data center equipment fault prediction method and system based on machine learning, and relates to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of data centers; the method comprises the steps of generating micro vibration through a piezoelectric actuator, obtaining an estimated value of the thickness of a scaling layer according to attenuation change of a feedback signal, taking multiphase bit stream data, health state indexes and the estimated value of the thickness as combined input, introducing a discriminator network into a generating network to conduct antagonistic training, generating reconstruction data which are difficult to distinguish from a normal state, calculating errors of the real reconstruction data and the reconstruction data, obtaining an abnormal fraction of the discriminator, judging fault evolution and predicting residual effective time when the error of the real reconstruction data and the error exceeds a historical data threshold, and realizing accurate prediction of the scaling fault of a cooling system of a data center and residual effective operation time prediction.

title: Moon load prediction method integrating time-of-use electricity price elements and long-short-period time sequence features
description: This application discloses a monthly load forecasting method that integrates time-of-use pricing factors and long- and short-term time-series characteristics, relating to the field of load forecasting. The method includes: constructing a monthly load forecasting model based on a dual-channel time-series neural network and a long- and short-term time-series routing module, using a knowledge transfer algorithm; the dual-channel time-series neural network includes a multi-scale block module, a Mamba module, and a local window transformer; obtaining key characteristic parameters of the monthly load; and inputting the key characteristic parameters into the monthly load forecasting model to predict the monthly load. This application can provide a scientific and reliable quantitative basis for electricity demand forecasting and system planning decisions.

title: Method for determining root cause of fault, electronic device and readable storage medium
description: This application discloses a method, electronic device, and readable storage medium for determining the root cause of a fault. The method includes: acquiring a fault text pair and at least one fault subgraph corresponding to a target fault, wherein the fault subgraph is used to characterize the reasoning path from the target fault to at least one first candidate root cause; inputting the fault text pair and at least one fault subgraph into a multimodal neural network to obtain the confidence level of each first candidate root cause, wherein the multimodal neural network is used to perform semantic encoding on the fault text pair to obtain a context embedding feature set corresponding to the fault text pair, and to perform graph feature encoding on the at least one fault subgraph to obtain a graph embedding feature set corresponding to each fault subgraph; and based on the confidence level of each first candidate root cause, determining the root cause matching the target fault from at least one first candidate root cause.

title: Independent station commodity recommendation method and device, equipment and medium thereof
description: This application relates to a method, apparatus, and medium for recommending products on an independent website. The method includes: responding to a product recommendation request and acquiring user data of the current user and product data of products currently listed on the independent website; inputting the user data and product data into a complete spatial multi-task model, and generating a first user feature vector and a first product feature vector by the corresponding built-in encoding network in the conversion index inference path within the model; generating a second user feature vector and a second product feature vector by the corresponding augmented encoding network within the path, wherein the augmented encoding network is pre-trained independently through comparative learning; fusing the user feature vectors and product feature vectors into a comprehensive feature vector by the prediction network in the path, and predicting conversion index data accordingly; and selecting a portion of the listed products based on their conversion index data and pushing them to the current user. This application can effectively improve the accuracy of product recommendations on independent websites.

title: Dermatophyte detection method, system, equipment and storage medium
description: This invention discloses a method, system, device, and storage medium for detecting skin fungi, relating to the field of skin detection technology. The invention includes the following steps: acquiring skin sample images using a microscope camera under fixed parameters and performing white balance correction; converting to LAB space, enhancing the brightness and chroma channels separately, and then merging them; extracting depth feature maps at three scales using an FPN backbone network; applying direction-sensitive convolutional kernels to calculate multi-scale directional responses and dynamically fusing them to generate a directional probability map; generating an initial mask based on the directional probability map and performing morphological optimization using direction-sensitive structural elements; extracting the skeleton from the optimized mask and calculating key morphological features such as the number of branch points and directional entropy; combining morphological and color features and inputting them into a lightweight classifier to determine the fungal species. This invention, by designing multi-scale direction-aware convolutional kernels, can more accurately identify slender and curved hyphal structures, thereby improving the reliability of morphological analysis.

title: Knowledge rewriting Agent-fused ozone intelligent prevention and control system and method
description: This invention discloses an intelligent ozone control system and method based on a knowledge rewriting agent. The system constructs an autonomous decision-making agent that integrates a knowledge graph and a large language model to achieve dynamic monitoring and intelligent control of VOCs treatment equipment. The system employs the Reflective Enhancement Knowledge Rewriting (RAKR) framework, dynamically fusing real-time sensor data with structured control knowledge through a two-layer reflective loop mechanism to generate accurate anomaly diagnosis hypotheses and process adjustment schemes. Core technologies include: a reasoning-driven knowledge rewriting agent, an open reflective loop before generation, a closed reflective memory system after generation, and a difference-perception preference alignment training framework. In VOCs treatment scenarios, it can dynamically respond to sudden changes in exhaust gas concentration, such as activated carbon adsorption tower saturation warning and catalyst poisoning resistance, such as sulfur/halogen pollution identification. This effectively solves the problems of poor dynamic adaptability and insufficient cross-modal decision-making reasoning ability in traditional VOCs treatment systems, significantly improving ozone control efficiency.

title: Operations related to AI/ML models
description: Exemplary embodiments of this disclosure relate to operations associated with artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) models. In one exemplary method, a first network device sends a first request to a second network device, the first request instructing the second network device to provide a first AI/ML model, and receives the first AI/ML model from the second network device. The first network device then obtains a fine-tuned AI/ML model based on the first AI/ML model. In this way, a custom local model can be obtained from a global base model to reduce the training complexity at the random access network (RAN) node. At the RAN node, a relatively lightweight custom AI/ML model can be obtained from a fairly large global base model at the core network (CN) or a third party, thereby reducing the training complexity at the RAN node.

title: Order issuing control method and device based on rule engine and electronic equipment
description: The invention discloses an order issuing control method, an order issuing control device and electronic equipment based on a rule engine, wherein effective order information is extracted by automatically identifying order characteristics; then, sorting orders according to preset rules, namely rejecting to issue, issuing at once, planning to issue three data pools, and storing orders pushed by an upstream system in different data pools based on rule matching; finally, orders can be orderly issued according to the pushing rules of different data pools, and therefore, compared with the traditional method of directly issuing orders to a downstream system, the method and the device realize classified pushing of orders, not only improve the flexibility of order issuing, but also realize orderly issuing of orders, thereby reducing the running pressure of the downstream system, ensuring the running stability of the system, simultaneously, the whole process does not need manual intervention, improving the efficiency and reducing the error rate, and therefore, the method and the device are very suitable for large-scale application and popularization.

title: Database-based intelligent question-answering systems and electronic devices
description: This invention discloses a database-based intelligent question-answering system and electronic device, belonging to the field of artificial intelligence technology. It includes: an entity extraction module for extracting core topic entities; an initial activity value creation module for creating initial topic activity values for new topics; an activity value update module for obtaining the updated topic activity value; an alternative topic filtering module for filtering out target alternative topics; a request generation module for retrieving response information from the response database; and a topic removal module for removing topics from the dynamic topic list. This invention, by constructing a dynamic topic list and intelligently managing the dialogue context based on an activity value decay mechanism, achieves accurate identification of user referents and realizes smooth and natural multi-turn dialogue interaction, solving the problems of incomprehensible referential meaning and disjointed multi-turn dialogues caused by a lack of context management capabilities in existing technologies.

title: A method and system for fast similar text retrieval
description: This invention discloses a method and system for fast similar text retrieval, belonging to the field of natural language processing and information retrieval technology. The fast similar text retrieval method includes the following specific steps: Step 1: Semantic vectorization. A pre-trained language model is used to encode the query text and documents in the text database into fixed-dimensional low-dimensional semantic vectors. Step 2: Hierarchical index retrieval. A first-level index structure is used to retrieve the N candidate documents closest to the query vector, forming the first candidate set. This invention achieves millisecond-level coarse screening through the parallel design of HNSW graph index and semantic cluster inverted index. The semantic cluster inverted index reduces the search space to a local optimum, avoiding global precision loss. New text only requires one cluster center distance calculation, significantly reducing the complexity of index updates.

title: Assessment and treatment systems and methods that integrate multiple psychotherapeutic approaches
description: This application relates to the field of mental health service consultation technology, and in particular to an assessment and treatment system and method that integrates multiple psychotherapeutic methods. In this system, a multimodal input module processes multi-dimensional information about the user's state; a mental state assessment module evaluates and analyzes this multi-dimensional information to obtain the user's mental health status result; a therapy integration module integrates multiple treatment methods into a targeted treatment plan based on the user's mental health status; an interactive production module produces the treatment plan into a system-implementable treatment activity; and a learning optimization module optimizes the treatment plan to achieve the best possible therapeutic effect. This allows the system to provide users with different problems with the most suitable integrated treatment plan, improving the system's accuracy and flexibility, enabling real-time adaptation and personalized adjustment of the psychotherapy process, and effectively enhancing the quality and effectiveness of digital mental health services.

title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Bridge Anomaly Early Warning Method and Device
description: This application discloses a bridge anomaly early warning method and device based on artificial intelligence, relating to the field of bridge monitoring technology. The method includes: constructing a bridge baseline model using digital twin technology and simulating the bridge's state to generate several state simulation data sets; constructing an anomaly detection model using a deep learning algorithm and an improved optimization algorithm based on the state simulation data sets; collecting multi-source heterogeneous monitoring data of the bridge and preprocessing the multi-source heterogeneous data to obtain a real-time monitoring data stream; inputting the real-time monitoring data stream into the anomaly detection model and triggering a bridge anomaly early warning based on the obtained anomaly detection score; after the early warning is triggered, performing damage diagnosis on the real-time monitoring data stream based on the bridge baseline model to obtain damage diagnosis results. This method solves the problems of lag and subjectivity, low data utilization, weak early warning capabilities, and inaccurate diagnosis inherent in existing technologies.

title: Wild animal detection method integrating unmanned aerial vehicle thermal infrared image and visible light image
description: This invention discloses a wildlife detection method that fuses UAV thermal infrared images and visible light images, belonging to the field of small target wildlife identification. The method includes the following steps: S1, acquiring a preprocessed set of TIR-RGB image pairs; S2, constructing an improved FDM-YOLO dual-source target detection model based on YOLOv8l, and training the improved FDM-YOLO dual-source target detection model based on the preprocessed TIR-RGB image pair set acquired in step S1; S3, inputting real-time acquired images into the improved FDM-YOLO dual-source target detection model trained in step S2, and outputting the wildlife detection result. By employing the above-mentioned wildlife detection method that fuses UAV thermal infrared images and visible light images, and through the improvement of the FDM-YOLO model, high-precision, real-time, and robust detection of small wildlife targets in complex wilderness environments is achieved.

title: Hybrid modulation identification method and device for multi-type signals
description: The invention relates to a mixed modulation identification method and device for multi-type signals, and relates to the technical field of communication signal processing. The method comprises the steps of processing an original discrete signal to obtain a noise reduction signal, classifying the noise reduction signal based on power mutation to obtain a burst signal or a non-burst signal, detecting the frequency mutation of the burst signal to obtain a frequency hopping signal or a burst signal, detecting the cyclic prefix of the non-burst signal to obtain an OFDM signal or a continuous signal, extracting fuzzy high-order cyclic accumulation volume characteristics of the continuous signal, the burst signal and the frequency hopping signal, reconstructing the OFDM signal into a three-dimensional signal frame, identifying the fuzzy high-order cyclic accumulation volume characteristics of each signal, and outputting a modulation format of a corresponding signal. The invention can realize the integrated identification of multiple types of signals.

title: A Transposon Hierarchical Classification Method Based on Dynamically Gated Multi-Scale Features
description: The invention belongs to the field of bioinformatics, and particularly relates to a transposon hierarchical classification method based on dynamic gating multi-scale features. Firstly, extracting K-mer frequency and One-hot coding bimodal features from a DNA sequence, secondly, respectively coding the bimodal features with a DNA specific convolution pyramid through a gating multi-scale convolution network, then, carrying out self-adaptive feature fusion by using an attention gating mechanism taking sequence features as conditions, and finally, carrying out hierarchical decision from top to bottom in a classification tree based on probability threshold values. The invention solves the defects of the existing method in feature capture, fusion and hierarchical decision, realizes transposon classification with high precision and high efficiency, and provides a more accurate and reliable analysis tool for genome annotation, evolution research and functional genomics.

title: Methods and electronic equipment for generating power grid equipment maintenance work orders
description: This invention relates to the field of power grid equipment maintenance technology, and provides a method and electronic device for generating power grid equipment maintenance work orders. The method includes: processing user input information into prompt information based on a knowledge graph, wherein the relationships constructed in the knowledge graph include subordinate relationships and physical connection relationships between primary and secondary equipment; combining the prompt information and user input information into enhancement information based on prompt word templates, wherein the prompt word templates are determined according to the relationships constructed in the knowledge graph; and inputting the enhancement information into a large language model to generate the work order, wherein the large language model is obtained by supervised fine-tuning training of a base large language model. During the supervised fine-tuning training, the weight increments of the attention layer and feedforward network layer of the base large language model are decomposed into multiple low-rank matrices, and the low-rank matrices are set with corresponding dropout probabilities and scaling coefficients. This addresses the problem of low practicality and reliability of work order generation methods in related technologies.

title: A method for monitoring and optimizing intelligent electrical equipment
description: The invention discloses an intelligent electric equipment monitoring and optimizing method, which relates to the technical field of electric power and comprises the steps of collecting high-dimensional voltage-current time sequence data and transient event marks, calculating topological invariant features, inputting the topological invariant features into a lightweight neural network model, identifying each electric equipment feature, carrying out abnormal attribution and inverse fact energy efficiency prediction by using causal reasoning and dynamic regular regression based on each identified electric equipment feature, constructing a multi-objective optimizing function by using the abnormal attribution and the inverse fact energy efficiency prediction, generating an equipment operation scheduling strategy by deep reinforcement learning of an agent based on the multi-objective optimizing function, sending a control instruction to the electric equipment based on the operation scheduling strategy, and collecting operation result feedback in real time to carry out optimization updating. According to the invention, by fusing topological features, causal reasoning and safety reinforcement learning, the accuracy, robustness and safety of intelligent electric equipment monitoring and optimizing are improved.

title: Heterogeneous resource pool-based large model training task arrangement method
description: This invention provides a method for orchestrating large-scale model training tasks based on a heterogeneous resource pool. The method includes: constructing a heterogeneous resource pool and acquiring the current resource status and historical performance data of each computing node; determining the computational resource requirements of each subtask of the large-scale model training task; matching computing nodes to each subtask based on the current resource status and historical performance data of each computing node, as well as the computational resource requirements of each subtask, by comprehensively considering the current load, historical performance, expected energy consumption of executing the corresponding subtask, and the computational resource requirements of the subtask; during the execution of subtasks based on computing nodes, if it is detected that the resource status of a computing node does not meet predetermined requirements or the subtask execution progress is abnormal, re-matching computing nodes to the subtask and continuing the execution of the subtask; after all subtasks are completed, summarizing and verifying the large-scale model training task, and releasing the occupied computing nodes. According to this invention, the problems of low utilization rate and low energy efficiency of heterogeneous computing resources in existing large-scale model training based on heterogeneous computing resources can be solved.

title: A Method for Parameter Identification and SOC Estimation of Lithium-ion Batteries Based on MSDBO-FFEKF
description: The invention provides a parameter identification and SOC estimation method based on MSDBO-FFEKF, and belongs to the technical field of lithium ion batteries. The technical problem of large SOC estimation error caused by inaccurate parameter estimation of a classical swarm intelligent algorithm is solved. The method comprises the following steps of 1) carrying out intermittent constant-current discharge experiments on the lithium ion battery to measure terminal voltage and load current, 2) establishing a second-order RC equivalent circuit model, 3) providing MSDBO an algorithm to carry out parameter identification on the second-order RC equivalent circuit model of the battery, 4) constructing an extended Kalman filter with forgetting factors, and 5) inputting parameters obtained by identification of the MSDBO algorithm into FFEKF to accurately estimate the SOC of the battery. The invention can obtain high-precision parameters by utilizing the improved algorithm, thereby improving the estimation precision of the SOC.

title: A method for tracing the lineage and assessing the quality of cross-border e-commerce data
description: The invention relates to the technical field of data management and quality monitoring, and discloses a cross-border electronic commerce data blood-margin tracking and quality assessment method. The method comprises the steps of establishing a metadata snapshot sequence of data nodes by constructing a global topological graph containing space and level attributes, and calculating node association strength according to the metadata snapshot sequence to generate a dynamic propagation path so as to reflect the real flowing state of the data blood edges in real time. The state characteristic vector of each node on the path is extracted, and the potential migration mode of the data quality state is identified by analyzing the evolution trend of the state characteristic vector. And fusing migration modes of all paths to construct a data quality evaluation matrix, and driving iterative optimization of a tracking strategy to form closed-loop monitoring. The method can dynamically capture the change of the blood-cause relationship, accurately position the source of the quality problem and forecast the propagation of the source of the quality problem, and improves the reliability and maintainability of a data system.

title: Intelligent evaluation method for plateau avalanche susceptibility
description: The invention discloses an intelligent evaluation method for plateau avalanche susceptibility, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster risk evaluation. The method at least comprises the following steps of S1, collecting multi-source geospatial data of a research area, wherein the multi-source geospatial data comprise topographic factors, surface attributes and meteorological factors, performing spatial registration, resampling and normalization processing, S2, extracting an avalanche correlation evaluation factor sub-layer based on remote sensing interpretation and GIS spatial analysis, performing multiple collinearity analysis by adopting a pearson correlation coefficient and a variance expansion factor, removing redundant factors, and reserving key variables. The invention integrates the multisource geospatial data and fully delineates the avalanche formation conditions, acquires multisource geospatial data such as terrain, earth surface, weather and the like, and performs effective fusion processing, so that the avalanche formation conditions can be fully reflected from multiple angles and aspects, a rich and comprehensive data basis is provided for avalanche susceptibility evaluation, and the evaluation result is more accurate and reliable.

title: A digital technology and AI approach for generating transaction prices based on vector metadata of the agricultural supply chain
description: This invention provides a digital technology and AI method for generating transaction prices based on agricultural supply chain vector metadata, belonging to the field of agricultural product trading technology. The technical content includes: an innovative digital technology for generating transaction prices based on agricultural supply chain vector metadata, as well as the physical components and system architecture of the AI method system. The invented AI transaction price generation topology includes input layer neurons, hidden layer neurons, and output layer neurons; the AI system physical components include a feedback and optimization module, a multi-stage transaction support module, and modular interfaces. Business entities can obtain transaction data within seconds, drastically reducing transaction business decisions from days to levels, shortening transaction time by more than 30%, reducing transaction costs by more than 13-46%, and reducing settlement costs from several days to several hours. It enhances market fairness, enables innovation in pricing and transaction models, and has the advantages of inclusiveness and low marginal costs.

title: A Forest Canopy Closure Estimation Method Based on Lightweight Gradient Morphology Perception Network
description: This invention belongs to the field of forestry remote sensing monitoring and image processing technology, and specifically relates to a method for estimating forest canopy closure based on a lightweight gradient morphology perception network. The method includes the following steps: Step 1: Acquire a forest canopy remote sensing image dataset; Step 2: Construct a canopy segmentation model based on a lightweight gradient morphology perception network; Step 3: Train the model using a boundary-enhanced composite loss function; Step 4: Use the trained model for inference and forest canopy closure estimation. This invention can be efficiently run directly on consumer-grade drones or portable devices, meeting the needs of rapid forestry surveys. It can accurately capture subtle gradient changes between tree canopies, effectively cut overlapping canopy boundaries, significantly improve the geometric accuracy of segmentation, effectively filter out redundant information such as forest background and non-canopy shadows, and solve the texture confusion problem, possessing extremely high practical value.

title: Intelligent platform system and robot
description: The invention provides an intelligent platform system and a robot, which are applied to a humanoid robot scene, and comprise a cloud platform layer, an application scene intelligent body, a robot abstraction layer and a physical robot layer, wherein the cloud platform layer is used for providing skills, a graphical interface and a simulation test environment of a robot, the application scene intelligent body is used for receiving a working business flow compiled by the cloud platform layer, analyzing and adjusting the working business flow, the robot abstraction layer is used for providing interfaces of the robot abstracted by the capabilities of various robots of a plurality of manufacturers, and the physical robot layer comprises hardware of the robot connected to the intelligent platform system. In the method, knowledge can be multiplexed through hardware abstraction layer packaging differences and skill market packaging, a development threshold is reduced through a visual orchestrator, and finally, the robot is endowed with intelligence for coping with real-world uncertainty through scene application agents, so that a complete, open and efficient robot application development ecology is formed.

title: A medium-orbit space-based control system based on a large edge-side model
description: The disclosure relates to a middle orbit space-based management and control system based on an edge side large model, which belongs to the technical field of aerospace and comprises a physical bearing layer, an intelligent service layer, a cooperative control layer and a user service layer. The invention provides application of an edge side large model in a middle orbit satellite, which aims at limited computing resources of the satellite, deploys a lightweight large model, realizes local task assessment and decision, avoids high time delay caused by ground transfer, is based on a multi-satellite cooperative mechanism of edge side large model state perception, and is characterized in that satellite capacity (battery, load and bandwidth) is assessed through the edge side large model, dynamic allocation and cooperative processing of tasks are realized, the overall efficiency of a constellation is improved, an intelligent service unit for middle orbit application is designed, and an integrated management unit for not less than a perception module, an edge large model module, a decision execution module, a communication management module, a storage module and the like is designed, so that an end-to-end large model service capacity for space-based application is constructed.

title: A System and Method for Digital Reconstruction of Cultural and Tourism Resources Based on Generative Intelligent Models
description: This application provides a system and method for digital reconstruction of cultural and tourism resources based on a generative intelligent model, belonging to the field of intelligent model generation technology. It analyzes the features of the reconstruction requirements of a target historical scene to obtain the constraints of era characteristics during the visual restoration of the historical scene, and constructs a cultural knowledge graph. The target historical scene is then reconstructed under constraints to obtain a digital painting of the target historical scene. The cultural knowledge graph is used to verify the era consistency of the digital painting, obtaining the consistency verification result of the era characteristics within the digital painting. When the consistency verification result passes, the digital painting of the target historical scene is output; when the consistency verification result fails, the era conflict characteristics of the digital painting are identified. The conflict characteristics are then used to correct the conflict in the digital painting, resulting in a corrected digital painting. This application can suppress the erroneous generation of cross-era characteristics in the cultural and tourism resource generation model, thereby reducing the probability of era misalignment in the generation model.

title: A Non-Sample-Based Incremental Learning Method for Artificial Neural Networks Based on Sleep Mechanism
description: This invention discloses a non-sample-based incremental learning method for artificial neural networks based on a sleep mechanism, belonging to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method includes: training an artificial neural network using a dataset of a target category task to obtain an artificial neural network in a wake-up learning phase; replacing the activation function of the artificial neural network after the wake-up learning phase with a Heaviside step function, and periodically adding Poisson noise to random blocks of the average image of the dataset before inputting them into the artificial neural network; determining the activated neurons based on the replaced Heaviside step function; updating the connection weights between neurons based on the Heblin rule according to the activated neurons; and restoring the original activation function to obtain the artificial neural network in the sleep playback phase, i.e., the artificial neural network after completing incremental learning of the target category task. This method alleviates the catastrophic forgetting problem commonly encountered by neural networks when facing multi-task sequential learning.

title: Image segmentation network method based on dual-path latitude-crossing attention
description: The invention relates to an image segmentation network method based on dual-path latitude-crossing attention, and belongs to the technical field of medical image processing and deep learning. The method comprises the steps of performing size adjustment and standardization processing on stomach tissue pathological images by an input layer, adopting a double-path downsampling architecture by an encoder, combining a double-path characteristic interaction mechanism, extracting multi-scale characteristics through depth separable convolution and fusing, enabling a shallow jump connection layer to extract characteristics by dividing cross dimension and standard space dimension branches and fusing to generate jump connection characteristics based on a cross-latitude characteristic fusion mechanism, adopting an upsampling architecture by a decoder, combining a composite pooling attention enhancement mechanism, extracting local characteristics and generating decoding characteristics, and outputting a pathological change region segmentation result by an output layer through a single-channel convolution and activation function. The accuracy and stability of the segmentation of the pathological change region of the stomach tissue pathological image are effectively improved, and reliable image analysis support is provided for clinical pathological diagnosis.

title: A Boiler Nitrogen Oxide Emission Concentration Prediction Method and Application Based on XGBoost
description: The invention discloses a XGBoost-based boiler nitrogen oxide emission concentration prediction method and application, comprising the following steps of (1) collecting a data sample of an operation parameter related to the boiler nitrogen oxide emission concentration, (2) decomposing the data sample collected in the step (1) by adopting a characteristic mode decomposition method to obtain decomposed data, (3) training a constructed XGBoost model by utilizing the decomposed data, optimizing the super parameter of a XGBoost model by utilizing a fruit fly optimization algorithm in the model training process, obtaining an FMD-FOA-XGBoost model after training, carrying out model test evaluation, and (4) predicting the boiler nitrogen oxide emission concentration by utilizing an FMD-FOA-XGBoost model. The method can be used for predicting the emission concentration of the nitrogen oxides of the boiler under the deep peak regulation working condition, and can effectively improve the prediction accuracy.

title: Electric power facility monitoring method, system, device and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method, a system, a device and a storage medium for monitoring electric power facilities, which belong to the technical field of electric power facilities, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining positioning information of a power grid; the power grid positioning information comprises target positioning information of at least one target facility, the power grid positioning information is classified by utilizing a trained sedimentation discrimination model to obtain sedimentation information of the target facility, the sedimentation discrimination model is trained by utilizing a power grid positioning training set, if the sedimentation information is judged to be matched with a preset sedimentation condition, a sedimentation state corresponding to the target facility is generated, and the sedimentation state is used as a monitoring result. And the neural network model, namely the sedimentation discrimination model, is utilized to process the power grid positioning information to obtain the sedimentation state of each target facility, so that the target facilities are not easy to miss, and the sedimentation monitoring quality of the electric power facilities is improved.

title: Knowledge-driven bridge construction digital twin scene intelligent construction method and system
description: The invention discloses a knowledge-driven digital twin scene intelligent construction method and system for bridge construction, which solves the problem of complex modeling operations and low modeling efficiency in the prior art, which adopts the method of static and fine display of the scene, and is easy to cause construction problems. The model is difficult to meet the accuracy problem. The invention acquires bridge construction data to construct a bridge construction scene knowledge map; performs semantic modeling and environmental influence factor coupling on the bridge construction scene based on the bridge construction scene knowledge map, and obtains a coupled bridge construction virtual scene; based on the monitoring data acquired in a period , the long-short-term memory model and the coupled bridge construction virtual scene to intelligently predict the changes in the bridge construction scene. The invention is used for the intelligent construction of complex bridge construction digital twin scenes.

title: Operation and maintenance method, operation and maintenance system, equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to the field of computer technology, and the embodiments of the present application provide an operation and maintenance method, an operation and maintenance system, equipment, and a storage medium. The method includes acquiring operation and maintenance data of at least one monitored device; determining a first knowledge graph and a second knowledge graph according to the operation and maintenance data; wherein, the first knowledge graph is used to represent graph information of basic operation and maintenance data; the second knowledge The map is used to represent the map information of key assets; according to the first knowledge map and the second knowledge map, the operation and maintenance risk management and control of the monitored equipment is carried out. Since both the first knowledge graph and the second knowledge graph record the relationship with the monitored device, the accuracy of operation and maintenance can be made higher. At the same time, by using the first knowledge graph to represent the graph information of the basic operation and maintenance data; the second knowledge graph to represent the graph information of the key assets, it is possible to perform more refined management and control on the monitored equipment. The accuracy of operation and maintenance risk management and control.

title: Ground feature identification method based on Lush multilayer feature fusion bias network
description: The invention discloses a ground object identification method based on a Lush multilayer feature fusion bias network, and relates to a ground object identification method. The invention aims to solve the problem that in the existing method, in the ground feature classification task, an over-fitting phenomenon is often caused by an over-deep network structure, and the traditional activation function cannot effectively solve the problem; as the network model deepens, gradient explosion or gradient disappearance may also occur, which is not favorable for the problem of updating the bias in the network model parameters; and the problem of low accuracy of ground feature classification caused by the fact that the strong complementary relation between different feature layers is not considered and how to effectively fuse deep features and shallow features is solved. The process is as follows: 1. obtaining a trained multilayer feature fusion bias network based on the Lush; 2. and inputting the hyperspectral image to be detected into a trained Lush-based multilayer feature fusion bias network, and completing the classification of the hyperspectral image to be detected. The invention is used in the field of ground object identification.

title: Component-Based Sequencing Layer software Architecture for Intelligent Service Robots
description:
The present invention relates to a structure of a sequencing layer in which a control logic for actually performing a work plan and a relatively time-consuming algorithm service are located in a component-based software structure for an intelligent robot. Recognition module; An inference module that grasps the intention of the user based on a predetermined rule from the user's speech; An operation module for controlling the movement of the robot; And a content module that performs a specific service provided to the user by the robot.
     
       
     
      Intelligent Robot, Component Based, Software Architecture

title: System and method for AI controlling waste-water treatment by neural network and back-propagation algorithm
description: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence control system that automatically controls variable factors such as dissolved oxygen and microbial retention time according to the influent characteristics, reaction conditions and target water quality.In Korea, it is a flexible design factor that flows into sewage treatment plant through confluent sewer pipe. Through the data obtained by automatically measuring biological oxygen demand, inflow flow rate, and water temperature, one stage of control tank and two stages of control tank are applied by applying the residence time considering the volume of each reaction tank and settling tank which are fixed factors used in initial design. By collecting target knowledge such as dissolved oxygen amount and microbial retention time, and automatically controlling the supply air control valve and sludge drawing pump through the present value, knowledge of existing experts is collected to create the most appropriate knowledge-base. Artificial intelligence (neural controller) We use the learning method and algorithm to control the excess sludge by setting the concentration of dissolved oxygen corresponding to the change of temperature and the change of concentration, and calculating the appropriate SRT. Despite the differences, changes in sewage treatment plant capacity and flow, it can be applied to most sewage treatment plants by slight modifications and relearning and tuning with new data, and new and better efficiency by accumulating new data. The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence control system that is tuned to be able to do so.

title: Predicting the future movement of agents in an environment using occupancy flow fields
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for predicting the future movement of agents in an environment. In particular, the future movement is predicted through occupancy flow fields that specify, for each future time point in a sequence of future time points and for each agent type in a set of one or more agent types: an occupancy prediction for the future time step that specifies, for each grid cell, an occupancy likelihood that any agent of the agent type will occupy the grid cell at the future time point, and a motion flow prediction that specifies, for each grid cell, a motion vector that represents predicted motion of agents of the agent type within the grid cell at the future time point.

title: Method and system for anomaly detection based on time series
description: An anomaly detection method includes collecting and preprocessing time series data every preset detection cycle; detecting an anomaly in time series data preprocessed for a current detection cycle using a deep learning model trained with an unsupervised learning scheme using features of time series data of a previous detection cycle; retraining the deep learning model by further using the time series data preprocessed for at least one detection cycle included in the current learning cycle; and detecting an anomaly in time series data collected and preprocessed for a detection cycle after the current learning cycle using the retrained deep learning model.

title: Electronic device and method for processing user input
description: An electronic device and method are disclosed herein. The electronic device includes a communication circuit, a processor, and a memory. The processor implements the method, including: receiving, from each of one or more external devices receiving a voice signal of a user, via the communication circuit, a first probability value based on usage frequency, and a second probability value based on signal-to-noise (SNR) magnitude, calculating final probability values for each of the one or more external devices, based on respective first and second probability values of each of the one or more external devices, and selecting an external device from among the one or more external devices having a highest final probability value from among the calculated final probability values.

title: Integrating circuit elements in a stacked quantum computing device
description: A stacked quantum computing device including a first chip that includes a first dielectric substrate and a superconducting qubit on the first dielectric substrate, and a second chip that is bonded to the first chip and includes a second dielectric substrate, a qubit readout element on the second dielectric substrate, a control wire on the second dielectric substrate, a dielectric layer covering the control wire, and a shielding layer covering the dielectric layer.

title: Construction management method, system, computer readable medium, computer architecture, computer-implemented instructions, input-processing-output, graphical user interfaces, databases and file management
description: A system for construction management including a device having at least one processor and a memory storing at least one program for execution by the at least one processor, the at least one program including instructions, when, executed by the at least one processor cause the at least one processor to perform operations. The operations include receiving as input an electronic version of a document; identifying at least one string of data from the electronic version of the document; mapping the identified at least one string of data to a predetermined unitary database including at least one key string of data associated with at least one key event; tagging the mapped and identified at least one string of data with a tag associated with the at least one key string of data associated with the at least one key event; and transmitting a signal based on the tagged, mapped, and identified at least one string of data. Related methods, devices, apparatuses, systems, techniques and articles are also described.

title: Virtual Conversational Agent
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for generating and operating voice conversing virtual agents with pre-modeled and inherited human behavior across use cases and domains. One of the methods includes: using a first non-domain specific neural network based model to predict a non-domain specific conversational situation, the first neural network based model trained with labelled parts of conversations from more than one domain; forwarding the non-domain specific conversational situation to a second domain specific neural network based model; using the second domain specific neural network based model to predict a conversational situation and to provide a system intent, the second domain specific neural network based model trained with labelled parts of conversation from a specified domain; and generating a response based at least in part on the predicted conversational situation and system intent.

title: Methods for action localization, electronic device and non-transitory computer-readable storage medium
description: A method for action localization is disclosed. The method includes dividing a video comprising a first number of frames into a second number of clips, each of the clips comprising at least one of the frames; processing the clips to obtain a first clip descriptor for the each of the clips and feature maps for each of the frames; obtaining a representation of the video based on the first clip descriptor for the each of the clips; predicting an action classification of the video based on the representation of the video; calculating an importance weight for each of the feature maps based on a gradient of the action classification; and obtaining a localization map for the each of the frames based on importance weights of corresponding feature maps.

title: A Cyclic two-way Bidding Matching Method and System Based on The Needs of Both Sides of Job-hunters and Recruiters
description: This invention application presents a cyclic two-way bidding matching method and system used to periodically match resumes and recruitment positions by the way of bidding matching. Every round of bidding matching cycle comprises: comparing the pre-matching items of resumes and positions, and establishing a pre-matching relation between the positions and resumes if their pre-matching items match each other; based on the pre-matching relation, quantifying each resume's attraction and each position's attraction; building the bidding queue of resumes and the bidding queue of positions, then the two-way bidding matching is implemented to match resumes and positions to get the two-way optimal matching results. In every round of bidding matching cycle, a certain number of matching results are generated for each resume and for each position. As the bidding matching periodically runs rounds after rounds, more and more two-way optimal matching results are generated.

title: Quantum device integrating a buried metallic electrode
description: A Qbit spin quantum device includes juxtaposed first and second semiconducting portions, the semiconducting portions being formed in a surface layer of a semiconductor-on-insulator type substrate and disposed on an insulating layer of the substrate, the substrate being fitted with a semiconducting support layer such that the insulating layer is arranged between the support layer and the surface layer, and several pairs of front control gates, each pair being formed respectively of first and second front control gates covering a region of the first and second semiconducting portions to form first and second quantum islands, respectively. An insulating region is provided between the first and second quantal islands to enable electrostatic coupling between the first and second quantum islands. The quantum device includes a back conductive electrode vertically aligned with a coupling insulating region and being formed of a region of metal-semiconductor material alloy arranged in the support layer.

title: Reconstruction Algorithms for DNA-Storage Systems
description: There may be provided method for estimating an information unit represented by a cluster of traces that are noisy copies of a synthesized strand, the method may include estimating the information unit by applying processing operations on r-tuples related to the traces, wherein r is smaller than a number (t) of traces of the cluster; wherein processing operations applied on at least some of the r-tuples comprise calculating a length of a shortest common supersequences (SCS) of the r-tuples.

title: Privacy preserving machine learning labelling
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for identifying labels for a dataset without revealing the dataset to any individual computing system. Methods can include receiving, by a first computing system of a multi-party computation (MPC) system, a query that includes a first and second share of a given user profile. The second share is encrypted with a key that prevents the first computing system from accessing the second share. The second share is transmitted to a second computing system of the MPC system. The first and the second computing system generates a machine learning model and identifies a respective first and a second label. The first computing system receives the second label as a response from the second computing system. The first computing system responds to the query with a response that includes the first and the second label.

title: Transformation of data from legacy architecture to updated architecture
description: One or more systems, computer-implemented methods and/or computer program products to facilitate a process to transform original operational data into updated operational data. A system can comprise a memory that stores computer executable components and a processor that executes the computer executable components stored in the memory. The computer executable components can comprise a transformation component that can transform original operational data of a first architecture into updated operational data employable at a second architectures, wherein the second architectures is an updated architectures relative to the first architecture. In one or more embodiments, the transformation component further can employ machine learning to match one or more data elements of the original operational data to one or more aspects of the second architecture.

title: Method of managing system health
description: A method of managing system health is provided. The method includes calculating a reconstruction missing value with respect to the second domain data, determining a degree of degradation of the system on the basis of the reconstruction missing value, predicting a second remaining useful life (RUL) prediction value {tilde over (y)} of the system on the basis of the second domain data, based on a result of the determination of the degree of degradation, optimizing a degradation compensation function on the basis of a distribution of a first RUL prediction value y of the system predicted based on the first domain data in a pre-learning process of the diagnosis model, and predicting a final RUL prediction value {tilde over (y)}′ obtained by compensating for the second RUL prediction value {tilde over (y)}, by using the optimized degradation compensation function.

title: Method And System For Identifying Objects In A Blood Sample
description: A system and method for analyzing bodily fluid include a sample holder holding a bodily fluid sample, an image capture device generating an image of the bodily fluid sample comprising a plurality of fields of view. An image processor is programmed to determine a biofilm in the bodily fluid sample from the image, determine a biofilm area or volume within each of the plurality of fields of view to form a plurality of biofilm areas, determine a total biofilm area or total biofilm volume by adding the plurality of biofilm areas, determine a first value corresponding to a comparison of the total biofilm area or the total biofilm volume and a total volume of the bodily fluid sample, and classify the first value into a classification. An analyzer, using the classification, displays an indicator on a display for indicating the classification of the biofilm within the bodily fluid sample.

title: Neural network processing device, method, and computer-readable recording medium
description: The 1 dimensional data generation means  92  generates 1 dimensional data, by setting the number of elements of each dimension other than predetermined one dimension to 1 based on multidimensional data corresponding to one input data. The number of elements reducing means  93  reduces the number of elements included in the 1 dimensional data. The copy means  95  generates multidimensional data, by copying the 1 dimensional data whose number of elements has been reduced multiple times. The convolution layer processing means  96  performs a convolution layer process with a filter size of 1×1 on the multidimensional data generated by the copy means  95.  The element-wise product operation means  98  performs an element-wise product operation, based on the multidimensional data corresponding to one input data and multidimensional data generated by the above process.

title: Virtual Reality System with Modeling Poses of Tracked Objects by Predicting Sensor Data
description: A platform system receives sensor data describing the state and orientation of a tracked object and models the pose of the tracked object to determine user interactions with the platform system. To ensure that incorrect sensor data due to a saturation event or connection loss does not impact user experience, the platform system identifies regions for correction in sensor data streams based on the sensor data being at or above a saturation limit or not being received. The platform system predicts sensor data for an identified region of correction by applying a fit corresponding to points adjacent to the region for correction and determining predicted sensor data using the applied fit. The predicted sensor data is used to correct the modeled pose for the tracked object.

title: Apparatus, system, and method for classifying and neutralizing bias in an application
description: An apparatus for classifying and neutralizing bias, wherein the apparatus includes a computing device configured to receive candidate data items as a function of a candidate application, identify a potential bias of the candidate data items, and block the potential bias by removing the candidate data item associated with the potential bias from the candidate application.

title: Realistic neural network based image style transfer
description: A mobile device can implement a neural network-based style transfer scheme to modify an image in a first style to a second style. The style transfer scheme can be configured to detect an object in the image, apply an effect to the image, and blend the image using color space adjustments and blending schemes to generate a realistic result image. The style transfer scheme can further be configured to efficiently execute on the constrained device by removing operational layers based on resources available on the mobile device.

title: Parallelized video decoding using a neural network
description: In a method for decoding a data stream by way of an electronic device (10) including a processor (14), and a parallelized processing unit (16) designed to perform a plurality of operations of the same type in parallel at a given time, the data stream includes a first dataset (Fet) and a second dataset (Fnn) representative of audio or video content. The decoding method includes the processor (14) processing data from the first dataset (Fet), obtaining the audio or video content by processing (E70) data from the second dataset (Fnn) using a process depending at least partially on the data from the first set (Fet) and using an artificial neural network (18) implemented by the parallelized processing unit (16).

title: Integrated machine learning prediction and optimization for decision-making
description: A method includes training, by one or more processing devices, a plurality of machine learning predictive models, thereby generating a plurality of trained machine learning predictive models. The method further includes generating, by the one or more processing devices, a solved machine learning optimization model, based at least in part on the plurality of trained machine learning predictive models. The method further includes outputting, by the one or more processing devices, one or more control input and predicted outputs based at least in part on the solved machine learning optimization model.

title: System for dynamically provisioning cyber training environments
description: Methods and systems allow a user or operator to easily create cyber-training environments for use in a cyber-training system. In one embodiment, the environments are configured as missions. The missions may have a plurality of features, such as training objectives, a mission storyline, a mission order and mission objectives, relative to a mission environment. The mission environment comprises a virtual environment, such as defined by a virtual network having virtual machines or devices.

title: System and methods for predictive cyber-physical resource management
description: A system and method for predictive cyber-physical resource management, including a business operating system, parameter evaluation engine, at least one cyber-physical asset, at least one crypt-ledger, a network, and the ability to represent data in Markov State Models and finite state machines.

title: Damage Detection Based on Images With Varying Resolutions
description: Disclosed are devices, systems, apparatus, methods, products, and other implementations, including a method for detecting damage in a geographical area that includes receiving a first image of the geographical area, with the first image having a first resolution, and detecting damage to at least one object appearing in the first image in response to applying a trained learning engine to the first image. The learning engine is trained to detect damage in geographical areas based on received one or more images in a second set of images having a second resolution higher than the first resolution, and based on one or more images in a first set of images having the first resolution. The one or more images in the first set of images and the one or more images in the second set of images include one or more overlapping portions in which one or more objects appear.

title: Queue consolidation and peer-to-peer quantum workload stealing
description: Distributing quantum jobs are disclosed. When a quantum processing unit is underutilized or when wait times are long, quantum jobs may be distributed from the job queue of one vendor to another vendor. This improves utilization and reduces wait times.

title: Methods and systems for cyber threat detection using artificial intelligence models in data-sparse environments
description: Methods and systems comprising a first portion of a model that includes a model component that is trained to perform sentiment analysis based on training data for a plurality of users (e.g., what language, phrases, and/or responses the population at large uses). The first portion of the model also includes a model component that is trained to identify user intent based on the sentiment analysis that is specific to user groups. For example, the system first determines the likely context and/or meaning of communications of the user. The system then determines a likely intent of the user based on the likely context and/or meaning of communications (e.g., based on a correlation of the meaning of communications of the user and the intents of users corresponding to a user group of the user).

title: Calculating risk score associated with a physical structure for a natural disaster peril using hazard and vulnerability models
description: Examples described herein include methods and computing systems which may include examples of calculating risk scores for certain natural disasters perils based on machine learning model outputs. For example, a machine learning model may weight each of the pixels of a map in accordance with the set of weights associated with a structure, to calculate a risk score for a particular natural disaster peril associated with that structure. A plurality of risk selections may be provided to a user computing device for selection by a user, with those risk selections being associated with that risk score. Advantageously, the computing system facilitates the interaction of datasets with different measurement parameters in a machine learning model. In normalizing datasets before providing the datasets to input nodes of a machine learning model, a computing system may efficiently provide hazard and vulnerability outputs of the machine learning model.

title: Apparatus and method for generation an action validation protocol
description: The invention is directed towards an apparatus and method for generating an action validation protocol. A processor is configured to receiver user data relating to an action datum. The processor is configured to select an action datum validator. The action datum is transmitted to the action datum validator where an action datum label is selected. Once an action datum validator selects an action label, the action is further categorized. If the action datum has not been completed, it will be sent back to the action datum identifier.

title: Systems and methods for administrating a federated learning network
description: A method and apparatus of a device that trains or evaluates a model is described. In an exemplary embodiment, the device creates a loop network between a central aggregating node and a set of one or more worker nodes, where the loop network communicatively couples the central aggregating node. The device further receives and broadcasts a model training or evaluation request from one of the nodes in the loop network to one or more other nodes in the loop network.

title: Collaborative industrial integrated development and execution environment
description: A method for providing access to a development and execution (D&E) platform for development of industrial software, including providing while the D&E platform is being accessed a GUI with a development tool having process flow and code editors and an execution tool and arranging two or more programming blocks of a process flow responsive to input from an author when the process flow editor is accessed. The two or more programming blocks, when arranged, are configured to be executed. The method further includes editing source code of the two or more programming blocks responsive to input from the author when the code editor is accessed, compiling at least one of the two or more programming blocks responsive to input from the author when the execution tool is accessed, and executing the compiled at least one programming block responsive to input from the author when the execution tool is accessed.

title: Intelligent workload routing for microservices
description: A system may include a memory and a processor in communication with the memory. The processor may be configured to perform operations. The operations may include training a model. The operations may include enhancing the model with reinforcement learning and improving stability of the model with a graph neural network model. The operations may include predicting, with the model, a resource cost of a node and deploying the node.

title: Systems and methods for automatic data annotation
description: Described herein are systems, methods, and instrumentalities associated with automatically annotating a 3D image dataset. The 3D automatic annotation may be accomplished based on a 2D manual annotation provided by an annotator and by propagating, using a set of machine-learning (ML) based techniques, the 2D manual annotation through sequences of 2D images associated with the 3D image dataset. The automatically annotated 3D image dataset may then be used to annotate other 3D image datasets upon passing a readiness assessment conducted using another set of ML based techniques. The automatic annotation of the images may be performed progressively, e.g., by processing a subset or batch of images at a time, and the ML based techniques may be trained to ensure consistency between a forward propagation and a backward propagation.

title: Memory allocation method for ai processor, computer apparatus, and computer-readable storage medium
description: A memory allocation method for an AI processor, a computer apparatus, and a computer-readable storage medium. The method includes: obtaining a plurality of operators of a neural network; analyzing an operator whose input and output occupy memory space that can overlap; determining whether a size of an input of the neural network is fixed; and if yes, determining storage addresses of a memory blocks by using a static memory pool allocation algorithm: calculating a size of each memory block in an inference process of a neural network model, determining a life cycle of each memory block, determining whether the memory block is a memory block that can be overlapped and if yes, correcting the size and the life cycle of the memory block, and allocating a storage address to each memory block.

title: System and method for efficiently determining targeted training objectives for new hires
description: The present disclosure provides systems and methods for efficiently determining targeting training objectives for new hires. Employee performance is initially captured to provide a baseline performance, and is utilized, along with targeted performance goals, to determine an expected timeline for when an employee will reach a target performance threshold. This timeline can be used to generate SMART objectives (Specific agent attributes that can be Measured in their growth, which are Attainable and are Resource and Time bound), provide attainable goals and targets for employees, and develop a realistic and concrete training plan to implement.

title: Encoder, decoder, encoding method, and decoding method
description: An encoder includes circuitry and memory coupled to the circuitry. In operation, the circuitry: encodes an image to generate encoded image data; and generates supplemental enhancement information (SEI) including information indicating post processes. The post processes are to be applied sequentially to a decoded image generated by decoding the encoded image data at a decoder.

title: Automatically generating a custom artificially intelligent (ai) character based on a user-provided description of the ai character
description: Some examples of the present disclosure related to converting a text description input by a user into an artificially intelligent character. In one example, a system can receive a user input that includes a description of a custom artificially intelligent (AI) character. The system can then automatically generate the custom AI character based on the description. For example, the system can generate a personality dataset based on the description, a voice dataset based on the description, and/or an appearance dataset based on the description. The system can then provide the custom AI character using the personality dataset, the voice dataset, and/or the appearance dataset.

title: Protein-to-protein interface analysis
description: A method for analyzing a family of protein-to-protein interfaces between a first protein group and a second protein group may include assigning, to each position within an aligned plurality of protein sequences from the first protein group and/or the second protein group, a family position identifier. One or more clusters of protein-to-protein interfaces within the family of protein-to-protein interfaces may be identified based on the family position identifier assigned to one or more positions included in each protein-to-protein interface in the family of protein-to-protein interfaces. One or more protein-to-protein interface properties may be determined for the one or more clusters of protein-to-protein interfaces. Related systems and computer program products are also provided.

title: Goal-based Motion Forecasting
description: Example aspects of the present disclosure relate to an example computer-implemented method for predicting the intent of actors within an environment. The example method includes obtaining state data associated with a plurality of actors within the environment and map data indicating a plurality of lanes of the environment. The method includes determining a plurality of potential goals each actor based on the state data and the map data. The method includes processing the state data, the map data, and the plurality of potential goals with a machine-learned forecasting model to determine (i) a forecasted goal for a respective actor of the plurality of actors, (ii) a forecasted interaction between the respective actor and a different actor of the plurality of actors based on the forecasted goal, and (iii) a continuous trajectory for the respective actor based on the forecasted goal.

title: Systems and methods for testing, training and instructing autonomous vehicles
description: Systems and methods for testing, training, and instructing autonomous vehicles (AVs) are described herein. In one aspect, a computer-implemented method for live testing an AV including generating one or more test objects from a stored set of test objects, test object attributes, or a combination thereof; superimposing the one or more test objects on sensory data received from one or more sensors of the AV and corresponding to an external environment of the AV; and testing one or more software subsystems of the AV, in a manual mode, a partially autonomous mode or a fully autonomous mode, with the sensory data after superimposition.

title: Detection device, detection method, and detection program
description: A detection device includes processing circuitry configured to acquire data to be detected and normal reference data, calculate a Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) distance between the acquired data and the reference data, and classify the acquired data into either a Clean Sample or an Adversarial Example by using the calculated LPIPS distance.

title: Virtual training method for a neural network for actuating a technical device
description: The invention relates to a method for training a neural network for actuating a technical device, in a virtual training environment. The method comprises establishing a first data link between the neural network and a first simulation of the technical device, and then training the neural network by actuating the first simulation.
