Once a first training goal has been achieved, the first data link is broken and a second data link is established between the neural network and a second simulation of the technical device in order to train the neural network by actuating the second simulation. The second simulation is configured to be more realistic than the first simulation and requires more mathematical operations for a simulation cycle owing to its higher degree of realism.

title: Machine learning method and system for predicting key agricultural field management practices
description: A computer-implemented method for predicting agricultural management practices, includes: generating a training dataset that comprises a plurality of years of known management practices associated with a plurality of fields dispersed within geographic region along with a corresponding plurality of years of first remote sense images; training a Bayesian crop model to predict the plurality of years of known management practices associated with the plurality of fields using the corresponding plurality of years of first remote sense images as inputs; providing a time series of second remote sense images associated with a corresponding field having unknown management practices as exclusive inputs to the Bayesian crop model; and executing the Bayesian crop model to predict a key management practices for the corresponding field.

title: Rare example mining for autonomous vehicles
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for performing rare example mining in driving log data. In one aspect, a method includes maintaining a plurality of density estimation models that each correspond to a different rareness type with respect to historical sensor inputs in a driving log generated by sensors on-board a vehicle; receiving a query that references a sensor input; generating, from the sensor input, a corresponding density estimation model input for each of the plurality of density estimation models; processing, using each of the plurality of density estimation models, the corresponding density estimation model input to generate a corresponding density score; generating, for the sensor input, and from the density scores, a rareness score associated with each different rareness type; and providing the rareness scores in response to receiving the query.

title: Document generation inferences triggered by policy transactions
description: A document inference system applies document inference rules to policy operation data received from a separate policy management system, to determine which types of documents are to be generated in response to an operation performed within the policy management system. The document inference system also converts user-provided natural language definitions of conditions of document inference rules into document inference rules that the document inference system applies to policy operation data received from the policy management system.

title: Structuring visual data
description: Mappings are determined between viewpoints of an object and an object model representing the object. Each mapping identifies a location on the object model corresponding with a portion of the object captured in one of the viewpoints. Defect identifiers for the object model are created based on the mappings, where each defect identifier links one of the viewpoints to one of the locations on the object model. A user interface that includes the object model and the defect identifiers is provided for presentation on a display screen in a user interface. One of the viewpoints is presented in the user interface when the corresponding defect identifier is selected in the object model.

title: Measuring the effects of augmentation artifacts on a machine learning network
description: In various examples, sets of testing data may be selected and applied to an MLM such that differences in performance of the MLM in the testing between the sets indicates and may be used to determine whether and/or an extent by which the MLM is trained to rely on artifacts. Training data for the MLM may be generated using a first value of a parameter that defines a value of a characteristic of the training data. For testing, first testing data may be selected that corresponds to a second value of the parameter that shifts the value in a first direction and second testing data may be selected that corresponds to a third value of the parameter that shifts the value in a second direction (e.g., opposite the first direction). Various possible actions may be taken based on results of analyzing the differences in performance.

title: Processor and memory communication in a stacked memory system
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure relate to application partitioning for locality in a stacked memory system. In an embodiment, one or more memory dies are stacked on the processor die. The processor die includes multiple processing tiles and each memory die includes multiple memory tiles. Vertically aligned memory tiles are directly coupled to and comprise the local memory block for a corresponding processing tile. An application program that operates on dense multi-dimensional arrays (matrices) may partition the dense arrays into sub-arrays associated with program tiles. Each program tile is executed by a processing tile using the processing tile's local memory block to process the associated sub-array. Data associated with each sub-array is stored in a local memory block and the processing tile corresponding to the local memory block executes the program tile to process the sub-array data.

title: Josephson device, superconducting circuit, quantum operation device, and method for manufacturing josephson device
description: A Josephson device includes: a first superconducting metal layer that includes a first surface; a second superconducting metal layer that includes a second surface that faces the first surface; and an insulating layer provided between the first surface and the second surface. An outline of the second surface is inside an outline of the first surface in a plan view from a direction perpendicular to the first surface.

title: Method and system for optimizing an objective heaving discrete constraints
description: A system and method for optimizing an objective having discrete constraints using a dataset, the dataset including a plurality of aspects associated with the objective. The method comprising: receiving the dataset, the objective, and constraints, at least one of the constraints comprising discrete values; receiving a seed solution comprising initial values for the at least the constraints; iteratively performing until a predetermined threshold is reached: determining a constraint space for each of the constraints have discrete values using a determination of a constraint satisfaction problem; determining an optimized value of the objective using an optimization model, the optimization model taking as input the dataset and the constraint space; and outputting the optimized objective.

title: Method and computing device for generating neural network model and performing circuit simulation by using the neural network model
description: A method of generating a neural network model and performing a circuit simulation by using the neural network model is presented. The method includes generating sample data by performing a process simulation based on a temperature and a process parameter, training the neural network model based on the sample data, performing a lightweight operation on the neural network model to generate a lightweight neural network model, re-training the lightweight neural network model, and performing the circuit simulation with the process parameter as an input by using the re-trained lightweight neural network model.

title: Network scheduling device and method
description: A network scheduling device and method are disclosed. The scheduling method comprises: determining whether a set condition for a transmission time interval (TTI) is satisfied, and, if the set condition is satisfied, storing in a memory, at each TTI until the set TTI elapses, a data array comprising the network state of the current TTI, the scheduler type selected at the network state of the current TTI, the network state of the next TTI, and the actual compensation value for the network state of the current TTI, and updating the parameters of the first neural network based on at least one of the data arrays stored in the memory, and, if the set condition is not satisfied, inputting the network state of the current TTI to the first neural network and selecting a scheduler using the output of the first neural network based on the input network state of the current TTI.

title: Picture filtering method and apparatus, and device
description: A picture filtering method, performed by an electronic device, includes: obtaining a picture to be filtered; determining a neural network filter; dividing the picture to be filtered according to a blocking mode corresponding to the neural network filter to obtain one or more picture blocks to be filtered, the blocking mode being a same blocking mode for a training picture used in training the neural network filter; and filtering the one or more picture blocks based on the neural network filter to obtain a filtered picture.

title: Methods and systems for machine-learning based document processing
description: The present invention is related to data processing methods and systems thereof. According to an embodiment, the present invention provides a method of processing documents using a machine learning model. The process begins by accessing data files and extracting information from them, which is subsequently stored. This document information, along with the machine learning model trained on various document formats, is used to classify the data files and generate tabular data. From this tabular data, data objects are created and included in an output data file. The information from the output file is then used to update the data of the machine learning model, optimizing it for improved future document processing. There are other embodiments as well.

title: Methods, systems, apparatuses, and devices for facilitating sifr optimizer-based efficient training of neural network models
description: A method for training a neural network model having layers and parameters. The method includes providing an input to an input layer of the layers. The input corresponds to a batch of samples from a training dataset. The method includes obtaining outputs from the neural network model based on the input. The method includes calculating a loss function based on the outputs and corresponding desired values for the batch of samples. The method includes obtaining a curvature data representing a second order information about a loss function landscape based on the loss function. The curvature data includes at least one of a covariance matrix and a Gram matrix of the batch of samples. The method includes generating a Sifr update for optimizing at least one of the parameters based on the curvature data. The training of the neural network model is based on the Sifr update.

title: Superconducting quantum circuit apparatus and control method therefor
description: A superconducting quantum circuit apparatus includes: a coupler; a plurality of coupling ports; a plurality of qubits coupled to the coupler via the plurality of coupling ports, respectively; and a reserve port provided as a spare coupling port to be coupled to the coupler, separately from the plurality of coupling ports.

title: End-to-end workflow for automated narrative creation
description: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for narrative creation. A method generally includes receiving a selection of a first narrative type for generation, obtaining: a plurality of user responses to a plurality of prompts associated with the first narrative type; and at least one of: one or more stories from one or more users stored in a repository; or one or more insights associated with one or more documents stored in the repository, and processing, by one or more machine learning (ML) models, the plurality of user responses and at least one of the one or more stories or the one or more insights to generate an output associated with the first narrative type.

title: Pre-trained language models incorporating syntactic knowledge using optimization for overcoming catastrophic forgetting
description: A syntactic pre-training task is selected from among a set of syntactic pre-training tasks. For the selected syntactic pre-training task, the pre-trained language model is retrained by using an optimization function which prevents catastrophic forgetting during the retraining. Inferencing is performed using the retrained language model.

title: System and method for encrypted video stream data compaction
description: This invention is a system and method for encrypted video stream data compaction. The system integrates video processing techniques with data compaction methods, achieving compressed outputs that maintain data security. A video stream processor analyzes frames, estimates motion, and eliminates redundancies, preparing the data for further compression. The processed data is then divided into blocks, mapped to codewords, and subjected to additional compression and encryption rules. This multi-layered approach results in reduced data size and bandwidth requirements for video streaming, while ensuring data integrity and security. The system's adaptability makes it suitable for various video streaming applications, from high-definition content delivery to secure video communications.

title: Medical image analysis assistance system and method for providing medical image analysis results
description: The medical image analysis assistance system according to the embodiment of the present invention includes a lesion reading unit that estimates a presence of lesion from a plurality of medical images by reading medical image information including the plurality of medical images captured of a patient's body, and detects a position and information of the estimated lesion, and a readout information generation unit that generates readout information displaying markings related to the lesion on a scout image including at least one of the medical images in which the lesion is present and the medical images generated based on the plurality of medical images to represent the lesion, wherein the markings are displayed on the scout image corresponding to the position of the lesion and are displayed in different diagrams according to a type of the lesion, a medical image analysis support system.

title: Contextual recommendations with graphical elements based on activity recognition
description: A computer system can automatically populate graphical elements on a user interface. The system can receive sets of information from one or more third-party server operators. The system can create, for each set of information, a respective graphical element for the user interface. The respective graphical element can indicate at least one service provided in a respective set of information. The system can collect, via the user interface, a set of data from a specific user. The system can apply a trained machine-learning model to the set of data to predict a pattern in activities associated with the specific user. The system can automatically populate a particular graphical element in the user interface based on the pattern in activities associated with the specific user. The particular graphical element can include at least one recommended action related to the at least one service indicated by the particular graphical element.

title: Robust state estimation
description: State information can be determined for a subject that is robust to different inputs or conditions. For drowsiness, facial landmarks can be determined from captured image data and used to determine a set of blink parameters. These parameters can be used, such as with a temporal network, to estimate a state (e.g., drowsiness) of the subject. To improve robustness, an eye state determination network can determine eye state from the image data, without reliance on intermediate landmarks, that can be used, such as with another temporal network, to estimate the state of the subject. A weighted combination of these values can be used to determine an overall state of the subject. To improve accuracy, individual behavior patterns and context information can be utilized to account for variations in the data due to subject variation or current context rather than changes in state.

title: Parallelized rules-based and machine learning-based grouping analysis and prediction
description: Among other techniques, techniques for parallelized rules-based and machine learning-based grouping are described. An example method includes: identifying at least two different data records of a plurality of different data records, wherein each data record is associated with a respective entity, wherein each data record includes a plurality of respective record fields and corresponding record field values, and wherein at least a first record field value of a first data record is different from a corresponding first record field value of a second data record; determining, based on a plurality of different grouping rules, whether the respective entity associated with the first data record and the respective entity associated with the second data record comprise a same entity; determining, based on one or more machine learning models, whether the respective entity associated with the first data record and the respective entity associated with the second data record comprise the same entity, wherein the grouping rules-based determination and the machine learning model-based determination are determined in parallel; presenting, in response to the grouping rules-based determination indicating the respective entities are the same entity, a first graphical user interface element of a graphical user interface; presenting a second graphical user interface element of the graphical user interface indicating whether the machine learning-based determination indicates that the respective entities are the same entity or not the same entity; receiving, through the graphical user interface, a user input; and grouping, based on the user input, the first data record and the second data record.

title: Systems and Methods Related to Controlling Autonomous Vehicle(s)
description: Implementations process, using machine learning (ML) layer(s) of ML model(s), actor(s) from a past episode of locomotion of a vehicle and stream(s) in an environment of the vehicle during the past episode to forecast associated trajectories, for the vehicle and for each of the actor(s), with respect to a respective associated stream of the stream(s). Further, implementations process, using a stream connection function, the associated trajectories to forecast a plurality of associated trajectories, for the vehicle and each of the actor(s), with respect to each of the stream(s). Moreover, implementations iterate between using the ML layer(s) and the stream connection function to update the associated trajectories for the vehicle and each of the actor(s). Implementations subsequently use the ML layer(s) in controlling an AV.

title: A Short-term Photovoltaic Output Forecasting Method Based on Improved Gaussian Process Regression
description: The invention discloses a photovoltaic short-term output prediction method based on improved Gaussian process regression. A weather type index, a daily mean temperature and a humidity similarity are taken as references. Data is classified. Aiming at different weather types, different influence factors are selected. In a matlab, a corresponding weighted linear decreasing particle swarm Gaussian process regression LinWPSO-GPR prediction model is established. The method comprises the following steps of step1, carrying out data classification; step2, establishing a prediction model; step3, acquiring a prediction sample output expectation which is a power prediction value. In the prior art, an optimization searching process of the photovoltaic short-term output prediction method is easy to fall into a local optimization state, and an optimization effect and iteration convergence depend too much on an initial value. By using the method, the above problems in the prior art are solved.

title: Dynamic workshop scheduling rule optimization method based on dual-population gene expression programming
description: The invention provides a dynamic workshop scheduling rule optimization method based on dual-population gene expression programming, which is used for solving the technical problem of poor quality of a scheduling rule in the conventional dynamic workshop scheduling rule optimization method based on gene expression programming, and comprises the following implementation steps: constructing a dynamic workshop simulation model; initializing a gene expression programming algorithm; calculating the fitness and judging whether the shutdown criterion is met; acquiring a convergence population CP and a diversity population DP; carrying out genetic operation on the convergent population CP and the diversity population DP to obtain a new population; selecting a scheduling rule with dominant fitness from the new population; and (5) carrying out loop iteration until the shutdown criterion is met, and finally outputting the optimal scheduling rule. The scheduling rule obtained by the invention reduces the maximum completion time of the workpiece in the dynamic workshop, and can be applied to the technical fields of industrial manufacturing, production operation planning, transportation, aerospace and the like.

title: Image-recognizing method and device
description: The disclosure is directed to a kind of image-recognizing method and devices, wherein, this method comprises: obtaining images to be recognized data, and images to be recognized data are input to default network model, the default network model includes at least 1 class process layer, every class process layer includes that at least three is sequentially arranged successively subprocessing layer, successively image data to be identified is handled using above-mentioned at least 1 class process layer, image data after obtaining identification, wherein, at least sub 3 sub- process layers in every class process layer are successively handled image data to be identified, and in every class process layer since the 3rd sub- process layer, the input of each subprocessing layer includes the output of the first subprocessing layer of at least two.The technical solution of the disclosure, the image data after capable of faster getting identification improves the precision of the default network model, and then improves the precision of image recognition.

title: Device Location Based on Learning Model
description: Methods and systems for locating a device are presented. In one example method, a communication signal is received from a device by a wireless reference point over a period of time. A sequence of values is generated from the communication signal received by the wireless reference point during the time period. The sequence of values is provided to a learning model configured to generate an output based on historical values of the sequence of values and at least one predicted future value of the sequence of values. Based on the output of the learning model, a current location of the device is estimated over the period of time.

title: A Fault Prediction and Health Management Method Applied to Circuits and Systems
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of circuits and systems, and provides a deep learning-based fault prediction and health management method applied to circuits and systems, which is used for real-time monitoring of circuits and system equipment in operation; the method first prepares multiple waiting Test the circuit, carry out the aging test separately, obtain the training data and store it in the database; then conduct PCA analysis to obtain the training sample; then use the deep learning model to train the neural network and put it into the test chip; finally use the test chip to check the working status The health status of the test circuit is monitored in real time, and its remaining life is calculated at the same time. The invention can monitor the operating status of circuits and system equipment in real time, predict the time of failure, reduce the probability of sudden failure, and avoid many potential safety hazards when sudden failure occurs, thereby protecting property and reducing maintenance expenses.

title: A Target Tracking Method Based on Cellular Quantum Behavior Particle Swarm Algorithm
description: The invention discloses a kind of method for tracking target based on cellular quantum-behaved particle swarm optimization, belongs to computer vision field.Improvement of the present invention based on the particle swarm optimization algorithm of C9 neighborhoods, provides a kind of new target following framework with reference to the certain advantages of particle filter.The method is evaluated adaptive value with gauss hybrid models, and improves the topological structure of particle to realize more accurately target following by the resampling with reference to particle filter.The present invention solves existing QPSO target tracking algorisms and there is the situation that particle is misguided and causes Premature Convergence, and algorithm enters the slack-off situation of search middle and late stage convergence rate.When object voluntary movement or when there is big change in appearance, the tracking framework of the present invention more effectively, is more widely used in computer vision field.

title: Method and device for identifying social service characteristic users
description: Embodiments of the present application provide a method and device for identifying users with social business characteristics, the method includes: acquiring user data of candidate users, and mining social business characteristic users according to the first social attribute data in some candidate users; using The second social attribute data and the second business object attribute data of the social business characteristic user are used to train the classifier; the first social attribute data and the first business object attribute data of the neighboring users are input into the classifier, and the neighbors are output. The result of whether the user is a user with a social service feature for a period of time after the first period of time, and the neighbor user is a candidate user other than the user with the social service feature. The embodiments of the present application increase the amount of related data, improve the accuracy of the classifier, and further improve the accuracy of identification, and can identify potential users of social business characteristics in the first time period.

title: A method for predicting bank branch reserves based on long-short-term memory recurrent neural network
description: The invention discloses a kind of bank outlets' excess reserve Forecasting Methodology that Recognition with Recurrent Neural Network is remembered based on shot and long term, including data prediction, model training and prediction three phases.Data preprocessing phase counts bank outlets' cash transaction day total deposit, day withdrawal total value, and same day date property, construction feature vector in units of day；According to the day net amount that daily cash transaction record is calculated.In the model training stage, according to history feature vector sum day net amount data training LSTM models.The characteristic vector of some days, interval where the day net amount on the day of input LSTM model predictions before forecast period, statistics bank outlets forecast date, takes excess reserve demand of the random value in the interval as the same day.The present invention takes full advantage of the advantage of historical data and shot and long term memory Recognition with Recurrent Neural Network on data time series analysis, effectively increases the accuracy rate of bank outlets' excess reserve prediction.

title: Online network traffic anomaly detection method based on two-way two-dimensional principal component analysis
description: The invention discloses a method for online network traffic anomaly detection based on two-dimensional two-dimensional principal component analysis, which relates to the technical field of online network traffic anomaly detection. The method includes three different BPCA methods, including calculation by iteration The BPCA calculation method, the approximate BPCA method, and the BPCA method accelerated by the incremental (incremental) method; this method uses the sensitivity of the principal component analysis method to abnormal data and normal data to detect anomalies, which is mainly used for real-time The network traffic data is detected to determine whether there is any abnormal data in the collected real-time data. Therefore, it is determined that there is no abnormality in the collected data, and at the same time, network management is more convenient, and the accuracy of online abnormality detection can be improved and calculation time can be reduced.

title: An automatic modeling and hardware-in-the-loop simulation method for contactors
description: The present invention provides the automatic modeling and hardware-in-loop simulation method of a kind of contactor, has merged Based Intelligent Control, three parts of data acquisition and hardware-in-loop simulation of contactor：Data collecting system can gather the various dynamic parameters in contactor running, neutral net is introduced afterwards to set up the neural network model of contactor, only it can calculate contactor by gathering coil voltage and coil current and move real-time displacement unshakable in one's determination, the effect of permanent magnet can be included in automatically in the training process of neutral net.A kind of simple, general training method is provided for the displacement calculating of contactor, promotes the application of displacement Closed loop Control；Displacement closed loop is finally combined, the various Intelligent Control Strategies of contactor are write in host computer, and control strategy is downloaded to together with ANN model hardware-in-loop simulation is carried out in real-time processor, the validity of checking ANN model and Intelligent Control Strategy；Facilitate the exploitation of intelligent contactor.

title: Face recognition method based on multivariate linear regression association memory
description: This invention discloses a method for face recognition based on multiple linear regression associative memory, comprising the following steps: S1: Acquire face images, convert the face images into binary images, and obtain associative memory input and output matrices; S2: Construct a multiple linear regression face recognition model, and simplify the multiple linear regression face recognition model to obtain a simplified multiple linear regression face recognition model with unknown regression parameters; S3: Calculate the unknown regression parameters of the simplified multiple linear regression face recognition model, and finally determine the multiple linear regression face recognition model; S4: Recognize the face images. Beneficial effects: Combining associative memory and multiple linear regression models, converting face images into parameters, resulting in high security, good reliability, good recognition performance, good protection of face images, and high confidentiality.

title: Method and device for facial expression recognition
description: This application discloses a kind of facial expression recognizing method and device, methods described includes：Extract the local feature and global feature of face in detection image；The local feature, the global feature and the detection image are inputted into deep learning model, the classification results that the detection image belongs to different human face expressions are obtained；Wherein, the deep learning model is trained acquisition to deep neural network previously according to the training image of different human face expressions and the local feature of each training image and global feature；According to the classification results, the human face expression of the detection image is determined.The embodiment of the present application improves the accuracy of expression recognition.

title: Speed planning method and device for automatic driving of vehicle and computing device
description: A speed planning method, device, and computing device for autonomous vehicle driving. The method includes: performing machine learning using a training sample set to obtain a machine learning model; partitioning the input space; and, based on the obtained machine learning model, obtaining decision results corresponding to the determined partitions, forming a partition decision table indicating the corresponding decision results for each partition; obtaining, in real time, the characteristic components of each dimension of the moving vehicle as input feature quantities, determining the input partition to which the input feature quantities belong, and querying the partition decision table based on the determined partition to obtain the corresponding decision result. This method effectively solves the problem of being unable to make local adjustments to a machine learning-trained model, making it easy to modify the decision of a particular partition without affecting the decision results of other partitions. The intuitive nature of the partition decision table can effectively help identify and resolve problems in the machine learning process, and the partition decision table can accelerate the decision-making process.

title: Method and apparatus for performing operations of convolutional layers in a convolutional neural network
description: Disclose a kind of method and apparatus for the computing for performing the convolutional layer in convolutional neural networks.The method of the computing of convolutional layer in the execution convolutional neural networks includes：The unfolded characteristic of convolutional layer is supplied to according to the filling mode filling specified by convolutional layer；The unfolded characteristic being filled through is folded at least one dimension in width and height, to generate fold characteristics data；The original convolution core of the convolutional layer is folded at least one dimension, to generate one or more folding convolution kernels corresponding with original convolution nuclear phase；And perform convolution algorithm using one or more convolution verification fold characteristics data that fold.With it, channel utilization index can be improved, cache occupation amount is reduced, and operation efficiency can be improved.

title: Method and apparatus for neural network quantization
description: A kind of method and apparatus quantified for neutral net is provided.Describe equipment and manufacture the method for the equipment and the system and method for performing the quantization of the parameter in deep neural network.In one aspect, the multidimensional vector of network parameter is represented from trained neural network model structure.Quantify multidimensional vector to obtain the shared quantization vector as cluster center being fine-tuned.Then fine tuning and shared quantization vector/cluster center are encoded.Decode Umklapp process.

title: Analyzing health events using a recurrent neural network
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus for analyzing health events using a recurrent neural network, including a computer program encoded on a computer storage medium. A method includes obtaining a first time series of health events, wherein the first time series includes corresponding health-related data associated with a specific patient at each of a plurality of time steps; processing the first time series of health events using a recurrent neural network to generate a neural network output for the first time series; and generating health analysis data from the neural network output for the first time series, the health analysis data representing future health events that may occur after a last time step in the time series.

title: System and method for identifying vehicle driver by moving pattern
description: A computer-implemented method and system for identifying a driver of a vehicle by movement patterns, the method and system comprising receiving at least one sensor signal from at least one wearable device. The method and system additionally includes determining the movement pattern based on data extracted from the at least one sensor signal, and determining whether the movement pattern is consistent with at least one driver movement pattern. The method and system additionally includes identifying the driver of the vehicle based on the movement pattern being consistent with the at least one driver movement pattern. The method and system also includes controlling at least one vehicle system by implementing a vehicle setting associated with the identified vehicle driver.

title: Modify the calculation graph
description: Methods, systems, and apparatuses, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, are used to modify a computation graph to include sending nodes and receiving nodes. By inserting sending and receiving nodes into each subgraph, communication between unique devices that perform operations on different subgraphs of the computation graph can be efficiently handled. When executed, the operations represented by these sending and receiving nodes enable unique devices to communicate with each other in a self-sufficient manner. This removes the burden of collaborative communication from the backend, providing systems processing such computation graph representations with the opportunity to execute one or more other processes while devices execute subgraphs.

title: Unmanned vending system and unmanned vending method
description: The present invention provides a kind of self-service system and self-service method, and the self-service system includes that enclosure space, user identity identification system, kinds of goods monitoring system, shopping user judge system, shopping information recording unit and settlement system；The self-service method includes the following steps：Frame plate setting steps, user identity identification step, user's positioning step, kinds of goods perception step, shopping user judgment step, shopping information recording step and clearing step.The beneficial effects of the present invention are using the weight change of each frame plate of frame plate monitoring weight technology real-time perception, judge the type and quantity that are removed or are put back into kinds of goods in conjunction with the imaging monitor technology of shelf front region；The user identity for taking or putting back to kinds of goods away using the judgement of human body real time positioning technology, takes the type and quantity of kinds of goods away to record each user in unmanned supermarket, is settled accounts for it after the completion of shopping process.

title: People flow estimation system and people flow estimation method
description: The invention provides a system for estimating the flow of people and a method for estimating the flow of people. The human flow estimating system includes: a sensor network, which includes a plurality of sensors for collecting data arranged in each area to be estimated and between each area to be estimated; A plurality of sensors in the estimation area and/or arranged between each area to be estimated constructs a horizontal crowd flow model and a vertical crowd flow model; and a crowd flow estimation module, which estimates based on the horizontal crowd flow model and the vertical crowd flow model Measure crowd data. The people flow estimation system and the people flow estimation method according to the present invention can realize high-precision estimation of the people flow data in three-dimensional space.

title: Soil corrosion prediction method for buried oil and gas pipelines based on RS-PSO-GRNN
description: The invention discloses a method for predicting soil corrosion of a buried oil and gas pipeline based on RS-PSO-GRNN, which comprises the following steps: 1) constructing an original sample set { x ij 1,2, L, m, j 1,2, L, n }; 2) discretizing the index value of the original sample obtained in the step 1), and establishing a decision table according to the discretized condition attribute set and the discretized decision attribute set; 3) reducing and deleting redundant indexes in the decision table by adopting attributes in the RS theory to obtain a pipeline core index sample set; 4) normalizing the pipeline core index sample set obtained in the step 3); 5) dividing the normalized pipeline core index sample set obtained in the step 4) into a training sample set and a testing sample set, and then taking the training sample as a training set input by GRNN; 6) inputting the training set obtained in the step 5) into an RS-PSO-GRNN soil corrosion prediction model to obtain the annual average corrosion wall thickness of the pipeline of each monitoring point, and the method can accurately obtain the annual average corrosion wall thickness of the pipeline of each monitoring point.

title: Artificial reality application lifecycle
description: Aspects of the present disclosure relate to an artificial reality (XR) application system that controls applications in an artificial reality environment. In various cases, these controls include automatically recommending an XR application by determining an XR context and identifying an application that matches the XR context. These applications may be recommended to a user who may authorize the execution of the applications, thereby setting permissions for the applications. In some cases, an application may be partitioned into multiple components that are progressively downloadable. By providing application recommendations related to the current context and progressively downloading application components, the application may appear to be environmental, independent of the user continually downloading, installing, or activating the application. The rights of the application may be revoked permanently or for some situations-selected by user rights or automatically responsive to the determined user intent. When multiple applications are simultaneously authorized for execution, the XR application system may employ a ranking system to prevent overcrowding.

title: User satisfaction determination method, device, electronic equipment and media
description: This application provides a method, device, electronic equipment and medium for determining user satisfaction. The method includes: collecting index data of preset indicators, and calculating index scores based on the index data; the preset indicators are used to evaluate users' satisfaction with bank branches. Satisfaction, the indicator data includes user evaluation information, user image information and user voice information; obtain the preset weight value corresponding to the preset indicator, determine and feedback user satisfaction based on the preset weight value and indicator score; the preset weight value is It is obtained based on the first weight value and the second weight value. The first weight value is calculated based on the sample data through the entropy value method. The second weight value is obtained through the analytic hierarchy process. The sample data includes predictions within the historical time period. Set the indicator score of the indicator. The method of this application is conducive to obtaining more accurate user satisfaction, thereby making user satisfaction more valuable as a reference.

title: Crude oil water content detection method and system
description: The invention relates to a method and a system for detecting the water content of crude oil, which belong to the field of petroleum quality detection, wherein the method for detecting the water content of the crude oil comprises the following steps: 1) Collecting crude oil water content data and indicator diagram data corresponding to a crude oil gas-containing time period according to a time sequence 2), judging whether the gas-containing crude oil water content data is affected by gas or not by using the indicator diagram data, removing the crude oil water content data corresponding to the gas-affected time period from the gas-containing crude oil water content data, and extracting the gas-free crude oil water content data of the adjacent previous time period; 3) Respectively carrying out feature extraction and feature fusion on the moisture content data of the crude oil without being influenced by gas and the moisture content data of the crude oil without gas in the adjacent last time period; 4) And taking the fused data as the input of a calibration model, and predicting through the calibration model to obtain the calibration data of the water content of the crude oil without being influenced by gas. The accuracy of the water content data is improved through the calibration model.

title: A generative design method for plate and shell stiffeners
description: This application relates to the technical field of mechanical structures, and specifically provides a generative design method for plate and shell stiffeners, including constructing a finite element theoretical model of plate and shell stiffeners and performing finite element numerical simulation on it; combining optimization objectives according to its boundary constraints and loads. , set the objective function, constraint conditions, and the number and position of the stiffener generation starting points; call the Abaqus code file to generate the stiffeners in the plate shell structure and perform numerical calculations of the stiffener parameters; build a deep reinforcement learning agent model, and perform The objective function selects the generation direction of the stiffener, obtains the reward function through the learning simulation environment, and outputs the probability distribution of the action; through the interaction between the shell stiffener simulation environment and the deep reinforcement learning agent model, the optimized layout of the shell stiffener is output. Realize the generative design of plate and shell stiffeners and obtain a practical and efficient plate and shell stiffener layout.

title: Battery abnormality early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a battery abnormality early warning method, device, equipment and storage medium, and relates to the technical field of electric vehicle battery abnormality detection. The method includes: obtaining multiple target training data; the target training data includes a feature vector composed of multiple battery characteristic data; inputting the multiple target training data into a target neural network model for training based on a preset sliding window step size, and generating at least one At least one first target predicted value corresponding to the feature vector; the target neural network model includes: a long short memory LSTM model and a local attention model; Compare at least one first target predicted value corresponding to the at least one feature vector with a safety threshold to determine anomalies Feature vector; based on the abnormal feature vector, abnormal early warning information is generated; abnormal early warning information includes: abnormal battery characteristic data and abnormal handling measures. Thus, the technical problem of battery abnormality early warning accuracy in related technologies can be solved.

title: Pedestrian re-recognition network model generation method, device, computer equipment and medium
description: The invention discloses a method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for generating a pedestrian re-identification network model, wherein the method is realized by the following steps: acquiring a picture sample data set, wherein the picture sample data set comprises a labeled picture and an unlabeled picture; selecting a first preset number of tagged pictures, inputting the first preset number of tagged pictures into a preset prediction network of an initial pedestrian re-identification network to obtain a first prediction result, and calculating a first loss value; selecting a second preset number of unlabeled pictures, respectively inputting the second preset number of unlabeled pictures into different picture enhancers to carry out picture enhancement processing, and then respectively inputting the second preset number of unlabeled pictures into the preset prediction network to obtain a second prediction result and a third prediction result; extracting features of the second preset number of unlabeled pictures to obtain a first feature vector, assigning pseudo labels to target unlabeled pictures based on the first feature vector and a second prediction result, and calculating a second loss value; and performing iterative training based on the loss value to obtain a trained pedestrian re-recognition network model.

title: Knowledge graph construction method based on food safety field
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of knowledge graphs, and in particular to a knowledge graph construction method based on the field of food safety. It includes the following steps: S1. Technical route for food safety knowledge graph construction; S2. Data set construction; S3. Knowledge extraction; S4. Analysis of knowledge extraction experimental results; S5. Knowledge graph visualization. In order to improve the scalability and applicability of the knowledge graph in this field, the food safety event knowledge graph constructed by the present invention still needs to be improved from two aspects. First, in terms of knowledge, the data scale is not large enough, and the knowledge base needs to be expanded through knowledge completion to help update the ontology layer and data layer and enrich semantic information. The second is the method level. Using low-dimensional vectors to represent entities and relationships and exploring deep learning knowledge reasoning to automatically generate new knowledge are methods that can be considered to expand the knowledge base in the future.

title: Geological information extraction method, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a geological information extraction method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting geological text keywords by using four keyword extraction methods, and updating the keywords to a DISTILBIBRT model word stock; preprocessing geological text corpus, and pre-training by using the preprocessed corpus and an updated model word stock through an MLM pre-training method to obtain a pre-training model capable of understanding geological semantic information; extracting information by using a pre-training model, and converting the segmented text into a vector by using a word segmentation method based on combination of characters and words for English text which is not recognized in the geological field when a word segmentation device is used for word segmentation; the invention provides a word segmentation method based on combination of characters and words, which improves English text word segmentation in the geological field and optimizes the result of an information extraction task. And the keyword extraction is followed by updating the word stock and then pre-training, so that the effect of pre-training on the information extraction task is further improved.

title: Open stope identification and change detection method based on multitasking convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses an open stope identification and change detection method based on a multitasking convolutional neural network, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring remote sensing image data of two time phases of a study area T1 and a study area T2, and constructing a multi-task convolutional neural network model; s2, the change detection network branch carries out differential fusion on the characteristic diagram obtained by the first identification network branch and the characteristic diagram obtained by the second identification network branch to obtain a coding characteristic diagram, and then the coding characteristic diagram is connected through jump and is specially processedObtaining a characteristic diagram D by means of sign fusion  t‑5  、D  t‑4  、D  t‑3  、D  t‑2  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the S3, detecting network branching characteristic diagram D  t1‑2  And feature map D  t2‑2  Differential fusion is carried out to obtain a feature map D  a‑t2  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the S4, combining the characteristic diagram D  t‑2  Multiplying the channel attention weight and the space attention weight to obtain a feature map D'  t‑2  And then obtaining a change detection result through an up-sampling operation. The invention builds the multi-task convolutional neural network model based on the twin VGG-16 network structure, and can be rapidly and efficiently applied to the open pit mining field identification and the automatic detection of the change area.

title: A road covering detection device and early warning method thereof
description: The present invention discloses a road surface covering detection device and an early warning method thereof. The road surface covering detection device comprises a shell, wherein a data transmission module and a road surface covering sensor module connected to each other are encapsulated inside the shell, and the shell is embedded inside the target road surface, and is used to collect and output the road surface covering data of the target road surface to be tested. The early warning method uses the input of the road surface covering data as a characteristic value input variable, and the output of the convolutional neural network is the probability distribution of the road surface state category; then, the road surface state category is taken as the main influencing factor, and the road surface friction coefficient is taken as the secondary influencing factor, and a road surface slippery level classifier is constructed and analyzed and trained, and the road surface early warning level is predicted, and the driver is promptly prompted with the corresponding safe driving speed and the type of tire suitable for different scenarios.

title: Medium-low temperature clean heat supply planning configuration method based on electric-optical-thermal integration
description: The invention relates to an electricity-light-heat integration-based medium-low temperature clean heat supply planning configuration method, which comprises the steps of constructing a double-layer optimization model, researching and planning problems by an upper-layer model, and transmitting an optimized configuration scheme to a lower-layer model as a known condition; the lower layer model researches the running optimization problem, the optimization result is fed back to the upper layer to perform optimization calculation of the total cost, the optimal equipment configuration scheme and the output strategy are obtained through loop iteration, the upper layer planning model takes the economic objective annual total cost and the energy efficiency as optimization targets, the energy efficiency is transmitted to the upper layer after the lower layer completes optimization, and the lower layer planning model takes the economic operation cost as an objective function. Aiming at the planning configuration problem of the medium-low temperature clean heating system, the invention constructs a double-layer optimization model, can realize the upper layer and lower layer circulation iteration, and obtains the optimal equipment configuration scheme and output strategy.

title: Hyperspectral image classification method and system based on dynamic convolution Transformer
description: The invention discloses a hyperspectral image classification method and a hyperspectral image classification system based on a dynamic convolution transducer. The method converts hyperspectral image data into a sequence format suitable for a transducer model by combining dynamic convolution and Gaussian weighting technologies, and realizes content self-adaptive feature extraction. The method comprises the specific steps of extracting shallow spatial spectrum features by dynamic convolution, expanding in a spatial dimension to generate Token sequences, and weighting different tokens by a Gaussian weighting method and reducing the sequence length. And finally, excavating long-distance dependency relations among the features by using a transducer encoder, extracting depth features, and classifying by using a full-connection layer to realize a hyperspectral image classification task. Through experimental verification on two public hyperspectral data sets, the method provided by the invention has better classification performance.

title: Pseudo message recognition based on ontology reasoning
description: In some examples, a method for recognizing a pseudo message is described. The method may include receiving a message intended for a recipient having an associated recipient Ontology. The method may also include semantically analyzing content of the message to determine whether the content is inconsistent with any rules in the recipient Ontology. The method may also include, upon a determination that the content is inconsistent with a rule in the recipient Ontology, authenticating the message as a pseudo message.

title: Determining user key-value storage needs from example queries
description: Technologies are generally provided for conveying tree and index needs of a database by collecting and forwarding a statistically representative set of data requests so that a new datacenter can use its existing auto-learning and adjustment techniques to create local indices before receiving its first real or live requests. In some examples, requests at an origin datacenter may be collected to provide a small population of queries that are representative of a larger population of queries. Filters and/or anonymizers may be employed to adhere to data sharing rules and restrictions while still allowing a new datacenter to build indices and test performance. Thus, the new datacenter may be trained asynchronously from another site and without actual data changing hands. Training and testing of destination database services may be completed before committing to customer migration.

title: System and methods for adaptive model generation for detecting intrusion in computer systems
description: A system and methods for detecting intrusions in the operation of a computer system comprises a sensor configured to gather information regarding the operation of the computer system, to format the information in a data record having a predetermined format, and to transmit the data in the predetermined data format. A data warehouse is configured to receive the data record from the sensor in the predetermined data format and to store the data in a SQL database. A detection model generator is configured to request data records from the data warehouse in the predetermined data format, to generate an intrusion detection model based on said data records, and to transmit the intrusion detection model to the data warehouse according to the predetermined data format. A detector is configured to receive a data record in the predetermined data format from the sensor and to classify the data record in real-time as one of normal operation and an attack based on said intrusion detection model. A data analysis engine is configured to request data records from the data warehouse according to the predetermined data format and to perform a data processing function on the data records.

title: Demand flexibility estimation
description: An example embodiment includes a method of estimating demand flexibility of a site. The method may include quantifying energy usage parameters of the site and determining coefficients. Each of the coefficients may include a value based on one of the energy usage parameters. The method may also include multiplying each of the coefficients by a weighting factor associated with each of the coefficients. The method may also include summing products of the coefficients and the associated weighting factors. The method may further include estimating a demand flexibility of the site for a DR event involving energy usage curtailment. The demand flexibility may be based at least partially on the summation of the products of the coefficients and the associated weighting factors.

title: Self learning method and system for managing a group reward system
description: A system for managing a purchase agreement, including: a memory element for at least one specially-programmed general purpose computer for storing an artificial intelligence program (AIP) and a purchase agreement between a customer and at least one business entity, the purchase agreement including at least one requirement regarding at least one retail transaction between the customer and the business entity; a processor in the specially-programmed general purpose computer for: compiling a purchasing history for the customer with respect to the business entity and the purchase agreement, the memory element for storing the purchasing history, and modifying, using the purchasing history and the AIP, the at least one requirement to increase revenue or profitability of the business entity; and an interface element in the specially-programmed general purpose computer for transmitting the modified at least one requirement for presentation to the customer.

title: Rotating data for neural network computations
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for computing a layer output for a convolutional neural network layer, the method comprising: receiving a plurality of activation inputs; forming a plurality of vector inputs from the plurality of activation inputs, each vector input comprising values from a distinct region within the multi-dimensional matrix; sending the plurality of vector inputs to one or more cells along a first dimension of the systolic array; generating a plurality of rotated kernel structures from each of the plurality of kernel; sending each kernel structure and each rotated kernel structure to one or more cells along a second dimension of the systolic array; causing the systolic array to generate an accumulated output based on the plurality of value inputs and the plurality of kernels; and generating the layer output from the accumulated output.

title: Mapping Questions to Complex Database Lookups using Synthetic Events
description: An approach is provided in which a knowledge manager identifies training entities in a training question answer pair and identifies database paths a database that link the training entities. The knowledge manager then generates a generalized query based upon the identified database paths. In addition, the knowledge manager generates a generalized syntactic pattern based upon syntactic relationships between the training entities in the training question answer pair. When the knowledge manager receives a question and matches the syntactic pattern of the received question to the generalized syntactic pattern, the knowledge manager generates a custom query from the generalized query and queries the database using the custom query.

title: Processor with hybrid coprocessor/execution unit neural network unit
description: A processor includes a front-end portion that issues instructions to execution units that execute the issued instructions. A hardware neural network unit (NNU) execution unit includes a first memory that holds data words associated with artificial neural networks (ANN) neuron outputs, a second memory that holds weight words associated with connections between ANN neurons, and a third memory that holds a program comprising NNU instructions that are distinct, with respect to their instruction set, from the instructions issued to the NNU by the front-end portion of the processor. The program performs ANN-associated computations on the data and weight words. A first instruction instructs the NNU to transfer NNU instructions of the program from architectural general purpose registers to the third memory. A second instruction instructs the NNU to invoke the program stored in the third memory.

title: Individual and user group attributes discovery and comparison from social media visual content
description: A method and system are provided. The method includes deriving a set of user attributes from an aggregate analysis of images and videos of a user. The deriving step includes recognizing, by a set of visual classifiers, semantic concepts in the images and videos of the user to generate visual classifier scores. The deriving step further includes deriving, by a statistical aggregator, the set of user attributes. The set of user attributes are derived by mapping the visual classifier scores to a taxonomy of semantic categories to be recognized in visual content. The deriving step also includes displaying, by an interactive user interface having a display, attribute profiles for the attributes and comparisons of the attribute profiles.

title: Predicting and preventing an attacker's next actions in a breached network
description: A method for cyber security, including detecting, by a decoy management server, a breach by an attacker of a specific resource within a network of resources in which users access the resources based on credentials, wherein each resource has a domain name server (DNS) record stored on a DNS server, changing, by the decoy management server, the DNS record for the breached resource on the DNS server, in response to the detecting, predicting, by the decoy management server, which credentials are compromised, based on credentials stored on the breached resource, and changing, by the decoy management server, those credentials that were predicted to be compromised, in response to the predicting which credentials.

title: System and method for automatically updating inference models
description: Systems and methods for updating inference models are provided. Information based on a result of applying input data to an inference model may be received. An update to the inference model may be generated based on the received information. The generated update may be transmitted.

title: Increased granularity and anomaly correlation using multi-layer distributed analytics in the network
description: In one embodiment, a primary networking device in a branch network receives a notification of an anomaly detected by a secondary networking device in the branch network. The primary networking device is located at an edge of the network. The primary networking device aggregates the anomaly detected by the secondary networking device and a second anomaly detected in the network into an aggregated anomaly. The primary networking device associates the aggregated anomaly with a location of the secondary networking device in the branch network. The primary networking device reports the aggregated anomaly and the associated location of the secondary networking device to a supervisory device.

title: Server and Information Providing Device
description: A server includes a support aspect obtaining unit configured to obtain, from each of a plurality of vehicles by communication, a support aspect of driving support executed by a driving support device of the vehicle on each of a plurality of road links; a road link information generation unit configured to generate road link information in which the support aspect is associated with data of the road link for each of the road links; and an information providing unit configured to provide the road link information generated by the road link information generation unit, to an information service destination.

title: Image support for cognitive intelligence queries
description: A computer-implemented method, a cognitive intelligence system and computer program product adapt a relational database containing image data types. At least one image token in the relational database is converted to a textual form. Text is produced based on relations of tokens in the relational database. A set of word vectors is produced based on the text. A cognitive intelligence query expressed as a structured query language (SQL) query may be applied to the relational database using the set of word vectors. An image token may be converted to textual form by converting the image to a tag, by using a neural network classification model and replacing the image token with a corresponding cluster identifier, by binary comparison or by a user-specified similarity function. An image token may be converted to a plurality of textual forms using more than one conversion method.

title: Searching trees: live time-lapse cell-cycle progression modeling and analysis
description: A method of tracking a cell through a plurality of images includes selecting the cell in at least one image obtained at a first time, generating a track of the cell through a plurality of images, including the at least one image, obtained at different times using a backward tracking, and generating a cell tree lineage of the cell using the track.

title: Systems and Methods for Speed Limit Context Awareness
description: Systems and methods are directed to providing speed limit context awareness during operation of an autonomous vehicle. In one example, a computer-implemented method for applying speed limit context awareness in autonomous vehicle operation includes obtaining, by a computing system comprising one or more computing devices, a plurality of features descriptive of a context and a state of an autonomous vehicle. The method further includes determining, by the computing system, a context response for the autonomous vehicle based at least in part on a machine-learned model and the plurality of features, wherein the context response includes a derived speed constraint for the autonomous vehicle. The method further includes providing, by the computing system, the context response to a motion planning application of the autonomous vehicle to determine a motion plan for the autonomous vehicle.

title: Techniques to manage training or trained models for deep learning applications
description: Examples include techniques to manage training or trained models for deep learning applications. Examples include routing commands to configure a training model to be implemented by a training module or configure a trained model to be implemented by an inference module. The commands routed via out-of-band (OOB) link while training data for the training models or input data for the trained models are routed via inband links.

title: Fin strain in quantum dot devices
description: Disclosed herein are quantum dot devices, as well as related computing devices and methods. For example, in some embodiments, a quantum dot device may include: a base; a fin extending away from the base, wherein the fin includes a quantum well layer; a gate above the fin; and a material on side faces of the fin; wherein the fin has a width between its side faces, and the fin is strained in the direction of the width.

title: System and method for generating predictions
description: There is provided a system and method for generating predictions. The predictions are generated using a model configured to associate text with at least one action associated with at least one of a plurality of applications.

title: Technologies for efficiently booting sleds in a disaggregated architecture
description: Technologies for efficiently booting sleds in a disaggregated architecture include a sled. The sled includes a network interface controller, a set of processors, and firmware that includes an operating system. Additionally, the sled includes circuitry to perform, with multiple processors in the set of processors, a boot process. The circuitry is also to initialize the operating system present in the firmware, receive, with the network interface controller and from another sled, an assignment of a workload, and execute the assigned workload with the operating system.

title: Method and system for monitoring and predicting gas leak
description: A system and method for monitoring and predicting a gas leak at a facility involving receiving, via a server, real-time data measured via a plurality of sensors spaced throughout a facility; scrubbing, via the server, the real-time data by removing a plurality of spikes, a plurality white noise, or a combination thereof, from the real-time data to yield a set of scrubbed data; determining a gas leak location within the facility based on the scrubbed data; conducting a gas leak simulation based on the scrubbed data; determining a potential gas leak distribution based on the scrubbed data and the gas leak simulation; calculating a risk profile based on a set of predetermined risk parameters; generating a notification based on the potential gas leak distribution and the risk profile; and transmitting over a network, the risk profile and the potential gas leak distribution to at least one mobile device.

title: Systems and Methods for Improved Patient Care
description: Systems and methods for improved patient care are disclosed. A computer-implemented method for improved patient care may include receiving patient data, selecting an interaction mode based on the patient data, and processing the patient data based on an interaction mode. The system and method may include generating a healthcare response based on the processing of the patient data. An apparatus and a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium are also disclosed.

title: Deep-learning based feature mining for 2.5d sensing image search
description: Systems, methods, and computer-readable media are disclosed for determining feature representations of 2.5D image data using deep learning techniques. The 2.5D image data may be synthetic image data generated from 3D simulated model data such as 3D CAD data. The 2.5D image data may be indicative of any number of pose estimations/camera poses representing virtual or actual viewing perspectives of an object modeled by the 3D CAD data. A neural network such as a convolution neural network (CNN) may be trained using the 2.5D image data as training data to obtain corresponding feature representations. The pose estimations/camera poses may be stored in a data repository in association with the corresponding feature representations. The learnt CNN may then be used to determine an input feature representation from an input 2.5D image and index the input feature representation against the data repository to determine matching pose estimation(s).

title: Tracking Event Attendance
description: In one embodiment, a method includes receiving one or more input signals comprising one or more event signals associated with an event and one or more user signals associated with a user, where the input signals include time-based signals, each of which includes an event time or a user arrival time, and the input signals further include location-based signals, each of which includes an event location or a user location. The method may further include determining, using a trained machine-learning model, whether the user attended the event according to the input signals, and presenting, to a target user, an indication of whether the user attended the event. The machine-learning model may be trained on list of tuples, each of which includes a user identifier, an event identifier, and an indication of whether the user identified by the user identifier attended the event identified by the event identifier.

title: System and method for predicting future news coverage
description: A computer-implemented system and method for predicting and assessing future publicity of an organization or individual including receiving a potential future sentiment value of the company determined from a data set of a plurality of current and prior news sources with sentiment values and then, utilizing a processing circuit connected to the database, where potential future written communication documents including a press release, speech, marketing brochure, blog, or ghost-written article are added to the initial database, determining at least one potential future news story for the company utilizing a predictive analysis algorithm.

title: Component configuration for a robust tunable sensor system for a high radiation environment
description: A method of capturing and analyzing information for a particle detection system comprises generating a reaction to a plurality of particles using a converter material, wherein the converter material is operable to interact with the plurality of particles. The method further comprises converting a response to the reaction to an electrical signal using a plurality of sensors, wherein the converter material is operable to be coated onto the plurality of sensors, and wherein each of the plurality of sensors comprises an array of discrete pixel sensors each with a respective (x,y) coordinate within the array. Further, the method comprises processing the electrical signal to generate data regarding each pixel on the array of discrete pixels and serializing the data collected from the plurality of sensors and transmitting the data over thin cables to a processing unit that is located at a separate and remote location from the plurality of sensors.

title: Reducing architectural complexity of convolutional neural networks via channel pruning
description: The architectural complexity of a neural network is reduced by selectively pruning channels. A cost metric for a convolution layer is determined. The cost metric indicates a resource cost per channel for the channels of the layer. Training the neural network includes, for channels of the layer, updating a channel-scaling coefficient based on the cost metric. The channel-scaling coefficient linearly scales the output of the channel. A constant channel is identified based on the channel-scaling coefficients. The neural network is updated by pruning the constant channel. Model weights are updated via a stochastic gradient descent of a training loss function evaluated on training data. The channel-scaling coefficients are updated via an iterative-thresholding algorithm that penalizes a batch normalization loss function based on the cost metric for the layer and a norm of the channel-scaling coefficients. When the layer is batch normalized, the channel-scaling coefficients are batch normalization scaling coefficients.

title: Dynamic learning system for intelligent authentication
