Further disclosed is a means of computing and communicating (in a privacy-preserving manner if desirable) federated updates to olfactory decoding models between the local databases on the edge and the cloud database(s).

title: Information processing method, apparatus, system, electronic device and storage medium
description: An information processing method, an apparatus, a system, an electronic device and a storage medium are provided. The method includes: generating, by a first functional component, a resource graph by abstracting a capability of an IoT device; where the resource graph is configured to manage and/or orchestrate an available capability of a heterogeneous IoT device; acquiring, by a second functional component, a task to be processed, and producing a computation graph corresponding to the task to be processed; and performing, by a third functional component, a task allocation based on the resource graph and the computation graph.

title: Apparatus and method for applying artificial neural network to image encoding or decoding
description: The present disclosure relates to video encoding or decoding and, more specifically, to an apparatus and a method for applying an artificial neural network (ANN) to video encoding or decoding. The apparatus and the method of the present disclosure are characterized by applying a CNN-based filter to a first picture and at least one of a quantization parameter map and a block partition map to output a second picture.

title: Monitoring microwave oven leakage to estimate food temperature and food composition
description: Described herein are methods for determining the temperature and nutrient content of items heated in a microwave oven. An example method of determining the temperature of the item includes receiving item information; receiving a trained water model; measuring, by an antenna, an emission value from the exterior of the microwave; determining, the power flow into the item based on the trained water model, the item information, and the emission value; and estimating, by the trained water model, a temperature change of the item. An example method of determining the nutrient content includes receiving item information; receiving a trained water model; measuring, by an antenna, an emission value from the exterior of the microwave; determining an emission spectrum from the emission value; and determining, using the emission spectrum, the item information, and the trained water model, a nutrient profile of the item.

title: Data Center Monitoring and Management Operation Including Data Center Analytics Data Cluster Reconstruction Operation
description: A system, method, and computer-readable medium for performing a data center management and monitoring operation. The data center management and monitoring operation includes: receiving data center data from a plurality of data center assets within a data center, the data center data comprising data center telemetry data; compressing the data center telemetry data to provide compressed data center data; and, performing a data center analytics reconstruction operation, the data center analytics reconstruction operation reconstructing the compressed data center data to provide decompressed data center telemetry data, the data center analytics reconstruction operation using a gated recurrent unit (GRU) network generator.

title: System and method for managing tasks in a storage device
description: A method for scheduling requests in a storage system includes receiving, at a scheduler, a request associated with a first storage device, receiving, at the scheduler, task information from a neural network circuit, the task information being associated with a task performed by the first storage device, and modifying a processing of the request at the first storage device based on the task information.

title: Data Generation Method and Apparatus, Device, and Storage Medium
description: A data generation method and apparatus, a device, and a storage medium are provided, and relate to the field of artificial intelligence technologies. The method includes: obtaining a sub-image of a first image, where the sub-image includes a to-be-transferred object obtained from the first image through cropping; determining contour information of the to-be-transferred object in the sub-image; and performing style transfer on the to-be-transferred object in the first image based on the contour information and a reference style, to obtain a second image, where a background area of the second image is the same as that of the first image, and the background area is an area other than the to-be-transferred object in the first image. According to the solution of the method, style transfer is performed on a to-be-transferred object in an image. Therefore, background information of the image is not damaged, and data quality is good.

title: Graphics processing unit optimization
description: Methods, systems and computer program products are provided for optimizing resources privately. An initial information gain corresponding to an initial client embedding dataset is computed and a machine learning model is trained based on the initial client embedding data set to generate at least one initial attack path in the initial graph data. A second information gain corresponding to a second client embedding data set is computed. A difference between the first information gain and the second information gain is computed. The machine learning model is trained if the difference between the first information gain and the second information gain meets a predetermined threshold to generate at least one new attack path in the second graph data.

title: Dynamically-generated electronic database for portfolio selection
description: A system for creating a financial instrument selection, sharing the selection, and executing trade instructions thereof: a selector engine for creating selection parameters according to a statistical model for weighting desirability of financial instruments combined with entered user selection preferences or objectives for financial instruments, creating investment portfolios of financial instruments based on the selection parameters, and converting the investment portfolios data to output data representing trade instructions of financial instruments; a deep learning decision engine providing predicative input data and an investment sharing and democratization and portfolio monitoring module providing peer investment portfolio shared data input to the selector engine; and an execution platform for executing the trade instructions, the execution platform including electronic selection limiters to prevent execution of specific trades based on electronic flags computed from electronic checks relating to the amounts and types of the trades.

title: Artificial intelligence driven educational method
description: A method for providing personalized educational content includes capturing a learner's initial learning preferences, styles, and knowledge to generate an AI Key unique to the learner; presenting the learner with educational material from an educator; dynamically updating the AI Key based on continuous learner interactions with the educational material and the learner's progress; utilizing the AI Key to inform AI-driven educational tools and services and an educator about the learner's personalized learning profile; and iteratively updating the educational material using the AI-driven educational tools and services and the educator's input to tailor the updated educational material to the learner based on the dynamically updated AI key. The method additionally prompts the educator to create or provide additional educational content tailored to the learner's personalized learning profile, the learner's interactions with the educational material, and the learner's progress. The educational material is generated by the educator or with assistance of AI.

title: System and Method of Providing a Supply Chain Digital Hub
description: A system and method are disclosed including a digital hub and a cloud database. The digital hub encodes, as a virtual supply chain network, the structure, one or more objectives, and one or more states of a supply chain network and contextualizes data received from one or more supply chain entities and one or more external data sources with the virtual supply chain network. The digital hub further employs machine learning to extract insights from the contextualized data and monitors external data sources for an event that may impact the one or more objectives of the supply chain network. Responsive to identifying an event that may impact the one or more objectives, the digital hub automatically adjusts one or more of robotic warehouse systems, robotic inventory systems, automated guided vehicles, mobile racking units, automated robotic production machinery, and robotic devices.

title: Method for trajectory prediction and method for automatically operating a vehicle
description: A method for trajectory prediction of vehicles in the surroundings of an ego vehicle involves determining degrees of interaction between the vehicles using an attention-based interaction algorithm trained by machine. Individual vehicles from the multitude of the vehicles located in the surroundings of the ego vehicle are identified as relevant to the trajectory prediction by the interaction algorithm and selected for this when their respective degree of interaction with at least one of the vehicles whose trajectory is to be predicted exceeds a predetermined threshold value. In a subsequent learning step, a trajectory prediction algorithm is trained with the vehicles selected as relevant to the trajectory prediction, and the trajectory prediction carried out by the trajectory prediction algorithm is carried out for the vehicles selected as relevant to the trajectory prediction.

title: Method for evaluating the quality of mesenchymal stromal cells
description: The present disclosure provides a method for evaluating the quality of stem cells, comprising: obtaining expression level of feature genes related with the quality of stem cells; calculating quality score of the stem cells based on the expression level and weight coefficient of the feature genes; and evaluating the quality of the stem cells based on the quality score of the stem cells. The present disclosure determines feature genes related with the quality of stem cells and weight coefficient of the feature genes by using a supervised machine learning model to learn a single-cell gene expression dataset with quality attribute labels, in order to identify the heterogeneity of stem cells under the influence of the microenvironment and predict the resulting quality risk. The effect of accurately, rapidly and quantitatively determining the quality of the stem cells is obtained, and the safety risks of stem cells resulting from stem cells heterogeneity is reduced, based on the expression level of the feature genes in the stem cell samples and the weight coefficient of the feature genes.

title: Latent Intent Clustering in High Latent Spaces
description: A method of latent intent clustering is provided. The method comprises encoding identified features in a number of electronic user reports in a database. A binary matrix is created, wherein each row of the binary matric represents a different report and each column represents a different available feature. A 1 is placed in each cell of the matrix that matches a feature present in a user report. Cosine similarities are calculated for the user reports, and a similarity matrix is created, wherein each row and column of the binary matrix represents a different report, and wherein the cosine similarities of the reports are placed in corresponding cells of the matrix. The reports are clustered according to the cosine similarities. Features common to reports in each cluster are identified, and an intent of each report cluster is labeled according to the common features.

title: Data processing apparatus and method
description: A data processing apparatus comprising circuitry receives a sequence of first data elements from object tracking data indicating position of objects in a sports event at a first set of time steps; receives at least one of (i) adjustment information for adjusting the first data elements and (ii) second data elements based on user input indicating position information of the objects at a second set of time steps; generates an adjusted sequence having at least one of (i) adjusted first data elements adjusted using the adjustment information and (ii) the second data elements; performs a sequence prediction process using the adjusted sequence to predict a predicted data element at a future time step, the predicted data element indicating predicted position information of the objects at the future time step.

title: Information processing apparatus, method, and storage medium
description: An information processing apparatus includes at least one memory storing instructions, and at least one processor that, upon execution of the stored instructions cause the at least one processor to set up, in an input image, an inference target region subjected to an inference by a model established based on machine learning and decide, according to a size of the set inference target region, a model to be applied to an inference in which the input image is set as input data from among a plurality of models which have mutually different sizes of input data and on which an initialization for initiating a state in which the inference is executable on the input data is implemented.

title: Systems and Methods for Determining Circuit-Level Effects on Classifier Accuracy
description: A computerized method comprising receiving, by a simulator logic, inputs including: (i) at least one circuit-level characteristic, and (ii) an architectural description of a neural network, modeling, by the simulator logic, execution of the neural network described in the inputs to obtain results representative of what an analog implementation of the neural network would produce, and determining, by the simulator logic, an accuracy of computational analog elements within the analog implementation of the neural network based on the results obtained during modeling of the neural network is described. In some embodiments, the circuit-level characteristic includes thermal or flicker noise, an inaccuracy of weights between nodes within the neural network, or a frequency response variations of an integrated circuit. Additionally, the circuit-level characteristic can be obtained through simulation of an integrated circuit based on technology-specific measurements of the integrated circuit.

title: Venue detection
description: Examples of the present disclosure describe systems and methods for venue detection. In aspects, a mobile device comprising a set of sensors may collect and store sensor data from in response to a detected movement event or user interaction data. The sensor data may be used to generate a set of candidate venues corresponding to the location of the mobile device. The candidate venues may be provided to a venue detection system. The venue detection system may process the candidate venues to generate a set of features. The set of features may be applied to, and/or used to generate, one or more probabilistic models. The probabilistic models may generate confidence metrics for each of the candidate venues. In some aspects, the top ‘N’ venues may be selected from the set. The top ‘N’ venues may then be presented to the user and/or used to effect one or more actions.

title: Machine-learning-based detection of fake videos
description: A method for training a model for classifying videos as real or fake can include generating image tiles and audio data segments from an input video, generating a sequence of image embeddings based on the image tiles using a visual encoder and a sequence of audio embeddings based on the audio data segments using an audio encoder, transforming, using a V2A network, a first subset of the sequence of image embeddings into synthetic audio embeddings, transforming, using an A2V network, a first subset of the sequence of audio embeddings into synthetic image embeddings, updating the sequence of image embeddings by using the synthetic image embeddings, updating the sequence of audio embeddings using the synthetic audio embeddings, training the encoders and the networks using the updated sequences of image embeddings and audio embeddings, and training a classifier using the trained encoders and the trained networks.

title: Control with Scalable, Efficient Inference based on Non-Linear Tensor Networks
description: An apparatus or system configured to: provide a predetermined machine learning routine in the form of a tensorized neural network and associated with a target machine or system or process, with the tensorized neural network including a plurality of layers and one or more non-linearities per layer applicable to each tensor of the tensor network of the respective layer; and produce at least one output about the target machine or system or process, the at least one output being inferred by the provided predetermined machine learning routine upon inputting a data set therein.

title: IDENTIFYING OBJECTS USING LiDAR
description: Among other things, techniques are described for controlling, using a control circuit, motion of a vehicle based objects identified using LiDAR. For example, respective classes of points of a point cloud are determined, and based on the determined respective classes of the points of the point cloud, objects in the vicinity of the vehicle are identified.

title: Artificial intelligence apparatus for predicting power consumption, and method therefor
description: The present disclosure relates to an artificial intelligence device and method capable of predicting an amount of power consumption occurring in a home, can obtain power consumption data for pre-registered electronic devices, check whether there is a specific electronic device for which the power consumption data has not been obtained, and if there is a specific electronic device for which the power consumption data has not been obtained, obtain mixed power data consumed in a current home, classify the obtained mixed power data into a plurality of individual power data, extracts individual power data matching the specific electronic device, estimate power consumption data for the specific electronic device based on the extracted individual power data, and predict an amount of power consumption in a home based on power consumption data for all pre-registered electronic devices.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and program
description: An information processing apparatus detects a partial region corresponding to a detection target from an input image using a learning model. The information processing apparatus accepts information indicating a specific partial region, which is input by a user based on the input image, and generates learning data from a result of correction of the result of detection using the learning model based on the accepted information indicating the specific partial region and the input image.

title: Computer-readable recording medium storing information processing program, information processing method, and information processing device
description: A computer-readable recording medium storing a program for causing a computer to execute processing including: specifying two or more patterns that represent combinations of values of respective parameters of multiple parameters defining a variational quantum circuit to be used for quantum chemical computation in computation by a variational quantum eigensolver method; selecting one or more first parameters determined to have a relatively high degree of contribution to the computation from the multiple parameters using a calculation result of a cost function used for the quantum chemical computation for each pattern of the two or more patterns that have been specified; and controlling, by setting the one or more first parameters as target parameters whose value is to be updated in the computation, an arithmetic device that executes the variational quantum circuit such that at least one iteration of the computation is executed using the one or more first parameters.

title: Technologies for managing a flexible host interface of a network interface controller
description: Technologies for processing network packets by a host interface of a network interface controller (NIC) of a compute device. The host interface is configured to retrieve, by a symmetric multi-purpose (SMP) array of the host interface, a message from a message queue of the host interface and process, by a processor core of a plurality of processor cores of the SMP array, the message to identify a long-latency operation to be performed on at least a portion of a network packet associated with the message. The host interface is further configured to generate another message which includes an indication of the identified long-latency operation and a next step to be performed upon completion. Additionally, the host interface is configured to transmit the other message to a corresponding hardware unit scheduler as a function of the subsequent long-latency operation to be performed. Other embodiments are described herein.

title: User interfaces for visualizing remediation backlogs
description: In some implementations, an administrator device may transmit, to a backlog system, a request to assess a set of remediation actions associated with an administrator indicated in the request and a set of credentials for a tracking system and associated with the administrator. The administrator device may receive, from the backlog system, instructions for a user interface (UI) indicating the set of remediation actions in an order determined by a machine learning model. Each remediation action may be represented in the UI adjacent to a status associated with the remediation action. Additionally, or alternatively, the administrator device may receive, from the backlog system, instructions for a UI depicting the set of remediation actions relative to a set of datetimes for the set of remediation actions and a set of categories for the set of remediation actions.

title: Real and predicted measurement event prioritization
description: A WTRU may receive configuration information that includes a first measurement event, a second measurement event, a first action associated with the first measurement event, a second action associated with the second measurement event, criteria associated with the first measurement event, criteria associated with the second measurement event, and/or a condition. The WTRU may predict measurements based on the measurements that are determined based on the one or more reference signals. The WTRU may determine measurements. The WTRU may determine whether the first measurement event is fulfilled. The WTRU may determine whether the second measurement event is fulfilled. The WTRU may select the first action or the second action based on the condition, a determination of whether the first measurement event is fulfilled, and a determination of whether the second measurement event is fulfilled. The WTRU may perform the selected action.

title: User profiling using chain-of-thought knowledge graphs for querying a machine learning system
description: Techniques are disclosed for a machine learning model, such as a large learning model (LLM), that incorporates a model of a chain of thought of a particular user when responding to a query from the user. In one example, a system generates a knowledge graph of a chain of thought of the user. The knowledge graph comprises nodes representing topics present within past queries by the user and edges representing a co-occurrence between the topics. The system determines, based on a topic present within a query from the user and the knowledge graph, a goal query comprising a goal topic. The system provides, to a machine learning model, the user to generate, by the machine learning model, a response. The machine learning model is constrained to include the goal topic of the goal query within the response. The system outputs, for display, the response to the query.

title: Quantum error mitigation with diffusion models
description: One example method includes performing, on a quantum circuit, a circuit cutting process to generate a set of subcircuits of the quantum circuit, for each of the subcircuits, (1) running the subcircuit on a target backend quantum hardware configuration, and measuring a noisy output resulting from the running of the subcircuit, (2) using an ML (machine learning) model to obtain an estimate of a noise-free output of the subcircuit, and (3) replacing noisy output of the subcircuits with the estimated noise-free output generated by the ML model. The method further includes running a circuit knitting process, using the estimates, to knit the subcircuits together to form the quantum circuit, and executing the quantum circuit that resulted from the circuit knitting process.

title: Graphical user interface for use with open expert system
description: A rules system (1420) for creating rules (1360) to an expert system (1430) is provided, the rules system providing a user-friendly, guided process (1310) for creating such rules.

title: Distributed flexible job shop scheduling method considering limited transportation resources and multi-objectives
description: The invention relates to a scheduling method for a distributed flexible job shop, which considers limited transportation resources and multiple targets. The method comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-target distributed flexible job shop scheduling problem model considering limited transportation resources and low carbon, wherein the model comprises visualized symbolized definition, required constraint conditions, maximum finishing time, total processing energy consumption and three optimized target definitions of total processing quality, S2, designing a multi-target comprehensive decision method based on combination of spherical fuzzy sets and voting theory, S3, determining an intelligent optimization algorithm, solving an optimal solution of the multi-target distributed flexible job shop scheduling model considering the limited transportation resources and the low carbon by combining the decision method, and outputting scheduling results, and by applying the technical scheme, a better scheduling scheme can be obtained quickly and effectively, and the production efficiency of the shop is improved.

title: Wild animal identification method and device
description: The invention provides a wild animal identification method and device, which are characterized in that feature extraction is carried out on an image to be processed to obtain a plurality of feature images with different scales, after a plurality of feature images to be activated are selected, key point prediction is carried out on the feature images with different scales based on a key point prediction layer to obtain corresponding key point heat maps under a plurality of channels, then the key point heat maps to be activated and the key point heat maps under the plurality of channels are fused based on a key point representation layer to obtain key point representations of all the key points, then the key point representations of a plurality of the key points in the image to be identified and the key point representations of a plurality of the key points in a first sample image corresponding to a specific wild animal species are matched in pairs to obtain a key point matching result of the image to be identified, and based on the key point matching result, whether the animal species in the image to be identified is the specific wild animal species can be determined, so that the interference caused by different animal motion states is overcome, and the wild animal identification precision is improved.

title: A method and device for noisy named entity recognition based on debiasing
description: The present invention discloses a noisy named entity recognition method and device based on debiasing, comprising: performing word segmentation on a training text sequence, and then converting its label sequence to obtain a binary label sequence and a fine-grained entity class label sequence; constructing a named entity recognition model, and obtaining a clean binary sample set, an unlabeled binary sample set, a clean fine-grained entity class sample set, and an unlabeled fine-grained entity class sample set; at the same time, following a semi-supervised learning framework, training the named entity recognition model based on the clean binary sample set, the unlabeled binary sample set, the clean fine-grained entity class sample set, and the unlabeled fine-grained entity class sample set, calculating the loss function of each classification layer, and updating the parameters of the named entity recognition model based on the stochastic gradient descent method; finally, obtaining the trained named entity recognition model, and then performing noisy named entity recognition on a test text sequence.

title: Object recommendation model training method, recommendation object determining method and device
description: The embodiment of the specification provides an object recommendation model training method, a recommendation object determining method and a recommendation object determining device. And determining the user characteristic embedded representation of the user characteristic and the object characteristic embedded representation of the target object and the user interaction object during each round of model training. The method comprises the steps of obtaining object feature embedded characteristics of a user interaction object, decoupling the object feature embedded characteristics and the user popular embedded characteristics of the user interaction object, determining target object characteristics, user interest characteristics and user popular characteristics according to the object feature embedded characteristics of the target object and coupling results between the user feature embedded characteristics and the user interest embedded characteristics and the user popular embedded characteristics, and adjusting model parameters of an object recommendation model according to user interest predicted results and user popular predicted results determined based on the user interest characteristics, the user popular characteristics and the target object characteristics.

title: Method, system, equipment and medium for detecting stitching line of non-planar fabric
description: The invention provides a non-planar fabric sewing line detection method, system, equipment and medium, including: obtaining the plane image data of each plane of the fabric sample; performing affine transformation on each plane image data to generate each The transformed image data corresponding to the planar image data; all transformed image data are spliced to generate spliced planar data; the spliced planar data is subjected to sewing line labeling processing to generate mask image data; the mask image data is used to preset Semantic segmentation network model for training to generate a sewing thread detection model; affine transformation and splicing processing are performed on the collected image data of the fabric to be detected to generate plane restoration data; the plane restoration data is input into the sewing thread detection model to Output the image data of the sewing line area. The invention can accurately detect the sewing line position of the non-planar three-dimensional fabric.

title: Self-adaptive pre-fusion detection method for gas sensor array
description: The invention discloses a gas sensor array self-adaptive pre-fusion detection method, which belongs to the technical field of sensor intelligent detection, including: data set preparation and preprocessing; construction of a neural network model based on deep learning and MASK operator; Training of the neural network model of the MASK operator; using the above trained neural network model to detect the actual concentration value and the state of the array sensor device. In the present invention, the array sensor and the interfering gas sensor are completely included in the calculation, the input data is the original data collected from each sensor, and the output data obtained after algorithm fusion analysis is the gas concentration value and the working status of each sensor device, realizing the true meaning The end-to-end information extraction on the system; the successful construction of this algorithm will help to promote the construction of a general algorithm framework and automatic algorithm optimization for gas sensing systems.

title: Intelligent fault diagnosis and fault tolerance measurement method for multiple temperature measurement loops of train
description: The invention proposes an intelligent fault diagnosis and fault-tolerant measurement method for train multi-temperature measurement loops, which relates to the technical field of temperature measurement loop fault diagnosis. First, the historical case data of each temperature measurement loop in the train traction drive system is obtained, and a temperature measurement value estimation model is established. , and then based on the residual change rule of the temperature measurement value and the temperature estimation value, the fault diagnosis function and fault diagnosis decision are constructed; then the temperature measurement values of each temperature measurement loop in the system are collected online, and the temperature measurement value estimation model is used to output the temperature estimation value in real time. And according to the change law of the residual error, the fault diagnosis function is called to judge, and the fault diagnosis decision result is obtained. Finally, the fault diagnosis circuit is isolated, and the temperature estimated value is used instead of the temperature measurement value to realize the fault-tolerant measurement of temperature. The present invention considers The uncertain relationship between different temperature measurement circuits improves the accuracy of fault diagnosis and effectively prevents the phenomenon of missed and false alarms of faults.

title: Reinforcement learning-based method for deciding task unloading of parked vehicle
description: The invention discloses a parking vehicle subtask unloading decision-making method based on reinforcement learning. A wireless access point AP receives a task unloading request, observes parked vehicles in a parking lot, considers the parking stability of the parked vehicles, and constructs a vehicle candidate set. AP Input the vehicle observation state and task attributes of the candidate set at the current moment into the reinforcement learning model for training, divide subtasks and unload decisions, and then judge the impact of the mobility of the parked vehicle on task unloading. If the task cannot be completed in time, perform task migration to ensure that the task is completed in time. The method of the present invention considers the parking stability of the vehicle, uses a reinforcement learning algorithm to construct a candidate set to screen parked vehicles, reduces the impact of vehicle dynamics on existing unloading decisions, enables multiple vehicles to cooperate to complete sub-tasks, and optimizes task unloading time. At the same time, task migration is used to process subtasks that cannot be completed in time to reduce the task failure rate.

title: A Cloud Detection Method Based on Oxygen Absorption Bands
description: The invention discloses a cloud detection method based on an oxygen absorption band. This method calculates the spectral absorption characteristics of oxygen in the atmosphere after making necessary corrections to the passive remote sensing satellite observation data, then calculates the spatial texture information according to the oxygen absorption characteristics, and finally inputs the spectral and spatial texture information of the passive remote sensing satellite data into the artificial neural network , to achieve cloud detection in passive remote sensing satellite images. This method innovatively introduces the spatial texture information of the spectral absorption characteristics of passive remote sensing images, which significantly improves the recognition accuracy of cloud pixels, especially the recognition accuracy of optical thin clouds by about 20%.

title: Video-based assembly line processing operation analysis method and system
description: The invention discloses a video-based assembly line processing operation analysis method and a video-based assembly line processing operation analysis system, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence and solve the technical problems that: how to analyze and monitor the state of the assembly line processing operation so as to realize the efficient and continuous operation of the assembly line. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring assembly line processing operation through a camera to obtain video images; based on the view images, the processing steps, the processing sequence, the processing time length and the fatigue operation of the pipeline processing operation are identified and analyzed, whether the conditions of the abnormal processing steps, the abnormal processing sequence, the abnormal processing time length and the fatigue operation exist or not is judged, and if the conditions exist, a corresponding list is formed; and for the working products recorded in the processing step abnormal list, the processing time length list and the processing time length abnormal list, adding the working products into the checking list to perform directional spot check, and for the working personnel recorded in the fatigue working abnormal list, forming corresponding alarm information and prompting an administrator to reasonably arrange the working personnel to work.

title: Method and system for predicting yield of poly alpha-olefin synthetic oil product
description: The invention relates to a method for predicting the yield of a base oil product of poly alpha-olefin synthetic oil by taking alpha-olefin as a raw material, which is based on physical parameters of the raw material alpha-olefin and experimental data of PAO base oil, and a nonlinear regression algorithm is adopted to establish a model for predicting the yield of the PAO base oil product. And a system for predicting the yield of the poly-alpha-olefin synthetic oil product and a data processing device for predicting the yield of the poly-alpha-olefin synthetic oil product. The prediction method provided by the invention can accurately grasp the change rule of the yield of the PAO base oil product by selecting the key variable with larger influence on the yield of the base oil product, and the calculation result has higher accuracy.

title: Data enhancement method, fraud identification method and device
description: A data enhancement method, a fraud identification method and a device are disclosed. The sample set is divided into a training sample set and a first test sample set. For a first test sample in the first test sample set, the tags belong to a first category, and the same number of synthetic samples conforming to the data distribution characteristics of the first test sample are generated based on the countermeasure generation network model. And replacing the first test sample in the first test sample set with the synthesized sample to obtain a second test sample set. And respectively predicting the first test sample set and the second test sample set by using a classification model obtained based on training of the training sample set to obtain a first prediction result of the first test sample set and a second prediction result of the second test sample set. A composite sample is selected from the second set of test samples based on the first prediction result and the second prediction result. Therefore, the method can realize sample data enhancement and improve model training effect while solving the problem of data scarcity.

title: A Water Quality Classification Method Based on Visible Light UAV Aerial Photography
description: This invention discloses a water quality classification method based on visible light UAV aerial photographs, comprising the following steps: S1: acquiring monitoring units; S2: acquiring water quality types; S3: analyzing aerial photographs; S4: classifying water quality types; S5: predicting water quality types. This invention is highly efficient and low-cost: UAVs are flexible, easy to operate, and fully automated. Compared to traditional methods, the water quality analysis process eliminates the need for manual sampling along the river, saving time and labor. Equipment purchase and subsequent costs are lower, and the equipment can be reused, further reducing costs. This invention enables large-scale water quality analysis: UAVs are easy to operate and can achieve comprehensive water quality analysis, effectively solving the problems of low efficiency and blind spots in traditional monitoring methods. The analysis range can effectively cover the entire river; long-term, repeated, fixed-point water quality analysis is possible, facilitating widespread adoption.

title: Mixed mining separation model training method and related methods and devices
description: The invention discloses a mixed mining separation model training method and a related method and device. The method includes: performing gather extraction on multiple sets of aliasing data collected, corresponding main shot data and excitation time intervals, and using the received receiver point gathers corresponding to the acquired seismic data as a sample set; using the sample set The aliasing data and the corresponding excitation time interval are used as input data, and the corresponding main shot data is used as label data to train the mixed sampling separation model, which includes a deep learning network and a geophysical guidance network; when the preset When the training ends, the trained mixed mining separation model is obtained. It can effectively suppress the interference of adjacent shots and effectively protect the data of the main shot. It can greatly improve the separation efficiency and accuracy, improve the signal-to-noise ratio of seismic data, and provide high-quality basic data for subsequent quantitative interpretation of seismic data and high-precision reservoir prediction.

title: Photovoltaic power generation prediction method based on improved long-term and short-term memory neural network
description: The invention relates to a photovoltaic power generation prediction method based on an improved long-short-term memory neural network, which is characterized in that an EBS optimization algorithm provided by Mohsen Shahrouzi is applied, and an LSTM neural network super-parameter consisting of original learning data and an LSTM layer is provided, and then a OLSTM model is further provided, so that an optimization result with higher prediction precision and real-time performance than a traditional model is obtained. The LSTM neural network is composed of m hidden layers with m X n units and 1 dense layer, the EBS algorithm is used to complete the selection of high-precision superparameter, OLSTM model is used to input superparameter X  Gbest , and normalized data is obtained And training through an LSTM training function and a prediction function in the MATLAB tool box, and predicting the power to finally obtain a predicted value. Compared with the traditional LSTM model, OLSTM combined by EBS optimization and LSTM neural network can replace the superparameter found by manual calculation by automatically searching a set of optimal superparameters, so that the accuracy is remarkably improved.

title: Medical question-answer knowledge generation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to digital medical technology, and discloses a method for generating medical question-and-answer knowledge, comprising: obtaining articles to be processed, extracting information from the articles to be processed, and obtaining knowledge triplets; constructing a knowledge map according to the knowledge triplets, performing node feature extraction on the knowledge map to obtain knowledge features; obtaining medical questions, performing feature encoding on the medical questions, and obtaining word feature sequences of the medical questions; performing feature fusion of the knowledge features and the word feature sequences of the medical questions to generate medical question-and-answer knowledge. The invention also proposes a medical question-and-answer knowledge generation device, electronic equipment and storage medium. The invention can improve the generation efficiency and accuracy of medical question-and-answer knowledge.

title: Grabbing pose positioning method, computer storage medium and terminal equipment
description: The invention relates to a grabbing pose positioning method, a computer storage medium and a terminal device, wherein a class judgment model is constructed based on a neural network method to judge whether a current object to be grabbed is a regular piece or an irregular piece; and then selectively adopting a rotation searching method or a probability searching method according to the determined part type. The advantages are that: on one hand, the two search methods are shared, so that the optimal grabbing pose can be positioned to a great extent, and compared with a single mode of adopting a rotary search method, the grabbing success rate is greatly improved; on the other hand, when the trained class judgment model performs forward reasoning, the time cost is lower, and compared with a single mode of adopting a probability search method and a mode of adopting a rotation search method and then adopting the probability search method, the time consumption average value is less, and the technical advantage is more obvious in an industrial scene with more irregular parts. In the whole, the positioning method comprehensively considering the positioning accuracy and time expenditure greatly improves the pose accuracy and response timeliness.

title: Industrial defect classification method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to the field of computer technology, and in particular to a method, device, electronic device and storage medium for classifying industrial defects, wherein the method includes: obtaining a training data set of the target domain; designing an attention prototype network suitable for transfer learning; using the training data set to train the classification model of the target domain until the preset training conditions are met, and obtaining a trained classification model, wherein the classification model of the target domain is obtained by transfer learning of the classification model features of the source domain, and a training strategy is added according to problems such as small amount of industrial transfer learning data and differences in data distribution; inputting industrial defect data into the trained classification model, and outputting industrial defect the actual category of . As a result, the problems of low training efficiency caused by the difference in data distribution between the source domain and the target domain in the transfer learning of industrial defect classification and the low accuracy of existing transfer learning solutions in related technologies are solved.

title: A chip defect detection system and detection process based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a chip defect detection system and detection process based on deep learning, including a model training module, a real-time monitoring module, a chip identification module, and an information transmission and interaction module of a tape braider. The steps are as follows: establish a target recognition model, identify chip quality, connect to a front-end tape braider, perform CCD detection, and rewind the material tape; the chip defect detection system and detection process based on deep learning, the traditional tape braider is based on traditional algorithm detection, the present invention is based on deep learning, and can detect chip defects after adding a covering film. There are many inspection items, and it can identify the surface defects of the chip with the cover film, such as: rotation, rollover, space, printing defects, defects, quantity differences, carrier tape defects, and mixed materials. It can also identify defects of the plastic package, such as: cracks on the surface of the plastic package, pinholes in the plastic package; defects of the bubble lead pin: deformation, defect, broken pin, inconsistent length, and surface burrs.

title: Video scene mapping and positioning method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The disclosure provides a method for video scene mapping and positioning, comprising the following steps: a scene map establishment process based on the optimization of the iteration pose; video space-time feature aggregation process; a spatiotemporal region matching process based on saliency weighting; a multi-video geographic position identification and scene merging process; a coarse to fine video geolocation process. The disclosure also provides a device for video scene mapping and positioning, an electronic device and a readable storage medium.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, and non-transitory storage medium
description: The invention provides an information processing device, an information processing method, and a non-transitory storage medium, which can appropriately implement selection of a mobile body for use in machine learning. A control unit (31) provided in the information processing device (3) executes control of: acquiring moving body information including information indicating respective positions of a plurality of moving bodies (10) usable in machine learning; based on the moving body information, two or more moving bodies (10) used in machine learning are selected.

title: Data security intelligent protection model construction method, device and collaboration platform
description: The present invention provides a data security intelligent protection model construction method, device and collaboration platform, by determining the current data security protection task, based on the current data security protection task, to obtain the corresponding sample data set and model structure information, as well as the sample data set sample data After obtaining the data description information, construct the initial security protection model corresponding to the current data security protection task based on the model structure information, and adjust the model architecture and model hyperparameters of the initial security protection model based on the sample data in the sample data set and its data description information. The security protection optimization model is obtained, and then the security protection optimization model is trained based on the sample data in the dataset and its data description information, and the trained security protection optimization model corresponding to the current data security protection task is obtained, which improves the scalability of the method. Moreover, the process of model adjustment, optimization and training can be adjusted independently according to the performance of the model, and the security protection capability has been improved.

title: Parameter model building method of acoustic metamaterial plate
description: The invention discloses a method for establishing a parameter model of an acoustic metamaterial plate, which includes the following steps: S1, determining the form of the acoustic metamaterial plate; S2, generating multiple sets of parameters of the acoustic metamaterial plate, and calculating each set of parameters as described below Bandgap characteristics; construct a data set with each group of parameters and corresponding bandgap characteristics; S3, build a neural network, put in the data set to iteratively train the neural network, obtain the mapping relationship between parameters and bandgap characteristics, and obtain acoustic super Parametric model of the material plate. This method combines the deep learning neural network to learn the structural samples of acoustic metamaterial plates, and obtains the mapping relationship between structural parameters and physical properties. A smarter and more efficient approach.

title: Gesture acquisition method, model training method, terminal, medium and program product
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a gesture acquisition method, a model training method, a terminal, a medium and a program product, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image; the first image comprises at least one target part; inputting the first image into a target neural network, and obtaining a target result output by the target neural network; the target neural network is obtained by training based on a sample image, a target part detection label and a gesture prediction result label, and is an end-to-end neural network; the target result comprises a gesture prediction result; based on the target result, a pose of the target site in the first image is determined. The calculated amount of the terminal is reduced, and further consumption of storage resources and calculation resources when the terminal acquires the gesture is reduced.

title: Video frame prediction method based on multilayer convolution structure
description: The invention discloses a video frame prediction method based on a multi-layer convolution structure, and belongs to the technical field of spatio-temporal data prediction using a deep neural network model. This method has three main characteristics. One is that the prediction model proposed by this method adopts a multi-layer architecture. The second is that the convolution structure of the prediction model adopts a combination of multiple convolution kernels of different sizes. In this prediction model, the inner convolution operator is used to replace the convolution operator with a larger convolution kernel. The prediction model proposed by this method, on the premise of meeting the prediction accuracy, effectively reduces the reasoning time, calculation amount, model parameter amount and memory occupied by the video frame prediction task, and significantly improves the video frame prediction efficiency.

title: Interpretable region thermal load prediction method, interpretable region thermal load prediction device, interpretable region thermal load prediction equipment and storage medium
description: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for predicting an interpretable regional heat load, and relates to the technical field of intelligent heating. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring heating load time sequence data of a plurality of target clients in the area in a historical time period; preprocessing the heating load time sequence data, and then inputting a pre-trained heating load prediction model to obtain predicted heating load data of a plurality of target clients in the area in a future set time period; the heating load prediction model is obtained by training an interpretable graphic neural network through historical heating load time sequence data samples of a plurality of target clients in the area. The heating load prediction result has interpretability, can explain the reasons generated by the prediction result and the internal rules of time sequence data fluctuation in the face of complex real-time change conditions, and can improve the accuracy of predicting the heating load of a plurality of clients in an area compared with the traditional heating load prediction.

title: Knowledge graph-based infectious shock diagnosis and treatment recommendation method
description: The invention discloses a method for recommending diagnosis and treatment of septic shock based on a knowledge map. The method includes the following steps: S1: defining information related to the knowledge map of septic shock; S2: introducing symmetric relations, inverse relations, and combination relations, using The RotatE model represents the knowledge map; S3: uses the word2vec and RotatE models to complete the recommendation of diagnosis and treatment methods according to the patient's symptoms. The present invention relies on constructing knowledge graphs according to 5 entities and 7 relationships, introduces symmetric relationships, inverse relationships, and combined relationships, and uses the RotatE model to represent the knowledge graph of septic shock; It does not exist in the knowledge map. Retrain the word2vec model to recommend diagnosis and treatment methods for symptoms that do not exist in the knowledge map, and assist doctors in making clinical diagnosis and treatment decisions to achieve the best treatment effect.

title: Recipe making method and device based on food-related data
description: The invention discloses a menu making method and device based on food material related data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring food material related data uploaded by a user aiming at a target food material combination, wherein the food material related data comprises one or more of food material types, cooking processes, cooking cuisines, cooking finished products and cooking effects; according to the food material related data, analyzing the condition to be optimized corresponding to the target food material combination; and generating a cooking menu corresponding to the target food material combination according to the condition to be optimized and the food material related data. Therefore, the method and the system can intelligently perform optimization analysis on the target food material combination and the food material related data, generate the cooking menu corresponding to the target food material combination based on the determined condition to be optimized, improve the comprehensiveness, flexibility and intellectualization of the cooking menu generation mode, further improve the generation rationality, the dependability and the optimality of the cooking menu, further improve the accuracy and the reliability of the generated cooking menu, and further improve the diversity and the integrity of the generated cooking menu.

title: A method and system for house decoration design based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention relates to the field of house decoration design, and discloses a house decoration design method and system based on artificial intelligence, which collects multiple house images of a user's house to be decorated, and extracts basic house information from the multiple house images; acquires the user's Decoration demand information, extracting key features from the basic information of the house and decoration demand information respectively, to obtain the house feature information and decoration feature information; input the house feature information and decoration feature information into the neural network model to generate a house decoration design plan; The house type, total area of the house, number of rooms and the length, width and height of each room are obtained from the house image, and the user is constructed according to the house type, total house area, length, width and height of each room and the house decoration design plan. The decoration three-dimensional model of the house; the design parameters of the decoration three-dimensional model are obtained, and the decoration three-dimensional model and the design parameters are output; the invention improves the decoration design efficiency.

title: Semiconductor device image data augmentation method, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method, equipment and a storage medium for amplifying image data of a semiconductor device, which belong to the fields of digital image processing and data amplification, and an amplified data set R is obtained by uniformly labeling a semiconductor original image and geometrically transforming the original image  1  And generating an augmented data set R against the network by means of conditions  1  Augmented data set R to  2  Model parameters are optimized continuously, high-quality amplified image data are output, and the correlation between optimization tasks is improved through optimizing network parameters of a generator and a discriminator, so that the overall image generation effect of the model is more excellent.

title: PSO-CNN-BILSTM-based short-term wind power prediction method
description: The invention discloses a short-term wind power prediction method based on PSO-CNN-BILSTM. The method includes wind speed data preprocessing, convolutional neural network feature extraction, bidirectional long-short-term memory network modeling, particle swarm optimization algorithm and short-term wind power Forecasting, by using the PSO-optimized CNN-BILSTM model, the wind power in the future time period can be predicted to help decision makers plan and dispatch the power system. At the same time, it can also make full use of the characteristics and timing relationship of historical power data to improve Accuracy and reliability of forecasts; this helps wind farm managers make more accurate decisions, optimize wind farm operations and energy dispatch, and improve the efficiency and sustainability of wind power generation.

title: Multi-source heterogeneous big data processing system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of big data, and discloses a multi-source heterogeneous big data processing system, which comprises: a category feature generation module that generates a main data category feature based on field names of main data, one of which corresponds to each of the main data category features; a data source feature generation module that generates data source features based on the original data set linked by the main data; a generated feature extractor for randomly extracting characters and/or words from the original dataset to generate unit feature vectors, and then combining the unit feature vectors to obtain generated features; a model generation module for generating a master data generation model; the main data generation module is used for generating main data of an original data set of the main data to be generated and field names corresponding to the main data; the method and the device can automatically generate the main data matched with the big data with limited source range, and structure and unify the big data through the main data.

title: Service recommendation method based on depth matrix decomposition and knowledge graph
description: The present invention relates to a service recommendation method based on deep matrix decomposition and knowledge map. The method utilizes government service item data to build a government service knowledge map, and uses a knowledge representation method to model the entity context and entity description text information of the knowledge map. The learning method combines knowledge representation learning with personalized recommendation to get the optimal GKGR model. Finally, the score of each pair of users and service items is predicted, and the service items with higher scores are recommended to users through a recommendation list. This method uses the neural network to extract features of users and service items, makes full use of user behavior data, and effectively alleviates the problem of data sparseness; uses the knowledge representation method to model the entity context and entity description text information, and jointly learns knowledge representation tasks and Personalized recommendation tasks improve the accuracy and interpretability of recommendation results, and effectively alleviate the cold start problem of government service recommendations.

title: A Noisy Data Anomaly Detection Method Based on Adaptive Strategy
description: The invention relates to a noise-containing data anomaly detection method based on a self-adaptive strategy, which comprises the following steps of obtaining vibration signals, constructing data samples, carrying out training set and test set division, randomly sampling K samples from a training set non-tag data set to generate a non-tag subset Ut, combining a positive example set P and the non-tag subset Ut to serve as a training subset D, searching optimal initial model parameters by using a grid search algorithm, setting batch processing size, learning rate and iteration times N according to the results, training a neural network by the training set, extracting frequency domain characteristic information and LSTM module learning time sequence relation state characteristics by an FCN model, dividing the training set non-tag data prediction category by N to obtain a final prediction result, calculating an evaluation index, and outputting a training set calculation result. The method can reduce the influence of the label noise, simultaneously can reduce the signal noise, and solves the problem that the signal noise causes interference to the abnormal detection result.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine prescription recommendation method based on knowledge graph
description: A method for recommending TCM prescriptions based on knowledge graphs, using knowledge graph embedding models, multi-head attention mechanisms, graph convolutions, etc. The description text is the research object, integrates the knowledge map information of traditional Chinese medicine, absorbs the clinical experience of prescribing the right medicine to the case, and fully considers multiple individual factors such as the nature of the medicine, efficacy, condition and patient's constitution, based on the principle of holism of traditional Chinese medicine and the principle of syndrome differentiation and treatment. Thought, according to the patient's different symptoms and symptoms, select different combinations of medicinal materials, propose a TCM prescription recommendation method that integrates knowledge graphs, consider the complex relationship between personal signs and symptoms and drugs, and analyze the local laws in combination with each prescription. Recommend more reliable prescription medicinal materials for doctors and patients, and provide auxiliary decision support for clinical diagnosis and treatment of traditional Chinese medicine.

title: Multi-mode data fusion and uncertain estimation water level prediction method and system
description: The invention discloses a water level prediction method and system for multi-modal data fusion and uncertain estimation, using various spatio-temporal data related to reservoir water level prediction to generate multiple parallel CNN branches for feature fusion and dimensionality reduction, after processing as The input vector of the Bi-LSTM model predicts the water level, and Monte Carlo technology is introduced to evaluate the uncertainty and confidence of the prediction results. The present invention adopts multi-modal data fusion technology, builds different CNN branches for different types of spatio-temporal data to run in parallel, reduces dimensionality through PCA, builds Bi-LSTM network for prediction, and introduces Monte Carlo technology to predict model, uncertainty and confidence Degree evaluation can effectively reduce model prediction error and improve prediction reliability. The invention has high practicability, can be widely used in fields such as water conservancy and meteorology, and provides more rigorous and effective prediction and decision-making for application scenarios such as water resource management and disaster early warning.

title: Page development processing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: This application provides a page development and processing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining a development request, which includes: a Web UI picture to be identified; according to the development request, using a pre-trained recognition model to analyze and obtain each of the Web UI pictures to be identified. Categories and coordinates of UI components; output the categories and coordinates of each UI component to implement development and processing of Web pages. The method of this application can improve the development efficiency of Web pages.

title: A knowledge tracking method and system that combines multi-task learning and adversarial training
description: The invention discloses a knowledge tracking method and system that combines multi-task learning and adversarial training. The knowledge tracking system includes an input module, an embedding module, an encoder-decoder module, a prediction module and an adversarial training module. The invention relates to knowledge tracking technology field. This knowledge tracking method and system combines multi-task learning and adversarial training. By adding three encoder input features, it more fully considers the impact of test questions and interaction features on learners' answering performance. By combining multi-task learning, it will predict learners The probability of correctly answering test questions in the future is used as the main task, and predicting the learner's answering time as the auxiliary task. By using the collaborative multi-head self-attention module to replace the multi-head self-attention module, a single head has richer performance capabilities. By combining adversarial training , adding small perturbations to the embedded representation of test question IDs to achieve the effect of data augmentation and suppress model overfitting.

title: Medical image segmentation methods, systems, and devices based on efficient focus and attention
description: The invention discloses a medical image segmentation method, a system and a device based on high-efficiency focus attention, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly, adjusting the size of an image through a preprocessing stage, carrying out data augmentation through an image enhancement method of adjusting brightness, contrast, color and the like, enabling the preprocessed image to enter an embedded layer to generate an embedded vector, carrying out feature extraction through a high-efficiency focus attention module, carrying out three loops, enabling the feature vector dimension to be reduced after each loop, enabling high-level semantic features to be fused into low-level features through jump connection by a network structure of different layers, enabling the feature vector to enter a decoder to be gradually upsized, and finally restoring the feature vector into a masked image through a linear classifier, and the segmentation of medical images can be realized.

title: Steel structure plate fault detection method and system based on deep learning
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of plate fault detection, and discloses a steel structure plate fault detection method and system based on deep learning, using a three-layer multi-head attention module and a stochastic gradient descent optimizer as training optimizers for all models with attention architecture; inter-attribute attention for explaining the conclusions of the model by capturing the relative importance of various attributes; extensive testing using well-known data sets, and analysis of two levels of explanation. The present invention uses attention layers at two levels to demonstrate this architecture, achieving the granularity of explanation. Inter-attribute attention values provide the present invention with a concept of the relative importance of various attributes in the model, which explain personal decisions for end users. The model can be adjusted to meet specific requirements with the help of average case analysis of the importance of these attributes. The architecture proposed by the present invention provides meaningful decision explanations and outperforms all benchmark models.

title: A fractional-order PI control method applied to three-stage generators
description: The invention discloses a fractional-order PI control method applied to a three-stage generator, which includes: using the error between the output voltage of the main generator in the three-stage generator and a given reference voltage as the fractional-order PI control of the voltage outer loop The input of the generator; the output of the fractional-order PI controller is used as the expected control input of the PID controller of the current inner loop, and the excitation current fed back by the main exciter in the three-stage generator is used as the state variable input of the PID controller; The output controls the output voltage of the main generator. The present invention adds an inner loop excitation current feedback loop on the basis of single-parameter feedback voltage regulation. Based on multiple parameters, the invention further improves the response speed, realizes voltage building without overshoot, and improves the voltage building process of the generator; at the same time, it adopts parameters The dynamically adjustable fractional-order PI controller serves as the control of the voltage outer loop, which enhances the anti-interference ability when the load changes suddenly.

title: A distance measurement method, device, equipment and storage medium for a transmission line
description: The invention discloses a distance measurement method, device, equipment and storage medium for a transmission line. The method includes: obtaining a set of binocular images captured by a binocular camera for the target transmission line, and determining the target object in the binocular image based on the left eye image and the right eye image; wherein the binocular image includes the left eye image and the right eye image; based on the left eye image The image and the right eye image determine multiple feature point pairs corresponding to the target object, where the two feature pixel points in the feature point pair correspond to the same position of the target object; determine the distance measurement corresponding to the target object based on the multiple feature point pairs. The parallax value determines the actual distance of the target object from the binocular camera based on the feature point pair, the target parameters of the binocular camera, and the ranging parallax value. It solves the problem of difficulty in balancing the real-time and accuracy of ranging of transmission lines, improves the accuracy and real-time of ranging of large machinery around transmission lines, and provides guarantee for the safety of transmission lines.

title: Digital twin modeling method for hot-press welding head temperature field based on generation of countermeasure network
description: The invention discloses a digital twin modeling method for the temperature field of a hot-pressure welding head based on a generative adversarial network, which includes: arranging orthogonal experiments based on welding parameters, collecting hot-pressure welding system data during the welding process, and preprocessing the hot-pressure welding system data. Finally, a data set is constructed; a conditional deep convolution generation adversarial network model is designed based on the data set to realize the prediction of the temperature field image of the hot-pressing welding head and the temperature distribution curve of the welding surface; the structural similarity index and the mean absolute error are used as the parameters of the hot-pressing welding head respectively. The loss function predicts the temperature field image of the head and the welding surface temperature distribution curve; extracts the model file with the best prediction effect, and deploys the model file to the target device based on TensorFlow Serving to achieve online prediction; compared with the existing technology, the present invention proposes The digital twin modeling method of hot pressing welding head temperature field based on generative adversarial network has good prediction quality and fast prediction speed, and can meet the special modeling requirements of manufacturing digital twins.

title: Neural network-based prediction and optimization method and system for sediment remediation by electric leaching
description: The invention discloses an electric leaching repair sediment prediction optimization method and system based on a neural network, and belongs to the technical field of lead-cadmium pollution sediment repair. The method comprises the following steps: carrying out electric leaching repair experiments under various different influence factors on lead-cadmium polluted bottom mud to obtain actual lead removal rate and actual cadmium removal rate under different influence factors; constructing a BP neural network model, taking a plurality of different influencing factors as input parameters of the BP neural network model, taking the obtained actual lead removal rate and the obtained actual cadmium removal rate as output parameters of the BP neural network model, and training the BP neural network model; and predicting the lead removal rate and the cadmium removal rate of the polluted bottom mud to be repaired by using the trained BP neural network model. According to the invention, the predicted result of the electric leaching repair sediment under various influencing factors can be obtained.

title: Method and system for tracking twin hyperspectral image based on attention and knowledge distillation
description: The invention relates to the field of image processing technology and discloses a twin hyperspectral image tracking method and system based on attention and knowledge distillation, including: constructing a tracking network model including a hybrid attention mechanism and a twin network, acquiring existing data sets and Train the tracking network model, and use the trained tracking network model as the teacher model; obtain the hyperspectral image data of the object to be measured for preprocessing and divide it into a training set and a test set, use the tracking network model as a student model, use the teacher model and train Set train the student model, and use the trained student model as a prediction model; input the training set and test set into the prediction model to obtain the target tracking results. The invention can capture multi-scale important information and improve the accuracy and robustness of the tracking network model.

title: Pulse neural network image recognition method based on probability and attention mechanism fusion
description: The invention discloses a pulse neural network image recognition method based on probability and attention mechanism fusion, and belongs to the field of computer vision and brain-like calculation.
