The method uses probability information calculated based on membrane potential and discharge threshold to continuously conduct non-differentiable pulse discharge activity, combines probability and self-adaptive discharge threshold to generate output information, and simultaneously uses an attention mechanism to further refine and integrate input information received by pulse neurons into membrane potential. The pulse neurons are constructed by the method and form a deep pulse neural network, and parameters in the pulse neural network are iteratively updated by combining a back propagation algorithm performed with time. Compared with the prior art, the method can accurately identify the category of the static image and the event data based on the asynchronous pulse in a very low time delay scene.

title: Photovoltaic power prediction method, device, storage medium and equipment
description: The invention discloses a photovoltaic power prediction method, device, storage medium and equipment. The method includes: obtaining the output data and meteorological data of the target photovoltaic power station within the prediction period; and determining based on the meteorological data of the target photovoltaic power station within the prediction period. The weather type of the day to be predicted; wherein, the weather type includes: sunny, cloudy, rainy and extreme weather; based on the weather type of the day to be predicted, the output data and meteorological data of the target photovoltaic power station within the prediction period are input into the day to be predicted The pre-trained prediction model corresponding to the weather type is used to obtain the prediction results of photovoltaic power for the day to be predicted. The invention can improve the accuracy of photovoltaic prediction and reduce the uncertainty caused by large-scale photovoltaic grid connection to the power grid.

title: Forklift early warning method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
description: The application provides a forklift early warning method, a forklift early warning device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, which are applied to a forklift, wherein an image acquisition module is arranged on the forklift; when a target object of a preset type exists in the scene image through a preset neural network, judging whether the target object is located in a preset early warning range, wherein the preset early warning range is determined according to the position of the image acquisition module and a preset characteristic curve, the preset characteristic curve is a safety range boundary of the target object of the preset type, which is determined according to the framing characteristics of the image acquisition module, relative to the forklift, and if the judgment result is yes, early warning operation is carried out. The method improves the accuracy of forklift early warning and reduces the complexity of algorithms.

title: Teacher and student network target tracking method and system based on dual knowledge distillation
description: The invention provides a teacher and student network target tracking method and system based on dual knowledge distillation, wherein the method generates a target template image and a search image by respectively initializing search areas in a given first frame of monitoring image and a given subsequent frame of monitoring image; the target template image and the search image are respectively input into two different teacher-student networks for training to obtain two different lightweight student networks, and the lightweight student networks are used as feature extraction networks for respectively extracting features of the target template image and the search image so as to carry out subsequent target classification and target tracking. According to the invention, by responding to the student network trained by combining distillation and middle-layer characteristic distillation and different student networks with different understanding capacities, the characteristics of the two student networks are shared, and the performance of the student networks is improved, so that the calculation complexity of the network is effectively reduced, and the tracking instantaneity and the generalization capability of the tracker are improved.

title: Cross-domain small sample learning hyperspectral image classification method based on machine learning method
description: The application discloses a machine learning method-based cross-domain small sample learning hyperspectral image classification method, and relates to the technical field of hyperspectral remote sensing image classification. The method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining a source domain mark sample data set S  L , a target domain mark sample data set T  L  and a test data set Te, S2, constructing a deep neural network, S3, training the deep neural network by using the source domain mark sample data set S  L  to obtain a deep neural network initial model, training the deep neural network initial model again by using the target domain mark sample data set T  L  to obtain a deep neural network final model, and S4, constructing a test network, and classifying the test data set Te by using the test network to obtain a final test result. The application better realizes cross-domain small sample learning, can obtain more sufficient semantic information with spectral detail characteristics and local detail spectral characteristics, and effectively improves the image classification effect.

title: A method and device for automatically adjusting parameters of a user's model
description: The invention relates to a method and a device for automatically adjusting parameters of a model of an analysis user, wherein the method takes the number of parameters to be adjusted of the model of the analysis user to be adjusted as dimensions to construct a search space, all start values, end values and intermediate values of all parameters to be adjusted are combined in a full arrangement mode, the total number of the combination of the full arrangement mode is taken as the initial number of the crow of a CSA algorithm, vector coordinates of each group of combination are taken as the initial position of the crow to initialize the CSA algorithm, the crow is evenly and discretely distributed in the search space, and the parameters to be adjusted are automatically adjusted, so that the adjusted parameter model is obtained to analyze the user. Therefore, the method and the device uniformly and discretely distribute the crow in the search space, avoid the premature sinking into the local optimal solution when optimizing the parameters to be adjusted, consider all parameter combinations, ensure the more comprehensive search range in the crow iterative search process, and improve the accuracy of automatic parameter adjustment of the model, thereby improving the accuracy of user analysis.

title: A large-grained silicon material detection and removal system based on YOLOv8 network
description: The present invention provides a deep learning large-grained silicon material detection and removal system based on the YOLOv8 network, which is suitable for the field of silicon material subdivision and sorting. The system acquires silicon material images on the conveyor belt through a high frame rate camera and manually annotates them using labelme to eliminate abnormal silicon material images. The image samples were divided into training sets and verification sets at a ratio of 9:1, and data enhancement was performed on the images to improve generalization ability. Use YOLOv8 as the backbone network to create the YOLO_SI algorithm, and use the training data set to obtain the network model. This algorithm is used to detect all silicon materials in the image, perform size warning and tracking marking according to the preset threshold, and issue a clearing instruction to the lower computer when the clearing position is reached. By installing the air jet at a preset position, the lower computer sends commands to the air jet device to orderly remove the large-grained silicon materials marked and tracked. The invention can efficiently detect and remove silicon materials, has a high degree of automation, effectively reduces manual dependence, and meets the selection needs of the mining industry.

title: Data processing methods, devices, computer-readable media and electronic equipment
description: The embodiment of the application provides a data processing method, a data processing device, a computer readable medium and electronic equipment. The data processing method comprises the following steps: inputting data to be processed into at least two machine learning models to obtain a target probability value which is output by each machine learning model and aims at a prediction result; based on the collaborative standardization parameters corresponding to at least two machine learning models, carrying out standardization processing on the target probability value output by each machine learning model to obtain a standardization processing result corresponding to each machine learning model; and determining uncertainty of a prediction result corresponding to the data to be processed according to the standardized processing result corresponding to each machine learning model. According to the scheme provided by the embodiment of the application, the output result of each machine learning model is standardized based on the collaborative standardization parameter, so that the influence of the difference of the output results among different machine learning models is reduced, and the prediction result corresponding to the data to be processed is more reliable.

title: Unsupervised defect detection method, system and medium based on slice matching
description: The invention discloses an unsupervised defect detection method, system and medium based on slice matching. The method includes the following steps: configuring a feature extractor, collecting defect-free photovoltaic images, and creating slice features based on the feature extractor and the defect-free photovoltaic image. Storage library; confirm the image to be detected, obtain the slice features to be tested of the image to be detected based on the feature extractor; screen the normal similar features of the slice features to be tested in the slice feature storage library, and determine the slice features to be tested based on the slice features to be tested and the normal similar features. Abnormalities in slice characteristics; determine the defects of the image to be detected based on the abnormal conditions; the present invention can accurately detect and locate the defects of defective photovoltaic samples when there are only normal photovoltaic image samples, solving the labeling difficulties in industrial detection and The problem of a small number of defect samples relatively balances the contradiction between cost and performance, achieves cost reduction and efficiency improvement, and improves robustness and applicability.

title: Commercial aggregation area-oriented identification method and device
description: The invention provides a method and a device for identifying business aggregation areas, which comprise the steps of obtaining scene data, industrial parameter data, performance data and MDT data after preprocessing of the areas to be identified, and inputting the scene data, industrial parameter data, performance data and MDT data into a target decision tree model to obtain predicted scene data, predicted industrial parameter data, predicted performance data and predicted MDT data with data labels of business properties; performing scene missing data supplementation on the predicted scene data based on the predicted project data to obtain target scene data; scoring and calculating the predicted performance data and the predicted MDT data to obtain comprehensive total score data; and carrying out density clustering grouping on the target scene data and the comprehensive total score data to obtain a density clustering grouping result, and identifying the business aggregation area from the area to be identified according to the density clustering grouping result, so that the identification result has more confidence, and the identified business aggregation area is ensured to be more accurate by combining the comprehensive score with the scene data.

title: Large-scale point cloud semantic segmentation method for three-dimensional point cloud
description: The invention discloses a large-scale point cloud semantic segmentation method for three-dimensional point clouds, which includes using voxelized grids to downsample point cloud files, reduce the number of point clouds, and calculate relatively uniform large-scale point cloud data. ; Use the atrous convolution method of multiple different convolution kernels to expand the receptive field range of each point in each point cloud, and use the feature fusion algorithm to obtain a larger receptive field of the fusion context. By downsampling the input point cloud data and further enhancing the receptive field, the present invention reduces the loss of geometric information in the process of large-scale point cloud downsampling, retains the geometric characteristics of non-uniform point clouds as much as possible, and improves the boundaries of ground objects. Detection accuracy.

title: Non-contact power equipment diagnosis method using artificial intelligence and signal processing
description: The invention discloses a non-contact type power equipment diagnosis method using artificial intelligence and signal processing technology and a device using the same. A power device diagnostic method using artificial intelligence according to an embodiment may include the steps of: obtaining an ultrasonic signal of the power equipment; generating a mel frequency spectrum according to the ultrasonic signal, wherein the mel frequency spectrum comprises time information, frequency information and size information corresponding to the ultrasonic signal, and is in an image form; inputting the mel spectrum into a pre-learned diagnostic model; and obtaining diagnostic data of the electrical equipment according to the diagnostic model, wherein the diagnostic model can be constructed based on a convolutional neural network algorithm.

title: Tunnel advanced geological disaster intelligent judging and identifying method based on multi-source information fusion
description: The intelligent identification method for advanced geological hazards in tunnels based on multi-source information fusion consists of the following steps: S1: An advanced geological forecasting method combination includes multiple prediction methods; a tunnel hazard dataset is set up to collect prediction data for the location of the hazard in the target tunnel corresponding to each prediction method in the advanced geological forecasting method combination. The collected prediction data is then placed into the tunnel hazard dataset to establish a mapping relationship between various geological hazards and the construction parameters of the target tunnel; S2: The processing system uses each type of prediction data in the tunnel hazard dataset to train and generate a corresponding convolutional neural network model, resulting in a convolutional neural network model group; based on multiple single identification results, the system simulates the multi-expert analysis and decision-making process to achieve the goal of intelligent identification of geological hazards such as karst, faults, and sudden water inrushes through multi-source information fusion.

title: Image stitching method, device and equipment based on RGB similarity feature matching
description: The present invention discloses an image stitching method, device and equipment based on RGB similarity feature matching. The stitching method comprises: extracting feature information of images to be stitched, calculating the feature global similarity between two images to be stitched after regularizing the feature information, and calculating the predicted offset, estimating the homography matrix of the change between at least two images to be stitched based on the predicted offset; deforming the images to be stitched to obtain transformed images based on the images to be stitched, the homography matrix and the unit matrix, matching the feature information and determining the optimal match according to the pixel RGB similarity of the feature areas of at least two transformed images, and generating a preliminary stitching image; connecting the preliminary stitching image and at least two transformed images into a nine-channel output, and inputting the nine-channel output and the preset real label into a trained generative adversarial network to obtain a high-quality stitching image. The present invention can obtain a high-quality stitching result.

title: Product recommendation method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: This application discloses a product recommendation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium, including: constructing an action set based on historical products, constructing an environmental status set based on historical environmental status, constructing a reward feedback mechanism based on historical return expectations; constructing a deep Q-based Product recommendation model built by the network; given the initial environment state, train the product recommendation model; obtain the user portrait of the target user; input the user portrait of the target user into the trained product recommendation model, and use the trained product recommendation model to The probability of products being clicked by target users is predicted and sorted, and target products to be recommended to target users are selected. This application uses deep Q network to perform deep learning on the potential relationship between the environmental status generated based on user portraits and recommended products, and can accurately recommend target products to target users.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography small target detection method with improved YOLOv7
description: The invention relates to an improved YOLOv unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography small target detection method, and belongs to the technical field of target detection. Firstly, a feature map with higher resolution is obtained by adding small target detection branches, the feature extraction capacity of a model for small targets is improved, meanwhile, a large target detection layer is deleted, the number of model parameters and the calculated amount are reduced, secondly, a GMAM feature fusion module based on a multi-scale channel attention mechanism is designed, the attention of the model for the small targets is increased, the detection precision of the small targets is improved, a QARepN module is designed, the feature fusion capacity of the model is improved, meanwhile, the calculation amount of the model is reduced, and finally SIoU Loss is used as a loss function to accelerate the convergence of a network. Experimental results of VisDrone and 2019 data sets show that the method improves mAP50 indexes by 6.26%, and has a better detection effect on unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography small target detection.

title: Transient electromagnetic signal denoising method for improving variational modal decomposition based on sparrow algorithm
description: The invention discloses a method for denoising transient electromagnetic signals based on the Sparrow algorithm to improve variational mode decomposition. It relates to the field of signal processing technology and includes the following steps: Step 1: Use the Sparrow optimization algorithm to determine the penalty factor α in the variational mode decomposition. Perform global optimization with the mode number K to obtain the optimal parameters [K, α]; step two, use the optimal parameter combination obtained after optimization to perform variational mode decomposition on the collected transient electromagnetic signals to achieve In the denoising process of the original signal, the present invention uses the Sparrow optimization algorithm to globally optimize the penalty factor α and the mode number K in the variational mode decomposition to obtain the best parameters and avoid the modal problems that may be caused by artificial selection of parameters. aliasing problem and improve the signal denoising effect.

title: Event-image deblurring method based on LSTM
description: The present invention is an event-image deblurring method based on LSTM, which includes the following steps: constructing an event-image deblurring network model for processing blurred images; using training set data in the fuzzy data set to deblur the event-image network Carry out training to obtain a trained event-image deblurring network model; input the test set data in the fuzzy data set into the trained event-image deblurring network model to obtain a clear frame sequence  .  Taking full advantage of the timing information of events, it improves the deblurring performance and the generalization of the network. It can use a model to complete the deblurring output of any time resolution, and the clear frame time resolution of the output is determined by the input event. time resolution control. At the same time, the bidirectional encoding-decoding structure is used to enhance the deblurring effect of the network, which has the following advantages: only one model needs to be trained to output at any time resolution, which solves the problem of limited model generalization.

title: Pedestrian classification and identification-based active energy absorption device for automobile and control method thereof
description: The invention discloses an active energy-absorbing device for automobiles based on pedestrian classification and recognition and a control method thereof. The active energy-absorbing device for automobiles is an adult/child airbag structure. The method includes: acquiring a real-time image of the road; inputting the real-time image of the road based on The pedestrian classification model built by the YOLOv5 network performs classification and detection to obtain pedestrian classification results, that is, identifying whether there is a pedestrian and whether the pedestrian is an adult or a child; detecting the distance between the pedestrian and the car and obtaining the current vehicle status, and predicting the future of the pedestrian based on the distance and the current vehicle status. After a collision, based on the pedestrian classification results, the car's active energy-absorbing device pops up the corresponding adult airbag or child airbag. The technical solution of the present invention can avoid the occurrence of over-inflation, causing secondary injuries to children and insufficient inflation, and fails to effectively protect the heads of adults. At the same time, the entire airbag detonation and deployment process is realized before the actual contact between people and vehicles. Buy valuable time for pedestrian protection.

title: Space-sky non-cooperative target pose estimation method and device based on depth feature point matching
description: The invention relates to a method and device for estimating the pose of aerial and non-cooperative targets based on deep feature point matching, and belongs to the fields of image processing, deep learning, and aerospace. A feature point regression extraction module is constructed to extract sub-pixel key points from RGB images and depth images using the encoder-decoder structure. A multi-channel feature point pairing network is designed, using three loss functions to obtain the pairing of key points in the volume reference system. A non-iterative mismatch removal method is proposed to further improve the pairing accuracy, and the target rotation matrix is extracted from the matched key points to obtain the attitude information of the non-cooperative target. The invention solves the problem of inconspicuous foreground and background of non-cooperative targets and the low accuracy of feature point extraction of non-cooperative targets, and improves the accuracy and robustness of target attitude estimation.

title: A method, device, equipment and storage medium for generating private domain data
description: The invention discloses a method, device, equipment and storage medium for generating private domain data. The method includes: obtaining an API data source, combining several entries according to the API data of the private domain, and obtaining at least one third item based on the several entries and data structures. One QA pair, fuzzifying at least one first QA pair to obtain at least one second QA and mapping relationship table, deepening and expanding at least one second QA pair to obtain at least one third QA pair; according to the mapping relationship table, at least A third QA pair is clarified to obtain at least one fourth QA pair, and is transmitted to the training model as a supervised fine-tuning SFT data set that conforms to the private domain API, so that a large language model can be trained using the SFT data set. This method randomly generates a large number of SFT use cases covering multiple business scopes, thereby increasing the breadth of QA pairs; and improving the security of private domain codes by fuzzifying the first generated QA pair.

title: A standard quality inspection management platform based on image detection and recognition
description: The present invention discloses a standard quality inspection management platform based on image inspection and recognition, and relates to the technical field of quality inspection. The present invention automatically performs quality inspection and problem identification tasks through machine learning, deep learning and image processing technology, without a large amount of manual intervention. The automatic marking module adopts Mask R-CNN to train the image segmentation model, and realizes the automatic marking of defects and problem areas in the image, so that quality inspection becomes more efficient and accurate, and the burden on operators is reduced. The graph computing engine module performs real-time analysis on the cloud computing center and edge computing nodes, identifies quality problems and abnormal situations, and reduces production interruptions and resource waste. At the same time, through the long short-term memory network LSTM, quality problems are predicted according to historical data and current status, and potential problems on the production line can be identified and solved in advance, avoiding the expansion of quality problems and production interruptions.

title: Farmland remote sensing image segmentation method based on semi-supervised interactive learning
description: The invention is suitable for the technical field of agricultural image analysis, and particularly provides a farmland remote sensing image segmentation method based on semi-supervised interactive learning; and secondly, introducing a directivity contrast loss function into the CNN, and performing full-supervision training on the tagged data to ensure the consistency of the same identity features in the pictures under different scenes, thereby improving the generalization capability and robustness of the model.

title: Multi-input combined intelligent single-pixel imaging method and device thereof
description: The invention relates to the technical field of stable detection in a temporary security technology system, in particular to a multi-input combined intelligent single-pixel imaging method and a device thereof, comprising the following steps: acquiring a speckle pattern and a light intensity value of a corresponding light beam passing through an object; constructing a convolutional neural network based on a U-Net framework; based on the designed loss function, training the convolutional neural network until convergence, and outputting a final image. According to the invention, the physical model is embedded into the neural network by using the detected light intensity information and the speckle information, the network parameters are optimized by using the intensity value acquired by the detector as a reference standard, the generalization and the interpretability of the network are improved, and the parameters are optimized by combining one-dimensional input and two-dimensional input, so that the imaging quality is further improved.

title: Sight state prediction method, device and application
description: The invention relates to a sight state prediction method, which comprises the steps of obtaining ray tracing simulation results of an indoor scene to be predicted, dividing the simulation results into a preset number of receiving points; the coordinates of each receiving point and the real sight state are obtained and preprocessed to form a receiving point matrix; constructing a two-state Markov model based on the sight distance environment and the non-sight distance environment of the indoor scene to be predicted; moving the sample receiving points in the receiving point set according to different preset directions and preset distances, and calculating and acquiring the state transition probability of switching between the sight distance state and the non-sight distance state of the moved sample receiving points by using a two-state Markov model to form a state transition matrix; performing curve fitting on the state transition probability in each state respectively to obtain a corresponding probability prediction fitting equation; and acquiring an initial sight state of the receiving point to be positioned, selecting a target probability prediction fitting equation, inputting the moving direction and the distance of the target probability prediction fitting equation to obtain state probability, and acquiring a predicted sight state.

title: Network intrusion detection method and system based on deep learning optimization
description: The invention discloses a network intrusion detection method and system based on deep learning optimization. The method includes: performing data preprocessing on the original data set collected from the honeypot system to form an experimental data set; dividing the training set based on the experimental data set and test set to build a benchmark ELM model; combine the AE autoencoder with the benchmark ELM model to build an AE‑ELM algorithm model; modify the inertia weight of the standard particle swarm algorithm to form a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and use the particle swarm optimization algorithm to optimize the AE‑ELM algorithm. The learning parameters of the model are used to construct the PSO‑AE‑ELM algorithm model as an experimental model; the experimental model is compared with the mainstream algorithm model to verify the reliability of the experimental model in network intrusion detection, and the experimental model is used for network intrusion detection. The invention can not only effectively deal with the problems of high data dimension and strong noise, but also improve the detection performance of the algorithm.

title: Visual detection method for defects of stainless steel multistage pump impeller
description: The invention relates to the technical field of impeller defect detection, and in particular to a visual detection method for stainless steel multi-stage pump impeller defects. This method first obtains the initial sliding window, and obtains the gray-scale mutation point based on the gray-scale difference of adjacent pixels in the initial sliding window; obtains a matching pair composed of adjacent gray-scale mutation points along the impeller radius direction; based on all the gray-scale mutation points in the initial sliding window Match the distance between the gray-scale mutation points within the pair to obtain the initial width of the sliding window. Combined with the degree of scratch curvature, the adjusted sliding window width is obtained; at the same time, all similar points in the circumferential direction of the initial gray-scale mutation points are obtained and the grayscale is calculated. The arc length composed of the mutation point and its similar points is used to obtain the current sliding window arc length; then the impeller surface image is segmented. The present invention initializes the sliding window so that the sliding window conforms to scratch texture characteristics, and dynamically adjusts the width and arc length of the sliding window to improve the accuracy of segmentation results and reduce the amount of calculation that may occur during image segmentation.

title: Quantum calculation-based chemical reaction path generation method, device and medium
description: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for generating a chemical reaction path based on quantum computation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining an expected reaction path based on the target chemical reaction, wherein the expected reaction path comprises a plurality of target molecules; preparing a test state corresponding to each target molecule respectively, and measuring the average energy of each test state; and when all the average energy meets the preset condition, generating a final reaction path of the target chemical reaction, wherein the preset condition is the preset precision of the difference value between the current average energy and the average energy measured in the last time for the same test state. The embodiment of the invention can accurately generate the chemical reaction path, improve the calculation speed and promote the further development of quantum chemical simulation application.

title: Human behavior recognition method, device and storage medium based on skeleton points
description: The invention discloses a human body behavior recognition method, equipment and storage medium based on skeletal points, which are applied in the technical field of behavior recognition. It includes the following steps: S1. Data collection; S2. Construct human body detection and attitude estimation network; S3. Train and test human body detection and attitude estimation network; S4. Perform human body detection and attitude estimation; S5. Human multi-target tracking; S6. Repeat S4 and S5 complete the processing of all video frames, and finally obtain the stacked array of human body key point coordinates of all video frames; S7. Construct a human behavior recognition network; S8. Train and test the human behavior recognition network; S9. Human behavior recognition. The present invention performs human body behavior recognition based on skeletal points, and can effectively understand the target's behavior by extracting the position transformation information of the skeletal points, with higher accuracy; at the same time, it also reduces the amount of data processing and has higher real-time performance.

title: Automatic sorting and shelving method for test specimens
description: This application relates to the field of specimen sorting technology and discloses a method for automatic sorting and shelving of inspection specimens. The method includes the following steps: scanning barcodes for sample introduction, downloading barcode information; testing for specimen qualification; and placing qualified specimens to be processed into warehouses. Or put it on the shelf; put it on the shelf by partition. This application can perform routine specimen sorting, and can also automatically identify whether the specimen volume is qualified, whether the specimen has hemolysis, lipemia, jaundice, etc., and remove unqualified specimens. The specimens that need to be sorted and put on the shelves can be distinguished at one time, and the specimens that need to be put on the shelves are automatically placed in the designated test tube racks, avoiding the need to manually remove the specimens from the sorting warehouse and put them on the shelves again. And the shelving function can avoid the order of specimens being sorted and put on the shelf, ensuring that the specimens that arrive at the machine first are put on the shelves first, so that the specimens that arrive first can be put on the machine, the experiments can be done first, and the results can be obtained first. It can effectively guarantee the TAT time for specimen circulation and ensure that patients receiving reports can get their reports on time.

title: Language processing method and device, storage medium, and computer equipment for adaptive tasks
description: The invention discloses a language processing method and device, storage medium, and computer equipment for adapting tasks. It belongs to the technical field of natural language processing and mainly aims at solving the problem of processing the language model obtained by adjusting the parameters of the pre-trained language model in the prior art. Problems with poor performance in downstream tasks include: obtaining the pre-trained language processing main model, and obtaining the parameter matrix and deviation term of each linear transformation layer in the language processing main model; obtaining the target task learning data set corresponding to the downstream task , and determine the parameter fine-tuning function corresponding to each parameter matrix or deviation term through supervised learning on the target task learning data set; use the parameter fine-tuning function to fine-tune the parameters of each linear transformation layer of the main language processing model, and obtain the parameters corresponding to the downstream tasks The corresponding language processing sub-model; and based on the language processing sub-model, language processing of downstream tasks is implemented.

title: Audio-assisted depth fake face video detection method, system and equipment
description: The invention discloses an audio-assisted deep forgery face video detection method, system and equipment. The detection method proposed by the invention uses an audio generation model to input the forgery discrimination elements in the video, outputs the corresponding audio information, and combines it with The audio information in the original video is comparatively analyzed to obtain auxiliary components for authenticity judgment, which are combined with the audio and video information in the original video to determine the authenticity of the deep fake video, which not only utilizes the multi-modal feature information of audio and video, but also The relationship between video and audio is also considered, making the audio spectrum features more reliable and improving the detection accuracy of deep fake videos. In addition, the detection method proposed by the present invention does not need to rely on a medium and can be easily implemented, so it has high generalization.

title: Lubricating system experimental device, lubricating process data processing method and device
description: The invention discloses a lubrication system experimental device, a lubrication process data processing method and a device. The lubrication system experimental device includes: a fixed component, a sliding device, electrical steel, a driving motor, a spray device, a stirring liquid supply device; An air nozzle is provided; the electrical steel is fixed on the sliding device through the fixing component; the driving motor is fixed on top of the lubrication system experimental device through the fixing component; the driving motor is connected to the sliding device; the spray device is fixed on the lubrication system experimental device through the fixing component; air The nozzle is used to spray air to the electrical steel to control the duration of the emulsion acting on the electrical steel; the stirring liquid supply device is connected to the spray device through a plastic pipe and is used to provide evenly stirred emulsion to the spray device, which can provide a This kind of experimental device can realize the switching of different lubrication systems and provide a data basis for the reasonable selection of lubrication systems and process parameters.

title: A method, device, storage medium and electronic equipment for model optimization
description: This application discloses a method, device, storage medium and electronic device for model optimization. After the user specifies the target model, the user can collect different data contained in the target model specified by the user by calling the preset data collection programs. The operating data of the model units at different granularities can be analyzed and processed, so that the hardware resource usage information of the model units at different granularities included in the target model can be determined. , and based on the hardware resource usage information of model units at different granularities contained in the determined target model, the target model is evaluated and optimized from multiple granularity levels, thereby effectively improving the performance of the target model.

title: Photovoltaic power generation-based power exchange station operation method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of operation of a power exchange station, in particular to a power exchange station operation method based on photovoltaic power generation. The invention adopts the BP neural network-based method to predict the photovoltaic power generation power, so that the data is more accurate. According to the invention, the immune genetic algorithm and the shortest path algorithm model are adopted to carry out layout planning on the battery exchange station, so that the optimal path between the charging demand point and the optimal charging point of the battery exchange station in the whole map network can be quickly found. The invention builds the direct operation model of the photovoltaic-power exchange station, and reduces the charging cost of the power exchange station. The photovoltaic-power conversion station optimization operation model participating in the electric power market is built, and the extra benefit of the power conversion station is improved.

title: AI-based security risk identification analysis system and method
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of digital factories, and discloses an AI-based safety risk identification and analysis system and method, wherein the AI-based safety risk identification and analysis method comprises: generating a first node based on data of a chemical process system, and generating a second node based on data of an operator and data of a non-automated operation; generating initial features and a reference graph of the node; inputting the initial features of the node into a dynamic learning model, and outputting a value indicating whether the non-automated operation to be judged has a risk; if the non-automated operation to be judged has a risk, adding an operator to supervise the execution of the non-automated operation to be judged or manually reviewing the non-automated operation; the present invention can use artificial intelligence to extract the dynamic change characteristics of a chemical process system over a period of time, and fuse the global information of the chemical process system, so as to achieve the purpose of predicting the risk of the non-automated operation to be executed.

title: Combined measuring device of gas-liquid two-phase flow differential pressure flowmeter and precession flowmeter
description: The invention relates to a combined measurement device of a gas-liquid two-phase flow differential pressure flowmeter and a precession flowmeter. Based on the differential pressure flowmeter and precession flowmeter, the gas-liquid two-phase flow in the pipeline under different working conditions is measured respectively, and the gas-liquid two-phase flow flow and density signals are obtained. The DWT‑Transformer model is proposed to extract features of the signal, and then Realize the measurement of gas content of gas-liquid two-phase flow under different working conditions.

title: Multi-flow-graph neural network three-dimensional grid denoising method and system based on curvature driving
description: The invention discloses a curvature-driven multi-flow graph neural network three-dimensional grid denoising method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing first grid image data and second grid image data according to the three-dimensional grid, wherein nodes of the first grid image data are vertexes, and nodes of the second grid image data are patches; inputting the first grid map data and the second grid map data into a pre-trained multi-flow graph neural network based on curvature driving to obtain three-dimensional denoising vertex coordinates corresponding to each vertex and three-dimensional denoising surface normal vectors corresponding to each patch; and carrying out vertex updating operation on each three-dimensional denoising vertex coordinate according to a plurality of three-dimensional denoising surface normal vectors corresponding to each three-dimensional denoising vertex coordinate so as to finish denoising processing of the three-dimensional grid. The invention improves the performance of retaining the characteristics and the quality of the three-dimensional grid in the denoising process, thereby being capable of better processing the three-dimensional grid.

title: Non-circular signal spectrum sensing method based on deep learning
description: The invention belongs to the field of wireless communication technology, and specifically relates to a non-circular signal spectrum sensing method based on deep learning. It includes the following steps: (1) Calculate the augmented covariance matrix of the signal by sampling the received signal, and use the augmented covariance matrix Y of the multi-antenna received signal and its corresponding channel occupancy status Z as a single training data to construct a training set Ω; (2) Train on the training set Ω, and obtain the trained network h  0  after the training is completed; (3) At each sensing time t, sample the multi-antenna received signal and calculate its augmented covariance matrix; (4) ) Use all augmented covariance matrices as the input Y  t  of the trained convolutional neural network to obtain the test statistic of the received signal; (5) Determine the test statistic of the received signal to obtain the occupancy status of the channel. The spectrum sensing algorithm of the present invention is less affected by noise instability, and can still maintain good detection performance under low signal-to-noise ratio.

title: Real-scene three-dimensional-oriented map-generic visual knowledge construction method
description: The invention discloses a method for constructing real-scene three-dimensional pan-map visualization knowledge, which includes: obtaining multi-scene real-scene three-dimensional map cases; constructing a real-scene three-dimensional visualization ontology model based on the multi-scene real-scene three-dimensional map cases; and based on the real-scene three-dimensional visualization ontology. The model performs map expression feature analysis, and constructs a map recommendation knowledge graph based on the analysis results; the map recommendation knowledge graph displays real-life three-dimensional visual knowledge association results based on the map recommendation knowledge graph. By establishing a real-scene three-dimensional object visualization information knowledge base and mining association rules of three-dimensional object expression based on semantic networks, the present invention provides cartographic knowledge for the expression of real-scene three-dimensional maps, improves mapping efficiency, and realizes the function of multi-dimensional visual expression of real-scene three-dimensional maps.

title: Pavement disease recognition method based on deep learning
description: The invention belongs to the field of target detection technology, and in particular relates to a method for identifying road surface defects based on deep learning, which includes the following steps: S1. Constructing a road surface disease identification model; the road surface disease identification model is improved from the YOLOv7 model, and the improvement includes : Replace ordinary convolutions in the feature extraction part of the backbone network with deformable convolutions; and introduce a spatially explicit vision center scheme EVC into the overall network structure; the vision center scheme EVC includes lightweight MLP and learnable Vision center mechanism LVC; S2. Obtain a training data set including pavement disease images and corresponding annotation information; S3. Use the training data set to train the pavement disease recognition model; S4. Use the trained pavement disease recognition model to identify pavement diseases. Using this method, multiple pavement disease types can be accurately identified in real pavement environments.

title: Plastic corner protection molding processing system based on ABS resin composite material
description: The invention relates to the technical field of plastic molding, in particular to a plastic corner protector molding treatment system based on an ABS resin composite material. The system comprises: the system comprises an ABS resin composite material injection molding control data acquisition module, an ABS resin composite material injection molding parameter optimization selection module and an ABS resin composite material injection molding optimal control parameter acquisition module, wherein injection molding control parameter data are acquired; carrying out orthogonal test on injection molding control parameter data to obtain a response curved surface with optimized parameters; determining a local search space and an initial particle number; constructing the space uncertainty of the local search space; acquiring the expansion speed of a particle swarm in a local search space, and improving a speed update formula of a traditional particle swarm algorithm; constructing local search space merging discrimination conditions; and obtaining the optimal control parameters of injection molding by adopting a particle swarm algorithm. The invention aims to avoid the situation that the particle swarm optimization is in a local optimal solution when optimizing injection molding parameters, thereby ensuring better quality of plastic corner protector.

title: Knowledge and data dual-drive stream type multi-modal diagram learning method
description: The invention discloses a knowledge and data dual-driven flow type multi-modal diagram learning method, which relates to the field of multi-modal diagram learning and comprises the following steps: training a lifelong learning knowledge pre-training network using the collected multimodal data; the data rectifying module is utilized to perform decentralization and normalization operations on the streaming multi-mode data; the data complement module is utilized to complement the missing data; the mode data identification module is utilized to identify the complement multi-mode data; inputting the multi-modal data in the data warehouse to representative prototype knowledge points of the learning data in the trained lifelong learning knowledge pre-training network; and generating a bipartite graph by using a knowledge-driven graph generation module according to the representative prototype knowledge points in the knowledge warehouse and the complemented multi-mode data. The invention solves the problems that the existing data driving mechanism has large calculation cost and poor model generalization and expansibility, and the knowledge driving mechanism is easily affected by bad data and faces the risks of knowledge degradation and disastrous forgetting.

title: Image generator training method, image reconstruction method, device and storage medium
description: The present disclosure provides an image generator training method, image reconstruction method, device and storage medium, and relates to the field of image processing. The training method includes: obtaining a first image and a second image with reduced resolution of the first image; obtaining a first image feature and a downsampled image feature corresponding to the first image based on the first image, and obtaining a second image feature based on the second image. The image feature and the upsampled image feature corresponding to the second image; calculate the image similarity between the downsampled image feature and the upsampled image feature; use the image similarity to texture the first image feature and the second image feature based on the attention mechanism Process to obtain the image encoding; input the image encoding to the image generator to generate a predicted image with a higher resolution than the second image; and use a loss function to train the image generator based on the predicted image and the first image. The present disclosure can improve the quality of images after high-resolution reconstruction.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for optimizing and configuring battery capacity of wind farm
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of energy storage optimization configuration, and in particular to a method, device, equipment and medium for optimizing battery capacity configuration in a wind farm, including: combining energy storage to smooth power fluctuations and the working condition requirements of primary frequency regulation, constructing a planning layer model that takes into account the energy storage cost according to the net present value method; taking the optimal allocation of frequency regulation power between wind turbines and energy storage as the goal, constructing an operation layer model that takes into account the coordinated frequency regulation cost of wind turbine energy storage; combining the planning layer model and the operation layer model to construct a capacity optimization configuration model, and embedding a battery grouping control strategy and a variational mode decomposition method to update the grid-connected optimization reference power; using an improved particle swarm algorithm that combines reverse learning for early optimization with variation crossover for late optimization, and nesting a mathematical programming optimizer to solve the optimal battery capacity configuration plan. The present invention can effectively improve battery utilization and energy storage efficiency by utilizing the remaining power of energy storage to participate in wind farm frequency regulation and standby while achieving the demand for smoothing fluctuations.

title: Detection and identification method of network attacks in water supply pipeline network based on unsupervised overlay integration
description: The invention discloses a method for detecting and identifying network attacks on water supply pipe networks based on unsupervised superposition integration, which includes: Step (1): Perform hydraulic simulation on the water supply pipe network to obtain the data of each sensor under normal working conditions of the pipe network and during network attacks. Real-time monitoring data; Step (2): Construct a real-time detection and identification framework for network attacks on the water supply pipeline network. The framework contains four anomaly detection modules: (a) single-point anomaly detection module; (b) single-point qualitative detection module; (c) ) Sequence detection module of the monitoring point itself; (d) Sequence detection module between monitoring points; Step (3): Prepare training and test data, train and test the real-time detection and identification framework of network attacks on the water supply pipe network, and determine the detection of each anomaly The threshold of the module; Step (4): Use the real-time detection and identification framework of network attacks in the water supply pipe network to detect and identify network attacks; the present invention can better identify all attacks in the network attack detection algorithm data set.

title: Image processing methods, devices, electronic equipment and storage media
description: This application discloses an image processing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium. The image processing method includes: acquiring an original image as a first-eye image; acquiring a depth image corresponding to the first-eye image; based on the depth image and the first eye image to generate a target parallax image, and there is a parallax between the target parallax image and the first eye image; perform post-processing on the target parallax image to obtain the first eye image corresponding to Second eye image. This method can generate an image of another eye with parallax for a single-eye image, thereby expanding the field of view corresponding to the image content when displaying the image content.

title: An autonomous grasping system and method for unmanned vehicle mechanical arm suitable for small targets
description: The invention discloses an autonomous grasping system and method for an unmanned vehicle robotic arm suitable for small targets. It relates to the technical fields of smart factory robotic arm control and machine vision. It includes the following process: after starting the robotic arm binocular camera node, it can obtain Image and depth information within the camera's field of view, transfer this information to the GS‑YOLOV5 node in a topic manner and start the GS‑YOLOV5 target detection algorithm for prediction, output the pixel coordinates of the predicted target frame, and then combine it with the binocular camera calibration As a result, the three-dimensional coordinates of the target are calculated and transferred to the robotic arm drive node. The robotic arm drive node uses the small target classification information and pose information recognized by the GS‑YOLOV5 node to control the movement of the robotic arm. The method of the invention has strong versatility, high calculation efficiency and high grasping accuracy for small targets.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle general calculation joint design method based on hierarchical federal deep reinforcement learning
description: The present invention discloses a joint design method for UAV general computing based on hierarchical federated deep reinforcement learning. By jointly optimizing computing offloading decisions, computing resources and transmission power, the goal of minimizing the average long-term consumption value of client UAVs is achieved, that is, minimizing the average long-term delay and energy consumption of client UAVs. The client UAV selects the offloading action through the Thompson sampling algorithm. If the computing task is offloaded to the client UAV, the computing resources of the client UAV are optimized through the sequential least squares programming algorithm; if it is offloaded to the edge UAV or the cloud control platform, the transmission power of the client UAV is optimized through the sequential least squares programming algorithm. Finally, the hierarchical federated learning algorithm is used to update the network model parameters, and aggregation sharing is used to accelerate convergence and ensure data privacy. The joint design method proposed in the present invention can minimize the average long-term consumption value of the client UAV, while reducing communication overhead and ensuring data security.

title: A deep learning IoT identification system and method
description: The present application relates to the field of Internet of Things technology, and provides a deep learning Internet of Things identification system and method, the system includes an Internet of Things identification middle station, an Internet of Things data acquisition module, an Internet of Things fingerprint identification module, an Internet of Things asset identification module and an Internet of Things data association identification module; the Internet of Things data acquisition module, the Internet of Things fingerprint identification module, the Internet of Things asset identification module and the Internet of Things data association identification module are respectively connected to the Internet of Things identification middle station. The deep learning Internet of Things identification system provided in the present application can perform accurate and fast Internet of Things identification through the deep learning Internet of Things fingerprint identification module, the Internet of Things asset identification module and the Internet of Things data association identification module, and can quickly and accurately obtain fingerprint identification results, asset identification results and association identification results.

title: An underwater image enhancement method based on semantic perception
description: The invention discloses an underwater image enhancement method based on semantic perception, which relates to the field of image processing. The underwater image enhancement method based on semantic perception comprises the following steps: Step 1, in a semantic perception network, the input original underwater image I∈R  W×H×3  is combined with semantic segmentation to obtain the semantic prior of the segmentation result and the intermediate features of the multi-scale dimension   , through semantic priors   The original underwater image is enhanced and output to the SEM module. Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the present invention are as follows: the present invention uses an enhancement network guided by a semantic perception network to refine the underwater image, so that different underwater targets have their correct colors, and solves the unnatural problem caused by local under-enhancement or over-enhancement; in order to connect two heterogeneous networks, a SEM module (semantic perception embedding module) is used to connect the two networks, so that the semantic perception information can better guide the network.

title: Unmanned boat surface target recognition method, device, terminal and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of water surface target detection and identification, in particular to a method, a device, a terminal and a storage medium for unmanned ship water surface target identification. The method comprises the steps of processing an input image at an input end to form a characteristic image; the characteristic images with different scales are converted into characteristic vectors with fixed sizes, the characteristic vectors are input to a prediction end, the characteristic vectors are classified and regressed by a convolutional neural network at the prediction end to obtain the class information and the position information of the target, the loss is calculated according to a loss function, then the error is transmitted to a previous layer of network by using a back propagation algorithm to update the weight parameters of the convolutional neural network, and the loss is reduced by continuous loop iteration until training is completed. Compared with the prior art, the method provided by the invention has a certain improvement in calculation accuracy and calculation speed, and has important guiding significance for automatic obstacle avoidance and autonomous navigation of the unmanned ship.

title: FlexE-based carrier network power communication resource management method
description: The present invention discloses a FlexE-based bearer network power communication resource management method, which relates to the technical field of power system automation. By constructing a FlexE bearer network network topology structure, connecting power communication equipment to the FlexE bearer network network topology structure, setting different communication paths and traffic distribution rules, real-time monitoring of network status and power communication quality, flexibly managing and scheduling power communication resources, optimizing network performance and security, etc., the method can realize flexible management and scheduling of power communication resources and improve the stability and availability of power communication. At the same time, the method can be widely used in various fields in the power system, such as power monitoring, electric energy metering, fault diagnosis, etc.

title: Multi-dimensional dynamic evaluation real estate mortgage financial risk prevention and control method and system
description: The present invention relates to a multi-dimensional dynamic evaluation method and system for preventing and controlling financial risks of real estate mortgages. By collecting multi-dimensional data related to real estate mortgage loans, key characteristic elements of real estate mortgages are determined based on pre-processed multi-dimensional data and used as nodes in a knowledge graph; entity recognition and relationship extraction are used to establish association relationships between nodes, a feature knowledge graph is constructed, and a graph neural network is used to process the feature knowledge graph to learn independent features of nodes and association features between nodes; a risk assessment model is trained using features extracted from the feature knowledge graph, and the future value of the real estate mortgage is predicted through the trained risk assessment model, risk values are calculated based on node features, and risk values are sorted to form the output of the risk assessment model; the output of the risk assessment model is compared with a pre-set risk threshold to solve the static and delayed problems of real estate mortgage assessment in the prior art.

title: Cross-chain block multi-source selection storage method and system based on reinforcement learning
description: The present invention provides a cross-chain block multi-source selection storage method and system based on reinforcement learning, which defines factors affecting the storage location in the blockchain system; constructs an optimization objective function; converts the optimization objective into a Markov decision process, and defines a state space, an operation space, a state transition function and a reward function quadruple based on the Markov decision process; based on the quadruple, constructs a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, receives feedback from the environment at each moment and calculates the reward, selects a blockchain by observing the blockchain account book, determines the storage location, and then optimizes the local and cloud block storage strategies.

title: InSAR urban surface deformation risk fine recognition method combining optical images
description: A method for fine identification of dangerousness of InSAR urban surface deformation combined with optical images comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining an InSAR urban surface deformation information map based on multi-temporal SAR images of the urban area to be monitored; S2, obtaining an optical image of the urban area to be monitored, detecting the change of urban surface cover through an urban surface change detection model based on optical images, obtaining a distribution map of urban surface cover changes, and identifying pseudo-dangerous areas of surface deformation caused by urban surface cover activities; S3, superimposing the InSAR urban surface deformation information map and the urban surface cover change distribution map, removing pseudo-dangerous areas of surface deformation caused by urban surface cover activities from the InSAR urban surface deformation information map, and thus obtaining an InSAR urban surface deformation real dangerous area distribution map. This method can remove pseudo-dangerous areas of the surface caused by urban activities and more accurately identify potential real dangers related to urban surface deformation.

title: Reinforcement learning for continuous learning of optimal battery charge
description: Reinforcement learning for continuous learning of optimal battery charging. Methods and systems for optimizing battery charging are disclosed. A battery state sensor is used to determine the anode overpotential of a battery multiple times during multiple charging cycles. In a first phase, a reinforcement learning model (e.g., an actor-critic model) is trained using rewards given throughout each charging cycle of the battery to optimize training. The reinforcement learning model can determine the health state characteristics of the battery during the charging cycle, and in a second phase, the reinforcement learning model is augmented accordingly. During the augmentation, the reinforcement learning model is trained using rewards given on a cycle-by-cycle charging basis, wherein the rewards are given after checking the charging optimization after the end of each charging cycle. Based on the augmented reinforcement learning model, a command is given to charge the field battery, the associated health state characteristics of the field battery are determined, and the reinforcement learning model is further augmented accordingly.

title: Feed switch control method and device, electronic equipment and computer storage medium
description: The present application relates to the field of feed switch control technology, and in particular to a feed switch control method, device, electronic device and computer storage medium. The present application obtains the first operating data corresponding to the target power supply line connected to the feed switch in the current time period, inputs the first operating data into a pre-trained target data prediction model to predict the second operating data corresponding to the target power supply line in the next time period, and judges whether the target power supply line has fault behavior based on the second operating data and the standard operating data corresponding to the target power supply line. When it is determined that the target power supply line has fault behavior, the target processing method of the feed switch is determined based on the fault behavior, and the feed switch is controlled to process according to the target processing method. The present application can predict the operating data in the next cycle based on the operating data of the feed switch, and determine whether the feed switch has a fault based on the operating data.

title: A deep learning-based imaging genomics analysis device for renal clear cell carcinoma
description: The application discloses a deep learning-based clear cell carcinoma image group analysis device for kidney, and relates to the technical field of image processing. Wherein the device includes: the segmentation unit is used for segmenting the lesion area of the renal clear cell carcinoma according to the acquired scanning slice image of the renal cancer patient and acquiring a characteristic image of the renal clear cell carcinoma tissue; the labeling unit is used for preprocessing the characteristic image of the kidney transparent cell cancer tissue; the construction unit is used for constructing a deep neural network based on the characteristic images of the kidney transparent cell cancer tissue and the sub-images; and the prediction unit is used for training the deep neural network by using the marked data set and substituting the weight output by the auxiliary neural network to predict the pathological grading of the renal clear cell carcinoma of the patient with the renal cancer. The application solves the technical problem of low prediction efficiency of pathological grading of the renal clear cell carcinoma.

title: A method for predicting the oil recovery cycle of multi-source sewage sedimentation separation using neural network
description: The present invention relates to a method for predicting the oil recovery period of multi-source sewage settling separation using a neural network, which includes: sample feature extraction and data preprocessing of the sample space of the multi-source sewage system; division of the oil layer growth rate prediction data set considering the clustering categories of the multi-source sewage; establishing a multi-source sewage settling separation oil layer growth rate prediction model based on a neural network: optimizing the initial weight matrix and bias matrix of the multi-source sewage settling separation oil layer growth rate prediction model; determining the oil recovery period of the multi-source sewage settling separation. The present invention solves the problem of describing the process of oil layer thickness growth formed by the floating, collision, and aggregation of oil droplets in the sewage during the settling separation of multi-source sewage containing produced water from different oil drive modes such as water drive and chemical drive, and especially solves the technical problem of scientifically and reliably predicting the settling separation oil recovery period in the context of intelligent transformation of oil fields by using artificial intelligence algorithms, considering the complex and changeable chemical components in the multi-source sewage and the water quality characteristics they bring.

title: Universal image restoration method based on automatic screening mechanism
description: The invention discloses a general image restoration method based on an automatic screening mechanism, which comprises the steps of firstly downloading images from a public data set, randomly selecting n images with different damage degrees to form a picture set, dividing the picture set into a training set and a testing set according to a proportion, and preprocessing the images in the training set and the testing set. And extracting features from the preprocessed training set data by using a residual network, and judging the type to be repaired. And then, carrying out fine adjustment on different pre-training parameters in the multi-task image restoration model to realize the restoration of the degraded image. And finally, calculating the loss to obtain the optimal parameters of the residual error network and the multi-task image restoration model, and testing. The invention realizes the high-efficiency high-quality image restoration function, is beneficial to reducing the use cost of the image restoration technology and improves the working efficiency.

title: Image data analysis processing system and method based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to an image data analysis processing system and method based on artificial intelligence, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a multi-dimensional coordinate module, a feature training module, a difference direction module, a training analysis module and a position correction module, wherein the multi-dimensional coordinate module is used for recording the coordinates of an instruction block, extracting a vector feature set, the feature training module is used for constructing an image recognition network model, the difference direction module is used for recognizing an offset instruction block, the training analysis module is used for judging the semantics of the offset instruction block, and the position correction module is used for correcting the position of the instruction block.

title: Method, apparatus and computer readable storage medium for determining placement scheme of object
description: The present disclosure provides a method, device and computer-readable storage medium for determining a placement scheme for an object. The method may include: obtaining object information and container state information; based on the object information and the container state information, using a deep reinforcement learning algorithm to determine initial placement information, the initial placement information is used to represent a set of initial placement schemes for the current object; based on the container state information, using another algorithm different from the deep reinforcement learning algorithm to determine feasible placement information, the feasible placement information is used to represent a set of feasible placement schemes for the current object; based on the initial placement information and the feasible placement information, determining a final placement scheme for the current object, wherein the final placement scheme is a placement scheme shared by a set of initial placement schemes and a set of feasible placement schemes.

title: Method and system for discovering social interaction group in video based on environment-aware network
description: The present application provides a method and system for discovering social interaction groups in videos based on an environment-aware network, including: the environment-aware network designs two types of environment-aware visual cues to represent factors affecting social interaction; scene-aware visual cues, using a 3D network to extract input video segment features as visual representations, and using an encoder to extract spatial-temporal features; human-aware visual cues, using bounding boxes and regions of interest as visual representations of gesture openness, orientation, and position that affect interaction in psychology; extracting distance features from bounding boxes, extracting personal features from regions of interest, and using distance features and personal features as visual representations of human environments; fusing spatial-temporal features, distance features, and personal features to obtain high-order social interaction intensity features, and obtaining an interaction intensity matrix between people. The present application borrows from psychology to discover social interactions from a more essential perspective, and uses deep learning methods to quantify the intensity of interactions between people.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle aerial image target detection method based on improvement YOLOv7
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of deep learning, and particularly relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle aerial image target detection method based on improvement YOLOv. The invention comprises the following steps: s1, preprocessing VisDrone2019 data sets, and converting VisDrone2019 data set format into YOLO format; s2, constructing YOLOv a network model, and improving a network framework and a loss function of YOLOv; s3, training an improved YOLOv model; s4, testing the improved model by using the test set. According to the invention, a small target detection layer is added, the original three-scale detection is upgraded to four-scale detection, and a smaller anchor frame is arranged to cope with the change of a multi-scale target, so that the detection precision of the small target is improved; a Triplet Attenion module is embedded in a backhaul feature extraction network, various feature information is fully fused by utilizing an efficient attention mechanism, and the accuracy of small targets in a dense scene is improved; and the WIoUv1 loss function is adopted to replace CIoU loss function, so that the losses of different target scales are balanced better, the positioning prediction of the small target is emphasized, and the detection precision of the small target is improved.
