title: Alumina dissolution rate measurement method and related device under low temperature and low pressure environment
description: The invention discloses a method for measuring the dissolution rate of alumina in a low-temperature and low-pressure environment and a related device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time measurement data in the alumina dissolution process in a low-temperature low-pressure environment; the measurement data comprise data such as flow rate, caustic ratio and liquid level; extracting strong characteristic production data related to the dissolution rate of alumina according to the real-time measurement data; dividing the strong feature production data into a plurality of single channel time series data; wherein each single channel processes time series data of the same variable; inputting a plurality of single-channel time series data into an alumina dissolution rate network model, and predicting to obtain the alumina dissolution rate in the low-temperature low-pressure dissolution process; the alumina leaching rate network model is a generated pre-training transducer network, and adopts multi-head attention and multi-layer perceptron freezing strategies. The method reduces the calculation cost and improves the prediction precision by freezing the transducer multi-head attention and the single-channel variable processing method.

title: Process for aiding in detection of migration bodies within a fuel assembly
description: The present invention relates to a process for assisting the detection of migratory bodies within a fuel assembly of a nuclear power plant, more specifically on an anti-debris grid of a lower end piece of said assembly, during which process at least one camera is controlled in the direction of said assembly and the image stream recorded by said at least one camera is directed to a human-machine interface comprising at least one screen allowing a first operator to view said video image stream, characterised in that said process comprises a first step of detecting said migratory bodies using an image recognition algorithm, and at least a second step of alerting said operator if said algorithm has detected the potential presence of at least one migratory body.

title: Method and system for predicting interaction of peptide and protein and corresponding binding residues
description: The invention discloses a prediction method of peptide-protein interaction and corresponding binding residues, which comprises the steps of obtaining peptide-protein interaction and corresponding interaction site information and constructing a data set; calculating the multi-source sequence characteristics of the peptide and the protein; constructing peptide residue characteristics, protein residue characteristics, peptide sequence characteristics and protein sequence characteristics, and mapping the characteristics to a unified characteristic dimension space to obtain corresponding feature vectors; constructing a peptide-protein pair interaction diagram; constructing a peptide-protein interaction and corresponding binding point prediction model and training; and (3) carrying out actual peptide-protein pair interaction results and prediction of residue sites where interaction occurs by adopting a trained peptide-protein interaction and corresponding binding site prediction model. The invention also discloses a system for realizing the interaction between the peptide and the protein and the prediction method of the corresponding binding residues. The invention has higher reliability and better accuracy.

title: Intelligent detection method and system for emergencies in tunnel in operation
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of intelligent detection of tunnel dangers, and in particular to an intelligent detection method and system for emergencies in a running tunnel, the method comprising: real-time acquisition of videos in the tunnel and radar point clouds of vehicles in the tunnel; information fusion processing of the videos and radar point clouds to obtain information to be detected; inputting the information to be detected into a preset detection model, and outputting the detection result of emergencies in the tunnel, wherein the detection model is obtained by training with a training set, the training set includes traffic monitoring videos and pictures containing traffic events, and the detection model is constructed based on a deep learning network. The present invention can solve the problems of passive perception of tunnel traffic events, low handling efficiency, lack of intelligent management and control, and improve the safety and traffic efficiency of highway tunnel operation.

title: RNA-seq and ATAC-seq data integration analysis method based on domain adaptation model
description: A method for integrating and analyzing RNA-seq and ATAC-seq data based on a domain adaptation model, denoted as scBonder, includes the following steps: S1, scBonder uses annotated scRNA-seq data to warm up the instance adaptation network of domain adaptation to obtain the initial embedding and cell type prediction of scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq cells; S2, scBonder uses a Gaussian mixture model to model the reliability of scATAC-seq data; S3, based on the estimated reliability, scBonder calculates ATAC prototypes as the weighted average of scATAC-seq cells and aligns them with RNA prototypes for integration; S4, after each iteration, scBonder selects the most reliable scATAC-seq cells and merges them with the currently predicted labels into the annotated data; S5, repeats the above steps S1-S5 until the model converges, so as to integrate more ATAC cells, thereby obtaining the final data integration and label transfer results. This method can more accurately capture the correlation between the two data modalities, thereby more effectively performing integrated analysis.

title: Intelligent question answering method and system based on large model and knowledge base
description: The embodiment of the present invention provides an intelligent question-answering method and system based on a large model and a knowledge base, which relates to the field of computer technology. The method includes: receiving user input, generating a user question according to the user input; generating multiple similar user questions of the user question through a generative large model, and generating a user question set according to the user question and multiple similar user questions; vectorizing the user questions in the user question set to obtain user question vectors; performing similarity matching on the user question vectors with knowledge text vectors in the knowledge base to obtain knowledge recall results; wherein the knowledge text vectors include a first knowledge text vector obtained based on a question-answer pair and a second knowledge text vector obtained based on a data document fragment; generating a question answer according to the knowledge recall result. The intelligent question-answering method and system based on a large model and a knowledge base provided by the embodiment of the present invention improves the accuracy, comprehensiveness and reliability of questions and answers.

title: Lightweight remote sensing image salient target detection method based on convolution
description: The invention discloses a convolution-based lightweight remote sensing image salient target detection method, which reduces parameters and calculation complexity by using a convolution neural network subjected to lightweight modification and improves the reasoning speed of the network; enhancing the encoder characteristics in spatial and channel dimensions, respectively, by using enhancement modules to include more accurate information; and gradually fusing the enhanced features through a decoder module, and recovering the feature map scale to obtain a final prediction map. The model has smaller parameter quantity and calculation complexity, reduces the demand on calculation resources, accelerates the reasoning speed, can meet the demand of real-time operation on edge equipment, and generates a remote sensing image saliency prediction graph more accurately.

title: SAAS platform management method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present invention provides a SAAS platform management method, device, electronic device and storage medium, the SAAS platform management method comprising: obtaining a SAAS application set in a target sales area of a SAAS platform; obtaining first historical sales data and first historical sales rules of a first SAAS application in the target sales area; determining the future sales data of the first SAAS application in the target sales area through a SAAS application sales prediction model according to the first historical sales data and the first historical sales rule; and according to the future sales data, performing component editing on the application component of the first SAAS application based on event-driven, to obtain a second SAAS application, wherein the SAAS application sales prediction model is obtained by training an RNN neural network. The beneficial effects of the present invention are: improving the management efficiency of the SAAS platform, and improving the accuracy of the sales enablement of the SAAS application in response to sales events.

title: A method and system for predicting harmful biological disasters in rice planting areas
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image recognition, and discloses a method and a system for predicting pest disasters in a rice planting area, which are used for improving the accuracy of pest disasters prediction in the rice planting area. The method comprises the following steps: collecting image data of a target rice planting area through a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles to obtain a rice image set, and collecting environment parameters of the target rice planting area to obtain an environment parameter set; image denoising is carried out on the rice image set to obtain a denoised image set, and time sequence filling is carried out on the environment parameter set to obtain a time sequence parameter set; extracting physical characteristics of pests from the denoising image set to obtain a morphological characteristic set of the pests; inputting the time sequence parameter set into a decision tree model for extracting environmental characteristics to obtain an environmental characteristic set; inputting the pest morphology feature set into a pest identification model to identify pest information, so as to obtain a pest information set; and predicting the disaster grade of the target rice planting area to obtain a target disaster grade, and generating a disaster treatment strategy according to the target disaster grade.

title: Congestion control method, congestion control model training method, switch and medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of congestion control technology, and in particular to a congestion control method and a congestion control model training method, a switch and a medium. The current feature data of a target switch port and each scheme to be evaluated are obtained; the current feature data and each scheme to be evaluated are input into a target congestion control model, and the evaluation results corresponding to each scheme to be evaluated of the target switch port at the current moment are output; according to the evaluation results corresponding to each scheme to be evaluated, the target scheme corresponding to the target switch port at the current moment is determined, so as to solve the data congestion problem of the target switch port based on the target scheme. The target scheme to be evaluated corresponding to the target switch port at the current moment is determined based on the current feature data of the target switch port, ensuring that the data congestion problem in the data center network can be solved based on the target scheme to be evaluated.

title: A method and system for active thermal management control of engineering machinery based on deep learning
description: The invention provides a method and a system for controlling active heat management of engineering machinery based on deep learning.

title: Image definition labeling method, evaluation model training method and related equipment
description: The application provides an image definition labeling method, an evaluation model training method and related equipment, wherein the image definition labeling method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image set which is not marked with image definition and a second image set which is marked with image definition; performing image degradation processing on each first image in the first image set to obtain a degraded image of each first image; training a preset image classification model based on each first image and the degradation image of each first image to obtain an image definition comparison model; determining the definition level between each first image and each second image in the second image set based on the image definition contrast model; and determining the image definition of each first image based on the definition level between each first image and each second image and the image definition of each second image so as to mark each first image. The method and the device realize image definition labeling based on subjective evaluation and improve labeling efficiency.

title: A method and device for constructing an adaptive neural network model
description: The present invention proposes a method and device for constructing an adaptive neural network model, which solves the problem of efficient adaptive selection of neurons in a neural network under complex conditions. According to the input sequence, a basic unit corresponding to the input sequence data is obtained, thereby completing the construction and training optimization of the chain generative neural network model. The adaptive neural network model proposed in the present invention improves the training and reasoning efficiency of the model, reduces the mutual interference between model parameters, and enables the model to have the neurons required for adaptive selection.

title: Cooperative control method for wind power plant participation regional power grid frequency modulation based on non-dominant sequencing whale algorithm
description: The invention discloses a cooperative control method for wind power plant participation regional power grid frequency modulation based on a non-dominant sequencing whale algorithm, which comprises the following specific steps: firstly, a multi-source cooperative control model considering a wind power plant and a traditional water-fire motor group to participate in power grid frequency modulation is constructed, and the wind power plant is utilized to further improve the dynamic response capability of a regional power grid so as to balance two influencing targets of minimizing deviation between a power regulation command value and a power response value and minimizing total frequency modulation mileage expenditure. And then, acquiring the pareto front by NSWOA with the frequency modulation mileage price and the total power response deviation as objective functions, and designing an ash target decision method to objectively select a compromise solution by an entropy weight-based method. Finally, NSWOA until convergence is completed, the optimal power allocation scheme can be obtained. The method is used for solving the problem of real-time total adjustment power distribution between the wind turbine generator and the traditional hydro-thermal power generation unit, and improving the dynamic response capability and economic benefit of the wind turbine generator participating in frequency modulation of the lower regional power grid.

title: Graphical user interface rendering management through voice-driven computing infrastructure
description: Graphical user interface rendering management through a voice-driven computing infrastructure is disclosed. Managing rendering of a graphical user interface is provided. The system receives a data packet comprising an input audio signal. The system determines an application identifier and a query. The system provides a query to the application to cause the application to generate a second query for transmission to the third party server and to identify a response to the query. The system intercepts the response and generates a keyword based on the response. The system uses the keywords to select a digital component, performs a deduplication process and determines to add the digital component to the response. The system constructs a display output using a graphical user interface template that integrates a plurality of responses generated by the application with the digital component and provides the display output to the computing device for rendering.

title: Warehouse monitoring and early warning method and system, and electronic equipment
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of warehouse monitoring and early warning scheme design, and specifically to a warehouse monitoring and early warning method and system, and electronic equipment. The method comprises: fixing a depth camera and an infrared thermal imaging camera at the same position in space, using the depth camera and the infrared thermal imaging camera to simultaneously take pictures of the target warehouse area at preset time intervals, and obtaining the current frame depth image and the current frame infrared thermal imaging grayscale image of the target warehouse area; analyzing the image to timely discover the fire area at the early stage of the fire, and analyzing whether there are organisms in a dangerous environment, and issuing a timely warning when the organism is close to the fire area, which greatly simplifies the hardware system and does not require complex algorithm modeling, greatly improves the intelligence, safety and availability of warehouse monitoring and early warning, and greatly expands the application scenarios of the present invention.

title: A method and system for screening improved varieties for increasing corn yield
description: The application discloses an improved variety screening method and system for corn unit yield improvement, and relates to the technical field of agriculture. Wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first multispectral image, a second multispectral image and a third multispectral image of corn seeds to be screened; converting the time domain frequency domain signal of the attenuated total reflection spectrum and extracting absorbance parameters to obtain an absorbance spectrum; inputting multispectral image fusion data into a constructed convolutional neural network model comprising a multi-stage convolutional layer for model training, and obtaining a trained corn seed fine variety screening model; the parameters of the convolutional neural network model comprise a plurality of groups of convolutional kernel generation parameters; inputting multispectral image fusion data into a trained corn seed fine variety screening model to predict and screen fine varieties in corn seeds to be screened. The application realizes automatic screening of improved varieties in corn seeds.

title: A virtual scene interaction method and system
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of virtual interaction, and discloses a virtual scene interaction method and a virtual scene interaction system; comprising the following steps: acquiring current interaction instruction data of a user and related environment data, and preprocessing the current interaction instruction data of the user to obtain a fused interaction feature sequence; inputting the fusion interaction characteristic sequence into a pre-constructed time prediction model based on deep reinforcement learning to obtain a user interaction sequence in a future time period; according to the related environment data and the user interaction sequence, utilizing a pre-constructed probability graph model to obtain n virtual scene states in the future; and rendering corresponding virtual scene images based on n virtual scene states in the future, and transmitting the virtual scene images to the user terminal equipment, so that the interactive experience of the user is greatly improved.

title: Entity information extraction model training and entity information extraction method, device and equipment
description: The embodiment of the specification discloses a method, a device and equipment for training an entity information extraction model and extracting entity information. The entity may be personal information of identity. Acquiring a plurality of text samples and sample tags thereof; each text sample comprises a plurality of text units which are arranged in sequence, and a sample label of each text sample represents entity information actually contained in the text sample; and taking each text sample as a model input, taking the information extraction result of each text sample as a model output, and training the entity information extraction model according to the sample label of each text sample.

title: Intelligent design method and system for asphalt mixture mixing ratio
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent construction, in particular to an intelligent design method and system for asphalt mixture mixing ratio, wherein the method comprises the following steps: selecting basic asphalt category and asphalt mixture components according to asphalt construction quality targets; inputting the asphalt construction quality target and the basic asphalt category and the asphalt mixture component into an asphalt mixture proportioning model to generate a primary asphalt mixture proportioning scheme; extracting engineering environment data information, extracting data characteristics affecting an asphalt mixture proportioning scheme, and rectifying deviation of the primary asphalt mixture proportioning scheme according to the data characteristics; inputting the asphalt construction quality target and the asphalt mixture proportioning scheme into an asphalt mixture proportioning quality prediction model, and simulating the asphalt mixture proportioning scheme. According to the invention, the accuracy and construction quality of the proportioning scheme are improved, real-time optimization is realized to adapt to the changed construction environment, and the design and construction efficiency are improved.

title: Image stitching method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present application relates to the field of image processing technology, and provides an image stitching method, device, electronic device and storage medium. The method obtains at least two images to be stitched; performs corner point detection on each image to be stitched, and determines the feature points of each image to be stitched according to the corner point detection result; calculates the similarity between the feature points corresponding to at least two images to be stitched, and determines the matching points corresponding to each image to be stitched according to the similarity calculation result; stitches the at least two images to be stitched according to the matching points corresponding to at least two images to be stitched, wherein the matching points of each image to be stitched are determined based on the feature points of each image to be stitched, which reduces the amount of calculation for determining the matching points, realizes the rapid determination of the matching points of each image to be stitched, and avoids the problem of excessive calculation and excessive consumption of computing resources caused by directly determining the matching points based on all the pixel points of the image to be stitched.

title: Appearance inspection device, welding system, and appearance inspection method for welded part
description: The appearance inspection device (20) comprises: a shape measuring unit (21) for measuring the three-dimensional shape of the welded part (201); and a data processing unit (23) for processing the shape data and the sample shape data obtained by the shape measuring unit (21). The data processing unit (23) comprises: a first learning data set generation unit (26A) that generates a plurality of first learning data sets on the basis of the sample shape data; a second learning data set generation unit (26B) that generates a plurality of second learning data sets based on the plurality of first learning data sets; a judgment model generation unit (27) that generates a plurality of judgment models using the plurality of second learning data sets; and a first determination unit (28) for determining whether the shape of the welding site (201) is good or not, based on the shape data and one determination model.

title: Electromagnetic relay online fault detection method based on evidence reasoning
description: A degradation fault detection method for an electromagnetic relay contact system is proposed, including: selecting contact resistance, pull-in time, release time and overtravel time as characteristic data for relay fault detection according to the degradation fault mechanism of the relay contact system; constructing a triangular fuzzy membership function according to the fuzzy threshold of the characteristic data, obtaining the membership of the characteristic data to the relay working state, and expressing it as fault evidence; using a bidirectional long short-term memory recurrent neural network to fuse the fault evidence obtained from different characteristic data to obtain the fault credibility of the relay at the current moment; and obtaining the final relay fault detection result by iteratively fusing the fault evidence at the current moment and the history. The present invention establishes an optimization model based on correlation to optimize the fault threshold, so that the optimized threshold can be closer to reality; the bidirectional long short-term memory recurrent neural network reduces the loss of fault information; and the accuracy of fault detection is improved by iteratively fusing rules through evidence theory.

title: Low-redundancy inference method for surveillance video stream based on motion vector
description: The invention discloses a low redundancy reasoning method of a surveillance video stream based on a motion vector, which relates to the technical field of image processing and comprises the following steps: performing partial decoding on the acquired video stream, and extracting motion vector information from the frame characteristics after the partial decoding; inputting the motion vector information and the redundant feedback data characteristics into a moving object detector, and when a moving object exists, fully decoding the acquired video stream based on a video decoder to obtain a decoded image; performing region perception division on the decoded image based on a region MOR containing a moving object, and reducing space dimension redundancy to obtain one or more MOR boxes; reasoning the MOR box based on a self-adaptive reasoning algorithm to obtain a reasoning result, and combining the reasoning result with the decoded image to obtain image information after low redundancy reasoning; the time redundancy and the space redundancy existing in the reasoning result are fed back to the moving object detector through redundancy feedback; the low redundancy reasoning method improves the overall processing efficiency and speed.

title: Expressway interval speed calculation method based on vehicle feature matching
description: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic monitoring, and particularly discloses a highway interval speed calculation method based on vehicle feature matching, which comprises the following steps: establishing a speed measuring interval link table; extracting vehicle characteristics of a vehicle image; searching a target vehicle image acquired by the current video monitoring equipment according to the speed measurement interval link table, searching the next video monitoring equipment reached by the target vehicle, then predicting the reasonable time range of the target vehicle reaching the next video monitoring equipment, and searching the reasonable vehicle image acquired by the next video monitoring equipment within the reasonable time range; according to the vehicle characteristics of the target vehicle image, screening a matched vehicle image with the highest similarity value from the reasonable vehicle image, namely the target vehicle image; and calculating the running speed of the target vehicle between the two video monitoring devices. The invention improves the accuracy and reliability of speed calculation and provides an effective means for traffic management.

title: Intelligent loader conflict resolution method, system and storage medium
description: The present application discloses a solution, system and storage medium for intelligent loader conflict resolution, the method comprising the following steps: real-time collection of the planned trajectory data of each loader at the current moment, generating a graph data structure based on the planned trajectory data; inputting the graph data structure into the GCN graph convolutional neural network to obtain a comprehensive feature vector; using a feedforward neural network to process the comprehensive feature vector to predict the probability of conflict between loaders; using a conflict resolution strategy to adjust the loader based on the probability of conflict and task priority information to obtain updated planned trajectory data for the loader; wherein the task priority information is set based on the material remainder of the mixing plant. The present application can realize path conflict monitoring, intelligent decision-making and conflict resolution between loaders without the need for human intervention, and takes into account the possibility of collision while planning the path, thereby improving the safety of the loader.

title: Combustion simulation method based on physical information neural network coupling small flame model
description: The present invention discloses a combustion simulation method based on a physical information neural network coupled small flame model. The present invention can fully consider the detailed chemical reaction mechanism through the coupling of PINNs and small flame/process variable models; in this process, PINNs only need to learn the basic N-S equation and the equation of the small flame library control parameter, and can efficiently obtain the thermochemical state quantity and thermophysical property parameters such as temperature, component and viscosity/diffusion rate by searching in the small flame library through the control parameters, without solving the temperature/component transport equation and complex ODE calculation, reducing the number of PINNs learning equations and significantly reducing the difficulty of model training; in addition, the small flame library control parameters obtained through PINNs training can quickly obtain the full-field distribution of temperature and different components through post-processing interpolation, which can accurately and effectively solve the deficiency that the current PINNs cannot consider detailed mechanisms in combustion physics problems.

title: Training method and device for target detection model and monocular detection method and device
description: The present disclosure belongs to the field of computer vision, and specifically relates to a training method and device for a target detection model and a monocular 3D detection method and device. The training method of the detection model includes: obtaining spatiotemporally synchronized image data and point cloud data in a preset space, constructing a training data set for target detection using the image data as a sample, generating auxiliary training data based on the point cloud data, and adding it to the training data set; constructing a target detection neural network, the target detection neural network includes at least a 3D branch for performing 3D target detection, and a spatial embedding branch for mapping image features to an implicit coding space to generate an image feature vector; jointly training the target detection neural network based on the training data set, wherein the training of the spatial embedding branch includes adjusting the parameters of the target detection neural network to optimize the voxel occupancy prediction loss.

title: Expression recognition method, device, electronic device and readable storage medium
description: The disclosure relates to the technical field of computer vision, and provides an expression recognition method, an expression recognition device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be identified; inputting the image to be identified into an expression identification model, and processing the image to be identified in an interactive mode of a plurality of convolution processing modules and a plurality of channel attention modules of the expression identification model to obtain a first feature map of the image to be identified, a second feature map of the image to be identified and a first channel attention feature map of the image to be identified with different scales; carrying out fusion processing on the first channel attention feature map of the image to be identified, the first feature map of the image to be identified and the second feature map of the image to be identified to obtain a fusion feature map of the image to be identified; according to the fusion feature map of the image to be identified, the expression identification result of the image to be identified is determined, the problem of low expression identification accuracy in the prior art is solved, and the expression identification accuracy and robustness are effectively improved.

title: Dehydration drying device on-line monitoring system and method for dimethylethanolamine
description: The present application relates to the field of dehydration and drying, and specifically discloses an online monitoring system and method for a dehydration and drying device for dimethylethanolamine. The system first obtains an operation video of the dehydration and drying device for dimethylethanolamine collected by a camera, pressure values of the dehydration and drying device for dimethylethanolamine collected by a pressure sensor at multiple predetermined time points, and liquid level values of the dehydration and drying device for dimethylethanolamine collected by a liquid level sensor at multiple predetermined time points, and then uses deep learning technology to perform feature extraction and correlation analysis on the three. Finally, a classifier is used to determine whether to issue a safety warning for the dehydration and drying device for dimethylethanolamine, so as to have a more comprehensive understanding of the operation of the device, thereby timely discovering abnormal situations, improving the response speed to safety issues, and then accurately determining whether there are safety hazards.

title: Demand response potential evaluation method based on multi-scale load characteristic image
description: The invention discloses a demand response potential evaluation method based on a multi-scale load characteristic portrait, which specifically comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring user load data, processing the load data and extracting features, and establishing a multi-scale load feature set based on the extracted features; step 2, constructing a user portrait by utilizing the multi-scale load feature set; and 3, carrying out load demand response potential evaluation on the user image based on DGMMs algorithm and GEM algorithm. The method and the system remarkably improve the accuracy and efficiency of the evaluation of the demand response potential of the industrial user, accurately describe the electricity utilization behavior of the user, and realize the high-precision matching of the load prediction and the dispatching.

title: Method and device for managing sea area space data by dynamic remote sensing monitoring
description: The present invention discloses a method and device for managing marine spatial data by dynamic remote sensing monitoring, which relates to the field of marine disaster management. The method includes: extracting the first historical marine disaster time series; performing time series feature analysis; issuing a remote sensing monitoring instruction when the target marine disaster rate reaches a predetermined probability threshold; activating multiple remote sensing devices to perform multi-source remote sensing feature monitoring to obtain a predetermined remote sensing time series; matching the first remote sensing resource and the first remote sensing environment at the first remote sensing time; using the first coefficient obtained by weighting the first remote sensing resource with the coefficient of variation as a weight, adjusting the first remote sensing environment to obtain a first effective remote sensing environment; analyzing and verifying the target marine disaster rate to obtain the target effective marine disaster rate; and performing marine regulation and management. The method solves the technical problem that the existing marine spatial data management is insufficient in terms of the balance between the ecological environment and resource exploitation, and achieves the technical effect of achieving a dynamic balance between the ecological environment and resource exploitation.

title: Frame detection for object attachment
description: This disclosure describes techniques for determining bounding boxes. An image may be received. The X-frame, Y-frame, and normal frame may be image-based using a first neural network. At least one planar region may be detected from the image using a second neural network. Each vanishing point in the at least one planar area may be performed vanishing point detection. The output of the first neural network may be fused with the result of vanishing point detection. A depth value for each pixel in at least one plane corresponding to the at least one plane region may be determined based at least in part on the result of the fusing. The location of the bounding box may be determined based at least in part on the depth value of each pixel in the at least one plane.

title: Fracturing parameter optimization method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a fracturing parameter optimization method, a fracturing parameter optimization device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target initial value of a fracturing parameter of a target shale gas well, wherein the fracturing parameter is a main factor influencing the yield of the shale gas well; determining a sample database of the shale gas well, constructing a fracturing parameter optimization model based on the sample database and a preset model, wherein the preset model at least comprises two basic models for model training, the sample database comprises a historical initial value and a historical optimization value of fracturing parameters, and the fracturing parameter optimization model is used for outputting an optimization value of the fracturing parameters after optimizing the initial value of the fracturing parameters; and inputting the target initial value of the fracturing parameter into a fracturing parameter optimization model to obtain a target optimized value of the fracturing parameter of the target shale gas well. According to the method, the initial value of the fracturing parameter is optimized through the fracturing parameter optimization model to obtain the optimized value of the fracturing parameter, so that the fracturing parameter is accurately optimized, and the efficiency of fracturing design work is improved.

title: A method for predicting wind power in a wind farm
description: The present invention discloses a method for predicting wind power in a wind farm, which relates to the field of data prediction, and includes: S1, establishing a mapping relationship between the initialization weight of a BP neural network and the puma position of an improved puma optimization algorithm; S2, optimizing the initialization weight of the BP neural network using the improved puma optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal solution for the initialization weight; S3, inputting the optimal solution for the initialization weight obtained in S2 into the BP neural network to obtain an efficient BP neural network, using the obtained BP neural network to predict wind power data in the wind farm, and outputting the predicted value of the wind power data. Since nonlinear weight factors, adaptive optimal guidance strategies and reflection strategies are introduced into the puma algorithm, the global search capability of the algorithm in the optimization process is enhanced, effectively avoiding the problem of falling into a local optimal trap, thereby improving the accuracy and stability of the algorithm in wind power prediction.

title: Trace intention classification method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present application provides a trajectory intention classification method and device, electronic device and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining operating environment data, wherein the operating environment data is data used to characterize the operating environment of the target operating device; extracting trajectory information from the operating environment data, wherein the trajectory information is used to indicate the instantaneous state of the dynamic obstacle; determining multiple target trajectory samples based on the trajectory information, wherein each target trajectory sample is used to indicate the trajectory of the corresponding target dynamic obstacle; and obtaining the trajectory intention classification result of the target trajectory sample by clustering the target trajectory samples. Through the present application, it is possible to effectively overcome the technical problems existing in the related art that the rules of different behavioral intention modes are manually defined in advance, which introduces human factors and is limited by human experience and domain knowledge.

title: Lumbar osteoporosis diagnosis method, device and equipment
description: The application provides a lumbar osteoporosis diagnosis method, a lumbar osteoporosis diagnosis device, lumbar osteoporosis diagnosis equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The lumbar osteoporosis diagnosis method comprises the following steps: acquiring lumbar X-ray images; inputting the lumbar vertebra X-ray image into a preset osteoporosis diagnosis model, and outputting an osteoporosis diagnosis result; wherein, the osteoporosis diagnosis result comprises: osteoporosis, osteopenia and normals; the osteoporosis diagnosis model is obtained through model training and comprises a fusion context converter module, and texture features, detail information and structural morphological features are extracted on a multi-scale information weighted fusion value feature map. According to the embodiment of the application, the accuracy of lumbar osteoporosis diagnosis can be improved.

title: Automatic guided vehicle dispatching method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The application belongs to the technical field of automatic guided vehicle dispatching and discloses an automatic guided vehicle dispatching method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring task information and running state and position information of an automatic guided vehicle, distributing target tasks in the task information to the automatic guided vehicle with the smallest distance and in an idle state according to the position information, generating a corresponding running path, and generating a priority regulation scheme according to the number of the automatic guided vehicles in a running state in a neighborhood and the preset size relation of the smallest density by a clustering algorithm based on density, and when occupied route points exist in the running path, designing a local obstacle avoidance route by an A star search algorithm; through a density-based clustering algorithm and an A star searching algorithm, a running path is generated, and a priority regulation and control scheme and a local obstacle avoidance route are designed, so that the automatic guided vehicle is scheduled, and the scheduling efficiency of the automatic guided vehicle is improved.

title: Knowledge graph relation prediction method based on sub-graph relation information
description: The invention provides a knowledge graph relation prediction method based on sub graph relation information, which relates to the technical field of machine learning, and the method is that a knowledge graph sub graph is obtained by analyzing relation link conditions of entity data; analyzing and fusing the position features of the entity and the neighborhood relation features of the entity based on the knowledge graph subgraph to obtain initial representation feature data with enhanced information; inputting the initial representation feature data into a representation feature prediction model to obtain representation feature data; carrying out path analysis on the knowledge graph subgraph by using a biased random walk method to obtain path characteristic data of the knowledge graph subgraph; and based on the entity data, the representation feature data and the path feature data, comprehensively calculating by utilizing a triplet scoring function to obtain a knowledge graph relationship prediction result, and completing the prediction of the knowledge graph relationship. The method solves the problem that the existing prediction model based on the subgraph has poor robustness to the sparse subgraph.

title: Data testing method based on terahertz spectrum
description: The present invention is a data testing method based on terahertz spectroscopy, comprising the following steps: sample preparation; carried out by a sample preparation system, the sample preparation system comprising an automated sample preparation device, a sample pressing device, and an RFID label printer; sample measurement; carried out by a sample testing system, the sample testing system comprising a fully automated detector; sample measurement data testing; carried out by a data system, the data system comprising a data import module, a data processing module, a data analysis module, a data visualization module, and a report generation module. The present invention can significantly improve the overall efficiency and accuracy of terahertz spectral data acquisition and analysis, effectively improve the overall level of standardized acquisition and analysis of terahertz spectral data, and provide more efficient and reliable technical support for scientific research and practical applications.

title: Incremental target detection method, device, equipment and medium based on fine response distillation
description: This invention discloses an incremental target detection method, apparatus, device, and medium based on fine-grained response distillation. This method, while the target detector learns new target categories end-to-end, maintains the detector's detection capability for previously learned target categories by selecting fine-grained knowledge distillation regions and applying different knowledge distillation strategies to different regions. This allows target detectors, originally only applicable to fixed categories, to adapt to situations where the number of detectable categories is constantly increasing, improving the target detector's continuous learning capability and better adapting to dynamically changing real-world scenarios. It enhances the detector's ability to retain knowledge of existing categories when learning new categories, improving the continuous learning capability of conventional target detectors in real-world dynamic scenarios. Simultaneously, it expands the adaptability of conventional detectors to dynamically growing detectable categories, broadening the application scenarios of target detectors, improving the efficiency of incremental learning, and enabling further application to incremental target detection in specific business scenarios.

title: Method for analyzing monitoring influence of external input signal on infrared Fresnel lens
description: The invention discloses a method for analyzing the influence of an external input signal on monitoring an infrared Fresnel lens, relates to the field of control engineering, and solves the problems of noise interference, weak real-time performance and fixed monitoring parameters in the accuracy and reliability of the influence analysis of the external input signal on the monitoring of the infrared Fresnel lens. The method comprises: (S1) collecting an external input signal; (S2) preprocessing the converted sound signal by a data processor; (S3) analyzing frequency spectrum characteristics; (S4) extracting time domain characteristics; (S5) establishing an influence model; (S6) training and verifying the model; (S7) adjusting the detection angle and direction in real time; using the influence model to predict the angle and direction of the infrared Fresnel lens to be adjusted, and adjusting the position of the infrared Fresnel lens in real time by a feedback control algorithm PID and a motor drive control, thereby realizing an analysis method for dynamically monitoring the infrared Fresnel lens based on an external signal.

title: Method and system for migrating arbitrary picture style based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The invention provides a method and a system for migrating any picture style based on deep reinforcement learning, which relate to the field of picture processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a deep reinforcement learning model, wherein the deep reinforcement learning model at least comprises an actor network, a critic network and an executor network; building a training set; training the deep reinforcement learning model through a training set and a total loss function, wherein the total loss function at least comprises a content loss function, a style loss function and a multi-stage stylized comparison loss function; acquiring a content picture to be migrated and a style picture corresponding to the content picture to be migrated; the method has the advantages that through the trained deep reinforcement learning model, the pictures after style migration corresponding to the content pictures to be migrated are generated based on the content pictures to be migrated and the style pictures corresponding to the content pictures to be migrated, and the efficiency of style migration of any picture is improved.

title: Concrete crack detection method and device
description: The invention discloses a concrete crack detection method and a concrete crack detection device, comprising the steps of acquiring a to-be-detected concrete crack image, and inputting the to-be-detected concrete crack image into a preset concrete crack detection model, wherein the preset concrete crack detection model comprises a feature extraction network and a feature classification network; carrying out edge texture feature extraction and feature fusion on the concrete crack image to be detected by adopting a feature extraction network, and outputting an edge texture fusion feature map; performing crack detection on the edge texture fusion feature map through a feature classification network, and outputting a concrete crack detection result; the technical problem of poor accuracy of concrete crack detection caused by insufficient feature extraction capability of the existing concrete crack detection technology based on the digital image technology is solved.

title: Power grid fault treatment strategy generation and update method, system, equipment and medium
description: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a medium for generating and updating a power grid fault treatment strategy, wherein a multi-objective optimization model is established according to collected power grid key data and power grid real-time fault data, and the model takes the minimized power supply gap quantity, pre-fault line load rate and total carbon emission quantity of a power grid system as an objective function, and simultaneously meets the safety and stability constraint of power grid operation; solving a multi-objective optimization model by utilizing an improved particle swarm algorithm to generate a power grid fault treatment strategy; and checking the generated power grid fault handling strategy, and if the checking is not passed, updating the power grid fault handling strategy by adopting a transfer learning method. The method and the system can dynamically generate and update the power grid fault treatment strategy, improve the timeliness, accuracy and adaptability of power grid fault response, improve the reliability and environmental friendliness of the power grid, and provide effective technical support for intelligent management and operation of the power grid.

title: Airport group flight time optimization method and system based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The present invention provides an airport group flight schedule optimization method and system based on deep reinforcement learning, including the following steps: pre-processing actual airport group flight operation data to construct a flight operation data set; Markov process modeling to determine the agent, state space, action space, reward function, and environment simulator; constructing an airport group flight schedule optimization model based on DQN; using the actual flight operation data set to verify the rationality of the optimization model. The airport group flight schedule optimization method of the present invention uses DQN to optimize the flight schedule, and uses a deep neural network to replace the traditional reinforcement learning table, combining the decision-making ability of reinforcement learning with the data analysis ability of deep learning, making the task of processing large-scale data space more efficient; DQN can perform long-term planning and consider future rewards. Compared with traditional heuristic algorithms, it can better avoid falling into local optimal solutions, which is conducive to guiding the optimization of actual flight operation times.

title: Advertisement delivery method and system based on artificial intelligence and used for media data fluctuation analysis
description: The invention discloses an advertisement putting method and a system based on artificial intelligence and media data fluctuation analysis, comprising the following steps: and (3) data acquisition: collecting data from a data source in real time; and (3) data processing: cleaning, normalizing and extracting features of the acquired data; AI analysis and prediction: analyzing and predicting the processed data by utilizing ChatGPT models and other machine learning algorithms, identifying the fluctuation condition of the data, predicting the click rate and the conversion rate, and generating a detailed analysis report; real-time anti-cheating: detecting and identifying abnormal behaviors and fraudulent behaviors in advertisement clicking and conversion in real time, and marking and filtering suspicious clicking and conversion; and (3) strategy adjustment: automatically adjusting marketing strategies and advertisement delivery schemes according to the analysis and prediction results of the AI, and applying the adjustment results to an advertisement platform; effect evaluation: and evaluating the regulated strategy effect, generating an effect report, and feeding back an evaluation result to the model called by the AI analysis and prediction step for model optimization.

title: Detection system for copper wire conductor section based on image recognition
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing and discloses a detection system of a copper wire conductor section based on image recognition, which comprises an image preprocessing module, an edge detection module, a section detection module and a defect evaluation module, wherein a copper wire conductor of a flat wire motor is shot through a high-resolution camera to obtain an original section image, and the original section image is preprocessed to obtain a preprocessed original section image; performing edge detection on the preprocessed original section image by adopting a Canny operator, and extracting a copper wire conductor section outline edge image to obtain a target detection image; inputting the target detection image into a section detection model, detecting defects in the section of the copper wire conductor, and outputting a section detection result; the method and the device can automatically and nondestructively evaluate the quality of the copper wire conductor section and improve the detection efficiency and accuracy.

title: Soil detection and recovery system, method and equipment based on artificial intelligence
description: The application discloses a soil detection and restoration system, method and equipment based on artificial intelligence, wherein the system comprises a soil data acquisition unit, an artificial intelligence analysis unit, a soil restoration decision unit and an execution feedback unit, wherein the soil data acquisition unit is used for constructing a target soil feature set, the artificial intelligence analysis unit is used for classifying the target soil feature set by utilizing a plurality of groups of four classification models and integrating classification results based on a weight coefficient maximizing total prediction probability to obtain detection evaluation results, the soil restoration decision unit is used for inputting the target soil feature set and the detection evaluation results into a large language model to generate a plurality of groups of soil restoration schemes with preset quantity, and the execution feedback unit is used for restoring the soil of a target area. By the scheme of the application, various data can be integrated, and real-time and accurate soil monitoring and recovery can be realized.

title: Block terminal fault detection method
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of distribution box fault detection, and in particular to a distribution box fault detection method. The method comprises the following steps: collecting sensor data of the distribution box through temperature and current sensors and performing multidimensional data preprocessing to obtain a multidimensional time series data set; constructing a high-dimensional feature vector of the multidimensional time series data set to obtain a high-dimensional feature vector set; performing dynamic feature extraction on the high-dimensional feature vector set to obtain a multidimensional feature matrix; obtaining historical distribution box fault case data; performing difference analysis of different feature subsets on the multidimensional feature matrix to obtain a feature difference statistic matrix. The present invention effectively solves the deficiencies of traditional methods in fault analysis capabilities, feature extraction and recognition capabilities by accurately identifying a variety of fault modes and accurately locating fault areas, and realizes intelligent, precise and efficient distribution box fault detection.

title: A method for determining an information propagation prediction model, an application method and a related device
description: The invention discloses a method for determining an information propagation prediction model, an application method and a related device, and relates to the field of information propagation prediction; respectively inputting the real social graph data and the real propagation graph data into a hyperbolic neural network to obtain the prediction output of the hyperbolic neural network; determining a first loss value according to the real social graph data, the real propagation graph data, the predicted output of the hyperbolic neural network and the determined first loss function; and optimizing the network parameters of the hyperbolic neural network according to the first loss value to obtain an information propagation prediction model. The method solves the problems of distortion of hierarchical structure modeling, missing of high-order interaction relation of the user and poor smoothness of user characteristic representation of the cascade graph and the social graph in the prior method, thereby improving the accuracy of information propagation prediction.

title: Bayesian network training method, fault diagnosis method, device and terminal equipment
description: The application is applicable to the technical field of computers, and provides a Bayesian network training method, a fault diagnosis method, a device and terminal equipment, which comprise the following steps: determining a fault knowledge graph according to the mechanical structure relation of the target equipment and a fault event corresponding to the target equipment, converting the fault knowledge graph into a Bayesian network, and training the Bayesian network to obtain the target Bayesian network. The application can improve the accuracy of fault diagnosis.

title: Aircraft fault diagnosis method, model training method, device and computer equipment
description: The present application relates to an aircraft fault diagnosis method, a model training method, an apparatus, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises: obtaining the measurement information and other auxiliary information of the atmospheric data system and the inertial navigation system in the aircraft system, and constructing an atmospheric parameter model; constructing an unscented Kalman filter model of the atmospheric data system based on the atmospheric parameter model, and estimating the state of the atmospheric data system according to the unscented Kalman filter model; extracting the multidimensional new information and residual sequence of the unscented Kalman filter model; calling the pre-trained aircraft fault diagnosis model, and taking the multidimensional new information and residual sequence as input parameters to obtain the aircraft fault diagnosis result. The combination of model and data is conducive to timely and accurate diagnosis of aircraft atmospheric data system faults, and provides guarantee for the safe flight of the aircraft.

title: Three-dimensional vortex identification method based on local flow velocity
description: The present invention discloses a three-dimensional vortex identification method based on local flow velocity, which relates to the intersection of fluid mechanics and artificial intelligence technology. The method of the present invention includes S1, three-dimensional flow field characterization; S2, constructing a three-dimensional vortex identification standard; S3, constructing an input vector of a vortex identification model; S4, sampling in the three-dimensional flow field, and judging whether each sampling point is in a vortex area; S5, constructing a multi-task learning network model, and training and testing the model, using the model to perform binary classification on the vectors at each sampling point and obtain an optimized vortex identification model; S6, using the vortex identification model to perform vortex identification on the flow field to be tested. Based on the flow field theory, the present invention analyzes the relationship between flow velocity and vortices in the flow field, uses the physical relationship between local velocity and vortex area, designs a multi-task learning vortex identification network, and uses the model to realize vortex identification in the three-dimensional flow field, reducing the time required for calculating vorticity and improving the segmentation and identification efficiency of the three-dimensional flow field.

title: Intelligent analysis system for operation data of sound control lamp body
description: The invention relates to an intelligent analysis system for operation data of a sound control lamp body, which comprises the following components: the parameter analysis device is used for analyzing the predicted value of the consumed electric energy value and the predicted value of the turn-on frequency of the voice-controlled lamp body in a future time interval by adopting a single-layer neural network model based on the self-turn-off time of the voice-controlled lamp body, various associated information of the voice-controlled lamp body, various consumed electric energy values respectively corresponding to the voice-controlled lamp body in various historical time intervals and various turn-on times respectively corresponding to the voice-controlled lamp body; and the wireless reporting device is used for wirelessly reporting the analyzed predicted value to the big data management network element. According to the invention, the single-layer neural network model with the customized structure can be quoted, and the predicted value of the power consumption value and the predicted value of the turn-on frequency of the sound control lamp body in the future time interval can be analyzed simultaneously based on each item of basic information selected in a targeted manner, so that valuable reference information is provided for subsequent energy consumption management and life prediction.

title: Vital sign monitoring and bed state linkage system for prone position decompression bed
description: The present application discloses a vital sign monitoring and bed status linkage system for a prone decompression bed, which belongs to the field of clinical medical technology. The system includes the following modules: an intelligent vital sign analysis module, which collects and analyzes multiple vital sign data of patients in real time, and predicts the trend of vital sign changes in the short term; an adaptive bed adjustment control module, which generates the optimal bed adjustment plan based on the analysis results and executes it through the bed actuator to ensure the safety and continuity of the adjustment process; a dynamic parameter optimization module, which dynamically adjusts the bed change speed and safety threshold based on the changes in the patient's vital signs during the bed adjustment process to achieve the best balance between effect and safety; a human-computer interaction and alarm module, which provides a multi-modal operation interface to display system status information in real time, triggers an alarm in time when an abnormality or emergency is detected, and automatically executes preset emergency measures.

title: Day-ahead load prediction method and system based on MIC theory and monotonic value decomposition
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for day-ahead load forecasting based on MIC theory and monotonic value decomposition, which relates to the technical field of cascade hydropower dispatching, including obtaining a multi-source data set of a power grid in a target area, and filling in the gaps in the multi-source data set; analyzing characteristic parameters of the filled data, screening characteristic parameters to construct a data set; constructing a load forecasting model, and using the data set to train the load forecasting model; defining a loss function of the load forecasting model, and using the load forecasting model to perform load forecasting to obtain a load forecasting result. The present invention decomposes the original time series into three components: trend, cycle, and random, and adopts different filling strategies for missing values, thereby improving the accuracy of data filling, and introducing methods such as moving average and contemporaneous mean, which can better capture local trends and periodic characteristics, and estimate closer to the actual situation.

title: A double-protection energy storage cabinet and its fault detection system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power energy storage, and discloses a double-protection energy storage cabinet and a fault detection system thereof, wherein the double-protection energy storage cabinet comprises an energy storage monitoring module, a power supply module and a power supply module, wherein the energy storage monitoring module is used for monitoring the state of an energy storage system of the double-protection energy storage cabinet; the system comprises a double-protection monitoring module, a temperature prediction module, a fault response module, an energy storage control module, a double-protection control module and a monitoring display module, wherein the double-protection monitoring module is used for carrying out health assessment on a double-protection system of a double-protection energy storage cabinet, the temperature prediction module is used for carrying out temperature prediction of the energy storage system, the fault response module is used for carrying out fault response of the double-protection energy storage cabinet and sending out alarm signals and fault response instructions, the energy storage control module is used for executing the fault response instructions and controlling operation of the energy storage system, the double-protection control module is used for executing the fault response instructions and controlling operation of the double-protection system, and the monitoring display module is used for visually displaying state information of the double-protection energy storage cabinet. The invention provides a solution for improving the safety, reliability and operation and maintenance efficiency of the energy storage system, and has important practical significance for promoting the application and development of energy storage technology.

title: Combined extraction method, device and storage medium for entity and entity relation
description: The present application discloses a joint extraction method, device and storage medium for entities and entity relationships, including: determining text information to be processed; based on the text information to be processed, determining first word vectors corresponding to each word in the text information to be processed; determining first label vectors corresponding to each first word vector, wherein the first label vector is used to indicate the entity type corresponding to each word; based on each first label vector, generating a corresponding second label vector, wherein the second label vector further includes the semantic association between the first label vectors on the basis of the first label vector; splicing the first word vector and the corresponding second label vector respectively, and generating multiple splicing vectors; and determining the entity relationship between the entities of the text information to be processed based on the multiple splicing vectors.

title: A method for identifying main transformer defect risks based on large model
description: The invention discloses a main transformer defect risk identification method based on a large model, in particular to the technical field of large models, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-modal data of a main transformer, preprocessing the multi-modal data, constructing a knowledge graph of the main transformer, deducing the running state and defect risk of the main transformer by using a machine learning method, constructing a multi-modal large model according to the preprocessed multi-modal data and the knowledge graph, introducing a multi-task learning frame to train defect identification and classification of the multi-modal large model, based on the output of the knowledge graph and the multi-mode large model, a fuzzy evaluation matrix is established according to the evaluation index of the risk state of the main transformer, the risk state of the main transformer is evaluated by combining an entropy weight fuzzy method, risk analysis is performed according to the evaluation result of the risk state of the main transformer, decision support is provided for maintainers according to the risk analysis, the accuracy of defect risk identification is effectively improved, and the problem that the model is not matched with the knowledge graph is avoided.

title: UAV hyperspectral remote sensing image feature extraction and recognition method and system
description: The invention belongs to the field of hyperspectral remote sensing image processing, and discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle hyperspectral remote sensing image feature extraction and recognition method and system based on MBS-TD3DAN, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing an unmanned aerial vehicle pasture hyperspectral remote sensing data set; performing dimension reduction and denoising on an image by using a Multi Band Selector (MBS) preprocessing method, and extracting a characteristic wave band; the data weight is marked through TRANSDENSE D-AttnNet (TD 3 DAN) models, the data characteristics are extracted through three dimensions of an object, a space and a spectrum, the operations such as conversion, mapping and filtering are carried out on the data by using a self-attention mechanism, the transmission of the intensive convolution layer reinforcing characteristics is used, and finally high-precision identification is realized. The invention has excellent performance in the identification task, can flexibly adjust and optimize different data sets, can efficiently identify the data sets in complex backgrounds or in multiple plant types, and has good expansibility.

title: Intelligent household environment data judging system
description: The present invention relates to a smart home environment data judgment system, comprising: an imaging processing mechanism installed in a kitchen working environment to perform photoelectric sensing processing on the kitchen working environment within a kitchen operation time interval, for acquiring and outputting a corresponding instant imaging signal; a judgment execution device, for using a feedforward neural network that has been trained multiple times to intelligently judge the type number of the image processing type that the instant imaging signal has passed through based on multiple environmental contents of the kitchen working environment and multiple visual information of the instant imaging signal. Through the present invention, an artificial intelligence model with a customized structure design can be used to perform intelligent analysis of the image processing type that the instant imaging signal has passed through the imaging processing mechanism based on various targeted screened basic data, thereby providing a reliable basis for identifying the authenticity of the content of the instant imaging signal from the kitchen working environment.

title: Bath stability monitoring method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present application belongs to the technical field of monitoring molten pool stability, and discloses a molten pool stability monitoring method, device, electronic device and storage medium. The method comprises: obtaining a molten pool image and a corresponding molten pool annotated image of an additively manufactured molten pool, constructing a molten pool image segmentation model according to the molten pool image and the corresponding molten pool annotated image, periodically obtaining a real-time molten pool image of the additively manufactured molten pool, and inputting the real-time molten pool image into the molten pool image segmentation model, extracting a molten pool segmentation image containing only the additively manufactured molten pool, calculating a molten pool stability value of the additively manufactured molten pool according to a molten pool stability judgment paradigm and the molten pool segmentation image, so as to monitor the molten pool stability of the additively manufactured molten pool in real time; calculating the molten pool stability value of the additively manufactured molten pool through the molten pool stability judgment paradigm and the molten pool segmentation image, so as to monitor the stability of the additively manufactured molten pool, thereby improving the judgment efficiency of the stability of the additively manufactured molten pool.

title: Infrared image colorization method based on attention mask
description: An infrared image colorization method based on attention mask, the infrared image is input into a preliminary mapping module to generate a preliminary color image, the preliminary color image is input into an attention mask module to generate a content mask, a foreground attention mask and a background attention mask; the foreground attention mask and the background attention mask are merged with the corresponding content mask to enhance the color and details of a specific area, and a target image is obtained at the same time; the cycle consistency loss of the mask generator is determined to ensure that the image generated after each input image is cycled can be restored to the original input image; the perceptual loss is determined to improve the perceptual quality of the generated image; and a color image is output. The present invention significantly improves the colorization effect of the important information contained in the foreground content of the infrared image while completing the infrared image colorization task, so that the detailed content of the infrared image after colorization can be more clearly and completely displayed.

title: Small target detection method and system
description: The invention discloses a small target detection method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a visible light image and an infrared light image; inputting the visible light image and the infrared light image into a pre-trained small target detection model, and outputting the detection result of the image; the processing steps of the small target detection model comprise: sequentially carrying out contrast enhancement and preliminary fusion on the visible light image and the infrared light image to obtain a preliminary fused image; performing progressive feature extraction and fusion on the preliminarily fused images to obtain an input feature map; and obtaining a detection result of the input characteristic diagram by using a detection head.
