The invention effectively solves the problem of image blurring caused by illumination value change during image extraction and fusion in the existing method by introducing bimodal enhancement and progressive feature extraction fusion; the bimodal enhancement technique enhances image features; the progressive feature extraction fusion technology remarkably improves the quality and definition of the fused image.

title: Digital human video generation method and system based on local key position enhancement
description: The invention discloses a digital human video generation method and system based on local key position enhancement, comprising the following steps: acquiring a monocular video and extracting a key point sequence; real-time drawing the key point sequence by using a real-time nerve semantic image drawing mode based on OPENGL to obtain a nerve semantic image sequence and an eye gazing image sequence; introducing a local discriminator for discriminating true and false of local features into StyleUNet network comprising a generator and an image quality discriminator to construct a multi-discriminator combined optimized countermeasure learning frame, constructing a normal sample and a difficult sample to perform two-stage countermeasure training on the countermeasure learning frame, and taking the generator as a video generation model after training is finished; and continuously generating digital human images based on the nerve semantic image sequence, the eye gazing image sequence and the introduced random noise by utilizing the video generation model, and adding audio to the continuous digital human images to obtain high-fidelity and time-sequence continuous digital human video generation.

title: Medical image digital watermark embedding encryption method and system
description: The present invention provides a medical image digital watermark embedding encryption method and system, the method comprising: extracting the feature vector of the medical image by using a convolutional neural network, performing a DCT transformation, selecting a number of coefficients after the DCT transformation to form a visual feature vector; performing an XOR operation on the visual feature vector and a chaotic matrix generated by a Henon chaotic map to obtain an encrypted feature vector; creating a QR code according to the watermark information of the medical image, combining the encrypted feature vector with the QR code to form a watermark image and a corresponding verification key; calculating the LBP value of the medical image, performing a continuous two-level decomposition of the medical image through an LWT transformation and a DWT transformation, and obtaining a watermarked medical image. The present invention integrates watermarking technology of chaotic encryption, cryptography and third-party concepts, enhances the watermark algorithm's ability to resist attacks, ensures the robustness and recovery ability of the algorithm, strengthens the security of the watermark information, and ensures that the watermark is invisible to the naked eye while ensuring the high fidelity of the medical image.

title: False face detection and tracing method based on feature level decoupling
description: The invention provides a false face detection and tracing method based on feature level decoupling, which is divided into a progressive fake feature extraction stage and a cross decoupling stage. Based on the extracted overall counterfeit characteristics, the counterfeit characteristics are further classified into common counterfeit characteristics and special counterfeit characteristics. The generalization capability of the depth fake detector can be effectively improved in the detection task species of the common fake features, and the overfitting of fake irrelevant features and method specific features is avoided. The special counterfeit feature can further enhance the traceability of counterfeit methods. In addition, the method introduces orthogonalization regularization penalty to further help disentangle and enhance the generalization ability of the decoupling feature. Experimental results show that the method has good detection and tracing performances, and provides a brand new view angle for human face counterfeiting detection and tracing tasks.

title: A method for constructing large model corpus for industrial data
description: The invention discloses a large model corpus construction method for industrial data, which comprises the following steps: 1) The industrial data is subjected to data integration by retrieving a local knowledge base, a database and a map, and data related to the industrial data are found out to obtain integrated industrial data; 2) Carrying out structural extraction on industrial data through an LLM large language model, carrying out map retrieval on the extracted entity, and sequencing retrieval results according to the correlation between the entity and the industrial data to obtain an industrial mechanism context; 3) Constructing a local related corpus as a vector library; after vectorizing the industrial data, searching similar vectors in a vector library; re-ordering the searched related texts according to the relevance, and outputting the re-ordered related texts to be used as a sample template for generating corpus; 4) And the integrated industrial data is converted into corpus through the LLM large language model by adopting the sample template and combining with the industrial mechanism context.

title: A spatiotemporal data-driven stability assessment method for island microgrids
description: The invention relates to a space-time data driven island micro-grid stability evaluation method, and belongs to the field of island micro-grid evaluation. The method comprises the steps of performing time sequence feature selection of operation state variable collection and stability evaluation; the method comprises the steps of improving a space-time adjacency matrix of the island micro-grid, and reflecting the source charge association state and the connection compactness in a system; modeling the space-time relationship of the island micro-grid nodes; the graph neural network is used as a basic algorithm, a attention mechanism is introduced to automatically distinguish the complex working condition interference caused by the flexible operation characteristic of the island micro-grid, and the self-adaptive importance weight of different nodes is given; the provided data-driven stability evaluation algorithm is constructed based on a graph neural network, an attention mechanism and an LSTM network time sequence prediction layer, comprises an offline training online application link, and can implement alarming when instability is judged. The method has the advantages of high evaluation speed, high accuracy, good reliability and the like, and can adapt to the factor interference such as noise and the like existing in the actual operation complex environment of the island micro-grid.

title: UAV monitoring method, system, electronic equipment and program product
description: The disclosure provides an unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring method, system, electronic equipment and program product, comprising the steps of obtaining a target area image, wherein the target area image comprises a flying target to be identified; reasoning the flying target image through a flying target recognition model to acquire a target recognition result of the flying target to be recognized, wherein the flying target recognition model comprises a lightweight model; and monitoring the flight target to be identified based on the target identification result of the flight target to be identified. The unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring method, system, electronic equipment and program product based on the neural network are used for identifying the target flying object through a deep learning algorithm, so that the problems of low accuracy, low efficiency and the like of the traditional methods such as machine learning, complex neural network and the like are solved; compared with other black flight monitoring and interference early warning methods, the method has the advantages of higher recognition speed, higher recognition precision, effective interference capturing accuracy and better ductility.

title: Electronic case file element recognition method and system based on Transformer framework
description: The invention provides a method and a system for cognizing electronic file case elements based on a transform framework, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step S1: simulating and generating multi-mode electronic file data; step S2: building an electronic file case element cognitive network model; step S3: determining a multi-task learning framework, setting a loss function for optimizing network parameters, outputting the loss function using respective tasks and optimizing targets for different tasks; step S4: pre-training an electronic file case element cognitive network model; step S5: performing fine tuning training by using the model after the pre-training; step S6: and (3) deriving a fine-tuning trained electronic file case element cognitive network model, and directly deploying the electronic file case element cognitive network model into a service or integrating the electronic file case element cognitive network model into a system for use. The method and the device can extract different key case elements according to different data forms and cases, and have better robustness and higher recognition accuracy.

title: Alfalfa weed detection method and system based on lightweight balance feature fusion
description: The present invention provides an alfalfa weed detection method and system based on lightweight balanced feature fusion, which belongs to the technical field of computer vision target detection. The method includes: deploying a lightweight hierarchical multi-path balanced feature fusion fine-grained alfalfa weed detection model on both a cloud server device and an image processing device; the cloud server device obtains an original image set, generates labels for the original images, and performs enhancement processing on each original image to obtain an enhanced image; a data set is established using the original images and the enhanced images, and a training set, a verification set, and a test set are divided based on samples in the data set; the cloud server device trains the fine-grained alfalfa weed detection model using the training set, verifies using the verification set, and evaluates the model performance using the test set; the cloud server device transmits the weight parameters of the optimized model to the image processing device; the image processing device updates the model using the weight parameters transmitted by the cloud server device, and performs real-time detection of alfalfa weeds on the images collected in real time.

title: An automatic generation method of assembly language for reconfigurable flexible assembly line
description: An automatic generation of an assembly language (A‑code) for a reconfigurable flexible assembly line, including: extracting geometry, topology and material information from a three-dimensional model of a product; constructing an assembly process knowledge graph, defining assembly objects, resources and programs; instantiating and storing data to form a knowledge base; using a community detection algorithm to divide subassemblies and simplify assembly sequence planning; generating an optimal assembly sequence based on subassemblies and a priority relationship matrix; optimizing assembly process allocation and assembly unit layout; formulating SWRL rules and SPARQL query statements; and generating A‑code by reasoning using semantic web tools. Automatic generation and verification of A‑code ensure program correctness. By automatically extracting assembly information directly from a three-dimensional model of a product and generating an assembly program, the present invention eliminates the step of manually rewriting the assembly program according to product changes in the traditional method, significantly shortens the time for assembly line reconstruction, improves production line stability and product quality, and improves production efficiency and the ability to respond to market changes.

title: Data quality assessment method based on convolutional neural network
description: The present invention discloses a data quality assessment method based on a convolutional neural network, including collecting target data, preprocessing the target data, performing time series anomaly recognition on the target data to obtain abnormal data, and obtaining assessment data according to the abnormal data; the assessment data includes first assessment data and second assessment data; the first assessment data characterizes the degree of deviation of the abnormal data; the second assessment data characterizes the time skewness of the abnormal data; multimodal classification is performed on the assessment data according to the deviation to obtain graded data, a quality function is constructed according to the graded number, a data quality assessment model is constructed according to the quality function, the data to be evaluated is input into the data quality assessment model, and the recognition result is output. This method can not only improve the accuracy of data quality assessment based on a convolutional neural network, but also has good interpretability, and can be directly applied to a data quality assessment system.

title: Optical neural network training method, device, equipment, medium and optical neural network chip
description: This invention relates to the field of photonic neural networks, disclosing a method, apparatus, device, medium, and optical neural network chip for training optical neural networks. The method includes steps S11: Under the current magnetic field condition, transmitting the optical signal of a training image through a metasurface structure of the optical neural network to simulate the optical weight parameters of the training image; the characteristic parameters of the metasurface structure are controlled by the magnetic field. Step S12: Transmitting the optical signal to the activation layer, and causing the activation layer to simulate the activation function of the neural network according to the optical weight parameters. Step S13: Determining the output error between the output result corresponding to the training image and the desired output result. Step S14: Adjusting the network parameters according to the output error. Step S15: Adjusting the magnetic field to change the polarization channel of the neural network, and then proceeding to S11 to obtain the neural network under different polarization channels. This invention provides a dynamically adjustable optical neural network to meet the needs of various tasks, improving flexibility and adaptability.

title: Efficient fine-granularity target identification method in high-resolution remote sensing image
description: The present invention discloses an efficient fine-grained target recognition method in high-resolution remote sensing images. In order to solve the problem that the position of geospatial objects is not considered during the target detection process, the fine-grained recognition of dense objects performs poorly and lacks the reliability and stability of multi-object recognition. The fine-grained object recognition method needs to mine finer-grained content for each object. The method steps are as follows: Step 1: By imposing a coarse-to-fine or repeated classification strategy, object positioning and fine-grained classification are combined to improve the recognition ability and representation granularity of object features. A fine-grained target recognition network is designed in HR-RSIs based on the coarse-to-fine recognition strategy to fully extract the fine-grained features of each target and correct the misclassification in the initial recognition. Step 2: An efficient fine-grained object recognition model from knowledge edge distillation to filter grafting is proposed, the purpose of which is to speed up the reasoning process while ensuring accuracy.

title: Traffic accident prediction method and device based on deep learning
description: The present invention provides a traffic accident prediction method and device based on deep learning, which relates to the field of deep learning technology, including: obtaining a monitoring video corresponding to a target traffic scene; extracting features from the monitoring video to obtain target image features; the target image features include RGB image global features, RGB image local features, depth image global features, and depth image local features; using a collaborative attention mechanism to obtain the correlation information between different features in the target image features, and based on the correlation information, fusing each feature in the target image features to obtain a target fusion feature; inputting the target fusion feature into a trained GRU network model, and outputting the predicted probability of a traffic accident corresponding to the target traffic scene. Through the cascade combination of collaborative attention layers, the complementary perception fusion of multiple features is achieved, and then the GRU module is used to predict whether a traffic accident will occur in the future, thereby reducing the occurrence of traffic accidents.

title: News text classification method and system based on deep learning
description: The present application discloses a news text classification method and system based on deep learning, which includes: performing word vector representation on the acquired news text to be classified to obtain an input matrix corresponding to the news text to be classified; extracting semantic features of the input matrix based on a long short-term memory network to obtain text semantic relations corresponding to the news text to be classified; performing convolution processing on the text semantic relations based on hole convolutions of different sizes to obtain multi-scale text features corresponding to the news text to be classified; performing pooling processing on the multi-scale text features, and classifying the multi-scale text features after pooling processing to obtain news text classification results. The present application aims to solve the technical problem of low accuracy of news text classification in the prior art.

title: Device, method and electronic equipment for determining lesion area based on medical images
description: The application discloses a focus area determining device and method based on medical images and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of medical science and technology. The focus area determining device based on the medical image comprises a first obtaining unit, a first determining unit and a second determining unit, wherein the first obtaining unit is used for obtaining a target medical image, the first determining unit is used for determining the probability that each pixel in the target medical image belongs to a focus area through a segmentation model, the segmentation model is obtained through training according to a reference image of a known focus sketching area, and the second determining unit is used for determining the focus area of the target medical image according to the probability that each pixel belongs to the focus area. The application solves the technical problem of inaccurate identification of the focus area in the prior art when the area with the focus possibly is identified by an automatic segmentation algorithm.

title: Visual fusion sensing method and system based on millimeter wave radar
description: The application relates to the technical field of vision fusion perception, and particularly discloses a vision fusion perception method and a system based on millimeter wave radar, which are used for acquiring an obstacle image acquired by a camera, dividing the obstacle image acquired by the camera into a foreground and a background by adopting a computer vision technology based on deep learning, respectively extracting the foreground characteristic and the background characteristic of the obstacle image, and fully understanding possible shielding relation in a traffic scene by carrying out joint perception analysis on the foreground characteristic and the background characteristic of the obstacle image, so that the type of the obstacle can be identified more accurately, the identification capability of the obstacle in a complex environment can be effectively enhanced, and the obstacle avoidance safety is improved.

title: Method for controlling load frequency of power system by deep reinforcement learning
description: The present invention provides a method for controlling the load frequency of an electric power system by using deep reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of electric power system control. The method comprises: constructing an electric power system model, wherein the electric power system model comprises a power generation unit, a power transmission network, a load unit, and a frequency control device; obtaining historical operation data of the electric power system, including load demand records, power generation output logs, and frequency fluctuations, and preprocessing the historical operation data of the electric power system to obtain processed historical operation data of the system; training a deep neural network model according to the processed historical operation data of the system, extracting key features of the historical operation data of the system, and predicting future load demand and frequency change trends to obtain prediction results. The present invention utilizes deep reinforcement learning to fuse the electric power system model to achieve accurate prediction and automatic real-time control of load frequency, and improve the stability and economy of the electric power system.

title: A modular design method and system for composite beam bridges with corrugated steel webs
description: The present invention relates to the field of computer-aided design, and in particular to a modular design method and system for a composite beam bridge with a corrugated steel web. A modular design system for a composite beam bridge with a corrugated steel web comprises: a module for constructing a required data set for a composite beam bridge with a corrugated steel web, a population set construction module, a fitness calculation module, a population set iterative update module, an optimal design parameter set output module for a composite beam bridge with a corrugated steel web, and a modular design module for a composite beam bridge with a corrugated steel web. The present invention simulates and generates the design parameters of a composite beam bridge with a corrugated steel web through a genetic algorithm to complete the automatic modular design of a composite beam bridge with a corrugated steel web; and a corresponding parameter variation probability value is set for each simulated design parameter of the composite beam bridge with a corrugated steel web, and the parameter variation probability value can also be adaptively adjusted according to the iterative process, thereby reducing the computational consumption in the middle and late stages of the iteration and improving the convergence speed in the middle and late stages of the iteration.

title: Debt collection and repayment reminder method and system based on large model multimodality
description: The invention relates to a multi-mode prompting and repayment reminding method and system based on a large model, which belong to the field of finance and comprise the steps of S1, obtaining repayment information, consumption information and active information of a customer, S2, analyzing the customer information obtained in the step S1 through a repayment evaluation large model, combining the latest information of a user by using a RAG technology to obtain a repayment reminding strategy of the customer, S3, generating corresponding reminding content according to the repayment reminding strategy, and sending the corresponding reminding content to the customer in a corresponding time node in combination with a corresponding channel in the repayment strategy. The invention has the advantages that the prompting text of the traditional fixed template is difficult to attract attention again at present that social media are more and the content is more and more abundant. The technology is not only extremely rich and novel in prompting content, but also combines a plurality of channels, can be used for prompting customers in a diversified manner, and is attractive to the customers, so that the repayment efficiency is greatly improved.

title: Scene graph-based text graph large model prompt word optimization method, electronic equipment and medium
description: This invention discloses a method, electronic device, and medium for optimizing prompt words in a large text-to-image model based on scene graphs. The method includes: acquiring a first prompt word and parsing it to obtain a first scene graph; inputting the first prompt word into a large text-to-image model to generate a corresponding first image; semantically aligning the first scene graph with the first image to obtain a second scene graph; inputting the first prompt word and the second scene graph into a pre-trained prompt word optimization model to output a second prompt word; further including: encoding the first prompt word to obtain text features, encoding and convolving the second scene graph to obtain semantic features; concatenating the text features and semantic features and inputting them into a text editor/decoder to output actions including at least deletion, rearrangement, and insertion; and processing the first prompt word based on the output deletion, rearrangement, and insertion actions to obtain the second prompt word.

title: A device abnormality warning method and system based on machine learning
description: The present invention discloses a device abnormality early warning method and system based on machine learning, including collecting working data of the device, preprocessing the working data, screening the operating data to obtain abnormal data, importing the abnormal data into an abnormal function to obtain an abnormal coefficient, decomposing the abnormal coefficient and the state data characteristics to obtain a feature vector, comprehensively evaluating the state data to obtain a state evaluation value, calculating the similarity between the abnormal coefficient and the state evaluation value to obtain an abnormal state degree, constructing a device abnormality early warning model based on machine learning according to the feature vector and the abnormal state degree, inputting the data to be evaluated into the device abnormality early warning model to obtain a device abnormality early warning value, and performing an abnormal early warning according to the device abnormality early warning value. The method can not only improve the accuracy of the device abnormality early warning method, but also has good interpretability, and can be directly applied to the device abnormality early warning system.

title: Data anomaly identification method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the present application belongs to the field of financial technology, and relates to a method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for identifying data anomalies, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining product time series data; constructing a dynamic graph of the product time series data to obtain a product time dimension graph sequence; inputting the product time dimension graph sequence into a pre-trained feature extraction model to obtain product evolution features; calculating the similarity of product evolution features of different time series to obtain product evolution similarity; determining whether the product evolution similarity is greater than or equal to a preset similarity threshold; if the product evolution similarity is greater than or equal to the similarity threshold, extracting the key time points of the product time series, and identifying data anomaly factors based on the key time points. The present application can effectively realize the accurate identification of abnormal factors in product transaction records, so as to facilitate the improvement and adjustment of product transaction processes.

title: Multi-source image information fusion method for robot positioning in low-illumination scene
description: A multi-source image information fusion method for positioning a low-illumination scene robot belongs to the technical field of low-illumination scene image processing. The invention aims at the problem that the existing image fusion method cannot adaptively adjust the image fusion scale under the low-illumination environment, so that the image characteristics cannot be utilized to the greatest extent. The method comprises the steps of carrying out two-dimensional wavelet image decomposition on an acquired infrared light image and a low-illumination image to obtain an infrared light high-frequency image sub-band, a low-illumination high-frequency image sub-band and a low-frequency image sub-band, respectively fusing the infrared light high-frequency image sub-band, the low-illumination high-frequency image sub-band and the low-frequency image sub-band to obtain a high-frequency primary fused image sub-band and a low-frequency primary fused image sub-band, carrying out threshold processing and histogram equalization processing to obtain a high-frequency fused sub-band and a low-frequency fused sub-band, and selecting a high-frequency weight coefficient and a low-frequency weight coefficient to carry out image weighted fusion based on illumination to obtain a final fused image. The invention is used for restoring the low-illumination image.

title: Intelligent illumination optimization method and system for plant growth
description: The invention relates to the technical field of plant growth control, in particular to an intelligent illumination optimization method and system for plant growth, which are characterized in that an image acquisition device is used for acquiring plant images and inputting a plant life cycle identification model to obtain a plant growth stage, a target illumination position category is obtained by comparing the plant growth stage with a preset key position illumination table, obtaining target illumination position data of the plant through a plant key position positioning model according to the plant image and the target illumination position category, obtaining an illumination path through an illumination path iteration model according to the target illumination position data of the plant, searching an illumination strategy database according to a plant growth stage to obtain illumination strategy parameters, and carrying out directional illumination on the target illumination position of the plant according to the illumination strategy parameters and the illumination path to realize efficient growth of the plant and reduce light energy waste.

title: Conversational data analysis method and device based on multi-language model and electronic equipment
description: This disclosure relates to the field of computer technology and discloses a conversational data analysis method, apparatus, and electronic device based on a multilingual model. The method includes: displaying a data analysis page with analysis controls corresponding to at least one language model; determining a target language model in response to a selection instruction for the analysis controls; generating a first data analysis instruction in response to a first question determined on the data analysis page, the first data analysis instruction determining a first analysis result of the target language model for the first question; and displaying the first analysis result on the data analysis page. This disclosure can solve the problem of low accuracy in data analysis.

title: Method, processor and machine-readable storage medium for shelf hit
description: The present application discloses a method, processor and machine-readable storage medium for shelf hit, belonging to the field of intelligent warehousing technology, the method comprising: obtaining order information of an order to be picked and inventory information of a current cargo warehouse; encoding and generating multiple individuals according to preset encoding rules based on the order information and inventory information to obtain an initial population, the number of chromosomes of each individual equals the number of cargo types of the order to be picked, and the number of gene bits of each chromosome equals the total number of cargo compartments in the current cargo warehouse; based on a multi-objective genetic algorithm, determining a target individual according to the initial population and a pre-constructed fitness function, the fitness function is constructed according to a preset evaluation dimension; determining the hit result corresponding to the target individual as the target hit result of the order to be picked. The present application adopts a multi-objective genetic algorithm to determine the target hit result of the order to be picked, and encodes according to the cargo type of the order to be picked and the total number of cargo compartments in the cargo warehouse, with high flexibility.

title: Magnesium alloy forging process optimization method based on simulation and neural network
description: The invention discloses a magnesium alloy forging process optimization method based on simulation and neural network, which relates to the field of magnesium alloy plastic forming, and the specific steps include: step 1, establishing a finite element model of magnesium alloy forgings, and calculating through a deformation-heat transfer three-dimensional finite element numerical simulation system; step 2, establishing a multi-input, multi-output BP neural network model, and determining the input layer and output layer parameters; step 3, selecting an orthogonal experimental method to obtain training and test sample data of the neural network; step 4, normalizing the sample data obtained by the orthogonal experiment and importing it into the neural network model for training and prediction; step 5, comparing and analyzing the predicted value of the neural network and the actual simulated value and performing relative error evaluation to determine the accuracy of the prediction of the constructed BP neural network model; step 6, predicting the best forging process optimization parameter combination through the constructed BP neural network model. The present invention takes reducing the maximum load value and the maximum die wear value during the forging process as the optimization target, and through the constructed BP neural network model, quickly and efficiently obtains the optimal parameter combination of the forging process of magnesium alloy forgings, shortens the product development cycle, and improves the process production efficiency.

title: Bad traffic monitoring method and system based on LSTM and clustering algorithm
description: The present invention discloses a bad traffic monitoring method and system based on LSTM and clustering algorithm, which belongs to the field of network security technology, and utilizes BPF technology to efficiently aggregate network traffic; accurately identifies fragmented traffic through LSTM network, and uses its special memory unit structure to capture complex dependencies; adopts FCM clustering algorithm to reorganize the session, restore the complete network session, and quickly identify malicious traffic through feature matching; finally, timely disposal measures are taken for confirmed malicious traffic. The present invention realizes the rapid and accurate detection and identification of bad website traffic fragmentation behavior, and solves the technical problems that traditional methods are difficult to deal with; through efficient caching and reorganization mechanism, the efficiency and accuracy of malicious traffic processing are improved; intelligent disposal measures are adopted to ensure timely and effective containment of malicious traffic; the overall protection capability of network security is improved, and the security of enterprise network resources and user data is protected.

title: Informationized management system and method for brewing process of strong aromatic Chinese spirits
description: The application relates to the field of informatization management, and particularly discloses an informatization management system and method for a brewing process of strong aromatic white spirit, which firstly acquire white spirit brewing raw material inventory data and white spirit brewing production planning acquired by a database, then utilize deep learning technology, and finally, generating inventory optimization suggestions through a generator, and further helping enterprises to carry out stock feeding or adjust production plans when appropriate, so that stock backlog or raw material shortage is avoided, and the production efficiency and quality control level are improved.

title: Method for executing a batch of requests by applying a machine learning model and non-transitory computer readable storage medium
description: A method and a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium for executing a batch of requests by applying a machine learning model are provided. The method includes: receiving a batch of two or more token sequences; accessing a machine learning model; generating one or more output representations, the generation including: obtaining one or more queries, keywords, and values, splitting first and second queries for first and second token sequences from the queries, splitting first and second keywords from the keywords, and splitting first and second values from the values, generating a first attention output by at least combining the first query, the first keyword, and the first value, generating a second attention output by at least combining the second query, the second keyword, and the second value, connecting at least the first attention output and the second attention output into a connection tensor, and generating one or more output representations by at least applying one or more weight tensors to the connection tensor.

title: Island type assembly scheduling method and device
description: The present invention discloses a method and device for island assembly production scheduling. The invention includes: confirming the assembly island area and the assembly island; setting constraints, wherein the constraints include difference island constraints, parallel island constraints, parallel island constraints and conventional constraints; establishing an objective function based on a greedy algorithm model according to known quantities, constraints and initial decision variables, wherein the initial decision variables include machine allocation variables and workpiece sorting variables, and the objective function is a function of the minimum waiting time; adjusting the initial decision variables, and when the objective function is the minimum value, determining the initial decision variables as the final decision variables; calculating the total completion time according to the final decision variables, known quantities and constraints. Through the present invention, the problem of lack of an efficient production scheduling system in the multi-link production process of the island assembly mode in the related art is solved.

title: An electrostatic discharge immunity automated test management method and system
description: The present invention discloses an electrostatic discharge immunity automated test management method and system. The method of the present invention comprises: real-time collection of real-time environmental status data in an experimental environment, followed by redundancy mechanism and verification algorithm processing, and real-time calculation and adjustment of the discharge parameters of an electrostatic generator using a multi-dimensional nonlinear adaptive control algorithm; electrostatic discharge is performed based on the adjusted electrostatic generator discharge parameters to generate electrostatic interference of specified parameters, while simulating the actual scene of electrostatic discharge, and further the generated electrostatic discharge interference signal is transmitted to the test equipment and a corresponding response signal is generated; after pre-processing the response signal and the interference signal, a deep spectrum analysis is performed to extract key features, and the immunity of the test equipment is intelligently evaluated through a neural network model. The present invention not only improves the control accuracy of the electrostatic generator, but also enables it to dynamically adapt to changes in the experimental environment, ensuring that the discharge conditions are always in the optimal state.

title: Model training method and claim element extraction method
description: The present application discloses a model training method and a claim element extraction method, the method comprising: annotating entities in each insurance clause in an insurance clause data set to obtain a first data set, wherein the entities include: claim elements, element values corresponding to the claim elements, and semantic fragments containing the claim elements; for each insurance clause in the first data set, using a target template, and generating training instructions based on the insurance clause and the entities corresponding to the insurance clause, wherein the training instructions include a command part, an input part, and an output part, the input part corresponds to the insurance clause, and the output part corresponds to the entities annotated in the insurance clause; using a second data set to train a preset claim element extraction large model to obtain a trained claim element extraction large model, wherein the second data set includes training instructions corresponding to each insurance clause.

title: Sewage treatment method, device, electronic equipment and program product
description: The present disclosure relates to a sewage treatment method, device, electronic device and program product, which collects a group of influent data before the treatment of the sewage to be treated, and inputs the group of influent data into a pre-trained effluent prediction model to obtain the effluent data after the treatment of the sewage to be treated and the corresponding predicted energy loss value; determines the effluent quality according to the effluent data, and determines multiple sewage adjustment strategies according to the effluent quality, target effluent conditions and the predicted energy loss value; respectively determines the energy loss value and effluent quality corresponding to the multiple sewage adjustment strategies, and determines the target sewage treatment strategy from the multiple sewage adjustment strategies according to the corresponding energy loss value and effluent quality; treats the sewage to be treated according to the target sewage treatment strategy. Based on this, when the target sewage treatment strategy is used to treat sewage, the sewage treatment efficiency can be improved and the effluent quality can be guaranteed, while the energy loss can also be significantly reduced.

title: Display device and answer information display method
description: Some embodiments of the present application provide a display device and an answer information display method, which retrieves the first answer information through the target application name and the key information of the question, and retrieves the second answer information according to the vectorized target text vector, thereby performing aggregation according to the first answer information and the second answer information, outputting the target answer text, and displaying it in the corresponding application interface. The answer information display method improves the accuracy of the answer information through multiple answer information query methods, and by displaying the target answer text on the application interface, the application interface and the target answer information are displayed on the same interface at the same time, so that the user does not have to repeatedly switch interfaces to view the answer information, simplifying the display process of the answer information.

title: Regional power grid photovoltaic-oriented fire light storage system scheduling method
description: The invention discloses a fire light storage system dispatching method for regional power grid photovoltaics, which relates to the technical field of power system dispatching and has the technical scheme that the method is characterized in that data are collected and predicted, a main equipment model of a power system is built, a fire storage peak regulation layered dispatching model is built, the fire light storage peak regulation layered dispatching model comprises an upper model and a lower model, an objective function is determined, constraint conditions are set, a solving process of the fire storage peak regulation layered dispatching model is determined, the upper model takes the minimum equivalent net load fluctuation of the power system as a target to solve the optimal dispatching of a unit starting peak regulation stage, the lower model takes the minimum operation cost in the power system dispatching period as the target to solve the output dispatching of each unit, finally, a simulation test is carried out by taking a real scene as a case, and the effects of improving the power grid to the photovoltaic absorption level and reducing the operation cost of the power system are achieved.

title: Urban ground subsidence space-time fusion depth map model prediction method
description: The present invention is applicable to the technical field of ground subsidence prediction, and provides a method for predicting urban ground subsidence by spatiotemporal fusion depth map model, including: step S1, data processing based on spatiotemporal feature analysis; step S2, ground subsidence prediction based on STF-GCLSTM model of grouping strategy. The present invention adopts multi-source data input, and extracts spatiotemporal features according to GCN spatial feature extraction model and LSTM temporal feature extraction model, and finally obtains more accurate settlement prediction value through spatiotemporal feature fusion prediction model, and further considers the difference of settlement characteristics between large and small areas, divides the study area into multiple sub-areas through grouping strategy, so that the settlement trend of each sub-area is similar, and then models different sub-areas respectively, so as to reduce the fitting error of the model and improve the prediction accuracy of the model.

title: Method, device and storage medium for realizing business intelligent circulation engine
description: The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence data processing technology, and specifically to an implementation method, device, and storage medium of a business intelligent flow engine. Context-aware intelligent reporting and keyword adaptation mechanisms reduce manual intervention and significantly improve work efficiency. The multi-dimensional adaptation scoring system and the integration of multiple natural language processing technologies make data processing faster and business flow smoother. Dynamically adjust the reporting strategy and data format conversion mechanism according to different business needs to enhance the adaptability of the system. Through a flexible data format conversion mechanism, the system is compatible with and can process different types of business forms. Keyword adaptation and data clipping mechanisms ensure that data fields are highly matched with actual needs, thereby improving the accuracy of data reporting. Intelligent data extraction and processing reduce errors caused by manual operations and improve overall data quality.

title: Multimedia image optimization method and system
description: The invention discloses a multimedia image optimization method and a system, which relate to the technical field of image optimization and comprise the steps of obtaining a multimedia image to be optimized, carrying out HSI color space conversion, extracting brightness components in the HSI color space, carrying out brightness enhancement, adjusting contrast of the enhanced brightness components, carrying out division of brightness areas and dynamic range optimization, carrying out edge enhancement on the optimized brightness components, recombining to generate an enhanced HSI image, and converting the enhanced HSI image back to an RGB color space to obtain the optimized multimedia image. The invention realizes the comprehensive optimization of the brightness, contrast and details of the image, improves the layering sense of the brightness, solves the problem of detail loss of the image in the highlight and dark areas, improves the edge definition and color fidelity of the image, can obviously improve the visual quality of the multimedia image, and meets the practical application requirements of multiple scenes.

title: Intention recognition method, system and related device
description: The application discloses an intention recognition method, system and related device, which comprise the steps of obtaining initial intention input by a user, obtaining candidate intentions related to the initial intention from an intention database, obtaining relative ambiguity between the initial intention and each candidate intention, wherein the relative ambiguity is determined based on the matching degree between an initial element of the initial intention and candidate elements corresponding to the candidate intention, the relative ambiguity is inversely proportional to the matching degree, obtaining intention supplementary information based on the candidate intention and the relative ambiguity corresponding to the candidate intention, and obtaining target intention by utilizing the initial intention and the intention supplementary information. Through the mode, the accuracy of intention recognition can be improved.

title: A multi-channel detection method for end-to-end steel oil and gas pipeline cracks
description: The present application relates to the technical field of testing or analyzing materials by measuring the chemical or physical properties of materials, and specifically to an end-to-end multi-channel detection method for cracks in steel oil and gas pipelines, which is executed by a processor and includes: obtaining a detection signal of a crack in a target pipeline; obtaining a crack defect signal set; performing data enhancement on the signal in the crack defect signal set to obtain an enhanced data set; performing signal rasterization on the enhanced data set to obtain a raster image data set; inputting the data in the raster image data set into SSD model training to obtain a crack defect automatic annotation model; configuring the hyperparameters of a neural network based on a genetic algorithm; inputting the crack defect signal set into DRSN2d model training, and obtaining the best optimization model in combination with the hyperparameters. The present application solves the problems of high dependence on manual labor, low detection accuracy, and low quantization speed in the prior art when detecting cracks inside pipelines.

title: Pancreatic cancer artificial intelligence auxiliary pathological diagnosis system based on deep learning
description: The invention provides an artificial intelligent auxiliary pancreatic cancer pathological diagnosis system based on deep learning, which relates to the technical field of medical diagnosis, and comprises the steps of obtaining an original pancreatic cancer pathological image and performing preprocessing operation to generate a corresponding target pancreatic cancer pathological image, classifying the target pancreatic cancer pathological image to generate a training pancreatic cancer pathological image and a verification pancreatic cancer pathological image, constructing and training a pancreatic cancer pathological diagnosis model based on the training pancreatic cancer pathological image by adopting a deep learning algorithm, adjusting model parameters of the pancreatic cancer pathological diagnosis model in real time, evaluating the diagnosis performance of the pancreatic cancer pathological diagnosis model based on the verification pancreatic cancer pathological image, optimizing the pancreatic cancer pathological diagnosis model according to an evaluation result, obtaining a current pancreatic cancer pathological image, inputting the current pancreatic cancer pathological image into the pancreatic cancer pathological diagnosis model after preprocessing, outputting the current diagnosis result and displaying the current diagnosis result to a doctor end, so that the pathological image can be automatically analyzed, the accurate diagnosis of pancreatic cancer is realized, and the diagnosis efficiency and accuracy are improved.

title: Individualized prediction system for clinical curative effect of phlegm-heat clearing injection
description: The present invention provides a personalized prediction system for the clinical efficacy of Tanreqing injection, including: an input module, an efficacy prediction module and an output module. The input module is used to obtain the basic information of the patient to be predicted, the combined medication information and the injection time of Tanreqing injection; the efficacy prediction module is used to use C-reactive protein as the outcome indicator, and use the constructed personalized prediction model for the clinical efficacy of Tanreqing injection to predict the probability value of the ideal clinical efficacy of the patient to be predicted under different combined medication treatment schemes; the output module is used to output the probability value of the ideal clinical efficacy of the patient to be predicted under different combined medication treatment schemes. This application is based on the 13 selected indicators, and uses the XGBoost model to construct a personalized prediction model for the clinical efficacy of Tanreqing injection and its prediction system, so as to quickly, accurately and efficiently determine the optimal personalized treatment plan for Tanreqing injection and its combined medication.

title: Distributed photovoltaic energy storage regulation voltage deviation collaborative planning method
description: The invention relates to a distributed photovoltaic energy storage regulation voltage deviation collaborative planning method which comprises the following steps of 1, collecting injection power of adjustable points of a power distribution network, active output power of the distributed photovoltaic energy storage and reactive output power of the photovoltaic energy storage, establishing a three-layer model of a power distribution network system, 2, optimizing the three-layer model established in the step 1 by taking the lowest annual cost of the power distribution network, optimal planning configuration of the distributed photovoltaic energy storage and minimum voltage deviation of the power distribution network as targets, and 3, solving the three-layer model by using an improved multi-target gold jackal optimization algorithm to obtain a distributed photovoltaic energy storage regulation voltage deviation collaborative planning result. The method can effectively reduce the power flowing into the power distribution network from the upper power grid, eliminate the influence on the main network caused by the power reversal generated when the high-proportion distributed power supply is connected, slow down the expansion of the transformer to a certain extent and improve the utilization rate of the existing equipment.

title: Text segmentation method, device, equipment and storage medium thereof
description: The embodiments of the present application belong to the field of artificial intelligence and text processing technology, and are applied to the text content segmentation scenario in documents or clauses, and relate to a text segmentation method, device, equipment and storage medium thereof, which obtains the text to be segmented; extracts the full amount of text content to be segmented; inputs it into a pre-trained segmentation model; performs segmentation processing on the full amount of text content to be segmented, and obtains all segmentation sequence fragments contained in the full amount of text content to be segmented; and outputs the segmentation processing result from the segmentation model according to the segmentation sequence fragments. The text segmentation method is applied to the text content segmentation scenario in insurance business documents or clauses, and when searching for claim basis clauses, the text segmentation method can be used to quickly filter out the basis clauses, especially in the insurance business field with a large number of agreement clauses, and can assist underwriters or claims processing personnel to quickly find the basis clauses and improve business processing efficiency.

title: Model optimization method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application provides a model optimization method, a model optimization device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of machine learning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining operator specifications of each operator contained in a deep learning model before optimization, determining operators which are not supported by a nerve processing unit in a hardware platform of a model to be deployed from all operators contained in the deep learning model before optimization based on the obtained operator specifications, serving as super-specification operators, generating an optimization operator corresponding to each super-specification operator according to the operator specifications of each super-specification operator, wherein the optimization operator corresponding to one super-specification operator contains a public operator supported by the nerve processing unit and an expansion operator, replacing each super-specification operator with the corresponding optimization operator to obtain an optimized deep learning model, and enabling a central processor in the hardware platform to be used for running the expansion operator in the optimized deep learning model. Therefore, the normal operation of the deep learning model on the hardware platform can be ensured.

title: Automobile auxiliary driving monocular distance measurement method and device based on lightweight occupancy prediction network
description: A monocular distance measurement method and device for automobile auxiliary driving based on a lightweight occupation prediction network comprises the steps of firstly constructing a 3D occupation prediction data set, and then constructing a monocular occupation prediction teacher model based on multi-frame time sequence fusion and time sequence three-dimensional depth estimation and a lightweight monocular occupation prediction student model based on single-frame input. And training the occupancy prediction teacher model to obtain the occupancy prediction teacher model with good performance and evaluating the performance of the teacher model. And performing distillation training on the student model by using characteristics and output of the middle layer of the teacher network to obtain a light-weight occupation prediction student model with improved performance, and evaluating the performance of the student model. And finally, forward reasoning is carried out on the student model, and connected domain analysis is carried out on the interested examples (such as vehicles and pedestrians) from the reasoning result, so that monocular ranging is completed. The method solves the problem of inaccurate ranging caused by unstable detection frames in the traditional monocular ranging method, and improves the performance while the model is light by using a distillation technology.

title: Sow weight prediction method based on multi-mode data feature layer fusion
description: The present invention relates to a method for estimating sow weight by fusion of multimodal data feature layers. The method involves obtaining point clouds of sows at different angles through a sow point cloud acquisition device, taking sow time series data such as breed, parity and reproductive stage and reconstructed real-time three-dimensional point cloud of sows as input, establishing a dual-branch network based on feature layer fusion, and automatically extracting deep features from one-dimensional data and three-dimensional point cloud at the same time, fusing time series data features with real-time data features, and completing the current weight estimation of the sow and the weight curve estimation of the entire reproductive stage. Through this method, the accuracy of weight estimation is improved. The final output of this method is the real-time weight value of the current reproductive stage and the predicted weight value of the entire reproductive stage. The real-time weight value is conducive to obtaining the current physical health status of the sow and the adjustment of the feeding strategy, so that the sow can reach the best health state and maintain the best production performance, while maintaining the minimum feed cost.

title: Market subject credit risk evaluation modeling method and device based on machine learning
description: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for modeling credit risk evaluation of a market subject based on machine learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring related data of credit risk evaluation indexes of the market subject, and preprocessing the data; according to the preprocessed first data, training to obtain a risk index model, screening and primarily classifying market subject credit information data based on the risk index model and market subject credit risk evaluation indexes to obtain second data, training a neural network risk evaluation model according to the second data, secondarily classifying market subject credit risk grade data based on the neural network risk evaluation model to obtain a risk grade prediction result, automatically extracting credit risk evaluation indexes, training to obtain a general credit risk evaluation model applicable to all market subjects, achieving credit risk evaluation and credit rating, and improving risk evaluation accuracy.

title: Industrial large model platform and system thereof
description: The embodiment of the present application provides an industrial large model platform and its system. The industrial large model platform is used to train industrial large models, and the industrial large model platform includes: an infrastructure layer, a base layer, a model adaptation layer, an interaction layer and an application layer; the infrastructure layer is used to build basic resources for training industrial large models; the base layer is used to perform industrial multimodal pre-training to improve the processing capabilities of industrial large models on multimodal data; the model adaptation layer is used to perform embedded fine-tuning of industrial mechanisms to improve the processing capabilities of industrial large models on specific tasks, as well as the generalization capabilities in unknown domain scenarios; the interaction layer is used to improve the interactive capabilities of industrial large models; the application layer is used to express the functions of industrial large models. The industrial large model platform and its system of the embodiment of the present application solve the problems of poor generalization capabilities, low training efficiency and lack of understanding of industrial mechanisms of existing industrial large models.

title: Monitoring and early warning device for identifying thermal runaway of battery and operation method thereof
description: The present invention discloses a monitoring and early warning device for identifying battery thermal runaway and an operating method thereof, belonging to the technical field of battery monitoring and early warning. In the present invention, by combining advanced machine learning algorithms, deep learning technologies and signal processing methods, high-precision battery anomaly detection is achieved. The modular design of the system and the comprehensive evaluation framework ensure its reliability and scalability in practical applications. Through continuous optimization and monitoring, the system can adapt to changing data patterns, thereby providing strong support for battery quality control and performance optimization. Therefore, early and accurate monitoring and early warning of battery thermal runaway safety risks used in energy storage systems and electric vehicles are carried out, and the spread of thermal runaway between batteries is effectively prevented, which greatly reduces the probability and degree of loss of fire and explosion accidents caused by thermal runaway of batteries, thereby contributing to improving the quality and efficiency of safety risk prevention and control in the new energy industry.

title: Map road data generation model training method, related method, device and equipment
description: The application relates to a map road data generation model training method, a related device and equipment. The method comprises the steps of respectively converting a plurality of groups of pre-training map element vector data obtained in advance into pre-training map element grating data, pre-training a pre-built initial road generation model with increased randomness based on the plurality of groups of pre-training map element grating data and corresponding map geometric grating data to obtain a plurality of overfitting road generation models, obtaining a plurality of corresponding map geometric grating data based on the plurality of groups of obtained map element grating data and the plurality of overfitting road generation models, obtaining a training sample pair set, training a pre-built rewarding model based on the training sample pair set to obtain a trained rewarding model, and performing reinforcement learning training on a target road generation model set in parallel by using the trained rewarding model to obtain an optimal map road generation model.

title: Data evaluation of AI/ML
description: Example embodiments are directed to data evaluation for AI/ML. A method includes: receiving bitmap information at a first device and from at least one second device, the bitmap information indicating corresponding locations of data samples collected by the at least one second device, the at least one second device being configured for data collection for artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML) services; determining a quality level of the data samples collected by the at least one second device based at least in part on the bitmap information; selecting data samples to be included in the data set by comparing the quality level with a target quality level of the data set for the AI/ML service; and sending a request to the at least one second device to request reporting of the selected data samples to be included in the data set to a target entity.

title: Privacy computing method and system based on blockchain technology and trusted federation learning
description: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a privacy computing method and system based on blockchain technology and trusted federated learning, including: building a consortium chain system, wherein the consortium chain roles on the consortium chain system include data providers, data users, data annotators and system platform managers; the system platform manager automatically allocates data download permissions for each node to the consortium chain roles based on data security rules, submits the data source to be annotated and the data annotation requirement information corresponding to the data source to be annotated through the data provider node, automatically downloads the data annotation task block to be assigned and decrypts it through the data annotator node, obtains the data annotation requirement information, confirms acceptance of the data annotation task, and automatically downloads the available data resource block and decrypts it through the data user node. Solve the problems of data compliance, data authority, data credibility, data circulation, and benefit distribution that cannot be solved in the prior art.

title: Disaster relevance analysis system, server and method
description: The disaster correlation analysis system and method analyze the specific process of simultaneous multiple or chain disasters and accident damage in order to use artificial intelligence technology to conduct preventive disaster management of complex disasters. In addition, in order to improve the understanding of the analysis results through the implementation examples, the disaster correlation analysis results are distinguished according to the types of disasters and accidents, and information is provided in the form of scenes and supervision. In addition, through the implementation examples, the networking of disasters is used as the most important element of complex disaster analysis, and the correlation between disasters is analyzed based on the relationship between disaster and accident types and vulnerable elements.

title: Multispectral satellite fireproof method and multispectral satellite fireproof system based on data identification
description: The invention discloses a multi-spectrum satellite fireproof method and a system based on data identification, wherein a multi-spectrum satellite optical sensor array scans a target area for 30 minutes, acquires data through a high-precision attitude system and a formula, acquires quality through self-adaptive filtering and multi-source data correction, extracts fire characteristic construction vectors through dynamic threshold and wavelet transformation, inputs a fusion model to judge fire in real time, transmits early warning information containing position, fire and the like to a ground command center within 8 minutes, updates data every 10 minutes during fire, evaluates fire according to multiple indexes by combining a GIS and a time sequence model, adjusts strategies and stores the data. The invention has the advantages of rapid data acquisition and processing, early warning in 8 minutes, accuracy exceeding 92 percent, 15 minutes in advance for prejudging fire, stable system, high-efficiency data processing and conservation of ecology and life and property safety.

title: Method and system for performing non-supervision monocular three-dimensional target detection training processing and label generation
description: The embodiment of the present invention provides an unsupervised monocular three-dimensional target detection training processing, label generation method and system, wherein the label generation method includes: performing instance segmentation on image data, generating instance masks, and mapping point cloud data to generate point cloud instance segmentation data; dividing into different clusters according to point cloud density, determining point cloud cluster data of target instances; projecting onto a bird's-eye view to generate a two-dimensional bounding box, and generating a three-dimensional bounding box according to the instance height. The unsupervised monocular three-dimensional target detection training processing, label generation method and system of the embodiment of the present invention utilizes the three-dimensional depth characteristics of point cloud data and the existing registered point cloud and image data sets to generate depth labels that can be used to train monocular target detection models, thereby reducing the workload and errors of manual annotation, more efficiently training monocular target detection models, and improving the depth recognition effect of monocular target detection models.

title: Text display method and display device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present application discloses a text display method and display device, electronic device and storage medium, belonging to the technical field of electronic devices. The text display method includes: receiving a font switching input; in response to the font switching input, obtaining font switching data; wherein the font switching data includes an initial font and a target font; generating an intermediate font sequence based on the font switching data; wherein the intermediate font sequence includes at least one intermediate font; after displaying the initial font, sequentially transitioning to displaying each intermediate font in the intermediate font sequence, switching to display the target font.

title: Construction method of underlying surface dust emission level prediction model based on ground-atmosphere coupled remote sensing
description: The present application discloses a method for constructing a model for forecasting the dust emission level of an underlying surface based on ground-atmosphere coupled remote sensing, comprising real-time collection of multi-source observation data, preprocessing the multi-source observation data to obtain original observation data; obtaining key meteorological forecasting factors through the original observation data, and obtaining a sample data set by taking 16 days as an interval statistic; using the mean of aerosol product data as the true value of the dust emission amount, training and testing the sample data set using a random forest algorithm, and constructing a machine learning model for identifying dust emission conditions; using the machine learning model for identifying dust emission conditions to predict and calculate a dust emission index, revising the model results according to the newly added snow accumulation, precipitation phase and precipitation products, and outputting a forecast of the dust emission level for the next ten days; the present invention dynamically adjusts the dust emission level by distinguishing different precipitation types and precipitation amounts, so as to improve the accuracy and pertinence of the forecast.

title: Rock mass instability grading early warning method and system based on microseismic feature perception and classification enhancement algorithm
description: The invention discloses a rock mass instability grading early warning method based on a microseismic feature perception and classification enhancement algorithm, which comprises the steps of obtaining rock mass instability case data information of different geotechnical engineering projects, selecting a plurality of microseismic parameters as rock mass instability risk candidate evaluation indexes and carrying out correlation analysis to obtain rock mass instability grading early warning evaluation indexes, constructing a training data set, constructing a rock mass instability grading early warning primary model based on the classification enhancement algorithm and a genetic algorithm and training to obtain a rock mass instability grading early warning model, and adopting the obtained rock mass instability grading early warning model to finish rock mass instability grading early warning based on the microseismic feature perception and the classification enhancement algorithm. The invention also discloses a system for realizing the rock mass instability grading early warning method based on the microseismic characteristic sensing and classification enhancement algorithm. The rock mass instability grading early warning method based on the microseismic feature sensing and classification enhancement algorithm not only can realize rock mass instability grading early warning based on the microseismic feature sensing and classification enhancement algorithm, but also is higher in reliability and better in accuracy.

title: Surface element quantitative inversion method, system, storage medium and electronic equipment
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of geochemical element mapping, and discloses a method, system, storage medium and electronic device for quantitative inversion of surface elements. The method comprises: obtaining remote sensing image spectral data of a target area and laboratory spectral data of samples sampled at preset sampling points; converting the laboratory spectral data into simulated image spectral data based on a spectral response function; performing DS correction on the remote sensing image spectral data using the simulated image spectral data to obtain corrected remote sensing image spectral data; extracting and optimizing characteristic bands on the corrected remote sensing image spectral data to obtain characteristic spectra; and obtaining the geochemical element content of the target area based on characteristic spectral inversion. The present invention generates simulated image spectral data through ground laboratory spectral data, and then corrects the remote sensing image spectral data through the simulated image spectral data, thereby increasing the correlation between remote sensing spectral data and elements and improving the accuracy of element inversion.

title: Bidirectional employment recommendation method based on professional development trend modeling
description: The present application belongs to the field of data analysis technology. The present application provides a two-way employment recommendation method based on career development trend modeling. The disclosed embodiment uses the DMU‑Net architecture to model the career development trends of job seekers. DMU‑Net implements multi-level feature extraction through a time series feature pyramid network, thereby capturing seasonal changes at a shallow level and identifying long-term trends at a deep level. A cross-layer attention mechanism is then designed to fuse feature information of different scales, and a dynamic multi-key-value memory matrix is introduced to effectively reduce information loss during the downsampling process. In addition, through the design of a dual-view encoder and an adaptive feature fusion layer, a two-way matching of job seekers and recruiters' needs is achieved, providing more accurate employment recommendations.

title: Machine learning-based method for predicting preparation of intestinal tract before colonoscopy of patient
