description: The invention discloses a machine learning-based method for predicting intestinal tract preparation before colonoscopy of a patient, which comprises the following steps of S1 collecting clinical data of the patient and preprocessing the clinical data, S2 carrying out feature selection on the collected clinical data by using a Borata algorithm to identify important features related to insufficient intestinal tract preparation before colonoscopy, S3 constructing a prediction model by using a machine learning algorithm and carrying out prediction model evaluation by using a cross verification method to select an optimal prediction model, S4 adopting an SHAP interpretation tree model to interpret the optimal prediction model to identify features which have the greatest influence on a prediction result, S5 conveying the clinical data of the patient to be tested into the optimal prediction model to predict the intestinal tract preparation before colonoscopy of the patient, and meanwhile, providing personalized guidance, and remarkably improving clinical work efficiency.

title: Problem processing method, device, storage medium and electronic equipment
description: The invention discloses a problem processing method, a device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of searching in a target knowledge base based on target questions of a user under the condition that target questions of the user are received to obtain a search result, inputting at least one piece of reply information into a target neural network model under the condition that the search result comprises at least one piece of reply information, determining first reply information aiming at the target questions through the target neural network model, determining artificial customer service corresponding to the user under the condition that the search result does not comprise the reply information, switching the artificial customer service for the user, sending first prompt information to the artificial customer service, and generating second prompt information according to a target work order under the condition that the target work order triggered by the artificial customer service is detected, and sending the second prompt information to a first target object. The invention solves the technical problem of low answer efficiency caused by the dependence on manual customer service to answer the user questions in the related technology.

title: Human activity recognition method based on instance migration and attention distillation network
description: The present application relates to a method for human activity recognition based on instance transfer and attention distillation network. The method includes: sampling with replacement the target domain samples in the target domain sample data set to generate multiple sub-datasets to train the base learner; evaluating and calculating the weights of the trained base learner, adding the source domain samples with weights greater than the threshold to the candidate source domain set; using the candidate source domain set to pre-train the teacher network in the human activity recognition model; merging the target domain sample data set with the candidate source domain set, inputting the features of the samples into the student network and teacher network in the human activity recognition model, calculating the classification loss and distillation loss, and finally updating the parameters of the student network through back propagation to obtain a trained human activity recognition model based on the attention mechanism distillation learning network, inputting the user acceleration data into the trained human activity recognition model for activity recognition, and outputting the user's activity type; thereby improving the accuracy of human activity recognition.

title: Processing system and method for detecting environmental information of electric power material warehouse
description: A processing system and method for detecting the environmental information of the electric power supplies warehouse belong to the technical field of environmental information processing, it forms the forward queue of the environmental information parameter according to the sampled value from the environmental information sample, and form the forward queue of the corresponding auxiliary information according to the sampled value from the corresponding sensor to each sensor, then calculate and get the coherence factor of each auxiliary information and environmental information parameter according to such forward queue, and combine the neural network operation to get the final presumption value of the environmental information parameter at the future time, finally this presumption value is transmitted to the liquid crystal screen and sent out and shown, this can not only give the efficiency of the environmental information estimation of execution in advance and advance notification, still have better estimation accuracy and high-efficient of the advance notification, has promoted the performance of the environmental information in the room where the electric power supplies warehouse is located in advance of the advance control of the environmental information in advance, suitable for controlling the change situation of the environmental information in the room where the electric power supplies warehouse is located.

title: SMT surface defect detection method
description: The invention discloses a SMT surface defect detection method, which specifically comprises the following steps of S1, sample preparation, wherein a template image is randomly selected from a template image set of a patch element, the template image is a standard image without defects, and a to-be-detected image is randomly selected from a to-be-detected image set of the patch element. According to the SMT surface defect detection method, the defects of the patch elements can be more accurately identified through fusion of depth features and semantic difference mapping features, the false detection rate and the omission rate are reduced, automatic detection can be realized, manual re-judgment is not needed, the detection efficiency is greatly improved, the requirements of a modern production line for high-speed production are met, the labor cost can be remarkably reduced, the economic benefit of enterprises is improved through reducing the requirements of manual re-judgment, and the detection method is suitable for patch elements with different sizes, types and shapes and has high adaptability and flexibility.

title: Large model fine-tuning method, device, electronic device, storage medium and system
description: The invention provides a large model fine tuning method, a device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a system, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the steps of detecting corpus change indexes from the last time of reading a corpus data set from a target industry knowledge base to any target industry knowledge base in a plurality of industry knowledge bases in the current time; generating model parameters comprising the identification of a target industry knowledge base and a basic model when the corpus change index meets the fine tuning starting condition, reading a current corpus data set from the identified target industry knowledge base of the target industry knowledge base, converting the current corpus data set into a target fine tuning corpus data set in a target format, fine tuning the model parameters of the basic model according to the target fine tuning corpus data set to obtain a target industry large model file, and updating the current first industry large model into a second industry large model generated based on the target industry large model file. The invention can improve the fine tuning efficiency and accuracy of the large model.

title: Construction method of multi-mode tunnel construction human body pose detection and estimation model based on R2Fusion
description: The invention relates to a method for constructing a multi-mode tunnel construction human body pose detection and estimation model based on R2Fusion, belonging to the field of tunnel safety monitoring. The method comprises the steps of collecting RGB image data, depth image data and infrared image data, realizing multi-mode image Fusion by combining alignment processing with a self-adaptive weight network, detecting human body joint points through HRNet, capturing human body non-rigid deformation through WPNet, generating corresponding feature images, constructing an R2Fusion model through Fusion AGCA and DLCA, describing key points, realizing human body pose detection, collecting IMU inertial measurement data, fusing data and visual data obtained by the IMU, and further carrying out pose estimation and correction through constructing a minimum cost function of the key points and obtaining a rotation matrix and a translation matrix, and guaranteeing real-time monitoring and feedback. The invention improves the positioning precision of human bodies in the complex environment of the tunnel, so that the tunnel is safer and more reliable in inspection.

title: A traffic police dynamic gesture recognition method and system based on vehicle-mounted federated learning
description: The invention discloses a traffic police dynamic gesture recognition method and a traffic police dynamic gesture recognition system based on vehicle federal learning, which combine a key feature extraction model and a preset global model to be used as a traffic police gesture recognition model shared by all-network vehicle terminals, are beneficial to improving the gesture recognition precision of the traffic police, organize different vehicle terminals to train the models based on traffic police gesture image data collected by the vehicle federal learning, and then share only model update data instead of original training data by the vehicle terminals, thereby protecting the data privacy of vehicle users, saving the communication cost of uploading massive data to a central server, and simultaneously fully utilizing real-time traffic police gesture image data scattered on different vehicle-mounted devices by the vehicle federal learning, wherein the training data from the vehicle-mounted images have different observation angles, different environmental conditions and the like, enrich the diversity of the model training data, and further enhance the adaptability of the trained traffic police gesture recognition model under a changeable traffic environment.

title: Treatment device and method suitable for cylindrical part
description: U I T T R E K S E L The present disclosure discloses a treatment device and a method suitable for a cylindrical part. The device includes a weld joint treatment unit and a base material treatment unit. According to the present disclosure, a weld joint and base materials of the 5 cylindrical part are performed respectively to regulate and control the microstructure of the cylindrical part, which improves the forming quality of the cylindrical part. (+ Fig. l) 10

title: Systems and methods for underwater imagery enhancement
description: A computer-implemented method for training a generative adversarial network (GAN) for enhancing underwater images. An adversarial loss is computed for updating a discriminator model and a combined loss is calculated for updating a generator model. The combined loss is calculated based on loss components including the adversarial loss and at least one further loss component. Additionally disclosed herein is a generator network for processing underwater images that includes a novel encoder-decoder model architecture. Unlocking insights from Geo-Data, the present invention further relates to improvements in sustainability and environmental developments: together we create a safe and liveable world.

title: Identification of Compartments in Gas Reservoirs
description: Disclosed are methods, systems, and computer-readable medium to perform operations including generating a material balance plot for a plurality of wells in a gas reservoir. The material balance plot includes, for each of the plurality of wells, respective static pressure/compressibility factor (P/Z) values plotted against cumulative production in the gas reservoir. The operations further include calculating, for each of the plurality of wells, a respective slope of the respective P/Z values plotted against cumulative production. Also, the operations include grouping, based on the respective slopes and locations of the plurality of wells, each well into a respective cluster. Additionally, the operations include designating each respective cluster as a separate compartment in the gas reservoir. Fig 2.

title: A hierarchical hypergraph collaboration method of heterogeneous multi-agents
description: Disclosed is a hierarchical hypergraph collaboration method of heterogeneous multi-agents, belonging to the field of artificial intelligence technology. In view of the problem of pairwise interaction that focuses on local space, ignoring the information related from different levels and perspectives, and not improving collaborative efficiency and overall performance, hierarchical modeling of groups is carried out through hypergraphs. According to the group minimum division standard, agents with the same characteristics in a certain dimension are gathered together to form multiple heterogeneous agent subgroups. Subsequently, recursive operations are performed on subgroups in the same manner. In the constructed hierarchical hypergraph, the regret minimization algorithm is used to implement the equilibrium strategy among subgroups under local observation states. Through the feedback mechanism, collaborative consistency is achieved within the subgroup, thereby effectively improving the efficiency and accuracy of the group collaboration process.

title: Method of controlling length of electric arc in electric arc furnace, device for carrying out method, as well as electric arc furnace with such device
description:
FIELD: metallurgy. 
     SUBSTANCE: invention relates to metallurgy and can be used for regulating length of electric arc in an arc furnace. Method comprises measuring vibrations at a wall of furnace vessel, through which is determined a slag height (H rel ) of melt, wherein when at deviations of a determined actual slag height (H rel ) from a given value (S), control and/or regulation signals are output, through which is set electric arc length of at least one electrode by regulation of impedance of at least one electrode. Device comprises at least one structure-borne sound sensor for detecting vibrations at a wall of furnace vessel, computing unit configured to calculate an actual value of a slag height (H rel ) in furnace vessel, and a control or regulating unit for adjusting electric arc length of at least one electrode by regulating impedance of at least one electrode at deviation of actual slag height (H rel ) from specified value. 
     EFFECT: invention provides fast response to change of slag height, wherein fuzzy logic-based control system generates correction coefficients for individual electric arc lengths over a short reaction time of approximately one second. 
     28 cl, 2 dwg

title: Vehicle control device
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a vehicle control device capable of reducing man-hours required for a skilled person when setting a relationship between a vehicle state and an action variable.  When the CPU determines that it is the end of a trip (S30: YES), time-series data of the accelerator operation amount PA as a state during the trip, and a throttle opening degree command value TA * as an action. And the retard amount aperture of the ignition timing, the torque Trq for calculating the reward, the torque command value Trq *, and the acceleration Gx are read out (S34). The CPU gives a reward depending on whether the torque Trq or the acceleration Gx satisfies the standard (S36 to S40). The CPU updates the action value function Q and the policy π based on the given reward (S42 to S48).  [Selection diagram] Fig. 3

title: IMPROVED RECHARGING DEVICE, IN PARTICULAR FOR AN ELECTRIC VEHICLE
description: Charging device connected at the input to an electricity delivery point (PDL) adapted to supply maximum electrical power and delivering regulated electrical power at the output. The charging device comprises an optimization module (OPT) configured to construct a charging profile representative of a first electrical charging power, and a regulation module (REG) having a first mode of operation in which it regulates the power electric power delivered at the output to make it correspond to the first electric power, and a second mode of operation in which it regulates the electric power delivered at the output to make it correspond to a second electric power of recharge, the regulation module (REG) being configured to switch from the first mode to the second mode in response to the verification of at least one condition defined according to the electrical consumption forecasts of the other equipment and to electrical consumption data of the said other equipment measured.

title: Magnetic resonance T1 mapping system and method
description: The present application provides a magnetic resonance T1 mapping system and method comprising at least one memory device storing a set of instructions, and at least one processor in communication with the at least one memory device, characterized in that the at least one processor, when executing the instructions, is adapted to cause the system to acquire at least three images of a target during an inversion recovery process, each image of the at least three images being acquired during a breath-hold period of the target, and to determine a T1 mapped image of the target based on the at least three images acquired during the inversion recovery process and a trained model.

title: Double closed-loop control method for Boost circuit of fuel cell hybrid electric vehicle
description: The purpose of this invention is to provide a dual-closed-loop control method for the Boost circuit of a fuel cell hybrid electric vehicle, comprising the following steps: S1, designing an adaptive load estimator to reduce the impact of load disturbances on voltage regulation; S2, using the load estimate obtained in step S1, and based on fixed-time control theory, introducing a dual-loop feedback control technique to replace the virtual control law in the backstepping method, the fixed-time control method controls the internal loop of current regulation to ensure that the system output voltage tracks the set reference voltage within a fixed time; S3, optimizing the fixed-time controller described in step S2 using a particle swarm optimization algorithm to find the global optimum, minimizing the objective function value. This invention designs a fixed-time dual-closed-loop control loop based on fixed-time control theory, improving the fast response capability of the Boost converter, and optimizes the controller parameters in the fixed-time control strategy using a particle swarm optimization algorithm, resulting in better power control performance of the Boost converter.

title: Image classification method of pulse residual neural network based on gate mechanism
description: The invention discloses an image classification method of a pulse residual neural network based on a gating mechanism. The existing impulse neural network model structure for image classification has the problem that gradient disappears during training, the number of model layers is small, the model capacity is low, and high-precision image processing cannot be realized. Aiming at the problem of gradient disappearance, the invention provides a pulse residual error neural network based on a gate mechanism, wherein a main computing unit of the network is a pulse gate residual error module. The pulse gate residual error module introduces a binary selection gate to select residual error signals, and ensures normal back transmission of gradients under the limitation of pulse signals, so that the problem of gradient disappearance is solved. Compared with the artificial neural network with the same depth, the invention has the advantages that the energy consumption is obviously reduced, and compared with the impulse neural network which is directly trained, the accuracy in image classification is obviously improved.

title: Oil storage tank wall missing signal recovery method and device based on condition self-encoder
description: The present invention belongs to the field of fault diagnosis and artificial intelligence, and specifically relates to a method and device for recovering missing signals from the wall of an oil tank based on a conditional autoencoder. The method collects magnetic leakage signals from the wall of a healthy oil tank, preprocesses the collected magnetic leakage signals to obtain a grayscale matrix, converts the preprocessed data into a color image, and then generates training samples based on the grayscale matrix and the color image; constructs a missing signal recovery model for the wall of an oil tank based on a conditional autoencoder; uses training samples to train the missing signal recovery model based on the conditional autoencoder; inputs the signal to contain missing data into the trained missing signal recovery model to recover the missing signal. The addition of missing signal features enhances the purposefulness of the entire network, allowing the network to have a stronger understanding of missing information and a stronger sense of guidance in the signal recovery process, thus solving the problem of large missing signals being difficult to recover.

title: Knowledge selection method applied to knowledge distillation
description: The invention discloses a knowledge selection method applied to knowledge distillation, which comprises the following steps of 1) training a teacher model by using data of a text classification task, 2) extracting different types of knowledge by using the trained teacher model and classifying the knowledge, 3) initializing a student model based on the trained teacher model, 4) training a knowledge selection module by using a REINFORCE algorithm, 5) training a final student model by using the trained knowledge selection module, and selecting the knowledge of the type which the student model should learn according to the characteristics of the corresponding teacher model and the student model during training. The method can learn the knowledge type suitable for the learning of the student model in the knowledge distillation process, so that the knowledge type suitable for the learning of the student model can be selected according to the states of the teacher model and the student model in each training step in the knowledge distillation process.

title: A method for determining landslide rainfall threshold curve based on machine learning
description: The invention relates to a method for determining a landslide rainfall threshold curve based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of constructing a landslide model sample, determining a slope stability safety coefficient threshold and annual average rainfall capacity of a current research area, calculating a seepage field of the sample under given rainfall intensity, capturing a moment point when the slope safety coefficient is equal to the slope stability safety coefficient threshold, taking the corresponding rainfall intensity and rainfall duration as fitting data points of an I-D threshold curve, constructing an I-D threshold curve data set, constructing an I-D threshold curve prediction model by using an artificial neural network, training the prediction model, inputting slope parameters into the prediction model to obtain the slope fitting data points, fitting and drawing the I-D threshold curve on a coordinate system. The method has the advantages of more accurate result, realization of rapid prediction of the I-D threshold curve, improvement of analysis efficiency, good practical value and popularization.

title: Pruning method and device for cutter image classification model and computer equipment
description: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a method, device, and computer equipment for pruning a tool image classification model. The method comprises: obtaining a trained image classification model; evaluating the importance of each channel of the trained image classification model to the image classification task; specifically, for each channel in the network layer to be deleted, calculating the corresponding importance weight according to the degree of discrimination of the channel for samples of the same type and samples of different types to obtain the importance of each channel to the image classification task; deleting the channels whose importance does not meet the requirements to obtain a pruned image classification model; and fine-tuning the classification training of the pruned image classification model to determine the final image classification model. The present invention can prune certain model channels in the image classification neural network, reduce the number of parameters of the model, improve the runtime efficiency of the model, reduce resource consumption, and thus improve the accuracy of tool recognition and classification efficiency.

title: System and method for detecting image copy and paste tampering
description: This invention discloses a system and method for detecting image copy-paste tampering. The method includes the following steps: calculating similarity vectors between image regions; classifying regions in the image into three different matching modes based on their relationship with their matching regions; sorting the similarity vectors of all regions in descending order and recording the positions of their matching regions; fusing the similarity vectors of different regions according to their matching position relationships to obtain a fused similarity matrix; extracting an attention map from the fused similarity matrix and modulating a feature map; concatenating the feature map and the fused similarity matrix to obtain a fused feature map; feeding the fused feature map into a tampering detector to extract a copy-paste detection mask; using a dual-mask to separate the feature map and then concatenating it into a new feature along the channel dimension, and feeding the concatenated feature into a source-destination locator to obtain a source-destination localization mask; employing a cross-entropy loss function to tampering detection network; and inputting a single image into the trained tampering detection network to obtain the detection result.

title: Method and device for determining particulate matters in vehicle DPF and computer equipment
description: The application relates to a method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for determining particulate matters in a vehicle DPF. The method comprises the steps of obtaining current working condition data of a vehicle and current pressure difference data in a DPF, determining a carbon load prediction model corresponding to the current working condition data based on the current working condition data, wherein the carbon load prediction model comprises a corresponding relation between carbon load and pressure difference, determining the carbon load pressure difference according to the current pressure difference data and the ash load pressure difference corresponding to ash load in the DPF, and determining the carbon load in the DPF of the vehicle according to the carbon load prediction model and the carbon load pressure difference. By adopting the method, on one hand, the current working condition and the current pressure difference of the vehicle are considered when the carbon loading is determined, so that the method is more accurate, and on the other hand, the interference of ash loading is eliminated when the carbon loading is determined, so that the accuracy of the determined carbon loading is further improved.

title: Physique identification method and system based on unbalanced weighted cycle_MLP network
description: The invention discloses a constitution identification method and a constitution identification system based on an unbalanced weighted cycle_MLP network, which are characterized in that facial images and corresponding constitution type labels are obtained, and cognition information semantics of five-sense organ features are constructed aiming at the facial images under each constitution type; constructing a cycle_MLP network, and training the cycle_MLP network by using face images, cognition information semantics and corresponding physique categories and taking unbalanced weighted cross entropy based on European space and hyperbolic space as a loss function; and performing constitution identification by using the trained cycle_MLP network. According to the constitution identification method disclosed by the invention, under the condition of limited tag data, the accurate identification of constitution is realized; and introducing a hyperbolic space cross entropy loss function to construct an unbalanced classification average binary cross entropy loss function so as to fully consider the problem of uneven distribution of label data.

title: A motion capture missing data recovery method combining graph neural network and bone length constraints
description: The invention discloses a dynamic capture missing data recovery method combining a graph neural network and bone length constraint, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a skeleton diagram with joints as diagram nodes and natural connection of human body structures as edges; s2, a graph neural network based on a skeleton graph, wherein an encoder takes joint coordinate vectors of graph nodes as input, performs multi-layer space graph rolling operation on input data to generate a higher-level feature graph, and reconstructs output of the higher-level feature graph by using the fully-connected neural network; s3, dividing the human skeleton structure into a plurality of bone block chains, and forming bone length constraint by excavating a bone length constraint relation among nodes in the bone block chains; s4, a marker selection algorithm based on skeleton length constraint, and restoring the missing point coordinates which are more in line with the human body structure in the motion sequence through joint constraint learning; the method improves the recovery precision of the coordinates of the missing points and the recovery precision of the bone length, and has stronger robustness on the length of the missing gaps and the number of the missing marks.

title: An image restoration method and system
description: The invention discloses an image restoration method and system, which utilize three different image restoration models of a deformed convolution attention network, a non-local enhancement network and a high-frequency enhanced dual-branch network to better restore the detail and texture information of a damaged image, and can verify the advancement of the damaged image by applying the three different image restoration models to common image restoration tasks, including synthetic noise removal, real image denoising, compression artifact removal and real image super-resolution.

title: Spatiotemporal big data in-depth analysis method and system based on knowledge graph
description: The application relates to the technical field of space-time data analysis, and particularly discloses a space-time big data depth analysis method and a system based on a knowledge graph, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises a basic configuration module, a historical data table structure forming module, a format labeling module, a classification template construction module, a classification template configuration module, a semantic analysis model construction module, a classification matrix construction module, a guide link construction module and an identification module; before classifying by using the knowledge graph, the application constructs a data export mechanism, exports the data from the database according to a set table structure, limits the data structure characteristics, enables the exported data to be space-time data, directly filters other data, classifies and marks the data according to a set format when classifying by using the knowledge graph, and analyzes the relevance among different data characteristics by carrying out corresponding semantic analysis and relation extraction through a set semantic analysis model.

title: Quantum circuit processing methods, devices and electronic equipment
description: The disclosure provides a quantum circuit processing method, a quantum circuit processing device and electronic equipment, relates to the technical field of quantum computing, and particularly relates to the technical field of quantum circuits. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: acquiring a first instruction list of a first quantum circuit; determining a first directed acyclic graph based on the first list of instructions; determining first connectable information; sequentially determining a second directed edge based on the first directed acyclic graph and the first connectable information, sequentially adding the second directed edge to obtain a second directed acyclic graph, wherein the second directed edge is a candidate directed edge with the largest scoring value among M candidate directed edges, the scoring value is used for representing the maximum value in the number of the directed edges from an output node to an input node in a third directed acyclic graph, and the third directed acyclic graph is obtained after adding the candidate directed edge in the first directed acyclic graph; and based on the second directed acyclic graph, the first target list and the first instruction list, performing equivalent compiling on the first quantum circuit to obtain a second instruction list of the second quantum circuit.

title: Power grid work ticket evaluation system based on semantic inference
description: The application discloses a semantic inference-based power grid work ticket evaluation system, which relates to the technical field of power grid work ticket evaluation and comprises a data acquisition module, an analysis model building module, a data set building module, a comprehensive analysis module and an early warning module; the data acquisition module acquires information when the power grid work ticket evaluation system processes the power grid work ticket data by using natural language processing and semantic reasoning technology. According to the application, the information of the grid work ticket data is analyzed by the grid work ticket evaluation system by utilizing natural language processing and semantic reasoning technology, when the accuracy of system data processing is possibly affected, workers are prompted to timely check and maintain the grid work ticket evaluation system, so that the situation that accurate evaluation indexes, risk prompts and improvement suggestions cannot be provided due to the fact that the accuracy is reduced when the grid work ticket evaluation system performs data processing is effectively prevented, and a user can know the problem and the solution of the work ticket more accurately.

title: Ultra-long multidimensional time sequence classification method based on double-layer nested LSTM
description: The invention discloses an ultra-long multi-dimensional time sequence classification method based on double-layer nested LSTM, which comprises the steps of obtaining an ultra-long multi-dimensional time sequence data set, connecting an input layer, a network synthesized by connecting i LSTM networks in parallel, an LSTM network, a full-connection layer, a Batch Normalization layer and a Softmax layer in series to obtain a double-layer nested LSTM model, inputting a time sequence of a known category into the double-layer nested LSTM model as training data to carry out classification training, and using the trained double-layer nested LSTM model to carry out classification recognition on a target time sequence of an unknown category. The method is suitable for the ultra-long multidimensional time series in various practical application scenes, can effectively process the ultra-long time series data acquired from the practical scenes, and can not cause the problems of long training time, slow parameter updating, even gradient disappearance and the like.

title: A traffic sign detection method based on improved Yolov4-tiny algorithm
description: The present invention proposes a traffic sign detection method based on an improved Yolov4‑tiny algorithm, which is used to solve the technical problem of poor traffic sign detection effect in complex scenes; the steps are: first, a traffic sign data set is obtained and divided into a training set, a validation set and a test set; secondly, a convolutional neural network model of the improved Yolov4‑tiny algorithm is constructed; and the training set and the validation set are input into the convolutional neural network model of the improved Yolov4‑tiny algorithm for training and verification; finally, the test set is input into the convolutional neural network model of the trained improved Yolov4‑tiny algorithm for performance testing, and the convolutional neural network detection model with the best performance is saved according to the evaluation index; and the convolutional neural network detection model is used to detect traffic annotated images. The present invention effectively improves the quality of the traffic sign data set, optimizes the training effect of the deep learning model, and the method of the present invention has a good detection effect on small target traffic signs.

title: Brain-like perception-learning-decision system and method
description: The invention discloses a brain-like perception-learning-decision-making system and a brain-like perception-learning-decision-making method, and belongs to the field of human brain simulation. The perception cortex module integrates at least one perception information, the gating module automatically encodes and outputs a control signal according to the integrated perception pulse sequence and the latest control signal, the control signal can be used for selecting task paths of the rewarding and decision-making module and the cognitive map building module, the rewarding and decision-making module can generate decision-making signals when being selected, the cognitive map building module can continuously build a cognitive map when being selected, and the user interaction module displays concrete contents represented by the decision-making signals and/or displays the built cognitive map in an image mode. The automatic coding of the gating module realizes the independent learning decision-making action of the environmental information received by the human brain, and the gating module enables a plurality of brain areas with independent functions to exist in parallel in one system, thereby realizing the cooperative scheduling among the plurality of independent brain areas.

title: Optimization method for evaporation waveguide prediction model parameters
description: The invention relates to the field of evaporation waveguides, and discloses an optimization method of evaporation waveguide prediction model parameters, which comprises the following steps: installing meteorological hydrological sensors by utilizing an offshore observation platform, and measuring meteorological hydrological data at different heights from the sea surface in a layered manner; constructing an evaporation waveguide prediction model by using a combination of a sea surface roughness parameterization scheme and a stability universal function, and selecting a model with highest prediction result accuracy as a model to be optimized; and (3) taking the reference modified atmosphere refractive index profile and the predicted modified atmosphere refractive index profile output by the model before optimization as inputs of a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and taking the root mean square of the deviation between the reference modified atmosphere refractive index profile and the predicted modified atmosphere refractive index profile as a particle fitness calculation standard, and iteratively obtaining the optimal value of the parameter to be optimized of the evaporation waveguide predicted model. The method disclosed by the invention can improve the temperature and humidity of the near-sea atmosphere, correct the accuracy of the atmospheric refractive index profile prediction result and improve the applicability of the model in a target sea area.

title: A point cloud completion method based on low-quality denoising and multi-level upsampling
description: The invention discloses a point cloud complement method based on low-quality denoising and multi-stage up-sampling, the method comprises the steps of designing, constructing and training a self-encoder module, a neighborhood self-adaptive denoising module and a multi-stage up-sampling module. In the completion process, the incomplete point cloud first generates a sparse coarse complete point cloud by the self-encoder module, which has only global shape, lacking fine geometric details. And then denoising the sparse rough whole point cloud through a neighborhood self-adaptive module, so that most noise points are removed, and the geometric structure is clearer. And finally, inputting the denoised point cloud into a multi-stage up-sampling module to obtain a dense complete point cloud. Compared with the prior art, the point cloud completion method can generate dense complete point cloud with fine geometric details while maintaining the geometric structure of the residual point cloud, and has no noise points or a small number of noise points at the slender structure.

title: A multi-stage image description device with sparsity
description: A multi-stage image description device with sparsity includes: a device for performing preliminary feature extraction on an image to be described using a convolutional neural network to obtain first feature information of the image to be described; a device for inputting the first feature information into a multi-stage feature enhancement network based on a Transformer with sparsity to obtain second feature information of the image to be described, which contains global and semantic information; and a device for inputting the second feature information into a decoder composed of a Transformer and a maximum output module to obtain a textual representation of the image to be described. The device can improve the representation of detailed visual information, highlight important objects, and generate higher-quality sentences.

title: Multi-mode image segmentation model and method based on spatial attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses a multi-mode image segmentation model and a multi-mode image segmentation method based on a spatial attention mechanism. A multi-mode image segmentation model based on a spatial attention mechanism comprises an encoder module, a decoder module, a jump connection module, a spatial attention module and a feature selection module, wherein the encoder module and the decoder module are used for extracting features and recovering images, the jump connection module is used for splicing feature graphs between the encoder module and the decoder module, and the spatial attention module is used for strengthening attention weights. According to the multi-mode image segmentation model and method based on the spatial attention mechanism, the model and the method can integrate multi-mode image information, the weight of each mode is adaptively adjusted by using the spatial attention mechanism, and the model is optimized through different loss function ratios, so that the problem of feature missing in the model is solved, and the model focuses on more important areas.

title: A propagation source localization method based on encoder and decoder framework
description: The present invention discloses a method for locating a transmission source based on an encoder and decoder framework, belonging to the technical field of cyberspace security information tracing technology, comprising the following steps: inputting a set of time-varying transmission subgraphs; evaluating the influence transfer matrix between any two users; evaluating the coarse-grained probability characteristics of each node; constructing the dynamic infection characteristics of each node; constructing the topological characteristics of each node; aggregating the characteristics of all nodes at timestamp sj; using a bidirectional GRU to predict the transmission source of time series data at all timestamps; using a multi-headed temporal attention mechanism to correct the transmission source prediction probability of any node v at different timestamps; and outputting the group of nodes with the highest probability as the predicted transmission source. The present invention solves the problem of poor positioning accuracy caused by ignoring the impact of heterogeneous user behavior interactions on transmission, and achieves accurate positioning for complex user behavior interaction scenarios in social networks.

title: SAR ship target classification method based on multi-scale cross-polarization attention network
description: This invention provides a SAR ship target classification method based on a multi-scale cross-polarity attention network, belonging to the field of radar target recognition technology. This invention addresses the problems of limited available information in SAR images, the presence of speckle noise, trailing noise, and insufficient utilization of polarization information. It utilizes FBC (Free-Banded Pooling) for fusion, achieving better results compared to grouped bilinear pooling. Furthermore, the use of multi-scale information overcomes the disadvantage of limited SAR ship information, fully utilizing contextual information. Cross-polarity attention, compared to channel attention and spatial attention, is more suitable for SAR ship classification, allowing the two polarities to guide each other and fully utilize their complementary information. Adaptive adjustment of loss weights in network training leads to a more balanced approach, improving the effectiveness of the network framework in extracting SAR ship target features and enhancing classification performance.

title: A photovoltaic power prediction method based on multi-scale spatiotemporal graph attention convolutional network
description: The present invention discloses a photovoltaic power prediction method based on a multi-scale spatiotemporal graph attention convolutional network, obtains a real historical operation data set of a photovoltaic power station, uses mutual information entropy to perform correlation analysis between the main meteorological factors in NWP and photovoltaic power, screens out the meteorological factors with the highest degree of correlation, and uses a matrix filling algorithm to correct them; establishes a spatiotemporal graph attention convolutional network model, first constructs an attribute graph to capture the dynamic characteristics of photovoltaic power generation in time and space, extracts spatial features from the attribute graph through a multi-layer graph attention network, and uses a temporal convolutional network to mine time-related features from the attribute graph; uses an improved sequential model optimization algorithm to optimize the hyperparameters of the prediction model; finally, constructs a neural network full connection layer that fuses multi-source data, thereby predicting photovoltaic power generation. The present invention improves the prediction accuracy of power generation of photovoltaic power stations in a region.

title: Training device and method for text processing model
description: The present invention discloses a training device and method for a text processing model, which belongs to the technical field of model training, and includes: a text acquisition module, a text processing module, a model training module, an evaluation optimization module and a data storage module. The present invention solves the problem that the existing text processing model cannot pre-process the text data when training the text data, resulting in a large text data training load, and cannot be optimized and adjusted in real time according to the text data training situation, resulting in poor training effect of the text processing model. The present invention performs comprehensive processing on the text data set to be trained, determines the text feature data, can pre-process the text data, reduce the text data training load, and optimizes the text processing model accordingly based on the text processing model optimization method, can perform real-time optimization and adjustment according to the text data training situation, and improves the text processing model training effect.

title: A multi-stage train trackside component detection method
description: The invention discloses a multi-stage train rail edge component detection method. First, coarse target detection is performed on the train rail edge image to detect large-scale components existing in the original image and areas where small-scale components exist with high confidence. Then the small-scale parts area is cut out from the original image, and then the cut-out small-scale parts area image is generated to generate a series of slices that need to be finely detected. The small-scale parts present in the slices are finely detected to obtain the small-scale parts. The test results of parts are then integrated with the previous test results of large-scale parts to obtain the final test results. The invention includes two detection stages from coarse to fine, which improves the detection accuracy of components of various sizes. At the same time, only the areas where small-scale components exist with high confidence are subjected to secondary fine detection, ensuring detection efficiency. It lays the foundation for subsequent automated detection of component anomalies.

title: Self-calibration methods, devices, equipment, and media for human eye line deviation parameters
description: This application relates to the field of human eye gaze estimation technology, and provides a self-calibration method, apparatus, device, and medium for human eye gaze deviation parameters. Since the final gaze predicted in this application's embodiments is based on a gaze unrelated to the user's identity (i.e., the initial gaze) and a gaze related to the user's identity (i.e., the human eye gaze deviation parameters), and these parameters can be continuously optimized during user use, this application's embodiments can improve the accuracy of gaze estimation. Furthermore, since this application's embodiments perform gradient backpropagation based on intersection point error loss, i.e., using the geometric constraints of the gaze as a supervision signal, this application's embodiments do not require separate collection of the user's gaze label samples before the user uses the gaze estimation system. Instead, the human eye gaze deviation parameters can be continuously learned during user use, and as the number of samples increases, the human eye gaze deviation parameters will become increasingly accurate.

title: Classical computer, information processing method, and computer-readable recording medium
description: The result confirmation unit (204) calculates a state space probability that is a probability that the verification target device (300) has incorrectly prepared a state space in which the quantum state is stored, a Brinell measurement probability that is a probability that the verification target device (300) has incorrectly performed Brinell Z measurement and Brinell X measurement, and a magic state probability that is a probability that the verification target device (300) has not generated a magic state of the CCZ. Then, the result confirmation unit (204) calculates the approximation degree of the quantum state in the verification object device (300) and the magic state of the CCZ and the measurement precision of the Brix measurement and the Brix Z measurement for the quantum state in the verification object device (300) by using the state space probability, the Brix measurement probability and the magic state probability.

title: Robotic arm painting method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The disclosed embodiment provides a robot arm painting method, device, electronic device and storage medium, the robot arm painting method comprising: receiving target painting data, wherein the target painting data comprises prompt words or images; using a pre-trained image generation model to generate a target image based on the prompt words or images, wherein the image generation model is trained based on a preset painting image set, the visual elements of the painting images in the painting image set are lines and brushstrokes, and the image generated by the image generation model has similar visual elements to the painting images in the painting image set; and controlling the robot arm to draw the target image. The disclosed embodiment enables the robot arm to paint faster and better, or improves the fun and creativity of the robot arm painting.

title: Data security processing method and system based on data classification template
description: The application provides a data security processing method and a system based on a data classification template, which are characterized in that an initial data set is obtained and is converted into a data matrix to be classified by utilizing the data classification template; performing multiple feature extraction on the data matrix to be classified through multiple convolution layers by utilizing a feature extractor to obtain multiple sampling feature matrixes; adjusting one or more characteristic element values in each sampling characteristic matrix by using an attention adjuster in the data classification template, and converting the plurality of adjusted sampling characteristic matrices into at least one attention matrix; utilizing a classifier in a data classification template, and carrying out up-sampling on at least one attention matrix for a plurality of times through a plurality of transposed convolution layers in a preset neural network to obtain a data classification matrix; and obtaining the security category of each item of data in the initial data set according to each data classification value and at least one classification threshold value in the data classification matrix, and carrying out security processing on each item of data according to the security category.

title: Method and device for selecting low-voltage electrical apparatus components, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a method, device, computer equipment, storage medium and computer program product for selecting low-voltage electrical components. The method comprises: obtaining the required parameters for the input of components on the motor circuit; generating selection information options matching the required parameters according to the selection information of multiple components stored in the selection information library; obtaining the selection information selected based on the selection information options; obtaining the selection scheme information corresponding to the motor circuit according to the selected selection information; the selection scheme information contains the target selection information of each component on the motor circuit. The use of this method can improve the accuracy of the selection of low-voltage electrical components on the motor circuit.

title: Voice user emotion recognition method based on AI intelligent neural network
description: The invention provides a voice user emotion recognition method based on an AI intelligent neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining voice characteristic information of each short sentence in dialogue content to be recognized, processing the voice characteristic information of each short sentence based on a first long-short-term memory network model to obtain context semantic characteristics of each short sentence, inputting voice characteristic information of a plurality of short sentences into a second long-short-term memory network model, extracting to obtain speaking state characteristics of a short sentence sender, determining the sender switching state of the short sentence based on the sender of each short sentence and the corresponding sender of the last short sentence, and determining emotion recognition results of each short sentence according to the context voice characteristics of each short sentence, the speaking state characteristics of the short sentence sender and the sender switching state.

title: Electric vehicle charging management system and method based on low temperature compensation
description: The present application relates to the field of electric vehicle charging management, and specifically discloses an electric vehicle charging management system and method based on low temperature compensation, which adopts artificial intelligence monitoring technology based on deep learning to identify the characteristics of the electric vehicle operation and its environment by extracting features of the battery's current, power, capacity and ambient temperature, and then passes these features through a classifier to obtain monitoring results of whether the charging current needs to be increased. In this way, by intelligently monitoring the charging status of the charging pile and judging the environment to take timely measures, the charging efficiency can be effectively prevented from being affected by the low temperature environment.

title: Photovoltaic output prediction method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The application discloses a photovoltaic output prediction method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the photovoltaic output prediction method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of first historical satellite cloud pictures in a first preset time period in a first target area; the method comprises the steps of extracting first historical cloud blocking characteristics in a first historical satellite cloud chart, predicting cloud blocking characteristics in a second preset time period according to the first historical cloud blocking characteristics, obtaining first weather information in the second preset time period, and inputting the cloud blocking characteristics and the first weather information into a preset model to obtain a photovoltaic output predicted value, wherein the preset model is obtained based on ConvTransformer model training. Therefore, the prediction accuracy of the photovoltaic output is improved.

title: An electronic component storage data analysis system and method based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention discloses an electronic component storage data analysis system and method based on artificial intelligence, which belongs to the technical field of chip data analysis, and comprises a chip data acquisition module, a data management center, a history processing analysis module, a data cleaning management module and a storage data sorting and planning module. The chip data acquisition module is used to collect historical data of data cleaned in the chip and data storage information of the chip. The data management center stores and manages all the collected data. The history processing analysis module is used to analyze the historical data of data cleaned in the chip and generate training samples. The data cleaning management module is used to establish a data cleaning prediction model, predict the next time when chip data cleaning is required and perform data cleaning. The storage data sorting and planning module is used to compare the utilization value of the information stored in the chip, screen out part of the data in the chip for deletion, and continuously ensure the normal and convenient use of the navigation chip.

title: A construction engineering consulting allocation method and system based on big data
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for allocating construction engineering consultation based on big data, which relates to the technical field of engineering consultation. The method and system obtain consultation requests from several consultants, generate consultation tasks corresponding to the consultation requests, and allocate the consultation tasks to several preset submission ports, which upload the consultation tasks to a cloud server through the submission ports; adaptively configure the resources of the cloud server, extract consultation keywords corresponding to the consultation tasks through data mining after the configuration is completed, import the consultation keywords into a preset construction engineering knowledge base, and allocate consultation plans corresponding to the consultation tasks; obtain the communication authority of the consultant corresponding to the consultation task, and judge whether the consultant has consultation expansion needs, thereby generating different judgment results, performing different processing operations according to the judgment results, and generating a final consultation plan after the processing operations are completed, thereby realizing efficient and accurate allocation of construction engineering consultation.

title: Augmented reality anchor point placement method, device, electronic device and readable storage medium
description: The application provides an augmented reality anchor point placement method, an augmented reality anchor point placement device, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a neural radiation field NeRF model and an initial Augmented Reality (AR) point cloud of a scene to be mapped; acquiring M images and first pose data of the M images based on the NeRF models, wherein the M images are images rendered by the NeRF models, and M is an integer greater than 1; calculating the feature point number corresponding to each image in the M images, and determining a target image in the M images, wherein the feature point number corresponding to the target image accords with a preset condition; and placing anchor points in the initial AR point cloud based on the target image and the first pose data of the target image so as to generate a target AR point cloud. The method and the device can improve the flexibility of establishing the target AR point cloud placement anchor point.

title: An unmanned loading method and system based on laser radar data
description: The present invention relates to the field of unmanned loading, and in particular to an unmanned loading method and system based on laser radar data. In order to realize automatic loading by automating the manual loading system of coal mine washing plants, the purpose of reducing labor intensity, improving the working environment, reducing staff and increasing efficiency, and improving working efficiency is achieved. The present invention determines whether the vehicle information is consistent through the pre-recorded information and the actual information of the vehicle, and judges the actual information of the vehicle to determine the optimal parking position and material level height of the vehicle; according to the analysis results, the voice and traffic light prompt device sends a moving instruction to the driver to guide the vehicle to move to the designated position, and controls the opening of the material port by adjusting the hydraulic telescopic mechanism of the material port, directing the vehicle to complete the loading operation, and realizing the fine management of the unmanned loading process; the present application not only significantly improves the accuracy and efficiency of loading, but also reduces the uncertainty of manual operation and improves the safety of the operation.

title: Target area sketching method, model training method, device and equipment
description: The application discloses a target area sketching method, a model training method, a device and equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining medical image data of a target area to be sketched; the method comprises the steps of calling a trained image segmentation model, inputting medical image data to output a corresponding target region sketching result and a corresponding pin segmentation result, wherein the image segmentation model comprises a target region sketching network for outputting the target region sketching result and a pin segmentation network for outputting the pin segmentation result, the target region sketching network and the pin segmentation network share at least partial parameters, and correcting the target region sketching result based on set dose planning data and the pin segmentation result. The method and the device realize full-automatic segmentation of the target area and the inserting needle simultaneously by building the multi-task network model comprising the target area sketching network and the inserting needle segmentation network, so that the segmentation capability of the image segmentation model is improved integrally, and the sketching result of the target area can be corrected based on dose planning data and the inserting needle segmentation result.

title: A detection method for small remote sensing targets based on improved YOLO
description: The present invention belongs to the field of image detection, and specifically relates to a detection method for remote sensing small targets based on improved YOLO. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, obtaining a remote sensing small target detection data set, and randomly dividing the remote sensing small target detection data set into a training set, a validation set and a test set according to a preset ratio; step 2, building a YOLO-tiny network model; step 3, inputting the training set and the validation set into the YOLO-tiny network model for training and verification, obtaining the training weight file of the YOLO-tiny network model, and iteratively optimizing the training weight file through forward and backward propagation based on the loss function, and obtaining the trained YOLO-tiny network model; step 4, inputting the test set into the trained YOLO-tiny network model, and performing and completing remote sensing small target detection. The present invention reconstructs the existing loss function, and when detecting remote sensing small targets, the detection accuracy can be improved, and the category discrimination error rate can be reduced, thereby meeting the actual detection needs.

title: Computer-implemented method for determining an operational property of a drill-rod borehole pump, and analysis device and pump system for same
description: The invention relates to a computer-implemented method for determining an operational property of a drill-rod borehole pump (1). The pump (1) has a pump head (110, 111) which is connected to a kinematic converter (120) via a drill rod (5, 10), and the kinematic converter (120) is driven by a motor (3) during operation. A load-distance diagram with curve points for the pump (1) is ascertained by an analysis device (140) using a detection means (130) and is provided as an operational load-distance diagram (DC1-DC5) with operational curve points, wherein in a training mode, at least one model load-distance diagram with respective model curve points is provided by the analysis device (140), said model load-distance diagram being normalized to a specified reference variable, and for at least one sub-quantity of the model curve points, a model is generated and trained on the basis of a Kohonen network with elliptical Fourier descriptors; and in an operating mode, the operational curve points are normalized to the reference variable, elliptical Fourier descriptors are determined for the operational curve points, and a check is carried out to determine whether a similarity exists between the elliptical Fourier descriptors of the operational curve points and the model of the Kohonen network, and if so, the operational property of the pump (1) is determined therefrom.

title: Neural networks with hierarchical attention memory
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for performing a machine learning task on a network input to generate a network output. One of the systems includes an attention neural network comprising one or more hierarchical attention blocks, each hierarchical attention block configured to: receive an input sequence for the hierarchical attention block; maintain a 5 plurality of memory summary keys, each memory summary key corresponding to a respective one of a plurality of partitions of a sequence of memory block inputs; determine a proper subset of the plurality of memory summary keys; and generate an attended input sequence for the hierarchical attention block including applying an attention mechanism over the respective memory block inputs at the memory positions within the partitions of 10 the sequence of memory block inputs that correspond to the proper subset of the plurality of memory summary keys.

title: Method and system for detecting a data attack on a vehicle using deep learning methods
description: The invention relates to a method and a system (1) for detecting a data attack on a vehicle (2). In order to improve the detection of a data attack on the vehicle (2), in the method, a data stream is read (G2) by a data-reading device (16, 116, 216) of the vehicle (2) and/or a security-related event which occurs on a device (9) installed on the vehicle (2) is recorded (J) by an event-logging device (109) of the vehicle (2). The read data stream and/or an item of event information representing the recorded event are transmitted to a land-side or vehicle-side detection device (19) via a communication link (7, 30, 130). With the help of an artificial neural network, a land-side device (105) forms a model that detects whether the transmitted data stream and/or the event information relates to a data attack on the vehicle (2). A computer program representing the model is used on the land-side or vehicle-side detection device (19) for an application for detecting a data attack.

title: Neural network guided motion correction in magnetic resonance imaging
description: Described herein is a medical system (100, 300) comprising a memory (110) storing machine executable instructions (120) and a motion estimating neural network (122, 700, 800, 900, 1000) configured for outputting trajectory data (130) in response to receiving a trial motion trajectory (128) as input. The execution of the machine executable instructions causes a computational system (104) to: receive (200) measured k-space data (124) descriptive of a subject (318); perform (202) motion estimation of the subject between the sequence of discrete acquisitions by solving an optimization problem to determine a calculated motion trajectory of the subject in the predefined coordinate system, wherein the optimization problem is modified using the trajectory data; and reconstruct (204) a final motion corrected magnetic resonance image (136) from the measured k-space data and the calculated motion trajectory in the predefined coordinate system.

title: Platooning control device and platooning control method
description: A platooning control device includes: a learning device configured to perform reinforcement learning on the basis of image information and a feedback signal and to control a pertinent vehicle so as to follow a traveling trajectory of a front vehicle according to a result of the reinforcement learning; and a compensation determination unit configured to receive a coordinate of a control point regarding the traveling trajectory of the front vehicle from the front vehicle and to compare a coordinate of the pertinent vehicle with the coordinate of the control point, thereby generating the feedback signal.

title: System and method for training of neural network model for control of high dimensional physical systems
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method of training a neural network model for controlling an operation of a system represented by partial differential equations (PDEs). The method comprises collecting digital representation of time series data indicative of measurements of the operation of the system at different instances of time. The method further comprises training the neural network model having an autoencoder architecture including an encoder to encode the digital representation into a latent space, a linear predictor to propagate the digital representation into the latent space, and a decoder to decode the digital representation to minimize a loss function including a prediction error between outputs of the neural network model decoding measurements of the operation at an instant of time and measurements of the operation collected at a subsequent instance of time, and a residual factor of the PDE having eigenvalues dependent on parameters of the linear predictor.

title: System and method for video on video overlay
description: A second video may be overlaid on or inserted in a first video in a non-obstructive manner. A location for the second video within the first video may be determined based on analyzing non-essential locations in sequential frames in the first video. The second video may be selected from a plurality of candidate videos based on parameters of the second video, such as size, duration, context, etc. Accordingly, the second video may be displayed simultaneously with the first video by nesting the second video within the first video, while providing a streamlined viewing experience and minimizing distraction.

title: Method and a system for interacting with physical devices via an artificial-reality device
description: An Artificial Reality (AR) device captures an image of a physical environment surrounding a user wearing the AR device. A three-dimensional map corresponding to the physical environment is accessed. Then, a pose of the AR device relative to the three-dimensional map is determined based on first features of physical objects captured in the image and second features of object representations in the three-dimensional map. The device determines, using an eye tracker, a gaze of an eye of the user. Based on the gaze and the pose, a region of interest is computed in the three-dimensional map. Representations of physical devices in the region of interest of the three-dimensional map are identified. The device determines an intent of the user to interact with a physical device. A command is issued to the physical device based on the determined intent.

title: Selecting materials of components of a product to be manufactured
description: The disclosure notably relates to a computer-implemented method for selecting materials of components of a product to be manufactured. The method comprises providing a set of materials for the components of the product. The method also comprises providing, for each component, a set of use and/or manufacturing and/or material constraints for the component. The method also comprises providing, for the product, a set of use and/or manufacturing constraints for the product. The method also comprises providing, for the product, one or more material compatibility constraints. The method also comprises providing specifications. The specifications indicate an extent of compatibility of one or more reference materials within the set of materials with the constraints. The method also comprises determining, for each component of the product, at least one optimal material, with respect to compatibility with the constraints and based on the provided specifications, for manufacturing the component.

title: Reinforcement learning to explore environments using meta policies
description: The invention describes the method performed by one or more computers and for training a base policy neural network that is configured to receive a base policy input comprising an observation of a state of an environment and to process the policy input to generate a base policy output that defines an action to be performed by an agent in response to the observation, the method comprising: generating training data for training the base policy neural network by controlling an agent using (i) the base policy neural network and (ii) an exploration strategy that maps, in accordance with a set of one or more parameters, base policy outputs generated by the base policy neural network to actions performed by the agent to interact with an environment, the generating comprising, at each of a plurality of time points: determining that criteria for updating the exploration strategy are satisfied at the time point; and in response to determining that the criteria are satisfied: generating a meta policy input that comprises data characterizing a performance of the base policy neural network in controlling the agent at the time point; processing the meta policy input using a meta policy to generate a meta policy output that specifies respective values for each of the set of one or more parameters that define the exploration strategy; and controlling the agent using the base policy neural network and in accordance with the exploration strategy defined by the respective values for the set of one or more parameters specified by the meta policy output.

title: Automated refactoring of embedded software code
description: A first aspect of the present disclosure relates to a computer-implemented method for the automated refactoring of software code, comprising refactoring, via a machine learning model, the software code at least based on the code and a prompt, wherein the code is refactored; and evaluating the refactored code, resulting in an evaluation result. A second aspect of the present disclosure relates to a computer-implemented method for further training a machine learning model and/or another machine learning model, wherein the machine learning model is configured to refactor software code at least based on the code and a prompt, and the another machine learning model is configured to generate at least one refactoring suggestion for refactoring the code at least based on the code and a further prompt; the method comprising adapting the machine learning model and/or another machine learning model at least based on at least one refactored code and at least one evaluation result, wherein the at least one evaluation result results from evaluating the at least one refactored code.

title: Method and system to coordinate agents and avoid conflicts
description: A method is provided for coordinating nodes in a radio access network to optimize radio network operations.
