The method includes obtaining a topology of a plurality of network nodes in the radio access network. The method includes obtaining, for each network node of the plurality of network nodes, a plurality of potential actions each network node can perform in the radio access network to optimize one or more radio network operations. The method includes obtaining, for each network node of the plurality of network nodes, an optimization function. The method includes determining an action from the plurality of potential actions for a first network node of the plurality of network nodes to perform based on the plurality of potential actions and an optimization function.

title: Hearing device with low power neural network
description: A hearing device and related method is disclosed, the hearing device comprising a set of input transducers for provision of transducer input data, the set of input transducers comprising a first input transducer for provision of a first transducer input signal as part of the transducer input data; a processor for processing transducer input data and providing an electrical output signal based on the transducer input data; and a receiver for converting the electrical output signal to an audio output signal, wherein the processor is configured to apply a neural network to a network input based on the transducer input data for provision of a network output, the electrical output signal based on the network output, wherein the network input has a first data type and weights of the neural network have a second data type different from the first data type.

title: Computer-implemented method for updating a teacher-student framework
description: A computer-implemented method (20) for updating a teacher-student framework comprising a teacher model (T) and a student model (S), the computer-implemented method (20) comprising selecting (21), for a given test sample, the most confident model (S, T) among the student model (S) and the teacher model (T) based on a maximum logit score to generate a pseudo label for said test sample; updating (22) initial parameters (θ) of the student model (S) based on the generated pseudo-label and updating initial parameters (θ') of the teacher model (T) based on the updated parameters (θ n ) of the student model (S).

title: Recipe converter
description: A method (200) for operating a household appliance (155) to carry out a predetermined household task comprises steps of determining functional capabilities of the household appliance (155); providing an LLM (130) that is trained to perform linguistic operations on an input text; reading into the LLM (130) a text-based, especially generic, recipe for carrying out said household task; and causing or triggering or prompting the LLM (130) to generate, based on the text-based recipe, operating instructions for operating the household appliance (155); such that the household appliance (155) can be operated on the basis of said generated instructions to carry out said household task.

title: Safe personalized super intelligence (psi)
description: Personalized SuperIntelligence (PSI) represents the next leap forward in the development of advanced, autonomous, artificial intelligence agents. However, because of their extreme intelligence, PSIs also represent a dangerous potential threat to human safety. This invention discloses how to design and construct such agents safely. It also shows how to use them safely as part of a SuperIntelligent Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) system. Preferred implementations, including methods that enable PSIs to rapidly improve themselves, with or without human oversight, are disclosed. The invention describes how to produce different versions of PSIs using several novel methods. Methods for implementing scalable safety checks that operate effectively even when PSIs become much smarter than their human creators are also described. Finally, a completely new approach to AI safety, which relies on a community of PSIs combined with proven blockchain methods, is disclosed. Rather than relying on testing, the invention promotes PSI safety by design.

title: Method and system for specifying model on basis of artificial intelligence model including plurality of models
description: A method for specifying a model based on an artificial intelligence model including a plurality of models according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: performing MoE (Mixture of Experts) architecture-based training based on an artificial intelligence model which is a combination of a plurality of specialized models and a router (gating network); obtaining specialized model feature information which is information that specifies features of the specialized models based on the performed MoE architecture-based training; generating a specialized module model which is a specialized model that is matched with the obtained specialized model feature information and is independent and discrete; obtaining given domain information; detecting specialized model feature information of a feature corresponding to the obtained domain information; extracting a specialized module model that is matched with the detected specialized model feature information; constructing a DMoE model which is an artificial intelligence model which is a combination of the extracted specialized module model and the router; and providing output data for given input data based on the constructed DMoE model.

title: Method and apparatus for predicting life of battery by using artificial intelligence
description: The apparatus for predicting a life of a battery by using an artificial intelligence model includes a memory storing at least one program and at least one processor configured to execute the at least one program to generate a combined vector by using subvectors derived from time series data and discrete data, which are related to charging and discharging of the battery, input, as input data, the generated combined vector to a battery life prediction model and determine whether a capacity prediction value of the battery, obtained as output data of the battery life prediction model, is less than or equal to a preset value, and derive a life prediction value for the battery in response to a result of determining that the capacity prediction value of the battery is less than or equal to the preset value.

title: Parkinson's tremor classification using machine learning
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on a computer storage medium, for classifying a tremor of a subject having Parkinson's disease. In one aspect, there is provided a method comprising: receiving accelerometer data characterizing motion of the subject having Parkinson's disease; processing the accelerometer data using a tremor classification neural network, in accordance with values of a set of tremor classification neural network parameters, to generate a score distribution over a set of tremor classes, wherein the set of tremor classes comprises multiple tremor classes, wherein each tremor class in the set of tremor classes corresponds to a respective severity of tremor; and classifying a tremor of the subject having Parkinson's disease based on the score distribution over the set of tremor classes.

title: Multi-objective genetic optimization method
description: A multi-objective optimisation method. The method comprises a population of objects for each objective utilising an optimisation process 108, 110 and determining a measure for the variation in values of each gene within each population. A crossbreed 114 between objects from different ones of the populations is performed, wherein a selection of gene values for the child object 112 is weighted based on the measures for the variations in the values of each gene within the respective populations.

title: Processing a complex problem using one of a plurality of different solvers
description: The present invention relates to a method and a tool that allows the user to define a complex problem using the tools with which they are familiar but allows the optimal solution to be found using one of a range of different solvers without the user having expert knowledge of the underlying solver. The user defined rules are received in a rules engine 3 and applied to problem data. A common solver problem is generated by a rule adapter 13 in a middleware component 11 using the rules. The common solver problem is then provided to one of plurality of different solver engines 5,7,9 using a respective solver adapter 15. The most appropriate solver 5,7,9 for that problem may be chosen automatically for the user, for example by analyzing the properties of the common solver problem. The rules engine may be business rules engine 19. The solver engines 5,7,9 may be a scheduling engine, an integer programming engine, a mixed integer programming engine, a linear programming engine and a planning engine.

title: Single plane filters
description: Hardware for implementing a deep neural network (DNN) having a convolution layer (i.e. a convolutional neural network) comprises an input buffer 235 which provides data windows to convolution engines 245, each data window comprising a single input plane (which may comprise pixel values from an image). Each convolution engine performs a convolution operation by applying a filter to a data window, each filter comprising a set of weights for combination with respective data values of the data window. Each convolution engine comprises multiplication logic operable to combine a weight of the kernel with a respective data value of the data window, and accumulation logic which accumulates the results of a plurality of combinations performed by the multiplication logic so as to form an output for a respective convolution operation. The weights may be received from weight buffers 240. The neuron engines may only multiply non-zero weights and data values.

title: Systems and methods for generating hash trees and using neural networks to process the same
description: The present disclosure relates to systems and methods for detecting and detecting anomalies within a tree structure. In one implementation, the system may include one or more memories storing instructions and one or more processors configured to execute the instructions. The instructions may include instructions to receive a new data structure related to an individual, convert the data structure into a Bayesian wavelet, using a tree structure of existing Bayesian wavelets, calculate one or more harmonics, determine a measure of whether the Bayesian wavelet alters the one or more harmonics, and add the Bayesian wavelet to the tree structure when the measure is below a threshold.

title: De-centralised learning for re-identification
description: A method or system for generating a domain-generalisable model for target re-identification including : optimising a local feature embedding model (FEM) for domain specific feature representation of a client; receiving at a server information about changes to the local FEM; updating at the server a global FEM based on the changes to the local FEM model at a subset of clients; receiving at the client information about the updates to the global FEM; at the client, mapping onto the local FEM and updating the received updates of the global FEM; repeating the previous steps until convergence criteria for the local FEM are met. The global FEM is the optimised domain-generalisable model for target re-identification. The data on local clients may be independent, non-overlapping data sets. White noise may be applied to the local datasets. Because the local data sets are not shared and only changes to the local feature embedding models are shared with the server, the invention may achieve a level of privacy for local datasets.

title: Feature equivalence and document abnormality threshold determination
description: A method includes, as part of establishing a feature merging threshold (α) for determining equivalence between two features, selecting a set of candidate α values, partitioning training data into a plurality of groups, establishing a model Wα for each α value of the set of candidate α values, iteratively performing: selecting a next group of training data of the plurality of groups of training data; adding the selected next group of training data to a training set; and for each α value in the set of candidate α values: training the Wα for the α value using the training set, and evaluating a size of Wα, the size comprising a number of features included in the model, and choosing the feature merging threshold α based on the iteratively performing.

title: Multiple inertial measurement unit sensor fusion using machine learning
description: Tracking movement of an object is achieved by using a plurality of inertial measurements and extracting features from the inertial measurements. A machine learning algorithm is trained to select inertial measurement data and apply weights to the selected data sets based on the features. The machine learning algorithm is also trained to carry out compensation and fusion of the data sets. The trained machine learning algorithm is then stored and applied to inertial measurements for tracking movement of a navigation object. Training the machine learning algorithm may include performing a convolutional neural network, performing an auto-encoder, converting inertial measurements to the frequency domain, time-domain embedding, or generating a spectrogram. The output may be compared to truth data. In a further disclosure, the neural network may select data from particular sensors.

title: Modifying user interface of application during recording session
description: A computer-implemented method, system and computer program product for recording information in a user interface of an application (105) more desired to be seen and heard by viewers. A user interface of an application (105) is displayed. Upon detecting an initiation of recording the user interface of the application (105), the user interface of the application (105) is modified to ensure that the information desired to be viewed and heard by the viewers is recorded, such as by adjusting a size of a user interface element, adjusting an audio element of the user interface, etc. After such modifications, the modified user interface of the application (105) is recorded and broadcasted to viewers via a video live streaming service (102). In this manner, viewers are able to see and hear information desired to be viewed and heard that may have been previously lost during the recording of the user interface prior to such modifications.

title: Machine learning inference emulation
description: A method for emulating machine learning (ML) inference in a communication network. A ML emulation consumer 134 transmits a ML inference emulator 135, a request for instantiating inference emulation of a ML entity (e.g. a ML mode, neural network, genetic algorithm, or support vector machine) of the communication network 503, the request comprising an identifier of the ML entity. The ML emulation consumer then receives from the ML inference emulator, a ML inference emulation report based on an emulated output of the ML entity 511. The emulated output of the ML entity may be obtained by executing an inference of the ML entity 505 based on a simulated model or portion of the communication network. The validity of the ML entity may be determined based on the emulation report 512 and deployment of the ML entity may be enabled or disabled based on this determination.

title: Multi-layer neural network learning apparatus and control method thereof
description: To efficiently perform learning of a neural network in an adapted domain.SOLUTION: A learning device which learns a multilayer neural network (multilayer NN) includes: first learning means which learns a first multilayer NN by using a first data group; first generation means which generates a second multilayer NN in which a conversion unit which performs predetermined processing is added between a first layer in the first multilayer NN and a second layer following the first layer; and second learning means which learns the second multilayer NN by using a second data group having the property different from that of the first data group.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

title: Substance structure analysis device, method and program
description: To provide a substance structure analysis method for predicting a whole structure of an arbitrary substance using machine learning.SOLUTION: One embodiment of the present disclosure is a substance structure analysis method composed of steps to be implemented by a processor, and relates to the substance structure analysis method that has the steps of: acquiring structure data showing a structure of a substance, and spectral data showing a spectrum of the substance; inputting the structure data to a first neural network, and acquiring an amount of structure characteristic from the first neural network; inputting the spectral data to a second neural network, and acquiring an amount of spectral characteristic from the second neural network; and determining a matching degree of the substance corresponding to the structure data with the substance corresponding to the spectral data on the basis of the amount of structure characteristic and the amount of spectral characteristic.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Abrasion judgment system and textile machine system
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a wear determination system and a textile machine system capable of determining a wear state of a wear component which is worn during a period in which a package is rotated by a drive unit with higher accuracy.  A wear determination system is an article included in a winder unit that winds a thread around a take-up pipe to form a package, and is a drive among parts constituting a cradle that rotatably supports the package. This is a system that determines the wear state of worn parts that are worn while the package is being rotated by the parts. The wear determination system acquires a state variable including the vibration generated in the cradle and the rotation speed or time from when the braking device that brakes the rotation of the package is activated until the rotation of the package stops. An analysis unit 81B for determining a wear state of a worn part based on a state variable acquired by the unit 81A is provided.  [Selection diagram] FIG. 8

title: Abnormality judgment model generation device, abnormality judgment device, abnormality judgment model generation method and abnormality judgment method
description: To provide an abnormality determination model generation device, an abnormality determination device, an abnormality determination model generation method and an abnormality determination method capable of being generally applied without being aware of the type or the like of a monitoring object and performing abnormality determination with high accuracy.SOLUTION: An abnormality determination model generation device is configured to: generate a first abnormality determination model by calculating the average and variance of respective variables if the maximum value of a correlation between respective variables is less than a prescribed value about K-pieces L-dimensional vectors on an L-dimensional variable space; generate a second abnormality determination model by performing main component analysis to calculate a conversion coefficient of a main component if the maximum value of a correlation between the respective variables is equal to or more than the prescribed value; and generate a third abnormality determination model by constituting M-dimensional vectors composed of M types of variables at the same time and performing a main component analysis of the plurality of M-dimensional vectors to calculate a conversion coefficient of the main component if a time series signal during a normal operation is M types (M≥2).SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: Method and device for constructing result advantageous for guiding multipolicy decision making
description: A method and apparatus for guiding multi-policy decision making. A control object (100) includes a controller (104) and a data store (108). The controller issues commands to controlled objects. The data store contains policies 136 . A perception module locates objects in the environment and maintains an estimate of the state for each object. Perception module 112 identifies and evaluates arrays of state values for each object for use during forward simulation. A seed state generator 116 receives the state of each object from the perception module and determines the initial sampling state. The simulator 120 is provided with seed states from the seed state generator and forward simulates the binding states up to some planning period. A result quantifier 128 computes a result that indicates a score based on policy and seed state as a product of probability and cost for the generated seed state. [Selection drawing] Fig. 1

title: Information processing device, information processing method and information processing program
description: To provide an information processing apparatus configured to improve processing efficiency of inference processes based on deep learning, an information processing method, and an information processing program.SOLUTION: A GPU 20 performs each of inference processes based on deep learning by using a memory area allocated to the inference process. An in-use memory area prediction unit 123 predicts an in-use memory area of each of the inference processes, based on a profile denoting a change in a memory usage while the inference process is performed by the GPU 20 according to an algorithm of the inference process and based on a start history of the inference process, and creates a memory map, based on the predicted in-use memory area. A memory allocation unit 122 allocates the memory area to the inference process, based on the memory map created by the in-use memory area prediction unit 123.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title: System and method for detecting and classifying pattern in image with vision system
description: A system and method for detecting patterns in an image that incorporates a neural net classifier is provided. In a vision system (100), a pattern detection tool is coupled with a classifier (150) that can be run before or after the tool to have pattern persistence results labeled with sub-pixel accuracy. [Effect] For a pattern detection tool that can detect multiple templates, a neural net classifier improves its performance by telling the pattern detection tool to only work on a subset of the templates it was initially trained on; For pattern detection tools that detect patterns, it can be determined whether the tool has detected the correct pattern and the neural network can reconstruct/remove the imaged shape, eliminating pixels that are not closely related to the shape of interest. This not only reduces search time but also greatly increases the chance of locking on to the correct shape. [Selection diagram] Figure 1

title: Machine learning program, machine learning method, and information processing apparatus
description: [Problem] To realize a lightweight neural network including an attention structure. [Solution] A machine learning program causes a computer to execute a process for each element of a Q layer 161 that outputs a Query and a K layer 162 that outputs a Key as a result of computation processing on an input tensor of an attention structure in a trained machine learning model of a neural network 180 having an attention structure 160, deleting elements included in at least one of the tensors QT and KT, from one or more elements included in a tensor QT from the Q layer after elements are reduced based on a first reduction rate, and one or more elements included in a tensor KT from the K layer after elements are reduced based on a second reduction rate, so that only elements having the same index remain in the tensors QT and KT. [Selected Figure] FIG. 19

title: Method, computing device, and wearable device for sleep stage detection
description: A method for detecting sleep stages including rapid eye movement (REM) and non-REM (NREM) based on machine learning is provided. A method of sleep stage detection is provided, comprising the steps of receiving a first vital sign feature including a plurality of first feature values corresponding to respective epochs of a plurality of epochs, and performing a first logistic regression operation to calculate, for each intermediate epoch of the plurality of epochs, a first indication value representative of a sleep stage of the intermediate epoch based on the corresponding first feature value and the first feature values of preceding and succeeding epochs of the plurality of epochs.

title: Cross-document intelligent authoring and processing assistant
description: A document analysis and annotating system uses machine learning, artificial intelligence, and other computer-implemented methods to identify semantically significant chunks within a document, automatically label them with appropriate data types and semantic roles, and use this enhanced information to assist authors and support downstream processes. The location, data type, and semantic role of chunks can be automatically determined from what is called "context": their combination of format, structure, and content, adjacent or nearby content, the overall pattern of occurrence within the document, and the overall similarity of all these things. Similarity can include machine learning techniques such as measuring the similarity of natural language grammatical structures, the similarity of words, chunks, and other embeddings, as well as the data types and semantic roles of previously identified chunks. (Selected Figure: Figure 1)

title: Systems and methods for identifying and / or identifying and quantifying pain, fatigue, mood, and intent of persons with privacy protection
description: The disclosed technology performs, among other things, person identification and mental perception (eg, pain, fatigue, mood) and / or intention (eg, certain acts) for medical, safety, home care, and other purposes. ) To enable characterization. Important are applications that require long-term patient monitoring, such as tracking disease progression (eg, multiple sclerosis) or monitoring treatment or rehabilitation effectiveness. Therefore, longitudinal data must be acquired over time with respect to person identification and other characteristics (eg, pain level, cane use). However, the conventional person identification method (for example, photography) obtains unnecessary personal information and raises privacy concerns.

title: Systems and methods for translating natural language sentences into database queries
description: The systems and methods described allow automatic translation from a natural language (eg, English) to an artificial language such as a structured query language (SQL). In some embodiments, the translator module comprises an encoder component and a decoder component, both components including a recurrent neural network. Training a translator module involves two steps. The first step trains the translator module to produce an artificial language (AL) output when presented with an AL input. For example, the translator is first trained to regenerate the AL input. The second step of training involves training the translator to produce an AL output when presented with a natural language (NL) input.

title: Visual recognition of privacy protection through hostile learning
description: It provides a way to protect visual private data by preventing data reconstruction from the potential representation of deep networks. The method is to obtain potential features (316) from the input image (312) and, through a learning framework for hostile reconstruction (318), privacy to maintain useful performance and prevent data reconstruction. Learning protected feature representations, including data reconstruction, simulates a blackbox model inversion attack by training a decoder (332) to reconstruct the input image from potential features. And by training the encoder (314) to maximize reconstruction error in order to prevent the decoder from reversing potential features while minimizing task loss.  [Selection diagram] Fig. 1

title: Systems and methods for automating biological structure identification using machine learning
description: A system for automated biological structure identification using machine learning includes: receiving instructions to select a biological structure to identify; accessing a computer readable medium storing a machine learning model; selecting one of the machine learning models based on the received instructions; receiving image data; and selecting the model. identifying out-of-focus biological structures in the image data using a host device configured to receive adjusted image data and to identify in-focus biological structures in the adjusted image data using the selected model; including. The host device generates annotations corresponding to the identified biological structures and displays the image data and annotations.

title: COMPUTING POWER SHARING METHOD AND RELATED DEVICE
description: In embodiments of the present application, a computational power sharing method and related devices are disclosed. In embodiments of the present application, the computing power-sharing network element is connected to the network for control plane transmission and data plane transmission, or the computing power-sharing network element is connected to the network for control plane transmission. A computing power sharing network element obtains computing power demand information transmitted by a computing demander and available computing power information transmitted by at least one computing cooperating party, and obtains computing power demand information and available computing power Based on the information, determine a computing cooperator providing computing power to the computing demand, and direct or indirectly instruct the computing cooperating party providing computing power to complete the computing tasks of the computing demand. Thereby, computing power sharing is realized, computing speed is improved, and the time required for computation is shortened.  [Selection drawing] Fig. 2

title: Methods and Systems for Data-Driven and Modular Decision Making and Path Generation for Autonomous Agents
description: A system for data-driven and modular decision making and path generation includes a computing system. A method for data-driven modular decision-making and path generation comprises receiving a set of inputs, selecting a learning module, such as a deep decision network and/or a deep path network, from a set of learning modules; and repeating some or all of the above steps and/or other suitable steps. Additionally or alternatively, the method includes training some or all of the learning modules, validating one or more outputs, and/or any other suitable process and/or combination of processes. be able to.  [Selection drawing] Fig. 2

title: Generate machine learning predictions using multiple domain datasets
description: The method includes the steps of: obtaining an input matrix; and determining, for each input value of the input matrix, a domain index matrix that includes corresponding domain index values indicative of the corresponding training data distribution of the plurality of training data distributions. including. The method also includes the steps of providing an input matrix and a domain index matrix to a machine learning model trained using a plurality of training data distributions, each training data distribution being associated with a different attribute. include. The method uses a machine learning model, based on an input matrix and a domain index matrix, to determine (i) each input value and (ii ) generating an output matrix including corresponding output values generated based on the corresponding domain index values.

title: Interconnection between quantum computing modules and non-quantum processing modules in quantum computing systems
description: The technology disclosed in this patent document uses superconducting qubits to provide high-speed communication between a quantum computing module and its controller while enabling efficient management of wiring with other modules. , quantum computing, classical qubit control/readout, and classical digital computing in a scalable computing system based on a specialized interconnect design for connecting hardware components in multistage cryogenic systems. can be implemented to combine with

title: Dynamic acoustic signature system with sensor fusion for illegal logging in rainforests
description: Examples of implementations described herein may detect human disturbances from sensor data streamed from one or more sensors in a network of sensors, such as a chainsaw event related to an area associated with one or more sensors (e.g. processing the detected human disturbance to determine the probability of a chainsaw event (i.e., a light chainsaw event or a dense chainsaw event) and an estimated lead time of a chainsaw event; may be aimed at determining the probability of a state change to another regional human disturbance or chainsaw event relative to adjacent sensors.

title: Speaker-adaptive speech end detection for conversational AI applications
description: In various examples, the end of speech (EOS) of the audio signal is determined based at least in part on the speech rate of the speaker. For a segment of the audio signal, an EOS is indicated based at least in part on an EOS threshold determined based at least in part on the speaker's speech rate.

title: Method, computing system and computer program for division-free stochastic regularization for arithmetic coding
description: Various embodiments described herein include methods and systems for coding video. In one aspect, the method includes obtaining video data including a first syntax element having a corresponding alphabet of M elements and obtaining respective probabilities of occurrence for the M elements. The method further includes entropy coding a first portion of the video data using the respective probabilities of occurrence and encountering the first syntax element during the entropy coding. The method also includes updating the probabilities of occurrence based on the first syntax element and determining regularized probabilities of occurrence by applying a probability regularization to the updated probabilities of occurrence according to at least one of the updated probabilities being less than a threshold probability value, the probability regularization not including a division operation.

title: A classification system that facilitates space group inference and a method for recommending crystal zone axes therein
description: [Problem] The object of the present invention is to provide a classification system that facilitates space group inference and a method for constructing the classification system therein, and to provide a method for inferring space group candidates for a target material and recommending a zone axis for the next photograph. [Solution to the Problem] A classification system that facilitates space group inference and a method for constructing the classification system therein are disclosed. The SADP classification system includes a plurality of labels, which are constructed by clustering Selected Area Diffraction Pattern (SADP) images photographed by a Transmission Electron Microscope (TEM) based on specific criteria, and the labels are linked to space groups of the classification system from the perspective of crystallography. [Selected Figure] FIG. 6

title: Analysis of multi-run periodic processing procedures
description: A method includes receiving time trace sensor data associated with a substrate processing procedure. The substrate processing procedure includes two or more sets of processing states. At least a first set of processing states and a second set of processing states each include one or more operations that are repeatedly performed. The method further includes separating first and second portions of the time trace sensor data corresponding to the first and second sets of processing states into first and second pluralities of periodic data. The method further includes processing the first and second pluralities of periodic data to generate summary data. The method further includes providing an alert to a user. The alert is based on the summary data. (FIG. 2)

title: Live updating of machine learning models
description: Resources, such as machine learning models, can be updated for an application without any significant downtime for that application. For an application hosted at a network edge, the application can be deployed in a container and one or more model versions stored in local storage at the edge, which can be mounted into the container as necessary. When a different model version is to be used, a configuration change or new context can be used to trigger the application to automatically change to the different model version. This updating can be performed seamlessly, without any loss of data.

title: Machine learning algorithm
description: The present invention provides a method for identifying peptides that contain features positively associated with natural endogenous or exogenous cellular processing, transportation and major histocompatibility complex (MHC) presentation. In particular, the invention/method controls for the influence of protein abundance, stability and HLA/MHC binding on processing and presentation, enabling a machine-learning algorithm or statistical inference model trained using the method to be applied to any test peptide regardless of its HLA/MHC restriction i.e. the algorithm operates in a HLA/MHC-agnostic manner. This is attained through the building of positive and negative data sets of peptide sequences (peptides identified or inferred from surface bound or secreted MHC/peptide complexes in the literature, and those which are not). Specifically, the positive and negative data sets comprise a multiplicity of pairings between individual entries, in which both sequences of a pair are of equal or similar length, and are derived from the same source protein, and/or have similar binding affinities, with respect to the HLA/MHC molecule from which the peptide of the positive peptide is restricted.

title: Quantum information processing system
description: A building block (1) for a quantum information processing system includes a superconducting qubit (2) having a Josephson junction (5) connected between two superconducting electrodes (3, 4). The two superconducting electrodes (3, 4) are coaxial and coplanar. The building block (1) also includes a control line (6) coupled to the superconducting qubit (2) and arranged to monitor the state of the superconducting qubit (2), and/or a readout element (8) coupled to the superconducting qubit (2) and arranged to measure the state of the superconducting qubit (2). The control line (6) and/or the readout element (8) are arranged offset from the two superconducting electrodes (3, 4). (Automatic translation with Google Translate, without legal value)

title: A small-sample HSI classification method based on a novel network of GCN and CNN
description: The present invention proposes a small-sample HSI classification method based on a novel GCN and CNN network, comprising the following steps: S1, performing linear projection mapping on HSI data and converting pixel features to super-pixel features; S2, forming super-pixel features Send it to the image encoder, then perform feature extraction in the form of HSI image data, and then decode the image data features through the decoder; S3, perform nonlinear feature processing on the image data features to obtain feature 1; S4, pass HSI data through Spectral cleaning and convolution are used for noise reduction, and at the same time, high-dimensional HSI data are processed for dimensionality reduction to generate dimensionality reduction feature maps; S5, the dimensionality reduction feature maps are processed through attention mechanism and information interaction, and then through a layer of attention mechanism Convolve with spatial features to obtain feature 2; S6, perform ConCat multi-feature fusion of feature 1 obtained in step S3 and feature 2 obtained in step S5, and output the classification result. The invention solves the problems of small sample classification, large noise, loss of spectral space semantic position information and the like.

title: Method and device for predicting phosphate concentration of water body based on multispectral image
description: The invention relates to the field of remote sensing data analysis, in particular to a water body phosphate concentration prediction method based on multispectral images, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a multispectral image of a sample area; removing non-water areas in the multispectral image, acquiring a water image of a sample area, dividing the sample area into a plurality of sample areas according to the number of preset sample areas, and acquiring water phosphate concentration data and spectrum data corresponding to each sample area in the water image of the sample area; combining phosphate concentration data and spectrum data corresponding to the same sampling area to obtain a plurality of data sets corresponding to the sampling areas; inputting the data sets corresponding to the sampling areas into a neural network model to be trained for training, and obtaining a phosphate concentration prediction model; responding to the prediction instruction, acquiring a multispectral image of the region to be detected, inputting the multispectral image of the region to be detected into a phosphate concentration prediction model, and acquiring a water phosphate concentration data prediction result.

title: Aviation Text Data Annotation Method and Annotation System
description: The present invention relates to a method for labeling aviation text data and a labeling system thereof, comprising the following steps. Step 1 is based on the text enhancement algorithm of the entity core EODA to expand the sample of the original aviation text data, and the sample of the original aviation text data and the sample after the expansion The samples form unlabeled data together; step 2 is based on the sample screening of the active learning model, and selects the target sample from the unlabeled data; step 3 establishes an aviation text annotation model based on information extraction to realize arbitrary aviation text data annotation. The present invention expands the number of samples through the data enhancement algorithm based on the entity core EODA, and through entity recognition; in the active learning model, combined with the uncertainty sample query strategy and the version space reduction sample query strategy, the minimum confidence based on the word level is established Degree sample query strategy. Under the framework of active learning, it is verified by experiments that the labeling efficiency is improved. Improve the intelligent level of the labeling system through the effective integration of algorithms and models.

title: Dependent scalar quantization with substitution in neural image compression
description: Method, apparatus, and non-transitory storage medium for end-to-end neural image compression using dependent scalar quantization with surrogates, comprising: receiving an input image; based on the input image, determining a surrogate image using a neural network-based surrogate feature generator ; compress the substitute image; quantize the compressed substitute image by using a first dependent scalar quantizer to obtain a quantized representation of the input image with higher compression performance; and entropy the substitute image using a neural network based encoder Encoding to produce a compressed representation of the quantized representation.

title: Multimode comment emotion analysis method and system based on heterogram convolution
description: The present invention relates to a multi-modal comment sentiment analysis method based on heterogeneous graph convolution, comprising the following steps: Step A: collecting user comments and related images, extracting aspects of products or services involved in user comments, and annotating users Comment on the emotional polarity of a specific aspect of the product or service to construct a training set  DB  ; Step B: use the training set  DB  to train a deep learning network model  DLM  based on knowledge graphs and heterogeneous graph convolutional networks for Analyze the emotional polarity of user comments and related images on specific aspects of the product or service; Step C: Input user comments and related images and the aspect words of the product or service involved into the trained deep learning network model to obtain user The emotional polarity of reviews and related images to specific aspects of the product or service. The method and system are beneficial to improving the accuracy of emotion classification.

title: WiFi-based contactless action recognition method, system and laboratory device
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of motion data perception and recognition, and discloses a WiFi-based non-contact motion recognition method, system and laboratory device. The method includes: obtaining channel state information data through a WiFi device; preprocessing the received channel state information data to eliminate noise information caused by machine operation and environmental interference; Select subcarriers from the channel state information data of subcarriers; make dynamic and static judgments on the obtained channel state information data, and cut out the action interval; perform feature extraction on the action interval; train the extracted features, and based on the training The model performs recognition and classification of actions. The invention proposes a dynamic sub-carrier selection algorithm and a segmentation auxiliary algorithm, which effectively improves the segmentation accuracy and action classification accuracy of the action interval.

title: Prerequisites learning method based on hypergraph neural network multi-angle feature fusion
description: The invention relates to a prerequisite learning method based on hypergraph neural network multi-angle feature fusion, which belongs to the field of data mining. Based on the ability of hypergraph to encode high-level topological structures, the hypergraph structure can be modeled according to the relevance of concepts in document resources, the semantic similarity between concepts, and the affiliation between document resources and concepts, so as to fully model and Express the relationship between concepts, perform two-stage feature fusion on the potential representations of concepts generated under different semantic hypergraph structures, and jointly train the optimization model with concept prerequisites and document prerequisites. Using the concept of synonyms to amplify the positive samples of concept prerequisite relations to solve the problem of data imbalance. The above method improves the prediction accuracy of the model.

title: Target detection model compression method and system based on neural architecture search
description: The present invention provides a target detection model compression method and system based on neural architecture search; the method includes the following steps: preprocessing images in a target detection data set to obtain a normalized data set; Convert the target detection model of the supernet into a supernet; construct a subnetwork sampler; the subnetwork sampler is used to uniformly sample each stage of the supernetwork; train the supernetwork based on the subnetwork sampler and the normalized data set, and obtain the weight of the supernetwork ; Search the subnetwork to select the target subnetwork architecture of the Pareto optimal solution based on the search results, and take out the weight of the target subnetwork architecture from the supernetwork weights for deployment, so as to realize the compression of the target detection model; the present invention introduces The neural architecture search technology can use a small amount of computing resources to reasonably optimize the model architecture to be deployed, thereby improving the speed of model reasoning, and can save the complicated process of determining model structure hyperparameters and model architecture tuning.

title: Deep learning-based intelligent selection method for cosmetic preservative
description: The invention discloses an intelligent selection method of a cosmetic preservative based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: step S1, firstly, acquiring existing cosmetic composition data, secondly, preprocessing the acquired data, and then randomly dividing the preprocessed data into a training set, a verification set and a test set; s2, constructing a BERT multi-label classification model, inputting a training set and a verification set into the model for training, and evaluating the model by using a test set; step S3, inputting the determined cosmetic ingredients into a trained BERT multi-label classification model, and outputting one or more proper preservative categories. The method can help cosmetic research and development personnel select proper preservative types, shortens research and development period, reduces research and development cost, adopts attention mechanism and BERT model after pre-training, and improves prediction performance of the model.

title: Method and device for identifying and dividing coal and gangue and electronic equipment
description: The invention relates to a coal and gangue identification and segmentation method, device and electronic equipment, comprising: obtaining X-ray coal and gangue images to be segmented; inputting the X-ray coal and gangue images to be segmented into a coal and gangue segmentation model to obtain In the coal and gangue segmentation image output by the coal and gangue segmentation model, the same type of coal or gangue in the coal and gangue segmentation image is distinguished by connected domains with different colors; according to the connected domains of different colors, the outline of the coal gangue segmented image is extracted to obtain the following The gangue outline coordinates are marked in the form of rectangles, and the gangue outline coordinates are used to control the manipulator to grab the gangue. It can not only speed up the segmentation speed of coal and gangue images, but also reduce the semantic information loss of coal and gangue in feature extraction, and improve the segmentation accuracy of coal and gangue images.

title: A chip verification result verification method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The application discloses a chip verification result verification method, device, equipment and storage medium, and relates to the technical field of chip verification. Applied to a preset chip verification platform, the method includes: obtaining test cases used to verify the target function of the design to be tested during chip verification and determining verification incentives therefrom; determining a model training sample library based on the verification incentives, and using the samples therein Train the preset neural network to obtain the target neural network model; input the verification stimulus into the design under test, the reference model and the target neural network model respectively to obtain the corresponding first execution result, second execution result and third execution result ; Comparing the first execution result with the second execution result, and using the third execution result to verify the same correct result as the comparison result. Through the technical solution of the application, the reliability of chip verification can be improved, and potential but forgotten loopholes can be effectively discovered.

title: Sensor fusion
description: The present disclosure provides "sensor fusion." Multiple images may be acquired from multiple sensors, and multiple flattened patches may be extracted from multiple images. To each of the plurality of flattened tiles may be added the image position in the plurality of images and a sensor type token identifying the one of the plurality of images from which the corresponding flattened tile was acquired The image's sensor type. The flattened slices may be concatenated into a flattenor, where a flattenor is a one-dimensional array comprising two or more data types, and adding task tokens indicating processing tasks to the flattenor. The flattened tensor may be input to a first deep neural network comprising a plurality of encoder layers and a plurality of decoder layers and outputting a transformer output. The transformer output can be input to a second deep neural network, the second deep neural network determines an object prediction indicated by the token, and can output the object prediction.

title: Remote medical monitoring system and method thereof
description: A telemedicine monitoring system and a method thereof, which acquire physical sign data of a monitored object at a plurality of preset time points in a preset time period; by adopting an artificial intelligence technology based on deep learning, the time sequence collaborative correlation characteristic information among the physical sign data parameters is fully expressed, so that the physical state of a target object is accurately monitored in real time, the accuracy and timeliness of remote medical monitoring are improved, and better technical support is provided for remote medical treatment.

title: A federated learning method for measurement data based on zero-type centralized differential privacy
description: The invention discloses a measurement data federal learning method based on zero-concentration differential privacy, which comprises the following steps: each participant obtains local model parameters through training; adding noise into the local model parameters by adopting a zero-concentration differential privacy method to perform data disturbance, and uploading the data disturbance to a main station of the metering automation system; collecting local model parameters uploaded by each participant by a main station of the metering automation system, and carrying out aggregation to obtain global model parameters; broadcasting the aggregated global model parameters to all the participants by the metering automation system master station; each participant updates the local model, continues training, carries out privacy protection again on the new parameters, and uploads the new parameters until the metering automation system master station model reaches the optimal. By implementing the invention, the efficiency of data analysis of the measured data is effectively improved, the risk of data leakage in data transmission is reduced, and the safety of the measured data is greatly protected.

title: A face forgery clue detection method based on federated residuals
description: The present invention relates to a face forgery clue detection method based on federated residuals, comprising: constructing a federated learning framework, the local client includes multiple data centers, each data center is provided with a forgery detection model, and the server is provided with a global detection model ;Distribute the training data to each data center for training, upload the model parameters obtained by the client to the server for weighted aggregation, and then deliver them. The local client uses the delivered parameters to update the parameters of their respective models. The communication process will continue , after the forgery detection model reaches the preset cut-off condition, use the global detection model to identify the authenticity of the face image to be tested. A variational autoencoder is utilized in the forgery detection model to learn robust residual discriminative features to detect forgery clues, so as to guide the classifier to learn more discriminative forgery features. The method of the invention improves the generalization ability of the model for forged data from complex sources and simultaneously realizes the protection of face privacy.

title: Whole-slide image detection system for endometrial cancer based on a deep learning model
description: The present invention provides a full-slide image detection system for endometrial cancer with a deep learning model, including: a digital slide image classification module, which acquires a digital slide image training set, a digital slide image verification set, and a digital slide image test set; the grid search pathological plaque extraction module extracts digital pathological plaques side by side and non-overlapping from the effective tissue area of small digital image patches; the deep learning model optimization training module uses atrous spatial pyramid pooling for digital pathological plaques, so that The model focuses on tumor cells; the deep learning model is optimized through the adaptive moment estimation optimizer, and the digital slide image training set data is trained to obtain a full convolutional neural network deep learning model; the model evaluation full slide image detection module, evaluation Performance of a fully convolutional neural network deep learning model for endometrial cancer whole slide image detection.

title: Mammary gland medical image segmentation method based on improved U-net network
description: The invention relates to a breast medical image segmentation method based on an improved U-net network, which belongs to the field of image segmentation and comprises the following steps: s1: performing expansion pretreatment on the data set by using an MT-GAN method, and simultaneously generating a breast medical image and a matching mask image; s2: in the traditional U-Net network, replacing an original convolution module with a designed multi-scale attention residual module MAblock to obtain a MAU-Net network; s3: and introducing a W-GAN network on the basis of the MAU-Net network, constructing a mixed loss function, and dividing the mammary gland. The invention can realize effective expansion of the sample, so that the diversity of the sample can be satisfied; the network has better robustness and generalization capability, and the segmentation capability of the segmentation network is improved.

title: Quantitative identification method for single microcracks
description: The invention provides a single microcrack quantitative identification method, which belongs to the technical field of crack identification. The method includes obtaining a first sample set, and the first sample set includes one-dimensional data corresponding to different single microcrack models and single microcrack size categories ; The one-dimensional data is obtained by processing the original signal of an array element channel of the single microcrack model; the original signal of the array element channel is generated by the ultrasonic action of the single microcrack model; the one-dimensional data is used as input, and the size category is used as output. One-dimensional neural network training to obtain the first network model; obtain the one-dimensional test data of the single microcrack model to be tested; the one-dimensional test data is obtained by processing the original signal of an array element channel of the single microcrack model to be tested ; Input the one-dimensional data to be tested into the first network model to obtain the single microcrack size category of the single microcrack model to be tested. The invention realizes the quantitative identification of single microcracks through the combination of deep learning and nonlinear ultrasonic nondestructive testing technology.

title: Apparatus and method for training machine learning model to generate descriptor images
description: According to various implementations, a method for training a machine learning model to generate descriptor images for images of one or more objects is described, comprising: recording a plurality of camera images, wherein each camera image displays one or more objects; for each camera image, one or more augmented versions of the camera image are generated by applying a corresponding augmentation to the camera image for each augmented version of the camera image, where the augmentations include positional changes in pixel values of the camera image ; and generate a training image pair, the training image pair respectively comprising the camera image and an augmentation of the camera image or two augmented versions of the camera image; and train the machine learning model by using the training image pair with a contrastive loss, wherein the machine learning model targets each other Descriptor values generated by the pixels of are used as positive pairs, and descriptor values generated by the machine learning model for pixels that do not correspond to each other are used as negative pairs.

title: A method of statistically analyzing the operation of mine earthwork mining projects
description: The invention discloses a method for statistically analyzing the operating conditions of earthwork mining projects in mines, which comprises the following steps: the first step: calculating the index according to the cost type; the second step: calculating the index according to the economic index; Visual display; the fourth step: carry out further data mining on each indicator according to the improved decision-making algorithm, and obtain the evaluation value of the business status of the enterprise. The present invention fits the business scene, analyzes the project management situation in real time, abstracts the project->construction scene->revenue and expenditure type->economic index data model, and analyzes the project management situation in real time. Based on the improved decision tree algorithm, an accurate assessment of the project's operating status can be made.

title: A Method of Object Detection for Power Equipment in Complex Environment
description: The invention provides a power equipment target detection method under a complex environment, which comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring a visible light image and an infrared image of the electrical equipment; 2) Obtaining edge information of an infrared image and a visible light image by using an optimization threshold O-Canny edge detection algorithm combined with a gradient value, and detecting the curvature of the edge information by using a curvature scale space technology to obtain characteristic points of the infrared image and the visible light image; 3) Utilizing GSIFT algorithm to complete the characteristic point matching of infrared image and visible light image; 4) Screening a characteristic point matching result by using a random sampling consistency algorithm; 5) The registered infrared image and visible light image are fused by utilizing a dual ResNet deep learning network; 6) Respectively labeling power equipment in the infrared image, the visible light image and the fusion image by using labelImg software; 7) And training YOLOv5 by using the data set with the label, and respectively performing visible light image target detection, infrared image target detection and fusion image target detection to obtain the respective target detection precision of the three groups of experiments.

title: Domain knowledge updating system and method for large model
description: The invention discloses a domain knowledge updating system for a large model, which comprises a entity relation joint extraction model for extracting entities and relations of knowledge data, a new knowledge vector library for storing new knowledge, a sentence embedding module and a similarity analysis model for optimizing the output result of the large model, wherein the entity relation joint extraction model is used for extracting the entities and the relations of the knowledge data; compared with the prior art, the method and the device have the advantages that the independent new knowledge vector library is arranged to be matched with the large model, so that the large model can update knowledge in the large model and make up for possible defects or deviations of the large model when processing new tasks, the accuracy of the model is improved, meanwhile, the knowledge memory in the new knowledge vector library can provide previously learned knowledge and experience, the large model can be helped to quickly adapt to the new tasks, the training cost and time are reduced, the generalization capability of the model is further improved, and the large model can keep knowledge of multiple fields through continuously updating the content in the external knowledge memory along with the time.

title: Model quantification methods, devices, computing equipment, storage media and products
description: This application provides a model quantification method, device, computing device, storage medium and product, which belongs to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method includes: determining the first parameter corresponding to each model parameter on each layer based on the non-negative range of parameters in the first storage format and the non-negative representation range of the second storage format for each model parameter on each layer of the model. The scaling factor is used to scale the parameter value of each model parameter on each layer to obtain the scaling parameter value of each model parameter on each layer. The scaling parameter value of the model parameter is within the non-negative representation range of the second storage format; The scaling parameter value of each model parameter on each layer is converted from the first storage format to the second storage format to obtain the quantified parameter value of each model parameter on each layer; it will be composed of the quantized parameter value of each model parameter on each layer. The model is determined as a quantified model. This application avoids numerical overflow of model parameters in the quantization process and improves the accuracy of the model after quantification.

title: Human body posture recognition method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application provides a human body posture identification method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a two-dimensional image of a human body; determining a framework scaling factor; identifying a skeleton of the human body in the two-dimensional image; acquiring depth relations among a plurality of key points on the skeleton; and acquiring three-dimensional coordinates of a plurality of key points on the skeleton according to the skeleton scaling coefficient and the depth relation among the plurality of key points to obtain the posture of the human body. By implementing the embodiment, the severe requirements of the traditional reconstruction method on the environment and equipment are removed, and the task difficulty is reduced.

title: Ultrasonic image recognition method and device based on small sample deep learning
description: The application relates to the technical field of image recognition, and provides an ultrasonic image recognition method and equipment based on small sample deep learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an ultrasonic image of thyroid follicular tumor to be identified; inputting the thyroid follicular tumor ultrasonic image into a pre-trained tumor recognition network to obtain a recognition result corresponding to the thyroid follicular tumor ultrasonic image; judging whether the thyroid follicular tumor displayed by the ultrasonic image of the thyroid follicular tumor is benign or not according to the identification result. The method has high sensitivity, high specificity and high recognition rate.

title: Knowledge graph construction method for automatically extracting obstetric and research information based on open source information
description: The present invention provides a knowledge graph construction method that automatically extracts industry-university-research information based on open source intelligence, and relates to the technical field of knowledge graphs. This invention builds a data set based on the intelligent data acquisition system to obtain basic information from industry, academia and research; performs entity extraction through the LSTM-CSF model based on the data set; adopts two strategies of fusion and verification to fuse dispersed, redundant and heterogeneous knowledge as a construct The starting point of the knowledge graph is to verify the newly added knowledge to the knowledge graph, ensure the consistency between the new knowledge and the knowledge graph, and continuously update the knowledge graph; establish entity relationships and attributes, and design the knowledge graph mapping of basic industry-university-research information from top to bottom; in accordance with Mapping saves data to the graph database to complete the construction of the knowledge graph. The present invention completes the construction of a large-scale knowledge map of industry-university-research information, which helps to carry out in-depth subsequent related research, introduce corresponding talents in a timely manner, optimize the industrial structure, and increase scientific and technological strength.

title: A fault-assisted decision-making method and system for flexible-to-direct converter valves based on machine learning
description: A fault diagnosis method and system of a soft direct current converter valve based on machine learning are characterized in that: step 1, constructing a fault classification table and arranging a fault measurement sensor in a soft direct current converter valve; step 2, collecting sensing data and constructing a fault data set, and screening a key data set from the fault data set; step 3, calculating the gradient value of each characteristic item, sampling and selecting a small gradient sample while retaining a large gradient sample so as to construct a sample library; step 4, discretizing each characteristic item into simple numerical values of K dimensions, constructing a quality distribution diagram based on the simple numerical values of the K dimensions, and calculating information gain of the quality distribution diagram, so that node splitting of a decision tree is realized according to the information gain; and 5, repeating the step 4 until the decision tree is split to the maximum limit splitting times, completing construction of a decision tree model, classifying the current fault, and positioning the type of the current fault by referring to the fault classification table.

title: Wind speed prediction method of self-adaptive data
description: The invention discloses a wind speed prediction method of self-adaptive data, which comprises the following steps: acquiring historical wind speed information of a training point to be measured; determining a first loss function corresponding to the physical driving model and a second loss function corresponding to the data driving model according to the historical wind speed information of the training to-be-measured point; determining a target loss function according to the neural network optimized by the super-parameter optimization and the optimizer, the first loss function and the second loss function; and constructing a target model according to the target loss function, and acquiring the predicted wind speed of the target to-be-measured point based on the target model. The method can select proper super parameters and optimizers and improve the prediction accuracy and speed of the target model, and can be widely applied to the field of wind speed prediction.

title: A collaborative virtual maintenance training system and method
description: The invention discloses a collaborative virtual maintenance training system and method. The technical gist of the method is that: the method includes: first obtaining the first system operation and the second system operation, and then, performing the first system operation and the second system operation. The system operations perform semantic feature interaction coding to obtain interaction features between system operations, and then, based on the interaction features between system operations, determine whether there is a conflict between the first system operation and the second system operation. In this way, the accuracy and efficiency of conflict detection can be improved, thereby improving the stability and security of the system and providing maintenance personnel with a better training and practice environment.

title: A method and system for image report generation based on language model
description: Embodiments of this specification provide a method and system for generating an image report based on a language model. The method includes: obtaining a pre-training model, which is a language model obtained through a pre-training stage; determining a generation model based on the pre-training model, and generating The model is a language model obtained through the fine-tuning stage; the medical imaging data is processed based on the generated model to determine the imaging report.

title: Household electricity load optimization scheduling method based on improved particle swarm algorithm
description: The household electricity load optimizing and dispatching method based on improved particle swarm algorithm includes the first classifying household electricity loads, establishing household electricity load dispatching model, determining target function and constraint condition and establishing household electricity load dispatching and optimizing model; then, an algorithm of a standard particle swarm is improved, a nonlinear inertia weight formula is improved, a self-adaptive learning factor formula combined with inertia weight is provided, a dung beetle optimizing algorithm is mixed to improve the problem that the particle swarm algorithm is easy to fall into local optimum, after the algorithm is improved, global searching capacity is more balanced, local searching capacity is also enhanced, local optimum solution is more easy to jump out, and algorithm optimizing capacity is improved; and finally, applying the improved particle swarm algorithm to household power load optimization scheduling. The invention achieves the aims of low comprehensive electricity consumption cost for users, low inconvenience degree for users and small peak-valley difference.

title: Neural network structure, feature extraction method, device and medium
description: The invention discloses a neural network structure, feature extraction method, device and medium. The method includes: using a first convolution layer with a convolution kernel size of (3*N)*N to convolve the input feature map and then After processing by the first activation layer, the first feature map is obtained; the second convolution layer with a convolution kernel size of N*(3*N) is used to convolve the first feature map and then undergo the first batch of normalization. layer and the second activation layer are processed to obtain the second feature map; the third convolution layer with a convolution kernel size of (3*N)*N is used to convolve the second feature map and then pass through the third activation layer. Process to obtain the third feature map; use the fourth convolution layer with a convolution kernel size of N*(3*N) to convolve the third feature map and then pass through the second batch of normalization layers and the fourth activation layer Perform processing to obtain a fourth feature map; perform upsampling processing on the fourth feature map and then predict pixel categories to output a semantic segmentation map. It improves the segmentation accuracy for targets whose appearance aspect ratio is not 1:1.

title: Method and system for classifying risk of malignancy of kidney and training thereof
description: A computer-implemented method for classifying the risk of malignancy in the kidney, particularly in the human kidney, is provided. The imaging data of the subject patient's anatomy includes, at least in part, a representation of the subject patient's kidneys. A first neural network segments at least one region of the kidney representation based on the imaging data. A second neural network detects one or more suspected lesions represented by the segmented kidney. A third neural network classifies detected suspected lesions with malignancy risk. The third neural network is a deep profiler.

title: Deep learning-based skull CT image classification prediction model, method and device
description: The invention discloses a skull CT image classification prediction model, a method and a device based on deep learning, wherein the classification prediction model comprises the following components: the image contrast normalization module is used for carrying out contrast normalization processing on the input original single-layer skull CT flat scan image to generate a processed single-layer skull CT flat scan image; the classification prediction module is used for extracting the image characteristics of the processed single-layer skull CT flat scanning image by using the image characteristic extractor, generating a prediction value corresponding to a preset category by using the classification head module based on the image characteristics, and generating an image characteristic matrix weight corresponding to the preset category; the gradient category activation heat map generation module is used for generating an activation heat map based on the image feature matrix weight, and the activation heat map is used for assisting in determining the focus position. The model can complete the work of normal and abnormal classification of the skull CT image rapidly and with low cost. Moreover, the classification result can be more accurate.

title: Information retrieval methods, devices, computer equipment and storage media
description: The embodiments of the present application disclose an information retrieval method, device, computer equipment and storage medium; the embodiments of the present application can obtain sample information pairs, the sample information pairs include sample text information and sample voice information with semantic matching relationships; for Feature extraction is performed on the sample text information and the sample voice information to obtain sample text features corresponding to the sample text information and sample voice features corresponding to the sample voice information; based on the semantic matching relationship, the sample The text features and the sample speech features are feature fused to obtain fused features; an information retrieval model is constructed based on the fused features, and information retrieval processing is performed based on the constructed information retrieval model. This solution can improve the retrieval efficiency between text information and voice information.

title: Improved GRU model for charging pile failure prediction method
