description: The invention discloses a method for improving the GRU model for charging pile fault prediction, which is implemented according to the following steps: Step 1. Build a GRU model for charging pile fault prediction; Step 2. First select the parameters of the hybrid optimization algorithm, Optimization completed. According to the method of the present invention, the GA-PSO improved GRU model not only has a fast convergence speed, a good degree of curve fitting, but also a relatively high prediction accuracy. The results of experimental verification prove that it is ideal to use it as a fault prediction model for charging piles.

title: Robust power distribution method for multi-source information fusion
description: The invention relates to the technical field of robust power distribution, and discloses a robust power distribution method for multi-source information fusion. The method includes: determining a power distribution control feedback function based on a constructed data center power distribution model; constructing a data center Power distribution control model and construct the power distribution objective function; obtain real-time status information of each power distribution node and adjustable equipment, optimize and solve the data center power distribution control model based on the obtained real-time status information, and use the optimal power distribution control equipment Parameters control the power distribution process in real time. This invention combines the distribution node information, parallel capacitor information and distribution transformer information in the distribution network to realize distribution cost quantification under multi-source information fusion, and combines the information entropy of the adjustment parameter action parameters and the distribution control feedback of the next adjustment As a result, the robustness of the adjustment parameter action is calculated, and the optimal parameters with low uncertainty distribution control feedback results and the quantitative value of the data center power distribution cost are in line with expectations are obtained.

title: Catalyst system relaxation energy prediction model construction method and device
description: A method and device for constructing a catalyst system relaxation energy prediction model are disclosed. The method includes: obtaining a first training data set, each data containing first catalyst system structure information and its corresponding system energy information and atomic force information; using the first training data set to train a catalyst system energy prediction model to obtain a prediction Trained catalyst system energy prediction model; build an initial catalyst system relaxation energy prediction model based on the pre-trained catalyst system energy prediction model; obtain a second training data set, each data containing the second catalyst system structure information and its corresponding relaxation energy information and atomic displacement information; use the second training data set to train the initial prediction model of the catalyst system relaxation energy to obtain the catalyst system relaxation energy prediction model. The method according to the present application effectively improves the prediction accuracy and efficiency of relaxation energy.

title: Electric automobile charging load prediction method, system, equipment and medium
description: The invention discloses an electric vehicle charging load prediction method, system, equipment and medium, and relates to the field of electric vehicle charging load prediction. The method includes: obtaining the charging demand data of a target vehicle cluster in the current period; and determining based on the charging demand data of the current period. The total charging load of the target car cluster in the current period; a variable bandwidth kernel estimation model is used to determine the charging load probability density of the current period based on the total charging load of the current period, and determine the approximate charging load probability density of the current period based on the charging load probability density of the current period. Combine the charging load; input the fitted charging load of the current period into the load prediction model to obtain the fitted charging load of the next period; wherein, the load prediction model is constructed based on the convolutional neural network using a genetic algorithm; the present invention can improve Accuracy of electric vehicle charging load forecasting.

title: Picture marking method and device, storage medium and electronic device
description: This application provides a picture annotation method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device. The above method includes: inputting the picture to be annotated into an image classification model and an optical character recognition model. The image classification model is trained using a set of sample pictures. A set of sample images are obtained from the image library based on target keywords determined by a set of preset tags; a set of image tags for the images to be annotated output by the image classification model are obtained, and a set of image tags for the images to be annotated output by the optical character recognition model are obtained. Picture text, a set of picture tags includes a set of picture style tags and a set of picture topic tags, a set of picture style tags includes a first-level picture style tag and a second-level picture style tag, a group of picture topic tags includes a first-level picture topic tag and a set of picture topic tags Secondary image topic tags; based on a set of image tags and image text, determine the target tag corresponding to the image to be annotated and then determine the annotation result of the image to be annotated.

title: Artificial intelligent design method for energetic molecule
description: The invention discloses an artificial intelligent design method of an energetic molecule, which designs the structure of the energetic molecule by combining a molecule generation model and an attribute prediction model, and comprises three elements: creating a molecular generation model (G) of a molecular structure, an attribute prediction model (D) of a prediction performance and an adaptive molecular design and screening cycle (L); g can reversely generate a molecular structure according to the performance interval, and a computer autonomously generates a specified number of molecules to form a virtual screening molecular library; d, taking the molecular diagram as a unique input to predict the performance of the virtual screening molecules, and screening out energetic molecule candidates (C); expanding the molecular structure data set by using C and retraining G to enable the molecular structure data set to be easier to generate molecules with excellent performance; the application flow of G-D-C-G … … D-C forms L, so that the optimization of the generated model and the screening of the target energetic molecules can be synchronously realized; the invention realizes the rapid discovery of potential novel energetic molecules with limited resources.

title: Water quality parameter estimation method, device and medium based on satellite hyperspectral image
description: The invention discloses a water quality parameter estimation method, equipment and medium based on satellite hyperspectral images. The water quality parameter estimation method includes the following steps: collecting satellite hyperspectral images and water quality monitoring data in a target area and time period; determining the dimensionality reduction band range , delete the satellite hyperspectral remote sensing data to a certain band range; determine the highly correlated two-band data set with a coefficient of determination greater than the determination coefficient threshold; based on the principle that the two highly correlated bands do not appear in the characteristic remote sensing band of the same water quality parameter , traverse and solve all the comprehensive remote sensing reflectances that meet the requirements; use the artificial neural network method to traverse and establish an inversion model between the target water quality parameters and the comprehensive remote sensing reflectance; use the established inversion model to estimate the water quality parameters of the target area. The method of the invention can be used to quickly and accurately determine the characteristic remote sensing bands of different water quality parameters, and has more accurate, precise and reliable feature extraction and water quality parameter estimation capabilities.

title: Image-based defect detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The application is applicable to the technical field of image processing, and provides an image-based defect detection method, an image-based defect detection device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a surface image of a steel coil to be detected; determining a first processed image containing only defective areas from the histogram of the surface image; calculating a gradient map of the surface image through an edge algorithm, determining a segmentation threshold value of the gradient map according to a defect region peak value and a non-defect region peak value in the histogram, and performing binarization processing on the gradient map according to the segmentation threshold value to obtain a second processed image only containing the defect region; and obtaining a defect detection result based on the first processing image and the second processing image. The application can improve the speed and the precision of detecting the surface defects of the steel coil.

title: High-quality image generation method based on improved generation countermeasure network
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to a high-quality image generation method based on improved generation of an countermeasure network, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a training data set; constructing an image generation network, improving a generator and a discriminator network; training the improved GAN network, and gradually learning by the generator to generate text image data close to a real image through alternating training of the generator and the discriminator; generating high-quality text image data, and inputting noise vectors by using a trained generator to generate the high-quality text image data; the beneficial effects are as follows: according to the high-quality image generation method based on the improved generation countermeasure network, through stacking of the deep network and use of residual connection, learning capacity and feature expression capacity of the network are improved, performance of a generator and discrimination capacity of a discriminator are improved, and generated image data has higher quality and diversity and can better meet requirements of a text detection algorithm.

title: Analysis method and device of network data, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for analyzing network data, which are applied to network artificial intelligence network elements and comprise the following steps: receiving an artificial intelligence analysis request, wherein the artificial intelligence analysis request comprises a corresponding service type; inputting a service type into a preset service feature extraction model in response to an artificial intelligence analysis request to obtain service features, wherein the service feature extraction model is obtained by training first training service data contained in a target application layer network element as training data in a federal learning mode, and the service type corresponding to the first training service data is the same as the service type contained in the artificial intelligence analysis request; and matching the service characteristics with user plane data information acquired from the user plane network element, acquiring an analysis result of the network data according to the acquired matching result, and transmitting the analysis result to the consumption network element. The embodiment of the application can provide more accurate perception analysis for the service under the condition of protecting the privacy data of the network element of the application layer.

title: Bacterial keratitis and fungal keratitis slit lamp image classification method based on multi-granularity feature learning
description: The present invention provides a slit lamp image classification method for bacterial keratitis and fungal keratitis based on multi-granularity feature learning, which includes the following steps: constructing a slit lamp image data set containing bacterial keratitis and fungal keratitis , and process it into an appropriate format; preprocess the input image data set; input the preprocessed image data set into the feature extraction network to extract features of different granularities; put the features of different granularities into the contrast selection attention module for feature attention Force enhancement; train the model by predicting the enhanced features of different granularities and combining with the progressive knowledge regularization module; use the trained network model to classify bacterial and fungal keratitis images. The invention uses multi-granularity features to imitate the diagnostic thinking of ophthalmologists from details to the whole, and to understand the subtleties, thereby improving the accuracy and interpretability of automatic diagnosis.

title: Police condition content classification method based on pre-training model
description: The invention discloses a method for classifying police content based on a pre-training model, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology application. The invention includes the following steps: obtaining the alarm content and corresponding manually labeled category data in the alarm receiving system; performing pre-processing operations such as cleaning and deduplication of the original alarm content and corresponding category data to obtain unified and standardized data; extracting the standardized data The data are training data set, verification data set, and test data set; use the training data set to train the pre-trained deep learning network classification model, and use the verification data set to verify the model after training the model in each batch; after the model training is completed, use the test data Set test the model to obtain the model evaluation results; after the evaluation results meet the requirements, the model will be put online to predict and classify online police content data in real time. The present invention uses a pre-trained deep learning network classification model to quickly and effectively predict the categories corresponding to the warning content, with fast response speed, strong pertinence, and good prediction effect.

title: Dialogue data sample enhancement method and dialogue text generation model pre-training method and system
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence dialogue text generation, and in particular to a dialogue data sample enhancement method and a dialogue text generation model pre-training method and system. A single round of dialogue is selected from a collected dialogue sample data set, and the single round of dialogue includes dialogue. content, dialogue responses and dialogue best knowledge. Among them, dialogue best knowledge is the external knowledge with the best relevance to the single-round dialogue topic and assists in generating dialogue responses; based on cross-rotation, the dialogue content, dialogue responses and dialogue in a single-round dialogue are analyzed. The best knowledge is exchanged to generate a new extended single-turn dialogue; the original single-turn dialogue and the new extended single-turn dialogue are spliced to obtain a data-enhanced dialogue sample data set. The present invention can enhance the utilization of existing knowledge dialogue data, use a simple method to achieve data enhancement without increasing the cost of data annotation, improve model performance, and enable the model to obtain the ability to generate responses from different perspectives during the training process.

title: Laser linewidth prediction method and system based on deep learning
description: The invention provides a laser linewidth prediction method and a laser linewidth prediction system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, training data are acquired; s2, establishing a CNN deep learning neural network model and setting model parameters; s3, training and optimizing the CNN deep learning neural network model based on the data obtained in the S1 and testing a network; s4, importing beat frequency electric signal information of the laser to be measured into the CNN deep learning neural network model obtained in S3, and predicting the line width of the laser to be measured. According to the invention, the power spectrum information of the beat frequency electric signal after the laser beat frequency is acquired is constructed, the training set is constructed to establish the convolutional neural network model, the convolutional neural network model is trained, the efficiency of acquiring the line width information can be improved by using the scheme, and the technical difficulty of acquiring the laser line width information is reduced after the model is constructed.

title: A knowledge model construction method and system for amphibious aircraft model training
description: The invention discloses a knowledge model construction method and system for amphibious aircraft model training, which includes: determining the purpose, scope, purpose and user of knowledge ontology construction; performing amphibious aircraft model data based on the determined construction information Collect and analyze, and establish an initial amphibious aircraft model knowledge ontology; refine the initial amphibious aircraft model knowledge ontology to obtain the refined amphibious aircraft model knowledge ontology; make a refinement of the amphibious aircraft model knowledge ontology; Further confirm and verify the consistency to determine the final amphibious aircraft model knowledge ontology; use the knowledge ontology modeling tool to describe the final amphibious aircraft model knowledge ontology in the form of a knowledge model, and build an amphibious aircraft model knowledge model . The invention is used to solve the technical problems of traditional knowledge modeling methods, which are difficult to ensure the uniqueness and unambiguity of knowledge understanding and are prone to combinatorial explosion.

title: Anti-scaling clipping digital image watermarking method based on scaling coefficient detection network
description: The invention discloses a scaling-resistant clipping digital image watermarking method based on a scaling coefficient detection network, which comprises the following training processes: training a convolutional neural network capable of detecting a scaling factor to which the image is subject to a scaling process; digital watermark embedding process: converting an original image from RGB to YCbCr; embedding a template T in a Y component and embedding a watermark W in a Cb component based on a jitter modulation method for modifying the residual error of the DWT-DCT transform domain coefficient set; after the components are combined, converting the components back to RGB to obtain a final image; the digital watermark extraction process comprises the following steps: firstly, scaling factor detection is carried out based on the convolutional neural network, and an image is scaled back to the original size; extracting template information in an image to be detected; the MSE minimum criterion between the sliding splicing template and the extraction template is utilized to conduct exhaustive search to obtain the initial cutting position and cutting is conducted; extracting watermark bits in an image to be detected; and obtaining the final watermark based on the redundancy judgment of minority compliance and majority compliance.

title: Unique control region division method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the field of computers and provides a unique control area dividing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium. The method includes: performing control detection and image segmentation on a user interface image to obtain position information of each control block; responding to a click operation , obtain the click position information, match the click position information with the position information of each control block, use the successfully matched control block as the operation control block, and determine the operation control block position information; obtain the identification information of the operation control block ; Based on the block characteristics, position information and identification information of the operation control block, the user interface image is divided into unique control areas of the operation control block to obtain the target area block. The unique control area division method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium provided by the present invention can ensure that the test tool can uniquely identify the operation control and perform the test operation.

title: Interactive comic generation system, generation method and storage medium based on generative AI technology
description: The invention discloses an interactive comic generation system based on generative AI technology, including: a large language model, an initial corpus, a structure extractor, a world state model, a plot vector space, a plot controller, an image generation module and a user interaction module. This interactive comic generation system based on generative AI technology is a comic generation engine driven by user text and collaboratively created by multiple AI models. It combines the advantages of interactive story experience and automatic content generation technology, and is deeply optimized for the special medium of comics. In this system, the user's interaction method is to explore the comic world and respond to the plot through text input. We pay special attention to the consistency of time coherence and world structure. The order of events and plots in the comic world is coherent and closely related to user input and interaction.

title: Image processing method, device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
description: This application discloses an image processing method, device, electronic equipment and readable storage medium, belonging to the field of image processing. The image processing method includes: obtaining a mask image corresponding to the image to be processed; splicing the n-channel matrix corresponding to the image to be processed and the m-channel matrix corresponding to the mask image to obtain an input matrix of (n+m) channels, where, m and n are both integers greater than 0 and less than 4; input the input matrix of the (n+m) channel into the picture text erasure model, and obtain the text erasure picture output by the picture text erasure model corresponding to the image to be processed; Among them, the image text erasure model is used to use the background color to erase the text area of the image to be processed according to the input matrix of the (n+m) channel, and output the processed text erasure image.

title: DDoS attack and cloud WAF defense method based on neural network
description: The invention provides a DDoS attack and cloud WAF defense method based on a neural network, which relates to the technical field of DDoS attack and cloud WAF defense, and is used for capturing traffic at a network outlet and collecting information flow data; preprocessing the acquired information flow data, and extracting information values from the information flow data; establishing a BP neural network, inputting an information value into the BP neural network for compression information processing; the compressed information values form an information matrix X, and the information matrix X is subjected to data processing to obtain a front characteristic matrix U  *  The method comprises the steps of carrying out a first treatment on the surface of the According to the front characteristic matrix U  *  Judging whether DDoS attack occurs or not; and filtering the data packet of the attack host to realize the defense of DDoS attack.

title: Block chain-based carbon check and power data fusion system and method
description: The invention provides a carbon verification and electric power data fusion system and method based on blockchain. The system includes: a data acquisition unit, a data fusion unit, a data transmission unit and a blockchain platform; the data acquisition unit is used to pass preset sensors Collect raw power data from power grid companies; the fusion unit is used to convert the collected raw power data into carbon emission data through smart contract calculations; the data transmission unit is used to transmit all raw power data and calculated carbon emission data to the block chain platform for storage; the blockchain platform is used to encrypt and save all data transmitted by the data transmission unit, and build an interactive chain domain to provide information query functions; the invention realizes the integration of carbon verification and electric power data, combined with the blockchain Technology for encrypted storage and efficient query.

title: Anti-telecommunication phishing intelligent dissuading system and method
description: The invention discloses an intelligent discouraging system and method for anti-telecommunication phishing, and relates to the field of telecommunication network security. The system comprises: the early warning data receiving module is used for receiving early warning data of a plurality of data sources; the early warning data processing module is used for processing the early warning data; the early warning data analysis module is used for carrying out risk assessment on the processed early warning data according to a preset risk assessment model to obtain a risk grade; the intelligent anti-fraud robot module is used for adopting different treatment strategies for the early warning data according to the risk level; and the early warning data feedback module is used for feeding back the early warning data treatment result to the national anti-fraud center through the data security access boundary. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: the method can effectively identify and prevent telecommunication phishing in various types and scenes, improves the safety awareness and the prevention capability of potential victim users, reduces the occurrence and the loss of the telecommunication phishing, and improves the anti-fraud work efficiency and the level of public security authorities.

title: Early-stage unrealistic information detection method, device, equipment and medium
description: The invention relates to artificial intelligence technology in the financial field, and discloses an early false information detection method, which can be used for early false information detection of some product information on a financial online shopping platform, including: dividing the obtained false information data set into blocks Process and extract the false information semantic feature set from the chunked false information data blocks; use a two-way gated loop detection network to perform temporal false information detection on the false information semantic feature set; and use the neural Hawkes layer to capture False information is classified and inverted; the continuous time scale long short-term memory layer is used to calculate the hidden state of the false information classification and inverted information, the false information detection point is determined based on the hidden state and intensity function, and the false information detection point is fed back to In the bidirectional gated loop detection network, the classification results of target false information are obtained. The invention also relates to a blockchain technology in which false information data sets can be stored in blockchain nodes. The invention also proposes an early false information detection device, equipment and medium. The invention can improve the accuracy of early false information detection.

title: Insulating glass whole process information management system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of production line control. The invention discloses a whole-process information management system for insulating glass, which includes a data acquisition module for acquiring abnormal state characteristic data of abnormal processing equipment in the insulating glass production line, and inputting the abnormal state characteristic data into a pre-constructed In the first machine learning model, to obtain the abnormal state coefficient of each abnormal processing equipment; the strategy generation module is used to compare and analyze the abnormal state coefficient with the set abnormal state coefficient threshold to obtain the optimal insulating glass production process Management strategy; the management strategy includes a first control strategy and a second control strategy; a production control module is used to use the first control strategy or the second control strategy to perform automated and optimized management and control of the insulating glass production process; the present invention is conducive to ensuring Stable operation of insulating glass production tasks when an abnormality or serious accident occurs in the insulating glass production line.

title: Low-light image enhancement method based on semantic information guidance and light curve estimation
description: A low-light image enhancement method based on semantic information guidance and illumination curve estimation belongs to the field of image processing. The present invention introduces semantic information as a guide in the low-light image enhancement process, and performs different lighting adjustments for different semantic areas. To overcome the problem of regional color distortion that often occurs during low-light image enhancement. At the same time, the present invention also proposes a new color curve definition method, which constructs the color curve through discrete expressions and uses a deep learning model based on the mutual attention mechanism to calculate it, so that the color curve can be better defined. Enhance image brightness within semantic areas. The invention solves the problem of regional color distortion in low-light image enhancement and greatly improves the light enhancement performance. Experiments have confirmed that the present invention can achieve performance that exceeds the original low-light enhancement method on three low-light data sets: LOL, LOL-v2, and FiveK.

title: Code automatic generation method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for automatically generating codes, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the following steps: and generating the target code and the unit test code simultaneously through the code generation model, then detecting the target code and the unit test code for the first time by using a code compiler, detecting the target code for the second time by using the unit test code after the detection is passed, and obtaining the final code after the detection is passed twice. Therefore, the codes after the two detection are used as the final codes, so that the codes generated by the code generation model can be guaranteed to normally run on one hand, and the given code requirements can be met on the other hand, so that the usability of the final codes is higher, and the quality of the automatically generated codes is improved.

title: Digital counterweight balanced arch bridge construction method and system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of construction process management, specifically to a digital weight-balanced arch bridge construction method and system, which includes the following steps: based on terrain and bridge design parameters, using data analysis algorithms and computer vision technology to perform intelligent analysis of the bridge structure and generate a bridge deck Department of division plan. In this invention, data analysis algorithms and computer vision technology are used to intelligently analyze the terrain and design parameters of the bridge structure, generate an economical and reasonable bridge deck system segmentation scheme, reduce costs and optimize material use, and use Internet of Things technology and time series analysis to collect real-time construction data Environmental and structural data to improve the safety and efficiency of the construction process, support vector machines for automatic counterweight balancing to reduce human errors and enhance construction reliability, laser scanning and drone mapping technology to improve measurement accuracy, decision trees and neural network algorithms Used for predictive maintenance and risk assessment, digital twin technology optimizes the construction process through virtual simulation and improves project efficiency and quality.

title: Indoor spatial structure estimation method based on transfer learning
description: The invention discloses an indoor space structure estimation method based on transfer learning, which improves a feature extraction module and a prediction module of an original RoomNet model, and carries out data enhancement on an LSUN data set according to a feasible evolution path between indoor space structure types, trains and improves the RoomNet model to obtain an optimal model; in the prediction process, processing an indoor image into a uniform size, and inputting the uniform size into a model to obtain the type of an indoor space structure and a key point hetmap; then calculating the position of the key point in the image according to the key point hetmap; and finally, connecting all the key points in sequence according to the key point sequence corresponding to the predicted indoor space structure type, so as to estimate the indoor space structure. The invention solves the problems of difficult estimation of key points caused by easy shielding of the key points and structural features and uneven illumination in indoor space structure estimation and poor model generalization capability caused by unbalanced sample types in the LSUN data set.

title: File transmission method, system and device
description: A file transmission method, system and device are used to solve the problem of high bandwidth cost required for edge nodes to transmit data to central nodes. The transmission method is suitable for a file transmission system including multiple edge nodes and a central node, and the multiple edge nodes include a first edge node. The first edge node determines the incremental information of the first edge node based on the original data file of the first edge node; the first edge node sends the incremental information to the central node, where the incremental information includes a high-frequency field and a high-frequency field. The number of occurrences of the field in the original data file. The number of occurrences of the high-frequency field in the original data file is greater than the frequency threshold. Correspondingly, the central node receives the incremental information from the first edge node, and sends the incremental information to other edge nodes among the plurality of edge nodes except the first edge node.

title: A feature vector extraction method for fiber optic acoustic wave sensing early warning system
description: The invention discloses a feature vector extraction method for an optical fiber acoustic wave sensing early warning system, which includes the following steps: the optical fiber acoustic wave sensing early warning system collects vibration signals; through data preprocessing, the distribution of vibration acoustic wave energy distributed along the optical fiber is calculated in real time. Set a threshold to capture the data position of the local energy active range and obtain the local energy active range data; perform multi-dimensional principal component analysis on the original sampling data of the acquired data block in terms of spatial distribution, time distribution, amplitude phase distribution and frequency domain distribution; through Multiple groups of extracted feature vectors are combined to form a feature vector containing multi-dimensional information, and a model training for machine learning is constructed for recognition. This method can ensure the accuracy of model training and timeliness by obtaining a small amount of effective feature data, and improve the system recognition response speed and recognition accuracy.

title: Single-antenna satellite speed measurement method and system for two-dimensional trajectory correction fuze
description: The invention discloses a single-antenna satellite speed measurement method and system for a two-dimensional ballistic correction fuze, which can be used for speed measurement of satellite signals received by a single antenna of a two-dimensional ballistic correction fuze. It includes the following functional modules: roll attitude measurement module, positioning module, neural network rotation Doppler prediction module, rotation Doppler stripping speed measurement module, and satellite signal baseband tracking processing module. The single-patch microstrip antenna installed on the side of the two-dimensional ballistic correction fuze receives satellite signals while rotating. The carrier Doppler frequency is seriously interfered by rotating Doppler, and the influencing mechanism is complex, making it difficult to achieve accurate speed measurement. The invention proposes a speed measurement method for rotating and receiving satellite signals with a single antenna, and uses a neural network to peel off the rotating Doppler component in the carrier Doppler, thereby achieving accurate speed measurement.

title: Method, device, computer equipment and medium for predicting service life of power transmission line element
description: The application relates to a method, a device, computer equipment and a medium for predicting the service life of a power transmission line element. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target operation data and target environment data of a target power transmission line element in a current period; inputting the target operation data and the target environment data into a target digital twin model to obtain a current life value of a target power transmission line element in a current period; and determining the target life value of the target power transmission line element according to the historical life value and the current life value of the target power transmission line element in the historical period. According to the method, after the current life value is determined through the target digital twin model according to the target operation data and the target environment data, the target life value of the target power transmission line element is determined based on the historical life value and the current life value, the problem that the current life value is inaccurate due to low accuracy of the target digital twin model and the problem that the target life value is inaccurate is finally caused is solved, and the determined life value of the target power transmission line element is more accurate.

title: Fine tuning method, device, equipment and storage medium for on-board neural network
description: The invention provides a fine-tuning method, device, equipment and storage medium for on-board neural networks, which can be applied in the field of satellite technology. The method includes: S1, using a low-rank module and a pre-trained neural network to construct a neural network to be fine-tuned; S2, during the fine-tuning process, keeping the weight of the neural network to be fine-tuned unchanged, using the low-rank module Calculate the gradient; S3, add the weight and the gradient to generate update parameters; S4, use the update parameters to optimize the neural network to be fine-tuned; S5, repeat S2-S4 until the neural network to be fine-tuned The neural network achieves optimal convergence results, which can greatly reduce parameter adjustment costs.

title: Solar panel defect detection method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium for detecting defects of a solar panel, and belongs to the technical field of defect detection of solar panels. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a solar panel image; inputting the solar panel image into a trained defect detection model for processing so as to obtain a defect detection result; specifically, deep rolling and cross-space learning are carried out on the solar panel image through a trunk feature network, space dimensions are compressed, feature information of different dimensions is fused, and a first feature map of different dimensions is obtained; inputting the first feature images with different scales into a reinforced feature extraction network for processing, performing dense convolution and separation convolution on the first feature images, and penetrating information generated by the dense convolution into the separation convolution to obtain second feature images with different scales; and obtaining a defect detection result according to the second characteristic diagram. The method can balance the detection precision and speed of the solar cell panel, and solves the problem of unbalanced detection precision and speed of the existing defects.

title: A DEM correction method, electronic equipment and storage medium for regional network adjustment model
description: The invention provides a DEM correction method, electronic equipment and storage medium for an area network adjustment model. The DEM correction method for an area network adjustment model includes: dividing the first preset area into at least one grid; obtaining the first At least one laser height measurement control point in the preset area; generate a virtual control point; determine the temporary offset, and translate the composite image by the temporary offset to obtain a translated composite image; based on at least one laser height measurement control point and virtual control point Determine the translation elevation error by at least one of the parameters and translate the synthetic image; determine the temporary offset when the translation elevation error is minimum as the absolute offset, and translate the absolute offset of the synthetic image to obtain a plane absolute adjustment image; elevation adjustment The plane absolute adjustment image is obtained to obtain the regional network adjustment image. The adjustment accuracy of DEM images can be improved through the above methods.

title: Edible oil spectrum image classification method based on double-branch residual neural network
description: The invention discloses an edible oil spectrum image classification method based on a double-branch residual neural network, which specifically comprises the following steps: collecting hyperspectral information of an oil sample through a spectrum collecting system, and correcting spectrum errors of the oil sample caused by particle scattering by using a standard normal variable; extracting a spectrum wavelength effective wave band by using an information-free variable removal algorithm; training the spectral characteristics by using a double-branch residual neural network model to obtain a classification result of each sample, and detecting edible oil adulteration. The method combines standard normal variable correction (SNV) with an information-free variable removal algorithm (UVE) and can correct errors of a spectrum data set and remove redundant information. The dual-branch residual neural network model can extract the two-dimensional space and three-dimensional spatial spectrum combined characteristics of spectrum data and perform characteristic fusion, and improves the detection accuracy of the edible oil spectrum data.

title: A clothing design method and its pattern making device based on multi-modal data
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of clothing design, and in particular to a clothing design method based on multi-modal data and a pattern making device thereof. In the field of clothing design, the design process often requires manual drawing, which is inefficient, high-cost, and cannot be followed. In order to meet the constant demands of modern people for clothing, the present invention provides a clothing design method based on multi-modal data, including the following steps: data collection, data preprocessing, feature fusion, loss function, model training, model evaluation, clothing design , feedback optimization, the above solution can quickly generate and evaluate a large number of different design concepts, generate complex patterns and layouts, reduce the burden on designers, accelerate the design process, thereby reducing production costs, which helps designers realize their goals more quickly The creative conception generates personalized clothing designs based on individual preferences and characteristics, which makes customizing clothing easier and helps meet customers' specific needs.

title: Base station site selection method based on improved dayfish algorithm
description: The invention discloses a base station site selection method based on an improved ephemera algorithm, which includes: obtaining user distribution data in the area to be deployed; obtaining a candidate base station site set, which includes the location coordinates of the base station; according to the link The budget and propagation model estimate the base station coverage radius; determine the coverage rate of the area to be deployed based on the base station coverage radius, base station site, and user location coordinates. The coverage rate of the deployment area is the ratio of the number of covered users to the total number of users. Ratio; construct a mathematical model. The objective function of the mathematical model is to maximize the base station coverage radius and minimize the base station construction cost in the area to be deployed. The constraint condition of the objective function is that the coverage rate of the area to be deployed is greater than 90%; adopt improvements The ephemera algorithm solves the mathematical model and obtains the optimal solution for base station location selection. The invention achieves a balance between economic benefits and coverage performance of base station construction, and realizes base station location selection efficiently and accurately.

title: An intelligent and low-cost electroplating method
description: The invention provides an intelligent low-cost electroplating method, which belongs to the field of electroplating technology. The intelligent low-cost electroplating method includes the following steps: oil and contamination removal: first, the metal plated parts are cleaned to remove oil stains and impurities on the surface, and the cleaning is completed. Set aside for later use; pickling: put the metal plated parts cleaned in step S1 into a pickling solution for pickling treatment, then use an activator to clean, and finally wash with clean water; electroplating; acceptance treatment; the present invention In the process, by repeatedly cleaning the metal plated parts before electroplating, and using the saponification properties of oil removal liquid and alkali, the oil stains on the surface of the metal plated parts can be better cleaned, and rinsed with water after cleaning, so that the metal plating The surface of the parts can be cleaned cleaner before electroplating, and there are less residues, making the plating effect better during electroplating.

title: Federal learning optimization method for realizing data enhancement based on data distribution similarity
description: The invention discloses a federated learning optimization method that realizes data enhancement based on data distribution similarity. In this method, the client first calculates the respective local data category distribution information Pi and statistical  information D i   ,  and uploads them to the central server. Secondly, the central server uses  Pi  to represent each client, and aggregates the data category distribution information  Pi  of the clients in the group to represent each group. Then the central server aggregates the statistical information of the data categories to obtain the mean and covariance of the global data categories for data enhancement. Finally, federated learning training is performed. The client uses local data to train the grouping models in sequence, and the central server uses the classic federated learning algorithm to aggregate the grouping models and generate a new global model. This invention solves the problem of low global model accuracy caused by data heterogeneity in federated learning scenarios.

title: Question classification method, question classification model training method and device
description: The present application provides a question classification method, a question classification model training method and a device, wherein the question classification method includes: obtaining the question information to be classified and the question type information associated with the question information to be classified, wherein the question information to be classified includes The topic to be classified and the subject to be classified of the topic to be classified; the topic to be classified and the subject to be classified are input into the topic classification model, and the topic classification result output by the topic classification model is obtained; according to the subject to be classified and the subject to be classified The associated question type information determines the target classification question type of the question to be classified in the question classification result. While reducing the cost and time of manual annotation, it is possible to classify questions based on the discipline corresponding to each question and improve the accuracy of question classification.

title: Classification model training methods and classification identification methods applied in the health field
description: The invention discloses a classification model training method and a classification identification method applied in the health field. It relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology and includes: obtaining data to be trained; inputting the data to be trained into the first sub-network of the preset classification model to generate coding vector, and perform dimensionality reduction processing on the encoding vector to obtain the target vector, and determine the target weight according to the target vector, perform weighted pooling processing on the training data according to the target weight to obtain the weighted pooling vector; input the data to be trained into the preset classification model The two sub-networks perform average pooling processing to obtain the average pooling vector; determine the fusion vector between the average pooling vector and the weighted pooling vector, and use the fusion vector to predict to obtain the prediction type; according to the average pooling vector and weighted pooling vector The vector determines the information bottleneck loss; train a preset classification model based on the annotation type and prediction type of the data to be trained and the information bottleneck loss. Improved the robustness and classification accuracy of the classification model.

title: Small sample medical image processing method based on double similarity measurement and joint learning
description: The invention discloses a small sample medical image processing method based on double similarity measurement and joint learning, which constructs meta tasks for a training set and a test set respectively, and associates and processes a support set and a query set for each task. In the feature space, a double-similarity measurement module is constructed, cosine similarity is calculated for samples of the same class, euclidean distance is calculated for prototypes of each class, and measurement loss constraint is carried out, so that similarity of the classes is high, and differences among the classes are large. In the training phase, a target optimizer is trained jointly based on joint learning of support set and query set samples. In the testing stage, similarity calculation is carried out on the query set sample to be predicted and the support set category prototype to obtain a preliminary prediction label, and then a final prediction label is obtained through a target optimizer. By using the method, the model provides a general and effective auxiliary diagnosis method for classifying the small sample chest X-ray image diseases through learning double-similarity measurement and a combined learning module.

title: Remote dynamic monitoring system and method for playing of LED display screen
description: A remote dynamic monitoring system and method for playing LED display screen is disclosed. Firstly, acquiring temperature values of a plurality of monitored display screens acquired by a temperature sensor at a plurality of preset time points in a preset time period, then, carrying out data preprocessing on the temperature values of the plurality of preset time points of each monitored display screen in the preset time period to obtain a plurality of display screen temperature time sequence input vectors, then, extracting global temperature time sequence characteristics of the plurality of display screen temperature time sequence input vectors to obtain a display screen global pseudo-type center temperature time sequence characteristic vector, and finally, determining whether the corresponding display screen is abnormal or not based on a difference measurement coefficient between the display screen temperature time sequence distribution of each monitored display screen and the display screen global pseudo-type center temperature time sequence characteristic vector. Thus, the abnormal condition of the LED display screen can be identified.

title: Task processing method and device based on non-data knowledge distillation and electronic equipment
description: The application provides a task processing method and device based on distillation without data knowledge and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving a student model acquisition request sent by a terminal device, wherein the student model acquisition request carries task processing requirements; obtaining a teacher model meeting the task processing requirements according to the task processing requirements; training the plurality of generators and the plurality of student models according to the teacher model; and sending the trained appointed student model in the plurality of student models to terminal equipment, and performing task processing by the terminal equipment by utilizing the appointed student model. The method can improve the accuracy of the terminal equipment when the trained student model is used for task processing.

title: Face recognition system and logistics system of face recognition system
description: The present invention discloses a face recognition system and a logistics system of the face recognition system, which belongs to the field of artificial intelligence. A face recognition system includes a data acquisition module, a preprocessing module, a facial detection module, a feature extraction module, a database management module, a security and privacy module, a comparison and recognition module, a decision module, an output module, an output customization module, and a custom training module; the logistics system of the face recognition system includes a face recognition module, an authority verification module, an order processing module, an inventory management module, a logistics operation module, a notification and reporting module, a monitoring and log module, and an alarm and exception handling module. A face recognition system uses face recognition to enhance the security of office spaces, replace traditional clock-in machines, and provide customized shopping experiences in retail environments; provide targeted advertising and promotional activities and monitor the beneficial effects of face occlusion in workplaces or public areas.

title: Training and recognition method for cargo images and corresponding device
description: The present disclosure relates to training and recognition methods for cargo images and corresponding devices. The training method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of cargo images and corresponding cargo categories of cargo areas of the plurality of cargo images; performing semantic analysis on the plurality of cargo images to obtain a localized block diagram of cargo areas of the plurality of cargo images; performing feature extraction on the plurality of cargo images based on the localized block diagrams of the cargo areas of the plurality of cargo images to obtain feature vectors of the cargo areas of the plurality of cargo images; performing hierarchical clustering processing on the feature vectors of the cargo areas of the plurality of cargo images based on the corresponding cargo categories of the cargo areas of the plurality of cargo images to obtain standard feature vectors of each cargo category of the plurality of cargo categories; and establishing an independent threshold for each cargo category based on the standard feature vector for each of the plurality of cargo categories.

title: Multi-mode false information detection network based on attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses a multi-mode false information detection network based on an attention mechanism, and relates to the technical field of false information detection. The BERT model and the Bi-GRU model are adopted to realize the feature extraction of the data information of the text mode, and the feature of the picture mode data is extracted through the fast-RCNN; feature alignment is carried out on feature vectors of different dimensions of two different modes through contrast learning pre-training, then an intermodal attention mechanism and an in-modal attention mechanism are built through an attention mechanism, features of different modes in the language and vision fields are captured for interaction, multiple iterations of the process are carried out, final characterization of multiple modes is achieved, a final joint characterization model is obtained and used for detecting false information, and finally the authenticity probability of the multi-mode information is obtained. The invention realizes accurate detection of false information in the media platform and social software, timely screens false information and rumors, and protects the authenticity and effectiveness of data.

title: Optimal value evaluation-oriented byproduct energy optimal scheduling method
description: The present invention discloses a method for optimizing the scheduling of by-product energy for optimal value evaluation, including: S1, data preprocessing, S2, establishing an energy scheduling model, S3, solving the model using a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and constraints of multiple models; the constraints include gas supply and demand balance constraints, steam supply and demand balance constraints, electricity supply and demand balance constraints, energy balance constraints, equipment operation constraints, equipment capacity constraints, gas tank capacity constraints, etc. The present invention discloses a method for optimizing the scheduling of by-product energy for optimal value evaluation, using an objective function and constraints to establish an energy scheduling model, making full use of the by-product energy derived from production, thereby coupling various energy subsystems within the enterprise, optimizing the efficiency of energy utilization, ensuring the safe operation of the energy system, and improving the economic benefits of the enterprise.

title: Method and system for planning capacity lifting path
description: The embodiments of the present specification provide a method and system for planning a capability improvement path, the method comprising: obtaining an initial capability map corresponding to the capability to be improved of a target user, the initial capability map comprising two or more knowledge points related to the capability to be improved, each knowledge point corresponding to one or more learning contents; obtaining behavior data of the target user related to the capability to be improved; determining an initial capability score of the capability to be improved based on the initial capability map and the behavior data; determining a target capability score of the capability to be improved based on at least one of the initial capability score and the behavior data; and determining a capability improvement path for the target user based on the initial capability score and the target capability score.

title: Device and method for automatic identification of neurosurgical lesions
description: The invention relates to the field of machine learning, and discloses an automatic identification device and an automatic identification method for a neurosurgical focus, which are used for effectively combining 3D CNN and GCNs so as to realize better performance in a focus identification task. The automatic identification method of the neurosurgery focus comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring and processing a three-dimensional medical image to obtain a training sample set. Then, the 3DCNN model is used for extracting the characteristics, constructing a focus relation graph, and the characteristics are updated by a graph convolution network. And then, classifying by combining the updated and original characteristics, and judging the focus and type. Finally, according to the classification result and the true labeling data optimization model, a trained 3DCNN and graph convolution network is obtained and used for automatically identifying the neurosurgery focus. The automatic identification method for the neurosurgery focus solves the defects of the prior art in the aspects of processing three-dimensional medical images and integrating space information by combining the technical advantages of the 3D CNN and GCNs, and improves the accuracy and efficiency of focus identification.

title: Image reconstruction method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to an image reconstruction method, device, computer equipment and storage medium. The method comprises: inputting the image to be reconstructed into the image segmentation submodel and the super-resolution submodel in the image reconstruction model; the output layer of the image segmentation submodel is connected to the middle layer of the super-resolution submodel through the connection layer of the super-resolution submodel, and the output resolution of the middle layer of the super-resolution submodel and the output layer of the image segmentation submodel are the same. The image to be reconstructed is processed by the image segmentation submodel to obtain a segmented image output by the image segmentation submodel; the image to be reconstructed and the segmented image are processed by the super-resolution submodel to obtain a super-resolution image output by the super-resolution submodel as the reconstructed image corresponding to the image to be reconstructed. The use of this method can not only make the boundaries of the segmented area clearer, but also make the details of the segmented area richer, which can significantly improve the image quality of intravascular ultrasound imaging.

title: Image evaluation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present application discloses an image evaluation method, device, electronic device and storage medium for improving the objectivity and accuracy of CG work evaluation. In an embodiment of the present application, an image to be evaluated is obtained, and the level of the image to be evaluated is determined; based on the level of the image to be evaluated, a scoring prediction model and a comment prediction model corresponding to the image to be evaluated are determined; the image to be evaluated is input into the scoring prediction model to obtain the score of the image to be evaluated; based on the score of the image to be evaluated, a reference image corresponding to the image to be evaluated is obtained; the image to be evaluated, the reference image and the score of the image to be evaluated are input into the comment prediction model to obtain the comment of the image to be evaluated. Corresponding scoring prediction models are set for images to be evaluated at different levels, so that the score of the image to be evaluated is more accurate. Secondly, no manual intervention is required in the image evaluation method provided in the present application, so that the evaluation result of the image to be evaluated is more objective and saves labor costs.

title: Pellet production condition detection method, device, equipment and medium
description: The present application relates to the field of mineral industry detection technology, and provides a method, device, equipment and medium for detecting the production condition of pellet ore. The method includes: performing text annotation to obtain the label of the production condition image; using the image feature extraction model to extract features to obtain image features; using the text encoder to encode the label to obtain text features; optimizing the image feature extraction model and the text encoder; the optimized text encoder obtains the final text features; the optimized image feature extraction model obtains the final image features of the production sample image; the multi-task classification model obtains the marginal probability between the production sample image and the final text features; the multi-task classification model is optimized to obtain the final marginal probability between the production image to be detected and each final text feature; and the condition detection result is obtained based on the final marginal probability. The method of the present application can effectively improve the detection accuracy of the production condition detection of pellet ore.

title: A method and system for predicting the remaining service life of mechanical equipment
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for predicting the remaining useful life of mechanical equipment, including: constructing a remaining useful life prediction model based on a time series fully connected encoder; performing data preparation work in the model training phase, normalizing and segmenting the data; performing data clipping on the training set data to reduce the size of the training data set; training the constructed remaining useful life prediction model; and using the trained remaining useful life prediction model to perform real-time remaining useful life prediction. The present invention proposes a model architecture based on a time series fully connected encoder, and uses equipment status monitoring data to perform RUL prediction, which can better mine the complex relationships and laws in time series data, improve the accuracy and reliability of RUL prediction, and has the characteristics of low resource consumption, low computing power cost, and easy deployment, which is helpful to promote the application of data-driven predictive maintenance technology.

title: Train satellite positioning spoofing early warning method, system, equipment and medium
description: The embodiments of this specification provide a train satellite positioning deception warning method, system, device and medium, wherein the method includes collecting the positioning data of the train autonomous positioning unit under no deception and preset deception attack conditions based on the deception scenario test, and calculating the historical reference quantity of the navigation satellite signal observation characteristics to obtain the first data set; iteratively training the optimized lightweight gradient boosting machine to obtain the train satellite positioning deception state recognition model; iteratively training the long short-term memory network to obtain the train satellite positioning deception situation prediction model; inputting the real-time positioning data of the train autonomous positioning unit into the deception state recognition model to determine the current deception state flag quantity, and when the deception state flag quantity is a deception state, calling the deception situation prediction model to determine the deception trend flag quantity, and determine the degree of deception influence of the train autonomous positioning unit. This solves the problem that the prior art does not have an active protection mechanism for preemptive prevention from the perspective of forecasting and warning.

title: Power system reliability assessment method based on improvement Nataf
description: The present invention discloses a method for evaluating the reliability of a power system based on improved Nataf, which uses improved Nataf sampling technology to accelerate the method for generating samples for random influencing factors of the system in the process of evaluating the reliability of the power system; the process of evaluating the reliability of the power system includes two links: generating samples for random influencing factors of the system and calculating the reliability index of the samples; the improved Nataf sampling method includes improved initial value point generation, rapid generation of the original correlation test matrix, calculation of the normal correlation matrix, optimal mapping of the semi-positive definite matrix, and generation of inverse function mapping samples. The present invention can be applied to the operation evaluation of uncertain system objects containing high dimensions and correlation, and supports application scenarios such as rapid sample generation and reliability analysis of arbitrary distribution; when the traditional Nataf transform is applied to the reliability analysis of the power system, the problem of lengthy calculation time for arbitrary distribution is solved.

title: A method, system and device for carbon sequestration and sink enhancement in farmland based on silicate rock weathering
description: The invention provides a method, a system and equipment for carbon fixation and sink enhancement of farmland based on silicate rock weathering, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic agricultural management data; wherein, the agricultural management base data includes: carbon sequestration data for silicate weathering, farmland environment data, carbon emission data for soil carbon flux and carbon emission data for agricultural management; calculating an agricultural production management carbon emission amount according to the agricultural management basic data; acquiring a preset farmland carbon emission target value; and adjusting farmland management measures according to the preset farmland carbon emission target value and the agricultural production management carbon emission. The method can calculate the carbon emission amount of agricultural production management, solves the problems of unknown farmland carbon emission amount after adding the carbon fixation and fertilizer increase modifier based on silicate rock, can accurately estimate the carbon emission amount of agricultural production management, and provides data support for achieving the carbon emission target. The farmland management measures can be adjusted according to the calculated agricultural production management carbon emission and the preset farmland carbon emission target value.

title: Real CT self-supervised denoising method and device based on slice similarity
description: The present invention provides a real CT self-supervised denoising method and device based on slice similarity. The method first analyzes the features between similar images at different slice intervals and calculates the noise correlation, thereby constructing a data set of low-correlated noise; then introduces a blind spot scheme to combine blind spot denoising with original noisy image denoising to eliminate independent noise while avoiding the loss of valuable pixel information; finally, the denoising network is updated and trained according to a preset loss function, and the trained self-supervised denoising model is used to denoise the real CT image on the basis of restoring the inherent features, thereby improving the denoising performance in real scenes. Experimental results verify the feasibility and superiority of the proposed method in real CT image denoising.

title: Applet sub-service identification method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The specification provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for identifying the sub-service of an applet, which are characterized in that the characteristics of the applet are expanded by acquiring original characteristic data of the applet and acquiring operation characteristic data generated in the use process of the applet by adopting a computer network technology, and the content of the applet in the use process is understood by acquiring external operation characteristic data, so that the characteristics can characterize the functions of the applet. Meanwhile, the method is not limited in the form of the features, can provide rich data base for recognition of the small program sub-service for the multi-mode features such as texts, pictures and statistical data, more accurately represents the specific functions of the small program, improves the accuracy of recognition of the small program sub-service, and further facilitates popularization and use of the small program.

title: Intelligent Level Evaluation Algorithm Based on Fuzzy Mathematics Theory
description: The present invention discloses an intelligence level evaluation algorithm based on fuzzy mathematics theory, defines the intelligence level as a fuzzy object, and adopts a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation algorithm based on fuzzy mathematics theory to evaluate the intelligence level of an intelligent agent. Fuzzy mathematics is a mathematical theory and method for studying and processing fuzzy phenomena, and a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation algorithm is a method for overall evaluation of multi-factor complex objects. The evaluation algorithm includes a content comment set, a factor set, a membership function, a weight vector, and a fuzzy mapping. The present invention constructs an organizational structure and behavioral capability index, mainly a hierarchical structure, a multi-agent command and control system architecture that takes into account horizontal associations and vertical penetrations, and uses a deep learning algorithm to analyze the intelligence level of a multi-agent game deduction model.

title: Personalized autonomous electronic forms
description: A method includes: receiving, by a processing device, a natural language query corresponding to a request to create a personalized document having a tabular structure for the user from a client device associated with a user; determining, by the processing device, one or more attribute categories related to the personalized document; identifying, by the processing device, at least one external data source including at least one subjective data source related to the user; retrieving, by the processing device, data items indicating the one or more attribute categories from the at least one external data source; and generating, by the processing device, a personalized document for the user by filling each cell of the personalized document with the corresponding data item.

title: Video abstract processing method, system, readable storage medium and computer equipment
description: The invention provides a video abstract processing method, a system, a readable storage medium and computer equipment, which comprise the steps of obtaining a video data set, dividing the video data set to obtain a video organization structure; extracting key frames of a video organization structure based on a video reconstruction method; dividing the video organization structure based on a clustering strategy to divide the video organization structure into a plurality of clusters; obtaining the similarity of a plurality of clusters according to a target detection algorithm based on deep learning, and connecting the clusters based on the similarity and a distance connection mode to obtain continuous key frames; and scanning the continuous key frames by adopting a multi-scale sliding window to extract video features, and carrying out normalization operation on the video features to fuse the video features so as to obtain abstract video. The invention can fully express video information through the continuous key frames, and can effectively improve the processing efficiency of the video abstract by scanning the continuous key frames.

title: A method and device for monitoring elderly people's falls based on wearable devices
description: The present invention discloses a fall monitoring method and device for the elderly based on wearable devices, which relates to the technical field of fall monitoring, and solves the problem of effective monitoring and timely alarm of falls of elderly people living alone at home. The technical points of the present invention include: obtaining continuous acceleration time series and angular velocity time series collected by IMU sensors worn on multiple parts of the elderly's body to form a training data set; extracting time domain features and frequency domain features from multidimensional acceleration time series and multidimensional angular velocity time series, and performing dimensionality reduction processing on the acquired feature vectors; inputting the training data set after dimensionality reduction processing into a classification model based on an improved support vector machine for training, and obtaining a trained classification model; inputting the continuous acceleration time series and angular velocity time series collected in real time by the IMU sensor to be classified into the trained classification model, and obtaining the classification result.
