The present invention can effectively monitor the indoor behavior of elderly people living alone, and provide accurate warning when the elderly fall.

title: Mixed mode clustering method and device based on generated graph structure matching
description: The invention discloses a mixed mode clustering method and a device based on graph structure matching, which utilize a self-encoder module to project mixed mode data to different feature spaces and calculate feature matrixes of different mode data; establishing bidirectional mapping between different modal feature spaces, and generating a pseudo representation of a missing mode; constructing a bipartite graph in the mode between the existing representation and the pseudo representation in the same mode, guiding the generation of the characteristic representation of the missing mode data, and obtaining the complete mode information of the data; on the basis, an independent graph is constructed for each mode, global structures among samples are captured by executing graph convolution operation, and a graph matching mechanism is adopted to realize heterogeneous mode characteristic alignment; therefore, the method can generate missing mode information without paired mode data, align heterogeneous mode data characteristics, integrate the missing mode generation and the heterogeneous mode alignment into a unified framework, effectively mine the inherent correlation between mixed mode data and acquire a better clustering result.

title: Machine learning-based slab heating process parameter optimization method
description: The invention relates to a slab heating process parameter optimization method based on machine learning, and belongs to the technical field of steel rolling heating furnace optimization control methods. The technical scheme of the invention is as follows: forming samples from the optimal target parameters of slab heating and historical data of slab heating process, forming a sample set from all the samples, and determining the cluster number; randomly selecting k samples from the sample set as initial mean vectors, calculating the distance between the samples and each mean vector, and determining cluster marks according to the mean vector closest to the distance; and (3) dividing the samples into corresponding clusters to calculate a new mean value vector, and finally obtaining an optimal ideal vector which contains optimal slab heating process parameters. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: by using historical data in machine learning slab heating production, target parameters and process parameters of optimal slab heating are selected, so that optimization of slab heating process parameters is realized, and slab heating quality is further improved.

title: Knowledge-graph-based corrosion-resistant steel corrosion grade prediction method and device
description: The present invention relates to the field of corrosion-resistant steel processing technology, and in particular to a method and device for predicting the corrosion grade of corrosion-resistant steel based on a knowledge graph, the method comprising: obtaining source data; performing data cleaning on the source data, and dividing the corrosion grade of corrosion-resistant steel according to the distribution law of corrosion data; constructing a triple data set according to the processed source data; constructing a knowledge graph in the field of corrosion-resistant steel corrosion according to the triple data set; processing the knowledge graph in the field of corrosion-resistant steel corrosion according to the TransE model to obtain a vectorized representation of entities and relationships; obtaining a target corrosion-resistant steel vector and a given medium condition vector, using Euclidean distance to calculate the similarity between corrosion-resistant steels, and further determining the corrosion grade of the target corrosion-resistant steel vector under the given medium condition vector. The present invention can store corrosion data involving multiple corrosion-resistant steels and multiple medium conditions, realize the prediction of corrosion grade of corrosion-resistant steel, and is conducive to improving the material selection efficiency in the design stage and reducing maintenance costs.

title: AI generation content quality evaluation model training method based on multi-echelon generation model
description: The present invention discloses a method for training an AI-generated content quality assessment model based on a multi-echelon generation model, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method includes: obtaining a plurality of trained AI generation models, dividing the plurality of AI generation models into a plurality of echelons based on prior knowledge, the plurality of echelons having different levels, and the levels being associated with the quality of AI-generated content of the AI generation model; determining an AI-generated content quality assessment model to be trained and training the AI-generated content quality assessment model based on a plurality of trained AI generation models in a plurality of echelons; the trained AI-generated content quality assessment model can assess the quality of the generated content of the AI generation model, and can distinguish between AI generation models of different echelons. The present invention trains the AI-generated content quality assessment model without manually annotated data, and enables it to better understand the complexity and diversity of AI-generated content.

title: Method and system for comprehensive evaluation of campus students' learning ability
description: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a method and system for comprehensive evaluation of the learning ability of campus students, which collects basic data and performance data of a target student population; collects heart rate variability physiological data corresponding to the target student population based on remote photoplethysmography, and obtains individual potential ability prediction results corresponding to the heart rate variability physiological data; performs data fusion to obtain fused data; constructs a training set based on the fused data, constructs a comprehensive evaluation model for student learning ability based on a Gaussian process classification algorithm, inputs the training set into the comprehensive evaluation model for student learning ability for training, and obtains a trained comprehensive evaluation model for student learning ability; inputs a sample to be tested into the trained comprehensive evaluation model for student learning ability, and obtains a comprehensive evaluation grade of student learning ability corresponding to the sample to be tested. The method for comprehensive evaluation of the learning ability of campus students solves the problem that the existing technology cannot accurately evaluate the learning ability of campus students.

title: Electric smelting magnesium furnace working condition detection method and system based on attention and dendritic network
description: The invention discloses a method and system for detecting working conditions of a molten magnesium furnace based on attention and a dendritic network. The method comprises: collecting image data of the molten magnesium furnace under various working conditions; preprocessing the image data and marking the corresponding working conditions of the molten magnesium furnace; using a Transformer-based image encoder to process the preprocessed image data; building a dendritic network to classify feature sequences processed by the image encoder, wherein the image encoder and the dendritic network constitute a self-attention mechanism dendritic network; pre-training the built self-attention mechanism dendritic network first, and then performing migration training; using the trained self-attention mechanism dendritic network to identify the working conditions of the molten magnesium furnace; the invention has the advantages of accurate detection results, intuitive models, and strong interpretability.

title: Dynamic phase machine automation of oil & gas processes
description: A method, apparatus, and program product facilitate the automation of an oil & gas process, e.g., a drilling process, through the use of a dynamic phase machine incorporating multiple autonomous agents.

title: Methods and systems for analyses used in petroleum wells
description: The present invention describes the use of a method for determining sensor connections in a well, comprising the use of a system involving three different techniques - Monte Carlo technique, for modelling uncertainties of the physical parameters of petroleum; genetic algorithm technique, for generating possible solutions and also triage thereof; artificial neural network technique, for simulating the individual/environment pair, created by the aforesaid techniques, and evaluation of the performance of said pair. The method and the system use the Monte Carlo technique to determine uncertainties in the propagation medium, rendering the method sufficiently generic for it to be used in wells of any depth and with any filling fluid.

title: Improvements related to forecasting systems
description: A computer-implemented method of determining an approximated value of a parameter in a first domain is described. The parameter is dependent on one or more variables which vary in a second domain, and the parameter is determined by a function which relates sets of values of the one or more variables in the second domain to corresponding values in the first domain. The method is implemented on a computer system including a processor, and the method comprises: determining a plurality of anchor points in the second domain, wherein each anchor point comprises a set of values of the one or more variables in the second domain; evaluating, at each anchor point, the function to generate corresponding values of the parameter in the first domain; generating an approximation function to the function by fitting a series of orthogonal functions or an approximation to a series of orthogonal functions to the corresponding values of the parameter in the first domain; and using the approximation function to generate the approximated value of the parameter in the first domain.

title: System for energy consumption prediction
description: A computer-implemented method of generating predicted energy consumption data for a first energy consumer based on energy consumption data of a plurality of further energy consumers is disclosed. Prediction is based on a set of training samples, each training sample comprising predictor attribute data and energy consumption data for a respective one of the further energy consumers, as well as one or more predictor attribute values for the first energy consumer. A predictive model is generated based on the training samples, the predictive model defining a relationship between values of predictor attributes and energy consumption data of the training samples. Predicted energy consumption data for the first energy consumer is then determined using the predictive model and the predictor attribute values.A method of clustering energy consumption profiles is also disclosed.

title: Sensing system, sensor node device, sensor measurement value processing method, and program
description: Provided is a sensing system comprising a plurality of sensor node devices and an analysis device. Each of the plurality of sensor node devices comprises: a sensor which measures a measurement subject and acquires data values; a learning unit which, on the basis of the data values, learns a model used in estimating the data values for an installation position of the sensor; and a communication unit which transmits learning result data that indicates a result of the learning by the learning unit. The analysis device comprises a spatial analysis unit which, on the basis of the learning result data of each of the plurality of sensor node devices and the installation positions of each of the sensor node devices, estimates a spatial distribution of the data values.

title: Systems and methods for generating optimized market plans
description: Systems and methods for ranking or optimizing market configurations are disclosed. Optimized configurations of stores and formats in a market bounded within a geographic area are produced. The geographic area is divided into cells, and the cell attributes are used to determine which store formats can be present. Market configurations for each cell are provided to forecasters for determining of a first fitness criteria. Market configurations are filtered based on the first fitness criteria. Impacts between market configurations are calculated. A genetic algorithm produces a plurality of market solutions. In embodiments, optimization tasks are performed in parallel.

title: Systems and methods for determining potential malicious event
description: Disclosed are systems and methods for determining a potential malicious event. The systems and methods may obtain real-time information related to a vehicle (510). The systems and methods may determine a probability of arising malicious event (520) based on the real-time information of the vehicle. The systems and methods may determine whether the probability of arising malicious event exceeds a probability threshold (530). The systems and methods may in response to a determination that the probability of arising malicious event exceeds the probability threshold, determine that a potential malicious event exists.

title: Dynamically determining a region
description: A computer-implemented method includes monitoring, by a computing device, sensor data during gameplay of a sporting event; determining, by the computing device, predictive factors associated with a target based on the monitoring the sensor data; determining, by the computing device, a real-time region of effectiveness for the target based on the predictive factors and training data identifying historical effectiveness of the target;and outputting, by the computing device, the real-time region of effectiveness for displaying the real-time region of effectiveness around the target.

title: Meta learning for question classification
description: A system and a method are disclosed for automatic question classification and answering. A multipart artificial neural network (ANN) comprising a main ANN and an auxiliary ANN classifies a received question according to one of a plurality of defined categories. Unlabeled data is received from a source, such as a plurality of human volunteers. The unlabeled data comprises additional questions that might be asked of an autonomous machine such as a humanoid robot, and is used to train the auxiliary ANN in an unsupervised mode. The unsupervised training can comprise multiple auxiliary tasks that generate labeled data from the unlabeled data, thereby learning an underlying structure. Once the auxiliary ANN has trained, the weights are frozen and transferred to the main ANN. The main ANN can then be trained using labeled questions. The original question to be answered is applied to the trained main ANN, which assigns one of the defined categories. The assigned category is used to map the original question to a database that most likely contains the appropriate answer. An object and / or a property within the original question can be identified and used to formulate a query, using, for example, system query language (SQL), to search for the answer within the chosen database. The invention makes efficient use of available information, and improves training time and error rate relative to use of single part ANNs.

title: Adaptation of a power generation capacity and determining of an energy storage unit size
description: A method for determining a power outage probability of an electrical power grid (2) for a time period, the method comprising the following steps carried by a processor of a data processing unit: -dividing the time period into several time intervals, -determining a power generation capacity of a power generation facility (4) and an energy storage unit size for an energy storage unit (8) for said time period, -determining an effective load unit demand for each time interval from a load unit demand of a load unit (6) for each time interval, and -computing the power outage probability using a grid parameter that comprises the power generation capacity, the energy storage unit size and the effective load unit demand, wherein the grid parameter is optimized for its maximum value with respect to all time intervals of the time period.

title: Inferring user-specific location semantics from user data
description: Determining semantics for locations based on user data such as user activities and/or user communications. The user data is captured and analyzed to identify keywords including locations. Location data describing the locations is obtained and associated with the user and keywords. The associations represent user context for the locations. The associations are used to deliver services and/or products to the user at various times such as when user approaches or enters a particular location.

title: Plant control apparatus
description: A plant control apparatus has a measurement signal DB, an operation signal DB, a numerical value analysis executing unit, a numerical value analysis result DB, a model for estimating a value of a measurement signal for an operation signal, learning unit using the model, a learning information DB, a control logic DB for information used by an operation signal generating unit, a knowledge DB for plant running characteristics, and an analyzing unit processing information in the numerical value analysis result DB by information in the knowledge DB, learning information DB, operation signal DB, and measurement signal DB, wherein the analyzing unit includes at least one of a learning base analyzing unit checking adequacy of an operation method, a signal analyzing unit for evaluating an effect of the operation signal upon the plant and presence/absence of an abnormal signal, and a knowledge DB updating unit correcting information in the knowledge DB.

title: Automated verification of hypotheses using ontologies
description: A method on a computer for determining whether a hypothesis is verified by one or more ontologies. The method includes reading an address for a hypothesis comprised of one or more hypothesis axioms, wherein an axiom is represented in description logic form, reading an address for an ontology comprised of one or more ontology axioms and accessing the hypothesis and the ontology using the addresses that were read. The method further includes determining whether the ontology either corroborates or contradicts the hypothesis, identifying a first set of ontology axioms that corroborate the hypothesis and identifying a second set of ontology axioms that contradict the hypothesis, displaying a graphic indicating either corroboration or contradiction of the hypothesis, displaying the first set of ontology axioms together with a graphic indicating corroboration of the hypothesis and displaying the second set of ontology axioms together with a graphic indicating contradiction of the hypothesis.

title: Optical rule checking for detecting at risk structures for overlay issues
description: A method and system is provided for detecting at risk structures due to mask overlay that occur during lithography processes. The method can be implemented in a computer infrastructure having computer executable code tangibly embodied on a computer readable storage medium having programming instructions. The programming instructions are operable to obtain a simulation of a metal layer and a via, and determine a probability that an arbitrary point (x, y) on the metal layer is covered by the via by calculating a statistical coverage area metric followed by mathematical approximations of a summing function.

title: Dynamic model-based analysis of data centers
description: Techniques for model-based analysis of a data center. A method includes creating a metamodel based on domain knowledge to represent a type of object and/or relationship of a data center, using static and dynamic configuration and data analysis techniques to discover topology of elements of the data center and represent the topology as a model that is an instance of the metamodel, extending the metamodel, using the model to perform analysis of the data center in connection with a specified task, leveraging domain knowledge represented in nodes of the extended metamodel to guide the analysis in terms of determining guidelines to apply to each node and determining relationships to traverse to continue the analysis, extending the domain knowledge by updating the extended metamodel upon discovery of additional knowledge for use in improving analysis tasks, and extending the model on-demand using dynamic analysis techniques upon detection of multiple analysis failures.

title: System and method for creation, deployment and management of augmented attacker map
description: A system for augmenting an attacker map of a network of resources, including a deception management server within a network of resources, generating an attacker map for the network, the attacker map including one or more attack paths traversing some or all of the resources, each attack path corresponding to one or more successive attack vectors, wherein an attack vector is an object in memory or storage of a first resource of the network that may potentially lead an attacker to a second resource of the network, and a deployment module for planting one or more decoy attack vectors in some of all of the resources of the network, wherein the deception management server generates an augmented attacker map by augmenting the attack paths based on the decoy attack vectors added by the deployment module.

title: Method for learning a latent interest taxonomy from multimedia metadata
description: Techniques are disclosed herein for learning latent interests based on metadata of one or more images. An analysis tool associates one or more attributes with each of the objects based on a time and a location described in the metadata of that object. Each of the attributes describes one of a plurality of locations or an event scheduled to occur at one or more of the plurality of locations. The analysis tool identifies one or more concepts from a distribution of the one or more attributes to each of the objects. Each of the one or more concepts includes at least a first attribute in the distribution that co-occurs with a second attribute in the distribution.

title: Photonic quantum memory with time-bin entangled photon storage
description: A photonic quantum memory is provided. The photonic quantum memory includes entanglement basis conversion module configured to receive a first polarization-entangled photon pair and to produce a second entangled photon pair. The second polarization-entangled photon pair can he a time-bin entangled or a propagation direction-entangled photon pair. The photonic quantum memory further includes a photonic storage configured to receive the second entangled photon pair from the basis conversion module and to store the second entangled photon pair.

title: Automatic selection of representative media clips
description: A system determines human recognizable labels for portions of an electronic media stream, gathers data associated with the electronic media stream from a number of media players, and determines at least one section of the electronic media stream with a particular media feature. The system selects a representative clip for the electronic media stream based on information regarding the labeled portions, the gathered data, and the at least one section.

title: Secondary-game-mode sessions based on primary-game-mode arrangements of user-controlled elements
description: Approaches for secondary-game-mode sessions based on primary-game-mode arrangements of user-controlled elements are provided. Actions by user-controlled elements of a first user or other game-space elements in a primary game mode of a game space may be managed. A session request for a session in a secondary game mode of the game space may be received from the first user. A first session for the first user may be executed in the secondary game mode such that: (i) the first session involves artificial-intelligence-controlled elements as opponents against the user-controlled elements; (ii) an arrangement of the user-controlled elements at a beginning of the first session is the same as an arrangement of the user-controlled elements in the primary game mode at a time of the session request; and (iii) impacts on the user-controlled elements during the first session in the secondary game mode are not reflected in the primary game mode.

title: Systems and methods for identifying potentially malicious singleton files
description: A computer-implemented method for identifying potentially malicious singleton files may include (1) identifying a set of benign singleton files and a set of malicious singleton files, (2) obtaining, for each singleton file in the sets of benign and malicious singleton files, file identification information that identifies the singleton file, (3) using the file identification information of the singleton files from the sets of benign and malicious singleton files to train a classifier to classify unknown singleton files, (4) detecting an unclassified singleton file, (5) analyzing, with the trained classifier, information that identifies the unclassified singleton file, (6) determining, based on the analysis of the information that identifies the unclassified singleton file, that the unclassified singleton file is suspicious, and (7) triggering a security action in response to determining that the unclassified singleton file is suspicious. Various other methods, systems, and computer-readable media are also disclosed.

title: Data migration method and device under large data volume scene
description: The embodiment of the application provides a data migration method and device under a large data volume scene, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining an index to be migrated of target data in a distributed search engine and fragment setting thereof, determining corresponding migration task data volume and migration task priority according to the size of the index to be migrated and hot spot distribution in the fragment setting, determining corresponding migration strategies according to the migration task data volume and the migration task priority, reading the target data in the index to be migrated in batches according to the migration strategies, writing the target data into an migration catalog in a local file system, inputting a real-time migration speed and a real-time local file system resource utilization rate into a linear regression model, dynamically updating the data volume read during each migration operation, the maximum file number of each storage catalog and an migration catalog according to real-time adjustment parameters output by the linear regression model, and effectively improving the data migration efficiency and accuracy under the large data volume scene.

title: Face identity privacy protection method based on local modification
description: The present invention proposes a method for protecting the privacy of human face identity based on local modification, comprising the following steps: firstly, obtaining a data set and preprocessing it; segmenting the facial organs in the preprocessed image; step 3, using a local anonymizer, replacing each selected facial organ with an anonymous organ based on an anonymous strategy, and replacing the facial organ coordinate points before anonymization; step 4, constructing and training a generative model, the generative model comprising a local region encoder, a facial encoder and a generator; step 5, applying the trained generative model to reconstruct an image: using the anonymous organs of the eyes, nose, mouth and skin as inputs of the local region encoder, and using the anonymous organs of the facial organ coordinate points as inputs of the facial encoder, and finally, generating a reconstructed image through the generator. This method can not only achieve the purpose of deceiving uninformed observers, but also protect the availability of data.

title: Learning device, learning method and storage medium
description: The present invention provides a learning device, a learning method, and a storage medium that can generate a machine learning model that can accurately detect a road area from a distant area in an area included in an image. The learning device causes the machine learning model to learn, the machine learning model taking an image including a plurality of pixels as an input and outputting a discrimination value indicating whether each of the pixels represents a road, the learning device comprising: a setting unit that sets a weight for an error between the discrimination value output by the machine learning model and learning data indicating whether each of the pixels represents a road; and a learning unit that causes the machine learning model to learn in such a way that a value of a loss function calculated based on the error for which the weight is set decreases, the setting unit increasing the weight from the lower end center of the image toward one or more specified directions.

title: Drug screening method based on single virus tracing and machine learning and application
description: The present invention provides a drug screening method based on single virus tracing and machine learning, comprising the following steps: S1: attaching biotinylated viruses to host cell membranes and labeling them with quantum dots modified with streptavidin to obtain cell samples bound to the viruses labeled with quantum dots; S2: analyzing image sequences of host cells infected with biotinylated viruses to obtain single virus infection trajectories; S3: inputting coordinate information of several single virus infection trajectories into a machine learning model for calculation and analysis to obtain single virus infection fingerprints under corresponding treatment; S4: evaluating the antiviral effect of the drug based on the difference in single virus infection fingerprints between the drug treatment group and the control group. The present invention uses single virus tracing technology and machine learning to develop a fast and visual drug screening technology.

title: Method for reducing multi-mode characteristic quantity of large model based on multi-level coding
description: The present invention discloses a method for reducing the multimodal feature quantity of a large model based on multi-level coding, which relates to the fields of computer vision and deep learning, including collecting and preprocessing high-resolution images, extracting features and performing preliminary dimensionality reduction on the preprocessed high-resolution images, obtaining preliminary compressed feature maps, constructing multi-scale feature pyramids based on the preliminary compressed feature maps, generating features at different levels, applying hierarchical attention mechanisms to features at different levels, obtaining feature maps with local and global attention weights, using hierarchical fusion strategies on feature maps with local and global attention weights, generating multi-level attention optimization features, using image reconstruction processing on multi-level attention optimization features, and obtaining reconstructed feature representations and images. The present invention maintains attention to the global structure when capturing images, solves the problems of insufficient fusion of multi-scale features and unbalanced application of local and global attention mechanisms, and achieves more efficient feature representation.

title: Intelligent visual interaction system for manufacturing factory
description: The present invention discloses an intelligent visualization interactive system for a manufacturing factory, and the present invention relates to the field of intelligent visualization interactive technology. The intelligent visualization interactive system for a manufacturing factory includes an information interaction terminal, a customer information and order storage terminal, a visualization operation interface, an order product production monitoring terminal, an order product comparison terminal, and an order prediction and delivery terminal, wherein the information interaction terminal includes a manufacturing factory introduction module, a customer registration module, and a background information management module, and the manufacturing factory introduction module is used to introduce the manufacturing factory. The present invention performs a three-dimensional scan of the sample through the order product comparison terminal and transmits the product three-dimensional model to the visualization operation interface, so as to facilitate the customer to compare the sample with his own needs, so that the order product is more in line with the customer's requirements, so that the customer can observe the sample production, improve the customer's trust, and also allow the customer to compare the sample, so that the product is more in line with the customer's needs.

title: Medical knowledge explicit attribution system based on medical literature information
description: The invention discloses a medical knowledge explicit attribution system based on medical literature information, belongs to the field of natural language processing in artificial intelligence in the field of computers, and relates to a medical knowledge explicit attribution system based on medical literature information. The invention aims to solve the problem that the information uncertainty exists in medical attribution and diagnosis due to the diversity and complexity of the existing medical information and knowledge, so that the medical knowledge lacks reliability verification in practical application. The system comprises a query text module, a query vector module, a document vector module, a semantic similarity module, a document set screening module, a basic principle acquisition module, a medical knowledge judgment module to be verified and a result output module, wherein the basic principle acquisition module is used for acquiring basic principles, the medical knowledge judgment module to be verified is used for judging whether the medical knowledge to be verified is true or false, and the result output module is used for outputting the result of the medical knowledge judgment module to be verified and the result of the basic principle acquisition module.

title: Data security compliance assessment and identification method and system
description: The invention discloses a data security compliance assessment and identification method and a system, which relate to the technical field of data security compliance assessment and identification, and comprise the steps of collecting rule text data through an API interface, and preprocessing the rule text data by adopting a natural language processing library NLTK to obtain formatted rule text data; the method comprises the steps of adopting a pre-calculated word embedding method to map each word in formatted legal text data into a fixed length vector and generate a digital vector, adopting a named entity recognition NER method to mark important terms in the digital vector to obtain a key concept text, establishing an evaluation model based on a machine learning algorithm, inputting the digital vector into the evaluation model, adopting a weighted average method to calculate an output evaluation value, setting an evaluation threshold value to compare with the evaluation value, judging whether the digital vector is compliant or not, obtaining an evaluation result, constructing a recognition model based on an anomaly detection algorithm, and inputting the key concept text into the recognition model.

title: Business main body risk assessment method and system based on machine learning
description: The invention discloses a business subject risk assessment method and system based on machine learning, and belongs to the technical field of knowledge graphs. The method comprises the steps of obtaining basic characteristics of an enterprise, constructing a knowledge graph, utilizing the graph to mine and identify risk characteristics, carrying out qualitative analysis and quantitative analysis on the enterprise to obtain characteristic label description, constructing a sample set, setting misjudgment cost and class weight based on the sample set, carrying out parameter tuning and verification set feedback, teaching decision thresholds, classifying each characteristic in the sample set to obtain final risk scores, carrying out threshold selection and probability calibration to obtain risk grade classification and decision suggestion of the enterprise, and carrying out risk label explanation and large model auxiliary interpretation. The method solves the problems that manual collection and analysis of the supervision policy files are time-consuming and labor-consuming, omission is easy to occur, final risk judgment is easy to be misaligned, misjudgment is wrong, and frequent judgment is missed. The method and the system can accurately extract the key rules and mine the hidden risk conduction links and potential risk points.

title: Drug target binding prediction method based on variant coding
description: The invention discloses a drug target binding prediction method based on variant coding, and belongs to the field of bioinformatics. The invention realizes the efficient extraction of the drug and target characteristics, the potential characteristic space construction of the drug and target characteristics and the prediction of the interaction relation thereof through the end-to-end neural network of the double-stage coupling. The model mainly comprises two stages, wherein potential representation of drug and target characteristics is obtained through variational compression and extraction characteristics in the first stage, and a drug target action matrix is reconstructed through up-down sampling comprehensive deep neural network in the second stage. Through the framework, the chemical characteristics of the medicine and the biological characteristics of the target can be effectively integrated, and the accuracy of the interactive relation prediction is improved. The invention provides a novel and efficient solution for deep analysis of biological big data.

title: Automatic algorithm feature processing method and system
description: The invention discloses an automatic algorithm feature processing method and system, and relates to the technical field of computer data processing. Through collecting and cleaning data, then extracting characteristic parameters, establishing a test case based on the characteristic parameters, then establishing a test case of the characteristic parameters of the online data according to a characteristic parameter training model, finally inputting a target server for testing, and automatically carrying out the whole testing process, thereby effectively improving the testing efficiency. The automatic algorithm feature processing method and the automatic algorithm feature processing system integrate machine learning algorithms and deep learning algorithms, support unified configuration files, are configurable, can trigger a deep learning strategy when a data set reaches a certain amount, and solve the defect of poor modeling effect of a small data set.

title: A method and system for fault arc identification based on wavelet neural network
description: The present application provides a method and system for fault arc identification based on wavelet neural network, which relates to the technical field of fault arc identification. The method comprises steps of signal acquisition, signal processing, first modeling, first training and fault identification; the system comprises a signal acquisition module, a signal processing module, a first modeling module, a first training module and a fault identification module. The present application trains the wavelet neural network model using historical current signals when a fault arc occurs and fault type labels, thereby improving the accuracy of identifying a fault arc.

title: Full-flow monitoring and fault diagnosis method and system for pneumatic conveying system
description: The application provides a full-flow monitoring and fault diagnosis method and system for a pneumatic conveying system. The method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source monitoring data of a pneumatic conveying system, processing the multi-source monitoring data to obtain standardized monitoring data, building a training set based on historical operation data, training a pre-built deep learning model to obtain a system state evaluation model, generating a differential flatness index by adopting a system state vector algorithm based on the system state evaluation model and the multi-source monitoring data, designing a k induction control algorithm according to the differential flatness index, generating control parameters for the rotating speed of a draught fan and the opening of a distributing valve of the pneumatic conveying system, building an interference observer with a self-adaptive safety boundary, and controlling the pneumatic conveying system based on the control parameters. The method realizes intelligent monitoring and safety control of the pneumatic conveying system by combining deep learning with intelligent control, and improves the running efficiency and reliability of the system.

title: Heterogeneous multi-unmanned system task decision and path planning method based on multi-mode multi-task reinforcement learning
description: A heterogeneous multi-unmanned system task decision and path planning method based on multi-mode multi-task reinforcement learning belongs to the field of artificial intelligence. The invention solves the problem that a single type of intelligent agent can not complete complex tasks. And uniformly encoding the multi-mode information, extracting the position information and the obstacle information of the unmanned boats from the encoding result, inputting the information into a reinforcement learning algorithm based on the PPO to perform task decision, and transmitting the multi-task information to the unmanned boats. The unmanned red plane pre-processes the received multi-task text information, takes the acquired self position, target position and obstacle position information as a state space of path planning, executes a designated task after the planned path reaches the target position until the task switching time is reached, updates network parameters in the reinforcement learning algorithm according to the updated total rewards of the unmanned planes, and re-decides the task based on the updated parameters. The method can be applied to task decision and path planning of the heterogeneous multi-unmanned system.

title: Assistance type decision making system based on multi-mode historical action data
description: The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and discloses an assisted decision-making system based on multimodal historical action data, comprising: a multimodal data acquisition module, which collects multimodal data of a user through an RGB camera, a depth camera and a sensor group; a data preprocessing module: preprocesses the collected data, including data cleaning, labeling and feature extraction; a behavior prediction model module, which identifies feature values of its behavior pattern and establishes a model through an SN‑GCN model according to the user's historical action data; and realizes action prediction through a Transformer model multi-attention mechanism; an early warning decision module, which calculates the user's abnormal risk coefficient according to sensor data, judges the user's behavior state based on the prediction result of the comprehensive behavior prediction model, and immediately starts self-decision-making if it is abnormal, and sends a decision signal to a wearable device for alarm.

title: Vision-based battery electrode casting quality inspection method and system
description: The invention relates to the field of battery electrode quality detection, in particular to a battery electrode cast-weld quality detection method and system based on vision. The method comprises the steps of collecting time sequence cast-weld control parameters of a battery electrode and cast-weld area images after cast-weld completion, wherein the time sequence cast-weld control parameters comprise current, voltage, temperature, cast-weld position and cast-weld speed, calculating the difference value between the time sequence cast-weld control parameters of the battery electrode and standard time sequence cast-weld control parameters, determining whether abnormal cast-weld points exist, wherein the cast-weld points are the range of the time sequence cast-weld control parameters at any moment, extracting suspected defect area images from the cast-weld area images after the cast-weld completion according to the abnormal cast-weld points if the abnormal cast-weld points exist, inputting the suspected defect area images into a trained quality detection model, and determining whether the cast-weld quality of the battery electrode is qualified. The invention effectively solves the problem that the cast welding quality of the battery electrode cannot be detected rapidly and accurately.

title: Open world image classification method based on self-adaptive contrast learning
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of image classification, and particularly relates to an open world image classification method based on self-adaptive contrast learning. The method comprises the steps of firstly, training a pre-training classification model by using source domain data to obtain a source domain training classification model, clustering feature vectors extracted from source domain samples by the pre-training classification model to obtain clustering centers of all classes, then, training the source domain training classification model by using target domain data in a test mode, enhancing target domain data in the training process, optimizing the model by means of contrast learning of sample pairs, simultaneously, training and optimizing the model by means of class pairs, strong OOD class clustering centers and alignment modes of source domain and target domain feature distribution, and finally, calculating cosine similarity of the feature vectors extracted from the target domain samples by the source domain training classification model and the target domain class clustering centers, wherein a target domain class corresponding to the maximum cosine similarity is a prediction class label of the target domain sample. The method improves the adaptability and the recognition capability of the model to the unknown class, can maintain the classification stability when encountering the domain transfer and the sample of the unknown class, and effectively reduces the misclassification.

title: Multi-agent framework for foreground condition image generation
description: The present application provides a multi-agent framework for foreground conditional image generation, which specifically relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The multi-agent framework includes: a prompt generation module, which is used to perform semantic analysis on the foreground image to obtain a foreground description text, and generate a background prompt text based on the foreground description text; an image generation module, which is used to generate an initial template image based on the background prompt text and the edge map of the foreground image, and perform image optimization on the initial template image to obtain a result image; a quality assessment module, which is used to perform image quality assessment on the result image to obtain an assessment text, and output the result image when the assessment text matches the image output condition. The multi-agent framework provided by the present application can take into account the requirements of low difficulty of use and high adaptability between the output image result and the image condition.

title: Apparatus and method for decision support in standardized phenotypes
description: The present invention relates to a computer-implemented method for decision support of a user to normalize phenotypes in a genomic analysis of a subject, wherein the method comprises-receiving a list of symptoms comprising at least one symptom observed for the subject, -receiving a first graph comprising nodes and weighted links, -receiving a second graph previously obtained by applying a matrix decomposition to a gene-symptom matrix, -outputting at least one gene associated with the list of symptoms based on the first graph and the second graph.

title: A computer data processing method and system
description: The invention discloses a computer data processing method and a system, which relate to the technical field of computer data processing, wherein the processing method comprises the steps of obtaining performance data, cleaning the performance data, and performing characteristic engineering processing; training a model by using historical performance data according to a selected model algorithm, and performing tuning after evaluating the performance of the model; the method has the technical key points that the machine learning model can automatically learn the normal mode and the abnormal mode of the performance data, the abnormality can be identified more accurately than the traditional threshold value method, the system can adapt to the change of the system load and the newly-appearing abnormality type through continuous learning and updating of the model, the false alarm rate and the false alarm rate are reduced, the performance abnormality is detected in real time, operation staff is notified rapidly, the time for fault discovery and recovery is shortened, and the usability of the system is improved.

title: Intelligent dialogue system and method based on natural language processing
description: The application relates to the field of intelligent dialogue, and particularly discloses an intelligent dialogue system and method based on natural language processing, which uses an AI-based natural language processing technology and processing algorithm to perform word segmentation processing and semantic embedded coding on natural language description of a user question, then performs text semantic association reinforcement on granularity semantic embedded coding characteristics of each user question, obtains user emotion type characteristics according to the reinforced characteristic representation, and intelligently generates a reply text by comprehensively considering each reinforced characteristic representation and the user emotion type characteristics. According to the scheme provided by the application, the meaning of the polysemous word in a specific context can be better understood, the emotion state of the user can be accurately perceived, and a novel response fitting the context can be generated according to the specific situation, so that the dialogue is more vivid and interesting.

title: Analysis method, system, equipment and medium for nuclear medicine image radiation report
description: The present invention relates to the field of medical imaging technology, and specifically to an analysis method, system, device and medium for nuclear medicine imaging radiology reports. The present invention associates extracted medical imaging data characteristic values of patients with characteristic values of the patient's own historical medical imaging data to evaluate the comprehensive correlation coefficient between the patient's symptoms and their own historical medical images, and can fully consider the individual trajectory of the patient's disease development. By associating the extracted clinical data characteristic values of the patient with the clinical data characteristic values of a group of patients of the same type, the group deviation of the patient's clinical data is calculated, and new changes in the patient's condition are more likely to be discovered early. A model is constructed based on the comprehensive correlation coefficient between the patient's symptoms and their own historical medical images and the group deviation of the patient's clinical data to predict the patient's disease progression category, so that the patient's condition can be analyzed more comprehensively and the patient's disease progression can be better managed.

title: An underwater submarine pipeline detection device
description: The present invention discloses an underwater submarine pipeline detection device, which relates to the technical field of submarine pipeline detection. The device specifically comprises a frame and a propeller arranged on the frame, a machine box installed on the frame, a controller and a positioning module arranged in the machine box, and a multi-angle robotic arm that can be accommodated at the lower end of the frame and a drive motor on the angle robotic arm. The present invention uses the positioning module and the controller as the automatic control system of the underwater pipeline detection device, and relies on the infrared camera on the machine box and the multi-angle robotic arm to achieve automatic underwater navigation and real-time pipeline detection, and has the ability to detect the inside and outside of underwater pipelines. At the same time, a multi-angle robotic arm that can be accommodated and deployed is provided at the lower end of the frame, and the drive motor is used to control the multi-angle robotic arm to deploy at different angles to detect different positions of the pipeline, effectively improving the detection efficiency and accuracy of the underwater pipeline, having strong applicability, and effectively ensuring the continuity of underwater operations.

title: A method for intelligent filling of power flow data based on time-space coupling
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system application, and particularly relates to an intelligent filling method for power flow data based on space-time coupling. The invention provides an intelligent filling method of power flow data based on space-time coupling, which comprises the steps of firstly preprocessing original data through Hampel filtering, phase alignment and normalization, constructing a space-time encoder through joint coding of self-adaptive graph convolution ADAPTIVE GCN and attention LSTM, capturing space-time coupling characteristics, generating an countermeasure network Phy-GAN through physical constraint of a generator and multi-scale discriminant design multi-physical constraint to realize data filling, and ensuring filling results to have numerical rationality and physical feasibility.

title: Park facility operation status monitoring method and system based on multimodal perception
description: The present invention relates to the technical field related to multimodal sensing monitoring, and specifically includes a method and system for monitoring the operation status of park facilities based on multimodal sensing, including: collecting multimodal sensing data, generating a fusion matrix, extracting operation characteristics, constructing a facility status evolution map, configuring a monitoring cycle, identifying potential fault modes, matching and optimizing monitoring rules with historical data, and outputting a monitoring report. The present invention solves the technical problem that the potential fault characteristics associated across modalities cannot be effectively extracted, which affects the accuracy and comprehensiveness of fault identification. The present invention realizes the construction of a facility status evolution map, combines the time prediction of a health index with the spatial annotation of a fault risk probability, and identifies hidden faults in advance. At the same time, the sensitivity of fault feature extraction is improved through multimodal data backtracking analysis and state transfer feedback optimization. The present invention adopts incremental learning and model iteration to continuously optimize an adaptive correlation model, and improves the accuracy and comprehensiveness of fault identification.

title: Training method of code generation model, code generation method, device and medium
description: The application provides a training method, a code generation method, equipment and a medium of a code generation model, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence and comprise the steps of obtaining multi-mode model training data, wherein the multi-mode model training data comprise first text data and first image data, the first text data are data for describing characteristics of the first image data, model training is carried out on a preset artificial intelligent model based on the first text data and the first image data to obtain a code generation model, the artificial intelligent model is combined with a multi-mode large language model and a diffusion model to be constructed, and the code generation model is used for at least learning second image data and outputting codes corresponding to the second image data. The application can improve the capability of the code generation model based on artificial intelligence for realizing automatic programming based on images or characters, and the code generation model can automatically generate the codes of the website interface with complex structure, thereby improving the code writing efficiency.

title: Brain tumor multi-mode magnetic resonance image joint classification method and system
description: The invention provides a brain tumor multi-mode magnetic resonance image joint classification method and system, comprising the steps of S1, acquiring and preprocessing brain tumor multi-mode magnetic resonance image data, S2, extracting an image histology feature set F  rad  of the brain tumor multi-mode magnetic resonance image data, S3, training a depth feature extractor, extracting a depth feature set F  deep  of the brain tumor multi-mode magnetic resonance image data, S4, combining the depth feature set F  deep  with the image histology feature set F  rad , screening to obtain a joint feature set F  hybrid , and S5, classifying brain tumor multi-mode magnetic resonance images based on the joint feature set F  hybrid . The invention uses the depth separable convolution and expansion and compression layers in the convolution network coding module and the feature map downsampling module, so that the model can better fuse the cross-modal features of the multi-modal magnetic resonance image.

title: Fault diagnosis system and method based on roller equipment
description: The invention relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis of mechanical equipment, in particular to a fault diagnosis system and method based on roller equipment, comprising the following steps: the miniature microphone is arranged on the supporting frame provided with the roller, the installation end of the miniature microphone is fixedly connected with the supporting frame, the radio end of the miniature microphone is arranged towards the roller, the camera is arranged on the supporting frame, the installation end of the camera is fixedly connected with the supporting frame, the camera end of the camera is arranged towards the roller, according to the invention, through a multi-mode data fusion technology and a high-efficiency AI algorithm, the precision, the instantaneity and the reliability of equipment fault monitoring are comprehensively improved, the maintenance cost is obviously reduced, the running stability and the production efficiency of equipment are enhanced, and important technical innovation and application values are brought to the field of industrial automation.

title: Deep learning method for multi-source vibration identification
description: A deep learning method for multi-source vibration recognition is disclosed, comprising: step one, testing and collecting original vibration data sets; step two, data segmentation, including randomly segmenting the collected original vibration data according to a set sample length; step three, performing continuous wavelet transform on the data to convert the one-dimensional vibration data into a two-dimensional image; step four, dividing the data set; step five: building a ResNet deep learning model; step six: training the ResNet model and optimizing parameters according to the training results; step seven: importing the test set into the trained model for testing to obtain classification results and test accuracy, and generally the test accuracy is above 95%, which is regarded as reaching the target accuracy; step eight: importing the prepared multi-source vibration data to be identified into the trained model for identification, including the application of continuous wavelet transform and the inverse process of identification of two-dimensional images and conversion to one-dimensional data.

title: Dummy filling optimization method and system based on neural network CMP model
description: The present invention provides a dummy element filling optimization method and system based on a neural network CMP model, wherein the method comprises: dividing the chip layout into multiple windows, and taking each window as a basic filling unit for filling optimization; extracting the fillable area of each window according to the design rules; allocating the target height of each window based on the predicted height of the neural network CMP model and the design rules; and generating and optimizing the filling parameters using a multi-objective genetic algorithm based on the fillable area and the target height. The present invention is used to improve the surface flatness in the chemical mechanical polishing process and optimize the filling layout design. The method combines the multi-objective genetic algorithm to achieve efficient and accurate multi-objective optimization, which not only improves the prediction accuracy of height changes, but also significantly optimizes the comprehensive performance of the filling scheme.

title: Identity information identification method and system based on multi-mode large model
description: The invention provides an identity information identification method and system based on a multi-mode large model in the technical field of identity information identification, and the method comprises the steps of S10, collecting a large amount of historical multi-mode data, S20, uploading all the historical multi-mode data to a server for preprocessing to construct a data set, S30, training the created multi-mode large model through the data set by the server, S40, respectively extracting registered multi-mode fusion features of all users from a user information database through the trained multi-mode large model, storing all the registered multi-mode fusion features into a vector library, S50, preprocessing input real-time multi-mode data, inputting the multi-mode large model, obtaining real-time mode fusion features, and matching the real-time mode fusion features with the registered multi-mode fusion features to identify the identity information. The invention has the advantages that the accuracy, the robustness, the generalization and the expansibility of the identity information identification are greatly improved.

title: Multi-objective distributed deep learning container scheduling method, system and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of distributed deep learning technology, and discloses a multi-objective distributed deep learning container scheduling method, system and storage medium, the method comprising: using a graph neural network to model the communication structure between GPUs within a node, the communication performance within a node and the communication performance between nodes, generating an embedding vector that characterizes the node interaction characteristics, and obtaining a cluster state; inputting the cluster state into a deep Q network, defining the mapping relationship from container to node through an action space, optimizing the deep Q network decision based on a reward function, so as to minimize the communication overhead and balance the node load, and realize the training of the deep Q network; deploying the deep Q network model completed by offline training to a scheduler, and generating a container scheduling plan according to the real-time cluster state. The scheduling method proposed in the present invention effectively alleviates the communication bottleneck in the distributed deep learning job training while ensuring the real-time scheduling.

title: Data processing method and device
description: The present disclosure provides a data processing method and device, which relates to the field of data processing technology. The data processing method includes: obtaining first data; the first data at least includes first content and second content, the first content has a first presentation attribute, and the second content has a second presentation attribute; outputting based on the first data, the presentation attribute of at least one of the output first content and the second content changes to reflect the content difference.

title: Domain ontology construction method
description: The invention discloses a domain ontology construction method, which relates to the technical field of natural language processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining prompt words, inquiring in user interfaces provided by a plurality of public large models to obtain a domain ontology feedback text set, conducting text analysis on each feedback text in the domain ontology feedback text set to obtain domain concepts, relations and attribute words in the text, constructing a domain candidate ontology graph by taking the domain concepts and the attribute words as nodes and taking the relations between the domain concepts and the attribute words as edges to obtain a domain candidate ontology graph set, merging updated nodes and edges into an initialized weighted blank graph to obtain a domain candidate ontology graph, conducting confidence assessment on the domain candidate ontology graph, and selecting the nodes and edges with the confidence degree larger than a set threshold value in the graph to obtain a final domain ontology graph. The invention can fully integrate knowledge capability of a plurality of different large open models without introducing expert knowledge in the field.

title: Sleep apnea subtype detection method based on multimodal information fusion
description: The invention provides a sleep apnea subtype detection method based on multi-modal information fusion, which comprises the steps of acquiring an original multi-modal physiological signal, preprocessing the original multi-modal physiological signal to obtain a preprocessed signal window, performing node definition operation on the preprocessed signal window to obtain a node set, respectively performing homojunction edge construction and heterojunction edge construction on the basis of the node set to respectively obtain a homojunction edge set and a heterojunction edge set, extracting features of the signal window corresponding to the node by using a residual convolution neural network on the basis of the node set to obtain node embedding features, and forming a sleep heterograph by the node embedding features, the homojunction edge set and the heterojunction edge set. The invention designs the graph edge rule based on the physiological mechanism, so that the decision basis can be traced to specific physiological characteristics, the clinical interpretability is stronger, an intuitive diagnosis basis is provided for a clinician, and the pain point with poor interpretation of the traditional black box model is solved.

title: A radar array sparse optimization method based on improved fireworks algorithm
description: The invention discloses a radar array sparse optimization method based on an improved firework algorithm, and relates to the field of radar communication. Firstly, setting parameters such as array radius, array element number and the like, initializing a firework population and calculating an initial fitness value. And then judging whether the termination condition is met or not, and if not, entering iteration. In the iteration process, spark individuals are generated through explosion operation to explore a solution space, and variation operation is carried out on sparks to expand the diversity of solutions. Meanwhile, by combining a simulated annealing mechanism, the probability of accepting the inferior solution is controlled according to the temperature, so that the local optimum is avoided, and the global searching capability is enhanced. And finally, selecting and operating the optimal next generation firework population, and continuously iterating and optimizing until the optimal solution is output when the termination condition is met. According to the invention, by improving the initialization and explosion strategies of the firework algorithm and combining with the simulated annealing mechanism, the global optimization capacity is improved, the sidelobe level and the array element number are reduced, the system performance is optimized, and the hardware cost and the calculation complexity are obviously reduced.

title: Text classification algorithm optimization method based on machine learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of text classification algorithm optimization methods, and in particular to a text classification algorithm optimization method based on machine learning; technical solution: a text classification algorithm optimization method based on machine learning, comprising a data collection and preprocessing method; compared with a traditional text classification algorithm optimization method, the present invention usually relies on feature engineering and supervised learning, requires a large amount of labeled data, and has limited generalization ability of the model for new fields or new tasks, and needs to collect a large amount of labeled data again for training. The text classification algorithm optimization method combines deep learning with traditional machine learning methods, utilizes the feature extraction ability of deep learning and the stability of traditional machine learning, obtains more robust and efficient classification performance, and at the same time, pre-training or self-training is performed with a large amount of unlabeled data, and unsupervised and semi-supervised learning can greatly improve the generalization ability of the model.

title: Time sequence hypergraph knowledge graph construction method and system
description: The invention discloses a time sequence supergraph knowledge graph construction method and a time sequence supergraph knowledge graph construction system, relates to a graph neural network technology, and provides a scheme for solving the problem of insufficient triplet representation force in the prior art. The method comprises the following substeps of S11, extracting core technical keywords based on AI agents, S12, cleaning the core technical keywords, S13, constructing the time sequence knowledge graph, S21, forming a superside node set, S22, optimizing and generating supersides, and S23, embedding supergraphs and optimizing. The method has the advantages that through introducing the hypergraph structure and the time sequence information, the binary relation limitation of the traditional knowledge graph is broken through, and the method has remarkable technical advantages.

title: A fruit fly multi-target tracking method and system based on space science experiment video
description: The invention provides a drosophila multi-target tracking method and system based on a spatial science experiment video, according to the method, firstly, microgravity motion decoupling is realized by extracting optical flow information of frame images in a drosophila spatial science experiment video. Then, the static appearance characteristics, the motion optical flow characteristics and the thermodynamic diagram characteristics are subjected to multi-mode characteristic progressive fusion. And then, carrying out conditional prediction according to the fused target fusion characteristics, and determining thermodynamic diagram prediction results, offset prediction results and target size prediction results. And finally, carrying out offset prediction association according to the prediction result, and updating target drosophila motion track information according to the prediction result under the condition that the offset prediction association is successful, so as to determine a multi-target tracking result. The method is based on a multi-target tracking frame with appearance-motion bimodal fusion, motion characteristic decoupling is achieved by extracting optical flow information, multi-modal progressive characteristic fusion is conducted with static appearance characteristics, and accurate and stable multi-target tracking of the drosophila is achieved.

title: A method and system for estimating grassland aboveground biomass based on semivariogram function coupled with grazing heterogeneity
description: The invention discloses a grassland biomass estimation method and a grassland biomass estimation system based on half variance function coupling grazing heterogeneity, which belong to the technical field of grassland characteristic estimation, and comprise the steps of obtaining a fixed resolution canopy height model CHM through processing collected grassland cloud data, obtaining CGF and LAI grid data by using the CHM, fitting the half variance function model to obtain the spatial heterogeneity characteristic of grasslands, obtaining the optimal inversion scale, screening key independent variables with stability, and providing a reliable basis for inversion of grassland AGB; the method comprises the steps of combining CHM, CGF, LAI of different spatial scales with ground actually measured biomass data, inverting by utilizing a linear regression model, a random forest and a BP neural network to obtain an optimal variable combination and inversion model, and finally analyzing spatial heterogeneity characteristics of gAGB of different spatial scales in different management modes to formulate management measures according to local conditions, so that the utilization efficiency of grassland resources is improved, and an ecological system is protected.

title: A method for predicting immune checkpoint blockade responses based on neoantigen quality
description: An immune checkpoint blocking response prediction method based on new antigen quality relates to the technical field of computational biology and biological information. Solves the problems of small application range and low accuracy of the existing Immune Checkpoint Blocking (ICB) response prediction method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining clinical data of a subject and whole exon data of tumor tissues, preprocessing the whole exon data of the tumor tissues, combining the clinical data to obtain a training data set, predicting clinical response data of the subject by an immune check point blocking response prediction model according to input data of each training sample in the training data set, determining an optimal prediction threshold of the model according to a prediction effect, and predicting clinical response data of a current subject to be tested by the immune check point blocking response prediction model under the optimal prediction threshold N  Cutoff . The method is mainly used for ICB response prediction.

title: Update method, device, equipment and storage medium of intelligent question-answering system
description: A method, device, equipment and computer-readable storage medium for updating an intelligent question-and-answer system, comprising: the intelligent question-and-answer system receives input information from a user and obtains corresponding question information; based on the question information, determines the type of the question information to which it belongs, so as to obtain a corresponding answer and provide it to the user; obtains feedback information sent by the user regarding the answer; obtains feedback information sent by the user; if the feedback information is unresolved, manually answers the question according to a manual mechanism to obtain a corresponding target answer; adds the target answer and the question information to a knowledge base to update the intelligent question-and-answer system, wherein the intelligent question-and-answer system includes a knowledge base, which solves the technical problem of low answering efficiency and accuracy of the intelligent question-and-answer system in related technologies, and significantly improves the answering efficiency, accuracy, user experience and overall performance of the intelligent question-and-answer system.

title: A pipeline risk determination model construction method and system
description: The present invention relates to the field of pipeline monitoring technology, and in particular to a method and system for constructing a pipeline risk determination model. The method comprises the following steps: using an air compressor to generate compressed air, and delivering the compressed air to a preset pipeline to obtain pipeline compressed air data; constructing an air purification model according to the pipeline compressed air data; performing air purification simulation according to the air purification model to obtain purified air data; detecting residual condensed water according to the purified air data to obtain residual condensed water data; identifying pipeline corrosion based on the residual condensed water data to obtain pipeline corrosion data; predicting the probability of pipeline perforation according to pipeline corrosion data; detecting accumulated solid particles according to the purified air data to obtain accumulated solid particle data; performing pipeline blockage analysis according to the accumulated solid particle data to obtain pipeline blockage data. The present invention improves the accuracy and real-time performance of pipeline risk determination based on pipeline monitoring technology, and significantly improves the pipeline safety recognition rate.

title: Seismic random noise attenuation method and device based on convolution long-short-term memory network
