description: The invention discloses a random noise attenuation method and device for earthquake based on convolution long-short-term memory network, which relate to the field of earthquake data processing in oil-gas geophysical exploration and comprise the following steps of performing block processing on original earthquake data to obtain the earthquake data after the block processing; the method comprises the steps of constructing a convolution long-short-term memory network self-encoder model with a two-way connection structure, inputting the segmented seismic data into the convolution long-short-term memory network self-encoder model with the two-way connection structure to obtain reconstructed seismic data, and carrying out iterative denoising by taking errors between each reconstructed seismic data and original input seismic data as convergence cost. The method solves the defect that a large amount of clean tag data is required to be manufactured in supervised deep learning denoising, ensures the suppression effect of random earthquake noise, basically does not damage effective signals, has good denoising robustness, and has good denoising effect under different noise levels.

title: Method for regulating and controlling virtual element in simulation deduction based on large model, electronic equipment, storage medium and program product
description: The embodiment of the present application provides a control method, electronic device, storage medium and program product for virtual elements in simulation deduction based on a large model, wherein the virtual elements include virtual characters and virtual scenes; the method includes: obtaining historical confrontation data between the virtual characters and players at the historical moment of the simulation deduction; analyzing the historical behavior data of the virtual characters, the historical behavior data of the players, and the historical layout data of the virtual scenes, and determining the evaluation results of the confrontation authenticity and confrontation difficulty of the virtual scenes at the historical moments; adjusting the historical layout of the virtual scenes based on the evaluation results to obtain the target virtual scenes; inputting the historical behavior data of the players and the personality labels of the virtual characters into the behavior generation model to obtain the reaction actions of the virtual characters to the players. The dynamic adaptability and interactivity of the simulation exercise are significantly improved, so that players can experience a more realistic and challenging simulation exercise environment.

title: Disease data analysis method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The invention provides a disease data analysis method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the steps of acquiring multi-source disease data associated with a target area within a preset time period, wherein the multi-source disease data comprises at least one of pharmacy sales data, school absences, hospital visit amount data, pathogen data, epidemiological investigation reports and disease news information data in the target area, constructing an area map network of the target area based on the multi-source disease data, splicing multi-source fusion characteristics of the area map network and the multi-source disease data, inputting the multi-source disease data into a disease data analysis model containing a plurality of expert intelligent agents, and outputting disease analysis results of the target area.

title: Solar radiation forecasting method integrating decomposition algorithm and GRAPHCAST model
description: The invention discloses a solar radiation forecasting method integrating a decomposition algorithm and GRAPHCAST models, and relates to the technical field of solar radiation forecasting. The method comprises the steps of analyzing an open source database in ERA5 to obtain meteorological variable data, preprocessing the data to obtain meteorological variable data conforming to an input format of a GRAPHCAST model, constructing a GRAPHCAST model to conduct weather forecast, obtaining measured meteorological variable data and solar radiation data of a site in a certain area, screening out meteorological variables with high importance relative to solar radiation through a XGBoost feature screening algorithm, preprocessing the screened meteorological variables by utilizing a VMD decomposition algorithm, constructing a training set and a testing set by utilizing preprocessed data, taking measured solar radiation as a label of the model, training and optimizing an RF model by utilizing data of the training set, coupling the VMD decomposition algorithm based on GRAPHCAST to mix the RF model, and predicting solar radiation according to the meteorological data of the testing set. The invention can achieve higher-precision solar radiation prediction.

title: Method for identifying rotor blade tip vortex nuclear image by using U-net neural network
description: The invention discloses a rotor blade tip vortex core image identification method by utilizing a U-net neural network, which belongs to the technical field of vortex core image processing and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a training U-net neural network model, S2, predicting the position of a blade tip vortex by the U-net neural network model, S3, acquiring the position and the area of a vortex core, S4, carrying out elliptic curve fitting on the position of the vortex core, S5, equally dividing the elliptic arc sections of the curve and taking indexes, S6, calculating the distance between the position of the vortex core and the elliptic arc sections and belonging to the nearest elliptic arc sections, S7, counting the number of the vortex cores and carrying out curve index on the arc sections, S8, carrying out curve smoothing, S9, searching for peak positions, S10, mapping vortex cluster labels by peak position indexes, calculating peak value index corresponding peak arc section positions, S11, calculating the distance between the position of the vortex core and the curve peak arc section and belonging to the nearest peak value arc section, and carrying out labeling on each vortex, and accurately identifying the blade tip vortex, and simultaneously, carrying out processing on PIV images.

title: Classification model defense method based on dynamic countermeasure training and region-of-interest denoising
description: The present invention discloses a classification model defense method based on dynamic adversarial training and attention area denoising, aiming to improve the robustness of the classification model under adversarial attacks. In the training stage, different adversarial sample generation methods such as FGSM, PGD, C&W are dynamically selected according to the number of training rounds to avoid overfitting of the model to specific attacks and enhance the generalization ability to various attacks. At the same time, the class activation map (CAM) is used to locate the attention area of the input image, and wavelet denoising is used and weighted fused with the original image to accurately weaken the adversarial disturbance and retain key information. Experiments show that on the CIFAR‑10 dataset, this method significantly improves the classification accuracy of the model under FGSM, PGD, and C&W attacks. Compared with traditional methods, the robustness accuracy is improved by 10%‑20%, and it can be widely used in autonomous driving, security monitoring and other fields.

title: A Predictive Model Training Method for Predicting the Relative Efficacy of EC and T in NAC
description: The invention discloses a prediction model training method for predicting the relative curative effect of EC and T in NAC, which constructs a data set by acquiring MRI image data and clinical pathology data of a subject, and the relative curative effect of EC and T treatment is predicted by constructing an image histology model based on DCE and ADC sequences and a mixed model combining clinical pathological factors through the steps of image segmentation, feature extraction, qualitative relative curative effect feature, model construction and verification and the like. The invention can effectively predict the relative curative effect of the EC (epirubicin plus cyclophosphamide) and the T (taxus medicine) treatment scheme in the middle stage of NAC, so as to adjust the treatment scheme in time and improve the treatment effect.

title: Three-dimensional iris reconstruction and unfolding method
description: The present invention discloses a three-dimensional iris reconstruction and expansion method, which relates to the field of intelligent medical care. The method comprises the following contents: step one, generating a three-dimensional iris tag; step two, establishing an iris depth map prediction model; and step three, expanding the iris. The present invention utilizes the anatomical constraint relationship between multiple iris images in a video stream to accurately predict iris depth information, realize three-dimensional iris reconstruction, and expand the iris into a two-dimensional rectangular image and depth map. The method overcomes the defect of insufficient depth of a traditional single image and utilizes multiple pictures in a video to predict iris image depth information. The iris textures between the iris pictures have an anatomical constraint relationship, which can effectively predict iris image depth information, improve the robustness of iris recognition, and is suitable for a variety of application scenarios.

title: Steam turbine operation control method, intelligent body and electronic equipment
description: The application discloses a steam turbine operation control method, an intelligent body and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining current operation parameters of a high-temperature part of a steam turbine, respectively inputting the current operation parameters into a start-stop stage stress prediction model and a load adjustment stage stress prediction model to obtain a start-stop stage predicted stress parameter and a load adjustment stage predicted stress parameter, calculating a start-stop stage low-cycle fatigue crack initiation loss predicted value and a start-stop stage low-cycle fatigue crack initiation cumulative loss predicted value, calculating a load adjustment stage low-cycle fatigue crack initiation loss predicted value and a load adjustment stage low-cycle fatigue crack initiation cumulative loss predicted value, determining a start-stop stage target depth peak regulation operation control parameter and a load adjustment stage target depth peak regulation operation control parameter which meet stress and service life constraint conditions, and controlling the steam turbine according to the control parameters. The scheme of the application ensures that the steam turbine can meet the response depth peak shaving requirement and reduce loss.

title: Cross-door operation identification method and device based on deep learning, electronic equipment and program product
description: The application discloses a cross-door operation identification method and device based on deep learning, electronic equipment and a program product. According to the detection method, a CFEF module is introduced into a backbone network, and the spatial domain and the frequency domain characteristics are fused through convolution operation and Fourier transformation, so that the expression capability of the image characteristics in a complex environment is enhanced, and the robustness of the model to complex background and bad weather is improved. The neck network integration REMSA module combines two residual error-based attention mechanisms with multi-scale convolution operation, effectively aggregates multi-scale features and highlights key areas, and improves the identification effect on different-scale cross-gate operation behaviors. Meanwhile, a DSAF module is further configured on the neck network, and the recognition capability of small-scale cross-gate business targets is enhanced by fusing deep semantic information and shallow detail features, so that the generalization performance of the model is further improved.

title: Communication method and communication device
description: A communication method and a communication device are provided, wherein a first network device sends first information to a second network device, the first information is determined based on an artificial intelligence AI model and is used for the second network device to determine a strategy of a terminal device for double connection, the first information comprises identification information of the terminal device, the first network device receives first feedback information of the second network device, the first feedback information is determined according to the first information, the first feedback information comprises configuration information of the second network device, the first network device sends second information to the terminal device, and the second information comprises configuration information of the second network device. According to the method, through the first information determined by the AI model, double-connection communication between the terminal equipment and the first network equipment and between the terminal equipment and the second network equipment is established, and the communication performance of the terminal equipment is guaranteed.

title: Knowledge map space-time map display method oriented to cultural field
description: The present invention provides a knowledge graph spatiotemporal map display method for the cultural field, comprising the following steps: extracting cultural entities and their relationships from multi-source heterogeneous data through a knowledge graph construction module to construct a structured knowledge graph; parsing and normalizing the time and space information of cultural entities through a spatiotemporal processing module; displaying the processed cultural entities and their spatiotemporal relationships in the form of a map on a user terminal through a map display module; enabling users to interact with the knowledge graph displayed in the map through an interactive module. The present invention can allow users to explore cultural information more conveniently; supports the display of multi-level cultural relationships, can effectively extract and display target information in a complex cultural network, has good applicability, and can be widely used in cultural heritage, historical research, archaeological research and other fields, so that cultural entities and their relationships can be presented to users more intuitively and dynamically.

title: A cross-scale bionic gradient coating design method based on multi-principal element high entropy system
description: The present application belongs to the technical field of high-performance tool coatings, and relates to a cross-scale bionic gradient coating design method based on a multi-principal element high-entropy system, which sequentially forms a high-entropy alloy plastic layer, a high-entropy alloy/high-entropy ceramic tough layer, and a nanocrystalline high-entropy ceramic superhard layer on the surface of the tool substrate, constructs a gradient transition structure, matches the high-entropy alloy plastic layer with the tool substrate bonding phase, optimizes the high-entropy alloy/high-entropy ceramic tough layer material, improves the interface bonding force, uses thermal-mechanical coupling calculation to optimize the gradient transition design, constructs an atomic model and optimizes the microstructure based on molecular dynamics simulation, establishes a finite element model to simulate thermal cycles and mechanical loads, optimizes interface performance, and uses BP neural networks and particle swarm optimization algorithms to construct mathematical models to achieve a gradual transition design between the tool substrate and the coating. The present application solves the problems of large brittleness, insufficient adhesion, and limited thermal stability of the tool coating interface, and improves the coating interface bonding performance and the stability and durability of the coated tool.

title: Aquatic biodiversity monitoring system and method based on image recognition
description: The application provides an aquatic organism diversity monitoring system and method based on image recognition, which are used for acquiring an underwater image of a monitored water area, determining a substrate area of a non-aquatic organism and a potential organism area to be verified in the underwater image, determining a color space distance between the potential organism area and the substrate area, determining color texture features of texture structures of the potential organism area based on the color space distance and gray level symbiotic moment of the potential organism area, extracting biological candidate areas according to the color texture features and the contour features of the potential organism area, determining spatial distribution entropy of all texture break points in the biological candidate areas, determining mimicry labels of mimicry aquatic organisms in the biological candidate areas based on the spatial distribution entropy of all texture break points in the biological candidate areas and the texture structures, and generating a dynamic map for aquatic organism diversity monitoring according to all mimicry labels. By adopting the scheme of the application, the distinction between the pseudo aquatic organisms and the water area substrate can be realized based on the extraction of the visual appearance characteristics.

title: Clinical demand mining method and system
description: The present invention discloses a clinical demand mining method and system, which relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology, including: firstly, constructing a medical knowledge network, integrating patient clinical elements and clinical indication elements, and identifying highly connected patient clinical elements; secondly, selecting samples and mining clinical conduction chains with samples as the core; finally, cyclically training feature encoders and adapters based on the description parameters of the elements on the chain to obtain a model that can accurately map patient characteristics and clinical needs. This method improves the comprehensiveness and personalization of clinical demand mining through structured knowledge integration, deep association mining and dynamic model optimization, and is suitable for demand identification of complex patient groups.

title: A method and system for evaluating the robustness of models against adversarial attacks in black-box scenarios
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for evaluating the robustness of a model against adversarial attacks in a black box scenario, and belongs to the field of adversarial attacks and artificial intelligence intellectual property protection analysis. The method includes: obtaining access rights to a target model in a black box scenario, defining a substitute model with the same function as the target model; obtaining unlabeled original image samples that are consistent with the target model data distribution, and serving as initialized adversarial samples at the same time; optimizing adversarial samples using substitute models; using original image samples and final adversarial samples at the end of iteration to input the target model, and calculating the robustness evaluation score and security level of the target model. The adversarial sample generation method of the present invention optimizes the adversarial sample to generate more robust adversarial features by using the intermediate features of the substitute model as the optimization target, so as to enhance its adversarial transferability. The method does not need to obtain the model label of the sample, and realizes the quantitative evaluation of the robustness of the model against adversarial attacks based on the robustness of the adversarial features as the model security evaluation index.

title: Mountain-water forest Tian Hu grass integrated protection and repair current situation investigation and evaluation method
description: The present invention discloses a method for investigating and evaluating the current status of integrated protection and restoration of mountains, rivers, forests, farmlands, lakes and grasslands, and relates to the technical field of ecological protection and restoration. The present invention comprises: dividing the target area into a plurality of ecological monitoring units, and obtaining the subjective data indicator set and the objective data indicator set of the ecological monitoring unit; calculating the subjective weight value and the objective weight value of the ecological monitoring unit according to the subjective data indicator set and the objective data indicator set of the ecological monitoring unit, and then obtaining the dynamic weight value of the ecological monitoring unit; based on the dynamic weight value of the ecological monitoring unit, constructing a fuzzy evaluation model based on the Gaussian membership function, obtaining the comprehensive evaluation value of the target area, and performing a qualitative evaluation on the ecological quality of the target area according to the comprehensive evaluation value. The present invention can provide a scientific basis for the management and evaluation of ecological restoration projects, and help project managers to clearly understand the progress and effect of restoration work.

title: Text information processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a text information processing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which are used for acquiring evaluation text information, extracting defect text information according to the evaluation text information and determining target processing information according to the defect text information. The invention aims to improve the accuracy of determining processing information.

title: Ultrasonic image diagnosis system and method
description: The present invention relates to the field of sound wave measurement technology, and specifically to an ultrasonic image diagnosis system and method. In the present invention, a deep neural network is used to enable the matching between reflection features and tissue characteristics to have adaptive learning capabilities, thereby improving the targeted recognition effect in signal classification. Based on the judgment result of the reflection feature, when performing boundary partitioning of the tissue area, a combination of three parameters: grayscale extreme difference, gradient direction and texture continuity is used to judge the edge structure, thereby avoiding contour blurring caused by the judgment of a single indicator. By extracting the grayscale distribution center, amplitude change trajectory and edge area continuous change sequence, and inputting the regional positioning result into a support vector machine, accurate identification of the nature of the lesion is achieved based on the boundary classification comparison of the morphological structure quantitative features and historical benign and malignant feature data. After the image is formed, the structural morphology is secondary verified, thereby effectively improving the diagnostic integrity and judgment confidence.

title: Method and system for controlling artwork generation robot using robot interface system
description: A method and system for controlling an artwork generating robot using a robot interface system. The method includes: generating a digital prototype of an artwork using a rendering algorithm of the robot interface system; setting a digital canvas using the robot interface system; displaying the digital prototype of the artwork on a display of the robot interface system; calibrating the robot and the robot environment so that the robot can generate a robot generated artwork corresponding to the digital prototype; using the artwork generating robot to convert the digital prototype into a physical robot generated artwork; and using the robot interface system to adjust settings and interact with the robot when converting the digital prototype into the robot generated artwork. The step of calibrating the robot is performed by using a calibration tool of the robot interface system.

title: Waste gas purification method under multi-objective optimization
description: The invention discloses an exhaust gas purification method under multi-objective optimization, which comprises the steps of acquiring exhaust gas data acquired by each hardware in an exhaust gas purification system, executing synchronous operation of each hardware and abnormal value restoration operation of the exhaust gas data based on the exhaust gas data acquired by each hardware, defining a multi-scale state space and control actions, capturing dynamic characteristics of the exhaust gas purification system, then combining a depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, constructing a network architecture for deep reinforcement learning, determining an optimization objective of the exhaust gas purification system, and carrying out simulation of the exhaust gas purification system in a high-fidelity environment through the optimization objective of the exhaust gas purification system to optimize a control mode of the exhaust gas purification system.

title: Model training method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The embodiments of the present disclosure disclose a model training method, device, electronic device and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a plurality of training sample pairs, wherein the training sample pairs include sample multimedia and sample description texts, calling a feature extraction model to extract features from the sample multimedia and the sample description texts, obtaining sample multimedia features and sample text features, taking the sample multimedia features and sample text features of the same training sample pair as positive samples, taking the sample multimedia features and sample text features of the remaining training sample pairs as negative samples, determining a first contrast loss, taking the sample text features of the same training sample pair as positive samples, taking the sample text features of different training sample pairs as negative samples, determining a second contrast loss, determining a target loss according to the first contrast loss and the second contrast loss, and training the feature extraction model according to the target loss, thereby improving the generalization performance of the trained model when extracting features.

title: Database adaptation method based on large language model
description: The invention discloses a database adaptation method based on a large language model, which relates to the technical field of database adaptation; the training data is obtained and pre-processed to obtain a training data set, and the training data set is input into an open source large model to obtain a pre-trained model; a low-rank matrix is initialized, and the low-rank matrix is introduced into the pre-trained model as a fine-tuning parameter, the original parameters of the pre-trained model are frozen, and the fine-tuning parameters are trained to obtain a target task model; the project source code is obtained, and the project source code is input into the target task model to obtain a plurality of compatible codes, and the compatible codes are deployed to the target database. The pre-trained model learns the differences and conversion relationships between databases, generates codes compatible with the target database and performs database adaptation, improves accuracy, and ensures stable operation of the system; the low-rank matrix is used to fine-tune the parameters, reduces training resources and time costs, reduces adaptation workload, and reduces manual intervention.

title: Log analysis method, device, apparatus, readable storage medium and program product
description: The present application discloses a log analysis method, device, equipment, readable storage medium and program product. The method determines instruction type requests and non-instruction type requests in multiple target requests with unknown intent in the log to be analyzed; clusters instruction type requests into multiple categories using a first clustering model, and uses a large language model to perform intent recognition on instruction type requests under each category to obtain the intent corresponding to each category; clusters non-instruction type requests into multiple categories using a second clustering model, and uses a large language model to determine whether non-instruction type requests under each category contain entities; in the case where there is a category that cannot be determined whether it contains an entity, extracts keywords of non-instruction type requests under the corresponding category; in the case where it is determined that the corresponding category contains an entity based on the keyword, the keyword is used as the entity contained in the non-instruction type request under the corresponding category. The use of this method can improve the efficiency of log analysis.

title: General targeted attack resisting method for gesture recognition system based on acoustic wave perception
description: The present invention discloses a general targeted adversarial attack method for a gesture recognition system based on acoustic wave perception. The method comprises: constructing an objective function based on maximizing the confidence score of the adversarial signal in the target gesture category as the goal, wherein the adversarial signal includes the original signal and the disturbance signal; solving the objective function to obtain an optimized disturbance vector and an optimized disturbance signal; generating adversarial samples based on the optimized disturbance signal to train the ability of the target gesture classification model to resist attacks. The present invention can construct adversarial samples so that the input gesture is misclassified as a category predetermined by the attacker, revealing the security vulnerability problem in the acoustic wave perception gesture recognition system, and then improving its ability to resist attacks by training the gesture classification model in a targeted manner.

title: Agricultural product detection method and system
description: The present invention relates to the field of agricultural product testing technology and discloses an agricultural product testing method and system, comprising: obtaining test data of the agricultural product to be tested, performing feature extraction on the test data in an edge device to obtain a fused feature vector, and using an edge-end model to perform real-time testing of the agricultural product based on the fused feature vector; uploading the test results and the fused feature vector to the cloud, constructing a digital twin model in the cloud, generating a reference distribution, and performing difference monitoring; performing digital twin simulation based on the difference monitoring results, and achieving collaborative optimization through a two-way knowledge distillation mechanism, driving sorting equipment to complete agricultural product grading operations based on the test results. The proposed method and system can quickly adapt to scenario changes without requiring large-scale data backhaul, improving detection accuracy and stability, while ensuring the system's edge autonomy and cloud-edge consistency, and possessing high deployment practical value and promotion potential.

title: Intelligent design system and method for drilling, blasting, excavating and blasting scheme of underground tunnel
description: The application relates to the technical field of tunnel engineering, in particular to an intelligent design system and method for a drilling, blasting, excavation and blasting scheme of a subsurface tunnel, which solve the problems that the process of using a traditional blasting design mode is time-consuming and labor-consuming, adjustment and modification are not easy to make in time, and the progress and economic benefit of the tunnel engineering are seriously affected. The system comprises a blasting scheme design module and a blasting scheme optimization module, wherein the system is used for carrying out blast hole design, design chart display and automatic generation of a blasting scheme according to related data of tunnel engineering provided by a user, blasting parameter design is carried out according to the related data, meanwhile, the profile of an excavated section is drawn to display the arrangement of blast holes, and blast hole parameters and charging parameters are automatically counted to generate a blasting scheme file, so that a more scientific, reasonable, rapid and efficient tunnel blasting design mode is realized.

title: Method for judging abnormal ringing faults in industrial data analysis
description: The present invention belongs to the technical field of industrial data analysis, and in particular, relates to a method for abnormal sound fault judgment in industrial data analysis. The method collects equipment benchmark fault sound source data and mixed sound source data containing interference through a multi-dimensional distributed sensor array to construct a multimodal sound source database; separates the interference of the mixed sound source data and calculates the energy entropy value, and after data quality verification, compares the denoised data and the benchmark data to screen the valid data; constructs a fault location model to determine the spatial coordinates of the fault point and eliminates pseudo-location points; uses a dual-branch neural network to fuse space and sound source data, and outputs the fault category and probability. Compared with the prior art, the present invention overcomes the limitations of considering sound or position information alone, effectively removes interference, verifies data quality, achieves accurate fault location and category judgment, improves fault detection accuracy and maintenance efficiency, and ensures the safe and stable operation of industrial equipment.

title: Power big data mining and operation optimization system based on association rule model
description: The invention discloses an electric power big data mining and operation optimizing system based on an association rule model, and belongs to the technical field of big data mining. The method solves the problems that in the prior art, data analysis results are difficult to obtain quickly, so that online optimization response is slow, an association rule model is established by adopting a correlation analysis method, association rules among power grid data are identified by utilizing the association rule model, so that characteristic information in the power grid data is obtained, the accuracy of subsequent analysis is ensured, the characteristic information is analyzed by a time sequence method, so that the stability and the change trend of the characteristic information are determined, the accuracy of subsequent prediction is ensured, the characteristic information of the power grid data is predicted by combining a neural network model, the change trend of power grid load is obtained, and the output and the operation mode of a generator in a power system are optimized online according to the change trend, so that the operation efficiency of the power system is improved, and the reliability and the safety of the power system are optimized.

title: Ocean environment treatment and early warning method and system based on deep neural network
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of governance and early warning, and specifically discloses a governance and early warning method and system for marine environment based on deep neural network, establishes a marine environment monitoring relationship database, and divides it into a training set and a test set; performs data preprocessing on historical data of monitoring parameters and prediction parameters; determines the order of a dynamic prediction model of marine environment parameters, and obtains the dynamic prediction model of marine environment parameters; inputs the monitoring parameters into the dynamic prediction model of marine environment parameters, adopts a multi-step prediction method to obtain prediction parameters; based on the prediction parameters, warns the marine environment, and generates a marine environment early warning warning signal based on the early warning result; the present invention can more accurately reflect the changing law of prediction errors under different environmental conditions, so that the early warning system can more accurately judge the abnormal situation of marine environment parameters, reduce misjudgment and missed judgment caused by environmental factors, and improve the reliability and practicality of marine environment governance early warning.

title: Cross pseudo-supervision-based semi-supervised medical image segmentation method and device
description: The invention provides a semi-supervised medical image segmentation method and device based on cross pseudo supervision, and relates to the technical field of medical image segmentation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining medical image data, wherein the medical image data comprises a plurality of marked medical images and a plurality of unmarked medical images; the method comprises the steps of constructing a semi-supervised medical image segmentation model based on medical image data, wherein the semi-supervised medical image segmentation model comprises a convolution network and a diffusion network, the convolution network comprises a feature coding module, a high-frequency Mamba module and a feature decoding module which are sequentially connected, training the semi-supervised medical image segmentation model based on a total loss function, a cross pseudo-supervision mechanism and contrast learning, and obtaining a segmentation result of an unlabeled medical image. The invention solves the problems that the existing medical image segmentation method is limited to limited samples, the whole data distribution cannot be captured, the distribution information and the detail information are not utilized at the same time, and the existing label propagation method is limited to local semantic similarity.

title: Distribution network user voltage abnormality diagnosis method and system
description: The invention provides a power distribution network user voltage abnormality diagnosis method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting basic characteristics and electrical characteristics when a low voltage event occurs, acquiring event types corresponding to the low voltage event according to at least one key factor under a first preset rule, performing cause diagnosis on the low voltage event under a second preset rule, marking the cause diagnosis result once based on a third preset rule, constructing a final evaluation model, inputting the basic characteristics and the electrical characteristics into the final evaluation model according to the primary marking result to obtain a first diagnosis result corresponding to the primary marking result, and checking and fusing the first diagnosis result and the cause diagnosis result under a fourth preset rule to output a diagnosis report about the low voltage event according to the checking and fusing result. The invention can improve the efficiency and accuracy of low-voltage diagnosis.

title: Hydropower unit fault detection method and system based on deep learning
description: The invention relates to a hydropower unit fault detection method and system based on deep learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of forming a target vibration vector, a target swing vector and a target pulsation vector according to a current vibration vector set, a current swing vector set and a current pulsation vector set, constructing a vibration vector three-dimensional trend chart, a swing vector three-dimensional trend chart and a pulsation vector three-dimensional trend chart, extracting feature monitoring data, carrying out fault judgment according to the feature monitoring data to obtain node judgment data, judging whether a fault exists according to the node judgment data, and identifying the fault type, the fault grade and a fault development prediction chart if the fault exists. The invention further provides a fault detection system, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium for realizing the hydroelectric generating set based on deep learning. The method can solve the problems of low fault analysis efficiency and poor early warning precision existing in the current fault detection of the hydroelectric generating set by using a deep learning algorithm.

title: Oil well production prediction method and system based on dynamic and static hybrid attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses an oil well yield prediction method and system based on a dynamic-static mixed attention mechanism, wherein the prediction method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining historical production data of a target oil well, preprocessing the historical production data, S2, converting the preprocessed historical production data from a time domain to a frequency domain through Fourier filtering and decomposing the preprocessed historical production data into a time-varying component I and a time-invariant component I, S3, converting the decomposed frequency domain data into the time domain data through Fourier inversion to obtain a time-varying component II and a time-invariant component II, S4, respectively establishing a time-varying prediction model and a time-invariant prediction model, S5, respectively predicting the time-varying prediction model and the time-invariant prediction model to obtain a time-varying prediction result and a time-invariant prediction result, and S6, carrying out weighted fusion on the time-varying prediction result and the time-invariant prediction result to obtain a final prediction result. The invention can accurately predict the oil well yield and provide technical support for oil and gas exploitation.

title: A drone inspection target recognition algorithm integrating graph neural network and spatial semantics
description: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle inspection target recognition algorithm integrating a graph neural network and spatial semantics, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, and the technical scheme is characterized by comprising the following steps of collecting a target inspection area of an unmanned aerial vehicle in the inspection process, and carrying out segmentation and combination on an obstacle area, an obstacle-free area and an identification area in the target inspection area to obtain a first combined area set and a second combined area set; the method comprises the steps of judging image features of an area with the obstacle to obtain an image feature judging result of the obstacle, judging image features of an area without the obstacle to obtain an image feature judging result without the obstacle, processing and analyzing target recognition feature quantity and contrast feature quantity of a first combined area set according to the image feature judging result and the image feature judging result without the obstacle to obtain a first recognition quantity result set and a first contrast quantity result set, and greatly improving the automation level and abnormal recognition capability of inspection.

title: Control gateway for multi-protocol conversion and device access and data transmission method thereof
description: The present invention discloses a control gateway for multi-protocol conversion and a device access and data transmission method thereof, which belongs to the technical field of protocol conversion, and includes a protocol conversion module for identifying multiple communication protocols and performing bidirectional conversion on different communication protocols; a data processing module for performing error detection and correction on data and preprocessing on data; a security management module for providing multi-level security protection for data transmission and device access, including encryption, identity authentication, authorization and network security protection; a flow control module for dynamically adjusting the data transmission rate, priority and resource allocation according to the network status and user configuration; a device management module for managing the devices connected to the gateway; and a user interface module for providing an interactive interface and an API interface between the user and the gateway. The present invention provides an efficient, secure and flexible solution for the communication between networks and devices with different protocols through architecture design and functional arrangement.

title: Multi-agent cooperation-based problem generation method, device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a problem generation method, a device and a storage medium based on multi-agent cooperation, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining post description texts, and dividing the post description texts to obtain a plurality of text paragraphs; the method comprises the steps of inputting a plurality of text paragraphs into a plurality of labels to extract an agent to obtain a plurality of label sets, inputting the plurality of label sets into an optimizing agent to obtain a target label set, and generating target question pairs according to the target label set, wherein the target question pairs comprise questions and answers. According to the method, the multi-agent cooperative mechanism is constructed, so that effective segmentation, parallel processing and result fusion of the post description text are realized, and the accuracy of label generation is improved, so that the accuracy of problem generation is improved, and the problems that key information is missed and label coverage is incomplete in the processing process of the post description text are solved.

title: Deep information perception graph neural network recommendation model method
description: The invention discloses a deep information perceived graph neural network recommendation model method which comprises the steps of S10, generating a cooperation information graph based on user article interaction data and article knowledge graph, S20, acquiring a high-order cooperation information graph and a high-order interaction graph based on a high-order neighborhood graph generation module, S30, learning node characterization in the high-order cooperation information graph and the high-order interaction graph through a deep information aggregation module, S40, training a model, calculating preference scores of users on various articles based on training results, and generating a recommendation list of the users according to the scores. In addition, a high-order neighborhood graph generating module is provided, and the support node establishes connection with the high-order neighborhood in advance.

title: EPO algorithm-based dynamic progressive path planning method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics path planning, in particular to a dynamic progressive path planning method based on an EPO algorithm, which comprises the steps of collecting customer requirements and matching corresponding cargo attributes; the method comprises the steps of sequentially constructing objective functions corresponding to transportation cost, time cost, carrier carbon emission cost and carrier service quality cost, respectively determining weight parameters, integrating and establishing a multi-objective cost function, respectively determining transportation state values and storage state values of logistics nodes in the cargo transportation process, integrating and generating a logistics node dynamic judgment mechanism, improving EPO algorithm variation based on a difference variation method, and outputting optimal carrier combination numbers, transportation modes and logistics node numbers in the cargo transportation process to obtain optimal path planning results. The EPO algorithm after differential optimization can dynamically adjust the optimization direction according to the change of the transportation environment, and has stronger adaptability and stability to complex logistics networks with huge logistics node numbers.

title: Method for identifying space to be optimized of built environment based on morphological hierarchical model
description: The present invention discloses a method for identifying spaces to be optimized in the built environment based on a morphological hierarchy model, comprising the steps of collecting and preprocessing built environment data, preliminary morphological hierarchy of the built environment, correcting the morphological hierarchy of the built environment, preliminary identification of spaces to be optimized, hierarchy identification of spaces to be optimized, and interaction and feedback of identification results. The method collects data through a lidar system, an aerial drone, a street view collection vehicle, and a low-Earth satellite, and combines multi-task Bayesian federated learning, an XGBoost model, a Vision Transformer, and a convolutional neural network to identify and display spaces to be optimized in the built environment. The present invention can facilitate the rapid identification of spaces to be optimized in the built environment in the field of urban planning, and improve the rationality and accuracy of the identification results of spaces to be optimized in the built environment through morphological hierarchy.

title: Dynamic scene identification and AR information superposition method based on multi-mode large model
description: The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a method for dynamic scene recognition and AR information superposition based on a multimodal large model. By considering the task execution operation speed of each subtask executor and the multimodal large model library and hardware resources deployed by each collaborative device in the collaborative device candidate set, an optimization target based on a set of constraints of communication delay and hardware resources and the computing load of the collaborative device is constructed, and an optimization algorithm is used to solve the industrial collaborative execution strategy, driving each subtask executor to configure the corresponding collaborative device to execute the assigned industrial collaborative subtask. Therefore, the present invention adopts flexible allocation and scheduling to deploy collaborative devices with different multimodal large model libraries, and utilizes the communication link established between the target collaborative device and the associated collaborative device to hand over the data processing action of each industrial collaborative subtask to the collaborative device corresponding to the multimodal large model for processing, thereby improving the stability and real-time performance of the augmented reality industrial auxiliary system.

title: Multi-mode knowledge graph rule reasoning method and device based on large model
description: The invention discloses a multi-mode knowledge graph rule reasoning method and device based on a large model, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction and cross-mode alignment on input text data and image data to generate multi-mode feature vectors of a unified semantic space; the method comprises the steps of carrying out knowledge graph storage on emotion entities and relations by adopting an attribute graph model to complete emotion knowledge graph construction, generating interpretable reasoning rules from the emotion knowledge graph by utilizing a large language model, combining logic verification to eliminate conflict rules, calculating confidence level of a reasoning path based on an attention mechanism, carrying out quantitative evaluation on rule reasoning results, carrying out online updating on the knowledge graph and a rule base according to user feedback, and optimizing instantaneity and accuracy of a reasoning system by means of weight adjustment and forgetting mechanisms. The invention breaks through the limitations of the traditional emotion analysis method in the aspects of evidence dimension, adaptability, interpretation and the like through innovative technologies such as multi-modal data integration, dynamic knowledge evolution, interpretable reasoning and the like.

title: System and method for real-time target detection and intelligent recognition based on UAV images
description: This application discloses a system and method for real-time target detection and intelligent recognition based on drone imagery, relating to the field of image target detection technology. This application utilizes a dual-modal sensor to achieve pixel-level data alignment through a spatiotemporal synchronization error control matrix. It utilizes a dynamic feature fusion module to capture the differentiated representation of visible light and methane data and enhance the concentration-space joint feature through cross-modal weight learning, leakage characteristic perception, and an adaptive fusion unit. It also constructs a regional attention calculation module to generate sub-region attention scores based on multidimensional data such as historical leakage records and pipeline density, dynamically allocating computing resource priorities. A model optimization module combines attention levels with real-time computing load, achieving dynamic adjustment of channel resources through a baseline retention ratio and dynamic pruning strategy.

title: A 3D model feature recognition method based on heterogeneous graph neural network
description: The application provides a three-dimensional model feature recognition method based on a heterogeneous graph neural network, and belongs to the technical field of computer-aided manufacturing. The method comprises the steps of selecting a three-dimensional model database with characteristic labels, sequentially obtaining a topology set, a geometric information set and a normalized geometric information set of each three-dimensional model, extracting geometric characteristics of each normalized geometric information set to obtain a corresponding geometric mapping characteristic set, constructing an initial heterograph neural network, dividing data of all three-dimensional models in the three-dimensional model database into a training set, a verification set and a test set by using all geometric mapping characteristic sets, sequentially training, verifying and testing the initial heterograph neural network to obtain a final heterograph neural network, and carrying out characteristic recognition on the three-dimensional models by using the final heterograph neural network. The application can effectively improve the characteristic recognition capability and recognition accuracy of the complex three-dimensional model.

title: Self-supervised point cloud ranking using machine learning models
description: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques and apparatus for performing inference on multidimensional point clouds using machine learning models. Example methods generally include generating a score for each corresponding point in a multidimensional point cloud using a scoring neural network. Points in the multidimensional point cloud are ranked based on the scores generated for each corresponding point in the multidimensional point cloud. An optimal point is selected from the ranked multidimensional point cloud, and one or more actions are taken based on the selected optimal k points.

title: Digital model generation using neural networks
description: The invention discloses digital model generation using neural networks. Apparatus, systems, and techniques are provided for generating a digital model. In at least one embodiment, the neural network is to generate motion of the first portion of the object based on motion of the second portion of the object and audio corresponding to the motion of the second portion of the object. For example, the neural network may use the audio information to generate movements of facial and body features of the digital model.

title: Measuring device
description: The measuring device 1 involved in the present invention measures at least one parameter representing the state of a fluid, and comprises: a detection unit 10, which is used to obtain at least one sensor value required for calculating the parameter as data; and a calculation unit 30, which calculates the parameter based on the data obtained using the detection unit 10, and the calculation unit 30 obtains the result of at least one of regression processing and discrimination processing associated with the parameter performed using a learning model pre-constructed based on data when an impurity is mixed into the fluid and the obtained data.

title: Multi-mode interaction system based on large model drive
description: The present invention discloses a multimodal interaction system based on large model driving, which relates to the field of multimodal interaction. The system includes: an interactive agent terminal, configured to receive multimodal raw data input by a user and output a fusion feedback result; a multimodal gateway, communicatively connected to the interactive agent terminal, for converting the fusion feedback result into a low-dimensional feature vector, and eliminating the inter-modal semantic gap of the low-dimensional feature vector through a pre-trained attention mechanism; a large model driving engine, coupled with the multimodal gateway, including a dynamically loaded multimodal large model base supporting joint reasoning and a domain knowledge plug-in interface for mounting a vertical domain fine-tuning adapter; an intention decision center, configured to parse the output of the large model driving engine and generate executable instructions. The present invention can achieve the unity of high precision, strong robustness and scalability of industrial-grade multimodal interaction systems.

title: A data analysis model for multi-feature constraints
description: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, and discloses a data analysis model oriented to multi-feature constraint, which comprises a data acquisition module, an improved GAN network module and a configuration optimization module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring production basic data and production demand data of enterprises, the improved GAN network module is used for generating a resource configuration scheme, an input layer, a generation network, a discrimination network and an output layer are arranged in the improved GAN network module, the input layer takes the production basic data and the production demand data as inputs, the generation network is used for generating a basic configuration scheme, the discrimination network is used for discriminating the generated basic configuration scheme and analyzing to obtain the effectiveness score of each basic configuration scheme, the output layer is used for outputting the resource configuration scheme, and the configuration optimization module is used for applying constraint conditions to the generation process of the generation network so as to optimize the generation process. The method can efficiently complete resource allocation in the enterprise production process, and the generated allocation scheme is better, thereby being beneficial to realizing maximization of production benefits.

title: Method and apparatus for transmitting and receiving capability information in a wireless communication system
description: According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, a method performed by a terminal in a wireless communication system includes the following steps: transmitting capability information; and transmitting information related to one or more capability values based on range information. The capability information includes range information related to at least one capability value. The at least one capability value is related to at least one feature supported by the terminal.

title: Method and system for adjusting motion data in virtual battlefield environment
description: The present invention provides a method and system for adjusting motion data in a virtual battlefield environment. The method comprises: obtaining current motion data of a combat robot in the virtual battlefield environment; using a trained residual network to determine a matching score between the current motion data and standard motion data corresponding to the virtual battlefield environment; when the matching score is less than a preset threshold, determining a motion deviation vector between the current motion data and the standard motion data using a difference measurement formula that introduces correction factors; wherein the correction factors include an environmental correction factor for the virtual battlefield environment and an equipment constraint correction factor for the combat robot; inputting the motion deviation vector into a multi-agent proximal strategy optimizer to generate an optimization correction instruction that maximizes combat effectiveness; and adjusting the current motion data according to the optimization correction instruction. The present invention can improve the motion accuracy of a combat robot in a virtual battlefield environment.

title: Layered Exploration Thinking-Driven Large-Scale Complex Graph Question-Answering Method and Device
description: The invention provides a large model complex graph question-answering processing method and device driven by layered exploration thinking, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and aims to solve the technical problem that the existing complex graph question-answering method is insufficient in reasoning depth, path searching strategy and cross-layer information fusion capability. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a complex graph question-answering task to be processed, inputting the complex graph question-answering task into a pre-built large model, adding an induction mark for a node set by utilizing a first layer structure, generating an induction graph, extracting core entity characteristics and main logic structure characteristics in question description by utilizing a second layer structure, generating a context prompt, carrying out reasoning exploration by utilizing a third layer structure according to the induction graph and the context prompt, generating a preliminary question-answering result, checking a semantic relation and a logic relation of the preliminary question-answering result, and iteratively updating the induction graph and re-generating the question-answering result until the check is passed in response to the failure of the check, and outputting a target question-answering result.

title: Reasoning segmentation method based on Bounding Box and semantic text double prompts
description: This paper presents an inference segmentation method based on dual cues, namely, bounding box and semantic text, belonging to the field of embodied perception for large language models. The paper constructs an inference segmentation model based on both bounding box and semantic text cues, and establishes an effective training paradigm and dataset for two-stage training of the inference segmentation model. The method combines language model loss and mask loss to ensure the effective generation of both types of cues. Furthermore, it adds a bounding box position cues to the text cues, resolving the existing problem of segmentation being limited by the model's text comprehension ability and providing a single cues to the SAM, thereby improving the accuracy of inference segmentation.

title: Real-time channel boundary identification method and device in marine pasture net cage culture environment
description: A real-time channel boundary identification method and device in a marine pasture net cage culture environment belong to the technical field of water surface automation, and particularly relate to real-time channel boundary identification in the marine pasture net cage culture environment, and the method solves the problems that an existing channel identification method cannot adapt to influences of weather changes, illumination interference (such as extreme illumination conditions or night), water flow and wave motion (such as underwater net cage detection) and other water surface bad conditions in the net cage culture environment, and further cannot carry out channel identification with high precision, strong instantaneity, low cost and light weight. The real-time channel boundary identification method and the device under the marine pasture net cage culture environment are suitable for real-time channel boundary identification under the marine pasture net cage culture environment.

title: Multi-source data combined distracted driving behavior recognition method and system
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for identifying distracted driving behavior using multi-source data. This method belongs to the technical field of cross-domain data joint analysis. The method includes: connecting a vehicle GPS database to a traffic database, filtering vehicle GPS data, and obtaining a matching dataset; performing data preprocessing on the matching dataset to generate a GPS dataset, performing data alignment, and forming a joint feature dataset; based on the joint feature dataset, dividing time series samples into fixed time windows, extracting statistical features, constructing a multi-classification prediction model, and outputting distracted driving behavior identification results; and uploading the distracted driving behavior identification results to a vehicle supervision platform. Through multi-source data joint analysis, a three-level correlation mechanism, and multi-dimensional feature fusion, the present invention achieves both confidentiality and reliability through efficient cross-domain data integration, achieving high recognition accuracy and efficiency, and providing an all-weather, low-cost solution for the safety supervision of freight vehicles.

title: Urban waterlogging risk multi-level prediction method, equipment, storage medium and computer program product based on space-time diagram learning
description: This application discloses a multi-level prediction method, device, storage medium, and computer program product for urban waterlogging risk based on spatiotemporal graph learning, relating to the technical field of natural disaster risk prediction. The method comprises: collecting multimodal urban hydrological data; performing hierarchical temporal modeling on the multimodal urban hydrological data and extracting a temporal embedding vector; constructing a heterogeneous graph based on the temporal embedding vector, performing spatial feature aggregation calculation on the heterogeneous graph, and obtaining a spatial embedding representation; and performing multi-level prediction based on the spatial embedding representation to obtain a multi-granularity waterlogging risk indicator. Through multimodal data collection and preprocessing, hierarchical temporal modeling, heterogeneous graph construction and spatial feature aggregation calculation, and multi-level prediction, multimodal urban hydrological data is effectively integrated to achieve a comprehensive and accurate urban waterlogging risk prediction.

title: Cluster clustering distribution optimization method and system based on alliance game
description: The invention discloses a cluster clustering distribution optimization method and system based on alliance game, wherein the method mainly comprises the steps of analyzing task demands and resource constraints of a cluster clustering distribution scene, establishing a cluster clustering distribution mathematical model, and representing a coupling relation between the cluster clustering and a distribution process; initializing cluster clustering distribution, converting a mathematical model of cluster clustering distribution into a game solving model of a cluster distribution alliance, designing an alliance iterative optimization strategy based on the game solving model of the cluster distribution alliance, and generating a cluster clustering distribution optimization result through the alliance iterative optimization strategy. The invention can quickly solve the optimization problem of cluster clustering and high coupling of distribution, and is suitable for the scenes of communication resource distribution, target distribution, fire distribution and the like of a large-scale cluster.

title: Maintenance method, apparatus and computer program product for mobile network
description: The application provides a maintenance method, a device and a computer program product of a mobile network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining current complaint data and residence time data of each complaint area of the mobile network to construct a user area complaint image and a user area residence image, inputting the user area complaint image into an image convolution model to obtain a first user feature vector of each user and a first area feature vector of each complaint area, inputting the user area residence image into an hypergraph convolution model to obtain a second user feature vector of each user and a second area feature vector of each complaint area, fusing the first area feature vector and the second area feature vector to obtain a target user feature vector, fusing the first area feature vector and the second area feature vector to obtain a target area feature vector, and calculating the inner product of each target user feature vector and each target area feature vector to obtain the complaint probability of each user on each complaint area, so that the problem of inaccurate complaint prediction algorithm prediction is solved.

title: Intelligent generation method and device for non-targeted metabonomics molecular fingerprint
description: The invention provides a non-targeted metabonomics molecular fingerprint intelligent generation method and device, which relate to the technical field of data processing and comprise the steps of carrying out weak enhancement processing on labeled data in mass spectrum sample data, and carrying out weak enhancement processing and strong enhancement processing on unlabeled data in the mass spectrum sample data to obtain mass spectrum training data; performing feature extraction on the mass spectrum training data by using a transducer encoder to obtain Morgan molecular fingerprints, and performing back diffusion by using Morgan molecular fingerprints as constraint conditions and random Gaussian noise generated in a forward diffusion process as a basis to generate target molecular fingerprints; training a preset network model by using the screened target molecule fingerprints to obtain a target network model so as to finish the processing of mass spectrum data to be processed. According to the invention, the characteristics in the mass spectrum data are extracted, and the characteristics are used as constraint conditions for generating the molecular fingerprint of the metabolite to be analyzed, so that the training of a diffusion model is realized, and the generalization capability of the model is improved.

title: A novel method and device for identifying large branches in distribution networks based on whale swarm optimization algorithm
description: The invention discloses a novel power distribution network large branch identification method and device based on whale swarm optimization algorithm, which are used for solving the technical problem of low solving efficiency caused by the existing power distribution network large branch identification method. The method comprises the steps of responding to an identification request, constructing a main branch distribution transformation objective function and a branch distribution transformation load calculation objective function, constructing a main branch distribution transformation and branch distribution transformation identification model according to the main branch distribution transformation objective function and a preset main branch distribution transformation identification constraint condition, constructing a branch distribution transformation load calculation model according to the branch distribution transformation load calculation objective function and the preset branch distribution transformation load calculation constraint condition, respectively converting the main branch distribution transformation and branch distribution transformation identification model and the branch distribution transformation load calculation model by adopting a relaxation technology to generate a first unconstrained optimization problem and a second unconstrained optimization problem, solving the first unconstrained optimization problem and the second unconstrained optimization problem by adopting a whale group optimization algorithm, and outputting a large branch identification result of the distribution network.

title: PLC-based intelligent coal dispatching system and method for thermal power plants
description: The disclosed embodiments relate to the field of intelligent scheduling, and provide a PLC-based coal-fired intelligent scheduling system and method for thermal power plants, which relate to the field of intelligent scheduling. The system uses data processing technology based on deep learning to perform time series pattern feature analysis on the power load data and electricity price fluctuation data obtained by the PLC controller, and then performs fine-grained external knowledge interaction on the power load time series pattern features and electricity price time series pattern features after the time series analysis, and intelligently predicts short-term power demand based on the obtained interaction features between the power load and the electricity price, and automatically generates scheduling instructions in combination with the real-time speed value of the conveyor belt. In this way, it is possible to quickly adapt to the ever-changing market environment and provide more flexible and timely scheduling decisions. In addition, by deeply exploring the complex patterns in the power load and electricity price data, the accuracy of short-term power demand prediction can be improved to provide richer information support for intelligent scheduling.

title: Automatic hierarchical knowledge base construction method and system for long text
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for automatically constructing a hierarchical knowledge base for long texts, which solves the problem in the prior art that the original hierarchical structure cannot be retained, complex queries cannot be realized, and knowledge base updates cannot be realized. The method comprises: performing structural feature analysis on the input long text through a large language model to generate a structured parsing template, and automatically dividing the input long text into hierarchical levels to obtain a preprocessed output long text; constructing a three-dimensional knowledge base structure including a semantic hierarchical dimension, a temporal hierarchical dimension, and an attribute hierarchical dimension; based on the preprocessed output long text and the three-dimensional knowledge base structure, using the large language model to automatically extract and hierarchically aggregate multi-granularity knowledge units to form a hierarchical knowledge base; combining with an external knowledge source to realize dynamic updating of the knowledge base; the method realizes the construction of a hierarchical three-dimensional knowledge base structure, and when updating, it can be updated according to the hierarchical structure.

title: Express parcel loss identification method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for identifying express package loss. The method comprises the steps of obtaining package information corresponding to a plurality of historical express packages in a target time period, carrying out data processing on the package information of each historical express package to obtain loss identification data of each historical express package, determining data extraction dimensions, extracting loss identification key features of each historical express package based on the data extraction dimensions, constructing a loss identification model based on the loss identification key features in combination with a decision tree model, and identifying loss results of current express packages based on the loss identification model. According to the scheme, the loss prediction model is constructed to automatically identify the loss of the express delivery, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of identifying the loss state of the express delivery are improved.

title: Modulation signal classification system based on lightweight network
description: The embodiment of the specification discloses a modulation signal classification system based on a lightweight network, which comprises a signal acquisition module for acquiring an IQ modulation signal, a model detection module for judging based on a trained modulation signal identification model by taking the IQ modulation signal as input, a feature extraction unit for acquiring a feature matrix of the IQ modulation signal through deep separable convolution, a feature optimization unit for carrying out multistage wavelet decomposition and pooling processing on the feature matrix to obtain feature vectors, and obtaining attention weights corresponding to all features in the feature vectors through a self-attention algorithm, a classification unit for obtaining prediction probabilities corresponding to each modulation class label based on the feature vectors and the attention weights corresponding to all features in the feature vectors, and a result output module for outputting prediction classes. The depth separable convolution and the multistage wavelet decomposition are cooperatively used, so that the calculated amount is reduced, and the representation capability of the model on time-frequency characteristics is remarkably improved, thereby realizing the light weight and edge deployment of the recognition model.

title: Parameter adjustment method and system for Wi-Fi module
