description: The present invention discloses a parameter adjustment method and system for a Wi-Fi module. The method comprises: collecting and obtaining multimodal interference samples; constructing a spatiotemporal annotated dataset; constructing an LSTM-attention model to predict interference and output prediction results; constructing a dynamic interference tensor based on real-time IQ sampling data, prediction results, and a historical interference database, and outputting enhanced features after fusion through confidence-weighted CP decomposition and gated feature fusion; dynamically generating a QoS vector based on device type and service requirements, evaluating service quality based on the final quality value, and dynamically optimizing service quality; constructing and updating a virtual queue based on the final quality value, the prediction results, and the current radio frequency parameters, monitoring quality deviations, and dynamically adjusting radio frequency parameters. Through the closed-loop coordination of interference modeling, service perception, and an optimization framework, the present invention solves the problem of Wi-Fi module self-adaptation in highly dynamic interference environments, making it more suitable for complex scenarios such as industrial wireless control systems.

title: Intelligent body for saponification reaction and application thereof
description: The invention discloses an intelligent agent for saponification reaction and application thereof. The agent includes a hardware system and a software system. The hardware system comprises a feed liquid storage module, an infusion module, a reaction module, an environmental information sensing module, a fraction collection module and a central control module. The software system comprises a saponification reaction condition recommending module, an experimental operation condition calculating module, a hardware system control code generating module, a test design table generating module, an experimental result qualitative analysis and optimization module and an experimental result automatic modeling module. The intelligent agent disclosed by the invention is integrated with a large language model and a micro-channel continuous flow technology, can be used for automatic optimization of saponification reaction, and has the characteristics of accurate recommended process conditions, real-time monitoring and feedback adjustment, full-flow automatic control, environment sensing and fault early warning and the like.

title: Power distribution network topology analysis method and system
description: The present invention relates to a distribution network topology analysis method and system. The method constructs an undirected graph, a subgraph, and a connected subgraph by performing metadata parsing on a distribution line SVG file. Starting from a specified root node, the method uses a breadth-first search algorithm to traverse the subgraph, marking each node with a level based on the distance from the root node to the current node. Edge pruning is performed based on the marked levels, and the undirected graph is converted into a directed graph based on the hierarchical relationship. On this basis, a distribution transformer-switch relationship analysis is performed to form a basic information table of the switches belonging to the distribution transformer, and a connection line analysis is performed to obtain a line connection simplified path. The present invention ensures that the subgraph conforms to the radial structure of the distribution network through hierarchical pruning, removes connections at the same level, prevents the formation of a ring structure, and forms a line connection detailed path and a line connection simplified path, facilitating the quick viewing of the connection points between lines.

title: Typhoon path and strength prediction method based on multi-mode fusion network model
description: The invention discloses a typhoon path and strength prediction method based on a multi-mode fusion network model, and belongs to the technical field of meteorological monitoring. The method comprises the steps of obtaining position coordinates, central wind speed and central air pressure of typhoons and analysis data of wind fields and potential heights of typhoons in a central area, constructing a multi-mode fusion network model driven by the data and physics together, constructing a loss function of the multi-mode fusion network model, updating parameters of the multi-mode fusion network model through counter propagation to obtain a trained multi-mode fusion network model, inputting data in a test set into the trained multi-mode fusion network model, and outputting typhoons paths and intensities. The method analyzes the space-time characteristics of the dynamic association relation and the potential height field in the wind field, provides effective physical constraint for typhoon path and strength prediction, is used for typhoon path and strength prediction, and can improve the accuracy of typhoon path and strength prediction.

title: Underground garage operation and maintenance task management system and method based on Internet of things
description: The invention provides an underground garage operation and maintenance task management system and method based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of garage management, wherein the system comprises a blind area identification unit, a control unit and a control unit, wherein the blind area identification unit is used for constructing an initial digital twin model of an underground garage based on structural data of the underground garage, collecting state data of the underground garage and identifying blind area areas of the underground garage by combining a grid comparison algorithm; the system comprises a path planning unit, a routing inspection state monitoring unit and a control unit, wherein the path planning unit is used for generating an optimal routing inspection path of an administrator by using a path planning algorithm according to an identified blind area, based on a patrol initial point of the administrator and a preset receiver in the underground garage, and determining a receiver to be connected by combining the optimal routing inspection path, and the routing inspection state monitoring unit is used for executing routing inspection operation and maintenance tasks based on the optimal routing inspection path, determining routing inspection states of the administrator and recording according to the receiver to be connected so as to realize monitoring of the operation and maintenance tasks of the underground garage. The invention greatly improves the operation and maintenance efficiency, the data accuracy and the management transparency.

title: Engineering construction project safety penetration type management method and system
description: The invention discloses a safe penetrating management method and system for engineering construction projects, and relates to the technical field of constructional engineering, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting engineering entity data in real time, preprocessing the engineering entity data and generating engineering state vectors; the method comprises the steps of constructing a digital twin model based on engineering state vectors, calling a multi-physical field coupling simulation construction whole process to generate a risk early warning report, uploading the risk early warning report and historical construction data to a federal platform to construct a dynamic safety knowledge graph, carrying out hierarchical feature learning on nodes in the dynamic safety knowledge graph, simulating manager decision behaviors to generate optimal management and control rules, driving a construction site management mechanism to operate based on the optimal management and control rules to form a closed loop report, and utilizing the digital twin model and the multi-physical field simulation technology to realize accurate prediction of potential safety hazards possibly occurring in the construction process and greatly improve accuracy and timeliness of risk early warning.

title: Prediction method, device, equipment and product of operation and maintenance data
description: The invention discloses a prediction method, a device, equipment and a product of operation and maintenance data, which are used for training a long-term and short-term memory neural network model LSTM by utilizing corrected historical operation and maintenance time sequence data; the long-term and short-term memory neural network model LSTM after training is utilized to predict future operation and maintenance time sequence data, and the method has the characteristics of high operation and maintenance data prediction speed, accurate prediction effect and capability of effectively improving operation and maintenance quality, and an operation and maintenance team can actively prevent faults, reduce equipment downtime and ensure stable operation of the service according to the predicted operation and maintenance data.

title: Text processing method, device and electronic device
description: The present disclosure provides a text processing method, device and electronic device, the method comprising: determining prompt information based on an initial text corresponding to a target speech; inputting the prompt information into a generative model, using a character path as a constraint, and generating output characters corresponding to the initial text based on the prompt information; the type of the output characters comprising at least one of a text type, a number type, a punctuation type and a white space character type, the output characters constituting the target text corresponding to the target speech; the character path comprising at least one character in the initial text.

title: Air conditioning duct mold spot area recognition method based on GMM and adaptive threshold segmentation
description: The invention discloses an air conditioner pipeline mildew area identification method integrating GMM and self-adaptive threshold segmentation, and relates to the technical field of intelligent image detection and air conditioner pipeline maintenance. The method and the device have the advantages that mildew features and calculation areas are accurately extracted through an image analysis technology, detection precision is remarkably improved, dependence on various sensors is reduced, image acquisition equipment and algorithms are used for replacing the mildew features, hardware and maintenance cost are reduced, image data are processed in real time, detection period is shortened, quick response is achieved, the combination of Gaussian GMM clustering and adaptive threshold segmentation can effectively cope with the complex condition of the wall surface of an air-conditioning pipeline, the GMM can distinguish interference factors from mildew by modeling pixel distribution, and the adaptive threshold segmentation can remove interference according to local features, so that the identification result is more stable and reliable.

title: Medical information generation method and system based on model processing
description: The present invention relates to a method and system for generating medical information based on model processing, and relates to the field of text analysis technology, comprising a smart watch; the smart watch detects voice signals emitted from the outside; the voice signals are voice signals emitted by different speakers; the direction of the sound source is determined based on the voice signals; the camera of the smart watch is controlled to face the direction of the sound source to collect video information in the direction of the sound source; the video information is input into a text analysis model to obtain a text analysis result; the text analysis result is re-analyzed to obtain a re-analysis result; and the re-analysis result is transmitted to a computer. This greatly improves the real-time and accuracy of document input, reduces human errors and information loss, and saves time, which is conducive to improving the quality of diagnosis and treatment and nursing efficiency, and ultimately improves the patient's medical experience.

title: A method for evaluating voltage transformer measurement error
description: The invention discloses a voltage transformer metering error evaluation method, which relates to the technical field of voltage transformer metering, and comprises the steps of constructing a synchronous acquisition system of a plurality of groups of voltage transformers in a transformer substation, acquiring original voltage data, constructing a virtual reference voltage generation model, outputting a reference voltage sequence, calculating error statistical characteristics and marking the running state grade of the voltage transformers, evaluating health scores according to the error characteristics, outputting grading results, receiving inspection feedback comparison differences, updating the model, generating an analysis chart and uploading the analysis chart to a client display and linkage operation and maintenance system.

title: Method and device for reconstructing multi-sound-velocity photoacoustic image based on implicit neural representation
description: The disclosure provides a multi-sound-velocity photoacoustic image reconstruction method and device based on implicit neural representation, and relates to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the steps of adjusting parameters of an implicit neural representation network, wherein the parameters of the implicit neural representation network are adjusted, the parameters comprise the steps of obtaining first initial sound pressure distribution and first sound velocity distribution through the implicit neural representation network based on space coordinates in an imaging area, obtaining a predicted detector signal through a differentiable acoustic forward propagation model based on the first initial sound pressure distribution and the first sound velocity distribution, minimizing differences between the predicted detector signal and detector measurement signals to update the parameters of the implicit neural representation network, iterating until preset convergence conditions are met, and obtaining second initial sound pressure distribution through the implicit neural representation network after the parameters are adjusted based on the space coordinates in the imaging area. The present disclosure enables photoacoustic image reconstruction without the need for a sound velocity profile or a pairing truth value.

title: Artificial intelligence enhanced strong field terahertz spectroscopy detection imaging device and method
description: This invention relates to the field of terahertz wave detection and imaging technology, specifically to an AI-enhanced strong-field terahertz spectroscopy detection and imaging device and method, comprising: a femtosecond laser, a beam splitter, a chopper, a laser beam expander module, a spin terahertz emitter, a transmission-reflection integrated automated scanning and detection module, a terahertz detection device, and an AI-enhanced thickness measurement module and an AI-enhanced defect detection imaging module; the laser emitted by the femtosecond laser is used by the beam splitter to generate pump light and probe light. The pump light sequentially passes through the laser beam expander module, the spin terahertz emitter, and the transmission-reflection integrated automated scanning and detection module before entering the terahertz detection device; the probe light passes through the transmission-reflection integrated automated scanning and detection module before entering the terahertz detection device, and the terahertz detection device outputs the terahertz pulse shape, ultimately obtaining the sample thickness or defect contour; this invention can improve the efficiency of sample defect detection and reduce costs.

title: Thermal power generation coal-fired boiler fault risk early warning method based on period-trend network
description: The invention discloses a thermal power generation coal-fired boiler fault risk early warning method based on a period-trend network, which divides a period window by extracting a period signal of original data from a frequency domain; and designing a trend network, and predicting the future single-period window working condition based on the historical period window data. And extracting a characteristic paradigm of the periodic data from the historical normal periodic data, calculating a normal uncertainty range of the future trend, and sending out a fault alarm for a prediction result exceeding a reasonable range. The related method is used for verifying the overtemperature fault instance of the coal-fired boiler in the thermal power generation process, so that the effective early warning of the fault risk of the thermal power generation coal-fired boiler based on a period-trend network is realized.

title: Intelligent bus planning method and system based on passenger flow analysis
description: The application relates to the technical field of multi-target tracking, in particular to an intelligent bus planning method and system based on passenger flow analysis. The method comprises the steps of obtaining video stream data of a bus on an operation line, carrying out target detection and feature extraction on the video stream data through a multi-target tracking algorithm to obtain passenger features, carrying out feature matching on the passenger features in video frame images to determine labels of the passenger features in each video frame image, carrying out track tracking according to the labels of the passenger features, and determining track features of all passengers. According to the application, the travel route of the bus rapid transit is planned through the track characteristics, the track characteristics are encoded into ordered pairs for representing the tracks of the boarding station and the alighting station of passengers, and the occurrence times of the same ordered pair encoding are counted. And when the bus fast line shift is planned, fast line planning is carried out according to the high-heat line.

title: Municipal pipeline defect classification method and device based on intelligent algorithm and electronic equipment
description: The present invention provides a municipal pipeline defect classification method, device, and electronic device based on an intelligent algorithm, comprising the following steps: obtaining a water pipe image; capturing multimodal image features of the water pipe image to obtain image features to be monitored; inputting the image features to be monitored into a trained random forest model, and outputting defect monitoring results for the image features to be monitored. The random forest model is constructed by the following steps: obtaining a source water pipe image with a water pipe defect; capturing multimodal image features of the source water pipe image to obtain source image features; determining the target water pipe defect corresponding to the source image features based on the source image features; and constructing a random forest model based on the source image features and the target water pipe defect corresponding to the source image features. This method combines multimodal image feature extraction with a random forest model algorithm to achieve high-precision intelligent identification and automated classification of water pipe defect types, significantly improving detection efficiency and reliability.

title: Cloud edge collaborative anomaly prediction hierarchical processing method, device, equipment and medium
description: This application relates to a hierarchical processing method, apparatus, device, and medium for cloud-edge collaborative anomaly prediction. The method includes: acquiring terminal operating data and preprocessing the data to obtain a terminal operating state vector; inputting the terminal operating state vector into a gating network to obtain preliminary classification results, and constructing an anomaly prediction calculation task based on the preliminary classification results; inputting the anomaly prediction calculation task into the anomaly prediction expert unit corresponding to the preliminary classification results to generate edge node data processing result information; sending gating feature parameters of the gating network to the cloud nodes of the edge nodes, and obtaining gating network parameter update information generated by the cloud nodes based on the gating feature parameters. This method enables intelligent task scheduling, elastic resource allocation, and real-time model updates.

title: Pollution monitoring method, system and storage medium for river water
description: The invention relates to the technical field of pollution monitoring, in particular to a pollution monitoring method, a system and a storage medium for river water, which comprise the steps of acquiring river sediment spectrum data through a multipoint synchronous acquisition technology, analyzing and extracting feature vectors by adopting a main component, and determining pollutant types; the method comprises the steps of combining hydrodynamic force and molecular polarization effect, utilizing a counter-propagation neural network to predict pollutant diffusion direction and interface polarization intensity, generating a distribution mode of pollutants in sediment, obtaining potential gradient and chemical bond amplitude characteristics of pollution source spatial distribution, matching a signal attenuation rate and a chemical bond intensity model of spectrum signals, determining pollutant emission frequency and interface scattering effect, and combining pollution source persistence and chemical bond amplitude, and tracing the spatial distribution, emission frequency and potential gradient of the pollution source. Through the steps, the invention realizes the accurate tracing and dynamic monitoring of the pollution source, and effectively improves the accuracy of pollutant detection and the scientificity of water quality control.

title: Working parameter linkage regulation and control method and system for middle-deep geothermal water source heat pump
description: This invention relates to a method and system for the coordinated control of operating parameters of a medium-deep geothermal source heat pump, specifically in the field of medium-deep geothermal source heat pumps. First, a disturbance signal is generated through reinforcement learning and injected into the geothermal loop, thereby improving the dynamic mapping accuracy of the underground thermal reservoir. Second, the thermal diffusivity and fissure ratio of the rock strata are inverted using a physical information neural network model, enabling real-time monitoring of the underground thermal reservoir. Then, the difference between the heating load and the geothermal heat absorption capacity is predicted using meteorological data, room temperature data, and heat pump operating parameters, generating control decisions and setting graded triggering conditions. Finally, a dual-actuator collaborative algorithm is used to precisely control the phase change thermal storage device and the compressor, maximizing the response speed and energy efficiency of the heat pump system, mitigating room temperature fluctuations, avoiding frequent frequency adjustments, and reducing the activation of standby boilers, thereby optimizing the operating efficiency and stability of the heating system.

title: A carbon assessment method and system applicable to the entire life cycle of electronic products
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of carbon assessment, and discloses a carbon assessment method applicable to the entire life cycle of an electronic product. The method comprises: S1, determining the carbon accounting items at each stage in the manufacturing of the electronic product to be assessed; S2, collecting corresponding data sets of the carbon accounting items at each stage according to the carbon accounting items at each stage; S3, calculating the carbon emissions of the electronic product to be assessed during its life cycle; S4, performing analysis and result interpretation based on the carbon emissions of the electronic product to be assessed during its life cycle, and generating output data, wherein the output data comprises carbon emission reduction, carbon neutrality paths and suggestions during the entire life cycle of the electronic product to be assessed, and using the output data as input parameters for green carbon design, and optimizing the green carbon design process of the electronic product according to the input parameters.

title: Knowledge graph-based equipment fault prediction method and system
description: This invention discloses a knowledge graph-based method and system for equipment fault prediction, belonging to the field of equipment fault prediction technology. The method includes preprocessing historical equipment fault data and equipment topology and attribute data; defining entity nodes and relation edges in the knowledge graph to form a structured knowledge graph; preprocessing basic data during equipment operation and extracting time-frequency and trend features; inputting these features into a residual convolutional network for feature extraction; outputting basic feature vectors; simultaneously using the residual convolutional network to predict the basic data and calculate basic residuals; and normalizing the absolute value of the basic residuals to obtain sensor anomaly scores. This invention integrates equipment topology, component attributes, historical fault experience, and real-time sensor data into a unified knowledge graph, achieving integrated modeling of the semantic and data layers.

title: Multi-mode-fusion intelligent closed-loop system for monitoring, evaluating and controlling aquaculture water
description: This invention relates to the field of aquaculture, specifically to a multimodal fusion intelligent closed-loop system for monitoring, evaluating, and regulating aquaculture water bodies. The system includes a data processing module, a mapping module, a water quality analysis module, a scoring module, an evaluation module, and a regulation module. The data processing module acquires historical monitoring data and constructs training samples. The mapping module builds parameter correlation graphs. The water quality analysis module includes a water quality analysis model to obtain predicted values of various parameters for aquaculture water bodies during a preset period. The scoring module calculates seasonal scores. The evaluation module queries an evaluation level table to obtain the evaluation level corresponding to the seasonal score. If the evaluation level is excellent or good, routine maintenance is performed; otherwise, a regulation command is sent to the regulation module. The regulation module makes regulatory decisions for the aquaculture water bodies. Accurate evaluation based on seasonal characteristics helps improve the accuracy of risk warnings.

title: Machine learning enhanced silver-based covalent organic framework nanoenzyme colorimetric detection method and application thereof
description: The invention discloses a machine learning enhanced silver-based covalent organic framework nano enzyme colorimetric detection method and application thereof, and constructs a nano enzyme with oxide-like enzyme activity formed by loading silver nano particles on a covalent organic framework, which is used for rapid visual detection of mercury ions. When mercury ions exist, the silver ions in the COF-AgNPs can form silver amalgam with the mercury ions, so that colorless substrate 3,3', 5' -tetramethyl benzidine is catalyzed to generate blue oxidation products oxTMB. And judging the mercury content by detecting the absorbance and RGB value change of ‌ ‌ color reaction. Meanwhile, a machine learning data analysis strategy of a support vector machine model is adopted to carry out five-fold layered cross validation analysis on the obtained absorbance value and RGB value, so that the detection range is enlarged, and the detection sensitivity is improved.

title: Multi-mode knowledge dynamic recommendation method and system based on knowledge enhancement
description: The present invention belongs to the field of intelligent recommendation technology, and relates to a multimodal knowledge dynamic recommendation method and system based on knowledge enhancement. The present invention obtains the multimodal feature tensor of the project; fuses the multimodal feature tensor in combination with the attention coefficient of the modality to obtain a multimodal feature fusion vector; generates an entity embedding vector based on the domain knowledge graph and the graph attention network; obtains the current user interest state based on the multimodal feature fusion vector and the entity embedding vector, and obtains the interest prediction based on the current user interest state, the multimodal feature fusion vector, the bias vector, the weight matrix and the nonlinear activation function; if the interest prediction is greater than or equal to the adaptive recommendation threshold, the project is recommended to the user, otherwise it is not recommended; and generates a recommendation path explanation based on the recommendation results of multiple projects. The present invention significantly improves the accuracy and explainability of long-tail content recommendations through knowledge-guided multimodal semantic fusion.

title: Data integration method of full-automatic production mode
description: The invention discloses a data integration method of a full-automatic production mode, which relates to the field of industrial automation and comprises the steps of collecting multisource data by using APACHE NIFI, preprocessing to obtain a multisource characteristic data set, constructing a fault prediction model based on a deep neural network DNN, outputting a fault prediction value, setting an early warning threshold value, comparing the early warning threshold value with the fault prediction value, defining an early warning rule, setting intelligent early warning by using a Django framework, carrying out early warning notification, and analyzing the multisource characteristic data set by using APACHE SPARK to generate a visual report. According to the invention, the APACHE NIFI is used for collecting and preprocessing the multi-source data, so that the standardization and feature extraction of the data are realized, and the data processing efficiency is effectively improved.

title: Context awareness-based API intelligent test method
description: The application provides an API intelligent test method based on context awareness, which relates to the technical field of software test and comprises the steps of constructing a system context corpus by loading structured data such as API interface documents, parameter dependence tables and the like and unstructured data such as business rules, user manuals and the like. According to a natural language test target input by a user, a test plan comprising calling sequence, parameter dependence and state change is generated by combining a context, and further a state-aware API calling sequence is generated, and intelligent fuzzification processing is carried out on the parameters to form a test load. And executing the load, capturing the response, analyzing and identifying the loopholes or the anomalies, dynamically adjusting the test strategy based on the results, forming closed loop feedback, performing iterative execution until the termination condition is met, and finally outputting a test report.

title: Aquaculture cage damage monitoring method based on multi-sensor information fusion
description: The invention provides a culture net cage damage monitoring method based on multi-sensor information fusion, which comprises the following steps of 1, establishing an equivalent numerical model of a net cage according to the size of a gravity deepwater type net cage, 2, dividing the net cage into 8 areas, 3, carrying out simulation on tensile force and acceleration signals of complete and damage working conditions of a net by utilizing the equivalent numerical model of the culture net cage, 4, establishing a neural network damage monitoring model based on a CNN neural network, training the neural network damage monitoring model by utilizing an obtained simulation data set, 5, obtaining basic probability assignment m  A  and m  B  of each group of sensors through the neural network damage monitoring model, 6, synthesizing BPA basic probability assignment m  A  and m  B  of any two groups of sensors into new evidence C by using a Dempster synthesis rule, fusing the areas, and judging the state of the net according to the basic probability assignment m   Region(s) n  of the final comprehensive evidence C.

title: Safety assessment method and system for spherical tooth tip blades based on data analysis
description: The present invention discloses a data analysis-based safety assessment method and system for spherical tooth tip blades, relating to the field of cutting processing technology. The method involves collecting blade surface morphology, microscopic lattice structure, and cutting dynamic load data using white light interferometry, EBSD, and a dynamometer; establishing a macroscopic finite element model and embedding it into a microscopic crystal plasticity submodel; matching macroscopic and microscopic stress fields, calculating the lattice orientation conversion matrix and Schmid factor, and extracting slip system characteristic parameters; determining crack initiation, calculating the propagation path in combination with anisotropy criteria, and reconstructing the three-dimensional crack morphology; calculating the cumulative damage factor, classifying three levels of safety thresholds, and outputting a visual report and life prediction value. By establishing a coupling equation for the macroscopic stress field and microscopic crystal orientation, the present invention integrates the mechanical response characteristics of the material at different scales, improving the physical authenticity of crack initiation and propagation predictions.

title: A LiDAR Saturation Waveform Reconstruction Method Based on Hybrid Neural Network
description: The application provides a laser radar saturated waveform reconstruction method based on a hybrid neural network, which comprises the steps of carrying out normalization processing on laser radar full waveform data, traversing by using a sliding window with fixed length, extracting sub waveform segments with larger amplitude sum in the sliding window, respectively extracting local mutation features and global morphological features of each sub waveform segment by utilizing a double-branch convolution network, fusing the extracted features by utilizing a multi-head attention fusion network, detecting abnormal sub waveform segments and corresponding saturated sampling points, establishing a reconstruction network together based on an encoder structure and a residual convolution structure, reconstructing amplitude values of the saturated sampling points to obtain reconstructed sub waveform segments, inserting the reconstructed sub waveform segments into corresponding positions of the laser radar full waveform data after normalization processing, and carrying out inverse normalization operation to obtain the reconstructed full waveform data. The method has high recognition accuracy and small reconstruction error, and can remarkably improve the range accuracy of the laser radar and the usability of waveform data.

title: A model training data construction method and system based on minimum training step coverage frequency
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of model data analysis and processing, and in particular to a method and system for constructing model training data based on minimum training step coverage frequency. The method comprises the following steps: a training configuration input step: receiving basic parameters of a training task; a sample quantity inversion step: based on the input basic parameters, calling a preset formula to reversely calculate the minimum number of samples and the minimum sample proportion that each type of sample should have; a sample configuration output step: writing the reverse calculation results into a sample construction configuration file to guide the selection and generation of subsequent training sample data; a monitoring and verification step: monitoring the actual step coverage frequency of each type of sample; then comparing the coverage frequency with a set target frequency to determine whether the sample of this type meets the training target frequency; if not, outputting a prompt message. The present invention solves technical problems such as unscientific sample configuration, uncontrollable training effect, and insufficient frequency of small class samples in existing fine-tuning tasks.

title: Electrified railway contact network insulator defect detection method, system, equipment and medium based on enhanced YOLOv10
description: The invention provides an electrified railway catenary insulator defect detection method, system, equipment and medium based on an enhanced YOLOv, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting catenary insulator images of a target scene through a shooting device and automatic inspection equipment, marking catenary insulators and defects in the catenary insulator images by using a marking tool, dividing the marked images into a training set and a verification set according to a preset proportion, carrying out model training based on the training set and the verification set, introducing a lightweight EFFICIENTVIT module, a phase-IoU loss function and a knowledge distillation technology in the training process to obtain a catenary insulator defect detection model based on YOLOv, and inputting the obtained to-be-detected catenary insulator images into the catenary insulator defect detection model to obtain a defect detection result. The method improves the accuracy and efficiency of insulator defect detection.

title: A long-sequence abnormal behavior detection system and detection method based on spatiotemporal characteristics
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision and artificial intelligence, and particularly relates to a long-sequence abnormal behavior detection system and a detection method thereof based on space-time characteristics. The feature extraction module is respectively connected with the detection head and the optical flow estimation head of the optical flow guiding module, the detection head is respectively connected with the ROI extraction module I and the ROI extraction module II, the ROI extraction module I is connected with the image block of the identification network module, the ROI extraction module II is connected with the optical flow block of the identification network module, and the optical flow estimation head of the optical flow guiding module is respectively connected with the time sequence feature buffer and the ROI extraction module II. The method is used for solving the problems that the application effect of the existing algorithm in examination room monitoring is limited, and optimization is needed to adapt to complex monitoring environments and improve detection accuracy.

title: Visual fault diagnosis method, system, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a visual fault diagnosis method, system, electronic device, and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining fault information of a target operation scenario through an augmented reality device; transmitting the fault information to an internal server through a router; performing AI reasoning based on the fault information through the internal server to obtain a fault handling solution; and transmitting the fault handling solution to an augmented reality device through a router for visual processing. The embodiment of the present invention uses a closed-loop transmission architecture of augmented reality device-router-server to compress the end-to-end delay from fault information collection to solution return, significantly improving the response speed compared to traditional manual processing modes. The embodiment of the present invention can efficiently implement visual fault diagnosis and can be widely used in the field of data processing technology.

title: Multi-hardware collaborative sensing and storing integrated intelligent image processing architecture and method
description: This invention discloses a multi-hardware collaborative intelligent image processing architecture and method integrating sensing, storage, and computing, belonging to the field of edge artificial intelligence hardware and intelligent image processing technology. It includes: an MPU module, an FPGA module, and an RRAM module, tightly coupled and collaboratively connected via high-speed on-board or on-chip interconnects. The MPU module is responsible for image sensor control, system collaborative management, and nonlinear domain computation in the neural network. The FPGA module is responsible for pipeline preprocessing of image data acquired by the image sensor and control of the RRAM module. The RRAM module is responsible for analog domain multiplication and accumulation computation of the preprocessed image data in the convolutional and fully connected layers of the neural network. Through an architecture-level task mapping strategy, this invention ensures recognition accuracy while balancing processing speed and system energy consumption, providing a high-performance, high-reliability technical solution for intelligent sensing systems in resource-constrained scenarios.

title: Image restoration methods, apparatuses, electronic devices, storage media, and software products
description: The embodiment of the application provides an image restoration method, an image restoration device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an image to be processed, carrying out multi-granularity segmentation processing on the image to be processed based on a super-pixel segmentation technology to obtain a plurality of segmented images to be processed, carrying out noise recognition processing on the image to be processed according to a plurality of image blocks included in each segmented image to be processed to obtain a noise recognition processing result, and generating a plurality of noise mask images according to the noise recognition processing result and the image to be processed, wherein each noise mask image indicates different granularity, the granularity indicated by the noise mask image corresponds to the granularity indicated by the segmented image to be processed, and carrying out noise restoration processing on the image to be processed according to the plurality of noise mask images to obtain a restored image to be processed. The method is used for achieving the effect of improving the accuracy of image restoration.

title: Hand-held product six-side finishing state judging method based on cross visual angle image fusion
description: The invention provides a hand-held product six-side finishing state judging method based on cross visual angle image fusion, which relates to the technical field of data processing, and comprises the steps of calculating a sight vector of an O point pointing to the center of a pupil based on the pupil coordinate and a space consistency coordinate; calculating the axial vector of the product body of the O point pointing to each datum point based on X, Y, Z point coordinates, calculating azimuth angle and pitch angle characteristic quantity based on sight line vector and axial vector, dividing quadrants through a space cutting algorithm, obtaining a detected surface result by combining a preset space azimuth mapping rule, activating a corresponding accumulator based on the detected surface result, accumulating continuous detected time length and comparing the continuous detected time length with a preset threshold value, generating a finishing signal when the threshold value is reached, and otherwise, triggering an audible and visual alarm. The invention improves the detection reliability and the result reliability under the complex operation scene.

title: Internet of vehicles broadcast frame radio frequency fingerprint identification method based on LMMSE channel estimation
description: The invention provides an LMMSE channel estimation-based radio frequency fingerprint identification method of a vehicle networking broadcast frame, which comprises the steps of obtaining subcarrier data in a resource grid based on an acquired signal of a physical side link broadcast channel, carrying out root mean square delay expansion and channel autocorrelation matrix construction based on the subcarrier data, obtaining a channel estimation value by combining priori signal-to-noise ratio regularization and time domain windowing operation, obtaining initial radio frequency fingerprint characteristics through the channel equalization and the channel estimation value, and carrying out classification identification on vehicle networking equipment by utilizing an improved neural network and the initial radio frequency fingerprint characteristics. The influence of noise and channels on fingerprints is effectively considered, and the purpose of extracting fingerprints of different devices in a complex environment more accurately is achieved.

title: Robot control method, device, system and medium based on diffusion model
description: The present invention relates to the field of data processing technology, and specifically to a robot manipulation method, device, system and medium based on a diffusion model. The method comprises: collecting index finger end position information and state information of a flexible linear object during a human hand teaching process to construct a training sample; using a diffusion model to train the training sample, and learning the mapping from a high-noise state to a clear target state through a noise prediction network in the training diffusion model to obtain a trained diffusion model; the training process of the diffusion model comprises forward noise addition and reverse denoising; collecting the state of the flexible linear object and the end position of a robotic arm to construct a current observation environment, inputting the current observation environment into the trained diffusion model, generating a target action sequence, and controlling the robotic arm to perform manipulation actions based on the target action sequence; the present invention can improve the accuracy and real-time performance of the robot's manipulation of the flexible linear object.

title: Steel marking area detection model based on improvement YOLOv and training method thereof
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of steel surface detection, and in particular to a steel marking area detection model based on an improved YOLOv7 and a training method thereof. The following technical scheme is adopted: comprising a backbone network module and a detection head module, the backbone network module comprising four MCBS modules, four MELAN modules and three MP‑1 modules, and the detection head module comprising an AXA module, an MLCA module, an SPPCSPC module, a MELAN module, an MCBS module, an upsampling module, a REP module and a CBM module. The beneficial effect is that by improving the existing YOLOv7 model, on the one hand, by structurally optimizing and replacing the CBS module in the model, while retaining the effective feature extraction capability, the model calculation amount is significantly compressed, thereby reducing the computational complexity of the model; on the other hand, by introducing the axial attention (AXA) module and the mixed local channel attention module (MLCA), the model's ability to focus on key feature areas is enhanced, thereby improving target recognition performance in complex scenarios.

title: Method for improving model picture recognition capability based on multi-mode large model
description: The present invention discloses a method for improving the model's image recognition ability based on a multimodal large model, which relates to the field of image recognition technology. The method includes building a basic architecture of a multimodal large model, and using a large number of images to train the multimodal large model as a basic model; collecting newly added images, and preparing corresponding standard questions and answers describing the image content in combination with the images; and designing corresponding instructions, i.e., prompt words, according to the requirements of the image recognition task, to guide the large model to perform image recognition. The multimodal large model of the present invention uses a large number of images for training. When applied to the field of image recognition, the image feature library of the multimodal large model can be fully utilized to optimize the accuracy of the image recognition technology. Moreover, by using fine-tuning training of the multimodal large model, the order of magnitude of training images can be greatly reduced. After performing composite fine-tuning training, the multimodal large model can have the ability to generalize the recognition of the trained images, which can greatly reduce the number of images required for training.

title: Green ammonia reactor state detection model training method, device, equipment and medium
description: The invention provides a training method, a training device, training equipment and training media for a state detection model of a green ammonia reactor, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and data processing, comprising the steps of obtaining sample data in the running process of at least one green ammonia reactor; the method comprises the steps of carrying out sectional normalization on vibration data according to temperature data and a temperature interval to which the temperature data belong for each sample data to obtain normalized vibration data, inputting the normalized vibration data into a feature extraction module to obtain a time domain feature vector and a frequency domain feature vector for each normalized vibration data, inputting the time domain feature vector and the frequency domain feature vector corresponding to each normalized vibration data into an initial state detection model, and training the initial state detection model to obtain a state detection model. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can eliminate the influence of temperature on the time-frequency domain feature extraction result, and the time-frequency domain features are used for participating in training together, so that the accuracy of the model training result is improved.

title: Geochemical remote sensing image recognition method, device, equipment, medium and program product
description: The present application provides a geochemical remote sensing image recognition method, device, equipment, medium and program product, which can be applied to the field of geochemical exploration and remote sensing image processing technology to solve the technical problem of improving the efficiency of geochemical remote sensing image recognition. The geochemical remote sensing image recognition method includes: in response to obtaining a hyperspectral image, inputting the hyperspectral image into a remote sensing image recognition model to obtain a remote sensing image recognition result. The remote sensing image recognition model outputs a downsampled feature map based on the activation function operation, performs a cross-scale feature fusion operation on the downsampled feature map, and splices it with the feature map of the upsampling operation layer at the same level. By embedding FPN at different levels, cross-scale feature fusion is achieved, which is suitable for the characteristics of the multi-scale characteristics of mineral distribution in geochemical remote sensing, such as the macroscopic morphology of the vein and the microscopic spectral details. It enhances the fusion effect of multi-source data, can effectively avoid the missed detection of weak signals, and improves the accuracy of recognition.

title: A method for predicting the remaining life of lithium batteries based on a large model with multi-feature fusion
description: This application provides a method for predicting the remaining life of lithium batteries based on a multi-feature fusion large model, relating to the field of lithium battery health management and life prediction. The method includes: segmenting the original data using a sliding window technique and constructing a key health indicator soft measurement module using a Kaplan-Alphabet (KAN) to transform the original data into key indicators characterizing the battery's health status; concatenating the lithium battery data and key indicators to form fused features, inputting them into a large language model (LLM) to construct a fused feature prediction module; obtaining future fused features through pre-trained word embedding, multi-head attention mechanism, and natural language prefix prompts; and inputting the future fused features into a sparsed KAN to construct a remaining life prediction model. A regression relationship is established between the model and the remaining battery life, enabling real-time prediction of the remaining lithium battery life. This method is applicable to lithium battery status monitoring and maintenance decisions in scenarios such as electric vehicles and energy storage systems.

title: A High-Relevance Recommendation Method for Knowledge Question Answering Based on Large-Model Semantic Enhancement
description: The invention relates to the technical field of knowledge question and answer, in particular to a knowledge question and answer high-relevance recommendation method based on large-model semantic enhancement, which comprises the steps of obtaining a query question proposed by a user, and converting the query question into a query semantic vector by using a large language model; the method comprises the steps of optimizing an index graph construction process of a problem vector library by utilizing a HNSW algorithm to obtain an optimized HNSW graph, converting all problems in a knowledge base into problem vectors by a large language model, carrying out ANN search in the optimized HNSW graph to obtain the problems with high relevance to query semantic vectors, feeding back the problems to a user in a recommendation mode, and constructing the optimized HNSW graph to enable a generated graph structure to better reflect the internal relevance of domain knowledge and improve the overall quality and user experience of related problem recommendation in a knowledge question-answering system.

title: An RFID warehouse inventory system and method integrating Q-learning algorithm and dynamic power adjustment
description: The invention relates to the technical field of warehouse inventory, in particular to an RFID warehouse inventory system and method integrating a Q learning algorithm and dynamic power adjustment, wherein the system comprises a reading device, a storage environment and a storage control unit, wherein the reading device moves in the warehouse environment and comprises an environment sensing unit, a storage control unit and a storage control unit, wherein the environment sensing unit is used for acquiring environment sensing parameters reflecting the spatial position relation between the reading device and an article to be checked; and the multi-antenna radio frequency identification unit is used for transmitting radio frequency signals and receiving tag response signals so as to identify tag identity information and extract signal characteristic parameters representing signal propagation characteristics. The RFID warehouse counting system and method integrating the Q learning algorithm and the dynamic power adjustment effectively solve the problem that static parameters are difficult to adapt to complex warehouse environments in the traditional RFID warehouse counting technology, and realize real-time perception and intelligent decision on warehouse scenes by integrating the Q learning algorithm and the dynamic power adjustment mechanism.

title: Image classification method for depression based on multimodal dynamic graph convolutional neural network
description: A depression image classification method based on a multi-modal dynamic graph convolution neural network belongs to the field of medical image processing and artificial intelligence, a sliding time window method is utilized to divide a time sequence after functional magnetic resonance data preprocessing into a plurality of time windows, a functional connection matrix of each window is constructed, a plurality of spatial attention contrast networks are utilized to capture time information of cross-time windows, a high-order dynamic functional brain network is obtained, and complementary information transfer and modal fusion among modes are realized by utilizing a cross-modal graph neural network and cross-modal knowledge distillation. The invention can fully utilize the dynamic high-order information of the multi-mode brain network to realize the effective classification of depression.

title: Multi-model-based prediction method and system for molecular level composition of petrochemical production stream
description: This application relates to a method and system for predicting the molecular-level composition of petrochemical production streams based on multiple models, belonging to the field of molecular management technology in refining and chemical engineering. The method includes: determining the molecular composition of raw materials; constructing a digital molecular structure topology by assembling structural units based on a structural unit-bond-electric matrix framework; constructing a molecular composition model by combining a pre-set molecular database, probability density function, and molecular property predictor; establishing a molecular-level reaction network based on the catalytic reforming reaction mechanism and constructing a molecular-level reaction kinetic model by combining the reaction rate expression; constructing a reactor model based on mass, energy, and momentum transfer equations; constructing deactivation and separation unit models; sequentially coupling multiple models to generate a full-process reaction-separation molecular-level prediction model, predicting the molecular-level composition of any stream. This invention solves the problem of operational lag in traditional petrochemical production, which relies on measurement results to adjust process parameters. By predicting the molecular composition of streams, this lag can be eliminated, improving the accuracy of production control.

title: IoT-based intelligent identification method for medical devices
description: The invention provides an intelligent medical instrument identification method based on the Internet of things, which comprises the steps of generating a current-stage instrument demand set by utilizing an instrument demand identification model through acquiring real-time operation progress information of an operation area, and optimizing the specification. Adding the optimized set to a historical instrument demand atlas, updating the atlas, combining with historical global instrument demand change information, extracting a historical set with a time interval smaller than a preset time length from the atlas, and inputting the historical set into an instrument demand change prediction model to obtain instrument demand change information. And comparing the history with the predicted instrument demand change information, determining the difference, generating real-time instrument demand change information, and finally displaying an instrument list to be prepared on the terminal of the Internet of things. The invention can improve the accuracy and efficiency of surgical instrument supply, reduce the surgical risk and improve the overall management level of an operating room.

title: Three-dimensional Chirplet time-frequency analysis method for bidirectional sparse search
description: This invention discloses a three-dimensional Chirplet time-frequency analysis method based on bidirectional sparse search, belonging to the field of signal processing and acoustic target recognition technology. The method includes: acquiring the non-stationary multi-component signal to be analyzed and performing a three-dimensional Chirplet transform on it to obtain a three-dimensional time-frequency-chirple joint feature map that integrates time, frequency, and chirp rate features; selecting several initialization candidate points in the three-dimensional time-frequency-chirp joint feature map and performing forward and backward path searches on them to obtain sparse ridge trajectories; extracting sparse ridge components based on the sparse ridge trajectories; updating the residual signal energy of the three-dimensional time-frequency-chirp joint feature map based on the sparse ridge components; and outputting a time-domain representation that integrates all sparse ridge components. This method is applicable to sparse feature extraction and component separation of non-stationary multi-component signals, effectively suppressing cross-interference and background noise, and improving the signal structure identification capability and reconstruction accuracy.

title: Setting detection method and system based on five people
description: This invention relates to the field of stance assessment technology, and discloses a method and system for stance detection based on the Big Five personality traits. The method includes: constructing a high-frequency keyword dictionary of stances, and then filtering core users based on the number of text entries, text content relevance, and a set threshold; constructing a prompt template based on the core users' texts and the Big Five personality scale, using a large language model to assess the personality traits of the core users, and outputting the personality feature vector of the core users; extracting continuous stance scores of users through the large language model and stance bias template; constructing a sparse matrix of user behavior based on the core users' interaction behavior, and using singular value decomposition to obtain the embedding of user behavior features, and generating topic distribution features based on user texts; and constructing a heterogeneous feature vector and a stance prediction model to predict the stances of non-core users. This invention significantly improves the adaptability and reliability of implicit stance detection in social media environments.

title: AI appearance defect identification method for multiple acquisition terminals
description: The invention discloses an AI appearance defect identification method of a plurality of acquisition terminals, belongs to the technical field of product appearance detection, aims at solving the problems that in the existing AI visual detection, single-terminal images are easy to miss, the positions of the defects of the plurality of acquisition terminals are not uniform and the confidence is inconsistent, and manual intervention is required, and aims to improve defect identification accuracy and position accuracy. The method comprises the steps of constructing an appearance defect, image cutting, image fusion and defect judgment weight model, collecting surface images of a product through multiple terminals, dividing different surfaces of the product by utilizing the image cutting model, identifying defect information of each image by the appearance defect model, merging the same defects on the same surface based on an image fusion algorithm, and calculating final confidence of the merged defects according to the defect judgment weight model to determine final defects. According to the method and the device, through multi-terminal image fusion and weight confidence coefficient calculation, the problem of non-uniform defect positions of the multi-terminal is solved, repeated identification is reduced, manual confirmation is not needed, and detection efficiency and accuracy are effectively improved.

title: Pathogenic microorganism detection system based on nanopore sequencing and intelligent interpretation
description: The invention discloses a pathogenic microorganism detection system based on nanopore sequencing and intelligent interpretation, which comprises six modules, namely a biomolecule electric signal acquisition module and a pathogenic characteristic sequence extraction module. The method comprises the steps of collecting ion current change signals through a nanopore chip array, extracting pathogen feature sequences through differential encoding, establishing a pathogen relation model by utilizing a hypergraph topological structure self-adaptive construction module, integrating multidimensional parameters such as morphology, metabonomics and the like by a multidimensional heterogeneous pathogen parameter fusion analysis module, realizing pathogen category prediction by an optimized hypergraph neural network reasoning module, and finally generating a detection report containing pathogen categories, subtypes and risk grades by a nanopore sequencing result intelligent interpretation output module. The system combines nanopore sequencing and an intelligent algorithm, can efficiently and accurately complete pathogen microorganism detection, greatly improves the accuracy, reliability and efficiency of detection, and meets the requirement of rapid and accurate pathogen detection in practical application.

title: AR/VR/MR-based AD rehabilitation training methods, devices, equipment, and media
description: This invention provides an AD rehabilitation training method, device, equipment, and medium based on AR/VR/MR. The method includes: a user-initiated rehabilitation training request accessing the user's historical training dataset; obtaining the user's training data within a preset time period based on the historical training dataset, generating a user cognitive feature vector, inputting the user cognitive feature vector into a pre-constructed neural network model, enabling the neural network model to perform second-order feature extraction on the user cognitive feature vector, and outputting a training scenario difficulty decision result; obtaining a collection of training scenario information corresponding to the user's lowest training score within the preset time period, randomly selecting from the training scenario information collection according to a preset index, and generating a training scenario type decision result; and generating a rehabilitation training plan based on the training scenario difficulty decision result and the training scenario type decision result. This invention can realize the personalized and dynamic generation of rehabilitation training plans, improving the effectiveness of rehabilitation training plans.

title: A method for extracting parasitic parameters of on-chip calibration components based on particle swarm optimization algorithm
description: The invention discloses an on-chip calibration piece parasitic parameter extraction method based on a particle swarm algorithm, which comprises the steps of calculating a transmission line propagation constant to be measured through a TRL, calculating a transmission line capacitance to be measured through a direct current resistance and a reflection coefficient of a calibration piece, establishing a calibration piece parasitic parameter equivalent circuit model, calculating a real scattered parameter of the calibration piece according to the parasitic parameter, calculating 12 error items according to the real scattered parameter of the calibration piece and a measured value of the scattered parameter, setting an objective function as a constraint condition to enable a calibration value of the transmission line to be measured to approach the real scattered parameter of the transmission line to be measured, optimizing the parasitic parameter through the particle swarm algorithm, and outputting a group of optimal parasitic parameters. According to the method, the real scattering parameters of the transmission line model are calculated through modeling, and the particle swarm algorithm is utilized, so that the transmission line parameters after calibration approach the real values of the transmission line parameters as targets for optimizing the parasitic parameters, and the accuracy of the parasitic parameters of the calibration piece is effectively ensured.

title: Distillation-evolutionary optical core-guided intelligent cutting, sewing, and ironing robotic systems and equipment
description: The invention discloses a distillation evolution optical core navigation intelligent cutting, sewing and ironing robot system and equipment, which comprise a cutting module, a sewing module, an ironing module, a model module, a navigation module and a driving module, wherein the model module is mainly responsible for model generation, memorization, storage and modification of cutting, sewing, ironing and driving of various materials, the navigation module is mainly used for generating navigation models and instruction information, including positioning, planning, control and decision and reasoning, building and logic generation and control of workflow, the driving module is mainly responsible for generating a driving model and providing driving force for each module of the system, each module can independently form a subsystem, and each module can be mutually combined or fused to form various novel robot systems and equipment. The invention has the advantages of improving the automation, intellectualization and precision level of cutting, sewing and ironing, safely guiding, reducing energy consumption, helping hand unmanned system development and innovation, breaking through the bottleneck of space calculation and improving the efficiency of space communication.

title: Optimal modulation method and system for high-capacity direct-current interconnected electric energy conversion cluster
description: This invention discloses an optimal modulation method and system for large-capacity DC-DC interconnected power conversion clusters, belonging to the fields of power electronics conversion and new energy technology. The method includes: analyzing the coupling mechanism of pulse current on the DC side within the cluster, and constructing a global optimization model with the goal of minimizing DC bus current ripple; collecting the modulation index and cluster circuit parameter data of each converter in the large-capacity DC-DC interconnected power conversion cluster at the current moment; solving the model using a gradient descent algorithm based on the acquired data to obtain the optimal switching pulse sequence combination of the converter cluster at the current sampling moment; adjusting the modulation index value in the global optimization model based on the modulation index data at the sampling moment, and calculating the optimal pulse sequence within the modulation index deviation range to control the modulation of the switching pulses of each converter. This invention can significantly suppress DC-side current ripple and avoid dependence on large-capacity passive filtering devices.

title: Method for distributing building water retaining measures under typhoon flood in long-period regional scale
description: The invention discloses a method for distributing building water retaining measures under typhoon flood with long period area scale, which comprises the steps of constructing a typhoon rainfall model of a research area to obtain a typhoon rainfall event library with a perpetual scale, constructing a training data set required by a typhoon rainfall-waterlogging maximum inundation proxy model, constructing the typhoon rainfall-waterlogging maximum inundation proxy model fusing a convolutional neural network and a gate control circulation unit, determining urban building water retaining measure types and cost benefit parameters, extracting all events with reproduction periods smaller than a decision threshold, establishing an optimization model of an area scale measure planning decision problem, expanding multi-objective optimization of minimum loss and minimum cost, solving the optimization model of the area scale measure planning decision problem to obtain a combined optimization solution of area disaster reduction measures, and making disaster reduction planning according to actual conditions. The invention realizes the cost-benefit optimization of different disaster reduction measure combinations in the regional scale, and provides scientific basis and decision support for the configuration of pre-disaster waterlogging prevention measures.

title: Glacier surface snow identification method using time series optics and SAR data
description: This invention discloses a method for identifying snow cover on glaciers using time-series optical and SAR data. It generates monthly cloud-free NDSI composite images; constructs a spatiotemporally distributed binary training sample set of wet and non-wet snow; builds a monthly-scale wet snow distribution prediction model based on a convolutional neural network for spatiotemporal feature learning; obtains monthly wet snow distribution maps for the corresponding year; calculates and generates an annual wet snow cover frequency distribution map for the glacier surface; combines the backscattering coefficient characteristics of time-series SAR images, establishes a dynamic calculation model for the wet snow discrimination threshold of SAR images by statistically analyzing the backscattering coefficient distribution of time-series SAR images, and extracts the wet snow distribution from multi-temporal SAR images; for the residual areas outside the obtained wet snow distribution areas, it extracts topographic aspect parameters using a digital elevation model, and constructs classification constraints based on seasonal snow cover characteristics to achieve refined differentiation between dry snow and glacial ice. This invention improves the automation and accuracy of snow cover classification in high-altitude areas.

title: Sugarcane tillering rotating target detection method based on deep learning
description: This invention provides a deep learning-based method for detecting rotating sugarcane tillers, belonging to the field of sugarcane detection technology. The method involves labeling the number of tillers in collected sugarcane data to obtain an original image set; preprocessing and enhancing the original image set using a multi-dimensional enhancement strategy to obtain training samples; constructing a rotating target detection model; training the rotating target detection model using a custom detection head module to obtain a trained rotating target detection model; and analyzing multimodal sugarcane data using the trained rotating target detection model to obtain the detection results of rotating sugarcane tillers, thus completing the detection of rotating sugarcane tillers. This invention solves the problems of easy false detection, low efficiency, and poor environmental adaptability in existing technologies.

title: Video encoding method, computer device, apparatus, and computer readable medium
description: Video encoding using neural network-based inter prediction is performed by generating a current reference frame by generating an intermediate stream based on two input frames, performing backward deformation of the input frames to generate a reconstructed frame, and generating a fusion map and a residual map based on the input frames, the intermediate stream, and the reconstructed frame. The video encoding method further includes outputting an enhanced frame or a virtual reference picture by generating feature maps having different levels based on the current reference frame, the first reference frame, and the second reference frame, generating a predicted frame based on alignment features from the generated feature maps by refining the current reference frame, the first reference frame, and the second reference frame, generating a final residual based on the predicted frame, and calculating the enhanced frame as an output by adding the final residual to the current reference frame.

title: Distributed transducer training acceleration framework in federal learning
description: This patent discloses a distributed transducer training acceleration framework in federal learning. The model training speed based on the transducer is relatively slow and is mainly limited in calculation and communication. According to the scheme, dynamic model segmentation is introduced, a transducer model is dynamically cut according to data distribution on local equipment, so that the calculation complexity of each equipment is reduced, an intelligent task scheduling strategy ensures that each equipment can effectively participate in global model training and fully utilizes computer resources of the equipment, hierarchical communication optimization reduces communication expenditure, safety and privacy are guaranteed by transmitting key information and adopting asynchronous communication and differential privacy, the system further comprises model fusion acceleration, local equipment is allowed to locally complete partial model training, model weight updating is quickly fused into a global model, and a self-adaptive learning rate adjustment mechanism dynamically adjusts learning rate according to training progress of each equipment and model convergence conditions, so that training rate is improved.

title: Model reasoning acceleration method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: This invention provides a method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium for accelerating model inference, relating to the field of computer technology. The method includes: acquiring weight data of a target model; the weight data being in a first floating-point format; converting the weight data from the first floating-point format to a second floating-point format to obtain quantized weight data; the second floating-point format having lower precision than the first floating-point format; loading the quantized weight data and converting it back from the second floating-point format to the first floating-point format to obtain dequantized weight data; and performing an inference task on the target model based on the dequantized weight data. The method and apparatus provided by this invention can significantly improve the inference efficiency of the model while ensuring that model performance is not affected.

title: Natural Language-Driven Situational Awareness Control Methods, Systems, and Media Based on Task Intent
