description: The invention discloses a natural language driving situation awareness control method, a system and a medium based on task intention, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence and man-machine interaction, generate a natural language template library and a task intention field table based on three-table knowledge, take the three-table knowledge as a construction basis, take the natural language template library and the task intention field table as a retrieval rearrangement tool to construct an interface-data dual-mapping knowledge map, then carry out semantic retrieval and reference resolution to generate structured intention data, analyze a user instruction into the task intention on the premise of not depending on a fixed layout, realize stable anchoring of an interface object by adopting semantic positioning, and automatically compile the task intention into a system API call or an interface event sequence, and simultaneously guarantee the execution availability and compliance through a trusted execution scoring and minimized clarified closed-loop mechanism, thereby effectively reducing the operation complexity and improving the response efficiency and intelligent interaction level of a situation awareness system.

title: Entity retrieval method and system based on retrieval words
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses an entity retrieval method and system based on retrieval words, the method comprises the steps of constructing a knowledge graph by utilizing a large model, constructing new retrieval words based on association relation among entities during construction, extracting problem key words by utilizing a large language model, matching the problem key words with the retrieval words constructed in the knowledge graph, inquiring the entities according to candidate retrieval words obtained by matching, and inquiring related knowledge graphs of the problems by the inquired entities.

title: Privacy protection method, medium and equipment based on federal learning clustering
description: The application discloses a privacy protection method, medium and equipment based on federal learning clustering, the method comprises the steps that a server initializes global model parameters, homomorphic encryption key pairs and zero knowledge proof public parameters, and model training is carried out through iterative communication rounds. In each round, the server samples the client and broadcasts parameters, the sampled client calculates local model update based on local untagged data, generates a first zero knowledge proof to confirm that the calculation process accords with a preset federal clustering algorithm rule after sparsification and homomorphic encryption, performs homomorphic aggregation on the encrypted update after the server verifies the first proof and generates a second zero knowledge proof to confirm that the aggregation operation accords with the preset rule, and finally, the server outputs an encrypted aggregation result and the second proof for decryption and updating of the global model after verification. The application realizes the bidirectional verifiability of client training and server aggregation, and effectively ensures the reliability and fairness of the federal clustering training process.

title: Neural network model training methods, oral and nasal airflow signal reconstruction methods and equipment
description: This invention provides a neural network model training method, a method and device for reconstructing nasal and oral airflow signals, and is applied in the field of radar signal processing. The method includes: acquiring multiple chest and abdominal motion signals collected by a millimeter-wave radar from a target object; processing these signals using a neural network model to obtain reconstructed nasal and oral airflow signals and apnea prediction results; calculating regression errors based on the reconstructed and actual nasal and oral airflow signals, and calculating apnea prediction errors based on the apnea prediction results and apnea labels; performing a weighted calculation based on the regression errors and apnea prediction errors to obtain an integration loss; and performing backpropagation and gradient updates on the neural network model based on the integration loss, and optimizing the model parameters. The nasal and oral airflow signals reconstructed by the neural network model of this invention are more refined, comprehensive, and accurate.

title: 3D task processing method and device based on cross-modal migration of image and text
description: The application relates to the technical field of computer vision and discloses a 3D task processing method and device based on cross-modal migration of image characters, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining 3D point cloud data to be processed for structuring processing to obtain an ordered point cloud mass set; the method comprises the steps of obtaining two-dimensional image data and/or text description data associated with 3D point cloud data, extracting image feature vectors and/or text feature vectors, carrying out unified serialization processing on ordered point cloud mass sets to generate a 3D point cloud feature sequence fusing multi-modal information, inputting the 3D point cloud feature sequence, the image feature vectors and the text feature vectors into a gating fusion module, dynamically adjusting weights of modal features and fusing, generating enhanced 3D feature representation, and executing 3D downstream tasks based on the enhanced 3D feature representation. The method and the device can improve the robustness, accuracy and generalization capability of the 3D downstream task in the data scarcity scene, and realize efficient and robust 3D scene understanding.

title: Method and system for optimizing cutting and welding process parameters of tab of soft-package battery
description: The invention provides a method and a system for optimizing technological parameters of cutting and welding of a tab of a soft-package battery, and relates to the technical field, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting cutting force data of tab cutting and cutter displacement track characteristics, and obtaining cutting characteristic parameters; the method comprises the steps of acquiring temperature gradient and current characteristics of a welding point, acquiring welding characteristic parameters, carrying out similarity calculation and importance weighting on characteristics of a source domain and a target domain by utilizing transfer learning, and iteratively optimizing process parameters based on reinforcement learning. The invention realizes the self-adaptive optimization of the tab cutting and welding process parameters, and improves the stability of the battery production quality.

title: A fine-grained 3D model classification method and system based on dynamic prototype learning
description: This invention proposes a fine-grained 3D model classification method and system based on dynamic prototype learning, belonging to the field of 3D geometric analysis technology. The method includes: performing multi-view orthogonal projection rendering on the 3D model; extracting and projecting features from the image sequences of each view after projection rendering based on an encoder, and fusing multi-view features; constructing a shared prototype pool and generating a prototype cost matrix; constructing a structured metric space by calculating the cosine similarity between the multi-view features and the prototype cost matrix, and performing dynamic soft allocation; sequentially executing a dynamic update strategy and joint loss optimization on the shared prototype pool; and achieving probabilistic decision-making for fine-grained categories by measuring the distance between the test sample features and the prototypes in the shared prototype pool. Therefore, this invention constructs a dynamic prototype learning framework with geometric awareness, which can overcome the accuracy bottleneck of fine-grained classification tasks by analyzing interpretable features and prototype mapping relationships.

title: A communication method and apparatus
description: A communication method and apparatus are disclosed. The method includes: an AF (Automatic Front-End) network element sending a first request, the first request including information about a first terminal and/or information about a first session; the AF network element receiving a first response, the first response being a response to the first request, the first response including information about the artificial intelligence (AI) service capabilities of a first network, the first network being a network accessed by the first terminal, and the first session being a communication session between the first terminal and a first server. Further, the AF network element can determine an AI computing assistance strategy based on the AI service capabilities of the first network. In this AI computing assistance strategy, AI computing functions located on the first terminal and/or the first server can be migrated to the first network element of the first network, thereby reducing the AI computing load on the first terminal and/or the first server.

title: Method and system for auditing bond product release document based on large model intelligent agent
description: This invention provides a method and system for reviewing bond product issuance documents based on a large-scale model (LLM) intelligent agent. The method includes the following steps: constructing an intelligent agent based on review rules to transform unstructured review knowledge into structured review rules and storing them in a prompt word library; generating content location information based on historical document statistics and storing it in a location library; acquiring the document to be reviewed and identifying the bond product type to match review points; retrieving rules and location information from the prompt word library and location library respectively according to the key points, and extracting relevant content fragments; combining rules and fragments to form dynamic prompt words, submitting them to a large-scale language model (LLM) for analysis, and outputting standardized review conclusions. The system includes modules for knowledge construction, database, document processing, content extraction, dynamic prompt word generation, and LLM processing, which can improve review efficiency and consistency while reducing maintenance costs.

title: Multi-dimensional studying decision system based on safety emergency multi-mode data
description: This invention discloses a multi-dimensional assessment and decision-making system based on multi-modal data for safety emergencies, belonging to the field of public safety emergency decision-making technology. The system includes: a multi-modal data access layer that receives satellite remote sensing data, ground sensor networks, social media text streams, and urban infrastructure BIM models; a spatiotemporal alignment engine that uses a Geohash-Transformer structure for three-dimensional spatial encoding; a dynamic decision graph generation module that constructs a weighted, time-series updated disaster evolution knowledge graph; and a multi-objective optimization decision-maker that outputs a Pareto optimal strategy set. This invention solves the long-standing problems of data silos and static responses in the field of emergency decision-making, providing a new generation of infrastructure-level solutions for smart city safety; the system significantly improves the accuracy and efficiency of emergency response and is suitable for intelligent decision-making in scenarios such as urban flooding and earthquakes.

title: A method and system for simulating intraocular light fields based on physiological constraints and pathological origins
description: The invention discloses an intraocular light field simulation method and system based on physiological constraint and pathological tracing, wherein the system takes Physics Informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Net (PI-KAN) network as a core, namely physical information KAN, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining personalized parameters of eyeballs; inputting 5-dimensional light field parameters comprising space, wavelength and time into a pre-trained PI-KAN model to carry out light field solving, establishing three-layer network structures such as an input layer, a hidden layer and an output layer, constructing a physical information edge function, training by fusing a Helmholtz equation and a loss function of boundary conditions, generating an OCT image based on the light field obtained by simulation solving, and realizing visualization and pathology tracing of a light field propagation physical mechanism by analyzing edge function mapping. The invention utilizes the sparsity and the interpretability of PI-KAN, solves the problems of low calculation efficiency, difficult high-dimensional modeling, weak physical constraint and poor interpretability of the traditional method, realizes millisecond-level, high-precision and interpretable simulation of the eye light field, and is suitable for ophthalmic clinical auxiliary diagnosis, operation planning and equipment optimization.

title: A method and system for optimizing credit products based on multi-dimensional dynamic profiling and hybrid recommendation algorithms.
description: This application provides a method and system for optimizing credit products based on multi-dimensional dynamic profiling and a hybrid recommendation algorithm, relating to the field of digital data processing technology. This method decomposes the recommendation task through a hybrid computing task scheduling module. GPUs, with their natural advantages in parallel computing, are specifically used to process large-scale, structured matrix operation instructions. Simultaneously, CPUs, which excel at logical judgment and flow control, are freed up to focus on processing judgment instructions with complex branching and sequential logic. This avoids pipeline interruptions and resource contention caused by handling vastly different tasks in a single CPU architecture, resulting in efficient utilization of computing resources. Finally, by integrating the two computational results, this method can generate a complete output dataset in a short time, thereby compressing the overall response time to within seconds, meeting the credit needs of users in real-time scenarios.

title: A binocular vision 3D reconstruction method based on imaging plane spatial geometric entity modeling
description: This invention discloses a binocular vision 3D reconstruction method based on imaging plane spatial geometric entity modeling, belonging to the field of computer vision and 3D measurement technology. This method abandons the traditional "calibration first, reconstruction later" and "intrinsic-extrinsic parameter separation" models, and directly performs explicit parameterized modeling of the camera imaging plane in the world coordinate system, establishing a geometric model with only 9 degrees of freedom for each camera. The method includes: acquiring the 3D coordinates of the target point and its pixel coordinates in the binocular image; establishing an imaging plane model with the plane origin and pixel axis vectors as the core; constructing a nonlinear optimization problem with the goal of minimizing "collinearity error" and supplemented by unit orthogonal constraints, jointly solving all model parameters; and finally achieving 3D reconstruction by finding the intersection of the left and right imaging rays. This invention has the advantages of fewer parameters, clear physical meaning, high accuracy, and simple process, effectively avoiding the problems of complex operation procedures and numerous parameters in traditional methods.

title: A spectral optimization system for postharvest preservation of leafy vegetables
description: This invention relates to the fields of spectral optimization and intelligent lighting technology, specifically a spectral optimization system for post-harvest preservation of leafy vegetables. It includes a light source module composed of multiple independently controllable LED units of different wavelengths, used to generate a composite spectrum for illuminating the leafy vegetables; a spectral sensing module directly aligned with the light-emitting surface of the light source module, used to acquire the composite spectrum in real time and output multi-channel spectral data; a control module connected to the spectral sensing module and the light source module; and an optimal preservation spectral database integrated in the memory of the control module, storing target spectral data corresponding to different leafy vegetable varieties. This invention achieves a technological leap from fixed-spectrum lighting to dynamic and precise spectral control by constructing a closed-loop control system composed of a spectral sensing module, a spectral reconstruction unit, a spectral matching unit, and a spectral optimization unit, effectively solving the technical problem that traditional fixed-spectrum lighting cannot adapt to the physiological characteristics of different leafy vegetable varieties.

title: A GNSS Deformation Monitoring Method and System for Dams Based on a Three-Dimensional Water Vapor Model
description: This application provides a GNSS deformation monitoring method and system for dams based on a three-dimensional water vapor model, relating to the field of dam safety monitoring technology. The method includes: acquiring GNSS observation data from multiple reference stations within the monitoring area, meteorological station data, and remote sensing data containing regional topographic elevation information; then calculating the total zenith delay sequence based on the GNSS observation data and separating the target zenith wet delay; next, calculating the horizontal spatial distribution of water vapor content based on the target zenith wet delay, and obtaining the vertical spatial distribution by combining regional topographic elevation information, and then constructing a three-dimensional water vapor model; subsequently, using this model to correct for water vapor delay in the GNSS observation data, and obtaining the displacement time series through time series analysis; finally, calculating the long-term deformation rate and identifying abnormal deformation events, and generating visualized analysis results and a standardized report after quality control. This application improves the accuracy and reliability of dam vertical deformation monitoring.

title: A method to improve the accuracy of height difference measurement by smartphone barometric pressure sensors in urban environments
description: A method for improving the accuracy of height difference measurement using a smartphone barometric altimeter in urban environments includes the following steps: S1, setting up barometric altimeter control points; S2, conducting on-site measurements at the control points to establish a barometric altimeter sample control point dataset; S3, establishing a barometric altimeter model; S4, verifying the accuracy of the barometric altimeter model; and S5, acquiring height difference data in real time based on the barometric altimeter model. This method is easy to operate, considers the impact of weather on barometric altimeter measurement, minimizes the impact of weather on barometric altimeter measurement, and uses the least squares method and random forest algorithm to correct the model of the original differential barometric altimeter method, thereby improving the accuracy of height difference measurement using a smartphone barometric altimeter in urban environments, resulting in significant social and economic benefits.

title: Bearing temperature abnormality detection method, device, equipment and medium for railway vehicle
description: This invention provides a method, apparatus, device, and medium for detecting abnormal bearing temperatures in rail vehicles. The main components include: acquiring time-series temperature data of a set of bearings to be tested in the rail vehicle, and acquiring time-series vehicle condition data; generating correlation diagrams corresponding to multiple time windows based on the temperature time-series data of the bearing set, whereby the correlation diagrams characterize the correlation between different bearings within the bearing set under test within the corresponding time window; calling a preset neural network based on the correlation diagrams and vehicle condition time-series data of each time window to obtain a first feature vector; and determining the abnormal bearing temperature detection result for the rail vehicle based on the first feature vector. Based on this invention, the reliability of the abnormal bearing temperature detection result can be improved.

title: A wastewater discharge control method based on artificial intelligence
description: This invention discloses an artificial intelligence-based wastewater discharge control method, belonging to the field of wastewater treatment technology. Specifically, it includes: collecting wastewater flow rates and corresponding treatment plant operation data for each zone; constructing a time-series prediction model to output projected wastewater load values for each zone in the future; retrieving historical data from treatment plants to construct cost-load curves and identifying cost gradient abrupt change inflection points as load thresholds; designating treatment plants whose projected load values exceed the threshold as positive treatment plants, and those below the threshold and with unit costs lower than the regional benchmark as negative treatment plants; constructing an optimization model with the goal of minimizing scheduling losses, generating inter-regional transport paths and scheduling instruction sets; and scheduling treatment plants corresponding to all urban zones according to the scheduling control instruction set. This invention, by constructing an optimization model to minimize scheduling losses and generating scheduling instructions, achieves dynamic inter-regional optimized scheduling of urban wastewater, improving the economy and operational efficiency of the wastewater treatment system.

title: A method for reconstructing atmospheric turbulent wavefronts based on an attention-learnable activation synergistic mechanism
description: The invention belongs to the field of atmospheric turbulence wave-front aberration detection, discloses an atmospheric turbulence wave-front reconstruction method based on an attention-leachable activation cooperative mechanism, and aims to solve the problems that full-connection layer modeling is difficult, the characteristic extraction capability of a traditional convolution architecture is insufficient and the reconstruction error of a Zernike coefficient is unbalanced due to phase high-order nonlinear coupling existing in wave-front phase reconstruction of an existing end-to-end neural network. The method comprises the steps of collecting in-focus and out-of-focus images of light spots and corresponding distortion phases, constructing a training data set, constructing a focus encoder and a Kerr Mo Ge Roche-Arnod network, realizing high-precision mapping of high-order aberration characteristics by a learnable activation function, optimizing network parameters by using an error weighted root mean square loss function, and finally deploying a neural network with complete training to realize high-speed reasoning. The method provided by the invention provides a high-precision and high-speed scheme for atmospheric turbulence aberration wavefront aberration detection.

title: Edge-based intelligent drone pest and disease real-time detection system
description: This invention discloses an edge-intelligent drone-based real-time pest and disease detection system, belonging to the field of intelligent agriculture technology. The system includes a lightweight edge detection module, an adaptive resource scheduling module, a multi-task collaborative optimization module, and an edge-cloud closed-loop learning module. It compresses the model size through knowledge distillation technology, enabling real-time inference on the drone side; dynamically adjusts the inference strategy based on battery remaining and task urgency through adaptive scheduling, extending flight time; performs detection, classification, and density estimation simultaneously through multi-task collaborative optimization, reducing computational load; and continuously optimizes the model through edge-cloud closed-loop learning, improving accuracy, thus providing efficient and reliable technical support for smart agriculture.

title: A network security awareness method and system based on data analysis
description: This invention discloses a network security awareness method and system based on data analysis, including real-time collection of data traffic from different network nodes through a monitoring module. The invention uses a monitoring module to collect full data on traffic, logs, events, and alarms in real time, solving the problem of blind spots in internal threat monitoring in traditional solutions and achieving comprehensive network data monitoring. The integration and cleaning phase employs techniques such as SHA-256 fingerprint deduplication, IQR outlier correction, and cubic spline interpolation to eliminate noise interference and missing value bias, laying the foundation for high-precision analysis. Based on Word2vec-Doc2vec dual-model semantic analysis and a bidirectional LSTM-convolutional hybrid neural network, it detects abnormal network data, effectively addressing new threats such as zero-day vulnerabilities and combined attacks, and issues alerts to staff, enabling administrators to locate high-threat nodes and understand attack path evolution, thus meeting the needs of staff.

title: A Vehicle CAN Intrusion Detection Method Based on Protocol Space Features and Multi-Scale Bi-Mamba Model
description: This invention belongs to the field of vehicle networking and communication security technology, and relates to an in-vehicle CAN intrusion detection method based on protocol space features and a multi-scale Bi-Mamba model. This method constructs a set of multi-dimensional protocol space features for each CAN message, transposes the input sample into a shape, and then uses three 1D convolutional branches with different kernel sizes to average and fuse the three outputs to obtain multi-scale local features. These features are then transposed into the shape required by Mamba. After processing through a bidirectional Mamba stacking layer, the temporal features are adaptively reweighted using a channel gating mechanism to obtain the gated and reweighted features. Finally, normalization, Dropout operations, global average pooling, and MLP classification are performed sequentially. This method effectively solves the problems of existing methods lacking unified modeling of CAN protocol semantics, temporal behavior, and payload statistics, as well as the technical problems of difficulty in distinguishing multiple types of attacks, low overall detection accuracy, high model complexity, and insufficient real-time performance and deployment capabilities.

title: Model training method, video generating method, device, medium and computer program product
description: This application provides a model training method, video generation method, device, medium, and computer program product. The model training method includes: training a first model based on multiple first training samples until a set first convergence condition is met; each of the multiple first training samples includes a user's speaking audio and facial image; the first model is used to generate a corresponding digital human speaking video based on the input speaking audio and facial image; wherein, when training the first model based on each of the multiple first training samples, a first feature corresponding to that first training sample is injected into the first model, and the first model injected with the first feature is called to process the first training sample to obtain a first speaking video; the first feature is used to describe the lip-sync style of the first user speaking corresponding to the first training sample.

title: Rule engine-based test run adjustment strategy compiling and operating method and system
description: The invention discloses a test run adjustment strategy compiling operation method and system based on a rule engine, wherein the method comprises the steps of compiling a standardized flow file of strategies, uniformly dividing the strategies with different contents into parameter indexes, adjustable parts and controller parameter information which are recorded before the strategies are compiled, completing the compiling of the strategy contents, further forming a rule file which can be used for the automatic operation of the strategies, storing all the compiled and enabled strategy rule files into a rule library, automatically identifying and triggering the strategies meeting corresponding triggering conditions through the rule engine, and providing a compiled strategy disposal operation and troubleshooting scheme, and the system comprises a standardized compiling module and an automatic operation module of the strategies. The method ensures the rapidness and accuracy of identification, is more standardized, and can make the running of the test run debugging strategy standardized programming and the running of the automatic operation more standardized, rapid and accurate without depending on manpower.

title: A method for calculating carbon emission reductions from public transportation trips by integrating BeiDou spatiotemporal data
description: This invention relates to the field of urban traffic management and carbon emission reduction accounting technology, and proposes a method for calculating carbon emission reductions in public transportation by integrating BeiDou spatiotemporal data. The method includes: acquiring spatiotemporal trajectory data based on the BeiDou satellite navigation system and constructing a three-dimensional correlation model of "passengers-trajectory-stations" for passenger flow analysis; constructing a passenger transfer analysis system based on the passenger flow analysis results; constructing a dynamic scheduling optimization system of "perception-prediction-optimization" based on spatiotemporal trajectory data and reinforcement learning algorithms for detailed passenger flow analysis; and constructing a mileage-frequency distribution model and a station efficiency evaluation model based on spatiotemporal trajectory data, generating trajectory matching optimization strategies and differentiated station optimization schemes respectively, thereby achieving adaptive optimization of the public transportation system under dynamic changes in demand. Compared with traditional methods that rely on static data, this invention achieves dynamic and fine-grained monitoring of the public transportation system's operation, effectively improving the timeliness and completeness of the data.

title: Cable duct identification method, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to a cable duct identification method, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of S1, obtaining an environment image of a cable duct to be identified, S2, processing the image by using a YOLOX-ST target detection algorithm model, S3, obtaining and outputting an identification and positioning result of the algorithm model on an opening of the cable duct in the image, wherein the YOLOX-ST algorithm model comprises the steps of taking a lightweight Swin Transformer as a backbone network for feature extraction, introducing a convolution attention module into a neck structure, and using a EIoU loss function as a target positioning loss function. According to the method, the YOLOX-ST target detection algorithm model is adopted to process the cable duct environment image, and the cable duct opening in the image can be rapidly and accurately identified and positioned. Compared with the traditional method, the time cost of manual searching and judging is reduced, and the working efficiency is improved.

title: Focus on task intervention methods, devices, equipment, storage media, and program products.
description: This application provides a method, apparatus, device, storage medium, and program product for intervening in focused tasks. The method includes: acquiring the start time, end time, and current time of the current focused task; acquiring a sequence of physiological state characteristics of the user; the physiological state characteristic sequence includes various physiological state characteristics of the user from the start time to the current time; determining the user's flow state recognition result based on the physiological state characteristic sequence; predicting the user's cognitive exhaustion time based on the physiological state characteristic sequence; and adjusting the end time of the current focused task according to the flow state recognition result and the cognitive exhaustion time. This method allows for flexible intervention in the user's learning process.

title: Security reasoning method, device, equipment and storage medium based on multi-mode data
description: This application provides a secure reasoning method, apparatus, device, and storage medium based on multimodal data. The method includes: logically collecting data from the area to be monitored to obtain a first data block; transmitting and enhancing the first data block with knowledge according to a preset logical policy library to obtain a second data block; performing distributed feature extraction and logical fusion on the second data block to obtain a fused feature dataset; performing hybrid reasoning based on the fused feature dataset and a preset distributed knowledge base to obtain a risk assessment result; and generating an executable policy set based on the risk assessment result.

title: A Method and System for Generating 3D Indoor Scene Layout Based on Scene Graph Control
description: This disclosure provides a method and system for generating 3D indoor scene layouts based on scene graph control, relating to the field of 3D scene generation technology. The method includes: obtaining a user's natural requirement description for scene layout; inputting the natural requirement description into an LLM (Limited Module Model) for parsing, generating a structured sparse scene graph based on spatial logical relationships; utilizing a multi-condition constraint scene generation method based on a diffusion model, using the sparse scene graph, floor plan, and spatial constraints as conditional information, guiding the generation process of the diffusion model through a hybrid injection approach, and introducing a lightweight adaptive weight learning mechanism to enhance the physical constraints on the layout, adaptively balancing the weight distribution of different guiding conditions in the generation process, and finally outputting layout data; based on the layout data, retrieving and matching corresponding 3D models from a predefined 3D-FUTURE model library, placing them into 3D space, and constructing a complete 3D indoor scene. This disclosure improves the generalization and accuracy of controllable scene generation.

title: Rapid Early Warning and Source Tracing Analysis Method for Pathogen Transmission Based on Multi-Source Data Fusion
description: This invention discloses a method for rapid early warning and source tracing analysis of pathogen transmission based on multi-source data fusion. The method includes: S1 collecting multi-source data such as drug sales, online behavior, social media, outpatient visits, and traffic spatiotemporal data; S2 cleaning and standardizing preprocessing, and using BERT to extract symptom features from social text; S3 mining comprehensive weak signals through single-source anomaly detection and multi-source correlation analysis; S4 using an Attention-LSTM model to fuse features and output a regional risk index; S5 training an early warning model based on historical data and setting three-level thresholds to trigger early warning; S6 combining spatiotemporal data to locate the transmission starting point and constructing a transmission chain through a graph neural network. This invention provides early warning 3-7 days in advance, and the source tracing accuracy reaches the community level, improving the precision of prevention and control.

title: A smart transmission line inspection system and method
description: This invention discloses an intelligent transmission line inspection system and method, comprising: an intelligent inspection pole, a mobile terminal, and a backend server; the intelligent inspection pole includes a high-precision positioning module and a micro-environment sensor; the mobile terminal is configured to communicate with the intelligent inspection pole and includes a display module; the backend server is configured to communicate with the mobile terminal and includes an AI early warning module; wherein, the high-precision positioning module is configured to acquire centimeter-level positioning data through a third-party positioning service, the micro-environment sensor is configured to collect micro-environment data along the inspection path; the AI early warning module is configured to receive macro-meteorological data, the micro-environment data, and the positioning data, generate meteorological risk early warning information for specific sections of the inspection path through a pre-trained AI risk prediction model, and push it to the mobile terminal. This invention can achieve centimeter-level precision positioning, path recording, and navigation in remote mountainous areas or areas with few base stations, while possessing real-time environmental data perception and short-term weather forecasting capabilities, thereby enabling proactive prediction of micro-meteorological disasters along the transmission line corridor and improving the safety and risk avoidance capabilities of inspection operations.

title: Large-scale language model inference through database queries
description: A method executed using a computer, the computer including an encoder, a database return encoder, a feature fusion model, and a decoder. The method includes the encoder receiving a question. The encoder is capable of outputting a plain text database query for the question, data processing instructions, and a question embedding. The computer is capable of obtaining a set of data elements from a database using the plain text database query. The database return encoder is capable of receiving the set of data elements and the data processing instructions. The database return encoder is capable of outputting an intermediate embedding to the feature fusion model based on the set of data elements and the data processing instructions. The feature fusion model is capable of outputting an output embedding to the decoder using the intermediate embedding and the question embedding. The decoder is capable of determining text output based on the output embedding.

title: Image similarity calculation system, image search system, image similarity calculation method and image similarity calculation program
description: An image similarity calculation system is provided to generate a larger image similarity value between an edited image and the original image. A local region weight calculation device 14 calculates a weight value for each local region in the image based on the probability of each local region in the edited image, serving as a local region weight value. The local region weight calculation device 14 outputs the calculated local region weight values to an image similarity calculation device 122. A small region similarity calculation device 121 compares the feature values of each small region obtained by segmenting the query image with the feature values of each small region obtained by segmenting the reference image. The small region similarity calculation device 121 calculates the similarity of the feature values for each small region. The image similarity calculation device 122 calculates the image similarity between the query image and the reference image by applying the small region-based weight values to the calculated similarity. These weight values are obtained from the local region weight values provided by the local region weight calculation device 14.

title: A Neural Network Loss Layer Design Method Based on Interval Algorithm
description: This invention discloses a method for designing a neural network loss layer based on an interval algorithm, comprising the following steps: 1) Designing a loss layer based on a traditional neural network to obtain the feature input elements of the interval loss layer; 2) Subtracting the corresponding true value from the interval-form input element to obtain the maximum and minimum distance values for each element; 3) Obtaining the maximum and minimum loss values for a single training sample; 4) Averaging the maximum and minimum loss values obtained from all the training samples using the method in step 3) to obtain the interval loss value for this training. Compared with existing technologies, this invention defines the input and output values of the loss layer as interval data types, thereby forming an interval loss layer. This interval loss layer can handle uncertain input values within a certain range and output reliable interval values, compensating for the inability of neural networks to handle interval data.

title: New energy grid-connected broadband oscillation data restoration method, system, equipment and medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a method, a system, equipment and a medium for repairing new energy grid-connected broadband oscillation data, which comprise the steps of simulating a new energy grid-connected system by using a simulation model to obtain an original broadband oscillation data set, and preprocessing the original broadband oscillation data set to obtain a preprocessed broadband oscillation data set; and repairing the broadband oscillation missing and abnormal data set by utilizing a local-global two-stage correlation learning repair model to obtain broadband oscillation repair data. The two-stage restoration strategy based on deep learning realizes the efficient and accurate restoration of the missing and abnormal values in the new energy grid-connected broadband oscillation data, can effectively solve the problem of inaccurate positioning caused by the missing and abnormal broadband oscillation data, and ensures the stable operation of the new energy base grid-connected and outgoing system.

title: Automatic counting system and method for different products on conveyor belt
description: The present invention discloses a counting system for products on a conveyor belt, in particular, an automated counting system and method for different products on a conveyor belt. The system comprises: a visual sensor for collecting 2D image data; a structured light sensor for collecting 3D point cloud data; a deep learning neural network algorithm for target detection and classification of the collected 2D image data and 3D point cloud data, and a 2D image and 3D point cloud multimodal registration algorithm for accurately registering the 2D image data with the 3D point cloud data, and then performing point cloud surface reconstruction and point cloud segmentation on the 3D point cloud data, calculating the point cloud volume of the corresponding product, and a calculation module for matching and counting the volumes of different products. The present invention solves the technical problem of "realizing accurate counting of different products on a conveyor belt". The present invention can count different products on a conveyor belt, and can distinguish whether the product has obvious volume defects and count qualified products and unqualified products separately.

title: Automated method for monitoring rotating components of a rotating machine by domain adaptation
description: The invention relates to a method (100) for automatically monitoring a plurality of rotating components of a rotating machine based on a target database comprising a plurality of time signals generated by each rotating component from a distribution and based on a source database comprising a plurality of time signals from a distribution S that is different from a distribution T generated by a source rotating component of the source rotating machine and that is associated with a class of operation, the monitoring being made by means of an adaptive deep learning model that makes it possible to adapt the source distribution to the target distribution, the deep learning module being trained by minimizing a cost function related to a Gaussian kernel function having a parameter sigma, calculating sigma based on the distribution differences at each epoch, the distribution differences being weighted by constant static values based on a Pascal triangle estimate.

title: Data processing method of neural network, neural network and chip
description: The invention relates to a data processing method of a neural network, the neural network and a chip, wherein the data processing method of the neural network comprises the steps of storing weight data and loading the weight data into a PIM; and a calculation step of performing Mac calculation based on the data of each of the banks. The weight data is loaded into a memory calculation (Processing In Memory, PIM) unit and distributed into different banks, and then a multiply-add (MAC) operation is performed based on the data in each Bank. By integrating data processing and storage, the method reduces the transmission bottleneck of data from the memory to the processing unit, reduces calculation delay and power consumption, and can remarkably improve efficiency especially in large-scale neural network calculation.

title: Device for automatically identifying pictures, characters and sounds in real time
description: The invention discloses a device for automatically identifying pictures, characters and sounds in real time, which comprises a data acquisition module, an extraction module, a knowledge base module, a comparison module and a correction module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring picture, character or sound information of a specified target, the extraction module is used for extracting knowledge points in the picture, character or sound information, the knowledge base module is used for storing knowledge data information, the comparison module is used for comparing the knowledge points extracted by the extraction module with the knowledge data information in the knowledge base module to obtain comparison information, and the correction module is used for correcting the knowledge points of the specified target according to the comparison information. Compared with the prior art, the invention can automatically recognize characters, pictures and sounds, and achieve the purpose of automatic correction operation, thereby reducing correction time of teachers.

title: Adaptive weighted greedy instruction scheduling system and method for DSP
description: The present invention relates to the field of instruction scheduling of DSP, and discloses an adaptive weighted greedy instruction scheduling system and method for DSP, wherein the system comprises a ready instruction queue input module, a greedy scoring decision module, an adaptive weight adjustment module, a scheduling queue generation module, a scheduling termination check module, a ready queue update module, and a post-scheduling instruction queue output module. The system and method disclosed by the present invention comprehensively consider factors such as instruction delay, register pressure, and critical path, introduce an adaptive weight dynamic adjustment mechanism, weigh multi-objective optimization on the basis of a greedy strategy, can flexibly adapt to different program characteristics, efficiently utilize hardware resources, improve scheduling quality in complex scenarios, and improve overall program performance. At the same time, the algorithm is improved on the basis of the original algorithm, reuses a large part of the content, has moderate complexity, is easy to implement and integrate in a compiler, and has strong practicality and engineering value.

title: Method and device for evaluating safety of model training
description: The embodiment of the specification relates to a method and a device for evaluating safety of model training, which are implemented by a first party, and comprise the steps of providing current parameter values of model parameters in a joint model, including a first parameter of a graph characterization network and a second parameter of a multi-layer perceptron, receiving gradient data from the second party, reconstructing node characterization of each node at an output layer of the graph characterization network according to a second gradient and the second parameter value corresponding to the second parameter to obtain reconstructed graph characterization of each node, determining a reconstructed adjacent matrix according to similarity between the reconstructed graph characterization of each node, determining node characteristics which minimize an objective function as reconstructed node characteristics, wherein the objective function comprises a first loss which is positively related to differences between the reconstructed graph characterization and the output characterization obtained by processing the node characteristics of the graph characterization network, determining reconstructed graph data according to the reconstructed adjacent matrix and the reconstructed node characteristics, and using the reconstructed graph data for evaluating safety of the joint model training.

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for identifying anti-money laundering transaction
description: The application discloses a money back transaction identification method, a money back transaction identification device, computer equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical transaction data and current transaction data of a plurality of target objects, executing data logic analysis on the historical transaction data and the current transaction data according to a preset transaction data detection model, determining detection results aiming at money laundering behavior characteristics, and determining degree rating information of degree of regulation of each target object according to the detection results so as to determine the degree of regulation and degree of regulation of the target objects in money laundering. The application utilizes the detection model to respectively carry out data analysis, particularly logic analysis, on the historical data and the current data so as to obtain the data detection result determined according to the transaction data provided by each legal person, and further can evaluate the transaction closing rule degree of each legal person according to the data detection result, thereby carrying out money laundering identification and control on two layers of transaction and legal persons.

title: Predictive recommendations for skills development
description: Measuring a skill set of a user as the user plays a game on a gaming device to gauge a skill level of the user across a set of defined metrics. Predictive analytics are used to anticipate upcoming challenges a user will face; based on the upcoming challenges for the user, games are recommended to increase the skill levels of the user to address and overcome the upcoming challenges.

title: Multiloop interferometers for quantum information processing
description: Structures and techniques, using superconducting Josephson-junction based circuits, to directly engineer physical multiqubit (or “many-qubit”) interactions in a non-perturbative manner. In one embodiment, a system for multiqubit interaction includes: a multispin coupler including a plurality of loops, each loop having a pair of Josephson junctions; and a plurality of qubits each inductively coupled to the multispin coupler.

title: Method and system for executing problem solving rules by a cognitive agent
description: The present disclosure relates to a method and system for executing a plurality of business rules. The method includes scanning a plurality of elements added to an input link of an initialized state, writing the scanned plurality of elements to an output link of the initialized state, executing the plurality of business rules based on creation of a state graph, selecting one or more operators for execution and applying actions of productions on an operator of the one or more operators. The state graph is created by adding a plurality of nodes and a plurality of attributes to a top level state. The one or more operators are selected based on a preference of a plurality of preferences in a preference memory. The actions of productions can be applied by adding and removing the plurality of elements.

title: System and method for transaction volume determination
description: Systems and methods of improving the operation of a transaction network and transaction network devices is disclosed. A business size arbitration network host may comprise various modules and engines as discussed herein wherein the size of the business (e.g., aggregate value of sales) may be identified as being relatively large, whereby the transaction network may tailor the handling of a transaction of the business, such as by adjusting handling speed, fees, etc., whereby the transaction network may actively encourage use of transaction products and services by relatively large businesses, and/or such as by delivering value-added services, such as electronically provided advertisements and/or offers, and/or other credit and/or lending products, whereby the transaction network more properly functions according to approved parameters.

title: Complex Event Processing Method, Apparatus, and System
description: Embodiments of the present invention relate to the field of communications technologies, and provide a complex event processing method, apparatus, and system, so that when complex event processing is performed, a system requiring a synchronous response provides a synchronous response externally and avoids information flooding. A solution provided by the present invention includes: receiving an input event sent by an event source, where the input event includes an identifier of an object and an event type; acquiring, according to a preset database, M mode rules corresponding to the event type; performing mode matching between the input event and the M mode rules separately to acquire N output events; and if N is greater than or equal to 1, sending at least one piece of event information to a real-time decision apparatus, where each piece of the event information includes Q output events and indication information.

title: Progressive Objective Addition in Multi-objective Heuristic Systems and Methods
description: Systems and methods are provided for performing multi-objective optimizations with a relatively large number of objectives to which optimization is to be performed. The objectives of the optimization problem may be partitioned to two or more subsets (e.g., overlapping or non-overlapping subsets) of objectives, and partial optimization(s) may be performed using a subset or combination of subsets of the objectives. One or more of the partial optimizations may use one or more pareto-optimized chromosomes from a prior partial optimization. A final full optimization may be performed according to all of the objectives of the optimization problem and may use one or more chromosomes of any preceding partial optimization as a starting point for finding a final solution to the optimization problem. Any variety of processes may be employed to mitigate archive explosion that may be associated with relatively large objective sets.

title: Apparatus and method of generating internet of things data
description: An apparatus for generating IoT data is disclosed. The apparatus may search for a real IoT sensor capable of providing real IoT data desired by the user, collect the real IoT data desired by the user from the found real IoT sensor, and provide the collected real IoT data to the user. Also, when the real IoT sensor capable of providing the real IoT data desired by the user is not found, the apparatus may search for a realistic IoT sensor similar to the real IoT sensor, perform machine learning on the IoT data collected from the found realistic IoT sensor to generate realistic IoT data similar to the real IoT data, and provide the generated realistic IoT to the user.

title: Systems and methods for providing content
description: Systems, methods, and non-transitory computer-readable media can generate a set of candidate content items from a plurality of content items that are available in the social networking system for a first user. A corresponding score for each of the candidate content items can be generated based at least in part on one or more social affinity coefficients corresponding to the first user and a respective second user associated with a candidate content item, wherein a social affinity coefficient provides a quantitative measurement of the strength of a relationship between two users. A first set of content items from the set of candidate content items can be determined based at least in part on the respective scores, wherein content items in the first set are included in a content feed provided to the first user.

title: Population-based connectivity architecture for spiking neural networks
description: An electronic neuromorphic core processor circuit and related method include a dendrite circuit comprising an input that receives an input spike message having an associated input identifier that identifies a distribution set of dendrite compartments. A synapse map provides a mapping of the received identifier to a synapse configuration in the memory. A synapse configuration circuit associates the identifier with a set of synaptic connections, possibly shared hierarchically over populations of neurons defined implicitly by the mapping structures, that are read from the memory. The synaptic connections determine n-tuple information comprising a dendriteID, a weight, and a network delay time. A dendrite accumulator circuit accumulates weight values scheduled at the appropriate future time as identified by the n-tuple information and maps them to a soma compartment. A soma circuit maintains soma compartment state in response to the accumulated weight values scheduled for servicing and, when sufficiently activated, produces output spikes.

title: Crowdsourced learning engine for semantic analysis of webpages
description: A method for autofilling an electronic form is provided. Elements of the electronic form are identified. A value for each identified elements of the electronic form is determined. The electronic form is automatically filled with the determined values. During the automatically filling of the electronic form, the determined value is provided in a field corresponding to each of the elements. A user input is received on the provided value. The received user input includes a correction to a first value provided in a first field of the electronic form. An autofill application is trained using the received user input.

title: Methods and apparatus to generate anomaly detection datasets
description: Example methods and apparatus to generate anomaly detection datasets are disclosed. An example method to generate an anomaly detection dataset for training a machine learning model to detect real world anomalies includes receiving a user definition of an anomaly generator function, executing, with a processor, the anomaly generator function to generate user-defined anomaly data, and combining the user-defined anomaly data with nominal data to generate the anomaly detection dataset.

title: Hierarchical profiling inputs and self-adaptive fraud detection system
description: Embodiments disclosed herein are related determining a risk score for one or more data transactions. Current data transactions that are associated with one or more current attributes are received. Stored data transactions associated with stored attributes are accessed. A plurality of the stored attributes are selected. A first sliding window and a second sliding window are selected. A duration of the second sliding window is longer than a duration of the first sliding window and encompasses the duration of first sliding window. Risk information for those stored data transactions that are associated with the plurality of attributes is determined. The risk information is determined during the duration of both the first and second sliding windows and is indicative of a level fraud that is occurring. The determined risk information and the current attributes are used to generate a risk score for the current data transactions. The current data transactions are approved or rejected based on the risk score.

title: Utilizing interactive deep learning to select objects in digital visual media
description: Systems and methods are disclosed for selecting target objects within digital images. In particular, in one or more embodiments, the disclosed systems and methods generate a trained neural network based on training digital images and training indicators. Moreover, one or more embodiments of the disclosed systems and methods utilize a trained neural network and iterative user indicators to select targeted objects in digital images. Specifically, the disclosed systems and methods can transform user indicators into distance maps that can be utilized in conjunction with color channels and a trained neural network to identify pixels that reflect the target object.

title: Anomalous sound detection training apparatus, acoustic feature extraction apparatus, anomalous sound sampling apparatus, and methods and programs for the same
description: An anomalous sound detection training apparatus includes: a first acoustic feature extraction unit that extracts an acoustic feature of normal sound based on training data for normal sound by using an acoustic feature extractor; a normal sound model updating unit that updates a normal sound model by using the acoustic feature extracted; a second acoustic feature extraction unit that extracts an acoustic feature of anomalous sound based on simulated anomalous sound and extracts the acoustic feature of normal sound based on the training data for normal sound by using the acoustic feature extractor; and an acoustic feature extractor updating unit that updates the acoustic feature extractor by using the acoustic feature of anomalous sound and the acoustic feature of normal sound that have been extracted, in which processing by the units is repeatedly performed.

title: Adaptive Convolutional Neural Knowledge Graph Learning System Leveraging Entity Descriptions
description: Systems and methods for predicting new relationships in the knowledge graph, including embedding a partial triplet including a head entity description and a relationship or a tail entity description to produce a separate vector for each of the head, relationship, and tail. The vectors for the head entity, relationship, and tail entity can be combined into a first matrix, and adaptive kernels generated from the entity descriptions can be applied to the matrix through convolutions to produce a second matrix having a different dimension from the first matrix. An activation function can be applied to the second matrix to obtain non-negative feature maps, and max-pooling can be used over the feature maps to get subsamples. A fixed length vector, Z, flattens the subsampling feature maps into a feature vector, and a linear mapping method is used to map the feature vectors into a prediction score.

title: Discretized embeddings of physiological waveforms
description: Techniques described herein relate to training and applying predictive models using discretized physiological sensor data. In various embodiments, a continuous stream of samples measured by a physiological sensor may be discretized into a training sequence of quantized beats. A training sequence of vectors determined based on the training sequence of quantized beats and an embedding matrix may be associated with labels indicative of medical conditions, and applied as input across a neural network to generate corresponding instances of training output. Based on a comparison of each instance of training output with a respective label, the neural network and the embedding matrix may be trained and used to predict medical conditions from unlabeled continuous streams of physiological sensor samples. In some embodiments, the trained embedding matrix may be visualized to identify correlations between medical conditions and physiological signs.

title: Adaptive key performance indicator thresholds updated using training data
description: Techniques are disclosed for providing adaptive thresholding technology for Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that are updated using training data. Adaptive thresholding technology may automatically assign new values or adjust existing values for one or more thresholds of one or more time policies. Assigning threshold values using adaptive thresholding may involve identifying training data (e.g., historical data, simulated data, or example data) for the time frames and analyzing the training data to identify variations within the data (e.g., patterns, distributions, trends). A threshold value may be determined based on the variations and may be assigned to one or more of the thresholds without additional user intervention.

title: Method and system for activity classification
description: This disclosure is directed to an activity classifier system, for classifying human activities using 2D skeleton data. The system includes a skeleton preprocessor that transforms the 2D skeleton data into transformed skeleton data, the transformed skeleton data comprising scaled, relative joint positions and relative joint velocities. It also includes a gesture classifier comprising a first recurrent neural network that receives the transformed skeleton data, and is trained to identify the most probable of a plurality of gestures. There is also an action classifier comprising a second recurrent neural network that receives information from the first recurrent neural networks and is trained to identify the most probable of a plurality of actions.

title: Autoencoder, data processing system, data processing method and non-transitory computer readable medium
description: An autoencoder includes memory configured to store data including an encode network and a decode network, and processing circuitry coupled to the memory. The processing circuitry is configured to cause the encode network to convert inputted data to a plurality of values and output the plurality of values, batch-normalize values indicated by at least two or more layers of the encode network, out of the output plurality of values, the batch-normalized values having a predetermined average value and a predetermined variance value, quantize each of the batch-normalized values, and cause the decode network to decode each of the quantized values.

title: Intelligent scheduling of backups
description: Normal virtual machine operation is observed to automatically determine patterns of resource utilization. Backup activities are then scheduled, taking into account these utilization patterns. For example, if a normally scheduled backup would occur during a busy period, it may be rescheduled to a less busy period. As another example, backups made by made opportunistically during less busy periods even if not required by the normal backup schedule, in order to alleviate backup demands during more busy periods.

title: Apparatus and method for executing reversal training of artificial neural network
description: An apparatus for executing backpropagation of an artificial neural network comprises an instruction caching unit, a controller unit, a direct memory access unit, an interconnection unit, a master computation module, and multiple slave computation modules. For each layer in a multilayer neural network, weighted summation may be performed on input gradient vectors to calculate an output gradient vector of this layer. The output gradient vector may be multiplied by a derivative value of a next-layer activation function on which forward operation is performed, so that a next-layer input gradient vector can be obtained. The input gradient vector may be multiplied by an input neuron counterpoint in forward operation to obtain the gradient of a weight value of this layer, and the weight value of this layer can be updated according to the gradient of the obtained weight value of this layer.

title: Predicting using digital twins
description: In various examples there is a computer-implemented method performed by a digital twin at a computing device in a communications network. The method comprises: receiving at least one stream of event data observed from the environment. Computing at least one schema from the stream of event data, the schema being a concise representation of the stream of event data. Participating in a distributed inference process by sending information about the schema or the received event stream to at least one other digital twin in the communications network and receiving information about schemas or received event streams from the other digital twin. Computing comparisons of the sent and received information. Aggregating the digital twin and the other digital twin, or defining a relationship between the digital twin and the other digital twin on the basis of the comparison.

title: Methods and apparatus to provide machine programmed creative support to a user
description: Methods, apparatus, systems and articles of manufacture to provide machine programmed creative support to a user are disclosed. An example apparatus include an artificial intelligence architecture to be trained based on previous inputs of the user; a processor to: implement a first machine learning model based on the trained artificial intelligence architecture; and predict a first action based on a current state of a computer program using the first machine learning model; implement a second machine learning model based on the trained artificial intelligence architecture; and predict a second action based on the current state of the computer program using the second machine learning model; and a controller to select a state based on the action that results in a state that is more divergent from the current state of the computer program.

title: Device identifier classification
description: An example method can include tracking, by a network device, a plurality of attributes associated with a plurality of unique client device identifiers stored in a tracking table; deriving, by the network device, a training data set based on the plurality of attributes; and generating, by the network device, a plurality of clusters by inputting the derived training data set to an unsupervised machine learning mechanism. The example method can include receiving, by the network device, a labeling of the plurality of unique client device identifiers in the tracking table based at least on the plurality of clusters; generating, by the network device, a plurality of classifiers by inputting the labelled tracking table to a supervised machine learning mechanism; and classifying, by the network device, a new unique client device identifier in the tracking table based at least on the plurality of classifiers.

title: Wireless mac mode selection using machine learning
description: In one embodiment, a network monitoring service trains, using a training dataset from one or more wireless networks, a machine learning model to output an optimized set of media access control (MAC) mode parameters for a wireless access point given an input set of network characteristics. The service receives a plurality of network characteristics associated with a particular wireless access point in a particular wireless network. The service determines, using the received network characteristics as input to the machine learning-based model, a set of MAC mode parameters for the particular wireless access point. The service controls the particular wireless access point to communicate with one or more clients in the particular wireless network based on the determined set of MAC mode parameters.

title: Selecting acquisition parameter for imaging system
description: A system and method are provided for selecting an acquisition parameter for an imaging system. The acquisition parameter at least in part defines an imaging configuration of the imaging system during an imaging procedure with a patient. A depth-related map is accessed which is generated on the basis of sensor data from a camera system, wherein the camera system has a field of view which includes at least part of a field of view of the imaging system, wherein the sensor data is obtained before the imaging procedure with the patient and indicative of a distance that parts of the patient's exterior have towards the camera system. A machine learning algorithm is applied to the depth-related map to identify the acquisition parameter, which may be provided to the imaging system.

title: Activity-based content object access permissions
description: Methods, systems and computer program products for content management systems. The techniques of the methods, systems and/or computer program products automatically determine activity-based content object access permissions and/or make a recommendation of activity-based content object access permissions. A machine learning model is formed from observations of user interactions over a plurality of content objects. The model is continually updated based on ongoing observation and analysis of user interaction events. When a collaborative relationship is formed between an invitor and one or more invitees, the activity-based permissions model is accessed to determine a set of access permissions to assign to the collaborative relationship. A single collaborative relationship may cover many collaboration objects. In some cases, a set of access permissions are automatically assigned to the collaborative relationship. In other cases, a set of access permissions is presented to the invitor as a recommendation. A user can accept or reject any recommendation.

title: Rgbd sensing based object detection system and method thereof
description: An RGBD sensing based system for detecting, tracking, classifying, and reporting objects in real-time includes a processor, a computer readable media, and a communication interface communicatively coupled to each other via a system bus is illustrated. An object detection module is integrated into the system that detects and tracks any objects that are moved under its field of view.

title: Imaging device and electronic device
description: A data potential generated by the photoelectric conversion operation is input to a pulse generation circuit to output a pulse signal having a spike waveform. In addition, a structure in which product-sum operation of pulse signals is performed is provided, and digital data is generated from a new pulse signal. The digital data is taken into a neural network or the like, whereby processing such as image recognition can be performed. Processing up to taking an enormous amount of image data into a neural network or the like can be performed in the imaging device; thus, processing can be efficiently performed.

title: Local optimization of quantum circuits
description: Techniques facilitating local optimization of quantum circuits are provided. In one example, a computer-implemented method comprises applying, by a device operatively coupled to a processor, respective weights to matrix elements of a first matrix corresponding to a quantum circuit according to respective numbers of quantum gates between respective pairs of qubits in the quantum circuit; transforming, by the device, the first matrix into a second matrix based on the respective weights of the matrix elements; and permuting, by the device, respective qubits in the quantum circuit according to the second matrix, resulting in a permuted quantum circuit.

title: Method and device for adjusting and implementing topic detection processes
description: Aspects of the subject disclosure may include, for example, applying a topic detection process to documents to obtain automatically detected topics and groups of automatically detected words, comparing the automatically detected topics with manually determined topics to determine actual purity metrics, determining an error metric based on a measure of deviation between ideal purity metrics and the actual purity metrics, and adjusting a parameter of the topic detection process according to the error metric resulting in an adjusted topic detection process. Other embodiments are disclosed.

title: Detecting and reducing bias in machine learning models
description: A method identifies and removes bias from a machine learning model. A user/computer inputs a plurality of input training data into a machine learning system to generate an output of labeled output data. The user/computer evaluates the labeled output data according to a consistency metric to associate the labeled output data with a corresponding consistency assessment. The user/computer selects each labeled output data having a consistency assessment indicating a consistency assessment that is greater than a predetermined threshold to form a labeled output data subset, and then creates additional labeling for the labeled output data subset. The user/computer utilizes the additional labeling to distinguish each labeled training data from labeled output data subset as being mislabeled and biased, and then adjusts the learning machine based on the labeled output data subset being mislabeled and biased.

title: Neural network model for optimizing digital page
description: Techniques for improving the accuracy, relevancy, and efficiency of a computer system of an online service by providing a user interface to optimize a digital page of a user on the online service are disclosed herein. In some embodiments, a computer system accesses a profile of a first user of an online service stored in a database of the online service, and generates a suggestion for adding a measurable accomplishment to a particular section of a page of the first user based on profile data of the accessed profile using a neural network model, with the neural network model being configured to identify the measurable accomplishment based on the profile data of the accessed profile.

title: Recurrent Gaussian Mixture Model For Sensor State Estimation In Condition Monitoring
