The systems and methods of the present invention disclose use of one or more specifically programmed computer machines with artificial intelligence expert system battery energy management and navigation route control. Such specifically programmed computer machines may be located in the EV and/or cloud-based or remote computer/data processing systems for the determination of preferred routes of travel, including intermediate stops at designated battery charging or replenishing stations. Expert system algorithms operating on combinations of expert defined parameter subsets for route selection are disclosed. Specific fuzzy logic methods are also disclosed based on defined potential route parameters with fuzzy logic determination of crisp numerical values for multiple potential routes and comparison of those crisp numerical values for selection of a particular route. Application of the present invention systems and methods to autonomous or driver-less EVs is also disclosed.

title: Techniques for machine learning scheme changing based at least in part on dynamic network changes
description: Various aspects of the present disclosure generally relate to wireless communication. In some aspects, a first network node may receive assistance information indicating an occurrence of at least one dynamic network change, wherein the at least one dynamic network change corresponds to a change from a first network state to a second network state, wherein a first machine learning scheme is associated with the first network state, and wherein the first machine learning scheme includes a machine learning model for generating a prediction associated with a first serving cell and/or a machine tearning parameter associated with the machine tearning model. The first network node may identify, based at least in part on the assistance information, a second machine learning scheme associated with the second network state, and may perform a wireless communication based at least in part on the second machine learning scheme. Numerous other aspects are described.

title: Forward and backward embedding fusion for video panoptic segmentation
description: A system and a method are disclosed for performing video segmentation, including obtaining a plurality of frames from an input video; extracting a plurality of features from the plurality of frames; obtaining query embeddings corresponding to the plurality of features; refining the query embeddings in a forward time order to generate forward embeddings, and in a backward time order to generate backward embeddings; fusing the forward embeddings and the backward embeddings to obtain fused embeddings; and generating a classification prediction corresponding to the input video based on the fused embeddings.

title: Machine learning libraries for recipe setup
description: Methods and systems for constructing a machine learning (ML) library are provided. One method includes defining multiple architecture blocks, each of which is a reusable piece of ML architecture, and defining multiple architecture templates, each of which is a reusable template configurable for including one or more of the multiple architecture blocks. The method also includes assigning metadata to the templates responsive to input data metrics and performance objectives for which the templates are suited. The method further includes storing the blocks, templates, and metadata in a ML library configured for use in selecting one or more of the templates for an application-specific ML architecture based on the input data metrics and the performance objectives specific to the application. Similar steps may be performed for loss functions and hyperparameters. The embodiments provide flexibility and extendibility of ML architectures for application-specific challenging scenarios for applications such as metrology.

title: Efficient normalization operations in machine learning models
description: Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques and apparatus for improved machine learning. In an example method, an input tensor comprising a plurality of segments is accessed, the input tensor generated while processing data using a machine learning model. A normalization operation of the machine learning model is applied to the input tensor by generating a mean value for a segment of the input tensor, generating an intermediate segment based on differences between the mean value and each element of the segment, generating a normalization scaling factor for the segment based on the intermediate segment, generating a scaled segment based on scaling each element of the intermediate segment using the normalization scaling factor, and generating a normalized output tensor based on at least the scaled segment.

title: Adjusting a digital representation of a head region
description: A methods for adjusting a digital representation of a head region includes identifying a target patch in the digital representation of the head region where the target patch includes a target feature of the digital representation of the head region, determining, by a first inferential model and based on a feature of the target patch, a displacement field configured to modify a relative position of a visual element of the target feature within the target patch, determining, by a second inferential model and based on the displacement field and the feature of the target patch, editing instructions configured to modify the visual element, and adjusting the target patch in the digital representation of the head region based on the editing instructions.

title: Battery Cell Process Data Analysis System and Method
description: A battery cell process data analysis system according to an embodiment includes a controller configured to obtain process data of a battery cell, estimate a predicted capacity of the battery cell based on the process data, measure an actual capacity of the battery cell, calculate a difference between the predicted capacity of the battery cell and the actual capacity of the battery cell, and determine a process factor affecting the difference by using a trained artificial intelligence model, wherein the trained artificial intelligence model includes a first artificial intelligence model and a second artificial intelligence model.

title: Systems and methods for parallel exploration of a hyperparameter search space
description: A system, method, and computer-program product includes selecting, by a controller node, a plurality of candidate hyperparameter search points from a hyperparameter search space; instructing, by the controller node, one or more worker nodes to concurrently train a plurality of machine learning models for a target number of epochs using the plurality of candidate hyperparameter search points; identifying, by the controller node, a collection of intermediate candidate hyperparameter search points that outperform a remainder of the plurality of candidate hyperparameter search points by evaluating a performance of the plurality of machine learning models after training for the target number of epochs; and performing, by the controller node, a crossover operation with the collection of intermediate candidate hyperparameter search points to identify one or more new candidate hyperparameter search points to test in the hyperparameter search space.

title: Virtual object motion generation method and apparatus, and computer device
description: This disclosure relates to a virtual object motion generation method and apparatus, and a computer device. The method includes: parsing the motion description text to obtain respective motion description information of the plurality of semantic levels; separately encoding the motion description information of the plurality of semantic levels to obtain respective motion description representations of the plurality of semantic levels; performing denoising processing at the first semantic level on the sampled noise signal based on a motion description representation of the first semantic level, to obtain a motion eigenvector; performing, at each semantic level after the first semantic level, denoising processing on the sampled noise signal based on a motion eigenvector and respective motion description representations of at least two semantic levels from the first semantic level to the current semantic level, to obtain a motion eigenvector; and decoding the motion eigenvector to obtain the virtual object motion.

title: Apparatus and method for automated microdissection of tissue from slides to optimize tissue harvest from regions of interest
description: An apparatus and method for automated microdissection of tissue from slides to optimize tissue harvest from regions of interest are disclosed. The apparatus includes at least a processor and a memory communicatively connected to the at least a processor, wherein the memory contains instructions configuring the at least a processor to receive a stained input slide, identify a region of interest on the stained input slide, generate a segmentation map of the region of interest as a function of a segmentation algorithm, register a segmented region of interest, as a function of the segmentation map, onto an unstained slide, wherein registering the segmented region of interest includes determining an orientation of the unstained slide corresponding to the segmented region of interest of the stained input slide, recording the orientation of the unstained slide relative to a reference plane, and registering the segmented region of interest to the unstained slide.

title: Event prediction method based on satellite orbit threat domain knowledge graph
description: An event prediction method based on a satellite orbit threat domain knowledge graph is provided. By constructing a knowledge graph of the satellite orbit threat domain, and utilizing steps such as meta-path extraction, hyperedge construction, feature encoding, and feature aggregation, target features that can comprehensively and accurately describe each entity and the complex relationships between each entity in the satellite orbit threat domain are obtained, and a prediction model is trained by using the target features of each entity.

title: Electrically reprogrammable nonvolatile memory device
description: An electrically plastic device comprising an amorphous silicon semiconductor layer including movable dopant formed between a pair of electrodes and; at least one gate electrode formed on said amorphous silicon semiconductor layer through an insulation layer or a high resistance layer; whereby the operation of said gate electrode controls the dopant distribution of said amorphous semiconductor layer, thereby varying the electrical conductivity thereof.

title: Enhanced interface for a neural network engine
description: An interface for a neural network includes a generalized data translator and a certainty filter in the data path including the neural network for rendering a decision on raw data, possibly from a data processing application. The data translator is controlled with user-definable parameters and procedures contained in a property list in order to manipulate translation, truncation, mapping (including weighting) and other transformations of the raw data. The neuron to which the output of the data translator is applied is controlled by a code index contained in an action list. An external certainty threshold is also provided, preferably by the action list to filter the output of the neural network. The core program used with the ConExNS neurons for system maintenance also includes further core operations and size maintenance operations responsive to commands from the user of an application to cause operations to be performed with in the neural network as well as to create and update the property and action lists.

title: Method and apparatus for determining the accuracy limit of a learning machine for predicting path performance degradation in a communications network
description: A method and apparatus for determining the accuracy limit of a learning machine for predicting path performance degradation imposed by the quality of the path performance data is disclosed. A plurality of learning machines of increasing capacity are trained using training data and tested using test data, and the training error rates and test error rates are calculated. The asymptotic error rates of the learning machines are calculated and compared. When the change in asymptotic error rate falls below a certain rate, the asymptotic error rate estimates the accuracy limit for a learning machine for predicting path performance degradation. The accuracy limit is derived from insufficiencies in the path performance data and is applicable to any learning machine trained on and applied to the path performance data, regardless of the complexity of the learning machine or the size of the training data set.

title: Information processing device and information processing method
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To reduce the processing load of calculation and to realize more accurate learning.  SOLUTION: In a quantization function of a neural network having a parameter for determining a dynamic range as an argument, a learning unit for optimizing the parameter for determining the dynamic range by an error backpropagation method and a stochastic gradient descent method is provided. , Information processing equipment is provided. Further, the processor optimizes the parameter for determining the dynamic range by the error backpropagation method and the stochastic gradient descent method in the quantization function of the neural network having the parameter for determining the dynamic range as an argument. , Information processing methods are provided. title: Information processing equipment, information processing methods and information processing programs
description: The information processing apparatus (100) according to the present disclosure uses a learned encoder to acquire a feature amount for each partial data constituting the first content, and an acquisition unit (132) for acquiring the feature amount for each acquired partial data. From the calculation unit (133) that calculates the relative feature amount series showing the features of the composition of the first content by calculating the relative feature amount that is the relative feature amount between the partial data, and the first It includes a generation unit (134) that generates a second content based on a relative feature amount series of contents and a feature amount of arbitrary data.

title: Image processing method and apparatus, and device
description: The present invention provides an image processing method. A target area and a background area are determined in an image by performing mask segmentation on the image. Different color processing modes are applied to the target area and the background area, so that luminance of the target area is greater than luminance of the background area, or chrominance of the target area is greater than chrominance of the background area, and a main object corresponding to the target area is more prominently highlighted. This enables a terminal (100) user to have a movie special effect during photographing or video photographing, and improves photographing experience of the user. In addition, the present invention further a method for determining a target area by time period and/or a method for changing a color processing mode by time period, so that a main object change and a color change of video content are more flexible and automatic, and human-computer interaction is strengthened.

title: Interactive searching system and method
description: The invention is directed to an interactive method for searching a database to locate desired items, even if the key words used as search criteria are not used to identify the item in the database. Another purpose of this invention is providing a method, which, at the same time, reduces the results list based on user's response to a set of questions.

title: Method and apparatus for learning to classify patterns and assess the value of decisions
description: An apparatus and method for training a neural network model (21) to classify patterns (26) or to assess the value of decisions associated with patterns by comprising the actual output of the network in response to an input pattern with the desired output for that pattern on the basis of a Risk Differential Learning (RDL) objective function (28), the results of the comparison governing adjustment of the neural network model's parameters by numerical optimization. The RDL objective function includes one or more terms, each being a risk/benefit/classification figure-of-merit (RBCFM) function, which is a synthetic, monotonically non-decreasing, anti-symmetric/asymmetric, piecewise-differentiable function of a risk differential (Fig. 6), which is the difference between outputs of the neural network model produced in response to a given input pattern. Each RBCFM function has mathematical attributes such that RDL can make universal guarantees of maximum correctness/profitability and minimum complexity. A strategy for profit-maximizing resource allocation utilizing RDL is also disclosed.

title: Serial weightless data to thermometer coded data converter
description: Apparatus and methods are described for converting a serial input stream of weightless binary digits into a thermometer code in which there is provided a sequence of bit stores 121, to 128 each capable of storing a binary digit. An input device (14) inputs set bits (1's) at one end of said sequence and unset bits (0's) at the other of said sequence, in each case with the existing bits being moved along in the corresponding direction to accommodate the new set bit, with the bit at the other end of the sequence being 'lost'.

title: Methods and apparatus for interactive name searching techniques
description: Methods and apparatus include presenting an initial set of names to a user. The user selects a set of names from those presented. An Interactive Evolutionary Algorithm (IEA) extracts features of each selected name from a database of names and features to form a feature set. The IEA forms a set of match features that are chosen from the feature set according to a priority function and/or weighting of the features, either of which may vary in succeeding iterations. The IEA searches the database to obtain a candidate set of names, where each name has features matching the match features. One or more names is chosen from the candidate set and added into a presentation set of names. The IEA may repeat the formation of the match features, candidate set, and selection of one or more names from the candidate set until the new presentation set is complete.

title: Lookup front end input processor
description: A packet processor provides for rule matching of packets in a network architecture. The packet processor includes a lookup cluster complex having a number of lookup engines and respective on-chip memory units. The on-chip memory stores rules for matching against packet data. A lookup front-end receives lookup requests from a host, and processes these lookup requests to generate key requests for forwarding to the lookup engines. As a result of the rule matching, the lookup engine returns a response message indicating whether a match is found. The lookup front-end further processes the response message and provides a corresponding response to the host.

title: Methods for enabling a scalable transformation of diverse data into hypotheses, models and dynamic simulations to drive the discovery of new knowledge
description: The present invention relates to a method for the automatic identification of at least one informative data filter from a data set that can be used to identify at least one relevant data subset against a target feature for subsequent hypothesis generation, model building and model testing. The present invention describes methods, and an initial implementation, for efficiently linking relevant data both within and across multiple domains and identifying informative statistical relationships across this data that can be integrated into agent-based models. The relationships, encoded by the agents, can then drive emergent behavior across the global system that is described in the integrated data environment.

title: Mechanism and method for continuous operation of a rule server
description: An improved method and mechanism is disclosed for updating rules used by a rule serve. An embodiment is directed to a method and mechanism for connecting one or more rule service agents to a rule server, in which rules may be changed and put into operation without taking the rule server offline.

title: Knowledge storage and retrieval system and method
description: A system and method for representing, storing and retrieving real-world knowledge on a computer or network of computers is disclosed. Knowledge is broken down into permanent atomic 'facts' which can be stored in a standard relational database and processed very efficiently. It also provides for the efficient querying of a knowledge base, efficient inference of new knowledge and translation into and out of natural language. Queries can also be processed with full natural language explanations of where the answers came from. The method can also be used in a distributed fashion enabling the system to be a large network of computers and the technology can be integrated into a web browser adding to the browser's functionality.

title: Method for computer-aided plant control optimisation using a simulation module
description: The present invention relates to an interactive system for optimizing computer-aided control of a technical system, for example a gas or a wind turbine, in particular for optimizing a plant's action sequence (A) or control variables (e.g. gas supply, compression) System and method, in which at least one status parameter for providing a first system status (So) of the technical system and at least one configuration parameter (W) for adapting a compensation function (RF) A terminal is provided. A simulation module (SIM) having a pre-trained neural network simulating the plant, starting from the first system state (So) and until the prediction of the resultant states (S) of the technology system, Lt; / RTI &gt; In addition, it is possible to adapt the compensation function RF based on the set parameter W, generate a plurality of action sequences A for the first system state So, and simulate these action sequences A, To the module (SIM), and an optimization module (OPT) is provided to receive the resulting states (S). The optimization module OPT is also provided for determining the compensation of the simulation results using the adapted compensation function RF and for determining the compensation-optimization action sequence A '. An output terminal OUT is provided for issuing a system state S 'resulting from the compensation-optimization action sequence A'.

title: System, method and program for analyzing blood flow by deep neural network
description: The present invention relates to a system, method, and program for analyzing a blood flow state using a deep neural network. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for analyzing a blood flow state using a deep neural network includes: a step (S100) in which an analysis server including one or more computers receives input blood flow sound wave signals from sound measurement devices attached or worn on one or more specific body parts of a user; a learning signal data generation step (S200) in which the analysis server accumulates the input blood flow sound wave signals to generate learning signal data; a blood flow state information obtaining step (S300) in which the blood flow state information is obtained by one or more computers through the analysis of the learning signal data using the deep neural network whereas the blood flow state information includes normal blood flow information and abnormal feature information; a step (S400) of using the deep neural network to analyze the learning signal data and searching and matching the abnormal situation data with the fitting abnormal feature information; a step (S500) of searching for the abnormal feature information in the input blood flow sound wave signals of the specific user obtained on a real-time basis; and a step (S600) of predicting the occurrence of a specific abnormal situation based on the matching relationship between the abnormal feature information and the abnormal situation. The present invention can diagnose the blood pressure state by using the blood flow sound wave signals to predict the occurrence of an abnormal symptom on blood vessels in a specific body part of the user.

title: Human machine interface system
description: The HMI system provides state information indicating a state of a machine to a display device according to an embodiment of the present invention. The HMI system includes device information of a display device and user experience information, which is a history of use of the display device, And an HMI content server that generates content information for adjusting the size and position of the module of the content provided to the display device when the HMI combines the device information and the user experience information.

title: Quantine representation for emulating quantum-like computation on a classical processor
description: Quanton virtual machines approximate solutions to NP-hard problems in the factorial space in polynomial time. Data representations and methods emulate quantum computing in classical hardware, but also implement quantum computing when implemented in quantum hardware. Quanton shows quantum gates and operation using permutations indexed by the Le Mans code and the permutation operator. The generation function embeds the index into the geometric object for efficient compact representation. The nonlinear directional probability distribution is embedded in the manifold and there is a linear probability distribution in the tangent space for each index point. The simple vector operation on the distribution corresponds to the quantum gate operation. Quanton provides superposition, quantization, and entangled surrogates that are characteristic of quantum computing. The Quantum population evolves as a solution candidate in the local evolutionary gate operation or distribution algorithm estimation that solves the problem. Quanton uses modular arithmetic on permutations and is therefore fully parallel in any hardware.

title: Non-contact biosignal detecting method and apparatus thereof
description: A non-contact biological signal detection method and apparatus are disclosed. The method of detecting a heartbeat according to an exemplary embodiment includes receiving a speech signal and extracting a plurality of feature signals reflecting a characteristic of a vocal cord from the speech signal And detecting the biological signal based on the plurality of characteristic signals.

title: Anomaly detection
description: Disclosed is a computer program stored in a computer-readable storage medium to provide a data processing method using artificial intelligence. The computer program performs the following method for anomaly detection of data using a network function if executed by one or more processors. The method comprises: a step of generating an anomaly detection model including a plurality of anomaly detection submodels including a network function pre-learned by using a plurality of learning data subsets included in a learning data set; a step of using at least one among the generated plurality of anomaly detection submodels to calculate input data; and a step of determining whether an anomaly exists in input data of at least one among the generated plurality of anomaly detection submodels based on output data for the input data and the input data.

title: Diagnosis method of electric transformer using Deep Learning
description: The present invention relates to a method for diagnosing a transformer state through deep learning, and specifically, to collect mechanical vibration and acoustic signals generated from transmission and distribution transformers using a sensor, and to determine the condition of a facility and an abnormality. The present invention relates to a method of predicting and diagnosing a transformer failure with low cost and high accuracy.

title: Surveillance camera system including Augmented Reality mobile device and the control method thereof
description: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a surveillance camera system including an augmented reality mobile device comprises: a plurality of surveillance cameras photographing a monitoring area; an augmented reality mobile device receiving location information of each surveillance camera by performing near field communication with the surveillance cameras; and a surveillance server connected to the surveillance cameras and augmented reality mobile device through a communication network to receive basic location information and image information of the surveillance cameras and transmitting basic location information and image information of a surveillance camera to the mobile device in response to a request for confirmation from the mobile device. The augmented reality mobile device detects distances with adjacent surveillance cameras and monitors an image of at least one of the adjacent surveillance cameras through a display unit of the mobile device based on the detected distances.

title: Method and apparatus for predicting the result of games
description: Disclosed is a method and apparatus for predicting a match in a soccer match using an ensemble model. The game prediction method includes the steps of collecting game data for past games, performing data preprocessing on the game data, learning a plurality of game prediction models using the game data on which data preprocessing has been performed, and And obtaining a predicted value of a match result by using a plurality of game prediction models.

title: Classification method using distributed classification model
description: Disclosed is a method for classifying target data into a specific class by distributing a previously learned classification model to several terminals. The disclosed classification method using a distributed classification model comprises the steps of: receiving classification data for target data generated through a sub-classification model distributed to each of the plurality of terminals; and determining the final class for the target data using the classification data. A class for classification allocated to each of the previously learned sub-classification models includes at least one of the plurality of target classes. The number of classes allocated to each of the sub-classification model is less than the number of target classes. Therefore, the classification method can stably acquire a classification result.

title: Vehicle front object detection system and method
description: The present invention is a slope driving recognition unit configured to recognize the slope situation of the vehicle; a camera provided in the front part of the vehicle; an angle adjusting unit capable of adjusting the angle of the camera with respect to the vehicle body; an information analysis unit for analyzing information about a front object detected by the camera; a control unit for controlling the uphill driving recognition unit, the angle adjustment unit, and the information analysis unit, and generating a control signal based on the information on the front object analyzed by the information analysis unit; and a control operation unit of the vehicle driven according to the control signal of the control unit.

title: Processing apparatus, measurement apparatus, lithography apparatus, method of manufacturing article, model, processing method, measurement method, generation method, and generation apparatus
description: The present invention provides a processing apparatus comprising: a generator configured to generate position information of an object to be measured in a first direction on the basis of image data of the object to be measured; and a determiner configured to determine a confidence of the location information of the object to be measured generated by the generator on the basis of feature vectors of the image data with respect to a second direction different from the first direction.

title: Method and system for predicting responsiveness to theraphy for cancer patent
description: A method for predicting responsiveness to cancer patient treatment according to an embodiment of the present disclosure includes obtaining a pathological slide image, information on a plurality of immune cells and information on a plurality of tumor cells included in the pathological slide image Determining, calculating an immune-tumor cell interaction score (Lymphocyte & Tumor cell Interaction Score) based on the information on the plurality of immune cells and the information on the plurality of tumor cells, and using the interaction score to slide the pathology predicting a responsiveness to a cancer patient treatment associated with the image.

title: Computer system for multi-source domain adaptative training based on single neural network wothout overfitting, and method thereof
description: Various embodiments relate to a computer system for multi domain adaptive training based on a single neural network without overfitting and a method thereof. The various embodiments are configured to normalize data sets of multiple domains, extract shared information which is shared between the normalized data sets, perform training on the basis of the extracted shared information to implement a training model, and transplant the training model to a target domain.

title: System and method for predicting and analyzing trouble of mechanical equipment using federated learning
description: The present invention relates to a system and method for predictive analysis of mechanical equipment failure using federated learning, which is implemented to perform predictive analysis of mechanical equipment failure in real time based on AI (artificial intelligence) using federated learning. The collector collects IoT data from the hardware; The federated learner receives the IoT data collected by the data collector and performs federated learning to generate federated learning data; The AI predictive analyzer receives the federated learning data generated by the federated learner and performs real-time predictive analysis of machine failures based on AI.

title: Methods and apparatus to load data within a machine learning accelerator
description: A method, apparatus, system, and article of manufacture for loading data into an accelerator are disclosed. An exemplary apparatus includes data provider circuitry for loading a first section and an additional amount of compressed machine learning parameter data into a processor engine. A processor engine circuit executes a machine learning operation using the first section of the compressed machine learning parameter data. The compressed local data reuser circuit determines whether the second section is present in the additional amount of compressed machine learning parameter data. The processor engine circuit uses the second section to execute the machine learning operation when the second section is present in the additional amount of compressed machine learning parameter data.

title: Vision inspection apparatus and method for detecting product defects
description: Disclosed is a vision inspection method for detecting a product defect, the vision inspection method comprising: a step in which a Convolutional Auto-Encoder (CAE) returns a product image including a defect of a product into a normal image from which the defect is removed; a step in which a self-replication CAE returns the product image into a defect image including the defect thereof; and a step of comparing the normal image to the defect image to detect a pixel corresponding to the defect, and detecting the defect of the product based on the detected pixels. Therefore, an outward defect of a semiconductor package may be detected.

title: Method and apparatus for conditional data genration using conditional wasserstein generator
description: By using a device for generating conditional data according to one aspect of the present invention, a method for generating the conditional data that generates target data for the conditional data comprises a step of generating the target data for the condition data by inputting the received condition data to a learned conditional and a sustain generator. Here, a conditional Wasserstein generator is learned based on an equation representing a Wasserstein distance between the conditional distributions. Therefore, the present invention is capable of expecting a clearer and more accurate conditional data generation.

title: Systems and methods for improved facial attribute classification and its use
description: A deep learning supervised regression-based model including methods and systems for facial attribute prediction and its use is described. An example of use is an augmented and/or virtual reality interface to present a modified image in response to facial attribute predictions determined from the image. Facial effects matching the facial attributes are selected to be applied to the interface.

title: Manufacture of a recursive flow gas distribution stack using multiple layers
description: The method includes receiving one or more parameters associated with a plurality of metal plates. The method further includes determining a plurality of predicted strain values associated with the plurality of metal plates based on the one or more parameters. Each of the plurality of predicted deformation values corresponds to a corresponding one of the plurality of metal plates. The method further includes causing the plurality of metal plates to be diffusion bonded based on the plurality of predicted strain values to create a bonded metal plate structure.

title: Automatic voice data inspection system and method using deep learning
description: A voice data automatic inspection system using deep learning is provided. A voice data automatic inspection system using deep learning according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a voice data pre-processor that obtains n pieces of voice data, pre-processes them, and outputs voice data classified according to a preset classification; a pre-acoustic processing unit that generates a pre-acoustic model using the classified voice data and outputs a verification set, which is a set of selected voice data from among the classified voice data, using the generated pre-acoustic model; and a verification sound generation unit that generates a verification acoustic model using the verification set, determines whether or not each of the n voice data is defective using the generated verification acoustic model, and outputs a result.

title: System and method for customized advertisement interworking with medical information analysis service
description: An apparatus for targeting medical advertisements according to an embodiment includes a receiver configured to receive medical information including a plurality of attributes from one or more terminals; a first generator configured to generate summary information extracted from the medical information based on at least one of the plurality of attributes; a second generator generating a summary vector corresponding to the summary information by digitizing the summary information using a pre-learned model; a calculation unit that calculates a degree of matching between the summary vector and a plurality of candidate products using a preset function; and a determination unit for determining an advertisement target product to be displayed on an advertisement target terminal among a plurality of candidate products based on the matching degree.

title: 3D Modeling Generation System and Method Based on Deep Learning and Point Cloud Data Acquisition Using Mobile object
description: The present invention is a system in which a control server 10 having an arithmetic function and a database 20 storing point cloud data information are connected through a network and form a 3D modeling using transfer learning, wherein the control server 10 is a mobile body ( 110) a data acquisition unit 100 that collects point cloud data for facilities through the point cloud data acquisition means 120 mounted on the facility; a data matching unit 200 matching the obtained point cloud data; and a model learning unit 300 having a model selection unit 310 that selects a 3D semantic segmentation model with the matched data and a transfer learning unit 320 that performs transfer learning. It is a system for collecting point cloud data and forming 3D modeling based on deep learning.

title: Neuromorphic apparatus
description: The present invention relates to a neuromorphic apparatus and a method for driving the same. The neuromorphic apparatus comprises: an electrode which includes a first terminal connected to a bit line and a second terminal connected to a source line through a write driving transistor; a plurality of unit weight elements each of which includes a free layer disposed on the electrode, a tunnel barrier layer disposed on the free layer, and a fixed layer disposed on the tunnel barrier layer, corresponds to each bit of a synaptic weight, and has different resistance values; and a plurality of control electrodes each of which is connected to a bit line through a plurality of read driving transistors, and applies a control voltage between the free layer and the fixed layer of each of the plurality of unit weight elements.

title: Electronic device and method for operating file system
description: An electronic device, according to various embodiments, comprises a memory (random access memory), a storage, and a processor. The processor may control to write a file of an application on the memory in response to a file input request of the application; monitor a write pattern of the file at a first point of writing the file of the application on the memory and update the same on the memory; classify the file into one of a hot file and a cold file based on the write pattern of the file at a second point of copying the file written on the memory to the storage; and store a classification result of the file in the storage along with the file or divide the file into a first region or a second region to store in the storage based on the classification result of the file. Herein, the hot file has modification and/or deletion occurring more frequently than the cold file, and the cold file has modification and/or deletion occurring less frequently than the hot file. The write pattern may comprise a degree of modification of the file. According to the present invention, the electronic device uses identifiable write patterns to predict types of files even when a file extension or directory setting does not exist or is ambiguous.

title: Computing device for predicting resist profile using deep learning and operating method thereof
description: A method of operating a computing device for predicting a profile using deep learning according to the present invention includes sampling a unique pattern from a full chip, and performing a rigorous simulation corresponding to the unique pattern. extracting the contour of each resist profile of a plurality of heights, preparing an input image and an output image corresponding to each contour of the plurality of heights, and the extraction using the input image and the output image It may include performing deep learning on the contour, and generating a profile prediction model according to the deep learning.

title: Method of Automatically Operating Power Grid via Semi-Markov Afterstate Actor-Critic
description: A method for automatically operating a power grid using semi-Markov post-state actor-critic is disclosed. This method uses power grid topology configuration information (connectivity information of each power line in the power grid and bus bar allocation status information of each substation) and power amount information of power grid components (amount of power produced and provided by each power plant in the power grid, Based on the state information of the power grid, which includes the amount of power required by each load of the power grid, the amount of power carried by each power line, and information on the period during which each power line was overloaded), the ideal power grid connection state expressed as graph structure data Create the target topology. To this end, the state information of the power grid can be converted into graph structure data in which power plants, power loads, and power lines connected to each substation are used as nodes. Based on the created target topology, it controls the connection of power lines and the assignment of bus bars in substations.

title: Method and apparatus learning facial feature extractor for low-resolution face recognition
description: The present invention relates to a low-resolution face recognition device.  The present invention includes a high-resolution face image input device that inputs a high-resolution face image; A low-resolution face image input device that inputs a low-resolution face image; A high-resolution facial feature extractor that extracts high-resolution facial features using high-resolution facial images and low-resolution facial images; A facial quality feature extractor that extracts facial quality features using high-resolution face images and low-resolution face images; a feature combiner that concatenates high-resolution facial features and facial quality features to detect high-resolution facial features and low-resolution facial features, respectively; and a feature adaptation network that converts high-resolution facial features and low-resolution facial features using the detected high-resolution facial features and low-resolution facial features, respectively. and a similarity meter that determines a face ID by measuring the similarity of facial features using the extracted high-resolution facial features and low-resolution facial features.

title: Method for providing transportation service, apparatus and computer program for performing the method
description: The transportation service provision method according to a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the device for performing the same, and the computer program take into account not only waiting vehicles waiting to use the transportation service, but also return vehicles that are expected to be returned after the use of the transportation service has ended. By providing information about vehicles that can be reserved according to a vehicle reservation request, user satisfaction can be improved by expanding the range of vehicles that the user can select.

title: Method of correcting layout for semiconductor process using machine learning and method of manufacturing semiconductor device using the same
description: In a layout correction method for a semiconductor process, a design layout including a layout pattern for forming a process pattern of a semiconductor device is received. A first layout correction operation using a first machine learning model is performed on the design layout. A second layout correction operation is performed on the design layout using a second machine learning model that is different from the first machine learning model. Based on the result of the first layout correction operation and the result of the second layout correction operation, a correction layout including a correction layout pattern corresponding to the layout pattern is obtained.

title: Location decision method for a charging station of electric vehicle
description: The present invention relates to a method for selecting a location of an electric vehicle charging station. according to the present invention, it is possible to improve the efficiency of generating similar learning data by providing a common framework that supports latitude and longitude and lattice data conversion, to upgrade a location selection algorithm that comprehensively considers traffic volume, electric vehicle operation patterns, environmental factors, etc., to improve the visualization performance of q-gis through an effective visualization method of a vast amount of map data, and to be used as a hydrogen vehicle location selection algorithm.

title: Method And Apparatus to Generating Mental State Inference Using Artificial Neural Network
description: The present disclosure provides a psychological state inference device and method using an artificial neural network. According to one aspect of the present disclosure, a psychological state inference device and method with improved accuracy compared to existing methods are provided by extracting compressed feature information for psychological state inference from various information included in a video.

title: Defect detection device and defect detection method
description: The technical idea of the present invention includes the steps of irradiating light to a substrate; Obtaining a spectral image representing the amount of light according to wavelength from the reflected light reflected from the substrate; performing an EDS test on the substrate; inspecting defects in each of the plurality of blocks of the substrate based on the results of the EDS test; generating a defect map indicating a defect level for each of the plurality of blocks based on the defects; matching the spectral image and the defect map to generate spectral image information including the spectral image and defect information corresponding to the spectral image; Learning a defect detection model using the defect grade as an output value and the spectral image information as an input value; Obtaining a target spectrum image for the target substrate; For the target spectrum image, extracting a feature vector from the target spectrum image using the defect detection model, and detecting a target defect grade of the target spectrum image based on the feature vector; and generating a target defect map based on the target defect level.

title: A method for providing visual feedback on whether a goal has been achieved using an image generation model, and an electronic device in which the method is implemented
description: According to one embodiment of the present disclosure, an electronic device may be provided, comprising a memory and at least one processor electronically connected to the memory, wherein the at least one processor is configured to obtain target data, set target achievement information based on the target data, obtain a target image set including a plurality of target images based on the target data, the plurality of target images corresponding to a plurality of target achievement levels, provide a first level image corresponding to a current target achievement level of the user based on target achievement information associated with target achievement of the user, provide a second level image corresponding to an improved target achievement level when the target achievement level of the user determined based on the target achievement information has improved, and provide a target achievement image when the target achievement of the user has been completed.

title: Wearable electronic device for providing medication determination result based on sensor, server and operation method of the same
description: According to various embodiments, a wearable device may be provided, comprising: a communication circuit; at least one sensor; a camera; and at least one processor; wherein the at least one processor obtains activation data from a wireless communication device physically connected to a target object for medication through the communication circuit, activates a specific sensor having a preset authority among at least one sensor based on the activation data, obtains at least one value based on the activated specific sensor, and the at least one value represents a medication action of a user using the target object, and is set to transmit the at least one value to the outside through the communication circuit, and a medication judgment result for the medication action of the user is obtained based on the at least one value. Various other embodiments are possible.

title: Server and method for providing online transaction service and web 3.0-based NFT content transaction service
description: The present disclosure relates to a system that orders products and services and provides an NFT-based content transaction platform, and provides a service that provides a product list to a user's terminal when it is recognized that the user has approached or entered a store within a preset distance, so that the user can place an order from the terminal, a service that can produce and sell NFT content, and a service that can provide appropriate rewards to users who have sold NFT content according to an algorithm.

title: Safe bus platform based on renewable energy and artificial intelligence
description: The present invention relates to a bus stop. According to one embodiment of the present invention, a bus stop comprises: a power generation unit that generates electric energy using renewable energy; an energy storage unit that stores electric energy produced by the power generation unit; a danger guidance unit that outputs voice information; a monitoring unit that collects surveillance information about the passengers; a waiting guidance unit that outputs a waiting state of the passengers; a platform management unit that controls the danger guidance unit and the waiting guidance unit according to the location of the passengers estimated based on the surveillance information collected by the monitoring unit; and a charging unit that provides charging to the smart devices and transportation means of the passengers; wherein the energy storage unit provides power to the danger guidance unit, the monitoring unit, the waiting guidance unit, and the charging unit, and the platform management unit can provide a control signal for providing danger guidance voice information to the danger guidance unit when the bus is approaching the bus stop and the location of the passengers is included in a pre-set danger zone, and outputting guidance indicating the waiting to the waiting guidance unit when the passengers are located inside the bus stop.

title: Vehicle information estimation device, system and method combining spatiotemporal feature information
description: The present invention relates to a vehicle information estimation device, system, and method for estimating vehicle information by fusing spatiotemporal feature information. The vehicle information estimation device according to the present invention includes an interface unit and a control unit. The interface unit collects image information on a vehicle driving on a road from a CCTV installed on the road. The control unit designates a vehicle information collection area from the collected image information. The control unit detects a vehicle within the collection area and acquires spatial feature information of the detected vehicle. After acquiring the spatial feature information, the control unit collects temporal feature information, which is a change in the spatial feature information during the monitoring time. In addition, the control unit estimates vehicle information after the monitoring time of the detected vehicle by fusing the spatial feature information and the temporal feature information.

title: Apparatus for estimating question difficulty for video question answering and method thereof
description: A device and method for estimating question difficulty for video question-answering (QA) are disclosed. The device is a device for estimating question difficulty for video question-answering (QA), comprising: a video modality network encoding an input video into a corresponding video representation, and generating a sequential representation of the video during encoding; and a text modality network generating a text representation corresponding to a query and a subtitle corresponding to the video, and generating the sequential representation of the text during generation of the text representation. The device further comprises a directional modality association transformer generating a video representation carried by a text modality and a text representation carried by the video modality using the sequential representation of the video and the sequential representation of the text. The device further comprises an average pooler generating a final representation by average-pooling connections of the video representation, the text representation, the video representation carried by the text modality, and the text representation carried by the video modality; and a classifier determining a difficulty level for a query based on the final representation.

title: Method and apparatus for performing visualization for cognitive digital twin
description: Embodiments provide a visualization method and device for a cognitive digital twin. According to one embodiment, the method implements a three-dimensional virtual space for a building based on spatial semantic information about the building, the three-dimensional virtual space for the building includes at least one layer, and each of the at least one layer includes a plurality of unit spaces interconnected by a plurality of entrance doors, acquires information about a plurality of security camera terminals installed in the building, and the information about the plurality of security camera terminals includes location information of each of the plurality of security camera terminals, field of view information of each of the plurality of security camera terminals, and direction information of each of the plurality of security camera terminals, generates a view frustum cone for each of the plurality of security camera terminals based on the information about the plurality of security camera terminals, determines a plurality of contact points between the generated plurality of view frustum cones and the floor surface of each of the plurality of unit spaces, and generates an image coverage polygon for each of the plurality of unit spaces based on the plurality of contact points, and detects the occurrence of an event through an object detection model using a first neural network and an event detection model using a second neural network based on a plurality of images received in real time from the plurality of security camera terminals, and displays the occurrence of the event on a two-dimensional space map displayed on a screen of a user terminal. A step may be included to highlight in real time the area of the video coverage polygon of the security camera terminal where the occurrence was detected. For example, the two-dimensional space map may be generated based on a three-dimensional virtual space for the building and may include areas for multiple video coverage polygons.

title: Apparatus for predicting sepsis of neonate and method for generating sepsis prediction model of neonate
description: The present invention relates to a device for predicting sepsis in a newborn and a method for generating a model for predicting sepsis in a newborn. The device for predicting sepsis according to an embodiment of the present invention is characterized by including: an input unit into which diagnostic data regarding a newborn is input; a biosignal extraction unit for extracting multiple types of biosignals from the diagnostic data input through the input unit; a preprocessing unit for preprocessing the multiple types of biosignals extracted by the biosignal extraction unit so that they correspond to each other in time series; and an artificial intelligence-based sepsis prediction model for inferring whether or not sepsis is present by receiving the biosignals preprocessed by the preprocessing unit.

title: Aiops-based artificial intelligence model and big data management system for coastal disaster response
description: A system according to an exemplary embodiment may include a real-time data processing unit that collects real-time marine disaster data, extracts real-time features for the real-time marine disaster data, stores the real-time features in an online feature store, generates prompts based on the real-time features, and generates and provides real-time marine disaster integrated information using generative AI based on the prompts; and a batch data processing unit that collects non-real-time marine disaster data, extracts batch features for the non-real-time marine disaster data, stores the batch features in an offline feature store, and trains a supervised learning-based model based on the batch features. The real-time marine disaster integrated information may include at least one of a real-time marine disaster situation analysis result, response procedure information, and a warning message, and the supervised learning-based model may be trained to perform marine disaster prediction and ship route prediction.

title: List-wise learning-to-rank method and system for profit maximization of recommender systems
description: A method for learning a list-wise ranking for maximizing profit in a recommendation system and a system thereof are disclosed. In one embodiment, the method for learning a list-wise ranking for maximizing profit in a recommendation system may include: injecting user feedback on items having a profit higher than a preset standard among unused items from users into a user-item feedback matrix; determining a proximity-to-the-current-preference (PCP) for items related to the user based on the user-item feedback matrix into which the user feedback has been injected; and learning a list-wise ranking for items related to the user using the determined proximity to the user's current preference.

title: Convolution acceleration using activation static vectorization
description: Systems and techniques for processing image data are provided. Each first value enclosed by a convolution kernel at each position of a plurality of positions of a convolution kernel along a row of image data can be obtained and stored using a respective memory location associated with each position of the plurality of positions. Based on each first value, an accumulated value corresponding to a convolution output for each position of the plurality of positions can be updated. A plurality of second values enclosed by the convolution kernel at each position of the plurality of positions can be obtained. The plurality of second values include a subset of each of the first values and an additional second value. A memory location used to store a first value not included in the plurality of second values can be updated to store the additional second value.

title: A computing device and a method for data replication
description: According to one embodiment of the present disclosure, a computing device may be provided, comprising a memory and at least one processor electronically connected to the memory, wherein the at least one processor is configured to perform the following operations: acquiring a first data set; embedding the first data set in an embedding region of a specific dimension to acquire a first vector set corresponding to the first data set; acquiring a density value of at least one vector included in the first vector set based on a distance between at least two vectors among a plurality of vectors included in the first vector set; acquiring target data based on the first data set; and generating a first composite vector that is spaced apart from a first vector corresponding to first target data among a plurality of vectors included in the first vector set by a first threshold distance or more, wherein the first threshold distance is set based on the density value of the first vector.

title: Method and process for semantic or faceted search over unstructured and annotated data
description: A semantic query over a corpus of data is constructed using a graphical user interface to create an aggregation of graphical representations of annotations associated with a plurality of data elements contained within the corpus of data and graphical representations of search terms contained within the plurality of data elements. The aggregation includes at least one annotation and at least one search term. The relative positions of the graphical representations of the annotations and the search terms are manipulated within the aggregation within the graphical user interface to express relationships among the annotations and search terms, yielding a visual spatial representation of the semantic query. The annotations, search terms and expressed relationships define the semantic query that is used to search the corpus of data.

title: On-the fly pattern recognition with configurable bounds
description: Some embodiments of on-the-fly pattern recognition with configurable bounds have been presented. In one embodiment, a pattern matching engine is configured based on user input, which may include values of one or more user configurable bounds on searching. Then the configured pattern matching engine is used to search for a set of features in an incoming string. A set of scores is updated based on the presence of any of the features in the string while searching for the features. Each score may indicate a likelihood of the content of the string being in a category. The search is terminated if the end of the string is reached or if the user configurable bounds are met. After terminating the search, the scores are output.

title: Systems and methods for drilling fluids expert systems using bayesian decision networks
description: Provided are systems and methods for drilling fluids expert systems using Bayesian decision networks to determine drilling fluid recommendations. A drilling fluids expert system includes a drilling fluids Bayesian decision network (BDN) model that receives inputs and outputs recommendations based on Bayesian probability determinations. The drilling fluids BDN model includes a temperature ranges uncertainty node, a formation uncertainty node, a potential hole problems uncertainty node, and a drilling fluids decision node.

title: Inferring user preferences from an internet based social interactive construct
description: In embodiments of the present invention improved capabilities are described for a computer program product embodied in a computer readable medium that, when executing on one or more computers, helps determine an unknown user's preferences through the use of internet based social interactive graphical representations on a computer facility by performing the steps of (1) ascertaining preferences of a plurality of users who are part of an inter-net based social interactive construct, wherein the plurality of users become a plurality of known users; (2) determining the internet based social interactive graphical representation for the plurality of known users; and (3) inferring the preferences of an unknown user present in the interact based social interactive graphical representation of the plurality of known users based on the interrelationships between the unknown user and the plurality of known users within the graphical representation.

title: Machine learning system for assessing heart valves and surrounding cardiovascular tracts
description: A machine learning system for evaluating at least one characteristic of a heart valve, an inflow tract, an outflow tract or a combination thereof may include a training mode and a production mode. The training mode may be configured to train a computer and construct a transformation function to predict an unknown anatomical characteristic and/or an unknown physiological characteristic of a heart valve, inflow tract and/or outflow tract, using a known anatomical characteristic and/or a known physiological characteristic the heart valve, inflow tract and/or outflow tract. The production mode may be configured to use the transformation function to predict the unknown anatomical characteristic and/or the unknown physiological characteristic of the heart valve, inflow tract and/or outflow tract, based on the known anatomical characteristic and/or the known physiological characteristic of the heart valve, inflow tract and/or outflow tract.

title: METHOD FOR CONDITIONING AN INTRA-FRAME CODEC INTO AN END-TO-END LEARNED CODEC
description: A method, an apparatus, and a software product are provided. In the context of a method, the method receives fundamental truth data from a first codec. Based on the fundamental truth data, the method generates a first bitstream. Based on the first bitstream, the method generates initial reconstruction data, wherein the initial reconstruction data comprises a reconstruction of the fundamental truth data. The method outputs the initial reconstruction data via the first codec. The method determines residual fundamental truth data based at least on the initial reconstruction data and the fundamental truth data. The method determines auxiliary data based at least on the first bitstream or on data derived from the first bitstream. The method receives the residual fundamental truth data and the auxiliary data via a second codec. Based on the residual fundamental truth data and the auxiliary data, the method generates a second bitstream.

title: SPECULATIVE DECODING IN AUTOREGRESSIVE GENERATIVE ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE MODELS
description: Certain aspects of this description provide techniques and apparatus for generating a response to a query input in a generative artificial intelligence model. One example method typically includes receiving a plurality of token sets generated based on an input cue and a first generative artificial intelligence model, each token set in the plurality of token sets corresponding to a candidate response to the input cue; selecting, using a second generative artificial intelligence model and recursively fitting a target distribution associated with the received plurality of token sets, a set of tokens from the plurality of token sets; and issuing the selected set of tokens as a response to the input cue.

title: Apparatus and method for making a judgement on positive and negative intention by using the EEG
description: The present invention relates to a positive / negative pseudo-discrimination device using EEG, a method thereof, and a recording medium. The present invention relates to an increase / decrease of the output of EEG over time and synchronization of the EEG measured in the left / right brain under a general computing environment. In order to provide a positive / negative pseudo-fractionation device and a method and a recording medium for discriminating positive / negative physicians (yes / no), Four-Eye data of unit time measured from two electrodes attached to the forehead of the left / right brain are collected. A first step of converting to obtain synchronization of the output and left / right brain waves for each frequency; A second step of repeatedly performing the first step to obtain time zone output and time-to-synchronization with respect to each frequency to increase and decrease with time of output and synchronization; And a third step of discriminating positive / negative intentions by inputting the increase and decrease of the output and synchronization for each frequency into the artificial neural network, and used for a machine operated as a positive / negative pseudo (yes / no). .

title: METHOD OF INDIVIDUAL MICROCLIMATE MANAGEMENT OF BUILDINGS AND ITS IMPLEMENTATION SYSTEM
description: The invention is intended to realize a method for regulating the microclimate and a system implementing the regulation, which creates a special effect and analyzes the level of human ability to work, depending on the created microclimate in the workplace. This system makes it possible to increase overall work efficiency and ensures the maintenance and extension of a particularly useful period of human working capacity by changing the microclimate parameters of the workplace according to short- and medium-term reactions of the employee's emotional and affective state and physiological state. The invention provides a proposed method of individual microclimate management and its implementation system.

title: Fuzzy logic controller with optimized memory organization
description: (57) [Summary] This bulletin contains application data before electronic filing, so abstract data is not recorded.

title: Method and system of using network graph properties to predict vertex behavior
description: Network graphs are determined using data about the vertices. Vertices are clustered into community of vertices based on maximizing the density of linkages within each community. Vertex properties describing the extent to which each vertex's community has exhibited a particular behavior are determined. Vertex properties describing whether the most important vertex in each community has exhibited a particular behavior are determined. Functions describing the relationship between these two categories of vertex properties and other relevant vertex properties, and a particular behavior are determined. These functions are used to predict the likelihood of each vertex exhibiting the particular behavior.

title: Method for Selecting Neighborhoods of Training Points for Local Learning
description: A method selects a subset of training points near a query point from a set of training points. The subset of training points near the query point is determined from a the set of training points such that a cumulative similarity is maximized, wherein the cumulative similarity measures a similarity of the query point to each point in the subset and a similarity of points in the subset to each other.

title: Method and Apparatus for Neutron Porosity Measurement Using a Neural Network
description: A method of estimating formation porosity using a neural network for neutron porosity tools. In the training stage, the near-to-far ratio, environmental variables, such as mineralogy, borehole size, standoff etc., are fed to the inputs and the neural network is trained for obtaining the related true porosity (the output). The trained neural network is implanted into tool's firmware for the real time porosity measurement, accounting for the environmental effects considered during training

title: Method and System for Word Sequence Processing
description: A method and system of conducting named entity recognition. One method comprises selecting one or more examples for human labelling, each example comprising a word sequence containing a named entity and its context; and retraining a model for the named entity recognition based on the labelled examples as training data.

title: Constructing a bayesian network based on received events associated with network entities
description: Records of events associated with network entities in a network environment are received, where the network entities are selected from hardware entities, software entities, and combinations of hardware and software entities. The records of the events are identified to identify relationships between events associated with different ones of the network entities, where the records of the events identify corresponding network entities impacted by the events. A Bayesian network is constructed based on the analyzing, wherein the constructed Bayesian network is able to make predictions regarding relationships between events associated with the network elements.

title: Context Accumulation Based on Properties of Entity Features
description: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a system for determining related entities includes at least one processor. The system identifies one or more candidate entities for a data object associated with an entity based on one or more features. The entity and candidate entities are each associated with one or more features and each feature is associated with one or more behaviors. The identified candidate entities related to the entity are determined based on the associated behaviors of the features of the identified candidate entities and the entity. Embodiments of the present invention further include a method and computer program product for determining related entities in substantially the same manner described above.

title: Using data from a wearable device to determine and present activities for types of individuals
description: The methods and systems described herein may involve determining at least one lifeotype of at least one individual, analyzing the at least one lifeotype, and delivering content to at least one individual based on the analysis. The methods and systems described herein may involve providing a game, determining at least one lifeotype of at least one player of the game, analyzing the at least one lifeotype, and affecting the game play based on the analysis. The methods and systems described herein may involve providing an interactive space, determining at least one lifeotype of at least one individual in the space, analyzing the at least one lifeotype, and modifying at least one attribute of the space based on the analysis.

title: Systems and Methods for Artificial Intelligence Decision Making in a Virtual Environment
description: Disclosed is a AI decision making solution under which the actions, reactions and behavior of an AI entity are defined in a virtual environment. In addition to gathering user interactive data within a given scenario, the disclosed principles also provide for a periodic analysis of the entire virtual environment, regardless of user interaction. This allows the disclosed AI entity to make more accurate decisions by constantly taking into account the status of the environment in addition to user interactions with the environment or other characters. Also, the disclosed principles provide an AI solution capable of modifying not only the weights assignable to data used in the decision making process, but also modifying the actual rules of the decision making process itself depending on the gathered and analyzed weighted data. As a result, the disclosed AI entity is capable of making varying decisions on the same or similar collection of data.

title: Data from wearable sensor devices to manage educational content
description: The methods and systems described herein may involve determining at least one lifeotype of at least one individual, analyzing the at least one lifeotype, and delivering content to at least one individual based on the analysis. The methods and systems described herein may involve providing a game, determining at least one lifeotype of at least one player of the game, analyzing the at least one lifeotype, and affecting the game play based on the analysis. The methods and systems described herein may involve providing an interactive space, determining at least one lifeotype of at least one individual in the space, analyzing the at least one lifeotype, and modifying at least one attribute of the space based on the analysis.

title: Distributed similarity learning for high-dimensional image features
description: A system and method for distributed similarity learning for high-dimensional image features are described. A set of data features is accessed.
