Subspaces from a space formed by the set of data features are determined using a set of projection matrices. Each subspace has a dimension lower than a dimension of the set of data features. Similarity functions are computed for the subspaces. Each similarity function is based on the dimension of the corresponding subspace. A linear combination of the similarity functions is performed to determine a similarity function for the set of data features.

title: Ambipolar synaptic devices
description: Device architectures based on trapping and de-trapping holes or electrons and/or recombination of both types of carriers are obtained by carrier trapping either in near-interface deep ambipolar states or in quantum wells/dots, either serving as ambipolar traps in semiconductor layers or in gate dielectric/barrier layers. In either case, the potential barrier for trapping is small and retention is provided by carrier confinement in the deep trap states and/or quantum wells/dots. The device architectures are usable as three terminal or two terminal devices.

title: Device and method for the autonomous bootstrapping of unified sentience
description: A system for monitoring an environment may include an input device for monitoring and capturing pattern-based states of a model of the environment. The system may also include a 5 thalamobot embodied in at least a first processor, in which the first processor is in communication with the input device. The thalamobot may include at least one filter for monitoring captured data from the input device and for identifying at least one state change within the captured data. The system may also include at least one critic and/or at least one recognition system.

title: Reader learning method and device, data recognition method and device
description: A recognizer training method and apparatus includes selecting training data, generating clusters by clustering the selected training data based on a global shape parameter, and classifying training data from at least one cluster based on a local shape feature.

title: Classifying test data based on a maximum margin classifier
description: Systems and methods for classifying test data based on maximum margin classifier are described. In one implementation, the method includes obtaining training data having a predefined sample size, wherein the training data is composed of separable data-sets. For the training data, a Vapnik-Chervonenkis (VC) dimension for the training data is determined. For the VC dimension, an exact bound is subsequently determined. The exact bound may be minimized for obtaining the minimum VC classifier for predicting at least one class to which samples of the training data belong.

title: Flexible, personalized student success modeling for institutions with complex term structures and competency-based education
description: A flexible persistence modeling system and method for building flexible persistence models for education institutions using a Markov model based on units of academic progress of a non-traditional learning program of an education institution. The Markov model is used to quantify transitions of students between the states as parameters of state transitions so that features from the Markov model with the parameters of state transitions can be extracted that are related to the non-traditional learning program of the education institution using defined flexible persistence. The extracted features can then be used to build at least one flexible persistence model for different segments of the students.

title: Data processing apparatus, data display system including the same, sample information obtaining system including the same, data processing method, program, and storage medium
description: A data processing apparatus that processes a spectral data item which stores, for each of a plurality of spectral components, an intensity value, includes a spectral component selecting unit and a classifier generating unit. The spectral component selecting unit is configured to select, based on a Mahalanobis distance between groups each composed of a plurality of spectral data items or a spectral shape difference between groups each composed of a plurality of spectral data items, a plurality of machine-learning spectral components from among the plurality of spectral components of the plurality of spectral data items. The classifier generating unit is configured to perform machine learning by using the plurality of machine-learning spectral components selected by the spectral component selecting unit and generate a classifier that classifies a spectral data item.

title: Dental appliance case
description: A dental appliance case for receiving a dental appliance is provided. In some embodiments, the case may include a power source, a sound device, an occupancy sensor, and a processing unit. The sound device may be configured to create an audible alert sound. The occupancy sensor may be operable to detect the presence of a dental appliance. The processing unit may be in electrical communication with the power source, occupancy sensor, and the sound device. The processing unit may be operable to operate the sound device to create an audible alert in response to an electronic communication from the occupancy sensor.

title: Systems and Methods For Providing Customized Product Recommendations
description: Systems and methods for providing customized skin care product recommendations. The system utilizes an image capture device and a computing device coupled to the image capture device. The computing device causes the system to analyze a captured image of a user via the by processing the image through a convolutional neural network to determine a skin age of the user. Determining the skin age may include identifying at least one pixel that is indicative of the skin age and utilizing the at least one pixel to create a heat map that identifies a region of the image that contributes to the skin age. The system may be used to determine a target skin age of the user, determine a skin care product for achieving the target skin age, and provide an option for the user to purchase the product.

title: Automated metadata cleanup and distribution platform
description: Example apparatuses, systems, and methods for automated data distribution and cleanup is provided. An example method includes receiving content associated with primary metadata by a processor of a content management system from a primary data storage unit, validating the content, and performing a search, of a secondary data storage unit, for data matching the content and associating secondary metadata with the content based on the search. In this regard, the primary metadata and the secondary metadata may be combined to form metadata for the content. The example method may also include performing a rule set update and formatting the metadata of the content based on the updated rule set for a distribution service. The example method may also include distributing the content with the formatted metadata to the distribution service.

title: Systems, devices, and methods for improved affix-based domain name suggestion
description: Embodiments relate to systems, devices, and computing-implemented methods for generating domain name suggestions by obtaining a domain name suggestion input that includes textual data, segmenting the textual data into tokens, obtaining a list of possible affixes to the textual data, determining conditional probabilities for the possible affixes using a language model, ranking the list of possible affixes based on the conditional probabilities to generate a ranked list of affixes, and generating domain name suggestions based on the ranked list of affixes.

title: Computing device and sampling method
description: According to one embodiment, a computing device includes an oscillator network and a controller. The oscillator network includes a plurality of oscillators coupled to each other. The controller is configured to control the oscillator network. Each of the oscillators has a nonlinear energy shift. The controller multiply performs a sampling operation. The sampling operation includes a first operation a first operation of outputting a signal causing the oscillators to stop oscillating, a second operation of outputting a signal causing the oscillators to oscillate based on a parameter relating to a first probability distribution, and a third operation of outputting a signal to measure, for the oscillators, a phase of an electromagnetic wave generated by an oscillation.

title: Decision support apparatus and method in power system, and application system thereof
description: The present invention provides a decision support apparatus and method in a power system that can present control candidates at high speed and can support decision support of an operator, and its application system. One of the representative embodiments of the present invention for solving the above problems is a plurality of control candidate learning units for deriving a plurality of control candidate models for stabilizing the power system by learning, and a plurality of control candidate learning units for deriving the plurality of control candidate models. A control candidate extraction unit that extracts a control candidate using measurement data and extraction parameters of the power system, and a control candidate evaluation unit that evaluates the control candidate using a control candidate and a power system grid model; According to another aspect of the present invention, there is provided a decision support apparatus for an electric power system comprising: a control candidate; and an information presentation unit for presenting information on an evaluation result.

title: Quality prediction model generation method, quality prediction model, quality prediction method, metal material manufacturing method, quality prediction model generation device and quality prediction device
description: The quality prediction model generation method is a quality prediction model generation method for a metal material manufactured through one or a plurality of steps, and the manufacturing conditions of each step are collected for each predetermined range of a predetermined metal material. One collection step, a second collection step in which the quality of the metal material produced through each process is evaluated and collected for each predetermined range, the production conditions of each process, and the production under these production conditions. A quality prediction model that predicts the quality of a metal material for each predetermined range is generated from a preservation step in which the quality of the metal material is stored in association with each predetermined range and manufacturing conditions for each predetermined range in each saved process. Includes model generation steps and.

title: A video monitoring method and system for safe production
description: This application discloses a video monitoring method for production safety, which includes receiving video stream images related to production safety. From the video stream image, select an image every several frames. Input the selected image into the deep convolutional neural network model to identify at least one or more of the following violations related to production safety: illegal appearance information of the object to be identified, violation behavior information of the object to be identified, vehicle type or vehicle Area information driven into, abnormal status of production equipment, fireworks status, and leftover information. The images corresponding to the identified illegal content are stored and input into the deep convolutional neural network model to train the deep convolutional neural network model again. This application achieves all-round security monitoring of the production environment through the above method, and at the same time realizes the automatic update and upgrade of the deep convolutional neural network model, ensuring the accuracy of safety hazard detection.

title: Speech separation method, system, mobile terminal and storage medium
description: The present invention provides a voice separation method, system, mobile terminal and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining the sample audio of the left channel and the sample audio of the right channel and combining them to obtain the combined sample audio; constructing a coding network to combine the The spectral features are input into the encoding network for dimensionality reduction encoding to obtain dimensionality reduction features; the attention mechanism is used to perform attention calculations on dimensionality reduction features to obtain attention probability values, and the attention probability values are input into the decoding network for decoding to obtain spectral decoding results; Calculate the loss value between the spectral decoding result and the spectral features of the sample audio, perform model iterative training on the encoding network and decoding network according to the loss value, and obtain the speech separation model; input the speech to be recognized into the speech separation model for speech separation, and obtain the left voice channel audio file and right channel audio file. The invention realizes the human voice separation effect in the voice data by adopting the end-to-end model, and improves the accuracy of the voice separation.

title: Case element extraction method in news text sentence based on case correlation joint learning and graph convolution
description: The invention relates to a method for extracting case elements from news text sentences based on case correlation joint learning and graph convolution, and belongs to the technical field of natural language processing. The method comprises the steps of firstly analyzing core components in a sentence to be extracted by a dependency syntax analysis tool to form an alternative element group, carrying out characteristic modeling on the dependency relationship of the candidate elements through a graph convolution neural network to capture the inherent relevance of the candidate elements, then carrying out characteristic modeling on the sentence to be extracted in a time sequence logic manner to learn the correlation characteristics of the case field, and finally, integrating the characteristics of the candidate elements and the characteristics of the sentence where the candidate elements are located to judge whether the candidate elements are a group of case elements. The method can effectively learn the case field correlation and the internal correlation of the elements to be extracted, and is favorable for improving the prediction accuracy.

title: Teacher data collection device
description: The external environment information acquired by a camera or the like mounted in the vehicle is acquired by the external environment information acquisition unit 302, and is given a label by the label processing unit 304. At this time, if the vehicle can pass without the avoidance operation at the time when the information of the marker object is acquired, the given tag indicates that the vehicle can pass. On the other hand, when the avoidance operation is performed, the external environment information may not be given a label, or a label indicating that the external environment information cannot pass may be given.

title: Material recognition method for dental products based on the combination of machine vision and near-infrared spectroscopy
description: The present invention provides a method for identifying material of dental products based on the combination of machine vision and near-infrared spectroscopy, which is characterized by comprising the steps of: S1 collecting images of three sample dental molds to be identified through a camera, and preprocessing the images ; S2 extracts the principal component features of the near-infrared information for the three sample dental model images to identify the materials of the three main dental products; S3 fuses the principal component score features extracted from the near-infrared spectrum of the dental model based on the Softmax classifier to identify different dental products. Ceramic dental products. This method can effectively improve the accuracy and speed of material identification of dental products.

title: High-precision three-dimensional face reconstruction method
description: The invention discloses a high-precision three-dimensional face reconstruction method, which constructs a real face database and a synthetic face database, trains a deep neural network by utilizing the data, thus not only providing a large amount of tagged data for training the deep neural network, but also increasing the robustness of the three-dimensional face reconstruction method, so that the trained network can obtain a high-precision normal direction to a face image under any input point light source, the process utilizes the face image information, avoids a complex time-consuming optimization process, accelerates the speed of reconstructing a three-dimensional face model, finally can recover a high-quality three-dimensional face model, and greatly reduces the difficulty and cost of data acquisition and increases the applicability of the method because the three-dimensional face image under any point light source is input. In addition, by combining the priori knowledge of the human face with the photometric stereo technology under the point light source, the quality of the three-dimensional human face model is greatly improved.

title: Structure, addressing line and related method based on quantum flux parametrics
description: Methods useful for the operation of scalable processors with increasing numbers of logical devices (e.g., qubits) advantageously utilize QFP, e.g., to implement shift registers, multiplexers (i.e., MUXes), demultiplexers devices (i.e., DEMUX) and permanent magnet memories (i.e., PMM), etc., and/or employ XY or XYZ addressing schemes, and/or employ control lines extending in a "braided" pattern across an array of devices. Many of the described methods are particularly suitable for implementing input to and/or output from such a processor. A superconducting quantum processor including a superconducting digital-to-analog converter (DAC) is provided. These DACs can use dynamic inductance to store energy via thin-film superconducting materials and/or a series of Josephson junctions, and can use single-loop or multi-loop designs. Specific configurations of energy storage elements including tortuous structures are disclosed. Galvanic and inductive connections between the DACs and/or to the target device are disclosed.

title: A Prediction Method of Industrial Boiler Steam Volume Based on Image Transformation
description: The invention discloses an industrial boiler steam quantity prediction method based on image transformation, which uses a deep learning training method to automatically extract characteristics from original characteristic variables and predict a steam quantity target value; compared with the traditional machine learning method based on the characteristic engineering, the method is simple to operate, does not need to do excessive characteristic engineering, and has a better prediction effect; the method is divided into a pretreatment stage and a use stage, the pretreatment stage does not consume the time for actually running and predicting the steam quantity, and the method can be used only through a trained model in practical application, so that the prediction efficiency is improved, and the real-time property of prediction is ensured. The method can provide prediction of the steam quantity of the boiler, complete modeling of the relationship between the steam quantity and the characteristic variable, further control the steam quantity and optimize factors influencing the steam quantity, and further improve the operation efficiency of the boiler.

title: An Encryption Algorithm Identification Method Based on Deep Learning Graph Network
description: An encryption algorithm identification method based on a deep learning graph network consists of a training and checking process, wherein: training: constructing a basic source code library for the crawled source code data related to encryption; the binary code library is obtained through cross compiling pretreatment, statistical features and structural features of a binary encryption algorithm are respectively extracted and integrated to generate an encryption algorithm map, the encryption algorithm map is embedded into a neural network to become vectors, whether codes are similar or not is judged through distance between the compared vectors, and a model for judging whether the embedded vectors of the encryption algorithm map are similar or not is obtained through training; checking: and generating a standard encryption algorithm library, respectively selecting one encryption algorithm which is standard to be realized and has the determined type, generating an encryption algorithm map to be detected of an unknown type, embedding the encryption algorithm map to be detected into a trained model, sequentially comparing vector distances with the embedding of the standard encryption algorithm library, and obtaining the type of the standard algorithm with the shortest vector distance with the algorithm to be detected as the type of the encryption algorithm to be detected.

title: Prediction of shale gas sweet spots based on multi-level fuzzy identification
description: The invention provides a shale gas sweet spot prediction method based on multi-level fuzzy recognition, and relates to the field of shale gas. It includes: setting the deposition condition, the storage condition and the storage condition as criterion layers, setting the parameters of the deposition condition, the parameters of the storage condition and the parameters of the storage condition as index layers respectively, comparing the indexes of the same layer in pairs to form a plurality of discrimination matrixes, calculating the weight of each parameter in each index layer relative to the corresponding criterion layer, and confirming the shale gas sweet spots according to the measured value of each parameter and the corresponding weight. The influence of various geological parameters in the deposition condition, the storage condition and the storage condition on the shale gas content is analyzed through a system, the weight of the geological parameters of desserts in different structural areas is determined by combining a multi-level fuzzy recognition method, the quantitative plane distribution diagram of each parameter is combined, and the distribution of the shale gas desserts areas is predicted through weighted summation.

title: Sentence emotion classification method and related equipment
description: The invention provides a sentence emotion classification method and related equipment. The method comprises the following steps: converting the words before the missing words in the first sentence sample into a first coding sequence according to word sequence by utilizing a feature extraction model, converting the words after the missing words in the first sentence sample into a second coding sequence according to reverse word sequence, and converting the missing words in the first sentence sample into tag vectors of the first sentence sample according to a preset word coding table; calculating a missing word vector of the first sentence sample according to the first coding sequence and the second coding sequence by utilizing the feature extraction model; training a feature extraction model according to the missing word vector of the first sentence sample and the tag vector of the first sentence sample; and identifying the attribute words of the to-be-processed sentences by using an attribute classification model formed by the feature extraction models, and classifying the to-be-processed sentences connected with the attribute words by using an emotion classification model formed by the feature extraction models. The invention enhances the accuracy of emotion classification and scene adaptability.

title: Recognition method and system of metal minerals under microscope based on BP neural network
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying metal minerals under a microscope based on a BP neural network, which relate to the technical field of metal mineral identification and mainly comprise the steps of acquiring an unknown metal mineral image shot by a reflection polarization microscope; processing the unknown metal mineral image by using MATLAB software to obtain primary characteristic data of the unknown metal mineral image; determining the difference characteristics of the environment; calculating final characteristic data of the unknown metal mineral image according to the primary characteristic data and the environment difference characteristic of the unknown metal mineral image; and inputting the final characteristic data of the unknown metal mineral image into a trained BP neural network model to determine the type of the unknown metal mineral. The invention automatically identifies the image through computer software and a reflection polarization microscope, eliminates the interference of personal factors and environmental factors on the basis of ensuring the low identification cost of the metal minerals, and improves the identification accuracy.

title: Text classification model generation method, text classification device and equipment
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a text classification model generation method, a text classification method, a device and equipment, wherein the text classification model generation method comprises the following steps: after the first training data are acquired, training a first basic classification model of at least one category by using the first training data, and respectively obtaining Q first classification probability values corresponding to the text data by using the first basic classification model of each category; and obtaining a second basic classification model of each category, so that the category of the second basic classification model corresponds to the category of the first basic classification model, so that after Q first classification probability values corresponding to text data and Q classification labels corresponding to the text data, which are respectively obtained by using the first basic classification model of each category, are determined to be second training data, firstly training by using the second training data to obtain a mixed classification model, and then connecting an output layer of the second basic classification model of each category with an input layer of the mixed classification model to form the text classification model.

title: Target positioning method, device, equipment and computer-readable storage medium
description: The invention discloses a target positioning method, device, equipment and computer-readable storage medium. The method includes: if it is detected that the target to be positioned enters the shooting range of the camera group, then collecting a 2D image of the target to be positioned by the camera group and 3D images; based on the preset image processing function, extract the region of interest in the 2D image to obtain the image of interest, and input the image of interest to the neural network to obtain the target positioning result; based on the 3D image, perform plane segmentation on the 3D image , to obtain point cloud data corresponding to multiple planes; based on the point cloud data and target positioning results, determine the first area intersection ratio of each plane; if the first area intersection ratio is greater than the first preset threshold and less than the second If the threshold is preset, the target positioning result is output to the execution unit for the execution unit to grab the target to be positioned. The invention can accurately locate dense multi-rectangular logistics packages.

title: Method and device for continuously learning on equipment of neural network for optimizing sampling
description: The present invention relates to a method for on-device continual learning (On-Device Continual Learning) of a neural network (Neural Network) for analyzing input data provided for smart phones, drones, ships or military purposes. The method includes : Step (a), the learning device uniformly samples the new data (Uniform‑Sampling) so that it has the first volume. The lifting network converts k-dimensional random vectors into k-maintained positive vectors. The original data generator network repeatedly outputs the first synthesis The process of previous data, such that the first synthesized previous data has a preset second volume and refers to generating a first batch (Batch) for the first current learning (Current-Learning); and step (b) ), causing the neural network to generate output information (Output Information) corresponding to the first batch. The present invention can prevent privacy infringement, such as resource optimization of storage devices and optimization of the training image sampling process, and can use the adversarial generation network (Generative Adversarial Network, GAN) learning process is carried out.

title: A method for classroom behavior detection based on improved Openpose model and facial microexpressions
description: The invention discloses a classroom behavior detection method based on an improved Openpos model and facial micro-expressions. The face information and the upper body skeleton information are identified through an artificial intelligence model, whether key points can be identified or not and the distance between the key points are used as main judgment conditions, and the change of the micro expression is used as an auxiliary judgment condition. And if the condition of a certain student is not met for a period of time, judging that the student has abnormal examination behaviors. In addition, through the video stream of a lesson, the stage in which the abnormal behavior of the students is possible to occur is found out, and the stage is analyzed, so that the innovation and the reform of the teaching are realized. The invention reduces interference factors by machine vision identification, simplifies equipment, and also provides a corresponding data analysis processing system. The invention further optimizes the network model by methods of residual error network, weight pruning and the like. The invention realizes self-service classroom behavior detection and feedback, and has high test efficiency and 95% accuracy.

title: Particulate matter management and control method and system for coupling medium-long term and fine contribution prediction
description: This invention discloses a particulate matter control method and system coupled with medium- and long-term and refined contribution forecasts, belonging to the field of air pollution control technology. The method mainly includes: S1. Dynamically correcting daily control targets by combining medium- and long-term forecasts and machine learning forecasts, and calculating the target decomposition concentrations for different stations; S2. Based on a standardized pollution source emission inventory, simulating the refined contribution of each pollution source using the CALPUFF small-scale air quality model, and extracting a priority control list; S3. Calculating the concentration reduction potential at each station by combining the priority control list and the target decomposition concentrations; S4. Formulating emission reduction measures based on the concentration reduction potential at each station. This invention, by integrating air quality forecast data with pollution source contribution simulation technology, achieves a significant shift from static control to dynamic and precise regulation, and provides a practical dynamic decomposition method for setting pollutant control targets, improving the effectiveness and accuracy of control measures.

title: Valve high-temperature fusing early warning method based on edge calculation control
description: This invention discloses a valve high-temperature meltdown early warning method based on edge computing control, belonging to the field of valve high-temperature meltdown early warning technology. The valve high-temperature meltdown early warning method based on edge computing control includes the following steps: S1: Deploy an edge computing gateway to monitor valve temperature and pressure changes in real time; S2: Collect valve temperature and pressure data; S3: Perform trend analysis and extract feature data; S4: Predict the valve high-temperature meltdown risk level and the changing trends of valve pressure and temperature data; S5: Issue corresponding early warnings based on the prediction results. This invention solves the problem that existing technologies easily lead to equipment damage or safety accidents. This invention can avoid the expansion of faults due to data delays. The valve high-temperature meltdown early warning system based on edge computing control can monitor valve temperature in real time, promptly detect and handle high-temperature problems, and reduce production interruptions and maintenance costs caused by equipment failures.

title: Neural patient rehabilitation training method based on task training and brain-computer interaction
description: This invention discloses a method for rehabilitation training of neurological patients based on task training and brain-computer interaction, belonging to the field of rehabilitation training technology. Specifically, it includes: based on a motion decoding model corresponding to the training task machine; real-time acquisition of data signals from the patient's current rehabilitation training and segmentation processing to obtain several independent data blocks; frequency domain conversion of the independent data blocks; extraction of time-frequency features; and calculation of KL divergence between adjacent data blocks; if the KL divergence of any adjacent independent data block is greater than or equal to a preset threshold, historical data signals are acquired and the motion decoding model is corrected; motion decoding of the patient is performed according to the corrected motion decoding model, and rehabilitation training is conducted accordingly. This invention ensures a high degree of matching between the decoding results and training objectives by selecting the corresponding model based on the current rehabilitation training task and dynamically adjusting it in conjunction with real-time signal features, thereby improving the patient's rehabilitation training effect.

title: Computing power resource allocation method and device for cloud computing platform and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of computing power resource allocation, and particularly discloses a cloud computing platform computing power resource allocation method, a cloud computing platform computing power resource allocation device and a storage medium, wherein the cloud computing platform computing power resource allocation method comprises the steps of determining segmentation quantity according to performance parameters of each cloud processing node when receiving a task to be processed, segmenting the task to be processed based on the segmentation quantity to obtain subtasks, and numbering the obtained subtasks; the method comprises the steps of traversing a task list of each cloud processing node by subtasks, determining the matching degree of the subtasks and each cloud processing node, determining the distribution scheme of a preset number of subtasks according to the matching degree and the performance parameters of the cloud processing nodes, simulating task processing processes based on the performance parameters of the cloud processing nodes and the task list, optimizing the distribution scheme by using a particle swarm algorithm by taking simulation results as optimization parameters, and determining a final distribution scheme.

title: Battery pack capacitance balancing method and device, terminal equipment and storage medium
description: The application is applicable to the technical field of battery management, and provides a method, a device, terminal equipment and a storage medium for balancing the capacitance of a battery pack. The quantum random number generator adopts quantum vacuum fluctuation as a randomness source to generate a true random number. And determining a target cell and a capacitance balancing operation type of the plurality of cells to be subjected to capacitance balancing according to the current state data of the plurality of cells and the true random number. And carrying out capacitance equalization processing on the target battery cell according to the operation type of the capacitance equalization processing to obtain equalized state data of the target battery cell. Unpredictable true random numbers are generated through the quantum random number generator, and the balance weight value and the operation type are dynamically calculated by combining the real-time state data of the battery cells, so that the problem of excessive use of a specific battery cell caused by a fixed balance strategy is effectively avoided, the randomness and fairness of capacitance balance are improved, and the service life of the battery pack is prolonged.

title: New energy automobile insulating safety AI early warning platform
description: The invention discloses a novel energy automobile insulation safety AI early warning platform, which relates to the technical field of fault detection and comprises a data acquisition unit, a signal processing unit, a signal detection unit, a classification unit and a target model, wherein the data acquisition unit is used for acquiring high-frequency pulse signals of key parts in an electrical system to obtain a signal set, the signal processing unit is used for performing preprocessing operation on the high-frequency pulse signals in the signal set to obtain a target signal set, the signal detection unit is used for inputting the target pulse signals into the target model to perform abnormality detection to obtain a detection result, if the detection result is abnormal, the target pulse signals are classified to obtain a classification result, the high-frequency pulse signals of the key parts are acquired and preprocessed, the quality and the usability of the signals are effectively improved, the preprocessed target signals are input into the target model to perform abnormality detection and classification, the insulation fault type in the electrical system can be accurately identified, the fault early warning can be performed in time, the accuracy and the fault position can be rapidly located.

title: Multi-module collaborative flight simulator control panel and method
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of aviation flight training, and particularly relates to a multi-module collaborative flight simulator control panel and a method, which solve the problems of low interaction efficiency, subjective evaluation, early warning lag and time consuming evaluation of the existing system. The intelligent voice interaction module is used for recognizing the voice of a instructor through ASR, recognizing the instruction generated by complementing three-level slots by means of intention, ensuring interaction accuracy by matching with a double-layer flight stage recognition logic, enabling the flight quality monitoring module to run a rule engine and an enhanced LSTM neural network in parallel, outputting comprehensive flight quality scores by combining a self-adaptive fusion algorithm, dynamically adjusting early warning priority by a real-time reminding module according to event grades and flight stages, providing multi-mode early warning, enabling the intelligent assessment module to fuse multi-source data, and generating a personalized structured report according to the template priority. The invention realizes intelligent interaction, quantitative evaluation and automatic comment of training, and improves training efficiency and evaluation objectivity.

title: Method, apparatus and medium for video processing
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a solution for video processing. A method for video processing is presented. The method includes performing a conversion between video and a bitstream of the video, wherein NNPF is applied to a current picture associated with the video based on at least one input picture to a neural network post-processing filter (NNPF), and all pictures output by NNPF do not precede a first picture in the bitstream in output order.

title: Power consumption abnormality detection method based on time-frequency behavior mismatch analysis
description: The invention relates to the technical field of power grid dispatching, in particular to a power consumption anomaly detection method based on time-frequency behavior mismatch analysis, which comprises the following steps of firstly extracting multi-mode features and finding dynamic frequency bands, secondly constructing a hierarchical graph volume-variation self-encoder model, thirdly introducing dynamic hierarchical center constraint and map guidance, fourthly training and optimizing a multi-target model, fifthly classifying the multi-target model and detecting time-frequency consistency anomalies, and sixthly realizing system and multi-mode output.

title: A Feed Processing Load Management Method Based on a Staged Policy Gradient Algorithm
description: This invention discloses a feed processing load management method based on a phased policy gradient algorithm, belonging to the field of industrial automation control technology. The method includes: collecting a dynamic state set of feed processing and preprocessing it to obtain a standardized decision input vector; dynamically adjusting equipment parameters based on the standardized decision input vector using a two-factor collaborative compensation algorithm to obtain equipment control commands; executing the equipment control commands and generating an efficiency feedback data package by real-time monitoring of equipment energy consumption changes and output material particle size; constructing a load management decision model and using a phased policy gradient algorithm to obtain optimized policy parameters based on the efficiency feedback data package; updating the load management decision model based on the optimized policy parameters and generating a closed-loop verification report through load management verification. This invention constructs a load management decision model through a quantum annealing mechanism, breaking through the limitations of local optima in traditional reinforcement learning and achieving a leap in global optimization efficiency.

title: A method and system for detecting defects in transmission line fasteners based on frequency domain distillation
description: This invention discloses a method and system for detecting defects in transmission line fasteners based on frequency domain distillation. The method includes: acquiring images using a drone, labeling and enhancing them to construct a dataset, and dividing it into training and validation sets; constructing a teacher model and a lightweight student model with a residual network as the backbone, containing a feature pyramid structure and classification and regression branch detection heads; training the teacher model and saving its weights, then loading and training the student model; performing frequency domain transformation on multi-scale features using a frequency domain perceptual distillation module to separate high and low frequencies of amplitude and calculating the frequency domain distillation loss; updating parameters by backpropagation combined with the student model's own detection loss to obtain the trained student model; and inputting the results into the validation set. This method enhances the student model's perception of target structural information through the frequency domain distillation module, suppresses background noise, and improves robustness and accuracy. The resulting small model saves storage space, has fast inference, is suitable for deployment on edge devices, and saves manpower and resources.

title: Training methods for human image generation models, video synthesis methods and devices
description: This disclosure provides a training method for a portrait generation model, a video synthesis method, and an apparatus, relating to the technical fields of deep learning, model training, digital human rendering, and video synthesis. The method includes: extracting synchronized audio data and a real facial representation from a synchronized audio-visual video, wherein the real facial representation is extracted from a sample video portrait corresponding to the corresponding audio data; training a facial representation prediction model by using the audio data as sample input and the matched real facial representation as the expected sample output, thereby obtaining a predicted facial representation output by the facial representation prediction model; performing a hybrid processing on the real facial representation and the predicted facial representation corresponding to the sample video portrait, thereby obtaining a hybrid facial representation corresponding to the sample video portrait; and training a portrait generation model based on the sample video portrait and the hybrid facial representation corresponding to the sample video portrait, thereby obtaining a trained target portrait generation model. This method can make the facial regions of the generated portrait more harmonious and natural.

title: Method for realizing ArgMax operator optimization based on many-core processor
description: The invention particularly relates to a method for realizing ArgMax operator optimization based on a many-core processor. The method for realizing ArgMax operator optimization based on the many-core processor comprises the steps of splitting input tensor data in a specification dimension and a non-specification dimension simultaneously, unloading calculation tasks of the split tensor data to a plurality of physical cores of the many-core processor in a balanced mode for calculation, synchronizing all the physical cores by adopting an on-chip communication network of the many-core processor, and summarizing calculation results of all the physical cores to form a final result. According to the method for realizing ArgMax operator optimization based on the many-core processor, the memory concurrency and the computing capacity of a single core are greatly improved, the cross-core efficient operation is realized, the computing requirement of large-scale tensors can be met, the data transmission bottleneck is reduced, and the execution speed of the whole operator is improved.

title: Method and device for detecting illumination of video equipment environment and electronic equipment
description: This invention provides a method, apparatus, and electronic device for detecting illuminance in the environment of a video device, relating to the field of illuminance detection technology. The method includes: acquiring parameter values of multiple target parameters of the video device; the multiple target parameters include multiple exposure factors and multiple pixel features of a target region in an image captured under the current environment; normalizing each target parameter to obtain a standard parameter value for each target parameter; inputting the standard parameter value of any first target parameter from the multiple target parameters into a target deviation mapping model to obtain the mapping parameter value of the first target parameter output by the target deviation mapping model; inputting the mapping parameter values of all target parameters into a target neural network model; and obtaining the illuminance value of the environment where the video device is located based on the output of the target neural network model. This invention can solve the problem of large deviations in illuminance detection results for different video devices under the same environment, improving the accuracy of illuminance detection results.

title: A Method and System for Adversarial Training of Large-Scale Autonomous Driving Models Based on Adversarial Adapters
description: This invention discloses a method and system for adversarial training of a large-scale autonomous driving model based on an adversarial adapter. The adversarial training method includes the following steps: embedding a pre-configured adversarial adapter into a preset position in a pre-trained visual-language large-scale model and setting its parameters; inputting a preset sample set into the large-scale model to dynamically identify task keywords based on an attention mechanism; constructing a task-aware adversarial training objective function; for each sample in any batch, iteratively optimizing the perturbation on the visual input during training using a projective gradient descent method to maximize the adversarial training objective function and generate corresponding adversarial samples; for all adversarial samples in the same batch, updating only the parameters of the adversarial adapter by minimizing the adversarial training objective function; iterative training to update the parameters of the adversarial adapter again until the total training cycle is completed or a stopping condition is met, forming the final robust model.

title: Method, device, equipment and computer storage medium for generating model configuration parameters
description: This invention provides a method, apparatus, device, and computer storage medium for generating model configuration parameters. The method acquires preset target model task data. Based on the target model task data, and according to the correspondence between preset historical model task data and historical model prediction computing power values, the target model prediction computing power value corresponding to the preset target model task data is determined. When the target model prediction computing power value is equal to the historical model prediction computing power value, the historical model configuration parameters corresponding to the historical model prediction computing power value are used as the target model configuration parameters, which are then used to construct the target model. This invention, by using the historical model configuration parameters corresponding to the historical model prediction computing power value as the target model configuration parameters when the target model prediction computing power value is equal to the historical model prediction computing power value, reduces the time required to determine the target model configuration parameters, thereby reducing the time required to construct the target model based on the target model configuration parameters.

title: Rotary machine fault diagnosis method and system based on physical constraint
description: This invention provides a method and system for diagnosing rotating machinery faults based on physical constraints, belonging to the field of intelligent industrial fault diagnosis technology. The method includes the following steps: collecting raw vibration signal data of key components of rotating machinery containing different fault types and preprocessing them; performing variational mode decomposition on the preprocessed vibration signal sample set to obtain modal components and the center frequency of each modal component; constructing a dual-channel parallel feature extraction structure, using the modal components as input for feature extraction, to obtain cross-period dependent features and transient impact features; enhancing the cross-period dependent features and transient impact features; employing a multi-level gating mechanism to fuse the enhanced cross-period dependent features and enhanced transient impact features; and using a fully connected classifier to classify the fused features. This invention relies on physical constraints for feature extraction, enhancement, and fusion, improving the accuracy and physical interpretability of rotating machinery fault diagnosis.

title: Child viral encephalitis classification system based on deep learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent medical auxiliary diagnosis and data processing, in particular to a child viral encephalitis classification system based on deep learning. The device comprises a data acquisition module, a characteristic decoupling module, a risk assessment module and a closed loop control module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring serological indexes, cerebrospinal fluid biochemical indexes and contemporaneous epidemic background intensity factors of a target infant, the characteristic decoupling module is used for calling preset historical statistical data to normalize the serological indexes and the cerebrospinal fluid biochemical indexes, the risk assessment module is used for mapping encephalitis specificity residual error feature vectors into encephalitis illness probabilities by using a preset classifier, and calculating comprehensive decision trust entropy based on the encephalitis illness probabilities, symptom masking coefficients and norms of the encephalitis specificity residual error feature vectors. The invention forces the classifier to focus on the real neuropathological changes in cerebrospinal fluid and serum, thereby improving the accuracy of identifying viral encephalitis under complex clinical characterization.

title: A method, system, and device for optimizing the arrangement and size of throttling orifices in hydrostatic bearings based on deep reinforcement learning.
description: This application discloses a method, system, and device for optimizing the arrangement and size of throttling orifices in hydrostatic bearings based on deep reinforcement learning. It relates to the fields of core component design for high-end equipment and artificial intelligence technology. The method includes: constructing a deep reinforcement learning agent; constructing a hydrostatic bearing simulation environment, and receiving mixed actions output by the deep reinforcement learning agent based on the simulation environment, calculating multi-dimensional performance indicators, and calculating reward values using a multi-objective reward function based on these indicators; sequentially interacting the deep reinforcement learning agent with the hydrostatic bearing simulation environment to obtain a trained deep reinforcement learning agent; generating an optimized design scheme for the throttling orifice of the hydrostatic bearing using the trained deep reinforcement learning agent; and optimizing the arrangement and size of the throttling orifice based on the optimized design scheme. This application can automatically and efficiently explore a wide design space for the layout and size of throttling orifices in hydrostatic bearings.

title: Methods and electronic devices that provide code through the use of generative artificial intelligence models.
description: An electronic device for providing code by using a generative artificial intelligence model and a method implemented by the electronic device are provided. The method may include the steps of obtaining user input corresponding to a first document, obtaining first context information that can be used for code generation based on the user input, generating a first hint for code generation based on the first context information and the user input, selecting second context information from the first context information based on a length of the first hint according to priority information, generating a second hint corresponding to the first hint based on the second context information and the user input, transmitting the first hint or the second hint to a server, and receiving a recommended code generated based on the first hint or the second hint via a generated AI model from the server and providing the recommended code.

title: Action recommendation device, action recommendation system, action recommendation method and program
description: The remaining power acquisition unit (12) of the behavior recommendation device (1) acquires the value of the remaining power of the storage battery (2). A prediction information acquisition part (11) acquires the prediction information containing at least one of the weather forecast of the area where the power generator which supplies electric power to a storage battery (2) is located, and the schedule information of a planned power failure from the internet. The recommended information generation unit (14) selects an action that conforms to a predetermined evaluation criterion based on the prediction information and the value of the remaining power from the action list indicating the actions that can be taken by the user stored in the action list storage unit (13). Extract and generate recommended information to display the extracted actions. The recommended information generation unit (14) displays the recommended information on the display unit (15).

title: Driving support method and driving support device
description: In the scene where the own vehicle changes lanes to the adjacent lane, even if there is not enough space area in the lane change destination of the own vehicle, the lane change of the own vehicle can be executed using the area where another vehicle travels. To do. The vehicle (VI) traveling in the own vehicle thread spring is equipped with a lane change controller (40) that controls the lane change to the adjacent lane (L2) in which another vehicle (V4) around the vehicle is traveling. It is a driving support method according to the procedure of. Detects whether or not there is a lane change request to the adjacent lane (L2) of the own vehicle (VI). It is detected that the own vehicle (VI) has a lane change request ^, and whether or not the other vehicle (V4) traveling in the adjacent lane (L2) intends to change lanes toward the own lane (L1) is detected. When it is detected that there is an intention to change lanes toward the own lane (L1) of another vehicle (V4), the other vehicle (V4) that has an intention to change lanes is replaced with a lane change vehicle (V2) and the vehicle (V2). ) Is set as the lane change target of the own vehicle (VI) by setting the position of the vacant area caused by the lane change.

title: Method and apparatus for predicting properties of feed and products in Reformer
description: Disclosed are a method and apparatus for predicting properties of feed and products in a reformer. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the method for predicting properties of feed and products in a reformer comprises: a step of training a first prediction model for predicting properties of feed of the reformer and a second prediction model for predicting properties of products; a step of allowing a first prediction unit including the trained first prediction model to receive a current operation condition for a reactor of the reformer so as to predict the properties of feed currently supplied to the reactor in real time; and a step of allowing a second prediction unit including the trained second prediction model to receive the current operation condition and the predicted properties of the feed so as to predict the properties of products currently produced in the reactor in real time. The present invention may efficiently control an operation of the reactor based on predicted data.

title: Gesture classifier learning method and gesture inference method using the same
description: Disclosed are a gesture classifier learning method and a gesture inference method using the same. A gesture classifier learning method according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: generating first and second backgrounds; obtaining a first foreground based on a difference between an input image and the first background, and obtaining a second foreground based on a difference between the input image and the second background; extracting a part commonly detected through the first and second foregrounds as a final foreground, and extracting a part detected only through the second foreground as a still foreground; generating silhouette history images using the final foreground and the still foreground; and training a neural network model (NN) using the silhouette history images annotated with various gestures. The present invention detects a change in an environment, detects a person, and analyzes the behavior of the person to detect a fall.

title: Apparatus for visualizing the result of detecting pothole in aerial image based on deep-learning and method thereof
description: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for visualizing a porthole detection result in an aerial image based on deep learning.  According to the present invention, in the porthole detection result visualization method using a porthole detection result visualization device, the method comprising the steps of receiving an aerial image captured by a drone, inputting the aerial image into a pre-learned detection module, and then inputting the porthole from the aerial image Detecting the porthole, analyzing the aerial image in which the porthole is detected, measuring the size and coordinates of the porthole in the aerial image, and mapping the coordinates of the porthole on a map to visualize the porthole detection point as a marker. and visualizing a detection result including a size and coordinates of a corresponding porthole and an aerial image of the porthole when the marker is selected on the map.  According to the present invention, it is possible to detect the position of a porthole by deep learning analysis of an aerial image, map the detection result on a map, and provide visualization, and to facilitate porthole occurrence status and management tracking for each region.

title: Apparatus and methods for providing precise motion estimation learning model
description: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for providing a precise motion estimation learning model, a standard data set labeled according to a first number of keypoints, an animation data set labeled according to a second number of keypoints greater than the first number, and the first number of keypoints. a database unit for storing a photo-realistic data set having two key points; a standard learning unit configured to generate a standard learning model by learning the standard data set for motion estimation; an animation learning unit generating an animation learning model by re-learning the animation data set based on the weight of the standard learning model; and a motion estimation learning unit generating a precise motion estimation learning model by performing fine-tuning by learning the photorealistic data set based on the weights of the animation learning model.

title: Apparatus and method for active boarding support for the visually impaired
description: Presented are a device and method for supporting active boarding for the visually impaired which can support the visually impaired to actively board the bus through a personal mobile phone of the visually impaired without any additional devices on the bus or at the stop. The presented device comprises: a determination unit which combines BIS/BMS information and C-ITS information collected in relation to the bus to be boarded, and determines an estimated arrival time and estimated boarding point of the bus to be boarded at the stop; a recognition unit which applies deep learning recognition technology before the bus to be boarded stops at the stop to adjust the estimated arrival time and the estimated boarding point; and a display unit which guides an adjusted estimated arrival time and estimated boarding point. Accordingly, social perspectives and awareness of boarding for the visually impaired can be improved.

title: Computing system, computing apparatus, and operating method of computing system
description: An optoelectronic computing system comprises: a first semiconductor die comprising a photonic integrated circuit (PIC), the PIC comprising: a plurality of optical waveguides, wherein a set of multiple input values are encoded on respective optical signals carried by the optical waveguides, an optical copying distribution network comprising a plurality of optical splitters, in which each optical splitter sends half of the power of an input optical wave at an input port to each of two output ports, and an array of optoelectronic circuitry sections, each optoelectronic circuitry section receiving an optical wave from one of the output ports of the optical copying distribution network, and each optoelectronic circuitry section including: at least one photodetector detecting at least one optical wave from the optoelectronic operation; and at least one wire integrated in the PIC electrically coupled to the photodetector and electrically coupled to an electrical output port; and a second semiconductor die comprising an electronic integrated circuit (EIC), the EIC comprising: a plurality of electrical input ports receiving respective electrical values; wherein the first semiconductor die and the second semiconductor die are electrically coupled in a controlled collapsed chip connection, with the electrical output ports of the PIC connected to the electrical input ports of the EIC.

title: System, method, and non-transitory computer readable medium for processing an audio signal
description: A system processes an audio signal using spectrally orthogonal sound components. The system includes a circuitry that generates a mid component and a side component from a left channel and a right channel of the audio signal. The circuitry generates a hyper mid component including spectral energy of the side component removed from spectral energy of the mid component. The circuitry filters the hyper mid component, such as to provide spatial cue processing including panning or binaural processing, dynamic range processing, or other types of processing. The circuitry generates a left output channel and a right output channel using the filtered hyper mid component.

title: Apparatus and method for selecting informative patterns for training machine learning models
description: Described herein is a method and apparatus for selecting patterns from an image such as a design layout. The method includes obtaining an image (e.g., of a target layout) having a plurality of patterns; determining, based on pixel intensities within the image, a metric (e.g., entropy) indicative of an amount of information contained in one or more portions of the image; and selecting, based on the metric, a sub-set of the plurality of patterns from the one or more portions of the image having values of the metric within a specified range. The sub-set of patterns can be provided as training data for training a model associated with a patterning process.

title: Automated kiosk and method for collecting return items based on real time risk decision
description:
Disclosed embodiments provide systems and methods 
related to collecting return items using an automated kiosk based on a real time risk decision. The automated kiosk captures return item information representing a return item and transmits the return item information and a request for return risk level relating to the return item to a server operable to execute a machine learning model trained on historical information to determine the risk level. The server determines the risk level based on the received return by using the 
machine learning model and transmits the determined risk level to the automated kiosk in real-time. Based on the determined risk level and a return amount associated with the return item, the server may also process a refund in real-time.

title: Information processing device, recording medium, program product, and information processing method
description: Including: a distance matrix calculation part (104), which generates a similarity matrix, and the similarity matrix includes a plurality of columns and a plurality of rows arranged according to the order in which the plurality of samples are arranged from the data set containing a plurality of samples; Indicating that each sample uses the label information of the labeling result of a plurality of labels including a plurality of categories, adjusting the sequence in the similarity matrix so that the plurality of samples are ranked in each category of the plurality of categories in the object label, so as to generate an adjusted similarity matrix, the object label is the specified label from the plurality of labels; the visualization part (106) generates an evaluation screen image, and the evaluation screen image will adjust each column of the similarity matrix with brightness corresponding to the similarity; and the display part (107), This evaluation screen image is displayed.

title: Interpretable deep learning-based defect detection and classification
description: An explanation of a detection/classification algorithm made using a deep learning neural network clarifies the results that are formed and helps a user to identify the root cause of defect detection/classification model performance issues. A relevance map is determined based on a layer-wise relevance propagation algorithm. A mean intersection over union score between the relevance map and a ground truth is determined. A part of one of the semiconductor images that contributed to the classification using the deep learning model based on the relevance map and the mean intersection over union score is determined.

title: Storing entries in and retrieving information from episode object memory
description: A method is provided for identifying and storing landmark memories within an episodic object memory, including receiving one or more content items. Each content item has one or more content data. One or more content data associated with one or more content items may be provided and integrated within one or more embedding models representing a set of growing episodic memories. Episodic memories relate to the ability to recall content from one's personal past in the form of landmark memories, etc., and landmark memories may be filtered from multiple memories based on their degree of splendor. One or more landmark memories and references to the associated content items are inserted into the episodic object memory for use in subsequent recall and in the course of the current context and task.

title: Deep learning-based frozen electron microscope image denoising method and system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing and discloses a deep learning-based method and a deep learning-based system for denoising a frozen electron microscope image, comprising the following steps of S1, acquiring an original frozen electron microscope image data set, and preprocessing to obtain a training sample set; S2, constructing a frozen electron microscope image denoising model comprising a noise mapping module and a denoising module, S3, inputting a training sample set into the noise mapping module to perform noise mapping learning to obtain a noise mapping image, S4, inputting the noise mapping image into the denoising module to obtain a denoised frozen electron microscope image, S5, training the frozen electron microscope image denoising model according to the denoised frozen electron microscope image, and S6, denoising the frozen electron microscope image through the trained frozen electron microscope image denoising model. The invention solves the problems of high denoising training difficulty and complicated process in the prior art, and has the characteristics of high signal-to-noise ratio and high efficiency.

title: Lightweight music score recognition system and method based on improved CRNN
description: The invention discloses a lightweight music score recognition system and method based on improved CRNN, which belong to the technical field of music score recognition, and the method comprises the following steps: improving a convolution layer, a circulation layer and a transcription layer based on CRNN; introducing depth separable convolution into a convolution layer, reducing the calculated amount and accelerating the extraction of a feature map; the bidirectional simple circulating unit is used in the circulating layer, and the strong dependence problem of serial calculation is avoided by adopting parallel calculation; cross entropy function parameters are adjusted at a transcription layer, and unbalanced sample data is learned in a targeted manner. According to the improved CRNN-based lightweight music score identification method disclosed by the invention, experimental results prove that the time consumption of single iteration can be about 43% of that of a reference network, and the accuracy rate of the method on a distorted image is superior to that of other improved networks.

title: Multi-feature fusion human-object interaction identification method
description: The invention relates to a multi-feature fusion human-object interactive action recognition method, which performs data processing by extracting video sequence frames. Firstly, the target detection algorithm based on deep learning is used for object recognition, and the bounding box and position information of the object are extracted. Then, the bone data and object recognition results are cross-fused, and the angle features between bone segments, the relative distance features between joints, the relative distance and angle features between objects and joints are extracted according to the bone information, and multi-feature fusion is performed. Finally, the method of the present invention integrates the eigenvectors between the person and the object and the eigenvectors between the joints of the human body to classify the action of the video through a classification method of multi-layer learning, so that the action classification of the video can be completed more accurately.

title: Device and method for measuring water content of crude oil based on GRU neural network model
description: The invention relates to the technical field of fluid measurement, in particular to a device and a method for measuring the water content of crude oil based on a GRU neural network model. The device comprises a longitudinal five-electrode array sensor, a front-end signal processing and measuring circuit module, a microprocessor control module and a temperature monitoring module; the longitudinal five-electrode array sensor is connected with the front-end signal processing and measuring circuit module, and the front-end signal processing and measuring circuit module is connected with the microprocessor control module; the microprocessor control module is connected with the temperature monitoring module, and the temperature monitoring module is connected with the longitudinal five-electrode array sensor. The invention adopts a microprocessor control module as a main controller and combines various conversion circuits to finish the measurement of signal excitation, phase content and related flow rate. Low energy consumption, strong anti-interference capability and high automation degree.

title: A lunar impact crater recognition method based on data fusion and transfer learning
description: The present invention provides a lunar crater recognition method based on data fusion and transfer learning, which belongs to the field of image recognition technology and includes the following steps: S1, source domain data set construction; S2, network model construction; S3, multivariate fusion data construction; S4, target domain data set construction: random cropping and crater annotation of the fused image, drawing the real edge information of the crater, and dividing the training set and the test set; S5, transfer learning model; S6, result verification. After fusing the lunar remote sensing image and elevation data, the method of the present invention further realizes the detection and recognition of craters in the lunar remote sensing image, and the established network consists of two crater detection channels and one crater recognition channel. The present invention proposes a new method for fusing elevation data and image data, and adopts a transfer learning strategy for the newly fused data. Accurate recognition of craters can be achieved with only a small sample data annotation, and a good recognition effect is obtained.

title: Small sample target detection system and method based on attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses a small sample target detection system and method based on an attention mechanism. The attention residual error module is used for completing an attention mechanism between channels based on spatial information embedding and loading the final weight of the space and the channel attention on the original feature diagram, and the attention residual error module is formed by a convolution layer, a normalization layer, an activation function and the like and residual error connection based on the grouping space and the channel attention module so as to avoid attention gradient disappearance and gradient explosion.

title: Skeleton and sensor bimodal human behavior recognition method based on self-attention intention convolution
description: The present invention relates to a skeleton and sensor dual-mode human behavior recognition method based on self-attention graph convolution, which belongs to the technical field of neural network, and utilizes attention mechanism, spatial graph convolution, multi-scale residual network, temporal graph convolution The skeletal network model extracts skeletal modality features; uses CNN convolutional neural network to extract sensor features, and finally assigns weights to them according to the accuracy on the verification set to fuse each modality in the later stage, and then judges the behavior category through the softmax layer. The invention can not only improve the accuracy of behavior recognition of a single modality, but also requires less parameters and requires less hardware. It is of great significance in applications such as intelligent monitoring and behavior recognition. The introduction of the attention mechanism can obtain more detailed information about the target and suppress other useless information.

title: A hyperspectral-based bridge box girder disease detection device and detection method
description: The present invention proposes a hyperspectral-based bridge box girder disease detection device and detection method. The method acquires target hyperspectral data through hyperspectral scanning of bridge box girders, and realizes omnidirectional and high-precision disease detection of bridge box girders through the disease detection method. . Firstly, the hyperspectral data of bridge box girder diseased and non-diseased samples are obtained in advance, and SVM parameters are established to find the best SVM parameters, and the SVM disease identification model is trained.
