Secondly, a mobile platform and a scanning platform are installed on the bridge box girder to be scanned, and the surface of the bridge box girder is scanned in all directions to obtain target hyperspectral data. Finally, through the real-time disease detection system, the diseased part can be quickly detected, and the high-precision bridge box girder disease detection can be completed.

title: Non-supervision skill learning method and system based on behavior comparison learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of reinforcement learning, and provides an unsupervised skill learning method and system based on behavior comparison learning. The method comprises the following steps: interacting with the environment by the agent; collecting samples in the interaction process of the intelligent agent and the environment, and storing the samples in a data set; marking the samples with rewards based on behavior contrast learning; and updating the agent using the marked samples. The invention guides the intelligent agent to carry out skill discovery by providing rewards capable of encouraging active exploration, thereby improving the coverage degree of the skill to the state action space and the performance of downstream tasks, wherein rewards functions are constructed based on comparison learning to encouraging the intelligent agent to take exploration and skill learning into consideration in the training process, the skill with enough exploration capability is learned without additionally introducing an exploration module, the storage space and the operation resource are saved, and the behaviors among different skills are kept diversified and different.

title: A prognostic assessment model of ESES-related epileptic encephalopathy and its training and use methods
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of auxiliary diagnosis of epileptic encephalopathy, specifically an ESES-related epileptic encephalopathy automatic quantification and prognosis evaluation model and its training and use methods. The encephalopathy automatic quantification and prognosis evaluation model of the present invention includes a brain network feature extraction module, an EEG depth feature extraction module, and an identification and diagnosis module; the brain network feature extraction module includes a calculation module, a graph convolutional neural network, and an attention mechanism network to obtain a brain network Graph theory features and graph features are fused together to obtain state transition information between data segments; the EEG depth feature extraction module is used to extract EEG depth features; the identification and diagnosis module is used to extract the EEG depth features extracted by the EEG depth feature extraction module The network feature is fused with the EEG depth feature extracted by the EEG depth feature extraction module, and the ESES feature wave is identified and the prognosis grade is evaluated. The invention not only realizes the automatic quantification of ESES, but also realizes the prognosis evaluation of ESES-related epileptic encephalopathy, thereby greatly improving the diagnosis and treatment efficiency of ESES.

title: Text generation model training and text generation method and device and storage medium
description: The embodiment of this specification discloses a text generation model training and text generation method, device and storage medium. Calculate the copy probability of each character in the sample input sequence at each output time step, and calculate the generation probability of each character in the vocabulary space at each output time step; determine each output based on the copy probability and generation probability of each character at each output time step The sample output characters of the time step, and then obtain the sample output sequence corresponding to the sample input sequence; calculate the output loss according to the standard output sequence and the sample output sequence, and train the text generation model. The text generation model learns to copy important characters in the input sequence to the output during the training process to obtain a high-confidence output sequence.

title: Data preprocessing method and device for joint training model
description: The embodiments of this specification provide a data preprocessing method and device for jointly updating models, and provide an implementation framework for multi-party joint and secure service feature selection before joint training models. In this framework, the business characteristics of the joint training model and the participants in the model training process are selected by the label holder. Specifically, the label holder can provide the label data and the coded data of the selected features to each candidate party, and each candidate party determines the feature score of the local candidate feature based on the label data. The feature score describes the business characteristics and the label data. , the association relationship between the selected features. The label holder summarizes the feature scores of each candidate, and determines the selected members and selected features in descending order of feature scores. This business feature selection method improves the effectiveness of service feature selection while protecting data privacy.

title: Method and device for generating recommendation information, method and device for pushing information
description: The present disclosure provides a method and device for generating recommendation information, and an information push method and device. The method for generating recommendation information includes: acquiring a plurality of candidate recommendation information; Evaluate to obtain the first evaluation result of the main material of each candidate recommendation information; and evaluate the auxiliary materials and display styles of multiple candidate recommendation information to obtain the second evaluation result of the auxiliary materials and display styles of each candidate recommendation information An evaluation result: based on the first evaluation result and the second evaluation result of each candidate recommendation information, determine the final evaluation result of each candidate recommendation information, so as to determine the recommendation information from a plurality of candidate recommendation information. The method and device for generating recommended information, and the method and device for pushing information according to the present disclosure solve the problem of difficulty in generating recommended information, which can improve the calculation speed, ensure the accuracy of information recommendation, and improve the overall display of recommended information.

title: Text key information extraction method, device, equipment and computer storage medium
description: The embodiment of the present invention relates to the technical field of natural language processing, and discloses a method for extracting key information from text. The method includes: respectively determining the target sentence vector corresponding to each target sentence in the target text, and obtaining the target sentence vector sequence corresponding to the target text; The target sentence vector sequence is input into the preset prediction model to obtain the predicted probability that each target sentence belongs to the key information of the target text; the prediction model is trained based on the preset text sample; the text sample includes a sample sentence vector sequence, a sample sentence vector sequence The sentence type label corresponding to each sample sentence vector and the text type label of the text sample; the sentence type label is used to characterize whether the sample sentence corresponding to the sample sentence vector belongs to the key information of the text sample; filter each target sentence according to the predicted probability to obtain the target The key information of the text. Through the above method, embodiments of the present invention achieve more accurate extraction of text key information.

title: Image description method, device and medium based on temporal scene graph attention mechanism
description: The application discloses an image description method, equipment and medium based on a time sequence scene graph attention mechanism, which are used for solving the problems that an existing time sequence scene graph attention mechanism ignores the importance and node information of attention LSTM hidden layer information at the previous moment, and generated sentences are monotonous and poor in diversity. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring current moment attention hiding layer information, previous moment attention hiding layer information and context information of an abstract scene graph corresponding to a picture to be processed based on a time sequence scene graph attention mechanism; calculating the content attention and the flow direction attention of the graph; the current time attention hiding layer information, the previous time attention hiding layer information and the context information are processed through an activation function to obtain super parameters; the content attention and the flow attention of the map are fused based on the super parameters to obtain corresponding attention scores, and the abstract scene map is decoded based on the attention scores to generate corresponding words so as to realize image description of the abstract scene map.

title: An intrusion detection method and device, and a computer-readable storage medium
description: The embodiment of the invention provides an intrusion detection method and device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring related security data accessed by an object; based on a preset standard model and a preset comprehensive model, carrying out rationality prediction and validity prediction on the access path of the related safety data to obtain rationality probability and validity probability; wherein, the related security data is data under an access path formed when the object is accessed; calculating the rationality probability and the legality probability through a preset cross analysis criterion to obtain the compliance probability; and comparing the compliance probability with a preset compliance value, and judging whether the access path is in compliance or not. According to the scheme, the related safety data accessed by the object are analyzed, so that track analysis and cross analysis are realized, and the accuracy of an analysis result is ensured; the method can effectively discover the unauthorized and illegal operation behaviors, so as to discover the invasive attack behaviors and improve the intranet security.

title: Viewpoint path planning method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of path planning, and provides a viewpoint path planning method, a viewpoint path planning device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the viewpoint path planning method comprises the following steps: determining boundary points, surface element examples and surface element types corresponding to the surface element examples corresponding to the target to be detected based on point cloud data of the target to be detected; determining a target viewpoint set based on a first viewpoint set corresponding to the bin type and a second viewpoint set corresponding to the boundary point; and determining a viewpoint traversing path based on the target viewpoint set. According to the viewpoint path planning method provided by the invention, the point cloud data of the target to be detected is obtained, the corresponding boundary points and the surface element types of the surface element examples are determined according to the point cloud data, and the target viewpoint set is obtained according to the viewpoint set corresponding to the surface element types and the viewpoint set corresponding to the boundary points, so that the viewpoint path planning is carried out according to the target viewpoint set, the labor is greatly saved, the method is suitable for various types of targets to be detected, and the universality is higher.

title: Analysis method of saline water resources in irrigation area based on deep learning
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of water resources analysis, and specifically discloses a method for analyzing salt water resources in irrigation areas based on deep learning. The method includes: aiming at matching degree of vegetation in irrigation areas, non-accumulation of salt in soil, and/or mixing of salty and fresh water with crop water demand and minimum economic investment, and taking the amount of salty and fresh water resources as constraints, a prediction model for utilization potential of underground salt water resources in irrigation areas is constructed; based on the prediction model for utilization potential of underground salt water resources in irrigation areas, parameters of potential utilization of salt water in irrigation areas are determined under different combinations. The invention can determine the utilization potential of salt water in irrigation districts under different scenarios and different combination modes, play an accurate guiding role in the development of salt water resources, and can effectively reduce the cost of development of salt water resources.

title: Pedestrian re-identification method, system, readable storage medium and computer equipment
description: The invention provides a pedestrian re-identification method, a system, a readable storage medium and computer equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: extracting features of the historical pedestrian images; encoding the feature tensor along the horizontal coordinate and the vertical coordinate respectively, performing cascade conversion on the horizontal feature and the vertical feature, and acquiring an attention feature map according to the middle feature map in the horizontal direction and the vertical direction; acquiring an activation weight corresponding to each activation value in the pooled core according to the attention feature map, so as to carry out weighted summation on all activation values in the pooled core according to the activation weights; and mapping the weighted sum value code to European space to calculate the class center of the sample, calculating class center triplet loss according to the class center of the sample, and iteratively training a pedestrian re-identification model according to the class center triplet loss. The invention can solve the problem of lower accuracy of pedestrian re-identification in the traditional technology.

title: CVGAN-based distortion communication complex signal anti-interference intermediate frequency generation method
description: The invention discloses a CVGAN-based distortion communication complex signal anti-interference intermediate frequency generation method. The invention has the core of an countermeasure network with a special structure, solves the problem of complex signal generation, enables a received distorted radio frequency signal to remove interference through the network, generates an anti-interference intermediate frequency signal, and can complete intermediate frequency signal integrity verification and radio frequency fingerprint identification through the generated anti-interference intermediate frequency signal, complete the intermediate frequency signal after verification and identification, extract a baseband and further complete baseband information analysis.

title: Road network updating method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the present application discloses a road network update method, device, electronic equipment, and storage medium; it can be used in the field of maps or transportation, including: obtaining the road network to be updated, and the road network to be updated includes multiple vertices; For each vertex in the vertices, at least two neighboring vertices corresponding to the vertices are determined, wherein the at least two neighboring vertices are connected to the corresponding vertices by a road segment, and each of the neighboring vertices has its own corresponding Initial elevation information; based on the initial elevation information of each neighbor vertex in the at least two neighbor vertices, determine the target elevation information of the vertex; based on the target elevation information of each vertex, for the road network to be updated The elevation information of each vertex is updated to obtain the updated road network. The embodiment of the present application can improve the efficiency and accuracy of determining the elevation information in the road network.

title: Intelligent extraction method, device, storage medium and equipment for map sensitive information
description: The invention discloses an intelligent extraction method, device, storage medium and equipment for map sensitive information, relates to the field of maps and computer vision, and can solve the problem that sensitive information of grid maps relies on manual extraction and review by map review experts, resulting in reduced map review efficiency technical problem. The methods include: acquiring a map image, annotating all location information on the map image, forming a map dataset from the annotated map image, and acquiring a non-map dataset composed of non-map images, wherein the location information includes the location name and location The location coordinates corresponding to the name, use the map data set and non-map data set to train the initial map information extraction model, get the optimal map information extraction model, use the optimal map information extraction model to extract all the target location information on the target map; use map sensitive The information knowledge base screens out target sensitive information in target location information.

title: Detection methods, devices, storage media and electronic equipment for leaked gas clouds
description: The application discloses a detection method and device of a leakage gas cloud cluster, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the detection method comprises the following steps: inputting the first infrared image into a gas cloud target detection model for target detection, outputting a first target frame conforming to the gas cloud characteristics, and determining a first target frame image corresponding to the first target frame based on the first infrared image; taking a plurality of first target frame images which are positioned in different frames and indicate the same air cloud target and are obtained after target detection is carried out on the first infrared image and N adjacent frames of infrared images as a target frame image group, and inputting an air cloud sequence classification model; processing an input target frame image group by using a gas cloud sequence classification model, and judging whether a gas cloud target indicated by the target frame image is suspicious leakage gas cloud or not based on the spatial characteristics of each target frame image in the target frame image group and the time characteristics among different target frame images; and outputting the gas cloud target determined to be the suspected leakage gas cloud as a detection result. By the method and the device, the detection accuracy of the leaked gas cloud cluster can be improved.

title: Foreign matter detection method and device for power transmission line, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a foreign object detection method, device, computer equipment and storage medium of a power transmission line. A low-light image optimization model is trained by obtaining a low-light image training set of a power transmission line. The low-light image optimization model can improve low-light image training. The concentrated images are optimized to make the obtained enhanced image to be tested clearer, and the enhanced image to be tested is obtained based on the low-light image optimization model, and the enhanced image to be tested is input to the foreign object detection model to obtain the target prediction of the foreign object vector. The power transmission line can be monitored in real time, and when a foreign object invades, the target prediction vector of the foreign object can be accurately obtained.

title: Air duct leakage signal detection method based on non-uniform frequency spectrogram
description: The present invention provides a method for detecting an air duct leakage signal based on a non-uniform frequency spectrogram, comprising steps: S1: collecting air duct leakage sound or vibration data; S2: performing high-pass filtering on the collected signal to suppress low-frequency noise; S3: Perform fast Fourier transform on the collected signal to find the high-frequency key feature interval; S4: Perform non-uniform frequency expansion on the frequency domain signal to generate a spectrogram expressed by non-uniform frequency, and adjust the function parameters to distinguish the features in different frequency intervals Process the signal and extract the key features of the signal; S5: Construct the DA‑YOLO5 neural network model for training to obtain the air duct leakage signal detection model. An air duct leakage signal detection method based on a non-uniform frequency spectrogram of the present invention generates a non-uniform frequency spectrogram, which effectively suppresses the influence of low-frequency noise and highlights high-frequency key features; The network model further improves the accuracy and timeliness of air duct leakage signal detection.

title: Task scheduling method and system based on artificial fish shoals
description: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, and provides a task scheduling method and a task scheduling system based on artificial fish shoals, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring parameters of a task allocation strategy set; determining a first execution time based on the first task and the first execution unit number; determining a movement increment and a movement strategy of the first target artificial fish based on the parameters, the first execution unit number and the first correction number; determining a second execution unit number and a second execution time based on the movement policy; and based on the first execution time and the second execution time, determining the total execution time and a first optimal task allocation strategy, and executing task scheduling through the first optimal task allocation strategy. According to the artificial fish swarm-based task scheduling method provided by the invention, the movement increment of the first target artificial fish is determined through the parameters, the first execution unit number and the first correction number, so that the movement strategy of the first target artificial fish is corrected, the optimal task allocation strategy is determined, and the accuracy of task scheduling is improved.

title: Safe federal learning method of ciphertext and plaintext hybrid learning mode
description: The invention discloses a secure federated learning method of a mixed learning mode of ciphertext and plaintext, which includes an encrypted training protocol in the first stage, a partial plaintext training protocol in the second stage, and the selection and discrimination of the current protocol; The index and the given discrimination method can determine which phase of the protocol should be used in this round of training, and send the judgment result to the server. The server decides this round of protocol according to the judgment result uploaded by the client and notifies it to the client. The client and server perform training and communication according to the content of the protocol to complete this round of training. The present invention selects appropriate training protocols in different periods of global training, protects the privacy of user data, improves the efficiency of federated learning training, effectively improves the efficiency of calculation, and reduces the bandwidth consumed by all parties to transmit data. Finally, Realized efficient deep neural network model training based on multi-party data.

title: An Urban Waterlogging Forecasting Method Based on Quadratic Isomorphic Mode Decomposition GRU Model
description: The present invention proposes an urban waterlogging forecasting method based on the quadratic isomorphic mode decomposition GRU model, which uses the EMD-GRU model to have relatively strong nonlinear feature extraction capabilities and sequence modeling capabilities, so as to be able to better handle nonlinear and Non-stationary data, thereby improving forecast accuracy and stability. At the same time, considering that the rainfall data used in urban waterlogging prediction usually contain certain randomness and uncertainty, so smoothing it can minimize the random error and uncertainty, thereby improving the accuracy and reliability of the prediction results sex.

title: Method for predicting concentration of gas in transformer oil based on online ensemble learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of transformer fault diagnosis, in particular to a method for predicting gas concentration in transformer oil based on online ensemble learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting gas data in the transformer oil through a gas concentration sensor and performing data processing to generate a data training set, S2, carrying out optimization of parameters of a least square support vector machine and an opposite type neural network through a nonlinear Kalman filtering algorithm, and S3, training new training data obtained through optimization and outputting a final prediction result. According to the invention, the acquired gas data is processed based on a scene memory gradient method, the parameters of a least square support vector machine and two machine learning algorithms of a countermeasure neural network are used as state variables through a nonlinear Kalman filtering algorithm, the optimal parameters are output, and the optimal prediction result is output according to the optimal weight, so that the accuracy of the prediction result is improved, and a better learning effect than that of a single learner is obtained.

title: Intelligent Bidding Evaluation System Based on Model Presentation and Neural Network
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent bid evaluation, and discloses an intelligent bid evaluation system based on model presentation and neural network, including a scanning module, a data acquisition module, a model presentation module, an artificial intelligence training module and an artificial intelligence decision-making module; To scan project materials and extract basic data from them; the model presentation module is used to generate a 3D model corresponding to the architectural design drawings based on the geometric data of the model, and match each component of the 3D model with associated construction information data, and perform a visual 3D display; The data acquisition module is used to obtain the bid evaluation reference data for bid evaluation; the artificial intelligence training module is used to train the intelligent decision-making model based on the bid evaluation reference data, and optimize the evaluation index weight during the training process; the artificial intelligence decision-making module is used to Based on the evaluation criteria, the corresponding tender documents for the project materials are evaluated and scored. The invention can carry out intelligent bid evaluation, and the evaluation result is accurate and fair.

title: Rumor detection method, rumor detection device, electronic equipment and medium
description: The present invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence, and discloses a rumor detection method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium, which can be used by insurance business personnel in the financial industry to judge current events. The method includes: extracting text sets from events to be detected and Corresponding timestamps; input the text set in the order of corresponding timestamps into the on-road network of the rumor detection model for rumor detection, obtain the first rumor detection result corresponding to each text, and input the timestamps corresponding to each text in sequence Go to the downlink network of the rumor detection model for rumor detection, and obtain the second rumor detection result corresponding to each timestamp; when the second rumor detection result meets the preset stop condition, stop the rumor detection of the uplink network and obtain the output of the uplink network The last rumor detection result of is used as the rumor judgment result of the event to be detected. The invention can improve the accuracy and efficiency of rumor event detection in the financial industry.

title: A Genetic Algorithm-Based Job Planning and Scheduling Method and Electronic Equipment
description: The invention discloses a genetic algorithm-based job planning and scheduling method and electronic equipment, including the following steps: coding and expressing job tasks as gene strings; randomly generating an initial population matrix, and decoding it to generate a phenotype matrix; calculating according to the fitness function FitnV The fitness value of each individual in the population, based on the roulette selection method, select the individual with the smallest fitness as the optimal individual; crossover and mutate the individuals in the population except the optimal individual; divide the optimal individual Merge with the individuals after crossover mutation to form a new generation of population; repeat the steps of iteratively obtaining a new generation of population until the maximum number of iterations is reached; in each generation of optimal individuals, select the optimal individual with the smallest fitness value as the final output result; Outputting a phenotype matrix corresponding to the final output result. The invention realizes intelligent job planning and scheduling based on the genetic algorithm, simplifies the distribution process, and makes the workload distribution more balanced.

title: Anti-occlusion multi-target tracking method based on trajectory prediction
description: The invention discloses an anti-occlusion multi-target tracking method based on trajectory prediction, and relates to the technical field of image processing methods. The method includes the following steps: obtaining a target prediction frame through trajectory prediction, and performing multi-target tracking in a general scenario as the first association matching; if the first association matching score reaches a preset threshold, the tracking task is completed; If the first correlation matching score does not reach the preset threshold, the second correlation matching will be performed; the second correlation matching is used for severe occlusion and complete occlusion situations, by using the quadratic polynomial based on the neighbor graph relationship. The target tracking method performs correlation matching; if the two correlation matches fail to match successfully, the historical trajectory information and target characteristics will be retained, and the target will continue to be tracked through the hypothesis frame continuous tracking mechanism. The method can achieve multi-target tracking under severe occlusion conditions.

title: Household charging pile monitoring method and system based on self-supervision and multi-task learning
description: The application discloses a household charging pile monitoring method and a household charging pile monitoring system based on self-supervision and multi-task learning, wherein the household charging pile monitoring method and the household charging pile monitoring system comprise the steps of acquiring the running active power of a household electric vehicle charging pile and the active power corresponding to a household bus by using an intelligent measuring terminal; preprocessing the collected data to generate a household charging pile monitoring data set; initializing a pre-training model, and performing self-supervision pre-training on the power data of the household buses in the data set based on reconstruction loss; initializing a multitasking charging pile monitoring model, migrating the feature extraction layer weight of the pre-training model, and training based on multitasking loss; and (3) putting the household charging pile monitoring model obtained through training into application, collecting the bus power at the entrance of a household, and carrying out event detection. The application provides a double-branch household charging pile monitoring model structure based on multi-task learning, which can effectively reduce the influence of the background load height fluctuation and improve the monitoring performance of the household charging pile.

title: Vulnerability detection method of quantum neural network and vulnerability detection method of autonomous driving
description: The invention discloses a vulnerability detection method of a quantum neural network, which comprises the steps of obtaining original input data and an initial quantum neural network model, and constructing a quantum state data set through coding processing; determining an optimization target for the challenge sample search by calculating the gradient direction; determining an optimization target of quantum entanglement coverage through a quantum state entanglement coverage calculation method of the model; defining a joint optimization target, and generating a target disturbance operator through optimization processing; adopting an initial network model and a target disturbance operator to finish vulnerability detection of the model; the invention also discloses an automatic driving vulnerability detection method, which comprises the steps of acquiring environment image data of an automatic driving system in a driving scene and an initial quantum neural network model applicable to the automatic driving system; training by a vulnerability detection method of a quantum neural network; and (5) completing vulnerability detection of the automatic driving system by adopting a training result. The reliability of the vulnerability detection method is improved, and the reliability of automatic driving is also improved.

title: Remote sensing image super-resolution method, system and medium based on residual separation attention mechanism
description: This application relates to an image super-resolution method, system and medium based on the residual separation attention mechanism, including downsampling high-resolution remote sensing satellite images to target low-resolution remote sensing satellite images; extracting rough feature maps; constructing upsampling module; build a residual separation attention module; build a residual separation attention group to further extract fine features; fuse the rough feature map as a global residual learning with the output of the last residual attention group, and finally obtain the The fine remote sensing satellite feature map is input into the multi-level feature fusion module for fusion; the final fine remote sensing satellite feature map obtained by fusion is subjected to ordinary convolution to reconstruct a high-resolution remote sensing satellite image of the target. The network proposed by the present invention is superior to other latest remote sensing satellite image super-resolution algorithms and can generate higher quality satellite images, especially in the case of high sampling multiples.

title: Image rendering model training method and image rendering method
description: The present disclosure relates to an image rendering model training method, image rendering method, device, electronic device and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining training data samples for a target object, and pre-training the image rendering model based on the training data samples. , obtain an image rendering model that meets the pre-training completion conditions; obtain the depth image corresponding to the target object based on the image rendering model that meets the pre-training completion conditions, and construct the point cloud data of the target object; surface the target object based on the point cloud data of the target object Reconstruction, obtain the surface reconstruction result of the target object, and determine the target sampling point corresponding to the target object based on the surface reconstruction result of the target object; based on the target sampling point, train the image rendering model that meets the pre-training completion conditions, and obtain the trained image Render the model. Using this method, the training efficiency of the image rendering model is improved.

title: Safety helmet detection method based on noise elimination training and dimension-reducing attention mechanism
description: The present invention proposes a hard hat detection method based on noise elimination training and dimensionality reduction attention mechanism. First, a hard hat detection data set is constructed by obtaining hard hat data pictures and preprocessing, and then a noise elimination training framework is constructed to replace the bipartite graph matching algorithm. , add noise to the ground‑truth information of each target object, introduce an attention mask, group the noise objects, and finally input the noise objects into the Transformer decoder. In addition, the present invention improves the multi-head attention mechanism in the Transformer architecture, decoupling key features into one-dimensional row features and one-dimensional column features through one-dimensional global average pooling, and then sequentially performs row attention and column attention, Finally, perform a weighted sum. The present invention uses sub-feature fusion and cross-layer perception enhancement convolution modules to build a lightweight feature extraction network, and adds it as a backbone network to the DETR network based on the Transformer architecture to obtain a lightweight DETR detection network.

title: Bleeding transformation judging method, device, medium and terminal based on multi-feature fusion
description: The application discloses a bleeding transformation judging method, a device, a storage medium and a terminal based on multi-feature fusion, wherein the method comprises the following steps: generating a CTP image vector and a text vector of the target object according to the original CTP image and the medical information text of the target object; inputting the CTP image vector and the text vector into a pre-trained bleeding transformation risk judging model, and outputting bleeding transformation probability; the bleeding conversion probability is generated based on image-text fusion characteristics, and the image-text fusion characteristics are generated by carrying out characteristic fusion based on CTP image vectors and text vectors; and when the bleeding conversion probability is larger than a preset probability threshold, determining that the bleeding conversion exists in the target object. According to the application, the CTP image vector and the text vector are constructed according to the original CTP image of the target object and the medical information text so as to realize feature fusion, and the medical information text contains a large number of parameters related to bleeding transformation, so that the feature richness of fusion is improved, and the bleeding transformation judgment accuracy is improved.

title: Page display method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: This application relates to a page display method, device, computer equipment, storage medium and computer program product. The method includes: when it is detected that at least two Lianmai user accounts with a preset matching relationship enter the target Lianmai room, obtain user information and personality description clue information of the at least two Lianmai user accounts; The character description clue information is determined based on the answer information entered by each Lianmai user account for the target questionnaire; the user information and the character description clue information are processed by a pre-trained generative artificial intelligence model to generate Target background image; when the interactive operation between the at least two Lianmai user accounts satisfies preset conditions, display an interaction result page including the target background image. Adopting this method can improve the display effect of interactive results.

title: A method and system for joint audio and video scene classification based on Transformer
description: This invention belongs to the field of deep learning technology, specifically relating to a Transformer network model for classification. It discloses a method for joint audio-video scene classification based on Transformer, comprising: using Transformer units to perform early fusion and feature extraction on noisy audio, video, and audio-video data respectively; using EfficientNetV2_S units to pre-train the video-side network on the fused feature representation; and inputting the weighted sum of audio features, video features, and joint audio-video features into a classifier for scene classification. This invention proposes replacing the original attention mechanism with a Transformer structure and replacing the original pre-trained model from ResNet50 with EfficientNetV2_S, thereby improving classification accuracy. The use of Transformer units enhances scene classification accuracy and improves the correlation between multimodal data.

title: Three-dimensional human body posture estimation method based on multi-level double-branch cross attention
description: The invention discloses a three-dimensional human body posture estimation method based on multi-level dual-branch cross-attention. The video to be detected is used as input, and the trained three-dimensional human body posture estimation model is used to predict the three-dimensional coordinates of human joint points in the two-dimensional image. The invention, through experimental results, shows that the prediction results are closer to the real prediction results than mainstream methods, enriching the method system of artificial intelligence and computer vision, and providing an option to improve prediction accuracy in the field of three-dimensional human posture estimation.

title: A method for analyzing the operational efficiency of the whole process of dispatching and commanding business
description: The invention discloses a method for analyzing the operation efficiency of the whole process of dispatching and commanding business, which belongs to the field of dispatching and commanding. Integrate the regression model of each process into an overall model, traverse the value space of each parameter in the overall model, form multiple parameter value combinations, train the overall model based on multiple parameter value combinations, and obtain the entire process operation efficiency prediction model, and then apply the whole-process operation efficiency prediction model to predict the operation efficiency of each process and the whole-process operation efficiency, realizing efficient analysis and evaluation of dispatch and command business operation efficiency.

title: A multi-classification and detection method of potato diseases based on iterative learning
description: The invention provides a multi-classification and detection method of potato diseases based on iterative learning. The method includes: conducting statistics on labeled potato disease data, such as pictures of leaves, insect damage, stems, etc., evenly extracting each category, and dividing the extracted data into a training set and a verification set according to a certain proportion; Perform data enhancement, input the deep learning model for training, adjust the hyperparameters on the verification set, and find the optimal supervised model weights; for unlabeled potato disease data, use the above weights to perform model inference and achieve pre-labeling; according to Detect the confidence and clean the pre-labeled data; freeze the backbone feature network of the model, and only reverse the gradient of the last output layer of the model; input unlabeled potato disease data into the model, and iterate the above training and pre-labeling process until the evaluation index Achieve balance.

title: Mechanical bearing residual service life prediction method based on DRSN-CS and BiGRU+MLP models
description: A method for predicting the remaining service life of mechanical bearings based on DRSN‑CS and BiGRU+MLP models, using an integrated method of signal denoising and feature extraction, namely the deep residual shrinkage network DRSN‑CS, for adaptive signal denoising and automatic extraction. Degradation characteristics; using the bidirectional gated cyclic unit BiGRU as the life prediction network, compared with the traditional recurrent neural network, it can better solve the gradient disappearance and gradient explosion problems. The model structure is simpler, the calculation speed is faster, and it can be used in a shorter time Longer time series information is learned, and the gating mechanism in the BiGRU model can effectively control the flow of information and improve the generalization ability of the network. The prediction method of the present invention: first normalize the original bearing vibration signal; then use the DRSN-CS model to learn and extract deep degradation features to construct health indicators; finally, input the obtained health indicators into the prediction model BiGRU+MLP to complete Remaining useful life prediction.

title: Extensible layout unit, multi-bit structure and flip chip
description: The application discloses an expandable layout unit, a multi-bit structure and a flip chip, and belongs to the field of quantum chip manufacturing. The expandable layout unit comprises a first capacitance plate and a second capacitance plate which are spaced from each other. And the expandable layout unit can also comprise two Josephson junctions connected in parallel between the two; and wherein the josephson junction may be provided with a read cavity coupled thereto and the read cavity is provided in proximity to but not in contact with the second capacitive plate. Based on the design of two capacitance polar plates, when the expandable layout unit is expanded, a plurality of reading cavities can be subjected to centralized wiring, so that the wiring difficulty during bit expansion is reduced, and the design and manufacturing efficiency is improved.

title: Tumor progress evaluation method based on two-stage multitask learning
description: The invention relates to a tumor progression assessment method based on two-stage multi-task learning. The method includes: CT image acquisition; coarse segmentation prediction; two-stage multi-task learning framework construction: integrating correlation between longitudinal images and clinical prior information to generate The feature map, based on the multi-task learning framework, constructs a disease progression classification sub-model based on the total tumor volume and a progression classification sub-model based on new lesions, respectively, to evaluate the progress of changes in the total tumor volume and evaluate new lesions respectively; among them, based on the total tumor volume The volumetric disease progression classification sub-model adopts a two-branch structure of segmentation and classification. In the classification branch, the progression judgment labels are continuously and orderly encoded to optimize the coarse segmentation results of forward registration and return them through inverse transformation; the total tumor volume is integrated The results of the change progression assessment and the assessment of new lesions are used to obtain the tumor progression assessment results. Compared with the existing technology, the present invention has the advantage of high accuracy in tumor progression assessment.

title: A voice- and video-based gesture recognition method, device, equipment and medium
description: The invention provides a gesture recognition method, device, equipment and medium based on voice and video, relating to the field of data processing, comprising the following steps: acquiring video data and voice data, and respectively preprocessing to acquire first processing data and second processing data; establishing an initial model, and training by adopting training data to obtain a target model; the target model comprises a first feature extraction network, a second feature extraction network and a feature fusion module, wherein the first feature extraction network and the second feature extraction network are formed by a plurality of stacked convolution blocks, and the feature fusion module is formed by a plurality of convolution layers; extracting image features of the first processing data through the first feature extraction network to obtain first features; extracting voice characteristics of the second processing data through the second characteristic extraction network to obtain second characteristics; and carrying out feature fusion by adopting a feature fusion module based on the first feature and the second feature so as to output a target result containing gesture information, thereby solving the problem that the accuracy rate of the gesture action identification by the existing video information is not high enough.

title: Pseudo tag unsupervised data training method, device, equipment and medium
description: The invention provides a pseudo tag non-supervision data training method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of using a CLIP pre-training model to carry out sample preliminary labeling on non-labeling image data in an image library; according to the preliminary labeling result and the category confidence, selecting samples from different categories to obtain manual labeling image data, performing supervised training on a classification model by using the manual labeling image data through a cross entropy loss function, copying the trained classification model into two parts, wherein one part is used as a teacher network model and the other part is used as a student network model, generating a pseudo label for non-labeling image data by the teacher network model, calculating an adaptive threshold value based on clustering pseudo labels, filtering the pseudo labels generated by the teacher network model by using the adaptive threshold value, and training the student network model by using the filtered pseudo labels. The method has the advantages of reducing the manual labeling cost and being convenient for generating diversified and high-quality pseudo labels.

title: Content push method, device, electronic equipment and computer-readable storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present application disclose a content pushing method, device, electronic equipment and computer-readable storage medium. The method includes: displaying a media information collection interface to a target user, and obtaining expectations input by the target user according to the media information collection interface. Media asset information; determine target media asset content based on expected media asset information; push the target media asset content to the interface of the target display terminal. By displaying the media information collection interface to the user, the user can actively obtain the desired media information after inputting the desired media information, thereby improving the accuracy of obtaining the desired media information. Among them, the target media content is determined based on the media content information expected by the user, so that the media content provided in the interface of the target display terminal is more in line with the user's needs and facilitates the user to quickly engage in movie watching.

title: A method for dynamically enhancing magnetic resonance imaging features to generate pathological image features
description: The invention discloses a method for generating pathological image features by dynamically enhancing magnetic resonance image features. And secondly, constructing a feature extraction network based on a visual self-attention model and a cross-attention mechanism, and extracting DCE-MRI features and pathological image features. The pathology image features are then generated using the DCE-MRI features based on the challenge-generating network. And finally, generating pathological image features by using the DCE-MRI data and through the DCE-MRI branches of the trained feature extraction network and the trained feature generation network. The invention better utilizes the global information of the image, and enables the model to generate pathological image features through DCE-MRI images under the condition of no pathological image, thereby solving the problem of pathological image deletion.

title: Dialogue processing method, dialogue processing device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a method, an apparatus, a computer device, a storage medium and a computer program product for processing a dialog. The barrage text display method can be applied to the field of artificial intelligence, and can be particularly applied to application scenes of intelligent dialogue on computers, intelligent mobile phones or vehicle-mounted equipment. The method comprises the following steps: when receiving the data to be replied of the target object, acquiring dialogue data of the target object and the robot; determining target thinking information of a target object and reply thinking information of the robot based on the dialogue data and the data to be replied; generating candidate reply data and dialogue thinking information chains based on the target thinking information, the reply thinking information, the data to be replied and the dialogue data; determining a conversation context relevance based on the candidate reply data and the conversation thinking information chain; and selecting reply data matched with the data to be replied on the basis of the dialogue context relativity in the candidate reply data. By adopting the method, the context consistency of the intelligent dialogue can be improved.

title: Black manuscript auditing and customizing system and method
description: The invention discloses a black manuscript auditing and customizing system and method, comprising a manuscript library management module, a file loading module, a region drawing module, a character recognition module and a manuscript comparison module; the manuscript library management module is used for storing standard manuscripts and carrying out classified management on the stored standard manuscripts; the file loading module is used for loading standard manuscripts and manuscripts to be compared; the region drawing module is used for marking the frame selection comparison region and carrying out character recognition and comparison; the character recognition module is used for recognizing the marked manuscript characters, comparing the characters and outputting the result in a window of a system interface in a comparison way; and the manuscript comparison module is used for comparing the standard manuscript with the file to be compared based on the picture format and outputting a comparison result. The invention constructs a character image processing system for character image consistency comparison, which is used for comparison and identification of standard manuscripts in engineering, has the functions of electronic signature and report output, and has simple operation and high identification accuracy.

title: A physical examination queuing system based on reinforcement learning prediction and sorting based on data flow
description: The invention discloses a physical examination queuing system based on intensive learning prediction sorting based on data flow, which includes a sign-in machine, a triage table, a doctor terminal, a display terminal, a reinforcement learning module and a smart medical physical examination system. The sign-in machine and the triage table are Sign in with the patient; after signing in, the patient's data will be queued up and arrive at the examination room for the patient's first physical examination item. At the same time, the patient's information will be displayed on the doctor's side and the display side of the corresponding examination room; the doctor's side will call the patient for physical examination. The recommended order of the remaining physical examination items; after the doctor calls the patient, a pop-up box will appear on the doctor's side to remind the patient of the next examination item to be performed. The present invention relates to the technical field of queue management. This kind of reinforcement learning prediction sorting physical examination queuing system based on data flow can reduce waiting time when queuing and improve the hospital's physical examination efficiency.

title: Brillouin sensing high-precision data demodulation method
description: The invention provides a Brillouin sensing high-precision data demodulation method, and relates to the technical field of optical fiber communication. The technical key points of the invention include: curve fitting is carried out on the Brillouin gain spectrum, and a nonlinear least square optimal solution of a fitted curve is obtained by utilizing an Adagrad algorithm, wherein the frequency corresponding to the optimal solution is Brillouin frequency shift; the Adagrad algorithm updates parameters through historical gradient information of each parameter, corrects parameters of the fitting function in an iterative process, obtains frequency shift of a Brillouin gain spectrum through obtaining frequency corresponding to the highest point of the fitting function when iteration is stopped, and further obtains strain information distributed along the optical fiber. The invention has low dependence on initial values, and as no history gradient accumulation exists at the beginning, the learning rate denominator is small, so that the overall learning rate is large, and the convergence state can be reached quickly; the method improves the curve fitting precision and has better real-time performance.

title: An efficient radar signal modulation mode identification method and device
description: The invention discloses an efficient radar signal modulation mode identification method and device, and specifically proposes a spatio-temporal feature sharing reconstruction network STARNet, which achieves excellent identification accuracy in a lightweight manner. A single autoencoder structure is used to simultaneously extract low-dimensional spatial and temporal features of radio signals. In addition, a hybrid attention module (HA‑Ghost) is designed to automatically extract differentiated radar signal spatial information based on signal reconstruction performance. This reduces the number of parameters of the model and improves the performance of automatic recognition. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that the proposed STARNet achieves an average modulation classification accuracy of 63.60%, outperforming previous state-of-the-art models. Moreover, despite extracting more types of features, STARNet only has 14860 parameters, which is much less than existing autoencoder-based methods.

title: Service prediction model training method, equipment and medium based on graph neural network
description: The invention discloses a business prediction model training method, equipment, storage medium and program product based on graph neural network, including: inputting the first business relationship diagram data of the training sample in the first participant's device to the first underlying network Perform processing to obtain the first hidden layer output; perform a security matrix multiplication calculation based on the first hidden layer output and the second hidden layer output in the second participant device and the network parameters of the aggregation layer network for the second participant device to determine The aggregation output result of the aggregation layer network; the second participant device is combined to perform gradient backpropagation based on the first gradient value of the aggregation output result, and each network parameter in the graph neural network is updated for multiple rounds to obtain a business prediction model. The present invention implements a training solution for a business prediction model based on a graph neural network using vertical federated learning to ensure data privacy and security.

title: Medical service method, device, equipment and medium based on LLM intelligent body architecture
description: The present invention provides medical service methods, devices, equipment and media based on LLM intelligent agent architecture. It uses LLM's ability to understand and generate language texts to realize the understanding and analysis of problems or instructions, disassemble them into subtasks and generate computer Program code implements the specific functions of the robot by executing the generated executable code in a pre-designed "sandbox". At the same time, based on this architecture, flexible system function expansion capabilities can be provided.

title: Deep learning multitasking magnetic resonance heart segmentation and quantification method
description: A deep learning multitasking magnetic resonance heart segmentation and quantification method relates to the field of image processing. Acquiring a magnetic resonance heart multi-contrast image, preprocessing data, and manufacturing a training label; dividing the processed data set into a training set, a verification set and a test set according to a fixed proportion; constructing a residual convolution network-based multi-task magnetic resonance cardiac segmentation and quantification network, the network simultaneously comprising a method for generating cardiac T  2  A quantitative quantification module and a segmentation module for heart structure segmentation; designing a multi-tasking loss function strategy, determining network optimizer parameters using with segmentation and localizationTraining the model by a training data set of the quantity label; loading a training model, inputting a test set, performing RGB mapping operation on the output segmentation result, and performing window cutting operation on the output quantitative result to obtain final heart segmentation and quantitative result.

title: Complex power transmission line identification method based on novel coding and decoding network
description: The invention discloses a complex power transmission line identification method based on a novel coding and decoding network, which comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring a complex power line image containing a plurality of crossed and diverted power lines; step 2: preprocessing an image containing a complex power line, and expanding the image containing the complex power line by a data enhancement method; labeling the image containing the complex power transmission line by using labeling software, and constructing an image dataset containing the complex power transmission line; step 3: constructing a novel coding and decoding network; step 4: inputting the complex power transmission line training set into a novel coding and decoding network for training to obtain a weight parameter with optimal training, and obtaining a complex power transmission line identification network model; step 5: and inputting the image to be detected into a complex power transmission line recognition network model, and outputting a recognition result to realize the accurate recognition of the complex power transmission line. The method has high stability and strong generalization capability, can effectively inhibit background noise in the image and accurately identify the complex transmission line.

title: Efficient data analysis and processing method based on pattern recognition algorithm
description: The invention discloses a high-efficiency data analysis and processing method based on a pattern recognition algorithm, and relates to the technical field of data analysis and processing; preprocessing data; training a model and performing data modeling: according to the preprocessed data, a corresponding deep learning algorithm or a combined deep learning algorithm is selected for modeling and training, wherein the deep learning algorithm comprises a convolutional neural network CNN, a long and short memory network LSTM and a self Encoder Auto Encoder; and (3) carrying out data association analysis: obtaining various correlations and correlations inside the data set according to a correlation rule mining algorithm and a cluster analysis algorithm; constructing a database and providing a data query service: and constructing a database by adopting an open-source relational database MySQL and a distributed database Hadoop/Hive, and inquiring and analyzing data by utilizing the characteristics extracted after preprocessing and data modeling.

title: Screw quality detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present invention provide a screw quality detection method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium. The method includes: collecting target quality parameters for target screws, and the target quality parameters include at least one of the following: target hardness data, target toughness data, target tension data, target torque data, and target thread data; input the target quality parameters into the preset screw quality prediction model to obtain the quality detection results of the target screw; among them, the screw quality prediction model is trained by a set of training quality parameters, The training quality parameter set includes training quality parameters and corresponding screw quality levels; the training quality parameters include at least one of the following: training hardness data, training toughness data, training tensile data, training torque data, and training thread data. Based on the model, the quality of screws is automatically detected based on the data obtained from screw detection, which improves the accuracy of screw quality detection.

title: Power equipment fault diagnosis method based on causal domain adaptation and sound vibration fusion
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of machine learning, and particularly relates to a power equipment fault diagnosis method based on causal domain adaptation and sound vibration fusion, which is provided by the invention, wherein sound real-time signal data of a target power equipment when the power equipment is in fault is input into a sound vibration conversion model to obtain a sound conversion signal; and inputting the sound conversion signal and the vibration real-time signal data into a causal domain adaptive fault diagnosis model to obtain a fault diagnosis result. According to the method, the problem that a traditional deep learning model is difficult to train due to the fact that single-mode fault samples are scarce is solved through the sound vibration conversion model, the problem that the model is insufficient in universality is solved, the sound vibration fusion data is utilized to construct a fault diagnosis model based on domain adaptation fusion, after model training is finished, the model can be utilized to conduct fault diagnosis on sound vibration data of different sources in an actual task, and the problem that the traditional deep learning diagnosis model is insufficient in accuracy and poor in universality when processing data of different sources is solved.

title: Method for generating quick creation of virtual digital person
description: The invention discloses a method for generating a virtual digital person by rapid creation, and relates to the technical field of computer content generation. According to the method for generating the virtual digital person rapid creation, each part of the virtual digital person can be controlled and driven, the control and driving are combined actions formed according to the text model, and time action data are referred, so that the actions of the digital person are under policy guidance, the action characteristics of the actual situation are more met, the digital person has better stability and adaptability under the control of the text model, and under a trained framework, the virtual digital person can rapidly create complex continuous actions according to the recombination of the text.

title: Unmanned image instance segmentation method and system based on prototype comparison learning
description: This invention discloses a method and system for autonomous driving image instance segmentation based on prototype contrastive learning, belonging to the field of image instance segmentation technology. The method includes: inputting multiple acquired autonomous driving images into a student model within an image instance segmentation model; extracting image instance features; and, based on prototype knowledge transferred to the student model, acquiring prototype knowledge specific to the image instance features through a query method; and, combined with the image instance features, outputting the image instance segmentation result. The image instance segmentation model includes a teacher model and a student model. The teacher model uses a feature extraction network and a prototype knowledge acquisition network to acquire sample image features and prototype knowledge similar to those features, respectively. The teacher model is trained based on contrastive learning, and the prototype knowledge learned by the trained teacher model is transferred to the student model. This invention ensures the accuracy of instance segmentation and simplifies the scale of the instance segmentation model through prototype contrastive learning and knowledge distillation.

title: Image processing, network training, coding methods and devices, equipment, storage media
description: Image processing, network training and encoding methods and devices, equipment and storage media; the network training method comprises the following steps: performing joint training on the coding and decoding network and the task execution network according to joint loss functions of the coding and decoding network and the task execution network and a preset sample training set until values of the joint loss functions meet convergence conditions, and obtaining a trained coding and decoding network and a trained task execution network; the task execution network is used for executing a machine learning task according to the decoded reconstructed image output by the coding and decoding network, and the joint loss function comprises a loss function of the task execution network and a function of the bit rate of a characteristic code stream of an input image of the coding and decoding network.

title: A method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium for generating a schedule plan
description: This application provides a method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium for generating a scheduling plan, which relates to the field of data processing technology and acquires conventional data and real-time data; based on the conventional data and real-time data, the first constraint and the second constraint are generated respectively. Conditions; randomly combine employees to obtain multiple initial scheduling plans, and based on the first constraint and fitness function, adjust and optimize the scheduling sequences in the multiple initial scheduling plans to generate the first scheduling plan; based on The second constraint modifies the first shift plan so that the workload of each employee in the first shift plan does not exceed the second constraint, and the target shift plan is obtained. This application generates the first shift plan based on the first constraint and fitness function. By flexibly adjusting the shift plan, employee satisfaction and work efficiency are improved. Based on the second constraint, the employee shift sequence is optimized and reasonably controlled. Employee fatigue levels and meeting overtime limits.

title: Defrost control method and device
description: The invention provides a defrost control method and device, an air conditioner and a non-transitory computer-readable medium. In the method provided by the present invention, the operating parameters and/or outdoor environmental parameters of the air conditioner are first collected in a preset cycle, and then the frost change parameters corresponding to the air conditioner are calculated, and then the frost change parameters are used to evaluate the impact of the frost layer on the air conditioner. The influence degree parameter of the operating ability is finally controlled based on the influence degree parameter to control the defrost work of the air conditioner. Based on the defrost control method proposed by the present invention, the real-time frosting speed can be calculated according to the actual operation process, and the impact of the real-time frost layer on the system capability can be calculated according to the formula to determine whether to perform defrost. Through the solution of the present invention, it can This allows the air conditioner to defrost at the best time and improves the heating comfort of the air conditioner.

title: Image retrieval method and device based on target shape characteristics, equipment and medium
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of image retrieval, and discloses an image retrieval method and device based on target shape characteristics, wherein a Stein-Weiss function is constructed for each pixel point in an image to be retrieved, 16 characteristic values of the corresponding pixel point in the image to be retrieved are calculated according to the resolution of each Stein-Weiss function, and an error back propagation neural network model is input to obtain a contour edge binary image; linear feature extraction is carried out on the contour edge binary image, and paired geometric feature vectors are obtained; when the similarity between the pair of geometric feature vectors and the candidate feature vectors reaches the preset similarity, the target image corresponding to the candidate feature vectors is determined to be a search result, so that the higher-dimensional feature value in the image can be calculated by utilizing the Stein-Weiss function, the extracted target shape contour is more refined, the richer contour edge information can be extracted, the search accuracy is further improved, the calculation operation time is reduced, and the robustness is also improved.

title: A method for evaluating the effectiveness of machine learning potential surface feature engineering
description: A method for evaluating the effectiveness of feature engineering on machine learning potential surfaces includes: generating feature engineering test datasets: rotation test dataset, translation test dataset, permutation test dataset, sensitivity test dataset, and consistency and continuity test dataset; using feature engineering to calculate the output of each system within one or more of the five specialized test datasets in the feature engineering test datasets, performing result statistics and evaluating the feature engineering; and statistically analyzing the evaluation results among different datasets within the feature engineering test datasets to provide an overall evaluation of the feature engineering. This invention, by considering the symmetry of the structure itself, strictly distinguishes between equivalent and inequivalent structures and requires that they be reflected in the output of the feature engineering, ensuring that the output information of the optimal feature engineering method does not interfere with the fitting of the neural network model. This invention can significantly improve the training accuracy of machine learning potential surface models and reduce the computational cost of network tuning.

title: Text data generation method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The invention provides a text data generation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium, and relates to the technical field of electronic equipment. The text data generation method includes: obtaining preset text structure information; when the first text collection is obtained, generating model input data based on the preset text summary information, preset text structure information and the first text collection; inputting the model The data is input into the preset model to generate target text data. The target text data is structured text data that matches the preset text structure information.

title: Method and system for generating secondary physical loop information model of conventional transformer substation
description: The invention provides a method and a system for generating a secondary physical loop information model of a conventional transformer substation, comprising the following steps: acquiring a CAD drawing of a transformer substation; analyzing the graphic primitive in the CAD drawing to obtain graphic primitive parameters; calculating the intersection point of the graphic class primitives and splitting the primitives according to the intersection point; calculating the overlapping interval of the graphic class primitives to split the primitives and eliminate the overlapping primitives; recalibrating the coordinates of the primitives by taking the central point of the primitives as the origin of coordinates, and extracting the effective parameter values of the primitives according to the sequence of the coordinates of the primitives; word segmentation is carried out on the text by using a pre-training model and a word segmentation device, words are converted into word vectors, and the word vectors are constructed into sentence vectors by using a word bag model; the binary cluster tree is output by using the reduced and text vectorized primitive parameter hierarchical clustering primitives; and traversing the leaf node clusters layer by layer to the root node, and distributing actual substation physical components for each node to form a conventional substation secondary physical loop information model. The invention has higher automation degree.

title: Charging bill word segment supplementing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a charging bill field supplementing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium.
