The method includes: decoding the charging bill based on a multi-code stream log file message decoding method; decoding abnormality based on a clustering algorithm Charging bills are clustered; the key field information data of abnormal billing bills is obtained according to the data flow weight characteristic value of abnormal billing bills and super-information fuzzy matching is performed; the codec based on the attention mechanism The recursive super information data of the abnormal billing bill is encoded and decoded; the recursive super information discrete feature data is predicted based on the preset neural network; the missing field data of the abnormal billing bill is supplemented and processed. The invention can reduce the loss rate of billing bills and improve the accuracy of billing bill data and billing processing results. As a charging bill field supplementing method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium, the present invention can be widely used in the technical field of telecommunications business processing.

title: Identity verification method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of blockchain, and discloses an identity verification method, device, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring the decentralised identity of the user and face data to be verified, searching a face data proving character string of the user according to the decentralised identity, verifying the face data to be verified according to the face data proving character string, and obtaining an identity verification result of the user; because the face data of the user is the private key of the user for decentralizing identity, the invention can directly verify the identity of the user through the face data of the user, thereby overcoming the problems of hard recording of the key and lost of the key, further improving the reliability of the identity verification and improving the user experience.

title: Workflow execution sequence generation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a workflow execution sequence generation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining a workflow execution sequence data set, which includes a training workflow description and a corresponding standard workflow execution sequence, training an initial model based on the workflow execution sequence data set, and obtaining execution Sequence generation model, input the target workflow requirement description into the execution sequence generation model to obtain the initial workflow execution sequence. If the initial workflow execution sequence does not meet the preset requirements, input the initial workflow execution sequence into the execution sequence. The sequence optimization model determines the target workflow execution sequence, and the execution sequence optimization model is trained by a reinforcement learning model. It not only improves the efficiency of workflow execution sequence generation, saves a lot of manpower and time, but also improves resource utilization.

title: Graph neural network interpretation method and device based on game theory
description: The invention discloses a graph neural network interpretation method and device based on game theory, proposes a structure-aware graph neural network interpretation method, uses the HN value of game theory to calculate the node importance score, and provides a The central node sampling strategy based on Monte Carlo sampling and the shortest path is used to assist in the calculation of node scores. The Hamiache-Navarro (HN) value used in the present invention is structure-aware, which is conducive to better utilization of the graph structure, thereby effectively interpreting the graph neural network results; the present invention uses Monte Carlo sampling, which can better estimate the The HN value on a large graph solves the difficulties of most game theory-based graph neural network explanation algorithms and improves explanation efficiency.

title: Single-view indoor scene three-dimensional reconstruction method, system and equipment
description: The invention belongs to the field of three-dimensional model reconstruction, and specifically relates to a single-view indoor scene three-dimensional reconstruction method, system and equipment, aiming to solve the problem that the existing 3D model reconstruction technology requires a large amount of data support and is performing models with complex spatial relationships. Error-prone issues when restoring. The invention includes: acquiring an image to be reconstructed; based on the image to be reconstructed, through a 2D detection network, acquiring an image to be reconstructed with a target bounding box; based on the image to be reconstructed and the image to be reconstructed with a target bounding box, using The dual-branch 3D reconstruction network generates correctly placed 3D models of indoor scenes and objects. This invention clarifies the importance of the relationship between 3D objects and the importance of channels in 3D reconstruction by setting up object relationship attention modules and squeeze excitation networks in different sub-networks in the 3D reconstruction network, and improves the efficiency of 3D reconstruction. The precision of the effect.

title: A graph data retrieval model training method based on hierarchical pooling graph hashing
description: This specification discloses a graph data retrieval model training method based on hierarchical pooling graph hashing. The retrieval model to be trained includes a coding sub-model and a prediction sub-model. The coding sub-model includes a convolution layer and a coding layer, so The convolutional layer includes embedding sub-layer, allocation sub-layer and output sub-layer. In the convolution process of each layer of the coding sub-model, the aggregation of the node features represented by the feature matrix of the previous convolution layer and the aggregation of the number of nodes represented by the adjacency matrix of the previous convolution layer are realized, so that each The feature matrices obtained by each convolutional layer retain the structural information of the graph data. Obtain the graph features according to the feature matrix, and then obtain the graph hash code of the graph data based on the graph features. Because the feature matrix retains the result information of the graph data, the obtained graph hash code is more accurate. After processing the graph data based on the graph hash code When searching, the search results obtained are also more accurate.

title: Airline pricing strategy formulation method based on Bayesian game and multi-objective optimization
description: The invention relates to airline pricing strategies, and specifically relates to a method for formulating airline pricing strategies based on Bayesian game and multi-objective optimization. It establishes a Bayesian game model and describes the competitive environment through the Bayesian game model; and adopts a differential evolution algorithm to solve the problem. The price vector of each airline realizes the Nash equilibrium of the competition process; based on the price vector of each airline, a multi-objective optimization algorithm is used to calculate the Pareto optimal solution set, and the optimal price vector of each airline under multi-objectives is obtained; output to the user The optimal pricing strategy of each airline company; the technical solution provided by the present invention can effectively overcome the shortcoming of the existing technology that cannot formulate the optimal pricing strategy under multi-objective conditions.

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for manufacturing instruction book
description: According to the manufacturing method, the device, the equipment and the storage medium of the specifications, under the condition that the information of the specifications triggering the manufacturing of the product is obtained, a first interactive interface is output, wherein the first interactive interface comprises a plurality of specification modules, and each specification module can be independently edited; outputting a second interactive interface under the condition that trigger information of the user for completing editing of the target specification module is obtained, wherein the second interactive interface comprises contents of the target specification module, and each specification module in the second interactive interface can be independently edited; when trigger information for determining the content of each specification module is obtained, a specification is generated based on the content of each specification module, and a plurality of environment personnel can participate in production at the same time through an interactive interface, so that production efficiency is improved.

title: Structural reliability testing methods, devices, equipment and storage media for auto parts
description: The invention provides a structural reliability testing method, device, equipment and storage medium for automobile parts. The method includes: conducting reliability testing on target automobile parts to obtain operating data and material data; testing the target automobile parts according to the material data. Corrosion defect detection, get the detection results, perform feature extraction on the material data based on the detection results, and get the material feature vector; perform feature extraction on the operation data, get the operation characteristics, perform feature encoding conversion on the detection results and operation characteristics, and generate the corresponding impact characteristics vector; calculate the structural corrosion rate and structural strength of the target auto parts based on the influence eigenvector and material eigenvector respectively to evaluate the reliability of the target auto parts. This method combines the operating data and material data of the accessories. By performing feature extraction, coding conversion and model processing on the two, it can more accurately evaluate the corrosion status and structural strength of the accessories, and more comprehensively evaluate the reliability of the accessories.

title: A pixel-level classification method for hyperspectral images based on MADWA network
description: A pixel-level classification method for hyperspectral images based on MADWA network, which belongs to the field of remote sensing image classification. The present invention solves the problem of poor classification accuracy of existing deep neural networks under the background of noisy labels. This invention uses a multi-scale structure to fully learn real label and noise label data information, improving the network's ability to learn information; and designs a spectral spatial attention structure, which can more effectively focus on the unique characteristics that should be learned in each dimension. , to make full use of local features of hyperspectral data and improve classification accuracy. And by using asymmetric convolution kernels, model parameters can be greatly reduced, the running speed is improved, and the computational complexity is reduced. The method of the present invention can be applied to remote sensing image classification.

title: Image segmentation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium for application interface
description: The application discloses an image segmentation method and device of an application interface, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of image processing. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that electronic equipment obtains an operation interface screenshot of a target application, wherein the target application is an application associated with a target task; and extracting at least part of entity objects contained in the operation interface screenshot by using a pre-trained image segmentation model to obtain an image segmentation result, and executing the operation corresponding to the target task according to the image segmentation result, wherein the image segmentation model is obtained by performing image segmentation training by using a plurality of applied operation interface screenshot samples in advance. Therefore, the image segmentation model specially trained for the running interface of the application is utilized to segment the running interface screenshot of the target application, so that a more accurate image segmentation result can be obtained, and the execution effect of the operation corresponding to the target task executed based on the accurate image segmentation result is better and more accurate.

title: An integrated feeding plan optimization method and system for wide and thick plates based on NSGA-Ⅲ
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for optimizing the integrated feeding plan of wide and thick plates based on NSGA-III, the method comprising: obtaining order and process related parameters, and defining decision variables; designing two-stage objective functions and constraints, and constructing a two-stage multi-objective optimization model based on the obtained order and process related parameters, and the defined decision variables; wherein the first-stage objective function is used to solve the feeding balance problem and optimize the order execution timing and relative position; the second-stage objective function is used to continue to optimize the furnace order and slab sequence corresponding to the order based on the optimization result of the first-stage multi-objective optimization model; based on the NSGA-III algorithm, the two-stage multi-objective optimization model is solved to obtain an optimized feeding plan. The scheme of the present invention can significantly optimize the feeding sequence, improve the coordination and balance of materials between processes, reduce material reversal and waiting, and improve production efficiency.

title: Four-hazard intelligent detection method and system based on image recognition
description: The invention relates to the field of image processing, and specifically to an intelligent detection method and system for four hazards based on image recognition, that is, collecting a target RGB image, converting the target RGB image from RGB color space to LAB color space, and obtaining the target image; The image is subjected to image processing to obtain a saliency image; the target RGB image and the saliency image are used as the input of the constructed network recognition model, and the target image is recognized and detected. That is to say, the solution of the present invention obtains a salient image by processing the target image, and combines the salient image with the target RGB image to perform intelligent identification of four pests, which can improve the accuracy of four pest identification.

title: Multi-target detection model and method for urban capacity event management
description: This solution provides a multi-target detection model and method for urban appearance event management, improves the dynamic hybrid self-attention mechanism, uses global channel features and local channel features to collect global and local information, and integrates the global effective receptive field and The inductive bias of convolution; the introduction of a mixed group attention mechanism enables the model to more comprehensively capture the structural information in the image, improves the sensitivity to visual patterns at different scales and levels, and thus improves the performance of the multi-target detection model in city appearance. Accuracy in target detection.

title: Method, device and electronic equipment for estimating state of charge of marine lithium-ion power battery
description: The invention provides a method and a device for estimating the state of charge of a marine lithium ion power battery and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring voltage time sequence data, current time sequence data and temperature time sequence data of the marine lithium ion power battery; extracting features of the time sequence data to obtain corresponding input features; performing feature fusion to obtain fusion features; inputting the fusion characteristics into a trained module neural network to obtain a first state of charge estimated value; determining a second state of charge estimate based on the charge and discharge current of the marine lithium-ion power battery in the target time period, the state of charge at the start of the target time period, and the battery capacity; a final state of charge estimate is determined based on the first state of charge estimate and the second state of charge estimate. The invention solves the problem of low accuracy and reliability of the existing battery state-of-charge estimation algorithm by fusing the first state-of-charge estimation value with the second state-of-charge estimation value.

title: CT image target detection method based on three-dimensional orthogonal attention
description: The invention discloses a CT image target detection method based on three-dimensional orthogonal attention, which includes the following steps: constructing a CT image data set and performing data preprocessing on the CT image data set; dividing the preprocessed CT image data set It is a training set, a verification set and a test set, and formalizes the training set and verification set tasks; builds a CT image target detection model; the CT image target detection model consists of a feature extraction backbone network, a CT image detection module, a false positive reduction module and a CT It consists of an image segmentation module; use the training set and verification set to train the CT image target detection model to obtain the trained CT image target detection model, input the test set into the trained CT image target detection model, and output the CT segmentation image; this The invention can greatly solve the time- and resource-consuming problem of training multiple three-dimensional convolutional neural networks by sharing feature extraction backbone networks for different tasks.

title: Fault handling expert system, method and computer equipment based on open source big model
description: The application relates to a fault handling expert system, a fault handling expert method and computer equipment based on an open source large model. The expert system includes: the data processing module is used for extracting summarized information fields and alarm disposal information of the incremental alarm data from the alarm data table and the work order data table, processing the incremental alarm data according to preset data processing rules to obtain training data corresponding to disposal tasks, and the training module is used for training the input first training data and second training data by using the open source big model so that the deduction module can deduce the summarized information fields of the input incremental alarm data to obtain supplementary fields according to training results of the first training data, and deduce the summarized information fields and supplementary field data of the incremental alarm data to obtain alarm disposal results according to training results of the second training data. The expert system can automatically generate the treatment mode of diversified alarms.

title: A method for detecting small lesions in pancreatic CT images based on composite feature fusion
description: A pancreas CT image small focus detection method based on composite feature fusion comprises the following steps: step S1, acquiring a pancreas CT image data set and performing primary screening; step S2, adjusting the window width and the window level of the pancreas CT image; step S3, converting the pancreatic CT image into an image in jpg format; s4, grouping all data sets; s5, carrying out online data enhancement operation on the data set; step S6, training a YOLOv6 model based on a plurality of auxiliary fusion improvements; and S7, verifying, evaluating and storing a YOLOv6 model based on the multi-term auxiliary fusion improvement. The invention can improve the detection capability of small tumors, is very beneficial to the early screening task of pancreatic tumors, and effectively improves the working efficiency of doctors.

title: A video understanding method based on dynamic spatiotemporal graph
description: The present invention discloses a video understanding method based on dynamic spatiotemporal graph, which transmits video data to a trained network model to output a video understanding result; the network model is   A backbone network is formed by feature extraction layers connected in sequence. In the backbone network, the output of the previous feature extraction layer is used as the input of the next feature extraction layer. Each feature extraction layer includes a multi-head attention layer, a spatial fusion module, a first adapter, a temporal interaction module, a second adapter and a feedforward network layer connected in sequence. The video understanding method accurately captures the complex dynamic and structural information in the video through a dynamic spatiotemporal graph, improves the global understanding and comprehensive capture of the overall spatiotemporal information, and utilizes the adapter-based pre-trained model migration to improve the accuracy and efficiency of video understanding.

title: Scene classification method, device, computer equipment and readable storage medium
description: The invention discloses a scene classification method, a device, computer equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a picture to be classified and a scene picture; inputting the picture to be classified into an FCOS algorithm model to obtain the category and confidence information of the target object in the picture to be classified; obtaining the color ratio information of the pictures to be classified by using a color extraction method; inputting the category, confidence information and color duty ratio information of the target object into a multi-layer perceptron model for scene classification to obtain a probability value of each scene; respectively extracting features of the scene picture and the picture to be classified by utilizing a Swin-transform network model to obtain a scene picture vector and a picture vector to be classified; calculating the picture vector to be classified and the scene picture vector by using a cosine similarity function to obtain similarity; and inputting the probability value and the similarity of each scene into a D-S evidence fusion model for fusion, and obtaining the scene category of the picture to be classified. The method improves the efficiency and the precision of the classification of the picture scenes.

title: Primary frequency modulation control method and system for energy storage auxiliary thermal power generating unit
description: The invention discloses a primary frequency regulation control method and system for energy storage-assisted thermal power units. Based on a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, a strategy network and a value network based on feedforward neural networks are constructed respectively, and the historical data of primary frequency regulation by energy storage is added to the training pool. , the data in the training pool are randomly selected to train the constructed policy network and value network at the same time. The trained value network evaluates the control effect based on the system status and the output of the policy network; the frequency data of the power grid and the frequency change data of the power grid at the same time are And the strategy network obtained by inputting the state of charge of the energy storage itself is trained, and then the value network obtained by training is calculated to obtain the input and output power of the energy storage, and the primary frequency regulation control of the energy storage-assisted thermal power unit is completed based on the output power. Improve the frequency regulation effect of energy storage and reduce the number of operations of thermal power units, thereby maintaining the safe and stable operation of thermal power units and power systems.

title: A method and system for automatically creating data models based on natural language
description: The present invention provides a method and system for automatically creating a data model based on natural language, which relates to the field of data processing technology and includes: storing all table names and field names in data sources and industry model libraries into the first and second lexicon libraries respectively, After vectorization, they are stored in the first and second vector databases respectively; each table in the industry model library is stored in the graph database; the business demand information is segmented through the first and second word segmentation libraries respectively, and keyword information is extracted. Form the central word; vectorize the central word, then retrieve the data source field information and industry model library field information that match the central word in the first vector database and the second vector database respectively, and find out the table information and Table information in the industry model library; based on the field information and table information in the industry model library, irrelevant parts in the graph database are eliminated to obtain the industry data model corresponding to the business demand information. The invention improves the efficiency of creating data models.

title: Data processing method, text graph generation method and related devices
description: A data processing method includes: using user input text as the input of a large language model and outputting multiple prompt texts; using multiple prompt texts as the input of a text and image generation model and outputting multiple corresponding images. The user input text and multiple images are processed to obtain a reward score for each image. The reward score is related to the overall information score and the local information score. It is determined that at least one prompt text including the bonus score as the target score is the target prompt text. The user input text and the target prompt text are used as first training samples, and multiple first training sample pairs form a first training set. Use the first training set to train a large language model. In other words, this application trains a large language model so that the large language model can expand the user input text to obtain the prompt text. Furthermore, since the prompt text includes rich details and scene information, the text-image generation model can generate images containing rich information.

title: Method and device for daily recording and intelligent monitoring of old people
description: The invention relates to a method and device for daily recording and intelligent monitoring of the elderly, belonging to the field of intelligent monitoring technology. The method includes: respectively acquiring audio data and image data collected within a preset range around the elderly; and sequentially executing the audio data Speech signal preprocessing, low-level acoustic feature extraction, and high-level emotional feature extraction are used to obtain health data used to evaluate the mental health of the elderly; when the health data meets the preset conditions, an early warning message is issued; image preprocessing and image extraction are performed on the image data in sequence Positive images and negative images are obtained after emotional characteristics and image decision-making; positive images are stored for subsequent nostalgic treatment of the elderly; negative images are deleted; the cost of voice psychological assessment and nostalgic therapy is reduced, and the operation is simplified.

title: A thermal power plant safety accident analysis method, system, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a thermal power plant safety accident analysis method, system, equipment and storage medium, which includes using text mining technology to conduct logical sequence analysis of text data to obtain process stages and several key events included in each process stage; Several key events included in each process stage are classified according to logical timing characteristics to obtain the logic type corresponding to each process stage; text analysis is performed on each key event to obtain the influencing factors that trigger the key event, and based on the influencing factors, each process is The stages are classified to obtain the importance level of the process stage; according to the logical type and importance level, a safety accident macro model is constructed, the safety accident is analyzed, and the safety accident analysis results are obtained. By constructing an accident macro model, the present invention changes the accident description process from textualization to digitalization, provides data support for analysis of accident causes and accident prevention, and improves the scientificity and efficiency of safety management of thermal power plants.

title: Distributed photovoltaic mid- and long-term forecasting methods and systems
description: The invention discloses a distributed photovoltaic medium and long-term prediction method and system, relates to the technical field of photovoltaic output prediction, and solves the problem that existing distributed photovoltaic power prediction cannot achieve medium and long-term prediction. The method includes: analyzing the effects of various meteorological factors on photovoltaic output Influence, determine the key meteorological factors that affect photovoltaic output; build an XGBoost model, train the XGBoost model based on the historical data of key meteorological factors and the corresponding historical data of photovoltaic output, and obtain the XGBoost prediction model; bring the key meteorological factors into the above-mentioned years of data The XGBoost prediction model obtains mid- and long-term prediction results of photovoltaic output; a mid- and long-term prediction model of photovoltaic output is established based on the XGBoost algorithm, and mid- and long-term predictions of photovoltaic output are made based on resource-meteorological data.

title: Knowledge graph recommendation method and system based on double-space information aggregation
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of knowledge graph recommendation, and provides a knowledge graph recommendation method and a knowledge graph recommendation system based on double-space information aggregation, wherein double-space multi-level information aggregation of European space and hyperbolic space is carried out according to the characterization of a user and an article to obtain a multi-layer European space vector and a multi-layer hyperbolic space vector; based on the multi-layer European space vector and the multi-layer hyperbolic space vector, cross-space contrast learning is carried out, and contrast loss scores are obtained; performing inner product operation based on the obtained vectors of the user and the article to obtain a predicted loss score; constructing mixed loss based on the comparison loss score and the predicted loss score, and utilizing a mixed loss optimization knowledge graph recommendation model to realize joint optimization; and carrying out knowledge graph recommendation by using the knowledge graph recommendation model after the joint optimization. According to the invention, the complex topological structure is considered, european space modeling and hyperbolic space modeling are combined, and the accuracy and the rapidity of the recommendation result can be improved.

title: Text detection method based on feature correction and difference guiding attention
description: The invention discloses a text detection method based on feature correction and difference guiding attention, which comprises the following steps: taking a natural scene image as input, and extracting multi-level features by a backbone network; sending high-level features of multi-level output features of a backbone network into a TFCM, carrying out two-stage feature correction on sub-pixel convolution features, and then merging the sub-pixel convolution features with low-level features step by step from the highest-level features to obtain merged features; the DGAM respectively compensates the detailed information on the channel and the space dimension of the fusion feature by utilizing the difference information of the fusion feature and the lowest-level feature; the output module outputs the text prediction box. The invention carries out characteristic correction on the sub-pixel convolution characteristic through the TFCM, and can obviously improve the quality of the up-sampling characteristic; the detail information compensation is carried out on the fusion characteristics through the DGAM, so that the edge detail information can be effectively compensated, the network can more accurately divide the text boundary, and a more accurate text detection result is obtained.

title: Construction method of feature consistency constraint network for forest fire detection
description: A method for constructing a feature consistency constraint network for forest fire detection includes the following steps: Step 1: First, a dual-branch network is constructed, each branch network completely shares parameters, and two different data enhancement perspectives of the same image are input respectively, and the images of two different perspectives are respectively input into the dual-branch network to extract features; Step 2: Construct a feature consistency module, constrain the features extracted by the dual-branch network according to the feature consistency of the two different perspectives, and constrain the features of the object to be consistent; Step 3: Calculate the loss of the detection results of the dual branches and the real box respectively, and optimize the detection effect of the dual-branch network. Construct and train through the above steps.

title: Power supply planning management method based on Internet
description: The invention discloses a power supply planning management method based on the Internet, which relates to the technical field of power supply planning, and comprises the steps of dividing a power consumption area into a photovoltaic power supply unit and a non-photovoltaic power supply unit, obtaining historical power consumption of different units, predicting the subsequent power consumption to obtain predicted power consumption, constructing an illumination prediction model, obtaining predicted illumination intensity according to the illumination prediction model, obtaining predicted power generation amount according to the predicted illumination intensity, obtaining actual power generation amount of different units, judging whether abnormal power generation equipment exists in a photovoltaic power station, obtaining the spent power or the surplus power of different units according to the predicted power consumption and the predicted power generation amount, and scheduling the obtained spent power or surplus power; by the technical scheme, more accurate prediction of electricity consumption and generated energy is facilitated, and traditional energy sources can be better saved and novel energy sources can be utilized.

title: A method and system for intelligent power plant equipment maintenance
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of power equipment maintenance. The method of the present invention includes acquiring equipment operating status data in real time through sensors and monitoring equipment, analyzing and processing the collected equipment status data, applying data analysis and machine learning algorithms to identify abnormal conditions and predict equipment failure risks, intelligently determining the equipment maintenance cycle and maintenance content according to the equipment operating status model, transmitting the maintenance data to a data center through a wireless network, and feeding back to the equipment operating status model, updating and optimizing the parameters and structure of the model. The method uses advanced sensor technology, data analysis technology and artificial intelligence technology to monitor the operating status of power plant equipment in real time, quickly and accurately determine whether the equipment needs maintenance, thereby improving the operating efficiency and safety of the power plant equipment.

title: Real-time semantic segmentation method, system and equipment
description: The present invention discloses a real-time semantic segmentation method, system and equipment, which relate to the field of agriculture. The method includes: constructing a real-time semantic segmentation network model based on multi-branch weight fusion and semantic guidance, the model is obtained by adding a weight fusion module, adding a semantic guidance learning module and adding deep supervision on the basis of a three-branch backbone network including a semantic branch and two detail branches, training and optimizing the model using a training data set, inputting the images directly shot in the farm to be segmented into the optimized real-time semantic segmentation network model based on multi-branch weight fusion and semantic guidance, and obtaining the segmented images output by the model, the segmented images represent the crops, background and weeds in the image to be segmented with different colors. The present invention can realize the semantic segmentation of the images directly shot in the farm at high speed, high precision and low storage in edge devices with limited processing resources such as smart agricultural robots.

title: Multi-energy complementary park double-layer capacity configuration method and system
description: The invention discloses a dual-layer capacity configuration method and system for a multifunctional complementary park, which comprise the steps of calculating park carbon emission and park carbon emission reduction based on a multifunctional complementary park carbon accounting boundary, further calculating a park low-carbon evaluation coefficient, calculating green card transaction cost based on park holding green card quantity and green card quota indexes, constructing a park upper-layer configuration planning model by taking the lowest annual comprehensive cost of the multifunctional complementary park as an optimization target and taking the maximum capacity limit as a constraint condition, constructing a park lower-layer operation optimization model by taking the lowest daily operation cost of the multifunctional complementary park taking the green card transaction cost as an optimization target and taking the low-carbon evaluation coefficient as a constraint condition, and jointly solving the park upper-layer configuration planning model and the park lower-layer operation optimization model to obtain the dual-layer capacity configuration parameters of the multifunctional complementary park. The invention realizes deep excavation of the carbon reduction potential of the park on the premise of comprehensively considering the economy and the supply and demand balance of the park.

title: A tooth segmentation method, device and electronic device based on CBCT
description: The present disclosure provides a CBCT-based tooth segmentation method, device and electronic device, which obtains an oral CBCT image, determines a tooth region image in the oral CBCT image; inputs the tooth region image into a pre-trained semantic segmentation network, and divides the tooth region image into an upper tooth image and a lower tooth image; determines tooth surface data corresponding to each tooth in the upper tooth image and the lower tooth image; inputs the tooth surface data into a pre-trained instance segmentation network, and segments a single tooth model corresponding to each tooth in the upper tooth image and the lower tooth image. The accuracy of segmenting single tooth three-dimensional structure information from CBCT images can be improved, and a good segmentation effect is achieved.

title: A visible light infrared pedestrian re-identification method and system based on spectral information filtering
description: The invention discloses a visible light infrared pedestrian re-identification method and a visible light infrared pedestrian re-identification system based on spectrum information filtering, wherein the method comprises the following steps: (1) Obtaining original data, dividing a training set, a verification set and a test set, and preprocessing; (2) Randomly forming a cross-modal image pair by the obtained batch training samples; (3) Setting up a three-branch pedestrian re-recognition network based on PyTorch and setting training parameters; (4) Dividing the training period into two stages of V-T and V-I, calculating the semantic consistency loss updating network weight when the training period is in the V-T stage, taking a transition mode as a filtering condition, and reserving spectrum information most relevant to an infrared mode from a visible light mode; (5) When the method is in the V-I stage, the cascade aggregation loss is calculated, the network weight is updated, the mode alignment is directly realized between the visible light and the infrared modes, and the mode sharing representation is extracted; and verifying the accuracy of the algorithm by using the verification set, and storing the network weight with optimal accuracy.

title: Photovoltaic operation and maintenance management system based on data cleaning and power prediction
description: The invention discloses a photovoltaic operation and maintenance management system design based on data cleaning and power prediction, which specifically comprises a front end and a rear end, wherein the front end comprises an application layer and a user layer, and the application layer comprises a real-time monitoring module, a historical data module, a user management module, a fault alarm module and a power grid end module; the user layer includes a visual interface; the back end comprises a data storage layer and a data processing analysis layer; the data storage layer comprises a postgreSQL database; the data processing analysis layer comprises data cleaning, data set normalization processing, pearson correlation analysis, LSTM network input, LSTM network output and fault alarm. The invention designs a management system of a webpage client by adopting a PostgreSQL database and RuoYi-Vue background frames, and realizes data management, fault alarm and data visualization of the photovoltaic power station. In order to optimize the data effectiveness, the data in the database is cleaned, a short-term power prediction function is added, and the method has positive significance in the aspects of energy management, power grid planning, operation and the like.

title: Knowledge graph-based nutrient solution concentration regulation and control method, device and storage medium
description: The present application provides a method, device and storage medium for controlling nutrient solution concentration based on a knowledge graph, and relates to the field of fertilization technology. The method comprises: constructing a knowledge graph of nutrient solution influencing factors based on the influencing factor data of the EC value of the tomato irrigation nutrient solution; obtaining a nutrient solution EC value control model based on the nutrient solution influencing factor knowledge graph and a crop growth database; the crop growth database contains the growth status data of plants under different environments; and using the nutrient solution EC value control model to control the tomato nutrient solution concentration. The nutrient solution concentration control method, device and storage medium based on a knowledge graph provided in the present application construct an EC value control model that can adaptively and accurately give real-time EC values based on the established nutrient solution influencing factor knowledge graph, thereby improving the accuracy of dynamic control of nutrient solution concentration, achieving long-season harvesting of tomatoes with stable appearance, and increasing tomato yield.

title: Sliding window water reserve abnormal downscaling method based on physical constraint
description: A sliding window water reserve abnormal scale-down method based on physical constraint belongs to the cross technical fields of satellite gravity, hydrology, computer science and the like. And acquiring a multisource data set under the global scale, and constructing a downscale model with coarse resolution of 0.5 degrees based on a random forest machine learning algorithm. After a 0.05-degree preliminary downscaling result is obtained, deviation calculation is carried out on a 3-degree window, after the deviation is obtained, the deviation of the polymerized water volume is distributed and calculated, the weight calculation is completed to multiply the deviation, the volume is converted into the equivalent water height, the corresponding deviation can be obtained, the corresponding deviation is added to a corresponding grid, and window sliding constraint is carried out at a 0.5-degree step length to obtain a final 0.05-degree downscaling result. The invention provides physical constraint for the data after the downscaling, so that the data after the downscaling is characterized with more space details while the information of the data before the downscaling is reserved.

title: Remote sensing image target detection parallel training method based on communication optimization
description: The present invention discloses a parallel training method for remote sensing image target detection based on communication optimization, which mainly solves the problem of high communication ratio of existing parallel training methods for remote sensing image detection. Its implementation scheme is: obtain a training sample set; select any existing remote sensing image target detection model; perform overlapping optimization of the remote sensing image target detection model in stages: 1) calculate the loss of the remote sensing image target detection model and perform back propagation to calculate the gradient; 2) update the first-order momentum and the second-order momentum, and correct them; 3) set elastic global parameters, update the target detection model parameters; 4) update the elastic global parameters; 5) repeat the above steps until the model converges to obtain a trained remote sensing image target detection model. By setting elastic global parameters and updating them, the present invention can achieve efficient overlap of model calculation and model communication, reduce the proportion of training communication, speed up the speed of parallel training, and can be used for deep learning of neural networks.

title: Steel wire rope stress detection or monitoring method and device based on magnetic Barkhausen noise
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for detecting or monitoring the stress of a steel wire rope based on magnetic Barkhausen noise, and relates to the technical field of detection or monitoring of the stress of the steel wire rope. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining the tensile stress of the position to be measured of the steel wire rope to be measured according to the value of the target sensitive characteristic parameter of the magnetic Barkhausen noise signal of the position to be measured of the steel wire rope to be measured and the stress state calibration model; the stress state calibration model is obtained by using a target sensitive characteristic parameter of a magnetic Barkhausen noise signal as an independent variable and using tensile stress as a dependent variable and adopting a data fitting method to fit the value of the target sensitive characteristic parameter of the magnetic Barkhausen noise signal under each tensile stress and each tensile stress of the reference steel wire rope. The invention can realize high-precision, rapid, flexible and non-contact detection or monitoring of the stress at any position of the full-dry wire of the steel wire rope.

title: A 3D point cloud object detection method based on multi-view fusion
description: The present invention proposes a three-dimensional point cloud target detection method based on multi-view fusion. First, the 3D point cloud is projected in XOY to obtain a 2D top view, the 3D point cloud is converted to cylindrical coordinates and the cylinder is cut and flattened into a rectangle to obtain a 2D front view, the two 2D views are encoded and processed in combination with the height, density, depth and reflection intensity information of the 3D point cloud to obtain a three-channel pseudo RGB image, and then the image is denoised using bilateral filtering, and then it is used as the input of the target detection network, and the Complex-YOLOv4 network that can perform target detection on point cloud data is used as the target detection network, and target detection is performed on the front view and the top view respectively, and finally the target detection results obtained from the front view and the top view are fused, and the weighted D-S evidence theory is applied to multi-view fusion, and the classification is judged using the decision method based on BPA to obtain the final target detection result. The present invention fuses the target detection based on multi-view projection of 3D point clouds, thereby improving the accuracy of target detection.

title: Automatic identification method, system and equipment for underwater nondegradable garbage
description: The invention discloses an automatic identification method, system and equipment for underwater nondegradable garbage, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting image data related to underwater garbage, establishing a garbage data set which is not easy to degrade underwater, and dividing the data set into a training set and a verification set; improving the YOLO v5 algorithm model, and applying the training set to the improved YOLO v5 algorithm model to obtain a prediction result; substituting the prediction result into a loss function, promoting the updating of network weight parameters, minimizing the loss function value, completing the training of the model, and obtaining a final recognition model; performing identification verification on the verification set by using the final identification model to obtain an identification result of the underwater nondegradable garbage; the invention realizes the accurate identification of the underwater nondegradable garbage, improves the identification precision, is suitable for the instant underwater identification, can meet the requirement of underwater cleaning loaded on an AUV, and makes up the defect of the conventional cleaning of the marine underwater garbage.

title: Automatic medical image segmentation method based on graph contrast learning
description: The invention provides an automatic medical image segmentation method based on graph contrast learning, which comprises the following steps: step 1: performing scale division on the medical image; step 2: constructing a ViG-CNN Block based on graph contrast learning based on the medical image blocks after scale division; step 3: the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-scale double-branch hybrid encoder based on ViG-CNN Block of graph comparison learning; step 4: extracting medical image features based on a multi-scale double-branch hybrid encoder; step 5: designing BottleNeck modules containing a transducer, and updating the state of the medical image characteristic based on the BottleNeck modules; step 6: and designing a feature decoder based on convolution, and inputting the updated medical image features into the decoder to complete automatic segmentation of the medical image. The invention enhances the learning ability of the encoder by transmitting the high-level semantic information and the low-level detail information stage by stage, and BottleNeck is added in the encoder and the encoder, so that the experimental results on the data sets of different modes of heart, multiple organs and brain fully prove the superior performance of GCV-UNet.

title: Guided rocket large airspace glide increase Cheng Dandao optimization method based on ant colony algorithm
description: The invention discloses a guided rocket large airspace glide increase Cheng Dandao optimization method based on an ant colony algorithm, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a guided rocket three-degree-of-freedom motion model; then establishing a guided rocket state constraint equation and a guided rocket target function; the continuous state space formed based on the guidance rocket state constraint equation is next; initializing pheromones in a search interval according to the division of the search interval, the setting of node numbers and the given ant colony scale; according to the initialized space parameters, calculating the adaptability of the ant colony, recording the iterative optimal solution and the global optimal solution of the ant colony, and updating rules and the pheromones of all nodes; and finally, optimizing to obtain an optimal solution of the guided rocket glide increase Cheng Dandao based on an ant colony algorithm optimization scheme, a guided rocket state constraint equation and an objective function. According to the method, the ant colony trajectory optimization algorithm is adopted to perform trajectory simulation optimization calculation, and the design of the large airspace glide increase Cheng Dandao is used to effectively improve the maximum range of the guided rocket and solve the range requirement of the guided rocket.

title: Intelligent network detection method and device based on preference tree and knowledge graph
description: The invention discloses an intelligent network detection method and device based on preference trees and knowledge patterns. Firstly, interactive information between a user and a network detection technology is cleaned and arranged, a knowledge graph is constructed, entity vector representation is obtained by embedding the relation between each entity in the graph, the weight of the entity vector relation is weighted and fused to obtain the comprehensive relevance of the user and the network detection technology, and a TopN recommendation list is obtained; according to the preference of the user and the historical operation data, a tree model of the preference is built, the preference of the user is layered in different levels, the preference score between the user and the detection technology is obtained according to the preference tree, and finally the intersection of the two recommendation lists is taken as a final recommendation list. The invention provides an intelligent network detection method and device based on preference trees and knowledge graphs, which realize comprehensive recommendation through embedding the preference trees and the knowledge graphs, thereby intelligently recommending a network detection technical scheme which accords with user preference.

title: Method and system for generating decision logic and power system
description: In order to generate decision logic (34) for the IED (30), at least one machine learning model is trained in iterative machine learning model training. In the iterative machine learning model training, samples are weighted using a weighting function. In the iterative machine learning model training, the weighting function(s) associated with one or several training cases are automatically modified.

title: Bridge girder erection machine braking system fault diagnosis method based on improved snake optimization network model
description: The invention relates to the technical field of bridge erection machine fault diagnosis, and in particular to a bridge erection machine brake system fault diagnosis method based on an improved snake optimization network model. The method comprises: establishing a bridge erection machine brake system model, acquiring multiple groups of running data to obtain a data set, and dividing the data set into a training set and a test set; establishing an improved snake optimization network model, which comprises: adding Logistic chaotic mapping to a snake optimization algorithm in an initial snake algorithm model, fusing whale mechanism behavior and introducing an adaptive weight factor to obtain an improved snake optimization algorithm; using the improved snake optimization algorithm, taking a root mean square error as a fitness function to optimize the number of hidden layer neurons and a learning rate of a neural network to obtain an improved snake optimization network model; using the data set to train and optimize the improved snake optimization network model to obtain a bridge erection machine brake system fault diagnosis model; and performing fault diagnosis based on the bridge erection machine brake system fault diagnosis model.

title: Intelligent data prediction visualization system based on deep learning and Django technology
description: The present invention provides an intelligent data prediction visualization system based on deep learning and Django technology, and a data prediction solution based on RNN (recurrent neural network) and LSTM (long short-term memory). Through the past green electricity historical price data and CCER (national certified voluntary emission reduction) historical price data, RNN (recurrent neural network) is used for data processing, and at the same time, LSTM (long short-term memory) is used for data processing through the past carbon quota historical price data. The future price trend is predicted through the processed results to provide customers with cost reduction suggestions and purchase decision support.

title: Deep learning-based method for inverting concentration profile of plume of deep sea mining through electrical monitoring
description: The present invention provides a method for inverting deep-sea mining plume concentration profiles through electrical monitoring based on deep learning, including the following four parts: acquiring and normalizing on-site electrical in-situ monitoring data; constructing a suspended particle concentration model based on natural potential measurement results; testing and optimizing the constructed model; and inverting the plume particle concentration profile. Through the technical solution of the present invention, the transformation of electrical monitoring signals into suspended particle concentration signals can be completed, and a series of devices such as electrical in-situ monitoring probes and streamers can be used to accurately monitor the particle concentration profile of deep-sea mining plumes. The present invention takes into account the influence of factors such as seabed temperature, salinity, flow velocity, and polymetallic nodule debris, and uses artificial neural network training to realize in-situ electrical monitoring to invert deep-sea mining plume concentration profiles, providing technical support for electrical monitoring of deep-sea mining plumes.

title: Electric power engineering management system based on network planning algorithm
description: The present invention relates to the field of power management technology, and specifically to a power engineering management system based on a network planning algorithm, comprising an information acquisition module, a data processing module, a network planning algorithm module, a management decision module and an information feedback module; the information acquisition module is used to identify and enter the initial materials of power grid project management; the data processing module pre-processes the entered data, and the pre-processing includes data cleaning, data standardization, etc.; the network planning algorithm module analyzes the pre-processed data by applying a deep learning advanced algorithm to form a management plan for the power grid project; the management decision module formulates a corresponding execution strategy according to the management plan formed by the network planning algorithm module; and the information feedback module monitors the execution of the execution strategy in real time. The present invention not only improves the efficiency of power grid project management and reduces management costs, but also improves the operational stability and reliability of the power grid.

title: A line segment detection method, device, storage medium and computer program product
description: The present invention discloses a line segment detection method, device, storage medium and computer program product, the method comprising: embedding a Hough transform module in a deep learning network containing a convolutional layer to obtain an initial model; using a data set to train the initial model to obtain a line segment detection model; inputting a picture to be detected into the line segment detection model to obtain a picture containing a line segment target; wherein the Hough transform module converts a first feature map containing local edge information into a Hough space through a Hough transform layer, and obtains a second feature map after calculation; then converts the second feature map back to the image space through an inverse Hough transform layer to obtain a third feature map containing global information; and residually connects the first feature map with the third feature map to supplement the global information. The embodiment of the present invention can combine the traditional method of line segment detection with the deep learning method, improve the speed and accuracy of network detection, and reduce the model's dependence on the labeled data set.

title: Minors age identification method based on face horizontal slice fine granularity convolution
description: The present invention provides a method for identifying the age of minors based on fine-grained convolution of horizontal facial slices, and relates to the field of biometric feature identification. The method comprises two parts: extraction of facial features of minors and feature association. Feature extraction is based on a residual network with a channel attention mechanism to extract fine-grained age features from the horizontal direction of the minor's face, and weights the feature vectors in each horizontal direction of the minor's face according to their importance to age identification to obtain weighted facial horizontal features. Feature association is based on mining the spatial relationship between weighted facial horizontal feature vectors through a long short-term memory network, and retains the age feature vector output by the last layer of long short-term memory network units for final age classification. The present invention improves the accuracy of facial age recognition of minors, and has important practical significance in the network protection of minors.

title: Analysis method, system, device and storage medium based on video description task
description: The present application provides an analysis method, system, device and storage medium based on a video description task, the method comprising: obtaining a described video and a generated description text; performing different processing on the video and the description text to obtain a first frame feature vector, a second frame feature vector, a third frame feature vector, a first text feature vector, a second text feature vector and a third text feature vector respectively; determining a first analysis result based on the first frame feature vector and the first text feature vector; determining a second analysis result based on the second frame feature vector and the second text feature vector; determining a third analysis result based on the third frame feature vector and the third text feature vector; and determining a final analysis result of the description quality based on the three analysis results. The present application provides a convenient analysis method for description quality by performing different processing on the video and the description text.

title: Entity relationship joint extraction method based on countermeasure learning
description: The invention discloses a physical relationship joint extraction method based on countermeasure learning, which relates to the field of natural language processing and is used for improving the efficiency and accuracy of the physical relationship joint extraction. The method utilizes a pre-trained BERT model to encode an input sentence, and simultaneously generates a potential relation set and a global corresponding matrix; splicing the codes of each potential relation and the sentence codes, modeling context information through a two-way long-short-term memory network, and respectively marking a main body and an object of the sentence by using a label marking method; and performing constraint filtering on all possible triples by using the global corresponding matrix to obtain a final triplet. The invention takes the potential relation vector as the prior information extraction entity, so that the neural network model can pay more attention to semantic information related to the potential relation type, and the efficiency of joint extraction is improved. The accuracy of entity relationship joint extraction is further improved by modeling the context information through the two-way long-short-term memory network and introducing the idea of antagonism learning.

title: Training an automatic encoder to generate a model
description: A system and method for training an automatic encoder on training data to obtain a generative model for synthesizing new data is provided. During the training, affine transformation 320 is applied to the output of encoder 310 to obtain a representation of the training data instance in potential space. Furthermore, a mean and covariance of the representations of the training data instances in the potential space are determined, and parameters of the affine transformation are updated to shift the mean and covariance of the representations of the training data instances toward the target mean and target covariance. The decoder 330 of the trained auto-encoder may be used as a generation model, for example to synthesize input data for a test or simulation of a system, device or machine, or to synthesize training data for training of a (further) machine-learnable model.

title: Enhanced semantic-position feature fusion network method, device and application based on different pre-trained feature extraction backbones
description: The present invention discloses an enhanced semantic-position feature fusion network method, device and application based on different pre-trained feature extraction backbones, which are used for high-resolution remote sensing image ground object extraction and surface cover classification tasks. The method first uses a pre-trained visual Transformer-based feature extractor and a convolutional network-based feature extractor as a joint feature extractor without participating in network training; then an enhanced semantic-position feature fusion module is designed to achieve effective fusion of deep semantic features and high-resolution position features of the image from two perspectives; finally, a fine extraction module based on preliminary segmentation prompts is designed to improve the accuracy of ground object extraction or surface cover classification. The method of the present invention can be quickly, effectively and economically applied to ground object extraction and classification of high-resolution remote sensing images.

title: Autonomous navigation method, system and medium for unmanned aerial vehicle based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The embodiments of the present application provide a method, system and medium for autonomous navigation of a drone based on deep reinforcement learning, the method comprising: obtaining an initial position and a destination position, generating drone movement trajectory information based on a path planning model; obtaining real-time movement state information of the drone, comparing the real-time movement state information of the drone with set state information, and obtaining a state deviation rate; determining whether the state deviation rate is greater than or equal to a preset state deviation rate threshold; if greater than or equal to, generating correction information, and dynamically adjusting the drone movement trajectory information based on the correction information; if less than, performing dynamic navigation based on the drone movement trajectory information, generating voice broadcast information, and transmitting the voice broadcast information to a terminal in real time; determining abnormal position of the drone navigation by analyzing the trajectory deviation during the movement of the drone, thereby accurately navigating the drone and improving the accuracy of position guidance.

title: Methods, devices and products for deploying PyTorch models in programs
description: The present disclosure provides a method, device, program product and storage medium for deploying a PyTorch model in a program. The method is applied to a target program. The program package is compiled from source code. The source code includes a PyTorch model file and a PyTorch library file. In the compilation process of the source code, the PyTorch library file is deleted. During the program running process, the compiled PyTorch library file is downloaded from the server and stored. The local storage path of the compiled PyTorch library file is provided to the operating system, and the operating system loads the compiled PyTorch library file based on the storage path. After the compiled PyTorch library file is loaded, the PyTorch model is run based on the PyTorch model file. The package size increase caused by the program deploying the PyTorch model can be reduced, and the normal operation of the PyTorch model can be ensured.

title: A method, device, equipment and medium for predicting battery state of charge (SOC)
description: The embodiment of the present invention provides a method, device, equipment and medium for predicting the state of charge (SOC) of a battery, and relates to the field of data processing technology. The method includes: obtaining data to be processed related to the battery SOC, preprocessing the data to be processed to extract an input feature matrix, inputting the input feature matrix into a SOC prediction model that integrates a multi-scale convolutional neural network and a multi-head attention network, capturing SOC feature relationships from the input feature matrix based on the multi-scale convolutional neural network, capturing SOC long-distance dependencies based on the multi-head attention network, and processing to obtain the SOC prediction result of the data to be processed, thereby improving the accuracy of SOC prediction.

title: A mirror file placement method based on edge computing
description: The present invention provides a method for placing an image file based on edge computing, which relates to the field of cloud computing. The method comprises: obtaining a first image file access log of a first edge computing node in an edge network; for each image file cached by the first edge computing node, determining the access frequency of the image file in  m  time windows based on the first image file access log, and constructing a corresponding image access sequence based on each access frequency and the image attribute of the image file; inputting each image access sequence into a cold image prediction model to screen a cold image file set in a first time period in the future; controlling the first edge computing node to generate a compressed file for the cold image file set, and cold storing the compressed file. Thus, intelligent image file management and dynamic image optimization strategies are implemented in the edge computing framework, which enhances the system's responsiveness to dynamic business needs and the overall user service experience.

title: Training method and system for migration in large model field, and text generation method and system
description: The specification provides a training method and system for large model field migration, a text generation method and system, which can train a model for generating a keyword group by text by using a small number of sample pairs, and then use the model to generate a large number of sample pairs on an existing text database. And then exchanging the input and output positions of the sample pairs, and training a model for generating text by the key word groups. The trained large model can receive input of keyword group types and output answers of text types.

title: Automatic diagnosis method, system, device and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses an automatic triage method, system, device and storage medium. The present invention determines the patient's disease type based on the patient's description of symptoms, determines the corresponding interactive indication interface and disease grading model based on the disease type, collects text, audio, video and other target disease interactive data through the interactive indication interface, and inputs the target disease interactive data into the disease grading model to obtain a disease grade that characterizes the severity of the disease, and then matches medical resources in the database based on the disease type and disease grade to obtain hospital recommendation results and doctor recommendation results. The database stores medical resource data of multiple hospitals in the region. After the disease type is preliminarily determined through symptom information, data related to the disease is collected through the corresponding interactive indication interface, and then the accurate disease grade is determined through the corresponding disease grading model, and medical resources are matched based on the patient's disease type and disease grade, thereby improving triage efficiency and rationality of triage.

title: Image processing and identifying method and system based on impulse neuron model
description: The invention relates to a pulse neuron model and a system for image balance self-sparse coding, and provides a novel self-sparse drain-integral discharge neuron model by introducing a neural homeostasis plasticity mechanism. The model can dynamically adjust the discharge difficulty by comparing the difference between the self membrane potential and the set discharge threshold, thereby realizing self-sparse discharge. The invention further develops a balanced self-sparse drain-integral discharge neuron model which takes the membrane potential time constant as a learnable parameter into a learning process, and realizes the self-adaptive balance of sensitivity to synaptic inputs and self-sparse discharge activity. By applying the balanced self-sparse leaky-integrate discharge neuron model to encode the static image and the neuromorphic image, the invention not only improves the accuracy of image identification, but also enhances the robustness of the system, and is suitable for various image processing scenes, in particular to visual task processing in edge computing equipment.

title: A method for optimizing fluidized bed granulation process of botanical medicine based on correlation analysis
description: The invention relates to a method for optimizing a vegetable drug fluid bed granulation process based on correlation analysis, and belongs to the field of vegetable drug fluid bed granulation and the field of technical optimization. The method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring process parameter time sequence data, particle yield and production duration data from a historical database; s2, converting the process parameter time sequence data into a series of statistics according to a predefined rule; s3, discretizing statistics of process parameter time sequence data conversion, particle yield and production duration data; s4, establishing association rules among discretization statistics, discretization particle yield and production duration data; s5, screening a strong association rule in the association rules; s6, the discretized statistics in the verified strong association rule are restored to continuous statistic control intervals one by one. The invention can improve the yield of the plant drug fluid bed granulation process granules and the batch-to-batch consistency of the production time.

title: An artificial intelligence product selection method and system based on SAAS
description: The present invention relates to the field of computer technology, and specifically provides a SAAS-based artificial intelligence product selection method and system, the method comprising steps S1: using a crawler framework to obtain product data and user behavior data on the Internet; S2: preprocessing the product data and user behavior data; S3: selecting a machine learning algorithm to build a product selection prediction model; S4: using the preprocessed data to train the product selection prediction model; S5: deploying the trained product selection prediction model on a SAAS platform and developing it through a JAVA Web framework. Using big data and machine learning technology, useful information is automatically extracted from massive data to provide accurate product selection suggestions for e-commerce companies or merchants.

title: An unmanned swarm spectrum management method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
description: The invention provides an unmanned cluster spectrum management method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned cluster spectrum resource allocation. The method comprises the following steps: step 10, aiming at an unmanned cluster, executing a communication task, and constructing an unmanned cluster spectrum allocation Markov decision model by adopting a Markov decision theory and a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm; step 20, training an unmanned cluster frequency spectrum distribution Markov decision model to obtain a multi-agent reinforcement learning network; and step 30, realizing real-time spectrum allocation when the unmanned cluster executes a communication task by utilizing the multi-agent reinforcement learning network. The unmanned cluster spectrum management method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning provided by the invention optimizes the spectrum resource allocation efficiency of the unmanned cluster.

title: Mining area subsidence phase filtering method and system based on CA-ResNet
