description: The present invention discloses a method and system for phase filtering of mining area subsidence based on CA-ResNet, the method comprising: obtaining a simulated data set of mining area subsidence interference phase; constructing a residual neural network model combined with a channel attention mechanism; training the residual neural network model combined with a channel attention mechanism according to the simulated data set; and using the trained residual neural network model combined with a channel attention mechanism to perform phase filtering on the real mining area subsidence interference phase. The present invention simulates mining area subsidence deformation by a two-dimensional Gaussian surface, and performs phase denoising on the deformation phase with heteroscedastic Gaussian noise, so as to make it closer to the real noise distribution. The present invention uses the real part and the imaginary part of the interference phase as the input of the network, which improves the problem of phase jump of interference fringes. On the basis of the original residual network structure, a channel attention mechanism is added to effectively improve the noise reduction effect of targets of different scales and the texture feature acquisition ability of the interference phase.

title: Transmission analysis method, circuit, device and storage medium of optical fiber transmitter
description: The present application relates to the field of optical fiber transmission technology, and discloses a transmission analysis method, circuit, device and storage medium for an optical fiber transmitter. The method includes: initializing and calibrating the optical fiber transmitter through an initial working parameter set to obtain initialization calibration data; performing optical power and transmission distance tests to obtain optical power and transmission distance data; performing anti-interference performance tests to obtain anti-interference performance data; performing ESD protection performance tests to obtain ESD protection performance data; performing long-term stability tests to obtain long-term stability data; performing transmission performance analysis through a transmission performance analysis model set to obtain a comprehensive transmission performance index; performing parameter optimization and solving of the initial working parameter set according to the comprehensive transmission performance index through a genetic algorithm to obtain a target working parameter set. The present application improves the comprehensiveness of the transmission analysis of the optical fiber transmitter, thereby improving the transmission quality of the optical fiber transmitter.

title: Authentication method and device of baseboard management controller, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention provides an authentication method, device, electronic device and storage medium for a baseboard management controller, and relates to the field of baseboard management controllers. The method comprises: obtaining authentication information of a user to be authenticated; the authentication information comprises user information, user group information of a user group to which the user belongs, and server information of a server operated by the user; inputting the authentication information into a trained machine learning model so that the machine learning model determines the authority level corresponding to the authentication information according to prior knowledge; wherein the authentication information corresponding to users of different authority levels in an authentication database has been embedded as prior knowledge into the model parameters of the machine learning model; determining the operation authority of the user to be authenticated for the baseboard management controller according to the authority level; the authentication information corresponding to users of different authority levels in the authentication database can be embedded as prior knowledge into the model parameters of the machine learning model, and the machine learning model is used for authentication, thereby improving the reliability of the authentication system.

title: Intelligent question-setting method, device, equipment and storage medium for agricultural streaming media courseware
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent education, and provides an intelligent question-setting method, device, equipment and storage medium for agricultural streaming media courseware, wherein the method comprises the following steps: converting the video file of the streaming media courseware into a target text and associating the target text with the time point of the video file; determining target knowledge points contained in the streaming media courseware according to the target text and a pre-constructed subject knowledge map, and associating the target text with the target knowledge points; the map comprises knowledge point entities of subjects of the streaming media courseware and attribute information of each knowledge point entity; determining a target question corresponding to the target knowledge point according to the target knowledge point, the subject knowledge map and a preset question setting rule, and associating the target question with the target knowledge point; and packing the streaming media courseware, the target knowledge points and the target topics corresponding to the target knowledge points into streaming media courseware data packets, and sending the streaming media courseware data packets to the target release platform. The invention effectively realizes intelligent question setting of the streaming media courseware.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine intelligent query system based on knowledge graph
description: The present invention discloses a Chinese medicine intelligent query system based on knowledge graph, which specifically relates to the field of data query and is used to solve the problem that the information obtained by user query may not be comprehensive or accurate enough. The system embeds knowledge graph nodes into low-dimensional spatiotemporal feature space, and then maps spatiotemporal relationships to the embedding space through linear transformation, and fuses node and relationship embedding vectors to obtain a comprehensive spatiotemporal embedding vector, so as to fully capture the spatiotemporal characteristics of the knowledge graph. Based on the acquired spatiotemporal spatial similarity, the key moments of attribute changes are identified. The attribute stability index and attribute regularity index are defined, and the attribute steady-state index is obtained through normalized set composite function processing, and the regularity and stability of the attribute are comprehensively considered. According to the steady-state index, a positive or warning signal is generated to guide the user's decision-making and operation when querying and using the attribute information of Chinese medicine, improve the understanding and application level of the attribute information, and reduce the uncertainty of the analysis results.

title: Lower limb exoskeleton human motion pattern recognition method based on weighted fusion model
description: The invention provides a lower limb exoskeleton human body movement pattern recognition method based on a weighted fusion model, which comprises the following steps of: collecting and combining motion characteristic data of a plurality of subjects wearing lower limb exoskeleton walking in different motion modes to construct a motion characteristic data set; constructing a neural network model and training; the TCN model and the GRU model are output, weighted and fused to obtain an objective function; and (3) optimizing the weight coefficient of the objective function to obtain an AWF-IPTGNet model, training, converting the training result into probability distribution of multi-task identification, and outputting a final motion mode identification result. After parameters of a TCN model and a GRU model in a neural network model are adaptively adjusted by using an IPSO optimization algorithm, an objective function is obtained by means of the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) weighted fusion obtained by outputting the TCN model and the GRU model, so that the motion characteristics of different subjects can be rapidly and adaptively adjusted, and the robustness and generalization of the model are improved.

title: A bearing fault detection method based on Shapelets and graph attention network
description: The application discloses a bearing fault detection method based on SHAPELETS and a graph annotation force network, which relates to the technical field of bearing fault detection and comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of fault data acquisition, SHAPELETS feature extraction, KNN graph construction and GAT network classification model construction, wherein SHAPELETS is capable of capturing key features in a time sequence, the features are critical to tasks such as classification, clustering and the like, different time sequence modes can be effectively distinguished by selecting a shape segment with the most information, SHAPELETS provides an intuitive mode to understand a structure of time sequence data compared with a traditional feature extraction method, a graph attention network is applied to bearing fault diagnosis, and compared with a traditional deep neural network, the structure is capable of capturing the internal relevance of data more accurately and capturing more information.

title: A method and system for operating and maintaining electromechanical equipment based on data analysis
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for operating and maintaining electromechanical equipment based on data analysis, which relates to the technical field of electromechanical equipment operation and maintenance. The operating state of the electromechanical equipment is predicted by using a digital twin model of electromechanical equipment operation, and the predicted data is aggregated to construct an electromechanical equipment operation data set. The fault degree of the electromechanical equipment is constructed by the electromechanical equipment operation data set. If the fault degree exceeds the fault degree threshold, the impact degree is constructed. If the impact degree exceeds the expected, a fault analysis instruction is issued to the outside. After the corresponding fault characteristics are obtained by the electromechanical equipment operation data identification, a maintenance plan is given and executed for the electromechanical equipment by a pre-constructed electromechanical equipment operation and maintenance knowledge graph, and an optimization degree is constructed by the executed operation data, and the treatment measures for the electromechanical equipment are determined according to the optimization degree. When the electromechanical equipment needs to be operated and maintained, it can be used as a reference plan to maintain it and handle the faults that have occurred or may occur in the electromechanical equipment.

title: Distributed intelligent safety monitoring and alarming system and method for well lid
description: The present application relates to the field of safety monitoring technology, and more specifically discloses a distributed intelligent safety monitoring alarm system and method for manhole covers, which utilizes pressure-sensitive sensors, gas sensors, and resistance sensors to obtain the pressure, biogas concentration, and resistance values around the manhole covers, and obtains the manhole cover monitoring parameter-related feature matrix and global feature vector through feature extraction and neural network model processing. Finally, a classifier is used to determine whether the manhole cover status is normal, so as to improve road traffic safety and prevent possible dangerous events.

title: Method, transmitter and system for acquiring transmitting signal
description: The embodiment of the present application provides a method, a transmitter and a system for obtaining a transmission signal, the method comprising: preprocessing the data to be transmitted at the current moment to obtain a current pre-transmission signal, wherein the preprocessing includes coding, mapping, modulation and oversampling; obtaining a pre-distortion signal corresponding to the current pre-transmission signal according to a target generator, wherein the target generator is obtained by learning the inverse characteristics of a power amplifier PA, and the target generator has the ability to construct an inverse function of the power amplifier; and amplifying the power of the pre-distortion signal according to the power amplifier to obtain a target transmission signal. The embodiment of the present application adopts an indirect learning structure, uses an edge equalization generative adversarial network to model the inverse function of the power amplifier, and comprehensively considers the current signal and the historical signal at the input layer to better extract the memory effect of the power amplifier.

title: Medicine-medicine interaction prediction method and system based on multi-mode knowledge graph
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological information, and relates to a medicine-medicine interaction prediction method and system based on a multi-mode knowledge graph. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a medicine multi-mode knowledge graph data set; extracting structural features of drug interactions and modal features of drugs; training a drug-drug interaction prediction model; and inputting the multi-mode information of the drug pair to be predicted into the prediction model which is trained to obtain the relationship type of interaction of the drug pair. According to the invention, through integrating drug interaction data of a plurality of databases and drug multi-modal information, a knowledge map comprising chemical structures, targets, enzymes and pathways is constructed, and the multi-modal information of the drugs can be fused and long-path dependency relations among the drugs can be captured in DDIs prediction by adopting multi-modal alignment and graph neural network to learn the characterization of the drugs and carrying out DDIs prediction, so that the accuracy and generalization of a DDIs prediction method based on calculation are improved, and the development process of the propelling drugs is accelerated.

title: Self-supervised video object segmentation method and system based on foreground object dense feature enhancement
description: The present invention discloses a self-supervised video target segmentation method and system based on foreground target dense feature enhancement, the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a video target segmentation data set, dividing the video target segmentation data set into a data set A and a data set B, pre-training ResNet-18 based on data set A, extracting the foreground target dense feature map of the sample pair, and inputting it into a dense projection head to obtain a dense feature vector; constructing a pixel-guided loss function based on Huber Loss and Mask-IoU Loss; performing inter-frame relationship training based on data set B, minimizing the calculation result of the pixel-guided loss function to train ResNet-18, and reconstructing the next frame of image according to the previous frame of image; inputting the segmentation result of the previous frame of image into the trained ResNet-18 to obtain the segmentation result of the next frame of image. The present invention can improve the performance of model video target segmentation.

title: Organic fertilizer nutrient solution trace element dosage control method based on chromatographic data
description: The invention discloses a trace element dosage control method of an organic fertilizer nutrient solution based on chromatographic data, and particularly relates to the field of fault diagnosis and tracing; the method has the advantages that a dosage control system is constructed based on a time sequence sampling strategy, so that the content and the change trend of trace elements in the nutrient solution of the organic fertilizer are known more accurately, the stability and the rationality of the trace elements in the nutrient solution are improved, the requirement of dosage control is defined by adopting three grading standards, the dosage control flow is standardized, the operability and the accuracy of the dosage control flow are enhanced, the weight of each control index is determined by a fuzzy FMEA method, a fuzzy rule base is established, the basis is provided for formulating a scientific and accurate control strategy, the priority of the control index is determined, the dosage adjustment and the control are more targeted, the accuracy and the effectiveness of the control are improved, the formula of the nutrient solution is optimized by combining a trace element nutrient solution formula database, and the healthy growth and the high-efficiency yield of plants are promoted.

title: Sensor layout optimization method and device for two-dimensional annular sound field modal measurement
description: The application relates to the technical field of acoustic and vibration measurement, in particular to a sensor layout optimization method and device for two-dimensional annular sound field modal measurement, wherein the method comprises the following steps: estimating dominant oscillation frequency and a main circumferential modal order range based on target priori information and a modal oscillation frequency domain equation of a two-dimensional annular sound field to determine the number of sensors used, and dividing the number of sensors into two groups of sensors at different axial positions to perform position distribution to obtain position parameters of the sensors; and when the position distribution meets the preset constraint condition, taking the function of the condition number of the sampling matrix as the fitness function of the optimization algorithm, and obtaining the sensor layout mode with the minimum fitness function by utilizing the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm. Therefore, the problems that in the related art, the influence of different positions of the sensor on errors of an identification result is large, even the sensor is possibly completely distorted, the mounting position of the sensor is possibly limited, the accuracy of modal monitoring is reduced and the like are solved.

title: Modality expansion method of pre-training multi-modality language reasoning model based on continuous learning and transfer learning
description: The invention provides a modal expansion method of a pre-training multi-modal language reasoning model based on continuous learning and transfer learning, and belongs to the technical field of multi-modal understanding and language interaction. The invention mainly utilizes the constructed multi-mode language reasoning model to carry out language reasoning, and then, in the modal expansion process of the multi-mode language reasoning model, the problem of data dependence in modal expansion is solved by means of a flexible multi-mode adapter combination module, and the problems of calculation burden and knowledge forgetting are solved by introducing an adapter fine adjustment in transfer learning and a freezing-activation strategy in continuous learning, so that the problem of modal expansion of the pre-training multi-mode language reasoning model is finally solved.

title: Information recommendation method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
description: The disclosed embodiments provide an information recommendation method, device, equipment and readable storage medium, which relate to the field of big data technology. The information recommendation method is used in an online banking system, wherein the display interface of the online banking system is provided with an input area and a first display area, and the information recommendation method comprises: in response to a user inputting specific identity information in the input area, identifying the specific identity information, generating first prompt information, wherein the first prompt information is used to prompt whether the user is a target user; in response to the user being the target user, performing a preferential operation on the target user's transaction based on preferential information, and displaying the first prompt information and preferential information in the first display area, wherein the preferential information is predicted based on a preset preferential model.

title: Momentum weighted update low-quality image characterization model training method and system
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of image representation learning, and discloses a momentum-based weighted update low-quality image representation model training method and system. Given an original data set, anchor samples are generated, positive samples and negative sample sets are delineated, and a self-supervised training data set is composed, which is divided into a training set and a verification set. An encoder model is constructed, and the self-supervised training sample unit is input into the encoder model for training. In combination with the chain stack technology, the training loss is calculated; the parameters of each encoder model are updated, and the parameters of the standard encoder model are calculated and finally updated in combination with preset weights; the above operations are repeated until a predetermined number of training times is reached, the retrieval performance of the standard encoder model is verified, and the optimal model is saved as the low-quality image representation model, thereby solving the problems of poor performance and weak generalization ability of the existing low-quality image representation model.

title: A tumor boundary delineation system for radioactive seed implantation TPS
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of medical image processing, and discloses a tumor boundary delineation system for radioactive particle implantation TPS. The system divides tumor regions and non-tumor regions according to colors on a region of interest image, calculates SUV values, and compares the SUV values with a set tumor SUV threshold. If the SUV value of the tumor region is not within the set tumor SUV threshold, it indicates that a non-tumor tissue boundary exists in the region. If the SUV value of the non-tumor region is within the set tumor SUV threshold, it indicates that a tumor tissue boundary exists in the region. At this time, it is necessary to continue dividing the current region and calculating the SUV value and comparing the set tumor SUV threshold until the calculated SUV values of each region in the tumor region are within the set tumor SUV threshold, indicating that the current region is a tumor region that does not contain a non-tumor tissue boundary, and the non-tumor region that does not contain a tumor tissue boundary is segmented from the medical image.

title: Medical imaging report intelligent generation method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a medical image report intelligent generation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method establishes a patient file from a doctor user, uploads image sequence data of abdominal cavity CT scanning, a system can automatically identify and process the image file, and then dividing and masking to obtain liver region 3D image sequence data with self-adaptive layers, and extracting and fusing multi-view image features by an encoding processor to obtain an image fusion feature code. The image feature codes are respectively fused through the domain knowledge codes obtained by the diagnosis classifier and the knowledge graph enhancement module to obtain multi-mode feature codes, and finally, the multi-mode feature codes are subjected to an influence report generator to output a final 3D image diagnosis report.

title: A memory allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present disclosure provides a memory allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium. The above method includes: obtaining the corresponding calculation subgraphs in the first calculation unit and the second calculation unit; based on the corresponding calculation subgraphs in the first calculation unit and the second calculation unit, and the dependency relationship between the calculation subgraphs, determining the first target data, the first target data is the memory data that the calculation unit still needs to use in subsequent calculations; allocating the first target data to a safe area, the safe area is a memory area that will not be affected by subsequent operations; allocating memory to each of the at least two calculation units; wherein the base addresses of the respective memory allocations of the first calculation unit and the second calculation unit are the same, and the respective memories of the first calculation unit and the second calculation unit do not overlap with the safe area. The present disclosure can improve the execution efficiency of the neural network model.

title: Method, system and product for processing distribution generalization graph based on decoupling characterization learning
description: The present invention provides a method, system and product for out-of-distribution generalization graph processing based on decoupled representation learning, and relates to the field of graph processing technology. The method includes: inputting unlabeled graph structure data into a graph neural network model to be trained, performing L iterative updates on the node representation of each node in the graph structure data according to neighbor information, and obtaining updated node representations; processing the updated node representations through K graph convolution channels to obtain K representations of each node; processing the K representations of each node into a representation vector of graph invariant information and a representation vector of graph change information; simulating a variety of distribution environments according to the representation vector of graph change information; in a variety of distribution environments, using the representation vector of graph invariant information to perform self-supervised comparative learning, obtaining a trained graph neural network model and using it for the classification of graph data sets, so as to adaptively ensure the prediction effect of the graph neural network model when there are distribution differences between the test environment and the training environment.

title: Corn crop coefficient measuring and calculating method, device, equipment, medium and program product
description: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment, a medium and a program product for measuring and calculating corn crop coefficients, which relate to the technical field of agricultural production, and the method comprises the following steps: when the corn is in a growth stage from a seedling stage to a spike stage, merging the first environmental data, the first surface soil water content and the canopy coverage rate, and then respectively inputting the merged first environmental data, the first surface soil water content and the canopy coverage rate into a random forest model, a XGBoost model and a first deep neural network model for voting fusion to obtain a measurement and calculation result of a first crop coefficient corresponding to the seedling stage to the spike stage; and when the corn is in a growing stage from the flowering stage to the harvesting stage, merging the second environmental data, the second surface soil water content and the leaf area index, and then respectively inputting the merged second environmental data, the second surface soil water content and the leaf area index into a support vector machine, a gradient lifting decision tree model and a second deep neural network model for voting fusion to obtain a measuring and calculating result of a second crop coefficient corresponding to the flowering stage to the harvesting stage. The method improves the accuracy of measuring and calculating the corn crop coefficients.

title: Fan fault emergency prediction control method based on data driving strategy
description: The invention discloses a fan fault emergency prediction control method based on a data driving strategy, which relates to the field of intelligent fan control algorithms, according to the invention, the internal state data and the external environment data of the fan in the normal state and the emergency state are collected through the historical data set, and the deep learning model is constructed and trained by utilizing the data, so that the accurate prediction and intelligent control of the fan state are realized. The intelligent control method provided by the invention not only can improve the running efficiency of the fan and reduce the maintenance cost, but also can obviously improve the safety and reliability of the system.

title: Personalized data retrieval method and system based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention discloses a personalized data retrieval method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method converts first retrieval information input by a user into a search engine input box into second retrieval information based on a standard vocabulary based on a preset neural network model; performs a search to obtain retrieval results based on the user's confirmation operation on the second retrieval information, and sorts the homepage of the retrieval results through a preset genetic algorithm model and displays it to the user; the method is based on user portraits, and by comprehensively considering factors such as data personalization and data correlation, it realizes the reasonable sorting of retrieval results and improves the accuracy and relevance of the retrieval results.

title: A method for dynamic monitoring of microbial contamination in water supply pipelines and prediction of disinfection response
description: The present invention proposes a method for dynamic monitoring and disinfection response prediction of water supply pipeline microbial contamination, which relates to the field of microbial contamination response prediction. The present invention proposes a water supply pipeline microbial contamination prediction process, including collecting microbial contamination data, preprocessing microbial contamination data, building a water supply pipeline microbial contamination prediction model, training the water supply pipeline microbial contamination prediction model using a training set, and performing a microbial contamination prediction test on the prediction model using a test set. The water supply pipeline microbial contamination prediction model consists of an enhanced residual convolution module, a GRU model, and a multi-head mixed feature attention mechanism module. The prediction model uses convolution kernels of different sizes to capture features of different scales, and captures long-term and short-term dependencies in time series. The outputs of the first two are jointly input into the multi-head mixed feature attention mechanism module to enhance the prediction model's ability to focus on important information.

title: Weld joint detection optimal path planning method, system, equipment and storage medium based on improved sparrow search algorithm
description: The invention discloses a weld joint detection optimal path planning method, a system, equipment and a storage medium based on an improved sparrow search algorithm, wherein S1: acquiring three-dimensional position information of a workpiece welding line and an obstacle; s2: traversing by using an artificial potential field method to obtain reachable paths and path distances between welding seams; s3: discretizing a sparrow search algorithm, and acquiring an optimal sequence with shortest path for traversing the welding seam by using self-adaptive parameters and a re-search mechanism in a population iteration process; s4: and combining the three-dimensional position information of the welding seams, the reachable paths among the welding seams and the optimal sequence of traversing the welding seams to obtain a complete optimal path for detecting the welding seams. The calculation difficulty of the optimal path in the welding line detection process is reduced, and the efficiency and the accuracy of optimal path planning are improved.

title: Greenhouse temperature intelligent early warning method and system based on big data monitoring
description: The invention provides a greenhouse temperature intelligent early warning method and system based on big data monitoring, which relates to the technical field of greenhouse temperature intelligent early warning, the invention establishes a greenhouse temperature prediction model and a greenhouse night cooling model by acquiring real-time temperature data of a plurality of places in a greenhouse and calculating the whole temperature value of the greenhouse at the current moment, and by acquiring dynamic data of greenhouse environment change and various static parameter data of the greenhouse, and respectively predicting the daytime temperature and the nighttime temperature of the greenhouse according to the acquired future weather prediction, simultaneously respectively calculating the temperature early warning level, the temperature change coefficient and the nighttime heat preservation coefficient according to the comparison of the proper growth temperature range of crops in the daytime and at night and the real-time overall temperature of the greenhouse, and adopting a corresponding cooling or heat preservation mode according to different temperature early warning levels, temperature change coefficients and nighttime heat preservation coefficients.

title: Method and device for determining loading scheme of transport vehicle based on genetic algorithm
description: The present application relates to the field of logistics and transportation technology, and provides a method and device for determining a loading scheme for a transport vehicle based on a genetic algorithm. The method includes: constructing multiple virtual loading boxes with different box sizes according to the body size of a transport vehicle for multiple goods in a transport cargo order; for each virtual loading box, determining multiple loading schemes to be selected under the virtual loading box based on a genetic algorithm according to the loading order of multiple goods, the cargo size of each cargo, and the box size of the virtual loading box; determining the corresponding optimal loading scheme according to the fitness of each loading scheme to be selected under each virtual loading box; determining the average loading rate of each optimal loading scheme according to the number of boxes of each optimal loading scheme and the cargo volume of each cargo block in each virtual loading box; determining the final loading scheme of the cargo order according to the number of boxes and the average loading rate of each optimal loading scheme, so that the vehicle loading is more reasonable and the cargo loading efficiency is improved.

title: Electronic board fault analysis method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The disclosure provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for analyzing faults of an electronic board card, which belong to the technical field of fault diagnosis and acquire multi-channel data of the electronic board card to be analyzed; inputting the multichannel data to a pre-trained mixed attention network to obtain characteristic data of the multichannel data; obtaining the fault type of the electronic board card to be analyzed according to the characteristic data of the multichannel data and a preset fault knowledge dictionary; the mixed attention network is trained based on multichannel data samples, and the multichannel data samples are obtained based on fault simulation of the electronic board card. According to the method, the device and the system, the problem that the characteristic data of the multichannel data of the single-channel data of the electronic board is less is solved by performing fault simulation on the electronic board, the characteristics of the multichannel data of the electronic board to be analyzed are extracted through the mixed attention network which is trained in advance, and the problem that the network characteristics of the multichannel input are not extracted enough is solved.

title: Target pose estimation method and system
description: The invention provides a target pose estimation method which comprises the steps of obtaining image data of a target object to be identified, fusing a multi-branch structure block of multi-scale convolution to construct a pose estimation model, inputting the image data of the target object to be identified into the pose estimation model to obtain a pose estimation value of the target object, processing the target pose estimation value by adopting a mixed voxel grid method to obtain voxel volume density and color information, inputting the voxel volume density and the color information into a nerve radiation field model to obtain a rendering key frame, obtaining a real-time observation true value of the target object, calculating loss between the rendering key frame and the real-time observation true value of the target object according to a luminosity loss function, and obtaining a loss value.

title: Remote obstacle recognition method under complex illumination condition of non-structured lunar surface environment
description: The invention discloses a remote obstacle recognition method under a complex illumination condition of a lunar surface unstructured environment, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing a lunar surface obstacle target detection network; then constructing a lunar surface obstacle image sample data set, and training a lunar surface obstacle target detection network by using the lunar surface obstacle image sample data set to obtain a lunar surface obstacle target detection model; and acquiring a lunar obstacle image, and sending the lunar obstacle image into a lunar obstacle target detection model to finally finish lunar obstacle detection. Compared with the traditional image feature extraction method, the method has the advantages of less parameter quantity, faster calculation speed and lighter weight.

title: Game strategy generation method and device based on spacecraft
description: A game strategy generation method and device based on a spacecraft comprise the steps of obtaining state quantity of the spacecraft in an imaging game scene and constraint upper bounds and constraint lower bounds corresponding to a plurality of imaging influence factors, constructing a multi-factor imaging differential countermeasure model of the spacecraft, converting the multi-factor imaging differential countermeasure model into a two-point boundary value expression, and carrying out strategy solving on the two-point boundary value expression based on parameters corresponding to the state quantity, parameters corresponding to the constraint upper bounds, parameters corresponding to the constraint lower bounds and a preset particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain an optimal game control strategy. The technical problem that in a game task of spacecraft chase escaping, an equilibrium strategy is often solved through a model of single-factor game, and a multiparty optimal or equilibrium strategy cannot be obtained is solved.

title: Neural network model-based drain outlet flow accurate quantification method and system
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of water quality monitoring, but is not limited to, and discloses a neural network model-based drain outlet flow accurate quantitative method and system, which are flow monitoring data compensation optimization systems for electromagnetic flowmeters. The water quality parameters are collected, the parameter weight and the threshold value are set, the linear transformation is used for further processing sample data, the neural network model is utilized for screening the optimal structure and network parameters of the model, a drain outlet water flow prediction model is established, training and optimization are carried out, and finally the established BP neural network is utilized for compensating and correcting the data, so that the accurate real-time prediction of drain outlet flow is ensured. The invention corrects the error of the electromagnetic flowmeter through the neural network model in the machine learning, so that the electromagnetic flowmeter is suitable for various complex scenes, the accurate real-time prediction of the sewage outlet flow is realized, the average absolute percentage error of the flow is less than 5%, and the established system method has good stability, wide applicability and good application prospect.

title: Government service data processing method and system based on artificial intelligence
description: The present invention relates to the field of government data management, and discloses a government service data processing method and system based on artificial intelligence. The method comprises the following steps: collecting government service data from various government service departments, integrating the government service data, and obtaining service data to be processed; pre-processing the service data to be processed, obtaining standardized data, inputting the standardized data into a Gaussian mixture model, and iteratively updating the Gaussian mixture model using an EM algorithm to output first sample service data; performing outlier detection on the first sample service data, obtaining second sample service data, and performing dimensionality reduction processing on the second sample service data based on a t-SNE algorithm to obtain target feature data; inputting the target feature data into a data analysis model, performing prediction through the data analysis model, and outputting government analysis results; pushing the government analysis results to corresponding government service departments, and displaying the government analysis results through data visualization technology. The present invention makes government services more intelligent and automated.

title: Test case generation method, device, storage medium and electronic device
description: The embodiments of this specification disclose a method, device, storage medium and electronic device for generating test cases. First, evaluation seed data is obtained. Then, in combination with a trained large generation model, at least one induced attack method is designed and selected. A diversified test case set is generated by deforming the evaluation seed data. At the same time, case annotations for each test case in the test case set are automatically generated.

title: A Fault Diagnosis Method for Mining Rolling Bearings Based on ANLC-ADL
description: The present invention discloses a mining rolling bearing fault diagnosis method based on ANLC-ADL, which includes: constructing a fault diagnosis data set according to the original vibration signal of the rolling bearing; building an ANLC-ADL fault diagnosis model; using Dropout to preprocess the data; using a multi-scale information expansion module to expand the information; using a wide-core convolution module to extract features and quickly reduce the dimension of data; using a DSC module to extract features; and using an output module to output the diagnosis results. The present application can effectively extract fault features from vibration signals, and can realize fault identification and fault type classification of mining rolling bearings.

title: A method and system for evaluating the state of photovoltaic power generation components
description: The invention discloses a state evaluation method and a state evaluation system for a photovoltaic power generation assembly, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting operation data of the photovoltaic power generation assembly based on a current parameter configuration scheme; calculating a current state evaluation value of the photovoltaic power generation assembly according to the operation data; under the condition that the current state evaluation value does not fall into the numerical range of the preset ideal state, optimizing the current parameter configuration scheme of the photovoltaic power generation assembly; and taking the optimized parameter configuration scheme as a new parameter configuration scheme, and returning to the step of executing the acquisition of the operation data of the photovoltaic power generation assembly based on the current parameter configuration scheme until the current state evaluation value falls into the numerical range of the preset ideal state. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, accurate state evaluation, real-time monitoring and self-adaptive optimization can be realized, so that the overall efficiency and reliability of the photovoltaic power generation system are improved, and the further development of renewable energy technology is promoted.

title: Power transmission line defect identification and early warning method and system based on remote sensing monitoring
description: The invention relates to a method and a system for identifying and early warning defects of a power transmission line based on remote sensing monitoring, which belong to the technical field, the invention constructs a training set according to historical defect image information of the power transmission line, constructs a power transmission line defect identification model according to the training set, thereby identifying the remote sensing image information of the power transmission line through the power transmission line defect identification model, and acquiring defect characteristic data of the power transmission lines in each area, carrying out early warning according to the defect characteristic data of the power transmission lines in each area, generating early warning information, setting a priority maintenance scheme according to the early warning information, and carrying out work task allocation based on the priority maintenance scheme. According to the invention, the target defect characteristics in the training set are processed through the circulating space attention mechanism, so that the attention is focused on the target defect characteristics in the training set, the interference of the multi-scale characteristics on the transmission line defect recognition model can be restrained, and the recognition accuracy of the transmission line defect recognition can be improved.

title: An AI-based campus student risk warning method and system
description: The application relates to an AI-based campus student risk early warning method and system, relates to the field of campus safety management, and solves the problems that the existing campus monitoring system mainly relies on manual monitoring, and monitoring staff are required to discover and process in time when abnormal conditions occur, and the method comprises the following steps: identifying a conventional movement mode of the student by using a long-short-term memory network algorithm, and detecting an abnormal track which is inconsistent with the conventional movement mode; when an abnormal track which does not accord with the conventional movement mode is detected, recording the occurrence time period of the abnormality, calling the monitoring video of the corresponding time period, and analyzing and determining the specific place and time of abnormal reaction of the student according to the preset abnormal reaction behavior. The application has the following effects: automatically analyzing social media language of students and behavior tracks in campuses, and early warning the risks possibly faced by the students in time, such as a deceptive event.

title: Medical knowledge graph-based physical examination data intelligent processing method
description: The invention discloses a medical knowledge graph-based physical examination data intelligent processing method, which comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a medical knowledge graph; s2, collecting physical examination data of a patient, wherein the physical examination data comprise user basic information, examination indexes, imaging description text and total examination data; s3, performing intelligent cleaning on the total inspection data based on the medical knowledge graph; s4, intelligently extracting the imaging description; s5, discretizing the index, establishing an abnormal index label, and carrying out uniform structuring treatment. The invention not only can improve the processing quality of physical examination data, but also can provide more accurate and convenient data analysis tools for medical researchers, doctors and health management staff, thereby playing an important role in the field of medical health.

title: A self-supervised large-model malicious instruction detection method and system
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for detecting a large-model malicious instruction with self supervision, which relate to the field of network security, the large-model malicious instruction detection system is formed by connecting a user terminal, a firewall, an instruction feature extractor, a malicious instruction detector, a target large model, an instruction sample generator and an instruction filter through a network, and is a detection method provided by the large-model malicious instruction detection system. According to the method, the potential information in the unlabeled instruction data is utilized, so that the malicious instruction detection performance and generalization capability of the model can be effectively improved under the condition that the data labeling cost is not remarkably increased, and the more robust malicious instruction detection model is constructed to support timely defense against malicious instruction attacks.

title: Question-answering method and device, and question-answering processing model training method and device
description: The present specification provides a question-and-answer method and device, and a question-and-answer processing model training method and device, wherein the question-and-answer method includes: determining a target text, associated text of the target text, and a target question for the target text; determining a target prompt text according to the text content of the target text; fusing the target prompt text, the target text, the associated text, and the target question to obtain fused text data; inputting the fused text data into a question-and-answer processing model to obtain a target answer corresponding to the target question, wherein the question-and-answer processing model updates and trains a pre-trained question-and-answer model using sample fused text data and sample answers corresponding to the sample fused text data; inputting the fused text data into the question-and-answer processing model so that the question-and-answer processing model can fully understand the context based on the associated text and generate a target answer that meets expectations and is highly accurate based on the target prompt text.

title: Prediction method of drug-target interaction based on graph attention network and multi-scale feature fusion
description: The application belongs to the technical field of drug discovery. The application provides a prediction method of drug-target interaction based on graph attention network and multi-scale feature fusion. The embodiment of the disclosure introduces a large medical knowledge graph into a DTI prediction task, and utilizes the rich biological information in the knowledge graph to mine potential relations between the medicine and the target point. The self sequence information of the medicine and the target point and the position information between the medicine and other medical entities are considered, and the self characteristics and the external relation are comprehensively considered. When the position information is obtained, the local position information between the medicine and the target point and the global position information of the medicine and the target point in the knowledge graph are focused, and the position information with different scales is fused by using a graph annotation force network, so that the obtained comprehensive position information is favorable for obtaining high-quality medicine and target protein characteristics.

title: New energy power generation and absorption regulation energy storage system for coping with day and night tide reversal
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of new energy generation and energy storage, and specifically, to a new energy generation, consumption, regulation and storage system for coping with the reversal of day and night tides. It includes: an intelligent prediction and energy storage unit uses an LSTM model to provide power generation prediction for photovoltaic power generation during the day and wind power generation at night, and sets an energy storage plan according to the predicted power generation; a dynamic flow control unit monitors the flow changes during the day and night in the power network in real time to obtain flow change data, and controls the flow based on the power generation prediction information of the intelligent prediction and energy storage unit; an automatic operation mode adjustment unit automatically adjusts the operation mode of the power system through a power generation and energy storage adjustment strategy based on the flow change data of the dynamic flow control unit, and converts the power generation and energy storage adjustment strategy into a control instruction. The present invention is designed to predict the power generation of photovoltaic power during the day and wind power at night through an LSTM model, and combined with energy storage technology, it can effectively smooth the fluctuation of power generation during the day and night and reduce the phenomenon of abandoned light and wind.

title: Method, device, equipment and medium for generating calculation power deconstructing strategy
description: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for generating a calculation power deconstructing strategy, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a scheduling queue of a plurality of subtasks comprising componentized tasks; the subtasks are obtained by cutting the modularized tasks according to the calculation force requirement; inputting the scheduling queue into a deep reinforcement learning model to obtain a target calculation power deconstructing strategy of the componentized task; the deep reinforcement learning model is used for outputting a target computational power deconstructing strategy with the shortest task execution time in a plurality of computational power deconstructing strategies according to a network environment corresponding to the componentized task, wherein the computational power deconstructing strategy refers to a strategy of distributing a network node for executing each subtask of the componentized task. According to the embodiment of the invention, the granularity of the task objects is reduced in a mode of dividing the componentized task into a plurality of subtasks, and the convergence performance, the task execution time and the resource occupancy rate are comprehensively considered through a deep reinforcement learning algorithm, so that the total execution time is effectively saved, and the occupied resources are reduced.

title: Crime situation research and judgment model training method, research and judgment system and method
description: The present invention provides a crime situation analysis model training method, the method comprising: step S1, obtaining existing historical crime time series data and preprocessing it to obtain a target sequence data set; step S2, building an initial model; step S3, using the target sequence data set to perform multiple rounds of iterative training on the initial model to obtain a crime situation analysis model. The present invention constructs a crime situation analysis model through the basic structure of an LSTM model to capture long-term dependencies in crime time series data and improve the timeliness and accuracy of the crime situation analysis model; at the same time, an attention module is introduced into the crime situation analysis model to automatically learn important features in crime time series data, so that the crime situation analysis model pays more attention to information that affects crime prediction, improves the ability to express features, and thus improves the accuracy and reliability of the crime situation analysis model.

title: GANomaly-based nuclear power unit operation abnormal state monitoring method
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear power operation, and particularly relates to a nuclear power unit operation abnormal state monitoring method based on GANomaly. The method comprises the following steps: step one: preprocessing data; step two: training and detecting a network; step three: and reconstructing a histogram according to the error of the test result, setting a threshold value, and judging that abnormal data exists in the test result through the threshold value. The beneficial effects are that: according to the invention, the missing value filling is carried out based on linear interpolation, the abnormal value is deleted and filled by the isolated forest and sliding window mean value, and the training data which can represent abnormal detection of the running state of the nuclear power unit is obtained after the original data is denoised through VMD filtering, so that the later fault detection is carried out. The improved GANomaly network frame is used for detecting faults and anomalies in abnormal running states of the nuclear power unit, so that effective detection of anomalies in the running process of the nuclear power unit is realized.

title: Zero trust evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on adversarial training
description: The embodiment of the present application provides a zero-trust evaluation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on adversarial training, which relates to the field of network security technology. The specific implementation scheme is: obtain the interface document of the interface to be used as the first interface document; encode the first interface document based on the interface specification of the registered interface in the zero-trust gateway and the preset encoding rules to obtain a first structure matrix and a first text matrix; add the first type of noise to the first structure matrix and input the structure feature generator to obtain the first structure feature matrix, add the second type of noise to the first text matrix and input the text feature generator to obtain the first text feature matrix; decode the first structure feature matrix and the second text feature matrix based on the preset decoding rules corresponding to the interface specification and the preset encoding rules to obtain a test case. It can be seen that through this scheme, the efficiency of evaluating the zero-trust architecture to which the zero-trust gateway belongs can be improved.

title: Sample automatic loading and unloading method and device for full-automatic AI microscopic analyzer
description: The present invention discloses a method and device for automatic sample loading and unloading of a fully automatic AI microscopic analyzer, and relates to the field of image recognition technology. The method comprises: based on a machine vision module, a two-step method is used to collect sample container images and perform recognition analysis to determine self-features and spatial distribution features. The transmission control characteristics of the loading and unloading mechanism are obtained, and the control module is decoupled and divided into N independent and collaborative sub-modules. In combination with these sub-modules, a sample-driven gray decision model is trained, which includes an asynchronous loading and unloading decision unit and a process prediction unit. Through interactive loading and unloading task conditions, loading and unloading action sequences and path planning are executed based on sample characteristics to determine automatic loading and unloading strategies. The intelligent central control system responds to the strategy, executes loading and unloading operations, and synchronously records execution data, and performs feedback adjustment with gray prediction analysis. Thereby achieving the technical effect of improving loading and unloading efficiency and improving loading and unloading accuracy and stability.

title: TOU income calculation unit and photovoltaic TOU mode intelligent management system
description: The present invention relates to a TOU benefit calculation unit and a photovoltaic TOU mode intelligent management system, which are applied to the photovoltaic field, and perform TOU control on a photovoltaic power station according to the configured TOU configuration information data. The TOU benefit calculation unit includes a photovoltaic energy storage system model and a benefit management module. The photovoltaic energy storage system model is formed according to the digital twin structure of the photovoltaic power station, and the photovoltaic energy storage system model simulates the operation of the photovoltaic power station under the TOU working mode, and the benefit management module calculates the TOU benefit of the photovoltaic power station under the TOU working mode. The photovoltaic TOU mode intelligent management system with the TOU benefit calculation unit can calculate the corresponding TOU benefit while adjusting the TOU configuration information data, which can better meet the needs of users for autonomous TOU configuration. The process of TOU setting adjustment is simple and efficient, which can reduce the technical threshold of the operating users in photovoltaic energy management, improve user experience, and better realize the management of photovoltaic power stations.

title: Endoscope camera system based on chromatic aberration analysis
description: The present invention relates to an endoscope camera system based on color difference analysis, comprising: a color analysis device for extracting the occupied image blocks corresponding to the preset organs in the received real-time shooting picture, and using an artificial intelligence model to intelligently analyze the deviation level of the entity color of the preset organ relative to the original color of the preset organ based on multiple visual data of the occupied image blocks; a real-time playback device for issuing an alarm signal corresponding to the organ color difference exceeding the limit when the deviation level exceeds the limit. The endoscope camera system based on color difference analysis of the present invention is intelligently designed and easy to operate. Since the camera action of the endoscope structure can be triggered only when the endoscope structure penetrates into the human body depth matching the preset organ, and at the same time, a customized artificial intelligence model is used to intelligently judge the appearance color difference of the preset organ based on multiple visual information selected in a targeted manner, thereby completing the effective improvement of the performance of the endoscope structure.

title: A disaster scene intelligent analysis method and system combined with natural language processing
description: The present invention relates to natural disaster early warning and emergency response technology, and specifically to a disaster scene intelligent analysis method and system combined with natural language processing, the system comprising a data preprocessing module for preprocessing information at the disaster site; an information extraction module for using natural language processing technology to perform deep mining on the preprocessed information and extract key information related to the disaster scene; an information analysis module for parsing the extracted key information, generating a structured description of the disaster scene, and processing contradictions and conflicts between information to generate consistent analysis results; and a result display module for displaying the analysis results to rescuers in a visual manner. The system has higher technical creativity by deeply mining and analyzing the language information at the disaster site and visualizing the result display, significantly improving the overall effect of the disaster emergency response, and has important practical application value.

title: Slope greening method
description: The invention relates to the field of greening and discloses a slope greening method which comprises the steps of obtaining aerial images of a slope to be greened, classifying the slope according to the aerial images to obtain the slope type of the slope to be greened, obtaining a soil data set of the slope to be greened if the slope type of the slope to be greened is an earth slope, interpolating the soil data set to obtain an updated soil data set, generating a greening sub-scheme corresponding to each sub-region to be greened according to a corresponding soil data subset, inputting the aerial images into a rock type identification network to obtain the rock type if the slope type of the slope to be greened is a rock slope, generating a slope modification scheme for the slope to be greened according to the rock type and slope information of the slope to be greened, and sending the slope modification scheme to a greening personnel terminal to enable greening personnel to modify the slope of the slope to be greened according to the slope modification scheme. Therefore, the large-scale popularization and application of slope greening are realized.

title: Optimization theory and method for quantum neural network coding and evolution strategy
description: An optimization theory and method for quantum neural network coding and evolutionary strategy. It belongs to the field of quantum computing and artificial intelligence intersection technology. It includes two steps: "initial coding optimization" and "intermediate evolutionary strategy optimization". "Initial coding optimization" step: based on the universality of one-bit phase-shift gate and two-bit controlled NOT gate in quantum mechanics, the quantum state description of real-valued vector samples is realized; the phase of quantum bits is used as the initial coding to achieve the unity of optimization strategy; the mapping relationship between time and space complexity is explained by using the main theorem and divide-and-conquer idea. "Intermediate evolutionary strategy optimization" step: formulate a rotation angle update strategy based on the optimal retention mechanism, design quantum NOT gate operations of different quantum bits, construct a suitable Lyapunov function, and prove the convergence of quantum neural network evolutionary strategy.

title: Unsupervised domain adaptive medical image segmentation method based on teacher fusion model
description: The invention discloses an unsupervised domain adaptive medical image segmentation method based on a teacher fusion model, and relates to the technical field of medical image processing. The invention provides an unsupervised domain adaptive medical image segmentation method based on a teacher fusion model, which comprises a frequency domain alignment module based on 3D wavelet transformation, wherein appearance alignment is carried out by exchanging low frequency spectrums, so as to obtain a similar target domain image I; based on a feature alignment module with continuous and smooth 2.5D space direction, performing feature domain alignment by constructing a 2.5D image block to obtain a similar target domain image II; respectively inputting the class target domain image I and the class target domain image II into a first teacher model and a second teacher model for supervision training, fusing and guiding the training of the student models; and carrying out singular value decomposition on the weight parameters, and training by updating the singular value parameters. Therefore, by adopting the method, the three-dimensional characteristic information of the image can be effectively acquired, the calculated amount is reduced, and the accuracy of image segmentation is improved.

title: Table data matrixing processing method and system based on convolutional neural network
description: The present invention provides an innovative method of converting tabular data into a matrix form resembling an image and performing deep analysis on the data using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). By feature expansion, random arrangement and matrix generation, the system can effectively identify complex nonlinear relationships that are difficult to capture by traditional methods. The method improves the diversity of data and the feature extraction capability of CNN, and is suitable for data analysis in the fields of finance, industrial manufacturing and the like. The claims include steps of feature expansion, data enhancement, CNN training, etc., aiming to improve analysis accuracy and efficiency.

title: Abnormal flight route and crew recovery method, device, equipment and medium
description: The application relates to a method, a device, equipment and a medium for recovering an abnormal flight route and a crew, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring information of an abnormal flight route and a crew member, and coding to obtain a coding scheme; initializing a population to generate a first population and a second population, and generating an initial fitness value of each individual in the population; performing position movement on all individuals in the two populations according to random proportions by adopting a differential evolution operator and a genetic operator to obtain a first basic population and a second basic population; sorting all individuals according to a preset sorting mode, and screening feasible solutions in the sorted first basic population and second basic population; if the first termination condition is not met, generating a target action based on the current environmental state characteristics by adopting a strategy network model, and carrying out double-population iteration processing again to obtain a target feasible solution, target partitions and the number of individuals of each target partition. The application realizes the efficient integrated recovery of the flight route and the crew.

title: BP neural network training method and system based on singlechip
description: The invention relates to a BP neural network training method and system based on a singlechip. The method comprises the following steps: converting the weight, bias and activation values of the BP neural network from floating point numbers to fixed point numbers, and cutting unnecessary weights to obtain an optimized BP neural network; the external expansion interface of the singlechip is connected with the memory, the SPI interface of the singlechip is connected with the external flash, and the memory and the external flash adopt DMA channels for data transmission; performing modularized treatment on a target algorithm corresponding to the BP neural network and integrating the modularized treatment on the target algorithm into a singlechip; and training the optimized BP neural network on the optimized singlechip. The BP neural network algorithm is optimized, storage resources are expanded, the algorithm is processed in a modularized mode, the processing capacity of the singlechip can be improved, complex neural network calculation can be realized in a miniaturized and low-power-consumption embedded system, the hardware cost is reduced, the calculation efficiency is improved, the storage space utilization rate is optimized, and the system power consumption is reduced.

title: Urban local carbon emission hot spot prediction and regulation method based on generation countermeasure network
description: The invention discloses a city local carbon emission hot spot prediction and regulation method based on a generated countermeasure network, which comprises the following steps: s1, data collection and pretreatment; s2, constructing a short-term memory module by utilizing the carbon emission data of the hour level, and performing short-term space-time characteristic coding; s3, extracting periodic variation characteristics by adopting a multi-scale convolution network based on carbon emission data of daily and weekly levels, and performing medium-term space-time characteristic coding; s4, analyzing the carbon emission data of the month and quarter level by using a long time sequence dependency model, obtaining long-term space-time characteristics, and performing global coding on the overall carbon emission distribution of the city; s5, constructing and training to generate an countermeasure network; s6, weighting and fusing the space-time characteristics of different levels by using a space-time attention mechanism, and generating a regulation strategy by combining real-time data; and S7, monitoring the regulation and control effect in real time, and performing self-adaptive adjustment and optimization. The invention adopts a generated countermeasure network and a space-time characteristic coding method to realize accurate prediction and dynamic regulation of urban carbon emission hot spots.

title: Method for training machine learning model for analyzing immunohistochemical staining image and computing system for performing the same
description: A method and a computing system for performing the same are disclosed, which can train a machine learning model for precisely analyzing the expression level of a biomarker and the like by analyzing a biological tissue slice image stained by an immunohistochemical staining method for staining a tissue expressing a specific biomarker, and can perform judgment of a pathological sample image for analyzing the expression level of the biomarker and the like using the trained machine learning model. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method and system for training a machine learning model by generating learning data corresponding to an immunohistochemical staining image using a plurality of feature vectors calculated based on a plurality of staining intensity reference values will be provided.

title: Execution information generation method, electronic device, storage medium and chip system
description: The present application provides an execution information generation method, electronic device, storage medium and chip system, which relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology and can improve the efficiency of the solver. The method includes: determining the transition probability matrix corresponding to the target model through machine learning; the elements in the transition probability matrix represent the probability of one unit in multiple units transferring to the next unit; the multiple units include N preprocessing units; based on the transition probability matrix, a preprocessing unit sequence is generated; the preprocessing unit sequence is used to limit the execution order of at least one preprocessing unit.

title: Event camera target detection method and device based on bounding box memory
description: The present application discloses an event camera target detection method and device based on bounding box memory, which relates to the field of image data processing technology, including: when a moving target disappears from an event camera, obtaining two event frames corresponding to the moving target from the event camera; obtaining detection results corresponding to the first event frame and the second event frame in the two event frames based on a preset target detection algorithm and the two event frames; the first event frame is the previous event frame of the second event frame; calculating the intersection and union ratio between the bounding boxes in the first event frame and the second event frame based on each detection result, and obtaining a confusion matrix; performing a bounding box judgment process through the confusion matrix and preset judgment rules, determining the disappearance reason corresponding to the moving target, and completing the target detection operation corresponding to the moving target. Under the conditions of no need for training and low memory occupancy, the problem that the event camera cannot detect a moving target that moves slowly or is relatively still is solved.

title: Petroleum proppant particle forming control method and system based on machine learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of petroleum proppant molding. The invention discloses a petroleum proppant particle molding control method and system based on machine learning, comprising first obtaining a base material weight and a base material purpose, determining an initial additive type according to the base material purpose and a first preset rule, obtaining an additive weight according to the base material weight and the initial additive type, determining a waste material type according to the initial additive type and a second preset rule, and then obtaining a waste weight through the additive weight and the waste type; if the initial additive type is chromite or pyrolusite, determining the chromite or pyrolusite as a target additive type; if the initial additive type is dolomite, determining the target additive type based on a first processing cost and a second processing cost, and selecting additives according to demand or purpose, thereby improving the processing quality of the proppant.

title: Method for generating package image of cigarette case and electronic equipment
description: The application provides a method for generating a package image of a cigarette case and electronic equipment, and belongs to the technical field of computer image processing.
