The method comprises the following steps: acquiring condition data including text data for describing characteristic contents of a package image desired to be generated; inputting the condition data into a trained image generation model to obtain at least one package image of the cigarette packet output by the image generation model, wherein the image generation model comprises a stable diffusion model and a modified control Net model, and an improved attention module is arranged in each type of encoder of the trainable copy in the modified control Net model, and comprises a channel attention unit, a spatial attention unit and a depth convolution unit. Therefore, the improved attention module and the control Net model are combined, training parameters are reduced, and the problem of low design efficiency of cigarette case packaging images can be solved.

title: A method for constructing and measuring farmland plots based on remote sensing images
description: The present invention relates to a method for constructing farmland plots and measuring acres based on remote sensing images, the method comprising: U1. multiple unmanned aerial vehicles enter the farmland area to be measured, obtain image data information of the farmland area in real time based on an airborne camera, and preprocess the image to obtain multiple groups of image data information of the farmland area after preprocessing; U2. based on the multiple groups of image data information of the farmland area after preprocessing, an improved multi-focus image fusion algorithm is used to fuse the images of the farmland area to obtain the image data information of the fused farmland area. The present invention can not only quickly and accurately collect farmland image data, realize efficient coverage and data update of large areas of land, but also accurately identify farmland areas, is suitable for irregular plots and complex terrains, and ensures the accuracy and reliability of area calculation results.

title: Irregular target tracking method based on Gaussian process and variational Bayesian inference
description: The invention discloses an irregular target tracking method based on Gaussian process and variational Bayesian inference, which adopts a Gaussian process model to describe a radial function of a tracked target contour, models a target shape, adopts a variational Bayesian inference method to jointly estimate the shape state of the target and measurement noise, deduces a posterior distribution form of unknown measurement noise and the shape state of the tracked target, adopts square root volume Kalman filtering to process a nonlinear filtering problem in irregular target tracking, and realizes synchronous estimation of complex shape information and unknown measurement noise. The method can effectively overcome the limitation of the traditional tracking algorithm on the complex target shape when the unknown measurement noise is processed, and remarkably improves the accuracy and the robustness of target tracking.

title: Inference board card, inference method, device, medium and product based on same
description: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, and discloses an inference board card, an inference method, equipment, a medium and a product based on the inference board card, wherein the inference board card comprises a plurality of inference units for representing a hardware resource set; determining a second number of inference models which are allowed to run in parallel according to the total data quantity of the data to be inferred and the first number of inference units which are allowed to be used in parallel in the inference board, respectively distributing the inference units for the second number of inference models, loading each inference model into the distributed inference units, dividing the data to be inferred into a plurality of data subsets, and distributing the data to be inferred in different data subsets for each inference model loaded into the inference units, so that the inference units run the inference models in parallel, and carrying out parallel inference on the obtained data to be inferred. The model reasoning efficiency can be improved.

title: Optimal operation strategy of shared energy storage and multi-energy microgrid based on two-layer game
description: The optimized operation strategy of the shared energy storage and the multi-comprehensive energy microgrid based on the double-layer game comprises the steps of nesting a cooperative game in a master-slave game of the shared energy storage merchant and the multi-comprehensive energy microgrid, establishing a master-slave game model of the shared energy storage merchant and the multi-comprehensive energy microgrid, solving a cooperative game model of a multi-comprehensive energy microgrid alliance based on a Nash negotiation theory, converting a non-convex nonlinear Nash negotiation problem into an MMG cooperation cost minimization and cooperation benefit distribution sub-problem which are easy to solve, providing an ideal benefit distribution model considering the cooperation effect, realizing fair distribution of cooperation benefit, adopting an IPSO algorithm to solve the master-slave game model, and adopting an ADMM algorithm to solve the cooperation game model. The operation strategy effectively solves the problems of unbalanced distribution of the cooperation income among various benefit bodies, high cost of distributed energy storage investment in the regional comprehensive energy micro-grid, low utilization rate and the like in the cooperation operation process of the multi-comprehensive energy micro-grid.

title: Image super-resolution method and device based on two-stage generation countermeasure network
description: The present invention discloses an image super-resolution method and device based on a two-stage generative adversarial network, aiming to solve the problem of detail loss and noise in super-resolution reconstruction of remote sensing images in the prior art. The method improves the resolution of low-resolution remote sensing images and enhances the naturalness and detail richness of images through a two-stage generative adversarial network. In the first stage, a first generative adversarial network is trained using real low-resolution images and low-resolution images generated by bicubic downsampling to generate low-resolution images similar to the bicubic style. In the second stage, a second generative adversarial network is trained using the low-resolution images generated in the first stage and real high-resolution images to generate high-resolution images similar to real high-resolution images. The method of the present invention not only improves the spatial resolution of the image, but also enhances the visual quality and application value of the image.

title: Corn ear DUS character judging method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of crop trait discrimination, and discloses a corn ear DUS trait discrimination method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: inputting a corn ear image training set into a neural network model based on DeepViT and ASPP for training, using a corn ear image test set for testing, adding ear images of other trait categories based on the training test results to update a corn ear image sample set, and repeating the training and testing process until the training test results meet the requirements, and using the corn ear DUS trait discrimination model that has been finally trained to generate a DUS trait discrimination result of a corn ear to be discriminated. Thus, by considering the influence of the introduction of corn ear image samples of each trait category on the improvement of the discrimination accuracy of all trait categories, the training samples are gradually increased, and the efficiency and accuracy of corn ear DUS trait discrimination are improved while the sample processing workload is reduced.

title: A multi-objective dynamic switching optimization scheduling method and system based on virtual power plant
description: The application discloses a multi-target dynamic switching optimization scheduling method and system based on a virtual power plant, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time state data of the target virtual power plant, analyzing the real-time state data through a multi-model integration method based on a big tree mechanism, predicting to obtain first prediction data of the target virtual power plant, adaptively correcting the first prediction data according to an improved Kalman filtering algorithm to obtain second prediction data, respectively constructing scheduling target functions corresponding to each scheduling requirement based on a plurality of scheduling requirements of the target virtual power plant, constructing a multi-target dynamic switching scheduling database according to the real-time state data and each scheduling target function, and screening in the multi-target dynamic switching scheduling database based on the real-time state data and the second prediction data, and scheduling the target virtual power plant according to a target scheduling scheme obtained after screening. The method provided by the application improves the dispatching operation efficiency of the virtual power plant.

title: Soil organic matter classification model training method, device, equipment and medium
description: The application relates to the technical field of soil organic matter classification and discloses a training method, a device, equipment and a medium for a soil organic matter classification model, which comprise the steps of collecting data of a preset area and acquiring image source data and vegetation index images of the preset area; the method comprises the steps of training a machine learning model to be trained by using soil sample data and vegetation index data corresponding to the soil sample data to obtain the machine learning model, inputting the image source data and the vegetation index image into the machine learning model to generate a machine learning result graph, wherein the machine learning result graph is characterized by being based on a soil organic matter classification result of machine learning, taking the machine learning result graph as a pseudo tag, and training the soil organic matter classification model to be trained according to the image source data and the vegetation index image to obtain the soil organic matter classification model. The soil organic matter classifying device has the beneficial effects that the soil organic matter can be classified rapidly and automatically.

title: AI-based Zhixue Cloud Platform
description: The invention relates to an intelligent cloud platform based on artificial intelligence, which adopts the following technical scheme that the intelligent cloud platform comprises a user interface module, a data processing module, a data analysis sub-module, a knowledge base module, an intelligent coaching module, a security module and an interactive collaboration module, wherein the user interface module is used for receiving input of a user and displaying learning content and feedback, the data processing module comprises a data collection sub-module used for collecting learning data of the user, the data analysis sub-module is used for analyzing the user data to identify learning modes and effects, the personalized recommendation sub-module is used for generating personalized learning suggestions according to analysis results, the knowledge base module comprises learning resources in multiple fields, the intelligent coaching module provides targeted learning guidance by using a machine learning algorithm, the cloud database is used for storing user data, learning materials and historical learning data, the security module is used for protecting the security of data transmission and storage, and the interactive collaboration module is used for allowing multiple users to communicate and collaborate in an online manner.

title: Information extraction method, system, electronic device and computer readable storage medium
description: The invention relates to the technical field of natural language processing, and particularly discloses an information extraction method, an information extraction system, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining the topic type of information to be extracted, and preprocessing the information to be extracted to obtain preprocessed information to be extracted; and extracting a plurality of key information fragments based on the topic type and the preprocessed information to be extracted, integrating all the key information fragments to obtain integrated information, and determining the integrated information as target information when the integrated information is in compliance. The invention improves the accuracy and efficiency of information extraction, and can be applied to the field requiring high-efficiency and accurate information processing.

title: Method and device for constructing optical remote sensing image annotation engine based on iterative reasoning
description: The present invention discloses a method and device for constructing an optical remote sensing image annotation engine based on iterative reasoning; the method can be used as a supplement to the manual annotation method of optical remote sensing image training samples, reducing the annotation cost and difficulty of optical remote sensing image training data. The method is oriented to the training operation scenario of multimodal large models, and aims to generate multi-granular multimodal synthetic annotation data sets based on massive real optical remote sensing images, thereby supporting the training of multimodal large models in various optical remote sensing image interpretation tasks such as image classification, image description, image question and answer, image region classification, image region description, image region question and answer, target detection, vision grounding, target mask extraction, instance segmentation, reference expression segmentation, etc. The present invention enables a single model to have the ability to handle various spatial hierarchies and semantic granularities.

title: Network fault diagnosis method, equipment and device
description: The embodiment of the present application provides a network fault diagnosis method, device and apparatus. By obtaining a target fault description corresponding to the target base station when determining that the target base station is in an abnormal working state; based on the target fault description, determining the target fault cause of the target base station in the abnormal working state in the network fault knowledge graph; wherein the network fault knowledge graph includes a correspondence between multiple fault descriptions and multiple fault causes. The network fault diagnosis method, device and apparatus provided in the present application are used to improve the fault diagnosis efficiency of base stations.

title: A tobacco pest and disease pesticide matching method and system
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of tobacco information processing, and in particular to a method and system for matching tobacco pests and diseases with pesticides. A method for matching tobacco pests and diseases with pesticides includes: generating a first set based on identified pests and diseases and candidate pesticides, the first set including multiple tensor sets, each tensor set including a pesticide purchase decision tensor and a pesticide mixing decision tensor; inputting each tensor set in the first set into a first computing device for processing to obtain a target value set corresponding to each tensor set; and recommending a pesticide matching scheme based on the tensor set corresponding to the best target value set in the first set. The present invention realizes intelligent pesticide matching, and the pesticide matching scheme has a higher therapeutic effect on pests and diseases, saves pesticide matching time, and reduces costs.

title: A visitor reservation management system
description: The present invention discloses a visitor reservation management system, which relates to the field of monitoring and access control, and is used to solve the problem that the number of signature verification results increases due to the large number of visitor entry and exit times, and the system memory occupancy is too large. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a special processing module, a data analysis module, a signature security module and a visualization port, and the modules are connected by signals. By collecting visitor information and QR code information, the number of visitor entry and exit times, arrival rate, digital signature security, etc. are obtained through processing, a data analysis model is established, a cache evaluation coefficient is generated, and compared with the cache threshold, a cache determination result and an alarm word are obtained, and sent to the signature security module and the visualization port respectively; the signature security module uses fuzzy logic to determine the cache scheme, and sends it to the visualization port, effectively reducing the burden of real-time processing of the system, improving the efficiency and security of QR code verification, reducing the calculation delay during visitor verification, and making it more convenient for visitors to enter and exit.

title: Intelligent interaction method and system for risk compliance class
description: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent interaction, which solves the technical problems that an artificial intelligence matched with an artificial customer service easily gives an answer with legal risk, and the artificial intelligence is difficult to answer to a customer in compliance and satisfactorily without adding the artificial customer service, in particular to a risk compliance type intelligent interaction method and a risk compliance type intelligent interaction system, wherein the method comprises the following steps that S1, a trust domain search library and a cold door problem database are constructed based on historical data; S2, acquiring a plurality of question information input by a client, preprocessing the question information to obtain a plurality of question data C  a , and S3, converting the question data C (a) into question representation f (a) through a convolutional neural network.

title: A graph representation learning method based on sparse and distant neighbor node enhancement
description: The present invention provides a graph representation learning method based on sparse and distant neighbor node enhancement, which relates to the field of data enhancement technology. According to the acquired graph structure data set to be enhanced, the present invention obtains the initial node feature matrix, adjacency matrix and original classification labels, and divides the training set and the test set; the node features of the training set are enhanced by feature enhancement technology to obtain a sparse enhanced graph structure data set; then, in combination with the node mixing technology, the features and classification labels of intra-class nodes and inter-class nodes are mixed to increase the accessibility of distant neighbor nodes, and a distant neighbor enhanced graph structure data set is obtained; the distant neighbor enhanced graph structure data set is input into the graph neural network model for graph representation learning and training, so as to obtain the optimal node representation and the trained graph representation learning model; finally, the model is tested and evaluated to obtain an evaluated model. The present invention solves the shortcomings of traditional graph neural networks in processing sparse nodes and distant neighbor node information aggregation.

title: Model watermark generation method and model validation method based on blockchain
description: The application provides a model watermark generation method and a model verification method based on a blockchain, wherein the model watermark generation method combines a model watermark technology and a blockchain platform, a decentralised intelligent contract randomly generates a model watermark according to a model watermark generation request initiated by a user through a terminal, the model watermark takes a hash value of a latest block on the blockchain as a random seed, so that a model embedded by the terminal is expressed on the blockchain through watermark information tokenization, the blockchain does not need to store a complete model, the model verification method responds to the user verification request by the intelligent contract on the chain on the basis of model watermark generation, and extracts the current latest watermark from the model according to watermark extraction information stored on the chain to verify consistency with the originally generated watermark, thereby verifying ownership of the model by the user.

title: Document inspection method, document inspection device, computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment
description: The present application provides a document review method, device, computer-readable storage medium and electronic device. It includes: obtaining training documents, extracting and classifying the review opinions of the training documents, determining the pseudo-labels corresponding to each review opinion, splitting the training documents to obtain target training documents, and extracting semantic features from the split training documents to obtain a training document feature set; using the training document feature set and the target training document to train the initial weakly supervised network model to obtain a trained weakly supervised network model; obtaining the document to be reviewed, splitting the document to be reviewed and extracting semantic features to obtain a feature set of the document to be reviewed, and using the weakly supervised network model to review each sentence of the feature set of the document to be reviewed to generate a review document. It solves the problem that the existing technology performs secondary annotation after splitting the documents, resulting in high manpower and material costs.

title: A method for detecting lightning ablation of metal composite materials
description: The invention relates to the technical field of lightning stroke ablation material detection, in particular to a lightning stroke ablation detection method for a metal composite material. The technical scheme includes that a lightning stroke ablation image data set of a metal composite material to be detected is obtained, image data are preprocessed, a boundary frame is preset, two-dimensional representation is learned on the ablation image data of the metal composite material through a predefined convolution layer, and the ablation image data are stretched into one-dimensional data. The machine vision detection method based on the transducer can automatically, efficiently and accurately identify the ablation phenomenon, effectively reduce the influence caused by noise, effectively and selectively capture global information, improve the calculation efficiency, strengthen the capture of the global information, effectively reduce the data calculation amount, and improve the prediction accuracy and the calculation efficiency.

title: Laser radar wind measurement data interpolation method and device based on machine learning
description: The invention relates to a laser radar wind measurement data interpolation method and device based on machine learning, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining all distance layer laser radar data measured by a laser radar, preprocessing to obtain data rules of all distance layers, calculating target correlation coefficients between other distance layers and the farthest distance layers based on a preset correlation algorithm and the data rules of all the distance layers, determining the target distance layers from the other distance layers based on the target correlation coefficients, performing model training based on the laser radar data of the target distance layers, the laser radar data of the farthest distance layers and a preset machine learning model to obtain a laser radar data interpolation model, and obtaining the laser radar data of the farthest distance layers by inputting the real-time laser radar data of the target distance layers into the laser radar data interpolation model. Therefore, a data interpolation model is established based on a machine learning algorithm to interpolate the wind measurement data of the furthest distance layer measured by the laser radar, and the accuracy of the wind measurement data of the laser radar is improved.

title: POI recommendation device, method, electronic device and readable storage medium
description: The present invention provides a POI recommendation device, method, electronic device and readable storage medium, wherein the device includes a user grouping module, a configuration module, a model training module, a validation set loss calculation module, a user group weight adjustment module and a validation set loss judgment module; the user is grouped according to his/her behavioral characteristics and social attributes, initial weights are assigned to different user groups, and training is performed using a deep neural network model and an objective function. Through the validation set loss calculation and dynamic adjustment of the user group weights, the validation set loss is iteratively judged, and the historical optimal model parameters are updated until the model converges. Through the present invention, the influence of the data volume on the validation loss of each user group is considered, the group fairness is optimized, the problem that a single objective function cannot balance the goals of multiple groups is avoided, and fair recommendations for different user groups are achieved, thereby improving the prediction accuracy of the model and the personalization level of the recommendation system.

title: Singular value-based pre-training vision model parameter fine adjustment method
description: The invention discloses a singular value-based pre-training visual model parameter fine adjustment method, which comprises the steps of selecting a level which needs to be subjected to parameter fine adjustment from a visual model according to actual needs for a pre-training visual model, respectively carrying out singular value decomposition on a weight matrix of each layer to be fine-tuned to obtain an optimal rank-r approximate matrix and a residual matrix for reconstructing the weight matrix, constructing singular value vectors by the first r singular values to serve as trainable parameters, freezing other model parameters, inputting image samples in a training sample set into the visual model to update the trainable parameters, and reconstructing the trainable parameters after updating to obtain the weight matrix. According to the invention, the low-rank matrix is initialized by singular value decomposition, the training information is reserved, the learning of the downstream task on the knowledge in the new field is enhanced, the number of trainable parameters is obviously reduced, the knowledge and adaptability of the model are effectively reserved, and the fine tuning effect of the model is improved.

title: Fresh grape harvesting time prediction system and method based on deep learning model
description: The present invention provides a prediction system and method for the harvesting time of table grapes based on a deep learning model, the system comprising: a hyperspectral image shooting device, a data acquisition device, a controller and a data processor, the hyperspectral image shooting device is used to obtain hyperspectral image information of table grapes at different maturity stages; the data acquisition device is used to obtain physical and chemical index data of maturity of table grapes at different maturity stages; the controller is used to control the hyperspectral image shooting device and store the data acquired during the execution of the hyperspectral image shooting device and the data acquisition device in the memory of the controller; the data processor is used to process the data in the memory. The present invention improves the accuracy of the regression prediction of the maturity index and can determine the harvesting time more accurately and reasonably.

title: YOLO V5-based lightweight neural memory ordinary differential equation cascade method
description: The present invention discloses a lightweight neural memory ordinary differential equation cascade method based on YOLO V5, the method comprising: using a Backbone network to output feature maps of different resolutions, through the cascade of NmODE modules, the feature maps are repeatedly fused between each NmODE module, and the feature maps of different resolutions are fully integrated, which not only retains fine local information, but also enhances the expression ability of the global context. The NmODE module not only receives the output of the previous module as input, but also fuses with the feature map of the Backbone network, thereby further enriching the feature expression in each layer of cascade. In addition, after each NmODE module, the semantic features of the NmODE output are fused again with the current input of the current cascaded NmODE module through the enhanced aggregation EF module. This dual-path fusion strategy not only enhances the detection capability of multi-scale target objects, but also significantly improves the detection accuracy through the interaction and fusion of features.

title: RIS-assisted unmanned aerial vehicle network-based general sense integrated system and method
description: The invention discloses a sense-of-general integrated system and method based on an RIS auxiliary unmanned aerial vehicle network. And applying the RIS intelligent reflecting surface and the unmanned aerial vehicle network to the sense-of-general integrated system. The flow is divided into a communication part and a perception part in consideration of different service requirements in the system. And a deep reinforcement learning algorithm is designed according to the requirements of the system to control UAV flight track, base station beam forming, user association allocation and RIS phase shift in the system, so that the communication and perception performance in the ventilation and induction integrated system is optimal. According to the invention, while all functions of the original sense-of-general integrated system are reserved, RIS and unmanned plane network are introduced to assist the system, and an alternate iterative optimization method and a deep reinforcement learning algorithm are used to realize scheduling and decision of each resource. Compared with the prior system, the system provides additional channel gain and improves the allocation efficiency of communication perception resources.

title: Standard machine-readable ability evaluation method
description: The present invention discloses a standard machine-readable capability evaluation method, including: converting the same instruction into structured data and unstructured data respectively, and transmitting them to the machine input end; obtaining byte information with structured data, and obtaining feature information with unstructured data; clustering the byte information and feature information based on scope respectively, and obtaining a first transaction unit set and a second transaction unit set; selecting typical tags and adding indexes in the same transaction unit; obtaining a response instruction at the machine execution end, parsing the response instruction to the index to perform difference calculation, and obtaining a deviation coefficient; analyzing the weight distribution of the deviation coefficient, and constructing an evaluation model through a neural network based on the weight distribution to evaluate the machine-readable capability. This method can not only effectively evaluate the machine's processing capability for different types of data, but also has good interpretability, and can adapt to various complex machine-readable capability evaluation needs.

title: Method for constructing histopathological quantitative evaluation model of choroidal neovascularization and application thereof
description: The present invention discloses a method for constructing a quantitative histopathological evaluation model for choroidal neovascularization and its application. The evaluation model constructed by the method of the present application can accurately identify the choroidal neovascularization structure around the laser spot, and can perform rapid batch analysis on a large number of paving slides, thereby improving the reliability and consistency of the analysis results, reducing the variability caused by laser surgery, interference from human operating factors, and the labor cost of analysis.

title: A reference-free light field image quality assessment method based on visual transformer
description: The present invention discloses a reference-free light field image quality evaluation method based on a visual transformer. The method comprises the following steps: extracting a sub-aperture image array of a distorted light field image to obtain a central sub-aperture image and a sub-aperture image array with a central angular resolution of a×a; inputting the central sub-aperture image of the distorted light field image into a spatial blocking module to obtain a spatial block of the distorted light field image rich in spatial information; inputting the sub-aperture image array with a central angular resolution of a×a of the distorted light field image into an angular blocking module to obtain an angular block of the distorted light field image; obtaining multi-layer features in the spatial domain of the distorted light field image; obtaining multi-layer features in the angular domain of the distorted light field image; and splicing these features to obtain fused features rich in spatial features and angular features; regressing the fused features using a quality score prediction network to obtain a quality score of the distorted light field image, and training the network using gradient back propagation according to the configured relevant network model and training parameters.

title: Tracking result prediction method, device, electronic apparatus, storage medium, and program
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a tracking result prediction method, a tracking result prediction device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program. The method comprises the steps of determining target actual state data of a target missile at a target moment and an actual motion data set of a target tracking object, determining future prediction state data of the target missile at a future moment based on the target actual state data, the actual motion data set and a pre-trained state determination model, wherein the state determination model is a pre-trained neural network model, and determining a prediction tracking result of the target missile on the target tracking object based on the future prediction state data and the actual motion data set. According to the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, the neural network model does not need numerical integral calculation and differential calculation, so that the introduction of accumulated errors is avoided, the calculated amount is reduced, and the efficiency and the accuracy of determining the predicted state data are improved.

title: New energy power prediction method and device based on decomposition and attention mechanism
description: The invention relates to the technical field of wind power prediction, in particular to a new energy power prediction method and a new energy power prediction device based on a decomposition and attention mechanism, wherein a first query vector, a first key vector and a first value vector corresponding to wind speed data in a prediction period are used as inputs of a first cross attention mechanism of an encoder in a pre-built neural network model, and output characteristics of the encoder in the pre-built neural network model, a second query vector and a second key vector corresponding to wind speed data in the prediction period are used as inputs of a second cross attention mechanism of a decoder in the pre-built neural network model, so that a new energy power prediction result of the prediction period output by the pre-built neural network model is obtained; the technical scheme provided by the invention has higher precision and good generalization capability, and can effectively improve the performance of the wind power prediction method in the problem of wind power multi-step prediction.

title: Target intelligent identification method using remote sensing information processing system
description: The present invention discloses a method for intelligent target recognition using a remote sensing information processing system, including: step 1, fine extraction of hyperspectral ground feature elements based on hybrid pixel decomposition and spectral purification; step 2, determination of the working state of the operating target based on target thermal radiation modeling and multi-temporal analysis; step 3, feature mining of massive SAR data based on sparse deep belief networks; step 4, fusion of ship target trajectories based on multi-source information; step 5, software plug-in architecture and interpretation of multi-source load data of operating units. The present invention realizes data organization and management, multi-source data interpretation, data comprehensive compilation and business management through system integration construction, greatly improving the accuracy and production efficiency of remote sensing data of operating units.

title: Brain-like small sample behavior recognition algorithm based on motion guidance attention mechanism
description: A brain-like small sample behavior recognition algorithm based on motion-guided attention mechanism, involving the technical field of small sample behavior recognition for deep learning tasks. The brain-like inductive reasoning mechanism algorithm module based on the attention mechanism imitates the recognition mechanism of the human brain, and mainly includes a self-attention motion feature guidance module, a video-level global perception module, and a cross-attention motion feature guidance module. The self-attention motion feature guidance module is used to capture the key features of the action-related areas between each video frame; the video-level perception module continuously pays attention to the key action-related area features of the entire video; the cross-attention motion feature guidance module compares the key features of the action-related areas between different videos and establishes the association between the motion-related areas; compared with some existing classic methods, the constructed model can significantly improve the detection accuracy of small sample behavior recognition and achieve the best results.

title: Graphic neural network knowledge editing method based on drug toxicity classification
description: This invention relates to the field of graph neural network (GNN) knowledge editing, and particularly to a graph neural network knowledge editing method based on drug toxicity classification. The method includes: acquiring a drug toxicity classification dataset to be processed; extracting a graph subnetwork of the GNN used to classify chemical molecules; extracting class subnetworks from the graph subnetworks that retain only drug structural feature knowledge and compound knowledge; filtering and purifying the class subnetworks that retain only drug structural feature knowledge; optimizing the parameters of the purified class subnetworks; adding constraints to the optimization objective; and optimizing the model using a plug-in optimization method to obtain the optimization objective, thus completing the knowledge editing. Using the graph neural network knowledge editing method based on drug toxicity classification described in this invention, new knowledge can be effectively injected into the drug toxicity classification model, significantly reducing the cost of retraining the model to embed knowledge and improving the feasibility of practical applications.

title: A method for detecting weak heat source targets in space background
description: The present invention proposes a method for detecting weak heat source targets in a space background, comprising: obtaining several space background infrared images with real heat source annotations, inputting the images into a constructed weak heat source target detection network model, and obtaining heat source detection results in the space background infrared images, wherein the weak heat source target detection network model includes an image enhancement unit, an encoder, a feature fusion unit, and a decoder; establishing a total loss function based on the heat source detection results and the real heat source annotations, optimizing the constructed weak heat source target detection network model, and obtaining a trained weak heat source target detection network model when the total loss function value reaches a minimum; inputting the space background infrared image to be detected into the trained weak heat source target detection network model, and obtaining heat source detection results in the space background infrared image to be detected. The present invention can improve the detection accuracy of weak heat source targets in a space background and avoid false detections and missed detections.

title: Water conservation monitoring optimization method and monitoring equipment based on model feature encryption technology
description: The invention provides a water conservation monitoring optimization method and monitoring equipment based on a model feature encryption technology, which solve the problems of lower pixel occupation of a photo corresponding to key features of the existing construction ground feature, low follow-up three-dimensional modeling precision and the like, and the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source image data of the ground appearance to be constructed through aerial photography; the method comprises the steps of carrying out feature recognition on multi-source image data by a convolutional neural network model, merging the image data through the recognized common feature points, carrying out corresponding three-dimensional modeling, finally carrying out coordinate conversion and convolutional neural network model splicing, classifying each functional area in the three-dimensional model by the convolutional neural network model, simultaneously judging whether the functional area is a water and soil loss key interest area by introducing potential water and soil loss coefficients as judgment basis, carrying out continuous iterative optimization on water and soil conservation measure positions in the water and soil loss key interest area according to classification results, and guaranteeing accuracy of water and soil loss of the acquired area.

title: Electrochemical energy storage heat abuse early warning method based on reinforcement deep learning
description: The present invention discloses an electrochemical energy storage thermal abuse warning method based on enhanced deep learning, which relates to the field of energy storage technology. It includes obtaining charging time series data, equipment surface temperature time series data and external environment temperature time series data in the current time period; using the above data as the input of the temperature prediction model to obtain the equipment surface predicted temperature time series data for the next time period; based on the current charging data, determining the charging time series data in the next time period; based on the equipment surface temperature historical time series data and equipment surface predicted temperature time series data during this charging and discharging process, and the historical charging time series data during this charging and discharging process and the charging time series data in the next time period, establishing a device surface temperature curve that changes with the charging data; based on the curve, determining whether there is a risk of thermal abuse; and generating warning information when there is a risk of thermal abuse. The method disclosed by the present invention can give an early warning before thermal abuse occurs, avoiding unnecessary losses caused by thermal abuse.

title: Strong plot point determining method, system, equipment and medium
description: The application relates to a strong plot point determining method, a system, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of splitting script content into a plurality of plots, determining a target object based on the split plurality of plots, inputting the plurality of plots one by one into a large language model to determine a plot point corresponding to each plot, determining real-time attributes of the target object in the plot point aiming at any plot point, and taking the plot point with the real-time attributes meeting preset conditions as the strong plot point. The strong plot points in the scenario can be quickly and efficiently determined, and compared with the traditional time, the determined strong plot points are more objective.

title: North-area soil freeze-thawing state inversion method combining Chinese Tianmu No. (Tianmu-1) satellite-borne BDS-R and SMOS radiometer observation data
description: The invention discloses a soil freeze-thaw state inversion method in the Arctic region based on observation data of BDS-R and SMOS radiometers carried by China's Tianmu-1 satellite, namely, a method for inverting the soil freeze-thaw state in the Arctic region by using a Multiscale CNN-BiLSTM hybrid model based on an Attention mechanism and ResNet. The method is based on a hybrid model of Multiscale CNN-BiLSTM based on an Attention mechanism and ResNet. The model is mainly composed of three core modules, namely, a multiscale feature extraction module based on ResNet and CNN, a feature relationship reasoning module based on a BiLSTM network, and a fully connected network module based on the Attention mechanism for fusing multiple feature parameters. The hybrid model can significantly improve the F/T inversion accuracy and help provide data supplement for the Arctic region with a harsh environment.

title: Longitudinal federal learning backdoor defense method, equipment and product based on semantic consistency
description: The present invention discloses a method, device and product for backdoor defense in vertical federated learning based on semantic consistency. First, a latent mask autoencoder is used to evaluate the semantic consistency of embeddings provided by different vertical federated learning participants; then, malicious embeddings are identified with the help of semantic consistency evaluation to identify attackers; finally, the embedding reconstructed by the latent mask autoencoder is used to replace the attacker's embedding, thereby removing the backdoor semantics and enabling the top-level model to achieve robust prediction against backdoors. Based on the discovery that backdoor attacks may lead to inconsistent embedding semantics, the present invention proposes a new defense technology that does not rely on any auxiliary data and has no assumptions about backdoor attacks or model structures. The present invention develops a latent mask autoencoder to evaluate the semantic consistency between the embeddings of each participant. In addition, the autoencoder is used for attacker identification and embedding reconstruction, thereby achieving robust prediction of backdoor samples.

title: Image recognition method based on depolarization variation inference prompt tuning
description: The invention discloses an image recognition method based on depolarization variation inference prompt tuning, and belongs to the field of artificial intelligence and computer vision. The invention takes a CLIP as a reference frame, wherein the reference frame comprises an image branch and a text branch, an image encoder based on style disturbance is designed based on the image branch to obtain depolarized visual characteristics, a text encoder based on depolarized variation inference is designed based on the depolarized visual characteristics and the text branch to obtain depolarized text characteristics, training set data is minimized and optimized to obtain a model with optimal parameters through a designed loss function based on variation inference, and a model with optimal test image data input parameters is used to obtain an image recognition result. The invention provides a general small sample image recognition method for a data scarcity or limited scene, and can still keep higher recognition accuracy and generalization performance under limited data.

title: Grid capacity evaluation system and method based on multidimensional regional image
description: The present invention discloses a grid capacity evaluation system and method based on multi-dimensional regional portraits, and relates to the field of electric power technology. Compared with the previous distribution network grid capacity evaluation method, the present invention solves the existing distribution network grid capacity evaluation, which cannot timely discover the unreasonableness in the grid structure, accurately identify the root cause of power quality problems, determine aging or insufficient performance equipment, clarify the application effect and shortcomings of intelligent technology in the power grid, and consider the characteristics and demand differences of different regions; based on the six dimensions of grid power supply capacity, power quality, grid structure, equipment level, intelligent level and economic operation, the grid capacity in the analysis area is evaluated, which can more comprehensively and accurately reflect the actual capacity and operation status of the grid, and avoid the limitations and one-sidedness of single indicator evaluation; and establish a multi-dimensional regional portrait, which can better predict the future demand and development trend of the power grid, and provide strong support for forward-looking planning.

title: Training method and system for infrared superdivision network model and storage medium thereof
description: The present invention relates to the field of deep learning, and discloses a training method, system and storage medium of an infrared super-resolution network model. In the method, the infrared super-resolution network model is a lightweight super-resolution network model constructed by re-parameterized network blocks and transposed convolution, and is suitable for end-side devices; the training method comprises: inputting a single-channel infrared image to the lightweight super-resolution network model; expanding the number of channels to a set number of channels through a convolution layer; adjusting the parameters of the lightweight super-resolution network model through several re-parameterized network blocks; upsampling the feature map through a transposed convolution layer; restoring the number of channels to a single channel through a convolution layer; and outputting the result. Compared with the prior art, the present invention can achieve more accurate and effective image reconstruction, and will not increase the computing power of the end-side device, nor reduce the performance and speed of the device.

title: Vortex-vibration response prediction method for double-layer steel truss bridge based on machine learning algorithm
description: The invention discloses a machine learning algorithm-based vortex-induced vibration response prediction method for a double-layer steel truss bridge, which is characterized in that the influence rule of various auxiliary facilities and additional aerodynamic measures on the vortex-induced vibration of the section of the double-layer steel truss bridge is analyzed through a double-layer steel truss bridge segment model wind tunnel test; the method comprises the steps of analyzing a vortex-induced vibration generation mechanism of a bridge-forming segment model through numerical simulation, exploring an influence rule of additional aerodynamic measure parameter changes on the vortex-induced vibration of the cross section of the double-layer steel truss bridge, and establishing a cross section amplitude prediction model under different wind speeds and a vortex-induced vibration characteristic parameter prediction model under different additional aerodynamic measures based on a machine learning algorithm to predict the vortex-induced vibration response of the double-layer steel truss bridge. The method combines wind tunnel test, numerical simulation and machine learning methods to realize the prediction of the vortex-vibration response of the double-layer steel truss bridge, has good stability and high prediction accuracy, and provides references for bridge design, operation and maintenance.

title: Discontinuous combination method for multiple oil displacement systems based on random forest algorithm
description: The invention discloses a discontinuous combination method of multiple oil displacement systems based on a random forest algorithm. The method comprises the following steps of S1, carrying out physical simulation optimization on discontinuous combination injection parameters of an oil displacement system, S2, carrying out numerical simulation optimization on discontinuous combination injection parameters of the oil displacement system, and S3, establishing a random forest prediction model. The method can accurately reflect the contribution of discontinuous combination injection modes of various oil displacement systems to the oil increasing effect, is easy to parallelize, strong in overfitting resistance, insensitive to abnormal values and noise, capable of processing high-dimensional data without feature scaling, can accurately analyze the relevance of the improved recovery ratio and different influencing factors and predict the importance degree of different factors on the improved recovery ratio, forms a comprehensive synergy index pattern of the improved recovery ratio after integrating the factors, can more intuitively and accurately determine the advantages and disadvantages of an oil displacement scheme to be realized, and provides technical support for formulating discontinuous combination implementation modes of various oil displacement systems, and carrying out economic evaluation and risk analysis.

title: Emotion portrait tracking method and device based on multi-site dermatography technology
description: The present invention provides an emotion portrait tracking method and device based on multi-site skin electrical technology, which relates to the field of data processing technology. The method includes: obtaining multi-site skin electrical signal characteristics of a target individual; inputting the multi-site skin electrical signal characteristics of the target individual into a pre-trained emotion portrait prediction model to obtain a multi-dimensional emotion portrait prediction result of the target individual; wherein the emotion portrait prediction model is obtained by training a multi-label neural network model based on a pre-established multi-dimensional emotion label data set; the multi-dimensional emotion label data set includes: multi-dimensional emotion labels obtained by dynamic labeling of multiple individuals based on their own emotional experiences in a preset scenario. Through the method provided by the present invention, accurate portrayal of emotion portraits is achieved, and this dynamic portrayal method is characterized by high efficiency, convenience and low cost.

title: Brain-computer interface signal identification circuit based on memristive neural network
description: The invention discloses a brain-computer interface signal identification circuit based on a memristive neural network, which consists of three neuron circuits. Each neuron circuit is composed of nine parallel branches and comprises a signal input module, a weight adjustment module, a summation module ①, a memristor, a summation module ②, a sampling module and a comparison module. In a single neuron circuit, when nine input signals V  in1 ~V in9  are processed by the signal input modules, the weight adjusting modules, the summing modules ① and the memristors of nine parallel branches, the nine signals are combined together to pass through the single summing module ②, the sampling module and the comparing module, and the identification signal of the single neuron circuit is output. The designed circuit utilizes the resistance plasticity and threshold characteristics of the memristor to build the memristor neural network circuit, and can primarily identify the meaning of brain-computer interface signals through a self-learning mechanism, so that the identification accuracy of the brain-computer interface signals can be remarkably enhanced.

title: Rule swapping in a packet network
description: In some variations, first and second rule sets may be received by a network protection device. The first and second rule sets may be preprocessed. The network protection device may be configured to process packets in accordance with the first rule set. Packets may be received by the network protection device. A first portion of the packets may be processed in accordance with the first rule set. The network protection device may be reconfigured to process packets in accordance with the second rule set. A second portion of the packets may be processed in accordance with the second rule set.

title: Neural interface
description: Method(s) and apparatus are provided for interfacing with a nervous system of a subject. In response to receiving a plurality of neurological signals associated with the neural activity of the first portion of nervous system: processing neural sample data representative of the received plurality of neurological signals using a first one or more machine learning (ML) technique(s) trained for generating estimates of neural data representative of the neural activity of the first portion of nervous system; and transmitting data representative of the neural data estimates to a first device associated with the first portion of nervous system; and in response to receiving device data from a second device associated with a second portion of the nervous system: generating one or more neurological stimulus signal(s) by inputting the received device data to a second one or more ML technique(s) trained for estimating one or more neurological stimulus signal(s) associated with the device data for input to the second portion of nervous system; and transmitting the one or more estimated neurological stimulus signal(s) towards the second portion of nervous system of the subject.

title: Data processing method and related products
description:

receiving, by the general-purpose processor, a running result corresponding to the Al learning task; and 
determining, by the general-purpose processor, an offline running file according to the running result, where 
the offline running file is generated according to the device information of the Al processor and the binary 
instruction when the running result satisfies a preset requirement. By implementing the present disclosure, 
the debugging between the Al algorithm model and the Al processor can be achieved in advance.

description:

ABSTRACT 
Certain aspects of the present disclosure provide techniques for node matching with 
accuracy by combining statistical methods with a knowledge graph to assist in responding (e.g., 
providing content) to a user query in a user support system. In order to provide content, a 
5 keyword matching algorithm, statistical method (e.g., a trained BERT model), and data 
retrieval are each implemented to identify node(s) in a knowledge graph with encoded content 
relevant to the user's query. The implementation of the keyword matching algorithm, statistical 
method, and data retrieval results in a matching metric score, semantic score, and graph metric 
data, respectively. Each score associated with a node is combined to generate an overall score 
10 that can be used to rank nodes. Once the nodes are ranked, the top ranking nodes are displayed 
to the user for selection. Based on the selection, content encoded in the node is displayed to the 
user.

title: A FCM clustering based identification method of power system low-frequency oscillation mode parameters
description:
A low frequency oscillation mode parameter identification method based on FCM 
clustering is disclosed, which belongs to the field of power system oscillation mode 
identification technology. It preprocesses at least one measurement data of the power 
system collected by phasor measuring unit (PMU). With the pre-processed 
measurement data as input, the multi-order stochastic subspace calculation is carried 
out to obtain the identification results under different orders of the power system. By 
using fuzzy C-means clustering (FCM), the minimum order of the system oscillation 
is determined according to the number of elements in each class, and the 
identification values of oscillation parameters can be obtained by clustering center.  
In this invention, all possible oscillation modes are captured by multi-order 
calculation. The identification results are clustered by FCM, and the real modes are 
easy to be clustered.

title: Apparatus and a method for determining the position or state of a door
description: A method of estimating a precise position of a door by receiving data from a micro- electromechanical six-axis accelerometer, comprising at least the steps of: - applying the six-axis data to a symplectic geometry; - measuring each dynamic function as a linear combination of energy states in each axis; - differentiating to form six differentiations sets of six quantised states; -applying an unsupervised machine learning model including a fuzzy logic engine and outputting an estimate of the precise position of the door.

title: Performing interactive digital image operations utilizing modified machine learning models
description:
OF THE DISCLOSURE 
The present disclosure relates to systems, methods, and non-transitory computer 
readable media for performing interactive digital image editing operations utilizing machine 
learning models and a feature backpropagation refinement layer. For example, the disclosed 
systems perform interactive digital image editing operations by incorporating a feature 
backpropagation refinement layer within a non-interactive machine learning model that utilizes 
a consistency loss to adjust the feature backpropagation refinement layer according to one or 
more user interactions. In some embodiments, the disclosed systems utilize a feature 
backpropagation refinement layer that includes a bias sublayer for localizing changes to a 
digital image and a convolutional sublayer for channel-wise scale and feature combinations 
across channels. In some cases, the disclosed systems utilize a consistency loss that facilitates 
localized modifications to a digital image based on distances of various pixels or features from 
a user interaction.
