title: Systems and methods for pest pressure heat maps
description:
Systems and methods for generating and displaying heat maps are provided. A heat 
map generation computing device includes a memory and a processor. The processor 
is programmed to receive trap data for a plurality of pest traps in a geographic location, 
the trap data including current and historical pest pressure values at each of the plurality 
of pest traps, receive weather data for the geographic location, receive image data for 
the geographic location, apply a machine learning algorithm to generate predicted future 
pest pressure values at each of the plurality of pest traps, generate a first heat map for 
a first point in time and a second heat map for a second point in time, and transmit the 
first and second heat maps to a mobile computing device to cause a user interface on 
the mobile computing device to display a time lapse heat map.

title: Systems and methods for analyzing surgical videos
description: systems and methods for analyzing surgical videos. systems and methods for analyzing and reviewing surgical videos are disclosed. Systems and methods may include indexing characterized intraoperative surgical events, analyzing and cataloging surgical footage based on complexity, generating an intraoperative surgical event summary, overlaying a timeline on a surgical video, and/or generating a compilation of surgical event footage. The systems and methods may further include analyzing surgical videos to estimate surgical pressure, estimate a source and extent of fluid leak, detect a missed surgical event, predict a post-discharge risk for a patient, update a predicted outcome, provide real-time recommendations for a surgeon, determine insurance reimbursement, adjust an operating room schedule, and/or complete a post-operative report.

title: Neural network optimization device for edge device meeting on-demand instruction and method using the same
description: Disclosed is a neural network optimizing method performed by a device including performing a computation on an input value with a basic resource of a first neural network based on a customer-requested instruction for the basic resource used for computation execution of the first neural network, checking computational performance including a computational processing speed, a power consumption amount, and a chip area according to the computation execution of the first neural network, adjusting at least one of the basic resource based on the checked computational performance, and re-performing the computation on the input value based on the customer-requested instruction with a resource of the second neural network after changing to an environment of a second neural network by adjusting the at least one of the basic resource.

title: Hallucination Detection
description: A system and computer implemented method for detecting hallucination in output of a generative AI system. User input is received specifying a query or task relating to information contained in a data object. A first vector representation of the user input and a second vector representation of the data object are generated. The first and second vector representations are compared to identify parts of the data object which match the query or task. An input is generated for a generative AI system with the user input and the parts of the data object. The input is input to a generative AI system. An output produced by the generative AI system is analysed to determine if the output contains information also present in the data object. If not, an error process is initiated. If so, the output is produced by the generative AI system.

title: Method and system for automatic cook program determination
description: In variants, the method can include: sampling cavity measurements of the cook cavity; determining an image representation using the cavity measurements; determining a food class based on the image representation; optionally comparing the image representation to prior image representations; optionally determining a new food class based on the image representation; optionally updating a food identification module with the new food class; and optionally determining a cook program associated with the new food class.

title: Drilling framework
description: A system and method that include receiving data associated with a well at a field site. The system and method also include structuring the data as structured data according to an ontology of a computational knowledge system that is based at least in part on data from wells at other field sites. The system and method additionally include implementing the computational knowledge system to assess the structured data with respect to events. The system and method further include outputting an indicator of occurrence for at least one of the events for the well at the field site.

title: Degradation level prediction method and degradation level prediction system
description: A degradation level of a noise source is predicted by performing deep learning using frequency data indicating a vibration of the noise source during a time period and degradation data indicating degradation of the noise source during the predetermined period to determine a state estimation model. First vibration signals are measured at the noise point during a monitoring period. The first vibration signals are converted into a frequency domain, and the frequency domain converted first vibration signals are input into the state estimation model to estimate time series degradation data of degradation of the noise source during the monitoring period. A degradation prediction model is determined by deep learning using the time series degradation data. Degradation data indicating predicted degradation of the noise source during a prediction period are predicted via the degradation prediction model. A remaining useful life of the noise source may be calculated.

title: An adaptive judgment control method for sewage treatment process integrating knowledge transfer
description: The present invention proposes an adaptive critic control method for a sewage treatment process that integrates knowledge transfer, which is used to achieve accurate tracking of the dissolved oxygen concentration to the set value during the sewage treatment process. When realizing the optimization control of a sewage treatment system with an unknown model, the direct control strategy in the traditional adaptive critic control (ACC) algorithm is often sensitive to system disturbances, which may cause a sharp decline in control performance. The present invention simultaneously considers knowledge transfer and incremental control, and effectively improves the anti-interference performance by optimizing the control strategy of the conventional ACC algorithm to an incremental one. Secondly, knowledge transfer between different control methods is implemented with the help of the system's historical operating data, which successfully reduces the trial-and-error cost of the initial training of the present invention. Thirdly, a new utility function with a soft strategy constraint mechanism is designed to enhance the stability during the online optimization process. Finally, the effectiveness of the present invention is verified by experiments.

title: Fine tuning method and system supporting efficient processing of multi-tenant heterogeneous data
description: The invention discloses a fine tuning method and a system for supporting efficient processing of multi-tenant heterogeneous data, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the total number of cluster GPUs, a parallel strategy set, a data set submitted by multi-tenant fine tuning requests and a given model to be fine-tuned by multi-tenants, calculating the data duty ratio f  j  of a jth sub-bucket in data set distribution, generating a heterogeneous model deployment scheme after solving the optimal copy number of each parallel strategy based on the total number of the cluster GPUs, the data duty ratio f  j  of the jth sub-bucket in the data set distribution and the parallel strategy set, adjusting the boundaries of the sub-buckets according to the sequence length distribution of the training data for training data sampled randomly, generating an allocation scheme of the training data on different parallel strategies based on the sequence length distribution of the training data, and completing the iterative fine tuning of the given model based on the heterogeneous model deployment scheme based on the allocation scheme. The method and the device can effectively solve the problem of high-efficiency fine adjustment of multi-tenant heterogeneous data.

title: SSVEP electroencephalogram signal feature extraction and classification method, system, device and medium
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of electroencephalogram signal processing, and specifically to a method, system, device and medium for extracting and classifying SSVEP electroencephalogram signal features. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an SSVEP electroencephalogram signal, extracting spatial features through convolution processing to obtain spatial features, extracting time-frequency features to obtain reconstructed low-frequency features, adding the spatial features and the reconstructed low-frequency features to further obtain multi-scale time-frequency features, extracting local features through two-dimensional convolution processing to obtain local time-domain variation features, sequentially performing channel attention mechanism processing and spatial attention mechanism processing on the local time-domain variation features to obtain spatial enhancement features, sequentially performing deep convolution processing and separable convolution processing on the spatial enhancement features to obtain spatial domain fusion features, flattening processing and linear transformation processing on the spatial domain fusion features, and using a classification function to obtain an SSVEP electroencephalogram signal classification result, thereby improving the accuracy of SSVEP electroencephalogram signal classification across subjects.

title: Equipment operation and maintenance intelligent decision support system based on large model reasoning
description: The invention provides a device operation and maintenance intelligent decision support system based on large model reasoning, which aims to improve the accuracy of device fault prediction and the intelligent level of operation and maintenance decision. The system acquires equipment operation data in real time through a data acquisition module, performs reasoning analysis on the equipment health condition by utilizing a large-scale pre-trained deep learning model, and predicts the residual service life of the equipment and various fault types. The system combines multitask learning and a multitarget optimization algorithm to intelligently optimize operation and maintenance decisions, generates personalized maintenance suggestions, helps operation and maintenance personnel effectively reduce equipment downtime, lowers maintenance cost and prolongs equipment service life. The system can be widely applied to the fields of manufacturing industry, energy sources, traffic and the like, and the accuracy and the efficiency of equipment management are obviously improved.

title: Charging pile fault detection and diagnosis method, device and medium based on neural network
description: The invention relates to a method, a device and a medium for detecting and diagnosing a charging pile fault based on a neural network, and belongs to the field of charging fault detection. The method comprises the steps of collecting various fault characteristics of the charging pile, constructing corresponding sub-classifiers aiming at the various fault characteristics, performing evidence reasoning on the sub-classifiers which are weak classifiers for performing fault prediction based on the corresponding fault characteristics, and fusing output results of the sub-classifiers to obtain a final fault diagnosis result fused with the prediction diagnosis results of the sub-classifiers. The weak classifiers for carrying out fault analysis by applying fault characteristics of different modes are combined through evidence reasoning, the uncertainty and incomplete information can be well processed through the evidence reasoning, probability information can be processed, uncertainty wider than probability can be processed, information from different sub-classifiers can be effectively combined, and reasonable synthesis results can be given even if collision exists between evidences. There is some robustness to noise or errors of a single evidence source.

title: Space-time data stream type calculation method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The application provides a space-time data stream type calculation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a space-time data stream by preprocessing acquired space-time data; dynamically dividing a space-time window of a space-time data stream according to a preset time interval and a space range, determining target space-time data corresponding to a key space-time window in the space-time window, and detecting the abnormality of the target space-time data through an incremental graph algorithm. By implementing the scheme of the application, the obtained space-time data is preprocessed and divided into space-time windows, the key space-time data with important influence on analysis results is identified from the space-time data through a key window mechanism, unnecessary data redundancy is avoided, the scale of data processing and analysis is reduced, the calculation complexity is reduced, and the efficiency of the whole anomaly detection process is improved through screening and construction of a graph structure of the target space-time data.

title: Natural gas pipeline leakage probability calculation method and system based on genetic algorithm
description: The invention provides a natural gas pipeline leakage probability calculation method and a natural gas pipeline leakage probability calculation system based on a genetic algorithm, which relate to the technical field of probability calculation and comprise the steps of establishing a pipeline structure dynamic stress model, a material fatigue model and a corrosion damage model by collecting pipeline operation parameters, and (3) coupling analysis is carried out on the three models to obtain a risk assessment parameter matrix, a leakage risk assessment initial model is constructed to serve as an adaptability function, and a genetic algorithm is adopted to optimize the leakage probability calculation model. The invention can accurately predict the leakage risk of the pipeline, realize accurate assessment and early warning of the pipeline safety and improve the operation safety of the pipeline.

title: Long-term accumulation detection method for abnormal articles in charging station based on rising edge equipment
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of target detection, and particularly relates to a charging station abnormal article long-term accumulation detection method based on rising edge equipment. The method comprises the steps of constructing a general target detection model of the charging station, formulating a classification standard of target objects of the charging station, carrying out adaptation optimization on the general target detection model of the charging station on rising edge equipment to obtain a target detection model of the charging station adapting to the rising edge equipment, identifying targets by utilizing the target detection model of the charging station adapting to the rising edge equipment, classifying the identified targets according to the formulated classification standard of the target objects of the charging station, and judging abnormal objects accumulated in the charging station for a long time based on classification results. The invention realizes the accurate detection of the long-term accumulation of abnormal articles in the charging station and provides powerful support for the safety management of the charging station.

title: Based on blood source occupational exposure protection monitoring analysis system
description: The present invention relates to a blood-borne occupational exposure protection monitoring and analysis system, belonging to the field of protection monitoring technology. The system includes: a behavior warning module that warns according to the current medical staff behavior video frame through a behavior warning model; a data storage module that stores according to the current medical staff behavior video frame to obtain a medical staff behavior video sequence; a data preprocessing module that obtains a medical staff behavior video normalized optical flow frame through a data preprocessing model according to the medical staff behavior video sequence; a behavior classification module that classifies according to the medical staff behavior video normalized optical flow frame through a behavior classification model to obtain a medical staff behavior classification video optical flow frame; a behavior monitoring module that obtains an abnormal behavior video optical flow frame through an abnormal behavior monitoring model according to the medical staff behavior classification video optical flow frame. The blood-borne occupational exposure protection monitoring and analysis is realized, and the risk of blood-borne occupational exposure is reduced.

title: Hardware acceleration method and device for sparse matrix multiplication operation of convolutional neural layer
description: The invention discloses a hardware acceleration method and a device for sparse matrix multiplication operation for a convolutional neural layer, wherein non-0 elements can be quickly obtained from a sparse matrix through a constructed CSC coding module, the data storage space can be greatly compressed, meanwhile, a calculation unit is helped to only traverse the non-zero elements, the calculation time can be greatly reduced, and the cost is low.

title: Intelligent auxiliary system for electric power design enterprises based on knowledge base big data
description: The present invention relates to the field of electric power design, and provides an intelligent auxiliary system for electric power design enterprises based on knowledge base big data, comprising: receiving an electric power design scheme from a user end, determining an electric power dispatching state and an electric power design requirement; using a design function component representing the electric power dispatching state and a user trigger operation pre-configured from a user end as a call request for the design function component, and building a request call library for the design function component based on the preset knowledge base big data; configuring an auxiliary sandbox between the request call library and the user end, and converting the user trigger operation corresponding to the call request into an execution script of the user end through the auxiliary sandbox; generating a first simulation model of the current electric power design scheme in an electric power design program at the user end according to the execution script; generating an electric power design evaluation matrix, and judging whether there are design defects through the electric power design evaluation matrix, generating a target simulation model and electric power design data corresponding to the target simulation model.

title: Neural network training method for preparing high-coaxiality special vehicle axle, electronic equipment and readable storage medium
description: The invention discloses a neural network training method for preparing a high-coaxiality special vehicle axle, which comprises the steps of obtaining a test data training set and a simulation data training set as mixed training samples, establishing an initial neural network model, training the neural network model, obtaining a preassembly angle, guiding actual production, obtaining the high-coaxiality vehicle axle and the like. The invention utilizes the welding deformation which inevitably exists in the processing process, adopts the neural network training method, takes the mixed data as a training sample, realizes the pre-assembly angle prediction, further adjusts the pre-welding posture, directly obtains the high-coaxiality axle with the error of only 15-30 wires, reduces the difficulty and the cost for obtaining the training sample, can realize the accurate prediction of the pre-assembly angle, weakens the measurement of the welding deformation quantity, and is more beneficial to accurately guiding the production and obtaining the high-coaxiality axle.

title: Automatic calibrating device of multi-parameter monitor
description: The present invention discloses an automatic calibration device for a multi-parameter monitor, and relates to the technical field of calibration of medical monitoring equipment. The device comprises: an image acquisition device for acquiring monitor screen images and transmitting them to a host computer; a standard vital sign simulation device for simulating standard vital sign signals under the control of the host computer and transmitting them to the multi-parameter monitor to be calibrated; the host computer is used to control the standard vital sign simulation device to generate standard vital sign signals matching the items to be calibrated, and to control the image acquisition device to acquire the monitor screen images, and to detect and identify waveform parameters to determine whether the error between the detection value of the multi-parameter monitor and the output value of the standard vital sign simulation device is within a predetermined range. The present invention can efficiently and accurately extract and analyze monitor waveform parameters, and realizes the fully automatic operation of the calibration process.

title: Multichannel Raman spectrum analysis system for tumor marker detection
description: This invention belongs to the field of biomarker detection technology and discloses a multi-channel Raman spectroscopy analysis system for tumor biomarker detection, including a preprocessing module, an acquisition module, an enhancement module, an analysis module, and an output module. The preprocessing module is used to uniformly coat electromagnetic nanomaterials onto the surface of a target tissue slice. The acquisition module is used to acquire the Raman spectrum of the target tissue slice, and the Raman spectrum includes multiple Raman scattered light of different wavelengths. The enhancement module is used to convert the Raman spectrum acquired by the acquisition module into an electrical signal and to enhance the electrical signal. The analysis module is used to identify tumor biomarkers by analyzing the enhanced electrical signal. The output module is used to label the tumor biomarkers according to the identification results of the analysis module and to output a pathological image of the target tissue labeled with tumor biomarkers.

title: Cross-modal condition controllable retrieval method and system based on hybrid expert system
description: The invention discloses a cross-modal condition controllable retrieval method and system based on a hybrid expert system, and belongs to the technical field of image retrieval. The method comprises the steps of training a mixed expert system and a prompt word enhancement vector group based on a gating network by utilizing an image training data set with style labels and content labels and combining and comparing learning loss and prompt regularization loss, wherein the addition result of fusion characteristics output by the mixed expert system and corresponding prompt vectors in the prompt word enhancement vector group is used as an image embedded vector for similarity retrieval, the fusion characteristics output by the mixed expert system in the training stage are always weighted image characteristics, a retrieval mode is determined according to query texts input by a user in the retrieval stage, and image retrieval is carried out in different retrieval modes. The invention combines the advantages of text and image modes, can dynamically adjust the content and style retrieval weight, and enables the model to adaptively select the prompt related to the task based on a new prompt learning strategy, thereby flexibly adapting to different retrieval task requirements.

title: Multi-scale brightness perception-based polarized image fusion method and system
description: The invention discloses a polarized image fusion method and a polarized image fusion system based on multi-scale brightness perception, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a linear polarization degree image and an intensity image based on a Stokes vector method; and carrying out feature fusion processing on the linear polarization degree image and the intensity image based on the multi-scale brightness perception polarization image fusion network model to obtain a polarization fusion image. The invention can accurately extract the special target texture of linear polarization degree under the condition of complex brightness, maintain the details of the intensity image and improve the quality of the fused image. The method and the system for fusing the polarized images based on multi-scale brightness perception can be widely applied to the technical field of image fusion.

title: Self-driving vehicle remote control system and method in emergency
description: A system and a method for remotely controlling an autonomous vehicle in an emergency state are provided to monitor driving data and surrounding data of the autonomous vehicle and remotely control the autonomous vehicle in case the autonomous vehicle is in an emergency state in which the autonomous driving cannot be normally performed by grasping the state of the vehicle, thereby preventing an accident due to the autonomous vehicle by removing a factor which interferes with traffic flow. In addition, in the embodiment, the data communication efficiency between a server and the vehicle is improved to increase remote control safety, so that the autonomous vehicle can be remotely controlled more safely.

title: Method and system for estimating elevation angle of target drone in real-time using deep learning algorithm in multi channel
description: A method and system for real-time estimation of the altitude of a target drone using a deep learning algorithm in a multi-channel radar are presented. According to one embodiment, a method for real-time estimation of the altitude of a target drone performed by a system for real-time estimation of the altitude of a target drone using a deep learning algorithm in a multi-channel radar may include the steps of: generating a linear frequency modulation (LFM) signal in a transmitter and amplifying and outputting it by RF (Radio Frequency); receiving a signal reflected from a target in a detection area in response to a transmission signal output from the transmitter in a receiver with multiple polarizations; extracting a baseband I signal and Q signal using a beat signal extracted through mixing of the signal received from the receiver and the transmitter in an IQ demodulator; detecting a target drone through signal processing for the I signal and Q signal in a computation unit and generating input data for an identification unit for estimating the altitude of the target drone; and inputting the input data generated in the computation unit using a deep learning-based model learned in the identification unit to estimate the altitude of the target drone.

title: Method, computing device and computer program for providing a platform for sharing, renting, and selling personalized artificial intelligence models capable of generating revenue
description: A method, device, and computer program for providing a platform for sharing, renting, and selling personalized artificial intelligence models capable of generating revenue are provided. A method for providing a platform for sharing, renting, and selling personalized artificial intelligence models capable of generating revenue, according to various embodiments of the present invention, is a method performed by a computing device, comprising the steps of: obtaining from a user one or more conditional information about an artificial intelligence model to be shared, rented, or purchased; selecting an artificial intelligence model satisfying the one or more conditional information obtained from among a plurality of artificial intelligence models already registered in the platform; and providing the selected artificial intelligence model to the user.

title: The Method And System Of Automatic Cration Of No-code-based Backend API
description: The present invention relates to a method and a system for automatically generating a no-code-based backend API performed in a server system including one or more processors and one or more memories, and more specifically, to a method and a system for automatically generating a no-code-based backend API performed in a server system including one or more processors and one or more memories, which generate a data field through a macro-language model based on DB generation text input from a manager terminal, generate a DB and a server instance for a corresponding manager through a generation type AI based on the data field, and then automatically generate an API for the corresponding server instance.

title: Method and system for calculating car insurance fee using tire image
description: The present disclosure relates to a method and system for calculating automobile insurance premiums. Specifically, the method for calculating automobile insurance premiums may include a step of receiving a tire image in which a tire mounted on a vehicle is photographed, a step of extracting tire-related information based on the tire image, and a step of calculating automobile insurance premiums for the vehicle based on the tire-related information.

title: Method And Device for Model Training using Mahalanobis Distance-based Perceptual Loss
description: A method and device for training a model using perceptual loss based on Mahalanobis distance are disclosed.  According to one aspect of the present disclosure, a computer-implemented method for training an artificial intelligence model is provided, comprising: receiving a first image and a GT image for the first image; generating a second image from the first image using a first artificial intelligence model; extracting a first feature map and a second feature map from the GT image and the second image, respectively, using a pre-trained second artificial intelligence model; determining a first perceptual loss based on statistics for the first feature map and the second feature map; and updating parameters of the first artificial intelligence model based at least in part on the first perceptual loss.

title: Crack depth measurement method using a concrete crack mock-up sample
description: The present invention aims to obtain a plurality of crack samples by using a concrete crack simulation test body manufactured to be similar to an actual environment, machine-learn sample temperature information and crack depth extracted from the plurality of crack samples, machine-learn structure temperature information and structure environment information from a photographed image of the actual structure, and compare and analyze the information obtained by machine learning from the concrete crack simulation test body and the information obtained by machine learning from the actual structure, thereby accurately calculating and measuring the crack depth of the actual structure.

title: Board inspection method
description: The present invention relates to a technology for performing a learning-based inspection using a learning model on an inspection image determined to be defective in a rule-based inspection, and minimizing the false defect rate by excluding inspection items with a high false detection rate in the learning-based inspection from the learning-based inspection.  The substrate inspection method according to the present invention is characterized by comprising a first step in which a substrate inspection device sets an inspection item whose false detection rate in a learning-based inspection is higher than a reference value as an exclusion target for learning-based inspection, a second step in which a rule-based inspection is performed on an inspection image of a substrate to be inspected, and a third step in which, when the rule-based inspection result is determined to be defective, a learning-based inspection using an inspection image is performed on an inspection item that is not set as an exclusion target for learning-based inspection.

title: Method for predicting abnormal condition of ultra-low sample equipment using deep learning
description: The present invention relates to a method for predicting an abnormal state of ultra-low temperature sample equipment using deep learning. The method for predicting an abnormal state according to the present invention includes the steps of collecting data measured in real time in the past for a storage container having a sample storage rack stored therein, a step of training a prediction model using, among the collected data, the internal temperature of the storage container, the type of refrigerant, the level of the refrigerant, the volume of the storage container, the volume occupied by the sample storage rack in the storage container, the number of times the storage container lid is opened, the exposure time, the vacuum pressure, the refrigerant supply cycle, the amount of refrigerant supplied, and the temperature of the refrigerant supplied as input data and the occurrence of an abnormal state as output data, and a step of predicting in advance the occurrence of an abnormal state by applying the internal temperature of the storage container to be measured, the type of refrigerant, the change in the level of the refrigerant, the volume of the storage container, the volume occupied by the sample storage rack in the storage container, the number of times the storage container lid is opened, the exposure time, the vacuum pressure, the refrigerant supply cycle, the amount of refrigerant supplied, and the temperature of the refrigerant supplied to the prediction model.  According to the present invention, a prediction model is learned through deep learning based on past big data, and by applying real-time measured data from ultra-low temperature sample equipment to the learned prediction model, abnormalities and failure states of ultra-low temperature sample equipment can be predicted in advance, and advance notification and maintenance are enabled before an abnormal state occurs.

title: Vehicle type recognition method and device, storage medium and electronic device
description: Disclosed are a vehicle type recognition method and device, a storage medium and an electronic device. The method comprises: acquiring a request to recognise a vehicle type of a vehicle in a target image; using a pre-set neural network model to recognise the vehicle in the target image as a target vehicle type, wherein the pre-set neural network model is obtained by training a deep convolutional neural network model for performing vehicle type recognition using a training set, the training set is an image set obtained by performing first pre-processing on images of a plurality of vehicle types, the first pre-processing is used for enhancing the robustness of the pre-set neural network model, and the plurality of vehicle types comprising the target vehicle type; and in response to the request, returning a recognition result comprising the target vehicle type. The present application solves the technical problem in the prior art of low accuracy when performing vehicle type recognition.

title: Operation assistance system and method
description: This operation assistance system receives a selection of a first procedure included in a procedure manual that includes a plurality of procedures relating to operation of an object to be operated. The operation assistance system then displays: an abstract structure obtained by structuring a second abstract procedure that is included in a first abstract procedure corresponding to the first procedure; and an estimated structure obtained on the basis of the selected first procedure by structuring at least a portion of the first procedure.

title: PROBABILISTIC PREDICTION OF OIL PRODUCTION
description: The present invention relates to a method of receiving historical well production data and determining curve parameters based on historical well production data. The determination of the curve parameters includes taking into account the uncertainty. The method also includes determining curve matches for the historical data based on the curve parameters using a plurality of models, calculating the accuracy of each of the models based on a comparison of curve with the well production data, to compare the accuracy of each model using an information criterion that takes into account the uncertainty, to select one of the models on the basis of the comparison, and determining an estimated final recovery (EUR) for the well using at least the model selected from the models.

title: Electronic device, image processing method, and computer-readable recording medium
description: An electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device of the present disclosure comprises: a memory in which a learned artificial intelligence model is stored; and a processor for inputting an input image to the artificial intelligence model and outputting an enlarged image with increased resolution, wherein the learned artificial intelligence model includes an upscaling module for acquiring the pixel values of interpolated pixels around a cell according to a function having a non-linearly decreasing symmetric form with reference to an original pixel in the enlarged image, the original pixel corresponding to a pixel of the input image.

title: Image feature learning device, image feature learning method, image feature extraction device, image feature extraction method, and program
description: The purpose of the present invention is to enable learning of a neural network for extracting features of images having high robustness from an undiscriminating image region while minimizing the number of parameters of a pooling layer. A parameter learning unit 130 learns parameters of each layer in a convolutional neural network formed by including a fully convolution layer for performing convolution of an input image to output a feature tensor of the input image, a weighting matrix estimation layer for estimating a weighting matrix indicating a weighting of each element of the feature tensor, and a pooling layer for extracting a feature vector of the input image on the basis of the feature tensor and the weighting matrix. The parameter learning unit 130 learns the parameters such that a loss function value obtained by calculating a loss function expressed by using a distance between a first feature vector of a first image and a second feature vector of a second image which are relevant images and are obtained by applying the convolutional neural network.

title: Computer-implemented method, apparatus, and computer-program product
description: A computer-implemented method using a convolutional neural network is provided. The computer-implemented method using a convolutional neural network includes processing an input image through at least one channel of the convolutional neural network to generate an output image including content features of the input image morphed with style features of a reference style image. The at least one channel includes a down-sampling segment, a densely connected segment, and an up-sampling segment sequentially connected together. Processing the input image through the at least one channel of the convolutional neural network includes processing an input signal through the down-sampling segment to generate a down-sampling segment output; processing the down-sampling segment output through the densely connected segment to generate a densely connected segment output; and processing the densely connected segment output through the up-sampling segment to generate an up-sampling segment output. The input signal includes a component of the input image.

title: Inference microscopy
description: The invention relates to a method (1300) and a device (100) for optimizing workflows for at least one microscope or microscope system (210; 330, 350; 500; 1050; 1212, 1214, 1216). The prior art solutions have the drawback that workflows can be optimized only with great effort. The method (1300) of the invention and the device (100) of the invention improve prior art solutions by means of the following steps: a) having one or more components (260, 270) of at least one microscope and/or microscope system (210; 330, 350; 500; 1050;1212, 1214, 1216) execute (1310) a workflow involving acquiring first data (510, 520); b) applying (1330) a trained model (420, 430, 440; 530; 1220) to the acquired first data (510, 520); and c) making (1340) at least one decision in respect of the workflow on the basis of the application of the trained model (420, 430, 440; 530; 1220).

title: Modeling textural parameters of a formation with downhole measurements
description: A method includes obtaining a dielectric measurement of a downhole formation (902). The method also includes processing the dielectric measurement via a trained machine learning system (904). The method further includes determining water saturation and at least one classification or textural parameter of the downhole formation, via the machine learning system, based at least in part on the dielectric measurement (906). The method includes assigning water saturation and at least one of the classification or the textural parameter to the downhole formation (908).

title: Systems and methods for determining recommended locations
description: A method for determining a recommended location may include identifying a candidate location based on historical order data of a plurality of historical passengers (510); obtaining a plurality of images showing sights around the candidate location, wherein the plurality of images are captured by at least one vehicle recorder (520); determining an identification result as to whether a road element is present around the candidate location based on the plurality of images (530); and determining whether the candidate location is a recommended location based on the identification result (540).

title: A method and a system for estimating the impact area of a military load launched from an aircraft
description: A system and a method are for the estimation of the impact area of a smart load that can be launched from an aircraft as a function of data or signals indicative of the aircraft flight conditions upon release of the load and of predetermined impact conditions on the target. The estimation of a polygonal impact area defined by the coordinates of a central point and of a predetermined number of vertices is by corresponding neural networks.

title: Model training methods, model training devices, electronic devices, and storage media
description: This disclosure provides a model training method, a model training apparatus, an electronic device, and a storage medium. The method is applied to a multi-chip unit accelerator card, which includes multiple chip units integrated in a single package. The model includes a converter decoding layer. The method includes: training the converter decoding layer using a hybrid parallel strategy; during the forward and backward propagation of the converter decoding layer, distributing the activation values processed by the multi-chip unit accelerator card to the multiple chip units according to a first arrangement, and distributing the weights processed by the multi-chip unit accelerator card to the multiple chip units according to a second arrangement. This method significantly improves the training performance of large models on multi-chip unit accelerator cards without increasing inter-chip unit accelerator card communication overhead or memory resource consumption.

title: A building crack identification and structural safety analysis system
description: This invention discloses a building crack identification and structural safety analysis system, relating to the field of structural safety analysis. The system includes: acquiring historical structural change information of a target building through multi-source information collection; constructing a structural change risk knowledge graph and, based on the historical structural change information, inferring the location of potential cracks in the target building and generating a list of collection locations; feeding back the list of collection locations to the user terminal to guide image acquisition and obtain building image acquisition results; combining the image acquisition results with the historical structural change information to construct a simulation analysis model of the target building and perform crack inversion analysis; and calculating the structural safety coefficient of the target building based on the crack inversion analysis results and generating a safety analysis report. This invention, through its structural safety analysis system, solves the problems of insufficient structural safety information and the difficulty in achieving accurate and comprehensive structural safety analysis.

title: Multi-mode entity linking method integrating vision and text feature enhancement
description: A multimodal entity linking method integrating visual and textual feature enhancements is proposed. Taking images and text as input, a bidirectional feature pyramid fusion strategy is used to combine low-level high-resolution images with high-level semantically strong images to enhance image features. Phrase-level features of the text are extracted using a convolutional neural network and fused with character-level features obtained from the encoder to form the text input. A bottleneck fusion network is used to filter noise in the embedded vectors, improving the model's fusion efficiency. Then, text and visual vectors are fused to form a multimodal fusion vector. Finally, entity mentions are linked to the highest-scoring candidate entity in the knowledge base based on matching scores. This invention effectively reduces noise in existing model text and image vectors, retains key information such as text and visual features, aligns feature dimensions, bridges the semantic gap between text and image vectors, facilitates subsequent multimodal fusion, and improves the overall performance of entity linking.

title: An advertising review method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium
description: This application provides an advertising review method, apparatus, electronic device, and storage medium, relating to the field of content review technology. One advertising review method includes: receiving target advertising data; identifying target media that require review of the target advertising data; obtaining a target model call process and target prompts set for the content review requirements of the target media, required for advertising content classification; based on the target prompts, performing a large model call process on the target advertising data according to the target model call process to analyze and process advertising content classification; and determining the classification result of the target advertising data for the target media based on the processing result of the analysis and processing. Therefore, this solution can balance the accuracy of advertising review with the personalized review needs of advertising media.

title: Multi-task medical image segmentation and classification method and device based on task dependency closed-loop mechanism
description: This invention discloses a multi-task medical image segmentation and classification method and apparatus based on a task-dependent closed-loop mechanism, relating to the fields of artificial intelligence and medical image processing technology. The method includes: acquiring raw medical image data and preprocessing it; obtaining standardized images and inputting them into a multi-expert sub-network encoder for processing; outputting a multi-level, multi-channel feature set; inputting this set into a self-attention gating module; calculating the fusion weights of different expert features for different tasks; generating segmentation and classification results through task-specific nonlinear transformations; constructing a task-dependent closed-loop interaction mechanism, using the segmentation results as spatial priors to guide the classification task, and simultaneously using the classification results as semantic constraints to inversely optimize the segmentation task; dynamically adjusting the information flow path of the classification task based on the confidence level of the segmentation results; and outputting a segmentation mask and classification results. This invention achieves synergistic enhancement of segmentation and classification tasks, improving overall classification accuracy and robustness.

title: A three-dimensional lung ventilation electrical impedance imaging method and system
description: A three-dimensional lung ventilation electrical impedance imaging method and system, belonging to the field of electrical impedance imaging technology, is disclosed. The method includes: obtaining denoised voltage measurements using a residual denoising network; feeding random input signals into a dual-output neural network with an encoder and a decoder, where the encoder output has a fully connected branch to output latent variables, which are then used by a lung mask generator to generate a lung mask as a prior for the generative model; the decoder generating lung ventilation images, with the dual-output network structure itself providing implicit regularization; and using an image reconstruction loss function that includes a data consistency term and a lung shape loss term, based on the denoised voltage measurements, the lung shape mask, and the estimated boundary voltage, optimizing the dual-output neural network parameters through minimum iteration of the reconstruction loss function to reconstruct images for each instance in an unsupervised manner. This method improves the robustness and generalization performance of lung ventilation imaging and enhances image quality.

title: Training methods and apparatus for graph classification models
description: This specification provides a training method and apparatus for a graph classification model, comprising: obtaining descriptive text corresponding to target nodes in a target subgraph, wherein the node information description in the descriptive text includes special words indicating the target node and its neighboring nodes; performing graph embedding processing on the target subgraph using a graph neural network to obtain node representations corresponding to the target node and its neighboring nodes respectively; inputting the descriptive text and node representations into a target large model, causing the model to encode each word in the descriptive text, and adding each node representation to the position of the special word indicating the corresponding node to obtain a text representation; and performing a first response prediction based on the text representation; calculating a first loss based on the first probability of each first label word in the first label word sequence in the first response prediction; and updating the parameters of the graph neural network and the target large model according to the comprehensive loss, wherein the comprehensive loss includes the first loss.

title: AI-driven intelligent design and prediction system for orthodontic treatment plans
description: This invention relates to the fields of medical information technology and artificial intelligence, providing an AI-driven intelligent design and prediction system for orthodontic treatment plans. The system includes an oral data acquisition module, an intelligent planning module, a biomechanical simulation module, a plan optimization module, and a prediction generation module. The system generates a set of candidate movement plans through deep reinforcement learning algorithms, verifies the safety of the plans through biomechanical simulation, selects the optimal plan through multi-objective collaborative optimization, and generates a predictive 3D oral model. This invention significantly improves the personalization level and clinical safety of orthodontic plans, achieving multi-objective optimization of occlusal relationships, aesthetic effects, and treatment cycle, providing an intelligent solution for complex malocclusions.

title: Automatic matching method for automobile wire harness process rules based on knowledge graph
description: The invention discloses an automatic matching method of automobile wire harness process rules based on a knowledge graph, which comprises the following steps of collecting wire harness design data, carrying out standardized processing, analyzing a process rule base, extracting key attribute fields and generating a process rule metadata set, carrying out semantic modeling and structural fusion to construct the process knowledge graph, carrying out semantic association analysis, causal constraint fusion and feasibility judgment processing by utilizing a semantic retrieval enhancement module, carrying out provable retrieval, risk assessment and conflict resolution on the basis of a candidate process rule set, converting the target process rule set into a process instruction, driving a design system to synchronously update and rule label, updating the process knowledge graph on the basis of system feedback data, and outputting an optimized process verification report and an updated design version. The intelligent matching method based on the knowledge graph and semantic causal fusion technology realizes intelligent matching of the wire harness process rules, and has the advantages of high matching precision, strong interpretability and self-adaptive optimization capability.

title: Method for predicting erosion rate of marine oil and gas exploration well control manifold
description: The invention discloses a marine oil and gas exploration well control manifold erosion rate prediction method which comprises the steps of constructing a support vector machine model, wherein input parameters of the support vector machine model comprise manifold diameter, manifold bending angle, fluid speed, fluid density and fluid viscosity, output parameters of the support vector machine are maximum erosion rate of a well control manifold, a genetic algorithm is adopted to optimize penalty function coefficients and kernel function parameters of the support vector machine model to obtain an optimized support vector machine model, the optimized support vector machine model is trained to obtain a well control manifold erosion rate prediction model, the manifold diameter, manifold bending angle, fluid speed, fluid density and fluid viscosity of the well control manifold to be predicted are obtained, and the maximum erosion rate of the well control manifold to be predicted is obtained by inputting the support vector machine model into the well control manifold erosion rate prediction model. The well control manifold erosion rate prediction method provided by the invention can accurately predict the maximum erosion rate of the well control manifold.

title: A Dual-Mode Target Detection Method for UAVs in Open-Pit Mines
description: This invention discloses a dual-modal target detection method for UAVs in open-pit mines, relating to the field of target detection. The method includes acquiring dual-modal input data of an open-pit mine scene, comprising visible light RGB images and thermal infrared IR images; constructing a target detection model, which includes a dual-modal feature extraction backbone network, an attribute alignment and prototype-guided comparison module, a deformable cross-attention alignment module, a cross-modal feature modulation and dynamic fusion module, a feature pyramid network, and a detection head; inputting the dual-modal input data into the target detection model to obtain the dual-modal target detection results for UAVs in open-pit mines. By constructing a progressive collaborative alignment and fusion framework, the method resolves the semantic gap and spatial misalignment between visible light and infrared modalities, achieving adaptive feature fusion.

title: Multi-stage electronic medical record generation method and system based on structured thinking chain
description: This invention provides a multi-stage electronic medical record generation method and system based on a structured thinking chain, relating to the field of computer data processing technology. The method includes: generating at least one intermediate draft state of the medical record based on input raw medical data through a structured thinking chain processing flow. This intermediate draft state contains at least one specific assertion to be verified. A dual-path knowledge calibration mechanism is initiated to calibrate the intermediate draft state. The calibration includes: a forward knowledge enhancement path: responding to the specific assertion by retrieving relevant evidence from one or more authoritative knowledge bases; and a backward fact-checking path: using a small inference model to perform a consistency judgment on the specific assertion and relevant evidence. Based on the consistency judgment result, the intermediate draft state is corrected to generate a calibrated electronic medical record. This invention improves factual accuracy and credibility, ensuring structural integrity and logical consistency.

title: Instruction set strategy dynamic distribution method based on RPA
description: This invention discloses a dynamic instruction distribution method based on RPA, comprising the following steps: training a model using an AI analysis module, collecting instructions and extracting instruction features, inputting instruction processing system status data and instruction features into the trained model, and outputting the predicted value of the instruction; when a single instruction is issued, the server in the instruction processing system issues the instruction to the client, determines and modifies the instruction priority in real time by combining a weighted comprehensive score with the instruction prediction value, and adds the instruction to the instruction issuance queue; the client executes instructions according to the instruction priority order in the instruction issuance queue; when a higher priority instruction arrives, the current task is interrupted and reordered for execution; after the client finishes executing the instruction, the execution result is added to the instruction reporting queue for reporting. This invention realizes intelligent generation and dynamic adjustment of instruction distribution strategies through the instruction processing system, optimizes resource allocation, and improves system response speed and processing capacity.

title: Multilayer vertical and horizontal federation generation countermeasure network data enhancement method
description: This invention discloses a multi-layered, horizontally federated generative adversarial network (GAN) data augmentation method, belonging to the field of data augmentation technology. It generates high-quality image data and expands the training dataset through multi-client collaborative use of the GAN, while reducing local computational resource consumption, thus achieving data augmentation for downstream training tasks. Under a client-middle-layer server-top-layer server hierarchical architecture, a data augmentation method that balances image generation quality and training stability is constructed. This method reduces data transmission between clients and middle-layer servers through client-local training and a federated learning mechanism combining horizontal and vertical layers, enhances the detail consistency of generated data using perceptual loss, introduces gradient penalty to improve adversarial training stability, and balances the contributions of each client through dynamic weight allocation.

title: A method and system for guiding group opinions based on global perception
description: The invention provides a group opinion guiding method and system based on global perception, wherein the method comprises the steps of (S1) constructing a multi-agent opinion dynamics model, initializing system parameters and agent attributes, (S2) dynamically constructing a social network structure based on viewpoint homogeneity according to the current opinion difference among agents, (S3) calculating local social influence suffered by each agent according to instantaneous network topology, and (S4) introducing an intensity coefficient And saturation coefficient The intervention global perception, the size of which has a nonlinear function relation with the group average opinion, (S5) the local influence and the global perception effect are synthesized, the opinion states of all the intelligent agents are updated through numerical integration, (S6) the opinion states of all the intelligent agents are updated through the adjustment of parameters The active induction system changes phase from opinion polarization state to unilateral excitation state. The invention overcomes the technical defect that the polarization steady state is difficult to break by the existing model by constructing and intervening the global perception, and provides a quantifiable and predictable computing framework for public opinion guidance.

title: Multi-scale feature fusion laser radar single wood segmentation method
description: This invention discloses a multi-scale feature fusion-based lidar tree segmentation method, belonging to the field of lidar remote sensing forestry resource survey technology. The method includes: point cloud data preprocessing and multi-scale adaptive sampling, combining geometric distance and intensity information for joint denoising, and adjusting sampling parameters according to stand density; multi-scale feature extraction and cross-scale correlation, extracting local, morphological, global, and cross-scale correlation features; dynamic attention feature fusion and enhancement, constructing a feature pyramid; density peak clustering and initial segmentation, adaptively adjusting clustering parameters, selecting core points and aggregating neighboring points; segmentation result optimization and morphological constraints, optimizing boundaries through curvature adjustment, ellipse fitting, and closure operations, and correcting abnormal units through morphological verification. This invention improves the accuracy and morphological conformity of tree segmentation, dynamically adapting to different stand densities and point cloud conditions; it is suitable for diverse scenarios ranging from low-density pure forests to high-density mixed forests.

title: Intelligent diagnostic and treatment terminals embedded with the DIKWP engine and their proactive health management methods
description: This invention discloses an intelligent diagnostic and treatment terminal embedded with a DIKWP engine and its proactive health management method. The terminal integrates multiple physiological signal acquisition modules, a voice interaction and touch display interface, and a local DIKWP semantic reasoning engine module. It can autonomously acquire health data in real time, construct semantic graphs, and perform local reasoning analysis at the edge, outputting personalized health suggestions or intervention plans based on the patient's preset health intentions. The terminal also features anomaly detection and early warning, local data storage and cloud synchronization, semantic interpretation output, and continuous feedback learning functions, forming a proactive diagnostic and treatment closed loop from data acquisition to suggestion output. Compared with existing technologies, this invention can provide intelligent, personalized, and interpretable diagnostic and treatment services in an offline environment, improving the timeliness and targeting of health management in home and primary healthcare settings.

title: A database migration method, apparatus, device, and medium based on AI assistance
description: The invention provides a database migration method, device, equipment and medium based on AI assistance, belonging to the technical field of data migration, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating migration prediction results according to characteristic information of a source database and a target database based on a pre-trained migration knowledge graph model; based on the minimized shutdown time, the data loss and the migration cost as optimization targets, generating an optimal migration strategy according to a migration prediction result, monitoring a data playback state while starting to execute a data migration task according to the optimal migration strategy, adjusting migration parameters of the data migration task according to the monitoring result, predicting optimal switching time according to the monitoring result, evaluating a rollback risk, and adjusting an execution state of the data migration task according to the evaluation result. The database migration process is intelligent, self-adaptive and highly reliable, and the migration efficiency and success rate are remarkably improved.

title: Emotionally supportive dialogue methods, devices, systems, and storage media
description: The invention provides an emotion support dialogue method, device, system and storage medium, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence and comprise the following steps of S1, receiving user input information, obtaining user description about work, life, family or social problems, S2, analyzing the user problems through a thinking chain based on the description, identifying deep causes and cognition distortion types which cause dilemma, S3, feeding back the thinking chain analysis results to an intelligent therapist, generating an inverse logic solution for cognition distortion and definitely indicating the existing thinking error area, S4, receiving user feedback, adjusting response content in real time, optimizing subsequent dialogue generation, S5, adopting an independent scoring model to carry out multi-dimensional scoring on candidate responses, S6, maintaining psychological health of the user, and matching treatment thought aiming at different cognition problems, so that emotion support is changed from general comfort to accurate cognition deviation solution to actually help the user adjust unreasonable thinking, and improve psychological state.

title: Interatomic potentials for scalable augmented Hamiltonians based on charge transfer machine learning
description: Methods of a machine learning network for training and subsequently executing one or more Machine Learning (ML) models are disclosed. The systems described herein are configured to embed atomic positions and species of a given atomic system and apply them to the ML model(s) to learn charge transfer properties and local energies. By constructing atomic charges from the learned charge transfer properties, local and global charge neutrality is ensured. The atomic charge is then used to generate an auxiliary hamiltonian description. By combining the auxiliary hamiltonian description and the learned local energy, attributes such as the total energy of the atomic system are determined. By determining the total energy from the auxiliary hamiltonian description and learned local energy, such an approach ensures that long-range and short-range effects are accounted for while also properly achieving true discontinuities and/or transitions within the potential energy surface.

title: Image decoding method and apparatus based on neural network, image encoding method and apparatus based on neural network, and device thereof
description: Provided in the present disclosure are an image decoding method and apparatus based on a neural network, an image encoding method and apparatus based on a neural network, and a device thereof. The image decoding method comprises: decoding, from a code stream, a control parameter and image information, which correspond to the current block; acquiring, from the control parameter, neural network information corresponding to a decoding processing unit, and on the basis of the neural network information, generating a decoding neural network corresponding to the decoding processing unit; and on the basis of the image information, determining an input feature corresponding to the decoding processing unit, and processing the input feature on the basis of the decoding neural network, so as to obtain an output feature corresponding to the decoding processing unit. By means of the present disclosure, the encoding performance and the decoding performance can be improved.

title: 3-dimensional representations of post-contrast enhanced brain lesions
description:
Methods, apparatuses, systems, and implementations for creating 3-dimensional (3D) 
representations exhibiting geometric and surface characteristics of post-contrast brain lesions 
are disclosed. 3D MRI images of the brain may be created and acquired. After 
5 administration of a contrast substance, brain lesions and other abnormalities may be 
identified and isolated from the 3D MRI images, with each lesion serving as a region of 
interest (ROI). 3D region of contrast enhancement images may be created from segmented 
3D MRI images and different regions of contrast enhancement of the brain lesion may be 
depicted. Saved regions of contrast enhancement may be converted into stereolithography 
10 format, maximum intensity projection (MIP) images, and/or orthographic projection images.  
Data corresponding to these resulting 3D region of contrast enhancement images may be used 
to create 3D printed models of the isolated region of contrast enhancement using 3D printing 
technology. Analysis of the 3D brain region of contrast enhancement images and the 3D 
printed region of contrast enhancement models may enable a more efficient and accurate way 
15 of determining brain lesion risk factors and effective treatment regimens.

title: Training a multi-label classifier
description: The technology disclosed includes a system to perform multi-label support vector machine (SVM) classification of a document. The system creates document features representing frequencies or semantics of words in the document. Trained SVM classification parameters for a plurality of labels are applied to the document features for the document. The system determines positive and negative distances between SVM hyperplanes for the labels and the feature vector. Labels with positive distance to the feature vector are harvested. When the distribution of negative distances is characterized by a mean and standard deviation, the system further harvests the labels with a negative distance such that the harvested labels include the labels with a negative distance between the mean negative distance and zero and separated from the mean negative distance by a predetermined first number of standard deviations.

title: Online adaptation of segmentation machine learning systems
description: Techniques and systems are provided for performing online adaptation of machine learning model(s). For example, a process may include obtaining features extracted from a image by a machine learning model during inference and determining, by the machine learning model based on the features during inference, a plurality of keypoint estimates in the image and/or a bounding region estimate associated with an object in the image. The process may further include generating pseudo-label(s) based on the plurality of keypoint estimates and/or the bounding region estimate. The process may include determining at least one self-supervised loss based on the plurality of keypoint estimates and/or the bounding region estimate. The process may further include adapting, based on the at least one self-supervised loss, parameter(s) of the machine learning model. The process may include generating, using the machine learning model with the adapted parameter(s), a segmentation mask for the image (or another image).

title: Systems and methods for deriving and optimizing classifiers from multiple datasets
description: Systems and methods for subject clinical condition evaluation using a plurality of modules are provided. Modules comprise features whose corresponding feature values associate with an absence, presence or stage of phenotypes associated with the clinical condition. A first dataset is obtained having feature values, acquired through a first technical background from respective subjects in transcriptomic, proteomic, or metabolomic form, for at least a first of the plurality of modules. A second training dataset is obtained having feature values, acquired through a technical background other than the first technical background, from training subjects of the second dataset, in the same form as for the first dataset, of at least the first module. Inter-dataset batch effects are removed by co-normalizing feature values across the training datasets, thereby calculating co-normalized feature values used to train a classifier for clinical condition evaluation of the test subject.

title: Distance to obstacle detection in autonomous machine applications
description: In various examples, a deep neural network (DNN) is trained to accurately predict, in deployment, distances to objects and obstacles using image data alone. The DNN may be trained with ground truth data that is generated and encoded using sensor data from any number of depth predicting sensors, such as, without limitation, RADAR sensors, LIDAR sensors, and/or SONAR sensors. Camera adaptation algorithms may be used in various embodiments to adapt the DNN for use with image data generated by cameras with varying parameters—such as varying fields of view. In some examples, a post-processing safety bounds operation may be executed on the predictions of the DNN to ensure that the predictions fall within a safety-permissible range.

title: Systems and methods for soil mapping
description: Systems and methods for training a soil mapping model are provided, as well as systems and methods for generating soil maps with such trained soil mapping models. The soil mapping models predict soil characteristics (e.g. carbon content) across an area of interest. The training method can involve refining the parameters of a soil map model by estimating the soil mapping model's uncertainty at various locations across an area of interest, selecting relatively high-uncertainty areas, identifying sampling locations within those areas for further samples to be collected, and further training the parameters of the soil mapping model based on the newly-collected samples.

title: Information processing system, material composition search method, material composition search device, and program
description: An information processing system includes an annealing computing device, and a search device that converts a combinatorial optimization problem of a material composition asymptotically approaching a target physical property value into an Ising model and causes the computing device to solve the combinatorial optimization problem. The system receives a target value and a tolerable variation range of a physical property, converts a mathematical expression that formulates a combinatorial optimization problem of a material composition that asymptotically approaches the target value from a mixed material of materials having known physical property values, into the Ising model in a data format usable by the computing device, computes an optimum solution of the material composition asymptotically approaching the target value, using the Ising model, and excludes the materials included in the mixed material, from the material composition of the optimum solution computed, within the tolerable variation range, and outputs the material composition.

title: Building annotated models based on eyes-off data
description: Systems and methods are directed to building annotated models based on eyes-off data. Specifically, a synthetic data generation model is trained and used to further train a target model. The synthetic data generation model is trained within an eyes-off environment using an anonymity technique on confidential data. The synthetic data generation model is then used to create synthetic data that closely represents the confidential data but without any specific details that can be linked back to the confidential data. The synthetic data is then annotated and used to train the target model within an eyes-on environment. Subsequently, the target model is deployed back within the eyes-off environment to classify the confidential data.

title: Information processing method, program, and information processing device
description: An information processing method includes acquiring an evaluation result that indicates whether an estimation result of a learning model for a first evaluation image is correct or incorrect based on first evaluation data including data of at least one first evaluation image and correct answer data for the first evaluation image. The information processing method includes executing identification processing in which a feature of an image that is likely to cause the estimation result of the learning model to be incorrect is identified based on the evaluation result.

title: Ecosystem for Prediction and/or Prevention of Loss
description: The following relates generally to a home ecosystem and home ecosystem app. In some embodiments, one or more processors: (1) receive data from a plurality of data sources, the plurality of data sources including: smart home devices, a weather database, an insurance company, a real estate & property data company, artificial intelligence (AI) company, an electrical data company, a security company, and/or a property risk data company; (2) predict, based upon the received data from the plurality of data sources, that an event will occur that will damage an insured asset; and/or (3) initiate an action based upon the prediction that the event will occur.

title: Method for making an electronic device with superconductor qubit(s) including at least one jofet
Prediction apparatus, learning apparatus, prediction method, learning method and program
