description: Provided is a prediction apparatus including a feature extraction unit configured to extract a feature based on past behavior series data of a prediction target and output behavior feature data, a behavior series prediction unit configured to predict a future behavior series of the prediction target based on the behavior feature data using a trained behavior series prediction model for predicting a behavior series, and a mood series prediction unit configured to predict a future mood series of the prediction target based on the behavior feature data and past mood series data of the prediction target using a trained mood series prediction model for predicting a mood series.

title: Image processing method, video processing method and processing apparatus
description: An image processing method and apparatus, a device, a video processing method and a storage medium are provided. The image processing method includes: receiving an input image; and processing the input image by using the convolutional neural network to obtain an output image. A definition of the output image is higher than a definition of the input image. Processing the input image by using the convolutional neural network to obtain the output image includes: performing feature extraction on the input image; concatenating the input image and the plurality of first images; performing the feature extraction on the first image group; fusing the plurality of second images and the plurality of first images; concatenating the input image and the plurality of third images to obtain a second image group; and performing the feature extraction on the second image group to obtain the output image.

title: System and ensemble method for unbiased synthetic time series generation leveraging contrastive learning between generative modeling and probabilistic modeling
description: One example method includes collecting real data, creating synthetic data by modeling the real data, augmenting the real data and the synthetic data, applying a loss function to minimize an error between the real data and the synthetic data, adding noise to the synthetic data to create finalized synthetic data, and generating a forecast based on the finalized synthetic data. The forecast may be used as a basis to guide the performance of a resource allocation process.

title: Closed-Loop Intelligence
description: Methods, computer systems, and computer-storage medium are provided for providing closed-loop intelligence. A selection of data is received, at a cloud service, from a database comprising data from a plurality of sources in a Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) format to build a data model. After a feature vector corresponding to the data model is extracted, a selection of an algorithm for a machine learning model to apply to the data model is received. A portion of the selection of data is utilized for training data and test data and the machine learning model is applied to the training data. Once the model is trained, the trained machine learning model can be saved at the cloud service, where it may be accessed by others.

title: Event-driven architecture for interactive systems and applications
description: In various examples, an interactive agent platform that hosts an interactive agent may represent and/or communicate human-machine interactions and related events using a standardized interaction modeling API and/or an event-driven architecture. In an example implementation, a standardized interaction modeling API serves as a common protocol in which components use a standardized interaction categorization schema to represent all activities by agents and users as actions in a standardized form, represent states of multimodal actions from users and agents as events in a standardized form, implement standardized mutually exclusive modalities that define how conflicts between standardized categories of actions are resolved (e.g. saying two things at the same time is not possible, while saying something and making a gesture at the same time may be possible), and/or implement standardized protocols for any number of standardized modalities and actions independent of implementation.

title: Generating large-language-model compatible sequential attachment-based fragment embedding molecular representations
description: The present disclosure relates to systems, non-transitory computer-readable media, and methods for generating a sequential attachment-based fragment embedding (SAFE) molecular string representation that represents a molecular representation as an order agnostic sequence of interconnected fragment blocks. Indeed, the disclosed systems can generate the SAFE representation for processing via large language models for downstream molecular design tasks. For instance, the disclosed systems can extract fragments (and attachment points) from a molecular string representation, concatenate the extracted fragments using separation character connections between the fragments to generate a set of linked fragments, and can iterate over attachment points for the fragments to generate ring link characters in the set of linked fragments to simulate fragment links. In addition, the disclosed systems can utilize the SAFE representation to enable various downstream fragment-based molecular design tasks via large language models.

title: Synthetic data generation utilizing generative artifical intelligence and scalable data generation tools
description: Systems, methods, devices, and computer readable storage media described herein provide techniques for generating synthetic data utilizing generative artificial intelligence (AI) models and scalable data generation tools (SDGTs). A prompt comprising a domain is provided to an AI model. A parameter associated with the domain that specifies a boundary for synthetic values in a column of data is received from the AI model. An argument comprising the parameter is provided to an SDGT to generate scaled data based on the parameter. The scaled data comprises a column of synthetic values wherein each synthetic value is within the boundary specified by the parameter. In an aspect, an emulated workload is caused to utilize synthetic data comprising the scaled data to generate a performance benchmark. In a further aspect, a lightweight model is trained to generate synthetic sentences based on training data generated by the generative AI model based on the prompt.

title: Synthetic Data Generation for Query Plans
description: Techniques are disclosed relating to database query optimizers. In some embodiments, a system receives, from a query optimizer, a plurality of query plans for a database maintained by the database system. The system retrieves a set of database statistics for the database and generates, via a data synthesizer, a plurality of synthetic datasets, where generating a given synthetic dataset is performed based on a given query plan of the plurality of query plans and the set of database statistics, and includes generating a plurality of synthetic data tuples. The system executes the plurality of query plans on the plurality of synthetic datasets and updates the query optimizer based on results of executing the plurality of query plans on the plurality of synthetic datasets. The disclosed data synthesis may advantageously improve query performance due to more efficient query plans being selected for execution of requested queries.

title: System for post-training quantization of large language models
description: Post-training quantization of weight values and activation values substantially reduces the memory and processing requirements of floating-point (FP) large language models (LLMs). A quantization parameter training process is performed on the FP LLM to determine quantization parameters. Weight-activation scaling may be applied to linear modules of the LLM, including down projection layers, enabling subsequent per-tensor quantization for activation values. The weight and activations values of the FP LLM are quantized from FP to integer values. Different layers may have different integer sizes. For example, weight values may be reduced to 4 bit integers and activation values to 8 bit integers. Layers within the model are modified to operate on the integer values. For example, an integer SiLU module may provide an integer approximation of a sigmoid-weighted linear unit activation function.

title: System, method, and apparatus for providing dynamic, prioritized spectrum management and utilization
description: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for providing dynamic, prioritized spectrum utilization management. The system includes at least one monitoring sensor, at least one data analysis engine, at least one application, a semantic engine, a programmable rules and policy editor, a tip and cue server, and/or a control panel. The tip and cue server is operable utilize the environmental awareness from the data processed by the at least one data analysis engine in combination with additional information to create actionable data.

title: Communications for autonomous vehicles
description: Aspects of the disclosure provide a method of facilitating communications from an autonomous vehicle to a user. For instance, a method may include, while attempting to pick up the user and prior to the user entering an vehicle, inputting a current location of the vehicle and map information into a model in order to identify a type of communication action for communicating a location of the vehicle to the user; enabling a first communication based on the type of the communication action; determining whether the user has responded to the first communication from received sensor data; and enabling a second communication based on the determination of whether the user has responded to the communication.

title: Generating avatar fashion items
description: Methods and systems are disclosed for using generative machine learning models to generate fashion items for avatars. The methods and systems receive an image depicting a set of fashion items and identify a set of three-dimensional (3D) avatar fashion item assets corresponding to the set of fashion items depicted in the image. The methods and systems replace textures of the set of 3D avatar fashion item assets with target textures generated using the set of fashion items depicted in the image to generate a set of target avatar fashion item assets and generate an avatar using the set of target avatar fashion item assets.

title: Agent-Generated Search Analytics
description: The technology disclosed relates to a method of agent-generated search analytics. In particular, the technology disclosed relates to inducing an agent-under-test (AUT) to disclose respective outputs in response to processing a target input probe, analyzing the respective outputs and generating one or more analytics corresponding to the target input probe, and causing a topic large language model (LLM) to identify topics by sampling the respective outputs, and storing the topics in memory for further use.

title: Animal wearable device notification system and method
description: A wearable computing device includes a memory storing computer-readable instructions and at least one processor to execute the instructions to obtain movement information associated with an animal wearing the wearable computing device, compare the movement information with at least one machine learning model, each machine learning model related to a particular animal health condition, determine that the movement information indicates a potential health condition for the animal wearing the wearable computing device, obtain animal identification information for the animal with the potential health condition, and transmit a notification indicating the animal identification information for the animal with the potential health condition.

title: Backward Monte Carlo Tree Search Model for Monitoring and Analyzing Safety of Belief Reasoning for Autonomous Vehicles
description: A vehicle traversing a vehicle transportation network may use a scenario-specific operational control evaluation model instance. The vehicle may receive operational environment data that includes data associated with an object external to the vehicle. The vehicle may determine, based at least in part on the data associated with the object, a final belief associated with an undesired outcome. The vehicle may construct a backward Monte Carlo tree search model based on the final belief and may determine, based on the backward Monte Carlo tree search model, a set of initial beliefs corresponding to a likelihood of leading to the final belief within a timestep threshold. A policy may be trained using the set of initial beliefs. Based on the trained policy, a set of candidate vehicle control actions may be determined, and a vehicle control action may be selected from the set of candidate vehicle control actions.

title: Apparatus, method, and system for providing signature-based machine unlearning
description: An approach is provided for signature-based machine unlearning. The approach involves, for example, configuring a machine learning model to learn at least one main task and an auxiliary task. The auxiliary task maps at least one signature associated with at least one data provider to at least one identifier associated with the at least one data provider, and the machine learning model is trained using training data labeled with the at least one signature. The approach also involves calculating at least one data structure representing a sensitivity of at least one parameter of the machine learning model to the training data associated with the least one data provider. The approach further involves updating one or more model parameters of the machine learning model based on the at least one data structure to perform a machine unlearning of the training data associated with the least one data provider indicated in an unlearning request.

title: Query to interest mapping
description: Systems and methods for identifying relevant content within a corpus of visual content items in response to a user's text-based query are presented. In response to a text-based query, the query is mapped to a most-engaged content item of the corpus of visual content items included in responses to the query from a plurality of users. At least one text-based term associated with the most-engaged content item is identified and combined with the query from an expanded query. The expanded query is mapped to an interest node of an interest taxonomy and content items associated with the mapped interest node are identified. At least some of the content items associated with the mapped interest node are selected and returned as response content to the received query.

title: Systems and methods for data augmentation using mean-field games
description: A system for image augmentation includes a processor and a memory. The memory includes instructions stored thereon, which when executed by the processor cause the system to access a first image and a second image, generate a path including points, perform a time-continuous transformation of a first distribution of pixels of the first image to a second distribution of pixels of the second image within a time interval along the path based on a mean-field game, and generate an augmented dataset based on the time-continuous transformation. The points start from the first image and end at the second image. The points include augmented images. The augmented images retain a shape of the first image and the second image.

title: Syntax unit testing and fine-tuning of neural transcompilation models
description: A neural transcompilation model is tested with a set of syntax unit tests to determine the syntax elements of a source code program written in a source programming language that fail to translate properly into a target programming language. The syntax elements having a translation defect is identified and ranked according a translation failure rate. The neural transcompilation model is then fine-tuned with training samples of the syntax elements having the highest translation failure rates and their paired correct translation in order to teach the model to learn the association between the syntax elements of a source programming language causing translation defects and its correct translation in a target programming language.

title: Surface characterizing device system
description: A method and a device system for measuring a characteristic of a surface comprising a cured coat is disclosed. The device system, which is portable and battery powered, comprises a sensor configured to acquire a measurement of a characteristic the surface, and a processor and memory are configured to establish a representation of the measurement. A display visual output device, such as an LED or display, is configured to indicate a measurement or connection status, while a user interface is configured to control measurement. A communication module establishes a communication channel with a cloud and transmit the measurement representation via the communication channel. The device system also comprises a measurement buffer to temporarily store the measurement representation when the communication module is prevented from establishing the communication channel. The temporarily stored representation are transmitted upon reestablishment of the communication channel. The device system may be a measurement device together with a smart device.

title: Neural network based automated cytological specimen classification system and method
description: An automated screening system and method for cytological specimen classification in which a neural network is utilized in performance of the classification function. Also included is an automated microscope and associated image processing circuitry.

title: Circuit structure of fuzzy control processor
description: A circuit structure for calculating a fuzzy inference for a fuzzy logic controller is disclosed in which a memory unit is divided into a first memory for storing a plurality of membership functions whose number corresponds to the number of fuzzy levels for respective input variables and into a second memory for storing a plurality of encoded fuzzy control linguistic rules. Then, the fuzzy levels in the form of grades are integrally accessed for the respective input variables into a plurality of registers together with the encoded fuzzy control linguistic rules so that the registers prepare the synthesized data of the fuzzy levels and membership functions in the one of the linguistic rule.

title: Real-time video face key point detection method based on deep learning
description: The present invention is a real-time video face key point detection method based on deep learning. The method adopts a convolutional neural network to perform key point detection of a single frame, in which the depth separable convolution is applied to improve the model detection rate, and the boundary heat map is used as the original An additional subtask of the network improves the constraints of the global face structure of the original network, improves the detection accuracy of the original network, and is used to solve the data imbalance loss function for heatmaps. The generalization ability and optical flow loss function enhance the smoothness between frames. In the detection process, for frames with extremely large angles that cause the confidence level to be lower than the key point confidence threshold, use 3DMM to fit the dense key point coordinates, and perform 68 on the obtained dense key points according to minimizing the projection error between frames. Point sampling to maintain consistency with previous frames. It has the advantages of real-time performance, the ability to use global inter-frame information, and high detection accuracy for large poses of faces.

title: An academic early warning method based on artificial neural network and LSTM network
description: The invention discloses an academic early warning method based on an artificial neural network and an LSTM network, which is characterized by comprising the following steps of: 1) processing missing data based on the RBF core; 2) extracting self-adaptive features based on multi-dimensional normal distribution; 3) artificial neural network training based on the refined network; 4) training an adaptive excitation function LSTM network; 5) in conjunction with a software platform. The method has the advantages of good universality, low false detection rate and high prediction accuracy.

title: A kind of multi-unmanned boat cooperative search control method and system
description: The invention relates to a multi-unmanned-boat collaborative search control method and a system, which relate to the field of marine intelligent unmanned-boat collaborative operation and comprise the steps of determining a task area of an unmanned-boat team; determining environment perception information corresponding to each unmanned ship at the current moment according to the task area and the probability map mode; respectively inputting the environment perception information corresponding to each unmanned ship at the current moment into a corresponding target search strategy output model to obtain the execution action of each unmanned ship at the next moment; and sending the execution action of each unmanned ship at the next moment to a corresponding unmanned ship execution structure to search underwater targets in the task area. And the target search strategy output model is obtained based on training samples and the DDQN network structure training. The unmanned ship can solve the problems of low efficiency, low accuracy, uncertain task allocation and the like of the unmanned ship in the search task.

title: Shape completion method and system for terracotta warriors and horses point cloud based on multi-scale and folded structures
description: The invention discloses a shape complement method and a system of terracotta soldiers and horses point cloud based on a multi-scale and folding structure, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting the point cloud of the terracotta warriors to be shape-complemented into a trained shape-complemented model of the point cloud of the terracotta warriors to obtain the point cloud of the terracotta warriors after shape complementation; the method for acquiring the terracotta soldiers and horses point cloud shape complement model comprises the following steps: operating the training data set by using a multi-layer perceptron, and extracting potential feature vectors of the obtained data; obtaining feature vectors of different scales; obtaining point clouds with different scales to form a multi-scale structure; generating dense complete point clouds; calculating the distances between the point clouds with different scales and the ground real point clouds, and calculating the distances between the intensive complete point clouds and the ground real point clouds; and adding the obtained distances according to weights to obtain training loss. The method of the invention is directly operated on the original point cloud, and can generate more complete and high-resolution complement results on both the shape and the terracotta warrior data sets.

title: High-value medical consumable intelligent evaluation method and system
description: The invention discloses a method and system for intelligent evaluation of high-value medical consumables, comprising: acquiring three types of medical data before, during and after operation; performing word segmentation and extraction on the three types of medical data according to the information of high-value medical consumables; Word vectors evaluate the reasonable state of high-value medical consumables before, during, and after use. Through the extraction and analysis of the whole process of using high-value medical consumables before, during and after use, the rationality, accuracy, correctness, legitimacy of signatures, and standardization of disinfection of the use of high-value medical consumables are evaluated. Realize the clinical application management of high-value medical consumables.

title: A lip language recognition method combining graph neural network and multi-feature fusion
description: The invention discloses a lip language recognition method combining graph neural network and multi-feature fusion. The method first extracts and constructs the face change sequence, labels the face feature points, and then corrects the lip deflection angle. The graph structure of the point relationship is used to train the lip language recognition network, and finally the lip language recognition results are generated by the trained lip language recognition network. In the present invention, the CNN lip feature extracted and fused by CNN and the GNN lip feature obtained by GNN extraction and fusion of the CNN lip feature and the lip region feature point after the recognition network data set and the lip semantic segmentation network data set are input into the feature fusion after feature fusion. Recognition in BiGRU solves the problem that time series feature extraction is difficult and lip feature extraction is affected by external factors, effectively extracts static features of lips and dynamic features of lip changes, and has strong lip change feature extraction ability and high accuracy of recognition results. Advanced features.

title: DOA estimation method and device based on DNN (digital optical network) beam space and computer storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present invention disclose a DOA estimation method, device and computer storage medium for beam space based on DNN; the method may include: obtaining the covariance matrix of the array received signal; and according to the covariance matrix and angle of the array received signal The beam pointing covariance matrix of each angle interval in the space generates the received signal data in the beam space; the received signal data in the beam space is input into the deep neural network DNN that has been trained using the training data set; the DNN output The signal data is obtained by linear amplitude interpolation to obtain DOA estimates.

title: Method, device, storage medium and electronic device for predicting delivery mode
description: The present application relates to the technical field of logistics data processing, and in particular, to a method, device, storage medium and electronic device for predicting a delivery method. The method in one embodiment includes: acquiring the delivery method influencing factor data of the to-be-delivered waybill, identifying the target scene type to which the to-be-delivered waybill belongs, reading a preset delivery method prediction model, and acquiring the model corresponding to the target scene type. Threshold, the model threshold is used to configure the delivery method prediction model, so that the delivery method prediction model has the best performance in the corresponding scenario type, update the delivery method prediction model according to the model threshold, and obtain the updated delivery method prediction model. The delivery method influencing factor data is input into the updated delivery method prediction model to obtain the delivery method of the waybill to be delivered.

title: FY-3D infrared hyperspectral cloud detection method based on linear discriminant analysis
description: The invention discloses an FY-3D infrared hyperspectral cloud detection method based on linear discriminant analysis, and relates to the technical field of satellite remote sensing. According to the method, a traditional imager-based cloud detection method is utilized, cloud detection section products of MERSI are matched with HIRAS pixels to obtain HIRAS data with cloud labels, a training data set is formed, then a linear discriminant analysis algorithm is used for training the data set, in the training process, a grid search method is adopted to select a proper linear discriminant analysis algorithm over-constant to obtain model parameters with the best generalization performance, and finally the trained linear discriminant analysis cloud detection model is used for cloud detection processing of YF-3D infrared hyperspectral data. The linear discriminant analysis cloud detection model can achieve the classification accuracy of 0.95, the prediction speed is about 58 times of that of the traditional method, and good generalization performance is embodied.

title: Intelligent matching system of favorable enterprise policy based on big data
description: The invention discloses an intelligent matching system for favorable enterprise policies based on big data. First, corresponding basic information of enterprises, job information and historical policy application records are obtained through an enterprise management platform, and corresponding policies are obtained through the third-party platform. Supplementary information of the management platform or the enterprise management platform, and then the policy management platform uses the convolutional neural network to train the acquired historical data in the big database, constructs the corresponding big data model, and based on the extracted multiple features , build the corresponding matching tree; then acquire multiple data in the enterprise management platform, calculate the matching degree with the matching tree, and transmit the policy information that meets the matching requirements to the At the same time, the enterprise management platform will also transmit the completion time limit corresponding to the policy information to the enterprise management platform, saving the time of the enterprise administrator.

title: A state analysis method and image acquisition method of regional power facilities
description: The invention discloses a regional power facility state analysis method and a power facility image acquisition method, wherein the power facility state analysis method comprises the following steps: acquiring image information of a power facility to be analyzed and geographical position information of an image acquisition point; preprocessing the image, and then inputting a depth network model trained in advance to obtain an identification result of the power facility in the image; and combining the identification result with the corresponding geographic position information to generate vector data, and fusing the vector data into the regional map to obtain the regional power data map containing the power facility identification result at the corresponding geographic position. By combining the electric power facility image acquisition method, the electric power facility image information can be conveniently acquired, the state of the electric power facility is further identified, the identification result is quick and accurate, a manager can quickly construct a data map, the existing electric power data is patrolled and updated, the electric power planning layout is assisted, the current situation of the electric power facility is known, and the electric power design and patrolling efficiency is improved.

title: A cross-modal eye state recognition method from near-infrared light to visible light
description: The invention discloses a cross-mode eye state identification method from near infrared light to visible light. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a visible light eye state data set; acquiring a near-infrared eye state data set, mixing the visible light eye state data sets, and constructing a training set and a verification set; constructing a cross-mode eye state identification frame from near infrared light to visible light; processing the eye state samples input from the training set; extracting gradient information from the eye state samples input from the training set; identifying an eye state; performing model training on a cross-mode eye state recognition frame from near infrared light to visible light until convergence; the recognition of the eye state is completed. The invention fully considers various factors, fully utilizes the characteristics of the eye state identification, and simultaneously combines the cross-mode universal method, thereby greatly improving the identification performance under visible light while ensuring the identification performance of the eye state identification method under near infrared light.

title: A positioning method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present disclosure provides a positioning method, device, electronic device and storage medium, wherein the positioning method includes: acquiring video images collected by multiple collection devices set in a target place at the same time; The acquisition perspectives in the venue are different, and the video picture contains the target object; based on the video pictures collected by multiple acquisition devices at the same time, the initial position coordinates of the target object in the target venue are respectively determined; the initial position coordinates of the same target object are fused , get the target position coordinates of the target object in the target place.

title: A cross-modal transfer learning method
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a cross-modal transfer learning method, which is characterized in that a transfer learning model is constructed, a global domain discrimination module is used for aligning edge distribution, a local category discrimination module is used for aligning condition distribution of features from a category angle in a fine-grained manner, and a local modal discrimination module is used for aligning condition distribution of features from a modal angle in a fine-grained manner.

title: A method and system for predicting Gibbs free energy of iron-based alloys
description: The invention relates to a prediction method and a system for Gibbs free energy of iron-based alloy. The method for predicting Gibbs free energy of the iron-based alloy comprises the steps of training a fusion model (namely an initial Gibbs free energy prediction model) based on a factorization machine, a position-based self-attention mechanism and a bidirectional long and short memory neural network Bi-LSTM by adopting preprocessed thermodynamic experimental data of the iron-based alloy material to obtain the trained Gibbs free energy prediction model, and then quickly, accurately and comprehensively predicting the Gibbs free energy of iron-based alloy material data to be predicted by adopting the trained fusion model based on the factorization machine, the position-based self-attention mechanism and the bidirectional long and short memory neural network Bi-LSTM, so that the resource consumption for predicting the Gibbs free energy is reduced while the prediction efficiency of the Gibbs free energy of the iron-based alloy material is improved.

title: Single-channel noise reduction low-power consumption method, device and storage medium
description: The invention relates to a method, a device and a storage medium for processing single-channel voice, wherein the method for processing the single-channel voice comprises the following steps: collecting a voice signal with noise; extracting a first characteristic of the voice signal with noise according to short-time discrete cosine transform (STDCT); inputting the first features into a training model to obtain a target model; acquiring a voice signal to be processed, and extracting a second characteristic of the voice signal to be processed; and inputting the second characteristic into the target model to obtain a noise-reduced target voice signal. The method is suitable for the field of computers, and is used for reducing the calculated amount, further reducing the power consumption and improving the noise reduction effect through the single-channel voice processing method.

title: Optimization method of heating furnace billet temperature field prediction model based on HMPSO algorithm
description: The invention discloses a heating furnace billet temperature field prediction model optimization method based on the HMPSO algorithm, and relates to the technical field of heating furnace steel billet temperature field prediction model optimization. The method includes: dividing the heating furnace into sections at unequal intervals along the length of the furnace, establishing the overall heat absorption rates that need to be identified on the upper and lower surfaces of the steel billet; establishing the billet during the heating process in the heating furnace, including the total heat absorption rate to be determined. Temperature field prediction model; establish the objective function and constraint conditions for the optimization of the steel billet temperature field prediction model; use the HMPSO algorithm to optimize and identify the overall heat absorption rate based on the objective function and constraint conditions, thereby realizing the optimization of the heating furnace billet temperature field prediction model. Through this method, a more accurate overall heat absorption rate value of the furnace can be obtained, thereby providing an accurate temperature field prediction model for the heating furnace billet and solving the problem of low accuracy in predicting the temperature field of the heating furnace billet.

title: An Efficient LSTM Accelerator Based on FPGA
description: The invention discloses an efficient LSTM accelerator based on an FPGA (field programmable gate array). The FPGA accelerator internally comprises a plurality of computing units, a storage unit and a control unit; the calculation unit comprises a matrix vector multiplication module and an Element _ wise operation module, the matrix vector multiplication module consists of 4 × N DSPs and 4 adders, the N DSPs are used for parallel multiply-accumulate operation of the weight data and the input data, the N multiply-accumulate results are added to obtain a result vector corresponding to a single gate, and simultaneously the multiply-accumulate operation of the four gates is executed in parallel; the Element _ wise operation module is used for calculating a cell state value and output data at the current moment; the multiple computing units adopt a parallel operation and multiplexing strategy; the storage unit is used for caching weight data, input data, output values and cell state values required by calculation of the LSTM network; the control unit is used for controlling the state conversion and data stream transmission process of the LSTM network calculation, and compared with a general processor, the FPGA accelerator has the characteristics of high performance, low power consumption and high throughput.

title: A Remote Supervision Relation Extraction Method Based on Entity Features
description: The present invention provides a remote supervision relation extraction method based on entity features, and proposes an entity-guided enhanced feature network. First, a multi-level enhanced entity representation module is adopted, and under the multi-head attention mechanism, the entity-guided attention is designed, from keywords and Extract relational features from phrases. Specifically, entity pairs are regarded as query sequences, and under the action of multi-head attention, the most relevant words and phrases are searched from the target sentence. These features are used to enhance the head entity representation and the tail entity representation; the enhanced two entity representations are then concatenated and input into the linear layer to generate a robust relational representation r. Next, the present invention uses a semantic fusion layer to integrate multiple semantics Representations, including sentence representations, two augmented entity representations, and relation representations, generate final robust sentence vectors. The invention can capture reliable relationship features and improve the relationship extraction efficiency.

title: Character recognition model training method, recognition method, related equipment and storage medium
description: The method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial character feature extraction model and a first sample data set, performing non-supervision training on the initial character feature extraction model by using the first sample data set to obtain a target character feature extraction model, constructing the initial character recognition model based on the target character feature extraction model, obtaining a second sample data set, wherein the second sample data set comprises marked text line image samples belonging to a target language, and training the initial character recognition model by using the second sample data set to obtain a target character recognition model for recognizing characters belonging to the target language. By utilizing the embodiment of the invention, the target character recognition model can be obtained through quick transfer learning, and the character recognition precision of the target character recognition model can be improved.

title: Heterogeneous image pose estimation and registration method, device and medium based on neural network
description: The invention discloses a heterogeneous image pose estimation and registration method based on a neural network, and belongs to the field of image processing. The present invention optimizes the phase correlation algorithm to be differentiable, and embeds it into the end-to-end learning network framework to construct a neural network-based heterogeneous image pose estimation method. The method can find the optimal feature extractor for the result of image matching, can obtain the solution without exhaustive evaluation, and has good interpretability and generalization ability. The test results show that the present invention can accurately realize the accurate pose estimation and registration of heterogeneous pictures, and the time required is short, and it has high accuracy and real-time performance, can meet the needs of practical applications, and can be applied to the robot autonomous system. positioning, etc.

title: An aero-engine thrust estimation method based on CNN-RNN
description: The invention relates to an aero-engine thrust estimation method based on a deep CNN-RNN. Including: collecting the measurable parameters of the aero-engine and using the thrust value as a sample set; normalizing preprocessing; dividing the data set into training set and test set; inputting the training set into the CNN-RNN thrust estimator model for training, and then testing the Set input into the thrust estimator model, obtain the thrust prediction value, judge the prediction accuracy of the thrust estimator model, and train continuously until the maximum number of training rounds is reached; input the corresponding measurable parameters of the aero-engine into the thrust estimator model obtained by training , to get the estimated thrust of the aero-engine. Advantages: when the measurable performance parameters of the air path components of the aero-engine are changed, and the normal data is mixed with different degrees of measurement noise, the present invention can estimate the thrust value of the aero-engine with high efficiency and high precision.

title: A method and system for alerting abnormal data of a concentrator based on a multi-model
description: The invention relates to a method and system for alerting abnormal data of a concentrator based on multiple models. By installing a computing device on the end of a power grid concentrator, the invention realizes that a target power consumption model and a general abnormal model are constructed based on user data of multiple users. The target user's electricity consumption data is analyzed. When both models report that the target user's electricity consumption data is abnormal, the target user's electricity consumption abnormality is reported, which solves the existing power metering automation systems, power grid collectors, and power grids in the prior art. The technical problem that the concentrator and the electricity meter report many abnormal reports but the accuracy is poor, has achieved the technical effect of improving the accuracy of the abnormal report of the power grid, and greatly reduced the situation of false positives.

title: A Situational Awareness Method for Intelligent Countermeasure Simulation
description: The invention discloses a situation perception method for intelligent confrontation simulation deduction, which is based on multi-mode situation perception of deep learning, wherein the multi-mode situation perception comprises global situation perception, regional situation perception and first visual angle situation perception, the deep learning adopts a deep convolutional neural network to fuse the global situation perception and the regional situation perception, and the first visual angle situation perception of a single confrontation unit is combined for the confrontation simulation deduction. The invention provides a situation perception method for intelligent confrontation simulation deduction aiming at the characteristics of complex confrontation field environment and more confrontation units in the intelligent confrontation simulation deduction process, and effectively solves the future unmanned confrontation simulation requirement.

title: Model training method, device, storage medium and electronic device
description: The present disclosure relates to a model training method, an apparatus, a storage medium, and an electronic device, where the model training method is applied to a key point detection model, and the key point detection model includes: the model training method comprises the following steps: determining a target object to be updated in the keypoint detection model, wherein the target object comprises: the feature extractor, the regressor, and the counterregressor; updating the network parameters of the target object to enable the key point detection model to migrate from the source domain to the target domain, so as to at least solve the problem that the domain adaptive method in the related art cannot realize the migration of the key point detection model between different data domains.

title: A two-stage UAV logistics path planning method based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The invention discloses a two-stage unmanned aerial vehicle logistics path planning method based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the steps of firstly, constructing a deep reinforcement learning model through preprocessing a logistics distribution area and related data, establishing a corresponding unmanned aerial vehicle flight state space, an action space and a return value function, and training the deep reinforcement learning model by combining an offline learning mode and an online learning mode; secondly, planning a logistics distribution path and a flight path in the logistics process of the unmanned aerial vehicle by adopting a two-stage optimization method. And the unmanned aerial vehicle flight path planning stage is mainly completed by selecting real-time actions based on deep reinforcement learning. According to the method, the distribution cost of the unmanned aerial vehicle is estimated through deep reinforcement learning in the logistics path planning stage, so that the optimization of the logistics path is more suitable for the actual flight process of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the planning of the real-time flight path of the unmanned aerial vehicle is realized based on the deep reinforcement learning, and the method has the advantages of higher calculation speed and higher robustness.

title: HSI super-resolution reconstruction method and related equipment based on transfer learning and spectral recovery
description: The invention relates to the field of hyperspectral images, and discloses an HSI super-resolution reconstruction method and related equipment based on transfer learning and spectrum recovery, which are used for realizing HSI prediction from a low-resolution hyperspectral image through a machine learning model, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a hyperspectral image set training set and a color image training set; carrying out spectrum downsampling according to the hyperspectral image set training set to obtain a multispectral image set; training a preset migration learning model according to a color image training set to obtain a spatial super-resolution model, and optimizing the spatial super-resolution model to obtain a target spatial super-resolution model; training a preset depth learning model according to the low-resolution multispectral image set and the low-resolution hyperspectral image set to obtain a target spectrum super-resolution model; and acquiring a low-resolution hyperspectral image to be reconstructed, and respectively performing transfer learning and spectrum recovery processing based on the target space super-resolution model and the target spectrum super-resolution model to obtain a corresponding high-resolution hyperspectral image.

title: Point cloud data selection method and selection device, equipment, storage medium
description: The invention provides a point cloud data selection method, device, equipment, and storage medium. The selection method includes: obtaining point cloud data; using a trained neural network based on a self-attention mechanism to perform point cloud instance segmentation on the point cloud data , to obtain multiple segmentation instances; convert the multiple segmentation instances into multiple segmentation instances in the planar space; obtain the selected area of the target user in the planar space; obtain each The attribute of a segmentation instance; use the trained prediction network and predict the probability of each segmentation instance being selected based on the attribute of each segmentation instance; obtain the target point cloud data according to the probability of each segmentation instance being selected. The present invention first performs instance segmentation to obtain the category of each point, and then combines the selected area to obtain the predicted attribute of each segmented instance, which effectively improves the accuracy of point cloud selection, and has no requirements for the scene of point cloud data, and has a good robustness.

title: Emotion recognition method and system based on multimodal confrontation fusion in heterogeneous space
description: The invention discloses an emotion recognition method and system based on multi-modal confrontation fusion in a heterogeneous space, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s100: acquiring multi-modal data consisting of text information and image information; s200: extracting word feature vectors of the text information to obtain a text feature set; s300: extracting a regional characteristic vector of the image information to obtain an image characteristic set; s400: mapping the multi-modal data in a heterogeneous space; s500: adaptive fusion based on antagonistic learning; s600: and performing emotion category prediction on the fusion result by utilizing the softmax layer. The invention realizes the complementation of the multi-element heterogeneous data in the emotion recognition, and can obtain richer and more accurate emotion recognition results.

title: Methods and Systems of Four-Valued Monte Carlo Simulation for Financial Modeling
description: Automatic trading environments with their high degree of automation have become the backbone of modern financial markets. The ability to process orders and manage risk in these systems while maintaining a low latency between participants is crucial for the safety and liquidity of these markets. The disclosed system describes a four valued Monte Carlo simulation for the stochastic modeling of risk and syntactic pattern matching techniques to facilitate the design of these systems. The system is a self-compiling, machine independent system capable of dividing, scaling and communicating multiple-asset instruments efficiently in a parallel environment. The system also allows for the integration of computerized financial heuristics on financial instruments and user interfaces for creating trading strategies to monitor and hedge risk over a trading desk for financial institutions.

title: Multiple implementation fact checking method and system
description: An efficient fact checking system analyzes and determines the factual accuracy of information and/or characterizes the information by comparing the information with source information. The efficient fact checking system automatically monitors information, processes the information, fact checks the information efficiently and/or provides a status of the information.

title: Methods and systems for scalable group detection from multiple data streams
description: A system, method and computer program product for identifying strong links and discovering hidden relationships among entities, including identifying strong links and discovering hidden relationships among entities, wherein the entities include places, time slots, people, groups, and organizations; and identifying the strong links and discovering the hidden relationships based on low-level data streams, and incomplete and noisy evidence data streams.

title: Systems and methods for enhancing computer assisted high throughput screening processes
description: Embodiments are directed to identifying active compounds for a targeted medium from a library of compounds. In one scenario, a computer system receives high throughput screening (HTS) data for a subset of compounds that have been HTS-screened. The computer system determines labels for a subset of compounds based on labels identified in the HTS-screened compounds as being part of an active class or part of an inactive class, access chemical features corresponding to the HTS-screened compounds, apply Fuzzy logic membership functions to calculate membership values for active and inactive compounds to determine the degree to which each compound belongs to the active class or to the inactive class, train an artificial neural network (ANN) to identify active compounds in silico based on the Fuzzy logic membership functions, and process another subset of compounds in silico to identify active and inactive compounds using the trained artificial neural network.

title: Predictive navigation
description: A method, computer system and computer program product for predicting traffic is provided. A processor determines a content of a first message posted to a social network, determines that the content of the first message describes a first event, determines an amount of predicted traffic to be caused by the first event, determines a content of a second message posted to a social network, determines that the content of the second message describes the first event, and adjusts the amount of predicted traffic to be caused by the first event based, at least in part, on the content of the first and second message.

title: Predictive financial management system
description: Embodiments of the present invention provide methods and systems for predicting expenses. The method may include receiving a set of input parameters based on financial objectives of a user and updating financial data in a central repository. A saving trend graph depicting projected savings trend lines is created and the projected saving trend lines may be selected based on the preferences of a user.

title: Event mini-graphs in data intake stage of machine data processing platform
description: A security platform employs a variety techniques and mechanisms to detect security related anomalies and threats in a computer network environment. The security platform is “big data” driven and employs machine learning to perform security analytics. The security platform performs user/entity behavioral analytics (UEBA) to detect the security related anomalies and threats, regardless of whether such anomalies/threats were previously known. The security platform can include both real-time and batch paths/modes for detecting anomalies and threats. By visually presenting analytical results scored with risk ratings and supporting evidence, the security platform enables network security administrators to respond to a detected anomaly or threat, and to take action promptly.

title: Systems and methods for dynamically generating patrol schedules based on historic demand data
description: Systems and methods are described herein for dynamically generating and updating a patrol schedule for a shift based on historic demand event data, and a predicted-demand model based on the historic demand event data. The systems and methods also receive information associated with patrol officers assigned to a shift and constraints on the officers' availability, and generate a patrol schedule comprising patrol assignments for the assigned patrol officers optimized based on at least one policing objective. The patrol schedule may be dynamically updated based on changing information and provided to the patrol officer via mobile device or display in the patrol officer's vehicle.

title: Device for detection and prevention of an attack on a vehicle
description: A new device for detection and prevention of an attack on a vehicle via its communication channels, having: an input-unit configured to collect real-time and/or offline data from various sources such as sensors, network based services, navigation applications, the vehicles electronic control units, the vehicle's bus-networks, the vehicle's subsystems, and on board diagnostics; a database, for storing the data; a detection-unit in communication with the input-unit; and an action-unit, in communication with the detection unit, configured for sending an alert via the communication channels and/or prevent the attack, by breaking or changing the attacked communication channels. The detection-unit is configured to simultaneously monitor the content, the meta-data and the physical-data of the data and detect the attack.

title: Optimizing manufacturing schedule with time-dependent energy cost
description: A method of manufacturing at least a first product and a second product with at least a first machine and a second machine at minimum cost in an environment in which a cost of energy used by the first machine and the second machine varies as a function of time may include generating multiple chromosomes, determining fitness scores of each of the chromosomes, randomly generating, with probabilities based on the fitness scores, new chromosomes, determining fitness scores of the new chromosomes, selecting one of the new chromosomes with an optimal fitness score, and manufacturing at least the first product and the second product with at least the first machine and the second machine according to a schedule based on the selected new chromosome.

title: System and method for content-based media analysis
description: A media analysis system includes one or more hardware processors, a memory storing synopses associated with catalog books, and a content analysis engine. The content analysis engine generates a media vector for each catalog book based on the associated synopsis by generating a word vector for each word in the synopsis, combining the plurality of word vectors into a mean vector for the catalog book, and storing the mean vector as the media vector associated with the catalog book. The content analysis engine also identifies a target book associated with a seed media vector, determines R nearest neighbors for the target book from the plurality of catalog books based on (1) the seed media vector and (2) the media vectors associated with the plurality of catalog books, clusters the R nearest neighbors into K clusters, and selects catalog books for recommendation to a user based on the K clusters.

title: Constructing and programming quantum hardware for robust quantum annealing processes
description: Among other things, an apparatus comprises quantum units; and couplers among the quantum units. Each coupler is configured to couple a pair of quantum units according to a quantum Hamiltonian characterization of the quantum by the coupler.

title: Flux control of qubit under resonant excitation
description: Systems and methods are provided for flux control of a qubit. A quantum system includes a microwave transmitter configured to provide a continuous microwave tone, and a qubit configured such that a portion of an energy spectrum of the qubit is responsive to an applied flux. The qubit also has an inductive element responsive to the continuous microwave tone to produce a Rabi oscillation within the qubit. A flux source is configured to apply a flux to the qubit.

title: Systems and Methods for Predicting Traffic Signal Information
description: Systems and methods for predicting traffic signal information are provided. An exemplary method includes obtaining data from a plurality of types of sources and analyzing the data to predict states of a plurality of traffic signals. The data include crowdsourced data. The predictive traffic signal information may be used to adjust an operation of an on-board system of a vehicle.

title: Dynamic uploading protocol
description: A dynamic uploading protocol comprises an input interface configured to receive a manifest comprising a plurality of events which may be uploaded; wherein the manifest additionally comprises sensor information relating to each of the plurality of events. The system for a dynamic uploading protocol additionally comprises a processor configured to determine whether to upload additional information about each event, wherein determining whether to upload additional information about each event is based at least in part on the sensor information and contextual information. The system for a dynamic uploading protocol additionally comprises an output interface configured to request the additional information. The system for a dynamic uploading protocol additionally comprises a memory coupled to the processor and configured to provide the processor with instructions.

title: System and method for process monitoring and control
description:
The system for process monitoring and control integrates statistical process control (SPC) with automatic process control (APC) through the use of a fuzzy logic (FZL) controller, In order to relate the inputs to the output, fuzzy inference rules are applied. The fuzzy rules are based on the use of the APC controller during normal situations, deviating to 
     SPC as soon as abnormalities are detected. When the output error is negligible and the change in the output quality characteristic is almost zero, the fuzzy logic controller (FZLC) provides a utilization factor parallel for applying the APC controller. The FZLC has two inputs: the output error er t  and the rate of change of the output quality characteristic dy t . The FZLC has a single output: the controller utilization factor w t . When er t  is large and dy t  is maximum, the controller utilization factor w t  will utilize the application of the SPC controller.

title: System and method for monitoring health and predicting failure of an electro-mechanical machine
description: This disclosure relates to a method and system for monitoring health and predicting failure of an electro-mechanical machine. In an embodiment, the method may include receiving a plurality of operational parameters with respect to the electro-mechanical machine and determining a set of features and a set of events, based on the plurality of operational parameters. The method may further include detecting one or more fault signatures associated the electro-mechanical machine based on at least one of the plurality of operational parameters, the set of features, or the set of events. The method may further include determining at least one of a time to the possible failure and a remaining useful life of the electro-mechanical machine based on at least one of the plurality of operational parameters, the set of features, the set of events, or the one or more fault signature, by using a hybrid machine learning model.

title: Learning in communication systems
description: Apparatuses, methods and computer programs are described comprising receiving a sequence of messages at a correction module of a transmission system, wherein the transmission system comprises a transmitter, a channel, the correction module and a receiver, wherein the correction module includes a correction algorithm having at least some trainable weights; converting the received sequence of messages into a converted sequence of messages using the correction algorithm; receiving a reward or loss function from the receiver based on the modified sequence of messages; and training at least some weights of the correction algorithm based on the received reward or loss function.

title: Neural network processor based on application specific synthesis specialization parameters
description: Neural network processors that have been customized based on application specific synthesis specialization parameters and related methods are described. Certain example neural network processors and methods described in the present disclosure expose several major synthesis specialization parameters that can be used for specializing a microarchitecture instance of a neural network processor to specific neural network models including: (1) aligning the native vector dimension to the parameters of the model to minimize padding and waste during model evaluation, (2) increasing lane widths to drive up intra-row-level parallelism, or (3) increasing matrix multiply tiles to exploit sub-matrix parallelism for large neural network models.

title: Vectorized representation method for software source codes
description: A vectorized representation method for software source codes. The vectorized representation method is an AST-based neural network, and the AST-based neural network is a hierarchical vector representation method, and the implementation steps are as follows: step 1-1: at the bottom most layer, after an original software source code is converted into an AST, further segmenting same according to a source code statement, so as to obtain smaller statement tree sequences, the statement trees having an order which coincides with an original statement order; step 1-2: encoding each statement tree into statement vectors e 1 , e 2 , …, e t  by means of a recursive neural encoder; step 1-3: processing the obtained statement vector sequence by means of a bidirectional cyclic neural network layer, so as to extract dependent features between statements; and step 1-4: taking samples from multi-dimensional features of time steps of all bidirectional cyclic neural network layers by means of a pooling layer, so as to obtain the final single vector representation form.

title: Multi-person voice separation method and apparatus
description: A multi-person voice separation method and apparatus, used for implementing separation between voices in a multi-person voice scenario, and comprising: a terminal extracts mixed voice features from a mixed voice signal to be separated, N human voices being mixed in the mixed voice signal, and N being a positive integer greater than or equal to 2 (101); the terminal uses a generative adversarial network model to implement masking coefficient extraction of the mixed voice features to obtain a masking matrix corresponding to the N human voices (102); and the terminal uses the generative adversarial network model to implement voice separation of the masking matrix corresponding to the N human voices and the mixed voice signal, and outputs N separate voice signals corresponding to the N human voices (103).

title: Machine learning optimisation method
description: Embodiments provide a computer implemented method for use in self-optimising a complex time varying system, the method being performed in relation to a first model of the system. The first model is a weighted graph based model of the system. The graph may,optionally, be fully connected but constrained.The model comprises: a plurality of nodes, each node representing an element of the system and being associated with one or more data records indicative of the properties of the element of the system; a plurality of links connecting pairs of nodes, each link indicating the relationship between a pair of nodes. The method comprises: performing a query to determine at least one property of the system by performing a traversal along a path from a start node to an end node of the first graph via one or more intermediate nodes according to the links, which are stored in a common data storage structure, the traversal comprising collecting one or more data records associated with each of at least the start and end node and determining the property of the system based on the collected data records.

title: Arithmetic processing device
description: In this arithmetic processing device, during a filtering process and a cumulative addition process for calculating a specific pixel of an output feature amount map, an arithmetic control unit temporarily stores an interim result in a cumulative addition result storage memory and processes another pixel, stores the interim result of the cumulative addition process for all pixels in the cumulative addition result storage memory, then returns to a first pixel, reads the value stored in the cumulative addition result storage memory as an initial value of the cumulative addition process, and performs controlling so as to continue the cumulative addition process.

title: Method and system for extracting, storing and retrieving mass video features
description: Disclosed are a method and a system for extracting, storing and retrieving mass video features, wherein feature extraction is performed by training a deep convolutional neural network, the storage method comprises the steps of video slicing, interval sampling, landmark recognition, deep convolutional neural network processing to obtain hash codes and features, selection of key frames and the like, the retrieval method comprises landmark information and picture retrieval, when a picture is input, firstly extracting the hash codes and features through the deep convolutional neural network, quickly retrieving the hash codes in a hash index database, then accurately matching the features in a video feature database, and obtaining video information in a video information database after obtaining the index of a similar landmark; and the present application has advantages of better accuracy and high precision.

title: Neuromorphic algorithm for rapid online learning and signal restoration
description: A computer-implemented method of training a neural network to recognize sensory patterns includes obtaining input data, preprocessing the input data in one or more preprocessors of the neural network, and applying the preprocessed input data to a core portion of the neural network. The core portion of the neural network includes a plurality of principal neurons and a plurality of interneurons, and is configured to implement a feedback loop from the interneurons to the principal neurons that supports persistent unsupervised differentiation of multiple learned sensory patterns over time. The method further includes obtaining an output from the core portion, and performing at least one automated action based at least in part on the output obtained from the core portion. The neural network may be adaptively expanded to facilitate the persistent unsupervised differentiation of multiple learned sensory patterns over time by incorporating additional interneurons into at least the core portion.

title: Compressed network for product recognition
description: Aspects of this disclosure include technologies to detect unpackaged, unlabeled, or mislabeled products based on product images. Leveraging from improved machine learning techniques, the disclosed technical solution can reduce a full product space for product search to a partial product space. Accordingly, a limited number of product candidates in the partial product space may be visually presented for user evaluation. Sometimes, a product candidate is to be comparatively presented with a live image of the product via a uniquely designed graphic user interface, which further improves the confidence of the user and the accuracy of the underlying transaction.

title: Text classification method, electronic device and computer-readable storage medium
description: A text classification method, an electronic device and a computer-readable storage medium. The method comprises: acquiring text to be detected; performing sensitive word detection by means of an AC automaton to determine whether the text for detection has sensitive words; and determining, on the basis of a determination result that the text for detection has sensitive words, a text category of the text for detection according to the sensitive words included in the text for detection.

title: Methods and systems for training and validating a perception system
description: A perception system, comprising a set of reference sensors; a set of test sensors and a computing device, which is configured for receiving first training signals from the set of reference sensors and receiving second training signals from the set of test sensors, the set of reference sensors and the set of test sensors simultaneously exposed to a common scene; processing the first training signals to obtain reference images containing reference depth information associated with the scene; and using the second training signals and the reference images to train a neural network for transforming subsequent test signals from the set of test sensors into test images containing inferred depth information.

title: Building systems for improving temperature, pressure and humidity compliance
description: A building management system for monitoring and controlling HVAC parameters in a building is structured to monitor and maintain temperature, pressure, and humidity levels within the building and provide: trend analysis and control; improved reporting functions; more efficient and usable data management; improved user interfaces, dashboards, alerts, and communication; building scheduling integration; security system integration including door sensor integration; improved sensor calibration systems; and/or room adjacency based control.

title: Electronic apparatus that monitors a safety function and a controlling method thereof
description: An electronic apparatus including a memory; and a processor including at least one core, among a plurality of cores, that is configured to execute an instruction corresponding to at least one safety function. The processor is further configured to, based on at least one instruction being executed in the at least one core while the electronic apparatus operates in a first state, identify whether the at least one instruction corresponds to the safety function based on an output of a trained neural network model; and based on a result of the identification, determine an operation state of the electronic apparatus as one of the first state or a second state.

title: Image processing method and apparatus, server and storage medium
description: An image processing method and apparatus, a computer device and a storage medium. Said method comprises: acquiring a sample image and a generative adversarial network, the generative adversarial network comprising a generative network and an adversarial network (101); performing style transfer processing on the sample image by means of the generative network, so as to obtain a reference image (102); performing global style recognition on the reference image by means of the adversarial network, to determine a global style loss between the reference image and the sample image (103); performing image content recognition on the reference image and the sample image, to determine a content loss between the reference image and the sample image (104); performing local style recognition on the reference image and the sample image, to determine a local style loss of the reference image and a local style loss of the sample image (105); training the generative network on the basis of the global style loss, the content loss, the local style loss of the reference image and the local style loss of the sample image, so as to obtain a trained generative network (106); and upon acquisition of an image to be processed, using the trained generative network to perform style transfer processing on the image to be processed, so as to obtain an image subjected to style transfer (107).

title: Data processing apparatus and artificial intelligence chip
description: Provided are a data processing apparatus and an artificial intelligence chip. The data processing apparatus comprises a first selection unit with multiple input ends and multiple output ends, a second selection unit with multiple input ends and multiple output ends, and multiple operation units, wherein the multiple input ends of the first selection unit are connected to the multiple output ends of the first selection unit in a configurable manner; at least some of the multiple output ends of the first selection unit are connected to input ends of the multiple operation units; output ends of the multiple operation units are connected to the multiple input ends of the second selection unit; the multiple input ends of the second selection unit are connected to the multiple output ends of the second selection unit in a configurable manner; and at least some of the multiple output ends of the second selection unit are connected to the multiple input ends of the first selection unit, and/or are connected to data output ports of the data processing apparatus, such that the multiple operation units form different operation paths.

title: Technology configured to enable fault detection and condition assessment of underground stormwater and sewer pipes
description: The present invention relates to technology configured to enable fault detection and condition assessment of underground stormwater and sewer pipes. Embodiments of the invention have been developed to allow automated processing of video captured by pipe inspection robots and the like thereby to identify and categorise artefacts in pipes.

title: Virtual environment scenarios and observers for autonomous machine applications
description: In various examples, scenarios may be defined using a declarative description – e.g., defining a behavior of interest – that the present system may convert into a procedural description for generating one or more instances and/or variations of a scenario for testing an autonomous or semi-autonomous machine in a virtual environment. The system may execute observers or evaluators for testing the performance and accuracy of the machine and may compute coverage of various elements based on the generated virtual scenarios, and may feed the results back to the system to generate additional instances and/or variations where the coverage or accuracy is below a desired level.
