The technical result from the implementation of the declared solution is to provide an automated verification of documents for making a legal decision based on an incoming request by analyzing and identifying the compliance of the legal facts available in them based on knowledge of the subject area of technology using machine learning algorithms. The stated result is achieved through the use of a system of intellectual analysis of documents subject to legal verification within the framework of an incoming user request, which carries out automated information processing using machine learning algorithms that provide functionality for identifying and verifying legal facts in such documents, comparing them and further making a legal decision reflected in the legal opinion.

title: Website Traffic Forecasting
description: The traffic prediction component can automatically generate a predicted traffic profile for a website based on tags representing the website. An initial set of tags can be selected for the website based on a set of predetermined rules. An initial traffic profile can be selected based on the initial set of tags. A predicted user traffic profile can then be generated based on the initial set of tags and the initial traffic profile.

title: Skill generation method, device and electronic equipment
description: Embodiments of the present invention provide a skill generation method, device, and electronic device, wherein the skill generation method includes: generating distribution target information and corresponding tasks according to the establishment of demand instructions and demand content data; and responding to the distribution target information corresponding to the distribution target information Create a material library in response to the task's instructions; determine training materials from the material library according to the skill training instructions to generate skills based on the training materials. Through the embodiments of the present invention, the efficiency of skill development can be improved.

title: Conflicting evidence fusion method based on arithmetic mean closeness
description: The invention discloses a kind of conflicting evidence fusion methods based on arithmetic average approach degree, include the following steps: to obtain the BPA that multiple sensor measurement informations select suitable method to obtain evidence according to practical application scene, and be converted to evident information, it is introduced into arithmetic average Concept of Close Degree measurement evidence in fuzzy theory and the weight coefficient of fusion evidence is calculated using the arithmetic average approach degree between evidence to the mutual degree of support of same burnt member；Finally revised evidence is merged one by one using Dempster rule of combination, the result of decision of output final goal identification.Present invention introduces the arithmetic average approach degree methods in fuzzy mathematics, each evidence is measured to the mutual degree of support of same proposition using the arithmetic average approach degree of the Basic Probability As-signment of burnt member same in evidence, and revised evidence is merged one by one using Dempster rule of combination after being modified to evidence, there is important theory significance and application value.

title: Water pump equipment state prediction method based on improved particle swarm optimization BP neural network
description: A water pump equipment state prediction method based on an improved particle swarm optimization BP neural network comprises the following steps: step 1, carrying out noise reduction treatment on the vibration intensity data of a bearing at a driving end of water pump equipment by using a five-point three-time smoothing method; step 2, calculating delay time and embedding dimension of the vibration intensity by using a Cao method of a mutual information method, and performing phase space reconstruction on the vibration intensity data; step 3, dividing an input set and an output set to be used as a prediction model training sample set; step 4, optimizing the weight in the three-layer BP neural network by using an improved particle swarm algorithm; step 5, training to obtain a BP neural network model function; step 6, predicting the vibration intensity data of the drive end bearing in a period of time in the future by using a BP neural network model function to obtain a prediction set; and 7, analyzing the predicted concentrated vibration intensity to obtain the running state of the water pump equipment in a future period of time. The invention ensures the safe and reliable operation of the water pump equipment to the maximum extent.

title: Text similarity detection method based on deep learning for financial industry
description: The invention provides a text similarity detection method based on deep learning for the financial industry, which comprises the following steps: s1, step: and establishing a proper noun word library, obtaining a conditional probability model based on the conditional random field, and carrying out probability calculation through the conditional probability model. S2, sequentially taking out each word in the sentence by using the Bi-LSTM-RNN model, extracting information of the words, and embedding the information into the semantic vector so as to obtain semantic representation of the sentence. S3, analyzing the logical structure of the sentence according to the semantic information extracted by the neural network, organizing the sentence into a tree structure, and finally representing the paragraph in a vector tree mode. And S4, matching the extracted vector tree in the text with the historical data document in the database, and comparing the similarity from two angles respectively, wherein one is the similarity between the vector trees, and the other is the similarity between each node, so that a result is finally obtained.

title: High-temperature high-pressure jig dyeing machine temperature control method based on improved RBF neural network
description: The invention discloses a temperature control method for a high temperature and high pressure jigger based on an improved RBF neural network, comprising the following steps: S1, establishing a dye liquor temperature change curve model; S2, according to the actual measured value of the dye liquor temperature and the corresponding sampling time The dye liquor temperature in the dye liquor temperature change curve model calculates the temperature control deviation and sets the threshold value; S3, according to the relationship between the temperature control deviation and the set threshold value, the PD controller, the PID controller and/or the improved RBF neural network are respectively used. The PID controller controls the temperature of the dye liquor in sections until the value of the temperature control deviation is zero. The invention utilizes the feature learning method based on the improved RBF neural network and the PID controller to realize the self-adaptive control and adjustment of the temperature control system of the jigger under the harsh application environment, and ensures the high precision and high efficiency of the control process. Moreover, the control adjustment period is short, and the control efficiency is high.

title: For storing the method and apparatus for efficiently running neural network
description: The invention relates to a method for operating a computing system (1) having a neural network, in particular a convolutional neural network, wherein the computing system has computing means for the sequential calculation of the neural network (2) and a memory (4) external to said computing device for intermediate storage of intermediate results of said calculations in said computing device (2), said method having the following steps: - By means of neural The network progressively computes (S2, S3) data segments representing groups of intermediate results respectively, - lossily compresses (S5, S6, S7, S8) one or more of said data segments , in order to obtain compressed intermediate results, and - transmit (S9) said compressed intermediate results to said external memory (4).

title: Method and apparatus for generating information
description: The embodiment of the present disclosure discloses the method and apparatus for generating information.One specific embodiment of this method includes: to receive modeling request；According to the type of trained data and model classification, determine that destination number initial machine learns pipeline；It is executed using destination number initial machine study pipeline with drag generation step: pipeline is learnt based on destination number initial machine, generated destination number new engine and learn pipeline；Model training is carried out based on training data, destination number initial machine study pipeline and destination number new engine study pipeline, generates model after training；According to evaluation index, model after obtained training is assessed respectively；Determine whether to reach preset trained termination condition；Reach preset trained termination condition in response to determination, according to assessment result, the model after determining target training after obtained training in model.The automation that the embodiment realizes model generates.

title: Bone age assessment and height prediction model, its system and its prediction method
description: The invention discloses a kind of bone age assessment and prediction of height model, its system and its prediction technique, bone age assessment and prediction of height system include image acquisition unit and non-transient machine readable medium.Target hand bone X-ray image data of the image acquisition unit to obtain subject.Non-transient machine readable medium is to store program, when program is executed by processing unit to judge the hand bone development state of subject, stone age and the adult height for predicting subject.Whereby, bone age assessment of the invention and prediction of height system can effectively promote accuracy and the susceptibility of bone age assessment and prediction of height, and can shorten the judgement time of bone age assessment and prediction of height.

title: A picture screening method, device and electronic equipment
description: The invention discloses a picture screening method, device and electronic equipment, wherein the picture screening method comprises: obtaining a picture to be screened; inputting the picture to be screened into a text and picture recognition model to carry out recognition processing of a picture area containing text information to obtain a recognition result; When there is a picture area containing text information in the recognition result, the picture to be screened is selected as the target picture; wherein, the text picture recognition model includes feature data based on the target deep neural network model output, corresponding to the output A shallow neural network model for machine learning to determine the input picture and the label information corresponding to the input picture. The invention realizes the identification of whether the picture area in the picture contains text information based on the shallow neural network model with deep neural network model prediction ability, that is, the text and picture recognition model, which not only greatly improves the speed of picture screening, but also ensures the stability of the screening and screening accuracy.

title: A soft sensor modeling method for hydrocracking based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a hydrocracking soft measurement modeling method based on deep learning. The method comprises the steps that a timing program for respectively acquiring process data and quality data of a process history database and a production process quality detection LIMS database is compiled by Java, and process data are periodically acquired; selecting auxiliary variables required in soft measurement modeling according to prior knowledge of a hydrocracking process, and performing data preprocessing on corresponding process data; then, a network model combining a deep confidence network and a deep neural network is established, wherein the deep confidence network is used for extracting the characteristics of the complex nonlinear process data and reducing the data dimensionality, and the deep neural network is used for regressing and predicting the quality variable.

title: Image is repaired based on interim depth and improves the corn Spodopterafrugiperda detection method of Double-DQN technology
description: The present invention relates to repairing image based on interim depth and improving the corn Spodopterafrugiperda detection method of Double-DQN technology, solves different worm age corn Spodopterafrugiperdas compared with prior art and be difficult to the defect accurately detected.The present invention the following steps are included: training sample collection；Training sample is pre-processed；It constructs and trains different worm age corn Spodopterafrugiperda image detection models；The collection and pretreatment of corn Spodopterafrugiperda image to be detected and corresponding contextual information；The label of corn Spodopterafrugiperda specific location in corn image in different worm ages.The present invention merges the image stage reparation for realizing that large area lacks with Spodopterafrugiperda picture depth repairing model by constructing different worm age Spodopterafrugiperda edge graph models, different worm age corn Spodopterafrugiperdas and respective contexts information image detection model are trained on this basis, improve different worm age corn Spodopterafrugiperda image detections and recognition capability.

title: Context-based firewall for learning artificial intelligence entities
description: Content is provided that detects and blocks during the learning process that may cause Artificial Intelligence (AI) entities to produce undesirable behavior to the user. Input information for a set of one or more AI entities is received. Features of the input information are evaluated based on rules of a policy selected from a set of policies and learned features of information associated with a corpus of information. It is determined whether a result of evaluating the characteristic of the input information exceeds a predetermined threshold. In response to determining that a result of evaluating the characteristic of the input information exceeds a predetermined threshold, filtering the input information for the set of AI entities by performing a selective filtering action using the firewall based on the context of the input information.

title: Variable working condition bottom tool method for predicting residual useful life based on LSTM network
description: The invention discloses a kind of variable working condition bottom tool method for predicting residual useful life based on LSTM network, for solving the technical problem of existing cutter life prediction technique real-time difference.Technical solution is to extract wear characteristic from process monitoring signal using Hilbert-Huang transform, and multi-state factor processing operating condition scene is defined, by the incidence relation in the study processing of shot and long term memory network between operating condition scene and tool wear changing features, cutter remaining life is predicted.Since LSTM model fully considers the variation and its cumulative effect of operating condition scene and wear characteristic in time series, while the ambiguity of LSTM can spatially model operating condition scene and processing wear characteristic complexity correlativity.The present invention considers time-space relationship complicated between operating condition variation and tool wear under variable working condition scene, and practicability is good.Compared with prior art, prediction error reaches 0.01, and the neural network forecast accuracy rate of sample instance reaches 85% or more.

title: Product recommendation method and device
description: The present application relates to a product recommendation method and device; the method includes: acquiring a user's house interior scene image; identifying entity information in the house according to the house interior scene image; determining the product information to be recommended according to the identification result; Product information is pushed to users. The solution of the present application uses computer vision technology to process the interior scene image of the user's house, thereby judging the furniture, home appliances, etc. that the user may need to buy at home, and then pushes corresponding goods or services to the user according to the judgment result, so as to improve the accuracy of the recommendation, Improve user satisfaction, increase user conversion rate, increase user shopping satisfaction and repurchase rate, and save users time and effort to find product information.

title: A kind of implementation method of the generation confrontation network model generated for functional magnetic resonance imaging data
description: The invention discloses a method for realizing a generative confrontation network model used for generating functional nuclear magnetic resonance imaging data, which belongs to the field of machine learning. This method generates fMRI images through a generative confrontation network (GAN), and uses the generated images to mix with the original data set to expand the data set. The generative adversarial network structure proposed by the present invention includes a generator with five hidden layers and a discriminator using a skip connection residual module. The invention aims to use the fMRI images generated by the confrontation network to expand the data set, solve the problem of small amount of fMRI data, improve the generalization ability of the classification network, and reduce the risk of overfitting. The invention can effectively solve the problem of insufficient nuclear magnetic resonance imaging data in the brain disease classification process to assist doctors in diagnosing diseases.

title: Cloud trading system and method for providing similar neural network training model
description: A cloud trading system and method that provides a neural network-like training model. It mainly trains multiple data materials with different training programs to obtain different training models, which can be used by the user remotely through a third party. The trading platform conducts transactions, and under the supervision of the supervision unit, downloads the different training models mentioned above according to the transaction results, which allows the user to compare the accuracy differences between different training models, thereby promoting the accuracy of the training model.

title: Privacy Preserving Machine Learning
description: Provides new efficient protocols for privacy-preserving machine learning training (for example, for linear regression, logistic regression, and neural networks using stochastic gradient descent). The protocol may use a two-server model, where data owners distribute their private data between two non-colluding servers that train various models on the federated data using secure two-party computing (2PC). The new technique supports safe arithmetic operations on shared fractional numbers and proposes MPC-friendly alternatives to non-linear functions such as sigmoid and softmax.

title: Face sketch generation model and method in natural scene based on dynamic convolutional network
description: The invention discloses a face sketch generation model and a method under a natural scene based on a dynamic convolution network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, initializing all parameters of a convolution network and a full-connection network; s2, acquiring a face image, and extracting the layering characteristics of the face image by using a full convolution neural network; s3, performing up-sampling on the obtained features by using a transposed convolution network, and mining potential areas of the human face and information of the change form of the human face by using a deformable convolution network; s4, dividing the features into multi-scale regions, dynamically calculating self-adaptive filter weights in each region, carrying out convolution calculation on the filter weights and the features to obtain new features, and combining all the region features under multiple scales to generate a high-quality face sketch; s5, updating model parameters according to the comparison between the generated face sketch and the real face sketch; and S6, carrying out the training of the steps S2-S5 through multiple iterations.

title: A matrix convolution optimization operation method and circuit
description: The invention provides a matrix convolution optimization operation method and circuit, the circuit includes a multiplication operation unit, a matrix operation unit, and a data buffer unit; the matrix operation unit includes a first matrix operation unit and a second matrix operation unit; The multiplication operation unit includes a plurality of multipliers; the first matrix operation unit is configured to receive the first operation result of the multiplier connected to it, perform the first matrix operation, obtain the first matrix operation result, and calculate the first operation result of the first matrix operation. A matrix operation result is stored in the corresponding data buffer unit; the second matrix operation unit is used to obtain the first matrix operation result of the data buffer unit, perform the second matrix operation, obtain and output the second matrix operation result. The circuit designed by the above scheme can realize the related functions of the Winograd algorithm and reduce the amount of multiplication in the convolution process.

title: Deep learning in a two-memristive network
description: This paper describes a binary memristor network and a method for training such a network. In one example, the memristor network may include multiple nanofibers, each nanofiber comprising a metal core and a memristor shell. The memristor network may also include multiple electrodes placed on the nanofibers. A first set of multiple electrodes may include input electrodes in the memristor network, and a second set of multiple electrodes may include output electrodes in the memristor network. The memristor network may be embodied as a binary memristor network and trained according to the training method described herein.

title: Water level early warning monitoring method, device, storage medium and electronic equipment
description: The present application relates to a water level early warning monitoring method, device, storage medium and electronic equipment, which belong to the technical field of water level monitoring. The method includes: acquiring a first water level monitoring image of a predetermined water level monitoring location at a first time point, and dividing and obtaining A building structure feature map; periodically acquiring a second water level monitoring image at a second time point, and segmenting to obtain a second building structure feature map; obtaining a structural feature change area in the second building structure feature map relative to the first building structure feature map , and obtain the initial structural feature area corresponding to the structural feature change area in the first building structural feature map; extract multiple feature change subdomain sequences of the predetermined water level monitoring location; input the feature change subdomain sequence of the predetermined sequence into the machine learning model , and obtain the regular early warning risk value of the predetermined water level monitoring location. The present application realizes efficient and accurate water level monitoring and early warning based on the extraction of real-time feature change sub-domain sequences through a machine learning model.

title: A Situational Awareness Method for Operational Risks Considering Multi-level Vulnerabilities of Distribution Network
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric power engineering, and in particular relates to an operation risk situation awareness method considering multi-level weak links of a distribution network. The invention utilizes the historical operation data of the distribution network, weather data, static parameters and other data to construct a multi-level operation state prediction model of the distribution network. The operation severity of the distribution network is measured by the degree of operation state violation, and the operation risk at the next moment is calculated in combination with the occurrence probability of the operation state, so as to identify the weak link of the distribution network and help the control center to realize the real-time monitoring of the distribution network operation risk. early warning.

title: An end-to-end video timing behavior detection method based on R-C3D network
description: The invention discloses an end-to-end video time sequence behavior detection method based on an R-C3D network, belonging to the field of computer vision and comprising the following steps: performing frame rate adjustment and frame extraction on an input video, and normalizing and data enhancing the extracted frames to be used as a training set and a test set; constructing a time sequence behavior detection model; the time sequence behavior detection model comprises a feature extraction module, a long-term information coding module and a behavior identification module; the long-time information coding module is used for coding the extracted feature graph to obtain features containing long-time information; inputting the training set and the test set into a time sequence behavior detection model for training; and inputting the video to be detected into a trained time sequence behavior detection model for detection to obtain the behavior category and the positioning information existing in the video. According to the invention, the long-term information coding network is designed, and the extracted features are coded, so that the network can obtain the global time information of the time sequence action, and the accuracy of action positioning and classification is improved.

title: Wind turbine state parameter prediction method based on improved deep belief network
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of electrical equipment fault diagnosis methods, and particularly relates to a wind turbine state parameter prediction method based on an improved deep belief network, which firstly optimizes data samples and input parameter selection, improves the parameter training process of the deep belief network by utilizing a genetic algorithm, the state parameter prediction model based on the improved deep belief network is constructed by taking the prediction precision of the state parameter prediction model as a target, the model constructed by the invention can effectively predict the temperature of the rear end bearing of the generator, the validity of the state parameter prediction model based on the genetic optimization deep belief network is verified, the model can find abnormal information of the state parameters in time and is beneficial to sensing the abnormal running state of the wind turbine generator in time, therefore, serious faults of the wind turbine generator are avoided, and the method has important significance for safe and stable operation of the wind turbine generator.

title: A big data classification method for scientific and technological literature
description: The invention relates to a big data classification method for scientific and technological documents, and belongs to the technical field of big data text mining; the method S1 is to construct a topological relationship graph: the graph is composed of nodes and edges, and the nodes are keywords in documents, sentences and STKOS; For documents and sentences, documents and keywords, sentences and sentences, sentences and keywords, and the relationship between keywords and keywords; S2. Convert the topological relationship graph into a topological relationship matrix; S3. Use training data and its constructed The topological relationship matrix trains the classification model; S4, document classification: input the batch of documents to be classified into the trained classification model, and obtain the probability that the documents to be classified belong to different categories. Compared with the prior art, in the topological relationship diagram constructed by the present invention, the sentence takes into account the factor of word order, and the keywords are terms indexed by experts, which improves the classification accuracy; The input of the product layer is sampled and calculated, which improves the classification efficiency.

title: Sound detection method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: This invention discloses a sound detection method, apparatus, device, and storage medium. The sound detection method includes: obtaining sound waveform image data based on an acquired sound signal to be detected; inputting the sound waveform image data into a sound detection model to obtain the fault type of the sound signal to be detected; wherein the sound detection model is trained using waveform features of sample sound signals, sound waveform image data, and fault types. This invention uses the sound detection model to judge the sound waveform image data of the sound signal to be detected to obtain the fault type of the sound signal. It achieves real-time fault type judgment of the sound signal by collecting sound signals during the operation of the printing device, avoiding printing errors caused by inaccurate or untimely fault type judgment, thereby improving the operating efficiency of the printing device.

title: Deep learning-based nano structure design method
description: The invention provides a nano-structure design method based on deep learning, which comprises the following steps: establishing a training data set containing any one kind of nano-structure information; preprocessing the training data set to transpose and normalize the data in the training data set; constructing a Spectrum Prediction Network (SPN) and a geometric shape prediction network (GPN); integrating the spectrum prediction network SPN and the geometric shape prediction network GPN into a neural network model, wherein the output of the spectrum prediction network SPN is connected with the input of the geometric shape prediction network GPN; training the integrated neural network model by using the preprocessed training data set, and finishing the training of the neural network model when the loss function reaches a preset value; inputting the frequency spectrums and the material properties of the X and Y polarization directions corresponding to the nano structure to be established into the trained neural network model, so as to obtain 8 nano structure characterization points of the nano structure and further obtain the geometric shape of the nano structure.

title: A kind of video cropping method and server
description: Embodiments of the present application disclose a video cropping method and server, wherein the method is provided with a target object in the video; the method includes: determining the object contour of the target object in the current frame of the video; Determine the target area in the current frame, and determine the image in the target area as the cropped frame of the current frame; wherein, in the video, between the center coordinates of the target area in the current frame and the center coordinates of the target area in the previous frame The first offset degree is less than or equal to the specified offset degree threshold, and the proportion of the part of the object outline contained in the target area in the current frame is greater than or equal to the specified proportion; according to the cropped frame determined from the video, the corresponding video is generated. cropped video. The technical solutions provided by the embodiments of the present application can prevent the jitter phenomenon of the clipped video, thereby improving the viewing effect of the clipped video.

title: Pedestrian recognition method based on light field camera and deep transfer learning
description: A pedestrian recognition method based on light field camera and deep transfer learning, the steps are: ① using light field camera to obtain multiple pedestrian images; ② using Lytro desktop software to obtain color pedestrian images and depth pedestrian images; Color images and depth images are preprocessed and reduced to a uniform size, and the images are divided into positive and negative samples to obtain a light field image dataset; ④Model initialization; ⑤Using the existing VGG16 images trained on the ImageNet dataset Classify the model, freeze the previous convolution block, retain the parameters of the last convolution block, and obtain the initial value of the neural network; ⑥ The color pedestrian image and the deep pedestrian image in step ① are processed by the neural network in ④ to obtain a mixture. Convolution features; ⑦ Repeated training of the neural network and fine-tuning of the model are performed according to the convolution features obtained in ⑥ to obtain a new classification model. Using the present invention can effectively improve the accuracy and robustness of the pedestrian detection method.

title: Method for improving algorithm of goblet sea squirt group
description: The invention discloses a method for improving the salp swarm algorithm, aiming at the shortcomings of the salp swarm algorithm that cannot perform accurate search in the later stage of iteration and poor population diversity, and improves the salp swarm algorithm. By adding an attenuation factor, the size of the search range can be flexibly controlled, which speeds up the algorithm's convergence speed. By introducing a dynamic learning strategy, the follower's role in assisting the optimization is strengthened, the algorithm achieves higher convergence accuracy, and the salp group is improved. Optimized performance of the algorithm. The improved salps group algorithm has greatly improved the convergence accuracy and convergence speed.

title: Neural network processors, chips and electronic devices
description: The embodiment of the present application provides a neural network processor, a chip and an electronic device, wherein the neural network processor comprises: a first processing module, the first processing module comprises a convolution processing unit having a dedicated register; a general register, the general register being connected to the convolution processing unit; and a load storage module, the load storage module being connected to the general register, the load storage module being also connected to the convolution processing unit through the dedicated register; the load storage module being used to load data to at least one of the general register and the dedicated register of the convolution processing unit. The embodiment of the present application can improve the speed at which the neural network processor loads data.

title: A network optimization method for bevel-tip flexible needle path tracking based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The invention belongs to the field of puncture needle path tracking, and discloses a network optimization method for tracking a slant-tip flexible needle path based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: (1) constructing a simulation environment based on a bicycle model with a slant-tip flexible needle; (2) initializing the whole oblique-tip flexible needle model, and simultaneously giving a preset tracking path; (3) constructing an action network and a target action network; (4) storing the whole of [ s (t), a (t), s (t +1) and R (t +1) ] into the replay variable of the experience pool as a sample until the replay variable is saturated; (5) randomly taking a plurality of samples as training samples, training the action network and the target action network, and simultaneously ensuring the convergence of the two networks; and the trained convergent action network is the action network for tracking the path of the oblique-tip flexible needle. The action network obtained by the optimization method can be used for tracking the complex three-dimensional puncture path of the flexible needle, and has smaller path tracking error compared with the traditional method based on duty ratio.

title: Methods for Machine Learning via Gaussian Processes
description: Methods for machine learning via Gaussian processes. A computer-implemented method for machine learning by Gaussian process GP, having the following steps: selecting an accuracy target, selecting a prior GP family parameterized by hyperparameters, obtaining a training data set, selecting a GP parameterization to model, in The GP is trained by optimizing the PAC Bayesian bounds using the training dataset, prior GP family and accuracy target, and the next expected value is predicted by the trained GP.

title: BP neural network-based software function point number estimation method
description: The present invention relates to a method for estimating software function points based on BP neural network, comprising: 1) merging the same data storage and the same transaction in each group of data processed based on the IFPUG function point evaluation method to obtain new data containing seven attributes ; Among them, the seven attributes are data storage DET1, transaction DET2, FTR, transaction type, data storage type, operands, and function points; 2) Use BP neural network to train and obtain the software function point estimation model; 3) Based on training Good software function point estimation models estimate software function points. The invention improves the original method for estimating function points, reduces errors in calculating transaction complexity factors, and has great significance for improving the accuracy of software scale evaluation.

title: Instruction execution method, apparatus, device and storage medium
description: The present application discloses an instruction execution method, apparatus, device and storage medium. The method not only ensures the normal execution of the instructions without execution dependencies in the batch process, but also ensures the orderly execution of the instructions with execution dependencies, thereby ensuring the correctness of the execution results of the instructions. In addition, the present application also provides an instruction execution apparatus, equipment and storage medium, the beneficial effects are the same as those described above.

title: Text classification method and system, electronic device, computer-readable storage medium
description: The invention relates to a text classification method and system, electronic equipment and computer-readable storage medium. The text classification method is to add an input layer of a BERT pre-training model and participate in the training, and classify the text to be classified based on the classification model obtained after training. Recognition; the added input layer is the feature representation layer for auxiliary classification and recognition. By increasing the input layer of the BERT pre-training model, the present invention increases the amount of reference features in the text classification and recognition of the model, so the accuracy of text classification can be improved. In addition, the present invention does not change the structure of the BERT pre-training model, so there is no need to request Google, which provides the BERT pre-training model, to improve the BERT model, that is, the method of the present invention is not limited by the basic model provider company, nor does it exist Any inconvenience issues.

title: Integrated circuit chip devices and related products
description: The present disclosure provides an integrated circuit chip device and related products, the integrated circuit chip device includes: an integrated circuit chip device, and the integrated circuit chip device includes: a main processing circuit, k branch processing circuits and k groups of basic processing circuits, The main processing circuit is connected to the k branch processing circuits respectively, and each branch processing circuit in the k branch processing circuits corresponds to a group of basic processing circuits in the k group of basic processing circuits, and the group of basic processing circuits includes at least A basic processing circuit; the branch processing circuit includes: a data type operation circuit for performing conversion between floating-point type data and fixed-point type data. The technical solution provided by the present disclosure has the advantages of small calculation amount and low power consumption.

title: Prediction Method of Highway Passenger Traffic Based on SBS-BP Neural Network
description: The invention aims to provide a road passenger capacity prediction method based on an SBS-BP neural network, wherein a mathematical prediction model of the road passenger capacity is established by using the BP neural network, and the BP algorithm model is improved by using the optimization characteristics of an SBS algorithm, so that the performance of the prediction model of the road passenger capacity is more excellent.

title: Intelligent communication assistant with audio interface
description: Methods, systems, and computer programs for an intelligent communications assistant with an audio interface are presented. A method includes operations for obtaining a message addressed to a user. The messages are from one or more message sources and each message includes message data including text. The method further includes operations for: the message data is analyzed to determine a meaning of each message, a score is generated for each message based on the respective message data and meaning of each message, and a text summary is generated for the message based on the message score and meaning of the message. A voice summary is created based on the text summary and the voice summary is then sent to a speaker associated with the user. The audio interface also allows the user to verbally request an action for the message.

title: A method for sensing and calibration of a short-range robotic arm
description: The present invention particularly relates to a method for sensing and calibrating a short-range robotic arm, which includes the following steps: Step 1. Data collection is performed, and the collected data includes RGB images and depth images of the robot, and according to the collected RGB images, The depth image obtains the three-dimensional coordinates of each axis joint of the robot arm in the current state; step 2, using the three-dimensional coordinates of each axis joint of the robot arm obtained in step 1, to construct a multi-target perception calibration neural network; Step 3, using the above perception The robot pose detection model is obtained by calibrating the neural network. Using the robot pose detection model, when the robot RGB image is input, the pixel coordinates of the robot key points in the image and the depth value of the key points can be obtained. The invention can perceive the mechanical arm in a short range, and obtain the three-dimensional position and position and attitude information of the mechanical arm, so as to meet the requirements of the fine work of the robot.

title: A space-based crowd counting method based on underlying feature extraction
description: The invention discloses a space-based crowd counting method based on underlying feature extraction, which belongs to the field of aviation surveillance. First, the UAV obtains the scene graph to be detected and preliminarily processes it, and then uses the convolutional neural network to extract the underlying features, and uses the attention mechanism to generate the attention feature map for the above-mentioned underlying features. Then use the decoder to decode the low-level features and attention feature maps to obtain high-level features. Then, a convolution layer operation with a convolution kernel size of 1 is used on the high-level features to obtain a feature map D  out  with a channel of 1. Finally, the bilinear interpolation method is used to gradually restore the spatial resolution of the feature map D  out  to obtain the final crowd density map, and the pixel values in the crowd density map are summed to obtain the number of crowds in the scene map to be detected. The crowd density map generated by the present invention is clearer, and the position of the crowd can be positioned more accurately.

title: Multiple myeloma bone marrow elephant identification equipment based on computer vision
description: The invention discloses multiple myeloma bone marrow image identification equipment based on computer vision, which belongs to the field of computer vision, and comprises an image processing module, a memory module and a memory module, wherein the image processing module is used for identifying cells on each original myeloma picture, marking the types of the cells and outlining the boundary of each cell to obtain each marked myeloma picture; the pre-training module is used for pre-training the neural network based on a preset tumor cell picture and a corresponding labeled picture; the training module is used for training the pre-trained neural network by taking each original myeloma picture and each marked myeloma picture as a training set to obtain a trained target neural network; and the output module is used for obtaining a prediction result of the multiple myeloma picture to be identified based on the target neural network, wherein the prediction result comprises a predicted labeled picture, and the predicted labeled picture comprises cell boundaries and cell types. The computer aided diagnosis of the invention has the characteristics of low cost, high reusability, high speed and the like.

title: A recognition method for occluded faces based on joint loss function
description: The invention discloses a recognition method for occluded faces based on a joint loss function, comprising the following steps: collecting RGB face images of a YALE data set, an ORL data set and an AgeDB data set, and dividing the RGB face images into training set and test set; randomly generate face images of 1/4 face occluded parts according to the training set, and flip the face images of the 1/4 face occluded parts vertically and horizontally; The face image of the face occlusion part is input to the Resnet residual network to extract the high-dimensional features of the face; the high-dimensional features of the face are input to the joint loss function layer to separate and obtain several clustered high-dimensional image features; Calculate the Euclidean distance between the test set and the high-dimensional image features in the Resnet residual network, and set the distance threshold. If the Euclidean distance is greater than the distance threshold, it is the same person; otherwise, it is a different person.

title: An advertising bidding method, device and electronic device
description: The embodiment of the specification provides an advertisement bidding method, an advertisement bidding device and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an advertisement bid request, wherein the advertisement bid request comprises information associated with a user; judging whether the user is a target user or not according to the information, and acquiring user characteristic data and advertisement characteristic data of the target user when the user is the target user; inputting user characteristic data into a first machine learning model to obtain a first conversion probability of the target user, wherein the first conversion probability represents a natural conversion probability; inputting the user characteristic data and the advertisement characteristic data into a second machine learning model to obtain a second conversion probability of the target user, wherein the second conversion probability represents the exposure conversion probability; and calculating to obtain a third conversion probability according to the first conversion probability and the second conversion probability, wherein the third conversion probability represents net conversion probability, and bidding the advertisement based on the third conversion probability.

title: Image processing method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present disclosure relates to an image processing method and apparatus, an electronic device, and a storage medium. The image processing method comprises the following steps: determining a target area according to the image set to be processed; cutting the image set to be processed according to the target area to obtain more than two sub-images to be processed; and performing first prediction according to at least one sub-image to be processed to obtain a first prediction result corresponding to the image set to be processed. Through the process, the interference of irrelevant image parts can be effectively reduced, and the efficiency of subsequent cutting and prediction is improved; meanwhile, the image set to be processed is cut before prediction, so that the calculated amount in each prediction process is greatly reduced, and the prediction efficiency and accuracy are improved.

title: Neural network machine translation method, model and model forming method
description: The invention relates to a neural network machine translation method, a model and a model forming method. A method of forming a neural network machine translation model includes: forming an encoder comprising a first multi-head attention model; forming a decoder comprising a second multi-head attention model and a future information model representing the current predicted word and merging the first attention hidden layer representation of the generated word and the second attention hidden layer representation of the current predicted word and possible future words; forming a first machine translation model through the encoder and decoder; and interpreting the first machine translation The model is trained on left-to-right and right-to-left decoding of the source language sequence to form a neural network machine translation model, where the first multi-head attention model and the future information model provide input to the second multi-head attention model . The invention solves the problem that the future information cannot be fully utilized when predicting the current word in the process of machine translation.

title: A gender-constrained fully intelligent facial expression recognition method and system
description: The invention discloses a gender-constrained fully intelligent facial expression recognition method and system, including four steps of facial feature extraction, facial gender estimation, conditional random forest training, and gender-conditional random forest-based facial expression recognition. After face detection and image quality evaluation are performed on the input face image, it is sent to the pre-trained deep neural network for learning and extraction of deep learning features, and based on the extracted face features, the random forest classification method is used to perform human Face gender estimation, based on the extracted face features and their gender attributes, uses conditional random forest for facial expression recognition. The robust facial expression recognition method based on deep learning and conditional random forest proposed by the present invention solves the problem of facial expression recognition in uncontrollable environments and small samples, and solves the problem that deep learning methods need a large number of training samples to support , while improving the accuracy and effectiveness of facial expression recognition in uncontrolled environments.

title: Text processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: This application relates to a text processing method, device, computer equipment, and storage medium, which may involve the processing of big data, and can also perform accurate recommendations based on user portraits and semantically related texts obtained through processing, and can also perform accurate recommendations based on artificial intelligence models. The method includes: obtaining the initial relevant text corresponding to the target object; obtaining the target corrosion structural element; according to the position of the corrosion reference point corresponding to the target corrosion structural element, obtaining the target text element in the initial relevant text; The target corrosion structure element is compared with the target text element to obtain a target comparison result; when the target comparison result is consistent, the initial relevant text is corroded to obtain the semantic related text corresponding to the target object. By adopting the method, the text processing efficiency can be improved.

title: Hybrid genetic algorithm-based LED chip mounter pick-and-place path optimization method
description: A method for optimizing a pick-and-paste path of an LED placement machine based on a hybrid genetic algorithm relates to an optimization method for a pick-and-paste path of a placement machine. The purpose of the present invention is to solve the problems of long pick-up and paste path obtained by the prior method and low working efficiency of LED chip production. The process is: 1. Preparatory work before production, import machine parameters and PCB data file information; 2. According to the machine parameters and PCB data file information determined in 1. Determine the feeder slot allocation position that makes the placement head move the shortest distance ;3. Plan the pick-and-paste path of the parallel placement head, take the midpoint of the feeder slot allocation determined in 2 as the starting point and end point of the pick-up path optimization, and use the hybrid genetic algorithm to search for the feasible solution of the pick-up path, and keep the The solution with the shortest placement path; 4. The solution with the shortest placement path found in the third is output as the optimal solution. The invention is used in the fields of electrical technology and electrical engineering.

title: A kind of image fusion quality detection method and device
description: The application discloses an image fusion quality detection method and device. The method comprises the steps of searching a tracked image frame from each frame of a video image; respectively carrying out image fusion on a plurality of tracked person images according to a wavelet transform image fusion method, a contour wavelet fusion method and a scale invariant feature transform image fusion method; and respectively calculating average gradients according to the fusion results, and judging the image fusion quality according to the average gradients. By adopting the image fusion quality detection method provided by the application, the quality of image fusion is detected by calculating the average gradient of three different image fusion modes, and the tracked person is better positioned.

title: Audio recognition model training method, audio recognition method, device and equipment
description: The present application provides a training method for an audio recognition model, an audio recognition method, device and equipment, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence. Wherein, the training method obtains a training data set, the training data set includes a plurality of preset lengths of training sample data marked with note category labels, and the training sample data includes audio feature data and the player's actions corresponding to the audio feature data Feature data, and then through the neural network model, the audio recognition model obtained by using the note category label, the audio feature data in the training data set and the corresponding player's action feature data can be used for the identification and segmentation of the note category in the audio data , compared with manual identification and segmentation, it can save time and effort, save labor costs, and can improve the accuracy of note category identification and segmentation.

title: Control method, device, storage medium and self-moving device for self-moving equipment
description: The present application relates to a control method, device, storage medium and self-moving device for self-moving equipment, and belongs to the field of computer technology. The method includes: acquiring an environmental image collected by the image acquisition component; The computing resources occupied when the model runs are lower than the maximum computing resources provided by the self-mobile device; control the environment image to be input into the image recognition model to obtain an object recognition result, and the object recognition result is used to indicate the category of the target object; Solve the problem that the existing image recognition algorithm has high requirements on the hardware of the sweeping robot, which leads to the limited application scope of the object recognition function of the sweeping robot; by using the image recognition model that consumes less computing resources to identify the target object in the environmental image, it can be The hardware requirements of the object recognition method for self-mobile devices are reduced, and the application scope of the object recognition method is expanded.

title: Apparatus and method for improved subsurface data processing system
description: A method and apparatus for subsurface data processing includes determining a set of clusters based at least in part on measurement vectors associated with different depths or times in the subsurface data; defining the clusters in the subsurface data by classes associated with a state model; reducing the amount of subsurface data based at least in part on the classes, and storing the reduced amount of subsurface data and the classes with the state models in a training database for a machine learning process.

title: Building change detection method based on high-resolution satellite optical remote sensing imagery based on deep learning
description: The deep learning-based high-resolution satellite optical remote sensing image building change detection method includes step 1 to outline the vector range of the building on the remote sensing satellite images of the same resolution and the same area in multiple phases; Step 3: Make a sample; Step 4: Expand the sample; Step 5: Build a building classification network 1; 7, 8: classification network parameters and remaining parameter training; step 9 uses the trained network parameters to perform building classification detection and change detection, morphological processing of the detection results, and vectorization of the training results; step 10 The classification results are compared with the manual calibration results, and the samples are optimized and retrained. The above technical solutions effectively detect changes, and obtain the change areas of new buildings and reduced buildings.

title: A multi-precision optimization algorithm based on deep learning to realize aerodynamic optimization design method
description: The invention provides a method for realizing pneumatic optimization design by a multi-precision optimization algorithm based on deep learning, which realizes complex pneumatic appearance optimization design by combining a multi-precision deep neural network with a parallel point adding method. The multi-precision deep neural network (MFDNN) can adaptively learn linear or non-linear relationships between low-precision data sets and high-precision data sets without any a priori knowledge. Meanwhile, global optimization is carried out on the proxy model by utilizing PSO, and the current optimal solution is found for updating sample points of the high-precision data set, so that the optimization precision of the proxy model is improved; and for the low-precision data set, measuring the distance between the sample points by solving the Euclidean distance between the sample points, and updating the positions of the sample points lacking the sample points, so as to generate the sample points uniformly distributed in the whole design domain. The method is good in universality and simple to implement, the aerodynamic appearance of the aircraft is optimized and designed by the method, and the aerodynamic performance of the aircraft is remarkably improved.

title: Dynamic target grabbing gesture rapid detection method based on heterogeneous depth network fusion
description: The invention belongs to the field of target detection and robot operation, and discloses a method for rapidly detecting a dynamic target grabbing gesture based on heterogeneous depth network fusion. The method comprises the following steps: 1. the method for manufacturing the dynamic target sample set comprises the following steps of; 2. the training method of the heterogeneous depth network comprises the following steps of; 3. a fusion mechanism of heterogeneous depth networks; 4. a method for determining grabbing gesture. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an RGB image and a depth image of a dynamic target object to be detected through a depth camera, carrying out target recognition on the RGB image and the depth image through an I-type depth network, obtaining point cloud information of a boundary frame and a central area of the target, selecting proper point cloud through a heterogeneous fusion mechanism, inputting the point cloud into an II-type depth network, carrying out grabbing gesture recognition, and further obtaining a final grabbing gesture detection result. The method can fully exert the advantages of networks with different depths, can rapidly extract the core characteristics of the dynamic target, and further realizes efficient and stable grabbing gesture detection and recognition.

title: Cardiac MR image automatic segmentation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention provides a left ventricular MR image segmentation method based on Dilated-DenseNet convolutional network. This method uses atrous convolution to alleviate the problems of gradient disappearance and excessive memory consumption in deep learning, and improves the accuracy of the network through data enhancement and extraction of regions of interest. The segmentation results are evaluated and analyzed using indicators such as the minimum average Euclidean distance and the Dice coefficient. The test results on 138 pictures of the MICCAI2009 ventricular segmentation data set are: the average Dice coefficients of the inner and outer membranes are 0.9135 and 0.9579, and the minimum average Euclidean distances are 1.7134 and 1.4165, respectively. The experimental results show that the segmentation accuracy of this method is significantly higher than that of the traditional method, and it can also accurately segment MR images containing the left ventricular outflow tract.

title: An Unsupervised Automatic News Classification Method
description: The present invention relates to the field of information classification, more specifically, relates to an unsupervised automatic classification method for news, comprising the following steps: Step 1: check the acquired news for plagiarism through the simhash method; Step 2: generate a vocabulary vector table for the news through word2vec Step 3: Calculate the word frequency-inverse text frequency index value of the vocabulary in the news, obtain the weighted average sum according to the vocabulary vector table for the first k key words, to obtain the document vector table of the news; Step 4: through logistic regression, for Calculate the classification model for each type of news; step five: calculate the document vector table in the unclassified news database, and calculate the probability that the text in the news database belongs to a certain category through the classification model in step four. The training process of this classification method adopts an unsupervised learning method, which does not require human marking, which speeds up the speed and reduces the burden on manpower; after the model is trained, it takes a short time to calculate the classification of text, which can meet the needs of a large number of text classification .

title: An image scene classification method based on image saliency and transfer learning
description: The invention discloses an image scene classification method based on image significance and transfer learning, which comprises the following steps of: 1. extracting sample images of different scenes, and forming an image set after the images are zoomed; 2. extracting a salient region of each image in the image set; 3. amplifying the images of the salient region of each image obtained in the step 2, constructing a salient image set, and dividing the salient image set into a training set and a testing set according to a proportion; 4. establishing a scene classification network model based on a general VGG16 model, and performing transfer learning operation; 5. training and testing the network built in the step 4 by using the training set and the test set obtained in the step 3; 6. carrying out image scene classification by using the network established in the step 4 and obtained by training in the step 5; according to the method, the problem of insufficient discrimination performance caused by insufficient training samples in practical application is effectively solved by utilizing deep transfer learning, and secondly, the method adopts significant region extraction to process a data set, so that the efficiency and accuracy of scene classification are significantly improved.

title: Removing false alarms in the beamforming stage of a sensing radar using deep neural networks
description: Processor-implemented methods and systems are provided that use convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to perform target verification on spectral response maps to remove False alarm detection. The processor-implemented method includes: generating a spectral response map from radar data; and when the response map does not represent valid target detection, executing the CNN to determine whether the response map represents valid target detection and converting the response to a Graphs are classified as false alarms. After executing the CNN, only response graphs with valid targets are processed to generate direction-of-arrival (DOA) commands from them.

title: A face registration method and authentication method
description: The invention relates to the field of security authentication, and proposes a face registration method. The registration method includes: obtaining a frontal photo, a right side photo and a left side photo of a human face; performing facial feature point recognition on the front photo, extracting Facial feature vector to complete the 2D face registration; identify the position of the facial feature points in the right and left side photos respectively, and synthesize the three-dimensional space of each facial feature point with the corresponding facial feature points in the frontal photo Coordinates; the 3D registration is completed with the three-dimensional space coordinates of each facial feature point. At the same time, the present invention also provides a corresponding face authentication method. The invention combines the advantages of two-dimensional face recognition and three-dimensional recognition, improves the security, and reduces the complexity of the algorithm.

title: Object detection method and device
description: The embodiment of the present application discloses an object detection method and device; the present application provides an object detection method in the field of computer vision of artificial intelligence; the embodiment of the present application collects object images of at least two channels to obtain at least two object images , where one object image corresponds to one channel, the reference object image is determined from at least two object images, the object detection is performed on the reference object image, and the position information of the reference object area is obtained, based on the position information of the reference object area, from each channel The object region is extracted from the object image obtained by the method to obtain at least two object region images, and the object region image of each channel is subjected to object detection to obtain the object detection result of each channel; this scheme can improve the speed of multi-channel object detection.

title: Power grid engineering accurate investment decision simulation method based on full-factor data mining
description: The invention discloses a power grid engineering accurate investment decision simulation method and system based on full-factor data mining, and solves the problem that the decision result is not accurate due to incomplete factors considered by the traditional investment decision simulation technology. The invention adopts a Frisch comprehensive analysis method, carries out multilevel mining analysis on all-factor influence factors from macro, mesoscopic and microscopic levels, combines the macro factors and mesoscopic factors, establishes an investment scale prediction model by utilizing system dynamics, and corrects the investment scale according to a power grid income coefficient. The method comprises the steps of establishing a power grid project investment evaluation index system according to microscopic factors, evaluating power grid reserve projects, and then optimizing power grid project investment by using an investment scale as a constraint and adopting a genetic algorithm.

title: Frequency offset time vernier measurement method and system and computer readable storage medium
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for measuring a frequency deviation time vernier and a computer readable storage medium, belongs to the technical field of frequency deviation measurement, and solves the problem of low measurement precision of the frequency deviation time vernier in the prior art. A frequency offset time vernier measurement method comprises the following steps: acquiring a carrier signal to obtain an initial estimated value of a carrier frequency; taking the initial estimated value of the carrier frequency as the initial value of a tracking loop, and estimating the carrier frequency again by using the tracking loop to obtain the estimated carrier frequency again; sending a sine wave signal with fixed offset with the carrier frequency to the mobile station, acquiring the frequency of the sine wave signal, and acquiring the phase discrimination value of the sine wave signal and the carrier signal according to the frequency of the sine wave signal and the estimated carrier frequency again; and obtaining a frequency deviation time vernier according to the acceleration and the angular acceleration of the gyroscope and the phase identifying value. The frequency deviation time vernier measuring method improves the measuring precision of the frequency deviation time vernier.

title: SQL sentence security detection method, device, equipment and medium based on machine learning
description: The invention relates to artificial intelligence, and provides a SQL statement security detection method, a device, equipment and a medium based on machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: when an SQL access request is received, the access request is analyzed to obtain data to be detected, a TF-IDF algorithm is adopted to perform feature extraction on the data to be detected to obtain feature word segmentation, a hidden Markov model is used to perform text anomaly detection on the feature word segmentation to obtain a detection result, the rationality of the SQL access request is rapidly detected, the efficiency of security detection is improved, when the detection result is abnormal, the threat of the data to be detected is confirmed, and the SQL access request is intercepted.

title: Flexible robot end arrival control method, electronic device and storage medium
description: The present invention discloses a method for controlling the arrival of a flexible robot end, an electronic device and a storage medium, the method comprising: establishing a dynamic model of the flexible robot; establishing a deep neural network according to the dynamic model, the deep neural network being used to fit the dynamic model; performing preliminary training of the deep neural network in the first arrival process of the flexible robot end to obtain initial parameters of the deep neural network; performing preliminary training of the deep neural network in the second arrival process of the flexible robot to obtain final parameters of the deep neural network. The present invention reduces the uncertainty of the dynamic model of the flexible robot or the influence of external disturbances on the control system, and improves the terminal control accuracy of the flexible robot.

title: Number recognition device and method and electronic equipment
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a number identification device and method and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: training a training model for number recognition by using a training image; performing coordinate transformation on a certain training image, and taking one or more images subjected to coordinate transformation as a positive sample of training data; using the training model to detect the number in the image to be detected; and combining one or more digits obtained by the single-digit detection to obtain the number in the image to be detected. Therefore, even under the condition of less training samples, the training of the classifier can be simply and rapidly finished, and the high recognition precision is achieved.

title: Video analysis method combining target detection and human body posture estimation
description: The invention relates to a video analysis method combining target detection and human body posture estimation, which comprises the steps of obtaining a field camera video stream through a streaming media server, and intercepting a video frame to obtain a decoded picture; performing rapid target detection on each obtained picture by adopting a deep learning algorithm to find out target objects of all identifiable categories; judging whether a person exists, and sequentially analyzing dangerous behaviors and dangerous scenes of the pictures; in the process of carrying out dangerous behavior analysis and dangerous scene analysis, if a dangerous event is found, an alarm is reported and pushed to a display platform in time; and continuously analyzing the video stream in real time. According to the video analysis method, the target detection and human body posture estimation algorithm are combined, the video analysis method is introduced into the field of intelligent monitoring and identification of the infrastructure video, dangerous behaviors or scenes can be identified, the labor force for manually staring at the screen in the traditional monitoring can be liberated, and the efficiency of infrastructure safety management is greatly improved.

title: A method and system for detecting and extracting information of live broadcast events of e-sports events
description: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a method and a system for detecting live events of electric competitions and extracting information, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring frame data in the live stream of the electronic competition, and entering the step S2; s2, detecting the event of the extracted frame data picture, if the occurrence of the event is detected, the step goes to S3, and if the occurrence of the event is not detected, the step returns to S1; s3, the information of the occurrence of the event is extracted from the frame data picture in which the occurrence of the event is detected, and the flow is ended. The method solves the problems that the event detection in the electric competition is poor in intelligentization, real-time detection cannot be carried out, and the accuracy of a detection result is low at present, and also solves the problem that the information in the event cannot be extracted in real time by using the method for extracting the event information in the electric competition.

title: Node penetration testing method and device based on reinforcement learning and storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a node penetration testing method, apparatus, and storage medium based on reinforcement learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an infiltration tool set used for performing an infiltration test on a current node group, wherein the infiltration tool set comprises a plurality of infiltration tools, and each infiltration tool corresponds to an infiltration forming power value; selecting a corresponding penetration tool from the penetration tool set according to a preset condition, and performing penetration test on the current node group; and returning the penetration test result to adjust the penetration forming power value of the selected penetration tool according to the penetration test result. In this way, optimal tool selection and dynamic response can be achieved, while the complex network environment may not be considered.

title: Information recommendation method, device, electronic device and readable storage medium
description: The present application relates to the field of Internet technology, and discloses an information recommendation method, device, electronic device, and readable storage medium. The information recommendation method includes: respectively acquiring terminal usage records of multiple users; the terminal usage records include each user's The usage time of multiple application programs of the user terminal and the types of the correspondingly used application programs; based on the terminal usage records of the multiple users, determine the fuzzy relationship between the multiple users; classify the multiple users based on the fuzzy relationship, A classification result is obtained; based on the classification result, recommendation information is sent to user terminals of multiple users. The information recommendation method provided by the present application can improve the accuracy of classification, so that appropriate information can be recommended to corresponding users in an appropriate time period to achieve accurate recommendation.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle attitude control method based on Openpos and Alexnet
description: The invention relates to the field of human-computer interaction, and provides an unmanned aerial vehicle posture control method.
