Therefore, the technical scheme adopted by the invention is that the gesture control method is based on the Openpos unmanned aerial vehicle and the Alexnet unmanned aerial vehicle, the human body skeleton diagram of an operator in front of a camera is identified by using the Openpos through real-time multi-person two-dimensional gesture estimation based on deep learning at a server side, the human body skeleton diagram is sent to the Alexnet in the deep learning classification network for gesture classification, and the server sends corresponding control commands to all unmanned aerial vehicles according to the gestures of the operator in front of the lens so as to control the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster in real time. The invention is mainly applied to the unmanned aerial vehicle attitude control occasions.

title: Sparse neural network computing method and device based on systolic array
description: The application discloses a sparse neural network computing method based on a pulse array, which comprises the steps of obtaining a characteristic diagram containing n weights; the size of the characteristic diagram is x y; equally dividing the feature map into n sub-feature blocks along the direction of an x axis, wherein the size of each sub-feature block is (x/n) × y; each sub-feature block corresponds to one weight; calculating each sub-feature block according to the position of the weight in the weight matrix to obtain a calculation result; and regenerating a weight matrix according to the calculation result and outputting the weight matrix. According to the method, sparse convolution calculation is achieved through a pulse array mode, data multiplexing is more sufficient, convolution is conducted in a blocking mode, calculation is more flexible and efficiency is higher, the weight is input to subordinate equipment after being encoded, only nonzero weight is input to a framework for calculation, and loss of an encoding unit is reduced.

title: Semantic feature pyramid network-based small face detection method
description: The invention requests to protect a small face detection method based on a semantic feature pyramid network, and belongs to the technical field of face detection. Wherein the method comprises the steps of: step 1, an SFD face detection method is used as a basic model, and in order to enhance semantic information of predicted features, a semantic feature pyramid network is designed. And 2, in order to improve the recall rate of the small human faces and reduce the number of misclassified samples caused by a fixed classification threshold value, the invention provides a scale self-adaptive matching algorithm for performing anchor matching and sample classification. And 3, in order to relieve the problem of unbalance of positive and negative samples in the network, the method adopts focal loss to calculate the classification loss of the network, and obtains a final network model through iterative training and parameter updating. Under the condition of increasing a small amount of calculation, the method effectively extracts semantic information necessary for detecting the small face, enhances the characteristic expression capability of the network, improves the recall rate of the small face, and relieves the problem of unbalanced samples of the detector.

title: Product defect detection method
description: The invention provides a product defect detection method, comprising: a product image acquisition step: by setting cameras for different products and different optical surfaces of the same product, obtaining an original camera image that is consistent with the reference optical surface, and transmitting the original image to the The image processing module performs image processing, and finally obtains an image that can be used for model detection; model detection step: send the obtained image that can be used for model detection to the depth model and grayscale detection model for detection, and finally obtain the returned image of each optical surface of the product. Test results. The invention innovatively adopts the machine vision detection method of deep learning and traditional image processing, so there is a need for similarity comparison in the image acquisition stage to ensure that consistent images are collected, so as to ensure the subsequent use of deep model detection data. accuracy and image detection accuracy.

title: A dynamic optimization and matching method for energy Internet energy units
description: The invention discloses a dynamic optimization matching method of energy Internet energy units, which includes the following steps: Step 1, modeling the Energy Internet energy routing network based on graph theory; Step 2, applying neural network technology to the energy matching index between energy units Carry out modeling; Step 3, construct an energy Internet unit optimization matching problem based on the principle of local consumption first and wide-area interconnection later, and express it as an integer programming problem; Step 4, use reinforcement learning technology to learn the optimal energy unit Matching exponential function; Step 5, solve the actual energy unit dynamic matching optimization problem; Step 6, apply the obtained energy unit matching strategy to the energy routing of the energy Internet system. The present invention has strong pertinence and application value, that is, it focuses on The optimized matching between different energy units of the Energy Internet is designed to be professional and practical.

title: Automatic tuning method and device for sparse matrix-vector multiplication of parallel task granularity parameters
description: The invention belongs to the field of parallel computing, and discloses an automatic adjusting and optimizing method and device for sparse matrix vector multiplication parallel task granularity parameters, wherein the method comprises a prediction model construction step, namely constructing a prediction model by using a machine learning method; a statistical characteristic value obtaining step, namely analyzing the original data file of the matrix to obtain a statistical characteristic value of the matrix; an optimal task granularity parameter prediction step, namely inputting the obtained statistical characteristic values into a prediction model, and predicting optimal parallel task granularity parameter values of the SpMV program when the matrix characteristic values are used as input; and a configuration step, namely adjusting the task granularity of the system in parallel operation according to the prediction result. The device comprises a prediction model construction module, a statistical characteristic value acquisition module, an optimal task granularity parameter prediction module and a configuration module. The invention realizes the purposes of improving the load balance and the overall calculation performance of the parallel program by adaptively selecting the parallel task granularity of the SpMV in different input matrixes.

title: Translation quality evaluation method and device
description: The present disclosure relates to a translation quality evaluation method and device. The method includes: receiving a target language sentence to be evaluated and a corresponding source language sentence; obtaining characteristic information of the source language sentence and characteristic information of the target language sentence; The characteristic information of the source language sentence and the characteristic information of the target language sentence are processed to obtain evaluation information. By utilizing various embodiments of the present disclosure, the reliability of translation quality evaluation results can be improved.

title: Arithmetic processing device, object recognition system, object recognition method, lamps for automobiles and vehicles
description: The 2D conversion unit (42) converts the point group data (D1) acquired by the 3D sensor (20) into 2D image data (D2) with distance as pixel value. The convolutional neural network (44) receives the image data (D2) as input and determines the position and category of the objects contained in the point group data.

title: Searching method and device for determining neural network architecture for processor
description: A searching method and a searching device for determining a neural network architecture for a processor are provided, the searching method comprises the steps of acquiring an initial first neural network architecture, starting from the initial first neural network architecture, iteratively searching the next first neural network architecture based on a processor-related loss function until a first searching termination condition is met, and determining the searched optimal first neural network architecture as the neural network architecture to be used on the processor, wherein the processor-related loss function comprises a prediction error part and a processor operation cost part in a model training process. And the prediction error part and the processor operation cost part in the model training process are utilized to jointly carry out search convergence restriction on the neural network architecture, so that the searched neural network architecture is ensured to have good operation performance when the processor operates.

title: Overheating protection method of mine explosion-proof water-cooled inverter without flow sensor
description: The invention relates to a method for overheating protection of a mine explosion-proof water-cooled frequency converter without a flow sensor, comprising: determining a temperature monitoring point referenced by the method by using a thermal simulation technology or a thermal imaging experiment; using a BP neural network regression method to obtain a general prediction model ;Use the Softmax algorithm to accurately distinguish the three working conditions of the inverter: light load, heavy load and full load; according to the classification results of the Softmax algorithm, determine the flow prediction coefficient, convert the temperature rise, and substitute it into the general prediction model to realize the current working condition and temperature rise. Intelligent prediction of water-cooled radiator flow; real-time monitoring and recording of water-cooled radiator flow changes to determine whether the system is in safe working condition. The invention has strong versatility and intelligence under the premise of not using a flow sensor, meets the requirements of engineering practice, simplifies system composition, reduces system cost, enhances system reliability, and is more suitable for working in harsh underground environments.

title: Text emotion recognition method, device, terminal device and storage medium
description: The present application is applicable to the field of artificial intelligence technology, and provides a text emotion recognition method, device, terminal device and storage medium. The method includes: inputting each target text under each target scene into an existing training model, obtaining each target text The target prediction category corresponding to the target text; according to the target prediction category, obtain the first text belonging to the target category in each target scene; obtain the second text belonging to the non-target category and belong to the non-target scene; The second text is input into the existing training model, the model parameters of the training model are adjusted to obtain the target model, and the emotion recognition is performed on the text to be recognized according to the target model. The above method is used to train the existing model with the first text in the target scene and the second text in the non-target scene to obtain the target model. training time.

title: Prediction method of aircraft maneuvering trajectory based on Mogrifier-BiGRU
description: The invention provides an aircraft maneuvering trajectory prediction method based on Mogrifer-BiGRU, which combines the BiGRU and the aircraft maneuvering trajectory prediction problem, fully considers the problem of coupling loss between output data and input data of a hidden layer of a circulating network, introduces a Mogrifer coupling function, and solves the problem that historical information is wrongly discarded in the weight parameter updating process. The method can well realize the prediction of the maneuvering trajectory data of the aircraft, greatly improve the accuracy and the advance of the six-degree-of-freedom maneuvering trajectory data prediction, simultaneously, the network model has no limit on the sequence length and the dimensionality of the transmitted data, has strong adaptability to the data, and provides reliable support for judging the position and the attitude information of the target aircraft in advance.

title: Volumetric capture of objects with a single RGBD camera
description: A method includes receiving a first image including color data and depth data; determining a viewpoint associated with an augmented reality (AR) and/or virtual reality (VR) display displaying a second image; receiving at least one corrected image including an object in the first image at a different pose than a pose of the object in the first image, and generating a second image based on the first image, the viewpoint, and the at least one corrected image.

title: Audio processing method and device
description: The application provides an audio processing method and an electronic device in the field of artificial intelligence. The audio processing method is applied to a conference system, and the conference system comprises at least one audio acquisition device. The audio processing method comprises the following steps: receiving at least one piece of audio acquired by at least one audio acquisition device; determining voices of a plurality of targets in at least one piece of audio; and respectively carrying out voice recognition on the voice of each target in the plurality of targets so as to acquire the semantics corresponding to the voice of each target. And the voices of different targets are respectively subjected to voice recognition, so that the accuracy of voice recognition is improved.

title: Channel statistical information estimation method based on convolutional neural network
description: This invention discloses a channel statistics estimation method based on convolutional neural networks. First, it calculates statistical CSIs using historical uplink and downlink real-time channel state information (CSI) from a frequency division duplex (FDD) massive MIMO system, using this as a training dataset. The convolutional neural network is then trained using this dataset. Finally, the trained convolutional neural network is deployed at a base station. After obtaining the uplink statistical CSI, the base station inputs it into the convolutional neural network to estimate the downlink statistical CSI. This method utilizes the convolutional neural network to explore the nonlinear relationship between the uplink and downlink statistical CSIs in the FDD system, establishing a mapping between them. Based on this mapping, the base station uses only the uplink statistical CSI to estimate the downlink statistical CSI using the convolutional neural network, thereby reducing the overhead of the FDD base station acquiring the downlink CSI.

title: Driving information generation method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable medium
description: Embodiments of the present disclosure disclose a driving information generating method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable medium. A specific implementation of the method includes: determining the distance between each target coordinate data in the target coordinate data set and the coordinate origin as the vehicle distance distance to obtain a vehicle distance distance set; sorting each vehicle distance distance in the vehicle distance distance set, Obtain the vehicle distance distance sequence; determine the distance difference between each two vehicle distance distances in the vehicle distance distance sequence as the vehicle distance distance difference, and obtain the vehicle distance distance difference sequence; based on the speed value set of the detected vehicle and the vehicle distance The distance difference sequence is used to generate the speed value sequence of the detected vehicle; the speed information set is generated based on the speed value set of the detected vehicle and the speed value sequence of the detected vehicle; the driving information set is generated based on the distance distance set and the vehicle speed information set. This embodiment realizes the generation of driving information, expands the range of the vehicle speed detection area, and improves the safety of vehicle driving.

title: A short video click-through rate prediction method based on graph capsule network
description: The invention discloses a short video click rate prediction method based on a graph capsule network. According to the method, user browsing behavior data in a short video platform are utilized, interest characteristics of a user are extracted, and finally the click rate of the user on a target short video is predicted. For a < user, short video > pair to be predicted, the method first fuses the multi-modal features of the short video to generate a short video vector representation. And then constructing a short video graph network according to all the historical user interaction sequences, and generating a multilayer vector representation of the short video according to the short video graph network. And finally, according to the multilayer vector representation of the short video, generating a user interest representation and predicting the click rate of the target short video.

title: A method and device for analyzing punishment decision
description: The application provides a penalty decision analysis method and a penalty decision analysis device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a punishment decision book to be analyzed; inputting the punishment decision book to be analyzed into a pre-established punishment decision book analysis model; the pre-established penalty decision analysis model comprises a plurality of cutting nodes and an extraction formula corresponding to each cutting node; and utilizing the cutting nodes and the extraction formula to cut the to-be-analyzed penalty determinant, and outputting a cut text formed by a plurality of cuts as a penalty determinant analysis result output by the penalty determinant analysis model. In the scheme, the penalty decision to be analyzed is cut into blocks by utilizing a pre-established penalty decision analysis model to obtain different contents corresponding to different cutting nodes, so that one penalty decision is divided into a plurality of parts according to the contents to realize automatic analysis of the penalty decision, and the analysis efficiency is improved.

title: Multispectral-based forest fire identification method, system, program and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a multispectral-based forest fire identification method, system, program and storage medium, belonging to the technical field of forest fire prevention. The present invention first obtains the visible light image and the near-infrared image of the scene; and identifies the suspected fire area in the visible light image and the suspected fire area in the near-infrared image; Matching, the first verification of the forest fire situation in the scene; synchronously adjust the focal length of the visible light camera and the near-infrared camera, and re-match the suspected fire area in the visible light image with the suspected fire area in the near-infrared image; Finally, perform cloud recognition verify. The invention effectively improves the accuracy of forest fire identification and reduces false alarms.

title: Information structure processing method, device and computer readable storage medium
description: The invention discloses an information structure processing method. The information structuring processing method includes: acquiring a pending insurance clause document, inputting the pending insurance clause document into a pre-trained location labeling model, and obtaining a location labeling result; Intercept the clause document to obtain the target insurance clause content; use the pre-trained label labeling model to label the target insurance clause content, and obtain the label labeling result, where the label labeling result includes the target labeling label and its corresponding original information ; Perform structured processing on the original information to obtain target information corresponding to each target label. The invention also discloses an information structure processing device and a computer-readable storage medium. The invention can realize the structured processing of insurance clause information, so as to facilitate the reading of insurance clauses and the information entry.

title: An image processing method, apparatus, device and readable storage medium
description: The invention discloses an image processing method, an image processing device, image processing equipment and a readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target image; inputting the target image into the quantized target depth neural network model for classification/detection to obtain an output result; processing the target image according to a strategy corresponding to the output result; the process of quantifying and obtaining the target depth neural network model comprises the following steps: acquiring a floating point type deep neural network model obtained by pre-training; extracting the weight characteristics of the deep neural network model; determining a quantization strategy by using the weight characteristics; and quantizing the deep neural network model according to a quantization strategy to obtain a target deep neural network model. In the method, the process of obtaining the target deep neural network model in a quantification mode reduces occupied resources, shortens time consumption, and simultaneously can ensure the performance of the model, so that the performance of image classification/detection is ensured, and the performance of image classification processing can be further improved.

title: A Face Detection Algorithm Based on Small Auxiliary Network
description: The invention discloses a face detection algorithm based on a small auxiliary network, which is characterized in that on the basis of the existing face detection network, the small auxiliary network designed according to the network structure is added aiming at a feature extraction network, when a face detection data set is used for training the network, the auxiliary network can carry out zero training according to the characteristics of a detection task, and the features of the corresponding layer of the auxiliary network are used for supplementing a main network feature map.

title: Standard test function processing method based on particle swarm genetic hybrid algorithm
description: The invention discloses a standard test function processing method based on a particle swarm genetic hybrid algorithm, which comprises the following steps of: s1, after initializing the population, setting the population scale as M, firstly evolving the population to a certain algebra T by the particle swarm algorithm, and according to the fitness function value, making the fitness function value in the population be superior to the individual U of the population mean value k Directly extracting to obtain the (M-U) in the next generation k ) Individual, with the rest of (M-U) k ) Evolution of genetic algorithm on an individual basis to generate (M-U) k ) (ii) individuals; s2, and (M-U) remaining k ) Individual and genetic algorithm evolved (M-U) k ) The first half of the (M-U) is extracted after the individuals are combined together k ) Individual, U obtained by particle swarm evolution k (M-U) evolved from individual and genetic algorithm k ) The individuals are combined to form a new particle swarm M, and then the next step is carried outAnd (6) carrying out iteration. The hybrid algorithm provided by the invention has effectiveness, and can be widely applied to the aspects of function optimization, combination optimization, production scheduling and the like.

title: Triage model training method, triage method and system for department triage
description: The present disclosure provides a training method of triage model for department triage, comprising: generating a keyword table of each department based on the labeled data set of each department in the multiple departments and the department description text of the department in the knowledge base; generating a first feature vector of each disease condition description text by using a first network model, and generating a keyword list vector of each department by using a second network model; generating a second feature vector for each department based on the first feature vector of the disease description text and the keyword list vector of each department; generating a fused feature vector based on the correlation between the first feature vector and each second feature vector of the disease description text; and training the third network model based on the fusion characteristic vector of each disease condition description text and the department information of the disease condition description text to obtain a trained triage model. The disclosure also provides a training device, a triage method, a device, a system and a medium of the triage model.

title: System package generation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the field of data processing. The invention discloses a system package generation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium. The method includes: identifying the system package to be constructed by acquiring the generation information containing system description information and checked component information Language type, at the same time, text analysis is performed on the system description information to obtain system type information, service component information and parameter information, component recommendation is made by building a system component recommendation model, and component recommendation results are obtained; recommended toolkits are screened out and displayed on the application interface Display; after receiving the user's confirmation instruction, determine the final component information; obtain the available component toolkit from the component code platform, and obtain the service component package from the component code platform; according to the system type information, parameter information and obtained available components Toolkits and service component packages generate system packages. The invention realizes the effect of one-click generation of the system package, and improves the safety and efficiency of generating the system package.

title: A corpus processing method and related device
description: The embodiment of the present application discloses a corpus processing method and a related device thereof, wherein the corpus processing method comprises: obtaining a first corpus, performing data cleaning on the first corpus to obtain a second corpus; classifying the second corpus according to the token-level labels of the sentences in the second corpus to obtain a third corpus and a fourth corpus; inputting the third corpus into the first classification result prediction model and the second classification result prediction model for classification respectively to obtain a first multi-label classification result and a second multi-label classification result; inputting the fourth corpus into the third classification result prediction model for classification to obtain a third multi-label classification result; fusing the first multi-label classification result, the second multi-label classification result and the third multi-label classification result to obtain a target result. The embodiment of the present application improves the accuracy of corpus data processing by fusing the classification results obtained by passing the corpus data through different models.

title: Multi-dimensional data-based identification method, device, equipment and medium for group rental housing
description: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional data-based group renting house identification method, device, equipment and medium, which are used for acquiring multi-dimensional data of an address to be identified in a preset period and respectively calculating probability information of each dimensional data in the multi-dimensional data; calculating to obtain the probability sum of the multidimensional data according to the probability information of each piece of the multidimensional data in the multidimensional data; and determining whether the address to be identified is a group rental house or not according to the probability sum, and pushing the address to be identified to a group rental disposal department if the address to be identified is the group rental house. According to the invention, the multi-dimensional data of the address to be identified is firstly acquired, the probability sum of the multi-dimensional data is calculated, whether the address to be identified is a group rental house or not is determined according to the probability sum, and a manual identification mode is replaced by big data analysis and calculation, so that the speed and the accuracy of group rental house identification are effectively improved, and the efficiency of group rental management is improved.

title: A target user-oriented advertisement placement method and device
description: The invention discloses a target user-oriented advertisement placement method and device. The method includes: in response to an advertisement placement request, extracting a corresponding advertisement plan and advertisement cost from the advertisement placement request; and performing word segmentation processing on the advertisement plan. , obtain the keywords of the advertising plan; match the keywords of the advertising plan with the materials and their material labels in the preset material library to obtain the target material; match the keywords of the advertising plan with the users in the preset user database The data and its user tags are matched to obtain target customers; according to the target materials, the target customers and the advertising costs, page advertisements are created and placed in batches. By accurately matching the target materials used to create advertisements in batches and matching the target users for delivery, the existing advertising delivery methods require a certain amount of staff to operate, low delivery efficiency and easy delivery errors.

title: A method for data enhancement of images
description: The present invention discloses a method for data enhancement of an image, which is suitable for execution in a computing device, and the method comprises: determining a set of annotation points in a target image, the set of annotation points comprising one or more annotation points in the target image; determining a perspective transformation matrix in the target image; performing perspective transformation on the target image and the set of annotation points according to the perspective transformation matrix, and generating a data enhanced image and a perspective transformed set of annotation points. The present invention also discloses a device for data enhancement of an image, a computing device and a computer-readable storage medium.

title: A training sample screening method for target detection
description: The invention discloses a method for selecting training samples for target detection. The models in different stages obtained in the training process are used to detect targets in training set data, and the detection results of each image sample on the model M in different stages are obtained. Screen the detection results of each image sample at different stages of the model to obtain completely forgotten samples and partially forgotten samples. The model replaces manual analysis of noise samples in a large number of target detection data sets, which saves manpower and eliminates the subjective impact of human screening of data, and improves the efficiency and accuracy of using deep learning methods to perform target detection tasks.

title: A Meteorological Data Encryption and Decryption Service System Based on Hybrid Cryptography
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of meteorological data encryption and decryption services, in particular to a meteorological data encryption and decryption service system based on a hybrid cryptographic technology, which comprises: the data risk control center consists of a data encryption service cluster, a user authentication management system, a key management system and a log analysis management system; and the client service encryption machine is used for storing the private key and the public key generated by the encryption server, the public key of the weather bureau and the public keys of all client users (namely the public keys generated by the SDK). The meteorological data encryption and decryption service system provided by the invention adopts a method of encrypting and decrypting data information by adopting a hybrid password technology and combining the advantages of a symmetric password and a public key password, and meets the requirements of high efficiency, high confidentiality, high safety and high integrity.

title: Calibration of Simulated Cardiograms
description: A system is provided for generating data representing the electromagnetic state of a heart for medical, scientific, research, and/or engineering purposes. The system generates data based on source configurations (such as the dimensions of the heart and the location of scarring or fibrosis or arrhythmogenic substrate within the heart) and a computational model of the electromagnetic output of the heart. The system can dynamically generate the source configurations to provide representative source configurations that can be found in a population. For each source configuration of the electromagnetic sources, the system runs a simulation of the function of the heart to generate a modeled electromagnetic output for that source configuration (e.g., an electromagnetic grid for each simulation step, with a voltage at each point of the electromagnetic grid). The system can generate a cardiogram from the modeled electromagnetic output for each source configuration for predicting the source location of an arrhythmia.

title: Dynamic Allocation Method of Adversarial Units
description: The invention discloses a method for dynamic allocation of confrontation units. The method specifically includes: acquiring confrontation information in a digital battlefield environment, preprocessing the confrontation information to obtain the preprocessing information, and using the trained cyclic neural network model pair as an initial state The grouping start vector and the preprocessing information as the initial input are processed to obtain the first step output, and the attention model is used to process the first step output and the attribute information of the n adversarial units and the grouping end vector of the grouping end unit; Set the random sampling rule, sample the normalized result to obtain the sampling result; repeat the above steps until the current sampling result is the component corresponding to the end unit of the grouping. The grouping information obtained by this method is closer to the digital battlefield environment, which is conducive to the completion of confrontation tasks, and can also adapt to changes in the digital battlefield situation.

title: Small sample target detection method based on multi-scale feature weighting
description: The invention discloses a small sample target detection method based on multi-scale feature weighting, which comprises the following steps: step one, dividing a data set into a basic category and a small sample category; step two, constructing a feature extraction network in the basic class training process; step three, constructing a characteristic branch network, and fusing the multi-scale characteristics; step four, constructing a weight generation network, and predicting the weight corresponding to the corresponding category; step five, carrying out a category weight weighting process, and weighting the characteristics by using weight vectors of different categories; step six, performing regression prediction by using a comprehensive detector; and step seven, adding the basic category and the small sample category into the fine tuning process at the same time under the condition that the network frame is unchanged, and repeating the steps two to six to finally obtain the small sample target detection result. The invention has clear structure, and designs a multi-scale fused network structure so that the network can use the image information of each scale to better detect targets of different scales.

title: Local sign language recognition method and device based on secondary transfer learning
description: The invention discloses a local sign language recognition method and device based on secondary migration learning, wherein the learning and training steps of the local sign language recognition model include: using ordinary pictures as a training set to train a convolutional neural network model to obtain an initial image recognition model ; Keep some network layers of the initial image recognition model, and replace other network layers to obtain a first-time transfer learning sign language recognition model; use local sign language images as the training set, adjust the parameters of the first-time transfer learning sign language recognition model, and obtain the second transfer learning. Sign language recognition model. Using the above scheme, in the process of training the local sign language training model, secondary transfer learning is used to reduce the model's dependence on the local sign language label sample data, improve the recognition accuracy of the local sign language training model, and reduce the cost of training and learning.

title: Vortex beam mode identification system and method based on photonic neural network
description: The invention discloses a vortex beam mode identification system and method based on photon neural network. The device includes: a beam generating device, used to process heterogeneous fundamental mode Gaussian light into a horizontally polarized mode vortex beam; a characteristic sample preparation device, used to process the vortex beam to obtain the waveguide photonic neural network training and testing requirements Distortion feature samples; photonic neural network training and recognition simulation device, used to input the distortion feature samples of the training set into the waveguide photonic neural network to obtain the optimal model, and use the optimal model to perform vortex beam recognition and detection on the test set data. The waveguide photonic neural network experimental device is used to load the phase information in the optimal model into the Mach-Zehnder interferometer array to form a planar waveguide photonic neural network for experimental vortex beam mode identification. The present invention provides an integrated, efficient and high-speed waveguide photonic neural network for vortex beam identification, thereby improving the performance of the OAM communication system.

title: Intelligent work site intelligent scheduling method and system based on machine learning
description: The invention discloses an intelligent work site intelligent scheduling method and system based on machine learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting the state of workers in a construction site and the completion progress data of construction; and inputting a pre-trained deep reinforcement learning network to obtain a worker scheduling scheme. According to the invention, the states of workers (such as leave-out, working time length and construction progress of work) are taken as input, and the states of the workers are continuously arranged to output the results of worker scheduling by taking safety factors (one worker cannot continuously work for more than a specified time), economic factors (work sequence among work types), worker satisfaction (leave-out is arranged after work is carried out for a certain time) and workload required by enterprises for a certain time into consideration, so that the purpose of online intelligent scheduling is realized by utilizing a visual interface to visualize the output results.

title: An end-to-end autonomous driving model pre-training method based on asynchronous supervised learning
description: An end-to-end automatic driving model pre-training method based on asynchronous supervised learning is characterized in that a plurality of supervised learning processes are executed asynchronously and parallelly on a plurality of demonstration data sets acquired by a real vehicle, so that the stability of the supervised learning processes is improved, and the convergence of the pre-training processes is accelerated. After the end-to-end automatic driving model is pre-trained by expert demonstration data collected from the real world, the initial performance of the model in the subsequent real vehicle reinforcement learning training stage can be improved and the convergence of the model can be accelerated. In addition, the invention provides a visual analysis method for an end-to-end automatic driving model training process, so as to analyze the model performance improvement brought by the pre-training method based on asynchronous supervised learning from a microscopic angle. The invention designs a multi-vehicle distributed reinforcement learning-driven automatic driving model training system which is used for collecting expert demonstration data and verifying the feasibility of the application of the pre-training method in the real world.

title: A training method and device for glitch location and glitch detection model
description: This application provides a method and apparatus for training a burr localization and burr detection model, comprising: acquiring detection feature data of a device to be detected; the detection feature data being used to characterize the shape features of the device to be detected; inputting the detection feature data into a pre-trained burr detection model to obtain a confidence vector corresponding to the device to be detected; the values of different elements in the confidence vector characterizing the probability of burrs existing at different positions on the device to be detected; and determining the burr position on the device to be detected based on the confidence vector. This method can improve the accuracy of burr detection and localization.

title: A method and device for predicting vehicle weatherability temperature based on deep learning
description: The invention relates to a vehicle weatherability temperature prediction method and device based on deep learning, belonging to the technical field of neural networks, and solves the problems of low efficiency and low temperature prediction result accuracy of the existing vehicle weatherability temperature prediction method. The method includes: acquiring training data, where the training data includes atmospheric environment parameters and their corresponding vehicle measuring point temperatures; normalizing the atmospheric environment parameters and their corresponding vehicle measuring point temperatures to obtain normalized training data samples; constructing Deep learning prediction model, and input the normalized training data samples into the deep learning prediction model for model training, and obtain a trained deep learning prediction model; obtain the data samples to be predicted, and treat the prediction data based on the trained deep learning prediction model. The temperature of the vehicle measuring point corresponding to the sample is predicted, and the predicted value of the vehicle measuring point temperature is obtained. The prediction of the temperature of the vehicle measuring point is realized, and the prediction efficiency and accuracy are improved.

title: A CNN-LSTM-based online car-hailing target order prediction method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of order data processing, in particular to a network taxi appointment target order prediction method based on CNN-LSTM. The invention comprises the following steps: 1. the method comprises the steps of processing a preset area into a plurality of sub-areas in a slicing mode; 2. acquiring original order data of each sub-area in a preset area; 3. obtaining target order data based on the original order data: the target order data comprises the total order amount, the average order price, the POI characteristic, the weather characteristic and the time characteristic of the same region in the same time period; 4. predicting the order quantity data of each region in the next time period based on the CNN-LSTM model: inputting total order quantity data, POI characteristics, weather characteristics and time characteristics in the target order data into a CNN-LSTM model to obtain order quantity prediction data of each area in the next time period; 5. and establishing a region PVD model to obtain a value thermodynamic diagram of each sub-region. The invention can comprehensively and accurately predict the target order data.

title: A method and system for industrial equipment monitoring based on cloud-edge collaboration
description: The invention discloses a method and system for industrial equipment monitoring based on cloud-edge collaboration. The method includes: collecting monitoring data of industrial equipment and sending the monitoring data to an edge platform; the edge platform uses the monitoring data to perform a fault detection model training; send the fault detection model to the cloud platform; the cloud platform fuses the fault detection model based on the model fusion technology to obtain a shared model; sends the shared model to the edge platform; the edge platform uses the shared model to detect the monitoring data and obtain industrial equipment health status. The monitoring data is processed through the edge platform to avoid collecting the monitoring data to the cloud platform, improving data transmission efficiency and security, and reducing network pressure; the cloud platform integrates the fault detection model based on federated learning technology, obtains the shared model and sends it to the edge platform It can improve the generalization ability of the fault detection model, detect the equipment status through the edge platform, and improve the response speed of the detection.

title: A text-based emotion detection method and device, computer equipment and medium
description: The invention discloses a text-based emotion detection method and device, computer equipment and medium. The emotion detection method comprises: inputting text data into N trained neural network language models and outputting N emotion prediction probabilities, each The neural network language models include a pre-trained language model, a first fully connected layer and an activation function; the final prediction probability of the text data is obtained by fusing N emotion prediction probabilities, where N is a natural number greater than or equal to 2. In the embodiment provided by the present invention, multiple neural network language models are set, and each pre-trained language model is used to predict and generate multiple emotion prediction probabilities according to the extracted different features, and the multiple emotion prediction probabilities are fused to obtain the input text data. The final prediction probability can significantly improve the prediction ability and has a wide range of application prospects.

title: A method and device for predicting the operation situation of an enterprise
description: The present invention provides a method and device for predicting an enterprise operation situation. The method includes: acquiring enterprise time series data; training a preset neural network model according to the enterprise time series data to obtain a complex social network; using the complex social network Predict the operation situation of the enterprise; the method provided by the present invention performs more complex correlation analysis and feature extraction on the network and network evolution characteristics that affect the node performance and network performance of complex and variable network nodes through data-based machine learning means, and enhances and Expand the theoretical index characteristics of complex social networks, and then form an effective prediction of the future performance of complex social networks based on the analysis results of the characteristics. For complex social networks formed between enterprises, feature analysis can be performed based on enterprise operation data and multi-enterprise operation data. As well as forecasts of future benefits, cooperation and other aspects of enterprises, it can effectively assist enterprises in making strategic choices.

title: A Stage Interaction System Based on Image and Radar Data
description: The invention discloses a stage interaction system based on image and radar data, which comprises an information acquisition module, a processing module and a control module. The information acquisition module comprises an RGB camera and a LiDAR laser radar which are arranged right in front of the stage, and is used for detecting the attitude information of performers on the stage in real time to be used as training data or field data of production attitude; the processing module comprises attitude generation and attitude identification, and the attitude generation unit learns training data by using a double-flow deep learning network to generate an attitude model of the performer; and recognizing and matching the corresponding preset gesture according to the gesture model of the performer by gesture recognition, and sending the result to the control module. And the control unit module controls the display content of the stage screen to change along with the posture of the performer according to the received recognition result. Through the mode, the invention can enable performers to interact with the stage scene in real time through the action posture under higher precision.

title: Prostate cancer bone metastases identification system based on deep learning based on whole body bone scan images
description: The invention provides a deep learning prostate cancer bone metastasis identification system based on a whole body bone scanning image, wherein a preprocessing module receives and processes the input whole body bone scanning image; the neural network module detects whether the input whole body bone scanning image is prostate cancer bone metastasis. The neural network module comprises a chest part network module and a pelvis part network module. The chest portion network module includes: establishing a first stage accelerating regional convolution neural network, and segmenting a training image of a thoracic cavity part according to a whole body bone scanning image; and training a second-stage accelerating regional convolution neural network by using the training image, and classifying the focus of cancer cell bone metastasis. The pelvic region network module uses a convolutional neural network, comprising: establishing a first stage accelerating regional convolution neural network, and segmenting a training image of a pelvis part according to an input whole body bone scanning image; and training a convolutional neural network by using the training image to classify whether the pelvis part is a bone transfer image.

title: An optimization method for energy balance in wireless sensor networks
description: The invention discloses an optimization method for the energy balance problem of a wireless sensor network. The algorithm is divided into three stages during the execution of the optimization process: first, in the first stage of the optimization process, the convergence selection mechanism is dominated, and the convergence is selected. better solution. Then, in the second-stage optimization process, the diversity maintenance mechanism is used to preserve solutions with better diversity. In addition, the comprehensive metric method is used to ensure the balance of convergence and diversity of solutions in the third-stage optimization process of population evolution. In order to verify the superiority of the designed algorithm, it is simulated and compared with other five advanced high-dimensional multi-objective optimization algorithms on the benchmark function. And, the final simulation results achieve the expected effect requirements.

title: A key test feature identification and extraction method of MBD model
description: The invention provides a method for identifying and extracting key inspection characteristics of an MBD (model based definition) model, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, the method comprises the following steps: analyzing the MBD model to obtain a three-dimensional labeling and inspection tool list set; II, secondly: labeling the attached feature type and the inspection feature type at the later stage, extracting the precision, and matching an inspection tool; thirdly, the method comprises the following steps: adding inspection items on the geometric model and the structural tree; fourthly, the method comprises the following steps: encoding a component chromosome; fifthly: randomly generating an initial population; sixthly, the method comprises the following steps: training an SVM prediction model; seventhly, the method comprises the following steps: calculating an individual adaptation value by using K-fold cross validation; eighthly: selecting excellent individuals to form a new population; nine: crossing and mutating to generate new individuals; ten: if the condition is met, executing the step eleven, otherwise, returning to the step seven; eleven: outputting the key inspection characteristics to an excel table; through the steps, the key inspection characteristics in the MBD model can be identified, then the marking information is extracted, the inspection tool is distributed, and finally the marking information is output to the spreadsheet, so that subsequent guidance is provided for field inspection.

title: A business hall business intelligent distribution system
description: The invention discloses a business hall business intelligent distribution system and method, relates to the technical field of Internet data processing, and solves the technical problem of low work efficiency caused by unreasonable business distribution for business hall staff in their daily work; Identity recognition module, this setting can not only realize the preliminary screening of customers, but also can reasonably allocate GPU resources to improve the work efficiency of the present invention; the present invention is provided with a business allocation module, which can reasonably arrange customers and staff according to the actual situation , which is helpful to improve the overall work efficiency of the business hall and avoid the rush of the staff; the present invention sets a business forecasting module, which is set to predict the future business volume of the business hall according to the forecasting model, and the staff can reasonably arrange the work according to the forecasting results to avoid The accumulation of business, to ensure that the customer's business can be handled in a timely manner.

title: An automatic modeling method of meter based on machine vision
description: The invention discloses an automatic meter modeling method based on machine vision, which solves the shortcomings of the prior art and includes the following steps: step 1, establishing a meter master mold library; step 2, classifying the to-be-modeled model through a reid classification network The header image of the meter picture and the feature meter picture of the master mold library are matched; step 3, select the feature meter picture of the master mold library with the top several confidence levels as the candidate master mold; step 4, the table to be modeled The header image of the meter picture and the candidate master model are matched through the template of the key area indicated by the meter. After the matching is completed, the final confidence level is determined by combining the confidence level in step 3. The candidate master model with the highest final confidence level is the model to be modeled. The best master model matched with the meter picture; Step 5, calculate the homography matrix of the best master model and the meter picture to be modeled, convert the meter indication key area of the meter picture to be modeled according to the homography matrix, and complete the to-be-modeled meter picture. Modeling of Modeling Meters.

title: Memory device including neural network processing circuit
description: The present disclosure relates to a memory device, comprising: n cell array regions; a calculation processing block adapted to generate calculation completion data by performing a network-level operation on the input data, the network-level operation representing an operation of repeating M-level operations in a loop, the level operation representing an operation of performing N times of neural network calculations in parallel; a data operation block adapted to store input data and (m×n) pieces of neural network processing information in N cell array regions, and output calculation completion data through a data transfer buffer; and an operation control block adapted to control the calculation processing block and the data operation block.

title: Method and system for simulating planning of territorial spatial pattern based on multi-agent algorithm
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for simulating and planning a territorial spatial pattern based on a multi-agent algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of spatial planning. The method comprises the following steps: developing suitability indexes according to ecological environment resource bearing capacity and construction places, and carrying out space element risk identification on the research area to obtain space element risk identification data; extracting a distribution range of a suitability space built in a research area according to the space element risk identification data, taking the distribution range as a base map for simulating a town development boundary, and acquiring a preliminary delimiting result of the town development boundary in the research area based on a cellular automata model; and inputting the space element risk identification data and the preliminary planning result into a multi-agent model for scene optimization, outputting a space pattern division result of a research area, and simulating the planning of three areas and three lines so as to assist the planning of the territorial space planning and respond to the technical requirements of the planning of the territorial space during the transformation period of the current territorial space planning.

title: Cup optic disk segmentation method and imaging method based on rich context network
description: The invention discloses a cup optic disc segmentation method based on a rich context network, which comprises the steps of obtaining the existing color fundus image data and processing the image data to obtain a training data set; constructing a cup optic disc segmentation original model and training to obtain a cup optic disc segmentation model; and segmenting the target color fundus image by adopting the optic cup optic disc segmentation model to obtain a final optic cup optic disc segmentation result. The invention also discloses an imaging method adopting the cup optic disk segmentation method based on the rich context network. The invention provides a segmentation structure based on a convolutional neural network and capable of acquiring sufficient context information to segment a disk optic cup; therefore, the method can improve the segmentation performance of the optic disc cup, solve the problem that the segmentation of the edge of the optic cup is not smooth enough, and has high accuracy, good reliability and better segmentation effect.

title: User policy generation method, device and electronic device
description: The disclosure relates to a user policy generation method and device and electronic equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic information of a user, wherein the basic information comprises a plurality of pieces of sub information; extracting a preset variable parameter combination; integrating the plurality of pieces of sub information based on the variable parameter combination to generate a plurality of user variables; inputting the user variable into a trained user risk model to generate a user risk score; assigning a user policy to the user based on the user risk score. The user strategy generation method, the device, the electronic equipment and the computer readable medium can combine a plurality of independent characteristics of the user to generate more representative variable parameter combinations, and can analyze the risk of the user more comprehensively and accurately based on the variable parameter combinations, so that accurate and proper user strategies are distributed to the user, the resource utilization efficiency is improved, the resource safety risk is reduced, and the customer satisfaction is improved.

title: Fanbai music generation method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention relates to the field of artificial intelligence and discloses a method, device, equipment and storage medium for generating Sanskrit music. The method includes: acquiring the music data to be processed and inputting it into a preset Fanbei music generation model. The music data includes lyrics and lyrics melody; extracting the lyrics hidden code vector of the lyrics through the lyrics encoder, and extracting the melody hidden code vector of the lyrics and melody through the melody encoder. code vector; input the libretto hidden code vector into the libretto decoder for processing, and output the libretto output vector; input each libretto output vector and the melody hidden code into the melody decoder for processing, and output the melody output vector; convert each libretto output vector into the libretto, Convert each melody output vector into a melody to generate lyrics and melody pairs; finally, splice each lyrics and melody pairs according to the singing order to obtain Fanbai music. The invention effectively combines melody and lyrics, restores the "one word with multiple tones" characteristics of Sanskrit music, and makes the generated music closer to the real Buddhist Sanskrit music.

title: A structure design method of flexible PCB board based on wet chemical etching co-simulation
description: The invention discloses a flexible PCB structure design method based on wet chemical etching joint simulation, which comprises the steps of presetting a production parameter data set according to actual production data; then, constructing an equivalent two-dimensional geometric model of the flexible PCB by using multi-physical-field finite element simulation software according to the data set, establishing a multi-physical-field simulation model, and completing the establishment of the simulation model by setting material properties, boundary conditions, initial conditions and grids; and then calling and iteratively simulating the simulation model by using a model interaction algorithm and a GA algorithm according to a preset optimization target and a code parameter set, and solidifying and reserving the optimized structure parameters obtained by simulation for production design. The invention utilizes simulation to carry out simulation calculation of the structural parameters, and combines GA algorithm to obtain more intelligent structural parameters which have more pertinence and meet the actual design requirements, thereby being a scientific design method which can greatly reduce the design cost of the test mode and improve the design time efficiency.

title: A state feedback control method of parallel UPS system based on neural network
description: The invention is suitable for the technical field of parallel UPS systems, and provides a state feedback control method of a parallel UPS system based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: establishing a state space model of the parallel UPS system; state feedback tracking control design of completely known system dynamics; and identifying parameters of the parallel UPS system based on the neural network. The invention provides a neural network-based parallel UPS system state feedback control method, strictly proves the convergence of identification errors, and proves the identification capability of a neural network and the performance and effectiveness of the proposed control algorithm for the first time through simulation research.

title: Problem determination method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The application provides a question judging method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: detecting the image to be corrected by using a detection model to obtain at least one first question stem area and at least one first answering area; searching a question comparison image corresponding to the image to be corrected in a question bank, wherein the question comparison image comprises at least one second question stem area and at least one second answering area; determining a second answering area corresponding to the first answering area by utilizing the intersection ratio according to the first question stem area, the first answering area, the second question stem area and the second answering area; and comparing the answering content of the first answering area with the answering content of the corresponding second answering area to obtain a judgment result aiming at the image to be corrected. According to the embodiment of the application, the question types with semantic information can be processed, such as blank filling questions, choice questions and the like, so that the accuracy of the question judgment result is effectively improved, and the user experience is improved.

title: A keying algorithm based on opencv and shader fusion technology
description: The application relates to an image matting method based on a fusion technology, which comprises the following steps: carrying out matting processing on a to-be-matting image by using an image segmentation module in a pre-trained image matting model to obtain a matting image, and carrying out matrix splicing on the matting image by using a matting matrix generation module in the image matting model to obtain edge region information of the matting image to obtain an initial matting image; carrying out gray thresholding and binarization processing on the initial sectional image to obtain a target sectional image; fusing a foreground region and a background region of the target sectional image based on a graphic rendering tool which is created in the GPU in advance, and returning the fused target sectional image to a front-end page. In addition, the application also provides a keying device, electronic equipment and a computer readable storage medium based on the fusion technology. The method and the device can improve the generation speed of the sectional image and realize efficient display of the sectional image.

title: A kind of automatic monitoring and identification method of salinized land
description: The invention provides an automatic monitoring and identifying method for a salinized land, and belongs to the field of environmental monitoring, environmental ecological protection and environmental ecological protection. The method comprises the steps of obtaining soil salinity of a plurality of sampling points in a research area to form a sample data set; extracting a plurality of wave band values of a grid corresponding to the longitude and latitude in a remote sensing image closest to a sampling month according to the longitude and latitude of each sampling point, and obtaining a wave band combination set by constructing different wave band combination forms; then constructing a machine learning soil salinity inversion model, training the model by using the sample data set, and selecting a wave band combination form suitable for inverting the soil salinity of the research area from the wave band combination set to form a sensitive factor set and an optimal inversion model; and obtaining the soil salinity inversion result in the selected month in the research area by using the optimal inversion model. The method can be practically applied to monitoring the salinization degree of the surface soil layer of the arid and semi-arid region and identifying the salinization soil with different degrees, and provides an effective reference basis for local irrigation planning, agricultural management and the like.

title: A Visual Perceptual Emotion Recognition Method
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of emotion recognition, in particular to a visual perception emotion recognition method, which is used to solve the problem that in the prior art, facial expression-based and picture- or video-based physiological signals are prone to misjudgment in emotion recognition and analysis, and the detection of emotion Problems with narrow coverage of expression analysis. The present invention includes the following steps: step 1: collect face video through a camera and perform face detection and area of interest positioning; step 2: extract the color channel information of the area of interest to decompose and reduce dimension; step 3: signal denoising and stabilization, extract heart rate , the waveform of respiration and the physiological parameters of heart rate variability; Step 4: Extract the pre-trained nonlinear features of the physiological parameters for modeling regression based on the support vector machine model of the twin network; Step 5: Use the regression three-dimensional information to read the VAD model Get concrete emotional representations. Through the above technical solution, it is not easy to cause misjudgment of emotion recognition and analysis, and the coverage of emotion expression analysis is wider.

title: Micro-feedback-based recommendation method and system
description: The present invention provides a recommendation method and system based on micro-feedback, comprising: step S1: initializing a model generation module to generate candidate recommendation data by using a rule method, initializing a recommendation probability prediction model based on machine learning, and using the candidate recommendation data for machine-based recommendation data. The learned recommendation probability prediction model is trained, and a trained machine learning-based recommendation probability prediction model is obtained; Step S2: The recommendation content generation module loads the trained machine learning-based recommendation probability prediction model, and generates a generated according to the received impact factor. Recommended content; Step S3: The recommendation recording module records all the recommended influence factors and the corresponding recommended content as logs; Step S4: The micro-feedback model optimization module uses the micro-feedback information and the log for the trained machine learning-based recommendation probability prediction model optimization; and use the optimized probabilistic prediction model for content recommendation.

title: Ultrasonic lamb wave defect signal identification method based on variational modal decomposition
description: The invention relates to the technical field of information processing, and provides an ultrasonic lamb wave defect signal identification method based on variation modal decomposition, which comprises the following steps: step 1, an excitation signal is generated by an electromagnetic ultrasonic transducer to detect an aluminum plate, and an original signal of ultrasonic lamb waves is received by a receiving transducer at the other side of the aluminum plate; step 2, determining input parameters of variation modal decomposition, wherein the input parameters comprise a decomposition layer number, a secondary penalty factor and a termination condition; step 3, performing variation modal decomposition; step 4, determining the number of final decomposition layers to obtain sub-signals at the center frequency after separation; step 5, selecting and optimizing a variation modal decomposition input parameter-penalty factor by adopting a particle swarm algorithm; and 6, performing variation modes by utilizing the final decomposition layer number and the optimized penalty factors, ensuring complete extraction of defect signals, and performing defect identification by obtaining defect signals with central frequency. The invention can improve the accuracy and the recognition rate of ultrasonic lamb wave defect signal detection.

title: A Small-Sample SAR Target Classification Method Based on Hybrid Loss and Graph Attention
description: The invention provides a small sample SAR target classification method based on mixed loss and graph attention, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a training sample set and a test sample set; constructing a network model H based on mixed loss and graph attention; performing iterative training on the H; and obtaining a target classification result of the small sample SAR image. The invention passes the classification loss value l of the training task set C And the embedding loss value l of the training task set E The weighting and the mixed loss value l forming the training task set update the parameters of all the first convolution layers and all the second convolution layers in the embedded network module E and the parameters of all the first full-connection layers and all the second full-connection layers in the graph attention network module G, thereby enhancing the similarity between the characteristics of the same SAR target class and the difference between the characteristics of different SAR target classes, and the method can also improve the stability of the SAR target classesData enhancement effectively reduces the risk of overfitting in the model training process, and improves the classification precision of the small sample SAR target.

title: Human flow guidance method, device, computer equipment and storage medium based on edge computing
description: The invention relates to a human flow guidance method, device, computer equipment and storage medium based on edge computing. The method includes: setting a guidance center node in a guidance center, and communicating with an edge computing network; the edge computing node monitors traffic passing through the edge computing node. The human flow at multiple time points before the target time node; input the human flow into the human flow prediction model to obtain the predicted human flow corresponding to the target monitoring area at the target time node; according to the predicted human flow, recommend the target monitoring area to the user in The prediction guidance information of the target time node; each edge computing node sends the prediction guidance information to the guidance center node, and the guidance center node calculates the final guidance information of each edge computing node based on the current traffic flow and prediction guidance information of each edge computing node. And return to the corresponding edge computing node. The present application improves the precision and efficiency of people flow diversion.

title: Blog recommendation method and system based on graph convolution neural network
description: The invention discloses a blog post recommendation method and system based on graph convolutional neural network. The method includes: obtaining a target Weibo social network including user entities and blog post entities; inputting the Weibo social network into a trained implicit relationship prediction model to determine the implicit relationship between the target user and the blog post; the implicit relationship prediction model includes encoding The gated graph attention network model includes a graph attention layer and a gating layer. The graph attention layer aggregates the Weibo social network with different degrees of importance. For information about different entities, the gating layer selects and filters the aggregated information; the decoder contains an optimal scoring function, which can be used to score possible new relationships; the implicit score is evaluated based on the scoring function. The score of the relationship determines which blog posts are recommended to the target user. The invention realizes automatic recommendation of blog posts suitable for individual users.

title: High-precision automatic calibration method for multi-camera based on evolutionary algorithm
description: An evolutionary algorithm-based high-precision automatic calibration method for multiple cameras belongs to the technical field of camera calibration. The invention regresses and clusters the vanishing points and the vanishing lines through the body of the human body instead of the positions of the head and the feet for the first time, thereby enhancing the robustness of the vanishing point estimation method based on pedestrian detection and reducing the self-calibration error of the camera in the scene with large change of the human body posture. The invention uses the multi-camera parameter joint optimization method based on the evolutionary algorithm, effectively reduces the geometric error composed of the reprojection error and the symmetric transfer error in the camera calibration parameter, and can provide accurate calibration parameter for advanced visual application such as video monitoring and the like.

title: A method for predicting enantioselectivity of chemical reaction products
description: The present invention provides a method for predicting the enantioselectivity of chemical reaction products, and specifically relates to a method for predicting the enantioselectivity of chemical reaction products by combining an octree convolutional neural network model with a molecular surface electrostatic potential. On the basis of known reaction substrates and catalyst molecular structures, the enantioselectivity of chemical reaction products can be predicted quickly and efficiently by only calculating the point cloud of each molecular structure and the surface electrostatic potential value corresponding to each point, combined with the octree convolutional neural network model.
