The method calculates the 3D point cloud of the molecular structure and its corresponding surface electrostatic potential, while reflecting the stereo effect and electronic effect of the molecule, and is easy to understand and apply. The model has good predictive ability and can effectively predict the yield and enantioselectivity of organic reactions in the application domain, which is of great significance for the development of new catalytic reactions for preparing chiral compounds.

title: Method and apparatus, electronic device, and medium for information management
description: The present disclosure provides a method for information management, which belongs to the field of artificial intelligence. The method includes: acquiring at least one historical requirement use case and business model adjustment information corresponding to each historical requirement use case; wherein each historical requirement use case includes M dimension requirement information, and each business model adjustment information includes M dimensions Business model adjustment information; take the dimension requirement information and dimension business model adjustment information of the same dimension in the historical demand use case and business model adjustment information with corresponding relationship as one dimension feature sample data; use at least one dimension feature sample corresponding to each dimension A machine learning model is trained on the data, and a dimensional business model change analysis tool corresponding to the dimension is obtained; the dimensional business model change analysis tool is used to predict the dimensional business model adjustment information on the corresponding dimension of the demand use case. The present disclosure also provides an apparatus, electronic device, and medium for information management.

title: Data processing method
description: The present disclosure relates to a data processing method, comprising: determining the key of the target object according to the characteristic information of the target object and a trained neural network; performing digital watermark processing on the original data to be transmitted to obtain the watermark data corresponding to the target object, wherein , the watermark data is embedded with the watermark information corresponding to the target object; the corresponding watermark data is encrypted by the key of the target object, and the encrypted data corresponding to the target object is determined; according to the parameters of the neural network and the encrypted data, it is determined for transmission to the target object. data packets, which are sent to the target object. In the data processing method of the embodiment of the present disclosure, the generated data packet is not easy to be cracked, and the security of the data can be effectively improved.

title: A method and system for locating target information in semi-structured traffic data
description: The invention provides a method and system for locating target information in semi-structured traffic data, comprising the following steps: traffic hashing and clustering based on semi-structured data paths; information pre-alignment based on structure vectorization; Hope and alignment information for fast target information localization. The invention uses the "similarity hashing method" to encode the structure information of the traffic data, and realizes the rapid comparison of the similarity of the traffic structure information; and uses the "translation embedding model" to encode the data field of the traffic information, so as to realize the similarity in different traffic flows. The establishment of the corresponding relationship between the data fields; according to the "hash" of the traffic structure, the specific traffic is identified, and the corresponding relationship between the data field between the specific traffic and other traffic is obtained, and the target information can be quickly located.

title: An intelligent frequency conversion water supply method and system
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of intelligent water supply, and discloses an intelligent variable frequency water supply method, which includes: using a multi-index sensor to obtain user water use information, and preprocessing the obtained water use information; using a multivariate clustering algorithm Carry out clustering processing of user water use information to form multiple user groups with similar patterns; process each user group by using the user group information image method to obtain user group information images; use the neural network model to characterize the user group information images Extract the image features of the user group information image; according to the extracted image features, use the frequency conversion water supply strategy based on image features to realize dynamic periodic water supply. The invention also provides an intelligent frequency conversion water supply system. The invention realizes intelligent frequency conversion water supply.

title: Intelligent conversation method, system and medium based on graph neural network
description: The present application provides an intelligent conversation method and system based on a graph neural network. According to the customer conversation text data, customer semantic information, customer response dialogue and customer order results are obtained; according to the customer semantic information, customer response dialogue and customer order results, the customer semantic nodes, customer response dialogue nodes, customer order nodes and the adjacency matrix between nodes are converted into vector forms through a pre-trained language model; the customer semantic nodes, customer response dialogue nodes, customer order nodes and the adjacency matrix between nodes are input into a graph neural network model for training to obtain a trained graph neural network model; the current conversation data is input into the trained graph neural network model to obtain a response conversation path. The present application analyzes the customer's speech while talking to the customer, and predicts the best path with order completion as the end point in combination with the different speech paths of the intelligent robot itself.

title: Information processor, information processing method, and program
description: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To easily and efficiently teach a robot about various actions to an external object.  <P>SOLUTION: In learning, a learning part 201 learns a predetermined time series pattern. An output part 202 outputs the time series pattern corresponding to the result of learning by the learning part 201. An adjusting part 203 inputs the actions of a robot based on the time series pattern outputted by the output part 202 and the time series pattern to be acquired from direct teaching by a user about the actions, and adjusts the time series pattern to be outputted by the output part 202 according to the inputted time series pattern. The learning part 201 learns the time series pattern adjusted by the adjusting part 203 to be outputted from the output part 202.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2007,JPO&INPIT

title: A tracking method of social network information dissemination based on latent dissemination set
description: Tracking is propagated based on the potential social network information for propagating collection the present invention relates to a kind of, including：Set up based on the potential SIR models for propagating collection；Internet message is obtained from social networks, is clustered and is grouped, set up the taxonomy database of network hotspot message；Network hotspot message is chosen from taxonomy database, social networks is sampled, obtain propagation parameter；New network hotspot message is obtained, it is contrasted with the taxonomy database of network hotspot message, select immediate network hotspot type of message, and extract the propagation parameter of acquisition as the reference propagation parameter of new network hotspot message；To being adjusted with reference to propagation parameter, further predict the network hotspot transmission of news situation and carry out manual intervention.The present invention is used in the artificial network of different scales and real network, and three class curves degree are very high in the class curve of S, I, R tri- and analogue simulation situation that are generated by SIPR equation groups, show good effect.

title: Test data evolution generation method based on GA algorithm
description: The invention provides a test data evolution generation method based on a GA algorithm. The invention comprises the following steps: introducing the concept of multiple populations, and further considering the influence of individual similarity and population diversity of the populations on test data generation; the influence of the branch distance and the node coverage rate is considered, so that influence factors are added into various improved calculation formulas, some weight factors are added, weight distribution is carried out on the influence factors, and dynamic self-adaptive adjustment of the test case is facilitated. And the algorithm is strengthened in the aspect of the operational capability through a dynamic self-adaptive adjustment strategy of the cross rate and the variation rate. The contribution degree of the individual is calculated, and then the traditional adaptive value function is adjusted, so that excellent individual can be saved in later evolution, and the test data generation efficiency is improved.

title: Modeling method of aero-engine performance model based on self-tuning Wiener model
description: The invention discloses an aeroengine performance model modeling method based on a self-adjusting wiener model, which comprises the steps of firstly generating training and testing data of the model; and then, transmitting the initial combination of the model characteristic parameters and the training data to a nuclear extreme learning machine together to obtain corresponding optimal model structure parameters, nuclear parameters and output weights, constructing a self-adjusting wiener model, and finally forming the turbofan engine overall performance model by the self-adjusting wiener model cluster. The invention has the advantages that the time constant value of the linear dynamic part can be self-adjusted by using a learning machine, so that the dynamic performance estimation is more accurate, the block wiener model is provided with a nonlinear static module, and the static estimation precision is better than that of the conventional machine learning method. In addition, globally optimal model characteristic parameters and weighting vectors can be directly obtained in a training stage, and an optimization algorithm is not adopted to adjust the model parameters, so that the time consumption of calculation can be obviously reduced.

title: A New Method for Extracting Hidden Knowledge in Linguistic Cognitive Models
description: The present invention relates to data analysis field, the new method that language acknowledging model hides knowledge is extracted it discloses a kind of, is comprised the following steps：（A）The pattern of conclusion part is classified by unsupervised learning；（B）Analyze the common trait domain of premise pattern；（C）Recognize premise pattern feature space and conclusion part feature space；（D）Build inference rule.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows：Feature extraction has been carried out by premise pattern and conclusion pattern to language acknowledging model, has made this feature more accurate than conventional rule；By increasing interpreter, feature space is set to possess interpretation, so as to solve the problems, such as the non-categorical Rule Extraction of language acknowledging model.

title: Inference method of perceptual semantic content through analysis and inference of brain activity
description: A method is provided to infer the perceptual semantic content by measuring and analyzing brain activity. (1) The language description of the perceptual content induced by the training stimulus and the output of the brain activity detection unit that detected the brain activity are input into the data processing unit. (2) The semantic space representation of the training stimulus and the output of the brain activity detection unit are associated in the saved semantic space and saved to the training result information storage unit. (3) The output of the brain activity detection unit that detected the brain activity induced by the new stimulus is input into the data processing unit. The probability distribution of the perceptual semantic content is obtained from the above association of the output of the brain activity detection unit that detected the brain activity induced by the new stimulus. (4) Based on the probability distribution, the content with high probability is inferred as the perceptual semantic content. The above association can also be performed for each subject. In the inference of its probability, the likelihood calculated based on the coordinates of the provided words in the semantic space and the above probability distribution is used as an indicator.

title: Image characterization method and server
description: The embodiment of the application discloses an image characterization method and a server. The image characterization method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image matrix set corresponding to a target image in a preset color space; carrying out dimension reduction processing on the image matrix set to obtain at least one dimension reduction matrix set; calculating according to a preset algorithm by using elements with the same two-dimensional coordinate in a first dimension reduction matrix, a second dimension reduction matrix and a third dimension reduction matrix of the dimension reduction matrix set, and outputting a screening matrix corresponding to the dimension reduction matrix set; based on a screening matrix corresponding to the dimension reduction matrix set, performing data screening on the dimension reduction matrix set to obtain at least one characterization matrix set of the target image; wherein the set of characterization matrices includes a first characterization matrix, a second characterization matrix, and a third characterization matrix. The image characterization method and the server can reduce the operation workload generated when the characterization data of the target image are acquired.

title: Method, device, electronic device and storage medium for indoor monitoring
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and a device for indoor monitoring, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the following steps: receiving perception data collected by a plurality of sensors and the perception data is derived from at least one monitored object; analyzing and identifying the perception data to determine the corresponding relation between the perception data and the at least one monitored object; and analyzing the perception data of the at least one monitored object according to the corresponding relation so as to obtain activity rule data of the at least one monitored object. The embodiment of the invention improves the accuracy and convenience of indoor monitoring.

title: A New Bat Optimization Algorithm System
description: The invention discloses a kind of new bat optimized algorithm system (Iterated local search and stochastic inertia weight bat algorithm system, ILSSIWBAS), including：Bat algorithm operation module, disturbance module and Iterated Local Search module, judge globally optimal solution module, globally optimal solution memory module；Module is run by bat algorithm, bat algorithm is run, obtains locally optimal solution；On the basis of locally optimal solution, by disturbing module, add disturbance, according to office's iteration portion iterative search module, the globally optimal solution of population position is scanned for Iterated Local Search algorithm, after the Rule of judgment of globally optimal solution is met, globally optimal solution is obtained, and globally optimal solution is stored in globally optimal solution memory module.The present invention puies forward system and mainly solves the problems, such as that existing bat optimized algorithm is easily absorbed in that local optimum, optimum results are unstable, improves the low optimization accuracy and optimum results stability of optimized algorithm.

title: A Named Entity Recognition Method Based on Bi-LSTM-CNN
description: The present invention relates to a named entity recognition method based on Bi-LSTM-CNN. This method converts labeled training corpus data into character-level corpus data in the training phase, then trains a deep learning model based on Bi-LSTM-CNN, and converts unlabeled test corpus data into character-level corpus data in the prediction phase data, and then use the deep learning model trained in the training phase to make predictions. The present invention uses character-level rather than word-level vectors, which can avoid the impact of word segmentation accuracy, and can also avoid the problem of unregistered words; in addition, a combined model of bidirectional long-term short-term memory neural network Bi-LSTM and convolutional neural network CNN is adopted. , which significantly improves the accuracy compared with traditional algorithms.

title: A data-driven fault diagnosis method based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention belongs to method for diagnosing faults field, and a kind of data-driven method for diagnosing faults based on convolutional neural networks is disclosed, comprised the following steps：1) time-domain signal sampling is carried out to failure to be detected；2) time-domain signal collected is converted into pending image；3) convolutional neural networks model is built according to the characteristics of pending image；4) image is trained；5) it is predicted using convolutional neural networks model, draws fault diagnosis result.Original time domain signal is converted to 2 dimension gray level images by the present invention, and the data characteristics of gray level image is automatically extracted using improvement convolutional neural networks；Since time-domain signal is converted into 2-D gray image, signal noise will be converted into the factors unrelated with image classification result such as brightness, the gray scale of image, can eliminate as much as influence of the signal noise to final result.This method is easy to carry out and has higher precision, and significantly reduces characteristic extraction procedure and signal noise and influenced caused by final result.

title: Target detection method and device, computer device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: A kind of object detection method, the described method includes：Training sample set is obtained, the training sample set includes multiple target images for being labeled with target location and target angle type；It is trained using the training sample set pair acceleration region convolutional neural networks model, obtains trained acceleration region convolutional neural networks model；Obtain image to be detected；Target detection is carried out to described image to be detected using the trained acceleration region convolutional neural networks model, obtains the target area of described image to be detected and the target angle type of the target area.The present invention also provides a kind of object detecting device, computer installation and readable storage medium storing program for executing.The present invention can realize the target detection of quick high detection rate.

title: A method and system for medical image information recognition based on deep neural network
description: The invention discloses a kind of medical image information recognition methods based on deep neural network and system, wherein, the method includes：Image preprocessing is carried out to the medical image information to be identified got；Profound feature extraction is carried out to pretreated medical image information to be identified using trained deep neural network model；It is identified and matched one by one with the medical image feature in medical image feature database using the profound feature of medical image information to be identified, obtain the similar medical image information of at least more than one；Obtain the corresponding text message of similar medical image information of at least more than one；Keyword extraction processing is carried out to text message；The Medical service information to be matched according to keyword to user feedback and the medical image information to be identified.In embodiments of the present invention, solve the problems, such as that existing medical image matching is slow and inaccurate.

title: An information processing method, terminal and computer-readable medium
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a kind of information processing method, terminal and computer-readable medium, wherein method includes：Information to be operated is obtained, the information to be operated includes at least target operation object and object run；Using the information to be operated as the input of translation model, so as to obtain corresponding target control instruction, wherein, the translation model is trained in advance；According to the instruction that the target control instructs, the object run corresponding to the information to be operated is performed for the target operation object；Using the embodiment of the present invention, the accuracy rate of instruction identification can be promoted.

title: A UUV dynamic programming method based on LSTM-RNN
description: The invention discloses a UUV dynamic programming method based on LSTM-RNN, which belongs to the field of unmanned underwater vehicles, and comprises the following steps: step (1): select a geometric model to construct an obstacle environment model; step (2): use an ant colony algorithm to establish UUV dynamic planner for obtaining data sets; step (3): design the LSTM-RNN network model for dynamic programming; step (4): obtain data sets: step (5): use the data training of the training set in the data set LSTM-RNN network to obtain a dynamic planner based on LSTM-RNN network; step (6): input sonar detection information and target point information to a motion planner based on LSTM-RNN network to obtain the course and direction of the UUV at the next moment speed. This method has a strong learning ability, but also has a very strong generalization ability, which makes the implemented dynamic planner suitable for complex environments. At the same time, it meets the requirements of real-time performance, and the planned path conforms to the motion characteristics of UUV.

title: Generate a target sequence from an input sequence using partial conditions
description: The system may be configured to perform various tasks, such as converting recorded speech into a sequence of phonemes representing the speech, converting an input sequence of graphemes into a target sequence of phonemes, translating an input sequence of words of one language into a corresponding sequence of words of another language, or predicting a target sequence of words following an input sequence of words of one language (e.g., a language model). In a speech recognizer, the RNN system may be used to convert speech into a target sequence of phonemes in real time so that transcription of the speech may be generated and presented to the user even before the user has fully spoken the entire speech input.

title: Methods and systems for fixed-point optimization of convolutional neural networks
description: The invention provides a method and a system for optimizing convolutional neural network fixed-point, comprising the following steps: and (3) a quantization step: quantizing the pre-trained convolutional neural network, quantizing the input of the convolutional neural network into N bits of fixed point numbers, quantizing parameters in a convolutional kernel into numbers in a preset set, and selecting the number closest to the Euclidean distance in the preset set for quantization; training: controlling the parameters of the convolution layer to be unchanged, and training the quantized convolution neural network; convolution operation step: the trained convolutional neural network is input into a convolver, the input of the convolver is N fixed point numbers of N bits and N convolution kernel parameters of 4bits, N input tree-shaped cascade adder is input through a shifter, and N is the number of convolution kernels. The invention improves the operation efficiency, reduces the power consumption and ensures the accuracy of the prediction result.

title: Airport foreign object identification method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses an airport foreign object recognition method, device, computer equipment and storage medium. When a foreign object in a detection image is detected by a foreign object detection model, continuous predetermined frame images of the detection image are acquired to form a recognition image set. The comparison result is obtained by identifying the similarity between the feature vector of the corresponding position of the foreign object in the image set and the feature vector of the reference feature vector, and finally the recognition result is generated according to the comparison result. It can avoid the misjudgment of the recognition result caused by the detection image being affected by the surrounding environment changes (illumination, shadow, etc.), so as to screen out some misjudgment samples in the process of airport foreign object recognition, thereby improving the recognition accuracy of airport foreign objects.

title: Integration method for predicating quantile probabilistic short-term power load
description: The invention relates to a quantile probabilistic short-term power load prediction integration method, and belongs to the technical field of power system analysis. The method comprises the following steps: dividing historical load data into two parts, wherein the first part is used for training a single quantile probability prediction model, and the second part is used for determining the weights of multiple prediction methods so as to integrate load prediction; performing playback sampling on the first part of data to obtain a plurality of new training data sets; training three regression models of neural network quantile regression, random forest quantile regression and progressive gradient regression tree quantile regression for each training data set; and establishing an optimization model taking the least quantile loss as an objective function on the second data set to determine the weight of each quantile regression model, thereby finally obtaining the quantile probabilistic integrated load prediction model. The method can improve the accuracy of probabilistic load prediction further on the basis of various single prediction models, and is beneficial to reducing the running cost of the power system.

title: A face image quality assessment method and system based on multi-dimensional assessment standards
description: The present invention provides a face image quality evaluation method and system based on multi-dimensional evaluation standards. The method includes: collecting face images as training data; classifying the training data according to degraded features of different dimensions; classifying Each type of image in the final training data is initially evaluated and labeled; according to the classification results of degraded features of different dimensions, branch tasks corresponding to each type of dimension feature are established; The evaluation model performs multi-branch task prediction on the input face image to be evaluated, and completes the face image quality evaluation; the present invention uses a deep neural network to extract image features, and simultaneously completes the all-round quality evaluation of multiple image quality influencing factors, and obtains The comprehensive image quality score is closer to the subjective judgment of the human eye, and has a faster evaluation speed. After filtering out low-quality images, it can effectively improve the performance of face recognition.

title: Lossless compression method for hyperspectral images based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a hyperspectral image lossless compression method based on deep learning, which solves the problems of insufficient utilization of spectral information and low model generalization capability of the traditional method. The implementation steps comprise: establishing a prediction model by using a cyclic neural network in deep learning, performing prediction training on each pixel in a hyperspectral image, and generating a predicted image and a prediction network; performing difference on the hyperspectral image and the predicted image to generate a residual image; performing arithmetic coding on the residual image to generate a code stream file; decoding the code stream file to obtain a decoded image; predicting by using the trained network to obtain a predicted image; and adding the predicted image and the decoded image to obtain an original hyperspectral image. The invention combines deep learning with the traditional method, adopts a unit with a memorability structure in the network, fully utilizes spectral information through a large amount of training, increases the generalization capability of the model and improves the compression efficiency. The method is applied to the field of hyperspectral image compression.

title: Method and device for establishing age prediction model, age prediction method and device
description: The present invention provides a kind of method and device for establishing age prediction model, age prediction technique and device, which comprises m reference personnel's data set corresponding to the t1 weighted image of the brain section on x-axis, y-axis, each section direction of z-axis of building With Wherein, w refers to that the white matter t1 weighted image in corresponding cerebral white matter region, g refer to the grey matter t1 weighted image in corresponding cerebral gray matter region；N is the number with reference to personnel, and the value range of n is 1 to m.It is that the t1 weighted image in each data set adds age mark according to the corresponding real age with reference to personnel of t1 weighted image.Based on convolutional neural networks to data set With It is trained, foundation respectively corresponds data set With Age predict submodel.Determine the highest age prediction submodel of age precision of prediction as age prediction model.

title: A wood identification method and system based on deep learning of structural feature images
description: The embodiment of the present invention relates to a wood identification method and system based on deep learning of structural feature images, the method comprising: collecting structural image data of wood cross-sections; dividing the image data into multiple image blocks of the same size; Establishing a training set and a test set corresponding to the image data for each of the image blocks; constructing a multi-layer convolutional neural network for wood image identification; using the training set to perform deep learning on the multi-layer convolutional neural network for wood image identification; The test set is used to test the deep learning model, and the model parameters are optimized according to the test results to generate a wood image identification deep learning algorithm model; according to the image recognition deep learning algorithm model, the wood image data to be identified is identified. Thus, accurate and rapid identification of the wood species to be identified can be realized.

title: A crowd counting method and system
description: The invention discloses a crowd counting method and system based on a scale pyramid neural network, wherein the scale pyramid neural network structure takes VGG-16 as the basic skeleton, and a scale pyramid module is embedded in a high layer to extract multi-scale high-level features, wherein the scale pyramid module It consists of four atrous convolutions with different dilation rates in parallel. Input the image to the network, after a series of convolutions, high-level features are obtained and passed to the scale pyramid module to generate four feature maps, which are concatenated with the feature map input to the module in the "channel" dimension, and passed to the next The convolutional layer of , finally obtains the density map through 1×1 convolution. Compared with the prior art, the method of the present invention has a more efficient, more accurate and simpler network structure, and can apply a module for dealing with multi-scale problems to a deep network.

title: A method for binaural sound source localization based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses a kind of binaural sound sources localization method based on convolutional neural networks calculates the cross-correlation function of binaural signals in subband, forms 2-D data as characteristic parameter, is trained to convolutional neural networks, obtains convolutional neural networks classifier；The cross-correlation function of test binaural signals is calculated in test process as two dimensional character parameter, estimates the corresponding azimuth information of every frame binaural signals using trained convolutional neural networks classifier.It is under different acoustic enviroments the experimental results showed that, binaural sound sources localization method proposed by the present invention based on convolutional neural networks, with good robustness, it especially has been obviously improved correct localization in strong noise and strong reverberation, has been better than classic algorithm in the prior art.

title: Space-based multi-platform collaborative monitoring method
description: The invention discloses a space-based multi-platform collaborative monitoring method, and belongs to the technical field of information. Perform multi-angle coordinated monitoring on the tracking target to obtain the video to be detected; detect each frame image in each video, and output the cropped image and the corresponding confidence. The cropped image with the confidence level higher than or equal to the threshold H  d  is matched with the tracking target, and the similarity between the cropped image and the tracking target is calculated. The similarity is higher than a threshold value equal to the target similarity H  s  cropped image will remain tied to the region of interest, the frame is a frame of interest upgrade. Selecting a frame image of clear imaging in the frame of interest for precise tracking, and obtaining the best matching position of the tracking target. If the highest score corresponding to the best matching position is higher than or equal to the set tracking threshold H  t  , the monitor maintains the monitoring state and processes the next frame of the clear image. The invention adjusts the angle and position of the monitor in real time, and performs coordinated monitoring and correction on the target, thereby finally achieving accurate monitoring effect.

title: Prediction method of NDVI in grassland area of northern China based on BPNN
description: The prediction technique of the invention discloses a kind of grassland in northern China area NDVI based on BPNN: the following annual Growing season Month average rainfall BPNN prediction model is established；Establish the following annual Growing season Month average rainfall-NDVI mapping model；The future that rainfall BPNN prediction model is generated annual precipitation during growing season monthly average predicted value, is updated in rainfall-NDVI mapping model, obtains the following annual Growing season NDVI monthly average predicted value.The present invention can be with Accurate Prediction Growing season (the 6-8 month) NDVI average value, to realize the livestock number (animal number) that can be herded according to the predicted value of the NDVI assessment following time, this method is conducive to realize dynamic grazing strategy based on predictable weather conditions, overgrazes to avoid the disaster time.

title: Inline data inspection for workload simplification
description: A method, computer-readable medium, and system for inline data checking are disclosed. The method includes the steps of receiving a load instruction by a load/store unit and obtaining data specified by the load instruction via checking circuitry coupled to the load/store unit. An additional step includes determining that the data is equal to zero and sending the data and a predicate signal to the load/store unit, wherein the predicate signal indicates that the data is equal to zero. An optional additional step includes calculating a predicate value based on a comparison between the data and a threshold value, and sending the data and the predicate value to the load/store unit, wherein the predicate value is asserted when the data is less than the threshold value and negated when the data is not less than the threshold value.

title: A method and device for network intrusion detection based on temporal neural network
description: The invention provides a network intrusion detection method based on a time series neural network. The method includes: collecting network traffic data in the points to be detected, and classifying and storing the network traffic data; preprocessing the classified and stored network traffic data, and the preprocessing includes symbol feature digitization and feature value normalization ;Train the GRU network, and use the trained GRU network to detect the preprocessed network traffic data; if the detected data result shows normal traffic, the traffic is allowed to pass through the current detection point; if the detected data result shows attack traffic, it will be sent to User alerts. The present invention further simplifies the network structure on the basis of LSTM by adopting the GRU network, which can not only effectively solve the shortcomings of the RNN, but also meet the real-time requirements of the network compared with the LSTM.

title: Text translation method and related device
description: The invention discloses a method for text translation, comprising: obtaining a text sequence to be translated; encoding the text sequence to be translated to obtain a first implicit state sequence; obtaining a first state vector; containing the state sequence, generate the second implicit state sequence; according to the second implicit state sequence and the first state vector, generate the context vector corresponding to the current word; according to the context vector, the first state vector and the first target word, determine the first Two target words, wherein the first target word is the translation result corresponding to the previous word, and the second target word is the translation result corresponding to the current word. The invention also discloses a text translation device. In the process of encoding the text sequence to be translated corresponding to the source language text, the embodiment of the present invention introduces the context vector obtained by decoding, thereby enhancing the representation of the text sequence to be translated, thereby improving the translation quality.

title: A deep convolutional neural network character recognition method with embedded sparse connections
description: The invention discloses a kind of depth convolutional neural networks character identifying methods for being embedded in partially connected, belong to Information and Communication Engineering field.Character identifying method provided by the invention, it is based on depth convolutional neural networks, unlike existing method, the present invention is the improvement to depth convolutional neural networks structure, aiming at the problem that memory overflows when the training present in the legacy network, it is embedded in partially connected layer in original depth convolutional neural networks, increases the width of network, reduce parameter, reduces the dimension of parameter space.To save the required hardware spending in network training and test, reduce occupied memory headroom when trained network, required duration when shortening trained.

title: A tongue image segmentation method based on single target region segmentation
description: A kind of tongue body image partition method based on single goal region segmentation, method includes the following steps: step 1) original image obtains: acquisition tongue body original image；Step (2) image labeling: it is manually marked using each tongue body original image of the improved Grabcut algorithm of super-pixel to acquisition；Step (3) image making: the image after manually marking will be carried out and form image pair with corresponding tongue body original image；Step (4) trains neural network: by training set image, being trained to single goal semantic segmentation neural network；Step (5) tests neural network: being split using trained single goal semantic segmentation neural network to tongue body image, is tested by test set image neural network.Tongue body image partition method provided by the invention realizes that the mark to conventional images, segmentation, study generate mask images, then is synthetically formed tongue body segmentation figure with original image using single goal range constraint depth network.

title: A data processing method, apparatus, device and computer-readable storage medium
description: The present invention provides a data processing method, apparatus, device and computer-readable storage medium, which are used to improve the accuracy of neural network prediction results. The method includes: dividing the sample data in any one of the multiple cycles into N parts; wherein, N is a positive integer greater than 1; performing model training on each part of the sample data to obtain N prediction models; using the test The data respectively tests the accuracy of each of the N prediction models; the data input to the neural network in any one cycle is determined according to the accuracy of the N prediction models.

title: A kind of method and device for predicting pedestrian movement
description: The present application provides a method and device for predicting pedestrian motion, the method includes: inputting vector distance data between the pedestrian to be predicted and other pedestrians in the first preset forward space where the pedestrian to be predicted is located, into a pre-built The first speed prediction model is used to predict the movement speed of the pedestrian to be predicted; the distribution data of pedestrians in the second preset forward space where the pedestrian to be predicted is located are input into the pre-built second speed prediction The model is used to predict the moving direction of the pedestrian to be predicted; the speed of the pedestrian to be predicted is determined according to the predicted moving speed and the moving direction. The above-mentioned pedestrian movement prediction process gets rid of the dependence on a large number of calculation formulas and operation rules, and realizes the prediction of pedestrian movement completely based on the input data and artificial intelligence operation model, and the prediction process is more objective.

title: Project cost consultation data deduction method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of project cost consultation data deduction, in particular to a project cost consultation data deduction method which comprises the following steps of S1, collecting and arranging data, namely collecting various data related to the project cost, cleaning and preprocessing the data after the data is collected, S2, analyzing the data, namely describing the data distribution by using a statistical method, knowing the distribution condition of the project cost, carrying out correlation analysis so as to identify key factors influencing the project cost, and displaying the data distribution by a visualization tool.

title: KAN network-based device missing size data prediction method and system
description: The present invention relates to the field of microelectronics technology, and provides a method and system for predicting missing dimension data of a device based on a KAN network, including constructing a device group and setting different experimental conditions, collecting corresponding measurement data; performing data preprocessing on the geometric parameters, experimental conditions and collected measurement data of the devices in the device group, classifying them according to the geometric parameters and experimental conditions, and constructing a data set; constructing a device missing dimension data prediction model based on a KAN network structure, automatically adjusting the learning rate through an Adam optimizer, and using RMSE as a loss function; inputting the geometric parameters and experimental conditions of the devices in the device group as input data into the prediction model, and generating a predicted current Id. The missing dimension data is predicted using existing experimental data, and by filling in the data gaps in the device dimension combination, the model can more accurately predict the device behavior under different conditions, avoid repeated experimental measurements, and optimize resource utilization.

title: Multi-agent policy diversity-based implementation method and system
description: The present invention relates to an implementation method and system based on multi-agent strategy diversification, belonging to the field of multi-agent reinforcement learning technology. The method comprises the following steps: first, in the exploration phase, a multi-agent proximal strategy optimization framework is used to update the strategy, and global value assessment and local action generation are realized through centralized training of a decentralized execution architecture; at the same time, the coefficient of variation of the reward sequence is calculated through a sliding window, and the strategy convergence is dynamically detected. If the strategy converges, the current exploration strategy is collected into a historical strategy library; finally, a strategy particle set is extracted from the historical strategy repository based on the Stein variational gradient descent algorithm, and the strategy is driven to optimize the unexplored behavior space to break through the local optimum. The present invention significantly improves the diversity, adaptability and computational efficiency of multi-agent strategies through adaptive convergence detection, historical strategy repository architecture, and a complete framework integrating MAPPO and SVGD.

title: Dynamic polarization-beam steering anti-interference method and system based on intelligent metasurface
description: The invention provides an intelligent super-surface-based dynamic polarization-beam regulation anti-interference method and system, which relate to the technical field of wireless communication and comprise an intelligent super-surface array, a controller, a channel sensing module and a joint optimization module. The polarization state and the phase configuration of the intelligent super-surface unit are dynamically adjusted by sensing the channel state and the interference characteristics in the wireless environment in real time, so that the cooperative optimization of the polarization domain and the space domain is realized, an enhanced propagation path aiming at the expected user is formed, meanwhile, the interference source is inhibited, and the anti-interference capability and the communication quality of the system are improved. The invention adopts a mixed optimization strategy driven by combining deep reinforcement learning with a model, reduces the calculation complexity, realizes quick response to a dynamic interference environment, and improves the frequency spectrum efficiency and the energy efficiency through polarization-wave beam combined optimization. Through the collaborative optimization of the polarization domain and the space domain, the self-adaptive response to the complex interference environment is realized, and meanwhile, the energy consumption and the realization cost are reduced.

title: Meteorological service knowledge graph generation method and system based on resource collaboration of creating platform
description: The present invention provides a method and system for generating a meteorological service knowledge graph based on resource collaboration of an industrial innovation platform. First, the industrial demand data set and the meteorological monitoring data set in the industrial innovation platform are obtained. Then, the industrial demand features are semantically aligned to generate industrial semantic related features. The meteorological element observation features are spatially and temporally integrated to generate a meteorological element feature set. Then, based on a preset resource collaboration network, the cross-domain features of the two are matched to generate a meteorological service sub-graph set containing disaster prevention and resource utilization related sub-graphs. Afterwards, the sub-graph node connection weights are dynamically adjusted according to the real-time interaction data of industrial entities, and the priority sorting results are obtained in combination with the timeliness evaluation rules. Finally, the adapted meteorological service strategy is pushed to the service interface of the industrial innovation platform according to the priority sorting result, covering the disaster warning guidance parameters and the climate resource allocation plan, so as to achieve accurate adaptation and dynamic response of meteorological services to industrial needs.

title: Smart city emergency dispatch management method and system based on converged communication
description: A smart city emergency dispatch management method and system based on converged communications relates to the field of smart city technology. A multi-source data acquisition terminal is used to collect operating data of ground base stations in real time. Whether the ground base stations are damaged is determined based on a damage prediction model combined with a heartbeat packet mechanism. A GIS distribution map is constructed and the initial deployment location of drone base stations is obtained. Traffic migration and frequency band switching are performed between ground base stations and drone base stations. Load adjustment is performed on different ground base stations and drone base stations. The location of drone base stations is optimized to obtain dynamic deployment locations. Whether rotation is required is determined and corresponding rotation drone base stations are deployed. This method can significantly reduce previous emergency response times, effectively improve the flexibility of equipment scheduling, and provide optimal data transmission services for user devices.

title: Intelligent question-answering method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention relates to the fields of artificial intelligence technology and medical health technology, and discloses an intelligent question-answering method, device, computer equipment and storage medium, the method comprising: obtaining input data, and based on the type of the input data, using a corresponding feature extraction model to extract features from the input data to generate a patient health portrait; obtaining context information of the consultation dialogue, and generating new context information based on the context information and the patient health portrait, until the user ends the consultation, and the final context information is used as the result of multiple rounds of dialogue; based on the multiple rounds of dialogue results and the patient health portrait, the corresponding consultation information is retrieved from the medical knowledge base, and medical advice is generated based on the consultation information. The present invention solves the technical problem that the prior art cannot adapt to dynamic real-time information.

title: Integrated sensing equipment-oriented pest and disease damage early warning method and system based on online learning and large model
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of computers, and particularly relates to an integrated sensing equipment-oriented pest and disease damage early warning method and system based on online learning and a large model. The method comprises the steps of deploying integrated sensor sites in a monitoring area, collecting farmland environment data, carrying out multi-step prospective prediction on the collected data by adopting a lightweight LSTM, simultaneously transmitting the data collected in the step 1 to an online learning module, carrying out periodic training by using the online learning module through accumulating historical data of the integrated sensor as training data updated by weights to update a lightweight LSTM algorithm, automatically adjusting a threshold interval, constructing a pest knowledge base, generating a structured promtt input large model by using the knowledge base and a prospective prediction result for dynamic analysis of pest occurrence conditions, and generating early warning information and an operation prescription. According to the invention, the weight can be dynamically updated by increasing the model with time through the incremental online learning algorithm, so as to adapt to the problem of dynamic change of the environment.

title: Intelligent integrated warehouse logistics management method based on electronic tag
description: The application relates to an intelligent integrated warehouse logistics management method based on an electronic tag, which comprises the steps of obtaining real-time humidity monitoring data of a warehouse environment, combining temperature and ventilation conditions to generate an environment parameter matrix, training a mapping relation model of humidity and tag performance according to the environment parameter matrix to obtain the influence weight of the humidity on the tag performance, judging whether the tag performance is close to a failure threshold value by adopting a support vector machine algorithm according to the comprehensive score of the tag performance to generate a performance early warning signal, when the performance early warning signal is triggered, predicting the change trend of the tag performance by adopting time sequence analysis to generate a performance degradation curve, updating the tag performance evaluation model parameter according to the performance degradation curve by adopting a Bayesian network model to optimize the model prediction precision, applying the updated model parameter to a dynamic performance evaluation model, and combining the real-time environment parameter matrix to output a tag health state diagnosis result in real time.

title: Wind generating set power curve prediction method and device
description: The invention provides a method and a device for predicting a power curve of a wind generating set, and relates to the technical field of wind generating sets. Then, the generated data at the previous time is used as input, the actual power at the next time is used as a label, a multiple linear regression model is trained to focus on the influence of the current time, the conventional accumulated influence is easily ignored, the generated data at the previous times is used as input, the actual power at the next time is used as the label, a long-period memory network model is trained to focus on the influence of time sequence data, and the method is applicable to dynamically-changed data. Analyzing the data of the rotation speed, the wind speed, the temperature and the humidity of the generator, obtaining a fluctuation adjustment coefficient, correcting the actual power predicted by the two models at the current moment by applying the fluctuation adjustment coefficient, and applying the corrected actual power to a power curve of the wind generating set.

title: Component recommendation method, system and device for CAD drawing
description: The embodiments of the present disclosure provide a component recommendation method, system and device for CAD drawing drawing. Applied to the technical field of CAD drawing drawing and recommendation system, it includes: obtaining CAD component attribute information, encoding the text description of the CAD component using a text feature extractor; constructing a CAD component knowledge graph based on the association relationship between CAD components, and extracting the associated knowledge representation; constructing a contrastive learning loss function, and aligning the ID embedding of the CAD component with the text description and the associated knowledge representation to obtain aligned multi-dimensional component information; using an orthogonal decomposition method to extract isomorphic features, and using a self-attention mechanism to fuse them to generate a component representation enhanced with auxiliary information; integrating the component representation of the component assembly context information, and predicting the next CAD component required for the drawing design through a sequential recommendation process. In this way, the present invention can accurately recommend adaptation components and improve the robustness of recommendations in complex engineering scenarios.

title: Building digital twin three-dimensional reconstruction method and system based on large model
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for three-dimensional reconstruction of building digital twins based on large models, which relates to the technical field of fusion of building digital twins and three-dimensional modeling, including deploying multi-source equipment in buildings, collecting multi-angle data of buildings, and performing type differentiation and structured preprocessing. An adaptive deep network model is constructed and trained to identify building features, and a multi-type enhancement strategy is adopted to improve the robustness of the model. A fusion algorithm is used to achieve point cloud splicing and coordinate unification, and twin model updates and synchronization are achieved based on multi-dimensional thresholds. The method described in the present invention establishes high-quality input for the deep model; enables the recognition of building structural features to have robustness and accuracy advantages; and enables the twin model to have dynamic update capabilities. The three form a complete closed loop, ultimately breaking through the technical bottlenecks of traditional reconstruction methods in accuracy, stability and updateability, and realizing a new path for three-dimensional modeling of building digital twins for complex scenes.

title: Data processing method, device and electronic device
description: The present application discloses a data processing method, device and electronic device, which relate to the field of information processing. The data processing method comprises: in the process of training a target model, according to the idle resources of a storage module in an electronic device and the training status of the target model, determining the target data required for this training iteration, wherein the target data is part of the target model data; transferring the target data from a first storage module of the electronic device to a second storage module of the electronic device, wherein the data in the first storage module is transferred from a third storage module of the electronic device, and the total capacity of the third storage module is respectively greater than the total capacity of the first storage module and the total capacity of the second storage module; and controlling the training module of the electronic device to train the target model according to the target data in the second storage module.

title: Foundation beam deflection prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on TL-PINN
description: The present invention provides a foundation beam deflection prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on TL-PINN, by constructing multiple PINN local prediction models, selecting a corresponding number of coordinate points in the two-dimensional parameter space of the foundation beam, and inputting each PINN local prediction model one by one for deflection prediction training, and obtaining multiple deflection prediction values; using each trained PINN local prediction model as a source domain model, and expanding and generating multiple target domain models based on transfer learning, each target domain model is trained to obtain multiple groups of deflection distribution data sets; forming a PINN global proxy model, and inputting multiple groups of deflection distribution data sets and corresponding coordinate points for training, so as to predict the deflection of global parameters. The present application only needs to collect a small amount of foundation beam dynamic deflection data under the condition of small-range parameter changes, so as to realize global parameter prediction, and there is no need to repeat modeling of new working conditions.

title: Image noise reduction method and device
description: The present invention provides an image denoising method, which uses a guided filtering estimation convolutional neural network to estimate the filter radius and regularization parameter of a guided filtering processing module. After obtaining the estimated value, the guided filtering processing module performs filtering processing on an input image according to the estimated filter radius and regularization parameter, and decomposes the input image into a base layer and a detail layer according to the guided filtering processing result; the base layer includes low-frequency information and a rough outline of the image, and the detail layer includes high-frequency information including noise; the noise estimation convolutional neural network is used to estimate the noise of the detail layer to obtain noise, and the noise in the detail layer is removed to obtain the detail layer with the noise removed; the base layer and the detail layer with the noise removed are re-fused to obtain a denoised output image. The present invention also provides an image denoising device.

title: Geological model modeling optimization method, device, equipment, storage medium and product
description: The present invention provides a modeling optimization method, device, equipment, storage medium and product of a geological model, which relates to the field of geological science and technology. The method includes: constructing an initial geological voxel model based on the geological information of the area to be studied; performing level set function modeling on each geological interface respectively to obtain multiple initial voxel level set functions; performing gravity anomaly forward modeling based on each initial voxel level set function to obtain theoretical gravity anomaly information; optimizing each initial voxel level set function based on a genetic algorithm to obtain a coarse-resolution geological voxel model; and optimizing the coarse-resolution geological voxel model based on actual gravity anomaly information and theoretical gravity anomaly information to obtain a target geological model. Through the above-mentioned method, the resolution of the model can be effectively improved, the accuracy and reliability of the target geological model can be ensured, and the target geological model can accurately reflect the real geological structure of the area to be studied.

title: An automated evidence collection method and system for software copyright infringement
description: The present application provides an automated evidence collection method and system for software copyright infringement. Among them, the method first collects the calling sequence of multi-language interfaces based on the target software running process to form unified semantic expression data; at the same time, a high-sensitivity sound sensor is used to record the sound signal of the electronic device motherboard to generate the device sound characteristics; then the semantic data and the sound characteristics are jointly encoded through a cross-modal alignment mechanism to generate multi-modal related data; then the memory enhancement unit and machine learning technology are used to automatically learn the correspondence between the multi-language interface and the sound characteristics, and establish a cross-modal mapping relationship; finally, based on the mapping relationship, the cross-language plagiarism behavior is matched and the software similarity relationship data is automatically output. This application realizes the automated and accurate detection of cross-language software plagiarism behavior by combining code semantic analysis with hardware voiceprint features.

title: An equivariant neural network model for molecular conformation optimization tasks
description: The present disclosure provides an isovariate neural network model for molecular conformational optimization tasks. The method comprises four steps of firstly, giving a molecular graph, obtaining a corresponding low-quality conformation by using an open-source bioinformatics tool RDKit, secondly, encoding the low-quality conformation into a hidden space by using an encoder, thirdly, optimizing the low-quality conformation by using an isovariational transform architecture driven by Wasserstein gradient flow to minimize an energy function based on an atomic potential mixing model, and fourthly, decoding a final ground state conformation, namely a most stable molecular conformation from the hidden space by using a decoder. Compared with the previous method, the method provided by the invention can remarkably improve the accuracy and efficiency of obtaining the molecular ground state conformation while remarkably improving the interpretability of the model.

title: A large language model fine-tuning method for medical analysis and related equipment
description: The application relates to the technical field of large language model fine tuning, and provides a large language model fine tuning method and related equipment for medical analysis. The method comprises the steps of obtaining sparse masks for describing positions of a plurality of training parameters of a large language model, training the large language model according to a self-adaptive low-rank adaptation algorithm to obtain the self-adaptive low-rank adapter, training the large language model according to the sparse masks to obtain the sparse adapter, constructing a joint optimization target of the self-adaptive low-rank adapter and the sparse adapter, carrying out minimum solution on the joint optimization target to obtain a final self-adaptive low-rank adapter and a final sparse adapter, and combining the final self-adaptive low-rank adapter and the final sparse adapter with the large language model to obtain the final large language model. The method of the application can reduce the consumption of computing resources of medical analysis.

title: Bridge crack dataset construction method based on multimodal data enhancement and GAN network
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of data processing, and particularly discloses a bridge crack data set construction method based on multi-mode data enhancement and a GAN network, aiming at key problems of small sample learning, insufficient data diversity, high-resolution image generation and the like in bridge crack detection tasks, the invention provides a solution for fusing multi-mode data enhancement and depth symmetry GAN, simulates real scene interference through a combined enhancement strategy, the method is characterized by covering 98% of interference types of a real scene, solving the problem that the traditional enhancement technology cannot simulate complex shooting conditions, designing a depth-symmetric GAN network, eliminating chessboard effect of generated images and improving high-frequency detail retention capacity, generating 640 x 640 resolution images, constructing a high-quality bridge crack data set, expanding bridge crack data, generating crack images in different forms, and solving the problems of scarcity of the crack image data set and the like in bridge crack detection under complex background.

title: A digital pathology scanner that can automatically identify and annotate lesion areas
description: The present invention discloses a digital pathology scanner capable of automatically identifying and marking lesion areas, comprising a housing, a micro-host, a touch screen, a scanning component, an imaging component and an intelligent analysis system, wherein the housing is used to provide a pathology scanning space, the micro-host is used to coordinate and control scanning operations, the touch screen is used to display scanning data, and the scanning component is used to scan pathology sections. The present invention realizes automatic identification and marking of pathology sections through the cooperation of the housing, the micro-host, the touch screen, the scanning component, the imaging component and the intelligent analysis system, effectively shortens the time of pathology diagnosis and improves work efficiency through automated scanning, imaging and identification, can more accurately identify and extract features of lesion areas through image preprocessing and feature extraction technology, and the classification and identification module is based on a machine learning algorithm and can more accurately judge the type and nature of lesion areas, thereby improving the accuracy of diagnosis.

title: A weak current pipeline settlement monitoring system based on multi-source data fusion
description: The application provides a weak current pipeline settlement monitoring system based on multi-source data fusion. The system comprises a ground sensor array, a satellite remote sensing module, a data analysis platform and a multi-source data fusion algorithm, wherein the ground sensor array comprises a plurality of fiber bragg grating hydrostatic level gauges, a strain sensing optical cable and a plurality of MEMS triaxial accelerometers and is sequentially used for acquiring horizontal displacement, deformation stress and vertical settlement, the satellite remote sensing module comprises a synthetic aperture radar module and a GNSS module and is sequentially used for acquiring ground surface deformation data and elevation data of a monitoring area, the data analysis platform is used for extracting features of data acquired by the ground sensor array, and carrying out multi-source data fusion on the extracted features and satellite remote sensing data acquired by the satellite remote sensing module by adopting the multi-source data fusion algorithm, and settlement monitoring and early warning are carried out based on fusion results. The scheme of the application solves the problems of insufficient single monitoring precision and delayed response of the traditional method, can obviously improve the settlement early warning reliability of the pipeline and effectively prevent the pipeline fracture risk.

title: Unmanned aerial vehicle combat intent judging method based on Bayesian model and man-machine complementarity
description: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle combat intent judging method based on Bayesian model and man-machine complementarity, which has the technical scheme that a man-machine hybrid intelligent framework combining Bayesian inference and man-machine complementarity theory is constructed, real-time situation information of an enemy unmanned aerial vehicle is collected and analyzed, feature extraction is carried out on the situation data of the enemy unmanned aerial vehicle, independent intent judgment is carried out by machine intelligence and human intelligence respectively, relevant parameters are obtained dynamically through Bayesian inference, a confidence feedback mechanism is utilized, a human and machine prediction result is fused by combining man-machine complementarity coefficient, and a more robust and accurate intent recognition result is generated through dynamic weight distribution and parameter adjustment. The intelligent complementary method has the beneficial effects that the intuitive judgment of human intelligence and the complementary advantage of high-speed calculation of machine intelligence are effectively fused in a complex dynamic battlefield environment.

title: Digital management system and method for whole process of manufacturing intelligent PE (polyethylene) pipe
description: The digital management system and method for the entire process of intelligent PE pipe manufacturing of the present invention include a data acquisition module, a digital twin module, an analysis and optimization module, a detection module, and an integration module. The data acquisition module forms a first signal; the digital twin module receives the first signal and constructs a digital twin model, integrating material characteristic parameters and environmental data to simulate the crystallization process of the pipe to form a second signal; the analysis and optimization module receives the simulation data of the second signal and forms a third signal; the detection module receives the defect image and wall thickness data of the detection instrument, forms a fourth signal and transmits it to the digital twin module to update the digital twin model; the integration module integrates the optimization instructions of the third signal and the quality constraints of the fourth signal, generates equipment control instructions and sends them to the production line. The digital management system for the entire process of intelligent PE pipe manufacturing of the present invention can solve the problems of data islands, quality fluctuations, energy waste, and difficulty in quality traceability in PE pipe manufacturing.

title: Pipeline crack detection method, device, equipment and medium
description: The application discloses a pipeline crack detection method, a device, equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of pipeline detection, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a time sequence signal for detecting a target pipeline; the time series signal comprises a plurality of signal samples, each signal sample corresponds to an ultrasonic guided wave signal at a time point, the ultrasonic guided wave signal at each time point is an ultrasonic guided wave signal received from one end of a target pipeline after being transmitted from the other end of the target pipeline, the time series signal is input into a pipeline crack detection model to output a crack detection result, the pipeline crack detection model comprises a dynamic characteristic enhancement module, the dynamic characteristic enhancement module is used for outputting multi-scale characteristics according to different convolution kernel sizes, and one signal sample corresponds to one sample characteristic vector.

title: Power equipment defect detection method and system
description: The present invention relates to a method and system for detecting defects in power equipment. First, historical defect image data of power equipment is collected and preprocessed to obtain a data set. Then, a deep learning model is built. The model architecture includes a quantum neural network, a backbone network, a multi-scale feature fusion layer, and a target position and category prediction layer. The deep learning model is trained using the data set in S1 to obtain a defect detection model. Finally, the defect detection model is deployed on an edge device. The edge device inputs the current target power equipment image into the defect detection model and outputs the power equipment defect detection results, thereby realizing power equipment defect detection. Compared with the existing technology, the present invention has the advantages of adapting to complex inspection environments, accurate detection, and high confidence.

title: System and method for nucleotide analysis
description: A system and method for the detection of pathogens and other microbes using nucleotide analysis is described. Aligned and unaligned nucleotide sequences are utilized to predict the presence or absence of pathogens and other microbes.

title: Indoor scene structural estimation system and estimation method thereof based on deep learning network
description: An indoor scene structural estimation system and an estimation method based on deep learning network are provided. An indoor scene structural estimation system based on deep learning network includes a 2D encoder, a 2D plane decoder, a 2D edge decoder, a 2D corner decoder, and a 3D encoder. The 2D encoder receives an input image and encodes the input image. The 2D plane decoder is connected to the 2D encoder, decodes the encoded input image, and generates a 2D plane segment layout image. The 2D plane decoder is connected to the 2D encoder, decodes the encoded input image, and generates a 2D plane segment layout image. The 2D corner decoder is connected to 2D encoder, decodes the encoded input image, and generates a 2D corner layout image.

title: Recognizing typewritten and handwritten characters using end-to-end deep learning
description: Disclosed herein are system, method, and computer program product embodiments for optical character recognition using end-to-end deep learning. In an embodiment, an optical character recognition system may train a neural network to identify characters of pixel images, assign index values to the characters, and recognize different formatting of the characters, such as distinguishing between handwritten and typewritten characters. The neural network may also be trained to identify, groups of characters and to generate bounding boxes to group these characters. The optical character recognition system may then analyze documents to identify character information based on the pixel data and produce segmentation masks, such as a type grid segmentation mask, and one or more bounding box masks. The optical character recognition system may supply these masks as an output or may combine the masks to generate a version of the received document having optically recognized characters.

title: Predicting box office performance of future film releases based upon determination of likely patterns of competitive dynamics on a particular future film release date
