description: Systems and methods for dual-domain self-supervised learning for accelerated non-Cartesian magnetic resonance imaging reconstruction are provided. The present techniques provide a method for training a machine-learning model that receives magnetic resonance (MR) data and generates a reconstruction of the MR data. The machine-learning model can be trained based on a set of losses comprising a first loss value corresponding to a frequency-domain and a second loss value corresponding to an image-based domain. The training process can be a self-supervised training process that can utilize under-sampled and non-Cartesian MR data. The machine-learning model is trained by optimizing both data consistency in the frequency domain and appearance consistency in the image-based domain.

title: Picture classification and object detection synchronous processing method and system, storage medium, and terminal
description: The present invention provides a picture classification and object detection synchronous processing method and system, a storage medium, and a terminal. The method comprises the following steps: inputting a picture into a neural network for convolution operation to obtain a first feature map; performing convolution operation, pooling operation, and non-linear function activation operation on the first feature map in sequence to obtain a second feature map, and obtaining an object detection result of the picture on the basis of the second feature map; and performing global average pooling operation and a fully connected operation in sequence on the first feature map to obtain a classification result of the picture. The picture classification and object detection synchronous processing method and system, the storage medium, and the terminal of the present invention simultaneously perform picture classification and object detection by means of the same neural network, such that the system load is effectively reduced.

title: Cloud forecasting for electrochromic devices
description: A method includes identifying a plurality of images corresponding to sky conditions and isolating cloud pixels from sky pixels in each of the plurality of images. Responsive to determining percentage of cloud pixels in one or more of the plurality of images meets a threshold value, the method further includes determining predicted cloud movement relative to sun position. The method further includes causing a tint level of an electrochromic device to be controlled based on the predicted cloud movement relative to the sun position.

title: Systems and methods for pet-based networking
description: A pet-related system with a first dog collar operably configured to determine if the first dog collar is at or outside of a first user-selected geofence boundary; and a mobile electronic device communicatively coupled to the first dog collar. The mobile electronic device is operably configured to display a user interface of a first instance of a pet-related social network application associated with a first social network identity; receive a user input selecting the first user-selected geofence boundary of the first dog collar; communicate the first user-selected geofence boundary to the first dog collar; and receive a proximity notification of the mobile electronic device's proximity to a second mobile electronic device communicatively coupled to a second dog collar and operably configured to execute instructions of a second instance of the pet-related social network application associated with a second social network identity.

title: Real-time surgical tool presence/absence detection in surgical videos
description: Embodiments described herein provide various techniques and systems for building machine-learning surgical tool presence/absence detection models for processing surgical videos and predicting whether a surgical tool is present or absent in each video frame of a surgical video. In one aspect, a process for ensuring patient safety during a laparoscopic or robotic surgery involving an energy tool is disclosed. The process can begin receiving a real-time control signal indicating an operating state of an energy tool during the surgery. Next, the process receives real-time endoscope video images of the surgery. The process simultaneously applies a machine-learning surgical tool presence/absence detection model to the real-time endoscope video images to generate real-time decisions on a location of the energy tool in the real-time endoscope video images. The process then checks the real-time control signal against the real-time decisions to identify an unsafe event and takes a proper action when an unsafe event is identified.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, information processing program, and information processing system
description: An information processing device according to the present disclosure comprises a control unit for selecting, from among a plurality of networks, one or more first networks to be executed on a one-to-one basis by each of one or more mutually different first processors, and selecting, from the plurality of networks, a second network to be executed by a second processor, and a transmitting unit for transmitting each of the one or more first networks on a one-to-one basis to each of the one or more first processors, and transmitting the second network to the second processor, wherein: the second processor executes the second network using, as an input, output data output as a result of the execution of the network selected from among the one or more first networks for at least one processor from among the one or more first processors; and the control unit selects the second network corresponding to the output data from among the plurality of networks.

title: Systems and methods for simulating brain-computer interfaces
description: Systems and methods for simulating brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are described. In many embodiments, BCI decoders can be evaluated entirely in silico. Neural encoders are used to generate synthetic neural signals that mimic real neural signals for a given activity. Artificial intelligence agents emulate user control policies which can be used to guide the generation of the synthetic neural signals. Closed-loop testing can be achieved by providing a simulated testing environment.

title: Ground penetrating radar tunnel lining quality inspection method based on self-supervised learning
description: The present application is applicable to the technical field of tunnel lining quality inspection, and provides a ground penetrating radar tunnel lining quality inspection method based on self-supervised learning. A grayscale image of a tunnel to be inspected is obtained, the grayscale image is input into a trained feature recognition model to obtain a feature image corresponding to the grayscale image, and a quality recognition result of the tunnel to be inspected is determined according to the feature image. According to the present application, self-supervised learning is performed according to an unlabeled image set and a labeled image set to obtain the feature recognition model, and the unlabeled image set is directly used to train the recognition model, so that the efficiency of training the tunnel recognition model is improved, and the accuracy of a tunnel quality inspection result is also improved.

title: Method and system for beautifying image
description: The present application relates to the field of computer vision and the technical field of machine learning, and discloses a method and system for beautifying an image, so that the aesthetic degree and typicality of any image can be automatically improved without any additional artificial aesthetic information labelling. The method comprises: providing an image to be beautified; inputting the image to be beautified into a neural network, the neural network being a pre-trained deep neural network oriented to visual applications; on the basis of an intermediate layer output of the neural network, calculating a marginal utility generated by each pixel or superpixel in the image to a network output, and determining a significant signal and a noise signal in the image on the basis of the marginal utility; and suppressing the noise signal and/or enhancing the significant signal to obtain a beautified image.

title: Neural network training device and neural network training method
description: This neural network training device trains a neural network that implements an inference computation in a neural network circuit, the neural network training device comprising a training unit that generates a trained parameter including a threshold value used in quantization computation by using a function model of the neural network, the function model executing the quantization computation and convolution computation using a floating point format, and the training unit generating the threshold value on the basis of the difference between the computation environment of the neural network circuit and the computation environment of the function model.

title: Deep learning-based health condition prediction system using plurality of electrocardiograms
description: Disclosed is a deep learning-based health condition prediction system using a plurality of electrocardiograms, the system comprising: an electrocardiogram measurement unit (110) which obtains N electrocardiogram data by measuring each of electrocardiograms of the same examinee at different time points with a time difference; a prediction unit (120) which integrates semantic feature values or output values from the N electrocardiogram data provided from the electrocardiogram measurement unit (110) so as to generate disease information predicting the presence and trend of a disease and the degree of the disease, through a pre-built diagnosis algorithm by training N electrocardiogram data at different time points and a dataset of diseases corresponding to the electrocardiogram data; and an input unit (130) which converts and inputs the N electrocardiogram data from the electrocardiogram measurement unit (110) into the prediction unit (120), wherein it is possible to more accurately measure, diagnose, examine, and predict a health condition from a plurality of electrocardiogram data of the same examinee with a time difference.

title: Learning device, feature amount extraction device, learning method, and learning program
description: Provided is technology for improving the accuracy of understanding of an object included as a subject in a two-dimensional image. This learning device (1) comprises a first feature amount extraction unit (11), a first loss calculation unit (12), a first feature amount calculation unit (13), a second feature amount extraction unit (21), a second loss calculation unit (31), and an updating unit (41).

title: Image translation model training method, image translation method, device, and storage medium
description: The present application provides an image translation model training method, an image translation method, a device, and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of image processing. The training method comprises: using an initial image translation model, inputting a source image in a sample image pair to obtain a training image (S101); the sample image pair comprising a source image and a target image, the target image being a reference standard for source image translation; using an initial image judgment model, inputting the sample image pair and a training image pair, obtaining an image pair judgment result (S102); wherein the training image pair comprises: the source image and the training image; and according to the image pair judgment result, adjusting the parameters of the initial image translation model and initial image judgment model to obtain a target image translation model (S103).

title: T e text as een esa s e y s u or y o rea as o ows: systems and methods for providing health system scale language models which include clinical prediction engines
description: Exemplary systems, methods, and computer-accessible medium are provided that that can implement and/or utilize clinical predictive models, which can assist physicians and administrators make decisions by forecasting clinical and operational events. Thus, the exemplary systems, methods, and computer-accessible medium are provided that convert clinical notes to training data using at least one natural language processing procedure, train a machine learning model using the training data finetune the trained machine learning model based on selected parameters, receive patient data, and generate at least one medical prediction on the received patient data with the trained finetuned machine learning model. Additional exemplary systems, methods, and computer-accessible medium are provided that can generate a table language by implementing an artificial intelligence model configured to generate code to create a structured database procedure. Further exemplary systems, methods, and computer-accessible medium are provided that can train an electronic health records (EHR) artificial intelligence model on a training data set that comprises a plurality' of EHR records utilizing an under-sampling technique.

title: Electronic device and method for wireless communication, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The present application relates to an electronic device and a method for wireless communication, and a computer-readable storage medium. The electronic device for wireless communication comprises a processing circuit, wherein the processing circuit is configured to determine, according to state information reported by a user equipment within a service range of the electronic device, whether the user equipment is to cooperate with other user equipments to train a segmented model obtained by segmenting a model to be trained, so as to participate in federated learning in a non-independent way, or to independently train the model to be trained, so as to independently participate in federated learning. (FIG. 1)

title: Method for anomaly signal processing and machine learning prediction based on anomaly cumulative threshold
description: The present invention relates to a method for processing anomalies that occur in power plant equipment and, particularly, to a method for anomaly signal processing and machine learning prediction based on an anomaly cumulative threshold and a method for machine learning prediction according thereto, the methods managing a cumulative history of anomalies in order to apply a signal processing and data based machine learning technique for discovering, in advance, failure anomalies, so as to establish basic learning reference data, and performing machine learning prediction therethrough in order to increase prediction performance of machine learning through a scheme of processing a signal of excellent quality when operation data of the power plant equipment is input.

title: Synthesis device, synthesis method, and synthesis program
description: In a synthesis device (10), a training unit (15b) uses first training data to train a first model on the basis of the flatness of the slope of the loss function for the weights of the first model with respect to input data, and uses second training data to train a second model on the basis of the flatness of the slope of the loss function for the weights of the second model. An identification unit (15c) uses the weights of the first model and the weights of the second model to identify the weights of a composite model obtained by combining the first model and the second model.

title: Coupling arrangement for quantum computing
description: According to an embodiment, an arrangement for quantum computing comprises a ground plane (110), a qubit (120), and a flux coupler (130). The ground plane divides space into a first half-space and a second half-space. A first opening (101) and a second opening (102) are formed in the ground plane (110). A slit (103) formed in the ground plane (110) extends from the first opening (101) to the second opening (102). The qubit (120) is disposed in the first half-space. A projection of the qubit (120) on the ground plane (110) at least partly overlaps with the first opening (101). The flux coupler (130) is disposed in the second half-space. A projection of the flux coupler (130) on the ground plane at least partly overlaps with the second opening (102).

title: Unsupervised learning-based power battery anomaly detection system
description: An unsupervised learning-based power battery anomaly detection system, comprising: a battery parameter association reasoning module, configured to design a dynamic learnable graph neural network algorithm, and explore a potential association of battery parameters; a time sequence feature dependency analysis module, configured to model long-term and short-term time sequence dependency relationships on the basis of a temporal learning network; a coupling temporal-spatial neural architecture module, configured to perform coupling representation on the temporal learning network and a spatial learning network to integrate spatial-temporal association features; and a battery anomaly inference and evaluation module, configured to realize battery state prediction and evaluation by designing an adaptive threshold selection strategy and an experimental stage evaluation mechanism. The present application determines whether a power battery is in a normal operating state by analyzing a change mode of the key parameters of the power battery in a production process, and promptly stops the production process of a battery in an abnormal state, thereby preventing occurrence of accidents, and reducing resource loss in the production process.

title: Monitoring a target system
description: A computer implemented method for analyzing a target system for the purpose of controlling the target system. The method includes receiving (310) a matrix of observations, wherein rows of the matrix represent observations related to the target system and columns of the matrix represent values of different variables for each observation, or vice versa; performing (311) anomaly detection on the matrix of observations to obtain a matrix of anomaly coefficients; clustering (312) the matrix of anomaly coefficients to obtain clustered anomaly coefficients; determining (313) observations that substantially deviate from the core of any cluster in the clustered anomaly coefficients to be anomalous observations; and providing (314) results of the anomaly detection for detecting problems and taking corrective actions.

title: Method for solving optimization problems on a quantum computer by utilizing local energy detunings
description: This invention is based on the concept of solving an NP-complete optimization problem using a quantum computer by modelling the function to be optimized using the Hamilton function of a quantum system and then driving said quantum system into the basic state. Use of the basic state then solves the optimization problem. The problem on which the invention is based is solved by proposing a method for solving an optimization problem on a graph using Rydberg states, the method comprising the steps of: modelling the optimization problem by way of a graph having N nodes and K edges, encoding the N nodes of the graph by providing a system comprising N atoms consecutively numbered i ∈{1, …, N}, encoding the K edges of the graph, wherein an edge Ki,j between atoms (i,j) is encoded by way of interactions with interaction energy Vi,j between the atoms (i,j), adjusting energy detunings Δi0 of the individual atoms i so that the basic state of the system of N atoms solves the optimization problem on the graph, driving the system of N atoms into the basic state and reading said basic state, there being provision for the energy detunings Δi0 of the respective atoms to be adjusted individually.

title: Image generation with encoding semi-structured multimodal entity signature
description: This application discloses technology generally relating to a method for generating production-ready images using entity-specific signature information. The methods may include receiving signature inputs relating to signature elements such as logos, attributes, and target audiences. Further, the signature elements may be stored and incorporated into the image generation model to create images relevant to the specific entity. To generate the images using the entity-specific signature, the image generation model determines which signature elements to incorporate into the image based on what is most related to a generative request.

title: A method of assessing vulnerability of an ai model and a framework thereof
description: This invention discloses a framework (100) for assessing vulnerability of an AI model (M) and method (200) thereof. The framework (100) comprises a surrogate AI model (S), an XAI module (30) and at least a processor (20). The processor (20) generates a feature ranking list based on application of the XAI module (30) on an output generated by the surrogate AI model (S). The processor (20) then determines an optimal noise ("e") using method step (300) needed to generate a manipulated input based on the feature ranking list. Finally, the optimal noise ("e") is analyzed to assess the vulnerability of the AI model (M).

title: Controlling method and apparatuses
description: Provided are a controlling method and related apparatuses. The method includes: generating, by using a language model (LM), a controlling message in natural language; obtaining, according to the controlling message, semantic information of the controlling message; forming an information payload when the semantic information of the controlling message is relevant to one or more pieces of multiple pieces of semantic information, where the multiple pieces of semantic information correspond to multiple function modalities that have been registered to the LM, and a part or all of the multiple pieces of semantic information is obtained from at least one user device, and where the information payload includes the semantic information of the controlling message; sending the information payload. In this way, an open vocabulary can be supported in controlling, more effective and flexible communication can be achieved, backward and forward compatibility can be supported, and cross-modality functionality can be accommodated. The central device don' t need to know the description (s) of corresponding function modalities of the user device which does not send description (s) of corresponding function modalities, and therefore, which can protect customer's privacy and commercial intellectual property.

title: Deep learning-based photovoltaic panel defect detection device, and method therefor
description: The present invention relates to a method and a device for detecting defects in a photovoltaic panel by using an image of the photovoltaic panel. The photovoltaic panel defect detection method and device according to the present invention detect defects that cannot be detected in an EL image of the photovoltaic panel by using an artificial intelligence unit pre-trained with an optical image rather than the EL image, thereby classifying defects by type, and measure the size of defects so as to determine whether the panel is ultimately defective, and thus defect determination in a photovoltaic panel production process can be faster and more accurate such that process time is reduced and defect detection rate is increased, thereby enabling cost losses to be reduced.

title: Neural interface technology for communicating with clinically unresponsive patients
description: A method and system for temporarily restoring communication ability in clinically unresponsive patients with cognitive motor dissociation. The system can include decoding recorded brain signals in response to commands to determine a communication state of the patient.

title: Training device, training method, and program
description: Provided is a training device comprising a control unit which trains a model to be trained that is a mathematical model including: a differential encoder that encodes, through quantization, an image of an encoding target on the basis of a parameterized quantization table and an input compression rate, and obtains a differentiable image that can be differentiated as an encoding result for the encoding target; and a differential decoder that decodes the differentiable image. In the training, the quantization table is updated so as to reduce the difference between the encoding target and the result of the decoding, and the size of image data of the differentiable image.

title: Intelligent carbonate petrophysical techniques for energy development operations
description: Disclosed are methods, systems, and computer programs for generating petrophysical analysis data. The methods include: accessing first porosity data and first well log data associated with an NMR well; randomly selecting data elements comprised in the first porosity data and the first well log data; developing, based on the randomly selected first porosity data and first well log data, a learning data structure; generating, based on the learning data structure, a machine learning model; receiving second well log data using sensor(s) deployed about a non-NMR well; adapting, based on the second well log data, variable input parameters of the machine learning model to generate second porosity data; and formatting the second porosity data to generate petrophysical analysis data. The petrophysical analysis data indicates one or more of: a petrophysical characterization of a rock type; flow dynamic data of a carbonate reservoir; well test or perforation zone data; and pore data.

title: File content review method, system, computing device, and storage medium
description: Provided in the present application are a file content review method, a system, a computing device, and a storage medium. The method comprises: a file content review system first acquiring a first file, the first file being a file that requires content review; then extracting a first statement from the first file on the basis of a first keyword; and, then determining a second statement on the basis of the first statement, the similarity between the second statement and the first statement satisfying a similarity threshold, such that risk information of the second statement can be used as risk information of the first statement, the risk information being used for indicating whether a corresponding statement contains risky content. By means of measuring the similarity between a statement extracted from a file requiring content review and a statement marked with risk information, the method can accurately evaluate whether the file content contains risky content.

title: Query- and model- aware few-shot prompting
description: A method for forming a prompt for use with a large language model includes receiving an input query, generating query augmentation data relevant to the query, wherein the query augmentation data includes one or more examples of queries and respective responses, wherein the query augmentation data is selected based on the input query, wherein the selecting of the query augmentation data is further based on characteristics of the large language model, and forming the prompt by combining the input query with the query augmentation data.

title: Electronic apparatus and method for processing video
description: Disclosed are an electronic apparatus and method for processing a video. An operation method of the electronic apparatus according to an embodiment may comprise an operation of acquiring a visual object included in one frame from among a plurality of frames of an original video. The operation method may comprise an operation of generating sound content corresponding to the visual object, on the basis of at least one characteristic of the visual object. The operation method may comprise an operation of outputting the sound content by including the sound content in frames including the visual object from among the plurality of frames. Various other embodiments may be possible.

title: Question-answer processing methods and apparatus, device, storage medium and program product
description: Question-answer processing methods and apparatus, a device, a storage medium and a program product. A method comprises: at a client, in response to receiving a question speech from a user, sending to a server the question speech (410); determining a dialog scenario corresponding to the question speech (420); sending to the server an indication of the dialog scenario or a response strategy of the dialog scenario (430); and receiving from the server a question text and/or a response to the question speech (440), the response strategy comprising at least one of the following: a speech processing strategy for the question speech and a response processing strategy for the question speech, the question text being determined on the basis of the speech processing strategy and the question speech, and/or the response being determined on the basis of the question text and the response processing strategy.

title: Large language model-based method and system for orderly load regulation of electric vehicle charging station
description: The present invention relates to a large language model-based method for orderly load regulation of an electric vehicle charging station, specifically comprising: first, collecting historical charging load time series data of an electric vehicle charging station; normalizing the historical charging load time series data; second, for each charging load time series segment, collecting corresponding environmental data such as weekday/holiday, weather, temperature, and traffic conditions to generate environmental data input quantities; then, by using the charging load time series segment and the environmental data as inputs, constructing a charging load time series prediction model; constructing a dual optimization objective, and training the charging load time series prediction model to predict a future charging load; and finally, performing demand response on the basis of the charging load prediction result, and regulating charging facilities in the charging station to realize optimized management of corresponding orderly charging on the basis of the load prediction result. The solution improves the accuracy of charging load prediction.

title: Method and system for seizure detection
description: There is provided a method for seizure detection. The method includes: obtaining brain signal data of brain electrical activity of a subject; processing the brain signal data using a deep neural network to obtain a first processed output data of the brain signal data, the first processed output data indicating one or more seizure events in the brain signal data; processing the first processed output data using a statistical model to obtain a second processed output data of the brain signal data, wherein the statistical model is configured to model transitions between the one or more seizure events and one or more non-seizure events in the first processed output data of the brain signal data; and determining the one or more seizure events based on the second processed output data of the brain signal data.

title: Quantum computing-based fluid control and heat transfer structure design device
description: The present invention relates to a quantum computing-based fluid control and heat transfer structure design device. The quantum computing-based fluid control and heat transfer structure design device according to one embodiment of the present invention includes a classical computing device which receives design parameters for at least one of a fluid control and a heat transfer structure, converts the received parameters into quantum notation, and performs optimization modeling, and a quantum computing device which performs design parameter combination optimization based on a request of the classical computing device and performs a simulation for at least one of a fluid and a heat flow using a quantum simulator.

title: Wind power generator operation management method and system
description: A method and system for managing operation of a wind turbine are provided. The method for managing a wind turbine according to an embodiment of the present invention predicts the fire risk of a wind turbine by using a neural network learned to predict a fire risk by analyzing a plurality of input variables for the state of a wind turbine, predicts the fire risk of the wind turbine through fuzzy inference from a plurality of input variables for the state of the wind turbine, and calculates the fire risk of the wind turbine based on the predicted risks. Accordingly, it is possible to safely operate wind power generation facilities by predicting the fire risk of the wind turbine through artificial intelligence and fuzzy inference.

title: Vision-assisted speech processing
description: A speech processing system and method are disclosed. In certain examples, image data is used to generate a visual feature tensor, and audio data is used to generate an audio feature tensor. The visual feature tensor and the audio feature tensor are used by a linguistic model to determine linguistic features that can be used to analyze the user's utterance. The generation of the feature tensor can be configured jointly with the linguistic model. The system can be provided in a client-server architecture.

title: Method and device for continuous operation of a cryogenic-atom device using separate storage arrays
description: A system and method for performing sequential non-classical computations may include: loading a plurality of atoms into a storage array; transferring a first subset of the plurality of atoms from the storage array into a science array; performing a first non-classical computation using at least a portion of the first subset; determining an atom loss number representing a difference between (i) a number of atoms in the first subset and (ii) a number of atoms in a residual subset of the first subset that remain in the science array after performing the first non-classical computation; transferring a second subset of the plurality of atoms from the storage array into the science array; reloading the storage array with the additional atoms; and performing a second non-classical computation using at least a portion of one or both of the residual subset and the second subset.

title: System and method for predicting mobile traffic based on extracting and clustering mobile traffic patterns
description: The present invention is a technology for collecting the hourly traffic volume of a base station, converting it into an image, and identifying a pattern of mobile network traffic generation volume. According to one embodiment, a mobile traffic volume prediction system may include a data collection unit that collects time series data as the hourly traffic volume of base stations in a mobile network, an image conversion unit that converts the collected time series data into an image including a generation pattern according to the hourly traffic volume, a clustering processing unit that clusters the converted image based on the generation pattern to form at least one group of base stations, and a traffic prediction unit that predicts the traffic volume for each formed group through an artificial intelligence model.

title: Computer programs, information processing methods, and information processing devices
description: A computer program, an information processing method, and an information processing device for evaluating the accuracy of prediction using a learned model are provided. A simulation model that simulates substrate processing using a plurality of parameters related to substrate processing conditions, or a learned model that outputs a predicted shape of a substrate after processing according to input of a plurality of parameters and an initial shape of the substrate, is used, the plurality of parameters are adjusted so that the predicted shape becomes a specific shape, the substrate processing is simulated using the simulation model using the plurality of adjusted parameters and the specific initial shape of the substrate, and the predicted shape is acquired, and the learned model is used to acquire the predicted shape according to the plurality of adjusted parameters and the specific initial shape, and an error between the predicted shape acquired using the simulation model and the predicted shape acquired using the learned model is calculated, and the accuracy of the prediction using the learned model is determined based on the error.

title: Positioning utilizing artificial intelligence (ai)/machine learning (ml) model
description: A method for position determination is disclosed. The method includes the steps of receiving, by a UE, a threshold configured by a location server, determining, by the UE, a criterion associated with the threshold, activating, by the UE, a position determination model for position determination based on the criterion, monitoring, by the UE, the performance of the position determination model, and reporting, by the UE, the performance of the position determination model to the location server. The method is further implemented in a network node (e.g., a base station) or a location server, thereby improving the efficiency of position determination.

title: DEVICE AND METHOD FOR GENERATING Multi-Purpose Pareto Policy Set
description: A multi-objective Pareto policy set generation device and generation method are provided. According to one embodiment, the Pareto policy set generation method may include the steps of receiving a sample data set, generating a mimic policy and a reward function of the mimic policy from the sample data set, setting a target policy at a predetermined location near the mimic policy, fine-tuning the target policy based on a distance between the reward function of the mimic policy and the reward function of the target policy, and generating a Pareto policy set including the mimic policy and the fine-tuned target policy.

title: Automatic creation solution for memorial video for the deceased
description: Videos commemorating the deceased can be a profound comfort to their bereaved families. However, conventional methods of producing memorial videos have the disadvantage of requiring significant expertise, time, and money. Furthermore, videos focused on simple editing often fail to fully capture the life of the deceased.    The present invention aims to utilize artificial intelligence technology to analyze the deceased's life data and, based on this, automatically generate a memorial video that meaningfully captures the deceased's life and provide it to the bereaved family.    The present invention provides an artificial intelligence-based memorial video automatic generation system and method comprising the following steps.    Data collection and preprocessing: Collect photos, videos, and audio data of the deceased and process them into a format suitable for artificial intelligence model training.  AI model training: Based on the collected data, an AI model is trained to learn the characteristics of the deceased and extract the information necessary to create a memorial video.  Automatic memorial video generation: Automatically generate memorial videos that meaningfully capture the life of the deceased using trained artificial intelligence models.  Video Editing and Customization: Allows users to edit the generated videos to their liking and customize them by adding background music, subtitles, and more.    The artificial intelligence-based automatic video generation system and method according to the present invention provide the following effects.  Reduce memorial video production time and costs: By leveraging AI technology to automate the memorial video production process, production time and costs can be drastically reduced.  Create a customized memorial video that meaningfully captures the deceased's life: By analyzing the deceased's pre-life data, you can create a customized memorial video that effectively portrays their life.  Improving emotional satisfaction of bereaved families: Providing videos that allow them to meaningfully remember and commemorate the life of the deceased can increase the emotional satisfaction of bereaved families.

title: Adaptation framework apparatus, system and method for developing of adaptive context-aware learning environments
description: The present invention relates to an adaptive framework device, system and method for constructing an adaptive context-aware learning environment, which enables development of an adaptive context-aware learning system more easily by defining a reference model and an adaptive engine for constructing an adaptive context-aware learning environment.

title: Autonomous biologically based learning tool
description: An autonomous biologically based learning tool system and a method that the tool system employs for learning and analysis are provided. The autonomous biologically based learning tool system includes (a) one or more tool systems that perform a set of specific tasks or processes and generate assets and data related to the assets that characterize the various processes and associated tool performance; (b) an interaction manager that receives and formats the data, and (c) an autonomous learning system based on biological principles of learning. The autonomous learning system comprises a memory platform and a processing platform that communicate through a network. The network receives data from the tool system and from an external actor through the interaction manager. Both the memory platform and the processing platform include functional components and memories that can be defined recursively. Similarly, the one or more tools can be deployed recursively, in a bottom-up manner in which an individual autonomous tools is assembled in conjunction with other (disparate or alike) autonomous tools to form an autonomous group tool, which in turn can be assembled with other group tools to form a conglomerated autonomous tool system. Knowledge generated and accumulated in the autonomous learning system(s) associated with individual, group and conglomerated tools can be cast into semantic networks that can be employed for learning and driving tool goals based on context.

title: Computer-readable recording medium recording inspiration model device, spontaneous emotion model device, method and program thereof
description: The idea model apparatus of the present invention includes a spontaneous emotion unit, a knowledge database, and a conception unit. The spontaneous emotion unit prepares in advance the emotional state modeling the human emotion as data, and repeats the state transition among these emotional states in accordance with the probability model of the Schrodinger equation. In the knowledge database, knowledge data collected from the outside are classified and accumulated in relation to the intensity of correlation with the emotional state, thereby simulating the origin of human beings affected by emotion. When an external input is given, the conception unit simulates the human conception behavior by combining the external input with the emotional state of the spontaneous emotion unit and searching the knowledge data from the knowledge database using the combination or the like as a search key.

title: Apparatus and method of signature authentication
description: The present invention relates to a signature authentication apparatus and method, and more particularly, to an apparatus and method for signature authentication, which includes an input unit for inputting a signature, an acceleration sensor for measuring the acceleration of the signature authentication apparatus and data input through the input unit, acceleration data measured through the acceleration sensor, And a control unit for performing signature authentication on the basis of the authentication information.

title: Apparatus and method for learning software vulnerability prediction model, apparatus and method for analyzing software vulnerability
description: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a software vulnerability prediction model learning device which comprises: a feature extracting unit extracting feature information of each of a plurality of software binary files which are collected in advance; and a learning unit learning a vulnerability prediction model based on an artificial neural network by using the feature information and vulnerability of each of the plurality of software binary files as learning data.

title: Rule-based computer system
description: (57) [Summary] (Modified) [Purpose] To provide a series of provisional results to the user through dialogue. [Configuration] When a rule included in one rule set is applied to an operation set, a provided operation set that is a subset of the operation set is created, and a rule included in one rule set is applied to a selection item set. When done,   A provided selection item set that is a subset of the selection item set is created. When the user selects an operation or operation selection item from the provided operation set or provided selection item set,   Information is fed back to the rule and used to constrain the next offer operation and operation choice. In this way, by interacting with the system,   Knowledge and judgment are incorporated into each of the set of interim results and used in further iterations to further develop the next interim result.

title: Systems and methods for data management
description: There is provided a method for data management, the method comprising: storing a plurality of data items in a contiguous space within a memory; executing instructions comprising an address and a size that collectively identify the contiguous space to transfer the plurality of data items from main memory to Random Access Memory (RAM) on a chip, and the chip containing a computing unit comprising a plurality of multipliers; and instruct the computing unit on the chip to perform the following: extracting a plurality of data items from the RAM; and performing a plurality of parallel operations on the plurality of data items using the plurality of multipliers to produce output data.

title: A fast recognition method of EEG signals based on dense deep convolutional neural network
description: The invention provides a method for quickly identifying electroencephalogram (EEG) signals by an intensive deep convolutional neural network, which is designed by combining the characteristics of time and space characteristics of motor imagery electroencephalogram signals and using a characteristic connection method in the convolutional neural network. The convolutional neural network designed by the invention can simultaneously extract time and space characteristics, and also can interconnect the outputs of different convolutional layers, thereby reducing the number of weights and achieving the purposes of overfitting resistance and characteristic reuse. Firstly, inputting filtered and resampled original data into a dense deep convolution neural network, then updating parameters of each layer of the network through a back propagation and random gradient descent algorithm, finally testing the network, inputting test data into a trained network, and analyzing an output result. Compared with the Shallow ConvNet method proposed in 2017, the signal identification accuracy and kappa value of the method are improved by 5% and 0.066.

title: Method for extracting complex dielectric constant of building material based on quantum particle swarm optimization
description: The present invention relates to the field of microwaves, in particular to a method for extracting the complex permittivity of building materials based on quantum particle swarm optimization, including: acquiring the actually measured reflection coefficient, transmission coefficient and theoretically calculated reflection coefficient and transmission coefficient; initializing the complex permittivity Constant, and calculate the fitness function; update the global optimal value and individual optimal value, and calculate the average particle optimal position; based on the particle swarm algorithm, calculate the attraction point and establish the attraction point on the δ potential well to construct a quantum particle swarm Optimize the model; perform curve fitting on the measured data and theoretical data, and calculate the characteristic length of the delta potential well through the individual average optimal value and the current position of the particle; update the particle position according to the characteristic length of the delta potential well and the attraction point, and update The global optimal value and the individual optimal value output the complex dielectric constant matched when the fitness function is minimum; the method of the invention is simple, efficient, and high in precision, and can greatly improve the efficiency of extracting the complex dielectric constant of building materials.

title: A stratigraphic sequence simulation method based on drilling data for machine learning
description: The invention discloses a kind of bed succession analogy methods that machine learning is carried out based on borehole data, this method comprises: the filling of data normalization, bed succession, stratum encode, establish stratigraphic type series model, establish layer thickness series model, bed succession model；This method utilizes python language, carries out under Pytorch deep learning frame, in particular to the foundation of stratigraphic sequence during three-dimensional geological modeling, suitable for carrying out the exploitation and verifying of bed succession model during the three-dimensional modeling of stratum.It can relatively accurately judge the formation information of corresponding position, this method is assumed and the subjective factors such as expertise independent of data simultaneously, by showing with the comparison of actual borehole data result, above-mentioned model has preferable feasibility, can be applied to the planning of geological information Research And Engineering, design-build etc..

title: Soft instrument training and sample compensation process
description: Soft instrument training and sample compensation process, comprising the following steps: firstly, as the training sample of VAE, obtaining the hidden layer variable z of VAE using the data of acquired original；Secondly, sampling from hidden variable z using the decoded portion of VAE as the generator G of WGAN, as the input of G, new sample is generated；Finally, by authentic specimen and generating sample input arbiter D, the otherness of the two is judged, by optimization object function training WGAN, to obtain the sample closest to truthful data；It is that soft instrument generates new training sample using this model, supplementary data set solves the problems, such as original training data deficiency, improve the training precision of soft instrument, the data sample that the present invention generates has highest similarity with authentic specimen, and model has most fast convergence rate.

title: A facial local feature analysis system
description: The present invention relates to Internet technical fields, in particular a kind of facial Local Features Analysis system, including individual human face face Local Features Analysis and multiple face Local Features Analysis, individual human face face Local Features Analysis includes that camera collection image or picture library obtain image, image preprocessing, obtain face area, human face region segmentation, it extracts face single area feature and face information is analyzed, multiple face Local Features Analysis include input facial image, human face region segmentation, CNN parallelism recognition, extract linear relationship feature, judge whether it is same people.The present invention takes image segmentation to pre-process, area image result is substituted into parallel neural network model extraction local feature information, do so the datail description of available face, increase recognition of face and judges information, improve recognition accuracy, analysis identification may be implemented for situations such as facial angle changes, uneven illumination is even tool, improve recognition accuracy.

title: A kind of image partition method and device practised based on metric relation graphics
description: The present invention discloses a kind of image partition method practised based on metric relation graphics, is related to technical field of image processing, and method includes training part and partitioning portion；In training part, segmentation result is obtained after constructing metric relation figure by acquisition image, smooth correction image, the maximum section neighbour's metric learning method of introducing, handle metric relation figure input figure convolutional neural networks, eventually by study metric relation figure and segmentation result structure figures convolutional neural networks model；In partitioning portion, then metric relation figure is constructed, handle metric relation figure using picture scroll product neural network model and obtains segmentation result by acquisition image, smooth correction image, the maximum section neighbour's metric learning method of introducing, it is thus achieved that the high-precision of image is divided.Invention additionally discloses a kind of image segmentation devices practised based on metric relation graphics, and the high-precision segmentation of image equally may be implemented.

title: Image recognition method and related device
description: The application relates to deep learning, and discloses an image recognition method and a related device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first image to be identified; quantizing the first image to be identified to obtain first quantized data of the first image to be identified; inputting the first quantized data into a convolutional neural network model to obtain an image recognition result corresponding to the first quantized data; the p-layer convolution layers contained in the convolution neural network model are obtained by a server according to a preset convolution layer setting strategy, p convolution kernels contained in the p-layer convolution layers are determined by the server after comparing p feature map mean square errors with preset p feature map mean square errors, p is a positive integer, q=p and q is a positive integer. The embodiment of the invention is beneficial to improving the image recognition precision.

title: A kind of cloud computing resources distribution method based on improved adaptive GA-IAGA
description: The invention belongs to cloud computing resources to distribute field, be related to a kind of cloud computing resources distribution method based on improved adaptive GA-IAGA.The method constructs the mathematical model of cloud resource distribution first, then devises Revised genetic algorithum and solves to it.It is the improvement of generation to its initial population, cross and variation method to the improvement of genetic algorithm in the present invention.Virtual machine is divided into H group in initialization population, using secondary adaptive algorithm by this method, and one physical machine of every group of correspondence ensure that the validity of initial population.Gene evaluation function is introduced, the loading condition of each physical machine is evaluated, and intersected on this basis and made a variation, ensure that the high efficiency of algorithm.Minimum physical machine activation number and maximum resource utilization rate virtual machine allocation plan are obtained eventually by iteration.The present invention guarantees each physical machine resource utilization height and load balancing, to improve the utilization rate of cloud resource and reduce the energy consumption of cloud data center.

title: Image processing method, image processing device, terminal equipment and readable storage medium
description: The present application provides an image processing method, an image processing device, a terminal device, and a readable storage medium. The method includes: acquiring an image to be processed to be super-resolution reconstructed; performing image segmentation on the image to be processed to obtain an image containing a target object The first image, and the second image including other image regions, except for the target object in the first image, the pixel values of the remaining pixels are zero; the first image is input to the first neural network model to obtain super-resolution The corrected first image after high-rate reconstruction is used, and the second image is super-resolution reconstructed using a preset algorithm to obtain a corrected second image. The high-frequency information energy contained in the corrected first image is greater than the first threshold, and the preset algorithm The duration of the algorithm processing the second image is less than the second threshold; the modified first image is fused with the modified second image to obtain a processed image. This application can take into account both the super-resolution reconstruction effect and the time-consuming super-resolution reconstruction.

title: Information processing apparatus and information processing method
description: The information processing apparatus (10) is characterized by having: a data acquisition unit (101) that acquires input data as time-series data; a specimen error upper limit calculation unit (102) that, when generating a specimen subsequence by integrating similar learning subsequences from the subsequences extracted from the learning data as time-series data, uses data taken from the input data to calculate the upper limit of the dissimilarity between the integrated multiple learning subsequences, i.e., the specimen error upper limit; and a specimen subsequence generation unit (103) that generates a specimen subsequence based on the learning data using the specimen error upper limit.

title: Low-altitude target identification method, device, storage medium and electronic device
description: The present invention provides a method, device, storage medium and electronic device for identifying a low-altitude target. The method includes: detecting suspicious targets in a preset area; when detecting suspicious targets, detecting and tracking the suspicious targets , to obtain the video information of the suspicious target in the process of detection and tracking, the video information includes visible light video information and infrared video information; extract the behavioral characteristics of the suspicious target according to the video information; use preset deep learning classification The model identifies and categorizes feature parameters corresponding to the behavioral features, and identifies the suspicious target according to the identification and categorization results. The invention provides an efficient and reliable low-altitude target recognition method, which can effectively ensure the recognition efficiency and accuracy of the low-altitude target.

title: Method, device and system for detecting arc fault
description: The invention discloses a method, a device and a system for detecting a fault arc. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring arc parameters of a circuit where electrical equipment is located, wherein the arc parameters are parameters of an arc generated in the circuit; analyzing the arc parameters by using a first model, and determining the probability that the arc belongs to a normal arc and a fault arc; and judging the probability of the normal arc and the fault arc by using the second model, and determining whether the arc belongs to the fault arc. The invention solves the technical problems of low accuracy and poor reliability of the detection method of the fault arc in the prior art.

title: A low-latency generation method for machine learning-as-a-service
description: The invention discloses a low-latency machine learning as a service generation method. The model abstraction layer provides a general API, which can abstract the heterogeneity of existing machine learning frameworks and models; the model parameter optimization layer is located in the model abstraction layer. It is responsible for dynamically selecting, combining and optimizing the parameters of the prediction model; the model management layer manages the model through the information of the model storage layer, so that the application side can obtain the optimal prediction service dynamically and without perception; event service Layer, this layer is responsible for interacting with the application side, storing the information requested by the user on the application side, and feeding it back to the model layer to realize dynamic automatic optimization of model parameters; the model monitoring layer is responsible for monitoring the invocation of the online model service, and discovering the invocation process in time. problems, improve the transparency of model operation and maintenance. Reduce the complexity of existing prediction service stacks and achieve the key attributes of prediction services such as low latency, high throughput, model accuracy, etc.

title: Pole number identification method based on vehicle-mounted mobile deep learning platform
description: The invention discloses a pole number identification method based on a vehicle-mounted mobile deep learning platform, which comprises the following steps of: 1. acquiring and marking images of parts of a high-speed rail contact network, and screening to obtain a data set of a contact network rod number image; 2. training the contact net pole number image data set in the step 1 by using an acceleration region convolutional neural network model, namely fast R-CNN, and positioning the pole number plate in the global contact net pole number image to obtain a pole number plate image data set; 3. training the rod number plate picture data set in the step 2 by using a rapid positioning model SSD, and positioning the numbers in the rod number plate picture to obtain a rod number plate digital picture data set; 4. deploying a deep learning model on an embedded deep learning mobile platform; 5. screening the recognition target obtained in the step 4 by using a multi-class non-maximum inhibition algorithm to obtain a rod number digital text; the method aims at the identification of the pole number of the high-speed rail contact net, and is high in positioning accuracy and short in detection time.

title: Passive target external radiation source positioning method based on parallel radial basis network
description: The invention provides a target external radiation source passive positioning method based on a parallel radial basis network. The mapping relation between the target position and the received signal is learned through training a group of radial basis networks connected in parallel and through training of sample data, and passive positioning of the target external radiation source is achieved. The method provided by the invention does not depend on radiation source information in an electromagnetic environment, can realize target positioning only by training data, and can solve the problem that the radial basis network is not suitable for the radial basis network fitting in a training set. The method has the characteristics of simple positioning process and high efficiency, has good positioning performance, and has the potential of completing target positioning by utilizing the communication base station.

title: Optical unmarked three-dimensional human body motion capture method
description: The invention provides an optical unmarked three-dimensional human body motion capture method, which solves the problem of the constraint of the traditional non-optical and optical marked human body motion capture methods on human body motion and reduces the time for capturing the single human body motion to a certain extent. The method comprises the following steps: determining the connection relation between the serial number of the human body joint points and each joint point by using the positions of different joint points and the corresponding relation between the positions of the different joint points and the real human body; extracting two-dimensional joint points of the multi-angle human body image and connecting the limb bones between the joint points by utilizing a deep convolutional neural network and combining the serial numbers and the connection relation to obtain two-dimensional coordinate information of the human body joint points; and drawing a human skeleton model in a three-dimensional space by using the conversion relation among different coordinate systems and the two-dimensional coordinate information of the human joint points, so that the skeleton model reflects the real human posture motion information in the three-dimensional space, and the motion capture method is convenient to be subsequently used in the field of human motion analysis.

title: neurobehavioral animation system
description: The present invention relates to a computer-implemented system for animating virtual objects or digital entities. The present invention particularly relates to animation using biological or behavioral models, in particular neurobehavioral modules. A number of modules with computational and graphical elements are provided. The modules are arranged in a desired configuration, have at least one variable, and are associated with at least one connector. The connectors link variables between modules in the structure that together provide a neurobehavioral model. Also provided is a method of controlling a digital entity in response to an external stimulus.

title: System and method for predicting traffic information
description: The invention relates to a method and a system for predicting traffic information, the method comprising: determining a target road section containing a road section ID and a target future moment; acquiring at least two reference information packets associated with the target road segment and corresponding to at least two reference moments, wherein each of the at least two reference information packets corresponds to one reference moment and comprises at least one static information item and at least one dynamic information item related to the reference moment; and determining target traffic information of the target road section at the target future moment by using the trained recurrent neural network model based on the at least two reference information packets. The invention can realize more comprehensive and accurate traffic prediction based on different types of traffic data and a recurrent neural network model.

title: Pedestrian attribute identification method and device
description: The present disclosure relates to a pedestrian attribute identification method and device. The method includes: extracting features from a sample image according to a convolutional neural network to obtain a plurality of initial feature layers, the sample images are images in a preset pedestrian attribute sample set, and the images included in the preset pedestrian attribute sample set have multiple pedestrian attributes; Perform top-to-bottom feature fusion on multiple initial feature layers to obtain multiple composite feature layers; according to the spatial transformation network and multiple composite feature layers, determine the location and identification of each pedestrian attribute on each composite feature layer The attribute localization and recognition module of the system can improve the accuracy and efficiency of pedestrian attribute recognition.

title: Information processing apparatus, information processing method, and program
description: To enable highly accurate user authentication to be achieved by a simpler method. [ solution ] an information processing device includes an authentication unit that authenticates a user based on information acquired from at least two devices and about a state in which the user carries the devices.

title: A joint design method and application of complex signal measurement matrix and sparse support recovery
description: The invention relates to a combined design method and application of a complex signal measurement matrix and sparse support recovery, wherein the method is used for carrying out combined design on the measurement matrix and the sparse support recovery of a sparse complex signal to obtain a sparse support recovery result, and comprises the following steps of: A. performing linear compression on the sparse complex signal by using an encoder of a depth self-encoder to obtain a measurement matrix and a real part and an imaginary part of a noisy linear complex observation signal; B. obtaining an approximation of a sparse support estimate with a decoder of a depth autoencoder based on real and imaginary parts of the noisy linear complex observation signal; C. and comparing the approximation of the sparse support estimation with a decision threshold by using hard decision to obtain a sparse support recovery result. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of effectively improving the sparse support recovery performance, shortening the sparse support recovery time and the like.

title: Code review method, device, device and storage medium based on machine learning
description: The embodiment of the application provides a code auditing method and device based on machine learning, computer equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The embodiment of the application belongs to the technical field of code development, when code auditing is realized, only a developer needs to submit a code to be audited, computer equipment obtains the code to be audited according to a preset path, carries out word segmentation processing on the code to obtain a word segmentation set comprising a plurality of words, takes the word segmentation set as an entry parameter, and inputs a preset code auditing model based on machine learning to obtain a code auditing result.

title: Dark light image denoising method based on dense connection convolution
description: The invention relates to a dark-light image denoising method based on densely connected convolution, comprising the following steps: constructing a densely connected denoising convolutional neural network model and training it; The image is preprocessed to obtain the target image to be processed; the trained dense connection denoising convolutional neural network model is used to process the target image to be processed to obtain the denoised image. The invention realizes that even when processing images in dark light or backlight scenes, a large amount of image detail information can be retained, high-quality denoising images can be obtained, and good denoising effects can be achieved.

title: Motion synthesis device and motion synthesis method
description: A motion synthesizing method, comprising: obtaining a content feature value and a type feature value by a motion synthesizing device according to content motion data and type motion data; generating a target feature value by the motion synthesizing device using the obtained content feature value and type feature value; Identifying synthetic motion data by the motion synthesizing means, and obtaining synthetic motion feature values from the identified synthetic motion data; data is updated.

title: Representation learning-based network rumor propagation control method
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of social network rumor information control, and particularly relates to a network rumor propagation control method based on representation learning, which comprises the steps of acquiring original data, preprocessing the original data, and performing time slicing on the preprocessed original data; extracting relevant attribute vectors of the three aspects of the user social structure, the user history information and the user basic attribute, and converting the relevant attribute into a low-order dense substantial vector; constructing a graph convolution neural network, and taking the feature vector as the input of the graph convolution neural network; training the graph convolution neural network by using training data; the graph convolution neural network outputs the probability that the fan of the user participates in the topic at the next moment, the probability that the fan participates in the rumor and the probability that the fan participates in the dagger topic; if the probability of the user participating in the rumor is the maximum, pushing the rumor splitting message to the user; the invention uses the method of representing learning to represent the characteristics of the users under the rumor topics in a complete picture, thereby leading the final prediction effect to be better.

title: Pollution emission reduction effect evaluation method based on period analysis and filtering technology
description: The invention provides a pollution emission reduction effect evaluation method based on period analysis and filtering technology, which comprises the following steps of 1) meteorological element selection and time series decomposition; selecting KZ filtering or wavelet transformation, and decomposing the time series of the selected meteorological factors; 2) modeling the relation between the pollutant concentration and meteorological factors; establishing a relation model between meteorological factors and pollutant concentrations by using a BP neural network and respectively regarding the short-term component scale and the baseline scale; 3) reconstructing a pollutant concentration time series based on meteorological adjustment; 4) and the influence of meteorological factors on the pollution control effectiveness is reflected by comparing the time series change of the pollutant concentration before and after reconstruction. The invention realizes the separation of the meteorological information mixed in the pollutant concentration and the pollution source information, and then respectively estimates the influence degree of the pollution source change and the meteorological condition on the environmental quality. Quantitative evaluation of pollution emission reduction effects can be realized.

title: Insulator segmentation method based on improved conditional generative adversarial network
description: The invention belongs to the field of image segmentation and high-voltage transmission line inspection, and particularly relates to an insulator segmentation method, system and device for generating an antagonistic network based on improved conditions, aiming at solving the problems of poor segmentation precision and low efficiency of the insulator segmentation method for generating the antagonistic network based on the conditions. The method of the system comprises the steps of obtaining an image containing an insulator as an input image; acquiring an insulator segmentation image through an insulator segmentation model based on the input image; the insulator segmentation model is constructed by a generator for generating a countermeasure network based on conditions; the generator is constructed based on a self-encoder, and comprises an encoder and a decoder; the encoder comprises an asymmetric convolution layer and a maximum pooling layer; the decoder comprises an asymmetric convolution layer and an upper sampling layer; the training sample of the insulator segmentation model comprises an input image sample and a real segmentation image of the insulator contained in the input image sample. According to the invention, the countermeasure network is generated through improved conditions, and the segmentation precision and efficiency of the insulator are improved.

title: Driver abnormal behavior identification method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: This application discloses a method, device, equipment and storage medium for identifying driver's abnormal behavior. The method includes: determining the attribute information of the video stream data to be processed; and obtaining the video stream to be processed according to the attribute information of the video stream data to be processed. The target neural network model corresponding to the data; using the target neural network model, identify and process the video stream data to be processed to determine whether the video data to be processed contains abnormal driver behavior data. This method realizes the automatic identification of driver's abnormal behavior in the collected video stream data based on the neural network model, thereby providing timely warning when the driver's behavior is determined to be abnormal, allowing the control center to take timely remedial measures to reduce sudden emergencies. It can also reduce labor costs, improve identification efficiency, and provide conditions for the safe operation of vehicles.

title: Image cutting method, device and non-transitory computer readable medium
description: An image segmentation method, an image segmentation device and a non-transitory computer readable medium thereof are provided, wherein the image segmentation method is applied to the image segmentation device and comprises the following steps: receiving first and second images corresponding to first and second time points from the image stream; performing image segmentation on the second image by using a segmentation neural network to generate a label probability combination; carrying out similarity judgment operation on the first image and the second image by using a similarity calculation neural network to generate a similarity probability combination; the label probability combination and the similarity probability combination are connected in series by the series connection unit to generate a series connection result; and carrying out further inference operation on the concatenation result by the strategy neural network to generate a label mask. The image segmentation method, the image segmentation device and the non-transitory computer readable medium thereof can take previous images into consideration to generate similarity information to increase consistency among sequential segmentation results.

title: Online scheduling method and device for distributed machine learning task
description: The invention discloses an online scheduling method for distributed machine learning tasks, which converts difficult-to-process full-time online problems into a series of offline task scheduling problems by applying a dual approximation method and ensures the rationality of an algorithm in the conversion process. The invention can tend to optimally schedule the distributed machine learning tasks and resources on line without knowing the future, thereby avoiding the idle and waste of resources and efficiently scheduling and deploying various tasks and resources in real time under the condition of fully utilizing the limited resources.
