In a specific application process, the cloud resource provider can be helped to reasonably allocate resource scheduling tasks, and the resource demand elasticity of different tasks can be utilized to the maximum extent to fully utilize the existing resources. Resource providers in accordance with the present invention can adjust online scheduling policies in real-time online over time to achieve maximum utilization of resources and to minimize the weighted sum of completion times for all tasks.

title: A real-time artificial intelligence classification method, system, device and readable storage medium of lung rales for electronic stethoscope
description: The invention relates to the technical fields of computer hearing and artificial intelligence, in particular to an artificial intelligence real-time classification method for lung rales with an electronic stethoscope, comprising: collecting lung sound signals in real time through an electronic stethoscope, automatically classifying the lung rales, and collecting Data sliding extraction is a data block every 2 seconds through band-pass filter and normalization, using logarithmic Mel filter bank transformation to calculate the data matrix of three channels, and input a pre-built and trained convolution Neural network, the output of the convolutional neural network is the probability value of the four lung sound conditions, and the system combines the results of multiple data blocks to give the final probability value of the four lung sound conditions. The present invention can effectively improve the robustness of rales detection and classification results. The invention also discloses an artificial intelligence real-time classification system, device and computer-readable storage medium for lung rales of an electronic stethoscope, which have the same beneficial effects as the above method.

title: A multi-factor sensing terminal replacement prediction method based on deep neural network
description: The invention relates to a multi-factor perception terminal switching prediction method based on a deep neural network. First, terminal attributes and related user natural attributes, call behavior data, traffic usage behavior data and historical switching records are collected, and preprocessed; Perform encoding to obtain the user's natural attribute code and terminal attribute code, construct the user's historical switch information code according to the user's historical switch record and the corresponding terminal attribute code, and construct the user's call and traffic usage behavior sequence, and perform coarsening and normalization processing. ; Extract the time-series features of user calls and traffic usage behaviors; finally, splicing the user's natural attribute encoding, historical switching information encoding, call behavior time-series features and traffic usage behavior time-series features into the fully connected network to predict whether the user will switch phones. The prediction method of the present invention is beneficial for the operator to precisely market the mobile terminal and its supporting products to the users, thereby increasing the sales volume of the mobile terminal and expanding the market scale.

title: A fault detection method for power communication network based on transfer learning
description: The invention relates to a power communication network fault detection method based on transfer learning, which combines a convolutional neural network and transfer learning, integrates the characteristics of a plurality of trained local network models by utilizing the correlation between an actual network topology structure and an experimental network local network topology, and performs transfer parameter learning through a small amount of actual network fault samples to obtain an actual network fault diagnosis model, thereby realizing an available, accurate and comprehensive intelligent power communication network fault detection technology and expanding the applicability of the fault diagnosis technology. The invention innovatively combines the advantages of the convolutional neural network and the transfer learning method, fully utilizes the characteristic correlation between fault alarm data and the similarity of characteristics such as network node correlation degrees of different network topologies and the like, and accurately and comprehensively intelligently detects the fault data in the actual network.

title: Joint optimization underwater sound multi-hop cooperative communication network routing selection method
description: A jointly optimized underwater sound multi-hop cooperative communication network routing method relates to an underwater sound network. The method comprises the steps of utilizing randomness of an artificial fish swarm algorithm and a positive feedback mechanism of an ant colony algorithm to find the superiority of a global optimal solution, determining part of nodes in a routing sequence by taking the artificial fish swarm algorithm as a main body, integrating the other part of nodes selected by the ant colony algorithm to form a new routing sequence table, and finding a global optimal path by taking the energy consumption of the nodes as a cost function based on an underwater acoustic communication energy consumption model and combining a cooperative communication technology to minimize the system energy consumption of information transmission. The optimal path can reduce the overall energy consumption of the system, prolong the life cycle of the underwater sound multi-hop communication network and improve the efficiency of the underwater sound multi-hop cooperative communication. The defects that the precision of solving a global solution by using an artificial fish swarm algorithm alone is low and the ant swarm algorithm alone is easy to fall into local optimization are overcome.

title: Discover novel features that can be used in machine learning techniques, such as those used to diagnose medical conditions
description: An apparatus provides a system and method for exploring novel features to be used in machine learning techniques. The facility receives one or more sets of data for a plurality of objects, the data representing certain outputs or conditions of the objects or certain physical aspects of the captured objects over a period of time. The facility then extracts or calculates values from the data and applies one or more feature generators to the extracted values. Based on the output of the feature generators, the facility identifies a novel feature generator for at least one machine learning process and further mutates the novel feature generator, which may then be applied to the received data to identify other novel feature generators.

title: Positioning identification method and system for aircraft component
description: The invention relates to a method and a system for positioning and identifying airplane components, wherein a hourglass type network model is adopted to detect key points of an airplane to be a way for positioning and identifying the airplane components, and compared with the traditional component detection and a method for directly performing regression and classification on frames of the airplane key components based on a deep network such as fast R-CNN (fast R-CNN), the method can be used for constructing relative positions and structural relations among the components and between the components and the airplane, so that the key points of the airplane can be accurately positioned, the airplane components can be accurately positioned and identified, the identification accuracy of the airplane components can be finally improved, and the fine-grained classification performance and effect of airplane images can be further promoted.

title: Training ground meteorological observation element monitoring model, quality inspection method and system
description: The invention discloses a monitoring model for training ground meteorological observation elements, a quality inspection method and a system. The training method includes: constructing a game tree model for meteorological observation, and respectively taking corresponding actions on each node of the model according to the meteorological observation elements and the upper limit function of the confidence level of the tree strategy; traverse the nodes of the game tree according to its action strategy, and complete the game after traversing a preset number of times; after each traversal is completed, a backpropagation is performed to evaluate each node, and the game tree model reinforcement learning training is updated according to the evaluation parameters. The node parameters of the layer; after a preset number of games and back-propagation evaluations, the trained game tree model is obtained as a monitoring model. Based on the monitoring model, the quality inspection of the observation data of a large number of meteorological observation stations can be realized, and the refined processing of the inspection standards of each weather station can be realized, and the scalability is good. Performance degradation and high costs.

title: An Acceleration Method of Software-Hardware Collaboration Based on FPGA
description: The invention provides a software and hardware cooperative acceleration method based on an FPGA (field programmable gate array). The method comprises the steps of firstly compressing the network parameters of the deep learning model in a data quantization mode, and then inputting fixed point data obtained through quantization into a neural network accelerator for processing, wherein the neural network accelerator comprises an AXI4 bus interface, a convolution calculation module, a data cache module and a data processing module; the invention utilizes the software part to compress the neural network model, the hardware part is designed into a specific hardware architecture (neural network accelerator), the calculation amount is reduced, the high parallelism is utilized to effectively accelerate, and the memory access times are reduced to reduce the hardware energy consumption. The invention reduces redundant useless calculation and reading of parameter data by using the running information and the algorithm structure during convolution calculation, accelerates the reference of the neural network by using the FPGA hardware platform, can improve the real-time performance of the DCNN, realizes higher calculation performance and reduces energy consumption.

title: A System Elasticity Recovery Algorithm Considering Time and Task Importance
description: The invention discloses a system elastic recovery algorithm considering time and task importance, which comprises the steps of initializing parameter values of a population, coding individuals in the population into a maintenance sequence, adding information such as the importance and maintenance time into each node, adding time constraint, constructing an adaptive value function based on the task importance, obtaining the node importance of each group of maintenance personnel which can be maintained in limited time, and obtaining the total importance of the individuals through accumulation. The method searches and obtains the optimal individual with the highest total importance in the population, and then obtains the optimal individual in all algebras through iteration of the genetic algorithm, namely the optimal maintenance sequence. The advantages are that: the system elasticity recovery algorithm considering time and task importance is simple and efficient, the maintenance strategy and the maintenance result which enable the task importance to be the highest in limited time can be rapidly obtained, and the recovery algorithm can enable the damaged system elasticity to be rapidly recovered.

title: Campus violence behavior detection system and method based on deep learning
description: The present invention provides a system and method for detecting campus violence based on deep learning. The detection system includes: an image data management module. The image data management module is used to obtain images of campus violence scenes and non-campus violence scenes. data, and classify and annotate the image data and image augmentation to generate training data sets and test data sets; the deep learning algorithm training management module, the deep learning algorithm training management module builds the target algorithm model based on the neural network algorithm model, and based on the training The data set and test data set train and test the target algorithm model to generate a campus violence detection algorithm model; the human-computer interaction management module is used to obtain real-time information on campus monitoring using the campus violence detection algorithm model. The image data is used for judgment, and if the judgment result is that campus violence has occurred, an alarm will be issued.

title: Adaptive Neural Network Training and Inference Device
description: The invention discloses an adaptive neural network training and reasoning device, comprising a deep learning processing engine array, a storage module and an automatic update control module. The deep learning processing engine array is used for performing neural network training and reasoning; the storage module is used for storing neural network The output data of each layer of the network, the derivation value of the excitation function of each layer, the weight value of each layer, and the training samples; the automatic update control module is used to control the execution of forward propagation inference, and control the depth according to the monitored network output The array of learning processing engines performs backpropagation training to update network parameters of the neural network. Using the above modules, the adaptive neural network training and inference device can directly complete the neural network training and inference at the edge, realize automatic update, can effectively improve the processing performance of the deep learning network, reduce power consumption, and eliminate the need for training Additional interaction costs incurred by moving the process to the server or cloud.

title: Multi-stage series-parallel risk management method and device and electronic equipment
description: The invention discloses a multi-level series-parallel risk management method which comprises the steps of constructing a primary risk assessment model, constructing a secondary risk assessment model, and carrying out secondary risk assessment on a middle-period user meeting secondary risk assessment conditions to obtain a secondary risk assessment value, wherein the primary risk assessment model comprises a first risk assessment layer and a second risk assessment layer, the first risk assessment layer comprises two primary risk assessment links, initial user information is acquired and substituted into the primary risk assessment model to acquire the primary risk assessment value of the initial user, the primary user is screened for the first time according to the primary risk assessment value to form a middle-period user, the secondary risk assessment model is constructed, the secondary risk assessment is carried out on the middle-period user meeting the secondary risk assessment condition to acquire the secondary risk assessment value, the secondary risk assessment model comprises three secondary risk assessment links which are divided according to user types, and carrying out risk treatment on the user according to the secondary risk assessment value. The invention adopts different treatment measures at different stages in the pre-loan, thereby realizing accurate and soft post-loan management and early warning, finally optimizing the overall risk level and expanding the business income converted after actuation.

title: Abnormal electricity utilization user identification method, device, terminal and medium based on big data
description: The application discloses abnormal electricity consumption user identification, device, terminal and medium based on big data. By utilizing the power consumption fluctuation interval of the target user to carry out targeted judgment on the actual power consumption fluctuation of the target user, the technical situation that the power consumption habits of different user individuals are neglected in the existing identification mode can be avoided, and the technical problem that the misjudgment rate of the existing abnormal power consumption user identification method is high is solved.

title: A method, system, device and storage medium for generating video of character scene
description: The invention discloses a method, system, device and storage medium for generating a video of a character scene. By training a generative confrontation network model, and inputting label images with restricted conditions into the trained generation confrontation network model, the output and The real images corresponding to the constraints can guide the generative adversarial network model to generate real images corresponding to the constraints, so that the generated content can be more finely controlled and more controllable high-definition images can be generated. And new restrictions can be added according to the new generation requirements generated in the subsequent use, so that the generated content can be expanded according to the needs and become richer; and each video does not need to be recorded by real people, which has faster production efficiency and more Rich extension form. The invention is widely used in the field of computer technology.

title: Realization of Joint Judgment of Traffic Congestion Status Based on Point System
description: The invention relates to a processing method for jointly judging a traffic congestion state based on a point system, comprising the following steps: acquiring a video stream from a traffic monitoring system, decoding a frame of image, and detecting a vehicle target based on a deep learning target detection method , and optimize the results; calculate the center coordinate distance of each detection result of the current frame and the detection result of the previous frame, find the smallest center coordinate distance, and filter the detection results; count the number of vehicles by lane area, the lane in each lane The occupancy rate, the pixel similarity between the current frame and the previous frame of each lane; the congestion judgment calculation is performed for each lane area; the congestion judgment is performed. The processing method for jointly determining the traffic congestion state based on the integral system of the present invention is adopted, which greatly improves the detection accuracy of the traffic congestion state, can filter most of the noise, and has high robustness. This method has low computational energy consumption and fast speed, and can be applied to various traffic scenarios, and has strong scene versatility.

title: Novel plane molecular array antenna array comprehensive array arrangement method based on improved genetic algorithm
description: The invention relates to an antenna array arrangement optimization technology, in particular to an optimization arrangement technology of a sub-array level antenna array. The invention firstly provides an improved genetic algorithm, and compared with the traditional genetic algorithm, the problem that the traditional genetic algorithm is easy to fall into local optimum is solved, the steps of bottom layer global search are added, and the optimization performance of the genetic algorithm is improved. In addition, for the problem that whether the subarrays are overlapped or not is difficult to judge in the planar molecular array arrangement problem, the invention provides a simple and feasible judgment method, and the effect of the method in the planar molecular array arrangement is verified by adopting an improved genetic algorithm.

title: An image coloring method, device, image acquisition device and readable storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present invention provide an image coloring method, an apparatus, an image acquisition device, and a readable storage medium. The method is applied to a target image acquisition device having a multi-camera camera system including a black-and-white camera and a color camera. The method includes: acquiring a black-and-white image captured by the black-and-white camera and a color image captured by the color camera; inputting the black-and-white image and the color image into In the preset coloring model, the output result of the coloring model is obtained as the target image obtained by coloring the black and white image; wherein, the coloring model is based on the color sample image, the first coloring result and the level of each pair of sample images. The flipped second shading result is obtained by training the preset initial shading model. Compared with the prior art, by applying the solutions provided by the embodiments of the present invention, it is possible to colorize a black and white image captured by an image acquisition device having a multi-camera camera system including a black and white camera and a color camera.

title: Semantic recognition method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable storage medium
description: The embodiments of the present invention provide a semantic recognition method and device, an electronic device, and a computer-readable storage medium, which relate to the field of computer technology. The semantic recognition method includes: obtaining input information of a target object; extracting a target slot value of a target slot in the input information through a slot extraction model; wherein the slot extraction model includes an input layer, a shared layer, and an output layer connected in sequence, wherein the output layer includes n parallel sub-output layers, each sub-output layer is used to output a slot value prediction result of a slot; n is a positive integer greater than or equal to 2. The technical solution of the embodiment of the present invention can realize multi-slot prediction of the same word, thereby improving the accuracy of semantic recognition.

title: Small sample fault diagnosis method and system for power equipment based on virtual and real twin space
description: The invention discloses a small sample fault diagnosis method and system for electric equipment based on virtual and real twin space, belonging to the field of electric equipment fault diagnosis. Accurate entity space; according to the simulation model of the equipment to be diagnosed, the fuzzy mirror space is obtained by simulation; the training set of accurate entity space and the sample set of fuzzy mirror space are spatially crossed to obtain the training sample set of twin space; the training sample set of twin space is regarded as the precise entity space As a supplement to the training set, the fault type and location are used as diagnostic labels, which are input into the deep convolutional neural network for training, and the fault identification and location are performed on the accurate entity space verification set to verify the diagnostic effect. The present invention utilizes the power equipment simulation to enhance the data of the measured samples, which can give full play to the auxiliary function of the power simulation in the diagnosis practice, and effectively improve the accuracy rate in the case of small sample diagnosis.

title: Method and system for realizing intelligent replenishment of chain merchants
description: A method and system for realizing intelligent replenishment of chain merchants are provided. The method includes: acquiring a training data set; based on the training data set, using a reinforcement learning algorithm to train a machine learning model for predicting the replenishment amount required by each branch of a chain merchant this time, so as to obtain the trained machine learning model. model, wherein the optimization goal of the reinforcement learning algorithm is: the cumulative value of the total replenishment cost of each replenishment within the first preset time period is the smallest, wherein the total replenishment cost of each replenishment includes: Replenishment price of the branch where the stock was replenished and the unreplenished price of the branch that did not replenish this time. According to the method and system, a machine learning model for realizing intelligent replenishment of chain merchants can be obtained, and the replenishment plan obtained through the machine learning model can minimize the total replenishment cost.

title: Pedestrian re-identification method based on component guide graph convolution network
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a pedestrian re-identification method based on a component guide graph convolution network, which comprises the following steps: constructing a feature extraction module to obtain local features of the same region of the image of the training pedestrian; constructing a graph convolution module to obtain inter-class and intra-class local graph convolution characteristics of the same region of the training pedestrian image; constructing a feature embedding module to obtain the series features of the two and the final features after dimensionality reduction; constructing a loss calculation module, and optimizing a pedestrian re-identification model formed by the modules by using a loss value to obtain an optimal pedestrian re-identification model; and calculating the similarity between the query image and the final characteristic calculation image of the pedestrian bank by using the optimal pedestrian re-identification model to obtain a pedestrian re-identification result. The invention fully utilizes the advantages of the convolutional neural network and the graph convolution network to learn the local relationship between classes and the local relationship in the classes of the pedestrian images, and finally integrates the graph convolution characteristics to express the pedestrian images, thereby further improving the matching accuracy of pedestrian re-identification.

title: A Low-Power Convolution Operation Circuit Based on Approximate Multipliers
description: The invention discloses a low-power-consumption convolution operation circuit based on an approximate multiplier, which comprises a convolution operation module, an approximate convolution calculation mode generation module, an approximate multiplier module and an approximate adder module, wherein the convolution operation module is used for generating a convolution operation mode; the convolution operation module comprises an input vector matrix, a convolution kernel matrix, an approximate convolution calculation mode and an output approximate vector matrix; the input of the approximate convolution calculation mode generation module comprises an accurate calculation mode and an approximate multiplication operation; the input of the approximate multiplier module comprises two multipliers A 、 B And degree of approximation of multiplication DM The input of the approximate adder module comprises a partial product matrix to be accumulated and the addition approximation degree DA (ii) a The invention generates a high-precision approximate convolution calculation mode by designing a high-precision approximate multiplier and an approximate adder. The calculation mode in the original convolution operation is replaced by the approximate convolution calculation mode, so that the method can effectively meet the requirement of the output precision of the convolution operationThe calculation overhead is reduced, and the convolution operation with low power consumption is realized.

title: A model training control method, device and system based on multiple computing nodes
description: Embodiments of the present application provide a model training control method, device, and system based on multiple computing nodes, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein each iterative training process includes: the first computing node obtains the first sample data of each first sample data. A model output result, and the total model output result is determined according to the output results of each first model, the output results of each second model, and the secure multi-party summation protocol; the first computing node determines the loss value, and determines the value of the iterative training process based on the loss value. Update the gradient value and the encryption loss value; the first computing node updates the first model parameter to be determined in the iterative process based on the updated gradient value, and decrypts each encryption gradient value of each second computing node to obtain each decryption gradient value, each encrypted The gradient value is determined by each second computing node based on the encryption loss value and the Hadamard product of the encrypted random vector corresponding to each second computing node. This application does not need to introduce an intermediary party to ensure the security of each computing node.

title: Intelligent factory process flow optimization method based on big data
description: The invention discloses an intelligent factory process flow optimization method based on big data, which relates to the technical field of intelligent factories and aims at analyzing association rules of historical process flow data, preprocessing the historical process flow data through a big data platform, training and learning the process data through a decision tree algorithm to generate process rules, and importing the process rules into a historical process rule model base; real-time process flow data are generated by monitoring the production process, training is carried out through a neural network algorithm and the process flow data, and a real-time process rule model base is established; and comparing and analyzing the process model by using a process model comparison and analysis module to generate a process decision, and optimizing the process flow by using decision analysis. The method aims at the process production data of the intelligent factory to train and learn to generate the process rules, so that the process decision rule is found from the process production data of the intelligent factory, and the problems of large process data volume, low process decision efficiency and the like of the traditional factory are solved.

title: A sound-based identification method for rural road traffic accidents
description: The present invention proposes a sound-based identification method for rural road traffic accident alarm situation, including the following steps: collecting sound signals on the road with a microphone, manually listening to and classifying the obtained sound clips, and randomly dividing positive and negative sample data sets respectively Build a one-dimensional CNN network classification model for training data sets and test data sets; train the constructed CNN network classification model; deploy the trained CNN network classification model to embedded devices, and the deployment framework adopts Tencent's open source ncnn neural network inference. framework; the detection device is installed in the actual road environment to run, analyze the real-time audio stream, and detect whether there is a suspected traffic accident alarm situation; and in the present invention, the microphone is used to automatically identify the traffic accident alarm situation, which can greatly reduce costs and cover a wide range. And the system can run stably for a long time and is highly intelligent.

title: Case risk identification method based on machine learning
description: The invention discloses a case risk identification method based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of firstly analyzing a case, extracting an effective case feature list, extracting a white sample in a random undersampling mode, and balancing the ratio of the white sample to the black sample in data; and then processing a feature width table based on data such as transaction flow, account basic information, customer basic information and the like, training a random forest algorithm based on the feature width table, and extracting an important feature list capable of effectively distinguishing black and white samples. And finally training and predicting a random forest algorithm based on the important feature broad table to obtain a final suspicious account set, and checking and verifying the suspicious account. The invention applies the machine learning supervised algorithm to the small sample bank case risk scene for the first time, not only can accurately identify the risk account, but also can analyze out the effective rule, and provides a reference basis for rule formulation and prevention and control thought under the bank case risk scene.

title: Treatment effect prediction model construction system, treatment effect prediction system and terminal
description: The application provides a system for constructing a therapeutic effect prediction model, a therapeutic effect prediction system and a terminal, which relate to the technical field of diagnostic and therapeutic instruments. Through the deep neural network model, text word vector conversion module, embedded neural network model, feature splicing module and model training module, the collected sample patient information is processed, and the treatment effect prediction model based on Multi-Hot Embedding text word vector is obtained. The construction system of the treatment effect prediction model of the present application aims to solve the problem that the RNN model relies on the temporal correlation of text information during model construction, resulting in the inability to effectively capture patient information.

title: Method and system for network public opinion topic identification based on social text
description: The invention provides a social text-based online public opinion topic identification method, and relates to the technical field of text data processing. According to the method, the influence of the noise words on the text topic discovery is considered, the subject words in the generated words are separated from the noise words of the generated words, the noise words are filtered, and the subject word distribution of each word is deduced, so that the network public opinion topics corresponding to the generated words can be accurately judged, the accuracy of network public opinion topic identification is improved, and accurate data support is provided for follow-up public opinion monitoring, government or related management departments such as public opinion guiding and personalized marketing.

title: A single-indicator anomaly detection method based on the fusion of multiple unsupervised methods
description: A single-index anomaly detection method based on fusion of multiple non-supervision methods relates to the field of intelligent operation and maintenance anomaly detection. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Extracting analysis data: the data stored in the database is counted according to the minute level, and the required data format is returned; 2) Performing preliminary screening on the data extracted in the step 1) by adopting an unsupervised method, filtering and screening a batch of normal data sets from massive data with greater grasp to output as normal, and outputting other samples as suspected abnormalities; 3) Training a model: constructing a model for the normal sample identified in step 2); 4) Evaluating the model; 5) And outputting a final model, and deploying the final model on an online module for real-time abnormality detection. The method not only can solve the problem of low efficiency of the traditional anomaly detection method, but also can take advantage of the comparison with a new supervised method, and achieves higher identification precision. Not only meets the requirement of efficiency, but also saves the cost of manual marking.

title: Synthetic Aperture Imaging Method Based on Semantic Inpainting
description: The invention relates to a synthetic aperture imaging method based on semantic patching, which consists of generating a synthetic aperture image focused on an occlusion plane, marking pixels located in the occlusion area, generating a synthetic aperture image focused on a target plane, and semantic patching steps for missing areas. It is used to solve the problem that the synthetic image information is missing due to severe occlusion of the scene in the existing synthetic aperture imaging method. The present invention makes full use of the semantic information of the synthetic aperture image and the associated pixel information between multiple perspectives, regards the synthetic aperture imaging as the semantic repair problem of the image, uses the semantic information around the target to repair the missing area, and realizes the problem of the image under serious occlusion conditions. Clear and complete synthetic aperture imaging method for occluded targets.

title: Section lane-level short-term traffic flow prediction method based on deep learning combination model
description: The invention discloses a section lane level short-term traffic flow prediction method based on a deep learning combination model, which comprises the following steps of: 1) carrying out data preprocessing on the existing traffic flow data; 2) extracting traffic flow information and topological connection structures of the sections of the predicted lanes and the surrounding connection road sections at the same moment, and acquiring spatial correlation characteristics of upstream and downstream of the short-time traffic flow; 3) extracting traffic flow states of all lanes with different sections of a road section where the predicted lane sections are located at the same time, and acquiring space correlation characteristics and time characteristics of a target lane and the lanes with different sections of the same road section; 4) fusing the two spatial characteristics and the time characteristic through an FC network to predict the traffic flow; 5) comparing the actual traffic flow value with the predicted value, optimizing parameters and obtaining a final FC network model; 6) and (4) predicting the section lane-level short-time traffic flow by adopting the final FC network model. The method can effectively improve the accuracy of the short-term traffic flow prediction result of the section lane level.

title: A method for predicting dissolved gas concentration in transformer oil
description: The invention discloses a method for predicting the concentration of dissolved gas in transformer oil. First, in order to reduce the influence of the fluctuation of the time series of dissolved gas concentration in transformer oil on the prediction result, singular spectrum analysis is used to decompose the time series of dissolved gas concentration in original transformer oil into Multiple feature components, and then establish the prediction model of the chaotic bat algorithm to optimize the echo state network for each feature component to improve the stability and generalization ability of the prediction model; then input the test data to the prediction model to obtain the predicted values of all the feature components; finally The predicted values of all characteristic components are superimposed to obtain the actual predicted results of dissolved gas concentration in transformer oil. The method of the invention can better search for the variation law of the gas concentration time series, and obtain a higher precision prediction result of the dissolved gas concentration in the transformer oil than a single artificial intelligence prediction method.

title: A method and system for positioning the mitral valve in ultrasound images based on deep learning
description: The present invention provides a method and system for locating the mitral valve in ultrasound images based on deep learning, which relates to the field of deep learning technology, including: continuously collecting cardiac ultrasound images; when acquiring the first frame of cardiac ultrasound images, inputting the cardiac ultrasound images into a neural network for classification The model obtains the position of the slice including the slice type; and according to the slice positioning model associated with the slice position, the position of the mitral valve in the echocardiogram image is obtained; When the similarity between the ultrasound images is greater than the similarity threshold, the slice position of the previous frame of the cardiac ultrasound image is used as the slice position of the current frame of the cardiac ultrasound image; when the similarity is not greater than the similarity threshold, the current frame of the cardiac ultrasound image is input into the neural network classification The model conducts section recognition to obtain the section location. It can track the position of the mitral valve in real time, and solve the problem of probe position deviation in blood flow monitoring and mitral valve movement.

title: A method for evaluating the differentiation of hepatocellular carcinoma based on the fusion of multimodal image contributions
description: The invention discloses a hepatocyte cancer differentiation evaluation method based on multi-modal image contribution fusion, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing an effective high-dimensional multi-modal image data association representation, namely selecting a proper feature extraction mode to extract features of multi-modal MRI images, simultaneously, utilizing a multi-modal MRI image contribution self-adaptive weighting mechanism to learn task contribution of nine-modal MRI images, then carrying out feature layer fusion on a parameter result obtained by learning the task contribution and features obtained by the multi-modal fusion MRI data through a feature extractor, finally adding a classifier at the top end of a network, and carrying out a grading task of HCC differentiation degree by using multi-modal MRI image features combined with the contribution so as to realize more accurate prediction. Compared with the traditional imaging diagnosis method, the method eliminates the influence of subjective factors and simultaneously considers the diagnosis capability and contribution of each multi-mode MRI sequence, so that the obtained result is more accurate and robust.

title: System and method for object detection based on artificial neural network
description: A system and method for object detection based on artificial neural networks. The method includes: acquiring a three-dimensional point cloud and using a backbone neural network to acquire a first feature map of the three-dimensional point cloud (S101); processing the first feature map using an attention branch neural network and acquiring a second feature map, wherein each position of the second feature map includes a predicted attention coefficient corresponding to that position, and the second feature map is also used to acquire a loss function for the target object, which is used to update the network coefficients of the attention branch neural network (S102); obtaining a prediction result based on the second feature map, the prediction result including the position information of the target object (S103).

title: Extraction method, extraction apparatus, and computer-readable recording medium
description: Extraction methods, extraction devices, and computer-readable recording media are provided. The extraction device generates multiple combinations of conditions related to multiple item values included in the data. The extraction device calculates an index value indicating a degree of co-occurrence between a specified response variable and each of the plurality of combinations by using a machine learning model that estimates a response variable from a plurality of item values, the machine learning model using the data to train. The extraction device extracts a specific combination from a plurality of combinations based on any one of a condition and an index value.

title: Implicit discourse relation analysis method and system
description: The invention provides an implicit discourse relation analysis method based on a semantic-syntax dual-channel graph convolution network, and belongs to the technical field of natural language processing application. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, the corpus is participled. Pre-processing such as constructing a word list and the like, and then initializing a word vector by utilizing GloVe. And respectively inputting the two initialized arguments into a Bi-LSTM code to obtain the word expression fused with the context information. The Bi-LSTM output is used to subsequently initialize a representation of a graph node in the dual-path graph convolution network. The dual-path graph convolution network comprises two GCN networks, corresponding features are extracted from the interactive structure graph and the syntax structure graph respectively, and different features obtained by the two paths are spliced for classification. And updating the parameters in the model by adopting an Adam algorithm until convergence, and completing analysis of implicit discourse relation by using the parameters with optimal performance.

title: An Ant Colony Algorithm Optimization Method Based on Reverse Learning
description: The invention relates to an ant colony algorithm optimization method based on reverse learning, which is used for solving the problem of a traveler. The improvement of the algorithm mainly comprises the following points: 1, after the initial path is obtained, reversing the serial number of each city in the initial path to construct a reverse path; 2, sequencing the initial path and the reverse path from small to large according to the length, and taking partial paths to form a group of new paths; 3, setting an iteration threshold, and if the current iteration times do not reach the iteration threshold, performing pheromone updating on a new group of paths; otherwise, the pheromone is updated on the initial path. The invention improves the aspect of pheromone updating of a basic ant colony algorithm, introduces a reverse learning construction reverse path in the earlier stage of iteration, participates in pheromone updating, is beneficial to expanding the search range of ants, avoids ants from falling into local extreme values, and balances exploration and development of an understanding space.

title: Underwater sound FBMC communication signal detection method based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses an underwater sound FBMC communication signal detection method based on deep learning. The trained deep neural network model (DNN) is used for replacing modules such as channel estimation and equalization in the receiving end of the traditional underwater sound FBMC communication system, the modularization limit of the system is broken, underwater sound channel state information is learned in a self-adaptive mode, the inherent imaginary part interference influence of the original system is avoided, and the error rate performance of the system is improved. The invention has the beneficial effects that: the invention uses a DNN with perfect training to replace the original processes of channel estimation, equalization and the like at the receiving end of the traditional underwater sound FBMC communication system. And acquiring underwater acoustic channel state information by utilizing a DNN training stage, and realizing demodulation and recovery of signals in a testing stage. On the basis, the invention also introduces an Adam weight updating strategy and an L2 regularization method to optimize the DNN model, further improves the convergence efficiency and the estimation precision of the DNN, and has certain superiority in the aspects of precision and complexity compared with the existing method based on channel estimation.

title: Three-dimensional intelligent positioning method based on knowledge graph
description: The invention discloses a three-dimensional intelligent positioning method based on a knowledge graph, which comprises the following steps: acquiring data, wherein the data comprises correct and wrong knowledge points, capabilities corresponding to the knowledge points and question types and daily behavior emotions of students in daily tests and various examinations of the students; information extraction, namely performing entity extraction and relationship extraction on the acquired data from three dimensions of knowledge points, capacity and behaviors to form a relationship network; knowledge fusion, namely processing the relation network by using reference resolution and entity disambiguation to obtain a series of basic fact expressions; and knowledge processing, namely performing knowledge reasoning and quality evaluation on a series of basic fact expressions to obtain a knowledge graph for positioning weak knowledge points and question types of students. The method of the invention uses knowledge map technology, combines three dimensions of knowledge points, abilities and behaviors, really realizes intelligent positioning of students, increases the rationality of positioning, and is beneficial to scientifically and efficiently improving the learning efficiency and the achievement of students.

title: Digital holographic microscopy for determining the status of viral infection
description: A method for providing a viral infection status of at least one cell in a cell sample, the method comprising receiving holographic information (304) of the cell sample obtained by digital holographic microscopy and determining the viral infection status (306) of the at least one cell from the holographic information.

title: A method, device and electronic equipment for identifying fraud
description: The present invention provides a method, device and electronic equipment for identifying fraud, wherein the method includes: performing identification processing on the behavior data to be identified based on a classification model; when the behavior data to be identified is abnormal, determining the audit results of the behavior data to be identified; And add the behavior data to be identified as a positive sample to the preset sample set; use the behavior data to be identified as a piece of historical behavior data, and extract the corresponding outliers in the historical behavior data based on the preset outlier detection model. Outlier historical behavior data; when the outlier historical behavior data belongs to fraudulent behavior, the outlier historical behavior data is added to the sample set as a positive sample, and then the classification model is trained again based on the updated sample set. The technical solutions provided by the embodiments of the present invention not only expand the number of samples in the sample set, but also enable the classification model to identify new types of fraudulent behaviors in a timely manner, thereby improving the recognition effect of the classification model.

title: A real-time online monitoring system for pollution sources
description: The invention discloses a real-time online monitoring system for pollution sources, comprising an online pollutant analysis device, a remote transmission system, a server and a client terminal; the remote transmission system is connected with the online pollutant analysis device, and the remote transmission system and the client terminal are both connected to the server Communication connection; online pollutant analysis equipment is used to collect environmental parameters; remote transmission system is used to transmit the collected environmental parameters to the server; the server is equipped with collection services, storage services, databases, and computing services; Send a query command to the server, and receive the query result information fed back by the server. Collect the environmental parameters of each monitoring point through the pollutant online analysis equipment, and transmit them to the server in real time. Users can communicate with the server through the client terminal to obtain the environmental parameter data of each monitoring point in real time; at the same time, collect atmospheric environmental parameters, water environmental parameters, waste gas Environmental parameters and wastewater environmental parameters are conducive to the intelligent management of the overall environment.

title: On-line soft measurement method for butane content of debutanizer bottom product
description: The invention discloses an online soft measurement method for butane content at the bottom of a debutanizer tower, aiming to establish a deep Elman neural network model, thereby extracting nonlinear features layer by layer, and used to realize real-time soft measurement of butane content. Specifically, the method of the present invention realizes deep feature extraction of the debutanizer process data by building a deep Elman neural network model composed of multi-level Elman neural networks connected in series. On this basis, a soft measurement model for the butane content of the bottom product is established with higher accuracy and more guarantee. The main advantage of the method of the present invention is that when establishing the soft measurement model, a deep Elman neural network model composed of multi-level Elman neural networks is used, which not only utilizes the inherent ability of the Elman neural network to adapt to time-varying characteristics, but also Deep feature extraction of process data is also achieved by extracting nonlinear features layer by layer.

title: Image quality evaluation method, image quality evaluation model training method and device
description: The invention provides an image quality evaluation method, an image quality evaluation model training method and an image quality evaluation model training device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be processed; inputting the image to be processed into an image quality evaluation model trained in advance to obtain evaluation results of the image to be processed under a plurality of preset quality levels; the image quality evaluation model is obtained by using a sample set through machine learning training, and each sample in the sample set comprises a sample image and quality label distribution corresponding to the sample image; the quality label distribution comprises a plurality of preset quality levels and probability values of the sample images belonging to each quality level. According to the method, the quality of the image to be processed is evaluated through the image quality evaluation model to obtain the quality grade of the image, the image quality evaluation model can learn the inherent uncertainty of the image quality from the quality label distribution of the sample image in the training process, and further the accuracy and the stability of the model quality evaluation are improved.

title: Interactive method, apparatus, electronic device and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application provides an interaction method, an interaction device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are applicable to a man-machine interaction scene in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI), wherein the interaction method comprises the following steps: collecting an image set of a user; acquiring a user behavior parameter sequence according to the image set of the user; obtaining an interaction intention value of the user through an interaction intention value model according to the user behavior parameter sequence; and when the condition that the user meets the active interaction is determined according to the interaction willingness value of the user, outputting the interactive content according to the historical interaction information of the user. According to the embodiment of the application, the interactive content can be output according to the historical interactive information of the user instead of outputting the same content to all the users, different active interactive contents can be output aiming at different users, the user experience is further improved, and the adhesion degree with the user is improved. The electronic equipment in the embodiment of the application can be a robot, and can realize interaction of adults, children and the like in the aspects of entertainment, education and the like, so as to realize personification accompanying.

title: Inference system, inference device, and inference method
description: An inference system includes: a learning unit configured to generate an inference model using a first dataset including a plurality of sample data whose ground truth is given and a second dataset including a plurality of sample data whose ground truth is not given; and an inference unit configured to determine an inference result. The inference model includes an encoder configured to calculate from sample data a first feature value independent of the first dataset and the second dataset and a second feature value dependent on the first dataset or the second dataset. The learning unit is configured to train the encoder such that the same first feature value is calculated from any of first sample data and second sample data for a pair of the first sample data among the first dataset and the second sample data which is among the second dataset and whose ground truth is to be identical to the ground truth of the first sample data.

title: Neural network based line of sight detection for positioning
description: Techniques are provide for neural network based positioning of a mobile device. An example method for determining a line of sight delay, an angle of arrival, or an angle of departure value, according to the disclosure includes receiving reference signal information, determining a channel frequency response or a channel impulse response based on the reference signal information, processing the channel frequency response or the channel impulse response with a neural network, and determining the line of sight delay, the angle of arrival, or the angle of departure value based on an output of the neural network.

title: System and method for data augmentation for multi-microphone signal processing
description: A method, computer program product, and computing system for receiving a signal from each microphone of a plurality of microphones, thus defining a plurality of signals. One or more inter-microphone gain-based augmentations may be performed on the plurality of signals, thus defining one or more inter-microphone gain-augmented signals. Performing the one or more inter-microphone gain-based augmentations on the plurality of signals may include applying a gain level from a plurality of gain levels to the signal from each microphone. Applying the gain level from the plurality of gain levels to the signal from each microphone may include applying a gain level, from a predefined range of gain levels, to the signal from each microphone. Applying the gain level from the plurality of gain levels to the signal from each microphone may include applying a random gain level, from the predefined range of gain levels, to the signal from each microphone.

title: Cyber attack coverage
description: A target system is verified against one or more security threats. A selection of a threat type for an attack vector for verifying defensive capabilities of a target system is received via a user interface. A selection of one or more selectable parameters for delivery of the threat type to the target system is received via the user interface. In response to selection of the threat type and the selected parameters, a base binary executable and a library comprising functions for generating attack vectors is accessed. One or more functions from the library are added to the base binary executable based on the selected threat type and the selected parameters. A payload is generated that implements the selected threat type and the selected parameters in a delivery format based on the selected parameters.

title: Knowledge graph construction method and apparatus, check method and storage medium
description: A knowledge graph construction method and apparatus, a check method and a storage medium. A knowledge graph construction method for a network device, comprising: acquiring configuration data of a network device (201); preprocessing the configuration data to obtain a device classification data set (202); classifying configuration scenarios according to the device classification data set, and performing knowledge extraction on the classified configuration scenarios to obtain a configuration scenario data set (203); and extracting an entity relationship of the configuration scenario data set according to the device type and device role, and constructing a knowledge graph according to the entity relationship (204).

title: Spatial power outage estimation for natural hazards leveraging optimal synthetic power networks
description: The following relates generally to calculating estimated power outages during a natural disaster event. In this regard, some embodiments create a synthetic network of a power infrastructure of a geographic area by: determining a location of a power substation; determining a location of a customer; determining a location of a power line linking the power substation to the customer; and determining if the power line is overhead or underground. Some embodiments then use the created synthetic network to simulate an event to calculate the estimated power outages during the event.

title: Selectively masking query content to provide to a secondary digital assistant
description: Systems and methods for obfuscating and/or omitting potentially sensitive information in a spoken query before providing the query to a secondary automated assistant. A general automated assistant may be invoked by a user, followed by a query. The audio data can be processed to omit and/or obfuscate potentially sensitive information before providing one or more processed queries to secondary automated assistants based on a trust metric associated with each of the secondary automated assistants. The trust metric for a secondary automated assistant is indicative of trust in being provided with sensitive information. In response, the automated assistants can generate responses, which can be filtered to provide a response to the user.

title: Systems and methods for application accessibility testing with assistive learning
description: Systems and methods for an automated testing system may include a server including a processor and a memory. The memory may contain an accessibility matrix. The system may include a test engine in data communication with the server. The test engine may include a machine learning model. Upon receipt of a development application comprising one or more functions, the test engine may be configured to generate a test script configured to test at least one of the one or more functions, execute the test script to generate a test result, and implement a change to the development application based on the test result and the accessibility matrix.

title: Systems and methods for automated hyperspectral vegetation index derivation for high-throughput plant phenotyping
description: The present invention is directed to a method for automated hyperspectral vegetation index (VI) determination, including: accessing measured spectra and respective measured ground truth values of a selected vegetation trait; accessing a library of VI models, each model including a relationship defining an index value for the vegetation trait by mathematically combining spectral measurement values at a plurality of wavebands; selecting a VI model from the library; generating a hyperparameter for each of the spectral measurement values of the selected model, the hyperparameter including a selected waveband for each of the plurality of model wavebands; evaluating the selected model with the selected wavebands with an objective function score; a model parameter tuning step using an optimizer to select the waveband for each of the at least two wavebands based on sequential model-based optimization (SMBO); and repeating the model selection, generation, evaluation and tuning steps for a plurality of iterations.

title: Method, apparatus, and system for multi-modal multi-task processing
description: A system for multi-modal multi-task processing includes a task representation component configured to determine a task representation element corresponding to a task representation framework that is used to define a content format for describing a to-be-processed task, and the task representation element including an element used to define task description information, an element used to define task input information, and an element used to define task output information; and based on the task representation element, acquire task description information, task input information, and task output information corresponding to each of to-be-processed tasks in different modalities; a data conversion component configured to determine an encoding sequence corresponding to each of the to-be-processed tasks; and a data processing component configured to process each of the to-be-processed tasks based on the encoding sequence corresponding to each of the to-be-processed tasks to obtain a task processing result corresponding to each of the to-be-processed tasks.

title: Multi-asset placement and sizing for robust operation of distribution systems
description: A method for adding assets to a distribution network includes using a placement generation engine to generate discrete placements of assets to be added to the distribution network subject to asset-installation constraint(s). Each placement is defined by a mapping of an asset, from multiple assets of different sizes, to a placement location defined by a node or branch of the distribution network. Each placement is used to update an operational circuit model of the distribution network for tuning control parameters of one or more controllers of the distribution network for robust operation over a range of load and/or generation scenarios. A cost function is evaluated for each placement based on a simulated operation. Parameters of the placement generation engine are iteratively adjusted based on the evaluated cost functions to arrive at an optimal placement and sizing of assets to be added to the distribution network.

title: Quality score calibration of basecalling systems
description: A method of generating base calls by a base caller is disclosed. The method includes receiving a plurality of sensor data from a flow cell, wherein the plurality of sensor data is within a first range and identifying a second range, such that at least a threshold percentage of the plurality of sensor data are within the second range. At least a subset of the plurality of sensor data, that are within the second range, are mapped to a third range, thereby generating a plurality of normalized sensor data. The plurality of normalized sensor data is processed in a base caller, to call, for the plurality of normalized sensor data, one or more corresponding bases.

title: Method for data augmentation for channel state information feedback
description: There is provided an apparatus comprising: at least one processor; and at least one memory storing instructions that, when executed by the at least one processor, cause the apparatus at least to perform: receiving, from a network node, a request for training data for data augmentation algorithm; transmitting, to the network node, a first part of a plurality of parts of the training data, wherein properties of data in the first part of the training data reflect distribution of the training data.

title: Systems and methods for fault detection based on peer statistics
description: While many network components include diagnostic capabilities that are sometimes implemented at the hardware level, these diagnostics can be unreliable. Thus, false indications of operability or inoperability can result when these diagnostics are relied upon exclusively. To better detect operational problems with a network component, operational parameters from the network component and one or more peer devices are analyzed to determine whether the network component is operational. In some embodiments, data derived from these operational parameters is provided to a supervised machine learning model, and the model provides output indicating the operational status of the network component. Some embodiments binarize operational parameters of a device and compute a maximum duration the binarized parameters indicate inactivity of the device. Some embodiments compute a moving average of the binarized parameters. The maximum duration and/or moving average(s) are provided to the machine learning model in some embodiments.

title: Adaptive neural network for nucelotide sequencing
description: This disclosure describes methods, non-transitory computer readable media, and systems that can configure a field programmable gate array (FPGA) or other configurable processor to implement a neural network and train the neural network using the configurable processor by modifying certain network parameters of a subset of the neural network's layers. For instance, the disclosed systems can configure a configurable processor on a computing device to implement a base-calling-neural network (or other neural network) that includes different sets of layers. Based on a set of images of oligonucleotide clusters or other datasets, the neural network generates predicted classes, such as by generating nucleobase calls for oligonucleotide clusters. Based on the predicted classes, the disclosed systems subsequently modify certain network parameters for a subset of the neural network's layers, such by modifying parameters for a set of top layers.

title: Machine learning method, and machine learning device
description: A machine-learning method includes: a data-set division process of separating a period into a learning period and a validation period, and dividing data set into learning data and validation data; a learning-candidate-period separating process of separating learning candidate period into a plurality of divided learning periods; a learning-period evaluation process of generating a learning-period evaluation model for each divided learning period using learning data corresponding to the divided learning periods, and calculating an evaluation index of the learning-period evaluation model for each divided learning period; a learning-period selection process of repeatedly performing the learning-candidate-period separating process and the learning-period evaluation process until a predetermined termination condition is satisfied, and selecting a divided learning period having a high evaluation index as a learning target period when the termination condition is satisfied; and a model output process of outputting the learning model on which machine learning has been performed using the learning data corresponding to the learning target period.

title: Machine learning program, determination program, machine learning method, determination method, machine learning device, and determination device
description: A machine learning program for causing a computer to execute a process includes training a machine learning model by machine learning that uses a cost function in which each element of a matrix obtained by relaxing a discrete variable to be optimized to a continuous matrix becomes a discrete optimization problem as a cost function in a search process that performs a search by adopting continuous relaxation into the discrete optimization problem.

title: Methodsand systems for protecting genetic data
description: Systems, methods, and computer-readable storage media for comparing genetic data of at least two individuals to determine a relationship between the at least two individuals and to present the relationship while providing privacy protection of certain genetic data. One system includes a one or more processing circuits to receive at least a portion of a first genetic dataset and at least a portion of a second genetic dataset. Further, the one or more processing circuits to identify a first set of DNA markers and identify a second set of DNA markers, and wherein the first set of DNA markers and the second set of DNA markers at least partially correspond. Further, the one or more processing circuits to determine a plurality of relationship indices, generate a relationship interface that includes graphical representations, and provide the relationship interface.

title: Apparatuses for encoding and decoding a sequence of integer values, methods for encoding and decoding a sequence of integer values and computer program for implementing these methods
description: The invention describes an encoding scheme for encoding a sequence of integer values, particularly by first using encoding a value at a predetermined position and then consecutively calculating and encoding differences between neighboring values. A respective decoding scheme is also provided. These encoding and decoding schemes provide more efficient encoding concept.

title: System and method for variational annealing to solve financial optimization problems
description: A system and method for variational annealing to solve financial optimization problems is provided. The financial optimization problem is encoded as objective function represented in terms of an energy function. An autoregressive neural network is trained to minimize the cost function via variational emulation of classical or quantum annealing. Optimal solutions to the financial optimization problem are obtained after a stopping criterion is set. An optimal solution may be selected according to user defined metrics, and optionally applied to a real-world system associated with the financial optimization problem.

title: Multi-level rich autosuggestions for multi-intent search query
description: Systems and methods are directed to providing multi-level rich autosuggestions for multi-intent search queries. The system receives a query prefix entered in a search box and accesses a database of machine-learning derived intent clusters. Based on the query prefix, a top-ranking machine-learning derived intent cluster is identified, and the search user interface is updated to provide a plurality of first level autosuggestions in an autosuggestion box including a smart suggestion. The smart suggestion is a first level suggestion of the top-ranking machine-learning derived intent cluster. The system receives a selection of the smart suggestion and, in response, replaces the plurality of first level autosuggestions in the autosuggestion box with second level autosuggestions. The second level autosuggestions comprise one or more intent categories that are subsets of the smart suggestion, whereby each intent category comprises a plurality of subcategory suggestions.

title: Estimation program, estimation device, and estimation method for estimating the physical quantity of a substance
description: Provided is an estimation program causing a computer to execute a process. The process includes receiving proton position information indicating a position of a proton in each of a plurality of atoms included in a first substance as an estimation target and atomic orbital information indicating an atomic orbital of an electron in each of the plurality of atoms, estimating a physical quantity of the estimation target from the proton position information and the atomic orbital information by using a machine learning model, the machine learning model being trained by using training data including information indicating a position of a proton in each of a plurality of atoms included in a second substance and information indicating an atomic orbital of an electron in each of the plurality of atoms included in the second substance, and outputting an estimation result indicating the physical quantity of the estimation target.

title: NON-DESTRUCTIVE AUTOMATIC CONTROL METHOD FOR MECHANICAL PARTS
description: The invention relates to a method and a device for non-destructive inspection of mechanical parts by inspection of images of said parts obtained by an image acquisition radiographic system. The method according to the invention comprises the following steps: - acquiring at least one real image (20) of a test piece likely to contain indications of potential defects, - performing a 2D-3D registration of a 3D model of the piece to control to estimate its 3D pose during the acquisition of the real image (20), - simulate the operating conditions of acquisition of the real image (20) from the estimated 3D pose of said part to generate a reference image (22) without defects of said part; - generating, by means of an image processing module (24), for each pixel of the real image (20) a first feature vector describing the pixel and its neighborhood and for each pixel of the reference image (22) a second feature vector, - comparing the feature vectors of each pixel of the actual image (20) with the feature vector of the corresponding pixel of the image reference (22), - deducted ire a defect map of the controlled part from the comparison of said image pixel feature vectors.

title: Predictive analysis method to fill missing data in a set of sensors
description: PREDICTIVE ANALYSIS METHOD FOR FILLING MISSING DATA IN A SET OF SENSORS Method of predictive analysis, implemented by computer, for filling missing data in a set (100) of sensors (10), in which algorithms of type gradient boosting in regression, called GBR, are executed to find an approximation of missing data for a sensor i from data available for this same sensor, the GBR algorithms also being executed to find an approximation of missing data for a sensor j from data available for other sensors with which sensor j has a correlation greater than a determined threshold; for each missing data a best approximation being chosen from a plurality of approximations on the basis of a comparison of exogenous data relating to the sensors and the measurement intervals of said sensors. Figure for the abstract: figure 1

title: Sorting a set of text documents
description: The present disclosure relates to a computer-implemented method for sorting a set of text documents. The method comprises providing a formulation of a feature. The method further comprises determining at least one new formulation of the feature by applying a generative NLP neural network. The method further comprises determining, for each document in the set and each formulation among several formulations of the feature, a text similarity value between the document and the formulation. The method further comprises sorting the documents in the set according to the similarity values. [Fig. 2]

title: Image processing apparatus, image processing system, and control method for the same
