description: First image data is transmitted to an external apparatus, and second image data generated by the external apparatus (e.g. a server) performing first image processing (e.g. complex or intensive processing such as noise reduction, high resolution processing) on the first image data is received. Local processing (e.g. simpler processing such as sensor characteristics correction processing) is also performed on the first image data, and the subsequent addition or combination (S407) amount of the second image data with the locally processed first image data is adjusted (S411) using a user interface (S410). Repeated reprocessing and transmission of the second image data by the external apparatus every time a change is requested by the user is avoided as the external processing is only performed and transmitted once, with the amount of the effect of the second image data applied when combined with the locally processed image data being adjustable.

title: Implementation of Argmax or Argmin in hardware
description: A mechanism for processing, on a hardware accelerator comprising fixed-function circuitry, data according to a neural network process that comprises a neural network with an associated argmax or argmin function. Argmax and argmin operations are operations find the index of a maximum or minimum value within a tensor (e.g. a vector or matrix). They typically find use during a pooling or unpooling procedure in convolutional neural networks. The argmax or argmin function is mapped to a set of elementary neural network operations available to the fixed-function circuitry. The neural network process is then executed using the fixed-function circuitry. The data processed using the neural network process comprises image and/or audio data.

title: Method and system for predicting collision between components of a vehicle
description: A system (210, figure 2) and a method 400 is used for predicting a collision between components of a vehicle. The method includes collecting, by a controller (208), data associated with at least two components of the vehicle from a data system 410. The method further includes extracting one or more features of the at least two components from the collected data 420, training a quantum circuit model based on the one or more features of the at least two components 450, and then predicting the collision between the at least two components via the quantum circuit model 460. A calculated maximum thickness of the collision uses the Hausdorff distance between the at least two components. Quantum bits based on scaled data are generated and form a quantum circuit in a grid lattice which transforms a tensor, corresponding to the scaled data, to a quantum tensor which is input into a neural network to train the quantum circuit model.

title: Natural expression processing method, processing and response method, device, and system
description: The present invention discloses a natural expression processing method, comprising: identifying a natural expression from a user and obtaining a certain form of language information which can be processed by a computer; and converting the identified and obtained language information to a standard expression in an encoded form. According to the natural expression processing method of the embodiments of the present invention, a natural expression is converted to an encoded standard expression; conversion to a standard expression is converting the semantics of a natural expression to encoding and parameters; precise verbatim translation is not necessary, thus the requirement for degree of accuracy of machine translation can be reduced; at the same time, the complexity of the database used for expression conversion (machine translation) is reduced, increasing data query and update speed and thus improving smart processing performance. Furthermore, the relatively simple encoded expression reduces the workload for manually-assisted interventions, increasing the efficiency of the work of manually-assisted interventions.

title: MACHINE LEARNING FOR ADDRESSING TRANSMIT (Tx) NON-LINEARITY
description: A method of wireless communication by a transmitting device transforms a transmit waveform by an encoder neural network to control power amplifier (PA) operation with respect to non-linearities. The method also transmits the transformed transmit waveform across a propagation channel. A method of wireless communication by a receiving device receives a waveform transformed by an encoder neural network. The method also recovers, with a decoder neural network, the encoder input symbols from the received waveform. A transmitting device for wireless communication calculates distortion error based on a non-distorted digital transmit waveform and a distorted digital transmit waveform. The transmitting device also compresses the distortion error with an encoder neural network of an auto-encoder. The transmitting device transmits to a receiving device the compressed distortion error to compensate for power amplifier (PA) non-linearity.

title: Real-time adaptive control of additive manufacturing processes using machine learning
description: Methods for control of post-design free form deposition processes or joining processes are described that utilize machine learning algorithms to improve fabrication outcomes. The machine learning algorithms use real-time object property data from one or more sensors as input, and are trained using training data sets that comprise: i) past process simulation data, past process characterization data, past in-process physical inspection data, or past post-build physical inspection data, for a plurality of objects that comprise at least one object that is different from the object to be fabricated; and ii) training data generated through a repetitive process of randomly choosing values for each of one or more input process control parameters and scoring adjustments to process control parameters as leading to either undesirable or desirable outcomes, the outcomes based respectively on the presence or absence of defects detected in a fabricated object arising from the process control parameter adjustments.

title: Providing device, processing device, information processing method, and program
description: A providing device is provided that includes a processing unit that enables acquisition of one or both of control information that causes artificial intelligence to function in the device and information that specifies the control information from a distributed network.

title: Diagnostic support system, diagnostic support device and diagnostic support method
description: This diagnostic support system (100) receives the learning model information (M) generated by the learning model generation unit (11) via the external network (30), and is based on the received learning model information (M). A determination unit (21) for determining the presence or absence of a disease of a patient (P2) not included in the patient group (PF) is provided.

title: Eine methode zur erkennung ungewöhnlichen verhaltens von personen in einer bank basierend auf zwei kameras
description: Die vorliegende Erfindung offenbart eine Methode zur Erkennung ungewöhnlichen Verhaltens von Personen in Banken basierend auf zwei Kameras. Diese umfasst die Anordnung von zwei Kameras in verschiedenen Winkeln innerhalb einer Bank und die Verwendung dieser beiden Kameras, um Personen innerhalb der Bank mit zwei Kameras zu filmen; die erste Kamera wird verwendet, um die erste Bildperspektive zu erfassen; die zweite Kamera wird verwendet, um die zweite Bildperspektive zu erfassen, und nach der Verarbeitung der zweiten Bildperspektive wird ein Bild aus der zweiten Perspektive erhalten, das in das Haltungskodierungsmodul eingespeist wird, um Haltungskodierungsmerkmale zu erhalten; die erhaltenen Haltungsmaskenmerkmale und Haltungskodierungsmerkmale werden in das Haltungsinteraktionsmodul eingegeben, um Haltungsinteraktionsmerkmale zu erhalten; die erhaltenen Haltungsinteraktionsmerkmale werden in das menschliche Bewegungsvorhersagemodul eingegeben, um menschliche Bewegungen zu erkennen. Das gesamte Verfahren kann ungewöhnliches Verhalten von Personen in Banken erkennen und ungewöhnliche Verhaltensweisen in Banken mit hoher Genauigkeit erkennen, was zur Sicherheit der Personen in Banken beiträgt.

title: Information recommendation method and apparatus
description: Implementations of the present application provide an information recommendation method and apparatus. In the method, a plurality of recommended information sets are determined through different recommendation algorithms based on historical behavioral information of a user (S102). A recommendation list is determined based on a weight coefficient corresponding to each recommended information set. When the recommendation list does not satisfy a predetermined recommendation condition, the weight coefficient of each recommended information set corresponding to the recommendation list is adjusted, and an adjusted recommendation list is obtained until the obtained recommendation list satisfies the predetermined recommendation condition. Then information in the recommendation list is recommended to the user. In the information recommendation method, the weight coefficient of each recommended information set does not need to be manually set, and can be automatically adjusted based on historical behavioral data of the user to obtain a recommendation list that satisfies the user's needs. Therefore, accuracy of the recommendation list can be improved, so that the user does not need to spend a lot of time searching for relevant information. In addition, network resources can be saved, and server pressure can be relieved. (Figure 1)

title: System and earphone related to transforming sensed data
description: A system of transforming sensed data is provided. The system includes an inertial sensor and a processor. The motion sensor generates a first sensed data by sensing a motion of a user. The processor connects to the inertial sensor and stores a data transform model, wherein the data transform model converts an acceleration vector and an angular velocity vector corresponding to the first sensed data to an acceleration vector and an angular velocity vector corresponding to the second sensed data, and outputs the acceleration vector and the angular velocity vector corresponding to the second sensed data to an identification model pre-stored in the processor.

title: Smart maintenance scheduling system on and method and non-transitory computer readable medium
description: The present disclosure provides a smart maintenance scheduling method, which includes steps as follows. The number of products in the future for multiple days estimate is estimated on the basis of the past machine characteristics data; the production capacity of a plurality of machines in the future for the multiple days is estimated on the basis of the production speed data and status detection of the multiple machines; the maintenance date for the recommended machine is generated automatically on the basis of the number of products for multiple days and the production capacity of the machines for the multiple days.

title: Tracking a handheld device
description: In one embodiment, a method includes accessing an image comprising a handheld device, the image being captured by one or more cameras associated with the computing device, generating a cropped image that comprises a hand of a user or the handheld device from the image by processing the image using a first machine-learning model, generating a vision-based 6DoF pose estimation for the handheld device by processing the cropped image, metadata associated with the image, and first sensor data from one or more sensors associated with the handheld device using a second machine-learning model, generating a motion-sensor-based 6DoF pose estimation for the handheld device by integrating second sensor data from the one or more sensors associated with the handheld device, and generating a final 6DoF pose estimation for the handheld device based on the vision-based 6DoF pose estimation and the motion-sensor-based 6DoF pose estimation.

title: Computing system and method of processing photonic computing results
description: The present invention relates to the field of photonic computing, which provides a computing system and a method for processing photonic computing results. The method includes generating a first optical signal that represents a first data; performing a first computing to obtain a second optical signal representing the computing result; establishing a correspondence between the theoretical mathematical result of the first computing and the second optical signal; and, storing the theoretical mathematical result and the parameters of the optical signal corresponding thereto.

title: Device for resource allocation for device-to-device (D2D) communication in wireless communication systems
description: The present invention relates to an apparatus for allocating resources for device-to-device (D2D) communication in a wireless communication system. A resource allocation apparatus for D2D communication according to the present invention includes a DNN control module for allocating resources based on DNN by a device-to-device user terminal (DUE), and a device-to-device user terminal (DUE) for allocating equal resources to each channel. Control of the DNN control module or heuristic control module, comprising a heuristic control module, an operation module that operates one of the DNN control module or heuristic control module based on a set constraint, and is operated by the operation module It is characterized in that the resource is allocated by

title: Methods of correcting gamma and display apparatus employing the same
description: The gamma correction method includes generating a representative panel model by performing deep learning based on luminance factors and a representative display panel, and performing transfer learning based on the representative panel model and the display panel. Generating a panel model, and determining a grayscale voltage for the display panel based on the panel model.

title: Neural network processing device, information processing device, information processing system, electronic device, neural network processing method and program
description: Reduce the amount of memory. The neural network processing device is a zero-coefficient position table representing a position of a first coefficient whose value is zero in a coefficient matrix as a first value and a position of a second coefficient whose value is not zero in the coefficient matrix as a second value. and a decoding unit 41 that decodes the coefficient matrix encoded in the non-zero coefficient table holding the second coefficient in the coefficient matrix, and convolution of the coefficient matrix decoded by the decoding unit and the variable matrix a multiplication circuit (116) that performs processing, wherein the decoding unit stores the second coefficient stored in the non-zero coefficient table at a position indicated by the second value in the zero coefficient position table; decode matrix

title: Display panel and display device including the same
description: The display panel includes a pixel array including a plurality of pixels connected to scan lines and data lines, an optical synaptic block including a plurality of optical synaptic elements, and a plurality of neuron elements electrically connected to the optical synaptic elements. It may include a neuron block that

title: Method and apparatus for scheduling in communication system
description: A scheduling technology in a communication system is disclosed. An operating method of a communication node in a communication system comprises the following steps of: scheduling a plurality of resource blocks of a time slot unit by a resource block unit; obtaining experience information about the plurality of resource blocks of the time slot unit; decomposing the experience information to generate decomposition experience information of each resource block; and learning the decomposition experience information for progressive scheduling.

title: Apparatus and method for life prediction of fuel cell
description: A fuel cell life prediction device according to an embodiment of the present invention may include a control part that generates an expected output graph after using a fuel cell stack for a predetermined period of time, and calculates the remaining usage amount of the fuel cell stack based on the real-time output graph generated during use of the fuel cell stack and the expected output graph. Therefore, it is possible to provide power according to the power requirements of a drivetrain in a RUL (Remaining Useful Life) method optimized for industrial vehicles.

title: microfluidic droplet jet status monitoring apparatus based on deep learning and the method thereof
description: One embodiment of the present invention provides a deep learning-based microfluidic droplet jet status monitoring apparatus and a method thereof. In order to monitor a jet status of microfluidic droplets by applying deep learning to a microfluidic droplet class classification issue of a microfluidic droplet discharging device, the apparatus receives microfluidic droplet image frames capturing a microfluidic droplet jet status; applies a deep-trained microfluidic droplet image frame classification algorithm to conduct classification according to a droplet class of microfluidic droplets; groups the same into a group of microfluidic droplet image frames during a unit microfluidic droplet jet time; and evaluates the microfluidic droplet jet status according to the class of microfluidic droplets contained in the microfluidic droplet image frame group during the unit microfluidic droplet jet time.

title: Depth map image generation method and computing device therefor
description: A computing device according to one technical aspect of the present application includes a memory for storing one or more instructions and a processor for executing the one or more instructions stored in the memory, wherein the processor executes the one or more instructions, thereby generating a neural network An estimated depth map image for the training RGB image is generated using , and the training depth map image calculated based on the spherical transformation, wherein the training depth map image matches the training RGB image and has depth information, and the estimation The neural network is trained based on differences between depth map images.

title: Method And Apparatus for Evaluating Work
description: A work evaluation method and apparatus are disclosed. The present embodiment provides a work evaluation method and apparatus for giving incentives in tokens based on the results of evaluating work performance among colleagues who take over and perform the same work according to the IT industry-specific work style and mutual cooperation method (e.g., a cyclical method where the order and outcome of work is unclear). The apparatus includes: a work selection part; a collaborative personnel selection part; a performance evaluation part; an incentive personnel selection part; and a token payment part.

title: Exercise posture evaluation method
description: A method for evaluating a user's exercise posture according to an embodiment of the present invention includes extracting a two-dimensional skeleton of the user from an exercise image of the user; generating a three-dimensional skeleton of the user from the two-dimensional skeleton of the user; and calculating a posture similar to the user's 3D skeleton among one or more postures according to the type of exercise the user is performing and a degree of similarity between the user's 3D skeleton and the similar posture.

title: Method and apparatus for creating character guidebook automatically
description: In the method of automatically generating a character guidebook according to a first embodiment of the present invention, a) receiving character information including a character image and character name for a specific character from a user terminal; b) generating a product mock-up image in which the character is combined with an image of a specific product based on the character information; c) generating a character guidebook including the character information and the product mock-up image and providing the character guidebook to be displayed on the user terminal.

title: Optimal control method of HVAC systems based on machine learning models
description: A machine learning model-based heat source air conditioning equipment optimization drive control system according to an embodiment of the present invention is provided. The machine learning model-based heat source air conditioning equipment optimization operation control system includes a database unit that stores past data on the operating status of heat source air conditioning equipment including cold and hot water units and air conditioning equipment, outdoor temperature, indoor temperature, and outlet temperature of the cold and hot water unit; A first learning unit that learns the outdoor temperature over time and learns a first model that predicts the outdoor temperature the next day and past data stored in the database unit are set as input values, and the operating state of the heat source air conditioning equipment is set as an output value. A second learning unit that trains a second model, wherein the second learning unit includes the next day's outdoor temperature predicted by the first learning unit, time, a set temperature and set time set by the user, indoor temperature, and the hot and cold water. The startup time or stop time of the heat source air conditioning facility is extracted using the outlet temperature of the unit as an input value.

title: Machine learning method using caching data, computing device and recording medium implementing the same method
description: The present invention relates to a learning method of a neural network model. The learning method through lifecycle-based data according to the present invention includes the steps of: receiving first data and second data for which the lifecycle of the data is determined as learning data; training a neural network model using the input learning data; and evaluating the performance of the trained neural network model, wherein the second data is preferably generated or deleted according to the lifecycle. According to the present invention, the performance of the neural network model for a service environment can be increased by using data used for actual services for learning.

title: System and method for intelligent industrial safety monitoring
description: An intelligent industrial safety monitoring system is provided. The system includes a global monitoring unit that generates first monitoring information that globally monitors the work area of an industrial site, and a second monitoring unit that is attached to a work object being worked on in the work area and monitors the surrounding area of the work object. A local monitoring unit that generates information, a communication unit that transmits and receives data with the global monitoring unit and the local monitoring unit, and a first control unit that generates location information and tracks the movement path of the work object based on the first monitoring information, and at least one second control unit that predicts a dangerous object within a predetermined distance of the work object based on second monitoring information.

title: Apparatus, method, and recording medium for improving multi-view image quality restored from a 3d mesh model
description: The present invention relates to a method, an apparatus, and a recording medium for improving image quality of a multi-view image. the method for improving image quality of a multi-view image of the present invention comprises the steps of: obtaining a reconstructed multi-view image by rendering a reconstructed texture map image; and obtaining an image-improved multi-view image through a multi-view image enhancement network based on the reconstructed multi-view image and additional information. the additional information may include a mesh surface area, a depth information hole, and edge information.

title: Electronic device and method of providing recommended contents
description: An electronic device according to various embodiments of the present disclosure collects time-dependent location information of the first user for a predetermined period from the terminal device of the first user, and collects time-dependent location information of the first user during the predetermined period. Based on location information over time, at least one movement pattern of the first user is analyzed, current location information of the first user is collected from the terminal device of the first user, and current location information of the first user is collected. Based on location information and the current time, determine a current movement pattern among the at least one movement pattern, and determine recommended content for the first user among the plurality of contents based on the current movement pattern, It may be configured to transmit the determined recommended content to the terminal device of the first user.

title: Positioning method based on fingerprinting in millimeter wave small cell environment
description: The present invention relates to a fingerprinting-based positioning method in a millimeter wave small cell environment applicable to the fields of wireless communication and positioning.  A fingerprinting-based positioning method in a millimeter wave small cell environment according to the present invention comprises the steps of (a) setting a reference point for fingerprinting-based positioning in a millimeter wave small cell environment, (b) performing beam sweeping in the millimeter wave small cell environment, measuring RSRP and collecting beam pair angles, and (c) performing fingerprinting data learning.

title: Ai-based transmission diagnostic method and diagnostic device
description: According to one embodiment, an AI-based transmission diagnosis method includes the steps of collecting vehicle information and shift data of a vehicle, preprocessing and labeling the shift data, generating a candidate feature set list including a plurality of candidate feature sets satisfying specific criteria from among feature sets stored in a database, diagnosing a shift feel of the shift data using supervised learning-based AI based on the plurality of candidate feature sets and calculating an evaluation index, and selecting a candidate feature set with the highest value among candidate feature sets having the calculated evaluation index above a specific level, determining it as a feature set of the vehicle, and storing it in the database.

title: Semiconductor device for performing light-based computation and operation method of semiconductor device
description: The semiconductor device may include a color filter array; an optical synapse array including a plurality of light passageways for transmitting light incident through the color filter array with independently controlled transmittances; and an optical-to-digital conversion circuit for converting light transmitted through the plurality of light passageways into digital data.

title: Method for devoloping prognostics and health management system for aircraft, utylizing 4th industrial technology based on the data stored in flight recording devices
description: The present invention comprises: a data input step of inputting flight operation-related parameter data collected from an aircraft; a data preprocessing step of classifying the flight operation-related parameter data input in the data input step into fault influence parameter data and fault indication parameter data for expected faults by aircraft configuration system; a step of integrating a plurality of neural network (ANN/AI) modules generated by each configuration system of the aircraft based on the fault influence parameter data and the fault indication parameter data by equipment and system classified through the data preprocessing step; a data reproduction step of inputting first fault influence parameter data for predicting and managing the health of the aircraft into the plurality of neural network (ANN/AI) modules to reproduce the first fault indication parameter data; a data comparison analysis step of diagnosing the condition of the aircraft by comparing the first fault indication parameter data reproduced in the data reproduction step with second fault indication parameter data, which is actual flight operation-related parameter data of the aircraft requiring condition diagnosis; The present invention provides a method for developing a system for predicting and managing the health of an aircraft, including a health prediction and evaluation step for predicting the remaining life by evaluating the degree of deterioration of each component system of the aircraft based on the difference between the first defect indication parameter data and the second defect indication parameter data.

title: Method for diagnosing a vehicle based on cutomized reference values and system therfor
description: According to some embodiments of the present disclosure, a vehicle diagnostic method performed in a vehicle including an electric motor is provided. An exemplary vehicle diagnostic method may include a step of obtaining first to third measurement values for temperature, voltage, and current of an electric motor from one or more sensors installed for the electric motor; a measurement value storage step; a reference value adjustment step of analyzing a set of temperature measurement values, a set of voltage measurement values, and a set of current measurement values, respectively, and performing adjustment on at least one of a first partial reference value, a second partial reference value, and a third partial reference value stored in a database; an adjustment reference value storage step; a comprehensive diagnosis score calculation step of calculating a comprehensive diagnosis score based on the first to third measurement values and the adjusted partial reference values; and a failure diagnosis step of diagnosing whether the vehicle is faulty based on the comprehensive diagnosis score.

title: Neural processor and method for assigning config ID for neural core included in the same
description: The present invention discloses a neural processor. According to some embodiments, the neural processor includes a core array including a first neural core, a second neural core, a first data line connecting the first neural core and the second neural core in series, and a configuration line connecting the first neural core and the second neural core in series, an ID configuration manager assigning a first configuration ID to the first neural core and a second configuration ID to the second neural core through the configuration line, and a memory inputting and outputting data to and from the core array through the first data line.

title: Machine learning apparatus and method for large language model on civil service
description: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a learning device for a large language model for civil affairs work includes a communication circuit configured to communicate with the outside, a memory storing a language model and a regression model, and a processor electrically connected to the communication circuit and the memory, wherein the processor obtains a query related to a civil affairs work to a public institution and an answer corresponding to the query using the communication circuit, obtains meta information including at least a part of institution information and regional information associated with the query and the answer using the communication circuit, performs unsupervised learning of the language model by inputting an answer to the language model to learn a style of a result text generated by the language model, and after the unsupervised learning is completed, performs supervised learning of the language model for fine tuning so that an answer is output when a query and meta information are input to the language model, and after the supervised learning is completed, performs reinforcement learning of the language model using an evaluation score for a result text generated by the language model when a query and meta information are input and a result text output by the regression model, and performs machine learning for the regression model using the result text, the result score produced by the regression model when the result text is input, and an externally input score for the result text. You can perform learning.

title: Information processing device, machine learning device, information processing method and machine learning method
description: The present invention relates to an information processing device, a machine learning device, an information processing method, and a machine learning method. An information processing device (5) comprises a substrate processing device having a processing member that performs a predetermined substrate processing by bringing the member into contact with a substrate, and a processing fluid supply unit that supplies a processing fluid to the substrate or the processing member, wherein the information processing device comprises a fluid supply information acquisition unit (500) that acquires fluid supply information including processing fluid state information indicating a supply state of processing fluid supplied from a processing fluid supply unit, and a fluid dispersion information generation unit (501) that generates fluid dispersion information indicating a dispersion state when the processing fluid supplied from the processing fluid supply unit is dispersed while passing through a contact position between the substrate and the processing member based on the fluid supply information acquired by the fluid supply information acquisition unit (500).

title: Entity linking method and device, computer device and storage medium
description: In embodiments of the present application, an entity linking method and apparatus, a computer device and a storage medium are disclosed. The method in embodiments of the present application includes: acquiring text content including reference text content and explanatory text content describing the reference text content; performing a search process on at least one preset entity content according to the explanatory text content of the reference text content, to acquire at least one candidate entity content corresponding to the reference text content; performing a content filling process on first screening template content according to the reference text content, to acquire second screening template content; performing a content fusion process on the explanatory text content, at least one candidate entity content, and the second screening template content, to acquire fused text content; and performing a screening process on at least one candidate entity content according to the fused text content, to acquire a target entity content corresponding to the reference text content.

title: Electronic apparatus and the controlling method thereof detecting user's gait and performing user authentication
description: An electronic device and a control method thereof are disclosed. The control method of the electronic device according to the present disclosure may include a step of obtaining acceleration information of the electronic device corresponding to the user's gait through an acceleration sensor; a step of obtaining angular velocity information of the electronic device corresponding to the user's gait through an angular velocity sensor; a step of obtaining gait pattern information of the user based on the acceleration information and the angular velocity information; a step of inputting the obtained gait pattern information into a gait analysis model learned based on the gait learning information of a previously registered user, and identifying whether the obtained gait pattern matches the gait pattern of the previously registered user; and a step of approving user access authority if the gait pattern matches the gait pattern of the previously registered user.

title: Deep learning-based malware detection and removal system and malware detection and removal method to strengthen the security of IoT devices
description: The present invention relates to a deep learning-based malware detection and removal system and a malware detection and removal method for enhancing the security of IoT devices, which classify normal code and malware using a CNN algorithm. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a deep learning-based malware detection and removal system and a malware detection and removal method for enhancing the security of IoT devices, which implements a CNN-based algorithm to automatically classify whether a file received by an IoT device is normal code or malware, and automatically deletes the file if it is classified as a malware file.

title: Method for generating facial image with controllable gaze direction and apparatus using the same
description: A method for generating a face image capable of controlling the direction of gaze and a device therefor are disclosed. In one embodiment of the present invention, a method for generating a face image capable of controlling the direction of gaze includes: preprocessing a gaze direction corresponding to an actual face image into a latent vector randomly extracted from a latent space and inputting the preprocessed result into a mapping network; inputting an i*j-dimensional intermediate vector output from the mapping network and a CONST value randomly extracted from the latent space into a generator network of a generative adversarial neural network to generate a virtual face image; inputting the virtual face image into a discriminator network of the generative adversarial neural network to measure the difference in gaze directions between the actual face image and the virtual face image, and backpropagating the difference in gaze directions to update the parameters of all networks.

title: Method for monitoring the performance of artificial intelligence models and appatratus thereof
description: The present disclosure relates to an artificial intelligence performance monitoring technology, and provides an artificial intelligence model performance monitoring device and method, including a first anomaly detection unit that stores input data received from a database for a preset period of time to generate statistical information and compares the statistical information with preset reference statistical information to detect whether an abnormality has occurred in the input data, a second anomaly detection unit that inputs the input data into a preset anomaly detection model and detects whether an abnormality has occurred in the input data based on an output value of the anomaly detection model, and a third anomaly detection unit that inputs the input data into a preset artificial intelligence model and detects whether an abnormality has occurred in the artificial intelligence model using output data of the artificial intelligence model.

title: Hr management system that creates customized interview questions based on resumes
description: A method and a device for recommending resumes using an artificial intelligence algorithm are disclosed. According to one embodiment of the present disclosure, a method for recommending resumes using an artificial intelligence algorithm, performed by a device, comprises: a step of receiving a plurality of resume files; a step of identifying text data for each of a plurality of evaluation items written in each of the plurality of resume files; a step of inputting the identified text data for each of the plurality of evaluation items into an artificial intelligence (AI) model to obtain evaluation scores for the plurality of evaluation items; a step of obtaining a final score corresponding to the plurality of resumes based on the evaluation scores for the plurality of evaluation items; a step of providing a first message recommending at least one applicant corresponding to at least one resume having a final score exceeding a threshold value among the plurality of resumes, wherein the AI model may include a first artificial neural network trained to output a plurality of embedding vectors corresponding to the intent of texts for each of the plurality of evaluation items and a second artificial neural network trained to produce evaluation scores corresponding to texts for each of the plurality of evaluation items.

title: A substrate processing device, an estimation method, a method for generating learning data, a learning method, a learning device, a method for generating a model for which learning has been completed, and a model for which learning has been completed
description: A substrate processing device (100) comprises a processing chamber (11), a first processing sensor (50), and a first control unit (102). The first processing sensor (50) detects at least one of wind speed and wind direction at a first position during processing within the processing chamber (11) or around the processing chamber (11). The first control unit (102) inputs the detection result of the first processing sensor (50) into a model (M) for which learning has been completed, and acquires at least one of an estimated wind speed and an estimated wind direction at a second position during processing. The model (M) for which learning has been completed is generated by machine learning based on the first detection result of the first learning sensor (50L) at the first position during learning and the second detection result of the second learning sensor (60L) at the second position during learning.

title: Development of AI algorithm to predict logistics costs and transportation schedules for forwarding business
description: The present invention relates to an algorithm for predicting the cost and schedule of import/export cargo transportation, and is a very useful invention that records the cost and schedule of import/export cargo received from customers in a database, and uses various stored internal (invoice/freight/schedule) and external (port/weather/oil price) data to quickly and accurately calculate estimates in an automated manner using an AI model rather than the existing cost and schedule calculation method that relies on the experience of a person in charge, thereby increasing customer trust and operating profit rate.

title: System and method for teaching online video production process using artificial intelligence
description: The present invention relates to an online video production education system and method using artificial intelligence, and includes a user terminal recruitment unit, a planning process education unit that educates a process of generating script information through the recruited user terminal, a shooting process education unit that educates a process of generating image information, audio information, and background music information corresponding to the script information, an editing process education unit that educates a process of editing image information, audio information, and background music information corresponding to an input keyword to produce video data, and a sharing process education unit that educates a process of uploading the generated video data to one or more video sharing platforms and then sharing it.

title: Electronic device supporting online training of neural network for wireless communication and operating method thereof
description: According to one embodiment, an electronic device may be provided, including a plurality of antennas, at least one processor, and a memory storing at least one instruction. The at least one processor may be configured to receive a signal from an external electronic device through at least one of the plurality of antennas. The at least one processor may be configured to determine whether information associated with a characteristic of a wireless communication channel identified from the received signal satisfies a condition for verifying the reliability of training data. The at least one processor may be configured to perform online learning of an artificial neural network for estimating a characteristic of a wireless communication channel corresponding to a cell using the information associated with the characteristic of the wireless communication channel based on determining that the information associated with the characteristic of the wireless communication channel satisfies the condition. The at least one processor may be configured to input a signal received through at least some of the plurality of antennas into the artificial neural network based on online learning, thereby estimating the characteristic of the wireless communication channel based on information output from the artificial neural network based on online learning.

title: Apparatus for inspecting defects in welds based on Radiographic Test and method therefor
description: A method for inspecting a defect in a weld includes a step of evaluating the quality of a radiographic image according to the number of wires of a penetrameter, a step of performing image processing to highlight the characteristics of a defect in a weld in a reading area when the quality of the radiographic image satisfies a preset standard, a step of detecting a defect in the weld in the reading area, and a step of outputting a defect report including a defect location, a defect area, and a defect type according to the detected defect.

title: System and method for providing respiratory rehabilitation service according to respiratory diseases
description: According to the present disclosure, a respiratory rehabilitation service system and a service providing method are provided. The system may include: a voice information acquisition unit configured to acquire voice information about a user's breathing input from a user terminal; a flow-volume information acquisition unit configured to acquire the user's flow-volume information based on the voice information; a respiratory rehabilitation goal setting unit configured to determine a respiratory rehabilitation exercise goal based on the flow-volume information; and an exercise information providing unit configured to provide respiratory rehabilitation exercise information according to the respiratory rehabilitation exercise goal to the user terminal.  According to the present disclosure, there is an effect in that the user's respiratory condition can be analyzed and respiratory rehabilitation-related services can be provided through a mobile application without the need to visit a hospital in person to perform a pulmonary function test.

title: Method for performing defect inspection using multiple domain data
description: According to one embodiment of the present disclosure, a method for performing defect inspection using a neural network model, which is performed by one or more processors of a computing device, is disclosed. The method may include the steps of: acquiring a plurality of input data having different domains; preprocessing first input data associated with a non-visual domain among the plurality of input data; acquiring first learning data based on second input data associated with a visual domain among the plurality of input data and the preprocessed first input data; and training a neural network model for performing defect inspection based on the first learning data.

title: Ai based job matching method and apparatus
description: A job matching method according to the present invention comprises an input step of receiving job matching information from a worker, an extraction step of extracting one or more work sites based on the job matching information, an acquisition step of obtaining weather information for the one or more work sites, a prediction step of predicting the worker's attendance probability for the one or more work sites based on the weather information, and a determination step of determining a work site and work date to be matched with the worker based on the attendance probability. The job matching method and device according to the present invention utilize an attendance rate prediction model that takes into account environmental conditions such as weather and climate, thereby improving worker attendance rates and ensuring worker retention for recruiting companies. Furthermore, since job matching is performed based on the worker's skills and experience, the worker is matched with more appropriate jobs and can build his or her career. Accordingly, the labor shortage problem in the construction industry can be resolved, providing benefits to both workers and recruiting companies.

title: System and method for an under-display lensless camera
description: A system and method are described that can increase the screen-to-body ratio of a device by positioning a lensless camera equipped with an image sensor and a mask behind a display screen of the device. The image sensor captures an image based on light passing through the display screen and the mask. The display screen may include a light-transmitting portion between pixel elements. The mask may include a pattern, such as an opaque material, that allows light to pass from a portion of the display layer to the image sensor. The image captured by the image sensor may be difficult for a human to recognize. The system utilizes a trained machine learning model to reconstruct the image using data about the pattern of the mask, thereby enabling a human to visually recognize features in the image.

title: Electronic device, method, and non-transitory computer readable storage medium for associating content and user input
description: An electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device can display, through a display, a first text summarizing text data representing audio data and a second text representing the contents of a document, according to a split view. The electronic device can identify an input for a word in the second text. The electronic device can display, based on identifying an utterance corresponding to the word identified according to the input among utterances in the text data representing the audio data and identifying at least one word in the first text summarizing the utterance, the at least one word visually highlighted in the first text while displaying the word visually highlighted in the second text according to the input.

title: AI-based automated railway signal interlocking test machine and test method using it
description: The present invention relates to a railway signal electronic IT-based linkage inspection tester, and more specifically, to a railway signal electronic IT-based linkage inspection tester that standardizes the test procedure and performs it as an automated system to automate linkage testing using an unmanned autonomous driving device and an intelligent sensor, thereby eliminating deviations due to the tester's ability or skill level and always guaranteeing consistent quality.

title: Method And Apparatus for Generating Quantum Library
description: It relates to a method and device for creating a quantum library.  According to one aspect of the present disclosure, a method for generating a quantum library is provided, including: a process of generating a first code capable of implementing a quantum circuit using a programming language; a process of translating the first code into assembly language to generate a second code; a process of verifying the quantum circuit using the second code; a process of generating a function using at least one of the first code and the second code; and a process of generating a quantum library using the function.

title: Electronic device, method, and non-transitory computer readable storage medium for sharing content
description: An electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device can receive a user input for sharing information included in content. Based on the user input received, the electronic device can display a visual object representing a plurality of applications through a display. After displaying the visual object, the electronic device can receive another user input for selecting an application among the plurality of applications with which to share the information. Based on the other user input received, the electronic device can generate data to be displayed on the display through the application based on information about the application and the information included in the content.

title: Reinforcement learning-based autonomous driving system capable of adapting to dynamic environmental changes and operation method thereof
description: According to an embodiment of the present application, an operating method of an autonomous driving system based on reinforcement learning capable of responding to dynamic environmental changes is provided. The method may include: acquiring point cloud data corresponding to driving environment information through at least one sensor unit; generating a three-dimensional point cloud map based on the point cloud data by a map generation module; extracting driving environment features from the three-dimensional point cloud map by a feature extraction module including a neural network; determining a driving operation of a mobile device based on the driving environment features by a reinforcement learning module; and evaluating, by the reinforcement learning module, whether the driving operation is successful and providing a reward based on a state of the mobile device after performing the driving operation.

title: System for revelance criteria management of actions and values in a rete network
description: A method for programming a computer, and software products for implementing the method, are disclosed. According to the method, objects are created which, upon execution of the system, may initiate actions and may acquire values. A specification of relevance criteria is stored as an attribute of each object. Relevance criteria, which may refer to the values of other objects, describe all conditions necessary and sufficient to make the binary decision for whether the object will be considered relevant to the program's operation during execution. Action criteria may also be specified to control the actions of a relevant object. The method is particularly well suited for programming expert systems, but may be used for programming any type of computer program.

title: Arrangements for forming three-dimensional structures, and related methods thereof.
description: Modalities refer to a method of forming a three-dimensional structure. The method includes determining one or more locations for placing a sensing device based on structural coordinate information related to a three-dimensional structure to be formed. The method further includes forming a portion of the three-dimensional structure based on the structural coordinate information. The method further includes placing the detection device at a location of the one or more locations.

title: INTELLIGENT MONITORING SYSTEM FOR MINERAL LOADING PROCESS
description: The "GET smart" system uses AI modeling and neural network technology to efficiently identify wear part loss events and provide other useful metrics during excavator operation to improve efficiency and reduce downtime. The system monitors the integrity of ground contact tools (GET) by multidimensional sensors, determines regions of interest, and creates and processes rich tensors through integrated systems with a combination of CPU and TPU. The system also determines the level of wear of the GET, the volume of minerals per blade and the average size of the particles.

title: CONTACT MANAGEMENT SYSTEM FOR PERSONAL, EDUCATION, STORE AND BUSINESS CONTENT
description: The invention relates to an AI-based communication management system for personal, educational, retail, and business content, which facilitates education, work, and communication in users' preferred language by uploading information to their smartphone or computer operating systems in voice and/or text format, creating a modern social network. In this system, users can easily manage their time by swiping their phone screen in a specific direction or clicking on their preferred section to communicate with friends and acquaintances, receive training in a specific and selected field(s), and purchase updates and relevant business information.

title: Method and system of ranking of a variety of documents on the page of search results
description: FIELD: information technology.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to a method and server for ranking a plurality of documents on a search result page (SERP). Method performs a calculation using a machine learning algorithm (MLA), ranking estimates for each document from a variety of documents indicating the calculated relevance of the relevant document to the request and the original rank of the corresponding document in the SERP, calculating the class communication score for each document from a variety of documents, which is the probability of the corresponding document being associated with a predetermined document class and used when increasing the level of change in the original rank of the relevant document, which is the difference between the original and the changed document rank, calculating a modified ranking estimate for each document from a plurality of documents based on a corresponding ranking estimate and a corresponding class relationship estimate indicating the modified relevance of the corresponding document to the request, and initiating a SERP mapping with documents that were ranked based on the corresponding modified ranking score.EFFECT: technical result is to increase the efficiency of the ranking of the documents found.20 cl, 13 dwg

title: Storage medium, robot, information processing device and electronic pet system
description: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a realistic electronic pet by employing various devices. SOLUTION: An IC card 21 stores internal condition parameters including the feeling of an electronic pet. If the pet starts an action based on the parameters, the card 21 stores the updated items in accordance with the action. The card 21 is freely attachable and detachable to the device which functions as the body of the pet. A virtual pet device 22 conducts the processes to display the pet which functions as the body of the pet. The device 22 has a slot 22A through which the card 21 is freely attachable and detachable. A pet type robot 23 functions as the body of the pet and has a slot 23A through which the card 21 is freely attachable and detachable.

title: Methods for predicting age-or developmental stage-appropriate foods for children
description: The present disclosure provides methods for classifying food products and predicting appropriate ages and/or developmental stages that children should be provided with certain food products. In an embodiment, the methods include an analysis that use the measurements of key texture attributes by a mouth simulation machine to predict the minimum age and/or developmental stage of food products. Using the methods of the present disclosure, classification of food products can be directed during early product development. Additionally, the methods of the present disclosure have generated an understanding of which key texture attributes differentiate appropriate products across developmental stages.

title: E-commerce ontology construction method
description: The invention relates to the technical field of semantic recognition, in particular to a method for constructing an e-commerce ontology. The E-commerce ontology construction method comprises the following steps: establishing a candidate word set comprising a plurality of candidate words by adjusting and analyzing the spatial probability distribution of a question and answer corpus, a daily corpus and a commodity corpus; screening the candidate words to construct an ontology concept set comprising a plurality of ontology concepts; carrying out statistical analysis on the probability of common occurrence of any two ontology concepts in the same session so as to establish an association rule between the ontology concepts; performing hierarchical clustering analysis on the plurality of ontology concepts to establish a hierarchical relationship tree among the ontology concepts; and establishing the E-commerce ontology according to the ontology concept set, the association rule and the hierarchical relationship tree. The invention constructs a highly-targeted E-commerce domain ontology and solves the problem of low semantic recognition accuracy in the process of conversation between E-commerce intelligent customer service and customers in the prior art.

title: Method and System for Calculating Quantitative Indicators for Evaluating Myocardial Involvement in Patients with SLE
description: The present invention discloses a method and system for calculating quantitative indicators for evaluating myocardial involvement in patients with SLE. The method includes the following steps: pre-processing original T1 mapping image data and original CINE image data of hearts of patients with SLE to obtain pre-processed T1 mapping image data and pre-processed CINE image data; inputting the pre-processed T1 mapping image data into a pre-trained T1 mapping image feature extraction model to extract T1 mapping image features, and inputting the pre-processed CINE image data into a pre-trained CINE image feature extraction model to extract CINE image features; and calculating, based on the T1 mapping image features and the CINE image features, a plurality of quantitative indicators for evaluating myocardial involvement in patients with SLE. The quantitative indicators for evaluating myocardial involvement in patients with SLE are calculated by deep learning technology through non-enhanced T1 mapping images and CINE images.

title: Feedback lid for spam avoidance.
description: The present invention provides a feedback loop system and method which facilitates classification of elements associated with spam blocking in server-based and / or client-based architectures. The invention uses an automatic learning method that is applied to spam filters and specifically selects incoming emails randomly, so that examples of both legitimate email and spam / spam are used to generate sets of training data. Users identified as spam fighters ask to rate whether a selection of their incoming emails is either legitimate or spam. A database stores the properties of each record and rating transaction such as user information, message properties and summary of content, as well as query results for each message to generate training data for automatic learning systems. The automatic learning systems make it easier to build improved spam filters that are trained to recognize both legitimate and spam, and to distinguish between them.

title: Modeling hydrocarbon phase behavior for synthetic reservoir simulation
description: Methods and systems for hydrocarbon phase behavior modeling for compositional reservoir simulation, the methods and systems configured for estimating phase properties of a hydrocarbon sample based on a mole-fraction weighted mixing rule; determining contributions of individual phase components to the mole-fraction weighted phase properties; generating input data for a machine learning model including a first sub-network and a second sub-network, the input data including the contributions from the phase properties; generating, based on processing the input data using the first sub-network of the machine learning model, probability values for each potential phase state; processing the probability values and input data by the second sub-network of the machine learning model; and generating, by the second sub-network, output data including equilibrium K-values, vapor fraction, vapor compressibility, and liquid compressibility for the hydrocarbon sample. Fig 1.

title: Deep memory convolutional neural network device and construction method thereof
description: The invention relates to the field of learning-based neural networks, in particular to a structure of a deep memory convolutional neural network and a construction method thereof. The network structure of the invention includes three parts: a five convolution layer containing a clustered dimensionality reduction convolutional neural network structure; a deep memory neural network structure; and a BP network structure; the invention also relates to a construction method of the network structure. The present invention can overcome the shortcomings of the representation ability of complex functions in the case of limited samples and computing units to a certain extent, and improve the efficiency of the existing convolutional neural network.

title: Predictive method and system for structural repair during aircraft overhaul
description: A predictive method and system for structural repair during aircraft overhaul. Hybrid feature selection methods include methods for creating predictive models for structural repair during overhaul of a fleet of aircraft. The method includes preselecting a preselected data set of fatigue-related parameters calculated from data collected during a first set of flights of a first aircraft undergoing replacement of a structural component during an overhaul. The method includes receiving a preselected selection of fatigue-related parameters, and validating a validation data set of the preselected selection of fatigue-related parameters calculated from data collected during a second set of flights of a second aircraft that underwent overhaul without Replace structural components. The method includes receiving a set of fatigue-related parameters and using a training data set of validated and preselected fatigue-related parameters calculated from data collected during additional flights to build a predictive model for structural repair during an overhaul.

title: An energy-saving control method and system for air conditioning based on crowd density perception model
description: This invention discloses an air conditioning energy-saving control method and system based on a crowd density perception model, comprising the following steps: Step S1: Establishing a crowd density perception model based on deep learning; Step S2: Transmitting video stream data from surveillance cameras in each area to a server; Step S3: The server analyzes and processes all video stream data using the crowd density perception model to obtain the number of people; Step S4: The system generates corresponding control signals based on the number of people; Step S5: Transmitting the control signals back to the air conditioners in each corresponding area, adjusting the on/off state, temperature, and fan speed of the air conditioners in each area in real time, so that the air conditioners in each area can intelligently adjust according to the crowd distribution, maximizing air conditioning efficiency and significantly reducing energy waste. This invention intelligently adjusts according to crowd distribution, maximizing air conditioning efficiency and significantly reducing energy waste.

title: Character string verification method, character string expansion method and verification model training method
description: The invention provides a character string verification method, a character string expansion method and a verification model training method, wherein the character string verification method comprises the following steps: a name string to be verified is captured. And generating a character string to be inquired according to the character string of the name to be checked. And obtaining at least one return character string by using an automatic vocabulary recommending function on the character string to be queried. At least one piece of feature data is extracted from the at least one return string. And judging the classification of the name character string to be verified according to the at least one piece of feature data and a verification model.

title: A product classification method fused with attention map
description: The invention discloses a commodity classification method integrating attention diagrams. Collecting a clear and complete commodity front photo as a template image, expanding to obtain a training image, matching the training image with the template image to obtain an attention map, superposing RGB (red, green and blue) three channels and the attention map to form four channels to form training data, training to obtain an image classification model, inputting the four channels of data of the commodity image to be classified into the image classification model, and obtaining the prediction classification and the corresponding score of the commodity image to be classified. According to the method, attention which can amplify the influence of the fine features of the commodity pattern on the classification model and inhibit the non-significant features of the pattern is utilized to try to participate in training, and the accuracy of commodity image classification is improved.

title: Image processing method, device and storage medium
description: The invention discloses an image processing method, a device and a storage medium, which belong to the technical field of image processing. The method includes: discretizing the original image to obtain a discrete-valued image; determining at least one connected domain from the discrete-valued image according to the discrete value of each grid; The eigenvalues of each grid are pooled for each connected domain, and the pooling calculation result on each connected domain is obtained; according to the pooling calculation results on all connected domains, the pooling calculation result for the original image is determined. According to the discrete value of each grid and the positional relationship between the grids, the present invention determines at least one connected domain from the discrete value image. Since each pixel point on the connected domain has a certain correlation, the pooling calculation result is more accurate. Accurate, further improving the accuracy of the image recognition model trained based on the pooling results.

title: A kind of face identification method based on deep learning under real scene
description: The present invention provides the face identification method based on deep learning under a kind of real scene, it is that single factors influence can only be solved for the face identification method solved under existing real scene, it is proposed without can solve the influence of the factors such as posture, illumination, it include: to predict the face location of each picture in tranining database using an existing human-face detector, and intercept and save true face and inhuman face image；Corresponding low-resolution image is obtained according to facial image and non-face picture are down-sampled；Building generates confrontation network, and generating confrontation network includes generator and discriminator；Generator further comprises up-sampling network and optimization network；It is trained using high-resolution human face, inhuman face image and corresponding low resolution face, inhuman face image to confrontation network is generated；Mark the position of face in input picture to the score from the face candidate region that existing human-face detector obtains according to discriminator.The present invention is suitable for the recognition detection of face.

title: Interference signal identification method based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of wireless communication, and particularly relates to an interference signal identification method based on a convolutional neural network. The method mainly comprises the steps of constructing a convolutional neural network; preprocessing the received interference signal, and taking the preprocessed interference signal as an input sample of a convolutional neural network; constructing a signal sample and a corresponding category thereof as a training set according to the category of a signal to be identified, and training the constructed convolutional neural network by using the constructed training set; and according to the trained convolutional neural network, identifying each preprocessed signal sample to obtain the class of the unknown signal. The method has the advantages that the convolutional neural network is used for identifying the interference signals, the defect that the traditional method needs to artificially extract the characteristics of the interference signals for classification and identification is overcome, the universality and the flexibility are realized on the identification of the interference signals, and the identification accuracy is improved.

title: Small sample video identification method
description: A small-sample video recognition method, based on deep neural networks and hierarchical real-time memory, uses visible classes with multiple training samples per class and invisible classes with only a few training samples per class to classify the test samples of the invisible class. First, the deep network pre-training is performed on the visible class video; then, the hierarchical real-time memory network is trained using the pre-trained model and the visible class video, so that the network can predict the importance of the invisible class; at the same time, Use the pre-trained model to perform distance learning on small samples on invisible classes, increase the inter-class distance of samples, and reduce the intra-class distance of samples; finally, use the trained hierarchical real-time memory network to select frames for the test video, Use the distance-learned model to perform a classification task on the selected frames. Therefore, the method can realize video recognition under small samples, which is closer to the application in real recognition scenarios.

title: A multi-label object recognition method based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses a multi-label object recognition method based on a convolutional neural network. The method utilizes the inclusion relationship between labels, constructs the CNN feature extraction part of each label in the order of inclusion, and continuously abstracts and extracts through the convolution operation. The features of each layer, and the classifiers of each label are set at different depths of the network, and the feature map extracted by the CNN feature extraction part of the corresponding label is input to the corresponding classifier, and multiple classifiers are used for error back propagation. , supervise and train the network weight parameters of the corresponding layers, and finally obtain each label category to complete the recognition. The multi-label convolutional neural network adopted in the present invention can well solve the information fusion between multiple labels, solve the problem of low accuracy of traditional multi-label object recognition, and improve the efficiency of training and recognition at the same time.

title: Human behavior identification method based on attention mechanism and 3D convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses a human behavior identification method based on an attention mechanism and a 3D convolutional neural network, wherein the human behavior identification method constructs the 3D convolutional neural network, and an input layer of the 3D convolutional neural network comprises an original gray-scale image and an attention moment array. According to the method, a 3D CNN model for identifying human body behaviors in a video is constructed, an attention mechanism is introduced, the distance between two frames is calculated to serve as an attention matrix, the attention matrix and an original human body behavior video sequence form a double channel to be input into the constructed 3D CNN, and the convolution operation is used for extracting the key features of a visual key area. Meanwhile, a 3DCNN structure is optimized, a Dropout layer is added into a network to randomly freeze a part of network connection weights, a ReLU activation function is used, network sparsity is improved, the problems of calculation amount sharp increase and gradient disappearance caused by dimension increase and layer number deepening are solved, overfitting under a small data set is prevented, network identification accuracy is improved, and time loss is reduced.

title: A deep learning-based foreign object filtering video coding chip and method
description: The present invention provides a foreign object filtering video coding chip and method based on deep learning. The method uses a neural network classification and identification unit to classify objects contained in a video stream image one by one, and identifies sensitive objects in the current frame image. In the case of , the sensitive object is processed by the processing method corresponding to the sensitive object, so as to realize the purpose of automatically removing the object that the user does not expect to see in the current frame image. At the same time, when a certain frame of images recognizes a sensitive object, the next few frames of images will be recognized for the object. On the contrary, when a certain frame of images does not recognize a sensitive object, the next few frames of images will be directly encoded and output. Without object recognition, compared with the method of identifying and judging each frame of image, the processing efficiency is effectively improved.

title: Target body quantity statistical method, device and system
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision, in particular to a method, a device and a system for counting the number of target bodies, aiming at solving the technical problem of how to quickly and accurately count the number of the target bodies, and aiming at the purpose, the method for counting the number of the target bodies comprises the following steps: acquiring an image containing at least one object placed in a specific arrangement; calculating the central point of each target body contour in the image; and counting the number of the central points and acquiring the number of the target bodies according to the number. The method can rapidly and accurately count the number of the target bodies and improve the production efficiency.

title: Method for predicting output power of distributed wind power station
description: The invention proposes a prediction method for the output power of distributed wind power stations. This invention analyzes the power generation of distributed wind power stations into three parts: the equivalent power generation model of the local wind power generation array, and two different types of dynamic models describing the randomness of the power generation of the equivalent wind power generation array.
