This invention chooses a convolutional neural network to model the mapping from local wind field distribution to wind power array equivalent power generation, and uses stochastic differential equations driven by rough path theory and stochastic differential equations driven by point processes to do this. A prediction model is used to model random wind power output fluctuations that are difficult to describe. The combination of the three results in an accurate distributed wind power station output power model.

title: A data-driven prediction and intervention method for college students' personalized learning behavior
description: The invention discloses a data-driven personalized learning behavior prediction and intervention method for college students, which includes: collecting the daily campus activity data of college students, forming a standard data set reflecting the daily learning behavior process of college students, and using a spatio-temporal graph neural network model to self-adapt Learning methods Obtain daily learning behavior habits; use habit models to predict daily learning behaviors, establish parameter relationships between habits and learning behavior activities; carry out continuous monitoring of daily learning activities, and build multiple regression analysis models based on actual data measurement and model prediction results , optimize the habit model; set the habit-related behavior intensity threshold, build a three-level behavior intervention model, and form a data-driven continuous regression intervention mechanism through data measurement and regression analysis of the intervention process. The present invention realizes data-driven precise intervention by quantifying intervention behavior parameters, and continuously ensures that the intervention can effectively and better help students develop good study habits.

title: CT three-dimensional positioning image acquisition method, device and computer equipment
description: The invention relates to a method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for obtaining CT three-dimensional positioning images. Wherein, the method includes: acquiring a micro-radiation dose CT three-dimensional positioning image during CT imaging; performing denoising processing and multi-scale artifact suppression processing on the micro-radiation dose CT three-dimensional positioning image to obtain a reference CT three-dimensional positioning image; obtaining The organ categories and regions in the imaged area in the reference CT three-dimensional positioning image; determining the imaging parameters in the CT scanning protocol according to the organ categories and regions; configuring the imaging function in the CT imaging device according to the imaging parameters; The configured CT imaging device is used to acquire the target CT three-dimensional positioning image, wherein the configured CT imaging device adopts the CT scanning protocol to acquire the target CT three-dimensional positioning image. The above method improves the image quality of CT three-dimensional positioning images under micro-radiation dose.

title: Cross-domain personalized vocabulary learning method and electronic device thereof
description: A method for operating an electronic device, comprising: detecting a first natural language (NL) input; determining a skill from the first NL input; when the NL input includes at least one unique skill word, sending the first NL input to a customized skill parser for determining skill intent, wherein the customized skill parser is trained based on data including at least a customized training data set; and when the NL input does not include at least one unique skill word, sending the first NL input to a general parser for determining a general intent of the first NL input.

title: System, method and computer storage medium for block floating point computing
description: A system for block floating point computation in a neural network receives a block floating point number including a mantissa portion. The bit width of the block floating point number is reduced by decomposing the block floating point number into a plurality of numbers, each of the plurality of numbers having a mantissa portion having a bit width less than a bit width of a mantissa portion of the block floating point number. One or more dot product operations are performed separately on each of the plurality of numbers to obtain separate results, and the separate results are summed to generate a final dot product value. The final dot product value is used to implement the neural network. The reduced bit width computation allows high precision mathematical operations to be performed on a low precision processor with increased accuracy.

title: A method for estimating the physical size of microwave circuits based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a method for estimating the physical size of a microwave circuit based on deep learning, which includes: step 1, collecting multiple sets of microwave circuit S parameters and the physical size of the multiple sets of microwave circuit parameters as an initial data set, and according to the obtained The initial data set constructs a training sample set; Step 2, according to the training sample set, the convolutional neural network model is trained to obtain a microwave circuit size estimation neural network model; Step 3, collecting the S parameter of the target microwave circuit as an input parameter, The neural network model for estimating the size of the microwave circuit is input to obtain the physical size of the target microwave circuit. The method for estimating the physical size of microwave circuits based on deep learning provided by the present invention has a high degree of automation and high estimation accuracy, can effectively reduce the intermediate links and manual intervention in the estimation of microwave circuit physical size parameters, apply cost and complexity, and effectively improve microwave circuits. Accuracy and real-time performance of physical size parameter estimation.

title: Multi-level refined intelligent denitration system and method based on big data and firefly algorithm
description: The invention discloses a multi-level refined intelligent denitration system based on big data and a firefly algorithm, which comprises an economizer, an SCR denitration device, an air preheater, a dust removal device, a desulfurization device, a tail gas emission device, a boiler unit, an ammonia injection main pipe assembly, a denitration inlet flow velocity and NOx field distribution monitoring system, and a denitration outlet NOx/NH 3 Field distribution monitoring system, NOX field distribution monitoring system of catalyst region, and NOX/NH of catalyst region 3 A non-uniformity analysis system; according to the invention, a real-time adjustment system of the ammonia injection branch pipe is established through big data and a particle swarm optimization algorithm, so that dual control of partition control and total ammonia injection amount optimization is realized; the flow field matching is accurate, the variable working condition adaptability is strong, the quality of ammonia injection control can be effectively improved, the SCR performance can adapt to the requirement of ultralow NOx emission, and the comprehensive effects of saving ammonia injection amount, reducing NOx emission concentration, reducing the blockage probability of an air preheater and reducing tail equipment dust deposition are achieved.

title: Cement-emulsified asphalt mixture shrinkage behavior prediction method based on deep learning
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of civil engineering and discloses a method for predicting the shrinkage behavior of cement emulsified asphalt mixture based on deep learning to determine image generation design parameters and shrinkage performance design parameters; the designed cement emulsified asphalt mixture data package is used as Data to be trained, and an image generation training sample set is constructed; a generative adversarial neural network model is constructed and trained; a shrinkage performance deep neural network is constructed and trained; given the design parameters of the mixture to be predicted, the trained generative adversarial network and shrinkage are used The performance prediction model predicts the shrinkage of the target mix. The invention can accurately predict the shrinkage performance of the final designed product through design parameters, is conducive to quickly optimizing the design ratio of the cement emulsified asphalt mixture, and has positive significance for improving the shrinkage performance of the mixture.

title: Active disturbance rejection synchronous tracking control method for stepping electro-mechanical converter
description: An auto-disturbance rejection synchronous tracking control method of a stepping type electro-mechanical converter comprises the following steps: (1) an Adaptive Genetic Algorithm (AGA) evaluates the parameters of the electromechanical converter controller and optimizes the parameters on line in real time; (2) the rotor angular displacement control signal theta of the electromechanical converter output by the signal generator i (t) inputting the actual angular displacement signal theta (t) detected by the position sensor of the electro-mechanical converter and the position sensor of the electro-mechanical converter into a second-order active disturbance rejection position controller, and calculating and outputting an angular displacement control signal u by the controller 1 (t); (3) introducing feedforward control to make the motor rotor and the output u of the position controller 1 (t) collectively determining the desired theoretical control field θ m (t) tracking θ (t) in real time and by limiting θ m (t) making the misalignment angle between + -pi. (4) Theoretical control current i required by two-phase winding a (t)、i b (t) and the actual current i af (t)、i bf And (t) comparing the generated error signals and inputting the error signals into a current closed loop PI controller, generating an SPWM duty ratio signal after the controller operates, and controlling the actual winding current and the rotating magnetic field generated by the actual winding current through a control driving module by the signal.

title: High-precision microscopic virtual learning resource generation method
description: The invention belongs to the teaching application field of virtual reality technology, and provides a high-precision microscopic virtual learning resource generation method, which comprises the following steps: (1) collecting high-precision specimen images; (2) generating a 3D model of the surface of the specimen; (3) and (5) interactive display of the microscopic virtual learning resources. The invention provides a scheme of image acquisition, model generation and interactive display around the requirement of teaching on high-precision virtual learning resources, and establishes a set of multi-angle and high-definition specimen image data acquisition method according to the characteristics of microscopic teaching resources in a VR learning environment; after point cloud data is generated and processed, a three-dimensional model of the surface of the specimen is constructed, and then a high-precision model in the virtual learning resources is generated after surface simplification and texture mapping; and adding display schemes such as label display, interaction, movement and the like for the model in the virtual learning environment. The invention provides a new and fast-constructed way and mode for the wide popularization of VR teaching resources in different teaching scenes.

title: Low altitude target knowledge assisted intelligent electromagnetic perception method, system and storage medium
description: The invention relates to a low-altitude target knowledge-assisted intelligent electromagnetic perception method, system and storage medium, including: constructing a dynamically updated multi-source high-dimensional knowledge base, compressing massive information generated by electromagnetic sensing from the knowledge level and the data level to obtain load knowledge library; according to the load knowledge base, establish the time-space-frequency prediction model of the signal occurrence, formulate the corresponding sensing strategy scanned according to the prediction model, and complete electromagnetic sensing with high efficiency; judge whether the sensing result belongs to the category of the load knowledge base, and if so, use the small Sample low-complexity machine learning method to model corresponding features; if not, use reinforcement learning method to interact electromagnetic information of load intelligent perception with multi-source high-dimensional knowledge base to obtain reward and punishment guidance, and in action-evaluation Gain knowledge from the environment and make new decisions. The invention can realize order-of-magnitude improvement of time, space and frequency electromagnetic information perception efficiency.

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for processing consumption coupon transaction data
description: The present specification provides a method, an apparatus, a device, and a storage medium for processing consumer ticket transaction data, by acquiring user equipment information and user history transaction information of an account sending a consumer ticket pickup request, performing location tampering identification on a device initiating the consumer ticket pickup request based on the user equipment information, identifying a ticket pickup intention of a user based on the user history transaction information, and determining whether the consumer ticket pickup request has a risk based on a result of the location tampering identification and a result of the ticket pickup intention identification, so as to determine whether to issue a consumer ticket. The method can realize accurate risk identification on the behavior of the real user for cheating malicious transaction of the consumption ticket, and on the basis that the issuing of the consumption ticket can ensure the real and reliable identity of the user, the fairness of the transmission of the consumption ticket is determined, for example, the user who robs the ticket really operates in an activity stipulated area, the intention of the user to rob the ticket is possible to really consume, so that the accuracy of the risk identification of the transaction of the consumption ticket is improved, and the security of the transaction of the consumption ticket is ensured.

title: Registration method and device of deep learning image, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a registration method, a registration device, electronic equipment and a storage medium of a deep learning image, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring deformation fields of a first fixed image and a moving image through a first algorithm; and training the deep neural network according to the moving image, the second fixed image and the deformation field to obtain a trained deep neural network. According to the registration method for the deep learning image, provided by the embodiment of the invention, the simulated deformation field is generated by using the generation algorithm and is not artificially marked, so that a registration network is better trained, the problem that registration standards are defined by relying on manually set registration metrics in the prior art and a registration process is driven is solved, the training data amount is greatly improved in a neural network, and the registration accuracy is further improved and the calculation speed is high is solved.

title: Method and device for determining health information distribution based on machine learning
description: The invention discloses a method and a device for determining health information distribution based on machine learning, relates to the technical field of data processing, and mainly aims to solve the problems that the existing health information distribution image is low in determining efficiency and cannot meet the requirements of convenience and rapidness in data processing in health care. Comprising the following steps: acquiring spectrum data; classifying the spectrum data based on a trained spectrum classification model to obtain classification processing results containing health features marked by the spectrum data respectively, wherein the spectrum classification model is a hybrid model established based on different-level machine learning model combinations; and integrating the health features in the classification processing result according to a preset spectrum integration weight to obtain a distribution image of the health information. The method is mainly used for determining the health information distribution based on machine learning.

title: Target object recognition network model and its training method, target object recognition method
description: The invention discloses a target object recognition network model, a training method thereof and a target object recognition method. The target object identification method comprises the steps of receiving a target object to be identified with interference factors; inputting the target object to be identified into a trained target object identification network model; the target object recognition network model comprises an interference elimination network and a target object recognition network; the interference elimination network comprises at least one first type of interference elimination network based on the generation type countermeasure network and a second type of interference elimination network connected with the first type of interference elimination network; respectively utilizing a first type interference elimination network and a second type interference elimination network to eliminate interference of different interference factors in the target object to be identified; and identifying the target object to be identified after interference elimination by using a target object identification network. The technical scheme solves the problem that the existing target object identification technology is not strong in anti-interference capability when identifying the target object with interference.

title: Data transmission using fuzzy processing unit for Data Processing (DP) accelerator
description: According to one embodiment, a host communicates with a data processing (DP) accelerator using an obfuscation scheme. The DP accelerator receives a training request from the host, the training request including obfuscated data, the obfuscated data including one or more AI models and/or training input data. The DP accelerator deobfuscates the obfuscated data through an obfuscation unit of the DP accelerator to obtain one or more AI models. The DP accelerator trains the one or more AI models based on the training input data.

title: Federal learning model training method based on data feature perception aggregation
description: The invention provides a federal learning model training method based on data feature perception aggregation. According to the cloud server, a global optimal model is calculated according to a local model uploaded by an edge client, the data characteristics of the edge client are mined, the data characteristics are subjected to dimension reduction, key characteristics are screened out, and the edge client is clustered and grouped based on the key characteristics; the cloud server transmits grouping information and a global optimal model to the edge client; and the edge client provides local data according to the received global optimal model and performs model training locally according to the global optimal model, randomly selects one local model from the same edge client group or selects the optimal model from the edge client group and uploads the selected local model to the cloud server. The invention fully utilizes the data characteristics of the edge clients, groups the edge clients, avoids unnecessary communication, greatly relieves the influence of statistical isomerism on model training, and improves the training efficiency of the model.

title: Fault diagnosis system and method
description: The invention provides a fault diagnosis system and method. The system includes: a calculation module for calculating a probability of occurrence of a cause of a failure type of a target product failure; and a building module for taking the failure type as a root node and taking the cause of the failure type as a child A node constructs a decision tree; and a solving module for solving the decision tree to find the cause of the target product failure. The invention can quickly find the cause of the failure of the target product by constructing a decision tree and improve the production efficiency.

title: Tire tread wear diagnostic device and diagnostic method
description: The present disclosure relates to a tire condition diagnosis method and device. Specifically, the tire condition diagnosis method of the present disclosure includes a step of acquiring CAN bus data and sensor data of a vehicle, a step of performing a first diagnosis on a tire based on speed-related data included in the CAN bus data of the vehicle, a step of performing a second diagnosis on the tire based on the sensor data, and a step of cross-verifying a result of the first diagnosis and a result of the second diagnosis to obtain a final diagnosis result.

title: User Equipment (UE) Positioning Using Frequency Domain Windowing
description: Techniques for wireless communications are disclosed. In one aspect, a user equipment (UE) applies a plurality of PRS processing windows to a positioning reference signal (PRS) resource received from a network node over a multipath channel, determines a plurality of channel estimates for the PRS resource based on the plurality of PRS processing windows, and determines a positioning measurement of the PRS resource based on the plurality of channel estimates.

title: Apparatus And Method For Providing Optimized Classification Algorithm
description: The present invention relates to a classification algorithm providing device and method, and is characterized by including: a communication unit which receives a data set for evaluating a classification algorithm, and a processor which cross-validates a plurality of classification algorithms based on the data set to derive an evaluation index for at least one of operation time and classification performance, multiplies the evaluation index by a weight set within a range of 1 to 100 and then adds them to derive priorities for the plurality of classification algorithms, and provides information on at least one of the plurality of classification algorithms based on the priorities.

title: System for remaining useful life prediction of battery based on digital twin model and method thereof
description: The present invention relates to a digital twin-based battery remaining useful life prediction system and method therefor. According to the present invention, a digital twin-based battery remaining useful life prediction system comprises: a sensor unit that collects output data of an actual battery system using an IoT sensor and transmits it to a virtual space; a digital twin model construction unit that constructs a digital twin model having the same configuration as the actual battery system using the collected output data; a prediction algorithm learning unit that learns a prediction algorithm for predicting the remaining useful life using output parameters of the digital twin model; and a prediction unit that applies output data of the actual battery system to the learned prediction algorithm to predict the remaining useful life of the actual battery system. The system may further include a providing unit that provides the remaining useful life of the actual battery system predicted using the constructed digital twin model and the prediction algorithm.  In this way, according to the present invention, the digital twin model can be updated with online measurements of the physical model, which can improve prediction performance by taking into account changing operating conditions and differences between cells, and can help maintain a safe operating state of the battery method.

title: Method, device and recording medium for correcting oral images
description: A method, a device for performing the method, and a recording medium are disclosed, comprising: a step of obtaining an oral cavity image including a metal region; a step of obtaining, by a processor, a masking image in which the metal region is masked from the oral cavity image; a step of obtaining, by the processor, a comparison result of pixel values between adjacent pixels among a plurality of pixels included in the masking image; a step of determining, by the processor, a start point and an end point for the metal region based on the comparison result; a step of obtaining, by the processor, an intermediate region interpolation pixel value corresponding to an intermediate region initial pixel value between the start point and the end point based on a start point pixel value at the start point and an end point pixel value at the end point; a step of updating, by the processor, the intermediate region interpolation pixel value according to the intermediate region initial pixel value to obtain an intermediate region correction pixel value; and a step of providing, by the processor, a corrected oral cavity image based on the intermediate region correction pixel value.

title: Learning device and method for mitigating dependence on bias of classification model
description: The present invention relates to a learning device and method for mitigating the dependence on bias of a classification model including a main model (fully-trained model) and an under-trained model, wherein the main model and the under-trained model are trained based on a first dataset among learning datasets, a second dataset among the learning datasets is input to the under-trained model, and whether the second dataset is biased based on an output result is determined, and depending on the bias, mixup augmentation is applied to the second dataset to generate a re-weighted dataset, and only at least some layers of the main model are re-trained using the re-weighted dataset.

title: Cross-document intelligent authoring and processing assistant
description: Machine learning, artificial intelligence, and other computer-implemented methods are used to identify various semantically significant chunks in documents, automatically label them with appropriate data types and semantic roles, and leverage this enhanced information to assist authors and support subsequent processes. Chunk locations, data types, and semantic roles can often be automatically determined from what is called "context"—more precisely, a combination of their formatting, structure, and context, adjacent or neighboring content, overall occurrence patterns in the document, and similarities of all of these across documents (often, but not exclusively, among documents in the same document set). Similarity is not limited to exact or fuzzy string or attribute comparisons, but can include machine learning (ML) techniques such as measuring the similarity of natural language grammatical structure, words, chunks, and other embeddings, and the similarity of data types and semantic roles of previously identified chunks.

title: Apparatus and method for generating 3D human pose from 2D video data
description: The present invention relates to a three-dimensional pose generation device and a three-dimensional pose generation method, and according to an embodiment of the present invention, a three-dimensional pose generation method using a computing device comprises: a step of recognizing a human body included in each frame image of two-dimensional image data and generating a detection image including positional information corresponding to a position of the human body; a step of applying a feature extractor to the detection image and generating a feature map corresponding to the pose of the human body; a step of generating a skinned multi-person linear (SMPL) parameter corresponding to the feature map based on a generative adversarial network (GAN) model and inferring a three-dimensional pose for the human body; and a step of comparing the inferred three-dimensional pose with an SMPL dataset including a plurality of predefined reference poses and determining a three-dimensional pose for the human body, wherein a loss function of the GAN model may reflect a reprojection loss.

title: Broadcast transmitter, broadcast system and method that transmit broadcast data for creating media content
description: A transmitter, a media system, and a method thereof for transmitting communication data for generating media content, and a terminal, a media system, and a method thereof for receiving communication data for generating media content are disclosed. The transmitter may include a package formatting unit that formats at least one service element into a prompt package for generating media content, and a transmission unit that transmits communication data including the formatted prompt package. The terminal may include a receiving unit that receives communication data including the prompt package for generating media content, and a media content generator that generates media content based on the received prompt package.

title: Apparatus and method for in-memory computing
description: The following disclosure relates to an in-memory computing device and method, which may include a controller for generating command signals required for weighted multi-bit representation and operation based on row-column hybrid grouping, a memory array for storing weights used in multi-bit operations, and for operating the weights and input values, and an operation circuit for dynamically controlling coefficients by following the multi-bit representation, and outputting a final operation result based on the operation result and the controlled coefficients.

title: AI Camera-Based Bird Reepellent Laser System
description: In order to use a high-power laser for bird repelling, safety must be completely ensured during the operation of the high-power laser. In order to ensure safety during the operation of such a high-power laser, the present invention comprises: a surveillance camera that monitors an area where birds are to be repelled; a pan-tilt mount that fixes the surveillance camera, rotates the surveillance camera horizontally 360 degrees or by a set angle, and can adjust the angle in the up-and-down direction based on the surveillance camera; and one or more high-power laser bird repellents installed on the top or bottom or left and right sides of the surveillance camera, and sets a surveillance area to restrict the operation of the high-power laser bird repellent when a dangerous object is detected.  By means of the above-described invention, a technology is provided that is effective in providing a bird repellent that operates with safety as a top priority.

title: Device and method for operating chatbot performing role of artificial intelligence teacher
description: The present invention relates to a chatbot operating device and method that can create a persona of an instructor who conducts online classes and has a teaching style desired by a user, and then provide the user with step-by-step, deductive questions to reach the correct answer using the created persona.  The chatbot operating method performed by the above chatbot operating device may include a step of determining style information related to a style of responding to a user's inquiry, a step of outputting question data related to a predefined question to a user terminal corresponding to the user, a step of receiving request data related to the question data from the user terminal, and a step of generating a step-by-step guide for the user to reach correct answer data corresponding to the question data based on the request data, and providing the generated step-by-step guide according to the style information.

title: DETECTION OF ANOMALIES AND ALGORITHMS OF THE NEURONAL NETWORK FOR MONITORING THE PST HYDROCICLONE CONDITION
description: A system includes a learning network with a signal processor configured to: receive learned signaling containing information about representative samples of conditions related to operating states of a hydrocyclone and characterized as learned samples of each condition when the learning network is trained, and unprocessed signaling containing information about unprocessed samples containing information about the current operation of the hydrocyclone; and determine the corresponding signaling containing information about a state of operation of the current hydrocyclone operation based on a comparison of the signaling learned and the signaling unprocessed.

title: Data storage method
description: (57) Abstract: A method for optimizing a memory space for storing original data and maintaining high-speed access to the data is provided. SOLUTION: Original data is stored in a memory by a method applying a genetic algorithm. That is,   Select the number of generations, initialize a plurality of individuals, construct a tree representing the original data for each of the individuals, determine its size, select a mating population from the plurality of individuals, and perform the mating Generating at least one new individual by intersecting at least two individuals of the population and repeating the sub-step of adding the new individual to the plurality of individuals a number of times equal to the number of generations to obtain a tree of the smallest size. Stored in the computer memory.

title: Combined photovoltaic power physical model and data-driven photovoltaic power prediction method
description: The present invention proposes the photovoltaic power Forecasting Methodology with reference to photovoltaic power physical model and data-driven, belongs to power system new energy electric powder prediction.This method uses photovoltaic power physical model, it is determined that influenceing the crucial weather characteristics of photovoltaic power, establishes the crucial weather characteristics matrix of historical period and prediction period；Then the weather data matrix of history and prediction period is established respectively, obtains the input matrix of history and prediction period；Feature extraction is carried out to input matrix, obtains the principal component eigenmatrix of history and prediction period；Choose and K nearest historical period of any prediction period principal component feature manhatton distance, fitting obtains the principal component feature of K historical period and the mapping relations of corresponding historical period photovoltaic power, the principal component feature of selected prediction period is inputted into mapping relations, obtains the photovoltaic power of the prediction period.The present invention utilize photovoltaic power physical model, can Accurate Prediction photovoltaic power, there is stronger industrial application value.

title: A Semantic Understanding Method for Family Scenes
description: A method for semantic understanding of family scenes, comprising steps: S11, completing the collection and sorting of family scenes and corpus; S12, calculating the weight of each word in the corpus, and generating a dictionary; S13, detecting live life scenes on family scenes; S14, Match the similarity between the speech text to be recognized and the corpus of family scenes, and find out the text with the highest similarity for replacement.

title: Method and apparatus for generating information
description: The embodiment of the present application discloses a method and a device for generating information. A specific embodiment of the method includes: acquiring an image sequence obtained by photographing an infant; sequentially inputting images in the image sequence into a pre-trained first region positioning model to obtain a sequence of infant skeleton image regions; Skeleton image region sequence and the pre-trained first feature extraction model to obtain the baby's skeleton feature sequence; input the baby's skeleton feature sequence to the pre-trained mental state prediction model to obtain the baby's mental state information. This embodiment improves the prediction accuracy of the baby's psychological state information.

title: Computational optimization mechanism for deep neural networks
description: An apparatus for facilitating computational optimization is disclosed. The apparatus includes a plurality of processing units each including a plurality of Execution Units (EUs), wherein the plurality of EUs includes a first EU type and a second EU type.

title: Image text recognition method, device, equipment and storage medium thereof
description: This application discloses image text recognition methods, device, equipment and its storage mediums.This method includes：Images to be recognized is obtained, images to be recognized is administrative permission certificate picture；Images to be recognized is input in the image text identification model built in advance and carries out text detection and text identification, obtains target identification result；Wherein, image text identification model includes image text detection submodel and image text identification submodel, image text detects submodel and is respectively adopted what deep learning algorithm was trained with image text identification submodel, and target identification result includes sentence information characteristics corresponding at least one textual entry in images to be recognized.According to the technical solution of the embodiment of the present application, realize that the target area to images to be recognized is detected and identifies by the image text identification model built in advance, to improve the treatment effeciency of image text information, the time of user information typing is greatly saved.

title: Method and system for matching lidar image and camera image
description: The invention discloses a matching method of a laser radar image and a camera image, comprising: using a convolutional neural network to learn feature descriptors for the laser radar image and the camera image; comparing the distance between the feature descriptors extracted by the convolutional neural network , to confirm the classification and pose of the target; through the pose parameters extracted by the convolutional neural network, the lidar image is projected onto the camera image, and the fusion map of the lidar image and the camera image is obtained. It can solve the dependence on the texture of the target surface, reduce the influence of the environment, and improve the accuracy of image matching between the lidar and the camera.

title: A Fast Learning Method for SAR Automatic Target Recognition
description: The invention discloses a kind of SAR automatic target recognition methods of Fast Learning, this method obtains SAR destination image data first and according to target classification is marked to it, form training set, then making data to training set image enhances and pre-processes, dense connection convolutional neural networks are constructed again, and training sample is inputted in network and is trained, network is inputted after finally pre-processing sample to be sorted to be identified.The SAR automatic target detection training time of the invention is short, discrimination is high, high degree of automation.

title: Grain size intelligent rating method based on image recognition deep learning technology
description: The invention relates to the intelligent rating technology of grain size based on deep learning. The invention solves the problems of low precision, imperfect rating standards, semi-quantitative and relatively large subjective factors in the current artificial grain size rating execution process. The present invention proposes a grain size intelligent rating method based on image recognition deep learning technology. The key points of the technical scheme are as follows: firstly, the grain size rating image database of different materials is collected, and the grain size image information and grain size grade are extracted Label and perform image preprocessing; secondly, divide the grain size rating image database into training set, verification set and test set, and set the ratio of training set, verification set and test set according to needs; then, divide training set and verification set For the training of deep neural network; then, use the training model of deep neural network to initialize the neural network for testing; finally, input the test set into the deep neural network for testing after initialization for intelligent rating test of grain size of materials .

title: An optimization method for structural parameters of CSP solder joints to reduce stress under power cycle-harmonic response coupling
description: The present invention discloses a kind of CSP welding spot structure parameter optimization method of the stress under reduction power cycle-Harmony response coupling, and 1) establish simulation analysis model；2) solder joint heat stress value is obtained；3) influence factor of heat stress value is determined；4) the parameter level value of influence factor is determined；5) experiment sample is obtained；6) functional relation between influence factor and heat stress value is obtained；7) regression analysis is carried out to functional relation；8) correctness of functional relation is established；9) initial population is generated using random fashion；10) current the number of iterations and adaptive optimal control value are obtained；11) individual is carried out crossover operation, mutation operation and evolved to reverse；12) adaptive value optimum individual is selected；13) it is rejudged after population recruitment.This method combining response face and genetic algorithm reduce the stress under power cycle-Harmony response coupling loads in CSP solder joint, have excellent robust performance, calculation method is simple, greatly facilitates later period CSP welding spot structure Parameters Optimal Design.

title: Eccentric Image Fusion
description: The present disclosure provides "off-center image fusion". A system comprising a computer including a processor and a memory, the memory storing instructions executable by the processor to: inputting a red-green-blue (RGB) image and an off-center image to a neural network that outputs a located object based on combining the RGB image and the off-center image, wherein the off-center image is based on a pixel-by-pixel rolling average and a pixel-by-pixel rolling variance within a moving window of k video frames. The memory may also include instructions executable by the processor to receive the located object at a computing device included in one or more of a vehicle or a traffic information system.

title: Method and system for accelerating sparse convolutional neural network based on data flow architecture
description: The present invention provides a sparse convolutional neural network acceleration method and system based on a data flow architecture. For the application of sparse convolution, a set of instruction sharing detection device and sparse convolution acceleration method are designed by software. By detecting and comparing the instructions generated by the compiler, marking all instructions with the same instruction content, setting the addresses of these instructions to the same address, and realizing instruction sharing in sparse convolution, thereby reducing the memory load caused by instruction loading. access, which improves the running time of sparse convolutions.

title: Video semantic segmentation method, model training method, related device and electronic equipment
description: The present disclosure relates to a video semantic segmentation method, a model training method, a related device and an electronic device, including: acquiring a first video; wherein the first video includes key frames and non-key frames; identifying the key of the first video frame, the first unique feature and the first shared feature of the key frame are extracted based on the neural network model; the first target feature is determined based on the first unique feature and the first shared feature, and the first target feature is determined based on the first target feature Semantic segmentation result of the key frame; identifying the non-key frame corresponding to the key frame in the first video, and extracting the second unique feature of the non-key frame based on the neural network model; A shared feature and the second unique feature determine a second target feature, and a semantic segmentation result of the non-key frame is determined based on the second target feature. The present disclosure can improve the efficiency of video semantic segmentation.

title: A method and system for calculating market quotation of electric power frequency regulation based on opportunity cost
description: The invention discloses an opportunity cost-based power frequency modulation market quotation calculation method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of calculating income information only participated in an energy market, calculating total income information participated in a frequency modulation market, calculating income comparison information of two markets by comparing the income information only participated in the energy market with the total income information participated in the frequency modulation market, and calculating gross profit difference information according to the income comparison information of the two markets so as to respectively determine declaration capacity and declaration price. According to the invention, the overall power generation benefits of the power generation enterprises under the conditions of not participating in frequency modulation and participating in frequency modulation are respectively calculated, and the optimal declaration strategy is obtained through comparative analysis, so that the power generation enterprises are helped to realize benefit maximization; meanwhile, the problems that data confusion is caused by large storage capacity of traditional frequency modulation data management, and data display, settlement, copy and strategy support cannot be effectively provided by means of manual experience processing are solved.

title: Server memory capacity prediction method and device
description: The invention discloses a server memory capacity prediction method and device, wherein the method includes: obtaining memory usage data and corresponding time point data; inputting the memory usage data and corresponding time point data into a trained LSTM neural network The model predicts the memory capacity of the server, and the LSTM neural network model is trained according to the historical memory usage data and the corresponding historical time point data. The invention can predict the memory capacity of the server, expand the applicable scope of the data, and reduce the maintenance cost.

title: Ultrasonic water meter data restoration method based on deep learning model
description: An ultrasonic water meter data restoration method based on a deep learning model calculates an ultrasonic flight time difference through an ultrasonic water meter time chip to obtain ultrasonic water meter time sequence original data r m Screening abnormal values of the ultrasonic water meter time sequence data set by adopting a dynamic threshold method; preprocessing is carried out, abnormal values in the data set are removed, and configuration of a training set and a testing set is carried out according to the characteristics of the LSTM model; predicting the ultrasonic water meter time sequence data by the forward LSTM prediction model, and predicting the ultrasonic water meter time sequence data by the forward LSTM prediction model; reverse LSTM modeModeling and deducing ultrasonic water meter time sequence data, wherein the reverse LSTM model comprises model optimization parameter setting, model construction and training, carrying out ultrasonic water meter time sequence data deduction according to the reverse LSTM model, and deducing according to a predicted value y' t And the derived value y ″) t And calculating the recovery value of the abnormal data in a weighted mode. The invention has higher repairing precision and higher repairing efficiency.

title: Foreground guiding and texture focusing pedestrian re-identification model establishing method and application thereof
description: The invention discloses a method for establishing a pedestrian re-identification model with foreground guide and texture focusing and application thereof, belonging to the field of pedestrian re-identification and comprising the following steps: taking a pre-trained image classification network as a basic network, taking an output branch of the basic network as a global branch, introducing a local branch containing a BottleNeck module behind the last characteristic layer of the basic network, and introducing an attention branch containing a foreground attention module and a texture focusing decoder behind the last but one characteristic layer to obtain a network to be trained; taking a texture focusing decoder as a decoder part of the network to be trained, taking a global branch, a local branch and an attention branch as a non-decoder part of the network to be trained, and alternately training the non-decoder part and the decoder part; and after the training is finished, removing the texture focusing decoder in the network to be trained, and adding a characteristic output layer to obtain a pedestrian re-identification model based on foreground guidance and texture focusing. The invention can improve the robustness and accuracy of pedestrian re-identification.

title: Method and system for video concentration, extraction, refining and sublimation based on 5G edge cloud computing
description: This invention discloses a method and system for video condensation, extraction, refinement, and enhancement based on 5G edge computing. Applied to the field of video tracking and processing, it addresses the technical problems in existing technologies that struggle to support semantic association and behavioral analysis of moving objects across different viewpoints and time periods, as well as rapid retrieval and trajectory tracking of moving objects, determination and description of travel patterns and behaviors, and even the reconstruction of the spatiotemporal relationships of behaviors or events. This invention stores background images at a certain frequency based on whether the foreground salience changes within a time period, significantly reducing video storage space and saving storage resources. Furthermore, this invention stores video in a format based on time and the movement trajectory of moving objects in space, enabling the acquisition of moving object trajectories based on time trajectories, greatly saving retrieval time for moving objects in video files and reducing the computational resources used.

title: Air traffic control method, system, electronic device and storage medium based on digital twin technology
description: The invention discloses an air traffic control method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium based on a digital twin technology, and belongs to the technical field of air traffic control. The method carries out digitized modeling of airspace through a digital twin technology, divides the airspace into airspace unit blocks and sets unit attributes for airspace simulation and evaluation; inputting the flight plan in the preset time into the airspace model for simulation, carrying out flow measurement and calculation, predicting the possible capacity flow problem, providing decision assistance for flow improvement, eliminating risks from the predicted tactical level and improving the capacity flow matching degree; historical track data is used as input, an aircraft conflict model based on a BP neural network model is established, potential aircraft conflicts are identified by combining a digital airspace and perception technology, a conflict resolution scheme is provided, auxiliary decision support is provided for a controller, and the working intensity of the controller is reduced.

title: Image compression coding method based on overfitting convolution self-coding network
description: The invention provides an image compression coding method based on an overfitting convolutional self-encoding network, and relates to the technical field of image encoding, which includes: constructing a convolutional self-encoding neural network; generating a training data set; training a convolutional self-encoding network; Use the network to encode and decode high-definition natural images. The invention solves the problems of not using the network overfitting and insufficient repairing for the image coding damage in the existing image coding damage method, enhances the learning ability of the network for coding damage, and allows the deep learning network to participate in the coding in a targeted manner. The decoding process not only saves the image storage overhead, but also ensures the quality of the compressed image, and further improves the speed and effect of the image compression codec processing.

title: A machine learning model training method and device
description: Embodiments of the present application provide a method and device for training a machine learning model. The method includes: training a long short-term memory (LSTM) network corresponding to each feature with the features of the samples in the first training set of the trusted user as the granularity model; using the output of all the LSTM network models as the input of the first neural network model, obtain a first probability value for characterizing the credit of the credit user; based on the first training set and the first probability value , mark the samples in the second training set of all the credit-rejecting users; determine some credit-rejecting users among all the credit-rejecting users according to the marking result, based on the partial credit-rejecting users and the sample data of the credit-granting users. The third training set is to train a second neural network model; the second neural network model is used to evaluate the user's credit.

title: Thyroid cancer pathological image classification method based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a deep learning-based thyroid cancer pathological image classification method, which mainly solves the problem that the existing methods have poor classification effect on thyroid cancer pathological images. The implementation scheme is: read the thyroid pathological image database, extract low-level convolution and pooling features through the receptive field network and fuse them, and obtain the fused low-level features; extract the high-level features through the capsule network after the fusion, that is, the predicted low-level features. Category vector; update the category vector through the dynamic routing algorithm to obtain the final category vector, and calculate the modulus of the category vector through the compression activation function; use the vector with the largest modulus value to reconstruct the image through the decoding and reconstruction network; iteratively update the receptive field network and The weights in the capsule network complete the model training; finally, the thyroid pathological images to be classified are input into the trained model to obtain the final classification result. The invention improves the classification accuracy of thyroid cancer pathological images, and can be used for computer-aided diagnosis.

title: A method for predicting public energy consumption based on machine learning
description: The invention discloses a public energy consumption prediction method based on machine learning, which belongs to the field of energy consumption prediction. The present invention includes the following steps: S101, data collection; S102, data preprocessing, including: A, using MAD algorithm to eliminate outliers; B, replacing missing values; C, using PCA algorithm to reduce variables; S103, Predictive modeling; computes with DNN deep neural network, uses the collected data to use DNN with more hidden layers in R software tools in Keras library. The present invention overcomes the lack of effective means for public energy consumption prediction in the prior art, and intends to provide a public energy consumption prediction method based on machine learning, which mainly solves how to integrate a big data platform and machine learning into intelligent energy management systems. In the system, the efficiency of the public sector is an important part of the smart city concept, and the present invention is implemented in the existing MERIDA intelligent system to provide users with accurate energy consumption predictions.

title: Label identification method and device, storage medium and electronic device
description: The invention discloses a label identification method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. Wherein, the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a group of target description information, wherein the group of target description information and the group of media resources have a one-to-one correspondence relationship, each piece of target description information comprises description information except a target label in original description information of one media resource, and the original description information of each media resource comprises the target label; determining a group of content vectors according to words in a group of target description information, wherein the group of content vectors and the group of target description information have a one-to-one correspondence relationship; clustering the group of content vectors to obtain a clustering result; and identifying the target label according to the clustering result to obtain a label identification result. The invention solves the technical problem of low identification efficiency of the subject label.

title: Image-based health status identification method, device, device and storage medium
description: The present application discloses an image-based health state recognition method, device, equipment and storage medium, belonging to the field of artificial intelligence. The method trains an initial feature recognition model through a first training sample set to obtain a face feature recognition model; The training results of the facial feature recognition model, and based on the training results, the initial relationship recognition model is trained to obtain a feature relationship recognition model, and a correction matrix is generated based on the feature relationship recognition model; The image is recognized to obtain the facial features of the user; the facial features of the image to be recognized are corrected based on the correction matrix, and the health status of the user is recognized according to the correction result. In addition, this application also relates to blockchain technology, and the image to be recognized can be stored in the blockchain. The present application can significantly improve the recognition accuracy of the health state of the face, and at the same time, has strong adaptability and is convenient for deployment in mobile terminals.

title: Image and video vessel enhancement and segmentation method and system for venipuncture robot
description: The invention relates to an image and video blood vessel enhancement and segmentation method and system of a venipuncture robot. The method includes acquiring a blood vessel original image or blood vessel original video as raw data and performing grayscale processing; and performing Gaussian filtering on the grayscaled original data. and Frangi filtering to enhance the blood vessel part; perform convolution calculation processing of first expansion and then erosion on the filtered original data; judge whether the original data is an image or video, if it is an image, use a full convolutional neural network to segment and classify the image ; If it is a video, use a recurrent neural network with temporal memory function to segment and classify the video. Compared with the prior art, the present invention enhances the structure of blood vessels, significantly reduces the noise on the edges of blood vessels, smooths the transition between blood vessels and non-vessel blood vessels, and at the same time, eliminates the interference of hair on the blood vessel segmentation result, thereby effectively improving the blood vessel identification quality of the venipuncture robot. and precision.

title: Classification and recognition method of low-slow and small targets
description: The method for classifying and identifying the low-speed small target disclosed by the invention is accurate in identification and short in identification time. The invention is realized by the following technical scheme: taking different target track data as training samples of a data preprocessing module based on PPI images formed by original tracks; the data preprocessing module carries out data prediction and preprocessing on the acquired track related point data rules to generate a training set, a deep learning network model and a network optimization module which sequentially adopt a deep convolution network DCNN and a long and short term memory network LSTM are constructed, two groups of features are extracted from the frame data and spliced to obtain combined features, deep learning and image recognition target track data are input into a weighting calculation module in real time, model compression and acceleration are carried out on a trained network model structure, model compression acceleration is realized through weighting calculation and model pruning, the depth features required by accurate classification are realized, and accurate identification of classification of small flying birds and unmanned aerial vehicles is completed.

title: A method and system for online risk detection of construction quality and safety
description: The embodiments of the present application provide an online risk detection method and system for building construction quality safety, by acquiring building construction quality distribution information including multiple online safety risk wall objects, and at least one reference including multiple online safety risk wall objects quality distribution information, and extracting pieces of building construction quality distribution information with preset inspection levels from the building construction quality distribution information, and extracting pieces of reference quality distribution information with preset inspection levels from the reference quality distribution information, and then based on multiple acceptance data The data relationship between nodes and the data relationship between multiple reference data nodes are used to construct a data relationship distribution map between the construction quality distribution information segments and the reference quality distribution information segments, thereby obtaining online security risk information. In this way, it is possible to effectively avoid the behavior of the security online risk wall object under the condition that it is difficult to identify, and to ensure the effectiveness and accuracy of the behavior detection.

title: Channel estimation and signal detection method based on DDST and deep learning
description: The invention discloses a channel estimation and signal detection method based on DDST and deep learning. The channel estimation method includes: pre-estimating the channel state information on the obtained received signal containing the training sequence information; inputting the pre-estimation into the trained first deep neural network to obtain the enhanced channel state information value. The detection method includes: pre-equalizing the enhanced channel state information value obtained by the first deep neural network; inputting the pre-equalization into the trained second deep neural network to obtain a detection signal. The present invention improves the bit error rate performance of detection without using second-order statistic and reduces the complexity of the system.

title: A method and system for detecting money laundering transactions in complex related transactions
description: The invention discloses a detection method and system for money laundering transactions in complex related transactions. The detection method includes the following steps: establishing a cyclic neural network model, and using multiple transaction data known to be money laundering transactions to train the cyclic neural network model , until the loss of the recurrent neural network model is less than the set loss; collect multiple interrelated transaction data that is unknown whether it is money laundering, and input them into the trained recurrent neural network model in turn to obtain the judgment result of whether it is money laundering . The technical solution disclosed in the present invention trains the model according to diverse transaction data samples, and solves the problem of money laundering detection in complex related transaction data by means of cyclic input. Compared with the existing anti-money laundering rules that are manually and manually designed The technical solution of the present invention can significantly improve the efficiency of money laundering detection, simplify the formulation process of money laundering detection rules, and solve the problem of time-consuming and labor-intensive in the prior art. Note: Figure 1 is attached to the abstract.

title: Machine learning implementation for multi-analyte assay of biological sample
description: A system and method for analyzing blood-based cancer diagnostic tests using multiple classes of molecules is provided.  [Solution] The method includes receiving 210 a biological sample containing multiple classes of molecules, separating 220 the biological sample into multiple portions, identifying 230 a set of features for each of a plurality of assays to be input into a machine learning model, performing an assay for each portion of the plurality of portions against a class of molecules in that portion to obtain 240 a set of measurements of the classes of molecules in the biological sample, forming 250 a feature vector of features from the multiple sets of measurements, and inputting 270 the feature vector into a machine learning model to obtain an output classification of whether the biological sample has a specified property.  [Selected Figure] Figure 2

title: Putting and Approach Support Systems and Methods
description: A putting and approach support system, according to one embodiment of the present invention, comprises: a stride input unit which receives a user input about steps of a user; a mode input unit which receives an input for selecting a mode change according to approach and putting; a distance measurement unit which measures a foot width and stride of the user and calculates the distance from a ball to a target point as the number of steps of the user; a display unit which outputs the topography of the field and the position of the target point in association with the current position of the ball; a learning unit which learns a putting length according to a stroke length based on the distance to the target point, the topography of the field, and the position of the ball; and a recommendation unit which recommends the stroke length according to the position of the ball based on the learning result. According to the present invention, the system can be carried.

title: Method and apparatus for providing customized services based on healthcare
description: A method for providing a user-customized service based on health care in a vehicle of the present invention includes, in a sensor unit, acquiring the user's biometric information in real time; calculating, in the controller, a health status index of the user based on the biometric information; and in the display unit, when the vehicle arrives at a destination or an intermediate stopover, informing the user of non-recommended food information based on the pre-stored dietary characteristic information and the health status index of the user.

title: Apparatus and method for conversion of medical image based on artificial intelligence
description: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for converting a medical image based on artificial intelligence. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for converting a medical image based on artificial intelligence comprises the steps of: collecting learning data including a first learning image, which is a first type of medical image captured with respect to a subject, and a second learning image, which is a second type of medical image captured with respect to the subject; training an artificial intelligence model that generates a converted image, which is a virtual medical image corresponding to the second type, based on a target image corresponding to the first type, when the target image is input, based on the learning data; receiving the target image; and generating the converted image based on the artificial intelligence model. Therefore, the method can provide the converted image that is virtually simulated to be suitable to the second type corresponding to the first type, when the first type of target image is input.

title: Image processing apparatus and method for controlling the same
description: An image processing apparatus includes: a detection part that detects a plurality of types of subjects with respect to an input image; a setting part for setting the type of subject as a prior subject; and a main subject determination part which determines a detection result of a main subject based on the plurality of types of subjects detected by the detection part. The main subject determination part determines one type of subject in the same area based on the set prior subject and the type of the detected subject when there are detection results of a plurality of types of subjects in the same area.

title: Wireless distributed learning system including abnormal terminal and method of operation thereof
description: An electronic device according to various embodiments of the present disclosure includes a communication circuit and a processor, and the processor obtains information on the number of expected abnormal terminals, allocates different resources to each of a plurality of terminal groups, and The number of the plurality of terminal groups is greater than the number of the expected abnormal terminals, obtaining learning data of each of the plurality of terminal groups, and identifying a final terminal group among the plurality of terminal groups based on the learning data. can be configured.

title: System for image surveillance considering intelligent information processing
description: The present invention relates to a video surveillance system in consideration of intelligent information processing. When intelligent information processing is performed on an image and the corresponding image and the result of intelligent information processing are stored as metadata in a storage medium, the metadata is stored in the entire image. A storage area with a fixed size is formed and stored at the front end of the storage area or at each front end of an individual storage area in which frames of each image are stored, and a desired image (or frame) is accessed through the list of metadata. In this case, by first scanning only the storage area where the metadata is stored to access the desired image, unnecessary scanning of the storage medium in which the image is stored is excluded to prevent shortening of the lifespan of the storage medium and access time of the image. It relates to a system that can significantly shorten

title: apparatus for determining size of frame in multiple access network environment and method thereof
description: An apparatus for determining a frame size in a multi-access network environment according to an embodiment of the present invention includes an information collection unit that collects information corresponding to a current frame from a plurality of terminals connected to the multi-access network environment, and the collected information. a frame size determination unit for determining the frame size of the next frame based on the number of terminals performing energy harvesting among the plurality of terminals using the same, and information transmission for transmitting information on the determined frame size to the plurality of terminals. wealth may be included.

title: Analysis method for state of building and analysis apparatus
description: The building condition analysis method includes the step of receiving building data of a target building by an analysis device, calculating individual space characteristic indicators for each of the individual spaces of the target building by using at least a part of the building data by the analysis device, Calculating, by the analysis device, a total space characteristic index for the entire target building or the entire sectioned area of the target building based on the locations of the individual spaces in the target building; and evaluating the state of the target building based on the spatial marker calculated using the part. The individual space characteristic index is an index calculated based on building data collected in a corresponding individual space, and the space marker is information determined according to a specific item among conditions of a building to be evaluated.

title: Smart parking system based on intelligent image analysis
description: The intelligent video analysis-based smart parking system of the present invention includes an image acquisition unit for acquiring an image of a parking lot from a CCTV; a parking sensing unit provided on a parking surface of the CCTV image blind spot to determine whether the vehicle is parked; And a parking management server; including, wherein the parking management server, based on the image of the image acquisition unit, a video analysis unit for generating analysis data by analyzing the parking area and the vehicle area; A parking determination unit for determining whether or not a parking surface in the image is parked or not, using a model set to determine whether each parking surface of the parking lot is parked or not, based on the analysis data; a parking information management unit that collects and manages parking information including the number of available parking spaces from the parking determination unit and the parking sensing unit; a parking information providing unit providing the parking information to a parking lot user; And the CCTV image acquisition unit or a server for managing the video of the CCTV image acquisition unit, the parking sensing unit, and a communication unit for communicating with the user terminal through a communication network; and a parking management server including, the model is a parking lot As a model created by learning the image and analysis data using an artificial intelligence algorithm, it is a model created by learning standard information on whether or not a vehicle is parked and whether or not a vehicle is parked on each parking surface of a parking lot image.

title: Mobile robot device and method for measuring advertisement effect
description: The present invention relates to a mobile robot device and method for measuring advertising effectiveness. The method includes the steps of: while the mobile robot device is running, using a deep learning-based object recognition algorithm to obtain sensing information including at least one of the number, location, direction, and time spent within the identifiable distance of pedestrians located in the distance and direction where advertisements can be actually identified; and measuring advertising effectiveness based on the obtained sensing information.

title: Anti-malware algorithm and hw/fw for internal ssd health and storage space protection against cyber-attacks
description: A storage system according to the present invention includes a storage device including a host device, non-volatile memory, and at least one processor configured to implement a storage internal protection (SIP) module, wherein the SIP module corresponds to the non-volatile memory from the host device. To obtain a plurality of store commands, obtain a plurality of filtered store commands, filter the plurality of store commands, extract information about the filtered plurality of store commands, and apply the information to a machine-learning cryptocurrency mining (CM) detection algorithm, and provide a notification to the host device based on the machine learning CM detection algorithm indicating that CM activity has been detected. It is composed.

title: Device and method for removing noise from input signal
description: A computer implemented method for determining classification and/or regression results based on a provided input signal (S), comprising:    Providing a first portion (4), wherein the first portion (4) is configured to remove noise in the provided input signal (S) based on the input signal (S) and the randomly derived first value (2). -;    Randomly deriving a plurality of first values (2);    By means of the first part (4), determining a plurality of denoised signals (x), wherein the denoised signals (x) from the plurality of denoised signals (x) correspond to the provided input signal (S) and the plurality of denoised signals (x). each determined based on the first value (2) from the first value (2) of -;    determining, by the model, a plurality of prediction values based on the denoised values, each prediction value characterizing a classification of the denoised signal or a regression result based on the denoised signal;    providing an aggregate signal (y) characterizing the aggregation of predicted values.  wherein the aggregate signal (y) characterizes classification and/or regression results determined by the computer-implemented method.

title: Optimum concept selection system of ships
description: The present invention is a system for determining the optimal concept of a ship. More specifically, the present invention collects various characteristic data required for the design of existing eco-friendly ships and uses artificial intelligence, deep learning, machine learning, etc. based on the optimal eco-friendly ship concept that matches the existing eco-friendly ship design. This is about a system that determines the concept of an eco-friendly ship by calculating the design characteristics required when building a new ship by learning through a neural network that includes .

title: Blockchain smart contract vulnerability location detection method and device
description: A method and device for detecting the location of blockchain smart contract vulnerabilities are disclosed.
