description: The present invention relates to the particle group optimizing Steiner minimal tree building methods based on multistage conversion and genetic manipulation under a kind of X architecture, and in order to handle two kinds of SMT problems simultaneously, the invention proposes a kind of effective side-coding strategies.The present invention gives the search spaces that one kind can expand algorithm may insure effective convergent multistage switching strategy again.By testing the various combination from three kinds of schemes of two stages to four stage and every kind of scheme, The present invention gives a kind of optimal combinations.Discrete particle of the present invention using the genetic manipulation building combined with Union-find Sets segmentation for discrete VLSI wiring updates operation simultaneously.In addition, The present invention gives a kind of mutation operations for improving side switching strategy in order to introduce uncertain and diversity.Top-quality cabling scenario can be obtained in method of the invention in global angle.

title: Methods of processing intestinal images
description: The present invention provides a method for processing an intestinal image, the method comprising: 1) providing an intestinal image; 2) using a neural network structure to process to obtain preliminary proposed polyp segmentation data; the neural network structure includes convolution calculation and deconvolution Calculate; 3) further filter out the desired polyp segmentation data through the polyp boundary texture patch image and/or the non-polyp boundary texture patch image. The method for processing an intestinal image provided by the present invention can improve the accuracy of polyp identification.

title: Answer obtaining method, device, server and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses an answer obtaining method, an answer obtaining device, a server and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining a problem understanding result corresponding to the current problem through a predetermined recurrent neural network model; and obtaining a target answer corresponding to the current question according to the question understanding result corresponding to the current question. Not only can the time of obtaining the answer be saved, but also the accuracy of obtaining the answer can be ensured.

title: A method and device for clustering electric vehicle users based on random forest algorithm
description: The automobile user clustering method and device, technical characterstic that the present invention relates to a kind of based on random forests algorithm are: the following steps are included: step 1, obtaining electric car charging behavior big data；Step 2 deletes bad data；Step 3, data prediction；Step 4, setting charging feature target simultaneously choose appropriate variable parameter；Obtained variable data after step 3 pretreatment is input to random forests algorithm by step 5, and using the coordinate under classical multi-dimentional scale characterize each charging row be between connection；Step 6 is based on charging behavior two-dimensional coordinate obtained in step 5, and the classical multi-dimentional scale figure of all charging behaviors is drawn under rectangular coordinate system；Step 7, the cluster result for obtaining automobile user charging behavior；Step 8, the assessment that ratio, quantitative aspects are carried out to charging behavior.The present invention provides a kind of objective and reliable foundation for the judgement of charging behavior, helps to improve the accuracy and specific aim of electric car demand side management.

title: Deep Hashing Image Retrieval Method Fused with Semantic Information and Multilevel Similarity
description: The invention discloses a depth hash image retrieval method fusing semantic information and multilevel similarity, which comprises the following steps of; s1, constructing an image database; s2, constructing a label vector matrix and a semantic vector matrix; s3, constructing a similarity matrix; s4, building a deep hash neural network model, and converting the original image into an approximate hash vector; s5, constructing a loss function with lower bound on the Hamming distance of the similar picture Hash vector; s6, training the built deep Hash neural network model; s7, constructing a Hash vector database of the image; and S8, comparing the hash vector of the image to be retrieved with the vector in the hash vector database to find out a similar image. According to the invention, by fusing semantic information, the precision of image retrieval is improved; and by restricting the lower bound of the hamming distance between the hash vectors corresponding to the two similar pictures, the retrieval performance is improved.

title: A closed-loop model-based controller for accelerated memory and skill acquisition
description: A closed-loop control system for memory consolidation in subjects is described. During operation, the system encodes information about environmental events into memories in both long-term and short-term memory storage. The system generates a representation of the activation level of the attentional memory associated with at least one of the environmental events. An association strength representation of the memory is also generated. Memory consolidation is simulated by reinforcing the association strength representation associated with the attentional memory when the subject is in NREM sleep or quiet wakefulness. The system predicts the probability of recalling the attentional memory through cues based on behavioral performance related to the attentional memory. An intervention system can be activated when the behavioral performance falls below a threshold.

title: Robustness ordering learning method based on multi-target particle swarm optimization and application thereof
description: The invention relates to a robustness ordering learning method based on multi-target particle swarm optimization and application thereof, comprising the following steps: firstly, based on a deviation-variance balance theory, designing an effectiveness deviation function and a robustness variance function of a sequencing model, and constructing two optimized performance indexes of sequencing learning; on the sorting learning data set, based on a multi-objective particle swarm optimization algorithm framework, iterating and optimizing two targets of a validity deviation function and a robustness variance function of a sorting model to train the sorting model, so as to generate a sorting model filing solution set; and thirdly, selecting a Pareto optimal sorting model with a maximum net flow sorting value from the sorting model archiving solution set generated in the last step based on the thought of a preference sequence structure evaluation method PROMETHEE II in the multi-attribute decision theory, and taking the Pareto optimal sorting model as a trained final sorting model. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of improving the overall user satisfaction, enhancing the user experience and the like.

title: A kind of digital communication blind demodulation method and device
description: The embodiment of the present application discloses a kind of blind demodulation method of digital communication and device, method includes: acquisition sample data, wherein, sample data includes to the complex baseband signal obtained after binary data modulation, and class label corresponding with the complex baseband signal, the modulation system of the binary data are a variety of；Convolutional neural networks are constructed, the sample data is divided into training data and test data, the convolutional neural networks is trained, obtain trained convolutional neural networks；Signal to be processed is obtained, the trained convolutional neural networks are input to, the class label of the maximum probability of convolutional neural networks output is obtained, bit stream corresponding with signal to be processed is converted to based on the class label.The embodiment of the present application is suitable for the blind demodulation of digital communication signal of various different modulating modes, has versatility.

title: Customer satisfaction assessment method and device, and computer readable storage medium
description: A kind of customer satisfaction appraisal procedure and device, computer readable storage medium, the customer satisfaction appraisal procedure, comprising: obtain more wheel dialog texts to be assessed；Sentence in more wheel dialog texts is divided according to timing, obtains multiple statement sequences；Feature extraction is carried out to the multiple statement sequence using natural language feature extractor respectively, obtains validity feature collection；According to the validity feature collection, the one-to-one temporal aspect sequence of the multiple statement sequence is constructed；The one-to-one temporal aspect sequence inputting of the multiple statement sequence is subjected to customer satisfaction assessment into preset Recognition with Recurrent Neural Network classifier, obtains the corresponding customer satisfaction assessment result of more wheel dialog texts.Using the above scheme, it can be improved customer satisfaction Evaluation accuracy.

title: BP neural network wind speed prediction method for neuron branch evolution
description: The invention discloses a BP neural network wind speed prediction method based on neuron branch evolution, including obtaining historical meteorological data of wind farms; constructing wind speed influence characteristic factors; preprocessing the historical meteorological data, including correlation analysis, inputting Variable selection and normalization processing; establish a BP neural network model, use the preprocessed historical meteorological data to train the BP neural network model, adopt the idea of group evolution in the training process, and combine the differential operation and firefly algorithm to evolve the parameter population in the neural network model; obtain the actual meteorological data of the wind farm, input the actual meteorological data into the neural network, and calculate the predicted wind speed value. The present invention realizes grouping optimization by using the hidden layer neurons as the branch reference, and supplements the global optimization after judging the grouping effect. Therefore, the present invention has relatively lower computational complexity and higher prediction accuracy than the traditional method.

title: Computing device and method
description: A computing device, comprising: a storage unit (10) for acquiring input data and computing instructions; a controller unit (11) for fetching computation instructions from the memory unit (10), decoding the computation instructions to obtain one or more computation instructions and sending the one or more computation instructions and input data to the computation unit (12); and an arithmetic unit (12) for performing a calculation on the input data according to one or more arithmetic instructions to obtain a result of the arithmetic instruction. The computing device represents the data participating in machine learning calculation by adopting fixed point data, so that the processing speed and the processing efficiency of training calculation can be improved.

title: Neural network processor board and related products
description: The present disclosure provides a neural network processor board and related products. The neural network processor board includes: a neural network chip packaging structure, a first electrical and non-electrical connection device, and a first substrate; the neural network chip packaging The structure includes: a neural network chip, a second electrical and non-electrical connection device, and a second substrate, the second substrate carries the neural network chip, and the second substrate is connected to the second substrate through the second electrical and non-electrical connection device. Neural network chip connection described above. The technical solution provided by the present disclosure has the advantages of small calculation amount and low power consumption.

title: Method and system for processing blurred picture in sharpening mode based on deep neural network
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for processing a fuzzy picture in a sharpening way based on a deep neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: fuzzifying the original image P by a fuzzy algorithm to obtain an image The original image P and the image after the fuzzification processing are processed Training a BiCycleGAN network as training data; in actual application, the fuzzy image to be processed is transmitted to the server, and after receiving the fuzzy image data, the server calls the trained BiCycleGAN network to perform sharpening processing and returns a processing result. The method solves the problem of blurring caused by hardware or image content, utilizes the deep neural network to solve the problem, and expands the processing mode for solving the image blurring.

title: AI Software Market
description: The invention relates to an artificial intelligence software market. Example operations may include one or more of the following: generating a digest of a hash that includes a hash of one or more validation data sets and a hash of data points selected from a producer node in a previous iteration; and exposing a digest of the hash to a plurality of producer nodes; iteratively receiving a plurality of requests from the plurality of producer nodes respectively, wherein each request identifies an edge value provided by a hash of a data sample available to the producer node, Select a request received from a producer node based on an edge value associated with the request, fetch the hashed data of the producer node associated with the selected request, and compare the hashed data of the producer node with the The digests of the hashes generated in one or more previous iterations are aggregated to produce an updated digest, and the updated digest is stored via a data block of the distributed ledger.

title: Photovoltaic system maximum power tracking method under a kind of shadowed condition based on artificial bee colony algorithm
description: The present invention relates to photovoltaic system maximum power tracking methods under a kind of shadowed condition based on artificial bee colony algorithm, belong to technical field of electric power system control.Firstly, establishing photovoltaic system model and MPPT Controlling model；Secondly, by photovoltaic system received intensity of illumination S, temperature T and output voltage be input in the MPPT controller of ABC and carry out optimizing repeatedly until algorithmic statement；The optimal output voltage of photovoltaic system is obtained finally, the optimal duty ratio that MPPT controller exports is input to after insulated gate bipolar transistor to realize MPPT.The present invention can solve the problems, such as that the photovoltaic array MPPT control under shadowed condition with multimodal output characteristics is easily trapped into local maximum power point, the algorithm is compared with the convergent of traditional algorithm using Matlab software, iteration speed and stability can be effectively improved.

title: Target sentiment analysis method and system based on attention gate convolutional network
description: The invention discloses a target emotion analysis method and system based on attention-gated convolutional network, including: step 1, the input is a given context word vector and a corresponding target word vector, and the two are respectively used as input for training ; Step 2, use context words and context-aware target words to interact with multi-head attention mechanisms; Step 3, pass the emotional feature vectors c  intra  and t  inter  generated by the two channels through the gated convolution mechanism to generate context-aware targets The context word represented by the word represents a  i  and the context word represents u  i  ; step 4, pool the emotional feature o  i  , and select the most representative feature; step 5, perform full connection on the pooled feature word vector, Classification is then performed by a Softmax classifier; step 6, training and updating the attention-gated convolutional network model by minimizing the cross-entropy loss function. The invention can not only effectively improve the accuracy rate but also shorten the convergence time, and has stronger practicability.

title: Epileptic focus three-dimensional automatic positioning system based on deep learning
description: The invention discloses a three-dimensional automatic positioning system for epileptogenic foci based on deep learning. The system includes: a PET image acquisition and marking module; a registration module between the PET image and a standard symmetrical brain template; a PET image data preprocessing module, which generates left and right images Mirrored pairs of brain image patches; SiameseNet training module, consisting of two deep residual convolutional neural networks sharing weight parameters, the output layer connecting the multilayer perceptron and the softmax layer, using the images with epileptogenic foci and normal images. The training set is used to train the network to obtain a network model; the classification module and the epileptogenic foci location module use the trained network model to generate a probability heat map for the newly input PET image, and first determine whether the image is normal or carries epileptogenic through the classifier Focus samples, and then predict the location of the epileptogenic foci. The system automatically locates the epileptogenic foci in PET images by introducing the mirror pair of image blocks and the twin network SiameseNet, which can effectively improve the accuracy and efficiency of epileptogenic foci localization, and has high robustness.

title: Similar character recognition method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a similar word recognition method, device, computer equipment and storage medium, wherein the method includes: for each text to be processed in the form of a picture, respectively obtain the picture feature, text element feature and text structure feature of the text; according to The obtained features identify similar words in the text to be processed. Applying the scheme of the present invention can improve the accuracy of the recognition result and the like.

title: A Semantic Enhanced Subspace Cross-Media Retrieval Method Based on Quadratic Discriminant Analysis
description: A semantic enhancer space cross-media retrieval method based on secondary discriminant analysis comprises the following steps: extracting original feature representations of the image and the text data, and constructing a corresponding training data set and a corresponding testing data set; establishing semantic enhancer spaces of the image and the text data respectively through secondary discriminant analysis, and calculating similarity matrixes of the image and the text data respectively; according to the semantic enhancer space of the image and text data, projecting the similarity matrix to a public semantic subspace through a mapping model, and calculating the similarity matrix between image text pairs in the public semantic subspace through a similarity measurement method; respectively solving mapping matrix parameters corresponding to the image retrieval text and the text retrieval image through a training data set; and performing cross-media retrieval of the image retrieval text and the text retrieval image by using the test set based on the mapping matrix parameters corresponding to the image retrieval text and the text retrieval image.

title: Method for detecting irregular defects of industrial products
description: A method for detecting irregular defects of industrial products, comprising the following steps: step 1, image enhancement processing, specifically including histogram equalization and histogram matching; step 2, building a network model; step 3, setting relevant parameters of the network model, specifically Including the setting of the default box, the matching method of the default box, and the composition of the loss function. The method first performs image enhancement processing on the collected sample images to make the defects more obvious; then, based on the convolutional neural network CNN, combined with the SSD target recognition model, the defect detection network model is constructed, and the model parameters are reasonably designed, which can effectively Solve detection challenges for irregular defects.

title: A method and system for generating a subway environment target training set
description: The invention discloses a method and system for generating a subway environment target training set. A game confrontation generation network is used to automatically generate possible obstacles into the natural environment of rail transit by learning the characteristics of normal objects in urban rail transit. At the same time, a decision network is used to distinguish generated data from real data. Through the game process of generative network and decision network, the real simulation of urban traffic obstacles is realized, and the target training set of subway environment is obtained. Adopting the present invention can improve the accuracy of target training.

title: Hyperspectral remote sensing image super-resolution method based on self-fusion convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses a hyperspectral remote sensing image super-resolution method based on a self-fusion convolutional neural network, which comprises the steps of designing a self-fusion convolutional neural network comprising three parallel convolutional processes; sequentially carrying out normalization processing, 2-time double-three down-sampling and 2-time double-three up-sampling on 8 high-spectrum remote sensing images, and designing training data and training labels on the obtained 8 images; then training the self-fusion convolutional neural network by using the obtained training data and training labels until the iteration of the training process is finished to obtain a trained network; and finally, inputting the low-resolution hyperspectral remote sensing image to be processed into a trained network as test data to obtain a target high-resolution hyperspectral remote sensing image. The method solves the problem of low spatial resolution of the hyperspectral remote sensing image in the prior art.

title: Field determination method, device, storage medium and electronic device
description: The present invention provides a field determination method, device, storage medium and electronic device, including: respectively determining the similarity between an original field and a plurality of preset fields, wherein the similarity is used to indicate that the original field includes The similarity between the original feature and the preset feature corresponding to the original feature included in the preset field, the number of the original feature is at least two; based on the determined multiple groups of the similarity from the multiple Determine the target field that matches the original field among the preset fields. The present invention solves the problem of low efficiency and accuracy by manually mapping the data table and its fields, thereby achieving the effect of improving efficiency and accuracy.

title: Power distribution communication network fusion control method and system based on machine learning technology
description: The invention provides a power distribution communication network fusion control method and system based on machine learning technology, which collects multi-source data of various devices of a power distribution communication network, identifies the content of the multi-source data and obtains sample information sent by a port number, the sample information is used for determining the number of neurons in a hidden layer of a neural network, thereby improving the identification accuracy of the neural network, the trained neural network processes the multi-source data to obtain a plurality of flow characteristics with strongest relativity, identifies the flow characteristics to obtain the corresponding protocol types, then can fuse the same type of protocols to ensure the stable and reliable operation of the power distribution communication network, and the neurons in the hidden layer of the neural network are determined by the obtained multi-source data, so the neural network can effectively identify the flow characteristics with high precision, thereby facilitating the fusion after classification, and a reliable foundation is improved for the stable operation of the power distribution communication network.

title: Semantic map construction method and computer storage medium based on convolutional neural network
description: The present invention provides a method for constructing a semantic map based on a convolutional neural network and a computer storage medium, the method comprising the following steps: S1, receiving a 2D image, passing it into a convolutional neural network model, and outputting dense pixel-level semantic probability map points neurons; S2, use the Bayesian update model to track the classification probability distribution of each surface; S3, use the ElasticFusion method to provide data for correlation prediction, and update the probability distribution; S4, use the conditional random field regularization model to pass the scale of the map information to improve semantic detection. The method for constructing a semantic map based on a convolutional neural network according to an embodiment of the present invention can perform semantic segmentation based on a convolutional neural network, generate a semantic map, and enhance its robustness with few weak textures.

title: Convolutional neural network computing circuit based on speech signal-to-noise ratio pre-grading in real-time scenarios
description: The invention discloses a convolution neural network computing circuit based on voice signal-to-noise ratio pre-grading in a real-time scene, and belongs to the technical field of computing, calculating and counting. On the basis of the traditional voice recognition network circuit working mode of 'voice feature extraction + convolution calculation recognition output', a dynamic real-time voice signal-to-noise ratio detection module is additionally arranged. The dynamic real-time voice signal-to-noise ratio detection module outputs a circuit working mode control signal under the current voice scene in real time through intelligent sensing calculation, dynamically adjusts the data operation bit width of a subsequent bit width controllable convolution network calculation module and the butterfly operation stage number of the fast Fourier transform of the self-adaptive voice feature extraction calculation module, and fundamentally solves the problems of poor scene adaptability, more redundant calculation and excessive resource occupation existing in the traditional convolution network calculation circuit structure.

title: Method and device for training classification model and classification method and device
description: A method and device for training a classification model as well as a classification method and device are disclosed. A classification method includes: extracting features from the information to be tested input to the trained classification model; compressing the extracted features into low-dimensional latent features that can represent the information to be tested; decompressing the latent features to obtain Decompressed features; based on the decompressed features, the information to be tested is reconstructed to obtain the reconstructed information to be tested; based on the reconstruction loss between the information to be tested and the reconstructed information to be tested, it is judged whether the information to be tested belongs to Whether the known category belongs to the unknown category; and if it is determined that the information to be tested belongs to the known category, the information to be tested is classified through the trained classification model.

title: Real-time face detection method based on MobileNet V3
description: A real-time face detection method based on MobileNet V3 belongs to the field of face recognition. The invention designs a real-time face detector based on an SSD architecture. Meanwhile, the MobileNet V3 convolutional neural network is applied to a real-time face detection task for the first time. In addition, a lightweight feature improvement module is also provided, the representation capability of shallow features in the MobileNet V3 is enhanced, and the detection accuracy of the extremely small human face is improved. Finally, in order to improve the recall rate of extremely small faces, an anchor density strategy is used, so that different types of anchors have the same density on the image. SSRFD was able to achieve 99.43% maps on AFW dataset with only 0.62M parameter; in the aspect of speed, a 1024x1024 high-resolution picture is used for testing on an NVIDIA TITANX card, and the method can achieve the frame rate of 34 fps.

title: Adversarial defense method and related device for image classification network
description: The present application is about an adversarial defense method and related devices for an image classification network, belonging to the field of image classification technology. The method includes: inputting the original image sample and the adversarial attack sample into a deep neural network to extract the input features of the target layer of the deep neural network that is higher than a predetermined number of layers; generating the loss function of the deep neural network according to the input features as an adversarial defense denoiser; denoising the adversarial attack sample using the adversarial defense denoiser to obtain a denoised adversarial attack sample; regularizing the loss function of the deep neural network to obtain a regularized deep neural network; inputting the original image sample and the denoised adversarial attack sample into the regularized deep neural network to obtain the classification result of the original image. The scheme of the present application can effectively improve the defense capability of the image classification deep neural network.

title: A method and system for automatic detection of illegal buildings based on DSSD
description: The invention relates to the field of illegal building image recognition, in particular to a DSSD-based automatic illegal building detection method and system. The method comprises the steps that an image workstation acquires a collected illegal building picture, then a DSSD neural network is used for distinguishing, and finally a result obtained by processing of a detection system is sent to a system terminal. The invention completes an automatic detection violation building system based on an intelligent image processing technology and a neural network, can reduce the workload of manual identification to a certain extent, and has important significance for urban dynamic monitoring, violation building identification, geographic information updating and the like.

title: Injection upper limit optimization method and system during distributed power supply communication fault
description: The invention discloses an injection upper limit optimization method and system during distributed power supply communication faults, wherein the injection upper limit optimization method comprises the following steps: step S1: establishing a correspondence model of a communication fault scene and a link validity state according to a fault mode consequence analysis method, and obtaining a communication fault scene and link validity state table; step S2: establishing a double-layer multi-objective optimization model of the distributed power supply differentiated injection upper limit based on a communication fault scene and a link validity state table; step S3: and performing loop iteration on the double-layer multi-target optimization model by adopting an interval power flow and particle swarm intelligent optimization algorithm to realize optimization of the differential injection upper limit of the unconnected DG.

title: Deep learning offline reasoning load balancing method for Internet of vehicles
description: The invention discloses a deep learning offline reasoning load balancing method for an internet of vehicles. The method comprises the following steps: determining a master vehicle in the Internet of vehicles; calculating the memory occupation of each layer of network of the deep learning neural network to obtain a memory consumption sequence; smoothing the memory consumption sequence; calculating a neural network layer fluctuation characteristic sequence; performing task division on the deep learning neural network to obtain an initial task sequence; acquiring the computing performance of each node device in the Internet of vehicles; acquiring a redundancy multiple sequence of the calculation performance of all the nodes of the Internet of vehicles by taking the lowest calculation performance as a reference, and correcting the initial task sequence; and obtaining the optimal matching between the tasks in the corrected task sequence and the vehicle nodes, and distributing the tasks to each vehicle node. By using the method and the system, the task can be completed through cross-device cooperation in the scene of the Internet of vehicles, the design cost is low, and the practicability is high.

title: Crowd situation analysis method and device and electronic equipment
description: The present application provides a crowd situation analysis method, device and electronic device. The method includes: inputting a collected video stream of a designated area into a multi-task network model, so that at least two sub-networks of the multi-task network model output at least two Crowd situation parameters with correlation; wherein, the sub-networks of the multi-task network model are obtained by training samples containing at least two different labels, and different sub-networks are used to output different crowd situation parameters; determined according to the crowd situation parameters Whether the crowd situation in the designated area meets the alarm conditions; if so, output alarm information. According to the technical solution of the present application, the electronic device can obtain accurate crowd situation parameters through a multi-task network model, and then can analyze whether the crowd situation in the designated area meets the alarm conditions according to the crowd situation parameters, so that the crowd situation in the designated area satisfies the alarm conditions. accurate alarm.

title: Network slice resource mapping method based on reinforcement learning
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a network slice resource mapping method based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: receiving a network slice resource mapping request; triggering node resource mapping according to the network slice resource mapping request, wherein value evaluation is carried out on value information of the physical nodes, sorting information of the value of the physical nodes is provided according to an evaluation result, and network function resource mapping is carried out on the physical nodes with the maximum value according to the sorting information; and triggering link resource mapping, performing set secondary simulation link selection, calculating a feedback result of the set secondary simulation link selection, selecting an optimal value in the feedback result, and performing link resource mapping according to the link selection corresponding to the optimal value, so that the problem that the value information of the physical nodes is not considered in the prior art is solved, and the resource utilization rate of each physical node can be improved under the condition that the value information of the physical nodes is considered to perform physical node resource mapping.

title: Position self-adaptive action recognition method based on commercial WiFi
description: The invention provides a position self-adaptive action recognition method based on commercial WiFi, which is characterized in that amplitude information is extracted from CSI data according to the principle that human body action influences the CSI, trend component components are obtained by using a singular spectrum analysis method, then the action recognition capability based on an LSTM classification model is generalized to all positions through pseudo label semi-supervised learning, a double-scoring multi-classifier is adopted during semi-supervised learning, the scoring of the classifier and the scoring of categories are used as weighting items of classification probability by a double-scoring mechanism, the scoring precision is improved, and the position self-adaptive high-precision action recognition is realized. Experiments show that the method can achieve the action recognition accuracy rate of about 85% for all positions, improves the precision by about 40% compared with the precision of directly using a source domain model, and can be generalized to positions where action data are not collected.

title: Pedestrian attribute recognition and positioning method and convolutional neural network system
description: A pedestrian attribute identification and positioning method and a convolutional neural network system, the method comprises: extracting features of various different abstract degrees from an image to be detected to obtain various first feature maps of pedestrian attributes; convolving the multiple first feature maps to obtain multiple second feature maps, mapping each second feature map into multiple overlapping area bins, and respectively carrying out maximum pooling on each bin to obtain multiple high-dimensional feature vectors; wherein a plurality of mutually overlapping bins uniformly cover each of the second feature maps; processing various high-dimensional feature vectors into low-dimensional vectors to obtain the recognition result of the pedestrian attribute; and further, according to the plurality of second feature maps and the plurality of high-dimensional feature vectors, the positioning result of the pedestrian attribute can be obtained. The method can overcome the adverse factors in video monitoring and better identify and position the pedestrian attribute.

title: Question generation method and system based on given facts
description: The invention relates to a question generation method and a question generation system based on given facts, wherein the question generation method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical reference data, wherein the historical reference data comprises historical input information of a plurality of different users; expanding each history input information to obtain a corresponding context representation; establishing a question generation model according to each piece of input information and the corresponding context representation; and determining a question sequence corresponding to the current input information according to the current input information of the current user based on the question generation model. According to the invention, a question generation model is established through historical reference data; the question generation model can be based on the question generation model, and the question sequence corresponding to the current input information can be accurately determined according to a small amount of current input information given by the current user.

title: Cabinet internal layout design method, device, system and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a cabinet internal layout design method, device, system and storage medium, comprising: obtaining the current internal layout of the cabinet; using a functional cabinet category determination model constructed according to a deep neural network to design the current internal layout of the cabinet The category of functional cabinets in the remaining space of the cabinet, and then use the function cabinet position determination model constructed according to the deep neural network to determine the position of the category of functional cabinets in the remaining space of the cabinet; when the cabinet is full of functional cabinets, use the depth The functional cabinet area segmentation model constructed by the neural network is based on the corresponding internal layout of the cabinet when the cabinet is full of functional cabinets to segment the functional cabinet area, so as to realize the internal layout design of the cabinet. It can realize the automatic design of the remaining space inside the cabinet based on the current internal layout of the cabinet including the outline of the cabinet, so as to reduce the workload of the designer.

title: An Adaptive Threshold Adjustment Diagnosis Method Based on Improved BP Neural Network
description: The invention discloses an adaptive threshold adjustment and diagnosis method based on an improved BP neural network, and relates to the field of fault diagnosis of intelligent electric meters. In practical applications, the threshold for determining a dropped connection or other fault type is usually determined empirically, and a scientific set of threshold adjustment algorithms is lacking. The invention acquires historical message data information and experience threshold information of communication equipment such as an ammeter and the like to train a BP neural network, introduces an accuracy feedback mechanism based on the training result of the BP neural network on the threshold, adaptively adjusts the threshold, adjusts the threshold according to the judgment accuracy and the expected system accuracy, and obtains a dynamic threshold S '(t') of adaptive fault diagnosis k+1 ) (ii) a According to the obtained dynamic threshold value S' (t) of the adaptive fault diagnosis k+1 ) Failure of system acquisition equipmentAnd (6) diagnosis. The technical scheme has important scientific significance and application value for local adaptive diagnosis of the offline and other fault conditions of communication equipment such as an electric power system ammeter and the like.

title: Large-scale regional parking lot big data analysis system
description: The invention provides a large-scale regional parking lot big data analysis system, which belongs to the technical field of smart parking big data. The system includes A: The system business architecture includes a smart parking platform, and the smart parking platform includes system business, data, deployment location, and deployment environment. ;B: System user analysis: According to the needs of various types of system users, the solution of system users is analyzed through the integration of commercial parking + roadside + shared static traffic; C: System construction: based on parking knowledge graph construction, D: System Business process; E: system functional architecture; F: system technical architecture. Based on big data, artificial intelligence, image recognition and knowledge graph technologies, this system has established a smart parking big data platform, which plays a supporting role in optimizing the revenue of the parking lot, solving parking congestion, building smart static traffic, and developing the automotive aftermarket business.

title: Trainable compressed sensing module and image segmentation method
description: The invention discloses a trainable compressed sensing module and an image segmentation method, comprising the following steps: constructing a network model with the trainable compressed sensing module; taking a three-dimensional PET image of a non-small cell lung tumor as a training The data set is brought into the network model to train the network, and the trained network is obtained. It can achieve information compression during the training process, remove redundant feature maps and enhance effective feature maps. The segmentation results are more accurate, the segmentation speed is faster, and the number of parameters used is less.

title: Method and system for predicting motion trail of robot
description: Methods and systems for predicting a motion profile of a robot are provided. Training data of motion trajectories of robots are received for a plurality of pairs of robot positions. Processing the training data to obtain x-tuples and y-tuples for machine learning purposes; wherein the x-tuple describes the pair of robot positions and the y-tuple describes one or more intermediate robot positions at a particular timestamp during movement of the robot between the positions of the pair of positions. Based on the processed data, a function for mapping the x-tuple to the y-tuple is learned to generate a motion prediction module for the robot. For a given pair of robot positions, the robot motion between the given pair is predicted by obtaining the corresponding intermediate positions generated by the motion prediction module.

title: Building spoil particle size distribution rapid identification method based on convolutional neural network
description: The invention relates to a method for quickly identifying the particle size distribution of building spoil based on a convolutional neural network. The method identifies a convolutional neural network model based on a pre-trained building spoil particle size distribution, processes a building spoil image to be tested, and obtains an image of the building spoil to be tested. The particle size distribution of the tested construction spoil; wherein, the image of the construction spoil is: the construction spoil to be tested is pretreated and dispersed in a solution to obtain a dilute solution, and then the dilute solution is photographed and image-processed in sequence, and the result is obtained. The resulting binary image. Compared with the prior art, the present invention combines artificial intelligence with traditional geotechnical tests, adopts non-direct contact detection means, realizes long-distance rapid detection and effective recording of the particle size distribution of building spoil, and has the advantages of convenient operation, simple and practical, The results have the advantages of good reproducibility and high test accuracy, which provide a reliable and effective pretreatment method for the utilization of building spoil resources, and have high promotion value and environmental benefits.

title: Automatic verification method for air-ground communication repeating semantics based on BilSTM-Attention
description: A method for automatically checking the repeating semantics of air-ground communication based on BilSTM-Attention. The method comprises the steps of making a Chinese-English land-air communication repeating corpus; obtaining a word vector sequence of two sentences in each air-ground communication repeating sentence pair; obtaining a feature vector of a land-air communication repeating statement pair output by a BilSTM network; and obtaining and splicing the instruction statement semantic feature vector sent by the controller and the repeating statement semantic feature vector of the pilot, inputting the spliced statement semantic feature vector into the multilayer perceptron, and obtaining the matching score of the statement pair and the classification result of the repeating statement which is consistent or inconsistent. The invention has the advantages that: can catch the contact between land and air conversation instruction and reciting effectively, and then can improve the check-up result, can reduce controller's working strength, improve the check-up precision, have the significance to civil aviation transportation safety.

title: Short depth circuit as quantum classifier
description: A system includes quantum hardware, a memory storing computer-executable components, and a processor executing the computer-executable components stored in the memory. The computer-executable components include a calibration component for calibrating the quantum hardware to generate short-depth quantum circuits. The computer-executable components also include a cost function component that determines a cost function for the short-depth quantum circuits based on initial values of parameters from a machine learning classifier. The computer-executable components further include a training component that modifies the initial values of the parameters during training to second values based on the cost function of the short-depth quantum circuits.

title: Business model training method, device and business model training system
description: The embodiments of this specification provide a business model training method and apparatus. The business model includes at least one non-linear model structure. The model training system includes a first member device and a second member device, the first member device has a tag value, and the sub-models of each member device together form a business model. While the model is training, the loop process is executed iteratively. In each cycle, each member device obtains the current predicted value of the current business model by using the training sample data and respective current sub-models, wherein the model calculation corresponding to the at least one nonlinear model structure is implemented by linear approximation. When the cycle end condition is not met, the current sub-model of each member device is adjusted according to the current predicted difference, and the adjusted current sub-model of each member device is used as the current sub-model of the next cycle process.

title: Teaching system and smart mirror using the teaching system
description: The invention discloses a teaching system and an intelligent mirror using the teaching system, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence. When using this teaching system to learn sports actions, users do not need to wear hardware equipment, and learn by watching the images and videos played by the display module. At the same time, the system uses the camera module to capture human body information, and then processes it through the central control module. The display module intuitively feeds back whether the actions performed by the user are standard and normative and relevant suggestions. The user adjusts the action according to the information fed back by the system, thereby improving the standard and professional degree of the sports action. Installing the teaching system in the mirror can not only ensure the user's basic needs for the mirror, but also when the camera module captures the user's actions, the user can guess and adjust his actions according to the mirror surface, which is convenient to improve the standard and professionalism of the user's movement and action. Spend.

title: Growth recording method, device, electronic device and storage medium of colony image
description: The embodiment of the invention discloses a growth recording method, device, electronic device and storage medium of a colony image. The method includes: during the growth of the colony, collecting a current first colony image according to a preset period; according to a target neural network model Perform colony detection on the first colony image to obtain first detection information; acquire second detection information corresponding to the second colony image recorded last time; if it is determined that the second detection information and the first detection information exist When the colonies that meet the preset conditions are grown, the first colony image and the first detection information are recorded. Colony detection through the target neural network model can accurately detect all growing colonies to accurately record the growth of the colonies; at the same time, by comparing the detection information with the last recorded colony image and recording, it can greatly save manpower cost and storage space.

title: An intelligent mining system for sensitive information in public opinion information
description: The invention discloses an intelligent mining system for sensitive information in public opinion information, comprising: a public opinion information preprocessing module for filtering out impurity information in the public opinion information to obtain filtered public opinion information; The information display interface receives and records the manually labeled information to obtain the labeled public opinion information; the sensitive information identification module based on the bert model is used to train the sensitive information classification model according to the labeled public opinion information to obtain the mining model; the public opinion information sensitive intelligent mining module is used for Intelligently mine public opinion information in real time according to the mining model and output the mining results; the sensitive information visualization module is used to display the public opinion information and mining results in a visual form on the information display interface. The above-mentioned system can combine the needs of public opinion staff to complete sensitive and intelligent mining of public opinion information, which is convenient for public opinion staff to understand and grasp public opinion information in real time and conveniently, and assist relevant staff to complete decision-making.

title: A face image normalization method based on decoupled expression learning generative adversarial network
description: The invention discloses a face image transformation method based on decoupling expression learning to generate confrontation network. The identity information representation of the face image, combined with the hidden posture code, can explicitly control the posture of the generated face image. The three discriminators predict the true and false, posture and identity information of the face image respectively, so as to generate a face with rich texture details. image. The present invention can significantly improve the visual quality of the generated face image.

title: Optical probe for cervical examination
description: A system for cervical imaging and examination includes a control module connectable to a replaceable head configured to image the cervix and acquire tissue biopsies, the head being selected from the group consisting of a digital colposcope module, a transvaginal optical probe module, and a cervical endoscope module. The system also includes one or more light sources to illuminate cervical tissue; one or more sensing devices to generate one or more signals based on light and/or acquire one or more images of a portion of the cervix; and one or more processors communicating with the one or more sensing devices. The system is configured to (i) analyze the one or more signals; (ii) detect the size of the cervix; (iii) determine parameters defining the properties of the cervix; (iv) identify and differentiate normal and abnormal tissue within the cervix; (v) determine the location of one or more regions of abnormal tissue within the cervix; and (vi) generate a panoramic view of the cervix.

title: Neural network pulse synchronization method and system containing clustering topological coupling
description: The invention relates to a neural network pulse synchronization method and system containing clustering topological coupling, comprising the following steps: establishing an isolated neural network model with random disturbance and a derivative coupled neural network model with a plurality of clusters; establishing an error network model according to the isolated neural network model and the derivative coupled neural network model, and designing a pulse containment controller according to the topological structure of the error neural network model and a pulse signal; selecting a corresponding function according to the error network model, and combining the pulse pinning controller to realize cluster synchronization between the derivative coupled neural network model and the isolated neural network model; and constructing a neural network model, carrying out numerical simulation by using the neural network model, and verifying the clustering synchronization effect between the derivative coupled neural network model and the isolated neural network model. The invention has low cost and is beneficial to accurately controlling the synchronous rate.

title: Training data generation method, model training method and equipment
description: The present invention provides a training data generation method, a model training method and equipment. The training data generation method includes: acquiring multiple fundus images of the same eyeball, where the multiple fundus images come from different domains and have the same label information. ; Fusion of the plurality of fundus images into one fundus image according to the weight; fusion of the plurality of label information into one label information according to the weight, as the label information of the fused fundus image.

title: An image recognition method, apparatus, device and readable storage medium
description: The embodiments of the present application disclose an image recognition method, device, device, and readable storage medium. The method includes: acquiring an image sample, outputting a category prediction probability corresponding to the image sample through an image recognition model; determining the corresponding image sample according to the category prediction probability If the image prediction category is inconsistent with the image category label of the image sample, the first gradient value corresponding to the image category label and the second gradient value corresponding to the image prediction category are respectively determined according to the category prediction probability; according to the first gradient value value and the second gradient value, determine the target loss function value of the image sample, adjust the image recognition model according to the target loss function value, obtain the target image recognition model, and perform image category recognition processing based on the target image recognition model. By adopting the present application, the classification accuracy of images can be improved.

title: A closed-loop detection method based on various network characteristics
description: The invention discloses a closed-loop detection method based on multiple network features, which has better robust performance under environmental changes, adopts multiple network features as image feature descriptors, and uses different network output layers of different neural network models The feature combination is used to characterize the image, so that the image descriptor can carry richer and more accurate information, thereby improving the performance of the entire closed-loop detection algorithm. Compared with other methods that use convolutional neural networks for closed-loop detection, the present invention combines the features of different levels of various neural network models, and integrates the low-level and high-level image information of different neural network models, making image representation more accurate. The feature dimensionality reduction operation is performed before the feature cascading, so that the real-time performance of the method is guaranteed.

title: Credit evaluation method, device, storage medium and server
description: The embodiments of the present application disclose a credit evaluation method, a device, a storage medium and a server, which belong to the technical field of financial risk control. The method includes: acquiring user data of a user to be evaluated; processing the user data through a pre-trained credit evaluation model to obtain a credit score of the user, the credit evaluation model being created based on a logistic regression algorithm, and the The logistic regression algorithm is optimized based on the quantum particle swarm algorithm; the credit degree of the user is determined according to the credit score. The embodiment of the present application can not only improve the accuracy of the credit score, thereby improving the accuracy of the loan limit; also improve the efficiency of the credit score, thereby improving the review speed of the loan limit; and also improve the accuracy of the credit evaluation model.

title: Non-invasive load decomposition method based on improved genetic algorithm
description: The invention discloses a non-intrusive load decomposition method based on an improved genetic algorithm. The load history data is input; the power characteristics of each load state are extracted, and the load history data is marked with a load state label; The probability of appearing in the load power; input the total load power data to be decomposed, complete the optimization iteration according to the improved genetic algorithm; output the load decomposition result. The present invention makes the results of non-intrusive load decomposition closer to the actual situation. Aiming at the problem that the load state identification degree is not high in the traditional non-intrusive load decomposition method, the power characteristics of the load are selected as the basic characteristics. The load decomposition problem is transformed into a combinatorial optimization problem, and a new penalty term is incorporated into the objective function of the genetic algorithm to make the probability of working state combination as large as possible, which can effectively improve the accuracy of load identification.

title: Neural network image identification system, neural network construction system and method
description: The invention relates to a neural network image identification system, a neural network establishment system and a method, wherein the neural network establishment method comprises the following steps: forming an instruction graph label combination sequence according to a plurality of instruction graph labels which are clicked by a user and displayed on a picture; combining a plurality of program groups corresponding to the plurality of instruction graphic tags in the same order as the contents of the instruction graphic tag combination sequence to generate a neural network program; and checking whether the command graphic label assembly sequence conforms to one or more preset rules before the neural network program is compiled. Therefore, the image identification device is used for identifying the image to be identified shot by the shooting device, and the neural network image identification program of the image identification device for identifying the image can be built by the neural network building system according to the requirements of users.

title: A management method and device for a smart training room
description: The present invention provides a management method and device for a smart training room, including: obtaining a first training item; obtaining a first free training room according to the first training item; and obtaining a first free training room according to the first training item , obtain the first training instructor; obtain the first training time; obtain a predetermined idle time threshold; determine whether the first training time is within the predetermined idle time threshold; if the first training time is within the predetermined idle time threshold; Within the predetermined idle time threshold, obtain the first use right; If the first training time is not within the predetermined idle time threshold, obtain the first authorization information; According to the first authorization information, obtain the second use right , the second use authority is the use authority of the first user to use the first free training room alone; the first control instruction is obtained according to the first use authority or the second use authority, and the The first control instruction is used to control the opening of the first idle training room.

title: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for detecting text area
description: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for detecting text areas, and belongs to the field of image detection. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an image to be subjected to text region detection, wherein the image contains multiple language texts; extracting general features of at least two language texts in the image; extracting distinguishing features of at least two language texts in the image based on the universal features; a first text region of the multi-language text in the image is determined based on the distinguishing characteristics. According to the method and the device, the universal features of at least two language texts in the image are extracted, and the distinguishing features of the at least two language texts in the image are extracted based on the universal features, so that the difference among multiple different languages can be considered, and the first text region of the multiple language texts can be determined simultaneously based on the distinguishing features, so that the detection difficulty is reduced, and the detection efficiency is improved.

title: Method and device for identifying automatic driving simulation scene
description: The embodiment of the application provides a method and a device for identifying an automatic driving simulation scene, which relate to the field of intelligent transportation and specifically comprise the following steps: the method has the advantages that driving related data of the automatic driving vehicles in the automatic driving simulation scene and environmental data around the automatic driving vehicles are used as input, the simulation scene is classified by using a deep learning classification model comprising a coding layer and a clustering layer, scene features can be processed into vectors with unified dimensionality by the coding layer, the follow-up inaccurate classification caused by the fact that the scene feature dimensionality is not unified is avoided, the clustering layer can unsupervised classify the scene features into reasonable scenes or abnormal scenes, and therefore the method has high efficiency and high accuracy.

title: Method for characterizing full-view-field quantitative statistical distribution of gamma' -phase microstructure in metal material
description: The invention discloses a method for characterizing full-view-field quantitative statistical distribution of a gamma' -phase microstructure in a metal material, which comprises the following steps: step a: marking a gamma' phase, cloud interference and a gamma matrix through Labelme, and manufacturing a standard characteristic training sample; step b, establishing a feature recognition extraction model based on deep learning by utilizing BD U-Net; step c, acquiring a gamma' characteristic map in the metal material to be detected; step d, automatically identifying and extracting gamma' phase; and e, in-situ quantitative statistical distribution characterization of the wide-range full-field gamma'. The method for characterizing the full-view-field quantitative statistical distribution of the gamma '-phase microstructure in the metal material provided by the invention is based on a deep learning theory, realizes automatic, high-speed and high-quality identification and extraction of gamma' -phase characteristics in the metal material, and realizes full-view-field in-situ quantitative statistical distribution characterization of the characteristics.

title: A Technology Foresight and Patent Early Warning Analysis Method Based on Improved XGBoost Algorithm
description: The present invention provides a technology prediction and patent early warning analysis method based on an improved XGBoost algorithm. The user inputs a patent search formula, builds a patent subject database according to the patent search formula, uses a convolutional neural network to extract features from the patent text of the patent subject database, and obtains Feature vector, build a test set according to the feature vector, train the XGBoost model through the training set, and then use the gray wolf optimization algorithm to improve the XGBoost model to improve the classification accuracy and classification efficiency, and test the XGBoost model through the test set. Classifier, after inputting the patent to be warned into the XGBoost classifier, the classification of the patent to be warned and other patent texts of the same category can be obtained, so that patent early warning analysis, technology maturity and technology evolution direction prediction can be performed, providing users with Accurate and highly visualized prediction results allow users to understand the development trend of existing technologies and the future evolution direction at a glance.

title: Depth spectrum convolution collaborative filtering recommendation method based on scores
description: The invention discloses a depth spectrum convolution collaborative filtering recommendation method based on scores, which comprises the following steps: improving a scoring matrix prediction algorithm to obtain a sparsely filled scoring matrix; carrying out graph Fourier transform spatial domain-spectral domain conversion on recommendation related user-item interaction information, converting interaction scores of a scoring matrix into graph signals existing in a spectral domain, and directly representing the graph signals by characteristic vectors in the spectral domain to realize spectral domain characteristic extraction; carrying out convolution updating on user project diagram signals in different frequency domains, dynamically adjusting the weight of each frequency domain, taking the graph signals after convolution as the input of a spectrum convolution cyclic neural network, and outputting a convolution diagram signal sequence; carrying out deep cyclic neural network training on the convolution image signal sequence; and carrying out iterative optimization on the training result through a reasonable designed objective function to complete the Top-N recommendation sequencing.

title: Object three-dimensional detection method and device
description: The invention provides a method and a device for three-dimensional detection of an object. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining two images collected by a binocular camera, wherein the images contain objects, obtaining a depth map of a target image according to the two images, a base line distance between the binocular camera and a focal length of the target camera, wherein the target camera is any one of the binocular camera, the image shot by the target camera in the two images is the target image, the depth map contains a depth value of the target image, identifying the objects in the target image, obtaining a depth value of a part corresponding to the objects from the depth map of the target image, obtaining a spatial point cloud corresponding to the objects according to camera parameters of the binocular camera and the depth value of the part corresponding to the objects, and obtaining spatial position information of the objects according to the spatial point cloud corresponding to the objects. The method of the invention fully utilizes the texture information and the three-dimensional information of the image to determine the spatial position information of the object, so that the three-dimensional detection result of the object is more accurate.

title: Bridge safety assessment method combining dynamic Bayesian network and heuristic reasoning
description: The invention relates to a bridge safety assessment method combining dynamic Bayesian network and heuristic reasoning. First, Bayesian network (BN) nodes are set according to bridge components and external loads; a single time slice is gradually established through the force transmission path. The static BN topology below; the load nodes of adjacent time slices are connected by directed arcs, and the external loads are the state transition variables, and the static BN topologies of different time slices are associated to obtain the dynamic BN topology; then, each set of parameters is calculated. Then, establish dynamic BN; finally, input the monitoring data of some bridge components as evidence to the corresponding nodes of the established dynamic BN model, propose a multi-objective particle swarm search algorithm, and obtain different moments through heuristic reasoning The maximum stress value of other nodes and the reliability of the system are used to realize the safety assessment of the bridge structure. The present invention can evaluate the immediate safety of other components and systems of the bridge, and can also predict the safety in the future.

title: Identification method, equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application discloses an identification method, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining at least two images; obtaining key point information of each object in each image; determining a feature sequence of each object in each image based at least on the key point information of each object in each image; based on the feature sequences of the objects in the images, at least obtaining a first parameter between the objects in the at least two images, wherein the first parameter is used for representing the similarity degree between the objects of different images in the at least two images; and determining at least a target object based on a first parameter between each object in the at least two images, wherein the target object is a similar object between the at least two images.

title: Target object extraction method, product detection method, device, computer and medium
description: The invention provides a target object extraction method, a product detection device, a computer and a medium, wherein the target object extraction method comprises the steps of obtaining an image; inputting the image into a training model trained in advance for feature detection to obtain feature information of the image; obtaining a region of interest of the image from the image based on the characteristic information; obtaining a coverage area of the target object in the image according to the region of interest; obtaining a target contour of the target object in the image based on the coverage area of the target object in the image; and extracting the target object from the image according to the target contour in the image. The image is subjected to feature detection through the training model to obtain feature information of the image, a region of interest in the image is determined, the position of the target object in the image is obtained, the outline of the target object in the image is obtained, and the target object is extracted from the image. The automatic extraction of the target object in the image is realized, so that the extraction of the refrigerator panel is more accurate, and the efficiency is improved.

title: Firefly algorithm based unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network DSR protocol optimization method
description: The invention discloses a DSR protocol optimization method for an unmanned aerial vehicle ad hoc network based on the firefly algorithm. The neighbor node is used to receive the initialized routing request sent by the source node in the form of broadcasting, and according to the energy consumption, moving speed, transmission loss and congestion Calculate the corresponding fitness function value and comprehensive fitness value; obtain the initial firefly position and initialize the luminous intensity, and perform discrete movement based on the movement formula; and map the moved firefly to the corresponding UAV node, And correspondingly adjust the position and luminous intensity of the firefly until the firefly reaches the designated node or the number of iterations reaches the iteration threshold, the method of the present invention comprehensively selects the unmanned aerial vehicle node with high fitness as the next hop node of the transmission path, and improves the transmission chain. The stability of the path prolongs the lifetime of the path, improves the service reception rate, reduces the end-to-end delay, reduces the routing overhead, and improves the overall performance of the UAV ad hoc network.

title: A Structured Data Processing Method Based on Entity Embedding
description: The invention relates to a structured data processing method based on entity embedding, which comprises the following steps: 1) obtaining a data set containing structured data as an original data set; 2) preprocessing an original data set; 3) using the data in the preprocessed original data set for training a neural network model based on entity embedding; 4) inputting the test data into the trained neural network model, and outputting a prediction result. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of no need of characteristic engineering, good effect on category data and the like.

title: Face recognition method, device and electronic device
description: The application discloses a face recognition method, device and electronic device, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. Wherein, the method includes: obtaining a face image data set; for a sample pair composed of every two face images in the face image data set, obtaining a first feature vector extracted by a first network from the two face images of the sample pair, based on The obtained first feature vector obtains the first similarity of the sample pair; obtains the second feature vector extracted by the second network from the two face images of the sample pair respectively, and obtains the second feature vector of the sample pair based on the obtained second feature vector. Similarity; if the second similarity and the first similarity meet the misidentification condition, the sample pair is determined as the boundary sample pair; according to the loss value of the second similarity and the first similarity of the boundary sample pair, the second network is adjusted. network parameters, and perform face recognition through the adjusted second network. In this way, the recognition accuracy of the adjusted second network can be effectively improved.

title: Underground engineering support intelligent monitoring and early warning system and method based on GRU
