description: The invention discloses an underground engineering support intelligent monitoring and early warning system and method based on GRU, wherein the system comprises a support system, a data acquisition system, a signal processing system, a GRU intelligent analysis system and a prediction and early warning system; the data acquisition system is used for acquiring the data of the monitoring instrument arranged in the supporting system and transmitting the data to the signal processing system and the GRU intelligent analysis system, the GRU intelligent analysis system is used for intelligently processing and analyzing the monitoring data of parameters such as displacement, stress, osmotic pressure and the like of the tunnel supporting system based on a GRU gated circulating unit method, the analysis result is transmitted to the prediction early warning system, automatic and intelligent prediction early warning is realized, the practicability, reliability and accuracy of the monitoring early warning are improved, and the practical engineering service is realized. The invention has simple implementation, high automation degree and strong operability, can be used by vast engineering constructors or technicians, does not need the user to have profound learning and abundant engineering experience, and is easy to master and use.

title: Fully-connected multi-scale residual error network and voiceprint recognition method thereof
description: The invention provides a fully connected multi-scale residual network and a method for voiceprint recognition. The residual network includes an input layer, a convolutional layer, N sequentially connected residual modules, and a fully connected layer. Among them, in each residual module, the input feature map can be divided into multiple groups, and the output of the first convolution kernel with length and width of 1 is connected to the first convolution kernel formed by multiple second convolution kernels. The second convolution kernel group is used as the input of the second convolution kernel group. Finally, the feature maps output by the second convolution kernel group are spliced together, and the third convolution kernel with length and width of 1 is used to roll it. Product processing to achieve multi-scale feature information fusion, the fully connected layer can better predict and output the classification information used to indicate the speaker according to the fused features. In this way, multi-scale features can be better extracted without increasing the depth of the network, so as to achieve more accurate voiceprint recognition.

title: Image analysis, viewpoint-aware pattern recognition, and vehicle re-identification techniques for generating multi-view vehicle representations using neural networks
description: The present disclosure relates to an improved vehicle re-identification technique. The technique described herein utilizes artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning functions to re-identify vehicles passing through multiple cameras. Vehicle re-identification can be performed using images of the vehicle captured from any single viewpoint. A regional attention map can be generated to identify the vehicle, the region including the visual pattern of overlap between the viewpoint from which the image was captured and one or more other viewpoints. The attention map is used to generate a multi-view representation of the vehicle, which provides a global view of the vehicle from multiple viewpoints. The multi-view representation of the vehicle can then be compared with previously captured image data to perform vehicle re-identification.

title: A method, system and storage medium for optimizing electrical parameters of a square wave voltage source
description: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storage medium for square wave voltage source electrical parameter optimization, wherein the method for square wave voltage source electrical parameter optimization comprises the following steps: constructing a mathematical model of a square wave voltage source voltage forming loop, determining electrical optimization parameters and optimization targets of the square wave voltage source voltage forming loop, and determining a value range of the electrical optimization parameters; and calculating to obtain a training sample set for training the network through the value range of the electrical optimization parameters, then training through the deep belief network to obtain the trained deep belief network, and finally obtaining a group of parameters with the minimum comprehensive optimization target, namely the electrical parameter optimal value. According to the method for optimizing the electrical parameters of the square wave voltage source, the number of times of tests and test time are reduced by using the deep belief network, and the deep belief network is trained firstly, namely the deep belief network is pre-trained, so that initial parameters of the network are more accurate.

title: A method and system for judging the authenticity of an image
description: The embodiment of this specification discloses a method and system for judging the authenticity of an image. The method is applied to a server side, and the method includes: acquiring an original image from a client; extracting images in the original image according to preset extraction rules Multiple images or image parts are used as multiple extracted images; based on the multiple extracted images, the degree of matching between the multiple extracted images and the preset sequence is determined by the trained machine learning model; the authenticity of the original image; the preset sequence corresponds to the shooting device of the client, and judging the authenticity of the original image is specifically: judging the authenticity of the image from the shooting device.

title: Information extraction method and device, equipment, computer-readable storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present application disclose an information extraction method, device, equipment and computer-readable storage medium, which relate to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method includes: extracting header entities contained in unstructured text according to preset entity types; performing relationship classification processing on the header entities contained in the unstructured text, and obtaining information related to all the header entities contained in the unstructured text. Describe the entity relationship corresponding to the head entity; construct an entity relationship problem based on the head entity and the entity relationship corresponding to the head entity; extract the tail entity from the unstructured text, and extract the tail entity from the entity relationship problem corresponding to the head entity and entity relationship, and obtain the structured information contained in the unstructured text based on the head entity and entity relationship in the entity relationship problem, and the tail entity. The technical solutions of the embodiments of this application can improve the accuracy of extracting structured information.

title: Data processing method and device
description: The invention discloses a data processing method and a data processing device. The data processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring a data distribution algorithm of a distributed system for realizing load balance based on particle swarm optimization; calculating the optimal positions of the load-balanced particles in the distributed system according to a data distribution algorithm for realizing load balance based on particle swarm optimization; acquiring a data distribution algorithm for realizing optimized storage based on particle swarm optimization of a distributed system; and optimizing the storage space required by each node in the distributed system according to a data distribution algorithm for realizing optimized storage based on particle swarm optimization and the optimal particle position for load balancing. The invention solves the technical problems of long calculation time and low efficiency caused by the fact that the existing full-comparison calculation research adopts a branch-and-bound method to complete data distribution of full-comparison calculation.

title: Radar jamming suppression method based on neural network
description: The invention discloses a radar interference suppression method based on a neural network, which mainly solves the problem that the target detection rate is low in the prior art. The implementation scheme is as follows: 1) carrying out pulse compression and short-time Fourier transform on the radar receiving signals in sequence to obtain time-frequency characteristics, and forming a training data set and a test data set by a plurality of groups of time-frequency characteristics; 2) building a classification network consisting of an input layer, a bidirectional circulating convolution layer and a full connection layer from top to bottom; 3) training the classification network by using a training data set to obtain a trained classification network; 4) testing the trained classification network by using the test data set to obtain a label corresponding to the test data set; 5) replacing the position corresponding to the interference item in the label by using a random number to obtain replaced data; 6) and carrying out short-time Fourier transform on the replaced data to obtain a signal subjected to interference suppression. The invention has accurate classification, improves the detection rate of the target and can be used for radar target detection.

title: Model deployment method, device, system and storage medium
description: The present invention is applicable to the technical field of deep learning, and provides a model deployment method, device, system and storage medium. The method includes: performing a first format conversion operation on the received pre-training model, according to the received quantization bit width Perform full integer quantization on the pre-trained model after performing the first format conversion operation to obtain quantized parameters and quantized model parameters, perform a second format conversion operation on the quantized parameters and the quantized model parameters, and output, to obtain the quantized model parameters. The quantized model is deployed on the ASIC artificial intelligence chip, thereby realizing the quantitative deployment of pre-trained models of different deep learning frameworks on the ASIC artificial intelligence chip.

title: Print production quality forecast
description: A system and method for providing three-dimensional printing production quality predictions is described herein. The system may include logic to scan a region of interest associated with a layer of a plurality of parts during printing to obtain an input for the region of interest and to calculate an input metric associated with the layer based on the input. In response to a set of initial print jobs, at least a portion of the plurality of parts is mechanically tested to determine at least one output. In response to the production print jobs, a likelihood that a part of the plurality of parts meets a quality specification is predicted by inputting the input metric into at least one machine learning function including at least one output, wherein the at least one machine learning function is trained during the set of initial print jobs.

title: A calculation method of commodity trend index based on machine learning
description: The invention discloses a commodity trend index calculation method based on machine learning in the field of surveying and mapping science and technology. Commodity data sources are diversified, require a large amount of data, and can extract rich features. At the same time, the explosive product index is defined in combination with business needs, and the trend index has a scientific understanding and grasp, which can fully and accurately reflect the future trend of commodities. It is a comprehensive index. The supervised machine learning algorithm is used to calculate the explosive index, which avoids the calculation method being too simple. At the same time, the supervised explosive index can fully ensure that the trend index can be closely related to the business requirements, and calculate the indicators in the prediction model. The predicted value of commodities in a certain period of time in the future, the supervised machine learning algorithm is used to calculate the explosive index, which avoids the problem of too simple calculation method. Objectively reflect the development trend of commodities.

title: Method, system, device and readable storage medium for face recognition
description: The present application discloses a method for face recognition, including: obtaining an original picture, and using a quality network model to calculate the quality score of the original picture; performing picture enhancement processing on the original picture according to the quality score to obtain an enhanced picture, and establishing a second picture based on the enhanced picture A training set; use the first training set to train the preset model to obtain a face recognition model, and use the face recognition model to perform face recognition. This application enables the low-quality pictures in the first training set obtained by using enhanced pictures to be retained, but avoids the loss of identity information caused by excessive enhancement of low-quality images, thereby improving the accuracy of the trained face recognition model; at the same time , good-quality pictures can generate more enhanced data, which can realize the simulation of more scenes and improve the utilization rate of data. At the same time, the present application also provides a face recognition system, device and readable storage medium, which have the above-mentioned beneficial effects.

title: A non-destructive detection method for freshness of prawns based on deep learning
description: The invention relates to a deep learning-based nondestructive detection method for freshness of prawns. By collecting the appearance of a large number of prawn samples and their corresponding freshness indicators, a dataset of deep learning model of prawn freshness is created, and then a deep learning model with the ability to identify prawn freshness is trained through the dataset. Through this model, the freshness of prawns and the specific values of corresponding indicators can be predicted.

title: A word segmentation method for Chinese chemical literature based on hybrid feature fusion
description: The invention discloses a Chinese chemical industry document word segmentation method with hybrid feature fusion. First, a chemical industry scientific document corpus is constructed to train a Chinese word segmentation task; then, BiLSTM and CNN are used to extract and fuse document features, and a conditional random field is constructed in combination with boundary features. Then, the model interface is opened to segment the text input by the user; finally, the word segmentation result is rendered through ECharts to realize the visualization of chemical keywords, and the system accepts user feedback and processes it. The invention applies natural language processing and deep learning methods to the chemical industry, improves the word segmentation effect on chemical Chinese documents containing Chinese and English professional vocabulary through feature fusion, and solves the problem of term recognition in the chemical field caused by a large number of new words and Chinese and English mixed professional vocabulary on the word segmentation result. low rate problem.

title: A method, system and electronic device for face living verification based on neural network
description: This invention provides a face liveness detection method, system, and electronic device based on neural networks. By superimposing a first feature fusion map and a second feature fusion map, a final feature map is obtained. This final feature map simultaneously possesses detailed features from both visible light and infrared images, improving the accuracy of face detection. Simultaneously, a deep learning neural network method is employed for end-to-end training, enabling the extraction of features from visible light and infrared binocular images. Furthermore, the non-cooperative (silent) liveness detection technology requires no user interaction, significantly improving the user experience. Moreover, this method can effectively defend against attacks using images, videos, screens, and stencils, meeting the needs of practical application scenarios in terms of detection accuracy and user experience, such as face-based real-name authentication, face-based attendance, and smart access control.

title: Charging service intelligent recommendation method and device based on power Internet of Things big data
description: The present invention is applicable to the field of artificial intelligence technology of the Internet of Things, and provides a charging service intelligent recommendation method and device based on the big data of the power Internet of Things, including: obtaining the user's historical charging behavior data; according to the charging location information and charging time information, Construct a charging scene discrimination model; construct a multi-scenario charging preference model according to the charging preference information and the matching degree between the charging preference information and charging station attributes; when receiving a charging service recommendation request from the user, based on the The charging scene discrimination model and the multi-scenario charging preference model generate charging service recommendation results and recommend them to the user. This invention automatically learns the user's charging service selection preferences by distinguishing different charging scenarios, rather than adopting the perspective of global charging preferences or a single optimization target. It can better fit the car owner's actual pile-finding charging situation, and the recommendations better match the car owner's charging preferences. charging service to improve user experience.

title: Model training method and device for sleep stage
description: The present invention discloses a model training method for sleep staging, which includes: constructing a single-channel input competitive student model and a multi-channel input teacher model for sleep staging; inputting a multi-channel signal into the teacher model, and obtaining the teacher model loss according to the output of the teacher model, and inputting a single-channel signal into the competitive student model, and obtaining the competitive student model loss according to the output of the competitive student model; determining the knowledge transfer loss according to the output of the hidden layer in the teacher model and the output of the hidden layer in the competitive student model; optimizing the teacher model and the competitive student model according to the competitive student model loss, the teacher model loss and the knowledge transfer loss until a stop condition is met; constructing a single-channel input cooperative student model for sleep staging according to the trained teacher model and the trained competitive student model, and training the cooperative student model based on the knowledge distillation technology, and finally obtaining the teacher model and the cooperative student model with improved accuracy.

title: A self-service transaction processing method and device, and a self-service transaction cabinet
description: The present application discloses a self-service transaction processing method and device, as well as a self-service transaction cabinet. The type features and weight parameters of items are obtained, and the type features and weight parameters are input into a pre-built value estimation model to obtain a value estimation model. Output the result, which indicates the value of the item. In the case that it is determined that the item is sold, a transfer instruction is sent to the preset payment system, and the payment system is triggered to pay the provider of the item an amount equal to the value of the item. Upon determining receipt of an amount equal to the value of the item, the payer of the released amount removes the item. It can be seen that through the type characteristics and weight parameters of the item, as well as the value estimation model, the transaction amount equal to the value of the item is estimated. The provider of the item can immediately sell the item to obtain benefits, and others can buy the item by paying the transaction amount of the item. Therefore, the residual value of recyclable garbage as a trade item will be effectively utilized.

title: A lightweight multi-branch feature cross-layer fusion image semantic segmentation method
description: The invention relates to a light multi-branch feature cross-layer fusion image semantic segmentation method, which comprises the following steps of: 1) acquiring an original image, inputting the original image into a convolution downsampling network to obtain images with different resolutions, reserving space position information of an object, and reducing information redundancy in the image; 2) respectively inputting images with different resolutions into a semantic feature extraction branch and a cross-layer connection branch to respectively obtain a deep layer feature and a shallow layer feature; 3) respectively carrying out importance distinguishing on the deep layer characteristics and the shallow layer characteristics, and then carrying out characteristic cross-layer fusion; 4) and after classifying, recombining and upsampling the fused feature map, outputting a semantic segmentation result. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages of high calculation efficiency, high precision and the like.

title: Convolution computing device and method
description: One embodiment of the present application provides a convolution computing device, which is applied to the convolution computing of a convolution layer, and includes a decompression circuit, a data combination circuit and a computing circuit. The decompression circuit is used to decompress a compressed weight data of a convolution kernel of the convolution layer to generate a decompressed weight data. The data combination circuit is used to combine the decompressed data with an uncompressed weight data of the convolution kernel to restore the data order of the weight data of the convolution kernel. The computing circuit performs calculations based on the weight data of the convolution kernel and the input data of the convolution layer. Since the weight data of the convolution kernel that has been compressed in advance is transmitted to the convolution computing device, when performing a convolution operation, the compressed weight data is first decompressed, and then the convolution operation is performed based on it, which can reduce the storage space occupied by the convolution kernel in the electronic device and the bandwidth required for transmission.

title: Pedestrian trajectory prediction method and system based on trend guiding and sparse interaction
description: The invention discloses a pedestrian trajectory prediction method and system based on trend guiding and sparse interaction, and belongs to the field of computer vision; the method provided by the invention aims at the influence of pedestrian interaction and track trend on pedestrian future track prediction, carries out modeling on the pedestrian interaction and track trend, uses a self-attention mechanism to construct an interaction score, and combines an asymmetric convolution network to construct a sparse interaction graph, so as to find a real interaction object of the current person and the track trend influencing the future track of the current person; a new normalization function is used for ensuring the sparsity of interaction; extracting features by using a graph convolutional neural network, and finally predicting a distribution function of a future track by using a time convolutional network; the invention can improve the accuracy of the track prediction.

title: Fast video classification method, system and device based on H264 compressed domain
description: The invention belongs to the field of computer vision, and particularly relates to a method, a system and a device for fast video classification based on an H264 compressed domain, aiming at solving the problems of low speed and high model complexity of the existing video classification technology. The invention comprises the following steps: extracting I frame data, P frame data and B frame data of a video of the H264 standard; decoding the I frame and entropy decoding the P frame and the B frame to obtain a motion vector between the I frame image and the video frame; respectively constructing high and low time resolution models, and performing model fusion by modeling characteristics of different time resolutions through a time scale attention module; acquiring four preliminary prediction classifications based on the motion vector between the I frame image and the frame; and performing weighted fusion of the four primary prediction classifications to obtain a final prediction classification result. The invention does not need to carry out full decoding of all video frames, has small model parameter quantity, can effectively improve the video classification speed, can well identify the motion information with different speeds in the video and has stronger practicability.

title: System and method for providing information for online-to-offline services
description: The present application relates to a system, method and non-transitory computer readable medium. The system includes at least one computer-readable storage medium including a set of instructions and at least one processor in communication with the at least one computer-readable storage medium. When executing a set of instructions, at least one processor is configured to: receive a trigger event without input from a user terminal associated with the user (510); obtain one or more candidate destinations based on the trigger event (520); obtain a trained ranking model (530); determine ranking results for one or more candidate destinations based on the trained ranking model (540); and in response to a trigger event, send the (updated) ranking results to a user terminal (550).

title: Keypoint-based fall detection method
description: The invention discloses a fall detection method based on key points. The fall detection system based on key points includes an image acquisition module, an image recognition module, an action detection module and a display module which are connected in sequence. Image; the image recognition module detects the human body in the continuous frame images, and identifies the skeleton key points of the detected human body; the action detection module detects the human skeleton key points in the continuous frame images based on the width and height ratio of the target detection frame conforming to the set threshold. The straight-line distance formed by the key points of the wrist and the key points of the ankle, the straight-line distance formed by the key points of the eyes and the key points of the ankle, and the change of the angle between the key points of the shoulder and the key point of the knee can judge whether the human body is in a falling state in the video; Display module: Display whether someone is in a falling state in the video image area through the display, and give a corresponding warning prompt.

title: Ship shielding detection method and device based on YOLO-V3 algorithm
description: The invention discloses a ship occlusion detection method and device based on a YOLO-V3 algorithm, which are used for searching the position and the direction of an occluded ship in an image, and the method comprises the following steps: constructing a sample data set; performing cluster analysis on the sample data set; constructing a YOLO-V3 network, and optimizing an output box of the YOLO-V3 network so that the output box comprises an integral bounding box and a local bounding box; inputting the sample data set into the YOLO-V3 network for training and testing to obtain a ship occlusion detection model; and inputting the ship image to be detected into the trained ship shielding detection model for detection so as to output the whole boundary frame and the local boundary frame of the shielded ship. The invention can output the whole boundary frame and the local boundary frame by optimizing the output frame of the YOLO-V3 network, and then judges whether the detection is correct by making an error between the intersection ratio and the area ratio of the output whole boundary frame and the output local boundary frame, thereby improving the accuracy of the detection.

title: An Unbalanced Time Series Data Augmentation Method for Industrial Fault Diagnosis
description: The invention discloses an industrial fault diagnosis unbalanced time sequence data expansion method, which comprises the following steps: preparing a training data set; step two: constructing a network structure of GRU-BEGAN; step three: training the constructed GRU-BEGAN network model; step four: generating an antagonistic network model according to the trained GRU-BEGAN to generate artificial data of a small sample type, inputting a simple random variable z | t into the trained model to generate time sequence data according with time t, expanding the generated data set to the small sample type of the original data, and establishing a 1D/2D-CNN fault diagnosis model according to the expanded data set. The invention has the advantages that the model convergence is faster and the data quality is higher due to the improvement on the model structure and the loss function, the small sample time sequence data set in the fault data is trained by using the end-to-end GRU-BEGAN model, the generated artificial data is obtained to enhance the original data set, and the accuracy of the fault diagnosis model is improved.

title: Sample chapter generation method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present application discloses a method, apparatus, device and storage medium for generating sample chapters, and relates to the technical fields of deep learning and natural language processing. The specific implementation scheme is: obtaining the text to be processed including the content of multiple chapters; for the content of the dialog in each chapter, obtaining the content of the dialog and the number of appearances of the character in the corresponding context, as well as the distance between the character and the content of the dialog, to predict The main role of the dialogue content; obtain the importance information of the main role; according to the main role of the dialogue content in each chapter content and the importance information of the main role, select the target chapter content from the text to be processed, and generate samples based on the target chapter content chapter. Thus, sample chapters that can be used for small sample learning are generated, and the sample chapters generated by the method of the present application are used for small sample learning, which can make the obtained model more accurate when performing new tasks, thereby optimizing the performance of the model. performance.

title: X-ray image processing system, method thereof, and recording medium
description: The object of the present invention is to provide an X-ray image processing system and method and a recording medium for improving the accuracy of image recognition using X-ray images obtained in X-ray inspection services. As a solution, information of an area determined to contain an object is obtained, and the X-ray transmission amounts obtained by multiple sensors in the same area (for example, the same background, the same luggage) are synthesized, and material information is estimated based on the re-synthesized X-ray transmission amounts to generate a color image. As the object of synthesis, for example, the combination information of the objects stored in operation is used, and the combination of objects contained in the same luggage is set to a combination of more objects. The color image generated by the synthesis is used as learning data.

title: A Column Store Layout Optimization Method Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
description: The invention discloses a method for optimizing column storage layout based on deep reinforcement learning. The method includes: receiving a query load; analyzing the query load to generate query characteristics; obtaining characteristic data of data columns according to the query characteristics; The sequence strategy and the characteristic data of the data column determine the output sequence of the column; perform quantitative evaluation on the output sequence, and the quantitative evaluation strategy is adjusted based on the reward of the system; the strategy for adjusting the output sequence of the column according to the quantitative evaluation result. Through the present invention, the model parameters used can be continuously adjusted in the desired direction of reducing the disk skip reading time, so that the neural network can automatically learn the optimal column ordering according to the characteristic data of the columns, and incremental training can be realized without having to The column ordering is recalculated during optimization, thereby greatly reducing the computational cost.

title: Multimedia data sorting method, device, server and storage medium
description: The present disclosure relates to a method, device, server and storage medium for sorting multimedia data, and belongs to the field of computer technology. The solution provided by the present disclosure determines the probability of interactive operation of multiple multimedia data under the search keyword to be searched by the target account when receiving the search request of the target account, and then sorts the multiple multimedia data in combination with the correlation characteristics and quality characteristics of the multiple multimedia data. Since the correlation characteristics can indicate the matching degree between the multimedia data and the search keyword, and the quality characteristics can indicate the content quality of the multimedia data, the multimedia data ranked higher is the data related to the search keyword and of higher quality, thereby improving the sorting accuracy of the multimedia data.

title: A tree identification method, device and terminal device for power transmission lines
description: The invention discloses a tree identification method, device and terminal equipment for power transmission lines. The method includes: acquiring airborne point cloud data, using a preset algorithm to perform data filtering on the airborne point cloud data, and distinguishing ground point clouds and non-ground point cloud; use the ground point cloud to construct the surface DEM, and use the non-ground point cloud to separate the vegetation point cloud; extract the DBH point cloud of the vegetation, fit a circle based on the extracted point cloud data of the vegetation, and the obtained circle center position is used as the tree The position of the seed point, the diameter is the tree diameter at breast height, and the point corresponding to the center of the circle is the tree seed point; based on the position of the tree seed point, the tree trunk growth direction is fitted by the tree diameter at breast height, and the single tree height is obtained. The identification method applied in the present invention can accurately and efficiently obtain the vegetation point cloud, and obtain the height of a single tree, effectively predict the growth height of the tree, so that the power transmission personnel can timely predict the hidden danger of the tree and clean the tree.

title: Method, apparatus, program, and computer-readable medium for detecting drifting objects
description: The application provides a drift cargo detection scheme, this scheme is earlier before detecting from holistic position frame or the key point that waits to detect the target vehicle in the image, then according to the position frame or the key point of target vehicle follow it intercepts the peripheral image in the image to wait to detect to intercept the rear of a vehicle and carries out the detection of drift cargo, therefore the content that detects is more targeted, is of value to improving detection efficiency and precision, and wait to detect the image to the multiframe simultaneously and discern, combine every recognition result of waiting to detect the image to confirm final testing result, the result is more reliable, in addition utilized the deep learning algorithm in the testing process, stable high efficiency, the reusability is good, can save a large amount of manpowers.

title: Speech processing method and device and speech processing model generation method and device
description: This application discloses a speech processing method and device and a speech processing model generation method and device, which relate to the technical fields of speech technology, artificial interaction, and deep learning. The implementation plan is: obtain M speech signals and N reference signals to be processed; perform sub-band decomposition on each signal to obtain each frequency band component of each speech signal and reference signal; obtain N reference signals in each Corresponding ideal ratio membrane IRM in each frequency band of each speech signal; based on each IRM, echo cancellation is performed on each frequency band component of each speech signal to obtain M speech signals after echo cancellation. Therefore, based on the ideal ratio membrane IRM corresponding to the real reference signal in each frequency band of the speech signal, echo cancellation is performed on each frequency band component of the speech signal without relying on any simulated signal, thereby improving echo cancellation. The accuracy and generalization improve the user experience.

title: Method, device and device for determining target vibration position in multi-person wake-up scheme
description: The invention discloses a method, device and device for determining a target vibration position in a multi-person wake-up scheme. The method includes the following steps: collecting a current sleep image of a user; obtaining a first frame coordinate of the user's torso in the current sleep image and a vibration bed the second frame coordinates of the pad; obtain the distribution information of multiple vibrators on the vibration mattress, and calculate the first position coordinates corresponding to each vibrator according to the second frame coordinates of the vibration mattress; obtain the current sleeping posture of the user, and calculate the second position coordinates corresponding to the target vibration point on the user's torso; select the target vibrator according to the first position coordinates and the second position coordinates. In the present invention, multiple vibrators are arranged on the vibration mattress, and the target vibration position is reasonably determined according to the sleeping posture of the user, so as to control the multiple target vibrators to vibrate sequentially from the position of the lower torso, the position of the upper torso to the position of the head, so as to prevent the user from being disturbed by Wake-up, physical discomfort and other conditions occur when waking up, which also enriches the functions of the existing mattress.

title: A lane line detection and segmentation method based on attention space convolutional neural network
description: The invention discloses a lane line detection and segmentation method based on an attention space convolution neural network. According to the method, a space convolution layer is embedded in a traditional convolution neural network and an attention gate structure is introduced, so that space information in an image can be spread in neurons on the same layer, structured information can be better extracted, and the detection capability of long-distance continuous targets such as lane lines is enhanced under the condition that the calculated amount of a network model is not increased. The method mainly aims at the structural road with clear road sign lines, can detect and segment complete lane lines in complex driving conditions such as crowding, darkness, narrowness and the like, and has better performance than the existing method.

title: Operation processing method, device for operation processing and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the invention provides an operation processing method, an operation processing device and a storage medium, which are applied to a convolutional neural network model, wherein the method comprises the steps of extracting a cyclic structure to be converted from a pooling operator of the convolutional neural network model, determining operands participating in cyclic calculation in the cyclic structure, defining vector data matched with the data types of the operands, wherein each vector data comprises a preset number of operands, converting a cyclic body statement for carrying out cyclic calculation on the operands in the cyclic structure into a single instruction multiple data Stream (SIMD) instruction for carrying out cyclic calculation on the vector data, executing the cyclic structure after conversion, and carrying out cyclic calculation on the preset number of operands in parallel by executing the SIMD instruction in at least one cyclic calculation. The embodiment of the invention can optimize the circulation structure, reduce the circulation times and further improve the performance of the deep learning model.

title: A general image object classification method and system
description: The invention provides a general image target classification method and system. The method includes: when there is a problem of data imbalance in various samples in the training data set, inputting the various samples in the training data set into a neural network in turn for coarse adjustment training, Obtain the initial parameters of the neural network; expand the images in various samples in the training data set to obtain the expanded data set; construct multiple training sample lists according to the expanded data set by using the batch in-batch equalization method; Input to the neural network that has obtained the initial parameters for fine-tuning training, and obtain the final parameters of the neural network; input the image to be classified into the neural network that has obtained the final parameters for classification, and obtain the initial classification result; adopt the threshold shift method to The initial classification result is subjected to threshold shift to obtain the final classification result, which further improves the target classification accuracy under the condition of unbalanced samples between categories.

title: Human-computer symbiosis method and system
description: The invention relates to a man-machine symbiotic method and a man-machine symbiotic system, wherein a machine acquires information of an external environment through an outside sensor and transmits the information to a computing device through an information transmission system for information processing, the processed information is displayed to a person in a sealed cabin through a man-machine interaction system, meanwhile, the machine acquires cognitive behavior expression of the person in information interaction through an inside sensor in the man-machine interaction system, and after learning, an information processing algorithm is adjusted, so that the information of the external environment acquired by the outside sensor is effectively processed and displayed to the person in the sealed cabin, the person can perceive the external environment, and finally, the co-evolution of the man and the machine is realized through the cognitive behavior expression of the person and the learning of the machine. The human-computer symbiosis method and the system thereof provided by the invention can realize the perception and understanding of complex events of people in the environment, and can be generally suitable for systems consisting of people and machines, including intelligent robots, intelligent driving and the like.

title: Analysis method, system and storage medium based on traffic travel scene violation intelligence
description: The invention discloses a method for intelligent analysis of violations based on a traffic travel scene. The method includes the following steps: Step 1, capturing images of violations through traffic monitoring equipment, and constructing an intelligent violation analysis system to analyze the captured images; step 2, the The intelligent violation analysis system receives the parameters corresponding to the violation types captured and captured by the user; step 3, the intelligent violation analysis system filters the violation pictures according to the established traffic violation waste film filter model, wherein the filter model includes running a red light, speeding , drive a mobile phone, do not wear a seat belt filter model; step 4, according to the parameters input by the user and the filter model to process and return the classification of positive and waste films and the reasons for the waste films. Compared with the prior art, the present invention has the following beneficial effects: the present invention greatly reduces the workload of manually reviewing illegal pictures after pre-examination of waste film filtering by the violation analysis system by setting a waste film filtering model.

title: System and method for high speed computing and feature recognition capturing aspects of neocortical computation
description: A network of networks system and method includes a neuron (20) having processing capabilities; a first level module including a network of a plurality of interconnected neurons (20), the first level module also having processing capabilities; and a second level module including a network of interconnected networks or interconnected neurons, the second level module also having processing capabilities; wherein the first and second level modules are interconnected through neuron to neuron connections (30) such that simultaneous processing can be carried out by the neuron and by the first and second level modules. The system and method also includes means for forming a boundary between a first module having a first memory state and a second module having a second memory state such that the module comprising the boundary attains a third memory state distinct from the first and second memory states.

title: Control device and method therefor, information processing device and method therefor, and medium
description: A plurality of robots can be controlled simply, positively, individually and discretely. Specifically, when one robot device is controlled, a slide button (52) is switched to a module A side, and, when the other robot device is controlled, it is switched to a character B side. When a button (51) corresponding to a pitch name is operated, a voice corresponding to the pitch name is output at a pitch corresponding to a slide button's (52) switching position, and a robot is controlled by the voice. Each robot captures a voice signal with a pitch specific to itself only.

title: Method and system for modeling biological systems
description: The present invention relates to a method and system for quantitative and semi-quantitative modeling of biological and physiological systems. More specifically, the invention relates to the use of overlays to store and manipulate computational biological models. Also provided by the invention are methods and systems for preparing overlays, methods and systems for creating new computational biological models by applying overlays to old models, and computer program products comprising overlays.

title: Device impairment detection
description: Examples described herein involve detecting known impairments or other known conditions using a neural network. An example implementation involves receiving data indicating a response of a playback device as captured by a microphone. The implementation also involves determining an input vector by projecting a response vector that represents the response of the playback device onto a principle component matrix representing variance caused by one or more known impairments. The implementation further involves providing the determined input vector to a neural network that includes an output layer comprising neurons that correspond to respective known impairments. The implementation involves detecting that the input vector caused one or more neurons of the neural network to fire such that the neural network indicates that a particular known impairment is affecting the microphone and/or the playback device and adjusting operation of the playback device and/or the microphone to offset the particular known impairment.

title: Systems and methods for automated haiku chatting
description: Systems and methods for automated (or artificial intelligence) haiku chatting are provided. The systems and methods provide automated haiku chatting by generating, selecting, and/or scoring haikus. The systems and methods provide automated haiku chatting that may generate and/or select a haiku based on previously collected user inputs, that provides an image with a selected and/or generated haiku, that may generate or select a haiku based on an collected image from the user, and/or that may utilize bi-directional recurrent neural network learning model. Further, systems and methods as described herein are able update or train learning models utilized by the systems and/or methods based on user feedback and/or world feedback.

title: QEEG/Genomic Analysis For Predicting Therapeutic Outcome
description: Using a combinatorial algorithm comprised of quantitative EEG features and at least one pharmacogenomic variable, a significantly higher predictive accuracy and usability is achieved as compared to other current methods of clinical decision support for guided pharmacotherapy. The method produces a report with actionable findings for the treating physician, recommending for and/or against multiple drug classes and agents from among the available treatments for mental health disorders. While predictive accuracy for pharmacogenomic testing averages 73%, the presently disclosed combinatorial algorithms achieve a significantly higher rate of accuracy at 91%.

title: System and method for occupancy estimation
description: An occupancy estimator calculates an occupancy estimate (x ) of a region based on sensor data (z) provided by one or more sensor devices and a model-based occupancy estimate generated by an occupant traffic model (f). The occupant traffic model (f) is based on predicted movement of occupants throughout a region. The occupancy estimation system includes an occupancy estimator algorithm (20) that combines the sensor data (z) and the model-based occupancy estimate generated by the occupant traffic model (f) to generate an occupancy estimate (x) for the region.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, and program
description: There is provided an information processing apparatus including an experience information extracting unit that extracts experience information which is information regarding an experience, from text data input from a user, an item selecting unit that performs at least one of extraction and priority setting of an item to be provided to the user, based on the extracted experience information, and a provision control unit that controls provision of the item to the user, based on a result of the extraction or the priority setting of the item.

title: Judgment method and inference device for inference rule
description:
Rule of inference decision method of the present invention is to judge one by one when giving with the input data with the study function without empirical law, represents the satisfied meta-function to which kind of degree of condition of the IF part of each rule of inference, thereby can obtain the method for best inferred results.For example, realize the study function tail of this learning method use neural line road net model. 
     Apparatus for predicting of the present invention is by the meta-function decision parts 1 that the neural line road network is constituted, judge each deduction amount judging part 2 of each deduction amount of each rule of inference, provide from the two output that the final inferred results judging part etc. of final inferred results constitutes.

title: A method and device for analyzing user behavior data
description: The embodiment of the present invention discloses a method and device for analyzing user behavior data, which are used for accurately analyzing user behavior and improving the pertinence of advertising push objects. The method in the embodiment of the present invention includes: obtaining the behavior data generated in the data source after the user registers to the data source, wherein the data source includes the behavior data generated by each user registered in the data source, and the behavior data is the data recorded by the user in the data source. Behavior data information in the source; extract user tags from the behavior data generated by users on the data source, user tags are information used to characterize user behavior; obtain preset directional crowd features, oriented crowd features satisfy directional features The characteristics of the required group of people; according to the behavior data and user tags generated by the user on the data source, extract the target user group that meets the characteristics of the targeted group from all users of the data source, and the target user group includes multiple users that meet the characteristics of the targeted group .

title: METHOD AND COMPUTER SYSTEM FOR COMPILING A QUANTITY OF OBJECTS
description: The invention relates to a method of configuring a set of object values in a computer. At least one object value of the set of object values is user-chosen from a number of object values. Each object has at least one possible object value. Each object value is determined or undetermined. Each of the determined object values is assigned to a value. Some or all of these object values is included in the set of object values. The object values are constrained by a rule base defining a number of relationships between the objects or the object values. The method uses at least one interruptable algorithm adapted to deduce knowledge about the undetermined object values. This knowledge indicates whether a user selection of a part of or all of the individual undetermined object values are possible or not. The algorithm(s) includes at least one readout point. In at least one dynamic representation of object values, the deduced knowledge in each readout point represents partial knowledge about the undetermined objects, the partial knowledge being presented to the user in response to a user interrupt or a time interrupt. Thus, the invention improves the interactive performance of configuration because information of knowledge can be gradually extracted.

title: Creation assisting method and apparatus, and recorded medium
description:
Disclosed in the present invention are a creation
production support method, for enabling the easy production of
a large amount of creative material, within a short period of
time, while reducing the labor effort required of a creator,
and an apparatus and a storage medium therefor. 
     Specifically, creative element data for a pair composed
of a creative element and an element index are stored in a
database (4), and the element index is extracted from the
database (4) and is placed in a reactor (9). From this, a set
of correlated element indexes is obtained, and creative
elements corresponding to element indexes that constitute this
set are coupled together and output. Then, a creation is
automatically generated, and 5W1H information, indicating the
contents of a corresponding creative element, and sensory
information received from the creative element are written in
the element index. When based on this information a correlation
is obtained, a creation can be provided that can not be formed
merely by the random linking of creative elements.

title: Operational programming of a facility
description: A decision support tool to assist decision -making in the operation of a facility. The decision support tool allows a user to perform operational programming of the facility so that the analysis of specific operational events is flexible and "on-demand." This is achieved by allowing the user to set scope and timeframe of the analysis according to business needs. As a result, the organization can make better-informed judgments whether to add operational activities and how to adjust the ones already formulated in the program. The decision support tool can also allow for the application of strategies to communicate intent behind the programming instructions and to improve the quality of business decisions.

title: Hybrid quantum circuit assembly
description: Systems and methods are provided for a hybrid qubit circuit assembly is provided. A first plural set of Josephson junctions is arranged in series on a first path between two nodes of a circuit. A second plural set of Josephson junctions is arranged in parallel with one another to form a direct current superconducting quantum interference device (DC SQUID). The DC SQUID is in parallel with the first plural set of Josephson junctions. A capacitor is in parallel with each of the first plural set of Josephson junctions and the DC SQUID.

title: Identifying panelists based on input interaction patterns
description: A panelist identification device for determining an identity of a panelist based on an input interaction pattern of the panelist is provided. Additionally, a method for determining an identity of a panelist based on an input interaction pattern of the panelist is provided. Further, a computer-readable storage device having processor-executable instructions embodied thereon is provided. The instructions are for determining an identity of a panelist based on an input interaction pattern of the panelist.

title: System and method for semi-supervised conditional generative modeling using adversarial networks
description: One embodiment facilitates generating synthetic data objects using a semi-supervised GAN. During operation, a generator module synthesizes a data object derived from a noise vector and an attribute label. The system passes, to an unsupervised discriminator module, the data object and a set of training objects which are obtained from a training data set. The unsupervised discriminator module calculates: a value indicating a probability that the data object is real; and a latent feature representation of the data object. The system passes the latent feature representation and the attribute label to a supervised discriminator module. The supervised discriminator module calculates a value indicating a probability that the attribute label given the data object is real. The system performs the aforementioned steps iteratively until the generator module produces data objects with a given attribute label which the unsupervised and supervised discriminator modules can no longer identify as fake.

title: Artificial neural network
description:
A computer-implemented method of training an artificial neural network (ANN) by generating a first learned parameter for use in normalising input data values during a subsequent inference phase of the trained ANN comprises:  during an iterative training phase:   
for each of a series of batches of training data values, deriving a batch variance of the batch of training data values and a running variance of all training data values already processed in the training phase; generating an approximation of a current value of the first learned parameter so that a first scaling factor dependent upon the approximation of the first learned parameter and the running variance, is constrained to be equal to a power of two; normalising the batch of input data values by a second scaling factor dependent upon the approximation of the current value of the first learned parameter and the batch variance; deriving an error value; and 
updating the first learned parameter in dependence upon a gradient of the error value with respect to the approximation of the first learned parameter.

title: Computerized natural language query intent dispatching
description: A natural language query can be processed via a main natural language processor. A request to produce an intent of the query can be dispatched from the main natural language processor to an extension natural language processor. An intent of the query can be generated via the extension natural language processor in response to the dispatched request, with the generating of the intent being performed independently of the main natural language processor. The intent of the natural language query can be passed from the extension natural language processor to the main natural language processor in response to the request to produce the intent of the query. A selection of a conversation query processor for responding to the intent can be produced via the main natural language processor. Additionally, an instruction to respond to the intent of the query can be passed to the selected conversation query processor.

title: Model-calculating unit and control device for selectively calculating an rbf model, a gaussian process model, and an mlp model
description: The invention relates to a model-calculating unit (22) for selectively calculating an RBF model or a neuron layer of a multilayer perceptron model, comprising a hardwired calculation core (11, 13, 14) formed in hardware for calculating a fixedly defined computing algorithm in coupled functional blocks, wherein the calculation core (11, 13, 14) is designed to calculate, for an RBF model, an output value (y) in accordance with one or more input values of an input value vector (ut), with node points (V), with length scales (L), and with parameters defined for each node point, wherein the calculation core (11, 13, 14) is also designed to calculate, for the neuron layer of the multilayer perceptron model having a number of neurons (20), an output value for each neuron (20) in accordance with the one or more input values of the input value vector (ut), with a weighting matrix having weighting factors (V 0…p7-1,0…p6-1 ), and with an offset value defined for each neuron (20).

title: Neural network
description: A neural network (FIG. 3), which may be implemented either in hardware or software, is constructed of neurons or neuron circuits (46, 47, 51, 52) each having only one significant processing element in the form of an adder. Each neural network further includes means for applying a logarithmic function (41, 42, 44) to its inputs and for applying an inverse-logarithmic function (54, 55, 58, 59) to the outputs of its neurons. The neural network utilizes a training algorithm which does not require repetitive training and which yields a global minimum to each given set of input vectors.

title: Distributed machine learning intelligence development systems
description: A system, method, and computer-readable instructions for a distributed machine learning system are provided. A plurality of distributed learning environments are in communication over a network, wherein each environment has a computing device having a memory and a processor coupled to the memory, the processor adapted implement a learning environment via one or more agents in a rules-based system, wherein the agents learn to perform tasks in their respective learning environment; and a persistent storage in which knowledge comprising a plurality of rules developed by the agents for performing the tasks are stored, wherein the knowledge is tagged and shared with other agents throughout the plurality of distributed learning environments.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE OF A KNOWLEDGE-BASED SYSTEM
description: A method and apparatus for automating the acquisition, reconstruction and generation of knowledge bases of associated ideas (figure 1) and using such knowledge bases in many applications including machine translation of human languages, search and retrieval of unstructured text, or other data, based on concept search, voice recognition, data compression and artificial intelligence systems.

title: A method for measuring tidal flat elevation using remote sensing water content
description: The invention discloses a kind of methods using remote sensing moisture measurement beach elevation, include the following steps: the upper soll layer spectral value using all band spectrometer measurement Coastal Area, the relationship for analyzing spectral value and Coastal Area soil moisture content constructs remote sensing water content inverse model using Statistic Correlation.Select the moisture-sensitive wave band in remotely-sensed data, the soil moisture content of inverting Coastal Area；The relationship between soil moisture content and beach elevation is analyzed also with Statistic Correlation, constructs the relational model of beach water content and elevation, which, which is used for satellite image, can get beach elevation.The present invention is based on remote sensing image inverting beach beach face water content, obtain beach elevation indirectly, have the characteristics that at low cost, with high accuracy.

title: A fault diagnosis model training method, fault diagnosis method and related device
description: The invention discloses a fault diagnosis model training method, a fault diagnosis method and a related device, comprising: acquiring N historical fault work orders, and based on the manual diagnosis results of the M historical fault work orders and the M historical fault work orders A single system diagnosis result is used to determine the fault diagnosis accuracy of the fault diagnosis expert system; if the fault diagnosis accuracy is less than the first threshold and greater than or equal to the second threshold, the system based on the N historical fault work orders The diagnosis results, the manual diagnosis results of the M historical fault work orders, and the fault feature data of the N historical fault work orders are used to train a pre-stored fault diagnosis model, and the first threshold is greater than the second threshold. Using the embodiments of the present invention is beneficial to improve the fault diagnosis accuracy of the fault diagnosis model and reduce the training cost of the fault diagnosis model.

title: Service processing method and device
description: This invention discloses a service processing method and apparatus, relating to the field of communications. The method includes: an intermediate proxy node establishing a connection with a user agent and providing a predetermined webpage to the user agent on the connection; the predetermined webpage including a setting option for whether to process access requests through the intermediate proxy node; the intermediate proxy node receiving operation information triggered by the user agent according to the setting option; when the operation information is generated by the user agent triggering a prohibition processing option, the intermediate proxy node intercepts the access request sent by the user agent to the network server again and forwards the access request directly to the network server. This invention solves the problem that the intermediate proxy node needs to process the received information every time, consuming a lot of resources, thus achieving the effect of saving resources.

title: Artificial intelligence-based search method, apparatus, device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The invention provides a search method, a search device, search equipment and a computer-readable storage medium based on artificial intelligence. According to the embodiment of the invention, the search requirement type is obtained according to the search keyword provided by the user, and then the requirement keyword is obtained according to the search keyword and the search mode of the search requirement type, so that the search result can be obtained according to the requirement keyword, and the search result is output.

title: Method, device, computer equipment and storage medium for detecting mathematical formulas in images
description: The invention relates to a detection method, device, computer equipment and storage medium of a mathematical formula in an image. The method includes: acquiring an image to be detected; performing text segmentation on the image to be detected to obtain a plurality of text regions; sequentially inputting the plurality of text regions into input variables of a trained first convolutional neural network, output a plurality of roughly selected text regions containing mathematical formulas; input the roughly selected text regions containing mathematical formulas into the input variables of the trained second convolutional neural network, and finally output the text regions containing mathematical formulas. Divide the image to be detected into multiple text areas and input them into the convolutional neural network, first rough select the text area, and then re-screen the rough selected text area, which can more accurately obtain the mathematical formula , which improves the accuracy of detecting whether an image contains a mathematical formula.

title: Based on the object test equipment and method for improving convolutional neural networks
description: The present invention provides based on improve convolutional neural networks method for checking object, this method comprises: acquiring the tag image of marked object；Using stochastical sampling method, initial training is carried out to convolutional neural networks are improved, obtain the positive sample and negative sample of preliminary classification, and corresponding class probability value, further according to class probability value, a certain proportion of positive sample and negative sample are selected, is trained to convolutional neural networks are improved, obtains trained object detection model；Input image to be detected；Object detection, output test result are carried out to image to be detected using object detection model.Compared with prior art, the present invention can rapidly and accurately realize the object detection in image.

title: System and method for generating automatic response to input query in human-computer interaction environment
description: The present disclosure describes a system and method for generating automatic responses to input queries received from users in a human-computer interaction environment. The system may include an external memory in which data is stored and separated into a plurality of segments in a hierarchical structure. The system may further include a processor and a memory coupled to the processor. The processor may execute a plurality of modules stored in the memory. The segment identification module may be configured to identify a relevant segment from the plurality of segments that matches the user input. The relevant data determination module may be configured to determine relevant data within the relevant segment that matches the user input. The response generation module may be configured to generate a response regarding the user input based on the relevant data.

title: Advertisement space flow prediction method, system, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention provides a method, a system, equipment and a storage medium for predicting advertisement space flow, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting sample characteristic data, wherein the sample characteristic data comprises historical flow characteristics and predicted time-of-day characteristics of advertisement spots; adding a predicted daily flow value tag to the sample characteristic data; training based on the sample characteristic data to obtain a flow prediction model, wherein the input of the flow prediction model is a historical flow characteristic and a predicted time-of-day characteristic, and the input of the flow prediction model is a predicted daily flow prediction value; acquiring historical flow characteristics of advertisement spots to be predicted and time of day characteristics to be predicted, and inputting the flow prediction model; and determining the flow prediction value of the advertisement position to be predicted on the day to be predicted according to the output data of the flow prediction model. The invention realizes more accurate prediction of the traffic of the advertisement resource position.

title: Target tracking method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The application discloses a target tracking method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are used for detecting a target in a target video stream to obtain detection characteristics of the target to be tracked, wherein the detection characteristics at least comprise two sub-characteristics, the weight of each sub-characteristic is determined based on the change information of each sub-characteristic in each frame of image, each sub-characteristic is processed according to the weight of each sub-characteristic to obtain target characteristic information, and the target to be tracked in the target video stream is tracked based on the target characteristic information to obtain the tracking track of the target to be tracked. The method and the device realize self-adaptive adjustment of the detection characteristics based on the weights, so that the obtained target characteristic information is more in line with complex tracking scenes, such as the scene where the target is blocked, and the target tracking efficiency and the target tracking precision are improved.

title: A nondestructive detection method for composite material defects based on deep learning algorithm
description: The invention discloses a composite material defect nondestructive inspection method based on a deep learning algorithm, which comprises the steps of firstly preprocessing an original image, wherein each preprocessed image corresponds to one label picture; taking the preprocessed image as the input of the U-net network, taking the tag image as a tag, and carrying out iterative training on the U-net network by a gradient descent method, wherein the trained U-net network forms a processing network; the output of the processing network is a feature map of the input image; inputting an image to be processed into a processing network, outputting a feature image, processing the feature image through a threshold segmentation algorithm to obtain a binary image of a marked defect, and positioning the defect position in the binary image through a rectangular frame positioning algorithm; and finally, fusing the binary image and the image to be processed, and positioning the defect in the image to be processed. The method solves the limitations of the traditional algorithm through the rapidness and high accuracy of the neural network learning characteristics, and provides a new thought for defect detection of the composite material.

title: A method and system for predicting bit error probability of OTUk frame in optical transport network
description: The invention discloses a method and a system for predicting OTUk frame error probability of an optical transport network, belonging to the field of network performance prediction of the optical transport network. The method comprises the following steps: a training stage: A1. acquiring an error code performance value in a target OTUk SM-OH in an optical transport network and historical data of an optical domain optical channel error rate corresponding to the target OTUk; A2. marking the error code state according to the error code performance value of each time period of the OTUk; A3. taking a logarithmic value taking the error rate of the optical channel in the optical domain as a base as an input, taking the error state as an output, and training an OTUk frame error rate prediction model by adopting a logarithmic probability regression algorithm; an application stage: and inputting the error rate of the optical domain optical channel in the future time period into the trained prediction model to obtain the error rate probability of the OTUk frame corresponding to the future time period. The invention firstly proposes to predict the performance degradation probability of the electric domain signal by using the optical domain performance value and realizes the calculation of the performance degradation probability by using the logistic probability regression modeling.

title: A training method and device for formula recognition model
description: The present application discloses a training method for a formula recognition model, and a formula recognition model is obtained by training according to a training formula trajectory and a formula corresponding to the training formula trajectory. When training the formula recognition model, feature extraction is performed on the training formula trajectory to obtain a feature sequence; at the first decoding moment: the first semantic vector and the feature sequence are decoded to obtain a first context vector, wherein the first semantic vector is obtained according to the first hidden layer vector decoded at the second decoding moment, and the second decoding moment is the previous decoding moment of the first decoding moment; based on the first context vector and the label, the parameters of the formula recognition module are adjusted. It can be seen that in the model training stage, decoding is performed based on the first semantic vector and the feature sequence, so that the trained formula recognition model can adaptively fuse semantic information, thereby making the recognition accuracy of the formula recognition model higher.

title: Pre-training word vector generation method, system, electronic device and storage medium
