description: The application provides a pre-training word vector generation method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the technical scheme of the method comprises the steps of data set processing, collecting a data set, preprocessing the data set and converting original text data in the data set into digital representation; the method comprises the steps of creating a vector matrix, taking corresponding vectors from the vector matrix according to the digital representation, hiding the vectors within the size range of a central word window through a hiding layer to obtain hidden vectors, calculating the hidden vectors through a linear layer to obtain output vectors of central words CBOW, obtaining a matrix K, a matrix V and a matrix Q according to the output vectors and the digital representation, and further generating word vectors according to the matrix K, the matrix V and the matrix Q. The application solves the problem of limited word vector expression capability in the existing method.

title: Multi-target tracking method with fusion mechanism
description: The invention discloses a multi-target tracking method with a fusion mechanism, which belongs to the technical field of target tracking and comprises the steps of S31, selecting an image of which any frame contains a plurality of targets to be tracked as a previous frame image, S32, forming a moving image pair by the previous frame image and a current frame image, inputting the moving image pair into a position prediction model, predicting all target positions in the current frame image and normalized motion displacement of each target relative to the previous frame image, S33, updating the positions of the targets to be tracked according to all target positions in the current frame image and the normalized motion displacement of each target relative to the previous frame image, obtaining an updated previous frame image, S34, repeatedly executing the steps S32 to S33 based on the updated previous frame image, and realizing continuous tracking of multiple targets. The invention realizes the end-to-end multi-target detection tracking on the premise of not increasing any calculation cost.

title: Ship classification and identification method and system based on track characteristics and deep neural network MobileNet migration training
description: The invention discloses a ship classification and identification method and a system based on track characteristics and deep neural network MobileNet migration training; the method comprises the steps of firstly mapping characteristics such as speed, course, acceleration and the like obtained by excavation from track data into RGB color space, converting the characteristics into track characteristic image data, then migrating a deep neural network MobileNet and image Net pre-training weights thereof, training the network by using the track characteristic image data generated before, and finally obtaining a ship type recognition model to realize ship classification recognition. The method has obvious advantages in recognition accuracy and speed, and can be effectively applied to classification recognition of ship targets.

title: Tobacco leaf processing method, system, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a tobacco leaf processing method, system, equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: dividing the tobacco leaf processing procedure into a plurality of sub-stages; Prediction is performed to obtain the predicted moisture content of the tobacco leaves; if the predicted moisture content of the tobacco leaves is not within the preset error range after the end of the current sub-stage, then based on the measured value of the current sub-stage moisture meter and the predicted moisture content of the tobacco leaves, Adjust the steam moisture content of the current sub-stage; use the adjusted steam moisture content of the current sub-stage to re-process the tobacco leaves in the current sub-stage until the predicted moisture content of the tobacco leaves after the end of the current sub-stage is at Within the preset error range, the next sub-stage processing is carried out; the invention solves the problem of low qualified rate of moisture content of tobacco leaves, improves the qualified rate of moisture content of tobacco leaves, and ensures the production quality of tobacco leaves.

title: An automatic design method for convolutional neural network framework based on shuffle frog leaping algorithm
description: A method for automatically designing a convolutional neural network framework based on the shuffled frog leaping algorithm: The convolutional neural network framework design problem is modeled as a constrained combinatorial optimization problem, and a network framework that meets the target parameter quantity requirements is designed. A discrete variable-length coding method is proposed to encode hyperparameters such as the output of the convolutional layer, the number of fully connected layers, and the number of neurons in each layer to represent the convolutional neural network framework. Then, the shuffled frog leaping algorithm is used to search for the optimal network framework with the classification accuracy on the MNIST data set as the fitness evaluation value to obtain the optimal convolutional neural network framework. The method for automatically designing a convolutional neural network framework based on the shuffled frog leaping proposed in the present invention has the characteristics of being fully automatic and highly efficient, and is also very friendly to inexperienced scientific research beginners.

title: Music recommendation method, system, device and storage medium based on audio similarity
description: The invention discloses a music recommendation method, a system, a device and a storage medium based on audio similarity, which comprise the steps of obtaining a first audio file of historical music, converting the first audio file into a first spectrogram, converting the first spectrogram into a first chroma gradient map, inputting the first chroma gradient map into a trained chroma feature extraction model to obtain a first chroma gradient matrix, obtaining a second audio file of music to be selected, converting the second audio file into a second chroma gradient map, converting the second spectrogram into a second chroma gradient map, inputting the second chroma gradient map into the trained chroma feature extraction model to obtain a second chroma gradient matrix, calculating the similarity of the first chroma gradient matrix and the second chroma gradient matrix, and determining recommended music according to the similarity. The embodiment of the invention can search and recommend the music with high similarity according to the essential attribute of the music, more accords with the requirement of users, improves the user experience, and can be widely applied to the technical field of information processing.

title: Automatic variogram encoder method based on multitask learning
description: The invention discloses a variation graph automatic encoder method based on multi-task learning, which comprises the following steps of S1, preprocessing source data, S2, dividing graph data sets, S3, inputting a training set obtained in S22 into a shallow graph convolution layer to obtain shallow shared embedded representation H, S4, respectively inputting the shallow shared embedded representation H obtained in S3 into two different downstream network frames to obtain respective embedded representations, and S5, respectively carrying out link prediction tasks and semi-supervised node classification tasks on the two different embedded representations obtained in S4. The method can enable the embedded representation to be more similar to the real distribution of the sample space, has strong competitiveness in a link prediction task and strong robustness.

title: Test device and test method using test device
description: The invention discloses a test device and a test method using the test device for testing. Wherein, the device includes: a first coplanar waveguide and a second coplanar waveguide, the first coplanar waveguide includes a first center conductor strip and a second edge ground strip located on both sides of the first center conductor strip, and the second coplanar waveguide It includes a second center conductor strip and a second edge ground strip located on both sides of the second center conductor strip, and the first edge ground strip located on both sides of the first center conductor strip is connected to the second edge located on both sides of the second center conductor strip. The strips are integrated, and a target position for connecting the Josephson junction to be tested is reserved between the first central conductor strip and the second central conductor strip. The first coplanar waveguide and the second coplanar waveguide are combined to form the first resonance of the test device. cavity. The invention solves the technical problem that it is difficult to improve the Josephson junction in a targeted manner due to the inability to quantitatively distinguish and measure the different loss mechanisms of the Josephson junction.

title: Extreme case detection and collection for path planning systems
description: The present invention relates to a system and method for detecting and storing information describing errors in a predicted path planning function of a neural network.

title: OCT image denoising method, device, equipment and medium
description: The invention discloses an OCT image denoising method, a device, equipment and a medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining an OCT image to form a sample data set, wherein the sample data set is divided into a training set and a verification set; constructing a feature fusion attention intensive network for OCT image denoising, wherein the main structure of the feature fusion attention intensive network comprises a sparse block, a feature enhancement block, an attention mechanism and a reconstruction block, and the feature fusion attention intensive network is used for denoising the OCT image; inputting the sample data set into the feature fusion attention intensive network for training and testing until convergence; and inputting the image to be detected into a trained feature fusion attention-intensive network for processing to obtain a clear OCT image after denoising processing. The invention provides a network for progressively converging features and concentrating attention on the basis of the original deep convolution network, and OCT image noise can be effectively removed on the basis of the network.

title: Data relocation management in a data center network
description: Techniques are provided for an adaptive data recovery scheme. For example, one or more embodiments described herein may include a system that may include a memory that may store computer-executable components. The system may also include a processor operatively coupled to the memory and executable computer-executable components stored in the memory. The computer-executable components may include a data management component that can modify the data recovery scheme based on performance data and data recovery requirements exhibited by the data center network. The data recovery scheme may direct relocation of data within the network.

title: Performance testing of robotic systems
description: A "perceived statistical performance model" (PSPM) modeling perceived slices of a runtime stack of an autonomous vehicle or other robotic system may be used herein, for example, for safety/performance testing. PSPM is configured to receive the computed perceived ground truth, determine a probabilistic perceived uncertainty distribution from the perceived ground truth based on a set of learned parameters that are learned from a set of actual perceived outputs generated using the perceived slice to be modeled. PSPM includes a time-dependent model such that the perceived output sampled at a current time instant depends on at least one of an earlier one of the perceived outputs sampled at a previous time instant and an earlier one of the perceived ground truth calculated for the previous time instant.

title: Model training method and related equipment
description: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a model training method and related equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an initial two-dimensional object image carrying a real tag, processing the initial two-dimensional object image through a three-dimensional reconstruction network model to obtain three-dimensional image data of the initial two-dimensional object image, rendering the three-dimensional image data of the initial two-dimensional object image to obtain a target two-dimensional object image, processing the target two-dimensional object image through a discriminator to obtain a prediction tag of the target two-dimensional object image, constructing a first loss function according to the real tag and the prediction tag, constructing a second loss function according to the initial two-dimensional object image and the target two-dimensional object image, and training the three-dimensional reconstruction network model through the first loss function and the second loss function. In the method, the three-dimensional reconstruction network model can be used as a part of a picture generator in a generated type countermeasure network mode, and training of the three-dimensional reconstruction network model is realized through countermeasure training of the picture generator and a discriminator.

title: Method and device for compressing neural network model
description: The invention provides a method and a device for compressing a neural network model, electronic equipment and a readable storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence such as deep learning and cloud service. The method for compressing the neural network model comprises the following steps: acquiring a neural network model to be compressed; determining a first bit width, a second bit width and a target sparse rate corresponding to the neural network model to be compressed; obtaining a target numerical value according to the first bit width, the second bit width and the target sparse rate; and compressing the neural network model to be compressed by using the target numerical value, the first bit width and the second bit width to obtain a compression result of the neural network model to be compressed. The method and the device can simplify the compression steps of the neural network model and improve the compression efficiency of the neural network model.

title: Robot Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning Initialization Method Based on Automatic Discovery of Abstract Actions
description: The invention discloses a robot hierarchical reinforcement learning initialization method based on automatic discovery of abstract action. The method is characterized by: involving a Q learning module, an abstract action creation module, a state-abstract action assessment value Q (s, o) initialization module and a hierarchical reinforcement learning module, firstly utilizing the Q learning module to let a robot interact the environment to produce experience, and then based on the experience, using the abstract action creation module to let the robot create abstract action, finally by means of the state-abstract action assessment value Q (s, o) initialization module, letting the robot turn to the hierarchical reinforcement learning module from ordinary reinforcement learning to conduct hierarchical reinforcement learning, and recording the learning result. According to the invention, through initialization of the state-abstract action assessment value Q (s, o), the robot can reach a faster convergence speed when adopting hierarchical reinforcement learning method to solve the task in a complex environment.

title: Intelligent logistics data management method based on cloud computing
description: The invention provides an intelligent logistics data management method based on cloud computing. The method includes: the cloud platform e-commerce company accepts the user's order information, and selects the consignor to carry out the transportation service according to the user's service cost minimization target Z; obtains the logistics center vehicle Type, quantity and capacity information, as well as all user node information; the transportation route of each vehicle is planned with the lowest fuel consumption as the objective function U; the weighted sum of the two objective functions Z and U is the total objective, and the particle swarm algorithm is used to solve the problem global optimal solution. The present invention proposes an intelligent logistics data management method based on cloud computing. Based on user big data analysis, while ensuring that the subjective needs of users are met, logistics resources can be optimized, and user satisfaction can be improved to the greatest extent. Double benefits of economy and environmental protection.

title: System monitoring method and device
description: The invention discloses a system monitoring method and device. A specific implementation manner of the method comprises the following steps of: obtaining a history state index data sequence of at least one data acquisition period of a monitored system; importing the history state index data sequence into a pre-trained feature extraction recommendation model to carry out matching, so as to obtain a feature extraction algorithm matched with the history state index data sequence to serve as a recommended feature extraction algorithm; determining a maximum value and a minimum value of feature values obtained through carrying out feature extraction on the history state index data sequence according to the recommended feature extraction algorithm; determining a normal value range of the feature values obtained through carrying out feature extraction on the history state index data sequence of the monitored system according to the recommended feature extraction algorithm according to the determined maximum value and minimum value; and monitoring the monitored system according to the recommended feature extraction algorithm and the normal value range. Through the implementation manner, the operation and maintenance cost of system monitoring is decreased.

title: A ternary vector synthesis control optimization method
description: The invention discloses a ternary vector synthesis control optimization method, comprising the following steps: 1) constructing a fitness function for calculating the error extremum value of the actual positioning point and the ideal positioning point, and the fitness function is corresponding to the triplet feeding amplitude and phase The position of the positioning point is a variable, and the function value represents the error between the position of the actual positioning point and the ideal positioning point; 2) Using the multi-element array equivalent radiation center formula with the amplitude and phase of the array element as independent variables, the genetic algorithm is used to calculate the ideal The amplitude and phase variables of the positioning point are optimized so that the distance between the actual positioning point and the ideal positioning point is within the error range; 3) The amplitude and phase of each array element at the actual positioning point are obtained. The present invention adopts the optimization algorithm, the objective function of the optimization algorithm, and the optimization example, which reduces the complexity of the operation, has strong global convergence ability and robust performance, and can solve complex systems such as nonlinear, multi-model, and multi-objective , which has the advantages of high parallelism, randomness, and effective use of global information.

title: Deep learning dimension reduction method and device for link prediction
description: The present invention proposes a deep learning dimensionality reduction method and device for link prediction. The method includes: determining the first-level connection network node of each network node according to the connection relationship of each network node within a set time period and secondary connection network nodes; according to the set duration, the set time period is divided into multiple time slices, and according to the connection relationship of each network node in each time slice, determine the The connection relationship between each network node and the corresponding first-level connection network node and second-level connection network node; according to the connection relationship between each network node and the corresponding first-level connection network node and second-level connection network node in each time slice , performing link prediction on each network node through a deep learning algorithm model. The invention reduces the amount of data input to the deep learning algorithm model, reduces learning and training time and improves the accuracy of link prediction.

title: Method, device and system for processing voice commands
description: The present invention proposes a kind for the treatment of method and apparatus of phonetic order, wherein, this method includes：Speech recognition is carried out to phonetic order, to generate the text message of phonetic order；Semantic parsing is carried out to text message, to obtain the semantic analysis result of text message；Judge whether corresponding operation is able to carry out according to the semantic analysis result of text message；Whether if judging that according to the semantic analysis result of text message corresponding operation can not be performed, it is instruction text data to determine whether text message；If judging, text message, for instruction text data, is modified to text message, to obtain revised text message；Semantic parsing is carried out to revised text message, and corresponding operation is performed according to the semantic analysis result of revised text message.Hereby it is achieved that the amendment of the text message to that can not perform corresponding operation, reduces the operation of user, the interactive experience of user is improved.

title: An image fusion method and system based on a convolutional neural network model
description: The invention discloses an image fusion method and system based on a convolutional neural network model, wherein the image fusion method includes: acquiring at least one piece of style image information to be fused and at least one piece of content image information to be fused, and combining the Scaling the style image information to be fused and the content image information to be fused to a uniform size; performing initial fusion processing on the style image information to be fused and the content image information to be fused in a uniform size to obtain initial fused image information; Calculating the loss gradient of the initial fused image information and the style image information to be fused and the content image information to be fused in a uniform size in the convolutional neural network model to obtain a total loss gradient; The initial fusion image information is updated and the parameters of the convolutional neural network model are saved. In the embodiment of the present invention, the user's demand for image fusion is met, and the speed of image fusion is improved.

title: An image fusion method and device based on PCNN and linear superposition technology
description: The present invention provides a kind of image interfusion method and device based on PCNN Yu linear superposition technology, including：S1, the first pulse diagram picture and the second pulse diagram picture corresponding to the first image and the second image are obtained using PCNN；S2, the first pulse diagram picture and the second pulse diagram picture are overlapped respectively, obtain the first Saliency maps picture and the second Saliency maps picture corresponding to described first image and second image；S3, according to the first Saliency maps picture and the secondary Saliency maps picture, described first image and second image are merged using decision algorithm.By the present invention in that the effective information in image is fully extracted with PCNN, then for every image to be fused, effective information in its pulse diagram picture is overlapped, and image is merged with reference to simple decision algorithm, the inventive method is simple, processing speed is fast, can produce preferable syncretizing effect.

title: A Personalized Recommendation Method Fused with Structural Features and Implicit Feedback
description: The invention discloses a personalized recommendation method combining structural features and implicit feedback. The present invention uses the knowledge base embedding method to extract the feature representation of structured knowledge from the knowledge base, then integrates the implicit feedback between users and items and the structural embedding of the knowledge base, and provides each A ranked list of items that a user recommends for his interest. Therefore, the present invention greatly improves the accuracy of recommendation and has wide commercial application value.

title: A Convolutional Neural Network Based Pedestrian Attribute Recognition Method in Surveillance Scenes
description: The present invention relates to a kind of descending humanized recognition methods of monitoring scene based on convolutional neural networks, comprise the following steps：The monitor video containing pedestrian is obtained, and intercepts frame of video, builds pedestrian's data set under monitoring scene；By improving AlexNet convolutional neural networks models, new convolutional neural networks model is built；Pedestrian's data set is input in the new convolutional neural networks model and is trained, obtains pedestrian's attribute Recognition Model；Complete to identify using pedestrian's attribute Recognition Model.Accuracy of identification of the present invention is high, simple to operate, speed is fast.

title: A Local Descriptor Learning Method Based on RGBD Data
description: The invention discloses a kind of local description learning methods based on RGBD data, and including designing convolutional neural networks model, using stochastic gradient descent method training convolutional neural networks, the convolutional neural networks construction completed using training describes son.Wherein convolutional neural networks model includes two parts：First part is characterized extract layer, and second part is characterized fused layer；Wherein feature extraction layer is divided into two sub-networks：Two-dimensional convolution sub-neural network and Three dimensional convolution sub-neural network；Fusion Features layer is full Connection Neural Network；Two-dimensional convolution sub-neural network and Three dimensional convolution sub-neural network are parallel networks.The present invention solves the problems, such as that RGBD data fusion modes extraction feature point description is sub, and relative to other congenic methods, this method robustness is stronger, matching accuracy rate higher.

title: Compressive Evolutionary Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm Based on Phase Difference Wavefront Reconstruction
description: The invention belongs to Wavefront detectings and image to restore field, for caused by multidimensional multipole value of the phase difference method when large scale and high frequency wavefront distortion reconstruct the problem of reconstruction accuracy misalignment, compression evolution Hybrid Particle Swarm Optimization is invented, the algorithm solves the problems, such as that partial gradient class algorithm is easily absorbed in local extremum, the high-precision feature of partial gradient algorithm is maintained, enhances the adaptability that phase difference method Wavefront detecting and image restore.The algorithm flow chart of the present invention is estimated as shown in Figure 1, first obtaining the coarse of global extremum by the compression evolution particle cluster algorithm of random initial value, then is approached using high-precision two step of BFGS algorithms progress of partial gradient.The particle cluster algorithm of use introduces compressibility factor, balances the search capability of global and local, and the natural selection for having introduced integral particles group is evolved；The BFGS algorithms of use are a kind of mature and stable plan newton local search algorithms.By ' two step method ' strategy, the present invention can greatly enhance phase difference method Optimization Solution in large scale and the recovery capability of high frequency wavefront distortion, improve the adaptability of phase difference method.

title: A Performance Evaluation Method of Filter Press Workshop Based on Fuzzy Mathematics Theory
description: The present invention relates to a performance evaluation method of a filter press workshop based on fuzzy mathematical theory, comprising the following steps: 1) construction of a comprehensive evaluation model; 2) determination of the weight of each evaluation index by an analytic hierarchy process; 3) establishment of a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation system According to the fuzzy mathematics related knowledge, the fuzzy evaluation sets of production performance of different teams are calculated, and then the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation value is obtained. The present invention uses relevant knowledge of fuzzy mathematics in the production performance assessment field of the filter press workshop of the coal preparation plant, and establishes a fuzzy comprehensive assessment system based on the analytic hierarchy process, which integrates multiple assessment indicators into a single assessment indicator, which is used for each filter press workshop. The assessment of team production performance provides comprehensive indicators.

title: Convolution calculation method and device for deep convolutional neural network
description: The present application discloses a convolution calculation method and device for a deep convolutional neural network. The method includes determining a first optimization parameter; establishing a knowledge base according to the first optimization parameter, wherein the knowledge base is used to store the convolution algorithm and the corresponding first optimization parameter according to a table structure; and searching whether There is an execution plan meeting the preset performance condition; if there is an execution plan meeting the preset performance condition in the knowledge base, a convolution calculation method meeting the preset performance condition is generated. The present application solves the technical problem that the performance of the convolution calculation method cannot be adaptively tuned according to different depth convolution neural networks.

title: Image retrieval method, device and storage medium based on spiking cortical model
description: The invention discloses a kind of image search methods for providing cortex model based on pulse, including：Determine that the parameter value of cortex model is provided in pulse using default genetic algorithm；The textural characteristics of cortex model extraction image to be retrieved are provided in the pulse after being determined by the parameter value；Based on textural characteristics retrieval and the relevant image of image to be retrieved.By improved default genetic algorithm come the automatic setting for carrying out pulse and providing cortex model parameter value in the present invention, and the pulse after being set using parameter value provides cortex model to extract the textural characteristics of image to be retrieved, to carry out the retrieval of associated picture according to the textural characteristics extracted, improve the setting efficiency of model parameter, and the accuracy for improving texture feature extraction, to greatly improve the accuracy and recall precision of image retrieval.In addition, the present invention also provides a kind of image retrieving apparatus, equipment and storage mediums for providing cortex model based on pulse.

title: A Neural Network Based Tracking Robot Trajectory Recognition Method
description: The invention discloses a neural network-based trajectory recognition method for a tracking robot, which comprises the following steps: 1) the robot collects road images in an environment of changing illumination; 2) compresses the collected image data into pictures, and stores the pictures as jpg file; 3) crop the picture collected; 4) transfer the picture data collected into the computer, and mark the center of the guide line in the three areas in each picture on the computer side; 5) use the training data obtained Import it into matlab, train the neural network, and obtain the various parameters of the neural network; 6) write the neural network algorithm for marking the midpoint of the leading line in the middle of the road in the picture according to the neural network parameters obtained by matlab training; ...; this book Invented a neural network-based trajectory recognition method for tracking robots, which has strong self-adaptability, and has high accuracy and robustness for identifying road trajectories under changing visual lighting conditions.

title: Temperature detection method and device based on portable temperature measuring device
description: The invention discloses a temperature detection method and device based on a portable temperature measuring device, relates to the technical field of detection, and mainly aims to solve the problem that the temperature measurement requirement of agility cannot be met. The method comprises the following steps: sending a connection instruction to an Internet of things platform through a preset integration networking protocol; after connection with the Internet of things platform is established, temperature data, distance data and correction parameters which are respectively collected by a temperature sensor and a distance sensor in the portable temperature measuring device are obtained, and the correction parameters are used for representing influence factors acting on a mapping relation between the temperature data and the distance data; based on the mapping relation between the temperature and the distance, carrying out fusion processing on the temperature data and the distance data, and determining a compensation value of the temperature data; and detecting and processing the compensation value, the temperature data and the distance data based on the trained temperature compensation processing model, and determining a detected target temperature value.

title: Data processing method, apparatus, electronic device, and computer-readable storage medium
description: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a data processing method, a data processing device, an electronic device and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring digital voice data, wherein the digital voice data are label-free data; performing double training based on the data voice data to obtain a voice data processing model; and acquiring voice data to be processed, and processing the voice data to be processed by using the voice data processing model to obtain a data processing result. This technical scheme need not to label to pronunciation training data, also need not to consider the human cost that the data marking was spent, consequently can expand pronunciation training data quantity by a wide margin, combines above-mentioned dual training mechanism can obtain relatively complete pronunciation data processing model simultaneously to under the required a large amount of manpowers of saving data marking and financial resources's the condition, can effectively realize the comprehensive cover of data, and then effectively improve the speech processing accuracy, promote speech processing task performance, be favorable to promoting.

title: A method and device for event detection based on multi-layer graph attention network
description: The application provides an event detection method and device based on a multilayer graph attention network, which comprises the steps of obtaining context words in event text information, and determining a syntactic information adjacent matrix and a splicing vector corresponding to the context words; taking the adjacency matrix and the splicing vector as the input of an artificial neural network to obtain an output vector; generating aggregation information according to the splicing vector and the output vector in an aggregation mode; and determining the trigger word category of the context word according to the aggregation information. By simultaneously combining the syntactic information and the context information of the context words, the method effectively solves the problems that information is easy to lose and errors are easy to propagate by using a syntactic analysis tool; and by combining the jump connection module in the attention network layer, the situation that the final trigger word classification is not ideal due to excessive propagation of some short-distance syntax information is avoided, and the precision, recall rate and F1 value of the trigger word classification are effectively improved.

title: Electric cogeneration system, method and storage medium for electric heating, gas and fertilizer coupling biomass power plant
description: The invention discloses an electric heating gas fertilizer coupling biomass power plant electric combined supply system, method and storage medium, wherein biomass power generation equipment comprises a biomass direct-fired furnace, a generator set, a cylinder sleeve water heat exchanger and a flue gas heat exchanger; the biomass direct-fired furnace burns a first amount of straws to generate biomass gas heat, and a first part of the biomass gas heat is supplied to the generator set to generate electric energy and is merged into the power distribution network; the generating set provides high-temperature hot water heat for the cylinder sleeve water heat exchanger and provides high-temperature flue gas heat for the flue gas heat exchanger, the flue gas heat exchanger recovers waste heat of the cylinder sleeve water heat exchanger and the high-temperature flue gas heat and outputs recovered heat, and the recovered heat is superposed with a second part of biomass gas heat and used for catalyzing anaerobic fermentation of biomass in the methane tank to generate biomass natural gas and organic fertilizer raw materials. According to the invention, the safe and efficient operation of the biomass power plant is realized by constructing an optimization model and solving the model by adopting a genetic algorithm.

title: A hierarchical charging strategy method for electric vehicles based on probability transition matrix
description: The invention relates to the field of new energy electric automobiles, and provides an electric automobile layered charging strategy method based on a probability transfer matrix, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps that a main control center establishes an electric vehicle charging load prediction model based on a neural network, optimizes a load curve by taking the minimum load peak-valley difference at the power grid side as a target function, and gives an instruction to a secondary control center; the secondary control center makes a charging plan by calculating a probability transfer matrix and broadcasts the charging plan to a controlled electric automobile group in the area; and the electric automobile updates the charging plan according to the probability transfer matrix and the local constraint. The invention relates to a neural network load prediction model established based on historical charging load data of an electric vehicle, which can accurately predict a charging load curve of the electric vehicle on the next day, and an electric vehicle charging strategy based on a probability transfer matrix can effectively optimize a charging plan of the electric vehicle on the next day.

title: CT image processing method, terminal and computer storage medium
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of medical assistance methods, and provides a CT image processing method, a terminal and a computer storage medium. The method includes: step 100, performing sample learning to obtain a first graded sample of the CT image; step 200, using a region The growth algorithm performs classification learning based on the VGG-16 network, and obtains a pre-training model for CT image recognition; Step 300, the sample data of the collected CT image is learned by using the PG-GAN confrontation network to obtain the second graded sample of the CT image; Step 400, continue to perform image normalization on the image histogram information, and map the image to the image data domain corresponding to the pre-training model; Step 500, obtain an application model suitable for actual scene data; Step 600, use the actual operation model to calculate the The CT image is classified and predicted, and the prediction result report is obtained. The invention can improve the reliability of CT image processing.

title: An artificial intelligence-based firefighting Internet of Things system
description: The invention relates to an artificial intelligence-based fire-fighting Internet of Things system, comprising: a fire-fighting terminal, a first device, a second device and a smart fire-fighting platform; the fire-fighting terminal, the first device and the second device have a communication connection with the smart fire-fighting platform; The intelligent fire protection platform includes: a first analysis module, a second analysis module and a database, and each module has a communication connection. The first device collects fire image data and sends it to the smart fire protection platform; the second device collects fire analysis data and sends it to the smart fire protection platform. The first analysis module obtains the first fire protection feature according to the fire image data; the second analysis module obtains the second fire protection feature according to the fire analysis data, and inputs the first fire protection feature and the second fire protection feature into the fire protection analysis model to output the fire protection analysis data, and then Send the fire analysis data to the corresponding fire terminal.

title: Image evaluation method and related apparatus, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The present application discloses an image evaluation method and related devices, electronic equipment and storage medium, wherein the image evaluation method includes: identifying several tissue regions of a target object in a medical image to be tested; The image data is evaluated to obtain evaluation results of each tissue area; wherein, the multiple evaluation methods include at least a first evaluation method based on a neural network and a second evaluation method based on preset rules. The above solution can accurately and quickly evaluate medical images, so as to assist doctors to improve the speed and accuracy of decision-making.

title: An Agent Training Method Based on Differential Evolution
description: The invention relates to an intelligent body training method based on differential evolution. The population performs differential evolution operation to obtain a new generation of Q-list population, and repeats the differential evolution operation with the new generation of Q-list population as the initial evolutionary population of the next generation until the preset evolution conditions are reached, and the final Q-list population is obtained; The fitness function evaluates each individual in the final Q-table population and outputs the optimal individual; performs reinforcement learning training on the optimal individual to obtain an agent. In the intelligent body training method of the present invention, first, an optimal Q table is obtained by using an evolutionary algorithm, and then reinforcement learning training is performed based on the optimal Q table, and further in the process of intelligent body training, the convergence speed is accelerated and the training requirements are reduced. time resources, which improves the immediacy of agent training.

title: A vehicle identification method
description: The invention discloses a vehicle identity distinguishing method which comprises the steps of constructing a deep neural network model for self-supervision comparison learning, constructing a sample dimension dual comparison loss function, training the network model under a label-free data set, and realizing the extraction and comparison of vehicle picture characteristics; when the vehicle is judged, the vehicle picture to be judged is matched with all the vehicle pictures in the search library, the trained neural network is used for calculating to obtain a characteristic pair, and the identity of the vehicle is judged according to the cosine measurement function result. According to the method, different view samples of the same image are obtained by using a data enhancement algorithm, and the relation among the different view samples is maximized according to a contrast loss function, so that the model can extract accurate image characteristics. Compared with the traditional supervised learning, the method does not depend on the information of the labeled learning examples in the data set during training, and greatly reduces the cost for constructing the data set because the labeled labels are abandoned, so that large-scale vehicle identity discrimination data integration is possible.

title: Gaze locating method and device, electronic device and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for positioning a fixation point, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a face image of a target user and an eyeball radius of a target eyeball of the target user; determining first coordinate information and second coordinate information according to the face image and the eyeball radius of the target eyeball; the first coordinate information is used for representing the coordinate position of the eyeball center of the target eyeball on a first coordinate system, the second coordinate information is used for representing the coordinate position of the pupil center of the target eyeball on the first coordinate system, and the first coordinate system is constructed by a two-dimensional plane where the display screen is located and a straight line perpendicular to the two-dimensional plane; and determining the fixation point of the target user on the display screen according to the first coordinate information and the second coordinate information. Therefore, the positioning of the eyeball fixation point is facilitated only through the face image, and infrared equipment is not needed.

title: Abnormal temperature detection device, abnormal temperature detection method, and recording medium
description: The abnormal temperature detection device comprises: a temperature acquisition unit that acquires temperature data; a preprocessing unit that calculates differential data indicating a differential sequence of temperature data, generates replacement data in which either one of positive differential data and negative differential data is replaced with zero, and calculates a similarity between reference data and replacement data generated from teacher data that has been recognized as normal or abnormal; a learning unit that performs machine learning on the similarity calculated by the preprocessing unit and outputs an identification function; and a determination unit that determines, using the identification function, whether the temperature data for detection acquired by the temperature acquisition unit and subjected to the preprocessing by the preprocessing unit is normal or abnormal.

title: A kind of intelligent detection method and system for abnormality of tailings filling pipeline
description: The invention discloses a tailing filling pipeline abnormity intelligent detection method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting pipeline parameters of each monitoring node in a normal operation state of a pipeline in a tailing filling process, and constructing time sequence characteristic sample data; wherein the pipeline parameters include flow and pressure; constructing a generation countermeasure network model, and training the generation countermeasure network model by using time sequence characteristic sample data to obtain a pipeline parameter generation model for generating a pseudo pipeline parameter; generating a pseudo pipeline parameter by using a pipeline parameter generation model, and comparing the actual measurement pipeline parameter of the current pipeline to be detected with the pseudo pipeline parameter generated by the pipeline parameter generation model; and judging whether the pipeline parameters of the current pipeline are in a normal range according to the comparison result so as to realize the abnormal detection of the tailing filling pipeline. The invention can realize intelligent and accurate detection of the abnormity of the tailing filling pipeline under the condition of no negative sample.

title: U2net-based multi-channel output method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a multi-channel output method, a multi-channel output system, computer equipment and a storage medium based on U2net, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting the initial picture into a plurality of continuous coding layers and decoding layers in a U2net network to respectively carry out feature coding and feature decoding, and respectively obtaining a coding feature map and a decoding feature map corresponding to each coding layer and decoding layer; respectively inputting the coding feature map of the last layer and the decoding feature map of each layer into a first up-sampling module for convolution operation to obtain corresponding channel feature maps; adding the characteristics of the channel characteristic diagrams, and inputting the channel characteristic diagrams into a second up-sampling module for convolution operation to obtain a single-channel target characteristic diagram; and calling corresponding colors to color the pixel points of the target feature map based on the pitch library to obtain the target feature map with multiple labels. The invention calls corresponding colors to color different pixel points of the target characteristic diagram based on the pitch library on the basis of the U2net network, thereby constructing a multi-channel output mode and meeting the requirement of multi-channel output.

title: Water source pollutant detection system and method based on convolutional neural network
description: A system and method for detecting pollutants in water sources based on convolutional neural networks, including the determination of adsorption behavior between enrichment materials and persistent toxic pollutants in drinking water sources, including: through a set enrichment device, respectively Optimization and selection of enrichment materials, enrichment temperature and optimal enrichment conditions to determine the best enrichment materials and adsorption conditions for the enrichment of various persistent toxic pollutants in drinking water sources; persistent toxic pollutants based on infrared spectroscopy Establishment of a quantitative analysis model for pollutants. Combined with other structures or methods, the problems in the prior art that the molar absorptivity in the infrared spectral region of persistent toxic pollutants in drinking water sources is low, the analytical sensitivity of the infrared spectral analysis method is poor, and the inability to perform trace or trace analysis are effectively avoided. defect.

title: Polyp segmentation method and computer equipment based on attention-guided context correction
description: The invention provides a polyp segmentation method based on attention-guided context correction, a computer-readable storage medium and a computer device, comprising: inputting a polyp picture to be segmented into an enhanced context correction model for training, then performing down-sampling, then performing enhanced context correction model training, then performing down-sampling, and repeatedly obtaining a final semantic information image; inputting the final semantic information image into a progressive context fusion model for training, and outputting a semantic information image with fused features; performing upsampling on the semantic information image after feature fusion, performing enhanced context correction model training to obtain a feature mapping image, performing upsampling, performing enhanced context correction model training, and repeatedly obtaining a final feature mapping image with the same size as a polyp image channel to be segmented; and inputting the final feature mapping image into a multi-level feature fusion model for training and outputting a polyp segmentation picture. Thereby enabling the present invention to more accurately identify polyps.

title: Alveolar bone segmentation method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiments of the present invention disclose an alveolar bone segmentation method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining an original alveolar bone image; based on a target lower alveolar bone coarse segmentation model and a target upper alveolar bone coarse segmentation model, respectively performing a lower alveolar bone coarse segmentation and an upper alveolar bone coarse segmentation on the original alveolar bone image Segmentation; based on the target lower alveolar bone fine segmentation model, the lower alveolar bone coarse segmentation result image is subjected to fine segmentation of the lower alveolar bone; based on the target upper alveolar bone fine segmentation model, the upper alveolar bone coarse segmentation result image is subjected to upper Alveolar bone fine segmentation: Based on the lower alveolar bone position information and the upper alveolar bone position information in the original alveolar bone image, the result image of the lower alveolar bone fine segmentation and the upper alveolar bone fine segmentation result image are merged, Determine the target segmentation result image with the upper alveolar bone identification and the lower alveolar bone identification. Through the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present invention, the automatic segmentation of the alveolar bone can be realized, and the accuracy and efficiency of the segmentation can be improved.

title: Vehicle 3D Bounding Box Detection System and Method Based on Roadside Surveillance Perspective
description: A vehicle three-dimensional surrounding frame detection system and method based on a roadside monitoring view angle comprises the following steps: vanishing point detection module, vehicle profile detection module and surround the frame and construct the module, wherein: the vehicle detection module outputs a vehicle Mask according to input image information based on an example segmentation network and a Mask R-CNN network, and searches pixel edges according to the vehicle Mask to obtain a vehicle profile; and the bounding box construction module obtains an auxiliary intersection point through space geometric constraint and image focal length of the three-dimensional bounding box of the vehicle according to the first vanishing point, the third vanishing point and the vehicle outline, and further obtains the three-dimensional bounding box of the vehicle. The method can realize the detection of the vehicle three-dimensional bounding box with high precision, high robustness, high adaptability and high expandability.

title: A Knowledge Tracking Method and System Based on Hierarchical Refinement LSTM Network
description: The invention provides a knowledge tracking method and a knowledge tracking system based on a hierarchical refined LSTM network aiming at the defects of the existing deep learning method model, belonging to the technical field of knowledge tracking, and the method comprises the following steps: component depth tracking knowledge model: the knowledge mastering conditions of the students are obtained in the learning process of the students through the layering process of the primary learning layer, the double-layer attention layer and the deep learning layer; the student knowledge grasping condition is fused with a self-attention mechanism to be used as the input of the LSTM network, and the final knowledge grasping condition of the student is obtained through calculation; and predicting whether the student answers the question correctly or not based on the final knowledge mastering situation of the student. The invention improves the performance of knowledge tracking, provides interpretability to a certain degree and can better help learners to make personalized plans.

title: A problem scale unification method for agent optimization in cloud computing environment
description: The invention discloses a problem scale unification method for agent optimization in a cloud computing environment, which is applied to a cloud and comprises the following steps: acquiring an optimization task of a client about a multi-target problem; generating a plurality of input samples, and obtaining an output matrix by using a real function; generating a plurality of weight vectors, and aggregating the multi-target problem into a single-target problem; acquiring a plurality of relevant source models from a cloud database, and constructing a multi-problem agent model; searching a point to be evaluated by using a multi-problem agent model, and evaluating the point to be evaluated by using a real function to update an output matrix to obtain a pareto front surface; judging whether the preset evaluation times are reached; if not, returning to the step of generating a plurality of weight vectors; and if so, returning the finally obtained pareto frontier as an optimization result to the client. The invention uses a multi-problem agent model method to carry out multi-target optimization, introduces a random projection matrix, can solve the problem of inconsistent scale of a source model and a target model, can obtain more accurate results, and reduces the cost.

title: Intelligent voice recognizing method, apparatus, and intelligent computing device
description: Disclosed are an intelligent voice recognition method, a voice recognition apparatus and an intelligent computing device. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the intelligent voice recognition method adjusts the size of a microphone detection signal based on the size of a first voice signal when the microphone detection signal is obtained after determining the size of the first voice signal, and recognizes a second voice signal from the adjusted microphone detection signal, thereby accurately recognizing a command included in voice of a user. According to the present invention, one or more among the voice recognition apparatus, the intelligent computing device, and a server can be connected with an artificial intelligence module, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), a robot, an augmented reality (AR) apparatus, a virtual reality (VR) apparatus, a 5G service-related apparatus and the like.

title: Apparatus and method for suggesting action item based on speech
description: Disclosed are a method and a device for suggesting a voice based action item. The action item suggestion method includes collecting a user's voice, analyzing a user's action item based on the user's voice, and suggesting an action item based on the analysis result of the action item. Based on the analysis using the AI model through 5G network and artificial intelligence (AI) acceleration chipset, it is possible to suggest voice of action item by active speech.

title: Prediction apparatus for iron loss reduction of electric steel sheet
description: The present invention provides a device for predicting iron loss reduction of an electric steel sheet capable of improving a quality by predicting an iron loss values of the electric steel sheet according to a cooling zone temperature pattern of an annealing and an annealing coating line. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the device for predicting the iron loss reduction of the electric steel sheet can comprise: a weight calculation part for calculating a weight according to a temperature difference of each section of an annealing furnace cooling zone of the annealing and annealing coating line (ACL) producing the electrical steel sheet; and a calculation part for calculating an iron loss reduction prediction value of the electrical steel sheet of each section of the annealing furnace cooling zone according to the weight of the weight calculation part and the temperature difference of each section of the annealing furnace cooling zone.

title: Neural Networks, Power Storage Systems, Vehicles, and Electronic Devices
description: It provides a power storage system having excellent characteristics. Provides a safe power storage system. It provides a power storage system with less degradation. It provides a storage battery having excellent characteristics. Power storage systems include neural networks and storage batteries. The neural network includes an input layer, an output layer, and one or more hidden layers between the input layer and the output layer. The predetermined hidden layer is combined with the previous hidden layer or the front input layer by a predetermined weight coefficient, and the next hidden layer or the next output layer is combined by a predetermined weight coefficient. In the storage battery, the voltage and the time at which the voltage was acquired are measured as one data set. Data sets measured at different times are input to the input layer, and operating conditions of the battery are changed according to signals output from the output layer.

title: Method and Apparatus for Detecting Fault of Multi-Core in Multi-Layer Perceptron Structure with Dropout
description: According to embodiments of the present invention, provided is a computing system capable of verifying whether an error occurs in each core by comparing an original operation result value performed in an activated streaming processor to which a dropout technique is not applied and an operation result value performed in a deactivated streaming processor, in a dropout operation for solving overfitting.

title: Method for missing image data imputation using neural network and apparatus therefor
description: Disclosed is a method and apparatus for replacing missing image data using a neural network. A method for replacing missing image data according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: receiving input image data for at least two or more domains among preset multiple domains; And restoring missing image data of a preset target domain using a neural network receiving the two or more input image data as inputs, wherein the neural network stores at least two or more real image data of the multiple domains. By combining the fake image data of the first target domain generated as an input and the real image data, and using the multi-cycle coherence loss in which the reconstructed image and the real image data must be similar using the combined image data as an input Can be trained.

title: Information processing device, recording medium recording programs, and information processing method
description: A storage unit for storing a data set DG including a plurality of digital data DD and a label set RG including a plurality of labels RD each added to each of the plurality of digital data DD ( 102) and feature extraction for generating a feature vector set (BG) including a plurality of feature vectors by extracting a predetermined feature from each of a plurality of digital data DD and generating feature vectors representing the extracted features A clustering determination unit that determines the homogeneity of the data set DG by performing supervised clustering on the feature vector set BG using the unit 103 and the label set RG to determine the possibility of clustering ( 104).

title: Methods and systems for storing mixed audio signal and reproducing directional audio
description: Methods and systems for recording a mixed audio signal and reproducing a directional audio are provided. A method comprises the steps of: receiving a mixed audio signal via a plurality of microphones; determining an audio parameter associated with the mixed audio signal received at each of the plurality of microphones; determining active audio sources and the number of the active audio sources from the mixed audio signal; determining direction and position information of each of the active audio sources; dynamically selecting a set of microphones from the plurality of microphones based on at least one of the number of the active audio sources, the direction of each of the active audio sources, the position information of each of the active audio sources, the audio parameter, and a predefined condition; and recording, based on the selected set of microphones, the mixed audio signal for reproducing the directional audio. The present invention allows a dynamic selection of microphones equal to the number of active audio sources in the real-world environment, which is optimum for an over-determined case.

title: Electronic apparatus and control method thereof
description: An electronic device is disclosed. The electronic device is connected to a user interface, a camera, a memory storing a first artificial intelligence model learned to acquire information on emotion based on an input image, a user interface, a camera, and a memory to control the electronic device. And a processor for controlling, wherein when text is input through a user interface, the processor identifies whether the text includes first information on the emotion of the user, and when the text includes the first information, the image obtained through the camera is first Second information on emotion may be obtained by inputting into the artificial intelligence model, and the type of emotion of the user may be identified based on the first information obtained from the text and the second information obtained from the image.

title: Travel information providing system that provides contents selected by credibility estimation
description: The present invention relates to a travel information system for providing content selected by reliability estimation. More particularly, the travel information system comprises: an information collection module for collecting travel-related content including travel courses and accommodation reviews; a model configuration module for configuring a reliability estimation model for estimating the reliability of the content based on the importance of extracted keywords and the evaluation and recommendation levels of a creator by applying machine learning to the collected travel-related content; a content selection module for selecting travel-related content by using the configured reliability estimation model; and a content providing module for providing the selected travel-related content to travelers. The travel information system can provide the travel-related content selected by using the reliability estimation model configured by applying machine learning to the travel-related content including travel courses and accommodation reviews to easily provide high-quality travel information to potential travelers, thereby increasing satisfaction. In addition, the travel information system can configure the reliability estimation model for estimating the reliability of content based on the importance of the keywords extracted from the travel-related content and the evaluation and recommendation levels of the creator and use the same, thereby providing reliable information compared to other search engines or social media, in consideration of both the quality of the content itself and the quality of the creator.

title: Question analysis method, apparatus, knowledge graph question-answering system and electronic equipment
description: The present invention provides a question analysis method and apparatus, a knowledge-based question answering system and an electronic device, which relate to a field of knowledge-based question answering technology. The method comprises the steps of: analyzing a question to obtain N linearized sequences, wherein N is an integer greater than 1; converting the N linearized sequences into N network topology maps, respectively; calculating a semantic matching degree between each of the N topology maps and the question; and selecting a topology map, having the highest semantic matching degree with respect to the question, as a query graph of the question from the N topology maps. The technology in accordance with the present invention can obtain the query graph of the question more accurately to improve the accuracy of a question-to-query graph, thereby improving the accuracy of question analysis. The present invention solves the problem that the query graph generated based on the fusion method of word sequences in a prior art has relatively low accuracy.

title: Method, device and non-transitory computer-readable recording medium for estimating information about golf swing
description: According to one aspect of the present invention, there is provided a method for estimating information on a golf swing. When a photographed image about a user's golf swing is obtained, at least one joint of the user is selected from the photographed image using an artificial neural network model. Detecting, comparing the user's golf swing with the golf swing of a comparison target with reference to the detected position of the at least one joint, and estimating information about the user's golf swing based on the comparison result There is provided a method comprising the step of:

title: Method for biopsy and apparatus for biopsy
description: The present invention relates to a biopsy method which comprises the following steps of: extracting a tissue by fine needle suction; providing the tissue to a tissue analysis device; and performing, by one or more computers, a suitability test about whether the tissue is suitable for performing a biopsy through analysis of the tissue by using a first deep learning model.

title: Method for automatically pruning search space using machine learning in symbolic execution
description: The present invention relates to a symbolic execution device to detect various errors in a program easily and accurately, a symbolic execution method, and a probability distribution update method for symbolic execution. According to the present invention, the symbolic execution device comprises: a storage unit storing at least one of a first probability distribution and a second probability distribution; and a processor acquiring a weight vector from the first probability distribution by sampling, acquiring removal rate from the second probability distribution by sampling, adding the weight vector to at least one feature vector acquired from the at least one candidate state to acquire a score for each of the at least one candidate state, and using the score of each of the at least one candidate state and the removal ratio to selecting a state to be removed from the at least one candidate state.

title: Method, Device, and Program for Assessing Clothing Seller and Products in Sale
description: A method performed by a computer comprises the steps of: collecting vendor information; distributing and storing the vendor information in a distributed storage server; classifying the vendor information into structured information and unstructured information; evaluating the structured information; evaluating the unstructured information; and evaluating the quality of a vendor's product based on evaluation results on the structured information and the unstructured information.

title: System and Method for Shortening the Calculation Time of Wave Anlaysis from Sea Level Stereo images
description: The present invention relates to a device and method for reducing the calculation time of wave analysis from a sea level stereo image, which can reduce the calculation time by applying the AI technology and analyze the wave observation results in real time. According to the present invention, the device comprises: a first image collection unit and a second image collection unit collecting stereo images from different positions from each other; a stereo analysis unit calculating the relative distance difference and the rotation angle between the first image collection unit and the second image collection unit, and from the calculated values, drawing a coordinate system including a three-dimensional sensation geometrically; a three-dimensional (3D) restoration unit saving only the 3D sea level values of the pixels randomly extracted for 3D restoration; a learning unit learning by using the deep learning technology; and a 3D sea level restoration unit restoring the 3D sea level in real time and analyzing the results.

title: Apparatus and method for estimating bio-information
description: An apparatus for estimating biometric information is disclosed. According to an embodiment, the apparatus for estimating biometric information includes a pulse wave sensor measuring a pulse wave signal from a subject, a force sensor measuring a force signal acting between the subject and the pulse wave sensor, and a first input based on the pulse wave signal and the force signal A value, a second input value, and a third input value are obtained, and the obtained first input value, the second input value, and the third input value are input to the first neural network model to extract a feature vector, and the extracted feature vector is The second neural network model may include a processor to obtain biometric information.

title: Apparatus and method for hadware implementation of activation function in recurrent neural network
description: An apparatus and method for implementing an activation function of a recursive neural network are disclosed, and the method for implementing an activation function of a recursive neural network according to an embodiment of the present application includes (a) a slope for a first type activation function applied to an inference process of a recursive neural network ) and generating a table including an offset, (b) receiving input data for inference of the recursive neural network and type information of an activation function to be applied to the input data, and (c) the type information and deriving output data corresponding to the input data based on the slope and the intercept, or the transform slope transformed from the slope and the transform intercept transformed from the intercept.

title: System of detecting fake license plates and its method by using the same
description: The present invention relates to a system for detecting counterfeit vehicle license plates. The system comprises: a camera; a filter attached to the front of the camera; a first license plate photo unit of a first photo obtained by taking a photo of the license plate of a vehicle with the camera as the vehicle enters; a rotation drive unit configured to rotate the filter; and a second license plate photo unit of a second photo obtained by taking a photo of the license plate with the camera as the filter is rotated. If the photo of the first license plate photo unit and the photo of the second license plate photo unit are compared, and the photos are the same, it is determined that the license plate is a counterfeit license plate, and the vehicle is not allowed to enter. If the photo of the first license plate photo unit and the photo of the second license plate photo unit are compared, and the photos are different, it is determined that the license plate is not a counterfeit license plate, and entry of the vehicle is allowed.

title: Method and computer program product for representing the degree of risk in a 3d modeling space of a construction site
description: A method of expressing the degree of risk in a 3D modeling space of a construction site is provided.  The method of the present invention inputs first data including information on the type of work, information on the location of work, or information on the timing of work to the first network to predict the type of disaster, and to predict the type of disaster using the first data and the type of disaster. 2 Input into the network to calculate the comprehensive risk index, and the comprehensive risk index can be visually displayed in the 3D modeling space.

title: Electric vehicle charging management system in apartment houses
description: The present invention relates to an electric vehicle charging management system in an apartment building, and more particularly, to control a charger according to real-time charging scheduling of vehicles included in a user group to prevent overload and reduce peak power to provide optimized charging. It's about the management system.  In the present invention, a plurality of chargers installed in a charging station and having charging cables, a user grouping module for generating a plurality of user groups using user information received from a plurality of user terminals, and at least one of the created user groups A charging scheduling module for generating real-time charging scheduling for vehicles included in the user group and a charging management module for controlling the charger according to the charging schedule when the real-time charging scheduling is received.

title: Intelligent curation platform system for using asset-based content
description: An intelligent curation platform system for using asset-based content is disclosed. The intelligent curation platform system includes a database part that classifies multiple types of content data obtained from content into content object-related information, planning-related information, and viewer-related information, associates the content data for each of content asset, planning asset, and viewer asset based on the classified information, and stores them, and outputs the information upon the request of a user; and an annotation part that searches the content data to extract new content data and adds the information to the new content data using machine learning based on at least one of the information and a search query.

title: The electronic device for a game of slap-match
