description: The electronic device for scabing of the present invention includes a plurality of electrodes disposed on a substrate and outputting signals corresponding to friction generated by the attacking scab; And it may include a controller that receives a signal corresponding to the friction from the plurality of electrodes, checks the attack point of the attack scab, and determines whether the virtual scab is overturned based on the attack point.

title: A system for providing product recommendation service in video content based on artificial neural network and method for providing product recommendation service using the same
description: An artificial neural network-based product recommendation service providing system in video content according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a video content frame extractor that separates and extracts a plurality of video content frames constituting video content; an object recognition unit that recognizes a character object representing a character present in the video content frame extracted through the video content frame extractor and a product object worn by the character; a reference object information storage unit provided to pre-store at least one reference object-related information, which is information that serves as a standard for determining object information representing an object recognized by the object recognition unit; an object information extraction unit that extracts the object information; a machine learning unit that determines a degree of similarity between the object information and reference object information pre-stored in the object information storage unit and extracts reference object information having the highest degree of similarity to the object information; and a search unit that searches for and provides a vendor that sells the object indicated by the reference object information extracted through the machine learning unit.

title: Volume Pattern Prediction Method Using Sales Patterns
description: The method of predicting a traffic volume pattern using a sales pattern according to the present invention checks order log data for a product to predict a traffic volume pattern, and collects information on event periods related to the product based on the order log data. Confirm, and using the information of the event period, identify one of the grids to which sales patterns for products similar to the product are mapped, and use the sales pattern mapped to the confirmed grid to purchase the product. It is possible to predict cargo volume patterns.

title: Apparatus and Method for providing a summarized information using a artificial intelligence model
description: This disclosure relates to artificial intelligence (AI) systems and their applications utilizing machine learning algorithms such as deep learning. In particular, the server control method for providing summary information using an artificial intelligence learning model: When a search request for a search term is received, a plurality of documents are searched based on the search term and provided to an electronic device, and among the plurality of documents, When a user command requesting summary information for at least one is received, input at least one of the plurality of documents into an artificial intelligence learning model trained to obtain summary information to obtain summary information for at least one document related to the search term; , summary information can be provided through an electronic device. In particular, at least part of the server control method for providing summary information may use an artificial intelligence model learned according to at least one of machine learning, neural network, or deep learning algorithms.

title: Method for virtual hair style image synthesis and ai system using the same
description: The present invention includes the steps of (A) recognizing features of the entire face; (B) Separating the recognized facial features into facial parts and hair parts; And, (C) applying a recommended hairstyle image suitable for the facial area image of the separated face part; a virtual hairstyle image synthesis method including; and a virtual hairstyle image synthesis for this virtual hairstyle image synthesis method. Provides an artificial intelligence system for  According to the present invention, a face image synthesized with a virtual hairstyle image of a natural style is provided.

title: Method and device for predicting the initial optimal dose of anticoagulant using machine learning technology
description: A method of predicting an anticoagulant prescription dose implemented by a processor according to an embodiment includes receiving clinic data of a patient; generating input data based on the clinic data; By applying the input data to a first machine learning model including sub-machine learning models corresponding to each of a plurality of prescription dose intervals in which the expected prescription range of the anticoagulant is divided into unit doses, the input data is applied to the plurality of prescription dose intervals. outputting a plurality of prediction results for; And it may include predicting the patient's anticoagulant prescription dose based on the plurality of output prediction results.

title: Device and method for extracting dialogue-based relation extraction based on utterance-level computation over graph structure
description: Disclosed are a device and a method for extracting a conversation relationship using an utterance level graph operation. The method for extracting a conversation relationship is a method for extracting a conversation relationship performed by a computing device including at least a processor. The method comprises the steps of: receiving a target conversation including a plurality of utterances and an argument pair subject to relationship extraction; generating a graph (G = (A, X)) composed of an adjacent matrix (A) and a node quality matrix (X) based on the target conversation and the argument pair; and inputting the graph into a graph convolutional network (GCN) trained to infer a relationship of the argument pair to derive a relationship between a subject and an object included in the argument pair.

title: Apparatus and method for fabricating clothing fabric with intelligent type
description: The present invention relates to an intelligent clothing fabric manufacturing device and method capable of preventing slippage of a fabric that occurs during the manufacture of ultra-light clothing fabric, the device comprising: a fabric manufacturing unit that manufactures a fabric by performing at least one process among a weaving process, a dispersing process, a refining process, a dyeing process, a washing process, a fixing process, a dehydration process, a skacha process, a denta process, and a rolling process; a storage unit that stores control data for each process of the fabric manufacturing unit; and a control unit that controls the operation of the fabric manufacturing unit based on the control data for each process pre-stored in the storage unit, wherein the control unit obtains operation data for each process from the fabric manufacturing unit, inputs the operation data for each process into a pre-learned neural network model to predict the occurrence of slippage for each process, changes the control data of a process in which slippage is predicted based on the prediction result, and updates the control data for each process stored in the storage unit based on the changed control data.

title: Autonomous Vehicle Environment Awareness Software Management
description: A computer-operated method for constructing a customized training dataset for training an artificial intelligence (AI) platform, comprising the steps of: a) obtaining (i) a specification of training data for training the AI platform and (ii) data indicating a proposed use of the training data; b) referencing a database of training datasets, each of which is associated with a usage right, to identify a candidate set of the training datasets matching the specification; and c) approving disclosure of a subset of training datasets of the candidate set of the training datasets based on the data indicating the proposed use of the AI training data and the usage right associated with the training datasets of the candidate set of the training datasets.

title: Intelligent operating temple tips
description: Systems and methods herein describe an actuator control system for controlling intelligent actuated temple tips of eyeglasses. The actuator control system receives a set of measurements corresponding to the length of the eyeglass temple tips of the eyeglasses, receives user feedback from a user of the eyeglasses corresponding to the position of the eyeglass temple tips, generates a predicted set of measurements for the length of the eyeglass temple tips using a machine learning model, and transmits the predicted set of measurements to pneumatic actuators coupled to the eyeglass temple tips.

title: Method for multi-perspective electricity price prediction using adaptive self-supervised learning algorithm
description: The present invention discloses a multi-prospect electricity price prediction method using an adaptive self-supervised learning algorithm. The method comprises the steps of: selecting a prediction model for electricity price prediction; collecting online data to be applied to the prediction model from a cloud server; selecting input variables to be applied to the prediction model from the collected online data by applying correlation analysis to the collected online data; applying the selected input variables to the prediction model to derive a prediction result; comparing the derived prediction result with real-time electricity prices to calculate an error rate; and using the prediction model for a subsequent electricity price prediction if the error rate is less than a reference value, and retraining the prediction model if the error rate is greater than or equal to the reference value.

title: AI Human Chatbot by use of AI-avatar and domain-specific language model
description: The present invention relates generally to an ai human chatbot system that communicates with a user. In particular, the present invention relates to an ai human-type chatbot system which generates a natural dynamic avatar by image warping and a gan algorithm, specializes a neural network model for defining an operation of the avatar in a specific domain by a macro-language model (llm) to perform fine-tuning learning, generates various responses suitable for a situation to a user, and implements a human-friendly chatbot service. Since the existing chatbot operates based on predefined rules and patterns, a uniform image and response were output. On the other hand, according to the present invention, there is an advantage of providing a human-friendly chatbot service by creating the naturalness of the avatar and generating a user-friendly and various responses by the llm.

title: Method and computer for crm data analysis using large language model
description: According to one embodiment of the present disclosure, a computer program stored in a computer-readable storage medium is disclosed. The computer program performs the following methods for analyzing customer data, and the methods may include: a step of collecting customer response data; a step of performing preprocessing for analysis on the customer response data; a step of analyzing the preprocessed customer response data using a pre-learned large language model (LLM) to generate customer response data analysis information; and a step of generating customer response strategy information based on the customer response data analysis information.

title: Deep learning-based monitoring method for early detection of plant abnormalities
description: The present invention discloses a deep learning-based monitoring method for early detection of plant abnormalities. The method comprises: receiving learning detection data about a growth environment of a plant, training a first analysis model using the learning detection data, receiving learning image data about an appearance of the plant, training a second analysis model using the learning image data, receiving analysis detection data different from the learning detection data, deriving a detection feature vector for the analysis detection data using the first analysis model, receiving analysis image data different from the learning image data, deriving an image feature vector for the analysis image data using the second analysis model, and determining whether the plant is abnormal or diseased based on the detection feature vector and the image feature vector.

title: Smart manhole based on AIoT
description: AIoT-based smart manhole

title: Minimal superconducting quantum circuit for bosonic codes with galvanic coupling
description: The present disclosure relates to a minimal superconducting quantum circuit for bosonic codes with galvanic coupling. The present disclosure provides a nonlinear superconducting quantum circuit comprising at least one resonant section (30, 32; 60, 62) and an asymmetric spiral superconducting quantum interference element (34) galvanically connected thereto, the circuit having a first mode (a) having a first resonant frequency and a second mode (b) having a second resonant frequency, wherein the ratio between the first resonant frequency and the second resonant frequency is different from 1/2, and the at least one resonant section (30, 32; 60, 62) has a symbolic representation including a linear resonant section (32; 60) including at least one inductance (320; 600) and at least one capacitor (322; 602), and a nonlinear resonant section (30; 62) including at least one capacitor (302; 622) and the asymmetric spiral superconducting quantum interference element (34), wherein the linear resonant section (30) and the nonlinear The resonant portions (32) are arranged so that they are galvanically connected and one has elements connected in series and the other has elements connected in parallel, and at least one resonant portion (30, 32) is configured with inductance and capacitance values to induce the first mode (a) and the second mode (b) together with the asymmetric spiral superconducting quantum interference element (34), so that the nonlinear superconducting quantum circuit (100) has a zero-point fluctuation of the superconducting phase crossing the asymmetric spiral superconducting quantum interference element (34) of 0.05 rad or more for the first mode (a) and the second mode (b).

title: Apparatus and method for precise positioning based on cell id of mobile communication base station
description: A precise positioning method is disclosed. The method includes the steps of: a communication device receiving a serving cell ID from a mobile communication terminal; a neighboring cell inference model analyzing the serving cell ID to infer a neighboring cell ID; and a precise location inference model analyzing the neighboring cell ID to infer the location of the mobile communication terminal.

title: Language server based context provisioning for code generation with large language models
description: In an exemplary embodiment, a language server connected to an integrated development environment (IDE) is used to identify various code artifacts, such as functions, variables, etc., from a given input code, and then to search a repository of code files for declarations, definitions, and references related to those identified code artifacts. The declarations, definitions, and references can then be passed to the LLM as context.

title: Apparatus and method for analyzing data based on xai
description: The data analysis device provided in the present invention comprises: a data collection unit that collects data from the outside; a data storage unit that stores the collected data; a data management unit that manages the collected data based on preset data management criteria; a dataset formation unit that forms a dataset from data stored in the data storage unit based on selection information of a user who wishes to use the collected data; a model learning unit that automatically generates a data analysis model for deriving data desired by the user by learning the dataset; and an XAI processing unit that learns the data analysis model based on a preset XAI algorithm and determines important features that have a significant influence on data prediction using the data analysis model as a basis for data characteristic extraction, wherein the dataset formation unit, the model learning unit, and the XAI processing unit are formed in a pipeline structure and operate in parallel, so that a new dataset and an artificial intelligence model can be developed by combining features with high correlation within various types of data, and an environment can be provided in which the new dataset and an artificial intelligence model can be rationally created and analyzed using the same.

title: Method for improving prediction quality using multiple unit neural networks and assembling neural network, and apparatus therefor
description: The present invention relates to a method for improving prediction quality by using a plurality of unit neural networks that infer differently from each other and an integrated neural network that integrates them, and to a device therefor. More specifically, the present invention discloses a method performed in a computing device for performing inference by using an integrated neural network that operates based on the outputs of a plurality of unit neural networks, the method comprising: a step of inputting a first input matrix produced based on an input sequence including one or more tokens into each of k unit neural networks to produce k different intermediate matrices (wherein k is an integer equal to or greater than 2); and a step of inputting a second input matrix produced based on the k intermediate matrices into the integrated neural network to produce an output matrix.

title: Enhanced process and hardware architecture to detect and correct realtime product substrates
description: Embodiments disclosed herein include a processing tool for semiconductor processing. In one embodiment, the processing tool includes a chamber and a plurality of evidence sensors integrated with the chamber. In one embodiment, the processing tool further includes a drift detection module. In one embodiment, data from the plurality of evidence sensors is provided as input data to the drift detection module. In one embodiment, the processing tool further includes a dashboard for displaying output data from the drift detection module.

title: Learning device, information processing device, substrate processing device, learning method and method for determining processing conditions
description: The learning device comprises an experimental data acquisition unit that acquires a first dataset including processing conditions of a processing executed by a substrate processing unit and a processing result of the processing, a pre-learning unit that machine-learns a second dataset to a learning model, and a learning model generation unit that machine-learns the first dataset to a learning model that has been machine-learned by the pre-learning unit, wherein the second dataset includes a pre-processing result and pre-processing conditions predicted by a prediction algorithm determined in advance based on the pre-processing conditions.

title: Method and system for extracting length of singing voice phoneme using MIDI
description: A method and system for extracting the length of a singing voice phoneme are provided. The system for extracting the length of a singing voice phoneme using MIDI according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a prior encoder that receives phonemes converted from text as input and outputs a prior probability distribution; a posterior encoder that receives acoustic features as input and outputs a posterior probability distribution; a flow that transforms the probability distribution; a monotonic alignment search module that performs a monotonic alignment search using information about MIDI duration; and a decoder that outputs a waveform, which is a voice digital signal, based on an input in which the result of extracting the length of each phoneme is reflected.

title: Method for predicting plating adhesion amount, method for manufacturing hot-dip galvanized steel strip, method for generating a plating adhesion amount prediction model, and device for predicting plating adhesion amount
description: A method for predicting a plating amount of a hot-dip galvanized steel strip capable of predicting a plating amount with high precision is provided. In a manufacturing facility for a hot-dip galvanized steel strip having a plating treatment section for immersing a steel strip annealed in an annealing section into a zinc plating bath, the method for predicting a plating amount of a hot-dip galvanized steel strip comprises: a parameter acquisition step for acquiring at least one operation parameter among operation parameters of the plating treatment section and at least one operation parameter among operation parameters of the annealing section; and a plating amount prediction step for inputting input data including the operation parameters acquired in the parameter acquisition step into a plating amount prediction model, outputting the plating amount, and predicting the plating amount.

title: Method and system for predicting thyroid dysfunction for subject
description: According to the present application, a method for predicting thyroid dysfunction for a subject is disclosed. The method comprises: determining a target date based on a trigger signal; acquiring interval heart rates corresponding to the determined target date; acquiring a first preprocessing result for the interval heart rates corresponding to the acquired target date for the subject, wherein the first preprocessing result includes at least one indicator of an average and a distribution of the interval heart rates corresponding to the target date; acquiring at least one hormone concentration related to the thyroid corresponding to a reference date for the subject; acquiring a second preprocessing result for the interval heart rates corresponding to the reference date for the subject, wherein the second preprocessing result includes at least one indicator of an average and a distribution of the interval heart rates corresponding to the reference date; and acquiring a difference between the first preprocessing result and the second preprocessing result. And obtaining a prediction result for thyroid dysfunction based on values including at least one hormone concentration corresponding to the reference date and the difference;

title: Learning type decision support system
description: No content

title: Up-data device and method of cache memory
description: The present invention relates to a semiconductor memory device, and is intended to provide an up-data device and method of a cache memory suitable for realizing more efficient up-data using up-time data purge of a cache memory. To this end, the cache memory is divided into a plurality of segments, the number of times of use of each segment is counted, the area to be erased from the existing data is calculated through the purge circuit, the data of the area to erase the existing data is erased, Data box.

title: System and method for object recognition
description: The present disclosure proposes a computer implemented method for reconstructing a 3D point cloud of an object, and a method of object recognition of an object to be identified using the method for reconstruction of a 3D point cloud.

title: Methods and apparatus for automatic detection of software bugs
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus for automatic detection of software bugs are 5 disclosed. An example apparatus includes a comparator to compare reference code to input code to detect a source code error in the input code; a graph generator to generate a graphical representation of the reference code or the input code, the graphical representation to identify non-overlapping code regions; and a root cause determiner to determine a root cause of the source code error in the input code, the root cause based on the non-overlapping code regions. 10

title: Compact cognitive synaptic computing circuits
description: Embodiments of the invention relate to producing spike-timing dependent plasticity using electronic neurons interconnected in a crossbar array network. The crossbar array network comprises a plurality of crossbar arrays. Each crossbar array comprises a plurality of axons and a plurality of dendrites such that the axons and dendrites are transverse to one another, and multiple synapse devices, wherein each synapse device is at a cross-point junction of the crossbar array coupled between a dendrite and an axon. The crossbar arrays are spatially in a staggered pattern providing a staggered crossbar layout of the synapse devices.

title: Vector processing unit and computing system with vector processing unit, and computer implementation method
description: The present invention describes a vector processing unit, and the vector processing unit includes a processor unit each including a plurality of processing resources. The processor units are each configured to perform arithmetic operations associated with vectorized calculations. The vector processing unit includes a vector memory in communication with each of the processor units and their respective processing resource data. The vector memory includes a memory bank configured to store data used by each of the processor units to perform the arithmetic operations. The processor units and the vector memory are tightly coupled in an area of the vector processing unit, so that based on the placement of the respective processor unit relative to each other and based on the placement of the vector memory relative to each processor unit, A high bandwidth to exchange data communications.

title: Health management for magnetic storage media
description: The present disclosure describes aspects of health management for magnetic storage media. In some aspects, a media health manager determines, with a read channel, read metrics for a sector of magnetic storage media that resides in a zone of magnetic storage media. The media health manager accesses read metrics of the zone and updates the read metrics of the zone based on the read metrics determined for the sector to provide updated read metrics for the zone of magnetic storage media. A health score for the zone of magnetic storage media is then determined with a neural network based on the updated read metrics of the zone of magnetic storage media. By so doing, gradual wear of the magnetic storage media may be predicted using the health score, enabling replacement of a magnetic storage media device before failure to improve reliability or availability of data stored to the device.

title: Biaxially stretched polyamide film, laminate film, and packaging body
description:
PROBLEM:
To provide a biaxially stretched polyamide film having excellent piercing strength, impact resistance and friction pinhole resistance, and capable of reducing the environmental load by using polyamide 6 chemically recycled from a discharged polyamid product as a raw material.
SOLUTION:
A biaxially stretched polyamide film comprising a polyamide resin composition containing 70% by mass or more of polyamide 6 and 4 to 90% by mass of chemically recycled polyamide 6.

title: Electronic apparatus and operation method thereof
description: Provided is a method and an electronic apparatus for providing information regarding a discount coupon to be applied to an item, which a user wishes to purchase in an online store, using an algorithm selected based on at least one of a number of items, a number of discount coupons, and a sum of the number of the items and the number of discount coupons.

title: Method for assembling photonic computing system, photonic computing apparatus, method for fabricating integrated optoelectronic device, artificial neural network computation system and photonic computing system
description: A method for assembling a photonic computing system includes attaching a photonic source to a support structure, and attaching a photonic integrated circuit to the support structure. The photonic source includes a first laser die on a substrate configured to provide a first optical beam, and a second laser die on the substrate configured to provide a second optical beam. The photonic integrated circuit includes a first waveguide and a first coupler coupled to the first waveguide, and a second waveguide and a second coupler coupled to the second waveguide. The method includes attaching a plurality of beam-shaping optical elements to the support structure, the substrate, or the photonic integrated circuit, in which the attaching includes aligning a first beam-shaping optical element during attachment so that the first optical beam is coupled to the first coupler, and aligning a second beam-shaping optical element during attachment so that the second optical beam is coupled to the second coupler.

title: Object positioning method and object positioning system
description: An object positioning method and an object positioning system are provided. The object positioning method includes: obtaining an original object image including an object to be positioned; reducing a size of the original object image; inputting the reduced object image into a coarse positioning model for identifying a plurality of coarse feature positions; obtaining a plurality of image blocks from the original object image according to the plurality of rough feature positions; inputting the plurality of image blocks into an accurate positioning model for identifying a plurality of accurate feature positions; determining a position of the object to be positioned in the original object image.

title: Neural network with improved performance, using automatically uncovered failure cases
description: A method, system, and method for tuning a target neural network using automatically generated test cases prior to deploying the target neural network in a deployment environment comprising a computer program encoded on a computer storage medium. Provide equipment. One of the methods uses a test case generation neural network to generate a plurality of test inputs and to generate one or more test outputs for each test input. , processing a plurality of test inputs using a target neural network, and determining one or more criteria by the target neural network from one or more test outputs generated by the target neural network for each test input. and identifying failed test inputs that result in the generation of unsatisfactory test outputs. [Selection drawing] Fig. 3

title: Vacuum Fluctuation Quantum Random Number Generator Chip Based on Photon Integration Technology
description: comprising a heatsink substrate (1), a laser (2), a beam splitter (3) and at least two photodetectors (4), said laser (2) being located on the first of said heatsink substrate (1). The at least two photodetectors (4) are fixed to the second end of the heat sink substrate (1), and the beam splitter (3) is fixed to the middle part of the heat sink substrate (1). wherein the light exit of the laser (2) is aligned with the light path entrance of the beam splitter (3), and the at least two photodetectors (4) are respectively aligned with the light path exits of the beam splitter (3). Deployed vacuum fluctuation quantum random number generator chip based on photon integration technology.

title: Machine learning-based image compression settings that reflect user preferences
description: Embodiments described herein relate to methods, devices, and computer-readable media for determining compression settings. An input image may be obtained when associated with a user account. One or more features of the input image may be determined using a feature detection machine learning model. Compression settings for the input image may be determined based on one or more features in the input image using user-specific machine learning models personalized to the user account. The input image may be compressed based on compression settings.

title: Enhanced logit for natural language processing
description: A technique for using enhanced logit values to classify utterances and messages input into chatbot systems in natural language processing. A method may include a chatbot system receiving utterances generated by a user interacting with the chatbot system and inputting the utterances to a machine learning model that includes a series of network layers. The final network layer in the series of network layers may include a logit function. The machine learning model may use a logit function to map a first probability for a solvable class to a first logit value. The machine learning model can map the second probabilities for unresolvable classes to enhanced logit values. The method can also include the chatbot system classifying the utterance as a resolvable class or an unresolvable class based on the first logit value and the enhanced logit value.

title: Action suggestions for user-selected content
description: Systems and methods are provided for suggesting actions on selected text based on content displayed on a mobile device. An exemplary method comprises converting a selection made through a display device into a query, providing the query to an action proposal model trained to predict an action for a given query, each action associated with a mobile application, Receiving predicted actions, and initiating display of the one or more predicted actions on the display device. Another exemplary method may include identifying a web site from highly retrieved queries from search records, said web site being one of a plurality of web sites in a web site mapping for mobile applications. The method may also include generating positive training examples for the action suggested model from the identified queries, and training the action suggested model using the positive training examples.

title: Apparatus and method for detecting tic symptom using svm algorithm
description: The present invention provides a method and a device for detecting a voice tic symptom based on a support vector machine (SVM) algorithm, which analyze recorded voice of a patient and judge whether a voice tic symptom exists, thereby more rapidly and simply diagnosing and treating the voice tic symptom. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the device for detecting a voice tic symptom based on an SVM algorithm comprises: a learning part generating a voice tic symptom detecting model based on a plurality of tic symptom voice data, a mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC) feature vector and an SVM instruction learning algorithm; an input part receiving target voice data for testing the voice tic symptom from a user; and a diagnosing part judging whether the target voice data corresponds to the voice tic symptom based on the voice tic detecting model.

title: Electronic device and method for detecting a driving event of vehicle
description: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence (AI) system that simulates functions such as the recognition and judgment of a human brain using a machine learning algorithm such as deep learning and its application. According to one embodiment, the AI system includes a processor and a memory for storing instructions executable by the processor. The processor executes the instructions to obtain a video sequence comprising a plurality of frames photographed during the driving of a vehicle from the vehicle, to recognize the position of an object contained in the plurality of frames, and to analyze a time series variation with respect to the position of the object in the plurality of frames. So, it is possible to determine whether an event related to the driving of the vehicle is generated.

title: Apparatus and method for user experience based path computation
description: An apparatus for generating a path collects path information about a plurality of paths having been generated as learning data, learns sectional path information based on the collected learning data to generate learned section path information in order to generate a path of a transmission network line. When receiving a path generation request signal for a certain section, the apparatus for generating a path designs a recommended path corresponding to the path generation request signal based on the learned section path information, and checks whether or not there is an available resource for the designed recommended path to provide the recommended path as a candidate path when there is the available resource.

title: AI-based Management Server for Advertising Keyword
description: The present invention relates to an advertisement keyword managing server based on artificial intelligence, which comprises an advertisement keyword selecting unit, an exposure ranking determination unit, and a bidding price determination unit. The advertisement keyword selecting unit extracts an associated keyword associated with a request keyword received from an advertiser terminal, and calculates an ROI for each keyword with respect to the associated keyword on the basis of keyword advertisement data received from a search server. The advertisement keyword selecting unit selects a keyword corresponding to the ROI for each keyword and an advertisement condition as an advertisement keyword. The exposure ranking determination unit extracts an ROI for each exposure ranking from an exposure region of the search server, and selects the exposure ranking corresponding to the ROI for each exposure ranking and the advertisement condition. The bidding price determination unit derives a bidding price function from learning data including the keyword advertisement data with respect to a plurality of bidding variables using a multi-variable linear regression method, and generates a bidding price for the advertisement keyword and the exposure ranking by substituting a bidding variable value for the bidding price function.

title: 3D space monitoring device, 3D space monitoring method, and 3D space monitoring program
description: The 3D spatial monitoring device 10 monitors the first monitoring target and the second from the first measurement information 31a of the first monitoring target 31 and the second measurement information 32a of the second monitoring target 32. The learning unit 11 which generates a learning result by machine learning the operation pattern of the object, the first operation space 43 of the first monitoring object 31 and the second operation space of the second monitoring object 32 The first space 45 and the first distance 45 from the first monitoring target 31 to the second operating space 44 and the second monitoring target 32 are generated from the motion space generating unit 13 for generating the 44 The distance calculation unit 14 calculates the second distance 46 to the space 43 and the distance threshold L based on the learning result D2, and the first and second distances 45 and 46 ) And a contact prediction determination unit 15 that predicts the possibility of contact between the first monitoring object 31 and the second monitoring object 32 based on the distance threshold L, and performs processing based on the contact possibility do.

title: Apparatus and method for real-time flooding prediction
description: Disclosed are a real-time flooding prediction device capable of predicting flooding danger zones and flooding depths for each grid with a small amount of computation in real time with high accuracy, and a method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the real-time flooding prediction method comprises the steps of: classifying a class related to a maximum flooding depth range for each grid based on a domain having a maximum flooding range among two-dimensional analysis results by performing a one-dimensional urban runoff analysis and a two-dimensional urban flooding analysis for each rainfall scenario; calculating a representative volume for each time zone by summing the flooding depth for each time zone of the grids belonging to each class for each classified class; building a flooding map model by calculating parameters between each grid and the representative volume based on a determination coefficient between the representative volume for each time zone and the flooding depth for each time zone for each grid for each classified class; and predicting the representative volume by inputting real-time rainfall data, and spatially expanding the predicted representative volume by using the parameters of the flooding map model to predict the flooding depth for each grid and the flooding range in accordance with the real-time rainfall data in real time.

title: Method and apparatus of detecting object
description: According to one embodiment, provided is an object detection method which sets a first window area corresponding to a different sized partial area in an input image and a second window area greater than that of the first window area, down-samples the second window area to adjust the size of the second window area, detects a first object candidate from the first window area, detects a second object candidate from the second window area of which the size has been adjusted, and detects an object included in the input image based on at least one of the first object candidate and the second object candidate.

title: Sound Information Judging Device and Method Thereof
description: The present invention relates to a device and a method for determining sound information and, more specifically, to a device and a method thereof which determine whether sound information is a sound source which is a literary work such as a song, a performance, and the like. According to one aspect of the present invention, the device for determining sound information comprises: a processor; and a memory electrically connected to the processor, and storing a deep learning program. The memory extracts the first characteristic information and the first beat information from the sound information according to a preset method when the sound information is received when the processor is executed, and can store instructions for determining whether or not sound information is for a sound source through a deep learning program using the first characteristic information and the first beat information. According to the present invention, broadcasting content is monitored to automatically determine whether or not to broadcast the literary work of the sound source so as to greatly reduce the possibility of missing a claim for copyright fees.

title: System for Prescriptive Analytics and Variable Importance Analysis of Prognostic Factors for Cancer Patients using Artificial Intelligence
description: According to an embodiment of the present, a system for analyzing the importance of prognostic factors of cancer patients and prescriptively analyzing treatment planning by using artificial intelligence comprises: a data collection unit for collecting references and patient information to be used for the analysis of the importance of prognostic factors of cancer patients; a data extraction unit for extracting data to be used for meta-analysis from the references and extracting data to be used for artificial intelligence analysis from the patient information; an analysis unit for analyzing the relative importance of each prognostic factor affecting the treatment prognosis of the cancer patients by performing meta-analysis and artificial intelligence analysis on the data extracted by the data extraction unit; and a result output unit for outputting the analysis results obtained by the analysis unit.

title: A method and a device for backtracking public scene dialogue in multi-turn dialogues
description: The present invention relates to a method and a device for backtracking a public scene dialogue in multi-turn dialogues, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method for backtracking a public scene dialogue in multi-turn dialogues according to an aspect of the present invention includes: determining a business scene according to an inquiry sentence in response to receiving the inquiry sentence; entering the business scene and a corresponding first dialog node tree; verifying relevant parameters according to a parameter verification dialog node of the first dialog node tree, storing, when determined that it is necessary to enter a public scene, the parameter verification dialog node, moving to the public scene, and entering a second dialog node tree of the public scene; collecting user information through the second dialog node tree, and determining, when the collection is successful, whether a backtracking condition is satisfied; and returning to the business scene according to the stored parameter verification dialog node when the backtracking condition is satisfied, and continuing to perform other dialog logic processing of the business scene. The embodiment realizes automatic backtracking of a public scene dialogue in multi-turn dialogues, reduces system thresholds, complexity, and maintenance costs, and improves immediacy, effectiveness and accuracy.

title: Apparatus and method for generating feature vector with label information
description: The present invention relates to a device and a method for generating a feature vector including label information. The device includes: a feature vector generation unit which generates a feature vector based on learning data included in the learning population; and a feature matrix generation unit which is configured to generate a feature matrix corresponding to each column of a plurality of labels preset as a result of classification of the learning population based on the feature vector. Accordingly, according to the present invention, label information can be reflected in the feature vector generation process by generating the feature matrix corresponding to each column of a plurality of labels set in advance as a result of classification for a data set.

title: Method for determining lens and apparatus using the method
description: Disclosed are a method for determining a lens to minimize side effects after surgery and an apparatus using the same. According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for determining a lens to be inserted into the eye during lens implantation by using machine learning comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of examination data of a patient to receive surgery; and inputting the plurality of acquired examination data of the patient to receive surgery into a lens decision model to determine the size of a lens to be implanted into the eye of the patient to receive surgery among a plurality of lens sizes. The lens determination model is different from a formula for determining a lens to be implanted into the eye during lens implantation and is trained based on examination data of patients who received lens implantation in the past and size information of the lens implanted into the eye of the patients.

title: Augmenting virtual users and items in collaborative filtering for addressing cold start problems
description: Disclosed is a method for solving a cold start problem using virtual user and item augmentation. An item recommendation method for solving a cold start problem according to an embodiment comprises the steps of: inputting user data and product data into a trained learning model to recommend an item; generating neighboring data similar to the user data and the product data input into the trained learning model; constructing a user-product rating matrix based on the generated neighbor data; and recommending an item according to a user preference from the constructed user-product rating matrix using another learning model trained to recommend an item. The present invention can increase the accuracy of product recommendation.

title: Synchronization of multi-chip systems
description: A method, system and apparatus comprising a computer program encoded in a computer storage medium, for each pair of adjacent chips in a plurality of chips connected in a series-ring arrangement of a semiconductor device, corresponding to round-trip data transfer between the pair of chips determining the loop latency. Identifying, among the loop latencies, a maximum loop latency. determining a ring latency for data transmission occurring in one of a plurality of chips to be transmitted in the series-ring arrangement and to be transmitted back to a chip. comparing half of the maximum loop latency to 1/N of the ring latency, and storing the larger value as the chip-to-chip latency of the semiconductor device, where N is the number of chips in a plurality of chips, and the chip-to-chip latency represents the operating characteristic of the semiconductor device.

title: Method and apparatus of compressing artificial neural network
description: A method and device for compressing an artificial neural network according to one embodiment obtain the weights corresponding to an artificial neural network comprising a plurality of pre-trained layers, generate the data to understand a behavioral change of the artificial neural network due to pruning of the artificial neural network based on the weights, determine a pruning threshold for pruning of the artificial neural network through the behavioral change of the artificial neural network understood by the data, and compress the artificial neural network based on the pruning threshold.

title: Influenza Detection Kit Image Classification using Convolution Neural Network with BOHB
description: The present invention is a method for classifying an image of an influenza detection kit using deep learning, comprising: augmenting and preprocessing data using directly collected data; It includes the process of creating a model using the cnn algorithm and tuning hyperparameters using the BOHB algorithm.  Representative view - Fig. 5

title: Systems and methods for analyzing medical images based on spatiotemporal data
description: Systems, methods, and computer program products are provided for analyzing spatiotemporal medical images using artificial neural networks. The method includes capturing a series of medical images of a patient, the series of medical images comprising visual movement of the at least one entity, capturing time-varying spatial data associated with the at least one entity based on the visual movement A method comprising: tracking, generating spatiotemporal data by correlating the time-varying spatial data with a set of medical images; and analyzing the set of medical images based on an artificial neural network comprising a plurality of layers; The one or more layers each combine features from at least three different scales, and at least one layer of the plurality of layers of the artificial neural network is configured to learn a spatiotemporal relationship based on the spatiotemporal data.

title: Method, system, and computer program to optimize video encoding using artificial intelligence model
description: A video encoding optimization method using an artificial intelligence model, a system thereof, and a computer program are disclosed. The encoding optimization method includes the steps of: predicting an encoding option corresponding to a feature of an input image using an artificial intelligence model; and performing encoding on the input image according to the encoding option.

title: IoT Application Generation Automation Method for supporting Neuromorphic Hardware
description: The present invention relates to a neuromorphic hardware-assisted IoT application creation automation method, and more particularly, an image conversion rate (λ) for reducing the scale of an image input by a developer, and a hardware usage rate (η) for processing data It is about a method for automating the creation of neuromorphic hardware-supported IoT applications that receive input and automatically determine the number of neurons to create a neural network model.

title: Method for measuring the health of an electric vehicle battery
description: The present invention discloses a method for measuring the state of an electric vehicle battery capable of accurately measuring the state of an electric vehicle battery by using a data analysis technique including at least one of a neural network and deep learning do.  A method for measuring a state of an electric vehicle battery according to the present invention includes the steps of (a) generating a battery state of charge (SOC) model and a battery state of health (SOH) model using a data analysis technique; (b) attaching a data acquisition module to the electric vehicle to collect battery state information; and (c) measuring the battery SOH based on the battery state of charge (SOC) model and the battery state of health (SOH) model based on the collected battery state information.

title: Video Compression Using Adaptive Iterative Intra Prediction
description: A method of video decoding in a video decoder may include receiving one or more syntax elements associated with a current first block belonging to a plurality of first blocks partitioned from a picture, the one or more syntax elements comprising a current first block. Optimal partition, set of block selection signals indicating how a block is partitioned into second blocks for intra prediction - the current first block is re-partitioned into third blocks, each block selection signal being assigned to one of the third blocks corresponding and indicating whether each third block is coded using the first coding method or the second coding method - and indicates a set of compressed expressions each corresponding to one of the third blocks. The current first block may be reconstructed based on one or more syntax elements to generate the reconstructed current first block.

title: Method, apparatus and system of updating fashion ontology
description: A method for updating a fashion ontology previously constructed in a computing device according to an embodiment of the present invention can comprise: a step of collecting new product information; a step of preprocessing the collected new product information, comparing the preprocessed product information with the existing corpus of the previously constructed fashion ontology, and retraining the existing and new combined word lists using an already built embedding model; and a step of extracting the n words with the highest similarity relative to the new word list, and when there are words with values above a preset threshold, recommending and storing classification within the previously constructed fashion ontology with reference to the classes or attributes of the relevant words to update the fashion ontology. Therefore, the method for updating the fashion ontology can provide a service which allows consumers to search for fashion products more quickly and easily.

title: Method for providing data matching service between users
description: According to various embodiments of the present document, in a method for providing a data matching service between users, first data of a first user and second data of a second user are received, and mutual data is exchanged according to a user matching condition. conveying; a learning module for extracting attributes of the first and second data obtained from the first and second users through machine learning; a storage step of storing the first and second data and attribute information of each data into a database that stores and manages; and comparing properties of the first data and the second data according to a designation condition of the first data of the first user or the second data of the second user to determine whether they are mutually matched, and if matched, the matched data is transmitted. and a control step of transmitting to the requesting user.

title: Association learning of autoencoder pairs for wireless communication
description: Various aspects of the present disclosure relate generally to wireless communications. In some aspects, a client may determine, using a first client autoencoder, a feature vector associated with one or more features associated with the client's environment. The client may determine the latent vector based at least in part on the feature vector and using the second client autoencoder. A client may transmit feature vectors and latent vectors. A number of other aspects are provided.

title: Pooling device for deep learning accelerators
description: A pooling device for a deep learning accelerator is provided. A pooling apparatus according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a line memory in which lines constituting input data are sequentially stored one by one, and a first method for selecting a specific value by comparing data currently stored in the line memory with data in which a first window is located. A comparator, a memory in which the first previous specific value, which is a specific value previously selected in the first comparator, is stored, and a first previous specific value applied from the memory is compared with the data where the first window is located among the data currently stored in the line memory. , and a third comparator for selecting a specific value. Accordingly, it is possible to minimize the input/output of the internal memory in the deep learning accelerator, thereby reducing the calculation time and reducing the amount of hardware resources used, thereby enabling low-power operation.

title: Ensemble supervised learning-based fire situation detection method
description: An ensemble supervised learning-based fire situation detection method is provided. A fire detection method according to an embodiment of the present invention detects the occurrence of a fire using a first neural network learned to detect the occurrence of a fire by analyzing text data, and learns to detect the occurrence of a fire by analyzing acquired image data. The occurrence of fire is detected using the second neural network, and the occurrence of fire is finally detected based on the detection result of the first neural network and the detection result of the second neural network. Accordingly, it is possible to more quickly and accurately detect whether or not a fire has occurred through detection of a fire situation based on an ensemble model.

title: Smart inspection method and system for substation facilities
description: The present invention relates to a smart detection method and system for substation equipment, wherein the method extracts temperature matrix data based on an infrared thermal image, multi-values processes the temperature matrix, extrudes the temperature matrix, and generates an artificial intelligence model. It includes building and performing smart inspection of substation equipment based on the model. The present invention reduces the number of calculations for the unique characteristics of infrared thermal images of substation facilities in the process of data preprocessing, feature extraction, and model creation, increases the complexity of extraction in model feature extraction, and increases the pooling sensitivity in the pooling process. The amount of training and computation was reduced while maintaining the loss of sensitivity due to the reduction and finally not losing the model accuracy.

title: Methods and apparatus for predicting the occurrence of ischemic stroke in patients with atrial fibrillation based on deep leaarning technology
description: The present invention relates to a method and device for predicting the likelihood of developing ischemic stroke for various subjects, including atrial fibrillation (AF) patients, based on deep learning technology. The method according to the present invention is based on demographic information about the subject. Based on characteristic values including demographic information, medical history information, and health examination information, the likelihood of developing ischemic stroke in a subject can be predicted to a high level.

title: Emoji recommendation system using user context and biometric signals
description: A system and method for recommending emojis to send by a messaging application includes receiving user biometric signals from at least one sensor, receiving context information from at least one context source, and receiving user biometric signals and Based on the received context information, selecting a list of plausible user states from the possible heuristic states in the heuristic state table using a rule-based heuristic state selector. The state predictor determines, from at least a list of plausible user states and a user model of previously sent emojis in different user states, the probability that a user will send an emoji for each user state, given the list of user states, and context information. decide on them Recommended emojis are displayed for selection for transmission by the messaging application, in order from highest to lowest probability that the user will send the recommended emojis based on the selected likely user state.

title: Active noise cancelling system for roads based on artificial intelligence and method for processing thereof
description: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence-based active noise removal system for roads and a processing method thereof. The active noise removal system for roads of the present invention installs a plurality of microphones and a plurality of speakers in a multi-layered structure on the vehicle's movement path and is equipped with an active noise removal control device for active noise removal. The active noise removal control device uses artificial intelligence-based deep learning technology to analyze detected noise and noise signals, extracts and generates anti-phase wave signals to remove and offset the noise and noise signals, and outputs them to the speaker. This removes or reduces noise and noise. Therefore, according to the present invention, when noise or noise occurs while driving a vehicle, it reacts at ultra-high speed through deep learning iterative learning to extract and generate an optimized anti-phase processed wave signal corresponding to the noise and noise signal and outputs the vehicle's It is possible to quickly and precisely remove or reduce large-scale and continuously generated noise and noise around the road.

title: Integrated testing method for quality assurance of ai learning data and system thereof
description: The present invention provides an integrated inspection method for securing the quality of artificial intelligence learning data that can perform an integrated inspection regardless of the type of inspection data when performing a quality inspection of learning data to ensure the quality of artificial intelligence learning data, and the same. It's about the system.  The integrated test method for securing the quality of artificial intelligence learning data according to the present invention includes a test data selection step of selecting test data to be tested, a syntax correctness test step of performing a syntax correctness test on the selected test data, and the selected test data. A data type determination step of determining the data type of the test data, a semantic accuracy test step of calling a semantic accuracy check unit based on the determined data type and performing a semantic accuracy test on the selected test data, and It is characterized in that it includes a test result storage step of storing the test results of the syntactic accuracy test and the semantic accuracy test.

title: Apparatus and method for processing data, electronic device, storage medium, and computer program
description: The present disclosure relates to a data processing device, relates to the field of artificial intelligence technology, and particularly, to the field of chip technology. The device comprises: a cache unit including a plurality of storage spaces; and a processor, The processor is configured to determine I number of storage space groups from a plurality of storage spaces, determines a plurality of first initial size information according to the size of a first matrix and the capacity of a first storage space, for each storage space group, determines at least one second size information related to a second matrix according to each first initial size information among the plurality of first initial size information, performs an operation of determining a plurality of first initial memory access costs according to the plurality of second size information and the plurality of first initial size information to obtain a plurality of first initial memory access costs corresponding to each storage space, and determines a target memory access cost from all the first initial memory access costs of the I number of storage space groups. The present disclosure also relates to a data processing method, an electronic device, a storage medium, and a computer program.

title: Big data information-based cosmetic identification process and a method for measuring the same
description: The present invention interprets the spreadability (or spreadability) of the tactile sensation felt by humans while applying cosmetic materials to the skin with accuracy and high reproducibility, and uses deep learning-based artificial intelligence to replace the role of a taster. As a technology for diagnosing intelligent friction data (tribological data), it is about obtaining big data information including skin information of people with different genders, constitutions, ages, etc., and a method and device for interpreting friction data based on this. An important feature of the present invention is the step of mounting an artificial skin module that implements various skin properties so that various skin information is simultaneously expressed in the same measuring device, and acquiring big data of measurement of skin applicability without separate processing; Converting this into input data codes converted into time series measurements; Generating a model learned based on big data considering various skin conditions, including a big data information-based artificial intelligence cosmetics identification method including the step of distinguishing the type of cosmetics from the code by deep learning of artificial intelligence. As a result, it is possible to provide a measurement device that probabilistically enables precise and objective discrimination of complex and atypical time series measurement values.

title: Hardware-efficient electrocardiogram classification method and apparatus for resource-liminted devices
description: A low-power electrocardiogram (ECG) classification method and device that operates on devices with limited hardware resources, such as smart watches, are disclosed. The ECG classification method includes the steps of preprocessing ECG data and sampling ECG bits, matching the morphological characteristics of each ECG bit with the first characteristic of a pre-stored normal bit to determine whether the correlation is greater than a first threshold. , Comparing the temporal characteristics of two consecutive ECG bits among the ECG bits with the second characteristics of two previously stored consecutive normal beats, determining that the morphological characteristics of a specific ECG bit have a correlation equal to or higher than the first threshold. If the temporal characteristic of the ECG bit has an interval value less than or equal to a second threshold, updating the normal average bit by adding a specific ECG bit to previously stored normal bits, the correlation is less than the first threshold or the interval value is less than the second threshold. If it exceeds, it includes determining a specific ECG bit as abnormal.

title: Data Augmentation Method and Apparatus for Predicting Terminal Mobility
description: A data augmentation method and device for predicting terminal mobility are disclosed. A data augmentation method for terminal mobility prediction includes the step of (a) acquiring a mobility data set of a terminal - the mobility data set includes a plurality of samples, wherein the plurality of samples each contain location information and heading information. Included; (b) converting a geographic coordinate system to a grid coordinate system based on the mobility data set to determine a class label for each sample; (c) considering the correlation between at least two consecutive samples based on the mobility data set and generating at least one similar sample for data augmentation between the consecutive samples; and (d) generating class labels for similar samples by applying a grid labeling algorithm to the similar samples.

title: Neural processing device and Method for dynamic frequency scaling thereof
description: The present invention discloses a neural processing device and a dynamic frequency scaling method thereof. The neural processing device includes at least one neural core and a memory unit that stores data of the at least one neural core, and a compiler stack implemented by the at least one neural core receives an AI model and processes a workload. An adaptation layer that outputs frequency scaling information of the neural core and the memory unit for each group and quantizes the AI model to generate a quantization model, a front-end compiler that receives the quantization model and converts it into an intermediate representation, and the intermediate Contains a backend compiler that receives the representation and converts it into binary code.

title: Temperature Decay Method on Differentiable Architecture Search
description: Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) is a field that aims to speed up the development of artificial intelligence models and minimize the resources required. Among them, the NAS (Neural Architecture Search) algorithm that generates the architecture of the model is being actively studied. The basic purpose of NAS algorithms is to design the optimal model architecture while minimizing the intervention of the designer and increasing the efficiency of the model creation task. There can be various approaches such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and Evolutionary Algorithm for the design and implementation of NAS algorithms.  In this invention, we focus on a method to improve DARTS (Differentiable Architecture Search) using gradient descent among them. By applying temperature to the mixed operation of DARTS, we can control exploration and exploitation during architecture search. In addition, the existing DARTS algorithm assumes that the parameters of the architecture will be learned similarly to the one-hot encoded architecture in the process of creating the mixed operator, and the mismatch problem between the architectural parameters and the one-hot encoded architecture was alleviated by adjusting the temperature value. The experiment of this invention was conducted by lowering the temperature from 10 to 0.1 during the architecture search, and as a result, the accuracy of 97.37% was recorded on the CIFAR-10 data set, showing a performance that was 0.13%p higher than the existing DARTS algorithm.

title: Method and apparatus for training answer selection model for chatbot to select optimal answer
description: A training method for an answer selection model according to one embodiment may include the steps of: obtaining a plurality of context data representing a context including a query and a plurality of response data for the plurality of context data; calculating a vectorized first parameter matrix based on the plurality of context data and the plurality of response data; calculating a second parameter matrix estimated based on the plurality of context data and the plurality of response data from the first parameter matrix; generating a plurality of context data and a plurality of modified answer data based on projections of the plurality of context data and the plurality of response data; generating a vector-type arm set based on the modified plurality of context data and the modified plurality of response data; applying a penalty to the arm set according to the importance of a covariance; determining a third parameter matrix based on the arm set to which the penalty has been applied; and training the answer selection model using the third parameter matrix.

title: How to determine proper antenna placement by predicting radiation patterns
description: The present invention describes a method for determining an appropriate placement of an antenna on a support structure of, for example, a vehicle. The technique disclosed herein consists of optimizing the position of an antenna located on a fixed platform by relying on Bayesian optimization together with an electromagnetic solver and a fully convolutional neural network (U-Net), which determines a fitness function through electromagnetic simulation of the operation of the antenna at a given position.

title: Method, device and system for generating a summary
description: A method for generating a summary according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: calculating a first likelihood of each node included in a graph including a node corresponding to a keyword extracted from a natural language-based context and child nodes of a preset depth for the node; calculating a second likelihood of each of the nodes by giving a greater weight to a first likelihood of a node corresponding to a keyword not present in the context than to a first likelihood of a node corresponding to a keyword present in the context among keywords corresponding to each of the nodes; calculating a third likelihood of each of all paths present in the graph based on the second likelihood of each of the nodes; and generating a summary for the context based on a path having the highest third likelihood among the paths.

title: Electronic apparatus and controlling method thereof
description: An electronic device includes a memory storing at least one instruction and at least one processor connected to the memory to control the electronic device, wherein the at least one processor executes at least one instruction to obtain a first audio signal including a voice signal and a noise signal, convert the first audio signal in a time domain into a second audio signal in a frequency domain, obtain a first gain value representing a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) from the second audio signal, filter the first gain value to obtain a second gain value having a first dynamic range, input the second gain value into a neural network model trained to output a signal from which noise has been removed to obtain a third gain value, and convert the second audio signal into a third audio signal from which at least a portion of the noise signal has been removed by using the third gain value.

title: Method and apparatus for utilizing multi-map combination for fingerprinting and deep learning positioning
description: A method for utilizing a combination of multi-maps in fingerprinting and deep learning positioning according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: a) a first positioning device generating a plurality of fingerprinting maps, each of which is divided into grid units and matched with a plurality of grids based on RSSI values of BLE beacons installed in the plurality of grids; b) a step in which the first positioning device constructs a fingerprinting multi-map by collecting a plurality of fingerprinting maps by environmental variables affecting positioning performance, and measuring a location of a user located in an area within the plurality of grids based on a fingerprinting map reconstructed by reflecting a weight of environmental variable information to the environmental variable-specific fingerprinting map; c) a step in which the second positioning device assigns a color according to the RSSI value of the BLE beacon and then creates a plurality of deep learning maps, each of which is an image in a form matching the plurality based on the RSSI value to which the color is assigned; And d) the second positioning device may include a step of reconstructing a deep learning multi-map by collecting a plurality of deep learning maps by environmental variables, and reconstructing a deep learning map or deep learning positioning result data by environmental variables by reflecting the weights of the environmental variable information received from the first positioning device, thereby measuring the user's location.

title: Device and method for designing multilayer films
description: A design device and method for a multilayer film are disclosed. The design device for a multilayer film models a laminated structure of the multilayer film to be designed, collects stress-strain data for a single-layer film forming the laminated structure, reads a value stored in advance in a storage space accessible to the design device for the multilayer film, obtains a feature setting mode for designating a different feature setting method according to the read value, calculates strain energy from a plurality of physical indices selected from the stress-strain data according to the feature setting mode, sets the strain energy as a feature, selects at least one of a plurality of supervised learning models capable of regression analysis as a machine learning model, uses the feature as an independent variable and the drop strength of the multilayer film as a target variable to predict the drop strength of the multilayer film, and generates design data for the multilayer film by combining predicted values for other characteristics with predicted values of the drop strength so as to satisfy design requirements of the multilayer film.

title: Customized preferred charging station recommendation server and system using grid-based spatial data
description: A server and system for recommending customized preferred charging stations using grid-based spatial data according to an embodiment improve charging convenience by recommending electric vehicle charging stations based on previous selections even when an electric vehicle drives a new travel route. In addition, a server and system for recommending customized preferred charging stations using grid-based spatial data according to an embodiment adjust the priority of recommended charging stations according to driving time and driving conditions, thereby allowing a user to select the optimal charging station.

title: Transport Network Domain Slicing Architecture
description: Embodiments relate to systems, devices, and methods including a network slice management function (NSMF) and a transport network-network slice subnet management function (TN-NSSMF). The NSMF is configured to request at least a transport network (TN) domain within a network architecture to create a TN portion of a network slice within a wireless communication system. The TN-NSSMF is configured to manage the TN portion of the network slice. One of the NSMF and the TN-NSSMF has artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) integrated therein, wherein the AI/ML is configured to allow one of the NSMF and the TN-NSSMF to monitor and analyze performance of the network slice in the TN domain.

title: Device and method of tracing knowledge using difficulty information for english proficiency assessment
