description: A knowledge tracking device and method utilizing difficulty information in the field of English proficiency assessment are disclosed. The method for generating a knowledge tracking model according to an embodiment is performed by a computing device including at least a processor, and includes a step of acquiring basic data, a step of preprocessing the basic data to generate learning data, a step of generating input data by generating an embedding for the learning data, and a step of generating the knowledge tracking model by learning a learning model using the input data through multi-task learning (MTL).

title: Neural network analog operation system for convolutional neural networks
description: A neural network analog operation system for implementing a convolutional neural network (CNN) according to one embodiment of the present invention includes a DAC unit for receiving a digital signal for image or voice data, converting it into an analog signal, and outputting it; an analog operation unit for receiving the analog signal, performing a parallel operation, and outputting analog data; and an ADC unit for receiving the analog data, converting it into a digital signal, and outputting it.

title: Ship fuel consumption prediction system using automatic identification system data
description: The present invention comprises a fuel consumption prediction system for a ship, which collects ship information through AIS data received by an AIS (Automatic Identification System) installed on a ship (10) and stored in an AIS server (20), and a fuel consumption prediction unit (30) that predicts fuel consumption of a ship (10) using the collected ship information. The fuel consumption prediction unit (30) comprises an AIS data receiving unit (31) that receives AIS data transmitted from a ship (10) and collected through a low-orbit satellite to collect ship information, and a big data learning unit (32) that learns based on empirical data on various existing ship information through machine learning to predict fuel consumption through the collected ship information, stores and manages the learned data, and predicts fuel consumption of a ship (10) based on data on newly input ship information. The fuel consumption prediction system can predict fuel consumption by utilizing the AIS of a ship (10) without installing separate equipment or software on the ship (10). Accordingly, it has the effect of reducing the time and effort required to measure the carbon emissions of a ship (10), and since the performance of the ship (10) can be monitored by checking the CII grade of the ship through the predicted fuel consumption and carbon emissions, it has the effect of evaluating the expected economic efficiency of the ship (10) when operating it.

title: Deep learning-based CCTV camera system for black ice detection and vehicle accident prevention
description: A deep learning-based CCTV camera system for detecting black ice and preventing vehicle accidents is disclosed. The deep learning-based CCTV camera system according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a shooting unit configured to shoot real-time pictures of a road to be monitored and transmit the pictures to a deep learning judgment unit; and a deep learning judgment unit configured to detect patterns and shapes of black ice occurring on the surface of the road based on the shooting data acquired from the shooting unit.  According to the present invention, when black ice or icy roads occur on the road, it can be quickly detected and immediately notified to vehicles on the road and road managers to prevent traffic accidents in advance, and when a vehicle drives in the wrong direction on the road, a vehicle overturns on the road or in a parking lot, a vehicle suddenly stops on the road, or an unidentified object falls on the road, it can quickly detect these and immediately notify to vehicles on the road and road managers to prevent traffic accidents in advance, and it can detect and warn when a worker works outdoors for a long time, detect and warn when people are crowded, and detect vehicles driving dangerously on the road and report it to the competent police station. It is possible to provide a deep learning-based CCTV camera system including a configuration.

title: Financial recommendation system using ai robo-advisors
description: The present invention relates to a financial recommendation system using an AI robo-advisor.  The present invention discloses a financial recommendation system that recommends financial services to a client system, wherein a web server receives a request from a client system and provides a financial service processing result to the client system, a relay server receives a request from the client system from the web server, calls a financial recommendation server, generates a response including a financial service processing result of the financial recommendation server, and transmits the response to the web server, and the financial recommendation server receives a request from the client system, executes a plurality of financial models, generates results, and then generates a financial service processing result and transmits it to the relay server.

title: Generative artificial intelligence-based information provision device, information provision system including the same, and method thereof
description: In one embodiment of the present invention, a generative artificial intelligence-based information providing system may include: a product database storing product information according to a type name system; an information providing device receiving a prompt including search request information and weight information for the search request information, searching for product information corresponding to the search request information among product information stored in the product database based on the prompt, inputting the prompt and the searched product information into a generative artificial intelligence model to obtain result information corresponding to the prompt, and transmitting the result information to a user terminal.

title: Supporting system for business plan document writing
description: The present invention relates to a business plan writing support system, which assists and supports the writing of a business plan that matches the user's intention and the writing requirements of the business plan through information linkage with an interactive artificial intelligence service server based on generative AI technology, thereby reducing the user's effort in writing a business plan and increasing user convenience.

title: Resource saving system and method using artificial neural network
description: A resource saving system including an artificial neural network according to one embodiment includes a collection unit that obtains dietary information input from a user, a preprocessing unit that preprocesses the dietary information so that the artificial neural network can process it, a database that stores resource information corresponding to each food and/or food ingredient included in the dietary information, and an artificial neural network that determines a resource consumption amount according to the dietary information using the resource information and the dietary information, and outputs alternative food information based on the resource consumption amount, wherein the artificial neural network can learn a method of loading the resource information from the database in response to receiving the preprocessed dietary information, and outputting the alternative food information for reducing the resource consumption amount based on the dietary information and the resource information.

title: Apparatus and Method for Discovering Life Pattern based on Multiple Experience Attributes
description: A device and method for discovering lifestyle patterns based on multiple experience attributes are disclosed. The method for discovering lifestyle patterns based on multiple experience attributes according to an embodiment of the present invention may include a step of extracting experience attributes based on lifelog data including at least one of user-input experience information and sensor data, a step of constructing a daily experience matrix based on the extracted experience attributes, and a step of deriving a daily lifestyle pattern based on a correlation between two or more experience attributes.

title: Method of operation of a radar system in which the position information of a detected target is determined using machine learning, radar system, driver assistance system and vehicle
description: A method of operating a radar system (14), in particular a radar system (14) for a vehicle (10), a radar system (14), a driver assistance system (12) and a vehicle (10) are described. In the method, at least one electromagnetic radar signal (22) is transmitted from at least one transmitting antenna element (34) of the radar system (14). At least one electromagnetic echo signal (40) generated by reflection of the at least one radar signal (22) from at least one target (20) within the field of view of the radar system (14) is received by at least one receiving antenna element (38) and converted into received data (72) suitable for signal processing. The radar system (14) is operated as a MIMO radar comprising a plurality of transmitting antenna elements (34) and a plurality of receiving antenna elements (38), wherein the transmitting antenna elements (34) and the receiving antenna elements (38) create a virtual antenna array having a plurality of virtual antenna elements for receiving the echo signals (40) during MIMO operation of the radar system (14). For at least a portion of the virtual antenna elements, magnitude information and phase information are determined from at least one portion of the received data by performing at least one two-dimensional fast Fourier transform. At least one array data set is determined, which includes at least magnitude information and phase information of at least one portion of the virtual antenna elements. At least a portion of the data of the at least one array data set is fed to at least one neural network (64), from which at least one positional information for at least one detected target (20) is determined.

title: Method, computer device, and computer program to generate target style image from text
description: A method, a computer device, and a computer program for generating an image of a target style from text are disclosed. The image generating method includes a step of generating an image reproducing the style of a reference image using a generative artificial intelligence (AI) model trained with a given reference image by at least one processor, wherein, during the training process of the generative AI model, a text embedding for textual inversion is trained using a loss function between the reference image and an image generated by the generative AI model, and the text embedding can be generated by a prompt template consisting of a text prompt, a special token for the reference image, and a context prompt.

title: Method, computer device, and computer program for providing legal information using large language model
description: A method, a computer device, and a computer program for providing legal information using a large language model are provided. According to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for providing legal information using a large language model (LLM) executed by a computer device may include the steps of: when a user queries legal information and searches for legal information using a retriever, if the results fetched by the retriever include legal-related materials related to information to be ultimately provided to the user, determining whether a specific material cites another specific material; and, if the specific material cites another specific material, visually distinguishing between two specific materials or each specific material in a citation relationship and displaying them to the user.

title: Image encoding method, image encoding device, image decoding method, image decoding device, method for transmitting bitstream, and recording medium storing bitstream
description: A method according to embodiments includes the steps of obtaining a Supplemental Enhancement Information (SEI) message for pictures; and decoding the pictures, wherein the SEI message may include processing order information for a group of types of SEI messages. A method according to embodiments includes the steps of deriving a Supplemental Enhancement Information (SEI) message for pictures; and encoding the pictures, wherein the SEI message may include processing order information for a group of types of SEI messages.

title: Apparatus for assisting parking vehicle and method thereof
description: A vehicle parking assistance device according to one aspect of the present invention includes a processor and a memory storing instructions executed by the processor, wherein the processor calculates an optimal parking position for the vehicle by applying a vehicle identification number and a vehicle exit time to a predefined parking space search model when the vehicle enters a parking space.

title: Apparatus for Designing 2D Layout Drawing Concept for Smart Factory Using Generative AI
description: The smart factory 2D layout drawing concept design device using generative AI can design 2D layout concepts for smart factories based on the design requirements of smart factories by utilizing a large language model (LLM) and a generative adversarial network (GAN), and can apply these to actual manufacturing processes.  The present invention enables automation of 2D layout concept design work in the manufacturing process of a smart factory, thereby reducing design time, reducing errors, and improving manufacturing efficiency.

title: Molten salt multi-level energy storage management method and system
description: The present invention discloses a molten salt multi-level energy storage management method and system, which includes: obtaining the historical load data of the power grid, and modeling and predicting based on the historical load data of the power grid to obtain the load forecast data of the power grid; performing cluster analysis on the load forecast data of the power grid to determine the power grid load stages within the load forecast data; setting multi-level energy storage management strategies based on the power grid load stages, and performing simulation operations according to the multi-level energy storage management strategies; evaluating the simulation results to obtain a multi-level energy storage management evaluation value, and adjusting the multi-level energy storage management strategies based on the multi-level energy storage management evaluation value. The present invention utilizes technical means such as modeling prediction, cluster analysis, and simulation operation ot achieve intelligent scheduling and management of the multi-level energy storage system, and optimizes the multi-level energy storage management strategies by evaluating the simulation results to improve energy utilization efficiency and enhance system flexibility and responsiveness. FIG.1

title: METHODS FOR DIAGNOSING, DETECTING OR EVALUATING CANCER USING ISOTOPIC ELEMENTAL ANALYSIS
description: The isotopic fingerprint was adapted to the human body, and experimental data demonstrated a specific chemical fingerprint for cancer, such as prostate cancer, which was "fossilized" in samples like hair strands or fingernails from patients. To interpret the isotopic chemical data from the samples, predictive models were developed using machine learning algorithms that allowed for the separation of populations using various dimensions. Non-invasive methods for cancer diagnosis, detection, or evaluation are provided, some of which were developed by identifying the cancer's chemical fingerprint.

title: Face Image Processing Method and Apparatus, Image Device, and Storage Medium
description: Provided are a face image processing method and apparatus, an image device, and a storage medium. The face image processing method includes: acquiring (110) first-key-point information of a first face image; performing (120) position transformation on the first-key-point information to obtain second-key-point information conforming to a second facial geometric attribute, the second facial geometric attribute being different from a first facial geometric attribute corresponding to the first-key-point information; and performing (130) facial texture coding processing by utilizing a neural network and the second-key-point information to obtain a second face image.

title: SIGNAL PROCESSING APPARATUS AND METHOD.
description: An input signal SV has components representing aspects of a physical entity which are in a known state and other components which are unknown. The apparatus processes the signal in accordance with stored data representing rules which indicate which combinations of the components are possible. Rules are identified which involve the known components and all of the combinations consistent with the known states are identified. If all of these combnations have the same value for a particular component, the component is determined to have that value in the output signal. The rules are stored as binary representations of the possible combinations, and the components of the input and output signals may represent two allowable states, tautology (undefined state) and inconsistency (inallowable state).

title: COMPOSITIONS AND METHODS FOR ACTIVE SURVEILLANCE FOR PROSTATE CANCER
description: IT REFERS TO A METHOD TO EVALUATE A SUBJECT PREVIOUSLY DIAGNOSED WITH NON-AGGRESSIVE PROSTATE CANCER, WHICH INCLUDES: I) SUBMIT A BLOOD SAMPLE TO ONE OR MORE IMMUNE TESTS THAT MEASURE THE LEVELS OF ONE OR MORE SPECIFIC CALCIREGENT MARKERS OF CALCIREGEN SELICO. FREE PROSTATE (fPSA), INTACT PROSTATE SPECIFIC ANTIGEN (iPSA), TOTAL PROSTATE SPECIFIC ANTIGEN (tPSA) AND HUMAN KALICREIN 2 (hK2); AND II) DETERMINE THE PROBABILITY THAT A PROSTATE TISSUE BIOPSY OBTAINED FROM THE SUBJECT CONTAINS DETECTABLE AGGRESSIVE PROSTATE CANCER BY WEIGHTING ONE OR MORE MEASURED CALICREIN MARKERS AND AT LEAST ONE CLINICAL FACTOR. IT ALSO REFERS TO THE USE OF A COMPUTER WITH A SYSTEM AND STORAGE TO DETERMINE A PROBABILITY OF AN EVENT ASSOCIATED WITH PROSTATE CANCER

title: COMPUTING OPERATION CIRCUIT, COMPUTING OPERATION PROCEDURE AND PROGRAM
description: A computing operation method for a convolution layer in a folded neural network is provided. The arithmetic operation method includes the following: Generation of a coefficient matrix (A) by converting a kernel used in the convolution layer so that the coefficient matrix is linked to an input vector (x), which is expanded into a column by expanding a feature map that was entered in the convolution layer is obtained; Search for non-zero elements contained in the coefficient matrix; Allocate multiplications of the non-zero elements contained in the coefficient matrix and corresponding elements of the input vector to a plurality of computers (CL), each of the multiplications being treated as a process unit in order to balance the number of process units between the computers, all of the computers are able to run processes in parallel; and the computer executes the assigned multiplications sequentially and sequentially adds the results of the multiplications to corresponding elements of an output vector (f).

title: METHOD OF IMAGE PROCESSING THROUGH A NEURAL NETWORK AND METHOD OF TRAINING A NEURAL NETWORK
description: The present invention relates to a computer-implemented method for processing an image comprising the steps of dividing the image into at least two image areas, grouping at least one of the image areas in at least one group, each of the image areas being assigned to exactly one group or no group, and applying at least one Kernels in a layer of a neural network on the image areas of at least one group, with a maximum of one kernel being applied to the image areas of each group. Furthermore, a computer-implemented method for training a neural network is proposed, as well as a device for processing an image in a neural network and / or for training a neural network and a computer-readable medium.

title: Quantum optical system with NV centers and transparent circuit carriers
description: The invention relates to a quantum optical system with a plurality of NV centers in one or more diamond crystals and with a circuit carrier (GPCB) made of an optically transparent material. The NV centers can interact with optical radiation. The circuit carrier (GPCB) interacts with the quantum dot in such a way that the circuit carrier acts as an optical functional element for at least part of the optical radiation that can interact or has interacted with the quantum dot.

title: VERTICAL IMAGING AND CALCULATING FOR DEEP NEURAL NETWORKS IN NON-VOLATILE MEMORY
description: A non-volatile memory structure is presented which is able to store layers of a deep neural network (DNN) and to perform an inference operation within the structure. A stack of bonded pairs of chips is connected by silicon vias. Each bonded pair of chips includes a memory chip having one or more memory arrays on which layers of the neural network are mapped and a peripheral circuit logic chip that includes the control circuitry for performing the convolution or multiplication for the bonded pair of chips. The multiplications can take place either in-array on the memory chip or in-logic on the peripheral switching logic chip. The arrays can be formed in columns along the vias so that an inference operation can be performed by spreading an input up and down the columns, with the output of one level being the input of the subsequent layer.

title: Content Aware Style Coding Using Neural Networks
description: Apparatus, systems, and methods are described for facilitating the application of a style, for which one or more neural networks have not been trained by a training framework, from one image to content of another image. In at least one embodiment, a styled output image is generated from one or more neural networks based on a style contained in a style image and content of a content image, the one or more neural networks not being based on the style through a training framework have been trained.

title: PROCESSING ELEMENT AND ELECTRONIC DEVICE WITH PROCESSING ELEMENT
description: Electronic device (100, 200) comprising:a plurality of processing elements (PE) in rows and columns;a plurality of word lines (WL1-WLm) connected to the rows of the plurality of processing elements (PE);a plurality of bit lines (BL1-BLn) connected to the columns of the plurality of processing elements (PE);a plurality of body lines (BDL1-BDLn) connected to the columns of the plurality of processing elements (PE); and a plurality of source lines (SL1-SLm) connected to the rows of the plurality of processing elements (PE), wherein each of the plurality of processing elements (PE) includes: a body (BODY), including a first terminal (T1) connected to a corresponding bit line (BL) of the plurality of bit lines (BL1-BLn), a second terminal (T2) connected to a corresponding source line (SL) of the plurality of source lines (SL1-SLm), and a body terminal connected to a corresponding body line of the plurality of body lines (BDL1-BDLn), a control gate (CG) between the first terminal (T1) and the second terminal, which is connected to a corresponding word line (WL) of the plurality of word lines (WL1-WLm), a charge storage element (FG) between the control gate (CG) and the body (BODY), which includes a part (FG4) which, together with a conductive material (CM) connected to the corresponding Bit line (BL) is connected, forms a capacitor (C3) between the charge storage element (FG) and the corresponding bit line (BL).

title: CONTROL DEVICE FOR A HUMAN DRIVEN VEHICLE, LEARNING METHOD, METHOD FOR CONTROLLING A HUMAN DRIVEN VEHICLE AND COMPUTER PROGRAM
description: A human-powered vehicle control device 100 includes: a detection unit that acquires input information related to driving of a human-powered vehicle 1; a memory 112, 802 that stores a first learning model 11M trained to output output information related to the control of a device 30 mounted on the human-driven vehicle 1 based on the acquired input information; a controller 110, 800 that controls the device 30 by control data decided based on output information obtained by inputting the input information into the first learning model 11M; and an interpolation processor 118 that performs the processing of interpolating the first learning model 11M in the memory 112, 802 using a second learning model 82M trained with input information in a human-powered vehicle 1 located in at least one of the human-powered vehicle 1 and a driver of the human-powered vehicle 1.

title: Method and apparatus for machine learning
description: Apparatus and method for machine learning, the method providing that a first model is provided (202) which comprises parameters and is designed to map an input, in particular an input comprising a digital image, to an output, in particular an output which semantically segments or classifies the digital image or parts thereof, depending on selected parameters of the first model, wherein masks are provided for selecting the selected parameters from the parameters (204), wherein a relevance of parameters of the first model is determined depending on the masks (206), wherein selected parameters of the first model are learned depending on the relevance (208).

title: Addition method, semiconductor device and electronic device
description: An addition circuit for suppressing an overflow is provided. The addition circuit has a first memory, a second memory, a third memory and a fourth memory. In a step, first data with a sign are supplied to the first memory and first data with a positive sign, which are stored in the first memory, are supplied to the second memory. In a further step, the first data with a negative sign, which are stored in the second memory, are fed to the third memory. In a further step, second data are generated by adding the first data with a positive sign, which are stored in the second memory, and the first data with a negative sign, which are stored in the third memory. In a further step, the second data are stored in the fourth memory, all of the second data stored in the fourth memory being added if all of the second data stored in the fourth memory are either data with a positive sign or data with a negative sign.

title: Telematics prediction vehicle component monitoring system
description: A method of identifying real-time prediction indicators for the condition of operational vehicle components, comprising:   Accessing at least one record of operational component data, the operational component data containing operational values of at least one vehicle component of at least one vehicle, the operational values being representative of an operational life cycle usage of the at least one vehicle component and further based on a measured component event,   Accessing at least one record of management event data, the management event data containing at least one vehicle component event data point for at least one vehicle,   Linking the at least one data record of operational component data with the at least one data record of administrative event data,   Filtering of operating component data,   Deriving from the operating component data from at least one signal which is representative of the measured component event,   Comparing filtered operating component data and at least one signal before the vehicle component event data point with filtered operating component data and at least one signal after the vehicle component event data point, thereby real-time prediction indicators of the operating state of the vehicle components for real-time use in fleet management are identified.

title: Neural Network and Method of Training
description: Methods of training neural networks ( 100, 600 ) that include one or more inputs (102-108) and a sequence of processing nodes ( 110, 112, 114, 116 ) in which each processing node may be coupled to one or more processing nodes that are closer to an output node are provided. The methods include establishing an objective function that preferably includes a term related to differences between actual and expected output for training data, and a term related to the number of weights of significant magnitude. Training involves optimizing the objective function in terms of weights that characterize directed edges of the neural network. The objective function is optimized using algorithms that employ derivatives of the objective function. Algorithms for accurately and efficiently estimating derivatives of the summed input going into output processing nodes of the neural network with respect to the weights of the neural network are provided.

title: User interface methods and apparatus for rules processing
description: The invention provides, in one aspect, a user interface method that includes processing one or more BPM or other rules with a rules engine executing on a server digital data processor. The rules engine generates, for presentation on a client device, a user interface having one or more display, input or other elements specified by those rules. Related aspects of the invention provide methods as described above in which the rules engine generates the user interface dynamically, e.g., selecting and/or configuring the elements that make up that interface concurrently with the client-server session during which the interface (e.g., web page or other user interface paradigm) is requested by, transmitted to, and/or presented by the client device. Further aspects of the invention provide such a method, where the rules engine generates the interface, e.g., web page, with embedded BPM or other rules that are executed by the client device and that support automated decision-making, e.g., in the manner of rules executed by the rules engine itself.

title: Artificial Intelligence Analyzer and Generator
description: This invention relates to using artificial intelligence for analyzing real-life collected data from an operation system, modeling the collected data to identify characteristics of events, analyzing the models to conclude an optimal solution for maximizing the performance of the operation system.

title: Apparatus and Method for Processing Information, Recording Medium and Computer Program
description: An information processing apparatus includes a target problem acquisition unit for acquiring a target problem, a generation unit for generating a plurality of solution candidates to the target problem to solve the target problem, and a contribution ratio calculating unit for calculating a contribution ratio of each solution candidate to the target problem if the target problem is solved using all the plurality of solution candidates to the target problem acquired by the target problem acquisition unit. The generation unit generates a solution candidate to the target problem in a next generation in accordance with a genetic algorithm that uses an evaluation value that is calculated using at least the contribution ratio of each solution candidate to the target problem determined by the contribution ratio calculating unit.

title: Intelligent automated assistant
description: The intelligent automation assistant system invokes external services at the appropriate time to obtain information and perform various tasks, in association with the user in an integrated, interactive manner using natural language dialogs. The system may be implemented using any of a number of different platforms, such as web, email, smart phones and the like, or any combination thereof. In one embodiment, the system is based on interrelated domains and sets of tasks and utilizes additional functionality that is operated by external services with which the system can interact.

title: Voice recognition system based on deep neural network
description: The present invention relates to a depth-of-neural network-based speech recognition system that can effectively achieve training of an acoustic model by expressing a non-linear activation function, which is a parameter of an acoustic model based on a deep-layer neural network, . The system includes an input unit for receiving various information; A storage unit for storing a speech processing algorithm; And a processing unit based on a neural network that performs speech recognition by applying a speech processing algorithm stored in the storage unit to the speech signal input through the input unit, wherein the processing unit is a nonlinear activation function, which is an acoustic model parameter, And an activation function expressed by the following formula.

title: Electronic apparatus and controlling method thereof
description: A control method of an electronic device is disclosed. The control method refers to a user of another electronic device in a conversation with a user of another electronic device using an artificial intelligence model learned by an artificial intelligence algorithm while talking with a user of another electronic device using the electronic device. Acquiring a name and storing the acquired name in association with contact information of a user of another electronic device. In particular, at least some of the control methods of the present disclosure may use an artificial intelligence model learned according to at least one of machine learning, neural networks, or deep learning algorithms.

title: Learning method, learning device for detecting lane through classification of lane candidate pixels and testing method, testing device using the same
description: The present invention is a learning method for detecting at least one lane based on a convolutional neural network (CNN), comprising: (a) a learning apparatus obtaining information about an encoded feature map and lane candidate pixels in an input image; (b) The learning apparatus classifies the first portion of the suboptimal candidate pixel whose probability score is smaller than the predetermined threshold as the strong line pixel, and the second portion of the suboptimal candidate pixel having the probability score below the threshold and above the other threshold is a wick line pixel. Classifying as; And (c) when the distance between the weak line pixel and the strong line pixel is less than a preset distance, the learning device classifies the weak line pixel as a pixel corresponding to the additional strong line, and a pixel corresponding to the strong line and the additional strong line. And determining that it corresponds to a pixel corresponding to this lane.

title: Open Source Software Recommendation System and Method Using Personal Profiling
description: The present invention relates to an open source software recommendation system and a method thereof which combine user profiling and keyword search to efficiently search for open source software to provide a user who intends to use open source software with a difficult concept of license to be easily understood, promote license selection convenience, and recommend corresponding reliable open source software. According to the present invention, the open source software recommendation method comprises: a step of collecting metadata for user preference, open source evaluation, license information, and open source information for open source software to build an open source software database and refine and process collected data to store the data again; a step of receiving a user selection condition for open source software from a user; a step of performing profiling for the user, recommending open source desired by the user, and combining the user selection condition received from the user to search for open source software; and a step of displaying results of the searched open source software to the user.

title: Semantic actions and inference support through distributed semantic data
description: Methods, systems, and apparatuses solve problems with semantic inference operations. Different customized or user-defined rules may be defined based on application needs, which may lead to different inferred facts even if based on the same initial facts.

title: Method for processing all interior computed tomography image using single artificial neural network and apparatus therefor
description: Disclosed are a method and apparatus for processing an internal tomography image of multiple regions of interest using a single neural network. An image processing method according to an embodiment of the present invention includes receiving internal computed tomography data; And restoring an image of the internal computed tomography data using a neural network corresponding to a Hilbert transform function, wherein the restoring of the image includes a preset analytical tomography data of the internal computed tomography data. Obtaining an initial reconstructed image from which singularity has been removed from a boundary of a region of interest (ROI) by using an algorithm; And restoring an image of the internal computed tomography data from the original reconstructed image using the neural network.

title: System for Die-casting Process management using Deep learning
description: The die casting process management system using deep learning according to the present invention is a temperature sensor unit that measures the mold temperature, which is the internal temperature of the mold producing the product, and time-series mold temperature data measured by the temperature sensor unit is applied to the deep learning algorithm. A deep learning learning unit to learn, and a process management unit for detecting defects in the product produced in the mold according to the learning result of the deep learning learning unit, wherein the deep learning learning unit includes the mold in the cycle in which the product is produced Data on the trend average temperature, which is information about the average temperature of the product, and data on the process time, cycle average temperature, cycle maximum temperature, and cycle minimum temperature, which are information on the deviation of process conditions in the cycle in which the product is produced, are input values. It is characterized in that it is learned by using the judgment on whether the product is defective as an output value.

title: Service providing apparatus and method for advertisement of advertising products based on delivery
description: The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for providing a service for advertising delivery-based advertising products, and more particularly, by matching an advertisement product suitable for a sale product to advertise an advertisement product together with the sale product, and placing an order according to the order of the sale product The present invention relates to an apparatus and method for providing a service for advertising of delivery-based advertising products, which deliver an advertisement product together with an ordered product through a delivery company during product delivery to increase the delivery-based advertisement effect as well as an advertisement effect on the advertisement product. The present invention can recognize the user as a gift that can be ordered together with the advertisement product, so that the customer can actively order the advertisement product while resolving the customer's objection to the advertisement for the advertisement product being provided separately from the sale product as in the past. In addition to greatly improving advertising efficiency as it can induce users to use the product, it is possible to additionally pay a delivery fee according to the delivery of advertising products to the delivery person, thereby greatly increasing the satisfaction of both customers, delivery companies and advertisers.

title: Method and system for product search based on image restoration
description: A product search method and system based on image restoration according to an embodiment of the present invention is a method in which a product search application executed by a computing device performs a product search based on image restoration based on deep learning, and a target product to be searched for acquiring an input image comprising; detecting at least one object including the target product through object detection in the input image; determining a target product among the detected plurality of products and acquiring a main product image representing the target product; determining whether an obstacle that is an object other than the target product is included in the main product image; when the obstacle is included, removing the obstacle from the main product image to obtain a loss image; obtaining a restored image by performing image restoration on the lost image based on the deep learning; performing a product search for searching for a product similar to the target product by inputting the recovery image; and providing a result of the product search.

title: Fundus image processing method, device, computer device and storage medium
description: A fundus image processing method includes: receiving a collected fundus image; identifying a fundus image through a first neural network to generate a first feature set of a fundus image; and identifying a fundus image through a second neural network to generate a second feature set of a fundus image The first feature set and the second feature set represent different lesion attributes of the fundus image; combining the first feature set and the second feature set to obtain a combined feature set of the fundus image; and inputting the combined feature set into the classifier to obtain Classification results.

title: Method for paging, access network device, and terminal device
description: Embodiments of the present invention provide a paging method, an access network device, and a terminal device. The method comprises the following steps: an access network device receives mobile information from a terminal device from the terminal device; the access network device determines, based on the mobile information, a target paging area in which the access network device initiates a paging to the terminal device; the access network device sends the target paging area to the terminal device. The method, access network device, and terminal device of the embodiments of the present invention assist an access network device to configure an appropriate paging area, thereby reducing signaling overhead.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR EFFICIENT EVOLUTION OF DEFRONES DEEP CONVOLUTIONAL NETWORKS USING FILTER RECOMBINATION AND PROPAGATED MUTATIONS
description: An efficient machine learning technique for driving a plurality of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) with increased speed and accuracy using a genetic evolutionary model. A plurality of artificial chromosomes may be stored that represent artificial neuron connection weights of the plurality of respective CNNs. Several pairs of chromosomes can be recombined to generate, for each pair, a new chromosome (with a different set of weights than in either chromosome of the pair) by selecting whole filters as inseparable groups of one pair. plurality of weights from each chromosome of the pair of chromosomes (eg, filter-by-filter recombination). A plurality of weights of each chromosome of the new or multiple chromosome origin can be mutated by incrementally propagating recursive error corrections throughout the CNN. A small random sampling of weights can optionally be later mutated to zero, random values or a sum of current and random values.

title: FLEXIBLE COMPUTER-BASED GAME BASED ON AUTOMATIC LEARNING
description: According to the present invention, a game modification engine modifies the configuration parameters affecting the game and the user experience in computer games after the initial game release, based on device level and practice data. associated with a user or a cohort of users and based on relationships automatically acquired between input data and a usage quantity for the game. The change is selected to improve game performance such as measured by the quantity of use. The modification can be adapted for a cohort of users. The game modification engine may automatically define the cohort based on correlations discovered in the input data with respect to a defined usage quantity.

title: SYSTEM FOR IMPROVING EXPLORATION AND TANK PRODUCTION
description: An architecture for predicting and modeling geological features of a reservoir includes one or more neural networks, a static modeling module, a dynamic modeling module, and a fuzzy inference engine for providing recommendations for to drill a well. The neural networks receive log data for coordinates along a well trajectory, and determine a geophysical relationship for a property of a subterranean formation as a function of distance vectors between coordinates along the well trajectory and one or more sets of coordinates produced randomly. The static modeling module produces three-dimensional static models of a volume of interest as a function of predicted properties of formations that are present therefrom from the neural networks. The dynamic modeling module determines connectivity values between groups of formations based on nodal connectivity of neighboring groups, assigns pressure values over the entire volume of interest, and produces a three-dimensional dynamic model for the volume of interest. interest as a function of the pressure values.

title: Histological image analysis
description: A machine learning algorithm is trained on a number of microscopic images and a measure of outcome of each image. Each image is divided into tiles. The measure of outcome is assigned to each tile of the image. The tiles are then used to train the machine learning algorithm. The trained algorithm may then be used to evaluate images.

title: Generating a user-specific user interface
description: The present disclosure generally relates to generation of a user-specific user interface. Specifically, there is provided a computer implemented method (600) for generating a user-specific user interface (612). The method (600) comprises a learning phase and an execution phase. The learning phase comprising presenting one or more pre-defined tasks to a user, the pre-defined tasks including pre-defined task features (602), capturing user interaction features while the user completes the pre-defined tasks (604), capturing a user decision input indicative of a decision by the user on the one or more pre-defined tasks (606), and creating a user-specific trust model that models the relationship between the pre-defined task features, the user interaction features and the user decision input (608). The Execution phase comprising evaluating the user-specific trust model on current task features (610) and based on evaluating the user-specific trust model on the current task features, selectively including user interface elements into the user interface to thereby generate a user-specific user interface (612).

title: Information processing apparatus, method, and program
description: The information processing apparatus acquires a plurality of training data, extracts feature data from each training data, and divides the training data using the extracted feature data into a plurality of data clusters. The information processing apparatus performs for each data cluster: extracting a feature matrix from the training data in the data cluster; and perform matrix decomposition on the feature matrix to generate a first basis matrix. The information processing apparatus performs dimensionality reduction on a concatenation of a plurality of the first basis matrices to generate a second basis matrix. The information processing apparatus performs matrix decomposition on a concatenation of a plurality of the feature matrices using the second basis matrix, thereby generating an activations matrix.

title: Recycling method and taggant for a recyclable product
description: The present invention relates to a method of uniquely identifying a product for subsequent recycling, comprising the step of: marking a surface of the product with a first trace signature being representative of the manufacturer of the product.

title: Apparatus and method for recognizing coal-rock interface based on solid-state laser radar imaging
description: Provided is an apparatus for recognizing a coal-rock interface based on solid-state laser radar imaging. The apparatus comprises a plurality of laser radar modules, a signal transmission module, a data storage module, a radar imaging module, an image fusion module and an image recognition module, wherein the plurality of laser radar modules are used for emitting radar signals to the same region of a coal-rock ore to obtain multiple sets of coal-rock ore data information of the same region of the coal-rock ore; the signal transmission module is used for transmitting the multiple sets of coal-rock ore data information to the data storage module; the data storage module is used for storing the multiple sets of coal-rock ore data information; the radar imaging module is used for imaging each set of coal-rock ore data information respectively to obtain a plurality of coal-rock texture images; the image fusion module is used for fusing the plurality of coal-rock texture images to obtain a fused coal-rock texture image; and the image recognition module is used for performing normalization processing on the fused coal-rock texture image and recognizing same to obtain a coal-rock interface recognition result. Further disclosed is a method for recognizing a coal-rock interface based on solid-state laser radar imaging.

title: Learning system, learning method, and program
description: The present invention enhances the accuracy of a learning apparatus in semi-supervised learning. Learning means (103) of a learning system (S) trains a learning apparatus that classifies symbol information contained in each of a plurality of documents, on the basis of teacher data indicating an attribute value of each of a plurality of attributes. Acquisition means (102) enters each of the plurality of documents into the learning apparatus and acquires the symbol information classified by the learning apparatus, as an attribute value candidate. Determination means (104) determines whether a symbol or a symbol string indicated by the attribute value candidate satisfies a predetermined condition. Additional learning control means (105) controls additional learning of the learning apparatus that uses the attribute value candidate, on the basis of the determination result of the determination means (104).

title: Firearm monitoring and remote support system
description: A firearm monitoring and remote support system monitors firearms and other assets within a deployment location to detect threats to users of the firearms and to perform actions in response to threats. Measurements recorded using sensors of the firearms and/or of the other assets are used to determine changes in motion, position, orientation, and/or operation of the firearms and/or of the other assets. The measurements are processed to determine the nature of a threat and particular actions to perform in response thereto. Graphical user interfaces visualizing users within deployment location are updated using the measurements to show, in real-time, positions and orientations of cones of fire for the users within the deployment location. In some cases, the cones of fire may be used to detect threats within the deployment location. In some cases, the actions to perform in response to a detected threat may be automated.

title: Program, learning model, information processing device, information processing method, information display method, and method for producing learning model
description: Provided are an information processing device and the like that assist in the work of selecting sperm for which the possibility of successful micro-insemination is high. This program causes a computer to execute a process in which a photographic image, in which an image of a candidate sperm for use in micro-insemination has been captured, is obtained, the acquired photographic image is input to a learning model (53) that receives a photographic image in which an image of a sperm has been captured and outputs a prediction related to the success or failure of micro-insemination using this sperm, and the prediction output from the learning model (53) on the basis of the input photographic image is output.

title: Image processing neural networks with dynamic filter activation
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for processing images using neural networks. One of the methods includes receiving a network input; processing the network input through a gater neural network to generate a gating vector that includes a respective value for each of a plurality of filters; determining, from the gating vector and for each of the plurality of filters, whether the filter is active or inactive; and processing the network input through the main convolutional neural network to generate an image processing output, comprising, for each convolutional layer in the first plurality of convolutional layers: receiving an input feature map for the convolutional layer; and generating an output feature map, the generating comprising: for each filter of the convolutional layer that is inactive: setting the output channel for the filter to have all zero elements.

title: Machine learning network model compression
description: A first aspect relates to a computer-implemented method for performing model compression. The method includes compressing a machine learning (ML) network model comprising a multiple layer structure to produce a compressed ML network model. The compressed ML network model maintains the multiple layer structure of the ML network model. The method generates a model file for the compressed ML network model. The model file includes the compressed ML network model and decoding information for enabling the ML network model to be decompressed and executed layer-by-layer.

title: Machine-learning model operation management system and machine-learning model operation management method
description: This machine-learning model operation management system is provided with a model construction server and an operation server. The model construction server constructs a machine-learned model on the basis of received learning data. When the machine-learned model, which is preserved in a robot controller, operates so as to determine the operation of the robot, the operation server receives operation information generated by the robot controller. Model identification information, which is for uniquely identifying the machine-learned model, is imparted to data of the machine-learned model constructed by the model construction server. The robot controller inquires to the outside whether the outside has an authority to use the machine-learned model preserved in itself, and, when the outside has the use authority, puts the machine-learned model in an available state. The operation server stores the operation information in association with the model identification information.

title: Bandwidth extension of incoming data using neural networks
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including computer programs encoded on computer storage media, for bandwidth extension. One of the methods includes obtaining a low-resolution version of an input, the low-resolution version of the input comprising a first number of samples at a first sample rate over a first time period; and generating, from the low-resolution version of the input, a high-resolution version of the input comprising a second, larger number of samples at a second, higher sample rate over the first time period. Generating the high-resolution version includes generating a representation of the low-resolution version of the input; processing the representation of the low-resolution version of the input through a conditioning neural network to generate a conditioning input; and processing the conditioning input using a generative neural network to generate the high/resolution version of the input.

title: Question generation method and apparatus, computer device, and storage medium
description: Disclosed are a question generation method, a question generation apparatus, a computer device, and a storage medium, relating to the field of human-computer interaction. The method comprises: acquiring a question sentence input by a user (S110); acquiring, according to the question sentence, a topic group in the question sentence (S120); matching the question sentence with template question sentences in a pre-created knowledge base to acquire each candidate question sentence, and calculating a matching result between each candidate question sentence and the question sentence (S130); and according to the topic group and the matching result, selecting, from the candidate question sentences, a target question sentence related to the question sentence. The question generation method not only takes the matching degree between the question sentence and the template question sentences into consideration, but also takes the topic of the question sentence into consideration, such that a related question sentence of the question sentence can be acquired rapidly, conveniently, accurately and efficiently. The question generation method is very suitable for a human-computer interaction apparatus. These related question sentences are more in tune with the actual requirements and ideas of a user.

title: Cross replica reduction on networks having degraded nodes
description: Methods, systems, and apparatus, including instructions encoded on storage media, for performing reduction of gradient vectors for a network having one or more degraded nodes. A method comprises training a respective replica of a machine learning model on each node of multiple nodes organized in an n-dimensional network topology, combining the respective individual gradient vectors in the nodes to generate a final gradient vector by performing operations comprising: designating each group of nodes along the dimension as either a forwarding group or a critical group, updating, for each receiving node, a respective individual gradient vector with an intermediate gradient vector, performing a reduction on each critical group of nodes along the dimension to generate a respective partial final gradient vector for the critical group, and updating, for each critical group of nodes, an individual gradient vector for a representative node with the respective partial final gradient vector.

title: Artificial intelligence laundry processing machine
description: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence laundry processing machine. An artificial intelligence laundry processing machine, according to an embodiment of the present invention, comprises: a casing; a washing tub within the casing; a motor for rotating the washing tub; a driving unit that drives the motor and has an output current detection unit for detecting an output current flowing through the motor; a communication unit for communicating with an external mobile terminal or a server; an input unit for generating an input signal; and a control unit for controlling the driving unit. The control unit: performs, on the basis of the output current from the output current detection unit, deep neural network-based learning; determines, according to the learning, information on the material of laundry in the washing tub; receives information on the laundry from the input unit or the communication unit; and determines, on the basis of the laundry information and the laundry material information, driving course information. Accordingly, it is possible to provide optimal driving course information corresponding to the calculated laundry material information and the inputted laundry information.

title: Musical composition analysis device, musical composition analysis method, and musical composition analysis program
description: The present invention corrects, as appropriate, the positions of bar lines detected on the basis of machine learning.　A musical composition analysis device according to the present invention comprises: a detecting part that uses a detection model learned through machine learning to detect bar lines from sound information expressing a musical composition; and a correcting part that corrects, on the basis of a reference meter identified from the musical composition, the positions of the bar lines detected by the detecting part.

title: Communications device, infrastructure equipment and methods
description: A method of transmitting data by a transmitting entity in a wireless communications network to a receiving entity, the method comprising receiving, at the transmitting entity, data for transmission via a wireless access interface of the wireless communications network, dividing the data into portions for transmission, forming from each portion of data for each of one or more protocol layers one or more protocol data units, the one or more protocol data units being formed for each layer according to a protocol applied by the layer for transmitting the protocol data unit and each of the protocol data units for each layer includes a header, and transmitting the data via the wireless access interface by processing each of the one or more protocol data units via each of the one or more protocol layers, wherein the forming from each portion of the data for each of the one or more protocol layers the one or more protocol data units comprises determining a value of one or more input parameters, determining a header format for each of the one or more protocol layers based on the value of each of the one or more input parameters, forming the one or more protocol data units for each of the one or more protocol layers in accordance with each of the determined header formats, and transmitting the one or more protocol data units for each of the one or more protocols to the receiving entity, the determining the value of the one or more input parameters and the determining the header format for the one or more protocol data units of each of the one or more protocol layers being performed dynamically for each of the portions of data to be transmitted.

title: Method and device for estimating channel in wireless communication system
description: The present disclosure relates to an operation method of a terminal and a base station in a wireless communication system, and a device supporting same. An operation method of a terminal in a wireless communication system according to an embodiment of the present disclosure can comprise the steps of: transmitting a first message comprising information relating to learning; receiving a second message comprising configuration information for the learning; transmitting an uplink reference signal; and transmitting channel information relating to a downlink channel measured on the basis of a downlink reference signal.

title: Method of determining damage to auxiliary parts of a vehicle
description: The present invention relates to the determination of damage to portions of a vehicle. More particularly, the present invention relates to determining damage to auxiliary parts of a vehicle from images of the damage to the vehicle. Aspects and/or embodiments seek to provide a computer-implemented method for determining damage to auxiliary parts of a vehicle using images of the damage to the vehicle.

title: Communication assistance system and communication assistance program
description: This system assists communication that a user performs using a terminal. The system comprises a control data generation unit that uses a trained model to generate control data for controlling an agent such that the agent moves in accordance with a communication condition, said agent being displayed on the terminal and participating in the communication. The agent is an avatar in a virtual space. The trained model is generated using training data, such that when a communication condition is inputted, control data is outputted.

title: Target detection model training method, and data labeling method and apparatus
description: Disclosed are a target detection model training method, and a data labeling method and apparatus. The target detection model training method comprises: acquiring sample data labeled with a target type and a target position of a preset object; inputting the sample data into an initial detection model to obtain a predicted position of the preset object; and comparing the target position with the predicted position, adjusting a parameter of the initial detection model according to a comparison result, and taking a detection model that enables the value of a regression portion of a loss function to reach a convergence point as a target detection model, wherein the loss function of the target detection model comprises a classification portion and the regression portion, the value of the regression portion is a weighted sum of the positions of objects, to be labeled, after being sorted according to the sizes of normalized errors, and the weight of the normalized error is the k-th power of w, where w is a hyper-parameter, and k is an order value of the normalized error after being sorted. By means of the above-mentioned solution, the amount of time used by labeling personnel to modify an auxiliary box is effectively reduced, and the labeling efficiency of continuous frame data is improved.

title: Neural network channel parameter searching method, and related apparatus
description: A neural network channel parameter searching method and a related apparatus. The neural network channel parameter searching method is based on the utilization efficiency of computing power (e.g., FLOPs), and is applicable to the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises: calculating computing power utilization efficiency of each layer of a network, increasing the number of channels in a layer having high computing power utilization efficiency, and reducing the number of channels in a layer having low computing power utilization efficiency. The process may be performed iteratively, such that a neural network having extremely high computing power utilization efficiency is ultimately obtained, thereby alleviating the problem in which existing neural network channel parameter searching methods do not sufficiently take complexity, poor utilization efficiency, and a slow search speed into consideration. Further provided is a method for calculating computing power utilization efficiency of each layer of a neural network. The method randomly discards a portion of channels with a certain ratio and measures the resulting impact on network performance, in which the discarded channels are random for different testing examples, and in this way, computing power utilization efficiency of each layer of neural networks is calculated.

title: Information processing device, information processing method, computer program, and imaging device
description: Provided is an information processing device that adjusts neural network-based image processing on the basis of a user's speech.　The information processing device is provided with: a control unit; a speech input unit for inputting a user's speech; an image processing neural network for processing an image that is input; a parameter holding unit for holding a parameter relating to the image processing neural network; and a parameter adjusting neural network for adjusting the value of the parameter on the basis of the speech. The control unit adjusts the parameter on the basis of the speech to perform image processing based on an instruction from the user via the speech.

title: Method and system for data processing
description: A method and a system (100) comprising several edge computing devices (ECD), each comprising a sensor (S); a memory (M); a Central Processing Unit, (CPU); and a digital communication interface (IF), arranged to communicate across a network (NW). Each edge computing device interpret computer code, received via said interface and stored in said memory; a syntax is arranged to define queries sent from a requesting device to a responding edge device, in terms of calculations to be performed by the responding device based on a measured value from the sensor of the responding device the results of which queries are streams of data returned to the requesting device; an interactive Graphical User Interface, (GUI) allows a user to visually view said computer code using a visual notation system; and the GUI allows said user to graphically and interactively change queries visually, whereupon the GUI as a result communicates updated computer code to concerned devices.

title: Detection device, learning device, detection method, learning method, detection program, and learning program
description: A detection device (20) comprises: an encode unit (252) that uses natural language processing techniques to convert one detection target packet into one fixed-length vector; and a detection unit (253) that uses a detection model to detect whether or not there is an abnormality in the detection target packet, on the basis of the fixed-length vector converted by the encode unit (252).

title: Electric circuit assembly comprising a ferroelectric field effect transistor, and memory cell
description: The invention relates to an electric circuit assembly comprising a ferroelectric field effect transistor, an electric energy source (2), and a resistive element (3) having a minimum electric resistance of 100 kOhm, the resistive element (3) being electrically connected to a drain terminal (D) of the ferroelectric field effect transistor, and the electric energy source (2) being electrically connected to a gate terminal (G) of the ferroelectric field effect transistor (1).

title: A system to identify malfunctioning in components of a kitchen appliance
description: A system (100) to identify malfunctioning in components of a kitchen appliance (150), comprises sensors (104) in communication with the components of the kitchen appliance (150). The sensors (104) are configured to detect change of parameters of each component of the components, a processing module (102) in communication with the sensors (104), is configured to compare the parameters with predetermined parameters, determine a condition of the component based on the comparison of parameters. The condition is selected from a malfunctioning component or a functioning component. The condition is determined as the malfunctioning if the parameters falls outside a criteria of the predetermined parameters. The condition is determined as the functioning component if the parameters falls within the criteria of the predetermined parameters.

title: Annotation-efficient image anomaly detection
description: The present invention proposes a method for detecting anomalous or out-of-distribution images in a machine learning system (1) comprising a pre-training network with a first encoder, and an anomaly detection network with a second encoder. The system is first pre-trained by training the pre-training network, and then subsequently fine-tuned by training the anomaly detection network. According to one example, during pre-training, only unlabelled training images are used, while during fine-tuning, a small fraction of labelled training images is used in addition to unlabelled training images. The method can be applied to both single and multi-domain image data.

title: Data driven approaches for performance-based project management
description: Example implementations described herein are directed to project management systems and milestone management. In example implementations, for input of a project having project data and employee data, such implementations involve executing feature extraction on the project data and the employee data to generate features; executing a self-profiling algorithm configured with unsupervised machine learning on the generated features to derive clusters and anomalies of the project; executing a performance monitoring process on the generated features to determine a probability of a transition to a milestone associated with a key performance indicator; and executing a supervised machine learning model on the generated features, the derived clusters, the derived anomalies, the probability of the transition to the milestone associated with a key performance indicator to generate a predicted performance of the project.

title: Artificial neural network retraining in memory
description: An artificial neural network can be allocated to memory and operated. Performance of the artificial neural network can be periodically evaluated. The evaluation can include inputting a representative dataset to the artificial neural network and comparing an output of the artificial neural network to a known output for the representative dataset. The artificial neural network can be retrained at least partially in response to the evaluation yielding a sub-threshold result.

title: Method and system for testing a driver assistance system for a vehicle
description: A computer-implemented method (100) for testing a driver assistance system (2) of a vehicle (1) in a simulated environment (3), having the following working steps: providing (101) a scenario model that specifies input parameters needed to define a particular scenario and their respective relationship with the other parameters of the scenario model and that specifies those input parameters that are able to be modified in order to adapt the particular scenario, and their possible parameter values; selecting (110) combinations of parameter values that each characterize a scenario on the basis of the scenario model by way of a combinatorial testing algorithm, wherein, when selecting the combinations for an input parameter under consideration, only interactions with a predefined maximum number of other input parameters are considered; creating (111) a simulated environment (3) on the basis of the selected combinations of parameter values; operating (112) a driver assistance system (2) to be tested in the simulated environment (3) in accordance with the respective scenario; and acquiring (113) a driving behaviour of the at least one driver assistance system (2) to be tested in the simulated environment (3).

title: Temporally amortized supersampling using a kernel splatting network
description: ﻿One embodiment provides a graphics processor comprising a set of processing resources configured to perform a supersampling anti-aliasing operation via a mixed precision convolutional neural network. The set of processing resources include circuitry configured to receive, at an input block of a neural network model, a set of data including previous frame data, current frame data, jitter offset data, and velocity data, pre-process the set of data to generate pre-processed data, provide pre-processed data to a feature extraction network of the neural network model and an output block of the neural network model, process the first pre-processed data at the feature extraction network via one or more encoder stages and one or more decoder stages, output tensor data from the feature extraction network to the output block, and generate an anti-aliased output frame via the output block based on the current frame data and the tensor data output from the feature extraction network.

title: Person re-identification method and apparatus based on local feature attention
description: Disclosed in the present invention are a person re-identification method and apparatus based on local feature attention. The method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring an original monitoring video image data set, and proportionally dividing the original monitoring video image data set into a training set and a test set; and S2, performing image enhancement on the original monitoring video image training set, so as to obtain an enhanced image, and then converting the enhanced image into sequence data. By means of person re-identification technology based on local feature attention, a video image feature sequence is captured and extracted using a multi-head attention mechanism neural network, a convolution kernel in a convolutional neural network is replaced with a multi-head attention mechanism, a fully connected layer and an activation function are used to combine local person feature sequences into a complete person feature sequence by means of a weight matrix, the obtained person feature sequence is predicted so as to output the position coordinates of a person in an image, and the person is box-selected, thereby realizing person re-identification.

title: Data screening method and apparatus, device, and storage medium
description: The present disclosure relates to the technical field of computers, in particular, to the technical fields of artificial intelligence, big data, deep learning, and data backflow, and provides a data screening method and apparatus, a device, and a storage medium. The specific implementation scheme comprises: acquiring service data; and screening the service data on the basis of the influence degree of the service data on a model to obtain data for updating the model, wherein the degree of influence reflects the influence on the model updating performance. The service data is screened, and the retraining of all the service data is avoided to update the model, so that the data volume for model updating can be reduced.

title: Transformer based neural network using variable auxiliary input
description: The present disclosure relates to transformer based neural networks. It is provided a method of processing a current object, comprising the steps of: inputting a set of input data tensors representing the current object into a neural layer of a transformer based neural network, inputting at least one auxiliary data tensor into a neural layer of the transformer based neural network, wherein the at least one auxiliary data tensor is different from each of the input data tensors of the set of input data tensors and represents at least one auxiliary input and processing the set of input data tensors by the transformer based neural network using the at least one auxiliary data tensor in order to obtain a set of output data tensors. The input at least one auxiliary data tensor depends on information about processing the current object.

title: Nonlinear associative memory using a linear array of associative memory cells and method of operation thereof
description: The associative memory includes an associative memory cell. Each cell includes a sensor input unit, a previous stage associative display unit, a next stage associative display unit, and an associative output unit. These cells are interconnected in series to form a linear array, and the sensor input, the previous associative display, and the next associative display of the cells connected in series have an association affinity between a series of sensor inputs. Based on the order from the distal cell to the proximal cell. Each cell also has processing logic.
