description: The invention discloses a heterogeneous image registration method and device based on phase correlation calculation, extracting the first feature map S1 of the template image and the second feature map S2 of the reference image respectively; determining channel information KP1 according to S1; determining according to S2 Channel information KP2; generate phase correlation map RS according to KP1 and KP2; determine the rotation parameter r and scale parameter s between the template image and the reference image according to RS; the remaining channel information based on r, s, S1 and the remaining channel information of L1 and S2 L2 calculates the translation parameters (x, y) between the template image and the reference image; the present invention can calculate the template image and the reference image at one time by extracting the feature maps of the template image and the reference image, and then processing the feature maps in different channels The rotation parameters, scale parameters and translation parameters reduce the amount of calculation and the redundancy of calculation. It is applicable to devices with small video memory space, reduces the requirements for device performance, and improves real-time performance.

title: A meter reading method, device and robot
description: The present invention provides a meter reading method, device and robot. The method includes: acquiring an image to be processed; using an ORB feature recognition algorithm to match the image to be processed with a meter template image, and determining the image to be processed to the The affine matrix of the instrument template image; according to the affine matrix, the instrument template image is inversely transformed, the area of the target instrument in the image to be processed is determined, and the target instrument subgraph is generated; obtained by using reinforcement learning algorithm training The first agent of the method determines a reading display area from the sub-image of the target instrument; digitally identifies the reading display area, and determines the reading of the target instrument in the image to be processed. The invention improves the speed and accuracy of meter reading.

title: Code complement method combining user feedback and deep learning
description: The invention belongs to the field of intelligent software development, and discloses a code completion method combining user feedback and deep learning. The steps are as follows: use the code completion model CodeGRU to generate an initial recommendation list; use the deep neural network model LSTM trained in real time through the historical data in the feedback library to generate another recommendation list; merge the two lists in descending order according to the probability of the model output ;The code segment to be completed and the recommended items in the merged list are spliced and input into the pre-trained model Bert, which is fine-tuned in real time with the historical data in the feedback library; the merged list is reordered through the classification results output by the model and returned to Users, implement code completion, and record the user's choice in the feedback library. From the perspective of user feedback, the present invention effectively integrates user feedback information into the code completion task through deep learning models LSTM and Bert, thereby constructing a more accurate code completion system.

title: Multi-granularity line loss prediction method, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a multi-time granularity line loss prediction method, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the line loss prediction method comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring environmental data of an area where a line is located in real time; step 2, processing the data in the step 1 by adopting an MIC association degree analysis method to obtain a data feature set M; step 3: respectively constructing an optimal input characteristic set of a short-time granularity and long-time granularity line loss prediction model according to the analysis result of the step 2; step 4: according to the optimal model input feature set, the line loss prediction model is combined to predict the line loss under different scales for a long time and a short time, and the line loss is continuously corrected in a rolling way, so that the accurate prediction of the line loss is realized. The invention can meet the requirement of accurately predicting the long-term and short-term line loss values according to the line loss prediction methods with different time granularities, and avoid the singleness and uncertainty of the line loss prediction.

title: Image denoising method, image denoising device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to an image denoising method, device, computer equipment and storage medium, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. The method includes: acquiring an image to be denoised, performing denoising processing on the image to be denoised based on an image denoising model, and obtaining a clear target image corresponding to the image to be denoised, wherein the image denoising model is based on a sample noise image, a sample noise The sample clear image corresponding to the image and the output image obtained by denoising the sample noise image by the initial model are obtained by training the initial model. The method can improve the accuracy of image denoising results under the premise of shortening the time cost and calculation burden.

title: System for acquiring electrocardio ST segment information through shooting electrocardiogram
description: The invention discloses a system for obtaining ECG ST segment information by photographing an ECG, including an ECG image reading module, an ST segment abnormality diagnosis module, and an Android mobile phone APP function module; the ECG image reading module uses a YOLOv5 target detection model to take pictures from a mobile phone Quickly locate and extract the ECG region in the ECG report, and obtain an ECG image without redundant information; ST segment abnormality diagnosis module uses convolutional neural network and ST segment intelligent diagnosis algorithm to determine whether ST segment is depressed or elevated; Android mobile APP The functional module has an image selection module and a result feedback module. The image selection module selects pictures through the mobile phone camera or the built-in photo album of the mobile phone to help users upload standard 12-lead electrocardiogram report images to the platform; the result feedback module outputs ST segment diagnosis results; the present invention can According to the standard 12-lead ECG report uploaded by the user, it can judge whether there is any abnormality in the ST segment, and effectively assist the patient to comprehensively consider the next intelligent analysis and medical measures.

title: Q&A interactive data processing method and server applied to AI chat robot
description: The invention relates to the technical field of AI dialogue and big data, and provides a question-answer interaction data processing method and a server applied to an AI chat robot. Thus, the hard question-answering processing mechanism of the chat robot in the prior art can be improved.

title: A method and system for processing customer data on an e-commerce platform based on traffic analysis
description: The present invention provides a method and system for processing customer data of an e-commerce platform based on traffic analysis, which belongs to the technical field of data processing, and specifically includes: when the access frequency of the customer data of the e-commerce platform at the latest first preset time is greater than the set frequency , based on the access frequency at the first preset time, the IP address of the access user, the type of data obtained by the access user, and the data flow per unit time of the access user, the access risk value is obtained by using the evaluation model based on the machine learning algorithm, and when the access When the risk value is less than the first threshold, the frequency of customer data is obtained based on the access frequency of customer data at the first preset time, the cumulative access time at the second preset time, and the time difference between the latest access time and the current time Evaluation value, and based on the frequency evaluation value, customer data is stored in online or near-line storage, thereby further improving the security of customer data and the efficiency of access.

title: Power distribution network line standing book checking method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle visual perception
description: The invention discloses a method and system for checking the account of distribution network lines based on the visual perception of drones. The method of the invention includes acquiring multiple images taken by the drone for each base tower and identifying the image of the target equipment of the account , based on multiple ledger target device images of the same base tower, the average value of the real geographic location space coordinates of the ledger target device is calculated; If the distance exceeds the preset threshold, it is judged that the check fails, otherwise it is judged that the check is passed. The invention is low in cost and quick in effect. By intelligently analyzing the visible light images taken by the drone, the automatic verification of the longitude and latitude data of the ledger equipment of the distribution network can be realized, which helps the power grid company to improve the management ability of the ledger equipment , and reduce the labor intensity of operators, and improve the efficiency of distribution network line ledger checking and the level of automation and intelligence.

title: Capacity configuration method of wind-solar energy storage system containing gravity energy storage
description: A capacity configuration method for a wind-solar-storage system including gravity energy storage, the steps are: collect historical data sets including historical wind speed, temperature and solar irradiance in a certain area, establish a renewable energy output model, and calculate a certain time Renewable energy output data in this area; according to the predicted renewable energy output data in this area, the minimum annual comprehensive cost of the system is used as the objective function and the load power shortage rate is used as the evaluation index, and the stable operation and performance indicators of the system are used as constraints. The operation control strategy of the hybrid energy storage system is determined, and the mathematical model of the capacity allocation of the wind-solar-storage system is established; the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the mathematical model of the capacity allocation of the wind-solar-storage system, and the optimal configuration method of the capacity of the wind-solar-storage system is obtained. The invention considers that the wind-solar-storage system has the best economy, by simulating the wind-solar-storage joint operation model and combining with the optimization model, a more reliable system capacity allocation scheme is obtained.

title: A back-translation data construction and training method based on domain classification
description: A reverse translation data construction and training method based on domain classification relates to the fields of natural language processing, machine translation and data enhancement, and is used for training bilingual models based on primitive materials, wherein a Transformer neural network model is used for training two neural machine translation models by taking bilingual primitive materials as a source end-target end and a target end-source end respectively, 2) a domain monolingual dataset is constructed based on keywords and topic similarity, 3) a domain pseudo-parallel dataset is generated based on reverse translation, the acquired domain monolingual dataset is used as a source end dataset, the trained bilingual model is used for carrying out reverse translation to obtain pseudo sentence pairs, the domain pseudo-parallel dataset is formed after finishing alignment, and 4) the domain classification learning-based combined training is carried out by marking the pseudo-parallel dataset as domain corpus and general data. The method can effectively utilize the knowledge in the general field while acquiring the knowledge in the related field with high quality, improve the translation performance and ensure the translation quality.

title: Automatic segmentation method for fundus image of sugar net disease based on deep learning
description: A sugar net disease fundus image automatic segmentation method based on deep learning comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of S1, adjusting the size of a diabetic retinopathy fundus image to 512 x 512, S2, starting image preprocessing, S3, transmitting the preprocessed image into a network model for node feature initialization, S4 feature transmission and fusion, S5, transmitting features to an upper node by each node, segmenting a vascular structure in the image by a deconvolution/interpolation/anti-pooling method, recovering resolution to the same size as the original input image when the last node in the first layer completes feature fusion, and outputting a vascular structure segmentation gray map by single-layer convolution after the segmentation of the vascular structure is finished; the automatic segmentation fundus blood vessel structure is provided for a medical auxiliary system, and the problems of incomplete segmentation caused by slow reading, vague tail end of blood vessel and easy loss of new tiny blood vessel are solved. The invention has the advantages of realizing the automatic extraction of the fundus blood vessel, less calculation consumption resources and high segmentation accuracy.

title: Flow cytometry cell classification method, system and terminal based on machine learning
description: In the machine learning-based flow cytometry cell classification method, system and terminal of the present invention, the corresponding corrected training samples are obtained by calculating the normalized feature and the intra-sample density feature of each cell feature of each training sample, and then Correct the sample to be tested and each corrected training sample to remove the batch effect to obtain a plurality of final training samples, use each final training sample to train the machine learning model to obtain a cell classification model, and finally use the trained model for the prediction of the sample to be tested, Get cell classification results for each cell in the sample. The present invention alleviates the distribution difference between the new sample to be predicted and the training sample by introducing sample correction and removing batch effects, thereby greatly improving the accuracy of cell classification.

title: An intelligent unmanned system and method based on digital twins
description: The invention provides an intelligent unmanned system and method based on digital twins. The system is deployed on target unmanned equipment and includes: an interaction layer, used to obtain physical state data; a digital twin layer, including a physical twin model and an intelligent twin. model; a physical twin model is used to model the target unmanned equipment according to the physical state data to obtain a physical twin; an intelligent twin model is used to obtain a physical twin based on the physical twin and multiple action strategies Multiple digital intelligence twins; simulation layer, including environment simulation module, evaluation module and matching module; environment simulation module, used to simulate the operating environment of unmanned equipment; matching module, used to match the operating environment of unmanned equipment to each data respectively The smart twin is used to obtain multiple comprehensive twins; the evaluation module is used to evaluate multiple comprehensive twins to obtain the optimal twin, and based on the optimal twin, the optimal control strategy is obtained.

title: Physical point aggregation method, physical point aggregation device and electronic equipment
description: The present application provides a physical point aggregation method, a physical point aggregation device, and electronic equipment. The physical point aggregation method relates to the technical field of physical point aggregation in the field of maps. The method includes: performing physical point identification on the first image sequence to be identified , to obtain the second image sequence formed by the image of the target physical point in the first image sequence; for each image in the second image sequence, the distance between the target physical point and the acquisition position of each image Predict the distance between each image to obtain the depth value of the target physical point in each image; based on the depth value of the target physical point in each image and the acquisition position of each image, determine whether the first The target physical points in the two image sequences are aggregated into the same physical point. The physical point aggregation method avoids the aggregation of physical points directly based on the image recognition of the deep learning classification network, and can improve the accuracy of physical point aggregation.

title: Detecting and processing driving event sounds during a navigation session
description: To identify driving event sounds during navigation, a client device in a vehicle provides a set of navigation directions for traveling along a route from a starting location to a destination location. During navigation to the destination location, the client device identifies audio that includes driving event sounds from within or surrounding areas of the vehicle. In response to determining that the audio includes a driving event sound, the client device determines whether the driving event sound is false. In response to determining that the driving event sound is false, the client device presents a notification to the driver indicating that the driving event sound is false, or masks the driving event sound to prevent the driver from hearing the driving event sound.

title: Spacecraft lithium battery health state estimation method based on physical information neural network
description: The invention provides a method for estimating the state of health of a spacecraft lithium battery based on a physical information neural network. The relationship between the voltage and the state of charge of the battery is represented by a multi-layer perceptron; the open circuit voltage and the state of charge of the battery in the collected sample data are used to train the multi-layer perceptron; the multi-layer perceptron As the data-driven layer of the physical neural network model, the physical information neural network model is designed; the physical neural network model is trained by using the discharge curve in the collected sample data, and the battery health status is estimated by using the trained neural network model. The invention does not require additional tests, and on the basis of using limited data to establish a physical information neural network model, it can accurately realize the online estimation of the health state and ensure the stable operation of the spacecraft.

title: Same-city ticket face picture generation platform convenient to operate
description: The present invention relates to the technical field, and is specifically an easy-to-operate same-city coupon picture generation platform, including a picture generation module, an information acquisition module, a font adjustment module, a content writing module, a content optimization module, and a picture generation module. Dependence, no need for physical online banking, support for any time period to generate the required pictures, no time limit, support for editing of any bill information, no non-editable restrictions, the invention has low requirements for operators, and colleagues who do not know how to change page elements It is very friendly, you only need to enter the content you need in the provided key information input box to generate the corresponding picture, the invention is efficient, can generate multiple same bills at the same time, the ticket number is not repeated, the invention supports multiple people to use, Not subject to the restriction that only one person can operate online banking.

title: Image processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present invention provide an image processing method, device, device, and storage medium. The method includes: acquiring multiple images containing a target object, and performing registration processing on the multiple images to obtain multiple registered images. According to the first template image corresponding to the target reference object, the target object in the plurality of registration images is segmented to obtain a plurality of segmented images, and the segmented images include a plurality of segmented regions. Feature extraction is performed on each segmented area in the plurality of segmented images to obtain a plurality of image features corresponding to each segmented area in the plurality of segmented images. A plurality of image features corresponding to the same segmented region in the plurality of segmented images are fused to obtain a plurality of fused image features corresponding to each segmented region. According to multiple fused image features, the recognition result corresponding to the target object is determined, thereby improving the quality and effect of image processing.

title: A portable psychological companion robot system and emotional support method
description: The invention discloses a portable psychological accompanying robot system and an emotion supporting method. The system comprises a portable hardware system and a mobile phone APP software system, wherein the portable hardware system comprises a doll pendant and a mobile phone, the collection and transmission work of emotion information are completed, and the APP software system on the mobile phone comprises a front-end application program and a background server and is used for completing the processing of emotion information and emotion supporting work. Be provided with on the doll pendant and awaken up module, first information acquisition module, system control module, emotion pacifying support module and data transmission module, front end application includes individuation module, second information acquisition module, transmission module and pacifying module, background server has carried expression recognition model, pronunciation emotion recognition model, bimodulus emotion recognition model and emotion trend dialogue generation model, can both effectively discern user's emotion type under expression, pronunciation or the combination condition of both, pacifies the user.

title: A prediction method for coal, rock and gas composite dynamic disasters based on deep learning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine safety mining, in particular to a method for predicting coal, rock and gas composite dynamic disasters based on deep learning. Firstly, prepare the impact index data of the coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster, and use the box plot analysis method Boxplot and the chain equation multiple interpolation method MICE to clean the data; secondly, use the gray correlation analysis method GRA to analyze the data, and establish the coal-rock gas composite dynamic disaster prediction index system; thirdly, use the convolutional neural network (CNN) to build the model, and use the sparrow search algorithm SSA to optimize the hyperparameters of the model to improve the prediction accuracy; The test set is used to make predictions, and the prediction results are compared with the actual results to determine the prediction accuracy of the model. The prediction model of the invention has short training time, good generalization and strong robustness, and can quickly and accurately predict coal, rock and gas composite dynamic disasters.

title: CT image ring artifact suppression method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present invention provides a CT image ring artifact suppression method, device, equipment and storage medium, by obtaining an initial CT image, and making a data set according to the initial CT image; constructing a RAS_UNet network model, and designing a loss function for the RAS_UNet network model; then inputting the data set of the initial CT image into the RAS_UNet network model, the RAS_UNet network model can suppress the artifact in the initial CT, and output the first CT image and the second CT image after the artifact suppression processing, to realize the removal of the ring artifact, and finally the first CT image and Effective information in the second CT image is fused to output a fused final CT image, the details and structure of the fused final CT image can be effectively restored, and the signal-to-noise ratio can be significantly improved.

title: Computing accelerator, processing method and related equipment
description: An operation accelerator (10), a processing method, and related equipment, comprising: a first memory (102), used to store an input data set; a matrix converter (101), used to perform the following actions: read from the input data set M row vectors are generated to generate a first instruction; the M row vectors and the first instruction are sent to a second memory (103); the second memory (103), according to the first instruction to the M row vectors are preprocessed to obtain n row vectors, and store the n row vectors; the n row vectors include the M row vectors and (n-M) filled row vectors; wherein, the The n row vectors are N row vectors of the target matrix, and the storage order of the n row vectors in the second memory (103) is consistent with the order of the N row vectors in the target matrix. The efficiency of convolution operation can be improved by using the above operation accelerator (10), processing method and related equipment.

title: Method and system for realizing layout planning of rectangular macro-cells based on reinforcement learning
description: A layout planning method for rectangular macro cells based on reinforcement learning, including: sorting macro cell and standard cell information according to the public data set ispd2005; using GCN to encode the macro cells; sorting the macro cells according to area from large to small, and sorting the macro cells. Well-sequenced macrocell information and macrocell coding are used as the input of the bilinear model to extract environmental features; the mask matrix is calculated based on the size of the macrocell to determine the range in which the current macrocell can be placed; the environmental features are used as the input of the reinforcement learning strategy network, The policy network outputs the probability of placing the macro unit; the location of the macro unit is determined based on the output of the policy network and the mask matrix; the reward function is set as the weighted sum of the total line length, congestion level and layout density. It also includes a layout planning system that implements rectangular macro cells based on reinforcement learning. The present invention provides a solution for using reinforcement learning to solve the layout planning problem of rectangular macro cells of different sizes under the condition that the macro cells are disjoint with each other.

title: Fake image detection method, fake image detection device, fake image detection equipment and medium
description: The application belongs to the technical field of image processing, and can be used for detecting fake face images in the financial field, in particular to a fake image detection method, device, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: inputting a training image into a fake face detection model to be trained, comparing a real face image with a fake face image, and determining falsified pixels of the fake face image; dividing the fake face image based on the tampered pixels to obtain a real pixel area and a fake pixel area; and training the attention of the fake face detection model to be trained on the fake pixel region by taking the real pixel region as a standard sample until parameters in the fake face detection model to be trained are converged, so as to obtain the fake face detection model. According to the application, the real pixel area is taken as a standard sample, and the attention of the model to the fake pixel area is trained, so that a fake face detection model capable of accurately capturing tampered pixels is obtained, and the optimization of the technology for detecting fake face images is realized.

title: Industrial image restoration and feature learning method based on attention mechanism
description: The invention discloses an industrial image restoration and feature learning method based on an attention mechanism, and particularly relates to the technical field of computer vision and industrial image restoration. The invention comprises an integral network structure, wherein the integral network structure is based on a Swin-transform framework, and the integral network structure comprises a shallow feature extraction module, a UNet feature extraction module, a reconstruction module, a Loss calculation module and a feature learning module. According to the industrial image restoration and feature learning method based on the attention mechanism, the Swin-transform block is used as a basic module, and then the whole is stacked in a UNet architecture form, namely Swin-TransformerUNet (STUnet), so that high-dimensional image features with high efficiency and robustness are learned, and the image information restoration is effectively realized. Thanks to the network design, the STUNet and the training process can learn high-quality robust features, and have strong universality. This feature can be used directly for subsequent downstream quality inspection tasks such as classification, measurement, positioning, etc. common industrial quality inspection vision tasks.

title: A medical hyperspectral image classification method based on fast fully convolutional network
description: The invention discloses a medical hyperspectral image classification method based on a rapid full convolution network, which belongs to the technical field of medical hyperspectral images and comprises the following steps: preprocessing and sampling the medical hyperspectral image to obtain a training sample set; inputting the training sample set into a full convolution network based on an encoder-decoder to finish training the medical hyperspectral image; and inputting the pixels to be classified in the medical hyperspectral image into a trained full convolution network based on the encoder-decoder to obtain a classification result. The invention provides a medical hyperspectral image classification method based on a rapid full-convolution network, which aims at the problems of low efficiency, insufficient performance and the like of the existing classification method of medical hyperspectral images, avoids redundant calculation of overlapping areas among image blocks, and greatly improves reasoning speed.

title: Random forest-UKF lithium battery SOC estimation method, device and system based on cloud edge cooperation
description: The invention discloses a random forest-UKF lithium battery SOC estimation method, device and system based on cloud-edge collaboration. Among them, the SOC estimation method is the fusion method of random forest and unscented Kalman filter (Random Forest-Unscented Kalman Filter, RF-UKF), which uses the random forest model as the observation equation of UKF, and uses the powerful nonlinear fitting of random forest Ability, combined with UKF, reduces the influence of noise errors or other uncertain factors, and obtains more accurate SOC estimation results. Random forest model training requires large computing resources, so it is completed on the cloud server; at the same time, the UKF filtering algorithm is calculated on the edge side to reduce cloud-side data transmission. In this way, the system is based on the cloud-side collaboration technology, which not only utilizes the powerful computing power of the cloud server, but also ensures the system response speed.

title: Training method for characterization extraction model, characterization extraction method and related products
description: Embodiments of the present application provide a training method for a representation extraction model, a representation extraction method, and related products, which relate to the field of computer technology, wherein the training method for a representation extraction model includes: inputting samples into the representation extraction model, and obtaining the representation Extracting the first characterization vector of the sample output by the model; splitting the first characterization vector into a plurality of sub-characterization vectors; connecting each sub-characterization vector in the plurality of sub-characterization vectors to an output to obtain a plurality of second characterization vectors A representation vector; based on a preset loss function, determine a first entropy loss according to the plurality of second representation vectors, determine a first distribution divergence according to the plurality of sub-representation vectors, and use the first distribution divergence as the second A negative correlation penalty of entropy loss, determining a first loss value corresponding to the sample; according to the first loss value, training parameters of the representation extraction model to obtain a trained representation extraction model.

title: Improved DETR river surface drift detection method and device and related components
description: The invention discloses a method, device and related components for detecting floating objects on the river surface based on the improved DETR. The invention uses the improved DETR algorithm to detect the floating objects on the river surface, and uses the attention mechanism of the Transformer to focus on extracting the floating objects on the river surface during the encoding part. features, reducing the occurrence of background interference and misidentification such as river reflections, and improving detection accuracy; and this embodiment uses the DETR model, so it does not require prior knowledge and constraints such as non-maximum suppression post-processing and anchors. Therefore, end-to-end target detection can be realized, and the detection of floating objects such as river garbage, fallen leaves and foam can be completed.

title: Systems and methods for quantum caching
description: The invention relates to a system and a method for quantum caching. The entangled quantum cache includes a quantum store that receives a plurality of quantum states and is configured to store and sort the plurality of quantum states and provide selected ones of the stored and sorted plurality of quantum states to a quantum data output at a first desired time. The fidelity system is configured to determine the fidelity of at least some of the plurality of quantum states. A classical store is coupled to the fidelity system and configured to store classical data comprising the determined fidelity information and an index associating particular ones of the classical data with particular ones of the plurality of quantum states, and to supply at least some of the classical data to the classical data output at a second desired time. The processor is connected to the classical repository and determines a first time based on the index.

title: Photovoltaic power generation power prediction method and prediction system
description: The invention provides a photovoltaic power generation power prediction method, which belongs to the technical field of electric energy. It includes the following steps: obtaining the original meteorological data and photovoltaic output data of the photovoltaic power station; calculating the mean value, standard deviation, skewness coefficient and kurtosis of the historical power data in the original meteorological data and photovoltaic output data of the photovoltaic power station as an improved K-means For the input factor of the algorithm, the improved K-means algorithm is used to perform cluster analysis on the input factor, and the correlation between meteorological data and power generation in different cluster categories is calculated; the meteorological data with a correlation with power generation greater than 0.6 is used as the prediction model Input factors into the Attention-LSTM model, train the model to obtain optimal parameters, and output the final prediction results. Based on the improved K-means clustering and Attention-LSTM network model, the accuracy of photovoltaic power prediction can be well improved, which has engineering application value.

title: Visual question-answering method for constructing answer semantic space based on knowledge graph
description: The invention discloses a visual question-answering method based on participation of a knowledge graph in constructing an answer semantic space. When the answer semantic space is constructed, the method not only embeds external knowledge into answer features, but also reduces language deviation of the model through semantic loss of design, and remarkably improves generalization capability of the model. The technology can be applied to various different visual question-answering methods and has great commercial value.

title: Intelligent reinforcement detection method and system based on convolutional neural network and binocular vision
description: The invention discloses an intelligent reinforcement detection method and system based on a convolutional neural network and binocular vision. The method comprises the steps of S1, collecting RGB images and depth image data of the steel bars by using a depth camera, S2, inputting the RGB images of the steel bars into a convolutional neural network for steel bar recognition, obtaining a prediction boundary frame and a mask of the steel bars, and S3, carrying out reinforcement detection by using a binocular vision technology based on the steel bar recognition result, and outputting a visualized steel bar quality acceptance result. The convolutional neural network is used for identifying the reinforcing steel bars, improves the accuracy of detecting and segmenting the target of the reinforcing steel bars, combines a binocular vision technology, enables intelligent reinforcing steel bar detection to have real-time performance, outputs a visual result, assists workers in quality inspection and acceptance in reinforcing steel bar hiding engineering, greatly improves work efficiency and reduces labor cost.

title: Pseudo-pure state preparation method, nuclear magnetic resonance quantum computer and calculation method thereof
description: The invention discloses a preparation method of a pseudopure state, a nuclear magnetic resonance quantum computer and a calculation method thereof. The preparation method of the pseudopure state includes: transmitting a first radio frequency pulse to the sample, and the first radio frequency pulse is used to perform a first unitary operation on the thermal equilibrium state of the sample to obtain a first transition state with a first density matrix, the first density matrix The sub-diagonal elements in are the same as each other, and non-zero entries appear in the non-diagonal elements of the first density matrix; stop transmitting the first radio frequency pulse to the sample, and maintain the time to stop transmitting the radio frequency pulse to the sample for the first preset time time to obtain a pseudopure state of the sample. This method uses the relaxation process of the sample itself to prepare a pseudopure state without using a gradient field, effectively reducing the difficulty of preparing a pseudopure state.

title: Text emotion classification method and system
description: The application discloses a text emotion classification method and a system, wherein the text emotion classification method comprises the following steps: acquiring a text to be subjected to emotion classification; based on the acquired text to be subjected to emotion classification, performing text emotion classification by utilizing a pre-trained emotion classification model, and acquiring an emotion classification result; wherein the emotion classification model comprises: the feature extractor is used for inputting the text, extracting the features and outputting feature vectors; and the linear classifier is used for inputting the feature vector output by the feature extractor, classifying the feature vector and outputting an emotion classification result. In the text emotion classification method disclosed by the application, a new model training method is provided, so that the overall performance of a model can be improved, and the text emotion classification can be performed on the basis of the trained emotion classification model with higher accuracy.

title: Multi-mode rail transit emergency collaborative decision-making method and device based on fuzzy reasoning
description: The invention relates to the technical field of rail transit, and in particular to a multi-mode rail transit emergency collaborative decision-making method and device based on fuzzy reasoning. By analyzing the characteristics of multi-system collaborative emergency response, the present invention conducts in-depth analysis and quantitative calculation of the factors affecting multi-system operation due to faults. The emergency decision-making model constructed using fuzzy logic reasoning method can quantify the impact of a fault and quickly generate hierarchical emergency response strategies based on the specific conditions of the fault. Its fuzzy rules and fault impact calculation formulas are jointly formulated by on-site experts and scholars. The resulting emergency response strategy is closer to the actual situation, has higher credibility, and helps managers handle emergency events efficiently.

title: Face forgery image identification method, system, equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses a face forgery image identification method, system, equipment and storage medium. They are one-to-one corresponding solutions. In the solution: extract the identity representation of the image to be detected and the reference image, and extract the image to be detected and the reference image. The corresponding feature map uses the identity representation of the reference image to generate a learnable spatial filter operator with a priori of the person's identity, and combines the two feature maps to obtain the corresponding spatial activation map. Finally, the corresponding identity correction representation is obtained, and the image to be detected is The two types of identity representations corresponding to the reference image are fused, and then based on the similarity of the two fused features, the authenticity of the image to be detected is identified. The above scheme can adaptively mine discriminative local areas in forged faces, has high flexibility and strong generalization, and can perform bias correction. It does not require the assistance of any hand-designed features or three-dimensional face information, and is simple and easy to use. OK, overall, high-precision face forgery identification can be achieved.

title: Model training method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present application disclose a model training method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method includes: obtaining a training sample set of the current training batch; using a pre-trained language model to conduct at least one data analysis on the first training sample in the training sample set. Enhancement processing is performed to obtain the first enhanced data, and a positive sample pair is constructed using the first enhanced data and the first sample data corresponding to the first training sample; based on the first sample data and multiple negative sample data in the negative sample set, Construct multiple sets of negative sample pairs; wherein the negative sample set at least includes historical data, second sample data in addition to the first sample data, and/or second enhanced data; use positive sample pairs and multiple sets of negative sample pairs to pretrain the language The model is updated with parameters. In this way, a method is proposed to expand the negative samples without changing the batch size, so that the number of negative samples is no longer limited by the size of the video memory, so that the trained model can achieve better self-supervised learning of language representation.

title: A personnel early warning method and system based on Apriori algorithm
description: The invention discloses a personnel early warning method based on the Apriori algorithm, which belongs to the field of big data processing and data mining. The method includes: obtaining a historical data set; the historical data set includes several historical personnel information; performing feature extraction on the historical personnel information, Obtain the historical characteristics of historical personnel information; mine the historical characteristics of historical personnel information according to the Apriori algorithm to obtain frequent item sets; generate association rules based on frequent item sets; obtain the personnel information to be predicted; and obtain the personnel information to be predicted based on the personnel prediction model Make predictions and get prediction results. This invention provides timely early warning and control of personnel situations through the deep integration of business technology and machine learning algorithms, thereby realizing modern rectification of urban public security management.

title: System and method for improving robustness of a pre-training system with randomization and sample rejection
description: Systems and methods for improving the robustness of pre-trained systems using randomization and sample rejection. One system includes a machine learning network. The network includes an input interface configured to receive input data from the sensor. The processor is programmed to receive input data, utilize the input data to generate a perturbed input data set, wherein the perturbed input data set includes a perturbation of the input data, and denoise the perturbed input data set using a denoiser, wherein the denoiser is configured to generate denoising the data set, sending the denoising data set to both a pretrained classifier and a rejector, where the pretrained classifier is configured to classify the denoised data set and the rejector is configured to reject the denoised data classification of the set, training a rejector using the denoised input data set to achieve a trained rejector, and in response to obtaining the trained rejector, outputting a discard classification associated with the input data, where the discard classification is ignored for classification .

title: A real-time multi-modal perception high-precision map construction method
description: A real-time multi-modal perception high-precision map construction method, involving the field of electronic map technology, including: data collection, including camera image data, lidar point cloud data and GPS data; data preprocessing; synchronization and registration, preprocessing The processed data is subjected to time synchronization operations and spatial registration operations; feature extraction, LiDAR point cloud data feature extraction is performed on camera image data and 3D-CNN, and GPS trajectory data is used to calculate the target position or path; data fusion, including camera images Feature-level fusion of data, lidar point cloud data, and decision-level fusion of camera image data, lidar point cloud data, and GPS data; model training; evaluation and optimization; analyzing the fused data through deep learning segmentation models to obtain high-quality Precise map, the method of the present invention adopts multi-modal perception, which can improve the accuracy and completeness of the map, can better cope with various complex driving conditions, and can improve the robustness of the system.

title: Crack acoustic emission signal recognition method based on improved weakly supervised multi-feature fusion
description: The invention discloses a crack acoustic emission signal identification method based on improved weak supervision multi-feature fusion. The method includes the following steps: 1: Load acoustic emission signals obtained from rails with different cracks, and extract from these acoustic emission signals 25-dimensional features are clustered according to the K‑means algorithm, and features are screened according to the clustering accuracy to obtain a feature set that can effectively distinguish different crack information; 2: Input the feature set into the SCNN‑LSTM deep learning model. Combined with weakly supervised learning labels, multi-feature fusion is performed to obtain the rail health index; third: Based on the characteristics of the rail health index, an adaptive rail crack identification threshold is constructed to accurately identify the acoustic emission signals from four sections of rails with different cracks, and complete the rail crack Acoustic emission signal identification. The invention has fast calculation speed and high identification accuracy, and has high social significance and economic value in the field of crack damage identification of high-speed rail rails.

title: A very short-term prediction method and system for ship motion based on TFT model
description: The invention belongs to the technical field of ships and ocean engineering, and discloses a ship motion extremely short-term forecasting method and system based on a TFT model. The method is based on ship motion data recorded by a ship inertial navigation system under multiple working conditions, and a ship motion power spectrum obtained through fast Fourier transformation is used for extracting spectral characteristic parameters; taking the ship navigational speed, wave direction angle, sense wave height of the sea wave environment and characteristic period under each working condition as time-invariant characteristics, and taking six-degree-of-freedom motion time calendar, speed, acceleration data, wind field information and spectral characteristic parameters of the ship as time-variant characteristics; the method comprises the steps of taking time-invariant features and time-varying feature sequences as input, taking a target ship freedom degree motion calendar sequence to be forecasted as output, and constructing a ship motion calendar forecasting model; and predicting the ship motion time calendar of a period of time in the future by using a ship motion time calendar prediction model. The invention provides the feature matching which can be realized when the forecasting work is carried out aiming at different working conditions, so that the forecasting performance of the effective model is improved.

title: Infrared and visible light image fusion method and system based on relevant attention guidance
description: Aiming at the defects of the prior art, the invention provides an infrared and visible light image fusion method and system based on relevant attention guidance. The invention provides an end-to-end infrared and visible light image fusion framework for real-time processing, which adaptively retains complementary information from two modes. The fusion result achieves a better visual effect between retaining the prominent infrared object and the rich visible texture detail. The invention designs a cross-modal feature fusion module which can retain significant features and supplementary information from a global perspective. The method adopts the attention mechanism of related guidance as a fusion rule, can establish remote dependence on local characteristics of the multi-mode image, further refines the characteristic diagram and pays attention to typical targets and details of the source image.

title: A percutaneous ablation surgery planning method, device, medium and equipment
description: The invention provides a planning method, a planning device, a planning medium and planning equipment for percutaneous ablation operation. Acquiring a human body three-dimensional voxel image containing a focus, wherein the human body three-dimensional voxel image comprises different segmented areas; constructing an objective function in the form of an augmented Lagrangian function of a percutaneous ablation procedure plan to convert a percutaneous ablation procedure plan optimization problem into an augmented Lagrangian optimization problem, wherein the percutaneous ablation procedure plan comprises an ablation region and an ablation path; a reinforcement learning model for solving the objective function is constructed and trained based on the first reward function. The optimal ablation area and the optimal ablation path can be simultaneously recommended through the reinforcement learning model, the needle insertion position and the ablation area with guiding value are obtained, and the path planning quality is improved while the pre-operation path planning difficulty is reduced.

title: A multi-label and multi-level text information retrieval system
description: The invention discloses a multi-label multi-level text information retrieval system, which includes a number of big data servers, an initial selection and assignment device, a bionic connection calculation optimization module, a final selection and assignment device, an initial training device and a change device, and is characterized by: The multi-label multi-level text information retrieval system can select the most optimized server among several big data servers to provide retrieval information feedback or responses to multiple information retrieval clients. After automatic learning and optimization of the system of the present invention, each server can use the most appropriate server to respond to different retrieval command needs, which not only improves the use efficiency, allows users to obtain a better use experience, but also reduces costs. The lower server clusters gain the functionality of giant host-class servers, which results in significant cost savings.

title: Method and system for predicting and explaining film thickness process of wafer deposition
description: The invention relates to a method and system for predicting and interpreting wafer deposition film thickness processes. The method includes: obtaining production line data, preprocessing the production line data, and generating sample data; and inputting the sample data to The CatBoost model performs predictions and outputs prediction results; the SHAP model is used to process the sample data, and combined with the prediction results, the characteristics of the sample data are analyzed from the two perspectives of local interpretability and global interpretability. Describe the impact of the prediction results and generate analysis results. The beneficial effect is that the method and system enhance the credibility of the model prediction results. Those skilled in the art can make timely adjustments to the production equipment parameters based on the prediction results, thereby reducing deviations in the wafer process and achieving savings. Wafer process cost, the purpose of optimizing the wafer process flow.

title: Visual transmission design method based on artificial intelligence
description: The invention discloses a visual transmission design method based on artificial intelligence, which comprises the following steps: target setting and user research, design realization and manufacture, application of optical illusion principle, design work data transmission and emotion interaction response. The invention belongs to the technical field of computer vision, in particular to a vision transmission design method based on artificial intelligence, which adopts a space linear mapping model to adjust and optimize the display effect of a digital image by controlling the compression degree and the value of initial brightness; image enhancement is carried out by adopting a super-resolution reconstruction model, color control is carried out by using a depth latent space self-encoder model, and visual illusion is created by carrying out style shape transformation by using a style migration transformation model; adopting a flow self-adaptive allocation strategy based on a group search optimization algorithm to carry out wireless channel parallel transmission; and carrying out emotion classification prediction on the emotion state data without the tag by adopting an emotion interaction algorithm and using a semi-supervised emotion interaction model, and designing corresponding reply expression.

title: Image analysis method for 4CMOS camera acquisition
description: The invention relates to the technical field of image analysis, in particular to an image analysis method acquired by a 4CMOS camera, which still has the problems of low accuracy and low speed in acquisition and analysis of medical images at present. According to the invention, through preprocessing of in-vivo images, the accuracy of medical images is enhanced, and meanwhile, the focus range and the specific position of inflammation are given through demarcating of the inflammation area, so that the efficiency of medical diagnosis is improved.

title: Image enhancement-based hand vein image recognition method and device
description: The invention provides a hand vein image recognition method and device based on image enhancement, which relate to the technical field of vein image recognition and acquire hand vein images; preprocessing the hand vein image to respectively obtain an image sample pair data set and a data set to be enhanced; training a preset hand vein image enhancement model by using the image sample to obtain a trained hand vein image enhancement model; inputting the data set to be enhanced into a trained hand vein image enhancement model, and outputting an enhanced data set; inputting the enhanced data set into a pre-trained hand vein image recognition model, and outputting a feature extraction result of the hand vein image; the method and the device reduce the difficulty of constructing the image sample pair, improve the hand vein image recognition precision and eliminate the privacy protection risk by utilizing the feature extraction result to perform feature matching to obtain the personnel recognition result.

title: Language emotion prediction method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
description: The present disclosure provides a language emotion prediction method, device, storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of natural language processing. The method includes: obtaining a sequence to be processed, obtaining the syntactic dependency type of the word in the sequence to be processed and the attribute-aware distance of the word; performing embedding processing to obtain the contextual representation information, syntactic dependence representation information, and attribute-aware distance representation information of the word; and Obtain the initial representation information of the attribute word; use the attention mechanism for processing, and generate an adjacency matrix based on the processing results; obtain the aggregate representation information of the word by aggregating the contextual representation information, syntactic dependency representation information, and attribute perceptual distance representation information of the word; Determine the associated words of the attribute words, fuse the aggregate representation information of the associated words based on the adjacency matrix, and obtain the final representation information of the attribute words; use the emotion prediction model for processing to obtain the emotion prediction results of the attribute words. The present disclosure is beneficial to improving the accuracy of emotion prediction.

title: System and method for image-based crop identification
description: A system and method for image-based crop identification is disclosed. The image-based crop identification system includes a database, a communication module, and a model library. The database stores sample aerial photographing data and marked aerial photographing data. The communication module is coupled to the database and configured to provide the sample aerial data to a user and receive the annotated aerial data from the user. The model library is coupled to the database and configured to obtain annotated aerial data, train a crop classification model based on the annotated aerial data, and provide the trained crop classification model for subsequent crop identification. The annotated aerial data includes a determination of a type of crop present in the sample aerial data.

title: Vehicle long-term target tracking method for improving carnivorous plant algorithm optimization
description: The invention discloses a vehicle long-term target tracking method for improving optimization of a carnivorous plant algorithm, which is characterized in that a gradient histogram of a tracking area direction is extracted as a characteristic template, and a carnivorous plant algorithm tracking frame is designed based on a Pasteur distance similarity function; secondly, a short-term memory module is designed to predict initialized individuals of carnivorous plant algorithms in the tracking process, and a random following strategy and a population dividing mechanism are designed in the iterative process and are introduced into a tracking frame as a searching strategy; based on the directional gradient histogram, two layers of Conv2-1 and Conv4-3 features in ResNet-50 are fused, an adaptive learning rate dynamic updating template is designed, and a two-dimensional proportion sensing factor is added on the population dimension to adapt to the scale change of a target window. Experimental results show that the method can adapt to environmental changes in complex scenes, stably track the target vehicle for a long time, and greatly improve tracking precision and robustness compared with the prior art.

title: Recommendation methods, apparatus, computer equipment and storage media for production and sales products
description: The present application relates to a method, an apparatus, a computer device, a storage medium and a computer program product for recommending production and sales. The method comprises the steps of determining corresponding nodes of a product to be recommended in a pre-built product sales knowledge graph, generating sales characterization information of the product to be recommended based on association information of the corresponding nodes, wherein the association information comprises sales information of the corresponding nodes and product characterization information or sales characterization information of the association nodes of the corresponding nodes, calling a trained prediction model, and performing prediction processing on the sales characterization information and user characterization information of a user to be recommended to obtain recommendation degree of the product to be recommended. The method can improve the recommendation matching degree of the products and the sales products.

title: Training method, application method and medium for composite material shaft tube damage identification network
description: The invention discloses a training method, an application method and a medium of a damage identification network of a composite material shaft tube, wherein the training method comprises the following steps: respectively applying bending loads to a plurality of shaft tubes with layered damage degrees at different positions by adopting a preset finite element analysis method, and determining shaft tube strain information under different damage conditions; inputting the axle tube strain information as a training sample set to a constructed damage identification network, determining a predicted axle tube damage condition, and determining a loss function according to the true damage condition and the predicted damage condition, wherein the damage identification network is a DNN neural network model; and adjusting parameters of the damage identification network according to the value of the loss function until convergence conditions are met, and determining the damage identification network with complete training. The invention realizes the purpose of accurately identifying and positioning the layering damage of the composite material.

title: A method to optimize the design of marine nuclear power lubricating oil system
description: The invention is a method for optimizing the design of a marine nuclear power lubricating oil system. The present invention relates to the technical field of nuclear power plant optimization. The present invention abandons the traditional design method of the lubricating oil system and speeds up the design; different optimization plans can be generated according to different optimization tables; the generated plans satisfy a variety of preset constraints. ; Use the data storage and output functions of the model library to make the design results more accurate; improve the traditional genetic algorithm and improve its ability to avoid premature maturity.

title: Shaft seal control early warning method and system for mechanical seal
description: The application discloses a shaft seal control early warning method and a shaft seal control early warning system for mechanical seal, belonging to the field of intelligent machinery, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of compensation piece images through a compensation structure detection module; obtaining compression lengths of a plurality of compensators and obtaining a compensating force data sequence; obtaining a film thickness data sequence through a lubricating film detection module; acquiring a plurality of dry friction parameters and total dry friction parameters according to the film thickness data sequence and the compensation force data sequence; obtaining a dry friction balance coefficient according to the plurality of dry friction parameters; and acquiring a leakage risk level by combining the total dry friction parameter and the dry friction balance coefficient, and carrying out early warning by a control early warning module. The application solves the technical problems of low reliability and safety of the mechanical seal caused by the fact that the failure risk of the shaft seal cannot be accurately and comprehensively judged in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of realizing intelligent evaluation and early warning of the failure risk of the shaft seal and improving the reliability and safety of the mechanical seal through multi-azimuth detection and parameter calculation.

title: Conference file digital management system, method and electronic equipment
description: The present invention provides a conference archive digital management system, method and electronic device, the conference archive digital management system includes: an archive generation module, which generates digital archive information by digital processing of conference data information; a directory management module, which establishes a digital archive directory based on the metadata management strategy for the digital archive information; an archive management module, which processes the digital archive information based on a preset archive management specification and establishes a digital archive resource library; an archive utilization and visualization module, which realizes archive visualization and/or multi-dimensional retrieval based on the digital archive resource library. The present invention improves the efficiency and accuracy of archive management by establishing a systematic digital archive resource library; achieves green environmental protection and reduces costs by reducing the use and storage of paper archives; supports remote sharing and access, which is convenient for users to share and access conference materials anytime and anywhere, realize collaborative office, and improve work efficiency.

title: Data rationality verification method, system and storage medium based on semantic integrity
description: The invention discloses a data rationality verification method, system and storage medium based on semantic integrity, constructing a city simulation model based on digital twins; acquiring dynamic data and static data in the model; based on the CNN semantic analysis algorithm, The dynamic data and static data are extracted based on relationships, entities, and attributes, and the graph is built based on the extracted data to form an urban knowledge graph; within a preset time period, the model data is obtained in real time, and the model data is processed based on the city Data classification and data integrity calculation and analysis of the knowledge graph are performed to obtain data integrity and data rationality; a data adjustment plan is generated based on the data integrity and data rationality. The invention can make full use of the semantic information in the model, verify data consistency and integrity, and improve the accuracy and stability of the model.

title: Visual question-answering method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: Embodiments of the present application provide a visual question and answer method, system, electronic device and storage medium, which belong to the field of computer vision technology. The method includes: obtaining the target image and the corresponding natural language question; based on the target image and the natural language question, performing knowledge retrieval in the preset knowledge graph to obtain candidate knowledge; and performing associated queries based on the target image and the natural language question. The corresponding implicit knowledge is obtained, and the target question is obtained based on the implicit knowledge; then, the text features corresponding to the target question and the target image features corresponding to the image are spliced to obtain multi-modal query information; and then, the multi-modal query information is obtained The attention mechanism is fused with the candidate knowledge to obtain fine-grained information; finally, the multi-modal query information and the fine-grained information are feature fused to obtain the target feature information, and the query is performed based on the target feature information to obtain the target answer. This application can improve the accuracy of visual question answering.

title: Action perception model construction system and method based on physical layer semantics and server
description: The invention discloses an action perception model construction system, method and server based on physical layer semantics, which belong to the technical field of gesture perception model construction. The construction method includes: using an aggregation training method to realize a large-scale distributed wireless perception system. Model collaborative training. When performing aggregation, a personalized aggregation model is customized for each local node. The aggregation models downloaded by different local nodes are not necessarily the same. The greater the difference between models, the worse the effect of collaboration (i.e., model aggregation) between models will be, and the slower the convergence speed of the model will be. Therefore, generating personalized aggregation models based on model differences can, on the one hand, increase the similarity between models, help local models get more help from other nodes, and speed up the convergence of model training. On the other hand, through fixed values The personalized aggregation model can better adapt to the environment and has higher prediction accuracy in the environment.

title: Self-cleaning water quality monitoring system and detection method
description: This application provides a self-cleaning water quality monitoring system and detection method, which relates to the field of water quality monitoring. The monitoring system includes multiple water quality monitoring devices, a network transmission unit that is communicatively connected to the multiple water quality monitoring devices, and a cloud that is communicatively connected to the network transmission unit. Server; the water quality monitoring device includes a housing, a sensor unit and an electrical unit are provided inside the housing, and a self-cleaning unit is provided outside the housing; the electrical unit includes a communication module and a signal transmitter, and the communication module is electrically connected to the signal transmitter; The self-cleaning unit and the sensor unit are respectively connected to the communication module, and the communication module is connected to the network transmission unit. Through the self-cleaning function of the self-cleaning unit, the accuracy, reliability and robustness of the water quality sensor for long-term immersion in aquaculture waters for online monitoring of dissolved oxygen are improved.

title: Transaction display method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The present application relates to a transaction display method, device, computer equipment and storage medium. The method includes: if it is detected that the current transaction has been executed, obtain the transaction element information of the current transaction; input the transaction element information of the current transaction into the transaction classification model to obtain the classification result of the current transaction; and determine the classification result of the current transaction based on the classification result. Transaction display content, and output transaction display content. Through the above method, transaction data can be accurately displayed to users.

title: A system dynamic security assessment method and system based on abnormal alarms
description: The invention discloses a system dynamic security assessment method and system based on abnormal alarm, which relate to the technical field of system security assessment and security protection and comprise the following steps: acquiring abnormal alarm information generated by a system terminal and network equipment and constructing an alarm map; analyzing and processing the abnormal alarm information and outputting an abnormal alarm record; updating the alert profile based on the anomaly alert record; and carrying out system security assessment based on the updated alarm map. Based on the alarm information generated by the abnormality detection algorithm, the invention carries out system security assessment aiming at unknown type attacks, and reduces false alarm by dynamically constructing an alarm map and comprehensively analyzing the abnormal alarm information existing in the system, so that the security assessment result is more reliable. Based on the alarm map, the execution flow of the unknown type attack is revealed, so that a system security manager can conveniently formulate an optimal defense strategy. The execution flow of the attack is used as a safety evaluation basis, so that the evaluation result can be visually and quantitatively displayed, and the method is easy to understand and apply.

title: Converter steelmaking oxygen blowing amount prediction method, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The invention provides a converter steelmaking oxygen blowing amount prediction method, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The invention belongs to the technical field of prediction, and the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first detection data of a first oxygen blowing stage, inputting the first detection data into a preset oxygen blowing amount prediction model, and predicting to obtain the oxygen blowing amount of a second oxygen blowing stage; acquiring second detection data of a second oxygen blowing stage, and judging whether the molten steel meets tapping requirements according to the second detection data; the second detection data comprise data obtained by the second sub-gun detection; if the molten steel does not meet the tapping requirement, the second detection data and the first detection data are input into an oxygen blowing quantity prediction model, and oxygen blowing quantity in the supplementary blowing stage is predicted. According to the invention, the automatic prediction of the oxygen blowing amount can be realized through the preset oxygen blowing amount prediction model, the accuracy and stability of the oxygen blowing amount prediction are improved, and the prediction of the oxygen blowing amount in two stages can be completed only by one oxygen blowing amount prediction model, so that the occupation of memory resources is reduced.

title: Engine compression part flow field prediction method, device, equipment and storage medium
description: The present disclosure relates to methods, devices, equipment and storage media for predicting the flow field of engine compression components. The above method includes: obtaining the working condition information of the compressor; the working condition information includes the total flow rate and rotation speed of the compressor; acquiring the first flow rate corresponding to the working condition information. Data set; the first data set includes the outlet cross-section information of the compressor; a flow field prediction model is constructed based on the first data set; and based on the flow field prediction model, a prediction result of the working condition information to be predicted of the compressor is obtained. The method provided by this disclosure strengthens the physical correlation between each point in the flow field by constructing a flow field prediction model that reflects the deviation of the flow field details and component characteristics, ensuring that the macroscopic performance of the flow field is consistent with the component characteristics, and improving the accuracy of the flow field prediction results. sex. On the other hand, in the process of building the flow field prediction model, a multi-stage adaptive sampling strategy is used to update the first data set, thereby improving the accuracy of the flow field prediction model and reducing the computing resources and time costs in the construction process.

title: Investment method based on multi-update particle swarm
