description: The invention relates to the technical field of financial investment, especially an investment method based on multi-update particle swarm, which includes the following process: S1. Initialize the particle swarm and assign it an initial position and speed, taking into account problem domain constraints; use an objective function to evaluate particle fitness, It is updated based on historical and global optimal information; it integrates elimination selection and parent selection strategies to screen the current particle swarm and perform particle reorganization and evolution; it terminates when the preset number of iterations is reached or specific convergence criteria are met. Optimize the process and output the current best portfolio. The present invention also designed a prototype system for investment portfolio optimization based on the real financial market, and performed performance verification on actual market data. This method not only performs well in the traditional stock and bond investment fields, but can also be widely used in futures and foreign exchange. , emerging digital currencies and other complex investment fields.

title: Unknown malicious software detection method and device based on hypersphere embedding and distributed external sample detection
description: The invention discloses an unknown malware detection method and device based on hyperspheric embedding and out-of-distribution sample detection. The method includes: using malware PE files to extract and fuse malware feature vectors; using neural networks to perform feature processing to obtain low-dimensional Features are represented and regularized to a hypersphere; loss is calculated based on weights and the neural network is trained; the trained neural network is used to detect and calculate the Mahalanobis distance and obtain a confidence score; determine whether the malware sample to be tested is unknown malicious according to the set threshold software. The present invention proposes a new idea that comprehensively utilizes multiple features and hyperspherical embedding, comprehensively utilizes multiple feature information, and extracts compact feature representation of malware through embedding and hyperspherical modeling, thereby improving the feature expression ability and Generalization capabilities enable more accurate detection of the presence of unknown malware and adapt to the ever-changing malware threat environment.

title: Photovoltaic power station power prediction method and system based on image restoration
description: The present invention relates to the technical field of photovoltaic power station power prediction, and specifically to a photovoltaic power station power prediction method and system based on image restoration. The method uses the relationship between the irradiance and output power of a photovoltaic array, and the relationship between the irradiance of a photovoltaic array and the pixel change caused by the photovoltaic array being blocked by clouds to map the output power of the photovoltaic array to cloud features, and constructs a virtual cloud map capable of describing the cloud features. The virtual cloud map is restored using an image restoration model to restore the incomplete parts of the virtual cloud map caused by the photovoltaic array being blocked by clouds. The restored virtual cloud map is combined with the actual output power of the photovoltaic power station to realize photovoltaic power prediction under dynamic cloud occlusion, and the resolution of the prediction can be improved to seconds.

title: Wavefront information detection method for rotating pupil imaging system
description: The invention relates to the technical field of space astronomical telescopes, and in particular to a wavefront information detection method of a rotating pupil imaging system. First, according to the parameters of the rotating pupil imaging system itself, the pupil function of the rotating pupil imaging system is obtained by combining the phase function to obtain the rotation. The pupil function relationship existing in the pupil imaging system at different angles; based on the images captured at different angles by the rotating pupil imaging system, the pupil function and the pupil function relationship, a method for measuring the relationship between the reconstructed image and the actual collected image is constructed. The evaluation function of the degree of similarity between the two-dimensional polynomial coefficients is the iterative optimization through the optimization algorithm, and the two-dimensional polynomial coefficients that minimize the evaluation function are obtained. The two-dimensional polynomial coefficients are the wavefront information of the rotating pupil imaging system. This method uses its pupil to solve the wavefront information of the image formed by the target at different angles without adding any additional equipment, making the imaging system simpler and free of defocus errors and non-common path errors.

title: One record supply chain order logistics freight transportation information sharing and push method
description: This application discloses a method of sharing and pushing information based on one record supply chain order logistics and freight transportation, involving the field of logistics technology, including step S1, obtaining multiple information modules for logistics data management. The multiple information modules include a data standard module and a data sharing module. , data push module, authority control module, data exchange module; Step S2, determine the data processing set of each information module based on multiple information modules; Step S3, input multiple data processing sets into the data sharing platform, establish Shared connection with the participant; the shared connection includes the user information of the participant and the sharing requirements of the participant; step S4, determine the decision tree according to the shared connection, and determine the output shared connection according to the first feature and the second feature of the decision tree Path; it can classify order data according to the set decision tree to improve the effect of order decision-making.

title: Autonomous driving methods and systems using sensors to supplement cameras
description: The present invention relates to the technical fields of automatic driving and image recognition, and in particular to an automatic driving method and system that uses sensors to supplement cameras. The invention proposes an automatic driving method that uses sensors to supplement the camera. It combines the images captured by the camera to determine the scene and obstacle distance, selects the target radar, starts the target radar to obtain the radar point cloud image; inputs the captured image and radar point cloud image into the obstacles. Recognition model, obtain the obstacle recognition results output by the obstacle recognition model. The automatic driving method proposed by the present invention using sensors to supplement cameras can achieve a relative balance and obtain higher average accuracy and relatively lower time consumption.

title: Back door removing method based on Li Puxi Z inspection of channel
description: The invention discloses a backdoor removal method based on channel Lipchitz review, which is applied in the field of information security technology. Including: S1. Determine the channel to be detected, load the deep neural network, and obtain the usage rights and parameter access rights of the deep neural network; S2. Use the parameters that have obtained the usage rights and parameter access rights of the deep neural network to calculate the Lipschitz of each channel. Calculate the constant CLC and the upper bound UCLC of the Lipschitz constant CLC; S3. Use the upper bound UCLC of the Lipschitz constant CLC obtained in S2 to detect the channel to be detected in S1 and obtain the abnormal channel; S4. Perform the abnormal channel calculation on the abnormal channel obtained in S3. Pruning to achieve security protection against backdoor attacks. The present invention realizes security protection against deep neural network backdoor risks.

title: Human body model modeling method and system based on video sequences
description: This application relates to human body model modeling methods and systems. Video sequences depicting a person in a medical environment may be obtained and used to determine one or more human models of the person. A first human body model characterizing a first posture or a first body shape of a person may be determined based on a first subset of images from the video sequence, while a second posture characterizing the person may be determined based on a second subset of images from the video sequence. or a second human body model of a second body shape. The second 2D or 3D representation of the person may include an adjustment of the first 2D or 3D representation of the person based on the observation of the person provided by the second subset of images.

title: A multi-UAV intelligent path planning method based on deep reinforcement learning
description: The invention provides a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle intelligent path planning method based on deep reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle moving edge calculation and comprises the following steps: s1, establishing a basic framework of an unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary movement edge calculation model under a static task scene; s2, generating a path optimization strategy according to the basic framework, wherein the optimization strategy utilizes a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm introducing an auxiliary rewarding mechanism to perform task allocation and path planning on unmanned aerial vehicles in a scene of the basic framework, and the time required by the unmanned aerial vehicles to complete all tasks is minimized on the premise that the energy of all unmanned aerial vehicles can complete system tasks. The invention introduces an auxiliary rewarding mechanism of an unsupervised reinforcement learning algorithm based on a traditional multi-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm, plans the flight path of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on optimizing the energy and flight time consumed by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and improves the processing efficiency of the unmanned aerial vehicle on tasks through the system.

title: Artificial intelligence aided heart function detection system and method
description: This application discloses an artificial intelligence-assisted heart function detection system and method, which relates to the field of intelligent detection technology. It obtains the echocardiogram and electrocardiogram of the patient being analyzed; and extracts the image features of the echocardiogram and the electrocardiogram. To obtain the echocardiographic feature map and the electrocardiographic feature map; perform enhancement processing and cross-modal interaction processing based on the spatial mutual attention mechanism on the echocardiographic feature map and the electrocardiographic feature map to obtain a multi-modal cardiac function representation feature vector ; Determine the heart function health level based on the multi-modal heart function characterization feature vector. In this way, the health level of heart function can be more accurately determined, providing more precise guidance and decision-making basis for patient diagnosis and treatment.

title: Image super-resolution reconstruction method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
description: The invention discloses an image super-resolution reconstruction method, device, computer equipment and storage medium, which include: inputting original images into a trained super-resolution reconstruction model, wherein the trained super-resolution reconstruction model is a depth classification model. Layer multi-scale attention network, including shallow feature extraction module, deep layered residual structure, upsampling module and reconstruction module; use shallow feature extraction module to extract features from the original image to obtain shallow features; through deep layering The residual structure extracts and fuses shallow features to obtain deep features; uses the upsampling module to upsample deep features to obtain upsampled features; reconstructs the upsampled features based on the reconstruction module to obtain reconstructed high-resolution images , achieving high-resolution reconstruction through adaptive feature fusion, improving the effect of image reconstruction.

title: A coarse-to-fine method for identifying enterprises in the industrial chain
description: The invention discloses a method for identifying enterprises on a Coarse-to-fine industrial chain, which comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring patent data and preprocessing the data; s2, generating a patent data pseudo tag; s3, constructing a coarse recognition network of the patents on the chain; s4, training a coarse recognition network of the patents on the chain; s5, acquiring a full-quantity invention patent identification result of the on-chain patent coarse identification network; s6, constructing a patent fine recognition network on a chain; s7, training of a patent fine recognition network on a chain; s8, acquiring patent data to be identified; s9, acquiring a patent recognition result on a chain; s10, acquiring a recognition result of the enterprise on the chain. The invention solves the problems of coarse granularity, inaccurate recognition result and the like of the enterprise recognition on the chain, and greatly improves the usability of the deep learning method on the enterprise recognition task on the industrial chain.

title: Remote sensing image roof recognition method and system based on diffusion model
description: The invention discloses a method and system for identifying roofs in remote sensing images based on a diffusion model, which includes the following steps: Step (1): Perform data preprocessing on remote sensing images to obtain standardized image data; Step (2): From step (1) Obtain standardized image data of different sizes and add different amounts of noise to the image; Step (3): Obtain the image features after adding noise in step (2), build the Unet model, spatial attention unit and lightweight change detection unit, Restoring the image; Step (4): Form a remote sensing image roof recognition model based on steps (1)-(3), and use the data set to train the model; Step (5): Based on the two evaluation indicators of F1 score and intersection-union ratio The model performance after training is evaluated. The present invention improves the accuracy of roof detection by constructing a remote sensing image roof recognition model.

title: A portable bat ultrasonic monitoring and online identification terminal
description: The invention discloses a portable bat ultrasonic detection and online identification terminal, which comprises: the device comprises a power management unit, a sound wave acquisition processing unit, an embedded microprocessor unit, a storage unit and a touch display unit; the power management unit adopts a high-efficiency low-power-consumption stabilized voltage power supply to provide electric energy for the whole system; the sound wave collecting and processing unit collects and processes bat ultrasonic signals by adopting an MEMS analog microphone; the embedded microprocessor unit converts the ultrasonic time domain signals into spectrograms of frequency domain signals, and intelligently analyzes and processes bat types based on the deep learning model; the storage unit stores the ultrasonic files by adopting a large-capacity SD card; the touch display unit performs function setting, function operation, identification result display and the like through the touch screen. The invention can collect broadband sound wave signals, in particular to collect bat ultrasonic wave signals, and can effectively solve the defect that the convolutional neural network has time loss for extracting signal characteristics and the problems that no portable bat type on-line identification equipment exists at present. The portable bat type online identification tool has the advantages of convenience in carrying and operation, high identification accuracy, high identification speed and the like, and provides a novel portable bat type online identification tool for the portable bat type online identification tool.

title: A construction quality assessment method and system based on building information model
description: The invention provides a construction quality assessment method and system based on a building information model, which relates to the field of data processing technology. In the present invention, the building information model description data to be analyzed corresponding to the target building information model is collected, and it is determined whether the building information model description data to be analyzed belongs to normal building information model description data; when the building information model description data to be analyzed belongs to normal building information In the case of model description data, multiple target building quality assessment neural networks are used to perform building quality assessment processing on the building information model description data to be analyzed to output corresponding multiple candidate building quality assessment data; multiple candidate building quality assessment The data is fused to form target building quality assessment data corresponding to the target building information model. Based on the above content, the reliability of construction quality assessment can be improved to a certain extent.

title: Semantic-based federal learning method for mobile recommendation
description: The invention relates to a semantic-based federal learning method for mobile recommendation, which aims to improve the performance of a model on the premise of protecting user privacy and simultaneously reduce heavy calculation and communication load on a server. The method provides a semantic-based optimization strategy, and uses semantic information contained in user track data to guide model training under federal learning so as to improve recommendation performance of the model. Meanwhile, the semantic knowledge does not contain user privacy information, and the semantic learning process is irreversible, so that the privacy of the user is well protected. In addition, the method adopts a three-layer federation architecture of 'client-edge-server', so as to relieve the calculation and communication pressure of the server. The introduction of edge-side also provides more available computing and communication resources for semantic optimization. Experimental results show that compared with the traditional federal learning framework, the SFL has a certain improvement in performance and efficiency.

title: Optimal scheduling method of multi-energy flow system in steel industry based on maximum entropy reinforcement learning
description: The invention provides an optimal scheduling method of a multi-energy flow system in the steel industry based on maximum entropy reinforcement learning, which belongs to the technical field of information, and comprises the steps of firstly collecting real industrial data of a site, denoising and missing data, and simplifying a site pipe network; secondly, a day-ahead model is established by considering the load balance of the multi-energy flow system, mathematical models of a byproduct gas system, a high-pressure steam system and an electric power system are established, and an operation efficiency model of the energy conversion equipment is established; establishing a gas-heat-electricity daily model by taking a byproduct gas pipe network as an input side and taking a high-pressure steam pipe network and an electric power system as an output side through an energy conversion equipment operation efficiency model, and converting the gas-heat-electricity daily model into a daily-day daily model by combining a daily model; and solving by using a solver, saving data of a solving process, and training an agent for approximating the solving process by using the saved data through a maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm so as to achieve an acceleration effect. The invention solves the conflict generated by different time scales and accelerates the solving speed.

title: Financial abnormal behavior detection method and device based on federated learning
description: The present invention can be used in the technical field of financial application of artificial intelligence technology. The present invention provides a method and device for detecting financial abnormal behavior based on federated learning. The corresponding method includes: receiving attribute data of the abnormal financial behavior to be detected; The attribute data of the abnormal financial behavior to be detected and the pre-generated behavior detection model based on federated learning determine whether the abnormal financial behavior to be detected is abnormal, wherein the behavior detection model includes a global parameter training model and a plurality of Local parameter training model; the first round of training global parameters of the global parameter training model is generated by fitting the local parameters of at least one node selected from multiple distributed nodes, and the training data of the local parameter training model contains Time weight. The present invention can break the information barriers constructed by financial institutions and effectively utilize distributed privacy data for model training to improve the identification effect of financial risks.

title: Temperature control equipment for new energy battery
description: The application provides temperature control equipment for a new energy battery, which relates to the technical field of battery pack management, wherein the equipment comprises a data acquisition unit and a controller; the data collector is used for collecting operation condition data of each battery unit in the new energy battery pack, combining a plurality of historical operation condition data to form battery condition time sequence data, and constructing input data of the corresponding battery unit according to the battery condition time sequence data and the spatial position data of the battery unit; based on the input data corresponding to each battery unit, an input data sequence is constructed; the controller is used for predicting the thermal management risk probability of each battery unit corresponding to the future time period by using the space-time cyclic neural network, and determining a corresponding temperature regulation strategy according to the thermal management risk probability. Therefore, the potential thermal management risk probability of the battery is predicted in advance, and the corresponding temperature regulation strategy is adjusted and implemented in a targeted manner, so that the strategy diversity of battery temperature regulation is realized.

title: Electric quantity calculation method and device based on neural network
description: The application belongs to the technical field of electric quantity calculation, and discloses an electric quantity calculation method and device based on a neural network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time battery data; inputting the real-time battery data into a first neural network to obtain a first electric quantity value at a corresponding moment; inputting the real-time battery data into a second neural network to obtain a second electric quantity value at each moment; obtaining a first difference value according to the first electric quantity value at the first moment and the first electric quantity value at the second moment; obtaining a power integral difference value according to the real-time battery data; obtaining an electric quantity adjustment value at the first moment based on the first difference value, the power integration difference value, the second electric quantity value at the first moment and the second electric quantity value at the second moment; and adding the electric quantity adjustment value and the first electric quantity value at the first moment to obtain an adjusted output electric quantity value. The method and the device can improve the accuracy of the electric quantity calculation result and reduce the number of samples required by training the neural network in the initial stage.

title: Knowledge perception recommendation method based on hyperbolic dynamic neural network
description: The present invention proposes a knowledge-aware recommendation method based on hyperbolic dynamic neural network, which uses knowledge graphs and user-item interaction graphs for recommendation. This method first encodes the knowledge graph and the user-item interaction graph to generate an enhanced knowledge graph and an enhanced user-item interaction graph. Then, knowledge aggregation is used to aggregate the domain information of the items in the enhanced knowledge graph to generate high-order collaboration signals of the items. Then, collaborative aggregation is used to aggregate the user's domain information in the enhanced user-item interaction graph to generate the user's high-order collaboration signal. Finally, the high-order collaboration signal of the item and the high-order collaboration signal of the user are input into the bilateral memory network for fusion, and the two representations of the item and the final embedding of the user are output, and the user's final embedding is used to distinguish the two representations of the item. The prediction score is evaluated by cosine similarity comparison in the form, which effectively improves the recommendation accuracy of the hyperbolic dynamic neural network model.

title: Test result classification method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
description: The embodiment of the invention provides a test result classification method, a test result classification device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of testing. The method comprises the following steps: inputting the screenshot of the test interface into a test result classification network comprising a first feature extraction network, a second feature extraction network, a feature splicing network and a classification network; performing feature extraction on the test interface screenshot by using a first feature extraction network to obtain a first feature map; performing feature extraction on the first feature map in parallel by using a plurality of second convolution layers in a second feature extraction network to obtain a plurality of second feature maps; splicing a plurality of second feature graphs by using a feature splicing network to obtain a spliced feature graph; and classifying the test interface screenshot based on the spliced feature map by using the classification network to obtain a classification result corresponding to the test interface screenshot. The invention parallelizes a plurality of second convolution layers, improves the classification efficiency, and avoids the problems of great increase of parameter quantity and over-fitting caused by structural expansion of the traditional convolution neural network.

title: A humanized decision-making method for urban intelligent vehicles based on social value orientation
description: The invention discloses a social value orientation-based urban intelligent vehicle personification decision-making method, which comprises the following steps: step one, collecting a motion several frames bitmap of a vehicle; step two, constructing a CNN-LSTM hybrid network, carrying out feature fusion on the output of the CNN-LSTM hybrid network, and inputting a plurality of motion frame bitmaps of the vehicle into the CNN-LSTM hybrid network to obtain predicted SVO values of different targets so as to reflect the social value orientation of the vehicle, wherein the social value orientation comprises own interests, other interests and cooperation trends; and thirdly, establishing an intelligent vehicle decision model under urban working conditions based on SACER, and generating predicted driver behaviors including behaviors such as acceleration, deceleration, lane changing and the like so as to better interact with other vehicles in traffic. The invention has the characteristics of improving humanization and safety.

title: Adaptive surface reconstruction method based on multi-scale convolution kernel
description: The present invention provides an adaptive surface reconstruction method based on a multi-scale convolution kernel. It inputs a point cloud with normal information, first aggregates the input point cloud information in an octree-based adaptive grid, and then uses The multi-scale convolution kernel calculates the distance function, and finally decodes the distance function and extracts the zero isosurface. The present invention can learn complex features and prior knowledge from data, can process noisy data more flexibly and accurately, and shows higher efficiency when processing large-scale data, which is important for three-dimensional scene reconstruction in the real world. Very important.

title: Communication method and device
description: The present application relates to the field of communication technology, and provides a communication method and device for improving network performance. A first network element obtains a first measurement quantity to be input, and obtains a first AI model. Then, the first network element inputs the first measurement quantity to be input into the first AI model to obtain a first strategy output by the first AI model. Next, the first network element executes the first strategy. Next, when the first network element determines that an abnormality occurs in the execution of the first strategy, it sends an indication message of an abnormality in the execution of the first strategy to the second network element. Network elements can perceive the execution status of other network elements executing strategies obtained based on AI models, which can improve network performance to a certain extent. In particular, when it is determined that an abnormality occurs in the execution of the first strategy, the situation is notified to other network elements, which can facilitate other network elements to respond based on the abnormality and improve network performance.

title: Image segmentation model training method, device, electronic device and storage medium
description: This application discloses an image segmentation model training method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium, which belongs to the field of artificial intelligence technology. The method includes: using the first industrial sample image set to conduct self-supervised training of the backbone network of the preset segmentation model to update the backbone network parameters of the segmentation model; loading the updated backbone network parameters as initialization, using the labeled first The second industrial sample image set is used to train the middle layer of the segmentation model to update the middle layer parameters of the segmentation model; load the updated backbone network parameters and the updated middle layer parameters as initialization, and use the The segmentation model is trained on the labeled third industry sample image set to fine-tune the middle layer parameters and output head parameters of the segmentation model to obtain the image segmentation model. The embodiment of the present application adopts a training method in which the backbone network and the middle layer are separated, which can improve the training efficiency of the model.

title: Point cloud up-sampling method and device for gradually aggregating local features
description: The invention discloses a point cloud up-sampling method and device for gradually aggregating local features, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring point cloud input data, inputting the point cloud input data into a trained point cloud up-sampling model, extracting features of the point cloud input data to obtain an nth feature, and calculating an ith neighbor index in the point cloud input data; sequentially carrying out edge recombination on the nth feature and the ith neighbor index according to the preset target multiplying power until a high-power feature reaching the preset target multiplying power is obtained; and converting the high-power characteristics to obtain and output a target point cloud. According to the method provided by the invention, the neighbor indexes are generated in the high-power feature space, the local features in the high-power space are gradually aggregated by using the neighbor indexes in the high-power space, and the feature upsampling is performed, namely the edge recombination is performed, so that the feature information of the neighbor points is aggregated on different scales, the feature information of the neighbor points can be better acquired, an upsampling point cloud with more uniform spatial distribution is generated, and a better upsampling effect can be obtained.

title: High-resolution remote sensing image water body extraction network model and method
description: The invention provides a high-resolution remote sensing image water extraction network model and method, which belongs to the field of image processing technology; it solves the problems of low water extraction accuracy and poor performance of the U-Net model when processing remote sensing images; using U-Net The encoder-decoder structure includes an encoder module, a context extraction module and a decoder module. The encoder module and the decoder module implement jump connections through the ASPP_SCBAM module; the encoder module includes multiple Dense_Block modules and multiple SCBAM modules. and multiple downsampling layers. The decoder module includes multiple upsampling layers and multiple Dense_Block modules; the Dense_Block module consists of multiple densely connected convolutional layers. The input of each convolutional layer is the output of all previous convolutional layers. Splicing in the channel dimension; the SCBAM module is a CBAM module that incorporates random pooling; the ASPP_SCBAM module includes depth-separable convolution, global average pooling and SCBAM modules; the invention is applied to remote sensing highlighted water body extraction.

title: Data center energy consumption optimization method and system based on data mechanism fusion
description: The invention discloses a data center energy consumption optimization method and system based on data mechanism fusion, which relate to the technical field of intelligent control and comprise the following steps: receiving a data center cooling system effect evaluation sample library, inputting a pre-established data center cooling system effect evaluation deep neural network and the data center cooling system effect evaluation sample library into a pre-established fitting device constructed based on a supervised learning algorithm for training, and outputting to obtain a trained data center cooling system effect evaluation deep neural network; inputting a pre-established data center cooling system fuzzy logic controller, a trained data center cooling system effect evaluation deep neural network and a data center cooling system effect evaluation sample library into a pre-established optimizer constructed based on a reinforcement learning algorithm for training, outputting to obtain the trained data center cooling system fuzzy logic controller, and deploying and applying the trained data center cooling system fuzzy logic controller.

title: A method and device for detecting smoking behavior based on video sequences
description: The invention belongs to the field of artificial intelligence, computer vision and video monitoring, and particularly relates to a smoking behavior detection method and device based on a video sequence, which are used for collecting positive and negative sample video sequences of smoking behaviors and labeling pedestrian targets and pedestrian key points on the positive sample video sequence and the negative sample video sequence; acquiring clustered continuous frame picture subgraphs of the same pedestrian target, training a key point detection model, a multi-frame key point sequence two-classification model and a cigarette single-target detection model; obtaining continuous frames to be detected, and obtaining whether the continuous frames to be detected meet smoking behavior detection conditions according to the trained model; when the smoking behavior is satisfied, the continuous frames to be detected are determined to contain the smoking behavior; the invention can be applied to smoke behavior detection in a monitoring scene. A scheme combining motion recognition based on video sequences and video frame key target detection is adopted. The condition of low smoking behavior recognition rate caused by small target size of cigarettes, changeable background of monitoring pictures and the like is easy to be improved.

title: Method for generating computer executable code for implementing artificial neural network
description: The present invention relates to a method of generating computer executable code for implementing an artificial neural network. In an example, a method includes obtaining a neural network INN having a plurality of neural layers, each layer capable of being executed according to a different implementation solution and affecting a memory allocation required for execution of the neural network and/or an execution time of the neural network, defining a maximum execution time threshold for the neural network and/or a maximum memory allocation threshold required for execution of the neural network, determining an optimal required memory allocation size for execution of the neural network from among possible implementation solutions for each layer of the neural network, determining an optimal execution time for the neural network from among possible implementation solutions for each layer of the neural network, and estimating a performance penalty or performance gain in terms of the execution time and required memory allocation for each implementation solution for each layer of the neural network.

title: A ship power monitoring system and method based on multi-sensor fusion
description: Compared with the prior art, the invention can comprehensively monitor various indexes of a ship power system by adopting a multi-sensor fusion technology and analyze data in real time, thereby improving the monitoring capability and the running efficiency of the ship power system, reducing the fault risk, judging potential fault reasons and risks by the system through processing and model analysis on data acquired in real time, providing corresponding diagnosis results and suggestions for operators, enabling the operators to know the problems of the power system more accurately, generating a state report and a trend chart of the power system by storing and analyzing historical data, intuitively displaying an interface and a simple and easy-to-use operation mode, easily acquiring monitoring information and alarm notification of the power system by the operators, and improving the flexibility and convenience of operation.

title: Intelligent contract vulnerability detection method based on semantic information guided fuzzy test
description: The present invention relates to the field of network security technology, and specifically to a smart contract vulnerability detection method based on semantic information guided fuzzy testing. The detection method determines a target function according to the relationship between functions in a to-be-tested smart contract; then, space compression, space splitting and space dimension reduction are performed on the target function to obtain a plurality of reduced-dimensionality subspaces; then, each unassigned input variable in each reduced-dimensionality subspace is assigned a value, and after combining the assigned input variable with a historical assigned variable group, a judgment is performed to generate only high-quality test cases; finally, all high-quality test cases are used to attack the to-be-tested smart contract to obtain a vulnerability detection result; the quality of the test cases generated by the detection method is better than that of the existing detection method based on fuzzy testing, and has a higher detection accuracy on the basis of low path coverage, indicating that the detection method has high detection accuracy and high detection efficiency.

title: Intent recognition and emotional text-to-speech learning system
description: An example intent-recognition system comprises a processor and memory storing instructions. The instructions cause the processor to receive speech input comprising spoken words. The instructions cause the processor to generate text results based on the speech input and generate acoustic feature annotations based on the speech input. The instructions also cause the processor to apply an intent model to the text result and the acoustic feature annotations to recognize an intent based on the speech input. An example system for adapting an emotional text-to-speech model comprises a processor and memory. The memory stores instructions that cause the processor to receive training examples comprising speech input and receive labelling data comprising emotion information associated with the speech input. The instructions also cause the processor to extract audio signal vectors from the training examples and generate an emotion-adapted voice font model based on the audio signal vectors and the labelling data.

title: System for sensory substitution by asynchronous tactile stimulation
description: The sensory substitution system comprises a portable matrix of exciters (1) that can be worn by a user in such a way that the exciters (5) are placed against the skin of a user, as well as a control circuit (8) for the exciters of the matrix. An asynchronous signal source (10) provides the control circuit with an asynchronous signal representative of visual information organized according to a matrix of pixels. This asynchronous signal comprises, for each pixel, successive events associated in an asynchronous manner with said pixel.

title: Dynamic parallelization of a calculation process
description: A system for generating a parallel calculation plan to evaluate a rule-set or a rule-based expression list by spilling the list of rule-based expressions into multiple task units and reconfiguring all independent task units at the same calculation levels into several parallelized task groups such that task units within each task group may be scheduled for parallel execution across a cluster of processing nodes. The parallelization may be dynamically determined based on generated tasks but may further be subject to an additional layer of parallelization based on range-based splitting of each task into multiple parallel executable subtasks. The final parallelized calculation plan may include a set of sequentially ordered task groups based on logical dependencies and problem partitioning with information regarding parallelized execution of each task group.

title: Methods and systems for query segmentation
description: Methods and systems for query segmentation are disclosed. In one aspects, a method includes receiving, by one or more hardware processors, a query string, the query string comprising a plurality of tokens, identifying, by the one or more hardware processors, a first token and a second token from the plurality of tokens, determining, by the one or more hardware processors, a first vector and a second vector associated with the first token and the second token respectively, determining, by the one or more hardware processors, whether to include the first and second tokens in a single query segment based on the first and second vectors, generating, by the one or more hardware processors, a plurality of query segments based on the determination; and processing, by the one or more hardware processors, the query based on the plurality of query segments.

title: Using artificial intelligence and machine learning to automatically share desired digital media
description: Artificial intelligence is utilized to automatically share a digital media. The digital media is detected. The media is analyzed using machine learning to identify whether the digital media is likely not desirable to share. In an event the digital media is not identified as not desirable to share, the digital media is automatically shared.

title: Risk address identification method, device and electronic device
description: Embodiments of the present invention provide a method and apparatus for identifying a risky address, and an electronic device. The risky address identification method comprises: obtaining a corresponding sequence of address words as a function of an input address; and based on successful address words in the address word sequence and the context semantics of the address words, performing a risk identification on the input address using a hidden Markov model and a support vector machine model.

title: RISK IDENTIFICATION METHOD AND SYSTEM BASED ON DEEP TRANSFER LEARNING
description: A method and system for risk identification based on deep transfer learning. The method consists of: generating vectors for all possible characteristics by means of a prescribed pretreatment, which allows the set of vectors to act as a visible layer input of a first RBM (ie ie, a restricted Boltzmann machine) in order to build a RBM layer; performing a transfer learning using known fraud samples, and performing a transfer-weighted BP focusing on the RBM layer constructed during the RBM build step; and to determine whether or not the RBM after BP development meets the prescribed conditions; if the RBM meets the prescribed conditions, do not increase the RBM layer and continue the next step; and if the RBM after the BP focus does not meet the prescribed conditions, repeat the RBM construction and transfer weighted BP steps. A determination model can be constructed more precisely and the emerging fraud means can be better handled in accordance with the invention.

title: Improved onboarding of entity data
description: Techniques are described herein to improve onboarding of third party entity data with existing knowledge graphs. In various implementations, a computing system associated with an existing knowledge graph may receive a request from a third party to onboard, with the existing knowledge graph, a plurality of entities. Each entity may have associated identifier(s) and relationship(s) with other entities of the plurality of entities. First third party entity data that describes the plurality of entities and associated identifiers/relationships may be received from the third party. The first third entity party data may be analyzed to identify semantic fingerprint(s) matching respective subsets of the entities. Results related to the analyzing may be determined. The results may include a statistic representing success or failure of applying rule(s) to a respective subset of entities that match a given semantic fingerprint. Remedial action(s) may be triggered based on the failure statistic.

title: Method and kit for diagnosing non celiac gluten sensitivity
description: The present invention provides means for diagnosing non celiac gluten sensitivity.

title: Product-sum calculation device, neuromorphic device, and method for determining malfunction in product-sum calculation device
description: Provided is a product-sum calculation device which, when applied to a neural network, is able to accurately detect a malfunction for which there is a risk that the performance of the neural network will be significantly lost. The product-sum calculation device (1) comprises a product calculation unit (10), a sum calculation unit (11), and a malfunction determination unit (12). The product calculation unit (10) comprises a plurality of product calculation elements (10AA – 10AC), each of the plurality of product calculation elements (10AA – 10AC) being a variable resistance element. The sum calculation unit (11) comprises an output detector (11A) for detecting the total value of the output from the plurality of product calculation elements (10AA – 10AC). The malfunction determination unit (12) determines that a malfunction has occurred when the total value detected by the output detector (11) exceeds a specified value. The specified value is a value equal to or greater than a maximum value for the total value detected by the output detector (11) when all of the plurality of product calculation elements (10AA – 10AC) are operating normally.

title: Systems and methods for modeling probability distributions
description: Systems and methods for modeling complex probability distributions are described, One embodiment includes a method for training a restricted Boltzmann machine (RBM), wherein the method includes generating, from a first set of visible values, a set of hidden values in a hidden layer of a RBM and generating a second set of visible values in a visible layer of the RBM based on the generated set of hidden values. The method includes computing a set of likelihood gradients based on the first set of visible values and the generated set of visible values, computing a set of adversarial gradients using an adversarial model based on at least one of the set of hidden values and the set of visible values, computing a set of compound gradients based on the set of likelihood gradients and the set of adversarial gradients, and updating the RBM based on the set of compound gradients.

title: Robot reacting on basis of user behavior and control method therefor
description: A robot for outputting various reactions according to user behaviors is disclosed. A control method for a robot using an artificial intelligence model, according to the present disclosure, comprises the steps of: acquiring data related to at least one user; inputting the data related to the at least one user into the artificial intelligence model as learning data so as to learn a user state for each user of which there is at least one; determining representative reactions corresponding to the user states learned on the basis of the data related to the at least one user; and inputting the input data into the artificial intelligence model so as to determine a user state of a first user and controlling the robot on the basis of a representative reaction corresponding to the determined user state, when input data related to the first user among the users, of which there is a least one, is acquired.

title: Monitoring method, recognition method, related apparatus, and system
description: Disclosed are a monitoring method, a recognition method, a related apparatus, and a system, wherein the monitoring method comprises: performing first recognition on a monitoring video to obtain a target video frame sequence; determining, according to the target video frame sequence, a target area human shape image sequence; and uploading the target area human shape image sequence to a recognition device, wherein the target area human shape image sequence is used for the recognition device to determine, by means of second recognition, whether the target area human shape image sequence comprises a target figure, and the recognition accuracy of the second recognition is higher than the recognition accuracy of the first recognition. By means of the technical solution of artificial intelligence provided by the embodiment of the present application, the sequence uploaded to a recognition device is a target area human shape image sequence obtained after first recognition, and therefore, the sequence is much smaller than the monitoring video. In this way, the quantity of data transmitted to the recognition device is reduced, and the recognition load of the recognition device is also reduced, and the recognition performed on a target figure by the recognition device is facilitated when the technical solution is applied to the field of security protection, etc.

title: Method for cutting a model of a dental arch
description: Method for cutting a three-dimensional model of a dental scene, or "scene model", said method comprising the following steps: a) acquiring a view of said scene model, referred to as the "analysis view"; b) analysing the analysis view using a neural network to identify, in said analysis view, at least one elementary area representing an element of the dental scene, and assigning a value to at least one attribute of said elementary area; c) identifying a region of the scene model represented by said elementary area on said analysis view, and assigning, in said region, a value to an attribute of said scene model according to said value of said attribute of the elementary area.

title: Facial recognition method and apparatus, terminal, and computer readable storage medium
description: The present application relates to the technical field of facial recognition, and discloses a facial recognition method and apparatus, a terminal, and a computer readable storage medium, the method comprising: acquiring a facial image of a user to be recognised; inputting the facial image into a preset facial recognition model to obtain a facial features matrix corresponding to the facial image; and, on the basis of the corresponding relationship between the facial features matrix and identity information, determining identity information corresponding to the facial features matrix of the user to be recognised. In the solution of the present application, as multi-dimensional facial features can effectively reflect the features of the facial organs in a facial image, in the case of an uncoordinated application, even if only partial facial features in a facial image of a user to be recognised can be extracted, after implementing recognition of the facial image of the user to be recognised by means of the facial recognition model, the partial features can also be accurately reflected, making determining the identity information of the user to be recognised on the basis of a facial features matrix more accurate.

title: Image processing apparatus and operation method thereof
description: Disclosed is an image processing apparatus, comprising: a memory for storing one or more instructions; and a processor for executing the one or more instructions stored in the memory, wherein the processor generates a second image by performing a deconvolution operation on a first image with a kernel including one or more weights, sets values for the one or more weights on the basis of the second image, and adjusts values for the weights on the basis of positions of the weights in the kernel.

title: Reverse debugging of software failures
description: Debugging systems are configured to resolve both memory aliasing conditions in which a write instruction is directed to an unknown destination address, and concurrency conditions in which control flow information is collected for multiple, concurrently executing threads. Recorded state values corresponding to an application's prior execution and control flow information are both obtained.

title: Controlled not gate parallelization in quantum computing simulation
description: Techniques facilitating controlled NOT gate parallelization in quantum computing simulation are provided. A system can comprise a memory that stores computer executable components and a processor that executes the computer executable components stored in the memory. The computer executable components can comprise a selector component that can select a first qubit and a second qubit. The first qubit can be a control qubit. The computer executable components can also comprise a parallelization component that can reorder the first qubit with the second qubit and a replication component that can simulate a controlled NOT gate during the reordering by the parallelization component.
